jobs.title: Screening Officer
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 per annum (Level 07), (plus 37% in lieu of benefits)
jobs.summary: Screening officer in Pretoria for the Department of Agriculture, requiring a security-related diploma or degree with one year of experience in security administration.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of grade 12 certificate and Degree / National Diploma in Security Risk Management / Policing / Police Science. Minimum of (one) 1 year experience in relevant environment. Job Related Knowledge: Knowledge on security administration. Extensive knowledge of security systems.
jobs.duties: Render security screening of new employees: Receive request from Human Resource Administration. Register in screening databases. Receive screening request from various branches. Conduct security screening for special events. Take fingerprints of candidates. Retrieve security screening information from internal and external databases: Conduct credit check verification. Conduct criminal check verification. Conduct qualification verification. Identity verification. Conduct employment check verification. Liaise with State Security Agency and Police for screening matters: Conduct integrity checks. Conduct administration of security and background processes: Open screening files. Compile security screening request letter to SSA and SAPS. Distribute security report to HRA.
jobs.enquiries: Mr M Mnguni Tel No: (012) 319 7127
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to 20 Steve Biko Street, Agriculture Place, Arcadia, Pretoria, 0002 or by email SOrecruit99@nda.gov.za.
jobs.notes: EE Target: Africans, Coloured, Whites, Indians and Persons with disability will be given preference To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful competition of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Application: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Due to high volumes, the Department will not acknowledge receipt of applications. Communication will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DOA is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. ERRATUM: The erratum issued on the Public Service Circular regarding the withdraw the post of Senior Security Officer with Ref No: 3/3/1/83/2026 which was published in the Public Service Vacancy Circular 35 dated 02 October 2026 has been withdrawn, the Department will continue to fill the post. OTHER POST

af.title: Siftingsbeampte
af.summary: Siftingsbeampte in Pretoria vir die Department of Agriculture, wat 'n sekuriteitsverwante diploma of graad vereis met een jaar se ervaring in sekuriteitsadministrasie.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Graad / Nasionale Diploma in Security Risk Management / Policing / Police Science. Minimum van (een) 1 jaar ervaring in relevante omgewing. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van sekuriteitsadministrasie. Uitgebreide kennis van sekuriteitsstelsels.
af.duties: Lewer sekuriteitsifting van nuwe werknemers: Ontvang versoeke van Human Resource Administration. Registreer in siftingsdatabasisse. Ontvang siftingsversoeke van verskeie takke. Voer sekuriteitsifting vir spesiale geleenthede uit. Neem vingerafdrukke van kandidate. Haal sekuriteitsiftinginligting uit interne en eksterne databasisse: Voer kredietverifiering uit. Voer misdadigerverifiering uit. Voer kwalifikasieverifiering uit. Identiteitsverifiering. Voer indiensnemingsverifiering uit. Skakel met State Security Agency en Police oor siftingsake: Voer integriteitsondersoeke uit. Voer administrasie van sekuriteits- en agtergrondprosesse uit: Maak siftingslêers oop. zu.title: Inkosi Yesikrini
zu.summary: Inkosi yesikrini ePretoria kumnyango wezolimo, edinga idiploma noma idigri ehlobene nokuvikela okunomunyaka wokuhlolwa kokuvikela kahle.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nesisitifiketi samabanga ayi-12 nge-Digri / i-Diploma Yesizwe ekuphathweni kwengozi yokuvikela / ePoliseni / eSayensi Yepolisa. Okungenani unyaka owodwa wokuhlolwa kwendawo ehlobene nalokho. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kokuvikela. Ulwazi olwanela ngezinhlela zokuvikela.
zu.duties: Nikela ngokuhlola kokuvikela abasebenzi abasha: Yamukela isicelo esivela Kuphathwa Kwabasebenzi. Bhalisa kumathebhisi wekuhlola. Yamukela isicelo sokuqashwa esivela kumabhulashi ahlukene. Yenza ukuhlola kokuvikela ngezinkathi ezikhethekile. Thathe izigxivizo zezandla zabafaka izicelo. Lafa ulwazi lokuqashwa kokuvikela kumathebhisi angaphakathi nangaphandle: Yenza ukuqinisekiswa kokuhlolwa kwemali. Yenza ukuqinisekiswa kokuhlolwa kwebangelo. Yenza ukuqinisekiswa kwemfundo. Ukuqinisekiswa kobunikazi. Yenza ukuqinisekiswa kohlolwa lomsebenzi. Xhumana ne-Agensi Yokuvikela IsiZwe nabePhoyisa ngemayelana nokuqashwa: Yenza izihlolwa zokuzinza. Yenza ukuphathwa kwezinhlela zokuvikela nokuza kusemu: Vula amafayela okuhlola. Hlola incwadi yesicelo sokuqashwa kokuvikela eya e-SSA nase-SAPS. Sabelisa umbiko wokuqashwa kokuvikela kuHRA.

xh.title: Iofisa Yokuhlola
xh.summary: Iofisa yokuhlola ePretoria kwisebe le Agriculture, efuna idiploma okanye idigri ehlotshaniswa nokhuseleko eneyear enye yamava kulawulo lokhuseleko.
xh.requirements: Abafakeli kufuneba banesatifikethi sebanga le 12 nge Degree / National Diploma kwi Security Risk Management / Policing / Police Science. Ubuncinane beyear (enye) 1 yamava kwendawo ehlotshanayo. Ulwazi oluhlotshanana nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngolawulo lokhuseleko. Ulwazi olubanzi lwesixokelelwano sokhuseleko.
xh.duties: Yenza ukholo lokhuseleko kubasebenzi abasha: Yamkela isicelo kwi Human Resource Administration. Bhalisa kwiziseko zedata zokuhlola. Yamkela izicelo zokuhlola kwizithili ezahlukeneyo. Yenza ukholo lokhuseleko kwiifestile ezikhethekileyo. Thathe izigqubudlo zabafakeli. Khupha ulwazi lokholo lokhuseleko kuziseko zedata zangaphakathi nangaphandle: Yenza ukuqinisekisa ukuhlolwa kwekredite. Yenza ukuqinisekisa ukuhlolwa kwezenzo ezingezomthetho. Yenza ukuqinisekisa izifundo. Ukuqinisekisa ubuni. Yenza ukuqinisekisa ukuhlolwa kobomi bomsebenzi. Xhumana ne State Security Agency nePolice kumabhalo wokuhlola: Yenza ukuhlola ukuzithoba. Yenza ulawulo lweenqubo zokhuseleko nembali: Vula iifayile zokuhlola. Hlela ileta yesicelo sokholo lokhuseleko iya kwi SSA ne SAPS. Sabelisa ingxelo yokhuseleko kwi HRA.

jobs.title: Director: Public Examination
jobs.closing_date_text: 06 November 2026 FOR ATTENTION : Ms N Monyela/ Mr M Segowa
jobs.summary: Director of Public Examinations at the Department of Basic Education in Pretoria, managing Grade 12 question paper setting and national quality assurance for school-based assessment.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate NQF Level 7 qualification (as recognised by SAQA) in Education or a related field. A postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage. A minimum of five (5) years' experience at a middle/senior management level, of which at least three (3) years must be within the education assessment and examinations. Sound knowledge curriculum Policies and Assessment Policies. Sound knowledge of the National Senior Certificate (NSC) examination system, including question paper development, moderation, standardisation processes, quality assurance processes, marking, monitoring of examinations, examinations policy and examination irregularities. Working knowledge of the General and Further Education and Training Quality Assurance Act, 2001 and the Regulations Pertaining to the Conduct, Administration and Management of the NSC Examinations. Knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act, 1999, and other relevant prescripts governing public examinations administration. Proven project management, strategic leadership, and stakeholder liaison skills, including engagement with provincial education departments, examiners, moderators, and Umalusi. Process competencies: Knowledge Management; Service Delivery Innovation; Report Writing; Problem Solving and Analysis; Client Orientation and Customer Focus; and Communication. Core competencies: Strategic Capability and Leadership; Programme and Project Management; Financial Management; Knowledge Management; People Management and Empowerment; Communication; Innovation; and Creativity. A valid driver's licence and willingness to travel. The incumbent will undergo a vetting process through the State Security Agency before assumption of duty.
jobs.duties: Manage, coordinate and support the activities of the Directorate: Public Examinations. Facilitate the setting of high-quality Grade 12 question papers for the National Senior Certificate examination and the Senior Certificate. Enhance the National quality assurance system for School Based assessment in Grade 12. Facilitate the implementation of high quality and standardised marking of the National Senior Certificate (NSC) and Senior Certificate (SC) across all marking centres and pilot e-marking. Support and co-ordinate the implementation of the NSC and SC examinations across the nine Provincial Education Departments. Manage irregularities and enhance the integrity of the NSC. Contribute to strengthening communication.

af.title: Direkteur: Openbare Eksamens
af.summary: Direkteur van Openbare Eksamens by die Department of Basic Education in Pretoria, wat die opstel van Graad 12-vraestelle en nasionale kwaliteitsversekering vir skoolgebaseerde assessering bestuur.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike NQF Level 7-kwalifikasie (soos deur SAQA erken) in Onderwys of 'n verwante veld. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/seniorbestuursvlak, waarvan ten minste drie (3) jaar binne die onderwysassessering en -eksamens moet wees. Deeglike kennis van kurrikulumbelied en assesseringsbeleide. Deeglike kennis van die National Senior Certificate (NSC)-eksamenstelsel, insluitend vraestelontwikkeling, moderering, standaardiseringsprosesse, kwaliteitsversekeringsprosesse, nasien, monitering van eksamens, eksamenbeleid en eksamenonreëlmatighede. Werkende kennis van die General and Further Education and Training Quality Assurance Act, 2001 en die Regulations Pertaining to the Conduct, Administration and Management of the NSC Examinations. Kennis van die Public Finance Management Act, 1999, en ander relevante voorskrifte wat openbare eksamenadministrasie regeer. Bewese vaardighede in projekbestuur, strategiese leierskap en belanghebbendekommunikasie, insluitend betrokkenheid by provinsiale onderwysdepartemente, eksamineerders, modereerders en Umalusi. Prosesbevoegdhede: Kennisbestuur; Diensleweringinnovassie; Verslagdoening; Probleemoplossing en -analise; Kliëntoriëntasie en Kliëntfokus; en Kommunikasie. Kernbevoegdhede: Strategiese Vermoë en Leierskap; Program- en Projekbestuur; Finansiële Bestuur; Kennisbestuur; Personeelsbestuur en -bemagtiging; Kommunikasie; Innovasie; en Kreatiwiteit. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te reis. Die ampsdraer sal 'n ondersoekproses deur die State Security Agency deurloop voor die aanvaarding van pligte.
af.duties: Bestuur, koördineer en ondersteun die aktiwiteite van die Direktoraat: Openbare Eksamens. Fasiliteer die opstel van hoëgehalte Graad 12-vraestelle vir die National Senior Certificate-eksamen en die Senior Certificate. Verbeter die nasionale kwaliteitsversekeringstelsel vir skoolgebaseerde assessering in Graad 12. Fasiliteer die implementering van hoëgehalte en gestandaardiseerde nasien van die National Senior Certificate (NSC) en Senior Certificate (SC) oor alle nasientsentra en loods e-nasien. Ondersteun en koördineer die implementering van die NSC- en SC-eksamens oor die nege provinsiale onderwysdepartemente. Bestuur onreëlmatighede en verbeter die integriteit van die NSC. Dra by tot die versterking van kommunikasie.

zu.title: Umphathi: Izivivinyo Zomphakathi
zu.summary: Umphathi Wezivivinyo Zomphakathi eKuphathweni KweMfundo Eyisisekelo ePretoria, ephatha ukulungiselelwa kwamaphepha ezinkinga ebangeni le-Grade 12 kanye nokuqinisekiswa kobunjiniyela kazwelonke kwesilinganiso sezikole.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ezingeni le-NQF Level 7 (njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA) kwe-Education noma inkambu ehlobene. Ize kube yinzuzo ukuba nesiqu sokuthuthuka. Okungenani isipho sethu (5) seminyaka yohlelo ezingeni laphathi eliphakathi/eliphezulu, lapho okungenani iminyaka emithathu (3) kufanele ibe ngaphakathi kokuqashwa kwemfundo kanye nezivivinyo. Ulwazi oluhle lwemigomo yohlelo lokufunda kanye nemigomo yesilinganiso. Ulwazi oluhle wesistimu yesivivinyo se-National Senior Certificate (NSC), okuhlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa kwamaphepha ezinkinga, ukulinganisela, inqubo yokulinganisa, izinqubo zokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi, ukumaka, ukugqamisa izivivinyo, umgomo wezivivinyo kanye nokungalungile kwesivivinyo. Ulwazi lokusebenza lwe-General and Further Education and Training Quality Assurance Act, 2001 kanye ne-Regulations eziphathelene nokwenza, ukuphatha nokulawula izivivinyo ze-NSC. Ulwazi lwe-Public Finance Management Act, 1999, kanye namanye amagazethi ahlobene aphilisa izivivinyo zomphakathi. Ubungako obuveziwe bokuphatha amaphrojekthi, ukuletha ubuhlakani obusobala, kanye nokuxhumana nabahlanganyeli, okuhlanganisa ukuzibandakanya namaphatho emfundo ezifundazweni, ababuki, abalinganisi, kanye ne-Umalusi. Amakhono inqubo: Ukuphatha Ulwazi; Intuthuko Yokulethwa Kwezinsiza; Ukubhala Imbiko; Ukuxazulula Izinkinga Nokuhlaziya; Ukuqondiswa Kabathengi Nokugxila Kumthengi; kanye Nokuxhumana. Amakhono okuyikhongo: Ikhono Esubukhali Sokubhala Uhlelo Nobukhathi; Ukuphatha Uhlelo Namaphrojekthi; Ukuphatha Izimali; Ukuphatha Ulwazi; Ukuphatha Abantu Nokubakhuthaza; Ukuxhumana; Intuthuko; kanye Nokuqamba. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile kanye nokuzimisela ukuhamba. Lowo ozoqashwa uzodlula inqubo yokuhlola nge-State Security Agency ngaphambi kokuqala umsebenzi.
zu.duties: Phatha, hlanganisa futhi usekele imisebenzi yeDirectorate: Public Examinations. Yisa phambili ukulungiselelwa kwamaphepha ezinkinga ebangeni le-Grade 12 ahle kakhulu esivivinyweni se-National Senior Certificate kanye ne-Senior Certificate. Yisa phambili isistimu kazwelonke yokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi yesilinganiso sezikole ebangeni le-Grade 12. Yisa phambili ukusetshenziswa kokumaka okuhle kakhulu nokulinganiswayo kwe-National Senior Certificate (NSC) kanye ne-Senior Certificate (SC) kuzo zonke izikhungo zokumaka futhi uvavaye i-e-marking. Sekela futhi uhlanganise ukusetshenziswa kwezivivinyo ze-NSC ne-SC kuzona zonke izifundazwe ezinguyishumi ze-Provincial Education Departments. Phatha okungalungile futhi uthuthukise ukuzinza kwe-NSC. Wogezele ekwenzeni ukuxhumana kube namandla.

xh.title: Director: Public Examination
xh.summary: Umntu oLawula Public Examinations e-Department of Basic Education e-Pretoria, elawuleni ukubeka kwepepha lombuzo le-Grade 12 kunye noqinisekiso lwekhwalithi yezwe lonke mayela nokuqinisekiswa kokuqondiswa kwesikolo.
xh.requirements: Ifomali ekufanelekileyo yenqanaba le-NQF Level 7 (njengokunqatyiwa yi-SAQA) kwi-Education okanye indawo enxulumeneyo. Ifomali yangemva kweedigiri iya kuba luncedo elongezelelweyo. Amava amfutshane aneminyaka emihlanu (5) kwinqanaba lolawulo lolulinganiselo/oluphezulu, apho iminyaka elishumi (3) kufuneka ibe ngaphakathi kokulinganiswa kobugcisa nokuphangela. Ukwazi okuwaka ngemigaqo yesifundo nokulinganiswa kobugcisa. Ukwazi okuwaka ngonkqubo ye-National Senior Certificate (NSC) yokuphangela, kuquka ukuphuhliswa kwepepha lombuzo, ukulinganisela, iinkqubo zolungelelwaniso, iinkqubo zokuthembisa igqwethe, ukuphawula, ukulawula iimviwo, iinkqacholo zokuphangela nokungalunganga kokuphangela. Ukwazi okusebenzayo nge-General and Further Education and Training Quality Assurance Act, 2001 kunye nee-Regulations ezithintayo nokuphathwa, lolawulo lolungelelwaniso lweeksonde ze-NSC. Ukwazi ngo-Public Finance Management Act, 1999, nakwezinye iingqiqo ezingqamanyeneyo ezilawula uphathwa lweeksonde zabantu. Amava abonakalayo oLawulo loMsebenzi, inkokheli eya kuyo, kwaye unxibelelane nabathintekayo, kuquka nabanxibelelwano namasebe e-provincial education departments, iimviwo, abalinganisi, kunye ne-Umalusi. Iimfuno zenkqubo: Ukwazi uLawulo loGcino; Iveliso elisha loNyikelo; UkuBhala iiMbeko; Ukuxazula iingxaki noNqaku lolungelaniso; uMjongwe kwiKhasi noQwalaselo loMthengi; kunye noNxibelelwano. Iimfuno ezingundoqo: Ikhono leNkokheli noLungelelwaniso; ULawulo loNkqubo noMsebenzi; uLawulo lwezeMali; uLawulo loGcino; uLawulo lwaBantu noNyanzeliso; uNxibelelwano; iNnovation; kunye noBulumko. Ilayisenisi yokushayela egyozoneyo kunye nesabelo sokuhamba. Umntu oza kuthathwa kwindawo leya uya kuqwalaselwa yi-State Security Agency phambi kokuthatha kwindawo yomsebenzi.
xh.duties: Phatha, ulungelelanise kwaye uncedise imisebenzi yeDirectorate: Public Examinations. Qhubekea ekubekeni iipepha zemibuzo zegreyidi 12 ezilungileyo ze-National Senior Certificate examination kunye ne-Senior Certificate. Phucula inkqubo yezwe yokuthembisa igqwethe ye-School Based assessment kwigreyidi 12. Qhubekekisa ukuphunywa kwemigca eqaqambileyo nendlela elungisiweyo yomakilingo we-National Senior Certificate (NSC) kunye ne-Senior Certificate (SC) kuzo zonke iindawo zomakilingo kwaye uzingele i-e-marking. Nceda kwaye ulungelelanise ukuphunywa kweeksonde ze-NSC kunye ne-SC kulo lonke elishumi lamasebe e-Provincial Education Departments. Lawula iimpazamo kwaye uphucule qaqambileyo ye-NSC. Nghenisa inkqonkqonxiwa ekomelezeni unxibelelwano.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Whole School Evaluation (WSE)
jobs.closing_date_text: 06 November 2026 FOR ATTENTION : Ms N Monyela/ Mr M Segowa
jobs.summary: Deputy Director role coordinating whole school evaluation, developing training materials, and monitoring school evaluation quality at the Department of Basic Education in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of NQF level 6 post matric qualification or equivalent qualification as recognised by SAQA; Four (4) years relevant experience as an Assistant Director or equivalent; A post graduate will serve as an advantage; At least 10 years (10) years overall experience as an educator with five (5) years management experience; Experience in project management, supervision and managing a budget in line with strategic plan; Extensive knowledge of the General Education and Training (GET) and Further Education and Training (FET) curriculum; Knowledge and understanding of school evaluation, performance management and accountability systems; Knowledge of and insight into relevant education policies and legislation as well as CAPs; Knowledge of the national WSE-policy; Knowledge of research methods; Ability to conduct and report on classroom observations; Ability to keep up with a challenging education environment for the 21st Century; Adapt an outcomes approach and foster data-driven decision-making; Have capacity to work without supervision and be able to meet targets and deadline; Willingness to work extensive hours and be prepared to travel; Strong verbal and written communication skills; Good computer skills in Microsoft Office Programmes: Word, Excel and PowerPoint; Report writing and presentation skills; Excellent people skills in order to interact with stakeholders; A valid driver’s licence; Have a passion for making a positive contribution in the South African Education Sector.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for planning and coordinating meetings and training of provincial WSE-supervisory teams and district officials; Developing training material and instruments for internal and external school evaluations; Monitoring and reporting on the quality and effectiveness of school evaluations; Analysing reports on lesson observations; Monitoring WSE post-address areas of underperformance; Effectively use reliable and valid data for School Improvement Plans to support systematic evaluation processes; Creating a repository of school evaluation reports for system wide consumption; Work collaboratively to establish partnerships with stakeholders in the sector to strengthen accountability and promote improvement.

af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur-rol wat hele skoolevaluering koördineer, opleidingsmateriaal ontwikkel en die kwaliteit van skoolevaluering by die Department of Basic Education in Pretoria moniteer.

af.title: Onderdirekteur
af.summary: Onderdirekteur wat die HIV- en VIGS-voorwaardelike toelaes op nasionale vlak bestuur, met 'n NQF 6-kwalifikasie in Gesondheidsbevordering, Gesondheidswetenskap of Onderwys en vier jaar se relevante ervaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n NQF-vlak 6-kwalifikasie na matriek of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie in Gesondheidsbevordering, Gesondheidswetenskap of Onderwys hê soos deur SAQA erken; Vier (4) jaar se relevante ervaring as 'n Assistent-direkteur of gelykstaande; Begrip van die beleidsmandaat, biomediese getuienis en die sosiale determinante wat verband hou met die voorsiening van seksuele voorligting en gesondheidsopvoeding/-bevordering, tesame met uitgebreide ervaring in die ontwikkeling, implementering en bestuur van programme vir kinders en/of adolessente; Kennis van die onderwyssektor se beleide en strategieë wat ontwikkeling lei; Implementering en bestuur van MIV-, STI- en tienerswangerskapsvoorkomingsprogramme in skole; 'n Begrip van huidige skoolgesondheidsbeleide en -tendense, asook die getuienis en ingrypings wat op kwesbare dogters en seuns gemik is, word vereis; Belanghebbende- en vennootskapsbestuur is van kardinale belang in hierdie pos; Sterk finansiële bestuursvaardighede is 'n voorvereiste vir die pos; Sterk kommunikasievaardighede (sowel mondelings as skriftelik) is noodsaaklik, net soos konseptuele, organisatoriese en administratiewe vaardighede en netwerkvaardighede, die vermoë om met amptenare op alle vlakke van regering sowel as met sleutelbelanghebbendes in die veld te skakel; 'n Self-starter wat goed selfstandig sowel as in 'n span werk, met bewese vermoë om monitering en evaluering en projekbestuursbeginsels in hul werk toe te pas.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die bestuur en koördinering van die HIV- en VIGS-voorwaardelike toelaes op nasionale vlak; Konsolidering van die maandelikse, kwartaallikse, jaarlikse finansiële en programverslae; Monitering van die prestasie van die provinsiale MIV- en VIGS-program; Fasilitering van die ontwikkeling van die HIV- en VIGS-lewensvaardighede-voorwaardelike toelaesraamwerk en provinsiale besigheidsplanne; Verseker van nakoming van toegekende begrotings soos per die goedgekeurde besigheidsplanne; Konsolidering van finansiële prestasieverslae vir die toelae, bestuur van die MIV- en VIGS-lewensvaardighede-program in ooreenstemming met die toelaesraamwerk in provinsies, deur doeltreffende beplanning, implementering, monitering en evaluering van MIV- en VIGS-, STI- en TB-programaktiwiteite en -beleide te verseker; Uitvoer van toesigbesoeke in die 9 provinsies en hou van interprovinsiale vergaderings; Fasilitering en handhawing van strategiese vennootskappe met susterdepartemente en belanghebbendes.

zu.title: iNqobo Mkhulu
zu.summary: iNqobo Mkhulu ephatha i-HIV and AIDS conditional grant ezingeni lezikhwameni, edinga isifundo se-NQF 6 kwi-Health Promotion, Health Science noma Education kanye neminyaka emi-4 yohlaka oluhlobene nalo.
zu.requirements: Abafaki isicelo kufanele babe ne-NQF level 6 post matric qualification noma isifundo esilinganayo kwi-Health Promotion, Health Science noma Education njengoba kuqashwa yi-SAQA; Abafaki isicelo kufanele babe neminyaka emi-4 (4) yohlaka oluhlobene njengo-Assistant Director noma esilinganisana nalo; Bakwazi ukuqonda umthetho wezinqumo, izibonakaliso ze-biomedical kanye nemibandela ezenzakalayo ehlobene nokuqatshwa kwezemfundo ngocansi kanye nolwazi mayelana nezempilo/huthaza impilo kanye nohlaka olubanzi ekwakheni, ukusetshenziswa kanye nokuphathwa kwemikhiqizo yezingane kanye/noma abesimame abasha; Bakwazi izinqumo kanye nezindlela zeqoqo lemfundo eholisa ekuthuthukisweni; Ukusetshenziswa kanye nokuphathwa kwe-HIV, STIs, kanye nemikhiqizo yokuvikela ukukhulelwa kwabesimame abasha ezikoleni; Kudingeka ukuqonda izinqumo kanye nezinto ezibonakalayo eziphathelene nezimpilo zezikole okwamanje kanye noluvo kanye nezinyathelo eziqondiswe kwabesimame nabafana abasengozini; Ukuphathwa kwabahlanganyeli kanye nemithefubalo ibaluleke kakhulu kulesi sikhundla; Izindlela zokuphatha imali ezijulile ziyisidingo kulesi sikhundla; Ukusebenzisana kakhulu (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe) kuyadingeka, kanti futhi izindlela zokuqonda, zokulawula, zokuphatha kanye nezokuxhumanisa ziyadingeka, ubuchule bokuxhumana namaphoyisa eminyango yonke kanye nabadlule kulezo ngxoxo; Uchezi oyiqalo osebenza kahle eyedwa kanye nakwisiphithiphithi obonisa ukuthi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa izimiso zokuqaphela kanye nokuqinisekisa, kanye nokuphatha imikhiqizo emsebenzini wakhe.
zu.duties: Umntu okhethiwe uzobe ngumphathi kanye nomhlanganisi we-HIV and AIDS conditional grant ezingeni lezikhwameni; Ukuhlanganisa imibiko yenyanga, yekota, yonyaka yemali kanye nemikhiqizo; Ukuphenya ukusebenza kwe-HIV and AIDS Conditional Grant yezifundazwe zikhuluma ngaphakathi noma ngaphandle; Ukukhuthaza ekuthuthukisweni kweHIV and AIDS Life Skills Conditional Grant Framework kanye nezindaba zebhizinisi lwesifundazwe; Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana namaphuzu imali enikezwa ibhizinisi kanye nemikhiqize; Ukwenza imibiko yemali egqamile i-grant, ukuphatha iHIV & AIDS Life Skills programme kwegxenye yokubeka inqubo ye-grant framework ezifundazweni, ukwenza iplani yokwenza, ukuphathwa kwe-HIV and AIDS, STIs, kanye namaphuzu noma amaphuzu we-HIV and AIDS Conditional Grant, STIs kanye ne-TB kubandakanya nezinyathelo ezingezwa ezweni; Ukwenza ukubuka izifundazwe ezi-9 kanye nokuqasha imihlangano yezifundazwe; Ukuqasha nokulondolozwa imibanano ejulile nothisha nabanye abahlanganyeli emnyango kanye nabaphathi bemi.

xh.summary: Isekela Mongameli ophatha irmboleko ezimeleyo yeHIV neAIDS kwinqanaba lesizwe, efunwa ngamagqabantshintshi eNQF 6 kwiQeqesho lokuKhuthaza iMpilo, iNzululwazi weMpilo okanye eMfundo kunye neminyaka emine yamava ahambelanayo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Bids and Contract Administration
jobs.closing_date_text: 06 November 2026 FOR ATTENTION : Ms N Monyela/ Mr M Segowa
jobs.summary: Manage bid and contract administration processes for the Department of Basic Education in Pretoria, including bid committees and audit responses.

Ensuring performance development and performance management of staff.

jobs.title: Senior Administration Clerk
jobs.closing_date_text: 06 November 2026 FOR ATTENTION : Ms N Monyela/ Mr M Segowa
jobs.summary: Senior Administration Clerk position in Pretoria at the Department of Basic Education, involving receipt and verification of goods against purchase orders.
jobs.requirements: The applicant must be in possession of a Senior Certificate or equivalent qualification; Knowledge of The Public Finance Management Act (PFMA); Knowledge of Treasury Regulations; Knowledge of applicable Supply Chain Management policies and procedures; Good verbal and written communication skills; Computer literacy, including proficiency in Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Outlook and Microsoft PowerPoint; Good organisational and planning skills; Good problem-solving skills; Good interpersonal and client- relations skills; Ability to work effectively as part of a team; Ability to work independently and under pressure; Good administrative and record-keeping skills.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for Receipt of goods from service providers and verifying deliveries against purchase orders and other relevant supporting documentation; Ensuring that goods received are aligned with the specifications and quantities reflected in the applicable purchase orders; Ensuring that discrepancies between ordered and delivered goods are identified, recorded, reported and resolved with the relevant stakeholders; Monitoring stock levels and identify damaged, obsolete and slow-moving goods; Conducting regular stock counts and reconciliations and investigate discrepancies; Ensuring that goods are appropriately recorded, labelled, stored and controlled.
jobs.enquiries: Ms N Monyela Tel No: (012) 357 3294/ Mr M Segowa Tel No: (012) 357 4291
jobs.applications: Submitted via post to: Private Bag X895, Pretoria, 0001 or hand-deliver to: The Department of Basic Education, 222 Struben Street, Pretoria or you can email your application HR@dbe.gov.za in PDF format. Please visit the Department of Education’s website at www.education.gov.za

af.title: Senior Administratiewe Klerk
af.summary: Senior Administratiewe Klerk-pos in Pretoria by die Department of Basic Education, wat die ontvangs en verifikasie van goedere teen koopopdragte behels.
af.requirements: Die aansoeker moet in besit wees van 'n Senior Sertifikaat of ekwivalente kwalifikasie; Kennis van The Public Finance Management Act (PFMA); Kennis van Tesourie Regulasies; Kennis van toepaslike Supply Chain Management beleide en prosedures; Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede; Rekenaargeletterdheid, insluitend vaardigheid in Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Outlook en Microsoft PowerPoint; Goeie organisatoriese en beplanningsvaardighede; Goeie probleemoplossingsvaardighede; Goeie interpersoonlike en kliëntrelasievaardighede; Vermoë om doeltreffend as deel van 'n span te werk; Vermoë om onafhanklik en onder druk te werk; Goeie administratiewe en rekordhoudingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die Ontvangs van goedere van diensverskaffers en die verifikasie van aflewerings teen koopopdragte en ander tersaaklike ondersteunende dokumentasie; Verseker dat ontvangde goedere ooreenstem met die spesifikasies en hoeveelhede wat in die toepaslike koopopdragte weerspieël word; Verseker dat diskrepansies tussen bestelde en afgelewerde goedere geïdentifiseer, aangeteken, gerapporteer en met die tersaaklike belanghebbendes opgelos word; Monitor voorraadvlakke en identifiseer beskadigde, verouderde en stadigbewegende goedere; Voer gereelde voorraadtellings en afstemmings uit en ondersoek diskrepansies; Verseker dat goedere toepaslik aangeteken, geëtiketteer, gestoor en beheer word.

jobs.title: Regional Commissioner
jobs.summary: Regional Commissioner for Correctional Services in KwaZulu Natal providing strategic leadership and managing offender care and development programmes.
jobs.requirements: A postgraduate qualification (NQF level 8) in Public Administration / Law / Criminology / Social Sciences or relevant qualification as recognized by SAQA. A certificate for entry into the Senior Management Services (SMS) obtained from the National School of Government (NSG) is compulsory. 8 -10 years’ experience at a senior managerial level. Sound knowledge of the SA Correctional System and understanding the functioning of the Criminal Justice System. Computer literate. Valid driver’s licence. Required Knowledge: Knowledge and understanding of the South African Criminal Justice Systems and the Correctional Services architecture. Understanding of public service policy and related legislative framework (Public Service Act and Regulations, Public Finance Management Act, with emphasis on the Correctional Services Act 111 of 1998 as amended). Competencies And Attributes: Strategic capability and leadership. Service delivery innovation. Client orientation and customer focus. Financial management. Change management. People management and empowerment. Programme and project management. Communication skills (verbal and written). Problem solving and decision making. Transformation management. Influencing and impact. Policy development, facilitation, conflict management and conceptual skills. Diversity management. Negotiation skills. Confidentiality. Interpersonal relations and time management. Accountability. Diplomacy and tact. Policy development and implementation. Good corporate governance principles.
jobs.duties: Provide strategic leadership in ensuring effective, efficient and economic management of the region to realize policy outcomes. Manage the provision of care programmes to maintain the personal well-being of offenders. Manage the provision of programmes aimed at the development of offenders. Manage the rendering of security services to personnel, service providers, public, offenders and any other departmental operation. Management of Justice, Crime Prevention Security cluster and other stakeholders in the region. Manage the development and implementation of after care services to offenders. Manage the development and implementation of correctional programmes to correct offending behaviour. Effective risk management to ensure compliance with the risk management plan of the department. Management of human resources, finance, assets and performance information.
jobs.enquiries: National Head Office: Ms NS Khumalo Tel No: (012) 307 2174 or Ms TP Ngobeni Tel No: (012) 305 8589.
jobs.applications: should be submitted online at https://careers.dcs.gov.za/. Emailed, post or hand delivered applications will not be considered.
jobs.notes: Appointment under the Correctional Services Act. Before you apply: All costs associated with an application will be borne by the applicant. Applicants who have retired from the Public Service with a specific determination that they cannot be re-appointed or have been declared medically unfit will not be considered. Please take note that correspondence will only be conducted with the shortlisted candidates. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application is unsuccessful. Please do not call the department to enquire about the progress of your application. Applicants must note that further checks will be conducted once they are shortlisted and that their appointment is subject to positive outcomes on these checks, which include security clearance, security vetting, qualification verification and criminal records verification. Appointment will be provisional, pending the issue of a security clearance. If you cannot get a security clearance, your appointment will be re-considered/possibly terminated. Fingerprints may be taken on the day of the interview. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One shall be a practical exercise, and the other shall be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applications: Applications must be submitted on the Z83 form (Public Service application form) obtainable from any Public Service department and must be completed in full. Only a detailed CV should be attached to your application form. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies not older than 6 months of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview. Please send a complete application for the post you apply for on a pdf format, stating the correct reference for the position you are interested in. Requirement for valid driver’s licence is not applicable to applicants with a disability. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Streekkommissaris
af.summary: Streekkommissaris vir Korrektiewe Dienste in KwaZulu Natal wat strategiese leierskap verskaf en versorgings- en ontwikkelingsprogramme vir oortreders bestuur.
af.requirements: 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie (NQF level 8) in Openbare Administrasie / Regte / Kriminologie / Sosiale Wetenskappe of 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Sertifikaat vir toelating tot die Senior Management Services (SMS) verkry by die National School of Government (NSG) is verpligtend. 8 -10 jaar ervaring op 'n senior bestuursvlak. Deeglike kennis van die SA Correctional System en begrip van die funksionering van die Criminal Justice System. Rekenaargeletterd. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Vereiste Kennis: Kennis en begrip van die South African Criminal Justice Systems en die Correctional Services-argitektuur. Begrip van openbare diensbeleid en verwante wetgewende raamwerk (Public Service Act and Regulations, Public Finance Management Act, met klem op die Correctional Services Act 111 of 1998 soos gewysig). Bevoegdhede en Attribute: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Diensleweringinnovasie. Kliëntoriëntasie en klientfokus. Finansiële bestuur. Veranderingbestuur. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Program- en projekbestuur. Kommunikasievaardighede (mondeling en skriftelik). Probleemoplossing en besluitneming. Transformasiebestuur. Beïnvloeding en impak. Beleidontwikkeling, fasilitering, konflikbestuur en konseptuele vaardighede. Diversiteitsbestuur. Onderhandelingsvaardighede. Konfidensialiteit. Interpersoonlike verhoudings en tydbestuur. Verantwoordelikheid. Diplomasie en takt. Beleidontwikkeling en -implementering. Beginsels van goedgekose korporatiewe bestuur.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese leierskap om doeltreffende, doeltreflike en ekonomiese bestuur van die streek te verseker om beleidsuitkomste te bereik. Bestuur die verskaffing van sorgprogramme om die persoonlike welsyn van oortreders te handhaaf. Bestuur die verskaffing van programme wat gemik is op die ontwikkeling van oortreders. Bestuur die lewering van sekuriteitsdienste aan persone, diensverskaffers, die publiek, oortreders en enige ander departementele werksaamheid. Bestuur van die Justice, Crime Prevention Security-cluster en ander belanghebbendes in die streek. Bestuur die ontwikkeling en implementering van nasorgdienste aan oortreders. Bestuur die ontwikkeling en implementering van korrektiewe programme om oortredend gedrag te korrigee. Doeltreffende risikobestuur om nakoming van die risikobestuursplan van die departement te verseker. Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne, finansies, bates en prestasie-inligting.

zu.title: Umkhulumeli wesiFunda
zu.summary: Umkhulumeli wesiFunda weziko Lokulungisa Iziphambeko KwaZulu Natal ofika nokuqondisa ngobuhlakani futhi uphatha imiklalo yokunakekelwa nokuthuthukiswa kwezenjadi.
zu.requirements: Iziqu eziphezulu (NQF izinga 8) eNqubweni Yokuphatha Kubuzulu / Emthethweni / E-Criminology / Ezenzululwazi Zezentengiso noma iziqu ezihambisana nalokhu njengoba zivunyiwe yi-SAQA. Isitifikedi sokungena kwinkonzo ephathwa abaphathi abaphezulu (SMS) esitholiwe esikoleni kazwelonke sikaHulumeni (NSG) siyaphoqelekile. U-Hambo lweminyaka eyi-8 -10 ohlwini lwabaphathi abaphezulu. Ulwazi oluzinile mayelana nesistimu yokulungisa iziphambeko eNingizimu Afrika futhi uqonde ukusebenza kwesistimu yoBulungiswa becala. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi Oludingekile: Ulwazi nokuqonda kwezisistimu zoBulungiswa becala eNingizimu Afrika nobakheko wezinkonzo zokuLungisa Iziphambeko. Ukuqonda inqubomgomo yonke imiklalo kahulumeni futhi futhi omthetho ohambisana nayo (uMthetho futhi Izinqumo Zonke imiklalo, uMthetho Wokuphatha Imali Kahulumeni, futhi oNgcwatshwa ngokubaluleka kuMthetho wokuLungisa Iziphambeko 111 ka-1998 njengoba ulungisiwe). Amakhono futhi Iimpawu: Ikono lokuphambili futhi Abakhokheli. Okusha ekulethweni kokwethulwa kwesevisi. Ukugxila kumthengi futhi kumthengi ogxila kuso. Ukuphatha izimali. Ukuphatha inguqulo. Ukuphatha futhi ukukhulisa abantu. Ukuphatha imiklalo imiklalo. Amakhono okuxhumana (okuthunyelwe futhi okubhaliwe). Ukuxazulula izinkinga futhi ukuthatha izinqumo. Ukuphatha inguqulo. Ukuthinta inxaxheba futhi. Ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubomgomo, ukwenza kube lula, ukuphatha izinkinga futhi amakhono ezingqondo. Ukuphatha ukuhlukahluka. Amakhono okuxoxisana. Ukugcina imfihlo. Izindaba eziphakathi kwabantu futhi ukuphatha isikhathi. Ukubekezelela. Ukukhokha futhi ukuziphethe. Ukuthuthukiswa futhi ukuphunyuzwa kwenqubomgomo. Izimiso ezinhle zokuphatha inkampani.
zu.duties: Nikeza ubuhlakani bokuphambili ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo, okuyikho futhi okushibhile komakhonsi ukufeza imiphumela yenqubomgomo. Phatha ukunikezwa kwemiklalo yokunakekelwa ukugcina impilo yomuntu siqu yezendadi. Phatha ukunikezwa kwemiklalo ehlose ukuthuthukiswa kwezendadi. Phatha ukwethulwa kwesevisi yokuvikela abasebenzi, abahlinzeki besevisi, umphakathi, izendadi futhi nanoma yisiphi isenzo somnyango. Ukuphatha kobuLungiswa, isikhulumi sokuthintela Icala futhi amalungu amanye abashashedwa. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa futhi nokusetshenziswa kwemiklalo yokunakekelwa ngemuva kwezendadi. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa futhi nokusetshenziswa kwemiklalo yokulungisa ukuziphatha okuyisonadi. Ukuphatha ngempumelelo noma ukuthi kungabi nalutho ukuze kuqinisekise ukuthi kuhambisana neplani yokuphatha ubungozi bomnyango. Ukuphatha abantu, izimali, izimpahla futhi ukwaziswa ngemiklalo.

xh.title: Ukomishinala weNgingqi
xh.summary: Ukomishinala weNgingqi weKwindla eziKolweni KwaZulu Natal onika inkululeko ekuqhubi iindlela ezibalulekileyo kwaye ulawula iinkqubo zonakekelo nentluko kabanzi.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esiphakamileyo (NQF level 8) kwabaLawulo boLuntu / iZomthetho / uCriminology / izeNzululwazi zeZentlalontle okanye isifundo esichanekileyo njengoko sivunyiwe yiSAQA. Isatifikedi yokuNgena kwiSenior Management Services (SMS) efunyenwe kwiNational School of Government (NSG) iyafuneka. Unyaka o8 -10 wobuchule Kumanqanaba Omlawuli oPhezu kwayo. Ukuqonda okucotho okuQinileyo ngoBummandla boXinzelelo beSewula Afrika nokuQonda ngendlela elawula ngayo iCriminal Justice System. UkuQonda ngokusetyenziswa kweKhompyutha. Ilayisenisi yokuQhuba eSebenzayo. Ulwazi Olufunekayo: Ulwazi nokuQonda ngoBummandla beSouth African Criminal Justice Systems neSakhiwo seKwindla eziKolweni. UkuQonda ngeNkqubo yesebe loluntu nendlela yomthetho ephathelene nayo (Public Service Act and Regulations, Public Finance Management Act, ngokusondezela kwiCorrectional Services Act 111 of 1998 njengoko ilungisiwe). IimPawu neempawu zokuSebenza: Ikhono eliqhubayo kwaye eliyintloko. Ulwazi olutsha Kwindlela yokuXhweba iinkonzo. UkuQondisisa ngokuBeka abathengi phambili. UkuLawula iMali. UkuLawula iNtshintsho. UkuLawula abantu Bese benza amandla Okusebenza neNkqubo yolwazi lweProjekthi. Ikhono lokucoca Amagama nokuBhala. Ikhono lokusombulula iingxaki nokuThatha iziGqibo. UkuLawula uTshintsho. Ikhono lokuNtsikinya ngamandla kwaye nokuQhayisa. Amanyathelo Olayiko, abalulekileyo ekwakhiweni kweNkqubo ekuLawuleni, ukubeka kwindawo yonke, nakwiMali. Ikhono lokubala iSazindi somSebenzi. Ukuba buhle kumZimba womXhaswa weNkqubo. ukuba nolwazi lweKhompyutha.
xh.duties: Nika inkululeko ekuqhubi iindlela ezibalulekileyo ukuqinisekisa ukuLawulwa okusebenzayo, okulungele, nokucotho Kumanqanaba oLuntu njengoko kulindeleke. Lawula ukubonelelwa ngeNkqubo ezilungiselela ukuQondisa ngamandla nemizimba yabanzi. Lawula ukubonelelwa ngeNkqubo ezijoliswe ekuPhepheni nasekuPhuculeni iimPawu zabanzi. Lawula ukubonelelwa ngeNkqubo ezijoliswe kwiNtshukubo yabanzi. Lawula ukubonelelwa ngeNkqubo eziqinisekisa ukhuseleko komntu wonke ophathelene nesebe. UkuLawulwa Kolulwo lweNtshukumbo, iNkqubo yokuthintela uBugebengu ukuQinisekisa ukhuseleko kwindawo ekwiNgingqi. Lawula ukwakhiwa nokusebenziswa kweNkqubo ezilungiselela ukuQondisa ngamandla imizimba yabanzi Baze baphinde bahlaziye iinkqubo ezinika amandla. Lawula ukwakhiwa nokusebenziswa kweNkqubo ezilungiselela ukulungisa iNtshukumbo yabanzi. Qinisekisa ukuba ngokulungele ngokwemigaqo yokuzithembela kwiNkqubo yokuzithembela kwesebe. UkuLawulwa koluntu, lweMali, lweMpahla nakwiNkqubo yokuQulunqa ulwazi ngokuSebenza.

jobs.title: Deputy Commissioner: Correctional Security Operations
jobs.summary: Deputy Commissioner overseeing correctional security operations at National Head Office, requiring an NQF level 7 qualification and five years of senior managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) in Security Management / Criminology / Behavioural Sciences or relevant qualification as recognized by SAQA. A certificate for entry into the Senior Management Services (SMS) obtained from the National School of Government (NSG) is compulsory and should be submitted prior to appointment. Five [5] years’ experience at a senior managerial level in a similar environment. Security clearance. Computer literacy. Valid driver’s licence. Required Knowledge: Knowledge and understanding of the South African Criminal Justice System and the Correctional Services system and architecture. Understanding of public service policy and related legislative framework (Public Service Act and Regulations, Public Finance Management Act, with emphasis on the Correctional Service Act 111 of 1998 as amended). Competencies and Attributes: DCS/public service management knowledge. Policy development and analysis. Knowledge and understanding of security management dynamics. Intelligence and counter-intelligence operations and analysis. Research. Diplomacy and negotiation skills. Risk management. Strategic management and capability. Programme and project management.
jobs.duties: Provide leadership and strategic direction within the chief directorate. Develop strategies, policies, procedures and frameworks to ensure alignment with business plan of the department. Ensure implementation and monitoring of the operational plans in line with the departmental strategic plan. Ensure safe and secure DCS facilities and provide security standards services with respect to DCS. Ensure that sufficient and effective emergency support team services are available in correctional centres to support officials in their duties to create a safe environment for both inmates and officials. Manage the creation and maintenance of a national operational centre. Manage the effective capacitation and management of emergency support teams. Manage stakeholder relations. Management of liaison in relation to client expectations (internal & external). Effectively participate in cluster programs (NatJOINTS etc). Manage correctional programmes rendered in the department. Ensure that correctional programmes are rendered effectively in the department. Develop policies based on the national guidelines practices, procedures and policies and ensure the implementation thereof. Management of risks within the chief directorate. Develop action plans to mitigate the identified risks. Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of the control measures in place. Management of human resources, finance, assets and performance information.
jobs.enquiries: National Head Office: Ms NS Khumalo Tel No: (012) 307 2174 or Ms TP Ngobeni Tel No: (012) 305 8589.
jobs.applications: should be submitted online at https://careers.dcs.gov.za/. Emailed, post or hand delivered applications will not be considered.
jobs.notes: Candidates who previously applied need to re-apply. Appointment under the Correctional Services Act. Before you apply: All costs associated with an application will be borne by the applicant. Applicants who have retired from the Public Service with a specific determination that they cannot be re-appointed or have been declared medically unfit will not be considered. Please take note that correspondence will only be conducted with the shortlisted candidates. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application is unsuccessful. Please do not call the department to enquire about the progress of your application. Applicants must note that further checks will be conducted once they are shortlisted and that their appointment is subject to positive outcomes on these checks, which include security clearance, security vetting, qualification verification and criminal records verification. Appointment will be provisional, pending the issue of a security clearance. If you cannot get a security clearance, your appointment will be re-considered/possibly terminated. Fingerprints may be taken on the day of the interview. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One shall be a practical exercise, and the other shall be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applications: Applications must be submitted on the Z83 form (Public Service application form) obtainable from any Public Service department and must be completed in full. Only a detailed CV should be attached to your application form. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies not older than 6 months of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview. Please send a complete application for the post you apply for on a pdf format, stating the correct reference for the position you are interested in. Requirement for valid driver’s licence is not applicable to applicants with a disability. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Onderkommissaris: Korrektiewe Sekuriteitsbedrywighede
af.summary: Onderkommissaris wat toesig hou oor korrektiewe sekuriteitsbedrywighede by Nasionale Hoofkantoor, wat 'n NQF vlak 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 7) in Sekuriteitsbestuur / Kriminologie / Gedragswetenskappe of 'n relevante kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Sertifikaat vir toelating tot die Senior Bestuursdiens (SMS) wat by die Nasionale Skool van Regering (NSG) verkry is, is verpligtend en voor aanstelling ingedien moet word. Vyf [5] jaar se ervaring op 'n senior bestuursvlak in 'n soortgelyke omgewing. Sekuriteitsklaring. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Vereiste Kennis: Kennis en begrip van die Suid-Afrikaanse Strafregstelsel en die Korrektiewe Dienste-stelsel en argitektuur. Begrip van staatsdiensbeleid en verwante wetgewende raamwerk (Openbare Dienswet en -regulasies, Openbare Finansiesbestuurwet, met klem op die Korrektiewe Dienswet 111 van 1998 soos gewysig). Bevoegdhede en Eienskappe: DCS/staatsdiensbestuurskennis. Beleidontwikkeling en -ontleding. Kennis en begrip van sekuriteitsbestuursdinamika. Intelligensie- en teenintelligensiebedrywighede en -ontleding. Navorsing. Diplomatieke en onderhandelingsvaardighede. Risikobestuur. Strategiese bestuur en vermoë. Program- en projektebestuur.
af.duties: Verskaf leierskap en strategiese rigting binne die hoofdirektoraat. Ontwikkel strategieë, beleide, prosedures en raamwerke om belyning met die besigheidsplan van die departement te verseker. Verseker implementering en monitering van die operasionele planne in ooreenstemming met die departementele strategiese plan. Verseker veilige en beveiligde DCS-fasiliteite en verskaf sekuriteitsstandaarddienste met betrekking tot DCS. Verseker dat voldoende en doeltreffende noodondersteuningsteamdienste in korrektiewe sentrums beskikbaar is om amptenare in hul pligte te ondersteun om 'n veilige omgewing vir beide gedetineerdes en amptenare te skep. Bestuur die skepping en instandhouding van 'n nasionale operasionele sentrum. Bestuur die doeltreffende bevoegdheid en bestuur van noodondersteuningspanne. Bestuur belanghebbendeverhoudinge. Bestuur van skakeling met betrekking tot kliëntverwagtings (intern en ekstern). Neem doeltreffend deel aan trosprogramme (NatJOINTS, ens.). Bestuur korrektiewe programme wat in die departement gelewer word. Verseker dat korrektiewe programme doeltreffend in die departement gelewer word. Ontwikkel beleide gebaseer op die nasionale riglyne, praktyke, prosedures en beleide en verseker die implementering daarvan. Bestuur van risiko's binne die hoofdirektoraat. Ontwikkel aksieplanne om die geïdentifiseerde risiko's te verminder. Monitor en evalueer die doeltreffendheid van die beheermaatreëls in plek. Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne, finansies, bates en prestasie-inligting.

zu.title: IBamba Ofisi: Imisebenzi Yokuvikela Ekuqedisweni Kwezohlwayo
zu.summary: IBamba Ofisi elibhekele imisebenzi yokuvikela ekuqedisweni kwezohlwayo eNational Head Office, elidinga iziqu ezinga le-NQF level 7 namava eminyaka yokuqasha ohlangothini lwabaphathi abaphezulu.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-undergraduate (NQF level 7) kwi-Security Management / Criminology / Behavioural Sciences noma iziqu ezihambisana nalezo njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA. Isitifikedi sokungena ku-Senior Management Services (SMS) esitholiwe e-National School of Government (NSG) siyimfuneko futhi kufanele sithunyelwe ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Amava eminyaka eyi-Five [5] ohlangothini lwabaphathi abaphezulu endaweni efanayo naleyo. Ukucwetshiswa okusemthethweni ngokuvikela. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi Oludingekayo: Ulwazi nokuqonda i-South African Criminal Justice System kanye nesistimu nokwakheka kwe-Correctional Services. Ukuqonda inqubomgomo yomnyango wezisebenzi zikahulumeni nemiqondo yomthetho ehambisana nayo (Public Service Act and Regulations, Public Finance Management Act, kugqamise i-Correctional Service Act 111 of 1998 njengokulungisiwe). Ikhono nemikhuba: Ulwazi lokuphatha i-DCS/nomnyango wezisebenzi zikahulumeni. Ukuthuthukiswa nokuhlaziya inqubomgomo. Ulwazi nokuqonda okuphathelene nokushintshashintsha kokuphathwa kokuvikela. Imisebenzi yokuhlola nokuphikisana nokuhlola inhluzo nokuhlaziya. Ukuphenya. Ulwazi lwezobuchule nokuxoxisana. Ukuphathwa kwengozi. Ukuphathwa kokuqamba amacebo nokuqonda ukwenza. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo namaphrojekthi.
zu.duties: Nika ubuholi nokuqondisa ngesimo sokubhekise phambili ngaphakathi kwenkantolo yabaphathi abaphezulu. Biza amacebo, inqubomgomo, izinqubo namakhefu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana nenkampani yocingo lomnyango. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa nokubhekwa kwezinhlelo zokusebenza ngokuhambisana nenqubo yomnyango. Qinisekisa ukuthi izisebenzi ze-DCS zivikelekile futhi ziba namaphatho okuvikela mayelana ne-DCS. Qinisekisa ukuthi kunezinsizakusebenza ezenza iziqu zokwesekwa ngemibalana eziwanele futhi ezisebenza kahle ezikhungweni zokuqediswa izohlwayo ukuze kusekele abasebenzi emisebenzini yabo wokudala imvelo evikelekile kwababoshiwe nabasebenzi. Phatha ukudalwa nokugcinwa kwesikhungo sokusebenza esizweni. Phatha ukusebenza kahle nokuqashwa kokubhekana namathambo wokwesekwa ngemibalana. Phatha izinhlangano ezithinta isikhungo. Ukuphathwa kokuxhumana ngokuhambisana nezilindelelo zabathengi (ngaphakathi & ngaphandle). Thatha inxaxheba ngokusebenza kahle kumaphrojekthi amagabelangqamuzana (NatJOINTS njll). Phatha izinhlela zokuqediswa izohlwayo ezihlolwa kumnyango. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinhlela zokuqediswa izohlwayo zenziwa ngokusebenza kahle kumnyango. Biza inqubomgomo ngokusekelwe emithethonqubo yeziqu zesizwe, izinqubo namaphoyisa bese uqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwawo. Ukuphathwa kwezingozi ngaphakathi kwenkantolo yabaphathi abaphezulu. Biza amacebo okwenza ukuqeda izingozi ezitholakele. Bhekisisa futhi uhlaziye ukusebenza kahle kwezinyathelo zokuqaphela ezisekhona. Ukuphathwa kwabantu, imali, izimpahla nolwazi ngokusebenza.

xh.title: Ikomishana Elincedisayo: IiNtshukumo zoKhuseleko lokuLungisa
xh.summary: Ikomishana elincedisayo elibukelela iintshukumo zokhuseleko zokulungisa kwiNtloko eNkundla yaseZwe, elifuna ifom yesiNqanaba se-NQF 7 kwaye lifuna iminyaka emihlanu yamava obuqeqesha abaphathi abaphezulu.
xh.requirements: Ifom yesiNqaba (NQF 7) kwi-Security Management / Criminology / Behavioural Sciences okanye ifom efanayo njengoko kubonwa yi-SAQA. Isatifikethi sokungena kwi-Senior Management Services (SMS) esitholwe kwi-National School of Government (NSG) simfuno kwaye kufuneka sithatyathelwe phambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Iminyaka emihlanu [5] yamava kwinqanaba labaphathi abaphezulu kwindawo efanayo. Isicoca sokhuseleko. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisenesi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi olufunekayo: Ulwazi nokuqonda iNkqubo yoBulungisa becala yaseMzantsi Afrika kunye nenkqubo yokuLungisa iinkonzo nobakhiwayo. Ukuqonda inkqubo yesebe likarhulumente nomthetho ohambisanayo naayo (uMthetho nemigaqo yesebe likarhulumente, uMthetho woLawulo weeMali zikaRhulumente, ngokusondeza kuMthetho wokuLungisa iinkonzo 111 ka-1998 njengoko ulungisiwe). Iakhompedensi neempawu: Ulwazi lokuqonda ulawulo lwe-DCS/lesebe likarhulumente. Ukuthuthukisa nokuhlalutya iinkqubo. Ulwazi nokuqonda iimpawu zolawulo lokhuseleko. Iintshukumo zolwazi nokuchasana nolwazi nokuhlalutya. Uphononongo. Amakhono obunyeli nokucajisana. Ulawulo lwengozi. Ulawulo olusisigqawa nakhompetensi. Ulawulo lweenkqubo namaphulo.
xh.duties: Nika isikhokelo ngokwasemoyeni nengqondo ebandakanyekayo kwikomkhulu. Phuhliza iinkqubo, iinkqubo zemigaqo, iinkqubo zokwenza namakhowudi ukuqinisekisa ukuqwalaselwa nomgama wocweyo webhizinisi lwesebe. Qinisekisa ukusebenza nokuqwalaselwa kweendulu ezisebenzayo ngokomgama wolwangu olusisigqawa kwesebe. Qinisekisa iindlu zokulungisa ze-DCS ezikhuselekileyo kwaye unike iinkonzo zamazinga okhuseleko ngokumayelana ne-DCS. Qinisekisa ukuba kukho iinkonzo zeqela luncedo lwejongo yonke ngokwaneleyo kwaye zisebenza kumaziko okulungisa ukuxhasa abasebenzi kumsebenzi wabo ukuze bakhe indawo ekhuselekileyo yababoshwa nabasebenzi. Yiba ngumlawuli wokudalwa nokugcinwa kwesikhululo sasezweni esisebenzayo. Lawula ukuyalelwa ngamandla nokulawula amaqela oncedo lwejongo ngokusebenzayo. Lawula ubudlelwane nabathintelwa kubakho. Ulawulo lweendibano ezimalunga nolindelo lwabaxhasi (bangaphakathi & bangaphandle). Thatha inxaxheba ngokusebenzayo kwiinkqubo zeqela (i-NatJOINTS njl). Lawula iinkqubo zokulungisa ezenzelwa kwisebe. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo zokulungisa zibonelelwa ngokusebenzayo kwisebe. Phuhliza iinkqubo ngokusekela kumalungiselelo namayelelo, iinkqubo neendlu zomthetho ezingeni lesizwe, namakhompedensi ayo kwaseKwaZulu-Natali.

af.title: Onderkommissaris: Menslike Hulpbronontwikkeling
af.summary: Onderkommissaris vir Menslike Hulpbronontwikkeling by die Departement of Correctional Services se nasionale hoofkantoor, wat bestuurservaring op senior vlak en 'n NQF vlak 7-kwalifikasie vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 7) soos erken deur SAQA in Menslike Hulpbronontwikkeling/Openbare Administrasie of 'n tersaaklike kwalifikasie. Vyf (5) jaar se ervaring op 'n senior bestuursvlak in 'n soortgelyke omgewing. 'n Sertifikaat vir toetrede tot die Senior Management Services (SMS) wat by die National School of Government (NSG) verkry is, is verpligtend en moet voor aanstelling ingedien word. Rekenaargeletterd. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Vereiste kennis: Begrip van die dinamika van die Justice Cluster. Begrip van Openbare Diensbeleid en die verwante wetgewende raamwerk (Public Service Act, Regulations en Labour Relations Act). Bevoegdhede en kenmerke: Finansiële bestuursvaardighede. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Beleidontwikkeling. Kommunikasie. Projek- en programbestuur. Transformasiebestuur, Veranderingsbestuur. Kliëntgerigtheid en kliëntfokus. Probleemoplossing en analise. Diensleweringinnovasie. Besluitneming. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Integriteit en eerlikheid. Vertroulikheid. Interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Begrip van Openbare Diensbeleid en wetgewende raamwerk. Selfwaarheid. Vermoë om te netwerk. Diplomatiek en taktvol. Beïnvloeding en impak.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese leierskap en rigting vir die hoofdirektoraat. Bepaal die strategiese rigting van die departement om belyning met sy doelwit te verseker. Monitor en verseker die implementering van die strategiese planne. Ontwikkeling, bestuur en monitering van DCS-opleidings- en ontwikkelingsstrategie. Ontwikkel, implementeer en bestuur die loopbaanbestuurs- en opvolgingsbeplanningsprogramme. Bestuur en implementering van 'n prestasiebestuurstelsel wat gekoppel is aan die strategiese uitkomste, funksionele verantwoordelikhede en individuele prestasie. Skep effektiewe verhoudinge met al die tersaaklike rolspelers. Ontwikkel en onderhou goeie verhoudinge binne die departement en ander rolspelers. Skakel en co-ordineer met regerings-, nie-regeringsinstellings en ander strukture en organisasies. Verseker dat die voorbereiding van die begroting in ooreenstemming met strategiese planne en departementele doelwitte is. Verseker behoorlike implementering van die begroting deur besteding te monitor, te projekteer en te rapporteer. Bestuur die verskaffing van die volgende dienste en funksies: Eksterne Opleiding en Standarde. Kernkurrikulum. Funksionele en Bestuursopleiding. Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne, finansies en bates. Bestuur van prestasie-inligting.

zu.title: Isikhundla sikaNobhala-Jikelele: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwamandla Abantu
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaNobhala-Jikelele Sokuthuthukiswa Kwamandla Abantu eNdhloweni yesiKazimagange kweSevisi ZoLungiso Elikhulu Lenhlokodolobha, sifuna isipiliyoni esibalulekile sokuphatha kanye nesidanga se-NQF level 7.

jobs.title: Regional Head: Incarcerations, Corrections and
jobs.centre: Limpopo, Mpumalanga and North West region
jobs.summary: Regional Head needed to manage incarceration, corrections and healthcare services across the Limpopo, Mpumalanga and North West region.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) as recognised by SAQA in Behavioural Science or relevant qualification. A certificate for entry into the Senior Management Services (SMS) obtained from the National School of Government (NSG) is compulsory. Five [5] years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level. Security clearance. Computer literate. Valid driver’s licence. Required Knowledge: Knowledge and understanding of the South African Criminal Justice System and the Correctional Services architecture. Understanding of public service policy and related legislative framework (Public Service Act and regulations, Public Finance Management Act, with emphasis on the Correctional Services Act 111 of 1998 as amended). Competencies and Attributes: Strategic capability and leadership. Policy development, communication, project and programme management, transformation management, change management, client orientation and customer focus. Problem solving and analysis, service delivery innovation, decision making and financial management skills. People management and empowerment. Integrity, honesty, confidentiality and interpersonal relations. Understanding of Public Service policy and legislative framework. Assertiveness, ability to network, diplomacy, tactful, influence and impact.
jobs.duties: Ensure a safe and secure environment for members of the public, personnel and persons legally entrusted to our care. Manage health care services and incarceration management. Manage and oversee self-sufficiency and sustainability programs and services. Management of human resources, finances and assets. Management of performance information.
jobs.enquiries: National Head Office: Ms NS Khumalo Tel No: (012) 307 2174 or Ms TP Ngobeni Tel No: (012) 305 8589.
jobs.applications: should be submitted online at https://careers.dcs.gov.za/. Emailed, post or hand delivered applications will not be considered.
jobs.notes: Appointment under the Correctional Services Act. Before you apply: All costs associated with an application will be borne by the applicant. Applicants who have retired from the Public Service with a specific determination that they cannot be re-appointed or have been declared medically unfit will not be considered. Please take note that correspondence will only be conducted with the shortlisted candidates. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application is unsuccessful. Please do not call the department to enquire about the progress of your application. Applicants must note that further checks will be conducted once they are shortlisted and that their appointment is subject to positive outcomes on these checks, which include security clearance, security vetting, qualification verification and criminal records verification. Appointment will be provisional, pending the issue of a security clearance. If you cannot get a security clearance, your appointment will be re-considered/possibly terminated. Fingerprints may be taken on the day of the interview. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One shall be a practical exercise, and the other shall be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applications: Applications must be submitted on the Z83 form (Public Service application form) obtainable from any Public Service department and must be completed in full. Isatifikethi sokungena kwiSenior Management Services (SMS) esitholwe kwiNational School of Government (NSG) siyaphosiswa. [5] Iminyaka yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi/eliphezulu labalawuli. Ukuqinisekiswa kwesafety. Ukuba lugqatswo kwiikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi olufunekayo: Ukuqonda i-dynamics ye-Justice Cluster, i-White Paper on Corrections eSouth Africa naku-White Paper on Remand Detainees. Ukuqonda iNqubomgomo yeNkonzo zeLuntu nolwabiwo-lwezithetho ezinxulumene nayo (i-Public Service Act and Regulations naku-Public Finance Management Act). Iikhompetensi nezibalulekileyo: Ulwazi olujulileyo ngeenqubomgomo nemiqathango yeenkonzo zabantu. Amakhono obuququzeleli, ahlengahlengiso, okuxoxiswana ngaye, okweluleko, lokuhlalutya nokusombulula iingxaki, lokunxibelelwana nolokuva, lolawulo lwexesha, lolawulo lweentlobo-nentlobo zabantu nolawulo looyakhohlwayo.
xh.duties: Isebenza njalo: Ukuququzelela nokulawula iinkonzo zolawulo lweenkonzo zabantu kulo Mandla oLawulwayo. Ukuququzelela nokulawula ukusetyenziswa kweenkonzo zabantu nentshukubo yabasebenzi. Ukuququzelela iinkonzo zoxhaso lweenkonzo zabantu. Ukwenza izicelo zemigangatho yomthetho. Ukuququzelela iindlela eziphathwa ngayo abasebenzi. Unxibelelwano lolawulo lwenkcazelo. Ukuququzelela iinkqubo ezikhethekileyo. Ulawulo lwenkcazelo yemigangatho. Ulawulo lweenkonzo zabantu, zezimali nempahla.

jobs.summary: Coordinate incarceration, health care, social work and spiritual care services for offenders in the Durban management area within the Department of Correctional Services.

A certificate for entry into the Senior Management Services (SMS) obtained from the National School of Government (NSG) is compulsory. Five [5] years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level. Security clearance. Computer literate. Valid driver’s licence. Required Knowledge: Knowledge and understanding of the South African Criminal Justice System and the Correctional Services architecture. Understanding of public service policy and related legislative framework (Public Service Act and regulations, Public Finance Management Act, with emphasis on the Correctional Services Act 111 of 1998 as amended). Competencies and Attributes: Strategic capability and leadership. Policy development, communication, project and programme management, transformation management, change management, client orientation and customer focus. Problem solving and analysis, service delivery innovation, decision making and financial management skills. People management and empowerment. Integrity, honesty, confidentiality and interpersonal relations. Understanding of Public Service policy and legislative framework. Assertiveness, ability to network, diplomacy, tactful, influence and impact.
jobs.duties: Manage the effective health care of offenders in the management area. Co- ordination of policy on health care. Quality assessment of health care. Manage social work services in the management area. Coordination of policy on social work services. Quality assessment of services. Manage spiritual care services to offenders. Co-ordination of policy on spiritual care services to offenders. Quality assessment of religious care. Management of performance information. Management of human resources, finances and assets.

af.title: Area-koördineerder: Gevangenishouding, Korrektiewe Dienste en
af.summary: Koördineer gevangenishouding-, gesondheidsorg-, maatskaplike werk- en geestelike sorgdienste vir oortreders in die Durban-bestuursgebied binne die Department of Correctional Services.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF-vlak 7) soos deur SAQA erken in Gedragswetenskap of 'n relevante kwalifikasie. 'n Sertifikaat vir toetrede tot die Senior Management Services (SMS) wat by die National School of Government (NSG) verkry is, is verpligtend. Vyf [5] jaar ervaring op 'n middel/senior bestuursvlak. Veiligheidsklarering. Rekenaarvaardig. Geldige bestuurderlisensie. Vereiste Kennis: Kennis en begrip van die Suid-Afrikaanse Strafregstelsel en die Korrektiewe Dienste-argitektuur. Begrip van openbare diensbeleid en verwante wetgewende raamwerk (Public Service Act en regulasies, Public Finance Management Act, met klem op die Correctional Services Act 111 of 1998 soos gewysig). Bevoegdhede en Kenmerke: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Beleidsontwikkeling, kommunikasie, projek- en programbestuur, transformasiebestuur, veranderingbestuur, kliëntoriëntasie en klien tfokus. Probleemoplossing en ontleding, diensleweringinnovasie, besluitneming en finansiële bestuursvaardighede. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Integriteit, eerlikheid, vertroulikheid en interpersoonlike verhoudings. Begrip van Openbare Diens-beleid en wetgewende raamwerk. Selfversekerdheid, vermoë om te netwerk, diplomasie, taktvol, invloed en impak.
af.duties: Bestuur die effektiewe gesondheidsorg van oortreders in die bestuursgebied. Koördinering van beleid oor gesondheidsorg. Kwaliteitsassesserering van gesondheidsorg. Bestuur maatskaplike werkdienste in die bestuursgebied. Koördinering van beleid oor maatskaplike werkdienste. Kwaliteitsassesserering van dienste. Bestuur geestelike sorgdienste aan oortreders. Koördinering van beleid oor geestelike sorgdienste aan oortreders. Kwaliteitsassesserering van godsdienstige sorg. Bestuur van prestasie-inligting. Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne, finansies en bates.

zu.title: Isikhungo Sobuholi Bendawo: Ukuqiniswa Kwesigwebo, Ukulungiswa Kwabayiphiyo
zu.summary: Ukuqamba ukuqiniswa kwesigwebo, izinsizakalo eziphilayo, umsebenzi wezenhlalo nokunakekelwa okomoya kwabaye iphiyo endaweni yokuphathwa i-Durban ngaphakathi kuMnyango Wezinkonzo Zokulungisa.
zu.requirements: Isifundo esingaphansi kwesikolo (NQF level 7) esivunyelwe yi-SAQA kwi-Behavioural Science noma isifundo esihambisana nalesi. Isitifikedi sokungena kwi-Senior Management Services (SMS) esitholwe e-National School of Government (NSG) sibuyeke kanye. Five [5] iminyaka yobuchwepheshe ezingeni eliphakathi eliphezulu noma eliphezulu. Ukucocwa kwesimo sobumonde. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ilayisense yokuqhuba esebenzayo. Ulwazi oludingekayo: Ulwazi nenkambiso mayelana ne-South African Criminal Justice System nokwakheka kwezinkonzo zokulungisa. Inqondo yohlelo lwemigomo kahulumeni nezinyathelo ezihlobene nomthetho (Public Service Act namagunya, Public Finance Management Act, ngokugqamisa Correctional Services Act 111 of 1998 njengoba lusikwa kabusha). Ukuthuthukiswa kwemigomo, ukuxhumana, ukuphathwa kwemiklamo namaphrogremu, ukuphathwa kwenguquko, ukuphathwa kwentshintsho, ukuzinza ngomthengi nokugxila kumthengi. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nanalizi, ukuthuthukiswa kokulethwa kwensizakalo, ukwenza izinqumo namakhono okuphathwa kwezimali. Ukuphathwa kwabantu nakho ukunaka. Ukuqiniseka, ukuqinisile, ukugcinwa kwemfihlo kanye nobudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ukuqonda umgomo kahulumeni ohlelweni lomthetho. Ukuzimisela, ikharikhakhulo yokuxhuman nomuntu, ubuholi bokulethembeleka, ubumnini, ukuthonya nemithelela.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha kahle izinsizakalo eziphilayo zabaye iphiyo endaweni yokuphathwa. Ukuhlanganisa umgomo ngokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ukubuyekeza ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ukuphatha izinsizakazo zomsebenzi wezenhlalo endaweni yokuphathwa. Ukuhlanganisa umgomo ngemisebenzi yezensizakazo. Ukubuyekeza ikhwalithi yezensizakazo. Ukuphatha izinsizakazo zokunakekelwa okomoya kubaye iphiyo. Ukuhlanganisa umgomo ngezinsizakazo zokunakekelwa okomoya kubaye iphiyo. Ukubuyekeza ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa kwelucwecwe. Ukuphathwa kolwazi ngemiklamo. Ukuphathwa kwabantu, kwezimali namafa.

xh.requirements: Isidanga esingaphantsi kwesidanga seBachelors (NQF level 7) esamkelwe yi-SAQA kwisiZulu samagama nendlela yokuziphatha okanye isidanga esifanelekileyo. Isatifikethi sokungena kwiinkonzo zoLawulo lwabaPhakamileyo (SMS) esifunyenwe kwiSikolo sikaRhulumente weSizwe (NSG) sinyanzelekile. Iminyaka emihlanu [5] yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi/eliphezulu lolawulo. Ukuqinisekiswa kokhuseleko. Ukuba lilungiselelo lokusebenza ngokwekhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba edumeleyo. Ukuqonda iinkqabo zorhulumente weenkonzo zabantu kunye nosimo lwemigaqo-ngqongo elidityanisiweyo (uMthetho weenkonzo zabantu nemigaqo, uMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente, ngonqwanqwa kuMthetho weeNkonzo zoLungiso 111 ka-1998 njengoko ulungisiwe). Ukuphuhlisa iinkqabo, unxibelelwano, ulawulo lweeprojekthi neenqubo, ulawulo lokutshintsha, ulawulo loGuquko, ukujolisa kumthengi kunye nokunaka umthengi. Ikhono lokuxazula iingxaki nokuqonda ngokupheleleyo, iinkqubo ezitsha zokuhanuliswa kweenkonzo, ukwenza izigqibo kunye nekhono lolawulo lwemali. Ulawulo nabantu nokuba namandla. Ukuzithembisa, inyaniso, ukugcina iyimfihlo kunye neendlela zomanyano nosethu. Ukuqonda iinkqabo zorhulumente weenkonzo zabantu nosimo lwemigaqo-ngqongo. Ukuzimisela, ikhono lokudibanisa, unyamezelo, ukubamba ngobucrele, ukuchukumisa nokuba nomphezulu.
xh.duties: Qonda ngokusebenzayo ukunakekelwa kwempilo kwezigwele kwindawo yolawulo. Uqwalaselo lweenkqubo zokunakekelwa kwempilo. Ukuqwalasela ngokwmgangatho ukunakekelwa kwempilo. Uqwalaselo lweenkqubo zenkathalo yomoya kwiigwele. Ukuqwalasela ngokomgangatho inkathalo yenkolo. Ulawulo lolwazi ngemigangatho yemisebenzi. Ulawulo lwabantu, ziimali nempahla.

Management of performance information.

af.title: Hoofsielkundige Graad 1: Terapeutiese en
af.summary: Hoofsielkundige Graad 1 om terapeutiese en voorligtingsdienste by die Nasionale Hoofkantoor te bestuur, wat HPCSA-registrasie en drie jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: An toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Sielkundige in 'n toepaslike kategorie toelaat (d.w.s. Kliniese, Voorligting, Opvoedkundige, Nywerheids-, Navorsingsielkunde). Registrasie by die HPCSA as Sielkundige in enigeen van die geïdentifiseerde kategorieë. 'n Minimum van drie (3) jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Kliniese Sielkundige na registrasie by die HPCSA as Sielkundige in enige van die geïdentifiseerde kategorieë. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede en eienskappe: Uitgebreide ervaring in die verskaffing van terapeutiese en voorligtingsdienste. Ervaring in die ontwikkeling, implementering, monitering en evaluering van terapeutiese ingrypingsprogramme. Kennis en begrip van Openbare Diens-beleide en mandate. Kennis van alle wetgewing, norme en standaarde wat gesondheidsorg regeer. Leierskap in multidissiplinêre stelsels. PFMA – opstel van begrotings, skatting, besteding en verslagdoening. Professionele waardes en houding. Toegepaste strategiese denke, kommunikasie, projeksbestuur, aanbiedings en verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Diensleweringsstandaarde. Afrigting, mentorskap en opleiding.
