Monitor die implementering en uitkomste van terapeutiese en voorligtingsprogramme nasionaal. Voer navorsing uit en koördineer navorsing met betrekking tot oortrederbehandeling, gedragsverandering, rehabilitasie-uitkomste en voorligtingsingrypings. Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne, finansies en bates. Bestuur van prestasie-inligting.

zu.title: Inkosikhazi Yesikhulumi Isikhundla 1: Ukwelapha noku
zu.summary: Inkosikhazi Yesikhulumi Isikhundla 1 ukuphatha izinsizakalo zokwelapha nokweluleka Ehhovisi Elikhulu Likazwelonke, kudingeka ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA namaphuzu eminyaka emithathu wokuhlangabezana.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ezivumela ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengesikhulumi ohlotsheni olufanele (okungukuthi, Isikhulumi Sezokwelapha, Sokweluleka, Sokuqeqesha, Sezimboni, Noma Sokucwaninga). Ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengesikhulumi kunanoma yiluphi uhlobo oluchaziwe. Ukuhlangabezana kweminyaka engu-3 okungenani ngaphezulu njengesikhulumi sezokwelapha ngemuva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengesikhulumi kunanoma yiluphi uhlobo oluchaziwe. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ileyisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ikhono nezici: Isipiliyoni esibanzi ekunikezeni izinsizakalo zokwelapha nokweluleka. Isipiliyoni ekuthuthukiseni, ukuphumelelisa, ukulawula nokuhlola izinhlelo zokungenelela zokwelapha. Ulwazi nokuqonda izinqubomgomo nemigomo yomphakathi wosebenza. Ulwazi ngawo wonke umthetho, izimiso nezilinganiso ezilawula ukunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ukubhekana phansi kwezinhlelo ezihlanganisa izindikimba ezahlukene. I-PFMA – ukulungiselela amabhajethi, ukulinganisa, ukusebenzisa imali kanye nokubika. Amaxabiso obungcweti kanye nokubukeka. Ukucabanga ngokulinganisela, ukuxhumana, ukuphatha izinhlelo, ukubhala amalebhu nokubika. Izindinganiso zokulethwa kwensizakalo. Ukuqeqesha, ukuhlola kanye noqeqesho. Ukuphatha izinhlelo nokwenza izinqumo, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuxhumana nabahlanganyeli, ukuxoxisana, ukuhlela, ukuphatha izinkinga, ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, ukuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo, ukuhlaziya, ukulawula, ukuhlola kanye neseluleko sokuphumelelisa. Ukuqoqa ulwazi.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha izinsizakalo zokwelapha nokweluleka. Ukunikeza isiqondiso sobungcweti nezokwelapha kubasikhulumi abanikeza izinsizakalo zokwelapha kumimongo nasemapulazini ekulungisweni. Ukuthuthukisa futhi kubuyekeze izinhlelo zokwelapha ezigxile kubanhloli ezihlose ukuxazulula izinkinga zokuziphatha, izinkanhliziyo, ukucabanga, nokusebenza komphakathi. Ukulawula ukuphumeleliswa kanye nemiphumela yezinhlelo zokwelapha nokweluleka emazweni. Ukwenza futhi ukuhlanganise ucwaningo ngokuhlotshaniswa nokwelashwa kabanhloli, ushintsho lokuziphatha, imiphumela yokulungisa, kanye nokungenelela kokweluleka. Ukuphatha abantu abasebenzayo, imali nempahla. Ukuphatha ulwazi ngemiphumela.

xh.title: I-N Principal Psychologist Grade 1: Therapeutic and
xh.summary: I-N Principal Psychologist Grade 1 ukulawula iinkonzo zokwelapha nezabulela kwi-National Head Office, efunwa ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA namava eminyaka emithathu.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezifanelekileyo ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengePsychologist kwikhategori efanelekileyo (okt. i-Clinical, Counselling, Educational, Industrial, Research Psychology). Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengePsychologist nakuyo nayiphi na kwezi khategori ezichaziweyo. Okungenani eminyaka emithathu (3) yamava afanelekileyo njenge-Clinical Psychologist emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengePsychologist nakuyo nayiphi na kwezi khategori ezichaziweyo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba eyasebenzayo. Amandla nezimilo: Amava amaninzi ekuboneleleni ngeenkonzo zokwelapha nezabulela. Amava ekuphuhliseni, ukusebenziseni, ukuqwalasela nokuhlola iinkqubo zokungenelela kokwelapha. Ulwazi nokuqonda kweenkqubo zemigaqo kunye nemisebenzi ye-Public Service. Ulwazi ngawo onke amagqabantshintshi, iziqondiso kunye neemilinganiselo elawula inkonzo yezempilo. Ukulawula iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezidibanisa iindawo ezahlukeneyo. I-PFMA – ukulungiselela amabhajeti, uqikephelo, ukuchitha nemali nokuxela. Amaxabiso abungcali kunye nemo yokuzipatha. Ukucinga ngokubonelela, nton-nton, ukulawula iiprojekthi, iintonzinto nokubhala iingxelo. Izinga lenkonzo yokunikela. Ukumfundisa, ukukhuthaza nokusesigxeni abanye. Ukulawula iiprojekthi neenkqubo, ukuthatha iigqibo, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukuxhumanisa / ukusebenzisana nabantu abathile, ukuqwenekezela, ukulungelelanisa, ukulawula iingxabano, ukucinga ngokuhlalutya, ukuphuhlisa iinkqubo zemigaqo, ukuhlalutya, ukuqwalasela, ukuhlola kunye nenkqubo yesingcebiso. Ulwazi ngokuqathanisa izinto, ukubikezela, ukuthenga, ukuphatha izinto esitolo, ukuhlaziya imininingwane nokuphatha (izinga lezinto, ukusetshenziswa okuhamba ngesikhathi, ukuhlaziya ubudala). Ukumelana neengozi. Ubucala obuzolileyo nobunyanisekileyo.

Qinisekisa ukusebenzisa imithi ngokwezimvo, ukhuseleko lwemithi, uphando nongenelelo ngokweklinikhi. Diploma/Degree in Nursing) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. Registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. 'n Minimum van nege [9] jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste 4 jaar van bogenoemde tydperk moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring op bestuursvlak wees. Rekenaarvaardig. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede en eienskappe: Kennis van verpleegsorgproses en prosedure, verpleegstatute en ander relevante regsraamwerke, insluitend die klagteprosedure en dissiplinêre kode en prosedure. Finansiële bestuur, probleemoplossing, besluitneming en fasiliteringsvaardighede. Vermoë om te beplan, te organiseer, te lei en te beheer. Projekte, konflikbestuur, opleidings- en ontwikkelingsvaardighede. Goeie verslagskryf- en tydbestuursvaardighede. Verseker van vertroulikheid. Begrip van openbare diensbeleid en wetgewende raamwerk. Dienslewering en kliëntoriëntasie. Integriteit, eerlikheid en selfstandigheid. Bereidwilligheid om te reis.
af.duties: Ontwikkel, implementeer, monitor en hersien beleide, programme, riglyne en standaard bedryfsprosedures rakende nie-oordraagbare siektes (NCDs), spesiale sorg en terapeutiese en mediese dienste. Koördineer en hou toesig oor die voorkoming, bestuur en beheer van nie-oordraagbare siektes binne korrektiewe sentrums. Koördineer en monitor die verskaffing van terapeutiese en mediese ondersteuningsdienste binne die departement. Ontwikkel, implementeer, monitor en hersien mediese paroolbeleide, prosedures en riglyne. Voer risiko-assessments uit en ontwikkel risikobestuurplanne rakende NCDs, spesiale sorg en terapeutiese dienste. Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne, finansies en bates. Bestuur van prestasie-inligting.

zu.title: Isiphathihlathi Senakekelwa Abaguli Izinga 1 [pn-a8]: Izifo ezingadalisi
zu.summary: Kudingeka Isiphathihlathi Senakekelwa Abaguli Izinga 1 kutofisi enkulu yezwe ukulawula ukuvikela, ukuphathwa kanye nenqubo yezifo ezingadalisi ngaphakathi kwe-Department of Correctional Services.
zu.requirements: Izifundo eziyisisekelo ze-R425 (okuyithi I-Diploma/I-Degree eNakekelweni Abaguli) noma ezinye izifundo ezingalingana ezivumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoguli oPhathihlathi. Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengoguli oPhathihlathi. Ukwaziswa okuncane kweminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye [9] emsebenzini ohambisanayo/ovunyelwe ngemva kokubhalisa njengoguli oPhathihlathi kwi-SANC eNakekelweni Abaguli jikelele. Okungenani eminyaka eyi-4 kuleso sikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele kube ngumzekelo ohambisanayo/ovunyelwe ezingeni lolawulo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ikhono nezimpawu: ulwazi ngokuqhuba inqubo kanye nemithetho yonakekelwa, izikitjiji zenakekelwa kanye nezinye izakhiwo zomthetho ezihambisanayo, okuhlanganisa inqubo yezikhalazo kanye namakhothi nesinqubo yokujoyina. Ikhono lokulawula imali, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuthatha izinqumo kanye nokweseka. Ikhono lokweluleka, ukuhlela, ukuhola kanye nokulawula. Ikhono lokuphatha amaphrojekthi, ukulawula izinkathazo, ukugcina kanye nokuqhuba iqhaza ekuzulazuleni. Ikhono elihle lokubhala izikulumo kanye nokulawula isikhathi. Ukugunyaza ukwethula imfihlo. Ukuqonda izinqulumomphatho zezinkonzo zikahulumeni kanye nolimi olusemgqeni womthetho. Ukugxila ekulethweni kwenkonzo kanye nokubhekisa kumthengi. Ukuqotho, ukuthembeka kanye nokuzimisela. Ukuzithoba ekuhambeni.
zu.duties: Yakha, ufake esebenzweni, ulawule futhi ubuke izinqulumomphatho, amaphrojekthi, izinhlelo zokusebenza kanye nezinqubo ezijwayelekile zokusebenza ezihlobene nezifo ezingadalisiwe (NCDs), ukunakekelwa okukhethekile kanye nesevisi yokwelapha kanye nezokwelapha. Lawula futhi ulawule ukuvikela, ukuphathwa kanye nokuqapha izifo ezingadalisiwe ngaphakathi kwezikhungo zokuvala. Lawula futhi uqaphe ukunikezwa kwezinsizakalo zokwelapha kanye nokwesekwa ngokwelapha ngaphakathi kwesikhungo. Yakha, ufake esebenzweni, ulawule futhi ubuke izinqulumomphatho, izinqubo kanye nemithetho yokubhalwa kosuku lokuphola ngokwelashwa. Yenza ukuhlolwa kwezingozi bese ukha amaphulo wokulawula izingozi ahlobene ne-NCDs, ukunakekelwa okukhethekile kanye nezinkonzo zokwelapha. Ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi yabantu, imali kanye nempahla. Ukuphathwa kwolwazi ngemisebenzi yamandla.

xh.title: Manini ongathatha isikhundla sikaMphathiswa weZemiziyo inqanaba lesi-1 [pn-a8]: Izifo ezingahambelaniyo
xh.summary: Kufunekwe uManini ongathatha isikhundla sikaMphathiswa weZemiziyo inqanaba lesi-1 kwiNtloko eYiziko leSizwe ukulungelelanisa ukuthintela, ukulawula nokusebenza kweenkqubo ezimalunga nezigulo ezingahambelaniyo ngaphakathi kwiSebe leZnkonzo zokuLungisa.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezingundoqo ze-R425 (okt Iqondo eliphezulu kwiZemiziyo) okt isifundo esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwiBhunga leZemiziyo laseMzantsi Afrika (SANC) njengomongikazi oGqwethekileyo. Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomongikazi oGqwethekileyo. Amanye amashumi alithoba [9] eminyaka yamava afanelekileyo/avakalisekayo kumiziyo emva kokubhaliswa njengomongikazi oGqwethekileyo kwi-SANC kumiziwo jikelele. Amanye eminyaka engama-4 kulowo mthetho ochaziwe ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo/avakalisekayo kwinqanaba lolawulo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo. Iakhobho nokuzipatha: Ulwazi ngemisumo yexesha nemigaqo yemiziyo, imithetho yemiziyo nakwezinye iinkqubo zomthetho ezibalulekileyo, kuquka inqubo yokuphawula nekhowudi yokohlwayo nenqubo yayo. Izakhono zolawulo lwemali, yokuxazulula iingxaki, yokuthatha izigqibo nokunceda. Amandla okucwangcisa, ukuqamba, ukulawa nokulawula. Izakhono zolawulo lweenkqubo, zokuLawula ukungahambelani, zokuqeqesha nokuqhuba. Izakhono ezilungileyo zokubhaliwe kwimibhalo nolawulo lwexesha. Kuqinisekiswe ukugcina iyimfihlo. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zolawulo lwesebe lezempilo kunye nomthetho wawo. Ukulethwa kwenkonzo nokumiswa komthengi. Ukuzithembisa, ukuzithembisa nokuzimisela. Ukulungelelana ukuhamba.
xh.duties: Ukwenza, ukuphumeza, ukujonga nokuphonononga iinkqubo, iinkqubo, imigaqo yendlela yokusebenza ngokusesikweni ezimalunga nezigulo ezingahambelaniyo (NCDs), ukhathalo olukhethekileyo, iinkonzo ezonyangayo kwaye zonyango. Ukulungelelanisa nokulawula ukuthintela, ukulawula nokulawula izifo ezingahambelaniyo ngaphakathi kweziko lonhlangothi. Ukulungelelanisa nokujonga ukunikezelwa kweenkonzo zonyango nokuxhasa ngaphakathi kwesebe. Ukwenza, ukuphumeza, ukujonga nokuphonononga iinkqubo, iinkqubo nemigaqo yokusingatha ngokonyango. Ukwenza ukulinganisa iingozi nokwenza iinkqubo zokulawula iingozi ezimalunga ne-NCD, ukhathalo olukhethekileyo, iinkonzo zonyango. Ukulawula abantu, imali nempahla. Ukulawula ulwazi olumayela nemigaqo yentsimbi.

Ukuqedwa ngempumelelo kwesifundo sabafundi / uqeqesho olusiyisiseko sasayensi zokulungisa. Ukusebenzisana nekhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela ehlotshaniswa ngokushesha. Amakhono kanye nezici ezibanziyo: Amakhono okusetshenziswa kophahla okudubula nezobuchwepheshe ezihambisana zokuphepha. Unxibelelwano, kuphathwa kumaphrojekthi nezinhlelo zokwenza, ukuphathwa koshintsho, ukuphathwa komshinthsho, ukuphathwa kwebandla eliphikisana, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlaziya, ukudala okusha ekulethweni kwenkonzo, ukwenza izinqumo, ukuphathwa nabantu kanye nokuqinisela, kanye nokuzuva okujulile ngokuphepha nokuvikeleka kwindawo yokulungisa. Ukuqinisela kanye nokuziphatha, ukugcina imfihlo, nobuhlobo obuhle. ULwazi ngomthetho Wezinsizakusebenza Zokulungisa, umthetho 111 ka-1998, njengoba ulungiswe. Ukuqina, ukuba nethuba ukuqhanganiswa, ubuhlonzi nobuhlakaniphile, ukuqina emphefumulweni, ukuthonya nemithelela.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa komthetho-mthetho mayelana nama-Board Okulawula Ukulungiswa kanye Namayini Okukhululwa (ama-CSPB). Ukwenza ucwaningo ngemigomo noma amasu amahle kuzwelonke namazwe ngaphandle. Ukuphathwa kokuhlolwa kwemibiko yamaphrofayela abenzi-colo abanikwe isigwebo sokuphila impilo yonke. Ukwenza ukuqinisekiswa kwekhwalithi emibikweni yamaphrofayela abanikwe isigwebo sokuphila impilo yonke. Ukuphathwa kwama-Board Okulawula Ukulungiswa kanye Namayini Okukhululwa. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinkomba, imiyalo nezinqumo. Ukuphathwa kolwazi ngemigomo, izimali, abantu kanye nezimpahla.

Ukuphumelela ukuba ukhokelwa yi-Corrections Science Learnership / Basic Training. Kufuneki ube nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Kufuneki ulifumane ilayisenisi yokushayela. Ukuzithoba nokuba yi-Nyani, ukugcina imfihlo nokuba namagama amaninzi abantu ngokwendlaleko. Ukuyazi i-Correctional Services Act, Act 111 of 1998, njengoko ilungisiwe. Ukuzimisela, ukuba mandla okudibanisa abantu, ukuzipatha ngendlela ezilileyo nokuzinza, ukuba namandla okumela abantu nokuba sisiciko.
xh.duties: Ukulawula inqubo yokulawula iindaba zeBhodi zoLawulo nokuNikela iParole (CSPBs). Ukwenza uphando ngemigangatho okanye iinkqubo ezilungileyo zamazwe ngamazwe. Ulawulo lweBhodi zoLawulo nokuNikela iParole. Ukuphuhlisa iinkqubo zokusebenza, iindidi zemigca yezikhokelo nemiyalelo. Ulawulo lolwazi ngemveliso, zezimali, zabantu nezixhobo.

Ukugqiba ngempumelelo i-Correctional Science Learnership noma u-Qeqesho Oluyisisekelo. Ukwabiwa kwesigaba sokuvikeleka esiyimfihlo kuzoba yinzuzo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Amakhono nezimpawu: Amakhono okusebenzisa izibhamu nokusebenzisa theknoloji yokuvikeleka efanayo. Ukuxhumana, ukuphatha imiklamo namaphrogrami, ukuphatha intshontsho, ukuphatha inguqulo, ukuphatha izinxulumana, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlaziya, ukungasuseki kolunye ngohlelo lokuletha izinsizakalo, ukwenza izinqumo, ukuphatha abantu nokubusisa, nokuzuva okujulile ngokuvikeleka nokuphephakaliswa endaweni yokulungisa. Ukuzethemba nokwethe embuso, ukugcina imfihlo nokuba nobudlelwano obuhle nomuntu. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Correctional Services Act, umthetho 111 ka-1998, njengoba ulungisiwe. Ukuzimisela, ikhono lokuxhumana nabantu, ub diplomatic kakhulu nokuqaphela, ukumelana nobunzima, ukunamathelisa nokushukumisa.
zu.duties: Facilitate ukuthuthukiswa kohlaka lokusebenza ngokuhambisana nepharole nokuqashwa kwesigameko. Qapha izinhlelo zocwaningo ngokuqondene nezinhlobo zezwe kanye nezamazwe ngamazwe ngokuqashwa kwesigameko nokubusa kwaparole. Hlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokubhalwa kwemithetho, izimiso, izinqubomgomo, izincwadi zokuhola nemiqhafu ethile mayelana nokuqashwa kwesigameko nokubusa kwaparole. Phatha futhi uphendule imibuzo evela kumavolontiya noma komunye umuntu noma isikhungo. Phatha futhi uphendule imibuzo evela enkambisweni. Phatha, hlanganisa futhi nikeza izinkuleko mayelana namadokhada amabalabala, ukuhumusha imithetho, izimiso, izinqubomgomo, izincwadi zokuhola nemiqhafu ethile. Phatha futhi qinisekisa ukuthengisa nokuxhumana ngqo nabalwa abaningi (abangaphakathi nangaphandle). Ukulandelela nokuhlola ukusetshenziswa kwaparole nokuqashwa kwesigameko. Phatha abantu, imali nezimpahla.

xh.duties: Qonda lophuhliso lwecephu lolusebenzo ngokwahambelana nokuqatshelwa kwababekiyo nolawulo lwesigwebo. Lawula lophuhliso nolungelelaniswa kwemithetho, iimigaqo, iinqwelomgaqo, iincwadi zokulawula neenkqowa ezimalunga nolawulo lwesigwebo nokuqatshelwa kwababekiyo. Lawula uphendule imibuzo evela kwipalamente nakwisiphi na omnye umntu okanye isikhululo. Lawula uphendule imibuzo evela kwilindlela lokusebenza. Lawula, uqokelele unike iingcebiso malunga namaxwebhu amabalulekileyo, incazelo yomthetho, iimigaqo, inqwelomgaqo, iincwadi zokulawula neenkqowa. Three (3) - five (5) years management experience at an ASD level in Knowledge Management/Business Management/Library Information Management. Computer literate. Valid driver’s licence. Knowledge of business writing and case study development. Develop and implement knowledge management policy, marketing and change management plan. Communicate and execute knowledge management strategy and other knowledge management related projects and programs. Work with internal and external stakeholders to develop information and knowledge products. Develop and administer technologies for easy access to knowledge and information. Ensure data analysis and transform it into information, package and share across the department. Develop and implement data and information management strategy for the DCS. Apply meta data and data integrity for all information and knowledge products. Help entrench and institutionalise knowledge management plans, processes, procedures and all related plans. Develop and manage knowledge management strategy, policies and procedures for the department. Provide technical support on knowledge management issues to the department and relevant stakeholders. Develop and implement knowledge capacity building programme for the department and relevant stakeholders. Establish knowledge management learning networks/fora’s for the department and ensure proper functioning of the departmental resource centre. Manage resources of the sub-directorate. Manage performance information.

zu.summary: Isikhulu Esikhulu Sesikhundla: Izinhlelo Zolwazi kuDepartment of Correctional Services National Head Office, sinikeza R932292 ngonyaka, sifuna idigri namava okuphatha ekulawulenkolwazi noma ekulawuleni ulwazi.
zu.requirements: Idigri kwi-Library/Information Management noma iziqu ezifanelekayo. Three (3) - five (5) iminyaka yamava okuphatha ezingeni le-ASD ku-Knowledge Management/Business Management/Library Information Management. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ikhono Nezinto Ezibalulekile: Ulwazi ekulawuleni ulwazi. Ulwazi ngemigomo yokuhweba nokuphathwa. Ulwazi olunzulu lokucwaninga. Ulwazi namava ekwenziweni kwemigomo. Ulwazi lokubhala ngomhlaka wezohwebo nasekuthuthukiseni izifundo zezimo. Ukuqonda okugcwele umthetho ohambisana nalokhu, izindlela ezinhle nezakhiwo mayelana no-Knowledge and Information Management, ukuxhumana, ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi namuhlela, ukuphathwa koshintsho, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlaziya, ukuthuthukisa ukulethwa kwezinsizakalo, ukwenza izinqumo, ukuphathwa kwabantu nokuwkusekela.
zu.duties: Misela bese uthuthukisa izindlela nezinqubo ezizoqinisekisa ukukhiqizwa kolwazi, ukudluliswa kolwazi nokuphinda kusetshenziswe ulwazi emkhakheni we-DCS. Thuthukisa futhi usebenzise umgomo wokuphathwa kolwazi, ukumaketha kanye nenqubo yokuphathwa koshintsho. Xhumana futhi ufezekise inqubo yokuphathwa kolwazi kanye namaphrojekthi namuhlela okuhlobene nokuphathwa kolwazi. Sebenza nabaxhumana bangaphakathi nangaphandle ukuze uthuthukise imikhiqizo yolwazi nolwazi. Thuthukisa futhi ulawule izobuchwepheshe ukuze kube lula ukufinyelela kulwazi. Qinisekisa ukuhlaziya idatha uyiguqule ube ulwazi, uyifake esiphaziyini futhi uyabelane kuwo wonke umnyango. Thuthukisa futhi usebenzise inqubo yekuphathwa kwenhlonhlo yolwazi noma idatha ye-DCS. Faka umethadatha futhi qinisekisa ukuziniseka kolwazi emikhiqizweni yonke yolwazi. Siza ukuqinisekisa futhi wenze izinkqubo zokuphathwa kolwazi, izinqubo nezinkomba zazo zonke ezihlobene nazo. Thuthukisa futhi ulawule inqubo yokuphathwa kolwazi, imigomo nezinqubo zomnyango. Nikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe mayelana nezindaba zokuphathwa kolwazi kumnyango kanye nalabo abahlobene nalokhu. Thuthukisa futhi usebenzise uhlela lokwakha amandla oluwazi kumnyango nabalabo abahlobene nalokhu. Misela izinkqubo zokufunda ukuphathwa kolwazi/amafora umnyango futhi qinisekisa ukuthi isikhungo sab Balemidia somnyango sisebenza kahle. Lawula izinsiza zesikhundla esingaphansi kwesikhulu. Lawula ulwazi ngemvelu yomsebenzi.

zu.summary: Isikhulu Esiphandelayo: Ukuphathwa Kwezingozi ephakathi kwe-National Head Office ye-Department of Correctional Services, sifuna idiploma noma iziqu kanye neminyaka eyisithathu kuya kwayisihlanu yemfundo yokuqonda ukuphathwa kwezingozi.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma noma i-Degree evunyiwe kokuQaphela Izingozi/Ukubuyela emuva kwezimali/Isibalo sezezimali/Amnozo noma iziqu ezifanelekile. Iminyaka eyisithathu kuya kwayisihlanu (3-5) yemfundo yokuphatha ezingeni le-ASD emkhakheni wokuQaphela Izingozi nokuBuyela emuva kwezimali Ngaphakathi. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ikhono nezici: Ukuqonda i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), izimiso ze-Treasury, i-ISO31000, isakhiwo se-The Committee of Sponsoring Organizations (COSO), umbiko we-King III ngokuphathwa kwenkampani, umthetho wezisebenzi ohambisanana nalesikhundla, izinqubomgomo zokulwa nokukhwabanisa, nokubhaliswa kwezimpilo eZinkonzo Zikahulumeni. Ukuqonda izinqubomgomo nezinqubo zokuphathwa kwezingozi, imigomo nengqondo yekuphathwa kwezingozi. Izinhlelo zezimali zahulumeni nokuqonda ukuphathwa kwezingozi emkhakheni kahulumeni. Ukuqonda ukuphunyezwa kwezinqubomgomo. Ulwazi ekuboneni izingozi ezintsha kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezindlela zokuqaphela izingozi. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya. Ukuqondiswa kumthengi kanye nokugxila kumthengi. Ikhono lokubonisa. Ukuphatha abantu kanye nokuba ngokwezinhlobo. Ukubekezela kanye nokuziphatha ngokuzethemba. Ukuqinisekiswa kwizinga eliphezulu lolawulo lwemigomo. Ikhono elihle lokuhlela kanye nokuThintana. Ikhono elihle lokuphatha izimali, ukwenza kube lula, ukuhlela, ukuhlela kabusha, ukushintsha kanye nokuphatha isikhathi.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuphunyezwa kwesikhathi sokubhaliswa kwezingozi. Ukugadlela amaphrofayela ezingozi. Alikhulu loQaphelo Izingozi, ezizingeni lenazionali nakwesifundazwe. Ukuhlanganisa ngokuphelele kwinkampani. Hlola isu lokuphathwa kwezingozi, ihlelo lokunciphisa izingozi, ihlelo lokuqhubekela phambili ngekhono, izindlela namatekinikhazi okuhlola izingozi. Yenza kube lula ukuthuthukiswa kophakeji wokuqonda okuvamile, futhi wenze ukubuyekeza ulwazi ngokwesibonelo ngemininingwane, isabelo njll. Wenze ukuhlola izingozi, okuya ngomgomo nangomsebenzi. Ukuqoqa imibiko yokuqaphela izingozi, ukuhlela inqubo enikwe amagatsha nendawo ukuthola izinga lenqubo mayelana nokuncishiswa kwezingozi. Qedela ukuphunyezwa kwezinhlelo zenyuso izifundazwe namagatsha. Thintana nabahlanganyeli bangaphandle mayelana nezisu ezibanzi futhi ezisebenzayo zokuqaphela izingozi, okungukuthi i-National Treasury. Hlanganisa ilikhulu loqaphelo izingozi ezifundazweni. Hlanganisa ilikhulu loqaphelo izingozi ezifundazweni. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezimpumputhe ezingafakwa kuhlelo lokuqaphela izingozi. Hlela izinkampani zesifundazwe zokuthintana ngezingozi. Nikeza umsebenzi wokubhalisa ngesikhathi sekomidi lezesifundazwe leqaphelo izingozi futhiNikeza isimo sanjenesipho mayelana namahlela okuncishisa izingozi. Ukuphatha ukusebenza kolwazi, ukuphathwa kwezimali nabantu.

xh.title: Under-Director: Risk Management
xh.summary: Isithuba se-Deputy Director: Risk Management kwisebe le-Department of Correctional Services National Head Office, sifuna idiploma okanye isidanga kwaye sifuna ukuba noluvo lolawulo lweminyaka emithathu ukuya kwemihlanu kwindawo yokulawula iingozi.
xh.requirements: Kumkelwe i-National Diploma okanye i-Degree kwi-Risk Management/Auditing/Accounting/Economics okanye isimanga esifanelekileyo. Kubekho oluvo lolawulo lweminyaka emithathu ukuya kwemihlanu (3-5) kwinqanaba le-ASD kwindawo ye-Risk Management kunye ne-Internal Auditing. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ikhono nemiqatho: Ulwazi nge-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), i-Treasury Regulations, i-ISO31000, i-The Committee of Sponsoring Organizations (COSO) framework, ingxelo ye-King III malunga nogqitho lweshishini, umthetho wabasebenzi ofanelekile kulesi sithuba, iinqwelo-mthetho zokuchasa ukurhweba ngendlela engamthetho, iinqwelo-mthetho zokutshatyalaliswa kolwazi, kunye nama-Public Service Regulations. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo nemiqatho yokulawula iingozi, iimvisiswelo nenjongo yokulawula iingozi. Iinkqubo zikarhulumente ezingezimali ulwazi lokulawula iingozi kwicandelo likarhulumente. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa iinqwelo-mthetho. Oluvo ekumilenzeni iingozi ezintsha nakupapasha iindlela ezikwiziko lezokulinganisa iingozi. Isixazululo seenkinga nokuhalalaza. Ukuzinikela kumthengi nokugxila kwimfuno yakhe. Ikhono lokubonisa ulwazi. Ukulawula abantu nokuzingela ukungafani. Ukuxelisa nendlela yokuziphatha ethe krwada. Ukuzinikela kwinqanaba eliphezulu lokulawula umgangatho. Ikhono elihle lokuhlela nokuqukuqela. Ikhono elihle lolawulo lwemali, lokuqhuba iintlangano, zokucwangcisa, zokuhlela, zokutshintsha, nolawulo lwexesha.
xh.duties: Lawula ukusebenzisa irejista yeengozi. Ukugqitha iinkqubo zengozi. Iikomiti zokulawula iingozi, ezikwinqanaba lesizwe nengingqi. Uqoqosho lonke ekubambisweni. Phuhlisa inkqubo yokulawula iingozi, icandelo lokunciphisa iingozi, icandelo lokuphuhlisa amakhono, iindlela zokulinganisa iingozi nokuzezwa kuzo. Qinisekisa ukuphuhlisa iphakheji ekuqeqeshwa ngayo abantu ngokubanzi, yenze ukuphonononga ulwazi ngeendlela ezifana nomdxhasha wemibuzo, izifundo, nokunye. Yenza ukulinganisa iingozi, ngokwezokelelo nakumisebenzi. Ukuqulunqa iingxelo zokulawula iingozi, uphonononge inkqubela enikezwa ziindawo ezithile, ukwazi inqanaba lenkqubela malunga nokunciphisa iingozi. Lilindele ukusetyenziswa kweendicelo zokuziphatha kummandla nasezindaweni ezithile. Xhumana namaxhoba angaphandle kwindawo ebanzi ezingasetyenziswa ngokugqibeleleyo iindlela zokulawula iingozi, oko kukuthi i-National Treasury. Lawula iikomiti zokulawula iingozi kwii-regions. Lawula iikomiti zokulawula iingozi kwii-regions. Ukuqhubelela ekuphuhliseni izimvo eziza kusetyenziswa kwinkqubo yokulawula iingozi. Cwangcisa iintlangano zendawo zokulawula iingozi. Zinike inkonzo yokubhalisa ngelixa likomiti yendawo yokulawula iingozi kwaye unike iziko lesimo samanje malunga nemicimbi yokunciphisa iingozi. Ulawulo lonke lolwazi ngemisebenzi, ulawulo lwemali nethemba labantu.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Information Security
jobs.summary: Manage and implement information security objectives, policies and strategic plans at the Department of Correctional Services National Head Office.
jobs.requirements: Recognised Degree or National Diploma in Security Management or relevant qualification. 3-5 managerial experience at an ASD level in a similar environment. Computer literacy. Valid driver’s licence. Competencies And Attributes: Thorough knowledge of Public Service policies and regulations such as the Promotion of Access to Information Act, White Paper on Corrections and ICT Act. People management and empowerment. Strategic capability and leadership. Programme and project management. Problem solving and analysis. Governance principles, risk management principles, conflict management, presentation, time management, report writing and communication skills.
jobs.duties: Manage and implement information Security objectives. Develop policies, procedures, standards and strategic operational plans. Research on new trends and development in the field of information security. Liaise, maintain and ensure client service and service delivery. Identify and service clients. Maintain a well-balanced interpersonal relation. Coordinate activities of information management substructure. Implement project plans. Achieve targets set in the project plan. Conduct the risk and threat assessment management. Engage in a comprehensive consultation process before drafting policies. Facilitate assessment of systems. Ensure optimal management of resources. Peoples management: Ensure team work, that officials understand their tasks and optimal utilisation of skills. Management of assets finances.
jobs.enquiries: National Head Office: Ms NS Khumalo Tel No: (012) 307 2174 or Ms TP Ngobeni Tel No: (012) 305 8589.
jobs.applications: should be submitted online at https://careers.dcs.gov.za/. Emailed, post or hand delivered applications will not be considered.
jobs.notes: Appointment under the Public Service Act. Before you apply: All costs associated with an application will be borne by the applicant. Applicants who have retired from the Public Service with a specific determination that they cannot be re-appointed or have been declared medically unfit will not be considered. Please take note that correspondence will only be conducted with the shortlisted candidates. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application is unsuccessful. Please do not call the department to enquire about the progress of your application. Applicants must note that further checks will be conducted once they are shortlisted and that their appointment is subject to positive outcomes on these checks, which include security clearance, security vetting, qualification verification and criminal records verification. Appointment will be provisional, pending the issue of a security clearance. If you cannot get a security clearance, your appointment will be re-considered/possibly terminated. Fingerprints may be taken on the day of the interview. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One shall be a practical exercise, and the other shall be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applications: Applications must be submitted on the Z83 form (Public Service application form) obtainable from any Public Service department and must be completed in full. Only a detailed CV should be attached to your application form. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies not older than 6 months of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview. Please send a complete application for the post you apply for on a pdf format, stating the correct reference for the position you are interested in. af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Inligtingsekuriteit
af.summary: Bestuur en implementeer inligtingsekuriteitsdoelwitte, beleide en strategiese planne by die Departement van Korrektiewe Dienste Nasionale Hoofkantoor.
af.requirements: Erkende graad of Nasionale diploma in sekuriteitsbestuur of relevante kwalifikasie. 3-5 bestuurservaring op 'n ASD-vlak in 'n soortgelyke omgewing. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede en attribuute: Deeglike kennis van Openbare Diens-beleide en regulasies soos die Promotion of Access to Information Act, White Paper on Corrections en ICT Act. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Program- en projekbestuur. Probleemoplossing en analise. Regeringsbeginsels, risikobestuursbeginsels, konflikbestuur, aanbieding, tydbestuur, verslagskrywing en kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Bestuur en implementeer inligtingsekuriteitsdoelwitte. Ontwikkel beleide, prosedures, standaarde en strategiese operasionele planne. Doen navorsing oor nuwe tendense en ontwikkelings op die gebied van inligtingsekuriteit. Skakel, handhaaf en verseker kliëntediens en dienslewering. Identifiseer en bedien kliënte. Handhaaf 'n goed gebalanseerde interpersoonlike verhouding. Koördineer aktiwiteite van die inligtingsbestuursubstruktuur. Implementeer projekplanne. Bereik die teikens wat in die projekplan gestel is. Voer die risiko- en bedreigingsassesseringsbestuur uit. Neem deel aan 'n omvattende raadplegingsproses voordat beleide opgestel word. Fassiliteer assessering van stelsels. Verseker optimale bestuur van hulpbronne. Mensebestuur: Verseker spanwerk, dat amptenare hul take verstaan en optimale benutting van vaardighede. Bestuur van bates en finansies.

zu.title: Isikhulu Esiphezulu: Ukuphepha Kwolwazi
zu.summary: Qaphaza futhi usebenzise izinhloso, izinqubo nezinhlelo zokuqasha mayelana nokuphepha kolwazi eNqoleni Yezwe Lezinsizakalo Zokulungisa Iziphambeko.
zu.requirements: I-degree noma i-National Diploma ezinhlokweni Zokuphepha noma iziqu ezifanele. 3-5 unyaka wokuqonda ngqondongqondo ezingeni le-ASD endaweni efanayo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ikhono Nokuziphatha: Ulwazi olujulile mayelana nezinqubo nomthetho wezinsizakalo zikahulumeni njengesokuba uMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi, i-White Paper on Corrections kanye noMthetho we-ICT. Ukuphatha abantu kanye nokubusisa. Ikholo lokuhlela kanye nokubusa. Ukuphatha izinhlelo kanye nemitapo yezindaba. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqonda. Izinhlelo zokubusa, izinhlelo zokuphatha ingozi, ukuphatha impi, ukubhala imibhalo, ukuphatha isikhathi, ukubhala imibhalo kanye nakhono lokuxhumana.
zu.duties: Qaphaza futhi usebenzise izinhloso zokuphepha kolwazi. Butha izinqubo, imitapo yezindaba, izinga kanye nezinhlelo zokuqasha. Holela ucwaningo mayelana nezintsha kanye nentuthuko endaweni yokuphepha kolwazi. Xhumanisa, gcina futhi qinisekisa isevisi yabathengi kanye nokuhanjiswa kwisevisi. Hlukanisa futhi ukhonze abathengi. Gcina ukuxhumana okuhlangenwe nhlayo kanye nabantu. Hlela imisebenzi yesakhiwo sokuphatha ulwazi. Sebenzisa izinhlelo zemisebenzi. Fikelela okuhloswe kuhlelwe kwisevisi. Yenza ukuhlolwa kwezingozi nokusonga. Xhumana abantu ngokucabangisisa ngaphambi kokuqamba izinqubo. Siza ekwenzeni ukuhlolwa kwezinhlelo. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okuphumelelayo kwemithombo. Ukuphatha abantu: Qinisekisa ukusebenza njengesiqembu, ukuthi izikhulu eqondwa imisebenzi yabo nokusebenziseka okuphumelelayo kwamakhono. Ukuphatha impahla nezimali.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Ikhuseleko lolwazi
xh.summary: Phatha uze ufake ngokusebenziseko iinjongo zolwazi ngolukhuseleko, iinkqubo zengqungqula kunye namacebo aqhutywa phambili kwiNtloko eNkulu yesebe lezeMisebenzi zoLungiso iZiko.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esiqatywa okanye isiDiploma iSizwe kwiNkqubo yoLawulo lokuKhuseleka okanye ngesigqibo esihambelana nalo. 3-5 unyaka wamava okulawula kwinqanaba le-ASD kwindawo efanayo naleyaya. Ukuziphatha kwi-khompyutha. Ilayiseni yokuqhuba ephathwayo. Iakhompetensi nemiqatho: Ulwazi olujulile ngeenkqubo zengqungqula kunye namagunya karhulumante anjengesiMthetho sokuPhakamisa uFikelelo kwiiNkcazelo, iNgceni eMhlophe ngeMisebenzi yoLungiso kunye noMthetho we-ICT. Ukulawula abantu nokubakhulisa. Ikhono lokumisela iqhinga-rhulumente nokuba ngumqhankqalazi. Ukulawula iinkqubo namaprojekthi. Ukuzisolisa iingcinga kwaye uluhlalutye. Eemigaqo yolawulo, eemigaqo yokuLawula ingozi, ukuphathwa kwengxoxo, i Presentation, ukulawula ixesha, ukubhala iingxelo ngekhono lokuThetha-nxaxhumba.
xh.duties: Phatha uze ufake ngokusebenziseko iinjongo zoLwazi ngokuKhuseleka. Phezulu iinkqubo, iindlela, amazinga namacebo aqhutywa phambili okusebenza. Uphononongo ngamathuba amasha nophuhliso kwinkalo yalo wazi ngokuKhuseleka. Qhagamshelana, gcina uze uqinisekise inkonzo yabathengi kunye nokuhanjiswa kwenkonzo. Chonga uze uncedise abathengi. Gcina ubudlelwane obulinganelayo phakathi kwabantu. Hlanganisa imisebenzi yomncedbi wolwazi ongaphantsi. Faka ngokusebenziseko amacebo e projekthi. Zuzisa iinjongo ezifunyenwe kucebo le projekthi. Yenza ukulawula ingozi nokuqonda imiqaqawu ukulawula. Zibandakanye kwinkqubo yedatha ngobubanzi phambi kokubhala iinkqubo. Phuhlisa ukuzipheka ngokulinganisa amaxhoxho. Qhubekisa phambili lawulwa kwesixokelewaninkqubo. Qinisekisa ulawulo olululo olugqwesileyo lophuhliso. Ukulawula abantu: Qinisekisa ukusebenza ngokwemmango, ukuba abasebenzi badiyasse imisebenzi yabo nokusetyenziswa okugqwesileyo khwakhwethu. Lawulo lempahla, eemali.

Five (5) years’ experience in Monitoring and Reporting of which 3 years must be at a managerial/ASD level. Computer literacy. Valid driver’s licence. Policy framework for the government-wide monitoring and evaluation system. South African Statistical Quality Assessment Framework. National Evaluation Policy Framework (NEPF). Policy imperatives, strategic planning guidelines, management and development. Knowledge and experience of problem-solving technique. Planning and organisation. Relationship management, programme and project management. Analytical thinking, presentation, research data analysis, report writing, interpersonal, communication, interpersonal and diplomacy skills. Emotional intelligence, change management, risk management, goal orientation, leadership and people management skills.

Identify early signs of non-compliance or missed targets and offer corrective strategies to line managers. Establish and manage the institutional PoE framework. Review the source documents submitted by branches to ensure it completely supports the reported performance or reasons for deviations. Prepare data and performance presentations to internal stakeholders and external oversight bodies, including portfolio committees, audit committee, etc. Manage and develop policies and monitoring tools. Draft and institutionalize internal reporting SOPs so all branches understand how, when and where to submit their data. Oversee the implementation of the departmental monitoring and reporting tools. Facilitate the monitoring and reporting training for branches and regions. ensure provision of support services within the branch. Coordinate the strategic management forums and meetings for the quarterly and annual reports. Establish and maintain appropriate internal controls and reporting systems to meet performance expectations. Management of human resources, finance and assets. Management of performance information.

af.title: Onderdirekteur: Monitering en Verslagdoening
af.summary: Onderdirekteur: Monitering en Verslagdoening by die Department of Correctional Services National Head Office, wat 'n relevante graad en vyf jaar ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Erkende Graad of Nasionale Diploma in Openbare Administrasie/Ouditeurwerk/Statistiek/Monitering en Evaluering of relevante kwalifikasie. Vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in Monitering en Verslagdoening waarvan 3 jaar op bestuurs-/ASD-vlak moet wees. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede en attribute: Kennis van moniterings- en evalueringsprosesse. Kennis van navorsingsmetodes. Kennis van staatslike riglyne. Openbare Finansiesbestuur. Beleidsraamwerk vir die regeringsbreed moniterings- en evalueringstelsel. Suid-Afrikaanse Statistiese Kwaliteitsassesseringsraamwerk. Nasionale Evalueringsbeleidsraamwerk (NEPF). Beleidsimperatiewe, strategiese beplanningsriglyne, bestuur en ontwikkeling. Kennis en ervaring van probleemoplossingstegnieke. Beplanning en organisering. Verhoudingsbestuur, program- en projekbestuur. Analitiese denke, voorlegging, navorsingsdata-analise, verslagskryf, interpersoonlike, kommunikasie, interpersoonlike en diplomasievaardighede. Emosionele intelligensie, veranderingbestuur, risikobestuur, doelgerigtheid, leierskap en mensebestuursvaardighede.
af.duties: Samestelling van prestasie-inligtingsverslae vir die departement. Bestuur die insameling, verifikasie en evaluering van bewysgebaseerde prestasie-inligting. Identifiseer vroeë tekens van nie-nakoming of gemiste teikens en bied regstellende strategieë aan lynbestuurders. Vestig en bestuur die institutionele PoE-raamwerk. Hersien die brondokumente wat deur takke ingedien is om te verseker dit ondersteun volledig die gerapporteerde prestasie of redes vir afwykings. Berei data- en prestasievoorleggings voor vir interne belanghebbendes en eksterne toesigliggame, insluitend portefeuljekomitees, ouditeerkomitee, ens. Bestuur en ontwikkel beleide en moniteringsinstrumente. Ontwerp en institusionaliseer interne verslagdoening-SOP's sodat alle takke verstaan hoe, wanneer en waar om hul data in te dien. Hou toesig oor die implementering van die departementele moniterings- en verslagdoeningsinstrumente. Fasiliteer die moniterings- en verslagdoeningstraining vir takke en streke. Verskaf ondersteuningsdienste binne die tak. Koördineer die strategiese bestuursforums en vergaderings vir die kwartaal- en jaarverslae. Vestig en handhaaf toepaslike interne kontroles en verslagdoeningstelsels om aan prestasieverwagtinge te voldoen. Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne, finansies en bates. Bestuur van prestasie-inligting.

zu.title: Isikhulu Esihlalo: Ukulondolozwa Nokuqoshwa
zu.summary: Isikhulu Esihlalo: Ukulondolozwa Nokuqoshwa eDipartimenti Ezinkonzweni Zokulungisa Ehhovisi Elikhulu Lezwe, kudinga iziqu ezihambisanayo neminyaka emihlanu yohlelo lokusebenza.
zu.requirements: I-Degree noma i-National Diploma ebhalwe ngokusemthethweni ku-Public Administration/ Auditing/ Statistics/ Monitoring and Evaluation noma iziqu ezihambisanayo. Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yohlelo lokusebenza ekulondolozweni nokuqoshwa, okuyiminyaka engu-3 kumele ibe ngazinga labaphathi/ASD. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ikhono Nokubaluleka: Ulwazi mayelana nenqubo yokulondoloza nokuhlola. Ulwazi mayelana nezindlela zocwaningo. Ulwazi mayelana nezindlela zokuhola zahulumeni. I-Public Finance Management. Isakhiwo senqubomgomo sesistimu yokulondoloza nokuhlola kahulumeni wonke. I-South African Statistical Quality Assessment Framework. I-National Evaluation Policy Framework (NEPF). Okudingekayo ngokwenqubomgomo, izindlela zokuhlela okubalulekile, ukuphatha nentuthuko. Ulwazi nohlelo lokusebenza ekuxazululweni izinkinga. Ukuhlela nokuhlela. Ukuphatha ubudlelwano, ukuphatha amaphroghramu namaphrojekthi. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, ukuthwesa obala, ukuhlola idatha yocwaningo, ukubhala imibiko, ubuhlakani bokuxhumana nabantu, ukuxhumana, namakhono ob diplomatic. Ukuqonda izinkanuko, ukuphatha inguquko, ukuphatha ingozi, ukugxila kumgomo, ukukhokhela nokuphatha abantu.
zu.duties: Ukuhlanganisa imibiko yolwazi ngemisebenzi yomnyango. Ukuphatha ukuqoqa, ukuqinisekisa nokuhlola ulwazi olusekelwe emsebenzini. Ukukhomba izinkomba zokuqala zokungahambisani noma okuhlose kwenzekanga nokunikeza izindlela zokulungisa kubaphathi bemigqa. Ukusungula nokuphatha isakhiwo se-institutional PoE. Ukubuyeza imadokhumenti omthombo ethunyelwe amagatsha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi igxila ekusekeleni ngokugcwele umsebenzi oqoshiwe noma izizathu zokungahambisani. Ukuhlulela idatha nemibiko yemibhalo ebukhwele abantu abangenaphakathi namasemu okuhlola angaphandle, okuhlanganisa amakomidi e-portfolio, ikomidi lokuhlolwa, njll. Ukuphatha nentuthuko yezinqubomgomo namathuluzi okulondoloza. Ukubhala futhi kuqale ngokusemthethweni ama-SOP okuqoshwa ngaphakathi ukuze wonke amagatsha aqonde ukuthi kanjani, nini futhi kuphi kufanele kuthunyele idatha yawo. Ukubuka ukusetshenziswa kwamathuluzi womnyango wokulondoloza nokuqopha. Ukwenza kwenzeke ukulondolozwa nokuqoshwa kokuqeqeshwa kwamagatsha namasifundazwe. Qinisekisa ukunikezwa kwezinsiza zokusekela ngaphakathi kwesigatsha. Ukuhlanganisa amafolamu okuphatha okubalulekile namaphimpho zemihlangano yemibiko yegodi neminyaka yonke. Ukusungula nokugcina izilawulo ezifanele zangaphakathi nezistimu zokuqopha ukuze kuhambisanelwe nezinhloso zemisebenzi. Ukuphatha abantu, izimali nezimpahla. Ukuphatha ulwazi ngemisebenzi.

xh.title: Under-Mongameli: Ulawulo nokubika
xh.summary: Under-Mongameli: Ulawulo nokubika kwisebe leZiko leQela leeSebe zeNkonzo zoLungelelaniso kwindlu yeenkonzo ezingongameleyo, kufuneka ibe nesidanga esifanelekileyo kunye neminye emihlanu (5) yamava.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esiqatshelwa okanye iDiploma yezwelonke kuLawulo loLuntu/ uKuhlolwa/ izibalo/ uLawulo noNxibelelwano okanye ngesiqu esifanelekileyo. Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava kuLawulo nokubila apho kweminyaka emi-3 kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba labalawuli/ASD. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Iimpawu nokuziphatha: Ulwazi lwemisebenzi yolawulo noxinzelelo. Ulwazi lwendlela zophando. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zikarhulumente. uLawulo lweMali yoLuntu. Isakhelo senkqubo yolawulo noxinzelelo kuwo onke amaqela karhulumente. Isakhelo soQeqesho loMgangatho lweZibalo zaseMzantsi Afrika. Isakhelo senkqubo yoQeqesho loLuntu iQondo (NEPF). Iimfuno zenkqubo, iinkqubo zocwangco lwendlela, ulawulo nophuhliso. Ulwazi namava kwindlela yokuxazulula iingxaki. Ucwangco lolwakhiwo. uLawulo bobudlelwane, ulawulo lweenkqubo namaphulo. Okuqondisa ngengqondo, imiboniso, uhlalutyo lwedatha yophando, ukubhaliwe kweengxelo, amava obuntu, amava nokuziphatheka, kunye namava obuqhetseba. Ukuqonda iimvakalelo, ulawulo loshintsho, ulawulo lweengozi, ukumiselwa kwemigangatho, amava obukhulu kunye namava okulawula abantu.
xh.duties: Ukulungiselela iingxelo zenkcazolo yemisebenzi yesebe. uLawulo lokuqokelela, ukuqinisekisa nokulinganisa inkcazolo yemisebenzi esekelwe ngebungazi. Ukuqaphela iimpawu zokuqala zokungahoyi imigangatho okanye ezingafinyelelwa kwaye unikeze iindlela zokulungisa kubalawuli bemigca. Uku misela ulawulo lwebungazi bePoB esikhundleni. ukuHlola amaxwebhu achumiweyo awalwe ngamasebe ukunika isiqinisekiso sokuba axhasa ngokupheleleyo inkcazolo ebalwayo yomsebenzi okanye iimeko zokungahambelaniyo. ukuLungiselela idatha namaboniso emisebenzi kubathathi-nxaxheba bangaphakathi namabandla okulawula angaphandle, kuquka namakomiti amabango, ikomiti yokuhlolwa, njl. UkuLawula nophuhlisa iinkqubo namathulusi olawulo. UkuBhala nokumiswa kweenkqubo zangaphakathi zokubala iingxelo i-SOPs ukuze onke amasebe aqonde indlela, xesha nendawo yokungenisa idatha yawo. UkuQhuba ungeniso lweenkqubo namathulusi abalawulo nokubika esebe. ukuNcedisa uqeqesho lolawulo nokubika kumasebe nakummandla. ukuQinisekisa ukunikelwa kweenkonzo zoxhaso ngaphakathi kwesebe. ukuLungelelanisa amabandla abalawuli bendlela nemiqungqo yeengxelo zesikathi ngenyaka nazonyaka. UkuMisa kwaye ulondoloze iindlela zolawulo ezifanelekileyo zangaphakathi neenkqubo zokubika ukuba zihambelana nethemba lemisebenzi. uLawulo abantu, lweemali nezinto. uLawulo Iinkcukacha zemisebenzi yokulinganisa.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Production Workshops
jobs.summary: Deputy Director role managing production workshops and bakeries policy, operations and service standards at the Correctional Services National Head Office.
jobs.requirements: Recognized Degree or National Diploma in Production Management/ Operations Management or relevant qualification. Project management will be an added advantage. 3-5 years management experience at an ASD level in a similar environment. Computer literacy. Valid driver’s licence. Competencies And Attributes: Financial management. Plan, organize, lead and control. Change management. Team leadership. Project management. Problem solving and decision-making, facilitation and presentation skills. Conflict management. Report writing. Training and development. Knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook). Time management. Confidentiality. Coaching and mentoring. Understanding of Public Service policy and legislative framework. Service delivery and client orientation. Integrity and honesty. Assertiveness. Ability to network with stakeholders. Influence and impact. Accountability. Willingness to travel. Applied strategic thinking.
jobs.duties: Manage the policy and procedure formulation on production workshop and bakeries. Manage and coordinate the provision of production workshops and bakeries services. Ensure planning and operations management of production workshops and bakeries. Ensure adherence to service level standards. Monitoring and evaluation of productions workshops and bakeries to ensure optimum utilization of resources, cost savings, and production workshops revenue generation. Provide technical support services to regions and operational level. Report on the production/manufacturing output and financial performance of production workshops and bakeries. Ensure enhancement of self-sufficiency and sustainability in production workshops and bakeries, as well as offender development. Conduct economic analysis of production workshop and bakeries. Marketing of services rendered by production workshops and bakeries. Delivery of organizational support services and administration. Management of human resources, finance and assets. Management of performance information.
jobs.enquiries: National Head Office: Ms NS Khumalo Tel No: (012) 307 2174 or Ms TP Ngobeni Tel No: (012) 305 8589.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Produksiewerkswinkels
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur-pos wat die bestuur van produksiewerkswinkels en bakkerye se beleid, bedrywighede en diensstandaarde by die Correctional Services National Head Office behels.
af.requirements: Erkende graad of nasionale diploma in produksiebestuur/bedrywighedebestuur of 'n relevante kwalifikasie. Projektbestuur sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 3-5 jaar bestuurservaring op 'n ASD-vlak in 'n soortgelyke omgewing. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede en eienskappe: Finansiële bestuur. Beplan, organiseer, lei en beheer. Veranderingsbestuur. Spanleierskap. Projektbestuur. Probleemoplossing en besluitneming, fasilitering en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Konflikbestuur. Verslagdoening. Opleiding en ontwikkeling. Kennis van Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook). Tydbestuur. Vertroulikheid. Afrigting en mentorskap. Begrip van Openbare Diens-beleid en wetgewende raamwerk. Dienslewering en kliëntgerigtheid. Integriteit en eerlikheid. Vasberadenheid. Vermoë om met belanghebbendes te netwerk. Beïnvloeding en impak. Verantwoordelikheid. Bereidwilligheid om te reis. Toegepaste strategiese denke.
af.duties: Bestuur die formulering van beleid en prosedures vir produksiewerkswinkels en bakkerye. Bestuur en koördineer die verskaffing van produksiewerkswinkel- en bakkerydienste. Verseker beplanning en bedryfsbestuur van produksiewerkswinkels en bakkerye. Verseker nakoming van diensvlakstandaarde. Monitering en evaluering van produksiewerkswinkels en bakkerye om optimale benutting van hulpbronne, kostebesparings en inkomstegegenereering deur produksiewerkswinkels te verseker. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuningsdienste aan streke en operasionele vlak. Rapporteer oor die produksie-/vervaardigingsuitset en finansiële prestasie van produksiewerkswinkels en bakkerye. Verseker die verbetering van selfvoorsiening en volhoubaarheid in produksiewerkswinkels en bakkerye, asook oortrederontwikkeling. Voer ekonomiese ontleding van produksiewerkswinkels en bakkerye uit. Bemarking van dienste wat deur produksiewerkswinkels en bakkerye gelewer word. Lewering van organisatoriese ondersteuningsdienste en administrasie. Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne, finansies en bates. Bestuur van prestasie-inligting.

zu.title: Onjiniyela Omncane: Amawokshophu Okukhiqiza
zu.summary: Indima ka-Onjiniyela Omncane ephatha inqubomgomo yamawokshophu okukhiqiza nabezinkwa, imisebenzi nemizingcolo yesevisi eNdiweni Kazwelonke yeZikhungo Zokulungisa.
zu.requirements: I-Degree noma i-National Diploma evunyiweyo ku-Production Management/ Operations Management noma isifundo esifanele. Izindlela zokuqonda ukuphathwa kwezinhlela kuzoba yinzuzo. Uzothola eminyaka engu-3-5 ubhonisa wokuphathwa kwabantu emzinganweni we-ASD kwindawana efanayo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ukuzwana nezinye izici: Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ukwenza izinhlela, ukuhlela, ukukhulekela nokulawula. Ukushintshwa kwemisindo yomzimba. Ukuba ngumholi wethimba. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlela. Izindlela zokuxazula izinkinga nokuqamba izigqibo, amakhono okusiza nokwethula. Ukuphathwa kwezinkinga zomkhankaso. Ukubhala umbiko. Ukuqeqesha nokuqeqesha abanye. Ulwazi lwe-Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook). Ukuphathwa kwesikhathi. Ukugcina imfihlo. Ukuqeqesha futhi unikezezelane. Ukuqonda inqubomgomo yomphakathi nenhlelo yomthetho. Ukulethwa kwezinsizakalo nokuqondiswa ngabathengi. Ukuba necanso nokuzethemba. Ukuba nesibindi. Amandla okuxhumana nabantu abaningi abahlanganyene. Ukuqinisekisa futhi uthinte abanye. Ukuba nocoselelwano. Ukuthanda ukuhamba. Ukucabangisisa ngezindlela ezibusisekileyo.
zu.duties: Phatha ukwenziwa kwenqubomgomo nendlela yokuqhuba okukhiqizwa kumawokshophu nabezinkwa. Yenza izinhlela futhi uhlele ukulethwa kwezinkonzo zamawokshophu okukhiqiza nabezinkwa. Qinisekisa ukwenziwa kwezinhlela nokuphathwa kwezokusebenza kwamawokshophu okukhiqiza nabezinkwa. Qinisekisa ukulandelwa kwemizingcolo yezigaba zesevisi. Ukulawula futhi ukuhlola amawokshophu okukhiqiza nabezinkwa ukuze kuqiniseke ukusetshenziswa okuhle kwezinsizakalo, ukulondoloza izindleko, nokukhiqizwa kwezimali ngamawokshophu. Hlinzeka ngemisebenzi yesiqondiso nezomthetho emiphakathini nasemazingeni okusebenza. Nikeza umbiko ngokukhiqizwa/ukukhiqiza futhi ngomumo wezimali wamawokshophu okukhiqiza nabezinkwa. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kokuzinciphisa nokugcina imisebenzi emawokshophu okukhiqiza nabezinkwa, kanye nenhlalo yenhlalo yonke umuntu. Yenza isilinganiso sezomnotho samawokshophu okukhiqiza nabezinkwa. Ukumaketha izinkonzo ezinikwa ngamawokshophu okukhiqiza nabezinkwa. Ukulethwa kwezinkonzo zokusekela inhlangano nokuphathwa. Ukuphathwa kwezinsizakalo zabantu, izimali nezimpahla. Ukuphathwa kolwazi ngokusebenza kahle.

xh.title: Nodeputy Director: Iindlela zoMveliso
xh.summary: Indima kaNodeputy Director yokulawula iindlela zomveliso kunye nenkqubo yepekcake, iziqu ezibhalwe ngazo kunye namazinga enkonzo eKwisiKolo seNtloko eSizikile sokuQonda izigulana.

Ilayisensi yokushayela egunyaziweyo. Ukuzoba namagunya: UkuLawula iMali. Cwangcisa, hlela, mbekisa ilawule. Ukulawula iinguquko. Ukukhokela iqela. Ukulawula iiprojekthi. Isiphicoxesiphico sokuxazulula iingxaki nokwenza izigqibo, amandla okuququzelela nokubonisa, kunye namandla okuzibonakalisa. Ukulawula imiphumo engemihle. UkuBhala iingxelo. Ukufundisa nokuphucula. Ukuqonda iMicrosoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook). UkuLawula ixesha. Ukugcina imfihlo. Ukuqeqesha nokuqeqesha abanye. Ukuqonda inkqubo yolwazi yoLuntu kunye nolwazi we- ntlando yamagunya. Ukuhambisa iinkonzo nokumisela ukujolisa kumaxhwebi. Intembeko nokwethembeka. Ukuzimisela. Amandla okusebenzisana namaxhwebi. Ukubanamandla nokuchaphazela. Ukuhlawulela. Ukulungelelanisa ukuhamba. Ukuqonda ngokobuchule.
xh.duties: Lawula inkqubo neSithundo ngendlela ezenziwayo ngayo iindlela zomveliso neze pekcake. Lawula ukuququzelelwa kwemisebenzi yezi ndlela zepekcake zomveliso. Qinisekisa ucwangciso nokulawula ukusetyenziswa kwemiSebenzi yezi ndlela zomveliso neze pekcake. Qinisekisa ukubambelela kwamazinga enkonzo. Ukuqonda nokubeka kwawo nokuqondisa iindlela zomveliso neze pekcake ukuze kusetyenziswe ngokupheleleyo amandla, okugcinwa kwamaxabiso, kwanakuqhela iindlela zamali. Wela inkonzo yolwazi lwamandla kumacandelo naseqopheni lokuSebenza. Bhala ingxelo ngokuvela komveliso / ukwenziwa kwakho nakwindalo yezimali kwezi ndlela zomveliso neze pekcake. Qinisekisa ukuphuculwa kokuzicinga nokuzigcina kwendalo kwezi ndlela zomveliso nezepekcake, nasekucheneni kolwazi koluguquliweyo. Yenza isicoci solwazi lwezo ndlela zomveliso neze pekcake. Ukukhangela iinkonzo ezenziwa yile ndlela zomveliso neze pekcake. Ukuhambisa iinkonzo zoBuncwadi nokuLawula. UkuLawula abantu, imali nangaphezu kweempahla. UkuLawula ulwazi ngokuPhelelelwa.

Assertiveness. Networking.

Ensure projects adhere to organizational standards and timelines. Manage and coordinate staff training needs in network technologies. Arrange and coordinate training programs. af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Netwerkingenieur
af.summary: Bestuur en onderhou netwerkinfrastruktuur vir die Department of Correctional Services by Nasionale Hoofkantoor, wat 'n IT-diploma en 3-5 jaar se netwerkervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Erkende graad of Nasionale Diploma in Inligtingstegnologie/Rekenaarwetenskap of 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie. 3-5 jaar soliede IT-ervaring in Netwerkinfrastruktuurbestuur op 'n ASD-vlak. Fortinet- of Huawei-gesertifiseerde netwerksertifiserings sal 'n voordeel wees. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede en eienskappe: Sterk IT-netwerkinfrastruktuurvaardighede is verpligtend. Kennis van veelvuldige tegniese dissiplines (netwerke/TCP/IP, netwerktopologieë/Huawei of Fortinet-infrastrukture, werkstasiekonnektiwiteit, toepaslike sagteware en probleemoplossingstegnieke en webtegnologie). Goeie kliëntverhoudinge, sterk kommunikasie, probleemoplossing en verslagskryfvaardighede. Funksionele vermoë. Vinnige denke. Diagnostiese aksienavorsing. Konseptuele denke. Innovatief en kreatief. Selfhandhawing. Netwerking.
af.duties: Bestuur netwerkinfrastruktuur binne DCS. Ontwerp, implementeer en onderhou hardeware- en sagteware-infrastruktuur. Konfigureer IT-toerusting en netwerkstelsels. Ontwikkel, hersien en monitor die implementering van netwerkbeleid. Bestuur veranderingbeheer en probleembestuurprosesse. Verseker behoorlike dokumentasie en weergawebeheer. Ondersoek en ondersoek nuwe netwerktegnologieë en stel bestuur in kennis oor tendense. Ondersoek VoIP- en video-toegangstegnologieë en maak aanbevelings. Bly op hoogte van tenders en projekte wat Inligtingsdienste beïnvloed. Verskaf oplossings of stel alternatiewe voor vir Hoofkantoor en die streek se behoeftes. Fasiliteer probleemoplossing vir gebruikers. Berei tenderspesifikasies voor wat met organisatoriese behoeftes ooreenstem. Bestuur projekkontrakte en hou toelewering dop. Speel 'n sleutelrol in risikobestuur vir IT-infrastruktuurprojekte. Verseker dat projekte aan organisatoriese standaarde en tydlyne voldoen. Bestuur en koördineer personeel se opleidingsbehoeftes in netwerktegnologieë. Reël en koördineer opleidingsprogramme. Ondersteun personeel by die aanvaarding van nuwe stelsels en prosesse. Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne, finansies en bates. Bestuur van prestasie-inligting.

zu.title: Isikhulu Esikhulu Esincane: Injiniyela Yethimuli
zu.summary: Phatha futhi igcine izinsiza zethimuli koMnyango Wezinsizakalo Zokulungisa Iziphambeko Ekhaya Lenhlangano Kazwelonke, kudinga idiploma ye-IT nob unyaka abangu-3-5 bokuhlonza ngaphandle kwethimuli.
zu.requirements: Isiqu esithathwa njengokuhlonzekiwe noma iDiploma Yezwe kuTeknoloji yolwazi/Isayensi Yekhompyutha noma isiqu esihambisanayo. 3-5 iminyaka yokuhlonza ngqo ku-IT ekuphathweni kwesakhiwo sethimuli ezingeni le-ASD. Ukuqinisekiswa kuthimuli kwe-Fortinet noma i-Huawei kuzongeza inzuzo. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ikhono Nokuziphendulela: Ikhono eliqinile le-IT esakhiweni sethimuli kuyadingeka ngokuphelele. Ulwazi lwezifundo eziningi zobuchwepheshe (amathimuli/TCP/IP, izakhiwo zamathimuli/izakhiwo ze-Huawei noma i-Fortinet, ukuhlanganiswa kweziteshi zomsebenzisi, isoftware ehambisana nendlela yokuxazulula izinkinga nobuchwepheshe be-web). Uxhumano oluhle nabathengi, ukuxhumana okuqinile, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokubhala imibiko. Ikhono lokusebenza. Ukucabanga ngokushesha. Ucwaningo lokuxazulula izinkinga. Ukucabanga ngokuqonda. Bukhulu bengqondo nokudala. Ukuqina. Ukuxhumana.
zu.duties: Phatha izakhiwo zethimuli ngaphakathi kwe-DCS. Yakha, wenze futhi ulonde izakhiwo zohardiwe nesoftware. Hlanganisela ithuluzi le-IT namasistimu ethimuli. Buka kabusha futhi ulawule ukusetshenziswa kwezinqubo zethimuli. Lawula ukushintsha kolawulo nokuqondisa izinkinga. Qinisekisa ukulandelwa kokuqoshwa kanye nokuqondisa izinguqulo. Cwaninga futhi uphenye ubuchwepheshe obusha bethimuli uthwese abaphathi ngamathrendi. Cwaninga ubuchwepheshe be-VoIP nokuvinikelwa kwevidiyo wenze izincomo. Gcina ukwaziswa ngemiklamo namaprojekthi abhekana nezinsizakalo Zolwazi. Nikeza izixazululo noma phakamisa ezinye izindlela ezingenhla kwazo zonke izidingo zenhlangano nasesifundeni. Siza ekuxazululeni izinkingi zabasebenzisi. Lukela izinkomba zemiklamo ezihambisana nezidingo zenhlangano. Lawula izinkontilhaka zamaprojekthi ubheke ukulethwa. Dlala indima ebalulekile ekuphathweni kwezengozi kumaprojekthi wesakhiwo se-IT. Qinisekisa ukuthi amaprojekthi alandela izindinganiso nezikhathi zenhlangano. Phatha futhi uhlele izidingo zokuqeqesha abasebenzi obuchwepheshe bethimuli. Hlela futhi uhlele amaphulo okuqeqesha. Seke abasebenzi ekuthatheni amasistimu nobuqamba obusha. Ukuphatha abantu, imali nezimpahla. Ukuphatha ukwaziswa ngemiklamo.

xh.title: iSebe leNjingalwazi leNethiwekhi: uMongameli oNgcangalelew
xh.summary: Lawula aphume igqitha kwaye ulondoloze iziseko zolwakhiwo lwenethiwekhi kwiSebe lezeZigwebo eNtloko eNqwanqweni, kufuneka kubekho isatifikethi se-IT kunye neminyaka emi-3-5 yamava enethiwekhi.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esivunyiweyo okanye iNdiploma yeSizwe kwiNgcobo yolwazi/Isayensi yekhompyutha okanye isatifikethi esifanelekileyo. Iimvelwano zeminyaka emi-3-5 yamava aqinileyo e-IT ekulawulweni kweziseko zolwakhiwo lwenethiwekhi kwinqanaba le-ASD. Izatifikethi zeenethiwekhi ezivunyiweyo ze-Fortinet okanye i-Huawei ziya kuba luncedo elongeziweyo. ilayisenesi yomqhubi egunyazisiweyo. Amandla nokulinganisa: Amandla amaninzi eziseko zolwakhiwo lwenethiwekhi ze-IT iyafezekiswa. Ulwazi ngeendlela ezininzi zezobuchwepheshe (iinethiwekhi/i-TCP/IP, iindidi zenethiwekhi/iziseko zolwakhiwo ze-Huawei okanye i-Fortinet, uqhagamshelo lomsebenzi, isoftware esebenziswayo neendlela zokuzisa izisombululo nobuchwepheshe bewebhu). Ubudlelwane obuhle nabathengi, amandla okuqhatha, isisombululo seenkinga namandla okubhala iingxelo. Amandla okusebenza. Ukucinga ngokukhawuleza. Uphando lokuzisa isisombululo. Ukucinga ngemibono. Ukutsha nokudala. Amandla okuzimisela. Ukuqabanisa.
xh.duties: Lawula iziseko zolwakhiwo lwenethiwekhi ngaphakathi kwi-DCS. Yila, phumeza aphume igqitha ulondoloze iziseko zolwakhiwo zehadhiwe ne software. Misela uqwalaselo lwe-IT kunye neenkqubo zenethiwekhi. Phuhlisa, phinda uqwalasele ulandeleliswe ukuphunyezwiswa kweenkqubo zenethiwekhi. Lawula ulawulo lwenguquko neenkqubo zokulawula iinkinga. Qinisekisa uqwalaselo olufanelekileyo lolawulo loyilo. Phanda uphando ngobuchwepheshe obutsha benethiwekhi uze uncedise abalawuli ngokubakho kweendlela. Phanda nge-VoIP nobuchwepheshe bevidiyo bokuqhagamshela uze wenze izindululo. Zigcine ubomi bakho lunxibeke ngeenkqubo zemisebenzi ezithintayo ezizoNkonzo zaNgcobo. Zeza iindlela okanye phakamisa ezinye iinkqubo iNtloko kwaye iimfuno zommandla. Yiba yinto yokwenza isisombululo seenkinga kubasebenzisi. Lungiselela iinkqubo zekhontrathi ezihambelana neemfuno zenkampani. Lawula iikhontrathi zeeprojekthi uze ulawule ukufikelelwa. Dlala indima ephambili ekulawulweni ingozi kwiiprojekthi zeziseko zolwakhiwo ze-IT. Qinisekisa ukuba iiprojekthi zilandela iinkqubo zolawulo nexesha elifunekayo. Lawula uze ulungelelanise iimfuno zoluntu zolwazi ngobuchwepheshe benethiwekhi. Hlela uze ulungelelanise iinkqubo zolwazi. Xhasa abasebenzi ekwamkeleni iinkqubo neenkqubo ezintsha. Ulawulo lweemfuno zoluntu, zomanyano nezinto. Ulawulo lolwazi ngemveliso.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Administrative Support
jobs.summary: Coordinate conference facilities and meeting support for the Commissioner at the Department of Correctional Services National Head Office.
jobs.requirements: Recognised National Diploma / Bachelor’s Degree in Public Administration / Management or relevant qualification. 3-5 years middle management experience in a similar environment. Computer literate. Valid drivers’ licence. Competencies And Attributes: Knowledge of constitutional values and principles and how they apply to public service delivery. Ability to work under pressure. Ability to work in a team and independently. Political sensitivity and diplomacy. Organizational, communication, interpersonal and problem-solving skills. Project management and leadership skills. Confidentiality. Integrity.
jobs.duties: The administration of conference centres. The preparation of meeting venues for meetings chaired by the Commissioner. The making of support arrangements for attendees of meetings chaired by the Commissioner. Coordinating and managing meetings, including preparation of agendas, taking minutes and following up on action items. The administration of documentation in the Office of the Commissioner. The preparation of incoming/outgoing mail. The filing of correspondence. The distribution of correspondence in the office of the Commissioner. The sending/receiving of faxes. The control of use of the photocopier. The control of use of shared equipment. The administration of consumer services to the Office of the Commissioner. Act as inventory controller for the Office of the Commissioner. Requisition of supplies. Deciding on the repair of equipment. Act as financial clerk for the office. Maintaining of budgetary information on estimates and expenditure. Processing of claims for members of the Office of the Commissioner. Ensure the payment of diverse accounts/invoices received at the Office of the Commissioner. The management of secretarial services in the Department. The provision of secretarial services to managers in the Department. The training and development of secretaries in the Department. The development of secretarial policies for the Department. Manage human resources, finance and assets. Management of performance information.
jobs.enquiries: National Head Office: Ms NS Khumalo Tel No: (012) 307 2174 or Ms TP Ngobeni Tel No: (012) 305 8589.
jobs.applications: should be submitted online at https://careers.dcs.gov.za/. Emailed, post or hand delivered applications will not be considered.
jobs.notes: Candidates who previously applied need to re-apply. Appointment under the Public Service Act. Before you apply: All costs associated with an application will be borne by the applicant. Applicants who have retired from the Public Service with a specific determination that they cannot be re-appointed or have been declared medically unfit will not be considered. Please take note that correspondence will only be conducted with the shortlisted candidates. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application is unsuccessful. Please do not call the department to enquire about the progress of your application. Applicants must note that further checks will be conducted once they are shortlisted and that their appointment is subject to positive outcomes on these checks, which include security clearance, security vetting, qualification verification and criminal records verification. Appointment will be provisional, pending the issue of a security clearance. If you cannot get a security clearance, your appointment will be re-considered/possibly terminated. Fingerprints may be taken on the day of the interview. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One shall be a practical exercise, and the other shall be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applications: Applications must be submitted on the Z83 form (Public Service application form) obtainable from any Public Service department and must be completed in full. Only a detailed CV should be attached to your application form. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies not older than 6 months of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview. Please send a complete application for the post you apply for on a pdf format, stating the correct reference for the position you are interested in. Requirement for valid driver’s licence is not applicable to applicants with a disability. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Administratiewe Ondersteuning
af.summary: Koördineer konferensiefasiliteite en vergaderondersteuning vir die Kommissaris by die Department of Correctional Services Nasionale Hoofkantoor.
af.requirements: Erkende Nasionale Diploma / Bachelorsgraad in Openbare Administrasie / Bestuur of relevante kwalifikasie. 3-5 jaar middelbestuurservaring in 'n soortgelyke omgewing. Rekenaarvaardig. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede en eienskappe: Kennis van grondwetlike waardes en beginsels en hoe dit op openbare dienslewering van toepassing is. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Vermoë om in 'n span en onafhanklik te werk. Politieke sensitiwiteit en diplomasie. Organisatoriese, kommunikasie, interpersoonlike en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Projekbestuurs- en leierskapsvaardighede. Konfidensialiteit. Integriteit.
af.duties: Die administrasie van konferensiesentrums. Die voorbereiding van vergaderruimtes vir vergaderings onder voorsitterskap van die Kommissaris. Die reël van ondersteuningsreëlings vir bywoners van vergaderings onder voorsitterskap van die Kommissaris. Die koördineer en bestuur van vergaderings, insluitend die voorbereiding van agenda's, die neem van notules en die opvolg van aksiepunte. Die administrasie van dokumentasie in die Kantoor van die Kommissaris. Die voorbereiding van inkomende/uitgaande pos. Die indien van korrespondensie. Die verspreiding van korrespondensie in die kantoor van die Kommissaris. Die stuur/ontvang van faksse. Die beheer van die gebruik van die fotokopieermasjien. Die beheer van die gebruik van gedeelde toerusting. Die administrasie van verbruikersdienste aan die Kantoor van die Kommissaris. Tree op as voorraadbeheerder vir die Kantoor van die Kommissaris. Die aanvraag van voorrade. Die besluitneming oor die herstel van toerusting. Tree op as finansiële klerk vir die kantoor. Die instandhouding van begrotingsinligting oor skattings en besteding. Die verwerking van eise vir lede van die Kantoor van die Kommissaris. Verseker die betaling van diverse rekenings/fakture wat by die Kantoor van die Kommissaris ontvang word. Die bestuur van sekretariële dienste in die departement. Die voorsiening van sekretariële dienste aan bestuurders in die departement. Die opleiding en ontwikkeling van sekretarisse in die departement. Die ontwikkeling van sekretariële beleid vir die departement. Bestuur menslike hulpbronne, finansies en bates. Bestuur van prestasie-inligting.

zu.title: Omunye Nomphathi: Ukusekelwa Kokuphatha
zu.summary: Hlanganisa izinto zokuqasha izikhungo zengqungquthela noku sekela izinkqubo zokuhlangana kwaMphathi eNtlikweni Kazwelonke le Department of Correctional Services.
zu.requirements: National Diploma / Bachelor’s Degree ebonakalayo ku Public Administration / Management noma isifundo esihambisana nalokhu. Unyaka obuka 3-5 wokuphatha emazingeni aphakathi endaweni efana nale. Ukubhala ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisenisi yokushayela evumelekile. Amakhono nezimpawu: Ulwazi ngamagugu nemigomo yomthethosisekelo kanye nendlela okusetshenziswa ngayo ekulethweni izinsiza zikahulumeni. Isipho sokusebenza ngaphansi kweinkalo. Isipho sokusebenza eqenjini nokodwa. Uzwelo lokuzwilakucabangwa kanye nobu diplomatici. Amakhono okuhlelwa, okuxhumana, okuxhumana nabantu nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono okuphatha amaphrojekthi nokuba ngumholi. Ukugcina imfihlo. Ukuziphatha kahle.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha izikhungo zengqungquthela. Ukulungisa izindawo zokuhlanganisa kwemihlangano eholwa nguMphathi. Ukwenza izinhlelo zokusekela abathintekehle emihlanganweni eholwa nguMphathi. Ukuhlanganisa nokuphatha imihlangano, okuhlanganisa ukulungisa ohlelo lwemihlangano, ukubhala amaminithi kanye nokulandela izinto ezenziwayo. Ukuphatha uchwepheshe besixuku ehhovisi likaMphathi. Ukulungisa imeyili engenayo/ephumayo. Ukufaka uchwepheshe besixuku eziguqini. Ukusatshaliswa kochwepheshe besixuku ehhovisi likaMphathi. Ukuthumela/ukamukela amafeksi. Ukulawla ukusetshenziswa kwe-photocopier. Ukulawula ukusetshenziswa kwemishini yokuhlanganywa. Ukuphatha izinsiza zokuthengwa ehhovisi likaMphathi. Ukuba ngumlawuli wezimpahla ehhovisi likaMphathi. Ukucela izimpahla. Ukugqiba ngokulungiswa kwemishini. Ukuba ngumkhulu wezimali ehhovisini. Ukugcina ulwazi ngohlelo lwemali mayelana nokulinganiswa nokuchithwa. Ukucubungula izicelo zabantu basehhovisi likaMphathi. Qinisekisa ukukhokhwa kwe-akhawunti/izinikino ezehlukene ezitholakala ehhovisi likaMphathi. Ukuphatha izinsiza zokuba nobhedi ohhovisini e-Mnyangweni. Ukunika abaphathi ohhovisini izinsiza zokuba nobhedi e-Mnyangweni. Ukuqeqesha futhi athuthukise abobhedi e-Mnyangweni. Ukuthuthukisa imigomo yobhedi e-Mnyangweni. Phatha abantu, imali nezimpahla. Ukuphatha ulwazi mayelana nokusebenza.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Inkxaso Yolawulo
xh.summary: Lungelelanisa iziko zemibhiso nenkxaso yemiqungutho kwiKhomishana kwiNtloko ezilonelweyo zeSika leeNkonzo zokuLungisa ezingundoqo kwi Department of Correctional Services.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sezazwe jikelele / Isidanga se-Bachelor kuPublic Administration / Management okanye nelifikilele elo lifanelekileyo. 3-5 iminyaka yamava olawulo ophakathi kwindawo efanayo. Ukuba nokwaziseka ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Iimfuno nokuziphatha: Ulwazi lwamaxabiso namagatya omtsetho-siseko nendlela abasebenza ngayo ekunikelweni kweenkonzo zabantu. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcindezi. Ikhono lokusebenza kwinqanaba elinye nakodwa. Ukuzipatha ngokuzithoba kwezopolitiko namazwi aqhathanisiweyo. Amakhono oluhluho, lonxibelelwano, nabantu, nokuqonda iingxaki. Amakhono olawulo lomsebenzi othusiweyo noqeqesho. Ukugcina iyimfihlo. Ukuzinikela ngokuzithoba.
xh.duties: Ukulawula iindawo zemibhiso. Ulungiselelo lwendawo yomqungutho yemihlangano ephethwe yiKhomishana. Ukwenza izicwangciso zenkxazo kuluntu kubathathi-nxaxheba bemihlangano ephethwe ngamakhomishana. Ulungelelanisa ekulawuleni imihlangano, kuquka ulungiselelo lwe-ndaba, ukubhala iinqubo nokuqhubela phambathi izinto ezizekelwayo. Ukulawula ugcino lwamafxile kwiNtloko yamakomishana. Ulungiselelo lwemiyalezo engena/ephuma. Ugcinio lombhalo. Ukusasazwa kombhalo kwindawo yamakomishana. Ukuthumela/ukwamkela iifeksi. Ukulawula ukusetyenziswa kwe-photocopier. Ukulawula ukusetyenziswa kwesixhobo esahlulwayo. Ukusebenza ngemisebenzi yabathengi kumagunya okuLawulo kwabakhomishana. Ukuthathwa njengomlawuli wokugcina izinto kwiholo yabakhomishana. Isicelo sezixhobo. Ukugqiba ngokuqhuba iisixhobo. Ukuba ngumlawuli wetyala leemali kwindawo. Ukugcina ulwazi lwebhajeti ngeempimiso ezilinganiselweyo nentlawulo. Ukusingatha iimali zomceli kwiholo yabakhomishana. Qinisekisa intlawulo ye-akhawunti/i-invoisi ehlukileyo eziswa kwiholo yabakhomishana. Ukulawula iinkonzo zabasekretari kwisebe. Ukunika inkonzo yabasekretari kubalawuli kwisebe. Uqeqesho nokuthuthukisa abasekretari kwisebe. Ukuthuthukisa iinkqubo zomthetho zabasekretari kwisebe. Ukulawula imisebenzi yabantu, iimali nezixhobo. Ukulawula ulwazi lokusebenza kwakho.

Manage the vendor database and performance of suppliers. Implement Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment. Monitoring of quotation activities. Management of human resources, finance and assets. Management of performance information.
