af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Logistiese Administratiewe Ondersteuning
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir Logistiese Administratiewe Ondersteuning by die Department of Correctional Services Nasionale Hoofkantoor, wat 'n logistieke kwalifikasie en toesigervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Relevante graad/nasionale diploma in Logistieke Bestuur, Voorsieningskettingbestuur of 'n relevante kwalifikasie. 3-5 jaar se toesig-/bestuurservaring op 'n ASD-vlak in Voorsieningskettingbestuur/Logistiek. Kennis van LOGIS, LBIS, gebalanseerde voorafbepalingskaart en finansiële state. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede en kenmerke: Kennis van Voorsieningskettingbestuur. Kennis van Tesourie-regulasies en PFMA. Finansiële bestuur. Probleemoplossing en besluitneming. Spanleierskap. Projektebestuur. Aanbiedingsvaardighede. Konflikbestuur. Verslagskrywing. Opleiding en ontwikkeling. Tydbestuur. Konfidensialiteit. Begrip van openbare diensbeleid en wetgewende raamwerk. Dienslewering en kliëntgerigtheid. Integriteit en eerlikheid. Selfversekerdheid. Vermoë om te netwerk. Beïnvloeding en impak. Toegepaste strategiese denke. Bereidwilligheid om te reis.
af.duties: Ontwerp, formuleer en hersien logistiese administrasiebeleid, prosesse en prosedures in ooreenstemming met departementele beleid, riglyne en prosedures. Bestuur die winkels van die departement. Bestuur bates van die Hoofkantoor. Hou toesig oor die bestelproses en die bestellingsbetalingsproses. Bestuur reisreëlings en betaling. Hou toesig oor die reisbestuurskantoor van die departement. Analiseer verslae en gee advies aan senior bestuur rakende huidige kwessies ten opsigte van Logistiek in die departement en in die algemeen. Samestelling van finansiële state se openbaarmakingsnotas wat verband hou met verbintenisse, toerekenings, betaalbaar, en onnutsame en vermorsende besteding. Monitor en evalueer die nakoming van logistieke beleid en prosedures regdeur die departement. Neem toepaslike regstellende stappe waar nodig. Bestuur die verskaffersdatabasis en prestasie van verskaffers. Implementeer Breedgebaseerde Swart Ekonomiese Bemagtiging. Monitering van kwotasie-aktiwiteite. Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne, finansies en bates. Bestuur van prestasie-inligting.

zu.title: Onozanebe: Ukusekelwa Kokuqondisa Izinsiza
zu.summary: Onozanebe wokuQondisa Izinsiza Kwezinsiza kuHhovu ELikhulu Lezwe le-Department of Correctional Services, ofuna iziqu zokuqondisa izinsiza nolwazi lokubusa abantu.
zu.requirements: Iziqu eziyinhloko/IDiploma Yesizwe ekuqondisweni kwezinsiza, ekuqondisweni kwesikhwemu sokuhlinzeka noma iziqu ezifanele. Uluvo lokubusa/ukulawula iminyaka engu-3-5 ezingeni le-ASD ekuqondisweni kwesikhwemu sokuhlinzeka/izinsiza. Ulwazi nge-LOGIS, i-LBIS, ibhali losulinganiselo kanye nezinkomba zezimali. Ukubuka kakhulu komakhomphyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ikhono nezici: Ulwazi ekuqondisweni kwesikhwemu sokuhlinzeka. Ulwazi ngemithetho yeTreasury kanye ne-PFMA. Ukuqondisa izimali. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo. Ukubusa iqembu. Ukuqondisa amaphrojekthi. Amakhono okethula. Ukuphathwa kwezinkinga. Ukubhala umbiko. Ukuqeqesha nentuthuko. Ukuphathwa kwesikhathi. Ukugcina imfihlo. Ukuqonda umthetho ohlela imisebenzi kahulumeni nezinhlelo ezilawula imisebenzi kahulumeni. Ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi nokujuliswa kwabathengi. Ukuzithiba nokwethembeka. Ukuzimela. Isikhono sokuxhumana. Ukunamathelisa isithukuthezi. Ukucabanga ngokobuchwepheshe. ukulungele ukuhamba.
zu.duties: Hlela, umbeka kabusha futhi ubuke izinqumo zokuqondisa izinsiza, izinqumo kanye nenqubo ngokuhambisana nenqubo, imiyalo kanye nenqubo yomnyango. Phatha izitolo zomnyango. Phatha izimpahla zeHhovo ELikhulu. Qaphela inqubo yokulungiselela ukuthengwa kwenqubo yokukhokha. Phatha izinhlela zokuhamba kanye nokukhokha. Qaphela ihhovu elilawula ukuhamba lomnyango. Hlaziya izibuyekezo umyalo ongaphezulu mayelana nezinkinga zamanje ngokuqondisa izinsiza kumnyango ngokuvamile. Ukulungiselelwa kwezinkomba zokwazisa izinkulumo zezimali mayelana nokuzibophezela, izimali eziyisikweletu, izimali ezibizwe ngokuthi izimali ezingenalutho, kanye nezimali ezidayiswa bungenze mkhawulo. Qapha futhi uhlole ukuthobela izinqumo zokuqondisa izinsiza kanye nenqubo yonke umnyango. Thatha izinyathelo ezifanele zokulungisa lapho kudingeka khona. Phatha idathabhesi yabanikezeli kanye nokusebenza kwabanikezeli. Ukuphoqa ukusebenza ukuncibilikiswa kwezinsiza zabantu. Ukuqapha izinkambiso zokubeka intengo. Ukuphatha abantu, izimali kanye nezimpahla. Ukuphatha ulwazi ngemikhuba yomsebenzi.

xh.title: Isekela Mongambe: Inxaxheba yolawulo lwezinto ezihamba-hambayo
xh.summary: Isekela Mongambe wokuNika inxaxheba kuLawulo lwezinto ezihamba-hambayo kwiSebe lezeMisebenzi zoLungiso iNtloko eNkulu ezingongoma, elifuna izifundo ezifanelekileyo kwilogaisthiksi namava okulawula abasebenzi.
xh.requirements: I-Degree/ i-National Diploma echanekileyo kuLawulo lweLogaisthiksi, uLawulo lweNxibelelwano yeZinto okanye izifundo ezifanelekileyo. 3-5 iminyaka yamava okulawula/ abaphathi kwinqanaba le-ASD kuLawulo lweNxibelelwano yeZinto/ iLogaisthiksi. Ulwazi nge-LOGIS, i-LBIS, ibhalansi yemikondo negxathu kunye nezitatimende zemali. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. iLayiseni yokuqhuba ethembekileyo. Iakhomphensi nemiQondo: Ulwazi kuLawulo lweNxibelelwano yeZinto. Ulwazi ngeMigaqo yeNgxowa mali kunye ne-PFMA. uLawulo lweMali. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokwenza izigqibo. Ukuhola iqela. uLawulo lweProjekthi. Amanyathelo okubonisa. uLawulo lweNgxabano. Ukwibhala iingxelo. uQeqesho nokuPhuhlisa. uLawulo lwexesha. iBhayise. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zolwazi lwasemkhakheni wolawulo kunye nolawulo ngokoqoqo. uKunikelwa kolwazi lwasemkhakheni kwaye ulungelelaniswe nabaxumi. Ukuzithembisa nokuba yinyani. Ukuqina. Ikhono lokudibanisa. Ukuthonya nokuba nempembelelo. Ukucinga ngokobuchule. uKulungelelana ukuhamba.
xh.duties: Yila, yakha kwaye uhlola iinkqubo zolawulo lwezinto ezihamba-hambayo, iinkqubo kunye namanyathelo ngokwemigaqo, iinkqubo kunye namanyathelo esebe. Lawula izitshixo zezebe. Lawula izinto ezisezantloko zeNtloko. Qwalasela inqubo yokulungiselela nokuhlawula iziyalelo. Lawula ulungelelwaniso lokuhamba nokuhlawula. Qwalasela ofisi yolawulo lokuhamba kwisebe. Hlaziya iingxelo kwaye urekele abaphathi abaphezulu malunga neemeko ezikhoyo ngokwemisebenzi ezihamba-hambayo kwisebe ngokubanzi. Uhlu lwezitatimende zemali ngokwezinto ezichaziweyo ezithatha ngqo ulutsha lwemali ekanikayo, iigalelo kwisiseko, iimali ezingeniswayo, kunye nokutshatalala imali ngokungalunganga nokuyirhubuludha. Qwalasela kwaye ulinge ukubambelela kumigaqo nasekunkqubeni yolawulo lwezinto ezihamba-hambayo kulo lonke u-isebe. Thabatha amanyathelo alungileyo okulungisa apho kufunekayo. Lawula idathabheesi yabathengisi nokusebenza kwabathengisi. Zisele iBroad-Based Black Economic Empowerment. Ukwakhusa ukubakwa kwamanani emisebenzi. uLawulo lwabantu, imali nezinto. uLawulo lolwazi ngeziphumo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Logistical Support
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Logistical Support at the Department of Correctional Services National Head Office, managing LOGIS databases, policies, security and training.

Computer literacy. Valid driver’s license. Management of LOGIS training. Formulation, development, maintenance of and advise on training material for courses that support Logistical supply chain management. Monitor and evaluate Logistical supply chain management courses and material. Management of LOGIS information. Manage and provide support for the marketing of LOGIS. Manage the constant updating of the homepage of Logistics. Design, formulate and review policies, processes and procedures in line with departmental policies, guidelines and procedures and monitor the implementation thereof. Managing the evaluating/monitoring of LOGIS. Manage feedback on audit queries. Manage performance information. Management of human resources, finance and assets.

Rekenaarvaardigheid. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede en kenmerke: Kennis van die Public Finance Management Act, Supply Chain Management Guide for Accounting Officers (Section 6), Logistical Information System Manual (LOGISM), DCS Strategic Plan (Key departmental objective A1), Public Service Regulations, HRM-beleide/prosedures en die Skills Development Act, Act 97 of 1998. Monitor en evalueer logistieke voorraadkettingbestuurskursusse en -materiaal. Bestuur van LOGIS-inligting. Bestuur en verskaf ondersteuning vir die bemarking van LOGIS. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe kokuhlaziya izinkinga. Ikono lokufinyelela nokusebenzisa ulwazi. Ukuxhumana (ngaphakathi/ngaphandle). Ukubumbeka, ukusungula kanye nokubumbuka okusha. Ukuphathwa kwemali, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuthatha izinqumo nekono lokumisa izindaba. Ukuhlela, ukuhlelela, ukukhulekela kanye nokulawula. Phatha imibiko yemibuzo yokuhlola. Phatha ulwazi lokusebenza. Ukuphathwa kwemithombo yabantu, imali kanye nezimpahla.

Buka futhi uqinisekise ukuhambisana nomthetho osebenzayo, imithetho, izinqubo, imiyalo, namandla anikwe ukuphathwa kwezokuthutha. Qapha imisebenzi yokuphathwa kwezimoto zomnyango futhi uqinisekise ukulawula okusebenzayo izimoto zikahulumeni. Ukuphathwa kwezimali nokuhlelwa kokubuyekezwa. Ukuphathwa bantu abathintana nabo nezinkonzo zokweluleka. Phatha futhi uhlele inkqubo yokuqeqesha ukuphathwa kwezokuthutha komnyango. Phatha ulwazi ngokusebenza. Ukuphathwa kwabantu, zemali nezimpahla.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Ukulawula ukuThutha
xh.summary: Qondisa ukulawula ukuthutha kwiNdlu enkulu yeZiko lezeQhinga eNqamlezweni, kuqinisekiswe ukuthobela imithetho yamakamva nengqungquthela.
xh.requirements: Idegree yeBachelor okanye iDiploma yezwe kwiziKwenzaokuThutha/ingqungquthela yokuhamba/Isebe lokuQondisa oluPhakathi/ingqungquthela yeSantya seNkxaso okanye izifundo ezifanelekileyo. Iminyaka emi-5 [5] yamava kwakuLawulwa kokuThutha, ukuLawulwa kweKamva, ingqungquthela yokuhamba okanye kwindawo enxulumene nale. Ubuncinane iminyaka emi-3 yamava kwinqanaba le-ASD/lokulawula. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ukuziphatha nokuqabakho: Ulwazi ngemithetho yeTreasury, imithetho yabasebenzi, umthetho weSebe lokuQondisa oluPhakathi nemiqathango yalo, i-PFMA nemiqathango yayo, ukunikwa kwamagunya e-DCS, incwadana yokulinganisa ukusebenza, iKhowudi nemiQathango yeNtsetho, iPhepha elimhlophe leziQhinga (iindawo ezisebenzayo), inqubo yokulawula ukuthutha, ikhowudi yokuziphatha, incwadana yemigaqo kubakhwelwa basebe, incwadana yemigaqo kumathutha axhaswa ngemali, iplani yamajonye e-DCS (iindawo ezisebenzayo). Ulwazi lokufikelela kulwazi nokulisebenzisa malunga nokulungiselela iinkqubo zomthetho. Ukuqamba, ukuqamba inkqubo, ukuba ngumfama nokulawula. Ukulawula ingxabano. Ukuqonda abathengi nokuphendula abathengi. Uxhumo (langaphakathi/nangaphandle). Ukuchaphazela nokuqinisekisa ngamagqabo wokusebenza. Ukucinga ngokuhlaziyo. Ukwenza izigqibo, amakhono oncedo kwaye nakho ukukhiqiza. Ukuzimisela, ukuzinza nokuba namabala. Ukuzinikezela nokuba nolumko ngabanye. Ukwamkela, ukulunga ngokumthetho, inkoliso nokumelana. Unamandla, ukubukisisa nomonde. Ukukholisa nokuba nethamsanqo. Ukudalwa nokuqhwesha, nokuqonda ukucinga ngokusesikweni, ukwamkela iinguquko nokusebenzisa i-theknoloji ngokusebenzayo ukuxhasa iinjongo zoluntu.
xh.duties: Lawula hamba nokuqwalasela isiqhingi-nolawulo lokuthutha ngokwemigqabo yesebe nangokwemfuneko yomthetho. Qwalasela uqinisekise ukuthobela umthetho osebenzayo, iinkqubo, imigaqo, imiyalelo namagunya anikezelweyo angxulumene nokulawula ukuthutha. Qondisa imisebenzi yokulawula amakamva esebe uqiniseke ukulawula ngokusebenzayo izithuthi karhulumente. Ukulawula imali hamba nokuqwalasela ubandlavelo. Ukulawula ngenene abanxulumene nabancedisi. Lawula hamba uqwalasele inkqubo yokulungiselela ikhondo yokulawula ukuthutha. Lawula ulwazi lokusebenza. Ukulawula abantu, imali nempahla.

af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur-pos wat welsynsentrums en fisiese gesondheidsprogramme vir werknemers van Department of Correctional Services by Nasionale Hoofkantoor bestuur.
af.requirements: 'n Gepaste 3-jaar Nasionale Diploma/Grade in Bio-kinetika/Sportbestuur of relevante kwalifikasie. 3-5 jaar toesigervaring op 'n Assistentdirekteur-vlak in Gesondheid en Welsyn of verwante omgewing.ervaring en kennis in biokinetiek, gimnasiums en Sport sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne, finansies en bates.

zu.title: Usomlilo: Ukuphathwa Kwesikhungo Sezempilo
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi ohambisana nokuphathwa kwezikhungo sezempilo neminhlelengqondo yezokuphila komzimba kubasebenzi be Department of Correctional Services e National Head Office.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma/ Degree ezinhlahleni ze-3 ezifanelekile e-Bio-kinetics/ Sports Management noma iziqu ezihambisana nalezi. Eminyakeni engu-3-5 yohlelo lokusebenza njengomphathi ongumncedisomlilo ezingeni lomsekeli we Director kwezempi lo nomzimba noma endaweni ehlobene. Ulwazi nokwazi ngokuqonda ukusebenza komzimba, amagymnasium kanye namadlebe wezemidlalo kuzoba lusizo olukhulu. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ikhono nezici:ukuqonda inqubomgomo yesevisi yomphakathi nesakhiwo sezomthetho. Okuhlanganisayo emsebenzini wezempilo. Abasebenzi. Ukulawula amaphrojekthi nezenzo. Amakhono aphezulu okuhlaziya izibalo ohlelweni lwe SPSS noma okufanayo. Ukuthuthukisa, ukuhlaziya, ukuhlanganisa nokuphoqelela inqubomgomo. Ukuxhumana, ukwelula, ukuphatha amaphrojekithi namahlelo. Ukuphatha inguquko. Ukwethobela iklayenti ukugcwaliseka ngamathenda. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuphuhliswa kwezinto ezingahlulekayo ngokwezokusebenza. Ukuphatha abantu nokubakhulisa. Ukuzithiba nokwazi ukwethembeka. Ukugcina imfihlo. Ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Ulwazi olujulile nokuphoqelela izinhlelo zezempilo nomzimba zomsebenzi. Ikhono lokuxhumana nalabo abangaphandle. Ukuphatha imali.
zu.duties: Dumba futhi uphumeze izinqubomgomo nezinqubo zezempilo zomzimba ukuthuthukisa impilo yonke namandla omzimba wabasebenzi be DCS. Phatha futhi qinisekisa ukumiswa kwe gymnasiums/ izikhungo zezempilo komnyango kanye nokugcina zisebenza. Phatha futhi lawule wonke amahlelo ezempilo, ukuvivinywa kokuphila komzimba, ukuzivocavoca kanye nemihlela yokudla. Yenza ukuhlaziywa izibalo ngokuvivinywa kwamaphutha eempilo, ukuhumusha idatha ezenzweni bese uhlanganisa imibiko yezempilo. Phatha ulwazi ngemisebenzi ekhiwayo. Ukuphathwa kwabasebenzi, izimali nezimpahla.

xh.title: I-Deputy Director: Ukulawulwa kweZiko le-Wellness
xh.summary: Inkundla ye-Deputy Director ekulawuleni iinkonzo ezindalo kunye neenkqubo zempilo yomzimba kubasebenzi base-Department of Correctional Services e-National Head Office.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma/Degree esemthethweni yeminyaka eli-3 kwi-Bio-kinetics/ Sports Management okanye izifundo ezifanelekileyo. I-3-5 yeminyaka yamava okuhlola kwindlela yomphathi wesikhundla se-Assistant Director kwi-Health and Wellness okanye kwindalo ezenza ngokuhambelana nayo. Amando kunye nolwazi kwi-biokinetics, i-gymnasiums Sport kuya kuba lusizo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Iimpawu zokuqonda nokwenza: Ukuqonda i-police yaseburhulumente kunye nophawu lomthetho. Amando kunye nolwazi malunga neenkqubo ze-wellness. I-human resources. I-logistics kunye nokulawula iiprojekthi. Amando amaninzi e-statistical analysis anolwandiso kwi-SPSS okanye iindlela ezifanayo. Ukuphuhlisa, ukuhlalutya, ukuhamba kunye nokusebenzisa i-police. Unxibelelwano, ukulawula iinkqubo, iiprojekthi nokwenza iinkqubo. Ukutshintsha ukulawula. Uqhagamshelwano nabathengi kwaye ugqamise iimfuno zabathengi. Ukusombulula iingxaki. Ukwenza izinto ngendlela entsha kukuze kufikeleleke iinkonzo. Ukulawula abantu kunye nokuba namandla. Ukuzipatha kakuhle nokuthembeka. Ukugcina imfihlo. Unxibelelwano oluhle nabantu. Ulwazi olujulileyo nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zempilo kunye ne-wellness zabasebenzi. Amando bokudibanisa nabantu bangaphandle. Ukulawula iimali.
xh.duties: Yila uze usebenzise i-police kunye neendlela zempilo yomzimba ukuphucula impilo nokuze kube kakuhle kubasebenzi be-DCS. Lawula uze uqiniseke ukuzakwa kwaye kugcinwe kwi-gymnasiums/ iinkonzo ezindalo zesebe. Lawula uze ulawule zonke iinkqubo ze-wellness, iinzuzo zempilo yomzimha, ukuzilolonga kunye neenkqubo ze-Nutritional. Yenza i-statistical analysis yolwazi lweenzuzo zempilo yomzimha, tshatanisa ulwazi ngezibalo uze wakhe iingxelo zempilo yomzimha. Lawula ulwazi ngokusebenza. Ukulawula i-human resources, iimali kunye nezinto.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Kurrikulumbestuur
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur benodig om kurrikulumontwikkeling en -implementering vir opvoedings- en opleidingsprogramme by die Department of Correctional Services Nasionale Hoofkantoor te bestuur.
af.requirements: Erkende Graad/Diploma in Onderwys/Gevorderde Tegniese en Beroepsonderwys/Gevorderde Diploma in Volwasse en Gemeenskapsopvoeding en -opleiding en Onderrig of relevante kwalifikasie. 3-5 jaar bestuurservaring binne 'n opvoedings- en opleidingsomgewing op 'n ASD-vlak. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede en kenmerke: Begrip van DBE/DHET-kurrikulum. Begrip van die Nasionale Kwalifikasieraamwerk. Bestuur van opvoeding en opleiding. Risikobepaling, vaardigheidsontwikkeling, kapasiteitsopbouing, strategiese beplanning en prestasiebestuur. Begrip van die DCS-omgewing, die justisiesuster, relevante voorskrifte. PFMA – opstelling van uitgawes en verslagdoening. Toegepaste strategiese denke, kommunikasie, projekbestuur, aanbiedings, verslagskrywing, diensleweringsstandaarde, ontwikkeling van ander (afgerigtheid, mentorskap, opleiding), projek- en programbestuur. Besluitneming, probleemoplossing, netwerking/skakeling met belanghebbendes, onderhandeling, organisering, konflikbestuur en analitiese denke. Beleidsontwikkeling, -ontleding, -monitering, -evaluering.
af.duties: Bestuur die ontwikkeling, hersiening en implementering van beleide, prosedures, strategieë en operasionele raamwerke met betrekking tot opvoedings-, beroeps- en vakopleidingsprogramme. Bestuur die ontwikkeling, hersiening, belyning en implementering van opvoedings-, beroeps- en vakopleidingskurrikula om nakoming van wetlike voorskrifte, opvoedingsstandaarde en gevangerehabilitasievereistes te verseker. Bestuur stelsels en meganismes vir die monitering, evalueren en verbetering van die gehalte, doeltreffendheid en impak van kurrikulumaflewering. Bestuur assessering, moderering, sertifisering en kwalifikasieprosesse om te verseker dat leerders erkende kwalifikasies ontvang. Bestuur prestasie-inligting. Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne, finansies en bates.

zu.title: Usomlilo: Ukuphatha Ikhurikhulamu
zu.summary: Kudingeka uSomlilo ophathe ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwekhurikhulamu kumuhlelo wemfundo nokuqeqeshwa e-HQ Kazwelonke kwi-Department of Correctional Services.
zu.requirements: Iziqu eziyaziwayo/Iziqu eziphakeme zemfundo/Iziqu eziphakeme zokuQeqesha Kobuchwepheshe nokuSebenza ngobuciko/Iziqu eziphakeme kumazwe afunda abadala futhi afundisa emphakathini nokuQeqesha nokufundisa noma iziqu ezihambisana nalokho. 3-5 iminyaka yohlu lwemisebenzi yokuphatha endaweni yemfundo nokuqeqeshwa ezingeni le-ASD. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokuqasha esemthethweni. Ikhono kanye nezici: Ukuqonda ikhurikhulamu ye-DBE/DHET. Ukuqonda Isakhiwo Sakhozwelonke samakhwalifhayishini. Ukuphatha imfundo nokuqeqeshwa. Ukulinganisa ingozi, ukuthuthukiswa kwezikhono, ukwakha amandla, ukuhlela ngokusobala kanye nokuphatha ukusebenza. Ukuqonda isimo se-DCS, amaklaster obulungiswa, imibhalo ephathelene nalokho. PFMA – ukuhlanganiswa kokuchitha nemibiko. Ukucabanga ngokusobala ngokuhlelekile, ukuxhumana, ukuphatha imiklomo, okwethulwayo, ukubhala imibiko, izinga lokulethwa kwenkonzo, ukuthuthukisa abanye (ukuqeqesha, ukweluleka, ukufundisa), ukuphatha imiklomo kanye namuhlelo. Ukwenza izinqumo, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuxhumana / ukuxhumana nabahlanganyeli, ukuxoxisana, ukuhlela, ukuphatha ingxabano kanye nokucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubo, ukuhlaziya, ukulawula, nokuhlola.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuthuthukiswa, ukuhlola nokusetshenziswa kwezinqubo, izindlela, amasu namakhasimende okusebenza ahlobene nemfundo, ukuqeqeshwa komsebenzi namuhlelo wokuqeqesha ubuchwepheshe. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa, ukuhlola, ukuhambisana nokusetshenziswa kwekhurikhulamu yemfundo, ukuqeqeshwa komsebenzi nobuchwepheshe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kuhambisana nemibhalo yomthetho, izinga lemfundo kanye nezidingo zokulungiswa kabenzi bamacala. Phatha izinhlela nezindlela zokulawula, ukuhlola nokuthuthukisa izinga, ukusebenza kakhulu kanye nomthelela wokulethwa kwekhurikhulamu. Phatha ukuhlola, ukulinganisana, ukufakwa wegama kanye namakwalifhayishini ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abafundi bathola iziqu eziyaziwayo. Phatha ulwazi lokusebenza. Ukuphatha abantu, imali nezimpahla.

xh.title: I sephathhana nogunya: Ulawulo lwesicwangciso somfundo
xh.summary: Kufuneka isiphathhana esinogunya sokulawula uphuhliso nokusebenzisa isicwangciso somfundo kwaye kuqatshwe iinkqubo zemfundo nokuzilolonga kwiSebe leKonjiko eZikolweni eZilungisiweyo kwindlu enkulu yasekuqaleni.
xh.requirements: Isidanga noma iDiploma evunyiweyo eMfundweni nokuYifundisa ngamazinga aphezleyo obuchwepheshhe nobugcisa bokuzilolonga noma iDiploma eQhubekayo kwiMfundo yoluntu oMdala nokuQqaliswa koLuntu kwaye nokuFundisa okanye nangomlinganiselo ofanelekileyo. 3-5 yiminyaka yamava okulawula kwindawo yemfundo nokuqeqeshwa kwinqanaba le-ASD. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi nemimiselo: Ukuqonda isicwangciso se-DBE/DHET. Ukuqonda uNqamlezoyiMimiselo yoLuntu. Ulawulo lwemfundo nokuqeqeshwa. Ukuqwalasela ingozi, uphuhliso lwamakhono, ukwakha amandla, uqwalaselo lwakuqala kunye nokuLawula ukusebenza. Ukuqonda iNqanaba lendalo ye-DCS, iqela lomthetho, namagama achaziweyo. I-PFMA – ukuqulunqa ukuchithwa kwemali nokuxela. Ukuqonda okuqhubekayo, iNtetho, ulawulo lweenkqubo, iPrezenti, ukubhala iiripothi, iMigqaliselo yokuNika inkonzo, uphuhliso koluntu (ukuyala, ukuyala, ukuqeqesha), ulawulo lweenkqubo neenkqubo zokuQhuba. Ukwenza iZigqibo, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukuxhumanisa / ukunxibelelana nabo baphathiswa ngokomthetho, ukuqhuzelela, ulawulo lokungabishani nokucinga ngokuzalathisa. Uphuhliso lomthetho, uqwalaselo, ukuqwalasela, ukusetyenziswa kwesicwangciso somfundo.
xh.duties: Qwalasela ukuqhuba, ukulungisa nokusebenzisa imithetho, iinkqubo, iindlela ezahlukeneyo nokusebenza kolawulo ngokwemfundo, ukuqeqesha ngokolwazi obuchwepheshha nobugcisa bokuzilolonga. Lawula ukuqhuba, ukulungisa, ukuvumelana nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zemfundo ngokwezifundo ngokomthetho wobugcisa bokuzilolonga kuqinisekise ukuvumelana neMithetho, iMilinganiselo yemfundo nemfuneko yokulungisa iNgozi. Lawula iinkqubo iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuqwalasela, ukuqwalasela nokuphucula iMilinganiselo, ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo nokuchasene kwesicwangciso somfundo. Lawula ukuvavanya, ukubeka iNqanaba, ukuvunywa nokuQinisekiswa iNgqinisekiso ukuba abafundi bafumana iNgqinisekiso eVunyiweyo. Lawula iNkcazolo ngokuSebenza. ULawulo lweNtsiba, iMali namaZizo.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager Nursing [pn-b4]: PHC: Communicable
jobs.summary: Assistant Manager Nursing position at the Department of Correctional Services National Head Office focused on communicable disease surveillance and primary health care.
jobs.requirements: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. Diploma/Degree in Nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. Post basic qualification with a duration of at least 1 year in curative skills in Primary Health Care accredited with the SANC. Registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse. A minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognisable nursing experience after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 6 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/ recognisable experience after obtaining the 1- year post basic qualification in the relevant specialty. At least 3 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/ recognisable experience at management level. Computer literate. Valid driver’s licence. Competencies and Attributes: Demonstrate an in depth understanding of nursing legislation and related legal and ethical nursing practises and how these impacts on service delivery. Ensure clinical nursing practice by the nursing team (unit) in accordance with the scope of practice and nursing standards as determined by the relevant health facility. Promote quality of nursing care as directed by the professional scope of practice and standards as determined by the relevant health facility. Demonstrate a basic understanding of HR and financial policies and practices. Demonstrate effective communication with patients, supervisors, other health professionals and junior colleagues, including more complex report writing when required. Work as part of a multi-disciplinary team at unit level to ensure good nursing care by the nursing team. Work effectively and amicably, at a supervisory level, with persons of diverse intellectual, cultural, racial or religious differences. Able to manage own work, time and that of junior colleagues to ensure proper nursing service in the unit. Display a concern for patients, promoting, advocating and facilitating proper treatment and care and ensuring that the unit adheres to the principles of Batho Pele. Able to develop contacts, build and maintain a network of professional relations in order to enhance service delivery. Demonstrate basic computer literacy as a support tool to enhance service delivery.
jobs.duties: Develop, review and implement surveillance systems and other policies for communicable diseases in line with relevant legislation, policies and guidelines. Conduct research and data analysis. Establish clear metrics for evaluating the success of programs and initiatives aimed at treating and preventing communicable diseases. Design and implement innovative interventions aimed at reducing the incidence of communicable diseases. Management of physical/information resources and adherence to DCS policies/procedures.

af.title: Assistentbestuurder Verpleegkunde [pn-b4]: PHC: Oordraagbare Siektes
af.summary: Assistentbestuurder Verpleegkunde-pos by die Department of Correctional Services National Head Office wat op oordraagbare siekte-bewaring en primêre gesondheidsorg fokus.
af.requirements: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.i. Diploma/Degree in Nursing) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. Postbasiese kwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar in kuratiewe vaardighede in Primary Health Care wat by die SANC geakkrediteer is. Registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare verpleegervaring na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ten minste 6 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring na die verkryging van die 1-jaar postbasiese kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike spesialiteitsrigting wees. Ten minste 3 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring op bestuursvlak wees. Rekenaarvaardig. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede en Attribute: Toon 'n diepgaande begrip van verpleegwetgewing en verwante regs- en etiese verpleegpraktyke en hoe dit op dienslewering impakteer. Verseker kliniese verpleegpraktyk deur die verpleegspan (eenheid) in ooreenstemming met die omvang van praktyk en verpleegstandaarde soos deur die tersaaklike gesondheidsfasiliteit bepaal. Bevorder gehalte van verpleegsorg soos gerig deur die professionele omvang van praktyk en standaarde soos deur die tersaaklike gesondheidsfasiliteit bepaal. Toon 'n basiese begrip van HR- en finansiële beleide en praktyke. Toon effektiewe kommunikasie met pasiënte, toesighouers, ander gesondheidsprofessioneles en junior kollegas, insluitend meer komplekse verslagskryf wanneer vereis. Werk as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span op eenheidsvlak om goeie verpleegsorg deur die verpleegspan te verseker. Werk doeltreffend en vriendelik, op toesigvlak, met persone van uiteenlopende intellektuele, kulturele, rasse- of godsdienstige verskille. In staat om eie werk, tyd en dié van junior kollegas te bestuur om behoorlike verpleegdiens in die eenheid te verseker. Toon besorgdheid oor pasiënte, bevorder, pleit en fasiliteer behoorlike behandeling en sorg en verseker dat die eenheid aan die beginsels van Batho Pele voldoen. In staat om kontakte te ontwikkel, en 'n netwerk van professionele verhoudings op te bou en te handhaaf ten einde dienslewering te verbeter. Toon basiese rekenaarvaardigheid as 'n ondersteuningsinstrument om dienslewering te verbeter.
af.duties: Ontwikkel, hersien en implementeer bewaringstelsels en ander beleide vir oordraagbare siektes in ooreenstemming met tersaaklike wetgewing, beleide en riglyne. Voer navorsing en data-ontleding uit. Stel duidelike maatstawwe vas vir die evaluering van die sukses van programme en inisiatiewe wat gemik is op die behandeling en voorkoming van oordraagbare siektes. Ontwerp en implementeer innoverende ingrypings wat gemik is op die vermindering van die voorkoms van oordraagbare siektes. Bestuur van fisiese/informasiehulpbronne en voldoening aan DCS-beleide/prosedures.

zu.title: Umphathi Onumsizi Wokunakekela Abagula [pn-b4]: PHC: Communicable
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi onumsizi wokunakekela abagula ephandle lenhloko kabantu lenhlanga yezempilo i-Department of Correctional Services National Head Office, egxile ekulawuleni izifo ezithathelwanayo kanye nezinsiza zezempilo ezingunaphakade.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ze-R425 eziyisisekelo (okungukuthi i-Diploma/Degree ekunakekelweni kweziguli) noma okulingana naleso sifundo okuvumela ukubhalisa eSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoguli o Professional Nurse. Isifundo sesikhathi esilandela esiyisisekelo esithatha okungenani unyaka owodwa kwikhono lokwelapha kwizinsiza zezempilo ezingunaphakade ekuqinisekisiwe ngumnyango we-SANC. Ukubhalisa e-SANC njengoguli o Professional Nurse. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-10 yohlu lokusebenza okuhambisana noma olungahlehliswa ekunakekelweni kweziguli ngemva kokubhalisa njengoguli o Professional Nurse e-SANC ekunakekelweni jikelele. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-6 yikesikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kufanele kube ukuhlangabezela okuhambisana noma okungahlehliswa ngemva kokuthola isifundo sonyaka owodwa sokuthi kwesikhathi esilandela esiyisisekelo ekhalo oluthintekayo. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-3 yikesikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kufanele kube ukuhlangabezela okuhambisana noma okungahlehliswa ezingeni lokuphatha. Ukubhalisele ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Amakhono nemfanelo: Bonisa ukuqonda okujulile ngemithetho yokunakekela iziguli kanye nomthetho ohlobene nokunakekela iziguli ngokomthetho nangokwesimilo nokuthi lokhu kuthinta kanjani ukulethwa kwezinsiza. Qinisekisa ukunakekela iziguli ngokwemithetho eqokwe iqembu (yunithi) lokunakekela iziguli ngokwemikhawu yokuhlangabezela kanye namazinga okunakekela iziguli anqunywe isikhungo sezempilo esithintekayo. Khuthaza ikhono lokunakekela iziguli njengokuqondiswa umkhawu ohlela wekhono namazinga anqunywe isikhungo sezempilo esithintekayo. Bonisa ukuqonda okuyisisekelo ngemithethonqubo nangamasu e-HR nezimali. Bonisa ukuxhumana okusebenzayo neziguli, abanakekeli abangaphezulu, ochwepheshe bokunakekela ezempilo abanye kanye nabalingane abancane, okuhlanganisa nokubhala okubucayi imibiko lapho kudingeka khona. Sebenza njengengxenye yeqembu elihlukene emikhakheni eminingi ezingeni leyunithi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa okuhle iziguli ngoweqembu. Sebenza ngokusebenzayo nangokuzwana, ezingeni lokubuka phezulu, nabantu abehlukene ngokwezinga lokucabangela, inkolo, umbala noma inkolo yenkolo. Akwazi ukuphatha umsebenzi wakhe, isikhathi kanye nesabalingane wakhe abancane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulethwa kwezinsiza ezinhle zokunakekela iziguli ebuyinithi. Khombisa ukukhathazeka ngeziguli, ukukhuthaza, ukuzwela kanye nokwenza lula ukwelashwa nokunakekelwa okuhle kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi iyunithi ilandela imigomo yobuBatho Pele. Akwazi ukwakha izindinganiso, ukwakha futhi ahlale enxeshebufuni lwabahlobene bakhe bekhono ukuze kwandise ukulethwa kwezinsiza. Bonisa ukubhalisele kokuyisisekelo ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha njengesekelo ukwandise ukulethwa kwezinsiza.
zu.duties: Lakisa, ubuke futhi usebenzise izimiso zokuqapha kanye neminye imithethonqubo yezifo ezithathelwanayo ngokomthetho ohlobene, imithethonqubo kanye namalungiselelo. Yenza ucwaningo kanye nokuqagela imininingwane. Hlola izinkomba eziqondiswayo zokuqinisekisa impumelelo izinhlelo nezinyakazo ezibhekiswe ekwelapheni nokuvikela izifo ezithathelwanayo. Hlela futhi usebenzise izinyakazo ezintsha ezibhekiswe ekuncisheni inani lezifo ezithathelwanayo. Ukuphatha izinsiza ezingokomzimba/imininingwane nokulandela imithethonqubo/amasu e-DCS.

xh.title: Umncedisi Womphathi Wezolungelelwaniso Lomsebenzi [pn-b4]: PHC: Communicable
xh.summary: Isithuba somncedisi womphathi wezolungelelwaniso lomsebenzi kwiSebe lezikhululo zokulungisa izonakalo kwilizwe kwindlu enkulu egxile ekujolweni kwemifo ezithathelanayo nempilo yonke ekuqaleni.
xh.requirements: Ithobeli elisisiseko le-R425 (okanye i-Diploma/Isidanga kwezolungelelwaniso lomsebenzi) okanye isifanekiselana esikuvumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengongcali wezolungelelwaniso lomsebenzi. Ithobeli elingasemva kwesiseko elithatha ixesha elingangingaphantsi kwamnyaka-1 kwizakhono zokwelapha kwiPrimary Health Care elibhalisiwe kwi-SANC. Ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengongcali wezolungelelwaniso lomsebenzi. Amava angu-10 amafanelekileyo/avakalayo ekwolungelelwaniso lomsebenzi emva kokubhalisa njengongcali wezolungelelwaniso lomsebenzi kwi-SANC kwi-General Nursing. Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-6 kule minyaka elithethwe ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo/avakalayo emva kokufumana ithobeli lamnyaka-1 elingasemva kwesiseko kwinkalo ebalulekileyo. Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-3 kule minyaka elithethwe ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo/avakalayo kwinqanaba lolawulo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ikhono nemiqondiso: Bonisa ukuqonda ngokujulileyo ngemithethonqubo ye-nursing nolwabiwo-mthetho kunye nendlela yokwenza umsebenzi ngokuthe Ngokomthetho nengqiqo kunye nendlela ebinza inkqubo yokwenziswa kweenkonzo. Qinisekisa inkqubo yokwenziswa kwe-nursing ngokwenziwa ngaphantsi kwemimiselo yomsebenzi kunye nemigangatho yezolungelelwaniso lomsebenzi njengoko kumiswe kwisisi sakho esifanelekileyo sezempilo. Khuthaza ubunyonini bokunikelwa kwengkonzo kwizolungelelwaniso lomsebenzi njengokuba kumiswe ngummandla wokwenza umsebenzi nangona ngangangomgangatho njengoko kumiswe kwisisi esifanelekileyo sezempilo. Bonisa ukuqonda okusisiyo ngemigaqonqubo kunye nemithethonqubo ye-HR nezemali nendlela yokuyisebenzisa. Bonisa ukunxibelelana kakuhle nabenyongo, oonozimbongi, oonyezi beempilo abanye kunye nabahlobo ababancinane, kuquka nokubhala iiripoti ezinzima xa kufunekana. Sebenza njengesahlulelo senqanaba eliqhutywa kukuhlangenwe ngenye iindiwe kulawulo-mthetho ukubakwinkqubo enye eqinisekisa ukunikwa kwenkonzo ezolungelelwaniso lomsebenzi elilungileyo. Sebenza ngokuchanekileyo nangokuzonwabisana, kwinqanaba elilawulayo, nabantu abahlukene ngokwe-ntlalo, inkcubeko, imbala okanye inkolo. Makakwazi ukulawula umsebenzi wakhe, ixesha nalo lonke ukuba nabahlobo abancinane ukuvikeka inkonzo ezolungelelwaniso lomsebenzi ezilungileyo kwisi sahlo. Bonisa ukungethuka ngabenyongo, ukukhuthaza, ukubakhusela nokubanceda ngokwanelisekileyo kwelungiselelo nokunikelwa kwenkonzo nangona ukuvakalelwa ukuba isahluleleni siyazilandela iingcamango zamazwe e-Batho Pele. Makakwazi ukuyila iinthendelezo, ukwakha ukuphila kwamanye amakhaya izixhobo zenkalo ukonyeza inkonzo yokunikwa kwayona. Bonisa ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha ngenjongo yokuncedisa kuyo inkonzo yokunikwa.
xh.duties: Yila, vavanya iphelisele inkqubo ekujolweni kwemifo ezithathelanayo nayo yeminye imigaqonqubo ngokuhambelana nendalo-mthetho, imigaqonqubo neengcebiso ezifanelekileyo. Yenza uphando ngenkqubo yokulawula idatha. Misela okucacileyo ukulinganisa impumelelo kweenkqubo neengxamxam ezijolise ekwelapheni nokuthintela imifo ezithathelanayo. Yila uphuhlise iinkqubo ezintsha ezijolise ekunciphiseni imifo ezithathelanayo. Ulawulo lwezixhobo/zolwazi kwaye ulandele imigaqonqubo/iinkqubo zika-DCS.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager Nursing [pn-b4]: Specialty: Maternal,
jobs.summary: Assistant Manager Nursing post at the National Head Office, requiring an R425 qualification and SANC registration, offering R785568 per annum.
jobs.requirements: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. Diploma/Degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse. A post-basic nursing qualification, with a duration of at least 1 year, accredited with the SANC in one of the specialties referred to in the glossary of terms. Registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse. A minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 6 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/ recognisable experience in the specific specialty after obtaining the 1-year post-basic qualification in the relevant specialty. At least 3 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/ recognisable experience at management level. Computer literate. Valid driver’s licence. Competencies And Attributes: Demonstrate an in depth understanding of nursing legislation and related legal and ethical nursing practises and how this impact on service delivery. Ensure clinical nursing practice by the nursing team (unit) in accordance with the scope of practice and nursing standards as determined by the relevant health facility. Promote quality of nursing care as directed by the professional scope of practice and standards as determined by the relevant health facility. Demonstrate a basic understanding of HR and financial policies and practices. Demonstrate effective communication with patients, supervisors, other health professionals and junior colleagues, including more complex report writing when required. Work as part of a multi-disciplinary team at unit level to ensure good nursing care by the nursing team. Work effectively and amicably, at a supervisory level, with persons of diverse intellectual, cultural, racial or religious differences. Able to manage own work, time and that of junior colleagues to ensure proper nursing service in the unit. Display a concern for patients, promoting, advocating and facilitating proper treatment and care and ensuring that the unit adheres to the principles of Batho Pele. Able to develop contacts, build and maintain a network of professional relations in order to enhance service delivery. Demonstrate basic computer literacy as a support tool to enhance service delivery.
jobs.duties: Design, develop, monitor and review policies, programmes and guidelines for special categories i.e. women, children, adolescents and youth. Provide a comprehensive package of preventive, promotive, curative and rehabilitative services for special categories. Facilitate audit on quality of clinical records pertaining to the provision of clinical care to special categories. Reporting on indicators and programme performance for special categories. Develop and review relevant Information, Education and Communication (IEC) material for special categories programmes and services. Utilize resources efficiently and effectively. Maintain a constructive working relationship with nursing and other stakeholders. Execute the responsibilities of officials as stipulated in section 45 of the Public Finance Management Act 101 of 1999 as amended. Management of performance information, finances, human resources and assets.

af.title: Assistentbestuurder Verpleging [pn-b4]: Spesialiteit: Moederskap,
af.summary: Assistentbestuurder Verpleging pos by die Nasionale Hoofkantoor, wat 'n R425-kwalifikasie en SANC-registrasie vereis, teen R785568 per jaar.
af.requirements: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. Diploma/Grade in verpleging) of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. 'n Nagraadse verpleegkundige kwalifikasie, met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar, geakkrediteer by die SANC in een van die spesialiteite waarna in die woordelys van terme verwys word. Registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/erkende ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste 6 jaar van die hierbo genoemde tydperk moet toepaslike/erkende ervaring in die spesifieke spesialiteit wees na verkryging van die 1-jaar nagraadse kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike spesialiteit. Ten minste 3 jaar van die hierbo genoemde tydperk moet toepaslike/erkende ervaring op bestuursvlak wees. Rekenaarvaardig. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede en eienskappe: Toon 'n diepgaande begrip van verpleegwetgewer en verwante regs- en etiese verpleegpraktyke en hoe dit op dienslewering inwerk. Verseker kliniese verpleegpraktyk deur die verpleegspan (eenheid) in ooreenstemming met die omvang van praktyk en verpleegstandaarde soos deur die tersaaklike gesondheidsfasiliteit bepaal. Bevorder gehalte van verpleegsorg soos gerig deur die professionele omvang van praktyk en standaarde soos deur die tersaaklike gesondheidsfasiliteit bepaal. Toon 'n basiese begrip van HR- en finansiële beleide en praktyke. Toon effektiewe kommunikasie met pasiënte, toesighouers, ander gesondheidsprofessionele en junior kollegas, insluitend meer komplekse verslagskrywing wanneer vereis. Werk as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span op eenheidsvlak om goeie verpleegsorg deur die verpleegspan te verseker. Werk doeltreffend en vriendelik, op toesigvlak, met persone van uiteenlopende intellektuele, kulturele, rasse- of godsdienstige verskille. In staat om eie werk, tyd en dié van junior kollegas te bestuur om behoorlike verpleegdiens in die eenheid te verseker. Toon begaanheid met pasiënte, deur behoorlike behandeling en sorg te bevorder, voor te staan en te fasiliteer en te verseker dat die eenheid aan die beginsels van Batho Pele voldoen. In staat om kontakte te ontwikkel, en 'n netwerk van professionele verhoudings op te bou en te handhaaf ten einde dienslewering te verbeter. Toon basiese rekenaarvaardigheid as 'n ondersteuningsinstrument om dienslewering te verbeter.
af.duties: Ontwerp, ontwikkel, monitor en hersien beleide, programme en riglyne vir spesiale kategorieë, d.w.s. vroue, kinders, adolessente en jeug. Verskaf 'n omvattende pakket van voorkomende, bevorderende, genesende en rehabilitasiedienste vir spesiale kategorieë. Fasiliteer oudit op gehalte van kliniese rekords met betrekking tot die voorsiening van kliniese sorg aan spesiale kategorieë. Verslagdoening oor aanwysers en programmeprestasie vir spesiale kategorieë. Ontwikkel en hersien tersaaklike Inligting-, Opvoedings- en Kommunikasiemateriaal vir spesiale kategorieë se programme en dienste. Benut hulpbronne doeltreffend en effektief. Handhaaf 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met verpleegkundiges en ander belanghebbendes. Voer die verantwoordelikhede van amptenare uit soos uiteengesit in artikel 45 van die Public Finance Management Act 101 van 1999 soos gewysig. Bestuur van prestasie-inligting, finansies, menslike hulpbronne en bates.

zu.title: Isiphathi Somphathi Wezokunakekela Abagulayo [pn-b4]: Obuchwepheshe: Okwabomama,
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi wezokunakekela abagulayo e-National Head Office, esidinga isifundo se-R425 nokubhaliswa kwi-SANC, sinikeza i-R785568 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Isifundo esisisiseko se-R425 (okungukuthi i-Diploma/Degree ekunakekelweni abagulayo) noma isifundo esilinganayo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengogqwele wezokunakekela abagulayo. Isifundo sokunakekela abagulayo esingemuva kwesisisiseko, ngobude bonyaka osukodwa buncane ngaphezulu kwe-1, esamukelekile e-SANC kokunye kwemikhakha ekhonjisiwe ochazweni lwamagama. Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengogqwele wezokunakekela abagulayo. Uhlu lonyaka olungu-10 noma ngaphezulu lweminyaka yomuzwa ofanelekile/ovunyiwe ekunakekelweni abagulayo emva kokubhaliswa njengogqwele wezokunakekela abagulayo e-SANC ekunakekelweni abagulayo jikelele. Kuncane ngaphezulu konyaka osukodwa ungaba ngu-6 ohlwini oluchaziwe ngenhla kumele kube umuzwa ofanelekile/ovunyiwe kwelikhundla elithize lebuchwepheshe emva kokuthola isifundo esingemuva kwesisisiseko sonyaka osukodwa esihlotshaneni nelikhundla lebuchwepheshe. Kuncane ngaphezulu konyaka osukodwa ungaba ngu-3 ohlwini oluchaziwe ngenhla kumele kube umuzwa ofanelekile/ovunyiwe ezingeni lobaphathi. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ukuzakhela amakhono nemikhuba: Bonisa ukuqonda okujulile ngemithetho yokunakekela abagulayo kanye nemikhono yomthetho nokuziphatha ehlotshaniswa nokunakekela abagulayo kanye nendlela okuthipha ngayo ukulethwa kwenkonzo. Qinisekisa ukunakekela abagulayo ngokwezamazinga okwenziwe iqembu lokunakekela abagulayo (umkhakha) ngokohlelo lokusebenza nemazinga okunakekela njengokuqunyiwe isikhungo sezempilo esihlotshanayo. Khuthaza ikhwalithi yokunakekela abagulayo njengokuqondiswa ukuze kusetshenziswe umkhakha ohlobene kanye namazinga njengokuqunyiwe isikhungo sezempilo esihlotshanayo. Bonisa ukuqonda okuyisiseko ngemithetho yabasebenzi kanye nemithetho yezimali. Bonisa ukuxhumana okusebenzayo neziguli, abaphathi, ogoqwele abanye bezempilo kanye nabalabo bango-lowlowo, okubandakanya ukubhala amarekhodi adingekile uma kudingeke. Sebenza njengengxenye yeqembu elinabantu abaningi abanamakhono ahlukene ezingeni lomkhakha ukuthi kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa kahle abagulayo iqembu. Sebenza ngokuzuzisayo ngokuhambisana, ezingeni lokuphatha, nabantu abanengqondo, amasiko, izinhlanga noma inkolo ehlukene. Ukuba nokwazi okwokulawula umsebenzi wakho, isikhathi kanye nesabalabo bango-lowlowo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe inkonzo efanele yokunakekela abagulayo kulelo mkhakha. Khombisa ukukhathalela iziguli, ukuthuthukisa, ukusekela nokwenza kube lula ukwelashwa nokunakekelwa okufanele, ukuthi umkhakha uhambisana nemigomo ka-Batho Pele. Ukuba nokwazi okwokwakha izinhlonzi, ukwakha kanye nokuqhuba inxulumano eliyisiseko sabochwepheshe, ekuze kwenze kube mnandi ukulethwa kwenkonzo. Bonisa ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha njengesikhali sokusekela ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza zokuletha inkonzo.
zu.duties: Dizimba, thuthukisa, hlola futhi ubuyekeze imithetho, izinhlelo kanye nemihlahlandlela yezigaba ezithize okungukuthi abesimame, izingane, abasha kanye nabasha. Nikeza ingxenye egcwele yezinsiza zokuvikela, ukuthuthukisa, ukwelapha nokubuyisela isikhundla sezigaba ezithize. Yenza ukutholakale kophando lwekhwalithi yamarekhodi ezokwelashwa ahlobene nokuqinisekiswa kokunakekelwa ezinhlonhlweni ezithize. Umbiko ngesikhombisi, nokusebenza kwezinhlelo kwezigaba ezithize. Thuthukisa futhi ubuyekeze izinto ezihlobene nolwazi, imfundo kanye nokuxhumana i-Information, Education and Communication (IEC) izinhlelo kwezigaba ezithize kanye nezinsiza. Sebenzisa izinsiza ngokuzuzisayo nokusebenzayo. Gcina ubudlelwano obuhle bokusebenza nabonakeki nabanye abahlotshaniswa nabo. Phatha imisebenzi yabasebenzi njengokuqunyiwe kumgomo woku-45 we-Public Finance Management Act 101 of 1999 njengokulungisiwe. Ulawulo lolwazi ngemisebenzi, izimali, abasebenzi izipho.

xh.title: Umphathi oncedayo weNsesi [pn-b4]: Isikhokelo: Bosezala,
xh.summary: Isithuba somPhathi oncedayo weNsesi kwisiKulu seZiko seNqanaba leSizwe, sifuna isigaba se-R425 neregistrishei kwi-SANC, sinika i-R785568 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Isigaba se-R425 esisisiseko (okt. iDiploma/iNqanaba lemfundo kwizensesi) okanye isigaba esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengesesi eYenziweyo. Isigaba semfundo yensesi esingemuva kwesisisiseko, esithatha ubude bexesha elingangonyaka owodwa ubuncinane, esamkelwe kwi-SANC kwenye yezindawo ezikankanyiwe kwiglossari yamagama. Ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengesesi eYenziweyo. Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-10 yamava afanelekileyo/avakalisekayo kwizensesi emva kokubhalisa njengesesi eYenziweyo kwi-SANC kwiSesesi esiQuqeyo. Ubuncinane beminyaka esi-6 kwexesha elikankanywe ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo/avakalisekayo kwelo ndawo ethile yobugcisa emva kokuvezwa isigaba semfundo yensesi esingemuva kwesisisiseko sobude bonyaka owodwa kwindawo ethile efanelekileyo. Ubuncinane beminyaka esi-3 kwexesha elikankanywe ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo/avakalisekayo kwinqanaba lolawulo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Iikhompetensi Neempawu: Kubonisa ukuqonda ngobunzulu umthetho wezensesi nendlela ezinxulumeneyo yomthetho nokuziphatha ngokomthetho ekwenziweni kwezensesi nendlela okuchaphazela ngayo ukunikwa kwenkonzo. Qinisekisa ukwenza kwamasesesi iqela lezensesi (yunithi) ngokwemida yokwenza nangokweemfuno zeemigaqo ezisesi njengoko kumiswe ngumthunywa weempilo othile. Phakamisa umgangatho wokunyanga njengoko kuchazwe ngemida yomsebenzi ogunyazisiweyo namagunya njengoko kumiswe ngumthunywa weempilo othile. Bonisa ukuqonda okusiseko kwezondlu ezimalini neenkqubo zemali nakwizicwangciso. Bonisa ukunxibelelana ngokuchanekileyo nabaguli, ootitshala abanolawulo, oogqirha abangabangama njl njl kunye nabahlobo abancinci, kuquka nokubhala iiripoti ezinzima xa kudingeka. Sebenza njengesahlulelo seqela elinabahlali-njengoko kunesimo kwinqanaba leyunithi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunyanga okulungileyo ngamasesesi eqela lezensesi. Sebenza ngokuchanekileyo nangokwamanyano, kwinqanaba lolawulo, nabantu abohlukene ngokwengqondo, basiko, isini okanye inkolo. Akwazi ukulawula umsebenzi wakhe, ixesha nakalawulo labahlobo abancinci ukuze kuqinisekiswe inkonzo esebenzayo yezensesi kwiyunithi. Bonisa ukukhathalela abaguli, ukukhuthaza, ukuvakalisa nokuqhuba unyango nokuqwalasela okulungileyo nokuqinisekisa ukuba iyunithi ihamba ngeemigaqo yeBatho Pele. Akwazi ukuyila iintsebenziswano, yakha zigcine ubudlelwane obunamaxesha obunye obusebenzayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba kukho iinkonzo ezifikelelekayo ngokukhawuleza. Ukubhalisa abantu abangakwaziyo ukusebenza ekuthiwa yiinkqubo zokunika iinkonzo ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi lwemfundo.
xh.duties: Yila, yakha, qwalasela nokuqwalasela iindlela, iinkqubo neengcebiso ezimiselwe ukubakela iindidi ezithile kat. abafazi,abantwana, abasesi bokutsha nolutsha. Nika iqupha elizeleyo lezikonzo zokuthintela, zokukhuthaza, zokunyanya nokubuyisela kwimpilo kuzo iindidi ezithile. Qhubeza ukuvavanya umgangatho weeatekile zokunika iinkonzo ezithile kat.iindidi ezikankanyiwe. Nika iinkcukacha malunga neendidi ezikankanyiwe kwaye yiphelele inkqubo yokwenza konke okumiselweyo ngale ndidi. Yila nokuqwalasela izixhobo ezenziwayo eziyimfundo nabantu abangenayo ngokubeka iindidi ezikankanyiwe kwinkqubo. Sebenzisa izixhobo ngokusebenziseka kwakunye nokusetyenziswa. Gcina ubudlelwane obulungileyo bokusebenza kunye nezesesi nabaninyi abanngapandle kwenkqubo. Gcwalisa iimfuno zabasebenzi njengoko kumiswe ngumthetho wemali yorhulumente ngenamba ka-1999. Ulawulo lolwazi malunga nokwenza okubonakalayo, iimali, abantu abalawulwayo nezinto.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Criminologist
jobs.centre: Eastern Cape region: Regional Office Ref No: EC 2026/11/01 (Re- advertisement) Western Cape region: Regional Office Ref No: WC 2026/11/01 (Re- advertisement)
jobs.summary: Assistant Director Criminologist positions at Correctional Services regional offices in the Eastern Cape and Western Cape, conducting risk and behavioural assessments of high-risk individuals.
jobs.requirements: Recognised Master’s Degree (NQF level 9) in Criminology. 6-10 years relevant or related experience. Background in working on behavioural assessment/profiling in the corrections/justice cluster will be an added advantage. Computer literate. Valid driver’s licence. Competencies And Attributes: In depth understanding of safety and security in a correctional environment. Communication, negotiation, analytical and report writing skills. Project and programme management. Problem solving, decision making and analysis. Change, stakeholder and people management. Confidentiality, integrity and honesty. Diplomacy, tactful and assertiveness. Ability to network. Resilient, influence and impact. Good communication, report writing, research and development skills.
jobs.duties: Conduct risk assessment. Render induction assessment of high risk/high profile individuals to assess pattern of actions, demographics and motivation as well as other crime characteristics. Render risk management assessment to assess problematic and deficit areas and refer for professional intervention. Pre-parole assessment to assess progress of rehabilitation and risks and predictors for reoffending. Conduct behavioural assessment research. Interact with offenders to understand their criminal behaviour and determine their offending history and future risk of offending. Analyse and advise on criminality/risk behaviour occurring inside the management area. Compile data and form intact reports on crime/criminal related behaviours. Interview offenders to determine the effects of rehabilitation programmes and readiness for parole in terms of their risk for reoffending. Compilation and provision of pro file/criminologist report to Case Management Committees (CMC)/Correctional Supervision and Parole Boards (CSPB) to enhance decision making process. Identify problematic criminal behaviour and recommend referral to professionals. Apply wide range of theories and scientific academic literature to explain criminal behaviour. Assist in compilation and quality checking of profiles (G326) prior to submission to the CSPB. Contribute in the development, compilation and implementation of the criminogenic risk assessment/profiling tools for offenders. Identify shortfalls in the assessment, classification and profiling of offenders. Conduct research and assist criminologist sub directorate to improve offender risk profiling tools. Develop remedial action in addressing shortfalls identified. Provide orientation and capacity building of correctional assessment officials and other officials in the area of work to improve offender risk assessment and profiling practice. Conduct research in respect of all assessment tools. Promote criminological activities and awareness. Plan and organize awareness campaigns. Create and develop information leaflets. Research the effects of gangsterism within correctional facilities. Liaise with relevant DCS officials, professional officials and external stakeholders with regard to criminological theories, recidivism risks and patterns. Promote partnerships with communities and NGO’s to promote successful integration. Management of performance information, finances, human resources and assets.
jobs.enquiries: Eastern Cape region: Ms Myataza Z Tel No: (043) 706 7866/Ms Mgugudo N Tel No: (043) 706 7882. Western Cape region: Ms. A Reddy Tel No: (021) 559 7920 / Ms. NC Sotyibi Tel No: (021) 558 0518/ Mr S. Sikisazane Tel No: (021) 558 0108.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Kriminoloog
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur Kriminoloog-posisies by Correctional Services-streekkantore in die Eastern Cape en Western Cape, wat risiko- en gedrag assessing van hoë-risiko individue uitvoer.
af.requirements: Erkende Meestersgraad (NQF vlak 9) in Kriminologie. 6-10 jaar relevante of verwante ervaring. Agtergrond in werk aan gedragsassessering/profilering in die korrektiewe/justisiekluster sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Rekenaargeletterd. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede En Attribuute: Diepgaande begrip van veiligheid en sekuriteit in 'n korrektiewe omgewing. Kommunikasie-, onderhandeling-, analitiese en verslagskryfvaardighede. Projekte- en programbestuur. Probleemoplossing, besluitneming en analise. Verandering, belanghebbende- en mensebestuur. Konfidensialiteit, integriteit en eerlikheid. Diplomasie, takt en selfhandhawing. Vermoë om te netwerk. Veerkragtig, beïnvloeding en impak. Goeie kommunikasie, verslagskryf, navorsing en ontwikkelingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Voer risikoassessering uit. Lewer induksie-assessering van hoë-risiko/hoë-profiel individue om patroon van optrede, demografie en motivering asook ander misdaadkenmerke te assesseer. Lewer risikobestuursassessering om problematiese en tekortkoming areas te assesseer en te verwys vir professionele ingryping. Voor-parool assessering om vordering van rehabilitasie en risiko's en voorspellers vir heroortreding te assesseer. Voer gedragsassesseringsnavorsing uit. Interageer met oortreders om hul kriminele gedrag te verstaan en hul oortredingsgeskiedenis en toekomstige risiko van oortreding te bepaal. Analiseer en adviseer oor kriminaliteit/risikogedrag wat binne die bestuursarea voorkom. Stel data saam en vorm onveranderlike verslae oor misdaad/krimineel-verwante gedrag. Ondervra oortreders om die effekte van rehabilitasieprogramme en gereedheid vir parool in terme van hul risiko vir heroortreding te bepaal. Samestelling en verskaffing van profiel/kriminoloog verslag aan Case Management Committees (CMC)/Correctional Supervision and Parole Boards (CSPB) om besluitnemingsproses te verbeter. Identifiseer problematiese kriminele gedrag en beveel verwysing na professionele persone aan. Pas 'n wye reeks teorieë en wetenskaplike akademiese literatuur toe om kriminele gedrag te verduidelik. Bystand in samestelling en kwaliteitskontrole van profiele (G326) voor voorlegging aan die CSPB. Bydrae tot die ontwikkeling, samestelling en implementering van die kriminogene risikoassesserings/profileringsinstrumente vir oortreders. Identifiseer tekortkominge in die assessering, klassifikasie en profilering van oortreders. Voer navorsing uit en bied bystand aan kriminoloog sub-direktoraat om oortreer-risikoprofileringsinstrumente te verbeter. Ontwikkel herstelmaatreëls om geïdentifiseerde tekortkominge aan te spreek. Verskaf oriëntasie en kapasiteitsbou van korrektiewe assesseringsamptenare en ander amptenare in die werkarea om oortreer-risikoassesserings- en profileringspraktyk te verbeter. Voer navorsing uit ten opsigte van alle assesseringsinstrumente. Bevorder kriminologiese aktiwiteite en bewustheid. Beplan en organiseer bewustheidsveldtogte. Skep en ontwikkel inligtingsbrosjures. Ondersoek die effekte van bendewese binne korrektiewe fasiliteite. Skakel met relevante DCS-amptenare, professionele amptenare en eksterne belanghebbendes ten opsigte van kriminologiese teorieë, residiwisme-risiko's en -patrone. Bevorder vennootskappe met gemeenskappe en NGO's om suksesvolle integrasie te bevorder. Bestuur van prestasie-inligting, finansies, menslike hulpbronne en bates.

zu.title: Umncedisi Weqhaza: I-Criminologist
zu.summary: Izikhundla ze-Umncedisi Weqhaza i-Criminologist ezihlakeni zesifundazwe ze-Correctional Services e-Eastern Cape nase-Western Cape, okwenza ukuhlola ubungozi nokuziphatha kwabantu abasingathingi obuphezulu.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Master’s Degree (NQF level 9) eziyavunywa kwi-Criminology. Isipilingo seminyaka eyi-6-10 esihambisana noma ohlobene nalesi sikundla. Isipilingo sokusebenza kwi-behavioural assessment/profiling kwi-corrections/justice cluster kuzoba yinzuzo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Amandla Nabantu: Ukuqonda ngokujulile ukhuseleko nokuvikeleka endaweni yokulungisa abantu. Amakhono okuxhumana, ukuxoxisana, ukuhlaziya nokubhala imibiko. Ukuqeqesha amaphrojekthi namaphroghramu. Ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukwenza izinqumo nokuhlaziya. Ukuphathwa koshintsho, baphathi benzuzo kanye nabantu. Ukugcina imfihlo, ukwethembeka nokuba nesithunzi. Ukuba nobuhlakani bukamndela, ukuziphoqa nokuqina. Isikhathi sokuxhumana nabantu. Ukumelana nobunzima, ukuthonya nokuba nomthelela. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana, ukubhala imibiko, ucwaningo nentuthuko.
zu.duties: Yenza ukuhlolwa kobungozi. Nikeza ukuhlolwa kokuqala kwabantu abasingathingi obuphezulu/abasezingeni eliphezulu ukuze kuhlolwe indlela yokuziphatha, izibalo zabantu kanye nesifiso kanye nezinye izici zobugebengu. Nikeza ukuhlolwa kokuqondisa ukuphathwa kobungozi ukuze kuhlolwe izindawo ezinobunzima nezehluleko bese kunikezelwa kubantu abakhulu benhlangano ezingeni eliphezulu. Ukuhlolwa ngaphambi kwe-parole ukuze kuhlolwe inqubo yokulungiswa nobungozi kanye nezinkomba zokuphinda kwenze ubugebengu. Yenza ucwaningo lokuhlola ukuziphatha. Phathana nabagebengu ukuze kuqondwe ukuziphatha kwabo kobugebengu futhi kusize ukutholakala umlando wabo wobugebengu nobungozi bokuphinda kwenze ubugebengu kwendlalelo. Hlaziya futhi unikeze izeluleko mayelana nobugebengu/ukuziphatha okungcola okwenzeka endaweni ephathwayo. Hlanganisa ulwazi futhi akha imibiko ephelele ngokuziphatha ngokwe-criminal related behaviours. Coxoxa nabagebengu ukuze kusize ukuthi ziphiliswe yini izinhlelo zokulungiswa nokuthi basikhulile ngemvula yobugebengu futhi balungele ukuphila ngaphandle ngokuya ngobungozi babo bokuphinda bagebengu. Ukudidiyela nokuhlinzeka ngemibiko ye-profile/criminologist kwi-Case Management Committees (CMC)/Correctional Supervision and Parole Boards (CSPB) ukuze kuthuthukiswe inqubo yokwenza izinqumo. Hlola ukuziphatha okuyinkimbamkimba futhi uncomise ukunikwezelwa kubantu abakhulu. Faka izindlela eziningi zemfundiso nencwadi yezemfundo yesayensi ukuze kuqalwe ukuziphatha okuyicala. Siza ekudidiyelweni nasekuhlolweni ikhwalithi yamaphrofayili (G326) ngaphambi kokunikela kwi-CSPB. Siza ekuthuthukisweni, ekudidiyelweni nakokuqaliseni kwamathuluzi oku-hlola/akha amaphrofayili wobungozi kwabaphangi. Hlola izehluleko ekuhlolweni, ekwahlukaniseni nasekuvezeni amaphrofayili kwabaphangi. Yenza ucwaningo futhi usize ngesikhundla esincane sama-criminologist ukuthuthukisa amathuluzi okuakha amaphrofayili wobungozi. Akha izindlela zokuxazulula ezehluleko ezitholakele. Nikeza ukulungiselela nokwakha ukushuba kwabaphathi boku-hlola kwabaphangi kanye nabanye abaphathi endaweni yokusebenza ukuze kuthuthukiswe umthetho wokuhlola ubungozi nokwenza amaphrofayili. Yenza ucwaningo ngamathuluzi onke oku-hlola. Khuthaza izenzo ezihlobene ne-criminology nokwazisa. Hlela futhi uhle amasikhashana okwazisa. Akha futhi uthuthukise amakhashe olwazi. Cwaninga imithelela yezinkabi ezikhungweni zokulungisa abantu. Xhumana nabaphathi be-DCS, abaphathi benhlangano nabaphathi bangaphandle mayelana nemfundiso ye-criminological, ubungozi bokuphinda kwenze icala kanye nezindlela zokuziphatha. Khuthaza ubuhlobo nemiphakathi kanye nama-NGO ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuhlangana okuphumelelayo. Ukuphathwa kolwazi lokusebenza, izimali, abantu kanye nempahla.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNkalanga: Ugqirha weCriminology
xh.summary: Izithuba zikaMncedisi weNkalanga uGqirha weCriminology kumaziko ohlalo lwakwisixeko sakwaNtshona-Koloni nakumazantsi nasempuma koloni, ukwenza ukupima ingozi nokuqwalasela indlela yokuziphatha kwabantu abangomngcipheko omkhulu.
xh.requirements: Degree yaseKumasterku (inqanaba le-NQF 9) ekujoliswe kuyo kwiCriminology. Iimvelaphi zobugcisa kwindawo yokusebenza okulingana nokuqwalaselwa okuhlobene nendalo yomsebenzi. Iimfuno ekubeni nawolwazi ngokuthengisa nokusebenza kwimithetho yokulungelelana ikhondo kwabantu abangomngcipheko abakwindawo yegalelo/iqela lemigalelo, okongeza isipho sokuba nombono wokusombulula iingxaki kubomi babantu abangenamkhondo. Ulwazi ngokusebenza kweComputer nemvuzo ogqithiswe kulo nokuqwalasela indlela yokwenza iindlela ezinyanisekileyo zokuziphatha. Iimfuno namakhono: Ukucwangcisa amaqhinga ngokupheleleyo okukhuselekileyo nokhuseleko ekulungiseleleni ukungenelela nokubuyisa kolunye uhlaziyo. Ulwazi ekuthumeleni ngokulinganiselwa kwephulo, ikhondo nokusombulula iindlela ezimbalwa ekulawulweni kwabangenwa kukhondo. Ukuchitha, isazindingcangcango, kwaye nangakwi-nkwakhono ekunika isakhono esihle sokwenzela abantu abangenwa kukhondo nokwakhokelela iindlela ezikhethekileyo. Ukuzinika ngomsebenzi nokubakho kobuntu obukhawulezayo nokuzimisela ngokupheleleyo ekulawulweni kwezinto ezahlukeneyo.
xh.duties: Qwalasela ukupima ingozi. Yenza isikhululo manqakamba kubantu abangomngcipheko omkhulu/abaphawulwa kakhulu ukubona indlela yokuziphatha, iimpawu zomntu nokomelelo kwaye nakwezinye iindidi zobugcisa bolwazi. Yenza ukupima ukulawula ingozi ukubona indawo ezingomngcipheko nangapha kwaye uze uqonde ekusebenzeni kolunye iindlela. Qwalasela ukulungelelana kolunye ukubona ukukhula kwesigqibo sokuziphatha ingozi nemizekelo yamaza omziyane. Yenza uphando ngokusebenza kwabantu abangenwa kukhondo. Qhagamshelana nabantu abangenwa kukhondo ukuze uqonde ukuziphatha kwabo ngokubulala ukuze uqonde ukubakho kolunye ukungenwa kukhondo kwaye ubone oluhambo olusondeleyo lokuqhagamshela kolunye ukungenwa kukhondo. Hlaziya kwaye uncede ngokubakho kolunye iindlela zokuziphatha ezikwindawo yolawulo. Qokelela idatha kwaye wenze iimviwo ezintsonkotsho ngokusebenza kolunye iindlela ezihlobene nolwazi. Nxibelelanisa nolunye abantu abangenwa kukhondo ukuze uqonde ukusebenza kolunye iindlela ezifana nokuziphatha ngokusebenza kwepulo ezikwindawo ezikhethekileyo zokubuyiswa kolunye ukuziphatha kolunye ukuziphatha kolunye ukungenwa kukhondo. Qamba kwaye unikezela ingxelo yesiprofayile/ingxelo yomlingisi kumakomiti olawulo weziqendu (CMC)/Iibhodi zoLungelelwaniso lokulungelelana nokuziphatha (CSPB) ukuze kulawulwe isigqibo esihle sokwenza. Qaphela iindlela ezibi zokuziphatha ngokwenza iindlela ezahlukeneyo kwaye ucele ukujoliswa kolunye iindlela ezikhethekileyo. Sebenzisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo zeetheori nolwazi lwesayensi lokuchaza ukuziphatha kolunye iindlela. Nceda ekwakheni kwaye uhlole ngokusebenza kwamaprofayile (G326) phambi kokuzisa kwi-CSPB. Tyalela ekuphuhliseni, ekwakheni nasekuphumezeni iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokupima iingozi/ukwakha amaprofayile kubantu abangenwa kukhondo. Qaphela iindlela ezahlukeneyo ekupimeni, ekuqwalaseleni nasekwakheni amaprofayile kubantu abangenwa kukhondo. Yenza uphando kwaye uncedise isisekelo somlingisi ukuphucula amathuluzi okupima abangenwa kukhondo. Phucula iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuza kwindlela efunwa ngokumelana nendlela efuna ukulawulwa. Yenza isikhululo manqakamba nasekuthuthuzeleni amakhono abasebenzi bokuqwalasela nokulungelelana kolunye abasebenzi abakwindawo yokusebenza ukuphucula ukusebenza kolunye ukupima abangenwa kukhondo. Yenza uphando ngaphezu kwezindlela ezahlukeneyo zokupima iingozi. Phucula izinto ezahlukeneyo zokubakho kolunye ukusetyenziswa kolunye imisebenzi yokubakho kolunye iingcali. Cwangcisa kwaye uqwalasele iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuqwalasela. Dala kwaye uphuhlise iincwadi ezahlukeneyo. Qwalasela iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezibangelwa ziindumba kwizindlu zokugcinwa kwabantu. Thathelana nabasebenzi abahlukeneyo be-DCS, oogqirha nabalingane bangaphandle ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo zokubakho kolunye iingxaki zokubakho. Phucula uqhagamshelwano namaqela amaninzi ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo zokubakho kolunye ukuphucula ukubakho kolunye ukusetyenziswa kolunye abantu abangenwa kukhondo. Lawula ulwazi ngokusebenza kolunye iindlela, iimali, abantu abangenwa kukhondo nempahla.

jobs.reference_number: HO 2026/11/09 Directorate: Remand Detention System Management
jobs.title: Assistant Director: Remand Detention Systems and Support
jobs.summary: Manage remand detention systems, virtual courts and facility upgrades at the Department of Correctional Services National Head Office.
jobs.requirements: Relevant Degree/National Diploma (NQF level 6) in Behavioural Sciences with at least 5 years’ experience gained in supervisory post (NCB 2). Successful completion of the Correctional Science Learnership/Basic Training. Computer literate. Valid driver’s licence. Competencies And Attributes: Analytical thinking skills. Policy review, analysis and development. Human resource management including development and training. Research. Financial management skills. Knowledge and understanding on the development of security systems. Compliance management. Knowledge and understanding of monitoring and evaluation of the safety legislation (construction). Application of safety legislation. Project management. Communication, report writing and presentation skills.
jobs.duties: Management of virtual courts. Co-ordinate the upgrading and refurbishment of Remand Detention Facilities (RDFs). Co-ordinate the installation. Ensure maintenance of equipment. Gathering of statistics and report writing on court appearances. Verification and tracking of RDs. Co-ordinate the installation of APIS system. Ensure maintenance of equipment. Gathering of statistics and report writing on the tracking of RDs. Development of training framework for officials working in RDFs. Evaluation of safety and security tenders. Development of policies regarding RDFs. Review of operational policies. Assist in development of orientation programmes. Assist in policy development with regard to systems in RDFs. Assist in the drafting/compilation of specifications and or amendments of specifications. Effective and efficient use of detention management system and management information system. Ensure data integrity. Ensure the effective and efficient use of MIS on remand detention issues. Upgrading of RDFs. af.requirements: Relevante Graad/Nasionale Diploma (NQF vlak 6) in Gedragswetenskappe. Ten minste 5 jaar relevante ervaring opgedoen in 'n toesighoudende pos (NBC2). Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Korrektiewe Wetenskap Leerskap of Basiese Opleiding. Rekenaarvaardig. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede en attribuute: Kennis van die Korrektiewe Dienste Wet, Wet 111 van 1998, soos gewysig. Kennis van die relevante Seksies van die Strafproseswet 51/1977. Selfversekerdheid, Netwerking / skakeling met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes. Verslagdoening, onderhandeling, fasilitering, voorlegging, projektebestuur, navorsing, kommunikasie, luister, bestuur van belanghebbendes, probleemoplossingsvaardighede, analitiese vaardighede en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging, integriteit en eerlikheid, vertroulikheid, goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings.
af.duties: Ontwikkeling en hersiening van beleid en prosedures oor voorlegging en slagofferbetrokkenheid by die Korrektiewe Toezig- en Paroolraad (KTPE's). Ondersoek instel na beste praktyke. Administrasie van gewone en ministeriële voorleggings. Ontvangs van voorleggings van verskeie belanghebbende partye. Operasionalisering van slagofferbetrokkenheidsbeleid. Opstel van implementeringsplanne. Bestuur van media- en parlementêre vrae. Ontvangs van mediavrae van verskeie mediahuise. Bestuur van prestasie-inligting, finansies, menslike hulpbronne en bates.

zu.title: Osikhundla sikaOnozimele: Okwethulwa [ncb3]
zu.summary: Osikhundla sikaOnozimele: Okwethulwa eNasiponal Head Office, onesibopho sokuthuthukiswa kwenqubomgomo, ucwaningo, nophathwa kwemibhalo yesikhashana ethunyelwa kwi-Correctional Supervision and Parole Boards.
zu.requirements: I-Degree/National Diploma (NQF level 6) efanele kwi-Behavioural Sciences. Okungenani 5 iminyaka yamava afanele atholakile esikhundleni sokulawula (NBC2). Ukugcwala ngemfundo ye-Correctional Science Learnership noma i-Basic Training. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Izakhono nezimpawu: Ulwazi nge-Correctional Services Act, Act 111 of 1998, njengoba lungisiwe. Ulwazi ngezigaba ezifanele ze-Criminal Procedure Act 51/1977. Ukuzithoba, ukuxhumana / ukusebenzisana nabahlanganyeli bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukubhala imibiko, ukuxoxisana, ukweluleka, okwethulwa, ukuqondisa amaprojekthi, ucwaningo, ukuxhumana, ukulalela, ukuphathwa kwabahlanganyeli, izakhini zokusombulula izinkinga, izakhono zokuhlaziya kanye nezakhono zokuthatha izinqumo. Ukuphatha futhi wanikeza amandla abantu, ukuzithembisa nokwethembeka, ukugcina imfihlo, futhi abahle abantu.
zu.duties: Ukuthuthukiswa nokubuyekeza kwenqubomgomo nemigomo yokubhaliswa kwemibhalo yesikhashana nokubandakanya izisulu kwi-Correctional Supervision and Parole Board (CSPBs). Ukwenza ucwaningo ngezindlela ezinhle zokusebenza. Ukuqondisa imibhalo yesikhashana evamile nalena yomhloli. Ukuthola imibhalo yesikhashana kubahlangothi abahlukene abanomdlandla. Ukusebenzisa emisebenzini imiqango yokubandakanya izisulu. Ukubhala amaphulanu okuphumeza. Ukuphathwa kwemibuzo yabezindaba neyepalamente. Ukuthola imibuzo yabezindawa kwezindlu ezahlukene zabezindaba. Ukuphathwa kolwazi ngemikhiqizo, izimali, abantu, kanye nempahla.

xh.title: Umphathi oncedisayo: iNkcazelo [ncb3]
xh.summary: Umphathi oncedisayo: iNkcazelo kwi-National Head Office, unoxanduva lokuphuhlisa iinkqubo, uphononongo, nolawulo lokuqulunqa iingxelo kwiikorhu zokuLungiselelwa kunye neBhodi yokuNika iNdlela yokuphuma.
xh.requirements: Idegree eFanelekileyo/I-National Diploma (NQF level 6) kwi-Behavioural Sciences. Ubuncinane iiminyaka emi-5 yamava afanelekileyo afunyenwe kwisithuba sobalomgu (NBC2). Ukuphumelela ekufeni i-Correctional Science Learnership okanye i-Basic Training. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Iakhono namagunya: Ulwazi ngoMthetho weenkonzo zoLungiso, uMthetho 111 ka-1998, njengoko ulungisiwe. Ulwazi ngeendawo ezithintekileyo zoMthetho woNyathelo lweBhogaxa 51/1977. Ukuzimisela, uQuqumbo / unxibelelwano nabanikazi bendlu ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukubhala iingxelo, uTshintshiselwano ngemiQondo, ukuPhatha iintlanganiso, iNkcazelo, uLawulo lweeProjekthi, uphononongo, unxibelelwano, ukumamela, uLawulo lweentatheli ezibandakanyekayo, izakhono zokuSombulula iingxaki, izakhono zokuQonda nzimbana nezakhono zokuThatha izigqibo. uLawulo lwaBantu nokuBa malungisa nokuNika amandla, uQiniseko lokuZinika ithemba, ukuGcina imfihlo, nokuba noiZingelwano ezilungileyo.
xh.duties: Ukuphuhlisa nokuphonononga iinkqubo nemigaqo malunga nokumelwa nentsebenziswano kabathunywa kwiBhodi loLawulo lokuLungiselelwa kunye noNika iNdlela yokuphuma kuwo (CSPB). Ukwenza uphononongo malunga nezithethe ezilungileyo. Ukuqulunqa nokulawula imizekelo ejolise kubaphathi bezithuba (NBC2). Ukubhala izicwangciso zokuqalisa. Ukulawula imibuzo yabezindaba neparlement. Ukumamela imibuzo yabezindaba evela kumagazini ahlukeneyo. Ulawulo lwenkcazelo ngemigaqo ye-CSPB.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Design/develop Profile Mechanism
jobs.summary: Assistant Director role at the Department of Correctional Services National Head Office to design and develop offender profiling mechanisms, requiring a behavioural sciences qualification and five years supervisory experience.
jobs.requirements: Relevant Degree/National Diploma (NQF level 6) in Behavioural Sciences. At least 5 years relevant experience gained in a supervisory post (NBC2). Successful completion of the Correctional Science Learnership or Basic Training. Computer literate. Valid driver’s licence. Competencies And Attributes: Knowledge of the Correctional Services Act, Act 111 of 1998, as amended. Knowledge of the relevant Sections of the Criminal Procedure Act 51/1977. Assertiveness, networking / liaison with internal and external stakeholders, report writing, negotiation, facilitation, presentation, project management, research, communication, listening, stakeholder management, problem solving and analytical skills. Decision making, people management and empowerment, integrity and honesty, confidentiality and good interpersonal relations.
jobs.duties: Facilitate the development and maintenance of systems for offender profiling mechanisms. Develop and maintain mechanisms to establish and profile crime categories. Conduct profiling and research. Coordinate and facilitate the development and implementation of policies in line with applicable legislation and regulatory requirements. Management of performance information. Manage human resources, finance and assets.
jobs.enquiries: National Head Office: Ms NS Khumalo Tel No: (012) 307 2174 or Ms TP Ngobeni Tel No: (012) 305 8589.
jobs.applications: should be submitted online at https://careers.dcs.gov.za/. Emailed, post or hand delivered applications will not be considered.
jobs.notes: Appointment under the Correctional Services Act. Before you apply: All costs associated with an application will be borne by the applicant. Applicants who have retired from the Public Service with a specific determination that they cannot be re-appointed or have been declared medically unfit will not be considered. Please take note that correspondence will only be conducted with the shortlisted candidates. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application is unsuccessful. Please do not call the department to enquire about the progress of your application. Applicants must note that further checks will be conducted once they are shortlisted and that their appointment is subject to positive outcomes on these checks, which include security clearance, security vetting, qualification verification and criminal records verification. Appointment will be provisional, pending the issue of a security clearance. If you cannot get a security clearance, your appointment will be re-considered/possibly terminated. Fingerprints may be taken on the day of the interview. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One shall be a practical exercise, and the other shall be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applications: Applications must be submitted on the Z83 form (Public Service application form) obtainable from any Public Service department and must be completed in full. Only a detailed CV should be attached to your application form. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies not older than 6 months of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview. Please send a complete application for the post you apply for on a pdf format, stating the correct reference for the position you are interested in. Requirement for valid driver’s licence is not applicable to applicants with a disability. OTHER POSTS

af.requirements: Relevante graad/nasionale diploma (NQF vlak 6) in Gedragswetenskappe. Ten minste 5 jaar relevante ervaring opgedoen in 'n toesigpos (NBC2). Selfstandigheid, netwerking/skakeling met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes, verslagskrywing, onderhandeling, fasilitering, aanbieding, projektebestuur, navorsing, kommunikasie, luister, bestuur van belanghebbendes, probleemoplossing en analitiese vaardighede. Besluitneming, mensebestuur en bemagtiging, integriteit en eerlikheid, vertroulikheid en goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings.
af.duties: Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling en instandhouding van stelsels vir meganismes vir oortrederprofilering. Ontwikkel en onderhou meganismes om misdaadkategorieë vas te stel en te profileer. Voer profilering en navorsing uit. Koördineer en fasiliteer die ontwikkeling en implementering van beleide in ooreenstem met toepaslike wetgewing en regulatoriese vereistes.
