Isibonakaliso sokuthi uthole okungenani iminyaka emihlanu yamava ohambisana nendawo yokusebenza ekulawula abantu (NBC2). Ukuqeda i-Correctional Science Learnership noma i-Basic Training ngemphumela yezigidi. Ukwaziswa ngokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. I-Layisensi yokushayela evakaleyo. I-Khompedensi neZiphathwa: Ulwazi ngoMthetho Wezinsizakusebenza ZokuLungisa, uMthetho 111 ka-1998, njengoba ulungisiwe. Ulwazi ngeSigaba esihambisana noMthetho WokuQhoshwa Icala 51/1977. Ukuzethemba, ukuxhumana/kuxhumana nabaphathi abangaphakathi nangaphandle, ukubhala imibiko, ukucinga ngendlela yokwenza izinto, ukulawula inkulumo, ukubonisa izinto, ukuphatha amaphulo, ucwaningo, ukuthumela imiyalezo, ukulalela, ukuphatha abathintekayo, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlukanisa ulwazi ngengqondo. Ukwenza izinqumo, ukuphatha abantu nokuqinisa amandla abo, ukuthembeka nokubaqqambe, ukugcina imfihlo kanye nokuba nobuhlobo obuhle nabantu.
zu.duties: Kwelulekela ukuklama nokugcina izinhlelo zokusebenza kwezindlela zokudweba isithombe-ndaba. Kubekwe lindlela zokusebenza ezokusungula kwaye kudwebwe isithombe-ndaba sezinhlobo zebaphi. Kwensiwe ucwaningo kwaye kudwebwe isithombe-ndaba. Kuhlanganisiwe kwaye kwelulekele ukuklama nokusetshenziswa kwemigqabo ngokuhambisana nomthetho ohambisana nayo nezidingo ezibekiweyo. Kulawulwa ulwazi ngemvelaphi yemisebenzi ekwenzwayo. Kulawulwa abantu, imali izinto ezibekelwe ukuba zisetshenziswe.

Ukuqeda ngempumelelo i-Correctional Science Learnership okanye i- Basic Training. Ukuba nobuchule ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ukwenza iigqibo, ulawulo lubantu nokunika amandla, ukuzithoba nokuqothuka, ugqibo-fihlo nangcono iingxoxo phakathi kwabantu.
xh.duties: Kwenza amacebo okuphuhlisa nokuzeza iindlela zolawulo lwemikolo yabakrokrowayyo. Ukuphuhlisa nokuzeza iindlela zokuqamba nokuqamba iindidi zobugcisa bokwenza iziphoso. Ukwenza imikolo nophononongo. Ukulungelelanisa kwaye uncede ukuphuhlisa nokusebenzisa iinkqubo ngokulandela imithetho esemthethweni neemfuno zolawulo. Ulawulo lwexabiso ngenkcazelo yemisebenzi. Suksesvolle voltooiing van Corrections Science Learnership/Basic Training. Top geheime veiligheidsklassifikasie as 'n bykomende voordeel. Rekenaarvaardig. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Izindingo nezici: Ulwazi ngomthetho wokulungisa izono, Act 111 ka-1998, njengoba ulungiswe. Ukuqina, ukuxhumana/nokuxhumanisa ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwezinhlangano ezihlukene, ukubhala imibiko, ukuhlongoza, ukweluleka, ukubamba iqhaza, ukuphatha amaphrojekthi, ukuxhumana, ukulalela, ukuphatha abantu, ukuxazulula izinkinga, kanye namakhono okuhlola nokuqonda. Ukuthatha izinqumo, ukuphatha futhi nakho ukuphakamisa abantu, ukwethembeka nokuba nesibindi, ukugcina imfihlo, nokuba nobuhle obuhle ekuxhumaneni.
zu.duties: Yisa abaphangi baphinde bangenwe emphakathini ngokubandakanya izakhiwo ezintsha. Qapha futhi uhlole ukusetshenziswa kwemithetho yokuqondisa kuyo yonke imikhawu edinga ukunakwa mayelana nokubuyiselwa kobudedi kwabaphangi. Phakamisa ukubuyiselwa ngempumelelo kwabaphangi bakhiwe emiphakathini yabo. Hlela amathuluzi okuqapha ukuze kuqondwe ngemisebenzi ebonwa abakhiwo ezinikeza izinsiza abaphangi bakhiwe. Ukukhungatha nokuxhumanisa izakhiwo ezingaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukuqondisa ulwazi ngemikhuba yokusebenza kwezimali, abantu abasebenza, kanye nezimpahla.

xh.title: Umongameli Onconyo: Ukulinganisa nokulandela [ncb3]
xh.summary: Umongameli Onconyo kwisebe leZikhululo zokuLungiswa eNdiwaneni eliNgingozi eziko likazwelonke, luncedisa ekulawuleni ukubuyela kwabagqibi-matyetyo kwaye luhlelela inxaxheba ekulinganisweni kweenkqubo, lifuna idiploma okanye izidanga kwezenkcubeko zokuziphatha kunye neminyaka emihlanu yamava obuhloli.

Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ikhono neempawu: Ulwazi ngoMthetho weZikhululo zokuLungiswa, uMthetho 111 ka-1998, njengalungisiwe. Ukuzimisela, ukuxhumanisa/ukusebenzisana nabathathi-nxaxheba bangaphakathi nangaphandle, ukubhala iingxelo, ukuhlangangelana, ukuncedisa, ukubumba iingxelo, ulawulo lweenkqubo, unxibelelwano, okuziva, ulawulo labathathi-nxaxheba, ukusombulula iingxaki, amakhono okuhlalutya nokuphandayo. Ukwenza izigqibo, ulawulo lwabantu nokuqinisekisa amandla, ukuzithoba nokwethembeka, ukugcina imfihlo, nokuqonda kwakho nabanye.

Ukulawula nokulinganisa ukusebenza kweenkqubo kulo naliphi na icala elinodaka ngokubuyela kwabagqibi-matyetyo emphakathini. Ukuphucula ukubuyela ngempumelelo kwabagqibi-matyetyo abakhululweyo koomphakathi wabo. Ukuyila izixhobo zokulawula ukulinganisa iinkonzo ezinikwa ziinkonzo kubagqibi-matyetyo abakhululweyo. Ukuthengisa nokusebenzisana nabathathi-nxaxheba bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Ulawulo lwolwazi ngemisebenzi, zezimali, zomthakunywa neempahla.

Integriteit en eerlikheid, vertroulikheid, goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings en kennis van die Correctional Services Act, Act 111 of 1998, soos gewysig. Bestuur rekordhouding van opleidingsverwante aktiwiteite. Verseker vertroulikheid van rekords. Registrasie van Assessors en Moderators by SASSETA. Bied ondersteuning, leiding en advies op 'n deurlopende basis. Lewer leerderondersteuning. Dupliseer assesseringsinstrumente. hou toesig oor bewaarpligte. Verseker uitvoering van administratiewe pligte tydens die uitvoering van interne en eksterne bewaarpligte. Hanteer en bestuur verskeie noodsituasies tydens die uitvoering van bewaarpligte. zu.title: Meneger Wezokuphepha: Ukusekela Intuthuko [CB4]
zu.summary: Meneger Wezokuphepha eKroonstad Training College onenxenye yokuthenga izinsiza zokuqeqesha, ukuphatha izindawo kanye nokuphatwa kwezinsiza zokuqeqeshwa ngaphakathi kweDepartment of Correctional Services.
zu.requirements: I-Degree / National Diploma (NQF level 6) ehambisana nezindinganiso kuma-Behavioural Sciences. Ukuqedela ngemphumelelo i-Corrections Science Learnership/Basic Training. Okungenani eyikhaya (7) iminyaka yamava ahambisanayo esikhundleni sokuhlola (CB3). Ukuqashwa nokufakwa kuhlu nabakholwa njengoba u-Assessor no-Moderator kuzoba yinzelu. Ukubukeka kwekhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokuqasha esemthethweni. Amandla nemikhuba: Amakhono okusebenzisa izikhali kanye nokusetshenziswa kwethekinoloji yokuphepha ehambisana nayo. Ukuxhumana, ukuphatha imiklamo namaprograms. Ukuguqulwa, inguquko kanye nokuphatha abahlanganyeli. Ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlaziya, intuthuko yohlelo lokuletha izinsiza, ukwenza izinqumo, ukuphatha abantu kanye nokubanika amandla. Ukuqonda ngobunjalo ukuphepha kanye nokuvikeleka endaweni yokulungisa abantu. Ukuzinikela nokuba nembobo, ukugcina imfihlo, ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabantu kanye nolwazi lwe-Correctional Services Act, Act 111 of 1998, njengoba kulungisiwe. Ukuzimisela, amandla okuxhumanisa kanye nobudlelwano. Ukuqonda I-Public Service Policies kanye ne-Legislative Framework. Ukuletha izinsiza kanye nokuqondiswa kwabathengi, ukuzimisela kanye namandla okuxhumanisa, ukuthonya kanye nethonya, amandla okusebenzisa imicabango yokuhlela, ukuzithoba okokuhamba.
zu.duties: Kuthenge futhi kunikwe izinsiza zokuqeqesha. Kuphatwe izinkambu zokuqeqeshwa ezingaphansi. Kuqiniseziswe ukutholakala kwezinto zokubhala kanye nezinsiza zokuqeqeshwa. Kuphatwe isikhungo sezinsiza. Kuphatwe ukuphatwa kwezinsiza zokuqeqeshwa kanye nezindawo zokuqeqesha. Kuqiniseziswe ukutholakala kwezihluthi kanye nezinkambu. Kuqiniseziswe izimo ezingcolile zamanzi ezindaweni zokuqeqeshwa ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso ze-OHS. Kubhalwe abafundi nge-SASSETA. Kubhegwe imvume yokufunda kanye nokubonakalisa kwabafundi. Kuhlelwwe futhi kuphatwe ukunikazwa kwamafayela e-Portfolio of Evidence (POE) emva kokuhlolwa. Kusekelwe ukulungiselelwa kanye nokuqedela ukuphatwa okuhambisana nokuqinisekiswa ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Kuphatwe ukugcina irekhodi yemisebenzi ehambisana nokuqeqesha. Kuqiniseziswe ukugcinwa kwemfihlo kumarekhodi. Kubhalwe aboqeqeshi kanye nalabo abahola nge-SASSETA. Kunikwe ukusekela, inkomba kanye neluleko ngokuqhubeka. Kunikwe ukusekela abafundi. Ukushaywa kwamathuluzi okuhlola. Kubhekwa imisebenzi yokuqaphela. Kuqiniseziswe ukusayina kanye nokuthola izinto zokuphepha. Kubalwe futhi kuqinisekiswe izingalo zabashayiwe. Kubhalwe, kubitwe izenzakalo futhi kuqhubwe amaprograms okulungisa. Kungeniswe, kuphatwe/kuthunyelwe izikhalazo kanye nezicelo zababoshwa. Kuqiniseziswe ukwenziwa kwemisebenzi yokuqaphela ngaphakathi nangaphandle endaweni ethambekile nephephile yokulungisa/okuboshiwe. Kuqiniseziswe ukwenziwa kwemisebenzi yokuqaphela. Kuphatwe futhi kuhlolwe izimo eziphuthumayo lapho kwenza imisebenzi yokuqaphela. Kuhlanganyelwe emihlanganweni ye-OHS. Kubhalwe imibiko yenyanga yokuhamba. Kuphatwe ulwazi lomsebenzi. Kuphatwe izinsiza zomphakathi, imali nezimpahla.

xh.title: Umphathi Wokhuseleko: Inkxaso YoPhuhliso [CB4]

Ubuncinane kweminyaka esix (7) yamava afanelekileyo kwisithuba sokulawula (CB3). Ukubhaliswa nokuqinisekiswa njengomphathi wolucingo nokuba ngumlawuli kuya kuba lulungelelaniso. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Amakhono nemigcaqo: Amakhono okusebenzisa izixhobo zokhululeko nendlela yokusebenzisa iinkqubo zekhono lezithuba zokhuseleko namanqanaba abafundi. Ukuxhumana, ukulawula nendlela yokulawula iindlela zokwenza izinto, ukutshintsha izinto, kwaye ulawule abathathi nxaxheba ekusebenzeni. Ikhono lokuxazulula iingxaki, uhlalutyo, ukuyila iindlela ezintsha zokunikela inkonzo, ukwenza izigqibo, ukulawula abantu nokuqalisa abantu. Ukuqonda ngobunzima ukhuseleko nokukhuseleka kwindawo yokulungisa iziphatho. Intembeko nokwazisa, ukuzigcina, ukwakha ubuhlobo obuhle nabantu, nolwazi lomthetho we Correctional Services, Act 111 of 1998, njengoko ulungisiwe. Ukuzimisela ukuthetha, ukwazi ukuzamanisa nezinye iindawo, ukuziphatha ngobubele. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zobuRhulumente neSakhiwo sezomthetho. Ukunikela inkonzo nokuqondisela kumthengi, ukuzimisela nokwazi ukuzamanisa nezinye iindawo, ukuchukumisa kwaye ube namandla, ukuzisebenzisa ngokwendlela ephantsi yokucinga, ukulungelelana ukuhamba.
xh.duties: Ukufuna nokuqamba izixhobo zolungiselelo. Ukulawula izibhalo ezincinci ngenani. Ukuqinisekisa ukubakho kweepeni zokubhala nezixhobo zolungiselelo. Ukulawula iziko lezixhobo. Ukulawula ulawulo nokulawula iindawo zolungiselelo ezinxulumene nolungiselelo. Ukuqinisekisa ukubakho kwezitshixo nezibhalo ezincinci. Ukuqinisekisa ukhululeko kwindawo yolungiselelo ngokwemigqaliselo ye-OHS-standards. Ukubhaliswa kwezifundo kwiSASSETA. Ukuqinisekisa izifundo nokubhalwa kwazo. Ukulawula nokwenza kuqokelelwe iifayile zePortfolio of Evidence (POE) emva kokuqinisekiswa. Ukuncedisa ukulungiselela nokuphelisa ulawulo oluxhelene nolungiselelo ukwenzela ukuqinisekiswa ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukulawula ukugcinwa kweenkqubo zolungiselelo. Ukuqinisekisa ukugcinwa kolwazi. Ukubhaliswa kwabaphathi bomlingo nabaphathi bomthetho kwiSASSETA. Ukunika inkxaso, inkqubo yokulawula kwaye unikezelwe ingcebiso ngokuqhubekayo. Ukunikela inkxaso kwabafundi. Ukuphinda ukwenza izixhobo zokuqinisekisa ulwazi. Ukulawula imisebenzi yokugcina. Ukuqinisekisa ukusayina nokwamkela izixhobo zokhuseleko. Ukuqhela inani ukuze iqinisekiswe inani labaphangi. Ukubhala, ukuxela izenzo ezingalunganga nokulawula iinkqubo zokulungisa iziphatho. Ukubhalisa, ukuphatha/ukurekhoda iingxaki zabaphangi nezicelo. Ukuqinisekisa ukwenza imisebenzi yokugcina ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwendawo yokulungisa/eqinisekisa indawo yokubamba abantu. Ukuqinisekisa ukwenza imisebenzi yolawulo xa usenza imisebenzi yokugcina ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukuphatha kwaye ubhekane neendlela ezahlukeneyo ezingozi xa usenza imisebenzi yokugcina. Ukubakhona kwiindibano ze-OHS. Ukubhala iingxelo zentshukumo nyanga zonke. Ukulawula ulwazi ngokusebenza. Ukulawula iziseko zabantu, imali nezixhobo.

Beleidsontwikkeling, -ontleding, -monitering, -evaluering en -implementering. Kennis van DPSA-sirkulaires rakende werknemers se beroepsgesondheid en veiligheid. Fasiliteer die implementering van OHS soos ingesluit in die IEHW-beleid en -prosedure. Monitor die nakoming van beroepsgesondheid en veiligheid volgens COID-wette binne die streek en bestuursarea. Monitor en bevorder 'n korporatiewe kultuur van Veiligheid, Gesondheid, Omgewing, Risiko en Kwaliteit (SHERQ) in die streek. Fasiliteer die implementering van korrektiewe maatreëls om SHERQ-risiko's te verminder. Koördineer en fasiliteer noodparaatheidsplan en reaksieprosedures binne die streek.

zu.title: Umncedisi Wezinqosi: Izempilo Nokuphepha Komsebenzi
zu.summary: Umncedisi Wezinqosi: Izempilo Nokuphepha Komsebenzi kuMnyango Wezinkonzo ZokuLungisa ezindaweni eziningi zokuLungisa eGauteng naseWestern Cape, ofuna idiploma yokuphatha ukuphepha nomkhankaso wokuqapha.
zu.duties: I-Degree/I-National Diploma evunyiweyo kokuPhatha ukuPhepha noma izifundo ezifanele. 3-5 eminyakeni yokuhlola abasebenzi endaweni yezempilo nokuphepha komsebenzi. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisense yokushayela elisebenzayo. Amandla Nokubaluleka: Ulwazi ngomthetho we-OHS. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-COID. Ulwazi lwemikhakhasiqibano nokuqhubeka komsebenzi we-DCS mayelana nempilo nokuphepha komsebenzi. Imiyalelo ye-HR mayelana nempilo nokuphepha komsebenzi. Imithetho Yesevisi Yomphakathi. Ulwazi lwezivumelwano ngokuhlangenwe mayelana nempilo nokuphepha komsebenzi. Ukuqoqa ukwaziswa, ukuhlaziya, ukuhumusha, nokusabalalisa mayelana nemithetho yokuhlolwa kokusebenza nemigomo. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-COID (umthetho wokuHlawuleliswa komsebenzi). Amagaba okuphepha. Umthetho Wezimo Eziyisisekelo ZokuSebenza. Imithetho Yesevisi Yomphakathi. Umkhakhasiqibano Wezimali we-DCS mayelana nezinkaliso, ukuchithwa kwemali, izimali ezibhiswe phambili, izinkokhelo, izikweletu, njll. Imigomo ye-HR ehlobene nokuphumula, ukuHlolwa kokusebenza, isiyalezelo, izinkinga, ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono, izempilo nokuphepha komsebenzi, impilo yabasebenzi, ngeholo nezimali ezingeziwe, njll. Imigomo yokuPhatha amaphrojekthi. I-PFMA – ukuHlela amabhajeti, ukuqagela, ukuchithwa kwemali nokubika. Ikhono elokuthola futhi lihumushe ukwaziswa oludingekayo ekuphathweni. Ukuxoxa, ukubonisa, ukuthatha izinqumo, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuxhumana nabantu abathinteke nakho nokulalela. UkuBhala imibiko yobuchule nokucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ukuthuthukiswa, ukuHlolwa, ukuQapha, ukubuyekezwa kokuSetshenziswa komyalelo. Ulwazi ngemiyalo ye-DPSA ngempilo nokuphepha komsebenzi. Ukuqasha ukusetshenziswa kwe-OHS njengakuqatshwe kumkhakhasiqibano nendlela ye-IEHW. UkuQapha ukuziphendiseleka empilweni nokuphepha komsebenzi ngakho-kwemithetho ye-COID esiyingxenyeni nasendaweni ekuphathwa. UkuQapha nokukhuthaza inhlalo yasekhaya ngokuPhepha, iNtando, Imvelo, Ingozi neKhwalithi (SHERQ) esiyingxenyeni. Ukuqasha ukusetshenziswa kwezinyathelo zokuLungisa ukuze kuncishwe izingozi ze-SHERQ. UkuHlela nokukhuthaza iplani yokulungela iziphephelo nezinqumo zokuphendula esiyingxenyeni.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNkulumbuso: Impilo yokuSebenza nokuKhuseleka
xh.summary: Umncedisi weNkulumbuso: Impilo yokuSebenza nokuKhuseleka kwiSebe lezeNkonzo zoLungiso kumaziko olungiso amaninzi kwaGauteng nakwaWestern Cape, efunana ne-diploma yokulawula ukhuseleko namava okuqonda abasebenzi.
xh.duties: I-Degree yeNdluliweyo okanye i-National Diploma ekuLawulweni koKhuseleko okanye izatifikethi ezifanelekileyo. I-3-5 iminyaka yamava okuqonda abasebenzi kwindawo yeMpilo yokuSebenza nokuKhuseleka. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. iLayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo. Iikhompetensi neempawu: Ulwazi ngomthetho we-OHS. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-COID. Ulwazi lwenqgela yempilo yokuSebenza nokuKhuseleka yabasebenzi be-DCS namacebo. Iimthetho ye-HR malunga nempilo yokuSebenza nokuKhuseleka yabasebenzi. Iimthetho zeNkonzo zaBantu. Ulwazi lwezemvumelwano ezingqongqo malunga nempilo yokuSebenza nokuKhuseleka yabasebenzi. Ukuqokelela, ukuhlalutya, ukuhicilela, ukusasaza ulwazi malunga neenqgela zimthetho zokuqonda ulusebenzo neemthetho. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-COID (Umthetho weNkleko zeBasebenzi). Izinga lokhuseleko. Umthetho weemfuno eziyisisiseko zoBosebenza. Iimthetho zeNkonzo zaBantu. Inqgela yezeMali ye-DCS malunga neenkalazo, iindleko, oovimba bexeshazo, iindleko, iinvoisi, njl. Iinqgela ze-HR ezinxulumene noluhoko, ukuqondwa kolusebenzo, isohlwayo, iingxaki, uphuhliso lwamakhono, impilo yokuSebenza nokuKhuseleka, impilo yomsebenzi, umvuzo neenzuzo, njl. Iinkqubo zolawulo lweeprojekthi. I-PFMA – ukuqokelelwa kwepejethi, ukulinganisa, iindleko nokubika. Ikhono elokufikelela kuqondo nokuqonda ulwazi olufunekayo lolawulo. Unxibelelwano, iinkcazelo, ukuthatha izigqibo, ukuxazulula iingxaki, ukuqhomfa/ukunxulumana nabanomdla nokunxibelelana. Ukubala iingxelo ezisezantsi nokuqonda ngokucokisekileyo. Ukuphuhlisa iinqgela, ukuhlalutya, ukuqokelela, ukulinganisa nokuzisebenzisa. Ulwazi lwe-DPSA malunga nemiza yempilo yokuSebenza nokuKhuseleka yabasebenzi. Ukulawula ukusebenziswa kwe-OHS njengoko kuqulathiweyo kwinqgela nendlela ye-IEHW. Ukugcina ukuthobela iMthetho yeMpilo yokuSebenza nokuKhuseleka ngokomthetho we-COID ngaphakathi kwesithili nendawo yolawulo. Ukugcina nokukhuthaza isiko lokukhuseleka, impilo, ibhologo, ingozi nokuQonda (i-SHERQ) kwisithili. Ukulawula ukusebenziswa kwezinyathelo zolungiso ukuze kuthothelwe iingozi ze-SHERQ. Ukuququzelela nokulawula icebo lokulungelelanisa iimeko ezibuthathaka neendlela zokuPhendula kwisithili.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Fisiese Sekuriteit
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur: Fisiese Sekuriteit by die Department of Correctional Services Nasionale Hoofkantoor, wat 'n graad in Criminal Justice en 3-5 jaar se relevante ervaring vereis.

zu.title: Msizane: Ukubheka nokubika
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba ngumsizane enkantolo yezobuhluleki eNhlotshini Kazwelonke lemsebenzi wokulungisa, ongumnyango ophethe ukubheka, ukubika nokuhlanganisa imibiko yeminingwane yokusebenza komnyango.
zu.requirements: Iziqu eziqashelwe noma i-Diploma Yezwe kuPublic Administration / Auditing / Statistics / Monitoring and Evaluation noma iziqu ezihambisanayo. Uhambo lweenyanga ezintathu (3) kokuhlolwa nokubheka nokubika okuyingxenye yokuqashwa kweminyaka emibili (2) okufanele ukuba ibe kumazinga okuphatha noma okulingana nalawo. Ulwazi lwezincwajana zombuso. Ukuphathwa kwezimali zomphakathi. Umthetho wokubheka nokuhlolwa kweminyonjo yombuso jikelele. Izinto eziyimfuneko ngokomthetho. Izincwajana zesu elihlelekile. Ukuphatha kanye nentuthuko. Ulwazi loluhambo lwezinkinga kanye nendlela ezisombululwa ngayo izinkinga. Ukweluleka nokuhlela. Ukuphatha ubudlelwane nabantu. Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi nokuhlelwa kwazo. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya izinto, ukubukiswa, ukuhlola imininingwane yocwaningo, ukubhala imibiko, ubuhlobo, ukuxhumana, ubudlelwane nabantu kanye nobukhulu. Ukuziqondakalisa ngemiva, ukuphatha ukushintshwa kwento, ukuphatha ukungalunga kwezinto kanye nendlela yokuphatha abantu.
zu.duties: Ukuhlanganisa imibiko yeminingwane yokusebenza yomnyango. Lweminingwane yokusebenza. Hlanganisa, hlaziya futhi uhlanganise okokufaka okusuka kumabehe ahlukene ukuze uhlanganise imibiko yokusebenza yenyanga ngayinye yomnyango, imibiko yokusebenza kusukela kwindlu noma inyanga kuya kuhlobo, imibiko yokusebenza yesonto, imibiko yokusebenza yeminyaka eminingana, imibiko yonyaka, imibiko yaphakathi kanye nemibiko yokugcina. Yenza izincwajana kanye nezinsimbi zokubheka ezintsha besezihlola. Hlolisisa besezigcina zibambe iqhaza kulezo zindaba zakamuva ezintsha. Kuyimfuneko ukuba yenziwe besezihlola imibiko yendawo eqakalisa izinto ezisanda zibaluleka kakhulu ezindabeni zezimali nezohwebo. Hlolisisa ukuphathwa kwemibiko yokusebenza kwezinsimbi zokubheka nokubika ezisebenza emnyangweni. Qinisekisa ukubuyekeza izinsimbi ezisetshenziswa emnyangweni. Yenza izinsimbi ezintsha ezizobheka izinto ezibalulekile ezisesikhundleni esiphakeme ngemuva kokuba izincwajana zesikhathi kanye nemibiko yokubika yenziwe ngonendlela efanayo. Zama ukuba ngabasebenzi abaphethe imibiko yasekhaya kanye nalabantu abangenele kulesi sikhundla ukubheka futhi uhlele umsebenzi ongafakwa emthethweni. Hlanganisa futhi uhlele imibiko yeminyaka yonke nezokuhlolwa kwezinto ezitholakala esikhundleni. Yenza ukubheka futhi uhlele imibiko yokusebenza kwezimali nezohwebo okuyiyona ephethwe yilesi sikhundla ezinga eliphezulu ngemuva kokuba izincwajana zokuqala kanye nemibiko yokubika yenziwe ngonendlela efanayo.

xh.title: Umlawuli oncedayo: Ukuqwalasela nokubika
xh.summary: Umlawuli oncedayo kwiSebe leeNkonzo zokuLungisa iNtloko eLizwe ngokubhekene nokuqwalasela, ukubika nokudibanisa iimbiko zenkcazelo ngemisebenzi yesebe.
xh.requirements: Igreeji evunyiweyo okanye iDiploma yaseLizwe kuLawulo kaRhulumente / ukuQwalasela / iZibalo / ukuQwalasela nokubandakanya okanye izifundo ezifaneleyo. Iiminyaka emithathu (3) yamava kokwenza ukuQwalasela nokubika apho kwiminyaka embini (2) kufuneka kube ngowomphathi okanye elinganayo. Ukubakuguquguquki kwekhompyutha. ilayisenisi yokuqeshisa esemthethweni. Iimpawu nokulinganisa: Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zokuqwalasela nokubandakanya. Ulwazi ngeendlela zophando. Ulwazi ngeenkcwada zikalawulo karhulumente. ulawulo lweemali zorhulumente. Isakhelo senkqubo yorhulumente wonke yokuqwalasela nokubandakanya. Iimfuno zenkqubo. Ienkcwada zokuqulunqa iNdlela. Ulawulo nophuhliso. Ulwazi namava ngenkqubo yokusombulula iingxaki. ukuCwangcisa nokuhlela. ukuLawulwa kobudlelwane. ukuLawulwa kweenkqubo namaphrojekthi. Ukucinga ngokuhlaziya, okubekiweyo, ukuhlaziya idatha yophando, ukubhala iimbiko, ubuntu bokuchasana nabantu, ukunxibelelana, nobucukubhedi. Ukuqonda iimvakalelo, ulawulo lwetshintsho, ulawulo loyingozi nasekulawuleni abantu.
xh.duties: Ukudibanisa iimbiko zenkcazelo ngemisebenzi zesebe. Ukuqokelela, ukuqinisekisa nokwenza uqwalaselo olusekelwe kubungqina benkcazelo ngemisebenzi. Ukulungelelanisa, ukuhlaziya nokudibanisa okungenayo kumasebe ahlukahlukeneyo ukuze kudityaniselwe iimbiko zenyanga zonke zokusebenza zesebe, iimbiko zeesithuba ezintathu, iimbiko zophuhliso lwexesha eliphakathi, iimbiko zorhanyemnyaka, iimbiko zexesha eliphakathi nasekuphela. UkuLawula ukuphuhlisa iinkqubo nezixhobo zokuqwalasela. ukuQwalasela nokugcina usuhamba nexesha ngeendlela ezintsha. ukuphuhlisa nokuhlaziya iinkqubo zokuqwalasela nokubika, iinkqubo namanyuzi. ukuQwalasela ukusetyenziswa kwezixhobo zokuqwalasela nokubika zesebe. ukuxhasa ukusetyenziswa kweekhmpawundi zokuqwalasela idatha nokubika ngaphakathi kwisebe. ukuQinisekisa ukubonelelwa ngeenkonzo zoxhaso kwisebe loLawulo lweNdlela. ukuKhokela ukulungelelanisa kweeforham zoLawulo lweNdlela namagqibelele ngeembiko zeesithuba ezintathu norhanyemnyaka. ukuxhasa isiSebe esincinci: ukuQwalasela nokubika. ukuncedisa ukugcina ulawulo olufanelekileyo langaphakathi n iinkqubo zokubika ukuze kuhlangatshelwe iindaba ezilindelekayo ngokusebenza. ukuncedisa ukuqwalasela abujetyo neentlawulo kwisebe esincinci. ukuLawulo abantu, iimali nezinto. ukuLawulwa kwenkcazelo ngokusebenza.

Computer literacy. Valid driver’s licence. Quality Council for Trades and Occupations (QCTO) quality assurance requirements. Principles and practices of assessment and moderation. Assessment design, assessment instruments and moderation methodology. Unit standards, learning outcomes, exit-level outcomes and assessment criteria. Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL), where applicable. Skills Development legislation and related regulations. Public Service legislative and policy framework. Correctional Services legislative and policy framework. Departmental training and development policies and procedures. Quality management systems and compliance monitoring. Project and programme management principles. Financial management, procurement and asset management prescripts.
jobs.duties: Development and review of assessment and moderation frameworks. Assessment and moderation systems and processes. Development and review of learning programme standards. Quality assurance and compliance monitoring. Assessment and moderation tools. Stakeholder coordination and liaison. Reporting and information management. Human, financial and physical resource management.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Assesserings en Moderasies
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur by die Department of Correctional Services verantwoordelik vir die ontwikkeling en hersiening van assessorings- en moderasieraamwerke by die Nasionale Hoofkantoor.

Menslike, finansiële en fisiese hulpbronbestuur.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Interne Kommunikasie
af.summary: Bestuur interne kommunikasiekanale insluitend die intranet, kennissgewings en terugvoermetings vir die Department of Correctional Services.
af.requirements: Erkende Graad of Nasionale Diploma in Kommunikasie/Joernalistiek of tersaaklike kwalifikasie. 3-5 jaar se ondervinding op toesighoudende vlak in die kommunikasiesektor. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Rekenaargeletterd. Bevoegdhede en kenmerke: Bewese vermoë om die interne kommunikasiebehoeftes van 'n instelling te verstaan. Bewese vermoë om interne kommunikasiekanale en boodskappe te konseptualiseer, uit te voer en die doeltreffendheid daarvan te meet. Bewese ervaring in die skryf en redigeer van artikels. Uitstekende beheer van geskrewe en gesproke Engels. Ervaring met of deeglike begrip van 'n Content Management System (CMS) vir intranet of internet sal 'n voordeel wees. Vermoë om onder druk en volgens stywe sperdatums te werk. Bereidwilligheid om te reis en oortyd te werk. Eerlikheid en integriteit. Aandag aan detail. Beplan en organiseer. Stiptheid en vertroulikheid. Dienslewering en kliëntgerigtheid. Uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondelings). Vermoë om werksverwante take te koördineer en te organiseer. Hoë vlak van betroubaarheid. Vermoë om met takt en diskresie op te tree.
af.duties: Help met die bestuur van die departement se intranet. Bestuur en verbeter die daaglikse stelsel van interne kennissgewings. Skryf, redigeer en proeflees interne kommunikasieboodskappe. Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne, finansies en bates.

zu.title: Umnikazi Ohola Izinto: Ukuxhumana Okwangaphakathi
zu.summary: Qondisa iziteshi zokuxhumana zangaphakathi okuhlanganisa i-intranethi, izaziso, kanye nendlela yokuphendula umnyango we Department of Correctional Services.
zu.requirements: I-Degree ekuqashwe noma i-National Diploma ku-Communication/ Journalism noma izifundo ezihambisana nalokho. 3-5 weminyaka yokuhlolwa ezingeni lomphathi kwikhompyutha yokuxhumana. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amandla kanye Nemikhuba: Ubungqo obuqinisiwe bokuxhumanisa izidingo zokuxhumana kwangaphakathi zesikhungo. Ubungqo obuqinisiwe bokucabanga, ukuphequlula, nokukala ukusebenza kweziteshi zokuxhumana zangaphakathi kanye nemiyalezo. Okuhlangenwe nakho okuqinisiwe ukubhala nokulungisa izindatshana. Ukwazi kahle ukubhala nokukhuluma isiNgisi. Okuhlangenwe nakho, noma ukuqonda kabanzi okumayelana nesistimu yokuphathwa kwokuqukethwe yezinhlaka ze-intranethi noma i-inthanethi kuzoba ngumvuzo. Amandla okusebenza ngaphansi kwezinkinobho ngokushesha. Ukuzikhethela ukuvakashela noma ukusebenza amahora amaningi. Ukuqinisekwa nokuziphatha ngokweqiniso. Ukunakisisa izinkcukacha. Ukucubungula futhi uhlele. Ukufika ngesikhathi kanye nokugcina imfihlo. Ukuletha isevisi nokubhekisela kubathengi. Amandla aphezulu okuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokukhulunywa). Amandla okulungiselela futhi uhlele imisebenzi. Izinga eliphezulu lokwethembeka. Amandla okuziphatha ngokuphathwa kanye nokuqaphela.
zu.duties: Siza ekuphathweni kwe-intranethi yomnyango. Phatha futhi uthuthukise isistimu yansuku zonke yezaziso zangaphakathi. Bhala, lungisa, futhi uhlole imiyalezo yokuxhumana yangaphakathi. Besezindlela zokuphendula ukukala ngenjongo ukusebenza kweziteshi zokuxhumana zangaphakathi kanye nemiyalezo. Qaphela ngokuvamile ukufinyelela okuhlosiwe kanye nokusebenza kwezinhloso zokuxhumana kanye nenzindowomculo yokuxhumana bese uhlanganisa imibhalo ngaleyo ndlela. Akha izinkulungwane nobudlelwano ngaphakathi komnyango okuzosiza ukuqinisekisa ukulandelwa okuhamba kahle kwemizuzu ephawulekile yokuletha isevisi ngenhloso yokuyixhumana ngaphakathi. Ukuphathwa kwemithombo yabantu, zemali, nezimpahha.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNqanaba: Unxibelelwano langaphakathi
xh.summary: Phatha iindlela zoxibelelwano zangaphakathi eziquka i-intranet, izaziso nezinto ezisetyenziswa kwiingxoxo eziphindaphindwayo ze Department of Correctional Services.
xh.requirements: I-Degree ekuqatshelwa okanye i-National Diploma kwi-Communication/i-Journalism okanye izifundo ezifanelekileyo. Iminyaka engama-3 ukuya kwengama-5 yamava kwinqanaba lomphathi wolawulo kwicala loxibelelwano. Ilayiseni yokushayela esemthethweni. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Iikhompetensi Namabinzana: Amandla aboniswe ngokoyiku qonda iimfuno zoxibelelwano ngaphakathi kwenkundla. Amandla aboniswe ngokokuqamba, ukwenza nokulinganisa ukusebenza kolawulo loxibelelwano ngaphakathi nemiyalezo. Amandla aboniswe ngokubhalwa nokuhlelwa kweenqaku. Ulwimi olugqithisileyo lokubala nokuthetha isiNgesi. Amaxa okanye ukuqonda ngokucacileyo i-Content Management System (CMS) ye-intranet okanye i-intanethi kuya kuba ngumdla. Amandla okusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcinezelo nangokulandela iimigaqo yexesha elingenanto. Ukulungele ukuhamba nokusebenza iires eyongezelelweyo. Inyanisekiso nokuzithembeka. Kuqwalaselo oluqondileyo. Ukucwangcisa nokuhlela. Ukufika ngexesha nokugcina iyimfihlo. Ukuletha inkonzo nokujolise kumaxhesha. Amandla amaninzi oxibelelwano (okubaliweyo nokuthethwayo). Amandla okulungelelanisa nokuhlela imisebenzi ehlobene nomsebenzi. Inqanaba eliphezulu lokuthembeka. Amandla okuziphatha ngobuqhetseba nokuzithiba.
xh.duties: Nceda ekuphathweni kwe-intranet yesebe. Phatha kuphucule inkqubo yamaxesha yezaziso ngaphakathi. Bhala, hlela uqwalasele imiyalezo yoxibelelwano ngaphakathi. Zenze iindlela ezingagqibekanga zokulinganisa ukusebenza kolawulo loxibelelwano ngaphakathi nemiyalezo. Qaphela ngokuthi nexesha ukufikelela okujoliswe kuko nokusebenza okuchaseneyo nemiqango yoxibelelwano nakuqaliselo loxibelelwano uze uqokele iingxelo ngazo. xh.requirements: Isidanga okanye iDiploma yaseLizwe kokuSingathwa kwezabelo/okuLawulwa kweNtengiso yamacebo okanye isidanga esifanelekileyo nokuba nobugcisa obungengamkhono eminyaka engama-3 ukuya kwe-5 kokuSingathwa kwezabelo njengengqeqeshi (SL8). Yenza lula ukwakhiwa, ukuphuhlisa nokugcina izixhobo zokuphuhlisa uqeqesho lwemisebenzi. Lungelanisa unikeze iinkcukacha nengcebiso yokubhalisa kubantu abanomdla. Ukulawula iziseko zabantu, imali namacebo. Ukulawula iinkcukacha ngentsalela yomsebenzi.

Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayiseni yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ikhono nezimfuziselo: Ulwazi lwe-PFMA. Ulwazi lweMigaqo yeQoqwana lemali, iNkqubo yoQhathamshwano, iNdima eQhagamshelwaneyo, uMthetho weNkonzo yoLawulo Loluntu, iPhepha iLunguzo. Ukuqonda kumagatya, kumanuali nakumava. Yenza ukuphonononga kweziseko zezinto ezihamba-hamba zenkqubo ye-LOGIS. Qinisekisa ukwabiwa okuchanekileyo kweemisebenzi kumsebenzisi. Nceda ekwenzeni ukuphonononga kwindawo ezithengiselana khona izinto. Lawula ukusebenza kumthetho weziseko zezinto ezihamba-hamba. Qinisekisa ukuba abasebenzisi be-LOGIS balandela zonke iinkqubo ezimisiweyo ngumthetho we-LOGIS. Qinisekisa ukuzithoba ngokumthetho obalulekileyo ngokuqhubela phambili ukwamkelwa kweenkqubo kwiinkonzo zeziseko zezinto ezihamba-hamba. Lilandlela i-LOGIS Balance Score Card. Qinisekisa ukuchonga iindawo ezifuna ukuphucuka ngokomgangatho omisiweyo yiQoqwana leMali leSizwe. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iintengiso kwi-LOGIS zicace. Ulawulo lwabasebenzi, weeimali nezinto ezingenisa inzuzo. Ulawulo lolwazi ngezenzo.

Iminyaka engu-3-5 yamava endaweni yokuphepha kwe-IT. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Amakhono nobuqu: ikhono lokufaka amapheshi, i-antivirus, isofthiwe yokulondoloza idatha nezinhlangothi. Ikhono lokuphatha ukubuyiselwa kwezinto ezimeni ezingajwayelekile. Ikhono lokufaka amapheshi, i-antivirus, isofthiwe yokulondoloza idatha nezinhlangothi. Ukuqonda izinqamuleli nezidingo eziphezulu zokuphepha. Ulwazi oluzinzile ngezimiso nezindlela zokuphepha ulwazi. Ikhono elihle lokubhala nokukhuluma. Ukuze ukwazi ukuchaza imibono eyinkimbinkimbi ngendlela elifushane. Amakhono okubonisa, ukuqoqa ulwazi, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlaziya nokuhumusha.

Qinisekisa ukuthi izinsongo ezibalulekile ezitholakele zibhekwa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esivunyelwe. Phatha izinhlela zokuphepha kwe-IT. Zigcine amapheshi ahambisana nezidingo kumaseva nasemashini. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinhlela ze-antivirus zokuhlolwa kanti futhi zibuyekeziwa nsuku zonke ngaphandle kokunalahleko. Bheka impendulo yokutholakala kwezinsongo zokuphepha. Zihlole, zithole, zichaze futhi ziphendule izinsongo zokuphepha kusetshenziswa amathuluzi okuphepha. Gcina ukubheka okuqhubekayo ngemibiko eqoshiwe yokutholakala kokungena engemukelekile. Qinisekisa ukuzigcina kwemithetho ye-ICT kulo lonke umnyango. Phinda ubuke futhi ubuyekeze imithetho ye-IT njalo ngonyaka noma uma kuba khona izinsogo ezintsha. Yenza okuhlola kabili ngonyaka ukuze qinisekise ukuzigcina kwemithetho. Phatha ukuphila kwebhizinisi nokubuyiselwa kwezinto ezimeni ezingajwayelekile. Hlola izinhlela zokubuyiselwa kabili ngonyaka ngemiphumela eqoshiwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukulondoloza idatha yamajele kwenziwa nsuku zonke futhi kuqunywe njalo ngeviki. Ukuqondiswa kwemisebenzi yabantu, izimali kanye nezimpahla. Ukuqondiswa kolwazi ngemikhuba.

Amaxesha amva emyaka kwindawo yokhuseleko leTeknoloji yolwazi. ilayisenisi yomqhubi evumelekileyo. Iimfuno namagunya: Ikhono lokuseka iipayichi, i-antivirus, isoftware yokwenza backup nendlela zokusebenza. Ikhono lokusebenzisaindlela zokubuyisela into yajikelezi kwixa elingenangqondo. Ikhono lokuseka iipayichi, i-antivirus, isoftware yokwenza backup nendlela zokusebenza. Iqonde iindlela zamagqabantshintshi namazinga okukhusela iTeknoloji yolwazi. Ulwazi oluzinikeleyo ngeziqu ezintle zokukhusela ulwazi nendlela zokuziphumeza. Ikhono elilodwa elibaliweyo nokuqhuba. Ikhono lokuvezwa iingcamango ezibucayi. Ikhono ngokubonakalisa, ukutholana nolwazi, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukuhlola nokutolika.
xh.duties: Lawula ingozi nangxaki ezinokubakho. Yenza ikuqhweswa kwangxaki ezinokubakho koko wenze iingxelo ngezenzo zokuzithintela. Qinisekisa ukuba iingozi ezibalulekileyo ezibonwayo zihoywa ngaphakathi kwamaxesha ane aziwa. Lawula inkqubo zokukhusela iTeknoloji yolwazi. Gcina ukuthobela kweepayiki kumaseva nasemacimbini. Qinisekisa ukuba i-antivirus nendlela zokucoca zihlaziywa yonke imihla ngaphandle kokurhoxa. Qaphela impendulo yokubhaqwa kweziganeko zokukhusela. Phawula, bona, thintela kuphendule iziganeko zokukhusela ngokusetyenziswa kwezixhobo zokukhusela. Gcina uqaphelo oluyaqhubeka nge-log zokubhaqwa kwabangenangxolo ezibhaliweyo. Qinisekisa ukuthobela iinkqubo zoLwazi nokuThumela iinkqubo kulo lonke isebe. Phinda uhlaziye iinkqubo zoLwazi nokuThumela iinkqubo ngamnyaka okanye xa kusavela iingozi ezintsha. Yenza ukuyahlola ihlobo ngalinye ukulungiselela ukuvavanywa kokuzelelwa kumazinga okuziphumeza. Lawula ukuqhubela phambili kweshishini nendlela zokubuyisela. Computer literate. Valid driver’s licence. Competencies And Attributes: Employee incentives policy and processes. Knowledge of DPSA incentive policy framework and related circulars. Knowledge of Labour Relations Act. HR mandates regarding employee incentives. Knowledge of organisational structure. Public Service Act and regulations. Collective agreements with regard to employee incentives. Career management strategy. Knowledge of Employment Equity Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Financial policy regarding claims, expenditure, advances, payments, invoices, etc. HR policies related to leave, performance assessment, discipline, grievances, skills development, occupational health and safety, employee wellness, remuneration and allowances, etc. Project management principles. Delegations of authority. The ability to access and interpret required management information. Applied strategic thinking. communication, presentations, developing others (coaching, mentoring, training, supervisory, problem-solving, networking / liaison with stakeholders, negotiation and listening skills. Technical report writing. Analytical thinking policy development, analysis, monitoring, evaluation and implementation.
jobs.duties: Coordinate the implementation of employee incentive programmes. Coordinate the implementation of employee incentive programmes, including performance bonuses, pay progression and long-service recognition awards. Conduct research and policy support on employee incentives. Conduct research and benchmarking on employee incentive practices within the public service and relevant sectors. Monitor compliance and reporting on employee incentives. Monitor compliance with employee incentive policies, directives and applicable legislative frameworks. Management of human resources, finance and assets. Management of performance information.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Werknemer-aanmoedigings
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur: Werknemer-aanmoedigings by die Department of Correctional Services National Head Office, wat werknemer-aanmoedigingsprogramme en beleidsondersteuning koördineer.
af.requirements: Erkende Graad/ Nasionale Diploma in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur of relevante kwalifikasie. 3- 5 jaar se ondervinding in 'n soortgelyke omgewing en 3 jaar moet op toesighoudende vlak wees. Rekenaargeletterd. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede en eienskappe: Werker-aanmoedigingsbeleid en prosesse. Kennis van DPSA-aanmoedigingsbeleidsraamwerk en verwante sirkulaires. Kennis van Arbeidsverhoudingswet. HR-mandate met betrekking tot werknemer-aanmoedigings. Kennis van organisatoriese struktuur. Openbare Dienswet en regulasies. Kollektiewe ooreenkomste met betrekking tot werknemer-aanmoedigings. Loopbaanbestuursstrategie. Kennis van die Wet op Indiensneemgelykheid, Basiese Diensvoorwaardes-wet, Finansiële beleid met betrekking tot eise, uitgawes, voorskotte, betalings, fakture, ens. HR-beleide verwant aan verlof, prestasieevaluering, dissipline, griewe, vaardigheidsontwikkeling, beroepsgesondheid en -veiligheid, werknemer-welsyn, vergoeding en toelaes, ens. Projekbestuursbeginsels. Delegerings van gesag. Die vermoë om vereiste bestuursinligting te bekom en te interpreteer. Toegepaste strategiese denke. Kommunikasie, voorleggings, ontwikkeling van ander (afgerig word, mentorskap, opleiding, toesighoudend, probleemoplossing, netwerking / skakeling met belanghebbendes, onderhandeling en luistervaardighede. Tegniese verslagskrywing. Analitiese denke beleidsontwikkeling, ontleding, monitering, evaluering en implementering.
af.duties: Koördineer die implementering van werknemer-aanmoedigingsprogramme. Koördineer die implementering van werknemer-aanmoedigingsprogramme, insluitend prestasiebonusse, salarisvordering en langdienserkenningstoekennings. Doen navorsing en beleidsondersteuning oor werknemer-aanmoedigings. Doen navorsing en vergelyking oor werknemer-aanmoedigingspraktyke binne die publieke diens en relevante sektore. Monitor nakoming en verslagdoening oor werknemer-aanmoedigings. Monitor nakoming van werknemer-aanmoedigingsbeleide, riglyne en toepaslike wetgewende raamwerke. Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne, finansies en bates. Bestuur van prestasie-inligting.

zu.title: Umcedisi Weqonga: Izinkokhelo Zabasebenzi
zu.summary: Umcedisi Weqonga: Izinkokhelo Zabasebenzi e Department of Correctional Services National Head Office, ukuhlanganisa izinhlelo zezinkokhelo zabasebenzi kanye nokusekela inqubomgomo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezivunyiwe/ I-diploma yezwe ku Human Resource Management noma iziqu ezihambisana nalokho. 3- 5 iminyaka yohlu oluhambisana nalokho futhi iminyaka emi-3 kumele ibe ngizinga lokubeka. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ikhono kanye nezici: Inqubomgomo yezinkokhelo zabasebenzi nezinqubo. Ulwazi lwesisekelo senqubomgomo yezinkokhelo ze-DPSA kanye namagazidi ahambisana nalokho. Ulwazi lwe-Labour Relations Act. Imiyalo ye-HR mayelana nezinkokhelo zabasebenzi. Ulwazi lwenhlakahlisombo yenhlangano. I-Public Service Act kanye nemithetho. Izivumelwano zohlelo mayelana nezinkokhelo zabasebenzi. Isu lokuphatha umsebenzi. Ulwazi lwe-Employment Equity Act, i-Basic Conditions of Employment Act, inqubomgomo yezimali mayelana nezinsolo, izimali ezichithwayo, izimali ezibekwe eceleni, izinkokhelo, ama-invoisi, njll. Izinqubomgomo ze-HR ezihlobene nelungu lokuphumula, ukuhlola ukusebenza, isiyaluyalu, izikhalazo, intuthuko yamakhono, impilo kanye nokuphepha komsebenzi, impilo yomsebenzi, izinkokhelo kanye nezibonezelo, njll. Izimiso zokuphatha amaphrojekthi. Abasebenzi abathunyelwe amandla. Ikhono lokufinyelela futhi kuhumushe ulwazi lolawulo oludingekayo. Ukucabanga ngokuhlakaniphile ngesu. Ukuxhumana, izinkombiso, ukuthuthukisa abanye (ukwelula, ukukhuthaza, ukufundisa, ukubeka, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuxhumanisa / ukuba nodlwana nabahlomula, ukuxoxisana kanye namakhono okulalela. Ukubhala okusesimweni somtholampilo. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubomgomo, ukuhlaziya, ukubheka, ukulinganisa nokusebenzisa.
zu.duties: Hlanganisa ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zezinkokhelo zabasebenzi. Hlanganisa ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zezinkokhelo zabasebenzi, okuhlanganisa izinkokhelo zokusebenza kahle, inqubo yokhoho kanye neziwombe zokubonga inkonzo ende. Yenza ucwaningo kanye nokusekela inqubomgomo mayelana nezinkokhelo zabasebenzi. Yenza ucwaningo kanye nokuqonda izinqubo zezinkokhelo zabasebenzi ngaphakathi kwesevisi yomphakathi kanye nabalawuli abahambisanayo. Bheka ukulandela izinqubo kanye nokubika mayelana nezinkokhelo zabasebenzi. Bheka ukulandelwa kwezinqubomgomo zezinkokhelo zabasebenzi, imiyalo kanye nezisekelo zomthetho ezifanele. Ukuphatha abantu abasebenzayo, izimali kanye nezimpahla. Ukuphatha ulwazi lokuqonda ukusebenza.

xh.title: Isikhulu esiNcedisayo: Iindlela zokuKhuthaza basebenzi
xh.summary: Isikhulu esiNcedisayo: Iindlela zokuKhuthaza basebenzi kwisebe leZiczekelwa zeQhalaza iNtaba yaseBurhulumente eNasweni, elihlangenwe ndlinyo kwiinkqubo zokuKhuthaza basebenzi nenkxaso yomthethosiseko.
xh.requirements: Qatshelwa iDegree/ iDiploma yaseLizwe kwiQhinga leCandelo labaBantu ngesiFundo esichanekileyo okanye isiqinisekiso esifanelekileyo. 3- 5 iminyaka yamava kwimeko efanayo nento yokuba 3 iminyaka kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba lobalulekile. Ukusebenzisa iNkqubo yeKhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokuQhuba esemthethweni. Ikhono nezihloko: iMithetho yokuKhuthaza basebenzi neenkqubo zazo. ULwazi ngeNkqubo yokuKhuthaza basebenzi ngoDPSA nezazimveli ezinxulumene nayo. ULwazi lweMithetho yeBakala imiThetho. Iimfuno zeQhinga labaBantu ngokubakho kweindlela zokuKhuthaza basebenzi. ULwazi lweNkqubo yokuHlela iNtlaka. UMthetho weQhalaza kaRhulumente neMithetho eYilwayo. Isivumelwano esiNgqinelanayo malunga nokuKhuthaza basebenzi. Ukuqwalasela kokuqonda iMisebenzi nokuKhethwa kwaBantu. ULwazi lweMithetho yeQhinga ngeNdalo eQhathaniswa, iMigaqo eQhinga ngokusebenza, ukubakho kwemali yokuQinisekisa, iQhinga nokuSebenza ngeQhinga, ukusebenza, iQhinga ngokubonelela ngokwemali kwiNkqubo, naziphi na iNkqubo eQhinga ngokubonelela ngokwemali kwiinkqubo ezifana neLwazi lweMithetho yeNtlaka nokuHamba, iQhinga ngokuhoya imigaqo yokuQonda nokusebenza, ukubakho kwemali yokuQinisekisa, iQhinga nokuSebenza ngeQhinga, ukusebenza, iQhinga ngokubonelela ngokwemali kwiinkqubo ezifana nalezi. Iinkqubo zoLawulo lweNkqubo. Ukunikela igunya. IKhono lokufikelela kwaye utolike ulwazi oluLawulwayo oluFunekayo. Ukuzama okuQhinga ngokucwangciswa. iNtetho, iBizwana, iNkcubeko yaBanye (iQhinga lokubonelela ngenkxaso, iQhinga lokulunga iNtsea, iQhinga lokuQhingisa, iQhinga lokubeka iNtlaka, ukuxazulula iNkinga, iQhinga lokusebenzisana / nokuchumanisa nabantu abaNxulumene nayo, iQhinga lokuNxibelelwano nokuzama iNtetho. UkuBhala iNkqubo ngokobuChwepheshe. Ukuzama okuQhinga ngokuQwalasela nokusemthethweni, ukuhlalwa, iNkqubo yokuQwalasela nokwamkela nokusebenza.
xh.duties: Lungelelanisa ukusebenza kweenkqubo zokuKhuthaza basebenzi. Lungelelanisa ukusebenza kweenkqubo zokuKhuthaza basebenzi, kuquka iPhawu lokusebenza kakuhle, inqanaba lokuhamba kwemali nokubakho kweephrayizi zokuQonda ukukhonza ixesha elide. Yenza uphononongo nenkxaso yomthethosiseko kwindlela zokuKhuthaza basebenzi. Yenza uphononongo nokuqwalasela iindlela zokuKhuthaza basebenzi ngaphakathi kweqhalaza karhulumente nakumacandelo anhlobene nayo. Qwalasela ukulandela umthetho nokubika ngeindlela zokuKhuthaza basebenzi. Qwalasela ukulandelwa kwemithetho yindlela zokuKhuthaza basebenzi, iimiyalelo neenkqubo ezisemthethweni ezifanelekileyo. Ulawulo labantu, lwemali nolweempahla. Ulawulo lolwazi ngokusebenza.

Amandla nokubaluleka: Ulwazi ngezinqubomgomo ze-HR Corporate, inqubo yezikhalazo, izinqubomgomo zobudlelwano babasebenzi, ikhodi nesinqubo yokuqondiswa. I-Labour Relations Act ngokugqamisa kwemikhuba yokuxazulula izinxaxhi. I-Basic Conditions of Employment Act. Imithetho yamahhovisi okuxazulula izinxaxhi – i-CCMA ne-GPSSBC. Imithetho ephathelene nemikhuba yokungena emthethweni nokuvezwa kwezinxaxhi. Umthethosisekelo we-RSA mayelana namalungelo abasebenzi. Izindlela zokuphenya, ukuxhumana, ukuqoqa ulwazi, ukuhlaziya, ukuhumusha, ukusabalalisa, ukumisa inkinga phakathi kwabahlangothi, ukuphatha nokuxazulula izinkinga, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukulalela, ukucabanga ngezinhlangothi ezahlukene nokunikeza izeluleko. Ukusebenzisa izindlela zokuphenya. Ukwenza lula / ukumisa inkinga phakathi kwabahlangothi. I-Labour Relations Act ngokugqamisa kwekhodi yokuziphila okuhle mayelana nokukhishwa emsebenzini. Umthetho kanye nemithesho ye-Public Service. Ulwazi ngekhodi nesinqubo yokuqondiswa ye-Public Service.
zu.duties: Ukuhlanganisa nokugcina iliso ekuphathweni kokuqondiswa kwabasebenzi. Nikela izeluleko namacebo ohlelweni kubaphathi mayelana nezindaba zokuqondiswa, izinqubomgomo kanye nezinqubo. Nikeza inkuseleko yokuxazulula izinxaxhi eziphathelene nobudlelwano bokuqashwa. Nikela izeluleko nenkuseleko kubaphathi mayelana nokuphathwa kwezikhalazo, ukuxazulula izinxaxhi, ukungena emthethweni kanye nezinqubo zokuvezwa kwezinxaxhi. Gcina iliso futhi hlaziya ukuzinza kwezinqubomgomo zokuqondiswa kwabasebenzi, izinqubo nemithesho emigunyazwe. Gcina futhi uvuse i-Employee Relations Management Information Systems (ERMIS) kanye namabhuloho wezimininingwane ahlobene nawo.

Iindlela zokuphanda, unxibelelwano, ukuqokelela ulwazi, ukuhlalutya, ukucazulula, ukusasaza, ukuzululana, uLawulo nosombululo lweengxabano, ukuSombulula iingxaki, ukuPhatha ngokuziva, ukuCacisa oko kukho ngokwengqondo nokuphakamisa iingcebiso. Ukusebenzisa iindlela zokuphanda. Ukulawula / ukuzululana iingxabano. uMthetho woBudlelwane ngokweMisebenzi ogqithisa kwindlela ezilungileyo zokugqiba ngokushukumisa abasebenzi. uMthetho woQoqosho lweliLunge kwaye neemithetho yalo. Ulwazi ngeKhowudi yoQoqosho lweliLunge ngokwesonqobo senyathelo.

Uku Nikeza iingcebiso kunye nenkxaso kubaphathi ngokuphatha iingxelo zabasebenzi, ukusombulula iingxabano, ukuzululana nokuQamba iinkundla. zu.title: Usizo Lomqondisi: Workstudy kanye Nokulinganisa Amsebenzi
zu.summary: Kudingeka Usizo Lomqondisi e-National Head Office ukuze kwenziwe ucwaningo lwe-work-study, ukulawula incazelo yemisebenzi, ukulinganisa imisebenzi kanye nokwakha izakhiwo zenhlangano.

Ubecede minyaka yonke oqeqeshwe kuyo lomsebenzi. 3-5 iminyaka yokuhamba phambili kule minyaka yonke uqeqeshwe kuyo. 3-5 okuhlangenwe nakho endaweni efanayo. Ulwazi ngamatekniki we-Work Study. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ikhono Nomthelela: Abantu balawula, ukuyethula, ukubhala umbiko, ukulawula izimali, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo ezinengqondo, ukucubungula nokuhlela, ukulawula, kanye namakhono okuphatha isikhathi. Ulwazi ngosimiso wokuhlola umholo. Ukuhlaziya nokuhumusha umgomo, ukuxhumana okuhle, amakhono ahlaziyo kanye nemibono. Ukuhlaziya umsebenzi. Iminikelo yeqembu. Ukuphatha ukwehlukana, ukuhlanganisa, ukuphatha iphrojekthi kanye namakhono okuholo. Ukuthuthukisa ukulethwa kwesevisi. Ukushintsha kanye nokuphatha ulwazi. Ukucubungula nokuhlela, ubudlelwano obuhle obuvelana nabantu, ukuba nobudala, ukuba ngumuntu oprofessional, ukuqinisekisa ukungalunyazwa, ukuba nomthelela nokuwumtha, ukugcina imfihlo kanye nokuba nokuzethemba. Ikono lokuxhumanana. Ukuzimele nokubambisana. Ukusebenza ngokuqinisekile eqenjini nokuguquguquka. Ukuthanda ukusebenza ezimeni ezingashintshi/ezinzima/isikhathi eside.
zu.duties: Yenza ucwaningo lwe-work-study kanye nezifundo zokuzululeka ezithinta ukuthuthukiswa kokulethwa kwesevisi. Lawula ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokuhlola ukuhlanganiswa kwencazelo yemisebenzi kanye ne-Job profiling. Yenza ukulinganisa umsebenzi. Yakha futhi ubuyekeze isakhiwo senhlangano. Yakha futhi ulawule ukuqamaniswa kokuqashwa kwabasebenzi nesakhiwo senhlangano esigunyaziwe. Lawula izinqubo zokushintsha izinto. Ukuphatha ulwazi ngemikhuba, abantu abayiphethe, izimali kanye nezimpahla.

Ulawulo lweentlalo ngokwahlukana kwabantu, uqhubelekano, ulawulo lweenkqubo kunye nekhono lokuba ngumgqatswa. Inkonzo yokuleka izinto ezintsha. Ulawulo lotshintsho nolwazi. Ukwazimele kwaye uhleze. Ukuba ngumdlali wetim kwaye uguquguquke. Ukulungele ukusebenza phantsi kweemo eziguqukayo / ezinzima / iiveki ezide.

Yaza uqhube ukumiselwa kweenkqubo zolwakhiwo ngolwakhiwo loluntu oluvunyiweyo. Qhube iinkqubo zolawulo lotshintsho. Ulawulo lwemaxhama ezimali, okwemisebenzi, ezemali kunye nezinto.

Kennis van Openbare Dienswetgewing, beleide en voorskrifte, insluitend die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Public Service Act, en departementele beleide. Beplanning en organisering. Verslagdoeningsprosedures. Administrasieprosedures wat verband hou met die spesifieke werksomgewing, insluitend norme en standaarde. Interpersoonlike verhoudings. Probleemoplossing. Projekbestuur. Monitor en evalueer landbou-bedrywighede en produksieprestasie oor korrektiewe sentrums teen goedgekeurde teikens. Koördineer landbouverproduksieprogramme wat gemik is op die bevordering van selfvoorsiening en oortrederrehabilitasie. Vestig en onderhou effektiewe verhoudings met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes. Bestuur van prestasie-inligting, menslike hulpbronne, finansies en bates.

zu.title: Assistant Director: Agriculture Operations
zu.summary: Assistant Director: Agriculture Operations at Department of Correctional Services National Head Office, ukunika izeluleko zezolimo kwaye uhlanganise izinhlelo zokukhiqiza kuzo zonke izikhungo zokulungisa.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ezivunyelwe zeziminyaka yonke (NQF Level 7) kwezolimo, ukuphathwa kwezolimo, ukunweba kwezolimo, isayensi yezilwane, ukukhiqiza izitshalo, izuluma noma inkambu ehlobene nezolimo. Okungenani iminyaka emithathu (3) yenhlangano ephathelene nezolimo. Ulwazi ngendlela zokunweba izolimo kanye nezinkonzo zokulekelela. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evunyiwe. Ikhono nezici: Ulwazi ngokuhlela kwaye kuphathwe imikhankaso. Ulwazi ngamasistimu okukhiqiza izolimo, ukuphathwa kwezinsiza, namasiko ezolimo ahlala njalo. Ulwazi ngokuthuthukiswa, ukuqaliswa, ukuqapha kwaye kuhlolwe izinqubomgomo. Ulwazi ngomthetho, izinqubomgomo kanye nemiyalo yesevisi kahulumeni, okuhlanganisa i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), i-Public Service Act, nezinqubomgomo zomnyango. Ukubamba uhlelo kwezinhlelo. Izindlela zokubika. Izindlela zokuphatha ezihlobene nokusebenza endaweni ethize okuhlanganisa amagugu kanye namazinga. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo. Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ukushintshana kolwazi ngokukhuluma. Ukubhaliwe ukuxhumana okuyimibhalo, amamu, amagama, kanye nemibiko. Amakhono okulawula nokuphatha, okuthuthukile ukuxhumana nokubonisa.
zu.duties: Nika izeluleko ezenzululwazi nezobuchwepheshe mayelana nezolimo ukuze useke izinhlelo nezinhlelo zomsebenzi zezolimo zomnyango. Qaphesisi futhi hlola imisebenzi yezolimo nemikhuba yokukhiqiza kuzo zonke izikhungo zokulungisa ngokumelene nemiqesho evunyiwe. Hlanganisa izinhlelo zokukhiqiza izolimo eziqondiswe ekukhuthazeni ukuzinela nokulungisa abaphuli umthetho. Saka futhi gcina ubudlelwano obusebenzayo nababaningi abangaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukuphathwa kolwazi ngemikhuba, abantu abasebenzayo, imali kanye nempahla.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Izembozo Zolimo
xh.summary: Isekela Mongameli: Izembozo Zolimo kwindawo ekuqwalaselwa kwayo iNational Head Office kwisebe leCorrectional Services, inika izindulo ngolimo kwaye ihlele iinkqubo zokuvelisa kuzo zonke iindawo zolungelelwaniso.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezifanelekileyo ezivunyiweyo ze-myaka yamine (NQF Level 7) kwiAgriculture, iAgricultural Management, iAgricultural Extension, iAnimal Science, iCrop Production, iAgronomy okanye indawo ehlotshaniswa nolimo. Aminyaka amathathu (3) obungakanani bobuchule obuhambelanayo kwindawo yolimo. Ulwazi ngendlela zokwazisa kolimo nesebezela lwegceke. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ubuchule nofuziselo: Ulwazi ngokuqwalasela noplaanolwemisebenzi. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zokuvelisa kolimo, ulawulo lwamathuba, nendlela zokulima ezingcolisekiyo. Ulwazi ngokusika iinkqubo, ukuvelisa, ukuqwalasela nokuhlolwa. Ulwazi ngomthetho nemiqathango, namacebo oLuntu olwaseburhulumenteni, aquka iPublic Finance Management Act (PFMA), uMthetho weNkonzo kaLuntu, namacebo esebe. Ukuqwalasela nhlobo. Iinkqubo zokubika. Iinkqubo zolawulo ezihambelana nomsebenzi ochaziweyo kuquka iimfuno namagunya. Ukuba siseko nabantu. Ukusombulula iingxaki. Ukuplaanolwemisebenzi. Ulawulo lwemali. Ukucinga ngokwalamulo. Ulwazi olutshulwa ngomlomo. Ukubhala ngezithuba, iimemo, iileta namabali. Abasebenzi ngokulawula, ukuncoma ngokuchanekileyo nokuqhathanisa.
xh.duties: Nika izindulo ezibuchule nangobuchwepheshe kolimo ukuxhasa iinkqubo namaphupha olimo kwisebe. Qwalasela ukuhlela inkqubo yolimo kwaye uhlole ukusebenza kolimo nakuzo zonke iindawo zolungelelwaniso ukubhekisa kwiziphumo ezivunyiweyo. Hlela iinkqubo zokuvelisa kolimo ezijoliswe ekukhuthazeni ukuzinza nokulungelelwanisa abasetyholi. Misela uluthando lokusebenza nabantu abangaphakathi nabangaphandle. Ulawulo lolwazi ngokusebenza, abantu, imali namathuba.

Competencies And Attributes: Project management. Analytical and innovative skills. Knowledge of Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) Standards. Knowledge of applicable legislations, policies and regulations. Knowledge of Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Report writing, communication and interviewing skills. Interpersonal leadership and problem- solving skills. Time management. Coaching and mentoring. Knowledge of financial management, internal audit policies, practices, procedures and standards for professional practice of internal audit. Knowledge of internal control models and risk management tools and methodologies.

Participate in the development of the three-year strategic risk-based audit plans. Participate in the development of the annual audit operational plan. Participate in the coordination with other internal and external service providers of assurance to ensure proper coverage to minimize duplication of effort. Develop proposals to determine the scope of allocated internal audits. Collect, analyze and interpret data for purposes of the development of the engagement work program. Develop the engagement work program. Supervise and execute the allocated internal audits. Develop findings and recommendations for the enhancement of controls/processes. Compile and review audit reports for each engagement. Monitor progress on the implementation of agreed upon action plans. Review, collect information and compile reports to the accounting officer and audit committee. Progress reports against audit plan. Quarterly reports and annual reports. Study professional journals and publications to ensure that cognizance is taken of new developments. Monitor and study the relevant industry, legislative, standards change and policy frameworks continuously. Engage in continuous professional development activities relevant (tools and techniques) as required/prescribed. Supervise employees to ensure an effective internal audit service. Management of performance information, human resources, finance and assets.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Inligtingstegnologie-oudit
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur vir IT-oudit by die Department of Correctional Services se nasionale hoofkantoor, wat 'n relevante diploma of graad in interne oudit en 3-5 jaar ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Relevante Nasionale Diploma/ Graad in Interne Oudit of verwante veld. 3-5 jaar se ervaring in Interne Oudit of verwante veld. Rekenaargeletterd. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede en eienskappe: Projekbestuur. Analitiese en innoverende vaardighede. Kennis van Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) se standaarde. Kennis van toepaslike wetgewing, beleid en regulasies. Kennis van Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Verslagskrywing, kommunikasie en onderhoudingsvaardighede. Interpersoonlike leierskap- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Tydsbestuur. Afrigting en mentorskap. Kennis van finansiële bestuur, interne ouditbeleid, praktyke, prosedures en standaarde vir professionele beoefening van interne oudit. Kennis van interne beheermodelle en risikobestuursinstrumente en -metodologieë.
af.duties: Identifiseer die sleutelrisikogebiede vir die instelling wat voortspruit uit huidige bedrywighede soos uiteengesit in die strategiese plan en risikobestuidsstrategie. Neem deel aan die ontwikkeling van die driejarige strategiese risikogebaseerde ouditplanne. Neem deel aan die ontwikkeling van die jaarlikse ouditbedryfsplan. Neem deel aan die koördinering met ander interne en eksterne diensverskaffers van versekering om behoorlike dekking te verseker en duplisering van werk te minimaliseer. Ontwikkel voorstelle om die omvang van toegewysde interne ouditte te bepaal. Versamel, ontleed en interpreteer data vir die ontwikkeling van die betrokkenheidswerkprogram. Ontwikkel die betrokkenheidswerkprogram. Hou toesig oor en voer die toegewysde interne ouditte uit. Ontwikkel bevindinge en aanbevelings vir die verbetering van beheer/prosesse. Stel ouditverslae vir elke betrokkenheid op en hersien dit. Monitor vordering rakende die implementering van ooreengekome aksieplanne. Hersien, versamel inligting en stel verslae aan die rekeningkundige beampte en ouditkomitee op. Vorderingsverslae teenoor ouditplan. Kwartaalverslae en jaarverslae. Bestudeer professionele joernale en publikasies om te verseker dat kennis geneem word van nuwe ontwikkelinge. Monitor en bestudeer die relevante bedryf, wetgewing, standaardveranderinge en beleidsraamwerke deurlopend. Neem deel aan deurlopende professionele ontwikkelingsaktiwiteite wat relevant is (instrumente en tegnieke) soos vereis/voorgeskryf. Hou toesig oor werknemers om 'n effektiewe interne ouditdiens te verseker. Bestuur van prestasie-inligting, menslike hulpbronne, finansies en bates.

Ulwazi Ngeemfanelo ZokuPhatha Ngaphakathi Namathuluzi OkuPhatha Ubungozi.
zu.duties: UkuHlola Amane Wobungozi Obalulekile eNhlokweni Iphuma Kwezinye Izinkulumo Njengoba Kugcine emHlola Wehlelo Nohlelo Lokuphatha Ubungozi. UkuHlanganyela EkuPhatheleleni Iminyaka-(3) Uhlelo Wehlelo LokuHlola NgokuQinisekwa. UkuHlanganyela EkuPhatheleleni Uhlelo Lwamnyaka LokuHlola. UkuHlanganyela EkuHlanganiseni Nabanye Abaphathi Bengaphakathi Nabaphashi Bendlela Yokwenza Izinto Ngaphakathi Ukwenza Ukuthi Zibe Iqiniso Lokuvikelwa Ngaphakathi Nokuhlanzwa. Ukulungiselela Ukubala Isigaba Sokuhlolwa Ngokugcizelela. Ukugcina Ulwazi Futhi Uyihumushe Ukuyiqonde Ngokuthi Izinto Zibe Nomphumela Ohlelelekile Wehlelo Losuku. Ukusebenzisa Uhlelo Losuku Ekuphatheni Imisebenzi Eholekayo. Ukulola Imisebenzi Eholekayo. Ukulungiselela Iziphakamiso Nezinkomba Ezintsha Zokwenza Izinto Zibe Nomphumela Ohlelelekile. Ukubhala Futhi Uqaple Izinkomba EzoQoqo Ngakunye Uhlelo Losuku. Uqaphele Ukuthi Zonke Izinto Zibe Nomphumela Ohlelelekile Ekucubunguleni Amaphoyinti. Ukulola Uhlelo Lokubona Izinhlelo Ezintsha Ezisetshenziswayo Ezintsha Ezisebenzayo. Ukuba NoQoqo Lwamathuluzi Ezintsha Ezisetshenziswayo Ezintsha. xh.title: Umncedisi Wecejana: Ukuqonda Itekhnoloji Yolwazi
xh.summary: Umncedisi wecejana wokuqonda i-IT kwisiwulo sehloko leSebe leenkonzo zokuLungisa ekuZinzeleleni kwaseNasipho, lifuna izidanga okanye idiploma efanelekileyo kwilwazi loqondo lokungaphakathi kwaye lifuna iminyaka emi-3-5 yenqeqesho.
xh.requirements: Idiploma yesizwe izidanga kwilwazi loqondo lokungaphakathi okhule olindeleyo. Iminyaka emi-3-5 yenqeqesho kwilwazi loqondo lokungaphakathi okhule olindeleyo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebezayo. Ukuzinza kwaye kuqondwe kakuhle: Ulawulo lweprojekthi. Ikhono lokuhlola nokwakha izinto ezintsha. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yaseNyuvesi yabaQondi beNgcini yaseNgaphakathi (IIA). Ulwazi ngemithetho, iinkqubo namagunya asetyenziswayo. Ulwazi ngoMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente (PFMA). Ikhono lokubhala iingxelo, noku thetha nabanye, nokubuziswa. Ikhono lokulawula abantu nokusombulula iingxaki. Ulawulo lwexesha. Ukuqeqesha nokukhokela. Ulwazi ngolawulo lweemali, iinkqubo zolwazi loqondo lokungaphakathi, iinkqubo, iinkqubo zemigaqo yemisebenzi yelwazi loqondo lokungaphakathi. Ulwazi ngokuzinza kolawulo lokungaphakathi nezixhobo zolawulo lochingo.
xh.duties: Qonda iindawo ezibalulekileyo zolingo kule ndalo ziveliswe kumashishini aqhubekayo njengoko kuchazwe kwicwangciso lokuqhuba phambili nencwangciso yolawulo lwelingo. Thatha inxaxheba kwandulo lwencwangciso yamnyaka amathathu yolwazi loqondo lokuxhomeleke kulingo. Thatha inxaxheba ekwakheni incwangciso yokusebenza ngamnyaka yokuqonda. Thatha inxaxheba ekwenzweni kwenkqubo nakubasebenzi abavela ngaphakathi nangaphandle ukugcina ukhuseleko lwezfundo ukunciphisa ukuphindaphinda komsebenzi. Yakha iingcamu ukuze qonda isigaba sokulingwa ngaphakathi. Qokeleza, hlola ukuze alandelele ukwaziswa ngenjongo yokwakha inkqubo yomsebenzi wokubandakanyeka. Yakha inkqubo yomsebenzi wokubandakanyeka. Lawula yaye uphumeze ukulingwa ngaphakathi olindeleyo. Yakha iingxelo neengcebiso ukuze kukhuliswe amandla okulawula/iinkqubo. Qamba yaye uhlole iingxelo zokuqonda kumsebenzi ngamnye. Qwalasela inkqubo ekusebenzeni kweendululawulo ezivunywe ngamanyathelo. Qwalasela, qokeleza ulwaze uqamathe iingxelo kumsebenzi ophatha iimali nomenze wokuqonda. Ingxelo yokhula ngokuchasene nencwangciso yokuqonda. Iingxelo zexeshana nezingxelo zamnyaka. Funde iindaba ezithile nezindaba zefuthe ukuze ukhuseleko kuqatshwe kumashishino amatsha. Qwalasela yaye ufunde inkampani, imithetho, iinkqubo ezitshintsha, amandla emigaqo ngokungqubana. Zenzele ngokusela nokwenza iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezifanelekileyo (iinxhono nezindlela) njengoko kufuneka/kuqulunqwe. Lawula basebenzi ukugcina ukusebenza okusebenzayo kokulinga. Ulawulo lweemvuzo, abantu, iimali, izinto.

zu.requirements: National Diploma (Nqf Level 6) noma uQikwadi kwalwini eStrategic Management / Monitoring and Evaluation / Accounting and or Auditing / Public Administration/ Business Management noma isimemozulu esihlobene. 3-5 iminyaka yokusebenza endaweni yokuhlela. Ukulalela komphathi. Vidiyo yomshayeli etholakalayo. Isiqu nokunemvula: Ukuqonda izinqubo zohlelo lokuhlela kanye nomjikelezo kahulumeni wokuhlela. Ukuzwela kokuhlela kwendlela ebuhalweni. Ukubhala imibiko kanye nokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi. Isipili-chi esihle kokusingatha kanye nokuxoxwa kwamazwi. Ukwaziswa kwe excel ne PowerPoint okuyisibonakudeyo. Ukwaziswa kwemigango, izindlu kanye nemithetho kahulumeni. Ukuqonda ukugadwa kanye nokuqashelwa kahulumeni. Ukuphathwa kwemali. Ukuhloniphana okuhle kwabantu abangenwezinywe. Indlela esukela kulawulo oluhle. Ulwazi lokuhlaziya, ukuhlela, ukubumba kanye nokuqeqa izinkinga.
zu.duties: Hlela umsebenzi wokwakhiwa nokubukeka kabusha kwendlela yokulinganiswa yokubambana kwesikhathi eside, indlela yokulinganiswa kweminyaka yomsebenzi (APP), kanye nezinhlelo zabasebenzi zaminyaka yonke. Qapha ukuphumelela imigidingo yokulelelelwa komnyango kanye namapulani avunyelwe. Nikela inceku yokuhlela isikhundla kanye nokuqashelwa okusekelwa kwikhomkhamba lezikhulu nakumazinga. Thinta futhi ulondoloze ubudlelwano obuhle nabathintekayo ngaphakathi nangaphandle ngemikhuba yendlela yokulinganiswa. Kulawulwa ulwazi ngemisebenzi, abasebenzi, imali kanye nemali evunyelwe..

xh.title: UMqeqeshi weNkqubo: iNkqubo yoKuqondisa neNdlela zoLawulo
xh.summary: Qondanisa ukuyila okusemandla, amaCandu oMsebenzi oQobo kaWonaka kwaye nemisebenzi esebe limeleyo yeSebe leLungisa eNtshutshweni kwiNkundla eNkulu.
xh.requirements: Idiploma kazwelonke (NQF Level 6) okanye idigri ekuQondiseni okanye iphumelelo kwicala lemakethwe okuhlola okanye kuphando ngokusemthethweni ngokulawulwa kokuhamba kwemigqaliselo yomsebenzisi. Amava onyaka engama-3-5 njengoko kubalwa kwiinkalo azikuko. Isifundo sabantu bakwakhono ekhompyutha nokuthobela iindawo ezahlukeneyo zoluntu. Isakhono seNkosiyo egqwesileyo sokusebenzisa isixhobo semiyalezo nokubeka ngokulandelelana kweendaba. Ukuyiva nokubhala iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezisezantsi kakhulu kubakho isikokobhe esikwiphalantshi yekhaya ekhelwe iindlela zokwakha izinto. Ukuyilo-nkcubeko ngendlela ekhethe ekufundweni kwezimali nokulinganiselwa kwemisebenzi ngokuhamba kwexesha njengesikhokelo singangenwa nakuqwalasela kakhulu kwimimiselo yelali. Isikokobhe ekhona kwimiqathango yalawulo nakwiziko apho kuhamba izinto zimali nakakhona ekusekelwa ngokusemthethweni ngoluhlu lweziyavuya njengesixhobo sokulinganiselwa kwexesha elidlulileyo, ekubeni yindida ekuvaleni ngesandla eside kwelinye. Uhlakaniphi, iinkqubo zokubeka kunye neendlela zokulawula nokuzonakaliswa kwezinto ezingalunganga. Ukungcweliswa kwamava ngokusetyenzwa kwemisebenzi ekuqondweni kokuhamba kwexesha elingakumbi.
xh.duties: Qondanisa ukuphuhliswa nokuhlola iNkqundo yeNtshutshiso yeSebe, iCandu loMsebenzi Wonyaka (APP), namaCandu okuSebenza ngonyaka. Lundluza ukusebenziswa kwamasundu eplani yesebe namaplanu avunyweyo. Nikezelwa ngamacebo okuqondisa iplani kunye nenccedo emboniselweyo kwiNkundla eNkulu nakummandla. Qhagamshelana kwaye ugcine ubudlelwane obusebenzayo nabashukumisi abangaphakathi nabangaphandle kumabango okuyila. ulawulo lolwazi ngemisebenzi, abantu abaqeshwayo, iimali nezinto ezahlukeneyo.

jobs.title: Senior Correctional Administration Officer: Placement
jobs.summary: Senior Correctional Administration Officer at National Head Office responsible for developing and monitoring parole and correctional supervision policy, requiring a relevant degree and five years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Relevant Degree/National Diploma (NQF level 6) in Behavioural Sciences. At least 5 years relevant experience in a production post (NCB1). Successful completion of Corrections Science Learnership/Basic Training. Computer literacy. Valid driver’s licence. Competencies And Attributes: Conflict resolution. Report writing. Presentation skills. Problem solving. Team leadership. Facilitation skills. Analytical skills. Policy interpretation. Assertiveness. Plan and organize. Client orientation. Good communication skills. Integrity and honesty. Confidentiality. Interpersonal relations. Ability to work under pressure. Applied strategic thinking and willingness to travel. Service delivery. Client orientation. Confident and independent.
jobs.duties: Provide support regarding the development and maintenance of policy on day parole, parole, correctional supervision, release on medical grounds and correctional supervision. Assist with the monitoring and implementation of policy. Establish monitoring mechanism. Evaluate execution of policy. Assist with the updating of departmental orders. Revise orders, consult, and update. Document control. Maintenance of the documentation of the Sub-Directorate. Keep record of the issuing and return of documents. Management of human resources, finances and assets.
jobs.enquiries: National Head Office: Ms NS Khumalo Tel No: (012) 307 2174 or Ms TP Ngobeni Tel No: (012) 305 8589.
jobs.applications: should be submitted online at https://careers.dcs.gov.za/. Emailed, post or hand delivered applications will not be considered.
jobs.notes: Appointment under the Correctional Service Act. Before you apply: All costs associated with an application will be borne by the applicant. Applicants who have retired from the Public Service with a specific determination that they cannot be re-appointed or have been declared medically unfit will not be considered. Please take note that correspondence will only be conducted with the shortlisted candidates. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application is unsuccessful. Please do not call the department to enquire about the progress of your application. Applicants must note that further checks will be conducted once they are shortlisted and that their appointment is subject to positive outcomes on these checks, which include security clearance, security vetting, qualification verification and criminal records verification. Appointment will be provisional, pending the issue of a security clearance. If you cannot get a security clearance, your appointment will be re-considered/possibly terminated. Fingerprints may be taken on the day of the interview. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One shall be a practical exercise, and the other shall be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applications: Applications must be submitted on the Z83 form (Public Service application form) obtainable from any Public Service department and must be completed in full. Only a detailed CV should be attached to your application form. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies not older than 6 months of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview. Please send a complete application for the post you apply for on a pdf format, stating the correct reference for the position you are interested in. Requirement for valid driver’s licence is not applicable to applicants with a disability. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Senior Korrektiewe Administrasiebeampte: Plasing
af.summary: Senior Korrektiewe Administrasiebeampte by Nasionale Hoofkantoor verantwoordelik vir die ontwikkeling en monitering van voorwaardelike vrylating en korrektiewe toesigbeleid, wat 'n tersaaklike graad en vyf jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Relevante Graad/Nasionale Diploma (NQF level 6) in Gedragswetenskappe. Ten minste 5 jaar se relevante ervaring in 'n produksiepos (NCB1). Suksesvolle voltooiing van Corrections Science Learnership/Basic Training. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede en eienskappe: Konflikoplossing. Verslagskrywing. Aanbiedingsvaardighede. Probleemoplossing. Spanleierskap. Fasiliteringsvaardighede. Analitiese vaardighede. Beleidinterpretasie. Selfassertiwiteit. Beplan en organiseer. Kliëntgerigtheid. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Integriteit en eerlikheid. Konfidensialiteit. Interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Toegepaste strategiese denke en bereidwilligheid om te reis. Dienslewering. Kliëntgerigtheid. Selfversekerd en onafhanklik.
af.duties: Verskaf ondersteuning rakende die ontwikkeling en instandhouding van beleid oor dagparool, parool, korrektiewe toesig, vrylating op mediese gronde en korrektiewe toesig. Bystand verleen met die monitering en implementering van beleid. Stel moniteringsmeganisme in werking. Evalueer uitvoering van beleid. Bystand verleen met die bywerking van departementele bevele. Hersien bevele, raadpleeg en werk by. Dokumentbeheer. Instandhouding van die dokumentasie van die Sub-Direktoraat. Hou rekord van die uitreiking en terugbesorging van dokumente. Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne, finansies en bates.

Ukubhala imibiko. Amakhono okubonisa. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuhola iqembu. Amakhono okukhuthaza. Amakhono okuhlakanya. Ukuhumusha imithetho. Ukuzimisela. Ukucubungula futhi uhlele. af.title: Senior Administrasiebeampte: Koördineerder
af.summary: Senior Administrasiebeampte: Koördineerder by die Department of Correctional Services National Head Office, wat 'n graad of diploma in administrasie met 3-5 jaar relevante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Erkende drie (3) jaar Graad/Nasionale Diploma in Kantooradministrasie, Openbare Administrasie of relevante kwalifikasie. 3-5 jaar relevante ervaring in kantooradministrasie. Rekenaarvaardig. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede en eienskappe: Fasilitering en koördinering. Goeie skakelvaardighede met ander rolspelers/klante. Goeie kommunikasie-, beplannings- en organisasie-, verslagskrywing-, analitiese, rasionele besluitneming- en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Professionaliteit en integriteit. Administreer verlofregister en ander administratiewe aktiwiteite. Onderhoud van diens- en verlofregister. Nagaan en voorlê van verlofaansoeke. Reël en koördineer vergaderings. Administreer en konsolideer die toewysing van fondse. Bystand verleen aan die bestuur van staatsfondse onder toesig. Skatting en begroting van behoeftes binne die direktoraat. Bestuur van prestasie-inligting, menslike hulpbronne, finansies en bates.

zu.requirements: I-Degree/Idiploma Yezwe leminyaka emithathu (3) Office Administration, Public Administration noma iziqu ezihambisana nalokhu. 3-5 iminyaka yamava ohlotshanweni lozokuphathwa kwofisi. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela. Amakhono nezimpawu: Ukuthuthukisa kokuqhuba nokuhlela. Ukukhuluma kahle nabanye abadlulelo/bathengi. Ukuxhumana kahle, ukucubungula kanye nokuhlela, ukubhala imibiko, ukuhlaziya, ukuthatha izinqumo ezinengqondo kanye namakhono okuxhumana nabantu. Ukubekezela kanye nokuzithiba. Ukusungula izinto ezintsha kanye nokuqonda ngokubhekise emandleni.
zu.duties: Ukuthuthukisa ukuthenga izimpahla kanye nezinsizakolo futhi uhlele izinhlela zokuhamba zombusi. Ukuthola izicelo ezivela kubaphathi. Ukuthola izikhowudo kubanikezi bezinsizakolo. Ukuphatha irejista yokuphumula kanye nezinye izenzo zokuphathwa. Ukugcina irejista yemisebenzi kanye neyokuphumula. Ukuhlola nokuhambisa izicelo zokuphumula. Ukuhlela kanye nokucoordinator imihlangano. Ukuphatha kanye nokuhlanganisa ukwabiwa kwemali. Ukusiza ekuphathweni kwemali yesimo ngaphansi kokuqondiswa. Ukuqamba kanye nokuqamba kabusha okudingayo ngaphakathi kwombusi. Ukuphatha ulwazi lwenkokhelo, izinsiza zomuntu, imali kanye nezimpahla.

xh.requirements: Idigrinya ye-National Diploma eminyaka mithathu (3) ekusiqinisekiswayo kwi-Office Administration, Public Administration okanye ngesiqualifications esihambelanayo. I-3-5 iminyaka yamava ohambelanayo kulawulo lwe-ofisi. Ukuba nogunya lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ikhono nokuchaneka: Ukwenza izikhulumi nokumisela. Ikhono elilo lokunxibelelana nabanye abathathi inxaxheba/abaxhasi. Ikhono elilo lokunxibelelana, ukucwangcisa nokuhlela, ukubhala iiripotha, ukuhlalutywa, ukwenza izigqibo ezinobuchule nokuqonda nokuba nemfihlakalo. Ukuba ngumsebenzi wentando yakho nokwazi ukuzithoba. Ukuzoba ingqondo nokucinga ngezinto ezintsha.
xh.duties: Yenza izikhulumi zokufumana iimpahla namacebo uze umisele iindlela zokuhamba kwindlela. Yamkela iicelo ezivela kubasebenzi. Phatha iindlela zokubhala iindawo zokungenisa nokubhalisa ezinye izinto. Ukugcina irejista yokusingqongileyo nezinye iindawo zolawulo. Ukugcina irejista yomsebenzi nesinxaxheba. Ukuphonononga nokungenisa izicelo zesingqisho. Hlela uze umisele iindibano. Lawula uze uhlanganise ukwabiwa kweemali. Nceda ekulawulweni kwemali karhulumente ngaphantsi kolawulo. Ukulinganisa nokuqwalasela iimfuno ngaphakathi kwesikhululo. Ukulawula iinkcukacha zokusebenza, iimisebenzi yabantu, imali neempahla.

Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya. Ubuyiselo olusha ekukhonzeni abantu. Ukuphatha abantu kanye nokunika amandla. Ukuzithoba kanye nokuba nenkulumo yeqiniso. Ukugcina imfihlo. Ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu, ukuzethemba, ikhono lokusebenzela wedwa kanye nalokusebenza eqenjini.

Ukulawula ukukhokhelwa kwezimali zokuhlala kanye nezimali zokuhambelelu Inhloko Yomnyango. Ukuvumela izeluleko zezimali ezahlukahlukene ze-BAS, amajamela e-BAS, izitifiketi zokuthola e-BAS, namarejista e-BAS Amafoni Ekhaya Lokulawula Izimali. Ukulawula ukukhiqizwa okulungile kwesitifiketi sokuthola kanye nokuthwebulwa kwedatha e-BAS. Ukubheka izimango Zezinhlelo Zokuqashwa Kwemoto Kwezikhulu eziphakeme. Ukulawula izimango zeholo i-Z59 Yenhloko Yomnyango. Ukuphatha uhlu lwegumbi lwegumbi njengoba kuqinisekwe kumyalelo yobuhle. Qiniseka ukuthi abasebenzi esigabeni bahambisana namazinga kanye namaphuzu Oqondisa Izimali Ezibhalwayo. Phatha, qeqesha kanye ulawule abasebenzi. Phatha imibuzo ethize ivela kubathengi. Ukuba ngabaholiwe kwabalawuli abanamagunya ngenxa yethembela ethize. Qedela izibopho zabahlinziwe njengoba kutholakala ngaphezu Kuyisigaba 45 Sothetho Wemali Yawo Umdlandla kanye nokulawulwa ngaphezu kwezimali Zothuthukiso Komuntu Lwalowo osebenzela Kulo Umnyango Wokuhlinzeka Abantu Wezemfundo Ephakeme.

af.summary: Senior Voorsieningsadministrasiebeampte by die Department of Correctional Services National Head Office, wat 'n graad of diploma in logistiek of publieke administrasie met 3-5 jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Erkende Graad of Nasionale Diploma in Logistiek/Voorraadkettingbestuur/Publieke Administrasie. 3-5 jaar relevante ervaring. Kennis van LOGIS-stelsel. Rekenaarvaardig.
