zu.title: Senior Provisioning Administration Officer: Provisioning
zu.summary: I-Senior Provisioning Administration Officer e-Department of Correctional Services National Head Office, edinga i-degree noma i-diploma kwi-logistics noma i-public administration okuhlangene neminyaka engu-3-5 yokuhlangenwe nakho.
zu.requirements: I-Degree noma i-National Diploma ekuqashisiwe kwi-Logistics/Supply Chain Management/Public Administration. Uhlolojikelele iminyaka engu-3-5 yokuhlangenwe nakho. Ulwazi ngesistimu ye-LOGIS. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokuqasha esemthethweni. Amakhono nezimpawu: Ulwazi nge-PFMA. Ulwazi nge-Treasury Regulations, i-Operational Plan, i-Strategic plan, i-Public Administration Service Act, i-White Paper. Ukuqonda imithetho yenhlangano, izincwadi zokuhola namamemorandamu. Ulwazi nokuqonda isistimu ye-LOGIS. Amakhono okuxoxa, ukubeka izinhloso nokuhlela, okwabantu abadidiyelene, ukuhlaziya kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Uxhumano (ngaphakathi nangaphandle). Ukuqotho, ukuzinza nokuzibophezela. Ubuciko, ukucabanga ngokuhlakanipha nokuba nezinto ezintsha.
zu.duties: Qapha isistimu ye-LOGIS. Qiniseka ukuthi wonke amafayela abekiwe agqamisiwe aqedwe bese asayinwa ngaphakathi konyaka wezimali. Misela futhi ugqamise ikhodi ezithile zesitore ukuze isitore sisebenze njengokuqeqeshiwe. Yenza ishlolo sezomnotho sesistimu ye-LOGIS. Aba imisebenzi kumsebenzisi. Siza ekwenzeni izihlolo ezisitoren. Qapha ukusetshenziswa kwemithetho yezomnotho. Qiniseka ukuthi abasebenzisi be-LOGIS balandela zonke izinhlaka ezibekiwe yimithetho ye-LOGIS. Qiniseka ukuthikulelwa kwemithetho ehlobene ngokwesekela ukulandelwa kwezinqubo ezinkonzini zezomnotho. Qapha i-LOGIS Balance Score Card. Hlola amaphuzu ngasiteshe bese ukhomba izindawo zokuthuthukisa njengesilinganiso esibekiwe i-National Treasury. Siza abasebenzisi ekusuleni izinkambu kulesistimu. Ukuphathwa kwolwazi ngemvelo, abantu, izimali nempahla.

xh.title: Isikhulu Esinamagunya Esigurunywa Sabekelelo: Esigurunywa
xh.summary: Isikhulu Esinamagunya Esigurunywa Sabekelelo kwisebe leZiko eliPhakamileyo leSebe leeeNkonzo zokuLungisa, elifuna idigiri okanye idiploma kulez logistics okanye ulawulo lwentlalo, elineminyaka emi-3 ukuya kweyi-5 yamava.
xh.requirements: Idigiri esemthethweni okanye iDiploma yezwe kwiiLogistics/uLawulo lweChani eMva yoQoqosho/uLawulo lwentlalo. Iiminyaka eyi-3-5 yamava ahambelanayo. Ulwazi ngesiNkqobo seLOGIS. Ukuba lilungilel lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esebe nayo. Ikhono nokuNaneka: Ulwazi ngePFMA. Ulwazi ngeMiluli yoQoso, iCwangciso lokuSebenza, iCwangciso loBuchule, iMthetho weNkonzo yoLawulo lwentlalo, ipepha eliMhlophe. Ukuqonda iingqungquthela, izikhokelo namanye amaxwebhu. Ulwazi nokuqonda isinkqobo seLOGIS. Ikhono lokunxibelelana, ukucwangcisa nokuhlela, ukunxibelelana nabantu, ukuhlalutya nokusombulula iingxaki. Unxibelelwano (langaphakathi nangaphandle). Inyaniso, inkunjulwa nokoqinisileyo. Ukuyila, ukuchaza ngokucaca nokuyila izinto ezintsha.
xh.duties: Qhapha isinkqobo seLOGIS. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iifayile ezicetyiweyo zivulwe, zigqitywe zisayinwe ngonyaka wemali. Misela umze ugcinwe amakhodi ahambelana negumbi lokugcina ukuze lisetyenziswe njengoko kulindelwe. Yenza ukhangelo lwezinkqobo zeLOGIS.abela imisebenzi kumsebenzisi. Nceda ekwenzeni ukhangelo kwiigumbi zokugcina. Qhapha ukusebenza kweengqungquthela zeLogistics. Qinisekisa ukuba abasebenzisi beLOGIS balandelile zonke iinkqubo ezicetywa yiningqungquthela zeLOGIS. Qinisekisa ulandelo lweengqungquthela ezichanekileyo ngokukhuthaza ukuzinza kweenkqubo kwiinkonzo zeLogistics. Qhapha ikhadi leLOGIS leNqanaba lokulinganisa. Khangela amanqanaba kwigumbi ngalinye lokugcina uze uchaze iindawo ezingacutshungulwa njengoko kumisela iNgowam-nyama yezwe. Ndise abasebenzisi ukuyicima iinguqu zesinkqobo. Ulawulo lolwazi lokuvela, abantu, imali nempahla.

Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile. Ukuzakhela ngokwakho kanye nokuba nezimfanelo: Ulwazi ngemithetho, izinqumo nezenzo, izinqubo, izinqumo kanye namathambo. zu.duties: Ukuphatha imikhokhelo engaphezu kwemikhawulo ye-ACB (Automatic Clearing Bureau). Ukubhekisisa imikhokhelo yawo wonke amaphuzu okugcwalisa kanye nemiketsho yamaholo kwi-PERSAL. Phendula yonke imibuzo enxulumene nomvuzo ubhalise ngokuTshintshwa kwenkqubo (SCC) kwiinkqubo ezingaqondakalanga ngokweenkcukacha zobuchwephetshe. Yamkela imibuzo yomvuzo ethunyelwa kumlawuli wemivuzo. Phendula kuyo yonke iintengiso zemali ezilindele igunyaziso aze ajonge imiyalelo engaqondakalanga engafanelekanga. Yamkela ingxelo yentengiso elindele igunyaziso kuMlawuli wemivuzo. Ulawulo lwenkcazelo ngemisebenzi, abantu, iimali kunye nempahla.

Administrasie van reis-, vervoer- en verwante werknemersvoordele. Administrasie en implementering van verlof en werknemersvoordele. Bestuur van prestasie-inligting, hulpbronne, finansies en bates.

zu.title: Umsebenzi we-HR: Izenzuzo Zokukhonza
zu.summary: Umsebenzi we-HR uphatha izenzuzo zokukhonza okuhlanganisa nendawo yokuhlala, usizo lwezimali, ukuhamba kanye nokuqondiswa kokuqasha eDepartment of Correctional Services National Head Office.
zu.requirements: I-Degree yeminyaka eyithathu (3) egunyaziwe noma i-National Diploma ku-Human Resource Management noma izifundo ezifanele. Ulwazi nge-PERSAL. 1-2yrs isipilingqimbi esifanele kwindawo yamaphoyisa. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ikhono Nemfanelo: Ukuqondiswa kwezimali, ukucubungula, ukuhlela, ukubusa kanye nokulawula, ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi, okokubonisa, ukuphathwa kwezingxabano, ukubhala imibiko, ukuphatha isikhathi, ukugcina imfihlo, ukwelisa nokuqondisa. Ukuqonda inqubo kanye nezakhiwo zomthetho ze-Public Service. Ukulethwa kwezinkonzo kanye nokujwayelana nabathintekayo, ukuziphatha kahle kanye neqiniso. Ukuzimisela, ukulunga ukuhamba, ukuxhumana, ukwenza izinqumo, ukweseka, ukuxoxisana kanye nokuqonda nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuxhumana / ukusebenzisana namalayisense. Ukuqonda kujulile ngesakhiwo somthetho sika-Public Service. Ukuphathwa kwezingxabano. Ulwazi ngo-Correctional Service Act.
zu.duties: Ukuqondiswa kwezennzuzo zendawo yokuhlala. Ukuqondiswa kwesizo lezimali zabasebenzi kanye nezinkonzo zokuphatha izikweletu. Ukuqondiswa kokuqasha, ukuthutha kanye nezinye izenzuzo zabasebenzi ezihlobene nazo. Ukuqondiswa kanye nokusebenzisa ukuqasha nezenzuzo zabasebenzi. Ukuphathwa kolwazi lokusebenza, izinsiza, imali nezimpahla.

xh.title: Umsebenzi we-HR: Iinzuzo Zokukhonza
xh.summary: Umsebenzi we-HR olawula iinzuzo zokukhonza kuquka indlu, inkxaso-mali, uhambo lolawulo lokushiya kwiNdiBe zeZikhonza zoLungiso eNdibe yoMzi-mveliso iNqanaba eliphezulu.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seminyaka emithathu (3) esemthethweni okanye iDiploma yeSizwe kuLawulo lweZabantu okanye ngesimfundo esifanelekileyo. Ulwazi ngePERSAL. 1-2yrs amava afanelekileyo kwimeko yomthetho wezabantu. Ukubaluleka kakhulu ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ikhompetensi nemiqondiso: Ukuqulunqwa kwezemali, ukucwangcisa, ukuhlela, ukukhokela noku lawula, ulawulo lweprojekthi, i prezinteyishan, ulawulo lwezingxabano, ukubhala iingxelo, ukulawula ixesha, imfihlolokisho, ukukhokela nokuqeqesha. Ukuqonda iNkqubo yomgaqo-nkqabo weLizwe kunye namagunya omtetho. Ukuhanjiswa kweenkonzo nolungelelwaniso lokumelwa nabathengi, intlonipho nokuqinisekisa. Ukuzimisela, ukulungelelana ukuhamba, unxibelelwano, ukwenza izigqibo, ukwenza amacebo okuba yinxaxheba, intsebenziswano nokusombulula iingxaki. Ukusebenzisana / ukuqudumbisa kumabanjwa. Ukuqonda ngobunzulu iNkqubo yoLawulo eLizwe laseKoloni. Ulawulo iingxabano. Ulwazi loMthetho woLungiso lokukhonza.
xh.duties: Ukulawula iinzuzo zendlu nendawo yokuhlala. Ulawulo lenkxaso-mali yabasebenzi kwaye kubekho iinkonzo zolawulo zikarikhwedi. Ulawulo lohambo, kwethutho nethotho iinzuzo zabasebenzi ezithe lekwaso. Ulawulo nokuzeke kwenkqubo yokushiya kwaye kubekho iinzuzo zabasebenzi. Ulawulo lomphumo welwazi, amathuba, iimali nempahla.

jobs.title: State Accountant: Income
jobs.summary: Manage accounts payable and receivable, reconcile revenue, and coordinate annual tariff reviews for the Department of Correctional Services at National Head Office.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Degree/National Diploma in Finance related field with Financial Accounting with Cost and Management Accounting as a major subject. 1-2 years relevant finance experience. Knowledge of BAS. Computer literate. Valid driver’s licence. Competencies And Attributes: Good knowledge of Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations and Basic Accounting System. Knowledge of Public Service Regulations, Financial Administration Procedures and Supply Chain Manuals, Transport, Procurement and Asset Management. Ability to access and utilize information. Plan, organize, leadership and control. Conflict resolution, liaison (internal and external), analytical thinking, problem solving, productivity, responsible, accountable, integrity, committed and innovation skills.
jobs.duties: Responsible for handling accounts payable and accounts receivable. Reconcile monthly revenue collected and pay-over revenue collected to National Treasury. Clearing of suspense accounts. Coordinate the review process of annual tariffs. Issue financial circulars for annual tariffs to be used in each financial year. The incumbent will liaise with the following bodies/sections in the execution of his/her tasks - National Treasury, regions and management areas. Execute responsibilities of officials as stipulated in Section 45 of the PFMA. Management of performance information, resources, finance and assets.
jobs.enquiries: National Head Office: Ms NS Khumalo Tel No: (012) 307 2174 or Ms TP Ngobeni Tel No: (012) 305 8589.
jobs.applications: should be submitted online at https://careers.dcs.gov.za/. Emailed, post or hand delivered applications will not be considered.
jobs.notes: Appointment under the Public Service Act. Before you apply: All costs associated with an application will be borne by the applicant. Applicants who have retired from the Public Service with a specific determination that they cannot be re-appointed or have been declared medically unfit will not be considered. Please take note that correspondence will only be conducted with the shortlisted candidates. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application is unsuccessful. Please do not call the department to enquire about the progress of your application. Applicants must note that further checks will be conducted once they are shortlisted and that their appointment is subject to positive outcomes on these checks, which include security clearance, security vetting, qualification verification and criminal records verification. Appointment will be provisional, pending the issue of a security clearance. If you cannot get a security clearance, your appointment will be re-considered/possibly terminated. Fingerprints may be taken on the day of the interview. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One shall be a practical exercise, and the other shall be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applications: Applications must be submitted on the Z83 form (Public Service application form) obtainable from any Public Service department and must be completed in full. Please send a complete application for the post you apply for on a pdf format, stating the correct reference for the position you are interested in. Requirement for valid driver’s licence is not applicable to applicants with a disability. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Staatrekenmeester: Inkomste
af.summary: Bestuur skuld- en voorraadrekenings, vereffen inkomste en koördineer jaarlikse tariefherbesienings vir die Department of Correctional Services by Nasionale Hoofkantoor.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Graad/Nasionale Diploma in 'n verbandhoudende finansieringsveld met Finansiële Rekenkunde met Koste- en Bestuursrekenkunde as 'n hoofvak. 1-2 jaar relevante finansies-ervaring. Kennis van BAS. Rekenaargeletterd. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede en eienskappe: Goeie kennis van die Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations en Basic Accounting System. Kennis van Public Service Regulations, Financial Administration Procedures en Supply Chain Manuals, Transport, Procurement en Asset Management. Vermoë om inligting te ontsluit en te benut. Beplan, organiseer, leierskap en beheer. Konflikoplossing, skakeling (intern en ekstern), analitiese denke, probleemoplossing, produktiwiteit, verantwoordelik, aanspreeklik, integriteit, toegewyd en innoverende vaardighede.
af.duties: Verantwoordelik vir die hantering van skuldrekeninge en voorraadrekeninge. Vereffen maandelikse ingevorderde inkomste en betaal ingevorderde inkomste oor aan National Treasury. Skoonmaak van wagrekeninge. Koördineer die hersieningsproses van jaarlikse tariewe. Uitreik van finansiële sirkuliere vir jaarlikse tariewe wat in elke finansiële jaar gebruik moet word. Die ampsdraer sal skakel met die volgende liggame/afdelings in die uitvoering van sy/haar take - National Treasury, streke en bestuursareas. Voer verantwoordelikhede van amptenare uit soos uiteengesit in Artikel 45 van die PFMA. Bestuur van prestasie-inligting, hulpbronne, finansies en bates.

zu.title: Isiphathimandi seSizwe: Inzuzo
zu.summary: Phatha ama-akhawunti okukhokhelwayo nokuqoqwayo, linganisa inzuzo, futhi uhlelele ukubuyekeza kwamatharifu wonyaka kuMnyango Wezokwelapha Ngokomthetho eNqandeni Elikhulu Elikazwelonke.
zu.requirements: I-Degree/National Diploma ehambisana nomkhakha wezimali efaka i-Financial Accounting njengento enkulu kanye ne-Cost and Management Accounting. 1-2 iminyaka yokuhlangabezana ngokuhlangenwe kunoMkhakha wezimali. Ulwazi nge-BAS. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Ilayisense yokushayela esebenzayo. Ikhono Nezici: Ulwazi oluhle nge-Public Finance Management Act, i-Treasury Regulations kanye ne-Basic Accounting System. Ulwazi nge-Public Service Regulations, i-Financial Administration Procedures kanye ne-Supply Chain Manuals, ukuHamba, ukuThenga, kanye nokuPhatha Izimpahla. Ikhono lokufinyelela futhi usebenzise ulwazi. Cubungula, hlela, yiba nomthelela ohola futhi lawule. Ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuxhumanisa (ngaphakathi nangaphandle), ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukukhiqiza, ukubekezela, ukubekezelela, ukuqinisekisa, ukuzithiba, kanye namakhono okwakha izinto ezintsha.
zu.duties: Uxulumene nokuphatha ama-akhawunti okukhokhelwayo nokuqoqwayo. Linganisa inzuzo eqoqiwe nyanga zonke futhi ukhokhele inzuzo eqoqiwe ku-National Treasury. Ukusula ama-akhawunti okulinganisela. Hlelela inqubo yokuqondisa nokubuyekeza amatharifu wonyaka. Khishisa izexwayiso zezimali zamatharifu wonyaka okuzosetshenziswa kunyaka wonke wezimali. Lowo othweswe isikhundla uzoxhumana namabhenganise/amagabelo alandelayo ekwenzeni imisebenzi yakhe - i-National Treasury, izifunda kanye namakhasi okuphatha. Yenza imisebenzi yabasebenzi njengoba kushiwo kuMthetho wesiKa-45 we-PFMA. Ukuphatha ulwazi ngemigomo, izinsiza, izimali, nezimpahla.

xh.title: Isikhulu seZimali sesiLuntu: Ingeniso
xh.summary: Lawula ama-akhawunti okuhlawulelwayo nokuqokelelwayo, ulungelelanise ingeniso, kwaye uqobe ukuhlolwa kwemali yesikoonyana ngamnye kwisebe leZenzo zokuLungisa eKomkhulu leSizwe.
xh.requirements: I-Degree/National Diploma efanelekileyo kwindawo ephathelene nezimali ne-Akhawunti eZeMali kunye ne-Akhawunti yexabiso nezoLawulo njengomthwomkho ophambili. 1-2 iminyaka yamava afanelekileyo kwezimali. Ulwazi nge-BAS. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisense yokushayela esebenzayo. Ikhompetensi nezibalulekile: Ulwazi oluhle ngoMthetho woLawulo lweZimali zorLuntu, Iimigaqo zeTreasury kunye neNkqubo yoBuntu yoKubala. Ulwazi ngoMagaqo oLawulo lwaKhumkanankulu, Iinkqubo zoLawulo lweZimali namaNual azeLungelelanisa ukuQokelela izinto, ukuThutha, ukuThenga noLawulo lwamaSseti. Amandla okufikelela nokusebenzisa ulwazi. Ukucwangcisa, ukuQumba, ukulawula noLawulo. Ukusombulula iingxaki, ukuNhlanganisa (ngaphakathi nangaphandle), ukucinga ngokuhlalutya, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukusebenza kakuhle, ukuziphatha ngokubekisebenza, ukuziphendula, ukuqinisekisa, ukuzimisela namakhono obudala.
xh.duties: Uxanduva lokusingatha ama-akhawunti okuhlawulelwayo nama-akhawunti okuqokelelwayo. UkuLungelelanisa ingeniso eqokelelweyo nyanga ngenyanga kwaye uhlawule ingeniso eqokelelweyo kwiTreasury yoBuntu. UkuCoca ama-akhawunti amafutshane. UkuQobo inqobo yokuhlola imali yesikoonyana ngamnye. UkuKhutsha iindlu zexabiso ezimali zemali yesikoonyana ngamnye eziza kusetyenziswa kwixo ngamnye lemali. Umntu okhethiweyo uza kudibana nabalandelayo/ngezicandla ekwenzeni imisebenzi yakhe - iTreasury yoBuntu, iindawo nendawo yolawulo. UkuZenza iimisebenzi abalulekileyo njengoko kucatshuliwe kuQlu 45 kwe-PFMA. ULawulo lolwazi ngemisebenzi, izixhobo, izimali namaseti.

jobs.title: State Accountant: Financial Statement and Debt Control
jobs.summary: State Accountant needed at the Department of Correctional Services National Head Office to prepare financial statements, manage debt control, and perform debtor reconciliations.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Degree/National Diploma in Finance related field with Accounting, Financial Management, Cost with Management Accounting as a major subject. 1-2 years relevant finance experience in Debt Management. Knowledge of BAS. Computer literate. Valid driver’s licence. Competencies And Attributes: Strong data analysis, problem solving, effective communication, presentation and report writing skills. Sound clerical, numeracy organisational and time management abilities. Knowledge of Public Finance Management Act. Understanding of the Public Service legislative and regulatory framework. High level of integrity, attention to detail, accountability and the ability to work independently and under pressure.
jobs.duties: Assist with the preparation of annual financial statements in accordance with the modified cash standards. Perform monthly debtor reconciliations and resolving reconciling items. Assist with debt collection processes to ensure timely recovery of outstanding debts. Ensure accurate and timeous recording of all debtor transactions in the appropriate accounts. Ensure that all transactions captured on BAS are authorised within prescribed timeframes. Maintain proper filing systems and safeguard debtor records for audit purposes. Perform daily administrative duties within the Debt Control section. Coordinate monthly stationery requirements for the section. Monitor monthly reports on the status of suspense accounts. Ensure reporting is compliant with section 32 of the PMFA by maintaining effective financial management and internal controls. Management of performance information, resources, finance and assets.

af.title: Staatsrekenmeester: Finansiële State en Skuldbeheer
af.summary: Staatsrekenmeester benodig by die Department of Correctional Services National Head Office om finansiële state op te stel, skuldbeheer te bestuur en debiteurrekonstruksies uit te voer.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike graad/nasionale diploma in 'n finansieverwante veld met Rekeningkunde, Finansiële Bestuur, Koste en Bestuursrekeningkunde as 'n hoofvak. 1-2 jaar relevante finansie-ervaring in skuldbestuur. Kennis van BAS. Rekenaarvaardig. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede en eienskappe: Sterke data-analise, probleemoplossing, effektiewe kommunikasie, aanbiedings- en verslagskryfvaardighede. Soliede klerklike, numeriese, organisatoriese en tydbestuursvermoëns. Kennis van die Public Finance Management Act. Begrip van die wetgewende en regulatiewe raamwerk van die Staatsdiens. Hoë vlak van integriteit, aandag aan besonderhede, aanspreeklikheid en die vermoë om onafhanklik en onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Help met die voorbereiding van jaarlikse finansiële state in ooreenstemming met die gewysigde kontantstandaarde. Voer maandelikse debiteurrekonstruksies uit en los reconstruerende items op. Help met skuldinvorderingsprosesse om tydige invordering van uitstaande skulde te verseker. Verseker akkurate en tydige rekening van alle debiteurtransaksies in die toepaslike rekeninge. Verseker dat alle transaksies wat op BAS vasgelê is, binne voorgeskrewe tydraamwerke gemagtig word. Handhaaf behoorlike lêerstelsels en bewaar debiteurrekords vir ouditdoeleindes. Voer daaglikse administratiewe pligte binne die skuldbeheer-afdeling uit. Koördineer maandelikse skryfbehoeftes vir die afdeling. Monitor maandelikse verslae oor die status van hangende rekeninge. Verseker dat verslagdoening voldoen aan artikel 32 van die PMFA deur effektiewe finansiële bestuur en interne beheer te handhaaf. Bestuur van prestasie-inligting, hulpbronne, finansies en bates.

zu.title: Isiphathihliziwi Sezwe: Izinkomba Zezimali Nokulawula Izikweletu
zu.summary: Kudingeka isiphathihliziwi sezwe eHhovu Elikhulu Lesizwe le-Department of Correctional Services ukuze kulungiswe izinkomba ezimali, kulawulwe izikweletu, futhi kwenzike ukuqambaniswa kwabadebi.
zu.requirements: Iziqu/I-Diploma Yezizwe ohlweni oluhlobene nezimali ezine-Accounting, Financial Management, Cost with Management Accounting njengesihloko esikhulu. 1-2 unyaka weminyaka yolesiphi esihlobene nezimali ekulawuleni izikweletu. Ulwazi nge-BAS. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ikhono Nemfanelo: Ukuhlaziya idatha ngamandla, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuxhumana ngempumelelo, amakhono okubhenta inkombimfundo kanye nokubhala imibiko. Amakhono okulungiselela, ukwenza izibalo, ukuhlelwa kanye nokuphatha isikhathi. Ulwazi nge-Public Finance Management Act. Ukuqondaohlakahlisombulu bomthetho kanye nokuqonda icala lokulawula komthetho wesebenzi kahulumeni. Izinga eliphezulu lobuqotho, ukuqaphela izinhlaka, ubunikelo kanye nenyongo yokusebenza kodwa nokusebenza ngaphansi kokucindezelwa.
zu.duties: Usiza ukulungisa izinkomba zonyaka zemali ngokuhambisana namazinga okuthengisa okulungisiwe. Yenza ukuqambaniswa kwabadebi nyanga zonke uxazulule futhi izinto eziqambaniswa. Siza ngenqubo yokuthola izikweletu ukuze kuqiniseke ukubuyiswa kwesikhathi esifanele kwezikweletu ezingakahlawulelwa. Qiniseisa ukurekhodwa ngokuchanekile nangesikhathi esifanele kokuthengisa konke okwenzeka kubadebi kuma-akhawunti afanele. Qiniseisa ukuthi konke okuthengiswa okuthathiwe kwi-BAS kunikwe igunya phakathi kwesikhathi esimisiwe. Gcina izinhlelo zokufaka ezifanele futhi uvikele amarekhodi wabadebi ngenjongo yokuhlola. Yenza imisebenzi yansuku zonke yokuphatha imisebenzi yonqenqama kuluhlaka lokulawula izikweletu. Hlela izidingo zempahla yokubhala zenyanga zonke zanqenqama. Qapha imibiko yenyanga zonke ngobulukhuni be-akhawunti zokumiswa. Qinise isa ukuthi ukwenza imibiko kuhambisana nesigaba 32 se-PMFA ngokugcina ukuphatha kwezimali ngempumelelo kanye nokuqamba okulawulwa ngaphakathi. Ukuphatha ulwazi ngemikhiqizo, izinsiza, imali nezimpahla.

xh.title: IsiNgqunguthela seNtengiso: Iinkcinga zeMali nokuLawula Izikolweni
xh.summary: Kufunekwe isiNgqunguthela seNtengiso kwiSebe leZigunyaziso eZilungiselelwe iNtloko yeLizwe ukulungisa iinkcinga zemali, ukulawula izikolweni, nokuqamba iindlela zokuqwalasela izikolweni.
xh.requirements: I-Degree/National Diploma efanelekileyo kwilonga elifundayo ngeMali eliquka ukuBala, ukuLawula iMali, iNtlalo yokuBala nokuLawula iMali njengentsika. 1-2 years inkcazelo efanelekileyo kwiMali kukuLawula izikolweni. Ulwazi ngoBAS. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ikhono nezibini: Ulwakhiwo lweenkcukacha, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukunxibelelwana okusebenzayo, iinkcakuba ezibonwayo namakhono okubhala iingxelo. Amakhono okulungisa amaxwebhu, ukuqonda amanani, ukuhlelana nokulawula ixesha. Ulwazi loMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaWonke wonke. Ukuqonda isakhiwo somthetho nolawulo lwenkonzo yomntu wonke. Iqondo eliphezulu lokuqamba, kuqwalasela iinkcukacha, uxanduva namakhono okusebenza kodwa nokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo.
xh.duties: Nceda ekulungiseni iinkcinga zemali zorho ngamnye ngokuvumelana nezinga lemali elungisiweyo. Qamba iindlela zokuqwalasela izikolweni nyanga zonke usombulule izinto ezidityaniswayo. Nceda kwindlela zokuqokelela izikolweni ukuqinisekisa ukubuyiswa kwexesha ngezikolweni ezingazabalisiweyo. Qinisekisa ukubhalwa okuchanekileyo nangexesha lezonke iinkqubo zezikolweni kumanikhi afanelekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iinkqubo ezibhalwe kwiBAS zivunyelwe kwixesha elichaziweyo. Phucula iindlela zokulungelelanisa iifayile zigcine iirekhodi zezikolweni zokujolise ekuhloleni. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo yemihla ngemihla kwicandelo eloLawula izikolweni. Humanela iimfuno zexwebhu nyanga zonke zecandelo. Qaphula iingxelo nyanga zonke ngemo yamanikhi alibazisekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba iingxelo zivumelana nomgca 32 we-PMFA ngokugcina ulawulo olusebenzayo lwemali nolawulo langaphakathi. Ulawulo lolwazi lenkonzo, iimfuno, imali neempahla.

jobs.title: Junior Developer
jobs.summary: Junior Developer at the Department of Correctional Services National Head Office, requiring an IT diploma or degree with 1-2 years' software development experience.
jobs.requirements: Recognised National Diploma/Degree in Information Technology. 1-2 years’ working knowledge of software development. Experience in developing intranet and internet websites. Knowledge of basic coding language such as XML, XSL, HTML, JavaScript, VB Scrip, Visual Basic, COM, ASP< C#, SQL. Database (i.e. oracle and MS SQL) knowledge will be an added advantage. Valid driver’s licence. Competencies And Attributes: Technical Knowledge. Training in telephone etiquette. Training in image projection. Communication (verbal & written). Interpersonal relations. Time management. Team Work. Problem solving skills. Analytical thinking. Accountable. Committed. Disciplined. Flexible. Punctual. Respect. Self-confidence. Integrity and honesty. Professionalism. Ukuzethemba nokwazi ukwenza okulungile, ukugcina imfihlo, ubuhlobo obuhle nabantu kanye nolwazi mayelana ne-Correctional Services Act, Act 111 of 1998, njengoba ishintshiwe. Ukuphathwa kwemithombo yezinto ngokomzimba nolwazi. Lokuthuthukisa ngokufundisa. Ukugadama abagwetshyi lapho behlaza izinto. Nikezela ngokunyakaza kokuzivikela kanye nokuzilolonga umzimba kubafundi bahlela besikhathi. Hlola izinhlelo ezintsha ukuqinisekisa ukuthi okwamanje kusetshenziswa. af.requirements: Matric/ Graad 12 of 'n relevante Graad/Nasionale Diploma (NQF-vlak 6) in Gedragswetenskappe en suksesvolle voltooiing van die Korrektiewe Wetenskap-leerderskap/ Basiese Opleiding. 10 jaar relevante ervaring opgedoen by die intreevlak-produksiepos (CB1) of vir 'n persoon wat aangestel word met 'n relevante NQF-vlak 6-kwalifikasie, is geen vorige ervaring vereis vir aanstelling tot hierdie pos nie. Integriteit en eerlikheid, vertroulikheid, goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings en kennis van die Korrektiewe Dienste-wet, Wet 111 van 1998, soos gewysig. Selfgelding, vermoë om te netwerk en diplomasie.

Implementeer opleidings- en ontwikkelingsprosesse. Navorsing van nuwe internasionale en nasionale tendense in korreksies. Evalueer opleiding en gee terugvoer. Kennis van opleidingsverwante administrasie en finansiële bestuur. Opleiding van leerders. Verantwoordelik vir die fasiliteite en toerusting in die afdeling. Bestuur van leerders en verseker die beskikbaarheid van fasiliteite d.w.s. slaapakkommodasie vir leerders en opleidingskamers voor die aanvang van die korrektiewe wetenskap-leerderskapprogram. Bestuur van prestasie-inligting, finansies, menslike hulpbronne en bates.

zu.title: Onozungezile Bokuqinisa Isibili Isikhundla Esiphezulu: Umhumanisi [cb2-1]
zu.summary: Xhumanisa ukuqeqeshwa kwabafundi emitholamhpilo yokugcina amakhalenda ezinsizakazo, ukuphatha imikhankaso yokufundiswa, imithombo kanye nokuphathwa kwefoloshi yobufakazi.
zu.requirements: Amatikithi / ibanga lesi-12 noma i-degree / i-diploma yezwe (izinga le-NQF 6) kwezobungqondisi bokuziphilisa nokuphumelela kwesikhundla sokufundiswa / ukuqeqeshwa okuyisisekelo ekugcineni izinsizakalo. 10 iminyaka imikhawulo yokuhlinzeka ngomkhankaso wokufunda noma kumuntu okhethwe one-NQF level 6, akukho ukutholwa okudingwa ukubekwa kulesi sikhundla. Ukubhaliswa nokwamukelwa njengoMhloli noMbusi kuzoba yinzuzo. Ilayisensi yokushaya ehamba ngesinyathelo. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono namandla: Amakhono e-ayisense nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokuphepha oluhlobene. Unxibelelwano, ukulawula umkhankaso kanye nezinkambu. Ukuqhuba izinguquko, ukushintsha kanye nokuphathwa kwabahlanganyele. Ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlaziya, ukuthuthukisa ukulethwa kwenkonzo, ukwenza izinqumo, ukuphatha abantu nokunika amandla. Ukuqonda ukuphepha kanye nokukhuseka emkhakheni wokulungisa icala. Ukuzithiba nokwazeka, ukugcina imfihlo, ubuhle bokuxhumana nabantu kanye nolwazi ngoMthetho Wezinsizakazo Zokulungisa, uMthetho 111 ka-1998, njengoba ulungisiwe. Ukuzimela, ikhono lokuxhumana nobantu kanye nobuhlakani bokuzipatha.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuphathwa kwabafundi. Phatha ukusungulwa nokulungiselela kwefoloshi yobufakazi (POE). Cwangcisa, lungiselela uphathe imithombo yezinsiza. Xhumana nobuhle benu bomsebenzi nabafundi bese ningasebenza njengesiqembu. Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza. Ukubonisa ukufundisa. Lungiselela ukufunda ngemiyalo yesandla. Ukusebenzisa inqubo yokukholelwa nokuthuthukiswa. Ukuhlola izinto ezisha ezizweni nakulelizwe ngokulungiswa. Hlola isiqeshi bese unikeza imibiko. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kolunye uhlaka lwesiqeshi nokuphathwa kwezimali. Ukufundisa abafundi. Ubuhlakani bezinkomba zalezo zinto nezikhungo ezibekiwe kulungu. Ukuphathwa kwabafundiswa nokuhlinzeka ngemikhawulo ezindleleni ezindleko njengendawo yokulala kanye namakilasi phambi kokuthi iqale inkambu yomqondo wokulungisa icala. Ukuphathwa kolunye uhlaka lwezinsizakalo ezibekiwe, imali, abantu besebenzela imithetho yokuhlinzeka.

xh.summary: Ukuqhuba izikolo zabafundi kwikholeji zokuqeqesha zeCorrectional Services, ulawulo lokufundisa, izixhobo nolawulo lwebhanki yezifungo.

Iminyaka eli-10 yamava afanelekileyo afunyanwe kwisithuba sokwenza ngowona mgangatho wongeno (CB1) okanye kumntu oqeshwe ngeNQF level 6 efanelekileyo, akukho mva ngaphambili funwayo kumntu oqeshwayo kule sithuba. Ukwaba bubhalisiwe kwaye ugunyazisiwe njengoMhloli noMlawuli kuya kuba lusizo. ilayisenisi yomqhubi egunyazisiweyo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Iimpawu nezimfuno: Amaxesha okusebenzisa isixhobo sokutshaya nokusebenzisa iNkcubeko yekhuselo. Unxibelelwano, ulawulo lprojekthi nenkqubo. Uguqulo, utshintsho nolawulo babathathi-nxaxheba. Ukuxazulula iingxaki, uhlalutyo, intsingiselo yokuhambisa iinkonzo, ukuthatha iigqibo, ulawuloabantu nokubanika amandla. Ukuqonda ngokujulileyo ukhuseleko nokuqinisekisa kwindawo yokulungisa. Intembeko nenyaniso, ugcinolwazi, ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabantu nolwazi lomthetho weCorrectional Services Act, iAct 111 ka-1998, njengoko ulungisiwe. Ukuzigxina, ikhono lokuba luxhumanisi kunye nobuchule obuhle bokwakha ubudlelwane.
xh.duties: Lawula ulawulo lwesikolo sabafundi. Lawula ukusekwa nokulungiselela ibhanki yezifungo (POE). Cwangcisa, lungiselela ulawule izixhobo. Xhumana nobudlelwane obunesigqibo nabafundi kwaye usebenze njengosebenzisana. Ulawulo lwezixhobo. Ukubamba iinjongo zokufundisa. Lungiselela ukufunda ngokwenzelwayo. Zisebenzisa iinkqubo zokuqeqesha nentlaloreko. Phando ngeendaba ezintsha zamazwe ngamazwe nezwe kwizikhululo. Hlola uqeqesho unike iimvakalelo. Ulwazi ngolawulo ohlongene nokuqeqesha nolawulo lweemali. Ukuqeqesha abafundi. Uxanduva lweziseko nezixhobo kwicandelo. Ulawulo abafundi kuqinisekisa ukubakho kweziseko oko kukuthi indawo yokulala yabafundi nangabakho amagumbi okuqeqesho phambi kokusungulwa komthethosonke wokulunga izikhululo eziyimfundo. Ulawulo lolwazi ngomsebenzi, iimali, izixhobo zabantu nempahla.

Ervaring in 'n oproepsentrumomgewing sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Rekenaargeletterd. Bevoegdhede en eienskappe: Bedrewe met CRM (bv. MS Dynamics, Salesforce, of voorgeskrewe stelsel), MS Office (Outlook, Excel, Word). Kennis van oproephanteringsplatforms (ACD/IVR/softphone), tiketwerkvloei, en gebruik van kennbasis. zu.title: Inkemi Yekhasi Lokubiza
zu.summary: Inkemi Yekhasi Lokubiza Ehhovisi Eliyinhloko Lelikhandwe Lesizwe i-Department of Correctional Services, kudingeka ibhasikidi le-Ka-12 futhi ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, kungadingeki siphepho sokuzuliswa.
zu.requirements: Ibhasikidi le-Ka-12 (i-Matric). Isitifikedi/Idiploma emva kwesikole kulezenzalo zekhasi labathengi/imapulofu kuzoba yinzuzo ekhululekileyo. Akukho siphepho esidingekayo. Ukuba nesiphepho kulesimo sekhasi lokubiza kuzoba yinzuzo ekhululekileyo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono Neempawu: Ukuzijwayeza nge-CRM (umz., i-MS Dynamics, i-Salesforce, noma inkqubo ecacisiweyo), i-MS Office (i-Outlook, i-Excel, i-Word). Ulwazi ngezinkundla zokuphatha amakhasi (i-ACD/IVR/softphone), izindlela zokubhala amatikhi, nokuqashelwa okusekelwe kolwazi. Ukuqonda i-POPIA nokuqonda okuyisiseko ngokuvikeleka kolwazi. Izenzo zokubika. Izenzo zomthetho nolawu ahlobene nommandla wokusebenza okuthileyo okuhlanganisa izimilo nezilinganiso. Ukubhekelela bathengi, ukuxoxisana ngokuzwela, ukulalela ngokuzifaka. Ukwexazula izinkinga nokwenza izinkampani ezinhle. Ukunakela ukucutshungwa nokuchibiyela. Ukomelela, ukubekezela inkinga, nolawulo isikhathi. Ukusebenza njengothi futhi nokuziphendulela. Ukubhala izikhomizi, namemothi, amagama, kanye nezikhetheko.
zu.duties: Iphethe imibuzo nesevisi yabathengi ukuhlinzeka ngempendulo ehlukileyo, ehloniphekileyo futhi eqondo ngazo zonke izindlela. Isexazula imibuzo esibheshini sokuqala ukuthinta noma kunjani. Ithathe yonke imibuzo ngokuphelele futhi ngesiqondiso kule-CRM (Customer Relations Management) ecacisiwe. Idlulise izinkinga eziyinkimbinkimbi ngokushesha kwamabhulo/izinto ezihlobene nokubhala okucacileyo. Igcine ukubhaliswa ngokugqamile futhi ixhase okubikiwe kanye nezidingo zokuqashelwa. Ivikele ukwaziswa komuntu siqu nokuhlonza abantu abathizeka. Ukuphatha izimpahla.

xh.summary: I-Agent yaseCall Centre eDepartment of Correctional Services National Head Office, idinga i-Grade 12 nobuchule bokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, kwaye akukho mava owayadingeka.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 12 (Matric). Isatifikethi/I-Diploma emva kwesikolo kwinkonzo yabathengi/orho lophatho lwezinto kuya kuba ngumsebenzi ongongezelelweyo. Akukho mfundo yamava edingekayo. Amava kwimeko yaseCall Centre kuya kuba ngumsebenzi ongongezelelweyo. Ukuba nobuchule bokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngeendlela zokupatha amagumbi (ACD/IVR/softphone), iinkqubo zokulinganisa, nokusebenzisa ulwazi olusisiseko. Ukuqonda i-POPIA neziseko zolwazi olukhuselekileyo. Iinkqubo zokuxela. Iinkqubo zolawulo ezinxulumene nendawo ethile yokusebenza eziquka iimfuno namagunya. Ugxile kwabathengi, unxibelelwano oluziphandlayo, ukumamla ngokusebenzisa amandla. Unxibelelwano olubhaliweyo malunga Neenotosi, imemo, iileta neengxelo.
xh.duties: Phatha imibuzo nenkonzo yabathengi ukuze kunikezwe iimpendulo ezisezantsi, ezinobungcwathi nezingachazanga ngokuchanekileyo ngeendlela zonke. Susa imibuzo kwindawo yokuqala yokuxhumana naninini na kunokwenzeka. Bathathe ngokupheleleyo ngokuchanekileyo yonke imibuzo kwinkqubo ebekiweyo yoLawulo loBudlelwane namaXhosa (CRM). Yisa ngokukhawuleza izinto ezinzima kumasebe/iimodyuli ezifanelekileyo ngethutyana elicacileyo. Gcina amagqabantshintshi achanekileyo aze uxhase iingxelo neemfuno zokuvavanya. Gcina ulwazi lwangasese nedatha etholakalayo kaluhle. Ulawulo lweempahla.

af.summary: Die Department of Correctional Services soek sekretarisse vir agt direktorate by die nasionale hoofkantoor, wat Graad 12 met tik en rekenaarvaardighede vereis, met geen vooraf ervaring wat nodig is nie.
af.requirements: Graad 12 met tik as 'n vak of enige ander opleidingskursus of kwalifikasie wat die persoon in staat sal stel om die werk bevredigend te verrig. Geen ervaring vereis. Rekenaarvaardig. Bevoegdhede en eienskappe: Eerlikheid en integriteit. Aandag aan besonderhede. Beplan en organiseer. Stiptelikheid en vertroulikheid. Dienslewering en kliëntgerigtheid. Uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede (geskrewe en mondelings). Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Vermoë om werkverwante take te koördineer en te organiseer. Goeie telefoonetiket. Hoë vlak van betroubaarheid. Vermoë om met takt en diskresie op te tree.
af.duties: Voer kantoor- en algemene administratiewe pligte uit. Siwing en beantwoord telefoonoproepe. Tik korrespondensie. Stel dokumentasie en aanbiedings op. Verseker behoorlike rekordbestuur deur doeltreffende lêerstelsels. Bestuur elektroniese dokumentopsporingstelsel. Onderhou dagboek en bestuur afsprake. Verantwoordelik vir die bestuur van die dokumentopsporingstelsel. Reël en koördineer vergaderings, werkswinkels ens. Fasiliteer die verkryging van kantoorbenodigdhede soos stasie. Voer alle take en pligte wat verband hou met die rol uit. Maak alle vervoerreëlings vir konferensies, kursusse, vergaderings en verhore weg van die kantoor. Bestuur van bates.

zu.title: Unobhala
zu.summary: Umnyango we Correctional Services ufuna abanobhala kwezinkomba eziyisishiyagalombili e National Head Office, kudingeka ibe khona ibanga le-12 anithipha nolwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha, akudingeka kube khona nohambo olwangaphambilini lwemisebenzi.
zu.requirements: Ibanga le-12 anithipha njengesifundo noma noma iyiphi enye indlela yokuqeqesha noma izifundo ezizomnika isikhundla sokwenza umsebenzi ngendlela ehambisana nemigomo. Akudinga nohambo lwemisebenzi. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Amandla kanye nezici: Ukwethembeka nokuba nogqozi. Ukuqaphela imininingwane. Ukucubungula futhi uhlele. Ukufika ngesikhathi kanye nokugcina imfihlo. Ukulethwa kwenkonzo kanye nokuqondiswa kabantu. Amandla okuxhumana ohlebeni (okubhalwayo nokukhulwayo). Isikhundla sokusebenza ngocingo. Amandla okuhlela futhi ucoe imisebenzi ehlobene nomsebenzi. Ukuziphatha kahle kocingo. Izinga elikhulu lokwethembeka. Amandla okuziphatha ngobungcweti kanye nobumfihlo.
zu.duties: Ukwenza imisebenzi yohlangothi kanye nemisebenzi ejwayelekile yokuphatha. Ukuhlola kanye nokuphendula amakholi ocingo. Ukuthayipha izincwadi zoxhumo. Ukulungisa amadokhumenti kanye nezinkombiso. Kuqiniseke ukuphatha okufanelekile kwamarekhodi ngesisistimu yokugcina amafayela. Ukuphatha isisistimu yokuqaphela amadokhumenti kagesi. Ukulondoloza usuku kanye nokuphatha izinsizakusebenza. Ubhekele ukuphatha kwesistimu yokulandela amadokhumenti. Ukulungisa futhi uhlele izingqungquthela, amakilasi njll. Ukwenza kube lula ukuthenga izinsizakusebenza zohlangothi njengamapeni. Ukwenza yonke imisebenzi edingekayo ehlobene nesikhundla. Ukuhlela yonke imigwalo yezimoto yezinsizakusebenza zangaphandle kwezinkomshi, izifundo, izingqungquthela kanye nokuzwa kwezinsizakusebenza. Ukuphatha izimpahla.

xh.title: Unobumba

xh.requirements: I-Grade 12 ene-typing njengesifundo nanoma yiphi na inqeqesho enye okanye isifungo esiza kumncedi ukuba akwazi ukwenza umsebenzi ngokwanelisayo. Akukho nako yimbi yemfuno. Ukuba nobugcisa ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Iimpawu nezimilo: Inyaniso nokuzithembisa. Kuqwalaselwe iinkcukacha. Ukucwangcisa nokuhlela. Ukufika ngexesha nokugcina iyimfihlo. Ukunikela ngenkonzo nolungelelwaniso kubathengi. Amapolwe amnandi ekunxibelelanani (abhaliweyo nanomlomo). Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphantsi kwegxabiso. Ukuba nakho ukulungelelanisa nokuhlela imisebenzi ehlobene nendima. Amapholwe amnani etefuni. Inqanaba eliphezulu elithembekileyo. Ukuba nakho ukuziphatha ngobulumko nobuzigameko.
xh.duties: Ukuze kwenziwe imisebenzi yofisi netho yonke yolawulo. Ukuthumba uphendule iingxoxo zefowuni. Ukuthayipha iindaba ezingagqitywanga ngezibhalo. Ukuqamba uxwebhu nemboniso. Kuqinisekiswe ulawulo oluqhelekileyo lweerekhodi ngezendlela ezisebenzayo zokugcina iifayile. Ulawulo lwenkqubo yokulandela amaxwebhu kwekhompyutha. Ukugcina idayari nokulawula iindibano. Uxanduva lokulawula inkqubo yokulandela amaxwebhu. Ukulungelelanisa kwaye uqhube iindibano, iindibano zomsebenzi, njl. Ukuze kuncediswe ukuthenga izixhobo zofisi ezinjengesikhokelo. Ukwenza yonke imisebenzi negqibo elihlobene nendima. Ukwenza wonke amalungiselelo okuthutha ngelundibano, amaklasi, iindibano nokuzingela ibhas okwenziwa ngaphandle kweofisi. Ulawulo lwempahla.

af.title: Werkgeerdienskoördineerder
af.summary: Koördineer werkgeerdienste, grensvergtreende arbeidsmigrasie en belanghebbenderelaties by die Department of Employment and Labour se Parktown-provinsiale kantoor.
af.requirements: Drie (3) jaar tersiêre kwalifikasie in Sosiale Wetenskappe (Sielkunde)/ Publieke/ Besigheidsadministrasie. Twee (2) jaar bestuurservaring. Twee (2) jaar funksionele ervaring in Publieke Indiensneming/ Publieke Administrasie/ Bestuursdienste. Kennis: Relevante ILO-konvensies, Finansiële Bestuur, Menslike Hulpbronbestuur, Werwing en Keuringsprosesse. Relevante regeringsstrategieë. Employment Service Act, Unemployment Insurance Act, Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act, PFMA, Public Service Act, Skills Development Act, Immigration Act. zu.title: Umqambi Wezinkonzo Zomqashi
zu.summary: Ukuqamba izinkonzo zomqashi, ukuhamba komsebenzi kwemisebenzi kwezwe nokudlula kuyo kanye nobudlelwano nabaholi bemicimbi esikhungweni sesifundazwe saseParktown samnyango Wezomsebenzi Nolimi.

Employment Service Act, Unemployment Insurance Act, Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act, PFMA, Public Service Act, Skills Development Act, Immigration Act. Ukuhlaziya. Ubucukuzufanele. Ukuqondiswa ikhasimende. Isizwa sobuqu. Isikhathi sokusebenza phansi kwenkomba.
zu.duties: Ukuqamba ukuhamba kwemisebenzi kwabantu kwezwe nokudlula kuyo kanye nemisebenzi ye-PEA/ TES. Ukuqamba ukunikezwa kwezinkonzo kumashishini anezinkinga. Ukuhola ubudlelwano nabaholi bemicimbi ukuze kutholwe amathuba okubekwa abantu kumisebenzi. Ukunikeza inkxaso yokusebenza nobuchwepheshe kumalabhuwozi ukunikezwa kwezinkonzo zomqashi ezisebenzayo. Ukuhola ukunikezwa kwezinsiza ze-IT nokusetshenziswa kwezinto ezintsha ukunikeza inkonzo yomqashi ezisebenzayo. Ukuhola ukugadatshwa kwabasebenzisi be-ESSA abangaphakathi kanye nabangaphandle ngomsebenzi womqashi. Ukuphatha futhi kuhlaziye umbhalo wamashishini omqashi. Ukuphatha onke amatholwazi ku-Sub-Unit.

xh.title: Mlawuli weNkonzo yoQhagamshelano
xh.summary: Lungisa iinkonzo zabasebenzi, ukufuduka komsebenzi phakathi kwemida yamanye amazwe, kunye nobudlelwane beentanda-mntu kwiofisi yephondo lesebe lokuvakalwa labasebenzi kwindawo ebizwa ngokuba yiParktown.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sesithathu (3) sekufanelekileyo kwikholeji/univesithi kwizenzululwazi eZentlalo-ntle (iPsychology)/kuRhuqo lwaMazwe/kwiQondo lwaBizinesi. Iiminyaka emibini (2) yamava okulawula. Iiminyaka emibini (2) yamava asebenzayo kwiNkonzo kaRhulumente /kuLawulo lwaRhulumente /kwiNkonzo zoLawulo. Ulwazi: Imanyualiso zoQhagamshelano lweLabho yomZantsi Afrika (ILO Conventions), uLawulo lweMali, uLawulo lweZabantu, iinkqubo zoQeqesho kunye noKhetho. Iindlela ezifanelekileyo zeshishini karhulumente. uMthetho weNkonzo yoQhagamshelano, uMthetho woVimba weNgqalelo, uMthetho woRhwebo lweNgxaki zoMsebenzi ngeZifo, i-PFMA, uMthetho weNkonzo kaRhulumente, uMthetho woPhuhliso lwamakhono, uMthetho woRhwebo lwangaphandle. Uhlalutyo. Ukuqamba izinto ezitsha. Ukuqwalasela umthengi. Ubumi. Ikhono lokusebenza ngexesha lokuxinzeleka.
xh.duties: Lungisa iNhambano yoQhagamshelano lweNtlalo-ntle yoNyuso lwabasebenzi eMzantsi Afrika kunye namanye amazwe (International Cross-Border Labour Migration) kunye namagunya e-PEA/TES. Lungisa ukubonelelwa kweenkonzo kwiinkampani ezisengxwini. Khokela ubudlelwane beentanda-mntu ukufumana ithuba lokubekwa kumsebenzi. Bonezela inkxaso yemisebenzi yemini nobuchule kwiiziko zabasebenzi ukuze kuqedwe ngokusebenziseka koluntu olusebenzayo kubasebenzi. Khokela ukubonelelwa kweziseko ze-IT nokusebenzisa iingcinga ezitsha ukuze kuqedwe ngokusebenziseka koluntu olusebenzayo kubasebenzi. Khokela uqeqesho lwabasebenzisi bokugqibela be-ESSA (bangaphakathi kunye nabangaphandle) kweenkonzo zabasebenzi. Lawula uphonononge iingxelo ngeenkonzo zabasebenzi. Lawula onke amacebo kwesele esincinci.

Hlela kwaye uphumeze iziphithiphithi ngokuzimela ezigqibwe ngamacala obikwe malunga nokuqhuka komthetho weNtsimbi yezaBasebenzi, kwaye ugcizele ngokuba sako xa kufuneka, kuquka nokulungiselela imiboniso nokuvela eNkundleni njengongqondile weLizwe. zu.duties: Hlela futhi wenze ngokuzimele izinspektion ngenjongo yokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi kuhlonishwe umthetho wezimo ezisisekelo zokusebenza (BCEA). Wenze ngokuzimele uphenyo ngamacala abikhiwe ahlobene nokungalaleli komthetho wabasebenzi futhi uwaphikezele lapho kunesidingo. xh.requirements: Ithobeli lemfundo ephakamileyo leminyaka emithathu (3) kwi-Labour Relations/ BCOM Law/ LLB. Unyaka omnye (1) wamava asebenzayo kwii-Inspesha namasevisi oLawulo. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi: Iinkqubo, iinkqubo zomgangatho zesebe, i-Skills Development Act, i-Labour Relation Act, i-Basic Conditions of Employment Act, i-Skills Development Levies Act, i-Occupational Health and Safety Act, i-COIDA, i-Unemployment Insurance Act, i-UI Contribution Act, i-Employment Equity Act. Amakhono: Amakhono okukhokela iinkqubo, uKucwangcisa nokuQamba (Ngokuyinhloko eziqu), ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, amakhono abantu, amakhono okusombulula iingxabano, amakhono okuxoxisana, amakhono okusombulula iingxaki, amakhono ephendulwano, okulalelayo nokuqaphela, amakhono okubonisa, okutsha, okuhlalutyo, amakhono okunxibelelwana ngomlomo nakubhalwe.
xh.duties: Cwangcisa kwaye uze wenze ngokuzimeleyo iingqinqo ngenjongo yokwenza iqinisekiso lokuzinza kwi-Basic Conditions of Employment Act (BCEA). Zenzele iingxoxvinzulu ngokuzimeleyo kwiimeko ezibikisiweyo ezingqamana nokwaphuka-kwaphuka komthetho wabasebenzi kwaye uze ulawule xa kufuneka. Cwangcisa kwaye wenze ngamaxesha athile iingqinqo ezingeniswayo (Blitz) ukuqikelela ulawulo lokuzinza kumthetho wabasebenzi. Qhuba inkqubo yokuvakalisa ngawo onke amathetho abasebenzi ngokuzimeleyo. Qumba kwaye ulondoloze iindlela zeengqinqo nemiqulu equka uhlalutyo kunye nokudibanisa imiqulu yezibalo ezibekiweyo kuphela kwiimeko ezabelweyo.

af.title: Inspekteur

zu.title: Inspektha
zu.summary: Inspektha eLabour Centre eSabie ongemxhasi wokwenza ukuphenya ngemisebenzi kanye nokuphoqa ukuthobela umthetho wabasebenzi.
zu.requirements: Ithathu (3) iminyaka yeziqu ezihambisana neLabour Relations/ BCOM Law/ LLB. Akukho mqondo ofunekayo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi: Izinqubo namapholisi omnyango, Skills Development Act, Labour Relation Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Unemployment Insurance Act kanye neUnemployment Insurance Contributions Act. Amakhono: Amakhono okuhola, Ukuhlela nokuhamba kahle (Umsebenzi wakho), Ukusebenza ngogxoba (Spread sheet, PowerPoint nokubhala amagama), Amakhono abantu, Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, Amakhono okuphatisa imibuzo, Ukuhlaziya, Amakhono okuxoxa nokuqamba kanye neEmployment Equity Act.
zu.duties: Yenza ukuphenya ngemisebenzi nenhloso yokugqinisekisa ukuthobela bonke omthetho wabasebenzi. Phenza iziphindiselwe emikhalweni ebalulekile mayelana nokwesuka komthetho wabasebenzi uphoke lapho nasesikhathini kudingeka khona. Yenza ukuphenya okungazange kucashunwe (Blitz) njalo ukuqapha ukuthobela umthetho wabasebenzi. Yiza amakhampa okuqasula emthethweni wabasebenzi okutholiwe nokwabeliwe. Siza ukubhala icebo lokuphenya, imibhalo nokuhlanganisa izibalo emikhalweni ebanjwe.

xh.title: Isiphenduli-dyaphu
xh.summary: Isiphenduli-dyaphu kwiZiko leLabour eliseSabie exandulwe ukuqhuba iinqwelo zokuqina kwabasebenzi kwaye uphothule ukulandelwa kolwathi ngeendaba zolawulo lwabasebenzi.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezifanelekileyo zemyanga emithathu (3) kwabasebenzi basebe ngenxabaxa/ BCOM Law/ LLB. Akukho mphumelelo idisiwe. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi: Iindlela nezicwangciso zesebe, Skills Development Act, Labour Relation Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Unemployment Insurance Act nese Unemployment Insurance Contributions Act. Izakhono: Izakhono zokuqhuba, ukuqamba nokuhlela (umsebenzi wakho), ukuqhathanisa izibalo (Spread sheet, PowerPoint kwaye yonke imisebenzi yamagama), izakhono zokusebenzisana nabantu, izakhono zokusombulula iingxaki, izakhono zovavabyo, izikhundo ezibonwayo, izakhono zokuthetha nokuqamba, nese Employment Equity Act.
xh.duties: Qhuba iinqwelo zokuqina kwabasebenzi ngenjongo yokugcina ukulandelwa kolwathi olusemthethweni. Qhubeke uphando ngeendaba eziduliswe kwindawo ezithetha ngokuphula umthetho wobugcisa bolwazio lwabasebenzi kwaye ulawule apho naxa kuyimfuneko. Qhuba iinqwelo zokuqina (Blitz) ngokuzimela zonke iintsuku ukuze ulawule ukulandelwa kolwazio lwabasebenzi. Qhuba iinkampani zokuqeqesha ngolwazio lwabasebenzi oluboniswe kwaye olwabiweyo. Nceda ekubhaleni isicwangciso seenqwelo, iingxelo kwaye uhlele izibalo ngeendaba ezabelwe kona.

af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Bosbou of 'n relevante kwalifikasie binne die verwante veld soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in bosbou of 'n verwante veld waarvan drie (3) jaar op toegangsekunstige bestuursvlak (Assistentdirekteur-vlak of gelykwaardig) moet wees. Kennis van National Forest Act 1998 (Act 84 of 1998), National Veld and Forest Fire Act 1998 (Act 101 0f 1998), NEMA, NEMBA, Protected Areas, Land Reform Legislations en ander omgewingswetgewing insluitend Public Finance Regulations, Public Service Regulations, en PFMA. Kennis van die bosbou- en omgewingsbestuursektor. Kennis van enumerasie vir data-insameling. Verslagskryfvaardighede en finansiële bestuur. Uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede (geskrewe en mondeling). Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Vermoë om individueel en in 'n span te werk. Vermoë om onder uiterste druk te werk. Vermoë om inligting in te samel en te ontleed. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te reis.
af.duties: Bestuur die ontwikkeling en hersiening van Nasionale Sertifiseringsstandaarde. Raadpleeg alle belanghebbendes om hul insette te verkry en te konsolideer. Werk die standaarde in die bosousektor deur in werksessies. Monitor die implementering van die standaarde op staatsbosland. Hersien PCI &S-raamwerk. Fasiliteer en monitor die implementering van PCI & S op staatsbosland. Ontwikkel en hersien norme en standaarde vir volhoubare bosboubestuur. zu.title: Isikhundla sikaSekela Mfundi: Ukweluleka kokuPhatha amahlathi
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaSekela Mfundi ePretoria sokuqondisa ukuthuthukiswa kwemigomo yokufakazela amahlathi, ukubonisana nabaphathi bezingxenye kanye nokuqaphela ukuphoqelelwa kwayo emhlabeni wamahlashi kahulumeni.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma yezwe (NQF Level 6) kwezohlahla noma izifundo ezihambisana naleso sikhulu njengoba zivunyiwe yi-SAQA. Okungenani amalunga amahlanu (5) eminyaka yohlu lobudala emsebenzini wezohlahla noma enkundleni ehlobene nawo, lapho kuyadingeka khona iminyaka emithathu (3) ibe ngazinga elingangena eliphansi lokuphatha (elinga lkaSekela Mfundi noma okulingana nalo). Ukwazi ngomthetho weZwezamahlathi wonyaka we-1998 (Act 84 of 1998), umthetho we-1998 weNational Veld and Forest Fire Act (Act 101 0f 1998), i-NEMA, i-NEMBA, i-Protected Areas, i-Land Reform Legislations kanye nomthetho wezemvelo ohunyushwe, okuhlanganisa namathetho ezezimali kahulumeni, amathetho abasebenzi bomphakathi, kanye ne-PFMA. Ukwazi ngesikhulu sezohlahla nesesekthori yophatho kwemvelo. Ukwazi ngokuqoqa imininingwane. Amakhono okubhala umbiko kanye nokuphatha izimali. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana (okuqoshiwe nokuwakhuluma). Amakhono okucubungula futhi ukuhlele. Ikhono lokusebenza wedwa nakwisiqhingi. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi enkulu. Ikhono lokuthola kanye nokuqoqonda imininingwane. Ilayisense yokushayela esemthethweni kanye nesithembu sokuhamba.
zu.duties: Qondisa ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokubuyekeza imigomo yezwe yokufakazela. Bonisana nabo bonke abaphathi bezingxenye ukuze uthole futhi uhlanganise okufakwayo kwabo. Yenza izinkulumo-mfundisano ngesimiso kwisikhulu sezohlahla. Qaphela ukuphoqelelwa kwesimiso emhlabeni wezohlahla kahulumeni. Buyekeza isakhiwo se-PCI &S, qondisa futhi uqophe ukusetshenziswa kwe-PCI & S emhlabeni wamahlathi kahulumeni. Thuthukisa futhi ubuyekeze imigomo kanye namazinga okuphatha amahlathi ngendlela egcinwayo. Qondisa ukuqinisekiswa kwemininingwane yezibalo zokuqikelela. Qikelela inani lezihlahla ngokulandela izidingo zemigomo yezibalo. Thuthukisa isu sokuqhuba imibiko kaGeneral Director. Phatha isibaluli sesetu se-Biological Asset Database. Thuthukisa futhi uqondise izindlela ezihamba phambili zokusebenza. Buyekeza izindlela ezihamba phambili zokusebenza futhi unike okufakwayo kumali ehhushwa kumahlathi.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Ukuqulunqa uLwalathiso loKulawula ihlathi

xh.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF Level 6) kwi-Forestry okanye isifundo esihambelana nalo kweliphi elithintekayo njengoko kugunyaziswa yi-SAQA. Amava amabalikhulu ahlanayo kwiminyaka elithoba (5) kwi-forestry okanye kwelinye igatya elihlobene nalo, apho kumagatya amathathu (3) kufuneka abe kwinqanaba elingasentla kolawulo (inqanaba loMcedisi kaSekela Mongameli okanye elilingana nalo). Ulwazi ngomthetho weNational Forest Act 1998 (Act 84 of 1998), umthetho weNational Veld and Forest Fire Act 1998 (Act 101 0f 1998), i-NEMA, i-NEMBA, umthetho weProtected Areas, umthetho weLand Reform Legislations namanye amathethwe okusingathwa kwendalo kuquka i-Public Finance Regulations, i-Public Service Regulations, ne-PFMA. Ulwazi ngegatya le-Forestry nangokusingathwa kwendalo. Ulwazi ngokuthatha ulwazi olulungeleleneyo. Amakhono okubhala iingxelo nolawulo lwezemali. Amakhono amabalikleyo okuva ekubalulweni (okubhalwayo nokuTHethwayo). Amakhono okuqulunqa nokuHloma. Ikhono lokusebenza njengomntu yedwa nakwidyunyetho. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi kogxininiso olumandla. Ikhono lokuthola nokuHlola ulwazi. Ilayisensi yokuqamba etyiileyo nento yokuzithanda ukuhamba.
xh.duties: Lawula ukuphuhliswa nokuHlola iNational Certification Standards. Vakathintabathinti nabo bonke abathintekayo ukuze ufumane uze udibanise izimvo zabo. Yenza iindlela zokusebenza ezigqityiweyo kwigatya le-Forestry. Jonga ukusebenzisa kwale milinganiselo kumhlaba wamahlathi karhulumente. Hlola inkqubo ye-PCI &S, Yenza kwaye ulawule ukusebenzisa kwe-PCI &S kumhlaba wamahlathi karhulumente. Phuhlisa uze uHlole imigcabo nemilinganiselo yolawulo oluqhubekisela phambili lwehlathi. Lawula ukuQinisekisa ulwazi ngeziBaliso zoxabiso. Bala ixabiso leplantation ngokuthobela iimfuno zemilinganiselo ye-accounting. Phuhlisa icebo lesiNzo ngokuBalulela izindaba eziNcomeyo zaSekela-Gunjurhisweyo. Lawula i-Biological Asset Database. Phuhlisa uze usebenzise iindlela ezilungileyo zokusebenza. Hlola iindlela ezilungileyo zokusebenza uze unike izimvo ngokweentlawulo ze-Forestry.

af.title: Kommunikasieingenieur/-tegnikus
af.summary: Kommunikasieingenieur/-tegnikus benodig om kommunikasie-, satelliet-, radio- en IT-stelsels by die Marion Island-basis te onderhou en te herstel.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Elektroniese, Rekenaarwetenskap Ingenieurswese, IT of 'n tersykkwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken, met 'n minimum van 3 jaar ervaring na kwalifikasie. Bevoegdheid in elektroniese onderhoud, diagnostiek en herstel met bewese foutsoekvermoëns. By voorkeur ervaring hê in V-Sat Satellite Systems, IT (bestuur van 'n rekenaarnetwerk met LINUX-bedieners en roeteerders), HF- en VHF-2-weg-radiotoerusting en -bedryf, Telefoonstelsels (PABX's en VOIP), PC's, Fire Detection Systems, GPS's, en algemene elektroniese toerustingherstel. Die ampsdraer moet bevoegd wees in die gebruik van 'n Oscilloscope, Spectrum Analyser, ens., en vertroud wees met goeie werkwinkelpraktyke, korrekte gebruik van basiese werkwinkelnutsgereedskap en 'n begrip van huidige werk-, gesondheids- en veiligheidsbeleide. Die ampsdraer moet in staat wees om onafhanklik met minimale ondersteuning onder uiterste druk en sonder toesig te werk. Die ampsdraer moet rekenaarvaardig wees, oor goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede beskik en die vermoë hê om in 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Die ampsdraer sal verantwoordelik wees vir die bedryf, onderhoud, foutsoeking en herstel van al die kommunikasiedienste en -toerusting van ons Marion Base insluitend die satelliet-, radio-, IT-, GPS-, alarm- en telefoonstelsels. Bedryf vraghanteringsroerusting. Die ampsdraer sal aan die spanleier rapporteer en deel wees van die tegniese span, gelei deur die tegniese spanleier wat enige bykomende basisverwante tegniese funksies moet uitvoer. Berei maandelikse en jaarlikse verslae voor, doen voorraadopnames om onderdele en toerusting te bestel en verrig ander algemene "nie-tegniese" pligte wat deur ekspedisielede uitgevoer word.

zu.title: Injiniya/Wesikilini Wezokuxhumana
zu.summary: Kudingeka injiniya/wesikilini wezokuxhumana ukuze ahlale futhi alungise izimiso zokuxhumana, zomsatelayithi, zerediyo neze-IT esikhungweni se-Marion Island.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma Yezwe (NQF Level 6) kwezika-Elekthronikhi, eNjiniya Yezesayensi Yekhompyutha, i-IT noma izifundo ezihambisana nalokho ezivunyiwe yi-SAQA okunesiphephelo seminyaka engu-3 yohlu lwemisebenzi emumva kokuthola izifundo. Ukukwazi ukuletha ukweluleka kwezika-elekthronikhi, ukuthola izinkinga nokuzilungisa okubonakala ngokuba n amandla okuthola iziphazamiso. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kuhle kakhulu uma umuntu enolwazi kumasewebe we-V-Sat Satellite Systems, i-IT (okuyilawula inethiwekhi yekhompyutha esebenzisa abalekeleli be-LINUX kanye nabalahulekisi), kolwanganda kwe-HF ne-VHF 2-way radio kanye nokusebenza kwawo, izimiso zocingo (i-PABX's ne-VOIP), ama-PC's, izimiso zokubona imililo, ama-GPS's, nokulungisa izinto zensimbi yezika-elekthronikhi ngokuvamile. Lowo othatha isikhundla kumele akwazi ukusebenzisa i-Oscilloscope, i-Spectrum Analyser, njll., futhi azi izindlela ezinhle zokusebenza esitudiyweni, ukusebenzisa kahle izinsiza ezisisekelo zolwandi, kanye nokuqonda izinqubomgomo zokuqhubeka ngokuhambisana nomsebenzi, impilo nokuphepha. Lowo othatha isikhundla kumele akwazi ukusebenza eyedwa ngaphandle kwezindlela eziningi zokwesekela ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima futhi ngaphandle kokuhola. Lowo othatha isikhundla kumele azi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, abe nethalente elihle lokukhuluma nokubhala, futhi akwazi ukusebenza eqenjini.
zu.duties: Lowo othatha isikhundla uzobe ngumuntu ophethe ukusebenza, ukugcina, ukuthola izinkinga nokulungisa yonke imisebenzi nezinsiza zokuxhumana esikhungweni se-Marion Base kubalwa khona izimiso zomsatelayithi, zerediyo, ze-IT, ze-GPS, zokulumisa kanye nezocingo. Ukusebenzisa izinto ezingenisa nokuqashwa komthwalo. Lowo othatha isikhundla uzobika kumholi weqembu, futhi uzoba yingxenye yeqembu lobuchwepheshe, eliholwa umholi webuchwepheshe olimele lenze noma yimiphi eminye imisebenzi ebandakanya ubuchwepheshe besikhungo. Uzolungisa imibiko yenyanga nonyaka, abale imigidingo yokuthola nokulungisa ukudluliswa kwezinsiza ezilungisayo kwenze neminye imisebenzi evamile engasebenziselwa ubuchwepheshe eyeqenjini lezinhlangavula.

xh.title: Injiniere/Umzekeli wolonxibelelwano
xh.summary: Kufunekwa injiniere/umzekeli wolonxibelelwano ukugcina kwaye alungise iinkqubo zolonxibelelwano, zesathelayithi, zerediyo kunye nezobuchwepheshe bekhompyutha kwiziko le Marion Island.
xh.requirements: National Diploma (NQF Level 6) kwi Electronic, Computer Science Engineering, IT okanye ngesiqualifications esamkelwe yi SAQA ngamacandelo angu-3 eminyaka yamava emva kokufumana isiqu. Ukuzipatha ekugciniweni, ekunxibelelaneni naye kulungiseni izinto zombane nako kubonakalisa isakhono sokufumana iingenxa. Kufuneka abe namava kwi V-Sat Satellite Systems, IT (ukulawula inethiwekhi yekhompyutha nge LINUX servers kunye ne routers), kwi HF kunye ne VHF 2-way radio equipment nendlela yokuyisebenzisa, kwi Telephone systems (PABX's kunye ne VOIP), kwi PC's, kwi Fire Detection Systems, kwi GPS's, nasekulungiseni ulwelo olubanzi lweqela le electronics. Kufuneka akwazi ukusebenzisa i Oscilloscope, i Spectrum Analyser, njl., akwazi ukuqonda iindlela ezilungileyo zokusebenza, ukusebenzisa ngokuchanekileyo izixhobo ezisisiseko zendawo yokusebenza nokuyiqonda imigaqo yokuqhuba iyure, yempilo n yokhuseleko yanamhlanje. Kufuneka akwazi ukusebenza aze athile ngexesha elinzima lingathathi nkxame aze aqedele ingcaciso encinane aze angathathi nkxaxheba ngokubeka. Kufuneka akwazi ukusebenzisa iikhompyutha, akwazi ukunxibelelana ngesityhileteto nangokubhala kakuhle aske akwazi ukusebenza ngokubakho kwethim.
xh.duties: Kufuneka abe ngumnikeni wokuphatha, ukugcina, ukuzifumana iingenxa kunye nokuqamba konke onke amacebo olonxibelelwano nempahla yase Marion Base, kuqulathe iinkqubo zesathelayithi, zerediyo, zobuchwepheshe bekhompyutha, ze GPS, zetyhola ngered yo, nezefowuni. Phatha iimpahla zokusingatha umthwalo. Umyalezeli ngumntu oya kubikisa kumntu onethemba, ukwazi ukuba ngowethim labasebenzi bamacandelo, angene amagunya ngumntu ophatha ukuba nokuzimisela ngaluphi na uluntu oluhlobene nendawo yokusebenza ezongezelelweko. Lungise iingcelo zeminye ngeminye yomnyaka, wenze ukubala ukugcina ngokulungiselela ukulungelelanisa imigibe nempahla wenze eminye imisebenzi egeyileyo yamalungu e expedition.

xh.title: Control Biodiversity Officer Grade A: World Heritage
xh.summary: Ukulungelelanisa inkathazo yeSouth Africa kwizikhululo zeKomiti yeWorld Heritage, nokomeleza intsebenziswano phakathi kwamazwe malunga neemfuno eziphambili ze-biodiversity kwisebe lezo Ntshona, iNtlambo kunye neNdalo.
xh.requirements: IDigri yeminyaka emine (NQF8) kwi-Natural / Environmental Sciences okanye isifundo esihambelanayo njengokwamkelwa yiSAQA kwaye ngaphezu kweminyaka emithandathu (6) yamava emva kwesifundo kwilungelo elihambelanayo. Ulwazi ngeMithetho yeZenzo zeNdalo (WHCA, NEMPAA, NEMA, NEMBA). Ukuqonda imithetho yelifa lemfuyo. Ulwazi ngeNkqubo ezihambelana ne-UNESCO. Ulwazi ngeNkqubo zoKunikwa i gama nendlela yokuwazisa kwiWorld Heritage; Iinkqubo zesayensi ezilawula ulawulo kwindawo yeWorld heritage kunye neMithetho, iintsilinganisyo neemigangatho, iplani nolungiselelo. Amava ekuphandayo nokuhlalutya. Ikhalipha lokuphucula, ukuceba nokusebenzisa iinkqubo. Amava amninzi ebhanini naseluxoweni lokunxibelelana; Amava amniniz abantu, ulungiselelo nentshukumo; amava ebhalwe kakhulu tecgnical report. Ikhalipha lokusebenza yedwa nakwindlu. Ikhalipha yokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo olugqithisileyo.
xh.duties: Ukomeleza intsebenziswano yawamazwe aphezulu exhasa iimfuno eziphambili ze-Biodiversity ze-SA. Ukwenza lula iintlanganiso ezilungiselelayo ze-SA (Zwelonke) zeKomiti yeWorld Heritage, Isikhululo seQela elijikelezayo nanayo nayiphi na enye iKomiti engahlawulwayo. Ukulungelelanisa inkathazo kumthunywa we-SA kwezi ntlanganiso zamazwe aphesheya kuquka intlanganiso yokulungiselela yaseAfrika kwiKomiti yeWorld Heritage. Ukomeleza imfundo nokuziqonda kwesebe. Ukuphucula uxwebhu lokuyila ukuba lulawule icebo lenkqubo kuquka ukumapa iinxibelelanisi zamazwe aphesheya nasekhaya, Ababemenelee, Iziqulatho eziza kugqithwa kunye neziphumo zo lonke loo msebenzi. Ukuphucula iingxelo zemiphumoy. Kuqinisekiswe ulawulo olulinganeyo nolulungileyo loluntu. Ukwenza lula ukuphucula nokuphonononga izivumelwano kunye nabo nxibelelanisi abahambelanayo. Ukulondoloza, ukukhusela nokunciphisa iingozi ze-biodiversity. Ukuqhubana namazwe kwiimeko ze-transboundary okanye iWorld Heritage esislandelayo ukuxoxa ngolawulo nomthetho, iinkqubo namanye amacebo asebenzayo ekusebenzeni kweNkqubo eSouth Africa.

Goeie kommunikasie vaardighede. Rekenaar geletterdheid. Leierskap. Fasilitering. Analitiese vaardighede. Vermoe om vrywillig lang ure te werk. Vermoe om inligting in te samel en te analiseer. Vermoe om beleide te ontwikkel en toe te pas. Vermoe om individueel en in 'n span te werk. Goeie interpersoonlike verhouding vaardighede. Vermoe om onder uiterste druk te werk. Vermoe om met moeilike mense te werk en konflik op te los. Die kandidaat moet 'n geldige bestuurslisensie (Code B) hê en bereid wees om wyd en syd te reis.
af.duties: Die amptenaar sal verantwoordelik wees vir die instandhouding van die ontwikkeling van die Departement se kapasiteit om doeltreffende olie-kwytreaksie te lewer. Verseker doeltreffende beheer oor die storting van afval en ander materiaal ter see. Implementeer die Regulasies vir Omgewingsbestuur van Offskeep-tot-skeep-oordragte. Ontwikkel maatreëls om mariene besoedeling vanaf skeepvaart te beheer. Handhaaf die Departement se internasionale verpligtinge ten opsigte van mariene besoedeling.

zu.title: Isikhundla Sikahlelo Lokulawula Izindaba Zemvelo Isibili: A: Otholakala Kulsethuhlazenithangathi

Unyaka angu-6 wokuhlangenwe nakho ngemva kokuthola isiqu. Izinhlelo zomthetho zokuqashwa kolwandle kanye nokuqashwa komngcele wasogwini. Ukuphathwa kohlangothi. Sebenzisa izinhlelo zomthetho zokuqashwa kwemvelo zokudluliswa kwamafutha olwandle phakathi kwamayolukwandisemsebenzi yamafutha. jobs.title: Electrical Engineer/technician
jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.salary_text: R605 742 per annum, (plus 37% in lieu of service benefits)
jobs.closing_date_text: 09 November 2026, 16:00. No late applications will be accepted
jobs.summary: Electrical engineer or technician required to maintain and repair all electrical equipment at Marion Island base, including power generators and facility systems.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma in Electrical Engineering or relevant comparable qualification (NQF6) as recognised by SAQA with a minimum of five years post trade / qualification experience. Be competent in plant maintenance, power generation, diagnostics and repairs with proven fault-finding capabilities. Preferably have hands-on experience in facility management. The incumbent has to be familiar with good workshop practices, correct use of basic workshop tools and an understanding of current work, health and safety policies. It would be an advantage if there is experience with maintenance management plans as well as all the services that would be found in facilities like hotels or hospitals. The incumbent must be computer literate, have good verbal and written communication skills and the ability to work in a team.
jobs.duties: The incumbent will be responsible for the operation, maintenance, fault-finding on and repairs of all the electrical equipment of Marion Base and associated buildings and field huts, including the power generators, forklift, air- conditioning-, refrigeration, water reticulation and waste water systems. All electrical work will have to be done by this person. Operate cargo handling equipment. The incumbent will report to the team leader and will be part of the technical team, led by the technical team leader that has to perform any additional base related technical functions. Prepare monthly and annual reports, do stock-takes to order spares and equipment and do other common “non-technical” duties performed by expedition members.
jobs.enquiries: Mr Willem Boshoff Tel No: (021) 493 7379
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.environment.gov.za/
jobs.notes: The incumbent will execute duties at a Sub/Antarctic Base and adhere to the health, safety and environmental requirements. The successful applicant will spend a full year (April 2027 to May 2028) at Marion Island. There is no option to return to South Africa before May 2028. The ability to work and live with small groups of people is thus essential. Although the base is well-equipped with e- mail, fax and satellite telephone facilities, the applicant has to be self-sufficient and self-motivated. The location may affect both the physical and mental well- being of the incumbent, their family and close relationships. Candidates must be physically fit, mentally strong and prepared for physically challenging and satisfying work. In addition the successful candidates may often be called upon to work long hours in extreme conditions on duties unrelated to their function. Short-listed candidates will be subjected to screening and security vetting to determine their suitability for employment. Appointment to these positions is subject to a rigorous medical examination as well as psychometric assessment, which will be arranged for at no cost to the applicants. Interested applicants must submit their applications via the above link. Applicant must ensure that they complete all sections on the online Z83 and attached a detailed CV with at least three (3) contactable references. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, Senior Certificate, identity document and driver’s license on or before the day of the interview. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). The National Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. Preference may be given to appointable applicants from the underrepresented designated groups in terms of the Department’s equity plan. Persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply. Correspondence will be limited to successful candidates only. Short-listed candidates will be subjected to screening and security vetting to determine their suitability for employment, including but not limited to: Criminal records; Citizenship status; Credit worthiness; Previous employment (reference checks); and Qualification verification. Short-listed candidates will be expected to avail themselves at the Department’s convenience. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: In terms of the Directive on Compulsory Capacity Development, Mandatory Training Days & Minimum Entry Requirements for SMS that was introduced on 1 April 2015, a requirement for all applicants for SMS posts from 1 April 2020 is a successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG) prior to appointment. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entryprogramme. Furthermore, Shortlisted candidates must provide proof of successful completion of the course. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Following the interview and the technical exercise of all SMS posts, the Selection Panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic managerial competency assessment in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency-based assessments. Persons appointed will be subjected to a security clearance, the signing of performance agreement and employment contract. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment. af.title: Elektriese ingenieur/tegnikus
af.summary: Elektriese ingenieur of tegnikus word vereis om alle elektriese toerusting by Marion Island-basis te onderhou en te herstel, insluitend kragopwekkers en fasiliteitsstelsels.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma in Elektriese Ingenieurswese of 'n toepaslike vergelykbare kwalifikasie (NQF6) soos deur SAQA erken met 'n minimum van vyf jaar ervaring na ambag/kwalifikasie. Wees bevoeg in aanlegonderhoud, kragopwekking, diagnostiek en herstelwerk met bewese foutopsporingsvermoëns. By voorkeur praktiese ervaring in fasiliteitsbestuur hê. Die ampsdraer moet vertroud wees met goeie werkswinkelpraktyke, die korrekte gebruik van basiese werkswiligereedskap en 'n begrip van huidige werks-, gesondheids- en veiligheidsbeleid. Dit sal 'n voordeel wees indien daar ervaring is met onderhoudsbestuursplanne asook al die dienste wat in fasiliteite soos hotelle of hospitale aangetref word. Die ampsdraer moet rekenaargeletterd wees, goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede hê en die vermoë hê om in 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Die ampsdraer sal verantwoordelik wees vir die werking, onderhoud, foutopsporing op en herstel van alle elektriese toerusting van Marion-basis en gepaardgaande geboue en veldhutte, insluitend die kragopwekkers, vurkhywer, lugversorging-, verkoeling-, waterretikulasie- en afvalwaterstelsels. Alle elektriese werk sal deur hierdie persoon gedoen moet word. Laai-hanterings_toerusting bedryf. Die ampsdraer sal aan die spanleier verslag doen en deel wees van die tegniese span, gelei deur die tegniese spanleier wat enige bykomende basisverwante tegniese funksies moet uitvoer. Maak maandelikse en jaarlikse verslae op, doen voorraadopnames om onderdele en toerusting te bestel en doen ander algemene "nie-tegniese" pligte wat deur ekspedisielede uitgevoer word.

zu.title: Injiniri/Tekhnishini Yamandla Kagesi
zu.summary: Isifundo esingaba yi-Diploma yezwe lonke kwezokwelapha kagesi noma esifanayo esingangeni (NQF6) njengoba kubonwa yi-SAQA; kanye nokuba nobuncw bokusebenza iminyaka emihlanu ukwegqoka emsebenzini wezobuchwepheshe. Kubhekwe ukuba ukhulu ekugcineni kwesitashi, ekwakheni amandla kagesi, ekubukeni izinto ezingaka kagesi; futhi ukhokhele ekubukeni okuhle ekwaziseni izinto ezingaka kagesi. Okunye okungaba khona ukuba lapho kwakwenziwa imisebenzi yeziyingcwecwana ezohlobene nemilando ekhaya. Umphathi walezosikhundla kufanele azibe ngcono ngemisebenzi yethmini; azibe nokutshalwa kwezinyathelo ezingukho kokugqamisa imisebenzi; kanye nokuqonda okuhle kwemisebenzi yokugqamisa izinto ekhaya; futhi aqonde izinhlelo zemisebenzi yokugcina amandla amakhulu. Kuzomeka nendlela ezokwenza umphathi walezosikhundla athande ukuthola abantu abangangena emzini abazoba khona emilweni yalaba bantu abangakwazi ukuba namathalasa ekubone imisebenzi yamanye amaphoh, ayibone imisebenzi yokuthuthukisa imilando ekhaya kanye namanye amaphoyisa. Umphathi walezosikhundla kufanele azibe ngcono ekusebenzeni ngekhomphyutha; kanye nokuba khona abantu abangaba khona emhlabeni jikele abakwazi ukuthula besebenza; futhi abakwazi ukuba namandla okubeka uhlelo lweqembu.
zu.requirements: Izidingo
zu.duties: Umphathi walezosikhundla uzobe egxile ekusebenzeni, ekugcinweni, ekutholeni izinkinga nasekulungenisweni kwazo zonke izingxenye ze-kagesi ezenza kwi-Marion Base kanye neminye imilando ehambisana nayo; kuhlanganise izinto ezingiso kagesi, i-forklift, izinhlelo zomoya oqandisiwe, ebandlomulo, izinhlelo zokuhambisa amanzi nezesihambi. Wonke umsebenzi ophathelene kagesi kuzomeba kwenziwa loyo muntu. Ukuqasha izinto ezibeka ukushaywa komthwalo. Umphathi walezosikhundla uzobe abika kumholi weqembu; futhi uzobe engxenye yeqembu elibuswa ngumholi ezinga eliphakeme elibheke emisebenzi yonke ephathelene nobuchwepheshe. Kuzomeka ahlombe imibiko yanyanga zonke kanye nenyanga zonke; abuye okubalwa ukugcugca izinto; ukuze alunge ukuthenga izingxenye ezelulekile; kanye nokuba namandla okwenza imisebenzi ehlehlukuneyo evezwe ngamalunga aphuma olimini.

xh.title: Injiniye/Umsebenzisi wezobuchwepheshe kwezombane
xh.summary: Kufuneki injiniye yezombane okanye umsebenzisi wezobuchwepheshe kwezombane ukuze agcine ajule onke amacebo ezombane kwiziko leMarion Island, kuquka nabadayinisi bamandla kunene namacebo ezifcilisi.
xh.requirements: National Diploma kwi-Electrical Engineering okanye isigaba esifanayo esihambelana nalo (NQF6) njengokoqatshwa yiSAQA ngokumbonelela weminyaka emihlanu ubudala wolwazi emva kweziqu / kwesikhuselo. Makabe neliso ekugcineni kwiplanti, ekudaliseni amandla, ekuqondweni iingxaki nakulungisweni ngamandla obungcali bokufumana iingxaki. Ngokuzithanda mabanembono ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi ekulawulweni kwefacility. Lo mntu makaziqhelanise nendlela ezilungileyo zokusebenza kwiiworkshop, nokusetyenziswa kolona ngokuchanekileyo lwamathuluzi abalulekileyo eeworkshop, noqonda iimalizo zangoku zemigaqo yomsebenzi, yempilo nentlakuhlazo. Bekuya kubalulekile ukuba akhona ulwazi ngamaplani olawulo lwesiphithiphathi, nakuzo onke iinkonzo ezikwindawo ezinjengeehotele okanye iisibhedlele. Lo mntu makakwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, abe neliswe ngokuthetha nje nokubhala, nakwakhona ukuba anamandla okusebenza eqele.
xh.duties: Lo mntu uya kuba ngumntu oqhuba, ogcinya, ofuna iingxaki, ulungisa onke amacebo ezombane eMarion Base, nezakhiwo ezinxulumene nayo, neendawo zokuhlala zasemaphandleni, kuquka nabadayinisi bamandla, lifthi, i-air-conditioning, ukubuyisa amanzi, kunene nendlela yokuqoqwa kwamaza. Onke amasebenzi ezombane makuwenziwa ngumntu lo. Ukuqhuba amacebo okusingathwa kwenkunkuma. Lo mntu uya kuvela kwintloko ye-qela, aze abengumntu weqela lezobuchwepheshe, eliqhutywa yintloko yeqela lezobuchwepheshe elimele okunye nakuqhuba iinkalo ezimala nobuchwepheshe ezinxulumene nesebe. Ulungele isimo yeminye nengamva, enze uluhlu lwamathuluzi azakuthengwa namacebo, aze enze amasebenzi amanye aqhelekileyo “angengowobuchwepheshe” abenziwa malunga ekuyiweni

jobs.summary: Environmental Officer to regulate coastal effluent discharges and support marine pollution management initiatives in Cape Town.
jobs.requirements: Honours Degree in Natural or Environmental Management/Sciences (NQF Level 6) or relevant qualification as recognised by SAQA. 3 years’ experience in a related field. Extensive knowledge of the South African coast, marine and coastal pollution management, integrated coastal management, coastal processes, coastal management principles and national and international coastal policies and legislation. Knowledge of marine water quality and environmental monitoring techniques and management. Knowledge and understanding of data and information management. The ability to interpret and apply coastal and related legislation and policies, including the NEM: ICMA, NEMA, NEM: WA and NEM: BA Regulations, National Water Act, Minerals Act, international treaties and conventions, national and provincial laws, and departmental protocols. Functioning of coastal ecosystems and the impacts of human activity on those systems. Integrated Environmental Management and Environmental Impact Assessment. UNEP commitments, GPA programme, Regional Seas Conventions and related projects. Government administration and financial procedures. Project management. Public Service Regulation and Departmental procedures and prescripts. Background in Physical Sciences, Natural Sciences or Environmental Sciences. Sound organising and planning skills. Project management. Effective communicator. Analytical thinking. Scientific writing & reporting. Computer literacy. Driving. Multitasking. Networking and stakeholder engagement. Ability to work under pressure. Ability to meet tight deadlines, while maintaining good work quality. Good communication skills (written, oral and graphic). Willingness and ability to travel (at times on short notice). Ability to draft, interpret and apply policy and legislation. Ability to formulate solutions through analytical and innovative thinking. Ability to deal tactfully and efficiently with telephonic enquiries from members of the public. Ability to work within a team and individually. Ability to collect and analyse data and information. Good interpersonal skills. Proactive & honest. Conflict resolution.
