Represent the Directorate’s interests in EIA processes, relevant consultative forums, and other relevant structures to ensure good governance. Provide technical support to compliance and enforcement processes with specific focus on land-based sources of marine pollution.

af.title: Omgewingsbeampte Gespesialiseerde Produksie Landgebaseerd
af.summary: Omgewingsbeampte om kusuitvloeiloosing te reguleer en mariene besoedelingsbestuursinisiatiewe in Cape Town te ondersteun.
af.requirements: Honours-graad in Natuur- of Omgewingsbestuur/Wetenskappe (NQF Level 6) of 'n relevante kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. 3 jaar se ervaring in 'n verwante veld. Werking van kusekosisteme en die impak van menslike aktiwiteit op daardie stelsels. Geïntegreerde Omgewingsbestuur en Omgewingsimpakassessering. UNEP verbintenis, GPA-program, Regional Seas Conventions en verwante projekte. Regeringsadministrasie en finansiële prosedures. Projekbestuur. Public Service Regulation en departementele prosedures en voorskrifte. Agtergrond in Fisiese Wetenskappe, Natuurwetenskappe of Omgewingswetenskappe. Soliede organiseer- en beplanningsvaardighede. Projekbestuur. Effektiewe kommunikeerder. Analitiese denke. Wetenskaplike skryf en verslagdoening. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Bestuur. Multitaakverrigting. Netwerk- en belanghebbende-betrokkenheid. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Vermoë om styf skedules na te kom terwyl goeie werkgehalte gehandhaaf word. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik, mondelings en grafies). Bereidwilligheid en vermoë om te reis (soms op kort kennisgewing). Vermoë om beleid en wetgewing op te stel, te interpreteer en toe te pas. Vermoë om oplossings te formuleer deur analitiese en innoverende denke. Vermoë om telefoonnavrae van lede van die publiek taktvol en doeltreffend te hanteer. Vermoë om in 'n span en individueel te werk. Vermoë om data en inligting in te samel en te ontleed. Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede. Proaktief en eerlik. Konflikoplossing.
af.duties: Die ampshouer sal verantwoordelik wees om die lozing van uitvloei in riviermondings en kuswater te reguleer. Ondersteuning verleen aan departementele kusbesoedelingsinisiatiewe en ander verwante projekte. Die Direktoraat se belange in EIA-prosesse, relevante raadpleegforums en ander relevante strukture verteenwoordig om goeie bestuur te verseker. Tegniese ondersteuning aan nakomings- en handhawingsprosesse verleen met spesifieke fokus op landgebaseerde bronne van mariene besoedeling.

zu.title: Umphathi wezomvelo ochwepheshe bokukhiqiza okusekelwe emhlabeni
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaMphathi wezomvelo Kwi-Environmental Officer Specialised Production Land-based, esikhundleni esingu-level ngaphantsi kweholo elinye kwaye lisetyenziselwa ukusebenza kwiCape Town kwiDyunivesiti yombuso wakwaZulu-Natal.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Honours Kwi-Natural noma i-Environmental Management/Sciences (NQF Level 6) noma iziqu ezihambisanayo njengoba zivotwa yi-SAQA. Iminyaka yamava emi-3 enkundleni ehlobene naleyo. Ulwazi olubanzi ngasogwini lwaseNingizimu Afrika, ukuphathwa kwengcoliso yasolwandle nangasogwini, ukuphathwa okuhlanganiswe kwesogwini, izinqubo zasogwini, imigomo yokuqondisa isogwini kanye namapholisi namthetho wesogwini kazwelonke nawamhlabajikelele. Ulwazi ngomumo wamanzi olwandle, amasu okulawula futhi uphathe imvelo. Ulwazi nokunakekelwa kokuphathwa kwemininingwane. Ikhono lokuhumusha futhi usebenzise amapholisi namathetho wesogwini nawo ahlobene, okuhlanganisa ama-NEM: ICMA, NEMA, NEM: WA nama-NEM: BA Regulations, i-National Water Act, i-Minerals Act, izivumelwano zamathembu kazwelonke nawamhlabajikelele, amathetho kazwelonke nawesifundazwe, kanye namaphrotokholi omnyango. Ukusebenza kwesistimu yasogwini kanye nemithelela yemisebenzi yabantu kulezo sistimu. Ukuphathwa kwemvelo okuhlanganiswe kanye Nokuhlola Impembelelo Yemvelo. Iziphapho ze-UNEP, uhlelo lwe-GPA, ama-Regional Seas Conventions namaprojekthi ahlobene. Isohlanga sikaHulumeni kanye namaphrosedja ezezimali. Ukuphathwa kweprojekthi. I-Regulation of Public Service kanye namaphrosedja kanye namaphreskriptu omnyango. Isithundu kwesiZulu se-Physical Sciences, i-Natural Sciences noma i-Environmental Sciences. Amakhono abalulekile okuhlela futhi ucabange. Ukuphathwa kweprojekthi. Ukuxhumana ngempumelelo. Ukuqonda ngokuhlaziya. Umbhalo wezenzululwazi namabhili. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ukuqhuba. Ukwenzwa kwemisebenzi eminingi ngasikhathi sinye. Ukwakha uxhumo nolungelelwaniswa nabalingani. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegxulu. Ikhono lokuhlangabezana nemicimbe yesikhathi esibomvu, kuyilawo ugcina izinga elihle lomsebenzi. Amakhono abalulekile wokuxhumana (awabhalayo, abukhulumayo nawabonwayo). Ukwethemba kanye nokuqashwa kwakho ukuhamba (ngesinye isikhathi ngesikhashana esifushane). Ikhono lokubhala, ukuhumusha kanye nokusebenzisa amapholisi namathetho. Ikhono lokuveza izixazululo ngokuhlaziya futhi ngokucabanga okusha. Ikhono lokuphatha ngobuhlakani obunothando kanye nentshisekelo imibuzo yocingo esuka kulabo bantu. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphakathi kwesiqu nokuba ngumuntu. Ikhono lokuqoqa futhi uhlaziye imininingwane. Amakhono abalulekile wokuqonda ngomntu. Ukuba ngumuntu oqhuba kuyo ngaphambilili futhi oneqiniso. Ukuxazulula izingxabano.
zu.duties: Umphathi wezomvelo osekelwe ezweni ohlela ukukhiqiza okukhethekile. Umdidiyeli wezomvelo ozoregula ukukhishwa kwamanzi angcolile asolwandle futhi axhase izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwengcoliso lolwandle e-Cape Town.

xh.title: IOfisa yeNdalo eKhethekileyo eKwiMveliso eNgaphezulu koMhlaba
xh.summary: IOfisa yeNdalo ngakumbi ilawula ukuphuma kwezinto ezisetywayo kumanzi olunxweme nokuNxusa namaphulo alo lawulo lontlaninge olusemantlwemeni eCape Town.
xh.requirements: Iziqu zeHonours kwiZiNzulu okanye ekuLawulweni kweNdalo/Izayensi (iNqanaba leNQF 6) okanye isimemo esifanelekileyo njengoko sivunyiwe nguSAQA. Uluvo lweminyaka elingu-3 emthethweni ongummiselo. Ulwazi olwandisiweyo ngonxweme lwaseMzantsi Afrika, ulawulo lontlaninge olusemantlwemeni naselwandle, ulawulo oluhlanganisweyo lolunxweme, iinkqubo zolunxweme, iimpisiswelo zolawulo lolunxweme nengaqambo likarhulumente namazwe ngamazwe ngamagqabantshintshi nomthetho wolunxweme. Ulwazi ngohlelo lamanze olwandle nendlela zokuhlola imeko yendalo nolawulo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukulawula idatha nolwazi. Ikhono lokuhunyushela nokusebenzisa umthetho namagqabantshintshi angqamana nolunxweme, kuquka iNEM: ICMA, iNEMA, iNEM: WA neNEM: BA Iimigaqo, uMthetho weManze weSizwe, uMthetho weeNgqwetha, iimbeko namagqwebo kwamazwe ngamazwe, amagqabantshintshi namathetho karhulumente nakumapondo, namaphrothokholu esebenza. Ukusebenza kwendalo yolunxweme nemithelela yemisebenzi yabantu kwezo nkcubeko. Ulawulo oluhlanganisweyo Lwendalo nokuHlolwa koMthelela weNdalo. Iziyalelo ze-UNEP, iprogram yeGPA, iimbeko zeNqila eZommandla namaphulo athe ngqo. Iinkqubo zolawulo nezimali karhulumente. Ulawulo lweephrojekthi. Iimigaqo yezeNkonzo zaBantu namaQhingaba aseBenza namaphreskript ashe. Isqelo sokugqitha kuzoisiNzulu eZomzimba, iziNzulu eNdalo okanye iziNzulu zeNdalo. Ikhono elilulumko lokuhlela nokuqwalasela. Ulawulo lweephrojekthi. Ukunxiba ngokusebenzisana. Ukucinga okuhlalutyiweyo. UkuBhala nokubika ngesayensi. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. UkuQhuba. Ukwenza izinto ezininini ngexesha elinye. Ukwakhiwa kweenxaxheba nokuNxibelelana nabathintekayo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Ikhono lokuzala iimvakalelo ezinkqo, ngelixa ulondoloza umgangatho omhle womsebenzi. Ikhono elilulumko lokunxibelelana (elibhaliweyo, elithethwayo nelezobugcisa). Ilungelelo nakhono lokuhamba (ngamanye amaxesha ngokusesikweni esifutshane). Ikhono lokubhala, ukuhunyushela nokusebenzisa urhulumente namathetho. Ikhono lokuyila iindlela zokuqondisa ngokucinga okuhlalutyiweyo nokuqabayo. Ikhono lokuphathwa ngokuzolileyo nangempumelelo imibuzo yocingo eva kumalungu oluntu. Ikhono lokusebenza kwiqela nangamnye. Ikhono lokuqokelela nokuqondisa idatha nolwazi. Ikhono elilulumko lokuchasana nabantu. Eliqonde phambili nelona. Iindlela zokuzama ukulungisa inkxwale-miseni.
xh.duties: Umntu ofake isithuba uyakuba nawo uxanduva lokulawula ukuphuma kwezinto ezisetywayo kumanze onke kunye namanze olunxweme. Unike inkxaso kuqhingaba lolunxweme lontlaninge laseBenza nakuwo nawuphi na amaphulo athe ngqo. Umela iintshungo zoQqokotokwa kumaxesha esiHLola uMthelela weNdalo, kwiindawo zedatha ezithe ngqo, nakuwo nawuphi na amakomitye athe ngqo ukuqinisekisa ulawulo oluhle. Unike inkxaso yeobugcisa kwiinkqubo zokuwisa kumthetho nokuphothozelela ngokubhekiselele kwimithombo yommandla weontlaninge yamanze olwandle.

jobs.title: Diesel Mechanic
jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 per annum, (plus 37% in lieu of service benefits)
jobs.closing_date_text: 09 November 2026, 16:00. No late applications will be accepted
jobs.summary: Diesel Mechanic needed at Marion Island to maintain power generators and related mechanical systems for the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
jobs.requirements: Diesel Mechanic (Section 26D) Red Seal Trade Certificate issued by the Quality Council for Trades and Occupations (QCTO) or relevant qualification. 3 years’ post trade experience as Diesel Mechanic or relevant field. Competency in diesel engine and generator maintenance, diagnostics, repairs and fault-finding, with knowledge of engine management systems, experience in operating electronic diagnostic tools as well as the ability to interpret results. The candidate has to be familiar with good workshop practices, correct use of basic workshop tools and an understanding of current work, health and safety policies. It would be an advantage if there is experience on refrigeration. The incumbent must be computer literate, have good verbal and written communication skills and the ability to work in a team.
jobs.duties: The incumbent will be responsible for maintenance and operation of the power generators and related equipment. Maintenance and repairs of air- conditioning, refrigeration-, water reticulation- and wastewater systems. Replacement and repair of mechanical pumps and valves as well as pipe fitting. Maintenance and all repairs of forklift, telescopic cranes, portable generators and transfer pumps. Operate forklift and cargo handling equipment. Maintenance of field huts and field equipment. The incumbent will report to the team leader and will be part of the technical team, led by the technical team leader that has to perform any additional base related technical functions. Prepare monthly and annual reports, do stock-takes to order spares and equipment and do other common “non-technical” duties performed by expedition members.
jobs.enquiries: Mr Willem Boshoff Tel No: (021) 4937379
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.environment.gov.za/
jobs.notes: The incumbent will execute duties at a Sub/Antarctic Base and adhere to the health, safety and environmental requirements. The successful applicant will spend a full year (April 2027 to May 2028) at Marion Island. There is no option to return to South Africa before May 2028. The ability to work and live with small groups of people is thus essential. Although the base is well-equipped with e- mail, fax and satellite telephone facilities, the applicant has to be self-sufficient and self-motivated. The location may affect both the physical and mental well- being of the incumbent, their family and close relationships. Candidates must be physically fit, mentally strong and prepared for physically challenging and satisfying work. In addition the successful candidates may often be called upon to work long hours in extreme conditions on duties unrelated to their function. Short-listed candidates will be subjected to screening and security vetting to determine their suitability for employment. Appointment to these positions is subject to a rigorous medical examination as well as psychometric assessment, which will be arranged for at no cost to the applicants. Interested applicants must submit their applications via the above link. Applicant must ensure that they complete all sections on the online Z83 and attached a detailed CV with at least three (3) contactable references. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, Senior Certificate, identity document and driver’s license on or before the day of the interview. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). The National Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. Preference may be given to appointable applicants from the underrepresented designated groups in terms of the Department’s equity plan. Persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply. Correspondence will be limited to successful candidates only. Short-listed candidates will be subjected to screening and security vetting to determine their suitability for employment, including but not limited to: Criminal records; Citizenship status; Credit worthiness; Previous employment (reference checks); and Qualification verification. Short-listed candidates will be expected to avail themselves at the Department’s convenience. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: In terms of the Directive on Compulsory Capacity Development, Mandatory Training Days & Minimum Entry Requirements for SMS that was introduced on 1 April 2015, a requirement for all applicants for SMS posts from 1 April 2020 is a successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG) prior to appointment. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entryprogramme. Furthermore, Shortlisted candidates must provide proof of successful completion of the course. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Following the interview and the technical exercise of all SMS posts, the Selection Panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic managerial competency assessment in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency-based assessments. Persons appointed will be subjected to a security clearance, the signing of performance agreement and employment contract. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment. If you have not been contacted within three 3 months after the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. By submitting the employment application form, you agree and consent in terms of Section 11(1) of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), 2013 (Act 4 of 2013), for your personal information which you provide to the DFFE to being processed by the department and its employees, agents, Cabinet committees, and subcontractors for recruitment purposes, in accordance with the POPIA of 2013. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Dieselmeganikus
af.summary: Dieselmeganikus benodig op Marion-eiland vir die instandhouding van kragopwekkers en verwante meganiese stelsels vir die Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
af.requirements: Dieselmeganikus (Seksie 26D) Red Seal-handelsertifikaat uitgereik deur die Quality Council for Trades and Occupations (QCTO) of relevante kwalifikasie. 3 jaar se ervaring na vakleerlingskap as Dieselmeganikus of in 'n relevante veld. Bevoegdheid in die instandhouding, diagnostiek, herstel en foutopsporing van dieselenjins en kragopwekkers, met kennis van enjinbestuurstelsels, ervaring in die bedryf van elektroniese diagnostiese gereedskap asook die vermoë om resultate te interpreteer. Die kandidaat moet vertroud wees met goeie werkswinkelspraktyke, die korrekte gebruik van basiese werkswinkelinstrumente en 'n begrip van huidige werk-, gesondheids- en veiligheidsbeleide. Dit sal 'n voordeel wees indien daar ervaring in yskaste is. Die ampsdraer moet rekenaargeletterd wees, oor goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede beskik en die vermoë hê om in 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Die ampsdraer sal verantwoordelik wees vir die instandhouding en bedryf van die kragopwekkers en verwante toerusting. Onderhoud en herstel van lugversorging-, yskas-, waterleiding- en afvalwatersisteme. Vervanging en herstel van meganiese pompe en kleppe asook pyp Passing. Instandhouding en alle herstelwerk aan vurkhywe, teleskopiese kraane, draagbare kragopwekkers en oorpompompe. Bedryf vurkhywe en vraghanteringstoerusting. Onderhoud van velde hutte en veldtoerusting. Die ampsdraer sal aan die spanleier verslag doen en deel wees van die tegniese span, gelei deur die tegniese spanleier, wat enige addisionele basisverwante tegniese funksies moet uitvoer. Berei maandelikse en jaarlikse verslae voor, doen voorraadopnames om onderdele en toerusting te bestel en verrig ander algemene nie-tegniese pligte wat deur ekspedisielede uitgevoer word.

zu.title: Umechanik Wamafutha WesiDiyesela
zu.summary: Umechanik wamafutha wesiDiyesela uyadingeka e-Marion Island ukugcina izikhiye zamandla nezinhlelo ezihlobene nezobuchwepheshe zomzimba ku-Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Diesel Mechanic (Section 26D) Red Seal Trade esinikezwa yi-Quality Council for Trades and Occupations (QCTO) noma izifundo ezihlobene nalokho. 3 years’ post trade experience njengomechanik wamafutha wesiDiyesela noma enkundleni ehlobene nalokho. Ukwazi ukwenza ukugcinwa kwenjini yesiDiyesela nezikhiye zamandla, ukuthola iziphazamisi, ukulungisa nokubuka iziphazamisi, ngolwazi mayelana nezinhlelo zokuphatha injini, nakho ukusebenzisa izinto zokubuka iziphazamisi ze-elekthronik kanye namandla okuhipha imiphumela. Umphakeli kumele azazi izindlela ezinhle zokusebenza esikhungweni sokusebenza, ukusetshenziswa okulungile kwamathuluzi abhalwe nsuku zonke kanye nokuqonda izinqubomgomo zokuqashwa, ezempilo kanye nokuphila. Kuzothatha isikhundla esihle uma kukhona ulwazi ngokubandisa. Umphakeli kumele akwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, abe namakhono aphezulu okuxoxa nabantu nakho ukubhala, kanye namandla okusebenza eqenjini.
zu.duties: Umphakeli uzobe nesibopho sokugcina nokuphatha izikhiye zamandla nezinye izinto ezihlobene nalokho. Ukugcina nokulungisa izimiso zokubandisa, okubandisa, ukusatshulwa kwamanzi nezimiso ezihlanza amanzi angasetshenziswa. Ukushintsha nokulungisa amapompo ezobuchwepheshe amavhalvesi kanye nokwakhiwa kwamaphayipi. Ukugcina nokuze alungise konke ukuthwalisa ngamakhadi, ama-crane anamacala amabili ukubuka kude, izikhiye zamandla eziyithwala noma kanye namapompo okuthutha. Ukusebenzisa ukuthwalisa ngamakhadi nezinto zokuphatha imikhiqizo. Ukugcina izindlu zasemahlathini nezinto zokusebenza zasemahlathini. Umphakeli uzobe exesha nomholi weqembu futhi uzoba yingxenye yeqembu lobuchwepheshe,eliholwa ngumholi weqembu lobuchwepheshe okumele kwenze eminye imisebenzi ephathelene nophiko. Ukuqoqa imibiko yenyanga nganyanye nenyanga ngamunye, ukwenza ukubala izinto ukuze u-odele izingxenye nezinto zokusebenza kanye nokwenza eminye imisebenzi evamile ongeyona yobuchwepheshe ezenziwa amalunga eqembu.}

xh.title: Umenzi Wemoto Yidiyese
xh.summary: Kufuneka kubekho Umenzi Wemoto Yidiyese kwi-Marion Island ukuze igcinwe ijenengetha zamandla kunye nezinye iinkqubo zokusebenza ezinxulumene nazo kwi-Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi Sesthili Senguqulelo (Section 26D) Red Seal Trade Certificate esinikwa yi-Quality Council for Trades and Occupations (QCTO) okanye isifundo esifanelekileyo. Iminyaka emi-3 yamava emva kokuqesha njengoMenzi Wemoto Yidiyese okanye kwicala elinxulumene nako. Ukuzazi ukugcina, ukuyila iingxaki, ukulungisa nokufumana iimpazamo kwiinjin zidiyese nakwijenengetha, kunye nokuqonda iinkqubo zolawulo lweenjini, namava okusebenzisa izixhobo zokuyila iingxaki kwinzululwazi nakho nako ukuguqula iziphumo. Umphathiswa kufunke azibe nolwazi ngendlela ezilungileyo zokwenza umsebenzi kwindlu yokusebenza, ukusebenzisa ngokuchanekileyo izixhobo ezisisiseko zendlu yokusebenza nokuqonda iinkqubo zangoku zemisebenzi, impilo nokhuseleko. Iya kuba ngumda ukuba kunamava ekubeni kukho ukugqithisa. Umntu oze kulo sithuba kufuneko akwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, abe nAmakhono amabalise athetha nokuwabhala apho kunye nako ukuba nakho ukusebenza eqela.
xh.duties: Umntu oze kulo sithuba uza kuba nawo uxanduva lokugcina nokusebenza ijenengetha zamandla nayo yonke eminye imishini enxulumene nayo. Ukugcina nokulungisa inkqubo yokwisa amashishini, inkqubo yokugcina izinto ebandayo, inkqubo yokusatya amanzi nenkqubo yokususa amanzi olwelo. Ukutshintsha nokulungisa iimpompo zokusebenza nokuhlalutywa njengoko kunye nokuqhotyoshwa kweenjani. Ukugcina nokulungisa yonke imisebenzo yeforklift, iikrane ezithwala kude, iijenengetha ezithwalwayo ngeenqwana naye iimpompo zokudlulisa. Ukusebenzisa iforkift naye eminye imishini yokuphatha impahla. Ukugcina iindlu zasemmandla nezixhobo zasemmandla. Umntu oze kulo sithuba uza kuxela kumkhoki weqela uze abe yinxalenye yeqela lobuchwepheshe, elikhokelwa ngumkhoki weqela lobuchwepheshe ekufuneka lenze naziphi na ezinye imisebenzi yobuchwepheshe enxulumene nasekhowudi. Ukulungisa iingxelonyezi ezinyanga zonke nezonyaka, ukubala izinto ukuze olothe iziqwenga zokulungisa naye eminye imishini ukuze alungise naye yenye imisebenzi evamile engelobuchwepheshe ezenziwa ngamalungu eqela lokuhamba.

jobs.title: Medical Orderly
jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 per annum, (plus 37% in lieu of Service Benefits)
jobs.closing_date_text: 09 November 2026, 16:00. No late applications will be accepted
jobs.summary: Medical orderly required to provide nursing care and emergency treatment to expedition team members on Marion Island.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Nursing or Certificate in Operational Emergency Care Practitioner. Applicants must be registered with the HPCSA (Health Professions Council of South Africa) or SANC (South African Nursing Council.) 3-5 years relevant experience required. Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes and other relevant legal framework such as the Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health & Safety Act, Patient Rights Charter Act, Public Service Regulations Act and Labour Relations Act. Must have leadership skills, decision making, problem solving, interpersonal skills and computer skills in basic programmes. The incumbent has to be able to work independently with minimal support under extreme pressure and without supervision. The incumbent must have good verbal and written communication skills and the ability to work in a team.
jobs.duties: The incumbent will be responsible for providing medical treatment to all team members during the expedition and ensure the work is according to the scope of practise regulations. Undertake minor dental and x-rays when needed. Prepare reports, do stock-takes of food and medicines. Order spares and equipment and do other common non-technical duties performed by expedition members. Ensure the food is stored according to the medical acts by maintaining high standards of food/ hygiene/ housekeeper/ linen and tailoring roles. Provide support to team leader for coordinating and training for the rescue and evacuation/ emergency procedures for the island as well as in a social role to motivate and encourage fellow team members.
jobs.enquiries: Mr R Hlophe Tel No: (021) 493 7067
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.environment.gov.za/
jobs.notes: The successful candidate will be required to attend compulsory training at the South African Weather Service in Cape Town. The incumbent will execute duties at Marion Island Base and adhere to the health, safety and environmental requirements. The successful applicant will spend a full year (April 2027 to May 2028) at Marion base. There is no option to return to South Africa before May 2027. The ability to work and live with small groups of people is thus essential. af.title: Mediese Ordonnansie
af.summary: Mediese ordonnansie benodig om verpleegsorg en noodbehandeling aan ekspedisiespanlede op Marion-eiland te verskaf.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma (NQF-vlak 6) in Verpleegkunde of Sertifikaat in Operational Emergency Care Practitioner. Aansoekers moet by die HPCSA (Health Professions Council of South Africa) of SANC (South African Nursing Council) geregistreer wees. 3-5 jaar relevante ervaring vereis. Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures, verpleegstatute en ander relevante regsraamwerk soos die Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health & Safety Act, Patient Rights Charter Act, Public Service Regulations Act en Labour Relations Act. Moet leierskapsvaardighede, besluitneming, probleemoplossing, interpersoonlike vaardighede en rekenaarvaardighede in basiese programme hê. Die amptenaar moet in staat wees om onafhanklik te werk met minimale steun onder uiterste druk en sonder toesig. Die amptenaar moet goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede hê en die vermoë om in 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Die amptenaar sal verantwoordelik wees vir die verskaffing van mediese behandeling aan alle spanlede tydens die ekspedisie en verseker dat die werk ooreenkomstig die bestek van praktykregulasies is. Onderneem klein tandheelkundige en x-strale wanneer nodig. Berei verslae voor, doen voorraadopnames van kos en medisyne. Bestee onderdele en toerusting en doen ander algemene nie-tegniese pligte wat deur ekspedisielede uitgevoer word. Verseker dat kos gestoor word volgens die mediese wette deur hoë standaarde van kos/ higiëne/ huishouding/ linne en kleremakersrolle te handhaaf. Verskaf ondersteuning aan spanleier vir die koördinering en opleiding vir redding en ontruiming/ noodprosedures vir die eiland sowel as in 'n sosiale rol om mede-spanlede te motiveer en aan te moedig.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezempilo
zu.summary: Kudingeka umphathi wezempilo ukuze anikezele ngokunakekelwa kwezokwelapha kanye nokwelashwa okuphuthumayo kulawo abayingxenye yesibhedlela ku-Marion Island.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-National Diploma (NQF Level 6) e-Nursing noma i-Certificate ku-Operational Emergency Care Practitioner. Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe ngabakahile nge-HPCSA (Health Professions Council of South Africa) noma i-SANC (South African Nursing Council.) Zidingwa iminyaka eyi-3-5 yohlelo, abafaka izicelo kumele babe nokuqonda ezindleleni nemithelela nendlela yokunakekelwa kwezokuhlaliswa kwesibhedlela, kanye nesibonelo esibeki isisekelo ngomthetho ohambisanayo njengomthetho wakwaNursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health & Safety Act, Patient Rights Charter Act, Public Service Regulations Act, kanye ne-Labour Relations Act. Kudingeka ukuthi umuntu ophatha le ndima abe namakhono okuba ngumholi, ukwenza izinqumo, ukuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okuxhumana nabantu, kanye namakhono okusebenza ngemikhondo yamakhalenda ngeskhalende eziyisisekelo. Umuntu ophatha le ndima kumele ukuthi abe nethonya lokusebenza kodwa ngaphandle kokuxhaswa okuncane ngaphansi kwegangezo yokuphatheka kabi ngokomzimba, ngaphandle kwalowo emqondisela. Kumele abe namakhono amahle okukhuluma futhi abhale kahle, kanye nokuthi athande ukusebenza eqenhu.
zu.duties: Umphathi wezempilo uzobe nenzebela lokunakekelwa kokwelashwa kwamalungu onke eqenhu ngesikhathi kuhamba ohambweni, futhi aqinisekise ukuthi umsebenzi wenziwa ngokomthetho wemisebenzi ekhulu. Uzobe nenza izinyo elincane nama-x-ray uma kudingeka. Uzobe lungisa imibiko, futhi enze isibali sokudla nezithi. Uzobe la imitsha kanye namabhulokho wezempilo, bese enza neminye imisebenzi evamile engenobuchwepheshe eba yisoqenhe sabahambi. Aqinisekise ukuthi ukudla kugcinwe ngokuhambisana nemithetho yezokwelapha ngokugcina izinga eliphakeme kwezokuhlanza, ukulondoloza indlu, ukusingathwa kwemifula nemisebenzi yokulungisa. Anikeze inkokhelo umholi weqembu ekuhlelweni nokuqeqeshweni kwemikhuba yokubuyisa abantu nokuhamba kulesibhedlela mayelana nemibandela ephuthumayo kanye nendima yomphakathi ukuze aduduze futhi akhuthaze lapho abanye besebenza nabo eqenhu.

xh.title: Isikhululi sokulungiselela izigulana
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umntu ofanelekileyo kwizinto zonyango lwezempilo onike inyango lezempilo kwaye onyange iingxwabo ngokutsha kwilungu leqela leqhagamshelwano eMarion Island.
xh.requirements: Izidanga ezingangqondo kwilizwe (NQF Level 6) kwisoNursing okanye Isatifikethi kwiPractitioner yoQoqosho lweNgxwabo yeNgxwabo. Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babhalise kwi-HPCSA (Health Professions Council of South Africa) okanye kwi-SANC (South African Nursing Council.) Iimbonelelo zeminyaka eli-3-5 efunekayo. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi nendlela zokwenza unyango lwezempilo, ngokomthetho wezempilo nakumanye amathuba achazwe ngomthetho njengoko kukuNgcenkcebo yeziBhedi, uMthetho weZempilo, uMthetho weMisebenzi yoQoqosho oLungelelanisiweyo & oKhuselekileyo, uMthetho weZibaluleko zoMthengi, uMthetho woQoqosho woBomi bomLuntu, kunye noMthetho weMisebenzi yoBudlelwano bemisebenzi. Kufuneka abe namaphawu okuba ngumfundisi-gqitha, ukwenza izigqibo, ukuyilwa kobunzima bezigxobo, amaphawu okuvakalisa ubuni bakho kunye namaphawu okusebenzisa ikhompyuter kumanqaku amabini. Umphathi kufuneka akwazi ukusebenza eyedwa ngaphandle kokuxhaswa kakhulo kwize/zimo ezinzima kwaye ngaphandle kolawulo. Umphathi kufuneka abe namaphawu amakhulu okunika ulwazi ngokuthetha nokubhala, kunye nokuba nako ukusebenza eqeleni.
xh.duties: Umphathiswa uya kuba nawesibininiso sokunika unyango lwezempilo onke amalungu eqela ngexesha leqhagamshelwano nokuqinisekisa ukuba umsebenzi uyenzwa ngokomda wolawulo lokwenza umsebenzi. Ukwenza izigqibo ezincinci ezithile kunye nokuthabatha iirayidhi xa kufuneka. Ulungelelanise iingxelo, wenze isixa sezinto zokutya neyamayeza. Ucele izixobo ezingenaso imisebenzi noko kwaye wenze eminye imisebenzi eqhelekileyo engenabo ubuchwepheshe eyenziwa ngamalungu eqhagamshelwano. Aqinisekise ukuba ukutya kugcinwa ngokomthetho wezempilo ngokugcina iinganginganiso eziphezulu kumisebenzi yokutya / icoceko / umphathi wekhaya / ilineni nakuqhelanisa ulwazi. Unike isixhaso kumfama weqela ekulungelelaniseni nasekufundiseni iinkqubo zokusindwa nokuqhuba / iinkqubo zeengxwabo zesiqhobo nakuqoqosho lokuxhasa nokukhuthaza abanye amalungu eqela.

Conduct quality control of data, report writing and asset control. Assist other team members with logistical and administrative tasks associated with the general running of the base. Conduct all duties in accordance with the rules, regulations and standards as set out by the South African Weather Service.

af.title: Senior Meterologiese Tegnikus
af.summary: Senior Meteorologiese Tegnikus wat toesig hou oor oppervlak-meteorologiese en atmosferiese navorsingsprojekte by Marion Island, wat 'n tersaaklike BSc- of BTech-graad vereis.
af.requirements: BSc-graad of BTech (NQF-vlak 6) in Natuurwetenskappe of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie in 'n verwante veld wat deur SAQA erken word, met 'n minimum van een jaar se ervaring in oppervlak-meteorologiese waarnemings; of Graad 12 met 'n Nasionale Weersertifikaat en vyf jaar se ervaring in weerwaarneming. Vorige eilandervaring sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Tegniese bevoegdhede: Projektbestuur, konflikbestuur, verslagskrywing en kommunikasievaardighede ens. Kandidate moet bereid wees om skofte te werk (beide dag- en nagskofte) en op openbare vakansiedae, in moontlik ongunstige weersomstandighede. Kandidate moet stiptelik, toegewyd, presies wees en bereid wees om in 'n span te werk, asook op hul eie.
af.duties: Hou toesig oor en coördineer oppervlak-meteorologiese en atmosferiese navorsingsprojekte wat deur die Mariene Afdeling van SAWS toegewys is. Oefen verantwoordelike skofbestuur van die twee assistent-meteorologiese tegnici uit. Verantwoordelik vir die toezig van 'n span assistent-meteorologiese tegnici, verskaf leierskap en leiding aangaande daaglikse bedrywighede, insluitend die delegering van take en verseker die indiening van daaglikse en maandelikse verslae binne die vasgestelde tydraamwerke, om nalewing van die toepaslike WMO-standaarde te verseker. Voer oppervlak-meteorologiese waarnemings uit, voer bogrondse ballonvrystellings uit en onderhou en verifieer alle meteorologiese toerusting by die afgeleë stasie van Marion Island. Voer gehaltebeheer van data, verslagskrywing en batebeheer uit. Help ander spanlede met logistiese en administratiewe take wat verband hou met die algemene bestuur van die basis. Voer alle pligte uit ooreenkomstig die reëls, regulasies en standaarde soos uiteengesit deur die South African Weather Service.

zu.title: Obucha Bemimo Wangaphansi Ohlonze Kakhulu
zu.summary: Obucha Bemimo Wangaphansi Ohlonze Kakhulu oqondise imiklamo yokucwaninga kwesimo sezulu nokuhamba kwemoyonhlonzi e-Marion Island, ofuna iziqu ze-BSc noma i-BTech ezihambisanayo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-BSc noma i-BTech (NQF Level 6) kwi-Natural Science noma isiqu esilinganayo enkundleni ehlobene esivunyiwe yi-SAQA, nokuba nokuhlangenwe nakho okungajwayelekile komnyaka owodwa ekuqapheleni isimo sezulu sangaphansi; noma i-Grade 12 ne-National Weather Certificate nokuhlangenwe nakho okungeminyaka emihlanu ekuqapheleni isimo sezulu. Ukuba nokuhlangenwe nakho kwezinsuku eMsizwana kuzoba yinzuzo enkulu. Ikhono Lobuchwepheshe: Ulawulo lwemiklamo, ulawulo lwephikiswano, ukubhala imibiko nekho bokuxhumana njll. Abafaki isicelo kumelwe bazibe ukusebenza usuku nobusuku kanye nangemihla yiholide, besebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima zemimosha. Abafaki isicelo kumel babe basheshe, babhekisele ekubeni babhiki, baqinise kakhulu futhi bazibe ukusebenza njengeqembu, kanye nokusebenza bodwa.
zu.duties: Oqondise futhi ahloboze imiklamo yokucwaninga kwesimo sezulu nokuhamba kwemoyonhlonzi onikelwe uhlelo lwe-Marine lwabo-SAWS. Asethenze ulawulo olubhekile lokusebenza ngamashifu bobucha ababili bemimosha wangaphansi. Abhekene nokugada iqembu labocha bemimosha wangaphansi, anike ubuholo nesiqondiso emisebenzini yansuku zonke, okuhlanganisa nokwaba imisebenzi futhi aqinise ukuthunyelwa kwemibiko yansuku neminye yamunyaka ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esihlukanisiwe, eiqinise ukuthi kuhambisana namazinga abekwe yi-WMO. Azenze ukuqapha isimo sezulu sangaphansi, akhulule amabalasi emoyonhlonzi asezansi, agcine futhi aqinise amasetshenzwa wonke emimosha esiteshini sase-Marion Island. Asethenze ukulawula ikhwalithi yemininingwane, abhale imibiko futhi alawule izimpahla. Asize amalungu amanye eqembu emisebenzini yokuphathwa kwezimpahla kolawulo ehlobene nokuphathwa kwesiteshi. Azenze yonke imisebenzi ngokuhambisana nemithetho, imilando namazinga abekwe i-South African Weather Service.

xh.title: Umphathi Ophakamileyo Wezobuchwepheshe Bosezulu
xh.summary: Umphathi Ophakamileyo Wezobuchwepheshe Bosezulu olawula iiprojekthi zophando olusemazantsi ngaphezu komhlaba nolwesicelo sasezulu kwiMarion Island, efuna izidanga ezifanelekileyo zeBSc okanye zeBTech.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seBSc okanye iBTech (NQF Level 6) kwiNatural Science okanye nesidanga esilinganayo kwilawulo eliqhelekileyo elivunywe yiSAQA, noluhlobo lweminye elinye yamava kwizikhendlo zomzulu ezingaphaya komhlaba; okanye iGrade 12 ngeNational Weather Certificate namava eminyaka emihlanu kwizikhendlo zomzulu. Uluhlu oludlulileyo kwi Isle luya kuba lusisongezo. Ulwazi Lwobuchwepheshe: Ulawulo Lweprojekthi, ulawulo lwezingxabano, ukuweba amabali nemipondo yonxibelelwano njl. Iqabane kufuneka zichuze ukusebenza iishifthi (ezangemini nangobusuku) nakumhla wentsapho, kwiimeko ezinobungozi bezulu. Iqabane kufuneka zibe zichanekileyo ngenkathalo, zichibanyele, zichanekile nazoqheliselo lokusebenza ngqo, nangaphezu koko zibe chule ukusebenza kwiqela, nakuzo ngokuzo.
xh.duties: Ulawula ulungelelanisa iiprojekthi zophando lomzulu nolwesicelo sasezulu oluvela kwiMarine Section yeSAWS. Yiba nolawulo lweeshifthi olunoxanduva lomphathi wezobuchwepheshe bonyana ababini. Uchaze ukulawula iqela labaphathi bezobuchwepheshe bonyana, unikeze ukulawula nemixholo eshukumisayo ekusebenzeni kwemihla ngemihla, kubandakanya ukwaba umsebenzi ukuqinisekisa ukungeniswa kwamabali emihla ngemihla ngenyanga kwixesha elichaziweyo, ukuqinisekisa ulandelo lwe-WMO ngokwemigangatho. Yenza izikhendlo zomzulu ezingaphezulu komhlaba, upando nokuphuma okubekelwe ngaphezulu kolwandle ukuze ulondoloze, uqinisekise zonke izixhobo zomzulu kwisikhululo saseMarion Island. Yalathise ulawulo lwemigaqo ngokwemigaqo, weba amabali, ulawule izinto. Siza amalungu amanye eqela ngemisebenzi yonke nolawulo oluncedisa ukukhutshwa kwenkqubela yonke yamaziko. Yenza umsebenzi wonke ngokulandela imigaqo, iimiso nemigangatho ngegaziso leSouth African Weather Service.

af.title: Omgewingsbeampte: Marion Island
af.summary: Omgewingsbeampte benodig by Marion Island om biosekuriteitsmaatreëls, vreemde uitroeiingsplanne te implementeer en nakoming van omgewingswetgewing te monitor.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma in Omggewingswetenskappe/Bestuurskunde/Bewaring of 'n tersaaklike vergelykbare kwalifikasie in Natuurwetenskappe (NQF6) soos deur SAQA erken. Minimum 2 jaar se ondervinding vereis. Kennis van Openbare Diens- en Departementele prosedures en preskripte en Omgewingswetgewing en ondervinding in indringsiekologie en plantidentifikasie. Moet oor die volgende vaardighede beskik: Voldoende vaardighede in rekenaargebruik, verslag/professionele skryfwerk, rekenaarvaardigheid, goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings en diplomatieke vaardighede, verhoudingsbestuur, belanghebbendesbetrokkenheid, aanbieding, navorsing en verbale en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Die ampshouer moet oor die volgende bevoegdhede beskik: spanwerk, eerlikheid en integriteit, betroubaarheid, vermoë om inligting te versamel en te ontleed, vermoë om individueel en in 'n span te werk, vermoë om in die veld onder uiterste weersomstandighede te loop en met minimale toesig te werk, goeie interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede en vermoë om onder uiterste druk te werk. Vermoë om met moeilike persone te werk en konflik op te los.
af.duties: Implementeer biosekuriteitsmaatreëls en bevem algemene omgewingsbewustheid. Implementeer die Vreemde Uitroeiingsplan (plante, ongewerweldes en knaagdiere) en die Prince Edwards Islands Bestuursplan en geassosieerde wetgewing. Monitor nakoming van Omgewingsmagtigings wat onder die EIA Regulasies vir aktiwiteite by die Prince Edward Islands (PEI's) uitgereik is. Verseker implementering van die SANAP Afvalbestuurshandboek en onderneem landskopskoonmaakaktiwiteite. Verseker omgewingsnakoming en ouditering en stel maandelikse en jaarlikse EKO-verslae op. zu.title: Inkantili Yezemvelo: Marion Island
zu.summary: Kudingeka Inkantili Yezemvelo e Marion Island ukuze kusetshenziswe izinyathelo zokuvikela izinto ezingezona zasendaweni, izinhlela zokujeyisa izinto ezingezona zasendaweni kanye nokugqamisa ukuziphendulela kumthetho wezemvelo.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma Yezwezonke kweZesayensi Zezemvelo/Impatho/Ukuhlonga noma izifundo ezifanayo ezihambisana neziqu kwezesayensi yemvelo (NQF6) njengoba kuhlonishwa yi-SAQA. Kudingeka kube nokutholakala kweminyaka engu-2 yokuhamba ibonke. Ukwazi izinqubo nomthetho wesebenzi kahulumeni kanye nomnyango, nomthetho wezemvelo kanye nokuba namava ekujeyiseni isayensi kanye nokuhlonza izitshalo. Kumele abe namakhono alandelayo: amakhono afanele ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha, ukubhala imibiko/ukubhala ngobungcweti, ukwazi ukusebenza ngakompyutha, ubuhlobo obuhle nabantu namakhono obudiplomathikhi, ukuphatha ubuhlobo, ukuxhumana nabahlukaniswa, okokubhakaqindi, ucwaningo, namakhono okuxhumana ngokwenxulumile nokubhaliwayo. Lowo othathwe esikhundleni kumele abe nokuqonda okulandelayo: ukusebenza njengeqembu, ukuqotho nokuzethemba, ukuthembeka, ikhono lokuqoqa futhi ahlaziye ukwaziswa, ikhono lokusebenza wedwa nasenqenjini, ikhono lokuhamba endaweni evulekile emigosqweni emincane kakhulu futhi asebenze ngaphansi kokuhlakaniphwa okuncane, amakhono obuhlobo obuhle nabantu kanye nakhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegxabo elikhulu. Ikhono lokusebenza nabantu abezingqondo ebusa kakhulu nokuqedwa kwezinkinga.
zu.duties: Kwenziwe izinyathelo zokuvikela izinto ezingezona zasendaweni futhi kukhuthazwe okuqondile nolwazi ngemvelo. Kwenziwe iNkulumo Yokuqotha Izinto Ezingezona Zasendawo (izitshalo, izilwane ezingenawo umhlathi namagundwane) kanye ne-Nkulumo Yokuphatha iPrince Edwards Islands kanye nomthetho ohambisana nayo. Kugqamiswe ukuziphendulela kumvume ophilayo ngemvelo okunikiwe ngaphansi komthetho we-EIA emisebenzini e-Prince Edward Islands (PEIs). Kuqinisekiswe ukuqashwa kwe-SANAP Waste Management Handbook futhi kwenziwe imisebenzi yokuhlanza izwe. Kuqinisekiswe ukuziphendulela ngemvelo nokuhlola kanti kuhunjwe imibiko yenyanga zonke kanye yonyaka wonke ye-ECO. Kuphathwe futhi kugcineke izinsongo ezingezinhle ekuphathweni kwemvelo kanye nasemvelweni jikelele.

xh.title: Somxinwa oZolimo: Marion Island
xh.summary: Kufuneka iSomxinwa oZolimo eMarion Island ukuphumeza izigqibo zokhuseleko kwabalawuli abangangelendlwini, iinkqubo zokucutha abangelendlwini nokugcina amathuba okuthobela imithetho yezolimo.

Ukulwazi koLawulo lwaseLurhwalweni loWo kunye neendlela zesebe nemigaqo yezolimo kwaye unako ukuzonwabisa isazi sezithuba zokungena kolunye uhlobo nokuqaphela izityalo. Kufuneka akho ngekhono elilandelayo: ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ngokwaneleyo, ukubhala iingxelo/ngebala lolwazi lomsebenzi, ukwazi ukusebenza ngokwemikhono yekhompyutha, ukuba nobudlelwane obuhle nabantu nokuzele ngamakhono obulumko, ulawulo lobudlelwane, ukuzonwabisa abathathi nxaxheba, iingcombolo ezinomxholo, ucopho nolwazi lokuthetha nobhalo olunemfihlakalo. Phumeza iNkqubo yoKucutha Abasezindlwini ezingenasaphiwo (izityalo, izilwanyana ezingenasaphiwo namagundwane) kunye neNkqubo yoLawulo lwePrince Edwards Islands nalo mthetho ongowayo. Qaphela ukuhambelana koLawulo ngokwemithetho yezolimo evunyiweyo ngaphantsi koMthetho we-EIA kumisebenzi ePrince Edward Islands (PEIs). Qinisekisa ukuphumeza iNkqubo yoLawulo loGqabiso lwe-SANAP kwaye wenze imisebenzi yokucoca ilizwe. Qinisekisa ukuhambelana ngokwemithetho yezolimo nokuqaphela kwaye uqokelele iingxelo zenyanga nezonyaka ze-ECO. Lawula kwaye ukhusele iingozi ezikwizolimo nakwindalo yesikhululeko.

af.title: Assistent Meteorologiese Tegnikus
af.summary: Bystand met oppervlak-meteorologiese waarnemings en opballonvrystellings in die boonste lug by die afgeleë Marion Island-stasie, wat 'n Nasionale Diploma in Natuurwetenskappe of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie vereis.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma in Natuurwetenskappe of 'n gelykwaardige relevante kwalifikasie (NQF Level 6) erken deur SAQA, met 0–1 jaar se relevante ervaring; of Graad 12 met 'n National Weather Certificate en twee (2) jaar se ervaring in weerswaarneming. Kennis van Automatic Weather Stations en Automatic Rain Stations; Kennis van South African Weather Service-beleide en prosedures; Kennis van internasionale standaarde soos WMO en ICAO. Tegniese bevoegdhede: Kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede, ens. Kandidate moet bereid wees om skofte te werk (beide dag- en nagte) en op openbare vakansiedae, in moontlike ongunstige weersomstandighede. Kandidate moet stiptelik, toegewyd, presies wees en bereid wees om in 'n span te werk, sowel as op hul eie.
af.duties: Bystand en neem aktief deel aan die uitvoering van die oppervlak-meteorologiese en atmosferiese navorsingsprojek wat deur die Marine Section van SAWS toegewys is. Voer oppervlak-meteorologiese waarnemings uit, doen opballonvrystellings in die boonste lug en onderhou en verifieer alle toerusting by die afgeleë stasie van Marion Island. Voer gehaltebeheer van data uit wanneer vereis of voer take uit binne die voorgeskrewe omvang van werk soos deur die Senior Meteorological Technician gedelegeer. Bystand ander spanlede met logistieke en administratiewe take wat verband hou met die algemene bestuur van die basis. Voer alle pligte uit ooreenkomstig die reëls, regulasies en standaarde soos uiteengesit deur die South African Weather Service.

zu.title: Umncedi Wezezulu Lokuhlolwa Kwesimo Sezulu
zu.summary: Siza nokuqashwa kwezimo sezulu emhlabeni kanye nokukhulula amabaluni ezulu endaweni ekude yesikhungo sase Marion Island, okudinga i-National Diploma kwezemvelo esezulwini noma iziqu ezingekho ezimbalwa.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma kwezemvelo esezulwini noma iziqu ezingekho ezimbalyo ezihambisana nalokho (i-NQF Level 6) ezivunywe yi-SAQA, eminyakeni yoku-0–1 yohlelo lokusebenza; noma i-Grade 12 ene-National Weather Certificate neminyaka emibili (2) yohlelo lokusebenza ekubukelweni kwesimo sezulu. Ulwazi mayelana ne-Automatic Weather Stations kanye ne-Automatic Rain Stations, ulwazi mayelana nezenzo nezinqumo ze-South African Weather Service, ulwazi mayelana namazinga amazwe njenge-WMO ne-ICAO Technical Competencies: amakhono okuxhumana nabantu njll. Abafaka izicelo kumele bazimisele ukusebenza amashifi (amashini emini nas ebusuku) nangemihla yeholide, kumimo yezulu engase ibe nzima. Abafaka izicelo kumele bahambisane isikhathi, benze ngokuzinikela, baqinise ngokwenza izinto ngokunembile futhi bazimisele ukusebenza eqenjini, kanye nokusebenza bodwa.
zu.duties: Siza futhi uthathe inhlangothi ekwenzeni iphrojekthi yokucwaninga isimo sezulu kanye namagesi esibhakabhaka esikhundlweni kwesikhungo saseMarine Section kwa-SAWS. Yenza ukuhlola isimo sezulu emhlabeni, khulula amabaluni ezulu ulalele amagesi bese wagcina futhi uqinisekisa wonke amathuluzi esikhundleni esikude saseMarion Island. Hlola izinga lemininingwane futhi lapho kudingeka noma yenza imisebenzi engaphakathi komkhawulo omentiwe womsebenzo njengoba kumisiwe nguMgijimi Ophakeme Wezezulu Lokuhlolwa Kwesimo Sezulu. Siza amalunga amanye eqenjini ngemisebenzi yokuqashwa nokuqamba imibhalo ehambisana nokuphatha isikhungo ngokuvamile. Yenza konke imisebenzi ngokusho komthetho, imithesho namazinga njengoba okumisiwe yi-South African Weather Service.

xh.title: Umncedi wenjineli yemozulu
xh.summary: Nceda ngokuqwalasela imo yemozulu emantla komhlaba nokukhulula amabaluni moya ephezulu kwisikhululo saseMarion Island esikude, kufuneka ufumane iDiploma yaseLizwe kwiZentlalo zendalo okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo.
xh.requirements: iDiploma yaseLizwe kwiZentlalo zendalo okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo esibalulekayo (NQF Level 6) esivunyiwe yiSAQA, eneminyaka engu0–1 yamava ahambelanayo; okanye iGrade 12 neNational Weather Certificate kunye neminyaka emibini (2) yamava ekubonisweni kwemozulu. Ulwazi ngeAutomatic Weather Stations nangeAutomatic Rain Stations. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo nezithethe zeSouth African Weather Service. Ulwazi ngamazinga amazwe ajikeleze njengeWMO neICAO. Amapreme athembekile ngokobuchwephetha: Amakhono ekunxibelelana nabantu njl njl. Abagqibi-mfundo kufuneba bekulungele ukusebenza ngokutshintshwa (ngokwemini nakwabusuku) nakumihla yamacandelo, kwindawo ephotha ukuba nemozulu engahle ibe nkulu. Abagqibi-mfundo kufuneba benelise ixesha, bazingile, bachanekile kwaye bazimisele ukusebenza nqanaba labantu, njengoko besebenza bodwa.
xh.duties: Nceda kwaye uthathe inxaxheba ngokuzimisela ekusebenziseni iprojekthi yophando yemozulu nomoya esemantla komhlaba enikelwe kwiMarine Section yeSAWS. Yenza ukuqwalasela kwezimo zemozulu esemantla komhlaba, yenza ukukhululwa kwamabaluni pomoya ephezulu kwaye ulondoloze ukuqinisekise zonke iixeli kwisikhululo saseMarion Island esikude. Yenza lolawulo lomgangatho wedatha kwaye xa kufuneka okanye wenze umsebenzi ngaphakathi komda olongeziweyo womsebenzi njengoko ubekwe yiSenior Meteorological Technician. Nceda emanye amalungu eqembu ngemisebenzi yokulawula nokulawula amafa ebandakanya ukusebenza jikelele kwesikhululo. Yenza yonke imisebenzi ngokwezimiso, iinkqubo namazinga njengoko ezibekwe yiSouth African Weather Service.

af.title: Veldassistente: Seevoëls
af.summary: Veldassistente word benodig om seevoëlbiologiese navorsing, veldwerk en monitering op Marion Island vir die Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment te onderneem.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma (NQF Level 6) of 'n relevante kwalifikasie in Natuurwetenskap. 0– 1-jaar ervaring word op Marion Island vereis. Kennis van omgewingswetgewing. Openbare diens- en departementele prosedures en voorskrifte. Ervaring in veldopnames, navorsingsadministrasie, data-insameling en -bestuur, voëlidentifikasie en -hantering, inligting versprei, verslagdoening en rekordhouding. Moet oor goeie aandag aan detail beskik en noukeurig wees in data-insameling en ervaring toon om wetenskaplike monitering met betrekking tot seevoëls tot 'n hoë standaard te doen. Moet selfgemotiveerd wees en in staat wees om op 'n afgeleë plek weg van familie en vriende met minimale toesig te werk.
af.duties: Onderneem biologiese navorsing, veldwerk en monitering volgens 'n werkplan soos deur die projekbestuurders opgestel. Neem daaglikse besluite oor werksprioriteite en veldwerkprotokolle. Handhau akkurate rekords van die werk en rekenaardatabasisse van die werk. Rapporteer gereeld aan en werk die projekbestuurder oor die vordering van die projek by. Die aansoekers moet vasberadenheid, fisieke fiksheid en die vermoë om onder strawwe omgewingstoestande wat aan uiterste weerstoestande onderhewig is, te werk hê; 'n begeerte om met diere te werk, insluitend die hantering van seevoëlvolkwassenes en kuikens, wat empatie vir die voëls vereis. Suksesvolle aansoekers sal 'n volle jaar (April 2027 tot May 2028) op Marion Island deurbring. Neem kennis dat daar geen opsie is om voor die einde van die ekspedisie terug te keer nie, sodra u op die eiland land. Die goed toegeruste nuwe basisstasie het volledige e-pos-, faks- en satelliettelefoondienste.

zu.title: Abasizi Baseshibhini: Izinyoni Zasolwandle
zu.summary: Badingwa abasizi baseshibhini ukuze bacathe imisebenzi ecwaningwa ngabayobi, abayise emahlathini futhi balawule izinyoni zasolwandle e-Marion Island ku-Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF Level 6) noma izifundo ezihambisana nazo kwi-Natural Science. Kudingeka unobho wohlelo lweminyaka engu-0–1 e-Marion Island. Ukwazi ngemithetho mayelana nomhlaba. Izinqubo zasezikhungweni zikahulumende nezomnyango kanye nemibhalo. Ubuhle bokwenza ocwaningweni oluseshibhini, ukuphathwa kocwaningo, ukuqoqa kanye nokulawula idatha, ukuhlukanisa nokuphatha izinyoni, ukusabalalisa ulwazi, ukubhala izinkulumo-magugu nokugcina irekhodi. Kumele uqaphele kakhulu izinkinobho futhi uqaphele emseleni wokuqoqa idatha, futhi ubonise ubungcweti bokwenza isibhekezele somzimba mayelana nezinyoni zasolwandle ngezimo eziphezulu. Kumele uzilalele ngokwakho futhi ukwazi ukusebenza endaweni ekude ngaphandle kwezihlobo kanye nabangane ngaphandle kokulawulwa kakhulu.
zu.duties: Yenza ucwaningo ngabayobi, umsebenzi weshibhini kanye nesibhekezele somzimba ngokuhamba kohlelo olumisiwe abaphathi bephrojekthi. Thatha izinqubo zansuku zonke ngokuhamba kwemisebenzi kanye nemithetho yeshibhini. Gcina amarekhodi afanele womsebenzi kanye namadethi ekhompyutha. Meldeni futhi nibuyekeze umphathi wephrojekthi njalo mayelana nenhambiswano yephrojekthi. Abafaki izicelo kumele babe nesibopho, beme kahle ngomzimba futhi bakwazi ukusebenza ezimeni ezinzima zomhlaba eziphezu kwezimo zezulu; bafune ukusebenza nezilwane, okuhlanganisa nokuphatha izinyoni zasolwandle ezindala kanye nezinsipha, okudinga ukuzwelana nezinyoni. Abafaki izicelo abaphumelelayo bazochitha unyaka oqelete (April 2027 kuye ku- May 2028) e-Marion Island. Qaphela ukuthi ayikho indlela yokubuya ngaphambi kokuphela kohambo, uma usufike esiqhingini. Isiteshi esisha esihleliwe nesinamawoza siba nezinsiza ezigcwele ze-e-mail, fax kanye nethelweyini yesathelayithi.

xh.title: Abakhumenti basesiphundweni: Iinyoni zasolwandle
xh.summary: Kufuneka kubekho abakhumenti basesiphundweni ukwenza uphando ngohlolojioyili, umsebenzi wasesiphundweni nokuqwalasela iinyoni zasolwandle e Marion Island nge Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
xh.requirements: National Diploma (NQF Level 6) okanye izifundo ezifanelekileyo kwi Natural Science. Kufuneka kukho 0–1-year yamava emsebenzini e Marion Island. Ulwazi ngemithetho yokusingqongileyo. Iinkqubo zikarhulumente nesebe nemithetho yaso. Amava kwiziphingqisho zasemthunyeni, ulawulo lophando, ukuqokelela nokulawula iingcombolo, ukuqapha nokuphatha iinyoni, ukusasaza ulwazi, ukubhala iingxelo nokuqamba iirekhodi. Kufuneka uqaphele kakuhle iinkcukacha kwaye ube necindakada ekuthathweni kweengcombolo kwaye ubonise amava okwenza ikuqwalasela yezesayensi ezithe ngqo malunga neenyoni zasolwandle ngomgangatho ophezulu. Kufuneka uzinike ngokuzenzisela kwaye ukwazi ukusebenza kwindawo ekude ngesapho sakho nangabahlobo bakho ngaphandle kolawulo oluncinci.
xh.duties: Yenza uphando ngohlolojioyili, umsebenzi wasesiphundweni nokuqwalasela ngokwesicwangciso esilungiswe ngabaphathi bephrojekthi. Thatha iigqibo zangemihla ngemisebenzi edingekayo nangemithetho yomsebenzi wasesiphundweni. Zama ngokuchanekileyo iirekhodi zomsebenzi namanqanaba omyalelo wokhompyutha womsebenzi. Phawula kwaye uhlaziye ngamaxesha amavesi ngophuhliso wephrojekthi kumphathi wephrojekthi. Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe nenkqubo, ingqondo ehle yomzimba nendlela yokusebenza phantsi kweemeko zokusingqongileyo ezibuhlungu ezithe ngqo ngapha koko kwemo yezulu; isifuno sokusebenza neenyoni, kuquka nokuphatha iinyoni ezindala namachick amancinci, okudinga ukwazisana neenyoni. Abaphumeleleyo baya kuchitha unyaka opheleleyo (April 2027 ukuya May 2028) e Marion Island. Qaphela ukuba akukho thuba lokubuyela phambi kokuphela kohambo, inyaniso ulandile kwesi sihlumele. Isiseko esitsha esinolwalamkelo oluhle sinalonke iifasilithi ze email, fax kunye nesathelayithi yefowuni.

jobs.title: Director: Strategy, Planning and Monitoring
jobs.summary: Director role in Pretoria responsible for developing and implementing strategic planning frameworks aligned to government-wide prescripts, requiring a degree and five years' senior experience.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 plus Degree (equivalent to NQF level 7 as recognised by SAQA) in Business Management / Business Administration / Bachelor of Commerce / Public Management. A minimum of 5 years’ experience at middle / senior level (Deputy Director) in strategic management environment. Knowledge and understanding of all departmental legislation and prescripts. Understanding of the Public Finance Management Act and Regulations. Knowledge of the South African Constitution. Knowledge of the Public Service Act and Regulations, and other relevant legislation. Ability to communicate with all levels of management. Extended working hours may be required. Willingness to travel. A Valid Driver’s licence.
jobs.duties: Develop and implement frameworks on strategic planning matters: Align departmental strategies to government wide planning prescripts and frameworks in line with the DPME Framework on Strategic Plans and Annual Performance Plans and Framework for Managing Programme Performance Information. Develop the departmental strategic planning framework align to the government strategic planning prescripts and programme. Align the departmental strategic guidelines to government frameworks which are PMFA, treasury regulations and Public Service Act. Implement government planning policy documents. Develop the Departmental Strategic Plan and ensure alignment of Annual Performance Plan (APP) indicators to the strategic outcomes: Facilitate the development of the departmental strategic plan. Ensure alignment of the departmental strategic planning with MTDP (Medium Term Development Plan), Ministerial priorities and Government wide priorities (SONA, sustainable developmental goals) and compare with the priorities of the and previous performance of the department. Facilitate consultation processes with Branches and business units to ensure that strategic planning processes are understood by management. Develop performance indicators with Branches. Identify points of integration across all strategic outcomes and outputs. Develop the compilation of the Strategic Plan and Annual Performance Plan and submit for approval and tabling. Coordinate the development of Annual Operational Plans (AOP): Facilitate the development of Annual Operational Plans emanating from strategic outcome and performance outputs in line with the APP. Provide technical support to ensure managers develop achievable outputs per identified programme. Facilitate the approval of AOP. Coordinate and develop a Service Delivery Improvement Plan (SDIP): Arrange and conduct workshops to populate the SDIP template. Identify services requiring improvement as DPSA requirements. Present findings on areas that require improvement to EXCO and MANCO. Facilitate the approval of the SDIP. Monitor the implementation of the SDIP. Conduct monitoring and evaluation of performance information: Coordinate performance information reporting on a monthly basis. Coordinate the monitoring of quarterly performance reports and submission for approval. Coordinate the compilation of the annual report and its submission for approval and tabling. Coordinate the compilation of mid-term and end-term reports and their submission for approval. Manage the Directorate: Develop the operational plan for the Directorate and ensure its implementation. Allocate and manage resources at functional levels to ensure the delivery on set targets for the Directorate. Formulate, identify Policy shortfalls and necessary amendments. Conduct financial planning and account for allocated budget. Ensure adherence to policy and statutory directives relevant to the functional terrain of the Directorate and Monitor, evaluate and report on the performance of the directorate.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. DP Barnett Tel No: (012) 748 6013
