af.title: Direkteur: Strategie, Beplanning en Monitering
af.summary: Direkteurspos in Pretoria verantwoordelik vir die ontwikkeling en implementering van strategiese beplanningsraamwerke in ooreenstemming met regeringsvoorskrifte, waarvoor 'n graad en vyf jaar se senior ervaring vereis word.
af.requirements: Graad 12 plus 'n Graad (gelykstaande aan NQF vlak 7 soos deur SAQA erken) in Besigheidsbestuur / Besigheidsadministrasie / Baccalaureus Commercii / Openbarebestuur. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op middel-/ senior vlak (Adjunkdirekteur) in 'n strategiese bestuursomgewing. Kennis en begrip van alle departementale wetgewing en voorskrifte. Begrip van die Openbare Finansiesbestuurswet en Regulasies. Kennis van die Suid-Afrikaanse Grondwet. Kennis van die Openbaredienswet en Regulasies, en ander tersaaklike wetgewing. Vermoë om met alle bestuursvlakke te kommunikeer. Uitgerekte werksure kan vereis word. Bereidwilligheid om te reis. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Ontwikkel en implementeer raamwerke oor strategiese beplanningsake: Belyn departementale strategieë met regeringswye beplanningsvoorskrifte en raamwerke in ooreenstemming met die DPME-raamwerk oor Strategiese Planne en Jaarlikse Prestasieplanne en die Raamwerk vir die Bestuur van Programprestasie-inligting. Ontwikkel die departementale strategiese beplanningsraamwerk belyn met die regeringsvoorskrifte vir strategiese beplanning en die program. Belyn die departementale strategiese riglyne met regeringsraamwerke wat PMFA, tesourieregulasies en die Openbaredienswet is. Implementeer regeringsbeplanningsbeleidsdokumente. Ontwikkel die departementale Strategiese Plan en verseker die belyning van Jaarlikse Prestasieplan (APP)-aanwysers met die strategiese uitkomste: Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van die departementale strategiese plan. Verseker die belyning van die departementale strategiese beplanning met MTDP (Medium Term Development Plan), ministeriële prioriteite en regeringswye prioriteite (SONA, volhoubare ontwikkelingsdoelwitte) en vergelyk dit met die prioriteite van die en vorige prestasie van die departement. Fasiliteer raadplegingsprosesse met Takke en besigheidseenhede om te verseker dat strategiese beplanningsprosesse deur bestuur verstaan word. Ontwikkel prestasie-aanwysers met Takke. Identifiseer integrasiepunte oor alle strategiese uitkomste en uitsette. Ontwikkel die samestelling van die Strategiese Plan en Jaarlikse Prestasieplan en dien dit vir goedkeuring en voorlegging in. Koördineer die ontwikkeling van Jaarlikse Operasionele Planne (AOP): Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van Jaarlikse Operasionele Planne wat voortspruit uit strategiese uitkomste en prestasie-uitsette in ooreenstemming met die APP. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning om te verseker dat bestuurders haalbare uitsette per geïdentifiseerde program ontwikkel. Fasiliteer die goedkeuring van AOP. Koördineer en ontwikkel 'n Diensleweringverbeteringsplan (SDIP): Reël en hou werkswinkels om die SDIP-sjabloon in te vul. Identifiseer dienste wat verbetering vereis volgens DPSA-vereistes. Lê bevindings oor areas wat verbetering vereis aan EXCO en MANCO voor. Fasiliteer die goedkeuring van die SDIP. Monitor die implementering van die SDIP. Voer monitering en evaluering van prestasie-inligting uit: Koördineer prestasie-inligtingverslagdoening op 'n maandelikse basis. Koördineer die monitering van kwartaalprestasieverslae en voorlegging vir goedkeuring. Koördineer die samestelling van die jaarverslag en die voorlegging daarvan vir goedkeuring en voorlegging. Koördineer die samestelling van middeltermyn- en eindtermynverslae en die voorlegging daarvan vir goedkeuring. Bestuur die Direktoraat: Ontwikkel die operasionele plan vir die Direktoraat en verseker die implementering daarvan. Ken bronne op funksionele vlakke toe en bestuur dit om die lewering van gestelde teikens vir die Direktoraat te verseker. Formuleer, identifiseer beleidstekorte en nodige wysigings. Voer finansiële beplanning uit en verantwoord vir die toegewysde begroting. Verseker nakoming van beleid en statutêre richtlyne wat relevant is tot die funksionele terrein van die Direktoraat en Monitor, evalueer en rapporteer oor die prestasie van die direktoraat.

zu.title: Umdluli: Umkhandlu, Ukuhlela Nokubukeka
zu.summary: Isikhundla somdluli ePretoria esibhekele ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokuqondisa ngokwezinqungethe zikahulumo jikelele, esidinga idigri neminyaka emihlanu yemisebenzi ephakeme.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye ne-Degree (elingana ne-NQF level 7 njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA) kwi-Business Management / Business Administration / Bachelor of Commerce / Public Management. Okungenani iminyaka engu-5 yemisebenzi ezingeni eliphakathi / eliphezulu (Deputy Director) emhlabeni wolawulo lwezomkhandlu. Ulwazi nokuzwisisa kwawo wonke umthetho nezinqungethe zomnyango. Ukuzwisisa i-Public Finance Management Act kanye nezimiso layo. Ulwazi lwe-South African Constitution. Ulwazi lwe-Public Service Act kanye nezimiso layo, nomunye umthetho ohlobene nalo. Ikono lokuxhumana namazinga wonke olawulo. Kungase kudingeke ukusebenza amahora amude. Ukuzithoba okuhamba. I-Driver's licence esevisayo.
zu.duties: Thuthukisa futhi usebenzise izakhiwo mayelana nezindaba zokuqondisa ukuhlela: Linganisa izinqamuleli zomnyango kuzinqungethe zokuhlela kahulumo jikelele nezinhlelo ngokwe-DPME Framework on Strategic Plans and Annual Performance Plans kanye ne-Framework for Managing Programme Performance Information. Thuthukisa isakhiwo sokuhlela ngokwezomkhandlu silinganiswe nezinqungethe zokuqondisa kahulumo kanye nenqubo. Linganisa izeluleko zokuqondisa zomnyango kumakhemu kahulumo okuyi-PMFA, izimiso zesikhwama kanye ne-Public Service Act. Sebenzisa amadokhumenti ohlelo mthetho kahulumo. Thuthukisa i-Departmental Strategic Plan futhi qinisekise ukulinganiswa kwemiboniso ye-Annual Performance Plan (APP) kumziphumelelo zokuqondisa: Siza ekuthuthukisweni kohlelo lokuqondisa lomnyango. Qinisekisa ukulinganiswa kohlelo lokuqondisa lomnyango ne-MTDP (Medium Term Development Plan), izinto ebalulekile zoNgqongqoshe kanye nezinto ebalulekile kahulumo jikelele (SONA, sustainable developmental goals) futhi ziqhathaniswe nezinto ebalulekile kanye nokubukeka kwangaphambili komnyango. Siza izinqubo zokubonisana nama-Branches namayunithi ebhizinisi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo zokuqondisa ziyazwisiswa ngabolawulo. Thuthukisa imiboniso yeziphumelelo nama-Branches. Hlola amaphuzu okuhlanganisa kuzo zonke iziphumelelo zokuqondisa nemiphumela. Thuthukisa ukuhlanganiswa kwe-Strategic Plan ne-Annual Performance Plan futhi zithunyelwe ukugunyazwa nokubukwa. Hlela ukuthuthukiswa kwe-Annual Operational Plans (AOP): Siza ekuthuthukisweni kwe-Annual Operational Plans eziveza iziphumelelo zokuqondisa nemiphumela yokusebenza ngokwe-APP. Nikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaphathi bathuthukisa imiphumela efinyelelekayo ngohlelo oluliqonde. Siza ukugunyazwa kwe-AOP. Hlela futhi uthuthukise i-Service Delivery Improvement Plan (SDIP): Hlela futhi yenza amakilasi ukuze kuzaliswe ithemplethi ye-SDIP. Hlola izinsiza ezifuna ukuthuthukiswa njengezidingo ze-DPSA. G presenti iziphumelo ezindaweni ezifuna ukuthuthukiswa ku-EXCO naku-MANCO. Siza ukugunyazwa kwe-SDIP. Bheka ukusetshenziswa kwe-SDIP. Yenza ukubukeka nokuqonda kolwazi lweziphumelelo: Hlela ukubika kolwazi lweziphumelelo nyanga zonke. Hlela ukubukeka kwemibiko yeziphumelelo yexeshana nokuthunyelwa ukugunyazwa. Hlela ukuhlanganiswa kwemibiko yonyaka nokuthunyelwa ukugunyazwa nokubukwa. Hlela ukuhlanganiswa kwemibiko yexeshana eliphakathi naleyokugcina nokuthunyelwa ukugunyazwa. Lawula i-Directorate: Thuthukisa uhlelo lokusebenza kwe-Directorate futhi qinisekise ukusetshenziswa kwaso. Aba futhi ulawule izinsiza emazingeni okusebenza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulethwa kwezinhloso ezibekiwe kwe-Directorate. Hlela, hlola izinto ezhosals imithetho okungalungile kanye nokulungiswa okudingekayo. Yenza ukuhlela kwezimali futhi uphendule ngabhejidi otholiwe. Qinisekisa ukuzilandela imithetho nezinqungethe ezibalulekile emhlabeni okusebenza kuso i-Directorate futhi Buka, qonde futhi bike ngokusebenza kwe-Directorate.

xh.title: Um lawuli: Umcebisi, Ulungiselelo Nokuhlola
xh.summary: Indima kaM lawuli ePretoria enesibopho sokuphuhlisa nokuphumeza iinkqubo zolungiselelo oluzelweyo ezihambelana nemigaqo yurhulumente yonke, efunisa idigiri kunye neminyaka emihlanu yamava abavela abaphezulu.
xh.requirements: UGrade 12 ngenye yeedigiri ezilingana noNQF level 7 njengokuqatshwa yiSAQA kwiBusiness Management / Business Administration / Bachelor of Commerce / Public Management. Kufuneka abe neminyaka emi-5 ubudala emva kwesiqu kwiinqanaba elingana nonobangela kokusingathwa komcebisi ongumLawuli ongumenekeli ohloleneyo kwindawo yolawulo lwamanqanaba ahambelana neendlela zokusingathwa kwabaphathi. Kuqatshwe okubalulekileyo kweso seamde yemigaqo-nkqubo yesebe. Kuqatshwe okubalulekileyo kwiPublic Finance Management Act namagunya ayo. Kuqatshwe okubalulekileyo kwesoMgaqo-siseko waseMzantsi Afrika. Kuqatshwe okubalulekileyo koMgaqo-nkqubo weSebe loRhulumente namagunya ayo, nakoMgaqo-nkqubo ongakuhambelana nawo. Kufunek abe nakho ukuthetha ngokusetyenziswa kweendlela ezahlukeneyo kwizinto ezahlukeneyo.
xh.duties: Phuhlisa kuphumeze iinkqubo kumacandwo obulungiselelo ngokuhamba kwexesha kwaye uqinisekise ukuba iindlela zesebe ziyilongisel ngokuchanekileyo kwimigaqo yurhulumente yonke esebenzisa iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo njengoko kucetyiswa ngumGaqsiseko olulu ulawulo oluvela kwiDPME kwiiNkqubo ezingamaCandwo ezeLungiselelo kunye neziQondo ezingamaCandwo eziQondiswe kuPhuhliso ezingamaNqanaba ahukeneyo. Phuhlisa iinkqubo zesebe ezihambelana nemigaqo yurhulumente yonke. Lungiselela iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezihamba kwelinye iqondo elingaqinisekiswa kwizinto ezahlukeneyo. Qinisekisa ulungiselelo lwesebe ngokuchanekileyo ngokuhambelana noMGaqsiseko weNkqubo yoLungiselelo ngokuchanekileyo noMthetho wokuLawula iNtlawulo kuSebe lokuLungiselelo ngokuchanekileyo noMgaqo-nkqubo wokuLawula kuSebe lokuLungiselelo. Phuhlisa kuphumeze iNkqubo yesebe yeNdlela ezahlukeneyo zokuLungiselela. Phuhlisa iNkqubo yesebe yeNdlela yokusingathwa kwamaQondo aSebe aPfilewayo (APP) kunye noMhla oQinisekisiweyo (APP) kuQinisekiso olusemthethweni. Qhuba imihlala-ngesithiyo ngeSebe. Qhuba imihlala-ngesithiyo eNtlongano yoNyaka (AOP). Yiba nedlela yokusinika amathuba okuLawula iNtlawulo yeSebe lokuLawula iNkqubo yoNyaka (SDIP). Phuhlisa iNkqubo yeSebe yeNdlela yokusingathwa kweZiko eSebe lokuSebenza (SDIP). Qhuba iNkqubo yokusinika amathuba okuLawula iNtlawulo yeSebe lokuLawula iNkqubo yeNdlela. Yiba nedlela yokusinika amathuba okuLawula iNtlawulo yeSebe lokuLawula iNkqubo yoNyaka (SDIP) yeNdlela yokusingathwa kweZiko. Qhuba iNkqubo yeNdlela yokusingathwa kweZiko eSebe lokuSebenza (SDIP). Qhuba iNkqubo yeNdlela yokusingathwa kweZiko eSebe lokuSebenza (SDIP).

jobs.title: Director: Facilities Management
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), all-inclusive package CENTRE             Pretoria
jobs.summary: Director of Facilities Management position in Pretoria requiring a degree in the built environment and at least five years' senior facilities management experience.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 plus Degree (equivalent to NQF 7 qualification as recognised by SAQA) in Build environment/ Property Management/Facilities Management or related field. Government Certificate of Competency (GCC) an added advantage. A minimum of 5 years’ experience at middle/senior level (Deputy Director) in Facilities Management environment. Knowledge of the Public Service Regulatory Framework. Extensive knowledge of M&E, risk, planning, compliance and management methodologies and practices. Ability to communicate with all levels of management. Extended working hours may be required. Willingness to travel. A Valid Driver’s licence.
jobs.duties: Manage the provisioning of property management services: Manage the provisioning of property maintenance services. Manage the development and implementation of a Facilities Management Maintenance Plan or Improvement Programme for the GPW. Oversee the contract management portfolio and ensure the implementation of clear guidelines and specifications for execution. Manage the review of stakeholder’s Service Level Agreements to improve internal and external relationships with stakeholders’/service providers. Manage office allocation, maintenance, refurbishment and renovation in GPW. Coordinate the management of lease agreements between the GPW and the Landlords. Manage the rendering of office services: Manage the process of planning the allocation of accommodation utilisation and monitor the compliance with Occupational Health and Safety Standards. Manage the interpretation of the property portfolio and influence the internal environment through appropriate accommodation management and utilisation. Oversee waste disposal, cleaning, parking and fleet management services: Manage the development and implementation of transport management guidelines. Ensure the periodical inspection of facilities are accurate, advice and recommend on preventative maintenance measures needed. Manage the provisioning of overall cleaning services. Ensure safety and compliance of accommodation regulations are in line with the risk management framework. Manage waste disposal and keep a record of the allocation of parking space in the Department. Ensure the proper utilisation and maintenance of departmental vehicles. Oversee the development, maintenance and implementation of the departmental strategies, processes and procedures pertaining to facility management: Manage and monitor the development of Facilities Management Strategy. Manage the development and implementation of relevant processes, procedures and systems to comply with legislative requirements in the resource optimisation environment. Manage the Directorate: Develop the operational plan for the Directorate and ensure its implementation. Allocate and manage resources at functional levels to ensure delivery on set targets for the Directorate. Formulate and identify Policy shortfalls and necessary amendments. Conduct financial planning and account for the allocated budget. Ensure adherence to policy and statutory directives relevant to the functional terrain of the Directorate. Monitor, evaluate and report on the performance of the Directorate.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. DP Barnett Tel No: (012) 748 6013
jobs.applications: Link: GPW 26/05

af.title: Direkteur: Fasiliteitsbestuur
af.summary: Direkteur van Fasiliteitsbestuur-pos in Pretoria waarvoor 'n graad in die beboude omgewing en ten minste vyf jaar se senior fasiliteitsbestuurservaring vereis word.
af.requirements: Graad 12 plus 'n Graad (equivalent to NQF 7 qualification as recognised by SAQA) in die beboude omgewing/Eiendomsbestuur/Fasiliteitsbestuur of 'n verwante veld. 'n Government Certificate of Competency (GCC) is 'n bykomende voordeel. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op middel-/seniorvlak (Deputy Director) in 'n fasiliteitsbestuursomgewing. Kennis van die Openbare Diens Reguleringsraamwerk. Uitgebreide kennis van M&E-, risiko-, beplannings-, nakomings- en bestuursmetodes en -praktyke. Vermoë om met alle bestuursvlakke te kommunikeer. Uitgebreide werksure kan vereis word. Bereidwilligheid om te reis. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Bestuur die verskaffing van eiendomsbestuursdienste: Bestuur die verskaffing van eiendomsonderhoudsdienste. Bestuur die ontwikkeling en implementering van 'n Fasiliteitsbestuurs-Onderhoudsplan of Verbeteringsprogram vir die GPW. Hou toesig oor die kontrakbestuurportefeulje en verseker die implementering van duidelike riglyne en spesifikasies vir uitvoering. Bestuur die hersiening van belanghebbendes se Service Level Agreements om interne en eksterne verhoudings met belanghebbendes/diensverskaffers te verbeter. Bestuur kantoortoewysing, onderhoud, opknapping en renovasie in GPW. Koördineer die bestuur van huurooreenkomste tussen die GPW en die verhuurders. Bestuur die lewer van kantoordienste: Bestuur die proses van beplanning van die toewysing van akkommodasiegebruik en monitor nakoming van Occupational Health and Safety-standaarde. Bestuur die interpretasie van die eiendomsportefeulje en beïnvloed die interne omgewing deur toepaslike akkommodasiebestuur en -gebruik. Hou toesig oor afvalbeskikking, skoonmaak, parkeer- en vlootbestuursdienste: Bestuur die ontwikkeling en implementering van vervoerbestuursriglyne. Verseker dat die periodieke inspeksie van fasiliteite akkuraat is, en gee advies en aanbevelings oor benodigde voorkomende onderhoudsmaatreëls. Bestuur die verskaffing van algehele skoonmaakdienste. Verseker veiligheid en nakoming van akkommodasiereëlings in ooreenstemming met die risikobestuursraamwerk. Bestuur afvalbeskikking en hou 'n rekord van die toewysing van parkeerruimte in die Departement. Verseker die behoorlike gebruik en onderhoud van departementele voertuie. Hou toesig oor die ontwikkeling, onderhoud en implementering van departementele strategieë, prosesse en prosedures rakende fasiliteitsbestuur: Bestuur en monitor die ontwikkeling van die Fasiliteitsbestuurstrategie. Bestuur die ontwikkeling en implementering van tersaaklike prosesse, prosedures en stelsels om aan wetgewende vereistes in die hulpbronoptimaliseringsomgewing te voldoen. Bestuur die Direktoraat: Ontwikkel die operasionele plan vir die Direktoraat en verseker die implementering daarvan. Wys hulpbronne op funksionele vlakke toe en bestuur dit om levering op gestelde teikens vir die Direktoraat te verseker. Formuleer en identifiseer beleidstekorte en nodige wysigings. Voer finansiële beplanning uit en hou verantwoording oor die toegewysde begroting. Verseker nakoming van beleids- en statutêre direktiewe wat tersaaklik is tot die funksionele terrein van die Direktoraat. Monitor, evalueer en rapporteer oor die prestasie van die Direktoraat.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ukuphathwa Kwezakhiwo
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi wokuphathwa kwezakhiwo ePretoria esidinga idigri kumazinga okwakha kanye nokuhlangenwe khona okungenani eminye yisihlanu ekuphathweni kwezakhiwo ezingeni eliphezulu.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 plus Degree (ehlotshaniswa nesifundo se-NQF 7 njengoba setshunqiwe yi-SAQA) kumandla wokwakha/ Ukuphathwa Kwezindlu/ Ukuphathwa Kwezakhiwo noma inkambu ephathelene nalokho. Isitifikedi Kahulumeni Sokukwazi (GCC) kuyinzuzo ekwedlulele. Okungenani eminye yisihlanu kokuhlangenwa khona ezingeni eliphakathi/elphezulu (Umphathi Onamandla) kumkhakha wokuphathwa kwezakhiwo. Ulwazi ngesikhungo sokulawula Imisebenzi Yomphakathi. Ulwazi olubanzi ngo-M&E, ingozi, ukuletha kwezinhlelo, ukuhambisana namazinga, kanye nezindlela zokuphatha nendlela yokwenza. Ikono lokuxhumana namaphongo onqenqema onke amazinga. Kungadingeka ukusebenza amahora amaningi. Ukuzithoba ukuhamba. Isitifiketi Esivumelekile Sokushayela.
zu.duties: Phatha ukunikezwa kwezinsiza zokuphathwa kwezindlu: Phatha ukunikezwa kwezinsiza zokugcina izindlu. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kweHlelo Lokuphathwa Kwezakhiwo Noma Iprovharamu Yokuthuthukisa ye-GPW. Qapha ibhange eliphathelene nokulawula izinkontileka futhi qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezimiso eziqondile nezinkomba ezicacile ukuze kwenziwe umsebenzi. Phatha ukubuyekeza Izinkontileka Zezinhlelo Zokukhonza zabahlanganyeli ukuthuthukisa ubudlelwano bongaphakathi nangaphandle nabahlanganyeli/abahlinzeki bezinsiza. Phatha ukwabiwa kwezikhundla zamabhulidi, ukulondolozwa, ukushintshwa nokubuyiswa kabusha e-GPW. Hlanganisa ukuphathwa kwezinkontileka zokuhlinzwa ngesibali phakathi kwe-GPW nabanikazi bezindlu. Phatha ukunikezwa kwezinsiza zolunyoukusebenza: Phatha inqubo yokuhlela ukwabiwa kwezindlu okusetshenziswa futhi qapha ukuthi kuhambisana yini namazinga oMthetho Wezempilo Nokuphepha Okusebenzayo. Phatha ukuhumusha ibhange lezindlu futhi muncwe emkhakheni ongaphakathi ngokuphathwa kwamakhono okuhlala nokusetshenziswa okufanele. Qaphela ukulahlelwa kwezinhlahla zokwenza umsila, ukushova, ukupaka kanye nezinsiza zokuphatha ibhange lamakhathoni: Phatha ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwezimiso zokuphathwa kwezokuthutha. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukuhlola izakhiwo njalo kwenzwa ngokunembile, futhi nikela ngeluleko futhi nokuhamba phambili ngokulondolozwa kwezinyathelo ezingadingekile. Phatha ukunikezwa kwezinsiza zokushova zamakhaya aphelele. Qinisekisa ukuphepha nokuhambisana namagunya okuhlala ahambisana nesikhungo sokuphatha ubungozi. Phatha ukulahlelwa kwezinhlahla zokwenza umsila futhi gcina irekhodi lokwabiwa kwesikhala sokupaka kumnyango. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okufanele nokulondolozwa kwezimoto zomnyango. Qaphela ukuthuthukiswa, ukulondolozwa nokusetshenziswa kwezindlela, izinqubo namagunya omnyango ahlobene nokuphathwa kwezakhiwo: Phatha futhi ulawule ukuthuthukiswa kweNdlela Yokuphathwa Kwezakhiwo. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwezinqubo, izimiso namasistimu ahlobene nokuhambisana nemithetho yezidingo kumkhakha wokulondolozwa kwezinsiza. Phatha Ikhanda leMisebenzi: Thuthukisa icebo lokusebenza leKhanda leMisebenzi futhi qinisekise ukusetshenziswa kwalo. Yabela futhi uphathwe izinsiza emazingeni asebenzayo ukuze uqinisekise ukufeza okuhlosiwe ngokweKhanda leMisebenzi. Hlela futhi uchaze ukwehluleka kwezinqubo kanye nezinguquko ezidingekayo. Yenza uhlelo lwezimali futhi uzibophe ekubhajethini okwabeliwe. Qinisekisa ukulandelwa kwezinqubo kanye nezinkomba zemithetho ehlobene nomkhakha osebenzayo weKhanda leMisebenzi. Lawula, hlola futh wenze umbiko ngemisebenzi yeKhanda leMisebenzi.

xh.title: Mongameli: uLawulo lweziFasilithi
xh.summary: Isikhundla sikaMongameli wolawulo lwezifasilithi ePretoria esifuna idigri kwandawo yakhiwa kwaye kube namava okungenwa okungenani iminyaka emihlanu kowona mongameli wolawulo lwezifasilithi.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrajiyethi 12 kuqatshelwe neDangwe (lingalingana neNQF 7 njengokuqatshelwa yi-SAQA) kwindawo yokwakha/ uLawulo lweMpahla/ uLawulo lweziFasilithi okanye indawo ephathelele leyo. Isatifikethi sikaHulumendi sabakhubeleki (GCC) siba lusizi. Amava amadinga okungenwa okungu-5 iminyaka ubuncinane emazinga apakathi/aphezulu (Sekela Mongameli) kwindawo yolawulo lweziFasilithi. Ulwazi ngeNyathelo loLawulo lwesiLungu sikaHulumendi. Ulwazi olubanzi nge-M&E, ingozi, ukucwangcisa, ukuzithoba kwaye nezindlela zokulawula kwaye nokwenzeka kokuqatshelwa. Ikhono lokuthetha nabaphathi abanqwenelayo. Kusenokufuneka kusebenze emva kweyure. Ukulungele ukuhamba. Ilayisenisi yokuQhuba esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Lawula ukunikela ngezinkonzo zolawulo kwempahla: Lawula ukunikela ngezinkonzo zokulondoloza impahla. Lawula ukuphuhliswa nokusebenziswa kweNkqubo yokulondoloza eYilwayo kwelawulo leziFasilithi okanye iNkqubo yokuphucula kwi-GPW. Qonda umthunywa wolawulo weziqinisekiso kwaye uqinisekise ukusebenziswa kwemiqathango necaciso elicacileyo ekuphumeleleni. Lawula ukuphonononga iSaziso ngeQondo leNkonzo zabathintathelana ukuphucula ubudlelwane bangaphakathi nangaphandle nabathintathelana/abakha izixhobo zolonikelelo lweenkonzo. Lawula ukwabiwa kweeofisi, ukulondoloza, ukulungisa nokuvuselela kwi-GPW. Lawula ulawulo lovimba wezivumelwano zokuhisha phakathi kwe-GPW nabaNini mizi. Lawula ukunikelwa kweenkonzo ze-ofisi: Lawula inkqubo yokucwangcisa ukwabiwa kokusetyenziswa kwindlu kwaye ulawule ukuthobela imigaqo yeMilo yokuSayika kwiMisebenzi nasekuKhuselekeni. Lawula ukucretsa ulwazi ngesiqinisekiso semali okanye ulawulo lokusebenza kwempahla kwaye usetyenzise ulwazi malunga nokuqatshelwa kwentengiso ngokulawula okulungileyo kwendlu kwaye uqinisekise ukusetyenziswa ngokufanelekileyo. Lawula ukugcinwa kokuchithwa, ukucocwa, iindlela zokupaka nokulawula inkqubo yeemoto: Lawula ukuphuhliswa nokusebenziswa kweenkqubo zokulawula ezithile ezingaguqukiyo zemithetho yolawulo yethutho. Qinisekisa ukuba iindaba ezithile ezilandelayo zihlobo zikwakhalo ezifanelekileyo, zincokole kwaye zicebise ngendlela yokulondoloza iindawo ezingahoyi kakhulu. Lawula ukunikela ngezinkonzo zokucoca ngokupheleleyo. Qinisekisa ukhuseleko nokuthobela imigaqo yendlu ngokusemthethweni ngokuhamba kwemigaqo yokulawula engozi. Lawula ukuchithwa kwezinto ezingasafunekiyo kwaye ugcine irekhodi yokwabiwa kwendawo yokupaka kwiSebe. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa ngokufanelekileyo nokulondoloza iimoto zesebe. Qonda ukuphuhliswa, ukulondoloza nokusebenziswa iindlela zokuziphatha, iinkqubo namacebo esebe ngokumalunga nolawulo lwezifasilithi: Lawula kwaye ulawule ukuphuhliswa kweNkqubo yolawulo kweziFasilithi. Lawula ukuphuhliswa nokusebenziswa kweenkqubo, iinkqubo namacebo okuhambelana nemigaqo yomthetho kwindawo yokusebenzisa izixhobo ngokulinganiselekileyo. Lawula isiKhulu: Cwangcisa iNkqubo yokusebenza kubuse weZikhulu kwaye uqinisekise ukuyisebenzisa. Yahlula kwaye ulawule izixhobo ngamazinga abo ukqinisekisa ukufezwa kwamaphupha abekelwe esiKhulu. Cwangcisa kwaye uchaze iindawo ezingagqitywanga ngokucacileyo kumigaqo nezilungiso eziyimfuneko. Yenza icwangciso lemali kwaye uchaze ngebhajethi ekwabelwe. Qinisekisa ukulandela imigaqo nemiyalelo yomthetho esebenzayo kumthetho wobuso babuse weZikhulu. Qonda, hlola kwaye ungexelela ngemisebenzi yesiKhulu.

jobs.title: Director: ICT Security, Governance, Risk and Compliance

jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 plus Degree (equivalent to NQF 7 qualification as recognised by SAQA) in Information Technology /Computer Science/ Business Information. Knowledge of the basic configuration of the various systems like Transversal Systems (BAS, LOGIS, PERSAL). Sound knowledge and application of the GITO Requirements and Frameworks. Knowledge of the State Information Technology Agency Act 88 of 1998. Knowledge of the government policy framework consultation paper developed by GITO. jobs.duties: Manage the design and implementation plans for infrastructure architecture: Manage the enforcement of infrastructure architecture execution as well as ongoing refinement tasks regarding infrastructure architecture. Manage the evaluation of technology, market trends and industry development on business within the GPW. Manage the identifying of the prospective impact on business within the GPW and the identification of a need to change technical architecture to incorporate infrastructure needs. Manage the safeguarding of information assets by identifying and solving potential and actual security problems: Manage the protection of the IT system by defining access privileges, controlling structures and resources. Manage the implementing of security improvements by assessing the current situation, evaluating trends and anticipating the necessary requirements. Manage the determining of security violations and inefficiencies by conducting periodic IT audits. Manage the upgrading of the system. Manage the building of firewalls into network infrastructures, data centres and constantly monitoring for attacks and intrusions. Manage the process of designing and defining the IT strategy and ICT service(s) continuity: Manage the implementation of corporate governance of ICT. Manage the safeguarding of information assets and information systems by identifying and solving potential and actual security problems. Manage the process to build ICT governance controls. Manage ICT risk and compliance. Manage and align the ICT strategy to the business strategy. Manage the designing and planning the Directorate’s objectives and operations to the business continuity plan. Oversee the IT service Support and Operations: Administer the implementation of the ICT incident management and requests fulfilment. Coordinate the compilation of performance report. Facilitate the acquisition of end-user devices. Manage the standardization of new computers user accounts. Manage the Directorate: Develop the operational plan for the Directorate and ensure its implementation. Allocate and manage resources at functional levels to ensure delivery on set targets for the Directorate. Formulate, identify Policy shortfalls and necessary amendments. Conduct financial planning and account for allocated budget. Ensure adherence to policy and statutory directives relevant to the functional terrain of the Directorate. Monitor, evaluate and report on the performance of the directorate.

Inzuzo Eyongeziwe: CCNA, COMPTIA Server+ Certificate COBIT 5, ITIL, IT Service Management certification, Information Security certifications, KING 3 or 4, Project Management, CISSP, CISP, CISA, CRISC, CGEIT, TOGAF. Ukwazi okuqinile kwemigagango yokuqasha ulwazi okungenani (MISS, iphepha lesikhundla ngosekurithi yolwazi ISO 17799 (Information Security framework). Ukwazi i-Public Service Regulatory Framework. Ukuqonda imigagango ye-corporate Governance kanye nomthetho nezincwadi ze-Human Resources. Kudingeka ukunweba amahora okusebenza. Kuzodingeka ukuhamba.
zu.duties: Phatha ukudizayina nezinhlelo zokuqashwa kwezakhiwo zempangiso: Phatha ukuphoqwa kokuqashwa kwezakhiwo zempangiso kanye nemisebenzi yokuthuthuka ngokuphefumula mayelana nezakhiwo zempangiso. Phatha ukuhlola itheknoloji, izinto ezikhona emakethe nentuthuko yembono kumshini ngaphakathi kwe-GPW. Phatha ukuqashwa komthelela ohlezi uphelela kumshini ngaphakathi kwe-GPW kanye nokubona isidingo sokushintsha izakhiwo ezobuchwepheshe ukufaka izidingo zempangiso. Phatha ukuqashwa kwezintuthuko zesekurithi ngokuqinya isimo samanje, ukuhlola izinto ezikhona kanye nokubona izidingo eziyadingeka. Phatha ukutholwa kokwephulwa kwesekurithi kanye nokungaluleki ngokwenza ukuhlolwa kwesistimu ye-IT ngesikhathi esithile. Phatha ukweswa kwe-sistimu. Phatha ukwakha amadivayisi okuzivikela ohlelweni lwenethiwekhi, izikhungo zedatha bese uqapha njalo ukushombolozwa nokungena ngaphandle. Phatha inqubo yokudizayina nokuchaza uhlelo lwe-IT kanye nokuphela kwezinsiza ze-ICT: Phatha ukuqashwa kolawulo lwe-corporate governance ye-ICT. Phatha ukuvikela okwaziswa nezinhlelo zolwazi ngokuqapha nokuxazulula izinkinga zesekurithi ezingaba khona nezivele. Phatha inqobo yokwakha izilawulo zolawulo lwe-ICT. Phatha ingozi kanye nokuhambisana nemithetho ye-ICT. Phatha futhi ulungelelise uhlelo lwe-ICT kuwo ohlelo lomshini. Phatha ukudizayina nokuhlela imigomo nemisebenzi ye-Directorate ohlelweni lokuqhubeka kumshini. Qapha ukusekelwa kwezinsiza nokusebenza kwe-IT: Lawula ukuqashwa kokuqashwa kwezinsimbi ze-ICT kanye nokuqedwa kwezicelo. Hlanganisa ukuhlanganiswa kwesibiko sokusebenza. Facilitate ukutholwa kwezinsiza zabadayisi. Phatha ukumiswa kwemithetho emitsha yama-akhawundi abasebenzisi bamakhompyutha. Phatha i-Directorate: Tumba uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-Directorate bese uqinisekisa ukuqashwa kwalo. Aba bese uphatha izinsiza ezibucayi ukuze uqinisekise ukulethwa emigidingweni esethiwe ye-Directorate. Bala, qapha izikhala ezincane emigagango kanye nokulungiswa okudingekayo. Yenza ukulethwa kwemali futhi uphendule ngebhajethi ekezelwe. Qinisekisa ukuzilandela imigagango kanye nemiyalo esemthethweni ehlobene nendawo yokusebenza ye-Directorate. Qapha, hlola bese ubika ngokusebenza kwe-Directorate.

Yiba ngumcebisi ongathembekiyo kubasebenzi bakho, ukuba ulungele ukwenza izigqibo ezisemthethweni ezikulawulo lwakho. Cima iingxaki ezithile ezikwingcinga yakho ngokukhawuleza, kodwa ngokusemthethweni. Ukuba uzimisele ukuphuhliswa kolawulo lwakho, ukhokele iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezinceda ukuphuhliswa kolawulo lwakho. Lawula ukulinganisa kobuchwepheshe, iintshukumo zemarike nakuphuhliso kwishishini kwishishini ngaphakathi kwi-GPW. Lawula ukuqonda umthamo ogqithiselayo kwishishini ngaphakathi kwi-GPW kunye nokuqonda isidingo sokutshintsha ubuchwepheshe bolwakhiwo ukuze kuquke iimfuno zolwakhiwo. Lawula ukuqwalaselwa kophuhliso lokhuseleko ngokuqwalasela imeko yanamhlanje, ukuqwalasela iintshukumo nokubona iimfuno ezifunekayo. Lawula ukumiswa kokwaphula khuseleko nangasebenzi ngokwenza uvavanyo lwe-IT ngamaxesha athile. Lawula ukuphuculwa kwenkqubo. Lawula ukufakelwa kweefirewalls kwindalo yesixhobo senethiwekhi, iindawo zedatha nokujonga ngokuhamba kwexesha ukhuseleko lweentlwebhu kunye nokungena ngaphakathi. Lawula inkqubo yokulunda nokuchaza i-strategy ye-IT kunye nokuphila(ko)kwesebe le-ICT: Lawula ukuqatywa kolawulo lweshishini le-ICT. Lawula ukukhusela iimpaho zolwazi iinkqubo zolwazi ngokuqonda nokusombulula iingxaki ezinokubakho kunye neze khona ezixhonywe khuseleko. Lawula inkqubo yokwakha izilawulo zorhulumente kulwazi-lwesi-ICT. Lawula ingozi ye-ICT nokuvunyelwa. Lawula kwaye ulungelelanise i-strategy ye-ICT eya kwestrategy yeshishini. Lawula ukulunda nokucwangcisa iinjongo kunye nemisebenzi ye-Directorate kwicebo lokuphila kobuchwephesha. Qwalasela inkxaso yesebe nakwimisebenzi ye-IT: Lawula ukuqatywa kokulawula iingozi ze-ICT kunye nokuzelelwa kwezicelo. Lawula ukubhalisa ingxelo yokusebenza. Qedela ukufumana iisixhobo zabasebenzisi-baqhelanisi. Lawula ukumiswa kwamaxwebhu amatsha kweeprofayile zabasebenzisi bekhompyutha. Lawula i-Directorate: Phuhlisa icebo lokusebenza le-Directorate uze uqiniseke ukuqatywa kwaso.abela kalunga kunye nokulawula imithombo kwiiqondo zomsebenzi ukuze kuqiniseke ukufikelela kwabakhuselwe kumgangatho othile wokuqatywa kwe-Directorate. Yenza ngokusezicwangciso, qonda iindleko ezishiyekanga ngokomthetho kunye noseto olufunekayo lwamalungiselelo. Yenza iplani yemali uze wonyule ibhajeti elingeniswe kuwe. Qiniseka ukusikelwa idolo ngumthetho malunga nemigaqo yesikhokelo ekummandla wakhe womsebenzi ukuze kusetyenziswe i-Directorate. Qwalasela, vavanya uze ungxelela ngokusebenza kwe-Directorate.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Costing and Pricing
jobs.summary: Deputy Director needed in Pretoria to develop and maintain costing and pricing systems, requiring a finance degree and three years' relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 plus Degree (equivalent to NQF level 7 as recognised by SAQA) in Cost and Management Accounting or B Com Finance majored with Costing. A minimum of 3 years’ experience at an Assistant Director level in Costing and Pricing/Estimation/Accounting environment. Knowledge of the Public Service Regulatory Framework. Knowledge of the PFMA, Financial Management, National Treasury Regulations, prescripts, cost accounting and business practices. Other: Valid Drivers licence. Knowledge and understanding of public service policies and procedures. Understand the PFMA and Treasury Regulations. Understanding of Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act.
jobs.duties: Develop, implement and maintain costing and pricing system. Oversee and gather sourcing and verification of pricing information/data and unit costs. Ensure the creation and maintenance of data accumulation and reporting systems in relation to policies, work in progress, standard cost and selling price: Provide advice to staff members on pricing strategies and ensuring compliance with all rules and regulations relating to the proposal requirements. Maintain accurate information/data in cost and selling prices databases. Offer pricing strategies making cost proposals more competitive and cost efficient. Manage, monitor and report on costing and pricing of materials: Manage cost proposal modifications. Collect cost and pricing data for bids including in- country data, market data for cost line items and provide reports. Develop templates and other proposal forms. Manage/ Conduct work centre rates calculations: Ensure the receipt of GPW budget per cost centre and planning of the recovery rate. Ensure the utilisation of the number of hours available for production against the cost centres . Allocate other indirect and variable cost to cost centres on the absorption key. Manage the total manufacturing cost including indirect cost. Ensure the analysis of performed work and job ticket closure: Manage/ Conduct and analyse the labour utilisation, raw materials consumption, efficiencies and adherence to processes. Close jobs as finished goods at the manufacturing completion. Ensure the delivery of other completed jobs to customers Ensure the analysis of the department’s profitability for revenue versa via cost of sales: Ensure the quarterly analysis of standard stock cost versa via selling prices to determine if the department is making profits. Ensure the analysis of the purchase price variance report to update the inventory and standard cost. Provide managerial activities: Monitor and ensure proper utilisation and maintenance of equipment. Evaluate and monitor performance appraisal of subordinates. Ensure capacity building and training of staff. Develop job descriptions for subordinates. Implement workplace discipline. Effective management of sub-ordinates’ leaves. Allocate work.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Koste- en Prysbepaling
af.summary: 'n Adjunkdirekteur word in Pretoria benodig om koste- en prysstelsels te ontwikkel en te onderhou, waarvoor 'n finansgraad en drie jaar se relevante ervaring vereis word.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 plus 'n Grade (gelykstaande aan NQF level 7 soos deur SAQA erken) in Cost and Management Accounting of 'n B Com Finance met Costing as hoofvak. 'n Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring op 'n Assistant Director-vlak in 'n Costing and Pricing/Estimation/Accounting-omgewing. Kennis van die Public Service Regulatory Framework. Kennis van die PFMA, Financial Management, National Treasury Regulations, voorskrifte, kosterekeningkundige en besigheidspraktyke. Ander: Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis en begrip van openbare diensbeleid en prosedures. Begrip van die PFMA en Treasury Regulations. Begrip van die Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act.
af.duties: Ontwikkel, implementeer en onderhou koste- en prysstelsels. Hou toesig op en versamel broning en verifikasie van prysinligting/data en eenheidskoste. Verseker die skepping en instandhouding van data-akkumulasiestelsels en verslagdoeningstelsels met betrekking tot beleid, werk in wording, standaardkoste en verkoopprys: Verskaf advies aan personeellede oor prysstrategieë en verseker nakoming van alle reëls en regulasies wat verband hou met die voorstelvereistes. Onderhou akkurate inligting/data in databasisse vir koste en verkooppryse. Bied prysstrategieë om kostevoorstelle meer mededingend en kostedoeltreffend te maak. Bestuur, monitor en rapporteer oor koste en prysbepaling van materiaal: Bestuur wysigings aan kostevoorstelle. Versamel koste- en prysdata vir bodde, insluitend plaaslike data, markdata vir kostereëlitems, en verskaf verslae. Ontwikkel sjablone en ander voorstelvorms. Bestuur/voer werksentrumkoersberekeninge uit: Verseker die ontvangs van die GPW-begroting per kostesentrum en beplanning van die herwinningskoers. Verseker die benutting van die aantal beskikbare ure vir produksie teenoor die kostesentrums. Wiys ander indirekte en veranderlike koste toe aan kostesentrums op die absorpsiesleutel. Bestuur die totale vervaardigingskoste, insluitend indirekte koste. Verseker die ontleding van verrigte werk en sluiting van werktickets: Bestuur/voer ontleding uit van arbeidsbenutting, grondstowwe-verbruik, doeltreffendheid en nakoming van prosesse. Sluit take af as klaargemaakte goedere by voltooiing van vervaardiging. Verseker die aflewering van ander voltooide take aan kliënte. Verseker die ontleding van die departement se winsgewendheid vir inkomste via koste van verkope: Verseker die kwartaalontleding van standaardvoorraadkoste via verkooppryse om te bepaal of die departement wins maak. Verseker die ontleding van die aankoopprysafwykingsverslag om die voorraad en standaardkoste op te dateer. Verskaf bestuursaktiwiteite: Monitor en verseker behoorlike benutting en onderhoud van toerusting. Evalueer en monitor prestasiebeoordeling van ondergeskiktes. Verseker kapasiteitsbou en opleiding van personeel. Ontwikkel werksbeskrywings vir ondergeskiktes. Implementeer werksplekdissipline. Effektiewe bestuur van ondergeskiktes se verlof. Wiys werk toe.

zu.title: Omhwebe: Ukubala Izindleko Nokushaja Intengo
zu.summary: Kudingeka Omhwebe ePretoria ukuthuthukisa futhi agcine izinhlelo zokubala izindleko nokushaja intengo, kudingeka iziqu zezimali kanye neminyaka emithathu yobuchule obuhambisanayo.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye neziqu (okulingana ne-NQF level 7 njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA) ku-Cost and Management Accounting noma i-B Com Finance edlule ku-Costing. Ukwazi okuncane kweminyaka engu-3 kokusebenza esikhundleni sika-Assistant Director esimweni sokubala izindleko nokushaja intengo/ukulinganisa/isimo sezimali. Ulwazi mayelana ne-Public Service Regulatory Framework. Ulwazi mayelana ne-PFMA, Ukuphathwa Kwezimali, I-National Treasury Regulations, imilayo, ukubala izindleko kanye nezinhla zokwenza umsebenzi. Okunye: Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwaziukuqonda izinqubomgomo kanye neziyalezelo zenkonzo kahulumeni. Ukuqonda i-PFMA kanye ne-Treasury Regulations. Ukuqonda i-Public Service Act, i-Public Service Regulations, i-Labour Relations Act.
zu.duties: Thuthukisa, faka esikhathini sangaphambilisise kanye nokugcina uhlelo lokubala izindleko nokushaja intengo. Buka ngokushesha futhi uqoqe imininingwane/imininingo yokuthola futhi uqinisekise ukushaja intengo kanye nezindleko zeyunithi. Qinisekisa ukudalwa nokugcinwa kwezinhlelo zokuqoqa imininingo nokubika okuhlobene nezinqubomgomo, umsebenzi osaqhubekayo, izindleko eziqavile kanye nentengo yokuthengisa; Nikeza izeluleko abasebenzini mayelana nezindlela zokushaja intengo futhi uqinisekise ukuzilandela bonke imithetho kanye nemilayo ehlobene nezidingo zesiphakamiso. Gcina imininingwane/imininingo eqinisekilewe emakhasimede az izindleko kanye nezintengo zokuthengisa. Hlinzeka ngezindlela zokushaja intengo ezenza iziphakamiso zezindleko zibe nomncintiswano futhi zihamba kahle ngokwezindleko. Phatha, qapholisise bese ukhipha umbiko mayelana nokubala izindleko nokushaja intengo kwezinsimbi: Phatha ukushintshwa kwesiphakamiso sezindleko. Qoqela imininingwane yokubala izindleko kanye nokushaja intengo mayelana nezinketho okubandakanya imininingwane yezwe, imininingwane yasemakethe yemitshwalense futhi uhlinzeke ngemibiko. Thuthukisa amafomu wokuqopha kanye namanye amafomu okuphakamisa. Phatha/Yenza izibalo zamaphuzu emisebenzi: Qinisekisa ukutholwa kwebhajethi ye-GPW kuleso sikhungo sezindleko kanye nokuqashwa kwesibalo sokulungiselela. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwenani lamahora atholakalayo okukhiqiza ngokumelene namakhaya ezo zindleko. Hlanganisela eminye imikhakabhiyane ethwala okuhlukahlukene kwamakhaya ezindleko ngokokhiye wokumunca. Phatha ngokuphelele izindleko zokukhiqiza okubandakanya izindleko ezingaqondile. Qinisekisa ukuthwetshulwa komsebenzi kanye nokuvalwa kwamathikithi womsebenzi: Phatha/Yenza futhi uhlole ukusetshenziswa kwabasebenzi, ukusetshenziswa kwempahla, izindlela ezihamba kahle kanye nokulandela izinqubo. Vala imisebenzi njengempahla eqedile ekugcineni kokukhiqiza. Qinisekisa ukulethwa kwezinye imisebenzi eqediwe kumakhaya Wenza kuqondakale ukutholwa komsebenzi: Qinisekisa ukuhlolwa kwesikhathi esithathu ngesikhathi esithathu kwezindleko zomchamo kanye neentengo ezikhiqizwa, ukuze kube yizindleko eziqashelwayo. Qinisekisa ukuhlolwa kwesikulo. Qiniseka. Qinisekisa ukuhlolwa kumbiko wokuhluka kwentengo yokuqasha ukuze ubuyisele imininingo kanye nezindleko zomgidingo. Amandla okusebenzisa amadatha. Hlinzeka ngezinkinga zokubhalisa emhlabeni: Hlola ukusebenza ngokuphelele bese uqapha ubuchule, amandla, nokwenzeka okuhlolwayo. Bika ukukhula kwethimba. Qiniseka isikhathi esilingene sokuhlolwa kwemininingo yemisebenzi ethintekayo. Qedela izidingo ezimayelana nemisebenzi. Zama ukuphatha kubukeka ngokuphelele kwangemva kokuhlinzeka ngokuthumela imisebenzi ethunyelwe ngemvama yokungena ngokusemthethweni kwezohlelo zokuhlela imisebenzi yokuphathwa kwezimali nokwamukela imininingwane ehlobene nokugcina imininingo nokuqinisekisa ukulandelwa komthetho ngemithetho yokubuyisela imininingwane ehlobene ngemisebenzi ehloselwe ukubuyiselwa endaweni yayo ngokuvumelana nokuqondakala kokusebenziswa kwamandla emisebenzi yokubuyisela imininingo ehlobene nokugcina imininingo eqinisekisiweyo. Qinisekisa ukuhlolwa kwezinkinga zokubalwa komsebenzi: Hlola bese uqinisekisa ukutholakala nokugcinwa kwempahla ethengiswayo. Hlola kanti futhi bheka kokubili ukusetshenziswa kanye nokuqhubela phambili kwezomphakela. Hlola futhi uqinisekise isikhathi esithile sokutholwa kokuhlolwa. Hlola bese uqinisekise imisebenzi ekhokhelwa ngaphambili eyenzeke emhlabeni wokutholwa kwemisebenzi. Hlola ukuba khona nokungabi khona kwezinsiza ezibhekene nokunqamula amaqiniso mayelana nokubhaliswa kokutholwa kwemisebenzi ehlobene ukubhaliswa kwemisebenzi.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Iindlela zokuNxulumba nokuBeka ixabiso
xh.summary: Kufunekwe iSekela Mongameli ePretoria ukuba aqhube kwaye agcina iindlela zonxulumba nokuvela ixabiso, kusafuneka inqond yezemali iya kunyaka wamathathu wamava ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 12 ngenye i-Degree (elingangokuqondisa NQF level 7 njengokuqatshelwa yi-SAQA) kwi-Cost and Management Accounting okanye i-B Com Finance ngesihloko se-Costing. Amava angaphantsi kweenyanga ze-3 njengoMncedisi weSekela Mongameli kwindlela yokuNxulumba nokuBeka ixabiso/Icala nokuQikelela/Iindlela ze-Akhawunti. Ulwazi nge-Public Service Regulatory Framework. Ulwazi nge-PFMA, uLawulo lweMali, Iimigaqo ze-National Treasury, iimila, iindlela ze-akhawunti yendlela zokuNxulumba namashishini. Ezinye: ilayisenisi yoQhubi esemthethweni. Ulwazi nokuqonda iimeko zoburhulumente kunye neendlela. Ukuqonda i-PFMA kunye neeRegulation ze-Treasury. Ukuqonda i-Public Service Act, i-Public Service Regulations, i-Labour Relations Act.
xh.duties: Yakha, seta kwaye ulugcine uluvo lokuNxulumba nokuBeka ixabiso. Qhweba kwaye uqokelele ulwazi ngemvelaphi nokuqinisekisa ngolwazi lweemvelaphi malunga nexabiso leemayitha. Qinisekisa iindaba ezisemthethweni nokuqhubela phambili iindlela ze-sistim ekugcineni iinkcukacha malunga nee-meeko, umsebenzi oqhubekayo, iindlela zexabiso eliqhelekileyo kunye nexabiso lokuthengisa. Nikeza ingcebiso kumajoni abasebenzi ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo zokuBeka ixabiso kwaye uqinisekise ukuthobela imigaqo namacebo ecotho malunga neemfuno zokuNgenisa izicelo. Gcina ulwazi oluchanekileyo kumasumbula weemvelaphi nexabiso lokuthengisa. Nikeza iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuBeka ixabiso ukwenza iindlela zokuNxulumba zibe namandla nakuzinza. Lawula, qwalasela kwaye wenze ingxelo ngeendlela zokuNxulumba nokuBeka ixabiso zezixhobo. Lawula iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokutshintshwa kweendlela zokuNxulumba. Qokelela iinkcukacha ezingangenanga mntu ngokubandakanya ngaphakathi kwelizwe, ngokuthengiswa ngenyxiba malunga nokuNxulumba kokubeka ixabiso kwiindidi ezahlukeneyo zokusetyenziswa kunye negalelo ngexabiso. Yakha iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuzalisekisa izicelo ezingangenanga mntu. Lawula / Qhuba iindlela zeendlela zokusetyenziswa kwindawo yokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukufumaneka kwe-GPW ngokwexabiso leemvelo zeentengiso kwaye ulungiselele iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokugqibela. Lawula iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezilungelelanisa ukusetyenziswa kwamaxesho amaninzi apha kwindawo yokwenza iimvelo ngexabiso. Misa olunye ulwazi olungalunganga ngolwazi olutshintshayo kwimvelo ngexabiso ngokomyekelelo wemigaqo. Lawula iindlela zonke zemali ezingangeniso ngokubandakanya iindlela ezilungelekileyo zemali ezingangeniso. Qinisekisa ukuyilo konke ukusebenza nokwamkelwa kweendawo ezahlukeneyo zokusetyenziswa njengemali esekwenziwe ngokugqibela. Lawula / Qhuba kwaye uqwalasele ukusetyenziswa kolunye ulwazi, ukusetyenziswa kwezinto ezingangenanga mntu kwiindidi ezahlukeneyo, imida yokusebenza ngokulinganisa nokwamkelwa kwiindlela ezahlukeneyo. Vala iindawo ezahlukeneyo zokusebenza njengemali ezenziweyo ngokwemigqaliselo yokuqhubela phambili. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kolunye ulwazi olugqityiweyo ngokwemigqaliselo ngabathengi. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kweemveliso ngobulumko bokusingatha ngokuchasene neemveliso ezilungelekileyo ukugqibela. Qinisekisa ukuyilo kwamaxesha amaninzi amabini onke amaxesha okulinganisa ixabiso lokuguqula nokuthengisa ukumisela ukuba ithafa leMali lisebenza ngenkululeko yokwenza imali. Qinisekisa ukuyilo kweemveliso ezahlukeneyo ezilungelekileyo zokuqwalasela ukusetyenziswa kolunye ulwazi olulungelekileyo ukulungisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokubeka ixabiso kwiindlela ezilungelekileyo. Nikeza ulunye ulwazi olulungelekileyo ngokuchukumisa kolunye ulwazi olulungelekileyo kwimigca yonke. Qwalasela kwaye uqinisekise ukusetyenziswa kolunye ulwazi lwezixhobo ngokuchukumisa kolunye ulwazi ngokomthetho. Qwalasela kwaye uqwalasela uluvo lokwamkelwa kolunye ulwazi ngokusetyenziswa kolunye ulwazi lwezixhobo ezilungelekileyo. Qinisekisa ukwakha iindlela ezilungelekileyo zokusetyenziswa kolunye ulwazi lwezixhobo ezilungelekileyo nokulungisa ulunye ulwazi. Misa kwindlela ezilungelekileyo zokusetyenziswa kolunye ulwazi olulungelekileyo. Yakha iindlela ezilungelekileyo zokusetyenziswa kolunye ulwazi lwezixhobo ezilungelekileyo kubasebenzi. Seta ngokusebenzisa iindlela ezilungelekileyo zokusetyenziswa kolunye ulwazi kwindlela ezilungelekileyo zokusetyenziswa kolunye ulwazi olulungelekileyo. Lawula ulunye ulwazi.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Management Accounting
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Management Accounting position in Pretoria requiring a finance degree and three years' experience to manage financial reporting functions at Government Printing and Works.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 plus degree (equivalent to NQF level 7 as recognised by SAQA) in Financial Management or Finance. A minimum of 3 years’ experience at an Assistant Director level in a financial/accounting environment. Valid Driver’s licence. Knowledge of the Public Service Regulatory Framework. Knowledge of the PFMA, Financial Management, National Treasury Regulations, prescripts, cost accounting and business practices. Other: Travelling may be required. Extended working hours may be required. Ability to communicate with all levels of management.
jobs.duties: Compile monthly/quarterly management account reports: Manage the financial revenue, expenditure, and accounting reporting functions within the GPW. Provide monthly/quarterly feedback to Business units Head and the CEO. Managing the analysing and reporting on income, expenditure, assets and liabilities. Monitor an efficient and effective bookkeeping system and financial control within the GPW. Provide strategic guidance in decision-making on reporting, compliance or regulatory matters. Ensure the development and execution of financial reporting strategies and systems: Analyse financial statements and quarterly reports. Analyse profitability by product line and reporting on it through a sales profitable report. Analyse the consumption rates of printing equipment. Monitor waste disposal levels/ratio. Provide inputs to the annual spending plans aligned to the business plan for the coming year. Review all Directorate policies. Ensure compliance with relevant legislation and directives: Ensure compliance with the PFMA and Treasury Regulations, requirements. Ensure proper responses to audit findings and requests for information. Compile/oversee reporting in terms of the Public Finance Management Act. Oversee/Review compliance reports/certificate. Manage the Sub-directorate: Monitor and ensure proper utilisation and maintenance of equipment. Evaluate and monitor performance appraisal of subordinates. Ensure capacity building and training of staff. Implement workplace discipline. Provide inputs on the development/review of Business plans with clear roles and responsibilities assigned with the resource’s requirements identified.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. H Ellimdin Tel No: (012) 748 6379
jobs.applications: Link: GPW 26/08

af.title: Ondirekteur: Bestuursrekeninge
af.summary: Ondirekteur: Bestuursrekeninge pos in Pretoria wat 'n finansies-graad en drie jaar se ervaring vereis om finansiële verslagdoeningsfunksies by Government Printing and Works te bestuur.
af.requirements: Graad 12 plus 'n graad (gelykstaande aan NQF level 7 soos deur SAQA erken) in Finansiële Bestuur of Finansies. 'n Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring op 'n Assistentdirekteur-vlak in 'n finansiële/rekenkundige omgewing. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van die Openbare Diens Reguleringsraamwerk. Kennis van die PFMA, Finansiële Bestuur, Nasionale Tesourie Regulasies, voorskrifte, kosterekeninge en besigheidspraktyke. Ander: Reis kan vereis word. Verlengde werksure kan vereis word. Vermoë om met alle vlakke van bestuur te kommunikeer.
af.duties: Stel maandelikse/kwartaallikse bestuursrekenaarverslae op: Bestuur die finansiële inkomste-, uitgawe- en rekenkundige verslagdoeningsfunksies binne die GPW. Verskaf maandelikse/kwartaallikse terugvoer aan hoofde van besigheidseenhede en die CEO. Bestuur die ontleding en verslagdoening oor inkomste, uitgawes, bates en laste. Monitor 'n doeltreffende en effektiewe boekhoudstelsel en finansiële beheer binne die GPW. Verskaf strategiese leiding in besluitneming oor verslagdoening, nakoming of regulerende aangeleenthede. Verseker die ontwikkeling en uitvoering van finansiële verslagdoeningsstrategieë en stelsels: Ontleed finansiële state en kwartaalverslae. Ontleed winsgewendheid volgens produklyn en doen daaroor verslag deur middel van 'n winsgewendheidsverslag. Ontleed die verbruiksyfers van druktoerusting. Monitor afvalverwyderingsvlakke/verhouding. Verskaf insette tot die jaarlike bestedingsplanne wat ooreenstem met die besigheidsplan vir die komende jaar. Hersien alle Direktoraatbeleid. Verseker nakoming van toepaslike wetgewing en riglyne: Verseker nakoming van die PFMA en Tesourie Regulasies, vereistes. Verseker behoorlike reaksies op ouditbevindings en versoeke om inligting. Stel op/oesien verslagdoening ingevolge die Public Finance Management Act. Oesien/Hersien nakomingsverslae/sertifikate. Bestuur die Subdirektoraat: Monitor en verseker behoorlike benutting en instandhouding van toerusting. Evalueer en monitor prestasie-evaluering van ondergeskiktes. Verseker kapasiteitsbou en opleiding van personeel. Implementeer werksplekdisipline. Verskaf insette oor die ontwikkeling/hersiening van besigheidsplanne met duidelike rolle en verantwoordelikhede wat toegeken is met die hulpbronnereqvereistes geïdentifiseer.

zu.title: ONganele: Izimali Eziphathwayo
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaNganele: Izimali Eziphathwayo ePretoria esidinga iziqu zezezimali nokuhlangenwe nakho kweminyaka emithathu okuphatha imisebenzi yokuvela kwezimali kuGovernment Printing and Works.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye neziqu (elingana nenqanaba le-NQF level 7 njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA) kwi-Financial Management noma i-Finance. Okungenani ukuhlangenwa nakho kweminyaka eyi-3 kunqanaba likaAssistant Director endaweni yezimali/izibalo. Ilayisenisi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi nge-Public Service Regulatory Framework. Ulwazi nge-PFMA, i-Financial Management, i-National Treasury Regulations, izelayi, izibali zezindleko kanye nezinqubo zebhizinisi. Okunye: Kungase kudingeke ukuhamba. Kungase kudingeke ukusebenza amahora amade. Ikhono lokuxhumana nabaningi bonke abaphathi.
zu.duties: Hlunga imibiko yezimali eziphathwayo yenyanga/kwesikhashana: Phatha imali ezingenayo, izindleko, nemisebenzi yokuvela kwezibalo ngaphakathi kwe-GPW. Nikela impendulo yenyanga/kwesikhashana kuNobhala wezikhungo zeBhizinisi kanye no-CEO. Phatha ukuhlaziya kanye nokuvela ngemali engenayo, izindleko, izimpahla kanye nezikweletu. Qaphela isistimu efanele nesebenzayo yokubhala izibalo kanye nokulawula izimali ngaphakathi kwe-GPW. Nikela isiqondiso esinobuqhawe ekuthathweni kwezinqumbo ngokuvela, ukulandelwa komthetho noma izindaba ezilawulwayo. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezinqumbo zokuvela kwezimali kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza: Hlaziya izitatimende zezimali kanye nemibiko yesikhashana. Hlaziya inzuzo ngomugqa womkhiqizo bese kuvelwa ngayo ngommbiko wenzuzo yethengiso. Hlaziya izinga lokusetshenziswa kwemishini yokushicilela. Qaphela amazinga/ugudlu lokulahlekelwa. Nikela okokufaka emaphulenini okushiswa nyaga zonke ahambisana nephula lebhizinisi lowaka ozayo. Cabangela wonke amapholisi we-Directorate. Qinisekisa ukulandelwa komthetho ohlobene kanye nezinqumbo: Qinisekisa ukulandelwa kwe-PFMA kanye ne-Treasury Regulations, izidingo. Qinisekisa izimpendulo ezifanele kumatholwe okuhlola kanye nezicelo zolwazi. Hlunga/qaphela ukuvela ngokwe-Public Finance Management Act. Qaphela/cabangela imibiko/izitifiketi zokulandelwa komthetho. Phatha i-Sub-directorate: Qaphela futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa okufanele kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwemishini. Hlaziya futhi uqaphele ukulinganiswa kokusebenza kwezisebenzi. Qinisekisa ukwakhiwa kwamandla kanye nokuhlelela izisebenzi. Setha isiyalo esebenzini. Nikela okokuthuthukisa/cabangela kabusha amaphula eBhizinisi anamagunya namaphethini abekiwe kanye nezidingo zezinsiza eziqashelwe.

xh.title: Isebe elingenele: Ubuhlengucashela Bolawulo
xh.summary: Isithuba sekuba nguMongameli okaNye: Ubuhlengucashela Bolawulo ePretoria esafuna isidanga kwezezimali kunye namava emyaka emithathu ukulawula imisebenzi yokubika ngemali ngokwakwa i-Government Printing and Works.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 12 negunya elingana nesidanga se-NQF level 7 njengoko kubonwa yi-SAQA kwilawulo leezezimali okanye i-Finance. Ukuba ndithi angaphantsi kweminyaka engama-3 amava kulwazi obulinganiselwe kwindlela yoMqathu weNqanaba kwindawo ekukho iimali/okubhalwayo ngokwakha izimali. Ilayiseni elikhoyo yomqhubi. Ulwazi malunga nolwakhiwo loLawulo Lesebe Lomsebenzi Wohulumeni. Ulwazi malunga ne-PFMA, Ulawulo leezezimali, Imithetho ye-National Treasury, izibhalo ezithile, ubuhle bobungaziimali nendlela zokusebenza. Okunye: Unokuqatshelwa ndlela zokuhamba. Unokufuneka usebenze iiyure ezimbini. Ikhono lokunxibelelana nabaqhubi abakuzo onke amanqanaba.
xh.duties: Lungiselela/ziphisise iingxelo zobuhlengucashela bezinyanga/zonyaka ezili-3 ngokwamaqela: Lawula imali egqithiswayo, imali ekhutshwayo, kunye nomsebenzi wokubika ngeemali ngaphakathi kwi-GPW. Nikezela ingxelo ngokwamasinye ngenyanga/isikwetha kwi-Qela lezeMisebenzi kuSihlalo kunye no-CEO. Lawula uhlalutyo nokubika ngemali egqithiswayo, ekhutshwayo, iimpahla nangemimiselo emisiweyo. Qhatha ukusebenza koluntu lokubhalisa izinto ngemali oluqhuba kakhulu ngokuchanekileyo nolulawulo ngemali ngaphakathi kwi-GPW. Nikezela inkokhelelo yobuchwepheshe ekuthatheni izigqibo ngokubika, ngokumisela imithetho nangamagunya e-Audit. Qinisekisa ukuphuhliswa kunye nokusebenza kweenkqubo zokubika ngeemali kunye nezithulusi: Hlalutya izatshetho zemali kunye neengxelo zonyaka ezili-3 ngokwamaqela. Hlalutya inzuzo ngesalathiso semveliso ubuye ubike ngakunye ngeengxelo ezibonisa inzuzo kwintengiso. Hlalutya izinga elithathwa ngokutshatshaliswa kwezixhobo zokushicilela. Qhatha izinga/bungakanani bokuziphoswa iindonga ezongamileyo. Faka izimvo kwizicwangciso zokuhola ngemali zonyaka ozayo ezilungelelaniswe nescwangciso leMisebenzi yonyaka ozayo. Phengulula zonke iingqwalasela zikaBala. Qinisekisa ukuzilandelana kwemithetho ebalulekileyo kunye neenyaleko: Qinisekisa ukuzilandelana kwe-PFMA nemiThetho yo-National Treasury, iimfuno. Qinisekisa iimpendulo ezichanekileyo kumakrwa e-Audit nakwisicelo senkcazelo. Lungiselela/qhatha ukubika ngokwemithetho ye-Public Finance Management Act. zu.title: Umphathi Ohlangene: Ukuphethuka Kwebhizinisi Nokuhambisana Nemithetho
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi ohlangene esibuka ukuphathwa kokuphethuka kwebhizinisi, ukuhambisana nemithetho, ukuhlola imingcele yengozi kanye nentuthuko yenqubomgomo ye-BCM ye-GPW ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Umfundi we-Grade 12 kanye ne-Degree (efana ne-NQF level 7 njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA) ku-Business Administration / Business Management / Risk Management / Business Continuity / Internal Audi / Finance / Law/ ICT / Risk Management. Ukwazi okungenani iminyaka engu-3 yamava kokuphathwa kokuphethuka kwebhizinisi ezingeni lomphathi osize. Ilayisense yokuqasha okusemthethweni kuzoba yinzuzo ekungeziye. Ukuqonda i-Public Service Act, i-Public Service Regulations, i-Labour Relations Act, ne-Skills Development Act. Ukuqonda okuhle i-PFMA, i-Financial Framework, kanye ne-Treasury Regulations. Ukuqonda imigomo emihle yokuphathwa kwenkampani (King III Report). Ukuqonda yonke imigiqamfanelo yemithetho ehlobene nabaluleki bantu, imithetho kanye nemibhalo yesiqondiso.
zu.duties: Sungula futhi usebenzise inqubo yokuphathwa kokuphethuka kwebhizinisi (BCM) ye-GPW: Yenza ukuhlola kwempembelelo yebhizinisi. Yenza ukuhlola imingcele yengozi ye-BCM. Cula imigomo namasu ye-BCM, amasu okuphendula i-BCM, izinhlelo zokuhlola i-BCM namasu kanye namathuluzi nemiqulu yokuqondisa ye-BCM. Sekela ukuhlolwa, ukugcinwa kanye nokubuyekezwa kwe-BCM. Sungula isakhiwo sokuphathwa kwe-BCM: Sekela ukusungulwa kwesakhiwo sokuphathwa kwe-BCM se-GPW (isb. i-Business Continuity Committee; amafulemu abashinelikombe be-BCM, njl.). Cula imigomo yokubhekise kumasakhiwo okuphathwa kwe-BCM. Sekela futhi uhlele izinkomidi zahlela amabhizinisi ezindaweni kanye nezifundazwe zonke ze-GPW. Qedela ukuhlolwa kwamasiko okuhlobene nobuhlakani bokuqonda bomthetho nokuziphendulela kwe-GPW ebufakazini bokusebenza njalo, bobuqotho njengoba kutshwaywe ngamadokhada e-GPW asemthethweni. Hlela futhi ube ngumlobi wezinkomidi zokuqonda konke okuhlangene kwelungelo elinganampumuleko, isibonakaliso nesinxibe esikhokhelwa yi-GPW ngokusobala ngokokuqotshwa ngemikhawulo yokusebenzela nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ukugcizelela ukukhokhelwa ngemali yokuhlinzeka ngokubalulekile. Bika ngeminyuzi ngokuhlanganisa imibiko kwabaphathi nezinkomidi zokuqaphela. Hlela imibiko yamakhota yezinkomidi ezithi zithole ukuziphendulela. Qedela amasu okuqaphela isiko elihle le-BCM nokuziphendulela ngaphakathi kwe-GPW: Hlela isiteleka se-BCM esihlangene nobuhlakani bobuciko bokuqashwa imali yebhizinisi ukuziphendulela. Bonisa ulwazi, amagama amakhulu, izinkomidi, nezinkinga abantu abangabe bazi ngqo konke okuhlobene nokulawula amandla e-GPW. Cabanga ngokuqinisekile mayelana nalabo abangase bangene ezindaweni okungenziwa izindaba ezihlobene nendawo yocingo. Buyeza ngokusobala ngaphansi kokuthi uqedele ukusiza ukuze ugcine isikhundla kumkhakha wekhwaliwe eholayo ohlolayo. Qaphela futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa okulungile kanye nokuqashwa kokuqasha kokulondoloza izinsiza zokusiza nokuqonda okuhle kokulondolozwa okuphathelene nokuqedela ukusebenzisa imithetho ye-GPW emihle ukuba nakho ukwamukela imisebenzi efanele ehleli ehleliwe ehleziyo, nokuba nazo zonke izinkinga ngokucophelela nokuba namava amaningi ngesidingo sokuqinisekisa ukusebenza ngenkathi eqinile ngokubuka amandla amakhulu okwenza kahle konke.

xh.duties: Seka uphumeze inkqubo yoLawulo loQhubeko lweShishini (BCM) ye-GPW: Qwalasela uQwalaselo loMthelela weShishini. Qwalasela uQwalaselo lweNgozi ye-BCM. Seka isakhiwo solawulo se-BCM: Ququnda isakhiwo soLawulo se-BCM se-GPW (umz. iKomiti yoQhubeko lweShishini; iifowum zeentshabo ze-BCM, njl). Phezulu iinkcazelo zomsebenzi zesakhiwo soLawulo lwe-BCM. Ququnda ukuhlela iindibano zekomiti ye-BCM. Zenza imisebenzi yebala lokwamkela iinkqubo ze-BCM. Seka uphumeze inkqubo yolawulo lokuzithobela i-GPW: Phezulu ukuququnda kwaye uphumeze umgaqo nendlela yokuzithobela/isu loLawulo lokuZithobela. Qwalasela iinkqubo zoLawulo lweNgozi yokuzithobela. Ququnda ukwakhiwa kolwelo lwamazwe apho kuzithobela khona i-GPW nakhalenda yokuzithobela. Qwalasela iingxelo zokuZithobela nyanga ezintathu kubalawuli nakumakomiti oqwalaselo. Phezulu iingxelo zokuZithobela nyanga ezintathu kubalawuli nakumakomiti oqwalaselo. Misela inkcubeko elungileyo ye-BCM nokuzithobela kwi-GPW: Qwalasela imfundo ye-BCM kumalungu onke i-GPW, kuquka iindawo. Qwalasela imfundo yokuzithobela kumalungu onke i-GPW kuquka iindawo. Phezulu iimpatho zolwazi nge-BCM nokuzithobela ezingeniswa kundlela yokuthetha ngaphakathi i-GPW. Qwalasela uphando lokulinganisa inkcubeko ye-BCM nokuzithobela. Lawula iNgelabakonke: Qwalasela ukuqinisekisa ukusetyenziswa okulungileyo nokugcinwa koloncedo. Linganisa ulondoloza ukuqwalaselwa komsebenzi wabagcinwa. Qinisekisa ukwandiswa kwamandla nemfundo yabasebenzi. Phezulu iinkcazelo zomsebenzi zabagcinwa. Nikezela iingxelo ezinye kwangenyanga nakwingenyanga ezintathu ezaneleyo/ezitheanye neNkqubo yeShishini/APP/Iqela leNkqubo. Nikezela iingxelo ngokwakhiwa/ukuphinda kuqwalaselwe iinkqubo zeshishini zinendima necala elichaziweyo, nemfuno yemithombo yaziwayo.

Ukuqonda ngokugqamile izimiso zokuqondiswa koluntu oluhle.
zu.duties: Bizelelisa futhi uhlele ukusetshenziswa kwamadokhumenti okuphatha iingozi: Yenza ucwaningo lwezindlela ezinhle, uthuthukise futhi uhlele izindlela zamamodeliwezingozi. Yenza ukubukeka kwenqubomgomo yokuphathwa kwezigozi kwa-GPW. Yenza, ufake, futhi ugcine inqubomgomo yokuphathwa kwezigozi ehlelekile neyanele i-GPW. Yenza futhi usakaze amapulani okusetshenziswa nyakenyonke ekuphathweni kwezigozi. Xhumana namayuniti omsebenzi ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kokuqashwa kwezigozi kwa-GPW kuhamba ndawonye. Luleka abaphathi nganoma yiziphi izindaba eziphathelene nokuphathwa kwezigozi. Yenza isilinganiselo sezengozi se-GPW: Qamba futhi uxhase abamele izingozi bebhalansi ekusebenzeni isinqubo sokuphathwa kwezigozi, isilinganiswo sezengozi, nokubika ngezigozi. Hlela ngokuvama kwesikhathi isilinganiso sezengozi esihlelekile kanye nesokuqashwa, izinkalo zengozi zemigwaqo yomsebenzi, izinkalo zengozi zenkohlakalo kanye nezingozi ezitholakala kumabhologo. Bhalisa ezinye izinhlela zokulawula izengozi, bhalisa izinhlela ezisetshenziswa emabhologweni, futhi bhalisa izinhlela zokuphathwa kwezigozi kumabhologo. Yenza izinto zokwazisa ngokuphathwa kwezigozi ukusetshenziswa kwasekhaya kwi-GPW. Mela ibhuloho kumaphaneli aphathelene nezinye izindaba zikahulumeni.
