Yenza imisebenzi yabahloli bebhalansi. Yenza ukubukwa kwesikhathi ngeminye yonke yamapulani wezigozi kubhaliswelubalamthetha. Xhumana nohlobo lokubhala olungaphakathi nolungaphandle ngemibuzo ephathelene nezinkalo zengozi. Lawula iqhaza elingaphansi kwesikhathi esimaphakathi: Qaphela futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kusetshenziswa kahle futhi kugcinwe kahle imishini. Hlola futhi ubuke ukusebenza kwabasebenzi abangaphansi kwakho. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kohlelo kanye nokuqeqshwa kwabasebenzi. Hlela inqubo yokubhala okuyimfihlo. Yenza isiqondiso sendawo yokusebenza. Lawula ngokuphumelelayo ukukhishwa kwamalungeni abasebenzi abangaphansi.

xh.title: Menkuru wolawulo: Ulawulo loMngcipheko
xh.summary: Isithuba sikaMenkulu wolawulo: Ulawulo loMngcipheko ePretoria esifuna isidanga kunye neminyaka emithathu yamava ngangoQeqesho loMncedi wolawulo kulawulo lomngcipheko.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 12 eNqanaba le-12 kwanye ne-Degree (elinganayo nelo-NQF level 7 njengokuqatshelwa yi-SAQA) kwi-Risk Management / Internal Auditing / Finance / Business Management. Iminyaka engu-3 yamava nangaphezulu kwinqanaba loMncedi wolawulo kwimeko yolawulo lomngcipheko. Ilayisenesi yokushayela iya kuba ngumonde olongezelelekileyo. Amava kulawulo lokuzeleyo iya kuba ngumonde olongezelelekileyo. Ukuqonda ngokupheleleyo yonke imithetho egunyazisa imisebenzi yemithombo yabantu, iimvumelwano namagqabantshathi. Ukuqonda ngokupheleleyo i-Public Service Act, i-Public Service Regulations. Ukuqonda i-PFMA nemiGaqo ye-Treasury, nangaphezulu. Ukuqonda ngokupheleleyo imigaqo ye-Good Corporate Governance (King Report).
xh.duties: Phepha kuqwalaselwa ngokwemigaqo echanekileyo yonwaba lokuqhuba imisebenzi yolawulo lomngcipheko: Phando ngeendlela eziloncedo kakhulu, uphuhlise kwaye ucace indlela zamafimu namagqabantshathi ezilawula ukuchaneka koloyiko oluvela kuyo nayiphi na imeko. Phuhlisa ulwazi lokwenza umgaqo-nkqubo wolawulo lomngcipheko lwa-GPW kwaye ulawule isiphumezo sawo. Phuhlisa, phumeza kwaye ulondoloze umgaqo-nkqabo wolawulo lomngcipheko olulungele i-GPW. Phuhlisa kwaye uzichaze iinkqubo zonyaka ezifanelo ukuba zisenzielwe kwi-GPW. Qhagamshelana namayunithi omsebenzi ukuqinisekisa ukuba kukho ukumangalisana nokuhambelana kolawulo lomngcipheko ngaphakathi kwi-GPW. Nikezela ngolwazi ngayo nayiphi na imiba ezalathwa ngokulawula ingozi kwabaphathi bayo. Qwalasela iingozi ezinokubakho kumsebenzi we-GPW: Qamba kwaye uxhase oMmeleli be-Branishi kolawulo lomngcipheko kumsebenzi wokuqwalasela iingozi, uluvo ngengozi nokuvelisa iingxelo zamaxesha onke. Diba iziphumo zamaxesha onke kunye nohlaziyo lweemeko ezichazwe ngokomthetho. Qwalasela iingozi ezinokubakho ezingenisa ubungozi ekuphumezeni iinkqubo ezize ngokuchanekileyo. Qamba isiphelo sabexesha iingxelo zamaxesha onke ezibuyeziweyo ngokulawula imisebenzi nokuqinisekiswa ulawulo lomsebenzi wakho nangonina na ubani na. Qamba iingxelo zamaxesha onke malunga neengozi ezilawulwayo, kunye neengozi ezingalawulekiyo, iingozi ezibangelwa yimisebenzi yamaprojekthi, iingozi ezibangelwa ukubakho kwamaxhala, kunye namaxhala amaninzi onke olunye usetyenziso. Qinisekisa ukuba ukulawula iingozi ezilawulwayo ngabazini bazo, kwaye kubekho isiphemezo salo naluphi na uluvo ngolwazi lwemiba eqhubekayo. Sikhulisa isiko elilungele ukuziphatha kolawulo lwemiba yoloyiko kwi-GPW: Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo lomngcipheko yonke iminyaka, kuqwalaselwe iindawo zonke zase-GPW. Phuhlisa iinkqubo ezilungele ukwazisa ngokulawula iingozi kwindalo ekuphathwa ngayo imiba yangaphakathi kwi-GPW. Mela ibalse lemisebenzi kumabakhusi oluqwalaselwayo kolunye uluvo ngokulawula imiba. Qwalasela umgangatho, iingozi, imigaqo nendlela ezisebenza ngayo xa kubekho imigaqo eqokiweyo. Qamba iingxelo ngengozi kwaye ulawule imisebenzi yolawulo lomngcipheko: ZiiNgxelo zemihla leyo nangemini malunga nexesha elithathwa ngumngcipheko wolawulo lomngcipheko. Sebenzela njengomxhasi wekomiti yomngcipheko. Yenza ukugcina ixesha elithathwa luluhlu lomngcipheko kwiinkqubo ezihamba phambili ngokulawula iingozi ezilawulwayo, iingozi ezikummandla wemisebenzi, iingozi kwiiNgingu zakulawula iingozi ngamanye amaxhala, kunye namanyuzemntu aze aphile eqongqothelwe ngokukhethwa kwakho. Qhagamshelana nama-Auditor aseNgaphakathi naseNangaphandle kumibuzo yokuqwalasela yamaxesha onke kwindawo ekulawulwa ngayo imiba ezingozi. Lawula iSebe lomncedi ovela kulo: Lawula kwaye uqinisekise ukusetyenziswa ngokufanelekileyo nasekulondolozeni inkqubo yokujongana nayo nayiphi na imiba ekhoyo. Qwalasela kwaye ulawule uluvo kubomi babo baphakamileyo kunye noluvo abasebenzela kubo ngokulawula iimfuno zomsebenzi. Qhuba imisebenzi yokulawula abantu abangaphantsi kwakho. Qamba iingxelo zomsebenzi zabantu abangaphantsi kwakhe. Phumeza imigaqo yokuziphatha kwandawo yokusebenza. Lawula ngokufanelekileyo i-peyile yabasebenzi abangaphantsi kwakho.

jobs.title: Director: Forensic Mental Health
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum, (an all-inclusive remuneration package), (basic salary consist of 70% of total package, the State’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund (13% of basic salary) and a flexible portion]. The flexible portion of the package can be structured according to the Senior Management Service guidelines.
jobs.summary: Director position overseeing forensic mental health services compliance and policy development, requiring an NQF 7 qualification in a mental health profession and five years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 certificate and an appropriate NQF 7 in Mental Health Related Profession (Medicine, Psychiatric Nursing, Psychology, Occupational Therapy or Social Work) as recognised by SAQA. Registration with a relevant statutory council as a Mental Health Practitioner. Postgraduate qualification in Psychiatry or another relevant mental health specification will be an advantage. At least five (5) years’ experience in middle/senior managerial level in the field involved with forensic mental health. Demonstrable experience in forensic psychiatry/mental health including care, treatment and rehabilitation of State patients and mentally ill prisoners as outlined in the Mental Health Act No 17 of 2002. Evaluation/assessments relating to section 77, 78 and 79 Criminal Procedure Act No 51 of 1977 (as amended), section 11 of the child Justice Act No 75 of 2008. Implementation of Sexual Offences Act. Knowledge in health legislation and health policies, health systems as well as of Clinical Mental Health/psychiatry/psychology, forensic mental health and research. Good communication (verbal and written), facilitation and people management, financial management, leadership, planning and organization, problem solving, human resource management and computer skills (MS Office package). A valid driver’s license. SMS pre-entry Certificate is required for appointment finalization.
jobs.duties: Process, monitor and ensure compliance of the department with the legislative mandates emanating from the Mental Health Care Act, Criminal Procedure Act, Child Justice Act, and Sexual Offences Act. Develop legislation, policies, guidelines and programmes on forensic mental health services. Develop training programme for psychiatrics and clinical psychologists on the implementation of the legal mandates emanating from the Criminal Procedure and Child Justice Act. Ensure adequate appropriate infrastructure for forensic mental health services. Develop and seek approval for the proposal on a project for increasing beds for mental observations in psychiatric hospitals. Consult provinces on the number of beds required for mental observations in designated psychiatric hospital. Maintain and update information management systems on forensic mental health. Keep and update information management systems for State patients on movements to and from designated psychiatric hospitals. Facilitate intersectoral, interdepartmental and intradepartmental collaboration on issues pertaining to forensic mental health. Serve in the Director-General’s Child Justice Committee and the Development Committee (DevComm) of the Criminal Justice system led by the Department of Justice and Constitutional Development. Participate in the Human Rights Commission on issues pertaining to the human rights of involuntarily detained persons.
jobs.enquiries: Ms CM Mongale Tel No: (012) 395 8044 OTHER POSTS
jobs.applications: The Director-General, National Department of Health, Private Bag X399, Pretoria, 0001. Hand delivered application may be submitted at Reception (Brown Application Box), Dr AB Xuma Building, 1112 Voortrekker Rd, Pretoria Townlands 351-JR or should be forwarded to recruitment@health.gov.za quoting the reference number on the subject e-mail. FOR ATTENTION : Ms M Shitiba
jobs.notes: All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment batteries. Assessment for core competencies outlined in the SMS Handbook shall be conducted within one month of the appointment of candidate. Applications should be submitted on the new Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service department and should be accompanied by a CV only (previous experience must be comprehensively detailed). The Z83 must be fully completed (in line with DPSA Practice note), failure to comply will automatically disqualify the applicant. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualification and other relevant documents on application. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be requested prior to the final selection phase. Applications should be on one PDF format (If emailed). Applications received after the closing date and those that do not comply with the requirements will not be considered. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications and national certificates (where applicable) evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Please note by responding to the advertisement, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) Your information will be used solely for the purpose of this promotion and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent unless required by law. The Department reserves the right not to fill the posts. The successful candidate will be subjected to personnel suitability checks and other vetting procedures. Applicants are respectfully informed that correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If notification of an interview is not received within three (3) months after the closing date, candidates may regard their application as unsuccessful. The Department will not be liable where applicants use incorrect/no reference number(s) on their applications. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Forensiese Geestesgesondheid
af.summary: Direkteurspos wat tosig oor forensiese geestesgesondheidsdienste se nakoming en beleidontwikkeling hou, wat 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie in 'n geestesgesondheidsberoep en vyf jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n toepaslike NQF 7 in 'n geestesgesondheidsverwante beroep (Geneeskunde, Psigiatriese Verpleging, Sielkunde, Arbeidsterapie of Maatskaplike Werk) soos deur SAQA erken. Registrasie by 'n toepaslike statutêre raad as 'n Geestesgesondheidspraktisyn. Nagraadse kwalifikasie in Psigiatrie of 'n ander toepaslike geestesgesondheids spesifikasie sal 'n voordeel wees. Ten minste vyf (5) jaar se ervaring op middel-/ senior bestuursvlak op die gebied wat met forensiese geestesgesondheid te make het. Aantoonbare ervaring in forensiese psigiatrie/geestesgesondheid insluitend sorg, behandeling en rehabilitasie van Staatspasiente en geestelik siek gevangenes soos uiteengesit in die Mental Health Act No 17 van 2002. Evaluering/assesserings met betrekking tot section 77, 78 en 79 Criminal Procedure Act No 51 van 1977 (soos gewysig), section 11 van die child Justice Act No 75 van 2008. Implementering van die Sexual Offences Act. Kennis van gesondheidswetgewing en gesondheidsbeleid, gesondheidstelsels asook van Kliniese Geestesgesondheid/psigiatrie/sielkunde, forensiese geestesgesondheid en navorsing. Goed kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), fasilitering en mensebestuur, finansiële bestuur, leierskap, beplanning en organisasie, probleemoplossing, menslike hulpbronbestuur en rekenaarvaardighede (MS Office-pakket). 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. SMS-voortoelatingsertifikaat word vir aanstellingfinalisering vereis.
af.duties: Verwerk, monitor en verseker nakoming van die departement met die wetgewende mandate wat voortspruit uit die Mental Health Care Act, Criminal Procedure Act, Child Justice Act, en Sexual Offences Act. Ontwikkel wetgewing, beleid, riglyne en programme oor forensiese geestesgesondheidsdienste. Ontwikkel 'n opleidingsprogram vir psigiaters en kliniese sielkundiges oor die implementering van die regsmandate wat voortspruit uit die Criminal Procedure en Child Justice Act. Verseker toepaslike en voldoende infrastruktuur vir forensiese geestesgesondheidsdienste. Ontwikkel en verkry goedkeuring vir die voorstel oor 'n projek om beddens te vermeerder vir geesteswaarnemings in psigiatriese hospitale. Raadpleeg provinsies oor die aantal beddens wat vereis word vir geesteswaarnemings in aangewese psigiatriese hospitale. Onderhou en werk inligtingbestuurstelsels oor forensiese geestesgesondheid by. Hou en werk inligtingbestuurstelsels vir Staatspasiente oor bewegings na en vanaf aangewese psigiatriese hospitale by. Fasiliteer intersektorale, interdepartementale en intradepartementele samewerking oor aangeleenthede rakende forensiese geestesgesondheid. Dien in die Direkteur-generaal se Child Justice-komitee en die Development Committee (DevComm) van die Criminal Justice-stelsel onder leiding van die Department of Justice and Constitutional Development. Neem deel in die Menseregtekommissie oor aangeleenthede rakende die menseregte van onvrywillig aangehoudenes.

zu.title: Umcondi: Esemthethweni Wezempilo Yengqondo
zu.summary: Isikhundla somcondi esibhekele ukuzinza kwezempilo yengqondo esemthethweni kanye nentuthuko yemithetho, esidinga iziqu ze-NQF 7 emsebenzini wezempilo yengqondo kanye namava iminyaka emihlanu.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12 nokuqeqesheka okufanelekile kwanga-NQF 7 kumsebenzi ohlobene Nempilo Yengqondo (Uyilo, Ukunakekelwa Kwengqondo, Isifundo sengqondo, Ukunakekelwa Okuhlobene Nomsebenzi noma Ukusebenza Komphakathi) njengoba kubonwa yi-SAQA. Ukuqanjwa kwegama emkhandlwini osemthethweni ofanele njengomunyenti wezempilo yengqondo. Iziqu zemva kweziqu ze-Psychiatry noma okunye okuhlobene nempilo yengqondo kuzoba yin advantage. Bese iminyaka engu-5 ubudala bemva emsebenzini ophakathi noma phezulu wobuquqamba enkingeni yezempilo yengqondo esemthethweni. Imva ebonakalayo ekukweni izempilo yengqondo esemthethweni ehlanganisa ukunakekelwa, ukwelashwa kanye nokubuyisela iziguli zombuso nabagqithisiwe bengqondo njengoba kushiwo emthethweni we-Mental Health Act No 17 of 2002. Ukuhlola/ukuhlola ngokwemigqa 77, 78 and 79 Criminal Procedure Act No 51 of 1977 (njengoguquliwe), umugqa 11 we-Child Justice Act No 75 of 2008. Ukuphatha umthetho we-Sexual Offences Act. Ulwazi ngemithetho yezempilo kanye namapholisi wezempilo, izinhlelo zezempilo kanye nempilo yengqondo ngokwesibonelo, isifundo sengqondo, izempilo yengqondo esemthethweni kanye nokupenyulula. Ukukhuluma kahle (ngomlomo nokubhaliwe), ukwenza kube lula kanye nokuphatha abantu, ukuphatha imali, ukuba ngumholi, ukwelula kanye nenhlelo, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuphatha abantu kanye namakhono ekhompyutha (MS Office package). Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Isitifikedi semali yomsebenzi noma i-SMS pre-entry Certificate iyadingeka ukuqedwa isikhundla.
zu.duties: Bhekisisa, qaphela futhi wenze isiqiniseko sokuzinza komnyango ngemithetho ephuma emthethweni we-Mental Health Care Act, Criminal Procedure Act, Child Justice Act, kanye ne-Sexual Offences Act. Bumba imithetho, amapholisi, iziqondiso kanye namaphroghremu ezinsizeni zezempilo yengqondo esemthethweni. Bumba iphroghramu yokuqeqesha kubayizengqondo kanye nabafundi bengqondo abayizikhulu ekuphathweni kwemithetho ephuma emthethweni we-Criminal Procedure kanye ne-Child Justice Act. Qinisekisa isakhiwo esifanele kakhulu sezinsiza zezempilo yengqondo esemthethweni. Bumba futhi ufune ukugunyazwa isiphakamiso sephrojekthi yokwengeza amabhedi okuhlola ukuzila kwengqondo emibhalweni engqondo.consult provinces ngenani lamabhedi adingekayo ukuhlola ukuzila kwengqondo emibhalweni eqokiwe yengqondo. Gcina futhi uvuse izinhlelo zokuphatha ulwazi ngezempilo yengqondo esemthethweni. Gcina futhi uvuse izinhlelo zokuphatha ulwazi ngeziguli zombuso ngokunyakaza kuya nakuqoka emibhalweni engqondo eqokiwe. Yenza kube lula ukusebenza ndawonye phakathi kweminyango, eminyangweni kanye nasemnyangweni ngemibuzo ehlobene nempilo yengqondo esemthethweni. Phathise eKomishini Lemithetho Yezingane likaMjikelijeyinali kanye neKomishini Lokuthuthuka (DevComm) lesimiso sokubekwa kocala oluhola umnyango we-Justice and Constitutional Development. Hlanganyela eKomishini Lamalungelo Ebuntu emabuzweni ahlobene namalungelo abantu ababoshiwe ngaphandle kokuthanda kwabo.

xh.title: Umphathi: Izeempilo Zengqondo Ezisemthethweni
xh.summary: Isithuba somphathi esibuka ukuthobela imigaqo nokuphuhliswa kweenkqubo zeemfuno zezeempilo zengqondo ezisemthethweni, kufuneka nayo ifundo ye-NQF 7 kwishishini leezeempilo zengqondo kunye namava eminyaka emihlanu.
xh.requirements: Isetifikethi se-Garde 12 nefundo efanelekileyo ye-NQF 7 kwishishini elinxulumene nezeempilo zengqondo (Utyikomatyo, Ukhuselo lweengqondo lukaNesi, Isekelo ngokweNgqondo, Unyango lweMisebenzi okanye uMsebenzi weNtlalo) njengokwamkelwa yi-SAQA. Ukubhaliswa kulawulo elifanelekileyo lomthetho njengompraktisi wezeempilo zengqondo. Ifundo yamabanga aphezulu kwiPsychiatry okanye kwelinye ichazi elinxulumene nezeempilo zengqondo kuya kuba luncedo. Ubuncinane amava eminyaka emihlanu (5) kwinqanaba eliphakathi/lamaphakathi okulawula kwicala elinxulumene nezeempilo zengqondo ezisemthethweni. Amava abonakalayo kwiPsychiatry/izeempilo zengqondo ezisemthethweni kuquka ukunyamekela, ukunyanga nokubuyisela isikhundla kwabafundi beSizwe nakumagxwembu abaguleyo ngengqondo njengokuchazwa kumthetho weMental Health Act No 17 ka-2002. Iimvavanyo/ukuhlola ezinxulumene nesigaba 77, 78 ne-79 se-Criminal Procedure Act No 51 ka-1977 (njengokulungisiweyo), isigaba 11 se-Child Justice Act No 75 ka-2008. Ukusebenzisa umthetho weSexual Offences Act. Ulwazi ngomthetho weezeempilo nayeenkqubo zeezeempilo, iinkqubo zeezeempilo kunye nokuSebenza ngokweNgqondo ngokweNgqondo/iPsychiatry/iPsychology, iizeempilo zengqondo ezisemthethweni nophando. Ukunxibelelana kakuhle (ngemilomo nangobhalweyo), ukulawula abantu nokuqhuba iinkqubo, ukulawula iimali, ukulawula, ukuhlela nokuhlela iinkqubo, ukuzisombulula iingxaki, ukulawula abantu nokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Office package). Ilayisense evumelekileyo yokushayela. Isetifikethi se-SMS phambi kokungena sifunekiswa ekugqityweni kwenkokhelo yokuqatshwa.
xh.duties: Qhuba, hlola uqiniseke ukuthotyelwa kolawulo ngumthetho lwesebe oluphuma kumthetho weMental Health Care Act, Criminal Procedure Act, Child Justice Act, nayeSexual Offences Act. Phuhlisela umthetho, iinkqubo, iinkqubo zokuqhuba iinkqubo kunye neenkqubo zezeempilo zengqondo ezisemthethweni. Phuhlisela inkqubo yokuzifundisa kwabaPsikiathri kunye nabaPsychologist abaqhagamshelana nokuqhuba iinkqubo zemisebenzi yomthetho ephuma kum-Criminal Procedure nakuChild Justice Act. Qinisekisa isakhiwo esifanelekileyo neesanele ngezeempilo zengqondo ezisemthethweni. Phuhlisela ufune isigqibo sepurojekthi yokwazi iibhedi ezongeziweyo ezikwindlu yesibhedlele seengqondo ngeenkalo zokuhlola isengqondo. Ncedisana namaphondo ngonani leebhedi efunekayo ngeenkalo zokuhlola isengqondo kwizibhedlele eziqondisiweyo zeengqondo. Gcina uhlaziye iinkqubo zolawulo lwolwazi ngezeempilo zengqondo ezisemthethweni. Gcina uhlaziye iinkqubo zolawulo lolwazi kubafundi beSizbe ngokunyuka ne kuhla kwizibhedlele eziqondisiweyo zeengqondo. Khuthaza ukubambisana ngakumbi ngaphakathi kwamashishini, ngaphakathi kwesebe nakusebe ngeenkalo ezimalana nezeempilo zengqondo ezisemthethweni. Zisebenzele eKomiti yobuLungisa beNgqondo yoMphathi-Jikelele naseKomiti yoPhuhliselo (DevComm) yenkqubo yoBulungisa boGewal eyoyilwe nguSebe loBulungisa noPhuhliselo lweMigaqo. Thatha inxaxheba kwi-Human Rights Commission ngeenkalo ezimalana namalungelo obuntu ababekiweyo ngaphandle kwentando yabo.

jobs.reference_number: NDOH 83/2026 Chief Directorate: Digital Health Systems
jobs.title: Deputy Director: Specialist Analyst - Knowledge
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum, (an all-inclusive remuneration package), (basic salary consists of 70% or 75% of total package, salary package will be structured according to Middle Management Service guidelines.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director Specialist Analyst position in Pretoria requiring a relevant BSc degree and three years' public health research experience to lead knowledge management for a digital health unit.
jobs.requirements: Bachelor of Science Degree (NQF 7) as recognised by SAQA in any of the following scientific fields: Information Science and/or Data Science. Health Economic Sciences or Public Health Research Sciences, Knowledge and Information Management Sciences. At least three (3) years’ experience at an ASD level or equivalent level in public health research and analytics in the public, private or academic sectors. Proven experience in implementing knowledge-sharing platforms and repositories, managing digital libraries, and digital document management and facilitating communities of practice and learning networks. Facilitate multi-stakeholder knowledge-exchange initiatives, coordinate stakeholder consultations and engagement activities. Support partnerships for knowledge generation and dissemination. Promote collaboration across digital health ecosystems as well as knowledge of Management Service Delivery Innovation (SDI). Proven experience in managing health-related data and analytics is an added advantage. Good strategic capability and leadership, problem-solving and analysis, client orientation and customer focus, people management and empowerment, programme and project management, financial and change management, resilience and assertiveness, communication (written and verbal), and ethical behaviour skills. Ability to work independently and within a diverse multidisciplinary team. A valid driver’s licence.
jobs.duties: Establish and maintain an effective knowledge management framework that supports the digital health units’ objectives. Develop and implement the digital health unit’s knowledge management strategy. Establish knowledge management standards and procedures. Define knowledge governance structures and roles. Preserve institutional knowledge and critical information assets. Capture tacit and explicit knowledge from projects, programs, and subject matter experts. Develop and maintain knowledge repositories. Promote a culture of knowledge exchange within the digital health unit and other clusters within the NDoH. Facilitate communities of practice and learning networks. Organise knowledge-sharing events, webinars, and workshops. Develop collaboration platforms and knowledge-sharing tools. Ensure effective management of digital knowledge platforms and resources. Manage knowledge management systems, portals, and repositories. Maintain content taxonomy, metadata, and classification standards. Transform evidence and research into actionable knowledge for decision-making. Synthesise research findings, policy documents, and technical reports. Develop evidence briefs, summaries, and knowledge products. Support dissemination of research outcomes. Foster collaboration and knowledge exchange with internal and external stakeholders. Build relationships with healthcare, academic, research, and technology partners. Facilitate multi-stakeholder knowledge exchange initiatives as well as coordinate stakeholder consultations and engagement activities.
jobs.enquiries: Ms Elbie Vosloo at: Elbie.Vosloo@health.gov.za
jobs.applications: The Director-General, National Department of Health, Private Bag X399, Pretoria, 0001. Hand delivered application may be submitted at Reception (Brown Application Box), Dr AB Xuma Building, 1112 Voortrekker Rd, Pretoria Townlands 351-JR or should be forwarded to recruitment@health.gov.za quoting the reference number on the subject e-mail. FOR ATTENTION : Ms M Shitiba
jobs.notes: All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Spesialisontleder - Kennis
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur Spesialisontleder-pos in Pretoria wat 'n relevante BSc-graad en drie jaar se ervaring in openbare gesondheidsnavorsing vereis om kennisbestuur vir 'n digitale gesondheids-eenheid te lei.
af.requirements: Baccalaureus Scientiae-graad (NQF 7) soos erken deur SAQA in enige van die volgende wetenskaplike velde: Inligtingwetenskap en/of Datawetenskap. Gesondheidsekonomiese wetenskappe of Openbare Gesondheidsnavorsingswetenskappe, Kennis- en Inligtingbestuurswetenskappe. Ten minste drie (3) jaar se ervaring op 'n ASD-vlak of gelykwaardige vlak in openbare gesondheidsnavorsing en -ontleding in die openbare, private of akademiese sektore. Bewese ervaring in die implementering van kennisdelingsplatforms en bewaarplekke, die bestuur van digitale biblioteke en digitale dokumentbestuur, asook die facilitering van gemeenskappe van praktyk en leernetwerke. Fasiliteer multispanaangelê-kennisuitruilingsinisiatiewe, koördineer belanghebbende se samesprekings en betrokkenheidsaktiwiteite. Ondersteun vennootskappe vir kenniserwerking en -verspreiding. Bevorder samewerking oor digitale gesondheid-ekosisteme asook kennis van Management Service Delivery Innovation (SDI). Bewese ervaring in die bestuur van gesondheidsverwante data en ontleding is 'n bykomende voordeel. Goeie strategiese vermoë en leierskap, probleemoplossing en ontleding, kliëntoriëntasie en klantfokus, mensebestuur en bemagtiging, program- en projekbestuur, finansiële en veranderingbestuur, veerkragtigheid en stelligheid, kommunikasie (geskrewe en mondeling), en etiese gedragsvaardighede. Vermoë om onafhanklik en binne 'n diverse multidissiplinêre span te werk. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Stel 'n doeltreffende kennisbestuursraamwerk in stand wat die doelwitte van die digitale gesondheids-eenhede ondersteun. Ontwikkel en implementeer die digitale gesondheids-eenheid se kennisbestuurstrategie. Stel kennisbestuursstandaarde en -prosedures vas. Definieer kennisbestuursstrukture en -rolle. Bewaar instellingskennis en kritieke inligtingsbates. Vang stilswyende en uitgesproke kennis uit projekte, programme en vakdeskundiges vas. Ontwikkel en onderhou kennisbewaarplekke. Bevorder 'n kultuur van kennisuitruilings binne die digitale gesondheids-eenheid en ander trosse binne die NDoH. Fasiliteer gemeenskappe van praktyk en leernetwerke. Reël kennisdelingsgeleenthede, webinars en werkswinkels. Ontwikkel samewerkingsplatforms en kennisdelingsinstrumente. Verseker doeltreffende bestuur van digitale kennisplatforms en -hulpbronne. Bestuur kennibestuurstelsels, portale en bewaarplekke. Onderhou inhoudstaksonomie, metadata en klassifikasiestandaarde. Transformeer bewyse en navorsing in toepasbare kennis vir besluitneming. Sintetiseer navorsingsbevindings, beleidsdokumente en tegniese verslae. Ontwikkel bewyskritieke, opsommings en kennisprodukte. Ondersteun die verspreiding van navorsingsuitkomste. Bevorder samewerking en kennisuitruiling met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes. Bou verhoudings met gesondheidsorg-, akademiese, navorsings- en tegnologielvennote. Fasiliteer multispanaangelê-kennisuitruilingsinisiatiewe asook die koördinering van belanghebbende se samesprekings en betrokkenheidsaktiwiteite.

zu.title: Isikhundla Sikabamba-Director: Onchwepheshe Analyst - Ulwazi
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikabamba-Director Onchwepheshe Analyst ePretoria esidinga iziqu ze-BSc ezihambisanayo namafomu eminyaka emithathu wemisebenzi yocwaningo lwempilo yomphakathi ukuqonda ukuphathwa kolwazi kwenhlangano yezempilo yedijithali.
zu.requirements: I-degree ye-Bachelor of Science (NQF 7) evunyiwe yi-SAQA kunoma yisiphi isimongo sezobuchwepheshe esilandelayo: I-Information Science kanye/noma i-Data Science. I-Health Economic Sciences noma i-Public Health Research Sciences, i-Knowledge and Information Management Sciences. Okungenani amafomu eminyaka emithathu (3) ohlelwini kokusebenza ezingeni le-ASD noma ezingeni elinganayo ocwaningweni lwempilo yomphakathi nokuhlaziya kwemiphakathi yangasese, yangasese kwinhlangano yezesikhashana noma kwezemfundo. OkwesiQinisekiso imisebenzi yokuletha izinkundla zokwabelana ngolwazi nangamakhoselo, ukuphatha amalabhulali edijithali, kanye nokuphathwa kwamadokhumende edijithali nokuqondisa amaphathi okuziphilisa kanye namathonga okufunda. Qondisa izinkundla zokushintshaniselana kolwazi phakathi kwabantu abaningi, lungiselela umbiko wabaholi kanye nemisebenzi yokubandakanya. Sekela izinhlangano zokukhiqiza nokusakaza ulwazi. Khuthaza ukusebenza ndawonye kumasimu wezempilo yedijithali kanye nokuqonda okuphathwayo kwenkonzo yokuletha izinto ezintsha (SDI). Ukuba namava okuphatha idatha ezimalana nezempilo nokuhlaziya kuyisipho esingeke sikhohlwe. Ikakhono elihle lokubuka nokuqonda phambili, ukubusa, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, ukuqonda ngomthengi nokuqasela komthengi, ukuphatha abantu nokuqasha, ukuphatha amaphrojekthi, ukuphatha izimali noshintsho, ukuzinza nokubekezela, ukuthintana (okubhalwayo nokukhulunywayo), kanye nokuziphatha ngokomthetho. Ikakhono lokusebenza eyedwa nangaphakathi kwenhlangano ehlangene ezinkambeni eziningi. Ilayisensi yokushayela evunyiwe.
zu.duties: Hlula futhi ulondoloze uhlaka olusebenzayo lokuphatha ulwazi olusekela imigomo yenhlangano yezempilo yedijithali. Bese ukwakha futhi ukuphatha uhlaka olusebenzayo lwalo msebenzi. Hlula amazinga nendlela yokwenza imisebenzi. Chaza imithetho yokuphatha ulwazi kanye namakhono. Londoloza ulwazi lwale nhlangano namanani abalulekile wemininingwane. Bamba ulwazi olungabonakali nolubonakali kumaphrojekthi, emaphrokhramu, nasemabungweni abachwepheshe. Bese futhi ulondoloze izinkundla zokugcina ulwazi. Khuthaza isiko lokushintshaniselana kolwazi ngaphakathi kwenhlangano yezempilo yedijithali nangaphakathi kwamanye amaqenjantshwa eNDoH. Qondisa amaphathi okusebenza kanye namathonga okufunda. Hlela imikhosi yokwabelana ngolwazi, amawebinari, kanye nasezinkundla zokufunda. Bese izinkundla zokusebenza ndawonye nezixhobo zokwabelana ngolwazi. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kwezinkundla zolwazi zedijithali nezinsizakalo. Phatha izinhlelo zokuphatha ulwazi, izinkundla zokufinyelela, nangamakhoselo. Londoloza ukuhlwa kolimi, imininingwane yemininingwane, kanye namazinga okuhlukanisa. Shintsha iziqinisekiso nocwaningo abe ulwazi olusebenzayo ngenhloso yokuthatha izinqumo. Hlanganisa imiphumela yocwaningo, amadokhumba okuhlela imigomo, kanye nemibiko yezobuchwepheshe. Bese amaphepha ezinhloso, izifinyezo, kanye nokuqasha ulwazi. Sekela ukusakaza imiphumela yocwaningo. Khuthaza ukusebenza ndawonye noshintshaniselana kolwazi nabaholi bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Akha izinhlangano nabahlinzeki bezempilo, bemfundo, bacwaningo, kanye nabobuchwepheshe. Qondisa izinkundla zokushintshaniselana kolwazi phakathi kwabantu abaningi kanye nokulungiselela umbiko wabaholi kanye nemisebenzi yokubandakanya.

xh.title: Isekabini Mlawuli: Ononophi iNkanga - ulwazi
xh.summary: Isithuba seSekabini Mlawuli uNonophi iNkanga kwiPretoria esifuna iziqu ezifanelekileyo zeBSc kunye neminyaka mitatu yamava okuphonononga impilo yomntu wonke ukukhokela ulawulo lolwazi kwisebe lempilo yedijithali.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ze Bachelor of Science (NQF 7) ezikhuselekileyo yi-SAQA kunye naluphi na olu landelayo lwamagaba esayensi: uLwazi n okanye /okanye iSayensi yoManani. uSayensi ye-Health Economic okanye iSayensi yoPhononongo lwaMandla aVekiwa aSebenzayo iSayensi yoLawulo loLwazi nolwazi. Ubuncinane iminyaka mitatu (3) yamava kwinqanaba le-ASD okanye elingana nalo kwiphononongo nokuhlalutywa impilo yomntu wonke kumacandwo angaburhulumente, abucala okanye abemfundo. Amava abonakalayo ekusekenziseni ziindawo zokwabelana ngolwazi nolugcino lolwazi, ekulawuleni imithombo yolwazi yedijithali, nolawulo lwamaxwebhu edijithali nakukhuthazi amaqela abantu abanobuchule nophando. Khuthaza ukutshintshiselwana kolwazi phakathi kwamathuba amaninzi abathathi nxaxheba, lwandise uhlelo lokubuzwa iingcali kunye nemisebenzi yokuzibandakanya. Ncedisa ubudlelwane ngokudalwa nokusasazwa kolwazi. Khuthaza ukusebenzisana kwindalo yempilo yedijithali nakolwazi ngolawulo loQoqosho oluNikela iNkonzo (SDI). Amava abonakalayo ekulawuleni idatha yempilo nohlalutyo lwayo ngowongezo oluhle. Ikhono elhle lokuziphatha ngokweqondo nokuqhatha, ukusombulula iingxaki nohlalutyo, ukunika nxaxheba abakhwebzi nokuqwalasela abakhwebzi, ukulawula abantu kunye nokuqinisekisa, ukulawula iinkqubo namaphrojekthi, ukulawula imali noshintsho, ukumelana nokuxhomekeka nokuzimisela, iindlela zokuthetha (ezibhaliweyo nangomlomo), kunye nemikwa emihle yokuziphatha. Ikhono lokusebenza yedwa nakwikomiti ethile yabasebenzi abavela kumagatya amaninzi. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Misa zigcine ukulawulwa kolwazi olusebenzayo oluxhasa iinjongo ze sebe lempilo yedijithali. Yakha uze uphulaphule iindlela zokulawula ulwazi kwisebe lempilo yedijithali. Misela iinkqubo zokulawulwa kolwazi neenkqubo. Chaza iinkqubo zolawulo lolwazi nendima yawo. Gcina ulwazi lweqela nolunye ulwazi olubalulekileyo. Thatha ulwazi olungabonakalayo nolubonakalayo kwimiphakamiso, iinkqubo, nakubagcisa abangenisa imiba. Phuhlisa ulondoloze iindawo zokugcina ulwazi. Khuthaza inkqubo yokutshintshiselana kolwazi kwisebe lempilo yedijithali nakwezinye iindawo kwiNDoH. Khuthaza amaqela abantu abanobuchule namaphando. Hlela iindawo zokwabelana ngolwazi, i-webinars, namawebhusayithi. Phuhlisa iindawo zokusebenzisana neendawo zokwabelana ngolwazi. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa ngokusebenzayo iindawo zolwazi zedijithali nezibonelelo. Lawula iinkqubo zolwazi, iindawo zokusebenza, neendawo zokugcina. Gcina uludwe lomxholo, imetadatha, nemiqathango yokuhlelwa. Tshintsha ulwazi oluqinisekileyo nophondo kuye kulwazi olusebenzayo ngokwenza izigqibo. Dibana nemitapo yophando, amaxwebhu emigaqo, nengxelo ngemiba. Bhaqa izibinqana ngolwazi oluqinisekileyo, iingcombolo, nemiba yolwazi. Ncedisa ukusasazwa kophando. Khuthaza ukusebenzisana nokuqhathaniswa kolwazi nabathathi nxaxheba bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Sakhe ubudlelwane nabaqonywa impilo, emfundo, uphando, nasekhonoloji. Khuthaza iindlela ezininzi zokutshintshiselana kolwazi kokuninzi abathathi nxaxheba ngokunjalo lwandise izindululo zabathathi nxaxheba. Yenza imisebenzi yokuzibandakanya.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Business Process Analyst
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur: Business Process Analyst-posisie binne die Department of Health in Pretoria, wat digitale gesondheidstransformasie lei deur BPM-strategie en prosesoptimalisering.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n toepaslike Bachelorsgraad (NQF 7) in Inligtingstelsels/Besigheidsontleding/Business Process Management/Informatika of Rekenaarwetenskap soos deur SAQA erken. Ten minste drie (3) jaar se ervaring op Assistantsdirekteur- of gelykwaardige vlak in besigheidsontleding, Business Process Management, besigheidsprosesverbetering of stelselontleding. Bewese ervaring in vereistes-ontginning, ontleding en dokumentasie; besigheidsprosesmodellering en -herontwerp; funksionele vereistes; gebruikersstories; aanvaardingskriteria; besigheidsgevalle en prosesvloeie. Kennis en toepassing van erkende besigheidsontledingsraamwerke en -praktyke soos BABOK. Toepaslike besigheidsontledingsertifisering sal voordelig wees. Kennis van besigheidsprosesverbeteringsmetodologieë en 'n begrip van Agile-lewering, stelselontwikkeling en Enterprise Architecture-beginsels. Ervaring met SQL en BI-rapportering sal voordelig wees. Basiese begrip van die gesondheidssektor, met kennis van die Suid-Afrikaanse digitale gesondheids- en NHI-omgewing wat voordelig sal wees. Goeie kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Bewese belanghebbende-betrokkenheid, fasilitering, analitiese, probleemoplossings-, kommunikasie en mensebestuursvaardighede. Basiese begrip van die gesondheidssektor, met kennis van die Suid-Afrikaanse digitale gesondheids- en NHI-omgewing wat voordelig sal wees. Kennis van toepaslike openbare sektor-wetgewing en bestuursvereistes. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Looi die ontwikkeling, ontleding, optimalisering en standaardisering van besigheidsprosesse om digitale gesondheidstransformasie te ondersteun. Ontwikkel en implementeer die Business Process Management (BPM)-strategie, -raamwerk, -metodologieë en -standaarde vir digitale gesondheidstelsels. Verseker dat digitale gesondheidsoplossings met besigheidsbehoeftes ooreenstem en effektiewe dienslewering ondersteun. Hou toezig op die ontwikkeling en gehalteversekering van Business Requirements Specifications, Functional Requirements Specifications, gebruikersstories en aanvaardingskriteria. Verskaf bestuur en belanghebbende-leierskap om nakoming van departementele en digitale gesondheidstandaarde te verseker. zu.title: Isikhundla Sikabaphathi: Umhloli Wezinqubo Zebhizinisi
zu.summary: Isikhundla Sokubaphathi: Umhloli Wezinqubo Zebhizinisi kwi-Department of Health ePretoria, sihola inguquko yezempilo yedijithali ngomculu we-BPM nokuqinisekisa izinqubo.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-Bachelor's Degree (NQF 7) efanelekile kwi-Information Systems/ Business Analytisis / Business Process Management/ Informatics noma i-Computer Science njengoba kuqashelwe yi-SAQA. Okungenani amakhulu amathathu (3) unyaka wemfundo njengoAssistant Director noma esikhundleni esalinganayo ekuchazweni kwebhizinisi, ekuqineni izinqubo zebhizinisi, ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo zebhizinisi noma ekuchazweni kamasistimu. Ulwazi olubonakalisiwe ekukhumbukeni, ukuhlaziya kanye nokubhala izidingo; ekumodeleni nasekwenzeni kabusha izinqubo zebhizinisi; izidingo ezisebenzayo; amabalana omsebenzisi; izinkambiso zokwamukela; amacala okusebenzisa ibhizinisi kanye nokuqhutshwa kwezinqubo. Ulwazi nokusetshenziswa kwezisekelo namasu okuhlaziya ibhizinisi aqashelwe njengakwi-BABOK. Isitifiketi esifanelekile sokuhlaziya ibhizinisi sizoba nomthelela omuhle. Ulwazi ngamasu okuthuthukisa izinqubo zebhizinisi kanye nokukuqonda ukulethwa kwe-Agile, ukuthuthukiswa kwamasistimu kanye namasimu we-Enterprise Architecture. Ulwazi nge-SQL nokubika kwe-BI kuzoba nomthelela omuhle. Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo ngemikhakha yezempilo, kanti ulwazi ngemvelakude ye-Digital Health ne-NHI yaseNingizimu Afrika kuzoba nomthelela omuhle. Inkomishi elungile (eyathunyelwayo nalebhalwe). Amakhono abonakalisiwe okuxhumana nabathintekayo, ukuxhumanisa, ukuhlaziya, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuxhumana kanye nokuphatha abantu. Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo ngemikhakha yezempilo, kanti ulwazi ngemvelakunde ye-Digital Health ne-NHI yaseNingizimu Afrika kuzoba nomthelela omuhle. Ulwazi ngomthetho ohlobene nomkhakha kahulumeni kanye nezidingo zokubusa. Ilayisense yokuqasha esebenzayo.
zu.duties: Qhansa ukuthuthukiswa, ukuhlaziywa, ukuqiniswa kanye nokulinganiswa kwezinqubo zebhizinisi ukuze kusekele inguquko yezempilo yedijithali. Thuthukisa futhi usebenzise umculu, izisekelo, amasu kanye namazinga we-Business Process Management (BPM) kumasistimu we-Digital Health. Qinisekisa ukuthi izixazululo zezempilo yedijithali zihambisana nezidingo zebhizinisi futhi zisekele ukulethwa kwenkonzo ephumelelayo. Qapha ukuthuthukiswa kanye noqiniseko lwekhwalithi we-Business Requirements Specifications, i-Functional Requirements Specifications, amabalana abasebenzisi kanye neziyayi zokwamukela. Nikeza igunya elibusiwe kanye noqobo abaholi babathintekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuziphendula kwemigomo yomnyango nana kumazinga e-Digital Health. Misela futhi ulawule ukuziphendula kumazinga okuhlaziya ibhizinisi, izisekelo zokubuso ze-Digital Health, i-Enterprise Architecture kanye nemigomo yomnyango. Phatha umsebenzi wokuhlaziya izinqubo zebhizinisi futhi uqhube ngokuthuthuka ngokuqhubekayo. Thuthukisa izinkambiso zokuqasha, qapha izinkomba zokusebenza futhi uthule ngokuqhutshwa kohlelo kanye nokuqhubeka kwe nkambiso kuDirector. Nikeza ubuholi ekuboneni, ekuphatweni nasekuqaphuleni iingozi namaphuzu okuhlola. Thuthukisa, usebenzise futhi uqaphe iplani yokuphatha ingozi yeDirectorate kanye nesibuko seengozi.

xh.title: Isekela Mongamzi: Onondwebeko wezenzo zoshishino
xh.summary: Isithuba sikaSekela Mongamzi: Onondwebeko wezenzo zoshishino kwiSebe lezeMpilo ePretoria, nokukhokela iinguquko yezempilo ezinzima ngokusebenzisa iBPM nomqondo wokuphucula iinkqubo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seNqanaba le-12 nokugqiba kwesidanga seBachelor esifanelekileyo (NQF 7) kwiNkqubo zeMbali / Uhlalutyo lweShishino / ulawulo lwenkqubo yoshishino / iInformatics okanye iComputer Science njengokuqatshwa yiSAQA. Ubuncinane iimfundo ezintathu (3) zeminyaka yokulinganiswa kwinQanaba loMcebisi okanye kwesinye isahlulo kuhlalutyo lweshishino, ulawulo lwenkqubo yoshishino, ukuphuculwa kwenkqubo yoshishino okanye uhlalutyo lwenkqubo. Ulwazi obuqinisekisiweyo ekutsheni, ukuhlalutya nokubhalwa kwemfuno; ukumodelwa nokwakhiwa kwakhona iinkqubo zoshishino; iimfuno ezisebenzayo; iimbali zabasebenzisi; iindlela zokwamkela; iindaba zoshishino nezintambo zekqubo. Ulwazi nokusebenzisa iindaba eziziqaqambera zohlalutyo lweshishino njengeBABOK. Isatifikethi seHlalutyo lweShishino esichanekileyo siza kuba lusizo. Ulwazi ngeendlela zokuphucula iinkqubo zoshishino nokugqonda ukulethwa kwe-Agile, ukuphuhliswa kweenkqubo kunye neemigaqo ze-Architecture yoshishino. Ulwazi nge-SQL nokuchaza i-BI siza kuba lusizo. Ukuqonda okuyimfuneko ngabom bamashishino, ulwazi ngeNkqubo yaseMzantsi Afrika yezeMpilo kunye nendawo yeNHI kuya kuba luncedo. Unxibelelwano olululo (ngomlomo nangokubhaliweyo). Amandla obuqinisekisiweyo ekunxibelelaneni nabanomdla, ekudalweni, ekuhlalutyeni, ekuzameni ukusombulula iingxaki, ekuqxabalayseni ekunxibelelaneni nakulawuleni abantu. Ukuqonda okuyimfuneko ngabom bamashishino, ulwazi ngeNkqubo yaseMzantsi Afrika yezeMpilo kunye nendawo yeNHI kuya kuba luncedo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yomthetho kolawulo lokuziphatha ehambelana nommandla nokwimfuno yokulawula. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Kukhokela ukuphuhliswa, ukuhlalutywa, ukuphuculwa nokulinganisa iinkqubo zoshishino ukuxhasa iinguquko zezempilo ezithwalwa ngobuchwepheshe. Ukuphuhlisa nokusebenzisa umqondoguqo, inkqubo, iindlela nezilinganiso zeQondo LoluLawulo LweNkqubo Yeshishino (iBPM) ukwenza iinkqubo zezeMpilo ezinzima. Kuqinisekiswe ukuba iisixhobo zezempilo ezikwincwadi ezithwalwa ngobuchwepheshe zihambelana nentluleko yeshishino kwaye zixhase isebenziso esisebenzayo. Ukulawula ukuphuhliswa nokuqinisekiswa ngemigangatho yemaxwebhe amacacangelayo aze acacise ngobunyani iimfuno zoshishino, iimfuno ezisebenzayo, iimbali zabasebenzisi nendlela yokwamkela. Kukhoke ixhosa labanomdlo lokulawula kuqinisekiso lokuziphatha kwamagunya esebe lezeMpilo. Kuyilwe kwaye kulawulwe ukuziphatha ngokwemiqathango yokuhlalutya lweshishino, iinkqubo zolawulo lwezeMpilo ezingatshitshwa, i-Architecture yeshishino namagunya osebe. Kulawulwa isithuba sohlalutyo lwenkqubo yoshishino kwaye kugqitywa ngokuzinza ngokuphucula. Kuphuhliswa iindawo zokuqhubela phambili izixhobo, kulawulwa okubonakalayo ngokubala kwemigangatho yemisebenzi kwaye kuchazwa ngemveliso nokugqitywa kolawulo kumongamzi. Kukhokelwa ekuboneni, ekulawuleni nakuphawuleni iingozi neendaba ezibhala kalulu. Kuphuhliswa, kusetyenziswa nakulawulwa inkqubo yeNqondo yeNgozi neNqakamfazwe yeNgozi yesebe.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Environmental Health
jobs.salary_text: R664 410 per annum, as per OSD.
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Environmental Health based in Pretoria, requiring an NQF 6 qualification, HPCSA registration and at least five years' relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: An NQF level 6 qualification in Environmental Health and Registration with Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as an Environmental Health Practitioner. An NFQ 7 qualification in Environmental Health will be an advantage. Registration with HPCSA as an Environmental Health Practitioner and in good standing. At least five (5) years’ appropriate experience after registration with HPCSA, of which three years must be appropriate experience in Management (i.e. Chief Environmental Practitioner or equivalent). Knowledge of related legislation applicable to port health and environmental health, policy development, port health matters, project and stakeholder management as well as knowledge of International Health Regulations, 2005. Good communication (verbal and written), research/analysis, planning, organizing, report writing, presentation, problem solving and computer (MS Office package) skills. Must be willing to work overtime and travel extensively. A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Provide support in the development and revision of Port Health policies, legislation, norms and standards, guidelines and strategies. Conduct stakeholder engagements and consultations on developed policy documentation. Assist in undertaking Socio Economic Impact Assessment processes, where applicable. Assist in conducting capacity building on developed regulations, guidelines and norms and standards. Support the provision of technical support to Points of Entry. Identify and coordinate capacity building to strengthen the provision of port health services. Develop training manuals, schedule and assist in conducting training on the various legislation and norms and standards. Provide technical support for the implementation of policies, legislation, norms and standards and guidelines. Provide support on the issuance of human remains import and export permits. Support PoE in strengthening emergency preparedness and response activities. Support compliance with Port Health Services with domestic and international requirements. Provide technical support to Points of Entry to facilitate compliance with domestic and international requirements. Participate in cross border projects and initiatives to strengthen cross border coordination and collaboration. Support stakeholder engagements and representation in Committees on Port Health matters. Map and engage with relevant stakeholders on matters relating to environmental and port health. Actively participate in National coordination structures and other key collaborative structures to ensure prioritization of port health issues and reports. Coordinate and participate in awareness raising campaigns in observance of environmental health and other health calendar days. Provide inputs or comments on documents related to environmental health matters.
jobs.enquiries: Ms P Masilela Tel No: (012) 395 8520
jobs.applications: The Director-General, National Department of Health, Private Bag X399, Pretoria, 0001. Hand delivered application may be submitted at Reception (Brown Application Box), Dr AB Xuma Building, 1112 Voortrekker Rd, Pretoria Townlands 351-JR or should be forwarded to recruitment@health.gov.za quoting the reference number on the subject e-mail. FOR ATTENTION : Ms M Shitiba
jobs.notes: All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment batteries. Assessment for core competencies outlined in the SMS Handbook shall be conducted within one month of the appointment of candidate. Applications should be submitted on the new Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service department and should be accompanied by a CV only (previous experience must be comprehensively detailed). The Z83 must be fully completed (in line with DPSA Practice note), failure to comply will automatically disqualify the applicant. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualification and other relevant documents on application. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be requested prior to the final selection phase. Applications should be on one PDF format (If emailed). Applications received after the closing date and those that do not comply with the requirements will not be considered. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications and national certificates (where applicable) evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Please note by responding to the advertisement, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) Your information will be used solely for the purpose of this promotion and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent unless required by law. The Department reserves the right not to fill the posts. The successful candidate will be subjected to personnel suitability checks and other vetting procedures. Applicants are respectfully informed that correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If notification of an interview is not received within three (3) months after the closing date, candidates may regard their application as unsuccessful. The Department will not be liable where applicants use incorrect/no reference number(s) on their applications. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

zu.title: Umqondisi Osekela: Izesulu Lezempilo Ezingcolile
zu.summary: Umqondisi Osekela: Izesulu Lezempilo Ezingcolile osekelwe ePretoria, ofuna iziqu ze-NQF 6, ukubhaliswa kwe-HPCSA nokuba okungenani iminyaka emihlanu yemfundo efanele.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezithatha izinga le-NQF 6 kulesulu Lezempilo Ezingcolile nokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengomunyenti wocwaningo wezesulo Lezempilo Ezingcolile. Iziqu ze-NQF 7 kulesulo Lezempilo Ezingcolile zizoba yinzuzo. Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengomunyenti wocwaningo wezesulo Lezempilo Ezingcolile nokuba ugqamile. Okungenani iminyaka emihlanu (5) yemfundo efanele emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA, lapho kubakhona iminyaka emithathu okumele ibe yimfundo efanele ekuPhathweni (okuyilowo oyiNdlula Yesulu Lezempilo Ezingcolile noma okulingana naye). Ukwazi ngemithetho ehlobene nesesulo Lezempilo Ezingcolile, ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubo, izindaba zesesulo lempilo, ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi nakwabathintekayo kanye nokwazi ngeMthetho Yezesulu Yomhlaba, 2005. Ukuxhumana kakuhle (ngomlomo nakubhalwayo), ucwaningo/ukuhlaziya, ukuhlela, ukuhlelela, ukubhala imibiko, okunikezwayo, ukuxazulula izinkinga namakhono ekhompyutha (iphakheji ye-MS Office). Kumele abe vuliwe ukusebenza ngaphezulu kwesikhathi aze adunge kakhulu. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Nikeza inkhaso ekuthuthukisweni nasekulungisweni kwenqubo, umthetho, izindinganiso, izinqondiso kanye nezinhlelo zesesulo Lezempilo. Yenza ingxoxo nabathintekayo kanye nezeluleko emafayeleni wenqubo ethuthukisiwe. Siza ekwenzeni izinqubo zokuHlola Ukuthinta Komnotho Wezomphakathi, lapho kusemelwe khona. Siza ekwenzeni ukwakha amandla emithethweni ethuthukisiwe, izinqondiso kanye nezindinganiso. Sekela ukunikezwa kwenkhaso yobuchwepheshe kumaphoyinti okungena. Hlaza futhi uhloze ukwakha amandla ukugcizelela ukunikezwa kwezinkonzo zesesulo lempilo. Bhala izincwadi zokuqeqesha, hlela isikhathi futhi siza ekwenzeni ukuqeqeshwa ngemithetho ehlukene kanye nezindinganiso. Nikeza inkhaso yobuchwepheshe ekuqalisweni kwenqubo, umthetho, izindinganiso, izinqondiso kanye nezinhlelo. Nikeza inkhaso ekunikezeni izimvume zokungenisa nokuthumela emanye izwe imidumbu yabantu. Sekela ama-PoE ekugqameni izinkonzo zokulungiselela izimpilo eziphuthumayo kanye nokusabela. Sekela ukuzwa emthethweni kwezinkonzo zesesulo Lezempilo ngemithetho yangaphakathi kanye nangaphandle. Nikeza inkhaso yobuchwepheshe kumaphoyinti okungena ukwenza lula ukuzwa emthethweni ngemithetho yangaphakathi nangaphandle. Thatha inxaxheba kumaphrojekthi namasu okweqa imingcele ukugcizelela ukuququqelelana nokuhlangana okweqa imingcele. Sekela ingxoxo nabathintekayo kanye nokumela emakomidini ngezindaba zesesulo Lezempilo. Hlaza futhi xoxa nabathintekayo abafanele ngezindaba ezihlobene nesesulo lempilo nangasesulo Lezempilo. Thatha inxaxheba ngokuzithoba kuqeqo Lokuhlelwa Koluntu Nakwezinye izakhiwo ezibalulekile zokuququqelelana ukuqinisekisa ukugcinwa kwesimo sasesulo lempilo nemibiko. Hlela futhi thatha inxaxheba emikhankasweni yokwandisa ulwazi ekugujeni kwesulu Lezempilo Ezingcolile kwezinye izinsuku zekhalenda yezempilo. Nikeza okufakwayo noma izimpendulo emafayeleni ahlobene nezindaba zesesulo lempilo.

xh.title: Umncedisi woMlawuli: Izempilo Yamaphango
xh.summary: Umncedisi woMlawuli: Izempilo Yamaphango ohlala ePretoria, efuna izidanga ze-NQF 6, ugunyaziso lwe-HPCSA kunye nobugcisa obuqhelefeyo kwiminyaka emihlanu.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-NQF 6 kwiZempilo Zamaphango nogunyaziso kwi-HPCSA njengompraktikhali wezeMpilo yaMaPhango. Isidanga se-NFQ 7 kwiZempilo Zamaphango siza kuba luncedo. Ugunyaziso kwi-HPCSA njengompraktikhali wezeMpilo yaMaPhango ukaye abe ngumntu osesimweni esihle. Obuncinane iminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava afanelekileyo emva kogunyaziso kwi-HPCSA, apho iminyaka emithathu kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo ekuLawuleni (oko kukuthi ngumPraktikhali weNtloko wezeMpilo okanye ofana nalo). Ulwazi ngemigaqo ehlobene nayo esebenza kwiempilo yamazibuko nazempilo zamaphango, ukuphuca izicwangciso, iindaba zeempilo zamazibuko, ulawulo lweenkqubo nabathathi-nxaxheba nakulwazi ngeSisemo samaZwe nangaphandle sazeMpilo, 2005. Amaphefumlo athetha nawabhala amahle, ukuphandisisa/ukuhlalutywa, ukucwangcisa, ukuqamba, ukubhala iingxelo, imiboniso, ukuxazula iingxaki namakhono ekhompyutha (iphakheji ye-MS Office). Kufuneka abe nesithembu sokusebenza ngeyure eNgapheleleyo nahambo omde. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso ekuphuceni nokulungisa iingcango zeempilo zamazibuko, imigaqo, iindinganiso namagunya, iinkcukacha nezicwangciso. Qhelanisa nabathathi-nxaxheba kwaye wenze ingxoxo ngexwebhu lesicwangciso elididiyiweyo. Nceda ekwenzeni iinkqubo zoHlolo loMlinge woQoqosho loLuntu, apho kufanelekileyo. Nceda ekuzameni ukwakha amandla kumagunya adidiyiweyo, iinkcukacha namadinganiso. Xhasa ukunika inkxaso yamandla obuchwepheshe kumapowo ongena ngawo. Phawula kwaye uhlobole ekwakheni amandla ukuze kuqiniswe ukunikwa iinkonzo zeempilo zamazibuko. Yenza iincwadi zokuqeqesha, cwangcisa ulwazi kwaye ucede ekwaziseni uqeqesho malunga nemigaqo eyahlukileyo namadinganiso. Nika inkxaso yobuchwepheshe ekusebenzeni kweengcango, imigaqo, iindinganiso namagunya nainkcukacha. Nceda ekunikweni iiremoto zokungenisa nokurhuma iisidumbu. Xhasa amapowo ongena ngawo ekuqinisweni kwesicwangciso soxhobo kunye nemisebenzi yokuphendula. Xhasa ukuvunywa kweNkonzo zeMpilo zaMaZibuko neemfuno zangaphakathi nangaphandle. Nika inkxaso yobuchwepheshe kumapowo ongena ngawo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvunywa neemfuno zangaphakathi nangaphandle. Thatha inxaxheba kwiprojekthi neenjongo zomda wakuqinisa ulawulo nodibano komda. Xhasa ukunxibelelanisa nabathathi-nxaxheba nokumela kwiKomiti ngemiba yeempilo zamazibuko. Qamba uncedule kwaye unxibelelane nabathathi-nxaxheba abahlobene naye ngemiba ephathelene nezeMpilo ngeeMpilo zaMaZibuko. Thatha inxaxheba ngokuzithandela kumagunya oburhulumente ngamazwe nakwezinye iindawo eziphambili zodibano ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukubekwa kwemiba yempilo yamazibuko pezu kwaye kubhalwe iingxelo. Hlobole kwaye uthathe inxaxheba kwimigca yokuvusa ingqondo ngokusika iimpilo zamaphango nemiinye yemini yekhalenda yezempilo. Nika izimvo okanye amagosa ngamaxwebhu ahlobene nemiba yezempilo zamaphango.
