zu.requirements: Iziqu zesizinga se-NQF 6 kwezempilo zendalo nokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengosenzo sezempilo zendalo. Iziqu ze-NQF 7 kwezempilo zendalo zizoba yinenzuzo. Ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengosenzo sezempilo zendalo nasekubeni kwakuhle kwe-HPCSA. Okungenani iminyaka eyihlanu (5) yamava afanele ngemva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA, lapho kuyiminyaka emithatha kufanele kube namava afanele eNqubo (okungukuthi Nosenzo Oyinhloko Wezempilo Zendalo noma okulinganayo). Ulwazi ngemithetho yaseNingizimu Afrika ngemvelo nezempilo ephathelene nezempilo zendalo, inqubo yokwenza izinqubomgomo zokuhlolwa nokuhlolwa kwezinhlelo. Amakhono okuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe), uphenyo/ukuhlaziya, ukwelula, ukuhlela, okokuphatha, okokuqondisa amaphrojekhi nokuphatha imali namakhono ekhompyutha (ihlelo le-MS Office). Kumele athande ukusebenza ngaphezulu kwesikhathi futhi ahambe kakhulu. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Butha izinqubomgomo, iziqondiso, amaphulani, izindinganiso nezimiso eziphathelene nezempilo zendalo. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezindlela nezinqubomgomo zokuLawula Ukudla, ukuPhatha Ukushiswa Kwabafileyo nokuvikela Izifo Ezihambahanayo. Nikeza amandla izifundazwe kamasipala ngemithetho ekhona entsha ethunyiwe nangezindinganiso nezimiso nasokuqalisweni kokugcina amapulazi, ukulawula ukudla, ukuphatha ukushiswa kwabafileyo nahlelo zokuqaphela izempilo zendalo. Hlanganyela emisebenzini kahulumeni weningi ukuze kuqinisekise ukuhlanganiswa nokucatshangelwa kwezinto ezithinta impilo yomuntu ezinye izinqubomgomo, amaphulani nahlelo zezinye izigaba zahulumeni. Sebenzisana nabanomdlayo kuleyo minikelo eziphathelene nalezo hlelo. Nikeza inkxaso yamandla obuchwepheshe futhi uthuthukise amandla izifundazwe kamasipala ekwenzeni izinqubomgomo zezwe. Hlola futhi uhlole ukusetshenziswa kwezinsizakalo zezempilo zendalo kanye nezempilo kamasipala. Lokuhlelelelwa kokuphatwa kwezehla zezempilo zendalo futhi nokuphathwa kwezinsipho kanye namaphulo athenjwa izifundazwe kamasipala.

xh.title: Umncedisi weDirektha: Iimpilo zeNdalo
xh.summary: Umncedisi weDirektha: Iimpilo zeNdalo osekelwe ePretoria, efunayo isifundo seNQF 6, ukuqwalaselwa kwi-HPCSA namava eminyaka emihlanu emva kokuqwalaselwa,elinika i-R664410 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Isifundo seNQF level 6 kwiimpilo zeNdalo nokuQwalaselwa kwiBhunga leMisebenzi yeMpilo yaseMzantsi Afrika (HPCSA) njengomPraktishani weMpilo yeNdalo. Isifundo se-NFQ 7 kwiimpilo zeNdalo siya kuba lusizo. UkuQwalaselwa kwi-HPCSA njengomPraktishani weMpilo yeNdalo nokuba lolungelo elilungileyo. Ubuncinane eminyaka mihlanu (5) yamava afanelekileyo emva kokuqwalaselwa kwi-HPCSA, apho iminyaka mithathu kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo kuLawulo (okt. uMlawuli oyintloko weMpilo yeNdalo okanye olinganayo). Ulwazi ngemimiselo yaseMzantsi Afrika mayela nendalo nempilo esebenzela impilo yendalo, iinkqubo zokwenza iinkqubo zolawulo nokuhlola. Amakhono amabalise (ethethwayo nokuwmbhaliyo), uphando/ohlolo, uqwalaselo, ukuqamba, ulawulo, nolawulo lweeprojekthi nemali namakhono ekhompyutha (MS Office package). Kufuneka abe willingness yokusebenza ihola yokugqitha ixesha elqhelekileyo nahamba kakhulu. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Phatha iinkqubo ezimala nempilo yendalo, izikhokelo, iinkqubo, iimigaqo nemilinganiselo nolawulo. Qinisekisa ukuqhutywa kwezinyanzelo nezikokelo zoLawulo lokutya, uLawulo lokuphela kwabafileyo nokuthintela iinzifo eziqhelekileyo. Nikezela amandla kwiphondo nakumasipala ngemimiselo ekhoyo nentsha esemthethweni nangemigaqo nemilinganiselo nakuphathweni kokuqwalasela iindawo, ulawulo lokutya, ulawulo lokuphela kwabafileyo ne nkqubo zokuqwalasela impilo yendalo. Thatha inxaxheba kumisebenzi kahulumfana phakathi ukuze uqinisekise ukuhlanganiswa nokuqwalaselwa kwezibalo zempilo yomntu kumimiselo yamanye amacandelo ahulumfana, iinkqubo neenkqubo. Sebenzisana nabanikazi bafanelekileyo kumacala ezehla ngenkqubo. Nikezela inkxaso yobuchwepheshe kwaye uphuhlise amandla kwiphondo nakumasipala nakuphathweni kwezazimali zikawonke-wonke. Qwalasela ukuze uhlole ukuphathwa kweemvelo nkonzo zempilo yomasipala. Lawula iinkqubo zokuphatha iziganeko zempilo yendalo nolawulo leeango ezilumkisayo nezinkqubo eziphathwa ngamaphondo namasipala.

jobs.title: Secretary
jobs.summary: The Department of Health seeks a secretary in Pretoria to provide reception and diary management support, requiring Grade 12 with typing and Microsoft Office proficiency.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 (NQF 4) with typing as a subject or related training course / qualification that will enable the person to perform the work satisfactorily. Knowledge and experience in general office and provisioning administration. Knowledge and experience in Microsoft office and knowledge of departmental procedures regarding finances and budgeting. Good telephone etiquette, computer literacy, organisational and planning, high level of reliability and good communication (written and verbal) skills. Ability to act with tact and discretion.
jobs.duties: Provides a secretarial/ receptionist support service manager: Receives and screen telephones calls, receive visitors and refer enquiries to the appropriate officials. Manages the Manager’s diary, appointments, meetings and arrangements, including coordinating venues and virtual meetings. Arrange and coordinate meetings, workshops, stakeholder engagements, including agendas, meeting packs, minutes and action registers where required. Receive, records, distribute and track correspondence, submissions, memoranda and other official documents. Provides a clerical support in the preparation, formatting, filing, copying and distribution of letters, reports, submissions and presentations. Maintains effective electronic and physical filing systems, registers and records, ensuring that information is secure, confidential and readily accessible. Liaise with travel agencies and relevant officials to arrange official travel and accommodation and verifies travel documentation and arrangements. Assist with travel claims, office resource and other administrative and logistical arrangements as required. Coordinates communication and follows up on outstanding matters, information, documentation and actions on behalf of the Manager. Provides administrative support to the Directorate in dealing with internal and external stakeholders, including provincial departments and other government institutions. Remains up to update with and applies relevant Public Service and departmental legislation, prescripts, policies, procedures and guidelines applicable to the work environment.
jobs.enquiries: Mr Exley Louters Tel No: (012) 395 9629
jobs.applications: The Director-General, National Department of Health, Private Bag X399, Pretoria, 0001. Hand delivered application may be submitted at Reception (Brown Application Box), Dr AB Xuma Building, 1112 Voortrekker Rd, Pretoria Townlands 351-JR or should be forwarded to recruitment@health.gov.za quoting the reference number on the subject e-mail. FOR ATTENTION : Ms M Shitiba
jobs.notes: All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment batteries. Assessment for core competencies outlined in the SMS Handbook shall be conducted within one month of the appointment of candidate. Applications should be submitted on the new Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service department and should be accompanied by a CV only (previous experience must be comprehensively detailed). The Z83 must be fully completed (in line with DPSA Practice note), failure to comply will automatically disqualify the applicant. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualification and other relevant documents on application. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be requested prior to the final selection phase. Applications should be on one PDF format (If emailed). Applications received after the closing date and those that do not comply with the requirements will not be considered. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications and national certificates (where applicable) evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Please note by responding to the advertisement, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) Your information will be used solely for the purpose of this promotion and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent unless required by law. The Department reserves the right not to fill the posts. The successful candidate will be subjected to personnel suitability checks and other vetting procedures. Applicants are respectfully informed that correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If notification of an interview is not received within three (3) months after the closing date, candidates may regard their application as unsuccessful. The Department will not be liable where applicants use incorrect/no reference number(s) on their applications. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Sekretaris
af.summary: Die Department of Health soek 'n sekretaris in Pretoria om onvangstoon en dagboekbestuursteun te verskaf, waarvoor Graad 12 met tikvaardighede en vaardigheid in Microsoft Office vereis word.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 (NQF 4) met tik as 'n vak of 'n verwante opleidingskursus / kwalifikasie wat die persoon in staat sal stel om die werk bevredigend te verrig. Kennis en ervaring in algemene kantoor- en voorsieningsadministrasie. Kennis en ervaring in Microsoft Office en kennis van departementele prosedures rakende finansies en begroting. Goede telefoonetiket, rekenaarvaardigheid, organisasie en beplanning, 'n hoë vlak van betroubaarheid en goeie kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondeling). Vermoë om met takt en diskresie op te tree.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n sekretariële/onthalingsdienssteundiensbestuurder: Neem en filtreetelefoonoproepe, ontvang besoekers en verwys navrae na die gepaste amptenare. Bestuur die bestuurder se dagboek, afsprake, vergaderings en reëlings, insluitend die koördineer van plekke en virtuele vergaderings. Reël en koördineer vergaderings, werkswinkels, belanghebbendesbetrekkinge, insluitend agenda's, vergaderingspakkette, notules en aksieregisters waar vereis. Ontvang, registreer, versprei en hou korrespondensie, voorleggings, memoranda en ander amptelike dokumente dop. Verskaf klerieke steun in die voorbereiding, formatering, liassering, kopiëring en verspreiding van briewe, verslae, voorleggings en aanbiedings. Onderhou doeltreffende elektroniese en fisiese lêerstelsels, registers en rekords, en verseker dat inligting veilig, vertroulik en geredelik toeganklik is. Skakel met reisagentskappe en relevante amptenare om amptelike reis en akkommodasie te reël en verifieer reisdokumentasie en -reëlings. Help met reiseise, kantoorhulpbronne en ander administratiewe en logistieke reëlings soos vereis. Koördineer kommunikasie en volg uitstaande sake, inligting, dokumentasie en aksies namens die bestuurder op. Verskaf administratiewe steun aan die Direktoraat in die hantering van interne en eksterne belanghebbendes, insluitend provinsiale departemente en ander regeringsinstansies. Bly op datum met en pas tersaaklike Openbare Diens- en departementele wetgewing, voorskrifte, beleide, prosedures en riglyne van toepassing op die werksomgewing toe.

zu.title: Unobhala
zu.summary: I-Department of Health ifuna unobhala ePretoria ukuba ahlomle ekwamukeleni kwabantu nakuphathweni kwedayari, kudingwa ibhalo le-Graidi 12 kanye nokuqonda ukuthayipha nokusebenza ngamakhompyutha ehlelwini leMicrosoft Office.
zu.requirements: Ibhalo le-Graidi 12 (NQF 4) lokuthi uthole ubhalo ngokuthayipha noma ukufundela esikoleni / noma ngesitifikidi esizomtshengisa ukuthi uyakwazi ukwenza lo msebenzi kahle. Ulwazi nolwazi ngomsebenzi wehhovisi nakuhlelokusebenza. Ulwazi nolwazi kwiMicrosoft Office kanye nolwazi ngezenqubo zomnyango mayelana nezimali namabhajethi. Ukwazi kahle ukukhuluma ocingweni, ubuchwepheshe bekhompyutha, ukuhlela futhi ulunge, izinga eliphezulu lobuzemfihlo kanye namakhono okuxhumana (okubhalwayo nokukhulunwayo). Ukuba nakho ukuze aphathe ngobuhlakani futhi agcine imfihlo.
zu.duties: Ohlinzela ngomsebenzi wezokwaziswa/wezokwamukela abantu kumenzezi: Amukela futhi ahlule amakholi ocingo, amukele abakubashiwo babeke imibuzo kubaphathwa abafanele. Phatha idayari, izonkezo, amahlangano futhi azenge izinhlela zomenzezi, kuhlanganise nokuqondisa amawena namahlangano asehlabathini elikhombisa. Hlela futhi uqondise amahlangano, amaseminari, nokuthintana nabasabalalisi, kuhlanganise izinhlela zomsebenzi, amaphakheji ehlangano, iminithi namarejista esenzo lapho kudingeka khona. Amukela, abhale, abeke athumle futhi alandele impendulo, izithakazelo, amamorejandamu namanye amafayela asemthethweni. Ohlinzela ngomsebenzi wolwazi ekulungiseni, ekubhaleni ngokuhlelekile, ekugcineni amafayela, ekukopisheni nasekusatshalaliseni ngaphandle kwamaguwenti, imibiko, izithakazelo namaphrezenteshi. Gcina amasistimu abhalwe ngabakhompyutha nawokugcina imibhalo yezandla, amarejista namaphuzu, aqiniseka ukuthi ulwazi luvikelwe, luyimfihlo futhi lutholakala lula. Thintana nabalungiselela uhambo nabaphathwa abafanele ukuze uhlele uhambo lwangaphandle namagumbi okulala futhi uhlole amafayela nohlelo lokuhamba. Siza ngemikhawulo yohambo, izinsizakusebenza kohhovisi kanye nokunye ukuphathwa kanye nezinhlela zomkhando njengoba kudingeka. Qondisa ukuxhumana ulandele izindlela ezingagqamile, ulwazi, amafayela nezinye izenzo ngenkanya yomenzezi. Ohlinzela ngokuphathwa kwemisebenzi kwiDirectorate ekuphatheni ngabasabalalisi bangaphakathi nabangaphandle, kuhlanganise nomnyango wezifundazwe nananye izikhungo zahulumeni. Hlala usazi futhi usebenzisa umthetho, imiyalo, amapholisi, inqubo nezinhlela ezithintka zaPublic Service noma kanye nomnyango ezisebenza kwindawo yokusebenza.

xh.title: Umshinekeli
xh.summary: Isebe lezeempilo lifuna umshinekeli ePretoria ukunikeza inkxaso yokwamkela iindwendwe nolawulo lwediary, kufuneka abe neGrade 12 anesipho sokucofa nesikwazi ukusebenzisa iMicrosoft Office.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 12 (NQF 4) ngokuthi ucofa njengesifundi okanye indlela efana nayo yokuzifundisa / iziqu eziza kumzenza umntu ukuba akwazi ukwenza umsebenzi ngokwanelisekileyo. Ulwazi namava kwintlawulo yefayili ngokubanzi nolawulo lokunikela. Ulwazi namva kwiMicrosoft office nolwazi ngendlela zisebenza ngayo iintlobo-mthetho zesebe malunga nezimali nobugcisa bokulinganisa amafa. Iindlela ezilungileyo zokuthetha kulefowuni, ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuqamba ngokuchanekileyo nokuhlela, inqanaba eliphezulu lokuziphathe ngokuzithembeka nendlela ezilungileyo zokuzithetha (nokubhala nokuthetha). Ukuba nakho ukuziphatha ngobuqhotsa nokuba bucala.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yokusebenza njengomshinekeli / wokwamkela iindwendwe kumlawuli: Wamkela aze ahlule iingxoxo zelefowuni, wamkele iindwendwe aze athumbe imibuzo kubasebenzi abafanelekileyo. Ulawula idayari yomlawuli, iinkqubo zokuqonda, iindibano nolungiselelo, kuquka ukuqamba ngendlela iindawo zokubamba iindibano neendibano ezingabonakalayo. Ahlele aze alawule iindibano, iindibano zemisebenzi, iindibano nabantu abanomdla, kuquka oovimba beendibano, amaqabi, iinkcazelo zedolo namarejista okwenza lapho kufuneka khona. Wamkele, abhale, aze asasaze alandele inkcazelo, izibhalo, iinkcazelo ezingangqinelana namaxwebhu amanye asemthethweni. Zale inkxaso yomsebenzi kwisiqendu sokuqamba, ukulungisa, ukugcina, ukutsala nakusasazwa kwamagama, iingxelo, izibhalo namaxwebhu okubonisa. Zigcine iindlela ezisebenzayo zokugcina iifayile zangamakhompyutha nolwqwemele, amarejista nathi tabatha ulwazi, ukuqinisekisa ukuba ulwazi lukhuselekile, luyimfihlo luye lufikeleleke kalula. Nxibelelane neenkampani ezibonelela ngeendlela zokuhambla nabasebenzi abahlobene nendlela yokuhamba nokuhlala aze aqinisekise iinxalenya zokuhamba nolungiselelo. Nceda nemiwayo yokuhamba, amacebo efayili kwaye nezinye iindlela zolawulo nokuhlelwa njengoko kufuneka. Lawule ukunxibelelana kwaye ulandele izinto ezingagqitywanga, iinkcazelo, iinxalenya namanyathelo ngokomlawuli. Nikeza inkxaso yolawulo kuBaphathi ukuphathwa koluntu abangaphakathi nabangaphandle, kuquka amasebe olwandle nozinye iintlangano zorhulumente. Hlala ulwazi oze usebenzise imithetho yoluntu noyesebe, oovimba, iingqungqula, iinkqubo nokuqulunqwa kwemigaqo ekwelulekileyo kumzi osebenza kulo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Curriculum Implementation (SHORT
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Curriculum Implementation at the Department of Higher Education and Training Head Office, responsible for planning and monitoring short skills occupational programmes and learnerships.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/ plus a recognised Degree/Diploma in Education. A minimum of seven (7) years of working experience in the TVET sector of which at least three (3) years should be at managerial level. Must be registered with SACE. Computer Literacy (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access & Outlook) and must also have a valid Driver’s License. Working experience in Data Management or TVETMIS. Competencies: Knowledge of PSETA and CET Act, Knowledge of Teaching and Learning, Knowledge of the Skills Development Act, Public Service Regulations and Public Service Act, and the Labour Relations Act, Knowledge of the Public TVET sector and its regulatory and legislative framework, Knowledge and understanding of the Higher Education sector, Knowledge of Education Act. Skills: Administrative, Report writing, Communication and interpersonal, Problem solving, Computer literacy, Analytical, client-oriented, project management, Team leadership. Planning and organizing. Report writing, Communication and interpersonal, Problem solving, Computer literacy, Analytical, Client-oriented, Project management, Team leadership, and people management.
jobs.duties: Plan, manage, and monitor the implementation short skills occupational programs, learnerships and special programs, ensuring all administrative functions related to ongoing programmes are efficiently managed. Conduct regular monitoring of programme progress, including site visits where necessary, to ensure effective delivery. Establish and sustain strategic partnerships with both the public and private sectors to secure funding for learnerships and short skills programmes and facilitate work placements for learners requiring practical experience. Manage SETA funding. Drive programme accreditation applications with all relevant SETAs/ QCTO, aligning these with industry needs and community demands as identified through Skills Audits of the respective Municipalities. Ensure the coordinated and consistent delivery of occupational qualifications across all college delivery sites. Oversee the development of project plans, including milestones, resource requirements and timeframes. Compile the project budgets and manage all related expenditure. Oversee the sectional budget, managing payments to training providers, facilitators, and learner stipends, as well as procurement of stationery, PPE, and work equipment. Proactively identify and manage risks that could impact the smooth running of the unit, such as learner dropouts linked to stipend delays, and ensure timely submission of monthly reports and quarterly reports to maintain transparency and accountability. Oversee the management of TVETMIS, including data capturing, validation and extradition of College data. Compile college reports based on TVETMIS data. Manage human, physical and financial resources effectively and efficiently.
jobs.enquiries: Mr A Mahamba/Ms N Thompson Tel No: (041) 996 1800
jobs.applications: Email address: asdcur20@emcol.co.za
jobs.notes: To Apply: Applications must be submitted on completed latest Z83 form. A detailed comprehensive CV is required. Certified copies of the required documents as per the advert specification will be requested from shortlisted candidates only on or before the day of the interview. Failure to submit completed latest Z83 form and detailed comprehensive CV will result in the application not being considered. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Recommended candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, citizenship, financial record checks, verification of qualification and previous employment verification). Late applications will not be accepted. Applicants who have not been informed about the outcome of their applications within 3 months after the advert closing date may regard their application as being unsuccessful. The employer is an equal opportunity and reserves the right not to appoint. The decision of employment in terms of employment equity will be determined by the employment equity targets of the Department/College. People with disabilities are encouraged to apply. All Applications must be submitted through email addresses per position and ensure that it is 1 attachment.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Kurrikulumimplementering (KORT
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur: Kurrikulumimplementering by die Department of Higher Education and Training Hoofkantoor, verantwoordelik vir beplanning en monitering van kortvaardigheids-beroepsprogramme en leerderskappe.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/Graad 12/ plus 'n erkende Graad/Diploma in Onderwys. 'n Minimum van sewe (7) jaar se werkservaring in die TVET-sektor waarvan ten minste drie (3) jaar op bestuursvlak moet wees. Moet by SACE geregistreer wees. Rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access & Outlook) en moet ook 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie hê. Werkservaring in Data Management of TVETMIS. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van PSETA en CET Act, Kennis van Onderrig en Leer, Kennis van die Skills Development Act, Public Service Regulations en Public Service Act, en die Labour Relations Act, Kennis van die publieke TVET-sektor en sy regulatoriese en wetgewende raamwerk, Kennis en begrip van die Hoër Onderwys-sektor, Kennis van Education Act. Vaardighede: Administratief, Verslagskrywing, Kommunikasie en interpersoonlik, Probleemoplossing, Rekenaargeletterdheid, Analities, kliëntgerig, projekbestuur, Spanleierskap. Beplanning en organisering. Verslagskrywing, Kommunikasie en interpersoonlik, Probleemoplossing, Rekenaargeletterdheid, Analities, Kliëntgerig, Projekbestuur, Spanleierskap, en mensebestuur.
af.duties: Beplan, bestuur en monitor die implementering van kortvaardigheids-beroepsprogramme, leerderskappe en spesiale programme, en verseker dat alle administratiewe funksies wat verband hou met lopende programme doeltreffend bestuur word. Voer gereelde monitering van programmevoortgang uit, insluitend plekbesoeke waar nodig, om doeltreffende lewering te verseker. Vestig en handhaaf strategiese vennootskappe met beide die publieke en privaat sektors om befondsing vir leerderskappe en kortvaardigheidsprogramme te verseker en werkplasing vir leerders wat praktiese ervaring benodig te fasiliteer. Bestuur SETA-befondsing. Dryf programakkreditasie-aansoeke by alle tersaaklike SETAs/QCTO aan, en belyn dit met bedryfsbehoeftes en gemeenskapsbehoeftes soos geïdentifiseer deur Vaardigheidsoudits van die onderskeie Munisipaliteite. Verseker die gekoördineerde en volgehoue lewering van beroepskwalifikasies oor alle kollegeleweringsplekke. Hou toezig oor die ontwikkeling van projekplanne, insluitend mylpale, hulpbronvereistes en tydraamwerke. Stel projekbegrotings op en bestuur alle verwante uitgawes. Hou toezig oor die afdelingsbegroting, bestuur betalings aan opleiders, fasiliteerders en leerderstoekenning, asook die verkryging van skryfbehoeftes, PPE en werktoerusting. Identifiseer proaktief en bestuur risiko's wat 'n gladde verloop van die eenheid kan beïnvloed, soos leerder-uitval wat verband hou met vertraagde toekenning, en verseer tydige indiening van maandelikse verslae en kwartaalverslae om deursigtigheid en verantwoordbaarheid te handhaaf. Hou toezig oor die bestuur van TVETMIS, insluitend datavaslegging, validasie en onttrekking van Kollege-data. Stel kollegeverslae op grond van TVETMIS-data op. Bestuur menslike, fisiese en finansiële hulpbronne doeltreffend en doeltreffend.

Ukubhala imibiko, Ukuxhumana nabantu, Ukuxazulula izinkinga, Ulwazi lokusebenzela ikhompyutha, Oqondo ngezincazelo, Ukuqondiswa kumthengi, Ukuqondiswa kwezinhlelo, Bukeka bukhoma besigaba, kanye nokuphatha abantu.
zu.duties: Hlela, lawula, futhi ulawule ukuphunyulwa kwezinhlelo zamasu amafupha zokusebenza, izinketho zabafundi nezinhlelo ezikhethekile, waziqinise ukuthi yonke imisebenzi ehlobene nezinhlelo eziqhubekayo iphathwe ngemvelo. Yenza isiphevu sokubuka isinqumo sehlelo, okuhlanganisa ukuvakashela iziteshi lapho kunesidingo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhamba kahle. Yakha futhi ugcine ubuhlobo bokusebenza bobungcali emkhakheni kahulumeni nowabangasese ukuze uthole imali yokuxhasa izinketho zabafudi nezinhlelo zamasu amafupha, futhi wancede abafundi bathole izikhungo zokusebenza lapho badinga isipiliyono sokusebenza. Lawula imali yokuxhasa i-SETA. Qedela izinhlelo zokuqinisekiswa kwezinhlelo kuyo yonke i-SETA/ QCTO, uzibambe ngemigqa namidingo emkhakha wezimbonza kanye nezidingo zabantu bakhona njengoba kubonakaliswe esiHLabuhlongi Sabukhishi bahulumeni basendaweni. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imfundo ezingeni labakhweshi yanikezwa ngokuhlelele kuyo yonke iziteshi zemfundo. Lawula ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo zokusebenza, okuhlanganisa okutholakalayo, kanye nezimali naxaxa. Ngesikhathi esifanele ukwenza imibiko yenyanga neyexaxa, waziqinise ukuthi imibiko iye yethulwa ngesikhathi esifanele ukugcina ukuzibonisa kanye nobunye bemfundo. Lawula imisebenzi ehlukile, okuhlanganisa ukutholwa kwencazelo, ukuqinisekiswa nokukhipha incazelo emakholeji. Hlela imibiko yamakholeji ngokusekelwe kule mininingwane ye-TVETMIS. Ukuceba nokuqokelela. Okubaliweyo iingxelo, Unxibelelwano noluntu, Ukusombulula iingxaki, Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, Ukuhlola-analysis, Ukwakhisa abathengi, Ulawulo lweprojekthi, Ukukhokela iqela, nolawulo labantu.
xh.duties: Ceba, lawula, kwaye uthathele nkqubo ukusebenzisa inkqubo zamakhono amafutshane ezomsebenzi, izikholeji nakwezizonke, ukuqinisekisa ukuba yonke imisebenzi yolawulu engamatyala enxulumene neenkqubo eziqhubekayo ilawulwa ngokusebenza kakuhle. Qhuba uluvo lokumonya inkqubo yentsebenzo, kuquka nokutyelela iindawo apho kufuneka khona, ukuqinisekisa ukunikwa ngokusebenza kakuhle. Misela kwaye ugcine ubudlelwane bokuzama obubakhe isixhongo nobugcini kwilungu loluntu nangasese ukufumana imali-mali yezikholeji nakwezinkqubo zamakhono amafutshane kwaye ulawule ukubekwa kolusebenzo kubafundi abafuna ivuyo lokuzilolonga. Lawula imali-mali yeSETA. Phatha iimfuno zokuqinisekisa inkqubo kuzo zonke iSETAs/ QCTO ezinxulumene, ukuze zongamane neemfuno zoshishino neemfuno zoluntu njengoko zifunyanwa kwiSkills Audits zamaMasipala ngamnye. Qinisekisa ukunikwa ngokulungelelanisa nangokungaguqukiyo kwemimfundo ezonzakalayo kuwo onke amaza anikezela kwikholeji. Lawula ukwenza izicwangciso zeprojekthi, kuquka iindawo ezibalulekileyo, iimfuno zomthombo nexesha. Hlenga imali-mali yeprojekthi kwaye ulawule yonke imali echithiweyo. Lawula imali-mali yecandelo, ekulawuleni imali-mali kubanikezeli bokulinga, abaqeqeshi, naxabiso labafundi, nakwinkqubo yokuthenga ngezinto zokubhala, izixhobo zokhuseleko lomsebenzi, nezixhobo zolusebenzo. Qaphela kwaye ulawule iingozi ezingachaphazela ukusebenza ngokulula kweyuniti, njengokushiya kolwango ngabafudi nxulumene nokuqhelelana kwamaxabiso abafundi, kwaye uqinisekise ukuba sityhalelwa ngexesha iingxelo zenyanga nakwezexesha elithathu ukuze kugcinwe ukuziphatha okucacileyo nokuqonda ekuzeni. Lawula ukulawula iTVETMIS, kuquka ukubala okwethiweyo, ukuqinisekisa kwaye ukuqokelela iData yekholeji. Yenza iingxelo zekholeji ezosisiseko kwiData yeTVETMIS. Lawula ngokusebenza kakuhle nangokuchanekileyo imithombo yabantu, ezemidalido nakwezimali-mali.

Bestuur die hersiening en implementering van ICASS-riglyne vir alle assesserings, insluitend die ontwikkeling van klaskamerbestuursbeleid om kurrikulumlewerings te verbeter. Monitor en evalueer die uitvoering van assesserings oor alle programme en voorsien omvattende verslae aan kollege-uitvoerende bestuur en tersaaklike toesigliggame. Verseker die geköördineerde en konsekwente aflewering van die kurrikulum oor alle kollege-afleweringsplekke, en bevorder bestuurspraktyk-onderrig in samewerking met kampusbestuurders. Verskaf akademiese bestuursdienste deur deurlopende ondersteuning aan doseerpersoneel te bied, vir gehalte-onderrig en -leer te beplan, met studenttoelatings te help, en te verseker dat inskrywingsteikens bereik word. Fasiliteer toegang tot loopbaadvlyting om studente te ondersteun om ingeligte programmeseleksies te maak. Lei die verbetering van kurrikuluminhoud en -aflewering deur aktiewe betrokkenheid by publieke en private nywerheidsbelanghebbendes. Analiseer akademiese resultate, ontwikkel ingreepplanne vir kritieke vakke, en koördineer klaskamerbesoeke om ICASS- en ISAT-nakoming te ondersteun. Oorsien die verskaffing van toepaslike leermateriaal deur ontwikkelingsaktiwiteite te koördineer, materiaal- en hulpbronnebehoeftes te identifiseer, en die verspreiding van leerhulpmiddels te bestuur. Bestuur alle menslike, finansiële en fisiese hulpbronne wat aan die eenheid toegewys is effektief om optimale akademiese prestasie en diensaflewering te verseker.

zu.title: Umkelikleli Ophethe Izinto: Ukuqashelwa Kohlelo Lwemfundo (NCV,
zu.summary: Kudingeka umkelikleli ophethe izinto ukuze abhekele ukuqashelwa kohlelo lwemfundo kwemikhiqizo ye-NCV eHHed Office yaseDepartment of Higher Education and Training.
zu.requirements: National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/ kanye ne-Degree/Diploma esemthethweni kwe-Education. Okungenani amashumi ayisikhombisa (7) eminyaka yohlelo lokusebenza kwikhulu le-TVET lapho okungenani iminyaka emithathu (3) kufanele ibengenga lobuqotho bokuphatha. Kumele abhalwe ku-SACE. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access & Outlook) futhi kumele abe nelayisensi yokuqasha esemthethweni. Ikhono: Ulwazi nge-PSETA nge-CET Act, ulwazi ngokufundisa nokufunda, ulwazi nge-Skills development Act, Public service Regulations ne-Public Service Act, kanye ne-labour relations Act, ulwazi ngehobo le-Public TVET kanye namagugu alo womthetho, ulwazi nokukuqonda ihobo le-Higher Education, ulwazi nge-Education Act. Amandla: Ukulethisa nokuhlela, ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukubhala imibiko, Unxibelelwano nomuntu, Ukuxazulula izinkinga, Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, Ukuhlaziya, Ukuqondiswa ngomthengi, Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo, Ukuphatha iqembu, Ukulethisa nokuhlela, Ukuphatha abantu.
zu.duties: Bhekele ukuthuthukiswa, ukuqashelwa, kanye nokuqashwa kwemigomo yezemfundo nanehlelo lokufunda ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana nemiyalo yezwe. Sekela ukwethulwa kwezinhlelo zemikhiqizo ezintsha, izifundo, kanye nokulungiswa kwezinhlelo ze-National Curriculum (Vocational), futhi unhlelonise ukubuyekeza imigomo ne-SAQA ngokufanele. Phatha ukubuyekeza kanye nekuqashelwa kwemigomo ye-ICASS yazo zonke izivivinyo, okuhlanganisa nokuthuthukiswa kwemigomo yokuphatha ikilasi ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukulethwa kohlelo lokufunda. Bheke futhi uhlolle ukwenziwa kwezivivinyo kuyo yonke imikhiqizo futhi unikeze imibiko enembile abaphathi babashayela phansi bezikole kanye namashembu aphathelene nokuqashwa. Qinisekisa ukulethwa okuhlelekile futhi okuhambisana kohlelo lokufunda kuyo yonke iziteshi zezikole eziletha imfundo, ukukhuthaza ukufundisa okuhle kanye nentando yonke ngokubambisana nabaphathi bamakhasi. Nikeze izinsiza zokuphathwa kwezemfundo ngokunikeza inkxaso eqhubekayo kwabafundisi, ukuhlela ukufundisa nokufunda okuhle, ukusiza ngokwamukelwa kwabafundi, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi okuhlosiwe ekubhaliseni kufinyelelwa. Wenze indlela yokuqondiswa kwemisebenzi ukusekela abafundi ekwenzeni okuhlonishwayo ekukhethweni kwezinhlelo zemikhiqizo. Qondisa ukuthuthukiswa okuhle kokuqukathiwe nokuhanjiswa kohlelo lokufunda ngokuzibandakanya okuphilayo namashembu aphathe kanti futhi namathembu ehobe lobuciko. Hlaziya imiphumela yezemfundo, thuthukisa izinhlelo zokungenelela kwezifundo eziyisilingo, futhi uhlele izivakashi zikilasi ukuze usekele ukuzinhlela kwe-ICASS ne-ISAT. Bhekele ukunikezwa kwezinsiza ezifanele zokufunda ngokuhlela imiklamo yezinsiza, ukuqonda imithombo kanye nezidingo, futhi uphathe ukusatshalaliswa kwezinsiza zokufunda. Phatha ngokuphumelelayo yonke imithombo yabantu, yezimali, nezomzimba enikeziwe kuleyunithi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphumelela okuhle kwezemfundo nokuhanjiswa kwezinsiza.

xh.title: Isikhululi soMkhathi weZiko: Ukusebenzisa iCurriculum (NCV,
xh.summary: Kufunekwa i-Assistant Director ukulawula ukusebenziswa kwecurriculum kweenkqubo ze-NCV eNdzulumbini kwisebe le-Department of Higher Education and Training.
xh.requirements: National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/ ukongeza ne-Degree/Diploma ekuqatyelweyo kwi-Education. Iminyaka yamava yokusebenza esixhenxe (7) kwicandelo le-TVET apho iminyaka yamava ubuncinane kakhulu kwaye kufuneka ibengamashumi amathathu (3) ibe kwinqanaba labalawuli. Kufuneka abhaliswe kwi-SACE. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access & Outlook) kwaye kufuneka abe nelayisensi yokuqhuba esebenzayo. Ikhompethensi: Ulwazi nge-PSETA noma ne-CET Act, ulwazi lokufundisa nokufunda, ulwazi nge-Skills development Act, i-Public service Regulations ne-Public Service Act, nakuMthetho weziqu zabasebenzi, ulwazi ngecandelo le-Public TVET nolawulo lalo nendlela yomthetho, ulwazi nokuqonda icandelo le-Higher Education, ulwazi nge-Education Act. Amakhono: Ukuqamba iindawo nokuzihlomla, ulawulo lemali, uku bhala iingxelo, Unxibelelwano nabantu, ukuxazulula iingxaki, ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, Ukuhlalutya, ukujolisa kumthengi, uLawulo lweplani, ukulawula iqela, ukuqamba iindawo nokuzihlomla, ukulawula abantu.
xh.duties: Lawula uphuhliso, ukusebenziswa, nokujola iinkqubo ze-academic nunicurriculum ukuqinisekisa ukuba zihambisana neendlela zezizwe. Xhasa ukungeniswa kweenkqubo ezintsha, iikwalifikheshini, nokulungiselelwa kwesizwe i-Curriculum (Vocational), kwaye uqhube ukuhlaziywa kweenkqubo nge-SAQA ngokufanelekileyo. Lawula ukuhlaziywa nokusebenziswa kweekhonsi ze-ICASS kwazo zonke iinkqubo zokuqwalasela, kuquka nophuhliso lweenkqubo zolawulo lweklasi rhoqo ukuphucula ukunikela kwecurriculum. Jola kwaye uqwalasele ukwenziwa kwee-ncediso kuphando kwazo zonke iinkqubo kwaye unike iingxelo ezibonakalayo kubaphathi babasebenzi bekholeji nakuqwalaselo olunxulumene nayo. Qinisekisa ukunikwa ngokulawuleka nangokungatshintshiyo kwecurriculum kuzo zonke iindawo zokunikela zekholeji, ukukhuthaza izindaba ezilungileyo zokufundisa ngokusebenzisana nabaphathi be-campus. Nikezela iinkonzo zolawulo lwemfundo ngokunika inkxaso ephila rhoqo kubasebenzi abafundisayo, ucwangcisa ukufundisa nokufunda ngomgangatho ophezulu, ukuncedisa ngokwamkelwa kwabafundi, nokuqinisekisa ukuba iigadi zokubhalisa zifunyenwe. Yenza ukuba kungangeni ukhuseleko kokukhokezelwa kobomi bengaphakathi ukuxhasa abafundi ekwenzeni izinto ezikhethwayo ngeenkqubo. Khokela ukuphuculwa kokuqukatwa nokunikwa kwecurriculum ngokubandakanyeka ngokudibana nabatyali-mali basemphakathini nasabucala. Hlaziya iimpembelelo zokufunda, phuhliza iindawo zolawulo kwizifundo ezingundoqo, kwaye uqhube iindwendwe zeklasi ukuxhasa ukuzalathana ne-ICASS ne-ISAT. Lawula ukunikwa kwezinto zokufunda ezifanelekileyo ngokuqhathanisa imisebenzi yophuhliso, ukuchonga iimfuno zezinto nabantu, nokulawula ukusasazwa kwezixhobo zokufunda. Lawula ngokusebenzayo onke amathuba abantu, amathuba emali, namathuba ezinto ezingaqathwa asinikweleyo kwicandelo ukuqinisekisa ukuphumelela okuhle kwe-academic nokuza kweentsiba.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: ICT
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Assistant Director ICT at the Department of Higher Education and Training Head Office, managing communication systems and providing ICT service support.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 certificate and NQF 6 qualification in Information Technology / Computer Sciences. ITIL certificate and ICT Governance and Ethics will be an advantage. Certification in CAN, CNE, MCITP, A+, N+, Networking+, Security+, Mobility+, CISA, CISM, CRISK, CGEIT as well as Microsoft certifications like MOS, MSCA Desktop will be an added advantage. At least three (3) years’ experience at a supervisory level in Information Technology environment and must also have a valid Driver’s License. Competencies: Experience in supporting transversal applications e.g. BAS, PERSAL, Logis, Safety web and Firewall as well as in ICT policy, process, procedure and standard development, Microsoft environment, open source and directory authentication systems and services. Knowledge of procedure and process for installing, configuring, upgrading, troubleshooting and repairing applicable software, hardware and peripherals such as printers and related hardware. Monitoring the LAN’s and WAN’s. Knowledge of the OSI model as well as Government Transversal Systems and Financial Systems. Good communication (verbal and written), technical, interpersonal, problem solving and organizing skills. Ability to work under pressure and in a team as well as able to travel when required. Skills: Planning and organizing, financial management, Report writing, Communication and interpersonal, Problem solving, Computer literacy, Analytical, Client oriented, Project management, Team leadership, Planning and organizing, People management.
jobs.duties: Manage, maintain, and ensure the availability of communication systems. Provide ICT service support for the computer software and applications, computer hardware, computer networks (Wide Area Network (WAN), and Local Area Networks (LAN), Virtual Private Network (VPN), Multi-Protocol Label Switching (MPLS). Management and support for the Transversal Systems (Application software, connectivity, computer client software). Manage, monitor and report on ICT service support and delivery. Ensure ICT service requests and incidents are reported, addressed and resolved as per the service standards. Ensure contractors deliver service correctly. Manage resources, ICT risks and audit queries. Manage staff performance in line with PMDS, including performance agreements and reviews. Establish contingency plans with backup resources for ICT service support and delivery. Assistance in the planning and research of ICT policy. Development, review, and documentation of ICT policies, processes, procedures, and standards. Development and implementation of network capacity management plans. Management and maintenance of physical security systems. Develop strategy for Ndoh Datacentre and physical environment controls as well as implement server environment controls in alignment to audit requirements and governance control and good practice. Manage customer relations. Liaise with users and work groups on their needs, questions, requests and problems with regard to network services. Investigate current computers and compare with new trends and ensure current technology is capable.
jobs.enquiries: Mr A Mahamba/Ms N Thompson Tel No: (041) 996 1800
jobs.applications: Email address: asdict22@emcol.co.za
jobs.notes: To Apply: Applications must be submitted on completed latest Z83 form. A detailed comprehensive CV is required. Certified copies of the required documents as per the advert specification will be requested from shortlisted candidates only on or before the day of the interview. Failure to submit completed latest Z83 form and detailed comprehensive CV will result in the application not being considered. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Recommended candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, citizenship, financial record checks, verification of qualification and previous employment verification). Late applications will not be accepted. Applicants who have not been informed about the outcome of their applications within 3 months after the advert closing date may regard their application as being unsuccessful. The employer is an equal opportunity and reserves the right not to appoint. The decision of employment in terms of employment equity will be determined by the employment equity targets of the Department/College. People with disabilities are encouraged to apply. All Applications must be submitted through email addresses per position and ensure that it is 1 attachment.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: IKV
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur IKV by die Department of Higher Education and Training Hoofkantoor, wat kommunikasiestelsels bestuur en IKV-diensondersteuning bied.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n NQF 6-kwalifikasie in Inligtingstegnologie / Rekenaarwetenskappe. 'n ITIL-sertifikaat sowel as IKV-bestuur en -etiek sal 'n voordeel wees. Sertifisering in CAN, CNE, MCITP, A+, N+, Networking+, Security+, Mobility+, CISA, CISM, CRISK, CGEIT asook Microsoft-sertifiserings soos MOS, MSCA Desktop sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Ten minste drie (3) jaar se ervaring op toesigvlak in 'n Inligtingstegnologie-omgewing asook 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Ervaring in die ondersteuning van transversale toepassings bv. BAS, PERSAL, Logis, Safety web en Firewall asook in IKV-beleid, proses-, prosedure- en standaardontwikkeling, Microsoft-omgewing, oopbron- en gidsverifikasiestelsels en -dienste. Kennis van prosedure en proses vir die installering, konfigurering, opgradering, probleemoplossing en herstel van toepaslike sagteware, hardeware en randapparatuur soos drukkers en verwante hardeware. Monitering van die LAN's en WAN's. Kennis van die OSI-model asook Regering Transversale Stelsels en Finansiële Stelsels. Goeie kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik), tegniese, interpersoonlike, probleemoplossings- en beplanningsvaardighede. Vermoë om onder druk en in 'n span te werk asook om te reis wanneer vereis. Vaardighede: Beplanning en organisering, finansiële bestuur, verslagskrywing, kommunikasie en interpersoonlik, probleemoplossing, rekenaarvaardigheid, analities, kliëntgerig, projekbestuur, spanleierskap, beplanning en organisering, mensebestuur.
af.duties: Bestuur, onderhou en verseker die beskikbaarheid van kommunikasiestelsels. Verskaf IKV-diensondersteuning vir rekenaarsagteware en -toepassings, rekenaarhardeware, rekenaarnetwerke (Wide Area Network (WAN), en Local Area Networks (LAN), Virtual Private Network (VPN), Multi-Protocol Label Switching (MPLS). Bestuur en ondersteuning van die Transversale Stelsels (Toepassingsagteware, konnektiwiteit, rekenaarkliëntsagteware). Bestuur, monitor en rapporteer oor IKV-diensondersteuning en -lewering. Verseker dat IKV-diensversoeke en -insidente aangemeld, hanteer en opgelos word volgens die diensstandaarde. Verseker dat kontrakteurs dienste korrek lewer. Bestuur hulpbronne, IKV-risiko's en ouditnavrae. Bestuur personeelprestasie in ooreenstemming met PMDS, insluitend prestasieooreenkomste en -hersienings. Stel noodplanne op met rugbronne vir IKV-diensondersteuning en -lewering. Bystand in die beplanning en navorsing van IKV-beleid. Ontwikkeling, hersiening en dokumentasie van IKV-beleide, prosesse, prosedures en standaarde. Ontwikkeling en implementering van netwerkkapasiteitsbestuursplanne. Bestuur en onderhoud van fisiese sekuriteitsstelsels. Ontwikkel strategie vir Ndoh Datacentre en fisiese omgewingskontroles asook implementering van bedieneromgewingskontroles in ooreenstemming met ouditvereistes en bestuursbeheer en goeie praktyk. Bestuur kliëntverhoudinge. Skakel met gebruikers en werkgroepe oor hul behoeftes, vrae, versoeke en probleme met betrekking tot netwerkdienste. Ondersoek huidige rekenaars en vergelyk met nuwe tendense en verseker dat huidige tegnologie geskik is.

zu.title: Umncedi Wezikhulu: ICT
zu.summary: Umncedi wezikhulu ICT eKantolo Elikhulu le Department of Higher Education and Training, ephatha izindlelela zokuxhumana futhi enikeza inkxaso yesevisi ye ICT.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se Grade 12 kanye nesidingo se NQF 6 kwi Information Technology / Computer Sciences. Isitifikedi se ITIL kanye ne ICT Governance and Ethics kuzoba lusizo. Isitifikidi kwi CAN, CNE, MCITP, A+, N+, Networking+, Security+, Mobility+, CISA, CISM, CRISK, CGEIT kanye nokugqamisa izitifikidi ze Microsoft njenge MOS, MSCA Desktop kuzoba lusizo olwengeziwe. Okungenani amava eminyaka emithathu (3) ezingeni lokubhekisisa endaweni ye Information Technology futhi kumelwe abe nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Izindlela: Amaxa ekunikeni inkxaso kumabhulogi okudlula njenge BAS, PERSAL, Logis, Safety web ne Firewall kanye naku mthetho we ICT, inqubo, uhlelo kanye nentuthuko yamazinga, indawo ye Microsoft, umthombo ovulekile kanye nezindlelela zokuqinisekisa uhlu kanye nesevisi. Ulwazi ngenqobo ngezinhlaka zokuqinisekisa uhlu ngokufaka, ukulungiselela, ukwenza ngcono, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokulungisa amabhulogi okusebenzayo, okungenalutho kanye neqhinga elifanayo njengabaphrinti kanye neseqhinga elihlobene. Ukuqaphela i LAN kanye ne WAN. Ulwazi lweqhinga i OSI model kanye namasistimu kahuluminti okudlula kanye namasistimu ezimali. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle (okuthiwa nokuqoshiwe), obuchwepheshe, abantu, okuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlela. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegciniselo nangaphakathi kohlelo kanye nokwazi ukuhamba nxa kudingeka. Amakhono: Ukulungiselela futhi ukuhlela, ukulawula imali, ukubhala ingxelo, Ukuxhumana nabantu, Ukuxazulula izinkinga, Ulwazi lwekhompyutha, Ukuhlaziya, Ukuzinikela kumxhasi, Ukuphatha iphrojekthi, Ukuba ngumholi ohlelo, Ukulungiselela futhi ukuhlela, Ukuphatha abantu.
zu.duties: Phatha, gcina, futhi qinisekisa ukutholakala kwezindlela zokuxhumana. Nikela inkxaso yesevisi ye ICT ekuqinisekisweni kwekhompyutha kanye nokuqinisekiswa kweqhinga lekhompyutha, amanethiwekhi wekhompyutha (Wide Area Network (WAN), kanye ne Local Area Networks (LAN), Virtual Private Network (VPN), Multi-Protocol Label Switching (MPLS). Ukuphatha nokuqinisekisa izindlelela ezihamba phambili (amabhulogi okusebenzisa, ukuhlanganisa, amabhulogi okusebenzisa wekhompyutha). Phatha, qaphela futhi kidinga ngesevisi ye ICT kanye nokuhlinzeka. Qinisekisa ukuthi izicelo kanye nezinkinga ze ICT zikabikwa, ziphathwe futhi zixazululwe ngokuvumelana namazinga asevisi. Qinisekisa ukuthi oqashiwe bakhonza ngendlela efanele. Phatha izinsiza, izinkinga ze ICT kanye nemibuzo yokuhlola. Phatha ukusebenza kwabasebenzi ngokuvumelana ne PMDS, okuhlanganisa izivumelano zokusebenza kanye nokubuyekeza. Hlela izindlela zokwesula kanye nezinsiza zokusekelwa ngokwezinsiza ze ICT kwaye inkxaso kanye nokuhlinzeka. Usizo ekulungiseleleni kanye nokuphenya umthetho we ICT. Ukuthuthuka, ukubuyekeza, kanye nokuloba umthetho we ICT, izinqubo, izinhlelo, kanye namazinga. Ukuthuthuka kanye nokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuphatha umthamo wenethiwekhi. Ukuphatha kanye nokugcina izindlela zokuqinisekisa ngokomzimba. Hlela isu le Ndoh Datacentre kanye nezilawuli zendawo ngokomzimba futhi usebenzise izilawuli zendawo yeseva ngokuvumelana nezidingo zokuhlola kanye nokuqinisekiswa kokuphatha kanye nendlela efanele. Phatha ubuhlobo namaxhasi. Xhumana nabasebenzisi kanye namaqembu okusebenza ngokudingo kwabo, imibuzo, izicelo kanye nezinkinga ngokuhlobene nesevisi yenethiwekhi. Phenya izikhompyutha zangalesi sikhathi uze uqhathanise nokuqhamuka okusha bese uqinisekisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bamanje bunamandla okusebenza.

xh.title: Umsekela weNkulumbuso: I-ICT
xh.summary: Umsekela weNkulumbuso I-ICT kwiNkompono eNkulu yoMsebenzi wezeMfundo ePhakamileyo nokuqeqesha, elawula iinkqubo zokunxibelelwana kwaye linika inkxaso yesebenzo le-ICT.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samabakala gradesi 12 nesidanga se-NQF 6 kwiNzululwazi yoQwgezo / eZikhompyutha. Isatifikethi se-ITIL kunye noLawulo nokuZiphatha kwe-ICT kuya kuba lusizo. Isatifikethi kwi-CAN, CNE, MCITP, A+, N+, Networking+, Security+, Mobility+, CISA, CISM, CRISK, CGEIT nakuqinisekiso lwe-Microsoft njengakwi-MOS, MSCA Desktop kuya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo. Ubuncinane eminyaka emithathu (3) yamava kwinqanaba labaphathi kwimo yokuQhelanisa noQwgezo kwaye kufuneka abe nelayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Iikhompetensi: Amanqanaba abakho okunikela inkxazo kwiinkqubo ezihamba ngaphandle ezinjengokuba yi-BAS, PERSAL, Logis, i-Safety web ne-Firewall nakuqhelanisa namapolisi, iinkqubo, iindlela nentluko yokuqulunqa, iimo zikaMicrosoft, iinkqubo zemithombo evulekileyo nendlela yokuqinisekisa ngokulandela imithetho. Ulwazi ngenkqubo nendlela yokufaka, uqwalaselo, ukwandisa, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqwalasela isoftware efanelekileyo, i-hardware nezixhobo ezidityaniswayo ezinjengabaprinti nezinye i-hardware. Ukulanda i-LAN's ne-WAN's. Ulwazi ngohlobo lwemodeli ye-OSI nakuqonda iinkqubo ezingangangenyo ezikarhulumente nendlela zelimali. Amakhono amahle okunxibelelwana (ngomlomo nangobhalo), obuchwepheshile, bokuhlobana nabantu, bokusombulula iingxaki nokuqamba izinto. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokucinezela kwaye unako ukusebenza eqeleni kwesikhathi usenokwazi ukuhamba xa kufunwa. Ikhono: Uqqamba nokuqamba, ulawulo lwezemali, ukuBhala iingxelo, ukuNxibelelana nokuxhumanana, ekuSombululeni iingxaki, ukwazi iKhompyutha, ekuQwalaseleni, ukujolisa kumXhasi, uLawulo lweeProjekthi, uBukhosi beQela, Uqamba nokuqamba, uLawulo lwabantu.
xh.duties: Qamba, zigcine, kwaye uqinisekise ukubakho kweenkqubo zokunxibelelwana. Nikela ngokukhusela inkxazo yamakhonza e-ICT kusoftware nakuzo nkqubo zekhompyutha, i-hardware yekhompyutha, amanethiwekhi ekhompyutha (i-Wide Area Network (WAN), kunye nama-Local Area Networks (LAN), i-Virtual Private Network (VPN), i-Multi-Protocol Label Switching (MPLS). Ulawulo nonkonzo eLuxe kweNkqubo eZihamba ngaphandle (isoftware ye nkqubo, ukudibanisa, isoftware yamakhasa ekhompyutha). Qamba, landelela kwaye ube nexela malunga nenkxazo nokuhanjiswa kwamakhonza e-ICT. Qinisekisa ukuba izicelo zinkxazo ye-ICT neenkcitha zibaliwe, ziphathwe kwaye zisombululwe njengoko kukho kwemiqathango. Qinisekisa ukuba oqeqeshiweyo benza inkonzo ngendlela elungileyo. Lawula izixhobo, iingxaki ze-ICT neembuzo yolawulo. Lawula inkqubo yabasebenzi ngokwemiqathango ye-PMDS, kuquka nemvumisano yemisebenzi nokuyiqwalasela. Misela iindlela zokuziqhelanisa ngendlela yokuzithintela ezingadinwa ngokomthombo wokukhusela inkxazo nokuhanjiswa kwe-ICT. Ncedo kokuqamba nokuphangela ngamapolisi e-ICT. Ukuphuhlisa, ukuqwalasela, nokubhala amapolisi, iinkqubo, iindlela, namagaba aphakathi kwe-ICT. Ukuphuhlisa nokusebenzisa iiplani zokulawula umthamo wamanethiwekhi. Ulawulo nokugcina iinkqubo zokukhusela ngezakho. Uphuhlise isu leNdoh Datacentre nolawulo lwendalo eqhingwe kuyo ngokwemfuno, ngokunjalo usebenzise ulawulo lwemo yamaseva ngokwemiqathango yolawulo nezimiso ezilungileyo. Lawula ubudlelwane namaxhasi. Xhumana neqela labasebenzi ngemfuno yabo, imibuzo, izicelo, neenkinga ezikwi nkqubo yamaphasheke. Phanda ngamakhompyutha akhoyo uze uwalinganise nokuqhakamshela okutsha ukuze uqinisekise ukuba inkqobo yobuchwepheshile ikwazi ukusebenza.

af.duties: Beplanning - Koördineer, hersien, ontleed en verseker die gehalte van die finansiële ondersteunende inligting vir beplanningsdoeleindes, Koördineer en hersien die nodige finansiële ondersteunende dokumente wat vir die strategiese en jaarlikse prestasiebeplanningsproses vereis word. Ontleed en verseker die gehalte van die tersaaklike finansiële inligting wat in die evaluering en ontwikkeling van besigheids- en projekplanne vereis word. Kontroleer en verifieer die ondersteunende inligting vir verskeie finansiële beplanningsprosesse. Begroting - Koördineer, hersien, ontleed en verseker die gehalte van die begrotingsvoorbereidingsproses. Koördineer die voorbereiding en konsultasie vir die MTEF-begrotingsproses. Ontleed, interpreteer en implementeer die tesourieriglyne vir die raming van nasionale bestedings (ENE), Ontwikkel sjablone vir die versameling van begrotingsinligting van lyntfunksionarisse. Onderneem die beplanning en hou toesig oor die voorbereidings- en konsultasieproses by die implementering van die aanpassingsramingsproses. zu.duties: Ukubhekisisa -Hlelela, bheka, hlaziya kanye nokuhlinzeka ngentuthuko eyisibonelo ekwaziseni ngemali ngokuhlose ukuhlelela, hlelela kanye nokubhala imibhalo esekelayo emadidingo ahambisana nokuHlelela Kweminyaka yonkana. Hlaziya nokuhlinzeka ngentuthuko ethile ngemali esidingeka ekubhekeni nasenkululenweni kwezinhlelo ze-mali emigidingweni eminingi yokucubungula nemali. Bheka futhi qinisekisa izibonelo ezisekela imigidingo eminingi yokuhlelela imali. Ukwenza iNani -Hlelela, bheka, hlaziya kanye nokuthuthukisa ibhajethi, inqubo yokulungiselela. Hlelela ukulungiselela kanye nexesha lokubonisana leProsesi yeMTEF bhajethi. Hlaziya, humusha kanye nokusebenzisa izixwayo ezivela Kwindlu Yegceke eziyisilinganiso sechiza lezimali ezikashixamazwe, developa ithempleyithi egcinwa ukuthola imininingwane yebhajethi kubantu abangaphandle. Lungelelanisa izinkulumo zebhajethi ngokuHlelela ngokweminyaka yonkana, hlela iminyaka yonkana yezinto ezibalulekile mayelana nokuchithwa kwemali emazweni nasemifundeni. Hlaziya futhi uhulumusha izimfuneko kwibhajethi yenyanga zonkana kanye nalokhu okulungisiwe njengoba bekuhlela Kwindlu Yegceke futhi uphakamise izenzo zokulungisa lapho kudingeka khona. Yiba ngumhleli futhi ube ngumlawuli mayelana nokuHlelela kanye nexesha lokubonisana ekusetshenzisweni kwezenzo zokulungisa izimali. Qinisekisa ukuthi kungathathwa imali enkulu/iphethselwe kukuphi okuhambisana nezimali ezichithekiwe. Lawula ukubhalwa kwento ezilungiswayo kanye nokunikezela ngemibhalo engqondweni ethile. Phathwa ngenhlahleko emafayini amaningi okulungisa ngonyaka. Lalela ukuthi konke ukushintshwa kwemali okuxhunyiwe kungafakwe kubhajethi elungisiwe. Hlaziya izicelo ezithunyelwe ukuthi zithunyelwe kabusha kanti futhienze izincomo ngokwemithetho (kufaka phakathi imali ethunyelwe engasebenziwe). Ukubika Hlelela, bheka, hlaziya futhi uthuthukise inqubo yokuBika kwezimali. Hlaziya imininingwane ekubikweni kwanyanga zonkana okukhiyizwayo (okuhlukile phakathi kwemali echithekile nesebhajethini) uphakamise futhi izenzo ezifanele lapho kudingeka khona. Lalela ukuthi konke ukushintshwa kwemali okuxhunyiwe kufakwe kuBiko lokubukela ngaphakathi kwaminyaka. Nikeza izeluleki kanye nokuhola abanye ekusetshenzisweni kwezinhlela zokuqagela imali. Qoqa imininingwane ebalulekile kwimibhalo yeminyaka yonkana kanye nayo ephakathi kweminyaka. Phatha inqubo yokuSebenza, imithombo yokusebenza kanye nemigidingo, ehambisana nemisebenzi yezimali ekuqingeni imali. Lungiselela kanye nokubheka imithetho yesikhungo ehambisana nokuphathwa kwezimali (ukuhlelela kanye nokuqinisa ibhajethi). Nikeza imisebenzi abantu abangaphandle, ulalele imibhalo kanti futhi ukhulule imigidingo ebalulekile yokulungisa konke okuhlukile kumazinga afunwayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhlelwe imisebenzi kahle. Lalela imigidingo yabasebenzi futhi ubheke ukuthi badinga ukulelwa yini. Lawula ukushiywa kwemali kanye nezinkinga ezihlobene nabantu, ngokulandela imithetho ethunyelwe mayelana nokuphathwa kwabantu.

xh.duties: Ukuqamba -Ukuquka, ukuphonononga, ukuhlalutywa negumbi lokunyanzelisa khwalithi ulwazi oluxhasa imali ngenjongo yokuqamba, ukuquka nokuphonononga amaxwebhu axhasa imali afunekayo kwinkqubo yokuqamba ngokuqhubekisela phambili nangomnyaka wonyaka wokuphumeza. Ukuhlalutywa negumbi lokunyanzelisa khwalithi ulwazi lolwazi lwemali olufunekayo ekulinganisweni nokuphuhliseni iinhlobo zeplani zeplani zeprojekthi. Ukukhangela kunye nokuqinisekisa ulwazi oluxhasa iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zokuqamba imali. Ukwalatha imeko yemali -Ukuquka, ukuphonononga, ukuhlalutywa negumbi lokunyanzelisa khwalithi lebajeti, inkqubo yokulungiselela. Ukuquka ukulungiselela kunye nokucelelana ngemibuzo ngenkqubo yebajeti yeMTEF. Ukuhlalutywa, ukutolika nokusebenzisa iindlela zokuqulunqa zeMali ezibekiweyo ngeziqikizo zentshabalalo yemali yebhunga likazwelonke (ENE), Ukuphuhliswa kwefom eza kuthi isetyenziswe xa kutsalwa ulwazi ngebajeti kubasebenzi bemisebenzi eqhagamshelweyo. Ukuqondanisa iinkcazelo zebajeti neplani yokuphumeza isebenzisa inyaka, neplano yangowonyaka yokuqhubekisela phambili ukuchithwa kwemali kwabasebusazwe nakumaprovinsi. Ukuhlalutywa nokutolika iimfuno zokuhamba kwemali yenyanga nentshintsho yemali njengoko kubekiweyo yiTreasury kwaye sicebise izinyathelo zokuqwalaselwa apho kufuneka khona. Ukuqamba kwaye ulawule ukulungiselela nokucelelana ngemibuzo kwinkqubo yokusebenzisa inkqubo yeziqikizo zentshintsho. Ukulinganisa ukuba kukho isidingo nokwenzeka kokuhanjiswa kweemali/okushintshwa kwemali ngokuphonononga ukuchithwa kwimali ngokubhekiselele kwibajeti kwaye uze neengcebiso. Ukulawula ukubhaliswa kwezintshintsho kwaye unike imbisela yemiba kumacandelo ahambelanayo. Ukunika ulwazi malunga nokulungiselelwa iinkcazelo zemali zonyaka. Ukugcina ukuba onke amashifti/amatshintsho abandakanywe kwibajeti etshintshiweyo. Ukuhlalutywa iimfuno zokugqithisa kwaye kwenziwe iingcebiso ngokuthobela imigaqo (kuquka nemali ethunyelwe kodwa ingachithwanga) Iingxelo Ukuquka, ukuphonononga, ukuhlalutywa negumbi lokunyanzelisa khwalithi iinkqubo zokwenza iingxelo zokulawula imali., Ukulinganisa ulwazi kwiingxelo nyanga zonke ezivelisweyo (umahluko phakathi kwentshabalalo yokwenyani nokubheka phambili kubunjelwe ukuchithwa) kwaye kucebiswe izinyathelo ezifanelekileyo apho kuyimfuneko. Ukugcina ukuba onke amashifti/amatshintsho abandakanywe kwiIn Year Monitoring Report., Ukunika ingcebiso nokuqondisa abadlali bemidlalo ngokusetenziswa kweendlela nezixhobo zokubikezela. Ukuqulunqa ulwazi ngeengxelo zokusebenza kuthotho kunye nezonyaka. Ukulawula iinkqubo zokuqhuba, amakhaya amathuba, kunye neenkqubo, ezinxulumene nomsebenzi wokulawula imali. Ukuphuhliswa nokuphonononga iindlela namagunya esebenze kumsebenzi weqela elalawula imali (okuqamba nokubajetha). Ukwaba imisebenzi kubasebenzi, ukuqonda iziphumo nokuseka izinyathelo zokuqwalaselwa eziyimfuneko ukulungisa iindlela ezahluka kumazinga abekiweyo. Ukumisela iimfuno zokuhamba komsebenzi. Ukuqonda ukusebenza kwabasebenzi kwaye kugqitywe iimfuno zolwazi. Ukulawula ikhefu neminye imiba ehambisanayo nabasebenzi ngokusebenzisa ngenqgela ezelwe. Iinkqubo zeZemisebenzi yabantu.

jobs.title: Senior Administrative Officer: Office of the Principal
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.salary_text: R413 001 – R486 501 per annum (Level 08), plus benefits
jobs.summary: Senior Administrative Officer providing administrative support to the Office of the Principal at the Head Office, drafting correspondence and consolidating reports.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 Certificate. Recognised National Diploma in Public Administration / Business Management / Office Management (NQF Level 6) or equivalent qualification. 3-5 years in Public Administration environment. Valid Driver’s License will be an added advantage. Competencies: Knowledge and understanding of Public Administration. Knowledge of the relevant legislation, policies, prescripts and procedures. Basic knowledge of Financial Administration. Skills: Administrative; Planning and organizing; Financial management; Report writing; Communication and interpersonal; Problem solving; Computer literacy; Analytical. Client oriented. Project management. Team leadership. Planning and organizing. People management.
jobs.duties: Draft all letters, submissions and memorandums. Preparing supporting documents for meetings, receive and distribution of stationery to the relevant officials. Receive and consolidate monthly reports. Assist in co-ordinate of college inputs for annual, quarterly, monthly reports, and cash flow statements. Assisting in the establishment and implementation of effective records and document management systems in the office of the Principal. Coordinate all logistical arrangements for travelling and meetings etc. Processing of claims for travelling and meetings etc. Arrange all meetings, proceedings and activities of the above structures. Compile agenda, minutes, reports and other records of the above structures. Distribution of relevant documents for meetings of above structures. Assist in keeping a register of resolutions and supporting all relevant Council Members / Managers / Officials through continuous correspondence to remind them of what needs to be done. Safekeeping of approved minutes are signed off and safely kept. Assist in coordinating operational and strategic planning process. Assist in coordinate and compile strategic and operational plans. Assist in facilitating the development and implementation of service delivery improvement plans and initiatives. Assist in coordinating and compiling institutional performance and strategic reports. Assist in conducting an assessment on college effectiveness and efficiency in supporting the attainment of service delivery objectives.
jobs.enquiries: Mr A Mahamba/Ms N Thompson Tel No: (041) 996 1800
jobs.applications: Email Address: adminotp24@emcol.co.za
jobs.notes: To Apply: Applications must be submitted on completed latest Z83 form. A detailed comprehensive CV is required. Certified copies of the required documents as per the advert specification will be requested from shortlisted candidates only on or before the day of the interview. Failure to submit completed latest Z83 form and detailed comprehensive CV will result in the application not being considered. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Recommended candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, citizenship, financial record checks, verification of qualification and previous employment verification). Late applications will not be accepted. Applicants who have not been informed about the outcome of their applications within 3 months after the advert closing date may regard their application as being unsuccessful. The employer is an equal opportunity and reserves the right not to appoint. The decision of employment in terms of employment equity will be determined by the employment equity targets of the Department/College. People with disabilities are encouraged to apply. All Applications must be submitted through email addresses per position and ensure that it is 1 attachment.

af.title: Senior Administratiewe Beampte: Kantoor van die Skoolhoof
af.summary: Senior Administratiewe Beampte wat administratiewe ondersteuning aan die Kantoor van die Skoolhoof by die Hoofkantoor verleen, korrespondensie opstel en verslae konsolideer.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat. Erkende Nasionale Diploma in Publieke Administrasie / Besigheidsbestuur / Kantoorbestuur (NQF Level 6) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. 3-5 jaar in 'n Publieke Administrasie-omgewing. Geldige bestuurderslisensie sal 'n voordeel wees. Bevoegdhede: Kennis en begrip van Publieke Administrasie. Kennis van die tersaaklike wetgewing, beleide, voorskrifte en prosedures. Basiese kennis van Finansiële Administrasie. Vaardighede: Administratief; Beplanning en organisering; Finansiële bestuur; Verslagskrywing; Kommunikasie en interpersoonlik; Probleemoplossing; Rekenaargeletterdheid; Analities. Kliëntgerig. Projekbestuur. Spanleierskap. Beplanning en organisering. Personeelsbestuur.
af.duties: Stel alle briewe, voorleggings en memorandums op. Voorbereiding van ondersteunende dokumente vir vergaderings, ontvang en versprei skryfbehoeftes aan die tersaaklike amptenare. Ontvang en konsolideer maandelikse verslae. Help met die koördinering van kollege-invoere vir jaarlikse, kwartaal- en maandelikse verslae, asook kontantvloeistate. Bystand verleen by die totstandstelling en implementering van doeltreffende rekord- en dokumentbestuurstelsels in die kantoor van die Skoolhoof. Koördineer alle logistieke reëlings vir reis en vergaderings ens. Verwerking van eise vir reis en vergaderings ens. Reël alle vergaderings, verrigtinge en aktiwiteite van bogenoemde strukture. Stel agenda, notule, verslae en ander rekords van bogenoemde strukture op. Verspreiding van tersaaklike dokumente vir vergaderings van bogenoemde strukture. Help om 'n register van besluite by te hou en ondersteun alle tersaaklike Raadslede / Bestuurders / Amptenare deur volgehoue korrespondensie om hulle te herinner aan wat gedoen moet word. Veilige bewaring van goedgekeurde notule wat geteken en veilig gehou word. Help met die koördinering van die operasionele en strategiese beplanningsproses. Help met die koördinering en opstel van strategiese en operasionele planne. Help om die ontwikkeling en implementering van diensleweringverbeteringsplanne en -inisiatiewe te fasiliteer. Help met die koördinering en opstel van institusionele prestasie- en strategiese verslae. Help om 'n assessering uit te voer oor die doeltreffendheid en effektiewiteit van die kollege om die bereiking van diensleweringdoelwitte te ondersteun.

zu.title: Umphathi Wabasebenzi Abangangemuva: Ihhovisi Likamongameli
zu.summary: Umphathi Wabasebenzi Abangangemuva onikeza inkhaselo yolawulelo kuHhovisi Likamongameli eHhovisi Elikhulu, olumba izincwadi futhi ehlanganisa imibiko.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi Se-Grade 12. I-National Diploma evunyiwe kwi-Public Administration / Business Management / Office Management (NQF Level 6) noma iziqu ezingalinganayo. Unyaka abangama-3 kuya ku-5 kumkhakha we-Public Administration. Ilayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile izoba yinzuzo. Amakhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda i-Public Administration. Ulwazi ngemithetho ehlobene, izinqubomgomo, izinqubo nezimiso ezidingekayo. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo lwe-Financial Administration. Amakhono: Olawulelo; Ukucubungula nokuhlela; Uphatho lwezemali; Ukubhala imibiko; Ukuxhumana nabantu; Ukuxazulula izinkinga; Ulwazi lwekhompyutha; Ukuhlaziya. Ukuqondiswa kukhasimeli. Uphatho lwephrojekthi. Ukuba ngumholi wethimba. Ukucubungula nokuhlela. Uphatho labantu.
zu.duties: Lumba yonke imilelo, iziphakamiso nezinkumbulo. Ulungiselela amadokhumenti axhasayo ohlelweni lwemihlangano, wamukela futhi usabalalise izinto zokubhala kubasebenzi abahlobene. Yamukela futhi uhlanganise imibiko yenyanga zonke. Siza ekuhlanganiseni okufakwayo kwesikole ezimibikweni yonyaka, yenkwarta, yenyanga zonke, nakumashedi okuphela kwemali. Sisa ekumiseni nokuphotheni izimiso ezisebenzayo zokulonda nokuphathwa kwamadokhumenti ehhovisi likamongameli. Hlanganisa zonke izinhlelo zezinsiza zokuhamba nokuze imihlangano njll. Ukucubungula izimangalo zokuhamba kanye nemihlangano njll. Hlela yonke imihlangano, izinqumo nemisebenzi yezakhiwo ezingenhla. Qamba ajenda, amaminithi, imibiko namanye amadokhumenti wezakhiwo ezingenhla. Usabalalisa amadokhumenti ahlobene ohlelweni lwemihlangano lwezakhiwo ezingenhla. Sisa ekugcineni irekhodi lzezinqumo futhi usize bonke abalungu be-Council / Abaphathi / Abasebenzi abahlobene ngokuthi uxhumane nabo njalo ukuze ubakhumbise ngalokho okumele kwenziwe. Ugqoziwe kwamaminithi avunyiwe abasayiniwe futhi agcinwe ngokuphepha. Sisa ekuhlanganiseni inqubo yokucubungula nokuhlela okusebenzayo nokuqhubela phambili. Sisa ekuhlanganiseni nasekubhaleni izinhlela eziqhubela phambili nezisebenzayo. Sisa ekukhombiseni ukuthuthukiswa nokuphothwa kwezinhlela nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa ukulethwa kwenkonzo. Sisa ekuhlanganiseni nasekubhaleni imibiko yentengo yokusebenza komnyango nezimo eziqhubela phambili. Sisa ekuhlola ukusebenza nokusebenza kahle kwesikole ekukhombiseni ukufeza izinjongo zokulethwa kweenkonzo.

xh.title: Umsebenzi oPhakamileyo woMlawuli: iKamva leSikhulu
xh.summary: Umsebenzi oPhakamileyo woMlawuli onika inkxaso yolawulo kwiKamva leSikhulu eNdiweni eNkulu, eubhala iinkxaso nokudibanisa iingxelo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12. I-National Diploma evunyiweyo kuPublic Administration / Business Management / Office Management (NQF Level 6) okanye ngesi/iziqu ezinginguna. I-3-5 years kwindawo yePublic Administration. I-Driver's License esebenzayo iya kuba ngaphezulu kwenye. Ikhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda ngoPublic Administration. Ulwazi ngomthetho osemthethweni, iinkqubo, iimiso namacebo ahambelana nawo. Ulwazi olusetyenzwayo ngoFinancial Administration. Amandla: Oolawulo; Ulungiselelo nokuhlela; UkuLawula koMali; UkuBhala iingxelo; Unxibelelwano nabantu; Ukuxazulula iingxaki; Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Ukuhlola. Uqhelwe ngabathengi. UkuLawula iProjekthi. Ukukhokela iqela. Ulungiselelo nokuhlela. UkuLawula abantu.
xh.duties: Bhala yonke iileta, iingeniselo namagqabantshintshi. Lungisezela amaxwebhu enkxaso kwiindibano, wamkele usasaze izixhobo zokubhala kwabasebenzi abahambelanayo. Wamkele udibanise iingxelo zenyanga zidibana. Nceda ukulungiselela iingeniselo kolunjiwe kwangonyaka, kwethatu, ngenyanga, namaxwebhu okutyhala kwekhadinali. Nceda ekusekweni nakusebenzeni kweendlela ezisebenzayo zokugcina iirekhodi namaxwebhu ofisini leSikhulu. Lungiselela onke amacebo okuhamba nakweendibano nokunye. Uphucula iingxelo ezimali yokuhamba nakweendibano nokunye. Hlela zonke iindibano, iinkqubo nemisebenzi yezakhiwo ezingentla. Qedelela izinhloko, imizuzu, iingxelo namanye amarekhodo ezakhiwo ezingentla. Sasaza amaxwebhu ahambelanayo ngeendibano zezakhiwo ezingentla. Nceda ukugcina irekhodi lezigqibo nokuxhasa bonke abaLungu beNdikithi / BaPhathi / oBasebenzi abahambelanayo ngokunxibelelana rhoqo ukubakhumbuza into efanele ukwenziwa. Ukugcina kwakhuselekileyo imizuzu egunyaziweyo esayinwayo igcinwe ngokhuselekileyo. Nceda ukulungiselela inkqubo yocwangciso lokusebenza nolucwangciso lwenjongo. Nceda ukulungiselela nokubhala izicwangciso zenjongo nolokusebenza. Nceda ukukhuthaza uphuhliso nokusebenza kweenkqubo zokuphucula ukunikezelwa kweenkonzo neengcamango. Nceda ukulungiselela nokubhala iingxelo zokusebenza ngenjongo koluntu. Nceda ukwenza isilinganiselo ngokusebenza nokusebenza kakuhle kolunjiwe ekuxhaseni ukufezekiswa iinjongo zokunikezelwa kweenkonzo.
