af.title: Senior Bursary Officer
af.summary: Senior Bursary Officer om studentebursdatabasisse en -aanvrae by die Department of Higher Education and Training Hoofkantoor te bestuur.
af.requirements: Matric of gelykwaardig plus 'n erkende Nasionale Diploma of Graad in Finansiële Bestuur/Rekenkunde of enige ander relevante kwalifikasie. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie sal 'n voordeel wees. Moet vaardig wees in MS-Excel. 3-5 jaar se relevante werkservaring in burs-/finansiële hulpdienste. Geldige bestuurslisensie sal 'n voordeel wees. Bevoegdhede: Basiese kennis van finansiële funksies, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, 'n rekenaar te bedryf en finansiële statistiek te versamel; Kennis van basiese finansiële bedryfstelsels (Coltech, ens.) Essensiële kennis van finansiële funksies, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, 'n rekenaar te bedryf en finansiële statistiek te versamel. Basiese kennis van die Openbare Diens se finansiële wetgewing, prosedures en Tesourie-regulasies (PFMA, NSFAS-riglyne en Finansiële Bestuurspraktyke). Vaardighede: Beplanning en organisering; Rekenaarvaardighede; Taal; Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasie; Basiese syfervaardighede; Vermoë om roetine-take uit te voer; Vermoë om kantoortoerusting te bedryf; Buigsaamheid; Interpersoonlike verhoudings; Akkuraatheid; Aanleg vir syfers.
af.duties: Onderhou 'n databasis van alle studentaanvrae in ooreenstemming met Department of Higher Education and Training en NSFAS-vereistes. Onderhou 'n databasis van alle studentaanvrae in ooreenstemming met kollegebeursvereistes. Registreer en dien alle aanvrae in en verseker dat alle vereiste inligting by die aanvraag aangeheg is. Monitor beurse en ander toekennings in samewerking met die finansies-portefeulje en kollegeprosedure. Koördineer burs-toekenning. Verseker dat die administrasie van beurse in lyn is met NSFAS-riglyne, funderings-MOU/SLA en beleide. Hersien aanvrae vir finansiële hulp. Analiseer NSFAS-voorlopig gefinansierde studente. Magtig die uitbetaling van fondse. Rapporteer oor alle burs- en finansiële hulptoekenning en vordering. Bestuur van menslike, fisiese en finansiële hulpbronne.

zu.title: Onkamela Ophethe Amabhasari Ezinga Eliphezulu
zu.summary: Onkamela Ophethe Amabhasari Ezinga Eliphezulu ophatha izincazelo-data zemibhalo yamabhasari abafundi kanye nezicelo eHHhovisi Elikhulu Lezomnyango Wezemfundo Ephakeme Nokuqeqeshwa.
zu.requirements: Umatrik noma okulinganayo okuphele kuyisiDiploma Kazwelonke esamukelwe noma iDigri ekuPhathweni Kwezimali/Izimali noma noma iyiphi iziqinisekiso ezihambisana naleyo. Lesibili elivumelekile lokuqhuba kuzoba yinzuza engeziwe. Kufanele ukwazi ukusebenzisa i-MS-Excel. 3-5 iminyaka yamava okusebenza ahambisana namabhasari / izinkonzo zosizo lwemali. Lesibili elivumelekile lokuqhuba kuzoba yinzuza engeziwe. Ikhono: Ukuqwashisisa okuyisisekelo ngemisebenzi yezimali, izindlela kanye nethuba lokufaka idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha futhi uqoqe izibalo zezimali; Ulwazi ngemisistimu yokusebenza ngezimali yisisekelo (Coltech, njll.) Ulwazi olubalulekile ngemisebenzi yezimali, izindlela kanye nethuba lokufaka idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha futhi uqoqe izibalo zezimali. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngemithetho yezimali Yomphakathi, izinqumo kanye Nemithetho Yezigqeba (PFMA, izinqubo ze-NSFAS kanye nezindlela zoKuphathwa Kwezimali). Amakhono: Ukucubungula futhi uhlele; Amakhono ekhompyutha; Ulimi; Ukuxhumana okuhle kokukhulunywa nokubhalwa; Amakhono okubala ayisisekelo; Ithuba lokwenza imisebenzi evamile; Ithuba lokuphatha izinto zehhovisi; Ukuguquguquka; Izinto zokuxhumana nomuntu; Ukuqiniseka; Amakhono amanani.
zu.duties: Gcina incazelo-data yazo zonke izicelo zabafundi ngokwesidingo somnyango Wezemfundo Ephakeme Nokuqeqeshwa kanye nezidingo ze-NSFAS. Gcina incazelo-data yazo zonke izicelo zabafundi ngokwesidingo samabhasari esikoleni. Faka futhi uhlolise zonke izicelo uqiniseke ukuthi yonke imininingwane edingekile inamathiselwe kusicelo. Qapha amabhasari kanye namanye emiklomelo kanye nokuqhathaniswa namaphesenti ezimali ngenqubo yesikole. Hlela ukwabiwa kwamabhasari. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuphathwa kwamabhasari kuhambisana nezinqumo ze-NSFAS, isivumelwano sefunder MOU/SLA kanye namapolisi. Cabangisisa isicelo sosizo lwemali. Hlaziya abafundi abaxhaswe kulesikhathi ngemali yi-NSFAS. Vuma ukukhishwa kwemali. Xinzelela ngayo yonke ukwabiwa kwamabhasari nosizo lwemali kanye nokuqhubekayo. Uphatha abantu, izinto ezingabonakali nezimali.

xh.title: ISikhululusi Esiphathwa kakhulu Sezibonelelo zabafundi
xh.summary: ISikhululusi Esiphathwa kakhulu Sezibonelelo zabafundi siseke iziseko sedatha zabafundi abafuna izibonelelo kwaye silawule izicelo kwindlu enkulu yesebe leMfundo ePhakamileyo nokuQeqesha.
xh.requirements: I-Matric okanye eyequivalente kunye neDiploma yezwelonke evunyiweyo okanye iDegree kwiNkululo yemali/iNzulu-ntlu okULO nayiphi na ngenye ifomaliqela ekufaneleyo. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo iza kuba ngaphezulu kumanzi. Kufuneka abe nobuchule kwi-MS-Excel. I-3-5 yeminyaka yamava ohlwempuzo kumasebe ezibonelelo/inkonzo yoncindo lwezimali. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo iza kuba ngaphezulu kumanzi. Iimfuno zakhono: Ulwazi olusesixekweni ngemisebenzi yemali, iinkqubo kunye nolwazi lokugcina idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqokelela izibalo zemali; Ulwazi olusesixekweni ngemisebenzi yekhompyutha yezimali (i-Coltech, njl.) Ulwazi olubalulekileyo ngemisebenzi yemali, iinkqubo kunye nolwazi lokugcina idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqokelela izibalo zemali. Ulwazi olusesixekweni ngemithetho yemali yesebe likarhulumente, iinkqubo neMimiselo yeGqumo lemali (i-PFMA, iingcebiso ze-NSFAS kunye neenkqubo zoLawulo lweZimali). Ulwazi lokusebenza: uCwangciso lolwangciseko; Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha; Ulwimi; Unxibelelwano olulungileyo oluthethwayo nolubhalwayo; Ulwazi olusesixekweni lwamanani; Ulwazi lokwenza imisebenzi eqhelekileyo; Ulwazi lokusebenzisa izixhobo zendlu; Ukuqhubeka ngokusuka nakuqhubeka; Umanyano nezabantu; Ukuchaneka; Ulwazi ngamanani.
xh.duties: Gcina isiseko sedatha yazo zonke izicelo zabafundi ngokwemfuno yesebe leMfundo ePhakamileyo nokuQeqesha kunye ne-NSFAS. Gcina isiseko sedatha yazo zonke izicelo zabafundi ngokwemfuno yezibonelelo zekholeji. Faka zezenze izicelo zonke ukuqinisekisa ukuba lonke ulwazi olufunekayo luxhotyiwe kusicelo. Qwalasela izibonelelo nezinye izipho zonganyaniswa nobuhlalu bemali ngenkqubo yekholeji. Lungisanisa ulwahlulo lwezibonelelo. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa kwezibonelelo ngokwamagqibo e-NSFAS, isivumelwano sabanikazi bemali/i-MOU/SLA kunye neenkqubo. Phinda uqwalasele izicelo zoncindo lwezimali. Hlola abafundi abaxhaswa okwethutyana yi-NSFAS. Vuma ukwahlulahlula kwemali. Iingxelo ngazo zonke izibonelelo nangohlulo oluncindayo kwaye ukhululeke. Ulawulo lweemali, zabantu nezinto.

jobs.title: ICT Technician
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 – R398 277 per annum (Level 07), plus benefits
jobs.summary: ICT Technician at the Department of Higher Education and Training Head Office requiring a National Diploma in IT and 2-3 years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12/Matric. National Diploma in Information Technology (IT) / Computer Science or equivalent. At least 2-3 years’ experience in IT environment, Software and hardware support (Windows Microsoft). Industry Training. A+, N+, IT Fundamentals ITF+, Server+, Security+, CCNA, Microsoft Certified Professional. Industry certificates or diplomas in routers, switches, access points, telephone systems, security systems, access control systems, and camera systems. ITIL Foundation. Valid driver’s licence. Competencies: Advanced ICT Hardware and Software repairs, maintenance, and networking. Advanced ICT software application installation & configuration. ICT Server Administration. ICT equipment networking, configuration, & maintenance. Data Backup Processes, Software and Equipment. Disaster Management Equipment and Software. Advanced ICT Hardware and Software troubleshooting. Collaboration and Teamwork. User Training and Knowledge Sharing. ICT Inventory Management. Firewalls, routers, switches, and access points. Telephone equipment. Security system equipment. Camera system equipment. Access control equipment. ICT Help Desk Operation and Management Skills: Problem-solving skills and attention to detail; Proficient Communication Skills; Good interpersonal skills and attention to details; Ability to prioritize; Ability to interpret ICT challenges of the stakeholders; Ability to interact with service providers; Effective Time Management.
jobs.duties: Performing complex ICT equipment configuration, installation, repair, and replacement. Performing complex ICT equipment and server maintenance, administration, and network configurations. Troubleshooting complex ICT hardware, software, and network issues. Collaboration with Level 1 technicians to resolve end-user ICT support requests. Share technical knowledge and best practices with Level 1 technicians to foster knowledge- sharing. Working closely with Level 3 technicians to escalate and resolve challenging ICT support requests. Maintaining end-user information to ensure data integrity and data security. Maintaining information management systems such as database to ensure integrity and security of data.
jobs.enquiries: Mr A Mahamba/Ms N Thompson Tel No: (041) 996 1800
jobs.applications: Email Address: icttech26@emcol.co.za
jobs.notes: To Apply: Applications must be submitted on completed latest Z83 form. A detailed comprehensive CV is required. Certified copies of the required documents as per the advert specification will be requested from shortlisted candidates only on or before the day of the interview. Failure to submit completed latest Z83 form and detailed comprehensive CV will result in the application not being considered. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Recommended candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, citizenship, financial record checks, verification of qualification and previous employment verification). Late applications will not be accepted. Applicants who have not been informed about the outcome of their applications within 3 months after the advert closing date may regard their application as being unsuccessful. The employer is an equal opportunity and reserves the right not to appoint. The decision of employment in terms of employment equity will be determined by the employment equity targets of the Department/College. People with disabilities are encouraged to apply. All Applications must be submitted through email addresses per position and ensure that it is 1 attachment.

af.title: IGT Tegnikus
af.summary: IGT Tegnikus by die Department of Higher Education and Training Hoofkantoor wat 'n Nasionale Diploma in IT en 2-3 jaar ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12/Matriek. Nasionale Diploma in Inligtingstegnologie (IT) / Rekenaarwetenskap of gelykwaardig. Ten minste 2-3 jaar ervaring in 'n IT-omgewing, sagteware- en hardewareondersteuning (Windows Microsoft). Bedryfsopleiding. A+, N+, IT Fundamentals ITF+, Server+, Security+, CCNA, Microsoft Certified Professional. Bedryfsertifikate of diploma's in roeteers, skakelaars, toegangspunte, telefoonstelsels, sekuriteitstelsels, toegangskontrollestelsels en kamerasisteme. ITIL Foundation. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Gevorderde IGT-hardeware- en sagtewareherstel, onderhoud en netwerkwerk. Gevorderde IGT-sagtewaretoepassing installasie en konfigurasie. IGT-bedienertoediening. IGT-toerusting netwerkwerk, konfigurasie en onderhoud. Data-rugstepprosesse, sagteware en toerusting. Rampbestuurstoerusting en sagteware. Gevorderde IGT-hardeware- en sagtewarefektoplossing. Samewerking en spanwerk. Gebruikersopleiding en kennisdeling. IGT-voorraadbestuur. Brandmure, roeteers, skakelaars en toegangspunte. Telefoontoerusting. Sekuriteitstelseltoerusting. Kamerasisteemtoerusting. Toegangskontroletoerusting. IGT-opleidingskantoorbedryf en bestuursvaardighede: Probleemoplossingsvaardighede en aandag aan besonderhede; Bevoerde Kommunikasievaardighede; Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede en aandag aan besonderhede; Vermoe om te prioritiseer; Vermoe om IGT-uitdagings van die belanghebbendes te interpreteer; Vermoe om met diensverskaffers in te skakel; Effektiewe tydbestuur.
af.duties: Uitvoer van komplekse IGT-toerustingkonfigurasie, installasie, herstel en vervanging. Uitvoer van komplekse IGT-toerusting- en bedienonderhoud, toediening en netwerkkonfigurasies. Foutoplossing van komplekse IGT-hardeware-, sagteware- en netwerkprobleme. Samewerking met Vlak 1 tegnici om eindgebruiker IGT-ondersteuningsversoeke op te los. Deel tegniese kennis en beste praktyke met Vlak 1 tegnici om kennisdeling te bevorder. Noue samewerking met Vlak 3 tegnici om uitdagende IGT-ondersteuningsversoeke te eskaleer en op te los. Onderhou van eindgebruikerinligting om data-integriteit en datasekuriteit te verseker. Onderhou van inligtingsbestuurstelsels soos databasisse om integriteit en sekuriteit van data te verseker.

zu.title: Ithekhinishi ye-ICT
zu.summary: Ithekhinishi ye-ICT eDepartment of Higher Education and Training Head Office edinga i-National Diploma kwi-IT nokuhlangenwe nakho kweminyaka eyi-2-3.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12/Matric. I-National Diploma ku-Information Technology (IT) / Computer Science noma okulinganayo. Okungenani ukuhlangenwe nakho kweminyaka eyi-2-3 endaweni ye-IT, ukwesekwa kwesoftware ne-hardware (Windows Microsoft). Ukuqeqeshwa emkhakheni. A+, N+, IT Fundamentals ITF+, Server+, Security+, CCNA, Microsoft Certified Professional. Izitifikedi noma izidiploma zemikhakha kuma-router, ama-switch, ama-access point, izistimu zocingo, izistimu zokuvikela, izistimu zokulawula ukungena, nezistimu zekhamera. I-ITIL Foundation. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ikhono: Ukulungisa, ukugcina, nokuxhumana kwenziwa ngeqhwa lekhompyutha le-ICT elithuthukisiwe nokuhlela amasu okusebenza. Ukuhlelwa nokulungiswa kwesoftware yamahlelo we-ICT ethuthukisiwe. Ukuphathwa kwe-ICT Server. Ukuxhumanisa, ukulungiswa, nokugcinwa kwemishini ye-ICT. Inqubo yokulondoloza idatha, isoftware, nemishini. Imishini nesoftware yokuphatha izipho. Ukuxazulula izinkinga ze-ICT Hardware kanye ne-Software ethuthukisiwe. Ukusebenza ndawonye kanye nokubamba iqembu. Ukuqeqesha abasebenzisi nokuwabelana ngolwazi. Ukuphathwa kwe-ICT Inventory. Ama-firewall, ama-router, ama-switch, nama-access point. Imishini yocingo. Imishini yesistimu yokuvikela. Imishini yesistimu yekhamera. Imishini yokulawula ukungena. Amakhono okuqalisa nokuphatha i-ICT Help Desk: Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga nokunaka imininingwane; Amakhono Okuxhumana Aphumelelayo; Amakhono ahle kahle okuhlangana nabantu nokunaka imininingwane; Ikhono lokubeka izinto ezibaluleke kakhulu; Ikhono lokutolika izinselele ze-ICT zabanikazi bendawo; Ikhono lokuxhumana nabahanisi bezinsizakalo; Ukuphatha isikhathi ngempumelelo.
zu.duties: Ukwenza ukulungiswa, ukufaka, ukulungisa, nokushintsha okuyinkimbinkimbi kwemishini ye-ICT. Ukwenza ukugcinwa, ukuphathwa, nokulungiswa kwemenoxwebo ukuyinkimbinkimbi kwemishini ye-ICT ne-server. Ukuxazulula izinkinga ezinkulu ze-ICT hardware, software, kanye nomenoxwebo. Ukusebenza ndawonye nabathekhnishi bezinga 1 ukuze kuxazululwe izicelo zokwesekwa kwe-ICT zabasebenzisi. Ukwabelana ngolwazi lobuchwepheshe nemisebenzi emihle nabathekhnishi bezinga 1 ukuze kukhuthazwe ukuwabelana ngolwazi. Ukusebenza eseduze nabathekhnishi bezinga 3 ukuze kwandiswe kuxazululwe izicelo ezinembula zokwesekwa kwe-ICT. Ukugcina ulwazi lwabasebenzisi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuzinza nokuvikeleka kwedatha. Ukugcina izistimu zokuphathwa kolwazi njengesisekelo sedatha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuzinza nokuvikeleka kwedatha.

xh.title: Icanda lwe-ICT
xh.summary: Isithuba socanda lwe-ICT kwi-Department of Higher Education and Training Head Office esifuna i-National Diploma kwi-IT kunye neminyaka yamava engama-2-3.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 12/Matric. I-National Diploma kwi-Information Technology (IT) / Computer Science okwa okulinganayo nomthetho. Omnye unamava amabalwa afunwayo, owqobo lolawulo lwesoftware noluhlelo lwesoftware nofundo lwe-hardware phantsi kolwabiwo oluninzi. Kwaye ufune owona mnikezela oqinisekisiweyo ngokwelixesha eliyimfuneko ukuba namava okugcina ulwazi kwindawo apho ulwazi lufunwa kona. Unemfuneko yokuqinisekisa isetyenziswa nceda ngokulandela izinto ezimbalwa ngokuqinisekileyo. Nceda ufune ukuba ube namava okusetyenziswa kolawulo iinkcukacha ezingcali kwilixa elifanelekileyo. Ufune kwakhona ukuba ulawule iinkqubo ezikwi-intanethi ngokulawula iinkqubo zolwazi kwindawo yakho. Ukufaneleka: Ilungiselelo nolondolozo lwe-hardware nesoftware ezingcali ze-ICT. Ukuhlela nokumisela izicelo zesoftware ze-ICT ezingaliphandi. Ukulawula kwiseva ye-ICT. Ulwabiwo lwenethiwekhi, ukumisela, nolondolozo lweqela le-ICT. Iinkqubo zokugcina idatha, isoftware noloncedo. Isoftware noloncedo lokulawula iingozi. Ukusombulula iingxaki ze-hardware nesoftware ze-ICT ezingaliphandi. Ukusebenzisana nokubakho komanyano ngenqanaba lesiqinthi. Ukuqeqesha abasebenzisi nokwabelana ngolwazi. Ukulawula izinto ze-ICT. Ama-firewall, ama-router, ama-switch, namachapho ongeno. Iqela lefowuni. Iqela lenkqubo yokhuseleko. Iqela lenkqubo yekhamera. Iqela lokulawula ungeno. Amakhono okuphatha nokulawula i-ICT Help Desk: Amakhono okusombulula iingxaki kunye nokunaka iinkcukacha; Amakhono othetha-nxaxheba obalaseleyo; Amakhono abantu alungileyo kunye nokunaka iinkcukacha; Ulwazi lokubeka izinto ngokwendlela eziphambili; Ulwazi lokutolika iingxaki ze-ICT zababanini-ntsebenziswano; Ulwazi lokusebenzisana nabahanjiswa-nkonzo; Ukulawula ixesha ngokuchanekileyo.
xh.duties: Ukuqhuba ukumiselwa, ukufakwa, ukulungiswa, nokutshintshwa kweqela le-ICT. Ukwenza ukulondoloza, ukulawula, nokumisela inethiwekhi yeqela le-ICT neseva. Ukusombulula iingxaki ze-hardware, software, nethiwekhi ze-ICT. Ukusebenzisana nabaqeqeshi be-Level 1 ukusombulula iimfuno zoccedo lwe-ICT zabasebenzisi. Ukwabelana ngolwazi lobuchule nolwazi olungcono nabaqeqeshi be-Level 1 ukuze kulunyulwe ulwazi. Ukusebenza kufutshane nabaqeqeshi be-Level 3 ukuze kukhuliswe okusombululwe iimfuno zoccedo lwe-ICT ezinzima. Ukulondoloza iinkcukacha zabasebenzisi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuchanekileyo nokhuseleko kwidata. Ukulondoloza iinkqubo zolawulo lolwazi ezinjengesiseko sedata ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuchanekileyo nokhuseleko kwidata.

jobs.title: State Accountant: Management Accountant (PROJECTS)
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 – R398 277 per annum (Level 07), Plus benefits
jobs.summary: State Accountant managing project budgets and costing at the Department of Higher Education and Training Head Office, requiring a diploma or degree and 2-3 years' project management experience.
jobs.requirements: Matric or equivalent plus a recognized National Diploma in Cost management Accounting/ Project Management / Financial Management Degree or equivalent qualification. 2-3 years’ experience in project management environment. Valid Driver’s License will be an added advantage. Competencies: Knowledge and understanding of project management and budgeting. Coordination of meetings. PSET and CET Act. Public Service prescripts and DHET Policies. Industrial operation. Identification of opportunities in the market and Labour Market. Opportunity linkages with industries. Skills: Excellent Communication (oral and written); Networking; Negotiation; Research; Interpersonal; Planning; Organising; Computer; Promotion; Placement.
jobs.duties: Conduct project related costing investigations and compile project budget and cash. Control Project Accounts. Prepare costing tables for project. Provide support in the management project budget and cash flow sheet. Analyze project expenditure against project budget and project milestones. Receive, evaluate and process request for procurement of consumables/goods of projects. Provide support in the management of funding Grant for projects. Monitor the in-time availability of funds as per MOU/SLA. Match data to different ledger accounts and verify account postings. Provide support in the processing of stipends. Reconciliation of project income and expenditure. Monitor and assist in project expenditure, SLA, Income, Invoicing, Reporting, Close-out reports. Human resource planning and management of project team. Identifying potential partners and networks to benefit and support exiting students. Conduct monitoring and evaluation for WILL and WBE. Project time management.
jobs.enquiries: Mr A Mahamba/Ms N Thompson Tel No: (041) 996 1800
jobs.applications: Email Address: fap27@emcol.co.za

af.title: Staatsrekenmeester: Bestuursrekenmeeter (PROJEKTE)
af.summary: Staatsrekenmeester wat projekbegrotings en -kosteberekening by die Departement of Higher Education and Training se hoofkantoor bestuur, met 'n diploma of graad en 2-3 jaar se projekbestuurservaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: Matric of ekwivalent plus 'n erkende Nationale Diploma in Cost management Accounting/ Project Management / Financial Management Degree of ekwivalent kwalifikasie. 2-3 years' ervaring in 'n projekbestuursomgewing. Geldige bestuurslisensie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Bevoegdhede: Kennis en begrip van projekbestuur en begroting. Koördinering van vergaderings. PSET and CET Act. Openbare diens voorskrifte en DHET-beleide. Nywerheidsbedryf. Identifisering van geleenthede in die mark en arbeidsmark. Geleentheidskakeling met nywerhede. Vaardighede: Uitstekende kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik); Nettwerkbou; Onderhandeling; Navorsing; Interpersoonlik; Beplanning; Organisering; Rekenaar; Bevordering; Plasing.
af.duties: Voer projekverwante kosteondersoeke uit en stel projekbegroting en kontant op. Beheer projekrekeninge. Stel kostetabelle vir projekte op. Bied ondersteuning in die bestuursprojekbegroting en kontantvloeiblad. Analiseer projekte besteding teen projekbegroting en projekmylpale. Ontvang, evalueer en prosesseer versoeke vir die verkryging van verbruiksgoedere/goedere van projekte. Bied ondersteuning in die bestuur van befondsingsubsidies vir projekte. Monitor die betydbeskikbaarheid van fondse volgens MOU/SLA. Pas data by verskillende grootboekrekeninge en verifieer rekenkboekings. Bied ondersteuning in die verwerking van toelaes. Herbolaning van projekinkomste en -besteding. Monitor en help met projektebesteding, SLA, inkomste, fakturering, verslagdoening en afsluitingsverslae. Menslike hulpbronbeplanning en bestuur van projekspan. Identifiseer potensiële vennote en netwerke om voordeel te trek en uitgaande studente te ondersteun. Voer monitering en evaluering uit vir WILL and WBE. Projektydbestuur.

zu.title: Isi-Accountant Sezwe: Ukuqashwa Kwemali Komphathi Weprojekthi (AMAPROJEKTHI)
zu.summary: Isi-Accountant Sezwe esiphethe imali yamaphrojekthi nokubiza izindleko eNhlokweni Kohlelo Lomnyango We-Higher Education and Training, esifuna idiploma noma iziqu kanye neminyaka engu-2 kuya ku-3 yohlu lokusebenza ekuphatweni kwamaphrojekthi.
zu.requirements: I-Matric noma okulinganayo kanye ne-National Diploma evunyiwe kwi-Cost management Accounting/Project Management/Degree ye-Financial Management noma iziqu ezilinganayo. Iminyaka engu-2 kuya ku-3 yohlu lokusebenza endaweni yokuphatwa kwamaphrojekthi. I-Driver's License esebenzayo izobe ngenye yezinto ezengeza inzuzo. Amandla: Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuphatwa kwamaphrojekthi nokwenza amabhajethi. Ukuhintsha imihlangano. I-PSET ne-CET Act. Izinqubo Zomsebenzi Womphakathi kanye Namapholisi we-DHET. Ukusebenza kwezimboni. Ukuqonda ithuba emakethe kanye ne-Labour Market. Ukuhlobana kwezithuba nezimboni. Amakhono: Ukuxhumana Okuhle (okubhaliwe nokuksizwa); Ukuxhumana nabantu; Ukuxoxisana; Ukuqeqesha; Okubangenwa; Ukuhlela; Ukuhlela; Ikhompyutha; Ukukhangisa; Ukubeka.
zu.duties: Qeqesha iziphatho ezihlotshaniswa namaphrojekthi futhi uhlele imali yephrojekthi nensimbi. Lawula ama-accounts Amaphrojekthi. Lungelela izinkomba zokubiza zamaphrojekthi. Nikeza inkxaso ekuphathweni kwemali yephrojekthi kanye nephepha lensimbi. Hlaziya izindleko zamaphrojekthi ngokumelana nembhajethi yephrojekthi namageja amaphrojekthi. Thola, hlaziya futhi ucubungula izicelo zokuthenga izimpahla/izinto zamaphrojekthi. Nikeza inkxaso ekuphathweni kwe-Grant yokufaka imali yamaphrojekthi. Bheka ukutholakala kwemali ngokuhamba kwesikhathi njengoba kushiwo kwi-MOU/SLA. Linganisa idatha kuma-ledger accounts ahlukene futhi qinisekisa ukuthunyelwa kwama-accounts. Nikeza inkxaso ekuqeqeshweni kwezimali ezinikwa abafundi. Ukuhintsha kwenani nezindleko zamaphrojekthi. Bheka futhi usize kwezindleko zamaphrojekthi, i-SLA, Inani, Ukuqamba izikweletu, Okubikwayo, Okubalwayo okuseduze. Ukusiza abantu abangaphakathi kanye nokuphatwa kweqembu nephrojekthi. Ukuqonda ongahlobana nabo futhi uxhumanise nabo ukuthi bazokwazi ukusiza abafundi abaphuma. Qeqesha ukuhlola ukuqinisekiswa nokulinganiselwa kwe-WILL kanye ne-WBE. Isikhathi sokuphathwa kwephrojekthi.

xh.title: IsiNtlezi seSizwe: isiNtlezi soLawulo (IZIPROJEKTI)
xh.summary: IsiNtlezi seSizwe esilawuleni amabhajeti nezindleko zeprojekthi kwiNtloko eNkulu kwisebe leMfundo ePhakamileyo nokuQeqesha, kufuneka kubekho idiploma okanye izidanga kunye neminyaka engama-2-3 yamava alo kwilawulo lwaprojekthi.
xh.requirements: I-Matric okanye okulinganayo nexa kukho i-National Diploma evunyiweyo kwi-Cost management Accounting/ Project Management / Financial Management Degree okanye izidanga ezilinganayo. 2-3 years’ experience in project management environment. Ilayisensi yokuQhuba evumelekileyo iyakuba ludlamko olungezweyo. Ikhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda ukulawula iprojekthi nokuqwalasela amabhajeti. Uqwalaselo kwindibano. I-PSET ne-CET Act. Iinkqubo zorhwebo lweziko lolawulo neenqobo zoMgaqo-nkqubo ze-DHET. Ukusebenza kwamashishini. Ukuqaphela ithuba kwimarike nakuLwabiwo lweMisebenzi. Ukudibanisa amathuba namashishini. Amakhono: Indlela entle yokuchazana (ngomlomo nangokubhala); Ukudibanisa nabantu; Ukuxoxisana; Uphononongo; Ukusebenza nabantu; Ukuqamba; Ukuqwalasela; Ikhompyutha; Ukukhuthaza; Ukubeka.
xh.duties: Qhuba uphononongo oluthe kratya lwendleko eziphathelekayo neprojekthi uze uhlole ibhajeti yeprojekthi nemali. Lawula ii-akhawunti zeProject. Lungelelanisa iitafile zendleko yeprojekthi. Nikela inkxaso ekulawuleni ibhajeti yeprojekthi nephepha lokujikeleza kwemali. Chaza ukuchithwa kwemali yeprojekthi ngokumelana nebhajeti yeprojekthi nangokumelana neenjongo ezibalulekileyo zeprojekthi. Yamkela, hlola uze uqhubise izicelo zokuthenga izinto ezidityanisiweyo/impahla yamaprojekthi. Nikela inkxaso ekulawulweni kweGrant yokufunding yamaprojekthi. Qaphela ukufumaneka kwemali ngexesha njengoko kucetywa kwi-MOU/SLA. Qhathanisa idatha nakwii-akhawunti zahluhleneyo zeleda uze uqinisekise ukubhalwa kwe-akhawunti. Nikela inkxaso ekuphathweni kweestipendi. Ukuqwalasela inzuzo nendleko yeprojekthi. Qaphela uncedise kwendleko yeprojekthi, i-SLA, iNzuzo, ukuFaka iinvisi, ukuBika, neengxelo zokuValwa. Ukuqamba kwezabenzi nolawulo loluntu olusebenza kiprojekthi. Ukuqaphela abaqheli abanakho ukubakho nabantu abanokuzuzisa uncedo abafundi abaphuma. Qhuba ukuqaphela nokuqwalasela i-WILL ne-WBE. Ulawulo lwexesha leprojeke.

Basiese kennis en begrip van PFMA, Treasury regulasies en toepaslike SCM voorskrifte. Kennis van vraag en verkryging sal 'n voordeel wees. Kennis van die mandate van die Department of Higher Education. af.duties: Tree op as sekretariaat vir die Bid Evaluation Committee en Bid Adjudication Committee (sluit in om goedkeuring te verkry). Berei tenderadvertensies voor en ontvang voorleggings van uitdrukkings van belangstelling. Ontvang en open biddokumente. Reël en koördineer tenderinligtingsessies en berei teenwoordigheidsregisters voor. Stel 'n databasis van goedgekeurde verskaffers op. Verkry kwotasies van die databasis volgens die drempelwaardes wat deur die National Treasury bepaal is. Verkry kwotasies van geakkrediteerde verskaffers deur middel van die College-databasis. Hersien kwotasies, spesifikasies en alle dokumente wat deur die verskaffer verskaf is om te voldoen aan die voorgeskrewe vereistes. Reël en koördineer inligtingsessies waar nodig. Implementeer verkrygingsbeleid in ooreenstemming met toepaslike voorskrifte en wetgewing. Genereer bestelorders, voorleggings vir goedkeuring en voorlegging van bestelorders aan die relevante partye. Help met die ontvangs van goedere en dienste deur middel van die MIS en voorlegging aan die Finance departement. Help met die voorsiening van 'n doeltreffende Contract Management-diens aan die College. Handhaaf behoorlike verhoudings met verskaffers binne die kode van etiek om levering van goedere/dienste te verseker. Verskaf logistieke en beskikingsdienste. zu.title: Inkantshuzimenti Yemibhalo Nenhlalonhle
zu.summary: Inkantshuzimenti Yemibhalo Nenhlalonhle ehhovisi eliyinhloko le-Department of Higher Education and Training, edinga idiploma noma iziqu kwi-Supply Chain Management namava eminyaka emi-2 kuya kweyi-3 ohlotsheni oluhambisanayo.
zu.requirements: Ibhasikhi noma okulingana nayo kunye ne-National Diploma / Degree ebuyisiwe kwi-Supply Chain Management/ Logistics/Public Management (NQF level 6). Ulwazi lweminyaka eyi-2 - 3 e-Supply Chain Management noma endaweni ehambisanayo. I-License yokuqasha izithuthi ezisebenzayo izoba yinzuzo. Izakhamuzi: Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngezinqubomgomo, izinqubo namasu we-Supply Chain. Ulwazi oluqondakalayo nge-PFMA, izinqubo ze-Treasury nezinhlayiya ze-SCM ezifanele. Ulwazi ngoku funa nokuthola kuzoba yinzuzo. Ulwazi nokuqonda nangohlelo lokubuSakabukhosi lolawula konke imisebenzi kahulumeni. Ulwazi lwezinqubo ngokohlelo lwesikhathi esibekiwe. Ulwazi lwe-Coltech. Ulwazi ngokuyalelwa kwe-Department of Higher Education. Amakhono: Ukucubungula futhi uhlele; Ukubhala imibhalo; Unxfaniso nokuxhumana nalabo buseduze; Ukuguquguquka; Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Iinkonzo zokunakekelwa kwabathengi; Ukusebenza njengeqembu.
zu.duties: Sebenza njengonobhala we-Bid Evaluation Committee ne-Bid Adjudication Committee (okuhlanganisa ukuthola imvume). Siza ekwenzeni imibhalo yeminikelo bese ukuhambisa izinkomba ku-Bid Committee kanye noqoqo kwezemali ngenjongo yebhajethi. Lungiselela ukukhangisa kwemitsho bese wamukela izinketho zentantolo. Thola bese kuvulwa imibhalo yeminikelo. Lungiselela bese uhlela izinkomba ezisetshenziselwa ukuchaza imitsho, bese ulungiselela uhlu lwabathathi-nxaxheba. Hlela idathabhethi yabahlinzeki abagunyaziwe. Thola izikwesono kusuka idathabhethi ngokwamagugu e-threshold abekwe i-National Treasury. Thola izikwesono kubahlinzeki abagunyaziwe ngedathabhethi yase-College. Hlola izikwesono, izinkomba kanye yonke imibhalo ethunyiwe ngumhlinzeki ukuze ihambisane nezidingo ezibekiwe. Lungiselela bese uhlela izinkomba lapho kunesidingo. Yenza izinqubomgomo zokuthenga ngokohlelo oluhambisanayo nezinhlayiya kanye nomthetho. Yenza izinhloko zemigwaqo yokuthenga, izinketho ezibhalwe ukugunyazwa nokuzinikela kwazo ngokohlelo kubantu abahambisanayo. Siza ekutholeni impahla nezinsiza ezahlukene kwi-MIS nokunikelwa kwazo ohhovisi lwezezimali. Phakamisa ngokufeza inkonzo ephumelelayo ye-Contract Management kwi-College. Hlala uqobile eduze naye ohlinzekayo kuleso siphatho semithetho yokuziphatha ukuze isule imisebenzi empahleni futhi nasezinsizini. Khona izinkonzo zemisebenzi yohlelo bese ucasha izinsiza. Siza futhi nokufeza izinkonzo eziphathelene nokuqashwa kwempahla kwi-College.

xh.title: Iofisa Wokuqokelela izixhobo
xh.summary: Iofisa Wokuqokelela izixhobo kwiNtloko eNkulu yeSebe leMfundo ePhakamileyo nokuQeqesha, efuna idiploma okanye isidanga kokuLawula uQoqosho lokunikezela kwaye idinga unyaka wama-2 ukuya kwa-3 woluhlu lolugqibo oluhambelanayo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-10 okanye esilinganayo kunye neDiploma yesiQongo eziqwalaselwayo / Isidanga kokuLawula uQoqosho lokunikezela / iLogistics / uLawulo lukaZwelonke (inqanaba le-NQF 6). Unyaka wama-2 - 3 woluhlu lolugqibo kokulawula uqoqosho lokunikezela okanye endaweni ehambeanayo. Ilayisenesi yokuQhuba esemthethweni iya kuba luncedo ekongezeleleni. Iimfuno zokuqonda: Ulwazi olusisiseko ngemigaqo, iinkqubo namalungiselelo okulawula uqoqosho lokunikezela. Ulwazi olusisiseko nokuqonda i-PFMA, iimigaqo yoNqwindla begodu nokuchazwa okusebenzayo kwi-SCM. Ulwazi ngokuqonda nokufuna iimfuno kuya kuba luncedo ekongezeleleni. Ulwazi nokuqonda inkqubo yomthetho ebalulekileyo elawula iinkonzo ezikaZwelonke. Ulwazi lweenkqubo ngokwendawo yokusebenza. Ulwazi nge-Coltech. Ulwazi ngomthetho wokuqaliswa kweSebe leMfundo ePhakamileyo. Amakhono ekuqonda: Ucwangciso nokuhlela; Ukubhala iingxelo; Unxibelelwano nokuqonda abanye; Ukuguquguquka; Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha; Iinkonzo zokukhathalela abathengi; Ukusebenza njengesigqiza.
xh.duties: Zoba ngumongameli weKomiti yoQoqosho oluLungileyo nokuQokelela izixhobo nokuba ngumongameli weKomiti yoQoqosho oluQondisiweyo (kuquka nokufumana isigunyaziso). Nceda ekubhalweni kweefayile ze-bid kwaye uzenze iinkcazelo kwiKomiti yoQoqosho nasekwindlu yethemba ngenjongo yemali. Lungiselela izikhangiso zee-tender kwaye wamkele iingeniselo ezibonisa ukuvakalelwa. Yamkela kwaye uvule iifayile ze-bid. Cwangcisa kwaye uqondanise iindibano ze-tender kwaye ulungiselela iirejista zobukho. Yila idatabase yabahanjisi abagunyazisiweyo. Funisisa amaxabiso kwidatabase ngokwamaxabiso okumngcipheko oqeqeshwe yiNqothula yeSizwe. Funisisa amaxabiso kubahanjisi abagunyazisiweyo ngedatabase yeKholeji. Yenza isalathiso namaxabiso, iinkcazelo nazo zonke iifayile ezinikiwe yinkampani ukuze zihambisane neemfuno ezichaziweyo. Cwangcisa kwaye uqondanise iindibano xa kuyimfuneko. Zisebenzisa imigaqo yokuthenga ngokweemigaqo nemithetho ehambelanayo. Yenza iiodolo zokuthenga, iingeniselo zokuqinisekiswa kunye noku thunkanisa iiodolo zokuthenga kubaphathi abahambelanayo. Nceda kwamkelwa kweempahla neenkonzo nge-MIS nakuThuselo kwindlu yethemba. Nceda ekunikezeni inkonzo ePhakamileyo yoLawulo loQhagamshelwano kwiKholeji. Zigcine ubudlelwane obulungileyo nabahanjisi ngaphakathi komthetho wokuziphatha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunikwa kweempahla/inkonzo. Nikezela ngenkonzo yokutsalwa kolwandle noku lahla. Nikezela ngenkonzo yolawulo lwempahla kwiKholeji.

af.title: Fasiliteitebeampte
af.summary: Fasiliteitebeampte benodig by die Department of Higher Education and Training Hoofkantoor om instandhoudingsprojekte te koördineer en fisiese hulpbronne van die kollege te bestuur.
af.requirements: Matric of gelykwaardig plus 'n erkende Nasionale Diploma in Fasiliteitebestuur / verwante ingenieurskwalifikasie (NQF6). Geldige bestuurderslisensie. OHS-sertifikaat en projekbestuur sal 'n voordeel wees. 2-5 jaar se ervaring in die bestuur van fisiese fasiliteite en sekuriteitsbestuursomgewing of verwante veld. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van Tesourie- en PFMA-regulasies. Kennis van voertuigonderhoud en diensprosedures. Kennis van gebouinstandhouding. Kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Dienste regeer. Monitering en evaluering. Kennis van die Department of Higher Education se mandaat. Kennis van OHSA en brandkodes. af.duties: Bystand verleen met die opstel van 'n instandhoudingsplan vir alle fisiese hulpbronne van die kollege. Koördineer instandhoudingsprojekte wat deur interne werknemers sowel as kontrakteurs onderneem word. Hou die voorraad van alle geboue en toerusting op datum. Monitor die optimale benutting van fasiliteite, insluitend die verhuur van kollegegeboue en -fasiliteite. Bystand verleen met die identifisering van die behoefte aan nuwe geboue en fasiliteite. Bystand verleen met die implementering van beleid rakende sekuriteits-, gesondheids- en veiligheidsake. Verskaffing van advies en leiding oor die aanstelling van sekuriteitskontrakteurs. Verskaffing van administratiewe dienste oor die aanstelling van sekuriteitskontrakteurs. Verskaf advies en leiding aan die kampusbestuurder rakende sekuriteits- en veiligheidsake. Bystand verleen met die nakoming van gesondheids- en veiligheidsstandaarde. Lewer doeltreffende ondersteuning met die ontwikkeling en implementering van beleid rakende die bestuur van residensies van die kollege. Lewer ondersteuning met die ontwikkeling van 'n residensiebestuurstelsel. Ontwikkel 'n gedragskode vir residensiebewoners. Verskaf advies en leiding aan personeel by residensies. Bystand verleen met die nakoming van dissipline deur alle residensiestudente en residensiepersoneel. Bystand verleen met die opstel van 'n instandhoudingsplan rakende masjinerie, gereedskap en toerusting. Bystand verleen om te verseker dat die instandhoudingsplan ooreenstem met die kollege se beleidsriglyne. Monitor en onderhou die masjinerie, gereedskap en toerusting van die kollege. Maak aanbevelings rakende die aankoop van nuwe masjinerie, gereedskap en toerusting. Stel 'n instandhoudingsplan op rakende geboue en terreine. Hou voorraad van alle geboue en toerusting. Beheer instandhoudingsprojekte wat deur eie personeel sowel as deur kontrakteurs onderneem word. Bestuur van menslike, fisiese en finansiële hulpbronne: Lewer personeelbestuur.

zu.title: Inkantolo Eziphathwayo Ezisemandleni (Facilities Officer)
zu.summary: Kudingeka i-Facilities Officer e-Department of Higher Education and Training Head Office ukulungiselela imiklamo yokugcina nokuphatha okuyizimali zasekolishi.
zu.requirements: I-Matric noma okulinganayo kanye ne-National Diploma ebonwayo ku-Facilities Management / izifundo ezihlobene kwengqondo (NQF6). Ifayela lokushayela elivunyiwe. Isitifikedi se-OHS kanye ne-Project management kuzoba yinzuzo. Ubufakazi beminyaka engu-2-5 ekuphathweni kwesikhungo sokugcina nokuphathwa kwezokuvikela noma endaweni ehortaniswayo. Ifayela lokushayela elivunyiwe. Amakhono: Ulwazi mayelana nenqubo yokuqoqa ulwazi ngezinsiza. Ulwazi mayelana nezinkulumo zentela kanye nenqubo ye-BBBE. Ulwazi ngo-OHSAS 18001 nangolawulo lwemiklamo. Ulwazi ngo-Treasury kanye ne-PFMA Regulations. Ulwazi mayelana nokuqashwa kwezimoto kanye nezinsiza zokukhiqiza. Ulwazi lokulondolozwa kwezakhiwo. Ulwazi kanye nekuqonda inqubo eyisisekelo eyaphatha izinkonzo zikahulumeni. Ukubheka nokuhlola. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Department of Higher Education. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-OHSA namakhodi zomlilo. Amakhono: Ukuhlela nokuqamba; Ukuxhumana (Okuhle okuthintwayo nakubhalwayo); Ulwazi lwekhompyutha; Amakhono okuphatha izingxabano; Izinkonzo zokunakekelwa kwabathengi; Ukubhala imibiko; Amakhono okuphatha abantu ngaphambili; Amakhono okwenza ibhajethi.
zu.duties: Siza ekubhaleni umklamo wokugcina yonke imali yasekolishi. Lungiselela imiklamo yokugcina ezenziwa abasebenzi bangaphakathi nabanempilo yokusebenza. Gcina ulwazi lwazo zonke izinsiza nezinsiza. Hlola ukusetshenziswa okuhle kwezikhungo, okuhlanganisa nentela yezakhiwo nezinsiza zasekolishi. Siza ekuqoqweni izidingo zezakhiwo nezinsiza ezintsha. Siza ekwenzeni ukuhlolwa kwesikhathi okuhlelelwe kwakho konke ukwakhiwa. Nikeza izeluleko nokele abaphathi beholo lokugcina izinsiza zakho. Bhala ikhodi yokuziphatha yabakhulele kwindawo yokuhlala. Yakha futhi usebenzise inqubo yokuphatha izindawo zokuhlala zasekolishi. Siza ekusebenziseni inqubo ngezindaba zokuvikela, impilo nokuphepha. Nikeza izeluleko nokweseka ekukheteni abenza imisebenzi yokuvikela. Nikeza izinkonzo zokuphatha ekukheteni abenza imisebenzi yokuvikela. Nikeza izeluleko abaphathi beholo ngemisebenzi yokuvikela nokuphepha. Siza ekwenzeni okuhle ezindinganweni zempilo nokuphepha. Nikeza inkonzo ebandakanyeka ekwakheni nasekusebenziseni inqubo ngokuphathwa kwezinsiza zasekolishi. Nikeza inkonzo ekwakheni inqubo yokuphatha izindawo zokuhlala. Yakha ikhodi yokuziphatha yabakhulele kwindawo yokuhlala. Nikeza izeluleko nokele abantu abangabakhulele kwindawo yokuhlala. Siza ekulawulweni okuhle kwabafundi nabasebenzi baleziyikhaya zokuhlala. Siza ekubhaleni umklamo wokugcina ngamashini, izinsiza nezinyanga. Siza ekuqinisekiseni ukusebenza komklamo wokugcina ngendlela ehambisana nezinqubo zasekolishi. Hlola futhi ulondoloze amashini, izinsiza nezinyanga zasekolishi. Nikeza izinketho mayelana nokuthenga amashini, izinsiza nezinyanga ezintsha. Hlela umklamo wokugcina ngemali yasekolishi nezinto eziphathwayo. Gcina ulwazi ngazo zonke izakhiwa kanye nezimpahla. Lawula imiklamo yokugcina ezenziwa ngabakini kanye nalawo abenza isivumelwano. Ukuphathwa kwabantu, izinto nemali: Nikeza ukuphathwa kwabasebenzi.

xh.title: Iofisa Yeziseko

Amandla okuQamba: Ukucwangcisa nokuHlela; Ukunxibelelana (Ngokuthetha ngomlomo nokubhala); UkuQwalasela iKhompyutha; Ukulawula Iingxaki; Iinkonzo ezilungiselela abakhomyuthi; Okubhaliweyo ukwazisa; Amandla okuPhatha abakhokele ngokuzenzekelayo; Amandla oBulunga.
xh.duties: Nceda ukuqamba indlela yokulondoloza konke okusesikweni samakhempasi. Lungelanisa amaprojekthi okulondoloza athengwa ngabasebenzi bangaphakathi nabo bakwa-kontrekthi. Gcina uluhlu lwazo zonke izakhiwo nemibhobho. Qwalasela ukusetyenziswa ngokugqithisileyo kweziseko, kuquka nokuqashwa kwezakhiwo neziseko zeKholeji. Nceda ukumisela imfuneko yezakhiwo neziseko ezintsha. Nceda ukwenza iQwalaselo lokujonga izakhiwo ngeshedi eqhelekileyo. Nikeza izigqibo nokuqondisa kumaneja wekhasimphuse ekulondolozweni kwezakhiwo. Bhala ikhowudi yokuziphatha kubahlali bezakhiwo. Phepha kuphathwa iNkqubo yokusebenza kwezakhiwo ngokuchanekileyo ekholejini. Nceda kwiNkqubo yokuSebenza ngokuchanekileyo kwezokhuseleko, impilo nokhuseleko. Nikela izigqibo nokuqondisa ekumiseleni abakwa-khontrekthi bokhuseleko. Nikela iinkonzo zolawulo ekumiseleni abakwa-khontrekthi bokhuseleko. Nikeza izigqibo nokuqondisa kumaneja wekhasimphuse ngemiba yokhuseleko nokhuseleko. Nceda ngokuvumelana nezinga lempilo nokhuseleko. Nikeza inkxaso ngokusebenza ekuthethweni nokusebenza kwenkqubo yokuphathwa kwezakhiwo zekholeji. Nikela inkxaso ekuthethweni nasekuphathweni kwenkqubo yezakhiwo. Phepha ikhowudi yokuziphatha yabahlali bezakhiwo. Nikeza izigqibo nokuqondisa abasebenzi kuzakhiwo. Nceda ekuvumelaneni nokuqwalasela ngokuziphatha koMfundi nabasebenzi bohlali. Nceda ekuqoqweni kwenkqubo yokulondoloza ngokugqithisileyo ngeshedi, amathuluzi nangemiba ekholejini. Nceda ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza kwenkqubo yolondolozo ngokulandela iNkqubo yekholeji. Qwalasela uphathwe olondolozo lweMfundi, amathuluzi nangemiba yekholeji. Yenza izigqibo ngokuthenga iMfundi, amathuluzi nangemiba. Phepha inkqubo yokulondoloza ngokugqithisileyo izakhiwo nendawo. Gcina uluhlu lwazo zonke izakhiwo nangemiba. Lawula amaprojekthi okulondoloza ezenziwa ngabasebenzi nangabakwa-khontrekthi. Ukuphathwa koluntu, iziseko nemitahlezo: Nikela nokuLawula abasebenzi.

jobs.title: Sheq Officer
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 – R398 277 per annum (Level 07), Plus benefits
jobs.summary: Coordinate and monitor SHERQ compliance programmes, OHS committees and training at the Department of Higher Education and Training Head Office.
jobs.requirements: Matric or equivalent plus a recognized three (3) year National Diploma (NQF 6) in Building Management/Safety. Management/ Construction Management or related qualification. 2-3 years in Facilities Management, SHERQ and OHS environment. Fire marshal and a First aid certificate will and added advantage. Must also be in possession of a valid Driver’s License. Competencies: Knowledge of Public Service Act and Regulations, Occupational Health and Safety Act, immovable. Asset Management Act, Telephone Management system, fire control system and facilities management system. Knowledge of Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993 and related Regulations. Knowledge of COIDA. Knowledge of incident reporting processes and procedures. Skills: Operating of fire extinguisher; Marketing research skills; Internet usage skills; Planning and organizing; Financial management; Report writing; Communication and interpersonal; Problem solving; Computer literacy; Analytical; Client oriented; Project management; Team leadership; Planning and organizing; People management.
jobs.duties: Provide assistance in the coordination, implementation and monitoring of compliance on SHERQ programmes. Coordinate the establishment of OHS committee. Coordinate OHS-related training and continuous educational programmes. Participate in identification of hazards and risks at the workplace and assist in initiating appropriate actions. Implement and monitor SHERQ management system
jobs.enquiries: Mr A Mahamba/Ms N Thompson Tel No: (041) 996 1800
jobs.applications: Email Address: sheq30@emcol.co.za

af.title: Sheq-beampte
af.summary: Koördineer en monitor SHERQ-nakomingsprogramme, OHS-komitees en opleiding by die Departement of Higher Education and Training Hoofkantoor.
af.requirements: Matric of gelykwaardig plus 'n erkende drie (3) jaar Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) in Building Management/Safety. Management/ Construction Management of verwante kwalifikasie. 2-3 jaar in Facilities Management, SHERQ en OHS-omgewing. Fire marshal- en 'n First aid-sertifikaat sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Moet ook in besit wees van 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van Public Service Act and Regulations, Occupational Health and Safety Act, immovable. Asset Management Act, Telephone Management system, fire control system en facilities management system. Kennis van Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993 en verwante Regulasies. Kennis van COIDA. Kennis van voorvalverslaggewingsprosesse en -prosedures. Vaardighede: Randbediening van brandblusser; Bemarkingsnavorsingsvaardighede; Internetgebruiksvaardighede; Beplanning en organisering; Finansiële bestuur; Verslagskrywing; Kommunikasie en interpersoonlik; Probleemoplossing; Rekenvaardigheid; Analities; Kliëntgerig; Projekbestuur; Spanleierskap; Beplanning en organisering; Personeelsbestuur.
af.duties: Verskaf bystand by die koördinering, implementering en monitering van nakoming van SHERQ-programme. Koördineer die totstandstelling van OHS-komitee. Koördineer OHS-verwante opleiding en deurlopende opvoedkundige programme. Neem deel aan die identifisering van gevaare en risiko's by die werkplek en help met die inisiëring van toepaslike aksies. Implementeer en monitor SHERQ-bestuurstelsel.

zu.title: Isiphathi se-Sheq
zu.summary: Kuhlele futhi kulawurwe izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuzinza kwe-SHERQ, amakomidi e-OHS nokulolonga eNhlokodolobha yase-Department of Higher Education and Training.
zu.requirements: I-Matric noma okulingana kanye ne-National Diploma (NQF 6) eminyakeni emithathu (3) evunyiwe ekuphathweni kwezakhiwo/Ezokuphepha. Ekuphathweni noma ekuphathweni kwezokwakha noma iziqu ezihlobene nalokho. 2-3 iminyaka kokuphathwa kwezinhlangano, kwe-SHERQ nasezindaweni ze-OHS. Isitifiketi somlindi mlilo kanye nesitifiketi sosizo lokuqala kuzoba yinzuzo engeziwe. Kufanele futhi abe ne-Driver's License evunyiwe. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngo-Public Service Act nezimiso zayo, Occupational Health and Safety Act, umthetho wokuphathwa kwezimpahla ezingahambahambi, isistimu yokuphathwa kocingo, isistimu yolawulo lomlilo kanye nesistimu yokuphathwa kwezinhlangano. Ulwazi ngo-Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 ka-1993 nezimiso ezihlobene nalowo. Ulwazi ngo-COIDA. Ulwazi ngeminyakazo nezinqubo zokubika izehlakalo. Amakhono: Ukusebenza nomsizi womlilo; Amakhono okucwaninga emakethe; Amakhono okusebenzisa i-intanethi; Ukuhlela nokuhlela; Ukuphathwa kwezimali; Ukubhala imibiko; Ukuxhumana nabantu; Ukuxazulula izinkinga; Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha; Ukuhlaziya; Ukuqondiswa kumthengi; Ukuphathwa amaprojekthi; Ukuba ngumholi wetimu; Ukuhlela nokuquumba; Ukuphatha abantu.
zu.duties: Nikeza usizo ekuhleleni, ekusebenziseni nasekulawuleni ukuzinza kwezinhlelo ze-SHERQ. Hlela ukusungulwa komkhandlu we-OHS. Hlela ukulolonga okuhlobene ne-OHS kanye nezinhlelo zokufunda ezingapheli. Thatha inxaxhe ekuqapheleni ingozi namathuba ezindaweni zokusebenza futhi usize ekuqaliseni izinyathelo ezifanele. Sebenzisa futhi ulawule isistimu yokuphathwa kwe-SHERQ.

xh.title: Iofisa ye-Sheq
xh.summary: Qamba kwaye ulawule iinkqubo zokuzithoba kwi-SHERQ, iikomiti ze-OHS nololwe kwiNtloko eNkulu yeSebe leMfundo ePhakamileyo nokuQeqesha.
xh.requirements: I-Matric okanye ezingqamanayo kunye ne-Diploma yaseMzantsi Afrika (NQF 6) eminyaka mithathu (3) evunyelweyo kwinguqulelo yoLawulo lweZakhiwo/loKhuseleko. uLawulo/ uLawulo lokuVakalwa okanye izifundo ezinxulumene nalo. Iiminyaka ezi-2-3 kwindawo yoLawulo lweZiseko, i-SHERQ nendawo ye-OHS. Iqesha lomlilo nesatifikethda sokuphathwa kokuqala siza kuba ngumngeni ongazange abe khona. Kufunekuye ukuba nabure womqhubi osebenzayo. Ikhono: ulwazi ngomthetho weSebe loRhalomshini namagunya, umthetho wezobuKhuseleko loNyuso lweMisebenzi kunye namagunya, umthetho olungelehli. umthetho woLawulo lwama-Asebho, inkqubo yoLawulo lweFowuni, inkqubo yolawulo lomlilo nendawo yolawulo lweziseko. Ulwazi ngomthetho wezobuKhuseleko loNyuso lweMisebenzi u-85 ka-1993 namagunya anxulumene nawo. Ulwazi nge-COIDA. Ulwazi ngenkqubo nendlela yokuchaza iziganeko. Ikhono: ukusebenzisa isixhobo sokucima umlilo; amakhono okuphanda kwintengiso; amakhono okusebenzisa i-intanethi; ukuceba nokuhlanganisa; ukulawula imali; ukubhala iingxelo; ukunxibelelana nokunxibelelana nabantu; ukuxazulula iingxaki; ulwazi lwekhompyutha; ukwahlula-hlula; ukuqondiswa komxhasi; ukulawula iprojekthi; ukukhokela iqela; ukuceba nokuhlanganisa; ukulawula abantu.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso ekuzameni, ekusebenziseni nasekuqwalaselweni kokuzithoba kwinzameko kweenkqubo ze-SHERQ. Qamba ekuqwalaselweni lwekomiti ye-OHS. Qamba ukufundiswa okuqhagamshelwe kwi-OHS nokuqhubeka neenkqubo zemfundo. Thatha inxaxheba ekuchazeni iingozi namathuba ezINGOZI endaweni yomsebenzi uncedise ekuqaliseni izenzo ezifanelekileyo. Sebenzisa ulawule inkqubo yolawulo ye-SHERQ.

jobs.title: Human Resources Clerk
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.salary_text: R237 453 – R279 708 per annum (Level 05), Plus benefits
jobs.summary: Capture pension, housing and long service benefits and maintain staff files at the Department of Higher Education and Training Head Office, requiring Grade 12 and PERSAL knowledge.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 Certificate. Appropriate National Diploma (NQF 6) in Human Resource Management, Public Management, Labour Relations, or equivalent qualification will be an added advantage. Driver’s License will be an added advantage. 1-2 years’ experience in Human Resource Management. Competencies: Knowledge of HRM processes and practices; Knowledge of PERSAL; Personnel Administration Standards and CORE; Public Service Regulations and PFMA; Public Service Act; POPI Act; Knowledge of Recruitment, Training and PMDS procedures and processes; Knowledge of Labour Relations Act and understanding of bargaining process and dispute resolutions; Basic knowledge of Health and Wellness policies, processes and systems; Knowledge and understanding of the TVET Administration; Knowledge and understanding of the Higher Education sector. Skills: Human Resource Administration and Development; Investigations and negotiations; Administrative; Planning and organizing; Financial management; Report writing; Communication and interpersonal; Problem solving; Computer literacy; Analytical; Client oriented; People management; Presentation skills.
jobs.duties: Capture Pension, Housing Allowance and Long Service benefits etc. in accordance with the Regulator’s Conditions of Service Policy; Capture all signed contract of employment forms on salary levels 2 to 8 on a database. Assist in processing employee leave and maintaining staff files (employment contracts, details, leave forms etc.); Receive and process all termination paperwork and terminate employees as and when required; Assist with enquiries relating to the Pension Fund and Medical Aid. File and safe keep Human Resource Records in line with the Records Management Systems. Source and consolidate records required for auditing purposes. Render support in the provision of recruitment and selection services; Capture applications, handle responses and short-listing processes. Provide logistical and secretariat support during shortlisting/ interviews (arrangements of interviews such as dates, venues, and invitations to candidates). Compile appointment letters and receive assumption of duty letters from the appointable candidate. Conduct reference check for successful candidates. Provide administrative support on Labour Relations matters in the College. Gather evidence to assist with the investigation of grievances, disputes, misconduct etc. Capture grievances, disputes, misconduct cases on PERSAL. Provide assistance in the implementation of collective bargaining council resolutions. Provide logistical and secretariat services during bilateral and multilateral meetings, disciplinary hearings etc. Assist in the distribution and filing of attendance register for each strike day. Assist in the implementation of Performance Management Development System, Integrated Quality Management System and coordinate training for college staff. Render administrative support in the implement of PMDS and IQMS for College staff. Provide assistance with the completion of PMDS and IQMS documents. Collate and capture Half Yearly and Annual PMDS and IQMS Assessments for College staff. Capture PMDS and IQMS scores on PERSAL and update the database. Coordinate the delivery of external and in-house training as and when requested. Render logistical support in the arrangement of external and internal trainings. Assist in the recruitment and selection of interns and learners. Receive and capture bursary application. Capture and maintain databases for all PMDS, IQMS and Training matters. Assist with the provision of Employee Health and Wellness services in the College. Coordinate Employee Health and Wellness events for the College (Wellness days, Sports Tournaments etc.). Coordinate and communicate bereavement about College staff and their spouses and families.
jobs.enquiries: Mr A Mahamba/Ms N Thompson Tel No: (041) 996 1800
jobs.applications: Email Address: hrc31@emcol.co.za

af.title: Personeelklerk
af.summary: Voer pensioen-, behuising- en langdienstevoordele in en onderhou personeellêers by die Departement of Higher Education and Training Hoofkantoor, wat Graad 12 en PERSAL-kennis vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat. Toepaslike Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur, Publieke Bestuur, Arbeidsverhoudinge, of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Bestuurslisensie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 1-2 jaar se ervaring in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van HRM-prosesse en -praktyke; Kennis van PERSAL; Personeeladministrasiestandaarde en CORE; Openbare Diensregulasies en PFMA; Openbare Dienswet; POPI-wet; Kennis van Werwing-, Opleidings- en PMDS-prosedures en -prosesse; Kennis van Arbeidsverhoudingewet en begrip van bedingingsproses en geskilbeslegting; Basiese kennis van Gesondheids- en Welstandsbeleid, -prosesse en -stelsels; Kennis en begrip van die TVET-administrasie; Kennis en begrip van die Hoër Onderwyssektor. Vaardighede: Menslike hulpbronadministrasie en -ontwikkeling; Ondersoeke en onderhandelings; Administratiewe; Beplanning en organisering; Finansiële bestuur; Verslagskrywing; Kommunikasie en interpersoonlik; Probleemoplossing; Rekenaarvaardigheid; Analities; Kliëntgerig; Mensbestuur; Voorleggingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Voer Pensioen-, Behuisings-toelae en Langdienstevoordele ens. in ooreenkomstig die Reguleerder se Diensvoorwaardesbeleid; Voer alle getekende dienskontrakvorms op salarisvlakke 2 tot 8 op 'n databasis in. Help met die verwerking van werknemerverlof en die onderhou van personeellêers (dienskontrakte, besonderhede, verlofvorms ens.); Ontvang en verwerk alle beëindigingsdokumentasie en beëindig werknemers soos en wanneer vereis; Help met navrae rakende die Pensioenfonds en Mediese Hulp. Liasseer en bewaar Menslike Hulpbronrekords in ooreenstemming met die Rekordbestuurstelsels. Versamel en konsolideer rekords wat vir ouditsdoeleindes benodig word. Lewer ondersteuning in die voorsiening van werwing- en keuringsdienste; Voer aansoeke in, hanteer terugvoer en kortlyssprosesse. Verskaf logistieke en sekretariële ondersteuning tydens kortlysting/onderhoude (reëlings van onderhoude soos datums, plekke en uitnodigings aan kandidate). Stel aanstellingsbriewe op en ontvang diensaannembriewe van die aanstelbare kandidaat. Doen verwysingkontrole vir suksesvolle kandidate. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning oor Arbeidsverhoudingsake in die Kollege. Versamel getuienis om te help met die ondersoek van griewe, geskille, wangedrag ens. Voer griewe, geskille, wangedraggevalle op PERSAL in. Verskaf hulp met die implementering van kollektiewe bedingingsraadsbesluite. Verskaf logistieke en sekretariële dienste tydens bilaterale en multilaterale vergaderings, disiplinêre verhore ens. Help met die verspreiding en liassering van bywoningsregisters vir elke stakingsdag. Help met die implementering van Prestasiebestuurstelsel (PMDS), Geïntegreerde Kwaliteitsbestuurstelsel (IQMS) en koördineer opleiding vir kollegepersoneel. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning met die implementering van PMDS en IQMS vir Kollegepersoneel. Verskaf hulp met die voltooiing van PMDS- en IQMS-dokumente. Versamel en voer Halfjaarlikse en Jaarlikse PMDS- en IQMS-assesserings vir Kollegepersoneel in. Voer PMDS- en IQMS-tellings op PERSAL in en werk die databasis by. Koördineer die lewer van eksterne en interne opleiding soos en wanneer versoek. Verskaf logistieke ondersteuning met die reëling van eksterne en interne opleiding. Help met die werwing en keuring van internes en leerders. Ontvang en voer beursaansoeke in. Voer en onderhou databasisse vir alle PMDS-, IQMS- en Opleidingsake. Help met die voorsiening van Werknemer Gesondheids- en Welstandsdienste in die Kollege. Koördineer Werknemer Gesondheids- en Welstandsgeleenthede vir die Kollege (Welstandsdae, Sporttoernooie ens.). Koördineer en kommunikeer rouberigte oor Kollegepersoneel en hul eggenotes en gesinne.

zu.title: Umkleli Wabasebenzi
zu.summary: Bhalisa izinzuzo zomhlalaphansi, zokuhola indlu nezokukhonza isikhathi eside, futhi ugcine amafayela abasebenzi eNyuvesi yase-Department of Higher Education and Training Head Office, okudinga ibanga le-Grade 12 nolwazi lwe-PERSAL.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12. Isidiploma Esifanele (NQF 6) ku-Human Resource Management, Public Management, Labour Relations, noma isiqu esilinganayo sizobe yinzuzo. Ilayisensi yokushayela izobe yinzuzo. Izinkathi eziyi-1-2 zokuhlolwa ku-Human Resource Management. Ikhono: Ulwazi lweminqubo nezinqubo ze-HRM; Ulwazi lwe-PERSAL; Izilinganiso zokuphathwa kwabasebenzi ne-CORE; Imithetho yesevisi yokomphakathi ne-PFMA; Umthetho wesevisi yokomphakathi; Umthetho we-POPI; Ulwazi lweenqubo nezinqubo zokuqasha, ukuqeqesha ne-PMDS; Ulwazi lomthetho we-Labour Relations nokuqonda inqubo yokuxhumana nezixazululo zezingxabano; Ulwazi oluyisisekelo lwezinqubomgomo, izinqobo nezimiso zezempilo ne-Wellness; Ulwazi nokuqonda i-TVET Administration; Ulwazi nokuqonda umkhakha we-Higher Education. Amandla: Ukuphathwa kanye nentuthuko kwabasebenzi; Uphenyo nezinkulumompikiswano; Okuphathwayo; Ukuhlela nokuhlela; Ukuphatha imali; Ukubhala imibiko; Unxibelelwano nabantu; Ukuxazulula izinkinga; Ulwazi lwekhompyutha; Ukuhlaziya; Ukuqondiswa kukhasimeli; Ukuphatha abantu; Amakhono abakhombo.
zu.duties: Bhalisa izinzuzo zomhlalaphansi, zokuhola indlu nezokukhonza isikhathi eside njll. ngokuvumelana nesenqubomgomo sezimo zesevisi ye-Regulator. Bhalisa yonke imivume yokusebenza esayinwe kumazinga eholo ama-2 kuye ku-8 esizindalwazini. Siza ekucubunguleni ukushiya kwabasebenzi nokugcina amafayela abasebenzi (izivume zokusebenza, imininingwane, amafomu okushiya njll.); Thola futhi ucubungule yonke imibhalo yokuqedwa isivumelwano se-projects. Thola imibuzo ngezenzo zamaprojekthi futhi usize ekubuyiseleni isimo esiqondile. Thola imibuzo ehlobene ne-Pension Fund ne-Medical Aid. Yisa kufayela futhi zigcine ngokuphepha izimoto zamafayela zamaprojekthi ngokuvumelana nokuqoqwa kwamafayela. Hlola ubuncane bezinsiza ezidingekayo mayelana nokuphathwa kwamafayela. Thola izinsiza ezidingekayo ezihlotshaniswa nokulandelwa kwezinsizakalo ezibhalwe phansi. Hlola ubuncane bamafayela asemthethweni ongakaphephulwa. Hlola ubuncane bamafayela okuyingxenye yemisindo yaleli thimba.

xh.title: Iklekhi yezemisebenzi yabantu
xh.summary: Ukuyalela iindlela zomvuzo wokuphila okukhulileyo, izibonelelo zendlu nezinzuzo zokukhonza ixesha elide nokugcina iifayile zomsebenzi kwiNkomfa eNkulu yoSebe leMfundo ePhakamileyo nokuQeqesha, kufunekane ibakala lesi-12 nolwazi ngePERSAL.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seQela lesi-12. Isidanga esifanelekileyo seQonga lesiNqanaba leMfundo seSizwe (NQF 6) ekulawulweni kwemisebenzi yabantu, ekulawulweni koluntu, kwimibanjano yabasebenzi, okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo siza kuba ngaphezulu kakhulu. Ilayisensi yokushayela iza kuba ngaphezulu kakhulu. Ukuba ngumsebenzi oneminyaka 1-2 yamava ekulawulweni kwemisebenzi yabantu. Iimpawu zokwaziswa: Ulwazi ngezenzo nendlela ezisetyenziswayo kwimisebenzi yabantu; Ulwazi ngePERSAL; Izingqwalasela zolawulo lwabantu kunye ne-CORE; Iimigaqo yoLuntu lwaseKhalala kunye ne-PFMA; uMthetho woLuntu lwaseKhalala; uMthetho we-POPI; Ulwazi ngezenzo nendlela ezisetyenziswayo ekubeni nabasebenzi, ekuyiqeqeshweni nakuqwalaselo lwenkqubo yokuphucula ukusebenza kunye neendlela zayo; Ulwazi ngoMthetho weMibanjano yabaSebenzi nokuqonda inkcitsho yexesha lokuthengiselana nendlela zokuxazulula iingxabano; Ulwazi olusisiseko ngeengqiqo, iinkqubo nendlela zezempilo nempilo ezilungileyo; Ulwazi nokuqonda uLawulo lwe-TVET; Ulwazi nokuqonda candelo leMfundo ePhakamileyo. Amapacity: Ukulawula nokuPhepha ubomi babantu; Iingxoxo nokuqwalasela iindaba; Ekulawulweni kwexesha ekujameni; Isicoco; Imisebenzi yabasebenzi ekujameni; Imisebenzi ngenkqubo; Ukubhala iingxelo; Ukuxhumanisa nabantu; Ukuxazulula iingxaki; Isikolo sabantu; Ukulinganisa; Ukuba nako ukuba nayo imfuneko yokuba ngumntu ogxile ekwazisweni; Ukulawula abantu; Amapacity abalawuli.
xh.duties: Ukuqamba ngokuhambelana neNgqiqo yeNgqiqo zomntu oLawulayo, isabelo sendlu nenzuzo zokukhonza ixesha elide njl. ngokuvumelana neNgqiqo yeSiseko seNkonzo yeSikhululeko; Ukuqamba zonke iifomu zeqingqiselwa legqiza elisayinwe kwizihloko zomvuzo ze-2 ukuya kwi-8 kwisiseko sedatha. Uncede ekubeni ikhompyutha iinkonzo zabasebenzi nagciniweyo iifayili zabasebenzi (iingqwalasela zokusebenza, iinkcukacha, iifomu zokuhlala ixesha elingekho kwizikhundla njl.); Ukuthatha nokuba ikhompyutha yonke imibhalo yokuphela kobomi bokusebenza nokuphelisa abasebenzi njengoko kuyimfuneko; Unceda iingxoxo ezidibanisayo ngeNkonzo yokuPhila nokuphuza iinkonzo ezizeNgayo kumthetho. Ugcina iingxelo zemisebenzi yabantu ngokuhambelana neNkqubo yoLawulo loQwalaselo. Ukufumana nokudibanisa iingxelo ezifunekelayo njengoko kuthethwa yiNkqubo yoQwalaselo. Ukunika inkxaso ekunikezeni iinkonzo zokufumanisa abasebenzi bakhethwa nokuqwalasela; Ukuyalela iingxelo zokuqesha, ukupatha iingxoxo nokuqwalasela inkqubo yokubeka abantu kuluhlu. Ukunika inkxaso ngokumiselwa kweenkxwxabo nangokuba ngumabhala weNkomfa ngelixa kwenzeka ukuqwalasela iingxelo okanye iintithuba zokuthetha nabantu (izinto ezifana namhla, iziko, nokuMema abantu). Ukuqamba iingxelo ezisetwe ngaphandle nangaphakathi iindlela zokugcina iindatshu zomsebenzi. Ukuqhuba iingxoxo ezilungele ukuyalela iingxelo ezilungileyo zokumiselwa kokusebenza komsebenzi ekwinkqubo yokuYalela ngokweNkqubo ePERSAL nangokuqinisekisa ukuba inkqubo isebenziseka kwaye iya kufumaniseka kwindawo yokuyilela. Ukucutha izixhobo nokuqinisekisa ukuba ngokumiselwa kwamandla eNkonzo eNgqiqweni yokuNika amalungu ayo ukwazi ukuze kugqitywe iingxelo ezilungele ukuMisela abantu. Ukunika iinkqubo zokuLawula nokuQwalasela inkqubo yokuMisela nokuLawula inkqubo ngokwamandla abonelelweyo ngokusebenza kwamandla abonelelweyo nangokuza kubakho kwindawo yokuLawula inkqubo yokuMisela inkqubo yokuQwalasela inkqubo yokuPhepha nokuPhepha iMisebenzi yabaSebenzi, iNkqubo yoQwalaselo lweNtengiso nokuQwalasela inkqubo yokuPhepha iMisebenzi yabaSebenzi, iNkqubo yoQwalaselo lweNtengiso nokuPhepha iMisebenzi yabaSebenzi.

jobs.title: Human Resources Clerk (EMPLOYEE Health and Wellness)
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.salary_text: R237 453 – R279 708 per annum (Level 05), Plus benefits
jobs.summary: Human Resources Clerk sought for Employee Health and Wellness at Head Office, requiring Grade 12 and HR experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 Certificate. Appropriate National Diploma (NQF 6) in Human Resource Management, Public Management, Labour Relations, or equivalent qualification will be an added advantage. Driver’s License will be an added advantage. 1-2 years’ experience in Human Resource Management. Competencies: Knowledge of HRM processes and practices; Knowledge of PERSAL; Personnel Administration Standards and CORE; Public Service Regulations and PFMA; Public Service Act; POPI Act; Knowledge of Recruitment, Training and PMDS procedures and processes; Knowledge of Labour Relations Act and understanding of bargaining process and dispute resolutions; Basic knowledge of Health and Wellness policies, processes and systems; Knowledge and understanding of the TVET Administration; Knowledge and understanding of the Higher Education sector. Skills: Human Resource Administration and Development; Investigations and negotiations; Administrative; Planning and organizing; Financial management; Report writing; Communication and interpersonal; Problem solving; Computer literacy; Analytical; Client oriented; People management; Presentation skills. DUITES : Assist with the provision of Employee Health and Wellness services in the College. Coordinate Employee Health and Wellness events for the College (Wellness days, Sports Tournaments etc.). Coordinate and communicate bereavement about College staff and their spouses and families. Provide administrative support services; Create a database of clients with respect to contact information, line of business and other information. Attend to general correspondence and prepare document packs for meetings. Ensure correct classification of documents and safekeeping of documents. Advice on compliance with procurement policy and coordinate all the administrative work and related functions. Keep a message system updated / forward information and take minutes. Organize meetings, strategic / business planning sessions, etc. Make appointments and keep diary updated (inform the Wellness Officer of appointments, ensure no overlaps occur, reschedule appointments when necessary). Organise travel arrangements (accommodation, car, etc.) and handle claims, petty cash etc. Keep circulars and relevant policies updated (HR policies, Finance policies and supply chain policies etc). Provide project support services in the Employee Health and Wellness Office; Keep a database of all projects. Assist with co-ordination of project reports. Coordinate inputs and prepare presentations for meetings. Assist the office to compile presentations. Render any other technical assistance required at project meetings. Provide secretariat support at meetings. Manage the flow of information and documents in the Labour Relations office. Perform document tracking for all correspondence and memorandums. Acknowledge receipt, apply file number allocation, record data into computer system, and file appropriately. Draft memos as and when instructed. Ensure distribution of documents to other functionaries. Ensure safe keeping of all documentation in the office in line with the relevant policies. Ensure / coordinate fast and efficient handling of other documentation, meeting of deadlines for documents (determine priority and follow up). File manually and electronically. Render assistance to other units. Provide support in the procurement of Employee Health and Wellness office needs.
jobs.enquiries: Mr A Mahamba/Ms N Thompson Tel No: (041) 996 1800
jobs.applications: Email Address: hrc33@emcol.co.za

af.title: Human Resources Klerk (WERKNEMER Gesondheid en Welstand)
af.summary: Human Resources Klerk gesoek vir Werknemer Gesondheid en Welstand by Hoofkantoor, vereis Graad 12 en HR-ervaring.
af.requirements: Graad 12 Sertifikaat. Toepaslike Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur, Publieke Bestuur, Arbeidsverhoudinge, of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie sal 'n byvoeglike voordeel wees. Bestuurderslisensie sal 'n byvoeglike voordeel wees. 1-2 jaar se ervaring in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van HRM-prosesse en -praktyke; Kennis van PERSAL; Personeeladministrasie-standaarde en CORE; Openbare Diensregulasies en PFMA; Openbare Dienswet; POPI-wet; Kennis van Werwings-, Opleidings- en PMDS-prosedures en -prosesse; Kennis van Arbeidsverhoudingewet en begrip van onderhandelingsproses en geskilleoplossing; Basiese kennis van Gesondheids- en Welstandsbeleid, -prosesse en -stelsels; Kennis en begrip van die TVET-administrasie; Kennis en begrip van die Hoër Onderwyssektor. Vaardighede: Menslike Hulpbronadministrasie en -ontwikkeling; Ondersoeke en onderhandelings; Administratiewe; Beplanning en organisering; Finansiële bestuur; Verslagskrywing; Kommunikasie en interpersoonlik; Probleemoplossing; Rekenaarvaardigheid; Analities; Kliëntegerig; Mensebestuur; Aanbiedingsvaardighede. PLIGTE: Bystand verleen met die verskaffing van Werknemer Gesondheids- en Welstandsdiense in die Kollege. Koördineer Werknemer Gesondheids- en Welstandsgeleenthede vir die Kollege (Welstandsdae, Sporttoernooie ens.). Koördineer en kommunikeer rou oor Kollege-personeel en hul gades en families. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuningsdiense; Skep 'n databasis van kliënte met betrekking tot kontakbesonderhede, besigheidslyn en ander inligting. Behandel algemene korrespondensie en berei dokumentpakkies vir vergaderings voor. Verseker korrekte klassifisering van dokumente en veilige bewaring van dokumente. Adviseer oor nakoming van verkrygingsbeleid en koördineer alle administratiewe werk en verwante funksies. Hou 'n boodskapstelsel opgedateer / stuur inligting aan en neem notule. Reël vergaderings, strategiese / besigheidsbeplanningsessies, ens. Maak afsprake en hou dagboek opgedateer (stel die Welstandsbeampte van afsprake in kennis, verseker dat geen oorvleueling plaasvind nie, herroep afsprake wanneer nodig). Reël reëlings vir reis (akkommodasie, motor, ens.) en hanteer eise, klein kontant ens. Hou omwisselbriefs en toepaslike beleid opgedateer (HR-beleid, Finansiesbeleid en voorsieningskettingbeleid ens). Verskaf projekondersteuningsdiense in die Werknemer Gesondheids- en Welstandskantoor; Hou 'n databasis van alle projekte. Bystand verleen met koördinering van projekverslae. Koördineer insette en berei aanbiedings voor vir vergaderings. Bystand verleen aan die kantoor om aanbiedings op te stel. Verskaf enige ander tegniese bystand wat by projekvergaderings benodig word. Verskaf sekretariaatsondersteuning by vergaderings. Bestuur die vloei van inligting en dokumente in die Arbeidsverhoudingekantoor. Voer dokumentopsporing uit vir alle korrespondensie en memorandums. Bevestig ontvangs, pas lêernommertoekenning toe, rekord data in rekenaarstelsel, en lê toepaslik weg. Opstel van memos soos wanneer toegedaan. Verseker verspreiding van dokumente aan ander funksionarisse. Verseker veilige bewaring van alle dokumentasie in die kantoor in ooreenstemming met die toepaslike beleid. Verseker / koördineer vinnige en doeltreffende hantering van ander dokumentasie, nakoming van sperdatums vir dokumente (bepaal prioriteit en volg op). Lê handmatig en elektronies weg. Verskaf bystand aan ander eenhede. Verskaf ondersteuning by die verkryging van Werknemer Gesondheids- en Welstandskantoorbehoeftes.

zu.title: Ilisekhi Lemisebenzi Yabantu (EZIPHATHWA Ezimpilweni Nasenkonzweni Yabasebenzi)
zu.summary: Ilisekhi Lemisebenzi Yabantu lifunwa kuZiphathwa Ezimpilweni Nasenkonzweni Yabasebenzi eHead Office, kudingeka ibe ne-Grade 12 nokuhlonipha kwemisebenzi ye-HR.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12. I-National Diploma (NQF 6) ehambisana ne-Human Resource Management, Public Management, Labour Relations, noma iziqu ezalinganayo kuzobe yinzuzo enkulu. I-Driver's License izobe yinzuzo enkulu. 1-2 unyaka isipiliwu se-Human Resource Management. Amandla: Ulwazi ngemikhuba kanye namazinga ayisisekelo e-PERSAL; Amanyathelo oluLawulo Bantu kanye ne-CORE; Imithetho yesevisi likahulumeni kanye ne-PFMA; Umthetho wesevisi likahulumeni; I-POPI Act; Ulwazi ngamanyathelo namakhasi omsebenzi wokuqasha, ukuqeqesha kanye ne-PMDS; Ulwazi ngomthetho weLabour Relations kanye nokuqonda inqubo yokubhula nokuxazulwa izinkinga; Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngezinqubomgomo, izinqubo kanye namasistimu eZiphathwa Ezimpilweni Nasenkonzweni Yabasebenzi; Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda ukuphathwa kwe-TVET Administration; Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda umkhakha we-Higher Education. Amakhono: Ukuphathwa kokuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi yabantu; Ukuphenya kanye nokuxoxisana; Okusemgqeni; Ukulungisa nokuhlela; Ukulawula izimali; Ukubhala izibali; Ukuxhumana kanye nobudlelwano nabantu; Ukuxazulula izinkinga; Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Ukwahlulela; Ukuqondiswe kumthengi; Ukulawula abantu; Amakhono okwethula. IMISEBENZI: Usiza ekunikezeni izinkonzo zeZiphathwa Ezimpilweni Nasenkonzweni Yabasebenzi e-College. Hlela ibhodi lemikhosi yezimpilo e-College (Kusukela emahholi, amaholide, ukuzijabulisa kwamabhasi, kanye nemikhosi eminingi). Hlela kanye nokuxhumana ngokufa komphakathi nabasebenzi bale-College kanye nabomakhelwane babo kanye nemindeni yabo. Nikeza inkonzo yokusekela emgunyeni, wokubhalisa idatha yokutholakala komthengi ngokuya ngemiphumela yegumbi, uhlobo lwebhizinisi kanye nolunye ulwazi. Hlela imibhalo yonke emikhakheni ehambisana nesikhathi esithile futhi ulungelelanise idatha kumaphakethe wemibhalo yegumbi. Qinisekisa ukuthi imibhalo ihleliwe ngokuhambisana nemithethonqubo elawulayo kanye namaphakethe okuxhumana. Hola ngemithethonqubo yokulawula imali kanye nokuhlela zonke izinkonzo zokusekela. Hlela imibhalo eyisisekelo nokwazisa ngemikhakha engaphansi kokuqashwa kokubhalisa kolunye uhlobo lobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana, ukulinganisa nokudlulisa imali. Hlela amaphakethe wemibhalo eqoqwayo, kanye nokuxhumana nokwamukela imibhalo evela kwabathintekayo. Hlela izinkalo kanye namaphakethe abathintekayo, hlela izinkalo zolwazi kanye nemibhalo yegumbi ngokuhambisana nemithethonqubo. Hlela amaphakethe womuntu, hlela ukususwa kwemithethonqubo kanye namaphakethe abathintekayo. Hlela imiphumela yegumbi kanye nohlelo lokugcina ukutholakala kolwazi olwanele. Hlela ukususwa kwemibhalo kanye nemiphumela yomuntu ngamunye mayelana nokutholakala kwezidingo zokubhalisa. Hlela nokubuyisela imisebenzi ngokuzenzakalela kanye nokudluliswa kolwazi oluphathwayo kumaphakethe abathintekayo kanye nabantu abathintekayo emkhakheni. Hlela amaphakethe wokuxhumana, ihlelo, kanye nobulungisi. Hlela imithetho yegumbi kanye nemiphumada yayo kanye nemiphumela yokubamba izingxenye zemikhosi yalolu hlobo, kanye nokuqoqa amaphakethe. Hlela kanye nohlelo lokulungiselela imiphumada yomkhakha we-Human Resource Management, noma yimuphi umkhakha ongaphansi kwawo, hlela nokuhlela imithetho yabo. Hlela imisebenzi kanye nokuqoqwa kwayo.

xh.title: Iclerk yaboBunchu boBantu (Impilo yoBasebenzi nokuZinza kakuhle kweMisebenzi)
xh.summary: Kufunekiwe i-Clerk yaboBunchu boBantu kwiNkonzo yoBuntu yoBasebenzi nokuZinza kakuhle kwiiNkonzo eziseKomkhulu, ifuna ibhashe lesi-12 nolwazi lwe-HR.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12. Isidanga sezizwe esifanelekileyo (NQF 6) koLawulo lweNcubele yabantu, uLawulo lweZorhle, uLawulo lweBhunga loBasebenzi, okanye isicelo esilinganayo siza kuba lusizo olongeziweyo. Ilayisenisi yokushayela siza kuba lusizo olongeziweyo. Ulwazi lweminyaka engama-1-2 kolawulo lwenkcubekaphambili yamagosa. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngeenkqubo kunye nezimiso ze-HRM; Ulwazi nge-PERSAL; Izingqwalasela zoLawulo lwabasebenzi nokuQonda i-CORE; Iimigaqo yoLuntu luzoLuntu naka-PFMA; uMthetho woLuntu luzoLuntu; uMthetho ka-POPI; Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zokuBhalisa, uQeqesho naku-PMDS; Ulwazi ngomthetho woLawulo lweBhunga loBasebenzi nokuqonda iinkqubo zokucwengisa kunye noku Soxazulwa iingxabano; Ulwazi olusemgangathweni ngeengqiqo, iinkqubo nemiqathango yeNkonzo yoBuntu yoBasebenzi nokuZinza kakuhle; Ulwazi nokuqonda iQikelelo loLawulo lwe-TVET; Ulwazi nokuqonda iLunga leNkqubo yoGcino lweMfundo ePhakamileyo. Amapipo: uLawulo noPhuhliso lweNcubele yabantu; Iiponelo neenkqubo zokuqhuba ingxoxo; Olulawulo; Uluhlelo lolwakhiwo; uLawulo lweMali; ukubhala iingxelo; Unxibelelwano noluntu; ukuZixa iingxaki; Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Ukuthelekisa nokwahlula; Ukugqitha kubathengi; uLawulo lwabantu; Amapipo abonakalisa. IMISEBENZI : Nceda ekuboneleleni iinkonzo zeNkonzo yoBuntu yoBasebenzi nokuZinza kakuhle eKholejini. Hlela iidixo zeNkonzo yoBuntu yoBasebenzi nokuZinza kakuhle zeKholeji (Iisuku zoBuntu, Amatombola wezemidlalo njl.njl.). Hlela unxibelelwano ngesango sokufa kosapho lwebasebenzi beKholeji nabatshati babo nabo bemizi babo. Bonelela iinkonzo zolawulo oluxhaswayo; Yaza idatabhezi yabathengi malunga nolwazi lokunxibelelana, umngxuma webhizinisi nalunye ulwazi. Yonwabela unxibelelwano jikelele uze ulungise iqela leexwebhu kwimiqophelo. Qinisekisa ulwahluluhlulo oluchanekileyo lweexwebhu nokugcina iexwebhu ngokhuseleko. Nika ingcebiso ngokulandela iingqiqo zolwazi walo ngeenkonzo zokuthenga uze uhlele wonke umsebenzi wolawulo oqhelekileyo. Gcina inkqubo yemiyalezo ize ibuyekezeke / dlulisa ulwazi uthathe imizuzu yomqophelo. Hlela imiqophelo, iinkqubo zocwangciso lwezoshishino / i-strategy, njl. Yenza izicwangciso kwaye ugcine usuku olubhalisiweyo (yazisa iNkosana yoBuntu ngemibuzo, qinisekisa ukuba akukho gqithiswano, phinda ucwangcise xa kuyimfuneko). Hlela izicwangciso zokuhamba (indlu yokuhlala, imoto, njl.) uze uphathe iklayim, imali encinci njl. Gcina i-somajoli nemiqatho e relevant ibuyekezwe (imigaqo ye-HR, imigaqo yezeMali nemiqatho ye-supply chain njl). Bonelela iinkonzo zexhaso leprojekthi kwiNkonzo yoBuntu yoBasebenzi nokuZinza kakuhle; Gcina idatabhezi yawo onke amaprojekthi. Nceda kuhlelweni lweengxelo zeprojekthi. Hlela imibhalo nolungise iinkcazelo emiqophelweni. Nceda ofisi yokubhala iinkcazelo emiqophelweni. Bonelela naluphi na uluxhaso lwe-nonxibelelwano olufunekayo emiqophelweni yeprojekthi. Bonelela ixhaso lomahlulelo emiqophelweni. Lawula ukuhamba kolwazi ngeexwebhu kwiNkonzo yaseBhunganlwabi lolawulo lwebasebenzi. Sebenzisa ukulandelela iexwebhu zonke iindaba nezicelo. Yamkela isiqinisekiso sokufumana, sebenzisa inani lefayile, bhala idatha kwi-computer system, uze uyifayile ngokufanelekileyo. Bhala imemo njengoko iyalelwa. Qinisekisa ukusaswa kweexwebhu kumanye abasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa ngokhuseleko kwayo yonke imibhalo kofisi ngokulandela imigaqo e relevant. Qinisekisa / hlela ukuphathwa ngokukhawuleza nangempumelelo kolunye uhlobo lwemibhalo, ukugcinwa kwexesha kumibhalo (qamba ukubaluleka ulandele). Faka ngokwesandla ngekhompyutha. Bonelela uluxhaso kwezinye iindawo. Bonelela uxhaso ekuthengeni iimfuno zeNkonzo yoBuntu yoBasebenzi nokuZinza kakuhle ofisi.
