Knowledge of basic financial operating systems (Coltech, Sage etc) Skills: Computer skills; Planning and organizing; Good verbal and written communication; Basic numeracy skills; Ability to perform routine tasks; Ability to operate office equipment; Flexibility; Interpersonal Relations; Accuracy; Aptitudes of figures.

af.title: Finansieklerk

af.requirements: 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat plus 'n Nasionale Diploma in Finansiële Bestuur / Finansiële Rekenkunde of enige ander relevante kwalifikasie. 1-2 jaar se ervaring in 'n finansiële bestuursomgewing. Bevoegdhede: Basiese kennis van finansiële funksies en gebruike, asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, 'n rekenaar te bedien en finansiële statistiek bymekaar te maak. Basiese kennis van die openbare diens se finansiële wetgewing, prosedures en tesourie-regulasies (PFMA, PSA, PSR, PPPFA, Financial Manual). Kennis van basiese finansiële bedryfstelsels (Coltech, Sage ens). af.duties: Ontvang fakture. Kontroleer fakture vir korrektheid, verifikasie en goedkeuring (interne beheer). Verwerk fakture (bv. vaslê van betalings). Lê alle dokumente weg. Voer salarisadministrasie-ondersteuningsdienste uit. Ontvang salarisadvies. Verwerk advies (bv. kontroleer advies vir korrektheid, lê salarisse, bonusse, salarisaanpassings vas, lê alle aftrekkings vas ens.). Lê alle dokumente weg. Lê alle finansiële transaksies vas. Skuiw rekeninge met hangende saldo's. Lê skuldenaars en skuldigers vas. Verwerk elektroniese banktransaksies. Stel joernale op. Versamel inligting van begrotingshouers. Vergelyk besteding teen begroting. Identifiseer afwykings. Lê oorplasing van begrotingsposse vas en wys dit toe. Versprei dokumente rakende die begroting. Lê alle dokumente weg. zu.title: I-Finance Clerk
zu.summary: I-Finance Clerk e Department of Higher Education and Training Head Office, edinga i-National Diploma ku-Financial Management noma i-Accounting kanye neminyaka 1-2 yamava.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi sesigaba se-12 plus I-Diploma Yezwe kokuPhatha Imali / I-Akhawunti Yezimali noma eyunoma yiphi eminye imfundo ehlobene. 1-2 iminyaka yokuhlola indawo yokuphathwa kwezimali. Ikhono: Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngemisebenzi yezimali, amasiko kanye nensimbi yokuthi umuntu aqambe ulwazi ngomshini wamakhompyutha, asebenzise ikhompyutha aze ahlanganise izibalo zemali. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngemithetho yezimali yoMphakathi wokuSebenza, izinqubo nemithetho yesibalo kazwelonke (PFMA, PSA, PSR, PPPFA, i- Financial Manual). Ulwazi lwezinhlelo ezisisekelo zokusebenza zemali (i-Coltech, i- Sage etc) Amakhono: Amakhono ekhompyutha; ukucubungula futhi uhlele; ukukhuluma nokubhala kahle; amakhono abalo ebelula; ukuba nesibindi ukwenza imisebenzi evamile; ukuba nesibindi sokuphatha izinto zohhovu; ukuguquguquka; ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu; ukuqinisekile; ifayim.
zu.duties: Thola ama-invoisi. Hlola ama-invoisi ukuze abe uyiqiniso, ukuqinisekiswa nokugunyazwa (ulawulo langaphakathi). Cuba ama-invoisi (isb. ukungenisa izinkokhelo). Ugqoza zonke izixhobe zokubhalayo. Yenza imisebenzi yokuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kweholo. Thola izeluleko ngeholo. Cuba izeluleko (isb. hlola izeluleko ukuthi ziyiqiniso yonke, qamba kumaholo, izibhosho, ulungiselelo loholo, qamba yonke okuyimikhiqizo njll.). Gqoza zonke izixhobe zokubhalayo. Qamba wonke umsebenzi wezimali. Sula izakhungo ezibambezele. Qamba labantu abakwe nkomo kanye nalabo abakwe nkwemukelo. Cuba imisebenzi yebhange yomshini wamakhompyutha. Hlela amajenali. Qoqa ulwazi kubanikazi bamasheya. Thefanisa ukusebenzisa ngokumalini nokulingana nesabelo. Hlola ukungafani. Qamba, abanike amasabelo amasha. Yaba izixhobe mayelana nesabelo. Gqoza zonke izixhobe. Thola futhi uqambe izinkokhelo.

xh.title: Mmemori wenimali
xh.summary: Isithuba sommemori wenimali kwiNtloko eNkulu yoMmandla weezemfundo ePhakamileyo nokuqeqesha, sifuna iQondo leSizwe kwiLawulo leMali okanye ukuBala imali kunye nolunyaka lwama-1-2 lolwazo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samabanga a-12 kunye neQondo leSizwe kuLawulo loMali / ukuBala iMali okanye naliphi na ifanele ngokomsebenzi. 1-2 years' experience financial management environment. Ikhono: Ulwazi olusisiseko ngemisebenzi yemali, iinkqubo kunye nakhona ukubhala iinkcukacha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuhlanganisa iinani zeemali. Ulwazi olusisiseko ngemithetho yemali yoLuntu, iinkqubo namaxwebhu ezezimali (PFMA, PSA, PSR, PPPFA, Financial Manual). Ulwazi lweendlela ezisisiseko zokusebenza ngeemali (Coltech, Sage etc). Amanqanaba ekhono: Ikhono lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha; ukuCwangcisa nokuhlela; iNtetho nokuBhalwa elungileyo; Ikhono elisisiseko lokubala; Ikhono lokwenza imisebenzi eqhelekileyo; Ikhono lokusebenzisa izixhobo zofiso; Ukuqhelaniswa nakwenkqubo; Ukuhamba nokuqonda nabantu; ukuQinisekisa; Ikhono lokusebenza namanani.
xh.duties: Amkele iinvoisi. Qinisekisa iinvoisi ukuba zilungile, ukuqinisekisa nokuvunywa (ulawulo langaphakathi). Cubungula iinvoisi (umz. ukubhala iintlawulo). Ugcinlo lwamaxesha angabhaliwayo. Zenza iinkonzo zokuxhasa kulawulo lomvuzo. Amkele ingcebiso yomvuzo. Cubungula ingcebiso (umz. ukujonga ingcebiso ukubona ukuba yonake yilungile, ukubhala umvuzo, izibonelelo, ulungiso lomvuzo, ukubhala onke amahlawula njl.njl.). Gcina onke amaxwebhu. Bhala zonke iinkqubo zeemali. Susa iiafawunti ezazisalindile. Bhala abatyali mali nabanikwe mali. Cubungula iinkqubo zebhankinga yekhompyutha. Hlela amajenari. Qokelela iinkcukacha kubanikazi besaphulela. Qikelela iindleko ngokuchasana nesaphulela. Tsho ukuguquka okubonakalayo. Bhala, ulawule iindleko ngokudluliswa kwemali. Yahlula amaxwebhu ngokwesisaphulela. Gcina onke amaxwebhu. Amkele ubhale iintlawulo.

Ulwazi ngokuQonda i-PFMA, iinjongo zeTreasury namacebo oLwazi wokuLawula iziNkonzo. Ulwazi ngokufuna nokuthenga kuzakwazi ukubakho isivakalakhi. Ulwazi ngokuzalathwa kweMithetho yoBulumko ezokuLawula eziNkonzo zeSizwe. Ulwazi ngokuZala amacebo oluBulela izikhalazo ezingalinganiswanga kwindawo yokusebenza. Ulwazi ngokuQinisekisa iinkonzo ezisesikweni zokuLawula iziNkonzo.
zu.duties: Nikeza isikhokelo esilula samagama axhumiweyo nobuntu obukhuthazwa kwindawo yamagama aphefumlayo. Khipa futhi uhlele izigqibo ezingelwanga ngomthengisi weqembu elisha. bhala izinkomba zokuthengiswa ngaphakathi kweNkqubo yokuSebenzela imali eqinisekisayo. Qedela amagama asendleleni ekuqala kwelishwa ukuba ngamagama alungele ukusetshenziswa. Khipa futhi wamukele izigqibo eziqashiwe emakethe. Qhuba umkhuba wokunikela ngesiqinisekiso noma inkxaso kule nkqubo naxa kuqwalaselwa amagabiso okusebenza kwaye siphethe isivumelwano. Lungelelanisa amagabiso okulungiselela ukucutshungwa kwezinkomba. Faka izinkomba ezithengiswayo kuluhlu lwamagama. Yamukela futhi uhlole ukuba impahla emukwa kubungazi bamathenga bayo ngokomkhuba. Ukuze kuhlehlwe impahla ekwaziswa kwayo ekuyikhaya layo ngemvula yomzimba.

xh.duties: Kunika inkxaso yemisebenzi yalowo mmandla nolawulo kwi-Supply Chain Management. Ukuhlaziya kwaye ulondoloze isiseko sedatha yabanikezeli (okuquka oorhwebo). Ukubhalisa abanikezeli kwi-Coltech. Ukucela kwaye wamkele iingcinga. Ukufaka iinkcazelo kwindlela yokupeyela ngokwekhompyutha. Ukusebenzisa iodolo yokupeyela. Ukuhanthisa kwaye wamkele iingcinga. Ukuhanthisa iimpahla kubasebenzisi ekugqibelelweni. Ukulondoloza irejista yeempahla

Iakhono: Iakhono ekuSebenziseni ikhompyutha; Ulwazi lokuCwangcisa nokuHlela; Ilizwi elihle elibaliweyo nokuBhalwa; Amakhono obunini obuyisiseko; Ulawu lokwenza imisebenzi eqhelekileyo; Ulawu lokuQhuba ipe okusingathwayo; Inzondo; Iindibaniselwano phakathi kwabantu; Uchuku; Iakhono ezingxoxweni.
xh.duties: Nceda ngokuqamba iinkqubo zokusetyenziswa kweebursary. Nceda ngokuqamba nokuqhuba iinkqubo zorhwebo lweemali. Qonda oSewayiweyo abaxhaswe ngokwesikhathi ngurhwebo lweNSFAS. Nceda ngokuqamba ulwabiwo lweebursary. Nceda ngokuqamba ukunika abafundi ulwazi ngophuhliso lweekhalazo zebursary njengoko kwaziswa yiNSFAS. Nceda ekubikiseni ngolwabiwo lonke lweebursary nophuhliso.

jobs.title: Director: Security & Facilitiies Management
jobs.summary: Director of Security and Facilities Management at the Independent Police Investigative Directorate in Pretoria, responsible for physical security, access control, and asset safeguarding.
jobs.requirements: An Undergraduate qualification (NQF7) in Safety, Physical Security/ Security/ Vetting Management and any related fields. as recognized by SAQA. 5 years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level in Safety / Physical security and security vetting management environment. Driver’s license. Knowledge Requirements: Thorough knowledge of security in the following fields is recommended: Physical security, Personnel security, documents security, Communication and investigations security. Knowledge of applicable legislation and legal mandate (MISS, National Strategic Intelligence Act, National Vetting Strategy, etc.). Able to observe human behaviour and interpret the behaviour. Vetting investigation training. Voice stress analysis or polygraph testing. Financial Management training. Skills and Competencies: Strategic capability and Leadership. Good communication Skills. Financial management skills. Change management skills. Client orientation and customer focus. Problem solving and analytical skills. Service delivery innovation.
jobs.duties: Ensure physical and personnel security in the Department: Ensure the enforcement of physical security and access control. Ensure proper safeguarding of departmental assets. Establish and maintain security registers and other records. Ensure the development and management of a contingency security plan. Manage the implementation of security operating measures (e.g. access control, key control, facilitate threats and risk assessment for the employees of the department, etc.) as well as investigations on security breaches. Ensure information security management in the department: Ensure that document safety systems are developed. Ensure the monitoring and coordination communication of security matters. Ensure compliance with relevant security prescripts such as MISS, Protection of Information Act, etc. Ensure that information security awareness is promoted in the department. Manage the vetting in the department: Ensure vetting filed work investigation is done. Ensure that liaison with SSA (State Security Agency) for the evaluation and issuing of clearance certificates. Ensure that uniform standards for security clearance levels are developed e.g. conduct regular workshops on the application process for security clearance. Manage the team responsible for the provision of security and work management services. Manage the provision of a conducive working environment in terms of the Occupational Health and Safety Act. Manage and ensure effective and efficient of financial, human and physical resources of the Directorate in line with applicable legislation: Ensure development and reporting on the operational plan for the unit. Ensure that identification and development of strategic and operational risks and response plan of the unit. Ensure that people management is effective. Ensure that inputs to the annual report, interim and annual financial statements are provided. Ensure participation in Management Committees of the Department. ensure and oversee effective governance and compliance pertaining to security and work environment management. Ensure overall compliance with SCM prescripts and reporting requirements. Communication with internal/external stakeholders as well as colleagues. Ensure that response letters, email status reports, presentations, memos and submissions are provided. Ensure formal presentations and facilitate discussions at relevant committees/forums are done. Ensure that advise on procedural and related technical matters in respect of security matters and vetting strategies and policies to ensure compliance with regulations provided. Manage the provision of infrastructure maintenance, refreshment and refectory, cleaning and transport services.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. NC Netsianda Tel No: (012) 399 0039
jobs.applications: Independent Police Investigative Directorate, National Office Private Bag X941, Pretoria, 0001 or hand deliver to Benstra Building, 473 Stanza Bopape & Church Street, Arcadia, Pretoria, or email Recruitment10@ipid.gov.za (Please indicate the post name and reference number on the subject line) when applying through e-mail. FOR ATTENTION : Mr. DS Baloyi Tel No: (012) 399 0202
jobs.notes: Employment Equity Target: Women are encouraged to apply Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on applications but must submit Z83 and a detailed Curriculum Vitae. Applications quoting the correct reference number must be submitted on the new form Z83, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents . Received applications using the incorrect application form (old Z83) will not be considered. Each application for employment form must be fully completed, signed and initialled by the applicant. Failure to sign this form may lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. A recently updated, comprehensive CV as well as a fully completed and initialled new signed Z83 (Section A, B, C & D are compulsory and section E, F and G are not compulsory if CV it is attached). However, the question related to conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part-F must be answered. Non-RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident Permit Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification; it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA) (only when shortlisted). All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioral preferences, emotional intelligence and integrity. Furthermore, the requirements for appointment at Senior Management Service level include the successful completion of Senior Management Pre-entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government. Applicants should indicate on their CV’s that they have registered or they have completed the Pre-entry Certificate, which can be accessed using the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/trainingcourse/sms-pre-entry- programme. No appointment will take place without the successful completion of the pre-entry certificate and submission of proof thereof. Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Due to the large number of applications we envisage to receive, applications will not be acknowledged, if you have not been contacted within three (3) weeks after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. Therefore, only shortlisted candidate for the post will be required to submit the documents on or before the date of the interview. The successful candidate will have to undergo security vetting. His / her character should be beyond reproach. The appointment is subject to security clearance, verification of qualifications and competency assessment (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification and employment verification). Applicants must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations against them. Should this be uncovered during / after the interview took place, the application will not be considered and in the unlikely event, that the person has been appointed such appointment will be terminated. The successful candidate will be appointed subject to positive results of the security vetting process. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. The successful candidates will be appointed on a probation period of 12 months and will be required to sign a performance agreement. The suitable candidate will be selected with the intention of promoting representivity and achieving affirmative action targets as contemplated in the Department’s Employment Equity Plan. The Independent Police Investigative Directorate reserves the right to fill or not fill the bellow-mentioned posts. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Sekuriteit en Fasiliteitebestuur
af.summary: Direkteur van Sekuriteit en Fasiliteitebestuur by die Independent Police Investigative Directorate in Pretoria, verantwoordelik vir fisiese sekuriteit, toegangsbeheer en die beskerming van bates.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF7) in Veiligheid, Fisiese Sekuriteit/Sekuriteit/ Gesuiweringsbestuur en enige verwante velde, soos deur SAQA erken. 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/seniorbestuursvlak in 'n Veiligheids-/Fisiese sekuriteits- en sekuriteitsgesuiweringsbestuursomgewing. Bestuurderslisensie. Kennisvereistes: Deeglike kennis van sekuriteit in die volgende velde word aanbeveel: Fisiese sekuriteit, personeelsekuriteit, dokumentsekuriteit, Kommunikasie- en ondersoeksekuriteit. Kennis van toepaslike wetgewing en regsmandaat (MISS, National Strategic Intelligence Act, National Vetting Strategy, ens.). Kan menslike gedrag waarneem en die gedrag interpreteer. Gesuiweringsondersoekopleiding. Stemmisanalise of poligraaftoetsing. Finansiële Bestuursopleiding. Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en Leierskap. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Finansiële bestuursvaardighede. Veranderingsbestuursvaardighede. Kliëntoriëntasie en klienstefokus. Probleemoplossings- en analitiese vaardighede. Diensleweringinnovatie.
af.duties: Verseker fisiese en personeelsekuriteit in die Departement: Verseker die handhawing van fisiese sekuriteit en toegangsbeheer. Verseker behoorlike beskerming van departementele bates. Stel sekuriteitsregisters en ander rekords op en handhaaf dit. Verseker die ontwikkeling en bestuur van 'n noodsekuriteitsplan. Bestuur die implementering van sekuriteitsbedryfsmaatreëls (bv. toegangsbeheer, sleutelbeheer, fasiliteer dreigings- en risikobevaling vir die werknemers van die departement, ens.) asook ondersoeke na sekuriteitskending. Verseker inligtingsekuriteitsbestuur in die departement: Verseker dat dokumnetveiligheidstelsels ontwikkel word. Verseker die monitering en koördinering van kommunikasie van sekuriteitsake. Verseker nakoming van tersaaklike sekuriteitsvoorskifte soos MISS, Protection of Information Act, ens. Verseker dat inligtingsekuriteitsbewustheid in die departement bevorder word. Bestuur die gesuiwering in die departement: Verseker dat gesuiweringsveldwerkondersoek gedoen word. Verseur dat skakeling met SSA (State Security Agency) vir die evaluering en uitreiking van sekuriteitsklaringssertifikate plaasvind. Verseker dat eenvormige standaarde vir sekuriteitsklaringsvlakke ontwikkel word, bv. hou gereelde werkswinkels oor die aansoekproses vir sekuriteitsklaring. Bestuur die span verantwoordelik vir die voorsiening van sekuriteits- en werksbestuursdienste. Bestuur die voorsiening van 'n gunstige werksomgewing ingevolge die Occupational Health and Safety Act. Bestuur en verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende finansiële, menslike en fisiese hulpbronne van die Direktoraat in ooreenstemming met toepaslike wetgewing: Verseker ontwikkeling en verslagdoening oor die operasionele plan vir die eenheid. Verseker die identifisering en ontwikkeling van strategiese en operasionele risiko's en die eenheid se reaksieplan. Verseker dat mensebestuur effektief is. Verseker dat insette tot die jaarverslag, tussentydse en jaarlikse finansiële state verskaf word. Verseker deelname aan Bestuurskomitees van die Departement. Verseker en hou toesig oor effektiewe bestuur en nakoming met betrekking tot sekuriteits- en werksomgewingsbestuur. Verseker algehele nakoming van SCM-voorskifte en verslagdoeningsvereistes. Kommunikasie met interne/eksterne belanghebbendes asook kollegas. Verseker dat antwoordbriewe, e-posstatusverslae, aanbiedings, memo's en voorleggings verskaf word. Verseker dat formele aanbiedings en fasilitering van besprekings by tersaaklike komitees/forums gedoen word. Verseker dat advies oor prosedurele en verwante tegniese sake met betrekking tot sekuriteitsake en gesuiweringsstrategieë en -beleid om nakoming van regulasies te verseker, verskaf word. Bestuur die voorsiening van infrastruktuuronderhoud, verfrissings- en kafeteriadienste, skoonmaak- en vervoerdienste.

zu.title: Umqondisi: Ukuphathwa Kwezokuvikela Nokwamakhompyutha
zu.summary: Umqondisi Wezokuphepha Nokuphathwa Kwamakhompyutha e-Independent Police Investigative Directorate e-Pretoria, onobumnuzi ekuphepheni kwemizimba, ekulawuleneni ukungena, nasekuvikeleni izimpahla.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zezinga elingaphansi kwabafundi abaphothule (NQF7) kwezokuvikela, Ukuphepha Komzimba/ Ukuvikela/ Ukuphathwa kokuhlola nalapho kuhlobene nakho. njengoba kuqashwe yi-SAQA. Uhambo lwezi-5 lusukela ohlakeni lomphathi ophakathi/omphezulu kwesimo sezokuphepha / ukuphepha komzimba kanye nokuphathwa kokuhlolwa kwezokuvikela. Ilayisensi yokushayela. Izidingo zolwazi: Kunconywa ukuthi ube lolwazi olujulile ngezokuvikela kule mimikhakha elandelayo: Ukuphepha komzimba, Ukuphepha kwabasebenzi, ukuphepha kwamadokhumenti, Ukuxhumana kanye nokuphepha kwezophenyo. Ulwazi ngemithetho efanelekayo nemandla omthetho (MISS, National Strategic Intelligence Act, National Vetting Strategy, njll.). Ukukwazi ukubheka ukuziphatha kwabantu nokuhumusha ukuziphatha. Uqeqesho lokuphenya lokuhlolwa. Ukuhlola ingcindezi yezwi noma ukuhlolwa kwe-polygraph. Uqeqesho Lokuphathwa Kwezimali. Amakhono namandla okusebenza: Ikholo lokubukeka phambili nokuholwa. Amakhono okuxhumana ahle kahle. Amakhono okuphatha izimali. Amakhono okuphatha ushintsho. Ukuqondiswa ikilenti nokugxila kumthengi. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Intuthuko yokulethwa kwenkonzo.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuphepha komzimba nabasebenzi eMnyangweni: Qinisekisa ukuphoqa ukuphepha komzimba nolawulo lokungena. Qinisekisa ukuvikelwa okufanele kwezimpahla zomnyango. Sula futhi ulondoloze imibhalo yokuphepha kanye nananye imibhalo. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa nokuphathwa kweplani yokuphepha yesimo esingeke sijabule. Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwezinyathelo zokusebenza zokuphepha (isb. ulawulo lokungena, ulawulo lwamaqhinga, ukuncedisa ukukalwa kwezinkinga nezinkinga ezinzima kubasebenzi bomnyango, njll.) kanye neziphenyo ngezehlakalo zokuphepha. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kokuphepha kolwazi emnyangweni: Qinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokuphepha zamadokhumenti zithuthukiswe. Qinisekisa ukubheka kanye nokuhlela ukuxhumana ngemayelana nezokuphepha. Qinisekisa ukuvumelana nemiyalo yokuphepha efanelekayo njengase-MISS, Protection of Information Act, njll. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukuzwana ngezokuphepha kukhuthazwe emnyangweni. Phatha ukuhlolwa emnyangweni: Qinisekisa ukuthi iphenyo lokuhlolwa lomsebenzi wasendaweni yenziwe. Qinisekisa ukuxhumana ne-SSA (State Security Agency) ukuze kuhlolwe futhi kunikezwe izitifikedi zokuqasha. Qinisekisa ukuthi izindinganiso ezifanayo zezigaba zokuqasha ukuphepha zithuthukiswe isb. uhlela izikhungazela njalo ngomqondo ngenqubo yokufaka isicelo sokuqasha ukuphepha. Phatha iqembu elibhekene nokunikezwa kwezokuphepha namasevisi okuphathwa komsebenzi. Phatha ukunikezwa kwesimo sokusebenza esibusizayo ngokomthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act. Phatha futhi uqinisekise ukusebenza okufanele nokuhle kwezimali,abantu kanye nezinsiza zomzimba zeDirectorate ngokuhambisana nomthetho ofanelekayo: Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa nokubika mayelana neplani yokusebenza yeqoqo. Qinisekisa ukutholakala nokuthuthukiswa kwezinkinga eziyisicoco nezokusebenza kanye neplani yempendulo yeqoqo. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukuphathwa kwabantu kuyasebenza. Qinisekisa ukuthi okufakwa ebikweni lonyaka,abikweni bangaphakathi namafinyela zimali zonyaka anikezwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi knikela emakomidi eMnyangweni. Qinisekisa futhi uqaphele ukulawula okufanele nokuvumelana ngokuphathwa kwezokuphepha nendawo yokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukuvumelana okuphelele nemiyalo ye-SCM nezidingo zokubika. Ukuxhumana namakhandela angaphakathi/ngaphandle kanye nabadlule abaphakathi nendawo. Qinisekisa ukuthi amagazeti okuphendula, imibiko yendawo ye-imeyili, izinkombandlela, imemorandomu kanye nokufakwa kwakho anikezwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinkombandlela ezifanelekile nokwedlulela izinkulumo emakomidi/amaphoram athintekile zenziwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi unikeza izeluleko ngezohlelo nemibuzo edingekayo emayelana nezokuphepha namasu okuhlola nezinqubo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvumelana nemithetho. Phatha ukunikezwa kokugcinwa kohlakiro, ukuphathwa kokudla, ukulungiswa nokuhlelwa kwezokuphathelwa namasevisi okuthutha.

af.title: Direkteur: Risiko- en Integriteitsversterking
af.summary: Direkteur benodig om risikobestuurstrategieë en -raamwerke by die Independent Police Investigative Directorate in Pretoria te lei.
af.requirements: N voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF7) soos erken deur SAQA in Risikobestuur/ Interne Oudit/ Ekonomie/ Rekeningkunde. Registrasie by IRMSA of die Institute of Internal Auditors (SA). 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/seniorbestuursvlak in 'n risiko- en integriteitsbestuursomgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennisvereistes: Deeglike werkskennis van die wetgewende vereistes rakende Enterprise Risk Management. Goeie begrip van geïntegreerde risikobestuurbeginsels en -praktyke soos: Corporate Governance (King IV); Public Sector Risk Management Framework; Public Finance Management Act; Public Service Regulations; COSO ERM Framework; ISO 31 000 Frameworks; Code of Ethics en hul inlywing in verskeie besigheidsprosesse; Fraud and Risk Assessment Methodologies en die Public Service Code of Conduct. Kennis van die ISO 22301 Framework; die ISO 22313 Framework; die Good Practice Guideline on Business Continuity Management, en die Treasury and Public Service Regulations. Vaardighede en bevoegdhede: Sterk leierskapsvaardighede. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Konflikbestuursvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheidstaalvaardighede. Analitiese vaardighede. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Finansiële bestuursvaardighede. Veranderingsbestuursvaardighede. Kliëntoriëntasie en klienfocus. Probleemoplossing en analitiese vaardighede. Diensleweringinnovering.
af.duties: Bestuur die ontwikkeling van risikobestuurstrategieë, stelsels (metodologieë, modelle en instrumente ens.), beleide en die jaarlikse risikobestuurplan. Bestuur, implementeer, hersien en verbeter die risikobestuursaamwerk: Verseker dat studies en ontledings onderneem word om risiko's te identifiseer ten einde die interne en eksterne organisatoriese konteks te vestig. Bestuur die facilitering en advisering oor die risikobestuurasesseringsproses. Bestuur, monitor en hersien die geïdentifiseerde risiko-reaksie-aktiwiteite. Verseker dat die departementele risikoprofiel ontwikkel word (verseker dat die risikoregister gehandhaaf word). Verseker dat verslae soos vereis opgestel word. Bestuur die institusionalisering van risikobestuur: Bestuur die risikobestuurfilosofie en verseker dat die kultuur in die organisasie ingebed word. Bestuur die kapasiteitsontwikkeling (lig werknemers in, lei hulle en gee advies oor risikobestuursaangeleenthede). Verseker goewerneance en nakoming van Oversight Committee(s)-besluite en beleidsriglyne/regulasies. Verseker effektiewe Enterprise Risk Management en voer strategiese en operasionele risiko-assesserings uit. Vestig en implementeer Nakomingsraamwerke: Bestuur die organisatoriese nakomingsraamwerk, nakomingsheelal en nakomingsrisiko. Verseker die ontwikkeling en implementering van Risiko- en Nakomingsbeleide en -prosedures in ooreenstemming met IPID se mandaat. Bestuur die verskaffing van advies oor goeie korporatiewe goewerneance-inisiatiewe. Verseker die hersiening van die toepassing van prosesse en prosedures om die handhawing van goeie korporatiewe goewerneance te fasiliteer. Verseker indiening van finansiële openbarings deur IPID-werknemers. Verseker nakoming van Sek 30 van die PSA ten opsigte van ander vergoede werk. Verseker bevordering van 'n etiese kultuur en die handhawing van organisatoriese integriteit. Monitor IPID-nakomingsvlakke met wette en regulasies. Ontwikkeling van 'n gekombineerde versekeringsmodel. Bestuur en implementeer die antikorrupsie-, bedrogvoorkomings- en etiekbestuur in ooreenstemming met tersaaklike wetgewing, beleide en regulasies. Bestuur die implementering van besigheidskontinuïteit. Vestig Business Continuity Management (BCM): Vestig 'n Business Continuity Management (BCM)-raamwerk en -beleid wat krisisbestuurstrategie en -planne insluit. Toets en handhaaf die Business Continuity Plans. Verskaf ondersteuning aan die Uitvoerende gesag oor Business Continuity Strategies. Voer Business Impact Analysis uit. Bestuur van hulpbronne: Effektiewe en doeltreffende bestuur van Menslike Hulpbronne. Effektiewe en doeltreffende bestuur van Finansiële Hulpbronne. Effektiewe en doeltreffende bestuur van Toerusting/Bates.

zu.title: Umongameli: Ukusekwa Kwezingozi Nokuziphatha
zu.summary: Kudingeka umongameli okuzohola izindlela zokuphatha izingozi namaphulatifomu e-Independent Police Investigative Directorate e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Undergraduate (NQF7) ezivunyelwe yi-SAQA kwi-Risk Management/ Internal Auditing/ Economics/ Accounting. Ukubhalisa kwi-IRMSA noma i-Institute of Internal Auditors (SA). 5 iminyaka yohlelo emazingeni aphakathi/ephezulu okuphatha emkhakheni wokuphatha izingozi nokuziphatha. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Izidingo Wolwazi: Ulwazi oluhle lokusebenza ngezidingo zomthetho mayelana ne-Enterprise Risk Management. Ukuqonda okuhle kemiqondo namasu okuphatha i-Risk Management ehlanganiswe njengoku: Corporate Governance (King IV); Public Sector Risk Management Framework; Public Finance Management Act; Public Service Regulations; COSO ERM Framework; ISO 31 000 Frameworks; Code of Ethics kanye nokuwelela kwayo kumaphulatifomu ahlukene ababhizinisi; Fraud and Risk Assessment Methodologies kanye ne-Public Service Code of Conduct. Ulwazi nge-ISO 22301 Framework; i-ISO 22313 Framework; i-Good Practice Guideline on Business Continuity Management, kanye ne-Treasury kanye ne-Public Service Regulations. Amakhono namandla okuzenzelela: Amakhono abakhongozi amaqhawe. Amakhono okuxhumana ahle. Amakhano okuphatha ingxabano. Amakhono okusebenzisana nekhompyutha nolimi. Amakhono okuhlaziya. Isikhathi eside kanye noBukhosi. Amakhono okuxhumana ahle. Amakhano okuphatha imali. Amakhano okuphatha inguquko. Isijobelelo somthengi kanye nokuqaswa komthengi. Amakhano okuxazulula izinkinga nohlelo lokuhlaziya. Intuthuko yohlelo lokulethwa kwezinsiza.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuthuthukiswa kwezindlela zokuphatha izingozi, izimiso (indlela, amamodeli namathuluzi njll), izinqobo kanye nesu leminyaka yonke lokuqapha izingozi. Phatha, faka uhlelo, reviewa futhi uthuthukise uhlelo lokuqapha izingozi: Qinisekisa ukuba kwenziwa izifundo kanye nokucazulula ukuze kutholakale izingozi ukuze kumiswe isimo sangaphakathi nangaphandle senhlangano. Phatha ukwelulekwa kanye nengxoxo ngomchilo wokuqapha izingozi. Phatha, qaphela futhi reviewa imisebenzi ephendula ezinhlekelele eziyivezile. Qinisekisa ukuthi iphulofayili yezingozi yomnyango yakhishwa (qinisekisa ukuthi irekhodi lezingozi igcinwa). Qinisekisa ukuthi imibiko ihlelwa njengoba kudingeka. Phatha ukwenza isiko lokuqapha izingozi: Phatha ifilosofi yokuqapha izingozi futhi qinisekisa ukuthi lesisiko singena enhlanganweni. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa kwamandla (azise, khombisa futhi weluleke abasebenzi ngemayelana nokuqapha izingozi). Qinisekisa ubulungiswa kanye nokuzelelana nezinqumo kwe-Oversight Committee(s) kanye neziqu zomthetho/izinqubo. Qinisekisa i-Enterprise Risk Management ephumelelayo futhi yenza ukuhlaziywa kwezingozi ezinguqiko kanye nezokusenzayo. Misela futhi faka isimiso sokuzelelana: Phatha isimiso sokuzelelana senhlangano, umhlaba wokuzelelana, kanye nengozi yokuzelelana. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokufakwa kohlelo kwezinqobo nezinqubo ze-Risk and Compliance ngokuhambisana namandlulo i-IPID. Phatha ukunikezelwa kwegcebiso ngamaphrojekthi abulungiswa bahle bomuntu. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhleziwa isicelo sezinqobo kanye nezinqubo ukwenza kubekhona ukugcinwa kolungiswa kahle. Qinisekisa ukuthi izikweletu zenyikithi zethunyelwa abasebenzi be-IPID. Qinisekisa ukuzelelana ne-Sec 30 ye-PSA ngokuhlobene nomsebenzi ohlinzeka ngemali enye. Qinisekisa ukukhuthazwa komsiko wokuziphatha nokugcinwa kokuziphatha kwenhlangano. Qaphela izinga le-IPID ukuzelelana nomthetho kanye nezinqobo. Ukuthuthukiswa kwemodeli kahle kokuqinisekisa. Phatha futhi usebenzise ukumelana nokukhokhela, ukuvikela ukukhohliswa kanye nokuphatha amasiko ngokuhambisana nomthetho, izinqobo kanye nezinqobo ezehlukene. Phatha ukusetshenziswa kokuqhubekayo kwebhizinisi. Misela i-Business Continuity Management (BCM): Misela isimiso kanye nenqobo ye-Business Continuity Management (BCM) ehlanganisa isu kanye namaphulani lokuphatha inkinga. Hlola futhi gcina amaphulani we-Business Continuity. Nikela ngokweseka i-Executive ngezinhlelo ze-Business Continuity. Yenza ukuhlaziya kwe-Business Impact Analysis. Ukuphatha izinsiza: Ukuphatha okusebenzayo kwe-Human Resource. Ukuphatha okusebenzayo kwe-Financial Resource. Ukuphatha okusebenzayo kwe-Equipment/Assets.

jobs.title: District Director
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (all-inclusive package). The package includes a basic salary (70% of package), and a flexible portion that may be structured in accordance with the rules for Senior Management Services (SMS)
jobs.summary: District Director for Land Reform and Rural Development in KwaZulu Natal, overseeing NARYSEC and youth development programmes at SMS Level 13.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a Bachelor’s Degree or Advanced Diploma in Business Administration / Public Management / Public Administration / Project Management / Bachelor of Arts in Sociology / Anthropology / Community Development Studies (NQF level 7) or related equivalent qualification and a Nyukela certificate (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) submitted prior to appointment. Minimum of 5 years of experience at middle / senior managerial level in the relevant environment. Experience in the implementation and management of projects. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: A thorough understanding of project management. Understanding of corporate governance principles. Ability to implement performance management and monitoring systems. Knowledge of government systems. Ability to think conceptually when analysing data designing concepts to modify corporate policies, procedures and processes. Job related skills: Project management. Coaching and mentoring (though leadership). Analytical thinking. Adaptability and flexibility. Customer service. Initiative. Innovation and creativity. Communication (verbal and written). Computer literate. Willingness to travel. Ability to work under pressure. Willingness to work after hours.
jobs.duties: Provide capacity building and National Rural Youth Service Corps (NARYSEC) services. Provide NARYSEC support services. Facilitate the establishment and support of participatory community development. Facilitate and coordinate NARYSEC project implementation. Facilitate youth programmes and skills development at provincial and district level. Reduce household poverty in accordance with comprehensive Rural Development Programme (CRDP). Provide strategic land acquisition services. Implement strategic land acquisition projects proposals. Procure service providers for development of project proposals. Coordinate the implementation process of land acquisition. Provide strategic land acquisition support services in the district. Facilitate poverty reduction, and the development of cooperatives, rural enterprises and industries. Promote rural businesses development and facilitate rural development financing. Facilitate establishment and support of primary cooperatives. Facilitate organisation of primary cooperatives into secondary and tertiary cooperative sand provide support. Facilitate the development of rural enterprises and industries. Provide land development support services. Manage the development of business plans for the development or agrarian development projects. Promote the participation of farmers through ownership and control across commodities value chains. Monitor the implementation of land development support projects and development business plans. Provide property management services. Administer and provide property leases administration. Administer and provide property holdings and disposable. Implement land rights and tenure reform programmes. Provide communal land tenure programmes. Provide land rights programmes. Establish, maintain, and support communal property institutions. Facilitate land dispute resolutions. Render corporate and financial support services. Provide legal advice. Provide telecommunications services. Provide administration and financial support services. Provide client relations services. Provide office services.

af.title: Distriksdirekteur
af.summary: Distriksdirekteur vir Grondhervorming en Landelike Ontwikkeling in KwaZulu Natal, wat toesig hou oor NARYSEC- en jeugontwikkelingsprogramme op SMS-vlak 13.

Afrigting en mentorskap (deur leierskap). Analitiese denke. Aanpasbaarheid en buigsaamheid. Kliëntediens. Initiatief. Innovasie en kreatiwiteit. Kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik). Rekenaarvaardig. Bereidwilligheid om te reis. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Bereidwilligheid om na ure te werk.
af.duties: Verskaf kapasiteitsbou- en National Rural Youth Service Corps (NARYSEC)-dienste. Verskaf NARYSEC-ondersteuningsdienste. Fasiliteer die vestiging en ondersteuning van deelnemende gemeenskapsontwikkeling. Fasiliteer en koördineer NARYSEC-projekimplementering. Fasiliteer jeugprogramme en vaardigheidsontwikkeling op provinsiale en distrikvlak. Verminder huishoudelike armoede in ooreenstemming met Comprehensive Rural Development Programme (CRDP). Verskaf strategiese grondbemakingsdienste. Implementeer strategiese grondbemakingsprojekvoorstelle. Verkaf diensverskaffers vir die ontwikkeling van projeksvoorstelle. Koördineer die implementeringsproses van grondbemaking. Verskaf strategiese grondbemakingsondersteuningsdienste in die distrik. Fasiliteer armoedevermindering, en die ontwikkeling van koöperasies, landelike ondernemings en bedrywe. Bevorder landelike besigheidsontwikkeling en fasiliteer landelike ontwikkelingsfinansiering. Fasiliteer vestiging en ondersteuning van primêre koöperasies. Fasiliteer organisering van primêre koöperasies in sekondêre en tersiêre koöperasies en verskaf ondersteuning. Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van landelike ondernemings en bedrywe. Verskaf grondontwikkelingsondersteuningsdienste. Bestuur die ontwikkeling van besigheidsplanne vir die ontwikkeling van agrariese ontwikkelingsprojekte. Bevorder die deelname van boere deur eienaarskap en beheer oor kommoditeitswaardekettings. Monitor die implementering van grondontwikkelingsondersteuningsprojekte en ontwikkelingsbesigheidsplanne. Verskaf eiendomsbestuursdienste. Administreer en verskaf eiendomsverhuuradministrasie. Administreer en verskaf eiendomsbesit en beskikbare eiendomme. Implementeer grondregte en eiendomshervormingsprogramme. Verskaf gemeenskaplike eiendomsregprogramme. Verskaf grondregte-programme. Vestig, onderhou en ondersteun gemeenskaplike eiendomsinstellings. Fasiliteer grondgeskilbemiddeling. Verskaf korporatiewe en finansiële ondersteuningsdienste. Verskaf regsadvies. Verskaf telekommunikasiedienste. Verskaf administratiewe en finansiële ondersteuningsdienste. Verskaf kliënteverhoudingsdienste. Verskaf kantoordienste.

Iakhoni yokusebenzisa inkqubo yolawula ukusebenza kwaye ulandele isiqondo sayo. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zorhulumente. Iakhoni yokucinga ngokweziczubo xa kuhlalutywa idatha yakhiwa iingqondo zokulungisa iingqigqiba, iinkqubo neenkcukacha zorhulumente. Amandla ahambelana nesebe ngokwamava: ULawulo lwamaprojekthi. Ukuyala kwaye kumceke (ngokuba ngumntu ongelaelwayo). Ukuhlalutywa ngokucinga. Ukuzihlengahla nekucothiswa kwento. Iinkonzo zabathengi. Isakhono esingaphandle kolawulo. Isakhono sokudala izinto ezitsha. Unxibelelwano (ngolwimi oluthethwayo nolubhalwayo). Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilungelelaniso lokuhamba. Iakhoni yokusebenza ngexesha elinzima. Ilungelelaniso lokusebenza emva kweyure ezisebenzayo.
xh.duties: Nika amandla okusebenza iinkonzo zeNational Rural Youth Service Corps (NARYSEC). Zize iinkonzo zoxhaso lweNARYSEC. Yenza kube lula ukumiswa nokuxhaswa koluntu ekuphuhliseni kwalo. Yenza kube lulu kwaye ulungelelanise ukusetyenziswa kwamaprojekthi weNARYSEC. Yenza kube lula iinkqubo zolutsha nokuPhuhliswa kwezakhono kwinqanaba lephondo nasesithilini. Nciphisa ubukhobo bawonke umzi ngokwemigaqo yeComprehensive Rural Development Programme (CRDP). Zize iinkonzo zokuPhuhlisa amanani obulumko ngokweziczubo. Sebenzisa izicwangciso ezibalulekileyo zokuPhuhlisa amanani obulumko. Landa abaniki bezinkonzo kwiinkqubo ezibalulekileyo zokuPhuhlisa amanani obulumko. Lungelelanisa inkqubo yokuPhuhlisa amanani obulumko. Zize iinkonzo zoxhaso olubalulekileyo lolwazi ngaphakathi kwesithili. Yenza kube lula ukunciphiswa kobukhobo, nokuPhuhliswa kwezophuhliso kunye namashishini eseRhoxaya. Khuthaza uPhuhliswa lweeshishini zaseRhoxaya kwaye ulungelelanise uxhaso lweemali ekuphuhliseni iindawo zaseRhoxaya. Yenza kube lula ukumiswa nokuxhaswa kwezophulliso ezingunyuka. Lungelelanisa ukuqhelaniswa kwezophulliso ezingunyuka zibe ngokwesibini nzesithathu kwaye unike ixhaso. Yenza kube lulu uPhuhliswa lweeshishini kunye namashishini oRhoxaya. Zize iinkonzo zoxhaso ngokwemigaqo yokuPhuhlisa amanani obulumko. Lawula uPhuhliswa lwezicwangciso zeeshishini kwiinkqubo zokuPhuhliswa okanye amapojekthi wezophuhliso. Khuthaza inxaxheba yabaLimi ngokuphuma kwaye ngokolawulo kumachain wezixhobo. Landelela ukusetyenziswa kweenkxaso zokuPhuhliswa kwamaprojekthi ezingunyuka nezicwangciso ezingowona eziphuhliswayo. Zize iinkonzo zolawulo lwempahla. Lawula kwaye unike iinkonzo zokuqeshwa kwempahla. Lawula kwaye unike iinkonzo zogcino kunye nempahla ezingalahlwayo. Sebenzisa iinkqubo zokuLungiswa kolwazi ngabantu nolwazi ngendlu. Zize iinkonzo zolwazi ngendlu ngokwendalo yoluntu. Zize iinkonzo zolwazi ngomanyano woluntu. Misela, zigcine, kwaye zixhase iziko lendalo yoluntu. Yenza kube lula ukulungiswa ngempahla yomhlaba. Zize iinkonzo zobumnini ngokwemigaqo nemali. Zize ingcebiso ngomthetho. Zize iinkonzo zokunxibelelana ngesixhobo. Zize iinkonzo zolawulo nemali. Zize iinkonzo zodibano nabathengi. Zize iinkonzo zofisi.

jobs.title: Chief Professional Surveyor
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R1 143 468 per annum, (The salary will be determined in accordance with the OSD)
jobs.summary: Chief Professional Surveyor needed in Mowbray to design, plan and manage complex survey projects; requires a BSc in Survey or Geomatics plus six years' post-qualification experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of Grade 12 Certificate and a four-year Bachelor of Science Degree in Survey / Geomatics. Compulsory registration with the South African Geomatics Council (SAGC) as a Professional Surveyor on appointment. Compulsory registration with SAGC as a Professional Surveyor to perform cadastral Surveys. Minimum of 6 years post-qualification survey experience required. Job related knowledge: Programme and project management, Survey, legal and operational compliance, Survey operational communication, Process knowledge and skills, Maintenance and knowledge, Mobile equipment operating, Survey design and analysis, Research and development, Computer-aided survey applications, Creating high-performance culture, Technical consulting, Survey and professional judgment. Job related skills: Strategic capability and leadership, Problem solving and analysis, Decision making, Team leadership, Creativity, Communication (verbal and written), People management, Planning and Organising, Conflict management, Negotiation and Change management. A valid drivers licence.
jobs.duties: Design, plan, and perform surveys to solve practical survey problems (challenges), improve efficiency and enhance safety. Manage projects on the application of new and existing survey technologies. Manage and plan surveys of a varied and complex nature. Develop cost-effective solutions and approve surveys according to prescribed requirements / standards. Promote safety in line with statutory and regulatory requirements. Evaluate existing technical manuals, standard drawings and procedures to incorporate new technology. Provide expert advisory and support services. Maintain survey operational effectiveness. Manage the execution of maintenance strategy through the provision of appropriate structures, systems and resources. Set survey maintenance standards, specifications and service levels according to organisational objectives. Monitor maintenance efficiencies according to organisational goals to direct or redirect survey services. Governance. Allocate, control, monitor and report on all resources. Compile risk logs and manage significant risk according to sound risk management practice and organisational requirements. Provide technical consulting services for the operation on survey-related matters to minimise possible survey risks. Manage and implement knowledge sharing initiatives e.g. short-term assignments and secondments within and across operations, in support of individual development plans, operational requirements and return on investment. Monitor the exchange and protection of information between operations and individuals to ensure effective knowledge management according to departmental objectives. Financial management. Ensure the availability of and management of funds to meet the Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) objectives within the survey environment / services. Manage the operational capital project portfolio for the operation to ensure effective resourcing according to organisational needs and objectives. Manage the commercial value add of the discipline-related programmes and projects. Facilitate the compilation of innovation proposals to ensure validity and adherence to organisational principles. Allocate, control and monitor expenditure according to budget to ensure efficient cash flow management. People management. Manage the development, motivation and utilisation of human resources for the discipline to ensure a competent knowledge base for the continued success of the survey services according to the organisational needs and requirements. Manage subordinates’ key performance areas by setting and monitoring performance standards and taking actions to correct deviations to achieve departmental objectives.
jobs.enquiries: Mr A Parker Tel No: (021) 657 4300
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 4th floor, No 2 Riebeeck Street, ABSA Building, Cape Town or by email to Post304@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Coloured, Indian and White Males, and African, Coloured, Indian and White Females, and Persons with disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form, (a nomination letter if required) and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. All shortlisted candidate, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidates suitability based on the posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre-entry programme offered by the National School of       Government          (NSG).       Find      course       details     here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/ appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re-advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. af.title: Hoofprofessionele Landmeter
af.summary: Hoofprofessionele Landmeter word in Mowbray benodig om komplekse opmetingsprojekte te ontwerp, te beplan en te bestuur; vereis 'n BSc in Landmeting of Geomatika plus ses jaar se ervaring na kwalifisering.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n vierjaar Bachelor of Science-graad in Landmeting / Geomatika. Verpligte registrasie by die South African Geomatics Council (SAGC) as 'n Professionele Landmeter by aanstelling. Verpligte registrasie by SAGC as 'n Professionele Landmeter om kadastrale opmetings uit te voer. Minimum van 6 jaar se opmetingservaring na kwalifisering word vereis. Werksverwante kennis: Program- en projekbestuur, Landmeting, regsonderhoudende en operasionele voldoening, Operasionele kommunikasie aangaande landmeting, Proseskennis en vaardighede, Onderhoud en kennis, Mobiele toerustingbedryf, Opmetingsontwerp en -analise, Navorsing en ontwikkeling, Rekenaargesteunde opmetingsprogramme, Skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur, Tegniese konsultasie, Landmeting en professionele oordeel. Werksverwante vaardighede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, Probleemoplossing en analise, Besluitneming, Spanleierskap, Kreatiwiteit, Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), Personebestuur, Beplanning en organisering, Konflikbestuur, Onderhandeling en veranderingbestuur. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Ontwerp, beplan en voer opmetings uit om praktiese opmetingsprobleme (uitdagings) op te los, doeltreffendheid te verbeter en veiligheid te bevorder. Bestuur projekte oor die toepassing van nuwe en bestaande opmetingstegnologieë. Bestuur en beplan opmetings van 'n gevarieerde en komplekse aard. Ontwerp kostedoeltreffende oplossings en keur opmetings goed volgens voorgeskrewe vereistes / standaarde. Bevorder veiligheid in ooreenstemming met statutêre en regulerende vereistes. Evalueer bestaande tegniese handleidings, standaardtekeninge en prosedures om nuwe tegnologie te inkorporeer. Verskaf kundige advisering en ondersteuningsdienste. Handhaaf operasionele doeltreffendheid van opmetings. Bestuur die uitvoering van die onderhoudsstrategie deur die voorsiening van toepaslike strukture, stelsels en hulpbronne. Stel opmetingsonderhoudstandaarde, spesifikasies en diensvlakke volgens organisatoriese doelwitte. Monitor onderhoudsdoeltreffendheid volgens organisatoriese doelwitte om opmetingsdienste te rig of te herlei. Bestuur. Allokeer, beheer, monitor en rapporteer oor alle hulpbronne. Stel risikologe op en bestuur beduidende risiko volgens goeie risikobestuurpraktyk en organisatoriese vereistes. Verskaf tegniese konsultasiedienste vir die operasie oor opmetingsverwante aangeleenthede om moontlike opmetingsrisiko's te minimeer. Bestuur en implementeer kennisdelingsinisiatiewe bv. korttermyn-opdragte en uitleenings binne en oor operasies, ter ondersteuning van individuele ontwikkelingsplanne, operasionele vereistes en opbrengs op belegging. Monitor die uitruil en beskerming van inligting tussen operasies en individue om effektiewe kennisbestuur volgens departementele doelwitte te verseker. Finansiële bestuur. Verseker die beskikbaarheid en bestuur van fondse om die Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) doelwitte binne die opmetingsomgewing / -dienste te bereik. Bestuur die operasionele kapitaalprojekportefeulje vir die operasie om effektiewe hulpbronvoorsiening volgens organisatoriese behoeftes en doelwitte te verseker. Bestuur die kommersiële meerwaarde van die dissiplineverwante programme en projekte. Fasiliteer die opstel van innovasievoorstelle om geldigheid en nakoming van organisatoriese beginsels te verseker. Allokeer, beheer en monitor besteding volgens begroting om effektiewe kontantvloei bestuur te verseker. Personebestuur. Bestuur die ontwikkeling, motivering en benutting van menslike hulpbronne vir die dissipline om 'n bevoegde kennisbasis vir die voortgesette sukses van die opmetingsdienste volgens die organisatoriese behoeftes en vereistes te verseker. Bestuur ondergeskiktes se sleutelprestasie-areas deur prestasiestandaarde te stel en te monitor en maatreëls te tref om afwykings reg te stel om departementele doelwitte te bereik.

zu.title: Umhloli Wekhono Elingunhlokhe
zu.summary: Kudingeka Umhloli Wekhono Elingunhlokhe eMowbray ukuthi akuse, ahlele futhi aphathe imiklamo yokuhlola eminingana; kudingeka i-BSc ku-Survey noma i-Geomatics kanye neminyaka eyisithupu yokuhlola ngemva kokuthola izifundo.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane kakhulu: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 kanye neziqu ze-Bachelor of Science Degree zeminyaka emine ku-Survey / Geomatics. Ukubhalisa ngokuphothile ku-South African Geomatics Council (SAGC) njengomhloli wekhono ngesikhathi sokumiswa emsebenzini. Ukubhalisa ngokuphothile ku-SAGC njengomhloli wekhono ukwenza imiklamo ye-cadastral. Kudingeka ubhekele okuncane iminyaka eyi-6 yokuhlola ngemva kokuthola izifundo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuqondisa kanye nokuphatha imiklamo nemiklamo, ukuhlola, ukulandela umthetho kanye nokuqondiswa kokusebenza, ukuxhumana kokuhlola kokusebenza, ulwazi kanye namakhono okwenza izinqumo, ukugcina kanye nolwazi, ukusebenzisa izinto eziyohambayo, ukuseka kanye nokuhlaziya ukuhlola, ucwaningo kanye nentuthuko, izinhlelo zokuhlola ezisekelwe kwichwephesha, ukwakha inhlalo yokusebenza ngamandla amakhulu, ukweluleka ngobuchwepheshe, ukuhlola kanye nokuqonda ngobuchwepheshe. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ikhono lokubuka phambili nokuqondisa, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya, ukwenza izinqumo, ukuqondisa iqembu, ukusungula izinto ezintsha, ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe), ukuphatha abantu, ukuhlela kanye nokuhlela izinto, ukuphatha izingxabano, ukuxoxisana kanye nokuphatha inguquko. Ilayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile.
zu.duties: Akuse, ahlele, futhi adlule emiklamweni yokuhlola ukuxazulula izinkinga zokuhlola ezibonwayo (izinselelo), ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kahle kanye nokwandiza ukuphepha. Phatha imiklamo ngokusetshenziswa kwamabhonteji okuhlola amasha kanye akhona. Phatha futhi uhlele imiklamo yokuhlola ehlukene futhi eningana. Tuthukisa izixazululo ezibiza kakhulu futhi vumela imiklamo ngokwesidingo / izinga eliqaqisiwe. Khuthaza ukuphepha ngokulandela izidingo zomthetho kanye nezomthetho oqondisayo. Hlola imanuwali zobuchwepheshe ezikhona, izithombe ezingezilesi kanye nezinqubo ukufaka amabhonteji amasha. Nikeza izinsiza zokweluleka ngesikhunzi kanye namasevisi okusekela. Gcina ukusebenza kahle kokuhlola. Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwenqubo yokugcina ngesiqondiso sezakhiwo ezifanele, izimiso kanye nezinsiza. Hlela izinga lokugcina ukuhlola, izinkomba kanye namazinga amasevisi ngokwezinhllo zenhlangano. Bhekisisa ukusebenza kahle kokugcina ngokwezinhllo zenhlangano ukuzondisa noma ukuzondisa kabusha amasevisi okuhlola. Ukuphatha. Aba, lawula, bhekisisa futhi ungabiko ngazo zonke izinsiza. Hlela amafayili ezingozi futhi phatha izingozi ezingakhulu ngokwenzeko efanele yokuphatha izingozi kanye nezidingo zenhlangano. Nikeza amasevisi okuweluleka ngobuchwepheshe ekusebenzeni ngezindaba ezihlobene nokuhlola ukunciphisa izingozi ezithweswe ukuhlola. Phatha futhiandise ukwabelana ngolwazi ngezinhloso ezibhekene nesikhathi esifushane kanye nezikalo zokusetshenziswa ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwezimiso zokusebenza, ekusekeleni izinhlelo zentuthuko yomuntu ngamunye, izidingo zokusebenza kanye nenzuzo yotshalo. Bhekisisa ukushintshiselana kanye nokuvikelwa kolwazi phakathi kwezimiso zokusebenza kanye nabantu ukubona ukuphathwa kolwazi okusebenza kahle ngokwezinhllo zomnyango. Ukuphatha imali. Qinisekisa ukutholakala kanye nokuphathwa kwemali ukubona izinhloso ze-Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) ngaphakathi kokuhlola / amasevisi. Phatha iphothifoliyo yomklamo wekhaya lokusebenza kwesimiso ukubona ukusetshenziswa okusebenza kahle ngokwezidingo kanye nenhloso yenhlangano. Phatha inani lezohwebo lezinhloso ezihlobene nesimiso namaklamo. Yisa isikhundla ekwenziweni kweziphakamiso zokusungula izinto ezintsha ukubona ukusemthethweni kanye nokulandelwa kwezimiso zenhlangano. Aba, lawula kanye nokubhekisisa ukusetshenziswa ngokwesabelo mali ukubona ukuphathwa kwemali okusebenza kahle. Ukuphatha abantu. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa, ukugqugquzelwa kanye nokusetshenziswa kwemithombo yabantu yesimiso ukubona ulwazi olusebenzayo lokuqhubeka nokuphumelela kwamasevisi okuhlola ngokwezidingo kanye nezidingo zenhlangano. Phatha izindawo eziyinhloko zokusebenza zabahansi ngokusetha kanye nokubhekisisa izinga lokusebenza bese uthatha izinyathelo ukulungisa okungeyona nhlobo ukufeza izinhloso zomnyango.

xh.title: Isikhulu esiPhambili se-Surveyor esiNobuchwepheshe
xh.summary: Kufuneka isikhulu esiPhambili se-Surveyor esiNobuchwepheshe kwi-Mowbray ukuyila, ucocisele kwaye ulawule iiprojekthi zokujonga ezingenele; kufuneka ibe nalesiXhoma se-BSc kwi-Survey okanye i-Geomatics kananjalo neminyaka yamathandathu yamava emva kokuthweswa isidanga.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingowona basebenzi: Kufuneka abafaki-zicelo babe neSatifikethi seGrade 12 kwaye be ne-Degree ye-Bachelor yeNzululwazi (i-Bachelor of Science Degree) eminyaka emine kwi-Survey / i-Geomatics. Ubhalo obuyinyaniso kwi-South African Geomatics Council (SAGC) njengonge-Surveyor osebenzayo ngexesha lokunikwa isikhundla. Ubhalo obuyinyaniso kwi-SAGC njengonge-Surveyor osebenzayo ukwenza i-cadastral Surveys. Kufuneka kube nobuncinane beminyaka eli-6 yamava okujonga emva kokuthweswa isidanga. Ulwazi oluxhomekeke kwisikhundla: Ukulawula iinkqubo neeprojekthi, i-Survey, ukuhambelana nomthetho nokusebenza, unxibelelwano lokusebenza kokujuqwa, ulwazi namakhono ezenzo, ukugcina nolwazi, ukusebenzisa izixhobo ezihambahambayo, ukuyila nokuhlalutya i-Survey, uphando nentlutho, izicelo zokujuqwa ngekhompyutha, ukudala inkqubo yokusebenza ngamandla amakhulu, ingcebiso yobuchwepheshe, i-Survey nesisindo esinzima sokugqiba. Amakhono axhomekeke kwisikhundla: Ikhono elingunxibelelwano phakathi kwendlu yangaphakathi nengaphandle nokulawula, ukuxazulula iingxaki nohlalutyo, ukwenza izigqibo, ukulawula iqela, ukudala, unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo), ukulawula abantu, ukucocisa nokuhlela, ukulawula ingxabano, ukuxoxwa nokuqhuba iinguquko. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Yila, cwangcisa, kwaye wenza i-Surveys ukuxazulula iingxaki zokujuqwa ezinzima (iingcali), ukuphucula ukusebenza kakuhle nokwandusa ukhuseleko. Lawula iiprojekthi ngokusetyenziswa kobuchwephesha obutsha nobuseleyo bokujonga. Lawula kwaye ucocisele i-Surveys ezahlukeneyo nenzima. Phezulu izisombululu ezingabizi kakhulu kwaye uvume i-Surveys ngokwemfuno / ngokwemilinganiselo. Khuthaza ukhuseleko ngokwemfuno yomthetho nemigaqo. Hlola iimanuali zobuchwephesha ezikhoyo, iimpawu ezisesikweni nezenzo ukuze ufake obutsha obuchwepheshe. Nikeza iinkonzo zeengcebiso ezingoworhwebo kwaye unike inkxaso. Yigcine inkqubo yokusebenza komsebenzi wokujonga. Lawula ukuphumeza inqubo yokugcina ngokunika iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo, iindlela namathemba. Misela imilinganiselo yokugcina, iinkcazelo namazinga enkonzo ngokumgama weenhloko zebody. Hlola ukusebenza kakuhle ngokwemgama we-body yokuzisa okanye ukuqhuba iinkonzo zokujonga. Ulawulo. Yaba, lawula, hlola kwaye wenze ingxelo ngawo onke amathemba. Hlaza iiresithi ezingozi kwaye ulawule ingozi ebalulekileyo ngokwenkqubo yokuqonda kwaye ngokwemfuno ye-body. Nikeza iinkonzo zeengcebiso zobuchwepheshe ngenkqubo kumabanga okujonga ukunciphisa iingozi ezinokubakho zokujonga. Lawula kwaye uphumeze iinkqubo zokusasaza ulwazi ezifana naberhere abafutshane kwaye ababelwe amanye amanyathelo aphakathi naphakathi kwemisebenzi, ukuxhasa iplani zophuhliso lwemini, iimfuno zokusebenza nenzuzo yemali. Hlola ukutshintshelana kolwazi nokuqhusela ulwazi phakathi kokusebenza nabantu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulawula ulwazi kakuhle ngokwemgama wesebe. Ukulawula imali. Qinisekisa ukubakho nokulawula imali ukuze kuhlangelwe iinjongo ze-Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) kwindawo / iinkonzo zokujonga. Lawula ibhashe leprojekthi yemali yokusebenza kumanyathelo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunikwa amathemba ngokwemfuno yomgama we-body. Lawula izongezo zemali zohwebo lwezinhloko kwiprogramu neeprojekthi. Yenza isicwangciso seengcebiso zotsha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kokumgama wemigaqo yoluntu. Yaba, lawula kwaye uhlolo imali esetyenziswa ngokwejara ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulawula imali. Ukulawula abantu. Lawula ukuphuhlisa, ukukhuthaza nokusebenzisa amathemba abantu kule ngcongcolo ukuze kuqinisekiswe isiseko solwazi esinamandla kulo iphina lalemisebenzi yokujuqwa ngokwemfuno namagama e-body. Lawula amabala okusebenza abo basembotsheni ngokuseta ukuqonda kwamazinga okusebenza kwaye uthathe amanyathelo okulungisa iinguqu ukuze kufezekiswa amagama e-body.

jobs.title: Chief Professional Surveyor
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R1 143 468 per annum, (The salary will be determined in accordance with the OSD)
jobs.summary: Chief Professional Surveyor position in Cape Town requiring a BSc in Survey or Geomatics, SAGC registration, and six years post-qualification experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of Grade 12 Certificate and a four-year Bachelor of Science Degree in Survey / Geomatics. Compulsory registration with the South African Geomatics Council (SAGC) as a Professional Surveyor on appointment. Compulsory registration with SAGC as a Professional Surveyor to perform cadastral Surveys. Minimum of 6 years post-qualification survey experience required. Job related knowledge: Programme and project management, Survey, legal and operational compliance, Survey operational communication, Process knowledge and skills, Maintenance and knowledge, Mobile equipment operating, Survey design and analysis, Research and development, Computer-aided survey applications, Creating high-performance culture, Technical consulting, Survey and professional judgment. Job related skills: Strategic capability and leadership, Problem solving and analysis, Decision making, Team leadership, Creativity, Communication (verbal and written), People management, Planning and Organising, Conflict management, Negotiation and Change management. A valid drivers licence.
jobs.duties: Design, plan, and perform surveys to solve practical survey problems (challenges), improve efficiency and enhance safety. Manage projects on the application of new and existing survey technologies. Manage and plan surveys of a varied and complex nature. Develop cost-effective solutions and approve surveys according to prescribed requirements / standards. Promote safety in line with statutory and regulatory requirements. Evaluate existing technical manuals, standard drawings and procedures to incorporate new technology. Provide expert advisory and support services. Maintain survey operational effectiveness. Manage the execution of maintenance strategy through the provision of appropriate structures, systems and resources. Set survey maintenance standards, specifications and service levels according to organisational objectives. Monitor maintenance efficiencies according to organisational goals to direct or redirect survey services. Governance. Allocate, control, monitor and report on all resources. Compile risk logs and manage significant risk according to sound risk management practice and organisational requirements. Provide technical consulting services for the operation on survey-related matters to minimise possible survey risks. Manage and implement knowledge sharing initiatives e.g. short-term assignments and secondments within and across operations, in support of individual development plans, operational requirements and return on investment. Monitor the exchange and protection of information between operations and individuals to ensure effective knowledge management according to departmental objectives. Financial management. Ensure the availability of and management of funds to meet the Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) objectives within the survey environment / services. Manage the operational capital project portfolio for the operation to ensure effective resourcing according to organisational needs and objectives. Manage the commercial value add of the discipline-related programmes and projects. Facilitate the compilation of innovation proposals to ensure validity and adherence to organisational principles. Allocate, control and monitor expenditure according to budget to ensure efficient cash flow management. People management. Manage the development, motivation and utilisation of human resources for the discipline to ensure a competent knowledge base for the continued success of the survey services according to the organisational needs and requirements. Manage subordinates’ key performance areas by setting and monitoring performance standards and taking actions to correct deviations to achieve departmental objectives.
jobs.enquiries: Mr E Daware Tel No: (021) 464 7806

jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Coloured and Indian Males, and Coloured, Indian and White Females, and Persons with disabilities.
