af.title: Hoof Professionele Landmeter
af.summary: Hoof Professionele Landmeter-pos in Cape Town wat 'n BSc in Landmeterkunde of Geomatika, SAGC-registrasie en ses jaar se ervaring na kwalifisering vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n vierjaar Baccalaureus Scientiae-graad in Landmeterkunde / Geomatika hê. Verpligte registrasie by die South African Geomatics Council (SAGC) as 'n Professionele Landmeter by aanstelling. Verpligte registrasie by SAGC as 'n Professionele Landmeter om kadastrale opmetings uit te voer. Minimum van 6 jaar se landmeet-ervaring na kwalifisering word vereis. Werksverwante kennis: Program- en projektebestuur, Landmeterkunde, regsmatige en operasionele nakoming, operasionele kommunikasie van opmetings, proseskennis en -vaardighede, instandhouding en kennis, bedryf van mobiele toerusting, opmetingsontwerp en -analise, navorsing en ontwikkeling, rekenaargesteunde opmetingstoepassings, skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur, tegniese konsultasie, opmetings- en professionele oordeel. Werksverwante vaardighede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, probleemoplossing en analise, besluitneming, spanleierskap, kreatiwiteit, kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik), mensebestuur, beplanning en organiserings, konflikbestuur, onderhandeling en veranderingbestuur. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Ontwerp, beplan en voer opmetings uit om praktiese landmeetprobleme (uitdagings) op te los, doeltreffendheid te verbeter en veiligheid te verhoog. Bestuur projekte oor die toepassing van nuwe en bestaande opmetingstegnologie. Bestuur en beplan opmetings van 'n uiteenlopende en komplekse aard. Ontwik kostedoeltreffende oplossings en keur opmetings volgens voorgeskrewe vereistes / standaarde goed. Bevorder veiligheid in ooreenstemming met statutêre en regulatoriese vereistes. Evalueer bestaande tegniese handleidings, standaardtekeninge en prosedures om nuwe tegnologie te inkorporeer. Verskaf kundige advisering en ondersteuningsdienste. Handhaaf operasionele doeltreffendheid van opmetings. Bestuur die uitvoering van instandhoudingsstrategie deur die verskaffing van toepaslike strukture, stelsels en hulpbronne. Stel instandhoudingsstandaarde, -spesifikasies en diensvlakke vir opmetings volgens organisatoriese doelwitte. Monitor instandhoudingdoeltreffendheid volgens organisatoriese doelwitte om opmetingsdienste te rig of te herlei. Goewerance. Ken toe, beheer, monitor en rapporteer oor alle hulpbronne. Stel risikologboeke op en bestuur noemenswaardige risiko volgens goeie risikobestuurpraktyk en organisatoriese vereistes. Verskaf tegniese konsultasiedienste vir die operasie rakende opmetingsverwante aangeleenthede om moontlike opmetingsrisiko's te minimaliseer. Bestuur en implementeer kennisdelingsinisiatiewe bv. korttermyn-opdragte en uitleenings binne en oor operasies, ter ondersteuning van individuele ontwikkelingsplanne, operasionele vereistes en opbrengs op belegging. Monitor die uitruil en beskerming van inligting tussen operasies en individue om effektiewe kennisbestuur volgens departementele doelwitte te verseker. Finansiële bestuur. Verseker die beskikbaarheid en bestuur van fondse om die Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) se doelwitte binne die opmetingsomgewing / -dienste te bereik. Bestuur die operasionele kapitaalprojekportefeulje vir die operasie om effektiewe hulpbronvoorsiening volgens organisatoriese behoeftes en doelwitte te verseker. Bestuur die kommersiële meerwaarde van die dissiplineverwante programme en projekte. Fasiliteer die opstel van innoveerdersvoorstelle om geldigheid en nakoming van organisatoriese beginsels te verseker. Ken toe, beheer en monitor besteding volgens begroting om effektiewe kontantvloei bestuur te verseker. Mensebestuur. Bestuur die ontwikkeling, motivering en benutting van menslike hulpbronne vir die dissipline om 'n bekwame kennisbasis vir die voortgesette sukses van die opmetingsdienste volgens organisatoriese behoeftes en vereistes te verseker. Bestuur ondergeskiktes se sleutelprestasie-areas deur prestasie-standaarde te stel en te monitor en maatreëls te tref om afwykings reg te stel om departementele doelwitte te bereik.

zu.title: Umlobi wezobuchwepheshe oyiNhloko
zu.summary: Isikhundla somLobi wezobuchwepheshe oyiNhloko eCape Town esifuna i-BSc kwiSurvey noma iGeomatics, ukubhalisa kwiSAGC, nezingu eminyakeni emithandathu yemivango yokusebenza ngemva kokuthola izifundo ezidlule.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Abafaka izinhlelo kufanele babe nesiSitifiketi seGrade 12 kanye ne-Degree ye-Bachelor of Science yeminyaka emine kwiSurvey / Geomatics. Kuyadingeka ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Geomatics Council (SAGC) njengomlobi wezobuchwepheshe ohlotshiwe lapho uthatha isikhundla. Kuyadingeka ukubhalisa kwiSAGC njengomlobi wezobuchwepheshe ohlotshiwe ukuze wenze iziSurvey zecadastral. Kudingeka okuncane ukuba neminyaka eyi-6 yamava wokwenza isurvey ngemva kokuthola izifundo ezidlule. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuphatha amaphrojekhi namaphrogramu, isurvey, ukuziphendulela ngokomthetho nangokwezimiso zokusebenza, ukuxhumana okuhlotshiwe nge survey ezisebenza, ulwazi namakhono ezinqubo, ukulondoloza nolwazi, ukusebenzisa izinto eziyihhandamshi ezihambahambayo, ukuklama nokuhlaziya isurvey, uphando nentuthuko, izinhlelo zekhompyutha ezeke isurvey, ukwakha isiko lokuza ngemvelo, ukweluleka ngemihlola yezobuchwepheshe, isurvey kanye nesahlulelo esithwebile. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ikhono elihlotshiwe namandla okuhola, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, ukwenza izinqumo, ukuhola iqembu, ukwakha, ukuxhumana (ngokukhuluma nokubhala), ukuphatha abantu, ukuhlela nokuqamba, ukuphatha izinkinga, ukuxoxa nokuqoka kanye nokuphatha izinguquko. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Klama, hlela, futhi wenze iziSurvey ukuze uxazulule izinkinga ezibucayi zesurvey (izinselelo), ukuthuthukisa isiphephelo futhi ukwenza ukusebenza kahle. Phatha amaphrojekhi ngokusetshenziswa kwamasurvey amasha nakho okwakhile kunyaka. Phatha futhi uhlele iziSurvey ezibanzi futhi eziyinkimbinkimbi. Yakha izixazululo ezibiza kakhulu ngemali kwaye wamukele isurvey ngokwezidingo / izinga ezibekiwe. Qedisa isiphephelo ngokuvumelana nezidingo zomthetho nangokwezimiso. Linganisa izincwadi ezinemininingwane yezobuchwepheshe ezikhona, imidweba emisisi namaphrogramu ukufaka izobuchwepheshe obusha. Nikeza izinsizakusebenza kanye nokuqinisekiswa okuyindida ngolwazi. Gcina ukusebenza kahle komsebenzi we survey. Phatha ukusebenza kwendlela yokulondoloza ngokunika izakhiwo, izinhlelo namatholide ahambisana. Hlela imigomo yokulondoloza i survey, imininingwane nezizinga zenkonzo ngokuhlose imigomo yenhlangano. Qapha ukusebenza kahle kokulondoloza ngokuhlose imigomo yenhlangano ukuze uholele noma uqondolose izinsiza zesurvey. Ukubusa. Hambisa, lawula, qapha futhi ulandele imali mayelana namatholide wonke. Lenga ukuthi okungalimazi nokulawula ukungalawuleki kwezinkinga ngokwezimiso ezinhle zokulawula izingozi kanye nezidingo zenhlangano. Nikeza insizakusebenza ngolwazi olunemininingwane ngendlela yokusebenza ngezindaba ezihlobene ne survey ukuze unciphise izingozi ezingenzeka esurvey. Phatha futhi usebenzise izinhlelo zokwabelana ngolwazi njengokuthi imisebenzi emifushane nokuthunyelwa kwabantu phakathi nokuqhekelelana ngokusebenza, ukusekela izinhlela zokuthuthukisa abantu ngabanye, izidingo zokusebenza kanye nenzuzo yokutshalwa imali. Qapha ukushintshana nokuvikwa kwemiyalo phakathi kwemisebenzi nabanjalo ukuxazisa ukulawula ulwazi ngokuhlose imigomo komnyango. Ukulawula imali. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuye kuvele kwaye kuhlolwe imali yokwenza imigomo yeMedium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) ngaphakathi kwendawo / izinsiza zesurvey. Phatha umbhalo wephrojekhi yenkonzo ukuxazisa izinsiza ngokohlelo lwemigomo nangokwezidingo zenhlangano. Lawula ukwengeza inzuzo yezohwebo yamaphrojekhi namaphrogramu ahlotshiwe. Qedusa ukulungiselela izingqungquthela zokuqamba ezasukilela ukuxazisa ukuthi kusebenza kahle na nokuhambisana nemiMaqembu yenhlangano. Hambisa, lawula futhi uqaphe imali echitshiyelwayo ngokweHlelo lokusebenza ukuxazisa ukulawula imali ngokuhamba kahle. Ukuphatha abantu. Phatha ukuthuthukisa, ukukhuthaza nokusebenzisa abantu abangomusa / abangabantu ngokohlelo ukuze qinisekise ukuthi baziyo kakhulu ngolwazi lwenzalo ngokuhlose izidingo nezimiso zenhlangano ukuze qinisekise ukuphumelela ngokuhamba kwesikhathi mayelana nezinsiza zesurvey. Phatha izindawo zokusebenza eziphambili zomsebenzi abangaphansi kakhulu ngokuhlela nokuqapha izinga lomsebenzi futhi uthathe izinyathelo zokulungisa ukweqa komgomo ukuze kuthole imigomo yenhlangano.

xh.title: Inkaradi eNkundla yeSalo
xh.summary: Isithuba senkaradi yokuPhakamila iSalo eCape Town esifuna i-BSc kwiSalo okanye i-Geomatics, ubhaliso kwi-SAGC, kunye neminyaka esi-6 yamava emva kokufumana isidanga.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingowona mgangatho omncinci: Abafakeli kufuneka babe neSatifikethi samaQumrhu ama-12 kwaye baneNyani yeSayensi (BSc) yeminyaka emine kwiSalo / iGeomatics. Ubhaliso oluyinyani kuBhungu laseMzantsi Afrika leGeomatics (SAGC) njengenkaradi yeSalo xa ihlawnwa. Ubhaliso oluyinyani kuSAGC njengenkaradi yeSalo ukuze yenze iintsalo ze-cadastral. Kufuneka ibe neminyaka eyi-6 evileyo inkqubo yensalo emva kokufumana isidanga. Ulwazi oluxhwele kumsebenzi: Ulawulo lweenkquba kunye neeprojekthi, iSalo, ulondolozo ngokomthetho nangokomsebenzi, unxibelelwano olusesichokweni lweSalo, ulwazi kunye namakhono ezenkqubo, ulondolozo nolwazi, ukusebenzisa izixhobo ezingenasondla, uyilo nahluko lweSalo, uphuhliso nophando, iinkqubo zesalo ezixhaswa khompyutha, ukuyila inkqubo yempilo ephezulu yomsebenzi, icebiso elingundoqo, iSalo nesigqibo esiyingqondi. Amakhono axhwele kumsebenzi: Isakhono esingundoqo sobuqhakamsheli nokuqhatha, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya, ukwenza izigqibo, ukuqhatha iqela, ubuchwephesi, unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangokubhaliya), ulawulo lwabantu, ukuqamba iqhinga lokulungiselela nokuhlela, ulawulo loquqho, ukuxoxa nolawulo lokutshintsha. Ilaysensi yomqhubi esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Yila, cwangcisa, kwaye wenze iintsalo ezisombulula iingxaki ezisesichokweni zeensalo (eziyingozi), zonyuse isiseko kwaye ziphucule ukhuseleko. Phatha iiprojekthi ngokusetyenziswa kweenknqubo ezintsha nezikhoyo zensalo. Phatha kwancwangcise iintsalo ezohlukeneyo nezinengxaki. Yila izisombulo ezibiza kancinci kunye nexabiso, kwaye uvume iintsalo ngokweemfuno/ziqondo ezibekiweyo. Khuthaza ukhuseleko ngokweemfuno zomthetho nentlungwano. Hlola iimanuali ezisesichokweni ezikhoyo, iindz ezisamgangatho kunye neenkqubo ukuze ufake iinkqubo ezintsha. Zeza icebiso lecaciso elingundoqo kunye neenkonzo zexhaso. Gcina isiseko sempilo yemisebenzi yensalo. Phatha ukuphunyiswa kwendlela yokonakele ekusingathweni ngokunika iindlela, iinkqubo nezixhobo ezifaneleyo. Misela iimigaqo yokonakeleka kwensalo, iimpawu ezingagqithiswa kunye namanqanaba enkonzo ngokomgama wobumbelelane. Qhatha iindlela zokonakeleka ngokumgama wobumbelebane ukuze ulawule okanye uqhube iinkonzo zensalo. Urharharube. Yahlathule, ulawule, uqhekeze kwaye usenge ngenxaxhe yonke imithobo yomsebenzi. Qamba iilog zomngozi kwaye ulawule umngozi omkhulu ngokweziseko sezindimi ezilungileyo zokulawula umngozi nangokweemfuno zenhlangano. Zeza iinkonzo zolwazi ezisesichokweni kundlu yangaphambili nangezindaba ezinxulumene nensalo ukuze unciphise iingozi ezinokubakho ezi nsalo. Phatha kwaye usebenzise iinmotion ezimali ngokwazi abanye ulwazi ngokomzekelo: iimisebenzi emfutshane kunye nokwabelwa iindawo ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwendlu yangaphambili, ukuxhasa iindaba ezicwangcisiweyo zophuhliso komntu ngamnye, iimfuno zomsebenzi nobuyingozi obufunyenwe ngentshisho. Qhatha ukutshintshiselana nokhuselwa kolwazi phakathi kwendlu yangaphambili nabantu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulawulwa kolwazi ngokomgama wesebe. Intengiselwano yolwazi yemali. Qinisekisa ukubakhona kunye nolawulo lwemali ukuze kugqitywe iimigama yolwazi ngeminyaka elishumi eliphezulu yokuchithwa kwemali (MTEF) ngaphakathi kwendawo/iinkonzo zensalo. Phatha iinqanaba zeeprojekthi zexabiso elikhulu ezisesichokweni zomsebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukubonelelwa ngemithobo ngokweemfuno kunye nomgama wobumbelebane. Phatha ixabiso lenkarada yentsapho yephakamiso leenkqubo kunye neeprojekthi. Qedelela ukwenziwa kwentatho ngenkuthalo ezintsha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kwazo kunye nokulandelwa kweemigaqo zenhlangano. Yahlathule, ulawule kwaye uqhekeze ukuchithwa kolwazi ngokwezixa zamabheje ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulawulwa kokuhamba kolwazi olusebenzayo. Intengiselwano yolwazi yabantu. Phatha uphuhliso, imfuneko nokusetyenziswa kwemithobo yabantu ngokwesigaba ukuze kuqinisekiswe isiseko selwazi elisebenzayo ngokwemfuno yokuphumelela iinkonzo zensalo ngokomgama wobumbelebane. Phatha iindawo ezingundoqo zokwenza izigaba ezisezantsi ngokumisela nokuqhatha iimigaqo yemisebenzi kwaye uthathe iinyathelo ukuze ulungise iintshukumo ezingafanelekanga ukuze kufikelelwe kumgama wesebe.

af.title: Hoof Professionele Landmeter
af.summary: Lei kadastrale opmetingsprojekte en ontwikkel kostedoeltreffende opmetingsoplossings vir die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Mahikeng.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n vierjaar Baccalaureus in Wetenskap-graad in Opmeting / Geomatics. Verpligte registrasie by die South African Geomatics Council (SAGC) as 'n Professionele Landmeter by aanstelling. Verpligte registrasie by SAGC as 'n Professionele Landmeter om kadastrale opmetings uit te voer. Minimum van 6 jaar post-kwalifikasie opmetingservaring vereis. Werksverwante kennis: Program- en projekbestuur, Opmeting, regstalkundige en operasionele nakoming, Opmetingsoperasionele kommunikasie, Proseskennis en vaardighede, Onderhoud en kennis, Mobiele toerustingbedrywing, Opmetingsontwerp en -analise, Navorsing en ontwikkeling, Rekenaargesteunde opmetingstoepassings, Skep van hoëprestasiekultuur, Tegniese konsultasie, Opmetings- en professionele oordeel. Werksverwante vaardighede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, Probleemoplossing en analise, Besluitneming, Spanleierskap, Kreatiwiteit, Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), Personebestuur, Beplanning en organisering, Konflikbestuur, Onderhandeling en veranderingbestuur. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Ontwerp, beplan en voer opmetings uit om praktiese opmetingsprobleme (uitdagings) op te los, doeltreffendheid te verbeter en veiligheid te verhoog. Bestuur projekte oor die toepassing van nuwe en bestaande opmetingstegnologieë. Bestuur en beplan opmetings van 'n uiteenlopende en komplekse aard. Ontwikkel kostedoeltreffende oplossings en keur opmetings goed volgens voorgeskrewe vereistes / standaarde. Bevorder veiligheid in ooreenstemming met statutêre en regulasievereistes. Evalueer bestaande tegniese handleidings, standaardtekeninge en prosedures om nuwe tegnologie te inkorporeer. Verskaf kundige advies- en ondersteuningsdienste. Handhaaf opmetingsoperasionele doeltreffendheid. Bestuur die uitvoering van die onderhoudsstrategie deur die voorsiening van toepaslike strukture, stelsels en hulpbronne. Stel opmetingsonderhoudstandaarde, spesifikasies en diensvlakke volgens organisatoriese doelwitte. Monitor onderhoudsdoeltreffendheid volgens organisatoriese doelwitte om opmetingsdienste te rig of te herlei. Bestuur. Allokasie, beheer, monitering en verslagdoening oor alle hulpbronne. Stel risikologe op en bestuur beduidende risiko volgens gesonde risikobestuurpraktyk en organisatoriese vereistes. Verskaf tegniese konsultasiedienste vir die operasie oor opmetingsverwante aangeleenthede om moontlike opmetingsrisiko's te minimaliseer. Bestuur en implementeer kennisdelingsinisiatiewe bv. korttermynopdragte en uitleenings binne en dwarsoor operasies, ter ondersteuning van individuele ontwikkelingsplanne, operasionele vereistes en opbrengs op belegging. Monitor die uitruil en beskerming van inligting tussen operasies en individue om effektiewe kennisbestuur volgens departementele doelwitte te verseker. Finansiële bestuur. Verseker die beskikbaarheid en bestuur van fondse om die Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) doelwitte binne die opmetingsomgewing / -dienste te bereik. Bestuur die operasionele kapitaalprojekportefeulje vir die operasie om effektiewe hulpbronvoorsiening volgens organisatoriese behoeftes en doelwitte te verseker. Bestuur die kommersiële meerwaarde van die dissiplineverwante programme en projekte. Fasiliteer die opstel van innovasievoorstelle om geldigheid en nakoming van organisatoriese beginsels te verseker. Allokasie, beheer en monitering van besteding volgens begroting om effektiewe kontantvloedbestuur te verseker. Personebestuur. Bestuur die ontwikkeling, motivering en benutting van menslike hulpbronne vir die dissipline om 'n bekwame kennisbasis vir die volgehoue sukses van die opmetingsdienste volgens die organisatoriese behoeftes en vereistes te verseker. Bestuur ondergeskiktes se sleutelprestasiegebiede deur prestasiestandaarde te stel en te moniteer en maatreëls te tref om afwykings reg te stel om departementele doelwitte te bereik.

zu.title: Inkantili Yezobuchwepheshe Ephambili
zu.summary: Hola amaphrojekthi okulinga okwemibhalo yezwe futhiuthuthukisa izixazululi zokulinga ezibambezele kakhudlwana ku Department of Land Reform and Rural Development e Mahikeng.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi kwesibalo: Abafaki izicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi se Grade 12 kanye ne Degree ye Bachelor of Science eminyakeni emine kwi Survey / Geomatics. Ukuqokwa okuyisimiso ngokuqinisekiswa yi South African Geomatics Council (SAGC) njengesincasuli sabahloli besive ekuthatheni isikhundla. Ukuqokwa okuyisimiso ngokuqinisekiswa yi SAGC njengesincasuli sabahloli besive ukwenza imigwaqo yezinhlanganisela zezibhalo. Kudingeka kube nokuhlangenwe nakho okungu 6 kweminyaka emva kokuthola iziqu ekulingeni. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Izinhlelo nokuphathwa kwephrojekthi, Ukulinga, ukuziphendukela ngomthetho nokuhamba kahle kokusebenza, Ukuxhumana kokusebenza kokulinga, Ulwazi namakhono enqubo, Ukugcina kanye nolwazi, Ukusebenzisa izinto ezingabantu zokuhamba, Ukuklama nokuhlaziya ukulinga, Ukuqashwa nokuthuthukiswa, Izinhlelo zokulinga ezisebenza ngokwesibhaxa, Ukudala isiko lokusebenza ngamandla amakhulu, Ukucwelwa kwabezobuchwepheshe, Ukulinga nokwahlulela ngobuchwepheshe. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ikusasa elinamandla nokuba ngumholi, Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokucazulula, Ukwenza izinqumo, Ukubeka iqhaza ekubeni ngumholi, Ukudala, Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe), Ukuphatha abantu, Ukucubungula nokuhlela, Ukuphatha izinkinga, Ukuxoxisana nokuphatha izinguquko. Ilayisensi yokushayela okuyisimiso.
zu.duties: Klama, hlela, futhi wenze ukulolonga ukuze uxazulule izinkinga zokulinga eziyizithakazelo ezisebenzayo, ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kahle nokukhulisa ukuphepha. Phatha amaphrojekthi ngokuqondanishe kwezinto zokulinga ezintsha nezikhona. Phatha futhi uhlele ukulolonga okuyizinga nokuyinkimbinkimbi. Thuthukisa izixazululi ezingabiza kakhudlwana futhi vumela izilinganisi ngokwezidingo / izinga ezinikeziwe. Khuthaza ukuphepha ngokuhambisana nezidingo ngomthetho nangokuqondiswa. Hlola izibhalo zobuchwepheshe ezikhona, izizibhalo eziyizinga kanye nezinqubo ukuzifaka uthuthukiswa olusha. Nikeza ngeluleko elibukhulu kwayo ngokobuchwepheshe kanye nongakuhluza ukuqasheka kwemisebenzi. Gcina ukusebenza kahle kokulinga. Phatha ukwenziwa kohlelo lokulondoloza ngokunikeza izakhiwo, izinhlelo, kanye nenhleleleko efanelekile. Hlela izinga lokulondoloza ukulinga, izinkomba, izinga lokukhule inkonzo ngokohlelo lenhlangano. Buka ukusebenza kahle kokulondoloza ngokohlelo lenhlangano ukuze uqondise noma uqondise kabusha izinkonzo zokulinga. Ukuphathwa. Hlukanisa, lawula, buka, futhi kukhombisa kuzo zonke izinhleleleko. Hlela ukubhaliswa kwengozi yomkhondo ukuze ulawule imikhondo enkulu ngokuhamba kwemikhakha yokulawula imikhondo kanye nezidingo zenhlangano. Nikeza ngongakuhluza ngokobuchwepheshe kumsebenzi ngakho-ke ngakho-ke ezindabeni ezihlobene nokulinga ukunciphisa imikhondo yokulinga engaba khona. Phatha futhi ufeze izinhlelo zokwabelana ngolwazi, isib. ukwabiwa kwemisebenzi yasekhishini nangaphezu kwemikhakha nangaphakathi nangaphandle kokusebenza, ngokusekelwa kuhlelo lokuqeqesha umuntu ngamunye, izidingo zokusebenza, nenzalo yentulo. Buka ukushintshana nokuvikelwa kolwazi phakathi kokusebenza nakubantu ngamunye ukuze kuqiniseke ukuphathwa kolwazi okuqondile ngokohlelo lomnyango. Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Qiniseka ukuthi zikhona ukuphathwa kwemali ukuze kuhlangatshezwe nemigomo yase Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) ngaphakathi kwezindiza / izinkonzo zokulinga. Phatha i-potfoliyo yephrojekthi yokugcizelela imali yokusebenza ukuze kuqiniseke ukutholakala kongakuhluza ngokohlelo lwemfuno nangomgomo wenhlangano. Phatha inani eliveza izinzuzo zokuhweba kumuhlela nangamaphrojekthi ahlobene nomkhakha. Sita ukuhlanganiswa kwezinkulumo-mpikiswano zokuthuthukiswa ukuze kuqiniseke ukusemthethweni nokuhambisana nemicimbe yenhlangano. Hlukanisa, lawula, futhi buke ukuchithwa ngokuhlela ukuze kuqiniseke ukuphathwa kwesabelo somzamo okusebenzayo. Ukuphathwa kwabantu. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa, ukukhuthaza, nokusetshenziswa kwesikhulu sabantu ngohlelo ukuze kuqiniseke isisekelo sabantu abanelwazi abadingekayo ngokuqhubekeka kempumelelo yezinkonzo zokulinga ngokomfuno nangokwezidingo zenhlangano. Phatha izindawo ezibalulekile zokusebenza zabaholi ngokuhlela nangokubuka izinga lokusebenza, bese uthatha izinyathelo zokulungisa iziphaphu ukuze kufinyelelwe emigomweni yomnyango.

xh.title: NoMmeli weZifundo zeNzululwazi oyiNtloko
xh.summary: Qhuba iiprojekthi zonzululwazi zokulinganisa amarhwebo womhlaba kwaye uphuhlise izisombululo ezizele ngexabiso zonzululwazi ze-Department of Land Reform and Rural Development eMahikeng.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaka izicelo kufuneka babe neSatifikedi seQela lesi-12 kwaye benalo iBachelors Degree yeSayensi eminyaka emine kwiSurvey / Geomatics. Ukubhalwa ngokungenakusalelwa kwi-South African Geomatics Council (SAGC) njengengcali yezululwazi ekulinganiseni nalapho kubekwa esikhundleni. Ukubhalwa ngokungenakusalelwa kwi-SAGC njengengcali yezululwazi ekulinganiseni ukwenza iimlinganiselo zamashishini. Kufuneka ube nomava ongazii eminyaka engu-6 kwizululwazi emva kokufumana isidanga. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulawulo lwenkqubo neprojekthi, Ulwazi bolulo, ukuzalanisa ngokomthetho nakwimisebenzi, Unxibelelwano lwezokusebenza kolwazi bolulo, Ulwazi namakhono enkcubeko, Ulondolozo nolwazi, Ukuqhuba izixhobo ezingahambayo, Ukuya kwindalo yolwazi nokuhlalutya, Uphononongo nophuhliso, Izicelo zekhompyutha zolwazi bolulo, Ukudala inkqubo yemvelo eyimveliso ephakamileyo, Iingcebiso ezinobuchule, Ulwazi bolulo negqibo elungileyo. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ikhono elibukhali lokulawula nokuba ngumbheki-mbhekiso, Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya, Ukwenza iigqibo, Ukulawula iqela, Ubuchule bokudala, Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangesibhalo), Ulawulo labantu, Ukuqamba nokuhlela, Ulawulo lwengxaki, Ukupecela iingcebiso ngokutshintsha, nokuLawula utshintsho. Ilayisensi yokushayela ebe nayiso.
xh.duties: Yila, cwangcisa, kwaye wenze iimlinganiselo ukusombulula iingxaki zezesibini zolwazi bolulo (iingqineliswa), ukuphucula ukusebenza kakuhle nokwandusa ukhuseleko. Lawula iiprojekthi ngokusetyenziswa kweenkqabo ezintsha nezikhoyo zolwazi. Lawula kwaye ucwangcise iimlinganiselo ezahlukeneyo nezibucayi. Phuhlisa izisombululo ezizele ngexabiso kwaye uvume iimlinganiselo ngokomthetho ochaziweyo / ngokweemigangatho. Khuthaza ukhuseleko ngokuvumelana neemfuno zomthetho nangokulawulwayo. Linganisa iimanuali ezizele ngobuchule, iizalo eziyimigangatho kwaye ziinkqubo ukuze ziqqitywe ubuchule obutsha. Zisa iingcebiso zobuchule kwaye unike inkxaso. Gcina ukusebenza kakuhle kolwazi. Lawula ukuphunyezwa kwenkqubo yokulondolozo ngokunika iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo, iisistim namancedo. Misela iimigangatho yokulondolozwa kolwazi, iimfuno namakhono okukhonza ngokweemigangatho yeqela. Qapha ukusebenza kakuhle kokulondolozwa ngokweemigangatho yeqela ukuyalela okanye ukuyalela kwakhona iinkonzo zolwazi. Urhwebo. Yahlula, lawula, qapha kwaye uchaze ngayo yonke imisebenzi. Hlengahlengisa iifayile ezichaza iingozi kwaye ulawule ingozi ebalulekileyo ngokomthetho ochanekileyo wokulawula iingozi nangokweemfuno zeqela. Zisa iinkonzo zamaqiniseki obuchule ekusebenzeni kwiindlela ezimalunga nolwazi ukunciphisa iingozi ezinokubakho kolwazi. Lawula kwaye usebenzise iinkqubo zokwabelana ngolwazi ezindi mzekelo, iimisebenzi yexesha elifutshane nezo kubekwa kwindawo ezingaphakathi nangaphaya kokusebenza, ukuxhasa iinkqubo zophuhliso lomntu, iimfuno zokusebenza nokubuyisa nzuzo kutyalo-mali. Qapha ukutshintshiselana nokukhuselwa kolwazi phakathi kokusebenza nabantu ukugcina ukusebenza kakuhle kolwazi ngokweemigangatho yesebe. Ulawulo lweemali. Qinisekisa ukufumaneka nokulawula amafuthu okuhlangabezana neemgangatho ye-Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) ngaphakathi kwendalo yezululwazi / iinkonzo. Lawula iqela leeprojekthi zemali yokusebenza kule ndawo kuqinisekise ukubonelelwa ngokusebenza ngokweemfuno zemigangatho yeqela. Lawula ixabiso lerhweba elifakwa yinkqubo neeprojekthi ezimalunga nesi sifundo. Khokela ukulungiselelwa iingcebiso zobuchwe ukugcina inyaniso nokulandela imigaqo yeqela. Yahlula, lawula kwaye uqaphe ukuchithwa ngokubhaliswe kwexabiso ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulawula ngokusebenza kwemali esemzimbeni. Ulawulo labantu. Lawula ukuphuhlisa, ukwakh’umoya wentshukumo nokusetyenziswa kwamaphulo abantu kwesi sifundo ukuze kuqinisekiswe isiseko sezalathi kulwazi ngokusombulula iingxaki ngokweemfuno namakhono oqela. Lawula iindawo ezibalulekileyo zokusebenza ezizele ngokumisela nokuqaphela iimigangatho yokusebenza nangezenzo zokulungisa iingxaki ukuze kufikelelwe kumgangatho wesebe.

Minimum of 3 years relevant experience at junior management level. A valid driver’s licence. In- depth knowledge of Policy Development and Monitoring and Evaluation techniques. Knowledge and understanding of Government Development Policies, e.g., National Development Plan, National Growth Path, Planning and Budgeting Framework etc. Research Methodology. Good Corporate Governance Principles. Knowledge in Human and Financial Management. Job related skills: Project management. Communication (verbal and written). Agricultural development. Conflict management. Stakeholder mobilisation. Financial management. Computer literacy. Information management and Analytical thinking. Willingness to travel and ability to work under limited supervision. Willingness to work extended hours when a need arise.

Facilitate the engagement with relevant stakeholders on policy matters. Identify issues to necessitate policy review and participate in policy formulation forum. Facilitate capacity building session for officials and stakeholders on policies and programmes developed. Participate in the development and review of standard operating procedures (SOP). Manage the implementation of the programmes for the development of procedures towards commercialisation. Manage the process of identifying procedures to be supported. Facilitate the establishment and management of partnership between procedures and development partners. Organise capacity building and training programmes for producers. Facilitate the appointment of prospective strategic partners and service providers. Facilitate resource mapping and mobilisation of all identified farms for development in line with departmental priorities, Annual Performance Plan and Operational Plan of the Branch. Facilitate the development and approval of project registers. Facilitate farm assessments and feasibility studies. Facilitate the compilation of reports and development of Business Plans. Co- ordinate processes towards approval of projects. Co-ordinate the compilation of the approval of documents and conduct quality assurance. Ensure alignment and compliance of submissions to the policies / SOPs. Present the submissions to the relevant committees and structures. Manage the implementation of the approved projects. Facilitate the effective promotion and practice of good corporate governance and compliance with financial and human resource. Facilitate ongoing monitoring and reporting of projects under implementation. Manage human and financial resources in line with relevant policy and legislative framework. Manage and mitigate identified operational and fraud risks. Manage and implement internal and external controls in line with policies.

af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir ondersteuning vir grondontwikkeling in Cape Town, wat beleidontwikkeling en post-nedersettingondersteuning binne die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development fasiliteer.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Baccalaureusgraad in Landbou-ekonomie / Agri-besigheid / Landboubestuur / B-Com Landbou (NQF Level 7) of verwante ekwivalent kwalifikasies. Minimum van 3 jaar se relevante ervaring op junior bestuursvlak. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van die departement se beleide, voorskrifte en praktyke met betrekking tot Land Reform. Kennis en begrip van sektorbehoeftes en besigheidsvereistes. Diepgaande kennis van beleidontwikkeling en monitering en evalueringstegnieke. Kennis en begrip van Regeringsontwikkelingsbeleide, bv., National Development Plan, National Growth Path, Planning and Budgeting Framework ens. Navorsingsmetodologie. Goeie beginsels van korporatiewe bestuur. Kennis van menslike en finansiële bestuur. Werksverwante vaardighede: Projekbestuur. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Landbou-ontwikkeling. Konflikbestuur. Belanghebbende-mobilisering. Finansiële bestuur. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Inligtingsbestuur en analitiese denke. Bereidwilligheid om te reis en vermoë om met beperkte toesig te werk. Bereidwilligheid om lang ure te werk wanneer die behoefte ontstaan.
af.duties: Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling, hersiening en bestuur van beleide en programme vir grondontwikkeling en post-nedersettingondersteuning. Fasiliteer betrokkenheid by relevante belanghebbendes oor beleid-aangeleenthede. Identifiseer kwessies wat beleidshersiening noodsaak en neem deel aan beleidformuleringsforum. Fasiliteer kapasiteitsbou-sessies vir amptenare en belanghebbendes oor beleide en programme wat ontwikkel is. Neem deel aan die ontwikkeling en hersiening van standaard bedryfsprosedures (SOP). Bestuur die implementering van die programme vir die ontwikkeling van prosedures tot kommersialisering. Bestuur die proses om prosedures te identifiseer wat ondersteun moet word. Fasiliteer die vestiging en bestuur van vennootskap tussen prosedures en ontwikkelingsvennote. Reël kapasiteitsbou- en opleidingsprogramme vir produsente. Fasiliteer die aanstelling van voornemende strategiese vennote en diensverskaffers. Fasiliteer hulpbronkartering en -mobilisering van alle geïdentifiseerde plase vir ontwikkeling in ooreenstemming met departementele prioriteite, Annual Performance Plan en Operational Plan van die Tak. Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling en goedkeuring van projeksregisters. Fasiliteer plaaswaarderings en haalbaarheidsstudies. Fasiliteer die samestelling van verslae en ontwikkeling van Business Plans. Koördineer prosesse vir goedkeuring van projekte. Koördineer die samestelling van die goedkeuring van dokumente en voer gehaltversekering uit. Verseker belyning en nakoming van voorleggings met die beleide / SOP's. Dien die voorleggings voor aan die relevante komitees en strukture. Bestuur die implementering van die goedgekeurde projekte. Fasiliteer die effektiewe bevordering en beoefening van goeie korporatiewe bestuur en nakoming van finansiële en menslike hulpbronne. Fasiliteer deurlopende monitering en verslagdoening van projekte wat geïmplementeer word. Bestuur menslike en finansiële hulpbronne in ooreenstemming met relevante beleid en wetgewende raamwerk. Bestuur en matig geïdentifiseerde operasionele en bedrogrisiko's. Bestuur en implementeer interne en eksterne beheer in ooreenstemming met beleide.

zu.title: Iphini Lomqondisi: Inkuxazekayo Yokuxhasa Ukuthuthukiswa Kwendlu
zu.summary: Iphini lomqondisi lokuxhasa ukuthuthukiswa kwendlu eCape Town,ukuqondisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo nokuqondiswa ngemva kokuhlelwa kulezi zindlu ngaphakathi kwe Department of Land Reform and Rural Development.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi kwazo: Abafaka izibhalo kumele banesisitifikadi se Grade 12 kanye ne-Bachelor's Degree ku-Agricultural Economics / Agri-Business / Agricultural Management / B-Com Agriculture (NQF Level 7) noma iziqu ezifanayo ezinhlobonhlobo. Ukwesiswelo kokuqashelwa okungenani iminyaka engu-3 esimeni esithintelayo ezingeni lobuqondisi. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngezinqubomgomo, izimiso nezinkambiso zomnyango ezihlobene nokulungiswa kwendlu. Ulwazi nokuqonda izidingo zesigaba nezidingo zebhizinisi. Ulwazi olujulile ngokuqondiswa kwezinqubomgomo kanye nokubhekezelela nokuhlolwa kwezindlela. Ulwazi nokuqonda izinqubomgomo zokuqondiswa kahulumeni, njll, i-National Development Plan, i-National Growth Plan, ne-Planning and Budgeting Framework. Inqubo yocwaningo. Izinhlobo ezinhle zokubusa ibhizinisi. Ulwazi ekuphatheni abantu nezimali. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuphathwa kwemiklamo. Ukuxhumana (ngesandla nangomlomo). Ukuthuthukiswa kwezolimo. Ukuphathwa kwezinkinga. Ukubumba nokuqondisa izindikimba. Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ulwazi lokuqonda ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuphathwa kolwazi nokucabanga ngesimo sezinto. Ukuthanda ukuhamba nendawo yokusebenza ngaphandle komqondisi ongaphansi. Ukuthanda ukusebenza ihora elingaphezulu uma kunesidingo.
zu.duties: Qondisa ukuthuthukiswa, ukubuyekezwa nokuphathwa kwezinqubomgomo kanye nemicimbe yokuthuthukiswa kwendlu nokuxhaswa ngemva kokuhlelwa. Qondisa ukuxhumana nezindikimba ezithintekayo ngemibuzo yezinqubomgomo. Hlola izindlela ezibangela ukuthi kubuyekezwe inqubomgomo, ulale kwisebe lezinqubomgomo zokuqondiswa. Qondisa ukuthuthukiswa kwamandla abasebenzi kanye namasebe azinhlangano ezihlobene nezesinqubomgomo nemicimbe ethuthukisiwe. Lingana ekuthuthukisweni nokubukekeni kwezinqubomgomo ezitholakala ngokugqamile (SOP). Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwemiklamo yokuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo eziholela ekuthuthukisweni kwezohwebo. Phatha inqubo yokuhlonza izinqubomgomo okumele zixhaswe. Qondisa ukusungula nokuphathwa kwezinxulumano phakathi kwezinqubomgomo nezindikimba zokuthuthukiswa. Hlela imiklamo yamandla nokuqeqesha abakhiqizi. Qondisa ukubekwa kwezindikimba ezibusisekile nabakhiqizi. Qondisa ukulondolozwa kwamafa kanye nokubumba nokuqondisa amapulani ohlelo lonyaka nokuqondiswa kwesiqu sephandle. Qondisa ukuthuthukiswa nokugunyazwa kwemibhalo yomklamo. Qondisa ukuhlola amapulani nezindaba ezingadlulisiwe. Qondisa ukubhala imibiko nokuthuthukiswa kwe-Business Plan. Hlanganisa izinqubo eziholela ekugunyazweni kwemiklamo. Hlanganisa ukuhlanganiswa kwemibhalo yokugunyazwa kanye nokuhlolwa kwemithetho. Qinisekisa ukulingana nokuhambisana ngezinqubomgomo ezingunqamula / ama-SOPs. Yenza imibalo kwamakomidi ahlobene namagunya okwakha uhlelo. Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwemiklamo egunyaziwe. Qondisa ukuthuthukiswa okuhle kanye nokuzinza okuhle kwezenzo ezinhle kahulumeni kwezimali nabantu. Qondisa ukuqapha nokubika ngemiklamo eqhubekayo. Phatha abantu nezimali ngendlela ehambisana nomthethosisekelo nezinqubomgomo. Phatha futhi unciphise okungenayo kwamapulani.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Inkxaso Yophuhliso Lomhlaba
xh.summary: Isekela Mongameli wenkxaso yophuhliso lomhlaba e Cape Town, unceda ekuphuhliseni iinkqubo zomgaqo-nkqubo nasekunikezeni inkxaso emva kokuzinza kwisebe le Land Reform and Rural Development.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezisingezantsi: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethe se Grade 12 kwaye babe ne Degree ye Bachelor kwi Agricultural Economics / Agri-Business / Agricultural Management / B-Com Agriculture (NQF Level 7) okwezifundo ezilinganayo ezinxulumene nesi. Ubuncinane i 3 iminyaka yamava ahambelanayo kwinqanaba lolawulo lwabasebenzi abangagqithanga inqanaba eliphakamileyo. Ilayisensi yokushayela eseleyo. Ulwazi oluxhelene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngeenkqabo zomgaqo-nkqubo, imigaqo namaziko esebe ngokunxulumene no Luguculo Lomhlaba. Ulwazi nokuqonda iimfuno zesigaba neemfuno zoshishino. Ulwazi olujulileyo malunga nokuphuhliso kweenkqubo zomgaqo-nkqubo nendlela zokuqonda nokuhlola. Ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqabo zophuhliso zorhulumente, umz., National Development Plan, National Growth Path, i Planning and Budgeting Framework njl. Indlela yophando. Iimvisiswano ezilungele iNkampani. Ulwazi kwilawulo labantu nezimali. Amakhono axhelene nomsebenzi: Ulawulo lomsebenzi. Unxibelelwano (ngolwahlulo nangokubhalwayo). Uphuhliso kolimo. Ulawulo lwengxaki. Ukuqhankqalaza abathintatho. Ulawulo lwezimali. Ulwazi lweekhompyutha. Ulawulo lwolwazi nokuqonda ngokwahlula-hlula. Ukulungele ukuhamba nokuze kusebenze ngaphandle kolawulo olulinganisiweyo. Ukulungele ukusebenza iiyure ezinganganga xa kufuneka.
xh.duties: Yenza lula ukuphuhlisa, ukuphonononga noku lawula iinkqubo zomgaqo-nkqubo nama phojekthi yophuhliso lomhlaba nankxaso emva kokuzinza. Yenza lula unxibelelwano namathintatho axhelene nendaba zomgaqo-nkqubo. Phawula iingxaki ezenza kubekho umdla wokuphonononga umgaqo-nkqubo uthathe inxaxheba kwiforum yokwenza umgaqo-nkqubo. Yenza lula i session yokwakha amandla abasebenzi namathintatho kumgaqo-nkqubo naku phojekthi eziphuhlisiweyo. Thatha inxaxheba ekuphuhliseni nasekuphononongeni iinkqubo ezizele zokusebenza (SOP). Lawula ukusebenza kweekhomnyithi zophuhliso lwe nkqubo eziya kutshaya iinkampani ezinkulu. Lawula inkqubo yokuqaphela iinkqubo eziza kuxhaswa. Yenza lula ukusekwa nokulawula ubudlelwane phakathi kweenkampani namaphuhlisi. Hlela inkqubo yokwakha amandla nokuyila abavelisi. Yenza lula ukumiswa kwabathintatho abangabathembekileyo nabahlinzi. Yenza lula ukumiswa kwemephu yemithombo nokuqhankqalaza zonke iifirmu ezikhethiweyo zophuhliso ngokwelanda izigqibo zesebe, i Annual Performance Plan ne Operational Plan ye Branch. Yenza lula ukuphuhlisa nokuvunywa kwemibhalo ye phojekthi. Yenza lula ukuvavanywa kweefirmu nefundo yokwenzeka. Yenza lula ukuqamba iingxelo noku phuhlisa i Business Plans. Lawula iinkqubo eziya kuvunyweni kweeprojekthi. Lawula ukuqamba kweemibhalo yokuvuma kwaye uqinise ise ko ubulungana. Qinisekisa ukuvanisana nokuzithoba kwemi sicalo kwinkqubo zomgaqo-nkqubo / SOPs. Yenza miso eku komityi naku strucutres axhelene nayo. Lawula ukusetyenziswa kweeprojekthi ezivunyiweyo. Yenza lula ukuthuthuziswa nokwenziwa koluntu oluhle noku zithoba ngokwerhulu mento yemali nangabantu. Yenza lula ukuqapha nokwenza ingxelo ngokuqhubekayo kwe projekthi ezisebenziyo. Lawula abantu nezimali ngokulandelana nemigaqo nentlalo yoluntu. Lawula kwaye unciphise iingozi ezikhethiweyo zokusebenza noshintsho. Lawula kwaye usebenzise izilawulo zangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokulandelana iinkqabo.

jobs.title: Assistant Registrar of Deeds: Examination and Sorting
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (all-inclusive package to be structured in accordance with the rules for MMS)
jobs.summary: Assistant Registrar of Deeds needed in Johannesburg to monitor deed examinations, check registrability, and provide guidance to conveyancers at a salary of R932,292 per annum.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Law / National Diploma Deeds Registration Law / Buris / B Proc / LLB or relevant equivalent qualifications. Minimum of 4 years’ experience at junior management level in Deeds environment. Extensive and proven ability in knowing, interpreting, and applying various legislation and Acts pertaining to registration of Deeds including (but not limited to): Deeds Registries Act, Sectional Titles Act, Ordinances, Proclamations, Case Law, Common Law. Ability to address a professional audience comfortably. Ability to convey knowledge to others. Planning and execution skills. Communication skills. Project Management skills.
jobs.duties: Monitor examination of deeds and documents. Check deeds and documents for registrability and take corrective measures. Grant hearing to Conveyancers, make ruling and provide guidance. Provide inputs for the update of deeds practice manual, legislation, and draft circulars. Report on examination team performance, standards, and turnaround times. Update acts, manuals, and circulars. Execute deeds. Validate that appointed appeared has signed execution clause / request for registration. Verify validity date of relevant certificates. Sign all deeds and documents that are registrable. Report problems with regard to execution of deeds, to ARD / DROD in charge of execution. Draft reports to court. Receive the notice of motions and all supporting documents. Peruse notices of motions and supporting documents. Research the facts there in. Compile a report to court and attach all relevant documents. Manage the execution of deeds and documents. Attend to the requests for late and expedited execution of deeds and arrange for final black booking. Notify conveyancers regarding problems encountered on deeds at execution and provide guidance. Monitor execution register for Conveyancers. Reject deeds that are not registrable. Attend to simultaneous registration with other offices. Manage distribution of deeds. Verify the information on the distribution list with actual deeds batches and spot-check. Verify returned deeds against distribution list and initiate corrective measures. Manage statistics, exception reports and implement corrective measures. Prevent and address backlogs. Attend to queries relating to deeds on the system. Authorize request for withdrawal of deeds. Manage the update procedure manual.
jobs.enquiries: Ms LR Maloka / Mr HP Nkwinika Tel No: (011) 843 8338 / 8314
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: Office of the Registrar of Deeds: at 28 Harrison Street, Marshalltown 2107, Johannesburg, 2001 Candidates are also encouraged to apply by using this link http://deedsportal.deeds.gov.za before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. Applications and supporting documents sent to us that are not specified in the advertisement for the post that you are applying for will not be accepted
jobs.notes: EE Targets: Coloured and Indian Males and African, Coloured, Indian and White Females, and Persons with disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form, (a nomination letter if required) and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. All shortlisted candidate, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidates suitability based on the posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre-entry programme offered by the National School of       Government          (NSG).       Find      course       details     here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/ appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re-advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. af.title: Assistent-Registrateur van Aktes: Ondersoek en Sortering
af.summary: Assistent-Registrateur van Aktes word in Johannesburg benodig om akte-onderzoek te monitor, registreerbaarheid te kontroleer en leiding aan transporteurders te gee teen 'n salaris van R932,292 per jaar.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Regte / Nasionale Diploma Akteregistrasie Regte / Buri / B Proc / LLB of toepaslike gelykwaardige kwalifikasies. Minimum van 4 jaar se ervaring op juniorbestuursvlak in 'n Akte-omgewing. Uitgebreide en bewese vermoë om verskeie wetgewing en Wette rakende registrasie van Aktes te ken, te interpreteer en toe te pas, insluitend (maar nie beperk tot nie): Akteregistere Wet, Deeltitel Wet, Ordonnansies, Proklamasies, Case Law, Common Law. Vermoë om gemaklik met 'n professionele gehoor te kommunikeer. Vermoë om kennis aan ander oor te dra. Beplannings- en uitvoeringsvaardighede. Kommunikasievaardighede. Projekbestuursvaardighede.
af.duties: Monitor ondersoek van aktes en dokumente. Kontroleer aktes en dokumente vir registreerbaarheid en neem regstellende maatreëls. Verleen 'n hearing aan transporteurders, doen uitspraak en gee leiding. Voer insette vir die opdatering van die aktepraktykhandleiding, wetgewing, en konsep sirkulaires. Rapporteer oor ondersoekspan se prestasie, standaarde, en deurloentye. Dateer wette, handleidings, en sirkulaires op. Voer aktes uit. Bevestig dat die aangestelde verskynende die uitvoeringsklousule / versoek om registrasie onderteken het. Verifieer die geldigheidsdatum van toepaslike sertifikate. Teken alle aktes en dokumente wat registreerbaar is. Rapporteer probleme met betrekking tot uitvoering van aktes, aan ARD / DROD in beheer van uitvoering. Opstelle van verslae aan die hof. Ontvang die kennisgewing van motiverings en alle ondersteunende dokumente. Deursoek kennisgewings van motiverings en ondersteunende dokumente. Ondersoek die feite daarin. Stel 'n verslag aan die hof op en heg alle toepaslike dokumente aan. Bestuur die uitvoering van aktes en dokumente. Tree op versoek vir laat en bespoedigde uitvoering van aktes en reël finale bespreking. Stel transporteurders in kennis oor probleme wat by aktes tydens uitvoering ondervind is en gee leiding. Monitor uitvoeringsregister vir transporteurders. Wys aktes wat nie registreerbaar is nie af. Tree op met gelyktydige registrasie met ander kantore. Bestuur verspreiding van aktes. Verifieer die inligting op die verspreidingslys met werklike akte-batches en doen steekproewe. Verifieer terugbesorgde aktes teen die verspreidingslys en stel regstellende maatreëls in werking. Bestuur statistiek, uitsonderingsverslae en implementeer regstellende maatreëls. Voorkom en spreek agterstande aan. Hanteer navrae rakende aktes op die stelsel. Magtig versoek vir onttrekking van aktes. Bestuur die opdatering van die prosedurehandleiding.

zu.title: Assistant Registrar of Deeds: Examination and Sorting
zu.summary: Kudingeka i-Assistant Registrar of Deeds eJohannesburg ukuze aqaphele ukuhlolwa kwamadidiyedi, ahlole ukuthi angabhaliswa ngemvume, futhi anikeze imiyalo kubadayimela bendawo ngeholo elingu-R932,292 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Abafaki izicelo kumele babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 kanye neNational Diploma in Law / National Diploma Deeds Registration Law / Buris / B Proc / LLB noma izifundo ezilinganayo ezihlobene. Okuncane okungu-4 iminyaka yohlelo emazinga obulungu obuncane emndeni wamadidiyedi. Isikhathi eside futhi ikhono eliqinisekisiwe ekwazini, ekuchazeni, nasekusebenziseni imithetho ehlobene nesibhalwa samadidiyedi okuhlanganisa (kodwa kungakhawulelwa): Deeds Registries Act, Sectional Titles Act, Ordinances, Proclamations, Case Law, Common Law. Ikhono lokukhuluma ngokuzethemba kumbutho wabasebenzi. Ikhono lokudlulisa ulwazi kwabanye. Ikhono lokuhlela nokuphumeza. Izakhono zokuxhumana. Izakhono zokuqondisa amaphrojekthi.
zu.duties: Qapha ukuhlola amadidiyedi namadokhumenti. Hlola amadidiyedi namadokhumenti ukuthi angabhaliswa ngemvume futhi uthathe izinyathelo zokulungisa. Nikela ingsizayo kubaDayimela bendawo, wenze isinqumo futhi unikeze imiyalo. Nikeza izincomo zokubuyekeza umhlahlandlela wokusebenza kwamadidiyedi, umthetho, futhi ubhale izaziso. Umbiko ngemisebenzi, amazinga, nesikhathi sokuphendula kwethimba lokuhlola. Buyekeza izindleko, imihlahlandlela, nezaziso. Qeda amadidiyedi. Qinisekisa ukuthi lowo oqokiwe usayine isigaba sokugqiba / isicelo sokubhaliswa ngemvume. Qinisekisa usuku lokusebenza kolwazi lwemifanekiso ehlobene. Sayina wonke amadidiyedi namadokhumenti angabhaliswa ngemvume. Mbika izinkinga ezihlobene nokugqibwa kwamadidiyedi, kuARD / DROD obhekene nokugqibwa. Bhala imibiko enkantolo. Yamukela izaziso zokunyakaza kanye nawo wonke amadokhumenti asekelayo. Fundisisa izaziso zokunyakaza namadokhumenti asekelayo. Cwaninga izinhlaziyo ezitholakala kuzona. Hlela umbiko enkantolo futhi wamathise wonke amadokhumenti ahlobene. Phatha ukugqibwa kwamadidiyedi namadokhumenti. Phendula izicelo zokubuyekezwa ngemuva kwesikhathi nokuqashwa kwamadidiyedi ngokushesha futhi uhlele ukubhukwa kokugqibha okumanqamu. Yazisa abaDayimela bendawo ngemikhawulo etholwe emadidiyedin ukugqibwa futhi ubanikeze imiyalo. Qapha irejista yokugqibwa kwebaDayimela bendawo. Asise amadidiyedi angabhaliswa ngemvume. Phendula ukubhaliswa ngemvume ngasikhathi sinye namanye amahhovisi. Phatha ukwahlukaniswa kwamadidiyedi. Qinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi ohlwini lokwahlukanisa luhambisana namadidiyedi eqenjini futhi uluhlole ngokungakhethi. Qinisekisa amadidiyedi abuyiselwe ahlobene nohlwini lokwahlukanisa futhi uqale izinyathelo zokulungisa. Phatha izibalo, imibiko yezimo ezingajwayelekile futhi usebenzise izinyathelo zokulungisa. Thwala futhi uxaze izinkinga ezingabhaliswa ngemvume. Phendula imibuzo ehlobene namadidiyedi esistimini. Vumela isicelo sokuhoxiswa kwamadidiyedi. Phatha ukubuyekeza umhlahlandlela wokuqhuba.

xh.title: Umncedisi weSikhululi seeZitya: Uphononongo nokuHlwa
xh.summary: Kudingeka uMncedisi weSikhululi seeZitya eJohannesburg ukuba aqwalasele izitya eziphononongwayo, ahloliswe ukuba zibhaliseka, anike imiqondo kubaHambeli bezitya ngomvuzo we-R932,292 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingowona mgangatho ophezulu: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi seQreyidi 12 kunye neDiploma yeSizwe kuMthetho / iDiploma yeSizwe kuMthetho woBhaliso weZitya / iBuris / iB Proc / iLLB okanye izifundo ezisiso ezizezinye. Ubuncinane iimfuno zenyanga ezisi-4 zesipilo ngowona mgangatho wolawulo osezantsi kwindawo yeZitya. Ikhono elibanzi nokuqinisekisiwe ekwazeni, ekuqondiseni, nokuqwalasela iindlela ezahlukeneyo zomthetho namagazethu omthetho ahambelana nobhaliso lweZitya kuquka (kodwa lingadingidingwa): uMthetho weZiko leeZitya, uMthetho wezaQwalaselo, iOdinensi, izaziso, iNgxelo yoMthetho, iNtetho yokuQhatha. Ikhono lokubonisana nabantu abangcali ngokuzola. Ikhono lokudlulisa ulwazi kabolunye. Ikhono lokucwangcisa nokuphumeza. Ikhono lokunxibelelwana. Ikhono loLawulo lweeProjekthi.
xh.duties: Qwalasela uphononongo lwezitya kunye namaxwebhu. Qinisekisa izitya namaxwebhu ukuba zigunyaziswa ukuba zibhaliswe ukuze kuthathwe iinyathelo zokulungisa. Nikela indlebe kubaHambeli beZitya, wenze izigqibo unikeze imiqondo. Nikela ngeminikelo yokuhlaziya imanuali yamasiko ezitya, izigqibo-mthetho, kunye nokubhala iindaba ezizodwa. Minga ngemisebenzi yeqela lophononongo, iizinga, kunye nexesha elithathwayo. Hlaziya iindlela, iimanuali, kunye neendaba ezizodwa. Phumeza izitya. Qinisekisa ukuba lowo ethunyiweyo usayine isatifikethi sophumezo / isicelo sokubhalisa. Qinisekisa umhla wokuqinisekiswa wamasatifikethi ahambelana naye. Sayina zonke izitya namaxwebhu angabhaliswa. Chicka iingxaki ezimalunga nophumezo lwezitya, kwi-ARD / DROD ephantsi kophumezo. Bhala iingxelo enkundleni. Yamkele izaziso zentshukumo yamaxwebhu axhasayo. Phonononga izaziso zentshukumo namaxwebhu axhasayo. Phanda iinkcukacha ezikuzo. Hlanganisa ingxelo enkundleni uze udibanise onke amaxwebhu ahambelana nayo. Lawula uphumezo lwezitya namaxwebhu. Jongana neezicelo zophumezo olubambe-debe nolusondeleyo lwezitya uze ulungise ukubhukuda kokugqibela okumnyama. Yazisa abaHambeli beZitya ngeengxaki eziphakanyiselwe kwiizitya ngexesha lophumezo unike imiqondo. Qwalasela irejista yophumezo yabaHambeli beZitya. Landula izitya ezingabhaliswa. Jongana nokubhaliswa ngaxeshane ngezinye iiofisi. Lawula ukuhambisa izitya. Qinisekisa ulwazi ohlu lokuhambisa olusesityeni seqela kwezitya zenene uze wenze iintlobo ezithile zokuqwalasela. Qinisekisa izitya ezibuyiselweyo ngokomthetho wohlu lokuhambisa uze uqale iinyathelo zokulungisa. Lawula izibalo, iingxelo ezizodwa uze usebenzise iinyathelo zokulungisa. Thintela ukuba kubekho iingxaki ezingalunganga apho kugqithwa khona imisebenzi eleyo. Jongana nemibuzo engqamana nezitya kwinkqubo. Gunyazisa isicelo sokukhupha izitya. Lawula inkqubo yokuhlaziya imanuali yomsebenzi.

Dien insette en items vir Aktesopleidingsadvieskomiteevergaderings in. Verifieer aktesopleidingsstatistiek. Koördineer of verskaf insette oor opleidingshandleidings, Kwaliteitbestuurstelsel ens. Verskaf insette oor die bywerking van wette, prosedurehandleidings en sirkulêres. Bestuur biblioteekdienste. Identifiseer boeke, publikasies, opleidingshulpmiddels wat vir die biblioteek aangeskaf moet word. Bestuur ouditbywerkings van biblioteekmateriaal en eksamineerders se wette. Hou toesig oor bywerking van toegangsregister (databasis). Bestuur toegang tot biblioteek en uitleenregister. Bestuur voorraadopname.

zu.title: Onkosikazi Ohlaza Izindlu: Ukulungiselela nokuQqboza Ukufundisa Izindlu
zu.summary: Onkosikazi Ohlaza Izindlu wokuqeqesha nantuthuko ePolokwane, ofuna idiploma noma idigri yomthetho kanye namaphuzu amane ohlelo lwabaphathi abancane emvelweni yezindlu.
zu.requirements: Izidingo eyingqayizivele: Abafakeli kumele babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 kanye neNational Diploma in Law / National Diploma Deeds Registration Law / Buris / B Proc / LLB noma izifundo ezifanayo ezihlobene. 4 years' experience at junior management level in Deeds environment. Ikhono elibanzi futhi elibonakaliswe ekwazeni, ukuhumusha, nokusebenzisa umthetho ohlukahlukene kanye nama-Acts ahlobene nokubhaliswa kwezindlu kuhlanganise (kodwa angagcini kulokhu): Deeds Registries Act, Sectional Titles Act, Ordinances, Proclamations, Case Law, Common Law. Ikono lokukhuluma ngokuzithoba kubungcotshadi bomqondo. Amakhono okubonisa, okuphatha isikhathi, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuphetha ucwaningo, amakhono okuzenzakalisela, ukuhlela kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga, kanye namakhono okuxoxa ngesikhathi samunwe kanye nokubhala. Amakhono okubhala imibiko.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa izidingo zokuqeqesha izindlu. Hlaziya ukuqeqeshwa kwamanje nokwesikhathi esizayo kwezindlukusuka ohlelweni lokuqeqesha ukusebenza. Hlela uhlelo lokuqeqeshwa lwonyaka futhi lulungiselele ukugunyazwa. Bumba umculo wezifundo zokuqeqesha izinakekeli futhi ulungiselele ukugunyazwa. Hlela imibiko yokuhlolwa kobuhle bengudalo futhi unikeze umbiko. Hlela futhi uhlanganise ukuqeqeshwa kwezindlu. Phetha ikhosi/ukuqeqeshwa kwezindlu kubasebenzi kanye nazinakekeli. Phatha imiminisitrazo yokuqeqeshwa. Lungiselela izinkomba kanye nezinto ezizothunyelwa emihlanganweni yeDeeds Training Advisory Committee. Qinisekisa izibalo zokuqeqeshwa kwezindlu. Hlanganisa noma unikeze izinkomba kumabhuku okuqeqesha, kwiQuality Management System njll. Unikeze izinkomba ekubhahleni kwama-acts, amabhuku okwenza kanye namaphepha okwazisa. Phatha izinsiza zomtapo wezincwadi. Khomba izincwadi, izipapashi, izixhosi zokuqeqeshwa ezidinga ukuthengwa komtapo. Phatha ukubhahlaziywa ngokohlelo izinto zomtapo kanye nama-acts komhloli. Qaphela ukubhahlaziywa kwesikhungasiqashi (database). Phatha ukufinyelela emtapo kanye nesikhungasiqashi sokuthengiselana. Phatha ukubala izinto.

xh.title: Umncedisi wommis wezoLungelo oBhalwe: uPhuhliso lokuZesikolo lwezoLungelo eziBhalwe
xh.summary: Umncedisi wommis wezoLungelo oBhalwe o kuqeqesho nophuhliso e Polokwane, ofuna idiploma okanye isidanga kwamagazabaprofethi kunye neminyaka emi-4 yamava oqhankqalaza abanjini basezingeni elinganqamlezantsi kwindawo yezoLungelo eziBhalwe.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaka izicelo kufuneka babe neSatifikhethi yesiGrediya 12 kunye neDiploma yaseLizwe kwiZomthetho / iDiploma yaseLizwe yoMthetho woBhalo lwezoLungelo eziBhalwe / iBuris / iB Proc / iLLB okanye izigaba ezilinganayo ezifanelekileyo. Iminyaka engama-4 yamava kwizinga loqhankqalaza ongumnqamlezantsi kwindawo yezoLungelo eziBhalwe. Ikhono elibanzi neliqinisekisiweyo ekwazini, ekutolikeni, nasekusebenziseni umthetho noMthetho owoLweyo oqhubekayo ochwayekela ubhalo lwezoLungelo eziBhalwe kuquka (kodwa ingagqityelwa kwi): uMthetho weBhala lezoLungelo eziBhalwe, uMthetho weeSiqimo, iiOrdinensi, izaLumko, uMthetho weeNgxatso, uMthetho oQhelekileyo. Ikhono lokunxiba isikhululo phambi kweqela labalawuli, abantu abachaphazelekayo, abantu abakwishishini namakhaladi abanamava ochwepheshe abanolwazi ngolu ntshukumo. Amakhono abalulekileyo aquka ukuzibamba kakuhle, ukulawula ixesha, ukusebenza ngekhompyutha, ucwango, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukuqamba izisombululo, nasekuhlalutyeni. Ikhono lokuzithatha njengoqhankqalaza ongumnqamlezantsi. Amakhono okubhala iingxelo.
xh.duties: Ukumisela iimfuno zoqeqesho lwezoLungelo eziBhalwe. Ukulalumba uqeqesho lwezoLungelo eziBhalwe lwangoku nalo elizayo ngenkqubo yophuhliso ekubonakaliseni. Ukulungelelanisa inkqubo yoqeqesho yonyaka kwaye uyinikeze ukuqinisekiswa. Ukuphuhlisa isikhokelo soqeqesho salabo bachaphazelekayo kwaye sinikezelwe ukuqinisekiswa. Ukwenza iingxelo ezithembekileyo kwaye uzinikeze ingxelo. Ukulungelelanisa nokuqhankqalaza kuqeqesho lwezoLungelo eziBhalwe. Ukubonelela ngamava aqeqeshe abaqeqeshiweyo abangenamva ngqo ekukhazimulweni komsebenzi abawenzileyo. Ukulawula urhulumente woqeqesho. Ukuzinikelwa ngezinto ezithileyo kwiKomiti loQeqesho lwezoLungelo eziBhalwe. Ukujonga amanani oqeqesho lwezoLungelo eziBhalwe. Ukulungelelanisa okanye ukuzinikezelwa ngezinto kumanuali oqeqesho, iNkqubo yoLawulo loMgangatho, njl. Ukuzinikezelwa ngemibuzo ekuvuselelweni komthetho owoLweyo, amanuali eenkqubo nezaziso. Ukulawula iinkonzo zethala leencwadi. Ukuqaphela iincwadi, okushicilelweyo, nezixhobo zokuqeqesha ezifuna ukuthengwa zithala leencwadi. Ukulawula uvuselelo lokuhlahlelwa kwezinto zethala leencwadi nomthetho kaqaphi-mapeki. Ukugcina ukuvuselelwa kwegazethi yokungenisa izinto (idatabeyisi). Ukulawula ukungena ethala leencwadi neregista yokuqhuqha.

jobs.title: Assistant Registrar of Deeds: Examination and Sorting
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (all-inclusive package to be structured in accordance with MMS)
jobs.summary: Assistant Registrar of Deeds needed in Polokwane to monitor deed examinations, check registrability, and grant hearings to conveyancers at Level 11.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of Grade 12 Certificate and National Diploma in Law / National Diploma Deeds Registration Law / Buris / B Proc / LLB or relevant equivalent qualifications. 4 years’ experience at junior management level in Deeds environment. Extensive and proven ability in knowing, interpreting, and applying various legislation and Acts pertaining to registration of Deeds including (but not limited to): Deeds Registries Act, Sectional Titles Act, Ordinances, Proclamations, Case Law, Common Law. Ability to address a professional audience comfortably. Ability to convey knowledge to others. Planning and execution skills. Communication skills. Project Management skills.
jobs.duties: Monitor examination of deeds and documents. Check deeds and documents for registrability and take corrective measures. Grant hearing to Conveyancers, make ruling and provide guidance. Provide inputs for the update of deeds practice manual, legislation, and draft circulars. Report on examination team performance, standards, and turnaround times. Update acts, manuals, and circulars. Execute deeds. Validate that appointed appearer has signed execution clause / request for registration. Verify validity date of relevant certificates. Sign all deeds and documents that are registrable. Report problems with regard to execution of deeds, to ARD / DROD in charge of execution. Draft reports to court. Receive the notice of motions and all supporting documents. Peruse notices of motions and supporting documents. Research the facts there in. Compile a report to court and attach all relevant documents. Manage the execution of deeds and documents. Attend to the requests for late and expedited execution of deeds and arrange for final black booking. Notify conveyancers regarding problems encountered on deeds at execution and provide guidance. Monitor execution register for Conveyancers. Reject deeds that are not registrable. Attend to simultaneous registration with other offices. Manage distribution of deeds. Verify the information on the distribution list with actual deeds batches and spot-check. Verify returned deeds against distribution list and initiate corrective measures. Manage statistics, exception reports and implement corrective measures. Prevent and address backlogs. Attend to queries relating to deeds on the system. Authorize request for withdrawal of deeds. Manage the update procedure manual.

af.title: Assistent-registrateur van Aktes: Ondersoek en Sortering
af.summary: Assistent-registrateur van Aktes word in Polokwane benodig om akte-ondersoeke te monitor, registreerbaarheid na te gaan, en verhore vir transporteurs by Vlak 11 toe te staan.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Regte / Nasionale Diploma Akteregistrasieregte / B luris / B Proc / LLB of tersaaklike gelykwaardige kwalifikasies. 4 jaar se ervaring op juniorbestuursvlak in 'n Akte-omgewing. Uitgebreide en bewese vermoë om verskeie wetgewing en Wette rakende akteregistrasie te ken, te interpreteer en toe te pas, insluitend (maar nie beperk tot nie): Akteregistre-wet, Deeltitelwet, Ordonnansies, Proklamasies, Cassereg, Gemene reg. Vermoë om gemaklik voor 'n professionele gehoor te praat. Vermoë om kennis aan anderen oor te dra. Beplannings- en uitvoeringsvaardighede. Kommunikasievaardighede. Projekbestuursvaardighede.
af.duties: Monitor ondersoek van aktes en dokumente. Kontroleer aktes en dokumente vir registreerbaarheid en neem regstellende maatreëls. Verhoor aan Conveyancers gee, beslissings maak en leiding gee. Voorsien insetsel vir die bywerking van die aktepraktykhandleiding, wetgewing, en konsep sirkulieres. Rapporteer oor ondersoekspan se prestasie, standaarde, en draaitye. Werk wette, handleidings, en sirkulieres by. Voer aktes uit. Bevestig dat die aangestelde verskynende persoon die uitvoeringsklousule / versoek om registrasie onderteken het. Verifieer die geldigheidsdatum van tersaaklike sertifikate. Onderteken alle aktes en dokumente wat registreerbaar is. Rapporteer probleme met betrekking tot uitvoering van aktes aan ARD / DROD in beheer van uitvoering. Skryf verslae aan die hof. Ontvang die kennisgewing van moties en alle ondersteunende dokumente. Deurlees kennisgewings van moties en ondersteunende dokumente. Ondersoek die feite daarin. Stel 'n verslag aan die hof op en heg alle tersaaklike dokumente aan. Bestuur die uitvoering van aktes en dokumente. Hoorsaam versoek vir laat en versnelde uitvoering van aktes en reël finale swart bespreking. Stel transporteurs in kennis aangaande probleme wat by aktes tydens uitvoering ondervind is en gee leiding. Monitor uitvoeringsregister vir Conveyancers. Verwerp aktes wat nie registreerbaar is nie. Hoorsaam gelyktydige registrasie met ander kantore. Bestuur verspreiding van aktes. Verifieer die inligting op die verspreidingslys met werklike aktebondels en doen steekproewe. Verifieer terugbesorgde aktes teen die verspreidingslys en stel regstellende maatreëls in werking. Bestuur statistieke, uitsonderingsverslae en implementeer regstellende maatreëls. Voorkom en hanteer agterstande. Hoorsaam navrae rakende aktes op die stelsel. Magtig versoek om onttrekking van aktes. Bestuur die bywerkingsprosedurehandleiding.

zu.title: Assistant Registrar of Deeds: Examination and Sorting
zu.summary: Kudingeka i-Assistant Registrar of Deeds e-Polokwane ukuze aqaphele ukuhlolwa kwamadidi, ahlole ukubhaliseka, futhi anikeze izingxoxo abashayeli batitshala ezingeni i-Level 11.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe ne-Satifikethi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-National Diploma in Law / National Diploma Deeds Registration Law / Buris / B Proc / LLB noma izifundo ezilinganayo ezihlobene. Unyaka wama-4 wobuhlolwayo ezingeni lokuphatha abasese emvelwaneni kwamadidi. Ikhono elikhulu elibonakaliswe ekwazini, ekuhumusheni, nasekusebenziseni umthetho ohlukene nezinkulumo ezimalunga nabhalisa amadidi okuhlanganisa (kodwa ezingagcini khona): i-Deeds Registries Act, i-Sectional Titles Act, ama-Ordinances, ama-Proclamation, i-Case Law, i-Common Law. Ikhono lokukhuluma kubungcweti ngenhliziyo ethule. Ikhono lokudlulisa ulwazi kubanye. Ikhono lokuhlela buse kuqede umsebenzi. Ikhono lokuxhumana. Ikhono lokuphatha amaphrojekthi.
zu.duties: Qaphela ukuhlola amadidi namadokhumenti. Hlola amadidi namadokhumenti nge-registrability bese uthatha izinyathelo zokulungisa. Nikela izingxoxo abashayeli batitshala, wenze izinqumo unikeze imiyalo. Nikeza izinto ezizosiza ukubuyeza kuqadi kamatshini wezokusebenza kwamadidi, umthetho, kanye nokubhala amasikirari. Bika ngemikhuba yethimba lokuhlola, izinga, kanye nesikhathi esithathwa ukuphendula. Buyeza omthetho, amamanuwali, namasikirari. Qeda ukusebenza kwamadidi. Qinisekisa ukuthi umabonakude ohunyushiwe usayine isigaba sokusebenza / isicelo sokubhalisa. Qinisekisa usuku olusemthethweni lwamasetifikhethi ahlobene. Sayina wonke amadidi namadokhumenti angabhaliswa. Beka ngezigaba ezinkinga mayelana nokusebenza kwamadidi, ku-ARD / DROD ophethe ukusebenza. Bhala amabhikiso enkantolo. Yamisa izaziso zezinyakazo namadokhumenti awonke osekela. Hlola izaziso zezinyakazo namadokhumenti asekelo. Cwaninga izinto ezikubo. Hlela ibhikiso enkantolo buse uhlanganise wonke amadokhumenti ahlobene. Phatha ukusebenza kwamadidi namadokhumenti. Phendula izicelo ukwedluliswa kwamadidi bese uhlela ukugcina okokugcina okumnyama. Yazisa abashayeli batitshala mayelana nabezinkinga abahlangabezana nawo kumadidi esikhathini sokusebenza bese unikeza imiyalo. Qaphela irekhodi lokusebenza labashayeli batitshala. Anqamula amadidi angabhaliswa. Phendula ukubhalisa ngasikhathi sinye namanye amahhovisi. Phatha ukwahlukaniswa kwamadidi. Qinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi ohlu lokwahlukanisa luhambisana namadidi bese uhola ngokulinganisela. Qinisekisa amadidi abuyiselwe ohlu lokwahlukanisa bese uqala izinyathelo zokulungisa. Phatha izibalo, amabhikiso okungajwayelekile buse ufake izinyathelo zokulungisa. Vimba buse uxazulula ukusalele emuva. Phendula imibuzo ehlobene namadidi esistimu. Vuma isicelo sokukhishwa kwamadidi. Phatha ukubuyezwa kwesiqubulo somthetho.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNkosana yokuBhalisa kweziTyhala: uKuPonisa nokuHlela
xh.summary: Kufuneka umncedisi weNkosana yokuBhalisa kweziTyhala ePolokwane ukujonga uphondo lophando lwezityhala, ukuponisa ubhaliseko, kunye nokunika abathunywa beemvumelwano ithuba lokuziva eNqanaba 11.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingezantsi: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe nesiQinisekiso seQela le-12 kunye neDiploma yeliLizwe kuMthetho / iDiploma yeliLizwe yoMthetho wokuBhalisa kweziTyhala / iBuris / iB Proc / iLLB okanye izifundo ezithintelweyo. 4 years’ experience at junior management level in Deeds environment. Ubuchule obubanzi obubonisiwe ekwazini, ekuvenuleni, nokuqokeleza iimithetho eyahlukeneyo kunye neMiThetho engemva kobhaliso lweziTyhala kuquka (kodwa ungekho kuphela koku): iDeeds Registries Act, iSectional Titles Act, amaOrdinances, amaProclamation, iCase Law, iCommon Law. Ikholo lokuthetha nabantu abangabochwepheshe ngokuzinikela. Ikholo lokudlulisa ulwazi kubanye. Amaplanu kunye namakhono okuphumeza. Amakhono okunxibelelwana. Amakhono oLawulo loProject.
xh.duties: Jonga uphondo lophando lwezityhala namaxwebhu. Phonisa izityhala namaxwebhu ngobhaliseko uthathe izigqibo zokulungisa. Nikela abathunywa beemvumelwano ithuba lokuziva, wenze isigqibo unike inkathazo. Nikeza izigqibo zokuqaliselwa kwesikhokelo esibhalwe ngentsimbo yezityhala, ekuvenuleni komthetho, kunye namaxwebhu abhalisiweyo. Chinezelela ngenkangeleko yomsebenzi weqela lophando, iindinganiso, kunye namaxesha okuphumeza. Hlaziya imithetho, izikhokelo, namaxwebhu abhalisiweyo. Phumeza izityhala. Qinisekisa ukuba ummeli oqokiweyo usayine isivumelwano sophumezo / isicelo sobhaliso. Qinisekisa umhla osemthethweni wezatifikhethi ezithintelweyo. Sayina zonke izityhala namaxwebhu abhalisekayo. Tile ngengxaki malunga nophumezo lwezityhala, kuARD / DROD ongoyilo lophumezo. Bhala iingxelo ezikwindlu yetyala. Yemkisa isaziso sezinyanzelo naxonke amaxwebhu axhasayo. Phonisa iisaziso sezinyanzelo namaxwebhu axhasayo. Phanda iinkcukacha ezikuzo. Qamba ingxelo ezikwindlu yetyala uze unamathele onke amaxwebhu ahambelanayo. Lawula uphumezo lwezityhala namaxwebhu. Jongana nokuwezwa ukuphuma ngexesha nephumezo elikhawulezayo lwezityhala uze ulungise isibuko esimnyama sokugqibela. Yazisa abathunywa beemvumelwano ngeengxaki ezibangelwa kuzityhala ngexesha lophumezo unike inkathazo. Jonga irejista yophumezo yabathunywa beemvumelwano. Landula izityhala ezingabhalisekiyo. Jongana nobhaliso ngexesha elinye namanye amanye ooPhando. Lawula ukwahlukanisa izityhala. Qinisekisa inkcazelo kuluhlu lokwahlukanisa ngeebeji zezityhala ezizodwa uze uphonise. Qinisekisa izityhala eziginyiweyo ngeluhlu lokwahlukanisa uze uqalise izigqibo zokulungisa. Lawula izibalo, iingxelo ezingeyonyaniso uze uphumeze izigqibo zokulungisa. Thintela ukuba kubekho iinkqubo ezingagqitywanga uze uzibeke. Jongana nemibuzo ehambelanayo nezityhala kwinkqubo. Vumela isicelo sokuyikho izityhala. Lawula inkqubo yohlaziyo yesikhokelo.

jobs.title: Assistant Registrar Deeds: Mechanisation and Digitisation
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (all-inclusive package to be structured in accordance with MMS)
jobs.summary: Manage the data section of the Deeds office in Mbombela, overseeing digitisation processes, workflow standards, and system change requests at a junior management level.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of Grade 12 Certificate and National Diploma in Law / National Diploma Deeds Registration Law / Buris / B Proc / LLB or related or related equivalent qualification. 4 years’ experience at junior management level in Deeds environment. Job related knowledge: Computer software skills. Good written and verbal communication skills. Good judgement and assertive skills. Project Management skills. People Management skills. Organise and planning skills. Applied strategic thinking. Budgeting and financial Management. Communication and information Management. Customer focus and responsiveness. Developing others. Diversity Management. Impact and influence. Managing Interpersonal Conflict and resolving problems. Networking and building bonds. Planning and organising. Problem-solving and decision Making and Team leadership.
jobs.duties: Managed data section. Manage workload, workflow, processes and standards and implement corrective measures. Oversee the review of system change request. Oversee the review of system change request. Recommend debit and credit notes. Extract exception report for data section and implement corrective measure. Quality assure that deeds are captured and verified correctly to meet turnaround times. Manage compliance with DRS standards. Manage update of the procedure manual.
