Phatha ukubhaliswa kabusha kwesikhwama samaphuzu eziwusizo mayelana nelayibrari nasemithethweni yabeluleki. Qaphela ukubhaliswa kabusha kwesazisi sokwamukela (database). Phatha ukungena klayibrari neregistri yokuboleka. Phatha ukubala kwempahla.

xh.title: Umncedisi womBhalisi weeZitshixo: uPhuhliso lweeZitshixo zoMfundo
xh.summary: Isithuba somncedisi wombhalisi weezitshixo kwinqanaba le-11 eQonce, sifuna idiploma okanye isidanga kumthetho namacala anamnye iminyaka emine yamava aphantsi kwabaphathi abancinci kwindawo yeezitshixo.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezincinci: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe neSatifikathi seQela lesi-12 kunye neDiploma yaseLizwe kumthetho / idiploma yaseLizwe ngokubhaliswa kweezitshixo / i-Buris / i-B Proc / i-LLB okanye izidanga ezilinganayo. Iminyaka emi-4 yamava kwinqanaba labaphathi abancinci kwindawo yeezitshixo. Ulwazi olubanzi nokuqonda, ukuhumusha nokusebenzisa iimthetho ezahlukeneyo nee-Act ezimayela nokubhaliswa kweezitshixo kuquka (kodwa ingagqityelwa koku): i-Deeds Registries Act, i-Sectional Titles Act, i-Ordinances, ama-Proclamation, i-Case Law, i-Common Law. Ulwazi lokuthetha ngokuzithembisa phambi kwegumbi labo ngamagunya. Amakhono okubethela, ulawulo lwexesha, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, uphononongo, amakhono okuziqhelanisa, ukuqamba nokuqamba iindlela, namakhono abalulekileyo ekuthetheni nasekubhaleni. Amakhono okubhala iingxelo.
xh.duties: Ukuqikelela iimfuno zomfundo zeezitshixo. Ukuhlaziya umfundo wamaje nangomso weezitshixo ukusuka kwicephula ndlela yokuphuhlisa ingqwalasela. Ukubhala inkqubo yomfundo yonyaka kwaye uyithumele kuvinjwa. Ukuqamba inkqubo yomfundo yabathathi-nxaxheba kwaye uyithumele kuvinjwa. Ukwenza iingxelo zikhowudi yokwanela kwaye unike ingxelo. Ukwenza kwaye uqhube umfundo weezitshixo. Ukubethela ikhosi yeezitshixo/umfundo kubasebenzi nabathathi-nxaxheba. Ukulawola ulawulo lomfundo. Ukuthumela izinto nemigca yomfundo weezitshixo yababonisana ngeemfundo. Ukuqinisekisa izibalo zomfundo weezitshixo. Ukuqhamba okanye ukunikela izinto ezimayela namanyualomfundo, iNkqubo yoLawulo lobuntu obuNobunganga, njl. Ukunikela izinto ngokuhlaziya iimthetho, amanyualomfundo olugqibo nemileyo. Ukulawula iinkonzo zethala leencwadi. Ukuqaphela iincwadi, iintshoho, izixhobo zomfundo ezikufuneka zithengelwe ithala leencwadi. Ukulawula uhlaziyo loluvo lwemixholo yethala leencwadi neemthetho kabonisayo. Ukuqhuba uhlaziyo lwebali lesikhathi sokuqhutywa kumagumbi (database). Ukulawula ukungena ethala leencwadi kunye nebali lokuboleka. Ukulawela ukuqhutywa kofuthe.

jobs.title: Assistant Registrar of Deeds: Examination and Sorting
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (all-inclusive package to be structured in accordance with MMS)
jobs.summary: Assistant Registrar of Deeds position in Qonce requiring a legal diploma or LLB with four years of junior management experience in a deeds environment.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and National Diploma in Law / National Diploma Deeds Registration Law / Buris / B Proc / LLB or related equivalent qualifications. 4 years’ experience at junior management level in Deeds environment. Extensive and proven ability in knowing, interpreting, and applying various legislation and Acts pertaining to registration of Deeds including (but not limited to): Deeds Registries Act, Sectional Titles Act, Ordinances, Proclamations, Case Law, Common Law. Ability to address a professional audience comfortably. Ability to convey knowledge to others. Planning and execution skills. Communication skills. Project Management skills.
jobs.duties: Monitor examination of deeds and documents. Check deeds and documents for registrability and take corrective measures. Grant hearing to Conveyancers, make ruling and provide guidance. Provide inputs for the update of deeds practice manual, legislation, and draft circulars. Report on examination team performance, standards, and turnaround times. Update acts, manuals, and circulars. Execute deeds. Validate that appointed appearer has signed execution clause / request for registration. Verify validity date of relevant certificates. Sign all deeds and documents that are registrable. Report problems with regard to execution of deeds, to ARD / DROD in charge of execution. Draft reports to court. Receive the notice of motions and all supporting documents. Peruse notices of motions and supporting documents. Research the facts there in. Compile a report to court and attach all relevant documents. Manage the execution of deeds and documents. Attend to the requests for late and expedited execution of deeds and arrange for final black booking. Notify conveyancers regarding problems encountered on deeds at execution and provide guidance. Monitor execution register for Conveyancers. Reject deeds that are not registrable. Attend to simultaneous registration with other offices. Manage distribution of deeds. Verify the information on the distribution list with actual deeds batches and spot-check. Verify returned deeds against distribution list and initiate corrective measures. Manage statistics, exception reports and implement corrective measures. Prevent and address backlogs. Attend to queries relating to deeds on the system. Authorize request for withdrawal of deeds. Manage the update procedure manual.
jobs.enquiries: Ms VC Bomela and Mr P Sabasaba Tel No: (043) 642 2741

af.title: Assistent-registrateur van aktes: Ondersoek en sortering
af.summary: Assistent-registrateur van aktes-pos in Qonce wat 'n juridige diploma of LLB met vier jaar se junior bestuurservaring in 'n akte-omgewing vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en Nasionale Diploma in Regte / Nasionale Diploma Akteregistrasiewet / Buris / B Proc / LLB of verwante gelykwaardige kwalifikasies hê. 4 jaar ervaring op junior bestuursvlak in 'n akte-omgewing. Uitgebreide en bewese vermoë om verskeie wetgewing en Wette met betrekking tot registrasie van aktes te ken, te interpreteer en toe te pas, insluitend (maar nie beperk tot nie): Akteregistreerwet, Deeltitelwet, Ordonnansies, Proklamasies, Kasreg, Gemene reg. Vermoë om gemaklik voor 'n professionele gehoor te praat. Vermoë om kennis aan ander oor te dra. Beplannings- en uitvoeringsvaardighede. Kommunikasievaardighede. Projekbestuursvaardighede.
af.duties: Monitor ondersoek van aktes en dokumente. Kontroleer aktes en dokumente vir registrasiebaarheid en neem korrektiewe maatreëls. Verleen 'n hearing aan Aktebesorgers, doen 'n uitspraak en gee leiding. Verskaf insette vir die bywerking van die aktepraktykhandboek, wetgewing en konsep omwaarskuwings. Rapporteer oor ondersoekspanprestasie, standaarde en terugvoertyd. Werk wette, handboeke en omwaarskuwings by. Voer aktes uit. Bevestig dat die aangestelde verskyner die uitvoeringsklousule / versoek om registrasie onderteken het. Verifieer die geldigheidsdatum van tersaaklike sertifikate. Teken alle aktes en dokumente wat registrasiebaar is. Rapporteer probleme met betrekking tot uitvoering van aktes aan ARD / DROD in beheer van uitvoering. Opgestel verslae aan die hof. Ontvang die kennisgewing van mosies en alle ondersteunende dokumente. Lees kennisgewings van mosies en ondersteunende dokumente deur. Doen navorsing oor die feite daarin. Stel 'n verslag aan die hof op en heg alle tersaaklike dokumente aan. Bestuur die uitvoering van aktes en dokumente. Skenk aandag aan versoeke vir laat en versnelde uitvoering van aktes en reël vir finale swart bespreking. Stel aktebesorgers in kennis oor probleme wat by uitvoering op aktes teëgekom word en gee leiding. Monitor uitvoeringsregister vir Aktebesorgers. Verwerp aktes wat nie registrasiebaar is nie. Skenk aandag aan gelyktydige registrasie met ander kantore. Bestuur verspreiding van aktes. Verifieer die inligting op die verspreidingslys met werklike aktebondels en doen steekproewe. Verifieer teruggestuurde aktes teen die verspreidingslys en inisieer korrektiewe maatreëls. Bestuur statistieke, uitsonderingsverslae en implementeer korrektiewe maatreëls. Voorkom en hanteer agterstande. Skenk aandag aan navrae rakende aktes op die stelsel. Magtig versoek vir onttrekking van aktes. Bestuur die bywerkingsprosedurehandboek.

zu.title: OsizaSolwaBhaliwezelifa: Ukuhlola Nokuhlela
zu.summary: Isikhundla sosizaSolwaBhaliwezelifa e Qonce esifuna idiploma yomthetho noma i-LLB ohambisana neminyaka emine yamava ohlinzangqondo kumasisekelo okubhala izelifa.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nesatifiketha se-Grade 12 kanye ne-National Diploma in Law / National Diploma Deeds Registration Law / Buris / B Proc / LLB noma iziqu ezingana nalezo. 4 years’ experience at junior management level in Deeds environment. Ikhono elikhulu eliveziwe lokwazi, ukuhumusha, nokusebenzisa izimiso zomthetho ezahlukene neziMthetho ezithinta ukubhaliswa kwezelifa okuhlanganisa (kodwa okungakhawulelwa kwezilandelwayo): i-Deeds Registries Act, i-Sectional Titles Act, ama-Ordinances, ama-Proclamations, i-Case Law, i-Common Law. Khono lokukhuluma ngokuzithobela kumbutho wabantu abanemfundo efanele. Khono lokudlulisa ulwazi kwabanye. Khono lokuhlela izinhlelo nokuziphumeza. Khono lokuxhumana. Khono loLawulo Lwamaphrojekhi.
zu.duties: Qapha ukuhlolwa kwezelifa namadokhumenti. Hlola izelifa namadokhumenti ukubone ukuthi ziyabhaliswa yini futhi uthathe izinyathelo zokulungisa. Nikeza ingsibi kubaSolwaMthetho Bhaliswamabili, wenze isinqumo futhi unikeze inhlahlela. Nikeza izincomo zokwazisa incwadi yesiko yokusebenza ngamabhaliwezelifa, izimiso zomthetho, nokubhala imiyalo yezenkundla. Wenze umbiko ngemisebenzi yeqembu lokuhlola, izinga, kanye nesikhathi sokuqeda. Azise izimithetho, izincwadi zokuhlela, namamyalo. Phumeza izelifa. Qinisekisa ukuthi lowo oqokwe ukubonakale usayine inkulumompikiswano yokuqedwa / isicelo sokubhaliswa. Qinisekisa usuku lokusebenza kolwazi lokuma koluguqulelo ngokweziqu. Sayina zonke izelifa namadokhumenti ezibhalisekayo. Wenze umbiko ngezinkinga ezithinta ukuqedwa kwezelifa, ku-ARD / DROD ophethe ukuqedwa. Bhala imibiko enkundleni. Thola izaziso zezinyathelo kanye nawo wonke amadokhumenti asekelo. Fundisisa izaziso zezinyathelo namadokhumenti asekelo. Cwaninga iziqiniseko eziphakathi kwawo. Hlela umbiko enkundleni futhi ushaye wonke amadokhumenti ahlobene nawo. Lawula ukuqedwa kwezelifa namadokhumenti. Joyini izicelo zokubheduka ngesikhathi kanye nokusheshiswa ukuqedwa kwezelifa futhi uhlele ukubhala okuphelayo okumnyama. Yezisa usolwa mthetho bhaliswamabili ngezinkinga ezitholake kuzo izelifa ekugcineni futhi unikeze inhlahlela. Qapha ibhuku lokubhaliswa kolwaSolwaMthetho Bhaliswamabili. Yeqa izelifa ezingabhalisekiyo. Joyini ukubhaliswa ngasikhathi sinye namanye amahhovisi. Lawula ukwabiwa kwezelifa. Qinisekisa ulwazi ohlwini lokwabiwa ngokuqinisekile izelfa ezimenywe kanye nokuqinisekiswa okumaphakathi. Qinisekisa izelifa ezibuyiswe ngokohlu lokwabiwa futhi uqale izinyathelo zokulungisa. Lawula izibalo, imibiko yezinto ezingajewayo futhi usebenzise izinyathelo zokulungisa. Thibela futhi uxazulule izinkinga ezingapheli. Phendula imibuzo ethinta izelifa esistimeni. Vumela isicelo sokukhishwa kwezelifa. Lawula ukwaziswa kwesinqumo sokusebenza.

xh.title: Umncedisi wommeli weeDeeds: Ukuqwalasela nokuQamba ngokwendlela
xh.summary: Isithuba somncedisi wommeli weeDeeds eQonce esifuna idiploma yomthetho okanye i-LLB eneminye minyaka emine yamava obunjinela abalawuli abasebunzimeni kwimeko yedeeds.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafakeli kufuneka babe neSatifikhethate seGrade 12 kwaye benayo iDiploma yoMthetho yesiZwe / iDiploma yoMthetho wobuko bokuBhaliswa kweeDeeds / i-Buris / i-B Proc / i-LLB okanye izifundo ezilinganayo ezinxulumeneyo. Iminyaka engu-4 yamava kwinqanaba lobulawuli obusebunzimeni kwimeko yedeeds. Ikhono elibanziyo nelibonakalisiweyo ekukwazeni, ekutolikeni, nokusebenzisa iimthetho ezahlukeneyo nama-Act anoxanduva lobhaliso lweeDeeds kuquka (kodwa lingadingwa kuphela): i-Deeds Registries Act, i-Sectional Titles Act, ama-Ordinance, ama-Proclamation, i-Case Law, i-Common Law. Ikhono lokuthetha komgangatho ongqongqo phambi kwegumbi labantu abanemfundo. Ikhono lokudlulisa ulwazi kwabanye. Ikhono lokuceba nokuphumeza. Ikhono lokuziphethea. Ikhono lokulawula amaprojekthi.
xh.duties: Qwalasela ukuqwalaselwa kweedeeds namaxwebhu. Qwalasela iideeds namaxwebhu ukubona ukuba ziyabhaliseka yini uze uthathe izigqibo ezilungisayo. Nika inkunde abaQhubi bokuBhalisa, wenze isigqibo uze unikeze inkokheli. Nikeza izimvo zokuhlaziya isandulela senkqubo yesebe leedeeds, oomthetho, kwaye ulungise iindlela ezixutyiweyo. Sigqibe ngenkqubo yenteam yokuqwalasela ngokwemigaqo, kwizinga, naxesha sokuphumeza. Hlaziya ama-acts, iimanual, neendlela ezixutyiweyo. Phumeza iideeds. Qinisekisa ukuba umbhalo wokuvela ubhaliwe isigqibo sokubhaliswa. Qinisekisa umhla wokuqina wamasatifikhethi ahlukeneyo. Tyala wonke amaxwebhu naxa kubhaliswa. Sigqibe ngeengxaki ezikwolwazi bolumi rhoqo, kwindima apho i-ARD / i-DROD ikhulule kuko oko. Bhala iingxelo ezisi nkundla. Wamkela izaziso zothotho lo mathandabuzo lonke amaxwebhu axhaso. Qwalasela izaziso zothotho nomaxwebhu axhaso. Cofa iindaba ezikulawulo. Hlaziya ingxelo enkundla uze udibanise lonke amaxwebhu ahambelanayo. Lawula ukuphumeza iideeds. Yonwabela iimfuno zokusikwa kwexesha nokuvezwa ngokukhawuleza kwangaphambili, uze ulungise iindlela ezikulo igumbi lokubeka i-booking ekugqibeleni. Yazisa abaQhubi bokuBhalisa ngezinto ezibucayi ezibangelwa kukusetyenziswa kweedeeds uze unikeze inkokheli. Qwalasela urhululo lokuphumeza abaQhubi bokuBhalisa. Sula iideeds ezingabhaliswa. Yonwanela ukubhaliswa ngaxeshanye namanye ooMmeli. Lawula ukusasazwa kweedeeds. Qinisekisa ulwazi ekuludwe lokusasaza ngokuchanekileyo njengoko iideeds zibonelelwe, uze uqwalasele ngokucohlisa. Qinisekisa iideeds ezibuyisiwe zikuludwe lokusasaza uze uqale izigqibo ezilungisayo. Lawula izibalo, iingxelo zezinto ezingangangenanga, uze uphumeze izigqibo ezilungisayo. Thintela uze ulungise iingxaki ezoshiyekayo. Yonwanela iimbuzo ngeendeeds ezikule nkqubo. Vuma ukubuyiswa ngokukhethwa kweendeeds. Lawula inkqubo yokulungiselela ukuhlaziya urhululo.

Phatha izibalo, imibiko yokungajwayelekile futhi usebenzise izinyathelo zokulungisa. Phatha ukubuyekeza kwemibhalo yezinqubo. Phatha ukugcinwa kwemibalo emqandathini. Hlola ngobuningi umbiko wocwaningo lwokwaneliseka kwabathengi futhi unikeze izincomo. Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokufinyelela, imihlangano yokuzibandakanya nabanikazi bamatshalakazi. Qaphela ukusetshenziswa kohlelo lwenzenzo lwenyanga yesevisi yomphakathi. Qinisekisa imibiko yeSevisi Yokuthuthukiswa Kokulethwa Kwenkonzo. Phatha uxhumano futhi unikeze inhlahniso kubathengi. Qinisekisa ulwazi/ amakhophi ajwabule / isigaba 212 / isibhalo esifungiswa ngomumo bese usayina irekhodi. Phatha irekhodi lesibethelo somthetho. Phatha iSistimu Yokulandelwa Kwezidakamizwa (DOTS). Phatha umthwalo womsebenzi, ukugeleza komsebenzi, izinqubo kanye namazinga futhi usebenzise izinyathelo zokulungisa. Manage statistics, exception reports and implement corrective measures. Prevent and address backlogs. Attend to queries relating to deeds on the system. Authorize request for withdrawal of deeds. Manage the update procedure manual.

af.title: Assistent-registrateur van Aktes: Ondersoek en Sortering
af.summary: Assistent-registrateur van Aktes in Cape Town wat akteondersoek, registreerbaarheidskontroles, verhore van aktebesorgers, en wetgewingsbywerkings overse het, met 'n vereiste van 'n LLB of ekwivalent met vier jaar se junior bestuursonderervaring.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Regte / Nasionale Diploma Akteregistrasieregte / Buris / B Proc / LLB of toepaslike ekwivalente kwalifikasies. Minimum van 4 jaar se ervaring op junior bestuursvlak in 'n akte-omgewing. Uitgebreide en bewese vermoë om verskeie wetgewing en Wette rakende registrasie van Aktes te ken, te interpreteer, en toe te pas, insluitend (maar nie beperk tot nie): Akteregisterswet, Deeltitelwet, Ordonnansies, Proklamasies, Kasreg, Gemeenregtelike reg. Vermoë om gemaklik voor 'n professionele gehoor te praat. Vermoë om kennis aan ander oor te dra. Beplannings- en uitvoeringsvaardighede. Kommunikasievaardighede. Projekbestuursvaardighede.
af.duties: Monitoriseer die ondersoek van aktes en dokumente. Kontroleer aktes en dokumente vir registreerbaarheid en neem korrektiewe maatreëls. Verhoor aktebesorgers, doen uitspraak en verskaf leiding. Verskaf insette vir die bywerking van die aktepraktykhandleiding, wetgewing, en konsep sirkulieres. Rapporteer oor ondersoekspan se prestasie, standaarde, en omlooptye. Werk wette, handleidings, en sirkulieres by. Voer aktes uit. Valideer dat die aangestelde verskynende party die uitvoeringsklousule / versoek om registrasie onderteken het. Verifieer die geldigheidsdatum van toepaslike sertifikate. Teken alle aktes en dokumente wat registreerbaar is. Rapporteer probleme met betrekking tot die uitvoering van aktes aan ARD / DROD in beheer van uitvoering. Opstelle verslae aan die hof. Ontvang kennisgewings van mosies en alle ondersteunende dokumente. Bestudeer kennisgewings van mosies en ondersteunende dokumente. Ondersoek die feite daarin. Stel 'n verslag aan die hof op en heg alle toepaslike dokumente aan. Bestuur die uitvoering van aktes en dokumente. Spreek versoekte na vir laat en versnelde uitvoering van aktes en reël finale swart bespreking. Stel aktebesorgers in kennis rakende probleme wat by uitvoering op aktes ondervind word en verskaf leiding. Monitoriseer uitvoeringsregister vir aktebesorgers. Keur aktes af wat nie registreerbaar is nie. Spreek gelyktydige registrasie met ander kantore aan. Bestuur die verspreiding van aktes. Verifieer die inligting op die verspreidingslys met die werklike aktepartye en doen steekproewe. Verifieer terugbesorgde aktes teen die verspreidingslys en begin korrektiewe maatreëls. Bestuur statistieke, uitsonderingsverslae en implementeer korrektiewe maatreëls. Voorkom en spreek agterstande aan. Spreek navrae aan rakende aktes op die stelsel. Magtig versoek om aktes terug te trek. Bestuur die bywerkingsprosedurehandleiding.

zu.title: Osiza-Mmeli Wezindebe: Ukuhlola Nokuhlukanisa
zu.summary: Osiza-Mmeli Wezindebe e Cape Town obhekene nokuhlola izindebe, ukuhlola ukubhaliseka, ukuzwa ababiki bezindebe, kanye nezibuyekezo zomthetho, edinga i-LLB noma okulinganayo okunamava eminyaka emine abaphathi abancane.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Abafaka izinto kumele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-National Diploma in Law / National Diploma Deeds Registration Law / Buris / B Proc / LLB noma iziqu ezifanele ezilinganayo. Okuncane unyaka be-4 bemava ezingeni labaphathi abancane esikhundleni sezindebe. Ikhono elibanzi nelibonakaliswe ekuqondeni, ekuhumusheni, nasekusebenziseni izixgabelo ezahlukene zemithetho neziyisimiso ezithinta ukubhaliswa kwezindebe okuhlanganisa (kodwa okungagcini lapho): i-Deeds Registries Act, i-Sectional Titles Act, ama-Ordinance, ama-Proclamation, i-Case Law, i-Common Law. Ikhono lokukhuluma kobuningi abaphathi ngokuzethemba. Ikhono lokudlulisa ulwazi kwabanye. Amakhono okuhlela nokuphumeza. Amakhono okuxhumana. Amakhono okuphatha amaphrojekthi.
zu.duties: Qapha ukuhlolwa kwezindebe namadokhumenti. Hlola izindebe namadokhumenti ukuthi zibhaliseka kanjani uthathe izinyathelo zokulungisa. Nikela ababiki bezindebe izingcingo ezibalulekileyo, wenze isinqumo unikezelwe ngokumediwe. Nikeza izindingo zokubuyekeza isikhokelo sokusebenza ngamakhono, imithetho nokubhala izikhubekwano. Bika ngemisebenzi eqokwe eqokwe yokuhlela, izindleko neziphumo. Buyekeza imithetho, izikhokelo namaphasi. Phumeza izindebe. Qinisekisa ukuthi umbuki oqokwe ubhalile inhlamvu yokuphumeza / isicelo sokubhaliswa. Qinisekisa usuku lokusebenza kolunye iqiniso lezitifiketi. Phonsa isigxivho kuzo zonke izindebe namadokhumenti ezibhalisekayo. Beka izinkinga ezihlobene nokuphumeza izindebe, ku-ARD / DROD obhekene nokuphumeza. Bhala izibiko enkundleni. Thola izaziso zokuhamba kanye nawo wonke amadokhumenti okusekela. Phenya izaziso zokuhamba namadokhumenti okusekela. Penya izinto eziphakathi kakhulu. Qamba ibiko enkundleni usuze wonke amadokhumenti ahlobene. Phatha ukuphumeza izindebe namadokhumenti. Phathwa izicelo zokuphumeza izindebe ngokubambe ngesikhathi futhi uhlele ukugqiba okumnyama. Yazisa ababiki bezindebe ngobunzima abahlangabezana nabo kuzo izindebe ngokuphumeza bakhombise inzuzo. Qapha irekhodi lokuphumeza lezinto ezazokwenziwa ngababiki bezindebe. Zikhulule izindebe ezingabhaliseki. Qapha ukubhaliswa ngasikhathi esinye namanye amahhovisi. Phatha ukwahlukanisa izindebe. Qinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi ohlwini lokwahlukanisa luhambisana nezindebe ezikuyona uphinde uqaphele. Qinisekisa izindebe ezibuyiswe ezingahambisani nohlunye lukwahlukanisa uphume izinyathelo zokulungisa. Phatha izibalo, izibiko eziphikisana nezinyathelo zokulungiseka. Thwala izinkinga ezenzeka ngaphandle kwesikhathi. Qapha imibuzo ehlobene nezindebe esistimini. Vumela isicelo sokukhishwa kwezindebe. Phatha ukubuyekeza isikhokelo senza.

xh.title: Oncedwe loMmeli weZibhalo zoBungqina: Ukuhlola nokwahlula
xh.summary: Oncedwe loMmeli weZibhalo zoBungqina eCape Town eluhlola izibhalo zobungqina, ukukhangela ukubhalwa kwesibhalo, ukuzwa ababhalisi bezibhalo, kunye nokuhlaziya imithetho, kufuneka kubekho isidanga se-LLB okanye okulinganayo kunye nolunyaka olungamane lwamava eburhulumente obungakanani.</summary>
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka benolwazi lwesiqinisekiso seGrade 12 kunye neNational Diploma in Law / National Diploma Deeds Registration Law / Buris / B Proc / LLB okanye izidanga ezilinganayo ezifanelekileyo. Ubuncinci beminyaka engama-4 yamava kwinqanaba elincinci loburhulumente kwimeko yeDeeds. Isakhono esibanzi nesiqinisekisiweyo sokwazi, ukucazulula, nokusebenzisa imithetho eyahlukeneyo nama-Acts anengxoxo ngobhalo lweZibhalo kuquka (kodwa ingaqwalaselwa kuphela): Deeds Registries Act, Sectional Titles Act, Ordinances, Proclamations, Case Law, Common Law. Isakhono sokuqulatha umbandela ochwepheshileyo ngokuzola. Isakhono sokuvelisa ulwazi kwabanye. Isakhono seplani nokuphumeza. Isakhono sokunxibelelwana. Isakhono soLawulo lweProject.
xh.duties: Qwalasela ukuhlolwa kwezibhalo namaxwebhu. Khangela izibhalo namaxwebhu ukubhalwa kwazo wathatha iinyathelo zokulungisa. Nika ukuzwa kwiConveyancers, wenze isigqibo unike nomceli. Nikezela ngemibongo yokuhlaziya incwadi yesiseko sezibhalo, imithetho, kunye nokubhala iileta zexesha. Beka ngelena ngokusebenza kwqembu lokuhlola, iinkqubo, kunye nexesha lokugqiba. Hlaziya ama-acts, iincwadi, kunye neeleta. Phumeza izibhalo. Qinisekisa ukuba umbonisi oqeshiweyo usayinile isigatana sophumezo / isicelo sobhaliso. Qinisekisa umhla wokuqiniswa kweziqinisekiso ezifanelekileyo. Sayina zonke izibhalo namaxwebhu angabhaliswa. Bika iingxaki ngokuphumeza izibhalo, kuARD / DROD ophethe uphumezo. Bhala iingxelo enkundleni. Yamkele isaziso sezinyanzelo yonke imibhalo exhasayo. Phenya izaziso sezinyanzelo kunye nemibhalo exhasayo. Phanda iinkcukacha apho. Hlenga ingxelo enkundleni wadinke yonke imibhalo engqamlezana. Lawula uphumezo lwezibhalo namaxwebhu. Jongana neesicelo zophumezo oluhutshiweyo nolukhawulezayo lwezibhalo ulungelelanise ukugqibela kokubhala okumnyama. Yazisa ababhalisi ngeengxaki eze kwezibhalo ekuphumezeni unike nomceli. Qwalasela irejista yophumezo yeConveyancers. Suka izibhalo ezingenakubhaliswa. Jongana nobhaliso ngaxeshake nezinye iiofisi. Lawula ulwahlulo lwezibhalo. Qinisekisa iinkcukacha kuluhlu lokuwahlula nezibhalo zangempela wajonga ngokukhawuleza. Qinisekisa izibhalo ezibuyisiwe ngokuluhlu lokuwahlala wazisa iinyathelo zokulungisa. Lawula izibalo, iingxelo ezingaqhelekanga wazise iinyathelo zokulungisa. Thintela ulungise iingxaki ezingekabhaliswa. Jongana nemibuzo enengxoxo ngezibhalo kwinkqubo. Vuma isicelo sokuhoxisa izibhalo. Lawula ukwenza incwadi yesiseko yohlaziyo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Marketing
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Marketing position at the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Pretoria, requiring a National Diploma in Marketing and 3 years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Marketing / Brand Management / Public Relations (NQF Level 6). Minimum of 3 years' experience in marketing and brand management service environment. A valid driver's licence. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of Policies and legislations governing communication. Marketing and Brand Management principles. Batho-Pele principles. Job related skills: Marketing Communication. Interpersonal Relations. Advocacy. Computer literacy. Analytical thinking. Decision making. Problem solving. Ability and willingness to travel extensively and work outside office hours.
jobs.duties: Provide marketing services for the Department. Coordinate outreach campaigns, information and advocacy sessions to create awareness of the department's initiative and programmes. Compile and distribute information material on the programmes, policies and services of the Department. Promote citizen engagement by coordinating public participation in departmental policies and programmes. Facilitate inter-departmental and external stakeholder messaging on marketing initiatives. Support initiatives to uphold the departmental brand identity. Handle and facilitate information queries from the public and stakeholders attending departmental events and activities. Coordinate corporate identity services for the Department. Monitor the implementation of the departmental brand for consistent visual presentation. Record non-compliance corporate identity guidelines on branded output. Conduct regular training sessions on the compliance to the branding guidelines. Assess and recommend appropriate types of branded signage and way-findings to departmental service delivery points or activities. Develop and implement consistent brand messages internally and externally. Provide advice and specifications for branded collateral and promotional material. Draft and implement event branding plans. Organise and implement events, exhibitions and information sessions. Plan, organise and coordinate events, exhibitions, campaigns and information sessions. Draft and keep an updated calendar for events, exhibitions and information sessions. Identify and recommend relevant target audiences for exhibitions and information sessions. Regular liaising with relevant event, activity or campaign content leaders. Interact with stakeholders and delegates to provide information at events and exhibitions. Maintain even and exhibition attendance registers. Maintain detailed referral documents for queries which cannot be addressed during the activities. Follow-up on events and exhibition queries with the relevant internal units until closure and provide reports. Package and implement traditional and multi-media information tools for departmental activities. Collate and distribute planned and ad-hoc information material to stakeholders. Coordinate media buying and advertising services. Recommend appropriate media channels for paid media campaigns and projects. Source media buying quotations from media houses and media owners. Coordinate the production of advertisement copy or audio-visual recordings aligned to corporate identity guidelines. Coordinate the placement of the advertisement. Collate print media advertisement tear-offs, audio and video clips.
jobs.enquiries: Mr F Mutangwa Tel No: (012) 312 8283
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 600 Lilian Ngoyi Street (formerly known as Van Der Walt Street) Berea Park, Pretoria, 0001 or by email to Post299@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: Coloured, Indian and White Males and African, Coloured, Indian and White Females and Persons with Disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form, (a nomination letter if required) and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. All shortlisted candidate, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidates suitability based on the posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre-entry programme offered by the National School of       Government          (NSG).       Find      course       details     here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/ appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re-advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Bemarking
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur: Bemarking-pos by die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Pretoria, wat 'n Nasionale Diploma in Bemarking en 3 jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Bemarking / Handelsmerkbestuur / Openbare Betrekkinge (NQF Vlak 6). Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring in bemarkings- en handelsmerkbestuursdiensomgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van beleide en wetgewing rakende kommunikasie. Bemarkings- en handelsmerkbestuursbeginsels. Batho-Pele-beginsels. Werksverwante vaardighede: Bemarkingskommunikasie. Interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Voorligting. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Analitiese denke. Besluitneming. Probleemoplossing. Vermoe en bereidwilligheid om wyd te reis en buite kantoorure te werk.
af.duties: Verskaf bemarkingsdienste vir die departement. Koördineer uitreikveldtogte, inligtings- en voorligtingsessies om bewustheid van die departement se inisiatiewe en programme te skep. Stel inligtingsmateriaal oor die programme, beleide en dienste van die departement op en versprei dit. Bevorder burgerbetrokkenheid deur openbare deelname aan departementele beleide en programme te koördineer. Fasiliteer interdepartementele en eksterne belanghebbende boodskappe oor bemarkingsinisiatiewe. Ondersteun inisiatiewe om die departementele handelsmerkidentiteit te handhaaf. Hanteer en fasiliteer inligtingsnavrae van die publiek en belanghebbendes wat departementele geleenthede en aktiwiteite bywoon. Koördineer korporatiewe identiteitsdienste vir die departement. Monitor die implementering van die departementele handelsmerk vir konsekwente visuele aanbieding. Rekordeer nie-nakoming van korporatiewe identiteitsriglyne op handelsmerksuitsette. Voer gereelde opleidingsessies uit oor die nakoming van die handelsmerkriglyne. Evalueer en beveel toepaslike tipes handelsmerkborduur en rigtingwysers vir departementele diensleweringspunte of aktiwiteite aan. Ontwikkel en implementeer konsekwente handelsmerkboodskappe intern en ekstern. Verskaf advies en spesifikasies vir handelsmerk-materiaal en bemarkingsmateriaal. Opstel en implementeer geleentheidsbrandingplanne. Reël en implementeer geleenthede, uitstallings en inligtingssessies. Beplan, reël en koördineer geleenthede, uitstallings, veldtogte en inligtingssessies. Stel 'n opgedateerde kalender vir geleenthede, uitstallings en inligtingssessies op en hou dit by. Identifiseer en beveel toepaslike teiken gehore vir uitstallings en inligtingssessies aan. Gereelde skakeling met toepaslike inhoudsleiers vir geleenthede, aktiwiteite of veldtogte. Skakel met belanghebbendes en afgevaardigdes om inligting by geleenthede en uitstallings te verskaf. Handhaaf registrasies van bywoning van geleenthede en uitstallings. Handhaaf gedetailleerde verwysingsdokumente vir navrae wat nie tydens die aktiwiteite hanteer kan word nie. Volg geleentheids- en uitstallingsnavrae met die toepaslike interne eenhede na tot afsluiting en verskaf verslae. Verpak en implementeer tradisionele en multimedia-inligtingsinstrumente vir departementele aktiwiteite. Versamel en versprei beplande en ad hoc-inligtingsmateriaal aan belanghebbendes. Koördineer media-aankope en advertensiedienste. Beveel toepaslike mediakanale vir betaalde mediaveldtogte en projekte aan. Verskaf media-aankoopkwotasies van mediahuise en media-eienaars. Koördineer die produksie van advertensiekopie of audiovisuele opnames wat met korporatiewe identiteitsriglyne ooreenstem. Koördineer die plasing van die advertensie. Versamel drukmedia-advertensie-uitknipsels, oudio- en videolekke.

zu.title: Umengamele: Ukumaketha
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba nguMengamele: Ukumaketha eMnyangweni Wezenguqulo Yomhlaba Nentuthuko Yasemaphandleni ePretoria, esidinga iDiploma Yezwe ekuMaketheni nokuba namava eminyaka engu-3.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane kakhulu: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe neSithifikethi SeGredi 12 kanye neDiploma Yezwe ekuMaketheni / Ekuqondisweni Kwebhrendi / Ezomphakathi (NQF Level 6). Okuncane ukuba namava eminyaka engu-3 kule midlalo yokumaketha nokuqondisa ibhrendi. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi lwezinqamulelo ezibusayo izindaba. Izimiso zokuMaketha nokuQondisa Ibhrendi. Izimiso zeBatho-Pele. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Izindaba ZokuMaketha. Ubudlelwano Phakathi Kwabantu. Ukuqinisekisa izindaba. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ikhono nesifiso sokuhamba kakhulu futhi ukusebenza ngemahora angaphandle kohwebo.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngemisebenzi yokumaketha kuMnyango. Hlela imikhuba yokufinyelela komphakathi, izikhathi zolwazi nezokusakaza izindaba ukwakha ukwaziswa ngohlelo nezinhlelo zomnyango. Hlanganisa futhi usabalise izinto zolwazi ngezinhlelo, izinqongo nomisebenzi woMnyango. Khuthaza ukubandakanywa kwabantu ngokuHlela ukuthi umphakathi ukubambe iqhaza kuzinqongo nezinhlelo zomnyango. Yenza kube lula ukudlulisa imiyalezo phakathi kwezinyangwa, kanye nabashwalizi abangaphandle mayelana nezinhlela zokuMaketha. Sekela izinhlela zokugcina isithombe-sibonakaliso sebhrendi yomnyango. Phatha futhi wenze kube lulu izibuzo ezivela kumphakathi nabashwalizi ababuke imicimib namasebenzi omnyango. Hlela imisebenzi yesithombe-sibonakaliso sebhidiiwo sebhrendi woMnyango. Qapha ukusetshenziswa kwebhrendi yomnyango ukuze kuqhubeke ukubonakala okuhlobene. Gcina inani elingahambisani nezindlela zokusetha ibhrendi ezikhiqizweni ezinoMphumela wesithombe-sibonakaliso sebhrendi. Yenza imiklalo evamayo yokuhambisana nezinqongo zobuhlela bebhrendi. Hlola futhi uphakamise izinhlobo ezifanele zamasayini ebhrendi kanye nezinkomba zendlela kumaphoyinti ohlelo lomsebenzi womnyango noma kumsebenzi. Buka futhi usebenzise imiyalezo ezingaqhubeki ibhrendi ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Nikeza umyalelo futhi incazelo ngezinto ezibalulekileyo zezenzo zokuMaketha neziphathwa njengesibonakaliso sesikhathi. Hlela futhi usebenzise izinkomba zokusungulwa kumcimib wezenzo zokuMaketha. Hlela futhi usebenzise imicimib, imibukiso nezikhathi zolwazi. Cwangcisa, hlela futhi uqondise imicimib, imibukiso, imikhuba nezikhathi zolwazi. Buka futhi ugcine ikhalenda evuselelweka yemicimib, imibukiso nezikhathi zolwazi. Hlola futhi uphakamise abaphulukisi abahlobene nemibukiso nezikhathi zolwazi. Xhumana njalo nabaholi bokuhlela imicimib, umsebenzi noma imikhuba ngokwelaye. Buyisana nabashwalizi nabamele ukunika ulwazi emicimibini nasezibukisweni. Gcina izibuko sokubhaliswa kwemicimib nangabaphulukisi. Gmina inani elingenanto lwemibhalo yokumiswa kobuvikela bokusebenzisa kwamakhono emiyalezo engatholakali phakathi nokwenza umsebenzi. Landela izinsimu zokuMaketha zabashwalizi namaphoyinti abo abafanele ukuxazululwa kusukela ekucaleni kuze kugcwalise. Hlanganisa futhi usabalise izinto ezifakiwe zesikhathi kanye nezithombe, imiyalezo yokuqala nezibaxa ngokomsebenzi nomnyango. Linganisa ukwenza imali kuMnyango mayelana nezinto zokusakaza izindaba. Landa izibaxa ezifakiwe emithombo yezindaba mayelana nesikhathi sokusebenza kwemibhalo. Susa imiyalezo eshaduli yommbhalo oyedwa nomnyombo wokususwa komsebenzi okudinga ukwenza imibukiso noma ukusakaza izindaba emicimibini yesibaxa. Misa futhi usebenzise izindlu ezithengisa iindlela zokumaketha zomnyango zokwenza imibhalo emibili. Susa imibhalo eshaduli yokuMaketha nendlela eshibhile yokwenza ukumaketha noma ukusakaza imibhalo eshaduli yomnyango. Susa imibhalo eshaduli yokuMaketha ngokususwa kwayo endaweni yokuMaketha eshaduli yomnyango. Susa imibhalo eshaduli yokuMaketha ngokususwa kwendawo ngokususwa kwayo endaweni yokuqashwa imali.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNkundla: UkuQashela
xh.summary: Isithuba somncedisi weNkundla kuQashela kwiSebe lezeMiguqo yoMhlaba nasekuPhuhliseni eMaphandleni ePretoria, kufuneka kubekho izatifikhasi yeNqanaba lesi-12 kunye neDiploma yaseLizwe kukuQashela / uLawulo loPhawu / uBudlelwano nokuLunga (NQF Level 6) nobugcilebo beminyaka eyi-3.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe neSatifikhasi yeNqanaba lesi-12 kunye neDiploma yaseLizwe kukuQashela / uLawulo loPhawu / uBudlelwano nokuLunga (NQF Level 6). Kufuneka abe nabugcilebo beminyaka engu-3 kwindawo yenkonzo yokuqashela nolawulo lwephawu. Ileyisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi olunxulumene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngemigaqo nemithetho elawula unyanzeliso. Iinkqubo zokuQashela nokuLawula iPhawu. Iinkqubo zeBatho-Pele. Amapondo oxhumo nolwazi olunxulumene nomsebenzi: Unyanzeliso lokuQashela. uBudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. UkuNxiba isitya. Ulwazi lokusebenzela ikhompyutha. Ukucinga ngokuhlola. UkuThatha iigqibo. Ukuxazula iingxaki. Imandla nenkathalo yokuhamba kakhulu nokusebenza ngaphandle kweyure zoficedle.
xh.duties: Zela inkonzo yokuqashela iSebe. Hlela iinkqubo zokufikelela kwabanini, iiseshoni zolwazi nokuNxiba isitya ukuze kudalwe ingqondo ngezigaba neenkqubo zesebe. Qokeleza kwaye usasaze izixhobo zolwazi ngeenkqubo, imigaqo neenkonzo zeSebe. Khuthaza oluqhathaniso lwabantu ngokuhlela oluqhathaniso loluntu kumigaqo neenkqubo zesebe. Yenza lolwazi phakathi kamabango nabalawuli bangaphandle kwamagumbi ngemicimbi yokuqashela. Nxiba isitya iinkqubo zokugcina uphawu lweSebe. Phatha kwaye ulawule imibuzo yolwazi evela kumphakathi nabalawuli abathatha inxaxheba kumacimbi nemiqobo yesebe. Hlela iinkonzo zophawu lweSebe phakathi kwamabango. Lilisisele ukusebenza kolawulo lwephawu lweSebe ukuze kuqhubeka okubonakalayo. Qamba ukungahambelani kwemigaqo yophawu lweSebe kumveliso ephawulweyo. Yenza iiseshoni zolwazi rhoqo ngokuthobela imigaqo yophawula. Qeqa kwaye ucele izicelo ezifanelekileyo zophawu nezikhombi zaseSebe kwindawo okuhamba khona iinkonzo okanye kumacimbi. Yenza kwaye uqonze imiyalezo yophawu engatshintshiyo ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Nikeza izalathiso nemigaqo yesixhobo esiphawulweyo nolwazi lokukhuthaza. Bhala kwaye uqonze iinkqubo zophawula kumacimbi. Hlela kwaye uqonze umthendeleko, imiboniso neeseshoni zolwazi. Cwangcisa, hlela kwaye ulungelelanise umthendeleko, imiboniso, iinkqubo neeseshoni zolwazi. Bhala kwaye zigcine zithsha ikhalenda yomthendeleko, imiboniso neeseshoni zolwazi. Chonga kwaye ucele abantu abafanelekileyo abakujongayo kumiboniso neeseshoni zolwazi. Thintana rhoqo nabagxeki balwazi bomthendeleko, umcimbi okanye inkqubo. Thintana nabalawuli nabathathi-nxaxheba ukunika ulwazi kumthendeleko nemiboniso. Gcina iresitha yokubakho kwabathandi bomthendeleko nemiboniso. Gcina amaxwebhu axela ngokweenkcukacha ezingasetyenziswa kusetyenziswa okungakwazi ukuphendulwa ngexesha lomsebenzi. Landela imibuzo yomthendeleko nemiboniso kunabasebenzi abangaphakathi okufanelekileyo de kugqitywe kwaye unike iingxelo. Hlela kwaye uqonze izixhobo zolwazi zendalo kwakunye nezixhobo zorulwazi ngokuthanda iSebe. Qokeleza kwaye usasaze ulwazi oluqanjweyo nolungaqanjwanga kumagumbi. Hlela ukuthengwa kolwazi kwamajelo nokukhangela. Ccela amajelo afanelekileyo iinkqubo neenkqubo ezihlawulwayo zokukhangela nokwenza iiprojekthi. Fumana izicelo zokuza kwamajelo kunye namajelo onke. Hlela ukwenziwa kophawu lokukhangela okanye ukurekhodwa kwesandi nemifanekiso ngokuthobela imigaqo yophawu leSebe. Hlela ukubekwa kolwazi lokukhangela. Qokeleza iziphetho zokukhangela eziprintiweyo, isandi nemifanekiso.

jobs.title: Senior ICT Technician / Officer
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Senior ICT Technician needed in Pretoria to install, configure and maintain computer hardware, software and network systems, requiring a National Diploma in IT and 3 years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of Grade 12 Certificate and National Diploma in Information Technology (NQF 6) or relevant equivalent qualifications. Minimum 3 years in a similar role supporting users onsite and/or remotely with desktop, application, system and infrastructure issues. Job Related Knowledge: Solid diagnostic and troubleshooting abilities, with a structured and logical approach to solving user and system issues. Thorough and seamless call log management process for all calls logged by users for work management and reporting purposes. Systems support. Working with Active Directory, O365, Anti-virus and other related Windows and Windows Server tools. Supporting users onsite and / or remotely with desktop, application, system and infrastructure issues. Diagnostic and troubleshooting abilities, with a structured and logical approach to solving user and system issues. Knowledge of ICT standards, best practices and policies. Installing hardware and software components. Knowledge of call log management process. Theoretical and practical knowledge of Active Directory, O365, anti- virus and other related Windows and Windows Server tools. Public Service Regulations. Job Related Skills: Communications skills. Problem Solving and Decision-Making skills. Computer software skills (good excel skills). Coaching and Mentoring (Though leadership) skills. Technical report writing skills. Presentation skills. Analytical skills. Problem solving skills. Communication skills. Project Management skills. A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Installing, Configuring and Maintaining Software and Hardware Components of Computer and Network Systems. Install, configure and upgrade desktop computers, laptops, printers and peripheral devices. Install, configure and maintain operating systems, Microsoft 365 applications and approved business software. Configure and maintain user accounts, mailboxes, groups and permissions in Active Directory and Microsoft 365. Install, configure and maintain network devices, including switches, routers and wireless access points. Monitor hardware and software performance to ensure optimal system functionality and availability. Conduct preventative maintenance of ICT equipment, infrastructure and systems. Perform software updates, security patches and firmware upgrades. Configure and maintain antivirus, endpoint protection and other security solutions. Manage and maintain ICT asset registers and configuration records. Respond to service requests escalated through the Help Desk and ensure timely fulfilment according to service standards. Monitor recurring incidents and recommend preventative measures to improve system performance and reliability. Diagnose, Troubleshoot and Coordinate Resolution of ICT Hardware, Software and Network Incidents. Diagnose and troubleshoot hardware, software, network and application- related incidents reported by users. Provide second-line support for desktop, laptop, printer, scanner and connectivity issues. Resolve software, operating system, Microsoft 365, Active Directory and application-related incidents. Analyse incidents to determine the root cause and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence. Escalate unresolved incidents to specialist support teams, vendors or service providers in accordance with support procedures. Log, categorise, prioritise and track incidents through the Help Desk system until closure. Coordinate warranty repairs and equipment replacement with suppliers, manufacturers and contracted service providers. Verify and test returned or replacement equipment before deployment to users. Provide users with regular feedback regarding the status and progress of incidents. Maintain records of incidents, resolutions, escalations and service provider interventions. Monitor recurring incidents and recommend permanent solutions or service improvement initiatives. Ensure incidents are resolved within agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Manage and Prioritise Operational Tasks and ICT Projects to Support Departmental Objectives. Prioritise operational support tasks according to business impact, urgency and management directives. Allocate time between incident resolution, service requests, maintenance activities and project work. Monitor the Help Desk queue and ensure critical incidents receive immediate attention. Execute assigned operational tasks within agreed timelines. Participate in ICT infrastructure, system enhancement and digital transformation projects. Support implementation of new software, hardware and network solutions. Assist with system upgrades, migrations and technology refresh initiatives. Support business continuity and disaster recovery activities. Monitor progress against project plans and report risks and challenges. Collaborate with internal stakeholders, service providers and ICT teams to achieve project objectives. Capture Progress and Generate Completion Reports to Enable Status Updates on System Availability. Log all incidents, service requests, changes and maintenance activities on the Help Desk system. Track and monitor incident response and resolution times. Maintain accurate records of system availability, downtime and service disruptions. Generate daily, weekly and monthly Help Desk performance reports. Produce reports on incident trends, recurring problems and root causes. Prepare system availability and infrastructure status reports for management. Provide timely feedback to users regarding the progress and resolution of incidents. Document solutions, procedures and knowledge-based articles for future reference. Compile project progress and completion reports. Produce recommendations for service improvement based on incident and performance trend analysis.
jobs.enquiries: Mr HS Tshinavhe Tel No: (012) 338 7389

af.title: Senior IKT Tegnikus / Beampte
af.summary: Senior IKT Tegnikus in Pretoria benodig om rekenaarhardeware, sagteware en netwerkstelsels te installeer, te konfigureer en te onderhou; vereis 'n Nasionale Diploma in IT en 3 jaar se ervaring.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en Nasionale Diploma in Inligtingstegnologie (NQF 6) of relevante ewekwaardige kwalifikasies. Minimum 3 jaar in 'n soortgelyke rol wat gebruikers ter plek en/of op afstand ondersteun met rekenaar-, toepassings-, stelsel- en infrastruktuurprobleme. Werksverwante kennis: Soliede diagnostiese en probleemoplossingsvermoëns, met 'n gestruktureerde en logiese benadering tot die oplossing van gebruiker- en stelselprobleme. Deeglike en naatlose oproeplogbestuurproses vir alle oproepe wat deur gebruikers gelog is vir werksbestuurs- en verslagdoelendes. Stelsondersteuning. Werk met Active Directory, O365, antivirus en ander verwante Windows- en Windows Server-gereedskap. Ondersteun gebruikers ter plek en/of op afstand met rekenaar-, toepassings-, stelsel- en infrastruktuurprobleme. Diagnostiese en probleemoplossingsvermoëns, met 'n gestruktureerde en logiese benadering tot die oplossing van gebruiker- en stelselprobleme. Kennis van IKT-standaarde, beste praktyke en beleide. Installasie van hardeware en sagtewarekomponente. Kennis van oproeplogbestuurproses. Teoretiese en praktiese kennis van Active Directory, O365, antivirus en ander verwante Windows- en Windows Server-gereedskap. Openbare Diensregulasies. Werksverwante vaardighede: Kommunikasievaardighede. Probleemoplossing- en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Rekenaarsagtewarevaardighede (goeie Excel-vaardighede). Onderig en mentorskap (hoor-leierskap) vaardighede. Tegniese verslagskryfvaardighede. Aanbiedingsvaardighede. Analitiese vaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Kommunikasievaardighede. Projektbestuurvaardighede. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Installeer, konfigureer en onderhou sagteware- en hardewarekomponente van rekenaar- en netwerkstelsels. Installeer, konfigureer en gradeer rekenaars, skootrekenaars, drukkers en randapparate op. Installeer, konfigureer en onderhou bedryfstelsels, Microsoft 365-toepassings en goedgekeurde besigheidsagteware. Konfigureer en onderhou gebruikerrekeninge, posbusse, groepe en toestemmings in Active Directory en Microsoft 365. Installeer, konfigureer en onderhou netwerktoestelle, insluitend skakelaars, roeteerders en draadlose toegangspunte. Monitor hardeware- en sagtewareprestasie om optimale stelselfunksionaliteit en beskikbaarheid te verseker. Voer voorkomende onderhoud van IKT-toerusting, infrastruktuur en stelsels uit. Voer sagteware-opdaterings, sekuriteitspleisters en fermware-opgraderings uit. Konfigureer en onderhou antivirus, eindpuntbeskerming en ander sekuriteitsoplossings. Bestuur en onderhou IKT-bate registers en konfigurasierekords. Reageer op diensversoeke wat deur die Help Desk geescaleer is en verseker tydige afhandeling volgens diensstandaarde. Monitor herhalende voorvalle en beveel voorkomende maatreëls aan om stelselprestasie en betroubaarheid te verbeter. Diagnoseer, los probleme op en koördineer die oplossing van IKT-hardeware, sagteware en netwerkvoorvalle. Diagnoseer en los hardeware-, sagteware-, netwerk- en toepassingsverwante voorvalle wat deur gebruikers gerapporteer is, op. Verskaf tweedelynsteun vir rekenaar-, skootrekenaar-, drukker-, skandeerder- en konnektiwiteitsprobleme. Los sagteware-, bedryfstelsel-, Microsoft 365-, Active Directory- en toepassingsverwante voorvalle op. Analiseer voorvalle om die oorsaak te bepaal en implementeer korrektiewe maatreëls om herhaling te voorkom. Eskaleer onopgeloste voorvalle na spesialis-ondersteuningspanne, verskaffers of diensverskaffers in ooreenstemming met ondersteuningsprosedures. Log, kategoriseer, prioritiseer en volg voorvalle deur die Help Desk-stelsel tot afsluiting. Koördineer waarborgherstel en toerustingvervanging met verskaffers, vervaardigers en kontraktuele diensverskaffers. Verifieer en toets teruggestuurde of vervangende toerusting voor ontplooiing aan gebruikers. Verskaf gebruikers met gereelde terugvoer rakende die status en vordering van voorvalle. Onderhou rekords van voorvalle, oplossings, eskalasies en diensverskafferintervensies. Monitor herhalende voorvalle en beveel permanente oplossings of diensverbeteringsinisiatiewe aan. Verseker dat voorvalle binne ooreengekome Diensvlakooreenkomste (SLAs) opgelos word. Bestuur en prioritiseer operasionele take en IKT-projekte om departementele doelwitte te ondersteun. Prioritiseer operasionele ondersteuningstake volgens besigheidsimpak, dringendheid en bestuursdirektiewe. Allocateer tyd tussen voorvaloplossing, diensversoeke, onderhoudaktiwiteite en projekwerk. Monitor die Help Desk-wagtou en verseker dat kritieke voorvalle onmiddellike aandag ontvang. Voer toegekende operasionele take binne ooreengekome tydlyne uit. Neem deel aan IKT-infrastruktuur-, stelselverbeterings- en digitale transformasieprojekte. Ondersteun implementering van nuwe sagteware, hardeware en netwerkoplossings. Bystand met stelselopgraderings, migrasies en tegnologie-vernuwingsinisiatiewe. Ondersteun besigheidskontinuïteit en rampsherstelaktiwiteite. Monitor vordering teenoor projekte en rapporteer risiko's en uitdagings. Werk saam met interne belanghebbendes, diensverskaffers en IKT-spanne om projekteikenis te bereik. Vang vordering vas en genereer voltooiingsverslae om statusopdaterings oor stelselbeskikbaarheid moontlik te maak. Log alle voorvalle, diensversoeke, veranderinge en onderhoudaktiwiteite op die Help Desk-stelsel. Volg en monitor voorvalrespons en -oplossingstye. Onderhou akkurate rekords van stelselbeskikbaarheid, ontyd en diensonderbrekings. Genereer daaglikse, weeklikse en maandelikse Help Desk-prestasieverslae. Produseer verslae oor voorvalneigings, herhalende probleme en oorsake. Berei stelselbeskikbaarheid- en infrastruktuurstatusverslae vir bestuur voor. Verskaf tydige terugvoer aan gebruikers rakende die vordering en oplossing van voorvalle. Dokumenteer oplossings, prosedures en kennisgebaseerde artikels vir toekomstige verwysing. Stel projekvordering- en voltooiingsverslae op. Produseer aanbevelings vir diensverbetering gebaseer op voorval- en prestasietendenseanalise.

zu.title: Usuba lwe-ICT eliphakeme / Ephethe
zu.summary: Isubhatha yobuchwepheshe be-ICT edingiwa ePretoria ukufaka, ukulungiselela nokugcina i-hardware yekhompyutha, isoftware kanye nezinhlelo zenkathi.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingezansi: Abafakiseli kufanele babe nesiatifiketi samabanga alikhulu shumi nambili kanye ne-diploma yezwe ebuqopheni lwamanani mayelana nobuchwepheshe benhlalo (NQF 6) noma izifundo ezifanayo ngokomumo. Okuncane kweminyaka eyishumi nantathu endzimeni efanayo yokukweseka abasebenzisi esikhundleni noma kude ngamadesktop, izinhlelo, isinhlelo kanye nezehloko zesakhiwo. Ukwazi okuhlobene nomsebenzi: Amandla okuchaza nokususa inkinga angaphakathi kwekhompyutha ngomthando ocwengekile kanye nonjongo ethile yokuxazulula izinkinga zabasebenzisi nezinhlelo. Inqubo ethize futhi egqamile yokubhalwa kwamakhophu engaso yonke imikhophi abalwe abasebenzisi ngenjongo yokuphatha umsebenzi kanye nokubhala imibiko. Ukukweseka kwamaphulo kanye nezinhlelo. Ukusebenza nge-Active Directory, O365, i-antivirus kanye nezinye izixazululi ezingafaniyo ezingezansi kweWindows kanye ne-Windows Server. Ukukweseka abasebenzisi esikhundleni noma kude ngamadesktop, izinhlelo, izinhlelo kanye nezehloko zesakhiwo. Amandla okuchaza inkinga kanye nokuyosusa, ngendlela ecwengekile kanye ehlelekile yokuxazulula izinkinga zabasebenzisi kanye nezinhlelo. Ulwazi ngemithetho yezibalo yobuchwepheshe ezingcingo, izindlela ezingcono kakhulu kanye nomgomo welawulo. Ukufaka amaningci enzwi kanye nezinhlelo. Ulwazi ngendlela yokubala kwamakhophi mayelana nomsebenzi. Ulwazi lwezibalo nezinto ezenziwayo nge-Active Directory, O365, i-antivirus kanye nezinye izinto ezingezansi kweWindows ne-Windows Server. Imithetho yesikhundla sabantu abakhonza abantu abayiPopi. Amandla ahlobene nomsebenzi: Amandla okuthumela imilwelwayo. Amandla okuxazulula inkinga kanya nokuqina kwesimo ngokomqondo. Amandla okusebenza ngesofthiwe yekhompyutha (amandla amuhle e-Excel). Amandla okuba ngumfundisi kanye nokokuletha kwezinkolelo (nangokuba ngumholi wezibhali). Amandla okubhala imibiko yezobuchwepheshe. Amandla okubonakalisa okuthile. Amandla okuhlaziya inkinga. Amandla okuxazulula izinkinga. Amandla okuxhumana nabantu. Amandla okulawula imisebenzi. Ilayisensi yokushayela ephathwayo.
zu.duties: Ukufaka, ukulungiselela nokugcina izinhlelo zezingcingo neziwa kwekhompyutha nalezinye iziqoqo zehardwehle kanye nezesofthiwe zezinhlelo zekhompyutha nezuthintathu. Faka, ulungiselele futhi ungasize ama-desktop, ama-laptop, ama-printer namanye amadivayisi ongaphandle. Faka, ulungiselele futhi ugcabe izinhlelo zokusebenza, izinhlelo zokusebenza ze-Microsoft 365 kanye nesoftware evunyiwe yebhizinisi. Lungiselela futhi ugcabe ama-akhawunti abasebenzisi, amabhokisi e-imeyili, amaqembu nemvume yokufinyelela ku-Active Directory naku-Microsoft 365. Faka, ulungiselela futhi ugcabe amadivayisi esuthintathu, okuhlanganisa ama-switch, ama-router namaphoyinti okufinyelela angakabeze. Qapha ukusebenza kwe-hardware ne-software ukuze uqiniseke ukusebenza okugcwele kokusebenza kwesinhlelo nokutholakala kwalo. Yenza ukunakekelwa okuvikela ukonakala kweqhibhigu lekhompyutha, isakhiwo kanye nezinhlelo zezingcingo. Yenza izibuyekezo zesoftware, izindikimba zokuvikela kanye nezinguquko ze-firmware. Lungiselela futhi ugcabe i-antivirus, ukuvikeleka kwaphoyinti kanye nezinye izixazululi zokuvikeleka. Phatha futhi ugcabe izibhalo zezimpahla ze-ICT kanye namarekhodi okulungiselela. Phendula izicelo zokusebenza ezikhuliswe nge-Help Desk ukuze uqiniseke ukufeza kwezinkathi ngokusho kwezinga lenkonzo. Qapha izehlakalo eziphindaphindayo futhi uphakamise izindlela zokuvikela ukuthi kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kokugqamisa kwesinhlelo nokuqiniseka kwalo. Chaza, susa inkinga futhi uhlanganise ukuxazulula kwezehlakalo ze-hardware ze-ICT, isoftware kanye nezinhlelo zesuthintathu. Chaza futhi ususe inkinga kwe-hardware, isoftware, isuthintathu kanye nezehlakalo eziqhathaniswa nezinhlelo ezibikhiwe abasebenzisi. Nikeza inkonzo yokusiza yesibili yedesktop, i-laptop, i-printer, isikenauri kanye nenkinga yokuxhumana. Xazulula izinhlelo zokusebenza, izinhlelo zokusebenza ze-Microsoft 365, i-Active Directory kanye nezehlakalo eziqhathaniswa nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Hlaziya izehlakalo ukuthi uthole imvelo yenkinga futhi usebenzise izenzo zokulungisa ukuze uvikele ukuphindaphinda kwenkinga. Thumela ezinhlebeni ezingaxazululwanga kubuchwepheshe besikhashana bokukweseka, kwabathengisi noma kubanikezwa benkonzo ngokusho kwenqubo yokukweseka. Bala, wahlukanise, wabeka ngokubaluleka futhi ulande izehlakalo ngesistimu ye-Help Desk kuze kufe nkusuku lokuvala kwazo. Hlanganisa okulungiswa kwesibhamu semfanelo kanye noshintsho lwempahla nabahlinzeki, nabakhiqizi nabanye abanikez inkonzo ngomqondo othile. Qinisekisa futhi uhlola impahla ebuyisiwe noma eshintshiwe ngaphambi kokuyinikela abasebenzisi. Nikeza abasebenzisi imininingwane njalo mayelana nesimo nokuqhubeka kwezehlakalo. Gcina amarekhodi wezehlakalo, izixazululi, ukusikweswa kwenkonzo yabachwepheshe kanye nokungenelela kwabanikeli benkonzo. Qapha izehlakalo eziphindaphindayo futhi uphakamise izixazululi ezihlala njalo noma izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa inkonzo. Qinisekisa ukuthi izehlakalo zixazululwa ngaphakathi kwemvume yemvumelwano ye-Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Phatha futhi ubale ngokubaluleka imisebenzi yokusebenza kanye namaphulo e-ICT ukuze usesuke ngqo ngemigomo yomnyango. Beka ngokubaluleka imisebenzi yokweseka ngokusho kwesithsakazo sebhalazwe, ukuphutha kanye nemiyalo yabaphathi. Hlela isikhathi phakathi kokuxazulula izehlakalo, izicelo zenkonzo, imisebenzi yokunakekela futhi omunye umsebenzi waphulo. Qapha umbhalo we-Help Desk ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi izehlakalo ezibaluleke kakhulu ziba nelukhulu njalo. Yenza imisebenzi yokusebenza enikiwe ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esimisiwe. Thatha inhlalo ezinhleleni zesakhiwo se-ICT, ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo kanye nokushintshwa kwezinto kuya kwezezibhangqiwe. Sekela ukusetshenziswa kusoftware entsha, ye-hardware kanye nezixazululi zesuthintathu. Siza ngokuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo, ukuhambahamba nobunikho bobuchwepheshe obusha. Sekela imisebenzi yokuqhubeka kwebhizinisi kanye nemisebenzi yokubuyisela emva kokubhodla. Qapha ukukhula ngokumelene nezinhlelo zaphulo futhi ufake ingozi ezibukeyo futhi inkinga. Sebenzisana ngaphakathi nababhangqwe kanye namaqembu e-ICT ukuze kufezeke imigomo yaphulo. Qamba ukukhula kanye nokukhiqiza imibiko yokufeza konke ngokwezimo yokutholakala kwesinhlelo. Bala yonke imibhikhi yezehlakalo, izicelo zenkonzo, izinguquko kanye nemisebenzi yokunakekela kwi-Help Desk. Landa futhi uqaphele izikhathi zokuphendula futhi zokuxazulula izehlakalo. Gcina amarekhodi eqiniso wokutholakala kwesinhlelo, isikhathi esingasebenzi kanye nobunikho bezinkinga zenkonzo. Akho imibiko yokusukeka kwe-Help Desk nsuku zonke, masonto, kanye nanyanga zonke. Khiqize imibiko mayelana nezehlakalo eziphaphathekayo, izinkinga eziphindaphindayo kanye namaphakamisa azenza kwenkinga. Lungiselela imibiko yesimo sesinhlelo kanye nesakhiwo sokubakwa kakhulu ngabaphathi. Nikeza abasebenzisi imininingwane yesikhathi esifanele mayelana nokuqhubeka kanye nokuqeda izehlakalo. Qamba izixazululi, izinqubo kanye namaphasi abuchwepheshe ukubhaliwe okuzosetshenziswa ngakusasa. Hlela imibiko yokukhula nokufeza kokuphila kwaphulo. Khiqiza izincoma zokuthuthukisa inkonzo ngokusekelwa kuhlaziyo lwehlelokulo nokukhula kwenkinga.

xh.title: Omlindi wekhompyutha wezinga eliphezulu / Ofisa
xh.summary: Kufuneka kubekho Omlindi wekhompyutha wezinga eliphezulu e Pretoria ukuba ayise, aqamise kwaye agcine iihardwe ze khompyutha, isoftwe kunye nezithulisi zenetwakhi, kwaye kufuneka abe ne Diploma yezizwe kwi-IT kunye neminyaka emi-3 yamava.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingowona mgangatho: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe ne-Sathifikethi se-Grade 12 kunye ne-Diploma yezizwe kwi-Information Technology (NQF 6) okanye izifundo ezidingekayo ezilinganayo. Kubangaphezulu kweminyaka emi-3 kwindima efanayo exhasa abasebenzisi kwindawo okanye kude ngokusebenzisa idesktop, izicelo, inkqubo kunye neembangela zeziseko. Ulwazi oluxhomekekitsho kumsebenzi: Ikhono eliqinileyo lokuxilonga nokusombulula iingxaki, nendlela ecocekileyo nengaqondakalayo yokusombulula iingxaki zabasebenzisi nzenkqubo. Inqubo echanekileyo nengahlaziyekiyo yokulawula irekhodi lokubiza yonke imibizeyo ebhalwe ngabasebenzisi ngenjongo yokulawula umsebenzi nokubika. Ixhaso lenkqubo. Ukusebenza ne-Active Directory, O365, i-Anti-virus nezinye izixhobo ezinxulumene ne-Windows ne-Windows Server. Ukuxhasa abasebenzisi kwindawo okanye kude ngokusebenzisa idesktop, izicelo, inkqubo kunye neembangela zeziseko. Ikhono lokuxilonga nokusombulula iingxaki, nendlela ecocekileyo nengaqondakalayo yokusombulula iingxaki zabasebenzisi nzenkqubo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo ye-ICT, iindlela ezilungileyo namapolisi. Ukufakeela iinhlobo zehardwe nesoftwe. Ulwazi nganqubo yokulawula irekhodi yokubiza. Ulwazi ngokubaluleka nangokusebenziseka kwe-Active Directory, i-O365, i-anti-virus nezinye izixhobo ezinxulumene ne-Windows ne-Windows Server. Imigaqo yoBunikelo bokuSebenza koRhulumente. Amapilityhi axhomekekitsho kumsebenzi: Amapilityhi okunxibelelana. Amapilityhi okusombulula iingxaki nokuthatha izigqibo. Amapilityhi ohlelo lwekhompyutha (amapilityhi amabalwa kwi-excel). Amapilityhi okuqeqesha nokukhokelela (apilityhi okukhokela ngokucinga). Amapilityhi okubhala iingxelo ngekhono. Amapilityhi okubonisa. Amapilityhi okuhlalutya. Amapilityhi okusombulula iingxaki. Amapilityhi okunxibelelana. Amapilityhi okulawula iprojekthi. Ilayiseni yomqhubi egunyazisiweyo.
xh.duties: Ukufakeela, Ukuqamisa kwaye Kugcine iinxalenye zesoftwe nehardwe zenkqubo yekhompyutha netwakhi. Faka, qamisa kwaye uluze izikhompyutha zedesktop, iilaptopi, iiprinta nezixhobo ezingaphandle. Faka, qamise kwaye ugcinise iinkqubo zokusebenza, izicelo ze-Microsoft 365 nesoftwe yeshishini egunyazisiweyo. Qamisa kwaye ugcinise i-akhawunti zabasebenzisi, iimeyileboxi, amaqela namagunya kwi-Active Directory nakwi-Microsoft 365. Faka, qamise kwaye ugcinise izixhobo zenetwakhi, kuquka iiswitshi, i-routa neenkcukacha zokungena kwithatshe. Qwalasela inkqubo yehardwe nesoftwe ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza okuthe ngqo kwaye ifikeleleka. Qhuba ulondolozo oluthintela iingxaki zeqhinga lekhompyutha, iziseko nenkqubo. Yenza izihlaziyo zesoftwe, izicengcelezo zokhuseleko nokunyuka kwe-firmware. Qamisa kwaye ugcinise i-antivirus, ukhuselo lwe-endpoint nezinye izisombululo zokhuseleko. Lawula kwaye ugcinise iirekhodi zempahla ye-ICT kunye neerecords zokuqamisa. Phendula iicelo zenkonzo ezithunyelwe nge-Help Desk kwaye uqinisekise ukuzaliseka kwexesha ngokwemigaqo yenkonzo. Qwalasela iingxaki eziphinda-philayo kwaye ucebisise izigqibo ezithintela iingxaki ukuphucula ukusebenza nokuzinza kwenkqubo. Xilonga, sombula kwaye ulawule ukusombululwa kweengxaki zehardwe, isoftwe nenetwakhi ze-ICT. Xilonga kwaye usombule iingxaki zehardwe, isoftwe, netwakhi nezicelo ezibiliselwa ngabasebenzisi. Bonelela ngexhaso lesibini ledesktop, ilaptopi, iprinta, iskanne neengxaki zokudibanisa. Sombla iingxaki zesoftwe, inkqubo yokuqhamba, i-Microsoft 365, i-Active Directory nezicelo ezinxulumene. Hlalutya iingxaki ukuqinisekisa imbangela yemveli kwaye usebenzise iinyuso zolungiso ukuthintela ukuphila kwakhona. Thumela iingxaki ezingazinzisiweyo kwiqela elixhasa ngekhono, kubathengisi okanye kubanikezeli benkonzo ngokwemigaqo yoxhaso. Bhala, wahlule ngokubaluleka, wabekise ngangaphambili kwaye ulandele iingxaki ngenkqubo ye-Help Desk de kugqitywe. Lawula izimilo zesiqinisekiso nokutshintshwa kwempahla nabathengisi, abavelisi kunye nabasebenzisi abaqashiweyo. Qinisekisa kwaye uvavanye impahla ebuyisiweyo okanye etshintshwayo phambi kokuyinika abasebenzisi. Bonelela abasebenzisi ngenkcazelo evamileyo ngobungakanani nangokuqhubeka kweengxaki. Gcina iirekhodi zeengxaki, izisombululo, ukuthunyelwa nabanye nabahlinzeki benkonzo. Qwalasela iingxaki eziphinda-philayo kwaye ucebisise izisombululo ezingatshatanga okanye iinkqubo zokuphucula inkonzo. Qinisekisa ukuba iingxaki zisombululwa kwithuba elivunyelwe yi-Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Lawula kwaye Ubekise ngangaphambili imisebenzi yokusebenza kunye neeprojekthi ze-ICT ukuze zixhase iinjongo zeSebe. Bekisa ngangaphambili imisebenzi yoxhaso lokusebenza ngokwentshukumo yeshishini, umyinge wobuzingo kunye neemiyalelo yolawulo. Wabelana nexesha phakathi kokusombulula iingxaki, iicelo zenkonzo, imisebenzi yolondolozo nomsebenzi weprojekthi. Qwalasela umgca we-Help Desk kwaye uqinisekise ukuba iingxaki ezibalulekileyo zifumana ingqalelo yangoko nangoko. Zala imisebenzi yokusebenza enikiweyo kwithuba elivunyelweyo. Thatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zeziseko ze-ICT, ukuphuculwa kwenkqubo neeprojekthi zokuguqula ngokwedijitha. Xhasa ukusebenzisa isoftwe entsha, ihardwe nezisombululo zenetwakhi. Nceda kwiinkqubo zohlaziyo lwesixhobo, ukuthuthela kwiindawo ezitsha nokuqaliswa kobuchwepheshe obutsha. Xhasa iinkqubo zoqhagamshelo lwebhishini kunye nemisebenzi yokuqhuma inkqubo. Qwalasela inkqubo ngokomyalelo weprojekthi kwaye ubeke iingozi kunye neenqaqamba. Sebenzisana nabahlalekayo ngaphakathi, abanikezeli benkonzo namanqanaba e-ICT ukuze kufikelelwe kwiinjono zeprojekthi. Thatha inqaba Yokuqhubeka kwaye Uveze Iingxelo zokuQwalasela ukuze kuqhubekele phambili iNkcazelo ngeFikeleleka kweNkqubo. Bhala yonke imibize, iicelo zenkonzo, utshintsho kunye nemisebenzi yolondolozo kwenkqubo ye-Help Desk. Landelela kwaye ulawule ixesha lokuphendula nokuqhubela phambili iingxaki. Gcina iirekhodi ezichanekileyo zofikelelo lwenkqubo, ixesha le nkqubo engasebenziyo kwaye kukhawuleziswe inkonzo. Yaza iingxelo zemihla ngemihla, yamasonto ngenyanga zokusebenza kwe-Help Desk. Yenza iingxelo ngamaphetha eengxaki, iingxaki eziphinda-philayo kunye neembangela zemveli. Lungiselela iingxelo zofikelelo lwenkqubo nommandla weziseko wolawulo. Bonelela iinkcazelo ezikhawulezayo kubasebenzisi ngokuqhubeka phambili nokusombululwa kweengxaki. Bhala izisombululo, iinqobo nokuqamba ngokwaziso oluvela kumagatya abakho. Qamba iingxelo zokuqhubeka phambili nokugqitywa kweprojekthi. Yaza izimvo zokuphucula inkonzo ngokuhlalutya kwamaphetha eengxaki.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Financial Services
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Financial Services at the Limpopo Deeds Registry in Polokwane, managing budgets, revenue, and expenditure for the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and National Diploma or Degree in Accounting / Financial Accounting / Financial Management / Management Accounting or related equivalent qualifications. 3 Years Supervisory experience in Financial environment. Knowledge of Public Finance Management Act (PMFA). Knowledge of Treasury Regulations. Policies procedures and prescripts. Financial systems including Accpac. Budgets and reporting procedures. Good written and verbal communication skills. Financial Management skills. Interpersonal skills. Computer software skills (good excel skills). Problem Solving and Decision-Making skills. Time Management skills. Budget forecasting skills. Driver’s License.
jobs.duties: Manage budget. Cost Demand Management Plan. Confirm availability of funds. Monitor and control income and expenditure trends and advise. Provide comments on In-Year Monitoring report. Provide inputs for adjustment of budget. Manage revenue, cash, and banking services. Monitor banking of state money. Monitor administration of Petty Cash. Monitor exempt transaction report. Manage debtors. Monitor recovery of outstanding debt and collection progress report. Analyze comments on debtors and revenue reports and take corrective measures. Oversee application of unapplied cash. Oversee the opening of accounts. Oversee suspension of overdue accounts. Make recommendations on dispute and queries, respond and monitor queries report. Review credit notes, B-accounts and related parties. Oversee debit and credit notes. Control internal debtors. Manage of creditors. Monitor payment of suppliers/ service providers. Approve invoices on the system. Approve adjustments and clear suspense account. Review processed reconciliation. Verify S&T claims and advances.
jobs.enquiries: Ms Maropeng Mobe/ Mr Eliot Nyamandi Tel No: (015) 495 1976
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: Office of the Registrar of Deeds, Limpopo at 101 Dorp St, Polokwane Central, Polokwane, 0700. Candidates are also encouraged to apply by using this link http://deedsportal.deeds.gov.za before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. Applications and supporting documents sent to us that are not specified in the advertisement for the post that you are applying for will not be accepted
jobs.notes: EE Targets: Coloured, Indian, and White Males, and Coloured, Indian, and White Females, and Persons with Disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form, (a nomination letter if required) and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. All shortlisted candidate, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidates suitability based on the posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre-entry programme offered by the National School of       Government          (NSG).       Find      course       details     here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/ appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re-advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination.
