af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Finansiële Dienste
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur: Finansiële Dienste by die Limpopo Deeds Registry in Polokwane, bestuur van begrotings, inkomste en uitgawes vir die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma of Graad in Rekenkunde / Finansiële Rekenkunde / Finansiële Bestuur / Bestuursrekenkunde of verwante gelykwaardige kwalifikasies hê. 3 jaar se toesigervaring in 'n finansiële omgewing. Kennis van Public Finance Management Act (PMFA). Kennis van Treasury Regulations. Beleide prosedures en voorskrifte. Finansiële stelsels insluitend Accpac. Begrotings en verslagdoeningsprosedures. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Finansiële bestuursvaardighede. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Rekenaarprogrammatuurvaardighede (goeie Excel-vaardighede). Probleemoplossings- en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Tydbestuursvaardighede. Begrotingsvoorspellingsvaardighede. Bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Bestuur begroting. Kost Vraagbestuursplan. Bevestig beskikbaarheid van fondse. Monitor en beheer inkomste- en uitgawetendense en gee advies. Verskaf kommentaar op In-Year Monitoring-verslag. Verskaf insette vir aanpassing van begroting. Bestuur inkomste, kontant en bankdienste. Monitor bank van staatsgeld. Monitor administrasie van klein kontant. Monitor vrystellingstransaksieverslag. Bestuur skuldenaars. Monitor terugbetaling van uitstaande skuld en invorderingsvorderingsverslag. Analiseer kommentaar op skuldenaars- en inkomsteverslae en neem regstellende maatreëls. Hou toesig oor toepassing van onontpasse kontant. Hou toesig oor opening van rekeninge. Hou toesig oor opskorting van agterstallige rekeninge. Maak aanbevelings oor dispute en navrae, reageer en monitor navraeverslag. Hersien kredietnotas, B-rekeninge en verwante partye. Hou toesig oor debiet- en kredietnotas. Beheer interne skuldenaars. Bestuur van skuldeisers. Monitor betaling van verskaffers / diensverskaffers. Keur fakture op die stelsel goed. Keur aanpassings en skakel wagrekening uit. Hersien verwerkte rekonsiliasie. Verifieer S&A-eise en vooruitgawes.

zu.title: Umtdidi Wezimali: Izinsiza Zemali
zu.summary: Umtdidi Wezimali e-Limpopo Deeds Registry e-Polokwane, ephatha amabhajethi, imali etholwayo, kanye nokuchithwa kwemali kuMnyango Wezokulungiswa Komhlaba Nentuthuko Yezomphakathi.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi kwalezi: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-National Diploma noma i-Degree ku-Accounting / Financial Accounting / Financial Management / Management Accounting noma izifundo ezingabanzi ezihlobene nalokho. Ukuhamba kweminyaka engu-3 ngokuba nisipiliyoni sokuphatha esimweni sezimali. Ukwazi i-Public Finance Management Act (PMFA). Ukwazi i-Treasury Regulations. Izinqubomgomo, inqubo nezinqumela. Izinhlela zemali kuhlanganise i-Accpac. Amabhajethi kanye nenqubo yokubika. Amakhono okubhala nokukhuluma kahle. Amakhono okuphatha izimali. Amakhono okuhlobana nabantu. Amakhono ohlelo lwesikhompuyutha (amakhono amahle e-excel). Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga nokuthatha izinqumo. Amakhono okuphatha isikhathi. Amakhono okubikezela amabhajethi. Ilayisensi yokushayela.
zu.duties: Phatha ibhajethi. Linganisa i-Demand Management Plan. Qinisekisa ukutholakala kwemali. Qapha lawa aphathe ukuphuma nokungena kwemali futhi unikeze izeluleko. Nikeza izinkulumo embikweni we-In-Year Monitoring. Nikeza okufakwayo ngokulungiswa kwebhajethi. Phatha imali etholwayo, imali yebhange, kanye nezinsiza zebhange. Qapha ukufakwa kwemali yombuso ebhange. Qapha ukuphathwa kwe-Petty Cash. Qapha umbiko we-exempt transaction. Phatha abanikazi. Qapha ukubuyiswa kwemali engekakhokhwa kanye nombiko wokuqhubekela phambili kokoqoqo. Hlaziya izinkulumo emibikweni yabanikazi nenyengo yemali bese uthatha izinyathelo zokulungisa. Buka ukusetshenziswa kwemali engasetshenzisiwe. Buka ukuvulwa kwezikhwama. Buka ukumiswa kwezikhwama eziyikhonondo. Nikeza izincomo ezimpikiswanweni nakubuzweni, phendula bese uqapha umbiko wombuzo. Qamba izikweletu, ama-B-accounts kanye namaqembu ahlobene. Buka izikweletu namakhredithi. Lawula abanikazi bangaphakathi. Phatha abakweletayo. Qapha ukukhokhwa kwabahlinzeki/abahlinzeki bezinsiza. Vuma amainvoyisi ohlelweni. Vuma okulungiwe bese usula isikhwama se-suspense. Buka ukuhlanganisana okucutshiwe. Qinisekisa izimangalo kanye nezindawo ze-S&T.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNqanaba eliPhakamileyo: Iinkonzo zeMali
xh.summary: Umncedisi weNqanaba eliPhakamileyo: Iinkonzo zeMali kwiLimpopo Deeds Registry ePolokwane, elilawula amabhajethi, inkomishi, nentlawulo-mali kwisebe leLand Reform and Rural Development.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaka izicelo kufuneka babe neSatifikethi seQela le-12 kunye neDiploma yesiZwe okanye iDegree kwi-Accounting / Financial Accounting / Financial Management / Management Accounting okanye izifundo ezinxulumene nazo ezingabanabazingeli. 3 Years zemfundo yokubeka abantu kwindalo yemali. Ulwazi ngoPublic Finance Management Act (PMFA). Ulwazi ngeTreasury Regulations. Iingqungquthela, iindlela zokwenza izinto kunye nemithetho. Iisistim zemali kuquka iAccpac. Amabhajethi nendlela yokwenza iingxelo. Amakhono amabalwa nabaphethwe ngomlomo okubakhawuleza. Amakhono oLawulo lweMali. Amakhono okuhamba ngabanye. Amakhono olwazi lwekhompyutha (amakhono amahle kwi-excel). Amakhono okuzeza ngengcinga kunye nokwenza izigqibo. Amakhono oLawulo loNxweme. Amakhono okucebisa ngebhajethi. iLayisensi yokuQhuba.
xh.duties: Lawula ibhajethi. Yenza iCost Demand Management Plan. Qinisekisa ukubakho kwemali. Qhapha ulawulo kwengeniso nentlawulo-mali kwaye unikeze inkxaso. Nikeza amagama kumaxesha onyaka wokulawula ingxelo. Nikeza izinto zokulungisa ibhajethi. Lawula inkomishi, imali ngokunxulumene naye, nolonke iisistim ze-banking. Qhapha ukubhankela kwemali kahulumeni. Qhapha ukulawula kancinci kwePetty Cash. Qhapha ingxelo yemisebenzi ekhutshwa kumda. Lawula abatyikitya imali. Qhapha ukubuyiswa kwetyala elingahlawulwanga kunye negxelo yokuqokelela. Hlaziya amagama abatyikityi imali nangengxelo yemali, ulandele iindawo ekufuneka zilungiswe. Qhapha ukusetyenziswa kwemali engasetyenziswanga. Qhapha ukuvulwa kweeposi zemali. Qhapha ukumiswa kweposi zemali ezingahlawulwanga. Zama ukunikela izindululo ngemibuzo nezicelo, phendula uqhqe ingxelo yemibuzo. Phinda ujonge i-credit notes, i-B-accounts kunye nabahlobo abasondelene. Qhapha i-debit nam-credit notes. Lawula abatyikitya imali abangaphakathi. Lawula abakrelekrele. Qhapha ukuhlawulwa kwabahlinzeki / abakho yonke imithombo yokuhlinzekwa. Vuma i-invoices kwisistim. Vuma ukulungelelwa kwaye ucime i-akhawunti esithintele. Phinda ujonge ukulungelelanisa okwenziweyo. Qinisekisa i-S&T claims nokuqhubela phambili.

jobs.title: Senior Examiner
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Senior Examiner needed in Polokwane to examine deeds and documents for registrability, requiring a law diploma or LLB and three years of deeds examination experience.

Communication skills. Organising skills. Problem- solving skills. Interpersonal skills. Report writing. Supervisory skills. People Management skills. Interpretation skills. Analytical skills. Presentation skills.
jobs.duties: Examine deeds and documents. Check that first level examination duties have been performed and initiate corrective measures where necessary. Examine deeds for registrability, advise conveyancers about non-compliance with practice, procedures and legislation then pass or reject deeds and documents. Compile quality assurance report, take appropriate interventions and submit. Update acts, manuals and circulars. Training of subordinates. Conduct person- to-person training and keep training schedule and submit. Nominate subordinates for deeds training courses. Consult with clients relating to deeds and documents. Discuss notes with Conveyancers and provide guidance. Check the deeds for compliance and remove notes. Distribute deeds. Sort and assess/value deeds for distribution and compile distribution list. Distribute deeds according to transactions and batches to Examiners. Monitor allocated townships / schemes / rosters / corrective maintenance and expedited deeds. Analyse DOTS reports on discrepancies and outstanding deeds and initiate corrective measures. Implement measures to address backlogs.

af.title: Senior Eksamineerder
af.summary: Senior Eksamineerder word in Polokwane benodig om aktes en dokumente vir registrasiebaarheid te ondersoek, met 'n regte-diploma of LLB en drie jaar se ondervinding in akte-ondersoek as vereistes.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en Nasionale Diploma in Regte / Nasionale Diploma Akteregistrasiereg / Buri / B Proc / LLB of verwante gelykwaardige kwalifikasies. 3 jaar se ondervinding in eerste-vlak ondersoek van aktes en dokumente. Akteregistrasieprosesse en prosedures. Interpretasie van wette. Ondersoek van aktes. Menslike hulpbronvoorskrifte. Projekbestuur. Eiendomsreg. Rekenaarvaardighede. Kommunikasievaardighede. Organiseringsvaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Verslagdoening. Toesighoudende vaardighede. Mensebestuursvaardighede. Interpretasievaardighede. Analitiese vaardighede. Voorleggingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Ondersoek aktes en dokumente. Kontroleer dat eerste-vlak ondersoekepligte uitgevoer is en stel regstellende maatreëls in waar nodig. Ondersoek aktes vir registrasiebaarheid, stel conveyancers in kennis van nie-nakoming van praktyk, prosedures en wetgewing en keur dan aktes en dokumente goed of verwerp dit. Stel kwaliteitsversekeringsverslag op, neem toepaslike ingrypingsmaatreëls en dien dit in. Dateer wette, handleidings en sirkulieres op. Opleiding van ondergeskiktes. Voer persoon-tot-persoon opleiding uit, hou opleidingskedule by en dien dit in. Benoem ondergeskiktes vir akte-opleidingskursusse. Raadpleeg kliënte rakende aktes en dokumente. Bespreek notas met conveyancers en verskaf leiding. Kontroleer aktes vir nakoming en verwyder notas. Versprei aktes. Sorteer en evalueer aktes vir verspreiding en stel verspreidingslys op. Versprei aktes volgens transaksies en groepe na eksamineerders. Monitor toegewyse dorp / skemas / roosters / regstellende onderhoud en versnelde aktes. Analiseer DOTS-verslae oor afwykings en uitstaande aktes en stel regstellende maatreëls in. Implementeer maatreëls om agterstande aan te spreek.

zu.title: Umqondo Omkhulu Wokuqapha
zu.summary: Kudingeka uMqondo Omkhulu Wokuqapha ePolokwane ukuqapha izinkwende namadokhumenti ukubuka ukuthi zingabhalwa kanjani ngokusemthethweni, kudinga idiploma yomthetho noma i-LLB namakhulu eminyaka emithathu yohlu lokuqapha izinkwende.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okubalulekileyo: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 kanye neNational Diploma in Law / National Diploma Deeds Registration Law / Buris / B Proc / LLB noma izifundo ezilinganayo ezohlobene. 3 years’ experience in first level examination of deeds and documents. Inqubo nezindlela zokubhaliswa kwezinkwende. Ukutolikwa kwemithetho. Ukuqapha izinkwende. Imithetho yeHuman Resource. Ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi. Umthetho weziphethu. Amakhono wokusebenza ngekompyutha. Amakhono okuxhumana. Amakhono aokusihlela. Amakhonookusombulula izinkinga. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu. Ukubhala imibiko. Amakhono okuphatha. Amakhono okuphatha abantu. Amakhono okutolikwa. Amakhono okuhlaziya. Amakhono okubukisa.
zu.duties: Qapha izinkwende namadokhumenti. Hlola ukuthi imisebenzi yokuqapha ezingeni lokuqala yenziwe bese uqala izinyathelo zokulungisa lapho kudingeka khona. Qapha izinkwende ukubona ukuthi zingabhalwa kanjani ngokusemthethweni, weluleze oqambele izinkwende ngokungahambisani nemikhuba, izindlela nomthetho bese udumulisa noma ungamukeli izinkwende namadokhumenti. Hlanganisa imibiko ye-quality assurance, thatha izinyathelo ezifanele bese uyithumela. Bukisa imithetho, izincwadi eziyimithetho namaketsethisi. Ukugadwa kwabangaphansi. Yenza ukugadwa komuntu-kuromuntu futhi ugcine ishejuli yokugadwa bese uyithumela. Phakamisa abangaphansi ukuthi bathathe amakosi okugadwa izinkwende. Phonsa nomxhasi ngezenkendo zamadokhumenti. Xoxa izinto eziqoshiwe nama-Conveyancers futhi unikeze isiqondiso. Hlola izinkwende ukubona ukuthi zihambisana yini bese ususa izinto eziqoshiwe. Saba izinkwende. Hlela futhi hlola/nika inani lezinkwende ukuze zisatshuliswe bese uhlanganisa uhlu lokusatshulwa. Satshuliswa izinkwende ngokohlobo lomsebenzi nangamabhotshisi kuboqaquli izinkwende. Qapha izitishi noma amaphulo noma amarooster noma ukulungiswa okulungisayo nezinkwende ezisheshisiwe ezabelwe. Hlaziya imibiko yeDOTS ngokungalengi nangohlu olungalungile izinkwende bese uqala izinyathelo zokulungisa. Setha izinyathelo ukubhekana ne-backlog.

xh.title: Umahluli Ophakamileyo
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umahluli ophakamileyo ePolokwane ukuhola izidanga namaxwebhu ukubona ukuba zingabhaliswa na, kufunelo idiploma yomthetho okanye i-LLB neminyaka emi-3 yamava ohlolwa izidanga.

I-3 yeminyaka yamava kwinqanaba lokuqala lokuhola izidanga namaxwebhu. Iinkqubo nemigaqo yokubhaliswa kwezidanga. Ukucazulula imithetho. Ukuhola izidanga. Imigaqo yabaBantu. uLawulo lweProjekthi. uMthetho weMpahla. Iakhono lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Iakhono lokunxibelelana. Iakhono lokuhlela. Iakhono lokuxazula iingxaki. Iakhono zophatho lweabantu. Ukubhala iingxelo. Iakhono lokulawula abantu. Iakhono zolawulo lwabantu. Iakhono zokucazulula. Iakhono zohlalutyo. Iakhono zokusentongo.
xh.duties: Hlola izidanga namaxwebhu. Qinisekisa ukuba imisebenzi yohlelo lokuqala yokuhlolwa kwenziwe kwaye uqale izigubo zolungisa apho kufunekayo. Hlola izidanga ukubona ukuba zingabhaliswa na, uxelele abagcini bezidanga ngokungahambelani nenkqubo,nemigaqo nemithetho yokuqhuba uze udlule okanye wali izidanga namaxwebhu. Hlela ingxelo yokuqinisekisa umgangatho, thatha izigubo ezifanelekileyo uze uzithumele. Hlaziya imithetho, iimanuali neendaba ezigqithiswayo. Uqeqesho labangaphantsi. Yenza uqeqesho lomntu-kuye-mntu uze ugcinise umcimbe wokuqeqesha uze uwuthumele. Tata abangaphantsi kumaxabiso oqeqesho lezidanga.Nxibelela nabathengi ngezidanga namaxwebhu. Thetha ngeengxelo nabagcinibezidanga uze unike imigaqo. Hlola izidanga ukubona ukuba ziyahambelana na uze ususe iingxelo. Sabela izidanga. Hlela ukuze uhlole/nike ixabiso izidanga ngokusabela uze uhlele uluhlu lokusabela. Sabela izidanga ngokweentengiso kunye neeqela kubahliwa. Qaphela amaphandle abekelwe ithafa / amacebo / ooluhu / ulungiso olulungisiweyo nezidanga ezijoliswe ukwenza ngokukhawuleza. Caculula iingxelo ze-DOTS ngemiba engahambelaniyo nezidanga ezingegenile uze uqale izigubo zolungiso. Yenza izigubo zokuunciphisa iindleko ezibekwe ngasexesheni.

jobs.title: Principal Cadastral Officer
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Capture and maintain cadastral survey data for the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Pietermaritzburg.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Certificate in Geomatics or Survey Officer Certificate (NQF Level 5). Minimum of 6 years geomatics post qualification experience in a geomatics or cadastral survey environment. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of Geographical Information Systems Software and fundamentals. Knowledge of Surveyor-General’s Office Standard Operating Procedures and processes. Knowledge of Cadastral Surveys. Job related skills: Problem solving and analysis. Decision making. Team leadership. Creativity. Customer focus and responsiveness. Communication (verbal and written). Computer literacy. Planning and organising. Conflict management. Negotiation.
jobs.duties: Capture, maintain and update alpha numeric data of simple as well as more complex cadastral documents. Capture alpha and numeric information from newly submitted cadastral documents (simple and complex) and undertake mathematical consistency checks of and data verification of proposed new land parcels. Update cadastral survey databases through the addition or amendment of every approved document (simple and complex) to maintain an electronic alpha-numeric repository. Capture and verify simple and complex historical cadastral documents. Attend to complicated maintenance of cadastral documents in accordance with legislated processes. Perform withdrawal or cancelation of cadastral documents upon lawful instruction. Deduct, cancel and endorse cadastral documents with registered land parcels, leases or servitudes. Attend to complex amendments of approved and registered cadastral documents. Insert all newly approved cadastral documents into the archive. Extract and issue out cadastral records. Refile returned cadastral records. Repair and keep cadastral records in good usable condition. Conduct technical examination of simple as well as more complex cadastral documents. Check designations of newly submitted lodgements. Perform technical examination of simple and complex diagrams and general plans. Perform technical examination of survey records. Perform technical examination of simple and complex sectional title plans. Update the noting sheets through the addition of every approved cadastral land parcel. Research and supply cadastral information to internal and external clients. Retrieve and supply cadastral information to clients. Supply aerial photographs, rectified imagery and maps from National Geospatial Information (NGI) according to signed service level agreements. Carry out basic research into cadastral survey information pertaining to land parcel boundaries for clients and Land Reform. Capture, maintain and update spatial data with simple as well as more complex cadastral documents. Capture newly submitted documents to determine if there are any spatial overlaps prior approval. Add data, update and maintain an accurate dataset of cadastral spatial information, including the addition and updating of historical data. Research possible sources of error if overlaps are detected and address errors appropriately. Utilise cadastral survey calculation principles and other legitimate sources of data to improve the quality of land parcel boundary information. Scan all cadastral documents on approval, amendment, endorsement or withdrawal and execute quality checking. Scan newly approved cadastral documents. Re-scan all updated (amended, endorsed or withdrawn) cadastral documents. Link the deposited scanned images to the alpha numeric data. Carry out operations and do quality checking to ensure that the scanned image databases are clean and accurate.

af.title: Hoofkadastrale Amptenaar
af.summary: Vang kadastrale opnamedata vir die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Pietermaritzburg vas en hou dit aktueel.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Sertifikaat in Geomatika of 'n Opname-amptenaarsertifikaat (NQF Level 5) hê. Minimum van 6 jaar geomatika-kwalifikasie-ervaring in 'n geomatika- of kadastrale opname-omgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van Geografiese Inligtingstelselsagteware en -grondbeginsels. Kennis van die Surveyor-General's Office se standaard bedryfsprosedures en prosesse. Kennis van kadastrale opnames. Werksverwante vaardighede: Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Besluitneming. Spanleierskap. Kreatiwiteit. Klantefokus en reaksievermoë. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Rekenaarvaardigheid. Beplanning en organisering. Konflikbestuur. Onderhandeling.
af.duties: Vang alfanumeriese data van eenvoudige sowel as meer komplekse kadastrale dokumente vas, hou dit aktueel en dateer dit op. Vang alfa- en numeriese inligting uit nuut ingediende kadastrale dokumente (eenvoudig en kompleks) vas en onderneem wiskundige konsekwensiekontroles en dataverifikasie van voorgestelde nuwe landperke. Dateer kadastrale opnamedatabasisse op deur die byvoeging of wysiging van elke goedgekeurde dokument (eenvoudig en kompleks) om 'n elektroniese alfanumeriese bewaarplek te handhaaf. Vang eenvoudige en komplekse historiese kadastrale dokumente vas en verifieer dit. Beaangee ingewikkelde onderhoud van kadastrale dokumente ooreenkomstig wetgewende prosesse. Voer onttrekking of kansellasie van kadastrale dokumente uit op wettige instruksie. Trek af, kanselleer en endorseer kadastrale dokumente met geregistreerde landperke, huurkontrakte of servitute. Beaangee ingewikkelde wysigings van goedgekeurde en geregistreerde kadastrale dokumente. Voeg alle nuut goedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente in die argief in. Haal kadastrale rekords uit en reik dit uit. Herlê teruggestuurde kadastrale rekords. Herstel kadastrale rekords en hou dit in 'n goeie bruikbare toestand. Voer tegniese ondersoek van eenvoudige sowel as meer komplekse kadastrale dokumente uit. Kontroleer benamings van nuut ingediende voorleggings. Voer tegniese ondersoek van eenvoudige en komplekse diagramme en algemene planne uit. Voer tegniese ondersoek van opnamerekords uit. Voer tegniese ondersoek van eenvoudige en komplekse seksionele titelplanne uit. Dateer die aantekeningblaaie op deur die byvoeging van elke goedgekeurde kadastrale landperceel. Doen navorsing en verskaf kadastrale inligting aan interne en externe kliënte. Haal kadastrale inligting op en verskaf dit aan kliënte. Verskaf lugfotos, geregistreerde beeldmateriaal en kaarte van National Geospatial Information (NGI) ooreenkomstig ondertekende diensvlakooreenkomste. Voer basiese navorsing oor kadastrale opname-inligting met betrekking tot landperceelgrense vir kliënte en Land Reform uit. Vang ruimtelike data met eenvoudige sowel as meer komplekse kadastrale dokumente vas, hou dit aktueel en dateer dit op. Vang nuut ingediende dokumente vas om vas te stel of daar enige ruimtelike oorvleuelings voor goedkeuring is. Voeg data by, dateer op en handhaaf 'n akkurate datasstel van kadastrale ruimtelike inligting, insluitend die byvoeging en opdatering van historiese data. Ondersoek moontlike bronne van fout as oorvleuelings opgespoor word en spreek foute toepaslik aan. Gebruik kadastrale opnameberekeningsbeginsels en ander wettige databronne om die gehalte van landperceelgrensinligting te verbeter. Skandeer alle kadastrale dokumente by goedkeuring, wysiging, endorsasie of onttrekking en voer gehaltekontrole uit. Skandeer nuut goedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente. Her-skandeer alle opgedateerde (gewysigde, geëndorseerde of onttrekte) kadastrale dokumente. Skakel die gestorte skandeerbeelde aan die alfanumeriese data. Voer bedrywighede uit en doen gehaltekontrole om te verseker dat die geskandeerde beelddatabasisse skoon en akkuraat is.

zu.summary: Bhalisa futhi ulondoloze idatha yosesho lwesigaba somhlaba woMnyango we-Land Reform and Rural Development e-Pietermaritzburg.

Okungenani iminyaka engu-6 yamava emva kokuthola iziqu kwezigeomatics endaweni yesigeomatics noma yosesho lwesigaba somhlaba. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi lwe-Geographical Information Systems Software kanye nezisekelo zalo. Ulwazi lwe-Surveyor-General's Office Standard Operating Procedures nemithelela. Ulwazi ngosesho lwesigaba somhlaba. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya. Ukwenza izinqumo. Buqongo bokuhola iqembu. Ukudala. Ukugxila kumthengi kanye nokuvela. Unxibelelwano (lwenkomishi nolubhaliwe). Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuhlela kanye nokuhlanganisa. Ukuphathwa kwezixabano. Ukuxoxiswana.
zu.duties: Bhalisa, lolonge futhi uvuse idatha yamagama anamanani amafuphi kanye namakhompyuta adidingekayo emafayeleni wesigaba somhlaba alula kanye nezinkimbinkimbi. Bhalisa ulwazi lwamagama namanani kumafayela amasha wesigaba somhlaba athunyelwe (alula nabezinkimbinkimbi) futhi wenze ukuhlola okuhlobene nokuhambisana kwemathematika kanye nokuqinisekisa idatha yezinto zomhlaba ezintsha eziphakanyisiwe. Vuse imininingwane yosesho lwesigaba somhlaba ngokungeza noma ukulungisa yonke imibhalo egunyaziwe (elula nabezinkimbinkimbi) ukuze ulondoloze indawo yamagama anamanani yagesi. Bhalisa futhi uqiniseke imibhalo yomlando yesigaba somhlaba elula nabezinkimbinkimbi. Joye ekuphathweni okuyinkimbinkimbi kwemibhalo yesigaba somhlaba ngokuhambisana nemikhakha emisiwe ngumthetho. Yenza ukukhishwa noma ukukhanselwa kwemibhalo yesigaba somhlaba ngokwesixwayo esemthethweni. Khisha, khansela futhi uvume imibhalo yesigaba somhlaba enezinto zomhlaba ezingunyawo, izinketho noma izinsiza. Joye ekulungisweni okuyinkimbinkimbi kwemibhalo egunyaziwe nengabhalisiwe yesigaba somhlaba. Faka yonke imibhalo entsha egunyaziwe yesigaba somhlaba kwisilu. Khishu futhi unikele imibhalo yesigaba somhlaba. Phinda ufake imibhalo yesigaba somhlaba ebuyiswe. Lungisa futhi ugcine imibhalo yesigaba somhlaba esimweni esihle sokusetshenziswa. Yenza ukuhlolwa kobuchwepheshe kwemibhalo yesigaba somhlaba elula nabezinkimbinkimbi. Hlola izinkomba zemithelela entsha ethunyelwe. Yenza ukuhlolwa kobuchwepheshe kwemifanekiso elula nabezinkimbinkimbi kanye namaphulani jikelele. Yenza ukuhlolwa kobuchwepheshe kwemibhalo yosesho. Yenza ukuhlolwa kobuchwepheshe kwamaphulani wesigaba somhlaba elula nabezinkimbinkimbi. Vusa amakhasi okuqaphela ngokungeza yonke into yomhlaba egunyaziwe yesigaba. Phenya futhi nikeze ulwazi lwesigaba somhlaba kubathengi bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Khipha futhi nikeze ulwazi lwesigaba somhlaba kubathengi. Nikeze izithombe zomoya, izithombe ezilungisiwe namamephu avela ku-National Geospatial Information (NGI) ngokusho izivumelwano sebenzise signwe. Yenza uphenyo oluyisisekelo olwabelana nge-cadastral survey information, ikakhulukazi ngesigaba somhlaba kubathengi nakwi-Land Reform. Bhalisa, lolonge futhi uvuse idatha yendawo nangemibhalo yesigaba somhlaba elula kanye nabezinkimbinkimbi. Bhalisa imibhalo entsha ethunyelwe ukuze uhlole ukuthi kunakhona e-mpinda kwamabala ngaphambi kwegunyazo. Faka idatha, vuse futhi ulondoloze isethi idatha eqinisekisiwe yendawo yesigaba somhlaba, kuhlanganise nokwengeza kanye nokuvuse idatha yomlando. Phenya imithombo engaba yamaphutha uma kutholakala ukudidanisa bese ukubhekana namaphutha ngendlela efanele. Sebenzisa izimiso zokubala zesigaba somhlaba kanye namanye amathombo okudatha avumelekile ukuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yolwazi ngemida yezinto zomhlaba. Skena yonke imibhalo yesigaba somhlaba ngesikhathi kugunyazwa, kulungiswa, kuvunywa noma ikhishwa bese wenza ukuhlola ikhwalithi. Skena imibhalo entsha yesigaba somhlaba egunyaziwe. Phinda usskena yonke imibhalo yesigaba somhlaba evusiwe (elungisiwe, evunyiwe noma ekhishiwe). Hlanganisa izithombe ezibhalisiwe ezinikwe idatha yamagama anamanani. Yenza imisebenzi futhi uhlola ikhwalithi ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi imininingwane yesithombe eskeniwe ihlize futhi iqinisekisiwe.

xh.title: ISikhulu Esingundoqo SezobuLumi Ngamaphepha EsiLinganwayo
xh.summary: Shiya igama elithi cadastral nokulondoloza iidata yovavvo lwesiLinganwayo seNhlelo zezeLwandle kwiSebe leLand Reform and Rural Development ePietermaritzburg.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babeseniwo icastifye yeqela lesi-12 nencestifye yesiLvlc yebhubesi kwiNcwadi yezobuLwandle ngesiCokothe seCestifye yomLwmgangatho weNcwadi yobuLwandle kwiZiko leSizwe (NQF Level 5). Iminyanya yeminyaka eyi-6 yemiba yobuLwandle emva kokuphumelela isicelo kwelakho laba yobuLwandle nangaphezulu kwilakho elinganwayo seSilinganwayo samaphepha. Ilayiseni yemoto esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluxhene nomsbenzi: Ulwazi lweSoftware yoLwazi lweNdalo eZenziwe ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi ngeendawo ezahlukileyo. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zoKusebenza ezimiswayo ngokomthetho ngenkqubo ezenzwayo zeSizwe kwiNtloko yoMlcholi-didiyileyo yobuLwandle babuLwimi naboHanjwa. Ulwazi ngeNcwadi yamaphepha eziLinganwayo. Amandla axhene nomsbenzi: Ukusombulula iingxaki nokwahlulela. Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukukhokela iqela. Ukudala izinto ngokuchaneka. Ugqo-lo kwixhilelabathi nakusabelo ekufuneni ngokukhawuleza. Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nakubhalwayo). Ukusebenza ngakwikhompyutha. Ulululo nolwandiso. Ukuqondisa ukuphakama kwamaxhala. Iindlela zokuqinisekisa nokubonisana.
xh.duties: Shiya igama elithi cadastral ukwaziswa kwamaxwebhu amancinci nangamakhaka ngokuphindaphindwayo kwamaphepha eziLinganwayo. Shiya igama elithi cadastral ulwazi olubaliweyo nakwamanani kwamaphepha amasha aseLinganwayo (aluncinci nangamakhaka) kwaye uqinisekise ngokubala isimo esibaliweyo ngokwamathuba namaxwebhu oxhaswayo eziqhamo zamhlaba. Hlaziya igama elithi cadastral ulwazi olwandisiweyo ngenkqubo yongezelelo okanye ukulungisa ngamaphepha obuLwandle amagama ambalwa namanani eLinganwayo. Qhuba amaxwebhu eLinganwayo ndalo-ndalo ukwenzela ukuba luhlaziywe. Thatha inxaxheba ekuqwalaselweni kolwazi lwamaphepha obuLwandle ehambela ngokomthetho. Yenza ukuyeka okanye ukuqhaqhwa kwamaphepha obuLwandle ngokwesiluleko esingumthetho. Thabatha, qhaqha nokuqinisekisa amaxwebhu obuLwandle ngamaxhala ezinkqubo zamaxhala abhalwe kwiNcwadi naxhene nawamanye amaxhala ekutyhaleni kolwazi. Thatha inxaxheba ekulungisweni amaxwebhu obuLwandle eqinisekisiweyo nakubhalwe kwabanye abantu. Faka amaphepha amasha eLinganwayo kwindalo yamaxwebhu. Khupha naphuma iinkcukacha zamaphepha obuLwandle. Phinda ubuyise iinkcukacha ezingekabuyiswa zamaphepha obuLwandle. Lungisa ulwazi lwezaziso zamaphepha obuLwandle. Qwalasela ulwazi ngokobuchwepheshe kwamaphepha obuLwandle. Qinisekisa ukuba yonke imisebenzi iyaqwalaselwa ngokwemigaqo yobuLwandle. Phuma phantsi ngemigaqo yamaphepha obuLwandle ngokomthetho. Hlaziya amaphepha obuLwandle ngokomthetho. Phinda ubuyise iinkcukacha zamaphepha obuLwandle. Khupha imizobo, iinkcukacha ezingamakhaka namaphuphu omlando namakhaka ngokomthetho eQhinga elihleliweyo. Yenza uphando ngenkqubo yeziqalelo zobuLwandle bezixuku ukwazi okunye ngeendawo ezikude. Shiya igama elithi cadastral imisebenzi yamaxwebhu eLinganwayo nangaphandle kweendalo ezingaziwayo nangamakhaka. Qwalasela ulwazi ngokobuchwepheshe kwamaphepha obuLwandle eqinisekisiweyo. Hlaziya ulwazi ngokwemigaqo yamaphepha obuLwandle nangokobuchwepheshe. Faka ulwazi lwamaphepha obuLwandle kwinkqubo. Phinda ubuyise iinkcukacha zamaphepha obuLwandle ezingekabuyiswa. Yenza uphando malunga nendlela yokusetyenziswa kolwazi ngeendlela zokulungisa iinkxalaba zezixuku.

jobs.title: Senior Auditor: Operational and Compliance Audit
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Senior Auditor role in the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development, based in Pretoria, requiring a diploma in auditing or accounting and two years' audit experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Auditing / Accounting (NQF Level 6) or related equivalent qualification. Minimum of 2 years' experience in Operational and Compliance Auditing. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Standards of the Institute of Internal Auditors, Risk based Internal Audit methodologies and procedures and software. Job related skills: Communication (verbal and written). Interviewing and Analytical thinking. Problem solving. Computer literacy. Business process analysis. Risk and control assessment.
jobs.duties: Perform the planning of the annual audit plan projects according to the deliverables and timelines defined on the approved audit projects planning memoranda. Perform the compilation on the electronic audit software of the planning phase deliverables of the Operational and Compliance Audit Directorate's projects allocated to this position, in line with the Chief Directorate’s quality standards, methodology, policies and procedures on a continuous basis, and report progress to the Assistant Director: Operational and Compliance Audit on a weekly basis. Perform the execution of the annual audit plan projects according to the deliverables and timeline defined on the approved audit projects planning memoranda. Perform the compilation on the electronic audit software of the execution phase deliverable’s of the Operational and Compliance Audit Directorate's projects allocated to this position, in line with the Chief Directorate's quality standards, methodologies, policies and procedures on continuous basis, and report progress to the Assistant Director: Operational and Compliance Audit on a weekly basis. Perform the defined scope of the reporting of the annual audit plan projects according to the deliverables and timelines defined on the approved audit projects planning memoranda. Preform the compilation on the electronic audit software of the defined scope of the reporting phase deliverable of the Operational and Compliance Audit Directorate's projects allocated to this position, in line with the Chief Directorate's quality standards, methodologies, policies and procedure on continuous basis and report progress to the Assistant Director: Operational and Compliance Audit on a weekly basis. Perform the closure of the annual audit plan projects according to the deliverables and timelines defined on the approved audit projects planning memoranda. Perform the compilation on the electronic audit software of the closure phase deliverables of the Operational and Compliance Audit Directorate's projects allocated to this position, In line with the Chief Directorate's quality standards, methodologies, policies and procedures on continuous basis and report progress to the Assistant Director: Operational and Compliance Audit on a weedy basis.

af.title: Senior Outeur: Operasionele en Nakomingsoudit
af.summary: Senior Outeur-rol in die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development, gebaseer in Pretoria, vereis 'n diploma in oudit of rekenkunde en twee jaar se ouditervaring.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Ouditing / Rekenkunde (NQF Level 6) of 'n verwante gelykwaardige kwalifikasie hê. Minimum van 2 jaar se ervaring in Operasionele en Nakomingsouditering. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Standarde van die Institute of Internal Auditors, risikogebaseerde interne ouditmetodologieë en prosedures en sagteware. Werksverwante vaardighede: Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Onderhoudvoering en analitiese denke. Probleemoplossing. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Besigheidsprosesanalise. Risiko- en beheerassessering.
af.duties: Voer die beplanning van die jaarlikse ouditplanprojekte uit volgens die lewerbare en tydlyne gedefinieer op die goedgekeurde ouditprojekbeplanningsmemoranda. Voer die samestelling op die elektroniese ouditsagteware van die beplanningsfaselewerbare van die Operasionele en Nakomingsoudit-direktoraat se projekte wat aan hierdie pos toegeken is, in ooreenstemming met die Hoofdirektoraat se gehaltestandarde, metodologie, beleide en prosedures op 'n deurlopende basis, en rapporteer vordering weekliks aan die Assistentdirekteur: Operasionele en Nakomingsoudit. Voer die uitvoering van die jaarlikse ouditplanprojekte uit volgens die lewerbare en tydlyn gedefinieer op die goedgekeurde ouditprojekbeplanningsmemoranda. Voer die samestelling op die elektroniese ouditsagteware van die uitvoeringsfaselewerbare van die Operasionele en Nakomingsoudit-direktoraat se projekte wat aan hierdie pos toegeken is, in ooreenstemming met die Hoofdirektoraat se gehaltestandarde, metodologieë, beleide en prosedures op 'n deurlopende basis, en rapporteer vordering weekliks aan die Assistentdirekteur: Operasionele en Nakomingsoudit. Voer die gedefinieerde omvang van die verslagdoening van die jaarlikse ouditplanprojekte uit volgens die lewerbare en tydlyne gedefinieer op die goedgekeurde ouditprojekbeplanningsmemoranda. Voer die samestelling op die elektroniese ouditsagteware van die gedefinieerde omvang van die verslagdoeningsfaselewerbare van die Operasionele en Nakomingsoudit-direktoraat se projekte wat aan hierdie pos toegeken is, in ooreenstemming met die Hoofdirektoraat se gehaltestandarde, metodologieë, beleide en prosedures op 'n deurlopende basis en rapporteer vordering weekliks aan die Assistentdirekteur: Operasionele en Nakomingsoudit. Voer die afsluiting van die jaarlikse ouditplanprojekte uit volgens die lewerbare en tydlyne gedefinieer op die goedgekeurde ouditprojekbeplanningsmemoranda. Voer die samestelling op die elektroniese ouditsagteware van die afsluitingsfaselewerbare van die Operasionele en Nakomingsoudit-direktoraat se projekte wat aan hierdie pos toegeken is, in ooreenstemming met die Hoofdirektoraat se gehaltestandarde, metodologieë, beleide en prosedures op 'n deurlopende basis en rapporteer vordering weekliks aan die Assistentdirekteur: Operasionele en Nakomingsoudit.

zu.title: Umhloli Ophakeme: Ukuhlola Izindlela Zokusebenza Nokuqinisekisa Ukuthobela
zu.summary: Isikhundla somhloli ophakeme kumnyango we Land Reform and Rural Development, sise Pretoria, sidinga idiploma yokuhlola noma ekubalweni kwezimali kanye neminyaka emibili yamava ekuholweni.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Abafaki izicelo kumele babe nesatifikethi se Grade 12 kanye ne National Diploma ekuholweni / ekubalweni kwezimali (NQF Level 6) noma izifundo ezilinganayo ezihlobene nalezizona. Okuncane iminyaka engu 2 yamava ekuholweni Izindlela Zokusebenza Nokuqinisekisa Ukuthobela. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Izindinganiso ze Institute of Internal Auditors, izindlela nezenqubo zokuqinisekisa ucingo olusekelwe ekuhesabenzi kanye nesoftwe. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Ukubuza imibuzo nokuqonda ngokuhlaziya. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuhlazanya inqubo yebhizinisi. Ukulinganisa ingozi nolawulo.
zu.duties: Qhubekisa ukuhlela amaphrojekthi ohlelo lokuhlola lwamnyaka ngokwemithelela nangezinsuku ezihanjiswa ememorandeni eqinisekisiwe yohlelo lwamaphrojekthi okuhlola. Qhubekisa ukuhlanganisa emsoftweni yokuhlola yangekhompyutha imithelela yohlelo lokuqasha amaphrojekthi we Operational and Compliance Audit Directorate ababelwe lesi sikhundla, ngokuhambisana nezinga lekhwalithi, indlela, izinqubomgomo nezenqubo ze Chief Directorate ngokuqhubekayo, bese ucabangele inqubo umkhandlu ophethe i Operational and Compliance Audit ngobekiwe njalo. Qhubekisa ukuphethwa kwamaphrojekthi ohlelo lokuhlola lwamnyaka ngokwemithelela nangezinsuku ezihanjiswa ememorandeni eqinisekisiwe yohlelo lwamaphrojekthi okuhlola. Qhubekisa ukuhlanganisa emsoftweni yokuhlola yangekhompyutha imithelela yesigaba sokuphetha amaphrojekthi we Operational and Compliance Audit Directorate ababelwe lesi sikhundla, ngokuhambisana nezinga lekhwalithi, izindlela, izinqubomgomo nezenqubo ze Chief Directorate ngokuqhubekayo, bese ucabangele inqubo kumqondisi ophethe i Operational and Compliance Audit ngobekiwe njalo. Qhubekisa isibonzi esichaziwe sokuvekela amaphrojekthi ohlelo lokuhlola lwamnyaka ngokwemithelela nangezinsuku ezihanjiswa ememorandeni eqinisekisiwe yohlelo lwamaphrojekthi okuhlola. Qhubekisa ukuhlanganisa emsoftweni yokuhlola yangekhompyutha isibonizi esichaziwe semithelela yesigaba sokuvekula amaphrojekthi we Operational and Compliance Audit Directorate ababelwe lesi sikhundla, ngokuhambisana nezinga lekhwalithi, izindlela, izinqubomgomo nezenqubo ze Chief Directorate ngokuqhubekayo bese ucabangele inqubo kumqondisi ophethe i Operational and Compliance Audit ngobekiwe njalo. Qhubekisa ukuvala amaphrojekthi ohlelo lokuhlola lwamnyaka ngokwemithelela nangezinsuku ezihanjiswa ememorandeni eqinisekisiwe yohlelo lwamaphrojekthi okuhlola. Qhubekisa ukuhlanganisa emsoftweni yokuhlola yangekhompyutha imithelela yesigaba sokuvala amaphrojekthi we Operational and Compliance Audit Directorate ababelwe lesi sikhundla, ngokuhambisana nezinga lekhwalithi, izindlela, izinqubomgomo nezenqubo ze Chief Directorate ngokuqhubekayo bese ucabangele inqubo kumqondisi ophethe i Operational and Compliance Audit ngobekiwe njalo.

xh.title: Ogcwayileyo kuNdolovo: UkuHlolwa kweMisebenzi nokuZinikela kwiMigaqo
xh.summary: Indima kaOgcwayileyo kuNdolovo kwiSebe leLand Reform and Rural Development, elisePretoria, lifuna idiploma ekuhloleni noma ekuwaliseni unyaka-mali nobunyulu bobambe beminyaka emibini yokuHlolwa.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezincinci: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe neSatifikethi seQela le-12 nesiDiploma seSizwe sokuHlolwa / ukuWalisa (iNqanaba le-6 le-NQF) okanye isifanekiso-mfuno esithinteleleyo. Ubuncinane beminyaka emi-2 yamava ekuHlolweni kokuSebenza nakuZinikela kwiMigaqo. Ilayisensi yomqhubi egqityiweyo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Izinga le-Institute of Internal Auditors, iindlela nezithopeni zokuHlolwa okusekelwe kwingozi kunye nesoftwe. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangokubhalwe). UkuPenda imibuzo nokuCwangcisa ngokucinga. UkuSombulula iingxaki. UkuQonda ikhompyutha. UkuHla konxibelelwano loshishino. Ukuvavanya ingozi nolawulo.
xh.duties: Yenza icwangciso lemisebenzi yoludwe lokuhlolwa lonyaka ngokwezinto ezifunekayo nangokwexesha elichaziweyo kwimemorandam yocwangciso lwemisebenzi yoludwe yokuhlolwa egunyaziweyo. Yiza nokuqokelela kwi-software yokuHlolwa yekhompyutha izinto ezifunekayo kwinqanaba locwangciso lemisebenzi yeDirectorate yokuHlolwa kokuSebenza nakuZinikela kwiMigaqo enikwe kule ndawo, ngokwemigaqo yomgangatho, indlela, iinkqubo neenkqubo zeChief Directorate ngokuqhubeka, kwaye uchaze inkqubela kuAssistant Director: Operational and Compliance Audit ngeveki nganye. Yenza ukwenziwa kwemisebenzi yoludwe lokuhlolwa lonyaka ngokwezinto ezifunekayo nangokwexesha elichaziweyo kwimemorandam yocwangciso lwemisebenzi yoludwe yokuhlolwa egunyaziweyo. jobs.title: Senior Project Officer: Land Development Support
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Senior Project Officer supporting land development and producer commercialisation in the Nkangala region of Mpumalanga for the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and Bachelor’s Degree in Agricultural Economics / Agri Business / Agricultural Management / LLB (NQF Level 7) or related equivalent qualification. Minimum of 2 years relevant experience in land reform environment. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of the Department’s policies, prescripts and practices pertaining to Land Reform. Knowledge and understanding of sector needs and business requirements. In- depth knowledge of policy development and monitoring and evaluation techniques. Knowledge and understanding of government development policies, e.g. National Development Plan, National Growth Path, Planning and Budgeting Framework, etc. Research methodology. Good corporate governance principles. Knowledge in human and financial management. Job related skills: Project management. Communication (verbal and written). Agricultural development. Conflict management. Stakeholder mobilisation. Financial management. Computer literacy. Information management and analytical thinking. Willingness to travel.
jobs.duties: Implement projects for the development of producers towards commercialisation. Assist with co-ordinating the process of identifying producers to be supported. Assist in the establishment and management of partnerships between producers and development partners. Organise capacity building and training programmes for producers. Facilitate the appointment of prospective strategic partners and service providers. Facilitate resource mapping and mobilisation of all identified farms for development in line with departmental priorities, Annual Performance Plan and Operational Plan of the Branch. Assist in facilitation of the development and approval of project registers. Assist in facilitation of farm assessment and feasibility studies. Compile reports and assist in the development of business plans. Co-ordinate processes toward approval of projects. Co-ordinate the compilation of approval documents. Ensure alignment and compliance of submissions to the policies / standard operating procedures. Present the submissions to the relevant committees and structures. Promote good corporate governance and compliance with financial and human resource. Conduct ongoing monitoring and reporting of projects under implementation. Adhere to relevant prescripts and legislative framework (human and financial resources). Assist in mitigation of the identified operational and fraud risks. Adhere to internal and external controls in line with the policies.

af.title: Senior Projektbeampte: Landontwikkelingsondersteuning
af.summary: Senior Projektbeampte wat landontwikkeling en produsent-kommersialisering in die Nkangala-streek van Mpumalanga vir die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development ondersteun.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Baccalaureusgraad in Landbou-ekonomie / Agribesigheid / Landboubestuur / LLB (NQF Level 7) of 'n verwante ewekansige kwalifikasie. Minimum van 2 jaar relevante ervaring in 'n landhervormingsomgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van die departement se beleide, voorskifte en praktyke rakende Landhervorming. Kennis en begrip van sektorbehoeftes en besigheidsvereistes. Diepgaande kennis van beleidsontwikkeling en moniterings- en evaluasietegnieke. Kennis en begrip van regeringsontwikkelingsbeleide, bv. Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan, Nasionale Groeipad, Beplannings- en Begrotingsraamwerk, ens. Navorsingsmetodologie. Goeie korporatiewe bestuursbeginsels. Kennis van menslike en finansiële bestuur. Werksverwante vaardighede: Projektbestuur. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Landbou-ontwikkeling. Konflikbestuur. Belanghebbende-mobilisering. Finansiële bestuur. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Inligtingsbestuur en analitiese denke. Bereidwilligheid om te reis.
af.duties: Implementeer projekte vir die ontwikkeling van produsente tot kommersialisering. Bied bystand met die koördinering van die proses om produsente te identifiseer wat ondersteun sal word. Bied bystand met die vestiging en bestuur van vennootskappe tussen produsente en ontwikkelingsvennote. Reël kapasiteitsbou- en opleidingsprogramme vir produsente. Fasiliteer die aanstelling van voornemende strategiese vennote en diensverskaffers. Fasiliteer hulpbronkartering en -mobilisering van alle geïdentifiseerde plase vir ontwikkeling in ooreenstemming met departementele prioriteite, Jaarlikse Prestasieplan en Operasionele Plan van die Tak. Bied bystand met fasilitering van die ontwikkeling en goedkeuring van projekte. Bied bystand met fasilitering van plaasassesserings en haalbaarheidstudies. Stel verslae op en bied bystand met die ontwikkeling van besigheidsplanne. Koördineer prosesse vir die goedkeuring van projekte. Koördineer die opstel van goedkeuringsdokumente. Verseker belyning en nakoming van voorleggings aan die beleide / standaardbedryfsprosedures. Dien die voorleggings aan die relevante komitees en strukture voor. Bevorder goeie korporatiewe bestuur en nakoming van finansiële en menslike hulpbronne. Voer deurlopende monitering en verslagdoening van projekte onder implementering uit. Hou aan die toepaslike voorskifte en wetgewende raamwerk (menslike en finansiële hulpbronne). Bied bystand met die matiging van die geïdentifiseerde operasionele en bedrogrisiko's. Hou aan interne en eksterne kontroles in ooreenstemming met die beleide.

zu.title: Onogwinya Ohlezi Phambili Wephrojekthi: Ukusekela Ukuthuthukiswa Komhlaba
zu.summary: Onogwinya ohlezi phambili wephrojekthi osekela ukuthuthukiswa komhlaba nokuqashiswa kwezimboni zabakhiqizi endaweni yase-Nkangala esifundazweni sakwa-Mpumalanga kuMnyango Wokulungiswa Komhlaba Nokuthuthukiswa Kwamaplasi.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane kakhulu: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nesi-Certificate se-Grade 12 kanye ne-Bachelor’s Degree ku-Agricultural Economics / Agri Business / Agricultural Management / LLB (NQF Level 7) noma iziqu ezincike kulezi. Ukuze kusebenze okuncane kakhulu kadingeka uneminyaka engu-2 yemisebenzi ehambisana nokulungiswa komhlaba. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi oluhambisana nomsebenzi: Ukwazi imigomo yomnyango, imithetho nokuqashwa kwemisebenzi ehlobene nokulungiswa komhlaba. Ulwazi nokuqonda izidingo zesigaba kanye nezidingo zebhizinisi. Ulwazi olujulile ngokuthuthukiswa kwemigomo kanye nendlela yokubuka nokuhlola. Ulwazi nokuqonda imigomo kahulumeni yokuthuthukisa, njenge-National Development Plan, National Growth Path, Planning and Budgeting Framework, njll. Indlela yokucwaninga. Imigomo elungile yokuphatha inkampani. Ulwazi lokuphatha abantu nezimali. Amakhono ahambisana nomsebenzi: Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi. Unxibelelwano (oluthiwayo nolubhalwayo). Ukuthuthukiswa kokulima. Ukuphatha izinkinga. Ukuhlanganisa izimalunga. Ukuphatha izimali. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuphatha ulwazi nokucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ukuzithoba ukuhamba.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi okuthuthukisa abakhiqizi ukuze benze ngokwezomabhizinisi. Ukusiza ekuhlanganiseni inqubo yokubona abakhiqizi abayokwesekwa. Ukusiza ekuqaleni nokuphatheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabakhiqizi nabalingani bokuthuthukisa. Ukuhlela izinhlelo zokwakha ikhono nokufundisa abakhiqizi. Ukwenza kube lula ukuqashwa kwabalingani abahlelekayo nabahlinzeki bokusebenza. Ukwenza kube lulu ukumepha izinsiza nokuqoqa onke amaplasi abhalwe ukuba athuthukiswe ngokuhambisana nezinto ebalulekile zomnyango, i-Annual Performance Plan kanye ne-Operational Plan yesebe. Ukusiza ekwenzeni kube lula ukuthuthukiswa nokuvunywa kwezinkomba zamaphrojekthi. Ukusiza ekwenzeni kube lula ukuhlolwa kwamaplasi ngezifundo zokubukeka. Ukuhluza imibiko nokuqoqonda ekuthuthukisweni kohlelo lobuhlelo bezimoto. Ukuhlanganisa izinqubo ukuze kuze kuvunywe ngamaphrojekthi. Ukuhlanganisa ukuhluza kwemibiko ekuvunyweni ngamaphrojekthi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nokuhambisana kwemibiko nemigomo / izinqubo ezijwayelekile zokusebenza. Ukumbula imibiko kumakomidi nezakhiwo ezibalulekile. Ukukhuthaza ukuphatha okuhle inkampani nokuhambisana nezimali nabantu. Ukuqhubekayo nokubuka nokubika ngamaphrojekthi asebenzayo. Ukuzihambisela nemithetho nokuqondiswa ngezomthetho (abantu nezimali). Ukusiza ekwehlisweni izinkinga ezibonakele zokusebenza nezezenkohlakalo. Ukuhambisana nolawulo lwangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokuhambisana nemigomo.

xh.title: Senior Project Officer: Land Development Support
xh.summary: I-Senior Project Officer exhasa uphuhliso lwamahlathi nentengiso yabavelisi kummandla we-Nkangala e-Mpumalanga kwi-Department of Land Reform and Rural Development.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingowona mgangatho: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi seQelo le-12 kwaye beNe Degree yeBachelor kwi-Agricultural Economics / Agri Business / Agricultural Management / LLB (NQF Level 7) okanye izifundo ezingowona mgangatho ezinguthotho. Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-2 yamava afanelekileyo kwimeko yokulungiswa kwamahlathi. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esebe sebenzayo. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngemiqathango, imigaqo kunye nezinto ezisetyenziswa yiSebe malunga noLungiso lweHlathi. Ulwazi nokuqonda iimfuno zecandelo nemiqathango yoshishino. Ulwazi olunzulu ngophuhliso wemigaqo nangamakhulu oqwalaselo nokuqwalasela iindlela ezisetyenziswayo. Ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqazo zophuhliso karhulumente, njengeNational Development Plan, National Growth Path, Planning and Budgeting Framework, njl. Iindlela zokuphanda. Iingcamango ezilungileyo zolawulo lwebhodi. Ulwazi ngolawulo labantu nezimali. Amakhono ahambelana nomsebenzi: Ulawulo lweiprojekthi. Unxibelelwano (olubhalwayo noluthethwayo). Uphuhliso lolimo. Ulawulo lolwahlukano. Ukukhuthaza abanik’amathuba. Ulawulo lwezimali. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha. Ulawulo lolwazi nokuqonda iingcamango. Isimemo sokuhamba.
xh.duties: Zalisa iiprojekthi zophuhliso lwabavelisi abaya kubakhoorheshane ngamathuba emarike. Nceda ekulungeniseni inkqubo yokuchonga abavelisi abaya kuxhaswa. Nceda ekusekweni nakulawulweni kwezibopho phakathi kwabavelisi nabalingane bophuhliso. Lungiselela iinkqubo zokwakh’isakhono nokuqeqesha abavelisi. Yenza kubekho lula ukubekwa kwabalingane abanika ithemba nababoneleli beepolisa. Yenza kubekho lula ukumapingwa kwezibonelelo nokuqokelelwa kwazo nakuzo zonke iifama ezichongiweyo zophuhliso ngokwemiqathango yesebe, iNqubo yeMisebenzi yoNyaka neNqubo eSebenzayo yoCandelo. Nceda ekwenzeni kubekho lula ukuphuhliswa nokuvunywa kwezarejista zeeprojekthi. Nceda ekwenzeni kubekho lula ukuvavanywa kweefama nophononongo lwamathuba okuphumelela. Hlanganisa iingxelo nceda ekuphuhliseni iplani zoshishino. Lungiselela iinkqubo ezihamba ngqo ekuvunyweni kweeprojekthi. Lungiselela ukuhlanganiswa kwamaxwebhu okuvunywa. Qinisekisa ukuhambelana nokuzithoba kwezithunywa kwiinkqazo / iinkqubo ezisebenzayo ezingundoqo. Nika izithunywa kumagqabantshintshi nakuwo onke amaqela afanelekileyo. Khuthaza ulawulo olulungileyo lwebhodi nokuzyalela kwezimali nempilo. Yenza umphumo oluqhubekayo nokuvela ngeengxelo zeeprojekthi ezizalisiwayo. Zithobe kumagunyaziso namaphu esebe omtsetho wezimali. Nceda ekunciphiseni ingozi ebonakalisiweyo yokusebenza nengcibi. Zithobe kolawulo olwangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokwemiqathango.

af.title: Senior Administratiewe Beampte
af.summary: Senior Administratiewe Beampte wat finansiële bestuursdienste verskaf, insluitend begrotingsvoorbereiding en aanvraagbestuursbeplanning vir die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Pretoria.
af.duties: Verskaf finansiële bestuursdienste. Fasilitteer, beplan, hou toesig oor en dryf die tydige en akkurate voorbereiding van die jaarlikse begroting in ooreenstemming met die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations strategiese prioriteite weekliks / maandeliks / kwartaalliks. Stel Demand Management Plan (DMP), Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), aanpassingsberamings en Estimated National Expenditure (ENE) op. Hou toesig oor doeltreffende, doeltreffende en ekonomiese benutting van fondse. Dokumenteer en kommunikeer prosedures vir toegang tot en verskuiwing van fondse. Koördineer begroting, oudit en finansiële funksies. Verifieer T&S en diverse en oortyd-betalings. Administreer die verkryging van goedere en dienste. Stel, bestuur en onderhou die Demand Management Plan op. Fasilitteer Supply Chain Management-dienste. Fasilitteer maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse verslagdoening oor SCM-verwante aangeleenthede. Hou toesig oor die veilige bewaring, benutting en onderhoud van alle bates. Verseker behoorlike administrasie van die bekom en evaluaeer van kwotasies. Vang en magtig goedere / dienste op die LOGIS-stelsel. Hanteer navrae van interne en eksterne kliënte oor verskaffingskettingaangeleenthede. Lewer algemene kantoorondersteuningsdienste. Oorsig, motiveer en ontwikkel personeel deur individuele prestasieooreenkomste. Bied hulp by die opstel / hersien van die operasionele plan. Stel verskeie voorleggings / memoranda en antwoorde op. Attend to queries from Internal Audit. Administreer verlofvorme / reageer op navrae. Maak reis / konferensiebesprekings en bevestigings. Verskaf sekretariatsdienste. Administreer bates. Onderhou bate-register. Skakel met bate-eenheid gedurende bate-verifikasie. Bestuur uitgaande en lopende bates. Ken toerusting aan amptenare toe.

zu.summary: Ongqongqoshe Wezobulungazwe onikeza izinsizakalo ezokuphathwa kwezimali okuhlanganisa ukuhlongoza kwesabelomali nokuhlela ukuphathwa kokuçashiswa koMnyango wezokuGuqulwa kweZwe nokuThuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemaphandleni ePretoria.
zu.duties: Nikeza izinsizakalo ezokuphathwa kwezimali. Qondisa, hlela, qapha, futhi qhubela phambili ukulungiswa ngokushesha nangokunembile kwesabelomali sonyaka ngokuvumelana nomthetho wezokuphathwa kwezimali kazwelonke (PFMA), izinhlelo zezimali zesikhungo esiphezulu ngezinto eziyisihluthulelo njalo ngeviki / ngenyanga / nangenyanga yamathathu. Hlongoza indlela yokuphathwa kokuçashiswa (DMP), umgomfutho wokusebenzisa imali wesikhathi esiphakathi (MTEF), ukulinganiswa okulungisiwe kanye nokulinganiswa kokusebenzisa imali kazwelonke (ENE). Qapha ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo, okunenzuzo kanye nokuhamba kahle kwemali. Qamba futhi uxhume izindlela zokuthola kanye nokushintsha imali. Hlanganisa ukulungiswa kwesabelomali, ukuhlola kanye nemisebenzi yezimali. Qinisekisa izimali zokuhamaba kanye nezinye kanye nenzalo yokuhamba ngesikhathi esadlule. Phatha ukuthenga kwezimpahla kanye nezinsizakalo. Hlongoza, phatha futhi gcinisise indlela yokuphathwa kokuçashiswa. Qondisa izinsizakalo zokuPhathwa kweKetshani Yokubonelela. Qondisa ukubika njalo ngenyanga, nyangenyanga yamathathu kanye ngonyaka ngemayelana nezindaba ezihlobene nokuPhathwa kweKetshani Yokubonelela. Lawula ukugcinwa, ukusetshenziswa kanye nokuqhashwa kwabo bonke abaphathi. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okulungile kokuthola kanye nokuqashwa kwamaxabiso. Faka futhi vivise ukuthengiswa kwempahla / insizakalo kusistimu yeLOGIS. Phatha imibuzo evela kubathengi bangaphakathi nangaphandle ehlobene nezindaba zokuPhathwa kweKetshani Yokubonelela. Nikeza izinsizakalo ezijwayelekile zokusekela ofisini. Qapha, khuthaza futhi thuthukise izisebenzi ngokuqashwa ngabanye ekusebenzeni. Siza ekuhleleni / ukubuyekezweni kwesu sokusebenza. Hlongoza izincomo / izaziso ezahlukahlukene kanye nemibhalo. Phathela imibuzo evela ekuHlolweni Kwangaphakathi. Phatha amafomu ezihamabo / phathela imibuzo. Yenza ukubhukwa kwezokuhamaba / izinkomfa kanye nokuqinisekisa. Nikeza izinsizakalo zokuba uyibhungana. Phatha impahla. Gcina ukubhaliswa kwempahla. Xhumana nenyuko yempahla ngesikhathi kuhlolwa impahla. Phatha impahla ephumayo kanye naleyo eqhubekayo. Aba izimpahla kumaphoyisa.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Ohamba Phambili Wolawulo
xh.summary: Umsebenzi Ohamba Phambili Wolawulo onika iinkonzo zolawulo lweemali eziquka ukuqulunqwa kwesikhnxaso nokucwangciswa kweplani yokulawula imfuno kwi Department of Land Reform and Rural Development e Pretoria.
xh.duties: Nika iinkonzo zolawulo lweemali. Qhubeza, cwangcisa, qwalasela, qhuba ukuqulunqwa ngexesha elifanelekileyo nangokuchanekileyo kwesikhnxaso sonyaka ngokwemigaqo ye Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), i Treasury Regulations iindaba eziphambili ngeeveki / nyanga / kota. Qulunqe i Demand Management Plan (DMP), i Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), izilinganiselo zolungiselelo kunye ne Estimated National Expenditure (ENE). Qwalasela ukusetyenziswa okusebenzayo, okusebenza kakuhle nakho ngokutshaja kweemali. Bacisa ulwazi lwemigaqo ngenkululeko yokufikelela nokushifting kweemali. Hlanganise ukucwangciswa kwesikhnxaso, audit kwaye nemisebenzi yezimali. Qinisekisa T&S nezahlukileyo nentlawulo yamahora ongenelelo. Lawula izibonelelo zempahla nezeenkonzon. Qulunqa, ulawule kwaye ugcine i Demand Management Plan. Qhubeza iinkonzo ze Supply Chain Management. Qhubeza ingxelo yenyanga, yekota nakonyaka ngeemiba ezinxulumene ne SCM. Lawula ukugcinwa, ukusetyenziswa nolondolozo kwemipahla yonke. Qinisekisa ulawulo olufanelekileyo lokufumana kwaye kuqwalaselwe iikoti. Faka kwaye uvume impahla / iinkonzo kwinkqubo ye LOGIS. Phatha imibuzo evela kumaxhaso angaphakathi nangaphandle enxulumene nezinto zesikwi esahlulelayo. Nikela ngenkxaso yemisebenzi jikelele yofisi. Qondisa, gcina ukuzimisela kwaye uphuhlise abasebenzi ngezivumelwano zokusebenza komntu ngamnye. Nikela ngenkxaso ekuphuhlisweni / ukuqhulwa kweplani yokusebenza. Qulunqa izibhalo ezahlukeneyo / memoranda nempendulo. Phendula imibuzo evela kwi Internal Audit. Lawula amafomu okuhlala / phendula imibuzo. Yenza izibonelelo / isibhengezo sokuhamba nakwiikonferensi. Nikela iinkonzo zabaseki. Lawula impahla. Gcina irekhodi lemipahla. Qhagamshelana necandelo lemipahla ngelixa kuqwalaselwa impahla. Lawula impahla ephumayo nengaqhutywayo.abel imitshato kwabasebenzi.

jobs.title: Survey Technician (GRADE A-C)
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R407 337 – R610 131 per annum, (Salary will be in accordance with the OSD requirements)
jobs.summary: Survey Technician position in East London requiring a National Diploma in Survey or Cartography, SAGC registration and three years' survey experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Survey or Cartography (NQF Level 6). Compulsory registration with South African Geomatics Council (SAGC) as a Survey Technician / Surveyor. Minimum of 3 years post qualification technical survey experience. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Programme and project management. Survey design and analysis knowledge. Research and development. Computer-aided survey applications. Knowledge of legal compliance. Technical report writing. Creating high-performance culture. Job related skills: Decision-making. Team leadership. Analytical Thinking. Creativity. Self-management. Financial management. Customer focus and responsiveness. Communication (verbal and written). Computer literacy. Planning and organising. Conflict management. Problem solving and analysis. People management. Innovation.
jobs.duties: Provide technical survey services and support. Provide technical services in terms of examination, maintenance, archiving and information supply of survey documents and submit for evaluation / approval by the relevant authority. Perform surveys and survey computations. Promote safety in line with statutory and regulatory requirements. Evaluate plans, existing technical manuals, standard drawings and procedures to incorporate new technology. Provide Geographic Information System (GIS), mapping and information supply services. Perform administrative and related functions. Provide inputs into the budgeting process as required. Compile and submit reports as required. Provide and consolidate inputs to the technical survey operational plan. Develop, implement and maintain databases. Supervise and control Candidate Survey Technicians / Officers and related personnel and assets. Conduct research and development. Render continuous professional development to keep up with new technologies and procedures. Research / literature studies on technical survey technology or new survey techniques to improve expertise. Liaise with relevant bodies/councils on survey related matters.
jobs.enquiries: Ms NO Ngcaba Tel No: (043) 783 1400
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 1A Waverley Office Park, 31 – 33 Phillip Frame Road, Chisehurst, East London or by email to Post294@dlrrd.gov.za

To apply, submit a completed Z83 form, (a nomination letter if required) and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re-advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. ERRATUM: The position of Senior Telecom Operator (2 Posts) ref 3/1/1/1/2026/246 for the Directorate: Facilities Management Services: Gauteng (Pretoria) that was advertised in Public Service Vacancy Circular no 35 of 2026 dated 02 October 2026 Has reference. Applicants are advised that the 1 position has been withdrawn. The Department apologies for any inconvenience caused. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Opnemings tegnikus (GRAAD A-C)
af.summary: Opnemings tegnikus pos in East London wat 'n Nasionale Diploma in Opname of Kartografie, SAGC-registrasie en drie jaar se opname-ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Opname of Kartografie (NQF Level 6). Verpligte registrasie by die South African Geomatics Council (SAGC) as 'n Opnemings tegnikus / Opnemer. Minimum van 3 jaar na-kwalifikasie tegniese opname-ervaring. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Program- en projekbestuur. Opname-ontwerp en ontledingskennis. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Rekenaargesteunde opname-toepassings. Kennis van regsvoorweging. Tegniese verslagskrywing. Skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur. Werksverwante vaardighede: Besluitneming. Spanleierskap. Analitiese denke. Kreatiwiteit. Selfbestuur. Finansiële bestuur. Klantefokus en reaksievermoë. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Rekenaarvaardigheid. Beplanning en organisering. Konflikbestuur. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Mensebestuur. Innovering.
af.duties: Verskaf tegniese opnamedienste en -ondersteuning. Verskaf tegniese dienste ten opsigte van ondersoek, instandhouding, argivering en inligtingvoorsiening van opnamedokumente en dien in vir evaluering / goedkeuring deur die betrokke owerheid. Voer opnames en opnameberekenings uit. Bevorder veiligheid in ooreenstemming met statutêre en regulatoriese vereistes. Evalueer planne, bestaande tegniese handleidings, standaardtekeninge en prosedures om nuwe tegnologie te inkorporeer. Verskaf Geographic Information System (GIS), karterings- en inligtingvoorsieningsdienste. Voer administratiewe en verwante funksies uit. Verskaf insette tot die begrotingsproses soos vereis. Stel verslae op en dien dit in soos vereis. Verskaf en konsolideer insette tot die tegniese opname-bedryfsplan. Ontwikkel, implementeer en onderhou databasisse. Hou toesig en beheer oor Kandidaat Opnemings tegnici / Amptenare en verwante personeel en bates. Voer navorsing en ontwikkeling uit. Lewer deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures. Navorsing / literatuurstudies oor tegniese opnametegnologie of nuwe opnametegnieke om kundigheid te verbeter. Skakel met betrokke liggame/rade oor opname-verwante aangeleenthede.

zu.title: Ubuchwepheshe Bokuqoka (GRADE A-C)
zu.summary: Isikhundla sobuchwepheshe bokuqoka e-East London esifuna i-Diploma Yezwe Kokuqoka noma i-Cartography, ukubhaliswa kwa-SAGC namaphuzu eminyaka emithathu wokuqoka.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi kwalezi: Abafaki isicelo kumele babe nesatifikhethi se-Grade 12 ne-Diploma Yezwe Kokuqoka noma i-Cartography (NQF Level 6). Ukubhaliswa ngokuyisinyathelo esibekiwe ku-South African Geomatics Council (SAGC) njengobaBuchwepheshe Bokuqoka / Onqobi. Okungenani eminyaka engu-3 yokuqoka okusemhlabeni jikelele emva kokuthola iziqu. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi oluhambisana nomsebenzi: Ukuqondisa uhlelo namaphrojekthi. Ulwazi lokuqamba nokuhlaziya ukuqoka. Ucwaningo nentuthuko. Izinhlelo zokuqoka ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Ukubhala umbiko wobufakazi bokuhlakanipha. Ukudala isiko lokusebenza ngamandla aphezulu. Amakhono ahambisana nomsebenzi: Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuba ngumholi wohlelo. Ukucabanga ngokuhlakanipha. Ukubumbeka. Ukuzilawula. Ukuqondiswa kwezimali. Ukuqonda izidingo zabathengi nokuphendula. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe). Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuhlela nokuhlelisa. Ukuphathwa kwezingxabano. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukuphatha abantu. Ukungaca futhi kuqambwe okusha.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngamasevisi bokuqoka nobuchwepheshe. Hlinzeka ngamasevisi obuchwepheshe mayelana nokuhlolwa, ukugcinwa, ukulondolozwa kanye nokunikezwa kolwazi lwamadokhumenti okuqoka uwathumele ukuze ahlolelwe / avunywe ngumnyango ofanele. Yenza imigogo yokuqoka nokubala okuhambisana nokuqoka. Khuthaza ukuphepha ngokuhambisana nezidingo ezisetshenziswa ngumthetho nemigomo. Hlola amaphulani, imanuali zobufakazi bokuhlakanipha ezikhona, imidwebo evamile kanye namaphrosedhi ukuze kufakwe itheshnaloloji entsha. Hlinzeka ngamasevisi we-Geographic Information System (GIS), ukudweba amaphulani nokunikezwa kolwazi. Yenza imisebenzi yentengiselwano nezinye ezihambisana nayo. Nikela ngeminikelo enkundleni yokwenza imali yesibhajethi njengoko kudingwa. Hlola bese uwathumela amabiko njengoko kudingwa. Nikela bese uhlanganisaeminikelo ohlelweni lokusebenza lokuqoka ngokobuchwepheshe. Yakha, usebenzise futhi ulondoloze idathabhesi. Qapha bese ulawula abaPhangiweyo kuBuchwepheshe Bokuqoka / Abofisa kanye nabalaborathwa ezihambisana nabo kanye nezimpahla. Yenza ucwaningo nentuthuko. Nikeza ngentuthuko yobuchwepheshe ngokuya kuqhubekile ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi ulandela itheshnaloloji namaphrosedhi entsha. Yenza ucwaningo / izifundo zolwazi ngobuchwepheshe bokuqoka noma izindlela ezisha zokuqoka ukuze kwandiswe ulwazi. Xhumana nabahulumu / amakhonsadili ezindaweni ezihambisana nokuzokuqoka.

xh.title: Umchweli weZicwangciso (NGRAPHU A-C)
xh.summary: Isithuba somchweli wezicwangciso e East London esifuna iDiploma yesiLwazi kwiZicwangciso okanye iKartografi, ukuqatshelwa kwi SAGC neminyaka emithathu yamava kwizicwangciso.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe neSatifikethi seQela le 12 neDiploma yesiLwazi kwiZicwangciso okanye iKartografi (NQF Level 6). Ukuqatshelwa ngokuyimfuneko kwi South African Geomatics Council (SAGC) njengomchweli wezicwangciso / umchaziwezicwangciso. Ukuba nobuncinane beminyaka engama 3 bamava obuchwepheshe bezicwangciso emva kokuqulunqa. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulawulo lwenkqubo nephulo. Ulwazi lokuyila nokuhlalutya izicwangciso. Uphando nophuhliso. Izicelo zokwenza izicwangciso ngekhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokuthobela umthetho. Ukwabhala iingxelo zobuchwepheshe. Ukudala inkqubo yemveliso ephezulu. Amandla ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukukhokela iqela. Ukucinga ngokuhlalutya. Umdla wokuyila. Ukuzilawula. Ulawulo lweemali. Ukuqwalasela abathengi nokuphendula. Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangesibhalo). Ulwazi lokusebenzisa iikhompyutha. Ukuqulunqa nokuqamba. Ulawulo lxaxhamba. Ukusombulula iingxaki noku hlalutya. Ulawulo labantu. Intsingiselo yemveliso.
xh.duties: Nika iinkonzo zobuchwepheshe bezicwangciso nolawulo. Nika iinkonzo zobuchwepheshe mayela nokuqwalasela, ukulondoloza, ukugcina kwafayili nokunika ulwazi lwamaxwebhokuzicwangciso uze uwathumela ukuqwalaselwa / ukugunyazwa ngamagunya afanelekile. Yenza izicwangciso nokubala izicwangciso. Khuthaza ukhuseleko ngokuthobela iimfuno zomthetho nokulawula. Qwalasela iiplani, imanuali zobuchwepheshe ezikhoyo, iimilo ezingalawulayo nemigaqo ukuzifaka iindlela zolutsha lobuchwepheshe. Nika iinkonzo zeGeographic Information System (GIS), ukuzoba iimephu nokunika ulwazi. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo nemiyelelo edibana nayo. Nika izimvo kwinkqubo yokwenza umgaqo weemalisengemfuneko. Hlanganisa uze unike iingxelo njengoko kufuneka. Nika uze uhlanganise izimvo kwiplani yokuqhuba izicwangciso zobuchwepheshe. Phuhlisa, faka esebenzini ulondoloze iisiseko zeenkcukacha. Qondisa ulawule abaPhandi bezicwangciso / oBaphathi nabasebenzi abahlobene nayo namaxhala. Yenza uphando nophuhliso. Nikeza uphuhliso obungcali obuqhubelekayo ukuze ugqameemiqondiso emitsha nobuchwepheshe. Yenza uphando / ifundo yamanqaku kubuchwepheshe bezicwangciso okanye iindlela ezintsha zokwenza izicwangiso ukuphucula ulwazi. Thintana namabhaso / amabhunga afanelekile kumacandw ahlobene nezicwangciso.
