af.title: Opmetings tegnikus (GRAAD A-C)
af.summary: Opmetings tegnikus pos in East London wat 'n Nasionale Diploma in Opmeting of Kartografie met SAGC-registrasie en drie jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Opmeting of Kartografie (NQF Vlak 6). Verpligte registrasie by die South African Geomatics Council (SAGC) as 'n Opmetings tegnikus / Opmeter. Minimum van 3 jaar na-kwalifikasie tegniese opmetings ervaring. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Program- en projekbestuur. Kennis van opmetingsontwerp en -ontleding. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Rekenaargesteunde opmetingstoepassings. Kennis van regs nakoming. Tegniese verslagskrywing. Skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur. Werksverwante vaardighede: Besluitneming. Spanleierskap. Analitiese denke. Kreatiwiteit. Selfbestuur. Finansiële bestuur. Kliëntefokus en reaksievermoë. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Rekenaarvaardigheid. Beplanning en organisering. Konflikbestuur. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Personeelbestuur. Innovering.
af.duties: Verskaf tegniese opmetingsdienste en -ondersteuning. Verskaf tegniese dienste ten opsigte van ondersoek, instandhouding, argiefbewaring en inligtingsvoorsiening van opmetingsdokumente en dien dit in vir evaluering / goedkeuring deur die betrokke gesag. Voer opmetings en opmetingsberekenings uit. Bevorder veiligheid in ooreenstemming met statutêre en regulatoriese vereistes. Evalueer planne, bestaande tegniese handleidings, standaardtekeninge en prosedures om nuwe tegnologie in te lyf. Verskaf Geographic Information System (GIS)-, karterings- en inligtingsvoorsieningsdienste. Voer administratiewe en verwante funksies uit. Verskaf insette tot die begrotingsproses soos vereis. Stel verslae op en dien dit in soos vereis. Verskaf en konsolideer insette tot die tegniese opmetingsoperasionele plan. Ontwikkel, implementeer en onderhou databasisse. Superviseer en beheer Kandidaat Opmetings tegnici / Amptenare en verwante personeel en bates. Voer navorsing en ontwikkeling uit. Lewer deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures. Navorsing / literatuurstudies oor tegniese opmetingstegnologie of nuwe opmetingstegnieke om kundigheid te verbeter. Skakel met betrokke liggame/rade oor opmetingsverwante aangeleenthede.

zu.title: Ithekinikhasi Yokuhlola (GRADE A-C)
zu.summary: Isikhundla seThekinikhasi Yokuhlola e-East London esifuna i-Diploma Yezwe kuHlola noma i-Cartography okugunyaziwe ku-SAGC kanye nohambo lweminyaka emithathu lokuqasha.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane kakhulu: Abafaki izicelo kufanele babe ne-Certificate ye-Grade 12 kanye ne-Diploma Yezwe kuHlola noma i-Cartography (NQF Level 6). Ukubhalisa ngaphandle kokhetho ku-South African Geomatics Council (SAGC) njenge-Thekinikhasi / Umloli Wohluhlovo. Okuncane kakhulu eminyaka engu-3 yohambo lobuchwepheshe bokuhlola ngemva kokuthola iziqu. Ilayisense yokushayela okusemthethweni. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Imphathi yohlelo noma projekthi. Ulwazi lokuqamba nokuqondo kohlolo. Ucwaningo nentuthuko. Izinhlelo zokuqamba ezisebenzisa ikhaya lomshini. Ulwazi ngokuziphatha ngokomthetho. Ukubhala ingxoxo yobuchwepheshe. Ukudala isiko sokusebenza ngamandla amakhulu. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukwenza izinqumo. Bunkonzo bokuhola iqembu. Ukucabanga ngokuqonda. Ukudala okusha. Ukuzilawula. Imphathi yemali. Ukuqonda abathengi kanye nokuphendula. Ukuxoxa (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhaya lomshini. Ukuhlela nokuqamba. Ukupatha ukungaboni okufanayo. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuqonda. Imphathi yabantu. Into entsha.
zu.duties: Nika izinsiza zobuchwepheshe zokuhlola kanye nokuqinisekisa. Nike izinsiza zobuchwepheshe mayelana nokuhlola, ukugcina, ukulondoloza imibhalo kanye nokuhlinzeka ngolwazi lwamaphepha ohlolo bese uyathumela ukuthathwa kwesinqumo / ukugunyazwa umnyango ohambisana nawo. Yenza ukuhlola kanye nokubala ukuhlola. Khuthaza ukuphepha ngokuvumelana nezidingo zomthetho kanye nezomthethosisekelo. Hlola izinkomishi, izingxoxo zedivayisi ezikhona, izimengamiso ezijwayelekile kanye nenqubo ukuze kufakwe ukuthuthukiswa komshini osha. Nikeka izinkiza ze-Geographic Information System (GIS), ukuqamba izinto ezingashintshwa kanye nokuhlinzeka ngolwazi. Yenza imisebenzi yobulungiswa kanye nezinye ezihlobene nayo. Nikeza okokufaka kwinqubo yokwenza umalingana njengoba kudingeka. Lungelela bese uthumela ingxoxo njengoba kudingeka. Nikeza bese uhlanganisa okokufaka ohlelweni lomsebenzi lokuqamba ohlolo obuchwepheshe. Qamba, usebenzise bese ulondoloza izinto ezigcinwayo. Hlola bese ulawula i-Candidate Survey Technicians / Officers abaqashwayo nabanye abasebenzi abahlobene nalokho kanye nezimpahla. Yenza ucwaningo nentuthuko. Nikeza ukuthuthuka obuchwepheshe okuqhutshwa njalo ukugcina uhamba nezinsiza ezisha kanye nenqubo. Yiza / cwaninga izincwadi zobuchwepheshe bokuhlola noma izindlela ezisha zokuhlola ukuthuthukisa ukwazi kwakho. Xoxa namanyuvesi / amakhonsili ahlobene nezindaba zokuhlola.

xh.title: Umtechinikani Wokulinganisa (GRADE A-C)
xh.summary: Isithuba somtechinikani wokulinganisa eEast London esifuna iNational Diploma kwiSurvey okanye iCartography enesigunyaziso seSAGC neminyaka emithathu yamava.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi kwesizinga: Abafakelwayo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi seGrade 12 nesidanga seNqanaba leBhaso (NQF Level 6) kwisiSurvey okanye iCartography. Ukubhaliswa ngokungenwa kwilunga leSouth African Geomatics Council (SAGC) njengomtechinikani wokulinganisa / umlinganisi. Ubuncinane beminyaka emi-3 yamava obuchwepheshe bokulinganisa emva kokuzuwa kwesidanga. ilayisenisi yokushuka elisebenzayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulawulweni lweenkqubo namaprojekthi. Ulwazi lokuyila nokuhlalutya iinguquko. Uphando nophuhliso. Iinkqubo zokulinganisa ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokuthobela imigaqo. Ukubhala iingxelo zobuchwepheshe. Udalwa lwenkqubo yemveliso ephezulu. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukukhokela iqela. Ukucinga ngokuhlalutya. Ukudala. Ulawulo lwakho. Ulawulo lweemali. Ukuqwalasela kwaye uphendule abathengi. Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangokubhaliweyo). Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukucazulwa nokuhlelwa. Ulawulo lwezingxabano. Ukusombulula iingxaki noku hlalutya. Ulawulo labantu. Okutsha.
xh.duties: Nika inkonzo yokulinganisa kobuchwepheshe nentshisahelo. Nikha inkonzo zobuchwepheshe malunga nokuphonononga, ukugcina, ukuconywa konke ulwazi, nokuvelisa ulwazi lwamaxwebhu okulinganisa uze uwancedise ngeqiweko esimayityikitywe / sivunywe ngulawo olufanelekileyo. Yenza ukulinganisa kunye nokubala okulinganisa. Khuthaza ukhuseleko ngokwemigaqo yesizwe kunye nemigaqo elawulayo. Hlola iiplani, iimbaliso zobuchwepheshe eziphilayo, iindrawings ezisesqweni, nendlela ekusetyenziswa ngayo ukuzisa inkqubo entsha. Nika inkonzo yeenkqubo zeGeographic Information System (GIS), ukulinganisa, nokuvelisa ulwazi. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo kunye naleyo ehlobene nayo. Nika ingeniselo kumachubo okulinganisa kwimali njengoko kufunekayo. Hlela uze uthumela iingxelo njengoko kufunekayo. Nikela uze uhlanganise ingeniselo kwiplani yokusebenza okulinganisa. Phuhlisa, ukuyisebenzisa, uze ulondolaze iisiseko sedatha. Lawula uze ulawule abaFundi beTechinikani bomlinganiso / Balamaba benkonzo kunye nabanini bento abahlukene nabo. Yenza uphando kunye nophuhliso. Nikela ngenkulungqo ngaphakathi kobugcisa, ukulandelela iindlela ezintsha kwiteknoloji namakonkqubo. Yala ngokufunda / ukuphanda ngokulinganisa kwiteknoloji okutsha, okanye ezona ndlela zokulinganisa ezintsha, ukuphucula iziphumo. Xhumana nababali / amabala afanelekileyo kumacandso ahambelana nolwazi lokulinganisa.

jobs.title: Senior Cadastral Officer
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Senior Cadastral Officer responsible for capturing and maintaining cadastral survey data, requiring a Geomatics qualification and at least 3 years relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and National Certificate in Geomatics or Survey Officer Certificate (NQF Level 5). Minimum of 3 years geomatics post qualification experience in a Geomatics / Cadastral survey environment. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of Geographical Information Systems Software and fundamentals. Knowledge of Surveyor-General’s Office Standard Operating Procedures and processes. Knowledge of Cadastral Surveys. Job related skills: Analysing and report writing. Interpersonal relations. Communication (verbal and written). Computer literacy. Presentation and /attributes: Confidentiality, fairness, respect and honesty.
jobs.duties: Capture, maintain and update alpha numeric data of simple as well as more complex cadastral documents. Capture alpha and numeric information from newly submitted cadastral documents (simple and complex) and undertake mathematical consistency checks of and data verification of proposed new land parcels. Update cadastral survey databases through the addition or amendment of every approved document (simple and complex) to maintain and electronic alpha-numeric repository. Capture and verify simple and complex historical cadastral documents. Attend to complicated maintenance of cadastral documents in accordance with legislated processes. Perform withdrawal or cancelation of cadastral documents upon lawful instruction. Deduct, cancel and endorse cadastral documents with registered land parcels, leases or servitudes. Attend to complex amendments of approved and registered cadastral documents. Insert all newly approved cadastral documents into the archive. Extract and issue out cadastral records. Refile returned cadastral records. Repair and keep cadastral records in good usable condition. Conduct technical examination of simple as well as more complex cadastral documents. Check designations of newly submitted lodgements. Perform technical examination of simple and complex diagrams and general plans. Perform technical examination of survey records. Perform technical examination of simple and complex sectional title plans. Update the noting sheets through the addition of every approved cadastral land parcel. Research and supply cadastral information to internal and external clients. Retrieve and supply cadastral information to clients. Supply aerial photographs, rectified imagery and maps from National Geospatial Information (NGI) according to signed service level agreements. Carry out basic research into cadastral survey information pertaining to land parcel boundaries for clients and Land Reform. Capture, maintain and update spatial data with simple as well as more complex cadastral documents. Capture newly submitted documents to determine if there are any spatial overlaps prior approval. Add data, update and maintain an accurate dataset of cadastral spatial information, including the addition and updating of historical data. Research possible sources of error if overlaps are detected and address errors appropriately. Utilise cadastral survey calculation principle and other legitimate sources of data to improve the quality of land parcel boundary information. Scan all cadastral documents on approval, amendment, endorsement or withdrawal and execute quality checking. Scan newly approved cadastral documents. Re-scan all updated (amend, endorsed or withdrawn) cadastral documents. Link the deposited scanned images to the alpha numeric data. Carry out operations and do quality checking to ensure that the scanned image databases are clean and accurate.

af.title: Senior Cadastral Offiser
af.summary: Senior Cadastral Officer verantwoordelik vir die vaslegging en instandhouding van kadastrale opnamedata, met 'n Geomatics-kwalifikasie en ten minste 3 jaar relevante ervaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Sertifikaat in Geomatics of 'n Survey Officer-sertifikaat (NQF Level 5). Minimum van 3 jaar geomatics na-kwalifikasie-ervaring in 'n Geomatics / Kadastrale opname-omgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van Geographical Information Systems-sagteware en -grondbeginsels. Kennis van Surveyor-General's Office Standard Operating Procedures en prosesse. Kennis van kadastrale opnames. Werksverwante vaardighede: Ontleding en verslagskrywing. Interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Rekenaarvaardigheid. Voorlegging en /eienskappe: Konfidensialiteit, billikheid, respek en eerlikheid.
af.duties: Vang, onderhou en werk alfanumeriese data van eenvoudige sowel as meer komplekse kadastrale dokumente by. Vang alfa- en numeriese inligting vanuit nuut ingediente kadastrale dokumente (eenvoudig en kompleks) in en onderneem wiskundige konsekwensiekontroles en dataverifikasie van voorgestelde nuwe grondpersele. Werk kadastrale opnamedatabasisse by deur die byvoeging of wysiging van elke goedgekeurde dokument (eenvoudig en kompleks) om 'n elektroniese alfanumeriese bewaarplek te onderhou. Vang en verifieer eenvoudige en komplekse historiese kadastrale dokumente. Pas toe op ingewikkelde instandhouding van kadastrale dokumente in ooreenstemming met wetgewende prosesse. Voer onttrekking of kansellasie van kadastrale dokumente uit op wettige opdrag. Trek af, kanselleer en endorseer kadastrale dokumente met geregistreerde grondpersele, huurkontrakte of servitute. Pas toe op komplekse wysigings van goedgekeurde en geregistreerde kadastrale dokumente. Voeg alle nuut goedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente in die argief in. Trek kadastrale rekords uit en reik dit uit. Herlê teruggestuurde kadastrale rekords. Herstel en hou kadastrale rekords in goeie bruikbare toestand. Voer tegniese ondersoek van eenvoudige sowel as meer komplekse kadastrale dokumente uit. Kontroleer aanwysings van nuut ingediente voorleggings. Voer tegniese ondersoek van eenvoudige en komplekse diagramme en algemene planne uit. Voer tegniese ondersoek van opnamerekords uit. Voer tegniese ondersoek van eenvoudige en komplekse seksionele titelplanne uit. Werk die aantekeningvelle by deur die byvoeging van elke goedgekeurde kadastrale grondperceel. Doen navorsing en verskaf kadastrale inligting aan interne en eksterne kliënte. Haal kadastrale inligting op en verskaf dit aan kliënte. Verskaf lugfotos, geregistreerde beeldmateriaal en kaarte vanuit National Geospatial Information (NGI) volgens ondertekende diensvlakooreenkomste. Voer basiese navorsing oor kadastrale opname-inligting met betrekking tot grondperceelgrense vir kliënte en Land Reform uit. Vang, onderhou en werk ruimtelike data met eenvoudige sowel as meer komplekse kadastrale dokumente by. Vang nuut ingediente dokumente in om te bepaal of daar enige ruimtelike oorvleuelings voor goedkeuring is. Voeg data by, werk en onderhou 'n akkurate datastel van kadastrale ruimtelike inligting, insluitend die byvoeging en bywerking van historiese data. Doen navorsing oor moontlike bronne van foute indien oorvleuelings bespeur word en spreek foute toepaslik aan. Benut kadastrale opnameberekeningsbeginsels en ander wettige databronne om die kwaliteit van grondperceelgrensinligting te verbeter. Skandeer alle kadastrale dokumente by goedkeuring, wysiging, endorsasie of onttrekking en voer gehaltekontrole uit. Skandeer nuut goedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente. Her-skandeer alle bygewerkte (gewysigde, geëndorseerde of onttrekte) kadastrale dokumente. Skakel die gedeponeerde geskandeerde beelde aan die alfanumeriese data. Voer bewerings uit en doen gehaltekontrole om te verseker dat die geskandeerde beelddatabasisse skoon en akkuraat is.

zu.title: Onobhala Omkhulu We-Cadastral
zu.summary: Onobhala Omkhulu We-Cadastral onegunya lokuthwebula nokuhlakanipha idatha yesilinganiso se-cadastral, ofuna iziqu ze-Geomatics nokuthi abeneminyaka engu-3 ubudala owutholile ohlwini lwezimo zomsebenzi.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okungezansi: Abafakeli kufanele kube nokuba nesitifikedi se-Grade 12 kanye Nesitifikedi Sezwe se-Geomatics noma Isitifikedi Sonobhala Sokulinganisa (NQF Level 5). Kufanele abeneminyaka engu-3 ubudala ohlwini lwezimo zomsebenzi ze-geomatics emumva kokuthola iziqu endaweni ye-Geomatics / isilinganiso se-cadastral. Ilayisense yokuqasha elisebenzayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi lwe-Geographical Information Systems Software nokuqonda okuyisisekelo. Ulwazi lwe-Standard Operating Procedures kanye nezinqubo zikahlelo koMphathi Wezokulinganisa. Ulwazi lwezilinganiso ze-Cadastral. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuhlaziya kanye nokubhala imibiko. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Unxibelelwano (olusho ngomlomo nolubhaliwe). Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukubonisa nokubamba inkomba. Izimo: Ukugcina imfihlo, ukuba nococwe, inhlonipho kanye noqotho.
zu.duties: Thwebula, hlakanipha futhi buyekeza idatha yamagama nemininingwane yamadijithi yamadokhumenti we-cadastral alicisha kanye nalawo anobungokoqobo. Thwebula ulwazi lwamagama nemininingwane yamadijithi kulawo madokhumenti we-cadastral asanda kunikelwa (alicisha nabanobungokoqobo) bese uenza ukuhlola ukuvumelana ngokwezibalo kanye nokugqinisekisa idatha yamaselula entsha athandwayo emhlabeni. Buyekeza izinqolobane zesilinganiso se-cadastral ngokufaka noma ulungisele ngedokhumenti ngayinye evunyiwe (alicisha nabanobungokoqobo) ukuze kugcinwe futhi kuhlaliswe isiqolobanobhali samagama nemininingwane yamadijithi. Thwebula futhi uqinisekise amadokhumenti we-cadastral womlando alicisha nabanobungokoqobo. Fanekisela ukunakekelwa okuyinkimbinkimbishi kwamadokhumenti we-cadastral ngokuvumelana nezinqubo ezisemthethweni. Yenza ukuyekisa noma ukukhansela kwamadokhumenti we-cadastral ngokomyalo osemthethweni. Thwebula, khansela futhi ufake uphawu kwamadokhumenti we-cadastral anamaselula abhalisiwe, izinkqashi noma izikhungo zokusebenzisa izinkalo. Fanekisela ukulungiswa okuyinkimbinkimbishi kwamadokhumenti we-cadastral avunyiwe nabhalisiwe. Faka wonke amadokhumenti we-cadastral asanda kuvunywa esiqolobanini. Khishwa futhi udwayize imibhalo we-cadastral. Buyeka emuva imibhalo we-cadastral ebuyisiwe. Lungisa futhi ugcine imibhalo we-cadastral esimweni esihle sokusebenza. Yenza ukuhlola ngobuchwepheshe kwamadokhumenti we-cadastral alicisha kanye nalawo anobungokoqobo. Hlola ukubhaliswa kwamafomu asanda kunikwa. Yenza ukuhlola ngobuchwepheshe kwamadijimu amalicisha nabanobungokoqobo kanye nezinhlelo ezivela emphakathini. Yenza ukuhlola ngobuchwepheshe kwemibhalo yesilinganiso. Yenza ukuhlola ngobuchwepheshe kwezinhlelo zesihloko sesicelo samadicili namadicili anobungokoqobo. Buyekeza amakhasi okubhala ngokufaka iselula ngayinye yomhlaba we-cadastral evunyiwe. CULULA futhi uhlinze ngolwazi we-cadastral abathengi bangaphakathi nabanaphandle. Layisha futhi uhlinze ngolwazi we-cadastral kubathengi. Hlinzeka ngezithombe ezithathwa emoyeni, izithombe ezilungisiwe namashadi asuka ku-National Geospatial Information (NGI) ngokuvumelana nezivumelano ezibaluliwe zezizinga zokukhonza. Yenza ucwaningo oluyisisekelo ngolwazi lwesilinganiso se-cadastral ngokuphathelene namagajini omaselula omhlaba kubathengi nakule Nguqulo Yomhlaba. Thwebula, hlakanipha futhi buyekeza idatha yendawo namadokhumenti we-cadastral alicisha kanye nalawo anobungokoqobo. Thwebula amadokhumenti asanda kunikwa ukuthola ukuthi ngabe kukhona ukubhetha emkhawulweni wendawo ngaphambi kokuqashwa kwenkulumo-mvume. Faka idatha, buyekeze futhi ugcine idatha equkethe ulwazi oluchanekileyo ngamaselula amakhulu, kubandakanya ukufaka nokubuyekeza idatha yomlando. CULULA imithombo engase ibe yizipho ezingalungile uma kutholakala ukubhetha bese ubhekana nemikhuba engahambisani yona. Sebenzisa isimiso sokubala kwesilinganiso se-cadastral kanye namanye emithobo yedatha evunyiwe ukuphucula inani lelwazi lwegajini lamaselula omhlaba. Sika wonke amadokhumenti we-cadastral uma evunywe, elungiswa, kufakwe uphawu noma ehyekiswa bese uenza ukuhlola ukuthi kwakuhle. Sika amadokhumenti we-cadastral asanda kuvunywa. Phinda usike wonke amadokhumenti we-cadastral abuyekeziwe (alungisiwe, kufakwe uphawu noma ahyekisiwe). Xhumanisa izithombe ezifakiwe ezibhaliwe kudatha yamagama nemininingwane yamadijithi. Yenza izimiso bese uhlola ukuthi kwakuhle ukuthi noma izinqolobane zezithombe ezibhaliwe zicoce futhi zibe nesidingo.

xh.title: Umphathi Omkhulu weZommandla weCadastral
xh.summary: Umphathi Omkhulu weZommandla weCadastral onoxanduva lokubamba nokugcina iinkcukacha zophando lwe-cadastral, ofuna isiqinisekiso se-Geomatics nokuba nabunga buchule bokusebenza ubuncinane iye3 eminyaka.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abakhangeli bakhangele kubekho neSatifikethe lesiGredy 12 kunye neNational Certificate kwi-Geomatics okanye iSurvey Officer Certificate (NQF Level 5). Ubuncinane kwiminyaka e3 yamava wokusebenza kwizinto ze-geomatics emva kokufumana isiqinisekiso kwindalo ye-Geomatics / Cadastral survey. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Ulwazi nge-Geographical Information Systems Software nemiqathango yayo. Ulwazi ngeSurveyor-General's Office Standard Operating Procedures neenqobo ezisetyenziswa. Ulwazi ngeCadastral Surveys. Amap abilities ahambelana nomsebenzi: Ukuhlalutya nokubhala iingxelo. Izihlobo zabantu. Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangokubhaliweyo). Ulwazi lokusebenza ikhompyutha. Iprezentashion kwaye / iimfuzo: Ixabiso lokuqinisekisa iimfihlo, ubulungisa, inhlonipho nonyaniseko.
xh.duties: Bamba, gcina uze uvuselele i-data yamagama namanani ngeenxaxheba zamanani zamaxesho alula nangalula e-cadastral documents. Bamba iinkcukacha zamagama namanani kwii-cadastral documents ezingeniswe kutsha (ezilula nezibucukubhali) uze wenze izikrwezu ezingxamisekileyo zokuqinisekisa idatha kunye nonyilio lweendawo ezintsha zomhlaba eziphiwoyiweyo. Vuselela iisiseko zeedata zophando lwecadastral ngokudibanisa okanye ulungisa nxija nxaxheba yexesho elamkelekileyo (elilula nelibucukubhali) ukugcina nendawo yegcinelo lamagama namanani kakhompyutha. Bamba uze uqinisekise i-cadastral documents zembali ezilula nezibucukubhali. Jongana nokugcina okubucukubhali kwii-cadastral documents ngokweenqobo ezithethwe ngumthetho. Yenza ukususa okanye ukurhoxisa ii-cadastral documents ngokwale nsuku ethunyelweyo ngokomthetho. Tshatha, rhoxisa uze uvumele ii-cadastral documents ngeendawo zomhlaba ezibhalisweyo, i-leases okanye i-servitudes. Jongana nokulungisa okubucukubhali kwii-cadastral documents ezamkelekileyo nezigqityiweyo. Faka zonke ii-cadastral documents ezisamkelwe kutsha kwindawo yegcino. Khupha uze unikeze iirekhodi zecadastral. Phinda ufake iirekhodi zecadastral ezibuyisiweyo. Lungisa uze ugcine iirekhodi zecadastral zikulungele ukusetyenziswa. Yenza uphononongo lobuchwepheshe kwii-cadastral documents ezilula nangalula ezibucukubhali. Qinisekisa iindawo ezithunyelweyo kutsha ezikwii-lodgements. Yenza uphononongo lobuchwepheshe kwii-diagrams nee-general plans ezilula nezibucukubhali. Yenza uphononongo lobuchwepheshe kwiirekhodi zophando. Yenza uphononongo lobuchwepheshe kwiplani zesihloko nge-section ezilula nezibucukubhali. Vuselela amaphepha okubhalisa ngokudibanza nxija nxaxheba yendawo yomhlaba ecadastral ayamkelekileyo. Phanda uze unike iinkcukacha zecadastral kumaxhwebe langaphakathi nalangaphandle. Khupha uze unike iinkcukacha zecadastral kumaxhwebi. Nikeza iifoto zomoya, izithombe ezilungisiweyo namaphu evela kwi-National Geospatial Information (NGI) ngokwezivumelwano ze-service level equations eziyi-signed. Yenza uphando olusiseko kwiinkcukacha zophando lwecadastral ngokuphathelene nemida yemitha yomhlaba kumaxhwebi nakwiLand Reform. Bamba, gcina uze uvuselele i-data esithubeni ngeenxaxheba ezingamagama namanani ezilula nangalula ezingabucukubhali nge-cadastral documents. Bamba iinkcukacha ezifakwe kutsha ukumisela ukuba kukho naziphi na iindawo ezingqamene ngaphambi kokuvunyelwa. Dibanisa idatha, vuselela uze ugcine idatha equkethe iin kcukacha ezichanekileyo ze-cadastral spatial information, kuquka ukudibanisa nokuvuselela idatha yembali. Phanda iindawo eziphindaphindwe kwimiba yokukhathazeka kuba zikhona iindawo ezingqamene ze ndawo zeke ngokufanelekileyo. Sebenzisa iintsika zokubala zophando lwecadastral namanye amthombo okudatha athembekileyo ukuze ukulise ubuchule bemida yemitha yomhlaba. Skeni zonke ii-cadastral documents xa zisamkelwa, zilungiswa, zivunyelwa okanye zisuswa uze wenze ukuyiqinisekisa ngexabiso layo. Skani ii-cadastral documents ezisamkelewe kutsha. Skani kwakhona zonke ii-cadastral documents ezivuselelwe (ezilungisiweyo, ezivunyelweyo okanye ezisusiweyo). Sqamanisa izithombe ezibhaliweyo ezinikelweyo kwindalo yamagama namanani. Yenza iinkqubo uze uqinisekise ngexabiso ukuze iqinisekiswe ukuba isiseko sedata yesithombe esikeni sichanekileyo kwaye sichanekileyo.

jobs.title: Finance Clerk (SUPERVISOR)
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Supervise financial accounting transactions, invoice processing, filing and cash collection for the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate or relevant equivalent qualification. Minimum of 3 years’ experience in financial environment. Job related knowledge: Basic knowledge of financial functions, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operated computer and collate financial statistics. Basic knowledge and insight of the Public Services Financial legislations procedures and Treasury regulations (PFMA, DORA, PSA, PSR, PPPFA, Financial Manual). Knowledge of basic financial operating systems (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS etc). Job related skills: Planning and organisation. Computer operating. Language. Good communication (verbal and written). Basic numeracy skills. Flexibility, Interpersonal relations, Teamwork, ability to perform routine tasks, Ability to operate office equipment, Accuracy, Aptitude for figures, Willingness to work additional hours as and when required.
jobs.duties: Supervise and render financial accounting transactions. Receive and allocate invoices. Verify invoices for correctness, verification and approval (Internal control). Verify processing of invoices (e.g. capturing of payments). Supervise filing of all documents. Supervise collection of cash. Supervise and perform salary administration support services. Receive and allocate salary advices. Process and ensure the processing of salary advices (e.g. check advices for correctness, capture salaries, bonuses, salary adjustments, capture all deductions etc). Supervise the filling of all documents. Supervise and perform bookkeeping support services. Verify all financial transactions captured. Clear suspense accounts. Record debtors and creditors. Verify and process the processing of electronic banking transactions. Compile journal and verify the compilation of journals. Render a budget support service. Verify information collected from budget holders. Compare and verify the comparison of expenditure against budget. Identify variances and verify the identification of variance. Verify the capturing, allocations virements on budget. Supervise the distribution of documents with regard to the budget. Supervise the filling of all documents. Supervise the receipt and capturing of cash payments. Supervise human resources/staff. Allocate and ensure quality of work. Personnel development. Assess staff performance. Apply discipline.

af.title: Finansieklerk (SUPERVISOR)
af.summary: Outeur hou toesig oor finansiële rekenaartransaksies, fakture verwerking, lêerwerk en kontantinvordering vir die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat of 'n toepaslike gelykwaardige kwalifikasie hê. Minimum van 3 jaar se ondervinding in 'n finansiële omgewing. Werksverwante kennis: Basiese kennis van finansiële funksies, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, 'n rekenaar te bedien en finansiële statistieke bymekaar te maak. Basiese kennis en insig van die Openbare Diens se finansiële wetgewing, prosedures en Tesourie-regulasies (PFMA, DORA, PSA, PSR, PPPFA, Finansiële Handleiding). Kennis van basiese finansiële bedryfstelsels (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS ens). Werksverwante vaardighede: Beplanning en organisasie. Rekenaarbedrywing. Taal. Goeie kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik). Basiese syferkundige vaardighede. Buigsaamheid, interpersoonlike verhoudings, spanwerk, vermoë om roetine take uit te voer, vermoë om kantoor-toerusting te bedien, akkuraatheid, aanleg vir syfers, bereidwilligheid om addisionele ure te werk wanneer nodig.
af.duties: Hou toesig oor en lewer finansiële rekenaartransaksies. Ontvang en wys fakture toe. Verifieer fakture vir korrektheid, verificering en goedkeuring (Interne beheer). Verifieer verwerking van fakture (bv. vaslegging van betalings). Hou toesig oor lêerwerk van alle dokumente. Hou toesig oor invordering van kontant. Hou toesig oor en voer salarisadministrasie-ondersteuningsdienste uit. Ontvang en wys salarisadviesse toe. Verwerk en verseker die verwerking van salarisadviesse (bv. kontroleer adviesse vir korrektheid, lê salarisse, bonusse, salarisaanpassings vas, lê alle aftrekkings vas ens). Hou toesig oor die invul van alle dokumente. Hou toesig oor en voer boekhoudondersteuningsdienste uit. Verifieer alle finansiële transaksies wat vasgelê is. Maak skeefrekenings skoon. Rekord skuldenaars en krediteure. Verifieer en verwerk die verwerking van elektroniese banktransaksies. Stel joernaal op en verifieer die opstel van joernale. Lewer 'n begrotingsondersteuningsdiens. Verifieer inligting wat by begrotingshouers ingesamel is. Vergelyk en verifieer die vergelyking van besteding teen begroting. Identifiseer afwykings en verifieer die identifisering van afwykings. Verifieer die vaslegging, toekenning en oorboekings op begroting. Hou toesig oor die verspreiding van dokumente met betrekking tot die begroting. Hou toesig oor die invul van alle dokumente. Hou toesig oor die ontvangs en vaslegging van kontantbetalings. Hou toesig oor menslike hulpbronne/personeel. Wys werk toe en verseker gehalte van werk. Personeelsonwikkeling. Beoordeel personeel se prestasie. Pas dissipline toe.

zu.title: Ikhilikithi lezezimali (UMQONISI)
zu.summary: Qondisa izenzakalo zokubhalwa kwamabaluli ezimali, ucwecwe lwamanikweni, ukugcinwa koshicilelo kanye nokutholwa kwemali ngokomthetho we Department of Land Reform and Rural Development e Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okungenani: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi se Grade 12 noma izifundo ezingangaleyo ezifanayo. Ubude obungenani eminyakeni engu-3 bobuhlobo bemisebenzi yezimali. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi olusisekelo ngemisebenzi yezimali, izindlela zokwenza umsebenzi kanye nenhlokolo yokuqasha ulwazi, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqoqa izibalo eziyimibalabhalo ezimalini. Ulwazi olusisekelo nokuqonda imithetho yezimali yomnyango wezinkonzo zikahulumeni kanye nomthetho wamabhange (PFMA, DORA, PSA, PSR, PPPFA, Financial Manual). Ulwazi lwezinhlelo eziyisisekelo zokusebenza izimali (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS etc). Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuhlela nokuqamba izinhlelo. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwimi. Ukuxhumana okuhle (ngomlomo nangokubhala). Amakhono abalo ebusisekelo. Ukuguquguquka, ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu, ukusebenza njengoluhsft, ikakhulukazi ikhono lokwenza imisebenzi evamile, ikhono lokusebenzisa izinto zenhloso, ukulunga, ikhono kwamanani, ukuzithoba ukusebenza amahora amaningi njengoba kudingeka.
zu.duties: Qondisa futhi uhlinzeke ngemisebenzi yezimali yokubhalwa kwamabaluli. Thola futhi wabelwe ngawo oshicilelo bamanikwa. Hlola oshicilelo bamanikwa ngokuqonda, ukuqinisekiswa kanye nesiqiniseko (ukulawula ngaphakathi). Hlola inqubo yokwenza oshicilelo bamanikwa (isb ukuqasha imibalabhalo yemali ehlinzekwayo). Qondisa ukugcinwa koshicilelo bonke. Qondisa ukutholwa kwemali. Qondisa futhi wenze imisebenzi yohlelo loholo. Thola futhi wabelwe ngemibiko yeholo. Yenza futhi uqiniseke ukwenziwa kwemibiko yeholo (isb hlola imibiko ngokuqonda, qasha amaholo, izibhwebhu, ukulungiswa kwehlo, qasha wonke amakhikhisho njll). Qondisa ukugcwaliswa koshicilelo bonke. Qondisa futhi wenze imisebenzi yokugcina izibhalo ezimalini. Hlola yonke imisebenzi yezimali eqashiwe. Susa izikhwama ezinguqukayo. Bhala abanikayo nabanikelayo. Hlola futhi yenza inqubo yokuqasha imisebenzi yamabhange ngqazanyo. Hlanganisa imibalo futhi uhlole ukuhlanganiswa kwemibalo. Hlinzeka ngomsebenzi wokusekela isabelo semali. Hlola ulwazi oluqoqwe kubanishi besabelo semali. Qhathanisa futhi uhlole ukuqhathaniswa kokuchitha kwemali nesabelo. Phawula izinto ezihlukile futhi uhlole ukuphawulwa kwezinto ezingafani. Hlola ukuqashwa, ukwabelwa kanye nokudluliswa kwesabelo semali. Qondisa ukusatshalaliswa koshicilelo mayelana nesabelo semali. Qondisa ukugcwaliswa koshicilelo bonke. Qondisa ukutholwa kanye nokuqasha imali ezingenayo. Qondisa abantu/basebenzi bemininigwane. Babela futhi uqinisekiswe inani lemisebenzi. Ukuthuthukiswa kwabantu. Hlola ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Faka isiyalo.

xh.title: Clerk wezeMali (UMAPHUFEKI)
xh.summary: Qondisa iintengiselwano zoku.accounta kwezeimali, ukuqhuba iinvoisi, ugcino lwamafayile nokuqokelela imali yase isebe le Land Reform and Rural Development e Pretoria.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezuncitshakeyo: Abafakeli kufuneka babe nesatifikethe seGrade 12 okanye izifundo ezilinganayo ezifanelekileyo. Kubeko kuguquguquka kweminyaka eyi-3 kwindawo yemali. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Ulwazi olusisiseko ngeemisebenzi yemali, iinkqubo njengokunokwazi ukuqamba iingcombolo, kusebenza ngekhompyutha nokudibanisa izibalo zemali. Ulwazi olusisiseko nokuqonda iinkqubo zobulungiselele bemali zoLuntu nemiGaqo yeTreasury (PFMA, DORA, PSA, PSR, PPPFA, iNkqubo yezeMali). Ulwazi lweenkqubo ezisisiseko zemali (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS njl). Amandla ahambelana nomsebenzi: Ulungelelwaniso nokuhlela. Ukusebenza ngekhompyutha. Ulwimi. Unxibelelwano olulunga (lwesinye nesibhalwe phantsi). Amandla okubalaisisiseko. Ukuguquguquka, Unxibelelwano nabantu, Ukusebenza njengeqela, amandla okwenza imisebenzi eqhelekileyo, Amandla okusebenza ngezixhobo zofisi, Uchane, Ifemomno wamanani, Ukulunga ukusebenza iiyure ezongezelelweyo xa kudingeka.
xh.duties: Qondisa kwaye uze unike iintengiselwano zoku.accounta kwezeimali. Yamkela kwaye wabelle iinvoisi. Qinisekisa ukuchaneka kweenvoisi, ukuqinisekisa nokuvunywa (ulawulo langaphakathi). Qinisekisa ukuqhubwa kweenvoisi (umz. ukubhalwa kweentlawulo). Qondisa ugcino lwezo zicatshulawa zonke. Qondisa uqokelelo lwezimali zetyhuna. Qondisa kwaye wenze iinkonzo zexhaso lolawulo lovuzo. Yamkela kwaye wabelle iindaba zobomi beka nxeba. Qhuba kwaye uqinisekise ukuqhubwa kweendaba zobomi beka nxeba (umz. qinisekisa ukuchaneka kweendaba, bhalo bovuzo, iibhonasi, ulungelelwaniso lovuzo, bhalo zonke izahlulelo njl). Qondisa ugcino lwezo zicatshulawa zonke. Qondisa kwaye wenze iinkonzo zexhaso lokugcina izihlwempu. Qinisekisa zonke iintengiselwano zemali ezibhaliweyo. Cacisa ama-akhawunti okurhuzu. Bhala abatyikityi nabanikencilo. Qinisekisa kwaye uqube ukuqhubwa kweentengiselwano zebhanki yeeselula. Hlela ijornali kwaye uqinisekise ukuhlelwa kweejornali. Nike iinkonzo zexhaso lebajeti. Qinisekisa ulwazi oluqokelelweyo kubanikabajeti. Fanekiselisa kwaye uqinisekise ukufanekiselwa kutyalo-mali ngokumelana nebajeti. Phawula iinguqu kwaye uqinisekise ukuphawulwa kweenguqu. Qinisekisa ukubhalwa, ukwabelana nokuguqulwa kwebajeti. Qondisa ukusasazwa kwezicatshulawa ngokumayelana nebajeti. Qondisa ugcino lwezo zicatshulawa zonke. Qondisa ukwamkelwa nokubhalwa kweentlawulo zetyhuna. Qondisa abasebenzi/abanthu. Wabela kwaye uqinisekise umgangatho womsebenzi. Uphuhliso lwabasebenzi. Linganisa inkqubo yabasebenzi. Faka isohlwayo.

jobs.title: Cadastral Officer
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Capture, maintain and update cadastral document data for the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and National Certificate in Geomatics or Survey Officer Certificate (NQF Level 5). Completion of the training prescribed in order to fulfil the required qualification. Job related knowledge: Computer literacy. Understanding spatial data. Knowledge of the functions of Surveyors’-General Offices. Job related skills: Good interpersonal relations. Good communication (verbal and written). Computer software. Good organising ability.
jobs.duties: Capture, maintain and update alpha numeric data of all cadastral documents: Capture alpha and numeric information from newly submitted Cadastral documents and undertake mathematical consistency checks and data verification for proposed new land parcels. Update Cadastral survey databases through the addition or amendment of every approved document to maintain an electronic alpha-numeric repository. Capture and verify Historical Cadastral documents. Maintenance of Cadastral Documents in accordance with legislated processes: Perform Withdrawal or cancelation of cadastral documents. Deduct, cancel and endorse cadastral documents with registered land parcels, leases or servitudes. Amend approved and registered cadastral documents. Insert all newly approved cadastral documents into the archive. Extract and issue out cadastral records. Refile returned cadastral records. Repair and keep cadastral records in good usable condition. Conduct technical examination of cadastral documents. Check designations of newly submitted lodgements: Update the noting sheets through the addition of every approved cadastral land parcel. Perform technical examination of diagrams and general plans. Perform technical examination of survey records. Perform technical examination of sectional title plans. Supply cadastral information to internal and external clients: Issue Survey data to Land Surveyors when required. Disseminate cadastral information to the public as required, in hard copy or digital formats. Supply aerial photographs, rectified imagery and maps from NGI according to signed service level agreements. Capture, maintain and update spatial data: Capture newly submitted documents to determine if there are any spatial overlaps prior approval. Add all newly created land parcels to the spatial datasets. Add data, update and maintain an accurate dataset of cadastral spatial information, including the addition and updating of historical data. Scan all cadastral documents on approval, amendment, endorsement, or withdrawal: Scan newly approved cadastral documents. Re-scan all updated cadastral documents. Link the deposited scanned images to the alpha numeric data.

af.title: Kadastrale Beampte
af.summary: Vaslegging, instandhouding en bywerking van kadastrale dokumentdata vir die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Sertifikaat in Geomatika of 'n Survey Officer-sertifikaat (NQF Level 5). Voltooiing van die voorgeskrewe opleiding om aan die vereiste kwalifikasie te voldoen. Werksverwante kennis: Rekenaarvaardigheid. Begrip van ruimtelike data. Kennis van die funksies van Surveyors'-General Offices. Werksverwante vaardighede: Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Goeie kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Rekenaarsagteware. Goeie organisasievermoë.
af.duties: Vaslegging, instandhouding en bywerking van alfa-numeriese data van alle kadastrale dokumente: Vaslegging van alfa- en numeriese inligting uit nuut ingediente kadastrale dokumente en uitvoer van wiskundige konsekwentheidskontroles en dataverifikasie vir voorgestelde nuwe landpercele. Bywerking van kadastrale opmeetdatabasisse deur die byvoeging of wysiging van elke goedgekeurde dokument om 'n elektroniese alfa-numeriese bewaarplek in stand te hou. Vaslegging en verifikasie van historiese kadastrale dokumente. Instandhouding van kadastrale dokumente in ooreenstemming met wetgewende prosesse: Uitvoer van onttrekking of kansellasie van kadastrale dokumente. Aftrek, kanselleer en endosseer van kadastrale dokumente met geregistreerde landpercele, huurkontrakte of servitute. Wysig van goedgekeurde en geregistreerde kadastrale dokumente. Invoeg van alle nuut goedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente in die argief. Uittrek en uitreik van kadastrale rekords. Herlêer van terugontvangde kadastrale rekords. Herstel en in stand hou van kadastrale rekords in 'n goeie bruikbare toestand. Uitvoer van tegniese ondersoek van kadastrale dokumente. Kontroleer van benamings van nuut ingediente voorleggings: Bywerking van die notasievelle deur die byvoeging van elke goedgekeurde kadastrale landparcel. Uitvoer van tegniese ondersoek van diagramme en algemene planne. Uitvoer van tegniese ondersoek van opmeetrekords. Uitvoer van tegniese ondersoek van seksionele titelplanne. Verskaf van kadastrale inligting aan interne en eksterne kliënte: Uitreik van opmeetdata aan Land Surveyors wanneer vereis. Verspreiding van kadastrale inligting aan die publiek soos vereis, in gedrukte of digitale formaat. Verskaffing van lugfotos, geregistreerde beeldmateriaal en kaarte van NGI volgens ondertekende diensvlakooreenkomste. Vaslegging, instandhouding en bywerking van ruimtelike data: Vaslegging van nuut ingediente dokumente om te bepaal of daar enige ruimtelike oorvleuelings voor goedkeuring is. Byvoeging van alle nuut geskepte landpercele by die ruimtelike datastelles. Byvoeging van data, bywerking en instandhouding van 'n akkurate datastel van kadastrale ruimtelike inligting, insluitend die byvoeging en bywerking van historiese data. Skandering van alle kadastrale dokumente by goedkeuring, wysiging, endossement of onttrekking: Skandering van nuut goedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente. Herskandering van alle bygewerkte kadastrale dokumente. Koppeling van die gedeponeerde geskandeerde beelde aan die alfa-numeriese data.

zu.title: Inkantili Yezinkomba Zomhlaba
zu.summary: Qopha, gcina futhi uvuselele imininingwane yamadokhumenti e-cadastral e-Department of Land Reform and Rural Development e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi kwalezi: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye nesitifiketi se-National Certificate in Geomatics noma i-Survey Officer Certificate (NQF Level 5). Ukugcwaliseka kokusebenza okushiwo ukuze kufezeke izindinganiso ezidingekayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ukuqonda idatha yezikhala. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yezikhungo ze-Surveyors'-General Offices. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Ukuxhumana okuhle (okulashelwayo nokubhaliwayo). Isofthiwe yekhompuyutha. Ikakhulu ukukwazi ukuhlela.
zu.duties: Qopha, gcina futhi uvuselele idatha ye-alpha numeric yawo wonke amadokhumenti e-cadastral: Qopha ulwazi lwe-alpha namanani kulawo madokhumenti e-cadastral amasha okuthunyelwe futhi wenze ukuhlola ukuvumelana kwemathematika kanye nokuqinisekisa idatha kumapasela omhlaba amasha abisiwayo. Vuselela idathabheyisi yokuhlola i-cadastral ngokungeza noma ukulungisa idokhumenti ngayinye egunyaziwe ukugcina indawo ye-electronic alpha-numeric. Qopha futhi uqinisekise amadokhumenti e-Historical Cadastral. Ukugcinwa kwamadokhumenti e-cadastral ngokusha imigomo esemthethweni: Yenza ukukhishwa noma ukukhanselwa kwamadokhumenti e-cadastral. Susa, khansela futhi ufake izinkomba kwamadokhumenti e-cadastral anamapasela omhlaba abhalisiwe, izikweletu noma izinsiza. Lungisa amadokhumenti e-cadastral agunyaziwe futhi abhalisiwe. Faka wonke amadokhumenti e-cadastral amasha egunyaziwe kwesikhungo sokugcina imibhalo. Khhipha futhi unike amarekhodi e-cadastral. Buyisela emaqashweni amarekhodi e-cadastral abuyisiwe. Lungisa futhi ugcine amarekhodi e-cadastral esimeni esihle sokusetshenziswa. Yenga ukuphambuka kwesobuciko kwamadokhumenti e-cadastral. Hlola izinkomba zobuhlengabezimo zamashodo amasha okuthunyelwe: Vuselela amakhasi okubhaliswa ngokungeza ipasela ngalinye lomhlaba e-cadastraleligunyaziwe. Yenga ukuphambuka kwesobuciko kwamadayagramu kanye namaphulani jikelele. Yenga ukuphambuka kwesobuciko kwamarekhodi okuhlola. Yenga ukuphambuka kwesobuciko kwamaphulani wesihloko-ngxenye. Nikeza imininingwane ye-cadastral abathengi bangaphakathi nangaphandle: Nikeza idatha yokuhlola abahleli bomhlaba uma kudingeka. Sabalalisa imininingwane ye-cadastral kubantu bemphakathi njengoba kudingeka, ngesimo elibhaliwe noma ngokwe-digital. Nikeza izithombe ezithathwa emoyeni, izithombe ezilungisiwe namamephu avela ku-NGI ngokushana izivumelano zezinga losebenze. Qopha, gcina futhi uvuselele idatha yezikhala: Qopha amadokhumenti amasha okuthunyelwe ukuze uhlole ukuthi kukhona yini ukweqelana kwezikhala ngaphambi kokugunyazwa. Faka wonke amapasela omhlaba amasha endaweni yedatha yezikhala. Faka idatha, vuselela futhi ugcine idathasethi ethembekile yemininingwane yesikhala se-cadastral, okuhlanganisa nokungeza kanye nokuvuselela idatha yomlando. Skena wonke amadokhumenti e-cadastral lapho kunegunyazwa, ukulungiswa, ukufaka izinkomba, noma ukukhishwa: Skena amadokhumenti e-cadastral amasha egunyaziwe. Skena kabusha wonke amadokhumenti e-cadastral avuseleliwe. Xhumanisa izithombe eziskeniwe ezibekwe zidathe ye-alpha numeric.

xh.title: Iofisa wezoKadastral
xh.summary: Qamba, zigcine uze wazise idatha yamaxwebhu okadastral kwiSebe loLwazi nokuPhuhlisa kwamahlaba nokuPhelezela kwindalo emaphandleni ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezambalwa: Kufuneka abafakelayo babe neQinisekiso lesiGreydi 12 kunye neQinisekiso leSizwe kwiGeomatics okanye iQinisekiso loFisa wezoSalo (iNqanaba 5 leNQF). Ukugqiba kwesisikolo esichaziweyo ngenjongo yokuzalisekisa ifanelekiso eliceliweyo. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Ukwazi kwaye usebenzise ikhompyutha. Ukuqonda idatha yesithuba. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yeziCango zaboBalo-Karhulu. Ikhono elihambelana nomsebenzi: Ubudlelwane obuhle nabantu. Unxibelelwano oluhle (lwalomlomo nolwelubhalo). Isoftware yekhompyutha. Ikhono elihle lokulungiselela.
xh.duties: Qamba, zigcine uze wazise idatha yamagama amanani yonke imixwebhu yokadastral: Qumba ulwazi lwamagama namanani kwimixwebhu yokadastral emitsha eposiweyo wenze ukuphonononga ngokulinganisa izibalo nokuqinisekisa idatha yamacebo amatsha amabiwo ahlukeneyo. Hlaziya iisiseko zedatha zesalo kadastral ngokongeza okanye ulungise lonke ixwebhu elamkiweyo ukuze zigcinwe ngokwekhwkhwkhi idatha yamagama namanani. Qamba uze uqinisekise imixwebhu yokadastral yangaphambili. Ukugcina kwamixwebhu yokadastral ngokweembonakaliso ezithile: Yenza ukukhutsha okanye ukurhoxisa imixwebhu yokadastral. Thabatha, rhoxisa uze upawule imixwebhu yokadastral enamabiwo ababhalisiweyo, iinkopho okuba iinkonzo. Lungisa imixmbhu yokadastral eamkiweyo nethi yabhaliswa. Faka lonke imixwebhu yokadastral emitsha eamkiweyo kwisiKhuluma-nxaxheba. Khupha uze upapasha amaxwebhu okadastral. Phinda ufake amaxwebhu okadastral abuyisiweyo. Louda uze ugcinise amaxwebhu okadastral ukuba abe kwimo yokusetyenziswa. Yenza uphononongo olunemithetho yamaxwebhu okadastral. Phonononga iinkqubo zelifa kumabhalo amatsha afakiweyo: Zihlaziya iikati zokubhala ngokongeza amacebo amabiwo ahlukeneyo okadastral. Yenza uphononongo nemithetho yamadiagram nendlela ejwayelekileyo. Yenza uphononongo lemithetho yerekhodi yesalo. Yenza upphononongo lezicwangciso zesihloko esahlulwayo.Nikezela ngenkcukacha kadastral kubathengi bangaphakathi nangaphandle: Papasha idatha yesalo kubaBali-Bahlobo bamabiwo xa kufunwa. Saza iinkukacha kadastral kuzemjondolo njengoko kufunwa, nakwifomatho yephepha okanye yedijithali. Nikezela iithathamdwa, imifanekiso elungisiweyo namaphu avela kwi-NGI ngokomvisiswano namasivnavi malunga nenqanaba lenkonzo. Qamba, zigcine uze wazise idatha yesithuba: Qamba imixwebhu emitsha eposiweyo ukugqiba ukuba kukho na ukutshintsana kwezithuba ngaphambi kokwamkelwa. Yongeza lonke amabiwo amatsha eendawo kumajelo esithuba. Yongeza idatha, hlaziya uze ugcinethe idatha echanekileyo yelwazi lokadastral kwiindawo esithuba, kuquka ukongeza ukuhlaziya idatha yangaphambili. Skenatha yonke imixwebhu yokadastral xa kwamkelwa, kulungiswa, kubekwa ipawulu okanye xa ikhutshiwa: Skenatha imixwebhu yokadastral eamkiweyo. Phinda uskene yonke imixwebhu yokadastral ehlaziyiweyo. Dibanisa imifanekiso eskiniweyo idityaniswe kwidatha yamagama namanana.

Lungisa futhi ugcine imibhalo yezinkomishi esimweni esihle sokusetshenziswa. Yenza ukuhlolwa kobuciko bezemisebenzi kwemibhalo yezinkomishi. Hlola izinkomba zemibhalo entsha efolakalayo: Vuselela amaphepha okuhlola ngokwengeza nge inkambu ngayinye yezinkomishi evunyiwe. Yenza ukuhlolwa kobuciko bezemisebenzi kwediagramu kanye nezinhlelo ezijwayelekile. Yenza ukuhlolwa kobuciko bezemisebenzi kwemibhalo yesoluko. Yenza ukuhlolwa kobuciko bezemisebenzi kwezinhlelo zamaqoqo amancane. Nikeza ulwazi lwezinkomishi kubathengi bangaphakathi nangaphandle: Nikeza idatha yesoluko kubasoluli bomhlaba lapho kudingeka khona. Sabela ulwazi lwezinkomishi kuyiloluhlule njengoba kudingeka, ngokubhalwe noma ngokwezezimali ezithwebuliwe. Nikeza izithombe zomkhathi, izithombe ezilungisiwe namamephu avela kwiNGI ngokwesivumelwano esishayiwe sezinkundla zokulethwa kwesevisi. Thatha, gcina futhi uvuselele idatha yesikhala: Thatha imibhalo entsha efolakalayo ukuze kubonwe ngabe kukhona ukugqamana kwesikhala ngaphambi kokuvunywa. Yengeza zonke izinkambu zomhlaba ezintsha ezidalwe kumaseti edatha yesikhala. Yengeza idatha, vuselela futhi ugcine isethi edatha enembile yolwazi lwezikhala zezinkomishi, okuhlanganisa ukwengeza nokuvuselela idatha yomlando. Skena imibhalo yonke yezinkomishi uma ivunywa, ilungiswa, igqashwa noma ikhishwa: Skena imibhalo yezinkomishi entsha evunyiwe. Phinde uskene imibhalo yezinkomishi yonke evuseleliwe. Xhumanisa izithombe ezenziwe njengezinsalo ngedatha yamagama nanonombolo.

jobs.title: Cadastral Officer
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Cadastral Officer needed in Pietermaritzburg to capture and maintain cadastral survey data, requiring a Grade 12 certificate and National Certificate in Geomatics.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and National Certificate in Geomatics or Survey Officer Certificate (NQF Level 5). Completion of the training prescribed in order to fulfil the required qualification. Job related knowledge: Computer literacy. Understanding spatial data. Knowledge of the functions of Surveyors’-General Offices. Job related skills: Good interpersonal relations. Good communication (verbal and written). Computer software. Good organising ability.
jobs.duties: Capture, maintain and update alpha numeric data of all cadastral documents: Capture alpha and numeric information from newly submitted Cadastral documents and undertake mathematical consistency checks and data verification for proposed new land parcels. Update Cadastral survey databases through the addition or amendment of every approved document to maintain an electronic alpha-numeric repository. Capture and verify Historical Cadastral documents. Maintenance of Cadastral Documents in accordance with legislated processes: Perform Withdrawal or cancelation of cadastral documents. Deduct, cancel and endorse cadastral documents with registered land parcels, leases or servitudes. Amend approved and registered cadastral documents. Insert all newly approved cadastral documents into the archive. Extract and issue out cadastral records. Refile returned cadastral records. Repair and keep cadastral records in good usable condition. Conduct technical examination of cadastral documents. Check designations of newly submitted lodgements: Update the noting sheets through the addition of every approved cadastral land parcel. Perform technical examination of diagrams and general plans. Perform technical examination of survey records. Perform technical examination of sectional title plans. Supply cadastral information to internal and external clients: Issue Survey data to Land Surveyors when required. Disseminate cadastral information to the public as required, in hard copy or digital formats. Supply aerial photographs, rectified imagery and maps from NGI according to signed service level agreements. Capture, maintain and update spatial data: Capture newly submitted documents to determine if there are any spatial overlaps prior approval. Add all newly created land parcels to the spatial datasets. Add data, update and maintain an accurate dataset of cadastral spatial information, including the addition and updating of historical data. Scan all cadastral documents on approval, amendment, endorsement, or withdrawal: Scan newly approved cadastral documents. Re-scan all updated cadastral documents. Link the deposited scanned images to the alpha numeric data.

af.title: Kadastrale Beampte
af.summary: Kadastrale Beampte benodig in Pietermaritzburg om kadastrale opnamedata vas te lê en te onderhou, met 'n Vereistes van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Sertifikaat in Geomatika.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Sertifikaat in Geomatika of 'n Opnamebeampte-sertifikaat (NQF Level 5). Voltooiing van die voorgeskrewe opleiding om aan die vereiste kwalifikasie te voldoen. Werksverwante kennis: Rekenaargeletterdheid. Begrip van ruimtelike data. Kennis van die funksies van Landmeters-generaal se kantore. Werksverwante vaardighede: Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Goeie kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Rekenaarsagteware. Goeie organisasievermoë.
af.duties: Vaslegging, onderhoud en opdatering van alfanumeriese data van alle kadastrale dokumente: Vang alfabetiese en numeriese inligting van nuut ingediende kadastrale dokumente vas en onderneem wiskundige konsekwensiekontroles en dataverifikasie vir voorgestelde nuwe grondperke. Werk kadastrale opnamedatabasisse op deur die byvoeging of wysiging van elke goedgekeurde dokument om 'n elektroniese alfanumeriese bewaarplek te onderhou. Vang historiese kadastrale dokumente vas en verifieer dit. Onderhoud van kadastrale dokumente ooreenkomstig wetgewingsprosesse: Voer onttrekking of kansellasie van kadastrale dokumente uit. Trek af, kanselleer en voorseen kadastrale dokumente met geregistreerde grondperke, huurkontrakte of serwituite. Wysig goedgekeurde en geregistreerde kadastrale dokumente. Plaas alle nuut goedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente in die argief. Haal kadastrale rekords uit en reik dit uit. Herlê teruggekeerde kadastrale rekords in. Herstel en hou kadastrale rekords in 'n goeie bruikbare toestand. Voer tegniese ondersoek van kadastrale dokumente uit. Kontroleer aanwysings van nuut ingediende voorleggings: Werk die aantekenvel op deur die byvoeging van elke goedgekeurde kadastrale grondperk. Voer tegniese ondersoek van diagramme en algemene planne uit. Voer tegniese ondersoek van opnamerekords uit. Voer tegniese ondersoek van seksionele titelplanne uit. Verskaf kadastrale inligting aan interne en eksterne kliënte: Reik opnamedata aan Landmeters uit wanneer vereis. Versprei kadastrale inligting aan die publiek soos vereis, in hardkopie- of digitale formate. Verskaf lugfotos, geregistreerde beeldmateriaal en kaarte van NGI volgens ondertekende diensvlakooreenkomste. Vaslegging, onderhoud en opdatering van ruimtelike data: Vang nuut ingediende dokumente vas om te bepaal of daar enige ruimtelike oorvleuelings voor goedkeuring is. Voeg alle nuut geskepte grondperke by die ruimtelike dataversamelings. Voeg data by, werk op en onderhou 'n akkurate versameling van kadastrale ruimtelike inligting, insluitend die byvoeging en opdatering van historiese data. Skandeer alle kadastrale dokumente by goedkeuring, wysiging, goedkeuring of onttrekking: Skandeer nuut goedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente. Her-skandeer alle opgedateerde kadastrale dokumente. Koppel die gedeponeerde geskandeerde beelde aan die alfanumeriese data.

zu.title: Ofisa we-Cadastral
zu.summary: Kudingeka inkokheli ye-Cadastral ePietermaritzburg ukubamba futhi igcine idatha yesibalo se-cadastral, idinga isitifikedi seGrade 12 kanye neNqubo Yesitifikedi iGeomatics.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okungenani: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nesitifikedi seGrade 12 kanye neNqubo yesitifikedi seGeomatics noma isitifikedi seSurvey Officer (NQF Level 5). Ukuqedwa kokulekelewa okuqondene nokuqedwa kokulungele isidingo esitholakalayo. Ulwazi oluhambisana nomsebenzi: Ukuba nolwazi ngokusetyenziswa kwekhompyutha. Ukuqonda idatha yesikhala. Ulwazi ngomsebenzi wezinkantolo zoSoli. Ikhono elihambisana nomsebenzi: Ubuhlobo obuhle kubantu. Ukuthintana ngokukhuluma nokubhala. Ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zekhompyutha. Ikhono elihle lokuhlela.
zu.duties: Bamba, gcina futhi ubuyekeze idatha ye-alpha numeric yawo wonke amadokhumenti we-cadastral: Bamba ulwazi lwe-alpha nokuqedwa kwamaminoringi kudokhumenti we-Cadastral athunyelwe sanda kube khona, futhi wenze izihlola ezindaba zezibalo kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwedatha yamaphasela entsha ezwa isiphakamiso. Buyekeza osimidijini besibalo se-cadastral ngokwenezela noma ukulungisa yonke idokhumenti evunyiwe ukugcina indawo yogcine i-alpha-numeric esibalo sekhompyutha. Bamba futhi uqinisekise idatha yamadokhumenti we-Cadastral eNamuhla. Ukugcinwa kwamadokhumenti we-Cadastral ngokomthetho osunguliwe: Yenza ukuhoxiswa noma ukukhanselwa kwamadokhumenti we-cadastral. Khisha, khansela futhi ufake uphawu kumadokhumenti we-cadastral anamaphasela abhalisiwe, izinkodze noma amalungelo okudlula endaweni. Lungisa amadokhumenti we-cadastral avunyiwe kanye nokuwabhalisa. Faka wonke amadokhumenti we-cadastral asanda kuvunywa kwindawo yokugcina. Khisho futhi unikeze amaphuzu we-cadastral etholakalayo. Buyisela kwindawo yokugcina amaphuzu we-cadastral abuyisiwe. Lungisa futhi ugcine amaphuzu we-cadastral esimeni esihle esingasetshenziswa. Yenza ukuhlola amadokhumenti we-cadastral ngokobuchwepheshe. Hlola ukubhaliswa kwakho konke okuthunyelwe okusanda kufakwa: Buyekeza amakhasi okuhlola ngokwenezela iphasela ngalinye le-cadastral elivunyiwe. Yenza ukuhlola ngokobuchwepheshe kwemiqulu kanye nezinhlelo zizonke. Yenza ukuhlola ngokobuchwepheshe okwamaphuzu ibalazwe. Yenza ukuhlola ngokobuchwepheshe okwezinhlelo ezibhekene namaphuzu. Yenza ukuhlola ngokubuchwepheshe okwezinhlelo ezingaba nokubhaliswa kwendawo ngqo. Nikeza ulwazi lwe-cadastral kumakhasimende angaphakathi nangaphandle: Nikeza idatha yebasoloji bezinkambu labaBasololi bezinkambu lapho kudingeka khona. Saza ulwazi lwe-cadastral kubantu njengokuthi kudingeka, ngokwe-hard copy noma endleleni yedijithali. Nikeza izithombe zomkhathi, izithombe ezilungiswe kabusha kanye namaphuzu avela eNGI ngokwezivumelwano ezibhalwe phansi. Bamba, gcina futhi ubuyekeze idatha yemikhawulo yasekhaya: Bamba amadokhumenti asanda kuthunyelwa ukuba uqinise ukuthi akukho ukugqamisa kwemikhawulo yasekhaya phambi kokuqinisekiswa. Engeza wonke amaphasela asanda kudalwa kwesethi yedatha yemikhawulo yasekhaya. Engeza idatha, buyekeza futhi ugcine isethi yedatha eqinisekile yolwazi lwe-cadastral, lokhu kubandakanya ukuvezwa nokubuyekezwa kwedatha eyisibalo samaMuhla. Skena bonke amadokhumenti we-cadastral lapho kuvunyelwa, kwehliswa, kufakwa phawu, noma lapho kuhoxiswa: Skena amadokhumenti we-cadastral asanda kuvunyelwa. Skena kabusha wonke amadokhumenti we-cadastral abuyekeziwe. Hlanganisa izithombe ezisandi kuskenwe kwidatha i-alpha numeric.

xh.title: I-ofisa leCadastre
xh.summary: Kufuneka i-Ofisa leCadastre ePietermaritzburg ukuqamba kunye noku-gcina i-data yolwabalazo lweCadastre, kufuneka sibe nesatifiketha seGrade 12 kunye neSatifikethi leSizwe kwi-Geomatics.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifiketha seGrade 12 kunye neSatifikethi leSizwe kwi-Geomatics okanye isatifiketha seSofisa soLwabalazo (NQF Level 5). Kuqikelelwa ukugqiba qho ukuzilolonga okumiseliweyo ukuze kugqitywe isigqeba esifunekayo sokugqiba. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Ukuziba ngekhompyutha. Ukuqonda i-data yespasiala. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yeziOfisi zoLwabalazo- jikelele. Amakhono ahambelana nomsebenzi: Ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Unxibelelwano oluhle (lwemilomo nolubhaliweyo). Isofthiwe yekhompyutha. Ikhono elihle lokuhlela.
xh.duties: Ukuqamba, ukugcina nokuhlaziya i-data alpha-numeric yayo yonke imibhalo yamakadastre: Qamba iinkcukacha alpha namanani kwimibhalo entsha yeCadastre ehanjisiweyo kwaye wenze ukuphonononga ngokuqinisekile kwemathematika kunye nokuqinisekisa i-data yamaphakeli amatsha omlibo. Hlaziya idatabase yolwabalazo leCadastre ngokongeza okanye ulungise yonke imbhalo evunyiweyo ukuze kugcinwe indawo yamakhobomane alpha-numeric yelekthronikhi. Qamba ukuqinisekisa imibhalo yamakadastre ebaliweyo. Ukugcina imibhalo yamakadastre ngokwemigaqo emisiweyo: Yenza ukususwa okanye ukurhoxiswa kwemibhalo yamakadastre. Susa, rhoxisa kwaye uqaphele imibhalo yamakadastre enamaphakeli abhalisiweyo omlibo, iikheyisi okuna iinkonzo zamanzi. Lungisa imibhalo yamakadastre evunyiweyo nesebhaliweyo. Faka yonke imibhalo yamakadastre entsha evunyiweyo kwindawo yogcino. Khupha kwaye uphumeze irekhedi zamakadastre. Phinda ufake iirekhedi zamakadastre ezibuyisiweyo. Lungisa kwaye ugcine iirekhedi zamakadastre zibe ngokwesimo esilungileyo esisebenzisekayo. Yenza ukuphonononga ngokobuchwepheshe kwemibhalo yamakadastre. Qinisekisa iindawo ezichaziweyo zokunikezelo okutsha okuhanjisiweyo: Hlaziya amaphepha okuphawula ngokongeza yonke ipakela yomhlaba omtsha weCadastre ovunyiweyo. Yenza ukuphononongo ngokobuchwepheshe kwemiyo yadayigraam kunye nezicwangciso jikelele. Yenza ukuphononongo ngokobuchwepheshe kwirekhedi yolwabalazo. Yenza ukuphononongo ngokobuchwepheshe kwizicwangciso zamaxabiso amacandwe. Nikeza iinkcukacha zamakadastre kubathengi bangaphakathi nangaphandle: Phumeza i-data yolwabalazo kooLwabalazi beMhlaba xa kufuneka. Saza iinkcukacha zamakadastre kwentengiselwano njengoko kufuneka, ngokwenkalo eqinileyo okanye ngokweefomathi zedijithali. Nikeza iifoto zasemoyeni, imifanekiso elungisiweyo namaphepha e-NGI ngokwemigqathana yamazinga enkonzo esayinwe. Qamba, gcina kwaye uhlaziye i-data yespasiala: Qamba imibhalo entsha ehanjisiweyo ukuze kqinisekiswe ukuba kukho naziphi na iindawo eziphathwayo zespasiala phambi kwemvume. Yongeza onke amaphakeli amatsha omlibo akhiweyo kwii-dataset zespasiala. Yongeza i-data, hlaziya kwaye ugcine i-dataset ethembekileyo yeenkcukacha zespasiala zamakadastre, kuquka ukongeza nokuhlaziya i-data yomlando. Skena yonke imibhalo yamakadastre ekuvunyweni, ekuhleni, ekuqapheleni, okanye esusweni: Skena imibhalo yamakadastre entsha evunyiweyo. Phinda uskene yonke imibhalo yamakadastre ehlaziyiweyo. af.title: Voorsieningskettingklerk
af.summary: Voorsieningskettingklerk word in Polokwane benodig om klerklike ondersteuning vir batebestuur te verskaf, batebeskikkings te handhaaf, en toedeling en beskikking van toerusting te hanteer.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat of 'n verwante ewekwaardige kwalifikasie. Werksverwante kennis: Basiese kennis van voorsieningskettingpligte, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, 'n rekenaar te bedien en statistieke te versamel. Basiese kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Basiese kennis van werkprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing. Werksverwante vaardighede: Beplanning en organisasie. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Tussenmenslike verhoudinge. Vermoë om in 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Verskaf klerklike ondersteuning vir batebestuur. Stel saam en handhaaf beskikkings (bv. batebeskikkings / databasisse). Kontroleer en reik meubels, toerusting en bybehore aan komponente en individue uit. Identifiseer oortollige, onbruikbare en verouderde toerusting vir beskikking. Verifieer bateregister. Verskaf klerklike ondersteuning vir aanvraag en verkryging. Werk die verskaffersdatabasis (insluitend kontrakteurs) by en handhaaf dit. Registreer verskaffers op LOGIS of 'n soortgelyke stelsel. Versoek en ontvang kwotasies. Lui spesifikasies op die elektroniese aankoopstelsel vas. Plaas bestellings. Reik boddokumente uit en ontvang dit. Verskaf sekretariële of logistieke ondersteuning gedurende die bodoorwegings- en kontrakproses. Stel konsepdokumente soos vereis saam. Verskaf logistieke ondersteuningsdienste. Plaas bestellings vir goedere. Ontvang en verifieer goedere van verskaffers. Lui goedere in beskikkingsdatabasisse vas. Ontvang versoeke vir goedere van eindgebruikers. Reik goedere aan eindgebruikers uit. Handhaaf goederebeskikking. Werk beskikking van verskaffers by en handhaaf dit.

zu.title: UmKhandi we-Supply Chain
zu.summary: Kudingeka uMkhandi we-Supply Chain ePolokwane ukuze anikeze inkongo emsebenzini wokuphathwa kwamasethi, agcine irekhodi lwamasethi, aphathe futhi ukuphiwa kwayo futhi akhishwe okungalidingeki.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe neGrade 12 Certificate noma izifundo ezilingana nalesi. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi olujwayelekile ngemisebenzi ye-supply chain, izindlela zayo kanye nokuqonda okokuthi ugcogce idatha, usebenzise ikhompyutha futhi uqoqe izibalo. Ulwazi olujwayelekile nokuqonda kwemithetho elawula inkonzo yomphakathi. Ulwazi olujwayelekile ngemisebenzi yansuku zonke endaweni yokusebenza. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuhlela futhi kuqhubeke. Ukuqonda ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe). Ukubambana nabantu. Ikhono lokusebenza ndawonye eqenjini.
zu.duties: Nika inkongo emsebenzini wokuphathwa kwamasethi. Qamba futhi ugcogce amarekhodi (isb. amarekhodi wamasethi / amadatabase). Hlola futhi uphe izinto zendlu, izisetshenziswa namakhono ezinye izinto kumagatsha kanye nabantu ngabanye. Hlola izinto ezingadingeki, ezingasebenzi futhi ezigugile ukuthi zingathunyelwa kanjani. Qinisekisa irekhodi lwamasethi. Nikezela ng inkongo ekudingweni nasekutholeni izinto. Buyela ulungise futhi ugcine idatabase yabanikeli (okuhlanganisa nabakhiwizayo). Bhalisa abanikeli ku-LOGIS noma enye inkanyiso efanayo. Cela futhi wamukele izinkomba zemali. Faka izinkomba ohlelweni lekhompyutha lokuthenga. Bekza imiyalo. Yeza futhi wamukele amadokhumenti e-bid. Nikezela ng inkongo yenhlaka noma yokuhamba emhlanganweni wezinkomba nasesiqhingini semivumelwano. Qamba amadokhumenti angadlulwa njengoko kudingeka. Nikezela ngamasevisi okuhamba. Bekza imiyalo yempahla. Yamukela futhi uqinisekise impahla evela kubanikeli. Faka impahla kwamarekhodi / amadatabase. Yamukela izicelo zempahla ezivela kubasebenzisi bayo. Uphe impahla abasebenzisi bayo. Gcina irekhodi yempahla. Buyela ulungise futhi ugcine irekhodi yabanikeli.

xh.title: Iklerk yeNkonzo yeSiseko seMithombo
xh.summary: Kufuneka iKlerk yeNkonzo yeSiseko seMithombo ePolokwane ukunika inkxaso yomsebenzi wolawulo lwamafutha, ukugcina iirekhodi zamafutha, nokujongana nokunikwa nokulahlwa kweq ukwenza imisebenzi yokulawula iirekhodi zamafutha, nokuphatha ukunikelwa nokulahlwa kwezixhobo ezisetyenziswa.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno eziphantsi: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe neSatifikethi seGrade 12 okanye isifanekiso esinxulumene neso. Ulwazi oluxhwele kumsebenzi: Ulwazi olusentsimbi ngemisebenzi yesiseko semithombo, iindlela zonxibelelwano nokuqonda njalo nokuba namandla okugcina ulwazi, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuthatha ulwazi lwezibalo. Ulwazi olusentsimbi nokulungelelanisa indlela esisetyenziswayo kumthetho weLungu loLawu olawula iNkonzo kaRhulumente. Ulwazi olusentsimbi ngeendlela zomsebenzi ngokollawulo lwendalo yokusebenza. Amakhono axhwele kumsebenzi: Ukuqamba ngokusetyenziswa nokuqamba. Ukusebenza ngokollawulo lwekhompyutha. Ukunxibelelwana (ngamagama nangokubhalwa). Izinto eziqondana nokuchuma phakathi kwabantu. Amandla okusebenza ngaphakathi kwethimba.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yomsebenzi wolawulo lwamafutha. Qamba kwaye ugcine iirekhodi (umzekelo iirekhodi zamafutha / amadatabase). Khangelo nikela iimpahla, izixhobo nezinto ezinxulumene nazo kumacandelo nabantu. Qonda izixhobo ezingasetyenziswayo, ezingasayi kusebenza nangaphezu kwexesha elidlulileyo ukulahlwa. Qinisekisa irekhodi yamafutha. Nika inkxaso yomsebenzi wokucesha nokuthengwa. Hlaziya kwaye ugcine idatabase yabathengisi (kuquka abathengisi ngqo). Bhalisa abathengisi kwi-LOGIS okanye inkqobo efanayo. Celwa kwaye wamkele iintsalela. Gcina ulwazi oluchaziwe kuyo nayipina na inkqubo yokuthenga. Faka iiodolo. Nikela kwaye wamkele amaxwebhu oku[-gqibela. Nika inkxabo okanye inkxaso yamagqibela ngexesha lequmbi lokunika amaxwebhu okuqwalasela kwaye ulandele iinkqubo zemigqabiso. The isishwankathelo samaxwebhu njengoko kufuneka. Nika inkxabo yamagqibela. Faka iiodolo ezimpahla. Wamkele kwaye qinisekisa izinto ezithengiswa. Gcina izinto kwi-database yamafutha. Wamkele isicelo sezinto kubasebenzisi bokuqhuba imisebenzi. Nikela izinto kubasebenzisi bokuqhuba imisebenzi. Gcina ukubhaliswa kwamafutha. Hlaziya kwaye ugcine ukubhaliswa kwabathengisi.

af.title: Rekokonstant
af.summary: Rekokonstant benodig in Polokwane om sentraalbedienings te bestuur, kliënte te ontvang en navrae te rig vir die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n NQF Level 4 of 5 of 'n relevante gelykwaardige kwalifikasiC besit. Werkverwante kennis: Microsoft Package. Werkverwante vaardighede: Telefoonetiket. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Tussenpersoonlike verhoudings. Sentraalbedienings. Vermoë om die dienslewering-komponente van die departement te leer. Vermoë om inisiatief te neem. Vermoë om onafhanklik te werk. Vermoë om werk te organiseer. Vermoë om werk te prioritiseer.
af.duties: Ontvang telefoonoproepe, boodskappe en stuur dit na die relevante rolspelers. Neem boodskappe wanneer nodig. Versprei boodskappe onmiddellik. Bedien alle kliënte en besoekers en verwys hulle onmiddellik na die relevante amptenare. Verwelkom, ontvang en verwys kliënte na die relevante eenhede. Hanteer alle kliëntnavrae. Verskaf basiese inligting aan kliënte oor die departement se diens wanneer nodig. Skakel met interne en eksterne personeel. Verskaf relevante inligting soos benodig. Bedryf die sentraalbediening deur inkomende en uitgaande oproepe te beantwoord. Hou 'n databasis van ander belangrike kontaknummers voortdurend aan. Rapporteer foute op die telefoonstelsel wanneer nodig. Gebruik die telefoonbestuurstelsel om telefoankoste voortdurend te monitor. Sif en stuur oproepe deur. Ontvang telefoonboodskappe. Bedryf kantoor-toerusting soos drukkers en fotokopieerders. Dateer interne telefoongids op wanneer nodig. Versprei interne telefoongids aan interne gebruikers wanneer nodig. Druk telefoankosteverslag vir elke ekstensie maandeliks. Onderhou telefoongids. Dateer telefoongids vir die amptenare op. Verwyder onaktiewe gebruikers uit die interne gids. Onderhou en beheer besoekersregister by ontvangs. Registreer besoeker.

zu.title: Umamukeli wesicelo
zu.summary: Kudingeka umamukeli wesicelo ePolokwane ukuphatha izindlela zokuqoqa kocingo, ukwamukela amakhasimodi, nokuhola imibuzo yeDepartment of Land Reform and Rural Development.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Abafakeli kumele babe nephepha lokugunyaza lesiginga 4 noma 5 noma izifundo ezifanayo ezehlukene. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: I-Microsoft Package. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Indlela yokuziphatha kocingo. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe). Izinhlobonhlobo zokuxhumana nabantu. Ukuphatha izindlela zokuqoqa kocingo. Ikhono lokufunda ngamalunga anikela ngesevisi womnyango. Ikhono lokuthatha isinyathelo. Ikhono lokusebenza nodwa. Ikhono lokuhlela umsebenzi. Ikhono lokubeka ngokubaluleka umsebenzi.
zu.duties: Amukela amacala ocingo, imilayezo uyiholele kubantu abahlobene nalawo. Bhalisa imilayezo ngenxa yisidingo. Yasiza imilayezo ngokushesha. Phathelana nabo bonke amakhasimodi nabavakashi baye kubasebenzi abahlobene nabo ngokushesha. Bamukele, wamukele uhole amakhasimodi emayunithi ahlobene nabo. Phathelana nayo yonke imibuzo yamakhasimodi. Nikeza ulwazi oluwumongo emakhasimodi mayelana nesevisi yomnyango ngenxa yisidingo. Xhumana nabasebenzi bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Nikeza ulwazi oluhlobene njengesidingo. Phatha isistimu yocingo ngokuphendula amacala angaphakathi nawangaphandle ngesikhathi. Gcina isisekelo sezimali zezinye izinamba zocingo eziyimfuneko ngokuqhubeka. Memela inkinga kwisistimu yocingo ngenxa yisidingo. Sebenzisa isistimu yokuphatha ucingo ukuze ubheke izindleko zocingo ngokuqhubeka. Hlola uhole amacala ocingo. Amukela imilayezo yocingo. Phatha izinto zofisi njengesishicileli kanye nezidwebi zokushicilela. Buyekeza uhlu lwangaphakathi lwocingo lwezinto ngenxa yisidingo. Sula uhlu lwangaphakathi lwocingo kubasebenzisi bangaphakathi ngenxa yisidingo. Shicilela umbiko wezindleko zocingo kwesinye isandiso nsuku zonke. Gcina uhlu lwocingo. Buyekeza uhlu lwocingo lube ngalabasebenzi. Susa abasebenzisi abangasebenzi ohlwini lwangaphakathi. Gcina ulawulo luhlu labavakashi kwisikhungo sokwamukela. Bhalisa umvakashi.

xh.title: Umamkeli weentlanganiso
xh.summary: Kufuneka umamkeli weentlanganiso ePolokwane ukulawla imisebenzi yebhodi yokutshintsha, ukwamkela abaxhasi, nokunqumla imibuzo kwiSebe loLwazi lweNdalo nasekuPhuhliseni amaphandle.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaka izicelo kufuneka babe neNQF Level 4 okanye 5 okanye izidanga ezilinganayo ezifanelekileyo. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Microsoft Package. Amakhono ahambelana nomsebenzi: Indlela yokuziphatha kumnxeba. Unxibelelwano (lwegama elithethwayo nolubhalwayo). Ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu. Imisebenzi yebhodi yokutshintsha. Amandla okufunda iinkcukacha zokuhanjiswa kweenkonzo zesebe. Amandla okuthatha inyathelo. Amandla okusebenza kodwa. Amandla okulungiselela umsebenzi. Amandla okubeka umsebenzi ngokubaluleka.
xh.duties: Wamkele iincoko zemnxeba, imiyalezo kanjalo uzinqumle kubathandi-nxaxheba abafanelekileyo. Uthathe imiyalezo xa kuyimfuneko. Yasaza imiyalezo ngokukhawuleza. Uphathe bonke abaxhasi nababakeli kubaphethe abafanelekileyo ngokukhawuleza. Wamkele, wamkele kanjalo unqumle abaxhasi kwiindawo ezifanelekileyo. Uphathe yonke imibuzo yabaxhasi. Unike abathengi ulwazi olusisiseko malunga neenkonzo zesebe xa kuyimfuneko. Unxibelelane nabasebenzi bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Unike ulwazi olufanelekileyo njengoko kuyimfuneko. Usebenzise ibhodi yokutshintsha ngokuphendula iincoko eziza naphandle nezithunyelwayo ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Ugcinwe idatabase yamanye amanani okunxibelelana abalulekileyo ngokoqhubekayo. Axelo ngempazamo kwindlela yomnxeba xa kuyimfuneko. Usebenzise inkqubo yolawulo lwemnxeba ukulola ixabiso lomnxeba ngokoqhubekayo. Uhlulele kanjalo udlule iincoko zemnxeba. Wamkele imiyalezo yomnxeba. Usebenzise izixhobo zeofisi ezinjengesiprinta naba-bala-khophi. Uhlaziye uqhagamshelo lwangaphakathi lomnxeba xa kuyimfuneko. Yasaza uqhagamshelo lwangaphakathi lomnxeba kubasebenzisi bangaphakathi xa kuyimfuneko. Asiprinte ingxelo yexabiso lomnxeba yalunye ungqamano nyanga nganye. Ugcine uqhagamshelo lomnxeba. Ukuguquguquka. Ukusebenza njengesiqhelo.

af.summary: Voorsieningskettingklerk by die KwaZulu Natal Aktesregister in Pietermaritzburg, wat klerklike ondersteuning vir batebestuur en aanvraag-en-verkryging bied.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat of 'n toepaslike gelykwaardige kwalifikasie hê. Werksverwante kennis: Basiese kennis van voorsieningskettingpligte, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, 'n rekenaar te bedryf en statistiek te versamel. Basiese kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Basiese kennis van werkprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing. Werksverwante vaardighede: Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Rekenaarvaardighede. Taal. Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike Kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaf klerklike ondersteuning vir batebestuur. Stel rekords op en onderhou dit. Kontroleer en reik meubels, toerusting en bybehore aan komponente en individue uit. Identifiseer oortollige, onbruikbare en verouderde toerusting vir wegdoening. Verifieer bateregister. Verskaf klerklike ondersteuning vir aanvraag en verkryging. Werk op en onderhou 'n verskaffer- (insluitend kontrakteurs) databasis. Registreer verskaffers op LOGIS of 'n soortgelyke stelsel. Versoek en ontvang kwotasies. Lui spesifikasies op die elektroniese aankoopstelsel vas. Plaas bestellings. Reik bieddokumente uit en ontvang dit. Ulwazi oluhambisana nomsebenzi: Ulwazi oluwumongo ezisebenzini zokusetyenzwa kwempahla, endleleni yokwenza kanye nokukwazi ukungenisa idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kanye nokuqoqa izibalo. Ulwazi oluwumongo kanye nokuqonda uhlelo loMthetho olulawula Izikhungo Zikahulumeni. Ulwazi oluwumongo lwezinqubo zomsebenzi ngokobume bomkhakha wokusebenza. Amakhono ahambisana nomsebenzi: Amakhono okuhlela nokuqamba izinhlelo. Amakhono ekompyutha. Ulimi. Amakhono amahle okuxoxa abhalwayo nokuqamba amagama.
zu.duties: Nikela ngokusekelwa okubhalwe ngako ekulawulweni kwempahla. Qamba futhi ulondoloze amarekhodi. Hlola futhi ukhuphe izinto zokuhlala, izinto zokusebenza kanye nezinye izimpahla ezixhunyiwe Kumagatsha nakuwo wonke umuntu. Chaza impahla engasetshenziswa, engasebenzi kakhulu naleyo edingekayo ukuyahlukaniswa. Qinisekisa ukuthi irekhodi lempahla ilungile. Nikela ngokusekelwa okubhalwe ngako ekufunweni nasekuthengweni kwempahla. Buyekeza futhi ulondoloze idathhebheji yabathengisi (okuhlanganisa nabakhiqizi bokwakha). Bhalisa abathengisi ku-LOGIS noma ohlelweni olufanayo. Cela futhi uthole izincazelo. Bhala izinkomba ohlelweni lokuthenga ngokugqamisa kwemiyalo. Yalela impahla. Nikela futhi uthole amadokhumenti okuthenga. Nikela ngokusekelwa ngemisebenzi yokuqamba amagama noma ngezokusetyenziswa ngesikhathi kucutshungulwa ukuthengwa futhi kuphethwe izinkontileka. Yenza imibhalo eminingi engaziwa nje ukuthi idingeka. Hlinzeka ngokusekelwa ngezokusetyenziswa. Yalela impahla. Yamukele futhi uqinisekise impahla evela kubathengisi. Faka impahla kumarekhodi. Yamukele izinto ezitholakala kubantu abathengisayo eminingi. Nikela izinto kubantu abathengisayo eminingi. Londoloza ukubhalwa kwempahla. Buyekeza futhi ulondoloze amarekhodi abathengisi.

xh.summary: UmLawuli we-Supply Chain e-KwaZulu Natal Deeds Registry e-Pietermaritzburg, onika inkxaso yemisebenzi yolawulo lweempahla noku funa noku thenga.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi se-Grade 12 okanye izifundo ezilinganayo ezifanelekileyo.
