Ulwazi olusiseko nokuqonda inguquko yemithetho elawula iNkonzo yaHulumende. Ulwazi olusiseko ngeendlela zomsebenzi malunga nendawo yomsebenzi. Amakhono ahambelana nomsebenzi: Amakhono okucwangcisa noku lungisa. Amakhono ekhompyutha. Ulwimi. Amakhono amabalise ahleliyo nabhalwayo.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yemisebenzi yolawulo lweempahla. Lungisa zigcine iirekhodi. Phinda uhlole uphume izinto ezifakelwa endlini, amacephu nezinxibelelanisi kwiziphakamiso nakuwo wonke umntu. Phawula izinto ezingasafanelekanga, ezingasasebenzanga nezingasikhoyo ezima ngokubuyiswa. Qinisekisa irekhodi yeempahla. Nika inkxaso yemisebenzi yokufuna noku thenga. Hlaziya zigcine isiseko sedata yabathengisi (kuquka nabaqhinga). Bhalisa abathengisi kwi-LOGIS okanye inkqubo efana nayo. Celwa wamkele iiquotations. Ngenisa iinkcazelo zenkqubo yokuthenga ngabakhompyutha. Faka iiodolo. Phinda wamkele amaxwebhu okuthengisa. Nika inkxaso yeseleteriat okanye yamagqabantshintshi ngelixa kuqwalaselwa iiodolo nangexesha lokugqiba iinkqubo zeenkontraxi. Hlenga amaxwebhu okudityaniswa njengoko kufuneka. Nika iinkonzo zenkxaso yamagqabantshintshi. Faka iiodolo zempahla. Wamkele uqinisekise impahla evela kubathengisi. Faka impahla kwiirekhodi zeedatha. Amkele izicelo zempahla ezivela kubasebenzisi bokuqhayiya. Phuma impahla kubasebenzisi bokuqhayiya. Gcina irekhodi yempahla. Hlaziya zigcine iirekhodi zabathengisi.

jobs.summary: Chief Registrar sought for the North West High Court in Mmabatho, requiring an LLB degree and eight years' post-qualification experience to manage court documentation and information systems.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of an LLB Degree or a four (4) year legal qualification as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of eight (8) years’ post qualification experience obtained as a Registrar. A valid driver’s license. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge of registry duties, knowledge of legislative framework governing the public service, knowledge of storage and retrieval procedures in terms of the working environment, knowledge of Quasi-Judicial, knowledge of Case flow management, knowledge of court documentation management and Human Management and Batho Pele Principles. Skilled in planning, organising numeracy, problem solving, decision making, computer literacy (MS Office), communication (written and verbal), people skills/interpersonal relations, report writing and interviewing skills.
jobs.duties: Manage the Information and case/court documentation Management System: Implement information desk in the court, develop and maintain a complaints management system, interface with external court stakeholders on a regular basis, ensure that the checking of relevant registers is done in terms of the codes. Provide support to court and case flow management / Quasi-Judicial functions: Develop & implement case management strategies, review and implement projects to improve court efficiency regularly, implement a case/ court documentation and information management system. Implement Service Level Agreements and Strategic Court projects: Ensure that all J33 requests to Service Providers are timeously returned, liaise with the service provider on a regular basis to ensure smooth service delivery, peruse proposed amendments received from the rules board and provide comments, if any to them. Provide leadership of the High Court: Develop annual institutional performance reports & other statutory reports, give direction and guidance to the court based on best court management practices and lead transformation in the High court. Supervise and develop staff: Ensure general supervision of employees, allocate duties and perform quality control on the work delivered by officials, manage leave of staff, advise and lead supervisees with regard to all aspects of the work, perform quality control on the work delivered by officials, manage leave of staff, advise and lead supervisees with regard to all aspects of the work.
jobs.enquiries: Technical Related Enquiries: Mr OPS Sebapatso Tel No: (018) 397 7004 HR Related Enquiries: Ms L Makula Tel No: (018) 397 7064

af.title: Hoofregistrauteur
af.summary: Hoofregistrauteur gesoek vir die North West High Court in Mmabatho, wat 'n LLB-graad en agt jaar se kwalifikasie-ervaring vereis om hofdokumentasie en inligtingstelsels te bestuur.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n LLB-graad of 'n vier (4) jaar regskwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken besit. 'n Minimum van agt (8) jaar se kwalifikasie-ervaring verkry as 'n Registrauteur. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van registratuurpligte, kennis van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die openbare diens regeer, kennis van berging en terugwinning prosedures binne die werksomgewing, kennis van Kwasigeregtelike funksies, kennis van Saakvloei-bestuur, kennis van hofdokumentasie-bestuur en Menslike Bestuur en Batho Pele-beginsels. Vaardig in beplanning, organisering, syfergeletterdheid, probleemoplossing, besluitneming, rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Office), kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings), mensevaardighede/interpersoonlike verhoudings, verslagskrywing en onderhoudvoeringsvaardighede.
af.duties: Bestuur die inligting- en saak-/hofdokumentasie-bestuurstelsel: Implementeer 'n inligtingstoonbank by die hof, ontwikkel en handhaaf 'n klagtebestuurstelsel, skakel gereeld met eksterne hofbelanghebbendes, verseker dat die nagaan van relevante registers gedoen word volgens die kodes. Verskaf ondersteuning aan hof- en saakvloei-bestuur / Kwasigeregtelike funksies: Ontwikkel en implementeer saakbestuurstrategieë, hersien en implementeer gereeld projekte om hofdoeltreffendheid te verbeter, implementeer 'n saak-/hofdokumentasie- en inligtingbestuurstelsel. Implementeer Diensvlakooreenkomste en Strategiese Hofprojekte: Verseker dat alle J33-versoeke aan Diensverskaffers betyds terugbesorg word, skakel gereeld met die diensverskaffer om gladde dienslewering te verseker, lees voorgestelde wysigings wat van die reëlsraad ontvang is en verskaf kommentaar, indien enige, aan hulle. Verskaf leierskap van die Hooggeregshof: Ontwikkel jaarlikse institusionele prestasieverslae en ander statutêre verslae, gee rigting en leiding aan die hof gebaseer op beste hofbestuurspraktyke en lei transformasie in die Hooggeregshof. Hou toesig oor en ontwikkel personeel: Verseker algemene toesig oor werknemers, wys pligte toe en voer gehaltebeheer uit op die werk wat deur amptenare gelewer word, bestuur verlof van personeel, adviseer en lei toesigtiges met betrekking tot alle aspekte van die werk, voer gehaltebeheer uit op die werk wat deur amptenare gelewer word, bestuur verlof van personeel, adviseer en lei toesigtiges met betrekking tot alle aspekte van die werk.

zu.title: Umhalalosi Omkhulu
zu.summary: Kufunwa umhalalosi omkhulu we North West High Court e Mmabatho, ofuna iziqu ze-LLB kanye namaju ejaha emumva kweziqu ayisikhombisa ukuze aphathe amadokhumenti enkantolo kanye namasistimu wolwazi.
zu.requirements: Abafakela izeluleko kufanele babe neziqu ze-LLB noma iziqu zomthetho ezisuka eminyakeni emine (4) njengoba zivunywe yi-SAQA. Okungenani amaju ejaha emumva kweziqu ayisikhombisa (8) atholwe njengoba engumhalalosi. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yesilulu-bhuku, ulwazi ngohlelo lomthetho oluphatha isevisi yomphakathi, ulwazi lwezinqubo zokugcina nokuveza ulwazi ngokohlelo lwendawo yokusebenza, ulwazi lwe-Quasi-Judicial, ulwazi lolawulo lokuhamba kwamacala, ulwazi lolawulo lwamadokhumenti enkantolo kanye noLawulo Babantu namaphasisidi we-Batho Pele. Ukuba nakhoni ekuhlelweni, ekuqotheni, ekubaleni izibalo, ekuxazululeni izinkinga, ekwenzeni izinqumo, ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha (MS Office), ekucochenzeni (okubhaliwe nokuKhulunywa), amakhono abantu/ubudlelwano nabantu, ukubhala imibiko namakhono okuphenya ngokuhlola.
zu.duties: Phatha i-Sistimu yoLawulo Lolwazi namadokhumenti amacala/enkantolo: Yize isikhashana solwazi enkantolo, yakhe uphathe isistimu yalolawulo lezikhala zomphakathi, xhumanisa nabalawuli bangaphandle benkantolo njalo, qiniseka ukuthi ukuhlola okufanelekile kwama-register kwenziwa ngokwegama. Nikeza ukwesekwa enkantolo nalawulo lokuhamba kwamacala / imisebenzi ye-Quasi-Judicial: Yakhe futhi usebenzise izinhlelo zolawulo lwamacala, buze futhi usebenzise izinhlela zokuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwenkantolo njalo, sebenzisa isistimu yalolawulo lwamacala/amadokhumenti enkantolo nolwazi. Hlela futhi usebenzise Izivumelwano zeNgaLesidinga namaPojekthi weNkantolo eziNgumgomo: Qiniseka ukuthi zonke izicelo ze-J33 kubanikezeli besevisi zibuyiswa ngesikhathi, xhumanisa nonikezeli besevisi njalo ukuze kuqiniseke ukulethwa kwezinsizakalo ngokusimama, funda ngokucophelela izinguquko eziphakanyisiwe ezitholakale kubhodi lezinqumo futhi unikeze iziphawulo uma kukhona ezo. Nikeza ubuholo be-High Court: Yakhe imibiko yeminyaka yonke yokusebenza kwenhlangano namanye emibiko esemthethweni, inikeza isiqondiso nesinqondiso enkantolo ngokuncika ezindleleni ezilokhu zisetshenziswa ukuphatha inkantolo ezinhle futhi uholele inguquko enkantolo enkulu. Qaphela futhi athuthukise izisebenzi: Qiniseka ngokuqaphela okuvamile izisebenzi, yaba imisebenzi futhi wenze ukulawula ukugqama emsebenzini ohanjiswa abasebenzi, phathe ilashi yezisebenzi, welule futhi uholele ababhalisiwe mayelana nazo zonke iziqondiso zomsebenzi, wenza ukulawula ukugqama emsebenzini ohanjiswa abasebenzi, phathe ilashi yezisebenzi, welule futhi uholele ababhalisiwe mayelana nazo zonke iziqondiso zomsebenzi.

xh.title: Noxumba weNgcinee
xh.summary: Kufunwa Noxumba weNgcinee we North West High Court e Mmabatho, ofuna izidanga ze-LLB namava eminyaka yam-8 emva kwezidanga ukulawula uxwebhu olusebenzayo lwengxiwa kunye nendlela yeenkqaba zolwazi.
xh.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufuneka babe ne-Degree ye-LLB okanye isidanga sezomthetho samnye unyaka (4) njengoko samkelwa yi-SAQA. Amava amancinci ngeminyaka yam-8 emva kwezidanga afunyenwe njengomgcini wesikhewu. Ilayisensi yokushaya ibhasi elisebenzayo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yokubhalisa, ulwazi ngesakhelo somthetho esilawula inkonzo kahulu, ulwazi ngemigaqo yokugcina nokuvezwa ngokwemiba yokusebenza, ulwazi nge-Quasi-Judicial, ulwazi ngolawulo lwendlela yokuhamba kwezityholo, ulwazi ngolawulo lwexwebhu lengxiwa nokuLawula Abantu kwaye neenkqubo ze-Batho Pele. Ukwazi ukucwangcisa, ukulungisa izibalo, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukwenza izigqibo, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Office), ukunxibelela (ngokubhalwa nangokuthethwa), amakhono abantu/ubudlelwane namanye abantu, ukubala iingxelo namakhono okuphendula imibuzo.
xh.duties: Lawula inkqabo yoLawulo lweNkukhacha naxwebhu lengxiwa: Qhoboshela ideski yolwazi kwingxiwa, yakha ulondolaze inkqabo yolawulo lwezingxaki, unxibelele ngokuhamba kwexesha namajoni abangenayo kwinguquko lengxiwa, qinisekisa ukuba ukuhlolwa kwezibhalo ezithintekayo kwenziwe ngokwemigaqo. Nikela inkxaso kwengxiwa nakuLawulo lwendlela yokuhamba kwezityholo / imisebenzi ye-Quasi-Judicial: Yakhe & qhoboshela iindlela zolawulo lwezityholo, hlola uze qhoboshela iiprojekthi ukuphucula ukusebenza kwengxiwa ngokuhamba kwexesha, qhoboshela inkqabo yolawulo lwezityholo/axwebhu lengxiwa nolwazi. Qhoboshela izivumelwano zeNqanaba loNkonzko kunye neeprojekthi ezibalulekileyo zengxiwa: Qinisekisa ukuba yonke imibuzo ye-J33 kwabahanisi besebenza ibuyiswa ngexesha, unxibelele ngokuhamba kwexesha nomhanisi wesebenzo ukuze uqinisekise ukuletkwa kwenkonzo ngokugqithileyo, hlola utshintsho olucetyisiweyo olufunyanwe kwibhodi yemigaqo unike iimvo, ukuba kukho na kubo. Nikela ubuntshatsheli kwi-High Court: Yakhe iingxelo zeminyaka yonke ezimalunga nokusebenza kwesikhungo & ezinye iingxelo ezithileyo, nike iindlela nokuqondisa ingxiwa ngokusekwe kwiziko elilo kulawulo olugqithisileyo lwezinto zangoxesha, wandule kwakhona uqonde iinguquko kwi-High Court. Lilise uncedise abantu: Qinisekisa ukulawulwa okubanzi basebenzi, waba imisebenzi uze wenze uqobo lwemigaqo kwimisebenzi ethunyelwe ngabasebenzi, lawule inkhalazo zabasebenzi, jengise uze khokele abo batyholwayo malunga nawo wonke amacala omsebenzi, wenze uqobo lwemigaqo kwimisebenzi ethunyelwe ngabasebenzi, lawule inkhalazo zabasebenzi, celisa uze khokhele abo bakulawulweni malunga nawo wonke amacala omsebenzi.

jobs.title: Principal Librarian
jobs.salary_text: R413 001 – R486 501 per annum (Level 08). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: Principal Librarian position at the Supreme Court of Appeal in Bloemfontein requiring a National Diploma in Library Science and two years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a National Diploma in Library Science, Information Science or equivalent qualification at NQF level six (6) with 360 credits as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of two (2) years’ relevant experience in library services. Experience in a legal/law library will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge of library and information science matters, library prescripts, legislation, procedures and processes, knowledge of online databases, understanding of information management and retrieval of information. Skilled in research and analytical skills, communication (written and verbal), computer literacy (MS Office), planning and organising, accuracy and attention to detail. Interpersonal skills; problems solving; report writing, ability to work under pressure and independently.
jobs.duties: Monitor the collection, cataloguing and publications of library materials within the court, identify and select the relevant material to be procured at the court library in accordance with library policies and guidelines; assess the relevance and currency of the library collection and make recommendations for additions, removals, or updates, organise and catalogue legal materials to ensure easy retrieval by legal professionals; apply appropriate classification systems and metadata to enhance the accessibility of the collection and barcoding of library material; monitor the usage of library information resources both hard copies and soft copies (online resources), monitor serial publications, receiving of amendments and updating of loose-leaf subscriptions and binders. Facilitate the submission of standing orders for the court, monitor the rendering of library and information services to judiciary, monitor circulation desk services and helpdesk roster, implement digital tools and technologies to enhance information retrieval processes, keep updated on emerging technologies relevant to legal research and library management and integrate into the library's operations, monitor the digital resources, including electronic databases, legal research tools, and online subscriptions, facilitate interlibrary loans to ensure access to materials not available within the court's own collection, monitor the circulation of delivered judgments in both PDF and Word version to publishers and external stakeholders on request, ensure the circulation of finalised judgments of interest to other judges; provide reference assistance and library awareness within the court, provide reference assistance to judges, lawyers, court staff, and the public, provide support with legal research, citation verification and locating relevant legal precedents, conduct training sessions for legal professionals on effective legal research methods and the use of legal databases, keep legal professionals informed about recent developments in the law through newsletters, alerts, and other current awareness services, advocate for the importance of the library within the court system and promote awareness of its resources and services. Coordinate and monitor effective library administration, coordinate library services staff meetings, provide support in the coordination of Library Committee meetings, provide support in the facilitation of online trainings by Juta, LexisNexis and Sabinet for judges, judges’ secretaries, registrars and law researchers, monitor quarterly budget allocations for the library; coordinate and monitor the procurement process with supply chain management for new purchases, monitor internal asset verification schedule and assets register, coordinate and monitor the disposal of approved library publications for donations. Supervision of staff.

af.title: Hoofbibliotekaris
af.summary: Hoofbibliotekaris-pos by die Supreme Court of Appeal in Bloemfontein wat 'n Nasionale Diploma in Biblioteekkunde en twee jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet oor 'n Nasionale Diploma in Biblioteekkunde, Inligtingskunde of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak ses (6) met 360 krediete soos deur SAQA erken beskik. 'n Minimum van twee (2) jaar se relevante ervaring in biblioteekdienste. Ervaring in 'n regsbiblioteek sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van biblioteek- en inligtingskwessies, biblioteekvoorskifte, wetgewing, prosedures en prosesse, kennis van aanlyndatabasisse, begrip van inligtingsbestuur en die ontsluiting van inligting. Vaardig in navorsing en analitiese vaardighede, kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings), rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Office), beplanning en organisering, akkuraatheid en aandag aan besonderhede. Interpersoonlike vaardighede; probleemoplossing; verslagskrywing, vermoë om onder druk en onafhanklik te werk.
af.duties: Monitor die versameling, katalogisering en publikasies van biblioteekmateriaal binne die hof, identifiseer en selekteer die relevante materiaal wat vir die hofbiblioteek verkry moet word in ooreenstemming met biblioteekbeleide en -riglyne; assesseer die relevansie en huidigheid van die biblioteekversameling en doen aanbevelings vir byvoegings, verwyderings of opdaterings; organiseer en katalogiseer regs materiaal om maklike ontsluiting deur regsprofessionele mense te verseker; pas toepaslike klassifikasiestelsels en metadata toe om die toeganklikheid van die versameling en die strepieskodering van biblioteekmateriaal te verbeter; monitor die gebruik van biblioteekinligtingsbronne, beide hardkopieë en sagtekopieë (aanlynbronne), monitor reekspublikasies, ontvangs van wysigings en opdatering van losblaad-abonnemente en binders. Fasiliteer die indiening van staande bestellings vir die hof, monitor die lewer van biblioteek- en inligtingsdienste aan die regbank, monitor sirkulasietoonbankdienste en helpdesk-rooster, implementeer digitale nutsprogramme en tegnologie om inligtingsontsluitingsprosesse te verbeter, bly op hoogte van nuwe tegnologieë wat vir regsnavorsing en biblioteekbestuur relevant is en integreer dit in die biblioteek se bedrywighede, monitor die digitale bronne, insluitend elektroniese databasisse, regsnavorsingsinstrumente en aanlyn-abonnemente, fasiliteer interbiblioteeklenings om toegang tot materiaal wat nie binne die hof se eie versameling beskikbaar is te verseker, monitor die sirkulasie van afgelewerde vonnisse in beide PDF- en Word-weergawe na uitgewers en eksterne belanghebbendes op versoek, verseker die sirkulasie van gefinaliseerde vonnisse van belang na ander regters; verskaf verwysings bystand en biblioteekbewustheid binne die hof, verskaf verwysingsbystand aan regters, prokureurs, hofpersoneel en die publiek, verskaf ondersteuning met regsnavorsing, sitaatverifikasie en die opspoor van tersaaklike regsprecedente, hou opleidingsessies vir regsprofessionele mense oor doeltreffende regsnavorsingsmetodes en die gebruik van regsdatabasisse, hou regsprofessionele mense ingelig oor onlangse ontwikkelinge in die regte deur nuusbriewe, waarskuwings en ander huidige bewustheidsdienste, bevorder die belangrikheid van die biblioteek binne die hofstelsel en skep bewustheid van sy bronne en dienste. Koördineer en monitor doeltreffende biblioteekadministrasie, koördineer biblioteekdienste-personeelvergaderings, verskaf ondersteuning in die koördinering van Biblioteekkomitee-vergaderings, verskaf ondersteuning in die fasilitering van aanlynopleiding deur Juta, LexisNexis en Sabinet vir regters, regters se sekretarisse, registrateurs en regsnavorsers, monitor kwartaallikse begrotingstoekennings vir die biblioteek; koördineer en monitor die verkrygingsproses met die verskakkettingbestuur vir nuwe aankope, monitor interne bateverifikasietydskedule en bateregister, koördineer en monitor die wegdoening van goedgekeurde biblioteekpublikasies vir skenkings. Toesig oor personeel.

zu.title: UmMnikathi Wedhive Lebhalo
zu.summary: Isikhundla somMnikathi Wedhive Lebhalo eNkantolo Ephakeme Yokuqula eBloemfontein esidinga iDiploma Yezwe ekwizeni lenzululwazi wedhive, kanye neminyaka emibili yothando.
zu.requirements: Abafaki isicelo kufanele babe neDiploma Yezwe kwiNzululwazi yeDhive, iNzululwazi Lolwazi noma iziqu ezilinganayo kumazinga enNQF kwesithupha (6) ezinamaphuzu angama-360 njengoba kunconyiwe i-SAQA. Okungenani amabelanga amabili (2) eminyaka yothando oluhambisana nemisebenzi yedhive lemibhalo. Uthando olwenziwe edhive lemibhalo yomthetho kuzoba yinzuzo eyongeziwe. Ulwazi namakhono: Ukuba nolwazi ngemibandela yenzululwazi wedhive nolwazi, imiyalo yedhive, umthetho, izinqubo nezinhlaka, ulwazi ngamadhejibhesi e-inthanethi, ukuqonda ukuphathwa kolwazi nokulanda kolwazi. Ukube nokwazi ukucinga nokuhlaziya, ukuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokuKhulunywa), ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Office), ukuhlela nokuhlela, ukunembile kunye nokuqasha ukunaka. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu; ukuxazulula izinkinga; ukubhala imibiko, ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwezingcindezi nokusebenza uzimele.
zu.duties: Qaphela ukuqoqwa, ukuhlolwa nokushicilelwa kwemibhalo yedhive ngaphakathi kwenkantolo, tshula futhi khetha imibhalo ephathelene nokuthengwa edhive lenkantolo ngokuhambisana nenqubomgomo nomila wedhive; hlola ukuthi kufanele kanjani futhi kusha kanjani ukuqoqwa kwedhive futhi nike izinkombandlela zokwengezwa, ukususwa, noma ukubuyekezwa, hlela futhi hlolela imibhalo yomthetho ukuze kube lula ukulanda kubachibi bomthetho; faka izinhlelo zokuhlola uhlobo nemethadetha ukuthuthukisa ukufinyelela esiqoqwini nokubhaqabhqa kwemibhalo yedhive; qaphela ukusetshenziswa kolwazi lwedhive, kokubili okushicilelwe futhi okuguqulelwe kwamakhompyutha (olwazi olusesikhundweni se-inthanethi), qaphela okushicilelwa ngamuhla, ukwamukela izinguquko kanye nokubuyekeza kokubhalwa kwamagama kanye nezibhengezela ezixubile. Facilitate ukudlulula imiyalo ezimele yenkantolo, qaphela ukunikezelwa kwemisebenzi yedhive nolwazi abahluleka, qaphela izinkonzo zedeski yokugejiswa kanye neRosta yedeski yokweseka, faka amathuluzi nobuchwepheshe bedijithi ukuthuthukisa izingqibo zokulanda ulwazi, zigcine usazi ngobuchwepheshe obusha obuhlobene nokuqoqweba komthetho nokuphathwa kwedhive futhi zifake emsebenzini wedhive, qaphela ulwazi olwedijithi, okuhlanganisa namadhejibhesi amkhompyutha, amathuluzi okucwaninga umthetho, kanye nezibhalo ezisesikhundweni se-inthanethi, facilitata izimali mboleko phakathi kwamadhive ukuze kubone kunikelwa ukufinyelela kwemibhalo ongayitholi enkantolo, qaphela ukugejiswa kwemibhalo yesigqibo kubashicileli nabantu abangaphandle esebenza nabo mayelana neziqu eziguqulelwe kwi-PDF kanye nesiLayentsi seBhalo uma kucelwa, qinisekisa ukugejiswa kwemibalo esiphothule abajaji abanomdlandla; nikeza usizo olusesikhundleni sokubonisa futhi ulwazi lwedhive enkantolo, nikeza usizo abajaji, oshodi bomthetho, abasebenzi benkantolo, noluntu, nikeza usizo ekucwaningeni umthetho, ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkomba nokuthola izibonelo zomthetho eziyisiseko, benza izikhathi zokuqeqesha abachibi bomthetho ngemisebenzi ephumelelayo yokucwaninga umthetho kanye nokusebenzisa amadhejibhesi omthetho, gcina abachibi bomthetho bet ukwaziswa ngeminyakazso yamuva emthethweni ngezindaba eziguqulayo, ukulumkisa, nezenzinye izinkonzi zokwaziswa kwesikhathi samanje, xubushela ngobuyingozi bedhive enkantolo yomthetho futhi ukuthuthukisa ukwaziswa kominikelo wayo nenzuzo. Hlela futhi qaphela ngempumelelo ukuphathwa kwedhive, hlela izinkonzo zedhive imihlangano yezemisebenzi yabantu, nikeza usizo ekuhlelweni kweNkomfa yethiyemu ledhive, nikeza usizo ekuHleleni kokuqeqeshwa ngesikhathi esibhalwe ngocwaningo, abajaji, ababambi bakhulu behova nabacwaningi bomthetho bathola usizo ekucwadweni nge-inthanethi abakwezeNgqikwazi, abamandi bahova, abakwa-Juta, LexisNexis kanye ne-Sabinet bathola usizo ekuphatheni imali, iphathi inani lamabhajethi ahole esikhatheni kwedhive; hlela futhi qaphela inqubo yokuthengwa nezinhlangana zokuqoqwa ngokusha ukuthengwa, qaphela isibalo sokuqinisekiswa kwempahla yangaphakathi futhi ugcine irekhodi lempahla, hlela futhi qaphela ukulahlwa kwemibhalo edhive eminyanywe ngokusetshenziswa izimali mayelana namagalelo. Ukuqondaniswa kwabasebenzi.

xh.title: Umthathi weNcwadi oMkhulu
xh.summary: Isithuba somThathi weNcwadi oMkhulu eNkantolo ePhakamileyo yoNgeniso eBloemfontein esifuna iQelikhshe yeNqanaba leSizwe kwiZinceba zeNcwadi kunye neminyaka emi-2 yamava.
xh.requirements: Abafakeli kufuneka babe nesiQinisekiso seDiploma yeSizwe kwiZinceba zeNcwadi, iZinceba zeCol Jongolwazi okanye isiqu esilinganayo kwinqanaba leNQF lesithandathu (6) ngeqhalothi ezili-360 njengokuvunywa yiSAQA. Amava abuncinane eminyaka emi (2) ehambelana nezinkonzo zethala leencwadi. Amava kwithala leencwadi lezomthetho kuya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemiba ezincwadi zethala leencwadi nolwazi ngenjongo yolwazi, imigaqo yethala leencwadi, umthetho, iinkqubo neenkqubo ezilandelayo, ulwazi ngeedathabheisi ezikwi-intanethi, ukuqonda ulawulo lolwazi nokuvela kolwazi. Unobuchule ekuphandeni nasekuhlalutyeni, ekuxelelweni (elokubhalwayo nolokuTHethwayo), ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha (iMS Office), ekuqweneni nokuqamba, ekuchanekeni nokuqwalasela iinkcukacha. Amakhona okubonisana nabantu; ukusombulula iingxaki; ukubala ingxelo, ikhono lokusebenza ngocango nangokuzimeleyo.
xh.duties: Qwalasela ukuqokelelwa, ukuhlelwa kokusingathwa nokushicilelwa kwezinto zethala leencwadi ngaphakathi kwenkantolo, qamba kwaye ukhethe izinto ezihambelana nezo kuthengelwa kuthala leencwadi lenkantolo ngokwemigaqo neenkcukacha zethala leencwadi; qwalasela ukuhambelana nokusebenza kokuqokelelwa kwethala leencwadi uze wenze izindululo zokongeza, ukususa, okanye ukuhlaziya, hlela uze ucange izinto zomthetho ukuze kuqondwe kalula ngamagqabi ezomthetho; sebenzisa iinkqubo zokwahlula nokugquma iinkcukacha ukuze kube lula ukufikelela kwokuqokelelwa kwezinto nokubeka ikhowudi kwizinto zethala leencwadi; qwalasela ukusetyenziswa kothotho lwamagqabi kwinkonzo yolwazi ngokubhalwe nangokubhalwe ngokuqhagrwa (amagqabi e-intanethi), qwalasela ukushicilelwa kothotho olulandelelanayo, ukwamkela okuqhagqmbelwe nokuhlaziya okubhalwayo okulandelelanayo neqoqo lezinto. Yenza izicelo ezizinzileyo zenkantolo zingenise, qwalasela ukunikwa kwethala leencwadi nolwazi njengenkonzo kumajaji, qwalasela iinkonzo ze-desk yokujikeleza kwamaxwebhu kwaye ulawule uluhlu lwabakho apho kusetyenziswa iinkonzo ze-helpdesk, sebenzisa izixhobo nobuchule obuseskrinini ukuphucula iinkqubo zokuvela kolwazi, hlala uhleli kolwazi ngobuchule obutsha obuhambelana nophando lomthetho nolawulo lwethala leencwadi uze ulifake kumasebe othala leencwadi, qwalasela izixhobo ezigqitywe kwiskrini, kuquka iidathabheisi ezikwishishini, izixhobo zophando lomthetho, kunye nokubhaliswa ngokuqhagrwa, yenza ukuboleka kothotho phakathi kwamathala eencwadi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufikelela kwezinto ezingekho kuthotho olwenkantolo, qwalasela ukuhamba-hamba kwezigqibo ezigqityiweyo ezikwakho nangoluvo lwe-PDF nakwele-Word kwabashicileli kunye nabantu abangenanga ekuqwalaselweni kwabo, qinisekisa ukuhamba kwamagqibo ezigqityiweyo ahambelana namajaji amanye abangengoqagqiswa; nikeza ncedo lokubhekisa nolwazi ngeenthala leencwadi ngaphakathi kwesikhululo senkantolo, nikeza abajaji ncedo lokubhekisa, abamela amagqabi, abasebenzi benkantolo nakwixhalaba, nikeza inkxaso ngophando lomthetho, ukuqinisekiswa kwezamagama nokufumana izigqibo ezingaphambili ezihambelana nomthetho, yama iinkqubo zokuqeqesha amalungu azomthetho ngeendlela zokuphanda ngokuchanekileyo ezomthetho nendlela yokusebenzisa iidathabheisi zomthetho,gcina amalungu azomthetho ezindabeni zamva nje ngomthetho ngeendaba, iindaba ezikhawulezayo, nakwezinye iinkonzo zangoku zolwazi, khankanya ubaluleko kwethala leencwadi ngaphakathi kwenkqubo yenkantolo uze ukhuthaze ukwaziswa kwezinto ngenkonzo yalo. Lawula uze uqwalasele ukulawulwa okusebenzayo kwethala leencwadi, lawula iindibano zabasebenzi benkonzo yethala leencwadi, nikeza inkxaso ekulawuleni iindibano zoQela loBulawu beNcwadi, nikeza inkxaso ekulawuleni iindlela zokuqeqesha ezingakwi-intanethi ngeJuta, iLexisNexis kunye neSabinet ukwenzela abajaji, oonozini bebajaji, ababhalisi kunye nabo baphando bomthetho, qwalasela ukwabiwa kwekadali yexesha lonyaka kwethala leencwadi; lawula uze uqwalasele inkqubo yokuthengwa ngeentlawulo zeshishini kuloNyiso oluBambe lungangeni nje kwabasha bakuqhelanayo, qwalasela ishedyuli yokuhoywa ngaphakathi kweempahada kunye nokubhalwa kweepahada, lawula uze uqwalasele ukugutywa kwemizekelo yezinto zemveliso ezamkelekileyo ethala leencwadi ngezipo. Ukulawula abasebenzi.

jobs.title: Junior Systems Tester
jobs.salary_text: R413 001 – R486 501 per annum (Level 08). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement
jobs.summary: The Office of the Chief Justice seeks a Junior Systems Tester in Midrand to support software testing activities, defect measurement and quality management.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a National Diploma in Information Technology/ Computer Science/ relevant equivalent qualification at NQF level six (6) as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of two (2) years’ experience in the relevant field. A valid driver’s license will serve as added advantage. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge and understanding of Programming, Quality Management, Software/Hardware Testing and Project management. knowledge of Corporate Governance of ICT Policy Framework, Test Methodologies in relation to the implementation of SDLC (Waterfall and Agile) Methodologies and Testing Techniques, Quality Management and Programming and Batho Pele Principles. Skilled in problem solving, analytical skills, communication, computer literacy, interpersonal skills, technical skills, planning and organising, project management, presentation, report writing and time management skills
jobs.duties: Collect the raw material: The total no. of defects (for a release/build/cycle), provide support in calculating the average no. of defects/Functional area, provide support in measuring percentage of an application’s code or functionalities that are tested by automated tests, provide support in measuring the efficiency of automated testing efforts in identifying defects and provide support in measuring performance that reflects how long it takes to run a complete suite of automated tests. Update list of testable requirements, perform test requirements using test actions, provide support in coordinating development of test cases, ensure correspondence between system requirements and test cases, provide support in maintaining test cases and test scripts. Test documentation, facilitate post deployment, verify post deployment results, provide support in performance monitoring across development cycles and analyse delays by tracking trends in team productivity. Determine non-conformances and performance quality management processes of systems, verify if the systems meet the requirements and function correctly, verify if data trends improve processes of product innovation and reduce costs and verify if software results assist management to make strategic decision. Identify and report potential issues that affect end-users, provide support in the analysis of software defects, escalate software defects to appropriate team members, provide support in performing continuous software testing integrates and verify if the system is functional.
jobs.enquiries: Technical Related Enquiries: Mr N Mngomezulu Tel No: (010) 493 2544 HR Related Enquiries: Mr K Mphela Tel No: (010) 493 2527
jobs.applications: Applications can be sent via email to 2026/152/OCJ@judiciary.org.za
jobs.notes: The Organisation will give preference to candidates in line with the Employment Equity goals. All applications must be submitted on a New Z83 form, which can be downloaded           on        internet       at       www.judiciary.org.za        / www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp or obtainable from any Public Service Department and should be accompanied by a recent comprehensive CV only; contactable referees (telephone numbers and email addresses must be indicated). Please send your documents in a PDF and put them in one folder. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Prior to appointment for SMS, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full     details    can      be      sourced       by     the     following    link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Each application form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialed on both pages by the applicant. The application must indicate the correct job title, the office where the position is advertised and the reference number as stated in the advert. Failure by the applicant to complete, sign and initial the application form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. Applications on the old Z83 will unfortunately not be considered. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation considered. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, financial checks, qualification verification, citizenship checks, social media, reference checks and employment verification). Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered during the selection process. All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointment. The Office the Chief Justice complies with the provisions of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA); Act No. 4 of 2013. We will use your personal information provided to us for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for. In the event that your application was unsuccessful, the Office of the Chief Justice will retain your personal information for internal audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide requested information will render your application null and void. The Office of the Chief Justice will safeguard the security and confidentiality of all information you shared during the recruitment process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Junior Stelseltoetser
af.summary: Die Kantoor van die Hoofregsaaksoffisier soek 'n Junior Stelseltoetser in Midrand om sagtewaretoetsaktiwiteite, foutevaluering en gehaltebestuur te ondersteun.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Nasionale Diploma in Inligtingstegnologie/ Rekenaarwetenskap/ relevante gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak ses (6) soos deur SAQA erken, hê. 'n Minimum van twee (2) jaar se ondervinding in die relevante veld. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis en begrip van Programmering, Kwaliteitsbestuur, Sagteware/Hardewaretoetsing en Projektbestuur. Kennis van Korporatiewe Bestuur van IKV-beleidraamwerk, Toetsmetodologieë in verband met die implementering van SDLC (Waterfall en Agile) Metodologieë en Toetstegnieke, Kwaliteitsbestuur en Programmering en Batho Pele-beginsels. Vaardig in probleemoplossing, analitiese vaardighede, kommunikasie, rekenaarvaardigheid, interpersoonlike vaardighede, tegniese vaardighede, beplanning en organisering, projektbestuur, aanbieding, verslagskrywing en tydbestuurvaardighede
af.duties: Versamel die roumateriaal: Die totale aantal foute (vir 'n vrystiging/bou/siklus), verskaf ondersteuning in die berekening van die gemiddelde aantal foute/funksionele area, verskaf ondersteuning in die meting van die persentasie van 'n toepassing se kode of funksionaliteite wat deur outomatiese toetse getoets word, verskaf ondersteuning in die meting van die doeltreffendheid van outomatiese toetspogings in die identifisering van foute en verskaf ondersteuning in die meting van prestasie wat weerspieël hoe lank dit neem om 'n volledige suite outomatiese toetse te laat loop. Werk die lys toetsbare vereistes byvoeg, voer toetsvereistes met behulp van toetsaksies uit, verskaf ondersteuning in die koördinering van die ontwikkeling van toetsgevalle, verseker ooreenstemming tussen stelselvereistes en toetsgevalle, verskaf ondersteuning in die instandhouding van toetsgevalle en toetsskripte. Toets dokumentasie, fasiliteer ontplooiing na afloop, verifieer ontplooiingsresultate na afloop, verskaf ondersteuning in prestasiemonitering oor ontwikkelingsiklusse en ontleed vertragings deur tendense in spanproduktiwiteit op te spoor. Bepaal nie-nakomings en prestasiekwaliteitsbestuursprosesse van stelsels, verifieer of die stelsels aan die vereistes voldoen en korrek funksioneer, verifieer of datatendense prosesse van produkinnovasie verbeter en koste verlaag en verifieer of sagteweresultate bestuur help om strategiese besluite te neem. Identifiseer en rapporteer potensiële probleme wat eindgebruikers raak, verskaf ondersteuning in die ontleding van sagtewarefoute, eskaleer sagtewarefoute na toepaslike spanlede, verskaf ondersteuning in die uitvoer van deurlopende sagtewaretoetsintegrasie en verifieer of die stelsel funksioneel is.

zu.title: I-Junior Systems Tester
zu.summary: I-Office of the Chief Justice ifuna i-Junior Systems Tester e-Midrand ukuze inikeze inkxaso ezinhlelweni zokuhlola amaphulongi, ukulinganiswa kweziphazamiso kanye nokuqinisekisa izinga lokuphathwa kwezinto.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nge-National Diploma e-Information Technology/ Computer Science/ noma izifundo ezifanayo ezilinganayo ezingeni le-NQF lesithupha (6) njengoba kuhlonzwa yi-SAQA. Ukuze ube nocingo olulodwa nangaphezulu (2) lweminyaka yokusebenza enkundleni. Isiqinisekiso esihamba phambili sokushayela kuzoba lusizo oluvelele. Ulwazi nezikhathi: Ulwazi nokuqonda kokulunga, ukuphathwa kokuqinisekisa izinga, ukuhlola izinhlelo/Izinsiza ezilula kanye nokuqulunqwa kwephrojekthi. Ulwazi mayelana ne-Corporate Governance of ICT Policy Framework, izindlela zokuqinisekisa ezihlobene nokusethwa kwezindlela ze-SDLC (Waterfall and Agile) kanye nobuchwepheshe bokuhola, ukuphathwa kokuqinisekisa izinga kanye nokuqamba izinhlelo kanye nemigomo ye-Batho Pele. Ukubekezela ekuxazululweni izinkinga, izikhathi zokuhlaziya, ukuxhumana, ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha, ukuxhumana nabantu, izikhathi zobuchwepheshe, ukuhlela futhi uhlele, ukuphathwa kweekhampa, ukuyalela imibhalo, ukubhala imibhalo nesikhathi sokuphathwa kwezinto
zu.duties: Qoqa izinto ezingezona ezilungile (iziphazamiso) ezingalungisiwe: Inani lilonke leziphazamiso (ze-release/build/cycle), nikeza inkxaso ekubaleni inani eliphakathi nendawo leziphazamiso ngamunye/Isikhungo Sokusebenza, nikeza inkxaso ekulinganiseni amaphesenti ekhodi yohlelo lokusebenza noma izindlela ezisebenza ezihlolwa ngemihlahlandlela yokuhlola esebenzisa ikhompuyutha ngokuzenzakalelayo, nikeza inkxaso ekulinganiseni ukusebenza kahle kwemihlahlandlela yokuhlola ngekhompuyutha ekutholeni iziphazamiso futhi nikeza inkxaso ekulinganiseni ukusebenza okubonisa ukuthi kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuqeda ukuhlola konke ngekhompuyutha ngokuzenzakalelayo. Buyeza uhlu lwezidingo ezihlolwayo,enza izidingo zokuhola kusetshenziswa izenzo zokuhola, nikeza inkxaso ekuhlelweni kokuthuthukiswa kwezinqumo zokuhola, qinisekisa ukuvumelana phakathi kwezidingo zesistimu nezinqumo zokuhola, nikeza inkxaso ekugcineni izinqumo zokuhola namaskripthi okuhola. Hlola imibhalo, sikisela ukuthunyelwa ngemva kokuqeda ukusebenza, qinisekisa imiphumela yokuthunyelwa ngemva kokuqeda ukusebenza, nikeza inkxaso ekuqapheleni ukusebenza phakathi kwamajubesi okuthuthukisa bese uhlaziya ukubambezeleka ngokuqapha izinguquko ekuqhubekeni kwethimba. Qedela ukubuyekeza izinkinga ezingahambisani nemigomo futhi wenze imigomo yokuqinisekisa izinga lokusebenza kwamaphulongi, qinisekisa ukuthi amaphulongi ahambisana nezidingo futhi asebenze kahle, qinisekisa ukuthi izinguquko zamaphulongi zithuthukisa izinqubo zokuqamba izinto ezintsha futhi zehlisa izindleko, qinisekisa ukuthi imiphumela yesistimu ilusizo abaphathi ekwenzeni izinqumo ezibalulekile. Thola bese ukubika izinkinga ezingase zibathinte abasebenzisi, nikeza inkxaso ekuhlaziyeni iziphazamiso zesistimu, dlulisa iziphazamiso zesistimu kwabasebenzi abafanele behthemba, nikeza inkxaso ekuhambeni phambili nokuhlolwa kwesistimu ukuze kuhlanganiswe bese kuqinisekiswa ukuthi isistimu isebenza kahle.

xh.title: Umvavvi ongazali wesixhobo sokusebenza
xh.summary: Iofisi yoMlawuli weeNkosi zobulungisa ifuna uMvavvi ongazali wesixhobo sokusebenza eMidrand ukuxhasa imisebenzi yokuvavwa kwesoftware, ukulinganisa iimpazamo nolawulo loluhlobo.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka abafaka izicelo babe neDiploma yaseSizwe kwiTekhnoloji yolwazi/ ISayensi yeKhompyutha/ ngesiqingatha esilinganayo esithintelekayo kwinqanaba le-NQF lesithandathu (6) njengokuqatshelwa yi-SAQA. Kufuneka abe noqoqosho lweminyaka elibini (2) ngaphambili kwinkundla ebalulekileyo. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni iya kuba yoncedo elongeziweyo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda kokulungiselela iinkqubo, uLawulo loLuhlobo, ukuVavwa kweSoftware/Hardware nokuLawulwa kwe Projekthi. Ulwazi lweNkqubo yeNguqulelo yeKhompyutha eLawulwa ngokusemthethweni (Corporate Governance of ICT Policy Framework), iindlela zokuVavwa mayela nanika izalathiso zokusebenzisa iindlela ze-SDLC (I-Waterfall ne-Agile) neendlela zoVavwo, uLawulo loLuhlobo nokuLungiselela iinkqubo kunye neenzelezo zeBatho Pele. Ukuziphatha ngamakhono okuxazulula iingxaki, amakhono anochazo, unxibelelwano, ulwazi olusebenzayo ngekhompyutha, amakhono okuhamba kakuhle nabantu, amakhono obuchwepheshe, ukuqamba kulungiselela nokuhlela, ulawulo lwaprojekthi, okubonakalisa, ukubhala iingxelo namakhono okulawula ixesha
xh.duties: Qokelela izinto ezingahlanjululwanga: Iyonke inani leempazamo (ngokwendalo/okwakhiweyo/ngokojesho), nikeza inkxaso ekubaleni inani eliphakathi lesisigaba/ endaweni esebenzayo, nikeza inkxaso ekulinganiseni amaphesenti ekhodi okanye izinto ezisebenzayo ezivavwa ngezivavvo ezenzelwe zonke, nikeza inkxaso ekulinganiseni isipho esilungileyo semizamo yokuvavwa ezenzelwe zonke ekubonakeni iimpazamo kwaye nikeza inkxaso ekulinganiseni ukusebenza okubonisa ixesha elithathwa ukuqhuba iqela elipheleleyo lezivavvo ezenzelwe zonke. Hlaziya uludwe lweemfuno ezivavwayo, phumeza iimfuno ezivavwayo kusetyenziswa iintshukumo zokuvavwa, nikeza inkxaso ekumanyanisweni koluhlaziyo lwezimeko zokuvavwa, qinisekisa uluhlelo phakathi kweemfuno zesixhobo sokusebenza nezimeko zokuvavwa, nikeza inkxaso ekugcineni izimeko zokuvavwa nemiqulu yokuvavwa. Vavwa ixwebhu, yenza okulungele ukuba kusetyenziswe emva kokubekwa esikhundleni, qinisekisa iziphumo zokubeka esikhundleni emva kokwenziwa, nikeza inkxaso ekumameni ukusebenza kuwo onke amajesho ahlaziwayo kwaye uhlaziye iingxaki ezibambelelayo ngokulandelana kwamathuba ekusebenzeni kw eqela. Qamba iingxaki ezingahambelaniyo neenqubo zolawulo loluhlobo lokusebenza kwesixhobo, qinisekisa ukuba izixhobo zihambelana neemfuno kwaye zisebenza ngokuchanekileyo, qinisekisa ukuba izinto ezibonakalayo ezihamba ngokwedlelana ziphucula iinkqubo zokuba sekwindalo entsha yemveliso kwaye zithsale ixabiso, qinisekisa ukuba iziphumo zesoftware zincebisa ulawulo ekwenzeni izigqibo ezibaluleleyo. Qonda kwaye uxele ngeengxaki ezinokubakhona ezichaphazela abasebenzisi ekugqibeleni, nikeza inkxaso ekunyangenzeni iimpazamo zesoftware, dlulisa iimpazamo zesoftware kwabasebenzi abafanelekileyo behlelo, nikeza inkxaso ekwenzeni ukuvavwa kusoftware ngokuchasene nexesha ukudibanisa kwaye qinisekisa ukuba isixhobo sisebenza.

jobs.title: Junior Functional Application Support
jobs.salary_text: R413 001 – R486 501 per annum (Level 08). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement
jobs.summary: Junior functional application support position at the Office of the Chief Justice in Midrand, providing second-line support, system testing and issue analysis.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a National Diploma in Information Technology/ Computer Science/ relevant equivalent qualification at NQF level six (6) as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of two (2) years’ experience in the relevant field. A valid driver’s license will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge and experience of systems maintenance and support, Software integration testing, system integration testing, user acceptance, Functional and non-functional specifications development, Testing and implementation of acceptance testing procedures, understanding of enterprise business systems, Software configuration/release principles, System implementation methodologies, customer relationship management, Business continuity, disaster recovery procedures and Knowledge of Batho Pele Principles. Skilled in Technical, problem solving, time management, communication, presentation, report Writing, project management, interpersonal skills, planning and organising skills.
jobs.duties: Provide second line support by solving operation incidents, conduct system testing in various environments, analyse functional application issues and make recommendations for potential enhancements, draft a detailed test plan before any enhancements are undertaken and provide feedback and progress on standing issues. Identify complex issues that require escalation to third line support, System/application performance and identify potential issues proactively, conduct system and user acceptance testing on various environments, contribute to the development and maintenance of technical and support documentation, provide support in the development of ICT technical and operational specifications for implementation. Conduct user access reviews. Provide user training and user access on applications, provide technical guidance to users on application features, functionality and basic troubleshooting steps, provide application updates and deployments for smooth transition and minimal disruption to users, administer and allocate roles and permissions and provide user training and user access on applications, contribute to the development and maintenance of technical and support documentation. Maintain accurate records in accordance with Departmental protocols. Monitor and follow up on the incident logged and liaise with end- users regarding incident logged, respond to user reported issues through various channels, provide support in implementing solutions based on documented procedures and knowledge base articles and configure audit roles and responsibilities when it is required.
jobs.enquiries: Technical Related Enquiries: Mr N Mngomezulu Tel No: (010) 493 2544 HR Related Enquiries: Mr K Mphela Tel No: (010) 493 2527
jobs.applications: Applications can be sent via email to 2026/153/OCJ@judiciary.org.za
jobs.notes: The Organisation will give preference to candidates in line with the Employment Equity goals. All applications must be submitted on a New Z83 form, which can be downloaded           on        internet       at       www.judiciary.org.za        / www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp or obtainable from any Public Service Department and should be accompanied by a recent comprehensive CV only; contactable referees (telephone numbers and email addresses must be indicated). Please send your documents in a PDF and put them in one folder. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Prior to appointment for SMS, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full     details    can      be      sourced       by     the     following    link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Each application form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialed on both pages by the applicant. The application must indicate the correct job title, the office where the position is advertised and the reference number as stated in the advert. Failure by the applicant to complete, sign and initial the application form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. Applications on the old Z83 will unfortunately not be considered. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation considered. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, financial checks, qualification verification, citizenship checks, social media, reference checks and employment verification). Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered during the selection process. All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointment. The Office the Chief Justice complies with the provisions of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA); Act No. 4 of 2013. We will use your personal information provided to us for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for. In the event that your application was unsuccessful, the Office of the Chief Justice will retain your personal information for internal audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide requested information will render your application null and void. The Office of the Chief Justice will safeguard the security and confidentiality of all information you shared during the recruitment process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Junior Funksionele Toepassingsondersteuning
af.summary: Junior funksionele toepassingsondersteuningspos by die Kantoor van die Hoofregter in Midrand, wat tweedelynsondersteuning, stelseltoetsing en probleemanalyse verskaf.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Nasionale Diploma in Inligtingstegnologie/ Rekenaarwetenskap/ relevante ewekwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak ses (6) soos deur SAQA erken word, hê. 'n Minimum van twee (2) jaar se ervaring in die relevante veld. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis en ervaring van stelselonderhoud en -ondersteuning, Sagteware-integrasietoetsing, stelselintegrasietoetsing, gebruikeracceptansie, Funksionele en nie-funksionele spesifikasie-ontwikkeling, Toetsing en implementering van acceptansietoetsingsprosedures, begrip van ondernemingsbesigheidstelsels, Sagtewarekonfigurasie/vrystellingsbeginsels, Stelselimplementeringsmetodes, kliënteverhoudingsbestuur, Besigheidskontinuïteit, rampherstelprosedures en Kennis van Batho Pele-beginsels. Vaardig in Tegniese, probleemoplossing, tydbestuur, kommunikasie, aanbieding, verslagskrywing, projekbestuur, interpersoonlike vaardighede, beplanning en organisasievaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaf tweedelynsondersteuning deur operasionele voorvalle op te los, voer stelseltoetsing in verskeie omgewings uit, analiseer funksionele toepassingsprobleme en maak aanbevelings vir potensiële verbeterings, opstel van 'n gedetailleerde toetsplan voordat enige verbeterings onderneem word en terugvoering en vordering oor staande probleme verskaf. Identifiseer komplekse probleme wat na derdelynsondersteuning ge-eskaleer moet word, Stelsel-/toepassingsprestasie en identifiseer potensiële probleme proaktief, voer stelsel- en gebruikeracceptansietoetsing op verskeie omgewings uit, dra by tot die ontwikkeling en onderhoud van tegniese en ondersteuningsdokumentasie, verskaf ondersteuning in die ontwikkeling van IKV-tegniese en operasionele spesifikasies vir implementering. Voer gebruikerstoegangshersienings uit. Verskaf gebruikersopleiding en gebruikerstoegang op toepassings, verskaf tegniese leiding aan gebruikers oor toepassingskenmerke, funksionaliteit en basiese probleemoplossingsstappe, verskaf toepassingsopdaterings en ontplooiings vir 'n gladde oorgang en minimale ontwrigting aan gebruikers, administreer en wys rolle en toestemmings toe en verskaf gebruikersopleiding en gebruikerstoegang op toepassings, dra by tot die ontwikkeling en onderhoud van tegniese en ondersteuningsdokumentasie. Onderhou akkurate rekords ooreenkomstig departementele protokolle. Monitor en volg die gelogde voorval op en skakel met eindgebruikers rakende gelogde voorvalle, reageer op deur gebruikers gerapporteerde probleme via verskeie kanale, verskaf ondersteuning in die implementering van oplossings gebaseer op gedokumenteerde prosedures en kennisbasisartikels en konfigureer ouditrolle en -verantwoordelikhede wanneer dit vereis word.

zu.title: Ukuxhaswa Okusezingeni Elingaphansi Kohlelo Lokusebenza Lwezomsebenzi
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuxhaswa okusezingeni elingaphansi kohlelo lokusebenza lwezomsebenzi ehhovisi likaNoMantsha weZezinhlalo eMidrand, esinikeza ukuxhaswa kwesigaba sesibili, ukuhlolwa kohlelo kanye nenhlaziyo yezinkinga.
zu.requirements: Abafaki izicelo kufanele babe nadiploma yezwe ekubhaleni ngobuchwepheshe lokwaziswa/Isayensi yamakhompyutha/izifundo ezidingekayo ezingabalingana nganoma yisiphi isinqumo esizingeni se-NQF level six (6) njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA. Kubalulekile ukuba nobuncwame obungaphezulu kweminyaka emibili (2) ubungcwazi egatshini elifanele. Ilayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile izokuba yithuba elengeziwe. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi nobungcwazi ekugcineni nasekuxhaseni izinhlelo, ukuhlolwa kokuhlanganiswa kwephrogra, ukuhlolwa kokuhlanganiswa kohlelo, ukwamukelwa komsebenzisi, ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqumo ezingezona zobuchwepheshe, ukuhlolwa nokuphathwa kwezinqumomprogra zokuqashwa nokwamukelwa, ukuqonda izinhlelo zezoshintsho zebhizinisi lezinkampani, izimiso zokuqasha/khulula iphrogra, izindlela zokuphatha imibhalo yokuqashwa kohlelo, ukuphathwa kwezomphakathi, ukuqhubeka kwebhizinisi, izinqumo zokubuyisela izinto ngemuva kwezinkinga nolwazi ngemiqondo yeBatho Pele. Unelwazi ekuxazululeni izinkinga, ekuphathweni isikhathi, ekuxhumana, emibhalweni, eziphoqelwa, ekubhaleni imibiko, ekuphathweni kwephrojekthi, ekuxhumaneni nabantu, ekwenza izinhlelo nokuqamba.
zu.duties: Nikela ngokuxhaswa kwesigaba sesibili ngokuxazulula izinkinga zokusebenza, yenza ukuhlolwa kohlelo kuzimo ezahlukene, hlaziya izinkinga zohlelo lokusebenza futhi unikeze izindulumiso ezingase zibe khona, bhala ipulani yokuhlola ngokucatshangwa kwako yonke into futhi unikeze imibiko futhi inkululeko kwezindlela zokuba khona izinkinga ezisezinkinobho khona manje. Hlola izinkinga ezibucayi ezidinga ukusatshaliswa kolwazi, ukuphathwa kohlelo/isicelo nokubonwa izinkinga ezizobe khona ngaphambi kwesikhathi, yenza ukuhlolwa kohlelo nokwamukelwa komsebenzisi kuzimo ezahlukene, geneza ekuthuthukisweni nokulondolozwa kwemibalo yobuchwepheshe nokuxhaswa, nikela ngokuxhasa ekuthuthukisweni kwemibalo yobuchwepheshe nezindlela zokusebenza ezingqangi. Hlola ukufinyelela komsebenzisi. Nikela ngokuqeqesha komsebenzisi kanye nokufinyelela kwabasebenzisi ezinhlelweni, nikeza inkombandlela yezobuchwepheshe kubasebenzisi ngamawindi ohlelo, ukusebenza kanye nenzuzo engavamile yezinyathelo zokulungisa, nikeza izibuyiselo nokuphathwa kwephrogra ngenhloso yoshintsho olushelelayo futhi kungabi nabaphazamisi abancane kubasebenzisi, lawula futhi wabe amagunya nemvume futhi nikeza ngokuqeqesha komsebenzisi kanye nokufinyelela ezinhlelweni, geneza ekuthuthukisweni nokulondolozweni kwemibalo yobuchwepheshe nokuxhaswa. Gcina ukuba bukhona ukubalwa kwezinto ngemvumelwano nemigomo yomnyango. Buka futhi ulandele ithuba lokubhalwa kwenkinga futhi uxhume nabasebenzisi bokugcina mayelana nenkinga ebhaliwe, phendula izinkinga ezibikwe umsebenzisi ngezindlela ezahlukene, nikeza ngokuxhasa ekuphathweni izixazululo ngokusekelwe emigomeni ebhaliwe nasemagatsheni obuhlakani, futhi uhlele amagunya nemithwalo yokuhlola uma kudingeka.

xh.title: Inkxaso yabasebenzi ejunyuni kwezicelo ezisebenzayo
xh.summary: Isithuba senkxaso yabasebenzi ejunyuni kwezicelo ezisebenzayo kwiOfisi yoMntu oMkhulu weZigqibo eMidrand, ebonelela ngenkxaso yesigaba sesibini, ukuhlolwa kweendlela nokwahlulwa phakathi kweziphaziso.
xh.requirements: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe nesidanga seNational Diploma kwi-Information Technology/ Computer Science/ nangaphezulu ekulinganayo kwendalo ethetha kakhulu kuma-NQF level six (6) njengoko kwamkelwa yi-SAQA. Kufuneka abe nembali yeminyaka eliqela (2) yamava kwinkalo ekhethekileyo. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba egunyazisiweyo iya kubakho njengentswelo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi namava okugcina nokuxhasa iindlela, ukuhlolwa kokudityaniswa kwe-software, ukuhlolwa kokudityaniswa kweendlela, ukwamkelwa ngabasebenzisi, ukuyila iinkcazelo ezisebenzayo nezingasebenziyo, ukuhlolwa nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa ukuhlolwa, ukuqonda iindlela zoshishino ezikhululekileyo, iinkqubo zokuhlela i-software/ezokuKhulula, iindlela zokusebenzisa iindlela, ulawulo lobudlelwane nabathengi, ukuqhutywa kolwakhiwo lwebhizinisi, iinkqubo zokusetyenziswa kwindlela yokuziphilisa ngexesha leengozi nolwazi ngeeBatho Pele Principles. Kubakhona ulwazi ngamandla obuchwepheshe, ukusombulula iingxaki, ulawulo lwexesha, unxibelelwano, okubonakalayo, ukubhala iingxelo, ulawulo lweenkqubo, amakhono onxibelelwano nabantu, ukucazulwa nokuhlelwa.
xh.duties: Bonezela inkxaso yesigaba sesibini ngokusombulula iingxaki zokusebenza, qhuba ukuhlolwa kweendlela kwindalo ezahlukeneyo, hlaluhlola iingxaki zezicelo ezisebenzayo wenze izindululo ezinokubakho ukuziphucula, qamba icebo elinezidadi zokuhlolwa phambi kokuba kwenziwe naziphi na iziphucula uze unike imbuyiso nenkqubela kumaphulo amile. Qaphela iingxaki ezinzima ezifuna ukunikezelwa kwenkxaso yesigaba sesithathu, ukusebenza kweendlela/izicelo ukuze uphawule iingxaki ezinokubakho ngaphambi kweixa, qhuba ukuhlolwa kweendlela nokwamkelwa ngabasebenzisi kwindalo ezahlukeneyo, yaphula inkxazo ekuyileni nasekugcineni iinkcazelo zobuchwephesha nenkxaso, bonezela inkxaso ekuyileni iinkcazelo zobuchwephesha nezeendlela zokusebenza ze-ICT eziza kusebenziswa. Qhuba ukuhlolwa kogqitho lwabasebenzisi. Bonezela uqeqesho lwabasebenzisi nangaphezulu kokufikelela ngabasebenzisi kwiinkqubo, nikeza iingcebiso zobuchwephesha kumasebenzisi ngeempawu nezicelo ezingundoqo zenkqubo namanyathelo okusombulula iingxaki, bonezela izihloko ezitsha kwezicelo nokuza kusebenza ngaphandle kokuvala iindlela nezicelo ukuze kubekho ukuhamba-hamba okukhululekileyo nokungabikho kokuphazamisa abasebenzisi, lawula kwakhona ulwabiwo lwamagama nemvume kwaye ubonezele uqeqesho ngabasebenzisi nokufikelela ngabasebenzisi kwiinkqubo, yaphula inkxazo ekuyileni nasekugcineni iinkcazelo zobuchwephesha nenkxazo. Gcina iirekhodi ezichanekileyo ngokwemigaqo yesebe. Lilindele kwaye ulandele iingxaki ezibhalisiweyo uze unxibelelane nabasebenzisi abaphelileyo ngeengxaki ezibhalisiweyo, phendula kumagcisa okuvela kubasebenzisi ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo, nikeza inkxazo ekusebenziseni izisombululo ezisekelwe kwiinkqubo ezibhaliweyo nakwiingxelo ezisekelwe kulwazi uze ucocise amagama nemithwalo yokuhlolwa xa kufuneka.
