af.requirements: 'n Aansoeker moet in besit wees van 'n Nasionale Diploma in IT/Sagtewareontwikkeling/ewekansige kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak ses (6) soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van twee (2) jaar se ervaring in die relevante veld. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis en vaardighede: Soliede kennis van programmeringstoepassings, ervaring (UX) en kliëntkanttegnologieë insluitend XML, HTML5, CSS, PHP, JQuery en JSON en mobiele raamwerke, kennis van programmeertaal en tegniese terminologie, kennis van Microsoft SharePoint-ontwikkeling, kennis en ervaring in Azure en CRM Dynamics, Web- en mobieltetegnologie-ervaring met User, kennis en begrip van C/C++, Visual, Basic, C#. Java, XML, Angular en enige BI-rapporteringsnutsprogram, lees en verstaan bestaande komplekse koderingstale en die beoogde funksionaliteit daarvan en toetsraamwerke vir API's. Vaardig in probleemoplossing, projekbestuur, kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings), Finansiële Bestuur, Strategiese vaardighede, analitiese vaardighede, verslagskryf, aanbieding, beplanning en organisering en rekenaargeletterdheid, (Word, PowerPoint & Excel).
af.duties: Ontwerp en ontwikkel tegniese spesifikasies vir enkele of veelvoudige sagteware, ontwerp, ontwikkel en pas sagtewareoplossings aan in ooreenstemming met die metode vir bestuur van die sagtwereontwikkelingslewensiklus, voer kodehertoetse uit, handhaaf IT-sagtewareoplossings sodra hulle in die produksie-omgewing is en rugsteun lêers vanaf die agterkant na plaaslike gids vir herstel. Ontwikkel toetsplan, toetsgevalle en kommunikasieplan, neem deel aan die User Acceptance Testing-proses, berei ontplooigids vir goedkeuring voor, rapporteer ontwikkelingsvordering, resultate en sleutelkeurlyne. Lewer gehalte-oplossings in ooreenstemming met die besigheidsgeval, evalueer kode om te verseker dat dit aan bedryfsstandaarde voldoen, pas sagtewareontwikkelingsbeginsels toe in alle ontwikkelde toepassings, verskaf gehalteversekeringsverslag aan alle relevante belanghebbendes en inisieer Change Management-prosedure om die ontwikkelde toepassing na produksie te ontplooi. Skep, handhaaf en hersien ontwikkelaarsdokumentasie, versprei kennis van bestaande funksionaliteit en nuwe funksionele vereistes. Redigeer, skryf, ontwerp toepassingsinhoud en stoor alle ontwikkelingskode in die toepaslike biblioteek.

zu.title: Umphuhlisi we-Junior Developer
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphuhlisi we-Junior Developer esikhundleni somphuhlisi esikhungweni sikaMongameli wokuGwinya e-Midrand, sidinga i-Diploma le-National Diploma ye-IT kanye neminyaka emibili yamakhono ahlobene nalesi sikhundla.
zu.requirements: Kufanele ube nelungelo le-Diploma le-National Diploma ku-IT/Software Development/efana nalolu noma oluqeqeshwe ku-NQF level six (6) njengoba kuqashwa yi-SAQA. Udinga okungenani okubili (2) iminyaka yamakhono ohla nolwazi ohlelo. Phambilini lwesiqu lesi sibopho sakho sesiGidi sokuhamba sizonikela ngezenzo ezizwakalayo nokuzola. Ulwazi, ezinye izikhathi kuhlakaniphwa kwezinto ezimbalwa zesicongo nokusetshenziswa nokugqamisa ikhodi kulezi zinto: kwi-XML, HTML5, CSS, PHP, JQuery, JSON kanye namakhulumi wezinhlaka ezisukiwe, kanye nelwazi eliqinisekileyo ngesiC, C++, Visual, Basic, C#, Java, XML, Angular naluphi na isixhobo sokubika i-BI, kuhlalwe kakuhle, kwakukhona ulwazi lokusesigabeni kwe-Microsoft SharePoint, kuhlalwa kakuhle, kanye nokuqonda ukuvalelisa amandla wezicelo zamakhadi we-Web nangamakhadi ekhompyutha, ngokumayelana ne-UX nakwindawo yamakhasimende, futhisekelwe ukulawulwa kwe-mibhalo yemali, amandla okuhlela, amandla okuhlaziya, ukuhlala kakuhle kwamanye amaxhulu, amandla okubhala, okubhala amaphepha, okulungiselela futhiokuqamba, kanye nokuqonda kakuhle i-Word, PowerPoint kanye ne-Excel.
zu.duties: Hlola futhiuthuthukise izinto ezithile zobuchwepheshe zamkhawulo wedatha elilodwa noma amaningi, hlela futhiuthuthukise futhiuzenzele izixazululo zekhompyutha ngokuvumelana nenqubo yokuphathwa kwesikhathi sempilo yophuhliso lwekhompyutha, thola inqubo yokuhlola ikhodi, gcina izixazululo zekhompyutha lapho zingatholakala ngaphakathi kwendawo yokukhiqiza futhigcine amafayela kusukela emuva kuya emaphathini endawo ukuze abuyiswe. Beselelisa ngehhovisi elisha iplani yokuhlolwa, amacala okuhlolwa futhi iplani yokuxhumana, ngena ohlelweni lwenqubo yokuvumelana nomsebenzisi, lungelelela isiqondiso sokuhumusha ukuvunyelwa, mexwaye ngokunqoba kwentuthuko, imiphumela futhi izinto ezibalulekile zokuilinganisa. Hambisa izixazululo eziyisibonakaliso ngezinye izikhathi ezingamakhono, ukuze kuhlolwe ukuthi ihlangabezana ngokwemigomo yonke imikhakha, futhi faka imigomo yophuhliso lwekhompyutha kuzo zonke izicelo ezithuthukisiwe, nikeza umbiko wokuqinisekisa isibonakaliso kubantu bonke abahlakaniphile futhiqale inqubo yokuphathwa koshintsho ukuthi uhlelo oluthuthukisiwe luthunyelwe emsebenzini. Dala, gcina futhibuyeke imibhalo yophuhliso, saka ulwazi ngemisebenzi ekhona nezidingo ezisha zemisebenzi. Hlela, bhala futhiklama umnxhwe wesicelo bese uvimba wonke amakodi wophuhliso kolabhulali efanele.

xh.title: Umphathi Ojongene Nophuhliso
xh.summary: Isithuba somPhathi Ojongene Nophuhliso kwi Ofisi yoMongameli weZigqibo e Midrand esifuna iDiploma yesiZwe kwi IT kunye neminyaka emi-2 yamava ahambelana nesenzo.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka umfaki-icebo abe nayo iDiploma yesiZwe kwi IT/Upuhliso lweSiftiwe/isigqibo esilinganayo kwinqanaba lesithandathu (6) le NQF njengoko sivunyiwe ngu SAQA. Kufuneka abe nobuganga obungalawanga kumyaka emi-2 (2) wamava kwindalo ephathwayo. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni iya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo. Ulwazi nobugangatho: Ulwazi olunzima lokuphuhlisa iinkqubo zekhompyutha, amava (UX) nobugangatho obusecaleni komthengi kuquka i XML, HTML5, CSS, PHP, JQuery ne JSON nakoopopusho lweselula, ulwazi lolwimi lokuphuhlisa iinkqubo nolwazi olubaliweyo ngeendlela zezobuchwepheshe, ulwazi lokuphuhlisa kwi Microsoft SharePoint, ulwazi namava kwi Azure ne CRM Dynamics, amava kwi Web nobugangatho beselula nomThengi, ulwazi nokuqonda i C/C++, Visual, Basic, C#. Java, XML, Angular nanayo iphi na isixhobo sokubika i BI, ukufunda nokuqonda iilwimi ezibucayi zekhowudi ezikhoyo ezikwimigaqo yayo ebalulekileyo neenkqubo zovavanyo lwe API. Ukhethelelekile ekuxazululeni iingxaki, ulawulo lweprojekthi, unxibelelwano (elubhalwe nolwethwe ngomlomo), uLawulo lweMali, amava amabali, ulwazi lokuhlola, ukubala amaxabiso nokubika, izipho esibonwayo, iplani nokuhlela nokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, (Word, PowerPoint & Excel,).
xh.duties: Yila kwaye uphuhlise iinkcazelo zobuchwepheshe zesiftiwe esimanye okanye esininzi, yila, phuhlisa kwaye ulungise iisolutions zesoftware ngokwemiqaqo yendlela yokuphuhlisa ibhalo loyilo ibhalo, qokelela kwaye uvavanye ikhowudi, gcina iisolutions zekhompyutha zesiya zisebenza kwindalo ekhoyo kwaye zigcine iifayile ezisemva ukuya kwiidata ezikwindawo yoqobo lwazo zibe zikulungele ukubuyiswa. Phuhlisa iplani yokuvavanya, iinkqubo ezivavanywayo neplani yokunxibelelana, thata inxaxheba kwindlela yokuvavanywa ngumThengi, lungiselela isikhokelo sokuzisa isixhobo esitsha kwinkqubo yamkelekileyo, chaza inkqubo yophuhliso, iziphumo namanani amabalulekile. Zisa iisolutions zoluhlobo lokulinga ngokwemiba yomthengi, qwalasa ikhowudi ukuqinisekisa ukuba ihambelana neemigaqo zendalo, sebenzisa imigaqo yophuhliso iinkqubo kuzo zonke iinkqubo ezikhoyo, nikeza ingxelo yoluhlobo lokulinga kubo bonke abantu abahambelana nesenzo kwaye qalise inkqubo yoLawulo lokuTshintsha ukuzisa inkqubo entsha esebenzayo kwinkqubo ekhoyo. Yila, gcina kwaye uqwalase amaxwebhu ophuhlisiweyo, saza ulwazi ngoluhlobo lokusebenza okukhoyo nokuqhutywa kuko. Hlela, bhala, yila okubhalwayo nokuqulethe iinkqubo kwaye ugcikele yonke ikhowudi yokuphuhlisa kwethala leefayili elifanelekileyo.

jobs.title: Senior Organisational Development Practitioner
jobs.salary_text: R413 001 – R486 501 per annum (Level 08). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement
jobs.summary: Senior Organisational Development Practitioner at the Office of the Chief Justice in Midrand, conducting work study investigations and developing post establishment structures.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a National Diploma in Management Services/ Operations Management/Production Management/ equivalent qualification at NQF level six (6) with 360 credits as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of two (2) years’ experience in the Organisational Development field. A valid driver’s license will serve as added advantage. Knowledge and skills: Good knowledge of organisational design, frameworks, practices, and processes in the Public service. Knowledge of Public Service Acts, Public Service Regulations, Operations Management Framework, OrgPlus, Organisational Design, process and work study techniques, Job Evaluation Processes and Batho Pele Principles. Skilled in Practical Knowledge of Computer, presentation, Report Writing and Project Management Skills.
jobs.duties: Conduct work study investigations, analyse information gathered during work investigations, conduct functional analysis and develop post establishment structure, cost structure in line with MTEF, compile work study report with relevant recommendations, communicate the outcome of reports to relevant stakeholders, maintain and update the organisational structure database. Develop/ review job descriptions for all posts in the department, conduct job analysis, conduct research/ benchmark on the latest trends within the ambit of OD, align coordinated job descriptions with the scope of the organization, facilitate the signing-off of the job description and develop/update the job description database. Compile acknowledgement letters for JE request, gather and analyse the relevant documents, conduct the job evaluation interview and capture information on JE system, provide secretariat support services to the Job Evaluation panel committee, communicate JE results to the relevant stakeholders, update the Job Evaluation database and attend to Job Evaluation related enquiries. Conduct analysis on the need for change management, participate in the development and implementation of Change Management Strategies, co-ordinate the implementation of Change Management processes, facilitate group sessions and discussions in workshops, serve as the change champion and report on progress of change management initiatives. Implement approved posts request in line with legislations on PERSAL (inclusive creation of posts) and on the organizational structure, advise all stakeholders on posts enquiries; coordinate amendments of post details on the system according to the structure and the staff establishment in consultation with PERSAL Controller, provide reports and data for completion of HRBP Tool and COE budget as well as expenditure. Ensure a proper filling system for all the records, keep an updated submission excel database, update the database, update the project dashboard and render secretarial services to the meetings within the unit.
jobs.enquiries: Technical Related Enquiries: Mr E Motsuenyane Tel No: (010) 493 2529 HR Related Enquiries: Mr K Mphela Tel No: (010) 493 2527
jobs.applications: Applications can be sent via email to 2026/155/OCJ@judiciary.org.za
jobs.notes: The Organisation will give preference to candidates in line with the Employment Equity goals. All applications must be submitted on a New Z83 form, which can be downloaded           on        internet       at       www.judiciary.org.za        / www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp or obtainable from any Public Service Department and should be accompanied by a recent comprehensive CV only; contactable referees (telephone numbers and email addresses must be indicated). Please send your documents in a PDF and put them in one folder. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Prior to appointment for SMS, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full     details    can      be      sourced       by     the     following    link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Each application form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialed on both pages by the applicant. The application must indicate the correct job title, the office where the position is advertised and the reference number as stated in the advert. Failure by the applicant to complete, sign and initial the application form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. Applications on the old Z83 will unfortunately not be considered. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation considered. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, financial checks, qualification verification, citizenship checks, social media, reference checks and employment verification). Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered during the selection process. All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointment. The Office the Chief Justice complies with the provisions of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA); Act No. 4 of 2013. We will use your personal information provided to us for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for. In the event that your application was unsuccessful, the Office of the Chief Justice will retain your personal information for internal audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide requested information will render your application null and void. The Office of the Chief Justice will safeguard the security and confidentiality of all information you shared during the recruitment process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Senior Organisasionele Ontwikkelingspraktisyn
af.summary: Senior Organisasionele Ontwikkelingspraktisyn by die Kantoor van die Hoofregter in Midrand, wat werkstudie-onderzoekke doen en postvestigingsstrukture ontwikkel.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet oor 'n Nasionale Diploma in Bestuursdienste/ Operasionele Bestuur/Produksiebestuur/ 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak ses (6) met 360 krediete soos deur SAQA erken, beskik. 'n Minimum van twee (2) jaar se ondervinding in die Organisasionele Ontwikkelingsveld. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis en vaardighede: Goeie kennis van organisasionele ontwerp, raamwerke, praktyke en prosesse in die Openbare diens. Kennis van Openbare Diens Wette, Openbare Diens Regulasies, Operasionele Bestuursraamwerk, OrgPlus, Organisasionele Ontwerp, proses- en werkstudietegnieke, Werksevaluasieprosesse en Batho Pele-beginsels. Vaardig in Praktiese Kennis van Rekenaar, aanbieding, Verslagskrywing en Projekbestuurvaardighede.
af.duties: Voer werkstudie-onderzoekke uit, analiseer inligting wat tydens werkondersoeke versamel is, voer funksionele analise uit en ontwikkel postvestigingsstruktuur, kostestruktur in ooreenstemming met MTEF, stel werkstudieverslag met toepaslike aanbevelings op, kommunikeer die uitslag van verslae aan tersaaklike belanghebbendes, onderhou en dateer die organisasionele struktuurdatabasis op. Ontwikkel/ hersien taakbeskrywings vir alle poste in die departement, voer taakanalise uit, voer navorsing/ benchmarking uit oor die jongste tendense binne die bestek van OD, belyn gekoördineerde taakbeskrywings met die omvang van die organisasie, fasiliteer die ondertekening van die taakbeskrywing en ontwikkel/dateer die taakbeskrywingsdatabasis op. Stel erkenningbriewe vir JE-versoeke op, versamel en analiseer die tersaaklike dokumente, voer die werksevaluasie-onderhoud en vaslegging van inligting op JE-stelsel, verskaf sekretariaatsondersteuningsdienste aan die Werksevaluasiepaneelkomitee, kommunikeer JE-resultate aan die tersaaklike belanghebbendes, dateer die Werksevaluasiedatabasis op en hanteer Werksevaluasieverwante navrae. Voer analise uit oor die behoefte aan veranderingsbestuur, neem deel aan die ontwikkeling en implementering van Veranderingsbestuurstrategieë, koördineer die implementering van Veranderingsbestuurprosesse, fasiliteer groepsessies en besprekings in werkswinkels, dien as die veranderingskampioen en rapporteer oor vordering van veranderingsbestuursinisiatiewe. Implementeer goedgekeurde posversoeke in ooreenstemming met wetgewing op PERSAL (insluitend skepping van poste) en op die organisatoriese struktuur, gee advies aan alle belanghebbendes oor posnavrae; koördineer wysigings van posbesonderhede op die stelsel ooreenkomstig die struktuur en die personeelvestiging in oorleg met PERSAL-beheerder, verskaf verslae en data vir voltooiing van HRBP-nutsgoed en COE-begroting asook besteding. Verseker 'n behoorlike lêerstelsel vir alle rekords, hou 'n opgedateerde voorlegging-ekseldatabasis, dateer die databasis op, dateer die projek-dashboard op en lewer sekretariële dienste aan die vergaderings binne die eenheid.

zu.title: Umuntu oPhezulu owenza Umsebenzi Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezinhlelo Zomnyango
zu.summary: Umuntu oPhezulu owenza Umsebenzi Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezinhlelo Zomnyango e-Office of the Chief Justice e-Midrand, owenza ucwaningo lokusebenza futhi athuthukise izakhiwo zokuqasha izikhundla.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe ne-National Diploma kwi-Management Services/ Operations Management/Production Management/ noma isifundo esilinganayo kuma-NQF level six (6) nge-360 credits njengoba kuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Ukuze kube nokuhlangenwe naso okungenani kwaminyaka yamabili (2) enkundleni ye-Organisational Development. I-driver's license evumelekile izoba yinzuzo eyengeziwe. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi oluhle lwe-organisational design, izakhiwo, izindlela, kanye nezinqubo kwi-Public service. Ulwazi lwe-Public Service Acts, i-Public Service Regulations, i-Operations Management Framework, i-OrgPlus, i-Organisational Design, izindlela zocwaningo lwe-process ne-work study, i-Job Evaluation Processes kanye ne-Batho Pele Principles. Ubesekwazi ukusebenzisa i-Computer, ukuthetha phambili, ukuBhala Imibhalo Yokubika kanye nama-Project Management Skills.
zu.duties: Yenza ucwaningo lwe-work study, hlaziya ulwazi olutholwe ngesikhathi kwenziwa ucwaningo lomsebenzi, yenza isibonakaliso sezinkinga futhi uthuthukise isakhiwo sokuqashwa kwezikhundla, isakhiwo sezindleko ngokuka-MTEF, lungiselela umbhalo wocwaningo lwe-work study ngezincomo ezifanelekile, wazise izinzipho zemibhalo kubandulelangqondo abahlobene, gcina futhi uvuselele i-database yesakhiwo sezinhlelo zomnyango. Thuthukisa/buyekeza incazalo yomsebenzi yazo zonke izikhundla kumnyango, yenza ukuhlaziya komsebenzi, yenza ucwaningo/isilinganiso sezintshingo ezisha enkundleni ye-OD, lunganisela incazalo yomsebenzi ehleziwe nebhalwe ngokubambisana nolwedlule lesikhungo, yenza kube lula ukusayina incazalo yomsebenzi futhi uthuthukise/vuselele i-database yencazalo yomsebenzi. Lungiselela imi leta yokuvuma izicelo ze-JE, qoqa futhi uhlaziye imibhalo ehlobene, yenza izingxoxo ze-job evaluation futhi ubhale ulwazi kwi-JE system, nikeza inkonzo yokwesekwa kwi-Job Evaluation panel committee, wazise imiphumela ye-JE kubandulelangqondo abahlobene, vuselele i-database ye-Job Evaluation futhi uphendule imibuzo ephathelene ne-Job Evaluation. Yenza isibonakaliso sosizo lokushintsha ukuphathwa kwezinto, thatha inxaxheba ekuthuthukisweni nokuphothulwa kwe-Change Management Strategies, hlezelela ukuphothulwa kwezinqubo ze-Change Management, yenza kube lula izingqungqutha zamagatsha kanye nezingxoxo kumaseminars, yiba nguqhaga woshintsho futhi ubike ngentuthuko yokuqaliswa koshintsho ekuphathweni kwezinto. Qalisa izicelo ezamukelekile zezikhundla ngokomthetho kwi-PERSAL (okuqukethe ukudalwa kwezikhundla) nakwisakhiwo sezinhlelo, nika amazizo onke abandulelangqondo ngemibuzo yezikhundla; hlezelela ialter ezinhlobonhlobo zemininingwane yezikhundla kusistimu ngokwesakhiwo kanye nokuqashwa kwabasebenzi ngokubonisana noPERSAL Controller, nikeza imibhalo yezibiko namaphuzu adingekayo ukugcwalisa i-HRBP Tool ne-COE budget kanye nokuchithwa kwemali. Qinisekisa isistimu yokugcina okulashelayo yonke imibhalo, gcina i-database ye-excel yezicelo ehlali uvuselelwe, vuselele i-database, vuselele i-project dashboard futhi nikeza izinkonzo zokwesekwa emihlanganweni ngaphakathi kweyuniti.

xh.title: UmPractitioner Ophakamileyo WoPhuhliso LweNqanaba Loshishino
xh.summary: UmPractitioner Ophakamileyo WoPhuhliso LweNqanaba Loshishino kwiLungelelaniso leNkulumbuso eMidrand, ezenza uphononongo lwangaphakathi lolusebenzo nasekuyiliwa iinkqubo ezakuqulunqwe kwindawo ezakusebenza kuyo.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka abafaka izicelo babe nefomu lesidanga lesiZwe kwiinkonzo zoLawulo / uLawulo lweNkqubo / uLawulo lokuvelisa / izifi kunye nokuqwalaselwa kwangokulinganayo kwinqanaba le-NQF lesithandathu (6) ngecredits ezingama-360 njengokuqatshwa yiSAQA. Kufuneka abe nokungenwa kwamava okungenayo kwiminyaka emi-2 (2) kwindawo yoPhuhliso LweNqanaba Loshishino. Ileyisensi yokushayela egqityiweyo iya kuba lisongono. Ulwazi namakhono: Ukuba nolwazi olululu ngenkqubo yokulunga kohando, iinkqubo ezahlulahlulweyo, iinkqubo ezisebenzayo kunye nendlela ezihamba ngayo kwinkonzo kaRhulumende. Ulwazi ngeMithetho yeNkonzo kaRhulumende, iNgqungquthela yeNkonzo kaRhulumende, iNkqubo yoLawulo lweNkqubo, i-OrgPlus, uLungelelwaniso lweNqanaba, indlela nophononongo lwangaphakathi lolusebenzo, iinkqubo zoQwalaselo lweMisebenzi kunye neenjongo zeBatho Pele. Ukuba namakhono oLwazi ngokuSebenzisa iKhompyutha, iinkqubo zokuPhepha iNgqungquthela, ukuBhala iiMbuyekezo namakhono oLawulo lweNdawo ezakwenziwa.
xh.duties: Yenza uphononongo lwangaphakathi lolusebenzo, hlaziya ulwazi oluqokelelweyo ngexesha lophononongo lolusebenzo, yenza uqwalaselo olusebenzayo uze uyile iinkqubo ezingundoqo ezikwindawo ezakusebenza kuyo, yandisa inkqubo yeentswabi ngokwe-MTEF, qulunqa ingxelo yophononongo lolusebenzo ngokwemigqeba ephathwayo, thwebula ingxelo kubantu abahilelyo, gcina uze uhlaziye i-data yeenkqubo ezikwindawo ezakusebenza kuyo. Phuhlisa / hlola iinkcazelo zemisebenzi yonke iindawo ezikwiso eLungelelwaniso, yenza uqwalaselo lomsebenzi, phanda / yenza i-benchmark ngenkqubo yakutshanje kwindawo ye-OD, yenza ibala ngenkcazelo yomsebenzi neLungelelwaniso lweshishino, qhubele phambili ukusayina kwenkcazelo yomsebenzi uze uyiphuhlise / uhlaziye i-data yenkcazelo yomsebenzi. Qulunqa iilette ezamkelwa zecekelo le-JE, qokelela uze uhlaziye amaxwebhu ahilelyo, yenza i-interview ye-JE uze ufake ulwazi kule nkqubo ye-JE, nikez inkonzo yokwazi ngokubhalisa kwabakwiKomiti yeNkqubo ye-JE, thwebula iimpendulo ze-JE kubantu abahilelyo, uhlaziye i-data ye-JE uze uphendule imibuzo ephathwa nge-JE. Hlaziya imeko yokwenza iNkqubo yoGuqulo, thata inxaxheba ekuphuhliseni nasekuqatyweni iindlela zoGuqulo, phambanisa isicelo seNkqubo yoGuqulo, qhubele phambili iintlangano namaxa kumagqibo lwemifanekiso, yiba ngumtshashi weguqulo uze uxhase inyathelo lokuqhuba iNkqubo yoGuqulo. Qatha iindawo eziphandle ngokwemigaqo ngokulinganayo kwi-PERSAL (ngokubandakanya iindawo ezintsha) nakwindawo yokwakheka koshishino, ixabise abantu abahilelyo ngemibuzo yendawo eziqhayiayo; phambanisa ulungiselelo lweenkcukacha zendawo kwinkqubo ngokohando nangokwabasebenzi ngokweluleko loKlawula i-PERSAL, nikez iingxelo ne-data ekugqibeleni i-HRBP Tool kunye ne-COE entshunjeliselwayo. Qinisekisa ukugcina iinkqubo ezichanekileyo zamaxwebhu onke, gcina i-data ye-excel entsha, hlaziya i-data, hlaziya iinkqubo ze-pha-pha kwaye usize kumasebe akwindawo ngokwexesha.

jobs.title: Registry Clerk
jobs.salary_text: R237 453 – R279 708 per annum (Level 05). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: Registry Clerk at the Office of the Chief Justice in Midrand, requiring a Grade 12 certificate, responsible for filing, record management and storeroom security.
jobs.requirements: An applicant should be in possession of a Grade 12 certificate or equivalent qualification at NQF level four (4) as recognised by SAQA. No experience required. A minimum of I-year registry experience as an added advantage. Knowledge and skills: Understanding of the National Archives Act and Regulations, understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service, knowledge of storage and retrieval procedures in terms of the working environment, understanding of the work in registry and knowledge of Batho Pele Principles. Skilled in communication (written and verbal), interpersonal relations, computer literacy (MS Office), numeracy, time management, planning and organising and report writing skills.
jobs.duties: Ensure that there is enough space for filing in the storeroom to avoid misfiling of documents, record receipt files, protection of records and ensure filling, Make sure that the storeroom is locked to limit access, replace torn out registers and keep closed registers safe in the archival storeroom. Open and close files according to record classification System, file/store, trace (manually) and retrieve documents and files and ensure that the information inside the personal file is filed accordingly. Label files neatly for easy retrieval, arrange and package files for archives and distribution, register all files requested by relevant clients. For example, clients such as Auditors and HR practitioners. Develop a database for employees who are transferred to other departments, record and screen all correspondence before forwarding, communicate with HR Practitioners from other departments about transferring of files, audit the files to make sure that all documents recorded are still in the file, register the files in the transfer register, register files with Facilities Unit for courier service and update the transfer register for future use.
jobs.enquiries: Technical Related Enquiries: Ms L Masia Tel No: (010) 493 2532 HR Related Enquiries: Mr K Mphela Tel No: (010) 493 2527

jobs.notes: The Organisation will give preference to candidates in line with the Employment Equity goals. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Prior to appointment for SMS, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full     details    can      be      sourced       by     the     following    link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Each application form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialed on both pages by the applicant. The application must indicate the correct job title, the office where the position is advertised and the reference number as stated in the advert. Failure by the applicant to complete, sign and initial the application form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. Applications on the old Z83 will unfortunately not be considered. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation considered. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, financial checks, qualification verification, citizenship checks, social media, reference checks and employment verification). Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered during the selection process. All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointment. The Office the Chief Justice complies with the provisions of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA); Act No. 4 of 2013. We will use your personal information provided to us for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for. In the event that your application was unsuccessful, the Office of the Chief Justice will retain your personal information for internal audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide requested information will render your application null and void. The Office of the Chief Justice will safeguard the security and confidentiality of all information you shared during the recruitment process. OTHER POSTS

zu.title: Umkleli wohlelo lokubhalisa
zu.summary: Umkleli wohlelo lokubhalisa eOffice of the Chief Justice eMidrand, ofuna isitifiketi seGrade 12, onenduna emsebenzini wokulonda amafayela, uphathwe kwabhaliswa okulondiwe kanye nokuvikeleka kwegumbi elilondwayo.
zu.requirements: Umfunyi kufanele abe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 noma iziqu ezilinganayo ezingeni leNQF elingu-four (4) njengokuthiwa yiSAQA. Asikho isipiliyoni esidingekayo. Isipiliyoni esingaphezulu kwegagasi leminyaka yohlelo lokubhalisa sithathwa njengenzuzo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ukuqonda umthetho weNational Archives Act kanye Nemithetho yalo, ukuqonda ohlelo lomthetho oluphethe Inkonzo Yomphakathi, ulwazi ngemiyalelo yokugcina nokuveza amafayela ngokwesimo somsebenzi, ukuqonda umsebenzi wohlelo lokubhalisa nolwazi lwemigomo kaBatho Pele. Ukhulelwe ekuxhumaneni (okulotshiwe nokuqhamulwayo), ebuqhawe obungomuntu nomuntu, ekusebenziseni ikhompuyutha (MS Office), ekuqondweni kwamanani, ekuphatheni isikhathi, ekuhleleni nokuqamba kanye namakhono okubhala imibiko.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuthi kukhona isikhala esanele sokulonda amafayela egumbini elilondwayo ukuze kugwemeni ukulonda amafayela kabi, bhala amafayela okwamukelwa, kuvikele amafayela okubhalisiwe futhi kuqinisekiswe ukubhaliswa, Qinisekisa ukuthi igumbi elilondwayo liyakhunjuliwa ukuze kuncishwe ukungena, esha izibhalo eziphukile futhi ugcine izibhalo eziyivaliwe zivikele egumbini elilondwayo lezinto zasendulo. Vula futhi uvalwe amafayela ngokwesimo sokuhlukaniswa kwamafayela, londa/gcina, landele (ngokwesandla) futhi uveze amadokhumenti namafayela futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi olusefayeleni nomuntu luhlelwe kanjani. Phawula amafayela ngokuhlanzekile ukuze kube lula ukuveza, hlela futhi uphakethe amafayela izinto zasendulo kanye nokusatshalaliswa, bhale bonke amafayela acelwe abathintekayo. Isibonelo, abathintekayo njengabahloli beAuditors nezisebenzi zeHR. Yakha isizathu semininingwane sabasebenzi abashuthunshiswa kwezinye iminyango, bhala futhi uhlole yonke imibhalo ngaphambi kokuqhubeka, uxhumane nezisebenzi zeHR ezinye iminyango ngokushuthunshiswa kwamafayela, hola amafayela ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi wonke amadokhumenti abhaliwe esafaka efayeleni, bhala amafayela esibhalweni sokushuthunshiswa, bhala amafayela ebaleni leFacilities Unit yesevisi yethwasa futhi uvuse isibhalo sokushuthunshiswa ukuze sisetshenziswe esikhathini esizayo.

xh.title: Mohlwehi weRekhodi
xh.summary: Isithuba soMohlwehi weRekhodi kwiNkululeko yeNjingcali eNkulu eMidrand, lifuna isatifikethi seQumrhu lesi-12, libophe ekubekweni kwamaphefumlo, ekulawulweni kwerekhodi nakho kuvikeleko kwendlu yokugcina iifayile.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka umthengi abi nesatifikethi seQumrhu lesi-12 okanye nesiqhantsulo esilinganayo kwinqanaba le-NQF lesine (4) njengoko bonwa yi-SAQA. Akukho njiniyithi edingiwa. Ubuncinane benyanga yom-1 yamava wokubeka iirekhodi yonakala ngenxa yokuba yeyona ndlela ilungileyo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ukuqonda koMthetho weZiko leNcwadi zeSizwe nezalo zakhe, ukuqonda kolawulo-lwemithetho olulawula iNkonzo kaZwelonke, ulwazi lwendlela zokugcina nokuphinda kutholwe iinkcukacha ngokwemeko yokusebenza, ukuqonda komsebenzi wokubeka iirekhodi nolwazi lweMinxulumaniso-mthetho yeBatho Pele. Uphezulu ekubonisweni kolwazi (okubhaliweyo nokuthethwayo), kubantu ngabanye ekubanisweni kwabo, ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha (i-MS Office), ekubaleni, ekulawulweni kwexesha, ekulungiseleleni nokuqamba nasekwazini ukubaliweyo kwemizekeliso.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukuba kukho indawo elungele ukubeka iifayile endlini yokugcina iifayile ukuze kungabi nako ukubeka iifayile ngokungalunganga, bhala iifayile ezifunyenwe ziswe, ukuvikela iirekhodi nokwenza isiqinisekiso sokuba zibekiwe, Qinisekisa ukuba indlu yokugcina iifayile itshixiwe ukuze kuncitshiswe indlela yokungena, buyisela iirejista ezidiniweyo zigqityiwe kwaye zibe zikhatywe endlwini yokugcina iirekhodi ezizeleko. Vula vale iifayile ngokweNkqubo yokwahlula iirekhodi, beka/gcina, landela (ngeSandla) nokuphinda uthole amaxwebhu ngeefayile kuze uqinisekise ukuba ulwazi olukufayile yamntu singathi lubekiwe ngokweNdlela efanayo. Bhala iifayile ngokucacileyo ukuze zibengalo mzuzwana ukuzithola, lungisa kwaye uphake iifayile ukuya kwindawo yokugcina iinkcukacha zembali nakwisithumelo, bhala zonke iifayile ecelwe ngabathengi abafanelekileyo. Umzekelo, abathengi aba njengabaBali baseMvuzo nabasebenzi be-ZK. Yakha isiseko sedatha yabasebenzi abadluliselwa kumanye amasebe, bhala kwaye uhlole konke ukuthetha-phakathi phambi kokuthumela, thetha nabasebenzi be-ZK kumanye amasebe malunga nokuqhutywa kweefayile, hlole iifayile ukuze uqinisekise ukuba zonke iinkcukacha ezibhaliweyo zisakuzifayile, bhala iifayile kwindawo yokuqhutywa kweefayile, bhala iifayile neYunithi yeZiseko zenkonzo yokuqhutywa kweefayile kwaye uhlaziye irekhodi yokuqhuba iifayile ukuzisebenzisa ngelixa elizayo.

zu.title: Umclerhi Wezinsiza Zabantu
zu.summary: Isikhundla somclerhi Wezinsiza Zabantu eNkantolo Ephakeme Yokwesula iNcala eBloemfontein, esidinga isitifiketi seGrade 12 lingadingi nakho okuhlangenwe nakho, sinikeza iholo elingu-R237,453 kuya ku-R279,708 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Abafakeli kufanele babe nesitifiketi seGrade twelve (12) noma izifundo ezilinganayo ezingeni le-NQF level four (4) njengoba kuqashwa yi-SAQA. Akukho okuhlangenwe nakho okudingekayo. Isifundo esihambisana nale ndawo sizoba usizo olwengeziwe. Ulwazi nezikhali: Ulwazi ngohlelo lwe-PERSAL, ukuqonda kohlelo lomthetho olawula Inkonzo Yomphakathi, izinqubo zokugcina nokubuyisela ulwazi ngokwesimo ezimeni zokusebenza. Ukwazi ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe), ukuphatha, ukuhlela nokuhlela, ukuphatha isikhathi, ukubala okuyisisekelo, izikhali zokuxhumana nabantu nokuthayipha. Kanye nalesi simo esilandelayo: ukuzimotivatha, ukucabanga ngokwakho, ukuzethemba, ukuthanda ukuphumelela, ukuba noguquko kanye nethuba lokuhlangabeza izikhathi ezibekiwe.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha izinqubo zokubumba, ukukhetha nokumisebenza enkantolo, ukuphatha nokubamba izicelo zeholide, ukulungisa amadokhumenti okumisebenza nokuphelisa inkonzo, ukubamba imisebenzi, ukuphelisa inkonzo kanye nezindaba zokulimala esikhathini somsebenzi, ukulungisa inkokhelo yokushintshela kwezindawo nezinzuzo zeholide, ukulungisa amadokhumenti ezimali okuphilile, ukwamukela futhi uhlolela ukuthembeka amadokhumenti e-PMDS nemibiko yesikhathi sokuzama, ukubatha izindaba ezihlobene nokusebenza, ukuvuselela idathabheysi yokuphatha irekhodi lezinsiza zabantu, ukuphatha yonke imikhubano ebuya nayo nephuma kuyo, ukuqinisekisa uhlelo lokugcina amafayela olungile, ukulandela amafayela namarekhodi, ukunika usizo ngemihlangano nezikhathi zokwazisa, ukunika usizo lwezinsiza zokuhlela kanye nokuba uyobumba kumihlangano, ukuqamba amaminethi namanye amadokhumenti. Ukuqamba izibalo ezihlobene nenyunithi.

jobs.title: Registra’s Clerk
jobs.centre: Western Cape Division of The High Court: Cape Town
jobs.salary_text: R237 453 – R279 708 per annum (Level 05). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: Register and manage case files, pleadings and court records at the Western Cape High Court in Cape Town.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of Grade twelve (12) certificate or equivalent qualification at NQF level four (4) as recognised by SAQA. No experience required. A relevant qualification in the field of will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge of working procedures in terms of the working environment, registry processes and practice, Knowledge of storage and retrieval procedures in terms of the working environment, understanding of legislative frameworks governing the Public Service, Knowledge of Filling system, Mail procedure manual, Promotion of access to information Act, National archives and Batho Pele Principles. Skilled in computer Literacy (Microsoft Office), communication, numeracy, interpersonal skills, problem solving and analysis, time management and administrative skills.
jobs.duties: Register/ allocate case numbers to all pleadings and court documents received, ensure that the files have been served on all parties concerned, draw up files for the litigants/Attorney, update the file of return service/s proof services, safe-keep and dispose of case records. Retrieve the requested file and make the file available to the requester, attend to queries from parties and members of the public, record documents received, ensure systematically recording of court files and keep record of requests received from litigants. Attend to case management and set down notice, implement case management practices (placing request forms in the space of a file that has been requested, complete and file the movement sheet), render case management duties, monitor files and records as per the case Management. Submit leave forms to HR for compliance, maintain and keep all registers for filing and archiving, comply with the telephone prescripts and leave policies, prepare and sign performance agreement timeously.

af.title: Registrateurklerk
af.summary: Registreer en bestuur saaklêers, pleitstukke en hofrekords by die Western Cape High Court in Cape Town.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad twaalf (12)-sertifikaat of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak vier (4) soos deur SAQA erken, hê. Geen ervaring word vereis nie. 'n Relevante kwalifikasie in die veld sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van werksprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing, registrasieprosesse en -praktyk, Kennis van bergings- en onttrekkingsprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing, begrip van wetgewende raamwerke wat die Openbare Diens regeer, Kennis van die lêerstelsel, Posprosedurehandleiding, Promotion of access to information Act, National archives en Batho Pele-beginsels. Vaardig in rekenaargeletterdheid (Microsoft Office), kommunikasie, syferkundigheid, interpersoonlike vaardighede, probleemoplossing en -ontleding, tydbestuur en administratiewe vaardighede.
af.duties: Registreer/ wys saaknommers toe aan alle pleitstukke en hofdokumente wat ontvang is, verseker dat die lêers op alle betrokke partye gedien is, stel lêers vir die litigante/Prokureurs op, werk die lêer van diens van terugbesorgings/ bewys van diens op, berg en dispositioneer saakrekords. Onttrek die aangevraagde lêer en maak die lêer beskikbaar aan die aanvrager, attendeer aan navrae van partye en lede van die publiek, teken dokumente wat ontvang is op, verseker sistematiese registrering van hoflêers en hou rekord van versoeke wat van litigante ontvang is. Attendeer aan saakbestuur en kennis van sitting, implementeer saakbestuurspraktyke (plaas versoekvorms in die plek van 'n lêer wat versoek is, voltooi en lê die bewegingsblad in), lewer saakbestuurspligte, monitor lêers en rekords volgens die saakbestuur. Dien verlofvorms by HR in vir nakoming, onderhou en hou alle registers vir lêerwerk en argivering, voldoen aan die telefoondirektiewe en verlofbeleide, berei en teken die prestasie-ooreenkoms betyds voor.

zu.title: Umsekeli weRegistra
zu.summary: Bhalisa uphathwa kwamafayela amacala, imibhalo yamacala namarekhodi enkantolo enkosiwa i-Western Cape High Court e-Cape Town.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nedisithifikethi seGrade twelve (12) noma iziqu ezingulinganayo ezingeni le-NQF level four (4) njengoba kuhlonzwa yi-SAQA. Akukho mkhulezo odingekile. Isiqu esihambisana nomkhakha sizonabela ngengozi ethile. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi lwezinqubo zokusebenza ngaphakathi kwezinsimbi, izinqubo namalungiselelo okubhalisa, ulwazi lwezinqubo zokugcina futhi kutholwe imibhalo, ukuqonda kumagobodo umthetho aphethe abasebenzi basezikhungini zikahulumeni, ulwazi ngohlelokusebenza lokushova, isikhokelo sezinqubo zezincwadi, ukuqashelwa kwesikhundla komthelela wemfundo, i-National archives kanye nemiYalo yeBatho Pele. Amakhono ohlelokusebenza lwekhompyutha (Microsoft Office), ukuxhumana, ukubala, amakhono obudlelwano nabantu, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, ukuphatha isikhathi namakhono obukhulu.
zu.duties: Bhalisa/nikeza izinombolo zamacala wonke amadokhumenti wamacala namadokhumenti enkantolo atholiwe, qiniseka ukuthi amafayili athunyelwe kubonke izinhlangaba ezithintekile, hlola amafayela abalwelisi/Abameli, buyekeza ifayela lebhalansi/ukutholwa kwesevisi, gcina ngokuphephile futhi ulahle amarekhodi amacala. Thola ifayela eliceliwe futhi yenze lifinyelele k lowo ocelayo, phendula imibuzo evela kubantu abathintekile nakubantu bokuziphila, bhalisa amadokhumenti atholiwe, qiniseka ukubhalisa ngendlela ehlelekile amafayela enkantolo futhi ugcgine irekhodi lezicelo ezitholwe kubalwelisi. Yeba kuhlelokusebenza lwezimiso zamacala nezaziso zokuhlela, yenza imisebenzi yohlelokusebenza lwezimiso zamacala (ukubeka amafomu wesicelo endaweni yefayela eliceliwe, gcwalisa futhi ufake isithi sendlela yokuqhubeka), yenzela imisebenzi yohlelokusebenza lwezimiso zamacala, londa amafayela namarekhodi ngokuhambisana nohlelokusebenza lwezimiso zamacala. Thumela amafomu ezinkulo ku-HR ukuze kuhambisane nemithetho, gcina futhi ubambe wonke amarejista okubhalisa nokugcina amafayela, lande imithetho yokusebenza yocingo nemithetho ezinkulweni, lulungele futhi usayine isivumelwano sokusebenza ngesikhathi esifanele.

Thumela iifomu zokushiya kwi-HR ngokwemigaqo, zigcine kwaye ugcine onke amarekhodo wokugcina noku-archiva, thobele imigaqo yefowuni kunye namagama okushiya, lungelela kwaye usayine isivumelwano sevidiyo ngexesha elifanelekileyo.

Qinfa, sombula iingxaki, uzilungise iimpazamo kwinethiwekhi ye-LAN/WAN, kwiPCs, kwiiperipherals, kwiindawo zenethiwekhi, nakwilisoftware. Nceda nokuqwalasela, ukuyila, nokusebenzisa inethiwekhi ye-LAN/WAN kunye nezisombulu zedesktop, laptop, nokuphrinta. jobs.title: Administration Officer: Acquisition Management (SCM)
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Administration officer needed in Cape Town to support acquisition management and procurement planning for the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of three-year tertiary qualification (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma in Supply Chain Management/ Procurement/ Public Management/Public Administration/Logistics or related. Relevant years of working experience in Supply Chain within Acquisition Management. Valid Driver’s Licence Knowledge of: Thorough knowledge and understanding of government procurement systems and relevant legislation; Supply chain management; Management of databases; PFMA; PPPFA; Supply Chain policies and procedures; Treasury Regulations and BBBEE Acts; Monitoring and evaluation theory and methodology; Monitoring and evaluation systems. Skills: Good verbal and written communication skills; Basic numeracy; Advanced interpersonal and diplomacy skills; Problem solving skills; Decision making skills; Statistical skills; Computer literacy; Problem solving skills; Presentation skills; Planning and organising skills; Ability to work independently and under pressure. Personal Attributes: Analytical thinking; Innovative; Creative; Resourceful; Ability to work under stressful situations; Ability to communicate at all levels; People orientated; Able to establish and maintain networks; Trustworthy; Assertive; Hard-working; Self-motivated; Ability to work independently. Must be prepared to adapt work schedule in accordance with office requirements.
jobs.duties: Provide admin support in the research and needs analysis for the Department. Provide guidance to End-Users/Project Managers on testing the markets. Lead the process of alignment of budgets with department objectives and Annual Performance Plans. Consolidation of Procurement Plans and report monthly to Head Office. Assist in the consultation with relevant stakeholders to determine challenges, opportunities and risks. Identify the frequency of needs and analyse the identified needs in line with the supply chain strategy and collect data commodity analysis and checking for alternatives. Provide support in the determination and development of procurement proposals for implementation based on the results of the research. Collect and collate information for the Department Annual Procurement Plan, collect information from the relevant units according to the prescribed template. Check and analyse the submitted information, confirm availability of budget. Consolidate the information into procurement plan. Provide support in the process of drafting specifications, advice whether specifications should contain special conditions. Assist in identifying and implementation of preference points system, track all movements of specification and terms of reference submission. Provide an appropriate response to internal and external stakeholders. Provide secretariat support to the relevant Bid Committees. Responsible for demand, acquisition and contract management. Ensure full compliance to all acquisition, demand management and contract management prescripts, policies, practice notes and delegations of authority. Develop and maintain internal control measures for procurement. Ensure the effective management of demand, acquisition and contract processes. Compile and consolidate the demand management plan, acquisitions management and contract management reports. Coordinate input in the Demand Management Plan. Ensure that procurement is in line with the approved demand plan. Ensure effective utilisation of the CSD. Manage acquisition including BID administration. Assist in compilation of Terms of reference, Specifications and BID Documents. Provide secretariat support to the BID committees and provide the administrative duties during the tender/bid briefing sessions. Provide assistance in the review of the scope of the Terms of Reference (TOR). Assist with the monitoring of validity period of closed tenders. Assist in the co- ordination and execution of the bidding process-: Arrange and attend bid Evaluation committee meeting. Management of the bid processes and ensure effective functioning of all Bid Committees. Management and effective utilisation of Transversal Contracts and Participation contracts. Manage the process of sourcing of quotations. Ensure proper document control and documentations. Implement and Oversee Risk and performance management strategies in the supply chain management unit. Identify and mitigate risks within the unit. Ensure that all administrative matters, correspondence and complex enquiries are attended to promptly. Assist in the compiling of monthly SCM performance reports. Compilation /verification of all monthly SCM reports. Ensure implementation and compliance of the Instruction Notes as issued by National Treasury as well as Departmental SCM Policy.
jobs.enquiries: Mr M. Sozombile Tel No: (021) 402 2250
