af.title: Administrasiebeampte: Verkrygingsbestuur (SCM)
af.summary: Administrasiebeampte benodig in Cape Town om verkrygingsbestuur en procurentbeplanning vir die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure te ondersteun.
af.requirements: ‘n Minimum van ‘n driejaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (NQF Level 06) / Nasionale Diploma in Supply Chain Management/ Procurement/ Public Management/Public Administration/Logistics of verwant. Relevante jare van werkservaring in Supply Chain binne Acquisition Management. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis: Deeglike kennis en begrip van staatsprocurementstelsels en relevante wetgewing; Supply chain management; Bestuur van databasisse; PFMA; PPPFA; Supply Chain-beleide en prosedures; Tesourie-regulasies en BBBEE-wette; Monitering-en-evalueringsteorie en -metodologie; Monitering-en-evalueringstelsels. Vaardighede: Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede; Basiese syferkundigheid; Gevorderde interpersoonlike en diplomasie-vaardighede; Probleemoplossingsvaardighede; Besluitnemingsvaardighede; Statistiese vaardighede; Rekenaargeletterdheid; Probleemoplossingsvaardighede; Voorleggingsvaardighede; Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede; Vermoë om onafhanklik en onder druk te werk. Persoonlike eienskappe: Analitiese denke; Innovatief; Skeppend; Vindingryk; Vermoë om onder stresvolle omstandighede te werk; Vermoë om op alle vlakke te kommunikeer; Mense-gerig; In staat om netwerke te vestig en te handhaaf; Betroubaar; Selfversekerd; Ywerig; Selfgemotiveerd; Vermoë om onafhanklik te werk. Moet bereid wees om werkskedule volgens kantoorvereistes aan te pas.
af.duties: Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning in die navorsing en behoefte-ontleding vir die departement. Verskaf leiding aan Eindgebruikers/Projekbestuurders oor die toetsing van markte. Lei die proses van belyning van begrotings met departementele doelwitte en Annual Performance Plans. Konsolidasie van Procurement Plans en verslag maandeliks aan Head Office. Bystand verleen in die konsultasie met relevante belanghebbendes om uitdagings, geleenthede en risiko's te bepaal. Identifiseer die frekwensie van behoeftes en ontleed die geïdentifiseerde behoeftes in ooreenstemming met die supply chain-strategie en versamel data kommoditeitontleding en soek na alternatiewe. Ondersteuning verleen in die bepaling en ontwikkeling van voorstelle vir procurent-implementering gebaseer op die resultate van die navorsing. Versamel en kollasioneer inligting vir die Department Annual Procurement Plan, versamel inligting van die relevante eenhede volgens die voorgeskrewe sjabloon. Kontroleer en ontleed die ingediende inligting, bevestig beskikbaarheid van begroting. Konsolideer die inligting in ‘n procurement plan. Ondersteuning verleen in die proses van die opstel van spesifikasies, adviseer of spesifikasies spesiale voorwaardes moet bevat. Bystand verleen in die identifisering en implementering van voorkeurpuntstelsel, volg alle bewegings van spesifikasie en indiening van terms of reference. Verskaf ‘n toepaslike reaksie aan interne en eksterne belanghebbendes. Verskaf sekretariële ondersteuning aan die relevante Bid Committees. Verantwoordelik vir aanvraag-, verkrygings- en kontrakbestuur. Verseker volle voldoening aan alle verkrygings-, aanvraagbestuurs- en kontrakbestuursvoorskryfte, beleide, praktyknotas en delegasies van gesag. Ontwikkel en handhaaf interne beheermaatreëls vir procurent. Verseker die effektiewe bestuur van aanvraag-, verkrygings- en kontrakprosesse. Stel op en konsolideer die aanvraagbestuursplan, verkrygingsbestuur en kontrakbestuursverslae. Koördineer insette in die Demand Management Plan. Verseker dat procurent in ooreenstemming met die goedgekeurde aanvraagplan is. Verseker effektiewe benutting van die CSD. Bestuur verkryging insluitend BID-administrasie. Bystand verleen by die opstel van Terms of reference, Specifications en BID Documents. Verskaf sekretariële ondersteuning aan die BID-komitees en verskaf die administratiewe pligte tydens die tender/bid-voorligtingsessies. Bystand verleen by die hersiening van die omvang van die Terms of Reference (TOR). Bystand verleen met die monitering van geldigheidsperiode van geslote tenders. Bystand verleen in die koördinasie en uitvoering van die biedproses-: Reël en woon bid Evaluation committee-vergaderings by. Bestuur van die bid-prosesse en verseker effektiewe funksionering van alle Bid Committees. Bestuur en effektiewe benutting van Transversal Contracts en Participation contracts. Bestuur die proses van die verkryging van kwotasies. Verseker behoorlike dokumentbeheer en dokumentasie. Implementeer en hou toesig oor risiko- en prestasiebestuurstrategieë in die supply chain management-eenheid. Identifiseer en mitigeer risiko's binne die eenheid. Verseker dat alle administratiewe sake, korrespondensie en komplekse navrae onverwyld behandel word. Bystand verleen by die opstel van maandelikse SCM-prestasieverslae. Opstel/verifikasie van alle maandelikse SCM-verslae. Verseker implementering en voldoening van die Instruction Notes soos uitgereik deur National Treasury asook Departmental SCM Policy.

zu.title: Isikhundla Sokuphatha: Ukuphathwa Kokuthenga (SCM)
zu.summary: Kudingeka ofikile eCape Town ukusekela ukuphathwa kokuthenga nokuhlelwa kokuthenga kwi-Department of Public Works and Infrastructure.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesikolo esiphakeme ezincane zonyaka we-3 (NQF Level 06) / i-National Diploma kwi-Supply Chain Management/ Procurement/ Public Management/Public Administration/Logistics noma okuhlobene nayo. Amawonke eminyaka yokusebenza ohlotshaneni nokuthenga ngaphakathi kokuPhathwa Kokuthenga. Ilayisensi yokuqasha esemthethweni Ulwazi: Ulwazi olujulile nokuzuva izistimu zokuthenga zahulumeni nomthetho ohlobene nawo; Ukuphathwa kwensindonkondolo; Ukuphathwa kwamasizindalwazi; PFMA; PPPFA; Izinqubomgomo nezinqubo zensindonkondolo; Izingqungquthela ze-Treasury ne-BBBEE Acts; Incazelo nendlela yokuhlola nokubuyekeza; Izistimu zokuqapha nokubuyekeza. Amakhono: Amakhono amahle okuxoxa nokubhala; Ukuqonda izibalo ezingezimsulwa; Amakhono aphakeme okuxhumana nabantu nobungcali; Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga; Amakhono okwenza izinqumo; Amakhono ezibalo; Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga; Amakhono okuyisa imibono phambili; Amakhono okuhlela nokuhlelabusa; Ukukwazi ukusebenza wedwa nangaphansi kwengcindezi. Izimpawu zobuntu: Ukucabanga ngesibindi; Okususwa kwinovathi; Okunemibono emitsha; Onamandla okuzenzela; Ukukwazi ukusebenza endaweni enomingcelephakade; Ukukwazi ukuxhumana emazingeni onke; Abantu abakhomba kubantu; Ukukwazi ukusungula futhi agcine izixhumo; Othembekile; Onamazwi; Okusebenza kanzima; Ozibusayo; Ukukwazi ukusebenza wedwa. Kumele alungiselele ukulungisha isikhathi sokusebenza ngokufezwa kwemithetho yohlulelo.
zu.duties: Nikeza ngenkambiso yokuphatha ocwaningweni nasekuhlaziyweni izidingo kumnyango. Hola abasebenzisi/Abaphathi Baphrojekthi ekuhlolweni imakethe. Hola inqubo yokuqondanisa amabhajethi nemigomo yomnyango ne-Annual Performance Plans. Kubutha Izinhlela Zokuthenga ubike njalo nyangazonke eNkundla Yenhloko. Siza ekuhumusheni nabanomthelela ukuthola izinselele, ithuba kanye nezengo. Hlola ukuvamise kwezidingo ukuze uhlaziye izidingo ezitholakalayo ngokuhambisana nenqubomgomo yensindonkondolo bese uqoqa imininingwane yokuhlaziya izimpahla futhi ubheke okunye okungakhethwa. Siza ekuthathweni kwenqubo kwezinhlelo zokuthenga ezizosetshenziswa ngokususwa kumphumela wocwaningo. Qoqa ubutha imininingwane ye-Department Annual Procurement Plan, qoqa imininingwane kumayunithi ahlobene ngohlelo olumisiwe. Hlaziya futhi ubheke imininingwane ethunyelwe, qinisekisa ukutholakala kwebhajethi. Buthelela imininingwane ohlelweni lokuthenga. Siza ekubhalweni kwezindikimbalilo, iphakamise ukuthi izindikimbalilo kufanele zibe nezimo ezizodwa. Siza ekutholeni nasekuhlokweni amaphuzu okukhethwa, landela konke ukunyakaza kwezindikimbalilo nezinsizakuxhumo ezithunyelwe. Nikeza impendulo efanele kubanomthelela baphakathi noma abangaphandle. Siza emaphaneli amakhulu okukhethwa. Bheka izidingo, ukuthenga nokuphathwa kwezivumelwano. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhlonishwa konke ukuthenga, ukuphathwa kwezidingo nokuphathwa kwezivumelwano, izinqubomgomo, amaphuzu okwenza izenzo kanye namandla okwezinja zokuphatha. Yakha futhi ulawule izinkambiso zolawulo zangaphakathi ukuthenga. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kwezidingo, ukuthenga kanye nokwenza izinqubo zokusebenza. Bhalisa futhi ubutha i-Demand Management Plan, izindaba zokuphathwa kokuthenga nokuphathwa kwezivumelwano. Hlanganisa okufakwe ohlelweni lokuqapha imigomo yomnyango. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukuthenga kuhambisana nohlela lokwenza izidingo oluvunyiwe. Qinisekisa ukusebenzisiswa okusebenzayo i-CSD. Phatha ukuthenga kuhlanganise ukuphathwa kwe-BID. Siza ekubhalweni kwezinsizakuxhumo, Izindikimbalilo namadokhumenti e-BID. Nikeza ngenkambiso ekuqoshweni emaphaneli we-BID futhi ufake imisebenzi yokuqasha ngexesha lezinkathi zokuqasha/okusazwa kobungewele. Siza ekuhlolweni okubalulekile koluhlu lwe-Terms of Reference (TOR). Siza ekuqaphelelweni isikhathi esivunyiwe kumakhetho avelwe. Siza ekubumbeni kanye nokwenzeni inqubo yokukhethwa-: Hlela ubuye ubonke izinkhathi zephaneli lokuhlola ukhetho. Hlela izinqubo zokukhetha futhi qinisekisa ukusebenza okuphelele kwayo yonke imaphaneli amakhulu. Hlela busebenzise izivumelwano ezihlanganisiwe nezivumelwano zokubamba iqhaza ohlelweni lokuthenga. Phatha inqubo yokuqasha izilinganiso. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okuhle kwamadokhumenti. Setha ubheke amacebo okuphatha kweengozi ekuqaphelelweni izinkomba. Hlola buphuze izinselele ezikhona ohlelweni. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amaphuzu okuphatha, okubhaliwe futhi okubuzwa imibuzo eyinkimbinkimbi aphathwe ngokushesha. Siza ekuqoqweni izindaba zenyangazonke zemigomo yokuqapha i-SCM. Bhala/htlole wonke amaphuzu okuqapha i-SCM nyangazonke. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa nokuhlonipha okufakwe ohlelweni lwamaphuzu okuqashwa eNational Treasury kanye nenqubomgomo yomnyango ye-SCM.

xh.title: Iofisa Wolawulo: Ulawulo Lokuqokelela (SCM)
xh.summary: Kufuneka kufakwe i-ofisa yolawulo e Cape Town ukuxhasa ulawulo lokuqokelela nokuqwalasela iinkqubo zokuqokelela ze Department of Public Works and Infrastructure.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esingaphantsi kweyimini yeminyaka emithathu (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma kwi Supply Chain Management/ Procurement/ Public Management/Public Administration/Logistics okanye ezinxulumene nayo. Iiminyaka efanelekileyo yamava basebenzisa kwi Supply Chain ngaphakathi kolawulo lokuqokelela. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni Ulwazi nge: Ukuqonda ngokupheleleyo nokuqonda iinkqubo zokuthengwa kolawulo karhulumente namagazethi ahambelana nayo; Ulawulo lwesikweni lokubonelela; Ulawulo lwesiseko seenkcukacha; PFMA; PPPFA; iindlela nezinqongo zolawulo lwesikweni lokubonelela; Iimigaqo zeTreasury ne BBBEE Acts; Iinkingqi nendlela yokuthelekisa nokuqwalasela inkqubo; Iinkqubo zokuthelekisa nokuqwalasela. Amakhono: Amakhono amabalisekileyo okuthetha nokubhala; Ukubala ngemilinganiselo eyisiseko; Amakhono aphakamileyo okuchasana nabantu nokupeytha; Amakhono okusombulula iingxaki; Amakhono okwenza izigqibo; Amakhono ezibalo; Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Amakhono okusombulula iingxaki; Amakhono okubonisa; Amakhono okucwangcisa nokuqamba; Ikhono lokusebenza kodwa nokusebenza ngoxinzelelo. Iimpawu zobuntu: Ukucinga ngokuhlalutya; Okutsha; Okwenza ngobuchwepheshe; Onamandla okufumana izixhobo; Ikhono lokusebenza kwiimeko ezinxulumene noxinzelelo; Ikhono lokunxibelelana kwakuzo naziphi na iinqanaba; Abathanda abantu; Bakwazi ukuqamba zigqibo zamagimbitha azinzileyo; Ethembekileyo; Ethembisa ngokuzimisela; Esifuthi; Ezenzela ngokuzikhusela; Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimela. Kufuneka alungiselelwe ukulungelelanisa umzuzu wakhe wokusebenza ngokweemfuno ze-ofisi.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yolawulo kuphononongo nokuqwalasela iimfuno ze Department. Nikela isikhokelo kubasebenzisi/ Abaphathi Beephrojekthi ngokuvavanya iimarike. Qhuba inkqubo yokuqwalasela amabhetsheti ngokomgama wesebe neNkqubo Yonyaka YoMsebenzi. Dibanisa iinkqubo zokuqokelela nize niche ngamnye kwi Head Office. Nceda kumbono wokuva iimvakalelo kubantu abafanelekileyo ngokumisela iingxaki, amathuba neengozi. Phawula kunesiphi isiphithiphathi seemfuno uze uhlalutye ezo mfuno ngokwengqiqo yolawulo lwesikweni lokubonelela, qokelela iingcombolo zohlalutyo lwemveliso uze ujonge ezinye iindlela. Nikela inkxaso ekumiseleni nasekuyilweni iingcamango zokuqokelela eziza kusebenza ngokweziphumo zophononongo. Qokelela dibanisa iinkcukacha ze Nkqubo Yokuqokelela Yonyaka ye Department, qokelela iinkcukacha kumacandlo afanelekileyo ngokwemvumba echaziweyo. Jonga uhlalutye iinkcukacha ezithunyelweyo, qinisekisa ukubakho kwamabhetsheti. Dibanisa iinkcukacha zibe ngumnqamlezo wolwazi. Nikela inkxaso ekwenzeni iinkcazelo, yalathise ukuba iinkcazelo kufuneka zibe namagama angamagqitho. Nceda ekuqwalaseleni nokuze kusebenze inkqubo yeenqondo ezikhethwayo, landela zonke iintshukumo zokunikwa iinkcazelo nemigalela. Nikela impendulo efanelekileyo kwabangaphakathi nabaphandle. Nikela inkxaso yesibhedlele kumakomiti abonelela ngeengcinga. Yenzela ukulawula iimfuno, ukuthengwa nolawulo lweenkonzo. Qinisekisa ukuzigcina ngokupheleleyo kwawo onke amagazethi okuthengwa, iinkqubo zokulawula iimfuno nolawulo lweenkonzo, iindlela nokuzinika lugunya. Yila zigcino zangaphakathi zolawulo lokuqokelela. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo lweemfuno, ukuthengwa nolawulo lweenkonzo. Hlengahlengisa dibanise neengcango zolawulo lweemfuno, nokuthengwa nokulawulwa kweenkonzo. Qhagamshela iingcamango kwinkqubo yolawulo lweemfuno. Qinisekisa ukuba ukuthenga kuhambelana neNkqubo yolawulo lweemfuno esemthethweni. Qinisekisa ukusebenzisa i CSD. Lawula ukuthengwa kuquka ulawulo lwe BID. Nceda kwelungiselelo lweenkcazelo, iinkqubo nemigaqo ye BID. Nikela inkxaso kumakomiti we BID uze unike amanqamba olawulo ngelixa le minyhadala yeenkonzo. Nikela inkxaso ekuhlalutyeni kobukhulu beenkcazelo zeengcinga. Nceda ekulawuleni ixesha lokuqina leenkonzo ezivaliweyo. Nceda ekulawuleni nasekwenzeni inkqubo yokuthengwa-: Lungiselela uze ukhangele iinkomfa zobukhomishane zokuqwalasela. Ulawulo lweenkqubo zokuthengwa ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo kwawo onke amakomiti. Ulawulo nokusebenzisa iinkonzo ze Transversal kunye nezo kwinkqubo. Lawula inkqubo yokufumana iinkcazelo ezithengwayo. Qinisekisa ulawulo lweenkcukacha nolawulo lwebali. Yila ujonge iindlela zokuphatha iingozi nolawulo lovavanyo kwicandelo lwe Supply Chain Management. Phawula zithinte iingozi ngaphakathi kovicwayo. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iingxaki zolawulo, iingxelo neembuzo eqhubekayo zihoywa ngokukhawuleza. Nceda ekwenzeni iingxelo zonyaka zomsebenzi we SCM. Yila uqinisekise onke amanqamlezo amnye we SCM. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa nokuzigcina kolawulo lweenqobo ezikhutshwa yi National Treasury kunye neenkqubo ze Departmental SCM.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Sector-wide Monitoring & Evaluation
jobs.closing_date_text: 09 November 2026 at 16h00. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for sector-wide monitoring and evaluation at the Department of Small Business Development in Pretoria, requiring an NQF level 7 qualification and three years of M&E experience.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) in Demography / Applied Statistics/ Research/ B. Com in Quantitative Management or equivalent / related as recognised by SAQA. Postgraduate qualification in Monitoring & Evaluation would be an added advantage. 3 years’ working experience in M&E/ Research/ Demography and Statistical analysis. Technical knowledge and proof of competencies in at least two of data analysis software for Quantitative such as SPSS, JMP, SAS STATA and for Qualitative analysis i.e Atlas.ti, MAXQDA, and or inVivo would be added advantage. Technical knowledge in Programme monitoring and reporting will also be considered an added advantage. Extensive training in MS Office Packages (Excel, PowerPoint, PowerBI and Word); proof of competencies will be an added advantage. A valid driver’s licence is required (must be willing to travel for the purpose of data collection). Have competencies in: Communication (verbal and written), Research Report writing skills, Qualitative and quantitative research methods skills, Planning and Organising Skills, Presentation and facilitation skills, ICT governance and innovation skills, Monitoring and evaluation skills and Mathematical abilities.
jobs.duties: Provide technical support in testing data against indicators and/or predetermined objectives and in the automation, integration, and sharing of data for multiple user purposes, i.e., planning, reporting, and/or triangulation. Provide evaluation and digital innovation support inclusive of but not limited to pre-testing of the data collection instruments to ensure the data generated responds to the key evaluation questions and prepares reports, provide preliminary inputs into the review and development of M&E frameworks, guidelines, and others based on the development in the M&E domain, participate in the data collection process at the level of monitoring and evaluation etc. Undertake routine monitoring (real-time) of data generated at the level of intervention outputs and outcomes for preparation of independent performance reporting to promote public accountability and provide technical advice on the applicability and responsiveness of quantitative and qualitative data instruments proposed for monitoring and evaluation assignments. Supervise employees, manage performance, conduct and discipline, provide on-the-job job training, and facilitate training and development of supervisees etc. Communicate with stakeholders, clients, management & colleagues: Written, Verbal and formal presentations/workshops/information sessions.
jobs.enquiries: Enquiries for all advertised posts should be directed to the recruitment office on Tel No: (012) 394-5286/43097
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by email to the relevant email and by quoting the relevant reference number provided on the subject line. Acceptable formats for submission of documents are limited to MS Word and PDF. Candidates must submit applications to recruitment4@dsbd.gov.za and quote the reference number for the above-mentioned position in the subject line (email) when applying, i.e. “REF NO: ASD SWM&EI”
jobs.notes: The Department of Small Business Development is committed to the pursuit of diversity and redress, and appointment will be in line with the DSBD EE Plan. Applications must quote the relevant reference number and consist of: A fully completed and signed Z83 form and a recent comprehensive CV. Submission of copies of qualifications, Identity document, and any other relevant documents will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. All non-SA citizens will be required to submit proof of permanent residence in South Africa when shortlisted. Personnel suitability checks will be done during the selection process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not been contacted within 1 month of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. In the pursuit of diversity and redress, appointments will be made in line with the DSBD EE Plan. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement within three months of appointment, as well as complete a financial interest declaration form within one month of appointment and annually thereafter. The Department reserves the right not to fill or withdraw any advertised post. Note: a new application for employment (Z83) form is applicable from 01 January 2021. The new form can be downloaded online at http://www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp. OTHER POST

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Sektorbreed Monitering en Evaluering
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur vir sektorbreed monitering en evaluering by die Department of Small Business Development in Pretoria, wat 'n NQF-vlak 7-kwalifikasie en drie jaar se M&E-ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF level 7) in Demografie / Toegepaste Statistiek / Navorsing / B.Com in Kwantitatiewe Bestuur of ekwivalent / verwant soos erken deur SAQA. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie in Monitering en Evaluering sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 3 jaar se werkservaring in M&E / Navorsing / Demografie en Statistiese ontleding. Tegniese kennis en bewys van bevoegdhede in ten minste twee data-ontledingsagtware vir Kwantitatiewe soos SPSS, JMP, SAS STATA en vir Kwalitatiewe ontleding d.w.s. Atlas.ti, MAXQDA, en/of inVivo sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Tegniese kennis in programmonitering en verslagdoening sal ook as 'n bykomende voordeel beskou word. Uitgebreide opleiding in MS Office-pakette (Excel, PowerPoint, PowerBI en Word); bewys van bevoegdhede sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie word vereis (moet bereid wees om vir die doel van data-insameling te reis). Beskik oor bevoegdhede in: Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), Navorsingsverslag-skryfvaardighede, Kwalitatiewe en kwantitatiewe navorsingsmetode-vaardighede, Beplannings- en organiseervaardighede, Aanbiedings- en fasiliteringsvaardighede, IK-beheer en innovasie-vaardighede, Moniterings- en evalueringsvaardighede en wiskundige vermoëns.
af.duties: Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning in die toetsing van data teen aanwysers en/of voorafbepaalde doelwitte en in die outomatisering, integrasie en deling van data vir veelvuldige gebruikersdoeleindes, d.w.s. beplanning, verslagdoening en/of triangulasie. Verskaf evaluerings- en digitale innovasieondersteuning ingesluit maar nie beperk tot vooraftoetsing van die data-insamelingsinstrumente om te verseker dat die gegenereerde data reageer op die sleutelevalueringsvrae en verslae voorberei, verskaf voorlopige insette in die hersiening en ontwikkeling van M&E-raamwerke, riglyne en andere gebaseer op die ontwikkeling in die M&E-domein, neem deel aan die data-insamelingsproses op die vlak van monitering en evaluering ens. Onderneem roetine-monitering (intyds) van data gegenereer op die vlak van ingryping-uitsette en -uitkomste vir die voorbereiding van onafhanklike prestasieverslagdoening om openbare verantwoordelikheid te bevorder en verskaf tegniese advies oor die toepaslikheid en reaksievermoë van kwantitatiewe en kwalitatiewe data-instrumente voorgestel vir moniterings- en evalueringsopdragte. Superwiseer werknemers, bestuur prestasie, gedrag en dissipline, verskaf werksaangepaste opleiding, en fasiliteer opleiding en ontwikkeling van toesighoudendes ens. Kommunikeer met belanghebbendes, kliënte, bestuur en kollegas: Skriftelik, mondelings en formele aanbiedings/werkswinkels/inligtingsessies.

zu.title: Onjomgugi: Okubhekile Kwezokuhlola Nokuhlola Phakathi Kwezikhungo
zu.summary: Onjomgugi wokuhlola nokuhlola phakathi kwezikhungo e-Department of Small Business Development e-Pretoria, ofuna iziqu ze-NQF level 7 neminyaka emithathu yohlolo kule M&E.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingaphansi kwesiquuphakeme (NQF level 7) kwi-Demography / Applied Statistics/ Research/ B. Com in Quantitative Management noma okufanayo / okuhlobene njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA. Iziqu eziphakeme ngesiquuphakeme kwi-Monitoring & Evaluation zizokuba yinewula enkulu. 3 years’ working experience in M&E/ Research/ Demography and Statistical analysis. Ulwazi lwamakhono nobufakazi bokuziphatha okungenani kuleminye emibili yisoftware yokuhlaziya idatha ye-Quantitative efana ne-SPSS, JMP, SAS STATA nokuhlolwa kwe-Qualitative analysis okunjengi-Atlas.ti, MAXQDA, noma i-inVivo kuzokuba yinewula enkulu. Ulwazi lobuchwepheshe ekubukeni nokubika kuhlelo nakho kuzothathwa njengenewula enkulu. Ukuqeqeshwa okuphelele kumaphakheji we-MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, PowerBI kanye ne-Word); ubufakazi bokuziphatha kuzokuba yinewula enkulu. Kudingeka ibe namalayisensi yokushayela evumelekile (kumele ube nesifofo sokuhamba ngenhloso yokuthutha idatha). ube namakhono okuziphatha okwalawa: Ukuxhumana (okuthi ngomlomo nokubhaliwe), amakhono okubhala umbiko wocwaningo, amakhano abasebenzisa ukucwaninga kobunjingalwazi nokwesibalo, amakhono okuhlela nokuqamba, amakhano asakaza ulwazi nokukhokhela, amakhano okugcina kanye novuselela ngesikhathi somakhalekhukhwini, amakhano okuhlola nokuhlola kanye namakhono ezezezwano.
zu.duties: Nika inkxaso yamakhono obuchwepheshe ekuvivinyeni idatha ngokumelene nezinkomba bese imibuzo eziqhathanisiwe emizamweni ehlelekile, ukuziphendanisa, nokwabelana idatha yezinhloso eziningana zabasebenzisi, ngokwesibonelo, ukuhlela, ukubika, nokuhlanganisa idatha. Nika inkxaso yokuhlola nokuvuselela ngezobuchwepheshe okuhlanganisa kodwa okungakugcini kunqubo yokuvivinya izinsiza ezithutha idatha ngenhloso yokuthi idatha ekhiqiziwe iphendule imibuzo ewulelo ebalulekile futhi ilungiselela imibiko, ukunikeza okokulingene ekubukeni nasekuthuthukisweni imigomo ye-M&E, izinkomba, nezinye okusekelwe ekuthuthukisweni kwesikhungo se-M&E, uthathe inhlangothi enkqweni yokuthutha idatha ngamazinga okuhlola nokuhlola njll. Yenza okuhlola njalo (ngesikhathi sangempela) idatha ekhiqizwe emazinga okuphuma emisebenzi nemiphumela ngenhloso yokuqeqesha ukubikezela ngokuhlenga ngokuzimele ekuthuthukiseni ukuze kube khona ubunikazi bomphakathi bese unika izeluleko ngobuchwepheshe ekusetshenzisweni nasekusabeleni idatha yesibalo esebenzisa isibalo ukuphawula imisebenzi yokuhlola nokuhlola uhlelo. Qondisa abasebenzi, uphathe ukusebenza ngokuphumelelayo, ukuziphatha nobuyekezo emqondweni, unikeze ukuqeqeshwa emsebenzini ngaphandle kwesikhathi esiqondiswayo, bese uyekuqeqesha nokuthuthukisa abantu abaqondiswayo njll. Xhumana nezithakazelo, abathengi, ukulawula nezitha: okubhaliwe, ngomlomo, okungeniswa esigungwini noma osebenzela imigidi yokwazisa noma amakilasi ephakeme.

xh.title: Umlawuli ongenamngangele: Emandla awo wonke woNqumrazihlwele nokuHlola
xh.summary: Umlawuli ongenamngangele wamonitoring nokuhlola kwesiphithiphithi kwi Sebe leNtshukubeleleko yoBuzindlebe kwi Pretoria, lifuna isilinganiso seNQF level 7 kunye neminyaka emithathu yamava aM&E.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-undergraduate (NQF level 7) kwisoLuntu / iziBalo eziSetyenziswayo / uPhando / iB.Com kwisoLawulo esiNani okanye okulinganayo / ahlotyaniswa njengokuqatshwa yiSAQA. Isidanga se-postgraduate kwisoLuntu nokuHlola kuya kuba lusango olongezelelweyo. Iiminyaka emi3 yamava okusebenza kwiM&E / uPhando / isoLuntu nokuHlola ngesiBalo. Ulwazi lolwazi lobuchwepheshe nokubonisa ukuzinza kwemisebenzi kwinkqubo enanciali emunci kwi software yamahlahla amabini obuntlafayelo obunjengoko iSPSS, JMP, SAS STATA nokulunga ukwazi ukwahlola iintlobo ezikwiAtlas.ti, MAXQDA, kwaye okanye iinVivo kuya kuba lusango olongezelelweyo. Ulwazi lolwazi lobuchwepheshe kwisoLuntu sikaqoqosho nokubika nakho kuya kusetyenziswa njengesango olongezelelweyo. Uqeqesho olubanzi kwiinkqubo zeMS Office (iExcel, iPowerPoint, iPowerBI neWord); ukubonisa ukuzinza kuya kuba lusango olongezelelweyo. Ilayisensi esemthethweni yokushayela iyafuneka (kufuneka ulungele ukuhamba ngenjongo yokuthathwa kolwazi). Wakube unolwazi kule nto: ikuTshaya izinto phiwo (ngemilo nangokubhalwayo), amakhono oBhala iingxelo zoPhando, amakhono oPhando oluBuntlafayelo nolwaMathath’lwimi, amakhono oCwangcisa nokuQamba, amakhono oBikelela nokuKhokela, amakhono oBulawa kwentlalo yolwazi lwesixhobo nobungqangi, amakhono oBika nokuHlola iimfuno namandla ezoBalwa.
xh.duties: Nikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe ekuvaviseni idatha ngokuchasene neziyobungozi okanye iinjongo ezithi zigqitywe ngaphambili nakwindalo, intlangano, nokwabelana ngodata ngenjongo zabasebenzisi abaninzi, oko kukuthi, ukuqamba, ukubika, kunye nokudityaniswa. Nikeza inkxaso yokuhlola nobugcwe bokudala obandakanya kodwa akukabekiwe kumda ekuvavweni kwezixhobo zokuthatha idatha ukuze kuqiniseke ukuba idatha ethi yenziwe iphendula iimbuzo ephethwe kukuhlola kwaye ilungise iingxelo, nikeza iimveliso ekuqaleni ekuphononongeni nasekuphuhliseni iinkqubo zeM&E, iindlela zokuqhuba, nezinye ngesiseko sokuqamba kummandla weM&E, thatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yokuthatha idatha kwinqanaba lokubika nokuqonda okuqhuba imisebenzi eyahlukileyo. Yenza umphumo okungenamthengisi oya kuqhubeka nobukhulu bomphumo kwezixhobo ezixhaphakileyo kwinkqubo yemisebenzi yokuzimisela nokubika ngokusebenza okuzimeleyo ukuze kuqatshwe ukuphendula kwentlangano kalawulo ebandakanyekileyo nokuba yinkxaso ngokobugcisa ngokusetyenziswa nokuphendula ngokubukhali okungenampaziso ngokudwelwa kwesicwangciso seM&E. Lawula abasebenzi, lawula ukusebenza, indlela yomsebenzi nokungabi namanyala, nikeza uqeqesho kumsebenzi nangexesha lokusebenza, qeqesha abalawuli ngokuphuhlisa nokubakhokela. Qhagamshela nabantu abathintekileyo, neenkampani, urhulumente ngokubhalwayo, nangokuzithetha ngomlomo ngamathandathu ebandakanya amawebhusayithi nesezibizo zeemfundo ezahlukileyo.

jobs.title: Cleaner
jobs.summary: Cleaner position at the SAPS National Operational Command Centre performing routine cleaning, housekeeping, gardening and refreshment duties.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must display competency in the core functions of the post. Be proficient in at least English and one other official language. Be a citizen of the Republic of South Africa of which documentary proof must be furnished on the day of the interview. Be in possession of ABET Level 4/ Grade 9/ Standard 7/ NQF Level 1 for which documentary proof can be produced when required. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies. Understanding of how to handle cleaning detergents. Occupational Health and Safety protocol. Basic literacy, numeracy and communication skills. Be able to read and write; Ability to interact with other officials in a professional manner. The ability to operate elementary machines and equipment; Willing to work extended hours when necessary.
jobs.duties: Perform routine cleaning services. Render store, stock and equipment support, inclusive of loading and offloading equipment from vehicles. Render gardening services. Execute and maintain housekeeping duties in and around assigned premises. Prepare and serve refreshments. Organize and keep the kitchen hygienically clean. Contribute to the purchasing of stock. Transport members/personnel/safely to desired location. Collect and deliver vehicle/ equipment/documents between venues/offices.
jobs.enquiries: Mrs. M Clark Tel No: (012) 493 5659
jobs.applications: Direct your application to the following addresses: SAPS Academy, Tshwane, No 1 Rebecca Street, Pretoria West email to ClarkeM@saps.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a Z83 Form (2021 version), obtainable from http://www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp, which must be accompanied with a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae. The post particulars and reference number of the post you are applying for, must be correctly specified on the application form. Please complete a separate application form for each post you wish to apply for. It is the responsibility of the applicants to submit applications timeously to the correct physical address as provided in the advertisement. Please note that applications submitted to an incorrect physical address will not be considered. Late applications will not be accepted or considered. Short-listed candidates will be required to produce originals of their Identity Document (ID), Senior Certificate and all educational qualifications obtained, service certificates from previous employers stating the occupation and motor vehicle driver’s license, before the interview. Qualifications and driver’s licences submitted will be subjected to verification with the relevant institutions. Applicants must have no previous criminal convictions or pending criminal/ departmental cases and shall allow their fingerprints to be taken and background enquiries to be made. Short-listed candidates may be subjected to a full security clearance process before or during any stage of employment. Short-listed candidates will be subjected to a vetting process which will include security screening, fingerprint screening, reference checking and verification of address, where necessary. All short-listed candidates, including the SMS, will be expected to undergo a personal interview and shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, (a) a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, as well as (b) an integrity assessment (ethical conduct).Short-listed candidates for appointments to certain identified posts will be vetted in terms of the Criminal Law (Sexual Offences and Related Matters) Amendment Act, 2007 (Act No 32 of 2007) and the Children’s Act, 2005 (Act No 38 of 2005). A candidate whose particulars appear in either the National Register for Sex Offenders or Part B of the Child Protection Register, will be disqualified from appointment. Candidates are expected to disclose if he/ she is a respondent in an interim or final protection order in terms of the Domestic Violence Act, 1998 (Act no 116 of 1998) or Protection from Harassment Act, 2011 (Act No 17 of 2011), and may be disqualified from appointment. The Criminal Law (Forensic Procedures) Amendment Act, Act 37 of 2013 requires that all new appointments in the South African Police Service as from 31 January 2015 provide a buccal (inside cheek) sample to determine their forensic DNA profile. The forensic DNA profile derived from the sample will be loaded to the Elimination Index of the National Forensic DNA Database. Appointments will be made in terms of the Public Service Act, 1994 (Act No 103 of 1994) as applicable to the post environment. Persons who retired from the Public Service by taking a severance package, early retirement or medical retirement, as well as persons with previous convictions, are excluded. The South African Police Service is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer and it is the intention to promote representivity in the Public Service through the filling of these posts. Persons whose transfer/ appointment will promote representivity will therefore receive preference. The South African Police Service is under no obligation to fill a post after the advertisement thereof. Correspondence will be conducted with successful candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Skoonmaker
af.summary: Skoonmakerpos by die SAPS National Operational Command Centre wat roetine-skoonmaak, huishouding, tuinwerk en verkwikkingpligte verrig.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet bevoegdheid in die kernfunksies van die pos toon. Wees vaardig in ten minste Engels en een ander amptelike taal. Wees 'n burger van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika waarvan dokumentêre bewys op die dag van die onderhoud verskaf moet word. Beskik oor ABET Level 4/ Grade 9/ Standard 7/ NQF Level 1 waarvoor dokumentêre bewys voorgeleë kan word wanneer dit vereis word. Kennis, Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede. Begrip van hoe om skoonmaakmiddels te hanteer. Beroepsgesondheid- en Veiligheidsprotokol. Basiese geletterdheid, syferkundigheid en Kommunikasievaardighede. Wees in staat om te lees en te skryf; Vermoë om op 'n professionele wyse met ander amptenare te kommunikeer. Die vermoë om elementêre masjiene en toerusting te bedryf; Bereid om indien nodig verlengde ure te werk.
af.duties: Verrig roetine-skoonmaakdienste. Verskaf winkel-, voorraad- en toerustingondersteuning, insluitend die laai en aflaai van toerusting van voertuie. Verskaf tuinwerksdienste. Voer huishoudelike pligte in en om toegewysde persele uit en onderhou dit. Berei en bedien verkwikkings voor. Organiseer en hou die kombuis higiënies skoon. Dra by tot die aankoop van voorraad. Vervoer lede/personeel/veilig na gewenste bestemming. Haal en besorg voertuig/ toerusting/dokumente tussen plekke/kantore.

zu.title: Umdidiyeli
zu.summary: Isikhundla somdidiyeli eSAPS National Operational Command Centre sokwenza imisebenzi ejwayelekile yokuhlanza, ukugcina indlu, ukulima nesimo sendalo kanye nemisebenzi yokuletha okuphuzwayo.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babonise ukukwazi ukwenza imisebenzi ebalulekile yesikhundla. Bakhone kahle ngokolimi laseNgilani nolunye ulimi olusemthethweni okungenani. Babe ngabakwethu beRiphabhuliki yaseNingizimu Afrika okuyilabo abayokuletha ubufakazi ngosuku lokuxoxisana. Babe ne-ABET Level 4/ Grade 9/ Standard 7/ NQF Level 1 lapho okuyikhona abakwazi ukuletha ubufakazi lapho kudingeka khona. Ulwazi, Amakhono nobukwazi. Ukuqonda ukuthi kusebenza kanjani amakhemikhali okuhlanzela. Inqubo yoYezempiro Nokuphepha Kwezomsebenzi. Amakhono okufunda, okubala nokuxhumana. Ukukwazi ukufunda nokubhala; Ukukwazi ukuxhumana nabanye abasebenzi ngendlela ehloniphekile. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa imishini nezinye izinto ezenziwa ngesandla; Ukuqonda ukusebenza amahora amaningi lapho kudingeka khona.
zu.duties: Yenza imisebenzi ejwayelekile yokuhlanza. Nikela ngokusekela ukugcina izinto, impahla nemishini, okuhlanganisa nokufaka nokukhipha imishini kwezimoto. Nikela ngemisebenzi yokulima nesimo sendalo. Yenza futhi ugcine imisebenzi yokugcina indlu ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwezindawo onikeziwe. Lungele futhi uphuthe ukudla okuphuzwayo. Hlela futhi ugcigcise indlu yokupheka ibe mhlophe. Ususe ekuthathweni kwempahla. Hamba nabasebenzi/abantu/ikhaya ngesikhathi esiphephile kuleyo ndawo abayifunayo. Thola futhi ufake izimoto/impahla/amadokhumenti phakathi kwezindlu/ofisi.

xh.title: Umcoci
xh.summary: Isithuba somcoci kwiSAPPS National Operational Command Centre ngokwenza umsebenzi wokucotha wonyuso, ukuhlohlela izindlu, ukulima indalo kwaye nenziwe ukubonelela ngokusela.
xh.requirements: Abafake isicelo kufunke babonise ukuzenzela kumsebenzi osemgqeni wesithuba. Bakwazi ukuzenzela ngeelwimi ezisemthethweni eziliNgesi kunye nolunye ulwimi linye. Babe ngabemi benkululeko yaseMzantsi Afrika abo baya kuphononwa ngemibhalo yabo ngosuku lokuba ngefowuni. Babe ngeABET Level 4/ Grade 9/ Standard 7/ NQF Level 1 eya kuziswa imibalo xa kufuneka. Ulwazi, amakhono, nokuzenzela. Ukuqonda indlela yokusebenzisa amacheda okuhlamba. I-OHS protocols. Ukufunda okusesiseko, ukubala, kunye nakhono oluqeqesha ulwazi. Bakwazi ukufunda nokubhala; Ukuba nakhono lokuthetha nabanye abasebenzi ngendlela echanekileyo. Amandla okusebenzisa iimpahla zomveliso; Ukulungele ukusebenza iiyure ezongezelelweyo.
xh.duties: Yenza imisebenzi yokucotha. Bonelela ngokuxhasa iindawo zokugcina, ukugcina, nezosebenzo nezixhobo, ngokubandakanya ukufaka nokukhupha izixhobo kwizithuthi. Bonelela ngemisebenzi yendalo. Yenza kwaye ugcine umsebenzi wokuhlohlela izindlu ngaphakathi nangaphaya kwindawo. Lungisa kwaye wahlule ixesha lokutyhela amacheda. Qamba kwaye ugcine kukhona iindawo ezicothileyo ezikwiKhitshi. jobs.title: Assistant Director: Departmental Performance Monitoring
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 per annum (Level 09), excludes service benefits
jobs.closing_date_text: 06 November 2026 by 16:30 (Late applications will not be considered)
jobs.summary: Assistant Director role in the Department of Tourism coordinating departmental performance monitoring and reporting, based in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: A recognised NQF Level 6 qualification in Social Sciences/ Management/ Business Administration/ Public Administration or equivalent qualification. 3-4 years’ experience in strategic planning, performance monitoring and reporting of which 2 years must be at a senior practitioner level or equivalent. Knowledge of organisational performance management system. Knowledge of eQPRS. Attention to details. Deadline-driven. Ability to work under pressure. Ability to gather and analyse information. Ability to develop and apply policies. Government Planning (Legislation and Cycle). Government Reporting (Legislation and Cycle). Legislative and Regulatory Framework: Public Finance Management Act, 1999 as Amended (PFMA). Treasury Regulations of 2005 as amended. Framework for Strategic Plans and Annual Performance Plans from the National Treasury 2010. National Treasury Framework for Managing Programmes Performance Information. 2007. Guidelines for the preparation of the Annual Report. Performance Information Handbook; Policy Framework for the government-Wide Monitoring and Evaluation System. Guidelines on the Preparation of Quarterly Performance Reports. All applicable directives from relevant authorities. Monitoring and Reporting procedures. Information Security Policies. Administrative procedures. Knowledge of analysing, interpreting, monitoring, evaluation and reporting performance information. Knowledge of policy development, analysis and implementation. Good communication skills (verbal and written). Organisational, Planning and Co- ordination skills. Ability to work individually and in a team. Facilitation and presentation skills. Good interpersonal relations skills. Analytical and Research skills. Financial Management. Project Management. Personnel Management. Computer literacy. Problem-solving skills. Creative thinking. Innovation. Sense of responsibility. Initiative. Conflict resolution.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for coordinating the submission of organisational performance reports in line with the PFMA and Treasury Regulations; Coordinating communication with all branches with regards to their reporting requirement; Compiling of the departmental quarterly performance reports to National Treasury and the DPME through eQPRS; Compiling of ad hoc reports that the Department might be requested to submit to The Presidency, Public Service Commission (PSC), National Treasury, Parliament etc; Coordinating of the alignment of organisational performance management practices in the Department with organisational performance practices in the public service; Coordinating Organisational Performance Management Monitoring and Reporting; Coordinating communication with all branches regarding performance monitoring and compliance with legislative requirements; Coordinating the collection of quarterly performance progress reports on the implementation of the departmental strategic plan from branches; Coordinating the analysis of quarterly performance reports received from branches for accuracy, completeness, validity of reported performance information and level of performance against pre-set performance indicators and targets; Coordinating and compilation of the annual performance report; Coordinating the compilation of the Director-General’s Annual performance Report to Presidency; Performing other related duties as may be assigned by the Deputy Director: Monitoring and Reporting; Coordinating the compilation of the in-year and end year (quarterly and annual) performance information reports; Preparing the performance information for presentation to the Executive Authority, Accounting Officer, Portfolio Committee, Audit Committee, Branch Managers, and SMS; Coordinating management of an effective and efficient organisational performance management system; Developing of an Organisational performance Management System for the Department; Continuous review of the Organizational performance Management Framework for the Department, which includes policies, procedures and guidelines; Coordinating the maintenance of an electronic database and hard copy files for all materials and information collected and/or produced (Knowledge Management System/EDMS); Continuous development and maintenance of an organisational performance management system for the Department of Tourism; Embedding a culture of accountability in terms of reporting against set targets; Developing and maintenance of adequate control measures for effectiveness and efficiency of the business performance management function; Developing and revise of organisational performance management instruments (e.g. templates); Providing all users with access to organisational performance system; Coordinating the development and maintenance of a reliable database of all stakeholders; Maintaining and update of the organisational performance management check list and reporting schedule covering all reporting requirements; Coordinating and management of organisational performance management audits; Providing inputs for the continuous improvement of the performance management guidelines for consolidation; Developing a monitoring and reporting schedule; Developing a reporting template for the branches’ quarterly reports; Uploading final departmental reports and relevant documents on EDMS
jobs.enquiries: Ms Mantsho Moloantoa Tel No: (012) 444 6737 APPLICATION : Recruitment5926@tourism.gov.za
jobs.applications: Applications, quoting the relevant reference number, must be forwarded to the attention of Chief Director: HR Management and Development at Department of Tourism, Private Bag X424, Pretoria, 0001, or hand delivered at Tourism House, 17 Trevenna Road, Sunnyside, Pretoria, or by email as provided.
jobs.notes: EE Requirements: Coloured Male and White Male candidates as well as Youth and People with Disabilities are encouraged to apply. Application must include a Z83 form and CV only. The electronic application must be in PDF format and made up of a single document file. Indicate the correct job title and the reference number of the post on the subject line of your email. Applications quoting the relevant reference number must be submitted on the new form Z83, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents. Received applications using the incorrect application for employment (old Z83) will not be considered. Each post(s) advert must be accompanied by its own application form for employment and must be fully completed, initialled, and signed by the applicant as instructed below. Failure to fully complete, initial, and sign the Z83 form will lead to the disqualification of the application during the selection process. All fields of Section A, B, C, and D of the Z83 must be completed in full. Section E, F, G (Due to the limited space on the Z83, it is acceptable for applicants to refer to their CV or see attached. However, the question related to conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part “F” must be answered, and the declaration signed. Only an updated comprehensive CV (with detailed previous experience, if any) and a completed and signed new Z83 application form are required. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview, following the communication from Human Resources, and such qualifications (s) and other related documents (s) will be in line with the requirements of the advert. Applicants in possession of foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) (only when shortlisted). Applicants who do not comply with the abovementioned instructions/ requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Candidates will further be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification, and employment verification). Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Appointment validity will be conditional to signing of the employment contract, performance agreement, and annual financial disclosure, and must attain a security clearance (vetting) applicable to the post. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment. You are consenting to the Department of Tourism processing your personal information, subject to POPIA, by applying for this post. Ukulawula nokuqokelela iNxelo loNyaka loQhagra; Ukulawula ukuqokelelwa kweNxelo loNyaka loMqwebi-Jikelele kumongameli; Ukwenza omnye umsebenzi ongathunyelwa nguMqwebi oNgangele: ukuQwalaselwa nokuyila iNxelo; Ukulawula ukuqokelelwa kweNxelo ngokuhamba kweminyaka nokuphela kwayo (ngenyanga nangonyaka); Ukulungiselela iinkcukacha zeNxelo eziza kuboniswa kuGunya eLawulayo, kuMphathi we-Akhowunti, kuQela lePortifolio, kuQela loQwalaselo, kuBaquqi beSebe naku-SMS; Ukulawula ukulawula iNkqubo esebenzayo nesemthethweni yoQhagra; Ukuqamba iNkqubo yoQhagra yesebe; Ukulawula ukuhlaziya iNkqubo yoQhagra yesebe, equka iinkqubo, iinkqubo neenkqubo eziluncedo; Ukulawula ukugcina isikhalazo sesikhwameni esibhaliweyo namafayela ezicwangcisiweyo zamagazathi amaxwebhu axelwe; Ukuqhubeka nokugcina iNkqubo yoQhagra yesebe lezokuQhagra; Ukulungelelanisa inkqubo yamava ngokubaluleka kokuxela ngokumilinganiselo obekiweyo; Ukwenza nokugcina iinkqubo zolawulo ezisebenzayo ukuze kuqwalaselwe ukusebenza kwalo; Ukwenza nokulungisa izixhobo zoQhagra (umz. iindlela ezilungiselelwe iindawo ezahlukeneyo); Ukubonelela abo bonke abasetyenzisi ngendlela yokungena kwenkqubo yeNkqubo yoQhagra; Ukulawula ukwenza nokugcina isikhwameni esibhaliweyo sabo bonke abathathi nxaxheba; Ukugcina nokuhlaziya uluhlu lokuQwalaselwa kweNkqubo yoQhagra noluHlu lokwenza iNxelo eziza kubonelelwa ngemfuno; Ukulawula nokuqamba amaQhagra aQwalaselwa eNkqubo; Ukubonelela izimvo ngeNkqubo yokuphucula iinkqubo zokuQwalaselwa; Ukwenza iNkqubo yokuyila iNxelo; Ukwenza iNkqubo yeNkqubo yeNkqubo yokubonisa iNxelo ngokuhamba kwamakota ayo; Ukulayisha iinxelo zangemva zemiba kunye namaxwebhu ahambelanayo kwi-EDMS.

jobs.title: Director: Financial Performance (2,3A,B,C)
jobs.summary: Director of Financial Performance at National Treasury in Pretoria, requiring a finance degree and five years of managerial experience in financial management.
jobs.requirements: A minimum Grade 12, coupled with a Bachelor’s Degree (equivalent to NQF level 7) is required in Accounting or Finance. CFA/CA will be an added advantage. A minimum 5 years’ experience at a middle or senior managerial level obtained in a financial environment, or public sector environment. Knowledge of the broader financial management framework. Knowledge and experience of analysing financial reports, business and strategic plans. Knowledge of the PFMA, Treasury Regulations and the Public Entities policy framework. Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government available as an online course on https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, prior to finalisation of an appointment.
jobs.duties: Review and implement any legislative and other Treasury’s Reporting requirements in terms of the Public Finance Management Act and Treasury Regulations: Participate in key legislative and policy reforms related to these entities and contribute through formal written input and other stakeholder engagement. Participate in key discussions related to Instruction Notes and updates and where possible, identify challenges with existing Instruction Notes and entity compliance by making submissions to the relevant authority such as the Office of the Accountant General. Stay abreast of any policy and treasury reporting requirements and be a key interface with entities to ensure compliance. Direct the formulation and implementation of governance, monitoring and reporting frameworks. Financial Analysis and Reporting: Evaluate Strategic Plans, Corporate Plans, Shareholders Agreements, Annual Performance plans for Public Entities reporting to the Minister of Finance. Analyse Public Entities expenditure trends and monitor financial management and performance in Public Entities as prescribed by the PFMA and Treasury Regulations. Provide financial inputs in relation to PFMA applications and other functions within the Chief Directorate. Evaluate annual reports of Public Entities reporting to the Minister and Monitor the performance as well as alignment with set objectives and programmes. Direct the formulation and implementation of governance, monitoring and reporting frameworks. Budget Analysis, review of annual budget allocations: Review and assess Public Entities Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE), Adjusted Estimates of National Expenditure (AENE) budget allocations. Draft chapters and provide inputs relevant to the ENE. Review, research, analysis of fiscal implications and engage through submissions on public entities in alignment with legislation, regulation, policy proposals, and service delivery trends. Prepare submissions and engage the Chief Financial Officer on retention and roll-overs of surplus funds. Lead the development and implementation of financial performance oversight strategies for public entities reporting to the Minister of Finance. Stakeholder relations: Engage SOC’s and liaise on the provision of information, inputs and recommendations. Provide advice to the Director-General and Minister on Cabinet Memoranda, Ministerial correspondence pertaining to Public Entities. Contribute to NT publications, MTBPS, Budget Review, and ENE.
jobs.enquiries: enquiries only (No applications): Recruitment.Enquries@treasury.gov.za OTHER POSTS
jobs.applications: To apply visit: https://erecruitment.treasury.gov.za/eRecruitment
jobs.notes: Effective from 7 April 2021, the National Treasury now utilises an e-Recruitment System which means all applicants must login/register to apply for positions, we only accept hand delivered/posted applications should an applicant prove that he/she tried to apply via e-Recruitment with no success and the National Treasury ICT unit was unable to assist. The applicant’s profile on the e- Recruitment is equivalent to the newly approved Z83, and it is the responsibility of applicants to ensure their profiles are fully completed or their applications will not be considered, as per the DPSA Practice Note. Certain documentation will still be required to be uploaded on the system such as copies of all qualifications including National Senior Certificate/Matric certificate, ID, etc., however these documents need not be certified at point of application, however certification will be required prior to attending the interview. Please note: All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. It should be noted that the National Treasury does not support the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in any of its recruitment and selection processes and will disqualify an application if it picks up the use of AI when completing assessments without acknowledging the source of information. Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government, available as an online course on        https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, prior to finalisation of appointment, is a requirement for all SMS positions. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All qualifications, criminal and SA citizenship checks will be conducted on all short-listed candidates and, where applicable, additional checks will be conducted in line with the new DPSA Directive effective 01 April 2024. Please note that by responding to our advertisement/s, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information for internal HR processes in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), Act No. 4 of 2013. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have all their foreign qualifications (this includes O and A level certificates) evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), at your own expense. Upon appointment, successful candidates will be required to disclose particulars of all registrable financial interests and to sign a Performance Agreement within 3 months from date of appointment and for candidates whose appointment exceeds 12 calendar months will be appointed on probation for the period of twelve (12) calendar months excluding leave taken as prescribed by Public Service Regulation 68. The status of your application will be visible on the e-Recruitment system. However, if you have not received feedback from the National Treasury within 3 months of the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Note: The National Treasury reserves the right not to fill the below-mentioned posts, withdraw or to put on hold a position and/or to re-advertise a post. All queries must be submitted via email addressed to the Human Resources Recruitment Support Team on Recruitment.Enquiries@treasury.gov.za. af.title: Direkteur: Finansiële Werkverrigting (2,3A,B,C)
af.summary: Direkteur van Finansiële Werkverrigting by National Treasury in Pretoria, wat 'n finansiesgraad en vyf jaar se bestuurservaring in finansiële bestuur vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van Graad 12, tesame met 'n Baccalaureusgraad (gelykstaande aan NQF-vlak 7) in Rekeningkunde of Finansies word vereis. CFA/CA sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n middel- of seniorbestuursvlak wat in 'n finansiële omgewing of openbaresektor-omgewing opgedoen is. Kennis van die breër finansiële bestuursraamwerk. Kennis en ervaring van die ontleding van finansiële verslae, besigheids- en strategiese planne. Kennis van die PFMA, Tesourie-regulasies en die beleidsraamwerk vir Openbare Entiteite. Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme soos deur die National School of Government goedgekeur, beskikbaar as 'n aanlyn kursus op https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, voor die finalisering van 'n aanstelling.
af.duties: Hersien en implementeer enige wetgewende en ander Tesourie se verslagdoeningsvereistes ingevolge die Public Finance Management Act en Tesourie-regulasies: Neem deel aan sleutel wetgewende en beleidshervormings wat verband hou met hierdie entiteite en dra by deur formele geskrewe insette en ander belanghebbende-betrokkenheid. Neem deel aan sleutelbesprekings wat verband hou met Instruksienotas en opdaterings en waar moontlik, identifiseer uitdagings met bestaande Instruksienotas en entiteitsnakoming deur voorleggings aan die betrokke gesag soos die Office of the Accountant General te doen. Bly op hoogte van enige beleids- en tesourie-verslagdoeningsvereistes en tree op as 'n sleutelkoppelvlak met entiteite om nakoming te verseker. Stuur die formulering en implementering van bestuurs-, moniterings- en verslagdoeningsraamwerke. Finansiële Ontleding en Verslagdoening: Evalueer Strategiese Planne, Korporatiewe Planne, Aandeelhouersooreenkomste en Jaarlikse Werkverrigtingsplanne vir Openbare Entiteite wat aan die Minister van Finansies verslag doen. Ontleed bestedingsneigings van Openbare Entiteite en monitor finansiële bestuur en werkverrigting in Openbare Entiteite soos voorgeskryf deur die PFMA en Tesourie-regulasies. Verskaf finansiële insette met betrekking tot PFMA-toepassings en ander funksies binne die Hoofdirektoraat. Evalueer jaarverslae van Openbare Entiteite wat aan die Minister verslag doen en monitor die werkverrigting sowel as belyning met vasgestelde doelwitte en programme. Stuur die formulering en implementering van bestuurs-, moniterings- en verslagdoeningsraamwerke. Begrotingsontleding, hersiening van jaarlikse begrotings-toekenninge: Hersien en assesseer Openbare Entiteite se Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE), Adjusted Estimates of National Expenditure (AENE) begrotingstoekenninge. Opstel van hoofstukke en verskaf van insette wat relevant is tot die ENE. Hersien, ondersoek en ontleding van fiskale implikasies en betrek deur voorleggings oor openbare entiteite in ooreenstemming met wetgewing, regulasie, beleidsvoorstelle en diensleweringstendense. Berei voorleggings voor en betrek die Chief Financial Officer oor die behoud en oorrol van surplusfondse. Lei die ontwikkeling en implementering van finansiële werkverrigtingsoorsigstrategieë vir openbare entiteite wat aan die Minister van Finansies verslag doen. Belanghebbende-verhoudings: Betrek SOC's en skakel oor die verskaffing van inligting, insette en aanbevelings. Verskaf advies aan die Direkteur-generaal en Minister oor Kabinetsmemoranda, Ministeriële korrespondensie rakende Openbare Entiteite. Dra by tot NT-publikasies, MTBPS, Budget Review en ENE.

zu.title: Umqondisi: Imikhuba Yezimali (2,3A,B,C)
zu.summary: Umqondisi Wezimali e-National Treasury e-Pretoria, edinga idiploma yezimali kanye neminyaka eyihlanu yomkhankaso wokuphatha ngendlela yokuphathwa kwezimali.
zu.requirements: Okuncane ibe ngu-Grade 12, kuhambisana ne-Bachelor's Degree (elingana no-NQF level 7) kudingeka kwi-Accounting noma i-Finance. I-CFA/CA izoba yinenzuzo engeziwe. Okuncane iminyaka eyi-5 yokusebenza ezingeni eliphakathi noma eliphezulu lokuqondisa itholwe endaweni yezimali, noma endaweni yomphakathi. Ulwazi mayelana nomgomo ongokommandla wokuphathwa kwezimali. Ulwazi kanye nokuqapha imibiko yezimali, amaphulo amabhizinisi nezindlela eziyisinqubomgomo. Ulwazi nge-PFMA, izimiso ze-Treasury, nomgomo wezinhlangano zomphakathi. Ukuphothula ngokuphumelelayo iNyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme njengoba kunconywa yi-National School of Government kuyatholakala njengesifundo ku-inthanethi ku-https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, ngaphambi kokugqiba ukumiswa komuntu.
zu.duties: Hlola futhi usebenzise noma yisiphi isidingo sezomthetho kanye nezinye izidingo zokubika ze-Treasury ngokwe-Public Finance Management Act kanye nezimiso ze-Treasury: Bamba iqhaza ekwenziweni kwemithetho kanye namaguqulo amakhulu enqubomgomo ahlobene nalezinye izikhungo, futhi ungene ngomqondo ngokubhala ngokusesimweni kanye nokunye ukuxhumana nabalingani. Bamba iqhaza kumihingqo ebalulekile ehlobene nama-Instruction Notes kanye namabalomhlabasha, futhi lapho kunesikhathi, thola izinselele ezikhona kuma-Instruction Notes okwamanje kanye nokuhambisana kwesikhungo ngokwenza izithakazelo ebona izigaba ezihlobene njengenhloko yama-Accountant General. Gcina ulwazi nganoma yisiphi isidingo senqubomgomo kanye nokubika kwe-treasury, futhi ube isixhumi esibalulekile kumakhungo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kuhambisana. Hola ekwakheni kwayesenzeni imigomo yokuphathwa, ukubuka nokubika. Ukuhlaziya izimali nokubika: Hlola ama-Strategic Plans, ama-Corporate Plans, ama-Shareholders Agreements, nama-Annual Performance plans ayikhungo azibika kwaMinista Wezimali. Hlaziya amathrendi wezimali ezikhundleni ezitholakala ngomphakathi futhi ubuke ukuphathwa kwezimali kanye nemikhuba kulezo zikhundla njengoba kuqunyiwe yi-PFMA kanye nezimiso ze-Treasury. Nikeza izindingo ezihlobene nezimali ngokufaka i-PFMA kanye namanye omsebenzi ngaphakathi kwe-Chief Directorate. Hlola imibiko yonyaka yezikhundla ezitholakala ngomphakathi ezibika kwaMinista futhi ubuke imikhuba kanye nokuqondana nezinhlilo ezibekiwe kanye namaphulo. Hola ekwakheni kwayesenzeni imigomo yokuphathwa, ukubuka nokubika. Ukuhlaziya ibhajethi, ukuhlola ukwabiwa kwebhajethi yonyaka: Hlola futhi uhlole ama-Public Entities Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), ama-Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE), kanye nokwabiwa kwebhajethi ye-Adjusted Estimates of National Expenditure (AENE). Bhala izahluko futhi nikeza izindingo ezihlobene ne-ENE. Hlola, ucime ulwazi, ukuhlaziya imiphumela yezimali futhi uxhumane ngemithetho mayelana nezikhundla ngomphakathi ukuze zihambisane nomthetho, izimiso, izinkulumo-mpendulo zenqubomgomo, namathrendi okulethwa izinsiza. Lungiselela izithakazelo futhi uxhumane no-Chief Financial Officer mayelana nokugcina nokushintsha izimali ezele. Hola ekuthuthukiseni nasekuqaliseni amasu okuqapha imikhuba yezimali kwizikhundla ezibika kwaMinista Wezimali. Izinto ezingaba naye ubudlelwano nabo: Xhumana nama-SOC futhi uxhumane mayelana nokuNikeza ulwazi, izindingo kanye nezincomo. Nikeza izincomo ku-Director-General kanye naMongameli mayelana nama-Cabinet Memoranda, ukubhalelwa uMongameli okuhlobene nezikhundla ezitholakala ngomphakathi. Basize ekushicilelweni kwe-NT, MTBPS, Budget Review, kanye ne-ENE.

xh.title: Umphathi: Ukusebenza Kolwangcwelet-imali (2,3A,B,C)
xh.summary: Umphathi wokuSebenza kolwangcwelet-imali kwi-National Treasury ePretoria, efuna isidanga kumazwemali kunye neminyaka emihlanu yamava obalulekile ekulawulweni kolwangcwelet-imali.
xh.requirements: Ungangaphantsi kwe-Grade 12, edibene ne-Bachelor's Degree (elingana nenoqondo lwe-NQF level 7) kufuneka kwi-Accounting okanye i-Finance. I-CFA/CA iya kuba yoncedo olongeziweyo. Amava angaphantsi kweminyaka emi-5 kwinqanaba eliphakathi okanye eliphezulu lokuLawula afunyenwe kwimeko yamafa, okanye kwimeko yalwesikhundla sabantu. Ulwazi malunga neyona nkqubo elawula ulwangcwelet-imali. Ulwazi namava okuhlola iingxelo zamafa, iinkqubo zoshishino nezicwangciso ezibalulekileyo. Ulwazi nge-PFMA, i-Treasury Regulations nolwazi lwenkqubo yemigaqo yamagunyazwe aliqela. Ukugqibela ngempumelelo i-Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme njengokuqinisekiswa yi-National School of Government, efunyenwe njengesifundo kwi-intanethi kwi-https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, phambi kokugqibeka kokumiswe komntu kwisikhundla.
xh.duties: Khangela uze uphumeze nayiphi na i-mithetho naxa kukho emanye iimfuno zokubika ze-Treasury ngokwe-Public Finance Management Act nokuqulunqwa kwe-Treasury Regulations. Thatha inxaxheba kwizinto ezibalulekileyo zokulungisa umthetho namagunyazwe axhobe kwezi nzimbi kwaye ungene ngemveliso ngesicatshulwa esesiqinisekisiweyo nakunye nokuqhathaniswa nabanye abantu. Thatha inxaxheba kwizicwangciso ezimalunga ne-Instruction Notes nanakuguqulwa kwaye apho kunokwenzeka khona, chonga iingxaki ezikhoyo kwi-Instruction Notes nakulandelwa kwemigaqo yamagunyazwe ngokwenza izicelo kwigunya elichaphazelekayo njengase-Office of the Accountant General. Hlala ulwazi malunga nayiphi na imigaqo nemiqulu yokubika yetreasury kwaye ube ngumthombo ophakamileyo woxhumo namagunyazwe ukuqinisekisa ukulandelwa kwemigaqo. Qonda ukwenziwa nokuphumezwwa kweekhomisho zolawulo, okuqwalaselwa nokubika. Ukuhlalutya kwamafa Nokubika: Qwalasela iStrategic Plans, iCorporate Plan, iShareholders Agreements, iAnnual Performance plans zamagunyazwe apheleleyo abikela uNgangezimali. Hlalutya iindlela zokuSebenzisa amafa kwamagunyazwe apheleleyo uze ulawule ulwangcwelet-imali nokusebenza kwawo njengoko kumiswe yi-PFMA nakuqulunqwa kwe-Treasury Regulations. Nikeza iziphakamiso zamafa ngokumayelana nezicelo ze-PFMA namanye umsebenzi ngaphakathi kwe-Chief Directorate. Qwalasela iingxelo zaminyaka yamagunyazwe apheleleyo abikela uNgangezimali uze ulawule ukusebenza kunye noyilo lweenhloso neenkqubo ezibekiweyo. Qonda ukwenziwa nokuphumezwaa kweekhomisho zolawulo, okuqwalaselwa nokubika. Ukuhlalutya lweBajeti, ukuKhangela i-annual budget allocations: Khangela uze uqwalasele i-Public Entities Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), i-Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE), i-Adjusted Estimates of National Expenditure (AENE) budget allocations. Bhala iisahluko uze unike iziphakamiso ezichaphazelekayo kwi-ENE. Khangela, uphando, ukuhlalutya iimpembelelo zamafa kwaye uthathe inxaxheba ngenkqubo yesicelo kwamagunyazwe apheleleyo ukuze uqambe nomthetho, uqulunqo, iziphakamiso zamagunyazwe, nokuqhubeka kokwabiwo kweenkonzo. Lungiselela izicelo kwaye uthathe inxaxheba kwi-Chief Financial Officer malunga nogcino nokugqibela kweemali ezongezelelwayo. Qonda ukuphuhliswa nokuphumezwaa kweekhomisho zokuqwalasela ukusebenza kwamafa zamagunyazwe apheleleyo abikela uNgangezimali. Ubudlelwane nabantu abachaphazelekayo: Thatha inxaxheba kwi-SOC's uze uqhagamshelane malunga nokunikwa kolwazi, iziphakamiso neezindululo. Nikeza ingcebiso ku-Director-General naku-Ngangezimali malunga ne-Cabinet Memoranda, izindululo ze-Ngangezimali ezichaphazela amagunyazwe apheleleyo. Ngenisa isandla kumaphephandaba e-NT, i-MTBPS, i-Budget Review, naku-ENE.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: International & Property TAX Design
jobs.summary: Deputy Director role at National Treasury in Pretoria focusing on international and property tax design policy, requiring a law or accounting degree and tax treaty experience.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 is required coupled with a Bachelor’s degree (equivalent to NQF level 7) in Law or Accounting or International Tax. A minimum 4 years’ experience of which 2 years should be on an Assistant Director level or equivalent obtained in International Tax and Business Tax Law practices. Knowledge and experience in international tax treaties. Knowledge and experience in negotiations of treaties and the drafting of agreements. Experience in editing of drafter notes and compilation of legal documents.
jobs.duties: International Tax Amendments (Cross-Border): Assist and provide input into the development of design policy options for cross- border legislation – including transfer pricing and CFC rules, for example. Research information pertaining to the improvement and refinement of taxation in respect of cross- border activities. Provide inputs to draft documents and discussion papers supporting cross-border tax issues for public or internal release. Gather supporting information on stakeholders’ needs pertaining to policy development on issues impacting international tax legislative amendments. Base Erosion and Profit Shifting (BEPS): Initiate research, investigate, review, analyses on the adoption of the BEPS Action Plan. Assist with South Africa with ensuring that the related anti-avoidance legislation remains fit for purpose. Assist with South African peer review mechanism as required in terms of the BEPS Action Plan. Assist with South Africa inputs in respect of future developments on the Two-Pillar approach and South Africa’s implementation thereof. Financial sector taxation and Exchange Controls: Review and contribute to any refinements / policy design changes required in respect of tax legislation pertaining to banks, insurers, security transfer tax, etc. Assemble exchange control information for refinement. Perform research on relevant information for decisions with stakeholders. International and Regional Coordination: Assist with inputs to the SADC coordination process. Assist with inputs to the OECD coordination process. Assist with inputs re G20, G24, ATAF coordination processes. Assist with inputs on the Official Development Assistance Agreements coordination process with donors. Assist with inputs to the UN Framework Convention on International Tax Cooperation and its envisaged protocols. International Tax Treaties: Provide a platform for engagement on support pertaining to tax treaty negotiations. Research and provide background information of potential stakeholders. Assist with the scrutiny on tax treaty networks, country trade and investment flows. Provide input to the signature process on tax treaties and assist with control measures.
