af.title: Onderdirekteur: Internasionale en Eiendomsbelastingontwerp
af.summary: Onderdirekteur-pos by National Treasury in Pretoria met die fokus op internasionale en eiendomsbelastingontwerpsbeleid, wat 'n regte- of rekenmeestergraad en belastingverdragervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 word vereis tesame met 'n Bachelors-graad (ekwivalent aan NQF-vlak 7) in Regte of Rekenmeesterkunde of Internasionale Belasting. 'n Minimum van 4 jaar se ervaring waarvan 2 jaar op 'n Assistentdirekteur-vlak of ekwivalent moet wees, verkry in Internasionale Belasting en Besigheidsbelastingregpraktyke. Kennis en ervaring in internasionale belastingverdrae. Kennis en ervaring in die onderhandeling van verdrae en die opstel van ooreenkomste. Ervaring in die redigering van opstellernotas en die samestelling van regsdocumente.
af.duties: Internasionale Belastingwysigings (GrensOorskrywend): Bystand verleen en insette verskaf in die ontwikkeling van ontwerpsbeleidopsies vir grens-overskrydende wetgewing – byvoorbeeld oorplakingsprysbepaling en CFC-reëls. Inligte navors ten opsigte van die verbetering en verfyning van belasting met betrekking tot grens-overskrydende aktiwiteite. Verskaf insette tot konsepdocumente en besprekingsdokumente wat grens-overskrydende belastingkwessies vir openbare of interne vrystelling ondersteun. Versamel ondersteunende inligting oor belanghebbendes se behoeftes met betrekking tot beleidsontwikkeling oor kwessies wat internasionale belastingwetgewingswysigings beïnvloed. Basis-erode en Winstverskuiwing (BEPS): Inisiëer navorsing, ondersoek, hersiening en ontledings oor die aanvaarding van die BEPS-aksieplan. Bystand verleen aan Suid-Afrika om te verseker dat die verwante anti-omgangswetgewing toepaslik bly. Bystand verleen met die Suid-Afrikaanse eweknie-hersieningsmeganisme soos vereis ingevolge die BEPS-aksieplan. Bystand verleen met Suid-Afrika se insette met betrekking tot toekomstige ontwikkelings oor die Twee-Pilaar-benadering en Suid-Afrika se implementering daarvan. Finansiële sektorbelasting en Effekbeheer: Hersien en dra by tot enige verfyning / beleidsontwerpsveranderinge wat vereis word met betrekking tot belastingwetgewing van toepassing op banke, versekeraars, effekte-oordragbelasting, ens. Versamel effekbeheer-inligting vir verfyning. Doen navorsing oor tersaaklike inligting vir besluite met belanghebbendes. Internasionale en Streekskoördinering: Bystand verleen met insette tot die SADC-koördineringsproses. Bystand verleen met insette tot die OECD-koördineringsproses. Bystand verleen met insette aangaande G20-, G24-, ATAF-koördineringsprosesse. Bystand verleen met insette oor die koördineringsproses van Amptelike Ontwikkelingsbystandooreenkomste met skenkers. Bystand verleen met insette tot die UN-raamwerkkonvensie oor internasionale belasting samewerking en die voorgenome protokolle daarvan. Internasionale Belastingverdrae: Verskaf 'n platform vir betrokkenheid oor ondersteuning met betrekking tot belastingverdragonderhandelings. Doen navorsing en verskaf agtergrondinligting van potensiële belanghebbendes. Bystand verleen met die ondersoek van belastingverdragnetwerke, landehandel en beleggingsvloei. Verskaf insette tot die ondertekeningsproses van belastingverdrae en help met beheermaatreëls.

zu.title: Isekela Umqondisi: Ukwakheka Kwezimali Ezihlatshiwe Ezivezwe Kwezinye Izwe Nokwezimpahla
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba yiSekela Umqondisi e-National Treasury e-Pretoria esigxile kumthetho wokwakheka kwezimali ezihlatshiwe ezivezwe kwezinye izwe nakwezimpahla, esidinga iziqu zobugqobhozi noma ezabahleli bomabhuku kanye namava emivumelwano yezintela.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 iyadingeka kanye n degree ye-Bachelor (elingana ne-NQF level 7) kubo-Bugqozi noma ezabahleli bomabhuku noma kwezintela ezivezwe kwezinye izwe. Okungenani 4 iminyaka yamava lapho kuyadingeka khona iminyaka engu-2 okuyibe kulezinga lika-Assistant Director noma okulingana nalo etholwe ekwenzweni kwezintela ezivezwe kwezinye izwe nasekwenzeni umthetho wezintela zabahwebi. Ulwazi namava kumivumelwano yezintela ezivezwe kwezinye izwe. Ulwazi namava ekuxoxweni ngemivumelwano nasekulungweni kwemigqomo. Amava ekulungiseni amapheshana omlobi nasekuhlanganiseni amadokhumenta omthetho.
zu.duties: Izinguquko Zalezintela Ezivezwe Kwezinye Izwe: Siza futhi unikeze imibono ekuthuthukisweni kwezinketho zomthetho wokwakheka ezihlobene nomthetho ohlangabezana nezinye izwe – okuhlanganisa imithetho yokuhlelwa kwezintela njengesibonelo. Phenya ulwazi mayelana nokuthuthukiswa nokucushwa kabusha kwezintela mayelana nemisebenzi ehlangabezana nezinye izwe. Nikeza imibono ekulungweni kwamadokhumenti namaphepha axoxa ngokuhlukaniswa okusekela izinkinga zezintela ezivezwe kwezinye izwe eziganyelwe ukukhishwa koluntu noma ngaphakathi. Qoqa ulwazi olusekelayo ngezidingo zabanomthelefayo mayelana nokuthuthukiswa komthetho ezithinta izinguquko zomthetho wezintela ezivezwe kwezinye izwe. I-Base Erosion and Profit Shifting (BEPS): Qala uphenyo, hlobo, buyekeza futhi uhlaziye ukuthathwa kwale ndlela yokuqeda ukuqhuma kwe-BEPS. Siza i-South Africa ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi umthetho ohlobene nokugwema izintela uhlala ulungele into yenjongo. Siza ngezenzo zokuqonda okuhlangenwe nakho phakathi kwe-South Africa njengoba kudingwa ngokwe-BEPS Action Plan. Siza ngemibono i-South Africa mayelana nokuthuthukiswa okuzayo kokwakheka kwezinsika ezimbili kanye nokusetshenziswa kwayo i-South Africa. Izintela zesigaba sezimali kanye nokulawula ukushintshaniswa kwezimali: Buyeka futhi ungene kuso yisiphi isicushwa / izinguquko zokwakheka komthetho ezidingeka mayelana nomthetho wezintela ohlobene namabhange, izinkampani zomshwalense, izintela zokudluliswa kwamasheya, njll. Hlanganisa ulwazi lokulawula ukushintshaniswa kwezimali ukusiza ekucushweni. Yenza uphenyo lolwazi oluhambisana nezinqumo kubanomthelefayo. Ukuqondana Ngamazwe Nakwesifunda: Siza ngemibono enqubweni yokuqondisa i-SADC. Siza ngemibono enqubweni yokuqondisa i-OECD. Siza ngemibono ngokokuqondana kwe-G20, i-G24, i-ATAF. Siza ngemibono enqubweni yokuqondisa imigqomo ye-Official Development Assistance Agreements kubanikazi. Siza ngemibono ku-UN Framework Convention on International Tax Cooperation nasezivumelwaneni ezicabangwayo. Imivumelwano Yezintela Ezivezwe Kwezinye Izwe: Nikeza inkundla yokuxoxisana ngokwesekela okuhlobene nokuxoxwa ngemivumelwano yezintela. Phenya futhi unikeze ulwazi ngemuva ngabanomthelefanyana abangaba khona. Siza ukuhlola uxhumano lwemivumelwano yezintela, ukuhamba kwezohwebo kwezwe nokutshona kwezimali. Nikeza imibono enqubeni yokusayina imivumelwano yezintela futhi usize ngezinyathelo zokulawula.

xh.title: Umlawuli oNgcwele osemthethweni: Ulungelelwaniso lweRhwebo leZimali lamazwe ngamazwe neliFundo-mali
xh.summary: Indima kaMlawuli oNgcwele osemthethweni kwiNational Treasury ePretoria egxile kwindleba yenkqubo yerhwebo lezimali lamazwe ngamazwe nelifa, ifuna isidanga somthetho okanye sobubala-mali namava kwiziVumelwano zerhwebo lezimali.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka ibe khona iGrade 12 edityaniswe neNqanaba le-7 le-NQF kwisiQinisekiso se-Bachelor's degree kwiMthetho okanyeokuBala iimali okanye iRhwebo leZimali lamazwe ngamazwe. Kufuneka kube kukho amava eminyaka elinguna-4 apho iminyaka elinguni-2 kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba lomLawuli oNcedisayo okanye elinganayo elicinywe kwindlela yokuSebenza koMthetho weRhwebo leZimali lamazwe ngamazwe nokuSebenza koMthetho weRhwebo leMali. Ulwazi namava kwiziVumelwano zerhwebo lezimali zamazwe ngamazwe. Ulwazi namava kwiingxoxo ngeziVumelwano noshicilelo lweziVumelwano. Amava ekulungiseni iinqwaba-magama zabashicileli bakwaye nakuhlanganiseni amaxwebhu omthetho.
xh.duties: Izaphulelo zeRhwebo leZimali zamazwe ngamazwe (Ngaphakathi kwemida yamavesi): Nceda nikela nengeniso ekwakheni iinketho zenkqubo yomthetho ongaphakathi kwemida yamavesi – kuquka ukubeka iinxabo rexabiso kunye nemithetho ye-CFC, umzekelo. Phando ulwazi malunga nokuphucula nokucociswa kwerhwebo lezimali ngokuphathwa kokusebenza ngaphakathi kwemida yamavesi. Nikela nengeniso ekubhalweni kwamaxwebhu okucwangcisiweyo namaphepha pencethe axhasa iingxaki zerhwebo lezimali ezisebenza ngaphakathi kwemida yamavesi ukuzikhululela kwentlangano yomntu wonke okanye yangaphakathi. Qokelela ulwazi oluxhasayo malunga neemfuno zabathathi nxaxheba ezithintela ukuphuhliswa kwenkqubo kwiingxaki ezithintela izaphulelo ezithintelwe umthetho werhwebo lezimali zamazwe ngamazwe. Ukutyholwa kwesisiseko nokushintshwa kweNxalenye yeVuzo (BEPS): Qalisa uphando, phonononga, kuphonononge, nokuhlalutya ukwamkelwa kweNkqubo yeZenzo ze-BEPS. Nceda uMzantsi Afrika kuqinisekisa ukuba umthetho ochasayo oqhelekileyo uyaqhubeka usebenza njengoko kufuneka. Nceda ngenkqubo yophononongo lwabalinganisana baseMzantsi Afrika njengoko kufuneka ngokwemigaqo yeNkqubo yeZenzo ze-BEPS. Nceda ngeniso laseMzantsi Afrika ngokuphathwa kokuphuhliswa okuzayo kuNdlela yeziPila ezimbini nendlela esiyenzayo uMzantsi Afrika. Irhwebo lezimali kwindawo yezemali kunye noLawulo lokuTshintshiselana kweNxaxheba: Phonononga kwaye unikele naluphi na ulungevishiso / iinguqulo zenkqubo ezifunekayo ngokuphathwa komthetho werhwebo lezimali othintela iibhanki, iinkampani zomlinganiselo werhwebo lezimali, irhwebo lezimali lokudluliswa kolungelelwano, njl. Qokelela ulwazi lolawulo lokutshintshiselana kolungevisiweyo. Yenza uphando ngolwazi olubalulekileyo ngezigqibo kunye nabathathi nxaxheba. Ulinganiselo lwamanye amazwe nengqungquthela yommandla: Nceda ngeniso kwinkqubo yolungelelwano ye-SADC. Nceda ngeniso kwinkqubo yolungelelwano ye-OECD. Nceda nengeniso ngeenkqubo zolungelelwano ze-G20, G24, ATAF. Nceda ngeniso kwenkqubo yolungelelwano yeZivumelwano zoNcedo lusemthethweni ngurhulumente kunye nezabelo. Nceda ngeniso kwiNkqubo ye-UN yeZivumelwano malunga noLawulo lweRhwebo leZimali lamazwe ngamazwe nemiThetho yawo ecel'iweyo. IziVumelwano zeRhwebo leZimali zamazwe ngamazwe: Zela inkqubo yoxhumo lokuzibandakanya ngokuxhasa iingxoxo ngezivumelwano zerhwebo lezimali. Phanda kwaye unikeze ulwazi olungasemva ngabathathi nxaxheba abanokubakho. Nceda nokuphonononga kweenkqubo zeziVumelwano zerhwebo lezimali, ukurhweba kwelizwe nokuwohloka kotyalo-mali. Nikela ngeniso kwinkqubo yokusayina kweziVumelwano zerhwebo lezimali kwaye nceda ngezithintelo zolawulo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Africa Continental
jobs.summary: Assistant Director at National Treasury in Pretoria providing policy analysis and advocacy on regional economic and financial integration across the African continent.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 is required coupled with a degree (equivalent to NQF level 7) in Economics and Econometrics, Political Science or Development Studies. 3 years’ experience within a development institution or policy or financial environment. Knowledge of policy analysis and formulation of drafting notes and cabinet memoranda. Proven knowledge and experience of benchmarking and research with recognized international institutions. Knowledge and experience on a diplomatic level will serve as an added advantage.
jobs.duties: Some key Outputs include: Process Policy Analysis & Advocacy: Regional Integration & Governance: Provide inputs in the formulation of National Treasury’s position on regional economic and financial integration agenda in the African Union Specialised Technical Committee (STC) of Finance, Planning and Monetary Economic Integration. Provide inputs in the formulation of National Treasury’s position for strategic participation and advancement of priority regional economic and developmental issues at the Conference of African Ministers of Finance, Planning, and Economic Development of UNECA. Engage in the tabling of the AU budget and advancement of innovative financing proposal for the AU Peace Fund, as part of the Experts of the Committee of Fifteen Ministers of Finance (F15), and in line with AU Financial Rules and Regulations (FRR), and rationalisation of overlapping activities within the AU. Advance South Africa's policy position on the development of the AU New Scale of Assessment at the Joint Sitting on the Scale of Assessment and Contributions at Ambassadorial Level and Experts of the Committee of Fifteen Ministers, the Ministerial Committee on the Scale of Assessment and Contributions of the Committee of F15 Ministers, etc. Monitoring and analyses of implementation of AU Executive Council and Assembly decisions on budget and financial management oversight at the Joint Sitting of the Sub-Committee on General Supervision and Coordination on Administrative, Budgetary, and Financial Matters (GSCBFAM), and Experts of the Committee of Fifteen Ministers of Finance (F15) etc. Research, Database Compilation & Analysis: Undertake periodic research, analysis for updates highlighting global, regional, geopolitical developments, domestic economic trends including policy and regulatory issues that could enhance or inhibit SA's regional economic integration objectives, on the Financial Integration paper. Undertake periodic research, analysis and update/reviews (highlighting global, regional, geopolitical developments, domestic economic trends including policy and regulatory issues that could enhance or inhibit SA's regional economic integration objectives, on the Financial Governance paper. Bilateral Cooperation: Development and review of a comprehensive MOU template for enhancing bilateral finance and monetary cooperation with strategic countries at SACU, SADC and continental levels. Bi-annual review and update of the AEI Engagement Strategy document for enhancing bilateral relations with Tier-1 countries, F15 & priority regional partners. Represent National Treasury in State Visits, Bi-National Commissions (BNC), Cooperation Commissions (JCC) Midterm Reviews (MTR) and other relevant DIRCO-led bilateral engagements. Coordinate engagements for strengthening SA’s relations with the F15 and likeminded countries for coordinating a common-position framework on key issues regarding the AU regional integration agenda to be advanced at AU STC meetings. Coordination of capacity building and policy cooperation programmes with strategic AU Member States’ and F15 Ministries of Finance. Coordination & Administration: Liaise with the office of the Minister and Deputy Minister and DDG – EPIC on participation in upcoming meetings of the UNECA Ministers Of Finance, Planning and Monetary Integration, the STC on Finance, Planning and Monetary Integration, F15 Committee, the AU Assembly, Executive Council and for all relevant events/ statutory or Ad Hoc meetings. Drafting of National Treasury inputs into the African Renaissance Fund (ARF) concurrence request memos and response letters for the Minister to the Department of International Relations Minister. Coordinate the payment of funds due to CABRI and IDEP. Representation of National Treasury’s participation at Cluster meetings, statutory and Ad Hoc meetings, Interdepartmental Meetings (IDM) in preparation for State Visits, Bi-National Commissions (BNC) Joint Cooperation Commission (JCC), Mid-Term Review (MTR) and other relevant DIRCO-led bilateral engagements of the 2026-2027 FY. Liaise and consult with EPIC, DIRCO, the DTIC, economic cluster departments, SOEs, DFIs, SA embassies abroad & other key stakeholders for coordination of NT’s position on crosscutting workstreams/issues. Provide input into the procurement plan within the set deadline. Ensure that documents (memos, briefing notes, BTORs, speaking notes, presentation, etc) in relation to statutory meetings, bilateral, Cabinet and research are filed after conclusion of meetings. Provide regular & consistent inputs to, amongst others, IRSC, CDOPs, risk register, procurement plan & quarterly reports for the Directorate’s work. Compilation and submission of back-to-office reports (BTORs).

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Afrika Kontinentaal
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur by National Treasury in Pretoria wat beleidsanalise en voorligting verskaf oor streeksekonomiese en finansiële integrasie dwarsoor die Afrika-kontinent.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 word vereis tesame met 'n graad (gelykstaande aan NQF level 7) in Economics and Econometrics, Political Science of Development Studies. 3 jaar se ervaring binne 'n ontwikkelingsinstelling of beleids- of finansiële omgewing. Kennis van beleidsanalise en die opstel van konsepnotas en kabinetsmemorandums. Bewese kennis en ervaring van maatstafontleding en navorsing met erkende internasionale instellings. Kennis en ervaring op diplomatieke vlak sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien.
af.duties: Sommige sleutel-uitsette sluit in: Prosesbeleid Ontleding & Voorligting: Streek-integrasie & Bestuur: Verskaf insette in die formulering van National Treasury se posisie oor die streeksekonomiese en finansiële integrasie-agenda in die African Union Specialised Technical Committee (STC) of Finance, Planning and Monetary Economic Integration. Verskaf insette in die formulering van National Treasury se posisie vir strategiese deelname en bevordering van voorrangstreeksekonomiese en ontwikkelingskwessies by die Conference of African Ministers of Finance, Planning, and Economic Development of UNECA. Neem deel aan die tabel van die AU-begroting en bevordering van innoverende finansieringsvoorstelle vir die AU Peace Fund, as deel van die Experts of the Committee of Fifteen Ministers of Finance (F15), en in ooreenstemming met AU Financial Rules and Regulations (FRR), en rasionalisering van oorvleuelende aktiwiteite binne die AU. Bevorder South Africa se beleidsposisie oor die ontwikkeling van die AU New Scale of Assessment by die Joint Sitting on the Scale of Assessment and Contributions at Ambassadorial Level and Experts of the Committee of Fifteen Ministers, the Ministerial Committee on the Scale of Assessment and Contributions of the Committee of F15 Ministers, ens. Monitering en ontleding van die implementering van AU Executive Council and Assembly-besluite oor begrotings- en finansiële bestuuroorsig by die Joint Sitting of the Sub-Committee on General Supervision and Coordination on Administrative, Budgetary, and Financial Matters (GSCBFAM), en Experts of the Committee of Fifteen Ministers of Finance (F15) ens. Navorsing, Databasissamestelling & Ontleding: Onderneem periodieke navorsing en ontleding vir opdaterings wat globale, streeks-, geopolitieke ontwikkelings, binnelandse ekonomiese tendense insluitende beleids- en regulatoriese kwessies wat SA se streeksekonomiese integrasie-doelwitte kan bevorder of inhibeer, belig, oor die Financial Integration-dokument. Onderneem periodieke navorsing, ontleding en opdatering/hersienings (wat globale, streeks-, geopolitieke ontwikkelings, binnelandse ekonomiese tendense insluitende beleids- en regulatoriese kwessies wat SA se streeksekonomiese integrasie-doelwitte kan bevorder of inhibeer, belig, oor die Financial Governance-dokument. Bilaterale Samewerking: Ontwikkeling en hersiening van 'n omvattende MOU-sjabloon vir die versterking van bilaterale finansies- en monetêre samewerking met strategiese lande op SACU-, SADC- en kontinentale vlak. Tweejaarlikse hersiening en opdatering van die AEI Engagement Strategy-dokument vir die versterking van bilaterale betrekkinge met Tier-1-lande, F15 & voorrangstreekspartners. Verteenwoordig National Treasury in State Visits, Bi-National Commissions (BNC), Cooperation Commissions (JCC) Midterm Reviews (MTR) en ander relevante DIRCO-geleide bilaterale betrekkinge. Koördineer betrekkinge vir die versterking van SA se betrekkinge met die F15 en gelykgesinde lande vir die koördinering van 'n gemeenskaplike-posisie-raamwerk oor sleutelkwessies rakende die AU-streek-integrasie-agenda wat by AU STC-vergaderings bevorder moet word. Koördinering van kapasiteitsbou- en beleidsamewerkingsprogramme met strategiese AU-lidstate se en F15-ministeries van finansies. Koördinering & Administrasie: Skakel met die kantoor van die Minister en Adjunkminister en DDG – EPIC oor deelname aan komende vergaderings van die UNECA Ministers Of Finance, Planning and Monetary Integration, die STC on Finance, Planning and Monetary Integration, F15-komitee, die AU Assembly, Executive Council en vir alle relevante gebeurtenisse/statutêre of Ad Hoc-vergaderings. Opstel van National Treasury se insette in die African Renaissance Fund (ARF) instemmingsversoek-memos en antwoordbriewe vir die Minister aan die Department of International Relations Minister. Koördineer die betaling van fondse verskuldig aan CABRI en IDEP. Verteenwoordiging van National Treasury se deelname by Cluster-vergaderings, statutêre en Ad Hoc-vergaderings, Interdepartmental Meetings (IDM) ter voorbereiding van State Visits, Bi-National Commissions (BNC) Joint Cooperation Commission (JCC), Mid-Term Review (MTR) en ander relevante DIRCO-geleide bilaterale betrekkinge van die 2026-2027 FY. Skakel en raadpleeg met EPIC, DIRCO, die DTIC, ekonomiese cluster-departemente, SOE's, DFI's, SA-ambassades in die buiteland & ander sleutelbelanghebendes vir die koördinering van NT se posisie oor kruiswerkstrome/kwessies. Verskaf insette in die beskaffingsplan binne die vasgestelde sperdatum. Verseker dat dokumente (memo's, briefnotas, BTOR's, spraaknotas, aanbiedings, ens) met betrekking tot statutêre vergaderings, bilaterale, Kabinet- en navorsingsvergaderings na afloop van vergaderings ingedien word. Verskaf gereelde en konsekwente insette tot, onder andere, IRSC, CDOPs, risikoregister, beskaffingsplan & kwartaalverslae vir die Direktoraat se werk. Samestelling en indiening van back-to-office-verslae (BTOR's).

zu.title: Umncedisi weNduna: iNhlangano yase-Afrika
zu.summary: Umncedisi weNduna ku-National Treasury ePretoria onikeza uhlolojigoqo lemigomo kanye nokuqinisekisa ngokuhlanganiswa kwezomnozo kwezomnozo nakwezezimali kuso sonke isiqhingi sase-Afrika.
zu.requirements: Kudingeka i-Grade 12 kanye nedigri (elingalingana ne-NQF level 7) ku-Economics and Econometrics, Political Science noma i-Development Studies. 3 years’ experience enhlanganweni yentuthuko noma kumthethongqondo noma kwesimo sezimali. Ulwazi lokuqaphela umthethongqondo kanye nokubhalwa kwezaziso kanye nememorandum kabakhameli. Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nolunyakazo lokulinganisa kanye nokuphenya ngezinhlangano zomhlaba ezaziwayo. Ulwazi kanye nolunyakazo emkhakheni wezobudiplomata kuzoba yinzuzo eveliswa emthanjeni.
zu.duties: Eminye imiphumela emphuma kubandakanya: Ukuqhuba Uhlolojigoqo Lomthethongqondo kanye Nokuqinisekisa: Ukuhlanganiswa Kwendawo kanye NokuLawula: Unikeza okungenayo ekubhalweni komsuka kwe-National Treasury ngokuhlanganiswa kwezomnozo nakwezezimali ohlelweni le-African Union Specialised Technical Committee (STC) of Finance, Planning and Monetary Economic Integration. Unikeza okungenayo ekubhalweni komsuka kwe-National Treasury ngokujoyina ngokuhlakaniphilana ekuthuthukisweni kwezidingo eziyisibalo sezomnozo nakho ukuthuthukiswa kwendawo ebandakanya i-UNECA Conference of African Ministers of Finance, Planning, and Economic Development. Uthatha inxaxheba ekubhalweni kwebhajethi ye-AU kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwesiphakamiso sezimali esisha se-AU Peace Fund, njengengxenye yabaJinja be-Experts of the Committee of Fifteen Ministers of Finance (F15), futhi ngokuvumelana ne-AU Financial Rules and Regulations (FRR), kanye nokuqoqwa kwezinye izenzo eziphinda-phindwayo ngaphakathi kwe-AU. Ukuthuthukisa umthethongqondo waseNingizimu Afrika ngokuthuthukiswa kwe-AU New Scale of Assessment e-Joint Sitting on the Scale of Assessment and Contributions ezingeni labaBaphathi Bezwe kanye ne-Experts of the Committee of Fifteen Ministers, i-Ministerial Committee on the Scale of Assessment and Contributions ye-Committee of F15 Ministers, njll. Ukulandula nokuhlolojwa kokusetshenziswa kwezinqumo ze-AU Executive Council ne-AU Assembly ngaphezu kwebhajethi nokuphathwa kwezezimali e-Joint Sitting of the Sub-Committee on General Supervision and Coordination on Administrative, Budgetary, and Financial Matters (GSCBFAM), kanye ne-Experts of the Committee of Fifteen Ministers of Finance (F15) njll. Ukuphenya, ukuqoqa isizindalwazi kanye Nokuqaphela: Ukwenza ukuphenya ngesikhathi, uhlolojigoqo okuveza izibalo zamanye amazwe, isikhungo sezomnozo nakwezombusazwe kanye nezimo zomnozo wasekhaya okubandakanya umthethongqondo nezinye izindikimba ezingaba negalelo lomthelela ekuthuthukiseni noma ukukhubaza ukuthi izinhloso ezingaba nomthelela ekuthuthukiseni kwezomnozo eNingizimu Afrika ezingaba nomthelela ekubhalweni nge-Financial Integration. Ukwenza ukuphenya ngesikhathi, uhlolojigoqo kanye nokubhalwa/kubuyekezwa okuveza izibalo zomhlaba, zendawo, ezo-geopolitical kanye nezenhlalo nezomnozo ezithinta izinhloso zenhlangano yeNingizimu Afrika ekubhalweni nge-Financial Governance paper. Ukusebenzisana Elinganisweni: Ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokubuyekeza ukuthi kubhalwe umhlahlandlela wememorandum yokuqonda (MOU) ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenzisana ngemali kanye noqobo ezweni namanye amazwe e-SACU, i-SADC nakumazinga obumbano. Ukubuyekezwa kanye nokubhalwa phakathi konyaka kwedokhumenti ye-AEI Engagement Strategy ekuthuthukiseni ubudlelwano namazwe e-Tier-1, i-F15 kanye nabalingani abaphambili bezinhlangano. Ukumela i-National Treasury ezivakashini zezwe, e-Bi-National Commissions (BNC), e-Cooperation Commissions (JCC), e-Midterm Reviews (MTR) nakwezinye izinhlangano ezihola i-DIRCO ngokuthi kube yinhlangano ephelele. Ukumisa ukuthi kuxhumwe ukuthi kwenhlangana yezombusano phakathi kwelungu laseNingizimu Afrika i-F15 kanye namanye amazwe efana nayo ukuze kube khona isimiso ngokuthi kube yinhlalo-bunye ekugqameni kwezinye izinhloso ezithinta i-AU regional integration agenda ezothuthukiswa kumhlangano we-AU STC. Ukuhlela izinhlelo zokwakha amandla nokusebenzisana komthethongqondo nama-AU Member States nama-Ministries of Finance e-F15. Ukumisa kanye Nokuphatha: Ukuxhumana ne-ofisi yeMinista neMinista Ohlangothi kanye ne-DDG – EPIC ngokujoyina ohlelweni lwangaphambili lwe-UNECA Ministers Of Finance, Planning and Monetary Integration, i-STC on Finance, Planning and Monetary Integration, i-F15 Committee, i-AU Assembly, i-Executive Council nakuzo zonke ezinye imihlangano/izinkomba ezibalulekile noma ezithile ezibekiwe. Ukubhala izingeniso ze-National Treasury ekuqatshweni kwe-African Renaissance Fund (ARF) nememorandum yezinhlangothi ezisabela umbhalo onikeza umyalezo kuMinista kuhlelo loBuhlonzi lwamazwe ngamazwe. Ukumisa imali emayikhokhwa i-CABRI ne-IDEP. Ukumela i-National Treasury ekubandakanyeni kwemihlangano ye-Cluster, imihlangano eyisimiso nokuyinto ethile, imihlangano yabahleli (IDM) ekulungiseleleni izivakashi zezwe, i-Bi-National Commissions (BNC) Joint Cooperation Commission (JCC), i-Mid-Term Review (MTR) kanye nezinye izinhlangano ezifana ne-DIRCO-led bilateral engagements zonyaka wezimali ka-2026-2027. Ukuxhumana kwaye ucabange ne-EPIC, i-DIRCO, i-DTIC, izinhlangano zomthethongqondo ze-cluster, i-SOEs, i-DFIs, izofisi zaseNingizimu Afrika emazweni aphesheya kanye nabanye abantu abaphathwa ukuba bathi kuye ukuhlelwa kwezinkomba eziguqukayo kanye nezigaba ze-National Treasury. Unikeza okungenayo ohlelweni lokuthenga izimpahla esikhathini esibekiwe. Uqinisekisa ukuthi amadokhumenti (amemorandamu, izaziso eziqondisa, ama-BTOR, izaziso zokukhuluma, izethulo, njll) ahlobene nemihlangano yezobuzwe futhi ngaphandle kokuphela komhlangano ahlelwe ngendlela efanele. Unikeza okungenayo ngesikhathi esivamile futhi ngokuqhubeka ekubhaleni, phakathi kwabanye, i-IRSC, ama-CDOPs, ukubhalwa kwezingozi, ohlelweni lokuthenga izimpahla nakubiko kwesikhashana ngomsebenzi weqembu. Ukuqoqa kwaye unikeze izibuko eziphakelwe kuso ofisi (ama-BTOR).

xh.title: Umncedisi weNhlekbe: iQela le-Afrika konjineli
xh.summary: Umncedisi weNhlekbe kwi-National Treasury e-Pretoria onikezela ngohlalutyo lweenqubo ezimelwe kwaye ungenelele ekubeni ngokumanyana kwezokwezactual nezenkcukacha kulo lonke iqela lesizwe sase-Afrika.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka abe ne-Grade 12 ngenye indlela kunye nedayim (elingundoqo kwi-NQF level 7) kwi-Economics and Econometrics, Political Science okanye Development Studies. Kufuneka abe neminyaka eliwaka elithoba yamava kwisikhedle esinzima seempilo ezikunzima ekubeni ngamava ekubeni komsebenzi ekubeni kwesixokelelwano. Kufuneka akwazi ukuhlalutywa kweenqubo ezimelwe kwaye abe nokwazi ukulungiselela iindawo ezikumgangatho ophezulu ekubeni ngamawaka abeluleki, nakwelungiselelo lwamagqabantshi kwikhaphethu. Kufuneka akwazi ukubeka izigqibo kwaye akwazi ukuphanda ngemithi yokuphandela ngokusemthethweni kwezinye iindawo ezingamanyano emhlabeni jikelele. Ukuba akwazi ukuba nakho amava ngokumanyana kwelinye iqela kwindawo ekumgangatho ophezulu kuya kuba ngumonde olongezelelweyo ekwabelulwa ngawo ekubeni ngamava.
xh.duties: Kukho iindawo ezingemva ezibalulekileyo ezikho: Ukuqhubekekisa koluhlalutyo lweenqubo ezimelwe kunye nokuzithanda: Ukubakho kwamanye amazwe nokuba ngamaphakathi woluntu: Nikela ngesiccedo ekulungiseleleni iindawo ezithileyo ze-National Treasury malunga neengqondo ezimanyaniswa kwizixokelelwano zangaphakathi nezakuzimela kumazwe ase-Afrika e-African Union Specialised Technical Committee (STC) of Finance, Planning and Monetary Economic Integration. Nikela ngesiccedo ekulungiseleleni iindawo ezithileyo ze-National Treasury malunga nokuthatha inxaxheba ekulungenisweni nokusasaza iindaba ezibalulekileyo ngokusasaza iindaba ngokuhamba kwexesha ekutshintsheni kwezoqoqosho namazwe angaphandle e-United Nations. Thabatha inxaxheba ekubeni kwindawo yokugqibelela i-AU budget nokusasaza iindaba ezintsha ngemali ehamba phambili yokwaziswa kwi-AU Peace Fund, njengenxaxheba ye-Experts of the Committee of Fifteen Ministers of Finance (F15), ngokuhambelana ne-AU Financial Rules and Regulations (FRR), nokusasaza iindaba ezingaphaya kwemida yawo ngokwemisebenzi kwi-AU. Phambukisa i-National Treasury malunga nokusetyenziswa kwemigaqo nokusetyenziswa kweenkcukacha ezintsha ze-AU New Scale of Assessment kwindawo ebanzi yomhla we-Ambassadorial Level ne-Experts of the Committee of Fifteen Ministers, i-Ministerial Committee on the Scale of Assessment and Contributions of the Committee of F15 Ministers, njl. Qwalasela nokuhlalutya inkqubo yomsebenzi wee-AU Executive Council nakwe-AU Assembly ekulawulweni kobungozi bemali ekwindawo ebanzi yomhla we-Joint Sitting of the Sub-Committee on General Supervision and Coordination on Administrative, Budgetary, and Financial Matters (GSCBFAM), ne-Experts of the Committee of Fifteen Ministers of Finance (F15) njl. Ukuphanda, ukuqokelela i-Nakhu yamagama nokuhlalutya: Yenza imisebenzi yokuphanda ngenkqubo, ukuhlalutya ukwaziswa okutsha ngokubakho kweendaba zamazwe ngamazwe, iindawo ezingaphakathi, ezommandla namazwe angaphandle, iindaba ezingaphakathi zangokuhamba kwexesha nezomiso nokulawulela imigaqo ezinokuthi zibe yindima yokwazi okutsha okanye zithintele ekubeni ngamava okusasaza iindaba ezintsha zokuhamba kwexesha kwelinye iqela lokuqondisa iindaba ngokuhamba kwexesha ezibhalwe kwelinye igama elithi-Financial Integration paper. Yenza imisebenzi yokuphanda ngenkqubo, ukuhlalutya nokwaziswa okutsha/ukuqwalasela (ukugqithisa iindaba zokubakho kwezinto ezintsha zangokuhamba kwexesha, iindaba zamazwe ngamazwe, iindawo ezikunzima, iindaba ezingaphakathi ezikunzima ngenkqubo nokulawulela imigaqo ezinokuthi zibe ngumsa okanye zithintele iindaba ezintsha zokuhamba kwexesha kwelinye iqela ekugqibeleleni iindaba ezintsha, kwelinye igama elithi-Financial Governance paper. Ukubakho kwamanye amazwe: Ukusetyenziswa kwelinye iqela lokulungiselela nokugqiba iindlela ezithileko zokumanya nemizekelo ekubeni kokulungelelanisa amanye amazwe ngokomsebenzi wemali nakumsebenzi wokuhlanganisa amanye amazwe anezimvo eziphambili kumazwe asebenza ngokuhlanganisa amanye amazwe ngokommandla we-SACU, SADC nakuqela lesizwe ngokuhamba kwexesha. Qwalasela kwelinye iqela lokuhamba kwexesha ukwaziswa okutsha ngo-2026-2027 FY nokuqwalasela inkqubo ye-AEI Engagement Strategy ukusetyenziswa kwelinye iqela ekumanyeni nokusetyenziswa kwelinye iqela nabakwabo abakumgangatho woku-1, i-F15 nabakwabo abakumgangatho weqela eliphambili bokumanywa. Phela i-National Treasury kwindawo ezithileko ezisemthethweni ezisetyenziswa ngokuhamba kwexesha ngeenhlangano ezahlukeneyo ezifana ne-State Visits, Bi-National Commissions (BNC), Cooperation Commissions (JCC), Midterm Reviews (MTR) nakwezinye iindawo ezahlukeneyo ezisetyenziswa ngokuhamba kwexesha ekulawulweni kwe-DIRCO. Qwalasela iindawo ezithileko zokumanya nokusetyenziswa kwamanye amazwe ukwaziswa okutsha okungagqithiswa kwelinye iqela ekubeni nayo iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezisetyenziswa ngokuhamba kwexesha ngeenhlangano ezahlukeneyo. Lungiselela iindlela ezithileko zokwazi ukusetyenziswa kwelinye iqela ngokuhamba kwexesha nokusetyenziswa kwelinye iqela elibalela ngokuhamba kwexesha. Yenza iindlela ezithileko zokusebenzela amanye amazwe ngokuhamba kwexesha ngeenhlangano ezahlukeneyo ezisemthethweni ekubeni kokubakho kwamanye amazwe e-F15 nakulawulo lweenkqubo ezahlukeneyo zokuhamba kwexesha ezibalela ngokuhamba kwexesha. Ukumanywa nokulawulela iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezisemthethweni: Hlanganyela nokusebenza ngenkqubo yoluntu kunye ne-Deputy Minister ne-DDG – EPIC ekwazisweni ngokuhamba kwexesha kwelinye iqela le-UNECA Ministers Of Finance, Planning and Monetary Integration, i-STC on Finance, Planning and Monetary Integration, i-F15 Committee, i-AU Assembly, Executive Council nakwindawo yonke imisebenzi egqithiswa ngokuhamba kwexesha/okuhlanganiswa ngokomthetho okanye okulungiselelwa ngenkqubo. Lungiselela iindlela ezithileko zokusebenzela amanye amazwe ngokuhamba kwexesha kwelinye iqela le-African Renaissance Fund (ARF) kwinkqubo yokusebenzela amanye amazwe ngokuhamba kwexesha nokusetyenziswa kweempulo zokwaziswa nokuhamba kwexesha ukwaziswa kwelinye iqela le-Department of International Relations Minister. Lungiselela iindlela ezithileko zokuhamba kwexesha ezihamba phambili ngokuhamba kwexesha ezisetyenziswa kwelinye iqela le-CABRI ne-IDEP. Yenza iindlela ezithileko zokusebenzela amanye amazwe ngokuhamba kwexesha kwinkqubo yokuhamba kwexesha nge-Cluster meetings, iidipakumente ezahlukeneyo ezisemthethweni, iidipakumente ezahlukeneyo ezilungiselelwa ngokuhamba kwexesha, Interdepartmental Meetings (IDM) ukulungiselela i-State Visits, Bi-National Commissions (BNC) Joint Cooperation Commission (JCC), Mid-Term Review (MTR) nakwezinye iindawo ezahlukeneyo ezisetyenziswa ngokuhamba kwexesha ekulawulweni kwe-DIRCO ekubeni kokuhamba kwexesha kwe-2026-2027 FY. Hlanganyela nokusebenza nge-EPIC, i-DIRCO, i-DTIC, iindawo ezahlukeneyo ezisemthethweni ezilawula imisebenzi, i-SOEs, i-DFIs, iindawo zase-South Africa eziseswini nakwamanye amazwe & nabanye abantu ababalulekileyo ekubeni kokuhamba kwexesha ngokuhamba kwexesha. Nikela ngesiccedo kwinkqubo yokusebenzela amanye amazwe ngokuhamba kwexesha ngenkqubo egqithiswa ngexesha elixeliweyo. Qinisekisa ukuba iidipakumente (i-memos, iindawo ezithileko zokwaziswa, i-BTORs, iindawo ezithileko zokuthetha, i-presentation, njl) ezihlobene neendawo ezisemthethweni, iindawo ezahlukeneyo ezihamba phambili, i-Cabinet nokuphanda zibekwe kwindawo ethile emva kokugqibela iindawo ezahlukeneyo ezihamba phambili. Nikela ngesiccedo ngokuhamba kwexesha, phakathi kwezinye iindawo, kwi-IRSC, i-CDOPs, i-risk register, i-procurement plan & iinkcazelo ngokuhamba kwexesha ngenkqubo ye-Directorate's work. Qokelela kwaye ungenise iindawo ezithileko ezibalulekileyo ze-back-to-office report (BTORs).

jobs.closing_date_text: 06 November 2026 at 16:00 NOTES : All fields in the Z83 application form on https://recruitment.dwypd.gov.za/ must be completed in full, in a manner that allows a selection committee to assess the quality of a candidate based on the information provided in the form. It is therefore prudent that fields be completed by applicants and signed, noting the importance of the declaration. South African applicants need not to provide passport numbers. Candidate must respond “Yes “or “No “to the question whether you are conducting business with the state. If “Yes”, details thereof only shortlisted candidates will submit Declaration form for conducting business with the state when shortlisted to the application. It is acceptable for applicant to indicate “not applicable” or leave a blank to the question “In the event that you are employed in the Public Service, will you immediately relinquish such business interest?” Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents but must submit the completed and signed Z83 and detailed Curricula Vitae. The communication from HR of the Department regarding the requirement for certified document will be limited to shortlisted candidates. Therefore, only shortlisted candidate for a post will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from HR. Applications received after the closing date will NOT be considered or accepted. Correspondence is limited to short-listed candidates only; should you not hear from us within six weeks of the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. Non-RSA citizens/permanent resident permit holders must submit a copy only when shortlisted. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Should you not hear from the Department within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to fill and/or make an appointment to any of the advertised posts. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Further, personnel suitability checks, including security vetting, competency assessment will be conducted, as such transfer/promotion/appointment will made subject to positive outcomes of personnel suitability checks. Successful candidates shall be required to enter into performance agreement within three (3) months of assuming their duties in the Department, and within one (1) month of the date of their appointment conclude the prescribed contract of employment. Designated employees shall be required to disclose their financial interest within 30 days after assumption of duty. Appointments will only be made on the first notch of the advertised salary level. Note that in terms of the Protection of Personal Information Act, 2021, the Department will ensure the protection of applicants ‘personal information and only collect, use and retain applicants’ personal information for the purposes of recruitment and selection processes. The Department shall safeguard such personal information against access by unauthorised persons, unlawful disclosure, or breaches. The Department is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. In the filling of these posts, it is the intention of the Department to promote representivity in the Public Service through the filling of this position and the candidature of persons whose transfer/promotion/appointment will promote representivity will receive preference as the objectives of section 195 of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa and the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act 55 of 1998) will be taken into consideration.
