jobs.summary: Researcher position in the Department of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities requiring a diploma or degree in social sciences and three years of research experience.
jobs.requirements: Matric Certificate and National Diploma/Degree in Social Sciences, Development Sciences, Public Administration/Management or a relevant NQF 6 qualification. A minimum of 3 years practical experience in the research field. Knowledge: Legislation, governance framework and prescripts applicable to research and policy; Policy research and analysis; Policy research and analysis; PMFA and Treasury regulations; Batho Pele principles and application thereof; Research methodologies, data collection, synthesis and analyses; Knowledge management and Data Literacy. Skills, Primary: Diversity awareness, Analytical and report writing skills, verbal and written communication skills; Applied strategic thinking; Customer focus and responsiveness; Planning and organising; Continuous improvement; People management and development; Team leadership. Secondary: Basic Budgeting and Financial Management; Problem solving and decision-making; Project management; Computer Literacy (MS Office Suite); Networking and building bonds; Impact and influence; Diversity management. Personal Attributes: Ethical behaviour; Honestly and Integrity; Emotional Intelligence; Passion and Achievement driven; Ability to work under pressure; Ability to maintain confidentiality of information; Respect for copyrights/ aversion to plagiarism.
jobs.duties: Contribute to the implementation of the research agenda related to women youth and persons with disabilities’ socio-economic empowerment and gender equality; Collect and analyse research data; Analyse qualitative and quantitative data using appropriate tools and techniques; Participate in the compilation of research executive summaries, reports and presentation; Conduct literature reviews; Prepare and update research data; Provide relevant research papers and/or reports; Provide research assistance and support to the Directorate. Provide inputs and support in the review and analysis of policies/bills/legislation/research/reports: Conduct analysis of identified policies/bills/legislation/research reports, provide inputs and where necessary, identify areas of possible review; Participate in forums or meetings for policy dialogues and discussions; Ensure research complies with ethical standards and relevant regulations; Collaborate with team members, stakeholders, and external partners. Render Information Knowledge Management support: Provide assistance with data capturing activities; Maintain the Research, Legislation and Policy Register records for the department; Assist with the identification and maintenance of relevant stakeholders and audience for dissemination of research findings; Support the implementation and operationalization of the Departmental Knowledge Management Strategy, as well as relevant DPSA knowledge management directives, policies, and circulars, to promote effective knowledge-sharing, retention, and management practices across the department; Facilitate and coordinate the participation of subject matter experts in contributing, reviewing, and maintaining knowledge products within the departmental knowledge hub, ensuring that information is accurate, relevant, and aligned with organizational knowledge-management standards. Render Administrative and Secretarial support to the Directorate: Assist with setting up of interviews; Provide assistance with copywriting and editing of documents; Maintain administrative records; Assist with drafting of submissions; Prepare/write/type/documents, presentations, memorandums, letters and reports on behalf of the Directorate; Arrange meetings, take minutes and compile reports; Maintain internal and external stakeholder relationships.
jobs.enquiries: Ms Ntando Buthelezi at 066 077 7002
jobs.applications: Recruitment01@dwypd.gov.za
jobs.notes: Preference will be given to African Male/ Female, Coloured, Female/Male, White female/Male, Youth as well as persons with disabilities as these groups are underrepresented in this post.

af.title: Navorser
af.summary: Navorserpos in die Department of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities wat 'n diploma of graad in sosiale wetenskappe vereis asook drie jaar se navorsingservaring.
af.requirements: Matric-sertifikaat en Nasionale Diploma/Graad in Sosiale Wetenskappe, Ontwikkelingswetenskappe, Publieke Administrasie/Bestuur of 'n relevante NQF 6-kwalifikasie. 'n Minimum van 3 jaar praktiese ervaring in die navorsingsveld. Kennis: Wetgewing, bestuursraamwerk en voorskrifte van toepassing op navorsing en beleid; Beleidsnavorsing en -ontleding; Beleidsnavorsing en -ontleding; PMFA en Tesour regulasies; Batho Pele-beginsels en toepassing daarvan; Navorsingsmetodes, data-insameling, sintese en ontledings; Kennisbestuur en Data-geletterdheid. Vaardighede, Primêr: Diversiteitsbewustheid, analitiese en verslagskryfvaardighede, mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede; Toegepaste strategiese denke; Kliëntefokus en -reaksiwiteit; Beplanning en organisering; Deurlopende verbetering; Mensebestuur en -ontwikkeling; Spanleierskap. Sekondêr: Basiese begroting en finansiële bestuur; Probleemoplossing en besluitneming; Projekbestuur; Rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Office Suite); Nettwerk bou en verbindings bou; Impak en invloed; Diversiteitsbestuur. Persoonlike eienskappe: Etiese gedrag; Eerlikheid en integriteit; Emosionele intelligensie; Passie en prestasiegedrewe; Vermoe om onder druk te werk; Vermoe om vertroulikheid van inligting te handhaaf; Respek vir outeursregte/afkeer van plagiaat.
af.duties: Dra by tot die implementering van die navorsingsagenda verbonde aan die sosio-ekonomiese bemagtiging en gelykheid van gender van vroue, jeug en persone met gestremdhede; Versamel en ontleed navorsingsdata; Ontleed kwalitatiewe en kwantitatiewe data met behulp van toepaslike gereedskap en tegnieke; Neem deel aan die samestelling van navorsings-uitvoerende opsommings, verslae en voorleggings; Voer literatuuroorsigte uit; Berei voor en dateer navorsingsdata op; Verskaf tersaaklike navorsingsartikels en/of verslae; Verskaf navorsings bystand en -ondersteuning aan die Direktoraat. Verskaf insette en ondersteuning in die hersiening en ontleding van beleide/wetsontwerpe/wetgewing/navorsing/verslae: Voer ontleding uit van geïdentifiseerde beleide/wetsontwerpe/wetgewing/navorsingsverslae, verskaf insette en waar nodig, identifiseer areas vir moontlike hersiening; Neem deel aan forums of vergaderings vir beleidsdialoë en -besprekings; Verseker dat navorsing voldoen aan etiese standaarde en tersaaklike regulasies; Werk saam met spanlede, belanghebbendes en eksterne vennote. Verskaf Inligtingskennisbestuursondersteuning: Verskaf hulp met data-invoeraktiwiteite; Onderhou die Navorsings-, Wetgewings- en Beleidsregister-rekords vir die departement; Bystand verleen met die identifisering en onderhoud van tersaaklike belanghebbendes en gehore vir die verspreiding van navorsingsbevindings; Ondersteun die implementering en operasionalisering van die Departementele Kennisbestuursstrategie, asook tersaaklike DPSA-kennisbestuursriglyne, beleide en sirkulaires, om effektiewe kennisdeling, -behoud en -bestuurspraktyke regdeur die departement te bevorder; Fasiliteer en koördineer die deelname van vakspesialiste by die bydrae, hersiening en onderhoud van kennisprodukte binne die departementele kennis sentrum, om te verseker dat inligting akkuraat, tersaaklik en in ooreenstemming met organisatoriese kennisbestuursstandaarde is. Verskaf Administratiewe en Sekretariële ondersteuning aan die Direktoraat: Bystand verleen met die reël van onderhoude; Verskaf hulp met kopskryf en redigering van dokumente; Onderhou administratiewe rekords; Bystand verleen met die opstel van voorleggings; Berei voor/skryf/tik dokumente, voorleggings, memorandum, briewe en verslae namens die Direktoraat; Reël vergaderings, neem notule en stel verslae op; Onderhou interne en eksterne belanghebbende verhoudinge.

zu.title: Umcingi
zu.summary: Isikhundla somcingi kumnyango wezenwezakhe nobulili ohlukile nembandana ephila nokhubazekile, esidinga idiploma noma idigri kwezolimo nezempilo yogqozi kanye namaphesente amathathu okuhamba kwesikhathi sokuba ngumuntu oyazi ukuthi kwenziwa kanjani uphando.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samatrikulasi kanye neDiploma yezwe/Idigri kwezolimo lokuxhumana nabantu, izimiso zokwakha komzabalazo, iNqubo kahulumeni/Imigomo yokuqondisa noma izifundo ezithintekayo ezilingana neNQF 6. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-3 yokuba nomzamo osemthethweni olawula ukukhombiswa kwephrojekthi ephathwa ngocwaningo. Ulwazi: Izimiso zomthetho, okokufaka imithetho namaphesente; ukukhomba isimiso somthetho nokusihlaziya; ukukhomba isimiso somthetho nokusihlaziya; i-PMFA namaphesente ezezimali; izimiso ze-Batho Pele nokusetshenziswa kwazo; izindlela zokucwaninga, ukuqoqa imininingwane, ukwakha nokuhlaziya; ukuphathwa kolwazi nokufunda imininingwane. Amakhono, Okuyinhloko: Ukuqonda ukubanzi, amakhono okuhlaziya nokubhala imibiko, amakhono okuxhumana ngomlomo nokubhala; ukucabanga ngokusimama komzamo; ukugxila kumthengi nokuphendula; ukwenza izinhlelo nokuhlela; ukuthuthuka okuqhubekayo; ukuphatha nokuthuthukisa abantu; ukuba ngumholi wesiqhaza. Okwesibili: ukumiswa kwezimali okuyisisekelo nokuphatha imali; ukuxazulula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo; ukuphatha amaphrojekthi; ulwazi lwekhompyutha (MS Office Suite); ukuxhumana nokwakha izibopho; ukuthinta nomthelela; ukuphatha ukubanzi. Izimpawu zobuntu: Ukuziphatha ngokomthetho; ukuqinisekiswa ngokwamanga nokukholwa ekwazini; ukuqonda izinkanhliziyo; inkanuko nokuzabalazela ukufeza izinhloso; ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi kweggandaganda; ikono lokugcina imfihlo yemininingwane; inhlonipho yamalungelo obumbi ukuthi / ukungezwa okubi.
zu.duties: Ngenisa isandla ekusebenziseni ihlelo locwaningo ngokuphathelene nokukhuluma abesifazane intsha nabantu abakhubazekile ekukhonyeni ukusebenza kahle kwezomnotho kanye nokuqoqwa ngokobulili; qoqa ukuhlaziya imininingwane locwaningo; Hlaziya imininingwane ekhomba inani nengqikithi ngokusebenzisa ithuluzi nezindlela ezifanele; Thatha inxaxheba ekuqokeleleni isifinyezo sabaphathi, imibiko kanye nesethulo; Yenza ukuphendula izincwadi; Lungiselela futhi uvuselele imininingwane locwaningo; Yezela amaphepha ocwaningo kanye/noma imibiko; Nikeza ngesandla lokusebenza kanye noncedo kwi-Directorate. Faka izimalimbe kanye noncedo ekuqwalaseleni nasekuhlaziyeni imigomo/izikweletu/umthetho/ucwaningo/imibiko: Yenza ukuhlaziya okukhombiswe imigomo/izikweletu/umthetho/imibiko yocwaningo, faka imininingwane kanti lapho kudingeka khona, khomba izindawo ezingaqwalaselwa; Thatha inxaxheba kuma-foramu noma imihlangano yokuxoxa ngemigomo kanye nezinkulumo; Qinisekisa ukuthi ucwaningo luhambisana namazinga okuziphatha ngokomthetho kanye nemithetho ehlobene nayo; Sebenzisana namalungu esiqhaza, izingxoxo, kanye nabalingani bangaphandle. Nikeza ngokulawula imininingwane kanye nokuqondisa ukusekelwa kolwazi: Nikeza ngesandla ekuthathweni kwemininingwane; Gcina imibiko yokucwaninga, umthetho kanye nokuqwalaselwa imigamo kumnyango; Siza ekukhombiseni nokugcineni izingxoxo kanye nabaphulukile abahlobene ekwabelaneni ngemiphumela yokucwaninga; Sekela ukusetshenziswa nokwenza kusebenze isu lokuphatha ulwazi lomnyango, kanye nemiyalo yabaphathi we-DPSA yokuphatha ulwazi, imigamo, namaphephancwadi, ukuze kwamukelwe ukwabelana ngolwazi ngokusebenza, ukugcina, kanye nokuphathwa kolwazi kulo lonke umnyango; Hlola futhi uhlanganise ukuthathwa koxhamukiwe ukuxhase ezindimeni zokufaka, ukuqwalasela, nokugcina imikhiqizo yolwazi endaweni yokuthola ulwazi lomnyango, ukuze imininingwane iqinisekiswe ngokubaluleka ngokuhlobene nokuhambisana namazinga okuphatha ulwazi kohlelo. Nikeza ngenkulu yokugcina imininingwane kanye noncedo lokubhala emyaleweni: Siza ukumisa izingxoxo; Nikeza ngesandla ekubhaleni okunye nasekuhleleni kwamadokhumenti; Gcina imibiko yezinsiza; Siza ekubhaleni izethulo; Lungiselela/bhala/thayipha/amadokhumenti, imithombo, amamemorandamu, izincwadi namaphesente ngenxa ye-Directorate; Hlela imihlangano, thatha amaminithi ugcine imibiko; Gcina ubudlelwano bangaphakathi nangaphandle nabahlangeneyo.

xh.title: Umphandi
xh.summary: Isithuba somphandi kwiSebe lezoNabafazi, iNtsholongwane nezoBomi babaNokuphila ngokwesini beBungumphakathi esifuna idiploma okanye isidanga kwezenzululwazi zentlalo kwaye sifuna iimveliso zonyaka omtathu zobugcisa obuphandayo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seMatric kunye neDiploma yesiLizwe/Isidanga kwezenzululwazi zentlalo, ezokusetyenziswa ekubeni nobomi bahlukahlukeneyo, ukulawulwa koluntu / ukuphathwa okanye isiqinisekiso esihambelana neNQF 6. Okungaphezulu kweminyaka engu-3 yamava akusebenzayo kummandla wophando. Ulwazi: Ulwawulo, undokufa koluntu olulawulwayo nemithefundo osetyenziswa kumphando kunye nenqongo; Uphando kunye nokunikezelwa kolwango-mqondiso; Uphando kunye nokunikezelwa kolwango-mqondiso; I-PMFA kunye neendlela ezilawula iTreasury; Iimpawu zikaBatho Pele nendlela zokusetyenziswa; Iindlela zophando, ukuqokelela iingcombolo, ukwenziwa kwemixholo kunye neyomnyili; Ukuphatha ulwazi ukwazi okunamagama. Amakhono, Okokuqala: Ukuqonda ukwahlukana kwabantu, amakhono okwenza isikripthi-ngqondo nokubhala iingxelo, amakhono okuthetha nokubhala; Ukusebenzisa isazimo-mqondiso; Ukuqwalasela kumthengi nokuphendula; Ukuqhubelela ngoko; Ukuqhuba iqhinga ekomelelweni; Ukuphetha abantu nokuphuhlisa; Ukulawula iqhinga. Okwamandulo: Ulwazi malunga neendlela zemali kunye neendlela ezilungele imali; Amaxa okusombulula iingxaki ukuze uzinike inkqubo; Uphetha imicimbi; Ukwazi ukusebenzisa iikhompyutha (MS Office Suite); Ukwakhiwa kweqhinga kunye nokuzinza phakathi kwamandu; Iimpembelelo kwindalo yamalungu; Ukuphatha ukwahlukana. Ubuni bomntu: Ukuziphatha kwayedwa; Ukuqiniseka nokuzinikela; Isazimo-mqondiso ngokwemizwa; Ngenkalo yazo zonke iindawo ezixhaphazileyo; Ukusebenza ngenqanaba legcisa; Ukugcina iindaba eziyimfihlelo; Ukuzinikela ngokwemilinganiselo yeendawo ezizodwa/ukuzithanda iindawo ezizezona.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso ekuphumeleleni kolwazi-mqondiso wophando oqhagamshelwe nentlalo-uchungechunge lokuzinza kwabafazi, iNtsholongwane neBantu basekhadi Imaneli; Qokelela kwaye uvavanye ingcombolo yophando; Hlola iingcombolo ezilandelayo: iindlela zophando ezahlukeneyo, ukwenza isikripthi-mqondiso kunye nokulungisa ulwazi-mqondiso; Thatha inxaxheba ekwakhiweni kolwazi-mqondiso, iingxelo kunye nezimbonakaliso; Yenza izifundo ngesiXhosa; Lungele, ugcine ulwazi-mqondiso; Khangelo inkqubo yemisebenzi yophando okanye iingxelo; Yinkxaso yophando kunye neNgcinee ekuLawuleni. Nika iingcombolo kunye nenkxaso ekuphuhliseni okwangoku kuphando: Hlola inkqubo echanekileyo yokunikezelwa kolwazi-mqondiso, iingcombolo, iindawo ezifunwa ngokusesikweni, iindawo ezingamava, iingxelo zophando: Yenza inkqubo yophando ekhethiweyo okanye iingxelo ezichanekileyo zomthetho; Thatha inxaxheba kwiindumba okanye iindibano zenkqubo yophando, ukudibana nabalawuli kunye nemiqondo esuka kumaphakathi kwelinye ihlobo lophando; Qinisekisa ukuba kuphando kuhambe ngemigaqo yesiXhosa nezinye izinto ezikwizikhundla ezahlukeneyo; Sebenzisana nathi iqhinga, abo baphathwa nasekwindalo yethu. Yinkxaso yoLawulo loLwazi ngokubanzi: Nikela ngokuncedisa imisebenzi yokugcina iingcombolo; Gcina iingxelo zophando, umthetho kunye neNkqubo yamaphakathi ezebe; Seda ekuphuhliseni nasekugcineni abantu ababalulekileyo nokulungelelana kolwazi lophando; Nxaxha ekuphumeleleni nasekubeni nolonake lweSebe lePhando loLwazi ngokubanzi, nasekusebenziseni imigaqo yolwazi nemiqondiso kaDPSA, ukuze ukhuthaze ukwabelwana ngolwazi, ukugcina nokulawula imisebenzi ngokuchanekileyo kulo lonke isebe; Qhube kwaye ulawule ukuthabathwa kwabaMphandi kuphuhliso-mphi, ukuqwalasela, nokugcina iinkqubo zolwazi kwindawo yolwazi yesebe, ukuqinisekisa ukuba ulwazi luchanekileyo, luhambelana nolonake loqoqosho.

jobs.title: Senior Youth Development Officer
jobs.department: Department of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities
jobs.closing_date_text: 06 November 2026 at 16:00 NOTES : All fields in the Z83 application form on https://recruitment.dwypd.gov.za/ must be completed in full, in a manner that allows a selection committee to assess the quality of a candidate based on the information provided in the form. It is therefore prudent that fields be completed by applicants and signed, noting the importance of the declaration. South African applicants need not to provide passport numbers. Candidate must respond “Yes “or “No “to the question whether you are conducting business with the state. If “Yes”, details thereof only shortlisted candidates will submit Declaration form for conducting business with the state when shortlisted to the application. It is acceptable for applicant to indicate “not applicable” or leave a blank to the question “In the event that you are employed in the Public Service, will you immediately relinquish such business interest?” Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents but must submit the completed and signed Z83 and detailed Curricula Vitae. The communication from HR of the Department regarding the requirement for certified document will be limited to shortlisted candidates. Therefore, only shortlisted candidate for a post will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from HR. Applications received after the closing date will NOT be considered or accepted. Correspondence is limited to short-listed candidates only; should you not hear from us within six weeks of the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. Non-RSA citizens/permanent resident permit holders must submit a copy only when shortlisted. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Should you not hear from the Department within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to fill and/or make an appointment to any of the advertised posts. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Further, personnel suitability checks, including security vetting, competency assessment will be conducted, as such transfer/promotion/appointment will made subject to positive outcomes of personnel suitability checks. Successful candidates shall be required to enter into performance agreement within three (3) months of assuming their duties in the Department, and within one (1) month of the date of their appointment conclude the prescribed contract of employment. Designated employees shall be required to disclose their financial interest within 30 days after assumption of duty. Appointments will only be made on the first notch of the advertised salary level. Note that in terms of the Protection of Personal Information Act, 2021, the Department will ensure the protection of applicants ‘personal information and only collect, use and retain applicants’ personal information for the purposes of recruitment and selection processes. The Department shall safeguard such personal information against access by unauthorised persons, unlawful disclosure, or breaches. The Department is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. In the filling of these posts, it is the intention of the Department to promote representivity in the Public Service through the filling of this position and the candidature of persons whose transfer/promotion/appointment will promote representivity will receive preference as the objectives of section 195 of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa and the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act 55 of 1998) will be taken into consideration. OTHER POSTS
jobs.summary: Senior Youth Development Officer based in Pretoria requiring a relevant NQF 6/7 qualification, a driver's licence and three years' youth development experience.
jobs.requirements: Matric Certificate and National Diploma/Degree (NQF6/7) in Youth Development, or Social Sciences, or a relevant NQF 6/7 qualification. A valid driver’s licence is required; however, this requirement is not applicable to persons with disabilities. Applicants must have a minimum of three (3) years’ practical experience in youth development programme/field. Knowledge: Legislation, governance framework and prescripts applicable to the Youth Sector; Risk management; NYP2030, NYDA Act, PFMA and Treasury regulations; Batho Pele principles and application thereof; Research methodologies and analyses; Knowledge management and Data Literacy. Skills: Primary; Diversity awareness; Effective report writing, verbal and written communication skills; Applied strategic thinking; Customer focus and responsiveness; Planning and organising; Continuous improvement; People management and development; Team Leadership. Secondary: Basic Budgeting and Financial Management; Problem solving and decision-making; Project management; Computer Literacy (MS Office Suite); Networking and building bonds; Impact Influence; Diversity management. Personal Attributes: Ethical behaviour; Honesty and Integrity; Emotional Intelligence; Passion and Achievement driven; Ability to work under pressure; Ability to maintain confidentiality of information; Respect for copyrights/aversion to plagiarism.
jobs.duties: Organise, mobilise and engage youth stakeholders: Drafting proposals, concept documents and submissions on youth stakeholder engagements; Compile reports on national and international engagements conducted; Compile reports and outcomes of stakeholder meetings; Oversee convening of stakeholder meetings and ensure that invitations, agenda, and minutes are compiled, signed and approved; Monitor meeting decision and compile status reports; Organise the National Youth Machinery meetings and compile a report; Participate in and support the Provincial and Local Youth Forums; Consolidate National Youth Month Programmes of Activities of stakeholders; Participate in the Youth Month National Task Team. Manage youth development stakeholder database: Update stakeholder database after every stakeholder engagement; Share the database with the stakeholders where necessary. Support youth engagement policies and strategies: Make input into the drafting of National Youth Machinery Framework and consolidate inputs; Make input into the drafting of youth work professionalisation policy; Participate in the consultation process of youth work professionalisation policy consolidate inputs; Distribute the youth work professional policy to stakeholders; Ensure finalisation of the constitution for the association for professionalisation of youth workers; Ensure registration of the youth workers’ Association. Support political principals on national and international engagements: Coordinate the National Youth Engagements; Coordinate International Stakeholder Engagement (BRICKS, Commonwealth, SADCA, UN, EU and IBSA); Attend meetings on national and international engagements and provide reports to the unit; Provide inputs notes for political principals; Develop submissions and briefing notes for the political principals for national and international engagements. Provide support and manage youth projects to advance youth development: Manage the professionalization of youth work project; Support the young women’s projects; Support on the ethical leadership and student representative council project; Facilitate social ills interventions to address the vulnerability of young people; Facilitate capacity building interventions for youth focal points.
jobs.enquiries: Mr OJ Fourie at 079 507 0127
jobs.applications: Recruitment03@dwypd.gov.za
jobs.notes: Preference will be given to African females, Coloured, (Males/Female,) Indians, (Male/Female), White (Male/Female), Youth as well as Persons with Disabilities, as these groups are underrepresented in this post.

af.title: Senior Jeugontwikkelingsbeampte
af.summary: Senior Jeugontwikkelingsbeampte gebaseer in Pretoria vereis 'n relevante NQF 6/7-kwalifikasie, 'n bestuurslisensie en drie jaar se jeugontwikkelingservaring.
af.requirements: Matrissertifikaat en Nasionale Diploma/Graddiploma (NQF6/7) in Jeugontwikkeling, of Sosiale Wetenskappe, of 'n relevante NQF 6/7-kwalifikasie. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie word vereis; hierdie vereiste is egter nie van toepassing op persone met gestremdhede nie. Aansoekers moet 'n minimum van drie (3) jaar se praktiese ervaring in jeugontwikkelingsprogramme/-veld hê. Kennis: Wetgewing, bestuursraamwerk en voorskrifte van toepassing op die Jeugsektor; Risikobestuur; NYP2030, NYDA-wet, PFMA en Tesourie-regulasies; Batho Pele-beginsels en die toepassing daarvan; Navorsingsmetodes en -ontledings; Kennisbestuur en Dataliteratuur. Vaardighede: Primêr; Diversiteitsbewustheid; Effektiewe verslagskrywing, mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede; Toegepaste strategiese denke; Kliëntfokus en reaksievermoë; Beplanning en organisering; Deurlopende verbetering; Mensbestuur en -ontwikkeling; Spanleierskap. Sekondêr: Basiese begroting en finansiële bestuur; Probleemoplossing en besluitneming; Projektbestuur; Rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Office Suite); Netwerking en die bou van bande; Impak en invloed; Diversiteitsbestuur. Persoonlike eienskappe: Etiese gedrag; Eerlikheid en integriteit; Emosionele intelligensie; Passie en prestasiegedrewe; Vermoë om onder druk te werk; Vermoë om vertroulikheid van inligting te handhaaf; Respek vir outeursregte/afkeer van plagiaat.
af.duties: Organiseer, mobiliseer en betrek jeugbelanghebbendes: Opstel van voorstelle, konsepdokumente en voorleggings oor jeugbelanghebbende-betrokkenheid; Stel verslae op oor nasionale en internasionale betrekkinge wat uitgevoer is; Stel verslae en uitkomste van belanghebbendesvergaderings op; Hou toezig oor die byeenroeping van belanghebbendesvergaderings en verseker dat uitnodigings, agenda en notules opgestel, onderteken en goedgekeur word; Monitor besluite van vergaderings en stel statusverslae op; Organiseer die Nasionale Jeugmasjien-vergaderings en stel 'n verslag op; Neem deel aan en ondersteun die Provinsiale en Plaaslike Jeugforums; Konsolideer Nasionale Jeugmaand-programme van aktiwiteite van belanghebbendes; Neem deel aan die Jeugmaand Nasionale Taakspan. Bestuur die jeugontwikkelingsbelanghebbendes-databasis: Dateer die belanghebbendes-databasis op na elke belanghebbendesbetrokkenheid; Deel die databasis met die belanghebbendes waar nodig. Ondersteun jeugbetrokkenheidsbeleid en -strategieë: Lewer insette by die opstel van die Nasionale Jeugmasjien-raamwerk en konsolideer insette; Lewer insette by die opstel van die professionaliseringsbeleid vir jeugwerk; Neem deel aan die raadplegingsproses van die professionaliseringsbeleid vir jeugwerk en konsolideer insette; Versprei die professionaliseringsbeleid vir jeugwerk aan belanghebbendes; Verseker finalisering van die grondwet vir die assosiasie vir die professionalisering van jeugwerkers; Verseker registrasie van die jeugwerkers-assosiasie. Ondersteun politieke.principale by nasionale en internasionale betrekkinge: Koördineer die Nasionale Jeugbetrokkenhede; Koördineer internasionale belanghebbendesbetrokkenheid (BRICKS, Commonwealth, SADCA, UN, EU en IBSA); Woon vergaderings oor nasionale en internasionale betrekkinge by en verskaf verslae aan die eenheid; Verskaf invoernote vir politieke principale; Ontwikkel voorleggings en briefnotas vir die politieke principale vir nasionale en internasionale betrekkinge. Verskaf ondersteuning en bestuur jeugprojekte om jeugontwikkeling te bevorder: Bestuur die professionaliseringsprojek van jeugwerk; Ondersteun die jongvroueprojekte; Ondersteun die projek vir etiese leierskap en studenteverteenwoordigende raad; Fasiliteer maatskaplike probleem-intervensies om die kwesbaarheid van jongmense aan te spreek; Fasiliteer kapasiteitsbou-intervensies vir jeugfokuspunte.

zu.title: Sozugogo Sokuthuthukiswa Kwentsha
zu.summary: Ukulawula ukuthuthukiswa kwentsha okuphezulu esebenza ePretoria kudinga iziqu eziphathelene nezifundo ezithile ze-NQF 6/7, ilayisensi yokushayela, kanye namakhono eminyaka emithathu wokuqeqeshwa kokuthuthukiswa kwentsha.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Matric kanye ne-National Diploma/Degree (NQF6/7) kwi-Youth Development, noma izifundo zezenhlalo, noma izifundo ezihambisana ne-NQF 6/7. Itholakala ilayisensi yokushayela; nokho, le sidingo asikabandakanyi abantu abasikhonzile. Kufanele kube nokubhaliswa okuncane kweminyaka emithathu (3) yeminyaka yokuqeqeshwa kokuzijwayeza ekuthuthukisweni kwezinhlela/zinkinga zentsha. Ulwazi: Umthetho, izinqubo zokubusa kanye nezibhalo ezithinta i-Sector Yentsha; Ukuphathwa kwezingozi; i-NYP2030, i-NYDA Act, i-PFMA kanye nemithetho ye-Treasury; Izimiso ze-Batho Pele kanye nokusetshenziswa kwazo; Izindlela zocwaningo kanye nokuqoqwa kwephoyisa lemininingwane; Ukulawula ulwazi kanye ne-Data Literacy. Amandla: Azele ngobukhosi; Ukwazi ngokuhlukahluka kwabantu; Ukwaziswa kokubhala imibiko, amandla okuthetha kobuhlakani obubhaliwe; Ukuzibonakalisa ngokucabangisisa ngokuhlelekile; Ukuqonda kubathengi kanye nokuphendula; Ukuhlela kanye nokuhlela izinto; Ukuphucula ngokuzimisela; Ukulawula kanye nokuqeqesha abantu; Ukuqonda amandla eqembu. Okwesibili: Okulingene namabhanca kanye neFinanci; Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokwenza izinqumo; Ukuphatha izinhlela; Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Office Suite); Ukwakha uxhumo kanye nobuhlobo; Ukuthonya imiphumela; Ukuphathwa kwezinhlobonhlobo zabantu. Izici zobuntu: Ukuziphatha ngokuzimisela; Ukuqiniseka nokwethembeka; Ukuqonda izinkalo zezemifino; Ukuthanda kanye nokuzimisela ukufinyelela; Amandla okusebenza ngaphansi kwegciwane; Amandla okugcina ithunzi lemibiko; Ukuhlonipha amalungelo obumbano / ukuziphepha ukuzenzela.
zu.duties: Hlela, hlanganisa futhi ubambe iqhaza nabanikazi balezinto eziphathelene nentsha: Bhala iziphakamiso, amadokhonda eqobo kanye nezethulo mayelana nokubamba iqhaza kwabanikazi balezinto eziphathelene nentsha; Qoqa imibiko ngokuhlangenwe nakho okwenziwe emazingeni ebizwe nasemhlabeni jikelele; Qoqa imibiko kanye nemiphumela yemihlangano yabanikazi balezinto eziphathelene nentsha; Qaphisise ukubizwa kwemihlangano yabanikazi balezinto eziphathelene nentsha futhi uqiniseke ukuthi izimemo, ihlela, kanye nemizuzu ihlelwe, futhi isayine futhi ivunyelwe; Qaphisise izinqumo zemihlangano futhi uqoqe imibiko yesimo; Hlela imihlangano ye-National Youth Machinery futhi uqoqe umbiko; Bambe iqhaza futhi useke ama-Foramu Ezinga Elihlito kanye Nomasipala entsheni; Hlanganisa Izinhlelo Zomnyaka Wezinto Ezenziwa Ngenkathi Yentsha Yezizwe zabizwe kwabanikazi balezinto eziphathelene nentsha; Bambe iqhaza ku-Youth Month National Task Team. Phatha isisekelo sedatha sabanikazi balezinto eziphathelene nentuthuko yentsha: Buyekeza isisekelo sedatha sabanikazi balezinto eziphathelene nentsha ngemva kokuhlangenwe nakho kwabanikazi balezinto eziphathelene nentsha ngakunye; Yabelana ngesisekelo sedatha nabanikazi balezinto eziphathelene nentsha lapho kudingeka khona. Sekela izinqubomgomo kanye nezindlela zokubamba iqhaza kwentsha: Nikeza okufakwe ebukhoneni bokubhalwa kwe-National Youth Machinery Framework bese uhlanganisa okufakiwe; Nikeza okufakwe ebukhoneni bokubhalwa kwenqubomgomo yokubhalwa ngobungcweti emsebenzini ongentsha; Bambe iqhaza inqubo yekonsultathi yenqubomgomo yokubhalwa ngobungcweti emsebenzini ongentsha, hlanganisa okufakiwe; Sabalalisa inqubomgomo yobungcweti emsebenzini ongentsha kubanikazi balezinto eziphathelene nentsha; Qinisekisa ukupheliswa komthethosisekelo wezinhlangano zokubhalwa ngobungcweti basebenzi bentsha; Qinisekisa ukubhalisa kwezinhlangano zabasebenzi bentsha. Sekela abaphathi bezombusazwe emhlanganweni ebizwe nasemhlabeni jikelele: Hlela emakhono ukubamba iqhaza kwentsha ebizwe; Hlela ukubamba iqhaza kwabanikazi balezinto eziphathelene nabanye emhlabeni jikelele (BRICKS, Commonwealth, SADCA, UN, EU kanye ne-IBSA); Zwa imihlangano ebizwe nasemhlabeni jikelele bese unikeza imibiko eqoqwe esimweni; Nikeza okufakwe ebukhoneni bezinhlaka zezinhlaka zombuso; Bhala izethulo kanye nezinhlaka zokwazisa abaphathi bezombusazwe mayelana nokubamba iqhaza emhlanganweni ebizwe nasemhlabeni jikelele. Nikeza usekelo bese uphatha izinhlela zentsha ukuze usize ekuthuthukisweni kwentsha: Phatha inqubo yokubhalwa ngobungcweti emsebenzini wentsha; Sekela izinhlela zabesifazane abasha; Sekela ekuqondiseni ubuholo obuzothile kanye nenqubo yebandla labafundi abamele abanye; Siza ekubeni kungene izindlela zokungenelela ezenzela ukubhekana nobuntwini bezinkinga kubantu abasha; Siza ekubeni kungene izindlela zokwakha amandla kubantu abasemikhakheni ebalulekile yentsha.

xh.title: Isikhulu Esinemvuyo Esibungula Intshukubo Yokuphuhlisa Abantu Abatsha
xh.summary: Isikhulu Esinemvuyo Esibungula Intshukubo Yokupphuhlisa Abantu Abatsha esekwe ePretoria esifuna isifundo esifanelekileyo seNQF 6/7, ilayisenisi yokuqhuba kunye neminyaka mitatu yamava odkuphuhlisa abantu abatsha.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seMatric kunye neDiploma eyiNqanaba leSizwe/Digri (NQF6/7) ekuPhuhliseni Abantu Abatsha, okanye eZoloncedo lwezenzululwazi, okanye isifundo esifanelekileyo seNQF 6/7. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni iyafuneka; nangona kunjalo, le mfuno ayifanelekeli abantu abakhubekileyo. Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe namava okusebenzisa okungenani eminyaka mitatu (3) ekubeni bahlaziya iinkqubo ekuPhuhliseni Abantu Abatsha. Ulwazi: Izixhobo zamthetho, inkqubo yolawulo nemimisela osebenza kummandla weNtshukubo yoButsha; uLawulo lwengozi; NYP2030, uMthetho weNYDA, iPFMA kunye nemimiselo yeTreasury; imigaqo yeBatho Pele nokusetyenziswa kwayo; iindlela zokuphandla nokuhlalutya ulwazi; uLawulo lolwazi kunye nokumfunda iData. Amakhono: Eyona njongo; Ukuqonda iintsingiselo ngokweluhlu ngokweentsapho; Ukubhala iingxelo ngokusebenza, amakhono okunxibelelana ngokuthetha nokubhala; Ukuqonda okusetyenziswa ngengcinga ekuqondisisa iindaba; Ukugxila kumthengi nokuphendula; Ukucazelana nokuhlela; Ukuphucula ngokusukelela; uLawulo nokuphuhlisa abantu; uLawulo loQeqesho lweQela. Eyesibini: uLawulo loMfuno mali olusisiseko kunye noLawulo lweMali; ukuSombulula iingxaki nokwenza izigqibo; uLawulo lweProjekthi; ukuQonda iziKhompyutha (MS Office Suite); ukuQhakambisa iqhina nokwakha ubudlelwano; ukuNamathela kolunye; uLawulo ngokwentsapho. Iimpawu zobuNTU: Ukuziphatha ngokuzinikela; uQqozo nokuzinikela; ukuQonda iimvakalelo; INkathazo nokuzimisela ukufeza iziphumo; uKwazi ukusebenza ngexesha elinzima; uKwazi ukugcina imfihlo yolonwabo; uHlonelo lwalawo malunga nokuqamba ngokucopya nokuthandabuza ukuziphatha kwabanye abantu abayiqambiyo.
xh.duties: Ukuqamba, ukudityanisa nokunxibelelana nabaqambi babantu abatsha: ukubhala iingxelo ezisiwayo, amaxwebhu ngokwemigaqo kunye nezicelo malunga nabaqambi babantu abatsha; ukuyila iingxelo malunga nentsebenziswano yente ngokuzimvela nakwamanye amazwe; ukuyila iingxelo nangemiphumela yemiqungqela yabaqambi babantu abatsha; ukuqwalasela imiqungqela yabaqambi babantu abatsha kuqinisekiswe ukuba imenyu, inqaku nemiqungqela iqamba ihlolelwe ukwenzeka, isayinwe igunyaziwe; ukuqwalasela iingxelo zemiqungqela nokuqamba iingxelo ezisisiseko; ukuLungelelanisa imiqungqela yeMfihlo yeSizwe nakummandla weButsha nokuyila ingxelo; ungenelele uncedise kwiNkqubo yokuQhela iNgingqi yomNtsha; ukuyila iinkqubo zomnyaka wokuzenzela abantanga abatsha malunga nemisebenzi yabaqambi babantu abatsha; ukuzinza kwakunye noncedo kwiNkqubo yoNyaka wokuQhela abantanga abatsha weSizwe. UkuLawula idatabase yabaqambi babantu abatsha: ukuhlaziya idatabase yabaqambi babantu abatsha emva komnye nomqambi ngamnye; ukwabelana ngedatabase nabaqambi babantu abatsha apho kufuneka khona. ukuncedisa iNgxelo ngokumthetho nokuyila inkqubo yokunxibelelana nabantanga abatsha: ukungenisa amanqaku kwisiQendu sokuyila inkqubo yeNgingqi yokuQhela iNtshukubo yoButsha yaseSizwe nokuqamba inqaku ngamnye; ukungenisa amanqaku kwisiQendu sokuyila iNkqubo yokusebenza ngokutsha ukuyila igama leNtshukubo kaYomntsha; ukuzinza kwinkqubo yoxoxo yabaqambi babantu abatsha malunga noyilo lweenkqubo zokusebenza kwabantanga abatsha; ukwabelana ngenkqubo yokusebenza kwabaqambi babantu abatsha kummandla wabo; ukuqinisekisa ukugqitywa kolwabiwo lomthethosiseko kumanqanaba olawulo kunye neNqubo ekuQhelwa kuyo yonke imiQango yokusebenza ngokutsha; ukuqinisekisa ukubhalwa koluhlu lwenkqubo kaYomntsha. Uncedo ukuzinza koluntu kwinxibelelwano nakwamanye amazwe: ukulungelelanisa nokuqamba iNgxelo yonxibelelwano nabaqambi babantanga abatsha yaseSizwe; ukulungelelanisa nokuqamba iNgxelo yonxibelelwano nabaqambi kwamanye amazwe (iBRICKS, iCommonwealth, iSADCA, i-UN, i-EU kunye ne-IBSA); ukuzinza kwemiQungqela yonxibelelwano yaseSizwe nakwamanye amazwe kunye nokunika ingxelo kwikhomityhemi; ukuyiwa kwemiQungqela malunga nonxibelelwano yaseSizwe nakwamanye amazwe nokuyiwa kwamanye amazwe nokwenza ingxelo eqondisa ngokukhawuleza ekuqweni; ukuyila iingxelo ezisisiseko nokuqamba iingxelo ezisisiseko zoluntu lwengingqi olunxibelela nabaqambi babantu abatsha ngokwesizwe nakwamanye amazwe. ukunikela ncedo nokuLawula nokuLawula iProjekthi yokuphuhlisa abantanga abatsha: ukuLawula iProjekthi yokusebenza nokutsha komntu omtsha; ukunikela ncedo kwabaqambi babantu abatsha abangamakhosikazi amlunjwana; ukunikela ncedo ngokukhethwa koluntu ngokuzinikela nokuqonda abameli bomntu omtsha; ukukhuthaza nokwenza imigaqo yokumiswa kwakho na kwenzakalo ekubeni ngabanjini kubomi bakho; ukukhuthaza imigaqo ekwazi ukwenza iProjekthi ekusebenzela abantanga abatsha.

jobs.title: Information Technology Technician
jobs.department: Department of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities
jobs.closing_date_text: 06 November 2026 at 16:00 NOTES : All fields in the Z83 application form on https://recruitment.dwypd.gov.za/ must be completed in full, in a manner that allows a selection committee to assess the quality of a candidate based on the information provided in the form. It is therefore prudent that fields be completed by applicants and signed, noting the importance of the declaration. South African applicants need not to provide passport numbers. Candidate must respond “Yes “or “No “to the question whether you are conducting business with the state. If “Yes”, details thereof only shortlisted candidates will submit Declaration form for conducting business with the state when shortlisted to the application. It is acceptable for applicant to indicate “not applicable” or leave a blank to the question “In the event that you are employed in the Public Service, will you immediately relinquish such business interest?” Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents but must submit the completed and signed Z83 and detailed Curricula Vitae. The communication from HR of the Department regarding the requirement for certified document will be limited to shortlisted candidates. Therefore, only shortlisted candidate for a post will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from HR. Applications received after the closing date will NOT be considered or accepted. Correspondence is limited to short-listed candidates only; should you not hear from us within six weeks of the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. Non-RSA citizens/permanent resident permit holders must submit a copy only when shortlisted. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Should you not hear from the Department within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to fill and/or make an appointment to any of the advertised posts. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Further, personnel suitability checks, including security vetting, competency assessment will be conducted, as such transfer/promotion/appointment will made subject to positive outcomes of personnel suitability checks. Successful candidates shall be required to enter into performance agreement within three (3) months of assuming their duties in the Department, and within one (1) month of the date of their appointment conclude the prescribed contract of employment. Designated employees shall be required to disclose their financial interest within 30 days after assumption of duty. Appointments will only be made on the first notch of the advertised salary level. Note that in terms of the Protection of Personal Information Act, 2021, the Department will ensure the protection of applicants ‘personal information and only collect, use and retain applicants’ personal information for the purposes of recruitment and selection processes. The Department shall safeguard such personal information against access by unauthorised persons, unlawful disclosure, or breaches. The Department is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. In the filling of these posts, it is the intention of the Department to promote representivity in the Public Service through the filling of this position and the candidature of persons whose transfer/promotion/appointment will promote representivity will receive preference as the objectives of section 195 of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa and the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act 55 of 1998) will be taken into consideration. jobs.summary: IT Technician sought by the Department of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities in Pretoria to provide network connectivity support, requiring a National Diploma in IT and at least two years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Matric Certificate and National Diploma/Diploma (NQF6) in Information Technology or a relevant NQF 6 qualification. ITIL Foundations Certificate, certified ITIL, MCSE, A+, N+ will be an added advantage. A valid driver’s licence is required; however, this requirement is not applicable to persons with disabilities. A minimum of 2 years’ experience in an information technology environment. Knowledge: Working knowledge of the policy and regulatory environment of information technology and security; Android and iPads mobile devices; LAN/WAN support; In-depth knowledge of performing hardware and software support for Windows. Skills: Interpersonal relations skills; Good communication Skills; Problem solving and analytical Skills; Advanced Computer Literacy; IT Technical support skills. Personal Attributes: Ethical behaviour; Honestly and Integrity; Conscientious and proactiveness; Ability to work under pressure; Ability to work independently; Ability to maintain confidentiality of information.
jobs.duties: Provide network connectivity to all computer users: Ensure accessible of WAN dependent functions; Ensure accessible of LAN dependent functions; Report on WAN functionality and connectivity changes and performance status; Report on LAN functionality and connectivity changes and performance status. Maintain Sever Room Infrastructure: Report faults of the server room within an hour to the supervisor; Ensure cleanness of the server room; Manage access to the server rooms; Update and Maintain server room access register. Maintain security and privacy of networks and computer systems: Install and upgrade anti-virus software to ensure security at the user level; Ensure the installation of the correct Operating Systems Version and Patches; Monitor Anti-Virus & Patches updates and escalate where updates are not received; Monitor & ensure connectivity of the GUP Server and escalate where it is not online. Install, configure and troubleshoot computer systems: Perform troubleshooting to diagnose and resolve computer problems; Repair or replace damaged hardware; Install and configure hardware and software components to ensure usability; Upgrade the entire system to enable compatible software on all computers; Performing tests and evaluations on new software and hardware. Provide IT service desk support services: Respond incoming calls, emails and walk in; Log calls for the queries/incidents received; Provide the client with the IT Reference number for tracking issues; Provide support to users and be the first point of contact for error reporting; Transfer or escalate unresolved incidents to the relevant units/service provider; Make certain that all queries are attended to timeously in alignment with a faster turnaround time for service delivery; Monitor the progress of the record life cycle; keep users informed of the progress of their queries. Manage, implement and maintain IT security controls to protect the department's data integrity and ensure continuity of service: Perform and monitor daily, weekly, and monthly backups of departmental systems, servers, databases, and Microsoft 365 services; Verify backup completion reports and promptly resolve backup failures; Conduct quarterly backup restore tests to validate data recoverability and integrity; Perform quarterly Disaster Recovery (DR) tests and document results; Maintain offsite and cloud-based backup repositories to ensure business continuity; Monitor Veeam Backup and Replication operations and ensure successful backup execution.
jobs.enquiries: Mr Mpolokeng Masiya at 079 8924 694

jobs.notes: Preference will be given to African Male/ Female, Coloured Male/ Female, Youth as well as Persons with Disabilities, as these groups are underrepresented in this post.

af.title: Inligtingstegnologie-tegnikus
af.summary: IT-tegnikus gesoek deur die Department of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities in Pretoria om netwerkverbindingsondersteuning te verskaf, wat 'n Nasionale Diploma in IT en ten mineste twee jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Matrik-sertifikaat en Nasionale Diploma/Diploma (NQF6) in Inligtingstegnologie of 'n relevante NQF 6-kwalifikasie. ITIL Foundations-sertifikaat, gesertifiseerde ITIL, MCSE, A+, N+ sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie word vereis; hierdie vereiste is egter nie op persone met gestremdhede van toepassing nie. 'n Minimum van 2 jaar se ervaring in 'n inligtingstegnologie-omgewing. Kennis: Werkende kennis van die beleids- en regulatoriese omgewing van inligtingstegnologie en sekuriteit; Android- en iPad-mobiele toestelle; LAN/WAN-ondersteuning; Diepgaande kennis van die uitvoer van hardeware- en sagtewareondersteuning vir Windows. Vaardighede: Tussengedragkundige verhoudingsvaardighede; Goeie kommunikasievaardighede; Probleemoplossing en analitiese vaardighede; Gevorderde rekenaarvaardigheid; IT-tegniese ondersteuningsvaardighede. Persoonlike eienskappe: Etiese gedrag; Eerlikheid en integriteit; Ywer en proaktiwiteit; Vermoë om onder druk te werk; Vermoë om onafhanklik te werk; Vermoë om die vertroulikheid van inligting te handhaaf.
af.duties: Verskaf netwerkverbinding aan alle rekenaargebruikers: Verseker toeganklikheid van WAN-afhanklike funksies; Verseker toeganklikheid van LAN-afhanklike funksies; Rapporteer oor WAN-funksionaliteit en verbindingsveranderinge en prestasiestatus; Rapporteer oor LAN-funksionaliteit en verbindingsveranderinge en prestasiestatus. Onderhou Server Room-infrastruktuur: Rapporteer foute van die server room binne 'n uur aan die toesighouer; Verseker netheid van die server room; Bestuur toegang tot die server rooms; Werk en onderhou die server room-toegangsregister. Onderhou sekuriteit en privaatheid van netwerke en rekenaarstelsels: Installeer en gradeer anti-virus-sagteware op om sekuriteit op gebruikersvlak te verseker; Verseker die installasie van die korrete Bedryfstelselweergawe en Regstellings; Monitor Anti-Virus- en Regstellings-opdaterings en eskaleer waar opdaterings nie ontvang word nie; Monitor en verseker konnektiwiteit van die GUP-bediener en eskaleer waar dit nie aanlyn is nie. Installeer, konfigureer en loste rekenaarstelsels uit: Voer probleemoplossing uit om rekenaarprobleme te diagnoseer en op te los; Herstel of vervang beskadigde hardeware; Installeer en konfigureer hardeware- en sagtewarekomponente om bruikbaarheid te verseker; Gradeer die hele stelsel om versoenbare sagteware op alle rekenaars moontlik te maak; Voer toetse en evaluerings op nuwe sagteware en hardeware uit. Verskaf IT-dienswoordondersteuningsdienste: Beantwoord inkomende oproepe, e-posse en inlopende besoekers; Log oproepe vir die navrae/voorvalle ontvang; Verskaf die kliënt met die IT-verwysingsnommer vir die naspeur van probleme; Verskaf ondersteuning aan gebruikers en wees die eerste kontakpunt vir fougeldigingsverslaggewing; Dra onopgeloste voorvalle oor of eskaleer dit na die relevante eenhede/diensverskaffer; Maak seker dat alle navrae betyds hanteer word in ooreenstemming met 'n vinniger omdraaityd vir dienslewering; Monitor die vordering van die rekordlewensiklus; hou gebruikers ingelig oor die vordering van hul navrae. Bestuur, implementeer en onderhou IT-sekuriteitskontroles om die departement se data-integriteit te beskerm en dienskontinuïteit te verseker: Voer en monitor daaglikse, weeklikse en maandelikse rugsteune van departementele stelsels, bedieners, databasisse en Microsoft 365-dienste uit; Verifieer rugsteunvoltooiingsverslae en los rugsteunmislukkings onmiddellik op; Voer kwartaallikse rugsteunhersteltoetse uit om dataterugwinbaarheid en integriteit te valideer; Voer kwartaallikse Disaster Recovery (DR)-toetse uit en dokumenteer resultate; Onderhou buiteperse en wolkgebaseerde rugsteunbewaarplekke om besigheidskontinuïteit te verseker; Monitor Veeam Backup and Replication-bewerkings en verseker suksesvolle rugsteun-uitvoering.

zu.title: Ithinosikhulu le-Innovation and Technology
zu.summary: IT Technician sought by Department of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities in Pretoria to provide network connectivity support, requiring a National Diploma in IT and at least two years' experience.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samatric kanye ne-Diploma yezwe/Diploma (NQF6) kwi-Information Technology noma noma isifundo esifanele se-NQF 6. Isitifiketi se-ITIL Foundations, esiqinisekisiwe i-ITIL, MCSE, A+, N+ kuyoba yinzuzo. Ilayisense yokushayela elivunyelwe siyadingeka; kodwa lesi sidingo asibambe abantu abasikhonza ngokubhubha ubuhle. Okungenani iminyaka emi-2 yokuqeqeshwa esimeni se-Technology yemininingwane. Ulwazi: Ulwazi lomsebenzi mayelana namapholisi kanye namandla okulawula kwemenzi yezobuchwepheshe kanye nokuphepha; Amadivayisi okuhamba njenge-Android kanye nama-iPad; Isekelo le-LAN/WAN; Ulwazi olujulile lokwenza isekelo lezinsimbi kanye ne-software ye-Windows. Amakhono: Amakhono okuxhumanisa nabantu; Amakhono amahle okuxhumana; Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga kanye nohlangothi lwengqondo; Ulwazi oluthuthukile lwekhompyutha; Amakhono esekela ubuchwepheshe be-IT. Izici Zomuntu: Ukuziphatha ngokwenisa; Ukuzithoba nokuba nesibindi; Ukuba nesifiso kanye nokwenza ngokushesha; Ukuba nokuthula ngaphansi kwezingcindezi; Ukuba nokuthula ngokwedina; Ukuba nokuthula kokugcina imininingwane efitshane.
zu.duties: Nika abasebenzisi abhozu kwesinyithi ukuxhumeka kwenethiwekhi: Qinisekisa ukuthi kusebenza imisebenzi eholela kwi-WAN; Qinisekisa ukuthi kusebenza imisebenzi eholela kwi-LAN; Cabangela ngemisebenzi ye-WAN kanye nokushintshwa kokuxhumeka nalesimo sikusebenza; Cabangela ngemisebenzi ye-LAN kanye nokushintshwa kokuxhumeka nalesimo sikusebenza. Gcina infrafethiwekhi yegumbi lesiphakeli: Mika amaphutha egumbi lesiphakeli phakathi kwehora uze uyixese ongqongqoshe; Qinisekisa ukuthi igumbi lesiphakeli lihlanzekile; Phatha ukungena kwabantu kumagumbi esiphakeli; Buya futhi ulondoloze irejista yokungena kwabantu kwegumbi lesiphakeli. Gcina ukuphepha kanye nobumfihlo bwenethiwekhi kanye namasistimu wekhompyutha: Faka futhi uluse loluqobo lwesoftware egazini ngezinjiva ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabasebenzisi ngezinga labo; Qinisekisa ukufakwa kokuhamba okulungile koluhlu lomshini wokuqalisa kanye namapaji; Qapha ulwazi olusha lwesoftware egazini kanye namapaji futhi uxuse lapho olusha bengangenwa; Qapha futhi uqinisekise ukuxhumeka kwesiphakeli i-GUP futhi uxuse lapho singakuxhuma. Faka, ulungiselele futhi ulungise amaphutha amasistimu wekhompyutha: Yenza ukulungisa amaphutha ukuze ubone futhi usolve izinkinga zekhompyutha; Lungisa noma ushintshe izinsimbi eziqhuba khompyutha ezilimele; Faka futhi ulungiselele izinsimbi kanye nezinhlobo ze-software ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ziyasebenza; Lululule inkqamba yonke ukuze ivumele i-software ehambisanayo kuyo yonke imikhompyutha; Yenza izivivinyo kanye nokubuyekeza i-software kanye nezinsimbi ezisha. Nikeza inkonzo yokusekela ideski lesevisi le-IT: Phendula amakholi asenwayo, ama-imeyili kanye nalabo abangena ngaphakathi; Bhalisa amakholi ngemibuzo/ezikhathi abekiweyo; Nikeza umthengi nenombolo yokubuka yethi yokulandelana imibuzo bese uyibuka; Nikeza abasebenzisi ngesekela futhi ube ngumuntu bokuqala ababekeze kuwo mayelana nokubika amaphutha; Dlulisela noma uxuse izinkathi ezingaxazululwa kumagumbi alingene/omhlinzisi; Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imibuzo iphendulwa ngesikhathi ngokuhambisana nesikhathi esiphezulu sokuphendula kunikezwa inkonzo; Qapha inkambiso yemibhal phakathi kwesikhathi sokuphila kwayo; Gcina abasebenzisi bezwa ngokuqhubeka kwemibuzo yabo. Phatha, faka futhi ulondoloze izilawuli zokuphepha ze-IT ukuvikela ukuzinza kwemininingwane kolumnyango futhi uqinisekise ukuphela kokunikezwa inkonzo: Yenza futhi uqaphe ukugcina imininingwane eminingi yonke ilanga, njalo ngesonto, kanye nanyanga zonke kumasistimu omnyango, iziphakeli, izinkambu zemininingwane, kanye namasevisi we-Microsoft 365; Qinisekisa imibiko yeqiniso lokuphothula ukugcina futhi usolve ngokushesha amaphutha okugcina; Yenza izivivinyo zokubuyisela imininingwane njalo kota unyaka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imininingwane ibuyiseka futhi ihlakaniphile; Yenza izivivinyo zokubuyisela emva kokubhubha (DR) njalo kota unyaka futhi ubhale imiphumela; Gcina izindawo zokugcina imininingwane ngaphandle kanye nalezo ezikulawini ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuqhubeka kobuchwepheshe; Qapha imisebenzi ye-Veeam Backup and Replication futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ukugcina imininingwane kuyaphothulwa ngempumelelo.

xh.title: Iteknishani yobuchwephesha bolwazi
xh.summary: Kufunwa Iteknishani yobuchwephesha bolwazi ngaphandle kwiSebe le Abantu abangesondo bobunye, abasha naba nokhubazekayo ePretoria ukunika inkxaso yokudibanisa inethiwekhi, kufuneka idiploma yezizwe kulo ntsimbi yobuchwephesha bolwazi kunye nobugcisa bokusebenza obungaphezulu kweminyaka emibini.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi sesidanga sematrik nediDiploma yeNqanaba leNQF6 kwibuchwephesha bolwazi okanye isiqinisekiso esifanayo seNqF6. Isatifikethi seITIL Foundations, iITIL evunyiweyo, iMCSE, iA+, iN+ kuya kuba lusizo. Kufuneka kubekho ilayisenisi yomqhubi evumelekileyo; nangona kunjalo, le mfuno ayisebenzeli kwabantu abanokukhubazeka. Ugcinelo lolwazi olungaphantsi kweminyaka eli-2 kwindawo yobuchwephesha bolwazi. Ulwazi: Ulwazi olusebenzayo lomthetho kunye nendawo yolawulo lobuchwephesha bolwazi nolokhuselo; izixhobo ezingezantsi ezinjengeAndroid kunye ne-iPad; inkxaso ye-LAN/WAN; Ulwazi oluzinzileyo ekunikezeni inkxaso yehardwea nesoftwea kwiWindows. Amandla: Amandla obudlelwane obuntu; Amandla aluncedo lokunxibelelana; Amandla okuxazulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya; Ugcinelo oluphezulu lwekhompyutha; Amandla obuchwephesha ekunikezeni inkxabo ye-IT. Iimpawu zobuntu: Ukuziphatha ngokuzithoba; Uqeqesho nokuzinikela; Ukuqonda kakhulu nokuba proaktif; Amandla okusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo; Amandla okusebenza kodwa; Amandla okugcina imfihlo yolwazi.
xh.duties: Xelela indibaniselwano yokuvakalisa kubo bonke abasebenzisi bekhompyutha: Qinisekisa ukufikeleleka kweemisebenzi ezixhomekeke kwi-WAN; Qinisekisa ukufikeleleka kweemisebenzi ezixhomekeke kwi-LAN; Xela ngokusebenza kwe-WAN, iinguquko zokudibanisa nokoqoqosho lokusebenza; Xela ngokusebenza kwe-LAN, iinguquko zokudibanisa nokoqoqosho lokusebenza. Phatha iNfrastrakhya yegumbi leSeva: Xela iimpazamo zegumbi leseva kwiyure elinye kumlawuli; Qinisekisa ukcoceka kwegumbi leseva; Lawula ukufikelela kwiigumbi zeseva; Hlaziya ugcine irekhodi yokufikelela kwigumbi leseva. Zihlengahlengise igcina ukhuseleko nobumfihlo bentimba nekhompyutha: Fakela ukuze unqandwayindlela entsha ukuze uqinisekise ukhuselelo kwinqanaba lomsebenzisi; Qinisekisa ukufakelwa kolwandiso lwe-Ore Operating Systems amagqabhuku adidiyiyoyo; Qwalasela unqandwayindlela ukhuseleko yonqongo lwe-ntshukumo ezilandelayo zesixhobo esizodwa kuphela; Qwalasela qinisekisa ukudibanisa kwiseva ye-GUP yonke iindlela ezingekho kwindalo yokwaziswa. Fakela, lungisa, xazulula iingxaki zekhompyutha: Zenza iziphumo sokubeka iingcali zekhompyutha ezikwisimo sokuxazulula iingxaki; Lungisa okanye tshintsha izixhobo ezonakalisiweyo; Fakela ulungiselela izixhobo zekhompyutha nesoftware aze ajikeleze abantu bonke; Hlaziya yonke inkqubo ukuze kuvumelekane isoftware yazo zonke iikhompyutha; Qhuba ukuqinisekisa ukuqaliswa kweenkqubo ezitsha zesoftware nezixhobo. Zeza inkxaso yencedo yeseva ye-IT kuluntu: Phendula iingxoxo ezingenayo, i-imeyile nabafike baya kwindlu; Tsala iingxoxo zemibuzo efunwa nasezantwini ezifunyenweyo; Nike abathengwe ngenani elichanekileyo leKhadi le-IT ukukhangela iingxaki; Nike inkxaso kubasebenzisi uze ube ngundwendwe wokuqala wokuxela iimpazamo; Qhuba okanye hlengahlengise iingxaki ezingaxazululwa kwindawo ezifanelekileyo kumncedisi we-IT; Qinisekisa ukuba imibuzo yonke iphendulwa ngexesha elifanelekileyo ukunika inkxaso ngesithuthi esikhawulezileyo sokwenzakalisa imiceli; Qwalasela inkqubo yokugcina amarekhodi; ugcine abasebenzisi bakuxelelwa ngokuphela kwemibuzo yabo. Lawula yenze ugcine iinkqubo zokhuseleko zokuqinisekisa ulwazi ngalwazi lwesebe ukuze uvikele ukuzinza kweenkqubo ezahlukeneyo ngokusemthethweni: Qwalasela emini ngemini nasekuhambeni kwesonto, ngenyanga ungeniso lweminikelo yorhoqo, iinkonzo ze-365 evela kwindalo ekhoyo, ukulinganisa amagama olwazi abalulekileyo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukugcina ulwazi kwindalo iinkonzo; Qinisekisa ukuba gqitha kuqinisekiso lokupela nokuphumeza konke ukungapheli komsebenzi weNkonzo; Qhuba iqondo elinye ngenyanga ukuze kuvakaliswe ukuba ulwazi obuyileyo kwaye abe nepeshoni efuneka kwindalo yamaphakathi azenza iinkonzo ngokukhawulezileyo ezahlukene; Qhuba iqondo elinye ngomnye wamaxesha iDisaster Recovery (DR) imihla kwakhona ulwazi ukuze kugcinwe iziphelo; Gcina ngapandle kwelakho nasekunxwameni zonke iindawo zokulondolozo ukugcina isimo esingekho phantsi komthetho wocingo lwamagama e-IT; Qwalasela iVeeam Backup nokuqwalasela konke okusenzekayo ukugcina ukwenziwa kolwazi oluqinisekileyo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Protocol and Ceremonial Services
jobs.closing_date_text: 06 November 2026 (16:30 walk ins and 00:00 on email)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Protocol and Ceremonial Services at The Presidency in Pretoria, requiring middle management experience in protocol and a National Diploma.
jobs.requirements: A Senior Certificate plus an appropriate National Diploma/Advanced Certificate or equivalent on NQF level 6. A minimum of 3-4 years’ middle management experience in Protocol and Ceremonial Services. Must possess a valid driver’s licence. Candidate must have the following competencies: Be professional, highly motivated, initiative and critical thinker who will be able to gather and analyse information skillfully. Have excellent interpersonal skills. Have excellent organizational and planning skills and ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously. Have sense of urgency and ability to identify, analyse and resolve problems in a timely manner. Be able to work independently and as part of a team and also work well under pressure. Excellent telephone etiquette. Have projects management skills. Have good report writing skills. Have effective oral and written communication skills. Good office management skills. Be able to handle confidential matters, have integrity and be trustworthy. Knowledge: Good understanding of protocol and security measures. Good computer knowledge. Good knowledge of travel and subsistence procedures. Willingness to travel local and internal. Good understanding of Public Service Regulation Framework.
jobs.duties: Providing hands-on logistical experience in offering Protocol and Ceremonial services to the President and the Deputy President. Providing of protocol and ceremonial support in accordance with national and international policies and procedures. The implementation of and adherence to protocol policies and procedures. Conducting of research on protocol in respect of other countries as requested/required. Advising and support of ‘clients”. Ensure compliance, maintenance and management of protocol on all events. Consult with stakeholders. Oversee overall logistical arrangements for all events attended by the President or Deputy President. Establish and ensure that sitting arrangements is in hierarchical order. Assist with development of programmes and develop order of proceedings. Liaise with the Presidential Protection Service Planning unit in coordination of events. Coordinate, review and consolidate directorate’s inputs for the medium term expenditure framework (MTEF) and estimates of national expenditure (ENE).
jobs.enquiries: Mr. P Seopa Tel No: (012) 308 1779
jobs.applications: The Presidency, Private Bag X1000, Pretoria, 0001 or Hand deliver at Government Avenue, Union Buildings, Pretoria or by email: applications@presidency.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : Ms L Mphahlele
jobs.notes: Email applications must on the subject line state ONLY the Reference number: PROT/PRES/2026 (with no spaces). Applications must include only TWO (2) documents (a fully completed and signed new Z83 Form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the Department of Public Service and Administration (DPSA) website link: https://www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/ and a detailed Curriculum Vitae). af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Protokol en Seremoniële Dienste
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir Protokol en Seremoniële Dienste by The Presidency in Pretoria, wat bestuurservaring op middelvlak in protokol en 'n Nasionale Diploma vereis.
af.requirements: A Senior Certificate plus 'n toepaslike National Diploma/Advanced Certificate of ekwivalent op NQF level 6. 'n Minimum van 3-4 jaar se bestuurservaring op middelvlak in Protokol en Seremoniële Dienste. Moet 'n geldige bestuurslisensie hê. Kandidaat moet oor die volgende bevoegdhede beskik: Wees professioneel, hoogs gemotiveerd, 'n inisiatief- en kritiese denker wat inligting vaardig kan versamel en ontleed. Oor uitstekende interpersoonlike vaardighede beskik. Oor uitstekende organisatoriese en beplanningsvaardighede beskik en die vermoë hê om gelyktydig aan verskeie projekte te werk. 'n Sin van dringendheid hê en die vermoë om probleme tydig te identifiseer, te ontleed en op te los. In staat wees om onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span te werk en ook goed onder druk te kan werk. Uitstekende telefoonetiket hê. Oor projektebestuursvaardighede beskik. Oor goeie verslagskryfvaardighede beskik. Oor effektiewe mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede beskik. Oor goeie kantoorbestuursvaardighede beskik. In staat wees om vertroulike aangeleenthede te hanteer, integriteit te hê en betroubaar te wees. Kennis: Goeie begrip van protokol en sekuriteitsmaatreëls. Goeie rekenaarkennis. Goeie kennis van reis- en leefkosteprosedures. Bereidwilligheid om plaaslik en internasionaal te reis. Goeie begrip van die Public Service Regulation Framework.
af.duties: Verskaf praktiese logistieke ervaring in die aanbied van Protokol- en Seremoniële dienste aan die President en die Adjunkpresident. Verskaf protokol- en seremoniële ondersteuning ooreenkomstig nasionale en internasionale beleide en prosedures. Die implementering van en nakoming van protokolbeleide en -prosedures. Voer navorsing oor protokol met betrekking tot ander lande uit soos versoek/vereis. Adviseer en ondersteun van 'kliente'. Verseker nakoming, instandhouding en bestuur van protokol by alle geleenthede. Raadpleeg belanghebbendes. Hou toezig oor algehele logistieke reëlings vir alle geleenthede wat bygewoon word deur die President of Adjunkpresident. Vestig en verseker dat sitplekreëlings in hiërargiese volgorde is. Bystand verleen met die ontwikkeling van programme en ontwikkel orde van verrigtinge. Skakel met die Presidential Protection Service Planning-eenheid in die koördinering van geleenthede. Koördineer, hersien en konsolideer die direktoraat se bydraes vir die medium term expenditure framework (MTEF) en estimates of national expenditure (ENE).

zu.title: Isikhundla Sikasobalulesi: Amasevisi Esiphakamiso Nesomiso
zu.summary: Isikhundla Sikasobalulesi Samasevisi Esiphakamiso Nesomiso eThe Presidency ePretoria, sidinga isipiliyoni sokuphatha esingowezinga eliphakathi kwi-Protocol kanye ne-National Diploma.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate kanye ne-National Diploma/Advanced Certificate efanelekile noma okulingana nayo kulelinga le-NQF 6. Okungenani eminyaka engu-3-4 yesipiliyoni sokuphatha kwelinga eliphakathi kwi-Protocol and Ceremonial Services. Kufanele abe nephazili yokuqasha esemthethweni. Umfunwa kufanele abe nokuzelelana okulandelayo: Abe ngumuntu ochwepheshile, onesithakazelo esikhulu, onesandla esihle, ongumdaki wokuqonda othole amandla okuthola futhi ahlaziye ulwazi ngobuchwepheshe. Abe namakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu. Abe namakhono amahle ohlelo nokuhlela kanye nethonya lokusebenza emapuloyekthi amaningi ngesikhathi esisodwa. Abe nokuqonda ukubaluleka kokushesha kanye nethonya lokubona, ukuhlaziya nokuxazula izinkinga ngokushesha. Akwazi ukusebenza eyedwa nangokuhlanganiswa kwabanye kanti futhi akwazi ukusebenza kahle ngaphansi kwezinga eliphezulu lokucindezela. Abe nokuhlonipha okuhle ekusebenziseni ifoni. Abe namakhono okuphatha amapuloyekthi. Abe namakhono amahle okubhala umbiko. Abe namakhono amahle okukhuluma kanye nokubhala. Abe namakhono amahle okuphatha ihhovisi. Akwazi ukuphatha izindaba ezimfihlo, abe nobuqotho futhi athembekile. Ulwazi: Aqonde kahle umthetho wesiphakamiso kanye nezinyawo zokuvikela. Abe nolwazi oluhle ngokusebenzisa ikhomphyutha. Abe nolwazi oluhle ngokuhamba kwezinsizakusebenza nendlela yokuzinikela. Azimisele ukuhamba kulelokhel nabangaphakathi. Aqonde kahle umthetho wePublic Service Regulation Framework.
zu.duties: Nikela isipiliyoni esibambe iqhaza ekuhleleni imisebenzi yokunika amasevisi Esiphakamiso Nesomiso kuMongameli nakusobalulesi uMongameli. Nikela inkhasela yesiphakamiso nesomiso ngokuhambisana namapholisi namaphrosedha kazwelonke nawamaphakathi nawomhlaba. Ukuqeqeshwa nokulandelwa kwamapholisi namaphrosedha yesiphakamiso. Ukwenza uphenyo ngokuPhakamisa mayelana namanye amazwe njengoba kuceliwe/kudingwa. Nikelaiseluleko kanye ngenkhasela kumathenga”. Qinisekisa ukuthobeka, ukugcinwa nokuphathwa kwesiphakamiso kuzo zonke izinkathi. Xoxa nabalingani. Bukela phezu kwakho konke okuhlelwa kwezinsiza kuzo zonke izinkathi ezihlotshaniswe uMongameli noma usobalulesi uMongameli. Misela futhi qinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokuhlala zilandelana ngokuhleleka. Siza ekwakheni amaphulogoimbu kanye nakwakhiwa kwendlela yokuqhuba. Xhumana nenyunyana yokuhlela iphulogo yoMongameli kwikhothe yezinsiza kumayelana nezinkathi. Hlelanisa, buyekeza futhi uhlanganise izinkinganiso zephuleli kwesikhashana uma hamba imali (MTEF) nakulinganiselweni kwemali yesizwe (ENE).

xh.title: Isekunjulwana: Iinkonzo zeSikhundla nokuQhutywa kweMikhosyo
xh.summary: Isekunjulwana lezeNkonzo zeSikhundla nokuQhutywa kweMikhosyo eThe Presidency ePretoria, elifuna nqamlezelo yolawulo oluphakathi kwesikhundla nokuqhelaniswa kwabantu nokuba neNational Diploma.
xh.requirements: ISatifikethi esiPhezulu sakuQala kwakunye neNational Diploma/Advanced Certificate efanelekileyo okanye okulingana nayo kwiNQF level 6. Okungenani 3-4 iminyaka yamava olawulo oluphakathi kwiiNkonzo zeSikhundla nokuQhutywa kweMikhosyo. Kufuneka abe nelayisensi yokushaya ithatheli eseyisiwayo. Umama kufuneka abe namakhono alandelayo: Abe ngumntu ongcali, enomdla ongokoqobo, ongazali kunye nokuqamba ngokunzulu ozakuba nakho ukuqokelela nokuhlola ulwazi ngabuchule. Abe namakhono amakhulu okuhamba nabantu. Abe namakhono amakhulu olulawulo nokucwangcisa nokuba nakho ukusebenza kwimibhadala emininzi ngexesha elinye. Abe nencam yokuqhuba ngokukhawuleza nakho ukubaqaphela, ukuhlola nokusombulula iingxaki ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Abe nakho ukusebenza yedwa nakube ingenxenyenye yeqela nokusebenza kakuhle ngaphantsi kwengcinezelo. Abe namakhono amakhulu okuthetha kumntu nthotho kumncedisi. Abe namakhono olawulo lweemba. Abe namakhono amakhulu okubhala iingxelo. Abe namakhono asemgunyeni okuthetha nokubhala. Abe namakhono amakhulu olawulo lekamva. Abe nakho ukuphatha iindaba ezimfihlakeleyo, abe nokuzinza nokuba yimntu ethembekileyo. Ulwazi: Kuqondwe kakuhle iinkonzo zesikhundla nendlela zokhuseleko. Ulwazi oluhle lwesixhobo sekhompyutha. Ulwazi oluhle ngeendlela zokuhamba nokuhlawulela. Ukuvuma ukuhamba ngaphakathi nakunye phandle. Kuqondwe kakuhle iSizulu sazoLilumba zoLuntu.
xh.duties: Ukunika amava olawulo lweekhomishini ekunikezeni iinkonzo zeSikhundla nokuQhutywa kweMikhosyo kuMongameli nakusiSekela Mongameli. Ukuhlinzela ngenkxaso yesikhundla nokuqhutywa kwemikhosyo ngokwezinqanaba zelizwe nakwelizwe lonke iindaba nokuqhutywa. Ukuqhutywa kwezinqanaba zesikhundla nokuqhutywa kwayo. Ukuqhuba uphando ngomgaqo-sikhundla ngokwamanye amazwe njengoko kuceliwe/kufuneka. Ukucebisa nokuinkxaselela abathengi'. Qinisekisa, ukugcina nokulawula umgaqo-sikhundla kuzo zonke iimikhosi. Uncedisana nabathengi. Ulawula zonke izicwangciso zokuhamba kuzo zonke iimikhosi ethundwe nguMongameli okanye uSekela Mongameli. Misela ukuqinisekisa ukuba izicwangciso zokuhlala zikulandelelaniso ngezigaba. Unceda ekwakheni iinkqubo waze wakha ulandelelwano lweenkqubo. Thethathathela ngeqela le Presidential Protection Service Planning kwilungiselelo leemikhosi. Lawula, hlola uze udibanise izimvo zesikhululi kwinkingada yexabiso lemiphakathi emidille (MTEF) nakwiZigqibo zexabiso leziko leluntu (ENE).

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Budget Management
jobs.closing_date_text: 06 November 2026 (16:30 walk ins and 00:00 on email)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Budget Management position at The Presidency in Pretoria, requiring a financial qualification and 3-5 years' finance experience for MTEF and budget compilation duties.
jobs.requirements: A Senior Certificate plus an appropriate Bachelor’s degree/ or National Diploma in Financial Management/Accounting OR an equivalent qualification on NQF level 6. A minimum of 3-5 years' experience in a Finance environment. Knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Advanced Excel, graphs, and Pivot Tables Interpretation. Knowledge of Budgeting preparation and analysis. Knowledge of BAS, PERSAL. Candidate must have the following competencies: Communication, both oral and written. Client orientation and customer focus. Honesty and integrity. Service delivery innovation. Knowledge Management: Financial management. Problem solving and analysis. Strategic capability leadership. Program and project management. People management and empowerment. Change Management. Public Service Regulatory Framework. Policy formulation process within Government. Business and management principles involved in strategic planning, resource allocation, human resource modelling, and leadership techniques. Monitoring and evaluation methods, tools and techniques. Statistical and data analysis. Policy analysis and research. Analytical thinking, Report writing, and Presentation. An understanding of Financial Statements will be an advantage
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for the following duties: Co- ordinate and consolidate inputs for compilation of Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF). Co-ordinate and consolidate inputs for compilation of Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE). Compile adjustment Estimates of National Expenditure (AENE) (reprioritisation, additional funds requests, movement of funds) for the branches. zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba nguIsikhulu Esikhundleni: Ukuphathwa Kwebhajethi eThe Presidency ePretoria, esidinga izifundo zezimali kanye namava eminyaka eyi-3-5 kwezimali ohlelweni lwe-MTEF nasekweni ibhajethi.

Ulwazi lokuqasha ibhajethi nokuhlaziya. Ulwazi lwe-BAS, PERSAL. Umuntu oqashiwe kumelwe abe namanhlamvu alandelayo: Ukuxhumana, kokukhulunywa nokubhalwa. Ukuqondisisa ngomthengi nokuqonda kumthengi. Ukwethembeka nobungcweti. Inqubomgomo yokuletha izinsizakalo. Ukuphathwa kolwazi: Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukukhokhela amandla ohlelo. Ukuphathwa kohlelo nemihlohlo. Ukuphathwa kwabantu nokubakhulisa. Ukuphathwa okushintshayo. Ohlelo lohlelo lwe-Public Service. Inqubo yokubeka inqubomgomo kahulumeni. Izimiso zebhizinisi nokuphathwa ezibandakanya ukuhlela ukubuka kwesikhathi eside, ukwaba imithombo, ukumodela imithombo yabantu, nobuchule bokukhokhela. zu.duties: Umuntu oqashiwe uzobe nesibopho sokwenza imisebenzi elandelayo: Ukuhlanganisa futhi uhlanganise okungenayo ekubhaleni i-Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF). Ukuqamba i-adjustment Estimates of National Expenditure (AENE) (ukubuyela emuva, ukucela imali engeziwe, ukunyakaziswa kwemali) kumabhuloho. Ukuba imali kwemithwalo yezinsizakazo ehlukene emabhulohweni. Ukuhlanganisa okungenayo kokubika nokuqapha ngokwamabhuloho ukubika ngaphakathi kwesikhathi. Ukubikezela ukukhishwa kwemali emabhulohweni. Ukuqamba imibiko yokuphatha nyanga zonke. Ukunika izeluleko abaphathi bebhajethi ngokuthile okuphathelene nebhalisi. Ukulinganisela izindleko zokumiswa. Ukusiza ekulungiseni nokuqaphen izinkulumo-mali zezimali.

Ulawulo lenkqubo neprojekthi. Ulawulo labantu kunye namandla okuzikhulisa. Ulawulo lootshintsho. IPublic Service Regulatory Framework. Inkqubo yokwenza iinkqubo ngaphakathi koRhulumente. Ezenza okulinganiselwe ngokutsho ukuba kukho imiba ekhoyo ebekiweyo ebume ngokutshintshwa bengxaki ekhoyo, ukubhala kwemibiko yoxinzelelo, emva kokuba ibikhona emva kokugqiba ukuba kukho iMTEF. Ulwazi ngokubakho kokuhamba kwexabiso, iindaba ngexabiso eliphandwayo lihlola amapoliisi esixeko ekhoyo ebuthathaka kunqanaba elingacwangciswanga ngokumelene nentlutha ezingaphaya kweminyaka engama-3. Ukuba nomsebenzi ngokwexabiso leenhlobo ezahlukeneyo zeengxaki ekhoyo ezingatshintsha imali esetyenziswa kwimigibe yendlela ebekwe ngokuhamba kwexesha. Ulwazi lwexabiso eliphakamileyo lobomi bezeimali elixabiso lokwenza isigqibo sokugcina iimali ezahlukeneyo ngokwemali evela kumazwe angaphandle. Ulwazi ngoluqoqosho lolwazi ngoMicrosoft Office, ngokukodwa iExcel, iigrap, kwaye iPivot Tables Interpretation.
xh.duties: Omgunyathiswa opumeleleyo uya kuba nogxenya lokwenza imisebenzi elandelayo: Ukuqamba kunye nokudibanisa izimvo zolwakhiwo lweMedium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF). Ukunikela ingcebiso kubaluli bomthetho wemali ngeemiba ezahlukeneyo ezithintela umthetho wemali. Ukubala ixabiso lesimo esisoloko sikhona. Ukuncedisa loluqokelelo kunye nokuphonononga lwezitatimende zezeimali.

af.title: Inligtings- en Kommunikasietegnologie-ontwikkelaar
af.summary: Die Presidentskap soek 'n IK-ontwikkelaar om besigheidstoepassings en BI-dashborde te ontleed, te ontwerp en te ontwikkel, met die vereiste van 'n diploma of graad in IT en drie tot vyf jaar se ervaring in stelselontwikkeling.
af.requirements: A Senior Certificate plus an appropriate Bachelor's degree/ or National Diploma in Information Technology OR an equivalent qualification on NQF level 6. A minimum of 3 to 5 years' relevant experience in systems development according to the Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Die kandidaat moet oor die volgende bevoegdhede beskik: Kommunikasie, beide mondelings en skriftelik. Kliëntoriëntasie en klintefokus. Eerlikheid en integriteit. Dienslewering, kreatiwiteit en innovering. In staat om nuwe tegnologieë vinnig aan te leer. Aandag aan besonderhede, akkuraatheid, analitiese vaardighede, kritiese denke en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Vermoë om onafhanklik, onder druk en in 'n span te werk. Goie tydbestuurvaardighede, Stelselontleding en dokumentasie. In staat om moeilike prosedures aan gebruikers te kommunikeer. Kennisbestuur en finansiële bestuur. Relasionele databasiskonsepte en ervaring in SQL Server vir databasisontwerp en SQL-navraagontwerp. SharePoint-ontwikkeling en administrasievaardighede. Programmeertaalvaardighede: .NET Framework, C#. Projekbestuur. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging; veranderingbestuur. Openbare Diens Regulerende Raamwerk. Beleidsformuleringsproses binne Regering. Besigheids- en bestuursbeginsels betrokke by strategiese beplanning, hulpbrontoewysing, menslike hulpbronmodellering en leierskaptegnieke. Monitering en evalueringsmetodes, -instrumente en -tegnieke. Kennis en belangstelling in rekenaarstelsels en die nuutste tegnologieë.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal vir die volgende pligte verantwoordelik wees: Ontleding, ontwerp en ontwikkeling van besigheidstoepassings gebaseer op gebruikersvereistes. Ontwikkel Besigheidsintelligensie-dashborde en verslae vir verskeie stelsels. Versnel IK-moderniseringsprojekte, veral outomatisering en digitalisering van die besigheidsproses. Ontwikkel interne toepassings deur inligting en korrespondensie deur gebruikergedefinieerde reëls en aksies te roeteer. Evalueer, ondersoek en pas nuwe tegnologieë toe om toepassings en stelsels binne Die Presidentskap te verbeter en doen aanbevelings aan bestuur. Die ontwikkeling en instandhouding van IT-stelsels ter ondersteuning van strategiese, operasionele en dienslewering-doelwitte. Ondersteuning en instandhouding van Inligtings- en Kommunikasietegnologie (IK) infrastruktuur. Implementeer, monitor en gradeer multi-platform Inligtingstegnologie-sagtewarestelsels op. Projekbestuur en moniteringsdiens. Identifiseer areas vir wysiging in huidige stelsels of toepassings en ontwikkel en implementeer daardie wysigings. Opstel Standaardbedryfsprosedures (SOP) en dokumenteer alle werk vir toekomstige verwysing. Lei gebruikers op. Ontwikkel en toets toepassingsbronkode.
