Werk met ander IT-span om spesifikasies vir nuwe toepassings vas te stel. Monitor die kwaliteit en prestasie van toepassings deur toetsing en instandhouding. Bied hulp met sagteware- of toepassingsondersteuning en probleemoplossing deur interaksie met die gebruikers.

zu.title: Umntuthisi Wobuchwepheshe Bolwazi Nokuxhumana
zu.summary: IGunya lomongameli lifuna umntuthisi we-ICT ukuze ahlole, akhe futhi athuthukise izinhlelo zebhizinisi kanye namadashibhodi e-BI, okudinga idiploma noma idigri kwi-IT kanye neminyaka emithathu kuya kwayisihlanu yemfundo yezinhlelo.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samabanga aphansi kanye nesiqu sezinga lesi-4 / noma iDiploma Yezwe kubuchwepheshe bolwazi noma iziqu ezingabalinganayo ezingeni le-NQF level 6. Okungenani ungamu weminyaka engu-3 kuya ku-5 ohambisanayo kokuthuthukiswa kwezinhlela ngokusho kweSistimu Yokuthuthukiswa KweCycle Yobomi (SDLC). Umphakethi kufanele abene khono okulandelayo: Ukuxhumana, kokukhulunwayo nakokubhaliwayo. Ukugxila kumthengi nokubhekisele kubathengi. Ukwethembeka nobuqotho. Ukulethwa kwenkonzo, ukudala okusha, nokuthumba. Ukukwazi ukufunda nobuchwepheshe obusha ngokushesha. Ukuqaphela iminikelo, ukungalunywa, amakhono ahlukanisayo, ukucabanga okubucayi, kanye namakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Ukukwazi ukusebenza kodwa, ngaphansi kokucindezelwa, kanye nakuqembu. Amakhono amahle okuphatha isikhathi, ukuhlaziywa kwezinhlelo, kanye nokubhala. Ukukwazi ukuchaza izinqubo ezinzima kubasebenzisi. Ukuphatha ulwazi kanye nezimali. Amagama okwakha idayithabhesi yokuxhumana kanye nolwazi kwi-SQL Server ukwakheka kwedayithabhesi kanye nokwakheka kwe-SQL query. Amakhono okuthuthukisa nokuphatha i-SharePoint. Amakhono olimi lokuhlela: i-NET Framework, C#. Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi. Ukuphatha abantu kanye nemandla; ukuphatha inguquko. Isakhiwo Esibhekezayo kumNyango Wonkonzo Kazwelonke. Inqubo yokumisa inqubomgomo ngaphakathi kukaHulumeni. Izinto zebhizinisi kanye nemithetho yokuphatha kuleyo ekubhekelela ukuhlela ngokobuchwepheshe, ukuhlinzeka ngamathuluzi, ukumakhula abasebenzi kanye nobuchwepheshe bokukhokha. Izindlela, amathuluzi, kanye nobuchwepheshe bokuhlola nokubuyekeza. Ulwazi kanye nokukhanga izinhlelo zekhompyutha nobuchwepheshe bakamuva.
zu.duties: Umphakethi ophumelelayo uzobe negunya lokusebenzela imisebenzi elandelayo: Ukuhlola, ukwakha, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zebhizinisi ngokusekelwe kwezidingo zabasebenzisi. Ukuthuthukisa amadashibhodi e-Business Intelligence nemibiko yezinhlelo ezahlukene. Ukusheshisa amaphrojekthi okuzuzisa i-ICT, ikakhulukazi ukuzenzakalela kanye nokwenza ngamakhompyutha inqubo yebhizinisi. Ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zangaphakathi ngokuqhutsha ulwazi kanye nokuxhumana ngemithetho yabasebenzisi kanye nezenzo. Ukuhlola, ucwaningwe, futhi usebenzise nobuchwepheshe obusha ukukhulisa izinhlelo namasistimu ngaphakathi kukaHulumeni kanye nokwenza izincomo eziphathelene nokuphatha. Ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokugcinwa kwezinhlelo ze-IT ukuze zisekele izinhloso ezihamba phambili, ezisebenzayo, nakulezo zokuletha inkonzo. Ukusekela kanye nokugcina uhlaka Lwobuchwepheshe Bolwazi Nokuxhumana (ICT). Ukufaka, ukuqaphela, kanye nokwenza ngcono izinhlelo zekhompyutha ezenza ngamaphulatifomu amaningi. Ukuphatha Amaphrojekthi kanye Nokuqaphela Inkonzo. Ukuthola izindawo okufanele zishintshwe ezinhlelweni noma kuzinhlelo zangaphesheya kwaye uzithuthukise futhi uzifake lezo zinguquko. Ukubhala Izinqubo Eziyisisekelo Zokusebenza (SOP) futhi ubhale yonke imisebenzi ngezesikhathi ezayo. Ukuqeqesha abasebenzisi. Ukuthuthukisa kanye nokuhlola ikhodi yemvelo yohlelo. Ukuxoxa ngezidingo zabasebenzisi kwaye unikeze izixazululo. Ukuhlanganisa izinhlelo noma amabhukuhabhukhuwozemu kwezinhlelo zabaqashi besibili. Ukwenza izivivinyo zokuqondanisa izinhlelo kwamanye amasistimu kwezinhlelo. Ukusebenza nabanye iqembu le-IT ukumisa izindingo zezinhlelo ezisha. Ukuhlola ikhwalithi kanye nokusebenza kwezinhlelo ngokusetha futhi zigcinwe. Ukusiza ngokusekela noma ukuxazulula izinkinga zohlelo ngokuxhumana nabasebenzisi.

Client orientation and customer focus. Honesty and integrity. Service delivery innovation. Knowledge Management. Financial Management. Problem solving and analysis. Strategic capability leadership. Accounting – Provide financial administration and accounting services and inputs for the compilation of the Interim and Annual Financial Statements. af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Finansiële Rekenaarhouding
af.summary: Die Presidentskap soek 'n Adjunkdirekteur vir Finansiële Rekenaarhouding in Pretoria, wat 'n graad of diploma en drie jaar se toesigervaring vereis.
af.requirements: A Senior Certificate plus an appropriate Bachelor's degree/ or National Diploma OR an equivalent qualification on NQF level 6. 'n Minimum van drie (3) jaar se relevante ervaring in Finansiële Rekenaarhouding op 'n toesigtelike/ bestuursvlak. Goeie begrip van Belastingadministrasie en Skuldenaarbestuur. Kennis van Microsoft Office, veral Gevorderde Excel. Kennis van BAS en PERSAL. Kandidaat moet oor die volgende bevoegdhede beskik: Kommunikasie, beide mondelings en skriftelik. Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus. Eerlikheid en integriteit. Dienslewering-innovasie. Kennisbestuur. Finansiële bestuur. Probleemoplossing en analise. Strategiese kapasiteitleierskap. Program- en projekbestuur. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Veranderingsbestuur. Regulerende raamwerk van die Openbare Diens. Beleidsformuleringsproses binne Regering. Besigheids- en bestuursbeginsels betrokke by strategiese beplanning, hulpbrontoekenning, menslike hulpbronmodellering, en leierskaptegnieke. Analitiese denke, verslagskrywing, en aanbieding. 'n Begrip van Finansiële State sal 'n voordeel wees. PLIGTE: Bestuur die Subsistensie en Reis, Belastingadministrasie, en Skuldenaarbestuur subdirektoraat. Ontwikkel en handhaaf beleide en prosesse. Monitor die beleids- en wetgewingsraamwerk om te verseker dat kennis geneem word van nuwe ontwikkelings. Monitor inkomste ingesamel en uitgawes aangegaan en dien verslae en planne in soos vereis. Skuldenaarbestuur – Verrig sekretariële pligte van die Verliesbeheerkomitee en verseker nakoming van Skuldenaarbestuur regulasies en verslagdoeningsvereistes. Handhaaf dissipline. Ontwikkel en bestuur die operasionele plan van die Sub-direktoraat en rapporteer oor vordering soos vereis. Ontwikkel, implementeer en handhaaf prosesse om behoorlike beheer van werkvloei te verseker. Stel op en dien alle vereiste administratiewe verslae in. Dien op dwarslopende taakspanne soos vereis. Verkryging en batebestuur vir die Sub-direktoraat. Beplan en wys werk toe. Kwaliteitsbeheer van werk wat deur werknemers gelewer is.

Inligting versamel vir response op die ouditeure se versoeke. Finansiële inspeksies en assesserings van departementele finansiële beleide uitvoer om nakoming te verseker. Finansiële dokumentbeheer (ontvangs, invul, rekonsiliasie, en ook opvolg van uitstaande lotsies). Identifiseer, registreer en ondersoek onreëlmatige en vrugtelose en wyloze besteding. Verseker dat alle geïdentifiseerde nie-nakoming van 30-dag betalings aan National Treasury gerapporteer word. Toesig hou oor rekeningklerke, kontrakteurs en mentor/ of leer die intern. Bystand verleen met die monitering van die korrekte implementering van beleide, strategieë en beleidsraamwerke. Bystand verleen met die ouditeitskoördinasieproses.

zu.title: Isiphathimandla Esiphezulu Sezwe Esibhekene Nezimali: Isilawuli Sakaphakathi
zu.summary: Isiphathimandla Esiphezulu Sezwe Esibhekene Nezimali ngokulawula okwangaphakathi e-The Presidency ePretoria, sidinga idigri noma idiploma kumikhakha ehlobene nezimali kanye neminyaka emibili kuya kwemithathu yeziphephelo ezihlobene.
zu.requirements: Isitifikadi samatrikulu esiphezulu kanye nedigri ye-Bachelor efanelekile noma i-National Diploma kwi-Financial Accounting noma i-Auditing noma i-Risk Management noma iziqu ezilinganayo ezingeni le-NQF level 6. Okungeziwe kumnyaka omibili (2) kuya kwemithathu (3) yamava afanelekile atholakale emhlabeni wezimali ngokugcizelela ekubikweni kwezimali, ekulawuleni ukuhambisana kwemithetho, ekulawulweni kwangaphakathi, nakuphathweni kobungozi. Ikhono: ukuxhumana, kokukhulunwayo nokubhalwayo. Ukugxila kumthengi nokuqala komthengi. Ukwethembeka nokuba nokwethembeka. Ukuthuthukiswa kokulethwa kwenkonzo. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukuphatha amaphrogrami namaphrojekthi. Ukuphatha abantu nokubakhuthaza. Ukuphatha inguquko. Umthethosisekelo wolawulo kumnyango kazwelonke. Inqubo yokubeka izinqulumo ezinguqulwini kahulumeni. Izindlela, izinsimbi namatekiniki zokubuka nokuhlola. Ukwazi ngomthetho we-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), nemithetho ye-Treasury.
zu.duties: Ubulebe ekusebenziseni izilawuli ezingena emarekhodini. Usiza ekuphathweni kolawulo lwezimali olungaphakathi ngokuqinisekisa ukusebenza okusebenzayo nokuphumelelayo kwemisebenzi yokuphathwa kwezimali nokuqashwa kwenhlangano yokuhlinzeka ngaphakathi kweyuniti ye-CFO. Ukuqinisekisa konke ukukhokha kwe-BAS/LOGIS, amajenali, iziphoqo, izinkambo ze-S & T, amafomu abonisa inani langempela, njll. Ukuhlola kabusha futhi kabusha uhlelo lwemithetho nokuqhuba mayelana nezimali. Ukuqaphela ukugcwaliswa kwemibhalo kumnyango ehlobene namadokhenda ezimali. Ukuxhumana nabahloli (abangaphakathi/abangaphandle) kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkomba zabo ziyasetshenziswa. Ukutholwa kolwazi ngeziphendulo kubahloli. Ukwenza ukubuyekezwa nokuhlola izimali mayelana nemithetho yezimali yomnyango ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana. Ukulawula amadokhenda wezimali (ukuthola, ukugcwalisa, ukubuyezelanisa, kanye nokulandela amaphakethe angakapeli. Ukubona, ukubhalisa, nokuphenya ukukhokha okungalungile nokungalulekile kanye nokuchitha okungalusebenzisi. Ukugqamisa ngokuthi sonke isingeniso esingahambisana nemithetho ngezikweletu zamalanga angu-30 kubikwe ku-National Treasury. Ukuqondisa abakhaladi bezimali, abathengisiwe kanye nokwelisa noma ukufundisa abantu abangaholelekile. Ukusiza ekulawuleni ukusetshenziswa okulungile kwemithetho, amasu namakhe wezombusazwe. Ukusiza ekwenzeni inhlangano yokuhlola.

xh.title: Owesemnyangweni weLwazi lukaRhulumente: Ulawulo langaphakathi
xh.summary: Owesemnyangweni weLwazi lukaRhulumente wokulawula ngaphakathi kwi-The Presidency ePretoria, efuna izidanga okanye izidanga eziphakamileyo kumabala ahlobene nemali kwaye nefundo yeminyaka emibini ukuya kwithathu yamava ahlobene nayo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikathi samabanga aphezulu kunye neNqanaba lesidanga leBachelors/ okanye iNazhonalidiploma kwiNzalo yeMali/ uKuhlolwa kwiSahluko/ uLawulo lweengozi OKANYE izidanga ezilinganayo kwiNqanaba le-6 le-NQF. Iminyaka emibini (2) ukuya kwithathu (3) yamava ahlobene nalo atholwe kwindawo yeNzalo ngokukodwa ngokubhekisele ekubika ngeemali, ukulandelela ukuthobela imigaqo, ulawulo langaphakathi, noku lawula iingozi. Ikhono elidingekayo: ukunxibelelana, ngokuthetha nangokubhala. Ukubaqwalasela abathengi nogqaliselo kubathengi. Inyaniso nokuzithembisa. Inzukombuso yokunikezela inkonzo. Ukuziqonda iingxaki noku chongelwa. Ulawulo lwezicwangciso neenjongo. Ulawulo labantu noku baqhwesa. Ulawulo lenguquko. Inkqubo yokulawula urhulumente. Inqubo yokwenza imigaqo ngaphakathi kurhulumente. Iindlela, izixhobo neendlela zokulandelela noku chongelwa. Ulwazi ngomthetho weNqengulwa yiMali yuruHulumente (PFMA), neMigaqo yeQhosha.
xh.duties: Uxanduva lokuncedisa ekusebenziseni ulawulo kwindlela yokungena kwamafayile. Uncede ekulawuleni ulawulo lweemali ngaphakathi ngokuqinisekisa ukusebenza ngempumelelo nangokusebenziseka kwezithuba zolawulo lweemali nolawulo lwezithuba ezihamba phambili kwinjongo yeCFO. Ukuqinisekisa onke amaxeshiso e-BAS/LOGIS, amajwenali, iingeno, iingcalaba ze-S & T, iifomu zexabiso elibonakalayo, njl. Ukuhlola noku hlaziya imigaqo nendlela zokwenza izinto ngeemali. Ukuqwalasela inkqubo yokugcina amaxwebhu esebe ehlobene namaxwebhu ezibalo. Unxibelelwano noBahlole (bangaphakathi/nangaphandle) nokuqinisekisa ukuba izindululo zabo ziyasebenziswa. Ukuqokelela inkcazelo ngamava yokuphendula koBahlole. Ukuqhutywa kwezihloko zokutya amava nokuqwalasela iMigaqo esebe yeMali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthobela imigaqo. Ulawulo lweemali ezingamaxesha (ukuyamkela, ukuzigcina, ukulinganisa, noku landelela iibhaji ezingazange zihlawulwe). Ukuqamba, ukuqwalasela, noku chongelwa ngemali engahambisana nemigaqo nenyani imali ehlatyiweyo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuzaliseka kwaye ngazo zonke iindawo ezingahambisana nemigaqo nemi galaqo yamaxesha angama-30 kwiNyango yeQhosha leZwelonke. Ukuqwalasela oBala bakaRhulumente ababala iimali, abantu abahlawulwe noku qeqesha/ okanye ukufundisa amafundi. Uncedo ekulandeleleni ulwazi lokuze kwenziwe imigaqo, izicwangciso neziseko zemigaqo. Uncedo ekulawuleni iinkqubo zokuhlolelwa ukuze kuqhutywe uxhaxha lwezihloko.

jobs.title: Clinical Manager
jobs.centre: Sarah Baartman District, Fort England Psychiatric Hospital
jobs.salary_text: R1 479 723 – R1 640 055 per annum, (OSD), (an all-inclusive package)- basic salary consists of 70% or 75% of total package, salary package will be structured according to Middle Management Service guidelines.
jobs.summary: Clinical Manager needed at Fort England Psychiatric Hospital in the Eastern Cape to manage clinical services in accordance with departmental standards.
jobs.requirements: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner. Registration with HPCSA as Medical Practitioner. A minimum of 3 years appropriate experience as a medical officer after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner. Knowledge of relevant legislation such as National Health Act, Mental Health Act, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA)), Public Service Act and related regulations and policies. Competencies: Strategic capability and leadership, Program and Project Management, Financial Management, Change Management, People Management and Empowerment, Service Delivery Innovation, Knowledge Management, Problem Solving and Analysis, Communication, Client Orientation and Customer focus. A valid driver’s licence.
jobs.duties: Management of clinical services in the entire hospital in accordance with the departmental standards, including after hours as delegated. Participate and accountable for assisting in leading and managing the hospital clinical services. Maintain accurate health records in accordance with legal ethical considerations. Train and guide staff and health associated professionals in morbidity and mortality reviews. Attend and participate in continuous medical education. Participate in quality improvement programs. Ensure that cost effective services delivery is maintained within the respective department. Attend to administrative matters as required. To plan, direct coordinate and manage the efficient and effective delivery of clinical and administration support services through working the key executive management team at the hospital within the legal regulatory framework. To present the Hospital Authoritatively at provincial and public forums. Determines system for intradepartmental functions in keeping with hospital policies and communicates it to staff. Training and development of staff in the relevant sections. Ensure compliance with National Core Standards requirements or any other regulatory and/or statutory requirement. Conduct regular clinical audits and develop, implement and monitor action plans. Develop, monitor and analyse budget and financial information and utilizes all resources in an effective and efficient manner. Practice effective problem identification and resolution skills as a method of sound decision making. Must be prepared to work under pressure and after hour duties as per commuted overtime policy. Compile medical reports and give evidence at trials, when required. Manage Performance and Development (PMDS) and perform quarterly reviews of subordinates. The incumbent must also be prepared to train, develop and supervise of undergraduate and post graduate junior doctors.
jobs.enquiries: Ms X Nazo Tel No: (046) 602 2463
jobs.applications: Alternatively, applications can be submitted electronically via email to: Xolelwa.Nazo@echealth.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly new Z83 Form (effective from 01 January 2021), a comprehensive CV, indicating three reference persons: Name and Contact Numbers, A relationship with reference. Applicants are only required to submit a Z83 form and a comprehensive CV. Therefore, only shortlisted candidates for a post will be required to submit certified documents (copies of Qualification(s) inclusive of Matric certificate, Identity document, Proof of registration, proof of citizenship if not RSA citizen) on or before the day of the interview following communication from HR. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants must note that further Personnel Suitability checks will be conducted on short-listed candidates and that their appointment is subject to the outcome of these checks which include security clearance, security vetting, qualification verification and criminal record checks. Reference checks will be done on nominated candidate(s). The department reserves the right to amend/ review/ withdraw the advertised posts if by so doing, the best interest of the department will be well served. (Females and People with Disabilities are also requested to apply and indicate such in their applications). Misrepresentation in the application documents will result in automatic disqualification and disciplinary action in the event the candidate has already been appointed. If you have not been contacted by the Department of Health within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. We thank all applicants for their interest. People with disabilities are encouraged to apply for these posts. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Kliniese Bestuurder
af.summary: Kliniese Bestuurder benodig by Fort England Psigiatriese Hospitaal in die Eastern Cape om kliniese dienste in ooreenstemming met departementele standaarde te bestuur.
af.requirements: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn. 'n Minimum van 3 jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n mediese beampte na registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn. Kennis van relevante wetgewing soos die Nasionale Gesondheidswet, Geestesgesondheidswet, Openbare Finansiesbestuurswet (PFMA)), Openbare Dienswet en verwante regulasies en beleide. Bevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, Program- en Projakbestuur, Finansiële Bestuur, Veranderingsbestuur, Personeelbestuur en Bemagtiging, Dienslewering Innovasie, Kennisbestuur, Probleemoplossing en Ontleding, Kommunikasie, Kliëntoriëntasie en Kliëntfokus. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Bestuur van kliniese dienste in die hele hospitaal in ooreenstemming met die departementele standaarde, insluitend na ure soos gedelegeer. Neem deel en is verantwoordelik daarvoor om te help met die leiding en bestuur van die hospitaal se kliniese dienste. Onderhou akkurate gesondheidsrekords in ooreenstemming met regtelike en etiese oorwegings. Oplei en begelei personeel en gesondheidsverwante professionele personeel in morbiditeit- en mortaliteitsbesprekings. Woon deurlopende mediese opleiding by en neem daaraan deel. Neem deel aan gehalteverbeteringsprogramme. Verseker dat koste-effektiewe dienslewering binne die onderskeie departement gehandhaaf word.skuif. Woon aan administratiewe aangeleenthede soos vereis. Om die doeltreffende en effektiewe lewering van kliniese en administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste te beplan, te rig, te koördineer en te bestuur deur met die sleutel-uitvoerende bestuurspan by die hospitaal binne die wetlike regulerende raamwerk te werk. Om die hospitaal gesaghebbend by provinsiale en openbare forums te verteenwoordig. Bepaal stelsel vir intradepartementele funksies in ooreenstemming met hospitaalbeleid en kommunikeer dit aan personeel. Opleiding en ontwikkeling van personeel in die betrokke afdelings. Verseker nakoming van Nasionale Kernstandaarde vereistes of enige ander regulatoriese en/of statutêre vereiste. Voer gereelde kliniese oudits uit en ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor aksieplanne. Ontwikkel, monitor en ontleed begroting en finansiële inligting en benut alle hulpbronne op 'n doeltreffende en effektiewe wyse. Pas effektiewe probleemidentifikasie- en oplossingsvaardighede toe as 'n metode van deurdagte besluitneming. Moet bereid wees om onder druk te werk en na ure dienste te verrig soos per kommuteer-oortydbeleid. Stel mediese verslae op en lewer getuienis by verhore, wanneer vereis. Bestuur Prestasie en Ontwikkeling (PMDS) en voer kwartaallikse hersienings van ondergeskiktes uit. Die ampsdraer moet ook bereid wees om voorgraadse en nagraadse junior dokters op te lei, te ontwikkel en te superviseer.

zu.title: Umphathi wezokwelapha
zu.summary: Kudingwa umphathi wezokwelapha e-Fort England Psychiatric Hospital eEastern Cape ukuze uphathe izinsizakalo zezokwelapha ngokuvumelana nemigidingo yomnyango.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifaneleko ezivumela ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengeDokotela wezeMpilo. Ukuqinisekiswa kwe-HPCSA njengeDokotela wezeMpilo. Ukuba ngeminyaka engu-3 nongakuhle njengesikhulumi sezedwala emva kokuqinisekiswa ku-HPCSA njengeDokotela wezeMpilo. Ulwazi ngemithetho ehlobene efana noMtsetfo wezeSempilo weSifundazwe, uMtsetfo wezeSempilo engqondweni, uMtsetfo wezeMphathe wezeMali (PFMA), uMtsetfo weZenze loMphakathi kanye nemithetho ehlukene nayo nayiphi iNqubo ezingeyiso. Izindlela: Ikhono lokuhola ngokuhlelekile, ukuphatha imihwambo kanye nomaqembu, ukuphatha izimali, ukuphatha izinguquko, ukuphatha abantu nokwethula abantu, ukwethula izinsizakulo ezintsha, ukuphatha ulwazi, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlalwa kwemininingwane, ukuxhumana, ukuqondiswa kubathintekayo kanye nokuqondiswa kwabakhiyose. Ileyisensi yomshayeli egunyaziwe.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa kwezinsizakalo zezokwelapha esibhedlela sonke ngokuvumelana nemigidingo yomnyango, kuhlanganise namahora emva kokushesha njengoba kumiwe. Ukuze athathe inxaxheba futhi abe nenzebe ekubhekene nokubeka uhlelo lokulawula nokuphatwa kwezinsizakalo zezokwelapha esibhedlela. Ukuze zigcinwe zibe ngemibhalo egqamile kwezempi lo yezempilo yantuthuko futhi ethobekile ngokusemthethweni. Ukuqeqesha futhi uhola abasebenzi kanye nabochwepheshe abahlobene nempi lo yezempilo emibhalweni yokuphatwa kwesifo nokufa. Ukuze aye futhi athathe inxaxheba ekukhuleni kwezemfundo ezeqhuba yezokwelapha. Ukuze athathe inxaxheba ohlelweni lokuthuthukiswa kwentuthuko ehle. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwezinsizakalo kwezimali okusiza kugcinwa emnyakeni ohlukile. Ukuba nokubhekene kwezindaba zentša njengoba kudingeka. Ukuhlela, ukuhola ukulawula nokuphatha ngokusebenza eqenjini elikhulu lemunyu wezokuphatha esibhedlela ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo esivumelene nemithetho. Ukumela iHospithala ngamandla emihlanganweni yesifunda kanye nabezintsha. Ukubamba uhlelo lwemisebenzi engaphakathi kumnyango ngokuvumelana namapholisi esibhedlela bese kuxoxwa nasebasebenzini. Ukuqeqeshwa nentuthuko yabasebenzi emigqeni ehlobene khona. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kuhambiswa nezinguquko zemigidingo yesikhashana noma noma yimuphi omunye umthetho. Ukwenza izivivinyo ezithile zezokwelapha futhi wakhe, uhlele futhi ulandele izinkomba ezintsha zokwenza umsebenzi. Wakhe, ulande futhi uhlule imali yokusebenza kanye nemininingwane yezemali, futhi usebenzise onke amathuba ngendlela ezebenza ngempumeleko nangokusebenza kahle. Ukuzimisela ekwenzeni okuthile ukuze kutholakale izixazululo ezithile eziba ngendlela yokucabanga okuhle. Kumele abe wethulwa kakhulu ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxhudula kwemisebenzi futhi emahora emva kokushesha ngokuvumelana nemithetho yokusebenza okwedlule isikhathi. Ukulungelelanisa imibiko yezokwelapha futhi unike ubufakazi ecaleni, lapho kudingeka khona. Ukuphatha ukuvela kokuthuthuka nokwethulwa (PMDS) kanye nokwenza izivivinyo ezinguqotho zezinyanga ezintsha zabasebenzi abangaphansi kwakho. Kumele futhi alungele ukuqeqesha, ukwethula futhi ahlole onkulu abafundi abangaphantsi kokuqeqesha kwezokwelapha kanye nalabo abangaphakathi kwesikhashana.

xh.title: Umphathi Wezemiba Zokwelapha
xh.summary: Kufunekwa Umphathi Wezemiba Zokwelapha e Fort England Psychiatric Hospital e Eastern Cape ukulawula iinkonzo zokwelapha ngokwemigaqo yesebe.
xh.requirements: Izatifikethi esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi HPCSA njengogqirha. Ukubhalisa kwi HPCSA njengogqirha. Uncedo lweenyanga eziziingama 3 zolwazi olufanelekileyo njengomkhosi wezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa kwi HPCSA njengogqirha. Ulwazi ngemigaqo ebangelweyo efana ne National Health Act, Mental Health Act, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA)), Public Service Act nemigaqo ezidityaniswe nayo neenkqubo zayo. Ikhono: Ikhono lestratetri nolawulo, ulawulo lweenkqubo neeprojekthi, ulawulo lwezemali, ulawulo lwenguqulo, ulawulo lwabantu namandla okuzakhela, intshukubviso ekunikezeni inkonzo, ulawulo lolwazi, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuhanjisisa, unxibelelwano, ukujolisa kumxhasi nokugqalisela umxhasi. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Ulawulo lweenkonzo zokwelapha kwibhospitali yonke ngokwemigaqo yesebe, kuquka nangemiyalezo yangemva kweyure njengoko kumiselwe. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwaye unoxanduva lokuncedisa ekukhuliseni nasekulawuleni iinkonzo zokwelapha zebhospitali. Ukugcina irekhodi ezilo ezichanekileyo zempilo ngokutsho kwezomthetho nezokuziphatha. Ukuqeqesha nokukhokela abasebenzi nabagqirha abasondulana nezempilo ekuphononongweni kokugula nokufa. Ukuhamba kunye nokuthatha inxaxheba kokuqeqesha okuqhubelekayo kwezokwelapha. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zokuphucula umgangatho. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba ukunikezwa kweenkonzo ezikhuselekayo ngexabiso lusingqithiwa ngaphakathi kwesebe elithinteleleyo. Ukujongana nezommono zolawulo njengoko kufunekile. Ukucela, ukwalatha ngqo nokulawula ukunikwa ngendlela echanekileyo nephumelelayo kweenkonzo zokwelapha nosekelo lolawulo ngokusebenza ngeqela eliphambili lomlawulo kwibhospitali ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo somthetho esithintela. Ukumela iNtshona-phakathi yoMmandla wesibini somthetho ngokusemthethweni kumazwe aphakathi naphandle. Ukumisa inkqubo yemisebenzi yangaphakathi kwesebe ngokuhambisana neenkqubo zebhospitali aze ayidlulisele kubasebenzi. Ukuqeqesha nentlholeko yabasebenzi kumacandelo ahambelanayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuzithobela imfuno ze National Core Standards okanye nayiphi na enye imfuno ekulawulekayo nangokomthetho. Ukwenza ukuphonononga okuqhubekayo kokwelapha kwaye uphuhlise, usebenzise kwaye ulandele iinkqubo zenyanga. Ukuphuhlisa, ukulandela nokuhlalutya umgangatho weemali nolwazi lweemali kwaye usebenzise zonke izixhobo ngendlela echanekileyo nephumelelayo. Ukuzilolonga ngenkqubo yokuqonda nokusombulula iingxaki njengendlela yokweniza iigqibo ezilungileyo. Kufuneka abe kulungele ukusebenza ngocinezelo nangemiyalezo yangemva kweyure ngokwemigaqo yovexo othintelekayo. Ukuqulunqa iingxelo zokwelapha kwaye unike ubungqina eengxoxweni zetyala, xa kufunekayo. Ukulawula ukuSebenza ngokusemthethweni nokuQeqeshwa (PMDS) kwaye wenze ukuphonononga kwexesha ngamnye kwabangaphansi kuye. Kufuneka lowo umthweswe isithuba abe kulungele ukuqeqesha, ukuphuhlisa nokulawula ogqirha abasebenza ngaphantsi kwabo kwaye abafunde kwakhona.

jobs.title: Clinical Manager

Participate and accountable for assisting in leading and managing the hospital clinical services. Maintain accurate health records in accordance with legal ethical considerations. Train and guide staff and health associated professionals in morbidity and mortality reviews. Attend and participate in continuous medical education. Participate in quality improvement programs. Ensure that cost effective services delivery is maintained within the respective department. Attend to administrative matters as required. To plan, direct coordinate and manage the efficient and effective delivery of clinical and administration support services through working the key executive management team at the hospital within the legal regulatory framework. To present the Hospital Authoritatively at provincial and public forums. Determines system for intradepartmental functions in keeping with hospital policies and communicates it to staff. Training and development of staff in the relevant sections. Ensure compliance with National Core Standards requirements or any other regulatory and/or statutory requirement. Conduct regular clinical audits and develop, implement and monitor action plans. Develop, monitor and analyse budget and financial information and utilizes all resources in an effective and efficient manner. Practice effective problem identification and resolution skills as a method of sound decision making. Must be prepared to work under pressure and after hour duties as per commuted overtime policy. Compile medical reports and give evidence at trials, when required. Manage Performance and Development (PMDS) and perform quarterly reviews of subordinates. The incumbent must also be prepared to train, develop and supervise of undergraduate and post graduate junior doctors.
jobs.applications: Alternatively, applications can be submitted electronically via email to: Siyabonga.Zetu@echealth.gov.za

af.title: Kliniese Bestuurder
af.summary: Kliniese Bestuurder benodig by Fort Beaufort Hospitaal in die Eastern Cape om kliniese dienste te lei en te bestuur, wat HPCSA-registrasie as 'n Mediese Praktisyn en ten minste 3 jaar post-registrasie ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn. 'n Minimum van 3 jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n mediese beampte na registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn. Kennis van toepaslike wetgewing soos die Nasionale Gesondheidswet, Geestesgesondheidswet, Openbare Finansies Bestuurswet (PFMA)), Openbare Dienswet en verwante regulasies en beleide. Bevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, Program- en Projektebestuur, Finansiële Bestuur, Veranderingsbestuur, Personeelbestuur en Bemagtiging, Dienslewering-innovasie, Kennisbestuur, Probleemoplossing en Analise, Kommunikasie, Kliëntgerigtheid en Klantefokus. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Bestuur van kliniese dienste in die hele hospitaal in ooreenstemming met die departementele standaarde, insluitend na ure soos gedelegeer. Neem deel en is verantwoordelik vir bystand om die hospitaal se kliniese dienste te lei en te bestuur. Handhaaf akkurate gesondheidsrekords in ooreenstemming met wetlike en etiese oorwegings. Lei en begelei personeel en gesondheidsverwante professionele persone in morbiditeits- en mortaliteits hersienings. Woon deurlopende mediese opvoeding by en neem deel daaraan. Neem deel aan gehaltsverbeteringsprogramme. Verseker dat kostedoeltreffende dienslewering gehandhaaf word binne die onderskeie departement. Skenk aandag aan administratiewe aangeleenthede soos vereis. Om die doeltreffende en effektiewe lewering van kliniese en administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste te beplan, direkteer, koördineer en bestuur deur saam te werk met die sleutel-uitvoerende bestuurspan by die hospitaal binne die wetlike regulerende raamwerk. Om die hospitaal gesaghebbend te verteenwoordig by provinsiale en openbare forums. Bepaal stelsel vir intradepartementele funksies in ooreenstemming met hospitaalbeleid en kommunikeer dit aan personeel. Opleiding en ontwikkeling van personeel in die onderskeie afdelings. Verseker nakoming van Nasionale Kernstandaard vereistes of enige ander regulatoriese en/of statutêre vereiste. Voer gereelde kliniese oudits uit en ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor aksieplanne. Ontwikkel, monitor en analiseer begroting en finansiële inligting en benut alle hulpbronne op 'n doeltreffende en effektiewe wyse. Pas effektiewe probleemidentifikasie- en oplossingsvaardighede toe as 'n metode van deurdagte besluitneming. Moet bereid wees om onder druk en na ure dienste te werk ooreenkomstig die beleid vir omgerekende oortyd. Stel mediese verslae op en lewer getuienis by verhore, wanneer vereis. Bestuur Werkverrigting en Ontwikkeling (PMDS) en voer kwartaallikse hersienings van ondergeskiktes uit. Die ampsdraer moet ook bereid wees om voorgraadse en nagraadse junior dokters op te lei, te ontwikkel en te superviseer.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezokwelapha
zu.summary: Kudingwa Umphathi Wezokwelapha e-Fort Beaufort Hospital e-Eastern Cape ukuba ahele aphathe izinkonzo zokwelapha, kuyadingeka ukubhaliswa kwa-HPCSA njengoDokotela Wezokwelapha nobuncane iminyaka eyi-3 yohluvo emva kokubhaliswa.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezifanele ezivumela ukubhalisa ne-HPCSA njengoDokotela Wezokwelapha. Ukubhalisa ne-HPCSA njengoDokotela Wezokwelapha. Okuncane iminyaka eyi-3 yohluvo olufanele njengesikhulu sezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa ne-HPCSA njengoDokotela Wezokwelapha. Ulwazi ngomthetho ofanele njengoba kuMthetho Wezempilo Kazwelonke, uMthetho Wezempilo Yengqondo, uMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi (PFMA)), uMthetho Wenkonzo Yomphakathi kanye nemithetho edingwayo kanye namapholisi ahlobene nawo. Amakhono: Ikhono lezomlando nezinqondo, Ukuphathwa kohlelo kanye nephrojekthi, Ukuphathwa kwezimali, Ukuphathwa koshintsho, Ukuphathwa kwabantu nokuabuswa, Ubuhlakani bokuletha izinkonzo, Ukuphathwa kolwazi, Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokucazulula, Unxibelelwano, Ukumelana nomthengi nokugxila kubathengi. Ilebhalo yokushayela into eqinisekisiwe.
zu.duties: Ukuphatwa kwezinkonzo zokwelapha esibhedlela sonke ngokuhambisana namazinga omnyango, kubandakanya amahora emva kwesikhathi njengoba kuqashiwe. Ukubamba iqhaza nokuba nesibopho ekusizeni ukuhola nokuphatha izinkonzo zokwelapha ezibhedlela. Ugcinwe kwemibhalo eqinisekisiwe yezempilo ngokuhambisana nokucatshangelwa komthetho nokungokomlando. Ukuqeqesha nokuhola abasebenzi kanye nabanhloli bezempilo ekubukeni izifo kanye nobuyo bokufa. Ukubamba iqhaza ekufundeni okuqhubekayo kwezokwelapha. Ukubamba iqhaza eminhlenjweni yokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwezinkonzo ezibiza kancane kugcinwa kulezo ndawo zomnyango. Ukujoyina izindaba ezibhalwayo njengoba kudingeka. Ukuhlela, ukuqondisa, ukuhlanganisa nokuphatha ukulethwa okusebenzayo nokuphumelelayo kwezinkonzo zokwelapha kanye nenkonzo yensiza yobhalo ngokusebenzisa iqembu eliyinhloko labaphathi abaphezulu esibhedlela ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo somthetho. Ukumela i-Authority yesibhedlela ngokugcwele emikhumbini yesisifundazwe kanye nomphakathi. Ukunquma uhlelo lwemisebenzi yangaphakathi komnyango ngokuhambisana namapholisi esibhedlela kanye nokuyidlulisa kwabasebenzi. Ukuqeqesha nokuthuthukisa abasebenzi kulezo ndawo ezihlobene. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana nezidingo zamazinga abalulekwe eNingizimu Afrika noma noma iyiphi enye idingo elingokomthetho noma elingokwesabalo. Ukwenza ukubukeka okuvame ukwenzwa kwemisebenzi yezokwelapha bese ukuthuthukisa, ukuphumelelisa futhi ubukele amaphulani omsebenzi. Ukuthuthukisa, ukubuka nokuhlaziya ibhajethi kanye nolwazi lwezezimali futhi usebenzise zonke izinsiza ngendlela esebenzayo futhi ephumelelayo. Ukusebenzisa amakhono okubona bese kuxazululwa izinkinga njengendlela yokwenza izinqumo ezisimeme. Kumele abe vulivane lokusebenza ngaphansi koxhumo kanye nemisebenzi yamahora emva kwesikhathi ngokuhambisana nenqubomgomo yokusebenza ngaphezu kwesikhathi. Ukulungiselela imibhalo yezokwelapha bese kunikeza ubufakazi ezingxabeni zomthetho lapho kudingeka. Ukuphatha ukusebenza kahle kanye nokuthuthukiswa komsebenzi kanye nokuqapha abasebenzi ikwatha emva kwesikhathi. Umbuzo okhethiwe kumele futhi abe vulivane lokufundisa, ukuthuthukisa kanye nokubuka abadokotela abasha abaphansi kwabafundi kanye nalaba abaphakathi kwabafundi.

xh.title: Umphathi Wezamalungelelwaniso Ezobuchopho
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe nguMphathi Wezamalungelelwaniso Ezobuchopho eFort Beaufort Hospital eEastern Cape ukuba ahola ajongene nezamalungelelwaniso ezobuchopho, kwaye kufuneka abhaliswe kwi-HPCSA njengongqondo wokwelapha angenalo ngxaki yokunyukela kulo qeqeselo, kwaye abe nakho eminye iminyaka engu-3 ubudala wamava emva kokubhalisa.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezifanelekileyo ezivumela ubhaliso kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha. Ubhaliso kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha. Okungaphezulu kweenyanga ezintathu zokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha, kwaye abe namava okusebenza njengomongameli wokwelapha. Ulwazi ngomthetho ohlobene nayo njengomthetho wezeempilo, umthetho wezobuchopho, umthetho wolawulo lwemali kaRhulumente (PFMA), umthetho waBasebenzi kaRhulumente nemiqathango nemigaqo ehlobene nayo. Iimpawu zokwazi ukuyalela nokuba ngumveledi, ulawulo lweenkqubo namaphulo, ulawulo lweemali, ulawulo lotshintsho, ulawulo lwabantu nokubasetyhinsi, inkqubo entsha yokuhambisa iinkonzo, ulawulo lolwazi, ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuqonda, unxibelelwano, ukuzinikela kumthengi nokubakhathalela. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Ulawa lwamalungelelwaniso obuchopho kwisibhedlele sonke ngokwemigaqo yesebe, kuquka namahora emva kwexesha njengoko kuqulunqwe. Ukuthabatha inxaxheba kwaye ungenele ekukhokeneni nokulawulweni amalungelelwaniso obuchopho esibhedlele. Ukugcina iirekhodi ezichanekileyo zempilo ngokwemigaqo yomthetho. Ukulungisa nokukhokela abasebenzi nabochopho abahlobene nezempilo kwiNdlela zokuqwalasela iingxaki nemifestere. Ukubakho kwaye uthabathe inxaxheba kwizifundo ezingapheliyo zokwelapha. Ukuthabatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zokuphucula ubungakanani. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba kugcinwa ukunikezela iinkonzo ezibiza kakhulu ngaphakathi kwesebe ngokufanelekileyo. Ukunyanga imicimbi yolawulo njengoko kufuneka. Ukucinga, ukuqamba uxabiso nokuqondanisa nokulawula ukunikela iinkonzo ezichanekileyo nezisebenzayo zolawulo nobuchopho ngokusebenzana nenhloko yeqela eliyaqhuba eSibhedlele ngaphakathi kwemigaqo yomthetho. Ukumela iSibhedlele ngokusemthethweni kwimibhobho yoluntu nakwichete. Ukumisela inkqubo yokusebenza ngaphakathi kwesebe ngokwemigaqo yesibhedlele wayixele abasebenzi. Ukuqeqesha nokuphuhlisa abasebenzi kumagatya ahlobene. Ukuqinisekisa ukuzilandelana kwemigaqo yezizwe okanye nawuphi na omnye wokuqinisekisa ngokomthetho. Ukuqwalasela rhoqo izifundo zolawulo lwezempilo, zeke, ziphathe kwaye ulandele iinkqubo zenzo. Ukuphucula, ukulandela nokuhlalutya imali yemali yonyaka nolwazi kuze uyisebenzise ngendlela echanekileyo nasebenzayo. Ukwenza ngcono ukuchonga iingxaki nokuqhuba izisombulu njengendlela yokuqumbisa ukuzigqiba. Kubalulekile ukuba abe lukhululekile ukusebenza kuxinzelelo namahora ngemva kwexesha ukwenza imisebenzi. Ukuqamba iinkqubo zokubhala iirekhodi zokwelapha kwaye unike ubungqina ecaleni kwamaxwebhu. Ukulawula ulwazi lokuziphilisa nokuphucula iinkqubo zeziphumo zabantu abangaphantsi kwakho. Kufuneka abe lukhululekile ukuba aqeqeshe, aphucule ajongane noGqirha abasha basebenzayo.

jobs.title: Manager Nursing (LEVEL 3)
jobs.centre: Nelson Mandela Metro, Livingstone Tertiary Hospital
jobs.salary_text: R1 201 302 – R1 353 267 per annum, (OSD), (all-inclusive remuneration package) - basic salary consists of 70% or 75% of total package, salary package will be structured according to Middle Management Service guidelines.
jobs.summary: Manage and provide strategic nursing leadership at Livingstone Tertiary Hospital in Gqeberha, overseeing quality patient care and nursing services.
jobs.requirements: Basic R425 qualification accredited with the SANC in terms of Government Notice 425 (i.e. diploma/ degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse. A post graduate qualification in Nursing Administration/Management will be added advantage. Registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse. A minimum of 10 years appropriate/ recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 5 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/ recognisable experience at management level. Demonstrate advanced understanding and application of Nursing legislation and related legal and ethical nursing practices. Knowledge of PFMA, HR Management. Knowledge of Public Sector Legislation and relevant Prescript/Regulation, Batho Pele Principles and Patient Rights Charter. Strong leadership, good interpersonal relations, effective problem solving, management and decision-making skills. Good verbal and written communication skills are essential requirements. Computer literate and may be required to demonstrate computer skills. Complex report writing skills is essential. A valid driver’s licence.
jobs.duties: To lead, manage and provide strategic Nursing leadership and direction to Nursing Services in the institution. Provide professional, technical and management support for the provision of quality patient care through management of nursing care programs. Advocate the promotion of nursing ethos and professionalism. Develop and monitor the implementation of policies, programs, regulations, practices, protocol/ procedures and standards pertaining to nursing care. Establish, maintain and participate in interprofessional multi-disciplinary team for effective and efficient health care. Manage and monitor the utilization of Human Resources and Finances in accordance with relevant directives and prescripts. Maintain and manage PMDS of subordinates. Collaborate with other team members in the hospital to identify actual and potential risks. Support nursing and health care research to improve the quality of care. Monitor compliance to Quality Assurance, Infection Prevention and Control, Occupational health and Safety and other programs within the institution. Participate in Hospital Executive decision- making body. Implement the SANC CPD programme in the facility.

af.title: Bestuurder Verpleegkunde (VLAK 3)
af.summary: Bestuur en verskaf strategiese verpleegkundige leierskap by Livingstone Tersiêre Hospitaal in Gqeberha, met toezig oor gehalte pasiëntsorg en verpleegdienste.
af.requirements: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie geakkrediteer by die SANC ingevolge Regeringskennisgewing 425 (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of 'n ekwivalente kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie in Verpleegkunde-administrasie/-bestuur sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Registrasie by SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. 'n Minimum van 10 jaar gepaste/erkende ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ten minste 5 jaar van die bogenoemde periode moet gepaste/erkende ervaring op bestuursvlak wees. Toon 'n gevorderde begrip en toepassing van verpleegkunde-wetgewing en verwante regtelike en etiese verpleegpraktyke. Kennis van PFMA, HR-bestuur. Kennis van Openbare Sektor-wetgewing en relevante Voorskrif/Regulasie, Batho Pele-beginsels en die Handves vir Pasiënteregte. Sterk leierskap, goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge, effektiewe probleemoplossing, bestuurs- en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Goede mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede is noodsaaklike vereistes. Rekenaarvaardig en dit word vereis om rekenaarvaardighede te demonstreer. Vaardighede in komplekse verslagskrywing is noodsaaklik. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Om leiding te gee, te bestuur en strategiese verpleegkundige leierskap en rigting aan verpleegdienste in die instelling te verskaf. Verskaf professionele, tegniese en bestuursondersteuning vir die voorsiening van gehalte pasiëntsorg deur die bestuur van verpleegsorgprogramme. Bepleit die bevordering van verpleegkunde-etos en professionaliteit. Ontwikkel en monitor die implementering van beleide, programme, regulasies, praktyke, protokolle/prosedures en standaarde rakende verpleegsorg. Vestig, handhaaf en neem deel aan 'n interprofessionele multidissiplinêre span vir effektiewe en doeltreffende gesondheidsorg. Bestuur en monitor die benutting van menslike hulpbronne en finansies in ooreenstemming met relevante riglyne en voorskrifte. Handhaaf en bestuur die PMDS van ondergeskiktes. Werk saam met ander spanlede in die hospitaal om werklike en potensiële risiko's te identifiseer. Ondersteun verpleegkunde- en gesondheidsorgnavorsing om die gehalte van sorg te verbeter. Monitor nakoming van Gehalteversekering, Infeksievoorkoming en -beheer, Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid en ander programme binne die instelling. Neem deel aan die Hospitaal-uitvoerende besluitnemingsliggaam. Implementeer die SANC CPD-program in die fasiliteit.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezokunakekela (IZINGA 3)
zu.summary: Hamba phambili futhi unikeze ukubhekwa phambili okuyisinqumo ezokunakekela e-Livingstone Tertiary Hospital e-Gqeberha, ubheke ngaphezulu ukunakekelwa kweziguli okunobungako kanye namasevisi ezokunakekela.
zu.requirements: Itholakala elidlulelweyo le-R425 elicwasiswe ne-SANC ngokusho kwesaziso kahulumenti 425 (okungukuthi idiploma/ iziqu ezikwizinkomondinganiso) noma isiqu esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa ne-SANC njengogqajiwe bokunakekela. Isiqu esiphezulu sokuthweswa iziqu eNqumeni Yokuphatha/Izokuphatha Izokunakekela kuzoba yinzuzo. Ukubhaliswa ne-SANC njengogqajiwe bokunakekela. Okungenani iminyaka engu-10 yomhlalaphi/okubonakalayo okuhambisanayo ezokunakekela emva kokubhalisa njengogqajiwe bokunakekela ne-SANC eZokunakekela Jikelele. Okungenani iminyaka engu-5 yesikhathi esisho ngenhla kumele ibe yomhlalaphi/okubonakalayo okuhambisanayo ezingeni lokuqondisa. Bonisa ukuqonda okuphezulu nokuwasebenzisa umthetho wezokunakekela kanye nendlela yezokunakekela ezomthetho nezokuziphatha eziyelelekile. Ulwazi nge-PFMA, Ukuphatha IZABANTU. Ulwazi ngomthetho wasezikhungeni zikahulumeni kanye neNkomba/Umthetho ohambisanayo, Iminqubo YobuBatho Pele kanye Neshadi Lamalungelo Esiguli. Ukubhekwa phambili okuqinile, ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabantu, ukuxazulula izinkinga ngempumelelo, amakhono okuqondisa nokwenza izinqumo. Amakhono okukhuluma nokubhala acacile ayizidingo eziyisisekelo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha futhi kungadingeka ukubonise amakhono okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okubhala imibiko eqinisiwe ayisisekelo. Ilayisense yokushayela esebenzayo.
zu.duties: Ukuhola, ukuqondisa futhi unikeze ukubhekwa phambili okuyisinqumo nezinhlela eziya phambili Kuzokunakekela kule sikhungo. Nikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe, yobuchwepheshe kanye nokuqondisa ekunikekeni ukunakekelwa kweziguli okunobungako ngokuqondisa izinhlela zokunakekela. Thatha isikhundla esihole ekukhuliseni inhlalo nokuziphatha ezokunakekela. Bile futhi ulandele ukusetshenziswa kwezinqubomgomo, izinhlela, imithetho, izindlela, inkomba/ izinqubo kanye namazinga ahlobene nokunakekelwa. Misa, gcina futhi uthathe inxaxheba eqenjini leminyango yezokwelapha elikhulu ukuze kube nokunakekelwa kwemphilo okusebenzayo nokwenza kahle. Qondisa futhi ulandele ukusetshenziswa kolwabo wabantu nezimali ngokuvumelana neNkomba namaphuzu ahambisanayo. Gcina futhi uqondise i-PMDS yalabo abangaphansi kwakho. Sebenzisana namanye amalungu eqenju esibhedlela ukuze uhlole okungaphezu kanye nezingozi ezingaba khona. Xhasa uphenyo lwezokunakekela nezokunakekelwa kwemphilo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukunakekelwa. Landela ukuzihlwayela kokuQinisekiswa Ikhwalithi, Ukuvikela Ukutheleleka Nokulawula, Ukuphathwa kwezempilo Nokuphepha kanye namaNqno amnye kule sikhungo. Thatha inxaxheba Eqenjini Lokwenza Izenqumo Eziphezulu Esibhedlela. Yisela inkqubo ye-SANC CPD esikhungweni.

xh.title: Mphathi woQeqesho lweZigulane (LEVEL 3)
xh.summary: Lawula unike imigaqo ephambili yobukhosi kwiQeqesho lweZigulane eLivingstone Tertiary Hospital eGqeberha, ulawula ukunakekelwa kwemvisiswano kwezigulane nezinkonzo zokuqeqesha izigulane.
xh.requirements: Isifanekezo seBasic R425 esiqinisekiswe yiSANC ngokwesaziso likarhulumente 425 (okt. idiploma/ isidanga kwinqeqesho lezigulane) okanye esilinganayo esivumela ubhaliso kwiSANC njengoGqithiswa loQeqesho lweZigulane. Isidanga esiphezulu nangaphezulu kwiNqeqesho loLawulo lweZigulane kuya kuba lusizo olukhulu. Ubhaliso kwiSANC njengoGqithiswa loQeqesho lweZigulane. Ubuncinane i-10 yeminyaka yamava afanelekileyo/ aqaphekayo kwinqeqesho lezigulane emva kokuqatshelwa njengoGqithiswa loQeqesho lweZigulane kwiSANC kwiGeneral Nursing. Ubuncinane i-5 yeminyaka yexesha elithethwe ngasentla kufuneka ibe yimava efanelekileyo/ ezipapashwe ngabakwiNqanaba bolawulo. Bonakalisa ukuqonda okuphezulu nokusetyenziswa kweMthetho weQeqesho lweZigulane namanye amathetho ahambelana noko kukhoyo noqeqesho lwezigulane ngokomthetho nangokwesiko. Ulwazi ngePFMA, uLawulo lweHR. Ulwazi ngoMthetho woLawulo lweSwift olukaRhulumente nemiQathango/ iMtsetho ephathelene nayo, iMigaqo yeBatho Pele neMiqathango yolawulo lwezigulane. Ubukhosi obuqinileyo, ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabantu, isisombululi sezinto esiyingozi, amava olawulo nokwenza izigqibo. Amava obukhalipha bobhalo nabathethi ngumlomo bubalulekile. Ukuba nalwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwaye unokucelwa ukuba ubonise amava wakho ekhompyutheni. Amava obhalo ngokungagqibekanga abalulekile. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Ukuziba, ukulawula unike imigaqo ephambili nobukhosi buQeqesho lweZigulane nomthetho oza kuthi alandele iinkonzo zokuqeqesha izigulane kwisiseko. Nikeza inkxaso ngobugqithwa, nangolawulo kwinkonzo yokunakekela ngokwemvisiswano izigulane ngokulawula iinkqubo zokuqeqesha izigulane. Suka uvakalise ukuthuthuzwa kobuntu nolwizi kwiqeqesho lezigulane. Yakhe ulawule nikela isandla ekusebenziseni iinkqubo ngamanyathelo, imithetho nemiqathango yokuziphatha, imimiselo/ iinkqubo nemigangatho ephathelene nokuqeqesha izigulane. Misela, gcina uthathe inxaxheba kwingqungquthela ethile yemisebenzi kwaye wenze ukuba ukunakekelwa kwesifo kusebenze ngokuchanekileyo nangokuchanekileyo. Lawula ulawule ukusetyenziswa kweZenzo zabantu nangemali ngokwemiQathango nemiQathango ephathelene nayo. Gcina ulawule iPMDS yabaqeshwayo. Sebenzisana nabanye amalungu eqela esibhedlele ukuze ubone iingozi ezenzeka okanye ezingenzeka. Nika inkxaso kuqeqesho lwesifo nokunakekelwa kwesifo ukuze kuphuculwe umgangatho wonakekelo. Lawula ukuthobela imigangatho yokhuseleko, ukuthintwa kolwalathi, ukhuseleko nomsebenzi wosizo kwezempilo nakwezinye iinkqubo ngaphakathi kwesiseko. Thabatha inxaxheba kwingqungquthela yokuza nezigqibo esibhedlele. Sebenzisa inkqubo yeSANC CPD kule ndawo.

jobs.title: Deputy Manager Nursing
jobs.salary_text: R1 069 215 – R1 219 323 per annum, (OSD) (an all-inclusive package) - basic salary consists of 70% or 75% of total package, salary package will be structured according to Middle Management Service guidelines.
jobs.summary: Provide strategic nursing leadership and manage nursing services at Empilisweni Hospital in the Joe Gqabi District, Eastern Cape.
jobs.requirements: Basic R425 qualification Diploma/Degree in Nursing or equivalent qualification that allows registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse General. A postgraduate diploma in Nursing Management/Administration will be an added advantage. A minimum of 9 years after registration as a Professional Nurse, at least 4 years’ appropriate recognizable experience must be at Management Level. Demonstrate advanced understanding and application of Nursing legislation and related legal and ethical nursing practices. Knowledge of PFMA, HR Management. Knowledge of Public Sector Legislation and relevant Prescript/Regulation, Batho Pele Principles and Patient Rights Charter. Strong leadership, good interpersonal relations, effective problem solving, management and decision-making skills. Good verbal and written communication skills are essential requirements. Computer literate and may be required to demonstrate computer skills. Complex report writing skills is essential. A valid driver’s licence.
jobs.duties: To manage and provide strategic Nursing leadership and direction to the Nursing Services. Plan and monitor the objectives of the specialized unit in line with the strategic plan of the institution and Department. Coordinate and maintain conducive/constructive working relationships with Nursing and other stakeholders. Ensure compliance with professional and ethical practice. Monitor and ensure nursing care is practiced in accordance with the statutory law, policies and procedures governing the Nursing Profession, Labour and Health Care. Effective management and utilization of Human and Material Resources. Ensure effective implementation of PMDS. Monitor compliance to Quality Assurance and Infection Control and Occupational Health and Safety standards and National Core Standards Compliance. Ensure efficient and effective execution of administration functions of the Nursing unit.
jobs.enquiries: Mr S.L Bosholo Tel No: (051) 611 0259
jobs.applications: Alternatively, applications can be submitted electronically via email to: Joseph.Ndzinde@echealth.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly new Z83 Form (effective from 01 January 2021), a comprehensive CV, indicating three reference persons: Name and Contact Numbers, A relationship with reference. Applicants are only required to submit a Z83 form and a comprehensive CV. Therefore, only shortlisted candidates for a post will be required to submit certified documents (copies of Qualification(s) inclusive of Matric certificate, Identity document, Proof of registration, proof of citizenship if not RSA citizen) on or before the day of the interview following communication from HR. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants must note that further Personnel Suitability checks will be conducted on short-listed candidates and that their appointment is subject to the outcome of these checks which include security clearance, security vetting, qualification verification and criminal record checks. Reference checks will be done on nominated candidate(s). The department reserves the right to amend/ review/ withdraw the advertised posts if by so doing, the best interest of the department will be well served. (Females and People with Disabilities are also requested to apply and indicate such in their applications). Misrepresentation in the application documents will result in automatic disqualification and disciplinary action in the event the candidate has already been appointed. If you have not been contacted by the Department of Health within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. We thank all applicants for their interest. People with disabilities are encouraged to apply for these posts. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Adjunkbestuurder Verpleging
af.summary: Verskaf strategiese verpleegleierskap en bestuur verpleegdienste by Empilisweni Hospital in die Joe Gqabi-distrik, Eastern Cape.
af.requirements: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie Diploma/Degree in Verpleging of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige Generies toelaat. 'n Nagraadse diploma in Verpleegbestuur/-administrasie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Minimum van 9 jaar na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige, waarvan ten minste 4 jaar se toepaslike, herkenbare ervaring op Bestuursvlak moet wees. Toon gevorderde begrip en toepassing van verpleegwetgewing en verwante wettige en etiese verpleegpraktyke. Kennis van PFMA, HR-bestuur. Kennis van Openbare Sektor-wetgewing en relevante Voorskrif/Regulasie, Batho Pele-beginsels en Pasienteregtehandves. Sterk leierskap, goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings, effektiewe probleemoplossing, bestuurs- en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede is noodsaaklike vereistes. Rekenaargeletterd en dit kan vereis word om rekenaarvaardighede te demonstreer. Vaardighede in komplekse verslagskrywing is noodsaaklik. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Bestuur en verskaf strategiese Verpleegleierskap en rigting aan die Verpleegdienste. Beplan en monitor die doelwitte van die gespesialiseerde eenheid in ooreenstemming met die strategiese plan van die instelling en Departement. Koördineer en handhaaf gunstige/konstruktiewe werksverhoudinge met Verpleging en ander belanghebbendes. Verseker nakoming van professionele en etiese praktyk. Monitor en verseker dat verpleegsorg beoefen word in ooreenstemming met die statutêre wet, beleide en prosedures wat die Verpleegprofessie, Arbeid en Gesondheidsorg regeer. Effektiewe bestuur en benutting van Menslike en Materiële Hulpbronne. Verseker effektiewe implementering van PMDS. Monitor nakoming van Kwaliteitsversekering en Infeksiebeheer en Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid-standaarde en Nasionale Kernstandaarde-nakoming. Verseker doeltreffende en effektiewe uitvoering van administrasiefunksies van die verpleegeenheid.

zu.title: Usomlondolozi Ohambisana Nomphathi Wezokunakekela
zu.summary: Nikeza ubuholi bezemizinzo bokunakekela abelaphi buphathe imisebenzi yokunakekela abelaphi e-Empilisweni Hospital e-Joe Gqabi District, Eastern Cape.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingunembezzeli ze-R425 i-Diploma/Degree ekuNakekelweni abelaphi noma isiqu esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa ku-SANC njengoGqitha weZokunakekela abelaphi Jikelele. I-diploma yesiqu esiphezulu ekuPhathweni kokuLawulwa kokoNakekelwa abelaphi/Isekelo kuzoba yinzuzo engeziwe. Ubulwelwazi obuncane beminyaka engu-9 emva kokuBhaliswa njengoGqitha weZokunakekela abelaphi, okungenani eminyakeni engu-4 okufanelekileyo kwaye elingaqondakaliyo kufuneka kube ngazinga loBaphathi. Bonakalisa ukuqonda okuphezulu nokusetshenziswa koshishino lokuLawulwa abelaphi nokuziphatha okumayelana nomthetho nokuziphatha kwemisebenzo yabelaphi. Ulwazi ngo-PFMA, i-HR Management. Ulwazi ngoShishino lwoHulumende kanye nokuQondisa/Izinqamuleli ezifanelekileyo, Izimiso ze-Batho Pele neSaziso SamaLungelo Omguli. Ubuholi obusakhiwe, ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabantu, ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokusebenza, amakhono obuphathekunye nokuThatha izinqumo. Amakhono okuxoxa nokubhala kahle ayimfuneko. Ukubhalisele ukusebenza kwesikhompyutha futhi kungadingeka ukubonisa amakhono esikhompyutha. Amakhono okubhala iinkxaso ezindzinakuwo yimfuneko. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha kwaye unikeze ubuholi beNkqubo yokunakekela abelaphi nokuQondisa iNkonzo zokuNakekela abelaphi. Cwangcisa kwaye ulawule iinjongo zeNkonzo ezingundoqo ngokwemigaqo yokuLandelana neNqumamente yonke yeNkonzo. Qhoboshela kwaye ugcine ubudlelwane obuhle nokwakha ngokusebenzisana oNakekela abelaphi nabaNye abantu abanenxaxheba. Qinisekisa ukuthobela imithetho yomsebenzi nokuziphatha okumayelana nomthetho. Linganisa kwaye uQinisekise ukunakekelwa kwegazi ngenkqubo yomthetho, iinkqubo namagqabantshi eNkonzo eNtloko yonke kuNakekelwa abelaphi, iLabour neNkonzo yezeMPilo. Ukulawula kwaye ukwazi ukusebenzisa abantu neZinto ngokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa okusebenzayo kokuQondisa ama-PMDS. Qhoboshela ukulawula isiQinisekiso seMnqamlezo nokuhambelana nokuLawulwaifo kweNdbeco kwezaBangela baseMsebenzini weeNkonzo Zentlalo yonke kwaye nelawulo leeNkonzo Eziqwenene ngokuzalathiswa kwesizwe. Ukwenza inkxaso ekuLawulweni neNkonzo enyaniselekileyo ngokusetyenziswa okusebenzayo kweenkonzo zolawulo eNqanweni leeNkonzo.

xh.title: Mongameli oNcedisayo weNursing
xh.summary: Bonelela ngolawulo olubalulekileyo lweNursing kwaye ulawule iinkonzo zeNursing kwisibhedlele i-Empilisweni kwisiPhahlalazi sika-Joe Gqabi, iNtshona Koloni.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seR425 esisisiseko kwiNursing okanye isiqu esifanayo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengongqondiso weNursing jikelele. Isidanga se-postgraduate kwiLawulo/Iqondo loLawulo lweNursing siza kuba yintoni eongezelelweyo. Ubuncinane iinyanga ezingama-9 emva kokubhaliswa njengongqondiso weNursing, ubuncinane iinyanga ezingama-4 zolwazi olufanelekileyo olusayinwe kufuneka zibe kwiNqanaba loLawulo. Bonisa ukuqonda okuphakamileyo nokusetyenziswa kolawulo lweNursing nemigaqo yolawulo enxulumene nokuziphatha ngokomthetho nakweyethiko ekunyakeni lweNursing. Ulwazi nge-PFMA, uLawulo lwe-HR. Ulwazi ngomthetho woLawulo lweSazinda nakwemigaqo/umthetho othintela, iMigaqo ye-Batho Pele kunye neSaziso samaLungelo oMngenisi. Inkululeko ebalulekileyo yolawulo, ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabantu, isisombululo sezixhindi esisebenzayo, amakhono olawulo nonxibelelwano. Amakhono obuGqala ebali kunye nokubhala alulwimi olubalulekileyo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha angafunwa ukuba abonise amakhono ekhompyutha. Amanyathelo okubhala iingxelo ezingxamisekileyo abalulekile. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebe nzileyo.
xh.duties: Ukuphatha kunye nokubonelela ngenkululeko ebalulekileyo kolawulo lweNursing nolungelelwaniso kwiinkonzo zoNursing. Cwangcisa kwaye ulawule iinjongo zeleyibhu yobuchwepheshe ngokuhambelana nenkqubo ebalulekileyo yesixeko kunye nesebe. Lawula kwaye ugcine ubudlelwane obuhle/akha obusebenzayo kuNursing nakwelaboabanomdla. Qinisekisa ukuvumelana nokuziphatha komsebenzi ochwepheshe kunye newethiko. Qwalasela kwaye uqinisekise ukuba ukunakekelwa kweNursing kwenziwa ngokomthetho oqwalaselwayo, iinkqubo kunye nemigaqo ebalawula uGqogqo lweNursing, iLabo kunye noNakekelo lweMihla ngemihla. Ulawulo olusebenzayo nokusetyenziswa kweeRhisosi zoLuntu kunye nezeZinto. Qinisekisa ukuphumeza ngokusebenzayo i-PMDS. Qwalasela ukuvumelana nokuQinisekiswa kweMgangatho kunye noLawulo loTsholongamo nokuQinisekiswa kweMpilo kunye neKhuseleko kumazinga abalulekileyo kunye nokuvumelana neMigaqo yeSizwe. Qinisekisa ukuphumeza ngokusebenzayo nangempumelelo imisebenzi yolawulo yeqela leNursing.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager Nursing Primary Health Care
jobs.centre: Buffalo City Metro, Empilweni Gompo CHC
jobs.summary: Assistant Manager Nursing for Primary Health Care at Empilweni Gompo CHC, requiring a basic nursing qualification, SANC registration and 10 years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse. Post basic qualification with a duration of at least 1 year in Curative Skills in Primary Health Care/ Clinical Assessment, Treatment and Care accredited with the SANC. Registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse. A minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognisable nursing experience after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 6 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/ recognisable experience after obtaining the 1-year post basic qualification in the relevant specialty. At least 3 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/ recognisable experience at management level.
jobs.duties: Deliver a service in the General nursing areas indicated to ensure service delivery on a 24-hour basis. Will be required to do calls within the discipline and do hospital sit-ups as required by the service as well as night duty. Demonstrate effective communication with patients and relatives, supervisors, other health professionals and junior colleagues including more complex report writing when required. Monitor patient care and compliance to quality standards. Work effectively and amicably at a managerial level, with persons of diverse intellectual, cultural, racial or religious differences. Provision of quality Nursing Care, assist team members with Quality Assurance and monthly audits and development of clinical guidelines and policies. Maintain, manage PMDS of subordinates. Manage risk and ensure that the environment complies with the Health and Safety Act and Infection and Prevention Control Policies. Ensure effective and efficient budget control and assets control for the department. Preparedness to engage and manage any project aimed at improving the image of the nursing profession and the effectiveness and efficiency of the health service. Overall management of the Community Health Centre.
