af.title: Assistentbestuurder Verpleging Primêre Gesondheidsorg
af.summary: Assistentbestuurder Verpleging vir Primêre Gesondheidsorg by Empilweni Gompo CHC, wat 'n basiese verpleegkwalifikasie, SANC-registrasie en 10 jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. Ná-basiese kwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar in Kuratiewe Vaardighede in Primêre Gesondheidsorg/ Kliniese Assessering, Behandeling en Sorg geakkrediteer by die SANC. Registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare verpleegervaring ná registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste 6 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring ná verkryging van die 1-jaar ná-basiese kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike spesialiteit wees. Ten minste 3 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring op bestuursvlak wees.
af.duties: Lewer 'n diens in die aangeduide algemene verpleegareas om dienslewering op 'n 24-uur basis te verseker. Sal verplig wees om oproepe binne die dissipline te doen en hospital sit-ups te doen soos deur die diens vereis, asook nagdiens. Toon effektiewe kommunikasie met pasiënte en familielede, toesighouers, ander gesondheidsprofessionals en junior kollegas, insluitend meer komplekse verslagskrywing wanneer vereis. Monitor pasiëntsorg en voldoening aan gehaltestandaarde. Werk effektief en saamwerkbaar op 'n bestuursvlak met persone van uiteenlopende intellektuele, kulturele, rasse- of godsdiensverskille. Voorsiening van gehalte verpleegsorg, help spanlede met Gehalteversekering en maandelikse oudits en ontwikkeling van kliniese riglyne en beleide. Onderhou en bestuur PMDS van ondergeskiktes. Bestuur risiko en verseker dat die omgewing voldoen aan die Wet op Gesondheid en Veiligheid en Infeksie- en Voorkomingsbeheerbeleide. Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende begrotingsbeheer en batesbeheer vir die departement. Gereedheid om enige projek te onderneem en te bestuur wat gemik is op die verbetering van die beeld van die verpleegprofessie en die doeltreffendheid en effektiwiteit van die gesondheidsdiens. Algehele bestuur van die Community Health Centre.

zu.title: Umphathi Ohambisanayo Wezokunakekela Ekuqaleni Kwezempilo
zu.summary: Umphathi Ohambisanayo Wezokunakekela Ekuqaleni Kwezempilo e-Empilweni Gompo CHC, ofuna izifundo eziyisisekelo zokunakekela, ukubhaliswa kwa-SANC kanye namava eminyaka engu-10.
zu.requirements: Isifundo esiyisisekelo se-R425 (okuyinkomba idiploma/iziqu ekuqashweni kwezokunakekela) noma isifundo esilingana esivumela ukubhaliswa kwa-SANC njengogosi Wezokunakekela Oqeqeshiwe. Isifundo esiyisisekelo ngemuva kweminyaka engu-1 okungaphezulu kuyo ngezakhono Ekuqashweni Kwezokunakekela Ekuqaleni Kwezempilo/ Ukuhlola Okwesibonelo, Ukwelashwa Nokunakekelwa esivunyelwe yi-SANC. Ukubhaliswa kwa-SANC njengogosi Wezokunakekela Oqeqeshiwe. Okungenani iminyaka engu-10 yamava ahambisanayo/abonakalayo ekunakekelweni ngemuva kokubhaliswa njengoGosi Wezokunakekela Oqeqeshiwe kwa-SANC Ekuqashweni Ngokujwayelekile. Okungenani iminyaka engu-6 yesikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kufanele ibe yamava ahambisanayo/abonakalayo ngemuva kokuthola isifundo esiyisisekelo ngemuva kweminyaka engu-1 ebumbeni oluhlobene. Okungenani iminyaka engu-3 yesikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kufanele ibe yamava ahambisanayo/abonakalayo ezingeni lokuqondisa.
zu.duties: Hlela isevisi emikhakheni yokuqashwa ngokujwayelekile okushiwo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwethulwa kwisevisi amahora angu-24 ngosuku. Kuzofuneka ukuqalisa amafoni ngaphakathi kwesigaba kanye nokuhlala esibhedlela njengoba kudingwa yisevisi kanye nomsebenzi wesikhathi sokuhlola ebusuku. Khombisa ukuxhumana okusebenzayo nabaguli nasemndenini wabo, abaphathi, abanye ochwepheshe bezempilo kanye nabalingisi abasha okuhlanganisa ukubhala okuyinkimbinkimbi yemibiko uma kudingeka. Qapha ukunakekelwa kwabaguli nokuhambisana nezindinganiso zesimo. Sebenza ngokusebenzayo nangokuzwana ezingeni lokuqondisa, nabantu abehlukene ngokweqondo, amasiko, isibala noma inkolo. Nikela ngokuqinisekiswa kwezempilo nokunakekelwa, siza amalungu eqembu nokuqinisekisa Ikhwalithi kanye nokuhlolwa nyanga zonke kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezinhlela nezinkomba zokuqashwa. Gcina, qondisa i-PMDS yabalawuli abangaphansi kwakho. Qondisa ingozi futhi uqinisekise ukuthi indawo ihambisana noMthetho Wezempilo Nokuphepha kanye Nezinqondiso Zokulawula Izelulezo Nokuvikela. Qinisekisa ukulawula kabuhlungu nangokusebenzayo kwesabelo nokulawula izimpahla zumnyango. Ukulungele ukuxhumana nokuqondisa nanoma yiphi iphrojekhi eyahunyiswe ukuthuthukisa isithombe somsebenzi wezokunakekela kanye nokusebenza nokusebenzaya kwezempilo. Qondisa ngokuphelele i-Clinic Yomphakathi.

xh.title: Mncedi weNjinela wokuQonda iNgcwaliso lweMisebenzi yezaMpilo eNguni
xh.summary: UMncedi weNjinela wokuQonda iNgcwaliso lweMisebenzi yezaMpilo eNguni kwi-Empilweni Gompo CHC, efuna isifundo esisisiseko seNgcwaliso lweMisebenzi, ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC namava eminyaka eli-10.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esisisiseko se-R425 (oko ngesidiploma/izidanga kwiNgcwaliso lweMisebenzi) okanye isifundo esilinganayo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengoGqirha weMisebenzi. Isifundo esisisiseko sokugqitha esithatha ubungevano obungingamnye unyaka ohlwini lwezakhono zokuPhilisa kwiMisebenzi yeNgcwaliso yezaMpilo eNguni/ ukuHlola iNgxaki, ukuNyanga noM iso nokuQikelela esamkelwe yi-SANC. Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengoGqirha weMisebenzi. Ukuba ngowona unyaka wama-10 wamava afanelekileyo/abonakalayo emsebenzini wokunqamba emva kokubhaliswa njengoGqirha weMisebenzi kwi-SANC kokuQonda iNgcwaliso yeMisebenzi. Ubungevano obungingamnye unyaka ohlwini lwezifundo ezisisiseko kwindawo echaphazelekayo. Ubungevano obungangamnyaka m-3 ohlwini lobungevano obungentla kumele bubambe amava afanelekileyo/abonakalayo kwinqanaba leNjinela.
xh.duties: Ukunikela inkonzo kwiiNdawo zeNgcwaliso yeMisebenzi eZiqhelekileyo ebonisiweyo ukuqinisekisa ukunikela inkonzo ngosuku iiyure ezingama-24. Uya kufunwa ukuba wenze amafowuni ngaphakathi kobumfundi kwaye wenze izihlalelo zesibhedlele njengoko kufunwa yinkonzo nakwindalo yokusebenza ebusuku. Ukubonisa ukunyanyezela okusebenzayo nabaguli nosapho, oogqirha abalawulayo, oogqirha abanye bezaMpilo nakwindalo ekwinqanaba elingentla kubandakanya ukubhala iingxelo ezinzima xa kufuneka. Ukujolisa ukunakekelwa kwabaguli nokuzithoba kwemigangatho yomgangatho. Ukusebenza ngokusetyenziswa ngokuzondana kwinqanaba leNjinela, nabantu abanohlalo olwahlukileyo ngengqiqo, ngenkcubeko, ngobuhlanga okanye ngenkolo. Ukunikela iNgcwaliso yoMgangatho weNgcwaliso lweMisebenzi, ukuncedisa amalungu eqela nokuQinisekisa uMgangatho nokuHlola nyanga zonke nokuPhuhlisa iinkqubo zokuQonda iNgxaki neeNkqubo. Ukugcina, ukulawula i-PMDS yabo bangaphantsi. Ukulawula ingozi nokuqinisekisa ukuba indawo izithoba neMithetho yezaMpilo noKhuseleko neeNkqubo zoLawulo lokuQala nokuthintela. Ukuzinikela ngokuzimisela nokusebenza kwaye ulawule nalipho na iprojekthi efunwa ukuphucula umfanekiso wobumfundi beNgcwaliso lweMisebenzi nokuSebenza nokuQonda iNgcwaliso yezaMpilo. Ukulawula ngokuQamba kweNdawo yeMisebenzi yoBunti.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager Nursing (AREA)
jobs.summary: Assistant Manager Nursing position at Empilisweni Hospital in Joe Gqabi District, requiring a nursing qualification, SANC registration and 8 years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Basic R425 qualification i.e. Diploma / Degree in Nursing or equivalent qualification. Current registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A minimum of 8 years’ appropriate experience after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC of which at least 3 years should be at a managerial level. Ability to work in a multi- disciplinary team. Knowledge of PFMA, Batho Pele Principles, Patient Rights Charter and other relevant legal frameworks, Labour Relations and Public Service Acts. Managerial and communication (both written and verbal), report writing and problem-solving skills. Knowledge of six key priority areas, ability to work under pressure. A valid driver’s licence. Computer literacy.
jobs.duties: Delegate, supervise and coordinate the provision of effective and effective patient care through adequate nursing care. Coordinate and monitor the implementation of nursing care plan and evaluation thereof. Develop, establish and maintain a constructive working relationship with nursing and other stakeholders (interprofessional, intersectoral and multi-disciplinary teamwork). Participate in the analysis, formulation and implementation of nursing guidelines, practices, standards and procedures. Manage and monitor proper utilization of human, financial and physical resources. Initiate and participate in health promotion to ensure consistent communication of relevant, accurate and comprehensive information on health care.
jobs.enquiries: Mr S.L Bosholo Tel No: (051) 611 0259
jobs.applications: Alternatively, applications can be submitted electronically via email to: Joseph.Ndzinde@echealth.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly new Z83 Form (effective from 01 January 2021), a comprehensive CV, indicating three reference persons: Name and Contact Numbers, A relationship with reference. Applicants are only required to submit a Z83 form and a comprehensive CV. Therefore, only shortlisted candidates for a post will be required to submit certified documents (copies of Qualification(s) inclusive of Matric certificate, Identity document, Proof of registration, proof of citizenship if not RSA citizen) on or before the day of the interview following communication from HR. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants must note that further Personnel Suitability checks will be conducted on short-listed candidates and that their appointment is subject to the outcome of these checks which include security clearance, security vetting, qualification verification and criminal record checks. Reference checks will be done on nominated candidate(s). The department reserves the right to amend/ review/ withdraw the advertised posts if by so doing, the best interest of the department will be well served. (Females and People with Disabilities are also requested to apply and indicate such in their applications). Misrepresentation in the application documents will result in automatic disqualification and disciplinary action in the event the candidate has already been appointed. If you have not been contacted by the Department of Health within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. We thank all applicants for their interest. People with disabilities are encouraged to apply for these posts. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Assistentbestuurder Verpleging (AREA)
af.summary: Assistentbestuurder Verpleging-pos by Empilisweni-hospitaal in Joe Gqabi-distrik, wat 'n verpleegkwalifikasie, SANC-registrasie en 8 jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie d.w.s. Diploma / Graad in Verpleging of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Huidige registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. 'n Minimum van 8 jaar se toepaslike ervaring na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC waarvan ten minste 3 jaar op bestuursvlak moet wees. Vermoë om in 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk. Kennis van PFMA, Batho Pele-beginsels, Patient Rights Charter en ander tersaaklike regsraamwerke, Labour Relations en Public Service Acts. Bestuurs- en kommunikasie (sowel skriftelik as mondelings), verslagskryf- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Kennis van ses kernprioriteitsgebiede, vermoë om onder druk te werk. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Rekenaarvaardigheid.
af.duties: Delegeer, hou toesig en koördineer die verskaffing van doeltreffende en effektiewe pasiëntsorg deur voldoende verpleegsorg. Koördineer en monitor die implementering van die verpleegsorgplan en die evaluering daarvan. Ontwikkel, vestig en handhaaf 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met verpleegkundiges en ander belanghebbendes (interprofessionele, intersektorale en multidissiplinêre spanwerk). Neem deel aan die ontleding, formulering en implementering van verpleegriglyne, praktyke, standaarde en prosedures. Bestuur en monitor behoorlike benutting van menslike, finansiële en fisiese hulpbronne. Inisieer en neem deel aan gesondheidsbevordering om konsekwente kommunikasie van tersaaklike, akkurate en omvattende inligting oor gesondheidsorg te verseker.

zu.title: Umphathi Omsiza Wezokwelapha Abagulayo (AREA)
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi omsiza wezokwelapha abagulayo esibhedlela i-Empilisweni Hospital endaweni i-Joe Gqabi District, sidinga izifundo zobuhlengikazi, ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC nohambo lweminyaka engu-8 lolwazi.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ze-R425 okuyi-Diploma / Degree eZokwelapha Abagulayo noma okufanayo nalokhu. Ukubhaliswa okwamanje ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogwadliwe ogwadayo. Ubuncwane beminyaka engu-8 yolwazi olufanelekile ngemuva kokubhaliswa njengogwadliwe ogwadayo ku-SANC, okuyilapho okungenani kumele kube neminyaka engu-3 ezingeni lemphathi. Isipho sokusebenza eqenjini elihlangene izinto eziningi. Ulwazi nge-PFMA, Izimiso ze-Batho Pele, IMibhalo Yezelo Zamalungelo Omuntu Namanye Amasimiso Omthetho, Izindaba Zomsebenzi Nemithetho Yomphakathi. Ikhono lokubusa nokuxhumana (okubhalwayo nokukhulunywayo), ukubhala imibalo nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ulwazi ngamagatsha ayisithupha abalulekile, nesipho sokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi. Ilayisense yomshayeli elivunyiwe. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha.
zu.duties: Yabelana, qaphisise uze uhlele ukunikezwa kokunakekelwa okusebenzayo nokunakekelwa abagulayo okwanele ngokwelapha abagulayo. Hlela uze ulawule ukuphathwa kohlaka lokunakekelwa kwabagulayo nokuhanjiswa kwalo. Yakha, umise uze ulondoloze ubudlelwano bokusebenza obuhle nabagwadayo namanye abahlanganyeli (ukusebenza kwabangamhlanga, phakathi kwezindawo naseqenjini elihlangene izinto eziningi). Thatha inxaxheba ekuhlaziyweni, ukwenziweni nokuphathweni kwezimiso zokwelapha abagulayo, izinqubo, amazinga nezindlela. Lawula uze uqaphise ukusetshenziswa okuhle kwemithombo yabantu, yemali nezinto eziphathekayo. Qala uze uthathe inxaxheba ekukhuthazeni impilo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuxhumana okungaguquki kwolwazi olufanelekile, oluchanekile loluneminingwane ngokunakekelwa impilo.

xh.title: Mphathi oNcedisayo weNursing (AREA)
xh.summary: Isithuba sikaMphathi oNcedisayo kwiNursing e Empilisweni Hospital kw Joe Gqabi District, sifuna isigqibo sokhathalelo lwamagumbi, ukubhaliswa kwiSANC kunye neminyaka engu-8 yamava.
xh.requirements: Izigqibo eziyimfuno ezigqibeleleyo ze R425 okt. Diploma / Degree kwiNursing okt isigqibo esilinganayo. Ugqibo lwangoku kwi South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongikazi weGazi. Eminyakeni engu-8 yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi weGazi kwiSANC apho unyaka obungaphantsi kwawo mawube ngamakhulu amathathu kwinxaxheba yabaphathi. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza kwibutha labasebenzi besifundo ezahlukeneyo. Ulwazi ngePFMA, iinkqubo zeBatho Pele, iziko lamagunya ezigulane nolunye ulwazi olusemgangathweni wolwazio, iLabhu Relations kunye nePublic Service Acts. Amaphuphu okuphatha nokunxibelelwana (kokubhaliweyo nakwethiyori), amaphuphu okubhala iingxelo kunye namaphuphu okusombulula iingxaki. Ulwazi ngezixhobo eziyimfuno eziphambili, ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngantsundu. Ilayisensi yokushayela. Ulwazi ngekhompyutha.
xh.duties: Abelana, balawule baze balungiselele ukubonelelwa kokhathalelo lwezigulane olusebenzayo noluphumelelayo ngokunjululwa kolwazi lokhathalelo lwamagumbi. Balungiselele baze balawule ukuphunyezwa kwesicwangciso sokhathalelo lwamagumbi nokutathwa kwemigaqo yaso. Bavuse, baseze baze bagcine ubudlelwano obusembakisweni bokusebenza phakathi kwamagumbi namanyeabanomdla (umsebenzi wabasebenzisana ngamakhondo, abasebenzisana ngamaphandle kunye nobuthimba abasebenza ngokwezifundo ezininzi). Bathathe inxaxheba ekuhlalutweni, ekwenzeni nasekuphunyizeni iinkqubo zokulawula, iinkqubo, amanqanaba neendlela zokusebenza kulwazi lokhathalelo lwamagumbi. Balawule baze balawule ukusetyenziswa okufanelekileyo kwemithombo yabantu, eyemali nentsimo. Baqalise baze bathathe inxaxheba kukhuthazo lokhathalelo olutsha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukudlulisa rhoqo ulwazi olufanelekileyo, oluchanekileyo nolugqithiswe ngokutsha ngokukhathalela impilo.

jobs.title: Operational Manager Specialty (PSYCHIATRY)
jobs.centre: Sarah Baartman District, Fort England Psychiatric Hospital
jobs.summary: Operational manager sought for psychiatric speciality at Fort England Psychiatric Hospital, requiring SANC registration and nine years nursing experience.
jobs.requirements: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows Registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse. A post basic nursing qualification, with duration of at least one (01) year accredited with the SANC in Psychiatric Nursing Science. Registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse. A minimum of 9 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 5 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/ recognisable experience in the specific specialty after obtaining the 1-year post-basic qualification in the relevant specialty. Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes and other relevant legal frameworks such as Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act Patient’s Rights Charter, Batho-Pele Principles. Sound knowledge and skills in implementing disciplinary code and procedure, grievance procedure Leadership, organizational, decision making and problem-solving abilities within the limit of the public sector and institutional policy framework. Good interpersonal skills including public relations, negotiating, conflict handling and counselling skills. Knowledge of financial and budgetary prescripts and processes pertaining to the relevant resources under management Insight into public health sector strategies and priorities including the nursing strategy, standards procedures and policies pertaining to nursing care, computer skills in basic programs. A valid driver’s licence.
jobs.duties: Provide effective management and professional leadership in the specialized units of Psychiatric. Demonstrate effective communication with patients, supervisors, other health professional and junior colleagues including more complex report writing when required Effective management, utilization and supervision of all resources Display a concern for patients, promoting, advocating and facilitating proper treatment and care and ensure that the unit adheres to the principles of Batho Pele Maintain clinical competence by ensuring that scientific principles of nursing and clinical governance are implemented. Implement maternal guidelines, demonstrate an in-depth understanding of nursing legislation and related legal and ethical nursing practice. Exercise control of discipline, grievance and any labour related issues in terms of laid down procedures. Provide supportive supervision and comply with PMDS evaluation of staff, formulate training programs and participate in training and development of staff and nursing students. Monitor implementation Disaster management, monitor implementation of NCS and Ideal Hospital Realization Framework and interpret its impact on service delivery thereof. Coordinate and participate in health promotion activities and monitor and evaluation of data Demonstrate basic computer literacy as a support tool to enhance service delivery. Support Nursing Services Management by working weekend and night duty when required.

jobs.applications: Alternatively, applications can be submitted electronically via email to: Xolelwa.Nazo@echealth.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly new Z83 Form (effective from 01 January 2021), a comprehensive CV, indicating three reference persons: Name and Contact Numbers, A relationship with reference. Applicants are only required to submit a Z83 form and a comprehensive CV. Therefore, only shortlisted candidates for a post will be required to submit certified documents (copies of Qualification(s) inclusive of Matric certificate, Identity document, Proof of registration, proof of citizenship if not RSA citizen) on or before the day of the interview following communication from HR. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants must note that further Personnel Suitability checks will be conducted on short-listed candidates and that their appointment is subject to the outcome of these checks which include security clearance, security vetting, qualification verification and criminal record checks. Reference checks will be done on nominated candidate(s). The department reserves the right to amend/ review/ withdraw the advertised posts if by so doing, the best interest of the department will be well served. (Females and People with Disabilities are also requested to apply and indicate such in their applications). Misrepresentation in the application documents will result in automatic disqualification and disciplinary action in the event the candidate has already been appointed. If you have not been contacted by the Department of Health within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. We thank all applicants for their interest. People with disabilities are encouraged to apply for these posts. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Operasionele Bestuurder Spesialiteit (PSIGIATRIE)
af.summary: Operasionele bestuurder gesoek vir psigiatriese spesialiteit by Fort England Psychiatric Hospital, wat SANC-registrasie en nege jaar verpleegervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.i. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie wat Registrasie met die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Postbasiese verpleegkwalifikasie, met 'n duur van ten minste een (01) jaar geakkrediteer met die SANC in Psigiatrise Verpleegwetenskap. Registrasie met die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. 'n Minimum van 9 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige met die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste 5 jaar van die bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in die spesifieke spesialiteit wees na verkryging van die 1-jaar postbasiese kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike spesialiteit. Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures, verpleegstatute en ander tersaaklike regskader soos die Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Patient's Rights Charter, Batho-Pele-beginsels. Deeglike kennis en vaardighede in die toepassing van die dissiplinêre kode en prosedure, klagteprosedure Leierskap, organisatoriese, besluitneming- en probleemoplossingsvermoëns binne die perke van die openbare sektor en institusionele beleidsraamwerk. Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede insluitend openbare betrekkinge, onderhandeling, konflikhantering en voorligtingsvaardighede. Kennis van finansiële en begrotingsvoorskifte en -prosesse rakende die tersaaklike hulpbronne onder bestuur Insiig in openbare gesondheidssektor-strategieë en -prioriteite insluitend die verpleegstrategie, standaarde prosedures en beleide rakende verpleegsorg, rekenaervaardighede in basiese programme. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Verskaf effektiewe bestuur en professionele leierskap in die gespesialiseerde eenhede van Psigiatrie. Toon effektiewe kommunikasie met pasiënte, toesighouers, ander gesondheidsprofessioneles en junior kollegas insluitend meer komplekse verslagskrywing wanneer nodig Effektiewe bestuur, benutting en toesig oor alle hulpbronne Toon bekommernis vir pasiënte, bevorder, behartig en fasiliteer behoorlike behandeling en sorg en verseker dat die eenheid voldoen aan die beginsels van Batho Pele Onderhou kliniese bevoegdheid deur te verseker dat wetenskaplike beginsels van verpleging en kliniese bestuur geïmplementeer word. Implementeer moederlike riglyne, toon 'n diepgaande begrip van verpleegwetgewing en verwante regs- en etiese verpleegpraktyk. Oefen beheer uit oor dissipline, klagte en enige arbeidsverwante kwessies volgens vasgestelde prosedures. Verskaf ondersteunende toesig en voldoen aan PMDS-evaluering van personeel, formuleer opleidingsprogramme en neem deel aan opleiding en ontwikkeling van personeel en verpleegstudente. Monitor implementering van rampbestuur, monitor implementering van NCS en Ideal Hospital Realization Framework en interpreteer die impak daarvan op dienslewering. Koördineer en neem deel aan gesondheidsbevorderingsaktiwiteite en monitor en evaluering van data Toon basiese rekenaarvaardigheid as 'n ondersteuningsinstrument om dienslewering te verbeter. Ondersteun Verpleegdienste-bestuur deur naweek- en nagdiens te werk wanneer nodig.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezokusebenza Obhekene Nesikhungazi (I-PSYCHIATRY)
zu.summary: Kufunwa umphathi wezokusebenza obhekene nesikhungazi e-Fort England Psychiatric Hospital, ofuna ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC nencepho yeminyaka yisishiyagalolunye eqondweni lokunakekelwa kwabaguli.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezisisiseko ze-R425 (okungukuthi idiploma/iziqu ezingunakekelo) noma izifundo ezingalingana nezisu ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengogogo oyingqwele. Isifundo sokunakekelwa esingemuva kokuqeqeshwa kwesisiseko, esithatha isikhathi esinganonye (01) owonyaka esamukelekile e-SANC kwi-Psychiatric Nursing Science. Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengogogo oyingqwele. Okungenani ungamashumi ayisishiyagalolunye eminyaka yamava ahambisanayo/awaziwayo eqondweni lokunakekelwa emva kokubhalisa njengogogo oyingqwele e-SANC eqondweni Lokunakekelwa Okujwayelekile. Okungenani iminyaka eyisihlanu kuleso sikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele ibe ngamava ahambisanayo/awaziwayo kuleso sikhungazi ngemva kokuthola isifundo sokunakekelwa esingemuva kokuqeqeshwa kwesisiseko esithatha unyaka owodwa kuleso sikhungazi. Ulwazi ngemikhuba nemithetho yokunakekelwa, emithethweni yokunakekelwa kanye namanye amasimiso omthetho ahlobene nakho njengengxenye yoMthetho Wezokunakekelwa, uMthetho Wezempilo, uMthetho Wezempilo Nokuphepha Komsebenzi Umthethosiseko Wamalungelo Abaguli, Imigomo YamaBatho-Pele. Ulwazi olujulile namakhono ekusebenziseni ikhodi nemikhuba yezisolo, imikhuba yesisolo, amakhono okukhokumula ekuqweni, ohlelweni, ekwenzeni izinqumo nasekuxazululeni izinkinga ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo yomphakathi kanye namasimiso ohlelo lwezikole. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu ahlanganisa ubudlelwano nomphakathi, ukuxoxisana, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga namakhono okweluleka. Ulwazi ngemithetho kanye namakhalenda ngemithetho yezimali kanye nemikhuba ehlobene namabhulokho asebaleni, amaphaposheka, izinkomba zohlelo ezingaphansi kokuphathwa, ukubuka imikhuba kwemithombo olawulwayo, izinkomba zezimali, izimali, izinkomba zokwaziswa kokuqasha kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga ezinkulu kakhulu, ulwazi mayelana nomshini wokusebenzisa ikhakhontha. Ilayisense evumelekile yokushayela.
zu.duties: Nika ukuphathwa okusebenzayo nokukhokumela okungobungcweti kumayunithi abhekene nokukhulumisana. Khombisa ukuxhumana okusebenzayo nabaguli, abaphathi, abanye ochwepheshe bezempilo nakubasebenza nabo kubandakanya ukubhala okuyinkimbinkimbi lapho kudingeka khona Ukuphathwa, ukusetshenziswa nokugadwa kwezinsiza zonke ukusebenza ngokufanele, ukuphathwa okuhle nokuhlela kabanzi komsebenzi, ukubaluleka kokuxhumana ngokufunda, ukulungiselelwa kwezinto ezingase zenzeka, ukuphathwa kwezigameko, izinqubo zokulawula, ukubeka kanye namazinga okulawula izinkomba kanye namasu ohlelo, ukugcina imikhuba ezingeni elikhulu, ukugcina amapurogremu amaningi, ukusebenzisa ulwazi ekwelulekeni nokuxazulula izinkinga, ukubuka izinsiza ezinkulu namazinga okuphathwa, ukulawula inqubo nokugcina imikhuba yokubuka kanye nokutholakala koshintsho, ukubuka izinsiza ezinkulu namazinga, ukulawula izinsiza ezinkulu kanye nokutholwa kwamazinga okubuka. Gcina ukulingana emsebenzini ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi imikhuba yezokunakekelwa nezinhlobo ezingezwa ziqondiswa kahle. Qeqesha, qeqesha abasebenzi abasha kanye nabafundi bokunakekelwa ngokusebenzisa izindlela zokuqeqesha namapurogremu, futhi thatha inxaxheba ekwelulekeni kwezinsiza, kokuqeqeshwa kokusebenza kwezinsiza. Buyeza izinkinga, izisolo nanoma yiluphi udaba oluhlobene nemisebenzi ngokuya ngemikhuba emisiwe. Bonezela ukulawula okusekelayo futhi landela ukulinganiswa kwe-PMDS kwabasebenzi, yenza amapurogremu okuqeqesha futhi uthathe inxaxheba ekuqeqeshweni nasekuthuthukiseni abasebenzi nabafundi bokunakekelwa. Qapha ukusetshenziswa kokuqeqeshwa kwakamuva kokunakekelwa kanye namaphoyinti abalulekile omthetho wezokunakekelwa. Lawula isimiso sokulawula izigameko, izisolo, ukuphathwa kwezimali, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukulawulwa kwenkathi yokugcina nokuqinisekisa ukuthi konke kwenziwa ngokulandela imikhuba evunyiwe mayelana nemisebenzi ehlobene. Hlola ukusetshenziswa kokuqeqeshwa kokunakekelwa komama, futhi khombisa ukugqamisa ukuphathwa komthetho wezokunakekelwa emthethweni wezokunakekelwa, okufaka amasu nezinqubo ezaholela ekwenziweni kwezinkomba zezezigameko ezingeyona ezingezwa, okungenzeka kuthathwe isinyathelo esisha sokusebenzisa amaqiniso. Lawula ukuphathwa kwezokunakekelwa kwezempilo mayelana nomthetho kanye namazinga okugcina imisebenzi yokunakekelwa kanye nokuhlola imigomo efanayo. Hlola imikhuba yesibonelo nokulawulwa kokuqeqeshwa kwesikhathi eside nokuphathwa komthelela wawo ekulethweni kwenkonzo. Hlanganisa futhi uthathe inxaxheba emsebenzini wokuthuthukisa izempilo kanye nokuqapha nokuhlola idatha. Khombisa ulwazi oluyisiseko lokusebenzisa ikhakhontha njengesixazululi sokukhulisa ukulethwa kwenkonzo. Sekela Ukuphathwa Kwezinkonzo Zokunakekelwa ngokusebenza ngevikendi nasobusuku lapho kudingwa khona.

xh.title: Umphathi Wemisebenzi Weziqu (I-PSYCHIATRY)
xh.summary: Kufunwa umphathi wemisebenzi weziqu ekunyusekeni ngengqondo kwisibhedlele i-Fort England Psychiatric Hospital, kufuneka abhalwe kwi-SANC abe nolwazi lweminyaka elithoba ekusingathweni kwabagulayo.
xh.requirements: Isigaba se-R425 esisekelo (oko kukuthi idiploma/iziqu ekusingathweni kwabagulayo) okanye isifanekiso esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengongqoshi oGqithisileyo. Isifanekiso sokongqoshi esingaphezulu kweyona esisekelo, esibekako ubungakanani beminyaka engu-1 (01) ubudala, esamkelelwe yi-SANC kwingcali yeSayensi yokunyuseka ngengqondo. Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengongqoshi oGqithisileyo. Okona ingcamango elinganiselweyo leminyaka elingu-9 olusebenzisekayo/oluvakalayo ekusingathweni kwabagulayo emva kokubhaliswa njengongqoshi oGqithisileyo kwi-SANC ekusingathweni kwabagulayo jikelele. Okona ingxenye yeminyaka engu-5 ebekwe ngasentla kufuneka iloluhlobo olusebenzisekayo/oluvakalayo kule ngcali ithile emva kokufumana isifanekiso esingaphezulu kweyona esisekelo sonyaka we-1 kule ngcali ethize. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo nemithetho yokusingathwa kwabagulayo, nemithetho yokongqishi nakwezinye iinkqubo zomthetho ezibalulekileyo ezinjengoMthetho wokuQongqothwa, uMthetho weMpiI loYilo, uMthetho woMphefumlo wokuSebenza nokuKhuseleka, uMthetho weMali yoMzimba kaMgentu, iNqaela zamabala aBantu. Ulwazi namakhono amaninzi ekusebenziseni ikhowudi nendlela yokuqwalasela ezingqayi, iinkqubo zokuveza iingxaki, iNqaela, ukubumba iindaba, ukwenza izigqibo nokusombulula iingxaki ngaphakathi kwemida yentlalo yoluntu nethembo lenkqubo yesebe. Amabakhoniza abantu amaninzi kuquka ubudlelwane noluntu, ukuxoxisana, ukuphathwa kwezinxaxhi nokunika ingxelo. Ulwazi lwezala nemithetho yesixa lemali kwaye neenkqubo ezithintela izixhobo ezingaphantsi kolawulo. Ukuqonda iindidi-miso zobugcisa boluntu lokunyuseka ngengqondo kuquka iindidi-miso zokongqishi, iimalizo, iinkqubo nemithetho ehlotshaniswa nokusingathwa kwabagulayo, amakhongothi ekhompyutha kumanqaku obuntshu. Ilayisensi yokushayiwa egunyazisiweyo.
xh.duties: Bonezela ulawulo olusebenzayo nengcebiso yengcali kwiindawo ezingcali zokunyuseka ngengqondo. Qamba ingxelo ethumelelwayo ecebileyo ebonakalisa ukuchuma naye naluphi na udliwano-ndlebe nabagulayo, nogqotha, nabanye babantu bengcali kwaye nabo bafundisi-mzobo kuquka nokuvela iingxelo ezinzima xa kufuneka. Ulawulo olusebenzayo, ukusetyenziswa nokuqwalasela kwazo zonke izixhobo. Bonakalisa ingxaki naye nayiphi na into ethintela abagulayo, ukhuthaza, ukumela nokuqinisekisa ukusingathwa okulungileyo nokhathalelo, uze uqinisekise ukuba i candelo liyayamkela iNqaela zamabala aBantu. Gcina ukhakululo ngokwenza ngokwenene isayensi yokongqisha kwaye ulawulo lwengcali lusebenze. Zonke iindidi-miso zokongqisha, yibonakalise ngokuziponela ukuzo zonke iingqayi zemithetho yokongqisha nengqayi yomthetho nelungelo. Qwalasela ulawulo ngokwemithetho neengxaki zomanyano ngendlela ethuliweyo. Bonezela ulawulo oluxhaso kwaye uhambe ngokwemigaqo yokuqwalasela i-PMS yebasebenzi, uqaqambise iinkqubo zokugqatywa kwaye ungene kwingxoxo yokugqatyo nokuphuhliswa kwabasebenzi naba fundi bokongqisha. Qwalasela ukubhaliswa kweNdlela yokulawula iingozi, qwalasela ukubhaliswa kweNCS nendlela yokuzinza iSibhedlele Esifanelweko uze uchaze impembelelo yayo ekuleka iinkonzo. Qwalasela kwaye ungene kwindlela yokulunga koluntu luphela ngokugqithisa kwakho ilwazi, uze uqwalasele ukuqonda ulwazi okanye uqwalaselo lweso sixhobo njengesixhobo sokuxhasa inkonzo yokubonakalisa ukusebenziseka kolwazi. Xhasa ulawulo lweNkonzo yokuQongqwa ngokusebenzela iweekhendi nobusuku xa kufunwa.

jobs.title: Operational Manager Specialty (TRAUMA)
jobs.centre: Joe Gqabi District, Taylor Bequest Hospital (Mt Fletcher)
jobs.summary: Operational manager for trauma specialty at Taylor Bequest Hospital in Mt Fletcher, requiring SANC registration as a professional nurse with a post-basic qualification and at least nine years of nursing experience.
jobs.requirements: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows Registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse. A post basic nursing qualification, with duration of at least one (1) year accredited with the SANC in the relevant specialty. Registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse. A minimum of 9 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 5 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/ recognisable experience in the specific specialty after obtaining the 1-year post-basic qualification in the relevant specialty. Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes and other relevant legal frameworks such as Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act Patient’s Rights Charter, Batho-Pele Principles. Sound knowledge and skills in implementing disciplinary code and procedure, grievance procedure Leadership, organizational, decision making and problem-solving abilities within the limit of the public sector and institutional policy framework. Good interpersonal skills including public relations, negotiating, conflict handling and counselling skills. Knowledge of financial and budgetary prescripts and processes pertaining to the relevant resources under management Insight into public health sector strategies and priorities including the nursing strategy, standards procedures and policies pertaining to nursing care, computer skills in basic programs. A valid driver’s licence.
jobs.duties: Provide effective management and professional leadership in the specialized units of Psychiatric. Demonstrate effective communication with patients, supervisors, other health professional and junior colleagues including more complex report writing when required Effective management, utilization and supervision of all resources Display a concern for patients, promoting, advocating and facilitating proper treatment and care and ensure that the unit adheres to the principles of Batho Pele Maintain clinical competence by ensuring that scientific principles of nursing and clinical governance are implemented. Implement maternal guidelines, demonstrate an in-depth understanding of nursing legislation and related legal and ethical nursing practice. Exercise control of discipline, grievance and any labour related issues in terms of laid down procedures. Provide supportive supervision and comply with PMDS evaluation of staff, formulate training programs and participate in training and development of staff and nursing students. Monitor implementation Disaster management, monitor implementation of NCS and Ideal Hospital Realization Framework and interpret its impact on service delivery thereof. Coordinate and participate in health promotion activities and monitor and evaluation of data Demonstrate basic computer literacy as a support tool to enhance service delivery. Support Nursing Services Management by working weekend and night duty when required.
jobs.enquiries: Ms N Ngwabeni Tel No: (039) 257 0099
jobs.applications: Alternatively, applications can be submitted electronically via email to: Joseph.Ndzinde@echealth.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly new Z83 Form (effective from 01 January 2021), a comprehensive CV, indicating three reference persons: Name and Contact Numbers, A relationship with reference. Applicants are only required to submit a Z83 form and a comprehensive CV. Therefore, only shortlisted candidates for a post will be required to submit certified documents (copies of Qualification(s) inclusive of Matric certificate, Identity document, Proof of registration, proof of citizenship if not RSA citizen) on or before the day of the interview following communication from HR. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants must note that further Personnel Suitability checks will be conducted on short-listed candidates and that their appointment is subject to the outcome of these checks which include security clearance, security vetting, qualification verification and criminal record checks. Reference checks will be done on nominated candidate(s). The department reserves the right to amend/ review/ withdraw the advertised posts if by so doing, the best interest of the department will be well served. (Females and People with Disabilities are also requested to apply and indicate such in their applications). Misrepresentation in the application documents will result in automatic disqualification and disciplinary action in the event the candidate has already been appointed. If you have not been contacted by the Department of Health within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. We thank all applicants for their interest. People with disabilities are encouraged to apply for these posts. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Operasionele Bestuurder Spesialiteit (TRAUMA)
af.summary: Operasionele bestuurder vir trauma-spesialiteit by Taylor Bequest Hospital in Mt Fletcher, wat SANC-registrasie as 'n professionele verpleegkundige met 'n ná-basiese kwalifikasie en ten minste nege jaar verpleegervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat Registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Ná-basiese verpleegkwalifikasie, met 'n duur van ten minste een (1) jaar geakkrediteer by die SANC in die tersaaklike spesialiteit. Registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. 'n Minimum van 9 jaar gepaste/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde ná registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ten minste 5 jaar van bogenoemde tydperk moet gepaste/erkenbare ervaring in die spesifieke spesialiteit wees ná verkryging van die 1-jarige ná-basiese kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike spesialiteit. Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures, verpleegstatute en ander tersaaklike regsraamwerke soos die Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act Patient's Rights Charter, Batho-Pele-beginsels. Deeglike kennis en vaardighede in die implementering van die dissiplinêre kode en prosedure, grievance procedure leierskap, organisatoriese, besluitnemings- en probleemoplossingsvermoëns binne die perke van die openbare sektor en institusionele beleidsraamwerk. Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede insluitend openbare betrekkinge, onderhandeling, konflikhantering en beradingsvaardighede. Kennis van finansiële en begrotingsvoorskrifte en -prosesse rakende die tersaaklike hulpbronne onder bestuur. Insig in openbare gesondheidssektorstrategieë en -prioriteite insluitend die verpleegstrategie, standaarde prosedures en beleide rakende verpleegsorg, rekenaarvaardighede in basiese programme. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Verskaf doeltreffende bestuur en professionele leierskap in die gespesialiseerde eenhede van Psigiatriese. Toon doeltreffende kommunikasie met pasiënte, toesighouers, ander gesondheidsprofessionele en junior kollegas, insluitend meer komplekse verslagskrywing wanneer vereis. Doeltreffende bestuur, benutting en toesig van alle hulpbronne. Toon besorgdheid vir pasiënte, bevorder, beywer en fasiliteer behoorlike behandeling en sorg, en verseker dat die eenheid voldoen aan die beginsels van Batho Pele. Handhaaf kliniese bevoegdheid deur te verseker dat wetenskaplike beginsels van verpleegkunde en kliniese bestuur geïmplementeer word. Implementeer moederlike riglyne, toon 'n diepgaande begrip van verpleegwetgewing en verwante wettige en etiese verpleegpraktyk. Oefen beheer uit oor dissipline, griewe en enige arbeidsverwante kwessies ooreenkomstig vasgestelde prosedures. Verskaf ondersteunende toesig en voldoen aan PMDS-evaluerings van personeel, formuleer opleidingsprogramme en neem deel aan opleiding en ontwikkeling van personeel en verpleegstudente. Monitor implementering van rampbestuur, monitor implementering van NCS en Ideal Hospital Realization Framework en interpreteer die impak daarvan op dienslewering. Koördineer en neem deel aan gesondheidsbevorderingsaktiwiteite en monitor en evaluering van data. Toon basiese rekenaarvaardigheid as 'n ondersteuningsinstrument om dienslewering te verbeter. Ondersteun Verpleegdiensbestuur deur naweek- en nagdiens te werk wanneer vereis.

zu.title: Umphathi Wemisebenzi Okhokhelwayo - Isikhundla Esikhethekile (TRAUMA)
zu.summary: Umphathi wemisebenzi okhokhelwayo wesikhundla esikhethekile se-trauma e-Taylor Bequest Hospital e-Mt Fletcher, ofuna ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomhlengikazi othunyelwe ngesikhundla esikhethekile kanye nesithakazelo esiyinga eliphezulu ubudala futhi abe nobudlule obungaphezulu kweyisikhombisa emsebenzini wezokuhlengwa.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esisisekelo i-R425 (okungukuthi idiploma/idigri ekunyusebenzi wokuhlengwa) noma isidingo esilinganayo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomhlengikazi othunyelwe. Isithakazelo sokuhlenga esiyinga eliphezulu, esithatha isikhathi esingaphezulu konyaka owodwa (1) esigunyaziwe yi-SANC esikhundleni esikhethekile. Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomhlengikazi othunyelwe. Ubude besikhathi esingaphezu kweminyaka engu-9 bomsebenzi ohambisanayo/ovunyelwe ekunyusebenzini wokuhlengwa emva kokubhaliswa njengomhlengikazi othunyelwe kwi-SANC Ekunyusebenzini Jikelele Lokuhlenga. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-5 yalowo masikhathi okushiwo ngenhla kumele ibe ngumsebenzi ohambisanayo/ovunyelwe esikhundleni esikhethekile ngemva kokuthola isithakazelo sokuhlenga esiyinga eliphezulu esithatha unyaka owodwa esikhundleni esikhethekile. Ulwazi ngemikhuba kanye nemigomo yokuhlenga, izimiso zokuhlengwa kanye nezinye izakhiwo zomthetho ezihambisanana njengakwi-Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Patient's Rights Charter, kanye nezinjongo ze-Batho-Pele. Ulwazi olunjalo namakhono ekusebenziseni ikhodi kanye nengqungquthela yesisulu, kanye nengqungquthela yezikhalazo, amakhono obuholi, ohlelweni, okwenza izinqumo kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo yomnyango womphakathi kanye nesakhiwo sezimali sezikhungo. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu ahlanganisa ubudlelwano nomphakathi, ukuxoxisana ngokwezimali, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga kanye namakhono okweluleka. Ulwazi ngemithetho yezimali kanye nokuqashwa kwebhajethi nezenzo ezihlobene nezinsiza ezikwengini ngaphansi kokuphathekile. Ukugqamisa izindlela kanye nezihloko eziphambili zomnyango wezesempilo womphakathi okuhlanganisa inqubo yokuhlenga, izinga lemikhuba kanye nemigobo ekunyusebenzini wokuhlengwa, amakhono okusebenzisa ikhompuyutha kumuhlela oyesisekelo. Ilayisense lokushayela elisebenzayo.
zu.duties: Nikela ngephethimba lokuphatha okusebenzayo nobuholi obungcalise kumayunithi akhethekile ayo yonke imikhakha ephathelene ne-psychiatric. Khombisa ukuxhumana okusebenzayo kubaphilwa, abaphathi, owozimele bezesempilo nakubasebenza ngesikhundla esingaphansi kwakho kufaka phakathi ukubhala imibiko eziyinkimbinkimbi lapho kudingeka khona Ukuphathwa, ukusetshenziswa kanye nokuhlola kwezinsiza zonke ngendlela ephumelelayo Khombisa inkathalo kubaphilwa, ukuthuthukisa, ukusekela kanye nokwenza kube lula ukwelashwa okuhle kanye nenkinga, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi iyunithi ilandela izimiso ze-Batho Pele. Gcina ubunjalo bokusebenza ngokugcina ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela zesayensi zokuhlenga kanye nobuphathi bezesempilo. Yakha imigobo yokunakekelwa kwabazali, khombisa ukuqonda okujulile komthetho wezokuhlenga kanye nokwenza umsebenzi wezokuhlenga ngokomthetho nokuziphatha. Lawula isisulu, izikhalazo kanye nanoma yikuphi okuhlobene nemisebenzi ngaphansi kwezinqumo ezibekiwe. Nikeza nokuqondisa ngokwesekela futhi ulandele ihlelo lokuhlola abasebenzi i-PMDS, wakhe amuhlela wokuqeqesha futhi uthathe inxaxheba ekuguqulweni nasekuthuthukiseni amakhono abasebenzi nakabafundi bezokuhlenga. Hlola ukusebenza imigomo yokuphatha izinsizi, hlola ukusebenza kwe-NCS kanye ne-Ideal Hospital Realization Framework uhumushe umthelela wayo ekulethweni kwezinsiza zomnyango. Hlanganise uthathe inxaxheba emisebenzini yokuthuthukisa izempilo futhi uhlole ulwazi. Khombisa ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha njengesinyathelo sokusekela ekwenzeni ukuba inhle ukulethwa kwezinsiza zomnyango. Sekela iNkokhelo Yezinsiza Zokuhlenga ngokusebenza ngevasikolo ngesikhathi sobusuku lapho kudingeka khona.

xh.title: Umphathi Wemisebenzi Ejongolene Nendlela (I-TRAUMA)
xh.summary: Umphathi wemisebenzi ejongolene nendlela kwisithili se-TRAUMA e-Taylor Bequest Hospital e-Mt Fletcher, kufuneka abhalise kwi-SANC njengomongikazi ongemvesi onesifundo esingaphaya kwesiseko anamava emisebenzi yongikazo ange minyaka le-9.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esisisiseko se-R425 (okt idiploma/idigri yongikazo) okt isifundo esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengoMongikazi Onemvesi. Isifundo sikaqeqheso emkhakheni wongikazo singangaphezu kwesiseko, esithatha inyanga enye (1) ubude bekhefu elivunyiwe yi-SANC kule mmandla. Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengoMongikazi Onemvesi. Amava amathambo angu-9 avunyele ekusebenziseni kwongikazo emva konyaka wokubhaliswa njengoMongikazi Onemvesi kwi-SANC emkhakheni wonke wongikazo. Iinyanga ezintlanu kule minyaka yamava ebalulwe ngasentla mazibe ngamava okusebenza kwelona mmandla lingange kwesifundo sakaqeqheso sangaphaya kwesiseko esithatha inyaka enye. Ukuqonda iindlela nemithetho yongikazo kunye nayo yamanye amawomiso efuneka kakhulu njengomthetho we-Bathing Act, i-Health Act, i-Occupational Health and Safety Act, iNqununu yamalungelo abaguli, iimpawu zikaBatho-Pele. Ukuqonda okululo kwaye unamava ekusebenziseni umthetho wolawulo neendlela zokuqhuba iingxaki, iindlela zokuthetha, ulawulo, ukuzimisela ukwenza izigqibo, nokuqonda ukusombulula iingxaki ngaphakathi komepho wolawulo lwabasebenzi bemithetho sesihelo kunye neme yolo lwazi wolwazi. Amava obudlelwane ngeenkqubo zokwamkela, ukuthengisa, ukuthetha, nokubonisana, nokunceda abantu abanengxaki. Ukuqonda imithetho yemali nemali kwaye ulawule iindlela ezimali neenkqubo ngeenkqubo zemali ngokwendalo yemimisela yendlawu ngenkqubo yekhompyutha. Ulwazi olusemthethweni lotyikityo lokuqonda isixhobo somatshini esingakumbi ekusebenziseni kwezempilo.
xh.duties: Yiba ngumongameli ongcono ekuthengisini nesikhokelo esibalulekileyo ekusebenziseni amasebe esiye amaxhoba ukubakwengqondo. Bonisa ubuchule bokunxibelelana nabo bakhethwe nabaqeqeshi ababukeneyo bengoce ekubeni ugqithise ekubhaleni iinkcukacha ngesixhobo esilula xa kufuneka. Lawula ngokuchanekileyo ulawulo lokusebenzisa nokulawula amaxhoba ekhuselo elingezantsi. Bonisa intshisekelo kwizidenge ngokukhuthaza, ngokumela kwaye ukwazi ukuthomalathisa ukungeniswa kokwelaphwa nokunakekelwa kwaye uqiniseke ukuba urhulumente ujwayele ukutshata izinto ngokwezinye iindlela ezintathu ezikwiziko. Zikhusele ekubeni nakho ekusebenziseni imigqabiso yokulawula iingxaki zokulawula imigqa engangenwa emthethweni ngokubakwayo ukuze kwakhiwe imithetho yongikazo nokwakha imiso engekho phezu kwemithetho yezizwe. Qhuba iingcango ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo zokuziqonda ezilula ezikwindawo yonke iinkqubo zokhuseleko abasebenzayo. Lawula isiphithiphithi, iingxaki ezikwindawo yonke yokusebenza nokunika inkxaso efunekayo kwabasebenzi abangaphantsi kwemiqathango. Khokelela ekuphandeni nasekuxhaseni ukuba abasebenzi bahlohle bayazi iinkqubo ngokukhankanywa kwemigaqo ngokuthengisa ekunxibelelaneni abantu kwaye ulawule ukwaliwa kolwazi nokwaliwa kwezo zilumkiso zokukhusela inkxaso ebalulekileyo.

Sound planning, organizing, administrative and problem-solving skills. Strong interpersonal skills. Customer focus and responsiveness. Be willing to work under pressure and extended hours.
jobs.duties: Ensure Administrative functions relevant to the core functions of the Component / Station / Unit. Ensure proper control over e-mails and files. In besit wees van Graad 12 / Senior Sertifikaat / NCV Vlak 4 of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 4 soos deur SAQA erken). Toon bevoegdheid om onafhanklik, professioneel, verantwoordelik en met geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Babe ngabakwaRiphabhuliki yaseNingizimu Afrika, okumele kubekhona ubufakazi bemibhalo obuzohlotshaniswa ngosuku lenhlangano yokuqeqesha. Babe nesoGrade 12 / Senior Certificate / NCV Level 4 noma izifundo ezilingana (NQF level 4 njengokuqashwa yiSAQA). Izifundo ezihlobene nendawo yesikhundla zizothathwa njengenzuzo eyongezelelwe. Amandla okuhlela, kokuhlela imisebenzi, kokuphatha nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amandla amakhulu okuxhumana nabantu. Ukugxila kumthengi nokuphendula. Ukuthanda ukusebenza ngaphansi kokucindezeleka nangemahora angenhla.

Babe ngummi weRiphabhlikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika apho ufakelo lwamaxwebhu kufuneka lubekwe ngosuku lokudibana nomntu. Babe nelungelo lebhedi 12 / Isatifikethi esiphakamileyo / NCV Level 4 okanye izifundo ezingundoqo ezingakwaziyo (NQF level 4 njengoko evunyelwe yiSAQA). Bonisa ukuziphatha okuzimeleyo, ngokugqibeleleyo, exeliswayo nokuzinzileyo. Amakhono amahle okuthetha nokubhala. Amakhono amaqondo okucinga, ukuqamba iplani, yolawulo nokuqamba iindlela zokuqonda iingxaki. Amakhono amaninzi okuziphatha. Ukuqonda abathengi nokuphendula ngokukhawuleza. Qinisekisa ukugcina amaxwebhu ngokuchanekileyo eQeleni. Ukwenza iMofolo zamaminithi kwintlanganiso. Yenza uluhlu lwemidatsha kwaye ulibekele imisebenzi ehambisana nayo endawo engundoqo yesebe.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Inligtingkommunikasietegnologie

Alle geldige relevante bestuurslisensies (A en EC). Geen strafrekord of hangende saak teen u nie. Kennis en vaardighede: Bedryfstelsels en bedieneradministrasie. Virtualisasie-oplossings. SAN-administrasie. Wolkgebaseerde dienste. Netwerkombewing - LAN/WAN, netwerktering/foutopsporing en ervaring in Cisco-roeteur/skakelaarkonfigurasie. Telekommunikasiestelsels - Kennis van PABX en telekommunikasiestelsels (TMS, VolP). Kennis van IKR-sekuriteitstegnologieë. IKR-regulasies en standaarde (CoblT, ITIL, ISO ens. Besigheidsontleding. Hou toesig op die bestuur en beskerming van die data om nalewing van standaarde en bedryfsprosedures vir datatoegang en die bewaring van data en berging te verseker. Bestuur die instandhouding en ondersteuning van alle rekenaareindgebruikertoestelle en gerekenariseerde stelsels, inligtingverwerkings toerusting en sagteware. zu.title: Omqondisi Ophethe: Inqubo yokwaziswa nokuThumela okwazisiwe
zu.summary: Indima kaMqondisi Ophethe okuqapha insimbi yethulwa kwe-ICT, izimiso zokuxhumana, kanye nolawulo lwedatha ehhovisi elikhulu le-Department of Community Safety eJohannesburg.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi seMatric kahle nesi-National Diploma seminyaka emi-3 (NQF level 6)/I-Degree (NQF level 7) ku-ICT (Computer Science noma Informatics). Noma iyiphi isitifiketi esihambisanayo se-ICT Infrastructure singeyenza inzuzo. Eminyakeni engu-3 yokuhlangabezana kwesipiliyoni ezingeni lokungena kolawulo (ASD) okuhambisana ngokuqondile nemisebenzi nezibopho ezibaluliwe. Zonke izilayisense zokushayela ezisesikhathini esihambisanayo (A kanye ne-EC). Akukho bungozi obuyidlwengule noma icala eliqhubekayo eliphambene nawe. Ulwazi namakhono: Izimiso zokusebenza nolawulo lomkhiqizo. Ukwazi ukusebenza nendawo yomkhiqizo ye-Microsoft kanye nezimiso zokusebenza ze-Windows. (AD kanye ne-MS Exchange Server). Amaphakheji we-Microsoft Office. Ulawulo lwamalayisense ohlelo lokusebenza. Inqubo yobuchwepheshe be-DBMS. Izixazululi zokuzigeza. Ulawulo lwe-SAN. Izinsizakalo ezinikwa isikhungo se-Cloud. Indawo yokuxhumana - LAN/WAN, ukuxhumaniselana nokuLungisa izinkinga nokuba nesipiliyoni ekulungenisweni kwe-Cisco routers/switch. Izimiso zokuxhumana - Ulwazi nge-PABX nezimiso zokuxhumana (TMS, VolP). Ulwazi lobuchwepheshe boKuphepha kwe-ICT. Imithetho nemigomo ye-ICT (CoblT, ITIL, ISO njll. Ukuhlaziya ibhizinisi. Izobuchwepheshe zokuthuthuka okususelwa ekuqalisweni. Izobuchwepheshe ze-DBMS. Amakhono olawulo lomqondo. Ulwazi nokuphepha kwedatha. Ukulinganisela ubungozi nokunciphisa. Izobuchwepheshe zokusubuyisa ngemuva kwezinsizi. Ukuxhumanisa kanye nokuxhumana. UkuPhepha. Ukuthembeka kobuchwepheshe nolawulo loKuphepha kwe-Cyber.
zu.duties: Ukuthuthukisa, ukusebenzisa, kanye nokulondeka kweNdlela ye-ICT Infrastructure. Ukunikeza nokuGcina izimiso zokuxhumana kanye nensimbi yoxhumano. Ukuqapha ulawulo nokuvikelwa kwedatha kuqinisekiswa ukuthobela imigomo nendlela yokusebenza ekufinyeleleni kwedatha nokuGcinwa kwedatha nendlalelo. Ukuphathwa kokugcinwa nokusekelwa kwazo zonke izinsimbi zomsebenzisi ogcina esikhathini futhi ezinhlelweni ezingamakhompyutha, amathuluzi okucubungula ulwazi, kanye nohlelo. Ukumisa isiqondiso bese eqapha imiqondo yensimbi ye-ICT futhi asekusebenzise izindlela zemiqondo ye-ICT. Ukusiza ekutholeni insimbi ye-ICT nohlelo ngokuthuthukisa imibhalo futhi nikelazeluleko ezobuchwepheshe ezintsha ezitholwe. Uxulumene nokukholeka, ukwesaba, nokuhlakanipha abasebenzi ukuthuthukisa ukwenza. Ukuqapha ukwenza kwabasebenzi futhi uqinisekise ukuhlolwa kwabo. Nikela ngemibono ekuhalaleni kabhalwa isabelo kwesiCandu. Lawula futhi uqaphe isabelo nezinkomba zokuchitha kwesigaba. Hlanganisa ukwakheka kwezibalo eziningana nemininingwane yesigaba. Lawula ukukhishwa kwabasebenzi nokuQondene.

xh.title: iPhini leDirektha: Ikhompyutha yoXinzelelo lolonwabo lwamaniane
xh.summary: Indima yePhini leDirekhta elilawula iziseko zomsebenzi ze-ICT, iinkqubo zokunxibelelanisa, nolawulo lwedata ehofisini elikhulu lesebe loKhuseleko lomPhakathi eJohannesburg.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samatric kunye neDiploma yesiZwe yeminyaka emi-3 (NQF level 6)/IDigri (NQF level 7) kwi-ICT (iKhompyutha Sayensi okanye i-Informatics). Nayo iphi na isatifikethi esinomdla esiphathelene neziseko zomsebenzi ze-ICT sibangumngcata. Iiminyaka eyi-3 yamava emqondeni wokuqala wolawulo (ASD) emava ahambelana ngqo nemisebenzi naxanduva eloquiweyo. Amalayisenisi onyawo onke asebenzayo ahambelanayo (A kunye ne-EC). Akukho bungeno bugutyungelwayo okanye icala livaliweyo ngasuka kuwe. Ulwazi namakhono: Iinkqubo zokusebenza nolawulo leseva. Ulwazi olusebenzayo lwemfanekiso weseva yeMicrosoft ngenkqubo zokusebenza zeWindows. (I-AD ne-MS Exchange Server). Amaphakheji eMicrosoft Office. Ulawulo lwamalayisenisi ohlelo. Iteknoloji ye-DBMS. Iindlela ezingathandabuzekiyo eziziswe ngokubakho. Ulawulo lwe-SAN. Iinkonzo ezibekwe kwi-cloud. Imo yenethiwekhi - i-LAN/WAN, inethiwekhi/iNkxaso-mbuso namava ekumisweni kwe-routers/switch ze-Cisco. Iinkqubo zokunxibelelanisa - Ulwazi nge-PABX nolonxibelelwano lweenkqubo (i-TMS, i-VoIP). Ulwazi ngeteknoloji yoKhuseleko lwe-ICT. Iimigaqo namazinga e-ICT (i-CobiT, i-ITIL, i-ISO njl. Uhlalutyo lweShishino. Iiteknoloji ezitsha zophuhliso. Iiteknoloji ze-DBMS. Amandla olawulo lomsebenzi wakho. Ulwazi lolwazi nokuqinisekiswa kwedata. Ukulinganisa nokuthomalobisa ingozi. Iiteknoloji zokusinda ekubuyiselweni kwento etyheliweyo. Inethiwekhi nolonxibelelwano. Ukhuseleko. Isigqibo seteknoloji nolawulo lokhuseleko lwe-cyber.
xh.duties: Uphuhliso, ukuphumeza, nokuqwalasela iSicimiso seziseko zomsebenzi ze-ICT. Ukunikela nokuqinisekisa iinkqubo zokunxibelelanisa nemicimbo yenethiwekhi yeziseko zomsebenzi. Ukuqwalasela ulawulo nolawulo lwedata kuqinisekisa ukuhambelana namazinga nendlela yokusebenza ekufikeleleni kwedata nolondolozo lwedata nendawo yokugcina. Ukulawula ukuqinisekisa kunye noncedo kuzo zonke izixhobo zomgca woqobo lomsebenzisi kunye nendlela yekhompyutha, izixhobo zokusingathwa kolwazi, kunye nohlelo. Ukumisela icandelo nokuqwalasela imisebenzi yeziseko zomsebenzi ze-ICT nokuphumeza iindlela zemisebenzi ye-ICT. Ukuncedisa ekuthengeni izixhobo ze-ICT nohlelo ngokuphuhlisa iingqikhumba nokuvela ingcebiso ngeteknoloji ezitsha ezithengiweyo. Uxanduva lokuxhobisa, ukulunga, nokukhokela abasebenzi ukuze kuphuculwe ukusebenza. Ukuqwalasela ukusebenza kwabasebenzi kuqinisekisa ukuqwalasela ukusebenza kwabo. Uncedo ekudalweni kwesabelo-mali kwicandelo. Ukulawula nokuqwalasela isabelo-mali kunye nemali echithiweyo kwicandelo elitshantsana. Ukuqhelanisa ukuqulunqa iingxelo ezahlukeneyo nabisilinganiso kwicandelo. Ulawulo lokuqhumsha kwaye abangenaphantsi.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Social Crime Prevention

Monitoring and evaluation skills. Report writing skills. Public speaking. Presentation skills. Public relations. Event management skills.

zu.summary: Onozimele ophatha inqubo yokuhlanganisa iziphumo zemali kuhlanganisa izohlizo zezokuthutha namaphawundi ezimoto ehhovisi elikhulu le-Department of Community Safety e-Johannesburg.

Qaphela futhi qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwenqubo eqinisekile nefanele yabashwalensi/abathola imali: qaphela futhi gcina inqubo efanele evezwe abashwalensi. Ukubikwa kwamasipho ngenyanga/zinyanga ezintathu/ngonyaka: Fake izimali ezitholakalayo esitatimendeni sezimali ngakho eziphumo zezimali kanye noma izikweletu. Imali nemali efanayo. Phatha ukukhulekela ukusebenza kahle futhi ulandele nokufundisa abantu ukuze bakwazi ukusebenza kahle. Phatha amaholide abantu abangaphansi.

Ukulawula iinymanga zangaphantsi kwakhe.

Manage assets as per inventories of station/centre.

Beplanning, Organisering, Beheer, Monitering, Personeelbestuur, Dienslewering, kommunikasievaardighede, besluitnemingsvaardighede, Resultate- en gehaltebestuur, Probleemoplossing, Innovasie/voortdurende verbetering, Analities, Onderhandeling, Inisiatief, Rekenaarvaardigheid, Projektbestuur, Mentoring en afrigting, Leierskapsvaardighede.
af.duties: Bestuur die implementering van die operasionele wetstoepassingsplan: Voltooi en werk omgewingsanalise by om te verseker dat dit as basislyn vir beplanning gebruik word. Ontwikkel operasionele plan vir stasie/sentrum gebaseer op provinsiale jaarlikse prestasieplan en verseker suksesvolle implementering. Beplan en monitor die uitvoering van projekte wat verband hou met die implementering van die Strategie/plan. Maandelikse monitering van die jaarlikse prestasieplan-teikens. Kommunikeer gereeld met stasie/sentrum-bestuur en fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van en deelname aan 'n sentrum strategiese/operasionele plan. Neem deel aan geïntegreerde vennootskappe met plaaslike owerhede. Verseker doeltreffende en effektiewe Leierskap: Koördineer belanghebbendeverhoudings met ander staatsdepartemente en Regstoepassingsagentskappe (LEAs). Bestuur van diensleweringverbetering: Bestuur administratiewe stelsels. Implementeer administratiewe prosesse om te verseker dat registers weekliks geïnspekteer word. Verseker dat statistiek wat gehou word korrek, huidig en teen sperdaties aangestuur en gemonitor en by sentrums beskikbaar gestel word. Bestuur en verseker doeltreffende eksterne gemeenskapskommunikasie en skakel met plaaslike Gemeenskappolisieforums. Verseker dat Toetsentrumstasies (TCS) optimaal funksioneer. Verseker dat voorgeskrewe Wette, Beleide en Prosedures van die Departement geïmplementeer en nagekom word. Verseker dat alle tersaaklike rekords en registers daarvan behoorlik geargiveer en te alle tye op datum gehou word. Bestuur van Menslike Hulpbronne: Bestuur griewe volgens voorgeskrewe prosedures. Fasiliteer ten minste een spanbou-aktiwiteit per kwartaal vir die sentrum. Verseker dat verlof benut en bestuur word volgens die tersaaklike beleide en instruksies. Ontwikkel en implementeer in-diens opleidingsprogram en monitor formele opleidingsbehoeftes van die eenheid. Bestuur prestasie van personeel. Finansiële Bestuur. Monitor maandelikse uitgawes en inspeksieverslae van die provinsie en implementeer korrektiewe maatreëls in probleemareas. Gereelde begrotingsbeheer en bestuursbesprekings as deel van bestuursvergaderings. Dokumenteer oortydbeplanning gebaseer op prioriteite. Neem deel aan begrotingsbeplanning soos deur die Provinsie vereis. Reageer op versoeke van hoofkantoor rakende uitstaande finansiële navrae binne verskafde tydslimit. Verseker doeltreffende en effektiewe Batebestuur: Monitor voertuigkoste vir stasie/sentrum-voertuie (soos per werkblad) en identifiseer en monitor lede betrokke by ongelukke en verseker dat motorvoertuigvloot behoorlik bestuur word en dat voertuie in goeie looporde is. Verseker dat doeltreffende verliesbeheermaatreëls in plek is om verlies van vuurwapens en ander verwante toerusting aan te spreek, d.w.s. die tersaaklike toerusting wat verlore raak en sit maatreëls in plek om dit te hanteer. Bestuur bates volgens inventarisse van stasie/sentrum.

zu.title: Umhloli Oholiyo Wezifundazwe
zu.summary: Umhloli Oholiyo Wezifundazwe obuka izimiso zokuphoqa umthetho wokuhamba kwezokuthutha endleleni enkulu yakwaGauteng Northern Corridor, ofuna isipiliyoni esikhulu sokubusa nemvume ezinhlelweni ezihlobene nezokuphathwa kwezokuthutha.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezihlobene ezingangenyuvesi (I-diploma/Isiqu yeminyaka engu-3 noma okulinganayo). Isipiliyoni sokububa iminyaka engu-3-5. Isipiliyoni sokusebenza seminyaka engu-7-10 enkundleni yokuphoqa umthetho wokuhamba kwezokuthutha. Amalayisensi wokushayela ahambisana nanoma iliphi elisebenzayo (A kanye ne-EC). Kungabi nerekodi yobugebengu. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi namakhono. Ulwazi olubanzi ngemigomo nemithetho yokuphathwa kwezokuthutha, umthetho ohambisana nemitheth yokuphathwa kwezokuthutha. Amakhono okushayela, ukuhlola/ukubamba izimoto. Ukuphathwa kwezinkambiso. Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza. Ukuphathwa kwezindaba zabathengi. Ukulungisa, ukuhlela, ukulawula, ukubuka, ukuphatha abantu, ukulethwa kwenkonzo, amakhono okuxhumana, amakhono okwenza izinqumo, ukuphathwa kweziphumo nobungcono, ukuxazula izinkinga, ukweza/ukuthuthuka okuhambisana nesikhathi, ukuhlaziya, ukuxoxisana, ukuthatha isinyathelo, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuphatha amaphrojekthi, ukwelisa nokholotha, amakhono okubusa.
zu.duties: Phatha ukusetshenziswa kohlelo lokusebenza lokuphoqa umthetho: Qedelela futhi uvuselele ukuhlaziywa kwendawo ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi kusetshenziswa njengesisekelo sokuhlela. Hlola uhlelo lokusebenza lwesiteshi/isikhungo ngokusekelwe ohlelweni lwenyanga lonke lokusebenza sezifundazwe futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa okuphumelelayo. Hlela futhi ubuke ukusetshenziswa kwamaphrojekthi ahlobene nokusetshenziswa kweNdlela/uhlelo. Ukubuka nyanga zonke imigomo yohlelo lwenyanga lonke lokusebenza. Xhumana njalo ngabaphathi besiteshi/isikhungo futhi ukhuthaze ukuthuthukiswa nokuthonywa ohlelweni lwendlela/ukusebenza kwesikhungo. Thatha inxaxheba kubuhlobo obuhlangene namagunya endlu. Qinisekisa ukubusa okuphumelelayo nokuqinisekile: Hlelahlela izindaba zabanomzabalazo namanye amnyango wesizwe kanye nezikhulu zokuphoqa Umthetho (LEAs). Ukuphathwa kokuthuthukiswa kwezinkonzo: Phatha amasistimu okuphatha. Setsha izinqubo zokuphatha ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi izinkambiso zihlolwa njalo ngeviki. Qiniseka ukuthi izibalo ezigcinwa zilungile, zimanje futhi zithunyelwe ngosuku oluhleliwe futhi zibukwe futhi zitholakale emaBentolo. Phatha futhi uqinisekise ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo nomphakathi bangaphandle futhi uxhume namaForamu Womphakathi Wamaphoyisa endawo. Qiniseka ukuthi Amasteshi Okuhlola (TCS) aqonda kahle. Qiniseka ukuthi uMthetho, imigono kanye nezinqubo ezibekiwe zomnyango zisetshenziswa futhi zilandelwa. Qiniseka ukuthi yonke izinkambiso ezihlobene nazo kanye nezinkambiso zazo zibekwe kahle futhi zihlale zimanje. Ukuphathwa kwabasebenzi: Phatha izikhalazo ngokuya ngezinqubo ezibekiwe. Khuthaza okungenani umsebenzi owodwa wokwakha iqembu ngenkwamuzi ngayinye ngasesikhungweni. Qiniseka ukuthi iholo/ukuphumula kusetshenziswa futhi kuphathwe ngokwegayo nemigomo kanye nemiyalo ehlobene nalokho. Hlola futhi usebenzise uhlelo lokuzinzisa ekusebenzeni futhi ubuke izidingo ezisemthethweni zokuhlolwa komanyenya wesikhungo. Phatha ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Ukuphathwa Kwezimali. Buka imali yokuchithwa nyanga zonke kanye namarekhodi wokuqasha ezifundazweni futhi usebenzise izinyathelo zokulungisa ezindaweni ezinobudingo. Izingxoxo ezijwayelekile zokulawula nesiphatho samabhajethi njengengxenye yemihlangano yokuphatha. Qamba amafayi ohlelo lwe-overtime ngokuya ngabaphambili. Thatha inxaxheba ekwakheni uhlelo lwebhajethi njengoba kudingwa yisifundazwe. Phendla izicelo eziqhamuka ehhovisi eliyisiqu mayelana nemibuzo yezimali ezingase igqityiwe phakathi kwesikhathi esinikiwe. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okuphumelelayo nokuqinisekile kwempahla: Buka izindleko lwezimoto zesesiteshi/isikhungo (njengoba kuboniswe kwiwokhishi) futhi uchaze futhi ubuke amalungu abekethe iziphothongo futhi uqiniseke ukuthi imizilo yezimoto iphathwe kahle futhi ukuthi izimoto zisezimweni esihle sokugijima. Qinisekisa ukuthi kunezinyathelo eziphumelelayo zokulawula ukulahleka kwamasotsha kanye nezinye izinsiza ezihlobene nalokho okungakhona izinsiza ezahamba ezilahlekile bese kubekwa izinyathelo zokuphathwa. Phatha impahla njengoba kuboniswe izinkambiso zesesiteshi/isikhungo.

xh.title: ISiphithiphithi Esihloko SePhondo
xh.summary: ISiphithiphithi Esihloko SePhondo elibukele imisebenzi yokuphunyezwa komthetho wezothutho kwikoridorni yeNyakatho yeGauteng, kufuneka nabakhangelele abanamava aphakamileyo abanemfuneko yamava amanqanaba apha kweyure kwaye banemfuneko yeziqu ezifanelekileyo zolawulo lothutho.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekileko zeTertiary (iDiploma/iNqanaba leminyaka ezi-3 okanye okulinganayo). Amava aphakamileyo ubuncinane iiminyaka eziyi-3-5. Iiminyaka ezingama-7-10 yamava ukusebenza kwinkundla yophunyiso lomthetho wezothutho. Amanye amalayisenisi okushayela abasebenzayo (A nese-EC). Akukho ntlolongo kumaka wobugebengu. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi namakhono. Ulwazi olubanzi ngoMgaqo-nkqubo namagunya woLawulo loThutho, umthetho ohlobene namagunya wolawulo lothutho. Amakhono okushayela, ukuhlola/ukubamba izithuthi. Ulawulo lwemibhalo, Ulawulo lwamakhaya ezixhobo, Ulawulo lobudlelwane nabathengi. Ukuqamba, ukuhlela, ukulawula, ukubuka, ukuLawula abantu, ukunikezela inkonzo, amakhono okunxibelelwana, amakhono okwenza izigqibo, uLawulo lweziphumo nobungakanani bokuhamba, ukusombulula iingxaki, iNnovation/ukuphucula ngokuhamba kwexesha, ukuhlola, ukuxoxa, ukuthatha inyathelo, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, uLawulo lomthamo, ukuyala nokuhlomisa, amakhono okubhungisa.
xh.duties: Lawula ukuphunyezwa kohlelo lomthetho wokusebenza: Qedeza uhlalutyo lolwaze bese uhlaziya ukuqinisekisa ukuba lusetyenziswa njengesiseko sekuqamba kohlelo. Phepha uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-station/isiko ngokusekelwe ohlelweni lwamaphondo lwamavaonyaka kwaye uqinisekise ukuba luphunyiswa ngempumelelo. Hlela kwaye ubuke imisebenzi yokwenza ngokusetyenziswa kweStrastra/ohlelo. Ukubuka nyanya ukuphunyiswa kwamagunya ohlelo lwenkonzo yonyaka. Xoxa ngokuhamba kwexesha noLawulo we-station/isiko kwaye uthintele ukuqamba nokuthatha inxaxheba kwisiko ohlelweni/i-strateji/okusebenzayo. Thatha inxaxheba kubudlelwano obuhlangene nobalulekileyo namagunya abahlali. Qinisekisa inkokheli ePhilileyo nesebenzayo: Yiba nabudlelwano namagunya amnye nezinye iinkalo zaburhulumente namaLawu azele omthetho (i-LEAs). Ulawulo lophuculo lwenkonzo: Lawula iinkqubo zolawulo. Phumeza iinkqubo zolawulo ukuqinisekisa ukuba amagama ahlolwa masonto. Qinisekisa ukuba izibalo ezigcinwe zifanelekile, zikwijyaza yangoku kwaye zithunyelwe ngemini eqeqeshiweyo kwaye zibuke kwaye zitholakale kwiZiko. Lawula kwaye uqinisekise ukusetyenziswa kolwimi olusebenzayo komgaqo woluntu kwaye unxibelelane namaziko obuntshatsheli ohlangeneyo ezindaweni zamaphondo. Qinisekisa ukuba I-station yoVavanyo (i-TCS) isebenza ngokuphumelelayo. Qinisekisa ukuba amaMthetho, umGaqo-nkqubo, namaQhinga abekezelwe ngasebe ayaphunyiswa kwaye alandelwa. Qinisekisa ukuba yonke imibhalo edibene noko igcinwe kakuhle kwaye ihlaziwe ngamaxesha onke. Ulawulo lwezeemisebenzi zabantu: Lawula iingxaki ngokomthetho obekiweyo. Thintela ubuncinane enye imisebenzi yokwakha iqela kwithuba ngalinye lonyaka kwiZiko. Qinisekisa ukuba amalungelo asebenziswa kwaye alawulwa ngokwemigaqo-nkqubo nemiyalelo ebalulekileyo. Yila kwaye uphumeze inkqubo yokolunye ulwazi kwaye ubuke iimfuno ezisemqoka zokuqeqesha esemthethweni kwindima. Lawula ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Ulawulo lweemali. Buka iindleko nyanya ezizezimali namaxwebhu okuhlola evela kwiphondo kwaye uphumeze izinyathelo ezilungisayo kwindawo enengxaki. Iingxoxo ezizezimali ngokulawula nokuqaphela amalungu entlanganisini yamagunya emthethweni. Qamba amaxwebhu ngokusukela kumagunya abalulekileyo. Thatha inxaxheba ekuyileni umthamo njengoko kufunwa ngeliPhondo. Phendula izicelo ezivela kwindlu enkulu mayela neembuzo ezizezimali ezingazisombululiyo ngexesha elinikiweyo. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo noluphumeleyo lwamakhaya ezixhobo: Buka iindleko zesithuthi se-station/isiko (njengakumanqaku omsebenzi) kwaye uchaze kwaye ubuke amalungu athatha inxaxheba kumatyala kwaye uqinisekise ukuba amakhaya ezithuthi alawulwa ngokufanelekileyo kwaye izithuthi zikwindalo elungileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba kusetyenziswa iindlela ezizezimali zokulawula ukulahleko ngokuphumelelayo ukuze kusombululwe ukulahleka kwamasela nezinye izixhobo ezidibene noko, oko kukuthi izixhobo ezibalulekileyo ezilahlekayo kwaye kubekwe iindlela ezizezimali ezizezimali ukuze kugqitywe ngazo. Lawula amakhaya ezixhobo njengakumanqaku okuqamba e-station/isikweni.

jobs.title: Chief Provincial Inspector
jobs.salary_text: R605 742 per annum, plus service benefits
jobs.summary: Chief Provincial Inspector in Heidelberg responsible for managing traffic law enforcement operations, requiring a tertiary qualification and extensive traffic enforcement experience.
jobs.requirements: Relevant Tertiary qualification (3-year Diploma/Degree or equivalent)3-5 years’ supervisory experience. 7-10 years working experience in the traffic law enforcement field. All valid relevant Driving Licenses (A and EC). No criminal record. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge and skills. Extensive knowledge of Traffic Management policies and regulations, Relevant legislations and traffic management regulations Driving skills, Vehicle inspections/impoundment. Records management Resource management Customer relationship management. Planning, Organising, Controlling, Monitoring, People Management, Service delivery, communication skills, decision making skills, Results and quality management, Problem solving, Innovation/ continuous improvement, Analytical, Negotiation, Initiative, Computer literacy, Project management, Mentor and coaching, Leadership skills.
jobs.duties: Manage the implementation of operational law enforcement plan: Complete and update environmental analysis to ensure that it is used as a base line for planning. Develop operational plan for station/centre based on provincial annual performance plan and ensure successful implementation. Plan and monitor the execution of projects relating to the implementation of the Strategy/plan. Monthly monitoring of the annual performance plan targets. Communicate regularly with station/centre management and facilitate the development of and participation in a centre strategic / operational plan. Participate in integrated partnerships with local authorities. Ensure effective and efficient Leadership: Co-ordinate stakeholder relations with other state departments and Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs). Management of service delivery improvement: Manage administration systems. Implement administrative processes to ensure registers are inspected weekly. Ensure that statistics kept are correct, current and forwarded by due dates and monitored and made available at centres. Manage and ensure effective external community communication and liaise with local Community Police Forums. Ensure that Testing Centre Stations (TCS) are operating optimally. Ensure that prescribed Acts, Policies and Procedures of the Department are implemented and adhered to. Ensure that all the relevant records and registers thereof are filed properly and always kept up to date. Management of Human Resources: Manage grievances according to prescribed procedures. Facilitate at least one team building activity per quarter for the centre. Ensure that leave is utilized and managed according to the relevant policies and instructions. Develop and implement in-service training program and monitor formal training needs of the unit. Manage performance of staff. Financial Management. Monitor monthly expenditure and inspection reports from the province and implement corrective action in problem areas. Regular budget control and management discussions as part of management meetings. Document overtime planning based on priorities. Participate in budget planning as required by the province. Respond to requests from head office regarding outstanding financial queries within provided time limit. Ensure effective and efficient Asset Management: Monitor vehicle costs for station/centre vehicles (as per worksheet) and identify and monitor members involved in accidents and ensure that motor vehicle fleet is managed properly and that vehicles are in good running order. Ensure effective loss control measures are in place to address loss of firearms and other related equipment i.e. the relevant equipment that get lost and put measures in place to deal with it. Manage assets as per inventories of station/centre.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. Tshidiso Chabane/ Ms. Dolly Seboane/ Tlalane Koenane Tel No: (011) 689 3845/ 3723/ 3847
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on new Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za/documents (effective from 01 January 2021). All fields in Part A to D of the Z83 form must be completed, and Part E to G noting that there is limited space provided applicants often indicate “refer” to CV or see attached, this is acceptable as long as the CV is attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. The question related to the conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered. Declaration must be completed and signed. The fully completed and signed new Z83 form should be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV only (only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications). Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applicants who do not comply with the above requirements, as well as late applications, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Suitable candidates will undergo a personnel suitability check (Vetting, criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification, and employment verification). The Department of Community Safety reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes. Candidate will be placed according to corridor coordination and the Department’s needs. The Department will not accept posted, emailed or hand delivered applications. We encourage youth, people with disability, coloured, Indian and white to apply and a confirmation of disabilities from a registered medical practitioner must be attached to the application. Please Note: Due to the large number of applications, we envisage to receive, applications will not be acknowledged. If you do not receive any response within 3 months, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. OTHER POSTS
