zu.title: Umhloli Wezifunda Oyinhloko
zu.summary: Umhloli Wezifunda Oyinhloko eHeidelberg obhekene nokuphatha imisebenzi yokuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwemithetho yezithuthi, ofuna iziqu ezingaphezulu neminye eminingi yohlelo lokuqinisekisa imithetho yezithuthi.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ezingaphezulu (3-year Diploma/Degree noma okulinganayo).3-5 iminyaka yohlelo lokuhlola. 7-10 iminyaka yohlelo lokusebenza enkundleni yokuqinisekisa imithetho yezithuthi. Amalayisensi wokushayela ahambisana nawo wonke (A kanye ne-EC). Akukho ngebhala lwenhlolandlebe. Ulwazi nezakhono: Ulwazi nezakhono. Ulwazi oluningi ngemithetho yokuphatha izithuthi kanye nemithetho, imithetho ehambisana kanye nemithetho yokuphatha izithuthi. Izakhono zokushayela, Ukuhlola/ukubamba izithuthi. Ukuphatha irekhodi. Ukuphatha abantu. Ukuphatha ubudlelwano nabathengi. Ukucubungula, ukuhlelwa, ukulawula, ukugcina isikhathi, ukuphatha abantu, ukulethwa kwezinsizakalo, izakhono zokuxhumana, izakhono zokuthatha izinqumo, ukuphatha imiphumela nenhla, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukusungula/ukuthuthuka ngokungalokothi, ukuhlaziya, ukuxhumana, ukuziqhuba, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuphatha amaphrojekthi, ukuba ngumsizi nomfundisi, izakhono zokuba ngumholi.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuphunyulwa kwephulani yokusebenza ngemithetho: Qedelela futhi uvuselele ukuhlolwa kwezemvelo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kusetshenziswa njengesisisekelo sokuhlela. Hlola iphulani yokusebenza yesiteshi/isikhungo ngokusekelwe kwi Provincial Annual Performance Plan futhi uqinisekise ukuphunyulwa okuphumelelayo. Hlela futhi ulawule ukuphunyulwa kwamaphrojekthi ahlobene nokuphunyulwa kweStrathiji/iphulani. Ukugcina isikhathi ngamnye izinhloso ze Provincial Annual Performance Plan. Xhumana njalo nomphathi wesiteshi/isikhungo futhi wenze ukuthuthukiswa kwayo kanye nokujoyina iphulani yokusebenza yesikhungo. Thatha inxaxheba kubuhlobo obuhlangene namahulumeni bendawo. Qinisekisa ukuba ngumholi ophumelelayo futhi osebenza kahle: Hlelisa ubuhlelwano nabahlangeneyo namanye amasebe karhulumwe namahlelo okuqinisekisa umthetho (LEAs). Ukuphatha ukuthuthukiswa kokulethwa kwezinsizakalo: Phatha izinhlelo zokuphatha. Phuma izinqubo zokuphatha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amarekhodi ahlolwa nsontzane. Qinisekisa ukuthi izibalo ezigcinwe zilungile, zimanje futhi zithunyelwe ngezinsuku ezibalulekile kanti futhi zibhekwe futhi zitholakala emasikhungweni. Phatha futhi uqinisekise ukuxhumana nomphakathi bangaphandle ngokusebenza kahle futhi xhumana namahlelo okuphatha abomphakathi endawo. Qinisekisa ukuthi iziteshi zokuhlola (TCS) zisebenza ngokugcwele. Qinisekisa ukuthi amabhizinisi, izinhlelo kanye nenqubo ye Department zisetshenziswa futhi zihlonishwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imibhalo nehlelo libhalwe kahle futhi lihlale litshajwe. Ukuphatha abantu: Phatha izikhalazo ngokuvumelana nenqubo. Hlela okungenani umsebenzi owodwa wokwakha iqembu njalo ngenkathi yesikhathi esinye kulesikhungo. Qinisekisa ukuthi iholo lisetshenziswa futhi lilawulwa ngokuhambisana nezinhlelo kanye nemiyalo ephilayo. Hlela futhi uphume izinhlelo zokuqeqesha abasebenzi bese ukwazi izidingo zokuqeqesha kwemikhakha. Phatha ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Ukuphatha imali. Hlola imali ejiywe nsontzane kanye namabhizinisi ohlelo esifundeni bese ukhuluma ngazo kubungako bakho kumabanga anzima. Xoxa ngokuqinisekiswa kwebhajethi njalo njengengxenye yohlelo lokuqinisekisa imiphumela. Bhala ukuphatha iholo lehhovisi eliqinisekisa imisebenzi ebanzi. Thatha inxaxheba ukwenza ibhajethi njengoba kudingwa esifundeni. Phendula izicelo eziyavela ehhovisi elikhulu ngezinkinga zemali ezingaqediwe ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esinikeziwe. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwempahla: Hlola izindleko zamathilidi ejiywe esiteshini/isikhungweni bese ubona futhi uhlola ukuthi ngabe abaholi banomthelela kuzo yini futhi qinisekisa ukuthi iqembu lemithuthukisi yezithuthi liphathwe kahle. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinkambiso zokulawula ukulahlekelwa zisebenza ngokuphumelelayo ukulungisa ukulahleka kwamaphoyisa nokunye okuhlobene, bese ubeke izinkambiso ukusebenzela lokho.

xh.title: INkulu weNkoviki yePhondo
xh.summary: INkulu weNkoviki yePhondo eHeidelberg enoxanduva lokulawula iintshukumo zokuphumeza umthetho wegqitho, kufuneka ibe nelifa lemfundo ephakamileyo namava amaninzi ekuphumezeni umthetho wegqitho.
xh.requirements: Ibhasethi efanelekileyo yemfundo ephakamileyo (iDiploma eyi-3 minyaka/iNqanaba loMfundo okanye okulinganayo). I3-5 iminyaka yamava okulawula. I7-10 iminyaka yamava okusebenza kwinkundla yokuphumeza umthetho wegqitho. Zonke iilayisenisi ezikhoyo zokuQhuba (A ne-EC). Akukho rekodi yokubakwingo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi namakhono. Ulwazi olubanzi ngeendiko nokulawula iTraffic kunye namagunya, umthetho ohambelanayo namagunya okulawula iTraffic. Amakhono okuQhuba, uKuhlola/iSitya iimoto. Ukuqulunqa iirekhodi. Ukuqulunqa iimbonelela. Ukuhamba ngokulungileyo nabathengi. Ukuqamba, ukuBumba, ukuLawula, ukuQaphela, ukuLawula abantu, ukuZisa iinkonzo, amakhono okunxibelelanayo, amakhono okuthatha izigqibo, ukuLawula iziphumo nomgangatho, ukuSombulula iingxaki, iNnovation/ukuPhucula ngokuqhubekayo, ukuQhelanisa, ukuXoxa, iNtshukso, ulwazi lwekhompyutha, ukuLawula iprojekthi, ukuMfundisa kunye nokuQeqesha, amakhono oBukhulu.
xh.duties: Lawula ukuphunyezwa kweNdiko yokuphumeza umthetho: Qedelela uhlalutyo lwendalo ukuze uqiniseke ukuba lisetyenziswa njengesiseko sokucwangcisa. Tyala indiko yokusebenza yezitishi/iziko ngokusekelwe kwicwangciso yenkonzo yonyaka yephondo ukuze uqiniseke ukuphunyezwa okuphumeleyo. Cwangcisa ukuze uqaphe ukuphunyezwa kweeprojekthi ezinxulumene nokuphunyezwa kweNdiko/icwangciso. Ukuqaphela nyanga zonke iinjongo zecwangciso yenkonzo yonyaka. Xoxa rhoqo nolawulo lwesitishi/iziko uze uncede ekuphumezeni nasekuthathini inxaxheba kwicwangciso entsamiselo/yokusebenza yeziko. Thata inxaxheba kubudlelwane obudibene noolawulo babantu basekuhlaleni. Qiniseka ukulawula okusebenzayo nokusebenzayo: Lawula ubudlelwane nabahlomuli kwamanye amasebe karhulumente nemiPumezo yoKuphumeza uMthetho (LEA). Ulawulo lokuphucula iinkonzo: Lawula iinkqubo zolawulo. Phumeza iinkqubo zolawulo ukuze uqiniseke ukuba iifomu zihlolwa rhoqo ngeveki. Qiniseka ukuba izibalo ezigcinwayo zichanekile, ziseyona ixesha, zithunyelwe ngemini zemigqibelo kwaye ziqatywe zibe zifumaneka kwiiziko. Lawula uze uqiniseke ukunxibelelana okusebenzayo nomphakathi wangaphandle uze uxhorne namaphondo oMmapoli woLuntu. Qiniseka ukuba IstashI Lokuvavanya (TCS) lisebenza kakuhle. Qiniseka ukuba uMthetho, iNdiko kunye neNkqubo zeSebe ziphunyezwa zize zithobelwe. Qiniseka ukuba zonke iirekhodi ezinxulumene noku zifakelwe kakuhle zize zigcinwe zibe zimtsha. Ulawulo lweBoNaBantu: Lawula iingxaki ngokwemiQathango echaziweyo. Qinisekise into enimdlalo wakha ngesigroupi inyanga emva kwexesha elithathu. Qiniseka ukuba iNqumla isetyenziswa kwaye ilawulwa. Cwangcisa uze uphumeze inkqubo yokusebenza ngesikhathi sokufundisa uze uqaphe iimfuno zokufundisa esaqweni. Lawula inkqubo yabasebenzi. Ulawulo lweMali. Qaphela iindleko nyanga zonke neNxulumene noMvuzo ovela kwiphondo uze uphumeze izigqibo ezilungisayo ezindaweni ezinengxaki. Xoxa ngeMali yecwangciso yolawulo njengenxalenye yemiQathango yabalawuli. Qamba uxwebhu lokuqwalasela ngokwemiQathango ebalulekileyo. Thata inxaxheba ecwangcisweni kweMali njengoko kufunwa ngumphondo. Phendula iimfuno ezivela kwindlu enkulu malunga neengxaki zeMali ezingagqitywanga kwixesha elinikiweyo. Qiniseka ulawulo olusebenzayo nezempahla: Qaphela iindleko zemoto yezitishi/iziko (njengakwifomu) uze uchaze uqaphe amalungu athabathe inxaxheba kwiingozi uze uqiniseke ukuba iimoto ezininzi zilawulwa kakuhle zize zibe kwimeko ende. Qiniseka izigqibo ezisebenzayo zolawulo lweziqhithi kwindawo ukuze zibhekane nokulahleka kwezixhobo ezinxulumene nalawo. Lawula izimpahla ngokwemihla yokubala yezitishi/iziko.

jobs.title: Chief Provincial Inspector
jobs.salary_text: R605 742 per annum, plus service benefits
jobs.summary: Chief Provincial Inspector managing operational law enforcement plans for the Gauteng Freeway Unit, requiring a tertiary qualification and traffic law enforcement experience.
jobs.requirements: Relevant Tertiary qualification (3-year Diploma/Degree or equivalent)3-5 years’ supervisory experience. 7-10 years working experience in the traffic law enforcement field. All valid relevant Driving Licenses (A and EC). No criminal record. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge and skills. Extensive knowledge of Traffic Management policies and regulations, Relevant legislations and traffic management regulations Driving skills, Vehicle inspections/impoundment. Records management Resource management Customer relationship management. Planning, Organising, Controlling, Monitoring, People Management, Service delivery, communication skills, decision making skills, Results and quality management, Problem solving, Innovation/ continuous improvement, Analytical, Negotiation, Initiative, Computer literacy, Project management, Mentor and coaching, Leadership skills.
jobs.duties: Manage the implementation of operational law enforcement plan: Complete and update environmental analysis to ensure that it is used as a base line for planning. Develop operational plan for station/centre based on provincial annual performance plan and ensure successful implementation. Plan and monitor the execution of projects relating to the implementation of the Strategy/plan. Monthly monitoring of the annual performance plan targets. Communicate regularly with station/centre management and facilitate the development of and participation in a centre strategic / operational plan. Participate in integrated partnerships with local authorities. Ensure effective and efficient Leadership: Co-ordinate stakeholder relations with other state departments and Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs). Management of service delivery improvement: Manage administration systems. Implement administrative processes to ensure registers are inspected weekly. Ensure that statistics kept are correct, current and forwarded by due dates and monitored and made available at centres. Manage and ensure effective external community communication and liaise with local Community Police Forums. Ensure that Testing Centre Stations (TCS) are operating optimally. Ensure that prescribed Acts, Policies and Procedures of the Department are implemented and adhered to. Ensure that all the relevant records and registers thereof are filed properly and always kept up to date. Management of Human Resources: Manage grievances according to prescribed procedures. Facilitate at least one team building activity per quarter for the centre. Ensure that leave is utilized and managed according to the relevant policies and instructions. Develop and implement in-service training program and monitor formal training needs of the unit. Manage performance of staff. Financial Management. Monitor monthly expenditure and inspection reports from the province and implement corrective action in problem areas. Regular budget control and management discussions as part of management meetings. Document overtime planning based on priorities. Participate in budget planning as required by the Province. Respond to requests from head office regarding outstanding financial queries within provided time limit. Ensure effective and efficient Asset Management: Monitor vehicle costs for station/centre vehicles (as per worksheet) and identify and monitor members involved in accidents and ensure that motor vehicle fleet is managed properly and that vehicles are in good running order. Ensure effective loss control measures are in place to address loss of firearms and other related equipment i.e. the relevant equipment that get lost and put measures in place to deal with it. Manage assets as per inventories of station/centre.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. Tshidiso Chabane/ Ms. Dolly Seboane/ Tlalane Koenane Tel No: (011) 689 3845/ 3723/ 3847
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on new Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za/documents (effective from 01 January 2021). All fields in Part A to D of the Z83 form must be completed, and Part E to G noting that there is limited space provided applicants often indicate “refer” to CV or see attached, this is acceptable as long as the CV is attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. The question related to the conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered. Declaration must be completed and signed. The fully completed and signed new Z83 form should be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV only (only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications). Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applicants who do not comply with the above requirements, as well as late applications, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Suitable candidates will undergo a personnel suitability check (Vetting, criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification, and employment verification). The Department of Community Safety reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes. Candidate will be placed according to corridor coordination and the Department’s needs. The Department will not accept posted, emailed or hand delivered applications. We encourage youth, people with disability, coloured, Indian and white to apply and a confirmation of disabilities from a registered medical practitioner must be attached to the application. Please Note: Due to the large number of applications, we envisage to receive, applications will not be acknowledged. If you do not receive any response within 3 months, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Hoofprovinsiale Inspekteur
af.summary: Hoofprovinsiale Inspekteur wat operasionele wetstoepassingsplanne vir die Gauteng-snelwegeenheid bestuur, wat 'n tersiêre kwalifikasie en ervaring in verkeerswetstoepassing vereis.
af.requirements: Relevante tersiêre kwalifikasie (3-jaar Diploma/Graduering of gelykwaardig). 3-5 jaar se toesigervaring. 7-10 jaar werkervaring in die verkeerswetstoepassingsveld. Alle geldige relevante bestuurslisensies (A en EC). Geen strafregtelike rekord nie. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis en vaardighede. Uitgebreide kennis van Verkeersbestuursbeleide en -regulasies, Relevante wetgewing en verkeersbestuursregulasies. Bestuursvaardighede, Voertuiginspeksies/-beslaglegging. Rekordbestuur. Hulpbronbestuur. Kliëntverhoudingsbestuur. Beplanning, Organisering, Beheer, Monitering, Mensebestuur, Dienslewering, Kommunikasievaardighede, Besluitnemingsvaardighede, Resultate- en gehaltebestuur, Probleemoplossing, Innovasie/ deurlopende verbetering, Analities, Onderhandeling, Inisiatief, Rekenvaardigheid, Projektebestuur, Mentoring en afrigting, Leierskapsvaardighede.
af.duties: Bestuur die implementering van die operasionele wetstoepassingsplan: Voltooi en werk omgewingsanalise by om te verseker dat dit as basis vir beplanning gebruik word. Ontwikkel operasionele plan vir stasie/sentrum gebaseer op provinsiale jaarlikse prestasieplan en verseker suksesvolle implementering. Beplan en monitor die uitvoering van projekte wat verband hou met die implementering van die Strategie/plan. Maandelikse monitering van die jaarlikse prestasieplan-teikens. Kommunikeer gereeld met stasie/sentrumbestuur en fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van en deelname in 'n sentrum se strategiese/operasionele plan. Neem deel aan geïntegreerde vennootskappe met plaaslike owerhede. Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende Leierskap: Koördineer belanghebbende verhoudings met ander staatsdepartemente en Wetstoepassingsagentskappe (LEAs). Bestuur van diensleweringverbetering: Bestuur administratiewe stelsels. Implementeer administratiewe prosesse om te verseker dat registers weekliks geïnspekteer word. Verseker dat statistieke wat gehou word korrek, huidig en teen vasgestelde datums aangestuur en gemonitor en by sentrums beskikbaar gestel word. Bestuur en verseker effektiewe eksterne gemeenskapskommunikasie en skakel met plaaslike Gemeenskappolisieforums. Verseker dat Toetsentrumstasies (TCS) optimaal funksioneer. Verseker dat voorgeskrewe Wette, Beleide en Prosedures van die Departement geïmplementeer en nagekom word. Verseker dat alle relevante rekords en registers daarvan behoorlik geberg en altyd op datum gehou word. Bestuur van Menslike Hulpbronne: Bestuur klagtes volgens voorgeskrewe prosedures. Fasiliteer ten minste een spansamewerking-aktiwiteit per kwartaal vir die sentrum. Verseker dat verlof benut en bestuur word volgens die relevante beleide en instruksies. Ontwikkel en implementeer in-diens opleidingsprogram en monitor formele opleidingsbehoeftes van die eenheid. Bestuur prestasie van personeel. Finansiële Bestuur. Monitor maandelikse uitgawes en inspeksieverslae van die provinsie en implementeer regstellende optrede in probleemareas. Gereelde begrotingsbeheer en bestuursbesprekings as deel van bestuursvergaderings. Dokumenteer oortydbeplanning gebaseer op prioriteite. Neem deel aan begrotingsbeplanning soos deur die Provinsie vereis. Reageer op versoeke van hoofkantoor rakens onopgeloste finansiële navrae binne die voorsiene tydslimiet. Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende Batebestuur: Monitor voertuigkoste vir stasie/sentrumvoertuie (volgens werkblad) en identifiseer en monitor lede betrokke by ongelukke en verseker dat die motorvoertuigvloot behoorlik bestuur word en dat voertuie in goeie looporde is. Verseker dat effektiewe verliesbeheermaatreëls in plek is om verlies van vuurwapens en ander verwante toerusting aan te spreek, d.w.s. die relevante toerusting wat verlore raak en stel maatreëls in plek om dit te hanteer. Bestuur bates volgens inventarisse van stasie/sentrum.

zu.title: Isiphathi SesiFunda EsiHlalo
zu.summary: Isiphathi SesiFunda EsiHlalo esibhekele amahlela okusebenza okuphoqa umthetho ohlelweni lweGauteng Freeway Unit, okudinga iziqu zesikhashana nokuhlolwa komthetho wezokuthutha.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekile zesikhashana (i-Diploma/Degree yeminyaka engu-3 noma okulinganayo)Okuhlolwa okungu-3-5 iminyaka njengomphathi. Okuhlolwa okungu-7-10 iminyaka kule ndawo yokuphoqa umthetho wezokuthutha. Amaphephawo wonke ohamba nayo ohlayo (A kanye no-EC). Kungekho nani ekuqoshweni kokwephula umthetho. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi namakhono. Ulwazi olude nemiqathango yokuphathwa kwezokuthutha, umthetho ohlukene nemigomo yokuphathwa kwezokuthutha. Amakhono okushayela, ukuhlola/ukubamba izimoto. Ukuphathwa kokuqoshwa Ulwazi oluqoshiwe. Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza. Ukuphathwa kwezindlela zokuhlobana nomphakathi. Ukuhlela, Ukubumba, Ukuqapha, Ukuphathwa kwabantu, Ukulethwa kwenkonzo, amakhono okuxhumana, amakhono okwenza izinqumo, ukuphathwa kwemiphumela nobungako, ukuxazulula izinkinga, intuthuko/ukuthuthuka ngokuqhubekayo, ukuhlaziya, ukuzezelana, ukuthatha isinyathelo, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi, ukwelisa nokhothagisa, amakhono okuba ngumholi.
zu.duties: Phatha ukusetshenziswa kohlelo lokusebenza okuphoqa umthetho: Qedelisa futhi uvuselele ukuhlaziywa kwendawo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusetshenziswa kwayo njengesisisekelo sekuhlekeni. Hlela uhlelo lokusebenza lwesiteshi/isikhungo ngokusekelwe ohlelwini lwanezinkathi lwesifunda futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa ngempumelelo. Hlela futhi uqaphe ukusetshenziswa kwamaphrojekthi ahlobene nokusetshenziswa kweSu/hlelo. Ukuqaphela nyanga zonke okuhlosiwe ohlelwini lokusebenza lwanezinkathi. Xhumana njalo nokuphathwa kweSiteshi/isikhungo futhi usize ekuthuthukisweni kanye nokujoyina ohlelweni lokusebenza/oluhlakaniphile lwesikhungo. Thatha inxaxheba kubuhlobo obuhlangene namaphandle omphakathi. Qinisekisa ukuba ngumholi osebenzayo nangempumelelo: Hlela ubuhlobo nabanye abaphathi bomnyango namaLungu Okuphoqa Umthetho (LEAs). Ukuphathwa kokuthuthukiswa kokulethwa kwenkonzo: Phatha amasistimu okuphatha. Setha inqubo yokuphatha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi okuqoshiwe kuhlolwa nsuku zonke. Qinisekisa ukuthi izibalo ezigcinwe zifanele, zimanje futhi zithunyelwe ngosuku oluhleliwe futhi ziqhathaniswe futhi zitholakale emakh Mpakamgama. Phatha futhi uqinisekise ukuxhumana okusebenzayo nomphakathi futhi uxhumane namaphahla Omphakathi Opholisi wendawo. Qinisekisa ukuthi Isiteshi Sokuqaphela (TCS) sisebenza kahle. Qinisekisa ukuthi uMthetho, imigomo nezindlela ezele Umnyango zisetshenziswa futhi zilandelwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amarekhodi nezindlu eziqoshiwe ahlelwe kahle futhi ahlale avuselelwe. Ukuphathwa kweNtanga Yabantu: Phatha izikhalazo ngokulandelwa kwendlela ecatshangwayo. Siza okungenani isenzo esisodwa sokwakha ithimba ngenkathi ngayinye ukuze kusekelwe isikhungo. Qinisekisa ukuthi iholo lisusetshenziswa futhi lilawulwa ngokulandelwa kwemigomo nezinkomba ezifanele. Hlela futhi usebenzise uhlelo lokugcotshwa emsebenzini futhi uqaphe izidingo zokugcotshwa ngokusemthethweni zeNkambu. Lawula ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Ukuphathwa kweMali. Qaphe imali echithwa nyanga zonke nemibiko yokuqaphela esifundeni futhi usebenzise izinyathelo zokulungisa kumakhulu aphandle kwezinkinga. Imihlangano eqhubekayo yokulawula nokuqonda ibhajethi njengengxenye yemihlangano yokuphatha. Qamba imibiko yohlela lwehora evela kumaphorathari ngokulandelwa kwezinhloso. Thatha inxaxheba ekuhlekeni ibhajethi njengoba kudingwa isifunda. Phendula izicelo ezivela enkantolo yenhloko mayelana nemibuzo yezomphakathi ephathekile ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esinikiwe. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwempahla okusebenzayo nangempumelelo: Qaphe izindleko zemoto zesiteshi/isikhungo (njengokuqoshiwe) futhi uqaphe futhi ubheke amalungu abe secenjini futhi uqinisekise ukuthi inqwaba yamimoto ilawulwe kahle futhi zisemagazini. Qinisekisa ukuthi ameja ezinqamula kumanje asebenza futhi abambe amalungu abe ngamaqembu eMoto kanye nalawo asebenza emsebenzini futhi abe ngamalungu ekilasi eliphelele. Hlela amanani abantu abangene kule ndawo futhi uqaphe futhi uhlale ubala labo abangenwe yizinhlekeleli futhi uqinisekise ukuthi amanani amoto akagesi aphathwe kahle futhi besebenza kahle. Qinisekisa ukuthi amasistimu ehlala aseqopheleni emsebenzini asetshenziswa ukuze kubhekwe nokulinganisa amalahle e nkampani. Qinisekisa ukuthi amaphutha ehhobelo lawulwa ngokulandelwa kwemigomo ethize yenhloko-mnyango kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwamarekhodi abe ngawo wonke amalungu ephathwe kahle aqhathaniswa nemikhomba. Phatha ukudluliswa kwentwana njengoba kudingwa imigomo yenhloko mayelana neNkambu yokuhla eqophweni kweGauteng.

xh.title: IsiGqeba-SiNguni EsibiNguni Esikhulu
xh.summary: IsiGqeba-SiNguni EsibiNguni Esikhulu esilawula iicwangciso zokusebenzisa umthetho kwindawo yeGauteng Freeway Unit, kufuneka kube nolwazi oluphezulu nemfuno yesixeleko kwaye nalulwazi ngokuqhubisa umthetho wezokuhamba.
xh.requirements: Isixeleko esifanelekileyo (iDiploma/iNqanaba leminyaka esi-3 okanye okulingana nayo). 3-5 yeminyaka yamava okuba ngumphathi. 7-10 yeminyaka yamava okusebenza kwindawo yokuqhubisa umthetho wezokuhamba. Amalayisensi onke amalungileyo ohamba nawo (A neEC). Akukho bungozi buni obubhalisiweyo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi namakhono. Ulwazi olubanzi lwemigaqo nokumiselwa kokuLawulwa koKuhamba, umthetho ofanelekileyo namagqabantshintshi okulawula ukwahamba. Amakhono okuqhuba, iindlela zokuqinisekisa/ukuthatha izithuthi. Ukulawula amarekhodi. Ukulawula amaxhala okusingathwa. Ukulawula ubudlelwane namakhasi. Ukuqamba, ukuqhubeleka phambili, ukulawula, ukuqwalasela, ukulawula abantu, ukulekela inkonzo, amakhono okunxibelelanana, amakhono okwenza izigqibo, ukulawula iziphumo nolungelo, ukusombulula iingxaki, okutsha/ukuphucula ngokuqhubekayo, ukuqamba, ukuxoxwa ngamandla, ukwenza ngokuzimisela, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukulawula amaphulo, ukukhokela nokukhuthaza, amakhono okukhokela.
xh.duties: Lawula ukusebenza kwecwangciso lokuqhuba umthetho: Qedela uhlaziyo lokwahlulahlula ibindu kuze kuqiniseke ukuba lisetyenziswa njengesiseko sokuqamba. Yila icwangciso lokusebenza lesitesi/iziko ngokusetyenziswa kwecwangciso leminyaka yonke yemveliso yesiNgingqi kuze kuqiniseke ukuba iyaphumelela kuyo. Qamba uze uqwalasele ukuphumeza amaphulo ahlobene nokusebenzisa iNdlela/cwangciso. Ukuqwalasela nyanga zonke iinjongo zecwangciso lemveliso yeminyaka yonke. Thetha ngokuvama nahlonipho nophathi besitesi/iziko uze ulawule uphuhliso nokuthabatha inxaxheba kwicwangciso ezilumkisayo/lokusebenza leziko. Thata inxaxheba kubudlelwane obudityanisiweyo namagunya angabommandila. Qinisekisa ukukhokela ngokusebenza nokusebenza kakuhle: Lawula ubudlelwane nobuntshatsheli namanye amasebe karhulumente neeLaw Enforcement Agencies (LEAs). Ulawulo lwenkonzo yokuphucula inkonzo: Lawula iinkqubo zolawulo. Sebenzisa iinkqubo zolawulo kuze kuqiniseke ukuba amarekhodi aqwalaselwa ngobeki ngobeki. Qinisekisa ukuba izibalo ezigcinwayo zilungileyo, zangoku kwaye zithunyelwe ngeemini ezimiselweyo kwaye ziqwalaselwe kwaye zifumaneke kumaziko. Lawula uze uqinisekise ukunxibelelana komphakathi kwangaphandle kwaye unxibelelane neForam zomPhakathi zoMphatho weNdawo. Qinisekisa ukuba iiTesting Centre Stations (TCS) zisebenza kakuhle. Qinisekisa ukuba amaActs, iMigaqo neenkqubo zoSebe ayamiselwayo ziyasebenza kwaye zilandelwa. Qinisekisa ukuba amarekhodi onke afanelekileyo kwaye amagama obhaliso afakwe kakuhle kwaye ahlala ohlaziweyo. Ulawulo lweBantu: Lawula iingxaki ngokwamanyathelo amiselwayo. Lawula inkxaso yeqela ubuki benyunyana ubeki kwikota ngamanye kumziko. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkqubela ziyasetyenziswa kwaye zilawulwa ngokwemigaqo nemiyalelo ehlobene nayo. Yila uze usebenzise inkqubo yokuzifundela kumsebenzi kwaye uqwalasele iimfuno zokuqeqesha eqaqobeni lweqela. Lawula ukusebenza komsebenzi wabasebenzi. Ulawulo lweMali. Qwalasela iindleko zenyanga zonke neendaba ezingezivo ezivela kwisiNgingqi kwaye usebenzise iinyathelo zokuqwalasela kummandla weengxaki. Iingxoxo ezithanda ngolawulo lwebhajeti ekugonyameleni njengenxalenye yokuqunyuliswa kwabaphathi. Bala ucwangciso lwehora ngokobaluleko. Thata inxaxheba ekuyileni icwangciso lemali njengoko kufuneka ngummandla. Phendula iimfuno ezivela kwindlu enkulu malunga neengxaki zemanga ezingazisolvuthwanga ngexesha elifunekileyo. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa okusebenza kakuhle kwamaxhala: Qwalasela iindleko zesithuthi sesitesi/iziko (njengakwakaka bhale) kwaye uchaze uze uqwalasele amalungu athatha inxaxheba kwiingozi kuze kuqiniseke ukuba uluhlu lwezithuthi lusebenza kakuhle kwaye izithuthi zikwimo elungileyo yokuhamba. Qinisekisa ukuba kukho iinyathelo zokuqwalasela ukulahlekelwa ngokusebenza kakuhle ukulawula ukulahleka kwamathambo nezinye izixhobo ezihlobene nayo okungethwa olo hlutho lweqela. Lawula amaxhala njengakuluhlu lwesitesi/iziko.

jobs.title: Chief Provincial Inspector
jobs.salary_text: R605 742 per annum, plus service benefits
jobs.summary: Chief Provincial Inspector needed to manage operational law enforcement plans for the Gauteng Special Law Enforcement Unit, requiring extensive traffic enforcement experience.
jobs.requirements: Relevant Tertiary qualification (3-year Diploma/Degree or equivalent)3-5 years’ supervisory experience. 7-10 years working experience in the traffic law enforcement field. All valid relevant Driving Licenses (A and EC). No criminal record. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge and skills. Extensive knowledge of Traffic Management policies and regulations, Relevant legislations and traffic management regulations Driving skills, Vehicle inspections/impoundment. Records management Resource management Customer relationship management. Planning, Organising, Controlling, Monitoring, People Management, Service delivery, communication skills, decision making skills, Results and quality management, Problem solving, Innovation/ continuous improvement, Analytical, Negotiation, Initiative, Computer literacy, Project management, Mentor and coaching, Leadership skills.
jobs.duties: Manage the implementation of operational law enforcement plan: Complete and update environmental analysis to ensure that it is used as a base line for planning. Develop operational plan for station/centre based on provincial annual performance plan and ensure successful implementation. Plan and monitor the execution of projects relating to the implementation of the Strategy/plan. Monthly monitoring of the annual performance plan targets. Communicate regularly with station/centre management and facilitate the development of and participation in a centre strategic / operational plan. Participate in integrated partnerships with local authorities. Ensure effective and efficient Leadership: Co-ordinate stakeholder relations with other state departments and Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs). Management of service delivery improvement: Manage administration systems. Implement administrative processes to ensure registers are inspected weekly. Ensure that statistics kept are correct, current and forwarded by due dates and monitored and made available at centres. Manage and ensure effective external community communication and liaise with local Community Police Forums. Ensure that Testing Centre Stations (TCS) are operating optimally. Ensure that prescribed Acts, Policies and Procedures of the Department are implemented and adhered to. Ensure that all the relevant records and registers thereof are filed properly and always kept up to date. Management of Human Resources: Manage grievances according to prescribed procedures. Facilitate at least one team building activity per quarter for the centre. Ensure that leave is utilized and managed according to the relevant policies and instructions. Develop and implement in-service training program and monitor formal training needs of the unit. Manage performance of staff. Financial Management. Monitor monthly expenditure and inspection reports from the province and implement corrective action in problem areas. Regular budget control and management discussions as part of management meetings. Document overtime planning based on priorities. Participate in budget planning as required by the province. Respond to requests from head office regarding outstanding financial queries within provided time limit. Ensure effective and efficient Asset Management: Monitor vehicle costs for station/centre vehicles (as per worksheet) and identify and monitor members involved in accidents and ensure that motor vehicle fleet is managed properly and that vehicles are in good running order. Ensure effective loss control measures are in place to address loss of firearms and other related equipment i.e. the relevant equipment that get lost and put measures in place to deal with it. Manage assets as per inventories of station/centre.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. Tshidiso Chabane/ Ms. Dolly Seboane/ Tlalane Koenane Tel No: (011) 689 3845/ 3723/ 3847
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on new Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za/documents (effective from 01 January 2021). All fields in Part A to D of the Z83 form must be completed, and Part E to G noting that there is limited space provided applicants often indicate “refer” to CV or see attached, this is acceptable as long as the CV is attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. The question related to the conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered. Declaration must be completed and signed. The fully completed and signed new Z83 form should be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV only (only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications). Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applicants who do not comply with the above requirements, as well as late applications, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Suitable candidates will undergo a personnel suitability check (Vetting, criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification, and employment verification). The Department of Community Safety reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes. Candidate will be placed according to corridor coordination and the Department’s needs. The Department will not accept posted, emailed or hand delivered applications. We encourage youth, people with disability, coloured, Indian and white to apply and a confirmation of disabilities from a registered medical practitioner must be attached to the application. Please Note: Due to the large number of applications, we envisage to receive, applications will not be acknowledged. If you do not receive any response within 3 months, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Hoofprovinsiale Inspekteur
af.summary: Hoofprovinsiale Inspekteur benodig om operasionele regstoepassingplanne vir die Gauteng Special Law Enforcement Unit te bestuur, wat uitgebreide ervaring in verkeersregstoepassing vereis.
af.requirements: Relevante tersiêre kwalifikasie (3-jaar Diploma/Degree of ekwivalent). 3-5 jaar se toesigervaring. 7-10 jaar werkervaring in die verkeersregstoepassingsveld. Alle geldige relevante bestuurslisensies (A en EC). Geen strafrekord nie. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis en vaardighede. Uitgebreide kennis van Traffic Management-beleide en -regulasies, relevante wetgewing en verkeersbestuursregulasies. Bestuursvaardighede, voertuiginspeksies/-beslaglegging. Rekordbestuur. Hulpbronbestuur. Kliëntverhoudingsbestuur. Beplanning, organisering, beheer, monitering, mensebestuur, dienslewering, kommunikasievaardighede, besluitnemingvaardighede, resultate- en gehaltebestuur, probleemoplossing, innovasie/voortdurende verbetering, analities, onderhandeling, inisiatief, rekenaargeletterdheid, projekbestuur, mentorskap en afrigting, leierskapsvaardighede.
af.duties: Bestuur die implementering van die operasionele regstoepassingplan: Voltooi en werk omgewingsanalise by om te verseker dat dit as basislyn vir beplanning gebruik word. Ontwikkel operasionele plan vir stasie/sentrum gebaseer op provinsiale jaarlikse prestasieplan en verseker suksesvolle implementering. Beplan en monitor die uitvoering van projekte wat verband hou met die implementering van die Strategie/plan. Maandelikse monitering van die teikens van die jaarlikse prestasieplan. Kommunikeer gereeld met stasie/sentrumbestuur en fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van en deelname aan 'n sentrum strategiese/operasionele plan. Neem deel aan geïntegreerde vennootskappe met plaaslike owerhede. Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende Leierskap: Koördineer belanghebbendesverhoudinge met ander staatsdepartemente en Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs). Bestuur van diensleweringverbetering: Bestuur administratiewe stelsels. Implementeer administratiewe prosesse om te verseker dat registers weekliks geïnspekteer word. Verseker dat statistieke wat gehou word korrek, huidig en teen sperdatums voorsien en gemonitor en by sentrums beskikbaar gestel word. Bestuur en verseker effektiewe eksterne gemeenskapskommunikasie en skakel met plaaslike Community Police Forums. Verseker dat Testing Centre Stations (TCS) optimaal funksioneer. Verseker dat voorgeskrewe Wette, Beleide en Prosedures van die Departement geïmplementeer en nagekom word. Verseker dat alle relevante rekords en registers daarvan behoorlik ingedien en te alle tye op datum gehou word. Bestuur van Menslike Hulpbronne: Bestuur klagtes volgens voorgeskrewe prosedures. Fasiliteer ten minste een spanbou-aktiwiteit per kwartaal vir die sentrum. Verseker dat verlof benut en bestuur word volgens die relevante beleide en instruksies. Ontwikkel en implementeer in-diens opleidingsprogram en monitor formele opleidingsbehoeftes van die eenheid. Bestuur prestasie van personeel. Finansiële Bestuur. Monitor maandelikse uitgawes en inspeksieverslae van die provinsie en implementeer korrektiewe maatreëls in probleemareas. Gereelde begrotingsbeheer en bestuursbesprekings as deel van bestuursvergaderings. Dokumenteer oortydbeplanning gebaseer op prioriteite. Neem deel aan begrotingsbeplanning soos deur die provinsie vereis. Reageer op versoeke van hoofkantoor rakende uitstaande finansiële navrae binne die verskafde tydperk. Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende Batebestuur: Monitor voertuigkoste vir stasie/sentrumvoertuie (volgens werksblad) en identifiseer en monitor lede betrokke by ongelukke en verseker dat die motervoertuigvloot behoorlik bestuur word en dat voertuie in goeie loopbare toestand is. Verseker dat effektiewe verliesbeheermaatreëls in plek is om verlies van vuurwapens en ander verwante toerusting aan te spreek, d.w.s. die relevante toerusting wat verloor raak en plaas maatreëls om dit te hanteer. Bestuur bates volgens inventarisse van stasie/sentrum.

zu.title: Isiphithiphithi Sesifunda Esikhulu
zu.summary: Kudingeka Isiphithiphithi Sesifunda Esikhulu sokuphatha izinhlelo zokuphoqa umthetho ezenzakalelayo ze-Gauteng Special Law Enforcement Unit, okudinga ulwazi olujulile lokuphoqa umthetho wezokuhamba.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesikhungo esiphakeme ezifanele (3-year Diploma/Degree noma okufanayo).3-5 iminyaka yamava okuhlakanipha. 7-10 iminyaka yamava okusebenza enkundleni yokuphoqa umthetho wezokuhamba. Amalayisense okushayela ahambisana nawo ongayona (A kanye ne-EC). Akukho rekodi yesiphambuki. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi namakhono. Ulwazi olubanzi ngemithetho nokuhleleka kokuqondiswa kwezokuhamba, imithetho ehambisana nalokhu kanye nemithetho yesimo sokuhlela izinto. Amakhono okushayela, ukuhlola/ukubamba izimoto. Ukuphatha amarekhodi Ukuphatha amas富mu Okuhlobene nabathengi. Ukuhlela, Ukuphatha, Ukulawula, Ukwengamela, Ukuphatha abantu, Ukuletha izinsiza, amakhono okuxhumana, amakhono okwenza izinqumo, Ukuphatha imiphumela nobungako, Ukuxazulula izinkinga, Intuthuko/ukuthuthuka ngokuqhubekayo, Ukuhlaziya, Ukuhlethisa, Ukuzinza, Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha, Ukuphatha iphrojekthi, Ukwelisa nokhothinga, Amakhono okuhlakanipha.
zu.duties: Phatha ukusetshenziswa kohlelo lokuphoqa umthetho olwenzakalelayo: Qedela bese ubuyekeza ukuhlaziya imvelo ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi kusetshenziswa njengomugqa wesisekelo sokuqondisa. Hlela uhlelo olwenzakalelayo lwegatsha/isikhungo okusekelwe uhlelo lwamaminyaka wonyaka lesifunda bese uqiniseka ukusetshenziswa okuphumelelayo. Hlela bese ubuka ukusetshenziswa kwamaphrojekthi ahlobene nokusetshenziswa kwenqubomgomo/uhlelo. Ukubuka njalo ngenyanga ihloso lohlelo lwamaminyaka wonyaka lokusebenza. Xhumana njalo nengqungquthu yegatsha/isikhungo bese usiza ukuthuthukisa nokubambe iqhaza kuhlelo olwenzakalelayo/olukhulu lesikhungo. Thatha inxaxheba kubudlelwano obuhlangene namagunya awendawo. Qiniseka ukuphatha okusebenzayo nokusebenza kahle: Hlela kabuhlungu ubudlelwano nabashlowe nomnyango wesifunda kanye namanye omnyango bengamabanga kanye Namashange Okuphoqa Umthetho (LEAs). Ukuphatha ukuthuthukiswa kokuletha izinsiza: Phatha izimiso zokuqondisa. Setshenziswa izinqubo zokuqondisa ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi amarejista ahlolelwa njalo ngesonto. Qiniseka ukuthi izibalo ezigcinwe zilungile, zisanda zifakelwe futhi zithunyelwe ngosuku oluhleliwe zibukwa futhi zitholakale emasikhungweni. Phatha bese uqinisekisa ukuxhumana nomphakathi okungaphandle bese uxhumana namafikhu ompakathi wezokuphoqa emphakathini. Qiniseka ukuthi Iziteshi Zesikhungo Sokuhiola (TCS) zisebenza ngokugcwele. Qiniseka ukuthi imithetho, imithetho nezinqubo ecazwe ngazo zomnyango zisetshenziswa futhi zihlonishwa. Qiniseka ukuthi yonke imibhalo namarejista ahambisana nayo afakwe kahle futhi ihlale ibuyekeziwe. Ukuphatha Abasebenzi: Phatha iziphikisano ngokwezinqubo ecazwe ngazo. Sula isenhleliso edlulayo okungenani elilodwa ngokunyanga kuzo zonke izinkulungwane zesikhungo. Qiniseka ukuthi ikhethe incishiswa futhi iphathe kahle ngokuhambisana nenhlelo nezinkomba ezihambisana nawo. Thuthukisa futhi usebenzise uhlelo lokwesekwa ngaphakathi kwenkathi bese ubuka izidingo zokuqeqesha ezisemthethweni zenqo. Phatha ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Ukuphatha Imali. Buka imali yamanyanga athi achithwa nabubani emibhalweni yesifunda ube usebenzisa izinyathelo zokulungisa ezindaweni ezinomkhingisi. Izingxoxo ezijwayelekile zokulawula ukubhajetha nokuqondisa njengengxenye yezinkomfa zokuqondisa. Gqamisa imibhalo yokuhlela amahora amakhulu ngokuhleleka kwezinto. Thatha inxaxheba ekucubunguleni ibhajetha njengoba kudingwa isifunda. Phendula izicelo ezivela eqhikweni mayelana nemibuzo yezimali engaphelele ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esinikiwe. Qiniseza ukuphatha impahla okusebenzayo nokusebenza kahle: Buka izindleko zezimoto zesiteshi/isikhungo (njengaku-worksheet) bese uqapha futhi ubuka amalungu abambe iqhaza ezinsizeni bese uqiniseka ukuthi izimoto eziningi ziphathwe kahle futhi zisebenza kahle. Qiniseka ukuthi kunezinyathelo zokulawula ukulahlekelwa okusebenzayo ukubhekana nokulahlekelwa ngezinsiza ezenzakalelayo nezinye izinsiza ezihlobene nalokho okulahlekelwe bese ube nezinyathelo zokuqondisa lokho. Phatha impahla ngokwezinto ezihlobene nazo zesiteshi/isikhungo.

xh.title: Isosebe eliNgunyi lesiGqenga sePhondo
xh.summary: Kufuneka kubyekwe iSosebe eliNgunyi lesiGqenga sePhondo eliya kuphatha iindlela zomsebenzi zokuqinisekisa umthetho kwiYuniti yeKhuselo eLize layo yePhondo leGauteng, ngokufuna isipilelezo esibanzi sokusebenza kwimisebenzi yokuthintela nokuqinisekisa ithrafikhi.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esifanelekileseo kwangaphakathi (iDiploma/uD Degree yeminyaka esi-3 okanye okulinganayo namayo)3-5 yeminyaka yamava okulawula. I7-10 yeminyaka yamava okusebenza kwinkalo yokuthintela nokuqinisekisa umthetho wethrafikhi. Zonke ilayisenisi zokuqhuba ezifanelekileyo eziphathekayo (A kwaye EC). Akukho bungcali bobugebengu. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi namakhono. Ulwazi olubanzi ngeenkqubo zemithetho yokulawula ithrafikhi nemithelela, kwaye nemithelela yokulawula ithrafikhi; amakhono okuqhuba, ukuhlola izithuthi/ukuzithatha nokuwagcina. Ukulawula irekhodi, ukulawula izibonelelo, ukulawula ubudlelwane nabathengi. Ukucwangcisa, ukuqamba, ukulawula, ukuphangalisa, ukulawula abantu, ukunikela inkonzo, amakhono enxibelelwano, amakhono okwenza izigqibo, ukulawula iziphumo nobuntu bemigqabhwo, ukusombulula iingxaki, intsha/ukuphucula ngokuqhubekayo, ukuhlola, ukuxoxisana, isigqibo, ukwaziswa kweekhompyutha, ukulawula iiprojekthi, ukukhokela nokukhwetsha, namakhono okuba ngumholi.
xh.duties: Phatha ukusebenza kwendlela yomsebenzi yokuthintela nokuqinisekisa umthetho: Qedaza kwaye uvuselele uhlalutyo lwendalo ukuze kuqiniseke ukuba lusetenziswa njengesiseko sokucwangcisa. Phepha indlela yomsebenzi yohlelo/iziko ngokusekelwe kwindlela yemveliso yonyaka wephondo kwaye uqinisekise ukuphumelela kwayo. Cwangcisa kwaye uphawule ukuphumeza iiprojekthi ezithintela ukusebenza kwendlela iNgcinga/indlela. Ukuphawula nyanga zonke iiphawuliselo zemveliso yonyaka. Thintana rhoqo nolawulo lohlelo/iziko kwaye luncede ekuphepheni nasekuthathini inxaxheba kwindlela yomsebenzi/operational yesiko. Thabatha inxaxheba kubudlelwane obuhlangeneyo namagunya ohlelo. Qinisekisa ukuba kukho ukulawula okusebenzayo nokuqinisekileyo: Qhagamshela ubudlelwane nabanye bahlali basebezayo kumasebe karhulumente namasebe eMthetho Wokuqinisekisa uLawulo (iLEAs). Ukulawula ukuphucula ukunikela inkonzo: Lawula iinkqabo zolawulo. Zisebenzise iinkqubo zolawulo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba ii-registers zihloliwa rhoqo ngeveki. Qinisekisa ukuba izibalo ezigcinwayo zilungile, zisahlaziyo kwaye zithunyelwe ngemihla ebekelwe elo kwaye ziphawulwe kwaye zibe khona kumaziko. Lawula kwaye uqinisekise ukuba kukho nxibelelwano lusebenzayo ngaphandle kwiqela labantu kwaye uxhokelelane namaForam weSixeko Sophatho. Qinisekisa ukuba Iiteshoni Zokuviwa (i-TCS) zisebenza ngokugqibeleleyo. Qinisekisa ukuba wonke umthetho, iinkqubo nemiqathango kaRhululumente iyasebenza kwaye ihoywa. Qinisekisa ukuba yonke irekhodi namarejista ahambelanayo afaylwa ngokufanelekileyo kwaye zihlaliswe zisahlaziyo. Ukulawula iZebe eBantu: Lawula iingxaki ngokulandela imiqathango ebekelwe. Khokela ubuchule bokwakha iqela ngenye imisebenzi ngekwikota kwisiko ngamnye. Qinisekisa ukuba ihigha isetyenziswa kwaye ilawulwa ngokwemiqathango nemiqulu edityanayo. Phepha kwaye usebenzise inkqubo yokusebenza-kumsebenzi yokuzilolonga kwaye ulandele iimfuno ezisesikweni zololwaze loluntu. Lawula ukusebenza kwabantu. Ukulawula izimali. Landela iinxo zenyanga nezibalo ezingaphezulu evela kwiphondo kwaye usebenzise izigqibo zolungiso kumacandelo aneengxaki. Zihlala kubuzwa nokuqaliswa kwesixa sebudget njengengxalenye yemiqulu yolawulo. Bacisa amaplani othatha ixesha elingaphezu kwendlela abayimeleyo kubaluleko. Thathela inxaxheba ekubekeni isixa se-budget njengoko kufunwa ngaphondo. Phendula iimfuno evela kuhlelo olungumtshotsha ngeengxaki zemali ezingazalisekanga ngaphakathi kwexesha elinikiweyo. Qinisekisa ukulawula iSebe esiSebenzayo nokuqinisekileyo: Landela iindleko zezithuthi zohlelo/iziko njengoko kubhalwe kwakwichithi kwaye zachule kwaye ulande amalungu athintekayo kwiingozi ukuze kuqiniseke ukuba ulawulo lwebhasi zezithuthi lwenziwe ngokuchanekileyo kwaye ukuba izithuthi zikulungele ukusebenza. Qinisekisa ukuba kukho iindlela eziphakamileyo zokuqinisekisa kushiyeka iintonga zomlilo nezinye izixhobo ezidityanayo zenziwa ulwango lwamalungu alo azitshatoyo zize zibekwe kwindawo ezingancedo kwinto. Lawula izinto ngokwemifanekiso yohlelo/iziko.

jobs.title: Chief Provincial Inspector
jobs.salary_text: R605 742 per annum, plus service benefits
jobs.summary: Chief Provincial Inspector to manage operational law enforcement planning and implementation in Gauteng, requiring a relevant tertiary qualification and extensive traffic law enforcement experience.
jobs.requirements: Relevant Tertiary qualification (3-year Diploma/Degree or equivalent)3-5 years’ supervisory experience. 7-10 years working experience in the traffic law enforcement field. All valid relevant Driving Licenses (A and EC). No criminal record. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge and skills. Extensive knowledge of Traffic Management policies and regulations, Relevant legislations and traffic management regulations Driving skills, Vehicle inspections/impoundment. Records management Resource management Customer relationship management. Planning, Organising, Controlling, Monitoring, People Management, Service delivery, communication skills, decision making skills, Results and quality management, Problem solving, Innovation/ continuous improvement, Analytical, Negotiation, Initiative, Computer literacy, Project management, Mentor and coaching, Leadership skills.
jobs.duties: Manage the implementation of operational law enforcement plan: Complete and update environmental analysis to ensure that it is used as a base line for planning. Develop operational plan for station/centre based on provincial annual performance plan and ensure successful implementation. Plan and monitor the execution of projects relating to the implementation of the Strategy/plan. Monthly monitoring of the annual performance plan targets. Communicate regularly with station/centre management and facilitate the development of and participation in a centre strategic / operational plan. Participate in integrated partnerships with local authorities. Ensure effective and efficient Leadership: Co-ordinate stakeholder relations with other state departments and Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs). Management of service delivery improvement: Manage administration systems. Implement administrative processes to ensure registers are inspected weekly. Ensure that statistics kept are correct, current and forwarded by due dates and monitored and made available at centres. Manage and ensure effective external community communication and liaise with local Community Police Forums. Ensure that Testing Centre Stations (TCS) are operating optimally. Ensure that prescribed Acts, Policies and Procedures of the Department are implemented and adhered to. Ensure that all the relevant records and registers thereof are filed properly and always kept up to date. Management of Human Resources: Manage grievances according to prescribed procedures. Facilitate at least one team building activity per quarter for the centre. Ensure that leave is utilized and managed according to the relevant policies and instructions. Develop and implement in-service training program and monitor formal training needs of the unit. Manage performance of staff. Financial Management. Monitor monthly expenditure and inspection reports from the province and implement corrective action in problem areas. Regular budget control and management discussions as part of management meetings. Document overtime planning based on priorities. Participate in budget planning as required by the province. Respond to requests from head office regarding outstanding financial queries within provided time limit. Ensure effective and efficient Asset Management: Monitor vehicle costs for station/centre vehicles (as per worksheet) and identify and monitor members involved in accidents and ensure that motor vehicle fleet is managed properly and that vehicles are in good running order. Ensure effective loss control measures are in place to address loss of firearms and other related equipment i.e. the relevant equipment that get lost and put measures in place to deal with it. Manage assets as per inventories of station/centre.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. Tshidiso Chabane/ Ms. Dolly Seboane/ Tlalane Koenane Tel No: (011) 689 3845/ 3723/ 3847
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on new Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za/documents (effective from 01 January 2021). All fields in Part A to D of the Z83 form must be completed, and Part E to G noting that there is limited space provided applicants often indicate “refer” to CV or see attached, this is acceptable as long as the CV is attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. The question related to the conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered. Declaration must be completed and signed. The fully completed and signed new Z83 form should be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV only (only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications). Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applicants who do not comply with the above requirements, as well as late applications, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Suitable candidates will undergo a personnel suitability check (Vetting, criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification, and employment verification). The Department of Community Safety reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes. Candidate will be placed according to corridor coordination and the Department’s needs. The Department will not accept posted, emailed or hand delivered applications. We encourage youth, people with disability, coloured, Indian and white to apply and a confirmation of disabilities from a registered medical practitioner must be attached to the application. Please Note: Due to the large number of applications, we envisage to receive, applications will not be acknowledged. If you do not receive any response within 3 months, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Hoofprovinsiale Inspekteur
af.summary: Hoofprovinsiale Inspekteur om operasionele regshandhawingsbeplanning en -implementering in Gauteng te bestuur, wat 'n tersiêre kwalifikasie en uitgebreide verkeersregshandhawingservaring vereis.
af.requirements: Relevante tersiêre kwalifikasie (3-jaar Diploma/Degree of gelykwaardig). 3-5 jaar se toesigervaring. 7-10 jaar se werkservaring in die verkeersregshandhawingsveld. Alle geldige relevante bestuurslisensies (A en EC). Geen strafrekord nie. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis en vaardighede. Uitgebreide kennis van Verkeerbestuursbeleide en -regulasies, relevante wetgewing en verkeerbestuursregulasies. Bestuursvaardighede, Voertuiginspeksies/-beslaglegging. Rekordbestuur. Hulpbronbestuur. Kliënteverhoudingsbestuur. Beplanning, Organisering, Beheer, Monitering, Mensebestuur, Dienslewering, Kommunikasievaardighede, Besluitnemingsvaardighede, Resultate- en gehaltebestuur, Probleemoplossing, Innovasie/voortdurende verbetering, Analities, Onderhandeling, Inisiatief, Rekenaargeletterdheid, Projektbestuur, Mentoring en afrigting, Leierskapsvaardighede.
af.duties: Bestuur die implementering van die operasionele regshandhawingsplan: Voltooi en dateer omgewingsanalise op om te verseker dat dit as basislyn vir beplanning gebruik word. Ontwikkel operasionele plan vir stasie/sentrum gebaseer op die provinsiale jaarlikse prestasieplan en verseker suksesvolle implementering. Beplan en monitor die uitvoering van projekte wat verband hou met die implementering van die Strategie/plan. Maandelikse monitering van die jaarlikse prestasieplan-teikens. Kommunikeer gereeld met stasie/sentrumbestuur en fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van en deelname aan 'n sentrum strategiese/operasionele plan. Neem deel aan geïntegreerde vennootskappe met plaaslike owerhede. Verseker doeltreffende en doeltrouende leierskap: Koördineer belanghebbendesbetrekings met ander staatsdepartemente en Regshandhawingsagentskappe (LEAs). Bestuur van diensleweringverbetering: Bestuur administrasiestelsels. Implementeer administratiewe prosesse om te verseker dat registers weekliks geïnspekteer word. Verseker dat statistieke wat gehou word korrek, huidig en teen vasgestelde datums voorsent en gemonitor en by sentrums beskikbaar gestel word. Bestuur en verseker doeltreffende eksterne gemeenskapskommunikasie en skakel met plaaslike Gemeenskaps-polisieforums. Verseker dat Toetsstasies (TCS) optimaal funksioneer. Verseker dat voorgeskrewe Wette, Beleide en Prosedures van die Departement geïmplementeer en nagekom word. Verseker dat alle relevante rekords en registers daarvan behoorlik ingedien en altyd op datum gehou word. Bestuur van Menslike Hulpbronne: Bestuur klagtes volgens voorgeskrewe prosedures. Fasiliteer ten minste een spanbou-aktiwiteit per kwartaal vir die sentrum. Verseker dat verlof benut en bestuur word volgens die relevante beleide en instruksies. Ontwikkel en implementeer in-diens opleidingsprogram en monitor formele opleidingsbehoeftes van die eenheid. Bestuur prestasie van personeel. Finansiële Bestuur. Monitor maandelikse uitgawes en inspeksieverslae van die provinsie en implementeer korrigerende optrede in probleemareas. Gereelde begrotingsbeheer en bestuursbesprekings as deel van bestuursvergaderings. Dokumenteer oortydbeplanning gebaseer op prioriteite. Neem deel aan begrotingsbeplanning soos deur die provinsie vereis. Reageer op versoeke van hoofkantoor aangaande uitstaande finansiële navrae binne die verskafde tydperk. Verseker doeltreffende en doeltrouende Batebestuur: Monitor voertuigkoste vir stasie/sentrumvoertuie (volgens werkblad) en identifiseer en monitor lede betrokke by ongelukke en verseker dat die motervoertuigvloot behoorlik bestuur word en dat voertuie in goeie looporde is. Verseker dat doeltreffende verliesbeheermaatreëls in plek is om verlies van vuurwapens en ander verwante toerusting aan te spreek d.w.s. die relevante toerusting wat verlore raak en plaas maatreëls om dit te hanteer. Bestuur bates volgens inventarisse van stasie/sentrum.

zu.title: Isiphathi sesiFunda Esikhulu
zu.summary: Isiphathi sesiFunda Esikhulu ukuphatha ukuhlelwa nokusetshenziswa kwezinqubo zomthetho eGauteng, okudinga iziqu ezifanele zesikolo sephakeme kanye nobuso obude bokusebenza ngokuqiniswa komthetho wezokugibela.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele zesikolo sephakeme (3-year Diploma/Degree noma okulinganayo).3-5 iminyaka yokuhlola ukubusa. 7-10 iminyaka yeminyaka yokuqasha emkhakheni wokuqinisa umthetho wezokugibela. Amalayisensi okushayela ahambisanayo avunyelwe (A kanye no-EC). Akukho rekodi yobugqila. Ulwazi nakhono: Ulwazi nakhono. Ulwazi olubanzi lwezinqumo zokuPhathwa koGibela kanye nemithetho, umthetho ohambisanayo nemithetho yokuphathwa kogibela. Amandla okushayela, ukuhlolwa/isithuthi esithathiwe. Ukuphathwa kweephhaphu. Ukuphathwa kwemithombo. Ukuphathwa kwezimbuyazwano. Ukuhlelwa, ukuhlanganisa, ukulawula, ukulondolozwa, ukuphathwa kwabantu, ukulethwa kwezinsizakalo, amandla okuxhumana, amandla okuthatha izinqumo, ukuphathwa kweziphumo nokulinganisa, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukusungula/ukuthuthuka ngokuqhubekayo, ukuhlaziya, ukuxoxa ngomthetho, ukungenelela, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuphatha imiklamo, ukulungiselela nokhothaza, amandla okubusa.
zu.duties: Phatha ukusetshenziswa kweplani yokusebenza komthetho: Qedelela futhi uvuselele ukuhlaziya okusingathwayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kusetshenziswa njengesisekelo sokuhlela. Hlela iplani yokusebenza yesiteshi/isikhungo ngokusekelwe kuhlelo lwabezinyanga lwenkolo yonyaka futhi qinisekisa ukuphumelela kokuqashwa. Hlela futhi lolule isethenjengesemiso semiklamo ehlobene nokusetshenziswa kweNdaba/Iplani. Ukulondoloza ngenyanga okuhloswe ngakho kuhlelo lwenkolo yonyaka. Xhumana njalo nobaphathi besiteshi/isikhungo futhi wenze kube lula ukuthuthukiswa kokuqhasha kanye nokujoyina ihlelo lezinhloso/eokusebenza kulesikhungo. Thatha inxaxhebo kubungani obuhlangene namaphiko omasipala. Qinisekisa ubungihamba obunamandla nobusebenzayo: Hlanganisa izindaba zabahlanganyeli namanye amaphiko kahulumeni kanye nama-Ajensi oMthetho (LEAs). Ukuphatha ukuthuthukiswa kokulethwa kwezinsizakalo: Phatha amasistimu okulawula. Sebenzisa izindlela zokulawula ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi okubhalwayo kuhlolwa nsontsono. Qinisekisa ukuthi izibalo ezigcinwe zifanele, zimanje futhi zithunyelwe ngosuku oluhleliwe, zibhekwe futhi zibekho emikhakheni. Phatha futhi qinisekise ukuxhumana nendawo yangaphandle kanti futhi uxhume namaForamu Amapolisindawo. Qinisekisa ukuthi Isiteshi SeSikhungo SokuHlola (TCS) sisebenza kahle. Qinisekisa ukuthi Amasethi, Izinqubomgomo kanye nezenzo zomnyango zisetshenziswa futhi zilandelekwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke okubhalayo okufanele kanye neencwadi ezikufana nalezo zifakiwe kahle futhi zihlale zivuselelwe. Ukuphathwa kwabasebenzi: Phatha izikhalazo ngokulandela izinqubo ezibekiwe. Yenza kube lula okungenani umnyakazo owodwa wokwakha iqembu unyaka ngamunye kwesikhungo. Qinisekisa ukuthi iholo liyasetshenziswa futhi liphathwa ngokwezinqubomgomo nemiyalelo ehambisanayo. Hlela futhi sethenze uhlelo lokulolongwa ngesikhathi sokusebenza futhi lulondoloze izidingo zokulolongwa kweqembu. Phatha ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Lolula ukusetshenziswa kwemali ngenyanga kanye neziphawuli zokuhlola ezivela esifundeni futhi sethenze isenzo sokulungisa kumakhoni ongcolile. Izingxoxo ezijwayelekile zokulawula ibhajethi kanye nezinkulumo zokuphatha njengengxenye yezinkhumo zabaphathi. Bahla ukucutshungwa kwe-over-time ngokwesibaluli. Thatha inxaxhebo ekuhleleni kwabhajethi njengoba kudingwa isifunda. Phendula izicelo ezivela kuhhovisi elikhulu ngemibuzo yezimali ekingayo ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esinikeziwe. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwempahla okunamandla futhi okusebenza kahle: Lolula izindleko zezimoto zesiteshi/isikhungo (njengoba kubhalwe kukhadi lokusebenza) futhi qinisekisa ukuthi amalungu abathintekayo ekonweni bahlolelwe futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimoto ziphathwe kahle futhi zisebenza kahle. Qinisekisa ukuthi kunezinyathelo ezinamandla zokulawula ukulahleka kwezikhali kanye nezinye izinkhali ezihlobene, okungukuthi, izinto ezifanele ezilahlekile bese kubekwa izinyathelo zokuzibhekana nazo. Phatha impahla njengoba kubhaliwe kufa yeziteshi/isikhungo.

xh.title: IsiNjingalwazi EsiliNgunya SePhondo
xh.summary: IsiNjingalwazi EsiliNgunya SePhondo ukuqhuba ucwangciso lokusebenza kolwalo lo-mthetho nolusebenziso kwaGauteng, kufuneka kubekho iziqu ezifanelekile zomfundo ophakamileyo nolunye olugqithisileyo lolwazo ekuphathweni kolwalo lo-thetho wepheku.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekileyo zomfundo ophakamileyo (iDiploma/Idigri yeminyaka esi-3 okanye okulinganayo). Ulunye lonyaka lwe-3-5 ekulawuleni abanye abasebenzi. Ulunye lonyaka lwe-7-10 olwaziyo kwinkalo yolwalo lomthetho wepheku. Amalayisense onke amaqondo oqhetshuba athengenele (A nange-EC). Akukho ntlolongo egazini ngesiphiso sobutyetyeli. Ulwazi namekhaya: Ulwazi nakhono. Ulwazi olugqithisileyo ngemigaqo nangemimiselo yoLawulo lokuPheku, iMigaqo-ndaba ezithintelayo nemimiselo yolawulo lokuPheku, amakhono oqhetshuba, ukuhlola/ukubamba izithuthi ngamandla. Ulawulo lwegama Lemigaqo yamagama, ulawulo lwezibonelelo, ulawulo lolunxulumano nabathengi. Ukuqamba ucwangciso, ukuhlela, ukuze kunqatwe, ukuqapha, ukuPhatha abantu, ukuze kuhlawulwe inkonzo, amakhono ekuqhathaneni, amakhono okwenza izigqibo, ulawulo lweziphumo nekhalithi, ukuxazula iingxaki, iNkqubo entsha/ukuqhubekekela phambili, ukwahlulela, ukuxoxisana, ukuzakhela, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ulawulo lweenkqubo, ukuyala nokumfundisa, amakhono obukhulu.
xh.duties: Qhuba isebenziso senkqubo yolwalo lomthetho: Qedelisa uhlalutyo olusingathwe kwinto yemvelo ukuqinisekisa ukuba lisetyenziswa njengesiseko soqcwangciso. Yila inkqubo yesebenziso yesikhululo/iziko ngesiseko senkqubo yonyaka wemiba yophondo ukuze kuqinisekiswe isebenziso esiphumeleleyo. Cwangcisa ukuze uqaphe ukwenziwa kweeknqubo ezimalana nesebenziso seNdlela/inkqubo. Ukuqapha ngenyanga iinkcukacha zemiba yemigangatho yenkqubo yonyaka. Thetha rhoqo nabaphathi besikhululo/iziko uze unciphise ukuyila nokuthatha inxaxheba kunkqubo yengqondo nesebenziso yeziko. Thatha inxaxheba kwiqumrhu elidibana namaphondo asemmandeni. Qinisekisa ukulawula okusebenzayo nokuze kubengumniki: Hlanganisa iintsapho ezinxulumene naye nomnye wezinye iimimandla karhulumente nokuwoMthetho oLawulayo (i-LEAs). Ulawulo lokuphucula ukusetyenziswa kwenkonzo: Qhuba iinkqubo zolawulo. Sebenzisa iinkqubo zolawulo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba amagama ahlolwa ngeveki. Qinisekisa ukuba izibalo ezigcinwe zilungile, zangoku kwaye zithunyelwe ngeemhla ezimisiweyo kwaye ziqaphewe kwaye zifumaneka kwiindawo ezithile. Qhuba ukuze uqinisekise ukunxibelelana kwangaphandle nomphakathi oncedisayo nohamba ehamba noMphakathi woM-polisa wendawo. Qinisekisa ukuba Iisikhululo Sokuqhelanisa (i-TCS) zisebenza ngokufanelekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba iMithetho, iMigaqo nemiSebengo yeSebe efunekayo isetyenziswa kwaye ilandelelana. Qinisekisa ukuba onke amagama namagama eempondo afayilwe kakuhle kwaye ahlale ekuguqulwa. Ulawulo lweziThunywa zoluntu: Lawula iingxaki ngokulandela imigaqo efunekayo. Qhubele phambili ubunjani besebenzi obunje ngamaxesha onke kuqondo ngamnye kule nyanga. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkonzo zokusika zisetyenziswa kwaye ziphathwe ngokwemigaqo nemiyalelo efunekayo. Yila kwaye usebenzise inkqubo yokusebenzisa inkqubo yokuziqhelanisa kwaye uqaphe iimfuno zokusebenza koluntu. Lawula inkqubo yokwenza kwabasebenzi. Ulawulo lweQoqo lemali. Qapha iinkqubo ezihlawulwa ngenyanga nakwiinkqubo zokuqonda evela kwiphondo kwaye usebenzise iindlela zokulungisa iindawo ezinengxaki. Yenza iindibano zolawulo nokuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kweqoqo rhoqo njengengxenye yendibano yolawulo. Qamba ucwangciso lwehora ngenkqubo yohlobo lweenkqubo ezibalulekileyo. Thatha inxaxheba ekuyileni ucwangciso lweqoqo njengoko kufuneka ngumphondo. Phendula iimfuno ezivela kwiofisi enkulu malunga neengxaki zeqoqo ezingekayo ngokungagqibekanga kwithuba elifunekayo. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo noluze lweziMbali: Qapha iindleko zezipho zesikhululo/iziko (njengakwilophu yomsebenzi) kwaye uqonde uze uqaphe amalungu achaphazelekayo kwiingozi ukuze uqinisekise ukuba iqela lezipho seliyiphathwe kakuhle kwaye izithuthi zikumhlaba oqhuba kakuhle. Qinisekisa ukuba kuye kubekho iindlela zokuze kubekho ulawulo olusebenzayo lokulahleka kolahleko lwezixhobo ezihambisanayo ezingafunekiyo, oko kukuthi izixhobo ezifunekayo ezilahlekayo kwaye kubekho iindlela zokuze kusingathwe ngazo. Lawula izimbali njengoko kubhalwe kwizikhululo/iziko.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Transport and Logistics
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 per annum, plus service benefits.
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Transport and Logistics at the Department of Community Safety Head Office in Johannesburg, managing fleet operations, vehicle registers and transport invoicing.
jobs.requirements: Matric Certificate plus a 3-year National Diploma (NQF level 6)/Degree (NQF level 7) ln Supply Chain Management/Logistics/ Transportation Management. 3 years’ experience in supervisory/ Logistics Manager/ Transport Officer/ Transport Admin Clerk. Certificates In Computer Training Course, Call centre, Transport and Fleet Management, Advance Management Development Programme, Monitoring and Evaluation and Fleet Management will be an added advantage. All valid relevant driving licenses (A and EC). No criminal record or case pending against you. Knowledge and Skills: MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint and MS Outlook: Internet and E-mail. Customer relationship management, ELS and SAP. Interpersonal relations, conflict management, and communications. PERSAL, FLEETMATIC, C VISION and Transport Policy. Interviewing, negotiation and facilitation skills. Inventory policy, cellphone policy and presentation skills. Report writing, computer literacy and advanced driving.
jobs.duties: Manage transport service according to departmental policy. Ensure that the is a vehicle asset register. Monitor vehicle movement. Manage and keep records on accidents. Licensing Department owned vehicles. Verifying and processing the monthly invoice. Compiling Payment for g-flee / stannic. Issuing Trip authority. Booking vehicle for repairs and maintenance. Facilitating the renewal of petrol cards. Processing fuel claims and requesting of new fleet. Receive a requisition and process requisition. Receive and check goods. Capture goods on relevant registers. Return damaged incorrect and substandard goods. Issue goods as required. Stock taking according to stock taking plan. Comparison of stock counted with official records. Capturing Stock count on SAP. Receive a cellphone request and process the request. Cellphone Administration (Blacklisting, Insurance claims and repairing). Processing payment and managing cellphone contracts. Maintaining Cellphone register. Calculate rate per kilo and process the request. Assisting with quotes and receiving applications. Process application, calculate rate per kilo and process the request. Administrate the scheme process (maintenance, repairs and accident). Workshops for users from Head Office and Regional Offices. Provide information and support documentation required by AG and GAS. Advise users procedures and reforms. General supervision of employees. Ensure that all are trained and developed to be able to deliver work of the required standard efficiently and effectively. Develop, implement and monitor work systems and processes to ensure efficient and effective functioning. Manage performance, conduct and discipline.

Decision-making. Interpersonal relations. Strategic thinking and planning. Probing. Negotiation. Written and oral communication. Report writing. Presentation and facilitation skills. Public speaking.

Development and implementation of the operational plan for the regional office. Effective performance management and capacity building of the regional staff. Recommend Disciplinary hearing against any Officer under your jurisdiction who is reasonably suspected of having committed an act of Misconduct in the execution of their duties. Manage grievances according to prescribed procedures. Facilitate at least one team building activity per quarter. Ensure that leave is utilized and managed according to the relevant policies and instructions. Develop and implement in-service training programme and monitor formal training needs of the unit. Monitor and evaluate operational performance of the region to ensure continuous alignment and development. Ensure the management of Performance Management and Development System as per the approved PMDS policy. Ensure proper record keeping of activities of the centre including minutes of every meeting convened. Compile monthly reports and submit. Attend operational meetings and any other meeting as required by strategic leadership. Manage assets as per inventories of the centre. Ensuring appropriate use of all facilities. Ensure effective loss control measures are in place to address loss of equipment's. Monitor vehicle costs for costs for the station/centre and identify and monitor members involved in accidents and ensure that motor vehicle fleet is managed properly and that vehicles are in good running order. Coordinate stakeholder relations with other state departments, NGOs, Road Safety Officials and Law enforcement agencies (LEAS). Identify relevant risks. Develop plan to address risks. Implement and monitor risk plan. Monitor monthly expenditure and inspection reports from Province and implement corrective action in problem areas. Regular budget and management discussions as part of management meetings. Document overtime planning based on priorities. Participate in budget planning as required by the province. Respond to requests from head office regarding financial queries within provided time limits. Monitor and manage the procurement needs of the centre. Evaluate progress. Coordinate Road Safety projects with regional team leaders. Draft business plans for the project. Draft an activity plan/detailed work plan. Manage project budget and procurement process. Ensure effective implementation of the respective project activities. Compile monthly project progress report on status. Engage with various role players on project implementation. Encourage road user compliance to road rules. Coordinate formal, informal and non-formal education and communication through projects and programmes targeting the categories of road users in order to change their behaviour and attitudes and increased knowledge and skills. Identify and engage key stakeholders in road safety promotion initiatives. Establish partnerships with relevant departments, local government etc. to foster mutual relations and pursue common interests. Participate in the communication forum for Law Enforcement Agencies.

Kennis en begrip van departementele strategiese prioriteite en programme. Rekordbestuur. Hulpbronbestuur. Kliëntverhoudingsbestuur. Prestasiebestuur. Finansiesbestuur. Konflikbestuur. Projekbestuur. Selfbestuur. Tydbestuur. Risikobestuur. Veranderingsbestuur. Openbare inligtingsbestuur. Netwerk bou. Hantering van druk. Diversiteit. Besluitneming. Tussengemenslike verhoudings. Strategiese denke en beplanning. Ondersoek. Onderhandeling. Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie. Verslagskrywing. Aanbiedings- en fasiliteringsvaardighede. Openbare spreke.
af.duties: Help om instellingsreëlings te koördineer vir effektiewe implementering van die GSS. Help met die belyning van Padveiligheidsaktiwiteite binne en buite die Departement. Help met die implementering van padveiligheidsstrategieë volgens nasionale departement (NDoT) se riglyne aan skole en die breë publiek. Verseker Openbare Onderwys deur opleiding van padgebruikers en gemeenskappe met die fokus op gemeenskapskoubereikprogramme, padskoue en bevorderingsprojekte. Verseker opleiding van alle Gauteng-opvoeders oor padveiligheidsonderwys. Help met koördinering en bestuur van die Gauteng Voetgangerbestuursplan met alle belanghebbendes. Ontwikkeling en implementering van die operasionele plan vir die streekkantoor. Effektiewe prestasiebestuur en kapasiteitsbou van die streekpersoneel. Beveel disiplinêre verhoor aan teen enige Beampte onder u jurisdiksie wat redelikerwys verdink word van die pleging van 'n wangedrag in die uitvoering van hul pligte. Bestuur klagtes volgens voorgeskrewe prosedures. Fasiliteer ten minste een spansamewerkingsaktiwiteit per kwartaal. Verseker dat verlof benut en bestuur word volgens die tersaaklike beleide en instruksies. Ontwikkel en implementeer in-diens-opleidingsprogram en monitor formele opleidingsbehoeftes van die eenheid. Monitor en evalueer operasionele prestasie van die streek om deurlopende belyning en ontwikkeling te verseker. Verseker die bestuur van die Prestasiebestuurs- en Ontwikkelingstelsel volgens die goedgekeurde PMDS-beleid. Verseker behoorlike rekordhouding van aktiwiteite van die sentrum insluitend notule van elke vergadering wat byeengeroep is. Stel maandelikse verslae op en dien dit in. Woon operasionele vergaderings en enige ander vergadering soos deur strategiese leierskap vereis, by. Bestuur bates volgens voorraadlyste van die sentrum. Verseker toepaslike gebruik van alle fasiliteite. Verseker dat effektiewe verliesbeheermaatreëls in plek is om toerustingverlies aan te spreek. Monitor voertuigkoste vir die stasie/sentrum en identifiseer en monitor lede betrokke by ongelukke en verseker dat die motorvoertuigvloot behoorlik bestuur word en dat voertuie in 'n goeie looptoestand is. Koördineer belanghebbedeverhoudinge met ander staatsdepartemente, NRO's, Padveiligheidsbeamptes en Regshandhawingsagentskappe (LEAS). Identifiseer tersaaklike risiko's. Ontwikkel 'n plan om risiko's aan te spreek. Implementeer en monitor risikoplan. Monitor maandelikse besteding en inspeksieverslae van Provincie en implementeer korrektiewe optrede in problematiese areas. Reëlmaatse begrotings- en bestuursbesprekings as deel van bestuursvergaderings. Dokumenteer oortydbeplanning gebaseer op prioriteite. Neem deel aan begrotingsbeplanning soos deur die provinsie vereis. Reageer op versoeke van hoofkantoor rakende finansiële navrae binne die verskafde tydperke. Monitor en bestuur die verkrygingsbehoeftes van die sentrum. Evalueer vordering. Koördineer Padveiligheidsprojekte met streekspanleiers. Opstel van besigheidsplanne vir die projek. Opstel van 'n aktiwiteitsplan/gedetailleerde werkplan. Bestuur projekbegroting en verkrygingsproses. Verseker effektiewe implementering van die onderskeie projekaktiwiteite. Stel maandelikse projekvorderingsverslag oor status op. Raak betrokke by verskeie rolspelers oor projelimplementering. Moedig padgebruiker-nakoming van padreëls aan. Koördineer formele, informele en nie-formele onderwys en kommunikasie deur projekte en programme wat op die kategorieë van padgebruikers gemik is om hul gedrag en gesindhede te verander en kennis en vaardighede te verhoog. Identifiseer en betrek sleutelbelanghebbendes in padveiligheidsbevorderingsinisiatiewe. Vestig vennootskappe met tersaaklike departemente, plaaslike regering, ens. om wedersydse betrekkinge te bevorder en gemeenskaplike belange na te streef. Neem deel aan die kommunikasieforum vir Regshandhawingsagentskappe.
