zu.requirements: Isitifikedi seGrade 12 kanjalo nendima yemfundo ephakeme ehlobene (I-diploma/I-degree yeminyaka emi-3 noma okulingana nayo). Uhlale iminyaka engu-3 ohlezi kumkhakha wezinsiza ezinga eliphansi noma ophethe abantu ohlezi kumkhakha wezokuphepha kwendlela. Amalayisensi onke okushaya amadoda afanele (A kanye no-EC). Isibopho sokungabi noma yikuphi isimo esidonsa izinkohlakalo noma esingakapheli. Ulwazi nezikhokelo: Uhlelo oluhlobene lokumiswa komthetho kanye nezinqumo ezahambisana nalawo mthetho. Ulwazi nokuqonda uhlelo lokuphepha kwindlela. Imbuso yohlelo. Ukucabangisa. I-PSR ne-PFMA. Ukuqonda kohlelo olwengeziwe lomnyango. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngokubaluleka kwezinhloso zomnyango kanye namaphulo awo. Ukuphatha amarekhodi. Ukuphatha izinsiza. Ukuphatha ubudlelwano namakhasimende. Ukuphatha ukusebenza. Ukuphatha imali. Ukuphatha inkinga. Ukuphatha amaphulo. Ukuziphathe ngokuzethemba. Ukuphatha isikhathi. Ukuphatha inkinga ezingathinta kahle. Ukuphatha izinguquko. Ukuphatha ulwazi lwabezumphakathi. Ukuxhumana. Ukubekezelela inkuluzeleko. Izinhlobonhlobo zezinto. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ukucabanga uhlelo kanye nokuqamba. Ukuphanda. Ukuhlangana. Ukubhala kanye nokukhuluma. Ukubhala imibiko. Amakhono okwethula kanye nokweluleka. Ukukhuluma esidlangalaleni.
zu.duties: Siza ukubheka izinhlelo zomnyango ukwenzela ukuthi kusebenze kahle ukusetshenziswa kwe-GSS. Siza ngokuhambisa izenzo zokuphepha kwendlela ngaphakathi nangaphandle komnyango. Siza ekusetshenzisweni kwezinhlela zokuphepha kwendlela njengoba kuqondwe umnyango kazwelonke (NDoT) kumabanga nasemphakathini jikelele. Qinisekisa ukuthi kufundiswa abantu abashaya amadoda namabanga ngokugqugquzela abantu abangaphandle, imikhankaso yasezindleleni kanye namaphulo okuthuthukisa. Qinisekisa ukufundiswa kwabofundisi bakaGauteng ngokuphepha kwindlela. Siza ekubukeni nokuphatheni uhlelo lokuphatha abahamba ngamanyawo eGauteng kubo bonke abahlanganyelayo. Ukuthuthukisa nokusebenzisa uhlelo lokusebenza kolunyuva lwesifunda. Ukuphatha ukusebenza kahle nokuakhula kolimi baseNdaya yesifunda. Phakamisa isizwa sokulalelwa ububi ngesulu nganoma imuphi ofisa osemthethweni wakho ofuna ngokumane udla naye isule kanti ke usolakala ngokwenza okungalungile ekwenzeni umsebenzi wakhe. Phatha izikhalazo ngokuhambisana nemiyalo ekelwe emthethweni. Kwenze okungenani omunye umbhali womkhankaso ohlelwa kujezi ngonyaka. Qinisekisa ukuthi iholo lisetshenziswa liphathwe ngokuhambisana nemiyalo ekelwe emthethweni ngokushesha. Thuthukisa futhi usebenzise uhlelo lokufundisa abasebenzi ngaphakathi kwenyuvesi ubuke izidingo zokufunda kweqembu. Buka futhi uhlole ukuthi inyuvesi isebenza kahle embindela wokugcina kuhambisana ukuthuthuka. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezokuphatha kwezinhlelo kanye nokuqonda ngokuhambisana nemiyalo ye-PMDS eqokiwe. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwarekhodi kwenkomba zenyuvesi kuhlanganise imibalo yomhlangano onke owenzayo. Buka imibiko yanyanga zonke uyithumele. Buka imihlangano yenzuko noma yimuphi omunye umhlangano njengoba kuceliwe ngokuphatha ngokuhle kwezinsizakusebenza ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Hola izinsiza ngokuhambisana nemibhalo yezinto zenyuvesi. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza ezifanele. Qinisekisa ukuthi kulawulo olunamandla okulawula ukulahlekelwa kwamadivayisi okubhekene nokuwa kwaleso siphazamisi. Buka izindleko zezimoto zesiteshi noma inyuvesi bese ubuka kanye nohlela labo abathintwe ngamakhasimende kanti futhi uhlole ukuthi imoto iyaphathwa kahle noma iyasebenza kahle. Hlanganisa ubudlelwano nabahlanganyeli kumanye amnyango kazwelonke, izinhlangano ezingekho emthethweni, iziphathimandla zokuphepha kwindlela kanye namagugu omthetho (LEAS). Hlela izinsiza ezingaka dedwa. Hlela amaphuzu okubhekana nalezo zinsiza. Zama futhi uhlole amaphuzu ahleliwe. Buka izindleko zenyanga zonke kanye nemibiko yokuqinisekisa ezivela esiFundazweni bese usebenzisa izinhlela zokulungisa ezindaweni ezinamaphutha. Hlola ngokuhamba kwesikhathi imibiko yohlelo loimali kanye nezimali ezingamaphuzu okuphatha njengengxenye yemihlangano yokuphatha. Hlela isikhathi sokushuma izinsuku ngenxa yezinhloso. Zibandakanye ekubekeni ihlelo limali njengoba kudingwa sifunda. Phendula izicelo eziwela kuhlelo lokuqondisa ngemibuzo yemali ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esinikeziwe. Buka futhi phatha izidingo zokuthenga izinto zenyuvesi. Hlola inhambulo. Hlanganisa amaphulo okuphepha kwindlela kanye nabaholi beqembu lesifunda. Hlela amaphuzu wamaphulo. Hlela ipulani yomsebenzi ongaphakathi. Phatha imali yamaphulo kanye nendlela yokuthenga. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kahle kwezenzo zamaphulo ahlobene. Hlela imibiko yanyanga zonke ngokuqhubeka kwamaphulo. Yiba nabalingani abahlukene ekusetshenziseni amaphulo. Khuthaza abashaya amadoda ukuba balandele imiyalo yendlela. Hlanganisa ukufundisa okuhleliwe, okungalungile kanye nokuqondisa abantu ngamaphulo kanye nemibhalo ehlose abantu abashaya amadoda ukuze ushintshe imikhuba kanye nokuqonda bese khona ukwazisa ngokwedlule ulwazi namakhono. Qaphela bese ubuyisana nabahlanganyeli abadingekayo ekukhuthazeni izinhlelo zokuphepha kwindlela. Siza izinhlelo zokusebenza namnyango, kahulumeni wendawo njll. ukwakhisa ubudlelwano kanye nokuzuza izinhloso eziyisiseko. Zibandakanye kuhlelo lokuxhumana lwamagugu omthetho.

xh.title: Umthunywa weNkululeko: Ukhuseleko lweeNdlela
xh.summary: Umthunywa weNkululeko woKhuseleko lweeNdlela kwiSebe loKhuseleko loLuntu kwiGauteng eJohannesburg, elibambisana neendleba nemisebenzi yokhuseleko lweeNdlela.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrede 12 kunye nesiqinisekiso esifanelekileyo samabanga aphakamileyo (iDiploma/IDigri yeminyaka esi-3 okanye esingako). 3 years' experience at administrative/ supervisory level in the field of Road Safety. Zonke iilayisenisi zokushayela ezisebenzayo ezifanelekileyo (A and EC). Akukho nputho yonwabo lwentleba okanye naziphi na iicala ezisasenkantolo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwangekolwimiso kunye nesakhiwo seNqgovomthetho. Ulwazi akuqonde kakuhle ngeCandelo loKhuseleko lweeNdlela. Ulawulo lwamaphulo. Uqwalaselo olubhekisa phambili. PSR and PFMA. Ukuqonda icebo lokusebenza elibhekisa phambili lesebe. Ulwazi akuqonde kakuhle ngamagqabantshishi amabhekisa phambili eeSebe namanqaku eSebe. Ulawulo lemigca. Ulawulo lwezixhobo. Ulawulo lweenthendamthetho. Ulawulo lentsingiselo. Ulawulo lweemali. Ulawulo lokukrokrela. Ulawulo lwamaphulo. Ulawulo lwakho. Ulawulo lwexesha. Ulawulo loyingozi. Ulawulo lotshintshiso. Ulawulo lwamagazini kaRhulumente. Ukuzonxibelelana nokuzenzela. Ukupatha inkxwabo. Ukuguquguquka. Ukuthatha iigqibo. Iintamano phakathi kwabantu. Ukucinga nokuqwalasela okubhekisa phambili. Ukucoca. Iingxoxo. Inkomfa elungisiweyo nolwimi lwasemlonyeni. Ukubhala iingxelo. Amakhono okubonisa nokuququzelela. Ukuthetha lukhoyo.
xh.duties: Nceda kubumbisano lwezibheno zoluntu ukuguqulela kwenkqubo echanekileyo zeGSS. Nceda ngokulungelelanisa imisebenzi yoKhuseleko lweeNdlela ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwisebe. Nceda ngokuqwalasela iindlela zokhuseleko lweeNdlela ngokwemiyalelo yesebe lesizwe (NDoT) kumaziko emfundo nakwishishakazi lonke. Qinisekisa imfundo yokoluntu ngokuqeqesha abasebenzisi beendlela nakumaziko kunye nokugxila kumanqaku okusasaza ulwazi kumaziko okuluntu, iindaba zemilingo kunye namaphulo okuthengisa. Qinisekisa ukugutyungwa kwabo bonke ootitshala bakaGauteng ngemfundo yokhuseleko lweeNdlela. Nceda ngokubambisana nokuLawula icebo loLawulo labaHamba ngeenyawo iGauteng kunye bonke abanegalelo. Uphuhliso nokuqwalasela kwenkqabo yomsebenzi yofiso elikuwo. Ukuqwalasela olusebenzayo nokuqhakamshwa koluntu lwabasebenzi bofiso ekuwo. Phakamisa isicelo sokuzwa iicala ngaliphi na igosa elikulawulo lakho elikrwaywe ngokubandakanyeka kwenkohlakalo ekuphumezeni imisebenzi yalo. Lawula iingxwankulala ngokulandelana kwemithetho eshiyiweyo. Ququzelela ubuncinane umsebenzi owodwa wokwakhiwa kwethu ngexesha ngalinye ngenyanga. Qinisekisa ukuba iholide ithathwa nokuLawulwa ngokwemigaqo nemiyalelo edibene nayo. Uphuhlisa nokuqwalasela inkqubo yokuyalela ngaphakathi kesebe kwaye ulawule iimfuno zokuqeqeshwa esemthethweni kwicandelo. Lawula aze uqwalasele intengo yomsebenzi weofisi ngokulungelelanisa nokuqhakamshwa ngokuqhubelekayo. Qinisekisa ulawulo loQwalaselo lwaBakho nokuLawulwa kweenkqubo ngokwemigaqo eP.M.D.S. ekuqwalaseliweyo. Qinisekisa ugcino oluchanekileyo lwemisebenzi yecandelo ngokubandakanya iinkcazelo zomqobo ngamnye onqunjelweyo. Hlela iingxelo ngenyanga kwaye uzithumele. Zibandakanye kwiindibano zomsebenzi kunye nazo zonke ezinye iindibano njengoko kufunwa ngabaphathi abajonge phambili. Lawula izinto ngokwahlulwahlulo kusetyenziswa izinto ezingazange kusebenze. Ukuqinisekisa ukusetyenziswa okufanelekileyo kwezixhobo zonke. Qinisekisa izigibo ezisebenzayo ezithintela ukulahleko kwesixhobo kwindawo ekufuneka kuthintelwe ukulahleka kwemizobo. Lawula iindleko zeemoto ezikwicandelo/iziko kwaye ukhokele abo babandakanyekayo kwiingozi aze uqinisekise ukuba ulawulo lwezimoto lwenziwe kakuhle neyimito isekulungelelwenzo. Babhisana noqhagamshelo namanye oophezele ekuphatheni iSebe, iN.G.O.s, oopezulu boKhuseleko lweeNdlela nooMthetho (L.E.A.s). Qamba iingozi ezifanelekileyo. Hlela icebo lokulawula iingozi. Qwalasela kwaye ulawule icebo leengozi. Lawula iindleko ngenyanga kunye neengxelo zokuqwalasela ezivela kummandla kwaye usebenzise isigibo esichanekileyo kwiindawo ezinengxaki. Iingxoxo ngeqela eliqhelekileyo kwalo lonke uxolo ngokwengxoxo yolawulo. Bacisa icebo lokubala ngaphezu koxolo oluqwalaselwa iindleko. Thatha inxaxheba ekubakweni ixesha eliqwalaselwa imfuneko yommandla. Phendula izicelo ezivela kwiofisi enkulu malunga nemibuzo yemali ngaphakathi kwamaxesha anikiweyo. Qwalasela kwaye ulawule iimfuno zokuthengiselwa kwisebe. Khetha inqanaba lokubakho. Lawula ngesixhobo samaphulo oKhuseleko lweeNdlela kunye nooqwalaselo bofiso. Hlela amacebo omsebenzi wamaphulo. Hlela icebo lomsebenzi/icebo elichaziweyo. Lawula imali yamaphulo nenkqubo yokuthengiselwa. Qinisekisa ukwenziwa kakuhle komsebenzi wamaphulo ahlukeneyo. Hlela iingxelo yamaphulo ngenyanga ngokwemeko. Nxibelelana nabatshatileyo abahlukeneyo ngokuqwalasela kwamaphulo. Khuthaza abasebenzisi beendlela ukuba balandelane nemithetho. Lawula imfundo efanelekileyo, engafanelekanga nengaqhelekanga ngokuqeqeshwa nokuqwalasela ngamaphulo namanqaku njengoko kubalulekile kwizigaba zabasebenzisi beendlela ukuzitshintsha iimvakalelo nokuziphatha kunye nokuqhakamshwa kolwazi namakhono. Phawula kwaye ugxile kumanqaku abalulekileyo abanegalelo kuqhakamshelo lokhuseleko lweeNdlela. Seba ngabahlobo namanye amaziko, urhulumente wengingqi nokubhalaa ngokusasaza iindaba ezithintela ukuziphendulela nokuzinceda. Thatha inxaxheba ekwindibano yokubaluleka koluntu ukwenzela urhulumente wokuPhumeza iMithetho.

jobs.reference_number: REFS/057065 Chief Directorate: Information Communication Technology
jobs.title: Assistant Director: Service Level and ICT Project
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 per annum, plus service benefits
jobs.summary: Manage ICT services and service level agreements for the Gauteng Department of Community Safety in Johannesburg, requiring a diploma or degree in ICT and three years' relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: Matric Grade 12, plus two (03) year National Diploma in ICT or Bachelor’s degree in ICT (computer science or informatics). 3 years' experience at administrative/ supervisory level in similar position, Experience in managing and monitoring service performance. ITIL Certificate will serve as a strong advantage. A valid code 8/10 driver’s license. No criminal record or any cases pending against you. Knowledge and Skills: Development and implementation of IT policies and procedures. CoBlT and ITIL knowledge beyond theory. He/she has participated in specific education about how to apply Understanding project management principles and best practices. Understanding different IT processes. Relevant Public Service Regulations. Geographical distribution of departments and composition thereof. Understanding Provincial and SITA procurement model. Understanding of expectations of customers. Knowledge of SLAs Management. A good understanding of the organization's business and how IT contributes to it. Skills: Very strong communication skills: oral, written, presentation, facilitation. Ability to think and act both strategically and tactically. Technical understanding with ability to translate into business concepts, ITIL best practices, Credibility and trust; ideally has earned the respect of IT managers and other business managers at all levels. Ability to work under fire; handle stressful situations in a calm manner. Relationship management and conflict resolution skills. The ability to bring together and work with a team of people with varied backgrounds business analysts, technical experts, process owners - to articulate and remedy service level issues. A good understanding of the organization's IT infrastructure, services provided and customers/users. Patience, tolerance, resilience. Statistical, numerical and analytical principles and processes. Innovative thinking with service quality.
jobs.duties: Manage ICT Service: Ensure effective, efficient and reliable ICT services by: Identify IT services and service requirements, initiate service improvement actions. Define, build and manage the IT service catalogue. Effective management of contracts: Identify underpinning contracts service requirements, define build and negotiate service level agreements. Analyses and reviews all achieved service level agreement levels and conducts comparison with the SLA, monitor and manage service targets. Monitor and mitigate all ICT risks. Oversee regular audits performed to determine the efficiency and effectiveness of the SLA process. Coordinate and Facilitate ICT Projects: Develop and implement ICT Projects Methodologies. Monitor all ICT Projects by: Development, maintenance and monitoring of projects schedules, ensuring that agreed time frames are met and in the line with the expectations of the client. Track progress against projects and release plans, assess the performance of the assigned resources, ensure that technical issues are resolved in a timely manner. Manage resources (human, financial, equipment/assets): Responsible for coaching, discipling and mentoring of the staff to improve performance. Monitor the performance of staff and ensure assessment of their performance. Provide input in drafting of budget in the section. Control and monitor the sub section budget and expenditure. Coordinate the compilation of the various reports and statistics for the section. Manage leave of sub-ordinates.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. Tshidiso Chabane/ Mr. Vuyo Sondo Tel No: (011) 689 3845/ 3723/ 3847
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on new Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za/documents (effective from 01 January 2021). All fields in Part A to D of the Z83 form must be completed, and Part E to G noting that there is limited space provided applicants often indicate “refer” to CV or see attached, this is acceptable as long as the CV is attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. The question related to the conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered. Declaration must be completed and signed. The fully completed and signed new Z83 form should be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV only (only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications). Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applicants who do not comply with the above requirements, as well as late applications, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Suitable candidates will undergo a personnel suitability check (Vetting, criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification, and employment verification). The Department of Community Safety reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes. Candidate will be placed according to corridor coordination and the Department’s needs. The Department will not accept posted, emailed or hand delivered applications. We encourage youth, people with disability, coloured, Indian and white to apply and a confirmation of disabilities from a registered medical practitioner must be attached to the application. Please Note: Due to the large number of applications, we envisage to receive, applications will not be acknowledged. If you do not receive any response within 3 months, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Diensvlak en IK-projek
af.summary: Bestuur IK-diens en diensvlakooreenkomste vir die Gauteng Department of Community Safety in Johannesburg, wat 'n diploma of graad in IK en drie jaar se relevante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Matric Grade 12, plus twee (03) jaar se Nasionale Diploma in IK of 'n Bachelorsgraad in IK (rekenaarwetenskap of informatika). 3 jaar se ervaring op administratiewe/ toesighoudende vlak in 'n soortgelyke pos. Ervaring in die bestuur en monitering van diensprestasie. 'n ITIL-sertifikaat sal as 'n sterk voordeel dien. 'n Geldige kode 8/10 bestuurslisensie. Geen kriminele rekord of hangende sake teen u nie. Kennis en vaardighede: Ontwikkeling en implementering van IT-beleide en prosedures. CoBlT- en ITIL-kennis wat verder as teorie strek. Hy/sy het aan spesifieke opvoeding deelgeneem oor hoe om dit toe te pas. Begrip van projekbestuurbeginsels en beste praktyke. Begrip van verskillende IT-prosesse. Relevante Openbare Diensregulasies. Geografiese verspreiding van departemente en samestelling daarvan. Begrip van provinsiale en SITAverkrygingsmodel. Begrip van kliënteverwagtinge. Kennis van SDB-bestuur. 'n Goeie begrip van die organisasie se besigheid en hoe IT daartoe bydra. Vaardighede: Baie sterk kommunikasievaardighede: mondelings, skriftelik, aanbieding, fasilitering. Vermoë om beide strategies en takties te dink en op te tree. Tegniese begrip met vermoë om dit in besigheidskonsepte te vertaal, ITIL-bestepaktyke. Geloofwaardigheid en vertroue; het ideaal gesien die respek van IT-bestuurders en ander besigheidsbestuurders op alle vlakke verdien. Vermoë om onder druk te werk; hanteer stresvolle situasies op 'n kalm manier. Verhoudingsbestuur- en konflikoplossingsvaardighede. Die vermoë om 'n span mense met uiteenlopende agtergronde - besigheidsontleders, tegniese kundiges, proseseienaars - saam te bring en mee te werk om diensvlakkwessies te artikuleer en reg te stel. 'n Goeie begrip van die organisasie se IT-infrastruktuur, verskafde dienste en kliënte/gebruikers. Geduld, verdraagsaamheid, weerbaarheid. Statistiese, numeriese en analitiese beginsels en prosesse. Innovatiewe denke met dienskwaliteit.
af.duties: Bestuur IK-diens: Verseker effektiewe, doeltreffende en betroubare IK-diens deur: Identifiseer IT-dienste en diensvereistes, begin diensverbeteringsaksies. Definieer, bou en bestuur die IT-dienskatalogus. Effektiewe bestuur van kontrakte: Identifiseer onderlêende kontrakte se diensvereistes, definieer, bou en onderhandel diensvlakooreenkomste. Analiseer en hersien alle behaalde diensvlakooreenkomsvlakke en voer vergelyking met die SDB uit, monitor en bestuur diensdoelwitte. Monitor en matig alle IK-risiko's af. Hou toesig oor gereelde oudits wat uitgevoer word om die doeltreffendheid en effektiewiteit van die SDB-proses te bepaal. Koördineer en fasiliteer IK-projekte: Ontwikkel en implementeer IK-projekmetodologieë. Monitor alle IK-projekte deur: Ontwikkeling, instandhouding en monitering van projekskedules, verseker dat ooreengekome tydrame nagekom word en in ooreenstemming met die kliënt se verwagtinge is. Volg vordering teenoor projekte en vrystellingsplanne, beoordeel die prestasie van die toegewysde hulpbronne, verseker dat tegniese kwessies betyds opgelos word. Bestuur hulpbronne (menslike, finansiële, toerusting/bates): Verantwoordelik vir afrigting, tug en mentorskap van die personeel om prestasie te verbeter. Monitor die prestasie van personeel en verseker beoordeling van hul prestasie. Verskaf insette by die opstel van die begroting in die afdeling. Beheer en monitor die subafdelingsbegroting en -besteding. Koördineer die samestelling van die verskeie verslae en statistieke vir die afdeling. Bestuur verlof van ondergeskiktes.

zu.title: Umsekeli Woholi: Izinga Lesevisi Neprojekthi ye-ICT
zu.summary: Phatha izinsizakalo ze-ICT kanye nesivumelano sezinga lesevisi se-Gauteng Department of Community Safety e-Johannesburg, okudinga idiploma noma idigri ku-ICT kanye namawula amathathu okuhlangenwe nakho okuhambisana nalokhu.
zu.requirements: I-Matric Grade 12, okuhambisana ne-National Diploma yeminyaka emibili (03) ku-ICT noma i-Bachelor's degree ku-ICT (computer science noma informatics). 3 years' experience ezingeni lolawulo/abaholi kuleso sikhundla esifanayo, Okuhlangenwe nakho ekuphatheni nokuqaphela ukusebenza kohlangothi lwezinsizakalo. Isitifiketi se-ITIL sizoba usizo olukhulu. I-licensi evumelekileyo yekhodi 8/10. Kungabi nomlando wobugengu noma nanoma yimaphi iziqephu ezilindile. Ulwazi nezikhono: Ukuthuthukisa nokusebenzisa izinqubo kanye nezimalulelu zokuhlelelwa ze-IT. ULwazi lwe-CoBlT kanye ne-ITIL ngaphezu kwethiyori. Lowo/loye usebine nxaxhebe emfundo ethize ngendlela yokusebenzisa ukuqonda izimiso zokuqasha imisebenzi kanye namasiko ahamba phambili ekuqashweni kwemisebenzi. Ukuqonda izinqubo ezahlukene ze-IT. I-Public Service Regulations ezihambisana nalokhu. Ukusabalala ngegografi kwamayunithi aphathe kanye nokwakheka kwawo. Ukuqonda imodeli yokuthenga ezingeni lesifundazwe nakwi-SITA. Ukuqonda izinhlalo zithile abakulindile. Ulwazi lolawulo lwe-SLA. Ukuqonda kahle ishishino lonke lenhlangano kanye nendlela i-IT engeniswa kulo. Izikhono: Izikhono zokuxhumana ezinamandla kakhulu: okubukhulumayo, okulotshiwe, okubukhombiswayo, okuxhaswayo. Isakhono sokuqhakaza nokwenza ngobuhlakani bokulinganisa nangokuhlelela kahle, futhi ngendlela ekwazi ukusebenzisa kahle. Ukuqonda okubuchwepheshe okwazi ukuhumusha sibuyele emigqeni yeshishino. Izinkulumo eziqotho, amasiko aqotho, ukuzithoba; ukubekezelela ukuziphatha kahle. Ukusebenza ngaphansi koxanduva; Ukuphatha izimo ezinomsizi ngendlela ethule. Izikhono zokulawula ubudlelwano kanye nezinsika ezihamba phambili zokuqondanisa. Isikhono sokubutha futhi sisebenze nabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene - abahlola izindaba zeshishino, izazi zobuchwepheshe, abanikazi bezinqubo - ukuze kucaciswe futhi kulungiswe izinkinga zezinga lesevisi. Ukuqonda kahle izinsiza ze-IT, izinsizakalo ezinikezelwa kanye namakhasimuzi/abasebenzisi bale nhlangano. Ukubekezelela, ukuthwala, ukungathathi hlangothi. Izimiso kanye nezinqubo ezengezayo, izibalo kanye nokuqhuba imisebenzi ngendlela ehlaziwayo. UKucabanga ngendlela entsha ngenhloso yekhwalithi yesevisi.
zu.duties: Lawula Isevisi ye-ICT: Qinisekisa izinsizakalo ze-ICT ezingasizwa, ezisebenza ngokuphumelelayo nangokuthembekile ngokwenza: Ukuthola izinsizakalo ze-IT kanye nezidingo zesevisi, qala izinyathelo zokuphucula isevisi. Chaza, akha uphathe i-IT service catalogue. Ukuphatha amakontrakti ngokuphumelelayo: Thola kontrakti abasiza izidingo zesevisi, chaza akha uxoxe ngamavesi wezinga lensevisi. Hlaziya uphinde uhlole amazinga wonke ama-SLA afinyelelwe wenze ukuqhathaniswa ne-SLA, qaphela uphathe izinhloso zesevisi. Qaphela uphume izingozi zonke ze-ICT. Buka ngokuphephile izihlobo ezenzwa njalo ukuze kutholakale ukusebenza kahle nokuqotho kwemigqo ye-SLA. Hlanganisa futhi uxhase amaprojekthi we-ICT: Thuthukisa usebenzise Izigaba zokuqasha amaprojekthi we-ICT. Qaphela wonke amaprojekthi we-ICT ngokuthuthukisa, ukulondolozela kanye noqeqesho lwesikhathi. Qinisekisa ukuthi izikhathi ezivunyelene ziyahambisana nezimfanelo ze-Gauteng Department of Community Safety. Landela inqubomgomo yamaphrojekthi avela nazo zonke izinhlelo zokuveza amaphrojekthi ahamba phambili; Uhlole ukusebenza koluntu oluthunyelwe, qinisekisa ukuthi izinkinga zobuchwepheshe zisizwa ngokushesha. Phatha izinsiza (abantu, imali, izinsiza/izimpahla): Uxolo ekuphateni, ukuqeqesha ukuzigcwalisa nokukhuthaza ukulunga kwabasebenzi ngokuphucula ukusebenza. Qaphela ukusebenza kwabasebenzi ukuthi kuyilunga kanjani kubuye uhlole. Nikeza umbhalo othile osizayo ekuthuthukiseni isabelo semali esigabeni. Lawula futhi uqeqele isabelo senani esigabeni kanye nezimali ezichithwayo. Hlanganisa ukuqoqa imibiko eyahlukene kanye nezibalo zalelo sigaba. Lawula ukushiywa kwabasebenzi abangaphansi.

xh.title: Umqondisi ongcwele: Iqanaba Lesebe kunye Neprojekthi ye-ICT
xh.summary: Lawula iinkonzo ze-ICT kunye nezivumelwano zesiqwenaba kwisebe lakwaGauteng leZokhuseleko Kwiluntu e-Johannesburg, kufuneka uthole i-diploma okanye idanga kwi-ICT kunye neminyaka emithathu yamava ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: I-Matric Grade 12, kwaye idiploma yebhaso lezwe (03) leminyaka kwi-ICT okanye i-Bachelor's degree kwi-ICT (isayensi yekhompyutha okanye i-informatics). 3 years' experience kwinqanaba lolawulo/lokulawula kwisithuba esifanayo, Amava ekulawulen nasekuqwalaselweni kusebenzo lwenkonzo. I-ITIL Certificate iya kuba ngumehluko ongundoqo. Ilayisenisi yomqhubi ekhethweyo ye-code 8/10. Akukho bung-calqngelwanga bokwenza ityala okanye naziphi na i-ndl ithuba ezintsundu ngokuchasene nawe. Ulwazi namakhono: Uphuhliso nokuqaliswa kweenkqubo kunye nemigaqo ye-IT. Ulwazi lwe-CoBlT nolwe-ITIL ngaphezu kwezibalo. Uye/waye ungene kulemfundo ethile ngendlela yokusebenzisa Ukuqonda iinkqubo zolawulo lweenkqubo zeprojekthi namanyathelo amagqibeleyo. Ukuqonda iinkqabo ezahlukeneyo ze-IT. Imigaqo ehambelanayo yoLawulo loLuntu. Isabalalo seyabavele ngemijelo kwiimimandla ezahlukeneyo elawulwa kwaye nalawo ahlukeneneyo. Ukuqonda iindlela zoluntu zokuThenga eSita. Ukuqonda iindlela abalangela abathengi. Ulwazi lolawulo lwe-SLA. Ukuqonda ngokubanzi ngomsebenzi wequmrhu yendlela nendlela i-IT ingenisa ngayo isigqibo. Amakhono: Amakhono obuntu obunamandla: okuthetha, okubaliweyo, okubonelelayo, okuncedisa. Ukukwazi ukucinga nokuziphatha ngokwamaqabanqabantu nakumashishini. Ukuqonda ngeemfihlo ngokunyathela nokuguqula iimbona ngokweshishini, iinkqubo ezilungileyo ze-ITIL, Ukuba ngowona kwaye uthenjwe; uyakwazi ukuba nxaxheba kumadododa e-IT namanye abaphathi beshishini kumanqanaba onke. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngeenguquko; ukuba nabambebele olunzima ngendlela ethule. Amakhono okulawula ubudlelwano nokusombulula iingxaki. Ukukwazi ukudibanisa nokusebenza nesebe labantu abavela kumagumbi ahlukeneyo abahlalutyi behlaziyo, iingcali zezobuchwepheshe, abanini inkqubo - ukuchaza nokusombulula iingxaki zesiqwenaba senkonzo. Ukuqonda okuqhelekileyo kohlalutyo olusemthethweni Iwequmrhu, iinkonzo ezinikiweyo kunye namathengi/abasebenzisi. Ukunyamezela, ukwamkela, ukumelana nobunzima. Iinkqubo nokuqonda izibalo, izibalo nolwazi lwezibalo ngenkqubo. Ukucinga ngeenkqubo ezintsha ngenkonzo esemgqeni.
xh.duties: Lawula iNkonzo ye-ICT: Qinisekisa iinkonzo ze-ICT ezisebenzayo, ezichanekileyo nokuqinisekileyo ngokwenza: Ukuchonga iinkonzo neemfuno ze-ICT, ukuqalisa iinkqubo zokuphucula iinkonzo. Ukuchaza, ukwakha nokulawula i-catalogue yenkonzo ye-ICT. Ukulawula ngokufanelekileyo amagqabantshintshi: Chonga iimfuno zamagqabantshintshi asekelwayo, chaza, yakha uze ulawule izivumelwano ngeqanaba lenkonzo. Ukuqamba kwaye uqwalasele onke amaqanaba ezivumelwano zesiqwanaba eafikelelwayo uze wenze uthelekiso nesi-SLA, ulawule uze ulawule iinjongo ze-ICT. Qwalasela uze unciphise onke amathuba okungasentla kwe-ICT. Qwalasela olovo olwenziwe rhoqo ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza nokusebenza ngokufanelekileyo kwenkqubo i-SLA. Lawula uze uncinge amashishini e-ICT: Phuhlisiza uze uqalise iinkqubo zobugcisa beprojekthi ze-ICT. Qwalasela zonke iiprojekthi ze-ICT ngokwenza: Uphuhliso, ukulondoloza nokuqwalasela kwesikhelela seeprojekthi, kuqinisekiswa ukuba amaxesha avunelwana agqitywe kwaye athobela iimfuno zabathengi. Landela intshukubak phantsi kweeprojekthi zeendlela zokhupho, qwalasela ukusebenza kwemithombo ezelweyo, kuqinisekiswa ukuba iingxaki zobugcisa zisombululwa ngelixesha elifanelekileyo. Lawula iimithobo (abantu, ezemali, izixhobo/impahla): Ubagcwele ekuyalweni, ekulawulweni kwemithetho nakukukhuthazeni abasebenzi ukuze kuphuculwe ukusebenza. Qwalasela ukusebenza kwabasebenzi uze uqinisekise ukuqwalaselwa kokuqwalaselwa kwabo. Nikela ngenkcazelo ekwakhiweni kwesethinge kwicandelo. Lawula uze uqwalasele ibhajethi yecandelo elincinci nentlawulo. Lawula ukuqulunqa iingxelo ngesibalo ngokwemimandla yalawulo. Lawula ukushiya kwabasebenzi abangaphantsi.

jobs.title: Assistant Director Enterprise Risk Management
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 per annum, plus service benefits
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for Enterprise Risk Management in the Department of Community Safety, requiring a diploma or degree and three years' supervisory experience.
jobs.requirements: Matric plus 3-year relevant National Diploma/Degree in Risk Management/ Internal Auditing/ Financial Accounting. (SAQA NQF level 6/7) and 3-year relevant experience. 3 years' experience at administrative/ supervisory level. No criminal record or any cases pending against you. A valid code 08/10 driver’s licence Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge of Risk Management Policies and Frameworks. Relevant legislations relating to Risk Management and understanding of the Department’s strategic objectives. Records Management, Report writing, Problem solving and analysis. Knowledge management, Change management, Business Continuity Management, Communication, Negotiation and Computer literacy. Attributes: Professionalism, Efficient and effective, Accessible. Team player, Customer focused, Proactive and resourceful. Quality oriented, Responsive, People oriented. Attention to detail, honesty and integrity.
jobs.duties: To supervise and implement the risk management framework in the organisation: Participate in the development of the risk management framework. Implement the risk management plan, Support the establishment of the risk management philosophy and culture in the organisation. Advocate and promote risk management in the organisation (awareness activities), Risk maturity-data gathering and quality review, Capacity building (training and development). Develop and maintain stakeholder and client relationships Continuous monitoring the risk environment. Collect statistical information on indicators of risks. Detect changes in the risk environment (internal and external context). Supervise the capturing of data and maintenance of databases on risk management information, Supervise and undertake studies and analysis for identifying risks to establish the internal and external organisation context. Supervise, facilitate and advice on the risk management assessment process. Facilitate the identification of risks, Analysis of risks, Risk evaluation, Risk response, Compile risk profile (ensure and maintain risk register. Compile reports as required, Monitor and review the identified risk response activities. Monitoring the implementation of the progress of activities to address risks as agreed on Revising risk response activities. Supervise employees to ensure an effective risk management service. This would, inter alia, entail the following. General supervision of employees. Allocate duties and perform quality control on the work delivered by supervisees. Advise and lead supervisees with regard to all aspects of the work. Manage performance, conduct and discipline of supervisees. Ensure that all supervisees are trained and developed to be able to deliver work of the required standard efficiently and effectively.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Avhatakali Nemukula/Mr. Vuyolwethu Sondo Tel No: (011) 689 3845/ 3723/
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on new Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za/documents (effective from 01 January 2021). All fields in Part A to D of the Z83 form must be completed, and Part E to G noting that there is limited space provided applicants often indicate “refer” to CV or see attached, this is acceptable as long as the CV is attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. The question related to the conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered. Declaration must be completed and signed. The fully completed and signed new Z83 form should be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV only (only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications). Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applicants who do not comply with the above requirements, as well as late applications, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Suitable candidates will undergo a personnel suitability check (Vetting, criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification, and employment verification). The Department of Community Safety reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes. Candidate will be placed according to corridor coordination and the Department’s needs. The Department will not accept posted, emailed or hand delivered applications. We encourage youth, people with disability, coloured, Indian and white to apply and a confirmation of disabilities from a registered medical practitioner must be attached to the application. Please Note: Due to the large number of applications, we envisage to receive, applications will not be acknowledged. If you do not receive any response within 3 months, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Assistentdirekteur Ondernemingsrisikobestuur
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur vir Ondernemingsrisikobestuur in die Department of Community Safety, wat 'n diploma of graad en drie jaar se toesigervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Matric plus 3-jarige relevante Nasionale Diploma/Graad in Risikobestuur/ Interne Oudit/ Finansiële Rekeningkunde. (SAQA NQF level 6/7) en 3-jaar relevante ervaring. 3 jaar se ervaring op administratiewe/ toesighoudende vlak. Geen strafrekord of hangende sake teen jou nie. 'n Geldige kode 08/10 bestuurderslisensie Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van Risikobestuurbeleide en -raamwerke. Relevante wetgewing met betrekking tot Risikobestuur en begrip van die departement se strategiese doelwitte. Rekordbestuur, verslagskrywing, probleemoplossing en analise. Kennisbestuur, veranderingsbestuur, besigheidskontinuïteitsbestuur, kommunikasie, onderhandeling en rekenaarvaardigheid. Eienskappe: Professionalisme, doeltreffend en effektief, toeganklik. Spanspeler, klieïngefokus, proaktief en vindingryk. Kwaliteitsgerig, responsief, mensegerig. Aandag aan besonderhede, eerlikheid en integriteit.
af.duties: Om die risikobestuurraamwerk in die organisasie te toesig te hou en te implementeer: Neem deel aan die ontwikkeling van die risikobestuurraamwerk. Implementeer die risikobestuurplan, Ondersteun die vestiging van die risikobestuurfilosofie en -kultuur in die organisasie. Pleit en bevorder risikobestuur in die organisasie (bewustheidsaktiwiteite), Risikovolwassenheid-data-insameling en kwaliteits hersiening, Kapasiteitsbou (opleiding en ontwikkeling). Ontwikkel en onderhou belanghebbende- en kliëntverhoudings Deurlopende monitering van die risikoomgewing. Versamel statistiese inligting oor aanwysers van risiko's. Bespeur veranderings in die risikoomgewing (interne en eksterne konteks). Toesig hou oor die vaslegging van data en instandhouding van databasisse oor risikobestuurinligting, Toesig hou oor en onderneem studies en analise om risiko's te identifiseer om die interne en eksterne organisasiekonteks te vestig. Toesig hou, fasiliteer en adviseer oor die risikobestuurbeoordelingsproses. Fasiliteer die identifisering van risiko's, Analise van risiko's, Risikoevaluering, Risikorespons, Stel risikoprofiel op (verseker en onderhou risikoregister. Stel verslae op soos vereis, Monitor en hersien die geïdentifiseerde risikoresponsaktiwiteite. Monitering van die implementering van die vordering van aktiwiteite om risiko's aan te spreek soos ooreengekom op Hersiening van risikoresponsaktiwiteite. Toesig hou oor werknemers om 'n effektiewe risikobestuurdiens te verseker. Dit sal, onder andere, die volgende behels. Algemene toesig oor werknemers. Wys pligte toe en voer kwaliteitskontrolle uit op die werk wat deur toesigtiges gelewer word. Adviseer en lei toesigtiges met betrekking tot alle aspekte van die werk. Bestuur prestasie, gedrag en dissipline van toesigtiges. Verseker dat alle toesigtiges opgelei en ontwikkel word om werk van die vereiste standaard doeltreffend en effektief te kan lewer.

zu.title: UmKhandeli Wezinsi Ezingavi Ngozimphi I Wokuqasha I Womphakathi
zu.summary: UmKhandeli Wezinsi Ezingavi Ngozimphi I Wokuqasha I Womphakathi KwiNkundla Yezokhululeka Kwendalo, Ofuna idiploma okanye isidanga kunye nokulingana kweminyaka elithathu kumsebenzi wokuqonda nabantu.
zu.requirements: Imatiriki ngesidanga sezwe seNQF level 6/7 ekuzikhandeni nge-Risk Management/ Internal Auditing/ Financial Accounting. (SAQA NQF level 6/7) kwaye unamava amnyaka amathathu ekuzikhandeni. Unamava eminyaka elithathu kwelinye inqanaba lesikhosi. Akukho ntlonipo okanye izigqibo ezingekayo ngokuchasene nawe. Unelayisensi yokushibula eqinisekisiweyo code 08/10 Ulwazi nobuchule: Ulwazi ngemigaqo ye-Risk Management kunye nezakhiwo. Imigaqo enjalo malunga ne-Risk Management nokutbukiswa kwezizinhloso eziyi strategic zeNkundla. Ukulawula amarekhodi, ukubhala iireporti, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqonda. Ulwazi lokulawula, ukutshintsha ukulawula, ukulawula uqhagamshelo lwebhizinisi, ukuthetha, ukuxoxisana nokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Iimpawu: Ubuchwepheshe, ukusebenza kakuhle nangempumelelo, ukufikeleleka. Ukudlala njengelungu leqela, ukujolisa kumthengi, ukuba phambili nokuba nefuthe. Ukujolisa kwikhwalithi, ukusabela, ukujolisa kwabantu. Ukwazisa iinkcukacha, inyaniselo nokuzithemb.
zu.duties: Ukulawula nokusebenzisa isakhina se-Risk Management kumsebenzi: Thatha inxaxheba ekuyilweni isakhina se-Risk Management. Sebenzisa icebo le-Risk Management, Xhasa ukumiswa kwejelo nengqiqo ye-Risk Management kumsebenzi. Phakamisa kwaye ukhuthaze i-Risk Management kumsebenzi (imisebenzi yokwazisa), Ukuthatha i-data ye-Risk maturity nokuqonda ikhwalithi, Ukwakha amandla (uqeqesho nentluko). Phucula kwaye ulondoloze ubudlelwane nabathengi njalo kulawule okusingqongileyi se-Risk. Qokelela iinkcukacha zezibalo ngezibonakaliso zeengozi. Qaphela iitshintsho ekwindawo esemngcele yengozi (ngaphakathi nangaphandle). Lawula ukuqokelelwa kwe-data nolondoloko lwedatabase yolwazi nge-Risk Management, Lawula kwaye wenze izifundo nokuhlola ukuze uqonde iingozi ukuze umise imiba engaphakathi nangaphandle komsebenzi. Lawula, xhasa kwaye nike icebiso ngomsebenzi wokuqondisiswa kwe-Risk Management. Xhasa ukumanywa kweengozi, ukuhlola iingozi, ukulinganisa iingozi, ukusabela kweengozi, Qamba iprofayile yeengozi (qinisekisa kwaye ulondoloze isiza seengozi. Qamba iireporti njengoko kufuneka, Qwalasela kwaye uhlolisise imisebenzi yokusabela iingozi ekuqaphelelweyo. Qwalasela ukusetyenziswa kwendlela yemisebenzi yokulinganisa iingozi njengoko kuvunyelwe. Ukutlhengisa imisebenzi yokusabela iingozi. Lawula abasebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe isikhundla se-Risk Management. Oku kuya kubandakanya, kunye nezinye, oku kulandelayo. Ulawulo olubanzi lwabasebenzi. Yabelamisebenzi kwaye wenze ulawulo lwebhanti kwimisebenzi ebanjwe ngabasebenzi abalawulwayo. Nike icebiso kwaye uzoke abasebenzi abalawulwayo kuzo zonke iindawo zomsebenzi. Lawula ukusebenza, ukuziphatha nobumfama ngabasebenzi abalawulwayo. Qinisekisa ukuba bonke abasebenzi abalawulwayo baqeqeshiwe bakhulile ukuze bakwazi ukunika umsebenzi ochanekileyo ngokuchanekileyo nangempumelelo.

xh.title: Umncedi weNkulumbuso eyiSikhulu Esincedisayo, uMlawulo woMngcipheko weShishini
xh.summary: ISikhulu Esincedisayo soMlawulo woMngcipheko weShishini kwiSebe loKhuseleko lweNxulumlamntu, sifuna idiploma okanye izidanga kunye neminyaka emithathu yamava aphethe abantu.
xh.requirements: Imatric kunye ne-National Diploma/Degree yeminyaka emi-3 ekufanelekileyo kuMlawulo woMngcipheko/ ukuQwalasela ngaphakathi/ ukuBala iZimali. (SAQA NQF level 6/7) kunye namava amnyaka emi-3 akufanelekayo. Iimvo zamnyaka emi-3 kwinqanaba lolawulo/ ophethe abantu. Akukho nkcitha yobugwala okanye naliphi na icala elisasandlula ngakuni. Ilayisensi yomqhubi ekhoyo ye-code 08/10 ULwazi nakhono: Ulwazi ngeMigaqo neNkqubo zoMlawulo woMngcipheko. Imithetho yomthetho echangwe kuMlawulo woMngcipheko nokuqonda iinjongo ezibalulekileyo zoSebe. uLawulo lwepepa, ukuBala iingxelo, ukuSombulula iingxaki nokuQwalasela. uLawulo lolwazi, uLawulo lokutshintsha, uLawulo loQhingelo loQhubela phambili, uNxibelelwano, ukuNxibelelana nokwaziswa kwiKhompyutha. Iimpawu: uBungcali, ukusebenza ngokusebenza kakuhle nangokuchanekileyo, ukufikeleleka. uKdlalela eqhweni, ukujolisa kumthengi, ukuziqhelanisa nangaphambili nokuba nemithombo. Ukujolisa kwisilinganiso, ukuphendula, ukujolisa kwabantu. Kuqwalaselwe iinkcukacha, inyaniso nolungeko.
xh.duties: Ukuqhuba nokusebenzisa inkqubo yolawulo womngcipheko kumashishini: Thatha inxaxheba ekuthuthweni kwenkqubo yolawulo womngcipheko. Sebenzisa icebo lolawulo womngcipheko, Nxiba ukumiswakwobuzo bonke namasiko olawulo womngcipheko kumashishini. Phengisa kunye nokukhuthaza ulawulo lomngcipheko kumashishino (imisebenzi yokwazisa), uKwazi ukugcina amathambo-xa uqokelela iingcelo, iXabiso elingcono lemveliso kunye nokuqokelelwa kwemithombo yolwazi. Yakha ulwazi (uqeqeshe kunye nentluko). Phuhlisa ngokuhamba kwexesha ubudlelwane bobujoli bakho nabo babathengi uQwalaselwa ngokubiwo kwemilinganiselo yokusingatha iindaba. Qokelela iinkcukacha ezibonisa imilinganiselo yomngcipheko. Phawula ukutshintsha kwindawo yolawulo lomngcipheko (ngaphakathi nangaphandle). Qhuba uqokelelo lwemilinganiselo yolwazi nolondolozeemvumi yolwazi ngomngcipheko, Qhuba uphenyo lolwazi nokuqwalasela ukuze Umqulu wezinto ezingcolisa ubucwazi bahlo phakathi nangaphandle kwalo msebenzi womntu ophetheyo. Qhuba, yenza kwaye ulule ngenkqubo yolawulo lokuqwalasela komngcipheko. Yenza kubonakale iindaba ezingcolisa ubucwazi bahlelwe ngokulungileyo, uQwalasela iindaba ezingcolisa ubucwazi bahle, Zonke izinto ezingcolisa ubucwazi zilungela ukuqwalaselwa kwaye nazo zonke iindaba ezilawulwa zibhalwe phantsi. Yenza iingxelo ezifunekayo, Qwalasela ngokuhamba kwexesha zonke iindaba ezilungelanisiweyo ngokukhankanywe apha ngasentla ngokuchasenayo okanye ngokudibanisa. Qhuba abantu abasebenzayo ukwenzaukuba basebenze ngokusebenza kakuhle nokugqibeleleyo kolawulo lomngcipheko. Oku kuya kubandakanya, phakathi kwezinye, oku kulandelayo. Ukuqhuba ngokubanzi abantu abasebenzayo. Abanike imisebenzi ngenkundla yokuqinisekisa ukulunga kolusebenzo abalunikiweyo. Banikezelengomceli ngokulunga ngemigaqo nayimithetho esetyenziswa ngalo wonke umntu ophethe. Balawule ukuphumeza imigaqo yokwenza nokuziphatha kwabo baphetheyo. af.title: Hoofprovinsiale Inspekteur
af.summary: Hoofprovinsiale Inspekteur in Soweto wat padverkeer- en openbare vervoerwetgewing handhaaf, wat 'n Basiese Verkeersdiploma en 6 tot 10 jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat of hoër kwalifikasie. Moet in besit wees van 'n Basiese Verkeersdiploma. 6 - 10 jaar se werkservaring in die veld. Alle geldige relevante bestuurslisensies (A en EC). Geen strafrekord nie. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van uitgebreide ervaring in padverkeer- en Openbare Vervoerbeleid en -regulasies. Regshandhawingskennis in verkeer- en Openbare Vervoervoertuiginspeksies. Voertuigbeslaglegging. Voltooiing van regshandhawing en dokumente. Vaardighede en bevoegdhede in rekordbestuur. Hulpbronbestuur. Kliëntverhoudingsbestuur. Beplanning. Organisering. Leiding. Beheer. Monitering. Mensebestuur. Dienslewering. Kommunikasie. Besluitneming. Resultate- en gehaltebestuur. Probleemoplossing. Skryfwerk en verslagdoening. Arbeidsverhoudinge. Bestuursvaardighede. Ondersoekvaardighede. Motiveringsvaardighede. Innovasie/ deurlopende verbetering. Analitiese vaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Operasies/Projekbestuur.
af.duties: Bestuur en handhaaf Padverkeer-, Openbare Passasiers-, Vervoerwetgewing en ander relevante wetgewing. Ontwikkeel operasionele strategieë en verseker implementering van goedgekeurde verkeersregshandhawingsstrategieë. Verseker die vrye vloei van verkeer deur punkplig en verkeersbeheer by besoekte areas, koördineer aktiwiteite, en beskerm ongelukstonele. Beplan en bestuur spoedtoetsoperasies. Koördineer uitvoering van arres op verkeersverwante aangeleenthede, woon hofverrigtinge by, en lewer getuienis. Bestuur prosesse van uitreiking van relevante kennisgewings aan oortreders. Bestuur verkeerspolisiëringsprojekte. Identifiseer en adviseer relevante rolspelers oor gevaarlike plekke. Bestuur begeleiding van abnormale voertuie en vragte om veilige beweging daarvan te verseker. Bestuur monitering van padluiwagte en sosiale gebeurtenisse en koördineer oorladingbeheerbestuur (sluit goedere en passasiers in). Bestuur gesamentlike regshandhawingsaktiwiteite en projekte (koöperatiewe bestuur): Neem deel aan beplanning van gesamentlike handhawingsstrategieë en projekte. Bestuur die uitvoering van gesamentlike regshandhawingsstrategieë en projekte. Evalueer en rapporteer oor strategieë en projekte. Bestuur hulpbronne en verskaf leierskap en rigting aan alle ondergeskiktes: Ontwikkel en handhaaf 'n moniteringstelsel en verseker dat balans bereik word met betrekking tot Senior Provinsiale Inspekteurs (SPIS) en Provinsiale Inspekteurs (Pls) produksie, insluitend statistieke van produksie van SPIS en Pls. Implementeer innovasies om die werksomgewing te verbeter en voer besoeke aan beamptes in die veld uit. Help met die opdatering van die omgewingsontleding om te verseker dat dit as 'n basislyn vir beplanning gebruik word. Voer basiese bestuursfunksies uit (beplanning, organiserig, leiding en beheer). Voer beplannings-, terugvoer-, evaluerings- en inligtingsdelingsvergaderings met ondergeskiktes uit. Help met menslike hulpbronkwessies by die stasie en koördineer personeel se kwartaallikse prestasie-evaluerings. Identifiseer en bestuur risiko's: Identifiseer relevante risiko's. Ontwikkel 'n plan om risiko's aan te spreek. Implementeer en monitor plan. Evalueer vordering. Bestuur die prestasie van alle administratiewe aktiwiteite en verwante pligte. Verseker dat die motorvoertuigvloot behoorlik bestuur word. Monitor die toestand van toerusting en help met proaktiewe vervangingsbeplanning, insluitend die identifiseer en monitor van lede betrokke by ongelukke. Reëlmatige begrotingsbeheer- en bestuursbesprekings as deel van bestuursvergaderings en deel inligting met lede rakende die sentrum se begrotingsprioriteite.

zu.title: Umphathi Wamaphrovinsi (Principal Provincial Inspector)
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi wamaphrovinsi (Principal Provincial Inspector) eSoweto ophoqa umthetho wezokuthutha nomthetho wezokuthutha komphakathi, ofuna i-Basic Traffic Diploma kanye neminyaka eyi-6 kuya kwayi-10 yohlelo lokusebenza.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 noma izifundo eziphezudidi. Kufanele abe ne-Basic Traffic Diploma. 6 - 10 iminyaka yohlelo lokusebenza endimeni. Zonke izelayisense zokushayela eziseduze (A kanye ne-EC). Kungabi yirekhodi lobugebengu. Ulwazi nobukhali: Ulwazi ngohlelo olubanzi lokuthola imfundo nasesimisweni sezokuthutha kanye nezinqumo zomphakathi kanye nomthetho. Ulwazi lokuphoqa umthetho ezokuthutha kanye nokuhlola Izimoto Zomphakathi. Ukubamba izimoto. Ukugcwaliseka kokuphoqa umthetho namadokhumenti. Amakhono namandla ekulawuleni amarekhodi. Ukulawula amasiza. Ukuphathwa kwebandla labathengi. Ukubumba. Ukuhlela. Ukuhola. Ukulawula. Ukulandelela. Ukulawula Abantu. Ukulethwa kwenkonzo. Ukuthumela imiyalezo. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuphatha imiphumela kakhulu. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukubhala nokubika. Izenzakalo zomsebenzi. Amakhono okushayela. Amakhono okuphenya. Amakhono okukhuthaza. Ukuthuthukisa okuqhubekayo. Amakhono okuhlaziya. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Ukuphatha imisebenzi/amaphrojekthi.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi ulawule umthetho wezokuthutha ezindaweni, wezokuthutha kwabagibeli borchwephebe, wemithetho yezokuthutha kanye namanye umthetho ohlobene nokuqukethwe. Bunglela izindlela zokusebenza futhi uqiniseke ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela ezamukelwe zokuphoqa umthetho wezokuthutha. Qinisekisa ukugeleza kwezokuthutha ngokusebenza emahhovisi nolawulo lwezokuthutha ezindaweni ezinovalo, hlanganisa izenzo, futhi uvikele izikhundla ezibekiwe lapho kwenzeke izehlakalo. Cwangcisa futhi uphathe imisebenzi yokuhlola isivinini. Hlanganisa ukwenziwa kokuweba ngemibuzo ehlobene nezokuthutha, zikhatsi uphuma enkantolo, futhi unike ifa lemininingwane. Phatha inqubo yokukhipha izaziso ezifanele kubenzi ubugebengu. Phatha amaphrojekthi obulumko bezokuthutha. Hlukanisa futhi uphakamise kubalingisi abafanele ngendawo ezinengozi. Phatha ukugqugquzela izimoto ezingajwayelekile nemithwalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunyakaza okuphephile. Phatha ukulandelela imikhosi yezindawo zezemidlalo kanye nemikhosi yomphakathi futhi uhlanganise ulawulo lokulawula ukugqwala (okufaka impahla nabagibeli). Phatha imisebenzi ehlangene yokuphoqa umthetho kanye namaphrojekthi (buhulumeni ohlanganisiwe): Thatha inhlangothi ekubumbeni izindlela zokuphoqa umthetho kanye namaphrojekthi. Phatha ukwenziwa kwezindlela zokuphoqa umthetho namaphrojekthi. Hlola futhi umbike ngezindlela namaphrojekthi. Phatha izinsiza futhi unikeze ubuholo nokuqondisa onke abangaphansi kwakho: Bungelela futhi ugqize inkqubo yokulandelela futhi uqiniseke ukuthi kufezeleka ngokuphathelene nokukhiqiza abaphathi abaphezulu bamaphrovinsi (SPIS) kanye nabaphathi bamaphrovinsi (Pls), okuhlanganisa izibalo zokukhiqiza kwaSPIS nakwaPls. Phatha okuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwendawo yokusebenza futhi wenzi izivakashi kwabashayeli abasendaweni. Siza ekubumbeni kwenhlalakahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusetshenziswa kwayo njengesisekelo sobumbeko. Yenza imisebenzi yezinto eziyisisekelo yokuphatha (ukubumba, ukuhlela, ukuhola kanye nolawulo). Yenza izinkomfa zobumbeko, imiphumela, ukuhlola, nokwabelana ngezinkomba nabangaphansi. Siza ngemibuzo yabantu esiteshini futhi uhlanganise ukuhlola ukusebenza kwabasebenza ngesikhashana. Hlukanise futhi uphathe imingcele: Hlukanise imingcele ehlobene. Bungelela indlela yokubhekana nemingcele. Yenza futhi ulandelele indlela. Hlola inqubo. Phatha ukusebenza kwayo yonke imisebenzi yolawulo kanye nemisebenzi ehlobene. Qinisekisa ukuthi ibhasi lezimoto liphatshwe kahle. Landelela isimo sezinkamba futhi siza ekubumbeni okubikezelayo kokushintsha, okuhlanganisa ukuhlukanisa futhi kulandelele amalungu abandakanyeka ezehlakalweni. Qinisekisa izindlela ezisebenzayo zolawulo lokulahlekelwa zisendaweni ukuze zibhekane nokulahlekelwa izibhamu kanye nezinye izinsiza ezihlobene futhi uzame ukwehlisa inani lemali ehlulekile. Thatha inhlangothi ekubumbeni kwesabelomali njengoba kudingwa umphathi wesikhungo. Landelela imibiko yokushiswa kwemali ngenyanga kanye namarekhodi ukuhlola avela kwiphrovinsi futhi ufake izinyathelo zokulungisa ezindaweni ezinengozi. Yenza izinkulumiswano ezijwayelekile zolawulo kanye nokuphatha isabelo njengengxenye yezinkomfa zokuphatha futhi wabelane ngolwazi namalungu ngemibhalo yesabelomali yomphakathi.

xh.title: ISikhulu esiPhambili seSiwingi samaphondo
xh.summary: ISikhulu esiPhambili seSiwingi samaphondo eSoweto esiphoqa umthetho wekhusi leendlela noluhambahambo koluntu, kufuneka kubekho iDiploma yokuQala yeKhusi leendlewa neminyaka yamava eyi6 ukuya kwi10.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethe seGrade 12 okanye izidanga eziphakamileyo. Kufuneka kubekho iDiploma yokuQala yeKhusi leendlewa. Iiyahele eziyiminyaka eyi6 - 10 yokusebenza kule ndawo. Zonke iilayisenisi zokushayela ezisebenzayo nezifanelekileyo (A neEC). Akukho ntlola yobugebenga. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemiva emininzi kumthetho wekhusi leendlewa kunye noLuhambahambo loLuntu namacebo alo. Ulwazi ngokuqinisekiswa komthetho ekhusini leendlewa nokuKhangela izithuthi zoLuhambahambo loLuntu. Ukuhomba kwezithuthi. Ukuqedwa kokuphoqa komthetho kunye namaxwebhu. Amakhono namandla okulawula urekhodi. Ukuqulunqa imithombo. Ukulawula ubudlelwane nabathengi. Ukuqulunqa. Ukuhlela. Ukukhokela. Ukulawula. Ukuqaphela. UkuLawula abaBantu. Ukunikela ngenkonzo. Unxibelelwano. Ukwenza isigqibo. UkuLawula iziphumo kunye nomgangatho. Ukuzonakalisa iingxaki. UkuBhala nokuBika. Ubudlelwano boBasebenzi. Amakhono okuShayela. Amakhono oPononxibo. Amakhono okuKhuthaza. Intsingiselo/ukuphucula ngokuqhubeka. Amakhono oKuhlalutyo. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. UkuLawula iNhlah/amaPhrojekthi.
xh.duties: Ukulawula nokuphoqa uMthetho weKhusi leendlewa, uMthetho woBakhenkethi boLuntu, uMthetho woLuhambahambo namanye omthetho ofanelekileyo. Ukuqulunqa iindlela ezisebenzayo kuqinisekise ukusebenza kweendlela ezamkelekileyo zokuphoqa umthetho wekhusi leendlewa. Kuqinisekise ukujikeleza okukhululekileyo kwezithuthi ngenkxaso yendawo nolawulo lweekhusi kwindawo eziqhotyoshisayo, uqhube imisebenzi, uze uvikele iindawo zeengozi. Uqulunqe ulawule imisebenzi yokuvavanya isantya. Uqhubele phambili ukwenziwa kokuthatywa kwabantu ngenxa yezendlela, uze ukhona iinkqubo zeenkantilo uze ubanike ubungqina. Ulawule iinkqubo zokunika izaziso ezifanelekileyo abo baphula umthetho. Ulawule amaphrojekthi ekhusini leendlewa. Uchaze uye uxele abo baluleko kakhulu ngendawo ezingoziyo. Ulawule ukukhuselwa kwezithuthi ezingaqhelekanga nemitwalo ukuqinisekisa ukusuka hamba kwazo ngokhuselekileyo. Uqophe ulawulo lweendlela zezemidlalo nemicimbi yentlalo uze uqhube ulawulo lokugqithiswa komthwalo (kuquka imithwalo ngokwemibutho nabakhenkethi). Uqophe izigqibo ekuphotheni umthetho kunye namaphrojekthi (ulawulo olubambisene): Uluncedo kubeni inkqubo yokulawula iindawo ezihamba ngesithuba. Ulawule ukuphotha kwamaphrojekthi kunye namacebo. Uhlaluthe uze ubike ngamacebo namaphrojekthi. Uqulunqe ulawule izinto ezibonelela ngolawulo ngaboni bakhokela uze uqinisekise ukuba nayo iquguqela phakathi kukaBaQaphi eBakhulu abaPhondo (SPIS) kwaye uLawulwa ziPhondo (Pis) eziqulunqayo, kuquka nazo iitilathi ngenxa yabantu abakhiwa yiSPIS nePIs. Ufake izinto ezintsha ukuze ubungcono imeko yokusebenza uze uhambe kumagosa abakwindawo esemthethweni. Uncede ngokuhlaziya uhlalutyo lwendawo ukuqinisekisa ukuba lusetyenziswa njengesiseko soqulunqo. Uzenza imisebenzi engundoqo yolawulo (ukuqulunqa, ukuhlela, ukukhokela ukulawula). Uqulunqe, unike amava, uhlaluthe uze wabelane nolwazi ngeendibano ezinxulumene nabagcina bendlewa. Uncede ngemiba yomthombo womntu kwisikhululo uze uqhube iqondo labaqaphi ngokwamakota. Uchaze ulawule iingozi: Uchaze iingozi ezifanelekileyo. Uqulunqe isicwangciso sokubhekana neengozi. Ufake uze ulawule isicwangciso. Uhlaluthe inkqubo. Ulawula ukuphumeza imisebenzi yolawulo lonke neyomkhwa. Uqinisekise ukuba iqela lezithuthi liphathwa ngendlela efanelekileyo. Uqophe imeko yemixhobo uze uncene ngokwexesha elidlulayo, ukuqapha abo bagcina imixhobo abo babandakanyekile kwengozi. Uqinisekise ukuba kukho iinkqubo ezisebenzayo zokuqhathanisa imiba yokulahlekelwa yiyo nayiphi na into ebalulekileyo ngaphakathi kwesikhulolo.

af.title: Hoofprovinsiale Inspekteur
af.summary: Hoofprovinsiale Inspekteur in Johannesburg wat padverkeer- en openbare vervoerwetgewing vir die Department of Community Safety bestuur en handhaaf.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat of hoër kwalifikasie. Must be in possession of a Basic Traffic Diploma. 6 - 10 jaar se werkservaring in die veld. All valid relevant driving licenses (A and EC). Geen strafblad nie. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge of Extensive experience in road traffic and Public Transport policies and regulations. Law enforcement knowledge in traffic and Public Transport Vehicle inspections. Vehicle Impoundment. Completion of law enforcement and documents. Skills and competencies in records management. Resource management. Customer relationship management. Planning. Organizing. Leading. Controlling. Monitoring. People Management. Service delivery. Communication. Decision-making. Results and quality management. Problem solving. Writing & Reporting. Labour Relations. Driving skills. Investigation skills. Motivational skills. Innovation/ continuous improvement. Analytical skills. Computer literacy. Operations/Projects management.
af.duties: Bestuur en handhaaf padverkeer-, openbare passasiers- en vervoerwetgewing asook ander relevante wetgewing. Ontwik operasionele strategieë en verseker implementering van goedgekeurde verkeersregtoepassingsstrategieë. Verseker die vrye vloei van verkeer deur puntbeheer en verkeersbeheer by besoekte gebiede, koördineer aktiwiteite, en beveilig ongelukstonele. Beplan en bestuur spoedtoetsoperasies. Koördineer die uitvoering van arrestasies rakende verkeerverwante sake, woon hofverrigtinge by, en lewer getuienis. Bestuur prosesse vir die uitreik van relevante kennisse aan oortreders. Bestuur verkeerspolisieprojekte. Identifiseer en adviseer relevante rolspelers oor gevaarlike plekke. Bestuur die begeleiding van abnormale voertuie en vragte om die veilige beweging daarvan te verseker. Bestuur die monitering van padsport- en sosiale gebeurtenisse en koördineer oorlaai-beheerbestuur (sluit goedere en passasiers in). Bestuur gesamentlike regtoepassingsaktiwiteite en -projekte (koöperatiewe regering): Neem deel aan die beplanning van gesamentlike regtoepassingsstrategieë en -projekte. Bestuur die uitvoering van gesamentlike regtoepassingsstrategieë en -projekte. Evalueer en rapporteer oor strategieë en projekte. Bestuur hulpbronne en verskaf leierskap en rigting aan alle ondergeskiktes: Ontwikkel en onderhou 'n moniteringstelsel en verseker dat balans bereik word ten opsigte van Senior Provincial Inspectors (SPIS) en Provincial Inspectors (Pls) se produksie, insluitend statistieke van produksie van SPIS en Pls. Implementeer innovasies om die werksomgewing te verbeter en doen besoeke aan beamptes in die veld. Bystand met die bywerking van die omgewingsanalise om te verseker dat dit as 'n basislyn vir beplanning gebruik word. Voer basiese bestuursfunksies uit (beplanning, organisering, leiding en beheer). Voer beplannings-, terugvoer-, evaluerings- en inligtingsdelingsvergaderings met ondergeskiktes uit. Bystand met menslike hulpbronkwessies by die stasie en koördineer personeel se kwartaallikse prestasie-evaluerings. Identifiseer en bestuur risiko's: Identifiseer relevante risiko's. Ontwikkel 'n plan om risiko's aan te spreek. Implementeer en monitor die plan. Evalueer vordering. Bestuur die uitvoering van alle administratiewe aktiwiteite en verwante pligte. Verseker dat die motorvoertuigvloot behoorlik bestuur word. Monitor die toestand van toerusting en help met proaktiewe vervangingsbeplanning, insluitend die identifisering en monitering van lede wat by ongelukke betrokke is. Verseker dat doeltreffende verliesbeheermaatreëls in plek is om die verlies van vuurwapens en ander verwante toerusting aan te spreek en streef daarna om die finansiële waarde van verliese te verminder. Neem deel aan begrotingsbeplanning soos deur die Sentrumbestuurder vereis. Monitor maandelikse uitgawes- en inspeksieverslae van die provinsie en implementeer regstellende optrede in probleemareas. Reëlmatige begrotingsbeheer- en bestuursbesprekings as deel van bestuursvergaderings en deel inligting met lede rakende die sentrum se begrotingsprioriteite.

zu.title: Isiphathi Sezwe Esinhloko
zu.summary: Isiphathi Sezwe Esinhloko eJohannesburg esibusa futhi siphathamise umthetho wezokuthutha ezindleleni kanye nomthetho wezokuthutha komphakathi wokuhamba abantu woku Department of Community Safety.

Amalayisensi wokushayela ongawo wonke ahambisana nalokhu (A kanye ne-EC). Kungabi nerekhodi lezenzo eziphambene nomthetho. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi lolunye ulwazi olunzulu ezintweni zezokuthutha ezindleleni kanye namapholisi nezimiso zokuthutha komphakathi. Ulwazi lwemithetho eqhothisayo kokuhlolwa kwezimoto nokuhlolwa kwezimoto zokuthutha komphakathi. Ukubamba izimoto. Ukugqiba imisebenzi eqhothisayo namadokhumenti. Amakhono nobuchwepheshe ekulawulweni kwamarekhodi. Ukulawula izinsiza. Ukuphathwa kwezimphathisano namakhasimende. Ukuhlela. Ukuhlela ukusebenza. Ukubusa. Ukulawula. Ukuqapha. Ukuphathwa kwabantu. Ukulethwa kwezinsiza. Ukuxhumana. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuphathwa kweziphumo nobuchwepheshe. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukubhala nokubika. Ubudlelwano bemisebenzi. Amakhono okushayela. Amakhono okuphenya. Amakhono okukhuthaza. Intuthuko/ngokuthuthuka ngokungapheli. Amakhono okuhlaziya. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuphathwa kwezimiso/zimiso zokusebenza.
zu.duties: Busa futhi uphathamise umthetho wezokuthutha ezindleleni, wezokuthutha abagibeli bomphakathi, umthetho wezokuthutha nomunye umthetho ohambisana nalo. Buhlele izindlela zokusebenza uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela ezivunyiwe zokuqhothisa umthetho wezokuthutha ezindleleni. Qinisekisa ukugeleza kokuthutha ngokwenza umsebenzi wokuqondisa izindiza kanye nolawulo lwezokuthutha ezindaweni eyanukiwe, hlela izenzo, futhi uvikele izendawo zezipesheli. Hlela futhi ulawule ukusebenza kokuhlola isivinini. Hlela ukwenziwa kweziboshwa ezintweni ezingokuthutha, khona emithelelweni yezinkantolo, futhi unikeze ubufakela. Lawula izinkambu zokunikeza izaziso ezifanele abayizoni. Lawula amaphrojekthi ezokuthutha ezindleleni. Baza futhi weluleke abadlali bezindima abahambisana nendawo eyingozi. Lawula ukuhamba nezimoto ezingajwayelekile kanye nezithwalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunyakaza okuphepha. Lawula ukuqaphela imiklalo yezindleleni kanye nemikhosi yomphakathi, hlela ukulawulwa kokugqamisa izinto (kubandakanya izimpahla nabahambi). Lawula izenzo zemithetho eqhothisayo ehlanganyelwe nawo wonke amaphrojekthi (ukubusa ngokubumbano): Ngena ekwelweni kwezindlela zokuqhothisa nomthetho ohlanganyelwe nawo onke amaphrojekthi. Lawula ukwenziwa kwezindlela zokuqhothisa umthetho ezihlanganyelwe nawo wonke amaphrojekthi. Hlola futhi ube ngakwesobunxele ngezigaba namaphrojekthi. Lawula izinsiza unikeze ubuholo noqondiso kubantu bonke abangaphansi kwakho: Buhle futhi ulondoloze inkambu yokuqapha uqinisekise ukutholakala kobulinganisani phakathi kwe-Senior Provincial Inspectors (SPIS) kanye ne-Provincial Inspectors (Pls) ekukhiqizweni, okubandakanya izibalo zokukhiqiza i-SPIS ne-Pls. Faka izinto ezintsha ukuthuthukisa indawo yokusebenza, uye uvakashele othisha ensimini. Siza ekubuyekezeni ukucwaninga kwemvelo ukuze kusetshenziswe njengesisisekelo ekuhlelweni. Yenza imisebenzi eyisisekelo yokulawula (ukuhlela, ukuhlela, ukubusa nokulawula). Yenza ukuhlela, ukuphendula, ukuhlola, kanye nemihlangano yokwabelana ngolwazi nabo abangaphansi kwakho. Siza ezindabeni zensiza yabantu esiteshini, hlela ukuqashwa kobuchwepheshe kuleminyaka yonke yabasebenzi. Baza futhi ulawule izengozi: Baza izingozi ezihamisana nalokhu. Buhlele indlela yokulungisa izingozi. Faka uhlelo uluqaphe. Hlola inqubo. Lawula ukwenziwa kwemisebenzi yonke yesiqondiso namanye omunye umsebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuthi i-fleet yezimoto ilawulwe kahle. Qapha isimo sezinsiza usize ekwelweni okuzama ukuvala izinsiza, okubandakanya nokubaza ukuqapha amalungu athatwa yingozi. Qinisekisa ukuthi kunezindlela ezisebenzayo zokulawula ukulahlekelwa ukuze kuphathwe ukulahlekelwa amasotsha namanye okunye okuhambisana nalokho, futhi uzame ukunciphisa inani lemali yokulahlekelwa. Ngena ekwelweni kwe-mali njengoba kudingwa ngu-Center Manager. Qapha okuhariswa njanyen kanye namarekhodu okuhlolwa ezweni, futhi usebenzise izenzo zokulungisa ezindaweni ezinomingqi. Imihlangano evamile yokulawula imali kanye nokuqonda emihlanganweni yokulawula, wabelane ngolwazi nabalungu ngezinto ebalulekile zemali yecentre.

xh.summary: I-Inspektha ePhakamileyo yoMmandla eJohannesburg ephatha kwaye yonakezela umthetho wehwayi nowerhwebo lokuthutha lwentengiso elungele i-Department of Community Safety.

Ukuthatha izithuthi ngokuzayo nangamandla. Ukuqedwa kolawulo lwemigibe nemibhalo. Amakhono nokuzinikela ekulawulweni kwiinkqubo zokulondoloza imibhalo. Ukulawula izixhobo. Ukulawula ubudlelwane nabathengi. Ukuqamba. Ukuhlela. Ukukhokela. Ukulawula. Ukuqaphela. Ukulawula abantu. Ukunikezela inkonzo. Unxibelelwano. Ukuthatha izigqibo. Ukulawula iimbango nokuhlolwa kwemigangatho. Ukusombulula iingxaki. Ukubhala nokubika. Iimalahle zomsebenzi. Amakhono okushayela. Amakhono okuphonononga. Amakhono okukhuthaza. xh.duties: Phatha kwaye ulawule umthetho we-Road Traffic, we-Public Passenger, we-Transport Legislation nakwelinye igazelo elithile. Phuhlisa iindlela zokusebenza kwaye uqinisekise ukusebenza kweenindlela ezamkelekileyo zolawulo lomthetho wehwayi. Qinisekisa ukuba kukookuqhawuka kwehwayi ngokusebenza kwindawo ethile nokulawula ihwayi kwindawo edinisileyo, lulungele iindwendwe, kwaye uvikele iindawo zengozi. Cwangcisa kwaye ulawule iinkqubo zovavayo lwesantya. Lunganisa ukwenziwa kookraso kwemiba ezehwayini, zithathe inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zetyala, kwaye nike ingcebiso ngokuchazwa kwemigibe. Lawula iinkqubo zokunika isaziso esifanelekileyo kubaxhasi. Lawula oorhwebo bokolawulo lwehwayi. Chaza kwaye ululeke abanxaxhe balawulo kwindawo ezengozi. Lawula ukukhuselwa kwezithuthi ezinobunzima nokuhamba kwezithwalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhamba okukhuselekileyo. Lawula ukuqaphela imidlalo yomgca kunye nemihla yomculo kwaye ulungelele ukulawula ukulawula ukudanisela ngokugqithisileyo (kuquuka iimpahla kunye nabakhenketho). Lawula imisebenzi yokulawula umthetho kunye noorhwebo (ukulawulana koluntu): Thabatha inxaxheba kukuqamba iindlela zoraso kunye noorhwebo. Lawula ukusebenza kweendlela zoraso kunye noorhwebo. Linganisa kwaye ushuthe iindlela noorhwebo. Lawula izixhobo kwaye unike isikhokelo nokuqonda kubo bonke abangaphansi kwakho: Phuhlisa kwaye ulondoloze inkqubo yokujonga kwaye uqinisekise ukuba kufikelelwa kumlinganiselo ngokwemveliso bee-Senior Provincial Inspectors (SPIS) nakwi-Provincial Inspectors (Pls), kuquuka izibalo zemveliso ye-SPIS nakwe-Pls. Zisebenzise izinto ezintsha ukuphucula ukusingathwa kwendawo yokusebenza kwaye uwenze iindwendwe kumagosa abasebundzini. Seda ngokuhlaziya ukuphonononga indawo ukuze iqinisekiswe ukuba isetyenziswa njengesiseko sokuqamba. Yenza imisebenzi yokulawula (ukuqamba, ukuhlela, ukukhokela nokulawula). Yenza iindwendwe zokuqamba, zokunika isaziso, zokuqaphela nokwabelana ngolwazi nabangaphansi kwakho. Seda ngeemiba zabasebenzi kwisikhululo kwaye ulungelele ukulinganisa iinkqubo zabasebenzi zenyanga zinyathelo. Chaza kwaye ulawule iingozi: Chaza iingozi ezifanelekileyo. Phuhlisa iplani yokusingatha iingozi. Zisebenzise kwaye ujonge iplani. Linganisa inkqubela. Lawula ukusebenza kweenkqubo zonke ezingezantsi kwezolawulo nemisebenzi edibene nayo. Qinisekisa ukuba iqembu lezithuthi lithathwa ngokuchanileyo. Qaphela ubume bezixhobo kwaye ucedele ngokuqamba ngokutsha okukhuselekileyo, kuquka ukuchaza kwaye ulawule amalungu abandakanyekayo kwingozi. Qinisekisa ukuba kukho iindlela ezisezinyanweni zokulawula ukulahleka ukuze kusombululwe ukulahleka kwezixhobo kwaye uzame ukunciphisa ixabiso lemali yokulahleka. Thabatha inxaxheba kukuqamba isikhwama njengoko kufunwa ngumlawuli we-Center. Qaphela iimali ezichithwa nyanga zonke kunye neendwendwe zokuhlova ezivela kwiphondo kwaye usebenzise izinyezelo kwindawo ezinengxaki. Yenza iindwendwe ezizezinye zokuqamba nokulawula isikhwama njengenxalenye yeendwendze zolawulo kwaye wabelane ngolwazi namalungu ngokumisela okubalulekileyo kwindawo yenkonzo.

jobs.title: Principal Provincial Inspector
jobs.salary_text: R413 001 per annum, plus service benefits.
jobs.summary: Principal Provincial Inspector to manage and enforce road traffic and public transport legislation in Bronkhorstspruit, requiring a Basic Traffic Diploma and 6 to 10 years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 Certificate or higher qualification. Must be in possession of a Basic Traffic Diploma. 6 - 10 years’ working experience in the field. All valid relevant driving licenses (A and EC). No criminal record. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge of Extensive experience in road traffic and Public Transport policies and regulations. Law enforcement knowledge in traffic and Public Transport Vehicle inspections. Vehicle Impoundment. Completion of law enforcement and documents. Skills and competencies in records management. Resource management. Customer relationship management. Planning. Organizing. Leading. Controlling. Monitoring. People Management. Service delivery. Communication. Decision-making. Results and quality management. Problem solving. Writing & Reporting. Labour Relations. Driving skills. Investigation skills. Motivational skills. Innovation/ continuous improvement. Analytical skills. Computer literacy. Operations/Projects management.
jobs.duties: Manage and enforce Road Traffic, Public Passenger, Transport Legislation and other relevant legislation. Develop operational strategies and ensure implementation of approved traffic law enforcement strategies. Ensure the free flow of traffic through point duty and traffic control at congested areas, coordinate activities, and safeguard accident scenes. Plan and manage speed testing operations. Coordinate execution of arrests on traffic-related matters, attend court proceedings, and give evidence. Manage processes of issuing relevant notices to offenders. Manage traffic policing projects. Identify and advise relevant role-players on hazardous locations. Manage escorting of abnormal vehicles and loads to ensure safe movement thereof. Manage monitoring of road sports and social events and coordinate overload control management (includes goods and passengers). Manage joint law enforcement activities and projects (co-operative governance): Participate in planning of joint enforcement strategies and projects. Manage the execution of joint law enforcement strategies and projects. Evaluate and report on strategies and projects. Manage resources and provide leadership and direction to all subordinates: Develop and maintain a monitoring system and ensure that balance is achieved with regard to Senior Provincial Inspectors (SPIS) and Provincial Inspectors (Pls) production, including statistics of production of SPIS and Pls. Implement innovations to improve the working environment and conduct visits to officers in the field. Assist with the updating of the environmental analysis to ensure that it is used as a baseline for planning. Perform basic management functions (planning, organizing, leading and control). Conduct planning, feedback, evaluation, and information-sharing meetings with subordinates. Assist with human resource issues at the station and coordinate staff quarterly performance appraisals. Identify and manage risks: Identify relevant risks. Develop a plan to address risks. Implement and monitor plan. Evaluate progress. Manage the performance of all administrative activities and related duties. Ensure that the motor vehicle fleet is managed properly. Monitor the state of equipment and assist with proactive replacement planning, including identifying and monitoring members involved in accidents. Ensure effective loss control measures are in place to address loss of firearms and other related equipment and strive towards reducing the financial value of losses. Participate in budget planning as required by the Center Manager. Monitor monthly expenditure and inspection reports from the province and implement corrective action in problem areas. Regular budget control and management discussions as part of management meetings and share infrmation with members regarding the center's budget priorities.
jobs.enquiries: Call Ms. Avhatakali Nemukula/Mr. Vuyolwethu Sondo Tel No: (011) 689 3845/ 3723/ 3847
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on new Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za/documents (effective from 01 January 2021). All fields in Part A to D of the Z83 form must be completed, and Part E to G noting that there is limited space provided applicants often indicate “refer” to CV or see attached, this is acceptable as long as the CV is attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. The question related to the conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered. Declaration must be completed and signed. The fully completed and signed new Z83 form should be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV only (only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications). Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applicants who do not comply with the above requirements, as well as late applications, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Suitable candidates will undergo a personnel suitability check (Vetting, criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification, and employment verification). The Department of Community Safety reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes. Candidate will be placed according to corridor coordination and the Department’s needs. The Department will not accept posted, emailed or hand delivered applications. We encourage youth, people with disability, coloured, Indian and white to apply and a confirmation of disabilities from a registered medical practitioner must be attached to the application. Please Note: Due to the large number of applications, we envisage to receive, applications will not be acknowledged. If you do not receive any response within 3 months, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. OTHER POSTS
