zu.title: Omphathi Oyingqayi weSifunda wokuphenya
zu.summary: Omunywe weSifunda ongumphathi wobugcisa wezokugcina futhi oqinise isemetho sezemoto ezibhakabhaka kanye nomphakathi wokuthutha kwezomthetho e-Bronkhorstspruit, okudinga iDiploma yokwesisekelo yezokugcina kanye nemiyaka engu-6 kuya kowe-10 yokusebenza.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samabanga angu-12 noma ngaphezulu. Kumele kube nepuloma elisisisekelo kwezemotya. Imiyili yokusebenza eyi-6 - 10 kule minyaka. Konke ukushayela okuvunyelwe (A kanye ne-EC). Akukho rekodi yokwephula umthetho. Ulwazi futhi Iziciko: Ulwazi ngokuhlangenye ngemiyili enkulu kumaphasi yezemoto kanye nomphakathi kanye nezimiso nemiyalo yokuthutha. Ulwazi lokuphotha umthetho kwezimoto futhi kwezimoto yomphakathi kwezokuhlola. Ukubophwa kwemoto. Ukuqedwa kwezomthetho nemibhalo. Amakhono nezikhathi eziyingqayi ekugcineni izitshuquko. Ukulawula kwabalwazi. Ukulawula kwemisebenzi yamakhasimende. Ukubaka. Ukuhlela. Ukuhola. Ukulawula. Ukuphenya. Ukubheke abantu. Ukulethwa kwezinsiza. Unhlalakhaye. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuphathwa kwemiphumela nobuchwepheshe. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukubhala nokubika. Izimo zomsebenzi. Amandla okushayela. Amakhono okuphenya. Amakhonya okukhuthaza. Ukungqubuzana / ukuphucula ngokungenaphandle. Amandyo wokuhlola. Ukubhala ngesikhathi esebenzisa imiqondo.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi uqinise isimetho sezokwezulu emigwaqweni, labagibeli bemiphakathi, ukuhleletha kwezokuthutha neminye imithetho ehlobene nalokho. Baka amasu okusebenza futhi uqinise ukusetshenziswa kwamashiwo okuphothulwe ekuqinisekiseni umthetho wokugibela emgwaqweni. Qinisekisa ukugeleza kwezokuthutha ngokusebenza kumaphoyintshi nolawulo lwemoto kwizindawo ezinamathrafikhi, lunge emasebenzi, futhi uvikele izindawo zezihlukahlukene zezokuletha. Hlela futhi uphathe imisebenzi yokuhlolwa kwesivinini. Lunge ukuphunywa kwezinhlekisa ezingokwegwegwe emgwaqweni, ziyakhamba izinqamuleli ngamalungisebalo ezomthetho, futhi unike ngemvume. Phatha imikhuba yokukhipha izaziso ezifanele kubagcini bomthetho. Phatha amaphrojethi okuqinisekisa umthetho emgwaqweni. Hlona futhi weluleke abadlali abahlobene nendawo mayelana nezindawo ezinengozi. Phatha ukuphathwa kwemoto ezingavamile nezithiwo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwazo. Phatha ulawulo lwemikhosi emigwaqweni nemicimbi yomphakathi futhi ulunge ulawulo lokugqiba kokuzisiza (okuhlanganisa izimpahlo nabagibeli). Phatha imisebenzi nephojechi ezibambisanayo zokuqinisekisa umthetho (uhulumeni babambisano): Zibandakanye ekubakeni amasu nephojehti zokuqinisekisa umthetho ezibambisanayo. Phatha ukusebenzisa amasu nephojehti zokuqinisekisa umthetho ezibambisanayo. Hlola futhi ungabiko ngemashiwo nephojehti. Phatha izinsiza futhi unikeze ubuholo futhi lapho kuhamba bonke abangaphansi kwakho: Baka futhi ugcinile uhlelo lokuhlola futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kufeza inhlalakahle mayelana noMgqatsi weSifunda (SPIS) noMgqatsi weSifunda (PIs) ekukhiqizeni, okuhlanganisa izibalo zokukhiqiza kwaSPIS naPIs. Setha izinto ezintsha ukuze kuthuthukiswe indawo yokusebenza futhi uvakashele amaphoyisa ensimini. Siza ekubususeni kokuhlukaniswa kwezemvelo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kusetshenziswa njengesisekelo sekubaka. Yenza imisebenzi yezisekelo yobuholo (ukubaka, ukuhlela, ukuholu futhi ukulawula). Yenza imihlangano yokubaka, impendulo, ukuhlola nokwabelana ngolwazi nabangaphansi kwakho. Siza ngemibuzo yezinsiza zabantu esiteshini futhi ulunge okuhluzwa kwemisebenzi yabezihlabathi njalo konyaka. Hlona futhi uphathe izengozi: Hlona imingeko ethile. Baka ilezo ukuze ubhekane nemingeko. Setha futhi ulawule ilezo. Hlola inqondo. Phatha imisebenzi yazo yonke imiyalo esiswati yemisebenzi ehlobene. Qinisekisa ukuthi imoto zilawulwa kahle. Hlola ubuso bekuhwesa futhi usize ekubakeni kwangaphambilini, okuhlanganisa ukuhlona futhi ukuhlola amalunga abekwa ezihlukahlukeni. Qinisekisela ukuthi kunezinyathelo zokulawula okushabisele ukususa nokulahlekelwa kwamaphoyisa nezinye izikhali ezihlobene futhi ugcine ngokwezimali ukunciphisa inani leziphothulo. Zibandakanye ekubakeni kwabiho njengoba kudingwa nguMphathi wesikhungo. Hlola amarekhodi ezimali zenyanga zinyanga nezibalo zokuhlova ezisuka esifundeni futhi usebenzise izinyathelo zokulungisa ezindaweni ezinamathuba. Ukulawula okuvulelwe kuhamon kaHlola kanye nokuqashwa kwemihlangano njengengxenye yemihlangano yokuqashiya, futhi wabelane ngemiyalo namalungu ngokuhamba ibho yohlelo lokuqinisekisa izingqikithi zamaphondo esikhungo.

xh.title: Ikomishana Ephethe elikwisixeko esingowurhulumente
xh.summary: Ikomishana Ephethe elikwisixeko esingowurhulumente ukulawula nokuphocea umthetho wezothutho negesi yolawulo lwendlela yoluntu kwindlela yoluntu kwiindawo zothutho zabahambi nabantu eBronkhorstspruit, kufuneka kubekho iDiploma ekuqalweni yeTraffic kwaye 6 ukuya kwi-10 yeminyaka yamava.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 okanye ngaphezulu kwesidanga. Kufuneka kubekho iDiploma ekuqalweni yeTraffic. 6 - 10 yeminyaka yamava kumsebenzi kule ndawo. Zonke ilayisenisi zokushayela ezisezinzileni nendalo (A nakwi-EC). Akubikho bungengamo bokubakho kwecaleni kolwaphulo-mthetho. Ulwazi nakhono: Ulwazi ngamava anomgama ekuthetheni ngeendlela zothutho ngemithetho yolawulo lokuthutha abantu. Ulwazi lokuphocea umthetho ekuxilazeni ithrafu kwiindawo zothutho zabahambi. Ukuthathwa kweemoto ngokusemthethweni. Ukugqiba ukuphocea umthetho namagama. Khono namandla ekulawuleni amarekhodi. Ukulawula iindlela zemali. Ukulawulwa koluntu olusebenzisa inkonzo. Ukuqulunqa. Ukuhlela. Ukukhokela. Ukulawula. Okokubeka phantsi amehlo. Ukulawula abantu. Ukulekelela ngenkonzo. Unxibelelwano. Ukuthatha izigqibo. Iziphumo nolawulo lolungelo. Ukusombulula iingxaki. Ukuhlomula nokubika. Iindaba zoluntu nakumasebenzi. Khono lokushayela. Khano lokuphandla. Khano lokuqinisekisa. Amava. Ukwenza izinto ngobuchule ngokuphucula amava. Khano lokuqonda ngobunzulu. Ulwazi lweekhompyutha. Ukulawula / ukuphatha amaprojekthi.
xh.duties: Ukulawula nokuphocea uMthetho weThrafu yoluntu, ukuThutha abaHambi, nokuthutha abantu, namanye eminye imithetho edibanisa naleyo. Ukuphuhlisa iindlela ezisezantsi zokusebenza oluqinisekisa ukusebenza iindlela ezivunyiweyo zokuphocea umthetho weethrafu. Ukuqinisekisa ukuhamba koluntu ngokulawula iindawo ezibuzayo, ukwenza umsebenzi walapho ithrafu izolo khona, ukulawula iindawo ezixineneyo kwaye ulinde iindawo ezikwisimo somonakalo. Ukuqulunqa nokulawula iindlela ezikwisimo soqhwesha. Ukulawula ukuthathwa kwabo bathiniwa ngokuthutha nangendlela ekuphocea umthetho, ukubakho kumacala kwaye unike ubungqina. Ukulawula iindlela zokuwa kumagama abo baphula umthetho. Ukulawula amaprojekthi okuthutha ngokulawula ithrafu. Ukubonisa nokuluncedisa abadlali abakhulu malunga neendawo ezinengozi. Ukulawula ukulawuliswa kwamathuthi awayo yedwa nabahambi abangenawo amakhadi, nokuqinisekisa ukuba abahamba ngokhuseleko. Ukulawula ukulawula iindawo zezemidlalo ekuthuthweni nakwezentlalo, kwaye ukulawule ukugqithiswa kwemithwalo yemihambi (kuqulathe imibini nabahambi). Ukulawula imisebenzi yokuphocea umthetho ngokubakanywa (ukulawulwa koluntu oluzimele): Ukuthabatha inxaxheba ekuqulunqeni iindlela zokuphocea umthetho ngokubakanywa namaphulo eprojekthi. Ukulawula ukusetyenziswa kweendlela zokuphocea umthetho ngokubakanywa namaphulo eprojekthi. Ukulinganisa ngokuchaza ukuba zeziphi iindlela namaphulo eprojekthi. Ukulawula iindlela zemali kunye nokunika isikhokelo nokuqondisa onke abasebenzi abangaphantsi: Ukuphuhlisa ukulondoloza ukubakanywa koluntu ngokumisela iindawo, nokuqinisekisa ukuba kubakho ukulingana ngakumbi kwabaphathi abangaphezulu abakwisixeko esingowurhulumente (SPIS) nabo baphathi abakwisixeko esingowurhulumente (Pls), kuquka nokubala imveliso yamaphupha. Ukusebenzisa iindlela ezitsha ukuphucula indawo yokusebenza kwaye ukwazi ukubakho koluntu. Ukuncedisa ngokwenza okokugcina ukusetyenziswa koluntu ngokwamava ngokwemeko yokusebenza indlela yokwenza okokugcina iindlela ngokuchaza nangokuvela kuluntu ngezinto ezikwindlela zokusebenza. Ukwenza imisebenzi yokulawula imicimbi (ukuqulunqa, ukuhlela, ukukhokela nokuqamba). Ukuqulunqa okunika iindlela zokugcina uluntu olubakho ngakumbi ngokuvakatya oluqinisekisa imveliso yamaphupha. Ukunika iindlela ngezicelo sabasebenzi, nokwenza okokugcina ukulinganisa iindlela zokuvela ngakumbi. Ukubonisa nangokuqonda ukuphocea umthetho ngokuchaza ukuba zeziphi iindawo. Ukusebenzisa iindlela zokuchaza uluntu ngokubakho kwamaphupha. Ukuchaza iindlela ezinkulu ezinamaphupha. Ukulinganisa nangokubakanywa uluntu. Ukuchaza imisebenzi. Ukunika uluntu iindlela ezikwisimo sokugcina uluntu ngakumbi. Ukubakanywa ngokwenza izinto ezilungele ukugcina amaphupha. Ukuqhagamshelana noluntu. Ukubakanywa ngokwenza okokuqinisekisa uluntu. Ukubakanywa kwamaphupha. Ukwenza okokuqinisekisa ukulondoloza amaphupha.

jobs.title: Principal Provincial Inspector
jobs.salary_text: R413 001 per annum, plus service benefits.
jobs.summary: Principal Provincial Inspector enforcing road traffic and public transport legislation in Springs, requiring a Grade 12, Basic Traffic Diploma and 6 to 10 years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 Certificate or higher qualification. Must be in possession of a Basic Traffic Diploma. 6 - 10 years’ working experience in the field. All valid relevant driving licenses (A and EC). No criminal record. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge of Extensive experience in road traffic and Public Transport policies and regulations. Law enforcement knowledge in traffic and Public Transport Vehicle inspections. Vehicle Impoundment. Completion of law enforcement and documents. Skills and competencies in records management. Resource management. Customer relationship management. Planning. Organizing. Leading. Controlling. Monitoring. People Management. Service delivery. Communication. Decision-making. Results and quality management. Problem solving. Writing & Reporting. Labour Relations. Driving skills. Investigation skills. Motivational skills. Innovation/ continuous improvement. Analytical skills. Computer literacy. Operations/Projects management.
jobs.duties: Manage and enforce Road Traffic, Public Passenger, Transport Legislation and other relevant legislation. Develop operational strategies and ensure implementation of approved traffic law enforcement strategies. Ensure the free flow of traffic through point duty and traffic control at congested areas, coordinate activities, and safeguard accident scenes. Plan and manage speed testing operations. Coordinate execution of arrests on traffic-related matters, attend court proceedings, and give evidence. Manage processes of issuing relevant notices to offenders. Manage traffic policing projects. Identify and advise relevant role-players on hazardous locations. Manage escorting of abnormal vehicles and loads to ensure safe movement thereof. Manage monitoring of road sports and social events and coordinate overload control management (includes goods and passengers). Manage joint law enforcement activities and projects (co-operative governance): Participate in planning of joint enforcement strategies and projects. Manage the execution of joint law enforcement strategies and projects. Evaluate and report on strategies and projects. Manage resources and provide leadership and direction to all subordinates: Develop and maintain a monitoring system and ensure that balance is achieved with regard to Senior Provincial Inspectors (SPIS) and Provincial Inspectors (Pls) production, including statistics of production of SPIS and Pls. Implement innovations to improve the working environment and conduct visits to officers in the field. Assist with the updating of the environmental analysis to ensure that it is used as a baseline for planning. Perform basic management functions (planning, organizing, leading and control). Conduct planning, feedback, evaluation, and information-sharing meetings with subordinates. Assist with human resource issues at the station and coordinate staff quarterly performance appraisals. Identify and manage risks: Identify relevant risks. Develop a plan to address risks. Implement and monitor plan. Evaluate progress. Manage the performance of all administrative activities and related duties. Ensure that the motor vehicle fleet is managed properly. Monitor the state of equipment and assist with proactive replacement planning, including identifying and monitoring members involved in accidents. Ensure effective loss control measures are in place to address loss of firearms and other related equipment and strive towards reducing the financial value of losses. Participate in budget planning as required by the Center Manager. Monitor monthly expenditure and inspection reports from the province and implement corrective action in problem areas. Regular budget control and management discussions as part of management meetings and share information with members regarding the center's budget priorities.
jobs.enquiries: Call Ms. Avhatakali Nemukula/Mr. Vuyolwethu Sondo Tel No: (011) 689 3845/ 3723/ 3847
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on new Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za/documents (effective from 01 January 2021). All fields in Part A to D of the Z83 form must be completed, and Part E to G noting that there is limited space provided applicants often indicate “refer” to CV or see attached, this is acceptable as long as the CV is attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. The question related to the conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered. Declaration must be completed and signed. The fully completed and signed new Z83 form should be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV only (only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications). Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applicants who do not comply with the above requirements, as well as late applications, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Suitable candidates will undergo a personnel suitability check (Vetting, criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification, and employment verification). The Department of Community Safety reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes. Candidate will be placed according to corridor coordination and the Department’s needs. The Department will not accept posted, emailed or hand delivered applications. We encourage youth, people with disability, coloured, Indian and white to apply and a confirmation of disabilities from a registered medical practitioner must be attached to the application. Please Note: Due to the large number of applications, we envisage to receive, applications will not be acknowledged. If you do not receive any response within 3 months, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Hoofprovinsiale Inspekteur
af.summary: Hoofprovinsiale Inspekteur wat padverkeer- en openbare vervoerwetgewing in Springs handhaaf, met 'n Graad 12, Basiese Verkeersdiploma en 6 tot 10 jaar se ervaring as vereistes.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat of hoër kwalifikasie. Moet oor 'n Basiese Verkeersdiploma beskik. 6 - 10 jaar se werkservaring in die veld. Alle geldige relevante bestuurslisensies (A en EC). Geen strafrekord nie. Kennis en vaardighede: Uitgebreide kennis en ervaring in padverkeer- en openbare vervoerbeleide en -regulasies. Regshandhawingskennis in verkeer- en openbare vervoervoertuiginspeksies. Voertuigbeslaglegging. Voltooiing van regshandhawing en dokumente. Vaardighede en bevoegdhede in rekordbestuur. Hulpbronbestuur. Kliëntverhoudingsbestuur. Beplanning. Organisering. Leiding. Beheer. Monitering. Mensebestuur. Dienslewering. Kommunikasie. Besluitneming. Resultate- en gehaltebestuur. Probleemoplossing. Skryfwerk en verslagdoening. Arbeidsverhoudinge. Bestuursvaardighede. Ondersoekvaardighede. Motiveringsvaardighede. Innovasie/ deurlopende verbetering. Analitiese vaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Operasionele/projekbestuur.
af.duties: Bestuur en handhaaf padverkeer-, openbare passasiers-, vervoerwetgewing en ander tersaaklike wetgewing. Ontwikkel operasionele strategieë en verseker implementering van goedgekeurde verkeersregshandhawingsstrategieë. Verseker die vrye vloei van verkeer deur puntpligte en verkeersbeheer by konjesteerdis areas, koördineer aktiwiteite en beveilig ongelukstonele. Beplan en bestuur spoedtoetsoperasies. Koördineer die uitvoering van arrestasies oor verkeersverwante sake, woon hofverrigtinge by en lewer getuienis. Bestuur prosesse om relevante kennissings aan oortreders uit te reik. Bestuur verkeerspolisieprojekte. Identifiseer en adviseer tersaaklike rolspelers oor gevaarlike plekke. Bestuur die begeleiding van abnormale voertuie en vragte om veilige beweging daarvan te verseker. Bestuur monitering van padsport- en sosiale gebeurtenisse en koördineer oorlaai-beheerbestuur (sluit goedere en passasiers in). Bestuur gesamentlike regshandhawingsaktiwiteite en -projekte (koöperatiewe regering): Neem deel aan beplanning van gesamentlike handhawingsstrategieë en -projekte. Bestuur die uitvoering van gesamentlike regshandhawingsstrategieë en -projekte. Evalueer en verslag doen oor strategieë en projekte. Bestuur hulpbronne en verskaf leierskap en rigting aan alle ondergeskiktes: Ontwikkel en handhaaf 'n moniteringstelsel en verseker dat balans bereik word ten opsigte van Senior Provinsiale Inspekteurs (SPIS) en Provinsiale Inspekteurs (Pls) se produksie, insluitend statistieke van produksie van SPIS en Pls. Implementeer innovasies om die werksomgewing te verbeter en doen besoeke aan beamptes in die veld. Bystand verleen met die bywerking van die omgewingsontleding om te verseker dat dit as 'n basislyn vir beplanning gebruik word. Voer basiese bestuursfunksies uit (beplanning, organisering, leiding en beheer). Voer beplannings-, terugvoer-, evaluerings- en inligtingsdelingsvergaderings met ondergeskiktes uit. Bystand verleen met menslike hulpbronsake by die stasie en koördineer personeel se kwartaallikse prestasie-evaluerings. Identifiseer en bestuur risiko's: Identifiseer tersaaklike risiko's. Ontwikkel 'n plan om risiko's aan te spreek. Implementeer en monitor plan. Evalueer vordering. Bestuur die uitvoering van alle administratiewe aktiwiteite en verwante pligte. Verseker dat die motorvoertuigvloot behoorlik bestuur word. Monitor die toestand van toerusting en help met proaktiewe vervangingsbeplanning, insluitend die identifisering en monitering van lede by ongelukke betrokke. Verseker dat doeltreffende verliesbeheermaatreëls in plek is om verlies van vuurwapens en ander verwante toerusting aan te spreek en streef daarna om die finansiële waarde van verliese te verminder. Neem deel aan begrotingsbeplanning soos vereis deur die Sentrumbestuurder. Monitor maandelikse uitgawes- en inspeksieverslae van die provinsie en implementeer korrigerende optrede in probleemareas. Reël gereelde begrotingsbeheer- en bestuursbesprekings as deel van bestuursvergaderings en deel inligting met lede met betrekking tot die sentrum se begrotingsprioriteite.

zu.title: Isiphathimandla Esikhulu Sezifundazwe
zu.summary: Isiphathimandla Esikhulu Sezifundazwe esivumela umthetho wezokuthutha ezindleleni nezokuhamba kwentengiselwano e Springs, esidinga ibheji le Grade 12, I-diploma yezokuthutha yisisekelo kanye namava eminyaka eyi-6 kuye kwayi-10.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se Grade 12 noma izifundo eziphakeme kakhulu. Kumele abe ne-Diploma yezokuthutha yisisekelo. Amava emsebenzini eminyakeni engu-6 - 10 kule minyakazo. Lawo wonke amalayisense okushayela ahambisana nangokuseshele (A kanye ne-EC). Kungabi nolaka lolwephula umthetho. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi olujulile emthethweni wezokuthutha ezindleleni kanye nezinhlelo zomphakathi nezokuhamba kanye nemithetho. Ulwazi lokuphoqa umthetho kokuhlola izimoto nezokuhamba kwentengiselwano. Ukubambelela kwezimoto. Ukuqedwa kokuphoqa umthetho namadokhumenti. Amakhono nokwaziswa ekulawulen imiphumulo. Ukulawula izinsizakusebenza. Ukulawula ubudlelwano namakhasimende. Ukuhlela. Ukubumba. Ukukhokhela. Ukulawula. Ukubuka. Ukulawula abantu. Ukulethwa kwezinsiza. Unxibelelwano. Ukuthatha izinqumo. Ukulawula imiphumela nokuhlelwa. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukubhala nokubika. Izimo zomsebenzi. Amakhono okushayela. Amakhono okuphenya. Amakhono okukhuthaza. Intuthuko/ezenza ngcono. Amakhono okuhlaziya. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukulawula imisebenzi/amaqhinga.
zu.duties: Nakekela futhi uphoqe umthetho Wezokuthutha Ezindleleni, Wokuhamba Kwentengiselwano Yomphakathi, Wokuthutha, nowomunye umthetho ohambisana nawo. Butha izinhlela zokusebenza futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlela ezivunyiwe zokuphoqa umthetho wokuthutha ezindleleni. Qinisekisa ukugeleza kwethrafikhi ngokusebenza emaphoyintini nangokulawula ithrafikhi kulezo ndawo ezigcwele, umube imisebenzi, futhi uvikele indawo yezikhashana. Cwangcisa futhi ulawule imisebenzi yokuhlola isivinini. Hlela ukuphunywa kwabantu ngenxa yezindaba zezokuthutha, khona eminkantolo, futhi unike umbhalo. Lawula inqubo yokukhishwa kwesaziso kubaphuli bomthetho. Lawula amaphrojekthi ezokuthutha ezindleleni. Chaza futhi usize abahluleki abahlobene ngalezindawo eziyingozi. Lawula ukuphathwa kwezimoto ezingajwayelekile kanye nezimpelayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuhamba kwazo okuphephile. Lawula ukuqashelwa kwezemidlalo ezindleleni kanye nemikhakha yokujwayelana nabantu futhi ulawule ukugcina ukuphathelwa ngokweqile (kufaka ukuthutha impahla nabahambele). Lawula imisebenzi kanye namaphrojekthi edlulisiwe womthetho (ukubambisana kolawulo): Thatha inxaxheba ekubumbeni izinhlela namaphrojekthi edlulisiwe womthetho. Lawula ukuphunywa kwezinhlelo kanye namaphrojekthi edlulisiwe womthetho. Hlaziya futhi ube ngokwezinhlelo namaphrojekthi. Lawula izinsizakusebenza futhi nikeza ukukhokhela kanye nesiqondiso kubo bonke abangaphansi kwakho: Butha futhi ulondoloze isimiso sokubuka futhi uqinisekise ukuthola ukulinganisela uma kuqhathaniswa nomveliso wabahloli Bezikahle Zesifundazwe (SPIS) Nabahloli Bezifundazwe (PIs), kufaka nezibalo zomveliso wabo. Funda ukuphumeza izinto ezintsha ngcono nendawo yokusebenza futhi ukhetshe abahleli emkhakheni. Siza ekuvuseleleni ukuxazulula nokuqoqa imininingo yendawo ukuze kuqinisekiswa ukusetshenziswa njengesisekelo sokuhlela. Yenza imisebenzi yagqibe eyisisekelo (ukuhlela, ukubumba, ukukhokhela, ukulawula). Butha imikhosi yokuqoqa imininingwana, yokubuyekeza, nokwazisa izindaba nabangaphansi kwakho. Siza ngemikhakha yezinsizakusebenza esiteshini futhi hlela amabhudeshi okubuyekeza umsebenzi wesikhashana. Chaza futhi ulawule izengozi: Chaza izingozi ezihlobene. Butha isu sokubhekana nalingozi. Phumeisa futhi ubuke isu. Hlaziya ukwenza kwangaphambili. Lawula ukwenza kwayo yonke imisebenzi ngokombhalo kanye namanye omile emayelana nawo. Qinisekisa ukuthi ibhalansi yezimoto ilawulwa ngokufanele. Qaphela isimo sezinsimbi futhi siza ngomchankathuli wokushintsha izimpahla ezisanda zandiswa, kufaka nokuhlola nokubuka amalungu abathintwa yizikhashana. Qinisekisa ukuthi kunezinyathelo ezisebenzayo zokulawula ukulahleka ukuze kubhekane nokulahleka kwezikhali kanye nezinye izinsimbi ezihlobene futhi ugcine ukuba bheke ekwehliseni inani lemali ephilahleke. Thatha inxaxheba ekubhekeni ibhajethi njengoba kudingwa ngumphathi Wesikhungo. Qaphela imali eholwa nyanga zonke kanye namabhudeshi eholi avela esifundazweni futhi uphume izinyathelo zokulungisa ezindaweni ezineningozi. Hlanganyela ezinkulumweni zokulawula ibhajethi njengengxenye yemikhosi yabaphathi futhi wazi abasebenzi ngabahleli bebhanji balesikhungo.

xh.title: Isebe eliPhambili leNgingceli yoMmandla
xh.summary: Isebe eliPhambili leNgingceli yoMmandla eliphozelela imithethonkqubo yegqitha kumgama nokuhamba kwabantu emmweni Springs, elifuna ibhedi ye-12, izidanga zeTraffic ezisisiseko namava eminyaka yamanqaku ali-6 ukuya kwayi-10.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 okanye nangaphezulu kwesidanga. Kufuneka abe nesidanga se-Basic Traffic Diploma. 6 - 10 yeminyaka yamava yokusebenza kule ndawo. Amanye amaweseki ashukumisa amathambo asemthethweni ahambelana nalawo (A kwaye EC). Akukho ntlonipho yonwatyiswa ngaphandle komthetho. Ulwazi nakhono: Ulwazi ngamava amaninzi kwimagqatho zomgama kunye namagqatho okuhamba kwabantu kumthetho. Ulwazi lokuphozelela umthetho kwigqitho kumgama nakuqwalaselo zithuthi zokuhamba kwabantu. Ukubamba izithuthi ngaphandle komthetho. Ukugqiba ukuphozelela umthetho namaxwebhu. Amandla nakhono ekulawulen iirekhodi. Ukulawula izixhobo. Ukulawulwa kwezibophelelo namaxabiso. Ugcino. Ubuzindisa. Ukubusa. Ukulawula. Okuqwalaselwa. Ukulawula abantu. Ukunikwa kweinkonzo. Unxibelelwano. Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukulawula imiphumela namgangatho. Ukusombulula iingxaki. Ukubhala nokubika. Unxibelelwano bethamsanqelwa. Amandla okushukumisa. Amandla okukhuthaza. Inzululwazi okwenza izinto ngenqanaba elihle ngaphandle kokujonga. Amandla esixhobo sokuhlalutya. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukulawula iindawo zokusebenza kunye neeprojekthi.
xh.duties: Ukulawula nokuphozelela ukwenza umthetho wegqitha kwumgama nokuqhuba izithuthi, nokuhamba kwabantu, nokwenza umthetho ngemithetho ehambelana nayo. Ukuyila iindlela zokwenza izinto ezisebenzayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusetyenziswa kweenqobo ezamkelekileyo zokuphozelela umthetho. Ukugcina intshona yegqitha kwumgama ngokwenza iinkonzo kwiziko ekunzima khona ukuhamba kunye nolawulo kwamagquma nabantu abaninzi kwizinto ezili-oyili, kokubakho iinkalo. Ukuyila nokulawula imisebenzi yokuhlolwa kobukhali bokugqitha kumgama. Ukuvakalelisa iinkalo zokuwela kwamagqitha ethamsanqelwa yimithetho yokuhamba, ukubakho kwaye kubekho iinkomnyana zomnyhadala wethamsanqelwa ukunikela ubungqina. Ukulawula inkqubo yokunika iinkomnyana ezahambelana nazo abo baphula umthetho. Ukulawula iiprojekthi zokuphozelela umthetho ekugqitheni kumgama. Ukubona nokuyalisa abo baphathwa kummandla wokuphozelela umthetho ngezinto ezimangalisayo ezinokubakho kwindawo ethileyo. Ukulawula ukukhokelela izithuthi ezongamileyo kakhulu nokutshala amagabelu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhamba ngokhuselekileyo. Ukulawula okuqwalaselwa kwemiqathango nokuhla kwamajoni, kunye nokuvakalelisa ukulawula ukugqitha kumthwalo. Ukulawula imisebenzi yokuphozelela umthetho eqhagamshelana namaqonga ekubakho bobulawulo: Ukuthatha inxaxheba kuguqulo lweenqobo zokuphozelela iindlela ezahambelana kunye neeprojekthi. Ukulawula ukwenza iindlela zokuphozelela umthetho ezahambelana neeprojekthi. Ukulawula ukubakho iindlela ezahambelana namagqibo eeprojekthi. Ukulawula izibophelelo kunye nokuqinisekisa inkokhela yonke iindlela kwabo basebenza: Ukuyila nokugcina inkqubo yokulawula nokulunga kweemfuno zaba balawuli abakhulu (SPIS) kunye noBalawuli baseMmandla (Pls) ekubakho iindlela ezahlukeneyo kwiinkalo, ekuqukunjelwe iindlela zokubakho iindlela ezahlukeneyo kwiinkalo zekhompyutha yamajoni eziqinisekisa ukubakho kweendlela ezahambelana. Ukuyila iindlela ezintsha ezinceda ukucela inkqubo yokubakho kweendlela ezahlukeneyo ekubakho. Ukuphakamisa ukugqibela inkqubo yokulinganisa imiba ekubakho ukuze isetyenziswe njengesiseko sokuqala ekuqwalaselweni kwemiba. Ukwenza iinkqubo zokulawula ezisisiseko (ukuyila, ukuvakalelisa, ukubakho nokulawula). Ukuphakamisa ukuyila, ukubakho iinkomnyana ezahlukeneyo ezahambelana neendlela ezahlukeneyo zabasebenzi, nokubakho iinkomnyana ezahlukeneyo ezahlukeneyo kwaba balawuli. Ukuphakamisa ukwenza izigqibo ezahambelana nendlela yokulawula abasebenzi ekholoni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukubakho iindlela ezahlukeneyo kwindawo ekubakho. Ukubona nokulawula ukubakho iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezinokubakho kwindawo ethileyo: Ukubona iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezinokubakho kwindawo ethileyo. Ukuyila indlela yokubakho iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezahlukeneyo. Ukuyila nokulawula iindlela ezahlukeneyo. Ukuphakamisa ukubakho iindlela ezahlukeneyo. Ukulawula ukusebenza kweenkqubo zonke ezahlukeneyo ezahambelana nemisebenzi. Ukulawula ukubakho kwezigqibo ezahlukeneyo ekubakho. Ukuphakamisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezahlukeneyo ezahlukeneyo kubasebenzi ekholoni, ekuqukunjelwe ukubakho iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezahlukeneyo kubasebenzi.

jobs.title: Principal Provincial Inspector
jobs.salary_text: R413 001 per annum, plus service benefits.
jobs.summary: Principal Provincial Inspector needed in Heidelberg to manage and enforce road traffic and public transport legislation, requiring a Basic Traffic Diploma and 6 to 10 years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 Certificate or higher qualification. Must be in possession of a Basic Traffic Diploma. 6 - 10 years’ working experience in the field. All valid relevant driving licenses (A and EC). No criminal record. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge of Extensive experience in road traffic and Public Transport policies and regulations. Law enforcement knowledge in traffic and Public Transport Vehicle inspections. Vehicle Impoundment. Completion of law enforcement and documents. Skills and competencies in records management. Resource management. Customer relationship management. Planning. Organizing. Leading. Controlling. Monitoring. People Management. Service delivery. Communication. Decision-making. Results and quality management. Problem solving. Writing & Reporting. Labour Relations. Driving skills. Investigation skills. Motivational skills. Innovation/ continuous improvement. Analytical skills. Computer literacy. Operations/Projects management.
jobs.duties: Manage and enforce Road Traffic, Public Passenger, Transport Legislation and other relevant legislation. Develop operational strategies and ensure implementation of approved traffic law enforcement strategies. Ensure the free flow of traffic through point duty and traffic control at congested areas, coordinate activities, and safeguard accident scenes. Plan and manage speed testing operations. Coordinate execution of arrests on traffic-related matters, attend court proceedings, and give evidence. Manage processes of issuing relevant notices to offenders. Manage traffic policing projects. Identify and advise relevant role-players on hazardous locations. Manage escorting of abnormal vehicles and loads to ensure safe movement thereof. Manage monitoring of road sports and social events and coordinate overload control management (includes goods and passengers). Manage joint law enforcement activities and projects (co-operative governance): Participate in planning of joint enforcement strategies and projects. Manage the execution of joint law enforcement strategies and projects. Evaluate and report on strategies and projects. Manage resources and provide leadership and direction to all subordinates: Develop and maintain a monitoring system and ensure that balance is achieved with regard to Senior Provincial Inspectors (SPIS) and Provincial Inspectors (Pls) production, including statistics of production of SPIS and Pls. Implement innovations to improve the working environment and conduct visits to officers in the field. Assist with the updating of the environmental analysis to ensure that it is used as a baseline for planning. Perform basic management functions (planning, organizing, leading and control). Conduct planning, feedback, evaluation, and information-sharing meetings with subordinates. Assist with human resource issues at the station and coordinate staff quarterly performance appraisals. Identify and manage risks: Identify relevant risks. Develop a plan to address risks. Implement and monitor plan. Evaluate progress. Manage the performance of all administrative activities and related duties. Ensure that the motor vehicle fleet is managed properly. Monitor the state of equipment and assist with proactive replacement planning, including identifying and monitoring members involved in accidents. Ensure effective loss control measures are in place to address loss of firearms and other related equipment and strive towards reducing the financial value of losses. Participate in budget planning as required by the Center Manager. Monitor monthly expenditure and inspection reports from the province and implement corrective action in problem areas. Regular budget control and management discussions as part of management meetings and share information with members regarding the center's budget priorities.
jobs.enquiries: Call Ms. Avhatakali Nemukula/Mr. Vuyolwethu Sondo Tel No: (011) 689 3845/ 3723/ 3847
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on new Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za/documents (effective from 01 January 2021). All fields in Part A to D of the Z83 form must be completed, and Part E to G noting that there is limited space provided applicants often indicate “refer” to CV or see attached, this is acceptable as long as the CV is attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. The question related to the conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered. Declaration must be completed and signed. The fully completed and signed new Z83 form should be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV only (only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications). Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applicants who do not comply with the above requirements, as well as late applications, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Suitable candidates will undergo a personnel suitability check (Vetting, criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification, and employment verification). The Department of Community Safety reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes. Candidate will be placed according to corridor coordination and the Department’s needs. The Department will not accept posted, emailed or hand delivered applications. We encourage youth, people with disability, coloured, Indian and white to apply and a confirmation of disabilities from a registered medical practitioner must be attached to the application. Please Note: Due to the large number of applications, we envisage to receive, applications will not be acknowledged. If you do not receive any response within 3 months, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Hoofprovinsiale Inspekteur
af.summary: Hoofprovinsiale Inspekteur benodig in Heidelberg om padverkeer- en openbare vervoerwetgewing te bestuur en af te dwing, wat 'n Basiese Verkeersdiploma en 6 tot 10 jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat of hoër kwalifikasie. Moet in besit wees van 'n Basiese Verkeersdiploma. 6 - 10 jaar se werkservaring in die veld. Alle geldige relevante bestuurslisensies (A en EC). Geen strafrekord nie. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van uitgebreide ervaring in padverkeer- en Openbare Vervoerbeleide en -regulasies. Regshandhawingskennis in verkeer- en Openbare Vervoervoertuiginspeksies. Voertuigbeslaglegging. Voltooiing van regshandhawing en dokumente. Vaardighede en bevoegdhede in rekordbestuur. Hulpbronbestuur. Kliënteverhoudingsbestuur. Beplanning. Organiseer. Leiding gee. Beheer. Monitering. Mensebestuur. Dienslewering. Kommunikasie. Besluitneming. Resultate- en gehaltebestuur. Probleemoplossing. Skryfwerk en verslagdoening. Arbeidsverhoudinge. Bestuursvaardighede. Ondersoekvaardighede. Motiveringsvaardighede. Innovasie/ deurlopende verbetering. Analitiese vaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Bedrywighede/Projekbestuur.
af.duties: Bestuur en handhaaf Padverkeer-, Openbare Passasiers-, Vervoerwetgewing en ander relevante wetgewing. Ontwikkel operasionele strategieë en verseker implementering van goedgekeurde verkeersregshandhawingsstrategieë. Verseker die vrye vloei van verkeer deur puntpligte en verkeersbeheer by gekontrafteerde gebiede, koördineer aktiwiteite, en bewaar ongelukstonele. Beplan en bestuur spoedtoetsoperasies. Koördineer uitvoering van arrestasies oor verkeerverwante aangeleenthede, woon hofverrigtinge by, en lewer getuienis. Bestuur prosesse om relevante kenniggewings aan oortreders uit te reik. Bestuur verkeerspolisiëringsprojekte. Identifiseer en adviseer relevante rolspelers oor gevaarlike plekke. Bestuur die begeleiding van abnormale voertuie en vragte om die veilige beweging daarvan te verseker. Bestuur monitering van pad sport- en sosiale geleenthede en koördineer oorladingbeheerbestuur (sluit goedere en passasiers in). Bestuur gesamentlike regshandhawingsaktiwiteite en projekte (koöperatiewe regering): Neem deel aan beplanning van gesamentlike handhawingsstrategieë en projekte. Bestuur die uitvoering van gesamentlike regshandhawingsstrategieë en projekte. Evalueer en rapporteer oor strategieë en projekte. Bestuur hulpbronne en verskaf leierskap en rigting aan alle ondergeskiktes: Ontwikkel en handhaaf 'n moniteringstelsel en verseker dat balans bereik word ten opsigte van Senior Provinsiale Inspekteurs (SPIS) en Provinsiale Inspekteurs (Pls) se produksie, insluitend statistieke van produksie van SPIS en Pls. Implementeer innovasies om die werksomgewing te verbeter en doen besoeke aan beamptes in die veld. Bystand verleen met die opdatering van die omgewingsontleding om te verseker dat dit as 'n basislyn vir beplanning gebruik word. Voer basiese bestuursfunksies uit (beplanning, organiseer, leiding gee en beheer). Voer beplanning, terugvoer, evaluering en inligtingsdelingsvergaderings met ondergeskiktes uit. Bystand verleen met menslike hulpbronkwessies by die stasie en koördineer persoonlike kwartaallikse prestasie-evaluerings. Identifiseer en bestuur risiko's: Identifiseer relevante risiko's. Ontwikkel 'n plan om risiko's aan te spreek. Implementeer en monitor plan. Evalueer vordering. Bestuur die uitvoering van alle administratiewe aktiwiteite en verwante pligte. Verseker dat die motorvoertuigvloot behoorlik bestuur word. Monitor die toestand van toerusting en help met proaktiewe vervangingsbeplanning, insluitend die identifisering en monitering van lede betrokke by ongelukke. Verseker dat doeltreffende verliesbeheermaatreëls in plek is om die verlies van vuurwapens en ander verwante toerusting aan te spreek en streef daarna om die finansiële waarde van verliese te verminder. Neem deel aan begrotingsbeplanning soos vereis deur die Sentrumbestuurder. Monitor maandelikse uitgawes en inspeksieverslae vanaf die provinsie en implementeer regstellende maatreëls in probleemareas. Reëlmatige begrotingsbeheer- en bestuursbesprekings as deel van bestuursvergaderings en deel inligting met lede rakende die sentrum se begrotingsprioriteite.

zu.title: Umhloli Wezwe Ongumholi
zu.summary: Kudingeka Umhloli Wezwe Ongumholi eHeidelberg ukuphatha futhi asebenzise umthetho wezokuthutha komgwaqo nezokuthutha kwabantu, kudingwa iDiploma Yezokuthutha Esisisekelo namava eminyaka eyi-6 kuya kwayi-10.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi Se-GRADE 12 noma iziqu eziphakeme kakhulu. Kumele ube nephasidi yeDiploma Yezokuthutha Esisisekelo. Amava emsebenzini eminyaka eyi-6 - 10 kulesikhundla. Yonke imaliyense yokuqhuba ekufanelekayo (A kanye ne-EC). Kungabi nalerekhodi lokwenza icala. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi ngeziphuzo eziningi ezimthethweni wezokuthutha komgwaqo kanye Nemithetho Yesimo Setransphathu Yomphakathi. Ulwazi lokuphoqelela umthetho ezokuthutha nokuhlola Izimoto Zokuthutha Komphakathi. Ukubamba izimoto. Ukugcina umthetho nokuphoqelela amadokhumenti. Amakhono namaqinqo ekuqophiseni izinkomba. Ukulawula izinsiza. Ukuphatha ubudlelwano namakhasimende. Ukucubungula. Ukuhlela. Ukukhokhela. Ukulawula. Ukuqapha. Ukuphatha abantu. Ukuletha izinkonzo. Ukuxhumana. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuphatha imiphumela nobuhle. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukubhala nokubika. Izindaba Zabasebenzi. Amakhono okuqhuba. Amakhono okuphenya. Amakhono okukhuthaza. Inkubukeli/ukuthuthukisa ngokuqhubekayo. Amakhono okuhlaziya. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Ukuphatha Iziphakamiso/Amaphulo.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi usebenzise umthetho Wezokuthutha Komgwaqo, Abagibeli Bomphakathi, Umthetho Wokuthutha kanye nomthetho ohlobene nawo. Hlela izindlela zokusebenza futhi qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela ezamukelekile zokuphoqelela umthetho wezokuthutha. Qinisekisa ukugcwala kwezokuthutha ngokusebenza emaphoyintini nolawulo lwezokuthutha kumawadi asemana, hlanganisa imisebenzi, futhi uvikele indawo yezikhungo zeziphephelamoto. Hlela futhi uphathe ukusebenza kokuqamba isivinini. Hlanganisa ukwenziwa kokuvalwa kwebandla ezindabeni eziphathelene nezokuthutha, khetha icala enkantolo, futhi unike umbhalo. Phatha inqubo yokukhishwa kwesaziso esifanelekile kubaphuli bomthetho. Phatha amaphulo okuqapha izokuthutha. Baza futhi uphakamise abadlali bebalulekile ngendawo ezingozi. Phatha ukuphephela kwezimoto ezingajwayelekile nezitshali ukuthi zinyakaze ngokuphephile. Phatha ukuqapha imidlalo yomgwaqo nemikhosi yomphakathi futhi uhlanganise ukuphatha ukulawula ukulayisha (kuhlanganisa izimpahla nabagibeli). Phatha imisebenzi kanye namaphulo okuphoqelela umthetho ngokuhlanganyela (ukuphatha ngokubambisana): Hlanganyela ekuhlelweni kwezindlela namaphulo okuphoqelela umthetho ngokuhlanganyela. Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela namaphulo okuphoqelela umthetho ngokuhlanganyela. Hlola futhi ubeke izindaba ngalezindlela namaphulo. Phatha izinsiza futhi unikeze ukuhola nokuqondisa bonke abangaphansi kwakho: Hlela futhi ugcinise isistimu yokuqapha futhi qinisekisa ukuthola isisindo ngokuphathelene koBahloli Bajwayelekile Bezwe (SPIS) kanye noBahloli Bezwe (Pls), kuhlanganisa izibalo zokukhiqizwa kwe-SPIS nama-Pls. Sebenzisa izinto ezintsha ukuthuthukisa isimo sokusebenza futhi uye kubaphathi abasemgwaqeni. Siza ekubuyiseleni ukuhlaziya ukuqaphathwa kwendawo ukuze kusetshenziswe njengesisekelo sekuhlelweni. Yenza imisebenzi yezisekelo yokuqondisa (ukuhlela, ukuhlanganisa, ukukhokhela nolawula). Hlela, nikeza umbhalo, hlola futhi wabelane ngolwazi emihlanganweni nabangaphansi. Siza ezindabeni zabasebenzi esiteshini futhi uhlanganise ukubukeka kwezimo zabasebenzi nyanga zonke. Baza futhi uphatle izengozi: Baza izingozi ezibalulekile. Hlela indlela yokulungisa izengozi. Sebenzisa futhi uqaphe indlela. Hlola ukwanda. Phatha ukusebenza kolawulo lomsebenzi konke okuyimisebenzi yokuqamba. Qinisekisa ukuthi izimoto eziningi ziyaphathwa kahle. Qapha isimo sezinsiza futhi siza ekuhlelweni okuzibambayo, kuhlanganisa ukubaza nokuqapha amalungu abathintwa yiziphephelamoto. Qinisekisa ukuthi kukhona izindlela ezisebenzayo zokuqapha ukulahleka ukuze kubhekwe ukulahleka kwezikhali nezinye izinsiza, futhi uzame ukunciphisa inani lemalini ezolahlekayo. Hlanganyela ekuhlelweni kwesabelomali njengoba kudingwa ngumphathi Wesikhungo. Qapha imibiko yokuqhathwa nyanga zonke nokuqapha esifundazweni futhi usebenzise izinyathelo zokulungisa ezindaweni ezinobuthi. Yizinkulumo ezijwayelekile zokuqapha nolawulo lwesabelomali njengengxenye yemihlangano yokuphatha futhi wabelane ngolwazi namalungu ngamabaluleki wesabelomali sesikhungo.

xh.title: I-General Provincial Inspector
xh.summary: Kufuneka i-General Provincial Inspector eHeidelberg ukulawula nokusebenzisa umthetho wentengiselwano yezithuthi nakumthetho wotwalwathu lwentengiselwano, kwaye kufuneka kubekho i-Basic Traffic Diploma neminye emi-6 ukuya kweli-10 yenkonzo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 okanye isiqu esiphezulu. Kufuneka abe nobugcisa bokugqiba i-Basic Traffic Diploma. Eminyaka engama - 6 - 10 yenkonzo kule ndawo. Amalayisenisi onke okushayela athintelweyo (A ne-EC). Akukho ngumbiwo womthetho. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngolwazi olubanzi ngomthetho weentengiselwano ngezo zithuthi nezithethwe zenkonzo yotwalwathu nakumthetho wolawulo. Ulwazi ngokuqwalasela kumthetho ophucula izithuthi nakwiimoto ezithwalathu zentengiselwano nokutshatyalaliswa kweento ezithwalwa ngemoto. Ukugqibelela kolawulo lomthetho nemibhalo. Amandla nakwakhono ekuqulunqweni lweempompo. Ulawulo lweenkcukacha. Ulawulo lwabiwo. Ulawulo lwesimo. Ukulungiselela. Ukuqamba. Ukukhokela. Ulawulo. Okuqwalaselwayo. Ulawulo lwabantu. Ukulawulwa kwemisebenzi. Unxibelelwano. Okuqaqululiweyo. Ulawulo lwemveliso nesimo. Ixabiso lomsebenzi. Ukubhala nokubika. Unxibelelwano basebenzini. Amandla okushayela. Amandla okuphonononga. Amandla okukhuthaza. Iingcinga ezintsha/ngaphezulu. Amandla okwahlula-hlula. Ulwazi ngekhompyutha. Ulawulo lwezicwangciso/eenkqubo.
xh.duties: Lawula futhi usebenzise umthetho wezithuthi, abagibeli abawela ngenkonzo, kunye nomthetho wokuthutha nabanye abantu. Cwangcisa iindlela zokusebenza ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza kwamacebo okuqwalaselwa komthetho. Qinisekisa ukuba kuyabakho ukuhamba kwezithuthi ngokuzinika eendaweni ezikhulu nabantu abaninzi, uhlanganise nokulawula iindawo ezibuhlungu ezikhoyo nakumanxweme. Cwangcisa nokulawula ukuvavanya isantya. Hlanganisa ukubanjwa kwamajoni phantsi komthetho wezithuthi, usuke ezigqibeni zamathala amaxwebhu, unike ingxelo. Lawula inkqubo yokunikwa iindaba ezifanelekileyo kwabanzi. Lawula iinkqubo zamaphoyisa asezithuthini. Bonisa nokuxelela abo babambe iqhaza ngeendawo ezengozi. Lawula ukukhokelela iimoto ezingezizo ezingozini nokuthwala ukuqinisekisa ukuba zihamba ngokhuseleko. Lawula ukuqwalaselwa kwezemidlalo zemigcaqo neziganeko zoluntu, ukuhlanganisa ulawulo lweesinthi (kuquka iimpahla nabagibeli). Lawula iinkqubo zolawulo oluthile kunye namaphojekthi (urhuluboqa):Thatha inxaxheba kwicwangciso lokuqamba amacebo olawulo oluthile namaphojekthi. Lawula ukusebenza kwamacebo kunye namaphojekthi. Qwalasela kwaye unike ingxelo ngamacebo namaphojekthi. Lawula iimpahla zeNdibano zokuqinisekisa ukuba ngokwamacebo obugcisa obukhulu bakuqwalaselwa kuwo onke amaqela eNtlalontle: Cwangcisa nokugcina inkqubo yokuqwalaselwa ukuqinisekisa ukubakho kokulingana ngokwesimo samacebo aqwalaselwayo kuwo onke amaqela abasebenzi abaphakathi (Sipho) kunye nabasebenzi abaqwalaselwa okuqwalaselwa ngeentlikwisana zeempahla zabo esinikiweyo. Qamba amacebo ukuphucula isimo sabasebenzi kwaye ubathande ngokubakhuthaza kwizigaba zabo ezahlukeneyo. Qwalasela amacebo ngokusetyenziswa kwenkqubo yokulingana yokugcina amanqaku afanelekileyo. Yenza imisebenzi engundoqo yokulawula (ukucwangcisa, ukuqamba, ukukhuthaza nokuqwalasela). Yiza kumasebe abasebenzi abangaphantsi kwakho ngeendaba zokuqwalaselwa, ukunika iingxelo, ukuqwalasela nokwabelana nolwazi. Phatha iingxwila zoluntu kwindawo yakho, ngokukhetha abantu abaneemfuno ezithile.

jobs.title: Principal Provincial Inspector
jobs.salary_text: R413 001 per annum, plus service benefits.
jobs.summary: Principal Provincial Inspector to enforce road traffic and public transport legislation in the Gauteng Freeway Unit, requiring a Basic Traffic Diploma and 6 to 10 years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 Certificate or higher qualification. Must be in possession of a Basic Traffic Diploma. 6 - 10 years’ working experience in the field. All valid relevant driving licenses (A and EC). No criminal record. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge of Extensive experience in road traffic and Public Transport policies and regulations. Law enforcement knowledge in traffic and Public Transport Vehicle inspections. Vehicle Impoundment. Completion of law enforcement and documents. Skills and competencies in records management. Resource management. Customer relationship management. Planning. Organizing. Leading. Controlling. Monitoring. People Management. Service delivery. Communication. Decision-making. Results and quality management. Problem solving. Writing and Reporting Labour Relations. Driving skills. Investigation skills. Motivational skills. Innovation/ continuous improvement. Analytical skills. Computer literacy. Operations/Projects management.
jobs.duties: Manage and enforce Road Traffic, Public Passenger, Transport Legislation and other relevant legislation. Develop operational strategies and ensure implementation of approved traffic law enforcement strategies. Ensure the free flow of traffic through point duty and traffic control at congested areas, coordinate activities, and safeguard accident scenes. Plan and manage speed testing operations. Coordinate execution of arrests on traffic-related matters, attend court proceedings, and give evidence. Manage processes of issuing relevant notices to offenders. Manage traffic policing projects. Identify and advise relevant role-players on hazardous locations. Manage escorting of abnormal vehicles and loads to ensure the safe movement thereof. Manage monitoring of road sports and social events and coordinate overload control management (includes goods and passengers). Manage joint law enforcement activities and projects (co-operative governance): Participate in planning of joint enforcement strategies and projects. Manage the execution of joint law enforcement strategies and projects. Evaluate and report on strategies and projects. Manage resources and provide leadership and direction to all subordinates: Develop and maintain a monitoring system and ensure that balance is achieved with regard to Senior Provincial Inspectors (SPIS) and Provincial Inspectors (Pls) production, including statistics of production of SPIS and Pls. Implement innovations to improve the working environment and conduct visits to officers in the field. Assist with the updating of the environmental analysis to ensure that it is used as a baseline for planning. Perform basic management functions (planning, organizing, leading and control). Conduct planning, feedback, evaluation, and information-sharing meetings with subordinates. Assist with human resource issues at the station and coordinate staff quarterly performance appraisals. Identify and manage risks: Identify relevant risks. Develop a plan to address risks. Implement and monitor plan. Evaluate progress. Manage the performance of all administrative activities and related duties. Ensure that the motor vehicle fleet is managed properly. Monitor the state of equipment and assist with proactive replacement planning, including identifying and monitoring members involved in accidents. Ensure effective loss control measures are in place to address loss of firearms and other related equipment and strive towards reducing the financial value of losses. Participate in budget planning as required by the Center Manager. Monitor monthly expenditure and inspection reports from the province and implement corrective action in problem areas. Regular budget control and management discussions as part of management meetings and share information with members regarding the center's budget priorities.
jobs.enquiries: Call Ms. Avhatakali Nemukula/Mr. Vuyolwethu Sondo Tel No: (011) 689 3845/ 3723/ 3847
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on new Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za/documents (effective from 01 January 2021). All fields in Part A to D of the Z83 form must be completed, and Part E to G noting that there is limited space provided applicants often indicate “refer” to CV or see attached, this is acceptable as long as the CV is attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. The question related to the conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered. Declaration must be completed and signed. The fully completed and signed new Z83 form should be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV only (only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications). Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applicants who do not comply with the above requirements, as well as late applications, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Suitable candidates will undergo a personnel suitability check (Vetting, criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification, and employment verification). The Department of Community Safety reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes. Candidate will be placed according to corridor coordination and the Department’s needs. The Department will not accept posted, emailed or hand delivered applications. We encourage youth, people with disability, coloured, Indian and white to apply and a confirmation of disabilities from a registered medical practitioner must be attached to the application. Please Note: Due to the large number of applications, we envisage to receive, applications will not be acknowledged. If you do not receive any response within 3 months, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Prinsipale Provinciale Inspekteur
af.summary: Prinsipale Provinciale Inspekteur om padverkeer- en openbare vervoerwetgewing in die Gauteng-snelweg-eenheid af te dwing, waarvoor 'n Basiese Verkeersdiploma en 6 tot 10 jaar se ervaring vereis word.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat of hoër kwalifikasie. Moet in besit wees van 'n Basiese Verkeersdiploma. 6 - 10 jaar se werkservaring in die veld. Alle geldige relevante bestuurslisensies (A en EC). Geen strafregistrasie. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van uitgebreide ervaring in padverkeer- en openbare vervoerbeleid en -regulasies. Regshandhawingskennis in verkeer- en openbare vervoervoertuiginspeksies. Voertuigbeslaglegging. Voltooiing van regshandhawing en dokumente. Vaardighede en bevoegdhede in rekordbestuur. Hulpbronbestuur. Kliënteverhoudingsbestuur. Beplanning. Organisering. Leiding. Beheer. Monitering. Mensebestuur. Dienslewering. Kommunikasie. Besluitneming. Resultate- en gehaltebestuur. Probleemoplossing. Skryf en verslag doening van Arbeidsverhoudinge. Bestuursvaardighede. Ondersoekvaardighede. Motiveringsvaardighede. Innovering/ deurlopende verbetering. Analitiese vaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Operasionele/projekbestuur.
af.duties: Bestuur en dwing Padverkeer-, Openbare Passasiers-, Vervoerwetgewing en ander relevante wetgewing af. Ontwikkel operasionele strategieë en verseker implementering van goedgekeurde verkeersregshandhawingsstrategieë. Verseker die vrye vloei van verkeer deur puntpligte en verkeersbeheer by digte gebiede, koördineer aktiwiteite, en bewaar ongelukstonele. Beplan en bestuur spoedtoetsoperasies. Koördineer die uitvoering van arres op verkeerverwante sake, woon hofverrigtinge by, en lewer getuienis. Bestuur prosesse om relevante kennigewings aan oortreders uit te reik. Bestuur verkeerspolisieprojekte. Identifiseer en adviseer relevante rolspelers oor gevaarlike plekke. Bestuur die begeleiding van abnormale voertuie en vragte om die veilige beweging daarvan te verseker. Bestuur monitering van pad sport- en sosiale geleenthede en koördineer oorlaai-beheerbestuur (sluit goedere en passasiers in). Bestuur gesamentlike regshandhawingsaktiwiteite en projekte (koöperatiewe bestuur): Neem deel aan beplanning van gesamentlike handhawingsstrategieë en projekte. Bestuur die uitvoering van gesamentlike regshandhawingsstrategieë en projekte. Evalueer en rapporteer oor strategieë en projekte. Bestuur hulpbronne en verskaf leierskap en rigting aan alle ondergeskiktes: Ontwikkel en handhaaf 'n moniteringstelsel en verseker dat balans bereik word ten opsigte van Senior Provinciale Inspekteurs (SPIS) en Provinciale Inspekteurs (Pls) se produksie, insluitend statistieke van produksie van SPIS en Pls. Implementeer innovasies om die werksomgewing te verbeter en doen besoeke aan beamptes in die veld. Help met die opdatering van die omgewingsanalise om te verseker dat dit as 'n basislyn vir beplanning gebruik word. Voer basiese bestuursfunksies uit (beplanning, organiserig, leiding en beheer). Voer beplannings, terugvoer-, evaluerings- en inligtingsdelingsvergaderings met ondergeskiktes uit. Help met menslike hulpbronkwessies by die stasie en koördineer personeel se kwartaallikse prestasie-evaluerings. Identifiseer en bestuur risiko's: Identifiseer relevante risiko's. Ontwikkel 'n plan om risiko's aan te spreek. Implementeer en monitor plan. Evalueer vordering. Bestuur die prestasie van alle administratiewe aktiwiteite en verwante pligte. Verseker dat die motorvoertuigvloot behoorlik bestuur word. Monitor die toestand van toerusting en help met proaktiewe vervangingsbeplanning, insluitend die identifisering en monitering van lede by ongelukke betrokke. Verseker dat doeltreffende verliesbeheermaatreëls in plek is om verlies van vuurwapens en ander verwante toerusting aan te spreek en streef daarna om die finansiële waarde van verliese te verminder. Neem deel aan begrotingsbeplanning soos vereis deur die Sentrumbestuurder. Monitor maandelikse uitgawes en inspeksieverslae van die provinsie en implementeer regstellende aksie in probleemareas. Gereelde begrotingsbeheer- en bestuursbesprekings as deel van bestuursvergaderings en deel inligting met lede rakende die sentrum se begrotingsprioriteite.

zu.title: Principal Provincial Inspector
zu.summary: Isikhundla sika-Principal Provincial Inspector, ukuze uqinise imithetho yezokuthutha kanye nomphakathi kwi-Gauteng Freeway Unit, sidinga i-Basic Traffic Diploma kanye namava eminyaka engu-6 kuya ku-10.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 noma iziqu eziphezulu. Kufanele ube ne-Basic Traffic Diploma. 6 - 10 years’ working experience in the field. Bonke amelayisense okushayela asebenzayo (A kanye ne-EC). Kungabi nerekhodi lobugebengu. Ulwazi nekhono: Ulwazi lwezinto ezinolwazi olunzulu emithethweni nezinhlelo zezokuthutha kanye Nabahambi Ngabantu. Ulwazi lokuqinisa umthetho ekuhloleni izokuthutha nezimoto Zabahambi Ngabantu. Ukuboshwa kwezimoto. Ukuqedwa kokuphoqa umthetho namadokhumenti. Amakhono namandla ekulawuleni amarekhodi. Ukulawula izinsiza. Ukuphathwa kwezimiso zabakhiqizi. Ukubusela. Ukuhlela. Ukuhola. Ukulawula. Ukwengamela. Ukuphatha Abantu. Ukulethwa kwezinsiza. Unxibelelwano. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuphatha iziphumuzo nakhona. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukubhala futhi Kubike ngamabhusa. Ukushayela amakhono. Amakhono okuphenya. Amakhono okukhuthaza. Inqondo entsha / ukuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo. Amakhono okuhlaziya. Ukubala ngomshini. Ukuphatha ukusebenza / Amaphrojekthi.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi ugcine umthetho Wezokuthutha Ezindaweni, Wabahambi Ngabantu, Wezokuthutha Neminye imithetho ehlobene. Buhlela izindlela zokusebenza futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela ezamukelwe zokuphoqa umthetho wezokuthutha. Qinisekisa ukugeleza kwezokuthutha ngokwenza izabelo kanye nokulawula izokuthutha kwezindawo ezixakekile, hlanganisa imisebenzi, futhi uvikele izigcawu zamacashi. Cwele futhi uphathe imisebenzi yokuhlola isivinini. Hlanganisa ukwenziwa kweziboshwa ezindabeni eziphathelene nezokuthutha, ubambe iqhaza ezinkantolo, futhi unikeze ubufakazi. Phatha inqubo yokukhishwa kwezaziso ezifanele kubaphuli bomthetho. Phatha amaphrojekthi okuphoqa umthetho wezokuthutha. Hlukanisa futhi weluleke abadlali abahlobene ngabazingela ezindaweni eyingozi. Phatha ukuhlola izimoto ezingajwayelekile namalayisense ukuze uqinisekise ukuphepha kwayo. Phatha ukubukwa kwezemidlalo zasezigeni nemicimbi yomphakathi futhi uhlanganise ukulawula ukugeleza ngokweqile (okuhlanganisa izimpahla nabahambi). Phatha imisebenzi namaphrojekthi ahlanganyelwe wokuphoqa umthetho (ukuphathwa ngokubambisana): Bamba iqhaza ekubuseleni izindlela namaphrojekthi ahlanganyelwe wokuphoqa umthetho. Phatha ukwenziwa kwezindlela namaphrojekthi ahlanganyelwe wokuphoqa umthetho. Hlola futhi umbike ngezindlela namaphrojekthi. Phatha izinsiza futhi unikeze inqondo nokuholwa kubo bonke abangaphansi kwakho: Buhlela futhi zigcine indlela yokubuka futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kufinyelelwa ukulingana mayelana ne-Senior Provincial Inspectors (SPIS) ne-Provincial Inspectors (Pls) ukukhiqiza, okuhlanganisa izibalo zokukhiqiza kwe-SPIS ne-Pls. Sebenzisa obufundisi obusha ukuze kuthuthukiswe indawo yokusebenza futhi uvakashele abaholi ensimini. Siza ekubuyiseleni kwesimo sokuhlaziya ukuthi kusetshenziswe njengesisekelo sokubusela. Yenza imisebenzi ebalulekile yokuphatha (ukubusela, ukuhlela, ukuhola nokulawula). Yenza izinkomfa zokubusela, impendulo, ukuhlola, nokwabelana ngolwazi nabangaphansi. Siza ezindabeni zamabalengiso esiteshini futhi uhlanganise ukubukeka kwabasebenzi njalo kothathu amasonto. Hlukanise futhi uphathe izingozi: Hlukanise izingozi ezihlobene. Buhlela uhlelo lokulungisa izingozi. Sebenzisa futhi ubuke uhlelo. Hlola inqubo. Phatha ukusebenza kobunye bonke imisebenzi yobulungiswa neminye imisebenzi ehlobene. Qinisekisa ukuthi uhambo lwezimoto luphathwa kahle. Buka isimo sezinsiza futhi usize ekubuseleni okungase kube khona kokushintsha, okuhlanganisa ukuhlukanisa futhi ubuke amalungu abathintekile emacashini. Qinisekisa ukuthi kunezinyathelo ezisebenzayo zokulawula ukulahlekelwa ukuze kubhekwe ukulahlekelwa izibhamu neminye imishini ehlobene futhi uzame ukunciphisa inani lemali elilahlekayo. Bamba iqhaza ekubuseleni kabhajethi njengoba kudingwa umphathi Wezikhungo. Buka okukhishwa ngenyanga kanye nemibiko yokuhlola esifundazweni futhi usebenzise izinyathelo zokulungisa ezindaweni ezinobudingo. Izinkulumo zokuqondisa nokulawula ibhajethi njalo njengengxenye yezinkomfa zabaphathi futhi wabelane ngolwazi namalungu ngezinto eziphambili zebhajethi yesikhungo.

xh.title: Isiphongo samapolisa wePhondo
xh.summary: Isiphongo samapolisa wePhondo sokuqinisekisa ukusebenza kolwabiwo lwezithuthi kunye noluntu kwisebe lweGauteng Freeway Unit, kufuneka kubekho iDiploma yokuQala yokuLawula isiThuthi kunye neminye eyi 6 ukuya kwi 10 yamava.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 okanye isiqu esiphezulu. Kufunek ubekho iDiploma yokuQala yokuLawula isiThuthi. 6 - 10 yamava okusebenza kule ndawo. Zonke iilayisenisi zokushayela ezisebenzayo ezifanelekileyo (A kunye ne-EC). Akukho nayo ipoto yamacala. Ulwazi kunye namakhono: Ulwazi olunamava amaninzi kumthetho wezithuthi kunye namacebo kaLuntu oHamba ngeNqwelamoya nolawulo. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngomthetho ukuphenya izithuthi ezithunyelwa iLuntu. Ukubamba izithuthi. Ukugqibezela imisebenzi yolawulo lomthetho kunye namaxwebhu. Amakhono kunye nokuziphatha ekulawulweni kwiinkcukacha zobugcisa. Ulawulo lwemithombo. Ulawulo lokubamba umnxhasi wakho. Ukuqulunqa. Ukuhamba. Ukukhokela. Ukulawula. Ukuqwalasela. Ulawulo lwabantu. Ukuhanjiswa kweenkonzo. Unxibelelwano. Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukulawula iziphumo nokuqinisekisa. Ukuzibulala iingxaki. Ukubhala kunye nokubika ngokuBizana ngeBahlali. Amakhono okushayela. Amakhono okuphenya. Amakhono okukhuthaza. Ukuqamba/ukuphucula ngokoqhubela phambili. Amakhono oohlalutyo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulawulo lwezandla/Amaphulo.
xh.duties: Lawula ukuqinisekisa ukuHamba kweziThuthi, ukuHamba kweziThuthi ziSixhobo sabantu kuLuntu, uMthetho weziThuthi namanye omathetho abalulekileyo. Qamba amacebo okusebenza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kwamacebo okuLawula isiThuthi. Qinisekisa ukuHamba kweziThuthi ngokubeka abantu kumanqanaba kwaye ulawule isiThuthi kummandla ongabalulekiyo, wenze imisebenzi eqhagamshelanayo, ugcine indawo yommandla wentswela. Cwangcisa ulawule iinkqubo ezijolise ekutshekweni isantya. Qhagamshele ekwenziweni kokubamba abantu kumacala ezithuthi, uphumelele kwiinkqubo zesigqeba, unike iinkcukacha. Lawula inkqubo yonikezelo lelaphu kwabanye abantu. Lawula amaphulo okuqinisekisa ukuba akukho nafipha. Lawula amaphando okuthutha izithuthi ngokubakhusela nokuzisa iinkqubo ngokuzinza nezithuthi ngokuba unako. Lawula iinkqubo zokuphenya iindawo ezingozayo kwaye ulule abanye abo balibheke phaya kweli ndawo. Lawula ukuhamba kwezithuthi ezingeyomthetho kunye namalungelo okwenza oko ngokulawula ukuhamba kwakhona ngokukhuselekileyo. Lawula ukuqwalasela kwemidlalo yaseluwonxwameni kwakunye nemiba yoluntu kwaye ulawule ukuqhagamshelana kolawulo (kuqulathe izinto ezahlukeneyo kubasebenzi). Lawula iinkqubo zomthetho ezahlukeneyo kwaye ulawule (iinkqubo zoluntu ezahlukeneyo): Thatha inxaxheba ekulwenziweni amacebo nokulawula iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo. Lawula ukusebenza kweekhosi ezahlukeneyo kunye namaphulo. Qwalasela kwaye ube ngumceli ngolwazi kwiimeko kunye namaphulo. Lawula iinkqubo zonikezelo ngokubanzi phakathi kwabasebenzi bakho: Qamba ulawulo lwezinto ezahlukeneyo kwaye uqinisekise ukuba kuye kubekho ngokubanzi phakathi kwabasebenzi bakaRhulumente (kunye nabasebenzi besiLungu sikarhulumente) iindidi ezahlukeneyo kwaye zenziwe kwaye kubekho isibalo ngokubanzi kwabo bo basebenzi. Sebenzisa izinto ezintsha ukuphucula imozamo yokusebenza kwaye ukhangele abasebenzi ekwindawo yesebe. Nceda ekulwenziweni isixhobo esahlukeneyo sokulawula ukuba sibe ngumthengi weendlela. Lawula imisebenzi efunekayo (ukucwangcisa, ukulungelelanisa, ukukhokela, ukulawula kwaye ulawule kwaye) kwaye ulawule imisebenzi yonke. Yenza iinkqubo zokubonisana, ukubika, ukubonisana ngolwazi kunye nokubonisana nabasebenzi nangoncedo. Nceda ngemiba yemithombo yamandla kwindawo yamandla kwaye ulawule iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa ukwenzeka kwexesha. Qaphela ulawule iingozi: Qondana neengozi. Cwangcisa ulawulo oluzama ukubonakalisa iingozi. Qinisekisa kwaye ulawule ulawulo. Qwalasela inkqubo. Lawula ukwenza konke okuballwayo kwakunye nemiba ezo kubakho kuyo. Qinisekisa ukuba ulawulo lwezithuthi ziKhompyutha lulungile. Qwalasela ukulungiswa kwamathulusi kwaye uncede ekucwangcisweni amathulusi amatsha, ngokubandakanya nokubona ukubonakala kweemeko ekutheni ngamalungu athunyelwe ekubeni yinkathazo. Qinisekisa ukuba kukho iindidi ezilawulwayo zokulawula ukulahleka kwezinto ezahlukeneyo kwaye uzame ukunciphisa inani lemali ephilayo. Thatha inxaxheba ekucwangcisweni kwexabiso njengoko kufuneka ngumlawuli wesebe. Qwalasela iinkcukacha zentsuzu ngenyanga ezivela kwiphondo kwaye usebenzise izigqibo ezilungileyo kummandla ongenanto. Qwalasela ngeendaba ngexabiso njengoko kungenwa njengenxaxheba yemibono yolawulo kwaye ulwazi olusemthethweni lwahlulelayo ngeendaba ezibalulekileyo.

jobs.title: Principal Provincial Inspector
jobs.salary_text: R413 001 per annum, plus service benefits.
jobs.summary: Principal Provincial Inspector managing road traffic law enforcement and public transport compliance at the Escort Unit in Gauteng.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 Certificate or higher qualification. Must be in possession of a Basic Traffic Diploma. 6 - 10 years’ working experience in the field. All valid relevant driving licenses (A and EC). No criminal record. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge of Extensive experience in road traffic and Public Transport policies and regulations. Law enforcement knowledge in traffic and Public Transport Vehicle inspections. Vehicle Impoundment. Completion of law enforcement and documents. Skills and competencies in records management. Resource management. Customer relationship management. Planning. Organizing. Leading. Controlling. Monitoring. People Management. Service delivery. Communication. Decision-making. Results and quality management. Problem solving. Writing & Reporting. Labour Relations. Driving skills. Investigation skills. Motivational skills. Innovation/ continuous improvement. Analytical skills. Computer literacy. Operations/Projects management.
jobs.duties: Manage and enforce Road Traffic, Public Passenger, Transport Legislation and other relevant legislation. Develop operational strategies and ensure implementation of approved traffic law enforcement strategies. Ensure the free flow of traffic through point duty and traffic control at congested areas, coordinate activities, and safeguard accident scenes. Plan and manage speed testing operations. Coordinate execution of arrests on traffic-related matters, attend court proceedings, and give evidence. Manage processes of issuing relevant notices to offenders. Manage traffic policing projects. Identify and advise relevant role-players on hazardous locations. Manage escorting of abnormal vehicles and loads to ensure the safe movement thereof. Manage monitoring of road sports and social events and coordinate overload control management (includes goods and passengers). Manage joint law enforcement activities and projects (co-operative governance): Participate in planning of joint enforcement strategies and projects. Manage the execution of joint law enforcement strategies and projects. Evaluate and report on strategies and projects. Manage resources and provide leadership and direction to all subordinates: Develop and maintain a monitoring system and ensure that balance is achieved with regard to Senior Provincial Inspectors (SPIS) and Provincial Inspectors (Pls) production, including statistics of production of SPIS and Pls. Implement innovations to improve the working environment and conduct visits to officers in the field. Assist with the updating of the environmental analysis to ensure that it is used as a baseline for planning. Perform basic management functions (planning, organizing, leading and control). Conduct planning, feedback, evaluation, and information-sharing meetings with subordinates. Assist with human resource issues at the station and coordinate staff quarterly performance appraisals. Identify and manage risks: Identify relevant risks. Develop a plan to address risks. Implement and monitor the plan. Evaluate progress. Manage the performance of all administrative activities and related duties. Ensure that the motor vehicle fleet is managed properly. Monitor the state of equipment and assist with proactive replacement planning, including identifying and monitoring members involved in accidents. Ensure effective loss control measures are in place to address loss of firearms and other related equipment and strive towards reducing the financial value of losses. Participate in budget planning as required by the Center Manager. Monitor monthly expenditure and inspection reports from the province and implement corrective action in problem areas. Regular budget control and management discussions as part of management meetings and share information with members regarding the center's budget priorities.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Avhatakali Nemukula/Mr. Vuyolwethu Sondo Tel No: (011) 689 3845/ 3723/

All fields in Part A to D of the Z83 form must be completed, and Part E to G noting that there is limited space provided applicants often indicate “refer” to CV or see attached, this is acceptable as long as the CV is attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. The question related to the conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered. Declaration must be completed and signed. The fully completed and signed new Z83 form should be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV only (only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications). Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applicants who do not comply with the above requirements, as well as late applications, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Suitable candidates will undergo a personnel suitability check (Vetting, criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification, and employment verification). The Department of Community Safety reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes. Candidate will be placed according to corridor coordination and the Department’s needs. The Department will not accept posted, emailed or hand delivered applications. We encourage youth, people with disability, coloured, Indian and white to apply and a confirmation of disabilities from a registered medical practitioner must be attached to the application.
