af.title: Hoofproviniale Inspekteur
af.summary: Hoofproviniale Inspekteur wat padverkeerswetstoepassing en openbarevervoernakoming by die Escort Unit in Gauteng bestuur.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat of hoër kwalifikasie. Moet in besit wees van 'n Basiese Verkeersdiploma. 6 - 10 jaar se werkservaring in die veld. Alle geldige tersaaklike bestuurslisensies (A en EC). Geen strafregister. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van Uitgebreide ervaring in padverkeer- en Openbare Vervoerbeleid en regulasies. Wetstoepassingskennis in verkeer- en Openbare Vervoervoertuiginspeksies. Voertuigbeslaglegging. Voltooiing van wetstoepassing en dokumente. Vaardighede en bevoegdhede in rekordbestuur. Hulpbronbestuur. Kliëntverhoudingsbestuur. Beplanning. Organisering. Leiding gee. Beheer. Monitering. Mensebestuur. Dienslewering. Kommunikasie. Besluitneming. Resultate- en gehaltebestuur. Probleemoplossing. Skryf en Verslagdoening. Arbeidsverhoudinge. Bestuursvaardighede. Ondersoekvaardighede. Motiveringsvaardighede. Innovasie/ deurlopende verbetering. Analitiese vaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Operasies/Projekbestuur.
af.duties: Bestuur en handhaaf Padverkeer-, Openbare Passasiers-, Vervoerwetgewing en ander tersaaklike wetgewing. Ontwikkel operasionele strategieë en verseker implementering van goedgekeurde verkeerswetstoepassingsstrategieë. Verseker die vrye vloei van verkeer deur puntpligte en verkeersbeheer by ongevalle tonele. Plan en bestuur spoedtoetsoperasies. Koördineer die uitvoering van arrestasies rakende verkeersake, woon hofverrigtinge by en lewer getuienis. Bestuur prosesse vir die uitreiking van tersaaklike kennisskrywes aan oortreders. Bestuur verkeerspolisierprojekte. Identifiseer en adviseer tersaaklike rolspelers oor gevaarlike plekke. Bestuur die begeleiding van abnormale voertuie en vragte om die veilige beweging daarvan te verseker. Bestuur die monitering van pad sport- en sosiale geleenthede en koördineer oorladingbeheerbestuur (sluit goedere en passasiers in). Bestuur gesamentlike wetstoepassingsaktiwiteite en projekte (koöperatiewe bestuur): Neem deel aan beplanning van gesamentlike toepassingsstrategieë en projekte. Bestuur die uitvoering van gesamentlike wetstoepassingsstrategieë en projekte. Evalueer en rapporteer oor strategieë en projekte. Bestuur hulpbronne en verskaf leierskap en rigting aan alle ondergeskiktes: Ontwikkel en handhaaf 'n moniteringstelsel en verseker dat balans bereik word met betrekking tot Senior Proviniale Inspekteurs (SPIS) en Proviniale Inspekteurs (Pls) produksie, insluitend statistieke van produksie van SPIS en Pls. Implementeer innovasies om die werksomgewing te verbeter en voer besoeke aan beamptes in die veld uit. Help met die opdatering van die omgewingsanalise om te verseker dat dit as 'n basislyn vir beplanning gebruik word. Voer basiese bestuursfunksies uit (beplanning, organiseer, leiding gee en beheer). Hou beplannings-, terugvoer-, evaluerings- en inligtingsdelingsvergaderings met ondergeskiktes. Help met menslike hulpbronkwessies by die stasie en koördineer kwartaallikse prestasie-evaluerings van personeel. Identifiseer en bestuur risiko's: Identifiseer tersaaklike risiko's. Ontwikkel 'n plan om risiko's aan te spreek. Implementeer en monitor die plan. Evalueer vordering. Bestuur die prestasie van alle administratiewe aktiwiteite en verwante pligte. Verseker dat die motorvoertuigvloot behoorlik bestuur word. Monitor die toestand van toerusting en help met proaktiewe vervangingsbeplanning, insluitend die identifisering en monitering van lede betrokke by ongevalle. Verseker dat doeltreffende verliesbeheermaatreëls in plek is om verlies van vuurwapens en ander verwante toerusting aan te spreek en streef daarna om die finansiële waarde van verliese te verminder. Neem deel aan begrotingsbeplanning soos vereis deur die Sentrumbestuurder. Monitor maandelikse bestedings- en inspeksieverslae van die provinsie en implementeer korrigerende optrede in probleemareas. Reëlmatige begrotingsbeheer- en bestuursbesprekings as deel van bestuursvergaderings en deel inligting met lede rakende die sentrum se begrotingsprioriteite.

zu.title: IsiGungqwana SesiFundazwe Esikhulu
zu.summary: IsiGungqwana SesiFundazwe Esikhulu esiphethe ukuphoqelelwa kwemithetho yeqembu lezokuthutha kumgwaqo kanye nokuhambisana kolawulo lokuhamba kwabantu emkhakheni we-Escort Unit e-Gauteng.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 noma iziqu eziphakeme. Kumele ube ne-Basic Traffic Diploma. Uluhlu lweminyaka eyi-6 - 10 yokusebenza kuleminyaka. Amalayisensi wokuqasha akho wonke (A kanye ne-EC). Akukho rekodi yobugebengu. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngoluhlu olubanzi lweminyaka yokusebenza kumthetho wezokuthutha komgwaqo kanye namapholisi Nokuhamba Kwabantu Nomthetho. Ulwazi lokuphoqelela umthetho kokuhlola izimoto zokuthutha nokuhamba Kwabantu. Ukuboshwa kwezimoto. Ukugcwaliseka kokuphoqelela umthetho namadokhumenti. Amakhono namandla okulawula irekhodi. Ukulawula izinsiza. Ukuphathwa kwezimabhizinisi zabakhulumeni. Ukulungelelisa. Ukuhlela. Ukukhokhela. Ukulawula. Ukubuka. Ukuphatha abantu. Ukuletha izinkonzo. Unxibelelwano. Ukuthatha izinqumo. Ukuphatha imiphumela nethuluzi. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukubhala nokubika. Izindaba Zabasebenzi. Amakhono okuqasha. Amakhono okuphenya. Amakhono okukhuthaza. Intuthuko ephila. Amakhono okuhlaziya. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Ukuphatha imisebenzi/ amaphrojekthi.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi uphoqe umthetho WokuHamba Kwezimoto, Abaphathi Basesiphithini BawoLuntu, Umthetho WokuHamba kanyeNomthetho ohlobene Nawe. Umumathe izindlela zokusebenza futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela ezivunyiwe zokuphoqelela umthetho wokuhamba kwezimoto. Qinisekisa ukugeleza kwezimoto ngokusebenza kwenqolobane nokulawula ukubukumela kwezimoto kulezo ndawo ezixakekile, hlelululula imisebenzi, futhi uvikele izigcawu zezona zinkinga. Hlela futhi uphathe imisebenzi yokuhlola isivinini. Hlelululula ukwenziwa kokuqiniswa kolimi ngabezomthetho ngendaba zokuhamba kwemoto, khona ezinkundleni zezinkantolo, futhi nike umlando. Phatha inqubo yokupha izaziso ezihambisana ezinsongeni. Phatha amaphrojekthi okhusa umthetho. Hlaza futhi unikele abenimfihlo ngendawo ezinobungozi. Phatha ukulungiselela nokuhambiswa kwezimoto ezinolwengo nemithwalo yawo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhamba kwezokuphepha. Phatha ubumfihlo bokubuka imidlalo yomgwaqo kanye nemikhosi yomphakathi futhi uhlele ukulawula ukulawuka isithwalo (okuqukethe izimpahla nabagibeli). Phatha imisebenzi yokuphoqelela umthetho ngokubambisana namaphrojekthi (imibusano yoculumo): Yiba ingxenye yokucocwa kwamasu nokusebenza ngokubambisana okuyinkimbinkimbi nokusebenza kwamaphrojekthi. Hlela futhi uphathe ukwenziwa kwamasu nokusebenza ngokubambisana okuyinkimbinkimbi ngokuphoqelela umthetho. Hlola futhi ubeke ngesu namaphrojekthi. Phatha izinsiza futhi nike isibonakaliso nesiqondiso konke okusemva kwakho: Umumathe futhi ukhombise inkqubo yokulawula ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kusuke kunesilinganiso kumakhono kwezindaba ze-Senior Provincial Inspectors (SPIS) nezindaba zolwazi nakulabo Kuphansi Kwabo (Pls), okubandakanya izibalo zokuqamba izindaba kuleminyaka okuyi-SPIS kanye namaphoyisa. Kenza ukuqonda okusha ukuze kuthuthukiswe indawo yokusebenza futhi ukhombise izinsuku eziyisikhungo ebyithi ikhasimende emkhakheni.usize ngesimo sezindawo ezingahlaziywa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ziyisisekelo ekucocweni. Yenza imisebenzi eyisisekelo yengaphandle futhi (ukulunga, ukwakha, ukukhuluma ngemisebenzi, nokuhola). Hola futhi uhlele imikhosi yokucoca, ukubuka, ukuhlola, nokwazisana ngolwazi nalabo abakusemva.usize nezinsizakalo zomuntu esiteshini futhi uhlele ukubukeka komsebenzi wezinsipho ezinhlanu zabasebenzi. Bonisa futhi uphathe izinsongo: Bonisa izinsongo ezihlobene nokulinganiselwa nokusebenza. Umumathe isu lokubheka izinsongo. Qhube futhi ubuke inkqubo. Hlola inqubo nokuguquka. Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwayo yonke imisebenzi esekela ukusebenza emkhakheni. Qinisekisa ukuthi imoto iyayilawulwa kahle. Bukela isimo sezimoto futhi usize nokuqonda okungalinganiselwa kokushintsha ezinto, okuhlanganisa nokubona nokubuka amalunga abathintwe ngomonakalo. Qinisekisa izinyathelo ezingasebenza kahle zokulawula ukulahleka kwezikhali futhi zizocasha nezinye izinto ezihlobene nazo nokubeka igalelo lokucatshangelwa okuphansi kolahleka. Ngena ohlelweni lwentela kuyilapho kudingeka khona nguSikhulu Sesikhungo. Bukela ukusetshenziswa kwenyanga zonke nokubukelwa imibiko esuka esifundazweni futhi ufake izinyathelo ezilungisayo ezindaweni ezinosimo. Bukela futhi ulawule inkomba yokubukelwa imibiko yokusetshenzwa kwentela kanye nokusetshenziswa kwenkulumo njengengxenye yemihlangano yokuphatha futhi ukwazise ngolwazi abalunga ngamabalana obugcisa bokuqeda imali.

xh.title: iNkundla yeNqanaba eliphezulu leProvincial Inspector
xh.summary: iNkundla yeNqanaba eliphezulu leProvincial Inspector ephatha ukusebenza kwezomthetho wezokuhamba kunye nokuzithobela kwezokuthutha kwenzakhowaba kwiiNqanaba zeEscort Unit eGauteng.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 okanye isidanga esiphezulu. Kufuneka ubeneDiploma yeBasic Traffic. 6 - 10 iminyaka yamava okusebenza kwindima. Zonke iilayisenisi zokushayela ezisezizo (A kunye neEC). Akukho rekholo yobugcisa. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngamava anamandla kumthetho wezokuhamba nezokuThutha kwenzakhowaba nezithetho. Ulwazi lokusebenza komthetho kwizokuhamba nokukhangela izithuthi zokuThutha kwenzakhowaba. Ukuthathwa kogunyaziso kwezithuthi. Ukugqiba ukusebenza komthetho namaxwebhu. Amakhono anamandla ekulawulweni kweerekhodi. Ukulawula izixhobo. Ukulawula ubudlelwane namakhasimende. Ukucwangcisa. Ukulungiselela. Ukukhokela. Ukulawula. Ukugcina iliso. Ukulawula abantu. Ukulekelela inkonzo. Unxibelelwano. Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukulawula iziphumo nomgangatho. Ukuxazulula iingxaki. Ukubhala nokubika. Ubudlelwane bolusebenzo. Amakhono okushayela. Amakhono okuphonononga. Amakhono okukhuthaza. Iingqiqo/ukuphucula ngokuhlala njalo. Amakhono okuhlalutywa. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngakomkhaya. Ukulawula iimisebenzi/iziprojekthi.
xh.duties: Ukuphatha nokuphumeza umthetho wezokuhamba, wezokuhamba kwabagibeli, umthetho wezokuthutha nokunye umthetho ongoyikiyo. Ukuphucula iindlela zokusebenza kuqinisekise ukuphumeza iindlela ezamkelekileyo zokusebenza komthetho wezokuhamba. Kuqinisekiswe ukuhamba mahhle kwethrafikhi ngokwenza umsebenzi weqondo kunye nolawulo lwethrafikhi kwiindawo ezixakekileyo, ukwongcisana nemisebenzi, nokhusela iindawo zeengozi. Ukucwangcisa nokuphatha imisebenzi yokuvavanya isantya. Ukwongcisana nokwenza izigqibo zokubamba abantu kumacala ezokuhamba, ukubakho kwiinkqubo zeenkantolo, nanikubanamangalingo. Ukuphatha iinkqubo zokunika izaziso ezifanelekileyo abenzi bashenxa. Ukuphatha iiprojekthi zokulawula ezokuhamba. Ukuchonga nokuxelela abadlali abafanelekileyo ngabangele iindawo ezinengozi. Ukuphatha ukukhusela izithuthi ezingaqhelekanga kunye namthwalo ukuze kuqiniseke ukuhamba kwazo ngokhuselekileyo. Ukuphatha ukugcina iliso kwezemidlalo zomgama neminye imicimbi yentlalontle, kunye nokwongcisana nolawulo lokugqitha umthwalo (okuquka izinto nabagibeli). Ukuphatha imisebenzi yomthetho exhubyene kunye neeprojekthi (urhulumente ohlanganyelayo): Ukubamba iqondo kuphakathi kwecwangciso leendlela zokuphumeza umthetho kunye neeprojekthi. Ukuphatha ukuphumeza iindlela kunye neeprojekthi zokusebenza komthetho ohlanganyela. Ukuvavanya nokubingelela ngeendlela neeprojekthi. Ukuphatha izixhobo kunye nokubonelela nokuqhuba ukulawula kunye nolondolozo kubo bonke abangenielayo: Ukuphucula ukugcina indlela yokugcina iliso kuqiniseke kufikelelwa kumlinganiselo ngokomthombo wabaphathi besebe bahamba icangi (SPIS) kunye nabaphathi besebe (Pls) ekwenzeni imisebenzi, kuquka nokuqokelelwa kwemveliso yeSPIS kunye nePls. Ukusebenzisa iindlela ezintsha ukuze kuphuculwe ukusingathwa koluntu nokwenza iindwendwe kumagosa abasekwindlela eziyiyo. Ukunceda ekuhlaziyeni iingongoma zendalo kuqinisekise ukuba ziyasetyenziswa njengesiseko sokucwangcisa. Ukwenza imisebenzi esisiseko yokulawula (ukucwangcisa, ukulungiselela, ukukhokela, ukulawula). Ukuqhuba iintlanganiso zokucwangcisa, ukuphindiselela, ukuvavanya, kunye nokuvelisa ulwazi kunye abangenielayo. Ukunceda kwingxaki zentsandla yabantu esikhundleni esithile ukwongcisana nokuqokelelwa kwemveliso yabasebenzi nyaka zonke. Ukuchonga nokuphatha iingozi: Ukuchonga iingozi ezifanelekileyo. Ukucwangcisa isicwangciso ngokwale ngozi. Ukuphumeza ukugcina iliso kwesicwangciso. Ukuvavanya inkqubela. Ukuphatha imisebenzi yemisebenzi yobunjineli kunye nomyalelo ongqalelo. Ukqinisekise ukuba iqela lezithuthi lisebenza ngokuchanekileyo. Ukugcina iliso kumimo wezixhobo ukunceda ngesicwangciso sokutshintsha ngaphambili, kuquka ukuchonga ukugcina iliso kubalungu abathintwa zingozi. Kuqinisekiswa amanyathelo alokulawula amashishini asekunyameni ukubandakanywa kushishini lokulahleka kwezixhobo ezinxulumene nokuzama ukunciphisa ixabiso lemali ekulahlekeni. Ukubamba iqondo kwecwangciso lepalament njengoko kufunwa nguMphathi weCenter. Ukugcina iliso ekuchithwa kwemali ngamnye kunye neNgxelo yokukhangela kwephondo kwaye uphumeze amanyathelo olungiso kwiziphithiphithi. Ukulawula ngokuchithwa kwemali kunye nengxoxo yokulawula njengengxenye yentlanganiso yolawulo ukwabelana ngolwazi namalungu ngokumisela ibhalansi yeendibano zepalament zomnye womkhango.

Facilitate reports for various strategic reporting. Coach and mentor staff members. Co-ordinate the development of operational plans, alignment of performance contracts, monitoring and evaluation. Submit inputs for drafting of unit budget. Supervise utilisation of sub-section budget and expenditure. Submit inputs the compilation of various reports and statistics for the sub-section. Supervise staff related matters e.g. leave and conflict.

af.title: Senior HR-praktisyn
af.summary: Senior HR-praktisyn wat rekordbeheer, korrespondensieregistrasie en lêerwerk by die Department of Community Safety-hoofkantoor in Johannesburg bestuur.
af.requirements: A Grade 12-sertifikaat plus 'n baccalaureusgraad in openbare bestuur of NQF-vlak 6. 3-5 jaar se ervaring in Rekordbestuur. Alle geldige relevante bestuurslisensies (A en EC). Geen strafregister of hangende sake teen jou nie. Kennis en Vaardighede: Tesourie-regulasies. Begrip van verskillende projektbestuursbeginsels. Relevante wetgewing en openbare diensregulasies. Begrip van DCS-verwante projekte. Begrip van kliënte se verwagtinge. Kennis van SLA's. Bestuursinligtingskennis. Arbeidsverhoudingkonsepte, teorieë, voorskrifte en wetgewing. Projektbestuurmetodologieë. Besigheidsprestasiebestuur. Belanghebbende-verhoudingbestuur. Beleidontwikkelingsontleding en -toepassing. Onderhandelingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Ontwikkel 'n beheerregister en verseker dat alle korrespondensie wat ontvang is, geregistreer en dienooreenkomstig versprei word. Berei dokumentasie wat daagliks ontvang word, voor en verseker lêering volgens die departementele lêerplan en die National Archive Act 43 of 1996. Berei lêering van alle dokumente voor en perforeer dit na die tersaaklike bokslêers. Verseker vertroulikheid van lewende en gearchiveerde lêers volgens die Minimum Information Security Standard of 2000. Implementeer behoorlike HR-lêerstelsels. Stoor HR-lêers soos ingelig deur departementele argiveringsriglyne. Monitor en evalueer tendense en patrone van departementele personeelrekordbestuurstelsels en rapporteer afwykings. Implementeer en identifiseer leemtes in rekordbestuursbeleid. Toets, ontleed tendense en praktyke. Berei verslae voor vir verskeie strategiese verslagdoening. Verskaal betaalstrokies vir alle normale en aanvullende lopies. Sorteer en versprei betaalstrokies na verskeie amptenare. Versprei loonrol en loonrolsertifisate vir ondertekening deur die tersaaklike gesag in ooreenstemming met Tesourie-regulasies. Lê alle korrespondensie rakende loonrol. Versamel en versprei IRP5's en lê dit jaarliks. Berei verslae voor vir verskeie strategiese verslagdoening. Ontwikkel 'n databasis vir alle HR-navrae wat ontvang is. Registreer alle navrae wat in die HR-databasis ontvang is. Rangskik alle navrae volgens kompleksiteit. Fasiliteer tydige respons aan kliënte. Eskaleer waar nodig komplekse navrae vir dringende ingryping en moontlike oplossing. Berei inkomende en uitgaande korrespondensie voor vir alle korrespondensie wat ontvang is. Fasiliteer verslae vir verskeie strategiese verslagdoening. Afrig en begelei personeellede. Koördineer die ontwikkeling van operasionele planne, belyning van prestasiekontrakte, monitering en evaluering. Dien insetsel vir die opstel van die eenheidsbegroting. Hou toesig oor benutting van die subafdelingsbegroting en besteding. Dien insetsel by die samestelling van verskeie verslae en statistieke vir die subafdeling. Hou toesig oor personeelverwante aangeleenthede bv. verlof en konflik.

zu.title: Umphathi Omkhulu We-HR
zu.summary: Umphathi Omkhulu We-HR obophethe ukuqaphelwa kwemibhalo, ukubhaliswa koxhumo nokufaka emafayela eNdlunkulu Yomnyango Wezokuphepha Kwengumphakathi eJohannesburg.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12 kahle nesiqu sebhalorwe degrees in public administration noma i-NQF level 6. 3-5 yeminyaka yokuhlangabezana emsebenzini wokuqapha imibhalo. Zonke izelayisensi zokushayela ezivumelekile (A kanye ne-EC). Kungabi noludweba noma noma yimiphi imicimbi evulekile ngawe. Ulwazi Namakhono: I-Treasury regulations.ukuqonda izimiso ezahlukene zokuqondisa amaphrojekthi. Umthetho ohambisanayo nemimiselo yomnyango wonke. Ukuqonda amaphrojekthi ahambisana ne-DCS. Ukuqonda izinkombandlela zabathengi. Ulwazi nge-SLAs. Ulwazi lokuphatha ulwazi. Iminikelo yabasebenzi: izinqubo, izincomo, imibhalo nemithetho. Izindlela zokuqondisa amaphrojekthi. Ukuphatha ukusebenza kwebhizinisi. Ukuphatha ubudlelwano namalunga ahlobene. Ukuhlaziya nokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo yomthetho. Izikhathi zokuqamba izinkulumo.
zu.duties: Bhala umlobokazi wolawulo futhi qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imibhalo etholakalayo ibhalisiwe futhi ithunyelwe ngendlela efanayo. Lungiselela imibhalo etholwa nsuku zonke futhi qinisekisa ukuyifaka ngohlelo lwemibhalo Lomnyango nange-National Archive Act 43 of 1996. Lungiselela ukufaka emafayela yonke imibhalo kwaye uyiphothe kumabokisi afanele. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwezimfihlo kwamafayela aphila kanye nalawo adotolwe ngokwe-Minimum Information Security Standard ka-2000. Sebenzisa izindlela zokuqondisa imibhalo ye-HR endleleni efanele. Gcina amafayela we-HR ngokwezincwajiso zamafayela zomnyango. Qaphazani futhi nihlaziye izindlela nemitapo yokuphatha imibhalo yabasebenzi bomnyango futhi nibike ngokwehluka. Phuma nokuqonda futhi uhlole imikhawulo yezinqubomgomo yokuphatha imibhalo. Qondanisa, hlaziya izikhubekelo nezindlela. Lungiselela amabhudesi ehlukene. Qoqa izipephu zeholo ezivela ezikhundleni zazo. Sula futhi abulethe izipephu ebasebenzini. Abulththe izipephu zeholo kanye namathikhithi ehhola ukuze asayinwe abantu abafanelekile. Faka yonke imibhalo ngendlela ehambisana. Qoqa futhi sasaza i-IRP5 bese uyifaka emacwadini ngonyaka wonyaka. Hlela amabhudesi abalingene. Sebenzisa isizathu ngamafayela wezisebenzi. sebenzisa idathabhensi kumibuzo yonke. Bhala umngozii wobudlovwana. Hlukanisa imibuzo ngokuhluka kwamazinga. Qinisekisa isikhathi. Lolu kugqamisa ukuthi singene olunye usuku mayelana nokuthi uhlezi nganoma ngabe yiluphi uhlobo. Faka izikhombisimalunga ezifanele.

xh.title: Umntu oPhatha abasebenzi obeNgangathabathi inqanaba eliphezulu kwi-HR
xh.summary: Umntu oPhatha abasebenzi obeNgangathabathi inqanaba eliphezulu kwi-HR ophatha ulawulo lwerekhodi, ukubhaliswa kothungelwano nokuwafaka kwindawo yawo ezingununyiswa kwiNtloko eNkulu yesebe leDepartment of Community Safety eJohannesburg.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethda seGrade 12 kunye nenqanaba le-bachelor's degree kwi-public administration okanye i-NQF level 6. Unyaka wokuqonda o3-5 kwi-Records Management. Yamakhepha akho okushayela ahambelana nawo ongagqityekanga (A kunye ne-EC). Akukho bungozi bokubhukuśwa ngamacala okanye naziphi na iicala ezingekayo ezichthwe kuwe. Ulwazi namakhono: Iimigaqo ye-Treasury. Ukuqonda iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zolawulo lweeprojekthi. Umthetho ohambelana nayo nemiqathango yesebe loqeqesho. Ukuqonda iiprojekthi ezinxulumene ne-DCS. Ukuqonda iimfuno zabathengi. Ulwazi nge-SLAs. Ulwazi lolawulo lwolwazi. Iingcamango, iithiyori, imigaqo nomthetho we-Labour relations. Iindlela zolawulo lweeprojekthi. Ulawulo lwenkqubo yokusebenza kwishishini. Ulawulo lolwalamano nabanomzabalazo. Uhlalutyo lolusebenziso kolwaziswa kwemigaqo. Amakhono okuxoxisana.
xh.duties: Phezula irekhodi yolawulo uze uqiniseke ukuba onke axwebhu athunyelweyo abhalisiwe athunyelwe kwindawo efanelekileyo. Lungaxa uxwebhu olufunyenwe ngemini yonke uze uqiniseke ukuba lufakwe kwifayile ngokomgxobankqubo wesebe nefayile yoMthetho weNaruba iNational Archive Act 43 of 1996. Lungaxa ukufaka kwifayile yonke amaxwebhu kuwafake ebokisini elifanelekileyo. Ukuqinisekisa ukugcinwa kolwaziswa kwamafayile abhalileyo kunye nalawo agcinwe ngokomGaqo oNgununyiswa ngeMininimum Information Security Standard ka-2000. Misela inkqubo yokufaka kwamafayile e-HR echanekileyo. Gcina amafayile e-HR ngokumiswa kwemigaqo yokugcina amaxwebhu yesbe. Qaphela uze uhlalutye iindlela namaphetha enkqubo yolawulo lweRekhodi zabasebenzi besebe uze uxele ingxaki ekhoyo. Zisebenzise uze uzive iingxowa kumthetho wolawulo lweerekhodi. Linganisa uhlalutye iindlela namaphetha. Lungaxa iingxelo ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo zokuvela iingxelo eziphambili. Qokelela iipayslips zakuzonke iziphakamiso ezizele nezongezelelweyo. Hlengahlengisa uze uwabelise iipayslip kubasebenzi bahlukeneyo. Sabelisa amapayroll namathifikethi apayroll ukuba basayine ngobukhosi obufanelekileyo ngokwemigaqo ye-Treasury Regulations. Faka kwifayile lonke uthungelwano oluthintelayo nge-payroll. Qokelela uze usabelise ama-IRP5s uze uwafake kwifayile ngamnyaka. Lungaxa iingxelo ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo zokuvela iingxelo eziphambili. Misela idatha-base yethe yonke imibuzo evela kwi-HR. Bhala yonke imibuzo efunyenwe kwi-HR idatha-base. Sabela yonke imibuzo ngokobunzima bawo. Zenza iziphendulo ezisesikweni kumaxhaso. Apho kufuneka khona dlulisa imibuzo eminzima ukuba kungenelelwe ngokukhawuleza kungancediswa ngokunokwenzeka. Lungaxa uthungelwano olufunyenweyo nokunyeniweyo yonke axwebhu athunyeliweyo. Zenze iingxelo ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo zokuvela iingxelo eziphambili. Qeqesha uze ulalele abasebenzi. Lawula ukuphefumlelwa kweenkqubo zokusebenza, ukuvumelanisa konke izivumelisanzo zenkqubo, ukuqaphela ukuze kuhlolwe. Nika izimvo ekubhaleni kwejelo lemali elisebenzayo. Qaphela ukusetyenziswa kwejelo lemali lengxenye engezantsi nendlela ekuqiweyo. Nika izimvo ekubhaleni kweengxelo ezahlukeneyo neze-statistics kule nxenye engantsi. Lawula imiba ezinxulumene nabasebenzi njengokuhamba nkonxe ekuphikisanweni.

jobs.title: Senior VEC Coordinator
jobs.salary_text: R413 001 per annum, plus service benefits.
jobs.summary: Senior VEC Coordinator to implement Victim Empowerment programmes including Green Door and Floor Management at the Pretoria Regional Office.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 certificate Bachelor’s Degree: preferably Social Sciences / Community Development as recognized by SAQA. 2 - 3 years’ working experience in Victim empowerment Field. A valid driving license. No criminal record or any pending cases against you. Knowledge and Skills: Basic knowledge and understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service. Basic knowledge of work procedures in terms of the working environment. Knowledge of the National Strategic Plan on Gender Based Violence and Femicide and the department Crime Prevention Strategy. Knowledge of the National Crime Prevention Strategy skills. Statistical analysis. Adaptation to change management. Report writing. Conflict management. Presentation skills. Be able to work under Pressure, Team worker, Flexible/change oriented, Problem-solving ability, Responsive, Interpersonal relations, Customer focus, Credible.
jobs.duties: Coordinate the implementation of the Green Door and Floor Management programme in line with the APP and AOP. Coordinate the Recruitment, Screening and contracting of the Floro managers and green door Ambassadors. Conduct assessments on functionality of the green doors and floor management program in-line to the service delivery plan. Screen potential green door ambassadors and Floor managers. On tracting and induction of green door ambassador and Floor managers. Establish and enhance stakeholder relations for effective referral matrix. Render support services to green door ambassadors and floor managers on their day-to-day services/ duties at service sites. Provide administrative support to green door and Floor managers with logging cases on the occurrence book and referral register. Conduct announces and unannounced weekly to monthly site visits to ensure compliance and optimal functionality. Regularly provide debriefing sessions to green door ambassadors and Floor managers. Regularly attend and participate at the VEP regional forum meeting presenting the Victim empowerment services. Showcasing of Green door and Floor managers services. Organize and set up the Training for Floor managers and green door ambassadors Participating during the Annual Upskilling programme for LEA on Gender based violence (consolidation and submission of accurate corridors Policing precinct attendees list) Facilitate quarterly workshops and marketing sessions for Floor managers and green door ambassadors. Provide logistics and administrative support before, during and after the training scheduled. Participate during the service delivery improvement plan. Regularly engage with SAPS personnel and CPF for purposes of tracking and monitoring the work of floor managers as the deployed policing precincts. Monthly submission of evidence and back to office reports. Compilation of cover report and stakeholders’ minutes as part of evidence. Quality Check and assessment of submitted evidence and the reporting templates utilized by the Floor managers and green door ambassadors. Establish and enhance stakeholder relations for effective referral matrix. Produce database of GBVF victims supported and link victims to further professional support services. Uploading of scanned OB copies (Collating, compiling of files and verification) Attending a scheduled monthly and quarterly evidence verification processes.\Ensure that the database of green door ambassadors and Floor managers is up to date.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Avhatakali Nemukula/Mr. Vuyolwethu Sondo Tel No: (011) 689 3845/ 3723/
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on new Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za/documents (effective from 01 January 2021). All fields in Part A to D of the Z83 form must be completed, and Part E to G noting that there is limited space provided applicants often indicate “refer” to CV or see attached, this is acceptable as long as the CV is attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. The question related to the conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered. Declaration must be completed and signed. The fully completed and signed new Z83 form should be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV only (only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications). Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applicants who do not comply with the above requirements, as well as late applications, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Suitable candidates will undergo a personnel suitability check (Vetting, criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification, and employment verification). The Department of Community Safety reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes. Candidate will be placed according to corridor coordination and the Department’s needs. The Department will not accept posted, emailed or hand delivered applications. We encourage youth, people with disability, coloured, Indian and white to apply and a confirmation of disabilities from a registered medical practitioner must be attached to the application. Please Note: Due to the large number of applications, we envisage to receive, applications will not be acknowledged. If you do not receive any response within 3 months, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Senior VEC Koördineerder
af.summary: Senior VEC Koördineerder om Slachtoffer Bemagtigingsprogramme, insluitend Green Door en Floor Management, by die Pretoria Streekskantoor te implementeer.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 sertifikaat. Baccalaureusgraad: verkieslik Sosiale Wetenskappe / Gemeenskapsontwikkeling soos erken deur SAQA. 2 - 3 jaar se werkervaring in die slagoffer bemagtigingsveld. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Geen kriminele rekord of hangende sake teen u nie. Kennis en vaardighede: Basiese kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Basiese kennis van werkprosedures rakende die werksomgewing. Kennis van die Nasionale Strategiese Plan oor Geslagsgebaseerde Geweld en Vrouemoord en die departement se Misdaadvoorkoming Strategie. Kennis van die Nasionale Misdaadvoorkoming Strategie. Statistiese analise. Aanpassing by veranderingbestuur. Verslagdoening. Konflikbestuur. Voorleggingsvaardighede. In staat wees om onder druk te werk. Spanwerker. Buigsaam/ verandering geörienteerd. Probleemoplossingsvermoë. Reageer. Interpersoonlike betrekkinge. Kliëntefokus. Geloofwaardigheid.
af.duties: Koördineer die implementering van die Green Door en Floor Management program in ooreenstemming met die APP en AOP. Koördineer die werf, ondersoek en kontraktering van die Floor managers en Green Door Ambassadors. Voer assesserings uit oor die funksionaliteit van die Green Doors en Floor Management program in ooreenstemming met die dienslewering plan. Skerm potensiële Green Door ambassadeurs en Floor managers. Onderrig en indoksering van Green Door ambassadeurs en Floor managers. Vestig en verbeter belanghebbende betrekkinge vir 'n effektiewe verwysingsmatriks. Verskaf ondersteuningsdienste aan Green Door ambassadeurs en Floor managers rakende hul daaglikse dienste/ pligte by dienswerwe. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning aan Green Door en Floor managers met die invul van gevalle in die voorvalboek en verwysingsregister. Voer aangekondigde en onaangekondigde weeklikse tot maandelikse werfbesoeke uit om nakoming en optimale funksionaliteit te verseker. Verskaf gereeld debriefingsessies aan Green Door ambassadeurs en Floor managers. Woon gereeld die VEP streeksforum vergaderings by en neem deel deur die slagoffer bemagtigingsdienste voor te lê. Verteenwoordiging van Green Door en Floor managers se dienste. Reël en stel die opleiding vir Floor managers en Green Door ambassadeurs op. Neem deel tydens die jaarlikse vaardigheidsprogram vir LEA oor geslagsgebaseerde geweld (konsolidasie en indiening van akkurate korridors Policing precinct bywonerslys). Fasiliteer kwartaallikse werkswinkels en bemarkingsessies vir Floor managers en Green Door ambassadeurs. Verskaf logistieke en administratiewe ondersteuning voor, gedurende en na die geskeduleerde opleiding. Neem deel tydens die dienslewering verbeteringsplan. Skakel gereeld met SAPS-personeel en CPF vir die doeleindes van die naspeur en monitering van die werk van Floor managers by die ontplooide Policing precincts. Maandelikse indiening van bewyse en terug-na-kantoor verslae. Samestelling van dekverslae en belanghebbendes se notules as deel van bewyse. Gehoudsbeheer en assessering van ingediende bewyse en die verslagdoeningssjablone wat deur die Floor managers en Green Door ambassadeurs gebruik word. Vestig en verbeter belanghebbende betrekkinge vir 'n effektiewe verwysingsmatriks. Skep 'n databasis van GBVF slagoffers wat ondersteun is en koppel slagoffers aan verdere professionele ondersteuningsdienste. Oplaai van geskandeerde OB-kopieë (Samestelling, samevoeging van lêers en verifikasie). Bywoon van geskeduleerde maandelikse en kwartaallikse bewysverifikasie prosesse. \Ensure that the database of green door ambassadors and Floor managers is up to date.

zu.title: Umqondisi Wamaphayona We-VEC Ophakeme
zu.summary: Umqondisi Wamaphayona We-VEC Ophakeme ukuze kusetshenziswe izinhlelo zokunika amandla izihlabani kuhlanganise i-Green Door kanye nokuphathwa kwephulethi e-Office Yesifunda i-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 I-Degree ye-Bachelor: okuncamelayo i-Social Sciences / i-Community Development njengokuqashwa i-SAQA. U-hambe emsebenzini unyaka 2 - 3 kulawula ukunika amandla izihlabani. Ilayisensi yokuqasha esemthethweni. Kungekho rekhotsho yobugebengu noma noma yimiphi imicimbi engakaqedwa ngawe. Ulwazi nakhono: Ulwazi oluyisisekelo nokuqonda uhlelo lomthetho oluphatha Inkholelo Yomphakathi. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngemiyalelo yomsebenzi ngokwendawo yokusebenza. Ulwazi lwe-National Strategic Plan on Gender Based Violence and Femicide kanye nesuLokubeka Isidingo Se-crime sikaUmnyango. Ulwazi lwakhona be-National Crime Prevention Strategy. Ukuhlaziya izibalo. Ukuzivikela ekushintshweni ekuphathweni. Ukubhala imibiko. Ukuphatha izinkinga. Amandla okwenza imibhalwano. Ukuba uyakwazi ukusebenza ngesikhungo, ukusebenza njengesiphakanyiswa, ukuguquguquka/lokuzungezela ishintsho, ikono lokuxazulula izinkinga, ukuziphendulela, ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, ukugxila kumthengi, nokuba nesithombe-mpilo esithembekile.
zu.duties: Hlela ukusetshenziswa kwenhlelo i-Green Door kanye nokuphathwa kwephulethi ngokomthetho we-APP kanye ne-AOP. Hlela ukubumba, ukuhlola nokuthumba abaphathi be-floor kanye nabaphathi be-green door. Yenza okuhlola ukusebenza kwe-green door kanye nenhlelo yokuphathwa kwephulethi ngokohlaka lwenkonzo. Hlola abaphathi be-green door abangaba khona kanye nabaphathi be-floor. Ukuthumba kanye nokwazisa abaphathi be-green door kanye nabaphathi be-floor. Saka uthuthukise ubudlelwano nabalwesekeli ukuze kusebenze kahle uhlelo lokukhomba. Nikeza izinsiza zokusekela abaphathi be-green door kanye nabaphathi be-floor emsebenzini wansuku zonke ezindaweni zokusebenza. Nikeza ngokusekelo okuphathwa ukuze abaphathi be-green door kanye nabaphathi be-floor kubhale izicelo ezincwadini yokuqamba kanye kurekhodi yokukhomba. Yenza izivakashi ezenziwe ezindaweni eziyisikhathi esisodwa kuya kwezinyanga ezimbili, ezenjalo ezingazange zenziwe ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi kuhambisana nemithetho kanye nokusebenza kahle. Phatha njalo izinkulumo zokuveza abaphathi be-green door kanye nabaphathi be-floor. Hlanganyela njalo ubethelele emihlanganweni yomthombo we-VE wesifunda bese ukhombisa izinsiza zokunika amandla izihlabani. Khombisa izinsiza zabaphathi be-green door kanye nabaphathi be-floor. Hlela ubeke ihlelo lokufundisa abaphathi be-floor kanye nabaphathi be-green door. Ukuthatha inxaxheba nkathi yohlelo lokwazisa i-LEA ngamayila ngamayila se-Gender based violence (ukuqoqa nokuthumela uhlu oluchithekile lwezihlabani ezisebenza emaphoyiseni). Yenza amawokishopho ohlu非ve nhlanganisayo kanye namaseshini okuthengisa abaphathi be-floor kanye nabaphathi be-green door. Nikeza ngesekelo lohlelo kanye nolunye ngaphambi, nangalesikhathi, nangemva kokuhleliswa ukufundisa. Hlanganyela esikhathini ohlelweni lokuthuthukisa izinsiza ezikhishwayo. Zibandakanya njalo abasebenzi be-SAPS kanye ne-CPF ngenhloso yokulandela bese ubuka umsebenzi wabaphathi be-floor njengoba bakahleliwe emaphoyiseni. Thumela njalo njalo ngenyanga izibonakaliso kanye nemibiko yokubuyela ehhovisi. Hlela imibiko yokuvula kanye nemizuzu yabalwesekeli njengengxenye yezibonakaliso. Hlola uthathe ngokulinganisa izibonakaliso ezithunyiwe kanye nezifanekiselo ezibhalwa ngabaphathi be-floor kanye nabaphathi be-green door. Saka uthuthukise ubudlelwano nabalwesekeli ukuze kusebenze kahle uhlelo lokukhomba. Yenza idathabheyisi yezihlabani be-GBVF ezibusiwe bese uxhumanisa izihlabani nezinye izinsiza zokusekela ngobungcweti. Ukulayisha izikhalishi ze-OB eziyi-scanned (ukuqoqa, ukuhlela amafayela kanye nokuqinisekisa). Ukuhamba emihlanganweni eheleliwe yenyanga kanye nenkathi yesikhashana iphathwa yezinhloli.\Qiniseka ukuthi idathabheyisi yabaphathi be-green door kanye nabaphathi be-floor ihliziwi.

xh.title: Umhlanganisi weSinhloko we-VEC
xh.summary: Umhlanganisi weSinhloko we-VEC ukuphumeza iinkqubo ze-Empowerment yabaBathintekayo kuquka i-Green Door ne-Floor Management kwi-ofisi yerhabe yePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 I-Degree yeBachelors: ngokwenkqubo kakhulu iziZociali / iNtshukuluseko yoLuntu njengoko evunywa yiSAQA. 2 - 3 iminyaka yamava yokusebenza kwiMncamatho ye-Empowerment yabaBathintekayo. Ilayisenesi yokushayela evumelekileyo. Akukho gquba zebenkalawuli okanye nanye na amacala angazange adlule ngawo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi olusisiseko nokuqonda kohlakaxiso lamthetho olawula iNkonzo zoLuntu. Ulwazi olusisiseko lweendlela zomsebenzi ngokwemizi yemisebenzi. Ulwazi lweSicwangciso seStrategic sikaZwelonke ngokuHlukunyezwa ngokobulili nokubulala abantu besifazane neSicwangciso soQobo lweKrimen yesebe namakhono. Uhlalutyo lwezitatisitiki. Ukuzivumela ekuguqulweni kolawulo. Ukubhala iingxelo. Ulawulo lokuxabanisa. Amakhono okubonisa. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngomfutho, ukusebenza nqenqema, ukuguquguquka/oriented ekuguqulweni, amakhono okusombulula iingxaki, ukuphendula, uqhagamshelwano olungaphakathi kwabantu, ukugxila kumthengi, ukuthembeka.
xh.duties: Ukuhlanganisa ukuphumeza inkqubo ye-Green Door ne-Floor Management ngokwemodela ye-APP ne-AOP. Ukuhlanganisa ukuQeqesha, ukuTshintsha kwemali esemthethweni kunye nokwenza iinkontraxi zabaphathi beFloro nabaMbasedwa be-green door. Ukwenza iinxaxhiba zokuqonda ukwenzeka kwamagosa e-green door nenkqubo yolawulo lwesango ngokwelanayo nesicwangciso sokuhanjiswa kwenkonzo. UkuTshintsha imali kwabasebenzi abanokubakho bagqiba i-green door abakhokeli bamatyala. Ukwenza iinkontraxi kunye nenkamiso yabaMbasedwa i-green door kunye nabaphathi beMatyala. Ukuseka kunye nokuphucula uqhagamshelwano lwabalunye kuqoqosho olunika amandla. Ukunika iinkonzo zoxhaso kubaMbasedwa i-green door kunye nabaphathi bamagosa besango kwimisebenzi yabo yemihla ngemihla kumawonke amasebe. Ukubonelela ngokuxhasa oko kubhalwe kumagosa e-green door kunye nabaphathi beMatyala ngokubeka amacala kwesigqibo semihla ngemihla naye kwirejista yokuhambisa. Ukuqhuba izindwendwe ezazisiweyo kunye nezingaziswanga ngeveki ukuya kwenyanga ezindwendweni zasebe ukuqinisekisa ulawulo nokusebenza okulungileyo. Ngokuthe njalo ukubonelela ngeshishini lokucoca ulwazi kubaMbasedwa i-green door kunye nabaphathi beMatyala. Ngokuthe njalo ukubakho nokuqhanga kwindibano yeforum yobuhlulelo lokuqhelanisa i-VEP iinkonzo ezibonelela iNkonzo ye-Empowerment yabaBathintekayo. Ukubonisa iinkonzo i-Green door kunye namakhono oLawulo. Ukuhlela nokuqamba iQeqesho labaphathi beMatyala nabaMbasedwa i-green door. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yeSizulu yokuziphucula ngokwonyaka i-LEA ngokuHlukunyezwa ngokobulili (ukuqokelela kunye nokunikezela koluhlu lwabakhoyo oluqinisekisiweyo oluqhagamshela uqhagamshelo IPolicing ngendawo) Ukuqhuba iindibaniselo zenyanga kunye neeshishini ezintathu ezithengiswayo kubaphathi beMatyala kunye nabaMbasedwa i-green door. Ukubonelela ngokulogistics nokuxhasa okubhalwe ngaphambi, ngexesha nangemva kweqesho elijadiweyo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yonikezelo lwenkonzo ekuphuculweni kwenkqubo. Ngokuthe njalo ukuya kubandakanyeka kwabasebenzi be-SAPS kunye ne-CPF ngenjongo yokulandela nokuqwalasela umsebenzi wobaphathi bamagoba njengabahanjiswa ngamaphondo oLuntu. Inyanga zonke ukunikela ngeparamnentsi nokubuyela kwengxelo e-ofisini. Ukuqokelelwa kokubhaliweyo kwezinto zangaphandle kubhalwe njengengxelo yeNgxelo yoluntu. Ukujola nokuqwalasela okunikezelwayo kwizixhobo ezibhalwe ngaphandle nobuchule bokubeka ngesandla. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba idathabheysi yabaMbasedwa i-green door kunye nabaphathi beMatyala ihlala itsha.

Qinisekisa ukugeleza kokuthutha ngokusebenza kwentuntu kanye nokulawula okwezokuthutha ezindaweni ezingcwengile. Linganisa imisebenzi futhi ivikele imigwaqo yezehlakalo, Qapha futhi weluleke ukuphathwa kumayinda angesehla. Thatha inxaxheba emaphrojekthini ophatho wezokuthutha futhi ukuhlelwa isivivinyo isivinini. Khishwa izaziso futhi yenza ukuboshwa ngaphansi komthetho ohlobene, izinkombandlela nezinqubo futhi uhambise inkantolo izinkathi futhi inike ubufakazi. Qedela izimoto ezingajwayelekile futhi izitwalwa ukuze uqinisekise ukuhamba kuzo okuphepha futhi ulawule ukuphathwa kokungeleza (kuhlanganise izimpahla nabagibeli). Phoqa umthetho wezokuthutha, abahambi bangoMphakathi, okuhamba nezinye izindlela ezihlobene. Ukusetshenziswa kwemisebenzi ehlelwe amukelekwe ukuphoqa umthetho wezokuthutha. Qinisekisa ukugeleza kokuthutha ngokusebenza kwentuntu kanye nokulawula okwezokuthutha ezindaweni ezingcwengile. Linganisa imisebenzi futhi ivikele imigwaqo yezehlakalo, qapha futhi weluleke ukuphathwa kumayinda angesehla. Thatha inxaxheba emaphrojekthini ophatho wezokuthutha futhi ukuhlelwa isivivinyo isivinini. Khishwa izaziso futhi yenza ukuboshwa ngaphansi kumthetho ohlobene, izinkombandlela nezinqobo futhi uhambise inkantolo izinkathi futhi inike ubufakazi. Qedela izimoto ezingajwayelekile futhi izitwalwa ukuze uqinisekise ukuhamba kuzo okuphepha futhi ulawule ukuphathwa kokungeleza (kuhlanganise izimpahla nabagibeli). Hlola layisensi yabaShayeli nezimoto kanye nokulawula ukuzwana kumayinda ahlola layisensi (DLTC) nemigwaqo yezimoto (VTS). Yenza isivivinyo se-Learner ne-Driver License. Yenza isivivinyo sezimoto esifanele indlela. Buka ukuzwana kwe-DLTC ne-VTS. Nikeza ukulawula kwezokuthuthwa okubonakalayo futhi ukhuthaze ukuthintwa kwezenzo zodlame. Siza ekuhlelweni kokulawula okubonakalayo ngokunikeza usizo kubashayeli futhi ukwenza imisebenzi yokuhambisa. Thatha inxaxheba emabhulokhadini neminye imisebenzo ebalulekile yokuphoqa umthetho. Ukuphatha izindlela ezindaweni ezeluliwe futhi luxwaye abashayeli ezindaweni ezingasehla (okuyinkinga zemigwaqon eonakele, ukuqhunywa kwezimoto). Yenza yonke imisebenzi yebhurokrasi nezinye ezihlobene. Gcina izinqubo zebhurokrasi ezisebenzayo. Ukuhambisana nomthetho Wezikhali Nezibhamu 60/2000. Ukuhambisana nemisebenzi echaziwe uhlelo lokusebenza. Thatha inxaxheba Ekuqashweni Kwemithombo Yabantu. Khuthaza izinkonzo ezisebenzayo nezakhileyo ezifanele ukwamukelwa. Gcina isithombe sekhaphokheli sokwakha: Ukuqashwa Komthetho Wezokuthutha. HLOLA IZIMO ZEMIGWAQO. Ukuqashwa kwezindawo ezingasehla nokubhala amarekhodi ngezimo zemigwaqo. Buka izinani zezokuthutha. Thatha inxaxheba Ekuqashweni kwesethem sokuphepha emgwaqweni. Ekuqashweni kwamaphrojekthi abahamba ngamawotsha. Khuleka futhi uFelekelele OHLOLI BEPHOVINISI abakho emsebenzini futhi ababelwe iPI. Siza ukulungiselela futhi ukukhuliswa kwe-PI abasebhedlele. Hlola amandla okusebenza e-PI abasebenza emsebenzini. Khuleka iPIs ababelwe ngeminikelo ebalulekile yokuba khona.

xh.title: UMphathwa weSijikelewe iPhondo
xh.summary: UMphathwa weSijikelewe iPhondo kwiSebe loKhuseleko lokuQhagamshelana nomLuntu eJohannesburg, kufuneka ibe neGreydi 12, iminyaka engama-3-5 yamava, nelayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGreydi 12 okanye imfundo ephezulu. Iminyaka engama-3-5 yamava ababalayo njengoko PI. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni-ikhowudi B. Idiploma eyisiseko yothutho okanye ngesi sizathu esingulinganyelo ekuqwalaselwayo. Akukho gumbi lwezobugebengwakho okanyeCAL yecala elingekayo phezu kwakho. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yobulungisi, iindlela zokwenza umsebenzi nakanjani nakhono lokuthumba idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqokelela izibalo. Ulwazi nakuqonda inkqubo yomthetho elawula iNkonzo ekuLungelelweni. Ulwazi lweenqobo zemisebenzi ngokommandla wokusebenza. Ulwazi lomsebenzi. Unxibelelwano. Iingqalelo zomanyano phakathi kwabantu. Ukuguquguquka. Ukusebenza njengesiqhenga. Uqwlqo lolucwangciso loluhlelo. Ulwimi. Amakhono abalulekileyo okunxibelelana ngokuthetha nangokubhala. Ulwazi nakuqonda ngomthetho wothutho lwezithuthi nokuLawulwa koBuntu kuThutho, iinkqubo zomthetho neemigaqo. Ukuqwalasela izithuthi. Ukuthunjwa kwezithuthi. Ukuqedwa kwamaxwebhe eLawulo eNkosi. Ulwazi lomthetho wezixhobo zokulwa neemvumbo. 60/2000. Ikhodi yokuziphatha. Izinto ezinobungozi. Iinkqubo zesebe. Iindlela eziyiimigaqo evela kwiSekela-Mmeli woLuntu. Iinkqubo zesebe ngolawulo lokuqhuba ngaphezulu kwesigqibo nokusingatha imisebenzi yokuqhuba incwadi yoThutho (TRH) 11. Iinkqubo zokuqhuba imisebenzi ngemishini yalawulo lwamathetho. Ulawulo lwamaxwebhe. Ulawulo lwemithombo. Ulawulo lokunxibelelana nabathengi. Ukufunda nokubhala (amakhono okunxibelelana ngokubhala nangokuthetha nakulwimi kwezona ndawo zithile zephondo. Amakhono okusombulula iingxabano. Amakhono okushayela. Amakhono okuxoxisana. Amakhono okutolika. Amakhono obungqina bomthetho Amakhono okuhlola. (ukwahlulela iimpazamo esesantya okwezithuthi okuzithiile). Ukuba nakhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Amakhono okukhokela nokuyala.
xh.duties: Ukulawula nokuyala abasebenzi abangaphantsi (UkuLawula abaBantu). Ukusebenzisa imisebenzi eqwalaselweyo nokuqvunywe yokuqhuba amathetho othutho. Ukuqinisekisa ukuhamba okukhululekileyo kwethutho ngokwenza umsebenzi oqwalaselwe kwiindawo ezixineneyo nokuLawula oothutho. Ukulungelelanisa imisebenzi kwaye ugcine iindawo zeonke, ukuziva nokululeka ulawulo ngeendawo ezinobungozi. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwimiprojekthi zoQhweshe oButhutho nakumanqam ole wokulinga isantya. Ukupapasha izaziso nokwenza izigqibo ngaphantsi kwamathetho amalungelelweyo, iimvisiswano neenqobo zemisebenzi, nokubakhona kwiinkqubo zikhotho nokunika ubungqina. Ukusingatha izithuthi ezinqamlezileyo nokuthwala ukunceda zihame ngokhuseleko nokulungelelanisa ulawulo lokuqhuba ngaphezulu kwesigqibo (kuqokelela izinto namage). Ukuqinisekisa amathetho othutho nolawulo abahambi, ulawulo lothutho nalunye ulwizo lwamathetho. Ukusebenzisa imisebenzi eqwalaselweyo ekuqunywe yokuqhuba amathetho othutho. Ukuqinisekisa ukuhamba okukhululekileyo kwethutho ngokwenza umsebenzi oqwalaselwe kwiindawo ezixineneyo nokuLawula oothutho. Ukulungelelanisa imisebenzi kwaye ugcine iindawo zeonke, ukuziva nokululeka ulawulo ngeendawo ezinobungozi. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwimiprojekthi zoQhweshe oButhutho nakumanqam ole wokulinga isantya. Ukupapasha izaziso nokwenza izigqibo ngaphantsi kwamathetho, iimvisiswano neenqobo zemisebenzi nokubakhona kwiinkqubo zikhotho nokunika ubungqina. Ukusingatha izithuthi ezinqamlezileyo nokuthwala ukuze zihame ngokhuseleko nokulungelelanisa ulawulo lokuqhuba ngaphezulu kwesigqibo (kuqokelela izinto namage). Ukuqwalasela amalayisenisi oBashayeli neziThuthi zokuQhutha kwaye ulawule ukuzinikela ngemithetho kwiZiko eliQwalasela iLayisenisi yokuShayela (DLTC) nakumaziko oqwalasela izithuthi (VTS). Ukwenza uVavvo lwaBafundi nokuShayela. Ukwenza uVavvo lokuzinikela kwesiThuthi. Ukulawula ukuzinikela ngemithetho kwiDLTC nakwiVTS. Ukubonelela ngokuLawula oothutho okubonakalayo / koQhweshe bathutho nokukhuthaza ukuqinisekiswa kweemisebenzi yokuthintela ubugebenga. Ukuncedisa ekucwangciseni ukuLawula oothutho okubonakalayo ngokunika incedo kubashayeli nokwenza imisebenzi yokuqhuba. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiindawo zokuvala umgama nakwisebenzo ngokukodwa sezoQhweshe oButhutho. Ukuqhuba iqondo kumagqabhukudwana kwindawo abekwe kuyo nokulumkisa abashayeli ngeendawo ezinobungozi (okt. iindawo ezonakeleyo zomgama, ukuqhwanyaza kwezithuthi). Ukwenza yonke imisebenzi yolawulo nento ebusyayo. Ukugcina iinkqubo zolawulo eziphumileyo. Ukuzinikela ngomthetho wamafafa namacephe aVuthuzayo 60/2000. Ukuzinikela ngemisebenzinjengokuqulunqwa kukacwangciso wokusebenza. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiNkqubo zoPhuhliso lwaBantu baseBe. Ukukhuthaza iinkonzo eziluncedo kwaye zifanele kubathengi. Ukugcina isithombe esilungileyo seKhosi: uLawulo lweMathetho oThutho. UKUQWALASELA IIMEKO ZOMGAMA. Ukuqonda iindawo ezinobungozi nokubhala iingxelo ngemeko yomgama. Ukulawula ukuxinwa koluntu. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zokhuseleko lomgama. UPhuhliso lwemiprojekthi zohamba-bhasi. Ukukhokela nokuyala abaQhweshe beSijikelele iPhondo abakwisigqibo nokuba ngoQhweshe abaQotyisiweyo. Ukuququzelela uqeqesho nokuphuhliso kubaQhweshe abakwisigqibo. Ukuqwalasela ukuzinikela kwabaQhweshe abakwisigqibo. Ukukhokela abaQhweshe abaQotyisiweyo ngeemfuno zophuhliso olubanzi.

jobs.title: Senior Provincial Inspector
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 per annum, plus service benefits
jobs.summary: Senior Provincial Inspector at the Department of Community Safety in Johannesburg, requiring a Grade 12 certificate, 3-5 years experience and a valid driving licence.
jobs.requirements: A grade 12 certificate or higher education. 3-5 years practical experience as PI. valid driving license-code B. Basic traffic diploma or equivalent qualification. No criminal record or pending case against you. . Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge of clerical duties, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operate computers and collect statistics. Knowledge and understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service. Knowledge of work procedures in terms of the working environment. Job Knowledge. Communication. Interpersonal relations. Flexibility. Teamwork. Planning and organization. Language. Good verbal and written communication skills. Knowledge and understanding of road traffic and Public Transport legislation, policies and regulations. Vehicle inspections. Vehicle impoundment. Completion of Law Enforcement document. Knowledge of Firearm and Ammunition Act. 60/2000. Code of conduct. Dangerous goods. Departmental policies. Guidelines from Director of Public Prosecutions. Departmental guidelines on overload control and escort duties Transport Handbook (TRH) 11. Operational guidelines on law enforcement equipment. Records management. Resource management. Customer relationship management. Literacy (Written and verbal communication skills in at least two of the provincial languages. Conflict resolution skills. Driving skills. Negotiation skills. Interpretation skills. Legal evidential skills Observation skills. (moving violations/defects). Ability to work under pressure. Mentoring & coaching skills.
jobs.duties: Management and supervision of subordinates (People Management). Implement planned and approved traffic law enforcement activities. Ensure the free flow of traffic through point duty and traffic control at congested areas. Coordinate activities at and safeguard accident scenes, Identify and advise management on hazardous locations. Participate in traffic Policing projects and speed testing operations. Issue notices and execute arrests under relevant acts, directives and procedures and attend court proceedings and give evidence. Escort abnormal vehicles and loads to ensure the safe movement thereof and coordinate overload control management (includes goods and passengers). Enforce road traffic, public passenger, transport and other relevant legislation. Implement planned approved traffic law enforcement activities. Ensure free flow of traffic through point duty and traffic control at congested areas. Coordinate activities at and safeguard accident scenes, identify and advise management on hazardous locations. Participate in traffic policing projects and speed testing operations. Issue notices and execute arrests under relevant Acts, directives and procedures and attend court proceedings and give evidence. Escort abnormal vehicles and loads to ensure the safe movement thereof and coordinate overload control management (includes goods and passengers). Examine Drivers license and Motor vehicle and monitor compliance at Driver License Testing Centres (DLTC) and Vehicle Testing Stations (VTS). Conduct Learner and Driver License Test. Conduct vehicle road worthy test. Monitor Compliance of DLTC and VTS. Provide visible traffic control/policing and promote ensure crime prevention activities. Assist in planning visible traffic policing by providing assistance to motorist and executing escort duties. Participate in roadblocks and/or special law enforcement operations. Patrolling of roads in dedicated area and warn motorists at hazardous locations (i.e damaged road surfaces, breakdown of vehicles). Perform all administrative activities and related duties. Maintain effective administrative procedures. Compliance with the firearm and Ammunition Act 60/2000.Compliance with activities as outlined in the operation plan. Participate in Human Resource Development Programs. Promote effective and efficient service delivery to clients. Maintain Professional corporate image of Directorate: Traffic Law enforcement. Assess Road Conditions. Identification of Hazardous area and drafting of reports on conditions of roads. Monitor traffic volumes. Participate in road safety programmes. Development of pedestrian projects. Mentor and Coach Provincial Inspectors on Probation and appointed PIs. Facilitate training and development of PIs on probations. Assess competencies of PIs on probation. Mentor appointed PIs on further development needs.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. Tshidiso Chabane/ Ms. Dolly Seboane/ Tlalane Koenane Tel No: (011) 689 3845/ 3723/ 3847
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on new Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za/documents (effective from 01 January 2021). All fields in Part A to D of the Z83 form must be completed, and Part E to G noting that there is limited space provided applicants often indicate “refer” to CV or see attached, this is acceptable as long as the CV is attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. The question related to the conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered. Declaration must be completed and signed. The fully completed and signed new Z83 form should be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV only (only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications). Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applicants who do not comply with the above requirements, as well as late applications, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Suitable candidates will undergo a personnel suitability check (Vetting, criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification, and employment verification). The Department of Community Safety reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes. Candidate will be placed according to corridor coordination and the Department’s needs. The Department will not accept posted, emailed or hand delivered applications. We encourage youth, people with disability, coloured, Indian and white to apply and a confirmation of disabilities from a registered medical practitioner must be attached to the application. Please Note: Due to the large number of applications, we envisage to receive, applications will not be acknowledged. If you do not receive any response within 3 months, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. OTHER POSTS

Hlola izimo Zezindlela. Ukuqapha izindawo eziyingozi nokubhala amalebula mayelana nezimo zezindlela. Hlola ukungcwasa kwezimoto. Thatha inhlangothi ohlelweni lokuphepha kwendlela. jobs.title: Communication Officer
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 per annum, plus service benefits
jobs.summary: Communication Officer at the Department of Community Safety in Johannesburg, requiring a degree or diploma in communication and a Grade 12 certificate.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 certificate plus a Degree / Diploma in Corporate Communication / Communication / Public Relations computer literacy. Understanding of communications, communication research, and government communication will be an advantage. All valid relevant driving licenses (A and EC). No criminal record or any pending cases against you. No criminal record or any pending cases against you. Knowledge and Skills: Relevant legislation and public service regulations. Relevant Traffic and Safety legislations and GPG legislation. Understanding of the department's strategic objectives. Knowledge of political and parliamentary processes. Knowledge and understanding of departmental strategic priorities and programmes. Knowledge and understanding of the target market various Gauteng community needs and challenges. Intergovernmental and Stakeholder relations management. Knowledge of advertising and promotions. Knowledge and information management. Project management. Problem solving Written and verbal communication skills. Computer literacy. Monitoring and evaluation skills. Report writing skills. Public speaking. Presentation skills. Public relations. Events management skills.
jobs.duties: Market departmental projects and programmes. Organise exhibitions on various departmental programmes and events. Promote the department's brand on safety and security projects. Conduct onsite visits to communities to identify information needs. Coordinate meetings with departmental stakeholders for marketing purposes. Ensure public access to departmental information at Multi-Purpose Centres around the province. Collate feedback on impact of marketing campaigns of the department. Support departmental events organised both internally and externally. Coordinate and manage exhibitions. Undertake tasks as delegated by programme coordinator. Attend Stakeholder meetings for planning events. Compile the portfolio of evidence. Circulate internal information to staff. Support with branding on all departmental events. Write articles for the departmental newsletter.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. Tshidiso Chabane/ Ms. Dolly Seboane/ Tlalane Koenane Tel No: (011) 689 3845/ 3723/ 3847
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on new Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za/documents (effective from 01 January 2021). All fields in Part A to D of the Z83 form must be completed, and Part E to G noting that there is limited space provided applicants often indicate “refer” to CV or see attached, this is acceptable as long as the CV is attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. The question related to the conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered. Declaration must be completed and signed. The fully completed and signed new Z83 form should be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV only (only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications). Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applicants who do not comply with the above requirements, as well as late applications, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Suitable candidates will undergo a personnel suitability check (Vetting, criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification, and employment verification). The Department of Community Safety reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes. Candidate will be placed according to corridor coordination and the Department’s needs. The Department will not accept posted, emailed or hand delivered applications. We encourage youth, people with disability, coloured, Indian and white to apply and a confirmation of disabilities from a registered medical practitioner must be attached to the application. Please Note: Due to the large number of applications, we envisage to receive, applications will not be acknowledged. If you do not receive any response within 3 months, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. OTHER POSTS

All fields in Part A to D of the Z83 form must be completed, and Part E to G noting that there is limited space provided applicants often indicate “refer” to CV or see attached, this is acceptable as long as the CV is attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. The question related to the conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered. Declaration must be completed and signed. The fully completed and signed new Z83 form should be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV only (only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications). Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applicants who do not comply with the above requirements, as well as late applications, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Suitable candidates will undergo a personnel suitability check (Vetting, criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification, and employment verification). The Department of Community Safety reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes. Candidate will be placed according to corridor coordination and the Department’s needs. The Department will not accept posted, emailed or hand delivered applications. We encourage youth, people with disability, coloured, Indian and white to apply and a confirmation of disabilities from a registered medical practitioner must be attached to the application. Please Note: Due to the large number of applications, we envisage to receive, applications will not be acknowledged. If you do not receive any response within 3 months, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Administrasiebeampte
af.summary: Administrasiebeampte gesoek deur die Department of Community Safety in Gauteng om administratiewe take, rekordbestuur en ondersteuning van verkeersbestuur te behartig.
af.requirements: Graad 12/matriek. Drie jaar se ervaring in Administrasie/Hulpdienste of 'n relevante veld. Geen strafregister of hangende sake teen u nie. 'n Geldige kode 08/10-bestuurslisensie. Kennis en vaardighede: Beplanning, organisasie, kliëntediens, dienslewering, kommunikasie, rekenaarvaardigheid, administratiewe vaardighede, rekordhouding, voorraadbestuur.
af.duties: Bied die bestuurder hulp met verslagdoening vir die kantoor. Ontwerp administratiewe stelsels vir die kantoor. Onderhou 'n effektiewe en doeltreffende rekordbestuur. Koördineer die indiening van dokumentasie en korrespondensie. Hou toesig oor alle administratiewe take met betrekking tot verkeersbestuur. Toesig oor alle administrasiepersoneel. Bied die bestuurder hulp met die skryf van verslae vir die kantoor. Verseker dat die veilige bewaring van alle dokumentasie in ooreenstemming met die relevante wetgewing en beleide is. Lewer administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste; verseker die doeltreffende vloei van inligting en dokumente na en vanaf die kantoor. Reageer op navrae wat intern en vanaf Hoofkantoor ontvang word. Hanteer die verkryging van standaarditems soos skryfbehoeftes, verfrissings ens. vir die aktiwiteite van die bestuurder en die eenheid. Verkry die nodige handtekeninge op dokumente soos verkrygingsadvies en maandelikse salarisverslag. Ondersoek dokumente om vas te stel watter aksies/inligting/ander dokumente vir vergaderings benodig word. Versamel en stel alle nodige dokumente saam om die bestuurder in te lig oor die inhoud daarvan. Neem notule/besluite op en kommunikeer dit aan die relevante rolspelers; hou toesig oor die vordering wat gemaak is. Stel dokumente op soos benodig. Versamel, ontleed en stel inligting wat deur die eenheid versoek word, saam.

zu.title: Inkantolo Yolawulo
zu.summary: I-Department of Community Safety eGauteng ifuna Inkantolo Yolawulo okumele ibheke imisebenzi yolawulo, okuphathwayo kumarekhodi kanye nenkuxaza yokwesekwa kokuqondiswa kogxiwo.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12/matric. Unyaka mathathu wokuhlola kwi-Administration/Auxilia services noma noma yisiphi isikhala okuhambisana nalokhu. Akukho nkinga yobugebengu noma namacala abhaliswe ngokulawula abathintekayo. I-licence yomshayeli yekhodi 08/10 esemthethweni Ulwazi kanye Namakhono: Ukucubungula, Ukubumba, Inkonzo yamakhasimende, Ukulethwa kwenkonzo, Unkululeko, Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, Amakhono Olawulo, Ukugcina amarekhodi, Ukuphathwa kwezinventri.
zu.duties: Siza umphathi ngemibiko engaphakathi kwehhovisi. Yila amasistimu olawulo ehhovisi. Gcina amarekhodi ukusebenza ngokuphumelelayo nangokumndwa. Lungisa ukubhaliswa kwamadokhumenti, nokuhambisana. Bheka yonke imisebenzi yolawulo ngokuhlobene nokuphathwa kogxiwo. Qaphela bonke abasebenzi bolawulo. Siza umphathi ngokubhala imibiko yehhovisi. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwakho konke okubhaliwe ngokuvumelana nemithetho namapholisi ahambisana nalokho. Yiza ngenkonzo yokweseka ngokuphumelelayo kolwazi kanye namadokhumenti ukuyithumela kwaye idlule ehhovisi. Phendula imibuzo evela kulehhovisi nasehhovisi eliyikhaya. Yiba nokuthenga okufanelekile njengamaphepha, okokuzitabisa nokunye okukhulu ngezinsiza zomphathi kanye nesikhungo. Thola ukusayinwa okudingekayo emadokhumenti njengokweluleka ngokuthenga nokubhala imibiko yeholo nyanga zonke. Hlola amadokhumenti ukuthola izenzo/ulwazi/amanye amadokhumenti okudingekayo emihlanganweni. Qoqa ubdlelwane bese uhlanganisa konke okudingekayo komphathi ukumtshenga ngokuqukethwe. Bhala amaminethi/izinqumo bese ukuxhumana nabalulingo, ulandele ukuthi kwenziwe kakhulu. Bhala amadokhumenti njengoko kudingekayo. Qoqa, uhlaziule bese uhlunga ulwazi oluceliwe isikhungo.

xh.title: Iofisa Lolulo Lwezobundo
xh.summary: Iofisa Lolulo Lwezobundo lifunwa yi Department of Community Safety e Gauteng ukulawula imisebenzi yolulo, ulawulo lwamarekhodi kunye nenkxaso yolawulo lwe trafikhi.
xh.requirements: Grade 12/matric. Unyaka omathathu wamava kululo Lwezobundo/Iinkonzo ezingngeniso okanye kwelinye icandelo elingummiselo. Kufuneki ungabi nalutyolisto okanye nangalipho na icala eliqhubekayo elicetyiswa ngokuchasene nawe. Ifayile yokushayela ikhoyo yekhodi 08/10 Ulwazi nemakhono: Uplani, ukuqamba, inkonzo yabathengi, ukulethwa kwenkonzo, Unxibelelwano, Ulwazi lweekhompyutha, Amandla olulo, Ukugcina amarekhodi, Ulawulo lwesikhewu.
xh.duties: Ncedisa umphathi ngengxelo ngaphakathi lefisi. Yila iinkqubo zolulo lolulo lefisi. Gcina ulawulo lwamarekhodi olusebenzayo noluchanekileyo. Xhobisa ukufaka iifayili zamaxwebhu nokunxibelelwano. Qwalasela yonke imisebenzi yolulo ehambelana noLawulo lwe Trafikhi. Lawula wonke abasebenzi bolulo. Ncedisa umphathi ngokubhala iingxelo lefisi. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwayo yonke imaxwebhu ngokwemigaqo nemigaqo-ngayo. Yenza iinkonzo zonxibelelwano lolulo- Qinisekisa ukusebenzisana kolwazi namaxwebhu ukuya kuvela lefisi. Phendula imibuzo efunyanwe ngaphakathi nakwi Head Office. Phatha ukuthenga izinto ezimiselweyo njengezixhobo zokubhala, iziselo njl. njl. kwimisebenzi yomphathi nesebe. Fumana iisinyitha eziyimfuneko kwamaxwebhu njengesalathiso sokuthenga nengxelo yomvuzo yenyangi. Qinisisa amaxwebhu ukumisa izenzo/ulwazi/amanye amaxwebhu afunekayo kwiminyhadala. Qokelela ukuze uqhube konke amaxwebhu afunekayo komphathi ukumxelela ngokuqulethwa. Bala amaminethi/ iigqibo uze unxibelelane nabahluli abahambelanayo, ulandele inkqubela ezenziwayo. Bhala amaxwebhu njengoko kufuneka. Qokelela, ukuhlalutya ukuze udibanise ulwazi oluceliweyo yisebe.

jobs.title: Pna2 Professional Nurse Grade 1 (GENERAL Nursing)
jobs.salary_text: R337 359 per annum, plus service benefits
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse Grade 1 sought in Braamfontein to implement nursing care plans and supervise clinical practice, requiring SANC registration and a relevant nursing qualification.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 and a relevant Basic R425 qualification i.e. Diploma/Degree in Nursing (NQF level 7) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council as a Professional Nurse. Current registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. Where applicable completion of community service. No criminal record or any cases pending against you. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes, and other relevant legal frameworks such as: Nursing Act, Health Care Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Patient Rights Charter, Batho-Pele principles, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Disciplinary Code and Procedure, Grievance Procedure, etc. Skills: Good Communication skills, Report writing skills, Facilitation skills, Co-ordination skills, Liaison skills, Networking skills, Problem solving skills, Information Management Knowledge Management, Planning & Organising, Computer Literacy.
jobs.duties: Provide direction and supervision for the implementation of the nursing plan (clinical practice/quality patient care): Implement a comprehensive nursing care plan/program for the promotion of health, self-care, treatment and rehabilitation of patients. Administer treatment plan of common or minor primary health conditions presented at primary care facilities in accordance with prescribed norms and standards, guidelines and treat conditions of patients as prescribed. Screen health problems and diseases in accordance with prescribed norms and standards. Maintain a therapeutic relationship and environment in which health care can be provided optimally and safely. Report and communicate on the continuity of care to the caregivers and members of the health team. Create and maintain a complete and accurate nursing record for individual health care users. Audit clinical records by analyzing data. Participate in health promotion and illness prevention initiatives and contribute to their evaluation. Demonstrate and understand traditional healing practices within the health care user’s belief. Implement standards, practices, criteria and indicators for quality nursing (quality of practice): Maintain a plan to improve the quality of nursing and health care. Implement quality improvement plan. Participate in the auditing of quality of nursing and health care. Assist in the development of nursing and improvement of standards of care through research. Create an environment and learning opportunities that foster professional growth and improvement in nursing and health care. Actively engage in the education and training of students in the health care system. Perform or carry out interventions ranging from personal care with active involvement of patients and other members of the team. Develop and document interventions and progress of patients to facilitate continuity of care. Participate in the formulation and review of nursing interventions through comprehensive and on-going assessment. Identify health indicators and risk factors and conduct client satisfaction surveys. Practice nursing and health care in accordance with the laws and regulations relevant to nursing and health care: Maintain a professional and ethical practice as well as an enabling environment for ethical practice. Protect and advocate rights of patients regarding health care. Implement patient care standards, policies and procedures. Compliance and adherence to the relevant acts/prescripts applicable within the nursing environment. Contribute to the education and professional development of students. Apply the principles of nursing care in service rendering, for the maintenance of professional excellence. Implement nursing care management activities according to the Standards of Practice and Scope of Practice and act upon breaching of laws relating to nursing practice and professional code of conduct and practice standards. Implement quality improvement plan, the Nursing Act and Regulations, the Code of Ethics and Professional Practice of the South African Nursing Council. Implement procedures that maintain effective infection control and occupational and safety measures in accordance with Occupational Health & Safety legislation. Maintain a constructive working relationship with nursing and other stakeholders: Collaborate with members of the health and social care teams and assist in decision-making pertaining to health care delivery. Communicate with the multi-disciplinary health teams, organizations and special interest groups when dealing with community health issues and needs. Disseminate information on epidemics, nutritional disease, maternal and infant morbidity and mortality and other common diseases. Participate in health promotion and illness prevention initiatives. Implement nursing interventions to achieve expected outcomes.
