af.title: Pna2 Professionele Verpleegkundige Graad 1 (ALGEMENE Verpleging)
af.summary: Professionele Verpleegkundige Graad 1 gesoek in Braamfontein om verpleegsorgplanne te implementeer en kliniese praktyk te superviseer, wat SANC-registrasie en 'n tersaaklike verpleegkwalifikasie vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 en 'n tersaaklike Basiese R425-kwalifikasie, d.w.s. Diploma/Graad in Verpleging (NQF-vlak 7) of 'n ekwivalente kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. Huidige registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. Waar van toepassing, voltooiing van gemeenskapsdiens. Geen misdaderecord of hangende sake teen u nie. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures, verpleegstatutes en ander tersaaklike regsraamwerke soos: Nursing Act, Health Care Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Patient Rights Charter, Batho-Pele-beginsels, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Dissiplinêre Kode en Prosedure, Grievance Procedure, ens. Vaardighede: Goeie kommunikasievaardighede, verslagskryfvaardighede, fasiliteringsvaardighede, koördineringsvaardighede, skakelvaardighede, netwerkvaardighede, probleemoplossingsvaardighede, Inligtingbestuur, Kennisbestuur, Beplanning en Organisering, Rekenvaardigheid.
af.duties: Verskaf rigting en toesig vir die implementering van die verpleegplan (kliniese praktyk/kwaliteitspasientsorg): Implementeer 'n omvattende verpleegsorgplan/program vir die bevordering van gesondheid, selfsorg, behandeling en rehabilitasie van pasiënte. Dien behandelingsplan van algemene of mindere primêre gesondheidstoestande wat by primêre sorgfasiliteite voorkom toe in ooreenstemming met voorgeskrewe norme en standaarde, riglyne en behandel toestande van pasiënte soos voorgeskryf. Ondersoek gesondheidsprobleme en siektes in ooreenstemming met voorgeskrewe norme en standaarde. Handhaaf 'n terapeutiese verhouding en omgewing waarin gesondheidsorg optimaal en veilig verskaf kan word. Rapporteer en kommunikeer oor die kontinuïteit van sorg aan die versorgers en lede van die gesondheidspan. Skep en handhaaf 'n volledige en akkurate verpleegrekord vir individuele gesondheidsorggebruikers. Oudit kliniese rekords deur data te analiseer. Neem deel aan gesondheidsbevordering en siektevoorkoming-inisiatiewe en dra by tot hul evaluering. Demonstreer en verstaan tradisionele genesingspraktyke binne die gesondheidsorggebruiker se oortuiging. Implementeer standaarde, praktyke, kriteria en aanwysers vir kwaliteitverpleging (kwaliteit van praktyk): Handhaaf 'n plan om die kwaliteit van verpleging en gesondheidsorg te verbeter. Implementeer kwaliteitsverbeteringsplan. Neem deel aan die ouditering van die kwaliteit van verpleging en gesondheidsorg. Bied aan by die ontwikkeling van verpleging en verbetering van sorgstandaarde deur navorsing. Skep 'n omgewing en leergeleenthede wat professionele groei en verbetering in verpleging en gesondheidsorg bevorder. Neem aktief deel aan die opvoeding en opleiding van studente in die gesondheidsorgstelsel. Voer uit of onderneem intervensies wat wissel van persoonlike sorg met aktiewe betrokkenheid van pasiënte en ander lede van die span. Ontwikkel en dokumenteer intervensies en vordering van pasiënte om kontinuïteit van sorg te fasiliteer. Neem deel aan die formulering en hersiening van verpleegintervensies deur omvattende en deurlopende assessering. Identifiseer gesondheidsaanwysers en risikofaktore en voer kliëntetevredenheidsopnames uit. Beoefen verpleging en gesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met die wette en regulasies wat op verpleging en gesondheidsorg van toepassing is: Handhaaf 'n professionele en etiese praktyk asook 'n bemagtigende omgewing vir etiese praktyk. Beskerm en bevorder regte van pasiënte ten opsigte van gesondheidsorg. Implementeer pasiëntsorgstandaarde, beleide en prosedures. Voldoening en nakoming aan die tersaaklike wette/voorskifte van toepassing binne die verpleegomgewing. Dra by tot die opvoeding en professionele ontwikkeling van studente. Pas die beginsels van verpleegsorg toe in dienslewering, vir die handhawing van professionele uitmuntendheid. Implementeer verpleegsorgbestuursaktiwiteite volgens die Standards of Practice en Scope of Practice en tree op bij oortreding van wette wat verband hou met verpleegpraktyk en professionele gedragskode en praktykstandaarde. Implementeer kwaliteitsverbeteringsplan, die Nursing Act and Regulations, die Code of Ethics and Professional Practice van die South African Nursing Council. Implementeer prosedures wat doeltreffende infeksiebeheer en beroeps- en veiligheidsmaatreëls handhaaf in ooreenstemming met Occupational Health & Safety-wetgewing. Handhaaf 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met verpleging en ander belanghebbendes: Werk saam met lede van die gesondheids- en sosiale sorgspanne en help by besluitneming aangaande gesondheidsorglewering. Kommunikeer met die multidissiplinêre gesondheidspanne, organisasies en spesiale belangegroepe wanneer daar met gemeenskaps gesondheidskwessies en -behoeftes gehandel word. Versprei inligting oor epidemies, voedingsiektes, moeder- en babasiekte en -sterftes en ander algemene siektes. Neem deel aan gesondheidsbevordering en siektevoorkoming-inisiatiewe. Implementeer verpleegintervensies om verwagte uitkomste te bereik.

zu.title: Isikhundla se-Pna2 Professional Nurse Grade 1 (GENERAL Nursing)
zu.summary: Kufunwa i-Professional Nurse Grade 1 e-Braamfontein ukuze kusetshenziswe amapulani okunakekelwa kwezempilo kubuye kulawulwe umsebenzi wezokwelapha, kudingwa ukubhalisa ku-SANC kanye nenemfundo ehambisana nalesi sikhundla.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye nethuluzi elihambisanayo le-Basic R425 okungukuthi i-Diploma/Degree kwi-Nursing (NQF level 7) noma ithuluzi elilingana leli elicelwa kubhalise ku-South African Nursing Council njengoba i-Professional Nurse. Ukubhalisa okwamanje ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njenge-Professional Nurse. Lapho kufanele khona, kuqedwe umsebenzi wasekhaya. Kungabi narekhodi lobugebengu noma noma yikuphi ukulandelwa komacala. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi ngamapululazi amisebenzi nokunakekelwa kwezempilo, izimiso zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, kanye nezinye izakhiwo zomthetho ezihambisanana njengalezi: i-Nursing Act, i-Health Care Act, i-Occupational Health and Safety Act, i-Patient Rights Charter, izimiso ze-Batho-Pele, i-Public Service Regulations, i-Labour Relations Act, i-Disciplinary Code and Procedure, i-Grievance Procedure, njll. Amakhono: Amakhono obuhlakani bokuxhumana, amakhono okubhala izibhelu, amakhono okukhuthaza, amakhono okuhlola, amakhono okuhlanganisa, amakhono okudala ugxizelelwano, amakhono okusombulula izinkinga, ukuphatha ulwazi, ukuphatha ulwazi, ukuhlela nohlelo, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
zu.duties: Nika isiqondiso nolawulo ekusetshenzisweni kwepulani yokunakekelwa kwezempilo (umsebenzi wezokwelapha/ukunakekelwa kwesiguli okukwalilanga): Setha ipulani ephelele yokunakekelwa kwezempilo/uhlelo ukuthuthukisa impilo, ukuzinakekela, ukwelashwa nokubuyisela emphakathini abesiguli. Phatha ipulani yokwelashwa izimo ezivamile noma ezincane zezempilo eziphakathi kwabesiguli ezibonakaliswa emakhaya okunakekelwa ngokuhambisana nezimiso nezindinganiso ezibekiwe, izeluleko kanye nokwelapha izimo zabesiguli njengoba kulindelekile. Hlola izinkinga nezifo ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso ezibekiwe.ugcine ubudlelwano nendawo ezokwelapha lapho kunakekelwa kwezempilo kungenzwa kahle nokuqhathaniswa. Report and communicate on the continuity of care to the caregivers and members of the health team. Dala futhi ugcine isibhalo esigcwele nesiqinisekisiwe sokunakekelwa kwezempilo kubesiguli ngamunye. Hlola izibhalo zokwelapha ngokuqhathanisa amaningisi. Thatha inhlalo ekuthuthukiseni impilo nokuvikela ukugula futhi ungene kokuqinisekiswa kwalezi zinhlelo. Bonisa futhi uqonde izindlela zokwelapha zendabuko ngaphakathi kokukholwa kwesiguli. Setha izindinganiso, izindlela, iziqondiso nezinkomba zokunakekelwa ngenathi (isimo somsebenzi): Gcina ipulani yokuthuthukisa isimo sokunakekelwa ngezempilo. Setha ipulani yokuthuthukwa isimo. Thatha inhlalo ekubukeni isimo sokunakekelwa ngezempilo. Siza ekuthuthukiseni ukunakekelwa kwezempilo kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezindinganiso zokunakekelwa ngocwaningo. Dala isimo namathuba okufunda aholela ekutholeni ukukhula ngokobuchwepheshe nokuthuthuka kokunakekelwa ngezempilo. Zibandakanya ngokusebenza kwesikhala ekufundiseni nasekugqotheni abafundi ohlelweni lwezempilo. Yenza noma uhlele ukungenelela okusukela kokunakekelwa komuntu ngabunye ngokubandakanya okusebenzayo abesiguli kanye namalungu ohlelo. Hlola futhi uthuthuke ukungenelela kwabesiguli ukuze kulungisekele ukuqhathaniswa kokunakekelwa. Thatha inhlalo ekuhleleni nokubukweni kokungenelela kokunakekelwa ngokuhlola okuphelele futhi okuqhubekayo. Hlola izinkomba zezempilo kanye namagugu wobungozi futhi uhlale izabelo zamakhasimeli. Yenza ukunakekelwa kwezempilo ngokuhambisana nemithetho kanye nokuqhathaniswa okuhlobene nokunakekelwa ngezempilo: Gcina umsebenzi wezenhlalo nezomthetho kanye nendawo ekuvumela umsebenzi wezenhlalo nezomthetho. Vela futhi usize amagugu abesiguli mayelana nokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Setha izindinganiso zabesiguli, izinqubo kanye nezinqubo zokulandelwa. Hlanganyela kwaye yamukele imithetho ebalulekileyo kwizinto ezichaza imisebenzo eyahlukeneyo kummandla wokunakekelwa. Thatha inxaxheba ekuqeqeshweni nasekuthuthukiseni ngobuchwepheshe besiguli. Setsha izimiso zokunakekelwa ngezempilo ekunikela ngezenzo, ukugcina isimo esiphezulu sezenzowesikhathi. Setha izinkalo zokuphatha ukunakekelwa ngokuhambisana nazo zonke izinto ezisemthethweni ze-Act ze-South African Nursing Council. Setha iindlela ezigcina ulawulo olusebenzayo lokunakekelwa kokutshatyalaliswa nokuqhathaniswa kwemizimba kwaye nawuphi na umzekelo othileyo njengoko kukhankanyiwe kwizinto ezingaqondwa ngokwenza iimveliso ngokulandela imigaqo yemithetho yezempilo. Gcina isimo sokusebenza okwakho kwaye noqhagamshelwano nakunye nabantu abanjengoko kumalunga ophando nakunye nakwabanye abantu abanenomdla: Sebenzisana namalunga ohlelo lokunakekelwa ngezempilo nasezenkundleni kwaye nceda ekwenzeni izigqibo ezimalunga nokunikwa kwezempilo. Thetha ngehlelo elinabantu abanobuchwepheshe abahlukene, iintshibenkelo kunye namaqela akhethekileyo xa kusetyenziswa iingxaki zempilo yoluntu kwaye neemfuno. Sasaza iinkcukacha ngobhubhane, izifo ezinganisa ukutya, ukugula nokufa kwabazali neantu asekwindla, kunye nezinye izifo ezixhaphakileyo. Thatha inxaxheba ekuthuthuziseni impilo kunye nasekuthinteleni iingcali zokugula. Setha izigqibo zokunakekelwa ngezempilo ukuze kufikelelwe kumaphupha abelekiselwe.

xh.title: Pna2 Umongikazi weGazi lesi-1 (iGENERAL Nursing)
xh.summary: Kufunyanwa umongikazi wesigaba 1 eBraamfontein ukuqalisa iinkqubo zonakekelo lomongikazi nokulawula inkqubo yezokwelapha, kufuneko bubhaliso kwiSANC nelifayilesi elifanelekileyo lonakekelo lomongikazi.
xh.requirements: IGrade 12 nelifayilesi elifanelekileyo leBasic R425 ndithi iDiploma/Idigri kwiNursing (iNQF level 7) okanye esinye isiqinisekiso esikuvumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council njengomongikazi oMgunyazwe. Ubhaliso lwangoku kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongikazi oMgunyazwe. Apho kufuneka khona, kufuneka ugqibe inkonzo yomphakathi. Akukho ntlazyo yecaleni okanye izigqibo ezingekayo ngokumelene nawe. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngenkqubo nendlela zonakekelo lomongikazi, kwinkqubo yomthetho womongikazi, namanye amathetho ammiselweyo njengokuwo: iNursing Act, iHealth Care Act, iOccupational Health and Safety Act, iPatient Rights Charter, iimpeliso zeBatho-Pele, iPublic Service Regulations, iLabour Relations Act, iDisciplinary Code and Procedure, iGrievance Procedure, nani. Aakhono: Amakhono mahle Onxibelelwano, amakhono obhalo lwemibiko, amakhono okukhuthaza, amakhono okulawula, amakhono onxibelelwano, amakhono okudibanisa, amakhono okusombulula iingxaki, ulwazi lolawulo lolwazi, ulawulo lolwazi, ukuqamba iplani nokuhlela, ulwazi lweekhompyutha.
xh.duties: Nika inkombandlela nolawulo ekubeni yinto ekuqaliseni iplani yonakekelo lomongikazi (inkqubo yezokwelapha/onakekelo olugqibeleleyo lomguli): Qalisa iplani yonakekelo lomongikazi ogqibeleleyo/nkqubo yokukhuthaza impilo, onakekelo lwakho, unyango nokuqaliswa kwakhona komguli. Lawula iplani yonyango yezifo eziziimota okanye ezincinci ezenziwa kwindawo zokunakekelwa kwempilo ngokwemigqaliselo enikezelweyo, imigaqo nokunakekelwa kwezifo zabaguli njengoko kumiselwe. Hlola iingxaki zempilo nezifo ngokwemigqaliselo enikezelweyo. Gcina uqhagamshelwano olubuyisa impilo nendawo apho onakekelo lwezempilo lunika ngokugqibeleleyo ngokukhuselekileyo. Chaza unxibelelwano ngokuqhubeka kolunyango kunye nabonakekeli namalungu eqela lezempilo. Yenza ulondolazo olugqibeleleyo noluchanekileyo lomongikazi ngamayeza onakekelo empilo ngamnye. Hlola iirekhodi zokwelapha ngokuhlola ulwazi. Thatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo zokukhuthaza impilo nokuthintela ukugula ungwadi wokuqala unikezele ngokuhlola. Bonisa ukuqonda iinkqubo zonakela zemithi yendalo ngokukholwa komnakekelwa wezempilo. Qalisa amanqanaba, iinkqubo, iindlela nemiqangambiso yonakekelo olugqibeleleyo lomongikazi (isimo senkqubo): Gcina iplani yokuphucula isimo sonakekelo lomongikazi nezempilo. Qalisa iplani yokuphucula isimo. Thatha inxaxheba ekuholweni kwesimo sonakekelo lomongikazi nezempilo. Siza ekwakhiweni kwezomongikazi nokuphuculeni kumanqanaba onakekelo ngophando. Yaza indawo namathuba okufunda aphephisa ukukula ngokobugcisa nokuphucula onakekelo lomongikazi nezempilo. Thabatha inxaxheba ngokusebenzayo kwemfundo nokuqeqeshwa kwabafundi kwindawo yonakekelo lwezempilo. Yenza okanye uze neenkqubo ezisuka kunakekelo ngokubandakanya ngokusebenzayo umguli namanye amalungu eqela. Yaza uchaze iinkqubo nokuqhubela phambili komguli ukuze kuncedwe ukuqhubeka kolunyango. Thatha inxaxheba ekudalweni nakuqwalaseleni iinkqubo zomongikazi ngokuvakalayo nangokuqhubekayo. Khomba izalathiso zempilo namaxhoba ayingozi uze wenze izifundo zamava abathengi. Zonakela njengomongikazi nezempilo ngokwemithetho nemigangatho enjengomanqanaba: Gcina inkqubo yomsebenzi oMgqibeleleyo nezokuziphatha kwaye wenze indawo ekuvumela ukuba kwenzeke umsebenzi oMgqibeleleyo. Vikela ubeko bathethelele ubalo-mguli mayela nonakekelo lwezempilo. Qalisa amanqanaba, iinkqubo nemigaqo yokunakekela umguli. Kumelana nokuze kuhambiswe namthetho/awomthetho asebenzayo kwinkqubo yomongikazi. Nika ngemfundo nophuhliso ngokubugcisa koluntu. Faka iinkqubo zonakekelo lomongikazi ekunikezeleni inkonzo, ukugcina ugqibo lokuba msebenzi wakhe ulungile. Qalisa iinkqubo zolawulo lonakekelo lomongikazi ngokwamanqanaba apho kwenziwa khona inkonzo ulenze ngokuchithwa kwamthetho angathintelwa ngawo umsebenzi wakho noba ngumthetho wokuziphatha kwaye ulawule amanqanaba okusebenza. Qalisa iplani yokuphucula isimo, iNursing Act neMigaqo, iCode of Ethics yonakekelo lwezomongikazi kwiSouth African Nursing Council. Qalisa iinkqubo ezigcina ulawulo olusemthethweni lwezifo nokugcinwa kokhuseleko koluntu ngokomthetho wekhompyutha. Gcina uqhagamshelwano olwakhiweyo nomongikazi namanye amaqela: Dibana namalungu eqela lezempilo nolonakekelo olwentlalo uncedise ekwenzeni izigqibo ezimali nonakekelo lwezempilo. Thethathisa neeqela lezempilo ezahlukeneyo, iintlanganiso namakholwa amakhulu xa kusengamkhupela iingxaki ncidame zempilo. Yasaza inkcazelo ngezigilibheli, iingxaki zokutya, iingxaki zabantu abakhulelweyo ne abantwana abancinane nobuny obukhangele kakhulu. Thabatha inxaxheba ekukhuthazeni impilo nokuthintelwa ukugula. Qalisa inkqubo zomongikazi ukufikelela kumgiba olindelekileyo.

jobs.title: Provincial Inspector Refs/057014
jobs.salary_text: R280 278 per annum, plus service benefits
jobs.summary: Provincial Inspector needed to enforce road traffic and public transport legislation within the Gauteng Freeway Unit, requiring a Traffic Officer's Diploma and one year of enforcement experience.
jobs.requirements: Matric Certificate plus Traffic Officer's Diploma and a valid driver’s license, at least a code B. 1 year of practical experience in traffic law enforcement. No criminal record or case pending against you. Knowledge and Skills: Good record and resource management. Good customer relationship management abilities. Knowledge and understanding of road traffic and public transport policies and regulations. Completion of law enforcement documents. Knowledge of vehicle inspections and vehicle impoundment. Knowledge of the Firearms and Ammunition Act 60/100. Knowledge of departmental guidelines on overload control and escort duties (Transport Handbook) 11. Ability to work under pressure. Good observation skills. Good driving and negations skills. Sound interpersonal and conflict resolution skills. Good written and verbal communication skills in at least two of the provincial official languages.
jobs.duties: Enforce Road Traffic, Public Passenger and Transport Legislation: Implement planned and approved traffic law enforcement activities. Ensure the free flow of traffic through point duty and traffic control at congested areas. Coordinate activities at and safeguard accident scenes, identify and advise management on hazardous locations. Participate in traffic policing projects and speed testing operations. Issue notices and execute arrests under relevant Acts, directives and procedures and attend court proceedings and give evidence. Escort abnormal vehicles and loads to ensure safe movement thereof and coordinate overload control management (including goods and passengers). Examine Drivers' Licenses and Motor Vehicles and monitor compliance at Driver License Testing Centers (DLTC) and Vehicle Testing Stations (VTS): Conduct learner and driver license tests. (ii) Conduct roadworthy tests. Monitor compliance with DLTC and VTS. Provide visible Traffic Control/Policing and promote/ensure crime prevention activities: Assist in planning visible traffic policing by assisting motorists and executing escort duties. Participate in roadblocks and/or special law enforcement operations. Patrol roads in dedicated areas and warn motorists at hazardous locations (i.e., damaged road surfaces, breakdown of vehicles). Perform all administrative activities and related duties: maintain effective administrative procedures. Compliance with the Firearm and Ammunition Act 60/2000. Compliance with activities as outlined in the operational plans. Participate in Human Resource Development Programs. Promote effective and efficient delivery service to clients. Maintain a professional corporate image of the Directorate: Traffic Law Enforcement.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. Tshidiso Chabane/ Ms. Dolly Seboane/ Tlalane Koenane Tel No: (011) 689 3845/ 3723/ 3847
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on new Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za/documents (effective from 01 January 2021). All fields in Part A to D of the Z83 form must be completed, and Part E to G noting that there is limited space provided applicants often indicate “refer” to CV or see attached, this is acceptable as long as the CV is attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. The question related to the conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered. Declaration must be completed and signed. The fully completed and signed new Z83 form should be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV only (only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications). Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applicants who do not comply with the above requirements, as well as late applications, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Suitable candidates will undergo a personnel suitability check (Vetting, criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification, and employment verification). The Department of Community Safety reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes. Candidate will be placed according to corridor coordination and the Department’s needs. The Department will not accept posted, emailed or hand delivered applications. We encourage youth, people with disability, coloured, Indian and white to apply and a confirmation of disabilities from a registered medical practitioner must be attached to the application. Please Note: Due to the large number of applications, we envisage to receive, applications will not be acknowledged. If you do not receive any response within 3 months, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Provinsiale Inspekteur Refs/057014
af.summary: Provinsiale Inspekteur benodig om padverkeer- en openbare vervoerwetgewing binne die Gauteng Freeway Unit af te dwing, waarvoor 'n Verkeersbeampte-diploma en een jaar se handhawingsondervinding vereis word.
af.requirements: Matrieksertifikaat plus Verkeersbeampte-diploma en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie, ten minste 'n kode B. 1 jaar praktiese ondervinding in verkeerswetstoepassing. Geen strafrekord of hangende saak teen u. Kennis en Vaardighede: Goede rekord- en hulpbronbestuur. Goee vermoëns vir kliëntverhoudingsbestuur. Kennis en begrip van padverkeer- en openbare vervoerbeleide en -regulasies. Voltooiing van wetstoepassingsdokumente. Kennis van voertuiginspeksies en voertuigbeslaglegging. Kennis van die Firearms and Ammunition Act 60/100. Kennis van departementele riglyne oor oorlaaide beheer en begeleidingspligte (Transport Handbook) 11. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Goede waarnemingsvaardighede. Goede bestuurs- en onderhandelingsvaardighede. Degtelike interpersoonlike en konflikoplossingsvaardighede. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede in ten minste twee van die provinsiale amptelike tale.
af.duties: Handhaaf Padverkeer-, Openbare Passasiers- en Vervoerwetgewing: Implementeer beplande en goedgekeurde verkeerswetstoepassingsaktiwiteite. Verseker die vrye vloei van verkeer deur puntbeheer en verkeersbeheer by besope areas. Koördineer aktiwiteite by en beveilig ongeluktonele, identifiseer en adviseer bestuur oor gevaarlike plekke. Neem deel aan verkeerspolisiëringsprojekte en spoedtoetsoperasies. Uit kennisgewings en voer arrestasies uit onder relevante Wette, richtlyne en prosedures en woon geregtelike verrigtinge by en lewer getuienis. Begeleid abnormale voertuie en vragte om veilige beweging daarvan te verseker en koördineer oorlaaide beheerbestuur (insluitend goedere en passasiers). Ondersoek Bestuurderslisensies en Motorvoertuie en monitor nakoming by Bestuurderslisensietoetssentrums (BLTS) en Voertuigtoetssentrums (VTS): Voer leerling- en bestuurderslisensietoetse uit. (ii) Voer padwaardigheidstoetse uit. Monitor nakoming met BLTS en VTS. Verskaf sigbare Verkeersbeheer/Polisiëring en bevorder/verseker misdaadvoorkomingaktiwiteite: Bystand met die beplanning van sigbare verkeerspolisiëring deur motoriste te help en begeleidingspligte uit te voer. Neem deel aan padblokkades en/of spesiale wetstoepassingsoperasies. Patrollie paaie in toegewyde gebiede en waarsku motoriste by gevaarlike plekke (d.w.s. beskadigde padoppervlakke, voertuigstoring). Voer alle administratiewe aktiwiteite en verwante pligte uit: onderhou doeltreffende administratiewe prosedures. Nakoming van die Firearm and Ammunition Act 60/2000. Nakoming van aktiwiteite soos uiteengesit in die operasionele planne. Neem deel aan Menslike Hulpbronontwikkelingsprogramme. Bevorder doeltreffende en doeltredende afleweringsdiens aan kliënte. Handhaaf 'n professionele korporatiewe beeld van die Direktoraat: Verkeerswetstoepassing.

zu.title: Umhloli Wesifunda Refs/057014
zu.summary: Kudingeka umhloli wesifunda ukuphoqa umthetho wezokuthutha kwindlela kanye nomthetho wokuthutha kwomphakathi ngaphakathi kwe-Gauteng Freeway Unit, okudinga i-Traffic Officer's Diploma nomyaka omunye wokuqashwa kokuphoqa umthetho.
zu.requirements: Isitifikidi se-Matric kanye ne-Traffic Officer's Diploma kanye nelayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni, okungenani ikhodi B. Unyaka omunye weminye yokuqashwa emthethweni wokuphoqa umthetho. Kungabi nerekodi yobugebengu noma icala elithunjiwe ngawe. Ulwazi namakhono: Ukuphathwa kwerekodi nezinsiza okuhle. Amakhono okuphatha ubuhlobo namakhasimonde ahle. Ulwazi nokuqonda izinhlelo zomthetho nezimiso zokuthutha kwindlela kanye nokuthutha kwomphakathi. Ukugcwalisa amafomu wokuqashwa komthetho. Ulwazi ngokuqamba izimoto nokuthweswa izimoto ngaphandle komthetho. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Firearms and Ammunition Act 60/100. Ulwazi ngemihlahlandlela yomnyango ekulawulen ukugeleza kakhulu nasezimeni zokuhlola (Transport Handbook) 11. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo. Amakhono okuqapha ahle. Amakhono okushayela nokuxoxisana ahle. Amakhono obuhlobo nabantu nokuxazulula izinkinga ahle. Amakhono okuxhumana okubhalwayo nokukhulunywayo angalenani ezilimi ezisemthethweni zesifunda.
zu.duties: Phoqa umthetho wezokuthutha kwindlela, Abashwayeli Bayohudaka kanye nomthetho wokuthutha: Qalisa imisebenzi ehleliwe neyamukelekile yokuqashwa komthetho wezokuthutha. Qinisekisa ukugeleza kwemithetho ngokusebenza emaphoyintini nolawulo lokuthutha ezindaweni ezele kakhulu. Hlela imisebenza ezindaweni zeziphambo futhi uvikele kulezo ndawo, qaphela futhi umyaleze ukuphathwa ngendawo eyingozi. Thatha inxaxheba kumaphojekthi ezokuphatha umthetho wezokuthutha kanye nokuhlola ijubane. Khishza izaziso futhi ubambe abantu ngaphansi kumthetho ohlukene, imiyalo nezinqumo futhi uhlangane namacala futhi unikeze ubufakazi. Hlola izimoto ezingajwayelekile kanye nezithwalo ukuze uqinisekise ukunyakaza kwazo okuphephile futhi uhlele ukuphathwa kolawulo lokugcwele kakhulu (okuhlanganisa izimpahla nabashayeli). Hlola amalayisensi abashayeli nezimoto futhi ulawule ukuzihlakanipha ema-Driver License Testing Centers (DLTC) naseziteshini zokuqamba izimoto (VTS): Qalisa ukuhlolwa kwamalayisensi abafundi nabashayeli. (ii) Qalisa ukuhlolwa kokuhambelana nomthetho. Lawula ukuzihlakanipha kwi-DLTC kanye ne-VTS. Nikeza ukulawula ukuthutha / ukuphatha umthetho okubonakalayo futhi ukhuthaze / qinisekise imisebenzi yokuvikela ubugebengu: Siza ekuhleleleni ukuphatha umthetho wezokuthutha okubonakalayo ngokusiza abashayeli bhemoto futhi wenze imisebenzi yokuhlola. Thatha inxaxheba eziblokini zendlela kanye noma imisebenzi ekhethekile yokuqashwa komthetho. Peta izindlela ezindaweni ezibalulekile futhi luxwaye abashayeli bezimoto ezindaweni ezingozi (okungukuthi, izindlela ezingcolile nokwahluleka kwemoto). Yenza yonke imisebenzi yokuphatha kanye nemisebenzi ehlobene: gcina izinqumo zokuphatha eziphumelelayo. Ukuzihlukanisa ngokomthetho we-Firearm and Ammunition Act 60/2000. Ukuzihlukanisa nemisebenzi enjengoba kuchazwe kuhlelo lokusebenza. Thatha inxaxheba kuhlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwabantu. Khuthaza ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi kubakhasimonde ngempumelelo nangokusebenza kahle. Gcina isithombe somnotho wesikhungo: Traffic Law Enforcement.

xh.title: Isalathiso Komphathi Wephondo Refs/057014
xh.summary: Kufuneka kuba nguMphathi Wephondo ukugcinwa kwemithetho yothutho negqitho kolwandle kunye nomthetho wothutho lwabagqithi kwiGauteng Freeway Unit, kufuneka abe neDiploma kaMphathi Wezothutho kunye nenyaka omnye wamava agqithiweyo ekugqithweni komthetho.
xh.requirements: Isatifikedi seMatric kanegama leDiploma kaMphathi Wezothutho kunye nelayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni, ubuncinane ikhodi B. Unyaka omnye wamava agqithiweyo ekugqithweni komthetho wothutho. Akukho gubo lolwaphula-mthetho okanye isigaba esithi sikujongile. Ulwazi namakhono: Ukulawula nokuqulunqa iirekhodi nezibonelelo. Amakhono amabalwe alokuqonda abathengi. Ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo nomthetho wothutho negqitho kolwangelo wabathengi. Ukuqedelaamaxwebhu okugqithwa komthetho. Ulwazi ngokuphonononga izithuthi nokuzithathela ngokusesikweni. Ulwazi ngoMthetho wezixhobo zokuzikhusela kunye nabambi wemigudu 60/100. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zomthetho zodonga lwendalo ngolawulo lweentsimbi zixake kakhulu kunye nemisebenzi yokukhusela (Incwadi yokuQhagamshelwana koThutho) 11. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Amakhono amabalwe aphawulelwazi. Amakhono amabalwe obugcisa bobuchwepheshe bokuzikhusela nokuzimisela. Amakhono abantu abanjalo nokuzalisa kunye nokwenza isisombululo. Amakhono abantu abanjalo bokubhala nokuqamba iilwimi ezimbini ezisemthethweni ze provinsi.
xh.duties: Qwalasela umthetho wokuQhagamshelwa koThutho, ukugqithwa kolwandle kwabathengi kunye noMthetho woThutho: Qhagamshela iinkqubo zokuqwalasela umthetho wothutho ezicwangqisiweyo kunye nezigqibo ezivunyiweyo. Qinisekisa isiqhagamsheli esikhululekileyo ngokwenza imisebenzi eqondo nasekuqwalaseleni ukuthutha kwiindawo ezixinene. Qhoba imisebenzi kwaye uqinisekise izithili zabantu abalimele, qonda kwaye ululele abaphathi ngeendawo ezikho inkinobho yezengozi. Thatha inxaxheba kwiiprojekthi zogqitho lomthetho kunye nokuqwalasela isantya. Nikela iinkomfa kwaye wenze ukubanjwa ngaphantsi kweMithetho, imiyalelo neenkqubo ezifanelekileyo kwaye uphume kumagqabethi enkantulu unike ulwazi. Qhagamshela izithuthi ezikho iinkxalabo namathumba ukunqinisekisa ukuhamba kwazo okukhuselekileyo kwaye ulawule ukulawula ukugqithwa kwezinto ezikumthwalo (kuquka izinto nabathengi). Pheqa iLayisenisi zoQhubi nezithuthi zoMzila kwaye ulawule ukulandela umthetho kwiindawo zokuPheqa kweLayisenisi yoQhubi (DLTC) kunye neendawo zokuPheqa iziThuthi (VTS): Qhagamshela ukuqwalaselwa kolayisenisi yabafundi nabaqhubi. (ii) Qhagamshela ukuqwalaselwa koluntu olungelantlandlolwane. Qhagamshela ukulandela umthetho kwiDLTC nakuVTS. Nikela iQwalaselo loThutho elibonakalayo lweNkqubo yoQhagamshelo kwaye ukhuthaze/uqinisekise imisebenzi yokuthintela ubugcisa benyani: Nceda ekuqwalaseleni ukubonakala koluntu oluphephayo ngokunceda abaqhubi kwaye wenze imisebenzi yokuqhagamshela. Thatha inxaxheba kumajoni okuqhagamshela kunye/noma iinkqubo ezikhethekileyo zokuqwalasela umthetho. Qhagamshela iindlela kwindawo ekhethekileyo kwaye uxhase abaqhubi kwindawo ethinta inkinobho yezengozi (oko kukuthi, iindonga ezonakeleyo zomgama, ukuwohloka kwezithuthi). Yenza yonke imisebenzi yaseburhululuse eluqhagamshelana nemithelela yomthetho: gcina iinkqubo zaseburhululuse ezisebenzayo. Ukulandela uMthetho wezixhobo zokuzikhusela nabambi wemigudu 60/2000. Ukulandela imisebenzi enjengoko kuchazwe kwiinkqubo zokuqwalasela. Thatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zeNkcukacha yoThutho nokuQhutywa kwabantu. Khuthaza inkonzo efanelekileyo nesezantsi ukwazi ukudlulisela abathengi. Gcina umfanekiso webhlanga ngokusetyenziswa kwiQela leNkqubo: uQhagamshelo lwoMthetho woThutho.

jobs.title: Provincial Inspector
jobs.salary_text: R280 278 per annum, plus service benefits
jobs.summary: Provincial Inspector enforcing road traffic and transport legislation in the Croesus Region, requiring a Traffic Officer's Diploma and a valid driver's licence.
jobs.requirements: Matric Certificate plus Traffic Officer's Diploma and a valid driver’s license, at least a code B. 01 year of practical experience in traffic law enforcement. No criminal record or case pending against you. Knowledge and Skills: Good record and resource management. Good customer relationship management abilities. Knowledge and understanding of road traffic and public transport policies and regulations. Completion of law enforcement documents. Knowledge of vehicle inspections and vehicle impoundment. Knowledge of the Firearms and Ammunition Act 60/100. Knowledge of departmental guidelines on overload control and escort duties (Transport Handbook) 11. Ability to work under pressure. Good observation skills. Good driving and negations skills. Sound interpersonal and conflict resolution skills. Good written and verbal communication skills in at least two of the provincial official languages.
jobs.duties: Enforce Road Traffic, Public Passenger and Transport Legislation: Implement planned and approved traffic law enforcement activities. Ensure the free flow of traffic through point duty and traffic control at congested areas. Coordinate activities at and safeguard accident scenes, identify and advise management on hazardous locations. Participate in traffic policing projects and speed testing operations. Issue notices and execute arrests under relevant Acts, directives and procedures and attend court proceedings and give evidence. Escort abnormal vehicles and loads to ensure safe movement thereof and coordinate overload control management (including goods and passengers). Examine Drivers' Licences and Motor Vehicles and monitor compliance at Driver License Testing Centres (DLTC) and Vehicle Testing Stations (VTS): Conduct learner and driver license tests. (ii) Conduct roadworthy tests. Monitor compliance of DLTC and VTS. Provide visible Traffic Control/Policing and promote/ensure crime prevention activities: Assist in planning visible traffic policing by assisting motorists and executing escort duties. Participate in roadblocks and/or special law enforcement operations. Patrol roads in dedicated areas and warn motorists at hazardous locations (i.e., damaged road surfaces, breakdown of vehicles). Perform all administrative activities and related duties: maintain effective administrative procedures. Compliance with the Firearm and Ammunition Act 60/2000. Compliance with activities as outlined in the operational plans. Participate in Human Resource Development Programs. Promote effective and efficient service delivery to clients. Maintain a professional corporate image of the Directorate: Traffic Law Enforcement.

af.title: Provinciale Inspekteur
af.summary: Provinciale Inspekteur wat padverkeer- en vervoerwetgewing in die Croesus-streek handhaaf, met 'n Verkeersbeampte-diploma en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie as vereistes.
af.requirements: Matric-sertifikaat plus Verkeersbeampte-diploma en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie, ten minste 'n kode B. 01 jaar praktiese ervaring in verkeerswettoepassing. Geen kriminele rekord of hangende saak teen u nie. Kennis en vaardighede: Goee bestuur van rekords en hulpbronne. Goeie vermoëns vir kliëntverhoudingsbestuur. Kennis en begrip van padverkeer- en openbare vervoerbeleide en -regulasies. Voltooiing van wetstoepassingsdokumente. Kennis van voertuiginspeksies en voertuigbeslaglegging. Kennis van die Firearms and Ammunition Act 60/100. Kennis van departementele riglyne oor oorlaai-beheer en eskortepligte (Transport Handbook) 11. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Goeie waarnemingsvaardighede. Goeie bestuurs- en onderhandelingsvaardighede. Sterk interpersoonlike en konflikoplossingsvaardighede. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede in ten minste twee van die provinsiale amptelike tale.
af.duties: Handhaaf padverkeer-, openbare passasiers- en vervoerwetgewing: Implementeer beplande en goedgekeurde verkeerswettoepassingsaktiwiteite. Verseker die vrye vloei van verkeer deur puntbeheer en verkeersbeheer by besope areas. Koördineer aktiwiteite by en beskerm ongeluktonele, identifiseer gevaarlike plekke en stel bestuur daaroor in kennis. Neem deel aan verkeerspolisiëringsprojekte en spoedtoetsoperasies. Reik kennisgewings uit en voer arrestasies uit kragtens toepaslike wette, richtlyne en prosedures, woon hofverrigtinge by en getuig. Eskorteer abnormale voertuie en vragte om die veilige beweging daarvan te verseker en koördineer oorlaai-beheerbestuur (insluitend goedere en passasiers). Ondersoek bestuurslisensies en motorvoertuie en monitor nakoming by Driver License Testing Centres (DLTC) en Vehicle Testing Stations (VTS): Voer leerling- en bestuurslisensietoetse uit. (ii) Voer padwaardigheidstoetse uit. Monitor nakoming van DLTC en VTS. Verskaf sigbare verkeersbeheer/-polisiëring en bevorder/verseker misdaadvoorkomingsaktiwiteite: Bystand met die beplanning van sigbare verkeerspolisiëring deur motoriste te help en eskortepligte uit te voer. Neem deel aan padblokkades en/of spesiale wetstoepassingsoperasies. Patrolleer paaie in toegewyde areas en waarsku motoriste by gevaarlike plekke (d.w.s. beskadide padoppervlakke, voertuigonklaarraking). Voer alle administratiewe aktiwiteite en verwante pligte uit: onderhou doeltreffende administratiewe prosedures. Nakoming van die Firearm and Ammunition Act 60/2000. Nakoming van aktiwiteite soos uiteengesit in die operasionele planne. Neem deel aan menslikehulpbronontwikkelingsprogramme. Bevorder doeltreffende en produktiewe dienslewering aan kliënte. Handhaaf 'n professionele korporatiewe beeld van die Direktoraat: Verkeerswettoepassing.

zu.title: Isiphathimandla Esifundazwe
zu.summary: Isiphathimandla Esifundazwe esiphoqa umthetho wezokuthutha ngezimoto nezokuhamba ngezitimela esifundeni sase-Croesus, esidinga i-Diploma yesebe lezokuthutha kanye nesilayisensi yokuqasha ethize.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Matric kahle ne-Diploma yesebe lezokuthutha kanye nesilayisensi yokuqasha ethize, okungenani ikhodi B. 01 unyaka weminyaka yemfundo yensebenzo ekuqhashweni komthetho wezokuthutha. Akukho rekodi yobugqwala noma icala elilindile kuwe. Ulwazi nanamakhono: Ukuphathwa kohlelo lobuqophelo kanye nezinsiza. Amakhono amahle okuphatha ubudlelwano nabathengi. Ulwazi nokuzuqonda ngemigomo nemithetho yezokuthutha ngezimoto nezokuhamba ngezimoto zabantu. Ukugcwalisa kwamadokhumenti okuqashwa komthetho. Ulwazi ngokuhlolwa kwezimoto kanye nokuboshwa kwezimoto. Ulwazi ngomthetho wezemfeno nama-Ammunition Act 60/100. Ulwazi ngemihlahlandlela yomnyango ngokulawula ukwethwwa kakhulu kanye nemisebenzi yokuhambisa (Transport Handbook) 11. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegcushwa. Amakhono amahle okuqapha. Amakhono amahle okuqasha kanye nokuxoxisana. Amakhono anomsoco wokuxhumanisa abantu nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana okubhalwayo nakokukhulunwayo okungenisini kulezilimi ezimbili ezisemthethweni sesifundazwe.
zu.duties: Phakamisa umthetho wezokuthutha ngezimoto, Abahamba ngabashayeli bomphakathi kanye noMthetho wezokuthutha: Qamba izinkalo ekuqashweni komthetho wezokuthutha ezenziwayo futhi zamukelekile. Qinisekisa ukugeleza kwezimoto ngokusebenza kwamaphoyinti nolawulo lwezimoto kulezindawo ezigcwelile. Hlanganisa izinkalo kanye nokulondolozwa kwemibhalo yezehlakalo, qaphela futhi unikezele abaphathi ngokwemibhalo eyingozi. Thatha inxaxheba kumaprojekthi wezokuphatha izimoto kanye nokuhlolwa kwezindleli. Khishela izaziso futhi wenze ukuboshwa ngaphansi koMthetho ohambisanayo, imiyalo kanye namasusu bese ubuya ezinkundleni zenkantolo unikeza ubufakazi. Hambisa izimoto ezingajwayelekile namathambo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhamba kwazo okuphephile futhi uhlanganise ukuphathwa kolawulo lokwethwa (okuhlanganisa izimpahla nabahamba). Hlola izilayisensi zabashayeli nezimoto bese uqaphela ukuziphatha kumakhemikhali wokuHlola izilayisensi yokuqasha ngezimoto (DLTC) kanye namasiteshi okuHlola izimoto (VTS): Qamba izivivinyo zamafundi nabashayeli. (ii) Qamba izivivinyo zokuqashwa kanye nokuqashwa kwemithetho yezimoto. Qaphela ukuziphatha kwe-DLTC ne-VTS. Nikeza ukulawula okubonakalayo / okuphathwa kwezimoto futhi ukhuthaze / uqinisekise izinkalo zokuthintwa kwezobugqwala: Siza ekuqashweni kwezokuthutha ezibonakalayo ngokusiza abashayeli bese uenza imisebenzi yokuhambisa. Thatha inxaxheba kumabhuloki nezinhlanganweni kanye noma / noma ezinkalweni ezikhethekile zokuqashwa komthetho. Zula izindlela ezindaweni ezimisiwe futhi xwayisa abashayeli ezindaweni ezingozayo (okungukuthi, izindawo ezonakele, ukuki kwamamoto. Yenza yonke imisebenzi yezokuphatha kanye nemisebenzi ebuswayo: gcina izinkalo ezisebenzayo zezokuphatha. Ukuhambisana noMthetho wezokuthutha nokwesinye isikhali 60/2000. Ukuhambisana nezinkalo ezibhalwe kuhlelo lokusebenza. Thatha inxaxheba kuhlelo lokuthuthukiswa kweZinsiza zomuntu. Khuthaza ukwethulwa kwezinkonzo ezisebenzayo neziphumelelayo kubathengi. Gcina isithombe sobuchwepheshe besikhundla: Iqasho lomthetho wezokuthutha.

xh.title: ISahluleli Sephondo
xh.summary: ISahluleli Sephondo esiphothoza umthetho wogqithiso lwethrafu kunye nothutho kwimbonakaliso ye-Croesus, esifuna iDiploma kaMphathi woGqithiso loThutho nephepha lokushuka elisebenzayo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seMatric kunye neDiploma kaMphathi woGqithiso loThutho nephepha lokushuka elisebenzayo, ubuncinane ikhowudi B. 01 unyaka wamava abalulekileyo ekuphothozeni umthetho wogqithiso lothutho. Akukho gungqo lwenzelelwayo okho icala elitsha phantsi kwakho. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulawulo olululo lwerekothi neemvabo. Amakhono amabalulu okulawula ubudlelwane nabathengi. Ulwazi lokuqonda iingqungqubela ezingomthetho weethrafu zaselwandle nezithuthi zabantu. Ukuqedwa kwamaxwebhu okuphothoza umthetho. Ulwazi ngekuhlola iimoto nokuthathwa kweimoto. Ulwazi ngeFirearms and Ammunition Act 60/100. Ulwazi ngeenkokhelo ze-isebe kumthetho wokuLawula ukuQhatshiswa kweMithwalo kunye nemisebenzi yokukhokela (Transport Handbook) 11. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Amakhono amabalulu okuqaphela. Amakhono amabalulu okushuka kunye nokuququumbela. Amakhono adaladelweyo okuhambelana nabantu kunye nokusombulula iingxabano. Amakhono amabalulu okubhala nokuvelisa izimvo kunjalo nasekuninzi ngesithili sabantu abaxhasa urhulumente kumntla ongungakanani ngowona unyiki wesi-1.
xh.duties: Phothoza umthetho weNethrafu, oMthwalo weNtswela-lwazi noMthetho woThutho: Zonke iimisebenzi ekuphothozeni umthetho wogqithiso lothutho ekuvunywe nakuqulunqwe. Qinisekisa igqwetha lethrafu ngokusebenzisa iimodyokhali nokulawula ixhonyiwe kulawulo abo bakhethwe kakhulu ukuqala bathi balawule ngokutsha ngexesha. Linganisa imisebenzi kwakunye nokulinda iindawo seziganeko, qaphela yaye uzinike iingcebiso ngokuqhayiya iindawo ezinobungozi. Thatha inxaxheba kwiiprojekthi zokucocwa kwethrafu nasekuhloleni isantya senyani. Satshela izaziso yaye wenze ukubanjwa abantu ngokwemiThetho, iinkqubo ezilawulwayo neengqangq athathwa ngokulawula okuqinisekisa ukuziphendulela ngomthetho kwaye uzame iinkqubo zikachipshwa yaye unike ubungqina. Khokela iimoto ezizodwa okanye kakhulu ukunqamlezela yaye ulawule ukuphanga kwamathrafu (kuquka izinto nabathathi). Hlola amaphepha okushuka kweMithwalo yoThutho yaye ujonge ukugqwesa kwiNkokhelo eQinisekisa iMpumelelo yokuHlola iPhepha lokushuka (DLTC) nakwiZiko eliHlola iMoto (VTS): Qeqsha abafundi kunye nabashukayi baphepha. (ii) Qeqsha isithili somthetho wethrafu. Qaphela ukugqwesa kweDLTC nakwiVTS. Zonke iNkqubo zokuQaphela iNethrafu/iNkqubo zokuQonywa/ukwenza izenzo zokuQinisekisa ukuthintela okwenzekayo: Nceda ekunqulunqweni kokubonakala kwabantu ngokwamathrafu ngokunceda abashukiweyo nokwenza imisebenzi yokukhokela. Thatha inxaxheba kwiindonga zokuthintelwa okanye kwezinye iinkqubo ezizodwa ezilawulwa ngumthetho. Tshona iindonga kwii ndawo ezikhethwe ngokukodwa yaye uxwayise abashukiweyo kwindawo ezinobungozi (kuyilo nje, iinkqubo ezingafuni ukwenza konke okufunekayo okanye ukuwohloka kweMithwalo). Zonke izenzo zokulawula iNkqubo nemiSebenzi ehambelanayo: gcina iindlela ezisebenzayo zokulawula inkqubo. Ukuhambelana nomthetho iFirearm and Ammunition Act 60/2000. Ukuhambelana nokuqinisekiswa kwemisebenzi kwinkqubo egqitha ngokumisela. Thatha inxaxheba kwiNkqubo zokuPhucwa iNthutho zeSabelo. Phucula inkqubo yokuHamba eqinisekiswa ngokusebenzela abathengi. Gcina umbono weNkqubo oqinisekisa iziko elifanayo leNkqubo yokuphothoza umthetho weNethrafu.

zu.title: Inspekta Wesifundazwe
zu.summary: Inspekta Wesifundazwe oqinisekisa umthetho wezokuthutha ngomgwaqo kanye nomthetho wentuthuko yomphakathi eSoweto, ofuna iDiploma ykaMphathi Wezokuthutha kanye nenyanga eyodwa yempilo yomsebenzi.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi seMatric kahle ngeDiploma ykaMphathi Wezokuthutha kanye nelayisense yokushayela esebenzayo, okungenani ikhodi B. 01 unyaka wemvelakude yomsebenzi oqinisekisa umthetho wezokuthutha. Asikho isikhwama senkinga zemithetho noma icala elilindile ngawe. Ulwazi namakhono: Ukulawula irekhodi nezinsiza ngendlela elungile. Amakhono ohlelo lobudlelwano namakhasimnde ahle kahle. Ulwazi nokuqonda izinqubomgomo nemitheshwana yezokuthutha ngomgwaqo kanye nentuthuko yomphakathi. Ukuqedela amafomu oqinisekiso womthetho. Ulwazi ngokuqamba izimoto kanye nokubamba izimoto. Ulwazi ngoMthetho Wamaphoyisa Asemthethweni kanye Nabaligari 60/100. Ulwazi lwegqoqho leminyango ngolawulo lwe-fa yamaphoyisa kanye nemisebenzi yokuqinisekisa izimoto 11. Isikhathi esifinyelele imisebenzi phansi kokwesabekayo. Amakhono abhekisa ngokuqinisekileyo. Amakhono okushayela kwesinye isikhathi kanye nobudlelwano. Amakhono obudlelwano nomuntu kanye nokuxazulula iinkinga. Amakhono okubhala nokuthetha kahle kwezilimi ezimbili eziyisikhulu ngalezo zikahulumeni wesifundazwe. Ukuze kutholakale ukusebenza kahle. Amakhono abonuwe kakuhle ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Isikhathi esifinyelele imisebenzi yokuqinisekisa kungcono kunaleyo yamaphoyisa. Amakhono okushayela kwaye ngcono kubudlelwano. Amakhono obudlelwano nomuntu ahle kakhulu nokuxazulula iinkinga. Amakhono okubhala nokuthetha kahle kwezilimi ezibili ezinhle kakhulu zigunyazwe yisifundazwe.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa umthetho Wezokuthutha Ngomgwaqo, Wabagibeli Basesikhashana Nentuthuko: Thatha inkinga ngezenzo ezifakiwe emthethweni wezokuthutha. Qinisekisa ukuhamba kahle kwezimoto ngesikhathi sokuthi ukwesabiwe emigwaqweni. Letha imisebenzi nokuqinisekisa izweni lesiphithiphithi, thola futhi umnikazi wemisebenzi yakho emigwaqweni. Thatha inkinga emibuzweni yokuqinisekisa izimoto. Faka amaphoyisa kumaphrojekthi wezokuthutha kanye nokuhlola ukushesha. Faka isicelo sokuba ngumuntu onegunya lokubamba ngaphansi komthetho othize, iNkomba nokuhamba kwemisebenzi, futhi uye enkantolo unike inkomba. Qinisekisa izimoto ezinkulu kakhulu nezinsimamakhontha ukuze zihamba ngokuphepha, kwaye ulawule ukuqhathaniswa ngokunzima (uhlanganise okuhamba kubantu nasezintweni). Hlola amalayisense kaShayeli kwezimoto, ukuze amalayisense kahulumenti abe ngokuqinisekileyo enkonzweni. Hlola izimoto ukuze zibe ngokuqinisekileyo, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi zihamba ngomthetho. Zinzele kusukela ngomhlaka 06/2000, ikhomishani yamaphoyisa eNingizimu Afrika, ilayisensi yokushayela ikhodi B/EB. (i) Ukuqinisekisa amalayisense okushayela nezimoto ngokuzenzakalelayo. (ii) Hlola amalayisense ezimoto zokushayela. Qinisekisa izinkomba ezitholwa emthethweni. Hlinzeka ngomsebenzi wezokuthutha Oqinisekisiweyo: Siza ekuletheni ngokubonakalayo nangokuqinisekisa ukuthi kwenzeke ukuthuthwa kwemisebenzi. Zama ukulawula imisebenzi yokuthi amaphoyisa abone ngokubonakalayo. Zama ukuthi uthole amaphoyisa ahle kakhulu endaweni. Zama ukuba ngumuntu onegunya lokubeka inkinga emthethweni. Hlinzeka ngemisebenzi ehle kahle. Hlinzeka ngezinsiza ezifanele. Letha imisebenzi efanayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi umthetho Wamaphoyisa nokuqinisekisa izinsimamakhontha ugcine. Zama ukuba ngumuntu onegunya lokubeka inkinga emthethweni. Thatha inkinga emibuzweni yokuqinisekisa izimoto.

xh.title: Iphumphu lePhondo
xh.summary: Iphumphu lePhondo elinika amandla umthetho we-thrafi zentsawo nathamkelo lwentlanga kwindawo ethi Soweto, elifuna iDiploma kaMphathi weThrafi kunye nomyaka omnye wemfundo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seMatric negunya leDiploma kaMphathi weThrafi kunye nelayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni, ubuncinane icode B. 01 yeminyaka yamava abalulekileyo ekusebenziseni umthetho we-thrafi. Akukho gaziwa legwenxa okanye cala elinqamlezileyo kuwe. Ulwazi nakhono: Ulawulo olululo bemigaqo namacebo. Ulawulo olululo wobudlelwane nabathengi. Ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo nomthetho we-thrafi zentsawo nathamkelo lwentlanga. Ukuqedwa kwamaxwebhu olusebenziselwa ukuphikisa umthetho. Ulwazi ngokuhlola izithuili nokuzibekwa kwezithuili. Ulwazi ngoMthetho weZixhobo zokuQhuba namaBhombu 60/100. Ulwazi ngeendidi-zixhobo zesebe ekulawuleni ukugqithisa umthwalo nangemisebenzi yokulungiselela (Incwadana yoThutho) 11. Amandla okusebenza ngaphantsi komthwalo. Amakhono obonisela obululo. Amakhono obukhali nabucholi obululo. Amakhono abalulekileyo okwazisa nokuxazulula iingxabano. Amakhono abalulekileyo okubhala nokuqwetha ngesithethe esibhalwe phantsi nasemlonyeni kubuncinane iilwimi ezimbini ezisemthethweni ephondo.
xh.duties: Kusebenzise umthetho weThrafi zentsawo, Abathathi abaHamba ngeThutho loMntu: Ukusebenzisa imisebenzi ecebiweyo nayo namkelweyo yokuphikisa umthetho we-thrafi. Kuqinisekiswe ukutyhutyha kolwandle lwe-thrafi ngokusetyenziswa kobuchwepheshe bokumisela iindawo nolawulo lwe-thrafi kwiindawo ezixineneyo. Ukuhlela imisebenzi kwaye kugcinwe iindawo ezithile zehlobo lokutsha kubhalwe kwaye kuyalelwe nabaphathi malunga neendawo ezingoziyo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kumapojekthi we-thrafi zentsawo nakusebenzisa iimvavayo zokulinga isantya. Ukunikela izaziso nokubamba abantu ngaphantsi kwezoMthetho, imiyalelo noluhlu lweendlela oluchanekileyo nokubakho kwiinkqubo zesigqeba nokunikela ubungqina. Ukulungiselela ukutyhutyha kolwandle kwezithuili ezingezoqhelekayo nokutsha kwaye kuqinisekiswe ukutyhutyha kolwandle okukhuselekileyo nokulawula ukugqithiswa komthwalo (kuquka nokutsha kwezithuili nabantu). Ukuhlola amaLayisensi oBashayeli ngeZithuili zoQhira kwaye kulawulwe ukulandela umthetho kwiZiko eliVavayo ukuze liphasiswe iLayisensi yokushayela iQhira (DLTC) nakuZiko eliVavayo ukuze liphasiswe iZithuili zentsawo (VTS): Ukulandela iimvavayo zabafundi nabashayeli. (ii) Ukulandela iimvavayo zokulunga kwesithuthi. Ukulawula ukulandela kolawulo kwiDLC nakuVTS. Ukunika ulawulo olubonakalayo lweThrafi nokuQhuba nokuqinisekisa amashishini okuthintela ubugebenga: Ukunceda ekuhleleni ulawulo olubonakalayo lwe-thrafi zentsawo ukunceda abashayeli bemithuthi nokulungiselela imisebenzi yokulawula ukutsha kwezithuili. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kumaxhoba okuvala iindlela nakwishishini loqeqesho ngokukhethekileyo lomthetho. Ukujikeleza iindlela kwiindawo ezichaziweyo kwaye kuyalelwe abashayeli bemithuthi kwiindawo ezinengozi (oko kukuthi, iindawo ezonakalisiweyo zeendawo, ukuwohloka kwesithuthi). Ukwenza yonke imisebenzi yolawulo olubanzi: ukulawula inkqubo echanekileyo yolawulo. Ukulandela umthetho weSilahle namaBhombu 60/2000. Ukulandela imisebenzi njengoko kuchazwe kwiinkqubo zokuqhubela phambili. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiNkqubo zoPhuhliso lwaBantu baseMmandla. Ukuphuhlisa inkonzo echanekileyo nasebenza kakuhle kumaxhwebhu. Ukulondoloza umfanekiso weNkampani ochanekileyo weqela: ukuQhinga umthetho we-Thrafi.

jobs.title: Provincial Inspector
jobs.salary_text: R280 278 per annum, plus service benefits
jobs.summary: Provincial Inspector enforcing road traffic and public transport legislation in Mabopane, requiring a Traffic Officer's Diploma, matric and a valid driver's licence.
jobs.requirements: Matric Certificate plus Traffic Officer's Diploma and a valid driver’s license, at least a code B. 01 year of practical experience in traffic law enforcement. No criminal record or case pending against you. Knowledge and Skills: Good record and resource management. Good customer relationship management abilities. Knowledge and understanding of road traffic and public transport policies and regulations. Completion of law enforcement documents. Knowledge of vehicle inspections and vehicle impoundment. Knowledge of the Firearms and Ammunition Act 60/100. Knowledge of departmental guidelines on overload control and escort duties (Transport Handbook) 11. Ability to work under pressure. Good observation skills. Good driving and negations skills. Sound interpersonal and conflict resolution skills. Good written and verbal communication skills in at least two of the provincial official languages.
jobs.duties: Enforce Road Traffic, Public Passenger and Transport Legislation: Implement planned and approved traffic law enforcement activities. Ensure the free flow of traffic through point duty and traffic control at congested areas. Coordinate activities at and safeguard accident scenes, identify and advise management on hazardous locations. Participate in traffic policing projects and speed testing operations. Issue notices and execute arrests under relevant Acts, directives and procedures and attend court proceedings and give evidence. Escort abnormal vehicles and loads to ensure safe movement thereof and coordinate overload control management (including goods and passengers). Examine Drivers' Licences and Motor Vehicles and monitor compliance at Driver License Testing Centers (DLTC) and Vehicle Testing Stations (VTS): Conduct learner and driver license tests. (ii) Conduct roadworthy tests. Monitor compliance of DLTC and VTS. Provide visible Traffic Control/Policing and promote/ensure crime prevention activities: Assist in planning visible traffic policing by assisting motorists and executing escort duties. Participate in roadblocks and/or special law enforcement operations. Patrol roads in dedicated areas and warn motorists at hazardous locations (i.e., damaged road surfaces, breakdown of vehicles). Perform all administrative activities and related duties: maintain effective administrative procedures. Compliance with the Firearm and Ammunition Act 60/2000. Compliance with activities as outlined in the operational plans. Participate in Human Resource Development Programs. Promote effective and efficient service delivery to clients. Maintain a professional corporate image of the Directorate: Traffic Law Enforcement.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. Tshidiso Chabane/ Ms. Dolly Seboane/ Tlalane Koenane Tel No: (011) 689 3845/ 3723/ 3847
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on new Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za/documents (effective from 01 January 2021). All fields in Part A to D of the Z83 form must be completed, and Part E to G noting that there is limited space provided applicants often indicate “refer” to CV or see attached, this is acceptable as long as the CV is attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. The question related to the conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered. Declaration must be completed and signed. The fully completed and signed new Z83 form should be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV only (only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications). Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applicants who do not comply with the above requirements, as well as late applications, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Suitable candidates will undergo a personnel suitability check (Vetting, criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification, and employment verification). The Department of Community Safety reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes. Candidate will be placed according to corridor coordination and the Department’s needs. The Department will not accept posted, emailed or hand delivered applications. We encourage youth, people with disability, coloured, Indian and white to apply and a confirmation of disabilities from a registered medical practitioner must be attached to the application. Please Note: Due to the large number of applications, we envisage to receive, applications will not be acknowledged. If you do not receive any response within 3 months, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Provinciale Inspekteur
af.summary: Provinciale Inspekteur wat padverkeer- en openbare vervoerwetgewing in Mabopane afdwing, met 'n Verkeersbeampte-diploma, matriek en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie as vereistes.
af.requirements: Matrieksertifikaat plus Verkeersbeampte-diploma en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie, ten minste kode B. 01 jaar praktiese ervaring in verkeerswetstoepassing. Geen strafrekord of hangende saak teen u nie. Kennis en Vaardighede: Goeie rekord- en hulpbronbestuur. Goeie vermoëns vir kliëntverhoudingsbestuur. Kennis en begrip van padverkeer- en openbare vervoerbeleid en -regulasies. Voltooiing van wetstoepassingsdokumente. Kennis van voertuiginspeksies en voertuigbeslaglegging. Kennis van die Wet op Vuurwapens en Ammunisie 60/100. Kennis van departementele riglyne oor oorladingbeheer en begeleidingspligte (Vervoerhandboek) 11. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Goeie waarnemingsvaardighede. Goeie bestuurs- en onderhandelingsvaardighede. Goeie interpersoonlike en konflikhanteringsvaardighede. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede in ten minste twee van die amptelike provinsiale tale.
af.duties: Handhaaf Padverkeer-, Openbare Passasiers- en Vervoerwetgewing: Implementeer beplande en goedgekeurde verkeerswetstoepassingsaktiwiteite. Verseker die vrye vloei van verkeer deur puntdiens en verkeersbeheer by verdigte gebiede. Koördineer aktiwiteite by en beveilig ongelukstonele, identifiseer en stel bestuur in kennis van gevaarlike plekke. Neem deel aan verkeerspolisieprojekte en spoedtoetsoperasies. Uit rekwisisies en voer arrestasies uit onder toepaslike Wette, richtlyne en prosedures en woon hofverrigtinge by en getuig. Begelei abnormale voertuie en vragte om die veilige beweging daarvan te verseker en koördineer oorladingbeheerbestuur (insluitend goedere en passasiers). Ondersoek Bestuurderslisensies en Motorvoertuie en monitor nakoming by Bestuurderslisensietoetsentrums (DLTC) en Voertuigtoetsstasies (VTS): Voer leerling- en bestuurderslisensietoetse uit. (ii) Voer padwaardigheidstoetse uit. Monitor nakoming van DLTC en VTS. Verskaf sigbare Verkeersbeheer/Polisering en bevorder/verseker misdaadvoorkomingsaktiwiteite: Bystand met die beplanning van sigbare verkeerspolisering deur motoriste te help en begeleidingspligte uit te voer. Neem deel aan padblokkades en/of spesiale wetstoepassingsoperasies. Patrollie paaie in toegewyde gebiede en waarsku motoriste by gevaarlike plekke (d.w.s. beskadige padoppervlakke, voertuigopbreke). Voer alle administratiewe aktiwiteite en verwante pligte uit: handhaaf doeltreffende administratiewe prosedures. Nakoming van die Wet op Vuurwapens en Ammunisie 60/2000. Nakoming van aktiwiteite soos uiteengesit in die operasionele planne. Neem deel aan Menslike Hulpbronontwikkelingsprogramme. Bevorder doeltreffende en doeltreffende dienslewering aan kliënte. Handhaaf 'n professionele korporatiewe beeld van die Direktoraat: Verkeerswetstoepassing.

xh.title: Ilnyangi lePhondo
xh.summary: Ilnyangi lePhondo eliphothoza imithetho yegqwetha yendlela kunye nemithetho yorhwebo lwabantu kawonke kwi-Mabopane, elifuna i-Diploma yesebe legqwetha, i-matric kunye nelayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se-Matric kunye ne-Diploma yesebe legqwetha kunye nelayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni, ubuncinane ikhodi B. 01 unyaka wamava obuchule ekuphothozeni komthetho wegqwetha. Akukho gqitho lwezobugcisa okanye isigqibo esilindelwe kuni. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulawulo olulungileyo kumagqabi-abakho kunye nemithombo yemininzi. Amakhono alungileyo okulawula ubudlelwane nabathengi. Ulwazi nakuqonda iindlela zemigaqo kunye nemithetho yegqwetha yendlela kunye norhwebo lwabantu kawonke. Ugqibo kwamaxwebhu okuphothoza umthetho. Ulwazi ngokukhangela iimoto kunye nokuthathwa kweimoto. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Firearms and Ammunition Act 60/100. Ulwazi malunga neenqobo zomthetho zesebe ngokulawula ukutyhafa kunye nemisebenzi yokuhamba nobele (Transport Handbook) 11. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcinezelo. Amakhono alungileyo okuqaphela. Amakhono alungileyo okuqhuba kunye nonotshaba. Amakhono alungileyo obudlelwane nabantu kunye nokuqondisa iingxabano. Amakhono alungileyo okubhala kunye nokuThetha ubuncinane kwezinye iilwimi ezisemthethweni zephondo.
xh.duties: Phothoza imithetho yegqwetha, yabakhi-mgama bokuRhwebo lwabantu kawonke kunye nezezoThutho: Qhuba imisebenzi equkiweyo kunye neyamkelekileyo yokuphothoza umthetho wegqwetha. Qinisekisa ukuhamba ngokukhululeka kwegqwetha ngokwenza umsebenzi oqondiswayo kunye nolawulo legqwetha kwindawo ezityhafiweyo. Lawula imisebenzi kwaye uhlole iindawo zeonke iingozi, uchaze kwaye ululeisebe ngendawo ezenza ingozi. Thatha inxaxheba kwiprojekthi zegqwetha kunye nokuvavanya ukukhawuleza. Nikela iisleazi kwaye wenze amagqabetho ngaphantsi kweMithetho, iimiyalelo kunye neendlela ezifunekayo kwaye uzibandakanye kwinkqubo yamangqwetha kwaye uze ubanika ubungqina. Hamba nabakhusi abangeyiyo kwaye ulawule ukutyhafa kwaye ulawule ukulawulwa kokutyhafa (kuquka izinto nabakhusi). Khangela iilayisenisi zokuqhuba kunye neeMoto kwaye ulawule ukuzithobela kwiZiko lokuVavanya iLayisenisi zoQhushumba (DLTC) kunye neSiteshi sokuVavanya iinstruments (VTS): Qhuba iinguqu zeveki kunye namavavanyo eLayisenisi yakuQhushumba. (ii) Qhuba amavavanyo okulungele ihayo ngomgama. Lawula ukuzithobela kweDLTC kunye neVTS. Nikezela ngokuQaphela / ukulawula kwegqwetha okubonakalayo kwaye unyuse / qinisekise imisebenzi yokuthintela ubugcisa: Nceda kwingcebiso yegqwetha esibonakalayo ngokuncedisa abashishiwe kwaye uqhuba imisebenzi yokuhamba. Thatha inxaxheba kwiindonga ezivaliweyo kunye / okanye iinkqubo ezikhethekileyo zokuphothoza umthetho. Zulula iindlela kwindawo onikezelwe kuzo kwaye lumkise abashishiwe kwindawo ezenza ingozi (oko kukuthi, iindawo ezonakalisiweyo zegqwetha, ukuqhawuka kweimoto). Yenza yonke imisebenzi yolawulo kunye nezinye ezinxulumene nayo: gcina iindlela ezisebenzayo zolawulo. Ukuzithobela ngokumthetho weFirearm kunye ne-Ammunition Act 60/2000. Ukuzithobela kumasebenzi achazwe kwinkqubo yokusebenza. Thatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yophuhliso yoBemi. Nyusa inkonzo esemgangathweni nesebenzayo kubathengi. Gcina umfanekiso ongemgceni webhodi yoBukumkani: ukuphothoza umthetho wegqwetha.

zu.title: Isiphathimandla Esifundeni
zu.summary: Isiphathimandla Esifundeni esiphoqa umthetho wezokuhamba kwezimoto kanye nowezokuhamba koluntu eMabopane, esifuna i-Diploma yaseMphathi Wezokuhamba Kwezimoto, i-matric kanye nesilayisensi yokushayela esevumelekile.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Matric kanye ne-Diploma yaseMphathi Wezokuhamba Kwezimoto nesilayisensi yokushayela esevumelekile, okungenani ikhodi B. 01 unyaka wokuqeqeshwa kokusebenza ekuphoqweni komthetho wezokuhamba kwezimoto. Akukho rekodi yokwebi noma icala elifakwe kuwe elisalindile. Ulwazi namakhono: Ephumelele ekuphathweni kwezarekhodi nezinsiza. Amakhono aphumelele ekuphathweni kwezibopho zabathengi. Ulwazi nokuqonda izinqubomgomo nezimiso zezokuhamba kwezimoto nezokuhamba koluntu. Ukuqedwa kwamadokhumenti okuphoqa umthetho. Ulwazi ngokuhlola izimoto kanye nokuthatha izimoto ngamandla. Ulwazi ngomthetho Wezikhali Nezibhamu 60/100. Ulwazi ngoluhla lomnyango lokulawula ukugeleta amathoni kanye nemisebenzi yokuqeqesha (Transport Handbook) 11. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi kwegazi. Amakhono aphumelele okuqapha. Amakhono aphumelele okushayela nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono aphumelele okuxhumana nabantu nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono aphumelele okuxhumana okushiwo nasekulalelwa okungenani kwezilimi ezimbili ezisemthethweni esifundeni.
zu.duties: Phoqa umthetho Wezokuhamba Kwezimoto, Abagibeli Basesithuthi Sikanhlekisa kanye Nezokuhamba Koluntu: Qamba izinkambiso zokuphoqa umthetho wezokuhamba kwezimoto ezihlelwe zivunyiwe. Qinisekisa ukugeleza kwezokuhamba kwezimoto ngesabelo nolawulo lwezokuhamba kwezimoto kumakhaya anoswela. Hlela imisebenko emakethe yezakhthi zemishini, ukhiqize futhi ulule imphathi ngendawo eyingozi. Thatha inxaxheba kumaphulo ephoyisa lezokuhamba kwezimoto nakumsebenzi wokuhlola ijubane. Khishela izaziso futhi ubambe abantu ngaphansi kwezomthetho, iziqondiso nemisiko ehlobene nawo, uhlotshanise neenkantolo futhi unike ubufakazi. Qeqesha izimoto nezithuthi ezingajwayelekile nezithwalwa kulelo ukuvikeleka ukuhamba kwazo ukuqonda kwaye ulawule ukulawulwa kokugqithisa umthwalo (kuquka izimpahla nabahamba. Vavanya Amalayisensi Abashayeli Nezimoto bese ulalela ukuthobeka eKilasi YokuVavanya Amalayisensi Abashayeli (DLTC) naseGumbini Lokuvavanya Izimoto (VTS): Qeqesha abafundi neenkosi zamalayisensi. (ii) Qeqesha ukuvikeleka kwemoto. Lilangazelela ukuthobeka kwesixhobo seDLTC neVTS. Siyize Isilawuli Sokuthutha nokuPhekela imisebenzi yokuthintela okona: Siza ekuphepheni isilawuli sokubuka ngokunika izinzuzo kubashayeli nokupheka izikhwama. Thatha inxaxheba kwizilawuli zokuphepha kanye/noma imisebenzi ekhethekileyo. Hambisa iindlela ezikhethwe nokuqapha abashayeli kwindawo eyingozi (njengendlela ephukileyo, ukuqhawuka kwemoto. Zonke izinto zolawulo nemisebenzi ehlotshaneyo: zigcinwe ngokusebenza kakuhle kwindlela yolawulo. Ukuze kuhambelane noMthetho Wamasele NeemVuthu 60/2000. Ukuze kuhambelane nemisebenzi enikelwe kwindlela yokusebenza. Thatha inxaxheba kwiNkqubo Yokuphuhlisa Abasebenzi. Phakamisa inkonzo ephumelelayo nesebenzayo kumaxhoba. Gcina umbono weNkundla yamabhaso: Ukuphatha umthetho Wokuthutha.

jobs.title: Provincial Inspector
jobs.salary_text: R280 278 per annum, plus service benefits

Knowledge and understanding of road traffic and public transport policies and regulations. Completion of law enforcement documents. Knowledge of vehicle inspections and vehicle impoundment. Knowledge of the Firearms and Ammunition Act 60/100. Knowledge of departmental guidelines on overload control and escort duties (Transport Handbook) 11. Ability to work under pressure. Good observation skills. Good driving and negations skills. Sound interpersonal and conflict resolution skills. Good written and verbal communication skills in at least two of the provincial official languages.

Issue notices and execute arrests under relevant Acts, directives and procedures and attend court proceedings and give evidence. af.title: Provinciale Inspekteur
af.summary: Provinciale Inspekteur in Wadeville wat padverkeer- en openbare vervoerwetgewing handhaaf, waarvoor 'n Verkeersbeampte-diploma en een jaar se ondervinding in verkeerswettoepassing vereis word.
af.requirements: Matriks-sertifikaat plus 'n Verkeersbeampte-diploma en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie, ten minste 'n kode B. 01 jaar se praktiese ondervinding in verkeerswettoepassing. Geen misdadige rekord of hangende saak teen jou nie. Kennis en Vaardighede: Goeie rekord- en hulpbronbestuur. Goeie vermoëns vir kliëntverhoudingsbestuur. Kennis en begrip van padverkeer- en openbare vervoerbeleid en -regulasies. Voltooiing van wetstoepassingsdokumente. Kennis van voertuiginspeksies en voertuigbeslaglegging. Kennis van die Vuurwapens- en Ammunisiewet 60/100. Kennis van departementele riglyne oor oorlaai-beheer en eskortepligte (Vervoerhandboek) 11. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede in ten minste twee van die provinsiale amptelike tale.
af.duties: Handhaaf Padverkeer-, Openbare Passasiers- en Vervoerwetgewing: Implementeer beplande en goedgekeurde verkeerswettoepassingsaktiwiteite. Verseker die vrye vloei van verkeer deur puntdiens en verkeersbeheer by opeengepakte gebiede. Koördineer aktiwiteite by en beveilig ongelukstonele, identifiseer gevaarlike plekke en stel bestuur daaroor in kennis. Neem deel aan verkeerspolisiëingsprojekte en spoedtoetsoperasies. Uitvaardig kenniggewings en voer arrestasies uit ingevolge relevante Wette, riglyne en prosedures en woon hofverrigtinge by en lewer getuienis. Eskorteer abnormale voertuie en vragte om die veilige beweging daarvan te verseker en koördineer oorlaai-beheerbestuur (insluitend goedere en passasiers). Ondersoek Bestuurderslisensies en Motervoertuie en monitor nakoming by Bestuurderslisensietoetsentrums (BLTC) en Voertuigtoetsstasies (VTS): Voer leerling- en bestuurderslisensietoetse uit. (ii) Voer padwaardigheidstoetse uit. Monitor nakoming van BLTC en VTS. Neem deel aan padblokkades en/of spesiale wetstoepassingsoperasies. zu.title: Isiphathimandla Sesifundazwe
zu.summary: Isiphathimandla Sesifundazwe eWadeville esiphoqa umthetho wezokuhamba kwezimoto kanye nomthetho wentengiso yomphakathi, esidinga iDiploma yaseOfisi Yezokuthutha kanye nenyanga eyodwa yemfundo yokwenza umthetho wezokuthutha.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi seMatric kanye neDiploma yaseOfisi Yezokuthutha nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile, okungenani ikhodi B. 01 unyaka wemfundo yenqubo yokwenza umthetho wezokuthutha. Kungabi nerekodu yobugebengu noma icala elisedwaleni ngesikhathi sokuqashwa kini. Ulwazi namakhono: Uphatho oluhle kwezinkomba kanye nezinsiza. Amakhono amahle okuphatha ubudlelwano nabathengi. Ulwazi nokuqonda izinqubomgomo nezimiso zezokuhamba kwezimoto kanye nentengiso yomphakathi. Ukuqedwa kwezincwadi zokuqinisekisa umthetho. Ulwazi ngokuhlola izimoto kanye nokuthathwa kwezimoto ngokusemthethweni. Ulwazi ngomthetho wezikhali namasotshi (Firearms and Ammunition Act) 60/100. Ulwazi ngeziqondiso zomnyango mayelana nokulawula ukunqatshwa ngobunzima kanye nemisebenzi yokuqaphela (Transport Handbook) 11. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo. Amakhono amahle okuqapha. Amakhono amahle okushayela kanye nokuxoxisana. Amakhono ahle abantu kanye nokuqeqeshwa kobundlobanuela. Amakhono amahle okuxoxa nokubhala okungenani ngolimi olungamapheshana wesifundazwe.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa komthetho wezokuthutha, ithransiphathi yomphakathi kanye nomthetho wentengiso yomphakathi: Ukusetshenziswa kwemisebenzi ehlelekile nokuqinisekisiwe yokuqinisekisa umthetho wezokuthutha. Qinisekisa ukuhamba kwamahhaya kwezimoto ngokusebenza emagumbi nokuqapha ukuphakama kwezimoto kumawendawo anamanani amakhulu wahamba e. Hlela imisebenzi futhi uvikele indawo yengozi, uqaphe futhi umnikaze ngendawo eyingozi. Thatha inxaxheba kumaphrojekthi wezokuthutha kanye nokuqeqeshwa kwesivinini. Nikeza izaziso futhi wenze ukuboshwa ngaphansi kwemithetho, iziqondiso kanye neziqondiso zokuqinisekisa umthetho, kanye nokuya ezinkantolo unikeza ubufakazi. Qaphela izimoto nezimpahla ezingajwayelekile ukuze kugqamise ukuphepha kwazo kwaye uhlele ukulawulwa kokunqatshwa ngobunzima (okuhlanganisa izimpahla nabagibeli). Hlola amalayisensi kanye nezimoto futhi ulawule ukuziphatha emagumbi okuqeqeshwa nokuhlolwa kwamalayisensi (DLTC) nasemagumbi okuhlolwa kwamamoto (VTS): Qeqesha abafundi ngezinga lokushayela. (ii) Qeqesha nokuhlolwa okungavumela ukushayiswa kwemoto. Lawula ukuziphatha kwe-DLTC ne-VTS. Nikeza ukulawulwa okubonakalayo kwezokuthutha futhi ukhuthaze/ukuhlela imisebenzi yokuthintwa nobugebengu: Siza ekwenzeni ucwaningo mayelana nezinhlelo ezibonakalayo ezolawula izimoto ngokusiza abashayeli futhi wenze imisebenzi yokuqapha. Thatha inxaxheba kumagumbi aqinisekiswa noma imisebenzi ekhetheke yeqinisekiswa umthetho. Zula emgwacweni emadolobheni ahleliwe futhi uxwayise abashayeli ngendawo eyingozi (isb., indawo eyonakele, ukuwohloka kwezimoto). Yonke imisebenzi yohluzo nolawulo okuhlobene nayo: gcina izinqubo zohluzo eziphuma embili. Ukuhambisana nomthetho wezikhali namasotshi (Firearms and Ammunition Act) 60/2000. Ukuhambisana nemisebenzi ehleliwe kuleyo nkqubo. Thatha inxaxheba kumaphrojekthi aqhutshwa kakhulu yabantu ekulawulweni imisebenzi yomthetho. Khuthaza ukwenza imisebenzi ngenkqubo ekhulu nakhona. Gcina isithombe esihle sokuqamba eqondisweni: Ukusetshenziswa komthetho wezokuthutha.

xh.title: Isohlwayo esiNgangingweni seRiphabhlikhi
xh.summary: Isohlwayo esiNgangingweni seRiphabhlikhi eWadeville sisebenzisa umthetho wothutho lwemizila nowohwebo bomphakathi, sifuna iDiploma yomphathi wothutho nomyaka omnye wamava wolawulo lomthetho wothutho.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seMatric negama leDiploma yomPhathi weZothutho nelayisensi yomBambeziwo, ubuncinane ikhowudi B. 01 yeminyaka yamava abalulekileyo kumthetho wokulawula izothutho. Akukho ntlolongo okanye icala elikhoyo ngokuchasene nawe. Ulwazi nobugcisa: Ulawulo olululo lwemiba nezibonelelo. Amandla amabalulekileyo oLawulo lweNxulumano noBakhweli. Ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo zobumthetho kwizothutho nomthetho wohwebo bomphakathi. Ukugqibezela amaphepha omthetho. Ulwazi ngokuvavanya iimoto nangokuBamba imoto. Ulwazi loMthetho weBhasha noMlingo iAct 60/100. Ulwazi ngeenqobo zomthetho zolawulo lwezothutho nangokukhusela imisebenzi (Incwadi yesandla soHwebo) 11. Amandla okusebenza ngexinxwinywa. Ubuchule obuhle bokubona. Amandla amahle okuQhuba nokuba negama elihle. Amandla amabalulekileyo obudlelwano nabantu nokusombulula iingxabano. Amandla amahle obuqulunqiweyo nokuThetha nabantu phantsi kwemivo, aze akanamsebenzi ongungathanda abantu, kwaye ukukwazi ukubhalisa
xh.duties: Ukuze kwenziwe umthetho weZothutho eMzila, uMthetho woBuhwele noMthetho woHwebo: Ukuzalisa izicwangciso ezilungelelweyo nezamkelekileyo zemisebenzi yokuzezelwa komthetho wezothutho. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthutha ngokukhululekileyo komzila ngokwenza umsebenzi kwii-pointi nolawulo lothutho kwindawo ezixakekileyo. Ulungelelanisa imisebenzi kwaye uvikele iindawo zethutyana, ukuqamba ukuze ubonise abaphathi ngeendawo ezizondo ngobungozi. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kumaphulo ombutho wezothutho nemisebenzi yokuvavanya isantya. Ukupapasha izaziso kwaye wenze izibambo ngaphantsi koMthetho, imiyalelo neenkqubo ezifanelekileyo kwaye ukhonde iinkqubo zenkundla unike ubungqina. Ukukhuseleka ngokuthutha iimoto ezingaqhelekanga nemicimbi yazo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunyamalala kwazo ngokukhuselekileyo kwaye ulungelelanise ulawulo lolawulo lokugqithisa umthwalo (kuquka izinto nabahambi). Ukuvavanya iilaayisensi zoBambeziwo kunye neeMoto kwaye ulawule ukuzinikela ngemigaqo kwiZiko Lovavanyo lweeLayisensi zoBambeziwo (DLTC) naseKwindawo zokuVavanya iziNqanamba (VTS): Ukwenza uvavanyo lwebhasi lokufunda nelayisensi yobambeziwo. (ii) Ukwenza uvavanyo lokulungele ukusetyenziswa emzileni. Ukulawula ukuzinikela ngemigaqo kwiDLTC nakwiVTS. Ukubonelela ngolawulo / umbutho weZothutho eMzila obonakalayo kwaye ukhuthaze / uqinisekise imisebenzi yokuthintela ubugcisa: Ukuncedisa ekulungeni umbutho wezothutho obonakalayo ngokuncedisa abashweshwezi bemoto kwaye ukhusele imisebenzi. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kumajoni emizila kwaye / nasezicwangcisweni ezizodwa zokuzezelwa komthetho. Ukuzila imizila kwiindawo ezizinikezelweyo kwayeulumkise abashweshwezi bemoto kwiindawo ezingozi (o.k., iindawo ezonakalisiweyo zemoto, ukuqhawuka kweekhoyo). Ukwenza yonke imisebenzi yolawulo nemisebenzi edibana nayo: ukugcina iinkqubo zolawulo ezisebenzayo. Ukuzinikela ngokuchanekileyo ngomthetho weBhasha noMlingo iAct 60/2000. Ukuzinikela ngokuchanekileyo ngokwemisebenzi echazwe kwizicwangciso zokusebenza. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kumaphulo eNqanaba lophuhliso loBabantu bakaRhulumente. Ukukhuthaza ukubonelelwa ngensebenzo efanelekileyo nesebenzayo kumaxhwebhe. Ukugcina umfanekiso webhunga ongemthethweni weqela leNkundla: ukuze kubekho uThetho lokuLwa ngeMthetho.

Ulwazi nokuzuva imigomo kanye nomthetho wezokuthutha emgwaqeni kanye nowezokuhamba koluntu. Ukuqedwa kwezixhumanisi zokuphotha umthetho. Ulwazi ngokuhlola izimoto kanye nokumbathwa kwezimoto. Ulwazi ngomthetho wezinsimbi zokudubula kanye namanani 60/100. Ulwazi ngemihlahlandlela yomnyango yokulawula ukugqamisa kanye nemisebenzi yokuqaphela (Incwadi yesandla Yokuthutha) 11.
