zu.duties: Ukuphotha umthetho wezokuthutha emgwaqeni, wezokuhamba kwabagibeli koluntu kanye no wokuthutha: Ukuphotha imigidingo ekuchazwe nasekuqashiwe yokuphotha umthetho. Ukunquma ukuzulazula kwemithetho okukhululekile ngokuphotha amaphoyinti kanye nokuqapha ukusula ukuba khona kwezimoto. Ukulungisa imigidingo nokuqamba izindawo ezenzeke ngalo, nokuchaza nokubika ukubhalisa izindawo ezingase zibe yingozi kubaphathi. Ukungenelela kumigidingo yokuqapha imithetho yasemgwaqeni nakumsebenzi wokuqhwaba isivinini. Ukunikeza izaziso nokubamba abantu ngaphansi kumthetho, imiyalo kanye nemigidingo, nokubukela izinkundla zamacala nokunika ubufakazi. Ukuqapha okungajwayelekile izimoto kanye nokuthwala noma okulayisha ukuze kusiqiniseke ukuthi kuhamba kuyafeza nokulungisa ukulawula ngokugqamisa (okuhlanganisa izimpahla nabagibeli). Ukuhlola amalayisensi abashayeli kanye nezimoto nokulawula ukuziphatha emakhomishini okuhlolwa amalayisensi (DLTC) nasemayunithi okuhlola Izimoto (VTS): Ukuqamba imiholo yokuhlola amalayisensi yokushayela nokulayisensi. (ii) Ukuhlola ukuthi isimoto ifanele ukushayelwa emgwaqeni. Ukulawula ukuziphatha kwi-DLTC nakwi-VTS. Ukunikeza ukulawula okubonakalayo nokuqapha umthetho, nokukhuthaza noma ukuqinisekisa imigidingo yokuthinta inyanga yokwenza ubugebengu: Ukusiza ekwelulekeni ukubona okubonakalayo kwesiteshi sokuqapha ngokusiza abashayeli bavikelwe futhi ngokwenza imisebenzi yokuphotha. Ukwenzela imigidingo yokuqapha umthetho. Ukuhlola izindawo eziqashiwe emgwaqeni nokuxwayisa abashayeli ngendawo ezingase zibe yingozi (isb. Izinto ezingcolile ezibonakala emgwaqeni, ukuphela kwezimoto). Ukuqedwa komsebenzi wokubhala nemicimbi ehlobene nabo: ukugcina izinqubo ezilungele ukusetshenziswa kwezohlelo. Ukuhambisana nomthetho wokuqamba nokuqedwa 60/2000. Ukuhambisana nemigidingo ekuhlelwe kumuhlelo wokuqamba nokuqedwa. Ukungenelela kumuhlelo wokuqamba abantu abaningi. Ukukhuthaza kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zikwazi ukuhamba koluntu kuyasebenza kahle. Ukugcina isithombe esihle seminyango: Ukuphotha umthetho ngokuthutha.

xh.title: Iphondo leMexico
xh.summary: Umqobo wenginga ejoliswe ekuphuculeni uluntu nakumanethi wezazimalu zoluntu eMexico. Ukuqinisekisa kwentela eqinisekileyo kubakho na kwiintsuku ezingomfunda namathuba alinganayo namava aqinisekileyo kulwazi lokugqithisa okukhethwe ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezikumgangatho.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seMatric kunye neDiploma yomsebenzi weTraffic kwaye ulawule igunya lokutyala elisebenzayo, ubuncinane ikhowudi B. 01 yeminyaka yamava obugqithiseyo ekusebenziseni umthetho wezokuhamba. Akukho ntlaveko zokungalawuleki okanye icala elingaphandle kwakho. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulawulo oluhle lwerekhodi nezibonelelo. Amakhono amahle okulawula ubudlelwane namakhasimende. Ulwazi nakuqonda iinkqubo neendlela zomthetho wezokuhamba kumazwe angaphandle nasesixekweni kwaye kubakho nolwazi lokugqitha okukhethwe. Ukugqitha amaxwebhu okusebenza ngokumthetho okubekweyo. Ulwazi lokuponononga izithuthi nokuthatha iindawo ezithintekileyo ngokomthetho. Ulwazi ngoMthetho wezikhali namabala eFires and Ammunition 60/100. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zesebe ngokulawula nokuhamba nabakhokheli (Transport Handbook) 11. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngamandla. Amakhono amahle okuhlola. Amakhono amahle okushuka kunye nobuchule bokucinga. Amakhono amahle okuziphatha nokubakhulisa, kunye nobuchule bokulunga izinkxwaleko. Amakhono amahle okuzithetha ngeentsingiselo nakubakho ubuchule bokubhala kwilwimi ezimbini nangaphezulu ezisemthethweni zoluntu.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa umthetho wezokuhamba, wezokuhamba abagibeli bolic, kunye nowoluntu hamba nabagqibeli: Zenza izicwangciso ezicwangqiswayo, kwakunye nezicwangciso ezivunyiweyo zokugqithisa umthetho wezokuhamba ezingakhoyo. Qinisekisa isikhathi sokuhamba ngokukhululekileyo kwiindawo ezinamandla kubukho bokuhamba. Hlela izicwangciso zezenzo zeTraffic project ukubakho koluntu nabakho ngokuqinisekiswa iindlela ezothuka ngokubalulekileyo ezakwenza. Zonke iimpawu zokuhamba ngokushuka nabasebenzi bemithetho. Thumela iindleko ezithunyelwa kumthetho, izimvo nokuziphatha kumthetho, ukuya kwindawo yokugqitha kwesigqibo sezithuthi nokuzisa ukuba kwetyala ngokukhetha kakhulu iinkxwaleko (kubandakanya imithwalo kwaye kubakho abagibeli). Hlola amatikiti abagibeli nokuzinza iindleko zeMoto kwaza kubakho isilumkiso sokungakhathali kwindawo yokuhlola iindleko zabagibeli (DLTC) nasezindaweni zokuqhobosha iindleko zezithuthi (VTS). Hlola amatikiti nokuzinza kwelungelo lokugqitha iindleko zemoto. Qwalasela isilumkiso seDLTC kunye neVTS. Nikela ngokubonakalayo ukulawula okanye ukupolisa iTraffic nakwindawo yokukhuthaza nokuqinisekisa ukuthintela okanye ukusilela. Nceda nikela ngokubakho kwakho ukubakho ngokubakho kwabasebenzi bakaMthetho weTraffic, kubandakanya ukubakhokhela iinkxwaleko zokuthumela iindleko. Zonke iinkxwaleko ezithileyo nakwizindawo ezizeleyo ukubakho kwindawo yokutshaya iinkxwaleko ezizeleyo, nangaphezulu iinkxwaleko eziphose (izithuthi ezingazange zisilele kwiindleko ezothuka). Qwalasela zonke izigqibo ezinkqubo nasezenzweni ezilawulwayo: kubakho inkqubo nembuyekezo yokusebenzela iinkqubo ezithileyo nangaphezulu iinkxwaleko ezizeleyo kwindawo. Ukusebenza ngokomthetho nangokwemithetho yokusebenza ngokomthetho wokuza kwindawo yaba neklayimisho yamabala eFires and Ammunition Act 60/2000. Ukusebenza ngokwemithetho yokukhuthaza ukusebenzisa iinkqubo ezithileyo ezizeleyo. Zinikelele kubakho kwabasebenzi nabakho ngokubakho kwemithetho yamakhono abantu. Khuthaza ukubakho kokusebenza kakuhle nangamandla kubakho abakhokhelwa. Phucula umboniso wokubakho kwentsika yoluntu kumthetho wokugqithisa iindleko ezizeleyo.

jobs.title: Provincial Inspector
jobs.salary_text: R280 278 per annum, plus service benefits
jobs.summary: Provincial Inspector enforcing road traffic and public transport legislation in Merafong, requiring a Traffic Officer's Diploma, driver's licence and one year's experience.
jobs.requirements: Matric Certificate plus Traffic Officer's Diploma and a valid driver’s license, at least a code B. 01 year of practical experience in traffic law enforcement. No criminal record or case pending against you. Knowledge and Skills: Good record and resource management. Good customer relationship management abilities. Knowledge and understanding of road traffic and public transport policies and regulations. Completion of law enforcement documents. Knowledge of vehicle inspections and vehicle impoundment. Knowledge of the Firearms and Ammunition Act 60/100. Knowledge of departmental guidelines on overload control and escort duties (Transport Handbook) 11. Ability to work under pressure. Good observation skills. Good driving and negations skills. Sound interpersonal and conflict resolution skills. Good written and verbal communication skills in at least two of the provincial official languages.
jobs.duties: Enforce Road Traffic, Public Passenger and Transport Legislation: Implement planned and approved traffic law enforcement activities. Ensure the free flow of traffic through point duty and traffic control at congested areas. Coordinate activities at and safeguard accident scenes, identify and advise management on hazardous locations. Participate in traffic policing projects and speed testing operations. Issue notices and execute arrests under relevant Acts, directives and procedures and attend court proceedings and give evidence. Escort abnormal vehicles and loads to ensure safe movement thereof and coordinate overload control management (including goods and passengers). Examine Drivers' Licences and Motor Vehicles and monitor compliance at Driver License Testing Centres (DLTC) and Vehicle Testing Stations (VTS): Conduct learner and driver license tests. (ii) Conduct roadworthy tests. Monitor compliance of DLTC and VTS. Provide visible Traffic Control/Policing and promote/ensure crime prevention activities: Assist in planning visible traffic policing by assisting motorists and executing escort duties. Participate in roadblocks and/or special law enforcement operations. Patrol roads in dedicated areas and warn motorists at hazardous locations (i.e., damaged road surfaces, breakdown of vehicles). Perform all administrative activities and related duties: maintain effective administrative procedures. Compliance with the Firearm and Ammunition Act 60/2000. Compliance with activities as outlined in the operational plans. Participate in Human Resource Development Programs. Promote effective and efficient service delivery to clients. Maintain a professional corporate image of the Directorate: Traffic Law Enforcement.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. Tshidiso Chabane/ Ms. Dolly Seboane/ Tlalane Koenane Tel No: (011) 689 3845/ 3723/ 3847
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on new Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za/documents (effective from 01 January 2021). All fields in Part A to D of the Z83 form must be completed, and Part E to G noting that there is limited space provided applicants often indicate “refer” to CV or see attached, this is acceptable as long as the CV is attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. The question related to the conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered. Declaration must be completed and signed. The fully completed and signed new Z83 form should be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV only (only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications). Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applicants who do not comply with the above requirements, as well as late applications, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Suitable candidates will undergo a personnel suitability check (Vetting, criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification, and employment verification). The Department of Community Safety reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes. Candidate will be placed according to corridor coordination and the Department’s needs. The Department will not accept posted, emailed or hand delivered applications. We encourage youth, people with disability, coloured, Indian and white to apply and a confirmation of disabilities from a registered medical practitioner must be attached to the application. Please Note: Due to the large number of applications, we envisage to receive, applications will not be acknowledged. If you do not receive any response within 3 months, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Provinsiale Inspekteur
af.summary: Provinsiale Inspekteur wat padverkeers- en openbarevervoerwetgewing in Merafong handhaaf, waarvoor 'n Verkeersbeampte-diploma, 'n bestuurslisensie en een jaar se ondervinding vereis word.
af.requirements: Matrieksertifikaat plus 'n Verkeersbeampte-diploma en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie, ten minste 'n kode B. 01 jaar se praktiese ondervinding in verkeerswetstoepassing. Geen strafblad of hangende saak teen u nie. Kennis en Vaardighede: Goeie rekord- en hulpbronbestuur. Goeie vermoëns ten opsigte van kliëntverhoudingsbestuur. Kennis en begrip van padverkeers- en openbarevervoerbeleid en -regulasies. Invul van wetstoepassingsdokumente. Kennis van voertuiginspeksies en voertuiginbeslagname. Kennis van die Wet op Vuurwapens en Ammunisie 60/100. Kennis van departementele riglyne oor oorladingsbeheer en eskordpligte (Vervoerhandboek) 11. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Goeie waarnemingsvaardighede. Goeie bestuurs- en onderhandelingsvaardighede. Sterke interpersoonlike en konflikoplossingsvaardighede. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede in ten minste twee van die provinsiale amptelike tale.
af.duties: Handhaaf padverkeers-, openbare passasiers- en vervoerwetgewing: Implementeer beplande en goedgekeurde verkeerswetstoepassingsaktiwiteite. Verseker die vrye verkeersvloei deur puntbeheer en verkeersbeheer by gekoöpteerde gebiede. Koördineer aktiwiteite by en beveilig ongelukstonele, identifiseer en adviseer bestuur oor gevaarlike plekke. Neem deel aan verkeerspolisiesprojekte en spoedtoetsoperasies. Reeëls kennisgewings uit en voer arrestasies uit ingevolge tersaaklike Wette, riglyne en prosedures en woong geregsverrigtinge by en lewer getuienis. Eskordeer abnormale voertuie en vragte om veilige beweging daarvan te verseker en koördineer oorladingsbeheerbestuur (insluitend goedere en passasiers). Ondersoek bestuurderslisensies en gemotoriseerde voertuie en monitor nakoming by Bestuurderslisensietoetssentra (DLTC) en Voertuigtoetstasies (VTS): Voer leerling- en bestuurderslisensietoetse uit. (ii) Voer padvatbaarheidstoetse uit. Monitor nakoming van DLTC en VTS. Verskaf sigbare verkeersbeheer/polisiëring en bevorder/verseker misdaadvoorkomingsaktiwiteite: Help met die beplanning van sigbare verkeerspolisiëring deur motoriste by te staan en eskordpligte uit te voer. Neem deel aan padblokke en/of spesiale wetstoepassingsoperasies. Patroller paaie in toegewyde gebiede en waarsku motoriste by gevaarlike plekke (d.i., beskadigde padoppervlakke, voertuigmeganiese Probleme). Voer alle administratiewe aktiwiteite en verwante pligte uit: Onderhou doeltreffende administratiewe prosedures. Nakoming van die Wet op Vuurwapens en Ammunisie 60/2000. Nakoming van aktiwiteite soos uiteengesit in die operasionele planne. Neem deel aan Menslikehulpbronontwikkelingsprogramme. Bevorder doeltreffende en doelmatige dienslewering aan kliënte. Handhaaf 'n professionele korporatiewe beeld van die Direktoraat: Verkeerswetstoepassing.

zu.title: Isiphathimandla Sesifundazwe
zu.summary: Isiphathimandla Sesi-fundazwe esiphoqa umthetho wezokuthutha kwemigwaqo kanye nowezokuhamba kwabantu emphakathini e Merafong, esidinga i-Diploma Yesiphathimandla Sezokuthutha, ilayisense yokushayela kanye nokuhlangabezwa unyaka munye wamashemu.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Matric kanye ne-Diploma Yesiphathimandla Sezokuthutha kanye nelalayisense yokushayela esevisayo, okungenani ikhodi B. 01 unyaka wamashemu oqobo ekuphotheni umthetho wezokuthutha. Akukho bhalo lezosenzo noma ikhalo elindele uwena. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ukuphathwa okuhle kwezinkomba nezinsiza. Amakhono okuphatha kahle ubudlelwano bathi abathengi. Ulwazi nokuqonda imigomo nemithetho yokuhamba kwemigwaqo kanye nayo yohamba kwabantu emphakathini. Ukuqedwa kwemibhalo yomsebenzi wokuphotha umthetho. Ulwazi ngokuqamba izimoto kanye nokuvinjelwa kwezimoto. Ulwazi ngoMthetho Wezikhali Namasotho 60/100. Ulwazi ngemihlahlandlela yomnyango mayelana nokulawula ukugqamisa kanye nemisebenzi yokuhambisa (Transport Handbook) 11. Isikhono sokusebenza ngaphansi kwenkulu. Amakhono okuhlola okuhle. Amakhono okushayela nokuxoxisana ahle. Amakhono okuzwana nabantu nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono okuxhumana okuhle okubhalwayo nokukhulwayo okungenani kulezinye izilimi ezivela ezinhlanganweni zomthetho wesifundazwe.
zu.duties: Kuphothwe Umthetho Wokuhamba Kwemigwaqo, Wabahambi Abadlula Nabezohamba: Kuqaliswe imisebenzi ekucashuniwe futhi evunyiwe yokuphotha umthetho wezokuthutha. Kuqinisekiswe ukuhamba ngokukhululeka kwethrekhi ngokusebenza emihlobanweni nasekubuseni izimoto. Kuhlelwe imisebenzi ezenzakalelweni yeziholelo, zibonwe futhi zinikwe izeluleko abaphathi izindawo eyingozini. Kubambe iqhaza kumaphrojekthi okuphathwa kwezokuthutha nasemisebenzini yokuhlolwa kwi-aveji. Kukhishwe izaziso kanye nokubanjwa ngaphansi komthetho, imiyalelo kanye ne makuhlelwa, uhhambe enkundleni ukunikela ubufakazi. Kuhambiswe ngezimoto ezingajwayelekile futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuhamba ngokuphepha kwalezi nthambo, kanti futhi kuhlelwe ukulawula ukuvinjelwa nangokugqamisa (kufaka phakathi izimpahla nezihambi). Kuhlolwe Amalayisense Abashayeli Nemoto: Kuhlolwe alayisense abashayeli kanye nemoto. Kwenziwe izivivinyo zamalayisense abafundi nabama-shayeli. (ii) Kwenziwe izivivinyo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi imoto ifanele ukuyiwa esigungwini. Kuboniswe ukuzinza kwe-DLTC ne-VTS. Kubonakalise ukulawula / ukuqapha Izimoto: Kuqashe ekwenzeni usuku olubonakalayo lokulawula izimoto ngokusiza abashayeli bemoto kanye nasekwenzeni imisebenzi yokuhambisa. Kuthathwe iqhaza kwizibambo zemigwaqo futhi nasekuvakasha emisebenzini ekhethekile yokuphotha umthetho. Kugqanyiswe imigwaqo ezindaweni ezikhethiwe futhi kwexwayiswe abashayeli basendaweni ezingozini (okungukuthi, ukuphathwa kabi kwemigwaqo, ukonakala kwezimoto). Kwenziwe yonke imisebenzi yengqungqutha ephathelene nomsebenzi: kugcinwe izinqubo ezisebenzayo zengqungqutha. Kubusisane noMthetho Wezikhali Namasotho 60/2000. Kubusisane nemisebenzi njengoba kuchaziwe kumaphule wokuqasha. Kubandakanywe kumaphule Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamandla Abantu. Kubuyekezwe ukubuyekelwa ngokusebenziseka kwabasebenzisi. Kugcinwe isithombe esisha esihle se-Directorate: Traffic Law Enforcement.

xh.title: Iprovincial Inspector
xh.summary: Iprovincial Inspector ephoza umthetho wothutho nolawulo lokuthuthwa kwabantu babantu kwi-Merafong, ifuna i-Diploma yokuQhweshebekekileyo, ilayisensi yokushayela kunye neminyaka elinye yamava okusebenzayo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seMatric negeli Diploma kaQhweshebekekileyo loThutho nelayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo, ubuncinane ikhowudi B. 01 yeminyaka yamava okusebenzayo ekuphoyiseni umthetho wethutho. Akukho nchenzo yobugcisa okanye isigwegwe esikwingxaki ngawe. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulawulo oluhle kwiirekhodi nemicimbi. Amakhono amahlulahhulu aphambili wolawulo loludwe ngabathengi. Ulwazi nokuqonda kweenqobo zemithetho yothutho nokuthuthwa kwabantu babantu nakomithetho wolawulo. Ukuqedwa kwamaxwebhu okuphoyisa umthetho. Ulwazi ngokuhlola izithuthi nokuthotywa kwesithuthi. Ulwazi ngoMthetho weSixhobo sokuBetha noMlingo 60/100. Ulwazi ngeengqungquthela zesebe ngolawulo lokugqithisa umthwalo namaxwebhu okuthunyelwa (iHadi yokuThutha) 11. Amandla okusebenza phantsi koxinzelelo. Amakhono amahlulahhulu aphambili wolawulo loludwe ngabathengi. Amakhono amahle okuqaphela. Amakhono amahle okushayela nokuxabela. Amakhono apheleleyo obuntu bomntu noyilwano lweengxabano. Amakhono amahle okubhala nokuethulwa ngemile ngolwimi kubuncinane kwabini balwimi lukarhulumente.
xh.duties: Phonza iMithetho yeNqanaba loMzila, yoMthwali woLuntu woNogada nokuThutha: Zisa ukusebenza okucwangcisiweyo nokuqinisekisiweyo kokuphoyisa umthetho wokuhamba kwethutho. Qinisekisa ukuhamba mahhle kwethutho ngokwenza umsebenzi wokuqonda nokulawula ithutho kwiindawo ezixakekileyo. Lungisa imisebenzi kwaye uvikele iindawo ezibethwe ngengozi, uchaze kanjalo uzamkele ngolwazi abaphathi ngeendawo eyingozi. Thabatha inxaxheba kwiiprojekthi zokuphoyisa ithutho nasekuhlolweni isantya. Yala iisaziso uze wenze izibambelo ngaphantsi kweMithetho, imiyalelo nemiGangatho efanelekileyo, uze ubhuke kwiinkqubo zeenkantolo uze unikeze ubungqina. Qhuba izithuthi nemitwalo engaqhelekanga ukuqinisekisa ukuhamba kwayo khuselwayo, ulungise kanjalo ulawulo lokulawula ukugqithiswa komthwalo (kuquka imithwalo nabahambi). Hlola amaNqanaba oQhubi nemiVelo yamakhithi, ujonge ukuzinikela ngemithetho kwiZiko lokuHolo lwaManqanaba oQhubi (DLTC) nakwiZiko lokuHolo lweeVelo (VTS): Qhuba ukuholwa kwabaQambi bethutho nabaQhubi. (ii) Qhuba iinhlolvo zokuqinisekisa ukufanelela kwemithetho yendlela. Jonga ukuzinikela ngemithetho kwe-DLTC naku-VTS. Yonke amanye amasebe aze abonakale oluLawulo loPhoyisa nokuKhuthaza/uQinisekisa imisebenzi yokuthintela ubugcisa: Nceda ukucwangcisa ukubonakala kolawulo loQhubi ngokuncedisa abaqhubi bemithutho nokwenza imisebenzi yoQhuba. Thabatha inxaxheba kumathuba okuvala umgama nakwezinye iinkqubo ezingaqhelekanga zokuphoyisa umthetho. Zulula iindlela kwiindawo ezichaziweyo uze uxhase abaqhubi bemithutho kwiindawo ezingozi (o.k.t., iindawo ezonakeleyo zemithetho yomzila, ukuqhawuka kwesithuthi). Yenza yonke imisebenzi yolawulo neminye efanayo: gcina iinkqubo ezisebenzayo zolawulo. Ukuzinikela ngeMithetho yeSixhobo sokuBetha noMlingo 60/2000. Ukuzinikela ngemisebenzi njengoko kuchaziwe kwiiplani zokuSebenza. Thabatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zoPhuhliso loLuntu/zeSebe. Khuthaza ukuphuhliswa kweenkonzo ezisebenzayo nasebenzayo kubaxhamli. Gcina isicwangciso soBume begunya elithembekileyo: uLawulo loPhoyisa loMthetho wokuHamba.

zu.summary: Inkombuzo Yesifunda egunyaza umthetho wezokuthutha kwegula kanye nomthetho wokuthutha kwabantu emphakathini wakwa-Merafong, edinga i-Diploma yekaMphathi Wezokuthutha kanye nokuthi uthole unyaka oyedwa wemfundo egunyaza umthetho wezokuthutha.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Matric kanye ne-Diploma yekaMphathi Wezokuthutha nelayisenseyokushayela okusemthethweni, okungenani ikhodi B. 01 unyaka wemfundo eqobo egunyaza umthetho wezokuthutha. Ukuqedwa kwamadokhumenti egunyaza umthetho. Ulwazi ngokushekelwa kwezimoto kanye nokuthi izimoto zithathwe ngamaphoyisa. Ulwazi ngomthetho Wezinsimbi Zokudubula kanye Namasotsha i-Act 60/100. Ulwazi ngezigaba zomnyango ezingabhekwa ngokulawula ukushaja okwedlula kanye nemisebenzi yokuqaphela (Transport Handbook) 11. Amandla okusebenza ngaphansi komunyuza. Amandla okuqapha okuhle. Amandla okushayela kanye nokuqondana okuhle. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono okubhala nokukhuluma kahle okungenani kolunyaku oluhlukene lwezilimi ezisemthethweni sesifunda.
zu.duties: Gxumela umthetho Wezokuthutha, Wokuthutha Kwabagibeli Nomphakathi: Ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi ehleliwe neyekeviwe yokugunyaza umthetho wezokuthutha. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhamba kahle izokuthutha ngokuqashwa emagunyazweni kanye nokulawula ukungahambi kahle kwezimoto. Hlela imisebenzi emgceni wokushona, phawula futhi ukhombe abaphathi ngendawo eyingozi. Thatha inxaxheba emikhakweni yezomthetho wezokuthutha nakumayelana nezinhlelo zokuhlola isivinini. Yazisa izaziso bese iphoqa ukuboshwa ngaphansi kwezinto ezithile, imiyalo kanye namaqiniso okwenza okukhoyo futhi uphume emacaleni ukuze unike ithuba lokubeka iqiniso. Qaphela izimoto ezihamba kabi nezithwalweni ukuze kusuke kuhamba okuphephile futhi uhlela ukulawula ukushaja okwedlula (okuhlanganisa izimpahla kanye nabagibeli). Hlola Ama-Layisense Abashayeli Nezimoto futhi uqaphele ukuziphendukela ema-Driver License Testing Centres (DLTC) nama-Vehicle Testing Stations (VTS): Yenza ukuhlolwa kwabafundi kanye nalabo abanamalayisense abashayeli. Yenza imithetho yokuqinisekisa ukuthi izimoto zifanelekile ukuzihamba. Qaphele ukuziphendukela kwe-DLTC nama-VTS. Nikeza ukulawula kwesikhashana/Ukuphatha izokuthutha bese ukhuthaza/qinisekisa imisebenzi yokuvikela ubugoola: Siza ekupheni ukubonakala komthetho wezokuthutha ngokusiza abashayeli kanye nokwenza imisebenzi yokubafundisa. Thatha inxaxheba emabhlokweni kanye nasemikhakheni ekhethe ukugunyaza umthetho. Phephazela emgwaceni wendawo oyidalelo bese ukhombisa abashayeli ngendawo eyingozi (okungukuthi, izinkalo ezonakele, ukuwohloka kwamathayara). Yenza yonke imisebenzi yokuphatha kanye nabalawule kulayini: Hlala eduze nemigomo yokuqinisekisa ukulawula kahle ukuphathwa komnyango. Gxumela emthethweni wokuphathwa kwamadokhumenti e-Firearm and Ammunition Act 60/2000. Gxumela emisebenzini enike imiqondo yesi-thutha phansi. Thatha inxaxheba kuhlelo Lokuqaliswa Kolwazi Leminyuzi. Khuthaza ukulethwa kwenkonzo ephumelelayo kuhlakaniphile kubathengi. Londoloza isithombe sethemba elihle lenhlangano yolawulo: Ukugunyaza umthetho Wezokuthutha.

jobs.salary_text: R280 278 per annum, plus service benefits
jobs.summary: Provincial Inspector enforcing road traffic and public transport legislation across Gauteng freeways, requiring a Traffic Officer's Diploma, matric and a valid driver's licence.
jobs.requirements: Matric Certificate plus Traffic Officer's Diploma and a valid driver’s license, at least a code B. 01 year of practical experience in traffic law enforcement. No criminal record or case pending against you. Knowledge and Skills: Good record and resource management. Good customer relationship management abilities. Knowledge and understanding of road traffic and public transport policies and regulations. Completion of law enforcement documents. Knowledge of vehicle inspections and vehicle impoundment. Knowledge of the Firearms and Ammunition Act 60/100. Knowledge of departmental guidelines on overload control and escort duties (Transport Handbook) 11. Ability to work under pressure. Good observation skills. Good driving and negations skills. Sound interpersonal and conflict resolution skills. Good written and verbal communication skills in at least two of the provincial official languages.
jobs.duties: Enforce Road Traffic, Public Passenger and Transport Legislation: Implement planned and approved traffic law enforcement activities. Ensure the free flow of traffic through point duty and traffic control at congested areas. Coordinate activities at and safeguard accident scenes, identify and advise management on hazardous locations. Participate in traffic policing projects and speed testing operations. Issue notices and execute arrests under relevant Acts, directives and procedures and attend court proceedings and give evidence. Escort abnormal vehicles and loads to ensure safe movement thereof and coordinate overload control management (including goods and passengers). Examine Drivers' Licences and Motor Vehicles and monitor compliance at Driver License Testing Centres (DLTC) and Vehicle Testing Stations (VTS): Conduct learner and driver license tests. (ii) Conduct roadworthy tests. Monitor compliance of DLTC and VTS. Provide visible Traffic Control/Policing and promote/ensure crime prevention activities: Assist in planning visible traffic policing by assisting motorists and executing escort duties. Participate in roadblocks and/or special law enforcement operations. Patrol roads in dedicated areas and warn motorists at hazardous locations (i.e., damaged road surfaces, breakdown of vehicles). Perform all administrative activities and related duties: maintain effective administrative procedures. Compliance with the Firearm and Ammunition Act 60/2000. Compliance with activities as outlined in the operational plans. Participate in Human Resource Development Programs. Promote effective and efficient service delivery to clients. Maintain a professional corporate image of the Directorate: Traffic Law Enforcement.

zu.title: Isiphathi sawonke
zu.summary: Isiphathi sawonke esiphoqa umthetho wezokuthutha ezindleleni nokuthutha kwabantu emphakathini kumagwebu e-Gauteng, esidinga i-Diploma yesebe lezokuthutha, ibhodi lematrikhi nefayizi yokuqasha ibhayisikili.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi sematrikhi kanye ne-Diploma yesebe lezokuthutha kanye nefayizi yokuqasha ibhayisikili esemthethweni, okungenani ikhodi B. 01 unyaka wokuhlolwa okusebenzayo ekuphoqeni umthetho wezokuthutha. Kungabi norekhodi lokweba noma inkelo ephathwe ngawe. Ulwazi nobuso: Buphiqangolwazi bokuphatha izibhalo kanye nezinsiza. Buphiqangolwazi bokuphatha ubuhlobo nabathengi. Ulwaziokuqonda izinqubomgomo nezimiso zezokuthutha ezindleleni nakuthutheni kwabantu emphakathini. Ukuqedakemibhalo yokuqhwaba umthetho. Ulwazi ngokuqashwa kwezimoto nokuqashwa kwento ngaphandle komthetho. Ulwazi ngomthetho Wezikhali Nezibhamu 60/100. Ulwazi ngezindlela zomnyango zokulawula ukugcwala kwezinto kanye nemisebenzi yokuhambisa (Incwadi yesandla yezokuthutha) 11. Ukuba nokwazi ukusebenza ngaphezulu kokuhlukunyezwa. Ubuhle bokubukeleka okuhle. Ubuhle bokushayela kanye nobuso bokuxoxisana. Ubuhle obuhle bokuxhumana nabantu kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ubuhle obuhle bokubhala nokukhuluma okungenani kwezilimi ezimbili ezisemthethweni zesifundazwe.
zu.duties: Phoqumthetho Wezokuthutha Ezindleleni, Nabagibeli Basesiphathimthetho Nakuthutheni Kwabantu Emphakathini: Qalisa izenzo zokuqhwaba umthetho ezokuthutha ezindleleni ezicushiwe kanye nezokugunyazwa. Qinisekisa ukugeleza okukhululekile kwezokuthutha ngokusebenza kwesikhundla nokulawula izokuthutha ezindaweni eziyize. Hlela imisebenzi esezindaweni sezenzekile futhi uvikele, ubone futhi umhlanganyise nomphathi ngezindawo eziyingozi. Thatha inhlalo kumaphrojekthi wezokuthutha ezindleleni kanye nokuhlolwa isivinini. Khishaisaziso futhi ugenise ukuboshwa ngaphansi komthetho ohlobene, izinkomba kanye nezindlela futhi uzobambe iqhaza ezenzakalweni zinkantolo futhi unike umbhalo. Hambisa imoto kanye nezinto ezingajwayelekile ukuqinisekisa ukunyakaza okuphephile futhi uhlele ukulawulwa kokugcwala kwezinto (okuhlanganisa izimpahla kanye nabagibeli). Hlola Amafayizi Abashayeli Kwezimoto Bese ulawula ukulandelwa komthetho Kuma-Centre Okuholayo Amafayizi Abashayeli (DLTC) Nakumasiteshi Okuholayo Izimoto (VTS): Qalisa ukuholwa kwabafundi namafayizi abashayeli. I-(ii) Qalisaukuholwa kokulungele isidlavini endleleni. Lawula ukulandelwa komthetho kuma-DLTC nakuma-VTS. Nikeza ukulawula Izokuthutha Ezindleleni Okubonakalayo Kanye Nokuqhwaba futhi/okugqugquzela/qinisekisa izenzo zokuthintela iningi: Siza ekwenzeni isu sokubona ukuthutha ngokusiza abashayeli bekhaya futhi ngokwenza imisebenzi yokuhambisa. Thatha inhlaloemibhoshongweni kanye/noma ezinkundleni eziqhwaba umthetho. Hamba endleleni ezindaweni ezikhethiwe futhi uxwayise abashayeli bezindawo eziyingozi (okungukuthi, endaweni ephukile yendlu, ukuqhwama kwezimoto). Yenza yonke imisebenzi yasebhalasi nakunye okuhlobene nayo: gcina izindlela eziphumelelayo zokuphatha ibhalasi. Ukulandelakomthetho Wezikhali Nezibhamu 60/2000. Ukulandelwa kwezenzo ezihlobene nezinkomba ezinkundleni zomsebenzi. Thatha inhlalo kwamaphrojekthi okukhuliswa Izinsiza zabantu. Ukuthuthukiswa kwesevisi ephumelelayo futhi esebenzayo kubathengi. Gcina isithombe esikhulu esiphephile nechwe sibonakalayo seqophamlando: Ukuthutha komthetho ezindleleni.

Qinisekisa imoto obugqithileyo nemiqlu yazo inyuselela inokuHamba ngokhuseleko naseKulawula iQhalobu (okubandakanya imiqulu kunye noqhamatho). Yongeza iilayisenisi zobakheniyo nayemoto eye kwiziko lokuvavanya iilayisenisi (DLTC) nakumashishini okukhupha imoto ukuqinisekisa amabali: Xelela abadisiyo kunye nobabheniyo bazakuphanda imoto. (ii) Yenze ukuvavanywa kububini bento barhwabo nayegweni. Qgibe ngokubonakala KolwaboKolwane kolwabis. Xela konke kwizingxoxo ezivela kwiKhathli yiNkunduNendi yoMahla-nye yokulawula imoto kund mye-U4: Khaq' isol' ebil 'kwatrhweb eNde, luphand' imit' Holo (Kokush' ekal iNgceKU emny' INgunu nabaKhaman. Umimo imiXusha loQwab' ikhal' ukwakha kwind' ecime' aBantu beNso in iBhah' ak' iSweli. iNgan.

jobs.salary_text: R280 278 per annum, plus service benefits
jobs.summary: Provincial Inspector needed at the Saturation Unit in Gauteng to enforce road traffic and public transport legislation, requiring a Traffic Officer's Diploma and one year of experience.
jobs.requirements: Matric Certificate plus Traffic Officer's Diploma and a valid driver’s license, at least a code B. 01 year of practical experience in traffic law enforcement. No criminal record or case pending against you. Knowledge and Skills: Good record and resource management. Good customer relationship management abilities. Knowledge and understanding of road traffic and public transport policies and regulations. Completion of law enforcement documents. Knowledge of vehicle inspections and vehicle impoundment. Knowledge of the Firearms and Ammunition Act 60/100. Knowledge of departmental guidelines on overload control and escort duties (Transport Handbook) 11. Ability to work under pressure. Good observation skills. Good driving and negations skills. Sound interpersonal and conflict resolution skills. Good written and verbal communication skills in at least two of the provincial official languages.

Ensure the free flow of traffic through point duty and traffic control at congested areas. Coordinate activities at and safeguard accident scenes, identify and advise management on hazardous locations. Participate in traffic policing projects and speed testing operations. Issue notices and execute arrests under relevant Acts, directives and procedures and attend court proceedings and give evidence. Escort abnormal vehicles and loads to ensure safe movement thereof and coordinate overload control management (including goods and passengers). Examine Drivers' Licences and Motor Vehicles and monitor compliance at Driver License Testing Centres (DLTC) and Vehicle Testing Stations (VTS): Conduct learner and driver license tests. Participate in roadblocks and/or special law enforcement operations. Patrol roads in dedicated areas and warn motorists at hazardous locations (i.e., damaged road surfaces, breakdown of vehicles). Perform all administrative activities and related duties: maintain effective administrative procedures. Compliance with the Firearm and Ammunition Act 60/2000. Compliance with activities as outlined in the operational plans. Participate in Human Resource Development Programs. Promote effective and efficient service delivery to clients. Maintain a professional corporate image of the Directorate: Traffic Law Enforcement.

af.title: Provinsiale Inspekteur
af.summary: Provinsiale Inspekteur benodig by die Versadigingseenheid in Gauteng om padverkeer- en openbare vervoerwetgewing af te dwing, met 'n Verkeersbeampte-diploma en een jaar se ervaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: Matrik-sertifikaat plus 'n Verkeersbeampte-diploma en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie, ten minste 'n kode B. 01 jaar se praktiese ervaring in verkeerswetstoepassing. Geen strafrekord of hangende saak teen u nie. Kennis en Vaardighede: Goede rekord- en hulpbronbestuur. Goeie vermoëns vir kliëntverhoudingsbestuur. Kennis en begrip van padverkeer- en openbare vervoerbeleide en -regulasies. Voltooiing van wetstoepassingsdokumente. Kennis van voertuiginspeksies en voertuigbeslaglegging. Kennis van die Vuurwapens en Ammunisiewet 60/100. Kennis van departementele riglyne oor oorlaai-beheer en geleidedienspligte (Vervoerhandleiding) 11. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Goeie waarnemingsvaardighede. Goeie bestuurs- en onderhandelingsvaardighede. Sterk interpersoonlike en konflikoplossingsvaardighede. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede in ten minste twee van die provinsiale amptelike tale.
af.duties: Handhaaf Padverkeer-, Openbare Passasiers- en Vervoerwetgewing: Implementeer beplande en goedgekeurde verkeerswetstoepassingsaktiwiteite. Verseker die vrye vloei van verkeer deur puntbeheer en verkeersbeheer by besoekte areas. Koördineer aktiwiteite by en beskerm ongelukstonele, identifiseer en adviseer bestuur oor gevaarlike plekke. Neem deel aan verkeerspolisieprojekte en spoedtoetsoperasies. Uit kennigewings en voer arrestasies uit onder relevante Wette, direktiewe en prosedures en woon hofverrigtinge by en lewer getuienis. Gelei abnormale voertuie en vragte om die veilige beweging daarvan te verseker en koördineer oorlaai-beheerbestuur (insluitend goedere en passasiers). Ondersoek Bestuurderslisensies en Motorvoertuie en monitor nakoming by Bestuurderslisensie-toetssentrums (DLTC) en Voertuigtoetssentrasies (VTS): Voer leerling- en bestuurderslisensietoetse uit. (ii) Voer padwaardigheidstoetse uit. Monitor nakoming van DLTC en VTS. Verskaf sigbare Verkeersbeheer/Polisering en bevorder/verseker misdaadvoorkomingsaktiwiteite: Bly met die beplanning van sigbare verkeerspolisering deur motoriste te help en geleidedienspligte uit te voer. Neem deel aan padblokke en/of spesiale wetstoepassingsoperasies. Patrouilleer paaie in toegewyde areas en waarsku motoriste by gevaarlike plekke (d.w.s. beskadigde padoppervlakke, voertuigonderbrekings). Voer alle administratiewe aktiwiteite en verwante pligte uit: handhaaf effektiewe administratiewe prosedures. Nakoming van die Vuurwapens en Ammunisiewet 60/2000. Nakoming van aktiwiteite soos uiteengesit in die operasionele planne. Neem deel aan Menslike Hulpbronontwikkelingsprogramme. Bevorder effektiewe en doeltreffende dienslewering aan kliënte. Handhaaf 'n professionele korporatiewe beeld van die Direktoraat: Verkeerswetstoepassing.

zu.title: Isiphathimandla SesiFunda
zu.summary: Kudingeka Isiphathimandla SesiFunda eSaturation Unit eGauteng ukuze kubekwe isikhashana umthetho wezokuthutha esigqwini kanye nowemithetho yezokuhamba kwabantu, kudinga i-Diploma yesiphathi sezokuthutha kanye unyaka oyedwa wamasu obuchwepheshe.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Matric esihambisana ne-Diploma yesiphathi sezokuthutha nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile, okungenani ibe yi-code B. 01 unyaka wamasu obuchwepheshe emthethweni wezokuphoqa wezokuthutha. Kungabi nalo ibhalo lokwenza cala noma icala elidalule ikho. Ulwazi nanamakhono: Uphatha kahle izinkomba kanye nezinsiza. Amakhono amahle okuphatha ubudlelwano nabathengi. Ulwazi nokuchazwa kwemithetho kahulumeni kanye nezincazelo zezokuthutha esigqwini nezokuhamba kwabantu. Ukuqedwa kwamafomu omthetho wezokuphoqa. Ulwazi ngokuhlola izimoto kanye nokuboshwa kwezimoto. Ulwazi ngomthetho wezikhali nezibhamu 60/100. Ulwazi lomnyango mayelana nokuhola ukulawula ukugcwele nokulekelela imisebenzi (Transport Handbook) 11. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwenkulu. Amakhono amahle okubuka. Amakhono amahle okushayela kanye nokuxoxisana. Amakhono aphelele okuxhumana nabantu kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono amahle okubhaliwe nokuKhuluma okungenani kwezilimi ezimbili ezisemthethweni sesifunda.
zu.duties: Phatha umthetho Wezokuthutha Ezibhakabhakeni, Abagibeli Bantu Bomphakathi kwezokuthutha: Ukwenza imisebenzi ehlelekileyokuqashiwe yokuphoqa umthetho wezokuthutha. Qinisekisa ukuthutha okukhululekile ngesikhathi sokwenza umsebenzi wokulawula ukuthutha kanye nokubeka iphoyinti lapho kunobungozi. Hlanganisa imisebenzi futhi uvikele izindawo zezikhathi zokungenwa kwezimoto, uchaze futhi ululeke abaphathi ngamakhonzomkhondo. Thatha inxaxheba kumaprojekthi ezokuthutha nokuhlolwa kwesikhathi sokushayela. Khisho izaziso futhi wenze ukuboshwa ngaphansi koMthetho othize, imiyalo kanye nemikhakha yezenzo bese uyaya ezinkantolo ukuze unikeze ubufakazi. Hambisa izimoto ezingajwayelekile namakhiwe ukuze uqinisekise ukunyakaza okuphephile futhi ulawule ukugcwele nokuhlela okubalulekile (okuhlanganisa izimpahla nabagibeli). Hlola amalayisensi abashayeli nezimoto futhi ulawule ukuziphendukela kwemithetho kumakhiye wezokuhlola amalayisensi abashayeli (DLTC) kanye nemitapo yezimoto yokuhlola (VTS): Qedela izivivinyo zamalayisensi abafundi nabashayeli. (ii) Qedela izivivinyo zokuhambelana nomthetho ohleliwe. Lawula ukuziphendukela emthethweni kwe-DLTC kanye ne-VTS. Nikeza ukulawula izokuthutha okubonakalayo/Ukuphoqisisa futhi ukhuthaze/qinisekise izenzo zokuthwala izinkohliso: Siza ekuhlelweni ukuphoqa izokuthutha okubonakalayo ngokusiza abashayeli futhi wenza imisebenzi yokulekelela. Thatha inxaxheba kumabhulokhwa wesigqwebu kanye/noma emisebenzini ekhethekileyo yokuphoqa umthetho. Hamba-hamba ezindleleni kumakhoni abekelwe ngaphansi futhi uxwayise abashayeli kumakhonzomkhondo (okungukuthi, indawo eonakeleyo yezimoto, ukuphuka kwezimoto). Yenza yonke imisebenzi yokuphatha kanye nemisebenzi ehlobene: gcina izinqubo zokuphatha eziyinhloso. Ukuthobeka komthetho wezikhali nezibhamu 60/2000. Ukuthobeka imisebenzi njengoba kuchaziwe ohlelweni lokusebenza. Thatha inxaxheba kumahlelo ezokusungula amandla abantu basebenzayo. Khuthaza ukulethwa kwenkonzo enhle kakhulu nabantu. Gcina isithombe esihle sezinhlangano se-Directorate: Traffic Law Enforcement.

xh.title: Igzemela lePhondo
xh.summary: Kufuneka igzemela lephondo kwiSaturation Unit eGauteng ukunika inkqubo amacebo omanyano wokulawula ithrafikhi yendlela noluntu lutshayela indlela, kwaye kufuneka kubekho iDiploma yekaTraffic Officer kunye neminye elikhulu yamava.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seMatric nesithi iDiploma yekaTraffic Officer nelayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo, ubuncinane icode B. 01 unyaka wamava okusebenzela inkqubo yomthetho wethrafikhi. Akukho ntlambo yonwabaLwaphulo mthetho okanye isigqebhelana sokwahlulelwa ngokuchasene nawe. Ulwazi nezakhono: Ulawulo oluhle kweerekhodi nezibonelelo. Ikhono elihle lokulawula ubudlelwane nabathengi. Ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo namacebo omanyano wethrafikhi yendlela noluntu lutshayela indlela. Ukuqedwa kwamaphepha okusebenzela umthetho. Ulwazi ngokuqwalasela izithuthi nokubeka izithuthi ngaphantsi komthetho. Ulwazi ngoMthetho weFirearms and Ammunition Act 60/100. Ulwazi ngeNkqubo yesebe ngokulawula ukugqithisa kwezithuthi namaxwebhu okusingathwa (Transport Handbook) 11. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Ikhono elihle lokuhlola. Ikhono elihle lokushayela nokuhenga. Ikhono eliqinisekileyo lokuziphatha nabantu nokuqamba iindaba. Ikhono elihle lokubhala nokuqhatha kwelinye nakwelinye iilwimi ezisemthethweni esiphongweni.
xh.duties: Ukuphumeza uMthetho weRoad Traffic, wePublic Passenger nowozoThutho: Ukusebenzisa iindalo ezicwangiweyo ezamkelekileyo zokusebenzela umthetho wethrafikhi. Kuqiniseke ukuba kukho ukuhamba kwethrafikhi ngokuzinza ngokwenza iinkonzo ezikumanqanaba kwaye kulawulwe ithrafikhi kwindawo edityaniswe ngokusilela. Ukuqamba iinkqubo kwaye kuvikelwe iindawo zonwabu lweenthuthi, ukhangelwe kwaye uxelelwe abaphathi ngozi kwendawo ezinkcapt2. Ukuthabatha inxaxheba kumaphulo eNkonzo yethrafikhi kwaye kwenziwe uvavanyo lokuqinisekisa ukusuka. Ukwaba izaziso nokuqamba iindaba ngaphantsi koMthetho, izikhokelo nolwazi lwemisebenzi, ukuzisa inkundla yokuqinisekiswa ngomthetho nokubakho iqhalo lomnyhadala nokuwa. Ukubakho iinkonzo zengxowa. Ukuthumela izithuthi ngaphezulu komthetho nezeke ezinkukhali ukulungiselela ukuba ngqo nabazali kwiimeko zokuziphatha okanye nokuba ngokomthetho ngokugqitha (ukubandakanya ukuvakalisa kunye nabantu). Ukulinganisa iLayisensi zoBaQhubi nokuqwalasela iMoto neZithuthi nokugqitha ukulawula kumaziko oQwalaselo lweLayisensi yoQhubi (DLTC) nakuwoQwalaselo weZithuthi (VTS): Ukuqhuba uvavanyo lokuqeqesha abaqeshi nabaqhubi. (ii) Ukuqhuba uvavanyo lokulungiselela imoto. Ukugqitha ukulawula iDLTC neVTS. Ukunika iNkonzo yoLawulo lweThrafikhi olubonakalayo nokukhuthaza/ukuqinisekisa ukuthintwa kokuqamba amashishini: Ukunceda ukulungiselela ukubonakala kwamapolisa ethrafikhi ngokunceda abashayeli kwaye uzenze iinkonzo zokuthumela. Ukuthabatha inxaxheba kumaziko onke noma kumanyano ngokukhetwayo wokusebenzela umthetho. Ukujikeleza iindlela kwiindawo ezikhethiweyo kwaye ugqithise abashayeli ngexa elikhathazekileyo (okt, iindlela ezingalunganga, izithuthi ezingasebenzi). Ukwenza zonke iinkqubo zolawulo nengqondo ebandakanyekayo: ukugcina iinkqubo zolawulo ezingqinelanayo. Ukulandela uMthetho weFirearm noAmmunition 60/2000. Ukulandela iinkqubo ezibhalwe kwicwangciso lomsebenzi. Ukuthabatha inxaxheba kumaphulo oPhuhliso loBuntu. Ukukhuthaza ukwenziswa kwenkonzo ngokuchanekileyo nangempumelelo kubathengi. Ukugcina umfanekiso ongemthethweni weQela: uMthetho woLawulo lweThrafikhi.
