zu.title: Isiyalosha Sesifunda
zu.summary: Isiyalosha Sesifunda esiphoqa umthetho wezokuthutha ezindleleni kanye nomthetho wokuthutha kwentengiselwano eGauteng, esifuna i-Diploma kaMphathi Wokulawula Ukuthutha kanye nokuze okungu-01 kweminyaka yotholakalo ohlotshiwe.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Matric kanikezwa i-Diploma kaMphathi Wokulawula Ukuthutha kanye nelayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo, okungenani i-code B. 01 unyaka wotholakalo ohlotshiwe ekuphotheni umthetho wezokuthutha. Kungabi nerekhodi lezenzo ezingezonhle noma ikholo elicwilile kuwe. Ulwazi namakhono: Uphatho oluhle kwezinkomba nezinsiza. Amandla okuphatha kahle izimilo zabathengi. Ulwazi nokuqonda izinqubomgomo nemithetho ehlobene nezokuthutha ezindleleni kanye nokuthutha kwentengiselwano. Ukuqedwa kwezinkomba zokuphotha umthetho. Ulwazi ngokuhlola izimoto nokuyithwala ngamandla. Ulwazi ngoMthetho Wamaphoyisa Nakumabalule 60/100. Ulwazi ngokuqondisa komnyango ngokulawula ukugcwala kwezimoto kanye nemisebenzi yokulawulela (Transport Handbook) 11. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwezingcinzana. Amakhono amahle okubheka. Amakhono amahle okushayela kanye nokuqondisa. Amakhono aphathele embili ekuxazululeni izinkinga nabantu. Amakhono amahle okubhala nokuqhathanisa okubhalwayo okungenani kwezilimi ezimbili ezisemthethweni sesifunda.
zu.duties: Phatha umthetho wokuthutha nezihamba ngesithuthi sabantu kanye nowokuthutha: Qalisa imisebenzi ohlotshiwe nokugunyaziwe yokuphotha umthetho wezokuthutha. Qiniseisa ukuthi kuhamba kahle izithuthi ngeyokusebenza emahhashini kanye nokulawula ukuthutha kwezindawo eziningisiwe. Hlanganisa imisebenzi kanti futhi uvikele indawo yezehlakalo, ubone futhi umemezele abaphathi ngemitholamphilo. Thatha inxaxheba emaphrojekthi okuphotha izithuthi nasimsebenzini wokuhlola isivinini. Khisho izaziso futhi ubambe ngomthetho ngaphansi koMthetho, imiyalo kanye nemibandela ahlobene nawo futhi uhbole ezinkundleni zomthetho unike izonhlangothi. Lawulela izimoto ezingavamile nezithuthi ezinesithwala ukuze zihamba ngokuphepha kanti futhi uhlanganise ukuphatha ukulawula ukugcwala (kuhlanganise izimpahla nabagibeli). Hlola amalayisensi abashayeli nezimoto bese ulawula ukulandelwa kwemithetho emikhakheni Wokuhlola Amalayisensi Wokushayela kanye Esiteshini Sokuhlola Izimoto (DLTC ne-VTS): Qalisa ukuholwa kwezivivinyo zalayisensi zokushayela. (ii) Qalisa ukuholwa kwezivivinyo zokuqinisekisa ukuzinza. Lawula ukulandelwa kwemithetho kwe-DLTC ne-VTS. Nikeza ukulawula ukuthutha okubonakalayo futhi unyuse/qinise ukuzivikela kwezenzo ezingezonhle: Siza ekucubunguleni ukulawula izithuthi esibonakalayo ngokusiza abashayeli kanye nokuqalisa imisebenzi yokulawulela. Thatha inxaxheba emigqeni yokuvikela futhi/noma emisebenzini ekhethelekile yokuphotha umthetho. Phepha izindlela ezindaweni ezikhethekile bese uxwayisa abashayeli ngaphandle kwamathonyawo amakhulu (okungukuthi, izindawo ezingcolile, ukuqhathuka kwezimoto). Qeda yonke imisebenzi yokuphatha kanye naleyo ehlobene nayo: gcina izinqubo eziphumelelayo zokuphatha. Ukulandela umthetho Wamaphoyisa Nakumabalule 60/2000. Ukulandela imisebenzi nengachaziwe kukhula lezinhlelo zomsebenzi. Thatha inxaxheba ekukhuliseni izinsizakalo ezingawonke umuntu. Qinisekisa isibonakaliso esihle nokuqinisekisa ukuba sisebenzela iholo elizwe ngokukhanya ukwethulwa kwamaphoyisa kwezokuthutha.

xh.title: Umhloli wePhondo
xh.summary: Umhloli wePhondo oqinisekisa umthetho wezokuhamba kolawulo nokuthutha koluntu kwindawo yaseGauteng, ofuna iDiploma kaMphathi weThrafikhi kunye nomyaka omnye wamava ahambelana nalo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seMatric kunye neDiploma kaMphathi weThrafikhi kunye nelayisenisi elisebenzayo, ubuncinane ikhowudi B. 01 unyaka wamava abalulekileyo ekusebenzeni komthetho wezokuhamba kolawulo. Akukho ntlonyubo yecalana okanye yamva ikho ngokuchasene nawe. Ulwazi namaqhawekazi: Ulawulo oluluhle lwerekhodi nezibonelelo. Amandla aluhle okulawula ubudlelwane nabadluli. Ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo nomthetho wezokuhamba kolawulo nokuthutha koluntu. Ukuqedela amaxwebhu olongezo lomthetho. Ulwazi ngokuqwalasela izithuthi nokuthatha ngokunyanzelisa izithuthi. Ulwazi ngomthetho weFayile kunye neSikhululu 60/100. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yesebe malunga nolawulo lokugqitha umthwalo nemisebenzi yokusuka (Incwadi yesandla zoKuthutha) 11. Amandla okusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Amandla aluhle okuqaphela. Amandla aluhle okushayela nokucingela. Amandla apheleleyo abantu kunye nokuza ngaphezulu kweengxaki. Amandla aluhle abhalwayo enyathelweni okuthethwayo kubuncinane kwezilumkiso ezimbini zolwimi lusesidlangalweni sesiphondo.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa uMthetho weZokuHamba koLawulo, abaThathiweyo ngoLuntu nokuThutha: Zisebenzisa iindaba ezicwangulisweyo ezamkelekileyo zolawulo lomthetho wezokuhamba kolawulo. Qinisekisa ukuhamba kolwandle kolawulo ngokwenza umsebenzi wokuqwalasela nolawulo oluchanekileyo kwawona ndawo zithwalwe ngantlanzi. Linganisa imisebenzi kwaye igcine iindawo zeengozi, ichaze kwaye ilule isebe malunga neendawo ezinengozi. Thatha inxaxheba kumaprojekthi ezokugcina ezokuhamba kolawulo nakusebenziseni iindawo ezijoliswe kwindawo yokulinganisa isantya sokuqhuba. Nikela iingxelo ukuze uze usebenzise ukubanjwa komthetho othileyo, izikhokelo neenkqubo kwaye uhube iinkqubo zekhoti uze unike ubungqina. Qhuba iindlela ezingatyhanga nemiqathelo ukuze kuqinisekwe ukuba ihamba ngokukhuselekileyo kwaye ulinganise ulawulo lokuqwalasela imithwalo (kuquka izinto nabahambi). Qwalasela iLayisenisi zoBaQhubi neZithuthi eziQhubwayo ukuze ulawule ukuzithobela kwiZiko LokuVavanya iLayisenisi zoBaQhubi (DLTC) naseNdaweni YokuVavanya iZithuthi (VTS): Yenza uvavanyo kolunye nolunye uqeqesho kubaqhubi. (ii) Yenza uvavanyo olugqithiswe ngokwemigaqo. Qwalasela ukuzithobela kwesikhululu DLTC neVTS. Nikela nokuLawula okubonakalayo kweZokuhamba kolawulo kwaye usize/qinisekise iindaba ezingasebenzi kubantu: Nceda ekucwanguliseni ugqitho lokubonakalayo ngokunceda abaqhubi baza kusebenzisa imisebenzi yokukhuseleka. Thatha inxaxheba kumagqabhuku-dla okanye kumasebenziso amangathethiyo. Zulula iindlela kwindawo ezizodwa kwaye lumkise abaqhubi kwiziko ezingabomi (umzekelo: iindawo ezonakalisiweyo zemithi yokuhamba, izithuthi eziphukileyo). Yenza yonke imisebenzi yolawulo nemicimbi engqamana nayo: gcina iinkqubo ezisebenzayo zolawulo. Ukuhambelana noMthetho 60/2000 weFayile nokuNxiba iSikhululu. Ukuhambelana nemicimbi njengoko kuchaziwe kwiinkqubo zokususela uluntu. Thatha inxaxheba kumaxwebhu oQeqesho loLuntu. Qinisekisa inkonzo ephumelele kwaye esebenza kakuhle ekubeni kubakho isimo esakuba ngumgangatho weNkundla: uLawulo lweMithetho yeZokuHamba koLawulo.

jobs.title: Provincial Inspector
jobs.salary_text: R280 278 per annum, plus service benefits
jobs.summary: Provincial Inspector enforcing road traffic and transport legislation in Vereeniging, requiring a Traffic Officer's Diploma and one year of enforcement experience.
jobs.requirements: Matric Certificate plus Traffic Officer's Diploma and a valid driver’s license, at least a code B. 01 year of practical experience in traffic law enforcement. No criminal record or case pending against you. Knowledge and Skills: Good record and resource management. Good customer relationship management abilities. Knowledge and understanding of road traffic and public transport policies and regulations. Completion of law enforcement documents. Knowledge of vehicle inspections and vehicle impoundment. Knowledge of the Firearms and Ammunition Act 60/100. Knowledge of departmental guidelines on overload control and escort duties (Transport Handbook) 11. Ability to work under pressure. Good observation skills. Good driving and negations skills. Sound interpersonal and conflict resolution skills. Good written and verbal communication skills in at least two of the provincial official languages.
jobs.duties: Enforce Road Traffic, Public Passenger and Transport Legislation: Implement planned and approved traffic law enforcement activities. Ensure the free flow of traffic through point duty and traffic control at congested areas. Coordinate activities at and safeguard accident scenes, identify and advise management on hazardous locations. Participate in traffic policing projects and speed testing operations. Issue notices and execute arrests under relevant Acts, directives and procedures and attend court proceedings and give evidence. Escort abnormal vehicles and loads to ensure safe movement thereof and coordinate overload control management (including goods and passengers). Examine Drivers' Licences and Motor Vehicles and monitor compliance at Driver License Testing Centres (DLTC) and Vehicle Testing Stations (VTS): Conduct learner and driver license tests. (ii) Conduct roadworthy tests. Monitor compliance of DLTC and VTS. Provide visible Traffic Control/Policing and promote/ensure crime prevention activities: Assist in planning visible traffic policing by assisting motorists and executing escort duties. Participate in roadblocks and/or special law enforcement operations. Patrol roads in dedicated areas and warn motorists at hazardous locations (i.e., damaged road surfaces, breakdown of vehicles). Perform all administrative activities and related duties: maintain effective administrative procedures. Compliance with the Firearm and Ammunition Act 60/2000. Compliance with activities as outlined in the operational plans. Participate in Human Resource Development Programs. Promote effective and efficient service delivery to clients. Maintain a professional corporate image of the Directorate: Traffic Law Enforcement.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. Tshidiso Chabane/ Ms. Dolly Seboane/ Tlalane Koenane Tel No: (011) 689 3845/ 3723/ 3847
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on new Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za/documents (effective from 01 January 2021). All fields in Part A to D of the Z83 form must be completed, and Part E to G noting that there is limited space provided applicants often indicate “refer” to CV or see attached, this is acceptable as long as the CV is attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. The question related to the conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered. Declaration must be completed and signed. The fully completed and signed new Z83 form should be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV only (only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications). Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applicants who do not comply with the above requirements, as well as late applications, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Suitable candidates will undergo a personnel suitability check (Vetting, criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification, and employment verification). The Department of Community Safety reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes. Candidate will be placed according to corridor coordination and the Department’s needs. The Department will not accept posted, emailed or hand delivered applications. We encourage youth, people with disability, coloured, Indian and white to apply and a confirmation of disabilities from a registered medical practitioner must be attached to the application. Please Note: Due to the large number of applications, we envisage to receive, applications will not be acknowledged. If you do not receive any response within 3 months, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Proviniale Inspekteur
af.summary: Proviniale Inspekteur wat padverkeer- en vervoerwetgewing in Vereeniging handhaaf, waarvoor 'n Verkeersbeampte-diploma en een jaar se handhawingservaring vereis word.
af.requirements: Matrieksertifikaat plus Verkeersbeampte-diploma en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie, ten minste 'n kode B. 01 jaar praktiese ervaring in verkeerswetstoepassing. Geen misdadige rekord of hangende saak teen jou nie. Kennis en Vaardighede: Goeie rekord- en hulpbronbestuur. Goeie vermoëns vir kliëntverhoudingsbestuur. Kennis en begrip van padverkeer- en openbare vervoerbeleide en -regulasies. Voltooiing van wetstoepassingsdokumente. Kennis van voertuiginspeksies en voertuigbeslaglegging. Kennis van die Vuurwapens- en Ammunisiewet 60/100. Kennis van departementele riglyne oor oorlaai-beheer en eskortpligte (Vervoerhandboek) 11. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Goeie waarnemingsvaardighede. Goeie bestuurs- en onderhandelingsvaardighede. Goeie interpersoonlike en konflikoplossingsvaardighede. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede in ten minste twee van die provinsiale amptelike tale.
af.duties: Handhaaf Padverkeer-, Openbare Passasiers- en Vervoerwetgewing: Implementeer beplande en goedgekeurde verkeerswetstoepassingsaktiwiteite. Verseker die vrye vloei van verkeer deur puntbeheer en verkeersbeheer by besope gebiede. Koördineer aktiwiteite by en beveilig ongelukstonele, identifiseer gevaarlike plekke en stel bestuur daaroor in kennis. Neem deel aan verkeerspolisiekundige projekte en spoedtoetsoperasies. Reeel kennisgewings uit en voer arrestasies uit kragtens toepaslike Wette, direktiewe en prosedures en woon hofverrigtinge by en lewer getuienis. Eskorteer abnormale voertuie en vragte om die veilige beweging daarvan te verseker en koördineer oorlaai-beheerbestuur (insluitend goedere en passasiers). Ondersoek Bestuurderslisensies en Motorvoertuie en moniteer nakoming by Bestuurderslisensie-toetsingssentrums (BLTC) en Voertuigtoetsingstasies (VTS): Voer leerling- en bestuurderslisensietoetse uit. (ii) Voer padwaardigheidstoetse uit. Moniteer nakoming van BLTC en VTS. Verskaf sigbare Verkeersbeheer/Polisering en bevorder/verseker misdaadvoorkomingsaktiwiteite: Bystand met die beplanning van sigbare verkeerspolisering deur motoriste by te staan en eskortpligte uit te voer. Neem deel aan padblokkades en/of spesiale wetstoepassingsoperasies. Patrollie paaie in toegewyde gebiede en waarsku motoriste by gevaarlike plekke (d.w.s. beskadige padoppervlakke, voertuigmankrake). Voer alle administratiewe aktiwiteite en verwante pligte uit: onderhou doeltreffende administratiewe prosedures. Nakoming van die Vuurwapens- en Ammunisiewet 60/2000. Nakoming van aktiwiteite soos uiteengesit in die operasionele planne. Neem deel aan Menslike Hulpbronontwikkelingsprogramme. Bevorder doeltreffende en doelmatige dienslewering aan kliënte. Handhaaf 'n professionele korporatiewe beeld van die Direktoraat: Verkeerswetstoepassing.

zu.title: Isiphathihlazi SesiFunda
zu.summary: Isiphathihlazi SesiFunda esiphoqa umthetho wezokuthutha kanye noMthetho wezokuhamba kwabagibeli kanye noMthetho wezokuthutha eVereeniging, esidinga iDiploma kaMphathi Wezokuthutha kanye nenyanga eyodwa yohlelo lwezokuphoqa umthetho.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi seMatric sikhanye neDiploma kaMphathi Wezokuthutha kanye nelayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni, okungenani ikhodi B. 01 unyaka wemisebenzi yonke ekuphoqweni komthetho wezokuthutha. Kungenze kabi ukuba nerekodi yobugebengu noma icala eliphelele ngakho. Ulwazi namakhono: Ukuphatha irekhodi nabezinsiza ngokuhlakanipha. Amakhono amahle okuphatha ubudlelwano namakhasimende. Ulwazi nokuqonda imigomo kanye nemithetho yezokuhamba koomageja kanye nendlela zokuthutha zomphakathi. Ukuqedela imadokhumenti ezokuphoqa umthetho. Ulwazi mayelana nokuhlola izimoto nokuthatha izimoto. Ulwazi loMthetho Wamaphoyisa kanye noMthetho Wezikhali 60/100. Ulwazi mayelana nemiyalo yomnyango mayelana nokuqapha ukugcwala kanye nemisebenzi yokubekeka (Transport Handbook) 11. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo. Amakhono amahle okulungelelanisa. Amakhono amahle okushayela kanye nokuqanjwa kwezindlela. Amakhono aqinisekile wabantu nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono amahle okubhaliwe nokukhulumisana okungenani ngolimi lwezinsizakalo ezimbili zomthetho wesiFunda.
zu.duties: Phakamisa uMthetho Wezokuhamba koomageja, Wabagibeli Basesiphakathini noWezokuthutha: Qalisa imisebenzi ehleliwe futhi evunyiwe yokuphoqa umthetho wezokuthutha. Qinisekisa ukuthutha okukhululekile ngomsebenzi wasezindaweni kanye nokulawula ukuthutha lapho kunolwandle. Hlanganisa imisebenzi lapho kuke khona izehlakalo futhi uvikele izinkomba, ubona futhi umyalele abaphathi ngendawo eyingozi. Thatha inxaxheba kumaphrojekthi wezokuthutha kanye nokuqeqesha inani lezimoto. Khuphula izaziso futhi ubambe abantu ngaphansi koMthetho, imiyalo kanye nezinqubo ezithintekile, ubambe izinkomba zangaphandle futhi ubambe izinkomba zangaphandle ukuze uthole ubufakazi. Hambisa izimoto ezingajwayelekile namalayisensi ukuze uqinisekise ukunyakaza okukhululekile, futhi ulawule imisutheka yokulawula ukulayisha okunyukile (kuquka okuhwebiswayo kanye nabagibeli). Hlola amaLayisensi Abashayeli kanye Nezimoto futhi uqaphele ukuvunyelwa emaLayisensi Abashayeli ekuHlolweni (DLTC) naseMaphoyisa ekuHlolweni Kwezimoto (VTS): Qeqesha izivivinyo zokugcina izitifiketi zokushayela. (ii) Qeqesha izivivinyo zokuqinisekisa. Qaphele ukuvunyelwa kwe-DLTC ne-VTS. Nikeza ukulawula kwezokuthutha okubonakalayo/okuqeqesha futhi ukhuthaze/uqinisekise imisebenzi yokuthibela ubugebengu: Siza ekwelapheni ukubonwa kwabashayeli ngokunika abashayeli isikhululo nokwenza umsebenzi wokubekeka. Thatha inxaxheba kumaphoyisa eendlela kanye/noma ukusetshenziswa okukhethekile kwamaphoyisa. Qeqesha imisebenzi yokuqapha oogibeli futhi uxwayise abashayeli ngolwandle oluyingozi (okungukuthi, izindawo ezingcolile, izimoto ezingasebenzi). Yenza yonke imisebenzi yomagatja kanye nalominyakazo: Sigcina inqubo ephumelelayo yamagatja. Ukuvunyelwa ngoMthetho Wamaphoyisa noMthetho Wezikhali 60/2000. Ukuvunyelwa ngemisebenzi ehleliwe mayelana nokuqeda uMthetho Wamaphoyisa. Thatha inxaxheba kwiNkqubo Yokuqeqeshwa KwebaLethu Bantu. Khuthaza ukulethwa kweenkonzo eziphumelelayo namandla kumakhasimende. Hlala uthole isithombe sohlele lwezokuthutha okuyisikhulu: amaphoyisa azokuthutha.

xh.title: Umphathi wePhondo
xh.summary: Umphathi wePhondo oqinisekisa umthetho wezothuthi nemithetho yezithuthi eVereeniging, ofuna iDiploma yomPhathi weZothuthi kunye nenkunzi yomsebenzi wokuqinisekisa unyaka omnye.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seMatric kunye neDiploma yomPhathi weZothuthi nelayisensi yokuqhayisa esebenzayo, ubuncinane ikhowudi B. 01 unyaka wamava abo bonke oqinisekiso komthetho wezothuthi. Akukho ntlola yobugwenxa okanye icala elicwangqisiwe ngalento. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulawulo olulilo lwerekodi nezixhobo. Amakhono amalulo obuhlakani bokulawula ubudlelwane nabathengi. Ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo zimithetho zothuthi lwemithetho yoluntu nezithuthi. Ukugqiba iifomu zoqinisekiso komthetho. Ulwazi ngokuphonononga izithuthi nokuzeza izithuthi. Ulwazi ngomthetho wamazwe emi 60/100 mayela nabanometho nemalebhu. Ulwazamagca athengisa iNkqubo 11 yekomkhulu yokuzisa oovakalisi phantsi kolawulo nemisebenzi yokuqhuba (Isikhokelo seZothuthi). Ukwenza umsebenzi ngcindezelo. Amakhono abalulekileyo okubala isimo. Amakhono abalulekileyo okuqhayisa nokuqwalasela iingxoxo. Amakhono abalulekileyo abantu nabasombululo babaxabaxa. Amakhono abalulekileyo okubhala nokuthetha ubuncinane iilwimi ezimbini eziyinkqubo yoMthetho wePhondo.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa uMthetho weZothuthi lweNtaba, iNkqubo yoMthetho yoluntu noMthetho weZithuthi: Qamba iinkqubo ezicwangqisiwe kwaye zithathwe ngemvumelwano ngokwenza umsebenzi womthetho wothuthi. Qinisekisa ukuba kusuka hamba ngokukhululekileyo ngeNkqubo yamaphondo nokulawulwa kothuthi kwindawo enentshukumo. Lungisa imisebenzi ngomhla nokuzeza iindawo zentshukumo ngokubeka kubaphathi iindawo ezinguqukileyo. Thatha inxaxheba kumaprojekthi wothuthi oovakalisi phantsi komthetho nokuqinisekisa iintango ezikwisantya sokuhamba. Nikezela iifomu zokumaka kwaye yenze ukubanjwa ngokweMithetho, izikhokelo iinkqubo kwaye ukhathazeke ngokwenza inkqubo yamakhothi uzisa iimbonakaliso. Qinisekisa iindawo nezingubo zeengxoxo ukuba zihamba ngokukhuselekileyo kwaye ulawule iNkqubo yokuqinisekisa ukwaziswa kwamathafa (kuquka izinto nabakhenkethi). Qwalasa uLayisensi abaQhubi nesiZithuthi kwaye alandele isikoqakaliso kwindawo yokuqinisekisa iilayisensi zabaQhubi (DLTC) nakuwoNamashishini oQinisekiso lweziZithuthi (VTS): Yenza uvavanyo lwabaQhubi nabafundi. (ii) Yenza uvavanyo lokuqinisekisa ukuzinza kolawulo. Qwalasa ukuzinza kolawulo ngokwenza isikoqakaliso seDLTC neseVTS. Qinisekisa iNkqubo yokuLawula ukubakho kukaVakalisi weNkqubo yamaphondo nokuxhasa/uqinisekisa iinkqubo ezithintela ubugwenxa: Nceda ekubekeni iNkqubo yokuqinisekisa ukubakho kukaVakalisi ngokunceda abaQhubi kwaye yenze imisebenzi yokuqhuba. Thatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo ezizezolo noma ezoqinisekiso ngokutsha komthetho. Qwalasa iindlela kwindawo ephilileyo nokuqhayisa abaQhubi ngokusingasini iindlela eziguquguqukiweyo (oko kukuthi, iindlela ezonakalisiweyo, izithuthi ezingasebenziyo). Yenza yonke imisebenzi yolawulo: gcina iinkqubo zolawulo ezisebenzayo. Ukuzinza kolawulo ngokwakho kunye noMthetho wokuqinisekisa iNkqubo yokuqinisekisa ukuba kusetyenziswa iinkqubo ezikwisikoqakaliso. Thatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yoLawulo lweNkqubo yoMntu. Khuthaza ukuba kusetyenziswa iNkqubo yokuqinisekisa ukuba kufikelelwa kubathengi ngokuchanekileyo nakanye. Gcina isiko lenkampani eNkqubo yoLawulo: UQinisekiso loMthetho weZothuthi.

jobs.title: Provincial Inspector
jobs.salary_text: R280 278 per annum, plus service benefits
jobs.summary: Provincial Inspector enforcing road traffic and public transport legislation in Wadeville, requiring a Traffic Officer's Diploma and one year of experience.
jobs.requirements: Matric Certificate plus Traffic Officer's Diploma and a valid driver’s license, at least a code B. 01 year of practical experience in traffic law enforcement. No criminal record or case pending against you. Knowledge and Skills: Good record and resource management. Good customer relationship management abilities. Knowledge and understanding of road traffic and public transport policies and regulations. Completion of law enforcement documents. Knowledge of vehicle inspections and vehicle impoundment. Knowledge of the Firearms and Ammunition Act 60/100. Knowledge of departmental guidelines on overload control and escort duties (Transport Handbook) 11. Ability to work under pressure. Good observation skills. Good driving and negations skills. Sound interpersonal and conflict resolution skills. Good written and verbal communication skills in at least two of the provincial official languages.
jobs.duties: Enforce Road Traffic, Public Passenger and Transport Legislation: Implement planned and approved traffic law enforcement activities. Ensure the free flow of traffic through point duty and traffic control at congested areas. Coordinate activities at and safeguard accident scenes, identify and advise management on hazardous locations. Participate in traffic policing projects and speed testing operations. Issue notices and execute arrests under relevant Acts, directives and procedures and attend court proceedings and give evidence. Escort abnormal vehicles and loads to ensure safe movement thereof and coordinate overload control management (including goods and passengers). Examine Drivers' Licences and Motor Vehicles and monitor compliance at Driver License Testing Centres (DLTC) and Vehicle Testing Stations (VTS): Conduct learner and driver license tests. (ii) Conduct roadworthy tests. Monitor compliance of DLTC and VTS. Provide visible Traffic Control/Policing and promote/ensure crime prevention activities: Assist in planning visible traffic policing by assisting motorists and executing escort duties. Participate in roadblocks and/or special law enforcement operations. Patrol roads in dedicated areas and warn motorists at hazardous locations (i.e., damaged road surfaces, breakdown of vehicles). Perform all administrative activities and related duties: maintain effective administrative procedures. Compliance with the Firearm and Ammunition Act 60/2000. Compliance with activities as outlined in the operational plans. Participate in Human Resource Development Programs. Promote effective and efficient service delivery to clients. Maintain a professional corporate image of the Directorate: Traffic Law Enforcement.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. Tshidiso Chabane/ Ms. Dolly Seboane/ Tlalane Koenane 011 689 3845/ 3723/ 3847
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on new Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za/documents (effective from 01 January 2021). All fields in Part A to D of the Z83 form must be completed, and Part E to G noting that there is limited space provided applicants often indicate “refer” to CV or see attached, this is acceptable as long as the CV is attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. The question related to the conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered. Declaration must be completed and signed. The fully completed and signed new Z83 form should be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV only (only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications). Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applicants who do not comply with the above requirements, as well as late applications, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Suitable candidates will undergo a personnel suitability check (Vetting, criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification, and employment verification). The Department of Community Safety reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes. Candidate will be placed according to corridor coordination and the Department’s needs. The Department will not accept posted, emailed or hand delivered applications. We encourage youth, people with disability, coloured, Indian and white to apply and a confirmation of disabilities from a registered medical practitioner must be attached to the application. Please Note: Due to the large number of applications, we envisage to receive, applications will not be acknowledged. If you do not receive any response within 3 months, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Provinsiale Inspekteur
af.summary: Provinsiale Inspekteur wat padverkeer- en openbare vervoerwetgewing in Wadeville handhaaf, wat 'n Verkeersbeampte-diploma en een jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Matricksertifikaat plus Verkeersbeampte-diploma en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie, ten minste 'n kode B. 01 jaar se praktiese ervaring in verkeerswetstoepassing. Geen strafrekord of hangende saak teen u nie. Kennis en Vaardighede: Goee rekord- en hulpbronbestuur. Goee vermoëns vir kliëntverhoudingsbestuur. Kennis en begrip van padverkeer- en openbare vervoerbeleid en -regulasies. Voltooiing van wetstoepassingsdokumente. Kennis van voertuiginspeksies en voertuiginbeslagname. Kennis van die Vuurwapen- en Ammunisiewet 60/100. Kennis van departementele riglyne oor oorlaai-beheer en eskortpligte (Vervoerhandboek) 11. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Goee waarnemingsvaardighede. Goee bestuurs- en onderhandelingvaardighede. Soliede interpersoonlike en konflikoplossingsvaardighede. Goee skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede in ten minste twee van die provinsiale amptelike tale.
af.duties: Handhaaf Padverkeer-, Openbare Passasiers- en Vervoerwetgewing: Implementeer beplande en goedgekeurde verkeerswetstoepassingsaktiwiteite. Verseker die vrye vloei van verkeer deur puntdiens en verkeersbeheer by digte gebiede. Koördineer aktiwiteite by ongelukstonele en beskerm dit, identifiseer gevaarlike plekke en gee advies aan bestuur daaroor. Neem deel aan verkeerspolisieringsprojekte en spoedtoetsoperasies. Uitvaardig kennisgewings en voer arrestasies uit ingevolge relevante Wette, richtlyne en prosedures en woon hofverrigtinge by en getuig. Eskorteer abnormale voertuie en vragte om die veilige beweging daarvan te verseker en koördineer oorlaai-beheerbestuur (insluitend goedere en passasiers). Ondersoek Bestuurderslisensies en Motorvoertuie en monitor nakoming by Bestuurderslisensie-toetssentra (BLTC) en Voertuigtoetssentra (VTS): Voer leerling- en bestuurderslisensietoetse uit. (ii) Voer padwaardigheidstoetse uit. Monitor nakoming van BLTC en VTS. Verskaf sigbare Verkeersbeheer/Polisiering en bevorder/verseker misdaadvoorkomingsaktiwiteite: Bystaan met die beplanning van sigbare verkeerspolisiering deur motorsiste by te staan en eskortpligte uit te voer. Neem deel aan padblokkades en/of spesiale wetstoepassingsoperasies. Patroller paaie in toegewyde gebiede en waarsku motorsiste by gevaarlike plekke (d.w.s. beskadigde padoppervlakke, voertuigonderbrekings). Voer alle administratiewe aktiwiteite en verwante pligte uit: handhaaf doeltreffende administratiewe prosedures. Nakoming van die Vuurwapen- en Ammunisiewet 60/2000. Nakoming van aktiwiteite soos uiteengesit in die operasionele planne. Neem deel aan Menslike Hulpbronontwikkelingsprogramme. Bevorder doeltreffende en doeltredende dienslewering aan kliënte. Handhaaf 'n professionele korporatiewe beeld van die Direktoraat: Verkeerswetstoepassing.

zu.title: Isiphathindaba Senyakatho
zu.summary: Isiphathindaba Senyakatho esiphoqa umthetho wokuhamba kolayini nokuqedela kwezokuthutha komphakathi eWadeville, esidinga i-Diploma yekaMphathi Wegazi kanye neminyaka eyodwa yamava.
zu.requirements: Isitifikredi se-Matric okanye i-Diploma yekaMphathi Wegazi kanye nelayisensi evumelekile yokushayela, okungenani ikhodi B. 01 unyaka wamava okusebenza ngokusebenza komthetho wokuhamba kolayini. Kungabi nerekhodi lobugebengu noma icala elilindile kuwe. Ulwazi nobukhono: Uphathwa okuhle kwarekhodi nezinsizakusebenza. Amakhono okuphatha kahle ubudlelwano bethimba. Ulwazi nokuqonda izinqubomgomo nezimiso zokuhamba kolayini nokuqedela kwezokuthutha komphakathi. Ukuqedela kwamadokhumenti okuphoqa umthetho. Ulwazi ngokuhlola izimoto nokuthunjwa kwezimoto. Ulwazi nge-Firearms and Ammunition Act 60/100. Ulwazi lokuqondisa komnyango ngokulawula ukugelezwa kakhulu nemisebenzi yokuqedela (Transport Handbook) 11. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi koxindelelo. Amakhono amahle okubuka. Amakhono amahle okushayela nokuxoxisana. Amakhono aqinile abantu nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono amahle okubhala nokuKhuluma ezilimi zombuso zesifunda okungenani ezimbini.
zu.duties: Phakamisa umthetho wokuhamba kolayini, wokuqedela kwabagibeli bomphakathi nezokuthutha: Qondisa imisebenzi ehlelwe neyamukelekwe yokuphoqa umthetho wokuhamba kolayini. Qinisekisa ukugeleza okukhululekile kwezokuhamba ngezezandla nolawulo lokuhamba kwezimoto ezindaweni ezixineni. Hlanganisa imisebenzi kwaye uvikele izigcawu zezehlakalo, uchaze futhi unikeze insimu ngendezawo eyingozi. Thatha inxaxheba kumaphulo okuphoqa umthetho wokuhamba kolayini nokuhlolwa kwejubane. Khupha izaziso futhi wenze ukuboshwa ngaphansi kumthetho ohambisana nawo, iziqondiso nemikhuba futhi uhambise izinkantolo unikeze ubufakazi. Qedela izimoto ezingajwayelekile nezimithwalo yakhe ukuze qinisekisa ukuhamba kwazo okuphephile futhi uhlanganise ulawulo lokulawula ukugelezwa kakhulu (okuhlanganisa izimpahla nabagibeli). Hlola amalayisensi abashayeli kanye nezimoto ezingokuhamba ugodle ukuthobela ema-Driver License Testing Centres (DLTC) naseziteshini zokuholo kwezimoto (VTS): Qondisa ukuholwa kwezivivinyo zolayisensi zokushayela. (ii) Qondisa izivivinyo ezihambisana nemithetho yasezindaweni. Godla ukuthobela kwe-DLTC ne-VTS. Nikeza ukulawula okubonakalayo kwezokuhamba / ukuphoqa umthetho futhi ukuthuthuze / qinisekise imisebenzi yokuvimbela ubugebengu: Siza ekwenzeni isu lokuphoqa umthetho okubonakalayo ngokusize abashayeli kanye nokuqedela imisebenzi. Thatha inxaxheba kumaphuzu okuvimbela noma imisebenzi ekhethekile yokuphoqa umthetho. Zulula izindlela ezindaweni ezihlukaniswe futhi luxwaye abashayeli kumakhaya ezingozi (okungukuthi, izindawo ezingahlanzekile zokuhamba kwezimoto, ukuqhwa kwezimoto). Wenze yonke imisebenzi yokuphatha kwaye ehlobene: Dlala imikhuba yonkwehle yokuphatha ukuthi igqamise kahle. Thobela umthetho weFirearm and Ammunition Act 60/2000. Thobela imisebenzi enjengokuchazwe emahleleni okuqondiswa. Thatha inxaxheba kumaphulo eNkqubo yokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Khuthaza ukulethwa kwenkonzo ngokuphumelelayo kwangempumelelo kumakhasimende. Dlulisa isithombe esihle senkampani yeDirectorate: Traffic Law Enforcement.

xh.title: IsiPhoni Sephondo
xh.summary: IsiPhoni Sephondo esiphozelela imithetho yojoliso lwendlela nomthwalo wabantu woluntu eWadeville, esifuna iDiploma yomPondisi weTreki kunye nomyaka omnye wamava.
xh.requirements: Iifomula zamatikiletsho zeMatric zinikwa iDiploma yomPondisi weTreki nelayisensi yokuqeshisa esemthethweni, ubuncinane ikhowudi B. 01 unyaka wamava okusebenzela ngokomthetho wokuphatha ujoliso lwendlela. Akukho ngena yecaluli okanye isigqeba sendlela esikhangele kuwe. Ulwazi nakhono: Ukulawula amarekhodi nabalawuli abalulekileyo. Amandla okulawula ubuhlobo nabathengi. Ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo zepolisi nemithetho yojoliso lwendlela nomthwalo woluntu. Ukugcwalisa amaxwebhu okuphatha umthetho. Ulwazi ngokuvavanya iimoto nokuthunjwa kwezithuthi. Ulwazi lomthetho weFirearms and Ammunition Act 60/100. Ulwazi lwegqibo lesebe ngolawulo lomthwalo olunzima nakuqhuba imisebenzi yokuqhuba (Transport Handbook) 11. Amandla okusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Amandla amahle okuqonda. Amandla amahle okuqhuba nokubeka ngasetyhini. Amandla abalulekileyo bokwazi ukuba nabantu nokusombulula iingxabano. Amandla amahle ekubhaleni nasekuthetheni ngesiXhosa esibhaliweyo kubuncinane kweelwimi ezimbini zolawulo lwephondo.
xh.duties: Ukuphozelela umthetho weNjineli, wokuQhuba abaGibeli bomThwalo bomThwalo woluntu: Ukuphatha iinkqubo zokuphozelela umthetho zicwangiweyo ezamkeliweyo. Qinisekisa ukutyhila kweendlela ngokwenza umsebenzi wendawo nolawulo lweendlela kwindawo edinile. Lawula imisebenzi kwaye uvikele iindawo ezimele intlangu, qaphela unikeze isalathiso kubaphathi ngeendawo ezicolileyo. Thatha inxaxheba kumaphulo ophatha ujoliso lweendlela nasekuvavanyeni isantya. Nikeza iintanda wenze izibambo ngokomthetho, iindlela nemicimbe yomsebenzi uzalele iinkundla zenkantla unike ubungqina. Qhuba iithuthi kunye nomthwalo ongenamthetho ukuze qinisekisa ukunyomba kwawo ulawule ulawulo lomthwalo onzima (kuquka izinto nabahambi). Hlola amaLayisensi oQhubi neMoto kwaye ulawule ukuzigqiba kumaziko oVavanyo bakaLayisensi baQhubi (DLTC) naseZikhweni zoVavanyo lweZithuthi (VTS): Yenza uvavanyo balayisense abafundi nabaqhubi. (ii) Yenza uvavanyo bokulungele ukuqhuba endleleni. Hlola ukuzigqiba kwe-DLTC nese-VTS. bonezela uLawulo lokuJolisa iNjineli olubonakalayo ukukhuthaza/okuqinisekisa imisebenzi yokuthintela ubughweta: Nceda ukucwangcisa ukujolisa iindlela ngokunceda abaqhubi bethuthi nokwenza imisebenzi yokuba ngumqhubi wamathandabuzi. Thatha inxaxheba kubazimele bandlela naphandle/kumasebe amaye womthetho. Khenketha iindlela kumacala acokiweyo uyaxabisile abaqhubi bethuthi kwiindawo ezicolileyo (oo.k., iindawo ezonakeleyo zendlela, ukuqhawuka kwezithuthi). Yenza yonke imisebenzi yolawulo nemisebenzi enxulumene nayo: gcina iinkqubo zolawulo ezisebenzayo. Ukuhambelana nomthetho weFirearm and Ammunition Act 60/2000. Ukuhambelana nemisebenzi echazwe kwiinkqubo ezicwangcisiweyo zomsebenzi. Thatha inxaxheba kumaphulo eNkqubo yoPhuculo lweMithwalo yabantu. Khuthaza ukuba kube nokuhamba-hamba kolwazi koluntu olusetyenzisayo kubathengi. Gcina umbono webhudo yeQela: uLawulo lomThetho wokuQhuba iNjineli.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk
jobs.salary_text: R237 453 per annum, plus service benefits
jobs.summary: Administration Clerk sought at the Department of Community Safety head office in Gauteng to provide clerical support, capture data and handle routine enquiries.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 (NQF Level 4) certificate or equivalent. No experience required. No criminal record or any pending cases against you. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge of clerical duties, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operate computer and collecting statistics. Knowledge and understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service. Knowledge of work procedures in terms of the working environment. Job Knowledge. Communication. Interpersonal relations. Flexibility. Teamwork. Planning and organisation. Language. Good verbal and written communication skills.
jobs.duties: Render general clerical support services: Record, organise, store, capture and retrieve correspondence and data (line function). Update registers and statistics. Handle routine enquiries. Make photocopies and receive or send facsimiles. Distribute documents/packages to various stakeholders as required. Keep and maintain the filing system for the component. Type letters and/or other correspondence when required. Keep and maintain the incoming and outgoing document register of the component. Provide supply chain clerical support services within the component: Liaise with internal and external stakeholders in relation to procurement of goods and services. Obtain quotations, complete procurement forms for the purchasing of standard office items. Stock control of office stationery. Keep and maintain the asset register of the component (district offices). Provide personnel administration clerical support services within the component: Maintain a leave register for the component. Keep and maintain personnel records in the component. Keep and maintain the attendance register of the component. Arrange travelling and accommodation. Provide financial administration support services in the component. Capture and update expenditure in component. Check correctness of subsistence and travel claims of officials and submit to manager for approval. Handle telephone accounts and petty cash for the component.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. Tshidiso Chabane/ Ms. Dolly Seboane/ Tlalane Koenane Tel No: (011) 689 3845/ 3723/ 3847

af.title: Administratiewe Klerk
af.summary: Administratiewe Klerk gesoek by die Department of Community Safety-hoofkantoor in Gauteng om klerklike ondersteuning te verskaf, data vas te lê en roetine-navrae te hanteer.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 (NQF Level 4)-sertifikaat of gelykwaardig. Geen ervaring vereis nie. Geen misdaderecord of enige hangende sake teen u nie. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van klerklike pligte, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, 'n rekenaar te bedryf en statistieke te versamel. Kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Public Service regeer. Kennis van werksprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing. Werkkennis. Kommunikasie. Interpersoonlike verhoudings. Buigsaamheid. Spanwerk. Beplanning en organisasie. Taal. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaf algemene klerklike ondersteuningsdienste: Reël, organiseer, berg, lê vas en haal korrespondensie en data op (lynfunksie). Werk registers en statistieke by. Hanteer roetine-navrae. Maak fotostaatkopieë en ontvang of stuur faksimiles. Versprei dokumente/pakkies aan verskeie belanghebbendes soos vereis. Hou en onderhou die lêerstelsel vir die komponent. Tik briewe en/of ander korrespondensie wanneer vereis. Hou en onderhou die inkomende en uitgaande dokumentregister van die komponent. Verskaf voorsieningsketting-klerklike ondersteuningsdienste binne die komponent: Skakel met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes met betrekking tot die verkryging van goedere en dienste. Verkry kwotasies, voltooi verkrygingsvorms vir die aankoop van standaard kantooritems. Voorraadbeheer van kantoorstasie. Hou en onderhou die bate-register van die komponent (distrikkantore). Verskaf personeeladministrasie-klerklike ondersteuningsdienste binne die komponent: Onderhou 'n verlofregister vir die komponent. Hou en onderhou personeelrekords in die komponent. Hou en onderhou die bywoningsregister van die komponent. Reël reis en akkommodasie. Verskaf finansiële administrasie-ondersteuningsdienste in die komponent. Lê uitgawes in die komponent vas en werk dit by. Kontroleer die korrektheid van bestaans- en reisaansprake van amptenare en dien dit by die bestuurder vir goedkeuring in. Hanteer telefoonrekenings en kleingeld vir die komponent.

zu.title: Ikhilhikhana Lezokuphathwa
zu.summary: Kufunwa Ikhilhikhana Lezokuphathwa eqhikambini le-Department of Community Safety eGauteng ukuze kubekwe usizo lwezokuphathwa, kubambe imininingwane futhi kuphathwe imibuzo ejwayelekile.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 (NQF Level 4) noma esilinganayo. Akukho mkhambi ofunwayo. Kungabi nani bani isigameko sokwenza ubugebengu noma noma yisiphi isigameko esikuletle kube ikhomishini. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yezokuphathwa, izindlela zokwenza kanye nenhla yokubamba imininingwane, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqoqa izibalo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngohlaka olwemithetho oluphethe Imphakathi Yomphakathi. Ulwazi ngendlela zokwenza umsebenzi ngokohlelo lwendawo yokusebenza. Ulwazi ngomsebenzi. Ukuxhumana. Izinhlobonhlobo zokuxhumana nabantu. Ukuguquguquka. Ukusebenza njengomuntu ohlanganyele. Ukubumba izinhlelo nokuhlelwa. Ulimi. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana okwenkulumo nokuqoshiwe.
zu.duties: Nikela ngamasevisi ajwayelekile okuphatha imibhalo: Qopha, hlela, gcine, bambe futhi ulande imibhalo nemininingwane (umsebenzi ohlotshanisiwe). Buyezeza izibalo namabhuku abhalwa kuyo imininingwane. Phatha imibuzo ejwayelekile. Yenza amakhophi bese wamukela noma uthumele imibhalo ezenziwa ngesibonakalisi. Yaba imibhalo/amasentho kubantu abahlukene njengoko kudingeka. Gcina bese ulondoloza uhlelo lokuqoqa imibhalo lezo zenqcrna. Thepha amagwazi kanye/noma eminye imibhalo lapho kudingeka. Gcina bese ulondoloza ibhuku abhalwa kuso imibhalo engena naphuma kuleyo zenqcrna. Nikela ngamasevisi okuphathwa kwezinsiza kuleyo zenqcrna: Xhumana nabantu bangaphakathi nangaphandle ngesihweba sezimpahla nesevisi. Thola izincomakhulu, gcwalisa amafomu esihweba ukuze uthenge izinto ezijwayelekile zofisi. Lawula izimpahla zensiza zofisi. Gcina bese ulondoloza ibhuku lezimpahla kuleyo zenqcrna (mahhovisi esifunda). Nikela ngamasevisi okuphathwa kwabasebenzi kuleyo zenqcrna: Gcina ibhuku lokuhamba kuleyo zenqcrna. Gcina bese ulondoloza imibhalo yabasebenzi kuleyo zenqcrna. Gcina bese ulondoloza ibhuku lobungikhindi kuleyo zenqcrna. Hlela ukuhamba nendawo yokulala. Nikela ngamasevisi okuphathwa kwezezimali kuleyo zenqcrna. Bambe bese ubuyezeza izindleko kuleyo zenqcrna. Hlola ukulunga kwamafomu yokuhamba nokuhlaliswa abasebenzi bese uwathumela kumphathi ukuba awamuke. Phatha ama-akhawundi efoni namadola amancane kuleyo zenqcrna.

xh.title: Iklerk yolawulo
xh.summary: Kufunwa iklerk yolawulo kumphathi wedolophu we Department of Community Safety e Gauteng ukunika inkxaso yemisebenzi yeklerk, ukubhala iinkcukacha ezahlukeneyo nokusebenza nemibuzo ejikelezayo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se Grade 12 (NQF Level 4) okanye esilinganayo. Akukho nyaniso lisebenzi eliceliwayo. Makungenaswazi lokwenzakaliswa noma naziphi na iindaba ezisangelangayo ezichasenwe nawe. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yeklerk, iindlela zayo kwanamandla okubhala iinkcukacha ezahlukeneyo, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuthatha ulwazi ngeenani. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngolwandilwo olulawula i Public Service. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yomsebenzi ngokommandla wokusebenza. Ulwazi lomsebenzi. Unxibelelwano. Ubummelwane nabantu. Ukuguquguquka. Ukusebenza njengothi. Uyilo nokuhlelwa. Ulwimi. Amakhono amabalise afanelekileyo ekuThetheni nokuBhaleni.
xh.duties: Nika iinkonzo ezingundotho zeklerk: Bhala, hlela, gcina, bhala iinkcukacha ezahlukeneyo zifunyenwe kwanepasati (umsebenzi wolawulo). Hlaziya izibhalo nolwazi ngobukhulu beentlalo. Sebenzisa imibuzo ejikelezayo. Yenza iikopi eziphinda phindwe kwaye wamkele okanye uthume iifeksi. Yahlula amaxwebhu/empahla kubahluki-hlukileyo nje kwafunwa. Gcina ulawulo lwendlela yokufaka iifayili kwicandelo. Bhala iileta okanye enye icorrespondence xa kufunwa. Gcina ulawulo lokubhala izibhalo ezifungenayo nasezithumwayo kwicandelo. Yinkonzo yeklerk yolawulo lwabasebenzi kwicandelo: Gcina isibhalo sonyawo kwicandelo. Gcina ulawulo lwemibhalo yabasebenzi kwicandelo. Gcina ulawulo lwesibhalo sokubakho kwicandelo. Hlela ukuhamba nokuhlala. Yinkonzo yolawulo lweemali kwicandelo. Bhala iinkcukacha ezahlukeneyo zokuchithwa kwemali kwicandelo. Panga ukuchaneka kwemibuzo yokutya nokuhambeleka kwabasebenzi uze uyithumele kumphathi ukuyamkela. Sebenzisa iiakhawunti zamathilifown ngesikwemali encinci kwicandelo.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk
jobs.salary_text: R237 453 per annum, plus service benefits
jobs.summary: Administration Clerk needed at the Far East Rand Regional Office to provide general clerical support, data capture and records management.
jobs.requirements: A grade 12 (NQF Level 4) certificate or equivalent. No experience required. No criminal record or any pending cases against you. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge of clerical duties, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operate computer and collecting statistics. Knowledge and understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service. Knowledge of work procedures in terms of the working environment. Job Knowledge. Communication. Interpersonal relations. Flexibility. Teamwork. Planning and organisation. Language. Good verbal and written communication skills.
jobs.duties: Render general clerical support services: Record, organise, store, capture and retrieve correspondence and data (line function). Update registers and statistics. Handle routine enquiries. Make photocopies and receive or send facsimiles. Distribute documents/packages to various stakeholders as required. Keep and maintain the filing system for the component. Type letters and/or other correspondence when required. Keep and maintain the incoming and outgoing document register of the component. Provide supply chain clerical support services within the component: Liaise with internal and external stakeholders in relation to procurement of goods and services. Obtain quotations, complete procurement forms for the purchasing of standard office items. Stock control of office stationery. Keep and maintain the asset register of the component (district offices). Provide personnel administration clerical support services within the component: Maintain a leave register for the component. Keep and maintain personnel records in the component. Keep and maintain the attendance register of the component. Arrange travelling and accommodation. Provide financial administration support services in the component. Capture and update expenditure in component. Check correctness of subsistence and travel claims of officials and submit to manager for approval. Handle telephone accounts and petty cash for the component.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. Tshidiso Chabane/ Ms. Dolly Seboane/ Tlalane Koenane Tel No: (011) 689 3845/ 3723/ 3847
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on new Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za/documents (effective from 01 January 2021). All fields in Part A to D of the Z83 form must be completed, and Part E to G noting that there is limited space provided applicants often indicate “refer” to CV or see attached, this is acceptable as long as the CV is attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. The question related to the conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered. Declaration must be completed and signed. The fully completed and signed new Z83 form should be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV only (only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications). Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applicants who do not comply with the above requirements, as well as late applications, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Suitable candidates will undergo a personnel suitability check (Vetting, criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification, and employment verification). The Department of Community Safety reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes. Candidate will be placed according to corridor coordination and the Department’s needs. The Department will not accept posted, emailed or hand delivered applications. We encourage youth, people with disability, coloured, Indian and white to apply and a confirmation of disabilities from a registered medical practitioner must be attached to the application. Please Note: Due to the large number of applications, we envisage to receive, applications will not be acknowledged. If you do not receive any response within 3 months, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Administrasie-klerk
af.summary: Administrasie-klerk benodig by die Far East Rand Regional Office om algemene klerklike ondersteuning, data vaslegging en rekordbestuur te verskaf.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 (NQF Level 4) sertifikaat of gelykwaardig. Geen ervaring vereis nie. Geen misdadige rekord of hangende sake teen jou nie. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van klerklike pligte, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, rekenaar te bedryf en statistiek te versamel. Kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Kennis van werkprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing. Werkkennis. Kommunikasie. Interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Buigsaamheid. Spanwerk. Beplanning en organisasie. Taal. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Lewer algemene klerklike ondersteuningsdienste: Rekord, organiseer, stoor, lê vas en haal korrespondensie en data op (lynfunksie). Dateer registers en statistieke op. Hanteer roetine-navrae. Maak fotokopieë en ontvang of stuur faksimiles. Versprei dokumente/pakkette na verskeie belanghebbendes soos vereis. Hou en onderhou die lêerstelsel vir die komponent. Tik briewe en/of ander korrespondensie wanneer vereis. Hou en onderhou die inkomende en uitgaande dokumentregister van die komponent. Verskaf toevoerketting-klerklike ondersteuningsdienste binne die komponent: Skakel met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes met betrekking tot die verkryging van goedere en dienste. Verkry kwotasies, voltooi verkrygingsvorms vir die aankoop van standaard kantooritems. Voorraadbeheer van kantoorstasie. Hou en onderhou die bate-register van die komponent (distrikkantore). Verskaf personeeladministrasie-klerklike ondersteuningsdienste binne die komponent: Onderhou 'n verlofregister vir die komponent. Hou en onderhou personeelrekords in die komponent. Hou en onderhou die bywoningsregister van die komponent. Reël reis en akkommodasie. Verskaf finansiële administrasie-ondersteuningsdienste in die komponent. Lê uitgawes in komponent vas en dateer dit op. Kontroleer die korrektheid van bestaan- en reis eise van amptenare en dien by bestuurder vir goedkeuring in. Hanteer telefoonrekenings en kleingeld vir die komponent.

zu.title: Ikhilikithi Lolawulo
zu.summary: Kudingeka Ikhilikithi Lolawulo eFar East Rand Regional Office ukunikeza inkxaso evamile yabakhalikithi, ukubhala idatha nokuphathwa kwezinkomba.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-grade 12 (NQF Level 4) noma esilinganayo. Asikho isiphi isiphephelo esidingekayo. Asikho irekhodi yobugebengu noma nakweyiphi incazelo ezahlulekile ngakho. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yamakhalikithi, izindlela ezisetshenziswa kanye nenkingosi yokubhala idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuthola izibalo. Ulwazi nokuqonda uhlelo lomthetho oluphethe Inkonzo Yomphakathi. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yomsebenzi ngokuhlobene nendawo yokusebenza. Ulwazi lwomsebenzi. Ukuxhumana. Izindlela zokuhlobana nabantu. Ukuqhathaniseka. Ukusebenza njengeqembu. Ukucubungula nokuhlela. Ulimi. Amakhono ohlelo lokuxhumana okushashalazi nokubhala.
zu.duties: Nikeza inkxaso evamile yamakhalikithi: Bhala, hlela, gigada, bhala futhi uthole imibhalo nedayitha (umsebenzi wolayini). Buyekeza izingxenye nezibalo. Phatha imibuzo ejwayelekile. Yenza amakhophi uye athole noma uthumele amafeksi. Yahlule amadokhumenti/amasonto abantuahlukene njengoko kudingeka. Gcina futhi ulondoloze uhlelo lokulondoloza amafayela esigaba. Bhala amaleta noma omunye umbhalo uma kudingeka. Gcina futhi ulondoloze irekhodi yamadokhumenti angena naphuma esigabeni. Nikeza inkxaso yamakhalikithi kwinkambiso yokuqinisekisa ukugehla ngaphakathi kwesigaba: Xhumana nabahlakaniphile bangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokuhlobene nokuthenga izimpahla nezinsizakalo. Thola izinkomba, gcwalisa amafomu okuthenga izinto ezijwayelekile zohlazi. Ukulawula isitokwe sesibhakela sehhovisi. Gcina futhi ulondoloze irekhodi yezimpahlazesigaba (amanhhovisi esifunda). Nikeza inkxaso yamakhalikithi kulawulo lwabasebenzi ngaphakathi kwesigaba: Londoloza irekhodi yokuhamba esigabeni. Gcina futhi ulondoloze izinkomba zabasebenzi esigabeni. Gcina futhi ulondoloze irekhodi yokubukwa kwesigaba. Hlela ukuhamba nendawo yokuhlala. Nikeza inkxaso yolawulo lwezimali esigabeni. Bhala futhi buyekeza ukuchithwa kwemali esigabeni. Hlola ukulunga kwezinkomba zokuhamba nokuhlala zabasebenzi uye uthumele kumphathi ukuze azamukele. Phatha ama-akhawunti ocingo nemali encane yesigaba.

xh.title: Umphathi wezokuqeqesha
xh.summary: Kufuneka abasebenzi bokulawula izinto eFar East Rand Regional Office ezakunika inkxaso yemisebenzi yonqeqesho, ukuqamba idatha nokulawula irekhodi.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 (NQF Level 4) okanye esingenelo. Akukho mphumo ebunziyo. Akukho bungozi kwizigidiya okanye na iziganeko ezingazange zibandakanyeke. Ulwazi nemisebenzi: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yonqeqesho, iindlela zokuqamba nokusebenza. Ulwazi nokuqonda inguquko yomthetho ekulawula inkonzo yobuzwe. Ulwazi lweendlela zokusebenza kwindawo yokusebenza. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi. Ukuzalanisa neenkqubo ezahlukeneyo. Unxibelelwano. Imizwelo emikhulu phakathi kwabantu. Ukuguquguquka. Ukusebenza njengodidi. Ulungelelwaniso nokuqamba. Ulwimi. Ulwazi oluhle lokuzalathisa ukuthetha nokuvela ngemilo elungiselelwe imisebenzi.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yonqeqesho ngemisebenzi eqhelekileyo: Qamba, lungisa, gcina, enza irekhodi nokubuyisela okubhaliweyo nayo yonke idatha (ukulawula imisebenzi).Qamba iindawo ezingenele ngokubhala izinto ezibalulwa khona.Mphendula imibuzo eqhelekileyo.Yenza amakhophi nokuqamba izinto nokuqhushumba nokuqhushumba.Isasaze amaphepha okanye izinto ezahlukeneyo kubantu abanomdla ngokufunekayo.Gcina nokulawula indlela yokubhala izinto kwicomponent Bhala iileta okanye ezinye izinto ezibhaliweyo xa kufunekayo. Gcina nokulawula irekhodi yemisebenzi evela nokuqhuba phambili kwecomponent. Nika inkxaso yonqeqesho kwi-supply chain kwicomponent: Qhagamshelana nabantu abangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokulinganisa ukuthengwa kwemisebenzi neezinto. Fumana iimvakaliso, gediza iifomu zokuthenga izinto zofice ezisemthethweni. Lawula izinto zofice ezikhoyo. Gcina nokulawula irekhodi yezinto ezikhoyo kwicomponent (district offices).

zu.title: Ikhilikhi lokuphatha izindaba
zu.summary: Kudingeka ikhilikhi lokuphatha izindaba eznikeza izinsiza zokusebenza ezenza umsebenzi ohlanganisa ukubhala idatha, ukuphatha amarekhodi kanye nemibuzo evamile eGauteng.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12 (NQF Level 4) noma okulingana naso. Akunalwazi oludingekayo. Akukho rekodi yobugqila noma noma yikuphi icala elingekabiqedwa kuwe. Ulwazi nobuhlakani: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yekhilikhi, izinqubo kanye nokuqonda ukubhala idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuthola izibalo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ingxenye yomthetho ehulumeni abenza kuKlase 4. Ulwazi lwezindlela zokusebenza ngokwesikhundla kanye nendawo yokusebenza. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi. Ukuthintana. Izindaba zokuxhumana nabantu. Ukuguquguquka. Ukusebenza njengosuku. Ukulungiselela nokuqamba. Ulimi. Amakhono okukhuluma nokubhala kahle.
zu.duties: Nikeza izinsiza zokusebenza ezenza umsebenzi ohlanganisa ukubhala: Bhala, hlela, gcina, faka futhi uthole imibhalo kanye nedatha (inselelo). Buyekeza amarekhodi nezibalo. Phathela imibuzo evamile. Yenza amakhophi futhi wamukele noma uthumele ngefeksi. Yabelana amadokhumenti/amacasho kubantu abahlukahlukene njengokuqondene. Gcina futhi ulondoloze indlela yokulondoloza amafayela yengxenye. Bhala amagama noma omunye umbhalo uma kudingeka. Gcina futhi ulondoloze irekhodi lokungenayo nokuphumayo kwamadokhumenti yengxenye. Nikeza izinsiza zokusiza ekuletheni izimpahla kanye nezinsiza ngaphakathi kwengxenye: Xhumana nabadlali abangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokutholwa kwempahla kanye nezinsiza. Thola izintengo, gcwalisa amafomu okuthenga izimpahla zehhovisi elijwayelekile. Lawula isitoko sehhovisi. Gcina futhi ulondoloze irekhodi lempahla yengxenye (ofisi esifundeni). Nikeza izinsiza zokusiza ekuphatheni abantu ngaphakathi kwengxenye: Gcina irekhodi lezekhishe yengxenye. Gcina futhi ulondoloze amarekhodi abantu ngaphakathi kwengxenye. Gcina futhi ulondoloze irekhodi lobungqondiswa yengxenye. Hlela ukuhamba nendawo yokulala. Nikeza izinsiza zokusiza ekuphatheni imali yengxenye. Faka futhi buyekeza ukuchitha kwemali kungxenye. Hlolisisa ukuthi imali yesibonezelo kanye neyokuhamba zabasebenzi ilungile futhi uyinikeze kumaimanidzela ukuze uvume. Phatha ama-akhawunti efoni kanye nemali etholakala ngaphakathi kwengxenye.

xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se grade 12 (NQF Level 4) okanye esilinganayo. Akukho nqanaba lokuqonda ngobugcisa difunwayo. Akukho bala bolwaphulo-mthetho okanye naziphi na icala elicwalisiweyo nawe. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yolawulo nasekuqhubeni imisebenzi nako ukukwazi ukuthatha iinkcukacha kwimepulo, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nasekuqokeleleni izibalo. Ukuguquguquka. Ukusebenza njengesithili. Ulungiselelo lokuqamba kwakunye nolawulo. Ulwimi. Amakhono amabalwe nethamsanqa lokunxibelelana ebuhlungwini nasekubhalweni.

Hlaziya ukuqwalasela indlela yokwenza imisebenzi yonke. Phatha imibuzo eqelayo. Yenza iikopi ezicashiwe uze wamkele okanye uthumele iifeksi. Yahlula amaxwebhu/amasaka kuwo onke amacandelo eziphathwa njengoko kuyimfuneko. Gcina ulungelelwaniso lokuqamba kwakunye noluhlu lokugcina oluqwalaselwa luloo candelo. Bhala iileta kunye/neminye imiyalezo xa kuyimfuneko. Gcina ulungelelwaniso lokwamkela nokuthumela amaxwebhu ekuqwalaselwa kuloo candelo. Yeza iinkonzo zokuncedisa kumkhondo woluhlu lwamatyala ngaphakathi kwala macandelo: Qhagamshelana namacandelo angaphakathi nangaphandle ukuba uzame ukufumana izinto ezibhaliweyo nokuzelelwa kakhulu. Fumana iintengo ezigqithisiweyo, ugcwalise iifom zokuthenga izinto zeqela lezinto zisebenza kwiofisi. Lawula izinto zokuhlala kwakhona kwiofisi. Gcina ulungelelwaniso lokuqamba kwakunye noluhlu lokugcina izinto ezikwisazakulo esibonelela ngamandla (iiofisi zesithili). Yenza iinkonzo zolawulo lomntu ongumnqayi kuloo candelo: Gcina ulungelelwaniso lobhalo lwesabelo sokungalawulwa kuloo candelo. Gcina ulungelelwaniso lokuqamba kwakunye noluhlu lokugcina iirekhodi zabasebenzi kuloo candelo. Gcina ulungelelwaniso lokuqamba kwakunye noluhlu lokubhalisa kwaleo candelo. Hlela ukuhamba nendawo yokulala. Yezela iinkonzo zolawulo lwezimali kuloo candelo. Thatha uhlaziye iindleko kuloo candelo. Qinisekisa ukuchaneka kwamagama abantu abahamba nendlela yokutya kubasebenzi bese kuthunyelwa kumphathi ukuze azamkele. Lawula ii-akhawunti zefowuni nesoqcwathwa esincinci semali yengeniso yonke yoqoqosho kuloo candelo.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk
jobs.salary_text: R237 453 per annum, plus service benefits
jobs.summary: Administration Clerk needed at the Department of Community Safety Head Office in Johannesburg to provide general clerical support services.
jobs.requirements: A grade 12 (NQF Level 4) certificate or equivalent. No experience required. No criminal record or any pending cases against you. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge of clerical duties, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operate computer and collecting statistics. Knowledge and understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service. Knowledge of work procedures in terms of the working environment. Job Knowledge. Communication. Interpersonal relations. Flexibility. Teamwork. Planning and organisation. Language. Good verbal and written communication skills.
jobs.duties: Render general clerical support services: Record, organise, store, capture and retrieve correspondence and data (line function). Update registers and statistics. Handle routine enquiries. Make photocopies and receive or send facsimiles. Distribute documents/packages to various stakeholders as required. Keep and maintain the filing system for the component. Type letters and/or other correspondence when required. Keep and maintain the incoming and outgoing document register of the component. Provide supply chain clerical support services within the component: Liaise with internal and external stakeholders in relation to procurement of goods and services. Obtain quotations, complete procurement forms for the purchasing of standard office items. Stock control of office stationery. Keep and maintain the asset register of the component (district offices). Provide personnel administration clerical support services within the component: Maintain a leave register for the component. Keep and maintain personnel records in the component. Keep and maintain the attendance register of the component. Arrange travelling and accommodation. Provide financial administration support services in the component. Capture and update expenditure in component. Check correctness of subsistence and travel claims of officials and submit to manager for approval. Handle telephone accounts and petty cash for the component.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. Tshidiso Chabane/ Ms. Dolly Seboane/ Tlalane Koenane Tel No: (011) 689 3845/ 3723/ 3847
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on new Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za/documents (effective from 01 January 2021). All fields in Part A to D of the Z83 form must be completed, and Part E to G noting that there is limited space provided applicants often indicate “refer” to CV or see attached, this is acceptable as long as the CV is attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. The question related to the conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered. Declaration must be completed and signed. The fully completed and signed new Z83 form should be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV only (only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications). Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applicants who do not comply with the above requirements, as well as late applications, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Suitable candidates will undergo a personnel suitability check (Vetting, criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification, and employment verification). The Department of Community Safety reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes. Candidate will be placed according to corridor coordination and the Department’s needs. The Department will not accept posted, emailed or hand delivered applications. We encourage youth, people with disability, coloured, Indian and white to apply and a confirmation of disabilities from a registered medical practitioner must be attached to the application. Please Note: Due to the large number of applications, we envisage to receive, applications will not be acknowledged. If you do not receive any response within 3 months, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Administratiewe Klerk
af.summary: Administratiewe Klerk benodig by die Department of Community Safety Hoofkantoor in Johannesburg om algemene klerklike ondersteuningsdienste te verskaf.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 (NQF Level 4) sertifikaat of gelykwaardig. Geen ervaring vereis nie. Geen kriminele rekord of hangende sake teen jou nie. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van klerklike pligte, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, rekenaar te bedryf en statistiek te versamel. Kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Kennis van werkprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing. Werkkennis. Kommunikasie. Interpersoonlike verhoudings. Buigsaamheid. Spanwerk. Beplanning en organisasie. Taal. Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaf algemene klerklike ondersteuningsdienste: Neem, organiseer, stoor, lê vas en haal korrespondensie en data (lynfunksie). Dateer registers en statistiek op. Hanteer roetine-navrae. Maak fotostate en ontvang of stuur faksimiles. Versprei dokumente/pakkies aan verskeie belanghebbendes soos vereis. Hou en onderhou die indossiëerstelsel vir die komponent. Tik briewe en/of ander korrespondensie wanneer vereis. Hou en onderhou die inkomende en uitgaande dokumentregister van die komponent. Verskaf voorsieningsketting-klerklike ondersteuningsdienste binne die komponent: Skakel met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes met betrekking tot die verkryging van goedere en dienste. Verkry kwotasies, voltooi verkrygingsvorms vir die aankoop van standaard kantoorartikels. Voorraadbeheer van kantoorstasie. Hou en onderhou die bate-register van die komponent (distrikkantore). Verskaf personeeladministrasie-klerklike ondersteuningsdienste binne die komponent: Onderhou 'n verlofregister vir die komponent. Hou en onderhou personeelrekords in die komponent. Hou en onderhou die bywoningsregister van die komponent. Rengel reis en akkommodasie. Verskaf finansiële administrasie-ondersteuningsdienste in die komponent. Lê en dateer besteding in komponent vas. Kontroleer korrektheid van bestaans- en reis-eise van amptenare en dien by bestuurder vir goedkeuring in. Hanteer telefoonrekeninge en kleingeld vir die komponent.

zu.title: IKlerki Bolawulo
zu.summary: Kudingeka IKlerki Bolawulo eNdayumba Elikhulu le-Department of Community Safety e-Johannesburg ukunikeza izinsiza zokusebenza ezijwayelekile zolawulo.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-grade 12 (NQF Level 4) noma esilinganayo. Akukho ngokuhlolwa okudingeki. Kumele ngingabe nendebende yobugebengu noma nakho yisiphi isikhundla esibhekiswe kimi. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yolawulo, izinqubo kanye namandla okungenisa idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqoqa izibalo. Ulwazi nokuqonda umhlaka wolawu ophatha i-Public Service. Ulwazi lwezinqubo zomsebenzi ngokuphathelene nomgwaqo wokusebenza. Ulwazi lomsebenzi. Ukuxhumana. Izinto zokuxhumana nabantu. Ukuguquguquka. Ukusebenza njengolelo. Ukuhlela nokuqamba. Ulimi. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana ngomlomo nangokubhala.
zu.duties: Nikeza izinsiza ezijwayelekile zolawulo: Qamba, hlela, gcina, faka futhi uyokhiphe unxibelelwano nedatha (umsebenzi wolayini). Buyekeza amarejista nezibalo. Phatha imibuzo ejwayelekile. Yenza amakhophi futhi wamukele noma uthumele ama-facsimile. Sabeliza amadokhumenti/amasethi kubahlali abahlukene njengoba kudingeka. Gcine futhi ulondoloze uhlelo lokuqoqwa kwamafayela elikhomponi. Bhala amagama namakhasi okungenisa isikhundla. Thatha amagama nemibhalo efakiwe/kungemunye umuntu ongayibhalayo uma kudingeka. Gcine futhi ulondoloze irejista yamadokhumenti angena napheya elikhomponi. Nikeza izinsiza zolawulo kwentengiso yamalungu aseqophelweni: Xhumana nabahlali abangaphakathi nabangaphandle ngokuthengwa kwempahla namasevisi. Thola izibizo, gcwalisa amafomu okuthenga ngokuthengiswa kwezinto ezijwayelekile zohlaka. Lolonga ukulawula kwesitshudi se-ofisi. Gcine futhi ulondoloze irejista yempahla yelikhomponi (ofisi zesifunda). Nikeza izinsiza zolawulo zokuphatha iziqhingi kusaphakathi: Gcina futhi ulondoloze irejista yokushiya kwabasebenzi. Gcina futhi ulondoloze amarekhodi abasebenzi esikhundleni. Gcina futhi ulondoloze irejista yokuhamba nemoto yamaphoyisa. Hlela ukuhamba nendawo yokulala. Nikeza izinsiza zokuphatha izimali zikahulumeni eqhingini. Faka futhi buyekeza ukuchithwa kwemali esikhundleni. Hlola ukulungiswa kwama-claims okuhamba nokudla kubasebenzi bahlali bese uyethumela kummanja ukuthi awugunyaze. Phatha ama-akhawunti efoni nemali encane yelikhomponi.

xh.title: Iclerka yolawulo
xh.summary: Kufunethi Iclerka yolawulo kwi Ofisi Elikhulu le Department of Community Safety e Johannesburg ukunika iinkonzo ezijolise ekwenziweni kweeklarka.
xh.requirements: Isetifikethi se grade 12 (NQF Level 4) okanye eselingana nalo. Akukho mfundo yamava edingekayo. Kufunekanga usho nayiphi na imoto ephangayo okanye ukho nangalo nayiphi na icala elisasazekileyo malunga nawe. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yeklarka, iindlela ezisetyenziswayo kananjalo nakuqonda ukubeka iidata, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqokelela izibalo. Ulwazi nokuqonda kwesakhiwo semithetho esilawula inkonzo kaRhulumnde. Ulwazi lweendlela zomsebenzi ngokwemohlamelelo wokusebenza. Ulwazi lomsebenzi. Unxibelelwano. Unxibelelwano namanye abantu. Ukuguquguquka. Ukusebenza njengesithili. Uqeqesho loluhlelo. Ulwimi. Amakhono amabalulwimi kunye nokubhalwa kolwimi.
xh.duties: Yenza iinkonzo ezijolise ekwenziweni kweeklarka: Qamba, hlela, gcina uze ugcine ulwazi ngokulandelelana kwemibhalo nedata. Lazisa izibalo. Phatha imibuzo eqhelekileyo. Yenza iikhophi nokuwamkula okuthumela iifeksi. Yahlula imibhalo/amasenthumba kubathathi nxaxheba bahlukeneyo njengoko kufunekayo. Gcina ulunjiselwayo lokuqulunqwa kwemibhalo lwesebe. Bhala iileta noma ezinye imibhalo xa kufunekayo. Gcina ulunjiselwayo lokuqulunqwa kwemibhalo engenayo nophumlayo lwesebe. Nikeza iinkonzo ezijolise ekwenziweni kweeklarka kwinkqubo yomthengiso ngaphakathi kwesebe: Qhagamshelana nabathathi nxaxheba bangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokwentengo yemimiselo nezabelo. Fumana izicelo, gedzalisa iifom zomthengiso zokuthenga izinto ezijoliswe kwisebe. Lawula isitokhwe zemisebenzi yofisi. Gcina ulwazi lwamafa yemiselo esebe (ofisi zengingqi). Nikeza iinkonzo ezijolise ekwenziweni kweeklarka yolawulo lwabantu ngaphakathi kwesebe: Gcina ulwazi lwamalungelo kwisebe. Gcina ulwazi lwabantu kwisebe. Gcina ulwazi lokubakho kubasebenzi kwisebe. Lungelelanisa ukuhamba nendawo yokuhlala. Nikeza iinkonzo zolawulo lweemali kwisebe. Faka ulwazi ngokusetyenziswa kweemali kwisebe. Qinisekisa ukuziphatha kweemfuno ezikwangoku zohamba nokuvela kwabasebenzi uze uzigcwalise kumlawuli ukuvunywa. Phatha iakhawunti zefowuni naxa imali yasekhondlweni yesebe.
