af.title: Sekretaris Regsdienste
af.summary: Sekretaris om sekretariële en ontvangersondersteuning aan die kantoor van die uitvoerende gesag by die Department of Community Safety in Johannesburg te verleen.
af.requirements: Graad 12 met tik as 'n vak of enige ander opleidingskursus/kwalifikasie wat die persoon in staat sal stel om die werk bevredigend te verrig. Geen strafrekord of enige hangende sake teen jou nie. Kennis en Vaardighede: Taalvaardighede en die vermoë om goed met mense op verskillende vlakke en uit verskillende agtergronde te kommunikeer. Goeie telefoonetiket. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Soliede organisatoriese vaardighede. Hoë vlak van betroubaarheid. Basiese skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om met takt en diskresie op te tree. Goeie versorging en aanbieding.
af.duties: Verleen 'n sekretariële/ontvangersondersteuningsdiens aan die kantoor van die uitvoerende gesag. Dit sal onder andere die volgende behels: Ontvang telefoonoproepe en verwys die oproepe na die regte persone. Ontvang besoekers by die kantoor van die uitvoerende gesag. Koördineer afsprake met die afsprakesekretaris. Tik dokumente vir die personeel binne die kantoor. Bedryf kantoortoerusting soos faksmasjiene en fotokopieerders. Verleen 'n klerklike ondersteuningsdiens aan die kantoor. Dit sal onder andere die volgende behels: Skakel met reisagentskappe om reisreëlings vir die personeel van die kantoor en die uitvoerende gesag te tref. Rêel besprekings en geleenthede vir die kantoor van die uitvoerende gesag. Identifiseer plekke, nooi rolspelers en organiseer vermaak. Verwerk die reis- en bestaansklappe van die personeel van die kantoor van die uitvoerende gesag. Opstel van roetine-korrespondensie en verslae. Administreer sake soos verlofregisters en telefoonrekeninge. Hanteer die verkryging van standaarditems soos stasievar, vermaak ens. Bly op hoogte met betrekking tot voorskrifte/beleide en prosedures van toepassing op haar/sy werkterrein. Dit sal onder andere die volgende behels: Bestudeer die relevante Openbare Diens- en departementele voorskrifte/beleide en ander dokumente om te verseker dat die toepassing daarvan behoorlik verstaan word. Bly op hoogte van die prosedures en prosesse wat in die kantoor van die uitvoerende gesag van toepassing is.

zu.title: Unobhala Wezinsizakalo Esemthethweni
zu.summary: Unobhala onikeza inkxaso yokubhala nokwamukela abavakashi ohlelweni lehhovisi likaholi wemibuso e-Department of Community Safety e-Johannesburg.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 enokuthayipha njengesifundo noma noma yiphi enye indlela yokuzifundela/izifundo ezizokwenza umuntu ukwazi ukwenza lo msebenzi ngendlela ethile. Kungabi nalungelo lobugebengu noma nanoma yimiphi imicimbi ekushiya phambili. Ulwazi namakhono: Amakhono olwimi kanye nethonya lokuxhumana kahle nabantu abakuwo wonke amazinga futhi abavela kumawele amaningi. Indlela enhle yokukhuluma efonini. Ukwazi ukusebenza ngemikhongothi. Amakhono ahleliwe. Izinga eliphezulu lokwethembeka. Amakhono abalulekile okubhala. Ikhono lokuziphatha ngobuhlakani kanye nokuzigcina. Ukuzigqoka nokubukeka kahle.
zu.duties: Nikela ngenkxaso yokubhala/okwamukela abavakashi ohlelweni lehhovisi likaholi wemibuso. Lokhu kuzohlanganisa okulandelayo: Thola amakholi efonini uze awaqondise kubantu abafanele. Amukele abavakashi ohlelweni lehhovisi likaholi wemibuso. Hlela izinkomashi nonobhala wezinkomashi. Thayipha amadokhumenti abasebenzi ohlelweni. Sebenzisa izinto zehhovisi njengemishini yefeksi kanye namashidi okukopisha. Nikela ngenkxaso yamaphepha ohlelweni. Lokhu kuzohlanganisa okulandelayo: Xhumana namawensi okuhamba ukuze uhlele ukuba bawakho abasebenzi behhovisi kanye noholi wemibuso. Hlela izinkundla kanye nemicimbi yehhovisi likaholi wemibuso. Khomba izikhungo, mema abantu abayindawo yomcimbi uze uhlele ukudla. Cubungula izinkomba zokuhamba nokuhlala zabasebenzi behhovisi likaholi wemibuso. Bhala imilayezo evamile nemibiko. Phatha izindaba njengokubhalwa kwabagodluli kanye namakhounti efonini. Phatha ukuthenga izinto eziyisisekelo njengokubhala, ukudla, njll. Gcina ulwazi lwakuqhamuka ngemithetho/inqulumo kanye nezinqumo ezisebenza ohlelweni lwakhe. Lokhu kuzohlanganisa okulandelayo: Funda imithetho/inqulumo yesevisi kahulumeni noma yomnyango kanye namanye amadokhumenti ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi uyayiqonda ngendlela efanele. Gcina ulwazi ngendlela nezinqumo ezisebenza ohlelweni lehhovisi likaholi wemibuso.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Wokuba Ngumongameli Kweenkonzo Zomthetho
xh.summary: Umsebenzi wokubhala nokwamkela abantu kwindlu yenkundla yophiko luphathi elikwiofisi yolawulo kwi Department of Community Safety e Johannesburg.
xh.requirements: I-Garde 12 ngesayensi yokuchwetheza noma naniphi na izifundo/iziqinisekiso eziza kumenza umntu ukuba akwazi ukwenza umsebenzi ngokwanelisayo. Akukho mlando wobugcwaliswa nabanjwa na izigwebo ezikundululwe ngalo lonke ixesha. Ulwazi namakhono: Amakhono olwimi nokubonakalisa ukuba umntu ukwazi ukuziphatha kakuhle nabantu abakuzo iinqanaba ezahlukeneyo nendalo ezahlukeneyo. Ukuziphatha kakuhle kuyo yonke imisebenzi eqhuba ngomnxeba. Ulwazi ngokusebenzisa iikhompyutha. Amakhono olungiselelo olululo. Iqondo eliphezulu lokuzinikela ngesithembiso. Amakhono obhalo abucukubhedi angenamva. Ikhono lokuziphatha ngobuqeqesho nokubambelela. Ukuzoncedakalisa ngokwemigaqo nemigaqo yendlela yokuziphatha.
xh.duties: Unikeze inkonzo yokubhala nokwamkela abantu kwindlu yenkundla yophiko luphathi. Oku kubandakanya, phakathi kwamanye amaxwebhu, oku kulandelayo: Ukuzamkela iinkamvo ezivela kumnxeba kwaye uzigqithise kubantu abafanelekileyo. Ukuzamkela iindwendwe zendlu yenkundla yophiko luphathi. Ukulungelelanisa iindlela zemibuzo nomongameli wemibuzo. Ukuchwetheza amaxwebhu abasebenzi bendlu yenkundla. Ukusebenzisa izixhobo zendlu njengamasini e-fax nakwindlu yabakhi. Unikeze inkonzo yokubhala kwindlu yenkundla yophiko luphathi. Oku kubandakanya, phakathi kwamanye amaxwebhu, oku kulandelayo: Unxibelelane nabakho amarhwebo okuhamba ukuze alungiselele indlela yokuhamba yabasebenzi bendlu yophiko luphathi. Ulungelelanisa iindibano nemiba yendlu yenkundla yophiko luphathi. Uphawule iindawo, wamkele abanomdla kulmsbenzi aze alungiselele iziselo ezihlahluzayo. Cima iindlela zokuhamba nezicelo zokubuyela kumzi zabasebenzi bendlu yenkundla yophiko luphathi. Bhala iindaba ezinkqubo nemiqulu yemiba. Lawula izinto ezinjengobhalo lwesixa lokuphumla ne-akhawunti zeminxeba. Yiba negalelo ekuthengeni izinto ezinkqubo ezinjengobhalo lwezinto zokubhala, iziselo ezihlahluzayo njl njl. af.title: Sekretaresse Sekuriteit en Fasiliteite
af.summary: Verskaf sekretariële en resepsioniste-ondersteuning aan die uitvoerende gesag se kantoor by die Department of Community Safety-hoofkantoor in Johannesburg, waarvoor Graad 12 met tik en 'n skoon strafregister vereis word.
af.requirements: Graad 12 met tik as 'n vak of enige ander opleidingskursus/kwalifikasie wat die persoon in staat sal stel om die werk bevredigend te verrig. Geen strafregister of enige hangende sake teen jou nie. Kennis en Vaardighede: Taalvaardighede en die vermoë om goed met mense op verskillende vlakke en vanuit verskillende agtergronde te kommunikeer. Goede telefoonetiket. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Soliede organisatoriese vaardighede. Hoë vlak van betroubaarheid. Basiese skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om met takt en diskresie op te tree. Goeie versorging en aanbieding.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n sekretariële-/resepsioniste-ondersteuningsdiens aan die kantoor van die uitvoerende gesag. Dit sal, onder andere, die volgende behels: Neem telefoonoproepe aan en verwys die oproepe na die regte persone. Ontvang besoekers by die kantoor van die uitvoerende gesag. Koördineer afsprake met die afsprake-sekretaresse. Tik dokumente vir die personeel binne die kantoor. Bedryf kantoortoerusting soos faksmasjiene en fotostaatmasjiene. Verskaf klerke-ondersteuning aan die kantoor. Dit sal, onder andere, die volgende behels: Skakel met reisagentskappe om reisreëlings vir die personeel van die kantoor en die uitvoerende gesag te tref. Reël vergaderings en byeenkomste vir die kantoor van die uitvoerende gesag. Identifiseer plekke, nooi rolspelers en organiseer verkwikking. Verwerk die reis- en bestaansaansprake van die personeel van die kantoor van die uitvoerende gesag. Opstel van roetine-korrespondensie en verslae. Administreer sake soos verlofregisters en telefoonrekenings. Hanteer die verkryging van standaarditems soos stasierynware, verkwikking ens. Bly op datum met betrekking tot voorskrifte/beleide en prosedures van toepassing op haar/sy werkterrein. Dit sal, onder andere, die volgende behels: Bestudeer die tersaaklike Openbare Diens- en departementele voorskrifte/beleide en ander dokumente om te verseker dat die toepassing daarvan behoorlik verstaan word. Bly op hoogte van die prosedures en prosesse wat in die kantoor van die uitvoerende gesag van toepassing is.

zu.title: Unobhala Wezokuphepha Nesikhungo
zu.summary: Nika inkonzo yobhala nemisebenzi yokwamukela abantu ehhovisi likaholi womnyango we-Department of Community Safety eJohannesburg, okudinga ibhasi le-Grade 12 nobungcweti bokuthayipha kanye nerekhodi elicacile lezenzo ezingezomthetho.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 inezokuthayipha njengesifundo noma nanoma yiphi iphulasimini yokuhlolwa/iziqu ezizomsize umuntu ukuba azifeze kahle le misebenzi. Kungabi nalutho olubi kurekhodi lezenzo ezingezomthetho noma nanoma yiphi inhlolamavaluwe embikho ngawe. Ulwazi Namakhono: Amakhono olwimi nokukwazi ukuxhumana kahle nabantu abakumazinga ahlukene abevela kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zendabuko. Amakhono amahle okusebenzisa ifoni. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono amahle okuhlela izinto. Izinga eliphezulu lokuthembeka. Amakhono abhalwayo okuxhumana okuyisisekelo. Ukukwazi ukuziphatha ngobuwula nononso. Ukuqapha okuhle kokubukeka nokwethula.
zu.duties: Nika inkonzo yobhala/yokwamukela abantu ehhovisi likaholi. Lokhu, phakathi kokunye, kusho ukulandelayo: Amukela amafoni uze adlulisele kulabo abafanele. Amukela abavakashi ehhovisi likaholi. Hlela eminye yonke imihlangano nesekela kaholi ohlelayo imihlangano. Thayipha amadokhumenti abasebenzi bangehhovisi. Sebenzisa izinto zehhovisi njengemishini yefaxi namashishini lokukopisha. Nikeza inkonzo yobhala ehhovisi. Lokhu, phakathi kokunye, kusho ukulandelayo: Xhumana namaphoyinti okuhamba ukuze uhlele izinhlela zokuhamba abasebenzi behhovisi nakaholi. Hlela imihlangano nemicimbi yehhovisi likaholi. Thola izikhungo, mema abahlshare nokuhlela iziphuzo. Linganisa izimangazo zokuhamba nezokuhlala abasebenzi bangehhovisi likaholi. Bhala imilando yemibhalo nemibiko yansuku zonke. Phatha izindaba njengerekhodi lezinyanga zemali nefoni. Phatha ukuthengwa kwemisebenzi evamile njengesitashi, iziphuzo njll. Gcina ulwazi olusanda ngemithetho/mapholisi namawesinsi asebenza esikhundleni sakhe. Lokhu, phakathi kokunye, kusho ukulandelayo: Funda imithetho/mapholisi yoMnyango wezeNkonzo Zomphakathi nalemnyangweni neminye imibhalo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umqondo wayo uyawuzwa kahle. Gcina ukuya phambili nawesinsi namasu ahamba kaholi.

xh.title: Unobumba wezoKhuseleko nezIziko
xh.summary: Nika inkxaso yobumbumba nomamkeli kwindlu yolawulo lolugunyazwe kwiHead Office yeDepartment of Community Safety eJohannesburg, kufuneka kube khona iGrade 12 nendlela yokuchwetheza kwaye kufuneka ugqibe irekhodi yezono ecocekileyo.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 12 nenkqubo yokuchwetheza njengesiyifundo okanye naliphi na enye ikhosi yokuziklasa / ngesidanga ezakwenza umntu ukwazi ukwenza umsebenzi ngokwanelisayo. Akukho rekhoti yezono naziphi na iicala ezisayo ngokuchasene nawe. Ulwazi nakhono: Ikhono lolwimi nendlela yokunxibelelana kakuhle nabantu abaqatshwe kumanqanaba ahlukeneyo nase kwindalo ehlukileyo. Indlela entle yokuthetha kumnxeba. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha. Aakhono alungileyo olwazi lokuqamba. Iqanaba eliphezulu lokuthembeka. Aakhono abalulekileyo bokubhala. Ikhono lokuziphatha ngobuchule nangokungazihlali phambi kwabantu. Ukuzilungisa nokubonakala kakuhle.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yobumbumba / nomamkeli kwindlu yolawulo lolugunyazwe. Oku kuya, phakathi kwezinye izinto, kuqulathe oku landelayo: Yamkela iincwadi zocingo uze uzidlude kubantu abachanekileyo. Yamkela ababendisiyo kwindlu yolawulo lolugunyazwe. Qhoboshela izicwangciso zokubonana nonobumba wezicwangciso. Chwetheza amaxwebhu abasebenzi bendlu yolawulo. Sebenzisa izixhobo zendlu yolawulo njengamashishini othumelo nasezicwangcisi zokufotokoza. Nika inkxaso yomsebenzi wezobhalo kwindlu yolawulo. Oku kuya, phakathi kwezinye izinto, kuqulathe oku landelayo: Nxibelelane neeenkampani zohambo ukuze wenze izicwangciso zohambo abasebenzi bendlu yolawulo nolugunyazwe. Cwangcisa iindibano nemicimbo bendlu yolawulo lolugunyazwe. Phawula iindawo, mema abathathi-nxaxheba uze uhlele ukuphatha okunaswazi. Cedisa iimala zohambo nezokusuka kunyuka abasebenzi bendlu yolawulo lolugunyazwe. Bhala iincwadi nemiqulu eqhelekileyo. Lawula izinto ezinjengeerekhodi zeholide ne-akhawunti zocingo. Phatha ukuthengwa kwezinto ezisemgangathweni ezinjengesiqwengqwezi, ukuphatha okunaswazi njalo njalo. Hlala utyalwe ngemigaqo / iinkqubo nendlela ezisebenza kumsebenzi wakhe. Oku kuya, phakathi kwezinye izinto, kuqulathe oku landelayo: Funda imigaqo / iinkqubo yoLuntu kunye nesebe kwaye namaxwebhu amanye ukuqinisekisa ukuba ulwazi lokuzisebenzisa luyaqondwa kakuhle. Hlala utyalwe ngeenkqubo nemicimba esebenza kwindlu yolawulo lolugunyazwe.

zu.title: Unobhala
zu.summary: Nika inkxaso yobuhlakani bomlomo nobekwabelule kulezi zikhungo zikaholi wemigungo, uphathwe amakholi, abavakashi kanye nemibhalo yokuhlangana e Southern Corridor, Gauteng.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 enegadi yokubhala njengesifundo noma noma yiphi na enye indlela yokuzifundisa/ noma isitifikedi sekhono elizomsekela ukuba akwazi ukwenza umsebenzi ngendlela efanele. Sukuba nobala bokwenza ubugebengu obubhalwe kumaphoyisa noma ukuba nalucala oluzayo oludinisayo. Ulwazi nakhono: Ulwazi lolimi kanye nesakhono sokuxhumana kahle ngezinhlobo zabantu abaningi. Indlela efanele yokuphendula ocingo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okuhlelwa komsebenzi ohlelekile. Izinga eliphezulu lokwethembeka. Amakhono abalulekile okubhala iziyaluzi. Isakhono sokuziphatha kahle nokuba yimfihlo. Ukuzinanela ngendlela efanele.
zu.duties: Nika inkxaso yobuhlakani bomlomo nobekwabelule kulezi zikhungo zikaholi wemigungo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi okulandelayo: Thola amakholi ocingo futhi uthumele kubantu abafanele. Thola abavakashi kulezi zikhungo zikaholi wemigungo. Lungiselela izinkathi zokuhlangana kanye nenkosi yezincwadi zokuhlangana. Bhala izincwadi zikaholi bamnikazi. Sebenzisa izinto zokusebenza ofisini ezinjengemishini yefeksi namakopi. Sika inkxaso yekhono lezinsiza kulezi zikhungo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi okulandelayo: Xhumana nezinkampani ezihlela amagama sika rhumela ohlele abasebenzi balezi zikhungo kanye nenkosi yezomthetho. Hlela izinkhulumo nezinkathi zokuhlangana kulezi zikhungo zikaholi wemigungo. Thola izindawo zokuhlangana, mema abathintekayo futhi uhlele ukudla. Sebenzisa izimali ezihlukene zohambo noma zokuphila zikaholi bamnikazi balezi zikhungo. Bhala izincwadi nezibhalo ezivamile. Phatha izindaba ezinjengabhalo bokulala kanye neziphithiphithi zocingo. Phatha ukuthengwa kwezinto ezivamile njengamaphensela, izinto zokudla, njll. Gcina ubumfihlo ngamaphoyisa/noma imikhuba esebenzayo ekubusweni komhlaba. Lokhu kufaka phakathi okulandelayo: Fundisisa imithetho yomphakathi nezincwadi noma imikhuba emayelana nezikhungo noma eminye imibhalo ukuze kuqonde ukusetshenziswa kwawo. Hlala ukhululekile ngemikhuba namagama asetshenziswa kulezi zikhungo zikaholi wemigungo.

xh.title: Unobhala
xh.summary: Nika inkxaso yobuhloli nobe nomamkeli kwindawo yokusebenza kolawulo oluphakamileyo, uphatha iicandi, iindwendwe nam cathungathelwe kumazantsi eNkoridor, Gauteng.
xh.requirements: I-Garde 12 netayiphu njengenxalenye yenkqubo yefundi okanye naliphi na enye ikhondo yokuqeqesha/igqwetha eliza kumvumela umntu ukuba azenze ngokwanelisayo lo msebenzi. Akukho ngumba wogawa obhalisiweyo okanye naliphi na icala elisasazela kuwe. Ulwazi nakhono: Amakhono olwimi nendlela yokunxibelelana kakuhle nabantu abakumazinga ahlukeneyo kwaye bavela kumvelaphi ehlukileni. Indlela elungileyo yokuthetha kwingxoxele yefowuni. Ukuba nakho ukusebenzisa iikhompyutha. Amakhono ahloniphekileyo e-organisa. Iqondo eliphezulu lokuzithembisa. Amakhona abalulekileyo okubhala. Ukuba nakho ukuziphatha ngobulumko nangokugqitha. Ukuzigqoka nokuzibonakalisa kakuhle.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yobuhloli/nomamkeli kwindawo yokusebenza kolawulo oluphakamileyo. Oku kuya kubandakanya phakathi kokunye oku landelayo: Yamkela iicandi zefowuni uze uzidlulisele kubantu abachanekileyo. Yamkela iindwendwe ezindaweni yokusebenza kolawulo oluphakamileyo. Lawula iindibano nomongameli weendibano. Thayipha amaxwebhu abasebenzi bendawo yokusebenza. Sebenzisa izixhobo zendawo yokusebenza njengemishini yefax naba-balishi. Nika inkxaso yomsebenzi welophu endaweni yokusebenza. Oku kuya kubandakanya phakathi kokunye oku landelayo: Qinengamana neeamphi zohambo ukuze uhlele iindulamthetho zohambo zabasebenzi bendawo yokusebenza nolawulo oluphakamileyo. Hlela iindibano nemicimbo yendawo yokusebenza kolawulo oluphakamileyo. Zhaga iindawo, mema abadlali bemimiselo uze uhlele okokunwa. Asbheshe iingxabano zohambo nezexabiso elenzelwa kukutya zabasebenzi bendawo yokusebenza kolawulo oluphakamileyo. Bhala oovimba beendaba abajikeleziyo nengxelo. Lawula izinto ezinjengezicatshulwa zeholide nee-akhawunti zefowuni. Phatha ukuthenga izinto ezingeziselwa njengamapensile, okokunwa, njalo njalo. jobs.title: Director: Human Capital Management
jobs.department: Department of Co-operative Governance and Traditional Affairs
jobs.summary: Director of Human Capital Management position in Johannesburg requiring an NQF level 7 qualification and five years' middle or senior management HR experience in the Public Service.
jobs.requirements: Matric plus NQF level 7 as recognised by SAQA in Human Resource Management/Public Management/Business Management or relevant qualification. Coupled by a minimum of 5 years’ experience at a Middle /Senior Management level in Human Resource Management in the Public Service. Furthermore, the recommended candidate will be required to produce his/her SMS Pre-entry certificate as offered by the National School of Governance (NSG) prior to the appointment being made. Competencies: Knowledge and understanding of legislative and Policy framework governing the Human Resource Management in the Public Service. Knowledge and understanding of Human Resources Mechanisms, Institutional processes and systems regulating the practice of Human Resources in the Public Service. Knowledge and understanding of Departmental Strategic focus and Human Resource priorities, Strategic Capability and Leadership, Programme and Project Management, Financial Management, Change Management, Knowledge Management, Service Delivery Innovation (SDI), Problem Solving and Analysis, People Management and Empowerment, Client Orientation and Customer Focus, Communication, and Honesty and Integrity. A valid driver’s licence.
jobs.duties: Organisational Development and Change Management: Lead organisational design, structure and post establishment management, job evaluation, job profiling, business process mapping and work-study investigations. Develop and implement organisational change interventions, human resource plans and policies aligned with departmental priorities and available resources. Human Capital Planning and Talent Management: Provide strategic leadership in workforce planning, recruitment, selection, retention, career development, succession planning and employment equity. Oversee talent management and development programmes, including training, bursaries, learnerships, internships, mentorship, and leadership development. Direct the implementation of the departmental Human Resource Plan, Human Resource Development Strategy and Workplace Skills Plan. Oversee remuneration, conditions of service, personnel administration, and human resource information systems. Performance Management and Development: Lead the implementation and monitoring of the Performance Management and Development System (PMDS), including performance assessment, moderation, reporting, recognition and management of underperformance and disputes. Utilise performance information to inform talent development, accountability, and organisational effectiveness. Employee Relations, Health, and Wellness: Provide strategic oversight of labour relations, grievances, disciplinary processes, collective bargaining, negotiations, and dispute resolution. Direct employee health and wellness programmes and oversee the implementation of occupational health, safety, and environmental management initiatives. Strategic Leadership, Governance and Resource Management: Provide strategic and operational leadership to the Directorate, ensuring achievement of performance targets and compliance with applicable legislation, policies, and public service prescripts. Manage the Directorate’s budget, human resources, performance, skills development, leave administration and internal controls. Oversee audit findings, risk management and corrective actions to strengthen governance and accountability. Develop employees, manage workplace conflict, and promote ethical conduct and a high-performance culture. Provide strategic advice to departmental leadership on organisational effectiveness, workforce capability, talent management, employee relations and human capital risks to enhance institutional capacity and service delivery.
jobs.enquiries: Caiphus/ Andy, cell: 071 474 7078/51
jobs.applications: Applications should be submitted strictly online at https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za/Public/Jobs.aspx FOR ATTENTION : Human Capital management
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly online completed Z83 form It is our intention to promote representivity (race, gender, and disability) in the Public Service through the filling of these posts. Preference will be given to people with disabilities, and they will be exempted from a driver’s license requirement. Applications        should       be     submitted       strictly    online     at https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za/Public/Jobs.aspx                                  or http://jobs.gauteng.gov.za/Public/Jobs.aspx and it should be accompanied by a most recent Z83 form which may be obtained from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents. and comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV), certified copies of qualifications and Identity will be submitted upon request (no postal or hand delivery applications will be accepted). It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Furthermore, the recommended candidate will be required to produce his/her SMS Pre-entry certificate as offered by the National School of Governance (NSG) prior to the appointment being made. The certificate for entry into SMS and full details can be sourced by the following link: http://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Preference will be given to female applicants for SMS posts. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments; one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Correspondence will only be limited to shortlisted candidates. If you have not been contacted within 3 months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Failure to comply with the above instructions of specifically attaching a recent Z83 and a comprehensive CV will result in applications being disqualified. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Menslike Kapitaalbestuur
af.summary: Pos van Direkteur van Menslike Kapitaalbestuur in Johannesburg wat 'n NQF-vlak 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se middel- of seniorbestuurs-ER-ervaring in die Openbare Diens vereis.
af.requirements: Matriek plus NQF-vlak 7 soos deur SAQA erken in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur/Openbare Bestuur/Sakebestuur of 'n relevante kwalifikasie. Vergezel deur 'n minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n Middel-/Seniorbestuursvlak in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur in die Openbare Diens. Verder sal die aanbevole kandidaat vereis word om sy/haar SMS-voor-toelatingsertifikaat soos aangebied deur die National School of Governance (NSG) voor te lê voordat die aanstelling gemaak word. Bevoegdhede: Kennis en begrip van die wetgewende en beleidsraamwerk wat Menslike Hulpbronbestuur in die Openbare Diens regeer. Kennis en begrip van Menslike Hulpbronmeganismes, institusionele prosesse en stelsels wat die beoefening van Menslike Hulpbronne in die Openbare Diens reguleer. Kennis en begrip van departementele strategiese fokus en Menslike Hulpbronprioriteite, Strategiese Vermoë en Leierskap, Program- en Projektbestuur, Finansiële Bestuur, Veranderingsbestuur, Kennisbestuur, Diensleweringinnovasie (SDI), Probleemoplossing en Analise, Mensebestuur en Bemagtiging, Kliëntoriëntasie en Kliëntfokus, Kommunikasie, en Eerlikheid en Integriteit. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Organisatoriese Ontwikkeling en Veranderingsbestuur: Lei organisatoriese ontwerp, struktuur en postvestigingsbestuur, werkwaardering, werkprofilerings, besigheidsproseskartering en werkstudie-onderzoek. Ontwikkel en implementeer organisatoriese veranderingsintervensies, menslike hulpbronplanne en -beleide in lyn met departementele prioriteite en beskikbare hulpbronne. Menslike Kapitaalbeplanning en Talentbestuur: Verskaf strategiese leierskap in werksmagbeplanning, werwing, seleksie, behoud, loopbaanontwikkeling, opvolgingsbeplanning en indiensnemingsgelykheid. Hou toesig oor talentbestuurs- en ontwikkelingsprogramme, insluitend opleiding, beurse, leerderskappe, internskappe, mentorskap en leierskapsontwikkeling. Lei die implementering van die departementele Menslike Hulpbronplan, Menslike Hulpbronontwikkelingstrategie en Werkplekvaardigheidsplan. Hou toesig oor vergoeding, diensvoorwaardes, personeeladministrasie en menslike hulpbroninligtingstelsels. Prestasiebestuur en -ontwikkeling: Lei die implementering en monitering van die Prestasiebestuur- en -ontwikkelingstelsel (PMDS), insluitend prestasie-assesserings, moderering, verslagdoening, erkenning en bestuur van onderprestasie en geskille. Benut prestasie-inligting om talentontwikkeling, aanspreeklikheid en organisatoriese doeltreffendheid in te lig. Werknemerverhoudinge, Gesondheid en Welstand: Verskaf strategiese toesig oor arbeidsverhoudinge, klagtes, dissiplinêre prosesse, kollektiewe bedinging, onderhandelings en geskilbeslegting. Lei werknemergesondheids- en welstandsprogramme en hou toesig oor die implementering van beroepsgesondheids-, veiligheids- en omgewingsbestuursinisiatiewe. Strategiese Leierskap, Bestuur en Hulpbronbestuur: Verskaf strategiese en operasionele leierskap aan die Direktoraat, en verseker die bereiking van prestasieteikens en nakoming van toepaslike wetgewing, beleide en openbare diensvoorskryfte. Bestuur die Direktoraat se begroting, menslike hulpbronne, prestasie, vaardigheidsontwikkeling, verlofadministrasie en interne kontroles. Hou toesig oor ouditbevindings, risikobestuur en korrektiewe maatreëls om bestuur en aanspreeklikheid te versterk. Ontwikkel werknemers, bestuur werkplekkonflik en bevorder etiese gedrag en 'n hoëprestasiekultuur. Verskaf strategiese advies aan departementele leierskap oor organisatoriese doeltreffendheid, werksmagvermoë, talentbestuur, werknemerverhoudinge en menslike kapitaalrisiko's om institusionele kapasiteit en dienslewering te verbeter.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ukuphathwa Kwemithombo Yabantu
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi wokuphathwa kwemithombo yabantu eJohannesburg esifuna iziqu ezinga le-NQF level 7 nobuchule eminyakeni emihlanu yokuphathwa kwemisebenzi yabantu emazingeni aphakathi noma aphezulu ezebholiki kwi-Public Service.
zu.requirements: I-Matric kanye ne-NQF level 7 eqiniswe yi-SAQA kwi-Human Resource Management/Public Management/Business Management noma iziqu ezihambisanayo. Kuphinda kube nobuhlobo bokuhlangeneminye unyaka osukude ngaphakathi kweminyaka eyi-5 bokuhlangeneminye emazingeni e-Middle/Senior Management e-Human Resource Management e-Public Service. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kumelwe umuntu okhethiwe ashoshe isitifikedi sakhe/sayo se-SMS Pre-entry esinikezwa i-National School of Governance (NSG) ngaphambi kokumiswa esikhundleni. Amakhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda uhlelo lomthetho kanye ne-Policy framework elawula i-Human Resource Management kwi-Public Service. Ulwazi nokuqonda izindlela ze-Human Resources, izinqubo zesikhungo kanye nezinhlelo ezilawula ukusebenza kwe-Human Resources kwi-Public Service. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukugxila kwe-Departmental Strategic kanye nezinto eziphambili ze-Human Resource, ikhono le-Strategic kanye ne-Leadership, i-Programme kanye ne-Project Management, i-Financial Management, i-Change Management, i-Knowledge Management, i-Service Delivery Innovation (SDI), ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya, ukuphathwa kwabantu kanye nokunika amandla, ukuqonda iklayenti kanye nokugxila kumthengi, ukuxhumana, kanye nokuqotho nokuzinza. Ilelisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Ukuthuthukisa inhlangano kanye ne-Change Management: Yiba nomthelela ekwakhiweni kwenhlangano, esakhiweni kanye nokuphathwa kwesikhundla esisekelwe, ukuhlola imisebenzi, ukubhalisa imisebenzi, ukumapa izinqubo zebhizinisi kanye nokuphenya izifundo zomsebenzi. Thuthukisa futhi usebenzise ukungenelela kokushintsha kwenhlangano, izinhlelo kanye nezinqubo zemithombo yabantu ezihambisana nezinto eziphambili zomnyango kanye namathuba akhona. Ukuletha amasu okubala imithombo yabantu kanye ne-Talent Management: Nikeza ukubusa okunesibalo ekubeleni amandla abasebenzi, ekuqashweni, eku khethweni, eku gcineni, ekuthuthukiseni umsebenzi, ekubeleni ukulandelana kanye ne-employment equity. Qaphula ukuphathwa kwamakhono kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa, okuhlanganisa ukuqeqeshwa, amabhasari, ama-learnerships, ama-internship, ukwesekwa, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kobuholi. Hola ukusebenziswa kwe-Departmental Human Resource Plan, i-Human Resource Development Strategy kanye ne-Workplace Skills Plan. Qaphula umvuzo, izimo zokusebenza, ukuphathwa kwabasebenzi, kanye nezinhlelo zemithombo yabantu. Ukuphathwa kwayinhlelo yokusebenza kanye nokuthuthukisa: Yiba nomthelela ekusebenziseni nasekuqapheleleni i-Performance Management and Development System (PMDS), okuhlanganisa ukuhlola inkalo, ukuqaphela, ukubika, ukubonga kanye nokuphathwa kokusebenza kabi kanye nezinxabano. Sebenzisa ulwazi ngemiphumela yokusebenza ukwazisa ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono, ukubophezela, kanye nokuqina kwenhlangano. Izindaba zabasebenzi, impilo kanye nesigcino: Nikeza ukubusa okunesibalo ezindabeni zomsebenzi, izikhalazo, izinqubo zokujezisa, ukuxoxisana ngokuhlanganyela, izinkulumo, kanye nokuxazulula izinxabano. Hola izinhlelo zempilo kanye nosizo abasebenzi futhi uqaphele ukusebenziswa kwezinhlelo zezempilo zomsebenzi, ukuphepha, kanye nokuphathwa kwendawo. Ukubusa ngesibalo, ukuhlonza kanye nokuphathwa kwamathuba: Nikeza ukubusa ngesibalo nangokusebenza kule- Directorate, ukuqinisezisa ukufeza izinto eziqondiwe nokuhambisana nomthetho, izinqubo, kanye nemiyalo ye-Public Service. Phatha ukulinganiselwa kwebhajethi le-Directorate, imithombo yabantu, ukusebenza, ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono, ukuphathwa kwebholo kanye nokuqaphela ngaphakathi. Qaphula iziphumo ze-audit, ukuphathwa kwe-risk kanye nezinyathelo zokulungisa ukuze kuqiniswe ukuhlonza kanye nokubophezela. Thuthukisa abasebenzi, phatha izinxabano zendawo yokusebenza, futhi ukhuthaze ukuziphatha okuhle kanye ngenhlonipho yokusebenza kakhulu. Nikeza ukubusa okunesibalo kubaphathi bomnyango ngokuqina kwenhlangano, ikhono lamandla abasebenzi, ukuphathwa kwamakhono, izindaba zabasebenzi kanye nezingozi zemithombo yabantu ukuze kwandiswe ikhono lesikhungo kanye nokuletha izinsizakalo.

xh.title: Umongameli: Ukulawula Abasebenzi
xh.summary: Isithuba somongameli wokulawula abasebenzi eJohannesburg esifuna isidanga se-NQF level 7 kunye neminyaka emihlanu yamava enkqubweni yabaphathi abalinganiselweyo okanye abaphezulu kumsebenzi we-HR kuRhumoye woLuntu.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-Matric kunye ne-NQF level 7 njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA kumanjala we-Human Resource Management/Public Management/Business Management okanye isidanga esifanelekileyo. Oku kudityaniswa nobuncinane beminyaka engama-5 yamava kwinqanaba loBuphathi abuLinganiselweyo okanye abaPhezulu kumanjala we-Human Resource Management kuRhumoye woLuntu. Ngaphezu koko, ummangalelwa ocekisiweyo kuya kufuneka aze ne-SMS Pre-entry certificate yakhe njengokuqatshwa yi-National School of Governance (NSG) phambi kokwenziwa isithuba. Ikhompetensi: Ulwazi nokuqonda komthetho namagqabantshintshi bolwaziwo olawula uLawulo lwe-Human Resource Management kuRhumoye woLuntu. Ulwazi nokuqonda kwezithuba ze-Human Resources, iinkqubo zenkqubo kunye neenkqubo ezilawula inkqubo ye-Human Resources kuRhumoye woLuntu. Ulwazi nokuqonda kogqitho loyilo lwe-Corporate Strategic kwaye ukujongana neendlela eziphambili kumasebenzi, Ulwazi loyilo nokuQonda, uLawulo lweNkqubo kunye noLawulo lweNkqubo ye-Projekthi, uLawulo lweMali, uLawulo lwetshintsho, uLawulo lolwazi, Innovation yokuNikezela iNkonzo (SDI), ukuSombulula iingxaki nokuQonda ngokucokobaxa, uLawulo lweSimo sabantu nokuNika amandla, uQonde lwaBathengi nokuQonda kwabo, uThethathethwano, nokuQotho nokuZithoba. Ilayisenesi yokushayela esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Uphuhliso lweNkqubo nokuLawulwa kweTshintsho: Yiba nogqhitha kuyilo lwenkqubo, eyakhiwayo nokuLawulwa kwezithuba, ukuqwalasela umsebenzi, ukwenza iiprofayile zemisebenzi, ukwenza imephu yeenkqubo zoshishino nokuphonononga ucando lomsebenzi. Yenza uze usemzimbeni iinkqubo zetshintsho kwinkqubo yabasebenzi, amacebo abasebenzi namagqabantshintshi ahambelana neendleba zephulo kunye nembali ezikhoyo. uLungelelwaniso lweNkqubo yeMisebenzi yaseKhusini: Nikeza iqhina elidumileyo ekulungelelwaniseni amasebenzi abantu, ekubeni abantu basebenzayo ekubakhenkethwa, ekukhethwa, ekugcinweni kwemisebenzi ekhoyo, ekuphuhlisweni kobomi bengqondo nengqamano, ekulungelelwaniseni isimo sokuqhubela phambili nokulingana ekubeni abantu basebenzayo. Qwalasela ukulawulwa kwemisebenzi yasekhusini nokuqhuba inkqubo yophuhliso yabasebenzi, kuquka uqeqesho, ii-bursaries, ukufundwa kubasebenzi abasha, abafundi ababambe iqhaza ekusebenzeni, ukufundisa ngokuyilawa, nophuhliso lolawulo. Qonda ukusebenziswa kweNkqubo yokuLawula uMsebenzi woLuntu, amacebo oPhuhliso lweNkqubo yoLawulo lweMisebenzi yaseKhusini nokuNikezela amakhono oQeqesho kwiiNkqubo. Qwalasela inkqubo yokuhlawula abasebenzi, iimeko zomsebenzi, ukulawulwa kwabasebenzi basekhaya, nokuLawulwa kweenkqubo zolwazi ngabasebenzi. uLawulo nokuPhuhliso lokuQaliswa kweNkqubo: Qalisa uze ulawule ukuQaliswa nokuQwalaselwa kweNkqubo yokuLawulwa nokuPhuhliso (PMDS), kuquka ukulinganiswa ngokuphathelele ekusebenzeni, ukuqwalaselwa kolwazi ngokuphathelele ekusebenzeni, ukubika nokuqwalaselwa ekusebenzeni, ukwaziswa nokuphawulwa ngokuphathelele ekusebenzeni nokuLawulwa kwenkqubo yedeshis. Sebenzisa ulwazi ngokuphathelele ekusebenzeni ukubakhusela ngakumbi ngokuphathelele ekuqhubela phambili, ukuziphendulela nokusebenza kwenkqubo. Iindaba zabasebenzi, iMpilo nokuZinza: Nikeza isikhokelo esidumileyo malunga namalungu abasebenzi nengxaki yemiba yabo, iingxaki, iinkqubo zolawulo lwemiba yokwaphula umthetho weNkqubo, ukuqwalaselwa kokudityaniswa phakathi kwamabhunga nabasebenzi, iingxaki zethethathethwano, nokuSombulula iingxaki ezibanga imiba. Qalisa inkqubo yempilo nokuZinza kwabasebenzi bese uyayicwangcisa ukuQaliswa kwamacebo oqwalaselo ngokuphathelele empilweni abasebenzi ngokusebenza, ekhuselekileyo, nakwindalo. ULawulo oludumileyo, uLawulo lweNkqubo nokuLawulwa kweMali: Nikeza isikhokelo esidumileyo nongawo msebenzi kwiSebe, kuqinisekisa ukufezekiswa kweempawu zokuqala nokulandela umthetho osebenzayo, amagqabantshintshi, nokuLawulwa kolwazi nokuLawulwa kolwazi ngokusebenzayo kuRhumoye woLuntu. Lawula imali ehamba phambili yeSebe, imisebenzi yabasebenzi, ukusebenza ngokuphathelele ekusebenzeni, ukuphuhliswa kwamakhono, ukulawula ukunqamula abasebenzi ekushiyeni iindawo zabo nabasebenzi abangaphakathi. Qwalasela ukuphononongwa kwe-odi, uLawulo lweengozi namacebo okulungisa ukuqinisekisa ukulawulwa kwendlela yokwenza imisebenzi nokuziphendulela. Phuhlisa abasebenzi, lawula iingxaki zangaphakathi, zodidi, ngokuphathelele ekusebenzisaneni nokukhuthaza ukusebenza ngokumoya othembekileyo kwaye ukhuthaze inkqubo yokusebenza ngamandla. Nikeza isikhokelo esidumileyo kolawulo le-Corporate malunga nokuba yeyona nkqubo iphumelelayo, amandla okusebenza abantu abasebenzayo, ukulawula imisebenzi yaseKhusini, imiba yamalungu abasebenzi namalungu abasebenzi abangaphakathi ngokubakhusela ngakumbi, ukuphuhliswa kobuchule bomzimba kunye neNkqubo yokusebenza.

jobs.title: Director: Traditional Institutional Management
jobs.department: Department of Co-operative Governance and Traditional Affairs
jobs.summary: Director role overseeing traditional and Khoisan institutional governance, budgeting and financial management support, requiring an NQF 7 qualification and five years of management experience.
jobs.requirements: Matric plus NQF Level 7 as recognized by SAQA in Development studies or relevant qualification. Coupled by 5 years’ experience at a Middle /Senior Management level in Traditional and Khoisan Institutional Management. Furthermore, the recommended candidate will be required to produce his/her SMS Pre-entry certificate as offered by the National School of Governance (NSG) prior to the appointment being made. A Certificate of Competency, issued by a recognised Senior Traditional Leader, as a male or female initiate, will be an added advantage; being a South African Citizen and having a valid driver's licence is a requirement. Competencies: Knowledge and understanding of Customary Initiation Act, Policy guidelines, Policy development, Legislation development and implementation, Institution of Traditional Leadership, Customary Initiation, Public Finance Management Act and Public Service Processes. A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Provide good governance and financial management support to Traditional and Khoisan institutions: In collaboration with the traditional councils develop annual budgets, cashflow projections and facilitate payments in accordance with the PFMA and its regulations against the agreed budget. Review quarterly financial reports, bank statements and performance reports. Ensure that traditional councils and the local house sit at least once a quarter. Review the minutes of traditional council and meetings of the local house and assist the institutions in implementing the resolutions. Ensure that the code of conduct for traditional leaders, traditional councils and the local house is adhered to in accordance with the TKLA. Provide support to Traditional and Khoisan communities with rural development initiatives and land administration services. In collaboration with the traditional council, community and leader identify projects and programmes that aligns to the support framework from the Department of Agriculture. Support traditional communities, councils and leaders in their land claims or restitution programmes. Ensure land administration in the traditional councils are aligned to the legislative frameworks, set up systems for land administration in the traditional communities and councils; and ensure the traditional councils implement and support government programmes relating to rural development and land administration. Establish, support, and monitor the provincial initiation coordinating committee: Establish the Provincial Initiation Coordination Committee as prescribed in legislation. Establish the Provincial Initiation Monitoring Team in line with legislative prescripts. Provide financial and administrative support to the Provincial Initiation Coordinating Committee and the Provincial Initiation Monitoring Team in line with legislative prescripts. Ensure regular training and development of the Provincial Initiation. Coordinating Committee, Provincial Initiation Monitoring Team, traditional surgeons, and principals. Provide secretariat support to the Provincial Initiation Coordinating Committee and the Provincial Initiation Monitoring Team regarding coordination of meetings, minute taking and the implementation of resolutions; and Develop systems of the applications received, approved, and rejected. Establish and implement the recommendation of the commission on traditional leadership, disputes, and claims: In collaboration with the Office of the Premier, establish a Commission on Traditional Leadership Disputes and Claims, by ensuring the establishment is published in a government gazette, the Premier approves the recommended commissioners, and their terms of reference is spelt out and published. Ensure the systems for the payment of commissioners is developed and approved by the Head of Department. Provide secretariat support to the commission by facilitating hearings, minuting the meetings of the commission, and recording the hearings. Register all claims and disputes presented to the Department and communicate with the applicants confirming receipt of the applications, advising them of the process to be followed and communicating the hearing dates. Implement the recommendations of the commission in line with the legislative requirements; and ensure that all traditional leaders recognised through this process is published in a provincial gazette and certification issued in line with legislative prescripts. Establish and support traditional and Khoi San leaders houses and councils to perform the legislative functions: Ensure members of the traditional council, local houses, and the provincial house complies with the legislative requirements for sitting in these structures. Establish traditional councils, local houses, and a provincial house in line with legislative prescripts. Ensure that a Magistrate or Judge swears in traditional councils, local houses, and the provincial house before commencing their duty. Provide financial and administrative support to the traditional councils, local and provincial houses in line with legislative prescripts. Provide training and development support to the local and provincial houses in line with the legislative prescripts. Provide infrastructure and tools of trade for the traditional councils, local houses, and the provincial house in line with legislative prescripts. Ensure traditional councils, local houses, and the provincial house sits at least once a quarter, that their meetings are minuted and resolutions implemented. Ensure that the Provincial and Local houses contribute to legislation, municipal by-laws and policy development that affects rural development, land administration and traditional communities. Ensure that traditional councils, local and provincial houses support government programmes; Ensure that the Provincial and Local houses provide annual reports to the Provincial Legislature and the municipal council. Ensure compliance with the Traditional and Khoisan Leadership Act and the Customary Initiation Act: Facilitate the establishment of traditional councils through hosting free and fair elections. Ensure that areas of jurisdiction, recognition of traditional leaders and the establishment of traditional councils are published in a government gazette in line with legislative prescripts. Support traditional councils to manage their finances and perform their administrative functions through training and development, infrastructure support, tools of trade and funding. Ensure the memorandum of agreement is adhered to by both traditional councils and ensure that expenditure is in line with the agreed budget. Ensure that traditional councils enter sound partnerships with government, civil society organisations and the private sector. Disestablish traditional authorities in line with legislative prescripts. Ensure that traditional leaders are recognised in line with the legislative prescripts, participate in municipal councils in line with the Municipal Structures Act. Review and align provincial legislation to that of the TKLA by preparing a provincial policy framework that EXCO adopts, consult drafting legislation with interested and affected parties, and ensure that the bill follows the legislative programme before being enacted. Establish a database of principals, surgeons, and initiates for each initiation season. Monitor initiation schools during the initiation season to ensure legislative compliance and close customary initiation schools that do not comply. Collaborate with the Departments of Health, Community Safety, Education and Social Development to ensure compliance with related legislation and ensure that the health and social well-being of initiates is protected. Collaborate and support municipalities in the implementation of the Customary Initiation Act; and facilitate regular awareness-raising programmes at the community level targeting parents and initiates. Management of Directorate: Manage and solve conflict within Directorate. Manage the Budget of the Directorate. Manage the skills development plan of the Directorate. Manage the PMDS of the Directorate. Manage the leave management of the Directorate and Manage the audit finding and queries of the Directorate.
