af.title: Direkteur: Tradisionele Institusionele Bestuur
af.summary: Direkteurspos wat toezig hou oor tradisionele en Khoisan-institusionele bestuursregering, begroting en finansiële bestuursondersteuning, wat 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: Matric plus NQF Level 7 as recognized by SAQA in Development studies or relevant qualification. Coupled by 5 years' experience at a Middle /Senior Management level in Traditional and Khoisan Institutional Management. Furthermore, the recommended candidate will be required to produce his/her SMS Pre-entry certificate as offered by the National School of Governance (NSG) prior to the appointment being made. A Certificate of Competency, issued by a recognised Senior Traditional Leader, as a male or female initiate, will be an added advantage; being a South African Citizen and having a valid driver's licence is a requirement. Competencies: Knowledge and understanding of Customary Initiation Act, Policy guidelines, Policy development, Legislation development and implementation, Institution of Traditional Leadership, Customary Initiation, Public Finance Management Act and Public Service Processes. A valid driver's license.
af.duties: Verskaf goeie bestuursregering en finansiële bestuursondersteuning aan tradisionele en Khoisan-instellings: Werk in samewerking met die tradisionele rade saam om jaarlikse begrotings en kontantvloei-projeksies op te stel en betalings in ooreenstemming met die PFMA en sy regulasies teen die ooreengekomde begroting te fasiliteer. Hersien kwartaallikse finansiële verslae, bankstate en prestasieverslae. Verseker dat tradisionele rade en die plaaslike huis ten minste een keer per kwartaal sitting het. Hersien die notules van die tradisionele raad en vergaderings van die plaaslike huis en help die instellings om die besluite te implementeer. Verseker dat die gedragskode vir tradisionele leiers, tradisionele rade en die plaaslike huis nagekom word in ooreenstemming met die TKLA. Verskaf ondersteuning aan tradisionele en Khoisan-gemeenskappe met landelike ontwikkelingsinisiatiewe en landadministrasiedienste. Identifiseer in samewerking met die tradisionele raad, gemeenskap en leier projekte en programme wat pas by die ondersteuningsraamwerk van die Department of Agriculture. Ondersteun tradisionele gemeenskappe, rade en leiers in hul grondeise of restitusie-programme. Verseker dat landadministrasie in die tradisionele rade in lyn gebring word met die wetgewende raamwerke, stel stelsels op vir landadministrasie in die tradisionele gemeenskappe en rade; en verseker dat die tradisionele rade regeringsprogramme rakende landelike ontwikkeling en landadministrasie implementeer en ondersteun. Stig, ondersteun en monitor die provinsiale inisiasie-koördineringskomitee: Stig die Provinsiale Inisiasie-koördineringskomitee soos in die wetgewing voorgeskryf. Stig die Provinsiale Inisiasie-moniteringspan in ooreenstemming met wetgewende voorskrifte. Verskaf finansiële en administratiewe ondersteuning aan die Provinsiale Inisiasie-koördineringskomitee en die Provinsiale Inisiasie-moniteringspan in ooreenstemming met wetgewende voorskrifte. Verseker gereelde opleiding en ontwikkeling van die Provinsiale Inisiasie-koördineringskomitee, Provinsiale Inisiasie-moniteringspan, tradisionele chirurge en skoolhoofde. Verskaf sekretariaatsondersteuning aan die Provinsiale Inisiasie-koördineringskomitee en die Provinsiale Inisiasie-moniteringspan met betrekking tot die koördinering van vergaderings, neem van notules en die implementering van besluite; en ontwikkel stelsels vir die aansoeke wat ontvang, goedgekeur en verwerp is. Stig en implementeer die aanbeveling van die kommissie oor tradisionele leierskap, geskille en eise: Stig in samewerking met die Office of the Premier 'n Kommissie oor Tradisionele Leierskapsgeskille en -eise, deur te verseker dat die stigting in 'n regeringskoerant gepubliseer word, die Premier die aanbevole kommissarisse goedkeur, en hul terme van verwysing uiteengesit en gepubliseer word. Verseker dat die stelsels vir die betaling van kommissarisse ontwikkel en deur die Hoof van die Departement goedgekeur word. Verskaf sekretariaatsondersteuning aan die kommissie deur verhore te fasiliteer, notules van die kommissie se vergaderings te neem en die verhore op te neem. Registreer alle eise en geskille wat aan die Departement voorgelê word en kommunikeer met die aansoekers om ontvangs van die aansoeke te bevestig, hulle van die proses wat gevolg moet word te adviseer en die verhoordatums te kommunikeer. Implementeer die aanbevelings van die kommissie in ooreenstemming met die wetgewende vereistes; en verseker dat alle tradisionele leiers wat deur hierdie proses erken word, in 'n provinsiale koerant gepubliseer word en sertifisering in ooreenstemming met wetgewende voorskrifte uitgereik word. Stig en ondersteun tradisionele en Khoi San leierhuise en rade om die wetgewende funksies te verrig: Verseker dat lede van die tradisionele raad, plaaslike huise en die provinsiale huis voldoen aan die wetgewende vereistes om in hierdie strukture sitting te hê. Stig tradisionele rade, plaaslike huise en 'n provinsiale huis in ooreenstemming met wetgewende voorskrifte. Verseker dat 'n Landdros of Regter tradisionele rade, plaaslike huise en die provinsiale huis beëdig voordat hulle hul pligte begin. Verskaf finansiële en administratiewe ondersteuning aan die tradisionele rade, plaaslike en provinsiale huise in ooreenstemming met wetgewende voorskrifte. Verskaf opleidings- en ontwikkelingsondersteuning aan die plaaslike en provinsiale huise in ooreenstemming met die wetgewende voorskrifte. Verskaf infrastruktuur en werks gereedskap aan die tradisionele rade, plaaslike huise en die provinsiale huis in ooreenstemming met wetgewende voorskrifte. Verseker dat tradisionele rade, plaaslike huise en die provinsiale huis ten minste een keer per kwartaal sitting het, dat hul vergaderings geminuiteer word en besluite geïmplementeer word. Verseker dat die Provinsiale en Plaaslike huise bydrae tot wetgewing, munisipiale verordeninge en beleidontwikkeling wat landelike ontwikkeling, landadministrasie en tradisionele gemeenskappe beïnvloed. Verseker dat tradisionele rade, plaaslike en provinsiale huise regeringsprogramme ondersteun; Verseker dat die Provinsiale en Plaaslike huise jaarlikse verslae aan die Provinsiale Wetgewer en die munisipale raad verskaf. Verseker nakoming van die Traditional and Khoisan Leadership Act en die Customary Initiation Act: Fasiliteer die stigting van tradisionele rade deur die aanbieding van vrye en regverdige verkiesings. Verseker dat regsgebiede, erkenning van tradisionele leiers en die stigting van tradisionele rade in 'n regeringskoerant gepubliseer word in ooreenstemming met wetgewende voorskrifte. Ondersteun tradisionele rade om hul finansies te bestuur en hul administratiewe funksies te verrig deur opleiding en ontwikkeling, infrastruktuurondersteuning, werksmiddels en befondsing. Verseker dat die memorandum van ooreenkoms deur beide tradisionele rade nagekom word en verseker dat besteding in ooreenstemming met die ooreengekomde begroting is. Verseker dat tradisionele rade goeie vennootskappe met die regering, burgerlike samelewingsorganisasies en die privaatsektor aangaan. Ontbind tradisionele owerhede in ooreenstemming met wetgewende voorskrifte. Verseker dat tradisionele leiers erken word in ooreenstemming met die wetgewende voorskrifte en in munisipale rade deelneem in ooreenstemming met die Municipal Structures Act. Hersien en belyn provinsiale wetgewing met dié van die TKLA deur 'n provinsiale beleidsraamwerk op te stel wat EXGO aanneem, raadpleeg die opstel van wetgewing met geïnteresseerde en geraakte partye, en verseker dat die wetsontwerp die wetgewende program volg voordat dit verorden word. Stig 'n databasis van skoolhoofde, chirurge en inisiasie-kandidatte vir elke inisiasie-seisoen. Monitor inisiasie-skole gedurende die inisiasie-seisoen om wetgewende nakoming te verseker en sluit gebruiklike inisiasie-skole wat nie voldoen nie. Werk saam met die Departments of Health, Community Safety, Education en Social Development om nakoming van verwante wetgewing te verseker en te verseker dat die gesondheid en maatskaplike welsyn van inisiasie-kandidatte beskerm word. Werk saam met en ondersteun munisipaliteite in die implementering van die Customary Initiation Act; en fasiliteer gereelde bewustmakingsprogramme op gemeenskapsvlak wat op ouers en inisiasie-kandidatte gemik is. Bestuur van die Direktoraat: Bestuur en los konflik binne die Direktoraat op. Bestuur die begroting van die Direktoraat. Bestuur die vaardigheidsontwikkelingsplan van die Direktoraat. Bestuur die PMDS van die Direktoraat. Bestuur die verlofbestuur van die Direktoraat en bestuur die ouditbevindinge en navrae van die Direktoraat.

zu.title: Umphathi: Traditional Institutional Management
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi esibuka phezulu ubulungiswa bezinstitushini zendabuko kanye nabakwa-Khoisan, ukwenza izabelomali kanye nenkxaso yokuphatha imali, okudinga izifundo ze-NQF 7 kanye neminyaka emihlanu yamava obuphathi.
zu.requirements: I-Matric kanye ne-NQF Level 7 njengokuqatshiwe yi-SAQA kwezifundo ze-Development noma isidingo esihambisana naleso. Okuhambisana neminyaka emi-5 yamava ezingeni le-Middle/Senior Management kwi-Traditional and Khoisan Institutional Management. Okwathi ngaphezu kwalokho, umuntu oqokiwe kuzodingeka akhihlele isitifiketi sakhe/sakhe se-SMS Pre-entry njengokuvezwa yi-National School of Governance (NSG) ngaphambi kokwenziwa ukugqoshwa esikhundleni. Isitifiketi Sobukhosi, esinikwa umholi wendabuko ophakeme, njengomuntu oqothwe wesilisa noma wesifazane, kuzobe kungenza isidingo sibe lulula; ukuba ngumakadebona wase-South African kanye nokuba nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile kuyisidingo. Ikhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda i-Customary Initiation Act, Izindlela zokuqondisa inqubomgomo, Ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubomgomo, Ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokuphunyiswa komthetho, Isikhungo Sobuholi Bendabuko, Iqhaza lendabuko, i-Public Finance Management Act kanye nokuqhubeka kwenkonzo yomphakathi. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Nikeza ubulungishi obuhle kanye nenkxaso yokuphatha imali ezinstitushini zendabuko nakwabakwa-Khoisan: Kubambiswane namakhonsela endabuko ukuthuthukisa izabelomali zonyaka, ukubikeza ukugeleza kwemali kanye nokwenza kutholwe izinkokhelo ngokusho kwe-PFMA nemithetho yayo ngokwesabelomali esivunyiwe. Hlola imibiko yemali yamakhota ngayinye, izitatimende zebhange namabiko okusebenza. Qiniseka ukuthi amakhonsela endabuko nendlu yendawo zihlale okungenani kathathu ngonyaka. Hlola imizuzu yamakhonsela endabuko namamehthidili endlu yendawo futhi usize izinstitushini ukuphunyisa izinqumo. Qiniseka ukuthi ikhodi yokuziphatha yabaholi bendabuko, amakhonsela endabuko nendlu yendawo ilandelwa ngokusho kwe-TKLA. Nikeza inkxaso emphakathini wendabuko nakwabakwa-Khoisan ngezinhloso zokuthuthukiswa kwemimongo kanye nesevisi yokuphatha umhlaba. Kubambiswane nakhonsela lendabuko, umphakathi nomholi ukuthola izinhlelo kanye namaphojekhi ahambisana nesakhiwo senkxazo esivela ku-Department of Agriculture. Sekele imiphakathi yendabuko, amakhonsela nabaholi emigqwenqweni yabo yezinkulumo zomhlaba noma izinhlelo zokubuyiselwa umhlaba. Qiniseka ukuthi ukuphathwa komhlaba kumakhonsela endabuko kuhambisana nemithetho, hlela amasistimu okuphatha umhlaba emiphakathini nasezinkernini zendabuko; futhi uqiniseke ukuthi amakhonsela endabuko aphunyisa futhi asekele izinhlelo zahulumeni ezihlobene nokuthuthukiswa kwemimongo nokuphathwa komhlaba. Misa, sekele, futhi ulawule ikomidi elihlanganisa i-provincial initiation: Misa i-Provincial Initiation Coordination Committee njengokuqatshiwe umthetho. Misa i-Provincial Initiation Monitoring Team ngokusho kwemithetho. Nikeza inkxaso yemali nolawulo ku-Provincial Initiation Coordinating Committee naku-Provincial Initiation Monitoring Team ngokusho kwemithetho. Qiniseka ukuqeqeshwa kokwakheka njalo kokuthuthukiswa kwe-Provincial Initiation. Ikomidi elihlanganisayo, i-Provincial Initiation Monitoring Team, odokotela besiko, kanye nabaphathi. Nikeza inkxaso yababhalisi ku-Provincial Initiation Coordinating Committee naku-Provincial Initiation Monitoring Team ngokuhlanganisa amamehthidili, ukubhala imizuzu nokuphunyiswa kwezinqumo; futhi uthuthukise amasistimu okwamukela, ukuvuma, kanye nokwenqaba izicelo. Misa futhi uphunyise izincoma zekhomishani mayelana nobuholi bendabuko, izinxulumano, kanye nezinkulumo: Kubambiswane ne-Office of the Premier, misa i-Commission on Traditional Leadership Disputes and Claims, ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi ukumiswa kushicilelwa kukahulumeni, i-Premier ivuma abakomishane abanconyiwe, futhi igama labo linqunyiwe futhi lushicilelwe. Qiniseka ukuthi amasistimu okukhokha abakomishani athuthukiswa futhi avunywa yi-Head of Department. Nikeza inkxaso yababhalisi kukhomishani ngokwenza izinkundla zokuzwa, ukubhala imizuzu yamehthidili ekhomisheni, futhi uqophe izinkundla. Bhalisa yonke imigqo nezinxulumano ezinikelwa kwi-Department futhi uxhumane nabafakelayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izicelo zitholwe, ubatshengise inqubo emayilandwe futhi uxhumane nabo ngemihla yokuzwa. Phunyisa izincoma zekhomishani ngokusho kwemithetho; futhi uqinisekise ukuthi bonke abaholi bendabuko abavunyiwe ngale nqubo bashicilelwa ekhasini likahulumeni we-province futhi izitifiketi zikhishwe ngokusho kwemithetho. Misa futhi usekele amakhonsela namahousi abaholi bendabuko nakwakwa-Khoi San ukwenza imisebenzi entshweni: Qiniseka ukuthi amalungu ekhonsela lendabuko, amahousi endawo, nendlu ye-province ayalandela imithetho yokuhlala kulezi zakhiwo. Misa amakhonsela endabuko, amahousi endawo, nendlu ye-province ngokusho kwemithetho. Qiniseka ukuthi i-Magistrate noma i-Judge ifaka izifungo kwamakhonsela endabuko, amahousi endawo, nendlu ye-province ngaphambi kokuqala umsebenzi wabo. Nikeza inkxaso yemali nolawulo kwamakhonsela endabuko, amahousi endawo neyeprovince ngokusho kwemithetho. Nikeza inkxaso yokuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwamahousi endawo neyeprovince ngokusho kwemithetho. Nikeza izinhlalo nezinkomba zomsebenzi kwamakhonsela endabuko, amahousi endawo, nendlu ye-province ngokusho kwemithetho. Qiniseka ukuthi amakhonsela endabuko, amahousi endawo, nendlu ye-province ihlala okungenani kathathu ngonyaka, ukuthi amamehthidili abo abhalwe futhi izinqumo zaphunyiswa. Qiniseka ukuthi Amahousi e-Province nendawo anegalelo emthethweni, emithethweni yasendaweni kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwenqubomgomo okuthinta ukuthuthukiswa kwemimongo, ukuphathwa komhlaba nendabuko yomphakathi. Qiniseka ukuthi amakhonsela endabuko, amahousi endawo neyeprovince asekela izinhlelo zahulumeni; Qiniseka ukuthi Amahousi e-Province nendawo anikeza amabiko njalo ngonyaka ku-Provincial Legislature nakwikhonsela yaseduzi. Qiniseka ukulandelwa kwe-Traditional and Khoisan Leadership Act kanye ne-Customary Initiation Act: Yenza ukuthi amakhonsela endabuko miswe ngokubamba ukhetho olukhululekile nolulula. Qiniseka ukuthi amapheshe wokubusa, ukuvuma abaholi bendabuko kanye nokumiswa kwamakhonsela endabuko ashicilelwa ekhasini likahulumeni ngokusho kwemithetho. Sekele amakhonsela endabuko ukuphatha imali yayo kanye nokuqhuba imisebenzi yolawulo ngokuqeqesha nokuthuthukisa, inkxaso yezinhlalo, izinkomba zomsebenzi nentlawulo. Qiniseka ukuthi imemorandhami yokuqinisekiswa ilandelwa zombili amakhonsela endabuko futhi ukuthi ukuchithwa kwemali kuhambisana nesisabelomali esivunyiwe. Qiniseka ukuthi amakhonsela endabuko angena kubudlelwano obuhle nohulumeni, izinhlangano zomphakathi kanye nemicabango yangasese. Yezisa ngaphandle amagunya endabuko ngokusho kwemithetho. Qiniseka ukuthi abaholi bendabuko bavunywa ngokusho kwemithetho, bangene amakhonsela endawo ngokusho kwe-Municipal Structures Act. Hlola futhi uhambisanise umthetho we-province nowe-TKLA ngokulungisa isakhiwo senqubomgomo ye-province esamukelwa i-EXCO, uxoxe ngokulungiswa komthetho nalaba nokuthintekile, futhi uqiniseke ukuthi ibhilide ilandela inqubo yomthetho ngaphambi kokuba umthetho. Misa idathabheysi yabaphathi, odokotela besiko, kanye nabaqothiweyo nsimu yonke ibanga. Hlola izikole zokwaluka ngesimo senkathi yokwaluka ukuze uqinisekise ukulandelwa kwemithetho futhi uvale izikole zokwaluka zendabuko ezingalandeli imithetho. Sebenzisana nama-Departments of Health, Community Safety, Education kanye ne-Social Development ukuqinisekisa ukulandelwa kwemithetho ehlobene futhi uqinisekise ukuthi impilo kanye nesimo sabaqothiweyo sivikelwe. Sebenzisana futhi usekele amakhonsela yaseduzi ekuphunyiseni i-Customary Initiation Act; futhi uhlele izinhlela zokwazisa abantu njalo emazingeni omphakathi okubalula abazali nabaqothiweyo. Ukuphathwa kwe-Directorate: Lawula futhi uxazulule izinkinga ngaphakathi kwe-Directorate. Lawula isabelomali se-Directorate. Lawula iplani yokuthuthukiswa kwezikhono se-Directorate. Lawula i-PMDS se-Directorate. Lawula ukuphathwa kwekhansela se-Directorate futhi Lawula iziphetho zokuhlola kanye nemibuzo ye-Directorate.

xh.title: Umvelisi: Uqhelwaniso Lweziko Lesiko
xh.summary: Indima yomvelisi elawula ulawulo lweziko lesiko nolwakhoi-San, ukwakhiwa kwebhajeti nenkxaso yocalulo lweemali, kufuneka unesiqu seNQF 7 namashumi eminyaka emihlanu yamava obuquphathi.
xh.requirements: I-Matric enye ne-NQF Level 7 evunyiwe yi-SAQA kwiZifundo zeZophuhliso okanye isiqu esifanelekileyo. Kuya kufuneka kube kukho iminyaka eli-5 yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi eliya kwelaphezulu lobuquphathi kwisoLwaliso Lweziko Lesiko nolwakhoi-San. Ngaphezu koko, ummangaliswa oyiyo kuya kufuneka aze nefaksi yakhe yemvume yangaphambi kokuqalisa kwabasebenzi abasenqanaba esiphezulu sebhodi (SMS Pre-entry certificate) enikezwa ligugu lesizwe lesikolo lolawulo (NSG) ngaphambi kokwenzwa isimemo sokumiswa. Ifaksi yeLunga, enikiwe ngumongameli wamagunya amakhulu njengomfundi wesiko wesilisa okanye wesifazile, iya kuba nzuzo; ukuba ngumZulu welaseMzantsi Afrika kwaye unelayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni ngumfuno. Iimfuno zokwazi: Ulwazi nokuqonda uMthetho weSiko Lokuqaliswa, iinkqubo zemigaqo, uphuhliso lwemigaqo, uphuhliso nokusebenza kwemithetho, iNkundla yobuBukhosi besiko, ukuqaliswa kwesiko, uMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente neNkqubo zeCandelo likarhulumente. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yolawulo oluhle nolweemali kwiindlu zamagunya amakhulu nabeNkululekane bakwa-Khoisan: Kuvakalelwa ngokubakho kwamaxulu amakhulu, zakha iibhajeti zonyaka, iindlela zemali ezidityanisiweyo kwaye ulawule imahlawulwa ngokwemigaqo ye-PFMA nemithetho yayo ngokwexesha elizisiweyo. Phonononga iingxelo zeemali ezithathwa ngekhota, iingxelo zebhanki nezingxelo zemveliso. Qinisekisa ukuba amaxulu amakhulu nendlu yengingasemzini zibutha ubuncinane kanye ngekhota. Phinda uphonononge isiqendu sexulu elikhulu nemibutho yendlu yengingasemzini kwaye uncede iindlu ezingundoqo ekusebenziseni iinkqulu. Qinisekisa ukuba umthetho wokuziphatha weenkokheli zekhaya lesiko, amaxulu amakhulu, nendlu yengingasemzimi uyamkelwa ngokwemigaqo ye-TKLA. Nika inkxaso kumaphakathi namagunya amakhulu nakwabakwa-Khoisan ngeenkqubo zophuhliso lwemiphakathi yasezilalini kwaye ulawule iinkonzo zolawulo lwemihlaba. Ndibene nomxuli wasekhaya lesiko, nabaphakathi nakwonotshephethe, qaphela iiprojektheyi neenkqubo ezihambelana nendlela yamandla avela kuSebe leZolimo. Nika inkxaso kumaphakathi, amaxulu, neenkokheli kumagunya emihlaba naseenkqubo zokubuyiselwa imihlaba. Qinisekisa ukuba ulawulo lwemihlaba kumaxulu amakhulu luhambelana nemithetho, misa iinkqubo zolawulo lwemihlaba kumaphakathi nakumaxulu; qinisekisa ukuba amaxulu amakhulu aya kusebenzisa kwaye axhase iinkqubo karhulumente ezihambelana nophuhliso lwasezilalini nolawulo lwemihlaba. Misela, nkxasa, kwaye ulandele ikomiti yengingasemzini elawula imiba yokuqaliswa kwesiko kwiphondo: Misela ikomiti yokulawula imiba yokuqaliswa kwesiko kwiphondo ngokuchazwe emthethweni. Misela iqela elalawula imiba yokuqaliswa kwesiko kwiphondo ngokwemithetho ekukhethwa kuyo. Nika inkxaso yeemali nolawulo kwiKomiti yoLawulo LweMiba Yokuqaliswa Kwesiko Kwiphondo naseQeleni loLawulo LweMiba Yokuqaliswa Kwesiko Kwiphondo ngokwemithetho ekukhethwa kuyo. Qinisekisa uqeqesho oluqhubekayo nolophuhliso lweKomiti yoLawulo LweMiba Yokuqaliswa Kwesiko Kwiphondo, Eqela loLawulo, oogqirha besiko, nabaphathi. Nika inkxaso yokuba ngumabhalane kwiKomiti yoLawulo LweMiba Yokuqaliswa Kwesiko Kwiphondo naseQeleni loLawulo malunga nolawulo lwemibutho, ukubhalwa kwemibutho nokuqhutywa kwezigqibo; kwaye Misela iinkqubo zokuqaliswa, ukwamkelwa nokwalathwa. Misela kwaye usebenzise izindululo zekomishini yobukhosi besiko, imiphatho namagunya: Sebenzisana neOfisi yenguPhongolo, misela ikomishini yamagunya nempixano ngokuba qinisekisa ukuba imisela igqityiwe kugazethi karhulumente, nguPhongolo evuma komishinala abapiwayo, nangokuba malathiso abo abhalwe kancinci adluliselwe. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo zokuhlawula abakomishinala zamiselwe zavunywa nguNobumba weSebe. Nika inkxaso njengomabhalane kwiKomishini ngokulawula iinqobo, ukubala iimithetho yekomishini, nokubeka iinqobo. Bala onke amagunya nemicimbo etyhilwe kuSebe kwaye thintana nabamfuyo ukuqinisekisa ukwamkelwa kwezicelo, ubaxelele inkqubo ekuya kuliswa kwaye ubaxelele ngemihla yeeqondo. Sebenzisa izindululo zekomishini ngokwemithetho ekukhethwa kuyo; qinisekisa ukuba zonke iinkokheli zamagunya amakhulu ezivunywe ngale nkqubo zibhalwe egazethi yephondo kwaye zikwazi ukuba namagunya avunyiwe ngokwemithetho. Misela kwaye uxhase iindlu zeenkokheli zamagunya amakhulu nakwabakwa-Khoi San namaxulu ukuba enze imisebenzi ngokomthetho: Qinisekisa ukuba amalungu amaxulu amakhulu, iindlu zengingasemzini, nendlu yephondo ayilandelile imithetho yobukho babho kule minyaka. Misela amaxulu amakhulu, iindlu zengingasemzini, nendlu yephondo ngokwemithetho ekukhethwa kuyo. Qinisekisa ukuba umongameli weNkundla okanye uJaji ubafungise kumaxulu amakhulu, iindlu zengingasemzini, nendlu yephondo ngaphambi kokuba aqale umsebenzi. Nika inkxaso ngeemali nolawulo kumaxulu amakhulu, iindlu zengingasemzini nendlu yephondo ngokwemithetho ekukhethwa kuyo. Nika inkxaso ngokuqeqeshwa nokuziphuhlisa kweendlu zengingasemzini nendlu yephondo ngokwemithetho ekukhethwa kuyo. Nika inkxaso ngezakhiwo ngezixhobo zabasebenzi kumaxulu amakhulu, iindlu zengingasemzini, nendlu yephondo ngokwemithetho ekukhethwa kuyo. Qinisekisa ukuba amaxulu amakhulu, iindlu zengingasemzini, nendlu yephondo zibutha ubuncinane kanye ngekhota, imibutho yazo iyabhalwa izigqibo ziphunywe. Qinisekisa ukuba iindlu zamaphondo nezingingasemzini zenza igalelo kumthetho, kumthetho basebe langa kamasipala nakuqhakamsho lwemigaqo echaphazela uphuhliso lwemiphakathi, ulawulo lwemihlaba kumaxulu amakhulu namaphakathi. Qinisekisa ukuba amaxulu amakhulu, iindlu zengingasemzini nendlu yephondo xhosa iinkqubo karhulumente; Qinisekisa ukuba iindlu zamaphondo nazingingasemzini zize neengxelo zonyaka kwilungu lobuveki lwePhondo nasekhaleni leNdlu yaseNgingasemzini. Qinisekisa ukuzalathiswa ngokucofa ngokwemithetho: Qinisekisa ukuzalathiswa ngokwemithetho we-TKLA nakuwo wonke amagunya amakhulu kwaye yenze ngokubakho kwemiba yokuhamba ngokulawula imali kwamaxulu amakhulu nasekusebenziseni iinkqubo zokwamkela imali. Lawula imali kwindlu yomvelisi. Lawula indlela yophuhliso lwezakhono kwindlu yomvelisi. Lawula i-PMDS yendlu yomvelisi. Lawula ulawulo lokulolonga iindleko zendlu yomvelisi kwaye Lawule iimpendulo zokuphonononga nemibuzo yendlu yomvelisi.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: IDP Coordination
jobs.department: Department of Co-operative Governance and Traditional Affairs
jobs.summary: Deputy Director needed to coordinate and support credible Integrated Development Planning in Gauteng municipalities, requiring an NQF Level 7 qualification and 3-5 years of supervisory experience.
jobs.requirements: Matric plus NQF Level 7 in Town and Regional Planning, Development Studies, Development Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation, Public Management, or relevant qualification as recognised by SAQA. Coupled with 3-5 years of experience at a supervisory (ASD) level either at municipal or provincial/national level or a combination of these and, preferably in the Integrated Development Planning, intergovernmental planning, spatial planning, or related field. Competencies: Personal and corporate leadership skills, Interpersonal relations, Analytical Thinking, Research skills, Facilitation and presentation skills, Project Management, Assertiveness, Computer skills, Conflict resolution skills, Networking skills, Negotiation skills, Teamwork, Work independently and Planning and organizational skills. A valid driver’s licence.
jobs.duties: Facilitate and coordinate the development and implementation of credible IDPs in municipalities: Provide technical, strategic support and monitoring towards the development of compliant IDPs. Facilitate the Integrated Development Planning Process on behalf of the MEC for COGTA in the Gauteng City Region. Facilitate the compliance, credibility, and implementation of Municipal IDPs as per legislation (Municipal Systems Act of 2000). Facilitate broad sectoral engagements to coordinate joint planning and collection of community needs by Municipalities as well as ensure that they are incorporated into municipal and provincial plans. Facilitate the process of submission of final IDPs to Municipal Council for approval before submission to COGTA. Ensure the circulation and incorporation of gazetted GPG projects in Municipal Final IDPs. Ensure alignment of Municipal IDPs with DDM. Conduct analysis on Municipal Process Plans. Facilitate engagements for the Provincial IDP Managers Forum. Facilitate and ensure the coordination of alignment of municipal IDPs to National and Provincial priorities and plans: Facilitate and coordinate sectoral support to ensure that Municipal IDPs are reflective of both National and Provincial priorities. Facilitate the alignment of provincial plans to municipal community needs. Ensure the review and implementation of provincial IGR calendar. Mobilise provincial and national sector departments to participate in municipal IDP Processes. Coordinate the inputs of sectoral departments and SOEs into the development of the Provincial IDP Analysis Framework. Prepare EXCO submission on the findings of IDP assessment. Develop, implement, and review the Intergovernmental Planning Framework. Represent the department at the National IDP Coordinators Forum and report thereof and share best practice to the forum. Coordinate the development, implementation, and review of DDM One Plans across the Gauteng City Region: Coordinate and participate in the DDM IGR Coordinating platforms. Ensure DDM is incorporated in provincial and municipal plans. Facilitate necessary engagements with relevant GPG sector departments. Management of staff: Manage human resource in relation to all IDP and DDM work. Management of staff leave through ESS. Facilitate and coordinate the mid-year and final year performance reviews of staff. Report on ad-hoc activity management. Facilitate the execution of all non-contracted work activities as and when requested by the authorities. Prepare reports and minutes for meetings and workshops attended. Participate in the Bid Evaluation Committee sittings for selection of biding applicants, where necessary. And prepare Service Level Agreements for approved projects where necessary.
jobs.enquiries: Caiphus/ Andy, cell: 071 474 7078/51
jobs.applications: Applications should be submitted strictly online at https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za/Public/Jobs.aspx FOR ATTENTION : Human Capital management
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly online completed Z83 form It is our intention to promote representivity (race, gender, and disability) in the Public Service through the filling of these posts. Preference will be given to people with disabilities, and they will be exempted from a driver’s license requirement. Applications        should       be     submitted       strictly    online     at https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za/Public/Jobs.aspx                                  or http://jobs.gauteng.gov.za/Public/Jobs.aspx and it should be accompanied by a most recent Z83 form which may be obtained from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents. and comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV), certified copies of qualifications and Identity will be submitted upon request (no postal or hand delivery applications will be accepted). It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Furthermore, the recommended candidate will be required to produce his/her SMS Pre-entry certificate as offered by the National School of Governance (NSG) prior to the appointment being made. The certificate for entry into SMS and full details can be sourced by the following link: http://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Preference will be given to female applicants for SMS posts. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments; one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Correspondence will only be limited to shortlisted candidates. If you have not been contacted within 3 months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Failure to comply with the above instructions of specifically attaching a recent Z83 and a comprehensive CV will result in applications being disqualified. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: IDP-koördinering
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur benodig om geloofwaardige Geïntegreerde Ontwikkelingsbeplanning in Gauteng-munisipaliteite te koördineer en te ondersteun, met 'n NQF Vlak 7-kwalifikasie en 3-5 jaar se toesigervaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: Matriek plus NQF Vlak 7 in Stads- en Streekbeplanning, Ontwikkelingstudies, Ontwikkelingsbeplanning, Monitering en Evaluering, Openbare Bestuur, of 'n relevante kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. Gekoppel met 3-5 jaar se ervaring op 'n toesig- (ASD)-vlak, óf op munisipale óf op provinsiale/nasionale vlak, of 'n kombinasie hiervan, en by voorkeur in die Geïntegreerde Ontwikkelingsbeplanning, interowerheidsbeplanning, ruimtelike beplanning, of verwante veld. Bevoegdhede: Persoonlike en korporatiewe leierskapsvaardighede, Interpersoonlike verhoudinge, Analitiese denke, Navorsingsvaardighede, Fasiliterings- en voorleggingsvaardighede, Projektbestuur, Selfstandigheid, Rekenaarvaardighede, Konflikoplossingsvaardighede, Netwerkvaardighede, Onderhandelingsvaardighede, Spanwerk, Onafhanklik werk en Beplannings- en organisatoriese vaardighede. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Fasiliteer en koördineer die ontwikkeling en implementering van geloofwaardige IDP's in munisipaliteite: Verskaf tegniese, strategiese ondersteuning en monitering tot die ontwikkeling van navolgbare IDP's. Fasiliteer die Geïntegreerde Ontwikkelingsbeplanningsproses namens die LEC vir COGTA in die Gauteng-streek. Fasiliteer die nakoming, geloofwaardigheid en implementering van Munisipale IDP's volgens wetgewing (Munisipale Stelselswet van 2000). Fasiliteer breë sektorale betrokkenheid om gesamentlike beplanning en die insameling van gemeenskapsbehoeftes deur Munisipaliteite te koördineer, asook om te verseker dat dit in munisipale en provinsiale planne geïnkorporeer word. Fasiliteer die proses van voorlegging van finale IDP's aan die Munisipale Raad vir goedkeuring voordat dit aan COGTA voorgelê word. Verseker die sirkulasie en inkorporering van geproklameerde GPG-projekte in Munisipale Finale IDP's. Verseker die belyning van Munisipale IDP's met DDM. Voer ontleding van Munisipale Prosesplanne uit. Fasiliteer betrokkenheid vir die Provinciale IDP-bestuurdersforum. Fasiliteer en verseker die koördinering van belyning van munisipale IDP's met Nasionale en Provinsiale prioriteite en planne: Fasiliteer en koördineer sektorale ondersteuning om te verseker dat Munisipale IDP's beide Nasionale en Provinsiale prioriteite weerspieël. Fasiliteer die belyning van provinsiale planne met munisipale gemeenskapsbehoeftes. Verseker die hersiening en implementering van die provinsiale IGR-kalender. Mobiliseer provinsiale en nasionale sektordepartemente om aan munisipale IDP-prosesse deel te neem. Koördineer die bydraes van sektordepartemente en SOE's tot die ontwikkeling van die Provinciale IDP-ontledingsraamwerk. Berei EXCO-voorlegging voor oor die bevindings van die IDP-assessering. Ontwikkel, implementeer en hersien die Interowerheidsbeplanningsraamwerk. Verteenwoordig die departement by die Nasionale IDP-koördineerdersforum en doen verslag daaroor en deel beste praktyke met die forum. Koördineer die ontwikkeling, implementering en hersiening van DDM Een-planne regdeur die Gauteng-streek: Koördineer en neem deel aan die DDM IGR-koördineringsplatforms. Verseker dat DDM in provinsiale en munisipale planne geïnkorporeer word. Fasiliteer nodige betrokkenheid met relevante GPG-sektordepartemente. Bestuur van personeel: Bestuur menslike hulpbronne in verband met alle IDP- en DDM-werk. Bestuur van personeelverlof deur ESS. Fasiliteer en koördineer die middeljaar- en finalejaar-prestasieheruitings van personeel. Doen verslag oor ad hoc-aktiwiteitsbestuur. Fasiliteer die uitvoering van alle nie-kontraktuele werksaktiwiteite soos en wanneer deur die owerhede versoek. Berei verslae en notule voor vir bygewoonde vergaderings en werkswinkels. Neem deel aan die sitval van die Biedevalueringskomitee vir die keuse van biedende aansoekers, waar nodig. En berei Diensvlakooreenkomste voor vir goedgekeurde projekte waar nodig.

zu.title: Isekela Mongameli: Ukuqondanisa kwe-IDP
zu.summary: Kudingeka iSekela Mongameli ukuze ahlophise aseke ukucubungula okethembekile kwe-Integrated Development Planning emasipalini e-Gauteng, kudingwa izifundo ezinga le-NQF Level 7 kanye neminyaka engu-3-5 yohlu lwemisebenzi yokuphatha.
zu.requirements: Matric kanye ne-NQF Level 7 kwi-Town and Regional Planning, Development Studies, Development Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation, Public Management, noma izifundo ezinhle ezihambisana naleso njengoba zivunyiwe yi-SAQA. Kuhambisana neminyaka engu-3-5 yohlu lwemisebenzi ezingeni lokuphatha (ASD) noma emasipalini noma ezingeni le-provincial/national noma ukuhlanganiswa kwalezi kanti kubapofukayo, kunakho ukuba kusemkhakheni we-Integrated Development Planning, intergovernmental planning, spatial planning, noma emkhakheni ofanayo. Izakhamuzi: Amakhono obuholi bomuntu siqu n bokunyango, Iziqu zokuzwana nabantu, Ukuqonda ngokuhlaziya, Amakhono ocwaningo, Amakhono okuqondisa kanye nezinkulumo, Ukuqondisa imiklamo, Ukuqinisekela izimiso zawo, Amakhono ekhompyutha, Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, Amakhono okwakha ukuxhumana, Amakhono okuxoxisana, Ukusebenza njengomuntu owodwa kanye neqembu, Ukusebenza kodwa nokuhlela amakhono abe nokuqondanisa. Ilayisense yokushayela esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Ukuqondisa futhi ukuhlophisa ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokusetshenziswa kwe-IDP ezethembekile emasipalini: Ukunika ukusekela ngobuhlakani obuchwepheshe, obusesibukweni kanye nokulawula ngokuphambene nokuthuthukiswa kwe-IDP ezihambisana nemithetho. Ukuqondisa inqubo ye-Integrated Development Planning ngokabeka kuka-MEC we-COGTA esifundeni se-Gauteng City Region. Ukuqondisa ukuhambisana nemithetho, ukwethembeka, kanye nokusetshenziswa kwe-Municipal IDPs ngokomthetho (Municipal Systems Act of 2000). Ukuqondisa izinkingxoxo ezinkulu emikhakheni ehlukene ukuze kuhlophiswe ukulethwa kwemiklamo ngokuhlanganyela kanye nokuqoqa izidingo zomphakathi ngamasipala kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi zifakwe emiklamweni yamasipala ne-provincial. Ukuqondisa inqubo yokuhambisa i-IDP eziphelelwe kumasipala ukuze avunyelwe yi-Municipal Council ngaphambi kokuthi zihambiswe ku-COGTA. Ukuqinisekisa ukusakazwa kanye nokufakwa kwemiklamo ye-gazetted GPG kwi-Municipal Final IDPs. Ukuqinisekisa ukuqondaniswa kwe-Municipal IDPs ne-DDM. Ukuhlaziya i-Municipal Process Plans. Ukuqondisa izinkingxoxo ze-Provincial IDP Managers Forum. Ukuqondisa futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuhlophisa ukuqondaniswa kwe-municipal IDPs kubaluleke kakhulu kwe-National and Provincial kanye namapulani: Ukuqondisa kanye nokuhlophisa ukusekela kwezinsimbi ukuze kutholakale ukuthi ama-Municipal IDPs abonakalisa izinto ezibalulekile zika-National and Provincial. Ukuqondisa ukuqondaniswa kwamapulani we-provincial nezidingo zomphakathi wamasipala. Ukuqinisekisa ukuhlola nokusetshenziswa kwe-provincial IGR calendar. Ukuqoqa amanyango e-provincial and national sector ukuba abambe iqhaza kumchameni we-municipal IDP Processes. Ukuhlophisa izimvo zamasipala namanyango kanye ne-SOE kuthuthukiseni i-Provincial IDP Analysis Framework. Ukuhlunga izinkethulo ze-EXCO ngokusha kwemiphumela yokuhlola i-IDP. Ukuthuthukisa, ukusetshenziswa, kanye ukuhlola i-Intergovernmental Planning Framework. Ukumela umnyango e-National IDP Coordinators Forum abika ngakho futhi wabelane ngokwenzelwa kuhle kule-forum. Ukuhlophisa ukuthuthukiswa, ukusetshenziswa, kanye ukuhlola kwe-DDM One Plans kulo lonke i-Gauteng City Region: Ukuhlophisa ukuthatha inhlalo kumagosa aguqukayo e-DDM IGR Coordinating platforms. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi i-DDM ifakwe emapulana e-provincial and municipal. Ukuqondisa izinkingxoxo ezidingekayo namanyango amakhulu we-GPG. Ukuphathwa kwabasebenzi: Ukuphatha abasebenzi ngokuphathelene nayo yonke imisebenzi ye-IDP ne-DDM. Ukuphatha ukukhishwa kwabasebenzi ngokusebenzisa i-ESS. Ukuqondisa nokuhlophisa ukubuyekezwa kokusebenza okuphakathi kwegama kanye nangasikhathi sokugcina kwabasebenzi. Ukubika ngokuqondisa imisebenzi eze ngesikhathi esithile. Ukuqondisa ukwenziwa kwawo wonke umsebenzi ongaphandle kwezivumelwano ngesikhathi esithunjwe ngabaphathi. Ukuhlunga imibiko nemaminithi wemihlangano kanye nezinkomfa ezibukwe. Ukuthatha inhlalo kumzuzu wokuqokwa kukabhunga lokukhetha abantu, uma kunesidingo. Futhi ukuhlunga ama-Service Level Agreements emiklameni evunyiwe uma kunesidingo.

xh.title: Deputy Director: IDP Coordination
xh.summary: Kufuneka iDeputy Director ukuze alungelelanise aze axhase iIntegrated Development Planning ethembekileyo kumasipala oGauteng, kufuneka abe nengqeqesho yeNQF Level 7 kunye namava eminyaka eli-3-5 ekubeni ngumphathi.
xh.requirements: iMatric kunye neNQF Level 7 kwiTown and Regional Planning, Development Studies, Development Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation, Public Management, okanye nangomgangatho ofanelekileyo njengokwamkelwa yi-SAQA. Edityaniswe namava eminyaka eli-3-5 kwinqanaba lomphathi (ASD) elisesiphalweni samasipala okanye kwinqanaba lephondo/naswesizwe okanye kutshanjwelwano lwaloo mivalo kananjalo, ngokukhethwa kuyo kwindawo ye-Integrated Development Planning, ucwangciso lwebalikazi phakathi koMasipala, ucwangciso lwendawo, okanye kwindawo enxulumene nalo. Iimfuno: Ikhono lokuloba ngokwakho nakwikampani, Izihlobo zobudlelwane phakathi kwabantu, Okuqondwa ngokwahlulahlula, Iimfuno zophando, Ikhono lokukhokela iinkqubo nokubonisa, Ulawulo lweProjekthi, Ukuzimisela, Ikhono lekhompyutha, Ikhono lokuxazulula iingxabano, Ikhono lokwakha ukuxhumana, Ikhono lokuxoxisana, Ukusebenza njengohlobo, Ukusebenza ngokuzimeleyo kunye nekhono lokucwangcisa nokuququzelela. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Qhubela phambili kwaye ulungelelanise ukuphuhliswa nokusebenza kweziQikelelo eziZintsonga zeNtshukumo ezingathembekiyo kumasipala: Zisa inkxaso yobuchwepheshe, ezamasiko nokulandelela indlela ephuhliswa ngayo i-IDP ezihambelana nemithetho. Qhubela phambili inqubo ye-Integrated Development Planning ngenxaxheba kaMEC we-COGTA kwiGauteng City Region. Qhubela phambili ukuhambelana nemithetho, ukwethenjwa nokusebenza kwe-IDP zoMasipala njengoko kumiselwe ngumthetho (iMunicipal Systems Act ka-2000). Qhubela phambili iingxoxo ebanzi zeemiba ezahlukeneyo ukuze kuhlonyulwe ulungelelwaniso lolucwangciso nokuqokelelwa kwezidingo zomphakathi ziMasipala, kananjalo ukuqinisekisa ukuba zifakwa kwiczwangciso zomasipala nephondo. Qhubela phambili inqubo yokunikela i-IDP zokugqibela kuMkhandlu wakaMasipala ukuze zamkelwe ngaphambi kokunikelwa kwi-COGTA. Qinisekisa ukusasazwa nokuqokelelwa kweeprojekthi ze-GPG ezishiwo kwisiGazeta kwi-IDP zoMasipala eziGqibelayo. Qinisekisa ulungelelwaniso lwe-IDP zoMasipala nayo i-DDM. Yenza isahluko ngePlana zeNqubo zoMasipala. Qhubela phambili iingxoxo zeForam yabaBali be-IDP bePhondo. Qhubela phambili ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulungelelwaniso lwe-IDP zoMasipala ezindabeni ezibalulekileyo kunye nezicwangciso zeSizwe nesiPhondo: Qhubela phambili kulungelelanise inkxaso yemiba ezahlukeneyo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba i-IDP zoMasipala zibonisa izinto ezibalulekileyo zeSizwe nesiPhondo. Qhubela phambili ulungelelwaniso lwezicwangciso zephondo ngezidingo zomphakathi womasipala. Qinisekisa ukuqwalaselwa nokusebenza kwekhalenda ye-IGR yephondo. Bumba iisebe zephondo nesesizwe ukuba zithathe inxaxheba kwiinkqubo ze-IDP zomasipala. Lungelanisa izimvo zezisebe ezahlukeneyo nake-SOE ekuphuhlisweni kwe-Provincial IDP Analysis Framework. Lungisa izibhalo ze-EXCO ngeziphumo zokuhlola i-IDP. Phuhlisa, yenza kwaye uqwalasele i-Intergovernmental Planning Framework. Mela isebę kwiForam yabaLungelelanisi be-IDP beSizwe kwaye uxele ngayo kwaye wabelane ngamava amnandi ngeforam. Lungelanisa ukuphuhliswa, ukusebenza nokuphinda kuqwalaselwe kwe-DDM One Plans kuwo onke amaza eGauteng City Region: Lungelanisa kwaye uthathe inxaxheba kumacandelo olungelelwaniso e-DDM IGR. Qinisekisa ukuba i-DDM ifakwe kwizicwangciso zephondo nomasipala. Qhubela phambili iingxoxo eziyimfuno nezisebe ezahlukeneyo ze-GPG. Ulawulo lwabasebenzi: Lawula abantu abasebenzayo ngokubhekisele kuyo yonke imisebenzi ye-IDP nese-DDM. Lawule ilishu leabasebenzi nge-ESS. Qhubela phambili kulungelelanise ukuphinda kuqwalaselwa kokusebenza ngaphakathi kwonyaka nakwindalo ekuphela konyaka kwabasebenzi. Xela ngolawulo lwenkqubo engaphangeliyo. Qhubela phambili ukwenziwa kwayo yonke imisebenzi engaqinisekiswanga ngomzimba naxa kucelwa ngamagunya alawulayo. Lungisa iingxelo namaminithi aleenkqubo namakomiti ethathwayo. Thatha inxaxheba kwizihlalo ze-Bid Evaluation Committee ukhetho lwabafaki isicelo, apho kufuneka khona. Kananjalo, lungisa iService Level Agreements zeeprojekthi ezamkelekileyo apho kufuneka khona.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Capacity Development
jobs.department: Department of Co-operative Governance and Traditional Affairs
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Capacity Development position in Johannesburg requiring an NQF Level 7 qualification and 3-5 years supervisory experience in human resource development.
jobs.requirements: Matric plus NQF Level 7 in Human Resource Development / Human Resource Management / Industrial Psychology or relevant qualification as recognised by SAQA. Coupled with 3-5 years of experience at a supervisory (ASD) level in Human Resource Development / Capacity Building environment. A Skills Development Facilitator and Education Training and Development Practitioner Certificates will be an added advantage. Competencies: Strategic Thinking, Stakeholder management, Conflict Management, Communication, Project Management, MS office, Report Writing, Budget Management, Leadership, capability and strategic thinking, Interpersonal skills, Supervisory Skills, Planning and Organizing, Risk Management and Problem Solving. A valid driver’s licence.
jobs.duties: Monitor and ensure support in the implementation of the scarce and critical skills strategy: Provide guidance and advice with regards to the implementation of the scarce and critical skills strategy through municipal engagements. Ensure the coordination and facilitation of meetings with municipalities with regards to the scarce and critical skills strategy. Manage the relationship between Local Government (LG) SETA and the Municipalities. Represent both COGTA and municipalities at LG SETA engagements. Manage the relationship between key stakeholders and Municipalities. Represent Gauteng CoGTA at DCOG (national COGTA) meetings, and report on capacity building initiatives in the province. Manage the updating of monthly reports timeously. Ensure the provision of quarterly reports timeously. Quality assure and ensure the provision of quarterly reports timeously. Provide technical and hands on support to the training and learning development units in municipalities: Monitor and ensure the compilation of the Workplace Skills Plan and Annual Report by all 11 Municipalities as well as the skills audit process. Develop Skills Audit Template and process flow. Provide guidance and support on implementation of Skills Audit process. Ensure the functioning of Workplace Skills Committees in Municipalities. Direct and facilitate capacity building programs through coordination, collaboration, leveraging and consolidation of various sector initiatives and strategic established stakeholders. Share knowledge and best practice with regards to capacity building. Manage and facilitate various engagements including stakeholder engagements, joint HR forums. Facilitate and manage capacity building programs for municipalities (Soft Skills): Ensure the development of materials for selected soft skills training. Manage and coordinate trainings at various municipalities. Facilitate the identified trainings. Manage the update monthly reports timeously. Quality assure and ensure the provision of quarterly reports timeously. Perform Deployment functions at identified municipalities: Manage and provide support at identified municipalities in respect to Pillar 5: Building Institutional Capabilities namely. Monitor senior vacancies. Monitor critical vacancies and scarce vacancies. Report on training that is facilitated by COGTA. Follow-up and action the recommendations made by South African Board of People Practice (SABPP). Lead the pillar in meetings with both the identified municipalities and the CoGTA team. Manage and update all progress reports. Escalate all challenges to both CoGTA and identified municipalities. Management of Sub Directorate: Management of day-to-day operations. Plan and delegate work and monitor progress. Manage weekly, monthly, and quarterly meetings. Manage the skills development plan of the Sub Directorate. Manage the PMDS of the Sub Directorate. Manage the audit finding and queries of the Sub Directorate. Facilitate the review and planning sessions and the submission of the strategic, operational plans, reports of the programme.
jobs.enquiries: Caiphus/ Andy, cell: 071 474 7078/51
jobs.applications: Applications should be submitted strictly online at https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za/Public/Jobs.aspx FOR ATTENTION : Human Capital management
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly online completed Z83 form It is our intention to promote representivity (race, gender, and disability) in the Public Service through the filling of these posts. Preference will be given to people with disabilities, and they will be exempted from a driver’s license requirement. Applications        should       be     submitted       strictly    online     at https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za/Public/Jobs.aspx                                  or http://jobs.gauteng.gov.za/Public/Jobs.aspx and it should be accompanied by a most recent Z83 form which may be obtained from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents. and comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV), certified copies of qualifications and Identity will be submitted upon request (no postal or hand delivery applications will be accepted). It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Furthermore, the recommended candidate will be required to produce his/her SMS Pre-entry certificate as offered by the National School of Governance (NSG) prior to the appointment being made. The certificate for entry into SMS and full details can be sourced by the following link: http://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Preference will be given to female applicants for SMS posts. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments; one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Correspondence will only be limited to shortlisted candidates. If you have not been contacted within 3 months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Failure to comply with the above instructions of specifically attaching a recent Z83 and a comprehensive CV will result in applications being disqualified. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

zu.title: Isikhulu Esihamba Phambili: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwamandla
zu.summary: Isikhundla sika-Isikhulu Esihamba Phambili: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwamandla e-Johannesburg esidinga izifundo ezitholakalanga kumazinga e-NQF Level 7 kanye neminyaka engu-3-5 yokuqondisa okuhlobene nokuthuthukiswa kwamandla abantu.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samatric kahle kakhulu, kanye ne-NQF Level 7 kuleyo ndikimba yokuthuthukiswa kwamandla abantu / ukuphathwa kwamandla abantu / I-Industrial Psychology noma isiqu esihambisana nalokho esivunyiwe yi-SAQA. Kuhlukaniswe nangeminyaka engu-3-5 yohlelo lokusebenza emazingeni okuqondisa (i-ASD) kokuthuthukiswa kwamandla abantu / indikimba yokwakha amandla. I-Certificate yokuba yi-Skills Development Facilitator kanye ne-Education Training and Development Practitioner zizokuba yinzuzo ethize. Amakhono: Ukucabanga ngokuhlakanipha, ukuphathwa kwabahlanganyeli, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga, Ukuxhumana, ukuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi, i-MS office, ukubhala imibiko, ukuphathwa kwebhajethi, Ukubusa, amandla nokucabanga ngokuhlakanipha, amakhono okuxhumana nabantu, amakhono okuqondisa, ukucubungula futhi uhlele, ukuphathwa kwezingozi kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ilayisense yokushayela esesebenzayo.
zu.duties: Qapha futhi qinisekisa ukwesekwa ekwenzeni isu lezikhungo ezibalulekile nezesikhathi esibucayi. Nikeza imiqondiso nencebiso ngokuphathwa kwesu lezikhungo ezibalulekile nezesikhathi esibucayi ngokuhlangana namasipala. Qinisekisa ukuhlanganiswa nokuhlelwa kwezinkulumo namasipala ngokuphathwa kwesu lezikhungo ezibalulekile nezesikhathi esibucayi. Phatha ubudlelwano phakathi kuka-Local Government (LG) SETA namaSipala. Mele kokubili i-COGTA namasipala ezinkulumweni ze-LG SETA. Phatha ubudlelwano phakathi kweziqu ezibalulekile namaSipala. Mele i-Gauteng CoGTA emihlanganweni ye-DCOG (i-national COGTA), futhi ube imibiko ngezinhlobo zokwakha amandla esifundazweni. Phatha ukubuyekeza imibiko yanyanga zonke ngasesikhathini. Qinisekisa ukunikwa kwemibiko yesikhashana ngasesikhathini. Hlolisisa izinga futhi qinisekise ukunikwa kwemibiko yesikhashana ngasesikhathini. Nikeza inkusezobuchwepheshe nosekwenzo emaphaneli okuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwesifundo emasipaleni. Qapha futhi qinisekisa ukulungiselelwa kwe-Workplace Skills Plan kanye neNqubo Yomnyaka Wezibalo kuwo wonke ama-11 amasipala kanye nenqubo yokuhlolwa kwamandla. Hlakisela isifanekiso Sokuholayo Kwamandla kanye nomzila wenqubo. Nikeza imiqondiso nosekwenzo ekusebenziseni inqubo Yokuholayo Kwamandla. Qinisekisa ukusebenza kwe-Workplace Skills Committees emaSipaleni. Qondisa futhi uhlele izinhlelo zokwakha amandla ngokuhlanganisa, ukubambisana, ukusebenzisa, kanye nokuqinisa izinhlelo ezahlukene zesifunda kanye nabahlanganyeli ababalulekile. Yabelana ngolwazi nezinhlelo ezinhle mayelana nokwakha amandla. Phatha futhi uhlele ezinye izinkulumo kufaka phakathi izinkulumo zabahlanganyeli, amafolo we-HR asehlanganini. Hlela futhi phathe izinhlelo zokwakha amandla amasipala (amandla asecaleni). Qinisekisa ukulungiselelwa kwemithi engeminye yezinhlelo zokuqeqesha okukhethwe. Phatha futhi uhlanganise ukuqeqeshwa emasipaleni ahlukene. Hlela ukuqeqeshwa okukhethiwe. Phatha ukubuyekeza imibiko yanyanga zonke ngasesikhathini. Hlolisisa izinga futhi qinisekisa ukunikwa kwemibiko yesikhashana ngasesikhathini. Yenza imisebenzi yokuthumela ezinkundleni emasipaleni akhethiwe. Phatha futhi nikeza nesebenzo emasipaleni akhethiwe mayelana nokuQakamba koku-5: Ukwakha Amandla Eshishini. Qapha izikhala ezingaba khona ezingama-senior. Qapha izikhala ezibalulekile kanye nezikhala ezibucayi. Yeka imibiko ngokuqeqeshwa okuhlelwe yi-COGTA. Landelela futhi wenze izincomo ezinikezwe i-South African Board of People Practice (SABPP). Dala inkundla emihlanganweni namaSipala akhethiwe kanye nothisi we-CoGTA. Phatha futhi buyekeza yonke imibiko yokuqhubekayo. Khuphula zonke izinselelo kokubili i-CoGTA namasipala akhethiwe. Ukuphathwa kwe-Sub Directorate: Ukuphathwa koshintsho lwangemihla ngemihla. Hlela futhi wabelwe ngomsebenzi bese uqapha inqubekelaphambili. Phatha imihlangano yamasonto onke, yanyanga zonke, nesikhashana. Phatha isu lokuthuthukiswa kwamandla se-Sub Directorate. Phatha i-PMDS yesi-Sub Directorate. Phatha izingxabano zokuhlolwa kanye nemibuzo yesi-Sub Directorate. Hlela ukubuyekezwa kanye nezinkulumo zokuqamba izinhlelo nokuthumela izinhlelo zesu, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nemibiko yale nqubo.

xh.title: Under-Director: Ukusetyenziswa kolwazi
xh.summary: Isithuba se-Deputy Director: Capacity Development eJohannesburg esifuna izidanga ze-NQF Level 7 namava eminyaka ye-3-5 ekulawuleni ukusetyenziswa kolwazi kwi-nkqubo yophuhliso lwemisebenzi yabantu.
xh.requirements: I-Matric kwaye kufuneka ibe ne-NQF Level 7 kwi-Human Resource Development / Human Resource Management / Industrial Psychology okanye isidanga esifanelekileyo njengoko samkelwa yi-SAQA. Kwaye kufuneka kube namava eminyaka ye-3-5 kwinqanaba lobaphathi (ASD) kwindawo yoPhuhliso lweMisebenzi yabaNtu / uKwakhiwa kwamandla. Ii-Skills Development Facilitator ne-Education Training and Development Practitioner Certificates ziya kuba ngumonga olongezelelekileyo. Iikhompetensi: Ukucinga ngokwebhalano, Ukulawula abanomdla, Ukulawula ingxabano, Unxibelelwano, Ukulawula iiprojekthi, I-MS office, uBhalo lwe-Report, Ukulawula iBhajeti, uBukhosi, amandla nokucinga ngokwebhalano, Iakhono zobuntu, Iakhono zokulawula, uCwangciso nokuHlela, Ukulawula ingozi noKusombulula iingxaki. Ilayiseni yomqhubi.
xh.duties: Qwalasa ukuqinisekisa inkxaso ekusebenzeni kwindlela yolwazi oluthe ngqo nalolu balulekileyo: Nikeza isikhokelo kunye nenkxabela ngokubalulela ekusebenzeni kwindlela yolwazi oluthe ngqo nalolu balulekileyo ngeengxoxo zomasipala. Qinisekisa uqhagamshelo nokuhubela iintlanganiso namasipala ngokubalulela kwindlela yolwazi oluthe ngqo nalolu balulekileyo. Lawula ubudlelwane phakathi kwe-Local Government (LG) SETA namaMasipala. Mela i-COGTA namasipala kwiingxoxo ze-LG SETA. Lawula ubudlelwane phakathi kwabanomdla abaphambili namaMasipala. Mela i-Gauteng CoGTA kwintlanganiso ze-DCOG (i-national COGTA), uze uxela ngenkqubo zokwakha amandla kwelithi. Lawula ukuhlaziya iireport nyanga zonke ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Qinisekisa ukunikwa kweereport zethatu nyanga ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Qinisekisa uthotho ukuze uqinisekise ukunikwa kweereport zethatu nyanga ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Nikeza inkxaso yobuchwephesha nenkxaso eqhoqho kwiindawo zokuzidla nokuphuhliswa kokufunda kumasipala: Qwalasa ukuqinisekisa ukulungiselelwa koLwazi lweNqanaba lokuSebenza i-Workplace Skills Plan kunye ne-Report yonyaka zazonke i-11 amaMasipala nakwishishini lokuhlola amandla. Phuhlisa i-Template yokuhlola Amandi nendlela yokuqhuba. Nikeza isikhokelo nenkxaso ekusebenzeni kwishishini lokuhlola amandla. Qinisekisa ukusebenza kwee-Komitshi zoLwazi lweNqanaba lokuSebenza kuMasipala. Qondisa ukuqhuba iinkqubo zokwakha amandla ngokuqhagamshela, ukusebenzisana, ukusebenzisa, nokuqokelela iinkqubo ngenkrnkrnkrnkrnkrnkr ngezithili ezahlukeneyo. Yabelana ngolwazi nendlela engcono kakhulu ngokwakha amandla. Lawula ukuqhagamshela kweenkrnkrnkrnkrnkrnkr ezahlukeneyo kuquka nokuqhagamshelana nabantomdla, iiforham ze-HR. Qhagamshelela ulawule iinkqubo zokwakha amandla kuMasipala (Amandla alula nje): Qinisekisa ukuphuhliswa kwezinto zokufundisa amandla alula. Lawula uqhagamshelele iqhube iindwendwe kumaziko ahlukene. Hubela isikolo esikhethwe. Lawula uhlaziye iireport zeentsuku zedola ngelixa. Qinisekisa isixa kodidi olungeniswayo ngenxa yentsuku ezindathu. Hlaziya imisebenzi kwindawo ethi nthutha kwindawo ethi yomthendeleko eselelwe: Lawulathethea ngqu thekelo kwindawo ethi ziiqonga ezikuwo zokuqoqwa kwakha iindawo. Qwalasela kwindawo iindawo ezingekhoyo zolunge. Qwalasela kwindawo iindawo ezingasentla phaya lunge. Xela kwindawo inxuzi elungiweyo eka-COGTA. Landela siqhube ngokulunge ngokulunge isiphakamiso zenziwa ngabakwi-South African Board of People Practice (SABPP). Qamba inqaba kwindawo iindawo ezize ngqo neze-COGTA. Lawula kwindawo uhlaziya zonke izikolo zolunge. Phakamisa kwindawo ngokuvela kwiimeko. Lawula ngenxa yesiqingengaba se-Sobukhazi: Lawula imisebenzi yangemihla. Cwangcisa usabelise imisebenzi qwalase ngakumbi. Lawula iintsapho iindawo ngeentsapho. Lawula inkqubo yolwazi lwe-Sobukhazi. Lawula inkqubo ye-PMDS ye-Sobukhazi. Lawula imiba yokuhlolelwa nengxoxo ze-Sobukhazi. Qhagamshela iindaba zokuhlolwa kwindawo ucwangciso ngokuthumela iindlela ezahlukeneyo, inkcazelo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Demand and Acquisition
jobs.department: Department of Co-operative Governance and Traditional Affairs
jobs.summary: Deputy Director role in Demand and Acquisition for the Department of Co-operative Governance and Traditional Affairs in Johannesburg, offering R932292 per annum.
jobs.requirements: Matric plus NQF level 7 in Supply Chain Management / Logistics or relevant qualification. Coupled with a minimum of 3-5 years’ experience at an Assistant Director level in Demand Management environment. Competencies: Knowledge and understanding of legislative and policy framework regulating Asset Management processes, procedures, and systems. Knowledge Public Finance Management Act. PPPFA, PPPFA Regulations, SCM Practice notes, All the SCM Prescripts, Asset Management skills, Analytical Skills, Project Management Skills, Report writing skills, Communication Skills, conflict management skills, Interpersonal Skills, Planning and Organizing skills, Leadership Skills, and Financial Skills. A valid drivers’ licence.
jobs.duties: Manage the process of request for demand and acquisition of goods and Services: Ensure that Annual Demand plan is compiled annually. Ensure that Demand Plan reports are aligned to departmental operational plans and activities. Monitor and manage leads time response versus requisitions and service delivery turnaround times from suppliers. Analyse, monitor and process all procurement transactions prior each financial year. Oversee management of stores management pertain to stores items. Monitor and manage validity of SAP transactions within the system by requesting management SAP reports. Advise and engage management on new policies in respect of procurement matters i.e. bidding process, contract management, practice notes and continuous improvement tender administration reforms. Engage business units with regards to status of their respective demand plans) and Effectively advice management on new policies regarding procurement matters. Manage and implement systems to ensure deliveries of goods, services and payments: Ensure that goods and or service received from suppliers is in line with PO issued and further ensure that they are in good condition, correct stock prior handing it over to the relevant unit. Ensure that RLS-02 (Good Confirmation) are captured on time when receiving invoice. Ensure constant follow-ups on all outstanding orders are recorded and suppliers are informed in writing. Monitor and advise on all tolerances (Price differences). Monitor and speed up all outstanding payments on Cockpit Web cycle and missing GRV’S daily. Ensure that all internal and external queries are attended within 2 days and query register is maintain for official purposes. Ensure invoices for goods and service rendered are processed on timeously within turnaround time of 10 days. Expedite, and Engage directorates regarding the delivery of goods and services rendered for invoicing. Engage business units with regards to status of their respective invoices (outstanding and paid invoices). Ensure that reorder levels are maintained for all store related items. Ensure that internal requisition forms (VA2) are signed properly by designated official’s prior issuance of stock. Ensure the provision of secretarial support in departmental demand committee: Ensure that BAC (Bid Adjudication Committee) agendas are compiled correctly. Manage the distribution of agendas and minutes to all members at least on the two days prior to the meetings. Check and ensure that minutes of the meetings are correctly taken, and clients are informed in writing of the outcome. Act as advisor to the adjudication evaluation panels. Arrange ad hoc meeting and ensure the recording of deliberations of the meetings. Coordinate and support with the development of request for proposal/Specifications. Ensure that the projects are aligned to the strategic objectives of the department. Ensure that the Procurement plan and Demand plans are aligned to the budget and submitted to GPT on time. Support the business units to develop specifications/Terms of reference. Review the specifications and Terms of reference before they are submitted to the Bid Committees. Management of Sub-Directorate: Management of the Sub-Directorate. Manage and solve conflict within the Sub-Directorate. Management of skills development plan of the Sub-Directorate. Management of the PMDS within the Sub-Directorate. Management of leave within the Sub-Directorate. Management of audit finding and queries of the Sub-Directorate.
jobs.enquiries: Caiphus/ Andy, cell: 071 474 7078/51
jobs.applications: Applications should be submitted strictly online at https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za/Public/Jobs.aspx FOR ATTENTION : Human Capital management
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly online completed Z83 form It is our intention to promote representivity (race, gender, and disability) in the Public Service through the filling of these posts. Preference will be given to people with disabilities, and they will be exempted from a driver’s license requirement. Applications        should       be     submitted       strictly    online     at https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za/Public/Jobs.aspx                                  or http://jobs.gauteng.gov.za/Public/Jobs.aspx and it should be accompanied by a most recent Z83 form which may be obtained from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents. and comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV), certified copies of qualifications and Identity will be submitted upon request (no postal or hand delivery applications will be accepted). It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Furthermore, the recommended candidate will be required to produce his/her SMS Pre-entry certificate as offered by the National School of Governance (NSG) prior to the appointment being made. The certificate for entry into SMS and full details can be sourced by the following link: http://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Preference will be given to female applicants for SMS posts. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments; one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Correspondence will only be limited to shortlisted candidates. If you have not been contacted within 3 months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Failure to comply with the above instructions of specifically attaching a recent Z83 and a comprehensive CV will result in applications being disqualified. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunk-direkteur: Vraag en Verkryging
af.summary: Adjunk-direkteur-pos in Vraag en Verkryging vir die Department of Co-operative Governance and Traditional Affairs in Johannesburg, wat R932292 per jaar bied.
af.requirements: Matric plus NQF vlak 7 in Voorsieningskettingbestuur / Logistiek of relevante kwalifikasie. Saam met 'n minimum van 3-5 jaar se ervaring op 'n Assistent-direkteurvlak in 'n Vraagbestuursomgewing. Bevoegdhede: Kennis en begrip van die wetgewende en beleidsraamwerk wat Batebestuursprosesse, prosedures en stelsels reguleer. Kennis van die Public Finance Management Act. PPPFA, PPPFA Regulasies, SCM Praktyknotas, Al die SCM Voorskryfte, Batebestuursvaardighede, Analitiese Vaardighede, Projekbestuursvaardighede, Verslagdoeningsvaardighede, Kommunikasievaardighede, konflikbestuursvaardighede, Interpersoonlike Vaardighede, Beplannings- en Organisasievaardighede, Leierskapsvaardighede en Finansiële Vaardighede. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Bestuur die proses van versoek vir vraag en verkryging van goedere en dienste: Verseker dat die jaarlikse vraagplan jaarliks opgestel word. Verseker dat vraagplanverslae bely word met departementele operasionele planne en aktiwiteite. Monitor en bestuur leitye-reaksie versus bestellings en diensleweringsomkeertye van verskaffers. Analiseer, monitor en verwerk alle verkrygingstransaksies voor elke finansiële jaar. Oorsien die bestuur van winkelbestuur met betrekking tot winkelitems. Monitor en bestuur die geldigheid van SAP-transaksies binne die stelsel deur bestuurs-SAP-verslae aan te vra. Adviseer en betrek bestuur oor nuwe beleid met betrekking tot verkrygingsake, d.w.s. bodproses, kontrakbestuur, praktysknotas en deurlopende verbetering van tenderadministrasiehervormings. Betrek besigheidseenhede met betrekking tot die status van hul onderskeie vraagplanne en adviseer bestuur doeltreffend oor nuwe beleid rakende verkrygingsake. Bestuur en implementeer stelsels om die aflewering van goedere, dienste en betalings te verseker: Verseker dat goedere en of dienste wat van verskaffers ontvang is, in ooreenstemming is met die uitgereikte KO en verder verseker dat dit in goeie toestand is, die regte voorraad is voordat dit aan die betrokke eenheid oorhandig word. Verseker dat RLS-02 (Goederebevestiging) betyds vasgelê word wanneer die faktuur ontvang word. Verseker dat konstante opvolg op alle uitstaande bestellings aangeteken word en verskaffers skriftelik in kennis gestel word. Monitor en adviseer oor alle toleransies (prysverskille). Monitor en bespoedig alle uitstaande betalings op Cockpit Web-siklus en ontbrekende GRV's daagliks. Verseker dat alle interne en eksterne navrae binne 2 dae hanteer word en die navraeregister vir amptelike doeleindes gehou word. Verseker dat fakture vir gelewerde goedere en dienste betyds verwerk word binne 'n omkeertyd van 10 dae. Bespoedig en betrek direktorate met betrekking tot die aflewering van gelewerde goedere en dienste vir fakture. Betrek besigheidseenhede met betrekking tot die status van hul onderskeie fakture (uitstaande en betaalde fakture). Verseker dat herbestellingsvlakke vir alle winkelverwante items gehandhaaf word. Verseker dat interne bestelvorms (VA2) behoorlik deur aangewese amptenare geteken is voor uitreiking van voorraad. Verseker die voorsiening van sekretariële ondersteuning in die departementele vrae-komitee: Verseker dat BAC (Bied-afhandelaarskomitee) agendae korrek opgestel word. Bestuur die verspreiding van agendae en notules aan alle lede ten minste twee dae voor die vergaderings. Kontroleer en verseker dat notules van die vergaderings korrek geneem word, en kliënte skriftelik van die uitslag in kennis gestel word. Tree as adviseur vir die afhandelingsevalueringspanele op. Reël ad hoc-vergaderings en verseker die opneem van beraadslaging van die vergaderings. Koördineer en ondersteun met die ontwikkeling van versoek vir voorstelle/spesifikasies. Verseker dat die projekte bely word met die strategiese doelwitte van die departement. Verseker dat die verkrygingsplan en vraagplanne bely word met die begroting en betyds aan GPT voorgelê word. Ondersteun die besigheidseenhede om spesifikasies/Terms of reference te ontwikkel. Hersien die spesifikasies en Terms of reference voordat dit aan die Biedkomitees voorgelê word. Bestuur van Sub-direktoraat: Bestuur van die Sub-direktoraat. Bestuur en los konflik binne die Sub-direktoraat op. Bestuur van die vaardigheidsontwikkelingsplan van die Sub-direktoraat. Bestuur van die PMDS binne die Sub-direktoraat. Bestuur van verlof binne die Sub-direktoraat. Bestuur van ouditbevindings en navrae van die Sub-direktoraat.

zu.title: IPhini Likadirekhtha: Isidingo NokuThola
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba yiphini likadirekhtha kuIsidingo NokuThola kwiDepartment of Co-operative Governance and Traditional Affairs eJohannesburg, linikeza iholo le-R932292 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Ukugqedwa kweMatric kanye ne-NQF level 7 kwiSupply Chain Management / Logistics noma iziqu ezifanele. Kuhlanganiselwe nomphumela weminyaka engu-3-5 ukuze uthole isiphephelo esikhundini sikabe nongqeshi ezingeni leAssistant Director kwindawo yokuphatha izidingo. Amakhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda umthethosisekelo nomthethondlela ohlolisayo inqubo, izinhlela namasistimu okuphatha izimpahla. Ulwazi lwePublic Finance Management Act. I-PPPFA, Izimiso ze-PPPFA, Izaziso zomsebenzi we-SCM, Wonke amaphrojekthi we-SCM, Amakhono okuphatha izimpahla, Amakhono okuhlaziya, Amakhono okuphatha amaphrojekthi, Amakhono okubhala imibiko, Amakhono okuxhumana, Amakhono okuphatha izinkinga, Amakhono abantu, Amakhono ekulungiseleleni nokuhlela, Amakhono ebuholi, kanye namakhono ezimali. Ilaysense yokuqasha ehloniphekile.
zu.duties: Phatha inqubo yokucela isidingo nokuthola izimpahla namasevisi; Qiniseka ukuthi iDolobha lesoNyaka lomGcini weMiklomelo ihlelwa ngonyaka. Qiniseka ukuthi imibiko yeDolobha lesoNyaka ihambisana namaphulani wemisebenzi nemitshwalense yomnyango. Qapha kuphinde ulawulele isikhathi sokuphendula ngokumelene nezicelo kanye nesikhathi sesevisi ekutholeni impendulo kubanikazi bahlinzeki. Hlaziya, qapha uphinde ulungise zonke izinkokhela zokuthenga ngaphambi kwegama lemali ngamunye. Qapha uphinde ulawule ukuphathwa kwezinto zokugcina ezithinteka kwindlu yokugcina. Qapha uphinde ulawule ukuthi kusebenze ngempela izinkokhela zeSAP ngaphakathi kwesistimu ngokucela imibiko yeSMP yabaphathi. Luleke uphinde uxhume abaphathi ngezinhlela ezisha ngokuthintsa imithetho ehlongeza izindaba zokuthenga izimpahla, okuyi inqubo yokuqasha, ukuphatha izinkontileka, izaziso zomsebenzi kanye nokuphucula ngokuphathwa kwemibiko yokugqoka izindleko. Xhuma amayunithi omhwebo ngemayelana nesimo sephulani zabo zamadolobha) futhi ululeke ngempumelelo abaphathi ngezinhlela ezinsha ngokuthintsa izindaba zokuthenga. Phatha uphinde usebenzise izistimu ukuze uqinisekise ukulethwa kwezimpahla, amasevisi nentengo; Qiniseka ukuthi izimpahla noma amasevisi atholakala kubahlinzeki ahambisana ne-PO ekhiqiziwe futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zisezimeni ezinhle, ngesitoki esifanele ngaphambi kokuba kudluliselwe kwiyunithi ebandakanyekayo. Qiniseka ukuthi ama-RLS-02 (Isiqiniseko Sokulunga) abhalwa esikhathini lapho uthola i-invoice. Qiniseka ukulandelela ngokuphindaphindayo zonke iziPhakamiso ezingagcwalisiwe zibhalwe futhi abahlinzeki batisitshwe ngomlob. Qapha uphinde ululeke ngokubekezelelana kwentengo (Umehluko wentengo). Qapha uphinde ukhuthaze zonke izintengo ezingakenzeki kuCockpit Web cycle kanye namalungu a-GRV angasekho nsuku zonke. Qiniseka ukuthi yonke imibuzo yangaphakathi nangaphandle iphendulwa phakathi kwamahora angama-2 futhi irekhoda yemibuzo igcinwa ngenjongo esemthethweni. Qiniseka ukuthi ama-invoice ezimpahla kanye namasevisi abhiyiwe alungiswa ngokushesha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi phakathi kwamahora alenga-10. Shesha futhi uXhumane nabaphathi ngokulethwa kwezimpahla kanye namasevisi abhiyiwe. Xhuma amayunithi nomhwebo ngokumayelana nesimo sezinsiza zomhwebo (ama-invoice angasekho nasekhokhiwe). Qiniseka ukuthi amazinga okudlulisela kabusha agcineke kuzo zonke izinto ezithinteka endaweni yokugcina. Qiniseka ukuthi amafomu angaphakathi (VA2) asayinwa ngokushesha ngabaphathi abakhethiwe ngaphambi kokuba kwezwa izinto zokugcina. Qiniseka ukuthi ihloko lesekile kubahleli bombnyango wocwaningo; Qiniseka ukuthi amandla e-BAC (iBid Adjudication Committee) ahlelwwe ngokufanele. Phatha ukwabiwa kwamandla kanye neminethi kwabahlanganiswe bonke okungenani izinsuku ezimbili ngaphambi kwezintshumayelo. Hlola futhi uqiniseke ukuthi iminethi yezintshumayelo ithathwe ngokufanele, futhi abaklayenti batisitshwe ngomlob ngomphumela. Yiba ngomeluleki kubaphathi bephaneli yokuhlola. Hlela izingqungquthela ezingajwayelekile futhi uqiniseke ukuthi imibhalo yalezo zingqungquthela ibhalwe. Hlelela uphinde uxhase ekwakheni izicelo zezindaba zemizamo noma iminikelo. Qiniseka ukuthi amaphrojekthi ahambisana nemigidingo yomnyango. Qiniseka ukuthi iPhulani yokuThenga nakuPhatha iziDingo ihambisana nesiHlalo semali futhi idluliselwe kwaGPT esikhathini. Xhasa amayunithi omhwebo ukwakha iminikelo namagama abhekiso. Hlola iminikelo namaGama abhekiso ngaphambi kokuba adluliselwe kubabhali beNgqungquthela. Ukuphatha isikhundla seNqunquthela; Ukuphatha isikhundla seNgqungquthela. Phatha futhi uxaze amaphutha aphakathi kwesikhundla seNgqungquthela. Ukuphatha iphulani yamakhono eNqunquthela. Ukuphatha i-PMDS ngaphakathi kwesikhundla seNgqungquthela. Ukuphatha iNqunquthela ukuphatha iNqunquthela. Ukuphatha ukuthola ukutholwa kweVulindlela kanye nemibuzo yeNqunquthela.

xh.title: I deputy Director: Demand and Acquisition
xh.summary: Indima ye Deputy Director kwi Demand and Acquisition kwi Department of Co-operative Governance and Traditional Affairs e Johannesburg, inika R932292 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Matric kunye ne NQF level 7 kwi Supply Chain Management / Logistics okanye izifundo ezifanelekileyo. Kunye nohlobo lweminyaka engu-3-5 yamava kwinqanaba le Assistant Director kwindawo ye Demand Management. Ikhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda kwesiseko sengqikithi yomthetho nemigaqo elawula iinkqubo, iindlela, namageji e Asset Management. Ulwazi lwe Public Finance Management Act. I PPPFA, Iimigaqo ze PPPFA, Iinkqubo zamagazati ze SCM, Onke amagazata e SCM, amakhono e Asset Management, amakhono e Analytical Skills, amakhono e Project Management Skills, amakhono okubhala iingxelo, amakhono e Communication Skills, amakhono olawulwa ingxabano, amakhono e Interpersonal Skills, amakhono e Planning and Organizing skills, amakhono e Leadership Skills, kunye namakhono e Financial Skills. jobs.title: Deputy Director: Municipal Performance Monitoring,
jobs.department: Department of Co-operative Governance and Traditional Affairs
jobs.summary: Deputy Director role in Johannesburg monitoring municipal performance and property rates compliance, requiring a relevant degree and three to five years' property management experience.
jobs.requirements: Matric plus NQF level 7/ Degree in Property Studies, Real Estate and Property Estate Management or relevant qualification recognised by SAQA. Coupled with a minimum of 3 – 5 years’ experience in property management environment. At least 3 years at supervisory (Assistant Director) level and 5 years’ experience in property management environment. Competencies: Real estate, auditing, project management, data management, planning and research, data collection, management and analysis, report writing, analytical skills, problem solving, communication, presentation, project management, co- ordination, negotiation, managing conflict, financial management, strong computer literacy, report writing, monitoring, project management, sound knowledge of the Municipal Property Rates Amendment Act (MPRAA) and its supporting regulations as well as other related local government legislation. Understanding of public sector environment provincial and national legislation (DPSA Act & Regulations, PFMA), sound and interpretation of directives including managerial skills. A valid drivers’ license.
jobs.duties: Management of municipal compliance and implementation of the Municipal Property Rates Amendment Act (MPRAA): Monitor compliance and conduct assessment on municipal calendar events in terms of MPRAA. Manage, process, and advise on all applications, submissions and requests submitted to the department for condonations. Manage, process, and advise on all applications, submissions and requests submitted to the department for the extension of the validity of the municipal general valuation rolls. Advise municipalities on corrective measures where non-compliance with MPRAA is identified. Assessment of municipal property rates policies: Conduct assessment of draft and approved municipal property rates policies. Provide feedback on findings and recommendations to municipalities on the outcomes of the assessment of municipal property rates policies. Conduct workshops with municipalities and VABs on compliance and implementation of the Municipal Property Rates Amendment Act: Compile quarterly reports on the progress made on the implementation on the MPRAA and issues emanating from the VABs. Monitor and report on the resolutions taken from the MPRAA workshops. Management of stakeholders in terms of MPRAA related issues: Respond to various MPRAA related questions posed by the different stakeholders and oversight bodies including the Gauteng Provincial Legislature. Work with relevant stakeholders on MPRAA related issues i.e Property Rates related organisations. Liaise with the legal representatives / Senior State Counsel on Court issues about MPRAA and manage the outcome of such queries and results. Management of sub-unit: Manage human resources in terms of training and development. Management of performance management within the sub-unit. Management of sub-unit’s annual performance and operational plan. Risk management within the sub-unit and Conflict management.
