af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur-pos in Johannesburg vir die monitering van munisipale prestasie en nakoming van eiendomskoerbelydings, wat 'n relevante graad en drie tot vyf jaar se eiendomsbestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: Matriek plus NQF-vlak 7/ Graad in Property Studies, Real Estate and Property Estate Management of 'n relevante kwalifikasie erken deur SAQA. Gepaardgaande met 'n minimum van 3 – 5 jaar se ervaring in 'n eiendomsbestuursomgewing. Ten minste 3 jaar op toesighoudende (Assistant Director) vlak en 5 jaar se ervaring in 'n eiendomsbestuursomgewing. Bevoegdhede: Real estate, ouditing, projekbestuur, databestuur, beplanning en navorsing, data-insameling, bestuur en analise, verslagskryf, analitiese vaardighede, probleemoplossing, kommunikasie, voorlegging, projekbestuur, koördinering, onderhandeling, konflikbestuur, finansiële bestuur, sterk rekenaargeletterdheid, verslagskryf, monitering, projekbestuur, deeglike kennis van die Municipal Property Rates Amendment Act (MPRAA) en sy ondersteunende regulasies asook ander verwante plaaslike regeringswetgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Bestuur van munisipale nakoming en implementering van die Municipal Property Rates Amendment Act (MPRAA): Monitor nakoming en voer assesserings uit oor munisipale kalendergebeurtenisse in terme van MPRAA. Bestuur, prosesseer en gee advies oor alle aansoeke, voorleggings en versoeke wat aan die departement vir kondonering voorlê word. Bestuur, prosesseer en gee advies oor alle aansoeke, voorleggings en versoeke wat aan die departement vir die verlenging van die geldigheid van die munisipale algemene waarderingsrolle voorlê word. Adviseer munisipaliteite oor korrigerende maatreëls waar nie-nakoming met MPRAA geïdentifiseer word. Assessering van munisipale eiendomskoerbelydingsbeleid: Voer assessering uit van konsep- en goedgekeurde munisipale eiendomskoerbelydingsbeleid. Verskaf terugvoer oor bevindings en aanbevelings aan munisipaliteite oor die uitkomste van die assessering van munisipale eiendomskoerbelydingsbeleid. Hou werkswinkels met munisipaliteite en VAB's oor nakoming en implementering van die Municipal Property Rates Amendment Act: Stel kwartaallikse verslae op oor die vordering gemaak met die implementering van MPRAA en kwessies voortspruitend uit die VAB's. Monitor en rapporteer oor die besluite geneem uit die MPRAA-werkswinkels. Bestuur van belanghebbendes in terme van MPRAA-verwante kwessies: Reageer op verskeie MPRAA-verwante vrae gestel deur die verschillende belanghebbendes en toesigliggame insluitend die Gauteng Provincial Legislature. Werk met relevante belanghebbendes oor MPRAA-verwante kwessies d.w.s. eiendomskoerbelasting-verwante organisasies. Skakel met die regsverteenwoordigers / Senior State Counsel oor Hofkwessies rakende MPRAA en bestuur die uitkoms van sulke navrae en resultate. Bestuur van sub-eenheid: Bestuur menslike hulpbronne in terme van opleiding en ontwikkeling. Bestuur van prestasiebestuur binne die sub-eenheid. Bestuur van sub-eenheid se jaarlikse prestasie- en operasionele plan. Risikobestuur binne die sub-eenheid en konflikbestuur.

xh.duties: Ukulawula ukuziphendthela kwamasipala nokuphumeza i-Municipal Property Rates Amendment Act (MPRAA): Qwalasela ukuziphendthela ukuqhutywa kwemisebenzi ekhalendar yamasipala ngokweMPRAA. Lawula, cwangcisa, ngceda zonke izicelo, iingcamango namacebo aziswa kwisebe ngenjongo yokuxolela. Lawula, cwangcisa, ngceda zonke izicelo, iingcamango namacebo aziswa kwisebe ngokwandiswa kwexesha lokuzelelwa kwezityalo zemichiza kwamasipala. Ceda amasipala ngendlela zokulungisa apho kuqatshwa ukungaziphendtheli kwesiMithetho i-MPRAA. Ukuqwalasela iindabakamda zemali yentsimbi yempahla kwamasipala: Qwalasela iindabakamda ezibhaliweyo zokuqwalasela kwaye zivunyelwe zimali yentsimbi yempahla kwamasipala. Nikeza ingxelo ngemivuzo kunye neengcebiso kumasipala ngemixholo yemveliso kuqwalaselo iindabakamda zemali yentsimbi yempahla kwamasipala. Qhubeza iindiba ngamasipala nama-VAB ngokuziphendthela nokuphumeza i-Municipal Property Rates Amendment Act: Hlaziya iingxelo ngekhathathi ngendlela ekuphumeza kuyo i-MPRAA nangemiba evela kuma-VAB. Qwalasela uze unikeze ingxelo ngogqibo oluthathwa kwizindiba ze-MPRAA. Ulawulo lweentanga ezahlukileyo ngokwezinto ezimalana ne-MPRAA: Phendula imibuzo emininzi emalana ne-MPRAA ecelwa ziintanga ezahlukeneyo namagunya oqwalaselo kuquka i-Gauteng Provincial Legislature. Okungenani iminyaka engu-3 ezingeni lokuqondisa (Assistant Director) kanye neminyaka engu-5 yomlando wokusebenza endaweni yokuphatha izimpahla. Ukuqonda isimo somphakathi kahulumeni kanye nomthetho wesifundazwe nowezwe (DPSA Act & Regulations, PFMA), ukuqonda nokutolikwa kwezinkomba okuhlanganisa nezikhono zokuphatha. Ilayisense lokushayela elisebenzayo.

Phatha, cucula, futhi unikezezelwe ngayo yonke imiyalelo, izinikelo kanye nezicelo ezinikelwa umnyango ukuze axolelwe. Phatha, cucula, futhi unikezezelwe ngayo yonke imiyalezo, izinikelo kanye nezicelo ezinikelwa umnyango ukuze kwenziwe isibuyelo sokusebenza kwezinsuku zobuncwadi bemaspala mayelana nezilinganiso ezivamile. Nikela amaspala ngendlela zokulungisa lapho kutholakala ukungahambisani ne-MPRAA. Isilinganiso semithetho yomaspala yokuhlinzwa ngamasheya wesithombe: Yenza isilinganiso semithetho yomaspala yokuhlinzwa ngamasheya wesithombe eyedwa noma evunyiwe. Nikeza impendulo ngemibuzo etholakele kanye nezincoma kumaspala ngemiphumela yesilinganiso semithetho yomaspala yokuhlinzwa ngamasheya wesithombe. Yiza nezingxoxo namaspala kanye nama-VABs mayelana nokuqonda nokusebenzisa i-Municipal Property Rates Amendment Act: Hlola imibiko yenyanga nganye mayelana nokuqhubekayo ekusebenziseni i-MPRAA kanye namaphuzu avela kuma-VABs. Qaphela futhi ubike ngamazwi athatshwe kumaqoqo e-MPRAA. Ukuphatha abahlanganyeli ngokwezinkinga ezihlobene ne-MPRAA: Phendula imibuzo ehlukene ehlobene ne-MPRAA ebezwa ngabantu abahlukene abahlanganyayo kanye namasiko okuhlola okuhlanganisa ne-Gauteng Provincial Legislature. Sebenzisana nabahlanganyeni abafanele mayelana nezinkinga ezihlobene ne-MPRAA okungaba izinhlangano ezihlobene ne-Property Rates. Xhumana nabamele umthetho / Senior State Counsel kwezinkinga zenkantolo mayelana ne-MPRAA futhi upheke imiphumela yaleyo mininingwane nemiphumela. Ukuphatha isigaba esincane: Phatha izinsiza zobuntu ngokokuqeqeshwa kanye nentuthuko. Ukuphatha ukugqamisa ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwesigaba esincane. Ukuphatha isigaba esincane se-plani yokusebenza yonyaka kanye ne-plani yokusebenza. Ukuphatha ingozi ngaphakathi kwesigaba esincane kanye nokuphatha ingxabano.

'n Minimum van 3–5 jaar se ervaring in die werk met die instelling van Tradisionele en Khoi San-leierskap en/of binne die gebruiklike inisiasie-omgewing. 'n Sertifikaat van Bevoegdheid, uitgereik deur 'n erkende Senior Tradisionele Leier, as 'n manlike of vroulike inisiand, sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Bevoegdheid: Kennis van die Wet op Gebruiklike Inisiasie, No. 2 van 2021, beleidsriglyne en wetgewende prosesse, die instelling van Tradisionele Leierskap, gebruiklike inisiassiepraktyke en die PFMA en Openbare Diens-regulerende raamwerke. Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: uitstekende kommunikasie en verslagskrywing, konflikhantering en interpersoonlike vaardighede, organisasie en tydbestuur, probleemoplossing en projekbestuur, rekenaarvaardigheid en koördinering en fasilitering van belanghebbendes. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie en Suid-Afrikaanse burgerskap is verpligtend.
af.duties: Die amptenaar sal verwag word om die Provinsiale Inisiasiekoördinerende Komitee (PICC) te koördineer en te ondersteun: Ontwikkel en hersien jaarliks die terme van verwysing; koördineer die identifisering en benoeming van belanghebbendes; fasiliteer kwartaallikse vergaderings; neem notule van verrigtinge; hou resolusies dop; ontwikkel jaarlikse implementeringsplanne; fasiliteer induksie en opleiding van PICC-lede. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning aan die PICC: Ontwikkel stelsels vir die verwerking van aansoeke wat ontvang, goedgekeur en verwerp is; kommunikeer PICC-besluite aan aansoekers; berei seisoenale provinsiale statistiese verslae voor; bestuur sterftes wat voortspruit uit inisiassieskole in ooreenstemming met wetgewende voorskryfte. Ontwikkel provinsiale beleid en wetgewing oor gebruiklike inisiasie: Ontwerp provinsiale beleid; raadpleeg belanghebbendes; koördineer wetgewende prosesse vir provinsie-spesifieke wetgewing; fasiliteer EXCO-goedkeuring en voor-sertifisering deur die Staatsregadviseur; verseker verwysing van die Wetsontwerp na die Gauteng Provinsiale Wetgewer. Fasiliteer opleiding, bewustheid en ondersteuning van belanghebbendes: Ontwikkel konsepdokumente vir opleidings- en bewustheidsprogramme; koördineer jaarlikse opleiding vir PICC, Provinsiale Inisiasie-moniteringspanne, tradisionele chirurge en skoolhoofde; voer gemeenskapsbewustheidsprogramme uit; koördineer gedrukte kommunikasiemateriaal (pamflette, plakkate); fasiliteer mediaverklarings, persverklaring en onderhoude voor en na inisiassieseisoene.

zu.title: Umcedisi weNhlanganista: Ukuphathwa Kwezikhungo Zendabuko
zu.summary: Umcedisi weNhlanganista ohlela futhi axhasa Ikomidi Lokuqhathanisa Ngesifundazwe, elibheke ukuzibandakanya kwabahlanganyeli, izinkundla kanye nokulandelela ukuxazulula izinkinga eJohannesburg.
zu.requirements: I-Matric kanye ne-NQF level 6/ National Diploma kwe-Development Studies noma iziqu ezingashwibelekileyo ezeqinise ngayo i-SAQA. Okungenani ungamaphakathi eminyaka engu-3–5 uphelele olwazi lokusebenza ngesikhungo sobuqhawe bendabuko nangokwaKhoi San futhi/noma endaweni yesiko lokusoka. Isitifiketi Sokukwazi, esinikezwe nguMqhawe Omdala Wendabuko njengomfana noma intombazane esokiwe, kuyoba ngcono kakhulu. Ukukwazi: Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Customary Initiation Act, No. 2 of 2021, iziqondiso zenqubomgomo kanye nezenqubo zomthetho, isikhungo sobuqhawe bendabuko, amasiko okusoka kanye ne-PFMA kanye nezinhlelo zolawulo zesevisi yomphakathi. Amakhono nobuchwepheshe: ukuxhumana okuhle kanye nokubhala imibiko, ukuphatha imizungulu kanye namakhono okuxhumana nabantu, ukuhlela kanye nokuqondisa isikhathi, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqondisa amaphrojekthi, ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha kanye nokuqondisa futhi uhlele abahlanganyeli. Ilayisenisi yokushayela evumelekile kanye nobuzwe baseNingizimu Afrika kuyimfuneko.
zu.duties: Lowo othathiwe izohlwaywa ahlele futhi axase Ikomidi Lokuqhathanisa Ngesifundazwe (PICC); Asuse futhi ahlolisise minyaka yonke izigaba zokuqondisa; ahlele ukubonakaliswa nokumiswa kwabahlanganyeli; axhase izinkundla ze-kota; abhale imininingwane yezinkundla; alandele izinqumo; akhe izinhlelo zokuqaliswa zeminyaka yonke; axhase ukungenwa nokuleqwa kwamalungu e-PICC. Anike isevisi yokuqondisa i-PICC: Akhe izimisozokusebenza zokuhlaziya izicelo ezitholakalayo, ezamukelekile, kanye nezaliwe; axhumane izinqumo ze-PICC kubafakeli; alungise imibiko yezibalo yesifundazwe ngamaphetha; aphathe izifo ezingabangelwa ukufa ezikoleni zokusoka ngokuhambisana nemiyalo yomthetho. Akhe inqubomgomo nomthetho wesifundazwe ngokwesiko lokusoka: Abhale inqubomgomo yesifundazwe; axhumane nabahlanganyeli; ahlele izinqubo zomthetho zomthetho ohleliwe wesifundazwe; axhase ukuthunyelwa kwe-EXCO kanye nesitifiketi sangaphambini se-State Law Advisor; aqiniseke ukuthumela iBill e-Gauteng Provincial Legislature. Axhase ukuleqwa, ukwaziswa, kanye nokuxhaswa kwabahlanganyeli: Akhe amadokhumenti omqondo wezinhlelo zokuleqwa nokwazisa; ahlele ukuleqwa kwamnyaka wonke kwe-PICC, Amateyimu Okuqaphela Ukwesula Isifundazwe, ochibheli besiko, kanye nezingxenye zezikole; enze izinhlelo zokwazisa umphakathi; ahlele izinto zokuxhumana eziphrintiwe (amaphamfulethi, amaphositha); axhase izitatimende ezidlule emaphepheni, izinkundla zamaphepha kanye nezinkulumo ngaphambi nangemva kwamaphetha okusoka.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNkulumbuso: uLawulo lweziBebe zoBuntu bokwendalo
xh.summary: Umncedisi weNkulumbuso ongakwazi ukulungelelanisa nokuxhasa iKomiti yoLungelelwaniso lweSithangamo sePhondo, elawula unyhiswano namaphakathi abathathi-nxaxheba, iintlanganiso nokulandela isisombullo sezithintelo e Johannesburg.
xh.requirements: iMatric plus NQF level 6/ National Diploma kwiiZifundo zoPhuhliso okanye izifundo ezifanelekileyo ezikhonwa ngu-SAQA. Uqikelelo lonyaka wokuqamba 3–5 ukuba namava okusebenza nesebe lobuNgamela bokwendalo nesiBinzana samaKhoi San nakwimeko yesithangamo ngokwesiko. iSatifikethi sobuNako, esinikiwa nguMlawuli oMkhulu wesiBebe soBuntu bokwendalo, njengomfundi wesilisa okanye wesifazane, kuya kuba ngaphezulu kweyolonwabo. Ubuchule: ulwazi ngeCustomary Initiation Act, No. 2 ka-2021, izikhokelo zomgaqo-nkqubo neenkqubo zomthetho, is sebe sobuNgamela bokwendalo, iinkqubo zesithangamo ngokwesoko nesiPFMA neenkqubo zolawulo zoBume bokuSebenza koluntu. Amakhono nobuNako: ukunxibelelana kolwimi noku bhala iingxelo ubuchule, ukusingatha iingxaki namakhono okuxhumana nabantu, uku lungelanisa nokulawula ixesha, ukusombulula iingxaki nokulawula amaprojekthi, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokulungelelanisa nokwamkela abathathi-nxaxheba. iLayisenisi yokushukuma evakalayo nobuzwe baseMzantsi Afrika ngumthetho oqinileyo.
xh.duties: Omkhethwewe kuya kulindelekwa ukuba alungelelanise axhase iKomiti yoLungelelwaniso lweSithangamo sePhondo (PICC): Akuze aphinde ahlolisise iMigaqo eBalulelayo ngonyaka; alungelelanise ukuqatshelwa nokumiselwa kwabathathi-nxaxheba; aqhube iintlanganiso zexesha lokothuka; abhale iingxelo zoxwebhu lweziganeko; alandele isisombullo se zintintelo; ake axobe iindawo ezilungelelanisiweyo zomsebenzi ngonyaka; aqhube isimiso somfundi nokolwa bamalungu ePICC. Anike inkxaso yolawulo kuPICC: Akhe iindawo zokugcina izicelo ezamkelweyo, ezivunyiweyo, nezingavunyiweyo; azis ultrike isigqibo sePICC kubafaki-zicelo; alungiselele iingxelo zemibalo yephondo ngokwetho nakwamathanga; alawule imifuduso evela kwiiskhulii zesithangamo ngokwemigaqo yomthetho. Akhe umgaqo-nkqubo nomthetho wephondo ngoku sisithangamo ngokwesiko: Abhale umgaqo-nkqubo wephondo; axoxe nabathathi-nxaxheba; alungelelanise iinkqubo zomthetho kumthetho oqhelekileko wephondo; aqhube isigqibo seEXCO nokugunyaziswa ngaphambili nguMmeli weQonga loMthetho; aqinise ukudluliselwa koMthetho kwiNdlu yoWiso-mthetho ya Gauteng Provincial. Aqhube ukuqeqesha, ukwazisa, noku xhasa abathathi-nxaxheba: Akhe amaxwebhu angabafundi ngokuqeqesha namaxhoba olwazi; alungelelanise ukuqeqesha kwamalanga ngeminyaka yonke yabo bonke abo bahlala kwiKomiti yase-PICC, amaqela okuqaphela iSithangamo sePhondo, abayintsangasi bemithi yamasiko, namaphrincipal; aqhube amaxhoba olwazi olusetyenziswa ngokwethu phakathi kwamaphakathi ephakathi; alungelelanise iinkqubo zolwazi olushicilelwayo (iipamfulethi, iipositha); axhase iziqinisekiso ezisetyenziswa kwimizimnyana, iintlanganiso nezimvo nangaphambili nangemva kweethanga ezimalizo ngeSithangamo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Municipal Finance (REVENUE
jobs.department: Department of Co-operative Governance and Traditional Affairs
jobs.summary: Assistant Director role in municipal finance focusing on revenue enhancement planning and diagnostic analysis of municipal revenue systems for CoGTA in Johannesburg.
jobs.requirements: Matric plus NQF level 6/ National Diploma in Finance/ Commerce, or relevant qualification as recognised by SAQA, coupled with a minimum of 3-5 years’ relevant experience. Competencies: Sound knowledge of the administration and finances of the local government sphere with a focus on Revenue Enhancement. In-depth technical knowledge and the ability to review, develop and implement Revenue Value Chain and Debtor Management standards (e.g. Credit control policies, Recoverable debt and write off policies, Billing policies, Receipting, Tariff policies, Customer Care policies, Indigent policies, Standard Operating Procedures, innovative systems etc.). Understanding of applicable local government legislation, regulations, policies, and procedures especially the Municipal Finance Management Act (MFMA) and Municipal System Act (MSA). Finance related matters, departmental and municipal priorities. Government Legislation (Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), SA Constitution, Treasury regulations and circulars, Division of Revenue Act, Municipal Structures Act, Municipal Budget policy and National Credit Act). Supervisory experience, management of staff and knowledge of HR matters. Understanding of GPG and Departmental priorities and needs of stakeholders and Project Management body of Knowledge. Driver’s License.
jobs.duties: Conduct Revenue Enhancement Planning: Undertake diagnostic analysis of the status Qiu as it relates to Revenue Enhancement systems in Municipalities (Section 71 reports, Municipal engagements, CoGTA Municipal Finance M&E reports, Municipal Annual Performance reports). Inputting into the Annual Performance Plan for the Directorate. Inputting into the Operational Plan for the Directorate and inputting into the budget for the Directorate. Support on Municipal Revenue Enhancement: Assess and advise on all Tariff charges, time schedule, accounts layout, printing, and distribution of statements. Assess and advise on payment methods, pay points, control of 3rd parties, un- allocated payments. Coordinate advice for municipalities on corrective measures where revenue linkages are identified and coordinate advice for Municipalities on the new sources of Revenue. Support and engage with municipalities and stakeholders on Revenue Enhancement related enquiries: Support in responding to various Revenue Enhancement-related questions posed by the different stakeholders and oversight bodies including the Gauteng Provincial Legislature and work with relevant stakeholders on Revenue Enhancement related issues. Support with Revenue Enhance Project Management/ Implementation: Ensure Municipal project engagements in Revenue Enhancement for by-in purposes. Ensure the preparation of Project Initiation Documents (Submission to HoD for project approval, Terms of reference, procurement processes, Service Level Agreements, Project, Plans and Skills Transfer Plans). Ensure the setting up of project steering committee meetings for monitoring purposes. Ensure the monitoring and reporting to different stakeholders regarding the Revenue Enhancement areas through monthly, quarterly, annual and presentations reports (COGTA executives, Premiers’ Coordinating Forum, Legislature, Communities, Businesses, MEC’s and MMC’s Indaba, National COGTA, National Treasury, Provincial Departments, CFO’s and Municipal Managers). Ensure the project close out processes (Post Project Support Plans, Close out reports and hand-over, Close out Municipal engagements). Coordinate Intergovernmental Relations in Revenue Management: Ensure the development of Regional Municipal support plan, Participating on the Regional task team meetings. Provide administrative support in meetings of the region. Report progress on the regional work and strengthen inter-governmental relations through the facilitation of meetings and forums in Revenue Enhancement. Management of the Division: Plan, delegate and provide direction on execution of work of my sub-ordinate. Review, quality assure, provide feedback and mentoring to junior staff members of the Division. Facilitate the development and training of junior officials in the Division. Monitor and approve leave for Division. Facilitating and coordinate the tools of trade for junior staff in the Division. Facilitate the performance and review of staff members in the Division. Providing regular feedback on performance of officials to improve performance and provide further guidance and on-the-job- training.
jobs.enquiries: Caiphus/ Andy, cell: 071 474 7078/51
jobs.applications: Applications should be submitted strictly online at https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za/Public/Jobs.aspx FOR ATTENTION : Human Capital management
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly online completed Z83 form It is our intention to promote representivity (race, gender, and disability) in the Public Service through the filling of these posts. Preference will be given to people with disabilities, and they will be exempted from a driver’s license requirement. Applications        should       be     submitted       strictly    online     at https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za/Public/Jobs.aspx                                  or http://jobs.gauteng.gov.za/Public/Jobs.aspx and it should be accompanied by a most recent Z83 form which may be obtained from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents. and comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV), certified copies of qualifications and Identity will be submitted upon request (no postal or hand delivery applications will be accepted). It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Furthermore, the recommended candidate will be required to produce his/her SMS Pre-entry certificate as offered by the National School of Governance (NSG) prior to the appointment being made. The certificate for entry into SMS and full details can be sourced by the following link: http://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Preference will be given to female applicants for SMS posts. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments; one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Correspondence will only be limited to shortlisted candidates. If you have not been contacted within 3 months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Failure to comply with the above instructions of specifically attaching a recent Z83 and a comprehensive CV will result in applications being disqualified. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Munisipale Finansies (INKOMSTE)
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur-pos in munisipale finansies met die fokus op inkomsteverbeteringsbeplanning en diagnostiese ontleding van munisipale inkomstestelsels vir CoGTA in Johannesburg.
af.requirements: Matric plus NQF level 6/ National Diploma in Finance/ Commerce, of 'n tersaaklike kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken, tesame met 'n minimum van 3-5 jaar se tersaaklike ervaring. Bevoegdhede: Deeglike kennis van die administrasie en finansies van die plaaslike regeringssfeer met 'n fokus op Revenue Enhancement. Diepgaande tegniese kennis en die vermoë om Revenue Value Chain en Debtor Management-standaarde te hersien, ontwikkel en implementeer (bv. Credit control policies, Recoverable debt and write off policies, Billing policies, Receipting, Tariff policies, Customer Care policies, Indigent policies, Standard Operating Procedures, innovative systems etc.). Begrip van toepaslike plaaslike regeringswetgewing, regulasies, beleide en prosedures, veral die Municipal Finance Management Act (MFMA) en Municipal System Act (MSA). Finansieverwante aangeleenthede, departementale en munisipale prioriteite. Regeringswetgewing (Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), SA Constitution, Treasury regulations and circulars, Division of Revenue Act, Municipal Structures Act, Municipal Budget policy en National Credit Act). Toesigervaring, bestuur van personeel en kennis van HR-aangeleenthede. Begrip van GPG en departementale prioriteite en behoeftes van belanghebbendes en Project Management body of Knowledge. Bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Voer Revenue Enhancement Planning uit: Onderneem diagnostiese ontleding van die status quo wat betref Revenue Enhancement-stelsels in munisipaliteite (Section 71 reports, Municipal engagements, CoGTA Municipal Finance M&E reports, Municipal Annual Performance reports). Lewering van insette tot die Annual Performance Plan vir die Direktoraat. Lewering van insette tot die Operational Plan vir die Direktoraat en lewering van insette tot die begroting vir die Direktoraat. Ondersteuning met Municipal Revenue Enhancement: Beoordeel en adviseer oor alle Tariff-heffings, tydskedule, rekenuitleg, drukwerk en verspreiding van state. Beoordeel en adviseer oor betaalmetodes, betaalpunte, beheer van derde partye, on toegewysde betalings. Koördineer advies vir munisipaliteite oor korrigerende maatreëls waar inkomskakelings geïdentifiseer word en koördineer advies vir munisipaliteite oor nuwe bronne van inkomste. Ondersteun en raadpleeg munisipaliteite en belanghebbendes oor Revenue Enhancement-verwante navrae: Ondersteun in die reageer op verskeie Revenue Enhancement-verwante vrae deur verskillende belanghebbendes en toesigliggame, insluitend die Gauteng Provincial Legislature, en werk met tersaaklike belanghebbendes oor Revenue Enhancement-verwante kwessies. Ondersteun met Revenue Enhancement Project Management/ Implementering: Verseker munisipale projekbetrekkinge in Revenue Enhancement vir koopdoeleindes. Verseker die voorbereiding van Project Initiation Documents (Submission to HoD for project approval, Terms of reference, procurement processes, Service Level Agreements, Project, Plans and Skills Transfer Plans). Verseker die instelling van projekteerste komiteevergaderings vir moniteringsdoeleindes. Verseker die monitering en verslagdoening aan verskillende belanghebbendes aangaande die Revenue Enhancement-areas deur middel van maandelikse, kwartaallikse, jaarlikse en aanbiedingsverslae (COGTA executives, Premiers' Coordinating Forum, Legislature, Communities, Businesses, MEC's and MMC's Indaba, National COGTA, National Treasury, Provincial Departments, CFO's and Municipal Managers). Verseker die projekafsluitingsprosesse (Post Project Support Plans, Close out reports and hand-over, Close out Municipal engagements). Koördineer Intergovernmental Relations in Revenue Management: Verseker die ontwikkeling van Regional Municipal support plan, Deelname aan die Regional task team vergaderings. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning in vergaderings van die streek. Rapporteer vordering oor die streekwerk en versterk interregeringsverhoudinge deur die fasilitering van vergaderings en forums in Revenue Enhancement. Bestuur van die Afdeling: Beplan, delegeer en verskaf rigting oor die uitvoering van werk van my ondergeskiktes. Hersien, verseker kwaliteit, verskaf terugvoer en mentorkapskap aan junior personeellede van die Afdeling. Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling en opleiding van junior amptenare in die Afdeling. Monitoer en keur verlof vir die Afdeling goed. Fasiliteer en koördineer die werksgereedskap vir junior personeel in die Afdeling. Fasiliteer die prestasie en hersiening van personeellede in die Afdeling. Verskaf gereelde terugvoer oor prestasie van amptenare om prestasie te verbeter en verskaf verdere leiding en op-die-werk-opleiding.

zu.title: Umncintiswano Womqashi: Imali Yasekhaya (INZUZO
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaMncintiswano Womqashi kumali yasekhaya sigxile ekwelakeni izindlela zokwenyusa inzuzo nasekuhlaziyeni izinhlelo zenzuzo yasekhaya zeCoGTA eGoli.
zu.requirements: Umatric kanye ne-NQF level 6/ National Diploma kwe-Mali/ Isabhizinisi, noma izifundo ezifanele njengoba zithathwa yi-SAQA, ezihambisana nomgomo weminyaka eyi-3-5 yeziphatimandla. Ikhono: Ulwazi olujulile ngolawulo nemali yendawo kahulumeni ngokugxile ekwenziseni inzuzo. Ulwazi lobuchwepheshe olujulile nethuba lokubuyekeza, ukuthuthukisa nokuphatha izindinganiso ze-Revenue Value Chain nokulawula izikweletu (isb. izinqubomgomo zolawulo wolweswele, izikweletu ezitholakalayo nezinqubomgomo zokukhipha ezikhishiwe, izinqubomgomo zokubhila, ukwamukela imali, izinqubomgomo zesilinganiso sokuhola, izinqubomgomo zokukhathaleka abathengi, izinqubomgomo zabantu abasondelo, izinqubo eziyisimiso zokusebenza, izinhlelo ezintsha, njll.). Ukuqonda umthetho, izimiso nezinqubo zikahulumeni wendawo okusebenza kuzo, ikakhulukazi i-Municipal Finance Management Act (MFMA) ne-Municipal System Act (MSA). Izindaba ezihlobene nemali, izinhloso zomnyango nendawo kahulumeni. Umthetho kahulumeni (Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), iSibhalo sakho somthetho saseNingizimu Afrika, izimiso namaphoyiza e-National Treasury, i-Division of Revenue Act, i-Municipal Structures Act, i-Municipal Budget policy kanye ne-National Credit Act). Isiphatimandla sokubusa, ukuphatha abasebenzi nokwazi izindaba ze-HR. Ukuqonda izinhloso nezingidingo zikaGPG nomaThungo kanye nezidingo zabahlanganyeli kanye ne-Project Management body of Knowledge. Ilayisensi yokushayela.
zu.duties: Qeqsha ukuthuthukiswa kenzuzo: Yenza ukuhlaziywa okujulile kwesimo njengoba okuhlobene nezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kenzuzo Ezikhungweni zokuLunga Kahulumeni womakhaya (Section 71 reports, Ukuxhumana nezikhungo zikahulumeni, i-CoGTA Municipal Finance M&E reports, imibiko yamamuva yezinto ezenziwe yisikhungo). Nikeza izinto ezingenayo ku-Annual Performance Plan komnyango. Nikeza izinto ezingenayo ku-Operational Plan yomnyango futhi ufake izinto ku-bajeti yomnyango. Sekela ukuthuthukiswa kenzuzo Ezikhungweni zokuLunga Kahulumeni womakhaya: Hlola futhi unikeze izeluleko ngazo zonke izimali zokuhola, ishejuli yesikhathi, isimo sezinkulumo-mali zee-akhawunti, ukushicilela nokusabalalisa izitatimende. Hlola futhi unikeze izeluleko ngezindlela zokukhokha, izindawo zokukhokha, ukulawula bantu besithathu, izimali ezingabelwe kaluleki. Hlela izeluleko Ema khaya kahulumeni ngomgomo wokulungisa lapho kuqashelwa ukuxhumana kwenzuzo bese uhlela izeluleko kumakhaya kahulumeni ngemithombo emitsha yenzuzo. Sekela bese uxhumana namakhaya kahulumeni nabahlanganyeli ngemibuzo eholelwe ekwenziseni inzuzo: Sekela ekuphenduleni imibuzo ehlukene eholelwe ekwenziseni inzuzo ebuzwe abahlanganyeli abahlukene namabhodi ecolisa okuhlanganisa i-Gauteng Provincial Legislature bese usebenza nabahlanganyeli abafanele kuleziphathelene nenzuzo. Sekela ekuphathweni/ukuphothelelweni kwemigomo yokwenzisa inzuzo: Qinisekisa ukuthi umakhaya kahulumeni uyaxhumana kumigomo yokwenzisa inzuzo ngenhloso yokwamukela. Qinisekisa ukulungiswa kwamaphoyiza e-Project Initiation Documents (Inikela kuHoD ukuze umgomo uvunyiwe, izinkulumo-mali, izinqubo zokuthenga, izivumelwano ze-Service Level Agreements, izinhlela zomgomo, kanye ne-Plans and Skills Transfer Plans). Qinisekisa ukumiswa kwemihlangano yekomidi elawula umgomo ngenhloso yokuqaphela. Qinisekisa ukuqaphela nokubika kubahlanganyeli abahlukene ngezindawo ezihlobene nokwenzisa inzuzo ngemibiko yenyanga, kodanga, yonyaka namaphrezentheyshini (COGTA executives, Premiers' Coordinating Forum, Legislature, Communities, Businesses, MEC's and MMC's Indaba, National COGTA, National Treasury, Provincial Departments, CFO's and Municipal Managers). Qinisekisa izinqubo zokuvala umgomo (Post Project Support Plans, Close out reports and hand-over, Close out Municipal engagements). Hlela izinhlangano phakathi kwamahulumeni ekuphathweni kenzuzo: Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kwe-Regional Municipal support plan, Ukubamba iqhaza emihlanganweni ye-Regional task team meetings. Nikeza isekelo lolawulo emihlanganweni sendawo. Bika inqubo yomsebenzi omlandvo bese uqinisa izinhlangano phakathi kwamahulumene ngokuqondisa imihlangano namaphorom ukuze kuqashelwe ukwenziswa kenzuzo. Ukuphathwa kwesigaba: Hlela, yabelana bese unikeza isiqondiso ekwenziweni komsebenzi abangaphansi kwami. Buyekeza, qinisekisa umgangacho, nikeza impendulo futhi uqeqeshe abasebenzi abasha besigaba. Qondisa ekuthuthukisweni nasekuqeqeshweni kabezikhulu abasha esigabeni. Qaphela bese uvuma i-leave Yesigaba. Qondisa futhi uhlele izinto zomsebenzi sabasebenzi abasha esigabeni. Qondisa ukusebenza nokubuyekezwa kwabasebenzi esigabeni. Nikeza impendulo evamile ngokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi ukuze kuphuculwe ukusebenza bese kunikezwa okwengeziwe isiqondiso nokuqeqesha emsebenzini.

xh.title: iNkulumbuso: Imali yaseMasipala (INGENISO
xh.summary: Isithuba sikaNkulumbuso kumali yaseMasipala esigxile ekucwangciseni ukwandiswa kwingeniso nakuqondisa ukwahlulwa-hlulwa kweenkqubo zingeniso zamasipala ze CoGTA e Johannesburg.
xh.requirements: iMatric plus NQF level 6/ National Diploma kumFinance/ Commerce, okanye izifundo ezifanelekileyo njengoko zivunywa yi SAQA, ezihambelana nokuba namava eminyaka engu-3-5 ohambelana nalenjongo. Iikhompethensi: Ulwazi olululo ngolawulo nangemali kwisingga samasipala egxininise kukuWandiswa kweNgeniso. Ulwazi lwamakhono obunzulu bengakanani nobunokuphonononga, yakha nesebenzisa iinkqubo zeNgeniso kunye ne standard zokuLawula iBhalansi yetyala (umz. iinkqazo zolawulo lwetyala, iinkqazo zetyala elijika nokuqhweshwa kwaso, iinkqazo zabhili, ukwamkelwa kwemali, iinkqazo zevolethi, iinkqazo zoNkonzo kubaThengi, iinkqazo zabantu abangakwazi kuzimela, iNqubo eZisebenzayo eZiqhagamshelwayo, iinkqabo ezintsha njl.njl.). Ukuqonda umthetho wolawulo lwamasipala, iimithetho, iinkqazo, n iinkqubo ngokukodwa iMunicipal Finance Management Act (MFMA) neMunicipal System Act (MSA). Izinto ezimala namali, izinto ebalulekileyo kwisebe nakumasipala. uMthetho woRhulumente (iPublic Finance Management Act (PFMA), uMgaqo-siseko we SA, iimithetho nemicimbo ye Treasury, iDivision of Revenue Act, iMunicipal Structures Act, iNkqazo beeNgxowa-mali zaMasipala n iNational Credit Act). Uluhlu lokuYala abantu, ulawulo labasebenzi nolwazi ngemiba ze HR. Ukuqonda iimfuno ze GPG neze sebe kunye neemfuno zabanini inxaxheba n iProject Management body of Knowledge. iDriver’s License.
xh.duties: Qhuba ukuCwangcisa ukuWandiswa kweNgeniso: Yenza uhlalutyo lokuqonda isimo sa ngoku ngokubuhambelana neenkqabo zokuWandiswa kweNgeniso kumasipala (iinkcazelo ze Section 71, iintlanganiso namaSipala, iinkcazelo ze CoGTA Municipal Finance M&E, iinkcazelo zeMisebenzi yomNyaka woMasipala). Ngenisa igalelo kwiNdlela yoMsebenzi woNyaka yoMmandla. Ngenisa igalelo kwiNdlela yoMsebenzi yoMmandla kwaye ungenise igalelo kwengxowa-mali yoMmandla. Nika inkxaso ekwuWandiseni iNgeniso yoMasipala: Qwalasela uncede ngayo yonke imirholo yevolethi, iwejikelo lexesha, isimo seakhawunti, i printi, nokusasazwa kweekamva. Qwalasela uncede ngeendlela zokuhlawula, iindawo zokuHlawula, ulawulo lwamagosa amabelesi, imihlawulo engabekwanga. Hambelanisa ingcebiso kumasipala ngezinyathelo zolungisiso xa kubonakala iinkqobo zingeniso kwaye uhambelanise ingcebiso kuMasipala ngeendawo ezintsha zokuFumana iNgeniso. Nika inkxaso uze uzibandakanye namasipala nabanini inxaxheba kumibuzo ehambelana nokuWandiswa kweNgeniso: Nceda ekuphenduleni imibuzo eyahlukeneyo ehambelana nokuWandiswa kweNgeniso ebuza ngayo banini inxaxheba abahlukeneyo namagunya okuQwalasela kuquka iGauteng Provincial Legislature kwaye usebenze ngemiba ehambelana nokuWandiswa kweNgeniso nabathile abanegalelo. Nceda nokuLawulwa kweProjekthi/ukuSetyenzeziswa kokuWandiswa kweNgeniso: Qinisekisa ukubandakanywa kwamasipala kumaprojekthi zokuWandiswa kweNgeniso ngenjongo yokwamkela. Qinisekisa ulungiselelo lwaBalikelwa bokuQaliswa kweProjekthi (iNgeniso kuHoD ngenkxaso yeprojekthi, iimigaqo yokuQondisa, iinkqubo zokuThenga, iService Level Agreements, iProjekthi, iNdlela nokuDlulisela amakhono). Qinisekisa ukumiswela kwekomiti yokulawula iintlanganiso zeprojekthi ngenjongo yokujonga. Qinisekisa ukuQwalasela nokuxela abanini inxaxheba abahlukeneyo ngenkundla zokuWandiswa kweNgeniso ngee nkcukacha ngenyanga, ngethuba, ngonyaka ne nkcukacha eziboniswa (iinxulunyisi ze CoGTA, iPremiers’ Coordinating Forum, iLegislature, uluntu, iishishini, iMEC’s and MMC’s Indaba, iNational CoGTA, iNational Treasury, iiprovincial departments, amaCFO namaMunicipal Managers). Qinisekisa inkqubo yokuVala iprojekthi (iNdlela zoNxaxheba emva kweProjekthi, iiNkcukacha zokuVala nokunikezela ngaso, iintlanganiso zoXinzelelo loMasipala). Hambelanisa uQhagamshelano lwaRhulumente oHlukeneyo ekuLawuleni iNgeniso: Qinisekisa ukuMisela iNdlela yoNxaxhebo loMasipala woMmandla, ukubandakanyeka kwentlanganiso ze Regional task team. Nika inkxaso yolawulo ngeentlanganiso zommandla. Xela inkqondo ngomsebenzi wommandla uze uqinise iqhagamshelano phakathi koRhulumente ngokulawula iintlanganiso neeforum ezikwisenjongo sokuWandiswa kweNgeniso. uLawulo loWoMmandla: Cwangcisa, wabelela unikezela iNdlela ngokusebenzwa komsebenzi kwaphezulu kwam. Qwalasela, qinisekisa iingxelo, nikeze ingcinga ninkxaso kwabasebenzi abasebunzini bakaMmandla. Qedisa ukusuka kubasebenzi abasebunzini bakaMmandla. Qwalasela uvume iNqanaba lwasemaLibaleni. Qedisa uhambelanise iinkqubo zomsebenzi kwabasebenzi abasebunzini bakaMmandla. Qedisa ukwenza ngokutsha ukukhululeka kwabasebenzi bakaMmandla. Nikeza iingxelo ezizezidanga ngomsebenzi kabasebenzi ukuze uphucule inkqubo yokusebenza unikez' nolwe inxaxheba nolwa nolwazi ngokusebenza esikhundleni.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Sourcing and Supplier Development
jobs.department: Department of Co-operative Governance and Traditional Affairs
jobs.summary: Assistant Director needed to manage supplier sourcing, database administration and contract management within the Department of Co-operative Governance.
jobs.requirements: Matric plus NQF level 6/ National Diploma in Supply Chain Management or Logistics, or relevant qualification as recognised by SAQA, coupled with a minimum of 3-5 years’ experience in acquisition and contract management environment. Competencies: Knowledge and understanding of tender and contract management legislative framework in the Public Service; Knowledge and understanding of PFMA and other SCM Legislation; Knowledge of Department’s procedures on tenders and contracts administration; Ability to work in a highly-pressured environment and driven by a sense of urgency to meet deadlines; Thorough understanding of policy formulation and co- ordination; Analytical Skills; Project Management Skills; Report writing skills; Communication Skills; Problem solving skills; Conflict management skills; Interpersonal Skills; Planning and Organizing skills; Leadership Skills; Coordination Skills; Analytical Skills; Contract management skills; Tender management skills; Team working; Supervision; Communication; Problem Solving and Analysis; Staff Development; Financial Management and Procedures; Budgeting Processes; Policies, procedures and legislations; Planning and co-ordinating; A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Ensure the updating of suppliers’ database on an ongoing basis; Ensure the registering of suppliers on departmental supplier database; Administer the updating of existing information of suppliers on database; Administer and maintaining effective systems and procedures for suppliers registration and accreditation; Ensure that goods are procured in line with PFMA, PPPFA, Treasury Regulations and Supply Chain Management Guidelines to Accounting Officers; Ensure the implementation of and adherence to policies and procedures; Ensure the submission of approved tender specifications (pack) to GDF for advertising on e-Tender Portal and Government Tender Bulletin; Conduct briefing sessions; Guide role players on policy and procedures during the tendering processes; Present SCM processes or background of the tender to the Bid Evaluation Committee members; Facilitate all bid committees; Ensure the preparation of BSC, BEC and BAC minutes; Ensure preparation of submissions to the Adjudication Committee; Ensure proper management and facilitation of tender processes; Ensure the preparation and coordination of all Public Adjudication Committee processes; Presenting Tender and Sourcing processes to end- users; Compilation of monthly, quarterly and annual report on tenders to management and Provincial Treasury; Administer the invitation of quotations from the suppliers listed on the database; Oversee the obtaining of quotations; Ensure that goods and services are obtained from the suppliers who score the highest points according to the PPPFA.; Administer and maintain all records in respect of Requests for Quotations (RFQ); Communicate and save information about unreliable service providers; Interacting with CIPRO/DTI and National Treasury; Advice service providers on steps to follow to comply with the Departmental requirements; Facilitate the approval in respect of the awarding of quotations; Supervise the regular verification of VAT registrations and preferential point system; identify, assess, and prioritize risks of different projects within the supply chain; Measure, analyse, and manage the performance of a supplier; Ensure that supplier performance evaluation and reports are completed for proper management of contracts; Ensuring that a vendor adequately performs a contracted service; Monitor contract and commitment registers to ensure that the service providers are not under/ overpaid; Check that BAC (Bid Adjudication Committee) agendas are compiled correctly; Manage the distribution of agendas and minutes to all members at least on the two days prior to the meetings; Check and ensure that minutes of the meetings are correctly taken and clients are informed in writing of the outcome; Act as advisor to the adjudication evaluation panels; Arrange ad hoc meeting; Ensure the recording of deliberations of the meetings; Management of staff performance; Management of leave plan; Management of staff training and development; Coordinate activities of the division. A valid driver’s license.
jobs.enquiries: Caiphus/ Andy, cell: 071 474 7078/51
jobs.applications: Applications should be submitted strictly online at https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za/Public/Jobs.aspx FOR ATTENTION : Human Capital management
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly online completed Z83 form It is our intention to promote representivity (race, gender, and disability) in the Public Service through the filling of these posts. Preference will be given to people with disabilities, and they will be exempted from a driver’s license requirement. Applications        should       be     submitted       strictly    online     at https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za/Public/Jobs.aspx                                  or http://jobs.gauteng.gov.za/Public/Jobs.aspx and it should be accompanied by a most recent Z83 form which may be obtained from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents. and comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV), certified copies of qualifications and Identity will be submitted upon request (no postal or hand delivery applications will be accepted). It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Furthermore, the recommended candidate will be required to produce his/her SMS Pre-entry certificate as offered by the National School of Governance (NSG) prior to the appointment being made. The certificate for entry into SMS and full details can be sourced by the following link: http://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Preference will be given to female applicants for SMS posts. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments; one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Correspondence will only be limited to shortlisted candidates. If you have not been contacted within 3 months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Failure to comply with the above instructions of specifically attaching a recent Z83 and a comprehensive CV will result in applications being disqualified. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Bronbepaling en Verskaffersontwikkeling
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur benodig om verskafferbronbepaling, databasisadministrasie en kontrakbestuur binne die Department of Co-operative Governance te bestuur.
af.requirements: Matric plus NQF vlak 6/ Nasionale Diploma in Voorsieningskettingbestuur of Logistiek, of 'n tersaaklike kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken, tesame met 'n minimum van 3-5 jaar se ervaring in 'n verkrygings- en kontrakbestuursomgewing. Bevoegdhede: Kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk vir tender- en kontrakbestuur in die Openbare Diens; Kennis en begrip van PFMA en ander SCM-wetgewing; Kennis van die departement se prosedures vir tender- en kontrakadministrasie; Vermoë om in 'n hoëdruk-omgewing te werk en aangedryf deur 'n sin van dringendheid om sperdatums te haal; Deeglike begrip van beleidsformulering en koördinering; Analitiese vaardighede; Projekbestuursvaardighede; Verslagdoeningsvaardighede; Kommunikasievaardighede; Probleemoplossingsvaardighede; Konflikbestuursvaardighede; Interpersoonlike vaardighede; Beplannings- en reëlingsvaardighede; Leierskapsvaardighede; Koördineringsvaardighede; Analitiese vaardighede; Kontrakbestuursvaardighede; Tenderbestuursvaardighede; Spanwerk; Toesig; Kommunikasie; Probleemoplossing en analise; Personeelontwikkeling; Finansiële bestuur en prosedures; Begrotingsprosesse; Beleide, prosedures en wetgewing; Beplanning en koördinering; 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Verseker die voortdurende bywerking van die verskaffersdatabasis; Verseker die registrasie van verskaffers op die departementele verskaffersdatabasis; Administreer die bywerking van bestaande inligting van verskaffers op die databasis; Administreer en onderhou doeltreffende stelsels en prosedures vir verskafferregistrasie en -akkreditasie; Verseker dat goedere in ooreenstemming met PFMA, PPPFA, Tesourie-regulasies en Voorsieningskettingbestuursriglyne aan rekeningkundige beamptes verkry word; Verseker die implementering van en nakoming aan beleide en prosedures; Verseker die voorlegging van goedgekeurde tenderspesifikasies (pakket) aan GDF vir advertering op die e-Tender-portaal en die Staatskoerant; Voer inligtingsessies uit; Lei rolspelers oor beleid en prosedures tydens die tenderprosesse; Bied SCM-prosesse of agtergrond van die tender aan die lede van die Biede-evalueringskomitee; Fasiliteer alle biedkomitees; Verseker die opstel van BSC-, BEC- en BAC-notule; Verseker die opstel van voorleggings aan die Adjudiseringskomitee; Verseker behoorlike bestuur en fasilitering van tenderprosesse; Verseker die voorbereiding en koördinering van alle Openbare Adjudiseringskomitee-prosesse; Bied Tender- en Bronbepalingsprosesse aan eindgebruikers; Opstel van maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse verslae oor tenders aan bestuur en Provinsiale Tesourie; Administreer die uitnodiging van kwotasies van die verskaffers wat op die databasis gelys is; Hou toesig oor die verkryging van kwotasies; Verseker dat goedere en dienste verkry word van verskaffers wat die hoogste punte volgens die PPPFA behaal; Administreer en onderhou alle rekords met betrekking tot Versoeke vir Kwotasies (RFQ); Kommunikeer en stoor inligting oor onbetroubare diensverskaffers; Skakel met CIPRO/DTI en Nasionale Tesourie; Adviseer diensverskaffers oor stappe om te volg om aan die departementele vereistes te voldoen; Fasiliteer die goedkeuring met betrekking tot die toekenning van kwotasies; Hou toesig oor die gereeld verifiëring van BTW-registrasies en die voorkeurpuntstelsel; identifiseer, assesseer en prioritiseer risiko's van verskillende projekte binne die voorsieningsketting; Meet, analiseer en bestuur die prestasie van 'n verskaffer; Verseker dat verskafferprestasie-evaluerings en -verslae voltooi word vir behoorlike bestuur van kontrakte; Verseker dat 'n verkoper toereikend 'n gekontrakteerde diens lewer; Monitor kontrak- en verbintenisregisters om te verseker dat die diensverskaffers nie onder- of oorbetaal word nie; Kontroleer dat BAC (Bied-Adjudiseringskomitee) agendae korrek opgestel word; Bestuur die verspreiding van agendae en notule aan alle lede ten minste twee dae voor die vergaderings; Kontroleer en verseker dat notule van die vergaderings korrek geneem word en kliënte skriftelik van die uitslag in kennis gestel word; Tree as adviseur vir die adjudiserings-evalueringspanele op; Reël ad hoc-vergaderings; Verseker die opteken van beraadslaging van die vergaderings; Bestuur van personeelprestasie; Bestuur van verlofplan; Bestuur van personeelopleiding en -ontwikkeling; Koördineer aktiwiteite van die afdeling. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie.

zu.title: Umncedisi Weqembu: Ukuthola Abahlinzeki Nentuthuko Yabo
zu.summary: Kudingeka Umncedisi Weqembu ohlele ukutholwa kwabahlinzeki, ulawulo lwesisekelodatha kanye nalawulo lezinkontileka ngaphakathi kwe-Department of Co-operative Governance.
zu.requirements: Matric kanye ne-NQF level 6/ National Diploma kwi-Supply Chain Management noma i-Logistics, noma iziqu ezifanele njengoba zithathwa yi-SAQA, kanye nomphumela osukwini ongaphansi kwe-3-5 weminyaka yokuqashwa kwindawo yokuqoqa futhi ulawule izinkontileka. Ikhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda uhlelo lomthetho lokuphathwa kwemiyalelo yezinkontileka kwi-Public Service; Ulwazi nokuqonda i-PFMA kanye nomunye umthetho we-SCM; Ulwazi ngemigomo yomnyango ekuphathweni kwemiyalelo yezinkontileka; Ikhono lokusebenza endaweni eneinkinga ezinengi futhi oshushise ukuhlangabeza izikhathi ezimisiwe; Ukuqonda okujulile kokwakheka kwenqubomgomo nokuqoqaniswa; Ikhono lokuhlaziya; Ikhono leProject Management; Ikhono lokubhala imibiko; Ikhono lokuxhumana; Ikhono lokuxazulula izinkinga; Ikhono lokuphathwa kwezinkinga; Ikhanozelano; Ikhono lokuhlela nokuqamba; Ikhono leLeadership; Ikhono loqoqo; Ikhono lokuhlaziya; Ikhono lokuphathwa kwezinkontileka; Ikhono lokuphathwa kwemiyalelo; Ukusebenza njengeqembu; Ukugada; Ukuxhumana; Ukuxazulula nokuhlaziya izinkinga; Intuthuko yabasebenzi; Ukuphathwa kwezimali kanye nemikhuba; Inqubo yokubhala izabalomali; Izinqubomgomo, imikhuba kanye nemithetho; Ukucubungula nokuqoqa; Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuhlaziwa kwesisekelodatha yabahlinzeki ngokuhamba kwesikhathi; Qinisekisa ukubhaliswa kwabahlinzeki esisekelodathini yomnyango; Phatha ukuhlaziwa kolwazi olukhona mayelana nabahlinzeki esisekelodathini; Phatha futhi ugcine izimisozezo ezisebenzayo kanye nezinqubo zokubhalisa nokwamukelwa kwabahlinzeki; Qinisekisa ukuthi impahla itholwa ngokwe-PFMA, PPPFA, Treasury Regulations kanye nemiyalelo ye-Supply Chain Management kubaphathi; Qinisekisa ukuphathwa nokuba ngaphakathi kwemigomo kanye nezinqubo; Qinisekisa ukuthunyelwa kwemiyalelo yezinkontileka evunyiwe (pack) ku-GDF ukuyithumela kwi-e-Tender Portal nakwi-Government Tender Bulletin; Yenza izinkulumo zokuqondisa; Qondisa abadlali bemigaba kumigomo nezinqubo ngesikhathi sezinkontileka; Yethula inqubo ye-SCM noma imvelaphi yinkontileka kwamalungu e-Bid Evaluation Committee; Hlinzeka ngawo wonke amakomidi emiyalelo; Qinisekisa ukulungiselela imizuzu ye-BSC, BEC kanye ne-BAC; Qinisekisa ukulungiselela iziphakamiso ku-Adjudication Committee; Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okufanele kanye nokuhlinzeka ngamandla enqubo yezinkontileka; Qinisekisa ukulungiselela nokuqoqiswa kwawo wonke amaqembu e-Public Adjudication Committee; Yethula inqubo ye-Tender ne-Sourcing kwabasebenzisayo; Qamba imibiko yenyanga, nengxenyenhla kanye neminyaka yonke mayelana nezinkontileka kubaphathi kanye ne-Provincial Treasury; Phatha isimemo sezibalo eziye zathunyelwa kubahlinzeki ababhaliswe esisekelodathini; Qaphela ukuthola izibalo; Qinisekisa ukuthi impahla kanye nezinsiza zitholwa kubahlinzeki abaphume phezulu ngezikhundla ngokwe-PPPFA; Phatha futhi ugcile yonke imininingwane ngokwe-Requests for Quotations (RFQ); Xhumanisa ulwazi futhi ulugcibe ngabahlinzeki abangathembekile; Xhumana ne-CIPRO/DTI kanye ne-National Treasury; Qondisa abahlinzeki ngamanye amagangu okwenza ukuze bahambisane nezidingo zomnyango; Hlinzeka ngemvume ngokwenzelwa izibalo; Gada ukubuyekezwa okuvamile kwemibhalo ye-VAT kanye nendlela yezikhundla ezikhethiweyo; qamba, hlaziya, bese uqabelela izinkinga kwamaphrojekthi ahlukene ngaphakathi kwe-supply chain; Linganisa, hlaziya, bese uphatha ukusebenza komphakeli; Qinisekisa ukuthi ukubuyekezwa kwesiphuzo somphakeli kanye nemibiko iqediwe ukugcina ukuphathwa okufanele kwezinkontileka; Qinisekisa ukuthi umphakeli usebenza ngokufanele inkontileka; Qaphela izibhalo zezinkontileka kanye nezibhalo zokuzibophezela ukuze qinisekise ukuthi abahlinzeki abakhokhelwa kancane/kakhulu; Hlola ukuthi imigqankathi ye-BAC (Bid Adjudication Committee) ihlelwe ngokufanele; Phatha ukusabalalisa imigqankathi kanye nemizuzu kubo bonke amalungu okungenani izinsuku ezimbili ngaphambi kokuhlangana; Hlola futhi uqinisekise ukuthi imizuzu yomhlangano ibhalwe ngokufanele futhi abathengi batshelwe ngemibhalo ngeziphumo; Yiba ngumeluleki kumaphanela e-adjudication evaluation; Hlela izinkomisho; Qinisekisa ukubhalwa kwezinkulumo zomhlangano; Ukuphathwa kokuqashwa kwabasebenzi; Ukuphathwa kwehlelo lokukhishiwa; Ukuphathwa kokhothwa nentuthuko yabasebenzi; Qoqa imisebenzi yesigaba. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.

xh.title: iNcwele yeMnini-msebenzi: Ukufumana Abathengi kunye noPhuhliso loBathengi
xh.summary: Kufuneka iNcwele yeMnini-msebenzi ukulawula ukufumana abathengi, ulawulo lwegcine yolwazi kunye nolawulo lweenkonzo kwindawo yesebe le-Co-operative Governance.
xh.requirements: iMatric plus NQF level 6/ National Diploma kwSupply Chain Management okanye Logistics, okanye nesiqinisekiso esifanelekileyo njengokuqatshelwa yi-SAQA, kunye nokuba ngaphantsi kweminyaka engu-3-5 yokulinganisa ngokubakho isipili sokusebenza kwendawo yokufuna nokuLawula iinkonzo. Iikhompetensi: Ulwazi nokuqonda i-fom yomthetho we-tender nolawulo lweenkonzo kwiNkonzo kaRhulumente; Ulwazi nokuqonda i-PFMA nakwezinye iMithetho ye-SCM; Ulwazi lweenqobo-zimbo zesebe malunga ne-tender nolawulo lweenkonzo; Ikhono lokusebenza kwendawo esindayo kakhulu nokuqhubeka nangumsa wokuqhubela phambili ukuze ugcwalise iintsuku ezingekayo; Ukuqonda kakuhle ukuqumba nokulawula iindlela zomgaqo-nkqubo; Amakhono oPiko lokuhlalutya; Amakhono oLawulo lweProjekthi; Amakhono okubhala iingxelo; Amakhono oThintelwano; Amakhono oLusulelo lwezinkinga; Amakhono oLawulo lwengxaki; Amakhono oNhlobo-mntu; Amakhono oCebo nokuLungiselela; Amakhono oBukhosi; Amakhono oLawulo; Amakhono oPiko lokuhlalutya; Amakhono oLawulo lweenkonzo; Amakhono oLawulo lwe-tender; Ukusebenza ngokwamaqela; Ulawulo; Ithintelwano; Ukuhlalutya nokuSombulula iinkinga; uPhuhliso lwabasebenzi; uLawulo lweMali kunye neenqobo-zimbo; Iinkqubo zoBungezimali; Iingqinisekiso, iinqobo-zimbo kunye nemithetho; UkuLungiselela nokuQamba; Ilayisenisi yokushayela evakalayo.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukuhlaziya igcine yolwazi yabathengi ngaphandle kokumiswa; Qinisekisa ukubhalisa kwabathengi kwigcine yolwazi yesebe; Lawula ukuhlaziya kolwazi olukhoyo lwabathengi kwigcine yolwazi; Lawula kwaye ulondoloze iindlela neenqobo-zimbo ezisebenzayo zokubhalisa nokwamkelwa kwabathengi; Qinisekisa ukuba izinto zithengwa ngokwe-PFMA, PPPFA, iTreasury Regulations kunye neNqobo-zimbo zoLawulo lweQhinga lokuthenga kubaphathi ababalulekileyo; Qinisekisa ukusebenziswa nokuthobela iingqinisekiso nesenqobo-zimbo; Qinisekisa ukunikela kolwazi olugunyaziweyo lwe-tender (pack) ku-GDF ukuba luqhoselwe kwi-e-Tender Portal nakwi-Government Tender Bulletin; Qhuba iindibano zokuchaza; Khokela abathathi-nxaxheba kumgaqo-nkqubo naseenqobo-zimbeni ngexesha leenkwabo zoku-tendera; Yenza iinkqubo ze-SCM okanye imbali yomva ye-tender kwabalinganisi be-Bid Evaluation Committee; Yenza zonke iikomiti ze-bid; Qinisekisa ulungiselelo lweekhadi ze-BSC, BEC kunye ne-BAC; Qinisekisa ulungiselelo lweenkululeko ezisiwa kwi-Adjudication Committee; Qinisekisa ulawulo olulungileyo nokwenziwa kweenkwabo ze-tender; Qinisekisa ulungiselelo nokuqamba zonke iinkqubo ze-Public Adjudication Committee; Yaza iinkqubo ze-Tender noku-Source kubasebenzisi bokugqibela; Ukuqamba ingxelo nyanga zonke, yexeshana nyaka zonke nonyaka wonke nge-tender kubaphathi nakwi-Provincial Treasury; Lawula isimemo seefom zamaxabiso abathengi ababhaliswe kwigcine yolwazi; Qaphela ukufumana iifom zamaxabiso; Qinisekisa ukuba izinto nesebezvina zifunyanwa kwabathengi abaphezulu ngenqanaba ngenqanaba nangokwe-PPPFA.; Lawula kwaye ulondoloze zonke iirekhodi malunga ne-Requests for Quotations (RFQ); Thintelana ulwazi ngokugcina ulwazi malunga nabathengi abathembekileyo; Thintelana ne-CIPRO/DTI kunye ne-National Treasury; Lula abathengi iindlela okufuneka balandel ukuze balandel iimfuno zesebe; Yenza ukuvunywa kolwazi malunga nokwamkelwa kweefom zamaxabiso; Lawula ukuvavanya ngokuhamba kwexesha ukubhalisa kwe-VAT nendlela yamanqanaba okukhetha; chonga, hlalutya, kwaye uze uqwalasele iingozi zeeprojekthi ezahlukeneyo ngaphakathi kwesithuba soku-thengisa; Linganisa, hlalutya, kwaye ulawule ukusebenza komthengi; Qinisekisa ukuba ukuhlolwa kokusebenza komthengi nokuqamba iingxelo kugqityiwe ukuze kulawulwe ngokufanelekileyo iinkonzo; Qinisekisa ukuba umthengi ophethe inkonzo ayiphethe ngokwaneleyo; Qaphela ii-resjista zenkonzo nokuqinisekisa ukuba abathengi abahlangabezanga nangaphezu komvuzo ochanekileyo; Hangaza ukuba i-agenda ze-BAC (Bid Adjudication Committee) ziqulunqwe kakuhle; Lawula ukusasazwa kwe-agenda namaminithi kwabo bonke abalungu bangaphantsi kwemihla emibini ngaphambi kweendibano; Hlola kwaye uqinisekise ukuba amaminithi endibano athathwe kakuhle kwaye abathengi baxelelwe ngokubhalayo ngemiphumela; Yiba ngumcebisi kumapanel oLAWulo lokulinganisa lolwazi; Lungisa iindibano ezingezicwangiisisiweyo; Qinisekisa ukurekhodwa kweencoko zendibano; ULawulo lokusebenza kwabasebenzi; ULawulo lwecebo lokuphumla; ULawulo lokuvavanywa nokuphuhlisa abasebenzi; Qamba iindibaniselwano zesebe. Ilayisenisi yokushayela evakalayo.

jobs.title: OHS Practitioner: Employee Health and Wellness
jobs.department: Department of Co-operative Governance and Traditional Affairs
jobs.centre: Johannesburg REQUIREMENT   :   Matric plus NQF Level 6 in Environmental Health, Occupational Health and Safety, Safety Management. Coupled with a minimum 2 -3 years’ experience in an Occupational Health and Safety environment. Registration with a professional body in either Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA), Southern African Institute for Occupational Hygiene (SAIOH), or South African Institute of Occupational Safety and Health (SAIOSH) as a requirement. Competencies: Knowledge and good understanding on OHS Act (85 of 1993) Legislation and its related regulations; Knowledge of and the ability to implement directives on EHW, SHERQ, HIV and AIDS in the workplace; Problem solving; Analytical skills; Computer skills; Interpersonal skills; Presentation and facilitation skills; Report writing skills. A valid drivers’ license.
jobs.summary: The Department of Co-operative Governance and Traditional Affairs seeks an OHS Practitioner in Johannesburg to ensure workplace health and safety compliance and manage SHERQ activities.
jobs.duties: Monitor and ensure compliance with OHS Act (85 of 1993) & collate reports on SHERQ activities in the department; Implement OHS Policy, Occupational Health and Safety Act (85 of 1993) and related Regulations; Investigate accidents/incidents and complaints of employees in the workplace; Coordinate medical screening and functional medical surveillance where necessary; Review the effectiveness of health and safety measures in the department; Develop Emergency Response policies, evacuation procedures for drills; Coordinate Emergency evacuation drills within the department; Coordinate and facilitate (formal/informal) training for OHS Committee and Representatives; Conduct awareness (posters, workshops, webinars, pamphlets etc) for target employees e.g. use of safety equipment, fire extinguishers, evacuation chairs and PPE usage; Develop and implement Emergency Response procedures. Appoint Emergency Response Team; Coordinate the appointment of OHS representatives and committee; Participate in monthly meetings when required to report on relevant health and safety matters; Establish guidelines that will regulate the functions, responsibilities and administrative aspects of the OHS committee and representatives; Facilitate and continuously review and update the appointment of the relevant OHS committee members and representatives; Coordinate the quarterly OHS committee meetings and/or when necessary ensure effective deliberations on OHS matters and implementation of all action plans thereof; Investigate complaints relating to employee's health and safety matters safety; regarding health and safety at the workplace; Report all OHS committee functions, resolutions and action plans to appropriate authorities; Compile reports on inspections, incidents and accident investigations; Keep record and fill all OHS documents; Liaise with internal and external stakeholders e.g. municipality, disaster management, SAPS, OHS Committee, Contractors, HOD, Risk Management etc; Provide documents and information in the compilation of submissions of quarterly & annual reports to DPSA & OOP; Identify potential hazards and potential major incidents in the college; Conduct comprehensive Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment at the workplace; Conduct occupational health and safety/hygiene-related surveys e.g. lighting, ventilation etc. and make recommendations on control measures to be applied; Organize OHS compliance audits by appropriate authorities (Department of Labour etc on an annual basis); Undertake routine inspections and observations in respective work areas to monitor compliance with or violation of safety regulations, codes and standards; Establish Health & Safety inspections sheets and ensure that OHS Representatives (Reps) conduct such inspections on regular basis; Study, review and initiate appropriate action plans for all hazards and risks identified during OHS Reps inspections; Investigate all SHERQ-related incidents and accidents at the workplace, report same to relevant authorities, maintain accurate records thereof and initiate appropriate actions to prevent recurrence; Constantly strive to reduce occupational injuries, accidents and incidents at the workplace.
jobs.enquiries: Caiphus/ Andy, cell: 071 474 7078/51
jobs.applications: Applications should be submitted strictly online at https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za/Public/Jobs.aspx FOR ATTENTION : Human Capital management
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly online completed Z83 form It is our intention to promote representivity (race, gender, and disability) in the Public Service through the filling of these posts. Preference will be given to people with disabilities, and they will be exempted from a driver’s license requirement. Applications        should       be     submitted       strictly    online     at https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za/Public/Jobs.aspx                                  or http://jobs.gauteng.gov.za/Public/Jobs.aspx and it should be accompanied by a most recent Z83 form which may be obtained from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents. and comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV), certified copies of qualifications and Identity will be submitted upon request (no postal or hand delivery applications will be accepted). It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Furthermore, the recommended candidate will be required to produce his/her SMS Pre-entry certificate as offered by the National School of Governance (NSG) prior to the appointment being made. The certificate for entry into SMS and full details can be sourced by the following link: http://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Preference will be given to female applicants for SMS posts. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments; one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Correspondence will only be limited to shortlisted candidates. If you have not been contacted within 3 months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Failure to comply with the above instructions of specifically attaching a recent Z83 and a comprehensive CV will result in applications being disqualified. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: OHS-praktisyn: Werknemer Gesondheid en Welwees
af.summary: Die Department of Co-operative Governance and Traditional Affairs soek 'n OHS-praktisyn in Johannesburg om nakoming van werkplekgesondheid en -veiligheid te verseker en SHERQ-aktiwiteite te bestuur.
af.duties: Monitor en verseker nakoming van die OHS-wet (85 van 1993) en stel verslae oor SHERQ-aktiwiteite in die departement saam; Implementeer OHS-beleid, die Wet op Beroeps gesondheid en Veiligheid (85 van 1993) en verwante Regulasies; Ondersoek ongelukke/voorvalle en klagtes van werknemers in die werkplek; Koördineer mediese sifting en funksionele mediese toesig waar nodig; Hersien die doeltreffendheid van gesondheids- en veiligheidsmaatreëls in die departement; Ontwik Noodreaksiebeleide, ontruimingsprosedures vir oefeninge; Koördineer Noodontruimingsakkeoefeninge binne die departement; Koördineer en fasiliteer (formeel/informeel) opleiding vir OHS-komitee en Verteenwoordigers; Voer bewustheid (posters, werkswinkels, webinars, pamflette ens.) uit vir teikengroepwerknemers bv. gebruik van veiligheidstoerusting, brandblussers, ontruimingsstoele en VPM-gebruik; Ontwik en implementeer Noodreaksieprosedures. Benoem Noodreaksiespan; Koördineer die benoeming van OHS-verteenwoordigers en komitee; Neem deel aan maandelikse vergaderings wanneer vereis om oor relevante gesondheids- en veiligheidsake te rapporteer; Stel riglyne op wat die funksies, verantwoordelikhede en administratiewe aspekte van die OHS-komitee en verteenwoordigers sal reguleer; Fasiliteer en hersien en dateer voortdurend die benoeming van die tersaaklike OHS-komiteelede en verteenwoordigers op; Koördineer die kwartaallikse OHS-komiteevergaderings en/of wanneer nodig verseker effektiewe beraadslaging oor OHS-sake en implementering van alle aksieplanne daarvan; Ondersoek klagtes rakende werknemer se gesondheids- en veiligheidsake veiligheid; rakende gesondheid en veiligheid by die werkplek; Rapporteer alle OHS-komiteefunksies, besluite en aksieplanne aan toepaslike owerhede; Stel verslae oor inspeksies, voorvalle en ongelukondersoeke op; Hou rekord en vul alle OHS-dokumente in; Skakel met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes bv. munisipaliteit, rampbestuur, SAPS, OHS-komitee, Kontrakteurs, HOD, Risikobestuur ens; Verskaf dokumente en inligting by die samestelling van voorleggings van kwartaallikse en jaarverslae aan DPSA en OOP; Identifiseer moontlike gevare en moontlike groot voorvalle by die kollege; Voer omvattende Gevaaridentifikasie en Risikobepaling by die werkplek uit; Voer opnames rakende beroeps gesondheid en veiligheid/higiëne uit bv. beligting, ventilasie ens. en maak aanbevelings oor beheermaatreëls wat toegepas moet word; Reël OHS-nakomingsoudits deur toepaslike owerhede (Department of Labour ens. op 'n jaarlikse basis); Onderneem roetine-inspeksies en waarnemings in onderskeie werkareas om nakoming van of skending van veiligheidsregulasies, kodes en standaarde te monitor; Stel Gesondheids- en Veiligheidsinspeksieblaaie op en verseker dat OHS-verteenwoordigers (Reps) sulke inspeksies op 'n gereelde basis uitvoer; Bestudeer, hersien en inisieer toepaslike aksieplanne vir alle gevare en risiko's wat tydens OHS-Reps-inspeksies geïdentifiseer is; Ondersoek alle SHERQ-verwante voorvalle en ongelukke by die werkplek, rapporteer dit aan tersaaklike owerhede, hou akkurate rekords daarvan en inisieer toepaslike aksies om herhaling te voorkom; Streef voortdurend daarna om beroepsbeserings, ongelukke en voorvalle by die werkplek te verminder.

zu.title: Umuntu Ofunda Ohunywe Ubuchwepheshe be-OHS: Impilo Nokuhlelekala Kwabasebenzi
zu.summary: I-Department of Co-operative Governance and Traditional Affairs ifuna umuntu ofunda ohunywe ubuchwepheshe be-OHS e-Johannesburg ukuze qinisekise ukuthobela umthetho wezempilo nokuphepha endaweni yokusebenza kanye nokuphatha imisebenzi ye-SHERQ.
zu.duties: Qapha futhi uqinisekise ukuthobela umthetho we-OHS Act (85 of 1993) futhi uhlanganise imibiko ngemisebenzi ye-SHERQ kumnyango; Faka esikhundleni inqubo ye-OHS Policy, Occupational Health and Safety Act (85 of 1993) kanye nemithetho ehlobene nakho; Phenya izehlo/ezenzakalo kanye nesikhalazo sabasebenzi endaweni yokusebenza; Hlela ukuhlolwa komzimba kanye nokuqashelwa komzimba ngokomsebenzi lapho kudingeka khona; Phinda ubuke ukusebenza kwezinyathelo ezishewayo zezempilo nokuphepha kumnyango; Ilula izinqubomgomo zokuPhendula Kwezimo Eziphuthumayo, izehlakalo zokushiywa kwendawo ngezinkomba; Hlela izinkomba zokushiya kwendawo ngesimo esiphuthumayo ngaphakathi kumnyango; Hlela futhi uphephise (ngokuhlelekile/okungalulelekile) ukuzifundisa kubahleli be-OHS kanye Nabamele; Yenza ukwazisa (izithombe ezidwebwe, izingosi zokusebenza, izinkomba ze-web, amaphamphleti njll) abasebenzi abahlosiwe isb. ukusetshenziswa kwemishini yokuphepha, izilumbi zomlilo, izihlalo zokushiya indawo kanye nokusetshenziswa kwe-PPE; Luma futhi ufake esikhundleni izehlakalo zokuPhendula Kwezimo Eziphuthumayo. Cuma iqembu LokuPhendula Kwezimo Eziphuthumayo; Hlela ukucuma kwezimele be-OHS kanye nebuhleli; Thatha inxaxhebe emihlanganweni yenyanga lapho kudingeka khona ukubika ngemibuzo ezishewayo yezempilo nokuphepha; Hlama iziqondiso ezizobe zilawula imisebenzi, izibopho kanye nezinkomba zokuphatha ibuhleli be-OHS kanye nabamele; Phathise futhi uphinde ubuke futhi uvuse izinkomba zokuqashelwa kwabahleli abahlobene be-OHS kanye nabamele njalo; Hlela imihlangano yebuhleli be-OHS njalo kumanxenye athathu unyaka noma lapho kudingeka khona ukuze qinisekise izinkulumo ezisebenzayo ngezimali ze-OHS kanye nokufakwa kwawo wonke amapulani wesenzo; Phenya izikhalazo ezihlobene nezimali zezempilo nokuphepha kubasebenzi ezishewayo; ngokumayelana nezempilo nokuphepha endaweni yokusebenza; Bika wonke imisebenzi yebuhleli be-OHS, izinqumo kanye namapulani wesenzo kulawula abafanele; Hlela imibiko ngezihloko, izehlo kanye neziphenyo zezenzakalo; Gcina amarekhodi futhi uzalise yonke imibhalo ye-OHS; Xhumana namaphoyintindlela angaphakathi nangaphandle isb. umasipala, ukuphathwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo, i-SAPS, Ibuhleli be-OHS, abahola izinkontileka, i-HOD, Ukuphathwa Kwezengozi njll; Nikela amadokhumenti kanye nolwazi ohlelweni lwemibiko yamanxenye athathu unyaka kanye nenyanga ku-DPSA & OOP; Faka esikhundleni izengozi ezingase zenzeka kanye nezehlakalo ezinkulu ezingase zenzeka esikhungweni; Yenza ukuHlola Okujulile Nokubuka Ingozi Nokuhlola Ubungozi endaweni yokusebenza; Yenza iziphico ezihlobene nezempilo yokuphepha/ukuhlanzwa kwendawo yokusebenza isb. ukukhanya, ukuhonyozwa komoya njll. futhi unike izinkomba ngamanyathelo okulawula okufanele kusetshenziswe; Hlela izihloko zokuqinisekisa ukuthobela umthetho we-OHS ngulawula abafanele (i-Department of Labour njll njalo unyaka ngamunye); Yenza izihloko ezivamile kanye nokubuka kumawindo okuhambisanayo ukuze qapha ukuthobela noma ukuphula komthetho wokuphepha, amakhodi kanye izinga; Luma amaphepha okuhlolela Izempilo Nokuphepha futhi qinisekisa ukuthi izimele be-OHS (Reps) zenza izihloko ezinjalo njalo; Fundo, phindu futhi uqale amapulani wamanyathelo okufanele kuzo zonke izengozi kanye nengozi ezibonwe ngesikhathi sezihloko be-OHS Reps; Phenza yonke izehlo kanye nezenzakalo ezihlobene ne-SHERQ endaweni yokusebenza, yize kubike kulawula abahlobene, gcine amarekhodi aqondile ngazo futhi qale amanyathelo okufanele ukuze thintele ukuphindwa kwabo; Phezu kokho, zama ngamandla ukwehlisa izingozi, izehlo kanye nezezenzakalo ngokomsebenzi endaweni yokusebenza.

xh.title: Umprhatildi we-OHS: Impilo Nabanojikelezo Basebenzi
xh.summary: Isebe le-Co-operative Governance and Traditional Affairs lifuna umprhatildi we-OHS eJohannesburg ukuze qinisekishe ukuzithoba ngemigaqo yempilo nokhuseleko kwindawo yokusebenza kwaye ulawule imisebenzi ye-SHERQ.
xh.duties: Qapha kwaye uqinisekise ukuzithoba ngomthetho we-OHS Act (85 of 1993) kwaye uqokelele iingxelo ngemisebenzi ye-SHERQ kwisebe; Zisebenzisa inqubomgomo ye-OHS, umthetho wezempilo nokhuseleko Occupational Health and Safety Act (85 of 1993) nemigaqo elungiselelwe leyo; Phepha iingozi/izenzo ezingezwiyoyo nengxaki zabasebenzi kwindawo yokusebenza; Lawula ukubuyiselwa kwezonyo kwaye kulandelwe imedical surveillance xa kuyimfuneko; Phinda ujonge ukusebenza kobuchule benzepilo nokhuseleko kwisebe; Yakh izicwangciso zeNgxakumbi eziphuthumayo, iinkqubo zokushiya indawo yokusebenza ngeendlela ezilungiselelwe ukuqhelaniso; Lawula ukuqhelana nokushiya izindawo zokusebenza ngexesha lengxakumbi ngaphakathi kwisebe; Lawula kwaye uncede (ngokusesikweni/angesikweni) uqeqesho lweKomiti ye-OHS nabameli; Yenza abasebenzi bakho bakhuseleke (ngokusebenzisa iipostthara, iindlela zokusebenza, i-webinar, amapamflet etc) njengakubasebenzi abajoliswe kuzo njengakusebenzisa izixhobo zokhuseleko, izixhobo zokucima mlilo, amatshishi okushiya indawo nokusetyenziswa kwe-PPE; Yakh kwaye usebenzise iinkqubo zokuPhendula ngexesha leNgxakumbi. Cacisa iQela lokuPhendula ngexesha leNgxakumbi; Lawula ukucaciswa kwabameli be-OHS nakomiti; Thatha inxaxheba kwiindibano zenyanga xa kufuneka uchaze ngemiba ephathiweyo ngempilo nokhuseleko; Misela iinkqubo ezakulawula imisebenzi, iimfuno nemiba yolawulo yekomiti ye-OHS nabameli; Uncede kwaye uqhubekise ukuhlola kwaye uhlaziye ukucaciswa kwamalungu abamelayo abafanelekileyo bekomiti ye-OHS kwaye nabameli; Lawula iindibano ze-komiti ze-OHS ezibenzwa kwikota okanye xa kuyimfuneko qinisekisa ingxoxo ephumelelayo ngemiba ye-OHS kwaye kusebenziswe zonke iinkqubo zenzoendlela; Phepha iingxaki ezimalunga neempilo nokhuseleko kwabasebenzi ngokukhuseleko; malunga nempilo nokhuseleko kwindawo yokusebenza; Chaza imisebenzi yekomiti ye-OHS, izigqibo neenkqubo zenzoendlela kulawulo abafanelekileyo; Qokelela iingxelo ngokuqhwesela, iingozi nokuphepha iingozi; Gcina irekhodi kwaye ugcwalise yonke imibhalo ye-OHS; Thethaththi nabantu bangaphakathi nangaphandle njengakumasipala, ulawulo leezi, iSAPS, ikomiti ye-OHS, aboqeqeshi, iHOD, ulawulo losengo etc; Yanela imibhalo nolwazi ekwqokelelweni kweenkqubo zokunika iingxelo kwikota kunye neminyaka kwiDPSA ne-OOP; Balula iingozi ezinokubakho neengozi ezinokubakho ezinkulu kwikholeji; Yenza ukuBalula iingozi kwaye kuqwalaswe ingozi kwindawo yokusebenza ngokupheleleyo; Yenza uphando olunxulumene nempilo, ukhuseleko nokhuseleko/ukucoca indawo njengakukhanya, ukuventha etc. kwaye uze nokuqwalela ngokulawulwa kwendlela ezakusetyenziswa; Lungiselela ukuqhwesela ngokwemigaqo ye-OHS ngurhulumente ofanelekileyo (Isebe leZabasebenzi etc ngonyaka wonke); Yenza ukuqhwesela nokuqapha kwangaphakathi ezindaweni zonke zokusebenza ukuze kuboniswe ukuthotyelwa okanye ukuqhawuka kwemigaqo yokhuseleko, amakhodi namazinga; Misela amaphepha okuqhwesela oloBuncinci bempilo noKhuseleko kwaye qinisekisa ukuba abameli be-OHS (OHS Reps) benza olu qhweselo rhoqo; Funda, phinda ujonge kwaye uqale iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo zenzoendlela yazo zonke iingozi nobungozi ebesetyenziswa ngelixa kuqhweselwa ngabameli be-OHS (OHS Reps); Phepha zonke iingozi ezinxulumene ne-SHERQ ezize apha kwindawo yokusebenza, chaza ezi zinto kulawulo olufanelekileyo, gcina irekhodi elungileyo lwazo kwaye qale iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo zokuqhuba ezithi zingaphinde kwenzeka; Zama ngokuqhubekayo ukunciphisa iingozi, izenzo ezingezwiyoyo neengozi kwindawo yokusebenza.

jobs.title: Admin Clerk: Asset Management
jobs.department: Department of Co-operative Governance and Traditional Affairs
jobs.summary: Admin clerk needed for asset management in Johannesburg, requiring matric and one year of supply chain experience, offering R237 453 per annum.
jobs.requirements: Matric or relevant qualification. Coupled with a minimum of 1 year working experience within Supply Chain Management environment. Competencies: A basic knowledge of supply chain duties, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operate computer and collecting statistics. Basic knowledge and understanding of the legislative framework governing, the Public Service and Basic knowledge of work procedures in terms of the working environment. Computer literacy in (MS Office, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and email), good planning, interpersonal skills, good verbal and written communication skills and teamwork. valid driver's license.
jobs.duties: Render asset management clerical support: Compile and maintain records (e.g asset records/databases), check and issue furniture, equipment and accessories to components and individuals, identify redundant, non- serviceable and obsolete equipment for disposal, verify asset register. Render demand and acquisition clerical support: Update and maintain a supplier (including contractors) database. Register suppliers on Logis or similar system, request and receive quotations, capture specification on the electronic purchasing system, place orders, issue and receive bid documents, provide secretariat or logistical support during the bid consideration and contracts conclusion process, and compile draft documents as required. Render an effective filing and record management service: Opening and close files according to record classification system, filing/storage, tracing (electronically/manually) and retrieval of documents and files, complete index cards for all files. Render logistical support services: Place orders for goods, receive and verify goods from suppliers, capture goods in registers databases, receive request for goods from end users, Issue goods to end users, maintain goods register, update, and maintain register of suppliers. Process documents for archiving and/ disposal: Electronic scanning of files, sort and package files for archives and distribution, compile list of documents to be archived and submit to the supervisor.
