af.title: Administratiewe Klerk: Batebestuur
af.summary: Administratiewe klerk benodig vir batebestuur in Johannesburg, wat matriek en een jaar se ondervinding in verskaffingsketting vereis, teen R237 453 per jaar.
af.requirements: Matriek of 'n tersaaklike kwalifikasie. Saam met 'n minimum van 1 jaar se werkservaring binne 'n Verskaffingskettingbestuursomgewing. Bevoegdhede: 'n Basiese kennis van verskaffingskettingpligte, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, rekenaar te bedryf en statistiek te versamel. Basiese kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer, en basiese kennis van werksprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing. Rekenaarvaardigheid in (MS Office, Word, Excel, PowerPoint en e-pos), goeie beplanning, interpersoonlike vaardighede, goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede en spanwerk. Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Verleen administratiewe bystand vir batebestuur: Stel en onderhou rekords (bv. baterekords/databasisse), kontroleer en reik meubels, toerusting en bybehore aan komponente en individue uit, identifiseer oortollige, onbruikbare en verouderde toerusting vir besinking, verifieer bateregister. Verleen administratiewe bystand vir vraag en verkryging: Werk die verskaffer- (insluitend kontrakteurs) databasis by en onderhou dit. Registreer verskaffers op Logis of 'n soortgelyke stelsel, versoek en ontvang kwotasies, lê spesifikasies op die elektroniese aankope-stelsel vas, plaas bestellings, reik en ontvang boddokumente uit, verskaf sekretariaat- of logistieke bystand gedurende die bodoorwegings- en kontraksluitingsproses, en stel konsepdukumente soos vereis op. Lewer 'n doeltreffende lêer- en rekordbestuursdiens: Open en sluit lêers volgens die rekordklassifikasiestelsel, lêering/berging, opsporing (elektronies/ handmatig) en terugwinning van dokumente en lêers, voltooi indekskaarte vir alle lêers. Lewer logistieke bystandsdienste: Plaas bestellings vir goedere, ontvang en verifieer goedere van verskaffers, lê goedere in registers-databasisse vas, ontvang versoeke vir goedere van eindgebruikers, reik goedere aan eindgebruikers uit, onderhou goedereregister, werk dit by en onderhou die register van verskaffers. Proseseer dokumente vir argivering en/of besinking: Elektroniese skandering van lêers, sorteer en verpak lêers vir argiewe en verspreiding, stel 'n lys van dokumente op wat gearchiveer moet word en dien dit by die toesighouer in.

zu.title: Clerk Wezolawulo: Ukuphathwa Kwempahla
zu.summary: Kudingeka clerk wezolawulo wokuphathwa kwempahla eJohannesburg, ofuna ibhadi kanye nonyaka oyedwa wemfundo yohwebo wokuhlinzeka, enikeza iholo le-R237 453 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Ibhadi noma izifundo ezihambisanayo. Kuhambisana neminyaka engu-1 yohlu lobuchwepheshe bokusebenza ngaphakathi kwendawo ye-Supply Chain Management. Ikhono: Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngemisebenzi yohwebo wokuhlinzeka, amasu kanye nenhlonipho yokungenisa idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqoqa izibalo. Ulwazi oluyisisebelo nokuqonda umthethosisekelo ohlolayo, Imphakathi Kazwelonke kanye nolwazi oluyisisebelo ngemiyalelo yomsebenzi mayelana nendawo yokusebenza. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha ku-(MS Office, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, kanye ne-imeyili), ukucubungula okuhle, amakhono obuntu bokuxhumana, amakhono okukhuluma nokubhala ahle kanye nokusebenza njengaqembu. ilayisense yokushayela elisebenzayo.
zu.duties: Nikela ngokusekela okuyi-office bokuphathwa kwempahla: Hlela futhi ulondoloze iziqoshisi (isb iziqoshisi zempahla/amasayithi wezobungcali), hlahla futhi ukhiqize impahla, izinsiza namaphakethe ezimfenhwana kumakomponi nabantu, thola impahla ezingasebenzi, engasebenzi kahle nedala efanayo ngokuyesabekayo, qinisekisa isiqoshisi sempahla. Nikela ngokusekela okuyi-office bokuqonda nokuqoqa: Buya futhi ulondoloze isayithi wezobungcali (okuhlanganisa nabakhiqizi) bedatha. Bhalisa abahlinzeki ku-Logis noma ohlelo olufanayo, cela futhi uthole izikethe, ugenise izinkomba kwangohlelo lokuthenga lwekhompyutha, biza okuthengiwe, ukhiqize futhi uthole amadokhumenti e-bid, nikeza ngokusekela noma inqubomgomo yendawo ngesikhathi se-bid kanye nokuqedwa kwamakhasimende, futhi uhlele amadokhumenti abhalwe phansi njengoba kudingeka. Nikela ngokusekela okuyi-office bokugcina iziqoshisi nokuphathwa kwebhaladi: Vula futhi uvale amafayela ngokohlelo lokuhlukanisa iziqoshisi, ukugcina/ukulondoloza, ukulandelela (ngekhompyutha/ngezandla) nokubuyisa amadokhumenti namafayela, Qedela amakhadi ashume ngenani kuwo wonke amafayela. Nikela ngokusekela okuyi-office bokuqonda nokwamukela: Biza okuthengiwe, amukele futhi uqinisekise impahla evela kubahlinzeki, ugenise impahla kubhaladi bedatha, amukele izicelo zempahla kubasebenzisi, Nikeza impahla kubasebenzisi, ulondoloze ubhaladi wempahla, buya, futhi ulondoloze ubhaladi babahlinzeki. Cedula amadokhumenti okulondoloza/okuyesabekayo: Ukuthwebula kwamafayela ngekhompyutha, hlela futhi upakishe amafayela ukuyogcinwa kanye nokusatshazelwa, hlela uhlu lwamadokhumenti okulondoloza bese uwunikela ongomqondisi.

xh.title: Ilungu loLungeleliso: uLawulo lwefa
xh.summary: Kufuneka ilungu lolungeleliso lolawulo lwefa eJohannesburg, lifuna imatrikulinthi kunye nenyanga enye yamava olunxibelelwano lokunikezela ngezixhobo, linika R237 453 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Imatrikulinthi okanye izifundo ezifanelekileyo. Ekunxulumene neminyaka engu-1 ubuncinane yamava okusebenza kwimo yoLawulo lokuNikezela ngeZixhobo. Ikhompethensi: Ulwazi olusisekelo lwemisebenzi yolawulo lokunikezela ngezixhobo, iindlela zokwenza nokuba nakho ukuqokelela iidata, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqokelela izibalo. Ulwazi olusisekelo nokuqonda isakhiwo semithetho esilawula, Inkonzo kaRhulumente nolwazi olusisekelo lweenkqubo zomsebenzi ngokwemo yokusebenza. Ukubakwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwi(MS Office, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, nemail), ukuqumba okulungile, amakhono okuxhumana nabantu, amakhono amabalubhalo nokuthetha ngomlomo aphilileyo nomsebenzi wababini. ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yolungeleliso ekulawulweni kwefa: Qumba zigcine iirekhodi (umz iirekhodi/ iidesabhese zefa), hlola kunye noku nikela iifanitsha, izixhobo nezinto ezongezwayo kumacandelo nakumabanzi, qaphela izixhobo ezingasafunekiyo, ezingasebenzisekiyo nezize ezindala ukuba zithotywe, qinisekisa irekhodi yefa. Nika inkxaso yolungeleliso kufuno langaphakathi nokuzelela: Hlaziya kwaye ulugcine ugqibo zabahanisi (kuquka abathengisi) iidesabhese. Bhalisa abahanisi kwiLogis okanye inkqubo efanayo,cela kwaye wamkele iikhowuthi, qokelela iispekhifikhesheni kwinkqubo yokuThenga yeelekthronikhi, faka iioda, nikeze kwaye wamkele amaxwebhu okuthengisa, nikeza inkxaso yasekretari okanye yeLogistics ngexa lesixa sokucatshulwa kwekhowuthi nokuqinisekiswa kweenkonzo, qamba amaxwebhu abhaliweyo njengoko kufuneka. Nikela inkonzo yefayile nolawulo lweerekhodi olusebenzayo: Ukuvula nokuvala iifayile ngokwengqendlelo yokwahlula iirekhodi, ukufaka/ ukugcina, ukulandela (ngeelekthronikhi/ngezandla) nokukhupha amaxwebhu neefayile, gcwalisa amakhadi okulandela iifayile zonke. Nikela inkxaso yeLogistics: Faka iioda ezimpahleni, amkele kwaye uqinisekise izinto ezivela kubahanisi, qokelela izinto kwiirekhodi iidesabhese, amkele izicelo zezinto ezivela kubasebenzisi ekupheleni, Nikeza izinto kubasebenzisi ekupheleni, gcina irekhodi yezinto, hlaziya, kwaye ulugcine irekhodi yabahanisi. Celisa amaxwebhuokuwa ku-archiving nokuwa: Uku-skanisa iifayile ngeelekthronikhi, hlela kwaye upakishe iifayile zearchives nakwangasenkundi, qumba uluhlu lwamaxwebhu okwa kwiarchives aze awathumele kumlawuli.

jobs.title: Head of Unit (HOU)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R2 168 145 per annum, (all-inclusive package) Grade 2: R2 370 741 per annum, (all-inclusive package)
jobs.summary: Lead the anaesthetic department at Thelle Mogoerane Regional Hospital, providing clinical services, management oversight, and undergraduate and postgraduate teaching.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12. Appropriate postgraduate qualification that allows for registration with the HPCSA as Medical Specialist. A minimum of three years’ appropriate experience as a Specialist Anaesthetist after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Anaesthesia. Outstanding clinical skills in the field preferably in the public service environment. Experience in undergraduate and postgraduate training, including research. Understanding of basic Human Resource matters including labour relations and ORW. Understanding of basic Finance matters such as cost drivers and budget allocations. Knowledge of relevant health & labour legislation. Proven leadership skills. Understanding of basic Supply Chain matters such as developing demand and procurement plans for the unit. Knowledge of legislative prescripts governing public service. Managerial and problem-solving skills. Good communication and supervisory skills. Stress-tolerance and the ability to work in a team.
jobs.duties: Assist the clinical manager with management and administrative duties within the anaesthetic department, and participate in hospital committees and Departmental activities. Teaching and training at an undergraduate and post graduate level. Supervision and delivery of anaesthesia services at Thelle Mogoerane Regional Hospital and its cluster as appropriate. Engagement in outreach activities of the department. Human capital management and other administrative duties as allocated. Participation in the research and publication agenda of the academic department. Comply with the Performance Management and Development System (Contracting, reviews and final assessment).
jobs.enquiries: Dr. D. Mdluli Tel No: (011) 891 7000
jobs.applications: Applicants should quote the relevant reference number and submit through the following email address TMRH.Vacancies@gauteng.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications should be submitted strictly online at the following email address: TMRH.Vacancies@gauteng.gov.za No hand-delivered, faxed applications will be accepted. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the completed CV and new updated Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za/documents. Applications submitted on the old Z83 form will not be considered. Each (Z83) application for employment must be fully completed, initialled, and signed by the applicant as per Circular no 3 of 2025. Failure to complete will lead to disqualification during the selection process. Section A, B, C and D must be completed in full. Sections E, F and G: Space on the Z83 form is limited. Applicants must complete the three lines provided in each section. If further information is required, they may write “Refer to CV” or “See attached” only after completing those lines, provided that the CV or attachment contains the required information. All experience listed in the CV should be in chronological order and should indicate the employer, position and period of employment. The CV should indicate the start and end dates for each period of employment in DD/MM/YYYY format. The CV must include the names and locations of schools and institutions attended. The information on the new Z83 form must be consistent with the CV. Reference checks: Provide at least three (3) references, of which one must be the immediate supervisor. The Department reserves the right to conduct further verification where necessary. Failure to submit all the required information listed above may result in the candidate being disqualified. The question in Part F relating to conditions that prevent reappointment must be answered. The declaration must be completed and signed. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on or before the day of the interview. Please ensure that the specific reference number is quoted correctly. Only emailed applications will be considered. Correspondence will be entered into with shortlisted candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The employer reserves the right not to fill this post. It is a legislative requirement that all newly appointed staff members undergo and pass a Personnel Suitability Check (PSC) upon appointment. The verification process includes reference, identity, qualification and criminal record checks. Candidates in possession of a foreign qualification must furnish the Department with an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) (only when shortlisted). The recommended candidate may be subjected to medical surveillance as required by the Occupational Health and Safety Act 5/1993. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process

af.title: Hoof van Eenheid (HOE)
af.summary: Geleiding aan die narkose-afdeling by Thelle Mogoerane Regional Hospital, deur kliniese dienste, bestuursig, asook voorgraadse en nagraadse onderrig te verskaf.
af.requirements: Graad 12. Toepaslike nagraadse kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Spesialis moontlik maak. 'n Minimum van drie jaar se toepaslike ervaring as 'n Spesialis-narkotiseur na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Narkose. Uitstaande kliniese vaardighede in die veld, by voorkeur in die openbare diens-omgewing. Ervaring in voorgraadse en nagraadse opleiding, insluitend navorsing. Begrip van basiese Menslike Hulpbron-aangeleenthede, insluitend arbeidsverhoudinge en ORW. Begrip van basiese Finansies-aangeleenthede soos koste-a drywers en begrotings-toekennings. Kennis van relevante gesondheids- en arbeidswetgewing. Bewese leierskapsvaardighede. Begrip van basiese Voorsieningsketting-aangeleenthede soos die ontwikkeling van vraag- en procurement-planne vir die eenheid. Kennis van wetgewende voorskrifte wat die openbare diens regeer. Bestuurs- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Goeie kommunikasie- en toesigvaardighede. Stresverdraagsaamheid en die vermoë om in 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Ondersteun die kliniese bestuurder met bestuurs- en administratiewe pligte binne die narkose-afdeling, en neem deel aan hospitaalkomitees en Departementele aktiwiteite. Onderrig en opleiding op voorgraadse en nagraadse vlak. Toesig en levering van narkosedienste by Thelle Mogoerane Regional Hospital en sy cluster soos toepaslik. Betrokkenheid by uitreikaktiwiteite van die departement. Menslike kapitaalbestuur en ander administratiewe pligte soos toegeken. Deelname aan die navorsings- en publikasie-agenda van die akademiese departement. Voldoen aan die Prestasiebestuurs- en Ontwikkelingstelsel (Kontraktering, hersienings en finale assessering).

zu.title: Umhola Weqembu (HOU)
zu.summary: Hola umnyango wezengcaphuno ezibhedleleni i-Thelle Mogoerane Regional Hospital, uhlinze ngezinkonzo zezokwelapha, ulawule, futhi ufundise abafundi abangaphansi kwababeziqu kanye nalabo bababeziqu.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12. Isiqu esifanele samabheziqu esivumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengogqokqabuchopho Wezokwelapha. Okungenani eminyakeni emithathu yohlelo lokusebenza olufanele njengoGqokqabuchopho Wengcaphuno emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengoGqokqabuchopho Wezokwelapha kwezengcaphuno. Amakhono aphawulekayo ezokwelapha enkambeni yenhlangano kazwelonke kungenxa enkonzeni kahulumeni. Isiphiwo sokuhlela ukufundisa kwabangaphansi kwababeziqu nabalabo bababeziqu, okuhlanganisa nocwaningo. Ukuqonda izinto ezisisekelo zeZinsizakalo Zabantu okuhlanganise izinhlobonhlobo zohlelo lwabasebenzi kanye ne-ORW. Ukuqonda izinto ezisisekelo zezezimali ezifana nokubaluleka kwemithefula yokusebenza kanye nemitholampilo yemali. Ulwazi ngomthethonqobo wezempilo kanye nowabasebenzi. Amakhono obuholi abaqotho. Ukuqonda izinto ezisisekelo ze-Supply Chain ezifana nokuthuthukisa amaphulani wezidingo nezokuthenga ngenhloso yeqembu. Ulwazi lomthethonqobo oluphethe inkonzo kahulumeni. Amakhono obuphathi kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle kanye nokuphatha abasebenzi. Ukumelana nokucindezeleka kanye nakho ukusebenza eqenjini.
zu.duties: Siza umphathi wezokwelapha ngomsebenzi wolawulo kanye nokuphatha engxenyeni yezengcaphuno, futhi uthathe inxaxheba ekomidi yasebhedlela nasemsebenzini womnyango. Ukufundisa kanye nokuhlela ukufundisa ezingeni elingaphansi kwamabheziqu neliyizinga lamabheziqu. Ukugada kanye nokuhlinzwa ngezinkonzo zengcaphuno e-Thelle Mogoerane Regional Hospital nakwilabhoshi yayo ngendlela efanele. Ukuthatha inxaxheba emisebenzini yokunweba kochwepheshe bengqondo yomnyango. Ukuphatha imithombo yomuntu kanye nomsebenzi wokuphatha omunye njengoba kunikelwe. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kuluhlelo locwaningo kanye nokushicilela kwengcaphuno yochwepheshe bengqondo. Ukuhambisana nesistimu yokuphatha ukusebenza nokuthuthukisa (ukubhala izivumelwano, ukuhlola nokuhlola ngokugcwele).

xh.title: Umphathi weNqanaba elingana neSithranu (HOU)
xh.summary: Qhoboshisa isebe le-anesthetics kwiThelle Mogoerane Regional Hospital, lonikeze iinkonzo zezempilo, ulawulo, nendlela yokufundisa abafundi abangenayo kunye nabaphothule abaphakamileyo.
xh.requirements: Qeqhela uMatriki. Ifomalo yemfundo ephakamileyo efanelekileyo evumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengokoGqirha weNgongoma. Iminyakathi emithathu yamava afanelekileyo njengoGqirha weNgongoma emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha weNgongoma. Amapiko amangcalo obuchwepheshe kwindima, ngokukhethwa kwelinye ilizwe lekonzo letshixa. Amava kumfundiso wabafundi abangenayo nabo baphakamileyo, kuqulathe uphando. Ukuqonda kwezomthetho wabasebenzi ongundoqo, kuqulathe iintambo lomsebenzi kwaye ORW. Ukuqonda kwezemali ongundoqo, njengemithetho yokutshixa ibhajethi. Ulwazi ngomthetho wezempilo wemithetho yabasebenzi. Amaphiko obunkqonkqo obungqina. Ukuqonda kwenkqubo yokuqonda kwemveliso njengendlela yokulunga iinkqubo zokuthenga zoluntu. Ulwazi ngomthetho wemicimbi yokulawula konzo letshixa. Amapiko obulawulo nokusombulula iingxaki. Amaphiko obunkqonkqo bomxhasi nogqirha bokulawula. Ukuqonda ukunyamezela kwaye ukwazi ukusebenza ngokubhananisana.
xh.duties: Nceda umphathi wezempilo ngolawulo nemisebenzi yocwango kwisebe le-anesthetics, kwaye uthabathe inxaxheba kumagatya esibhedlele nemicimbi yeSebe. Ukuqeqesha nokufundisa ngongqondo abafundi abangenayo nabaphakamileyo. Ukulawula nokunika inkonzo yonke i-anesthesia eThelle Mogoerane Regional Hospital nakuwo onke amaqela alokulinga. Unxibelelwano kwimisebenzi yokusasaza kwisebe. Ukulawula abantu nemisebenzi yocwango enye njengoko makukhankanywe. Ukuthabatha inxaxheba kuphando noluvo kwisebe lemfundo. jobs.title: Medical Specialist – Psychiatry

af.title: Mediese Spesialis – Psigiatrie
af.summary: Mediese Spesialis in Psigiatrie gesoek vir Thelle Mogoerane Regional Hospital in Gauteng om kliniese geestesgesondheidsorg, onderrig en navorsingstoeg te verskaf.
af.requirements: Grade 12. Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n mediese spesialis in psigiatrie toelaat. Master of Medicine in Psychiatry (MMedPsych) en/of 'n Fellowship of the College of Psychiatrists of South Africa (FCPsychSA). Die vermoë om te onderrig, op te lei, navorsing te doen en navorsing vir akademiese graaddoeleindes te superviseer. Bereidwilligheid om voorgraadse en nagraadse studente en ander gesondheidsorgwerkers te onderrig en op te lei. Graad 1- ervaring nie van toepassing nie, registrasie by HPCSA as Medical Specialist Psychiatry. Graad 2: 5 jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n mediese spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA as mediese spesialis in psigiatrie. Graad 3: 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as 'n mediese spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA as mediese spesialis in psigiatrie.
af.duties: Bestuur van psigiatrie by Thelle Mogoerane Regional Hospital in die verskaffing van kliniese sorg aan geestesgesondheidsgebruikers, onderrig van voor- en nagraadse studente. Bestuur eie dienslewering. Kliniese dienslewering: evaluering, bestuur, sorg, behandeling en rehabilitasie van geestesgesondheidsgebruikers in 'n akute psigiatriese eenheid in 'n algemene hospitaalopset asook uitreikdienste waar toepaslik. Verseker dat pasiëntsorg bevorder word om aan die National Core Standards for health, Batho Pele Principles en die Mental Health Care Act, 17 of 2002, en ander relevante medico-juridiese regulasies te voldoen, deur die behoeftes van die bevolking wat bedien word met fasiliteite in die hospitaal te bely. Toesig oor 'n multidissiplinêre groep geestesgesondheidsverskaffers en ander relevante personeellede. Bestuur en bedryf die Specialist Psychiatry Outpatients Clinic. Lei die multidissiplinêre saalrondes vir in-pasiënte. Konsultasies vir pasiënte buite die psigiatriese eenheid. Hersien en oudit pasiënte se mediese rekords. Administrasie: Voer administratiewe take uit wat verband hou met pasiëntbestuur en studenteopleiding. Hanteer pasiëntklagtes. Woon geskeduleerde vergaderings met hospitaalbestuur by. Dra tot elektroniese databasisse vir navorsingsdoeleindes by. Koördineer diensroosters en personeeltoewysings in die departement. Verseker werwing en behoud van personeel in die departement. Skakel met ander departemente en met ander hospitale, distrik geestesgesondheidsdienste waar nodig. Akademies: Verskaffing van onderrig en leer om te verseker dat beide voor- en nagraadse studente die vereiste vaardighede geleer word en geleenthede gebied word om in 'n veilige omgewing te leer. Help met die koördinering van akademiese programme. Voer toepaslike navorsing uit: Ontwikkel eie belangstellings en gepubliseer toepaslik. Ondersteun nagraadse studente met navorsingsprojekte. Wees bereid om deurlopende opleidings- en ontwikkelingsprogramme te ondergaan. Woon vergaderings en opleiding by soos deur toesigvoerder goedgekeur. Voldoen aan die Performance Management and Development System (Contracting, reviews and final assessment).

zu.title: Izikhwembu Ezivezwayo Ezesayensi Yezokwelapha – I-Psychiatry
zu.summary: Kufunwa udokotela weziguli onguchwepheshe ku-Psychiatry osebenza eThelle Mogoerane Regional Hospital eGauteng ukuze anikeze ukunakekelwa kwezempilo yengqondo, ukufundisa, kanye nokuqondisa ucwaningo.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12. Isifundo esifanele esivumela ukubhalisa kuHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha ku-Psychiatry. I-Master of Medicine in Psychiatry (MMedPsych) noma i-Fellowship of the College of Psychiatrists of South Africa (FCPsychSA). Ikhono lokufundisa, ukuqeqesha, ukwenza ucwaningo kanye nokuqondisa ucwaningo ngenhloso yeziqu zezifundo. Ukuzithoba ukufundisa kanye nokuqeqesha abafundi abasemqangweni nabalowo-ngaqondiswa kanye nabanye basebenzi bezempilo. I-Grade 1- ukuhlolwa kokuhlolile akusebenzi, ukubhalisa kuHPCSA njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha ku-Psychiatry. I-Grade 2: iminyaka engu-5 yokuhlolile okufanele njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha ngemva kokubhalisa kuHPCSA njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha ku-Psychiatry. I-Grade 3: iminyaka engu-10 yokuhlolile okufanele njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha ngemva kokubhalisa kuHPCSA njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha ku-Psychiatry.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa kwe-Psychiatry eThelle Mogoerane Regional Hospital ekunikezeni ukunakekelwa kwezempilo kubasebenzisi bezempilo yengqondo, ukufundisa kwabafundi abasemqangweni nabalowo-ngaqondiswa. Phatha ukulethwa kwezinsizakalo zakho. Ukulethwa kwezinsizakalo zezokwelapha: ukuhlola, ukuphatha, ukunakekela, ukwelapha kanye nokulungisa abasebenzisi bezempilo yengqondo kwisiteshi sokwelapha okusheshise kwezempilo yengqondo endaweni yesibhedlela jikelele kanye nezinsizakazo zokufinyelela lapho kufanele khona. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukunakekelwa kweguli kukhuthazwa ukugcina amanani wezwe avela amahlelokulinganiswa empilweni, izimilo zikaBatho Pele kanye neMental Health Care Act, 17 ka-2002, namanye eminye imithetho yezomthetho-mthetho eqondene nalokho, ukuhambisanana nezidingoabantu abakhululekwa izinsizakazo namathuluzi asibhedlela. Ukuqondisa iqembu elihlukene izikhungo zabakhiphi bezempilo yengqondo kanye nabanye basebenzi abahlobene nalesi sikhungo. Phatha kanye nokuqasha i-Specialist Psychiatry Outpatients Clinic. Dala amajikeleza eziguli ezikamaminithi eqenjini lokuhlanganisa iziguli eziyofakwa esibhedlela. Izincwadi zabathintana nabesekwa abangengaphakathi kwesiteshi sika-Psychiatry. Hlola kanye nokuqamba izinkomba zokwelapha ziguli. Ukulawula: Yenza imisebenzi yokuqondisa ehlobene nokuphathwa kweguli kanye nokuqeqesha abafundi. Phendula izikalwo zomzimba ziguli. Mzanywa ihafta lemitha yomholo ohleliwe nongqondisi wesibhedlela. Yenze izikhathi zesibhedlela ngenhloso yocwaningo ezibhedlela. Hlela ohlu lomsebenzi kanye nokwabiwa komuntu kumnyango. Qinisekisa ukubhaliswa nokugcinwa komsebenzi kumnyango. Thintana namanye amanyango kanye namanye amasibhedlela, kanye nezinsizakazo zezempilo yengqondo yewadi lapho kudingwa khona. Izifundo: Inikeza ukufundisa nokufunda ukugcina ukuthi abafundi abasemqangweni kanye nalowo-ngaqondiswa bafundiswa izikhondo ezidingekayo futhi banikezwa ithuba lokufunda endaweni ephephile. Siza ekuhleleweni kohlaka lwesifundo. Yenza ucwaningo olufanele: Sekisa umdla wakho uphinde ushicilela ngendlela efanele. Siza abafundi balowo-ngaqondiswa ngephrojekthi yocwaningo. Zithobele ekuthatheni ukuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa okuvela emuhleni. Mzanywa imitha kanye nokuqeqeshwa njengoba kuvunyiwe ngumqondisi. Hambisana ne-Personal Management and Development System (Contracting, reviews and final assessment).

xh.title: Isebe Lemigramu – Ipsychiatry
xh.summary: Kufunekiwe isebe lemiryamathi ngokwanga iPsychiatry kwiThelle Mogoerane Regional Hospital eGauteng ukunika inkathazo yempilo yengqondo ngokomzimba, ukufundisa, nokuqhuba uphando.
xh.requirements: IGrade 12. Isifundo esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalisa kwiHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengesabe semigramu kwiPsychiatry. I-Master of Medicine in Psychiatry (MMedPsych) okanye i-Fellowship of the College of Psychiatrists of South Africa (FCPsychSA). Ikhono lokufundisa, ukulungiselela, ukwenza uphando nokuqhuba uphando ngenjongo yezifundo zesidanga. Ukuzimisela ukufundisa nokulungiselela oboxuki basezingeni elingaphantsi nabanqamlez ezidingekileyo ngenani elingaphezulu abanye abasebenzi besebe lempilo. IGrade 1- amava abalulekanga, ukubhalisela kwiHPCSA njengeMedical Specialist Psychiatry. IGrade 2: 5 years amava afanelekileyo njengoMedical Specialist emva kokubhalisa kwiHPCSA njengeMedical Specialist kwiPsychiatry. IGrade 3: 10 years amava afanelekileyo njengoMedical Specialist emva kokubhalisa kwiHPCSA njengeMedical Specialist kwiPsychiatry.
xh.duties: Ukulawula iPsychiatry eThelle Mogoerane Regional Hospital ekunikezeni inkathazo yempilo kwabasebenzisi besebe lempilo yengqondo, nakufundiseni aboxuki abasezingeni elingaphantsi nabanqamlez. Lawula ukunikezwa kwezakhono zakho. Ukunikezwa kwezakhono zempilo: isilinganiso, ulawulo, inkathazo, unyango nokubuyisela kwabasebenzisi besebe lempilo yengqondo kwicandelo lePsychiatry ngokukhawuleza kumgel wezhospitali ejikelezi naye nakwinkonzo zokuhamba apho kufanelekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba inkathazo yomntu ikhuthazwa ukuba ihambelane neNational Core Standards yempilo, iBatho Pele Principles neMental Health Care Act, 17 ka 2002, nezinye iimithetho yomthetho yemedico-legal, ukwenza ukuba iimfuno zabantu abakhululelwayo zihambelane nezinto eziswizasbenziswa esibhedlele. Ukulawula iqela labasebenzi beempilo yengqondo abavela kumagatya amaninzi nabananye abasebenzi abafanelekileyo. Lawula phantsi kwayo uqhube iSpecialist Psychiatry Outpatients Clinic. Qamba amagatya amaninzi okujikeleza amagumbi azele abagulayo. Iingxoxo zabagulayo abangesesidlangeni sePsychiatry. Phinda uphele nokulinganisa iirekhedi zempilo zabagulayo. Ulawulo: Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo enxulumene nokulawula abagulayo nokulungiselela aboxuki. Phendula iingxaki zabagulayo. Khangela iindibano ezijilizwe nolawulo lwezhospitali. Sungula kumadatabase abakhoyo ngokwamagcisa kuqhagamshelo lwangaphakathi nasekuqhubeni uphando. Lawula futhi ulungelelanise uluhlu lomsebenzi nokwabiwa kwabasebenzi kwisebe. Qinisekisa ukuba abantu abangeniswa besebenzi ebaleni bathathwa kwaye bagcinwa esibhedlele. Thethathu nangamanye amanye amagunya avela kumazwe angaphandle iinkonzo zempilo yengqondo kwisithili. Isikolo: Ukunikela ngemfundo nokufunda kuqinisekisa ukuba aboxuki abasezingeni elingaphantsi nabanqamlez bafundiswa izakhono ezifunekayo bakanikezelwa ithuba lokufunda kwindawo ekhuselekileyo. Uncede ekulawuleni amagatya angabaxuki. Yenza uphando olufanelekileyo: Zisa phambili ithamsanqa lakho baza upapasha ngendlela efanelekileyo. Xhasa aboxuki bezinga eliphezulu ngeendwendwe zobuphando. Ukuze ubheke ukuthabatha isifundo nokuzikhulisa ngokuqhubekayo. Khangela iindibano nobulumko obuvunyiwe ngumlawuli. Phakama compliance noqhagamshelo lokuQinisekiswa kokuQhuba nokuzikhulisa (Contracting, reviews and final assessment).

Ondergaan deurlopende opleiding en ontwikkeling; bywoon vergaderings en opleing soos goedgekeur deur toesighouer.

zu.title: Iqhakambishi lezokwelapha (UDOKOTELA OQAPHELAYO) – Ukunakekelwa okuphuthumayo
zu.summary: Kudingwa Iqhakambishi lezokwelapha ezinakekelweni okuphuthumayo eThelle Mogoerane Regional Hospital eGauteng, kudingwa ukubhalise ku-HPCSA njengodokotela oqaphelayo.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12. Isiqu esifanele esivumela ukubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengengcweti lezokwelapha kuzoGule Lezokwelapha Ngaphakathi (UDokotela Oqaphelayo). I-Master of Medicine in Internal Medicine (MMed) kanye noma i-Fellowship of the College of Physicians of South Africa (FCPSA). Ukutshintsha intshisekelo ebonakalisekayo ekunakekelweni okuphuthumayo kuzoba yinzululwazi engeziwe. Isiqu esifanele samazinga aphakeme kwezempilo (MBChB). Ukubhalisa okwamanje ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengeQhakambishi lezokwelapha esimenyezelweni edingekayo. I-Grade 1: okuhlangenwe nakho akufaneleki, ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengeQhakambishi lezokwelapha ekunakekelweni okuphuthumayo. I-Grade 2: eminyakeni engu-5 okuhlangenwe nakho okufanelekile njengeQhakambishi lezokwelapha ngemva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengeQhakambishi lezokwelapha ekunakekelweni okuphuthumayo. I-Grade 3: eminyakeni engu-10 okuhlangenwe nakho okufanelekile njengeQhakambishi lezokwelapha ngemva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengeQhakambishi lezokwelapha ekunakekelweni okuphuthumayo. Isiqu esingaphandle kwamazinga aphakemi eNkohlakalo kuzoba yinzululwazi engeziwe. Amakhono okuxhumana amahle (okubhaliwe nokuKhulunywayo) kanye nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Kumele kube norekhodi eliqinile lobuchwepheshe bokwelapha kanye nokuphathwa kwezokwelapha, ucwaningo nokuhlangenwe nakho ekufundiseni nokuqeqesheni kokubili kwamazinga asezahluko nasaphakeme. Amakhono amahle okuphatha abantu, ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukwenza izinqumo kanye nenhlahlekho yokusebenza eqenjini elihlanganisiwe njalo.
zu.duties: Ukunakekelwa kwezokwelapha Nohlelo Lokuhlinzeka: Phatha ukuhlinzeka kwakho futhi unikeze ukuhlola kokwelapha, ukunakekela, ukuphatha, kanye nokwelapha iziguli eNqengeni Lokunakekelwa Okuphuthumayo eThelle Mogoerane Regional Hospital. Nikeza ubuholi izinkonzo zokunakekelwa okuphuthumayo esibhedlela nakumapulatifomu ezemfundo. Qinisekisa ukunakekelwa okuphuthumayo okwamazinga aphakeme okusemgqeni wenzululwazi, qinisa ukuphathwa kwezokwelapha, thuthukisa imiphumela yeziguli, futhi qinisekisa ukuzilandela izinqubomgomo zezwe, izindinganiso zokuphepha, Imigiqo kaBatho Pele, Izindinganiso Eziyisiseko Zwezwe, kanye nemikhakhaso ye-ICU. Holisa amaroundi wezibhedlela aleqenjini elihlanganisiwe futhi qaphazele amaqembu ahlanganisiwe nabasebenzi abafanele. Ukufundisa, Ukuqeqesha NoCwaningo: Hlanganise futhi useke ukufundisa, ukuqeqesha, kanye nokuqaphazela abafundi bamazinga asezahluko nasaphakeme, okuhlanganisa ababhali abajikelezayo kwi-ICU. Yenza futhi useke ucwaningo lweminyango; thuthukisa izintshisekelo zakho zocwaningo futhi ushicilele ngendlela efanele; axaze ekwakheni okwazi komthombo wolwazi lwesikhombisi. Seke abafundi bamazinga aphakeme ngemaprojekthi wocwaningo. Ukuqashwa Nokuphathwa. Yenza imisebenzi yokuqashwa ehlobene nokuphathwa kweziguli futhi uxazulule izikhalazo zeziguli. Hlale emihlanganweni elondoloziwe nobuphathi besibhedlela futhi uxhumane namanye amaminyango nasemamabhededle njengoba kudingeka. Landela Isistimu Yokuqashwa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwemisebenzi: ukusayina kontrakthi, ukubuka, kanye nekuhlola okugcwele. Okunye: Hlanganyela ekusingathweni kwe-ICU kwamahora emva kwesikhathi, imisebenzi yokuqasha, kanye nezinye izibopho zesikhungo njengoba kudingeka. Yeqe ukuqeqesha nokuthuthukiswa ngokungapheli; hlala emihlanganweni nasekuqeqeshweni njengoba kuvunyelwe ngumqapheli.

xh.title: Igcino lezeMedyasini (UMGANGATHO) – ezingqiqweni eziBalulekileyo zokuNakekelwa
xh.summary: Kufunekwa iGcino lezeMedyasini ezingqiqweni eziBalulekileyo zokuNakekelwa kwiThelle Mogoerane Regional Hospital eGauteng, kwaye kufuneka abhalwe kwi-HPCSA njengomgangatho.
xh.requirements: IGrade 12. Iqualifyingezo ezifanelekileyo ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengegcino lezeMedyasini kwiInternal Medicine (Physician). IMaster of Medicine kwiInternal Medicine (MMed) okanye iFellowship of the College of Physicians of South Africa (FCPSA). Ithungelwano elibonakalisiweyo kwingxoxo-mphendulwano ngezinto eziBalulekileyo zokuNakekelwa luya kuba yomelelo ongawongezi. Iqualifyingezo eziphakamileyo ezifanelekileyo kwiZuxhakazimo (MBChB). Ukubhalisa ngokwangoku kwi-HPCSA njengeGcino lezeMedyasini kwizifundo ezifunekayo. IGrade 1: amava abalulekileyo, ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengeGcino lezeMedyasini ezingqiqweni eziBalulekileyo zokuNakekelwa. IGrade 2: 5 years amava afanelekileyo njengeGcino lezeMedyasini emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengeGcino lezeMedyasini kwingxoxo-mphendulwano ngezinto eziBalulekileyo zokuNakekelwa. IGrade 3: 10 years’ amava afanelekileyo njengeGcino lezeMedyasini emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengeGcino lezeMedyasini kwingxoxo-mphendulwano ngezinto eziBalulekileyo zokuNakekelwa. Iqualifyingezo eziphakamileyo ezingalawulo zokugcina zokongeza isiqiniseko. Amakhono amabalulu (okubhaliweyo nakunokuthethwayo) nomthetho-damakhompyutha. Kufuneka abe nerekhod enamandla lengcaphep yamakliniki nothungelwano lwekliniki, uphononongo namava okuqeqesha nokufundisa kumazinga abafundi abangenayo nabo baphakamileyo. Amakhono amandla okulawula abantu, ukucinga ngokuhlalwa, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukuthatha izigqibo nendlela yokusebenza eqeqesha inkqubo ebalulekileyo yemisebenzi.
xh.duties: Amakliniki kwaye enze iinkonzo ezithunyelweyo: Lawula ezakho zonke iinkonzo kwaye uzinike ikliniki, inikela iindlela zokunakekela, ukulawula nokukhangela iingxaki zabaguli kwisebe sokunakekelwa kwindawo ebalulekileyo zeThelle Mogoerane Regional Hospital. Nikela ngamandla ezenzo zokuba sisikhokelo kwiinkonzo zokunakekelwa ezibalulekileyo kulo onke amaziko neziko. Qinisekisa ukunakekelwa okuphakamileyo, okusemthethweni kwaye kwamava, qinisa inkqubo yengcaphep yekliniki, ukuphucula iziphumo zabaguli, kwaye uqinisekise ukuzithoba kumalungiselelo ezizwe, ipeyinted yamaxhoba, iBatho Pele Principles, iNational Core Standards, nemimiselo ye-ICU. Qondisa iingqungquthela kumagumbi eqeqesha inkqubo ebalulekileyo yamandla kwaye ulawule amaqela ebalulekileyo abasebenzi. Ukuqeqesha, ukuLungisa & ukuPonononga: Qhagamshela kwaye uxhase ukuqeqesha, ukulungisa, nokuqeqesha abafundi abangenayo nabo baphakamileyo, kuquka nababhali abajikeleza kwi-ICU. Qhuba kwaye uxhase uphononongo lwesebe; tshisa amabhaka athandwayo okuphonononga kwaye ushicilele ngokufanelekileyo; unike ngaphezulu i database zophononongo ezikwi-intanethi. Xhasa abafundi abaphakamileyo ngeenjongo zokuphonononga. Isebe loLawulo & oluLawulwayo. Zenza imisebenzi yolawulo ngokubaluleka kokulawula umguli kwaye uphendule iingxaki zabaguli. Ziya kwindibano ezicwangciswayo nolawulo lwesibhedlela kwaye uxhulumane nanye amasebe nezasibhedlele njengoko kufunekayo. Zithobe kumacwangciso oLawulo kwaye aphuhlise iNkqubo yeMisebenzi: ukuqamba iinkonzo, ukuphonononga, kwaye uqinisekise isiqibo. Okunye: Hlanganyela ekunikekeni ngeyure zangemva kwe-ICU, imisebenzi yokubiza, kwaye onke eminye imisebenzi yeshishini njengoko kufunekayo. Phepha ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo nokuphuhliswa; zama iindibano noqeqesho njengoko kuvunyelwe ngumlawuli wakho.

jobs.title: Medical Specialist
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 134 185 per annum, (all-inclusive package) Grade 2: R1 531 032 per annum, (all-inclusive package) Grade 3: R1 773 222 per annum, (all-inclusive package)
jobs.summary: Medical Specialist in Ophthalmology at Leratong Hospital, requiring HPCSA registration, with clinical duties including cataract surgery and teaching.
jobs.requirements: Appropriate Medical Degree that allows registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist. Grade 1: No experience required. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years appropriate experience as Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in a normal Specialty. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years appropriate experience as Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in a normal Specialty. Ability to manage a team of junior and senior doctors. Ability to establish excellent working relationships with all the disciplines teams. Good leadership skills, excellent communication (verbal and written) skills, conflict resolution and good interpersonal skills. The successful candidate must be adaptable, disciplined and self-confident. The candidate must be able to work independently and under pressure and beyond normal working hours and work with diverse team. Ability to work in a multi-disciplinary team. Knowledge of legislation, policies and procedure pertaining to health care users. Computer Literacy. Experience in the public sector would be an advantage. Candidate will be expected to perform commuted overtime.
jobs.duties: Clinical management of patients in General Ophthalmology/ intake clinic as well as a subspecialist clinic in either Glaucoma, Medical Retina or Paediatric Ophthalmology. Surgery on Patients with general eye complaints and specifically performing and teaching cataract surgery. Clinical teaching of medical officers in cataract management and either glaucoma, cornea or adnexal diseases. Co-ordinate all clinical and administrative duties within the Department. Involvement in hospital committees and liaison with other departments within the hospital. Staff training theoretical and skills performance of junior doctors and allied medical disciplines at the hospital and referring hospitals. SOPs development and implementation. To participate, support and promote research relevant to the Ophthalmology department. Ability to initiate and conduct research will be an advantage. Be a role model for students and staff. Perform duties assigned by the Head of Department of Health. Maintain quality assurance standards and other Departmental policies. Reduction of waiting time of Backlogs. Ensure effective specialist services to contribute to optimal and quality health care in line with the vision, mission and values of Gauteng department of health. Ensure compliance to SOP’s and clinical Protocols. Supervision and effective utilization of Medical staff. Comply with the Performance Management and Development System (contracting, quarterly reviews and final assessment. Ensure an effective outreach to District hospitals. Participate in academic activities in the hospital and in the cluster. Full participation in Quality assurance programs, management of PSI’s and complaints
jobs.enquiries: Ms N Serobatse Tel No: (011) 411-3563 / Ms M Moeketsi Tel No: (011) 411-
jobs.applications: applications should be submitted strictly online at the following E-Recruitment portal: http://jobs.gauteng.gov.za. No hand-delivered, faxed, or emailed applications will be accepted. For assistance with online applications please email your query to healthjobqueries@gauteng.gov.za. NOTES : NB Candidates Who Previously Applied Are Encourage To Reapply. Kindly note that NO payment of any kind is required when applying for posts advertised by the Gauteng Department of Health. The Department reserves the right not to fill any advertised posts. Applications should be accompanied by a fully completed and signed new Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za/documents. The new Z83 form must be fully completed and signed by the applicant. The following must be considered in relation to the completion of the Z83 by applicants: All the fields in Part A, Part B, Part C and Part D must be completed. Leave the following question blank if they are not in possession of such: “If your profession or occupation requires official registration, provide date and particulars of registration”. Application without proof of a new Z83 application form and detailed CV will be disqualified. Applicants must indicate the post reference number on their applications. Shortlisted candidates will receive communication from HR unit to submit certified copies of educational qualifications and other relevant documents not older than 6 months on or before the day of the interview). Personnel Suitability Checks (criminal checks, citizenship checks, qualification verification, company directorship, social media, financial record checks, reference checks) must be conducted prior appointment. Candidates in possession of a foreign qualification must furnish the Department with an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Registrars will be required to rotate between the different institutions. Preference will be given to South African citizens. The performance of normal and commuted overtime is not mandatory, however it will be based on the operational needs of the hospitals. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process

af.title: Mediese Spesialis
af.summary: Mediese Spesialis in Oftalmologie by Leratong Hospital, wat HPCSA-registrasie vereis, met kliniese pligte wat katarakchirurgie en onderrig insluit.
af.requirements: Toepaslike mediese graad wat registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis toelaat. Graad 1: Geen ervaring vereis nie. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in 'n normale spesialiteit. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in 'n normale spesialiteit. Vermoë om 'n span junior en senior dokters te bestuur. Vermoë om uitstekende werksverhoudings met al die dissipline-panne op te bou. Goeie leierskapvaardighede, uitstekende kommunikasie (mondelinge en skriftelike) vaardighede, konflikoplossing en goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede. Die suksesvolle kandidaat moet aanpasbaar, gedissiplineerd en selfversekerd wees. Die kandidaat moet in staat wees om onafhanklik en onder druk te werk, buite normale werksure en met 'n diverse span te werk. Vermoë om in 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk. Kennis van wetgewing, beleide en prosedures rakende gesondheidsorggebruikers. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Ervaring in die openbare sektor sal 'n voordeel wees. Van die kandidaat sal verwag word om verskuilde oortyd te verrig.
af.duties: Kliniese bestuur van pasiënte in Algemene Oftalmologie/opnamekliniek asook 'n subspesialis-kliniek in óf Gloukoom, Mediese Retina of Pediatrese Oftalmologie. Chirurgie aan pasiënte met algemene oogklagtes en spesifiek die uitvoer en onderrig van katarakchirurgie. Kliniese onderrig van mediese beamptes in katarakbestuur en óf gloukoom, kornea of adneksale siektes. Koördineer alle kliniese en administratiewe pligte binne die departement. Betrokkenheid by hospitaalkomitees en skakeling met ander departemente binne die hospitaal. Personeelsonderig teoreties en vaardigheidsprestasie van junior dokters en verbonde mediese dissiplines by die hospitaal en verwysende hospitale. SOP-ontwikkeling en -implementering. Om navorsing relevant tot die Oftalmologie-departement deel te neem, te ondersteun en te bevorder. Vermoë om navorsing te inisieer en uit te voer sal 'n voordeel wees. Wees 'n rolmodel vir studente en personeel. Verrig pligte toegeken deur die Hoof van die Departement van Gesondheid. Handhaaf gehalteversekeringsstandaarde en ander departementele beleide. Vermindering van wagtyd van agterstande. Verseker effektiewe spesialisdienste om by te dra tot optimale en gehalte-gesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met die visie, missie en waardes van Gauteng department of health. Verseker nakoming van SOP's en kliniese protokolle. Toezig en effektiewe benutting van mediese personeel. Voldoen aan die Prestasiebestuurs- en Ontwikkelingstelsel (kontraktering, kwartaallikse hersienings en finale assessering). Verseker effektiewe uitreik na Distrikhospitale. Neem deel aan akademiese aktiwiteite in die hospitaal en in die tros. Volle deelname aan gehalteversekeringsprogramme, bestuur van PSI's en klagtes.

zu.title: Iqhawe Lemizwa
zu.summary: Iqhawe Lemizwa ku-Ophthalmology esibhedlela i-Leratong Hospital, kudingeka ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA, nemisebenzi yezokwelapho ehlanganisa ukuhlinzwa kweso elinesibindi namafundvo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zezokwelapha ezifanele ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengengcweti yezokwelapha. I-Grade 1: Akukho mkhankaso odingekayo. I-Grade 2: Okuncane kakhulu iminyaka engu-5 yamava afanele njengengcweti yezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengengcweti yezokwelapha enkundleni ejwayelekile. I-Grade 3: Okuncane kakhulu iminyaka engu-10 yamava afanele njengengcweti yezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengengcweti yezokwelapha enkundleni ejwayelekile. Ukukwazi ukuphatha iqembu labadokotela abasha nabadala. Ukukwazi ukwakha ubuhlobo obuhle bokusebenza namaphulo onke amaqembu. Amakhono okuba ngumholi wehle, amakhono ohlelo lokukhulumisana (olwalwe nolubhalwe) amakhelo, uxazululo lwezinkinga namakhono abantu abahle. Umuntu ohamba phambili kufanele azijwayeze, azibe yoluleko futhi azithembe. Umuntu kufanele akwazi ukusebenza eyedwa naphansi kokucindezelwa futhi ngaphezu kwamahora ajwayelekile okusebenza futhi asebenze neliqembu elihlukahlukene. Ukukwazi ukusebenza eqenjini elihlangene. Ukwazi ngemithetho, izinqobo nezinqubo ezihlobene nabasebenzisi bemigango yezempilo. Ulwazi lokusebenzela ikhompyutha. Ukube unamava emkhakheni kahulumeni kungaba lusizo. Umuntu uzofunwa ukuba azenze ngehora Emedo Egidikhulisayo Emanyuswe, isikhundla Esijwayelekile Esisetshenziselwe ukusebenza ngaphezu kwamahora.
zu.duties: Ezokuphatha ngokwelapha iziguli kwi-Ofisi eNtsulu jikelele yokuGenzwa/ noma oFisini leziguli kanye noFisi oluHlukile kolunye uGlaucoma, Medical Retina noma Ophthalmology yabantwana. Ukwenza Inselelo kubantu abanenkinga yamehlo njalo kukhombise ukwenza Inselelo yekhathara. Ukufundisa abantu abangangena emkhakheni wezokwelapha ngendlela yokuGenzwa Inselelo noma i-glaucoma, ukonakala kweso noma izifo eziHlobene. Ukulungisa yonke imisebenzi yokuGenzwa nokuBhalwa emkhakheni. Ukungena kwabakomidi behospitha nokuxhumana namanye amaphulo ahleli ehospitha. Ukwesekwa kokubhalwa nokuSetshenziswa kwe-SOP. Ukusebenza okuhlelwe emkhakheni kokuFunda nokutadisha okuhlobene ne-ophthalmology. Ukukwazi ukuHlanganisa nokuQamba imisebenzi yokuphathwa kwesikhathi eside kungaba lusizo.

xh.title: Igcisa lezonyobo
xh.summary: Igcisa lezonyobo kwi-Ophthalmology eLeratong Hospital, lifuna ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA, linemisebenzi yezempilo ehlanganisa usulelo lwe-cataract nokufundisa.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekileyo zonyubo ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengeGcisa leZonyobo. Inqanaba 1: Akukho naluphi na uluhlu lamava olufunekayo. Inqanaba 2: Uluhlu olungenangco lweminyaka eli-5 yamava afanelekileyo njengeGcisa leZonyobo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengeGcisa leZonyobo kwispeSialiti eqhelekileyo. Inqanaba 3: Uluhlu olungenangco lweminyaka eli-10 yamava afanelekileyo njengeGcisa leZonyobo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengeGcisa leZonyobo kwispeSialiti eqhelekileyo. Ikhono lokulawula iqela leengqkanga ezikwisikhundla esisezantsi nasephezulu. Ikhono lokwakha ubudlelwane obuhle bokusebenza namaqela onke amasebe. Ikhono elihle lokuba ngumkhokeli, ikhono elihle lokunxibelelwana (elithethwayo neliybhalwayo), ukuxazulula iingxabano nolunye ulwazi oluhle lokuhamba nabantu. Umjikelo ophumeleyo kufuneka akwazi ukuziqhelanisa, abe nolungelelwaniso aphatheke kakuhle anesiqiniseko sokuzithemba. Umjikelo kufuneka akwazi ukusebenza yedwa nangxweme ngxweme phantsi koxinzelelo nangaphandle kweeyure ezizezantsi ezamkelekileyo nasekusebenzeni nomaqela abahlukahlukeneyo. Ikhono lokusebenza kwiqela elinamasebe amaninzi. Ulwazi ngemithetho, iinkqubo namagama athengisa ngabasebenzisi bezempilo. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngakompyutha. Amava kwicandelo likawonke-wonke kuya kuba lusizo. Umjikelo kuya kuxelelwa ukuba aze aphure isikhathi sokuqhuba emva kweeyure.
xh.duties: Ukuphatha iziguli ngokwezonyobo kwi-General Ophthalmology/ iklinikhi yokwamkela kwaye naseklinikini yesaphetha ezikwiGlaucoma, Medical Retina okanye i-Ophthalmology yabantwana. Ukusebenza iziguli ezinezinkinga zamehlo ngokubanzi nokwenza ngokuthe ngqo nokufundisa usulelo lwe-cataract. Ukufundisa iziguli ezikwiklinikhi yamagosaonyubo ekuphathweni kwe-cataract nakweGlaucoma, cornea okanye izifo zomzimba osezantsi. Ukuqoqanisa onke imisebenzi yezonyobo nolawulo ngaphakathi kwisebe. Inxaxheba kumagosa esibhedlele nokuqhubana namanye amasebe angaphakathi kwesibhedlele. Ukuqeqesha abasebenzi ngokubuzo ngokubhalwayo namava okusebenza kumagosa amancinci namasebe amanyeonyubo esibhedlele nakumajikelo ibhedlele ecelelayo. Ukuphuhlisa nokusebenzisa iSOPs. Ukuthatha inxaxheba, ukuxhasa nokukhuthaza uphononongo oluhambelana nesebe le-Ophthalmology. Ikhono lokulungisa nokuphatha uphononongo kuya kuba lusizo. Ukuba ngumzekelo ongabafundi nabasebenzi. Ukwenza imisebenzi enikwe ngumntu ophethe iSebe loNyuso. Ukugcina ipeyisi ziso ezimngangokwenza ezinye iinkqubo zoMsebenzi. Ukunciphisa ixesha lolindela kwiBacklogs. Ukuqinisekisa iinkonzo ezithintelekileyo ukunceda ekufikeleleni kwezempilo ezilungelelwaniso nangokugqithisileyo ngokuhamba nemigaqo nokuqonda namanxibelelwano eGauteng department of health. Ukuqinisekisa ukulandelwa kweSOPs namaProtocols ezonyobo. Ukuqeqesha ukusebenza kwamagosaonyubo. Ukuzilandela nokuqinisekisa ukuqaliswa kolawulo ngokuphuhlisa inkqubo (ukubhidanisa, ukujonga kwamaxesha athile okuq1 nekuq2 nokuvavanya okugqibele). Ukuqinisekisa usetyenziso olusebenzayo olubuyela kwamajikelo esibhedlele eDistrict. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwimisebenzi yophando kwesibhedlele nakwiqlwadi. af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Spesialiteit Pnb1 (PSIGIATRIE)
af.summary: Professionele Verpleegkundige wat spesialiseer in Psigiatrie by Helen Joseph Tersiêre Hospitaal in Gauteng, wat SANC-registrasie en 'n na-basiese Psigiatrie-kwalifikasie vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. Diploma / Graad in Verpleegkunde) of 'n ekwivalente kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. Registrasie by SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. 'n Na-basiese verpleegkunde-kwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste een jaar, geakkrediteer by SANC in Psigiatrie. 'n Minimum van vier jaar se toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde.
af.duties: Toon begrip van verpleegkundige wetgewing en verwante regs- en etiese verpleegpraktyke. Werk as deel van die multidissiplinêre span om goeie verpleegsorg te verseker. Voer kliniese verpleging uit in ooreenstemming met die omvang van praktyk en verpleegstandaarde soos bepaal deur die gesondheidsfasiliteit. Bevorder gehalte van verpleegsorg soos gerig deur die professionele omvang van praktyk en standaarde soos bepaal deur die gesondheidsfasiliteit. Toon effektiewe kommunikasie met pasiënte, toesighouers en ander klinici, insluitend skryf van verslae wanneer vereis. Werk effektief, saamwerkend en vriendelik met mense van uiteenlopende intellektuele, kulturele, en rasse- of godsdienstige verskille. In staat om eie werk en dié van ondersteuningspersoneel te beplan en te organiseer om behoorlike verpleegsorg te verseker. Toon besorgdheid vir pasiënte, bevorder en pleit vir behoorlike behandeling en sorg insluitend bewustheid en bereidwilligheid om aan pasiënte se behoeftes, vereistes en verwagtinge te voldoen (Batho Pele-beginsels). Verskaf rigting en toesig vir die implementering van die verpleegsorgplan (kliniese praktyke / gehalte pasiëntsorg). Implementeer standaarde, praktyke, kriteria en aanwysers vir gehalte verpleging met die voorkoming van ernstige nadelige voorvalle. Beoefen verpleging en gesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met die wette en regulasies van toepassing op verpleging en gesondheidsorg. Onderhou 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met verpleging en ander belanghebbendes. Neem deel aan die ontwikkeling van protokolle en SOP's in die eenheid. Toon kennis oor die gebruik van mediese toerusting en beheer en herstel van sulke toerusting. Toon leierskap en toesighoudende vaardighede. Toon besluitneming- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Effektiewe benutting van materiaal en menslike hulpbronne. Vermoë om finansiële en begroting wat aan die departement toegewys is te bestuur. Toon effektiewe konflik- en klagtebestuursvaardighede. Nakoming van die Ideal Hospital Realization Framework. Vermoë om risiko's en pasiëntveiligheidsvoorvalle te identifiseer en dienooreenkomstig te bestuur. Voldoening aan PMDS- en CPD-vereistes. Verseker dat 'n veilige en terapeutiese omgewing vir pasiënte, personeel en publiek geskep word.

zu.title: Professional Nurse Specialty Pnb1 (PSYCHIATRY)
zu.summary: Professional Nurse ezesulele kwiPsychiatry e-Helen Joseph Tertiary Hospital eGauteng, edinga ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC nokuqinisekiswa kwemfundo eyisisekelo ePsychiatry.
zu.requirements: Isifinyezo se-Basic R425 (okungukuthi i-Diploma / i-Degree e-Nursing) noma sokuqinisekisa esivumela ukubhaliswa ku-SANC njengoba Professional Nurse. Ukubhaliswa ku-SANC njengoba Professional Nurse. Isiqinisekiso se-post-basic nursing semester esingaphezulu konyaka owodwa, esamukelekwe yi-SANC kwi-Psychiatry. Okungenani eminyaka emine yohlu oluqashisekayo / oluhlobene e-Nursing ngemuva kokubhaliswa njengo-Professional Nurse ku-SANC e-General Nursing.
zu.duties: Khombisa ukuqonda komthetho we-nursing kanye nemisebenzi edingekayo emthethweni nokuqothulwa. Sebenza njengengxenye yeqembu elihlukene kwezinkolelo ukunika isandla ekukhunjulweni okuhle. Yenza imisebenzi ye-nursing ngokuvumelana nesigaba semisebenzi nemigomo ye-nursing evunywe yi-facility. Khuthaza izinga lemisebenzi ye-nursing ngokuhambisana nesigaba semisebenzi semfundo nemitsetho evunywe yi-facility. Khombisa ukuxhumana okuhle nabaguli, abaphathi kanye nalabo abangenwe ngaphakathi kwemisebenzi yezempilo, okuhlanganisa nokubhala imibiko lapho kudingeka khona. Sebenza ngokusebenza kahle, ngokubambisana nangokuthandanisa nabantu abanemibono ehlukene, abanamasiko ahlukene, izinhlanga noma izinkolo ezahlukene. Kubalulekile ukuhlola futhi uhlele imisebenzi yakho kanye nabalawuli ukuze kuhlinzekwe ukunakekelwa okuhle. Khombisa ukukhathalela abaguli, ukukhuthaza futhi uwagcede ngokwelashwa nokunakekelwa okufanele okuhlanganise ukuzwisisa nokuzijwayeza ukuphendula izidingo, izidingo kanye nentengo yabantu (Imigomo ka-Batho Pele). Nikeza isiqondiso nokuqondisa ekusebenziseni i-nursing care plan (imisebenzi yesikhungo / ukunakekelwa kwabaguli okuhle). Hlela imitsetho, imikhuba, izinkomba kanye namagunya e-nursing okuhle ngokuvikela izenzakalo ezinkulu ezingadula empilweni. Yenza imisebenzi ye-nursing nezempilo ngokuvumelana nomthetho nemithetho ehambisana ne-nursing nezempilo. Londoloza ubudlelwano obuhle bomsebenzi nabasebenzi be-nursing nalabo abanomthelela. Ngena esikhundweni ekwakheni imithetho nemikhuba ekuthuthukisweni kwesikhungo. Khombisa ulwazi ekusebenziseni izinto zokwelapha kanye nokuqinisekiswa nokulungiswa kwalezo zinto. Khombisa amakhono okuba ngumholi kanye nokuba ngumphathi. Khombisa amakhono okuthatha izinqumo nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ukusebenzisa ngokuphelele izinto nabantu abasizekayo. Ukusebenzisa kahle imali nokulawula imali enikiwe umnyango. Khombisa amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga nezikhalazo. Ukulandela i-Framework ye-Ideal Hospital Realization. Ukukwazi ukuqaphela izengozi kanye nezinto ezingathinta ukuphila kwabaguli bese uzilawula ngokufanele. Ukulandela imitsetho ye-PMDS kanye nezidingo ze-CPD. Qinisekisa ukuthi abaguli, abasebenzi kanye nomphakathi basebenza endaweni ephephile ekwakhiwa ukuthuthukisa ukwelashwa.

xh.title: Inkonzo eNgeminye yokuBhalisa njaniSister ethile Pnb1 (I-PSYCHIATRY)
xh.summary: Inkonzo eNgeminye yokuBhalisa njaniSister ekugqithiseni kwiPsychiatry eHelen Joseph Tertiary Hospital eGauteng, ifuna ukubhalisa kwiSANC nelifikhaveyshini ye-post-basic yePsychiatry.
xh.requirements: Elona fikhaveyshini liBasic R425 (o.k.t. iDiploma / iDegree eNursing) okanye elilinganayo livumela ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengenkonzo eNgeminye yokuBhalisa njaniSister. Ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengenkonzo eNgeminye yokuBhalisa njaniSister. Ifikhaveyshini ye-post-basic nursing enalo ixesha elingezingaphi kwonyaka unye, evunyelwe yiSANC kwiPsychiatry. Okona kokubini kweminye emine yamava ahambelana nokuqatshwa kwinursing emva kokubhalisa njengenkonzo eNgeminye yokuBhalisa njaniSister kwiSANC kwiGeneral Nursing.
xh.duties: Bonisa ukuqonda ngomthetho wenursing nemithetho ehambelana nayo ethetha nokuqhelanisa okusemthethweni nakuzo nzima zenursing. Usebenze njengelinye iqela labasebenzi bezemithetho-yolwazi-lwemizi namagatya amaninji ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulunge lohlolo lwesigula. Yenza ulwazi lwenursing ngokwesabelo somsebenzi nemigangatho yenursing njengoko sigqithiswe sisebe sempilo. Phakamisa umgangatho olungileyo wolwazi lwenursing njengoko kuqwalaselwa isabelo somsebenzi samagatya kwaye emigangathweni njengoko sigqithiswe sisebe sempilo. Bonisa ukunxibelelana okusebenzayo nabagulayo, abalamuli nakwabanye ogqirha, kuquka nokuBhala iingxelo xa kufuneka. Usebenze ngokusebenzayo, ngokwabelanayo, ngokwamanyano nabantu abahluka ngokwengqondo, kwamasiko, nasemihla nangokwenkolo. Makakwazi ukucwangcisa nokuqamba umsebenzi wakhe nalawo abancedisayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulungiselelo olugqithiswe lwenursing. Bonisa inkathalo ngabagulayo, ngokukhuthaza nokubakhuthaza ukuba bafumane unyango olufanelekileyo nolulungileyo kuquka nokuziqonda nokulungele ukuhlangabezana neemfuno zomntu ongumguli, iimfuno namaxhala (iinkqubo zoBatho Pele). Zele iNdlela nomphathi wokuzalisekisa inkqubo yolwazi lwenursing (izilwelwane ezenywayo / ulunge olwethutywa kumguli). Zalise iinkqubo, iindlela ezenywayo, iziqendu neengqondo zobungakanani kwinursing ngokuthintela iiganeko ezibi ezingathungwa. Yenza ulwazi lwesigula nokuhlalwa kwempilo ngokwemithetho nemigangatho ehambelana nayo kwinursing nakuhlalwa kwempilo. Gcina uqhagamshelwano olwakhiwo lolwazi lwenursing namanye abathintekayo. Zibandakanye ekudalweni kweemithetho yolwazi kunye neSOPs kule candelo. Bonisa ulwazi ngokusetyenziswa kwezixhobo zonyango, nokulawula nokuqwalasela izixhobo eziNgokuzezona. Bonisa amandla okuba ngumlawuli nokuMlawula abanye. Bonisa ukuziqhelanisa neengxaki zeengxelo ezizululayo. Ukusebenzisa ngokusebenzayo amaxhoba abantu nemithi yamandla. Ukukwazi ukulawula imali nakuMvuzo onikelwe kwesebe. Bonisa ukuziqhelanisa neengxaki namaxhola ngokusebenzayo. Ukuzama ukuzingela ngokweIdeal Hospital Realization Framework. Ukukwazi ukubona iingozi neeganeko ezichukumisa ukhuseleko lomntu ongumguli kwaye ulawule ngokufanelekileyo. Ukuzinikela kwiPMDS nakuCPD iimfuno. Qinisekisa ukuba kukho indawo ekhuselekileyo nethambekileyo idalwe abagulayo, obasebenzi nabanantu.

Yenza ukunyatha kwezokwelapha ngokuvumelana nendawo yokusebenza kanye nezilinganiso zokunyatha njengoba kuncike isikhungo sezempilo. Khuthaza izinga elihle lokunakekelwa kokunyatha njengokuqondiswa isikhundla sezobungcweti sokusebenza kanye nezilinganiso njengoba kuncike isikhungo sezempilo. Khombisa unxibelelwano olusebenzayo nabeziguli, abaphathi kanye nabanye ochwepheshe bezokwelapha, kubandakanya ukubhala imibiko lapho kudingeka khona. Sebenza ngempumelelo, ngokubambisana nangobuhlalu nabantu abahlukene ngokwezinga lobuchwepheshe,amasiko, nobuhlanga noma izinkolo eziphikisayo. Ukuba nokwazi ukuhlela futhi uhlele umsebenzi wakho kanye nowabasekelayo ukugcina ukunakekelwa okufanele. Khombisa ukukhathazeka ngabeziguli, ukukhuthaza kanye nokwesekela ukwelashwa nokunakekelwa okufanele okubandakanya ukuqonda kanye nesifiso sokuphendula izidingo, izidingo nezethembaabeziguli (izimiso zeBatho Pele). Nikela isiqondiso kanye nokuqapha ukuze kuqashelwe uhlelo lokunakekelwa kokunyatha (izenzakalo zokwelapha / ukunakekelwa okuhle kweziguli). Qasha izilinganiso, izindlela zokwenza, izilinganiso kanye nezinkomba zokunakekelwa okulinganiselwe ukunakekelwa kokunyatha ngokuvikela izenzakalo ezibi ezibalulekile. Yenza ukunyatha kanye nenakekelwa lempilo ngokuvumelana nomthetho nemithetho elawula ukunyatha kanye nenakekelwa lempilo. Gcina ubudlelwano obwakhiwayo bokusebenza nabanye abanakekelayo kanye namanye abahlanganyeli. Sebenzisa ngempumelelo abantu kanye nezinsiza eziphathekayo. Phatha iPMDS labangaphansi kwakho. Kumele ukube nokwazi ukusebenza ngokushintshwa kanye nasezimeni ezingaba nomunyu. Gcina ukukhula / izimiso zokuziphatha ezobungcweti kanye nentuthuko yakho nalabangaphansi kwakho. Khombisa ulwazi ngeIdeal Hospital Realization Framework bese ukwazi ukuyisebenzisa. Ukuba nokwazi ukuzinikela njalo ezinyathelweni zokuvikela nokulawula izifo ezingathelekiswa. Ukuba nokwazi ukwakha futhi ugcine indawo ephephile. Ukuba nokwazi ukuhlola futhi uvimbele izengozi kuleso sikhungo.

xh.title: I nurse ezimeleyo egcina inqwaba (THEATRE) Pnb1
xh.summary: Kufuneka kubekho i nurse ezimeleyo egcina inqwaba e Helen Joseph Tertiary Hospital e Gauteng, kwaye kufuneka ibhaliswe kwi SANC kwaye ibe ne nqmngqangqo esemva kwesiseko eneminye ubuncinane iminyaka emine yamava okwazi ukusebenza njengesisebenzi sokunyanga.
xh.requirements: I nqmngqangqo esisiseko se R425 (okt. i Diploma / i Degree kwi Nursing) okt. nqmngqangqo efanayo evumela ubhaliso kwi SANC njengesisebenzi sesiprofeshini sokunyanga. Ubhaliso kwi SANC njengesisebenzi sesiprofeshini sokunyanga. I nqmngqangqo yokunyanga yesemva kwesiseko enentantlalo yonyaka omnye ubuncinane, evunyiwe yi SANC kwinqwaba echanekileyo. Ubuncinane beminyaka emine yamava afanelekileyo / aqaqableleyo ekunyangeni emva kokubhalisa njengesisebenzi sesiprofeshini sokunyanga kwi SANC kwi General Nursing. Ubuncinane unyaka omnye kwexesha elitshiwo ngasentla kufuneka abe ngamava afanelekileyo / aqaqableleyo okusebenza kwilcandelo le THEATRE, afumene inqmngqangqo yonyaka omnye yesemva kwesiseko kwinqwaba echanekileyo.
xh.duties: Bonisa ukuqonda kwemithetho yokunyanga nemithetho enxulumene nenyani neenkqubo zokunyanga. Sebendisa njengesiphuhlisi-mthetho emthethweni wokuchaneka ukulungela ukunakekelwa okulungileyo. Sebendisa imisebenzi yokunyanga ngokwemfuno ekudingekileyo kumthetho wokusebenza neendlela ezijulileyo ezinqunywe sisixeko esinika izigulane. Phucula ulungile lo nakekelwa lokunyanga njengoko kuqatshwe ngumthetho wokusebenza wezezimali neendlela ezijulileyo ezinqunywe sisixeko. Bonisa ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo nezigulana, iziphathi-magunya abaphezulu nabanye ogqitha bezesayensi, kuquka nokubhala iingxelo xa kufuneka. Sebendisa ngokuchanekileyo, ngokusebenzisana ngokulunga nabantu abavela kumkhakha ongakumbi. Hlela aze alungiselele umsebenzi wakhe nalawo abasebenzi abanika inkxaso ukugqiba ukulungela ukwamkela kwexesha elide. Bonisa inkathalo kwizigulana, ukulungela ukuze axhase inkqubo yokunyanga nokukhathalela ngokuchanekileyo, nokutshata iimpawu zentlalo kunye nokulungelelaniswa komthetho wezenkolo. Provide direction and supervision for the implementation of the nursing care plan (clinical practices / quality patient care). Implement standards, practices, criteria and indicators for quality nursing with the prevention of serious adverse events. Practice nursing and health care in accordance with the laws and regulations relevant to nursing and health care. Maintain a constructive working relationship with nursing and other stakeholders. Utilize human and physical resources efficiently. Manage PMDS of the subordinates. Must be able to work shifts and work under stressful conditions. Maintain professional growth / ethical standards and development of self and subordinates. Demonstrate knowledge of the Ideal Hospital Realization Framework and be able to implement it. Ability to always adhere to infection prevention and control measures. Ability to create and maintain a safe environment. Ability to identify and prevent risks in the unit.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Spesialiteit Pnb1 (ICU)
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige wat in ICU spesialiseer, word gesoek vir Helen Joseph Tertiary Hospital in Gauteng, met SANC-registrasie en 'n postbasiese kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike spesialiteit as vereistes.
af.requirements: 'n Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. Diploma / Graad in Verpleegkunde) of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. Registrasie by SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. 'n Postbasiese verpleegkundige kwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste een jaar, geakkrediteer by SANC in die tersaaklike spesialiteit. 'n Minimum van vier jaar toepaslike / herkenbare ondervinding in verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ten minste een jaar van die bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike / herkenbare ondervinding wees wat in die ICU-eenheid gewerk is, met die opdoen van die eenjaar-postbasiese kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike spesialiteit.
af.duties: Toon begrip van verpleegkundige wetgewing en verwante regs- en etiese verpleegpraktyke. Werk as deel van die multidissiplinêre span om goeie verpleegsorg te verseker. Voer kliniese verpleging uit ooreenkomstig die omvang van praktyk en verpleegstandaarde soos bepaal deur die gesondheidsfasiliteit. Bevorder die gehalte van verpleegsorg soos gerig deur die professionele omvang van praktyk en standaarde soos bepaal deur die gesondheidsfasiliteit. Toon doeltreffende kommunikasie met pasiënte, toesighouers en ander klinici, insluitend rapportering wanneer dit vereis word. Werk doeltreffend, samewerkend en vriendelik met mense van uiteenlopende intellektuele, kulturele, en rasse- of godsdiensverskille. In staat om eie werk en dié van ondersteuningspersoneel te beplan en te organiseer om behoorlike verpleegsorg te verseker. Toon besorgdheid vir pasiënte, bevorder en beywer vir behoorlike behandeling en sorg, insluitend bewustheid en bereidwilligheid om op pasiënte se behoeftes, vereistes en verwagtings te reageer (Batho Pele-beginsels). Verskaf rigting en toesig vir die implementering van die verpleegsorgplan (kliniese praktyke / gehalte-pasiëntsorg). Implementeer standaarde, praktyke, kriteria en aanwysers vir gehalteverpleging met die voorkoming van ernstige nadelige voorvalle. Beoefen verpleging en gesondheidsorg ooreenkomstig die wette en regulasies wat relevant is tot verpleging en gesondheidsorg. Onderhou 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met verpleegkundiges en ander belanghebbendes. Benut menslike en fisiese hulpbronne doeltreffend. Bestuur PMDS van ondergeskiktes. Moet in staat wees om skofte te werk en onder stresvolle toestande te werk. Onderhou professionele groei / etiese standaarde en ontwikkeling van self en ondergeskiktes. Toon kennis van die Ideal Hospital Realization Framework en wees in staat om dit te implementeer. Vermoë om altyd aan infeksievoorkoming en beheermaatreëls te voldoen. Vermoë om 'n veilige omgewing te skep en te handhaaf. Vermoë om risiko's in die eenheid te identifiseer en te voorkom.

zu.title: Unesi Ochwepheshe Ekhethiwe Pnb1 (ICU)
zu.summary: Kufunwa Unesi Ochube ngobuchwepheshe kwi-ICU esibhedlela i-Helen Joseph Tertiary eGauteng, kudingwa ukubhaliswa ku-SANC nefundo yesikhathi esingelesaba esikhundleni sobuchwepheshe ohambisanayo.
zu.requirements: Ifundo ye-Basic R425 (okunjengel Diploma / Degree eNursing) noma efana nayo evumela ukubhaliswa ku-SANC njengenesi Ochwepheshe. Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengenesi Ochwepheshe. Ifundo yesikhathi esingelesaba kwezokunhlengiza ngesikhathi esinganeminyaka engu-1 ubude, evunyiwe yi-SANC kuleyo ndawo yobuchwepheshe. Okungenani iminyaka emi-4 yohlelo / oluhlobene nokusebenza ezokwelapha ngemuva kokubhaliswa njengenesi Ochwepheshe kuyo i-SANC kwezokwelapha ngokuvamile. Okungenani unyaka owodwa kuleso sikhathi esikhunjulwe ngenhla kufanele ube yiso/uhlelo oluhlobene lokusebenza esigabeni se-ICU, uthole ifundo yesikhathi esingelesaba yonyaka owodwa kweso sikhundla sobuchwepheshe.
zu.duties: Khombisa ukuqonda komthetho wezokunhlengiza nomthetho ohambisana naye kanye nezokwelapha ezihambisana nomthetho nezimilo. Sebenza njengengxenye yeqembu elihlukene phakathi kwabangamabalwa ukuze kuqiniseke ukunakekelwa okuhle. Yenza ukunakekelwa ngekhanda ngokwesisindo sokwenza kanye namazinga okunhlengiza njengoba kumisiwe isikhungo sezempilo. Khuthaza izinga lenhlengizo njengoba kuhambisana nesisindo sokusebenza sobuchwepheshe namazinga njengoba kumisiwe isikhungo sezempilo. Khombisa ukuxhumana okusebenzayo neziguli, abaphathi kanye nabanye ochwepheshe bezokwelapha, okubandakanya ukubhala umbhalo lapho kudingwa khona. Sebenza ngokusebenzayo, ngokubambisana futhi ngokuzwana nabantu abehlukene ngokwengqondo, ngenhlalo, ngobuzwe noma ngenkolo. Yakha futhi uhlele umsebenzi wakho nalabo abakusekelayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa okuhle. Yisa intshisekelo ezigulini, ukukhuthaza nokukhuluma ukunakekelwa okuhle okubandakanya ukwazi nokuzikwazi ukuphendula izidingo, izifiso nezethemba leziguli (imigomo ye-Batho Pele). Nikeza isiqondiso nokuqondisa ukuze kusetshenziswe uhlelo lokunakekelwa kwezokunhlengiza (izinkambu zokwelapha / ukunakekelwa okuhle kweziguli). Sebenzisa amazinga, izinkambu, izilinganiso nezinkomba zokunhlengiza okuhle okuvikela kwezehla ezinzima ekwenzeni. Yenza izokunhlengiza kanye nempilo ngokuhambisana nomthetho nemithetho ehlobene nezokunhlengiza kanye nempilo. Gcina ubuhlobo obuhle bokusebenza nezokunhlengiza kanye nalabo abangenayo. Sebenzisa izinsizakalo ezindlini nezendalo ngokusebenziseka kahle. Phatha i-PMDS yalabo abakuphansi kwakho. Kufanele ukwazi ukusebenza izingamu futhi usebenze ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Gcina ukukhula ngobuchwepheshe / amazinga wokuziphatha kanye nenchubo yakho nalabo abakuphansi kwakho. Khombisa ulwazi nge-Ideal Hospital Realization Framework futhi ukwazi ukuyisebenzisa. Ukuzikwazi ukulandela ngaso sonke isikhathi izinkinga zokuvikela nokuthambisa ukutheleleka. Ukuzikwazi ukwakha futhi ulondoloze indawo ephephile. Ukuzikwazi ukuqaphula futhi uvikele izengozi esigabeni.

xh.title: Professional Nurse Specialty Pnb1 (ICU)
xh.summary: IProfessional Nurse ezibandakanya iICU efunwa sisiHelen Joseph Tertiary Hospital eGauteng, ifuna ukubhalisa kwiSANC nesifundo se-post-basic kwiprofeshane ethize.
xh.requirements: Isifundo seBASIC R425 (ooDiploma / iDegree eNursing) okanye isifundo esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengesiGulane eNurse eProfessional. Ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengesiGulane eNurse eProfessional. Isifundo se-post-basic nursing ngexesha elingangaphi kwenyanga enye, esamkelwe yiSANC kwiprofeshane ethile. Ukuqinisekiswa kweminye emine yamava afanelekileyo / aqhelekileyo ekunakeseleni emva kokubhalisa njengesiGulane eNurse eProfessional kwiSANC kwiGeneral Nursing. Ukuqinisekiswa kweminye yonyaka oyedwa kwexesha elidlulileyo kufuneka ibe yamava afanelekileyo / aqhelekileyo ekusebenzeni kwisiphimo seICU, kubandakanya ukufumana isifundo se-post-basic kwiprofeshane ethize.
xh.duties: Bonisa ukuqonda kwemithetho yokuhlola abasemzimbeni nendlela ezimizayo nezobugqila ekwenzeni imisebenzi yokuhlola abasemzimbeni. Sebenza njengenxalenye yeqela elisebenza ngokuhlangenwe hin kwemiSebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa okulungileyo. Yenza imisebenzi yokuhlola abasemzimbeni ngokwemigaqo yokwenza umsebenzi namazinga okuhlola njengoko kumiswe sisisi sezempilo. Khuthaza ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa njengoko kuphathe yimigaqo yobugcisa namazinga njengoko kumiswe sisisi sezempilo. Bonisa unxibelelwano olusebenzayo nabaguli, ababalindi nakwezinye izigulane, kuquka nokubhala iingxelo xa kufuneka. Sebenza ngokusebenzayo, ngokwabelana ngemisebenzi ngokubambisana nabantu abahlukene ngentetho, ngenkcubeko, ngerhini okanye inkolo. Kwanakho ukucwangcisa nokulungisa umsebenzi wakhe nocaluloabalindiyo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa okulungileyo. Bonisa inkathalo ngabaguli, ukukhuthaza nokukhusela ukunakekelwa okulungileyo okuquka ukuqaphela nokulungele ukuphendula iimfuno, iimfuno nentembezelo yabaguli (iimigaqo yeBatho Pele). Nikela iindlela nolawulo ekuphumezeni icebo lokunakekelwa (iinkqubo zokusesikweni / ukunakekelwa kwabaguli kwikhwalithi). Zisa kumsebenzi amazinga, iinkqubo, iindlela nezalathiso zokunakekelwa kwabaguli ngokukhusela ukwenzakala okumandla. Yenza umsebenzi wokuhlola abasemzimbeni nokunakekelwa kwempilo ngokwemithetho nemigaqo ehambelana nokuhlola abasemzimbeni nempilo. Gcina unxibelelwano olwakho olusembakweni nabahloli nakwabanye abanikwe babelo. Sebenzisa imithombo yabantu nendalo ngokusebenzayo. Lawula iPMDS yabangaphansi kuye. Kufuneka akwazi ukusebenza ngokutshintshwa kweeshifuthi nakwiimeko ezinxulumene nosizi. Gcina ukukhula / amazinga obugcisa nokuziphilisa kwakhe nakwabangaphansi kuye. Bonisa ulwazi ngeIdeal Hospital Realization Framework akwaze nakho ukuyisebenzisa. Ukuhlala nakho ukuzinikela kwizigqibo zokuthintela usuleleko nolawulo. Ikhono lokuyila nokugcina indawo ekhuselekileyo. Ikhono lokuchonga nokuthintela iingozi kwisiphimo.
