af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Spesialiteit Pnb1 (ORTOPEDIES)
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige wat in ortopedie spesialiseer, word gesoek vir Helen Joseph Tertiêre Hospitaal in Gauteng, wat SANC-registrasie en 'n na-basiese kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike spesialiteit vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. Diploma / Graad in Verpleegkunde) of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. Registrasie by SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. 'n Na-basiese verpleegkwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste een jaar, geakkrediteer by SANC in die tersaaklike spesialiteit. 'n Minimum van vier jaar toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste een jaar van die bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring wees terwyl daar in die Ortopediese eenheid gewerk word, met die opdoen van die eenjarige na-basiese kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike spesialiteit.
af.duties: Toon begrip van verpleegwetgewing en verwante wetlike en etiese verpleegpraktyke. Werk as deel van die multidissiplinêre span om goeie verpleegsorg te verseker. Voer kliniese verpleging uit ooreenkomstig die omvang van praktyk en verpleegstandaarde soos deur die gesondheidsfasiliteit bepaal. Bevorder kwaliteit van verpleegsorg soos gerig deur die professionele omvang van praktyk en standaarde soos deur die gesondheidsfasiliteit bepaal. Toon doeltreffende kommunikasie met pasiënte, toesighouers en ander klinici, insluitend die skryf van verslae wanneer vereis. Werk doeltreffend, saamwerkend en vriendelik met mense van uiteenlopende intellektuele, kulturele en rasse- of godsdiensteverskille. In staat om eie werk en dié van ondersteuningspersoneel te beplan en te organiseer om behoorlike verpleegsorg te verseker. Toon besorgdheid oor pasiënte, bevorder en pleit vir behoorlike behandeling en sorg, insluitend bewustheid en bereidwilligheid om op pasiënte se behoeftes, vereistes en verwagtings te reageer (Batho Pele-beginsels). Verskaf rigting en toesig vir die implementering van die verpleegsorgplan (kliniese praktyke / kwaliteit pasiëntsorg). Implementeer standaarde, praktyke, kriteria en aanwysers vir gehalteverpleging met die voorkoming van ernstige nadelige voorvalle. Beoefen verpleging en gesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met die wette en regulasies wat op verpleging en gesondheidsorg van toepassing is. Handhaaf 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met verpleging en ander belanghebbendes. Benut menslike en fisiese hulpbronne doeltreffend. Bestuur PMDS van ondergeskiktes. Moet in staat wees om skofte te werk en onder stresvolle toestande te werk. Handhaaf professionele groei / etiese standaarde en ontwikkeling van self en ondergeskiktes. Toon kennis van die Ideal Hospital Realization Framework en wees in staat om dit te implementeer. Vermoë om altyd aan infeksievoorkoming en -beheermaatreëls te voldoen. Vermoë om 'n veilige omgewing te skep en te handhaaf. Vermoë om risiko's in die eenheid te identifiseer en te voorkom.

zu.title: Uchwepeshe Bokesibhedlela Obheke Kakhulu Pnb1 (ORTHOPAEDIC)
zu.summary: Kufunwa uchwepeshe bokesibhedlela obheke kakhulu ohlobene nephediatriki ongumsebenzi we-Helen Joseph Tertiary Hospital o-Gauteng, ofuna ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC kanye nesidanga sokufunda okuhlobene nalokhu.
zu.requirements: Isidanga se-Basic R425 (okungukuthi Diploma / Degree e-Nursing) noma isidanga esingaso ngokulingana esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengogogwane ochwepeshe. Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengogogwane ochwepeshe. Isidanga sokwesobala kumsebenzi wezokwelapha isikhathi esingasenani unyaka owodwa, esamukelekwe yi-SANC esimweni esihambisana nemisebenzi yonke. Okungenani iminyaka emine yokuhlakanipha okuhambisana / okubonakalayo kumsebenzi wezokwelapha ngemva kokubhaliswa njengogogwane ochwepeshe kwi-SANC ngemisebenzi yonke yezokwelapha. Okungenani unyaka owodwa kwesikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kufanele ukube ukuhlakanipha okuhambisana / okubonakalayo kokusebenza e-Ward yamathambo, uthole isidanga sokwesobala kwisikhathi senyaka owodwa esimweni esihambisana nomsebenzi.
zu.duties: Bonisa ukuqonda komthetho wezokunyanga kanye nomthetho ohlobene nokuziphatha okuhle kwemisebenzi yokunyanga. Sebenza njengengxenye yeqembu elidingidwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunyanywa kahle. Yenza imisebenzi yokunyanga ngokuhambisana nomkhakha wokusebenza kanye nemigomo yokunyanga njengoba kucaciswe isibhedlela. Khuthaza izinga lemisebenzi yokunyanga njengokuqondiswa ngumkhakha ochwepeshe wokusebenza kanye namazinga njengoba kucaciswe isibhedlela. Bonisa ukuxhumana okusebenzayo nabagulayo, abaqondisi kanye nabanye ochwepeshe, okuhlanganisa nokubhala imibiko uma kudingeka. Sebenza ngokusebenzayo, ngokubambisene ngokwengqondo nabantu abahlukene ngokwezinkomfa,amasiko, futhi ngenhlalo noma inkolo ezihlukene. Ukwazi ukuhlela futhi uhle umsebenzi wakho nakwabasekelayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunyanywa kahle. Bonisa ukukhathazeka ngabagulayo, ukukhuthaza nokugqugquzela ukwelapha nokunakekela okuhle okuhlanganisa ukuqonda futhi nokuzimisela ukuphendula kwiimfuno zabagulayo, izidingo kanye nentsebenziso (Iimvisiso ze-Batho Pele). Nikeza isiqondiso kanye nokuqondisa ukuphethwa kohlelo lokunyanya (imisebenzi yokunyanya / ukunakekelwa kwesiguli esimweni esihle). Zisebenzisa imigomo, imisebenzi, okulinganisiwe kanye neziphawuli zokunyanya kahle ngokunqandela okubi okubalulekile. Yenza imisebenzi yokunyanya kanye nokuqashwa kwempilo ngokuhambisana nomthetho kanye nemithetho ehlobene nokunyanya nokunakekelwa kwempilo. Gcina ubudlelwano obuhle bokusebenza nabanye ochwepeshe kanye nalabo abahlangene nomyango. Sebenzisa ngokusebenzayo izinsiza zomzimba nabantu. Phatha i-PMDS yabasebenzisi abangaphansi kwakho. Kufanele ukwazi ukusebenza ngokujwayelekile futhi usebenze ngaphansi kwezimo ezinengqondo. Gcina ukukhula / amazinga okuziphatha ochwepeshe kanye nentuthuko yakho kanye nabasebenzisi abangaphansi kwakho. Bonisa ukuqonda nge-Ideal Hospital Realization Framework futhi ukwazi ukuyisebenzisa. Ukuzimisela ukulandela njalo izinyathelo zokunqanda ukutheleleka nokulawula. Ukuzimisela ukudala futhi ugcine isimo ephephile. Ukuzimisela ukubona futhi unqande ubungozi e-Ward.

xh.title: Ummeli weGazi oNgcali eNqanaba loku-1 (ORTHOPAEDIC)
xh.summary: Kufunekiwo ummeli wegazi ongcali kwindawo ye-orthopaedics kwi-Helen Joseph Tertiary Hospital eGauteng, kwaye kufuneka abhaliswe kwi-SANC ane-m qualification ye-post-basic kwindawo alubhekileyo.
xh.requirements: I-m qualification ye-Basic R425 (oko kukuthi i-Diploma / i-Degree kwi-Nursing) okanye i-m qualification ebalulekileyo evumela ubhaliso kwi-SANC njengomMmeli weGazi. Ubhaliso kwi-SANC njengomMmeli weGazi. I-m qualification ye-post-basic nursing ngesixa sonyaka osingaphantsi kwonyaka, evunyiwe yi-SANC kwindawo alubhekileyo. Iminyaka emine okanye ngaphezulu yamava aqondileyo / avakalisiweyo kwinkalo yamagazi emva kokubhalisa njengomMmeli weGazi kwi-SANC kwi-General Nursing. Ubuncinane nyaka omnye wexesha elidweliswe ngasentla kufuneka abe ngamava aqondileyo / avakalisiweyo asebenza kwindawo ye-Orthopaedic, afumana i-m qualification ye-post-basic yonyaka kwindawo alubhekileyo.
xh.duties: Bonisa ukuqonda kwemithetho yamagazi nendlela ezimalene nayo yolimo lolwapolitiko neqondo lezinto ezimalene namagazi. Sebenza njengesinye sejroma elinamacandla amaninzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukhathalo oluhle lwamagazi. Zenza inkalo yamagazi ngokwesixa sokusebenza nezinga lemigangatho njengoko ibekiwe yindawo yempilo. Khuthaza izinga loku khathalela kwamagazi njengoko kumiselwa bubude besebenzi bokulunga neemithetho njengoko ibekiwe yindawo yempilo. Bonisa unxibelelwano olusebenzayo nabagulayo, abalawuli nabalawuli benkalo yezempilo abanye, kuquka nokubhala iiripoti xa kudingeka. Sebenza ngokusebenzayo, ngokuthungathelana nokuzola nabantu abahlukene ngokwengqondo, inkcubeko, uhlanga okanye inkolo. Makakwazi ukucwangcisa nokulungelelanisa umsebenzi wakhe nolawuli abasebenzayo naye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukhathalo oluhle lwamagazi. Bonisa ingcamla ngabagulayo, ukukhuthaza nokukhusela ukwelashwa nokukhathalelwa ngokuchanekileyo kuquka nokuqonda nokuzimisela ukuphendula iimfuno, iimfuno nemiqobo yabagulayo (imigangatho ye-Batho Pele). Nikela iindlela nokulawula ukusebenza kwecwangciso lokukhathalela amagazi (izinto ezisenziwa / ukhathalo oluhle lwesiguli). Zisebenzisa imigangatho, iindlela, iindawo nemiboniso yoluntu oluhle lwamagazi ngokuthintela iziganeko ezibi kakhulu. Zisebenzisa amagazi nolonwabo lwempilo ngokomthetho neendlela ezimalene namagazi nolonwabo lwempilo. Phatha uludwe lokusebenza olwakhiweyo kwingcali yamagazi nolunye uluntu. Sebenzisa ngokuchanekileyo abantu neempahla ezithileyo. Lawula i-PMDS yalabo abangaphantsi kwakhe. Kufuneka akwazi ukusebenza ngokutshintsha ishedi nokusebenza iimeko ezinzima. Zigcine inkalo yoluntu nokukhula koluntu / imigangatho yeqondo nophuhliso lwakhe nalabo abangaphantsi kwakhe. Bonisa ulwazi ngesakhiwo se-Ideal Hospital Realization Framework nokuba nakho ukusisebenzisa. Ikhono lokuwohloka ngamaxesha onke kumanyathelo okuthintela ukungalungi nokulawula. Ikhono lokudala nolondoloza indawo ekhuselekileyo. Ikhono lokuchonga nokuthintela iingozi kwicandlo.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Specialty Pnb1 (RENAL)
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse specialised in renal care sought for Helen Joseph Tertiary Hospital in Gauteng, requiring SANC registration and a post-basic qualification in the relevant speciality.
jobs.requirements: A Basic R425 qualification (i.e. Diploma / Degree in Nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse. Registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse. A post-basic nursing qualification with duration of at least one year, accredited with SANC in the relevant speciality. A minimum of four years appropriate / recognisable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least one year of the period referred to above must be appropriate / recognisable experience working in the Renal unit, obtaining the one-year post-basic qualification in the relevant speciality.
jobs.duties: Demonstrate an understanding of nursing legislation and related legal and ethical nursing practices. Work as part of the multidisciplinary team to ensure good nursing care. Perform clinical nursing in accordance with the scope of practice and nursing standards as determined by the health facility. Promote quality of nursing care as directed by the professional scope of practice and standards as determined by the health facility. Demonstrate effective communication with patients, supervisors and other clinicians, including report writing when required. Work effectively, co-operatively and amicably with people of diverse intellectual, cultural, and racial or religious differences. Able to plan and organise own work and that of support personnel to ensure proper nursing care. Display a concern for patients, promoting and advocating proper treatment and care including awareness and willingness to respond to patients needs, requirements and expectations (Batho Pele principles). Provide direction and supervision for the implementation of the nursing care plan (clinical practices / quality patient care). Implement standards, practices, criteria and indicators for quality nursing with the prevention of serious adverse events. Practice nursing and health care in accordance with the laws and regulations relevant to nursing and health care. Maintain a constructive working relationship with nursing and other stakeholders. Utilize human and physical resources efficiently. Manage PMDS of the subordinates. Must be able to work shifts and work under stressful conditions. Maintain professional growth / ethical standards and development of self and subordinates. Demonstrate knowledge of the Ideal Hospital Realization Framework and be able to implement it. Ability to always adhere to infection prevention and control measures. Ability to create and maintain a safe environment. Ability to identify and prevent risks in the unit.

zu.title: Usesheli Ohlonishwayo Wezokwelapha Esikhundleni Esikhethekile Pnb1 (RENAL)
zu.summary: Kufunwa uSesheli Ohlonishwayo Wezokwelapha oqeqeshelwe ukunakekelwa kwezinpopomponyane ku Helen Joseph Tertiary Hospital eGauteng, okudinga ukubhalisa ku-SANC nefundo yasemva kwesisekelo esimkhakheni oqeqeshelwe kona.
zu.requirements: Ifundo evela ku-Basic R425 (okuyi-Diploma / Degree kwi-Nursing) noma esinye isifundo esilingana lesi esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengoSesheli Ohlonishwayo Wezokwelapha. Ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengoSesheli Ohlonishwayo Wezokwelapha. Isifundo sezokwelapha esingezansi kwesisekelo esithatha isikhathi esingan funder ngonyaka owodwa, esigunyaziwe yi-SANC emkhakheni oqeqeshelwe kona. Okungenani iminyaka emine yokuhlangabezela noma okubonakalayo kwezokwelapha ngemva kokubhalisa njengoSesheli Ohlonishwayo Wezokwelapha kwi-SANC kwi-General Nursing. Okungenani unyaka owodwa kwesikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele kube ukuhlangabezela okufanele noma okubonakalayo kusebenza kwisikhungo se-Renal, uthole isifundo sezinyanga zonyaka esingezansi kwesisekelo emkhakheni oqeqeshelwe kona.
zu.duties: Khombisa ukuqonda kwemithetho ezokwelapha kanye nemisebenzi ehlobene nomthetho nezokuziphatha kwezokwelapha. Sebenza njengengxenye yeqembu elinabasebenzi abaningi ngamakhono ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa okuhle kwezokwelapha. Yenza izokwelapha zesikhathi sezempilo ngokuhambisana nesibonakaliso somsebenzi nezindinganiso zezokwelapha njengokuqunywe yisikhungo sempilo. Khuthaza izinga elihle lokunakekelwa kwezokwelapha njengokuqondiswa isibonakaliso somsebenzi ohlonishwayo nezindinganiso njengokuqunywe yisikhungo sempilo. Khombisa ukuxhumana okusebenzayo nabagulayo, abaphathi kanye nabanye abaqeqeshi bezempilo, okuhlanganise nokubhala imibiko uma kudingeka. Sebenza ngokusebenzayo, ngokubambisana ngokuhle nomusa nabantu abahlukene ngokwengqondo,amasiko,noma izinkolo ehlukene. Ukuba nakho ukucubungula futhi uhlele umsebenzi wakho kanye nowabasebenzi abakusizayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa okufanele kwezokwelapha. Khombisa ukukhathalela ngabagulayo,ukukhuthaza nokuvikela ukwelashwa nokunakekelwa okufanele okuhlanganise nokuba sengatadikazi nokuba nakho ukuphendula izidingo,izicelo nezethemba zabagulayo (Izimiso ze-Batho Pele). Nikeza isiqondiso nokuqondisa ukuze kusetshenziswe uhlelo lokunakekelwa kwezokwelapha (izenzakalo zesikhathi sezempilo / ukunakekelwa okuhle kwesiguli). Zenza izokwelapha nezempilo ngokuhambisana nemithetho nemitshwayo ehlobene nezokwelapha nezempilo. Gcina ubudlelwano obuhle bokusebenza nezokwelapha kanye nabanye abahlotshaniswe nabo. Sebenzisa amabhodi abantu nezinsiza eziphilayo ngokusebenzayo. Phatha i-PMDS yabangaphansi kwakho. Kumele ukhone ukusebenza ngamashifthi futhi usebenze ngaphansi kwezimo ezibucayi. Ulwazi olungaqondiyo / olusayekileyo kwimisebenzi yokongeza emva kokubhaliswa njengomongikazi oGqibeleleyo kwiSANC kwiGeneral Nursing ubuncinane kweminyaka emine. Ubuncinane unyaka omnye kwexeshana elidweliswe ngasentla kufuneka ulwazi olungaqondiyo / olusayekileyo lokusebenza kwilabo yolungiselelo lwegazi, ube nomgama wokuba nefa lemfundo lonyaka oluqhubela phambili kwelona ntdaka lichanekileyo.
xh.duties: Bonisa ukuqonda komthetho wokongeza nemithetho yokuqhelekileyo ethathwa njengenqobo ekwenziweni kokongeza. Sebenza njengesinye isahlulelo seqembu elinabantu abanobuchule obuhlukeneyo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukhatho oluhle lweziguli. Wenze imisebenzi yokongeza ngokwegazi olungiselelweyo ngokwemimiselo yokwakha nokomeleza inqanaba elipheleleyo lokongeza njengoko kuqatshulwa yindlu yempilo. Khuthaza inqanaba eliphezulu lwekhatho lokongeza njengoko kuyalelwa ngumthetho weGazi olungiselelweyo nemigangatho njengoko kuqatshulwa yindlu yempilo. Bonisa ukunyaniseka ekuphathweni kwakho ngokuchanekileyo kweziguli, oziphatha ngokutsha kwangokwakho, kwaye wakha iingcali ezizezinye, kuquka nokubhala iingexelo xa kufuneka. Sebenza ngokusebenza kakuhle, ngokutsha kwabantu abaqondwayo kunye nabantu abahlukene ngokwemfundiso yocandilelwano, masiko, nokholo lwegazi elahlukeneyo. Wazi ukuqamba uluhlu lokusebenza kwakho nalokwabantu abakuxhasayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukhatho oluhle lokongeza. Bonisa inkathalo kweziguli, ukuzithanda nokukhuthaza ukunyanga nokhatho oluhle, kubandakanya ukuqonda nokuzithanda ukuphendula kwiimfuno, iimfuno nolindileyo lweziguli (iimvisiswano zikaBatho Pele). Nikela ngendlela nolawulo ekusebenzeni koluhlu lokhatho (iinkqubo zokwakha / ukhatho oluhle lweziguli). Zisebenzise imigangatho, iinkqubo, iindlela nezalathiso zokuqinisekisa inqanaba elihle lokongeza ukuyibuyisa ekubeni kubangele iingozi ezinkulu. Sebenza ngokongeza nempilo ngokomthetho nemithetho elandelwa ekusebenzeni kokongeza nempilo. Gcina ubudlelwane obuzoqonda ekusebenzeni ngokongeza kunye nabanye abathintekayo. Sebenzisa abantu nemicimbi yendalo ngokusebenza kakuhle. Lawula iPMDS yabalawulelwabo. Kufuneka ulunjwe wasebenza ngokutshintsha kweeshedule, wasebenza kwiimeko ezinkcaptsholo. Gcina ukukhula kweGazi / imigangatho yokutsha kwakho nakulawulelwabo. Bonisa ukuqonda kwesakhono esimnyama seGazi sokusebenza kakuhle kwiHospital esekelwe kumgangatho wezempilo ekubeni nayo indlela yokuyisebenzisa. Wazi ukuzinikela ngenyamezelo ekusebenzeni kokubonelela ngokuchanekileyo nokulawula iingozi. Wazi ukuyila nokuyithintela iingozi kwilabo.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Specialty Pnb1 Trauma
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse (Specialty PNB1 Trauma) position at Helen Joseph Tertiary Hospital in Gauteng, requiring SANC registration and a post-basic qualification in trauma nursing.
jobs.requirements: A Basic R425 qualification (i.e. Diploma / Degree in Nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse. Registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse. A post-basic nursing qualification with duration of at least one year, accredited with SANC in the relevant speciality. A minimum of four years appropriate / recognisable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least one year of the period referred to above must be appropriate / recognisable experience working in the Trauma unit, obtaining the one-year post-basic qualification in the relevant speciality.
jobs.duties: Demonstrate an understanding of nursing legislation and related legal and ethical nursing practices. Work as part of the multidisciplinary team to ensure good nursing care. Perform clinical nursing in accordance with the scope of practice and nursing standards as determined by the health facility. Promote quality of nursing care as directed by the professional scope of practice and standards as determined by the health facility. Demonstrate effective communication with patients, supervisors and other clinicians, including report writing when required. Work effectively, co-operatively and amicably with people of diverse intellectual, cultural, and racial or religious differences. Able to plan and organise own work and that of support personnel to ensure proper nursing care. Display a concern for patients, promoting and advocating proper treatment and care including awareness and willingness to respond to patients needs, requirements and expectations (Batho Pele principles). Provide direction and supervision for the implementation of the nursing care plan (clinical practices / quality patient care). Implement standards, practices, criteria and indicators for quality nursing with the prevention of serious adverse events. Practice nursing and health care in accordance with the laws and regulations relevant to nursing and health care. Maintain a constructive working relationship with nursing and other stakeholders. Utilize human and physical resources efficiently. Manage PMDS of the subordinates. Must be able to work shifts and work under stressful conditions. Maintain professional growth / ethical standards and development of self and subordinates. Demonstrate knowledge of the Ideal Hospital Realization Framework and be able to implement it. Ability to always adhere to infection prevention and control measures. Ability to create and maintain a safe environment. Ability to identify and prevent risks in the unit.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Spesialiteit Pnb1 Trauma
af.summary: Professionele Verpleegkundige (Spesialiteit PNB1 Trauma) pos by Helen Joseph Tertiary Hospital in Gauteng, wat SANC-registrasie en 'n na-basiese kwalifikasie in traumaverpleging vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. Diploma / Graad in Verpleging) of 'n ekwivalente kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. Registrasie by SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. 'n Na-basiese verpleegkwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste een jaar, geakrediteer by SANC in die tersaaklike spesialiteit. 'n Minimum van vier jaar gepaste / erkenningbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste een jaar van die bogenoemde periode moet gepaste / erkenningbare ervaring wees terwyl gewerk word in die Trauma-eenheid, met die opdoen van die eenjarige na-basiese kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike spesialiteit.
af.duties: Toon begrip van verpleegwetgewer en verwante regs- en etiese verpleegpraktyke. Werk as deel van die multidissiplinêre span om goeie verpleegsorg te verseker. Voer kliniese verpleging uit ooreenkomstig die omvang van praktyk en verpleegstandaarde soos deur die gesondheidsfasiliteit bepaal. Bevorder gehalte van verpleegsorg soos gerig deur die professionele omvang van praktyk en standaarde soos deur die gesondheidsfasiliteit bepaal. Toon effektiewe kommunikasie met pasiënte, toesighouers en ander klinici, insluitend verslagskrywing wanneer vereis. Werk effektief, saamwerkend en vreedsaam met mense van uiteenlopende intellektuele, kulturele, en rasse- of godsdiensverskille. In staat om eie werk en dié van ondersteuningspersoneel te beplan en te organiseer om behoorlike verpleegsorg te verseker. Toon besorgdheid vir pasiënte, bevorder en pleit behoorlike behandeling en sorg, insluitend bewustheid en bereidwilligheid om op pasiënte se behoeftes, vereistes en verwagtinge te reageer (Batho Pele-beginsels). Gee rigting en toesig vir die implementering van die verpleegsorgplan (kliniese praktyke / gehalte pasiëntsorg). Implementeer standaarde, praktyke, kriteria en aanwysers vir gehalteverpleging met die voorkoming van ernstige nadelige voorvalle. Beoefen verpleging en gesondheidsorg ooreenkomstig die wette en regulasies relevant tot verpleging en gesondheidsorg. Handhaaf 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met verpleging en ander belanghebbendes. Benut menslike en fisiese hulpbronne doeltreffend. Bestuur PMDS van ondergeskiktes. Moet in staat wees om skofte te werk en onder stresvolle toestande te werk. Handhaaf professionele groei / etiese standaarde en ontwikkeling van self en ondergeskiktes. Toon kennis van die Ideal Hospital Realization Framework en wees in staat om dit te implementeer. Vermoe om altyd aan infeksievoorkoming en -beheermaatreëls te voldoen. Vermoe om 'n veilige omgewing te skep en te handhaaf. Vermoe om risiko's in die eenheid te identifiseer en te voorkom.

zu.title: Umongikazi Ochwepheshe Obhekene Nokuqothula Umzimba Pnb1
zu.summary: Isikhundla somongikazi ochwepheshe (obhekene kuqothula umzimba PNB1) esibhedlela iHelen Joseph Tertiary Hospital egxalabeni iGauteng, esidinga ukubhalisa ku-SANC nokuqeqeshelwa okuthuthukileyo ekunakekelweni kwabaguli bakantu bahlolwa.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezisesimagazini ze-Basic R425 (okt. iziqu / izidanga ezenza umsebenzi ekunakeni abaguli) noma iziqu ezilingana okuvumela ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengomongikazi ochwepheshe. Ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengomongikazi ochwepheshe. Iziqu zokunakekela abaguli ezingaphezu kwesikhathi esifundwe isikhathi esingavunyelwa kwi-SANC ekunakekeni okuthize. Kufanele kube nokuhlangenwe nakho okuncane isikhathi esingamaphakade amane ngemva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi ochwepheshe ku-SANC ekunakekelweni kwamagqabantfu. Kufunke apho angaphela kwesikhathi esingunyaka owodwa uhlangabezane nokuhlangenwe nakho okubalulekileyo ekugcineni isikhathi esisodwa ekubhekeni ukunakekelwa kwabaguli, ukufumana iziqu ezifanelekileyo ekunakekeni abaguli.
zu.duties: Bonisa ukuqonda kwezimitsetmo esenemigqiba kwezomthetho nokwenza umsebenzi ngokulandela imithetho nemigqibo efanelekileyo ekunakekeni abaguli. Sebenza njengelinye iqembu abantu abangenzi umsebenzi ohlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa okuhle kwabaguli. Yenza ukunakekela abaguli ngokulandela imigqiba nemithetho yokunakekela abaguli njengoba kuchazwe isibhedlela. Khuthaza izinga elikhulu lokunakekelwa kubaguli njengoba kuhlaqwiziwe ngomsebenzi ochwepheshe nemigqiba njengoba kuchaziwe isibhedlela. Bonisa ukusebenzisana okusebenzayo kubaguli, abaphathi nabanye osohunyaphililo, kubandakanya ukubhala imibiko uma kudingeka. Sebenza ngokusebenzayo, ngokubambana nenjongo entle nabantu abanohlakahlisba oluhlukeneyo,amasiko, kanye nobuhlanga noma inkolo. Kufanele akwazi ukucubungula futhi ahlale emhlabeni umsebenzi wakhe nalabo abamsiza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa okuhle kwabaguli. Bonisa ukukhathalela abaguli, ukukhuthaza nokuphikisela ukwelashwa nokunakekelwa okufanele, okubandakanya ukuqonda nokuzithoba ukuphendula izidingo, izicelo kanye nezenzo zabaguli (Imigqiba yeBatho Pele). Nikeza isiqondiso nokubasela ekwenzeni ipulani lokunakekelwa kwabaguli (izinto ezisetshenziswa ekunakekeni / ukunakekelwa kwabaguli okuhle). Hlela imigqiba, izenzo, izibalo nemikhomba ekunakekeni okuhle kwabaguli nokuvikela izehlo ezinkulu. Yenza umsebenzi wakunakekelwa abaguli nezempilo ngokulandela imithetho nemithetho ehlobene nokunakekela abagulu nezempilo. Gcina ubudlelwano obuhle bokusebenza nabongikazi nabanye abantu. Sebenzisa abantu kanye nempahla ngokusebenzayo. Lawula i-PMDS yalabo abakusebenzela. Kufanele akwazi ukusebenza kumashifu futhi athathe umhlaba ngaphezulu. Gcina ukukhula komsebenzi / imigqiba yokuziphatha kanye nentuthuko yakhe nalabo abamisebenzela. Bonisa ukuqonda i-Ideal Hospital Realization Framework futhi akwazi ukuyisebenzisa. Kufanele ahlonitsha njalo izigaba ezivikela ukutheleleka nokulawula ukutheleleka. Kufanele akwazi ukwakha futhi agcine indawo ephila. Kufanele akwazi ukubona futhi avikele izibhuku eqhweni.

xh.title: Umongikazi weNgcali i-PNB1 iTrauma
xh.summary: Isithuba somongikazi weNgcali (i-PNB1 iTrauma) kwi-Helen Joseph Tertiary Hospital eGauteng, esifuna ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC nokuqatshelwa kwesidanga sangemva kokusesikweni ekunyangeseni iintsholongwane.
xh.requirements: Isidanga i-Basic R425 (okt. i-Diploma / i-Degree kokuNyongesa) okanye isidanga esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengomongikazi weNgcali. Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomongikazi weNgcali. Isidanga sokunyongesa sangemva kokusesikweni esithatha ubuncinane unyaka owodwa, esiqinisekisiwe kwi-SANC kwelungelo elithintelwe. Ubuncinane kwiminyaka emine yamava ahambelani / aqondekayo ekunyongeseni emva kokubhaliswa njengomongikazi weNgcali kwi-SANC kuKunyongesa ngokubanzi. Ubuncinane unyaka owodwa kwexesha elithintelwe ngasentla kufuneka abe ngamava ahambelani / aqondekayo ekusebenzeni kwicandelo leTrauma, nangokuqatshelwa kwesidanga sangemva kokusesikweni sokunyaka owodwa kwelungelo elithintelwe.
xh.duties: Bonisa ukuqonda kwimithetho yokunyongesa nakuqeqesho lokunyongesa oluhambelana nayo ngokomthetho nangokomahlakahlaka. Sebenza njengenxalenye yeqela elisebenza ngamanyang' amaninzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunyongesa okuhle. Yenza ukunyongesa kwesigulo ngokwemigaqo yokwenza imisebenzi nemizingqinisela yokunyongesa njengoko kucinywa sisimo sokuNxilamela impilo. Khuthaza izinga lokunyongesa njengoko kucaciswa ngumgaqo weqela elisebenza ngamanyang' amaninxi nemizingqinisela njengoko kucinywa sisimo sokuNxilamela impilo. Bonisa unxibelelwano olusebenzayo namagula, abalawuli nakwelinye iqela labasebenzi bezempilo, kuquka nokubhala iingxelo xa kufuneka. Sebenza ngokusebenzayo, ngokwabelana ngokuhambelana nangobuhlobo nabantu abohlukene ngenkqubela, ngenkcubeko, ngobuhlanga okanye ngenkolo. Makakwazi ukucwangcisa nokuhlela umsebenzi wakhe nawabalawuli abancedisayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunyongesa okuhle. Bonisa inkathalo ngezigula, ukukhuthaza nokuxhasa unyango negondisiso eluhle kuquka nokuzipha ukwazisa nokulungele ukuphendula iimfuno, iimfuno neenqobo ezikwisigula (iimigaqo yeBatho Pele). Nikela iindlela nolawulo lokuqeqeshwa kwenkqubo yokunyongesa (izigulo eziluncedisa / ukunyongesa okuhle kwesigula). Qeqesha imigaqo, iinkqubo, iinkqubo ezibalulekileyo neziqondiso ezikunyongesa okuhle ngokuthintela iiganeko ezibi ezingozipho. Yenza ukunyongesa nokuxilamela impilo ngokwemithetho nemigaqo ehambelana nokunyongesa nokuxilamela impilo. Gcina ubudlelwano obwakhiweyo bomsebenzi nabongikazi nakwelinye iqela elisebenza ngokubanzi. Sebenzisa ngokusebenzayo amabhafu obuntu okanye amadl' abantu nempahla ekwakhiwa kwesebe. Lawula i-PMDS yabasebenzi abangamaphakathi. Makakwazi ukusebenza ngamashifu nokusebenza kwiimeko ezinzima. Gcina inkqubela yomsebenzi / imigaqo yomahlakahlaka nokuqeqesha ukuziphucela nomsebenzi wesiqu nenkqubo yabasebenzi abangamaphakathi. Bonisa ulwazi lwe-Ideal Hospital Realization Framework ulifake emsebenzini. Makakwazi ukuhamba nawonke umhla nokuqwalasela ukuthintela iintsholongwane nolawulo. Makakwazi ukuyila nasekugcineni indawo ekhuselekileyo. Makakwazi ukuchonga nokuthinta iingozi kwicandelo.

Manage the professional inputs being provided to the Provincial Department of Education in terms of the final project list and budgetary implications. Manage the agreed procurement strategy to optimise economies of scale, reduce costs, reduce inefficiencies and promote seamless service delivery. Manage the enforcement of standardised designs where applicable. Direct and prepare the IPIP for sign of by the Provincial Education Department. Direct and prepare the procurement plan for the Provincial Department of Education supported by the Departmental Supply Chain Management. Manage the development and agreement of the Service Delivery Agreements. Manage the implementation of services in line with the signed Service Delivery Agreements. Manage the updating of IPIP including cash flow projections aligned to allocated budgets. Manage the validation of building plans in terms of National and Municipal Building Regulations. Manage the nomination and appointment of suitable professionals from the Provincial Education Department and the Directorate in collaboration with the Departmental Supply Chain Management Unit [SCM].Manage the attendance and professional inputs being made at the different SCM Committees Manage the nomination and appointment of suitable professionals from the Provincial Education Department and the Directorate in collaboration with the Departmental Supply Chain Management Unit [SCM].Manage the attendance and professional inputs being made at the different SCM Committees. Manage the preparation of relevant procurement documentation throughout the different phases in the project management cycle. Manage the registration of projects on the CIDB i-tender system. Manage the final appointment of Professional Service Providers and Contractors on successful conclusion of procurement processes [SCM] supported by the Department of Education and SCM. Manage the issuing of work and batch orders, where applicable. Manage sign-off by the Provincial Department of Education in terms of the IPIP and different Project Execution Plans [PEPs]. Manage the implementation of contacts in line with budgets, timeframes and quality standards. Manage regular site visits. Manage all cost and scope variations. Manage the signing-off on invoices. Prepare regular progress reports to the Provincial Department of Education. Manage regular interaction with the Provincial Department of Education to pro-actively identify problems and jointly agree on solutions. Manage the provision of inputs and credible data to the financial and non-financial performance reports being submitted by the Provincial Department of Education. Provide progress reports at all the relevant Governance Infrastructure Structures. Consolidate and provide reports on projects implemented by Alternative Implementing Agents until phasing out of Alternative Implementing Agents have been completed. Manage the validation of final accounts in close collaboration with Departmental Supply Chain Management [SCM]. Manage the release of construction guarantees in close collaboration with SCM. Manage the collection of all documentation including as-built plans and submission to the centralised document warehouse. Manage the final cost analysis of each project. Manage inputs for updating of cost and space norms based on learning generated during post project evaluation. Manage the preparation of performance reports for submission to CIDB. Manage the close out of all projects and prepare close out reports. Approve contract documentation as prepared by the relevant Infrastructure Professionals before submission to the Departmental Supply Chain Management. Monitor that awards and/or contract cancellations are captured on the required databases including on the CIDB register of projects. Guide performance reports on contracts being prepared by the relevant Infrastructure Professionals. Assess and recommend motivations for waiving of penalties and low-performance damages and submit to the Departmental Supply Chain Management. Assess and recommend an increase in time or prices in terms of a contract provided it does not exceed the total of prices at award by more than the amounts stated in the Treasury Regulations in consultation with Legal Services and relevant Infrastructure Professionals before submission to Departmental Supply Chain Management. Assess and recommend termination and/or cancellation of contracts based on inputs from Infrastructure Professionals and Legal Services. Analyse recommendations made by the relevant Infrastructure Professionals and decide on the implementation of appropriate mitigation strategies to manage in a pro-active manner potential contractual implications. Obtain the inputs of the Deputy Director Contract Management Specialist and the Legal Services on all aspects of contract management. Undertake ad hoc independent site visits to verify correctness of information submitted in reports and status on sites. Participate in site visits arranged by Provincial Treasury and/or other stakeholders. Report all non-performance issues to Risk Management. Make recommendations to Departmental Supply Chain Management on price escalations based on the appropriate indices published by Statistics South Africa and/or the contract price adjustment provisions contained in the JBCC form of contract in consultation with the Infrastructure Professionals and Legal Services. Make inputs to Departmental Supply Chain Management on the management of insurances for large and long-term programmes. Align the strategic priorities and the work plans of the unit with the priorities of DID. Manage the preparation of the annual operation plan. Manage the implementation of risk and mitigation plans. Develop infrastructure delivery strategies and plans. Manage preparation and presentation of management reports for infrastructure delivery projects and progress. Manage written contributions to departmental quarterly progress reports, Annual Report, SCOPA, Budget speeches, Annual Performance Plan, etc. Sign performance agreements for subordinates based on approved Job Descriptions, Strategic and Annual Performance Plans of the Department. Manage subordinates and maintain discipline. Manage training and development of subordinates according to agreed training interventions. Develop and update the service delivery and work plan for subordinates. Manage funds in the unit in compliance with Public Finance Management Act and the Treasury Regulations. Limit under spending or overspending by the unit in terms of the departmental budget allocations.

af.title: Direkteur: Infrastruktuurlewering Suidelike Cluster
af.summary: Direkteurpos wat toesig hou oor infrastruktuurlewering in Gauteng se Suidelike Cluster, waarvoor 'n kwalifikasie in die bou-omgewing en vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring vereis word.
af.requirements: An NQF level 7 voorgraadse kwalifikasie in Built Environment (Engineering / Construction Project Management/Architecture/ Quantity Surveying/ Town and Regional Planning) soos erken deur SAQA. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op middel- / senior bestuursvlak in die bou-omgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. 'n Voor-toetrede SMS-sertifikaat (Nyukela) wat voor aanstelling ingedien moet word. Geregistreer by die relevante Raad as 'n Built Environment Professional. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van PFMA/DORA/Treasury Regulations. Alle verschillende kontrakopsies vir infrastruktuurprojekte. Provincial/Departmental Supply Chain Management Policies. Promotion of Access to Information Act of 2000. Promotion of Administrative Justice Act of 2000. Broad Based Black Empowerment Act of 2003. Preferential Procurement Act of 2000 and Regulations. Public Service Act of 1994 and Regulations of 2001.Government Immovable Asset Management Act of 2007.Occupational Health and Safety Act of 1993 and Regulations. Labour Relations Act of 1995/Resolutions of Public Sector Bargaining Councils. Basic Conditions of Employment Act, 1997. Vaardighede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, probleemoplossing en analise, kreatiwiteit, finansiële bestuur, klantefokus en reaksievermoë, kommunikasie, rekenaarvaardighede, mensebestuur, beplanning en organisering, konflikbestuur, onderhandelingsvaardighede en veranderingbestuur. Attribute: Reaktief, geloofwaardig, buigsaam, gehalte-georiënteerd, kreatief, reaktief, besluitneming en spanleierskap.
af.duties: Bestuur die professionele insette wat aan die Provincial Department of Education verskaf word met betrekking tot die voorbereiding van die konkstruksie-aankoopstrategie en die Infrastructure Programme Implementation Plan [IPIP]. Bestuur die professionele insette wat aan die Sub Directorate Technical Portfolio Services verskaf word met betrekking tot eiendomsbestuursnorme en -standaarde. [Lewenssikluskostes, instandhoudingsplanne, ens.]. Bestuur die professionele insette wat aan die Provincial Department of Education verskaf word met betrekking tot nuwe tegnologie, hersiene norme, standaarde, innovasies en hernubare energie. Bestuur die professionele insette wat aan die Provincial Department of Education verskaf word met betrekking tot die finale projektelys en begrotingsimplikasies. Bestuur die ooreengekome aankoopstrategie om skaalvoordele te optimaliseer, koste te verlaag, ondoeltreffendhede te verminder en naatlose dienslewering te bevorder. Bestuur die afdwing van gestandaardiseerde ontwerpe waar van toepassing. Rig en berei die IPIP voor vir ondertekening deur die Provincial Education Department. Rig en berei die aankoopplan vir die Provincial Department of Education voor, ondersteun deur die Departmental Supply Chain Management. Bestuur die ontwikkeling en ooreenkoms van die Service Delivery Agreements. Bestuur die implementering van dienste in ooreenstemming met die ondertekende Service Delivery Agreements. Bestuur die bywerking van IPIP insluitend kontantvloeiprojeksies wat op toegewysde begrotings afgelyn is. Bestuur die validasie van bouplanne in terme van National en Municipal Building Regulations. Bestuur die nominasie en aanstelling van geskikte professionele persone vanuit die Provincial Education Department en die Direktoraat in samewerking met die Departmental Supply Chain Management Unit [SCM].Bestuur die bywoning en professionele insette wat by die verschillende SCM Committees gelewer word. Bestuur die nominasie en aanstelling van geskikte professionele persone vanuit die Provincial Education Department en die Direktoraat in samewerking met die Departmental Supply Chain Management Unit [SCM].Bestuur die bywoning en professionele insette wat by die verschillende SCM Committees gelewer word. Bestuur die voorbereiding van tersaaklike aankoopdokumentasie deur die verschillende fases in die projekbestuursiklus. Bestuur die registrasie van projekte op die CIDB i-tender stelsel. Bestuur die finale aanstelling van Professional Service Providers en Contractors by suksesvolle afsluiting van aankoopprosesse [SCM] ondersteun deur die Department of Education en SCM. Bestuur die uitreik van werk- en lotingsorders, waar van toepassing. Bestuur ondertekening deur die Provincial Department of Education met betrekking tot die IPIP en verschillende Project Execution Plans [PEPs]. Bestuur die implementering van kontrakte in ooreenstemming met begrotings, tydraamwerke en gehaltstandaarde. Bestuur gereelde terreinbesoeke. Bestuur alle koste- en omvangvariasies. Bestuur die ondertekening van fakture. Berei gereelde vorderingsverslae voor vir die Provincial Department of Education. Bestuur gereelde wisselwerking met die Provincial Department of Education om pro-aktief probleme te identifiseer en gesamentlik oor oplossings besluit. Bestuur die verskaffing van insette en geloofwaardige data tot die finansiële en nie-finansiële prestasieverslae wat deur die Provincial Department of Education ingedien word. Verskaf vorderingsverslae by al die tersaaklike Governance Infrastructure Structures. Konsolideer en verskaf verslae oor projekte wat deur Alternative Implementing Agents geïmplementeer is totdat die uitfaserings van Alternative Implementing Agents voltooi is. Bestuur die validasie van finale rekenings in noue samewerking met Departmental Supply Chain Management [SCM]. Bestuur die vrystelling van konstruksieborgstellings in noue samewerking met SCM. Bestuur die insameling van alle dokumentasie insluitend as-built planne en voorlegging aan die gesentraliseerde dokumentbewaarplek. Bestuur die finale kosteanalise van elke projek. Bestuur insette vir die bywerking van koste- en ruimtenorme gebaseer op leer wat tydens post-projektevaluering gegenereer is. Bestuur die voorbereiding van prestasieverslae voor legging aan CIDB. Bestuur die afsluiting van alle projekte en berei afsluitingsverslae voor. Keur kontrakdokumentasie soos voorberei deur die tersaaklike Infrastructure Professionals goed voor voorlegging aan die Departmental Supply Chain Management. Monitor dat toekennings en/of kontrakkansellasies op die vereiste databasisse vasgelê word insluitend op die CIDB register of projekte. Rig prestasieverslae oor kontrakte wat deur die tersaaklike Infrastructure Professionals voorberei word. Evalueer en beveel motiverings vir kwyt-skelding van boetes en lae-prestasieskade aan en dien voor by die Departmental Supply Chain Management. Evalueer en beveel 'n verhoging in tyd of pryse in terme van 'n kontrak aan, mits dit die totaal van pryse by toekenning nie met meer as die bedrae wat in die Treasury Regulations vermeld word oorskry nie, in oorleg met Legal Services en tersaaklike Infrastructure Professionals voor voorlegging aan Departmental Supply Chain Management. Evalueer en beveel beëindiging en/of kansellasie van kontrakte aan op grond van insette van Infrastructure Professionals en Legal Services. Analiseer aanbevelings gedoen deur die tersaaklike Infrastructure Professionals en besluit oor die implementering van geskikte mitigasiestrategieë om potensiële kontraktuele implikasies op 'n pro-aktiewe wyse te bestuur. Verkry die insette van die Deputy Director Contract Management Specialist en Legal Services oor alle aspekte van kontrakbestuur. Onderneem ad hoc onafhanklike terreinbesoeke om die korrektheid van inligting wat in verslae ingedien word en die status op terreine te verifieer. Neem deel aan terreinbesoeke wat deur Provincial Treasury en/of ander belanghebbendes gereël word. Rapporteer alle nie-prestasiekwessies aan Risk Management. Maak aanbevelings aan Departmental Supply Chain Management oor prysverhogings gebaseer op die toepaslike indekse wat deur Statistics South Africa gepubliseer word en/of die kontrakprysaanpassingsbepalings in die JBCC kontrakvorm, in oorleg met die Infrastructure Professionals en Legal Services. Lewer insette aan Departmental Supply Chain Management oor die bestuur van versekerings vir groot en langtermynprogramme. Lijn die strategiese prioriteite en werkplanne van die eenheid met die prioriteite van DID af. Bestuur die voorbereiding van die jaarlike bedryfsplan. Bestuur die implementering van risiko- en mitigasieplanne. Ontwikkel infrastruktuurleweringstrategieë en -planne. Bestuur voorbereiding en voorlegging van bestuursverslae vir infrastruktuurleweringprojekte en -vordering. Bestuur geskrewe bydraes tot departementele kwartaalvorderingsverslae, Annual Report, SCOPA, Budget speeches, Annual Performance Plan, ens. Onderteken prestasieooreenkomste vir ondergeskiktes gebaseer op goedgekeurde Job Descriptions, Strategic and Annual Performance Plans van die Departement. Bestuur ondergeskiktes en handhaaf dissipline. Bestuur opleiding en ontwikkeling van ondergeskiktes volgens ooreengekome opleidingsintervensies. Ontwikkel en werk die dienslewering- en werkplan vir ondergeskiktes by. Bestuur fondse in die eenheid in ooreenstemming met Public Finance Management Act en die Treasury Regulations. Beperk onderbesteding of oorbesteding deur die eenheid in terme van die departementele begrotingstoewysings.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ukulethwa Kwezokwakha Kweqoqo ElinguSouthern
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi esibukela ukulethwa kwezokwakha eqoqweni elinguSouthern eGauteng, esifuna iziqu zendawo yakhiwayo kanye neminyaka emihlanu yobuhle obuphezulu bokuphatha.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingaphansi kwesiqu ezingeni le-NQF level 7 kwindawo yakhiwayo (Engineering / Construction Project Management/Architecture/ Quantity Surveying/ Town and Regional Planning) njengoba kunakwa yi-SAQA. Okungenani ungamu weminyaka engu-5 ohlakeni lomphakathi noma lomphathi ohlakeni emkhakheni wendawo yakhiwayo. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Isitifikedi se-Pre-Entry SMS (Nyukela) esinikelwe ngaphambi kokwethweswa. Kufanele abhaliswe kwi-Council ehambisana nendima njengengcwadi yomunyenti we-Build Environment Professional. Ikhono: Ulwazi nge-PFMA/DORA/Treasury Regulations. Zonke izinketho zezinkundla ezihlukene zezinhlelo zezokwakha. Izinqubomgomo ze-Provincial/Departmental Supply Chain Management. I-Promotion of Access to Information Act of 2000. I-Promotion of Administrative Justice Act of 2000. I-Broad Based Black Empowerment Act of 2003. I-Preferential Procurement Act of 2000 and Regulations. I-Public Service Act of 1994 and Regulations of 2001. I-Government Immovable Asset Management Act of 2007. I-Occupational Health and Safety Act of 1993 and Regulations. I-Labour Relations Act of 1995/Resolutions of Public Sector Bargaining Councils. I-Basic Conditions of Employment Act, 1997. Amakhono: Ikharikhulu nesibindi sokuba ngumholi, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, ukwakha okusha, ukuphatha imali, ukugxila kumthengi nokuphendula, ukuxhumana, amakhono ekhompuyutha, ukuphatha abantu, ukucubungula nokuhlela, ukuphathwa kwezimpixano, amakhono okuxoxisana nokuphatha inguquko. Izimpawu: Ukuphendula, ukuthembeka, ukuguquguquka, ukugxila kikhwalithi, ukwakha okusha, ukwenza izinqumo nobuholi bqhame.
zu.duties: Phatha okufakwayo okwenziwe abangcwadi abunikezwe i-Provincial Department of Education ngokulungiselelwa komgomo wokuthenga izokwakha kanye nesu Sokusetshenziswa Kohlelo Lwezokwakha [IPIP]. Phatha okufakwayo okwenziwe abangcwadi abunikezwe i-Sub Directorate Technical Portfolio Services ngemiqatho namazinga okuphatha izimpahla. [Izindleko zomjikelezo wempilo, izinhlela zokulondoloza, njll.]. Phatha okufakwayo okwenziwe abangcwadi abunikezwe i-Provincial Department of Education ngobuchwepheshe obusha, emazingeni ashintshiwe, amagama ashintshiwe, izindlela ezisha nobudoba obuhlanzekile. Phatha okufakwayo okwenziwe abangcwadi abunikezwe i-Provincial Department of Education mayelana nolu lwezinhlelo kokugqamile kanye nezinkambiso zebhajethi. Phatha umgawa wokuthenga oqediwe ukuze kukhuliswe inzuzo yobukhulu, kuncishwe izindleko, kuncishwe ukungalunga futhi kuthuthukiswe ukulethwa kwezinsiza ngokuqhubekayo. Phatha ukuphoqelelwa kwemiklamo emisiwe lapho kufane khona. Hola futhi ulungisele i-IPIP ukuze isayine i-Provincial Education Department. Hola futhi ulungiselele i-Provincial Department of Education umya wokuthenga okusekelwa yi-Departmental Supply Chain Management. Phatha ukwakhiwa nokuvunyana kwezivumelwano zokulethwa kwezinsiza. Phatha ukuhlela kwezinsiza ngokuvumelana nezivumelwano zokulethwa kwezinsiza ezesayiniwe. Phatha ukubuyeka kokwaziswa kwe-IPIP kuhlanganisa izibikezelo zokuhamba kwemali ezilinganiswe nembhasidi exaxiwe. Phatha ukuqinisekiswa kwezinhlelo zokwakha ngokwezidingo zikaZwe nakamasipala. Phatha ukumiswa futhi ukwethwa kwabangcwadi abafanele abavela ku-Provincial Education Department kanye neDirectorate bese beya ngokubambisana ne-Unit yokuqoqwa kweziqhingi ye-Departmental Supply Chain Management [SCM]. Phatha ukubakhona nokufakwa kwemibiko ebalulekile kwamabhodi e-SCM ahlukene. Phatha ukumiswa futhi ukwethwa kwabangcwadi abafanele abavela ku-Provincial Education Department kanye neDirectorate bese beya ngokubambisana ne-Unit yokuqoqwa kweziqhingi ye-Departmental Supply Chain Management [SCM]. Phatha ukubakhona nokufakwa kwemibiko ebalulekile kwamabhodi e-SCM ahlukene. Phatha ukulungiselelwa kwemibiko yokuthenga ehambisana namagqamu ahlukeneyo ekuhleleni ukuphatha izinhlelo. Phatha ukubhalisa kwezinhlelo kwisistimu i-CIDB i-tender. Phatha ukwethwa kokugqamile kwezinkampani ezinika izinsiza ezingcwadi nabathwebuli ngempumelelo yomthisa wokuthenga [SCM] okusekelwa yi-Department of Education ne-SCM. Phatha ukukhishwa kwemiyalo yomsebenzi namagqamu, lapho kufane khona. Phatha ukusayina i-Provincial Department of Education nge-IPIP futhi ngezinhlelo ezahlukene zokuqalwa kwephrojekthi [PEPs]. Phatha ukuhlela kwezinkundla ngokwezibhajethi, izikhathi namazinga ekhwalithi. Phatha ukuvakashela iziteshi ngezikhathi ezithile. Phatha zonke izinguquko ezenzeka ezindlekweni nakumanani wephrojekthi. Phatha ukusayina izikweletu. Lungiselela imibiko yokuqhubela phambili ephinda kwenziwa inikezwa i-Provincial Department of Education. Phatha ukuxhumana njalo ne-Provincial Department of Education ukuze kubonwe izinkinga ngaphambi kwalawo futhi kuzuzwe isivumelwano ngamaxazululo. Phatha ukunikwa kwemibiko nge-data ethembekile kwimibiko yokusebenza ngokwemali kanye nalokungangokwemali eyethunyelwa i-Provincial Department of Education. Nikeza imibiko yokuqhubela phambili kuyo yonke izakhiwo ezibalulekile zokuqondiswa kwezokwakha. Hlanganisa futhi unikeze imibiko ngephrojekthi ezenziwe izinzima ezingabakhiphi kwaphela izinzima. Phatha ukuqinisekiswa kwama-akhawunti okugqamile ngokubambisana eduze ne-Departmental Supply Chain Management [SCM]. Phatha ukukhululwa kwezinkombiso zokuvikela izokwakha ngokubambisana no-SCM. Phatha ukuqoqa kwawo wonke amadokhumenti kuhlanganise izinhlela ezakhiwe bese kuthunyelwa esikhungweni somtapo wamadokhumenti oqoqiwe sikhundla esinye. Phatha ukuhlaziywa kwama-akhawunti okugqamile kokugqamile. Phatha okungeniswayo ukubuyeka kokwaziswa kwamazinga ezindleko nobungako bexwithu okusekelwe ekufundeni okwenziwe ngemuva kokuphatha iphrojekthi. Phatha ukulungiselelwa kwemibiko yokusebenza eyethunyelwa ku-CIDB. Phatha ukuphetha yawo wonke amaphrojekthi bese ulungiselela imibiko yokuqeda. Vuma amadokhumenti okusebenza njengoba alungiselelwe ngumunyenti wezokwakha ngaphambi kokuthunyelwa ku-Departmental Supply Chain Management. Bheka ukuthi imiklamo kanye noma ukukhanselwa kwezinkundla kutholakala emininingweni efunwayo kuhlanganise nesifundvwa se-CIDB samaphrojekthi. Hola imibiko yokusebenza ngamakhontrakti njengoba ilungiselelwa nguyise wezokwakha. Hlola futhi ucabangele ukwesulwa kwezohlangothi zamahlawula nezindleko zokungalungiseleli futhi kuthunyelwe kwi-Departmental Supply Chain Management. Hlola futhi uphakamise ukwandiswa kwesikhathi noma kwamaxabiso ngokwamakhontrakti okuhlinzeka ukuthi noma inini kungangeni enanini yonke yamaxabiso kokwethwa nangaphezu kwamabonwana abalulekile ezikweletini ze-Treasury Regulations ngokubonisana ne-Legal Services nomunyenti wezokwakha ngaphambi kokuthunyelwa kwi-Departmental Supply Chain Management. Hlolo futhi uphakamise ukupheliswa noma ukukhanselwa kwamakhontrakti okusekelwe okungeniswayo kwangabasebenzi bezokwakha kanye ne-Legal Services. Hlaziya iziphakamiso ezenziwe nguye osembangeni wezokwakha bese uphatha amasiko okwesula izinsongo ukuze aphathwe izinkinga ezingase zibambezele isikhathi esingakapheli. Thola izinkomba zo-Specialist we-Deputy Director Contract Management kanye ne-Legal Services ngawo wonke amaphuzu okuphatha amakhontrakti. Yenza ukuvakashela iziteshi ngokuzimela ukuze kufakazwe ukuthi ulwazi olutholwa kwimibiko luyiqiniso nokuthi zisesimweni esingakakazi. Thatha inhlangothi ekuvakasheleni iziteshi ehalaniswe yi-Provincial Treasury futhi noma ngubani ongumhlanganyeli. Dula konke ukungasebenzi kahle e-Risk Management. Yenza iziphakamiso kwi-Departmental Supply Chain Management ngokwandiswa kwamaxabiso okusekelwe kumilinganisela ehlobene ekhishwa yi-Statistics South Africa kanye noma ngezinkinganiso ezitholwa kulesofothiwe elingu-JBCC form of contract ngokubonisana nabangcwadi beInfrastructure Professionals kanye ne-Legal Services. Faka izinkomba ku-Departmental Supply Chain Management ngokuphatha izinsimahla ezinkulu futhi ezide isikhathi eside. Linganisela izinhlelo ezibalulekile kanye nezinkambiso zokuqasha zeqoqo nezinhloso zeDID. Phatha ukulungiselelwa kwemibiko yokusebenza yonyaka. Phatha ukuletha kwezelimo futhi kwemigomo yokwesula izinhlanhla. Yila imigomo kanye nezinhlela zokuqhatha izokwakha. Phatha ukulungiselelwa nokuhunyushwa kwemibiko yokuphatha ukulethwa kwezokwakha kanye nokuqhubela phambili. Phatha izinkombandlela eziyisiqalo semibiko yekota yokuqhubela phambili kumnyango, i-Annual Report, i-SCOPA, amagama ebhajethi, i-Annual Performance Plan, njll. Sayina izivumelwano zokusebenza zabangaphansi kwakho okusekelwe kumumo wokusebenza ovunyiwe, futhi ohlelwa ukusebenza kwabangaphansi kanye nokusebenza kwaminyaka yonke ibhalwe i-Departmental Supply Chain Management. Phatha ukukhuliswa kwabantu ngokwezigaba. Phatha amafunda nokuqasha okuhambisana nemigomo yokuqasha. Phatha imali ekulesikhungweni ngokuvumelana na-Public Finance Management Act kanye ne-Treasury Regulations. Yiba khona ezindlekweni ukusebenzisa imali okungekho emkhawuleni noma ngaphezulu ngebhajethi ebekiwe ekulesikhungweni.

xh.title: Umqondisi: Ukulethwa Kwezolimo Iindawo Zonakaliswayo SamaNqaku emazantsi
xh.summary: Inqanaba lomqondisi elibukelela ukulethwa kwezolimo iindawo zonakaliswayo kwilungu eliya emazantsi eGauteng,elifuna isifundo sezakhiwo zendalo kwaye five years imimiselo yamabiza amakhulu.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi kweNQF level 7 kwindalo ezakhiwayo (Engineering / Construction Project Management/Architecture/ Quantity Surveying/ Town and Regional Planning) njengokuqatshwa yiSAQA. Isipilingo seminyaka elingu-5 yamava kwinqanaba lephakathi / eliphezulu lokulawula kwizakhiwo zendalo. Ilayisenisi yemoto esemthethweni. Isatifikethi se-SMS se-Pre-Entry (Nyukela) ezinikezelwa phambi kokwamkelwa. Ubhalise kwiBhunga elichanekileyo njengengcali yezakhiwo zendalo. Ikhono: Ulwazi malunga ne-PFMA/DORA/Treasury Regulations. Zonke iinketho zeziqinisekiso ezahlukeneyo zeeprojekthi zeempahla ezakhiwayo. Iinkqubo ze-Provincial/Departmental Supply Chain Management. Umthetho wokuNgenisa ulwazi ka-2000. Umthetho wokuBulisa ngolawulo ka-2000. Umthetho wokuNika amandla abantu abamnyama abaningi ka-2003. Umthetho wokuThengwayo ngokukhethwa ka-2000 nemigaqo. Umthetho waBantu baseBurhulumente ka-1994 neMigaqo ka-2001. Umthetho woLawulo lweempahla zeBurhulumente ezingatshintshwayo ka-2007. Umthetho woKhuseleko loMsebenzi nayeMpilo ka-1993 neMigaqo. Umthetho wokuHamba kwamabango ka-1995/Izigqibo zeBhunga leBhazizwe nakwiBhunga lezeNkqubo. Umthetho oBhala iimeko zoMsebenzi, ka-1997. Amakhono: Ikhono lokulawula iindlela ezisisa nokuqhatha, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya, ukudala, ukulawula imali, ukugxila kumthengi nokuvela, ukunxibelelana, amakhono ekhompyutha, ukulawula abantu, ukuqamba ngoonxibelelwano nokuhlela, ukulawula iingxabano, amakhono okuxoxisana nokuqamba ukutshintsha. Iimpawu: Ukuba ngumntu ophendulayo, ongamntu ongathembekayo, ongagungqiyo, oqwalaselayo ukhwalithi, ongomdali, ophendulayo, othatha iigqibo kwaye ungalawuli iqela.
xh.duties: Qonda ukuba singenisa iingcali kwiProvincial Department of Education ngenkqubo yokuqamba iindlela zokuthenga izakhiwo nendlela yoQaliso lweNkqubo yeZakhiwo [IPIP]. Qonda ukuba singenisa iingcali kwiSub Directorate Technical Portfolio Services ngenkqubo nemiqathango yokulawula izinto ezizezinto. [Iindleko zomntu ongakanani, iindlela zokulungisa, njl]. Qonda ukuba singenisa iingcali kwiProvincial Department of Education ngenkqubo yobutsha bokudala, imigaqo etsha, iindlela ezintsha nokuqamba amandla antsha. Qonda ukuba singenisa iingcali kwiProvincial Department of Education malunga nolu luhlu lweeprojekthi zokugqibela nemithelelo yemali. Qonda inkqubo yokuthenga edityaniswayo ukuze kuncitshwe amandla amakhulu, kwehlishwe iindleko, kuncitshiswe ukungasebenzi kakuhle kwaye kunyuselwe inkonzo ekhula ngaphandle kwezithintelo. Qonda ukuphatha iinkqubo zokwakhiwa ezimiselweyo apho zifanele khona. Qonda kwaye ulungiselele i-IPIP ukuze iyamkelwe yiProvincial Education Department. Qonda kwaye ulungiselele iinkqubo zokuthenga zeProvincial Department of Education exhaswa yiDepartmental Supply Chain Management. Qonda ukuphuhlisa nokuqinisekisa iSivumelwano soLawulo lweNkonzo. Qonda ukuphatha ukwenza inkonzo ngokwesiVumelwano soLawulo lweNkonzo esamkeliweyo. Qonda ukuhlaziya i-IPIP kuquka nezibonelelo zemali ngokomthengiso olinganiselweyo. Qonda ukuqinisekisa amacebo okwakhiwa ngokwemiQathango yoLwakhiwo lwesiLulwazi nakwilali. Qonda ukubeka kwaye ukhankanye abantu abangabalaseleyo abangeneyo kwiProvincial Education Department nesiKhulu ngenkxaxhi kunye ne-Departmental Supply Chain Management Unit [SCM]. Qonda ukubakhankanya nangaphezulu kwezinto abangangenisa kumabala apho bengathatha khona iigqibo ze-SCM nesiKhulu kwindalo ekuqaliswe kuyo iProvincial Education Department nesiKhulu kwindalo esekuthethwa ngayo i-SCM Committees. Qonda ukuqinisekisa amaxwebhu okuthenga amafanele kumagqibo athile okuqaliswa kwinkqubo yekhompyutha ekuphuhliswa kwayo iphuhliswe kuyo iprojekthi. Qonda ukubhalisa iiprojekthi kwi-CIDB i-tender system. Qonda ukugqibela ukubizwa koluntu abanika inkonzo ngobungcali nabakhiwyi kwinkqubo edityaniswe ngokwemigaqo yamahla [SCM] exhaswa yiDepartment of Education nesiKhulu nakwiSCM. Qonda ukunika amaxwebhu okusebenza nokuqwalasela amaxwebhu, ngokwendlela efanele khona. Qonda ukuyamkela i-IPIP kunye neendlela ezahlukeneyo zokuQalisa iProjekthi [PEPs] yiProvincial Department of Education. Qonda ukusetyenziswa kolawulo ngokwemali, ixesha nangokwemilinganiselo yekhwalithi. Qonda ukwenza iindwendwe ezahlukeneyo kumzi. Qonda konke ukutshintsha kwemali nangaphezulu kwentshukumo. Qonda ukusayina ngokwamaxesha amaxwebhu wemali. Lungiselela iingxelo ezibhalelwa iProvincial Department of Education njalo nangalo lonke ixesha. Qonda ukunxibelelana ngeProvincial Department of Education kuqonda iingxaki kwangaphambili kwaye nisivumelane ngemida yokuqonda. Qonda ukubakela iingxelo nolwazi olungathembekanga kweemali ezingengamali ezibhala iProvincial Department of Education. Nikela iingxelo ngokuphuhliswa kwayo naziphi na iinkqubo zoLawulo lweZakhiwo ezikwindawo ezahlukeneyo. Dibanisa kwaye unike iingxelo zeeprojekthi ezenziwayo ngokwabakhi bentshintsho abangenakubakho kwelixesha abangamalungu apho kugqitywa ukurhoxiswa kwabo. Qonda ukuqinisekisa iingxelo zemali ngokwexabiso ngexabiso elikufutshane nendlela ekulawula iingxelo ezingekho mthethweni kwindalo ekudityaniswe kuyo iDepartmental Supply Chain Management. Qonda ukunikwa kwamacebo abakhiwo ekukhuphaneni kwaye kudityaniswe nakwindalo ekuphuhliswe kuyo iSCM. Qonda ukuqokelela amaxwebhu amaninzi aquka izakhriwo nokuba abanikezelwa kwindlu embalwa yamaxwebhu abalawuliyo. Qonda ukuphuhliswa kwexabiso leeprojekthi ngokwexabiso ngokuzimela. Qonda iingxelo ngenkqubo yokulungisa iindleko nangaphezulu kwemilinganiselo yendawo ngokwemfundo efunyenwe kwindlela iprojekthi iqaliswe kuyo emva kokuba igqityiwe. Qonda ukulungiselela iingxelo ezingenisa ulwazi lwemilinganiselo ekuthunyelwa kuyo iCIDB. Qonda ukugqibela ukugqitywa kweeprojekthi zonke kwaye ulungiselele iingxelo zokugqitywa. Yamkela amaxwebhu okusebenza njengoko alungiselelwa ziNgcali ezingazange zenze iprojekthi ngaphambi kokuba zithunyelwe kwiDepartmental Supply Chain Management. Qonda ukuba kuqinisekiswe ukuba abakhethwayo nabakhansulekileyo bafakelwa kwidatafile ekufuneka bayibe kwaye kubakho kumaziko i-CIDB. Qonda ukuba izinto ezifunwa kwiingxelo ekufuneka zenziwe ngenkqubo echanekileyo yokulawula. Qonda ukuyamkela okanye ukungayamkeli iingxelo ezifuna ukuba kusukwe kumakhaka okusukela kumakhaka okungenanto kwaye zenziwe iingxelo ekufuneka zenziwe kwaye zithunyelwe kwiDepartmental Supply Chain Management. Qonda ukuyamkela okanye ukungayamkeli ukunyuka kwexabiso nangaphezulu kokutshintsha kwexabiso ngokwemigaqo yesivumelwano esinikelwa ngaphantsi kwemigaqo yeTreasury ukuba kuyilwanga ngeenkxaxhi nabantu abangeneyo ngaphambi kokuba kuthunyelwe kwiDepartmental Supply Chain Management. Qonda ukuqonda okanye ukungaqondi iingxelo ezinikelwa ziNgcali ezahlukeneyo zeZakhiwo kwaye ugqibe ukuba senziwe ntoni na ngayo njengesinyathelo sokulawula iingxaki ezinokubakho ngokwemigaqo yesivumelwano. Qonda ukuba kufunyanwe ulwazi kumakhaka ongumongameli wolawulo lomthetho nakwisikhulu sezomthetho kumaziko onke amathetha ngokulawulwa kwesivumelwano. Qonda ukuba kunjani na ekwindawo ekuphuhliswe kuyo iprojekthi kwaye kuqinisekiswe ulwazi olunikelwa kwiingxelo nokuba kunjani na ekwindawo ekuphuhliswe kuyo iprojekthi. Qonda ukuba kuthathwa inxaxhi nakumaziko onke amaza abalawuliyo. Qonda ukungawazi amaziko onke amabiwo okungenwa kwemigaqo ekwiRisk Management. Qonda ukuba kwenziwe iingxelo ezinika amakhaka e-Departmental Supply Chain Management ngokwemigaqo ekulungele ngokomthetho nangaphezulu kokulungiswa kweeNkqubo ezibhaliweyo zeJBCC. Qonda ukuba kunikelwe ulwazi kwi-Departmental Supply Chain Management malunga nokuqinisekiswa kwezinsurance ezingamaza amakhulu nakwinkqubo ende yokulunga okuhleliweyo. Qonda ukulungiselela iinkqubo zonyaka zokuqalisa inkqubo yokusebenza. Qonda ukulungiselela iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zokulawula iingxaki ezinokubakho. Qonda ukuphuhliswa kweendlela zokwakha nokulawula inkqubo yokwakhiwa ezahlukeneyo. Qonda ukulungiselela nokubhala iingxelo zokulawula iinkqubo zokwakhiwa nangaphezulu kokuba kuyinkqubo iphuhliswa ngaphantsi kwayo. Qonda ukuba zibhalwe iingxelo ngeendaba ezahlukeneyo ezibhala iSikhulu ngeenkqubo ezahlukeneyo, kwiNgxelo yonyaka, kwiSCOPA, nakwiinkqubo zokwethula iNgxelo, njl. Sayina amaxwebhu okusebenza kubantu abangaphantsi kwakho ngokweNdlela yokuQinisekisa ulwazi oluceliweyo, nangokweNdlela yokuQinisekisa ulwazi oluceliweyo. Qonda ukuba abantu abangaphantsi kwakho balawulwe baze bagcine ukuzithiba. Qonda ukubakela abantu abangaphantsi kwakho inkonzo yokuqeqesha ngokweenkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezivunyelweyo. Qonda ukuphuhliswa nokuhlaziya inkqubo yokuNika ulwazi oluncedo kubantu abangaphantsi kwakho. Qonda imali ekusebenzela kwayo inkqubo nangaphantsi kwePublic Finance Management Act kwaye nangaphantsi kweTreasury Regulations. Qonda ukugcina imali engashiyekiyo kungekho nto kungenwa kwaye kube khona okungenwayo ngokwendlela ebanjwe yileSikhulu ngaphantsi kwemali ekwabelwe kuyo.

jobs.summary: Director role overseeing infrastructure planning and construction procurement strategy for provincial departments at the Gauteng Head Office in Johannesburg.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification at NQF level 7 in Built Environment (Engineering / Construction Project Management / Architecture / Quantity Surveying / Town and Regional Planning) as recognized by SAQA. A minimum of 5 years’ experience at middle / senior managerial level in the built environment. A valid driver’s license. A Pre-Entry SMS Certificate (Nyukela) submitted prior to appointment. Registered with the relevant Council as a Build Environment Professional. Competencies: Knowledge of PFMA/DORA/Treasury Regulations. All different contract options for infrastructure projects. Provincial/Departmental Supply Chain Management Policies. Promotion of Access to Information Act of 2000. Promotion of Administrative Justice Act of 2000. Broad Based Black Empowerment Act of 2003. Preferential Procurement Act of 2000 and Regulations. Public Service Act of 1994 and Regulations of 2001.Government Immovable Asset Management Act of 2007.Occupational Health and Safety Act of 1993 and Regulations. Labour Relations Act of 1995/Resolutions of Public Sector Bargaining Councils. Basic Conditions of Employment Act, 1997 Project Management People Management, Financial Management and Conflict Management. Skills: Strategic capability and leadership, Problem-solving, analysis, Creativity, Financial management, Customer focus and responsiveness Communication, Computer skills, People management, Planning and organizing, Conflict management Negotiation skills, change management. Attributes: Responsive. Credible. Flexible. Quality oriented. Creative. Responsive. Decision making. Team leadership.
jobs.duties: Manage the professional inputs being provided to the Other Provincial Departments in terms of the preparation of the construction procurement strategy and the Infrastructure Programme Implementation Plan [IPIP], new technology, revised norms, standards, innovations, renewable energy, final project list and budgetary implications. Manage the agreed procurement strategy to optimise economies of scale, reduce costs, reduce inefficiencies and promote seamless service delivery. Manage the enforcement of standardised designs where applicable. Direct and prepare the IPIP for sign of by Other Provincial Departments Direct and prepare the procurement plan for Other Provincial Departments supported by the Departmental Supply Chain Management. Manage the development and agreement of the Service Delivery Agreements. Manage the implementation of services in line with the signed Service Delivery Agreements. Manage the updating of IPIP including cash flow projections aligned to allocated budgets. Manage the validation of building plans in terms of National and Municipal Building Regulations. Manage the nomination and appointment of suitable professionals from Other Provincial Departments and the Directorate in collaboration with the Departmental Supply Chain Management Unit [SCM]. Manage the attendance and professional inputs being made at the different SCM Committees. Manage the preparation of relevant procurement documentation throughout the different phases in the project management cycle. Manage the final appointment of Professional Service Providers and Contractors on successful conclusion of procurement processes [SCM] supported by the Other Provincial Departments and SCM. Manage the issuing of work and batch orders, where applicable. Manage sign- off by Other Provincial Departments in terms of the IPIP and different Project Execution Plans [PEPs]. Manage the implementation of contacts in line with budgets, timeframes and quality standards. Manage regular site visits. Manage all cost and scope variations. Manage the signing-off on invoices. Manage regular interaction with Other Provincial Departments to proactively identify problems and jointly agree on solutions. Manage the provision of inputs and credible data to the financial and non-financial performance reports being submitted by Other Provincial Departments. Provide progress reports at all the relevant Governance Infrastructure Structures. Manage the validation of final accounts in close collaboration with Departmental Supply Chain Management [SCM]. Manage the release of construction guarantees in close collaboration with SCM. Manage the collection of all documentation including as-built plans and submission to the centralized document warehouse. Manage the final cost analysis of each project. Manage inputs for updating of cost and space norms based on learning generated during post project evaluation. Manage the preparation of performance reports for submission to Construction Industry Development Board. Manage the close out of all projects and prepare close out reports. Approve and submit contract documentation as prepared by the relevant Infrastructure Professionals before submission to the Departmental Supply Chain Management. Monitor that awards and/or contract cancellations are captured on the required databases including on the CIDB register of projects. Guide performance reports on contracts being prepared by the relevant Infrastructure Professionals. Assess and recommend motivations for waiving of penalties and low performance damages and submit to the Departmental Supply Chain Management. Assess and recommend an increase in time or prices in terms of a contract provided it does not exceed the total of prices at award by more than the amounts stated in the Treasury Regulations Assess and recommend termination and/or cancellation of contracts based on input from Infrastructure Professionals and Legal Services. Analyse recommendations made by the relevant Infrastructure Professionals and decide on the implementation of appropriate mitigation strategies to manage potential contractual implications in a pro-active manner. Obtain the inputs of the Deputy Director Contract Management Specialist and the Legal Services on all aspects of contract management. Undertake ad hoc independent site visits to verify correctness of information submitted in reports and status on sites. Report all non-performance issues to Risk Management. Make inputs to Departmental Supply Chain Management on the management of insurances for large and long-term programmes. Align the strategic priorities and the work plans of the unit with the priorities of DID. Manage the preparation of the annual operation plan. Manage the implementation of risk and mitigation plans. Develop infrastructure delivery strategies and plans. Manage preparation and presentation of management reports for infrastructure delivery projects and progress. Manage written contributions to departmental quarterly progress reports, Annual Report, SCOPA, Budget speeches, Annual Performance Plan, etc. Sign performance agreements for subordinates based on approved Job Descriptions, Strategic and Annual Performance Plans of the Department. Manage subordinates and maintain discipline. Manage training and development of subordinates according to agreed training interventions. Develop and update the service delivery and work plan for subordinates. Manage funds in the unit in compliance with Public Finance Management Act and the Treasury Regulations. Limit under spending or overspending by the unit in terms of the departmental budget allocations.

af.title: Direkteur: Infrastruktuur van Ander Proviniale Departemente
af.summary: Direkteurspos wat toesig hou oor infrastruktuurbeplanning en konstruksie-aanbestedingsstrategie vir provinsiale departemente by die Gauteng Hoofkantoor in Johannesburg.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie op NQF vlak 7 in Bou-omgewing (Ingenieurswese / Konstruksieprojekbestuur / Argitektuur / Hoeveelheidsopmeting / Stads- en Streekbeplanning) soos erken deur SAQA. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op middel- / senior bestuursvlak in die bou-omgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. 'n Voor-toetrede SMS-sertifikaat (Nyukela) wat voor aanstelling ingedien word. Geregistreer by die tersaaklike Raad as 'n Bou-omgewingsprofessionele. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van PFMA/DORA/Tesourie-regulasies. Alle verskillende kontrakopsies vir infrastruktuurprojekte. Provinsiale/Departementele Voorsieningskettingbestuursbeleid. Bevordering van Toegang tot Inligting Wet van 2000. Bevordering van Administratiewe Geregtigheid Wet van 2000. Breëgebaseerde Swart Bemagtigingswet van 2003. Voorkeur-aanbestedingswet van 2000 en Regulasies. Openbare Dienswet van 1994 en Regulasies van 2001. Staats Onroerende Batebestuurswet van 2007. Beroepsgesondheids- en Veiligheidswet van 1993 en Regulasies. Arbeidsverhoudingswet van 1995/Resolusies van Openbare Sektoronderhandelingsrade. Basiese Diensvoorwaardewet, 1997 Projekbestuur, Menslike bestuur, Finansiële bestuur en Konflikbestuur. Vaardighede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, Probleemoplossing, analise, Kreatiwiteit, Finansiële bestuur, Kliëntfokus en reaksievermoë, Kommunikasie, Rekenaarvaardighede, Menslike bestuur, Beplanning en organisering, Konflikbestuur, Onderhandelingsvaardighede, veranderingsbestuur. Kenmerke: Reaksief. Geloofwaardig. Buigsaam. Kwaliteitsgerig. Kreatief. Reaksief. Besluitneming. Spanleierskap.
af.duties: Bestuur die professionele insette wat verskaf word aan die Ander Provinciale Departemente ten opsigte van die voorbereiding van die konstruksie-aanbestedingsstrategie en die Infrastruktuurprogram-implementeringsplan [IPIP], nuwe tegnologie, hersiene norme, standaarde, innovasies, hernubare energie, finale projeklys en begrotingsimplikasies. Bestuur die ooreengekome aanbestedingsstrategie om skaalvoordele te optimaliseer, koste te verminder, ondoeltreffendhede te vermieder en naatlose dienslewering te bevorder. Bestuur die afdwing van gestandaardiseerde ontwerpe waar van toepassing. Lei en berei die IPIP voor vir ondertekening deur Ander Provinciale Departemente. Lei en berei die aanbestedingsplan voor vir Ander Provinciale Departemente ondersteun deur die Departementele Voorsieningskettingbestuur. Bestuur die ontwikkeling en ooreenkoms van die Diensleweringsooreenkomste. Bestuur die implementering van dienste in ooreenstemming met die ondertekende Diensleweringsooreenkomste. Bestuur die opdatering van IPIP insluitend kontantvloeprojeksies wat op die toegewysde begrotings afgestem is. Bestuur die validasie van bouplanne in terme van Nasionale en Munisipale Bouregulasies. Bestuur die nominasie en aanstelling van geskikte professionele persone van Ander Provinciale Departemente en die Direktoraat in samewerking met die Departementele Voorsieningskettingbestuurseenheid [SCM]. Bestuur die bywoning en professionele insette wat by die verskillende SCM-komitees gemaak word. Bestuur die voorbereiding van tersaaklike aanbestedingsdokumentasie deur die verskillende fases in die projekbestuursiklus. Bestuur die finale aanstelling van Professionele Dienverskaffers en Kontrakteurs by suksesvolle afhandeling van aanbestedingsprosesse [SCM] ondersteun deur die Ander Provinciale Departemente en SCM. Bestuur die uitreiking van werk- en lotingsorders, waar van toepassing. Bestuur ondertekening deur Ander Provinciale Departemente ten opsigte van die IPIP en verskillende Projekuitvoeringsplanne [PEPs]. Bestuur die implementering van kontrakte in ooreenstemming met begrotings, tydraamwerke en gehaltestandaarde. Bestuur gereelde terreinbesoeke. Bestuur alle koste- en omvangvariasies. Bestuur die ondertekening van fakture. Bestuur gereelde interaksie met Ander Provinciale Departemente om proaktief probleme te identifiseer en gesamentlik oor oplossings besluit. Bestuur die verskaffing van insette en geloofwaardige data aan die finansiële en nie-finansiële prestasieverslae wat deur Ander Provinciale Departemente ingedien word. Verskaf vorderingsverslae by al die tersaaklike Bestuursinfrastructurestrukture. Bestuur die validasie van finale rekeninge in nou samewerking met Departementele Voorsieningskettingbestuur [SCM]. Bestuur die vrylating van konstruksiegaranties in nou samewerking met SCM. Bestuur die insameling van alle dokumentasie insluitend soos-geboude planne en voorlegging aan die gesentraliseerde dokumentstoor. Bestuur die finale koste-analise van elke projek. Bestuur insette vir opdatering van koste- en ruimtenorme gebaseer op leer wat gedurende post-projek-evaluering gegenereer is. Bestuur die voorbereiding van prestasieverslae vir voorlegging aan die Konstruksiebedryfontwikkelingsraad. Bestuur die afsluiting van alle projekte en berei afsluitingsverslae voor. Keur kontrakdokumentasie soos deur die tersaaklike Infrastruktuurprofessionele voorberei goed en dien dit in voor voorlegging aan die Departementele Voorsieningskettingbestuur. Monitor dat toekennings en/of kontrakkansellasies op die vereiste databasisse vasgelê word insluitend op die CIDB-register van projekte. Lei prestasieverslae oor kontrakte wat deur die tersaaklike Infrastruktuurprofessionele voorberei word. Evalueer en beveel motiverings aan vir kwyt-skelding van boetes en skadevergoeding vir lae prestasie en dien dit in by die Departementele Voorsieningskettingbestuur. Evalueer en beveel 'n verhoging in tyd of pryse aan in terme van 'n kontrak mits dit die totaal van pryse by toekenning nie met meer as die bedrae in die Tesourie-regulasies vermeld nie. Evalueer en beveel beëindiging en/of kansellasie van kontrakte aan op grond van insette van Infrastruktuurprofessionele en Regsdiens. Analiseer aanbevelings deur die tersaaklike Infrastruktuurprofessionele en besluit oor die implementering van geskikte mitigasiestrategieë om potensiële kontraktuële implikasies op 'n proaktiewe wyse te bestuur. Verkry die insette van die Adjunkdirekteur Kontrakbestuurspesialis en die Regsdiens oor alle aspekte van kontrakbestuur. Onderneem ad hoc onafhanklike terreinbesoeke om die korrektheid van inligting wat in verslae ingedien is en die status op terreine te verifieer. Rapporteer alle nie-prestasiekwessies aan Risikobestuur. Lewer insette tot Departementele Voorsieningskettingbestuur oor die bestuur van versekerings vir groot en langtermyn-programme. Belyn die strategiese prioriteite en die werkplanne van die eenheid met die prioriteite van DID. Bestuur die voorbereiding van die jaarlike bedryfsplan. Bestuur die implementering van risiko- en mitigasieplanne. Ontwikkel infrastruktuurleweringstrategieë en -planne. Bestuur die voorbereiding en aanbieding van bestuursverslae vir infrastruktuurleweringprojekte en -vordering. Bestuur geskrewe bydraes tot departementele kwartaallikse vorderingsverslae, Jaarverslag, SCOPA, Begrotingsrede, Jaarlike Prestasieplan, ens. Onderteken prestasieooreenkomste vir ondergeskiktes op grond van goedgekeurde Werksbeskrywings, Strategiese en Jaarlike Prestasieplanne van die Departement. Bestuur ondergeskiktes en handhaaf dissipline. Bestuur opleiding en ontwikkeling van ondergeskiktes volgens ooreengekome opleidingsintervensies. Ontwikkel en werk die dienslewering- en werkplan vir ondergeskiktes by. Bestuur fondse in die eenheid in ooreenstemming met die Openbare Finansiesbestuurswet en die Tesourie-regulasies. Beperk onderbesteding of oorbesteding deur die eenheid in terme van die departementele begrotingstoewysings.

zu.title: Umholi: Izinsiza Ezakhiwe Zamanye Amaphoyinti Esezifundazweni
zu.summary: Indima yomholi okwazi ukubheka ngokusondezileyo inhlelo yokuhlela izinsiza ezakhiwe kanye nesu lokuthenga izinto zokwakha amaphoyinti esezifundazweni eGauteng Head Office eJohannesburg.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesikhathi esingeziwe ezingeni le-NQF 7 kwi-Built Environment (Engineering / Construction Project Management / Architecture / Quantity Surveying / Town and Regional Planning) njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA.
