Attributes: Programme and project management. Engineering legal and operational compliance. Engineering operational communication. Process knowledge and skills. Maintenance skills and knowledge. Engineering principles. Mobile equipment and operating skills. Technical consulting. Professional judgment. Research and Development. Creating a high-performance culture.
jobs.duties: Perform final review and approvals of audits on new engineering designs according to design principles or theory. Research the needs of the relevant health institutions. Co-ordinate design efforts and integration across disciplines to ensure seamless integration with current technology. Monitor current deployed technology. Pioneer new engineering services. Manage the execution of maintenance strategy through the provision of appropriate structures, systems and resources. Set engineering maintenance standards, specifications and service levels according to organisational objectives to ensure optimum operational availability. Monitor maintenance efficiencies according to organisational goals to direct or redirect engineering services for the attainment of organisational objectives. Allocate, control, monitor and report on all resources. Compile risk logs and manage significant risk according to sound risk management practice and organizational requirements. Provide technical consulting services for the operation on engineering related matters to minimise possible engineering risks. Manage and implement knowledge sharing initiatives e.g. short-term assignments and secondments within and across operations, in support of individual development plans, operational requirements and return on investment. Monitor the exchange and protection of information between operations and individuals to ensure effective knowledge management according to departmental objectives. Ensure the availability and management of funds to meet the MTEF objectives within the engineering environment/services. Manage the operational capital project portfolio for the operation to ensure effective resourcing according to organisational needs and objectives. Manage the commercial value add of the discipline-related programmes and projects. Facilitate the compilation of innovation proposals to ensure validity and adherence to organisational principles. Allocate, control and monitor expenditure according to budget to ensure sufficient cash flow management. Manage the development motivation and utilization of human resources for the discipline to ensure competent knowledge base for the continued success of quantity survey services according to organizational needs and requirements. Manage subordinates’ key performance areas by setting and monitoring performance standards and taking actions to correct deviations to achieve departmental objectives.

Mobiele toerusting en bedryfsvaardighede. Tegniese konsultasie. Professionele oordeel. Navorsing en Ontwikkeling. Skepping van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur.
af.duties: Voer finale hersiening en goedkeuring van oudits op nuwe ingenieursontwerpe uit volgens ontwerpbeginsels of teorie. Ondersoek die behoeftes van die tersaaklike gesondheidsinstansies. Koördineer ontwerppogings en integrasie oor dissiplines heen om naatlose integrasie met huidige tegnologie te verseker. Monitor huidige ontplooide tegnologie. Pionier nuwe ingenieursdienste. Bestuur die uitvoering van die onderhoudstrategie deur die verskaffing van toepaslike strukture, stelsels en hulpbronne. Stel ingenieursonderhoudstandaarde, spesifikasies en diensvlakke volgens organisatoriese doelwitte om optimale operationele beskikbaarheid te verseker. Monitor onderhoudsdoeltreffendheid volgens organisatoriese doelwitte om ingenieursdienste te rig of te herlei vir die bereiking van organisatoriese doelwitte. Allokasie, beheer, monitering en verslagdoening oor alle hulpbronne. Stel risiko-logboeke op en bestuur beduidende risiko volgens goeie risikobestuurspraktyk en organisatoriese vereistes. Verskaf tegniese konsultasiedienste vir die operasie oor ingenieursverwante aangeleenthede om moontlike ingenieursrisiko's te minimaliseer. Bestuur en implementeer kennisdelingsinisiatiewe bv. korttermynopdragte en uitleenings binne en oor operasies heen, ter ondersteuning van individuele ontwikkelingsplanne, operationele vereistes en opbrengs op belegging. Monitor die uitruil en beskerming van inligting tussen operasies en individue om effektiewe kennisbestuur volgens departementele doelwitte te verseker. Verseker die beskikbaarheid en bestuur van fondse om die MTEF-doelwitte binne die ingenieursomgewing/-dienste te bereik. Bestuur die operationele kapitale projekportefeulje vir die operasie om effektiewe hulpbronverskaffing volgens organisatoriese behoeftes en doelwitte te verseker. Bestuur die kommersiële meerwaarde van die dissiplineverwante programme en projekte. Fasiliteer die opstel van innovasievoorstelle om geldigheid en nakoming van organisatoriese beginsels te verseker. Allokeer, beheer en monitor besteding volgens begroting om voldoende kontantvloei-bestuur te verseker. Bestuur die ontwikkeling, motivering en benutting van menslike hulpbronne vir die dissipline om 'n bevoegde kennisbasis vir die volgehoue sukses van kwantiteitsopmetingsdienste volgens organisatoriese behoeftes en vereistes te verseker. Bestuur ondergeskiktes se sleutelprestasie-areas deur prestasie-standaarde te stel en te moniteer en maatreëls te tref om afwykings reg te stel om departementele doelwitte te bereik.

zu.title: Injiniyela Omkhulu: Kagesi/okunyakazayo
zu.summary: Isikhundla seNjiniyela Omkhulu eCharlotte Maxeke Facility Maintenance Hub eGauteng esidinga iziqu zeNQF 7 zoBunjiniyela, ukubhalisa kwi-ECSA namakhulu amashumi ayisithupha eminyaka yokuhlangenwe ndaba emva kokuqeqeshwa.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingeni (NQF 7) kuBunjiniyela boKagesi/Okunyakazayo (B Eng/ BSC Eng) noma iziqu ezithinthekayo ezivunyiwe yi-SAQA. Okungenani eminyakeni eyisithupha yokuhlangenwe ndaba ngemva kokuqeqeshwa njengenjiniyela ohunyushwe ngobungcweti. Ilayisensi yokuqasha esemthethweni. Ukubhalisa okuphoqelekile ku-ECSA njengenjiniyela ohunyushwe ngobungcweti. Ilayisensi yokuqasha esemthethweni. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngomthetho ka-1977 nezinqamuleli. Ulwazi ngomthetho weSisekelo seBunjiniyela, 2000, umthetho we-Construction Industry Development Board ka-2000 nezinqamuleli. Umthetho we-Council for Built Environment ka-2000. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-PFMA/DORA nezinqamuleli zeTreasury. Ulwazi ngazo zonke izinketho zezivumelwano kumaphrojekthi ezinsiza. Ulwazi ngeNqubomgomo ye-Departmental Supply Chain Management. Umthetho wePromotion of Access to Information ka-2000. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Broad-Based Black Empowerment ka-2003. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Preferential Procurement ka-2000 nezinqamuleli. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Public Service ka-1994 nezinqamuleli ka-2001. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Government Immovable Asset Management ka-2007. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety ka-1993 nezinqamuleli. Amakhono: Ikhono lokubusa kanye namandla okuphatha amaqembu. Ikhono lokuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlola. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuphatha iqembu. Ukuphatha izimali. Ugqozi lokunaka abathengi kanye nokuphendula. Amakhono okuxoxa kanye nokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okuphatha abantu. Ukuhlela kanye nokuqamba. Ikhono lokuphatha izinkinga kanye nokuqhathanisa. Izinto ezibakhona: Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi kanye namaphrogramu. Ukuziphendulela ngokomthetho nokusebenza kwebunjiniyela. Ukuxoxa ngokusebenza kobunjiniyela. Ulwazi namakhono ezinqubo. Amakhono nokwazi okuphathwayo. Izimiso zobunjiniyela. Amakhono okusebenzisa izinsiza ezingahambi. Ukubonisana ngezobuchwepheshe. Isahluleko sezobungcweti. Ucwaningo kanye nentuthuko. Ukudala isiko lokusebenza ngamandla aphakeme.
zu.duties: Yenza ukubuyekeza okuphelele futhi uvume izikhaso ezintsha zobunjiniyela ngokwezimiso noma inqubo yobunjiniyela. Cwaninga izidingo zezikhungo ezithintekayo zezempilo. Hlela ngokubambisana imizamo yokuklama kanye nokuhlanganisa phakathi kwamakhono ngokwezinhlobonhlobo ngenhloso yokuvumelana nobuchwepheshe besikhathi esiphila kubo. Bhekisisa ubuchwepheshe besikhathi esiphila kubo. Qedisa izinsiza ezintsha zobunjiniyela. Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwenqubo yokulungisa izinto ngenhlangano yezakhiwo, izinhlelo namathuluzi afanelekile. Hlela amazinga okulungisa izinto zobunjiniyela, izinkomba namazinga enkonzo ngemigomo yenhlangano ngenhloso yokuvumelana nentengo ephezulu yokuba khona kokusebenza. Hlola ukusebenza okulungile ngemigomo yenhlangano ukuze ukhombise noma uqondise kabusha izinsiza zobunjiniyela ngokufeza imigomo yenhlangano. Hlinzeka ngamathuluzi, lawula, bhekisisa futhi umbike ngawo wonke amathuluzi. Hlela irekhodi lezingozi futhi uphathe izingozi ezinkulu ngokwezinqubo ezinhle zokuphatha izingozi nezidingo zenhlangano. Nikeza amasevisi okubonisana ngezobuchwepheshe ngemisebenzi ehlobene nobunjiniyela ukuze kuncishiswe izingozi ezithize zobunjiniyela. Phatha futhi usebenzise izinhlelo zokwabelana ngolwazi njengamathuluzi okubeka iziqondiso nangokuthunyelwa kwemisebenzi phakathi nokudlula emisebenzini ngokwesekela izinhlela zokuqeqesha abantu, izidingo zokusebenza nenzuzo yokutshalwa imali. Bhekisisa ukushintshiselana nokuvikelwa kolwazi phakathi kokusebenza kanye nabantu ukuze kuqiniseke ukuphathwa kolwazi okusebenzayo ngokwezinhloso zomnyango. Qinisekisa ukutholakala nokuphathwa kwezimali ngokufeza imigomo ye-MTEF ngaphakathi kwezikhungo noma izinsiza zobunjiniyela. Phatha ibhalansi yephrojekthi yamandla emisebenzi yephrojekthi ukuze kuqiniseke ukusetshenziswa kwamathuluzi ngokwezidingo nezinhloso zenhlangano. Phatha inani elengezwa ngokwezohwebo lwamaphrogramu kanye namaphrojekthi ahlobene. Khokhela uhlelo lwezindulo ezintsha ukuze kuqinisekise ukusemthethweni kanye nokulandela izimiso zenhlangano. Hlinzeka ngamathuluzi, lawula kanye nokubhekisisa ukusebenzisa imali ngokwebajeti ukuthi kuqiniseke ukulawulwa kwegxabo ephilayo. Phatha ukuthuthuka, ukukhuthaza nokusebenzisa amathuluzi abantu ohlelweni olufanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwazi okusebenzayo ngokufeza impumelelo eqhubekayo kumasevisi obugcwelesi njengoba kudingwa izidingo zenhlangano. Phatha izindawo eziyinhloso zokwenza izinkinga kubahlosi ngokusetha kanye nokubheka amazinga okusebenza futhi uthathe izinyathelo zokulungisa iziphakeme ukuze kufezwe imigomo yomnyango.

xh.title: Injini Ephambili: Kwezombane/nyanzi
xh.summary: Isithuba senjini ethuthukileyo kwiCharlotte Maxeke Facility Maintenance Hub eGauteng sifuna isidanga seNQF 7 kwInjini, ukujingelelwa kwi-ECSA neminyaka yamagqabi e-6 yamava emva kokugqiba isidanga.
xh.requirements: Isidanga kwinqanaba (NQF 7) kwiNjini yamandla ombane/ yezinyanzi (B Eng/ BSC Eng) okanye ngesidanga esifanelekileyo esivunyelwe yi-SAQA. Okungaphantsi kweminyaka yamagqabi eyi-6 yamava emva kokugqiba isidanga njengenjini yobuchwepheshe egqithiswe njengengcali. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ukujingelelwa ngokuyimfuneko njengengcali kwi-ECSA njengenjini yobuchwepheshe egqithiswe njengengcali. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngomthetho ka-1977 namalungiselelo. Ulwazi ngomthetho weNkonzo yeNjini, 2000, nomthetho weBhunga loPhuhliso lweMizi-mveliso yokuVaka ka-2000 namalungiselelo. Umthetho weBhunga leNdalo eVakalwe ngo-2000. Ulwazi nge-PFMA/DORA/Izixhobo zokuLawula iNdalimdibaniso. Ulwazi ngazo zonke iinketho zezenkonzo ezahlukeneyo zamageza aphakathi kweendawo ezakhiweyo. Ulwazi ngeNgqungquthela yezeMveliso nokuLawulwa kweeNkonzo zeSebe (Supply Chain Management). Umthetho wokuKhuthaza uFikelelo lulwazi ngo-2000. Ulwazi ngomthetho weNkululeko yoQoqosho yeSizwe jikelele ka-2003. Ulwazi ngomthetho wokuThengwa ngokukhethwa kokuQatywa kuQoqosho ka-2000 namalungiselelo. Ulwazi ngomthetho weNkonzo kaRhulumente ka-1994 namalungiselelo ka-2001. Ulwazi ngomthetho woLawulo lwemiQulu yeqoqosho kaRhulumente ezingatshatanga kwiindlu ka-2007. Ulwazi ngomthetho woLawulo lwezeMpilo nokuKhuselwa eMsebenzini ka-1993 namalungiselelo. Amaphepha: Amandla okucinga okusemgangathweni namandla okukhokela. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqonda ngokunjalo. Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukukhokela iqela. Ukulawula imali. Ukuqwalasela iimfuno zabathengi nokuphendula. Unxibelelwano nakhono lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amandla okulawula abantu. Ukuqamba nokuhlela. Ukuphathwa kolwalule nakhono lokuxoxisana. Iimpawu: Ukulawula iinkqubo namaphrojekthi. Ukuthobela umthetho kwayenza kusebenze ngokomthetho injini. Unxibelelwano olusebenzayo kuhlelo lwenjini. Ulwazi nakhono lweenkqubo. Ulwazi nakhono lokulungisa. Iinkqubo zenjini. Ulwazi ngemishini yamandla nekhono lokuyisebenzisa. Ingcebiso ngomchini. Isigqibo esingcali. Uphononongo nophuhliso. Ukudala inkqubo yamandla aphezulu okusebenza.
xh.duties: Yenza uphononongo lokugqibela nikugunyaziswe iingxoxo ezintsha kwimiba yenjini ngokwezimvo zokwakha okanye inzululwazi. Phanda iimfuno zeziko lempilo. Lawula iinkqubo zoyilo nokudibanisa iindawo ukunqezela ukudityaniswa phakathi kobuchwepheshe ngaphandle kolahleko kumanzi. Qwalasela ubuchwepheshe obusetyenziswayo okwangoku. Qamba iindlela ezintsha zezenkonzo zenjini. Lawula ukwenziwa kweenkqubo zokulungisa ngokunika iindawo, iinkqobo nethemba elifanelekileyo. Misela iinkqobo zokulungisa injini, iinkqobo zemigqaqo nemida yeenkonzo kwizimvo zenkundla ukuze kugqitywe kwelungiselelwe ukuba ekulungele. Qwalasela iziphumezo ngokulungisa izinto kwizimbo zenkundla ukunqamisa okanye ukuguqula iindlela zokusebenza injini ukuze kugqitywe ezinye izinto ngokumgama ojikeleileyo owenziweyo. Ukunika, ukulawula, ukuqwalasela nokuchaza ngawo onke amathemba. Hlela iingxaki ezikhoyo ezibhaliweyo ulawule iingxaki ezilungele ukuphathwa ngokwemigaqo ethembekileyo nokumiselwa ngokwefakthathi. Khokeza kuphuhliswe iindlela ezintsha zokwaziswa ukuxhasa iindlela ezijoliswe kukuphuhlisa ngaphakathi nangaphandle kweekqubo ngokulandela iindlela ezichaziwe kwimigaqo-mthetho yenkundla ngexesha elikhuswa kwesisiseko-mgama sokutsha kweemfuno. Qwalasela ukugqibela nokudibana ngokwengxaki yamathemba ukunqezela ukuphumeza amagunya ngokwesebe njengoko kulindelekile. Qinisekisa ukuba khona nokuqondwa ngokumtyala ngokumthetho ukuba linganankqubo zokuba sebenzise iinkalo ezibekiweyo kweMTEF ngokweemfuno zomntu okwangoku kwakunye namaza okusingathwa. Lawula isikolo samaphrojekthi okuyiyo ngokuphathwa kweemfuno ezahlukeneyo kwinkundla ekunikelwa kuzo ukunqezela ukulinganiselwa kwamandla emali. Lawula ixabiso elifanele kwimicimbe eyahlukeneyo okuyiyo. Khokelela kukugqitywa koluhlu olunikelwa kubantu kuquka namaphulo kwindlela ezijoliswe kumbono wesizwe ngokuhamba kweyona ndlela ingazange kumgama wokubakho kwemigqaqo. Hlela amaqhalo abaliweyo nokwabiwa kwamafa athengise ngexesha elisemthethweni ukunqezela ukulunga kwamafu. Lawula ukuba khona kubakho imfuneko eqinisekisa nokuwasebenzisela kwindlela ezicwanguliswayo ukunqezela ulwazi olulungeleyo kubantu abakhokelayo ngokwemfuno yesisebe ngokwemigaqo-mthetho eshiweyo. Lawula izimbo zabantu abangaphantsi kwakho ngokumisela nokuphatha iinkalo ezibekiweyo ngokusebenzisa iinkqobo zokugqibela nokuwasebenzisela ngokulinganisela imigama ngexesha elithileyo ukuba kuqondwe iinkalo ezihamba ngokomgaqo-mthetho njengoko kulindelekile.

jobs.summary: Chief Quantity Surveyor needed at the Department of Infrastructure Development in Johannesburg to manage immovable asset management, requiring SACQSP registration and six years' experience.

Co- ordinate quantity survey efforts and integration across disciplines to ensure seamless integration with current technology through the provision of appropriate structures, systems and resources. Set quantity survey standards, specifications and service levels according to organizational objectives to ensure optimum operational availability. Monitor quantity survey efficiencies according to organizational goals to direct or redirect quantity survey services for the attainment of organizational objectives. Ensure availability and management of funds to meet the MTEF objectives within the quantity survey environment/services. Manage the operational capital project portfolio for the operation to ensure effective resourcing according to organizational needs and objectives. Manage the commercial added value of the discipline-related programmes and projects. Facilitate the compilation of innovation proposals to ensure validity and adherence to organizational principles. Allocate, monitor, control expenditure according to budget to ensure efficient cash flow management. Allocate, monitor and control resources. Compile risk logs (database) and manage significant risk according to sound risk management practice and organizational requirements. Provide technical specialist services for the operation of quantity survey related matters to minimize possible risks Manage and implement knowledge sharing initiatives in support of individual development plans, operational requirements and return on investment. Continuously monitor the exchange and protection of information between operations and individuals to ensure effective knowledge management according to departmental objectives. Manage the development motivation and utilization of human resources for the discipline to ensure competent knowledge base for the continued success of quantity survey services according to organizational needs and requirements. Manage subordinates’ key performance areas by setting and monitoring performance standards and taking actions to correct deviations to achieve departmental objectives.

zu.requirements: I-Degree kwi-Quantity Surveying noma izifundo ezihlobene. Amaphuzu angu-6 wonke eminyeni yawo wonke ukuxhumana nokuqashiswa izinani noma umphumela ohlobene. Isibopho sokubhalisa kwi-SACQSP njengomqashiwe njengomqashi.
zu.duties: Yenza ukubuyekezwa kokugcina nokuvuma noma ukuhlola izinqubo zokuqakashela izinani. Hlela futhi uhlanganise imizamo yokuqakashela izinani kuye kokunye ukuqinisekisa ukuhlanganisela okuhamba kahle nobuchwepheshe bamanje ngokunikezwa kwezakhi, izinhlelo kanye nezinsiza ezifanele. Hlela amazinga okuqakashela izinani, izinkomba kanye namazinga enkonzo ngokusho kohlelo lwenhlangano ukuqinisekisa ukutholakala okugcwele kokusebenza. Qapha ukusebenza kahle kokuqakashela izinani ngokusho nenhloso yenhlangano ukuqondisa noma ukuqondisa kabusha izinsiza zokuqashiswa izinani ukuze kufinyelelwe kuhlelo lenhlangano. Qinisekisa ukutholakala nokuphathwa kwezimali ukuhambelana nezinhloso ze-MTEF phakathi kwendawo/ezinsiza zokuqakashela izinani. Phatha ikhabethe lephulo lezinsiza zokusebenza zensimbi ukuqinisekisa ukwenziwa kwemisebenzi ngempumelelo ngokoshadingo benhlangano kanye nezinhloso. Phatha inani elingeziwe lezinhlelo nezinhlelo ezihlobene nomthwosimo. Sekela ukuhlelwa kwezindlela zokusungula izinto ezintsha ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza kanye nokulandelwa kwemigomo yenhlangano. Aba, qapha, lawula imali yokuchithwa ngokwesabelo ukuqinisekisa ukulawula imali egijimayo. Aba, qapha futhi ulawule izinsiza. Hlela ukuqoshwa kwezingozi (isiqukathi sezinto) futhi ulawule ingozi enkulu ngokuya endleleni elungile yokulawula ingozi noshadingo wenhlangano. Nikeza izinsiza zobuchwepheshe ekusebenziseni izinto ezihlobene nokuqashiswa izinani ukunciphisa ingozi. Phatha futhi ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokwabelana ngolwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kwabaholi, izidingo zokusebenza kanye nenzuzo yokutshalwa kwezimali. Qhubeka qapha ukushintshiselana nokuvikelwa kolwazi phakathi kokusebenza kanye nabantu ukuqinisekisa ukulawula ulwazi ngempumelelo ngokusho nenhloso yomnyango. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa, ukukhuthazwa nokusetshenziswa kolwazi ngemithwalo yocansi ukuqinisekisa ukwazi okuhlakaniphe kokuqhubeka ngempumelelo kwezinsiza zokuqashiswa izinani ngokoshadingo nenzuzo yenhlangano. Phatha izindawo eziyinhloko zokuqashiswa izinani ngokusho nenhloso yomnyango kanye noshadingo.

xh.title: Um lawuli oPhezulu woMlinganiselo Grade A-C
xh.summary: Kufuneka uMlawuli oPhezulu woMlinganiselo kwiSebe lePhuhliso lweZakhiwo eJohannesburg ukulawula ulawulo lwamaxabiso angahambeki, kufuneka abhalise kwiSACQSP aneminyaka elithandathu yamava.
xh.requirements: Isidanga kwiLawulo loMlinganiselo okanye izifundo ezifanelekileyo. Kufuneka abe neminyaka engu-6 ubuncinane yamava njengomlawuli womlinganiselo emva kokuqesha isidanga sakhe. Kuyimfuneko ukubhalisa kwiSACQSP njengoMlawuli oPhezulu woMlinganiselo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngoMthetho woPhuhliso woBummi ka-1994. IzoMthetho zoPhuhliso woBummi ka-2016. I-PFMA nemiThetho yeNdlu yoVimba. Iindlela zamazwe ngamazwe/eeNqongo zesebe ze-SCM. UMthetho woLawulo lweMaxabiso angahambeki kaRhulumente ka-2007. UMthetho weeZindlela zoMakhiwo zelizwe ka-1977 nemiThetho. UMthetho we Mpilo, Ukhuseleko, nokuKhuseleka emsebenzini ka-1993 nemiThetho. UMthetho weMpilo, imiThetho neNqongo ezilawulayo. UMthetho woBuchwepheshe ka-2000. UMthetho weeZindlela zoMakhiwo zelizwe ka-1977, imiThetho neNqongo zeNdlu yoLawulo. Ulawulo lweenkqubo namaphulo. Ulawulo lomthetho kwaye nokuzelelwa ngokomthetho ekulawulweni komlinganiselo. Unxibelelwano ekusebenzeni kolawulo lomlinganiselo. Ulwazi nakhono lwenkqubo. Ulwazi nakhono lokulungisa. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa izixhobo ezihambahambayo. Uphando nophuhliso. Iinkqubo zokusebenza ngekhompyutha eceda ubuchwepheshe- Ukuxazulula iingxaki kunye novo lokuhlalutya, ulawulo lweemali, unxibelelwano, amakhono ekhompyutha, amakhono okucinga.
xh.duties: Yenza ukuhlola okugqibeleleyo kwaye uvume okanye wenze ukuvavanyo kwindlela yolawulo lomlinganiselo. Qondanisa imizamo yolawulo lomlinganiselo kwaye uDibanise kumagatya abalawuli ukuze kuqinisekiswe uDibaniso olusetyenziswa ngobuchwepheshe bamaje ubomi ngokuqikelela iinkqubo, amacebo nenzuzo ezifanelekileyo. Misela imilinganiselo yolawulo lomlinganiselo, iinkcukacha kunye namazinga enkonzo ngokomgomo wakho-nkqubo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthe ngqo kokusebenza. Lilisele isebenza kolawulo lomlinganiselo ngokomgomo wakho-nkqubo ukuyala okanye ukuqamba inkonzo yolawulo lomlinganiselo ukuze kufikelelwe kumgomo wakho-nkqubo. Qinisekisa ukubakho kunye nokulawula imali ukuze kuhlangabezane namagosa e-MTEF kwimo/nkonzo yolawulo lomlinganiselo. Lawula ibhanki yamaphulo ekapa-phendla ukusebenza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukubonelelwa okusebenzayo ngokomfuno nomgomo wakho-nkqubo. Lawula ixabiso elongeziweyo lempahla yamaphulo kunye namaphulo ahlobene nerektha. Qhutyela ukuqulunqa iingcamu zophuhliso ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza nokuzithoba ngokomgomo wakho-nkqubo. Sabela ukuqwalasela ulawulo lwemali ngokwe bajeti ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulawula kolwelo lwegazi. Sabela ukuqwalasela ulawulo lweenzuzo. Qulunqa iingxelo ezingozi (idatabase) kwaye ulawule ingozi ebalulekileyo ngokwezindlela ezilungileyo zolawulo lwengozi nangokomfuno wakho-nkqubo. Bonelela ngenkonzo yochwepheshe yobugcisa ekusebenzeni kwezinto ezihlobene lolawulo lomlinganiselo ukuze kuncitshiswe iingozi ezinokubakho Lawula kwaye uphuhlise iinkqubo zokwabelana ngolwazi ngenkxaso yamacebo ephuhliso komntu ngamnye, izidingo zokusebenza nenzuzo yemali entsheni. Qhoboshela ukuqwalasela ukutshintshiselana nokhuselo lolwazi phakathi kokusebenza nabantu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulawulo lolwazi olusebenzayo ngokomgomo wesebe. Lawula ukuphuhlisa kwamandla nokusebenzisa amandla abantu kwirektha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulwazi olunamandla ngokuqhubekayo nempumelelo yolonke lolawulo lomlinganiselo ngokomfuno nangokomgomo wakho-nkqubo. Lawula amagosa onqwenela abo ngokumisela nokuphatha imilinganiselo yesebenzi kwaye uthathe izigqibo zokulungisa iindleko zokwenza iNgqonyela ukuba kufikelelwe kwizigqibo zesebe.

jobs.summary: Deputy Director overseeing soft services and facilities maintenance within the Gauteng Department of Infrastructure Development's property portfolio, based at Head Office in Johannesburg.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification at NQF level 6 or 7 as recognised by SAQA in Property Management/Facilities Management/ Built Environment. A minimum of 5 years relevant experience, of which 3 years must be at ASD level. A valid driver’s license. Competencies: Construction Industry Development Board Act of 2000 and Regulations. Council for Built Environment Act of 2000.PFMA and Treasury Regulations. Provincial/Departmental Supply Chain Management Policies. Promotion of Access to Information Act of 2000. Promotion of Administrative Justice Act of 2000.Skills: Strategic capability and leadership. Problem solving and analysis Decision making. Team leadership Creativity Financial management. Attributes: People-centred, Professionalism, Self- management Reliability Honesty and integrity Strong ethics.
jobs.duties: The incumbent is responsible for the effective management of soft services within the departmental property portfolio, and in that capacity conducts site visits and condition assessments to determine soft service requirements. The incumbent ensures that all facilities are maintained at habitable and hygienic standards, fit for occupation and for the purposes for which they are used. The incumbent manages the delivery of cleaning and hygiene services in compliance with contractual specifications, service level agreements, the Occupational Health and Safety Act, 1993 (Act 85 of 1993) and its regulations, and applicable public health requirements. The incumbent also manages waste removal, grounds maintenance and gardening services in compliance with the National Environmental Management Act, 1998 (Act 107 of 1998), the National Environmental Management: Waste Act, 2008 (Act 59 of 2008) and applicable municipal by-laws, including the lawful handling, segregation, storage, removal and disposal of general and hazardous waste. Pest control and fumigation programmes are implemented in accordance with approved schedules and applicable legislation, including the use of duly registered operators and approved products and the safe handling of hazardous chemical substances. The incumbent maintains and updates project and facility information for all sites under the unit’s management. The incumbent ensures that all equipment used by staff is in good functional, safe and serviceable condition, that statutory inspections and certification requirements are met, and that equipment is operated by competent persons. Repairs are managed so that defects are attended to timeously and within approved budgets, with priority given to defects that compromise health, safety, hygiene or environmental compliance. The incumbent plans and liaises with Supply Chain Management and Director Facilities Maintenance and for the timeous procurement of the consumables, supplies and spares required and service providers in compliance with the applicable procurement prescripts and with due regard to safety data requirements and environmentally responsible specifications. At a strategic and planning level, the incumbent provides inputs into the development of soft services and maintenance policies, strategies and plans, and manages the preparation of the unit’s annual operational plan. The incumbent oversees the implementation of risk management and mitigation plans, which include occupational health and safety, environmental and hygiene risks, and monitors service providers’ compliance with their statutory obligations, including health and safety plans, risk assessments, incident reporting and the provision of appropriate personal protective equipment. The incumbent manages the preparation and presentation of management reports on soft services performance, on compliance with occupational health and safety, environmental and hygiene requirements, and on the maintenance and repair of equipment. In respect of people management, the incumbent concludes performance agreements with subordinates, aligned to approved job descriptions and the Department’s Strategic and Annual Performance Plans. The incumbent manages subordinates and maintains discipline in accordance with the applicable labour relations prescripts. The incumbent also manages their training and development in accordance with agreed developmental interventions, including training required for statutory compliance in health and safety, and develops and updates their service delivery and work plans. The incumbent promotes a safe working environment for staff and service providers’ employees in terms of the Occupational Health and Safety Act, 1993. Regarding appointment of service providers, the official to prepare specifications for procurement of outsourced services and manage contracts with appointed service providers within applicable policies and Treasury prescripts. Finally, the incumbent manages the unit’s funds in compliance with the Public Finance Management Act, 1999 and the Treasury Regulations, and limits under-expenditure and over-expenditure in accordance with the departmental budget allocations.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Sagte Dienste en Onderhoud van
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur wat toesighouing oor sagte dienste en fasiliteite-onderhoud binne die Gauteng Department of Infrastructure Development se eiendomportefeulje behartig, gesetel by die Hoofkantoor in Johannesburg.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 6 of 7 soos deur SAQA erken in Property Management/Facilities Management/Built Environment. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se relevante ervaring, waarvan 3 jaar op ASD-vlak moet wees. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Construction Industry Development Board Act of 2000 and Regulations. Council for Built Environment Act of 2000. PFMA and Treasury Regulations. Provincial/Departmental Supply Chain Management Policies. Promotion of Access to Information Act of 2000. Promotion of Administrative Justice Act of 2000. Vaardighede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Probleemoplossing en ontleding Besluitneming. Spanleierskap Kreatiwiteit Finansiële bestuur. Eienskappe: Mensegesentreerd, Professionaliteit, Selfbestuur Betroubaarheid Eerlikheid en integriteit Sterk etiek.
af.duties: Die ampsdraer is verantwoordelik vir die doeltreffende bestuur van sagte dienste binne die departementele eiendomportefeulje, en in daardie hoedanigheid voer hy werfsbesoeke en toestandassesserings uit om vereistes vir sagte dienste te bepaal. Die ampsdraer verseker dat alle fasiliteite op bewoonbare en higiëniese standaarde gehou word, geskik vir bewoning en vir die doeleindes waarvoor dit gebruik word. Die ampsdraer bestuur die lewering van skoonmaak- en higiënedienste in ooreenstemming met kontrakspesifikasies, diensvlakooreenkomste, die Occupational Health and Safety Act, 1993 (Act 85 of 1993) en sy regulasies, en toepaslike openbare gesondheidsvereistes. Die ampsdraer bestuur ook afvalverwydering, gronderhoud en tuindiens in ooreenstemming met die National Environmental Management Act, 1998 (Act 107 of 1998), die National Environmental Management: Waste Act, 2008 (Act 59 of 2008) en toepaslike munisipale verordeninge, insluitend die wettige hantering, skeiding, berging, verwydering en wegdoening van algemene en gevaarlike afval. Plaagbeheer- en ontsmettingsprogramme word ooreenkomstig goedgekeurde skedules en toepaslike wetgewing geïmplementeer, insluitend die gebruik van behoorlik geregistreerde operateurs en goedgekeurde produkte, asook die veilige hantering van gevaarlike chemiese stowwe. Die ampsdraer handhaaf en werk projek- en fasiliteitinligting vir alle terreine onder die eenheid se bestuur by. Die ampsdraer verseker dat alle toerusting wat deur personeel gebruik word in goeie funksionele, veilige en bruikbare toestand is, dat statutêre inspeksies en sertifiseringsvereistes nagekom word, en dat toerusting deur bevoegde persone bedryf word. Herstelwerk word bestuur sodat gebreke tydig en binne goedgekeurde begrotings aangespreek word, met voorrang gegee aan gebreke wat gesondheid, veiligheid, higiëne of omgewingsvolhoubaarheid in gedrang bring. Die ampsdraer beplan en skakel met Supply Chain Management en die Direkteur Fasiliteite-onderhoud vir die tydige verkryging van die benodigde verbruiksgoedere, voorrade en onderdele en diensverskaffers in ooreenstemming met die toepaslike verkrygingsvoorskrifte en met behoorlike inagneming van veiligheidsdatavereistes en omgewingsverantwoordelike spesifikasies. Op 'n strategiese en beplanningsvlak verskaf die ampsdraer insette tot die ontwikkeling van sagte dienste- en onderhoudsbeleide, -strategieë en -planne, en bestuur die voorbereiding van die eenheid se jaarlikse operasionele plan. Die ampsdraer hou toesig oor die implementering van risikobestuur- en -beperkingsplanne, wat beroepsgesondheids- en -veiligheids-, omgewings- en higiënerisiko's insluit, en monitor diensverskaffers se nakoming van hul statutêre verpligtinge, insluitend gesondheids- en veiligheidsplanne, risiko-assesserings, voorvalverslagdoening en die voorsiening van toepaslike persoonlike beskermende toerusting. Die ampsdraer bestuur die voorbereiding en aanbieding van bestuursverslae oor die prestasie van sagte dienste, oor nakoming van beroepsgesondheids- en -veiligheids-, omgewings- en higiënevereistes, en oor die onderhoud en herstel van toerusting. Met betrekking tot personeelbestuur sluit die ampsdraer prestasieooreenkomste met ondergeskiktes af, in ooreenstemming met goedgekeurde posbeskrywings en die departement se Strategiese en Jaarlikse Prestasieplanne. Die ampsdraer bestuur ondergeskiktes en handhaaf dissipline in ooreenstemming met die toepaslike arbeidsverhoudingsvoorskrifte. Die ampsdraer bestuur ook hul opleiding en ontwikkeling in ooreenstemming met ooreengekome ontwikkelingsintervensies, insluitend opleiding wat vir statutêre nakoming van gesondheid en veiligheid vereis word, en ontwikkel en werk hul dienslewering- en werksplanne by. Die ampsdraer bevorder 'n veilige werksomgewing vir personeel en diensverskaffers se werknemers ingevolge die Occupational Health and Safety Act, 1993. Met betrekking tot die aanstelling van diensverskaffers berei die beampte spesifikasies voor vir die verkryging van uitbestee dienste en bestuur kontrakte met aangestelde diensverskaffers binne toepaslike beleide en Treasury-voorskrifte. Laastens bestuur die ampsdraer die eenheid se fondse in ooreenstemming met die Public Finance Management Act, 1999 en die Treasury Regulations, en beperk onderbesteding en oorbesteding in ooreenstemming met die departementele begrotingsallocasies.

zu.title: ONozulu: Isevisi Ezincane Nokugcinwa Kwakho
zu.summary: ONozulu ohlola isevisi ezincane kanye nokugcinwa kwemisebenzi ngaphakathi kwesifuba sezakhiwo seGauteng Department of Infrastructure Development, esekelwe eNdlunkulu eJohannesburg.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingaphansi kokuqeqeshwa kwesikhungo ezingeni le-NQF level 6 noma 7 njengoba kubonwa yi-SAQA kwi-Property Management/Facilities Management/Built Environment. Ukwazi okungenani eminyaka eyi-5, lapho kufanele kube ngeminyaka eyi-3 ezingeni le-ASD. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Amakhono: i-Construction Industry Development Board Act of 2000 kanye ne-Regulations. I-Council for Built Environment Act of 2000. I-PFMA kanye ne-Treasury Regulations. I-Provincial/Departmental Supply Chain Management Policies. I-Promotion of Access to Information Act of 2000. I-Promotion of Administrative Justice Act of 2000. Amakhono: Ikakhuluzi lokuhlela kanye nobuholi. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nanhlathulula. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ubuholi besiqhalavahli. Ukudala. Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Izici: Abantu abagcwatshiwe, Ukuziphatha okuhle, Ukuzibusa. Ukwethembeka. Ukuqotho kanye nobulungiswa. Izimilo ezomehlangothi.
zu.duties: Umntu oseqhamentweni unomthwalo wokuphatha ngokusebenzayo isevisi ezincane ngaphakathi kwesifuba sezakhiwo somnyango, futhi kulelo khono wenza ukuvakashela izindawo kanye nokuhlola izimo ukuze athole izidingo zezevisi ezincane. Umnthu oseqhamentweni uqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izakhiwo zigcinwa ezimeni eziphilayo kanye nenhlanzeko, ezifanele ukuziwa kanye nemitsho yalokho okusetshenziswa kuzona. Umnthu oseqhamentweni uphatha ukulethwa kwezinkonzo zokuhlanza kanye nenhlanzeko ngokuhambisana nemiyalo yesehlukanisi, izivumelwano zesikhungo, i-Occupational Health and Safety Act, 1993 (Act 85 of 1993) kanye nemithethwayo yayo, kanye nezidingo ezifanele zezempilo yomphakathi. Umnthu oseqhamentweni futhi uphatha ukukhishwa kokuhamba, ukugcinwa kwemikhando kanye nezinkonzo zensimbi ngokuhambisana ne-National Environmental Management Act, 1998 (Act 107 of 1998), i-National Environmental Management: Waste Act, 2008 (Act 59 of 2008) kanye nemithetho ye-municipal by-laws, okuhlanganisa ukuphathwa ngokumthetho, ukuhlukanisa, ukugcina, ukukhipha kanye nokulahla ukuzila okuvamile kanye nokwesabekayo. Amahlelo okulawula izinsect kanye nokuthunza bayenziwa ngokuhambisana nesikhathi esivunyiwe kanye nomthetho osemthethweni, okuhlanganisa ukusetshenziswa kwabahlinzeki ababhalisiwe ngokusemthethweni kanye nemikhiqizo evunyiwe kanye nokuphatha ngokuphepha izinto ezinkimbinkimbi ezingesabekayo. Umnthu oseqhamentweni ugcina kanye nabuyisela ulwazi lwephrojekthi kanye nesikhungo kuzo zonke izindawo eziphansi kokuphathwa kweyuniti. Umnthu oseqhamentweni uqinisekisa ukuthi wonke amagajethi asetshenziswa abasebenzi asezigabeni ezihle, eziphephile futhi ezisebenzayo, ukuthi izitlolondawo eziyimithetho nezidingo zokuqinisekiswa kufinyelelwe, kanye nokuthi amagajethi ashaywe abantu abanamakhono. Ukulungiswa kuphathwa kangangokuba iziphazekiso ziphathwe ngokushesha futhi ngaphakathi kwezibhajethi ezivunyiwe, ngokunikezwa ikakhuluzi iziphazekiso ezibeka engozini impilo, ukuphepha, inhlanzeko noma ukuzwela kwezimo. Umnthu oseqhamentweni uhlela futhi exhuma ne-Supply Chain Management kanye ne-Director Facilities Maintenance ukuze kuthengeke ngokushesha okudingekayo ukudla, izinsiza kanye nezesantsi kanye nabahlinzeki besevisi ngokuhambisana nemiyalo yokuthenga esebenzayo kanye nokunaka izidingo zedatha yokuphepha kanye nezinkomba ezinomthwalo wokwaziswa komphakathi. Ezingeni le-strategic kanye nohlelo, umntu oseqhamentweni unikeza imibhalo ekutholeni kwezinkambiso, amasu kanye namaphulani zezevisi ezincane kanye nokugcinwa, futhi uphatha ukulungiswa kohlelo lonyaka lokuqhuba kweyuniti. Umnthu oseqhamentweni uqapha ukusetshenziswa kwehlelo lokuphatha kanye nokunciphisa izingozi, okuhlanganisa ingozi yokuphepha kwezokwenzakala emsebenzini, kwezemuva kanye nenhlanzeko, futhi ubhekisa ukuzwela kwabahlinzeki besevisi kumthwalo wabo womthetho, okuhlanganisa amaphulani okuphepha kwezempilo, ukuhlola izingozi, ukubika izehlakalo kanye nokunikezwa kwesixhumi esifanele sokuvikela umzimba. Umnthu oseqhamentyoni uphatha ukulungiswa kanye nokubukiswa kwemibiko yokuphatha ngemisebenzi yezevisi ezincane, ngokuzwela kwemithetho yezempilo yokuphepha kwezokwenzakala emsebenzini, kwezemuva kanye nenhlanzeko, kanye nokugcinwa nokulungiswa kwamagajethi. Ekuphathweni kwabantu, umntu oseqhamentyoni wenza izivumelwano zemisebenzi nabagcinisi, ehambisana nezinkcazelo zemisebenzi ezivunyiwe kanye namaphulani a-Strategic kanye nama-Annual Performance Plans e-Department. Umnthu oseqhamentyoni uphatha abagcinisi kanye nogcina isithunzi ngokuhambisana nemithetho ephathelene neziqu zabasebenzi. Umnthu oseqhamentyoni futhi uphatha ukuqeqeshwa kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwabo ngokuhambisana nezindlela zokuthuthukisa ezivunyelwe, okuhlanganisa ukuqeqeshwa okudingekayo ukuze kuhambisane nomthetho kokuphepha kwezempilo, futhi yakha kanye nokubuyisela amaphulani abo bokuletha isevisi kanye nomsebenzi. Umnthu oseqhamentyoni ukhuthaza indawo yokusebenza ephephile kubasebenzi kanye nabasebenzi babahlinzeki besevisi ngokwesimu se-Occupational Health and Safety Act, 1993. Ekubekweni kwabahlinzeki besevisi, lowo mntu kufanele alungise izinkomba zokuthengiswa kwezinsiza eziyisikhungo ababashiya abangaphandle futhi aphathe izinkontula zabahlinzeki besevisi ababekwe ngaphakathi kwezinkambiso ezisebenzayo kanye nemithetho ye-Treasury. Ekugcineni, umntu oseqhamentyoni uphatha imali yeyunithi ngokuhambisana ne-Public Finance Management Act, 1999 kanye ne-Treasury Regulations, futhi anciphisa ukuchithwa kancane kanye nokuchithwa kakhulu ngokuhambisana nokwabiwa kwezibhajethi komnyango.

xh.title: Iseyibi loMlawuli: Iinkonzo ezithambileyo nokuZinza kwe
xh.summary: Iseyibi loMlawuli elilawula iinkonzo ezithambileyo nokuqinisekiswa kweempahla kwisithungo seGauteng Department of Infrastructure Development, esekwe kwindlu enkulu eJohannesburg.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso se-undergraduate kumqobo weNQF level 6 okanye 7 njengokuqatshiwa yiSAQA kwiProperty Management/Facilities Management/Built Environment. Amava obuntu aqinisekileyo eminye iminyaka eli-5, apho kwakufuneka kubekho iminyaka eli-3 kwi-ASD level. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Iikhompetensi: iConstruction Industry Development Board Act ka-2000 nemiGalelo. iCouncil for Built Environment Act ka-2000. IPFMA nemiGalelo yeTreasury. Iimigaqo yeProvincial/Departmental Supply Chain Management. IPromotion of Access to Information Act ka-2000. IPromotion of Administrative Justice Act ka-2000. Amakhono: Ulwazi lokuqamba amacebo nokulawula. Ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuqonda ngokwendlela eziyakuthi ngayo. Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukulawula iqela. Ukudala. Ulawulo lweemali. Iimpawu zobuuntu: Ukuqonda abantu, Ubugcisa bokwenza umsebenzi, Ukuzekelela ngokwakho. Uthembeko. Uqinisileyo nentlalontle. Imigaqo ethembekileyo.
xh.duties: Umsebenzisi uthathwa njengelowazi ngokulawula ngempumelelo iinkonzo ezithambileyo kwisithungo sempahla senkundla, kwaye kulo msebenzi uqhuba iindwendwe ezindaweni zokusebenza nokuqinisekiswa ngemiba yazo ukuze anqume iimfuno zezinkonzo ezithambileyo. Umsebenzisi uqinisekisa ukuba zonke iindawo zibohlwa zimihlaba ngokwemigaqo ehlanahlene nangendlela enokusetyenziselwa abantu, zilungele ukuhlala nakwindlela eziqheliswe kuzo. Umsebenzisi ulawula ukunikwa kwezinkonzo zokucoxa nangokuhlanzwa ngokulandela imigaqo yemininwana, iinkolelano zamaxesha enkonzo, iMthetho weOccupational Health and Safety Act, 1993 (Act 85 of 1993) nemiGalelo yayo, nokuqinisekiswa koluntu olunembileyo ekunxulumene nezempilo. Umsebenzisi ulawula nokuwarha inkqubo yokushenxiswa kwamashephe, ulondolozo lwezityalo nakwindalo iinkonzo ekuhambisana neNational Environmental Management Act, 1998 (Act 107 of 1998), iNational Environmental Management: Waste Act, 2008 (Act 59 of 2008) iNqamla yezezo zasekhaya echunwe, ukubanika unyango kweekomwe ezahlukeneyo namosa ekuhlanjwe kwaye kugcinwa kalulu ke zilahleka. Nangokulawula inkqubo yokukhuselwa nezilwanyana zechola nayimibambo nga phantsi kwamagunya anyukelweyo namathetho ekuhambisana, ukuqinisekiswa wokusebenzisa abalawuli ababhaliweyo nembali ezamkelekileyo ngenkqubo yokukhuseleka ekulawulenzi okanye ooncedo abalungileyo ekunikezelwa. Umsebenzisi ugcina aze achaze ulwazi ngomsebenzi gqithiweyo neefekithi ekulawulelwa zone iziphithiphithi. Umsebenzisi uqinisekisa ukuba zonke izixhobo eziqaliswa ngumntu ngamnye ngokulawula zikwizimo elungileyo zilungele ukuqaliswa ngokhuseleko nokunokubakho, ukuba ukufikelelwa kolwazi ulwandlalo lwethetho wezenzo oluqinisekisiweyo luyabonakaliswa, nakub abo babasebenzisa bahlakahaliswa kwaye bangabasebenzisi abanobulumko. Kulawulwa amagqibeli alungiselelwa ukuba zonke iingxwala ziqwalaselwa ngxesha kwaye ngaphantsi kweemali ezivunyiweyo, zikuxabiso eliphezulu kwizigqibo ukuba ngamagqibelo anobandezelekileyo ekuxhathiswe ngokunempulelo, ukhuseleko, ukucoca nokuhlanza okanye ukuqwalaselwa ngokwendalo. Umsebenzisi ulungiselela waye axhumana noSupply Chain Management noDirector Facilities Maintenance kungafikeleli xesha kwiimfuno zokuthengiswa ngokuchanekileyo kwendlela ekuhambisana nayo ooncedo, izinto ezingenamthengiswa namacebo edityanwe ngokulandela imigaqo yokuthengwa esemthethweni nangokunqumama iimfuno ezindululeliweyo kokukhuseleka ulwazi nakuqatshelwa kwemigaqo yendalo. Kwinga lokuhlahlelela nokulungiselela, umsebenzisi unika izalathiso kwinkqubo yokuqamba iingcamango nokuqinisekiswa ngokuhlanjwa nokugcinwa kwentlalo yokuhambisana kwe-soft services nakwindlela ekuqatshwa, wayesela kwangaphambili isikhundla esiyimnyaka senkqubo yokusetyenziswa kokuhanjiswa kwengcamango. Umsebenzisi ulawula ukusebenzisa inkqubo yokulawula iingxwaba nokuqonda iimfuno ezingayaziyo, ezibandakanya iingxwaba ezinobungozi bokwenzakala ngokukhuseleka kumsebenzi wezempilo, indalo nezempilo, wayesela uphenya iindikimba zabakwamabindini ukuba batshintshe ngokulandela iinkqubo zomthetho wemithetho yawo, kubandakanya iinkqubo zezempilo nakukhuseleka lokunokuzonakalisa, ukubika ngeendwendwe zomnyhadala zakozeze kubhaliswe ibhotwe elinye imihla, nalokunikelwa ulwazi oluluncedo lokukhuselwa ngokwezomqonya zokumamkhosi. Umsebenzisi ulawula ukuqinisekiswa nokuhambiswa kwezibali zabaphathi abangabasebenzi abakhokelwa yolwazi oluhlobene nekhalaza lesoft services, ukuze uqinisekiswe ngokuphumelela ngokulandelwa kwakho imithetho ngokwamawonga amakhulu, kokunokungozi ngokwendalo, nokuhlanzwa ngokomxholo nokwenza iingxwaba nangokulawulwa ulondolozo lwesinxibo. Ngeyakho ngokulawula abantu abangamelwe iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ngamakhonza, umsebenzisi uxela ulwazi ekuhambisanayo nolwazi olulungelelaniswe kwizikhundla ezindululiweyo nakwindlela ezenza iinkqubo zombono wobunyhadala zokuhamba kweminyaka yesebe. Umsebenzisi ulawula abantu abangamelwe iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo kwaye ugcina isiphithiphithi ngokulandela imigaqo egqithisiweyo yamathetho abasebenzi. Umsebenzisi ulawula ukuzifundisa nokuba kokusuka kwabo ngokuhambisana neenkqubo ezivunyiweyo zokuphuhlisa abantu ngokubakho, kubandakanya ukuzifundisa okusetyenziswa kumthetho wezempilo nakukhuseleka, ukuyila nokuphucula iinkqubo zabo zokusetyenziswa nakwindlela ekuqatshelwa imisebenzi. Umsebenzisi ukhuthaza ukusebenza kwendawo ekhuselekileyo kubasebenzi nakubasebenzi babakwamabindini ngokuhambisana neOccupational Health and Safety Act, 1993. Nangokumisela kwabakwamabindini, kulawulwa ukulungiselelwa kolwazi olunokuthi ukutsalwe abakwamabindini abangabakwasemthethweni nangokumisela iinkqubo nokulawula amakhonza alinganiselwa kwabakwamabindini abamiswe kwakhona ngokuhambisana namathetho okuchukwisa wamazwe namathetho abasebenzi kwindlela emtyeni wolwazi. Ekugqibeleni, umsebenzisi ulawula iimali zesikhundla ngokulandela iPublic Finance Management Act, 1999 nemiGalelo yeTreasury, kwaye ukuqinisekisa ukuba akukho nqathinga lokuwuchitha okanye lokuwugqitha kwiimali ezichaziweyo ngokuhambisana neemali ezabelwe isebe.

Provide advice and guidance to role players on the use of forecasting methods and tools. Ensure that information on the requirement for roll-over requests are disseminated to responsibility and program managers. Ensure that all roll-over requests are considered, proposal developed submitted to the CFO for consideration. Ensure that the approved roll-overs are incorporated in the adjustment’s budgets. Assess the need for additional funds required from the adjustment estimates process through monitoring of expenditure trends. Ensure the assessment of expenditure trends and the development of proposals on the virement or shifting of funds. Maintain discipline. Manage performance and development. Undertake Human Resource and other related administrative functions. Establish implement and maintain efficient and effective communication arrangements. Develop and manage the operational plan of the sub-directorate and report on progress as required. Develop implement and maintain processes to ensure proper control of work. Compile and submit all required administrative reports. Serve on transverse task teams as required. Procurement and asset management. Plan and allocate work. af.summary: Onderdirekteur: Bestuursrekeningkunde pos in die Gauteng Department of Infrastructure Development wat 'n NQF 7 finanskwalifikasie en vyf jaar se ervaring in bestuursrekeningkunde vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie op NQF vlak 7 in Finansiële Bestuur/ Bestuursrekeningkunde/Finansiële Rekeningkunde. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar ervaring in Bestuursrekeningkunde, waarvan 3 jaar op ASD-vlak moet wees. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die Openbare Diens Regulerende Raamwerk. Kennis van die departement se strategie. Kennis van die obtainingbeleid en prosedures. Diepgaande kennis van die Openbare Finansies Bestuurswet, Tesourie Regulasies se Finansiële Delegasies en Risikobestuur. Bevordering van Toegang tot Inligtingwet van 2000. Bevordering van Administratiewe Geregtigheidswet van 2000. Openbare Dienswet van 1994 en Regulasies van 2001. Regerings Onroerende Batebestuurswet van 2007. Arbeidsbetrekkingewet van 1995/Resolusies van Openbare Sektor Onderhandelingsrade. Basiese Diensvoorwaardeswet, 1997. Vaardighede: Kommunikasie. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Analitiese, voorleggings, verslagskryf- en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Beplannings-, organisatoriese leierskaps- en onderhandelingsvaardighede. Eienskappe: Besluitvaardig. Geloofwaardig. Motiverend.
af.duties: Monitor die beleids- en wetgewende raamwerk om te verseker dat daar kennis geneem word van nuwe ontwikkelings. Ontwikkel en handhaaf beleide en prosesse. Monitor kontantvloei en doen kontantvloei-verslae en planne soos vereis in. Verseker dat inligting vir beplanningsdoeleindes behoorlik versamel en ontleed word. Monitor nakoming van finansiële voorskrifte. Bestuur, hersien, ontleed en verseker gehalte van die begrotingsvoorbereidingsproses. Koördineer, hersien, ontleed en verseker gehalte van die bestuursrekeningkundige verslagdoeningsprosesse. Verskaf advies en leiding aan rolspelers oor die gebruik van voorspellingsmetodes en -instrumente. Verseker dat inligting oor die vereiste vir oordragversoeke aan verantwoordelikheids- en programbestuurders versprei word. Verseker dat alle oordragversoeke oorweeg word, voorstelle ontwikkel en aan die CFO vir oorweging voorgelê word. Verseker dat die goedgekeurde oordragte in die aanpassingsbegrotings ingesluit word. Assessseer die behoefte aan addisionele fondse wat deur die aanpassingsberamingsproses vereis word deur monitor van bestedingsneigings. Verseker die assessering van bestedingsneigings en die ontwikkeling van voorstelle oor die oordrag of verskuiwing van fondse. Handhaaf dissipline. Bestuur prestasie en ontwikkeling. Onderneem Menslike Hulpbron en ander verwante administratiewe funksies. Stel in werking en handhaaf doeltreffende en effektiewe kommunikasie-reëlings. Ontwikkel en bestuur die operasionele plan van die subdirektoraat en doen oor vordering soos vereis verslag. Ontwikkel, stel in werking en handhaaf prosesse om behoorlike beheer van werk te verseker. Stel alle vereiste administratiewe verslae op en dien dit in. Dien soos vereis op dwarslopende taakspanne. Verkryging en batebestuur. Beplan en wys werk toe. Gehaltebeheer van werk wat deur werknemers gelewer word. Funksionele tegniese advies en leiding. NAVRAE : Me. Sikelelwa Mboto by 076 521 4118

zu.title: Isikhundla sokuba nguMengameli oPhethe i-Akhaunting yoBuphathi: umsebenzi we-Akhaunting yoBuphathi e-Gauteng Department of Infrastructure Development ofuna nemithelela ye-NQF 7 kwezimali kanye neminyaka emihlanu yamava e-Akhaunting yoBuphathi.
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaMengameli oPhethe i-Akhaunting yoBuphathi eGauteng Department of Infrastructure Development sifuna izifundo ze-NQF 7 kwezimali kanye namava eminyaka emihlanu e-Akhaunting yoBuphathi.
zu.requirements: Isiqu sezanga eliphezulu ezingeni le-NQF level 7 kwi-Financial Management/ Management Accounting/Financial Accounting. Ukube kungenani iminyaka eyi-5 yamava kwi-Management Accounting, lapho kuyadingeka khona iminyaka eyi-3 ibe ngazinga le-ASD. Ikhono: Ulwazi nge-Public Service Regulatory Framework. Ulwazi ngesu le-umnyango. Ulwazi ngenqubomgomo kanye nemikhakha yokuthenga ngemithetho. Ulwazi olujulile ngoMthetho we-Public Finance Management Act, i-Treasury Regulations' Financial Delegations kanye nokuphathwa kwezingozi. UMthetho we-Promotion of Access to Information Act of 2000. UMthetho we-Promotion of Administrative Justice Act of 2000. UMthetho we-Public Service Act of 1994 kanye noMthetho ka-2001. UMthetho we-Government Immovable Asset Management Act of 2007. UMthetho we-Labour Relations Act of 1995/izinqumo ze-Public Sector Bargaining Councils. UMthetho we-Basic Conditions of Employment Act, 1997. Amakhono: Unxibelelwano. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okuhlaziya, okubeka phambi, kokubhala imibiko, kanye nokuxhumana nabantu. Amakhono okuhlela, ukulawula, ukuba ngumholi, kanye nokuxoxisana. Izimpawu: Ukuthatha izinqumo. Ukuthembeka. Ukukhuthaza.
zu.duties: Qaphela inqubomgomo kanye nesakhiwo somthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuqashelwa okusha okutholakalayo. Bese usakaza kanye nokugcina izinqubomgomo kanye nemikhakha. Qaphela ukugeleza kwemali bese ukuthumela imibiko yokugeleza kwemali kanye nezinhlela njengoba kudingeka. Qinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi olusetshenziselwa ukuhlela luqoqwa futhi luhlaziwa ngendlela efanele. Qaphela ukuvumelana nemithetho ephathelene nezimali. Phatha, hlola, hlaziya bese uqinisekisa izinga lekhwalithi enqubweni yokulungiselela isabelo somali. Hlanganisa, hlola, hlaziya bese uqinisekisa izinga lekhwalithi emikhakweni yokubika nge-akhaunting yobuphathi. Nikeza izeluleko kanye necandelo labathintekayo mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwezindlela namathuluzi okubikezela. Qinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi ngemithetho yokwedluliswa kwemali eshiywe ungalusebenzisa kwabelwa abaphathi bezibopho kanye nabaphathi bemihlenge. Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izicelo zokwedluliswa kwemali zibhekwa, kutholakale isu bese kuthunyelwa ku-CFO ukuze liqiniseke. Qinisekisa ukuthi imali evunyiwe ukuwedluliswa ifakwa ezabelweni zokulungisa. Hlola isidingo semali eyengeziwe edingeka kusuka enqubweni yezilinganiso zokulungisa ngokuqaphela izindlela zokusebenzisa imali. Qinisekisa ukuhlolwa kwezindlela zokusebenzisa imali kanye nokuthungatha izinketho mayelana nokushintsha noma ukudlulisa imali. Gcina inzilo. Phatha ukusebenza kanye nentuthuko. Yenza imisebenzi ye-Human Resource kanye neminye imisebenzi elawulwayo ehlobene. Misa, phumeza bese ugcina izinhlelo zoxhumano ezisebenza ngempumelelo. Lumba bese uphatha iholo lokusebenza lesikhulumi bese ubika ngokuqhubeka njengoba kudingeka. Lumba, phumeza bese ugcina imikhakha ukuze uqinisekise ulawulo oluhle lwomsebenzi. Hlanganisa bese uthumela yonke imibiko ephathelene nokulawula edingekayo. Phatha imisebenzi emayelana nokujoyina amaqembu emisebenzi njengoba kudingeka. Ukuthenga kanye nokuphatha impahla. Cwangcisa bese ukabela umsebenzi. Qinisekisela izinga lekhwalithi yomsebenzi ohlinzekwe izisebenzi. Izeluleko futhi necandelo lezobuchwepheshe bemisebenzi. IMIBUZO: Nks. Sikelelwa Mboto ngani 076 521 4118.

Uchazo olungaphantsi lwe-5 years yamava kwi-Management Accounting, apho kuyakufuneka i-3 years ibe kwi-ASD level. Iikhompedensi: Ulwazi nge-Public Service Regulatory Framework. Ulwazi ngeSakhiwo seSakhiwo seSebe. Ulwazi ngemigaqo nendlela yokuqatsha. Ulwazi oluzinzileyo ngo-Mthetho woLawulo woMali okaHulumeni, nge Treasury Regulations Financial Delegations nokuLawulwa koMngcipheko woMngcipheko. Promotion of Access to Information Act of 2000. Promotion of Administrative Justice Act of 2000. Public Service Act of 1994 and Regulations of 2001.Government Immovable Asset Management Act of 2007. Ukukhuthaza.
xh.duties: Qaphela umthetho nolwakhiwo lwemigaqo ukuze kuqwalaselwe izinto ezintsha. Qamba ulwakhiwo lwemigaqo nendlela zokwenza izinto aze zigcinwe. Qaphela ukujikeleza kwemali uze ugcobe iingxelo nendlela ekujikeleza ngayo imali njengoko kufuneka. Qinisekisa ukuba ulwazi olusetyenziswa kwinkqubo yokucwangcisa luqokelelwa lwahlulwa kahle. Qaphela ukuthobela imiyalelo yemali. Lawula, hlola, hlaziya uze uqinisekise ukuba inkqubo yokulungiselela izibalo igqitywe ngokwemigaqo. Lawula, hlola, hlaziya uze uqinisekise iinkqubo zokwenza iingxelo ngezibalo. Nikeza inkundla nolwazi olukhokelayo abo banxaxhebe ngendlela ngezixhobo zokusikeka kwezinto ezingaphambili. Qinisekisa ukuba ulwazi malunga nesicelo sokujikeleza kwemali sifikelela kubaphathi bemvisiswano nakubaphathi benkqubo. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iinkqubo zokujikeleza kwemali zihlolwa, zenziwe izindwendwe kwaye zithunyelwe ku-CFO ukuze zihlolwe. Qinisekisa ukuba izicelo ezamkelweyo zokujikeleza kwemali zifakwe kwizibalo eziyilungiso. Linganisa isidingo semali efuneka kwindlela yokulinganisa ulungelelwaniso lweemali ngokuqaphela iindlela zokuchitha imali. Qinisekisa ukuphonononga iindlela zokuchitha imali nokuqamba iindlela zokusika okube sekushityeni kwemali. Zigcine inkuliso. Lawula ukuphumeza nokuphuhlisa. Yenza imisebenzi yezabasebenzi nezinye izixhobo zolawulo. Ziseka, yenze igcine iinkqubo zokuNxibelelana ezisebenzayo nangempumelelo. Qamba ulawulo lwenkqubo yomsebenzi osesigqebenxaxhe kwaye uchaze inkqubo njengoko kufuneka. Qamba, yenze uze ugcinwe iinkqubo zokuqinisekiswa ngokulawulwa kolawulo lomsebenzi. Qamba uze uthumele ngeemfuyo zonke iingxelo efunwa ngokulawulo. Ukuba yingxenye yeemfuyo njengoko kufuneka. Urhoqo nemisebenzi yokulawula iimpahla. Cwangcisa uze wabelane ngomsebenzi. Ukulawula umgangatho womsebenzi onikiweyo ngabasebenzi. Nikeza ngeenkcukacha zomsebenzi naye wonke omnye umntu oncedo.

af.duties: Monitor die beleids- en wetgewingsraamwerk om te verseker dat kennis geneem word van nuwe ontwikkelings. Ontwikkel en handhaaf finansiële rekeninghoudingsbeleid en prosesse. Monitor inkomste wat ingevorder en uitgawes wat gemaak word en dien verslae en planne in soos vereis. Monitor nakoming van finansiële voorskryfte. Verskaf advies en leiding aan rolspelers oor inkomste- en uitgaweprosedures. Verseker dat kassier-, bank-, skuldbeheer-, monitorings- en verslagdoeningsdienste gelewer word. Verseker dat betaling vir vergoeding van werknemers, goedere en dienste, oordragte, subsidies en verslagdoening doeltreffend en effekief uitgevoer word. Verskaf finansiële administrasie- en rekeninghoudingsdienste (rekenings/Joernale, rekeninghouding en verslagdoening (tussentydse en jaarlikse finansiële state). Handhaaf dissipline. Bestee prestasie en ontwikkeling. Onderneem menslike hulpbronbronne en ander verwante administratiewe funksies. Vestig, implementeer en handhaaf doeltreffende en effekiewe kommunikasiereëlings. Ontwikkel en bestee die operasionele plan van die subdirektoraat en rapporteer oor vordering soos vereis. Ontwikkel, implementeer en handhaaf prosesse om behoorlike beheer van werk te verseker. Stel alle vereiste administratiewe verslae op en dien dit in. Dien soos vereis op dwarstakegroepe. Beplan en wys werk toe. Voer kwaliteitsbeheer uit oor werk wat deur werknemers gelewer word. Verskaf funksionele tegniese advies en leiding.

zu.title: ONgqonsi Ohlewayo: Izimali Ezingabhalwa Kahle
zu.summary: ONgqonsi Ohlewayo: Izimali Ezingabhalwa Kahle e-Department of Infrastructure Development, Gauteng Head Office, edinga izifundo ze-NQF 7 namafinye eminyaka eyisihlanu ngaphansi kwezimali ezingabhalwa kahle.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezingaphansi kwesiqu ezingeni le-NQF 7 kwi-Financial Management / Financial Accounting. Okungenani eminyakeni eyi-5 ngaphansi kwe-Financial Accounting, lapho kuyo eminyakeni eyi-3 kumele ibe ngazinga le-ASD. Izindidi zobuleme: Ulwazi nge-Public Service Regulatory Frame. Ulwazi ngesu lenhlangano yomnyango. Ulwazi ngemigomo nemigudu yokuthuthukisa izinto. Ulwazi olujulile ngomthetho we-Public Finance Management Act, izimiso ze-Treasury Regulations’ Financial Delegations kanye ne-Risk Management ulwazi lwe-BAS. Amakhono: Xhumana nabantu. Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Amakhono okuhlaziya, okubukhonisa, okubhala imibiko kanye namakhono axhuma abantu. Amakhono ocwangcisa, ahlele, ahola, axoxisana nabakhokha abanye. Izimpawu: Thatha isinqumo. Thembeka. Phukula ngenhliziyo.
zu.duties: Qaphela umgomo nendandatho yomthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuqashelwa okusha okumenyiweyo. Honda futhi ulondoloze imigomo nemigudu yezimali ezingabhalwa kahle. Qaphela imali etholwayo nalawula izimali ezichithiwe bese usinika imibiko nezinkulelo njengoko kudingekile. Qaphela ukulandelwa kwemiyalo yezimali. Nikeza izeluleko nesiqondiso kubalingisi ngenkulelo yekhaya noma imali ekhokhiwe ngaphandle. Qinisekisa ukuthi kwenziwa izinsizakalo zokusebenza ngemali, zokubhukuda, zokuphatha izikweletu, zokuqaphela kanye nezokuvekwa imibiko. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhlolwa kahle imali yokukhokha izisebenzi, izinto ezifakiwe, ukuthutha, izibonelelo, nokuvela imibiko. Nikeza izinsizakalo zokuphatha izimali kanye nezokubhala izimali (izithatheli/noma izinto ezibhalwe phansi, izimali nokuvela imibiko (imibiko esemaphakathi nomyaka omojwayelekile wesimali). Londoloza isithuthi. Phatha imikhankaso neyokuthuthukiswa komuntu. Yenza imisebenzi egxile kumntu kanye nalawo ohlelwangcoliswa. Misela, honda futhi ulondoloze izindlela ezihle futhi ezingavumelekile zokwenza imisebenzi ngokuthungwa kakhulu. Honda futhi uphe imikhankaso yokuqamba izinto ezingahlele emnyango ongaphansi futhi iveze ukugqama njengoba kudingeke. Honda, thuma bese ulondoloza izimvo noma imigudu yokuhlela, ukuze kuhlelwe imisebenzi kahle emnyangweni. Misela bese usinika izinkomba ezahlukeneyo njengoba kudingeke. Cwangcisa bese unikela umsebenzi. Qaphela izinga lomsebenzi osinikiwe. Nikeza izeluleko nesiqondiso ngemisebenzi ekhuluma ngemithetho yezimali.

xh.title: Under-Director: i-Akhawunti yemali
xh.summary: Under-Director: i-Akhawunti yemali kwisebe leZophulo lokuPhuhliswa, iGauteng Head Office, kufuneka ibe nelayisentshi kwinqanaba le-NQF 7 namava eminyaka emihlanu kwi-Akhawunti yemali.
xh.requirements: Isifundo se-undergraduate kwinqanaba le-NQF 7 kokuLawula kwezeMali / i-Akhawunti yemali. Amava angaphaya kweminyaka emi-5 kwi-Akhawunti yemali, apho iminyaka emi-3 kuyo kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba le-ASD. Ikhompetensi: Ulwazi ngeNkqubo yoLawulo lomZonke kuLuntu. Ulwazi lwenkululeko yesebe. Ulwazi lwenkqubo yokuthenga neenkqubo zayo. Ulwazi oluchaziweyo lweMithetho yoLawulo lwezeMali kaRhulumente, iNkqubo zoLawulo lwezeMalini zeTreasury, iDiligeshini ezoMiso wezeMali nokuLawulwa kweengozi Ulwazi nge-BAS. Amandla: Unxibelelwano. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Amandla okuhlola, okubonisa, okubhala iirepothi nokuchezelana nabantu. Amandla eceba, oluLungelelanisa, okuBusa, nokuNxibelelanisa ngokuxoxwa. Iimpawu: Okugqithisayo. Ethembekayo. Ekhubekisa.
xh.duties: Qwalasela inkqubo yomthetho nemigaqo ukuqinisekisa ukuba kunyukiwe kumanabangelo amatsha. Phucula zigcinze iinkqubo zakhawunti zemali. Qwalasela imali ethunyelweyo namashishini abakho uze ungenise iirepothi neenkqabo njengoko kufuneka. Qwalasela ukuzigqiba kunqbo lomthetho ngemali. Nikeza isalathiso nokukhokeza abadlali balo kwiinkqubo zokuqokelela nomshishino. Qinisekisa ukuba Zenziwa iinkonzo zokuba ngumlawuli wetyala, kwabhangi, ulawulo lweetyala, ukuqwalaselwa nokuChazwa. Qinisekisa ukuba kukhokhelwa imali yokuhlawula abasebenzi, izinto neenkonzo, ukuDluliselwa, izibonelelo nokuChazwa kwenziwa ngokusebenza kakuhle. Nikeza inkonzo yolawulo lwezimali nakhawunti (iilejisi/namajenari, ukubala nokuChaza (iirepothi zethembu nakamnyaka zezeMali). Zigcinze inyameko. Lawula ukusebenza nokuphuhliswa. Thatha iinkonzo zoluntu kwaye nezinye inkonzo ezahlukeneyo zulawulo. Misela, panga zigcinze amacebo oluntu olusebenzayo abo axabisekileyo anceda kakuhle. Panga ulawule inkqabo yoluntu nendalo yesebe ngaphantsi uze uchaze inqanaba njengoko kufuneka. Yila, panga zigcinze iinkqubo ukuze uqinisekisa ukulawulwa okuchanekileyo komsebenzi. Hlanganisela uze ungenise zonke iirepothi ezifunekayo zolawulo. Kubhalise kwiiqela zemisebenzi yokuhamba njengoko kufuneka. Ceba uze umabele umsebenzi. Yenza ukuqwalaselwa koluhlu lomsebenzi onikezelwe ngumzekelisi. Nikeza isalathiso nolwazi lwerefa leobuchwephetshe.

Bevoegdhede: Kennis van finansiële bestuur. Kennis in ooreenstemming met die Competency Standards for Construction Procurement wat deur CIDB uitgereik is. Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996. Construction Industry Development Board Act of 2000 and Regulations. PFMA/Division of Revenue Act/Treasury Regulations/Practice Notes/Instructions/Circulars. Provinciale/departementele Supply Chain Management-beleide. Vaardighede- Probleemoplossing en analise. Spanwerk. Veranderingsbestuur. Kliëntefokus en reaksievermoë. Kommunikasie. Rekenaarvaardighede. Tegniese ontwerp- en analisekennis. Rekenaargesteunde tegniese toepassings. Kennis van regsvoorskrifnakoming. Tegniese verslagskrywing. Tegniese konsultasie. Produksie- en proseskennis en -vaardighede. Eienskappe- Spanspeler. Besonderhede-georiënteerd.
af.duties: Bestuur, onderneem en hersien die monitering, ontleding en bepaling van aksies om behoorlike kontrakadministrasie te verseker. Administreer variasies tot kontrakte. Evalueer aansoeke om prysaanpassings en roep boetebedinge in werking. Evalueer aansoeke om variasies, wysigings en kansellasies en ontwikkel voorstelle vir goedkeuring. Handhaaf behoorlike verhouding met verskaffers binne die etiese kode om lewering van goedere/dienste te verseker. Ontwikkel, implementeer en handhaaf prosesse om behoorlike beheer van werk te verseker. Stel alle vereiste administratiewe verslae op en dien dit in. Dien soos vereis op dwarslopende taakspanne. Lewer verkryging en batesbestuur vir die subdirektoraat. Beplan en wys werk toe. Kwaliteitsbeheer van werk wat deur werknemers gelewer word.

zu.duties: Phatha,enza futhi uhlole ulwazi futhi waphicule isenzo ongaisibonakalisa ngokuphathwa kwezinkontileka. Phephetha ukushintshwa kwezinkontileka. Hlola izicelo zokulungiswa kwentengo futhi uvuse izinkulumo-mvubu ezijezisayo. Hlola izicelo zoshintsho, zokulungiswa nokukhansela uphinde uhlole iziphakamiso ukuze zivunyelwe. Yenza ukuxazulula izinkinga futhi ungcine zonke imibhalo ihlezi ilungele ukuxazulula izinkinga. Gcina ubudlelwano obuhle nabakhiqizi ngokuhambisana nendlela yokuziphatha ukugcina ukuhlelwa kwemikhiqizo / insiza. Hleze,uze futhi uqaphele ukuhambisana nezinkontileka ngokuphendula ukuthi imikhiqizo/insiza ihamba ngawosuku olunjani,ngobungakanani obunjani,imikhiqizo oyifunayo,esikhundleni esifanele,nasemomphenjweni ojwayelekile,kuyo yonke indaba ikhiqize ngomthengiso othize ngokwelanziwe. Gcina isibopho. Phatha impilo nokuthuthukiswa komuntu. Yenza imisebenzi epatha abantu kanye namanye eminye imisebenzi eminingi. Beka,sebenzisa futhi ulondoloze ukwaziswa okuhambisana kokunye nokunye. Khanda uphinde ulawule uhlelo lwendiza ngomsebenzi ogcina ushicilelwe ngokuningiliziwe. Khanda,sebenzisa futhi ulondoloze inqubo eqinisekisa ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi. Qamba uphinde uhambise wonke amarekhodo abhalwe ngesibopho. Yenza njengomuntu ophethe iqembu njengoba kudingekile. Phethe ukuthenga kanye nokuphatha impahla esikhundleni nangesikhathi esifanele. Cwangcisa ubeke imisebenzi. Lawula khona ukuhamba komsindo ngokuhlolwa.

xh.title: Mongameli ongenaye: Amakontraki Nempumelelo
xh.summary: Mongameli ongenaye wamakontraki nempumelelo kwisebe leGauteng Department of Infrastructure Development, elifuna izifundo zengowomlinganiselo weNQF Level 7 kunye neminye yimimfihlelo emihlanu ekulawulweni kwamakontraki.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingenzwanga izidanga kumlinganiselo weNQF Level 7 kwiSupply Chain Management okanye kwiFinance. Okungenani unyaka bali-5 bamava ekulawulweni kwamakontraki apho iminyaka emi-3 kufuneka ibe ngamakhono anzulu e-ASD level: Ulwazi ngokulawula izimali. Ulwazi ngokuhambisana namagqabantshintshi amaCompetency Standards for Construction Procurement apapashwe yiCIDB. Umgaqo-siseko weRiphabhlikhi yomZantsi Afrika wawo-1996. Construction Industry Development Board Act of 2000 nemiGaqo. I-PFMA/Division of Revenue Act /Treasury Regulations /Practice Notes/ Instructions /Circulars. Iinkqubela-moqondwe zeProvincial/Departmental Supply Chain Management Policies. Amakhono- Ukuxazulula iingxaki kunye nokuhlalutya. Ukusebenza njengesiqhanga. Ukulawula utshintsho. Ukwazinikela kumthengi nokuphendula. Unxibelelwano. Amakhono ekhompyutha. Ulwazi lokuqamba kunye nokuhlalutya ngobuchwepheshe. Izicelo zobuchwephesha ezisebenza ngekhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokuzelelwa kumthetho. Ukwabhala iingxelo zobuchwephesha. Iingcebiso zobuchwephesha Ulwazi namakhono ekukhiqizeni nasekwenzeni iinkqubo. Iimpawu- Umdlali wesiqhanga. Ukugxila kwiinkcukacha.
xh.duties: Lawula, yenza kwaye uphinde uhlalutye ukhathazo, uhlalutyo kunye nonikezelo lwezigqibo ukuqinisekisa ukulawulwa okulungileyo kwamakontraki. Lawula iinguqu kwamakontraki. Hlola izicelo zokulungiswa kwamaxabiso uze usebenzise iziklauzla zezohlwayo. Hlola izicelo zeenguqu, okulungiswa nokurhoxiswa uze uqambe iindimbano eziza kuvunywa. Yenza ukuxazululwa kweengxabano ukuze uqinisekise ukuba yonke imibhalo ilungile yaye ifumanekile ukuba kuxazululwe iingxabano. Phatha ubudlelwane obulungileyo nababoneleli ngaphakathi kwemigaqo yokuziphatha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulethwa kweempahla/iinkonzo. Lawulisa, hlola kwaye ulawule ukuzinikela kwamakontraki ngokuqinisekisa ukuba iimveliso/iinkonzo zithunyelwa ngesikhathi esifanelekileyo, ngobungakanani obufanelekileyo, iimveliso ezifanelekileyo, kwendawo elifanelekileyo, ngemimeko elifanelekileyo, ngomgangatho ofanelekileyo nangexabiso elifanelekileyo ngokwakontraki. Gunyazisa isithintelo. Lawula impumelelo nentluko. Yenza iZabalemvelwe njengabantu kunye neminye imisebenzi yolawulo ehambelanayo. Misela, phumeza, kwaye ulawule izikqubo zoluntu olusebenza ngokuchanekileyo nangempumelelo. Qamba ulawule icebo lokusebenza lesiqondiso esingaphantsi kwaye uxela ngokuqhubeka njengoko kufuneka. Qamba, phumeza, kwaye ulawule iinkqubo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulawula okulungileyo komsebenzi. Qamba kwaye ugcwalise yonke iingxelo ezifunekayo zolawulo. Khankanya kumaqela obusebenzo njengoko kufuneka. Yenza inkonzo yokuthenga nokulawula izimpahla zesiqondiso esingaphantsi. Cwangcisa kwaye wabelane ngomsebenzi. Lawula umgangatho womsebenzi onikiweyo ngabasebenzi.

zu.duties: Hola ucangelo lokuqamba izinhlelo, ukuphumezisa, ukulandelela, ukubika kanye nenhloloverho ngokuya ngendlela yokuphatha imiklamo. Dala futhi uphumeze izinhlela zomsebenzi womklamo bese uzilungisa ngokufanelekile ukuze zihambelane nezidingo ezishintshayo. Hlola izinsiza ezidingekayo bese unikeza ubuncwazi bomuntu ngamunye ngemisebenzi yawo. Phatha izinto ezikwizinga lensuku nannsuku zomklamo kanye nomkhawulo wawo. Sebenzisa indlela yokuphatha futhi uqinisekise izindinganiso zomklamo ukuze kuncishiswe ingozi kumimiselo. Bika inqubo yokuba phambili komklamo kwiChief Construction Project Manager. Phatha imali ebhalisiwe yomklamo nezinsiza. Nikeza iziqalelo kwabanye ochwepheshe ngokuphathwa kwemiyalelo yethenda. Xhumanisa bese usesebenzisana nabahlinzeki bezinsiza, abathengi kanye nabaphathi. Yifa imisebenzi ehlobene nolwabantu kanye namanye emisebenzi ehlobene nawo. Gcina indlela yokuphatha amarekhodi kanye nendlu yolwazi yokwakha. Sebenzisa izinsiza ezabeliwe ngokusemthethweni. Hlala ufuna futhi uwazi izinhlela ezintsha zobuchwepheshe nemiklamo. Bulunga izincwadi ngokuqhubeka komklamo omusha mayelana nezindlela ezintsha zokuphatha imiklamo. Xhumanisana nemisimangahlaka ezihlobene nomklamo yokuphatha imiklamo. Cwangcisa, qamba, qhubekise bese ulondoloza imiklamo yokunjiniyela. Tumba izixazululo ezithengiswa kahle ngokuya ngemithetho. Hlola imiyalo yobuchwepheshe ekhona, izithombe ezingokwesiko kanye nezinqubo zemibhalo esetshenziswayo ukuze kuqondwe ubuchwepheshe obusha. Bhalisa izinkomba zemiyalezo. Qinisekisa ngokuhlola ukuthi ukucwangcisa nokuqakambisa abakwenayo okunye kwenziwe kwezinye izinhlelo ezilungele ukunyakaza ngokuya emigomeni nasemithethweni kanye nendlela yokwenza futhi uvume izinhlelo njengoba kuhleziwe kumthetho nasemithethweni. Qinisekisa ukuqeqeshwa nokuqhubela phambili kwabasebenzi bomthwalo wezandla, abanjiniyela abathanda kanye nabanjiniyela abafuna ukusebenza ukuthuthukisa ulwazi ekuthumeleni nasekuhambeni ngemithethonqubo yokunakwa imisebenzi. Qapha imisebenzi nokuqhubeka kokunjiniyela bese uphatha kabuhlungu inqubo yemisebenzi efunwa yonke imikhakha kanye nemithefula. Qedela imiyalo ekhona bese uyihlanganisa ukuze kubengcono ukusebenzisa izinsiza. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana kwemithetho nasekuqhubekeni kwemisebenzi yokuqoqa izinkomba. Landela ukuqashwa kwemali kwaye nasekuthumeleni imali emisebenzini yokuqoqa izinkomba kubika ngokusetyenziswa kwemali.

Hlola iimanuali ezizezobuchwephesha ezingekho zintsha, iimbalo ezimiselweyo nemigaqo ukugcina iindlela ezintsha zolwazi bobuchwephesha. Tyala iinkcazelo zamaxabiso eminqathapha. Qinisekisa ngokuhlola ukuba ucwangciso kunye nolculo lulwenziwe ngabanye ngokomyandro weenzululwazi olusoundo ngokwemiqathango nemilinganiselo kunye nenkqubo yomsebenzi, futhi vuma imisebenzo yezinzululwazi ngokwemilinganiselo nemiqathango eboleke. Qinisekisa ukudluliselwa kolwazi nokuphuhliswa kwechniki, abanjinzulu benzululwazi abaqhubayo ukukhulisa izakhono/ukudluliselwa kolwazi nokuzinikela kuqondo olusoundo lweenzululwazi kunye nenkqubo yomsebenzi. Lawula umsebenzi wonzululwazi kunye nenkqubo futhi ulawule ukulawula ukuphumelela nokuphuhliswa. Lawula iindleko futhi ulungise kwaye udityanise izinto ezisesazweni ngekhon-thulo lwesixhobo somthengi. Qinisekisa ukuthobela imigaqo nemiqathango yoluntu nemisebenzi yabasebenzi. Lilise, lawula ukubakho kolwazi futhi unike iingxelo ezingekho zintsha ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi ngenkqubo.

Thetha nemiqathango/iikhowathi ezifanelekileyo kumacandelo ahlobene ne-injiniyela. Lawula izixhobo kwaye iqeke kwaye idibanise iingxelo ukukhawuleza ukusetyenziswa kwesixhobo. Qinisekisa ukuthobela izindaqulo namaxwebhu okuthenga nolawulo lwebasebenzi. Qwalasela kwaye ulawule ukuchithwa kwemali.nika iingxelo ngokuhanjiswa kwemali nesevisi.

Umthetho we-National Building Standards Act of 1977 kanye Nemithetho. Umthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act of 1993 kanye Nemithetho. Phinda ubuke ukuqiniswa kwemali yamaphrojekthi kanye nezilinganiso ezenziwe ngabaklami bezakhiwo kanye/noma abasebenzi abangesigaba esingaphansi kobuchwepheshe. Qondise, qeqesha futhi uthuthukise abagqinsi beziqu bokushayela izibalo kanye nabasebenzi abasesigabeni sobuchwepheshe nobonke abasesigabeni esingezansi kobuchwepheshe ukuze kukhuthaze ukudluliselwa kwamakhono/ulwazi nokuthobela imigomo emihle kanye nendlela yokwenza. Qapha umsebenzi kanye nenqubo yokushayela izibalo. Phatha ukuphathwa nokuthuthukiswa kokusebenza. Lungisa futhi uhlanganise imibhalo yokweseka ukusetshenziswa kwemithombo. Zibandakanya ekuthuthukiseni ngokungaphelele ubuchwepheshe ngokwezindlela zesikhungo. Yenza ucwaningo/izifundo zemibhalo mayelana nokushayela izibalo ukuze uthuthukise ulwazi. Xhumana namakomidi/izikhungo ezithintekayo mayelana nezinkomba ezingokushayela izibalo. Qinisekisa ukuthobela imithetho kanye nezinqubo zokuThenga i-SCM kanye nokuphathwa kwemithombo yomuntu. Qapha futhi ulawule imali echithwayo. Bika ngemali echithwayo nakohlelo lokwethulwa kwensebenzo. Zibandakanya ekuthuthukiseni ngokungaphelele ubuchwepheshe ngokwezindlela zesikhungo. xh.summary: Isithuba sokuba ngum sakwiwoyo sezimali kwiNqanaba leGalwehu leSebe lePhuhliso lweZakhiwo eGauteng eJohannesburg, sifuna izidanga kwiSakwiwoyo sezimali, ukuwugcwalisa kwi-SACQSP, nayo iminyaka emi-3 yamava.
xh.requirements: Isidanga kwiSakwiwoyo sezimali okanye isibhalo esifanelekileyo. Kufuneka kubekho amava angaphaya kweminyaka emi-3 emva kokufumana isidanga njengomsakwiwoyo sezimali. Kufuneka abhalise kwi-SACQSP njengomsakwiwoyo sezimali ongamagalanga. Ilayisenisi yomqhubi esemthethweni. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngoMthetho wesebenza ka-1994. Ulwazi ngokuLawulwa kusebenza ka-2016.I-PFMA nemigaqo yoQoqosho, iindlela ze-SCM zePhondo/Sebe. UMthetho woLawulo lweZiphumo ezingahambekiyo kaRhulumente ka-2007. UMthetho weeNqanaba zokuSakwa kwelizwe ka-1977 nemigaqo. UMthetho weMpilo nokuKhuselwa kumSebenzi ka-1993 nemigaqo. UMthetho weMpi lo, imigaqo neNqobo ezikhokelayo-Ikhono-Ukwenza iigqibo, ukuQhatha iqela, ukuHlola nokuchaza, uQqatsho, ukuZilawula, ukulawula izimali, ukujoliswa kumthengi nokuphendula, iNtetho, ukusebenza ngekhompyutha, ukuLawula ingxabano, ukuxazula iingxaki, uPhando, ukubhala iingxelo ezithe ngethubishi, ukuQhagamshelana.
xh.duties: Qhatha amaqela anamava kuzo zonke iindawo ezithetha ngokusakwa kwezimali. Qinisekisa ukhonza kumagqabantsheni okumisela izimali. Nikezela izimvo ngenkxaso ngamakhono ekulinganisweni kwexabiso lwezimali. Qinisekisa ukamkelwa kweenkqubo zekhono nangolinganiso lweemveliso. Bhiyazela iindlela, iindlela nokuziphatha ezinxulumene nokulinganisela izimali. Nikezela iindlwana ekungahambi kahle kwokulinganisela izimali. Phengela izimali ezimaliselwa amaphrojekthi nokuqikelela okwenziwe ngabaxhasi bezakhiwo nabobasebenzi abangesona oogqabhaxo babo bobuchwepheshe. Latha, qeqesha kwaye uphuhlise aba bali bokulinganisela izimali abangamagqabhaxo nabasebenzi abasesebugqirha bokulinganisela izimali abanengxi ndawo yobuchwephesha nokuyilawula, ngenjongo yokugqithisa izakhono/ulwazi nasekuqinisweni iinkqubo ezilungele umba wamagqabantshathu kumatshini wokuqhuba imisebenzi. Qhatha abakwiwoyo sezimali kumsebenzi wabo naseenkqubongeni. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo lomsebenzi nolwandiso. Lungiselela kwaye udibanise izimvo ukuncedisa uku setyenziswa kwezixhobo ezi funekayo. Qhubela phambili uqeqesho oluqhubelekayo ngokwemigaqo yesikhosi ngamagunya kwiKomiti. Qhuba upando/kupando kweencwadi ekuthiweni ngokusakwa kwamagqabantshathu ngenjongo yokuphucula isidanga kwiSakwiwoyo sezimali. Qhagamshelana neentlanga/oomonakali abafanelekileyo kuqoqosho ekusingathweni kwemiba ezilawula uku setyenziswa kwemali kumsebenzi woku linganisela izimali. Qinisekisa ukhonza kumagqabantshathu naseenkqubongeni ekuthengeni i-SCM nakuqoqosho lwabasebenzi. Londa kwaye ulawule iindleko zokusebenza. Yaza iingxelo nge ndleko zokusebenza nase ku setyenzisweni kweenkonzo. Qhubela phambili uqeqesho oluqhubelekayo ngokwemigaqo yesikhosi ngamagunya kwiKomiti. Qhuba upando/kupando kweencwadi ekuthiweni ngokusakwa kwamagqabantshathu ngenjongo yokuphucula isidanga kwiSakwiwoyo sezimali. Qhagamshelana neentlanga/oomonakali abafanelekileyo kuqoqosho ekusingathweni kwemiba ezilawula uku setyenziswa kwemali kumsebenzi woku linganisela izimali.
