Ulwazi lwobuchwepheshe ehambelana noluhlu lwakho lemisebenzi. Ulwazi ngemithetho ephathelene nayo nemigangatho yolawulo lwekhwalithi. Iakhono elungileyo lolulwalulo lendlela yokwenza imisebenzi ngolwandleko. Iakhono okugcina umthwalo wemisebenzi phambili kwaye ugaphe iimva zomphango. Iakhono lokunika ingqalelo enkulu kwiinkcukacha. Iakhono elungileyo lokusebenza njengesiqhanga. Iakhono: Qhuba iqondo lenkqubela kwaye ulawule imali ejiyiswa kumaphulo angabakho wolungiso namaphulo amancinci abakho oovakabakho. Zibandakanye kwindibano zenyanga zonke zenkqubela yomphango nabathengi. Lawula imisebenzi yabaqeshi babathengi nabacondisi apho kufuneka khona. Lawula inkqubo nokuziphatha kwebasebenzi abangaphansi kwakho. Iimpawu: Abantu abajoliswe kubo, ubungcali, uxanduva lokuhlangana, iinguquko, iNkqubo yeBatho Pele, ingqalelo kwinkcukacha, inyaniso nokuzithembisa, izigqibo ezomeleleyo.
xh.duties: Yabelisa imisebenzi namaphulo ngokwamanzi nolungiso lweemveliso ezikhoyo nezintsha. Qhuba iqondo lenkqubela kwaye ulawule imali ejiyiswa kulungiso olwangoku namaphulo amancinci abakho oovakabakho. Zibandakanye kwindibano zenyanga zonke zenkqubela yomphango nabanomdla. Qinisekisa ukuba iNkqubo yoLawulo loMsebenzi ihlaziywa, zenze iingxelo nangaphezulu kwaye icebise kwaye ulawule imali ejiyiswa nentlawulo. Qinisekisa ukuchaneka kwamaxwebho entengiso, iinkcazelo ngee-bills zezixa. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa ngempumelelo kweenkonzo ngenxa yoxazimo lweengxaki. Khuthaza kwaye ncedise ii-SMME, i-BBBEE nee-PPP. Khuthaza iinkqubo zeNkqubo yoVuselela uVakabakho (i-EPWP). Qokeleza kwaye uzenze iinkcukacha ngokwala nkqubo. Lawula inkqubo yokuqonda iimfuno, iinkonzo ezintsha neemfuno zovakabakho obuncinci nolungiso kolwazi olu khoyo ngokuzinikezela ukuba iziveko zabathengi zihloliswe kwaye zilandelelwe. Yakha kwaye uchaze iiplani nezakheto. Bhalaamaxwebho ekucinga iinkcukacha kwaye uhlole iinkcazelo, ii-bills zezixa namaxwebho eentengiso. Gagula kwaye unikeze izindululo ngezokucinga nentengiso. Thetha nabanomdla ngeeNkcukacha zobuchwepheshe. Nikeza icebiso nolundiselwako kubaqeshi babathengi nabacondisi ngokuzithobela imithetho, imigaqo nendlela ezisetyenziswa. Misela iinkqubo nemigaqo ukuze baqeshi babathengi nabacondisi balandele imithetho, imigaqo nendlela ezisetyenziswa. Qinisekisa iingxoxo kwaye uqinisekise inkqubela yentlawulo. Hlola kwaye usebenzise iimiyalelo yoxinzelelo nokuCelwa ngenxa yokwandiswa kwemithetho yokuvala. Chaza abacondisi nabaqeshi babathengi ngemisebenzi kwaye uqinisekise iindleko eziceliweyo. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa ngempumelelo kweenkonzo. Qhubandaba nokuxazwa kwemiinkinga evela kumaphulo kwaye uhlole iingxelo zenkqubela ngemiphango. Qonda iimfuno zophuhliso lweekhadi ngokubonelela ngolungelelwano lokuzilolonga nolondolozo iakhono kwabasebenzi abangaphansi kwakho. Nikeza icebiso nolundiselwako ngokuchaza nokusebenzisa imithetho, iinkqubo nemigaqo. Qinisekisa ukulawula ikhwalithi nokuphumelela nokusebenza ngokukhawuleza komsebenzi owenziweyo ngooMahloli bomsebenzi kwaye wenze iingxelo kuyo yonke imisebenzi enikiweyo. Qhuba ukusetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo kwezixhobo, izitolo nentlawulo. Lawula inkqubo yesebe ngokuphumelela nokuphuhlisa iinkqubo zayo.

zu.title: Umphathi Wohlelo Lokulola Izinto: I-Mechanical
zu.summary: Umphathi Wohlelo Lokulola Izinto wokunakekelwa kwe-mechanical e-Thelle Mogoerane Facility Maintenance Hub, ofuna i-National Diploma noma i-Trade Test kanye neminyaka emithandathu yohlu lwemisebenzi.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma (izitrimu ze-T/N/S) noma okulingana nayo/ N3 ne-Trade Test edlule kwindawo ye-Mechanical/ Ukwbhalisela njengomculankondlo we-Engineer Technician. Okungenani eminyakeni eyi-6 yohlu lokusebenza olufanele. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ikhono: Ulwazi Lokukhuluma nokubhala okuhle ngomlomo nokubhaliwe, ulwazi lwezobuchwepheshe oluhambisana nendawo yakho yokusebenza, ulwazi ngemithetho ehambisana naleyo ndawo nezindinganiso zokuqinisekiswa kwekhwalithi, Amakhono ohlelo oluhle nendlela yokusebenza okuhlelekile, ikhono lokubeka izinto eziyinhloko futhi ugcwalise izikhathi zephrojekthi. Ikhono lokunaka imininingwane ngokuzenzela kakhulu namakhono ohlelo lokusebenza njengeqembu. : Qaphela inqubo kanye nezinkundla ezechitshiyelwayo kumaphrojekthi okunakekelwa okwamanje namaphrojekthi amancane okwakhiwa kabusha, zibandakanye njenyanga zokuhlangana ngokuqhubeka kwephrojekthi namakhasimende, Phatha imisebenzi yabaqashiwe nabacekela phansi lapho kusemthethweni khona, Qapha ukusebenza nokuziphatha kwabangaphansi. Abantu kumbindo, ukuziphatha okuhle, umthwalo wemfumba ohlangene, ukuguqulwa, Izimiso ze-Batho Pele, ukunaka imininingwane, ukwethembeka nokuba nobuqotho, Izinga elikhulu lokuziphatha.
zu.duties: Yabel imisebenzi namaphrojekthi mayelana nokunakekelwa kwezinto ezikhona kanye nokuqasha okusha. Qaphela inqubo kanye nezinkundla ezechitshiyelwayo kumaphrojekthi okunakekelwa okwamanje namaphrojekthi amancane okwakhiwa kabusha. Zibandakanye njenyanga zokuhlangana ngokuqhubeka kwephrojekthi nabahlanganyeli abahambisanayo. Qiniseka ukuthi uhlelo lolawula imisebenzi lubuyekezwa, unikeze imibiko kanye nezilinganiselo futhi uphakamise futhi uqaphele izinkundla kanye nezinkokhelo. Qiniseka ukuthi amadokhumenti wokuthenga, izinkomba namabhili ezingani ziqinisekisiwe. Qiniseka ukuphathwa kweqiniso kwezenkonzo ngokuxazulula izinkinga. Khuthaza futhi usize ama-SMME, i-BBBEE ne-PPPs. Khuthaza izinhlelo ze-Extended Public Works Programme (EPWP). Qoqa futhi uhambise ulwazi ngokwe-Extended Public Works Programme. Phatha inqubo yokuhlonza izidingo, izinsiza ezintsha nezidingo zokuqasha okuncane okusha kanye nokulungisa izinto ezikhona ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhalazo zabathengi ziphenywa futhi kulandelwa. Lungisa futhi humusela izinhlobonhlobo namadrawing. Bhala amadokhumenti wezilinganiselo futhi uhlanganise izinkomba, amabhili ezingani namadokhumenti okubiza. Hlaziya futhi unikeze izincomo mayelana nezilinganiselo nokubiza. Thintana nabahlanganyeli abahambisanayo ngemibhalo yezobuchwepheshe. Nikeza izincomo nesiqondiso kubaqashiwe nabacekela phansi ngokuhambisana nemithetho, imithetho yamala nokuqashwa kwenza kanjani. Hlela amasistimu kanye nezenzo ukuze abaqashiwe nabacekela phansi balandele imithetho, imithetho yamala nokuqashwa kwenza kanjani. Qinisekisa izikweletu futhi uqinisekise inqubo yezinkokhelo. Hlola futhi uqeqeshe imiyalo yokuguqula nezicelo zokunwetwa kwezikhathi zokuqeda. Yazise abaqashiwe nabacekela phansi ngamaphrojekthi futhi uqinisekise izikhalo zezimali ezikhokhelwayo. Qiniseka ukuphathwa kweqiniso kwezenkonzo. Siza futhi xazulula izinkinga ezivezwa amaphrojekthi futhi uhlele imibiko ngokuqhubeka kwamaphrojekthi Hlonza izidingo zokuqeqeshwa amakhono futhi unikeze ithuba lokuziqeqesha nokuthuthuka abangaphansi. Nikeza izincomo nesiqondiso ngokuhumusha nokusebenzisa imithetho, izinqubomgomo nezenzo. Qiniseza ukulawula ikhwalithi kanye nokuthi uhlelo lokusebenza lusebenza kahle ngenqubo eya edlangeleni eyenziwe ngabalawuli bezinto bese ubika ngomsebenzi wonke onikelwe. Qaphela ukusetshenziswa okuhle kwemishini, izitolo kanye nezinkundla. Phatha uhlelo lokusebenza nokuthuthuka komnyango.

xh.title: Mphathi WoKohlwayo Kwezomsebenzi: Zobuchwephesha
xh.summary: Mphathi WoKohlwayo Kwezomsebenzi wokunyanga izinto zobuchwephesha eThelle Mogoerane Facility Maintenance Hub, ofuna i-National Diploma okanye i-Trade Test kunye neminye emi-6 yamava.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma (T/N/S streams) okanye efanayo/ N3 kunye ne-Trade Test edlulisiweyo kwindawo yezoBuchwephesha/ Ubindi njengomphathi wezobuchwephesha (Engineer Technician). Unyaka ozinze ngamava abafanelekileyo angu-6. Ilayiseni yomqhubi egunyazisiweyo. Ikhono: Ulwazi oluhle lokuthetha nokubhala, ulwazi lobuchwephesha oluhambelana noshishino lwakho, Ulwazi ngomthetho ofanelekileyo namazinga olawulo kokuhloba, Amafutha ahlelekileyo ekubumbeni nokusebenza ngendlela ecwangciswayo, ikhono lokubeka izinto ezibalulekileyo kuqqa kwaye uqedele imisebenzi ngexesha elibelweyo. Ikhono lokunaka iinkcukacha, amandla okusebenza ngokwemanyano. : Qaphela inkqubela nemali eveliswa kumapjektheyi akhoyo okunonotha kunye namapjektheyi amancinci amasha, thatha kwabathengi iintlanganisela zenkqubela zenyanga, Phatha imisebenzi yabakhi-mboni kunye nabacebisi apho kufanelekileyo, Qonda ukusebenza nokuziphatha kwabangaphantsi kwakho. Abantu kumbindi, ubungcali, nxibelelwano lomanyano, uguqulo, iimbekaphincamthetho zeBatho Pele, ukuqwalasela iinkcukacha, inyaniso nengqiqo, Inguqu ezomeleleyo.
xh.duties: Yabelana ngemisebenzi kunye namapjektheyi ngokwokunonotha kwemisebenzi ekhoyo nentsha. Qaphela inkqubela nemali eveliswa kumapjektheyi akhoyo okunonotha kunye namapjektheyi amancinci amasha. Thatha kwabaqhagamshelwana abafanelekileyo iintlanganisela zenkqubela zenyanga. Qinisekisa ukuba iNkqubo yoLawulo loMsebenzi ihlaziyiwe, nikezela iingxelo kunye nokulinganisa kwaye ucebe kwaye ulawule imali eveliswa nentlawayo. Qinisekisa ukuchaneka kwamaxwebhu okuqasha, iinkcazelo kunye neebhile ezimalini. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo lwesivumelwano ngokusombulula iingxabano. Khuthaza kwaye uncede i-SMMEs, i-BBBEE kunye ne-PPPs. Khuthaza iinjongano ze-Extended Public Works Programme (EPWP). Qokelela kwaye ungenise ulwazi mayelana nexesha elanduliweyo lenkqubo yomsebenzi oqulunqiweyo. Lawula inkqubela yokubonisa iimfuno, iinkonzo ezintsha nadiimfuno zomsebenzi omtsha omncinci nokulungisa imisebenzi ekhoyo ngokuqinisekisa ukuba iingxaki zabathengi ziphyongiwa kwaye zilandelelwa. Yakha kwaye ucacise iindlela nezizobo. Yenza amaxwebhu okusika nentengo kwaye uhlanganise iinkcazelo, iibhile ezimalini namaxwebhu okusika. Gxumela kwaye unikeze izindululo ngokusika nentengo. Thintathana nabahlaliswana abafanelekileyo malunga nezicala zobuchwephesha. Nikeza ingcebiso nokukhokeza abakhi-mboni kunye nabacebisi malunga nokuthobela umthetho, imigaqo kunye nenkqubo. Misela inkqubela nemiqathango ukuze abakhi-mboni kunye nabacebizi bathobele umthetho, imigaqo kunye nenkqubo. Qinisekisa i-invoyisi kwaye uqinisekise inkqubela yentlawayo. Hlola kwaye ulungise i-variation orders kwaye ucelo ukwandiswa kwamaxesha. Yaziisa abakhi-mboni kunye nabacebisi ngamapjektheyi kwaye uqinisekise iimfuna zemirhasho. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo lwesivumelwano. Qhubela phambili kwaye usombulule iingxaka eziphuma kwamapjektheyi kwaye uhlanganise iingxelo zenkqubela ngamapjektheyi Chonga iimfuno zophuhliso lwamakhono kwaye unikeze iimfundo namathuba okuphuhlisa abangaphantsi. Nikeza ingcebiso nokukhokeza ngokucacisa nokusebenzisa umthetho, iinkqubakuxhomekeki kunye nemigaqo. Qinisekisa ulawulo lobuhle nendlela esebenza ngayo ezi ithi kumsebenzi ozenziwo ngamajaji bomsebenzi kwaye uchaze ngawo onke amasebe abelwe kuye. Qaphela ukusetyenziswa okuchanekileyo kwesixhobo, iitokhwe nemali echithwayo. Lawula inkqubo yemveliso kunye nophuhliso yesebe.

jobs.summary: Control Works Inspector (Mechanical) sought by the Gauteng Department of Infrastructure Development to oversee maintenance projects at the Dr George Mukhari Facility Maintenance Hub.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma (T/N/S streams) or equivalent/ N3 and a passed Trade Test in the Mechanical environment/ Registration as an Engineering Technician. A minimum of 6 years appropriate experience. A valid driver’s license. Competencies: Excellent spoken and written communication skills. Technical knowledge relevant to your industry. Knowledge of relevant legislation and quality control standards. Good organisational skills and a methodical approach to work. The ability to prioritise workloads and meet project deadlines. The ability to pay close attention to detail. Good team working skills. Skills: Monitor the progress and expenditure on current maintenance projects and minor new works projects. Attend monthly project progress meetings with clients. Manage the activities of contractors and consultants where applicable. Supervise the performance and conduct of subordinates. Attributes: People centered, professionalism, collective responsibility, transformation, Batho Pele Principles, attention to detail, honesty and integrity, Strong ethics.
jobs.duties: Allocate tasks and projects in relation to the maintenance of existing and new works. Monitor the progress and expenditure on current maintenance and minor new works projects. Attend monthly project progress meetings with relevant stakeholders. Ensure that the Works Control System is updated, provide reports and estimates and recommend and monitor expenditure and payments. Ensure accuracy of tender documents, specifications and bills of quantities. Ensure effective contract administration through the resolution of disputes. Promote and assist SMMEs, BBBEE and PPPs. Promote the initiatives of the Extended Public Works Programme (EPWP). Gather and submit information in terms of the extended public works programme. Manage the process for the identification of needs, new services and requirements for minor new work and repairs to existing work by ensuring that customer complaints are investigated and follow-up. Develop and interpret plans and sketches. Draw-up quotation documents and compiles specifications, bills of quantities and bid documents. Adjudicate and provide recommendations on quotations and bids. Liaise with relevant stakeholders in respect of technical aspects. Provide advice and guidance to contractors and consultants in respect of compliance to legislation, regulations and procedures. Put systems and procedures in place to ensure contractors and consultants adhere to legislation, regulations and procedures. Verify invoices and certifies progress of payments. Check and process variation orders and requests for the extension of deadlines. Brief contractors and consultants on projects and certify claims for fees. Ensure effective contract administration. Facilitate and resolve problems emanating from projects and develop progress reports on projects. Identify skills development needs and provide training and development opportunities for subordinates. Provide advice and guidance on the interpretation and application of legislation, policies and procedures. Ensure quality control and effective and efficient workflow of work done by Works Inspectors and report on all work allocated. Monitor the proper utilisation of equipment, stores and expenditure. Administer the departmental performance and development system.

af.title: Control Works Inspector: Meganies RE NO: Refs/056871

'n Minimum van 6 jaar toepaslike ervaring. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Uitstekende mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Tegniese kennis wat relevant is tot u bedryf. Die vermoë om noukeurig op detail te let. Goeie spanwerkvaardighede. Vaardighede: Monitor die vordering en besteding aan lopende instandhoudingsprojekte en klein nuwe werke-projekte. Bywoon maandelikse projekvorderingsvergaderings met kliënte. Bestuur die aktiwiteite van kontrakteurs en konsultante waar van toepassing. Toesig hou oor die prestasie en gedrag van ondergeskiktes. Bywoon maandelikse projekvorderingsvergaderings met relevante belanghebbendes. Verseker dat die Werkebeheerstelsel op datum gehou word, verslae en ramings verskaf en besteding en betalings aanbeveel en monitor. Verseker die akkuraatheid van tenderdokumente, spesifikasies en hoeveelhedestate. Verseker effektiewe kontrakadministrasie deur die skikking van geskille. Bestuur die proses vir die identifisering van behoeftes, nuwe dienste en vereistes vir klein nuwe werk en herstelle aan bestaande werk deur te verseker dat kliënteklagtes ondersoek en opgevolg word. Ontwikkel en vertolk planne en sketse. Stel kwotasiedokumente op en samestel spesifikasies, hoeveelhedestate en bieddokumente. Beoordeel en verskaf aanbevelings oor kwotasies en bieë. Skakel met relevante belanghebbendes rakende tegniese aspekte. Verskaf advies en leiding aan kontrakteurs en konsultante rakende nakoming van wetgewing, regulasies en prosedures. Stel stelsels en prosedures in plek om te verseker dat kontrakteurs en konsultante aan wetgewing, regulasies en prosedures voldoen. Verifieer fakture en sertifieer die vordering van betalings. Kontroleer en prosesseer variasiebevele en versoeke om die verlenging van sperdatums. Lig kontrakteurs en konsultante oor projekte in en sertifieer eise vir fooie. Verseker effektiewe kontrakadministrasie. Fasiliteer en los probleme op wat uit projekte voortspruit en ontwikkel vorderingsverslae oor projekte. Identifiseer behoeftes vir vaardigheidsontwikkeling en verskaf opleidings- en ontwikkelingsgeleenthede vir ondergeskiktes. Verskaf advies en leiding oor die vertolking en toepassing van wetgewing, beleide en prosedures. Verseker gehaltebeheer en effektiewe en doeltreffende werkvloei van werk wat deur Werke-inspekteurs gedoen is en verslag doen oor alle toegewysde werk. Monitor die behoorlike benutting van toerusting, voorraad en besteding. Administreer die departementele prestasie- en ontwikkelingstelsel.

zu.title: I-Control Works Inspector: Mechanical RE NO: Refs/056871
zu.summary: I-Control Works Inspector (Mechanical) ifunwa ngu-Gauteng Department of Infrastructure Development ukuze alole amaphrojekthi okugcina emsebenzini e-Dr George Mukhari Facility Maintenance Hub.

Uqobo lokuze okungenani iminyaka eyi-6 ehambisana nomsebenzi. Ilayisenzi yomshayeli egunyazwe. Amakhono: Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhala. Ukwaziswa ngobuchwepheshe okuhlobene nobuciko bakho. Ukwaziswa ngomthetho nokungafuni ekulawuleni izinga. Amakhono ahle okuhlela ukusebenza kanye nendlela ecalile yomsebenzi. Ukwazi ukuqaphela izidingo eziyinhloko futhi ugqobe ngesikhathi esihle. Ukuguqula amaphutha nakwezinye izikhathi. Amakhono ohlelo. Amakhono: Qapha inqubo kanye nehlazo lezimali emaphrojekthini okuqhuba futhi nakwezincwadi ezisha ezincane. Hlanganyela emihlanganweni yamaphrojekthi yenyanga zonke kulo bathengi. Phatha imisebenzi yabathengi bokwakha kanye nabaluleki lapho kufanele khona. Lawula ukusebenza kanye nokuziphatha kwabaphansi. Izimpawu: Abantu abagxile ebusweni, ukuphathwa ngobungcweti, ukuba nomthwalo ohlangene, ukuguqulwa, izinhlelo zomzabalazo, ukuqaphela izinkambiso, ukwethembeka nokuba ngumnegi, izinkambiso ezinqukene.
zu.duties: Abanikeze imisebenzi namaphrojekthi ahlobene nokugcinwa kwemisebenzi ekhona eyensiwe. Lolungele inqubo kanye nokuchithwa kwemali emisebenzini yokuqhuba kanye namaphrojekthi amancane amasha. Hlanganyela emihlanganweni yenyanga zonke eyingenela phakathi kwamaphrojekthi nabanikazi bawo. Qinisekisa ukuthi Isistimu Yokulawula Imisebenzi ibuyekezwe, inikeze imibalo nokubalwa kwezindleko, futhi uphakamise ulawule imali ekhishiwe kanye nezimali ezikhokhwayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi amadokhumenti okuthengisa, izinkambiso namabhilidi ezingcindezi zifana njengoba kumele. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezinkonzo ngendlela elumele ngokuxazulula izinkinga. Khuthaze futhi usize amasmoli amancane (SMME), i-BBBEE kanye nama-PPP. Khuthaza izinhloso zohlelo olwedlule lwemisebenzi yomphakathi (EPWP). Qoqa futhi uhlolelolwazi ngokushaya kwesiHloko sehlelo lolwedlule lwemisebenzi yomphakathi. Phatha inqubo yokuhlonza izidingo, izinsizakalo ezisha nokuningi kwamaphrojekthi amasha namaphrojekthi okulungiswa emisebenzini ekhona ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhalo zabathengi zihlaziya futhi zilandelwa. Yakhe futhi uhumathe izinkatha namadumela. Bhala amadokhumenti okubhalisa bese uqoqa izinkambiso, amabhilidi ezingcindezi namadokhumenti okuthenga. Hlabela futhi uphakamise izinkambo ezibhalisayo futhi okuthengiswayo. Xhumana nabanikazi baphakeme ngemvumbo yezinsiza ezihlobene nobuchwepheshe. Nikeza izeluleko nokuqondisa abathengi bokwakha kanye nabaluleki emthethweni, emiyalweni nasenkambisweni. Misela izinhlelo zokusebenza nemikhuba ukuze kuqiniseke, abathengi bokwakha nabaluleki bathobela umthetho, imiyalo nemikhuba. Qalolasise izimali ezifunwa futhi uqinisekise ukuthi imali kanye nokuhamba kwemisebenzi kuhamba njengoba kumele. Hlola futhi uphathe imiyalo yokushintsha izinkambiso kanye nezicelo zokunweba izinsuku zokuqedela. Chaza abathengi bokwakha kanye nalabaluleki ngephrojekthi futhi uqinisekise izicelo ezimalini zabo. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezinkonzo ngempumelelo. Qondisa futhi uxazulule izinkinga ezivelwa kumphakathi waphrojekthi futhi yakhe imibalo yenhlekelele yamaphrojekthi. Hlaziya izidingo zezinsiza ezintsha futhi usize abaphansi ngezinsizakalo ezisha kanye nezidingo zemisebenzi eyintsintsib3 ezintsha nokulungisa imisebenzi ekhona. Yakhe futhi uhumathe izinkatha namadumela. Qoqa futhi uhlolelolwazi ngokushaya kwesiHloko sehlelo lolwedlule lwemisebenzi yomphakathi. Hlaziya imisebenzi eadingwa ukuze kube khona amakhono amasha futhi nikeza ithuba lokuzijwayeza kanye nokuqeqeswa abaphansi. Nikeza izeluleko nokuqondisa ekwaziseni nokusebenziseni umthetho, amaphoyisa nemikhuba. Qinisekisa ukulawula ukuthula kokuqinisekisa ukuphumelela kokuqhubeka komsebenzi owenziwe abayilawuli bawo. Lolungele ukusetshenziswa okufanele kwezinsiza, izitolo nemali ekhishiwe. Phatha inkambiso yokuhlolwa kwezinsizakalo zomnyango.

Ikhono lokubeka ngokwendlela umthwalo wokusebenza ugcwele nokuqinisekiswa kwemigca yeprojekthi. Ikhono lonakele iinkcukacha. Ikhono lokusebenza njengeqela. jobs.summary: Control Works Inspector for building maintenance at the Springs District Maintenance Hub, requiring a National Diploma or Trade Test with six years of relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma (T/N/S streams) or equivalent/ N3 and a passed Trade Test in the Building environment/ Registration as an Engineering Technician. A minimum of 6 years appropriate experience. A valid driver’s license. Competencies: Excellent spoken and written communication skills. Technical knowledge relevant to your industry. Knowledge of relevant legislation and quality control standards. Good organisational skills and a methodical approach to work. The ability to prioritise workloads and meet project deadlines. The ability to pay close attention to detail. Good team working skills. Skills - Monitor the progress and expenditure on current maintenance projects and minor new works projects. Attend monthly project progress meetings with clients. Manage the activities of contractors and consultants where applicable. Supervise the performance and conduct of subordinates. Attributes: People centered, professionalism, collective responsibility, transformation, Batho Pele Principles, attention to detail, honesty and integrity, Strong ethics.
jobs.duties: Allocate tasks and projects in relation to the maintenance of existing and new works. Monitor the progress and expenditure on current maintenance and minor new works projects. Attend monthly project progress meetings with relevant stakeholders. Ensure that the Works Control System is updated, provide reports and estimates and recommend and monitor expenditure and payments. Ensure accuracy of tender documents, specifications and bills of quantities. Ensure effective contract administration through the resolution of disputes. Promote and assist SMMEs, BBBEE and PPPs. Promote the initiatives of the Extended Public Works Programme (EPWP). Gather and submit information in terms of the extended public works programme. Manage the process for the identification of needs, new services and requirements for minor new work and repairs to existing work by ensuring that customer complaints are investigated and follow-up. Develop and interpret plans and sketches. Draw-up quotation documents and compiles specifications, bills of quantities and bid documents. Adjudicate and provide recommendations on quotations and bids. Liaise with relevant stakeholders in respect of technical aspects. Provide advice and guidance to contractors and consultants in respect of compliance to legislation, regulations and procedures. Put systems and procedures in place to ensure contractors and consultants adhere to legislation, regulations and procedures. Verify invoices and certifies progress of payments. Check and process variation orders and requests for the extension of deadlines. Brief contractors and consultants on projects and certify claims for fees. Ensure effective contract administration. Facilitate and resolve problems emanating from projects and develop progress reports on projects. Identify skills development needs and provide training and development opportunities for subordinates. Provide advice and guidance on the interpretation and application of legislation, policies and procedures. Ensure quality control and effective and efficient workflow of work done by Works Inspectors and report on all work allocated. Monitor the proper utilisation of equipment, stores and expenditure. Administer the departmental performance and development system.

af.title: Beheer Werkinspekteur: Bouwerk
af.summary: Beheer Werkinspekteur vir gebouonderhoud by die Springs Distriksonderhoudsentrum, wat 'n Nasionale Diploma of Vaktoets vereis met ses jaar se relevante ervaring.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma (T/N/S-strome) of ekwivalent/ N3 en 'n geslaagde Vaktoets in die Bou-omgewing/ Registrasie as 'n Ingenieurstegnikus. 'n Minimum van 6 jaar toepaslike ervaring. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Uitstekende mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Tegniese kennis relevant tot jou bedryf. Kennis van toepaslike wetgewing en gehaltebeheerstandaarde. Goeie organisatoriese vaardighede en 'n metodiese benadering tot werk. Die vermoë om werklading te prioritiseer en projektermyne na te kom. Die vermoë om noukeurig op detail te let. Goeie spanwerkvaardighede. Vaardighede - Monitor die vordering en besteding op huidige onderhoudsprojekte en klein nuwe werksprojekte. Bywoon maandelikse projekvorderingsvergaderings met kliënte. Bestuur die aktiwiteite van kontrakteurs en konsultante waar toepaslik. Toesig hou oor die prestasie en gedrag van ondergeskiktes. Kenmerke: Mensgerig, professionaliteit, kollektiewe verantwoordelikheid, transformasie, Batho Pele-beginsels, aandag aan detail, eerlikheid en integriteit, sterk etiek.
af.duties: Wys take en projekte toe in verband met die onderhoud van bestaande en nuwe werke. Monitor die vordering en besteding op huidige onderhouds- en klein nuwe werksprojekte. Bywoon maandelikse projekvorderingsvergaderings met tersaaklike belanghebbendes. Verseker dat die Werkebeheerstelsel opgedateer word, verslae en ramings verskaf en besteding en betalings aanbeveel en monitor. Verseker die akkuraatheid van tenderdokumente, spesifikasies en hoeveelheidslyste. Verseker effektiewe kontrakadministrasie deur die skikking van geskille. Bevorder en bystand SMME's, BBBEE en PPP's. Bevorder die inisiatiewe van die Uitgebreide Openbare Werke-program (EPWP). Versamel en verskaf inligting in terme van die uitgebreide openbare werke-program. Bestuur die proses vir die identifisering van behoeftes, nuwe dienste en vereistes vir klein nuwe werk en herstelwerk aan bestaande werk deur te verseker dat kliënteklage ondersoek word en opgevolg word. Ontwikkel en interpreteer planne en sketse. Stel kwotasiedokumente op en samevat spesifikasies, hoeveelheidslyste en bieddokumente. Beoordeel en verskaf aanbevelings oor kwotasies en bodde. Skakel met tersaaklike belanghebbendes rakende tegniese aspekte. Verskaf advies en leiding aan kontrakteurs en konsultante rakende nakoming van wetgewing, regulasies en prosedures. Stel stelsels en prosedures in plek om te verseker dat kontrakteurs en konsultante aan wetgewing, regulasies en prosedures voldoen. Verifieer fakture en sertifieer vordering van betalings. Kontroleer en prosesseer variasieordes en versoeke om die verlenging van sperdatums. Lig kontrakteurs en konsultante in oor projekte en sertifieer eise vir fooie. Verseker effektiewe kontrakadministrasie. Fasiliteer en los probleme op wat voortspruit uit projekte en ontwikkel vorderingsverslae oor projekte. Identifiseer behoeftes vir vaardigheidsontwikkeling en verskaf opleidings- en ontwikkelingsgeleenthede vir ondergeskiktes. Verskaf advies en leiding oor die interpretasie en toepassing van wetgewing, beleide en prosedures. Verseker gehaltebeheer en effektiewe en doeltreffende werkvloei van werk gedoen deur Werkinspekteurs en rapporteer oor alle werk toegewys. Monitor die behoorlike benutting van toerusting, voorrade en besteding. Administreer die departementele prestasie- en ontwikkelingstelsel.

zu.title: I-Control Works Inspector: Ukwakha
zu.summary: I-Control Works Inspector yokugcina izakhiwo e-Springs District Maintenance Hub, edinga i-National Diploma noma i-Trade Test eneminyaka eyisithupha yeziphephelo ezihambisana nendima.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma (amagatsha e-T/N/S) noma okulingana nayo/ i-N3 nesidlulele i-Trade Test emkhakheni wokwakha/ Ukwelulelwa njengenjiniyela yobuchwepheshe. Ubuncane beminyaka engu-6 yeziphephelo ezifanele. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ikhono: Ikhono elinhle lokukhuluma nokubhala. Ulwazi lobuchwepheshe oluhambisana nomkhakha wakho. Ulwazi ngemithetho ehambisana namazinga okulawula izinga. Ikhono elinhle lokuhlela kanye nendlela ebenze ngayo ngokuqeqeke. Ikhono lokubeka izinto ezibaluleke kakhulu phambili nokuhlangabezana nemikhawulo yephrojekthi. Ikhono lokunaka imininingwane ngokuqeqeke. Ikhono elinhle lokusebenza njengaqhikiza. Amakhono - Qapha inqubo nokuchithwa kwemali kumaphrojekthi okugcina okwamanje namaphrojekthi amancane okwakha okusha. Hlangana emihlanganweni yenyanga yokuqhuba phambili kwamaphrojekthi nakhothisi. Phatha imisebenzi yabo abakhiyo nabahunyazi lapho kufanele khona. Qapha ukusebenza nokuziphatha kwabangaphansi. Izimpawu: Ukwugxila kubantu, ukuziphatha ngobungcweti, uxanduva oluhlangene, inguquko, Izimiso ze-Batho Pele, ukunaka imininingwane, ukuqotho nokuthembeka, Izimiso ezinamandla.
zu.duties: Yabel imisebenzi namaphrojekthi ngokuhambisana nokugcina izinto ezikhona nezinto ezintsha. Qapha inqubo nokuchithwa kwemali kumaphrojekthi okugcina okwamanje namaphrojekthi amancane okwakha okusha. Hlangana emihlanganweni yenyanga yokuqhuba phambili kwamaphrojekthi nabahambisana nomsebenzi. Qiniseka ukuthi i-Works Control System ibuyekeziwe, nikeza imibiko nokubala kwemali futhi ucabange futhi uqaphe ukuchithwa kwemali nokukhokhelwa. Qiniseka ukuzinza kwemibiko yokunikela izinkomba, izinkomba nemibhalo yamagesi. Qiniseka ukuphathwa kwamavesi ngokusebenza ngokusombulula izinkinga. Khuthaza futhi usize ama-SMME, i-BBBEE nama-PPP. Khuthaza izinhlelo ze-Extended Public Works Programme (EPWP). Qoqa futhi uhambise ulwazi ngokuya kw Uhlelo lwe-Extended Public Works Programme. Phatha inqubo yokuqonda izidingo, izinsiza ezintsha nezidingo zemisebenzi yokuqasha okuncane okusha nokulungisa imisebenzi ekhona ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhalazo zakhothisi ziphenywa futhi kulandelwe. Yakha futhi uhumushe amaphulani nezithombe ezincane. Bhala imibiko yamacashiso futhi uhlele izinkomba, imibhalo yamagesi nemibiko yokuqasha. Hlola futhi unikeze izincomo ngamacashiso nezinqubo zokuqasha. Xhumana nabahambisana nomsebenzi ngezindlela zobuchwepheshe. Nikeza izincomo nokuqondisa abakhiyo nabahunyazi ngokuhambisana nemithetho, imithetho elawula izinqubo. Hlela izindlela nezinqubo ukuze abakhiyo nabahunyazi bahambisane nemithetho, imithetho elawula izinqubo. Qinisekisa amafakisi futhi uqinisekise inqubo yokukhokha. Hlola futhi ucubungula imiyalo yokushintsha nezicelo zokwandise imikhawulo. Tunca abakhiyo nabahunyazi ngamaphrojekthi futhi uqinisekise izinkomba zemali efakwe yimali. Qiniseka ukuphathwa kwamavesi ngokusebenza. Lulule futhi usombulule izinkinga eziphuma kumaphrojekthi futhi uhlele imibiko yokuqhuba phambili kumaphrojekthi. Qonda izidingo zokuthuthukisa izikhono futhi unikeze ithuba lokuzijwayeza nokuthuthukisa abangaphansi. Nikeza izincomo nokuqondisa ekuhumusheni nokusebenzisa imithetho, izinqobo namazinga. Qiniseka ukulawula izinga kanye nokuqhuba ngempumelelo nokuqhubele phambili komsebenzi owenziwe abo Works Inspectors futhi unikeze imibiko ngawo wonke umsebenzi owabeliwe. Qapha ukusetshenziswa okufanele kwempahla, izitolo nokuchithwa kwemali. Phatha uhlelo lomnyango lokuqhuba nokuthuthukisa.

xh.title: I-Control Works Inspector: I-Building
xh.summary: I-Control Works Inspector yokugcinwa kwezakhiwo kwi-Springs District Maintenance Hub, ifuna i-National Diploma okanye i-Trade Test eneminyaka emithandathu yamava ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma (T/N/S streams) okanye efanayo/ N3 kunye ne-Trade Test edlulileyo kwintsika yeZakhiwo/ Ukbhaliswa njengo-Engineering Technician. Okungenani i-6 iminyaka yamava afanelekileyo. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Iikhompetensi: Amakhono amabalideyo ethetha kunye nobhalo. Ulwazi lobugcisa oluhambelana neshishini lakho. Ulwazi ngomthetho ofanelekileyo nangamagangatho oluLawulo lomgangatho. Amakhono ahle wokulungelelanisa kwaye indlela esecaleni yokusebenza. Isikhokelo sokubeka izinto eziphambili kwaye ugcwalise iintsuku zokuphela komsebenzi. Isikhokelo sokunakisisa iinkcukacha. Amakhono amahle okusebenza njengesebe. Iikhono - Landela inkqubela phambili nentlawulo kumanqaka olondolozo abakhoyo namanqaka amancinci emisebenzi entsha. Zithathele iindibano zenyanga zinkqubela phambili kumanqaka kunye nabakhonzi. Lawula imisebenzi yabakhi kwaye nabacebisi apho kufuneka khona. Qeqesha ukusebenza nokuziphatha kwabasebenzi abangaphantsi kwakho. Iimpawu: Abantu kwindawo ephakathi, ukuzithoba, njengenxaxheba kumanyano, iinguqu, iZipho zeBatho Pele, ukuqwalasela iinkcukacha, inyanisekileyo nangobubele, Imigaqo eqinileyo.
xh.duties: Abanikeze iimisebenzi namanqaku ekunxibelelaniswa nokugcinwa kwemisebenzi esele ikhona n entsha. Landela inkqubela phambili nentlawulo kumanqaku olondolozo abakhoyo namanqaku amancinci emisebenzi entsha. Zithathele iindibano zenyanga zezichaso zinkqubela phambili kumanqaka kunye nabathathi nxaxheba abafanelekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba iNkqubo yoLawulo lwaManqaka ihlaziyiwe, zeze neengxelo nangaphezulu kwaye ucele kwaye ulandele iindleko nentlawulo. Qinisekisa ukuchaneka kwamaxwebhu olwabiwo, iinkcukacha nobungakanani beebhili. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo lweenkonzo ngokusombulula iingxabano. Khuthaza kwaye uncede i-SMMEs, i-BBBEE ne-PPPs. Khuthaza iinkqubo zeNkqubo yezaSebenzi eZandisiweyo zorHlathi (EPWP). Qokelela kwaye ungenise ulwazi ngokwale nkqubo yomsebenzi owandisiweyo zorolwathi. Lawula inkqubo yokuchonga iimfuno, iinkonzo ezintsha neemfuno zemisebenzi entsha emincinci nokulungiswa komsebenzi osele ukhona ngokuqinisekisa ukuba iizikhalazo zabakhonzi ziphengululwa kwaye kusenziwa ulandelelwano. Qamba kwaye uchaze iiplani nezalathiso. Bhala amaxwebhu okucela ixabiso kwaye uqulunqe iinkcukacha, amaxabiso amaninzi namaxwebhu okucela. Gweba kwaye unike iingcebiso ngokucela iixabiso kunye nezicelo. Nanisele nxaxheba abafanelekileyo ngeePLana zezinto ezinobuchule. Nikela ingcebiso kunye nesikhokelo kubakhi kunye nabacebisi malungana nokuthobela umthetho, iimigaqo nendlela ezisetyenziswa. Misela iinkqubo nendlela ezisetyenziswa ukuqinisekisa ukuba abakhi nabacebisi bayathobela umthetho, iimigaqo nendlela ezisetyenziswa. Qinisekisa iingxelo zentlawulo kwaye uqinisekise inkqubela phambili yentlawulo. Khangela kwaye ulungise iiodolo zotshintsho nezicelo zokwandisa iintsuku zokuvala. Yazise abakhi nabacebisi ngamanqaka kwaye uqinisekise izicelo zeefi. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo lweenkonzo. Khokela kwaye usombulule iingxaki ezisuka kumanqaka kwaye uphuhlise iingxelo zinkqubela phambili kumanqaka. Chonga iimfuno zophuhliso lwezakhono kwaye unike ithuba lokuzifundisa nokuqeqeselwa abasebenzi abangaphantsi kwakho. Nikela ingcebiso kunye nesikhokelo malungana nokuchaza nokusebenzisa umthetho, iinkqazo nendlela ezisetyenziswa. Qinisekisa ulawulo lomgangatho kwaye kuqubeke kakuhle kwaye ngokusebenza kakuhle komsebenzi owenziweyo ngabaKholwisi beManqaka kwaye uchaze ngawo onke amanqaka abelwe. Landela ukusetyenziswa okulungileyo kwemishini, izinto ezilungisiweyo kunye nentlawulo. Lawula inkqubo yesebe yokusebenza nokuphuhlisa inkqubo.

Kennis van toepaslike wetgewing en gehaltebeheerstandaarde. Goeie organisatoriese vaardighede en 'n metodiese benadering tot werk. Die vermoë om werklaste te prioritiseer en projekdeadlyn te haal. Die vermoë om noukeurig aandag aan besonderhede te gee. Goeie spanwerkvaardighede. Vaardighede - Monitor die vordering en besteding aan huidige instandhoudingsprojekte en klein nuwe werke-projekte. Bwoon maandelikse projekvorderingsvergaderings met kliënte. Bestuur die aktiwiteite van kontrakteurs en konsultante waar toepaslik. Hou toezig oor die prestasie en gedrag van ondergeskiktes. Eienskappe: Mensgerig, professionaliteit, kollektiewe verantwoordelikheid, transformasie, Batho Pele-beginsels, aandag aan besonderhede, eerlikheid en integriteit, sterk etiek.
af.duties: Wys take en projekte toe in verband met die instandhouding van bestaande en nuwe werke. Monitor die vordering en besteding aan huidige instandhoudings- en klein nuwe werke-projekte. Bwoon maandelikse projekvorderingsvergaderings met relevante belanghebbendes by. Verseker dat die Werke-kontrolesisteme opgedateer word, verslae en skattings verskaf en besteding en betalings aanbeveel en monitor. Verseker akkuraatheid van tenderdokumente, spesifikasies en hoeveelhedelyste. Verseker effektiewe kontrakadministrasie deur die skikking van geskille. Bevorder en bystand SMME's, BBBEE en PPP's. Bevorder die inisiatiewe van die Extended Public Works Programme (EPWP). Versamel en dien inligting in ingevolge die uitgebreide openbare werke-program. Bestuur die proses vir die identifisering van behoeftes, nuwe dienste en vereistes vir klein nuwe werk en herstelwerk aan bestaande werk deur te verseker dat klagtes van kliënte ondersoek en opgevolg word. Ontwikkel en interpreteer planne en sketse. Stel kwotasiedokumente op en stel spesifikasies, hoeveelhedelyste en boddokumente saam. Beslis en verskaf aanbevelings oor kwotasies en bodde. Skakel met relevante belanghebbendes ten opsigte van tegniese aspekte. Verskaf advies en leiding aan kontrakteurs en konsultante ten opsigte van nakoming van wetgewing, regulasies en prosedures. Stel stelsels en prosedures in plek om te verseker dat kontrakteurs en konsultante wetgewing, regulasies en prosedures navolg. Verifieer fakture en sertifieer die vordering van betalings. Kontroleer en prosesseer variasie-orders en versoeke om verlenging van deadlyn. Brief kontrakteurs en konsultante oor projekte en sertifieer eise vir fooie. Verseker effektiewe kontrakadministrasie. Fasiliteer en los probleme op wat voortspruit uit projekte en ontwikkel vorderingsverslae oor projekte. Identifiseer behoeftes vir vaardigheidsontwikkeling en verskaf opleidings- en ontwikkelingsgeleenthede aan ondergeskiktes. Verskaf advies en leiding oor die interpretasie en toepassing van wetgewing, beleide en prosedures. Verseker gehaltebeheer en effektiewe en doeltreffende werkvloei van werk wat deur Werke-inspekteurs gedoen is en rapporteer oor alle werk toegeken. Monitor die behoorlike benutting van toerusting, voorrade en besteding. Administreer die departementele prestasie- en ontwikkelingstelsel.

zu.title: I-Control Works Inspector: Building
zu.summary: I-Control Works Inspector ephethe ukugcinwa kwezakhiwo kanye namaprojekthi amasha amancane e-Sedibeng Facility Maintenance Hub, edinga i-National Diploma noma i-Trade Test enaminyaka yohlu lwamava eminyaka yonke.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma (T/N/S streams) noma okulinganayo/ N3 kanye ne-Trade Test edlule kwindawo yokwakha/ Ukubhaliswa njenge-Engineering Technician. Okungenani eminyaka engu-6 yohlu lwamava olufanelekile. Ilekhensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ikhono: Ikhono elihle lokukhuluma nokubhala. Ulwazi lobuchwepheshe oluhambisana nomkhakha wakho. Ulwazi ngemithetho ehambisana kanye nemizingo yokulawula izinga. Ikhono elihle lokuhlela kanye nendlela enolwesimi ekusebenzeni. Ikhono lokubeka izinhloso zomthwalo wokusebenza futhi ufinyelele izinkathi ezimisiwe zamaprojekthi. Ikhono lokunaka ngokucophelela imininingwane. Ikhono elihle lokusebenza ngokubambisana eqenjini. Amakhono - Qapha inqubo kanye nokuchithwa kwemali kumaprojekthi okugcinwa okwamanje kanye namaprojekthi amasha amancane. Hamba emihlanganweni yenqubo yamaphrojekthi yanyanga zonke nabathengi. Phatha imisebenzi yabakhiqizi nabahola izinsulu lapho kufanele khona. Qapha ukusebenza kanye nokuziphatha kwabangaphansi. Izici: Abantu abasembindeni, ubungcweti, ibumba elibhekene nobuwusiswa, intuthuko, izimiso ze-Batho Pele, ukuqapha imininingwane, ukuqotho nokuzethemba, Izimiso ezomehlqo.
zu.duties: Yabelela imisebenzi kanye namaprojekthi mayelana nokugcinwa kwezinto ezikhona kanye nomsebenzi omusha. Qapha inqubo kanye nokuchithwa kwemali kumaprojekthi okugcinwa okwamanje kanye namaprojekthi amasha amancane. Hamba emihlanganweni yenqubo yamaprojekthi yanyanga zonke nabalingane abahambisanayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi i-Works Control System ibuyekezwa, hunyusela imibiko kanye nezilinganiso futhi uphakamise futhi uqaphe ukuchithwa kwemali kanye nenzalo. Qinisekisa ukuqiniseka kwamadokhumenti wethenda, izinkomba kanye namabhilidi ezilinganiso. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezinkontileka ngempumelelo ngekulahlekelwa ngemibhikela. Khuthaza futhi usize ama-SMME, i-BBBEE ne-PPP. Khuthaza izinhloso ze-Extended Public Works Programme (EPWP). Qoqa futhi uhambise ulwazi ngokwe-Extended Public Works Programme. Phatha inqubo yokuhlonza izidingo, izinsiza ezintsha nezimfuneko zomsebenzi omusha omncane kanye nokulungiswa kwemisebenzi ekhona ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhalazo zabathengi zisungatuliwa kanti futhi kulandelwa. Butha futhi uhumushe amaphilani kanye namazweba. Bhala amadokhumenti ezilinganiso futhi uhlole izinkomba, amabhilidi ezilinganiso kanye namadokhumenti ezinkokhelo. Gagula futhi unike izincomo ngamazweba kanye nemitshali yezinkokhelo. Xhumana nabalingane abahambisanayo ngemayelana nezindaba zobuchwepheshe. Nikeza izeluleko nezindlela kubakhiqizi kanye nabahola izinsulu mayelana nokuhambisana nemithetho, izimiso kanye nezinqubo. Siza izimiso kanye nezinqubo ukuthi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abakhiqizi kanye nabahola izinsulu balandela imithetho, izimiso kanye nezinqubo. Qinisekisa izikweletu bese uqinisekisa inqubo yenzalo. Hlola futhi ucubungule imiyalo yokushintsha kanye nezicelo zokunweba izinkathi ezimisiwe. Tshela abakhiqizi kanye nabahola izinsulu ngamaprojekthi bese uqinisekisa izikhalo zamafa. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezinkontileka ngempumelelo. Siza futhi uxazulele izinkinga ezivelwa emaprojekthini bese uphakamisa imibiko yenqubo ngamaprojekthi. Hlonza izidingo zentuthuko yamakhono bese unikeza ithuba lokutadisha nentuthuko kwabangaphansi. Nikeza izeluleko nezindlela ekuhumusheni nokusebenzisa imithetho, izinqubo kanye nezinqubo. Qinisekisa ukulawula izinga kanye nokuhamba kwebumba lokusebenza okulandela izimiso kwemisebenzi ehloliwe futhi wenze imibiko ngawo wonke umsebenzi onikeziwe. Qapha ukusetshenziswa okulungile kwesibonakaliso, izitolo nokuchithwa kwemali. Phatha indlela yokusebenza nokututhuka komnyango.

xh.title: Mhloli Wolawulo Lwemisebenzi: Izakhiwo
xh.summary: Mhloli Wolawulo Lwemisebenzi ohlola ukonakaliswa kwezakhiwo neeprojekthi ezintsha ezincinci kwiSedibeng Facility Maintenance Hub, efuna iNational Diploma okaniTrade Test enyakeni wemfama ongama-6.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma (T/N/S streams) okanye okulingana nayo/ N3 kwaye udlule i-Trade Test kwendawo yezakhiwo/ Ukuhlelwa njenge-Engineering Technician. Uphelo lweminye elinganayo nemfama ongama-6. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni. Iikhompethensi: Amakhono amabalwobuchwepheshe bokuthetha nokubhalabuchwepheshe. Ulwazi lobuchwepheshe oluhambelana noluntu lwakho. Ulwazi ngemithetho eluncedo nezindinganiso zolawulo lokugqibela. Amakhono amahle ahlwayo indlela yokusebenza enamacandelo. Ikhono lokubeka izibophelelo zemisebenzi ngokubaluleko nokugqiba iiprojekthi ngexesha. Ikhono lokunaka iinkcukacha ngokusondeleyo. Amakhono amahle okusebenza njengelqembu. Amakhono - Qaphela inkqubela nemali echithiweyo kwizi projekthi zokonakaliswa zemihla ngemihla neeprojekthi ezintsha ezincinci. Zithabathathwe iindibano zeminye yonke yomqondiso weprojekthi nabathengi. Lawula imisebenzi yabalungiseleli nabaqaqambi kwindawo efunekayo. Qondisa inkqubo nobuziphendu kwabangaphansi. Iimpawu: Abantu bagqiywa phakathi, ubungcali, izibophezelo ngokuhlanganisa, ugqitho, IimPinciple zikaBatho Pele, ukunaka iinkcukacha, inyaniso nobuzondo, Izenzo ezomelezileyo.
xh.duties: Yahlula imisebenzi neeprojekthi ngokubeka kubakho konakaliswa okukhoyo neemisebenzi entsha. Qaphela inkqubela nemali echithiweyo kwiProjekthi zokonakaliswa nemihla le neeprojekthi ezintsha ezincinci. Zithabathathwe iindibano zeminye yonke yomqondiso weprojekthi nabalingane ngesiseko. Qinisekisa ukuba iNkqubo yolawulo Lwemisebenzi ihlaziya, nikezela iingxelo nezilinganiso kwaye uze ucocise kwaye ulawule imali eya kusetyenziswa nentlawulo. Qinisekisa ukuchaneka kwemibhalo yetender, iinkcazelo neebhili ezimalini. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo lwenkqubo ngenkathazo ezingxoxweni ezidlayo. Khuthaza kwaye uncede i-SMMEs, i-BBBEE nee-PPPs. Khuthaza iingcamango zenkqubo ye-Extended Public Works Programme (EPWP). Qokelela kwaye ufake ulwazi ngokwala ma nkqubo yemisebenzi ekhuliweyo yoluntu. Lawula inkqubo yokumisela iimfuno, iinkonzo ezintsha neemfuno ezincinci zomsebenzi omtsha nalungiselelo lomsebenzi osekho ngokwenza isigqi sokuba iingxeki zabathengi ziphononongwe kwaye kwenziwe landelo. Yakha kwaye uhlole iiplani nezifanekiso. Hlamba imibhalo ye-third quotation kwaye uqokele iinkcazelo, iibhili zokulinganisa nemibhalo yokuqhutyelwa phambili. Qondisa kwaye unike iingcebiso kwiwoqhuto nemibuzo ngemigiqatho. Nikeza icebo nolwazi kwabakhi nabajulukile ngokubaluleka kumthetho, iimiso neenkqubo. Misela iinkqubo neendlela zokwenza ukuze abakhi nabajululukile bamkele umthetho, iimiso neenkqubo. Qinisekisa i-invoices kwaye qinisekisa inkqubela yentlawulo. Hlola kwaye ucubungula iinkqubo zokutshintsha nemighelelo yokuwusa ixesha. Yala izaziso kwabakhi nabajululukile ngeeprojekthi kwaye qinisekisa iimpahla zemali ezibizwa ngayo. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo lweekhonthrekthi. Khokela kwaye usombulula iingxaki ezivela kwiiprojekthi kwaye yakha iingxelo ngenkqubela yeprojekthi. Misela iimfuno zokuphuhliswa kweekhono kwaye unikezelela iindya zokuphuhliswa kwabangaphansi. Nikeza icebo nolwazi ngokuhlohlwa nokusetyenziswa komthetho, iinkqubo neendlela. Qinisekisa ulawulo logqibelelolitya olusebenzayo nolukhuselekileyo lomsebenzi owenziweyo ngabaMhloli bemisebenzi kwaye wenze ingxelo ngomsebenzi wonke onikelweyo. Qaphela ukusetyenziswa ngokufanelekileyo kwezixhobo, izitolo nemali echithiweyo. Lawula inkqubo yokusebenza nokuphuhliswa kwesebe.

af.title: Hoofvakwerker: Bouwerk
af.summary: Hoofvakwerker: Bouwerk by die Department of Infrastructure Development in Gauteng, wat 'n Vaktoets-sertifikaat en 10 jaar se kwalifikasie-ervare ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Vaktoets-sertifikaat. 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se kwalifikasie-ervare ervaring as 'n Vakwerker/Vakwerker-oprigter. Bewys van erkende ervaring sal vir gekortlysde aansoekers versoek word). 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die Openbare Diens-wetgewing, Beleide en Regulasies, OHS-wet, Kennis van die departementele beleide, strategieë en prosedures. Rekenaargesteunde tegniese toepassings. Kennis van regsonderhouing. Kennis en vaardighede van produksieprosesse. VAARDIGHEDE- Projekbestuur, tegniese verslagskrywing, tegniese konsultasie, probleemoplossing en analise, besluitneming, kreatiwiteit, kommunikasie, rekenaar, beplanning en organisering. Kennis van tegniese ontwerp en analise. EIENSKAPPE- Spanwerk, veranderingbestuur, finansiële bestuur, kliëntfokus en reaksievermoë.
af.duties: Bestuur tegniese personeel. Bestuur afdelingsvergaderings. Bestuur werkassesserings vir die afdeling. Bestuur materiaalvereistes vir die afdeling. Bestuur beskikbaarheid van gereedskap en materiaal vir die afdeling. Bestuur kliëntinteraksie en -verhoudings. Bestuur skedulering van werk. Bestuur die algehele produktiwiteit van die afdeling. Bestuur die ontwikkeling van instandhoudingskedules. Handhaaf nakoming vir die byhou van instandhoudingskedules en rekords. Ondersoek en literatuurstudies. Pas bevindings van navorsing in die werksomgewing toe. Teken prestasie gebaseer op goedgekeurde Werksbeskrywings, Strategiese en Jaarlikse Prestasieplanne van die departement. Bestuur menslike hulpbronne en handhaaf dissipline. Bestuur die voorsiening van toerusting wat deur personeel vereis word vir die bereiking van lewerings in hul onderskeie Werksbeskrywings. Bestuur vaardigheidoordrag tussen personeel en externe tegniese assistente en/of konsultante. Beplan en wys werkverantwoordelikhede en prosesse toe om werkprestasie te beheer, insluitend gehalteversekering. Bestuur personeelprestasie en -ontwikkeling.

zu.title: Inkosi Yemisanwelo: Ukwakha
zu.summary: Inkosi Yemisanwelo: Ukwakha eDepartment of Infrastructure Development eGauteng, idinga Isitifiketi Sezivivinyo Zobugcweli neminyaka engu-10 yohlu olwamuva kokuthola izifundo.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi esifanele Sezivivinyo Zobugcweli. Ubuncwane beminyaka engu-10 ohlu olwamuva kokuthola izifundo njengomunanwelo/Nduna Yomunanwelo (Isiboniso sohlu esivunyiwe sizocelwa kubaphumelelayo abafaki isicelo). Ilayisense yokuqasha esemthethweni. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngomthetho, izinqubomgomo nemithetho yesevisi yomphakathi, umthetho we-OHS, ulwazi ngezinqubomgomo, izindlela nezinqubo zomnyango. Izinhlelo zobuchwepheshe ezisebenzisana nokuqoqwa kwenkqubo. Ulwazi lokuhambisana nomthetho. Ulwazi namakhono enqubo yokukhiqiza. AMANDLA- Ukuphatha imiklamo, ukubhala imibiko yobuchwepheshe, ukweluleka ngobuchwepheshe, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, ukuthatha izinqumo, ukudala, ukuxhumana, Ikhompyutha, ukuhlela nokuqamba. Ulwazi lokwakhiwa nokuhlaziya kobuchwepheshe. IZIMFONGO- Ukusebenza njengomqabi, ukuphatha inguquko, ukuphatha imali, ukugxila kumthengi nokusabelo.
zu.duties: Phatha abasebenzi bobuchwepheshe. Phatha igebe leSigaba. Phatha ukuhlola izinkalo zeSigaba. Phatha izidingo zensimbi zeSigaba. Phatha ukutholakala kwamathuluzi nensimbi yeSigaba. Phatha ukuxhumana nobuhlobo bamakhasimende. Phatha ukuhlela isikhathi somsebenzi. Phatha ukukhiqiza ngokuphelele kweSigaba. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa kwemishwana yokulungisa. Phoqa ukuhambisana nomthetho ekugcineni kwemishwana yokulungisa namarekhodi. Zibandakanya ocwaningweni nokufunda izincwadi. Faka iziphumelo zocwaningo endaweni yomsebenzi. Phuma ngokusekelwe kumshwana Womsebenzi Ovunyiwe, Amapholani Okusebenza Okubalulekile Nokwonyaka aqashiwe umnyango. Phatha abantu zigcinwe ngomugqo. Phatha ukubonelela ngemikhiqizo edingwa yabasebenzi ukufeza okukhiqizwayo kumShwana Womsebenzi wabo. Phatha ukudluliswa kwamakhono phakathi kwabasebenzi nabasizi bobuchwepheshe bangaphandle kanye/noma abeluleki. Hlela abele izibopho zomsebenzi nezinqubo ukuze ulawule ukusebenza kuhlanganise nokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi. Phatha ukusebenza nokuthuthukiswa kubasebenzi.

xh.title: Inkosi yengqungquthela: Ukwakha
xh.summary: Inkosi yengqungquthela: Ukwakha kwiSebe lePhuhliso loZakhiwo eGauteng, efuna Isatifikethi seVavanyo loBuchwephesha neminyaka yamava eli-10 emva kokufumana isidanga.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esifanelekileyo soVavanyo loBuchwephesha. Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-10 yamava emva kokufumana isidanga njengengqungquthela/Foreman yengqungquthela. Isibonakaliso samava aqaphelewayo siya kucelwa kubafakeli abakhethiweyo). Ilayisense yokuqhuba esebenzayo. Ikhono: Ulwazi malunga neMitha yaseNkonzeni kaLuntu, iMigaqo neMimiselo, uMthetho we-OHS, Ulwazi lwemigaqo, iinkqubo neendlela zesebe. Izicelo zobuchwephesha ezisekwe kwi-khompyutha. Ulwazi lokuzinza ngokomthetho. Ulwazi namandla eprosesi yokuvelisa. AMANDLA- uLawulo lwamaphuzu, ubhalo lwemibiko yobuchwephesha, ingcali yobuchwephesha, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuwahlula-hlula, ukwenza izigqibo, ukuqamba, ukuNxibelelana, iKhompyutha, ukuCwangcisa nokuQamba. Ulwazi lokuyila nokuwahlula-hlula ngobuchwephesha. IIMPAWU- uKusebenza njengesiqhenga, uLawulo lwenguquko, uLawulo lweMali, uKugxila kumthengi nokuphendula.
xh.duties: Lawula abasebenzi bobuchwephesha. Lawula iNdzima yokuHlangana. Lawula ukuQwalaselwa kwamasebenzi kweNdima. Lawula iimfuno zezinto zokwenza kweNdima. Amandla- Ukuhlela kanye nokuhlanganisa, ukuxhumana ngomlomo nangokubhalayo kanye namandla okusebenza ngekhompyutha. Izimpawu- Ukusebenza njengeqembu, ukuphatha inguquko, ukuphatha izimali, ukugxila kubathengi kanye nokuphendula.
zu.duties: Phatha izinkonzo zobuchwepheshe kanye nensekelo kanye nababuciko kunqobe abahlobene nendawo yomsebenzi, kulezi zindawo zokusebenza ngasese, okuqashiwe kanye nezindawo zokusebenza ezobuchwepheshe. Nikeza okungenwa kumagama obuchwepheshe abakhona, okubhalwe ngokwemithetho kanye nezinqubo ukufaka nobuchwepheshe obusha. Qinisekisa inani lokwemvumelelo ngokuhambisana nezinhlelo. Zama ucwaningo kanye nefundo elukhaya mayelana nobuchwepheshe bokwenza/bokuhlakula ukuthuthukisa amandla obuchwepheshe. Xhumana namaphanele/hulumo mayelana nezindaba ezihlobene nobuchwepheshe/bokwenza. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa, ukukhuthaza nokusebenzisa abantu abawuthola emkhakheni wokwenza ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi ulwazi loluqeqeshiwe luzakwazi ukwenza izinkonzo zobuchwepheshe ngokuhambisana nezidingo zendawu yokusebenza. Phatha izindawo ezibalulekile zokusebenza kwabangaphansi ngokusetha kanye nokubukeza imigomo yokusebenza bese uthatha izinyathelo zokulungisa ukweqa ukufeza imigomo yomnyango. Umthetho woLawulo loQoqosho ngeNyanga ka-2007 kunye nomthetho wokuQinisekisa uKhuseleko lwabasebenzi ka-1993. Ikhono- ukucwangcisa nokuqamba, unxibelelwano ngelizwi nangokubhala kunye nolwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Iimpawu- Ukusebenza ngokubambisana, ukulawula utshintsho, ukulawula iimali, ugqaliselo lwabathengi nokuqonda iimfuno zabo.
xh.duties: Lawula iinkonzo ezingundoqo kunye noncedo ngokubambisana noBashumile abangengonalwazi/nabaBugcisa kunye nabanye abahlobo kumasebe wezobugcisa emzileni, kwindlu yokusebenzela neziko lobugcisa. Qinisekisa ukukhuthazwa kokhuseleko ngokwesiseko seMithetho nemigaqo yelizwe. Nikezela ngamagugu kumamaxwebhu obugcisa, izahluliselo ezingundoqo neenkqubo ezikhoyo ukuze kufakelwe inqanaba elisha lobugcisa. Qinisekisa ukubaluleka kweMiba ngokomthetho. Nikezela ngamagugu kwinkqubo yokubalwa kweMali. Hlaba uncedo oluchaziweyo ukuze unikeze iinkcukacha ezithe vetshe kumaxwebhu aqinisekisa ukuqonda ukwazi okuvela kwiinkalo zobugcisa. Qhuba usifundo nobuntu kunye nezikhulu ezahlukeneyo ukuba ufunde ngakumbi ngendalo yemisebenzi yobugcisa. Nxibelelana ngeenkalo ezahlukeneyo ngokwemisebenzi yobugcisa. Lawula abantu abangesondo nabaBantu abangakwaziyo kwindalo yomntu wonke ukuze ancedise ngolwazi olubalulekileyo ekubeni ubugcisa bubuyile ngokomthetho. Lawula iinkalo ezingundoqo ngokumisela iinkqubo ezithe vetshe ekuhlahluzeni iinkqubo ezize ngokobugcisa nemisebenzi yokulawula. IMIBUZO : Nkosazana S. Mboto kwi-076 521 4118.

Government Immovable Asset Management Act of 2007 kanye neOccupational Health and Safety Act of 1993 and Regulations. Amakhono: Ukuhlela kanye nenhlelo, unxibelelwano ngomlomo kanye noloba kanye namakhono ekhompyutha. Izinto ezibalulekile- Ukusebenza njengeqembu, ukuphatha ushintsho, ukuphatha imali, ukugxila kumthengi kanye nokuqhasha.
zu.duties: Phatha imisebenzi yobuchwepheshe kanye nenkondlo kanye nabachwepheshe/Abashisekelo kanye nabahlanganyeli enkundleni, emsebenzini wentshisekelo kanye nemisebenzi yenhlelo yobuchwepheshe. Qinisekisa ukuthuthwa kwezokuphepha ngokuvumelana nezidingo zomthetho kanye nezimiso. Nikeza izinto ezingenayo kumanuals abakhona zobuchwepheshe, izithombe ezijwayelekile kanye namaprocedures ukuze kufakwe ubuchwepheshe obusha. Qinisekisa ikhwalithi ngokuvumelana nemibalabala. Nikeza izinto ezingenayo enkombulweni yebhajethi. Qamba futhi unikeze imibiko njengoba kudingeka. Nikeza futhi uhlanganise izinto ezingenayo ohlelweni lokusebenza lobuchwepheshe. Buyekeza idatabase. Phatha abashisekelo kanye nabantu abahlobene kanye nempahla. Yenza ucwaningo kanye nemfundvo yabaliteracyobuchwepheshe ukuze kuphuculwe ubuchwepheshe. Xhumana namabhodi/amakhansele ahlobene ngemikhondo yobuchwepheshe. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa, ukukhuthaza kanye nokusetshenziswa kwemithombo yabantu egatsheni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulwazi olufanele oluzoqhuba nempumelelo yemisebenzi yobuchwepheshe ngokwezidingo zenhlelo. Phatha izindawo ezibalulekile zokusebenza zabangaphansi ngokusetha kanye nokuqapha izinga lokusebenza futhi uthathe izinyathelo zokulungisa ukweqa ukuze kufinyelelwe imigomo yomnyango.

xh.title: Inkokheli Yabaphathi bezoVocoboza: Isakhiwo Samaqela A-C
xh.summary: Isikhundla sokuNkokheli kubaphathi bezoVocoboza (Isakhiwo Samaqelu A-C) kwi-Hub yoLungiso lweZiko laseDr George Mukhari eGauteng, esifuna iSatifikhate yeVavanyo loMsebenzi kunye neminyaka elishumi yamava emva kokufumana isigqibo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikhate esifanelekileyo sevavanyo lomsebenzi. Ubuncinane beminyaka elishu yamava emva kokufumana isigqibo njengomphathi wocoboza/ogqiba kubaphathi (Ibanga lolwazi oluzakucelwa kubakhethiwe abafakiwe isicelo). Ilayisenisi yomqhubi eseleyo. Iakhompetensi: Ulwazi ngeMigaqo yoKwakhiwa yoMbuso kunye noMthetho woMzingo woKwakhiwa uMthetho wonke wama-103 ka-1977, imigaqo kunye neMigaqo kaMasipala, ukuKhuthazwa kuMthetho wokuFikelela kwiNkcazelo ka-2000, ukuKhuthazwa koMthetho woBulungisa oluLawulayo ka-2000. UMthetho woLawulo lweZipho zokuGcinwa zeZigidi zoMbuso ka-2007 kunye noMthetho woKhathalelo lweMpilo nokuKhuseleko emsebenzini ka-1993 nemiGaqo. Amakhono: uCocwaso lweNkqubo nokuHlela, unxibelelwano ngemile ngokubhaliweyo nangezomlomo kunye nakhono ekuSebenziseni ikhompyutha. Iimpawu- uKusebenza njengeqela, uLawulo lweTshintsho, uLawulo lweMali, uKugxila kuxhaso malini nokuPhendula.
xh.duties: Lawula iinkonzo zobuchwepheshe kunye noncedo ngokusebenzisana nabachwephesheli/baphathi becocoboza kunye nabahlotyeni kumsebenzi wangaphandle, kwindlu yomsebenzi nakwiofisi yobuchwepheshe. Qinisekisa ukuthuthuziswa kokhuseleko ngokwemigaqo yomthetho nemiqathango. Nikela ngeengqiqo kwimaniyali zobuchwepheshe ezikhoyo, iimilo ezingezanto ezisesikweni nemiqathango ukuze kufakwe inkqubo entsha yobuchwepheshe. Qinisekisa ikhwalithi ngokwemiqathango. Nikela ngeengqiqo kumcimbi wokwakhiwa kwebhajeti. Lungisa kwaye uthumele iingxelo njengoko kufuneka. Nikela kwaye uquke iingngqiqo kwindlela yokusebenza ngobuchwepheshe. Hlaziya idayitabhizi. Lawula abaphathi becocoboza kunye nabasebenzi abahlobene nayo kunye neempahla. Zenzele uphando kunye noPhando lweMibhalo ngobuchwepheshe/obunjineli ukuphucula ulwazi. Thintana namabalwe/amarhulu ahlobene ngemiba yobuchwepheshe/obunjineli. Lawula uphuhliso, ukhuthazo nokusetyenziswa kwezibonelelo zabantu kule ndlela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulwazi olunamandla lokuphumeza impumeleko eqhubekayo yezinkonzo zobuchwepheshe ngokweenkqubo nezidingo zenkcubeko. Lawula iindawo ezibalulekileyo zokuPumeza kwabaphansi ngokumisa nokuphonononga amanqanaba okuphumeza kwaye uthathe izigqibo zokulungisa iingxaki ukuze kufikelelwe kumgama wesebe.

Ilayisensi yomqhubi egunyazisiweyo. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngeMthetho weNkululeko yaseMzantsi Afrika weNkcubeko nokuNika iNtshukumo yeSimemo soBunikazi bama-2000, ukuKhuselwa kolwazi olungenwa ngemigaqo yesiNtu esiNgqu iLiso ngokwesiseko senkqubo yeSizwe yeLwazi olutsha noloncedo ngokobuNguni bama-2000, iKhompyutha yonke iSebe ngokulawulwa komSebenzi osemthethweni wase Burkina Faso i-2007. Amakhono - Ukucwangcisa nokuqamba, unxibelelwano ngesandla ngesahluko kakhulu ulwazi lwe-computer. Iimpawu - Ukusebenza njengotsha, ukulawula utshintsho, ukulawula imali, ugqolo kwakhiliyithi kwaye uncedo ekuphenduleni.
xh.duties: Phatha iinkonzo ezenzelwe inqanaba lobuchwepheshe nokuxhasa ngokubambisana namaTechnicians/AmaArtisan nabahlobo kumisebenzi enxulumene nolwandle, kwithimpu lokusebenza nakwindlu yobuchwephesha. Qinisekisa ukuthuthwa komgama ophakathi kokuvunywa kwezomthetho nemigaqo. Nikela ngezinto kumanuali obuchwephesha aqulethiweyo, iimpomboo ezingagqibekanga kunye nemigaqo ukuze kubekho iteknoloji entsha. Qinisekisa izinga lokhwalithi ngokwemigaqo efunekayo. Nikela ngolwazi kwinqubo yokwenza ibhajethi. Lunga kwaye uzithumela iingxelo njengoko kufunekayo. Nikela kwaye udibanise iingcalo kwicebo lokusebenza lobuchwepheshe. Hlaziya idatabase. Phatha amaArtisan nabasebenzi abanye abanobudlelwane nabo kunye nempahla. Phatha ukuphuhliswa, ukukhuthazwa nokusetyenziswa kweemisebenzi yabantu kwicala ukuze kuqiniseke ulwazi oluchanekileyo loxhaso lokuphela lwezinkonzo zobuchwepheshe ngokwemfuno neemfuno ze-organisation. Phatha indawo ebalulekileyo yokusebenza kwabangaphantsi ngokumisela nokulinganisa amagqabantshintshi okusebenza uthatha amanyathelo okulungisa iindleko ezingachanekanga ukuze kufezwe iinjongo zesebe. Lawula kwaye ulinge ukuchithwa kwemali ngokwekhadi lebhajethi ukuze kuqiniseke ukulawulwa okulungele kwesikhathi. Phatha ixabiso elizisayo leshishini kwimisebenzi ecaleni kwentsimbi kunye nezo nkonziza. Ukuphuhliswa ngokungapheli kwexesha ukugcina izazongorwe ezitsha kwaye nemigaqo. Uphando/izifundo ngobuchwepheshe beempuzi/nzulu-mlilo ukuze ukhulise ulwazi lwakho. Thintana nemiNigi /iBhunga ngezinto eziphathelene nobuchwepheshe/bu-INjineri.

af.title: Hoofhandwerker: Bou
af.summary: Hoofhandwerker: Bou-pos by Springs District Maintenance Hub wat 'n Vaktoetsertifikaat en 10 jaar post-kwalifikasi-handwerkerservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Vaktoetsertifikaat. 'n Minimum van 10 jaar post-kwalifikasi-ervaring as 'n Handwerker/Handwerker-voorman (Bewys van erkende ervaring sal vir gekorte lys aansoekers versoek word). 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die National Building Regulation and Building Standards Act No 103 of 1977, Regulasies en Munisipale Regulasies, Promotion of Access to Information Act of 2000, Promotion of Administrative Justice Act of 2000. Government Immovable Asset Management Act of 2007 en Occupational Health and Safety Act of 1993 en Regulasies. Vaardighede- Beplanning en organisering, verbale en geskrewe kommunikasie en rekenaargeletterdheidsvaardighede. Kenmerke- Spanwerk, veranderingbestuur, finansiële bestuur, klienfokus en reaksievermoë.
af.duties: Bestuur tegniese dienste en ondersteuning in samewerking met Tegnici/Handwerkers en medewerkers in veld-, werkswinkel- en tegniese kantooraktiwiteite. Verseker die bevordering van veiligheid in ooreenstemming met statutêre en regulatoriese vereistes. Verskaf insette tot bestaande tegniese handleidings, standaardtekeninge en prosedures om nuwe tegnologie te inkorporeer. Verseker gehalteversekering in ooreenstemming met spesifikasies. Verskaf insette tot die begrotingsproses. Stel verslae op en dien dit in soos vereis. Verskaf en konsolideer insette tot die tegniese operasionele plan. Werk databasisse by. Bestuur handwerkers en verwante personeel en bates. Bestuur die ontwikkeling, motivering en benutting van menslike hulpbronne vir die dissipline om bevoegde kennisbasis vir die voortgesette sukses van tegniese dienste volgens organisatoriese behoeftes en vereistes te verseker. Bestuur ondergeskiktes se sleutelprestasie-areas deur prestasiestandaarde vas te stel en te monitor en maatreëls te tref om afwykings reg te stel om departementele doelwitte te bereik. Beheer en monitor uitgawes volgens begroting om doeltreffende kontantvloei-bestuur te verseker. Bestuur die kommersiële meerwaarde van die dissiplineverwante aktiwiteite en dienste. Deurlopende individuele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures. Navorsing/literatuurstudies oor tegniese/ingenieurswese-tegnologie om kundigheid te verbeter. Skakel met relevante liggame/rade oor tegniese/ingenieurswese-verwante aangeleenthede.

zu.title: Induna Yobuciko: Izakhiwo
zu.summary: Isikhundla se-Induna Yobuciko: Izakhiwo esikhungweni i-Springs District Maintenance Hub esidinga isitifiketi se-Trade Test futhi unamava eminyakeni engu-10 njengenomzila wociko ngemva kokuthola isifundo.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi esifanele se-Trade Test. Ubufakazi bokuthola okungenani unamava eminyakeni engu-10 ngemva kokuthola isifundo njengomuntu ocikelwayo/Onozimela wociko (Ubufakazi bamava abaziwayo buzocelwa kubafakazi abakhethiwe). Ilayisense yokuqasha esemthethweni. Ikhono: Ulwazi lwe-National Building Regulation and Building Standards Act No 103 of 1977, izimiso kanye nezimiso zeMasipala, i-Promotion of Access to Information Act of 2000, i-Promotion of Administrative Justice Act of 2000. I-Government Immovable Asset Management Act of 2007 kanye ne-Occupational Health and Safety Act of 1993 nezimiso. Amakhono- Ukulelela nokuhlela, ukuxhumana ngomlomo nakubhalwe kanye namakhono okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Izici- Ukusebenza njengeqembu, ukuphatha inguquko, ukuphatha imali, ukugxila kumthengi nokuphendula.
zu.duties: Phatha izinsiza zobuchwepheshe kanye nesenzo sobuntu kanye nabacikelwayo/onozimela nabahlanganyeli emsebenzini wasekamu, esitolo sabuciko nasemsebenzini wehofi lobuchwepheshe. Qinisekisa ukukhuthazwa kokuphepha ngokuhambisana nezidingo zomthetho kanye nezimiso. Nikeza izimpumputhe ezincwadini zomuchwepheshe ezikhona, kudweba okujwayelekile nasezimisweni ukuze kufakelwe ezobuchwepheshe ezintsha. Qinisekisa izinga lekhwalithi ngokuhambisana nezinkomba. Nikeza izimpumputhe enkambisweni yokwakhelelwa isabelo sebhajethi. Qamba futhi uhlike imibiko njengoba kudingeka. Nikeza futhi uhlanganise izimpumputhe ohlelweni lokusebenza lobuchwepheshe. Bukela izinhlangothi ezintsha kumakhompyutha. Phatha abacikelwayo kanye nabasebenzi abahlobene nabo kanye nempahla. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa, ukukhuthazwa nokusetshenziswa kwabasebenzi abantu kulendiza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulwazi olulodile olunamandla ngenxa yempumelelo eqhubekayo yezinsiza zobuchwepheshe ngokwezidingo nezidingo zenkampani. Phatha izindawo zokuqhuba izihloko eziyisihluthulelo zabaphansi ngokusetha futhi ubukele izinga lokusebenza bese uthatha izinyathelo zokulungisa ukweqa ukuze kufezwe imigomo yomnyango. Lawula futhi ubukele ukuchithwa ngokwezabelo sebhajethi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa kweqiniso kohlelo lomthamo oyimali. Phatha inani lokwengeza lokuhweba lomsebenzi ohlobene nendiza kanye nezinsiza. Ukuthuthuka komuntu ngamunye okuqhubekayo ukuze agcine nesikhathi ezobuchwepheshe ezintsha nasezimisweni. Ucwaningo/izifundo zolwazi ezintsha ngobuchwepheshe/obunjiniyela ukuze kube khona ukukhula kolwazi. Xhumana namabhodi/amakhasimende ahihlaye ngemayelana nezindaba zobuchwepheshe/zobunjiniyela.

xh.title: INkosi yabaGcini baseMvuzweni: Ukwakha
xh.summary: Isithuba sikaNtlxwana weGcini loMsebenzi: Ukwakha kwiSprings District Maintenance Hub esifuna isiQinisekiso seSatyesthi seKhadi kwaye amava eminyaka eyi-10 yokuba yigcini lomsebenzi emva kokuqesha.
xh.requirements: IsiQinisekiso esifanelekileyo seSatyesthi seKhadi. Iqondo elingentla leminyaka eyi-10 yamava okuba nguGcini lomsebenzi/Nkosana beeGcini lomsebenzi emva kokufumana isiqinisekiso (iBango lokwamkela amava liya kucelwa kwabakhetheka kwindlu ethunyelweyo). Ileyisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Iakhono: Ulwazi ngeNational Building Regulation and Building Standards Act No. 103 ka-1977, imigaqo kunye neMigaqo kaMasipala, iPromotion of Access to Information Act ka-2000, iPromotion of Administrative Justice Act ka-2000. iGovernment Immovable Asset Management Act ka-2007 kunye neOccupational Health and Safety Act ka-1993 nayo neMigaqo. Amakhono- Ucwangciso lolungelelwaniso, unxibelelwano ngokuthetha nokubhalisa kunye namakhono okusebenza ngamakompyutha. Iimpawu- Ukusebenza njengesiqhenga, ukulawula utshintsho, ukulawula iimali, ukugxila kumthengi nokuphendula.
xh.duties: Lawula iinkonzo zobuchwephesha kunye noncedo ngokubambisana namaGcini lomsebenzi/Nkosana beeGcini lomsebenzi namalungu athile kumasebe amakhulu kwimisebenzi yalo mzi, iinkampu kunye nemisebenzi yofiso lobuchwephesha. Qinisekisa ukukhuthaza ukhuseleko ngokwemigaqo yomthetho nemigaqo. Nikela izigqibo kwimanyualisi zobuchwephesha ezikhoyo, iintshaxo ezizezakwayo nendlela zokusebenza ukuze kufakwe technology entsha. Qinisekisa umgangatho wokucwangciswa ngokomgangatho obekiweyo. Nikela izigqibo kwinkqubo yokuqamba bhajeti. Hlaba uncedo kwaye ungenise izibalo njengoko kufuneka. Nikela kwaye uqinisekise izigqibo kwicwangciso lokusebenza kobuchwephesha. Phucula iisiseko ze-data. Lawula abaGcini baseMvuzweni baseMvazweni noluntu oluxhumene nayo nemali. Lawula ukuphuhliswa, ukunxibelelanisa nokusebenzisa abantu abangenamakhondo ekuqinisekiseni ulwazi oluqinisekileyo ukuze kuqhubeka kuswela phantsi ulwazi oluqinisekileyo ukuqinisekisa impumelelo esaqhubekayo yeenkonzo zobuchwephesha ngokweenkqubo zentlangano. Lawula iindawo ezibalulekileyo zokusebenza ezibekiweyo zabahleli ngokumisela nokulandelela umgangatho wokusebenza nokuthatha izigqibo ukulungisa iinguqu ezikhoyo ukuze kufikelelwe kwizigqibo zesabe. Lawula nokugcina iindleko ngokwembali ngokobheji ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulawulo lwe-cash flow olusebenzayo. Lawula ixabiso lezihloko ezongezelelweyo kwimisebenzi nenkonzo ephathwayo eqeitywe ngesihloko. Ukuphuhliswa okuqhubekayo komntu ngamnye ukuze agcine iindlela zokusebenza nobuchwephesha obutsha. Uphononongo/iifundo zengxwelo ngobuchwephesha bokusebenza ngobunjiniyela ukuphucula amakhondo. Thintana namagunya/amaBhunga achasene nezinto ezimalunga nobuchwephesha/ubunjiniyela.

Ubuchule- Ukuphatha imibhalo, ukubhala imibhalo yezobuchwepheshe, ukweluleka ngokobuchwepheshe, Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, ukwenza izinqumo, ukuba nobuchwepheshe bokudala okusha, ukuthumela imiyalezo, ukusebenzisana nekhompyutha, ukuhlela kanye nokuhlanganisa. ULwazi lokuklama nokuqaqa izinto ngezindlela zobuchwepheshe. Izinkomba- Ukusebenza ngqikithi, ukuphatha izinguquko, ukuphatha imali, ukugxila kumthengi kanye nokuphendula ngokushesha.
zu.duties: Phatha izinsizakalo ezobuchwepheshe kanye nokwesekela ngokubambisana nabacweti/Onosizo kwebhodi labo buciko kanye nabahlobene emsebenzini wasekhaya, esituluzini kanye emsebenzini ohlobene noluchwepheshe olusekhalini. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kokuvikeleka ngokwemithetho kanye nezidingo zokulawula. Nikela ngeminikelo emibhaleni, izithombe ezisendabeni kanye nokuqamba izinto eziyisinhlelo ezisebenzayo zokungena ohlelweni olusha lwamafayela nobuchwepheshe. Qinisekisa ukugqamisa izinga lempilo ngokwezidingo ezisendabeni. Nikela ngeminingwane emigidingweni yokuhlela imali. Hlela futhi uhlethe imibhalo njengoba kudingeka. Hlinzeka ngeminikelo ohlelweni lokusebenza olusemandleni futhi uhlanganise emabalweni. Hlaziya imininingwane egcinwe. Phatha abacweti abasiza emphakathini kanye nalabo abahlobene nalabo kanye nempahla. Yenza ucwaningo kanye nokuqoqwa kwezincwadi zobuchwepheshe zokulandela izinhlelo zokusebenza zobuchwepheshe/obunjiniyela ukuthuthukisa ulwazi oluyisisekelo. Yiba nxele nobudlelwano namaphuzu/aminikhulu ohlelweni mayelana nezindaba ezingokobuchwepheshe/obunjiniyela. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa, ukukhuthaza nokusetshenziswa kolwazi lwabantu kule ndawo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngokulondolozwa kokuphumelela kwezinsizakalo zobuchwepheshe ngokwemithetho nezidingo ezingokuhlelwa komphakathi. Phatha izingqikithi ezibalulekile zokusebenza kwabangaphansi ngokuhlela futhi ulawule izindinganiso eziphumelelayo bese uthatha izinyathelo zokuqamba izinto ezingezanga ezifanayo ukuze kufeze imigomo Yomnyango.

xh.title: INkulu yenkundla yomsebenzi: Yamatshini (IIBHOLA)
xh.summary: INkulu yenkundla yomsebenzi: Yamatshini (Iibhola) e Chris Hani Baragwanath Hospital e Gauteng, ifuna Isatifikethi sesivivinyo somsebenzi kunye neminyaka eyi-10 yamava emva kwesidanga.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esifanelekileyo sesivivinyo somsebenzi. Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-10 yamava emva kokufumana isidanga njengosenzi/ njengenenkundla yomsebenzi. Ilayisense yokuqeshela elisebenzayo. (Umboniso wamava abaqheketyiweyo uya kucelwa kubafake izicelo abakhethiweyo). Ikhono: Ulwazi ngomthetho weNkonzo yaSiphakathi, iMigaqo kunye neMithetho, umthetho we-OHS, ulwazi ngemigaqo yesebe, iindlela zokuqhuba kunye neenkqubo. Iinkqubo zemiyalelo ezingcweyeti ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokuvumelana nomthetho. Ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo zokuvelisa kunye namakhono. Amakhono - Ulawulo lweenkqubo, ukubhala iingxelo zobuchwepheshe, ingcaciso yobuchwepheshe, ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya, ukwenza izigqibo, ubuchule bokudala, unxibelelwano, ikhompyutha, uqwalaselo nokuqamba. Ulwazi lokwakha nobuchwepheshe nokuhlalutya. Iimpawu - Ukusebenza njengeqela, ulawulo lotshintsho, ulawulo lweemali, ukugxila kumthengi nokuphendula.
xh.duties: Qhuba iinkonzo zobuchwepheshe kunye nenkxaso kumanyathelo afanayo nabaBalinganisi/abaBenzi nabahlobo kumisebenzi yasendle, kwifem kunye nasendlini yobuchwepheshe. Qinisekisa ukukhuthazwa kokhuseleko ngokuvumelana neemfuno zomthetho nokulawulwa. Nikela ngezinto kumanual zobuchwepheshe ezikhoyo, iimfanekiso ezizeyo ngeenkqubo ukuze ufake nobuchwepheshe obutsha. Qinisekisa iqondo lekhwalithi ngokuvumelana neepekcifayo. Nikela ngezinto kumaprosesi wokwenza ibhajethi. Hlela ungaze unike iingxelo njengoko kufuneka. Nikela kunye nokuqamba izinto eziphakathi kwesebe loqwalaselo lobuchwepheshe. Hlaziya iisiseko seenkcazelo. Lawule abaBenzi abaqhagamshelana nabo basebenzi kunye nezinto. Zenze uphando kunye neefayili zokufunda ngobuchwepheshe/obunjilo-bugcisa ukuphucula ulwazi. Qhagamshelana namabumbo/amarhulu afanelekileyo kumagama obuchwepheshe/obunjilo-bugcisa. Lawula ukuphuhliswa, ukuziqhelanisa nokusebenziswa kwemithombo yabantu kwicala ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulwazi olunamandla ngokuqhubekayo kwezonko zobuchwepheshe ngokweemfuno neenkqubo zentlangano. Lawula iindawo ezibalulekileyo zokusebenza ezisezantsi ngokumisa ukuze ulawule iinqanaba zokusebenza ukuze ulungise iingcaphepha ukuphumeza iinjongo zesebe.
