jobs.summary: Construction Health and Safety Officer position at the Dr George Mukhari Facility Maintenance Hub in Gauteng, requiring a Safety Management qualification and relevant experience, paying R338 106 per annum.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification at NQF 6 as recognised by SAQA in Safety Management. A minimum of 1-2 years’ experience in Safety Management. A training in SAMTRAC, ISO 45001, HIRA, Incident Investigation, First Aid, Fire Fighting and Evacuation Coordination is required. A valid driver’s license. Competencies: Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) Act and its Regulations and environmental legislation (Construction Health and Safety), Health and safety management systems and the key components of an effective system, Principles of cause and effect and its application to hazard identification and risk management on a project. Criteria and standards for effective documentation and documents control. Skills: Computer literacy, Problem solving and analysis, Decision making, Creativity, Customer focus and responsiveness, Planning and organizing, Conflict management Attributes: Reliable and Team player.
jobs.duties: Conduct site research and use trends analysis to identify system deficiencies and incident trends and outline relevant improvements. Prepare health and safety specifications for construction sites and approve project specific health and safety plans. Complete site establishment health and safety checklists. Review and update health and safety plans. Facilitate health and safety regular site, technical and progress meetings. Compile project specific emergency response and preparedness plans and test the effectiveness. Provide guidance to the establishment of the Departmental OHS Committee. Represent the district at Departmental OHS committee meetings. Facilitate legal appointment letters for 16.2s, GMR 2.1S and OHS Committees’ Chairpersons. Provide demarcations and warning signs in areas where construction or maintenance operations are conducted. Propose and execute remedial solutions for safety related issues on sites. Attend the contractor’s site handover. Conduct hazard identification and risk assessment processes (included in the health and safety specifications of the department or the contractor) for work activities on sites. Inspect contractors’ equipment and file reports. Monitor contractors executing construction works which are not in accordance with the approved Health and Safety plans. Conduct baseline risk assessments / task specific risk assessment for the department. Conduct emergency evacuation drills in all facilities. Develop OHS Files for different facilities. Participate in management reviews of the health and safety systems. Identify training for staff and contractors on all OHS aspects. Facilitate and conduct health and safety awareness session for staff and contractors at the district on health and safety procedures, firefighting, and disaster evacuations. Act as a liaison between workers, management and subcontractors to ensure safety obligations are understood. Maintain records of safety inspections, incidents and training. Develop technical reports on health and safety issues and present findings to decision-makers.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Sikelelwa Mboto at 076 521 4118

Kudingeka ukuzijwayeza kwi-SAMTRAC, ISO 45001, HIRA, ukuphenya izehlakalo, usizo lwokuqala, ukulwa nomlilo kanye nohlelo lokukhishwa kwabantu abayingozi. Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela. xh.title: I-Construction Health and Safety Officer
xh.summary: Isithuba se-Construction Health and Safety Officer kwi-Dr George Mukhari Facility Maintenance Hub eGauteng, esifuna izifundo ze-Safety Management namava ahambelanayo, sikhawulela ngomvuzo we-R338 106 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi kwe-undergraduate kwinqanaba le-NQF 6 njengokuqatshelwa yi-SAQA kwi-Safety Management. Iminyaka engu-1-2 yamava kwi-Safety Management. Kufuneka kubekho uqeqesho kwi-SAMTRAC, ISO 45001, HIRA, Incident Investigation, First Aid, Fire Fighting and Evacuation Coordination. I-driver's license esemthethweni. Iikhompetensi: I-Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) Act ne-Regulations yayo nomthetho weemeko zendalo (i-Construction Health and Safety), iinkqubo zolawulo lweempilo nokhuseleko namacandelo abalulekileyo enkonzo ephumelelayo, iimpawu zesizathu nesiphumo nokusetyenziswa kwazo ekumaphawulweni ingozi nakulawulo lengozi kwiprojekthi. Iikhrayithariya namazinga axhasayo ombhalo olusemthethweni nolawulo lwamathuba. Iakhoniti: Ukusebenza ngekhompyutha, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuwadlulisa, ukwenza izigqibo, ukuyila, ukujolisa kumthengi nokuphendula, ukuceba nokuhlela, nolawulo loludano. Iimpawu: Othembekileyo nomdlali wethimba.
xh.duties: Yenza uphando kwisiza seprojekthi usebenzisa uhlalutyo lweendlela ukumaphawula iindlela ezingaphumeleliyo zenkqubo neendlela zeengozi uze kuchaze iimpucuko ezifanelekileyo. Lungiselela iinkcukacha zeempilo nokhuseleko kumawaka obakhiwo uvume iindlela zeempilo nokhuseleko ezizodwa ngeprojekthi. Qedela izi-1-2 checklists zeempilo nokhuseleko zokumiswa kwesika. Phinda uhlole uze uhlaziye iindlela zeempilo nokhuseleko. Yenza kube lula iindibano ezengethana ngeempilo nokhuseleko kwisiza, ngezobuchwepheshe nakwinkqubela phambili. Hlanganisela iindlela ezizodwa ngeprojekthi zokuphendula kwiimeko ezingadinwa nolungiselelo uze uvavanye ukusebenza kwazo. Nikezela isikhokelo ekusekweni kwekomiti yesebe le-OHS. Mela isithili kwindibano zekomiti yesebe le-OHS. Yenza kube lulupe amagazethi okugqiba ngokomthetho kwi-16.2s, GMR 2.1S namachairperson ekomiti le-OHS. Nikezela imida nezikhawuzo kummandla lapho kwenziwa khona iinkqubo zokwakha okanye ukulungisa. Phakamisa uze uphumeze izisombululo zokulungisa iingxaki ezinxulumene nokhuseleko emawaka. Khona kwisandla sokuba ngumsesho esizingeni sakwacontractor. Yenza inkqubo yokuziphawula iingozi nokuhlola iingozi (ezibandakanywa kwinkcukacha zeempilo nokhuseleko zesebe okanye kacontractor) kumisebenzi esizingeni. Hlola iqongo lokwakha likacontractor uze ugcine iingxelo. Qhatha ocontractor benza imisebenzi yokwakha engahambelani nendlela ezamkelekileyo zeempilo nokhuseleko. Yenga ukuhlolwa kolusu okanye kwesabelo ngesizathu esodwa kwisebe. Yenza iindibano zokuqhuba nokubaleka kwabasebenzi kuzo naziphi na iindawo. Yakha iifayile ze-OHS ngeendawo ezahlukeneyo. Thatha inxaxheba kwizihloko zolawulo zeenkqubo zeempilo nokhuseleko. Phawula uqeqesho kumbasebenzi nabacontractor kuzo naziphi na iindawo ze-OHS. Yenza ube nomnthwamnandi apho uninzi lusebenza kwaye unike isikhokelo kubaphathi nabacontractor bobungina ukwazi nokuqonda iindibano zeempilo nokhuseleko. Gcina irekhodi lokuholola, iingozi nokuqeqesha. Yakha iingxelo zobugcisa malunga neendawo zeempilo nokhuseleko uze uzibonise kubaphiwe iinkqubo zokwenza izigqibo.

jobs.duties: Receive telephone calls. Perform advanced typing work. Operate and ensure that office equipment, e.g. fax machines and photocopiers are in good working order. Record engagements of the senior manager. Utilize discretion to decide whether to accept/decline or refer to other employees’ requests for meetings, based on the assessed importance and urgency of the matter. Coordinate with and sensitizes/advises the manager regarding engagements. Compile realistic schedules of appointments. Ensure the effective flow of information and documents to and from the office of the manager. Ensure the safe keeping of all documentation in the office in line with relevant legislation and policies. Scrutinize routine submissions/reports and make notes and/or recommendations for the manager. Obtain inputs, collate and compile reports, e.g Progress reports, monthly reports, management reports. Respond to inquiries received from internal and external stakeholders. Draft documents as required. File document manager and the unit where required. Collect, analyze and collate information requested by the manager. Clarify instructions and behalf of the manager. Coordinate travel arrangements. Prioritize issues in the office of the manager. Manage the leave register and telephone accounts for the unit. Handle the procurement of standard items like stationery and refreshments. Obtain the necessary signatures on documents like procurement advice and monthly salary reports. Coordinate logistical arrangements for meetings when required Scrutinize documents to determine actions/information/other documents required for the meetings. Collect and compile all necessary documents for the manager to inform him/her of the contents. Record minutes /decisions and communicate to relevant role- players, follow-up upon progress made. Prepare briefing notes for the manager as required. Collect and coordinate all the documents that relate to the manager’s budget. Assist the manager in determining funding requirements for purposes of MTEF submissions. Keep records of expenditure commitments, expenditure and alert the manager of possible over and under spending. Check and correlate BAS reports to ensure that expenditure is allocated correctly. Identify the need to move funds between items, consult with the DDG and compile draft memos for this purpose. Compare the MTEF allocations with the requested budget and inform the DDG of changes. Remain up to date with regard to the prescripts/policies and procedures applicable to his/her work terrain to ensure efficient and effective support to the manager. Remain abreast with the procedures and process that apply in the office of the manager.

af.title: Persoonlike Assistent
af.summary: Persoonlike Assistent gesoek by die Department of Infrastructure Development Hoofkantoor in Johannesburg, waarvoor 'n Sekretariële Diploma en drie tot vyf jaar se relevante ervaring vereis word.
af.requirements: Sekretariële Diploma (NQF Level 5) of gelykwaardig. 'n Minimum van 3 – 5 jaar se ondervinding in die lewer van 'n diens aan senior bestuur. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van relevante wetgewing/beleide/voorskifte en prosedures, basiese kennis van finansiële administrasie, Vaardighede: Taalvaardighede en die vermoë om goed met mense op verskillende vlakke en uit verskillende agtergronde te kommunikeer. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Deeglike organisatoriese vaardighede. Skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om navorsing te doen en dokumente en situasies te ontleed.EIenskappe: Goeie telefoonetiket, hoë vlak van betroubaarheid, vermoë om met takt en diskresie op te tree, goeie versorging en aanbieding, selfbestuur en motivering.
af.duties: Ontvang telefoonoproepe. Voer gevorderde tikwerk uit. Bedryf en verseker dat kantoortoerusting, bv. faksmasjiene en fotostateermasjiene in goeie werkende toestand is. Neem afsprake van die senior bestuurder op. Gebruik diskresie om te besluit of om versoeke om vergaderings te aanvaar/af te wys of na ander werknemers te verwys, gebaseer op die vasgestelde belangrikheid en dringendheid van die aangeleentheid. Koördineer met die bestuurder en stel hom/haar in kennis/raad gee aangaande afsprake. Stel realistiese skedules van afsprake op. Verseker die doeltreffende vloei van inligting en dokumente na en vanaf die kantoor van die bestuurder. Verseker die veilige bewaring van alle dokumentasie in die kantoor ooreenkomstig relevante wetgewing en beleide. Ondersoek roetine-voorleggings/verslae en maak notas en/of aanbevelings vir die bestuurder. Verkry insette, stel same en compileer verslae, bv. vorderingverslae, maandelikse verslae, bestuursverslae. Reageer op navrae wat van interne en eksterne belanghebbendes ontvang word. Opstelle dokumente soos vereis. Argiveer dokumente vir die bestuurder en die eenheid waar nodig. Versamel, ontleed en stel inligting wat deur die bestuurder versoek word, saam. Verduidelik instruksies namens die bestuurder. Koördineer reërelings vir reise. Prioriteer kwessies in die kantoor van die bestuurder. Bestuur die verlofregister en telefoonrekeninge vir die eenheid. Hanteer die verkryging van standaardartikels soos stasieнер en verfrissings. Verkry die nodige handtekeninge op dokumente soos verkrygingsadvies en maandelikse salarisverslae. Koördineer logistieke reëlings vir vergaderings wanneer nodig. Ondersoek dokumente om vas te stel watter aksies/inligting/ander dokumente vir die vergaderings benodig word. Versamel en stel alle nodige dokumente vir die bestuurder saam om hom/haar van die inhoud in kennis te stel. Neem notules/besluite op en kommunikeer dit na relevante rolspelers, en volg op oor vordering gemaak. Berei notules van voorligting vir die bestuurder soos vereis voor. Versamel en koördineer alle dokumente wat met die bestuurder se begroting verband hou. Help die bestuurder om befondsingsbehoeftes vir MTEF-voorleggings te bepaal. Hou rekords van bestedingsverpligtinge, besteding en waarsku die bestuurder van moontlike oor- en onderbesteding. Kontroleer en korreleer BAS-verslae om te verseker dat besteding korrek toegeken word. Identifiseer die behoefte om fondse tussen items te skuif, raadpleeg die DDG en stel konsepmemorandums hiervoor op. Vergelyk die MTEF-toekenninge met die aangevraagde begroting en stel die DDG van veranderings in kennis. Bly op hoogte van die voorskifte/beleide en prosedures wat op sy/haar werkterrein van toepassing is om doeltreffende en effektiewe ondersteuning aan die bestuurder te verseker. Bly op hoogte van die prosedures en prosesse wat in die kantoor van die bestuurder van toepassing is.

zu.title: Nothile Ohamba Lomsebenzi
zu.summary: Kufunwa Nothile Ohamba Lomsebenzi eNtlungwini yeNtsebenzo eDepartment of Infrastructure Development Head Office eJohannesburg, ofuna i-Diploma kwezoBungqangi kwaye abe namava eminyaka ithathu ukuya kwaye zihlanu kumsebenzi ohambelanayo.
zu.requirements: i-Diploma kwezoBungqangi (NQF Level 5) okanye efanayo. Ubuncinane bamava eminyaka engama-3 – 5 ekubeni ibonelela ngenkxaso kwabaphathi abaphezulu. Ikhono ulwazi: Ulwazi ngemithetho/ iinkqazo/ amagazethi kunye neendlela ezichanekileyo. Ulwazi olusemngciphekweni ngolawulo lwezimali. Amakhono: Amakhono wolwimi nendlela yokuchazeka ngokuchanekileyo nabantu abakumazinga ahlukeneyo kwaye bevel kumaphulo ahlukileyo. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngamakhompyutha. Amakhono achanekileyo olulungiselelwa. Amakhono eXela ulwimi elibhaliweyo. Ikhono lokwenza uphando lula uxwebhu nendalo. Iimpawu: Indlela echileyo yokuthetha ngefowuni. Izinga eliphezulu lokuthembeka. Ikhono lokusebenza ngobuqhetseba ngokuzithiba, ukuzilungisa ngokuchanekileyo, indlela enhle yokuzikhusela. Ukuzilawula nokuzenzisa umdla.
zu.duties: Amkela amafowuni. Wenze umsebenzi wokuchwetheza ophezulu. Asebenze aqiniseke ukuba izixhobo zofice, njengefax machines namakhophisha-endawo zisebenza ngokuchanekileyo. Abhalise izigqibo zomphathi ophilayo. Sebenzisa ubuqhetseba ukugqiba ukuba makamkele/ala okanye athumele kubasebenzi abanye izicelo zokubonisana, ngokusekelwe kwisidingo kwaye sibingelela le nkxaso. Lungisa kwaye ulumkise/umcede umphathi ngokuzibandakanya. Yakha ishedyuli yokuboniselwa echanekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuhamba kwezindaba kwaye amaxwebhu ayokwakutshiya ofice yomphathi. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwamaxwebhu wonke ofice ngokwezimiso zemithetho. Lula ngokuthe ngqo izibhalo/iingxelo yaye enze iingcebiso okanye izindululo zomphathi. Zifumane izikhokelo anike amaxwebhu, abe adibanise axele iingxelo, njengeengxelo zokuqhubela phambili, iingxelo zenyanga, iingxelo zolawulo. Phendula izibuzo efumaniswa kubaphathi bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Bhala amaxwebhu njengoko kufuneka. Faka amaxwebhu komphathi nakwindlu lapho kufuneka khona. Lwazi, lula ngokuthe ngqo adibanise izindaba ezifunwa ngumphathi. Cacisa izikhokelo abuzele umphathi. Lungise izicwangciso zokuhambla. Phucula izindaba ofice yomphathi. Lawula irejista yokuhamba kunye nama-akhawunti efowuni. Phatha ukuthenga izinto eziqhelekileyo njengamapensile nokubuyisela. Fumana izigqibo ezifunekayo emaxwebhweni njengokubonisana ngokuthenga ngenkxaso kwaye zibe iingxelo ezinye zenyanga. Lungise izicwangciso ngokubonisana ngokufuna Lula amaxwebhu ukuze ukhethe izenzo/ulwazi/amanye amaxwebhu afunekayo kwindlu yokuboniselwa. Fumanisa kwaye udibanise zonke izixhobo ezifunekayo zomphathi ukumazisa ngolwazi. Bhala imizuzu/izigqibo uze uxelele abo bafanelekile, ulandele inkqubela. Yenzela iingcebiso ezimfutshane zomphathi njengoko kufuneka. Qokelela kwaye ulungise zonke amaxwebhu ahambelana namagxebo kaMphathi. Siza umphathi ekugqibeni izidingo zemali ukuze zithunyelwe kumagxebo eMTEF. Zigcine iirekhodi ezingeniswayo, ezikhutshiwayo kwaye lumkise umphathi malunga nokuchitheka nokungachithwa. Khangela kwaye uqamanise iingxelo ze-BAS ukuze qinisekisa ukuba imali ichitheka ngokuchanekileyo. Qaphela isidingo sokususa imali phakathi kwamaxwebhu, ningene naye i-DDG yakhe imemo yokucwangcisa ngokwale njongo. Qamba iMTEF ngenkxaso ngebajeti eceliwe kwaye yazele i-DDG malunga neenguvo. Hlala usethe izimiso/ngeenkqazo nolwazi olusetyenziswayo esithubeni sakhe somsebenzi ukuze abonelele ngokusebenza ngempumelelo kumphathi. Hlala ulwazi ngolwazi noluhambelana nendlela ngabasebenzi abangaphakathi ofice yomphathi.

xh.title: Umncedi
xh.summary: Kufunekiwe umncedi kwiNtloko yeSebe lezoPhuhliso lweziNfrastrakshi eJohannesburg, ofuna iDiploma yezoBoseki nonyaka wamava amathathu ukuya kwamahlanu obugcisa obuhambelanayo.
xh.requirements: iDiploma yezoBoseki (NQF Level 5) okanye into elinganayo. Iminyaka engu 3 – 5 ubudala bemava kwinkonzo yokuxhasa abaphathi abaphezulu. Iimfuziselo: Ulwazi ngemithetho/ iindlela zolawulo/ izalathiso nezendlela zokuqhuba, Ulwazi olusisiseko lolawulo lweemali, Amakhono: Amakhono olwimi nakhono lokunxibelelana kakuhle nabantu abakumazinga ahlukeneyo nasekumaqabantu ahlukeneyo. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono olungiselelo olulungileyo. Amakhono ebhalwe ngokwawo. Isakhono sokwenza uphando, ukwahlula ixesha nokuhlola amaxwebhu neemeko. Iimpawu: Indlela entle yokuthetha kwindlela yefowuni, Inqanaba eliphezulu lokuqinisekisa, Isakhono sokuziphatha ngobuqhwesagrulu, ukuzilungisa nokuzibonakalisa ngokulungileyo, ukuzilawula nokuzikhuthaza.
xh.duties: Wamkele iinkqubo zemifowuni. Yenza umsebenzi ophakamileyo wokuthayipha. Sebenzisa uqinisekise ukuba izixhobo zendawo yokusebenza, ngok. iifeksi nezishumi zincedi zikulimo elilungileyo lokusebenza. Qamba izicwangciso zobugcisa komphathi ophakamileyo. Sebenzisa isigqibo sokuzimisela ukugqiba ukuba wamkele/ wala okanye uthumele kumceli-mngeni wabanye abasebenzi ngenxa yokubaluleka nokusifuna kwendaba. Qhoboshisa kwaye ulumkise/ umyalele umphathi ngemisebenzi yakhe. Yenza iindlela ezingathanda kubakho zokwenza isikhundla. Qinisekisa ukuba ulwazi namaxwebhu ahamba ngokuchanekileyo kuwo naphezu kwindawo yakhe yokusebenza. Qhaqafaamaxwebhu wonke endaweni yakhe yokusebenza ngokulandela imithetho nemigaqo. Hlola ngokuchanekileyo iingxelo/iingxelo ezinqamlezileyo zenze izikhokelo/nokomendesho zomphathi. Thola iziqalelo, qoqa yenze iingxelo, ngok. iNkxaso ngemisebenzi, iingxelo nyanga nganye, iingxelo zolawulo. Phendula imibuzo evela kubandakanya bendlu kunye nabangaphandle. Bhala amaxwebhu njengoko kufuneka. Faka amaxwebhu komphathi okwabasebenzi kwindawo ekufuneka kuyo. Qokeleza, hlola uqoqele inkcazelo eceliweyo ngumphathi. Cacisa izikhokelo ihlala ngomphathi. Lungisa izicwangciso zokuhamba. Phawula izinto eziphambili endaweni yokusebenza komphathi. Lawula irejista yokuphumla nii-akhawunti zemifowuni kwindawo. Lawula ukuthenga izinto ezingagqitywa njengokubhala kunye neempeki. Fumana ukusayina okudingekayo kwamaxwebhu anjengesixelelo sokuthenga kunye neengxelo zemvuzo nganye inyanga. Qhoboshisa izicwangciso zokuqhubela phambathi iimetho xa kufuneka Hlola amaxwebhu kuqondise ukuba malahleka/inkcazelo/ amaxwebhu amaninzi afuna iimetho. Qokelela yenza wonke amaxwebhu afunekayo komphathi ukumziswa ngamananiwo axwebhu. Qamba umbhalo weengxelo/ izigqibo kwaye uzixelele abadlali bemigqa, ulandele inkqubo ekhoyo. Lungelelanisa izikhokelo zomphathi njengoko kufuneka. Qokeleza uqhoboshe wonke amaxwebhu ahlobene nembeko womphathi. Nceda umphathi ukumisela iimfuno zemali ngenxa yokunikezelwa kweMTEF. Gcina irekhodi yobungozi bemali, imali echitshiweyo kwaye lumkise umphathi ngokuchithwa okunokubakho okwe ngaphaya nase ngaphantsi. Hlola uqhobe iingxelo zeBAS ukuze uqinisekise ukuba imali ichitshiweyo ihambisana kakuhle. Qaphela isidingo sokususa imali phakathi kwamaxwebhu, uxoxe noDDG udibe ngayo iimemo zokuqulunqa le nto. Buka ukunikwa kweMTEF ukubalinganiswe nembeko eceliweyo kwaye uxelele uDDG iinguquko. Zihlaziye ngemigaqo/ iindlela kunye nemiqathango ekulawuleni isekhondle zakhe ukuqinisekisa inkxaso ebalulekileyo nomphathi. Zihlaziye ngemiqatho nemitjalo esebenza kwindawo yokusebenza komphathi.

jobs.summary: Works Inspector for Building at the Chris Hani Baragwanath Facility Maintenance Hub in Gauteng, requiring a National Diploma or trade test qualification.
jobs.requirements: A National Diploma (T/N/S streams) or equivalent/ N3 and a passed trade test in the building environment/ Registration as an Engineering Technician. No experience required. A valid driver’s license. Competencies: Knowledge of National Building Standards Act of 1977, Regulations and Municipal Regulations. Promotion of Access to Information Act of 2000. Promotion of Administrative Justice Act of 2000. Government Immovable Asset Management Act of 2007. Occupational Health and Safety Act of 1993 and Regulations. Legislation, Regulations and Guidelines pertaining to infrastructure matters in Health. PFMA 1999 and Regulations. Skills- Communication, Analytical, Problem Solving, Technical. Attributes- Team worker. Proactive and resourceful. Responsive. Responsible.
jobs.duties: Check if new and/or maintenance work undertaken on project sites are in compliance with all relevant regulations and legislation. Conduct inspections on work done, or to be done, to check that proper quality control is maintained. Compile an estimate of repairs and costs for minor new work and maintenance work to be undertaken. Maintain an electronic record system for work being done and work that was finalised. Develop progress reports on outstanding and finalised work. Develop and interpret plans and sketches. Draw-up quotation documents and compile specifications. Participate in the adjudication process and provide recommendations on quotations. Liaise with relevant stakeholders in respect of technical aspects. Inspect the work done by contractors to determine whether it is in compliance with all relevant prescribed standards. Advise and guide contractors in respect of the relevant legislation and regulations. Compile payment documents. Compile and process variation orders and requests for the extension of deadlines. Ensure effective contract administration. Develop reports on problems emanating from projects. Gather and submit information in terms of the extended public works programme (EPWP).

af.title: Werkinspekteur- Bou
af.summary: Werkinspekteur vir Bou by die Chris Hani Baragwanath Facility Maintenance Hub in Gauteng, wat 'n Nasionale Diploma of 'n vaktoetskwalifikasie vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Nasionale Diploma (T/N/S-strome) of ekwivalent/ N3 en 'n geslaagde vaktoets in die bou-omgewing/ Registrasie as 'n Ingenieurstegnikus. Geen ervaring vereis nie. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die National Building Standards Act of 1977, Regulations en Municipal Regulations. Promotion of Access to Information Act of 2000. Promotion of Administrative Justice Act of 2000. Government Immovable Asset Management Act of 2007. Occupational Health and Safety Act of 1993 and Regulations. Wetgewing, regulasies en riglyne rakende infrastruktuuraangeleenthede in Gesondheid. PFMA 1999 and Regulations. Vaardighede- Kommunikasie, Analities, Probleemoplossing, Tegnies. Eienskappe- Spanwerker. Proaktief en vindingryk. Reageer. Verantwoordelik.
af.duties: Kontroleer of nuwe en/of instandhoudingswerk wat op projekterreine onderneem word, aan alle toepaslike regulasies en wetgewing voldoen. Voer inspeksies uit op werk wat gedoen is of nog gedoen moet word om te kontroleer dat behoorlike gehaltebeheer gehandhaaf word. Stel 'n raming op van herstelwerk en koste vir klein nuwe werk en instandhoudingswerk wat onderneem moet word. Onderhou 'n elektroniese rekordstelsel vir werk wat gedoen word en werk wat afgehandel is. Stel vorderingsverslae op oor uitstaande en afgehandelde werk. Ontwikkel en interpreteer planne en sketse. Trek kwotasiedokumente op en stel spesifikasies op. Neem deel aan die evalueringsproses en verskaf aanbevelings oor kwotasies. Skakel met toepaslike belanghebbendes ten opsigte van tegniese aspekte. Inspekteer die werk wat deur kontrakteurs gedoen is om te bepaal of dit aan alle toepaslike voorgeskrewe standaarde voldoen. Adviseer en lei kontrakteurs ten opsigte van die toepaslike wetgewing en regulasies. Stel betalingsdokumente op. Stel op en verwerk variasie-orders en versoeke om verlenging van sperdatums. Verseker doeltreffende kontrakadministrasie. Stel verslae op oor probleme wat uit projekte voortspruit. Versamel en dien inligting in ooreenkomstig die uitgebreide openbare werke-program (EPWP).

zu.title: Isikhulumi Sokuhlolwa Kwemisebenzi- Ukwakha
zu.summary: Isikhulumi sokuhlolwa kwemisebenzi kwimvelo yokwakha, mayelana nokulawulwa kwemisebenzi yesikhungo sase-Chris Hani Baragwanath Facility Maintenance Hub, ese-Gauteng, sifuna idiploma yezwe noma isigqi sezandla.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma (T/N/S streams) noma okufanayo/ N3 kanye nokuthi uqede isivivinyo sentengo kwimvelo yokwakha/ Ukubhaliswa njengo-Engineering Technician. Akukho misebenzi edingekayo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngomthetho wezomgwaqo, Izinkinga, Ukuxazulula izinkinga, Okobuchwepheshe. Izikhwephetha- Ukusebenza nabaningi. Ungabhekwa phambili, ukusebenzisana nemithombo yezinkinga, futhi uzibekezele. Hlola imisebenzi ezenziwayo noma okufanele kwenziwe, izinqumo ezahlobene nalokhu. Siza abasebenzela ngomthetho kanye nezinqumo.
zu.duties: Hlola ukuthi umsebenzi omusha kanye/noma umsebenzi wokulungisa owenziwa kumasayithi ephemilo wezinhlelo usemthethweni ngokwemithetho yonke ehlobene nayo nezomthetho.enza izinhlelo zokulungisa, ukuthola ukuthi ukulawula ikhwalithi okulungile kugcinwa, ukwenza uhlelo lokubhalisa kwesibonelo, ukubhala imibiko yokuthi kungenani nemisebenzi eqediwe, nokuthi ukuthi inani lemali ezingenayo elifushaniswa lilinganisela kakhulu. Qinisekisa ukuthi imisbenze ye-etikit asekunomsebenzi ongenalwazi. Gcina ukuthi uhlelo lokugcina imibhalo yama-elekthronikhi nalawo luyisebenzise ngokubuka emisebenzini emusha okufanele uphathwe ohambweni.enza nokuhumusha okufanelekile. Hlanganisa uhlaka lwemibhalo yemibhalo yesicelo iminikelo kanye ukuthumela phansi namaphilisi inani ekugcineni. Thumela imibiko emidusha kumanye amaphrojekthi ukuze inike iminikelo. Thuma izindaba ezibekiwe ngomthetho wethu. lawula imiyalo yokuthumela imali ehlobene negciwane lolimi. Phefumulela ngezindaba ezithinta inqubo yemisebenzi, futhi uma kukhona okubalulekile ekuxazululeni izinkinga. af.title: Werkinspekteur- Meganies
af.summary: Meganiese werkinspekteur benodig by die Charlotte Maxeke Facility Maintenance Hub in Gauteng om nakoming en gehaltebeheer op projekterreine te verseker.
af.requirements: A National Diploma (T/N/S streams) of gelykwaardig/ N3 en 'n geslaagde ambagskreet toets in die meganiese omgewing/ Registrasie as 'n Engineering Technician. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van National Building Standards Act of 1977, Regulasies en Munisipale Regulasies. Promotion of Access to Information Act of 2000. Promotion of Administrative Justice Act of 2000. Government Immovable Asset Management Act of 2007. Occupational Health and Safety Act of 1993 en Regulasies. Wetgewing, Regulasies en Riglyne rakende infrastruktuuraangeleenthede in Gesondheid. PFMA 1999 en Regulasies. Vaardighede- Kommunikasie, Analities, Probleemoplossing, Tegnies. Eienskappe- Spanwerker. Proaktief en vindingryk. Ontvanklik. Verantwoordelik.
af.duties: Kontroleer of nuwe en/of onderhoudswerk wat op projekterreine onderneem word, aan alle tersaaklike regulasies en wetgewing voldoen. Voer inspeksies uit op werk wat gedoen is, of nog gedoen moet word, om te kontroleer dat behoorlike gehaltebeheer gehandhaaf word. Stel 'n skatting van herstelwerk en koste op vir klein nuwe werk en onderhoudswerk wat onderneem moet word. Handhaaf 'n elektroniese rekordstelsel vir werk wat gedoen word en werk wat afgehandel is. Stel vorderingverslae op rakende uitstaande en afgehandelde werk. Ontwikkel en interpreteer planne en sketse. Stel kwotasiedokumente op en spesifikasies saam. Neem deel aan die adjudikasieproses en verskaf aanbevelings rakende kwotasies. Skakel met tersaaklike belanghebbendes ten opsigte van tegniese aspekte. Inspekteer die werk wat deur kontrakteurs gedoen is om te bepaal of dit aan alle tersaaklike voorgeskrewe standaarde voldoen. Adviseer en lei kontrakteurs ten opsigte van die tersaaklike wetgewing en regulasies. Stel betalingsdokumente op. Stel veranderingorders en versoeke vir die verlenging van sperdatums op en verwerk dit. Verseker effektiewe kontrakadministrasie. Stel verslae op oor probleme wat uit projekte voortspruit. Versamel en dien inligting in ingevolge die extended public works programme (EPWP).

zu.title: Umhloli Womsebenzi- Okubuchwepheshe
zu.summary: Kudingeka umhloli womsebenzi wokubuchwepheshe eCharlotte Maxeke Facility Maintenance Hub eGauteng ukuze kuqiniseke ukuzilandela imithetho nokulawula izinga emakethe amaphrojekthi.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma (amaphaseji T/N/S) noma okulinganayo/ N3 kanye nokudlula itrade test emkhakheni wokubuchwepheshe/ Ukubhalisa njengo-Engineering Technician. Ilayisenisi yokuqasha esemthethweni. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngomthetho we-National Building Standards Act of 1977, Izimiso namaphasiya kweMaspala. Umthetho we-Promotion of Access to Information Act of 2000. Umthetho we-Promotion of Administrative Justice Act of 2000. Umthetho we-Government Immovable Asset Management Act of 2007. Umthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act of 1993 nezimiso. Umthetho, Izimiso nemihlahlandlela ehlobene nezindaba zesakhiwo ezeMpilo. I-PFMA 1999 nezimiso. Amakhono- Ukuxhumana, Ukuhlaziya, Ukuxazulula izinkinga, Okubuchwepheshe. Izimpawu- Umuntu osebenza ngaphakathi kweqembu. Osheshayo futhi ongafinyeleli kalula. Ophendula. Onomthwalo wemfanelo.
zu.duties: Hlola ukuthi umsebenzi omusha noma/kanye nokulungisa okwenziwa emakethe amaphrojekthi ulandela yonke imithetho nezimiso ezihlobene nayo. Yenza ukuthlolwa komsebenzi okuwenziwe, noma okuzoenziwa, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulawulwa kwemigomo yekhwalithi. Qamba amango olungiswa ngezindleko zomsebenzi omusha omncane nokulungisa okuzoenziwa. Gcina inkqubo yemakhompyutha yokubhala umsebenzi okwenziwayo noweduze. Buka imibiko yokuhamba komsebenzi ongakapheleli noweduze. Buka futhi uhumushe izinhlelo nezithombe ezixhunyiwe. Bhala amadokhumente okufuniswa futhi qamba imininingwane ehlobene nayo. Thatha inxaxheba enkqabweni yokulinganisa futhi nikezela izincomo ngokufuniswayo. Xhumana nabahlomunye abahlobene ngezindaba zobuchwepheshe. Hlola umsebenzi okwenziwe ngabathwesihlangothi ukuze kubhekwe ukuthi uyahambisana yini nezilinganiso ezibekiwe. Luleka futhi ohola abathwesihlangothi ngokwemithetho nezimiso ezihlobene nayo. Qamba amadokhumente okukhokhelwa. Qamba futhi uphose izindikelo zokushintsha futhi ucelo ukunwebwa kwesikhathi. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwemitheshwana ngokusebenzayo. Buka imibiko yezinkinga ezibuthaka kumaphrojekthi. Qoqa futhi uhambise ulwazi ngokuhambisana nenqubo yokuhlonga umsebenzi omkhulu (EPWP).

xh.title: Mkhenkethi womsebenzi- Oyilo njengethanga
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umkhenkethi womsebenzi oyilo njengethanga kwindawo yoYakho lweSiseko eCharlotte Maxeke Facility Maintenance Hub eGauteng ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthobela imithetho nolawulo lokhwalithi kwindawo zeprojekthi.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma (i-T/N/S streams) okanye ekelinganayo/ i-N3 kwaye kugqityiwe isivivinyo sobugcisa kwimeko yoyilo njengethanga/ Ubabelo njengomqudisi we-Engineering Technician. Ilayisense yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Iikhompetensi: Ulwazi nge-National Building Standards Act of 1977, i-Regulations ne-Municipal Regulations. I-Promotion of Access to Information Act of 2000. I-Promotion of Administrative Justice Act of 2000. I-Government Immovable Asset Management Act of 2007. I-Occupational Health and Safety Act of 1993 ne-Regulations. Imithetho, i-Regulations neenkqubo eziphathwe ngayo izindaba zesiseko ezeZempilo. I-PFMA 1999 ne-Regulations. Amakhono- Unxibelelwano, Ukuhlalutywa, Ukuxazula iingxaki, Obuchwepheshethe. Iimpawu- Umsebenzi wesiqhelo. Ukuba mdla kakhulu kunye nokuziphatha ngokuzinikela. Ukuphendula. Ukuba nekratyule.
xh.duties: Khangela ukuba umsebenzi omtsha kunye/noma wolondolozo owenziwa kwindawo zeprojekthi uyathobela yonke imithetho nolawulo ehambelana nawo. Qhuba ukuqwalasela komsebenzi oqediweyo, okanye oza kwenziwa, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba kulawulo lokhwalithi olufanelekileyo lulungelelaniswe. Hlenga ulinganiselo lolungiso nentengo yomsebenzi omtsha omncinci nomsebenzi wolondolozo oza kwenziwa. GCina inkqubo yerekhodi yamakhompyutha yomsebenzi oqhubekayo nomsebenzi oqediweyo. Phepha iingxelo zentuthuko malunga nomsebenzi ongagqityiwanga nowoqediweyo. Yila uze umele iiplani nezalathisi. Hlengaamaxatshatsho amaxwebhu okubamba ngamawaka uze uhlenge iinkcazelo. Thatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yokuqamba ngokusesikweni uze unike izindululo ngamaxwebhu okubamba ngamawaka. Qhagamshelana nabaqhagamsheli abahambelana nawo malunga neendaba zobuchwepheshethe. Qwalasela umsebenzi oqediweyo ngabaqeshi ukuziqinisekisa ukuba uyathobela yonke iindlela ezilawulwayo ezisesikweni. Lumkisa uze uqhagamshele abaqlisi malunga nemithetho nolawulo oluhambelana nawo. Hlengamaxatshatsho eziphakamiso zentlalahleko. Hlenga uze ulungelelanise imiyalelo yotshintsho nezicelo zokwandiswa kwexesha lokugqibela. Qinisekisa ulawulo lweenkonzo esemthethweni. Phepha iingxelo ngeengxaki eziphuma kumaprojekthi. Qokeleza uze ungenise ulwazi ngokwale nkqubo yomsebenzi olwandisiweyo yorampona (EPWP).

'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die National Building Standards Act of 1977, Regulasies en Munisipale Regulasies. Promotion of Access to Information Act of 2000. Promotion of Administrative Justice Act of 2000. Government Immovable Asset Management Act of 2007. Occupational Health and Safety Act of 1993 en Regulasies. Wetgewing, Regulasies en Riglyne rakende infrastruktuuraangeleenthede in Gesondheid. PFMA 1999 en Regulasies. Vaardighede- Kommunikasie, Analitiese, Probleemoplossing, Tegniese. af.duties: Kontroleer of nuwe en/of instandhoudingswerk wat op projekterreine onderneem word, aan alle tersaaklike regulasies en wetgewing voldoen. Voer inspeksies uit op werk wat gedoen is, of nog gedoen moet word, om te kontroleer behoorlike gehaltebeheer gehandhaaf word. Stel 'n beraming op van herstelkoste en koste vir klein nuwe werk en instandhoudingswerk wat onderneem moet word. Onderhou 'n elektroniese rekordstelsel vir werk wat gedoen word en werk wat afgehandel is. Stel vorderingsverslae op oor uitstaande en afgehandelde werk. Ontwikkel en interpreteer planne en sketse. Stel kwotasiedokumente op en spesifikasies saam. Neem deel aan die adjudikasieproses en verskaf aanbevelings oor kwotasies. Skakel met tersaaklike belanghebbendes rakende tegniese aspekte. Inspekteer die werk wat deur kontrakteurs gedoen is om te bepaal of dit aan alle tersaaklike voorgeskrewe standaarde voldoen. zu.requirements: I-National Diploma (T/N/S streams) noma okulinganayo, noma i-N3 netrade test edlule ezindaweni zezobunjiniyela, noma ukubhaliswa njenge-Engineering Technician. Umthetho we-Promotion of Access to Information Act of 2000. Umthetho we-Promotion of Administrative Justice Act of 2000. Umthetho we-Government Immovable Asset Management Act of 2007. zu.duties: Hlola ukuthi umsebenzi omusha futhi noma owokulondoloza owenziwa ezindaweni zamaphrojekthi uyahambisana yini nazo zonke izimiso nomthetho ohlobene nawo. Yenza ukuhlola kumsebenzi oswa noma uzoswa, noma ukwenza, ukuze uhlole ukuthi kulawulwa kahle ikhwalithi. Qamba ukulinganiselwa kwezilungiselelo nezindleko zomsebenzi omusha omncane nowokulondoloza okuzoswa. Gcina isistimu yezinkomba zohlelo lokusebenza ngomsebenzi osafakwa nalona owasedlule. Buthatha imibiko mayelana nomsebenzi ongakedlulwa nalona oqediwe. Tungatha futhi uhumushe iplanu kanye nezithombe eziyisiketshe. Bhala amadokhumenti okucela izinhlawulo futhi uqambe izinkomba. Thatha inxaxheba ekuqashweni inqinisekiso imibono kanye nezincomo ngezinhlawulo. Xhumana namaphuzu abantu abahlobene nezindaba zobuchwepheshe. Hlola umsebenzi oswa ngabakhiqizi ukuze ubone ukuthi uyahambisana yini nazo zonke izidingo ezishiwo. Nikela ngeluleko futhi uhola ngokomthetho nezimiso abakhiqizi. Qamba amadokhumenti okukhokha. Qamba futhi ucwengele imiyalo yokushintsha futhi wakhe izicelo zokwandisa izinsuku zokuqedwa. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa okusebenzayo kwezinkontileka. Qamba imibiko mayelana nezinkinga ezivela kwamaphrojekthi. Qoqa futhi uhambise ukwaziswa ngokuhambisana nesiteshi se-extended public works programme (EPWP).

xh.title: Mmgandi weMisebenzi: yamanzi
xh.summary: Mmgandi weMisebenzi: yamanzi kwiNtloko eNkulu yeSebe leZenzo lokuPhuhliswa kwaPhuhliso eGauteng, kufuneka abe neNdlambo yeSizwe okanye i-N3 enesivivinyo senkumbiso kwimeko yamanzi.
xh.requirements: INdlambo yeSizwe (i-N/S/T streams) okanye esilinganayo, okanye i-N3 nesivivinyo senkumbiso esidlulileyo kwimeko yamanzi, okanye uBhaliso njengoNjineli yaseKhono. ilayisenesi yokushaya itheksi esemthethweni. Ikhono: ulwazi ngomthetho weMilinganiselo yeSakhiwo seSizwe ka-1977, iMigaqo nemiQathango kaMasipala. uMthetho woKhuthazo lokufikelela kwiiNkcazelo ka-2000. uMthetho woBulungiseko koLawulo lwabaLungisa ka-2000. uMthetho wokuLawulwa kwamaSseti angahambahambi kaRhulumente ka-2007. uMthetho weMpilo yoKhuseleko nokuSebenza ka-1993 nemiQatho. umThetho, iMigaqo nemiQatho ephathelene neendaba zeempahla ezakhiwayo ekuQhelanisweni. i-PFMA ka-1999 nemiQatho. Ikhono - uNxibelelwano, luhlazo, ukuSombulula iingxaki, buNjineli. Iimpawu - uSebenzi woqobo. Yenza ngaphambi koko kucelwe kwaye unobuncwane. Phendula. Philisa inxaxheba.
xh.duties: Khangela ukuba umsebenzi omtsha kwaye noma osondolulo owenziwa kwindawo zamaphrojekthi ulandela onke amagqabantshintshi nomthetho. Yenza iNsuko kumsebenzi ovenziweyo, okanye ofuneka uwenze, ukukhangela ukuba kulawulwa ngokuchanekileyo izinga lomgangatho. Qamba uqikelelo lwezindleko nokuhlohlelwa kwemisebenzi emincinci entsha nesondolulo ofuneka uyenze. Gcina inkqubo yerekhodo ye-elektroniki yomsebenzi oqhubekayo nowugqibileyo. Qamba iingxelo ngenkqubela ngomsebenzi ongagqitywanga nowugqityiweyo. Qamba ukuze uphonononge iindawo namacebo. Qamba amaxwebhu okusika ixabiso kwaye uhlobe iimfuno. Thatha inxaxheba kwindlela yokugqiba kwaye unike iingcebatsho ngokuqikelela. Thintathusa namaphu ahlukeneyo malunga namacandelo obugcisa. Khangela umsebenzi owenziweyo ngabakhi-misebenzi ukuze uqonde ukuba ulandela wonke amagqabantshintsi obugcisa achaziweyo. Lumkisa kwaye ukhokele abakhi-misebenzi malunga nomthetho namagqabantshintsi. Qamba amaxwebhu ehrhementi. Qamba kwaye ulungise iiodolo zokutshintsha kwaye faka izicelo zokwandisa iimhla. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo lwekontraka. Qamba iingxelo ngeengxaki ezisuka kumaphrojekthi. Qokeleza kwaye ngenisa iinkcukacha ngokwesixokelelwano sikaRhulume esandul' ukwandiswa (EPWP).

Ugqalelo kumthengi. Okuthembekileyo.
xh.duties: Yenza iinkqubo zokwakha ngokwesicwangciso somthengi nangaphakathi kwemida yamandla okwenza. Yeza izinto ngesixhobo nempahla ngokwesicwangciso somsebenzi nangokwemigaqo evelwayo. Nikeza isiqinisekiso sokwakhiwa kwemigangatho kwezinto ezenziweyo. Phengola izixhobo nakwisiseko ngesiphithiphithi sobuchwepheshe. Lungisa izixhobo nesisiseko ngokwemigaqo evelwayo. Iimpawu- Ukusebenza njengelungu losapho. Ukuqwalasela umthengi. Okuthembekileyo.
xh.duties: Kuzalise izinto ngokomyalelo wabathengi ngaphakathi kwemida yenkqubo yokuzalisa. Kuzalise izinto ngezinto zokwenziwa nolawulo ngokomyalelo womsebenzi nangokwemigaqo eyaziwayo. Nikeza isiqinisekiso somgangatho kwiinto ezenziwe. Pheqa ulawulo kwaye nemitsho ngezinto yemiba yezobuchwepheshe. Lungisa ulawulo nemitsho ngokomgangatho. Vavanya ulawulo olungisiweyo kwaye nemitsho ngokomgangatho oceliweyo. Khusela ulawulo kwaye nemitsho ngokohlelo. Nikeza isiqinisekiso somgangatho kulawulo ekhutshwe kwaye nemitsho ekhuselweyo. zu.duties: Ukukhiqiza izinhlelo ngokwezidingo zomthengi futhi ngaphakathi kwanamandla okukhiqiza. Ukukhiqiza izinto ngezinto zokwakha nolwangomsebenzi ngokwezidingo zomsebenzi nangokwezindinganiso ezaziwayo. Ukunikeza isiqiniseko sokulingana kumikhiqizo ekhiqiziwe. Ukuhlola ulwangomsebenzi nezindawo ukuthola izingozi zobuchwepheshe. Ukulungisa ulwangomsebenzi nezindawo ngokwezindinganiso. Ukuhlola ukulungiswa kolwangomsebenzi nezindawo ngokwezidingo. Izinhlelo zobuchwepheshe ezisebenzisa ikhaya; ulwazi ngokubambe ngomthetho. Ulwazi namandla ekwenziweni kwemikhiqizo. Amasando: ukubhalwa kwemibiko yamathuluzi. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukusebenza ndawonye. Ukudala. Ukuhlaziya. Ukuzibusayo. Ukuthathana kwemiyalo kanye namakhono ekhaya. Ukubuka nokuhlela amasando. Izinhlobo: Ukusebenza kahle kwabahleli. Ukuqashwa kwabakhasimende. Ukuthembeka.
zu.duties: Khipha izinhlakahlwasimu ngokwezidingo zakhasimende nokuba phakathi kwemikhawulo yamandla okukhiqiza. Khipha izinto ngempahla nangesisetshenziswa ngokokuhleleka kwomsebenzi nangemazinga aqashelwayo. Nikeza isiqiniseko sokulingwa kwemikhiqizo edayiziwe. Hlola amathuluzi nezimpahla/izintshunalwemisebenzi ngamaphutha obuchwepheshe. Lungisa izimpahla nezintshunalwemisebenzi ngokwelwa kwemizingingongo. Hlola amathuluzi nezimpahla/izintshunalwemisebenzi ngesiqiniseko sokuthi izimpahla ezilungiswe ziphambene nezidingo. Phatha izinsiza futhi/izimpahla/izintshunalwemisebenzi ngokuhlelwini kwesikhathi. Nikeza isiqiniseko sokulinga kwesixazululo, ukugcinwa nokuphathwa kwamathuluzi noma izimpahla/izintshunalwemisebenzi. Lela futhi unikeze imibiko ehleliwe. Nikeza okufakiwe ohlelweni lokuqashwa. Gcina futhi ugcine irekhodi lesikhondla/irekhista. Qaphaza futhi ulungele ukufundisa abasebenzi. Zululeka embuchwepheshe bethu nobulula obusha ukuze kuqhubekangqondo kokuthuthukiswa komuntu munye.

xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esifanelekileyo sovavayo lwebhatala. Isiph esingaphantsi kweminyaka emi-2 yamava. Ifayile yemvumbo yoluntu eqinisekisiweyo. Ukwazi ukunika ulwazi ngokusebenzisa imithetho yase Kurhulumente, iNqwanqwa nemigaqo-nkqabo yokuLawulwa kweNkonzo kaRhulumente. Ulwazi ngomgaqo we-OHS Act. Ulwazi ngemigaqo-nkqabo, amava namathuba wesebe. Ulwazi lweaplikheshini zekhompyutha ezinceda ngokwenza izinto ngendlela echanekileyo. Ulwazi ngamthetho. Amava ngamava kunye nobuchule bokwenza izinto. Isonqo: Ulwazi ngokubhala iingxelo zobuchwepheshe. Ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuhlaziya. Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukusebenza njengeseqela. Ukudala. Ukucoca ngokuchanekileyo. Ukuzilawula. Ukunxibelelana nokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amava okuqamba nokulungelelanisa izinto. Iimpawu: Ukusebenza njengeseqela. Ukujolise kumthengi. Ukuthembeka.
xh.duties: Dala iindlwana ngokwezicwangciso zexhaswa ngaphakathi kwemida yamandla okuvelisa. Yila izinto ngesixhobo nangemishini ngokwezicwangciso zomsebenzi nemigangatho evaliweyo. Nikela nesianiso esigqwesileyo kwiinto eziqushiweyo. Hlola imishini kunye neziseko zonxibelelwano ukubona iimpazamo ezithe技术上. Lungisa imishini neziseko ngokomgangatho. Vivisa imishini esilungiweyo neziseko ukumisela nokuba zihambelana na nezicwangciso. Nika inkonzo imishini neziseko ngokwejadulu. Nikela nesianiso esigqwesileyo kwimishini neziseko ezinikiweyo inkonzo ezilungelelwanisiweyo. Qumba ngokubhaliweyo idinga ulwazi lwase Kurhulumente kwiMithetho, iMaqondwe namava eNkonzo kaRhulumente kuwo wonke amasebe. Ukwazi ngomgaqo-nkqubo we-OHS. Ulwazi ngemigaqo-nkqabo, iintjhijiswanayo kwisebe. Ulwazi ngokusebenzisa iaplikheshini zekhompyutha ezinceda ngokweza ngezenzo ezilawulwa ngumthetho. Ulwazi ngamava ngamva nangobuchule bokulungisa iingxaki. Ulwazi ngokwenza iiggciso ezibalulekileyo zezobuchwepheshe. Isakhono sokuxazulula iingxaki nokuhlaziya. Isakhono sokwenza izigqibo. Ukusebenza njengeseqela. Ukudala. Ukusika ngokucocileyo. Ukuzilawula. Isakhono sokunxibelelana nolwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amava eNkonzo kaRhulumente, iGaqa namava eNkonzo zaRhulumente, iindaba namava eNkonzo zaRhulumente. Ukusebenza njengomsebenzi weqela. Ukujongana nolwazi lokukhula komntu ngamnye kunye nendlela entsha zokwenza izinto.

Izinhlelo zezobuchwepheshe ezisebenzisana nekhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokuvumelana nomthetho. Amakhono- Ukubhala izimiso ezinobuchwepheshe. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukusebenza njengeqembu. Ukudala. Ukuhlaziya. Ukuziphatha. Amakhono okuxhumana nokuqondisa kanye nekhompyutha. Amakhono okuhlela nokuhlela. Izimilo- Ukudlala njengelungu leqembu. Ukuqala ngamakhasimende. Ukuthembeka.
zu.duties: Dala imiklamo ngokwezicelo zenhlaka bese ngaphakathi kwezikhathi zendalo. Yenza izinto ngokwemvula nezinkundla ngokwezidingo zenqubo ngokokuqashwa kwemisebenzi. Hlolla imishini nokuba ngamafasitela ngokwezicelo. Sebenza ngemishini nokuba ngamafasitela ngokohlelo. Nikeza isiqiniseko sokulingana semishini esezingxolweni nokuba ngamafasitela. Zibambezele ngezinga elisha lezinto ezingaka kanye nezindlela ezintsha ezenzelwa ukwaziswa kwakho ngokwakho.

xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esifanelekileso sovavanyo lobugcisa. Umda weminyaka engama-0-2 yamava. Ilayisenesi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ukusebenza njengodidi. Ukudalwa. Ukuqhathanisa. Ukuzilawula. Ikhono lokunxibelelana nasekusetyenzweni kwekhompyutha. Amakhono okuceba nokuqamba. Iimpawu- Umdlali wedidi. Egqamisa umthengi. Othembekileyo.
xh.duties: Yila izinto ngokwezifuniso zabathengi kwaye ngaphakathi kwemida yamandla okuphaya. Yenza izinto ngezinto ezenziwa ngazo nangemixholo ngokwezifuniso somsebenzi nangokwemigangatho evelwayo. Nikela isiqinisekiso sokulungiselela kwizinto ezenziwe. Hlola umxholo kunye/noba iziseko zokusebenzela iimpazamo zobuchwepheshe. Lungisa umxholo neziseko zokusebenzela ngokomgangatho. Vavanya ulungiso lomxholo kunye/noba iziseko zokusebenzela ngokwezifuniso. Nika umxholo kunye/noba iziseko zokusebenzela inkonzo ngokwejadulu. Nikela isiqinisekiso esibonelelwa inkonzo kunye nomxholo oligiweyo kunye/noba iziseko zokusebenzela. Qamba kwaye ungenise iingxelo. Nikela izigqibo kwicebo lokusebenza. Gcina kwaye ulondoloze irekhodi/irejista yomsebenzi. Phatha kwaye ulungelelanise abasebenzi. Gcina ulwazi malunga nobuchwepheshe obutsha neenqubo zokuziphuhlisa ngokuqhubekayo.

zu.summary: Isikhundla somuntu wemisebenzi yezandla (ukwenza izinto zesikhuni) eTulisa Park District Maintenance Hub esidinga isitifiketi sokuhlola ubuchwepheshe neminyaka yokuqonda engu-0-2.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi sokuhlola ubuchwepheshe esifanele. Okungenani iminyaka yokuqonda engu-0-2. Ilayisense yokushayela elisebenzayo. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngomthetho, izinqubomgomo nemithetho yesevisi yomphakathi. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-OHS. Ulwazi ngezinqubomgomo, izinhlelo zokusebenza namasu womnyango. Izinhlelo zobuchwepheshe ezisetshenziswa ngekhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Amakhono- Ukubika ngobuchwepheshe. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukuthatha izinqumo. Ukusebenza njengochwepheshe. Ukubumba. Ukuhlaziya. Ukuzibusayo. Inkonzo yokuxhumana namakhono ekhompyutha. Amakhono okuhlela nokuhlela. Izinto zobuntu- Ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwethimba. Ukuqala kwabathengi. Ukuthembeka.
zu.duties: Kwenziwe izinhlela ngokuthi izikhwama zabathengi zithi noma ngaphakathi kwamandla okukhiqiza. Kwenziwe izinto ngezinto kushayele njengoba imisebenzi ithi ngokuhlelwa kwemisebenzi. Kuhlolisiswe izinga lekhwalithi yezinto eziqinisekisiwe. Kuhlolisiswe amashayela noma amandla ngamaphutha obuchwepheshe. Kulungiswe amashayela namandla ngokuhlelwa. Kuhlolisiswe amashayela noma amandla okuhlangabezana nezinhlelo. Kukhonjiswe amashayela noma amandla ngohlelo. Kuhlolisiswe izinga lekhwalithi yamashayela noma amandla okhonjiwe nokugcinwe. Kwenziwe kubekwe izikhwama. Kunikezwa okuhlelekile ekhwalithi. Kugcinwe futhi kubhalwe ukukhonta noma ukubhalisa. Kuhlonyiswa futhi kunikezwa isiqondiso abantu. Kuhlaliswe nobuchwepheshe obusha nezinhlela zokuba ungene ngeminyaka yonke.

xh.summary: Isithuba somzobi wokukhiqiza (ukonzo lwamaphaphu) e Tulisa Park District Maintenance Hub esifuna Isatifikethi Sokuvavanywa Kobuchwephesha kunye neminyaka yamava engu-0-2.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esifanelekileyo sokuvavanywa kobuchwephesha. Inani elifingqwekileyo leminyaka yamava engu-0-2. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo. Iikhompetensi: Ulwazi ngomthetho wesebe likaWonke-wonke, iinkqubo kunye namagunya. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-OHS. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo, iindlela ezithembiswayo kunye namanyathelo asebe. Izicelo zobuchwephesha ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi lokuthobela umthetho. Amakhono- Ukubhala iingxelo zobuchwephesha. Ukuxazula iingxaki nokuzihlola. Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukusebenza njengqela. Ubuchwephesha bokudala. Ukuhlola. Ukuzilawula. Amakhono okunxibelelana nakuKhompyutha. Amakhono eplani nokuhlela. Iimpawu- Ukudlala njengelungu leqela. Ukugxila kumxhasi. Ukuthembeka.
xh.duties: Khiqiza iimphuphi ngokwemigqbo yomxhasi nakumda wamandla okukhiqiza. Khiqiza izinto ngesixhobo nempahla ngokwemigqbo yomsebenzi nangokwemilinganiselo evunyiweyo. Nikeza isiqinisekiso sokugqithisa kwizinto ezenziwe. Hlola isixhobo kwaye okanye izindlu zeempahla ukufumana iimpazamo zobuchwephesha. Lungisa isixhobo nezindlu zeempahla ngokwemilinganiselo. Vavanya ukulungiswa kwesixhobo kwaye okanye izindlu zeempahla ngokumgqbo. Hlola isixhobo kwaye okanye izindlu zeempahla ngokwejadule. Nikeza isiqinisekiso sokugqithisa kwesixhobo esihluziweyo kwaye esigcinwe kwaye okanye izindlu zeempahla. Qamba kwaye uhunge iingxelo. Nikeza izinto ezifakelwa kwindlela yokusebenza. Gcina kwaye ulondoloze irekhodi yomsebenzi okanye irekhodi. Lawula kwaye ululele abasebenzi. Gcina isakhono namanyathelo amatsha ukuphuhlisa umntu ngamnye ngokusondeleyo.

zu.summary: Isikhundla sokukhiqiza kwabasebenzi bakagesi esikhungweni sokulondolozwa kokwakhiwa kweSizwe District Facility Maintenance Hub eGauteng, esidinga isitifikedi sokuhlolwa kobuchwepheshe kanye nokuhlanganisa unyaka ababili wamava.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi esifanele sokuhlolwa kobuchwepheshe. Okungenani unyaka 0-2 wamava. Ilayisensi yokuqasha esemthethweni. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngemithetho yesevisi kazwelonke, izinqubomgomo kanye nemithetho. Ulwazi ngoMthetho we-OHS. Ulwazi lwezinqubomgomo, izuva kanye nendlela zokwenza zendawo yokusebenza. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezenziwa ngekhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokuziphatha ngokomthetho. Amandla - Ukubhala imibiko yobuchwepheshe. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokucazulula. Ukuthatha izinqumo. Ukusebenza njengeqembu. Ukudala. Ukucwazulula. Ukuzilawula. Amandla okuxhumana kanye nokusebenza ngekhompyutha. Amandla okuhlela kanye nokuhlela. Izimfanelo - Umuntu osebenza njengelungu leqembu. Ukugxila kumthengi. Othembekile.
zu.duties: Kukhiqize izinhlelo ngokwezidingo zomthengi kanye phakathi kwemikhawulo yamandla okukhiqiza. Kukhiqize izinto ngesiqu nangempahla ngokwezidingo zomsebenzi nangokwezindinganiso ezaziwayo. Kunikeze isiqiniseko sikhulu sezenzakalo ezikhiqiziwe. Kuhlolojwe isiqu kanye/noma izikhungo ngeziphazamiso zobuchwepheshe. Kulungise isiqu kanye nezikhungo ngokwezindinganiso. Kuhlolwe ukulungiswa kwesiqu kanye/noma izikhungo ngokwezidingo. Kunikwe isiqu kanye/noma izikhungo inkonzo ngokuhleleleko. Kunikeze isiqiniseko sikhulu senkonzo ekelwe isiqu esikhonziwe kanye/noma izikhungo. Kubhalwe futhi kuhambahambiswe imibiko. Kunikezwe imibiko yohlelo lokusebenza. Kugcinwe futhi kulondolozwe irekhodi/isibhalo somsebenzi. Kubhekwe kanye nokwelulekwe abasebenzi. Kugcine ngezinga namasuva amatsha nendlela zokwenza ngenhloso yokuthuthuka ngokomuntu qobo.

xh.title: Umenzi wesixhobo Wokwenza inqanaba A-C: Ezezohamba
xh.summary: Isithuba sokuMvelisi wesixhobo (Ezezohamba) kwiSizwe District Facility Maintenance Hub eGauteng, sidinga isatifikethi seVavanyo loBuchwepheshe kunye noyaka unyaka wamava onke angaphaya kwamawaka.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esifanelekileyo seVavanyo loBuchwepheshe. Iminyaka yamava ebekwe phantsi eyi-0-2. Ilayisenisi yomqhubi egqithisiweyo. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngeMiliso yoBumnini kuLuntu, iNqumrhu kunye noMthetho. Ulwazi ngoMthetho ka-OHS. Ulwazi lweenqubomgobo, iindlela zokuqhuba namacebo esebe. Iinkqubo zekhompyutha ezibusayo ezinezicelo. Ulwazi ngokuthobela umthetho. Amakhono - Ukubhala iingxelo zobuchwepheshe. Ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuhlengahlengisa. Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukusebenza njengelinye iqela. Ubuchwephesha bokudala. Uhlengahlengiso. Ukuqulunqa uqobo. Unxibelelwano kunye namakhono ekhompyutha. Ukuqulunqa nokuqwalasela amakhono. Iimpawu- Ukusebenza njengelinye iqela. Ukuqwalasela umthengi. Okuthembakalayo.
xh.duties: Yila izixhobo ngokwelwe ngemfuno yomthengi kwaye ngaphakathi kwemida yamandla okwenza. Yila izinto ngeenjongo zokwenza nangokwesinxibo ngokwelwe ngemfuno yomsebenzi nangokumaxwebhu amkelweyo. Yenza isiqinisekiso sobunzulu kwezinto ezenziweyo. zu.summary: Isikhundla somlobi wezimpahla zokukhiqiza somnyango wezinsiza zobuciko oseGauteng, okukhiqiza futhi kuqinisekise izinga lobuchwepheshe bemisebenzi yesibhanoyi nemiqondo yemiklamo.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi esifanele sokuqinisekiswa kobugcisa. A minimum of 0-2 years of experience. Isitifiketi sokushayela esivumelekile. Izindlela ezisezingeni eliphezulu: Ukuqonda ngemithetho, izinqubomgomo kanye namalawu abasebenzi bomphakathi. Ukuqonda ngomthetho wezokuphepha ezimsebenzini. Ukuqonda ngezingqikithi zemithetho engaqondakali. Ukuqonda ngezinqubomgomo zamanyanga, izindlela nezinqubo zomnyango. Ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zekhompyutha ezibuswa ngezandla. Ukuqonda ngezinhlaka zemithetho. Amakhono - ukuloba izibhalo zobuchwepheshe. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukusebenza njengeqembu. Ukukhuthaza imibono. Isipili umele nzulu. Ukuzibusa. Amakhono okuthumela okubhaliwe ngekhompyutha. Amakhono okuhlela izinto. Izici - ukusebenza njengelungu leqembu. Ukugxila ebathengini. Ukuthembeka.
zu.duties: Ukukhiqiza imiklamo ngokwendlela abathengi bakufuna ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo yamandla okukhiqiza. Ukukhiqiza izinto ngezinto ezitholakalayo nangemishini ngokwendlela ebekiwe yomsebenzi nangokwesiko. Ukunikezela usizo oluqinisekisa izinga lokwenziwa kwezinto. Ukuhlola imishini noma izindawo zomsebenzi ukuze kubonwe iziphazamiso ezimbandakanya nobuchwepheshe. Ukulungisa imishini nezindawo ngokwesiko. Ukuhlola imishini noma izindawo ezilungisiwe ukubheka ukuthi zihambisana nezidingo. Ukukhondlula imishini noma izindawo ngokwelulekwa. Ukunikezela usizo oluqinisekisa izinga lemishini noma izindawo ezikhondluliwe. Ukuhlola imishini noma izindawo ezilungisiwe ngokwesiko. Ukwenza nokuthumela izibhalo. Ukukhipha izeluleko zokusungula izinkomba. Ukubhala ukulondoloza izinkomba zomsebenzi. Ukubeka izinkomba kubasebenzi bezinyanga ezenza imisebenzi efunwayo. Ukubhalisa izinkomba zomsebenzi ohlinzwe ngabasebenzi bomphakathi eGauteng. Ukugcina izinkomba zomsebenzi ezilandelanayo. Ukuletha izinkomba zamandla athunyelwe emphakathini.

xh.summary: Isithuba somsebenzi wobugcisa bokwenza iindlu ezinamathumba kwi Department of Infrastructure Development e Gauteng, okuqhelaniswa nokwenza nokqinisekisa umgangatho wemivo yolwazi ezibunjwa njengamathumba amanzi kunye nezicwangciso.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esifanelekileso soVavvo lweNzalo. Ubuncinci beminyaka yamava engama-0-2. Ilayisense yokushayela eneplastiki. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngeMigaqo, iinkqubomgama kunye neeRegulations zeNkonzo zeLuntu. Ulwazi nge OHS Act. Ulwazi ngeenkqubomgama, iindlela kunye neenkqubo zesebe. Izicelo zobugcisa ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokuthotyelwa kwezomthetho. Ikhono- Ukubhala iingxelo zobugcisa. Ukusombulula iingxaki kunye nokuqonda ngokupheleleyo. Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukusebenza njengosapho. Ukudala. Ukuqonda ngokupheleleyo. Ukuzilawula. Ikhono lokunxibelelana nokuqamba. Ikhono lokucwangcisa nokuqokelela izinto. Iimpawu- Ukuba ngumntu othanda ukusebenza nabantu. Ukugxila kumthengi. Ukuba nthembekileyo.
xh.duties: Yenza izicwangciso ngokwemfuno yomthengi nangaphakathi kwemida yamandla okukhiqiza. Yiza izinto ngeempahla nezixhobo ngokwemfuno yomsebenzi nangokwemilinganiselo ezelweyo. Yiba ngumntu onika isiqinisekiso sokwemivo ezenziwayo. Khangela izixhobo kunye nezakhiwo ukuyibona ukuba zikho na iingxaki zobugcisa. Lungisa izixhobo nezakhiwo ngokwemilinganiselo. Vavanya izixhobo nezakhiwo ezilungisiweyo ukuzibekisa ngokwemfuno ecelelwayo. Nika inkonzo izixhobo nezakhiwo ngokwelishi. Yiba ngumntu onika isiqinisekiso sokwemivo yezixhobo nezakhiwo eziphathwayo nzenziwayo. Qamba ungathume iingxelo. Nika izimvo kwindlela yomsebenzi. Gcina uluhlu lwangaphakathi lwamaza omsebenzi ngokunjalo. Qwalasela kwaye ululele abantu. Zigcine useceleni nobugcisa obutsha nangeenkqubo ngokungangema kwentswalo yokuziphucukisa.

af.summary: Meganiese passer gesoek by die Discovery Facility Maintenance Hub in Gauteng om voorwerpe te vervaardig en te ondersoek, wat 'n ambagsertifikaat en tot twee jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Ambagsertifikaat. 'n Minimum van 0-2 jaar se ervaring. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van Openbare Diens-wetgewing, Beleide en Regulasies. Kennis van die OHS-wet. Kennis van die departementele beleide, strategieë en prosedures. Rekenaargedrewe tegniese toepassings. Kennis van wetlike nakoming. Vaardighede- Tegniese verslagskrywing. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Besluitneming. Spanwerk. Kreatiwiteit. Analities. Selfbestuur. Kommunikasie- en rekenaarvaardighede. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Kenmerke- Spanspeler. Kliëntgerig. Betroubaar.

Lewer gehalteversekering van vervaardigde voorwerpe. Ondersoek toerusting en/of fasiliteite vir tegniese foute. Herstel toerusting en fasiliteite volgens standaarde. Toets hersteltoerusting en/of fasiliteite teen spesifikasies. Onderhou toerusting en/of fasiliteite volgens skedule. Lewer gehalteversekering van onderhoude en reggemaakte toerusting en/of fasiliteite. Stel verslae op en dien dit in. Verskaf insette tot die operasionele plan. Hou en onderhou werkrekord/register. zu.title: Isonjiniyele Sokukhiqiza Izinga A-C: Umqambi Wezinsimbi
zu.summary: Kufunwa umqambi wezinsimbi eDiscovery Facility Maintenance Hub eGauteng ukuze akhiqize futhi ahlole izinto, kudingwa isitifiketi sokuhlolwa kwemikhiqizo kanye nokuhlangenwe nakho okungafika eminyakeni emibili.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi esifanele sokuhlolwa kwemikhiqizo. Okuncane ukuhlangenwe nakho kweminyaka engu-0-2. Ilayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngomthetho, izinqubomgomo kanye nemithetho yesevisi yomphakathi. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-OHS. Ulwazi ngezenqubomgomo zamaphoyintu, amasu kanye nemiyalelo yomnyango. Izinhlelo zobuchwepheshe ezisebenziswa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokuvumelana nomthetho. Amakhono- Ukubhala imibhalo yobuchwepheshe. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukuthatha izinqumo. Ukusebenza njengeqembu. Ukubakhulu cabango. Ukuhlaziya. Izimpatho zakho. Ikhono lokuxhumana nangekhompyutha. Amakhono okuhlela futhi uhlole. Izimfanelo- Umdlali wesiqembu. Ukuqakuliswa ngabathengi. Ethembekile.
zu.duties: Kukhiqize izinhlelwa ngokwezici zeklayenti nangaphakathi kwemikhawulo yamandla okukhiqiza. Kukhiqize izinto ngemateriali nangesisetshenziswa ngokwezici somsebenzi kanye namaphuzu avunyiwe. Kunikeze isiqiniseko sokuhlela izinto ezikhiqiziwe. Kuhlolwe isisetshenziswa kanye/noma izikhungo ukuthi ziyiphi imikhiqizo yezinsimbi. Kulungwe isisetshenziswa nezikhungo ngokwezindinganiso. Kuhlolwe ukulungiswa kwesisetshenziswa kanye/noma izikhungo ngokwezici. Kunikezwe insiza isisetshenziswa kanye/noma izikhungo ngokweqotho. Kunikeze isiqiniseko sokuhlela isisetshenziswa esinikelwe insiza kanye/noma izikhungo. Kuhlelwe futhi kuhumuswe imibalo. Kutholakale okufakwayo ohlelweni lwenkonzo. Kugcinwe futhi kugcinwe irekhodi/irejista yomsebenzi. Kubhekwe futhi kunikelwe isiqondiso abasebenzi. Kubambe iqhaza kubuchwepheshe obusha kanye nemiyalelo ngenhloso yokuthuthuka komuntu ngamunye okuphela.

xh.title: I-Ngcweti yokuKhiqiza inqanaba A-C: uMfaki-matshini oZenziselayo
xh.summary: Kufuneka kafakwe umatshini ozenziselayo kwi-Hub yokuLungiswa kwiZiko le-Discovery eGauteng ukuze aqhube kwaye ahlole izinto, kufuneka anesatifikethi esivakalisiweyo sokulinganiswa kobugcisa ebuthiyori kwaye abenolwazi olufikelela kwiminyaka emibini ubudala.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esifanelekileyo sokulinganiswa kobugcisa ebuthiyori. Amava amabini ubuncinane anawo onke amashumi amabhu iminyaka kwaye engangenanto. Ilayiseni yokuqhuba egqithisiweyo nokusebenzayo. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngeMithetho, iMigaqo kunye noMthetho wolawulo woKwabalwa kweliLizwe. Ulwazi ngoMthetho we-OHS. Ulwazi ngemigaqo, iindlela zokuqhuba kunye nendlela zokusebenza zesebe. Izicelo ezisezixeli zekhompyutha ezinceda ngobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi ngokuzalathisa ngokomthetho. Amandla - ukubhala iingxelo zobuchwepheshe. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuSeca. Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukusebenza njengeqela. Ubuchwephesha. Ukusetyenziswa kwezacwazela. Ukuqulunqa ngokwakho. Ikhono lokunxibelelana nokusebenzisa iKhompyutha. Ikhono lokucwangcisa nokuqamba. Iimpawu - Ukudlala njengelungu leqela. Ukuqwalasela abathengi. Okuthembekileyo.
xh.duties: Kuya kubakho iziphumo ezifanelekileyo ukuba kwakhiwe ukuba kwenzelwe imisebenzi esemthethweni yemisebenzi yokukhangela nokunika iziphelo ngokweemfuno zakho ngeenjongo zokulungisa izinto. Kuya kubakho imisebenzi yokulungisa izinto ezenziwayo ngokwemisebenzi efanayo. Kuya kubakho isiphelo esikumgangatho ophezulu sokulungisa izinto ezenziwayo. Kusayibakho isiphelo sokulungisa izinto kwaye kubakho namandla okusetyenziswa kwendlela yokulawula ezithile. Kuya kubakho isiphelo sokusebenzisa kwakhona izinto ezenziwayo kwaye kubakho isiphelo sokwenza okulungileyo. Kuya kubakho isiphelo esincedisa ngokusetyenziswa kwendlela yokwenza okulungileyo kumsebenzi wakho. Kusayibakho isiphelo sokulungisa izinto kwaye kubakho isiphelo sokusombulula iingxaki ezikwindlela ezizeleyo. Kuya kubakho isiphelo sokulungisa izinto kwaye kubakho namandla okusetyenziswa kwendlela yokulawula ezithile.

Kuhlole izisetshenziswa ezilungisiwe futhi/noma izindawo ngokuhambisana nesipesheli. Kunikeze inkonzo izisetshenziswa futhi/noma izindawo ngokusheshele. Kunikeze isinhlalo sokwesigqoko sezisetshenziswa ezinikeziwe inkonzo futhi ezilungisiwe futhi/noma izindawo. Kuhlanganise futhi kuthumele imibiko. Kunikeze okungenayo ohlelweni lokusebenza. xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esifanelekileyo seTrade Test. Esona sikhathi sade sisebenze isiqingatha seminyaka engu-0-2. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngemigaqo-mthetho, iinkqubomgumbo nemigaqo yoLwazi lwaseZikonini. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-OHS Act. Ulwazi ngeenkqubomgumbo, iindlela namagqabantshintshi asebe. Izicelo zobuchwephesha ezisebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ulwazi ngokuziphendulela ngokomthetho. Amandla- Ukubhala iingxelo ngezobuchwepheshe. Ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuqonda ngokweenkcukacha. Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukusebenza njengelixa. Ukuyila. Ukwenza isivenkile. Ukuzilawula. Unxibelelwano nakhona amakhono ekhompuyutha. Ukulungiselela nokuqamba izinto. Iimpawu- Umdlali welixa. Ukugxila kumthengi. Othembekileyo.
xh.duties: Yenza amadizayini ngokwezidingo zomthengi nangaphakathi kolulinganiso lwamandla okumvelisa. Yenza izinto ngezinto ngezixhobo ngokwezidingo zemisebenzi nangokwemigaqo eziqhelanayo. Nikeza isiqiniseko sokwakhona kwezinto ezenziweyo. Phengisa izixhobo kwaye/nendawo ngeziphazeko zobuchwepheshe. Lungisa izixhobo nemisebenzi ngokwemigaqo. Vavanya ulungiso lwezixhobo nakwindawo ngokwezidingo. Phuhlisela izixhobo kwaye/nendawo ngokweluhlu lomgcwangco. Nikeza isiqiniseko sokwakhona kwezixhobo eziphuhliseliweyo nokugcinwayo ezikwakhona/nakwindawo. Qamba kwaye uzihlomle iingxelo. Nikeza izinto ezithintelwe kwindlela yokusebenza. Gcina kwaye ulondoloze irekhodi lemisebenzi/irejista. Qonda kwaye ulungise abasebenzi. Gcina indlela ngeendalo ezintsha zezobuchwepheshe nemigaqo yapha kukhula kountu ngamnye.

Kuqwalasele ulwandlalo kwaye okanye izinto ezilungelelanisiweyo ukujonga amathuba obugcisa. Kulungise ulwandlalo nezinto ezilungelelanisiweyo ngokwemigaqo. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngemithetho, izinqubomgomo nemithetho yesebe loluntu. Umthetho we-OHS. Ulwazi ngezinqubomgomo, izuqu zokusimba nezinqubo zomnyango. Izinhlelo zobuchwepheshe ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Ulwazi nobuchwepheshe bokuqamba izinto. Amakhono: Ukubhala imibhali yobuchwepheshe. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukuthatha izinqumo. Ukusebenza ngokubumbana. Ukusungula izinto ezintsha. Ukuhlaziya. Ukuqondisa ngokwakho. Ukuthumela imiyalezo. Amandla okusebenza ngekhompyutha. Ukuhlela nokuqamba izinhlelo. Izimo: Ukusebenza ngokubumbana. Ukugxila kumthengi. Unikeze isiqiniseko sokulinganisa kwezinto ezikhiqiziwe. Hlola amathuluzi noma izakhiwo ukuba zinezici zobuchwepheshe ezingahambi kahle. Lungisa amathuluzi nezakhiwo ngokwezilinganiso. Zama ukwazi izinsiza nobuchwepheshe obusha ukuze uqhubeke nokuthuthukiswa kwakho ngokwakho.

af.title: Ambagsman Produksie: Loodgieter
af.summary: Die Department of Infrastructure Development soek 'n Ambagsman Produksie Loodgieter in Germiston om ontwerpe te produseer, gehaltversekering te lewer en toerusting vir tegniese foute te inspekteer.
af.requirements: 'n Geskikte Vaktoetsertifikaat. 'n Minimum van 0 – 2 jaar se ervaring. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van Openbare Dienswetgewing, Beleide en Regulasies. OHS Act. Kennis van departementele beleide, strategieë en prosedures. Rekenaargedrewe tegniese toepassings. Kennis van regsonderhouding. Produksieproseskennis en -vaardighede. Vaardighede: Tegniese verslagskrywing. Probleemoplossing en analise. Besluitneming. Spanwerk. Kreatiwiteit. Analities. Selfbestuur. Kommunikasie. Rekenaarvaardighede. Beplanning en organisering. Eienskappe: Spanspeler. Kliëntgerig. Betroubaar.
af.duties: Produseer ontwerpe volgens kliëntspesifikasies en binne die perke van produksievermoë. Produseer voorwerpe met materiaal en toerusting volgens werkspecificasies en erkende standaarde. Lewer gehaltversekering van vervaardigde voorwerpe. Inspekteer toerusting en/of fasiliteite vir tegniese foute. Herstel toerusting en fasiliteite volgens standaarde. Toets hersteltoerusting en/of fasiliteite teen spesifikasies. Onderhou toerusting en/of fasiliteite volgens skedule. Lewer gehaltversekering van onderhoude en gediende toerusting en/of fasiliteite. zu.title: Umsebenzi Wobuciko: Udokotela Wamaphayipi
zu.summary: I-Department of Infrastructure Development ifuna uDokotela Wamaphayipi Womsebenzi Wobuciko eGermiston ukwenza amadizayini, ukunikeza isiqiniseko sokuthungwa okuhle kanye nokuhlola izingxenye zesistimu ngeziphazamiso ezinzima.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi esifanele sokuqinisekiswa kobuciko. Okungenani unyaka 0 – 2 wamava. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngemithetho, izinqubomgomo kanye nemithethonqubo Yomphakathi. UMthetho we-OHS. Ulwazi ngeminqubomgomo, izuqukumgomo kanye nemithethonqubo yomnyango. Izinhlelo zokusebenza zezobuchwepheshe ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Ulwazi namakhono enqubo yokukhiqiza. Amakhono: Ukubika ngobuchwepheshe. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukusebenza njengeqembu. Ukusungula izinto ezintsha. Ukuhlaziya. Iqinisekiso lokuziphatha kahle. Ukuxhumana. Amakhono ekhompyutha. Ukuhlela kanye nokuhlanganisa. Izimpawu: Ukusebenza njengomuntu weqembu. Ukugxila kumthengi. Ukuthembeka.
zu.duties: Ukwenza amadizayini ngokwezidingo zomthengi kanye ngaphakathi kwegunya lokuqeqeshwa kokukhiqiza. Ukukhiqiza izinto ngesonto futhi ngezinto ngokwezidingo zomsebenzi njalo nangokwezindinganiso ezivunyelwe. Ukunikeza isiqiniseko sokuthungwa okuhle kwizinto ezikhiqiziwe. Ukuhlola izinto nezinkundla ngeziphazimiso ezinzima. Ukulungisa izinto nezinkundla njengemiqathango. Ukuhlola ukulungiswa kwezinto kanye nezinkundla ngokwezidingo. Ukwenza isevisi kwezinto nezinkundla ngohlelo. Ukunikeza isiqiniseko sokuthungwa okuhle kwezinto ezenziwe isevisi njalo ezigcinwe zisusebenza. Ukulungiselela nokuletha imibiko. Ukwethesa okokufaka ohlelweni lomsebenzi. Ukugcina futhi ukulondoloza irekhodi lesikhundla esithunyelwe kuso. Ukuphatha kanye noqeqesho lomsebenzi. Ukwazi izinto ezintsha zamathuluzi nezinhlelo zokuzithuthukisa ngokuya phambili.

xh.title: Umenzi zinto: Umthengisi wamanzi
xh.summary: Isebe loPhuhliso lweZakhiwo lifuna uMenzi zinto Umthengisi wamanza eGermiston ukuba adadle iindzame, anikeze isigqibo somgangatho aze ajonge izixhobo ngenxa yeziphazamiso zobugcisa.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esifanele sokuVavanya uBugcisa. Isipho sokugqiba kwamava okungenayo ngu 0 – 2 eminyakeni. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngoMthetho, iNqunqamiso namaLungiselelo oLwazi lokuSebenza kolawulo. uMthetho we-OHS. Ulwazi lweNqunqamiso, iindlela namanyathelo asebe. Izicelo zobugcisa ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi logcinisiso lomthetho. Ulwazi namakhono avelisa izinto. Amanqanaba abakho: Ukubhala iingxelo zobugcisa. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya. Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukusebenza njengesiqhathi. Ubuchule bokudala. Ukuhlalutya. Ukuzilawula. Unxibelelwano. Amanqanaba ekhompyutha. Ukucazulula nokuquka. Iimpawu: Ukudlala njengelungu leqela. Ukugxila kumxhasi. Ukuthembeka.
xh.duties: Dala iindzame ngokwezinto eziceliweyo lumxhasi nangaphakathi kweekrwele zokuphila koluyilo. Yila izinto ngezinto nakwizixhobo ngokwezinto eziceliweyo lumsebenzi nangokweemigangatho elungisiweyo. Nikela isigqibo somgangatho kubho ezidaliweyo. Jonga izixhobo noma izikhululo ngenxa yeziphazamiso zobugcisa. Lungisa izixhobo nangesikhululo ngokweemigangatho. Vavanya ulungiso lwezixhobo noma izikhululo ngokwezinto eziceliweyo. Phathe izixhobo noma izikhululo ngokwejadula. Nikela isigqibo somgangatho kwezixhobo noma izikhululo ezisebenziwe nokuqhutywa. Qamba ngexabiso uluntu ingxelo. Nikela imibuzo kwisicwangciso sokusebenza. Gcina aze uphuhlise irekhodi noma urejista yomsebenzi. Lawula uze ulawule abasebenzi. Zinze ubunye nobugcisa nobuchwethezi obutsha ukwakhwa komntu ngamnye.

zu.requirements: Isitifiketi esifanele se-Trade Test. Okuncane unyaka we-0-2 wemfundvo. Ilayisense yokushayela esebenzayo. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngemithetho, izinqubomgomo nemithethonqubo yesevisi yomphakathi. Ulwazi ngo-OHS Act. Ulwazi ngenqubomgomo, amasu nomthethosisekelo womnyango. Izinhlelo zobuchwepheshe ezisebenziswa ikhompuyutha. Ulwazi ngokuvumelana nomthetho. Ulwazi namakhono enqubo yokuqala. AMAKHONO- Ukubhala imibiko yobuchwepheshe. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukusebenza njengohlelo. Ukudala. Ukuhlaziya. Izimphiqamvelo. Isikhathi esibambezele. Ukuxhumana namakhono ekhompuyutha. Amakhono okucubungula futhi uhlele. Izici- Umuntu osebenza ngesiqhaza. Ugxile kwinhliziyo. Othembekile.
zu.duties:
Hlola izinkomba zomthetho waseSteve Biko Facility Maintenance Hub eGauteng. Hlola futhi uqinisise ukulandelwa kwemithetho yomphakathi.

**IZIDINGO:**

Isitifiketi esifanele sokuHlola uBungcweti. Okungenani unyaka we-0-2 wemfundo. Ilayisense yokushayela esebenzayo.

**IZINSELELE:**

Ukwazi ngemithetho, izinhlelo futhi nemiThetho yomSebenzi woMphakathi. Ukwazi ngoMthetho we-OHS. Ukwazi ngezinhlelo zamPhatho, amasu nomGaqo wokuSebenza womNyango. Ukusetshenziswa kwamaKhompyutha.

**IMISEBENZI:**

Hlela imiQondo ngesiKhathi esifanele somThetho we-0-2. Hlola futhi uqinise ukusetshenziswa kwethimba.

**IZINHLALO:**

Hlola imiQondo ngeMinyango yokuSebenza. Hlola futhi uqinise iziKhwama zokuSebenza. Ukwazi ukusebenza ngamaKhompyutha. Ukwazi nokuQonda ngokwemithetho.

Izicelo ezinxulumene nekhompyutha ngokobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi ngokuvumelana nomthetho. Ulwazi namakhono enkqubo yokukhiqiza. AMAKHONO- Ukubhala iingxelo ngobuchwepheshe. Iimpawu- Umdlali wetim. Ugxile kumthengi. Othembekileyo.
xh.duties: Khiqiza iindzayini ngokwezicelo zomthengi ngaphakathi kwemida yokukhiqiza. Khiqiza izinto ngesixhobo nengqekembe ngokwezicelo zenkonzo nangokweziqendu ezamkelweyo. Nikeza isiqinisekiso sokulingana kwezinto ezenziweyo. Hlola izixhobo kwaye okanye iziseko zonikezelo ngeziphene zobuchwepheshe. Lungisa izixhobo nesebe ngokomgangatho. Vavanya izixhobo ezilungiweyo okanye iziseko ngokwezicelo. Nika inkonzo izixhobo okanye iziseko ngokwejadule. Nikeza isiqinisekiso sokulingana kwezixhobo ezinikiwe inkonzo nokuqokelelwa izixhobo okanye iziseko. Qamba kwaye uhambise iingxelo. Nikeza izigqibo kwinkqubo yokusebenza. Gcina kwaye uqokelele irekhodi le mvulela le nkxazo. Lawula kwaye ulolise abasebenzi. Gcina nokuqhubela phambili nobuchwephesha amatsha nalandlela zokuziphumeza ngokuchanekileyo ngokwakho.

zu.title: Inhloli Yamasuvi Ezingeni A-C: Inja Yokuthutha Izinsiza
zu.summary: Umbhali ohlela imisebenzi oyikhuphile ohlelo lwe-Steve Biko Facility Maintenance Hub ukuze ahle imisebenzi yokusebenzela izidingo zomphakathi. Ukwenza imisebenzi ehleli kahle ngokuziphendulela okuhle kakhulu. Ukuze ahle imisebenzi ehleli kahle futhi ahle izinhlaka zomsebenzi kanye nokusebenzela izidingo zomphakathi. Ukuze ahle imisebenzi ehleli kahle kakhulu ngendlela yokusebenzela abantu ngokuziphendulela ngokwezomnotho. Ukuze ahle imisebenzi ehleli kahle kakhulu ngendlela ehambisana nemithelela yokusebenzela abantu abasha. - Hlela imisebenzi ehleli kahle kakhulu ngendlela yokusebenzela abantu abafuna ukwaziswa ngokomsebenzi. - Hlela imisebenzi ehleli kahle kakhulu ngendlela yokunaka izidingo zomphakathi mayelana nokusebenzela izidingo zomphakathi. - Hlela imisebenzi ehleli kahle kakhulu ngendlela ehambisana nemisebenzi yomphakathi. - Lawula imisebenzi yomphakathi ngokusebenzela izinsizakalo ezithile. - Lawula imisebenzi yomphakathi ehlangene nohlelo lokusebenza kwengxenye yesikhungo. - Lawula imisebenzi yomphakathi egqamile ehleli ngendlela yok
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi Esifanele Samasuvi weziqu. Ukuze ube nesikhathi esingezinyanga ezingu 0-2. Isitifikedi esiphathelene nokusebenza kwemoto. Ikhono: Ukuqonda ngemithetho, izinqubo nezinhlelo zikaRhulumente. Ukuqonda ngomthetho we-OHS. Ukuqonda ngemithetho ngeNgqikithi yokuHlela imisebenzi. Ukuqonda imithetho yokusebenza kahle ngesikhathi esibekiwe. Isiko elihlakaniphile lokubuyekeza imisebenzi. Ukuqonda ukusetshenziswa kwemithetho ekhulu. ukwaziswa ngezinkalo zezezimali ezingakaqondwa ngenhleleleko. Ikhono - Ukubhala ngokuhlela imibhalo yezinsizakalo ezithile. - Ukuqonda nokulawula imisebenzi ehlangene. - Ukuthatha izinqumo. - Ukusebenza ngokuvumelana. - Ukubhukuda ngokulawula ukwaziswa nokusebenza ngokuqondile. - Ukulawula imisebenzi. - Ukuba nelwazi lokuhlela. - Ukuba nok
zu.duties: Hluza izimoto nezimoto zokuhanjiswa kwesikhungo ngaphandle kokusebenza kolwazi lwesikhathi esibekiwe. Ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi ehlinzekwa yiZiko Lokugcina Izindawo e-Steve Biko. Kuduze nemibuzo yomphakathi mayelana nokuphathwa kwemisebenzi nokunikezelwa kokwaziswa komunnguni. Velela ngamaphothifoliyo alandela imithelela yemisebenzi. Hlela futhi ulawule ukubhalwa kwemisebenzi ephiwa izinkomba. Sebenzisana namakhomidi womkhakha ohlela imisebenzi yokubuyekeza. Hlinzeka ngemibono engangenwa umsebenzi ohlelwayo. - Thuthukisa imisebenzi yokunakekelwa kwemisebenzi ehlukene ehambisana namaphothifoliyo ohlelo lwemisebenzi. - Lawula imisebenzi eminingi ehlukene ngaphansi kohlelo lokusebenza lwesiKhwapha sokuGcina. - Lawula imisebenzi egqamile ehleli ngohlelo lokubuyekeza nokuhlolwa kwemisebenzi. - Lawula inqwaba yemisebenzi yokubuyekeza futhi uhlele ukusetshenziswa kolwazi lwezimali ngokuhambisana nemithetho yesikhungo. - Lawula imisebenzi yonk

xh.summary: Kufunwa umuntu wakho bani wesithuba somsebenzi wakho bani wePlumber kwiziko lase-Steve Biko Facility Maintenance Hub ukuze adale iindlela, anike isiqinisekiso samgangatho kwaye ahlole izixhobo ngeempazamo zobuchwepheshe.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esifanelekileyo soVavayo lwemisebenzi. Inani elingentla kweminyaka eyi-0-2 yamava. Ilayisense yokushayela esebenzayo. Ikhompetensi: Ulwazi ngeMithetho, iNqubomgomo nezeMigaqo yeNkonzo zoLuntu. Ulwazi nge-OHS Act. Ulwazi ngeenqubomgomo, iindlela neenkqubo zeNdzabamkulu noBuchwepheshe. Iinkqubo zobuchwepheshe ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokuthobela imithetho. Ulwazi nakhono lokukhiqiza iinkqubo. Ikhono- Ukubhala iingxelo zobuchwepheshe. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqonda. Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukusebenza njengaqela. Ukudala. Ukuqonda. Ukuzilawula. Ikhono lokunxibelelana kunye nekhompyutha. Ikhono lokucinga nokulungiselela. Iimpawu- Ukusebenza njengaqela. Ukujongana nabathengi. Ukuthembeka.
xh.duties: Dala iindlela ngokwezicelo zabathengi kwaye ngaphakathi kwamandla okukhiqiza. Khkwiqa izinto ngesixhobo nangemateriali ngokwezicelo somsebenzi nangokwemigangatho evunyiweyo. Yenza isiqinisekiso sokulungiselela kwiinto ezikhiqizwe. Phonononga izixhobo kwaye/noma izinto ezijikelezile ukujonga iimpazamo zobuchwepheshe. Lungisa izixhobo nakuqondo ezijikelezile ngokwemigangatho. Zama ukulungisa izixhobo nakuqondo ezijikelezile ngokwezicelo. Phatha izixhobo kwaye/nokuqonda ezijikelezile ngokwejadulwelo. Yenza isiqinisekiso sokulungiselela kwizixhobo ezinikelwe ngomnikezo kwaye/nangokubekwa izinto ezijikelezile. Hlela kwaye ungenise iingxelo. Yonke into ekwimigangatho yophando. Yigcine kwaye ulondoloze irekhodi yomsebenzi. Lawula kwaye ulule abasebenzi. Hlala ufunda iindlela ezintsha zobuchwepheshe neenkqubo ukuze uphuhlise uluntu.

af.title: Ambagsman Produksie Graad A-C: Loodgieter
af.summary: Loodgieterpos by Sebokeng Facility Maintenance Hub wat ontwerpe en voorwerpe tot spesifikasie produceer, met 'n handelsertoetssertifikaat en geldige bestuurderslisensie wat vereis word.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike handelsertoetssertifikaat. 'n Minimum van 0-2 jaar se ondervinding. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van Openbare Dienste-wetgewing, beleide en regulasies. Kennis van die OHS-wet. Kennis van departementele beleide, strategieë en prosedures. Rekenaargesteunde tegniese toepassings. Kennis van wetlike nakoming. Produksieproseskennis en -vaardighede. Vaardighede- Tegniese verslagskrywing. Probleemoplossing en analise. Besluitneming. Spanwerk. Skeppendheid. Analities. Selfbestuur. Kommunikasie en rekenaarvaardighede. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Eienskappe- Spanspeler. Kliëntgefokus. Betroubaar.
af.duties: Produceer ontwerpe volgens klientspesifikasies en binne die perke van produksievermoë. Produceer voorwerpe met materiaal en toerusting volgens werkspesifikasies en erkende standaarde. Lewer gehaltesekerheid van geproduceerde voorwerpe. Inspekteer toerusting en/of fasiliteite vir tegniese foute. Herstel toerusting en fasiliteite volgens standaarde. Toets herstelde toerusting en/of fasiliteite teen spesifikasies. Onderhou toerusting en/of fasiliteite volgens skedule. Lewer gehaltesekerheid van bediende en onderhoude toerusting en/of fasiliteite.
