zu.title: Umsebenzi wokukhiqiza i-Artisan izinga A-C: Uphayiphawuna
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuphayiphawuna e-Sebokeng Facility Maintenance Hub sokukhiqiza izinhlelo nezinto ngokomthethonqondo, kunesitifiketi senhloliso lobuchwepheshe nelayisensi evumelekile yokushayela esidingweni.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi senhloliso lobuchwepheshe esifanelekayo. Okungenani ungamuhla weminyaka engu-0-2 wobuhlotshaniselo. Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela. Ikhono: Ulwazi mayelana nomthetho, izinqubomgomo nezimiso zomphakathi. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-OHS. Ulwazi mayelana nezinqubomgomo, izuza nezinqubo zomnyango. Izinhlelo zethuluzi lokusebenzela ikhompyutha ezibuso obuchwepheshe. Ulwazi ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Ulwazi namakhono okukhiqiza inqubo. Amakhono- Ukubhala imibhalo yobuchwepheshe. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukuthatha izinqumo. Ukusebenza njengqembu. Ukudala. Ukuhlaziya. Ukuziphatha kahle. Amakhono okuxhumana nokuqamba ngekhompyutha. Amakhono ohlelo nokuhlelwa. Izinto eziwusizo- Ukusebenza njengqembu. Ukugxila kumthengi. Okuthembekile.
zu.duties: Kukhiqize izinhlela ngokomthethonqondo womthengi futhi ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo yamandla okukhiqiza. Kukhiqize izinto ngezinsimbi nobuciko ngokomthethonqondo womsebenzi nangokwezinga elivunyiwe. Kunikeze isiqiniseko sokudidiya kwezinto ezenziwe. Hlola izinsimbi kanye/noma izikhungo ukuthola iziphazamiso zobuchwepheshe. Lungisa izinsimbi nezikhungo ngokwezinga. Hlola ukulungiswa kwezinsimbi kanye/noma izikhungo ngokomthethonqondo. Phathwa izinsimbi kanye/noma izikhungo ngokohlelo. Kunikeze isiqiniseko sokudidiya kwezinsimbi kanye/noma izikhungo ezibukelwe nezokugcinwa. Bala futhi unikele imibhalo. Nikeza okufakwe ohlelweni lokusebenza. Gcina futhi ulondoloze irekhodi/irejista yomsebenzi. Qaphisise futhi ulungise abasebenzi. Qhubeka nokuthola amasu amasha nobuchwepheshe ukuze kube nokuthuthuka okuphelele komuntu ngamunye.

xh.title: Umsebenzi wokuqamba izinto esemgangathweni A-C: Undidimanisi wamapayipi
xh.summary: Isithuba sokusebenza njengoundidimanisi wamapayipi kwiSebokeng Facility Maintenance Hub ekwenza iinkqubo zokwakha namaphuju ngokomgangatho ocelelweyo, lisebe kule mfuno yesatifikethi sokuvavanya ubugcisa nelayisensi esebenzayo yokushuka.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esifanelekileyo sokuvavanya ubugcisa. Amava aphantsi kwe-0-2 unyaka. Ilayisensi esebenzayo yokushuka. Ikhomphetensi: Ulwazi ngomthetho, iinkqazo namalungiselelo asebenza kuLuntu. Ulwazi lwe-OHS Act. Ulwazi lweenkqazo zamasebe, iindlela nezinqubo. Iinkqubo zobuchwepheshe ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi lokuzithobela ngomthetho. Ulwazi n amakhono enkqubo yokwenza izinto. Amakhono- Ukubhala iingxelo zobuchwepheshe. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuwachaza. Ukwenza iigqibo. Ukusebenza njengesiqhelo. Ubuchule bokwenza. Ukuhlola. Ukuzilawula. Ikhomunikeshin n amakhono ekhompyutha. Amakhono okucwangcisa nokuqamba. Iimpawu- Ukusebenza njengesiqhelo kuluntu. Ukwagxila kwimfuno yabathengi. Othembekileyo.
xh.duties: Yenza iinkqubo zokwakha ngokweemfuno zamaxhwele kwaye ngaphakathi kwamandla enkqubo yokweniza izinto. Yenza amaphaju ngesixhobo nempahla ngokweemfuno zomsebenzi nangokomgangatho oqatshiweyo. Yaza inkqubo yokuqinisekisa umgangatho kumaphaju enziweyo. Hlola izixhobo kwaye izinto ngezizathu zobugcisa. Lungisa izixhobo nangona izinto ngokomgangatho. Vavanya ulungiso lwezixhobo kwaye izinto ukujongana neemfuno. Phatha izixhobo kwaye izinto ngokwejadule. Yaza inkqubo yokuqinisekisa umgangatho kwezixhobo eziphathiweyo kwayy ezigcinwayo. Qamba kwaye thumela iingxelo. Nikeza izimvo kwinkqubo yokusebenza. Gcina ugcino lomsebenzi /irejista. Lawula kwaye kalisa abasebenzi. Hamba nobuchwepheshe obutsha nangoomawunye ngeenkqubo kubakho luntlu phantse kokuziva phantse komntu.

zu.summary: Isikhundla somsebenzi wezenzakalo webuhlethi Gauteng esidinga Isitifikedi Sehlulelo Lobuchwepheshe kanye namaphesenti angu 0-2 okuhluza ukukhiqiza izakhiwo nezinto ngokwezinkomba ziklayenti.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi Esifanele Sehlulelo Lobuchwepheshe. Ubuncane bamaphesenti angu 0-2. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Amandla: Ulwazi ngeMithetho Yenkonzo Yomphakathi, Izinqubo NobuLungiswa. Ulwazi ngeMthetho We-OHS. Ulwazi ngemithetho yomnyango,amasu namasu. Izinhlelo zebuchwepheshe ezisebenza ngekhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokuvumelana nomthetho. Ulwazi namakhono eNqubo YokuKhiqiza. Amakhono- Ukubhala imibiko yobuchwepheshe. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuCwaninga. UkuThatha Izinqumo. Ukusebenza Njengeqembu. Ubuciko. Ukuhlaziya. UkuZibusa. Amakhono OkuXhumana NakuSebenzisa Ikhompyutha. Amakhono OkuCubungula NokuHlela. Izimpawu- Umdlali Weqembu. UkuGxila Kwiklayenti. Othembekile.
zu.duties: Kukhiqize izakhiwo ngokwezinkomba ziklayenti futhi ngaphakathi kwezikhungo zamandla okukhiqiza. Kukhiqize izinto ngesiqhathi nezisetshenziswa ngokwezinkomba zomsebenzi nasendlela evunyiwe. Kunikeze isiqiniseko somgangatho sezinto eziKhiqiziwe. Kubheke izisetshenziswa kanye nezakhiwo ukuthi zikho na izikhungo zobuchwepheshe ezimbi kakhulu. Kulungise izisetshenziswa nezakhiwo ngokwemithetho yomsebenzi. Kubuyekeze iziqapheli eziLungisiwe kanye nezakhiwo ngokohambo lwemisebenzi. Kubuyekeze izisetshenziswa nezakhiwo ngokohlelo lwesikhathi. Kunikeze isiqiniseko somgangatho sezinqubo eziBuyekeziwe nazo eziGcinwe ezisokuthi zingasetshenziswa futhi noma eziyiZakhiwo. Kubhale futhi kuhambise imibiko. Kunikeze okungenayo ohlelweni lweNkonzo. Kugcine futhi kugcathi izimfanelo zomsebenzi noma uhlu lwemisebenzi. KuQondise futhi kuQinise abasebenzi ngokwemisebenzi. KuLandele izindlela ezintsha zobuChwepheshe kanye neNqubo yokuthuthuka ngokuQhubeka komuntu ngamunye.

xh.title: Isikhongozeli Sokukhiqiza Isikhundla A-C: Ezobuchwephethshe
xh.summary: Isikhundla sokukhiqiza somenzi ochwephetsheko esifundeni saseGauteng esifuna isatifikedi senzuzo yokumthetho yomsebenzi kwaye neminyaka yamava emi kweloo minyaka ize ithathe apho ukuya kuthi ga kwezimbini ukuyila nokwenza izinto ngokwesicelo somthengi.
xh.requirements: Isatifikedi esifanelekileyo senzuzo yokumthetho yomsebenzi. Inani elingakananiyo leminyaka yamava engu-0-2. Ilayisenisi yomqhubi egunyazisiweyo. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngeMithetho, iNgqungoqhala noMthetho oLawulayo weNkonzo kaRhulumayi. Ulwazi lweMthetho kaQhatholithi ngamava. Ulwazi lweNgqungoqhala ngeenyoluhlelo nokwenziwa kwemisebenzi yesebe. Isicelo sabachwephethshe ekusebenziseni. Ulwazi ngenkqubela phambili kwakhona. Ulwazi lomthetho nokuba ngumntu othembekileyo kumthetho. Ulwazi lwenkqubo yokukhiqiza nakhono ukwenza. Khono-Ezokuchaza ngokobuchwephethshe. Ukuxazulula iingxaki nokwahlula-hlula. Ukwenza isigqibo. Ukusebenza njengesitfuba. Ukuyila okutsha. Umchazi wezinto. Ukuzilawula. Inkonzo yokunxibelelwana neKhompyutha. Khono ezenkqubo nopthuthuzela. Iimpawu-Umdlali wesitfuba. Ukubheka ngakumbi kumthengi. Othembekileyo.
xh.duties: Yila iinkqubo ngokwezicelo zomthengi kwaye ungamashumi amva enkqubo yokukhiqiza. Khiiqa izinto ngesifuno nexhula ngokwezicelo zemisebenzi kwakunye namaginga asemthethweni. Nikela ngemfihlelo eqinisisiweyo yezinto ezenziweyo. Phepha ixhulo nemiyalelo yakho ngokwezehlabathi ezingunyaze ezenkqubela phambili. Ngena ixhulo nemisebenzi ngakumbi ngokwamava ukuba sengozulu. Vavanya ixhulo nemisebenzi ngokuchasene nezigqibo. Zonke ixhulo nemisebenzi ngokohlelo. Nikela ngemfihlelo eqinisisiweyo yexhulo nemisebenzi ekhoyo. Yila kwaye ungenise iingxelo. Nikela ngengangamathamsanqa kwinkqubela yokuqulunqa. Gcina uphawu lomsebenzi nokummbatha ukuyala. Tyhila kwaye ulungise abasebenzi. Landela iindlela ezenkqubo ezitsha ngokusetyenziselwa ukuzintsengaphandle kokuba mntu oyileyo.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Wokukhiqiza: Kagesi
zu.summary: Kudingeka umculi wokukhiqiza kagesi e-Mamelodi Facility Maintenance Hub ukukhiqiza izilinganiso, ukubheka izisetshenziswa nokunikeza isiqiniseko somgangatho.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi esifanele sokuHlola Umsebenzi. Okungenani unyaka o-0-2 wamava. Ilayisensi yokuqasha esemthethweni. Amakhono: Umthetho Womphakathi, Izinqumo Nemithetho Yomphakathi, kanye noMthetho we-OHS. Ulwazi ngemithethomgomo yomnyango, izindlela kanye nendlela zokwenza izinto. Izinhlelo zetheknikhi ezisebenzisana ngekhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokuvumelana nomthetho. Izinhlelo ezisebenzisana ngekhompyutha. Ulwazi nendlela yokukhiqiza kanye Namakhono: Ukubhala imibiko yobuchwepheshe, ukuxazula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya, ukwenza izinqumo, ukusebenza ngokubambisana, ukubumba izinkumbulo, ukuhlaziya, ukuzilawula, ukuxhumana, amakhono ekhompyutha, ukuhlela kanye nokuqamba. Izinto Okuzibhekayo- Ukusebenza ngokubambisana nakilaba bathile, ukugxila kumthengi nokuba Ngaphezu kwayo konke.
zu.duties: Kukhiqize izilinganiso ngokwezici zomthengi futhi ngaphakathi kwamandla okukhiqiza. Kukhiqize izinto ngempahla nangesisetshenziswa ngokwezici zomsebenzi nangokwezindinganiso eziyaziwa. Kunikeze isiqiniseko somgangatho sezinto ezenziwe. Kubheke izisetshenziswa kanye/noma izikhungo ukuthola ziba nobuhlobo bamaphutha. Kulungise izisetshenziswa noma izikhungo ngokwezindinganiso. Kuhlale ulungise izisetshenziswa futhi ubheke noma izikhungo ngokwezici. Kunikeze isiqiniseko somgangatho sezinhlelo ezenziwe nezinsiza ezigcinwe kahle nezikhungo. Kuhlanganise futhi unikeze imibiko. Kunikeze izincomo ohlelweni lokusebenza. Uguge futhi ulondoloze umbhalo wesikhathi/bhuku lomsebenzi. Qaphela futhi uhola abasebenzi. Gcina ulwazi lwezindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinto ukuze uthuthuke.

xh.title: Umsebenzi wokuQamba izinto: uKwazibini kweBane
xh.summary: Kufuneka ube ngumsebenzi wokuqamba izinto ongummandli webane kwi-Mamelodi Facility Maintenance Hub ukuze aqambe iizayo, ahlolisise izixhobo anike inkqubo yokuqinisekisa umgangatho.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esifanelekileso sokuvavanya isiqu. Ukungazange ubenge nayo iphi iminyaka engu-0-2 yamava. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba evumelekileyo. Iikhompetensi: Urhelo lwemithetho yaseZikhaleni zeLuntu, iNgqikithi nezigaZizo; uMthetho we-OHS. Ulwazi ngemigaqo, iindlela zengqiqo neenkqubo zesebe. Izicelo zobuchwephesha ezisebenziswaikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokuziphatheka okusesidlangaleni. Izicelo ezisebenziswayo ngekhompyutha. Ulwazi namakhono enkqubo yokuvelisa izinto: Ukubhalwa kweenxaxheba zobugcisa, ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuhlola, ukwenza izigqibo, ukusebenza njengaqhama, umboniso oqhubekayo, ocheneyo, ukuzilawula, unxibelelwano, amakhono ekhompyutha, ucwangciso loluhlelo. Iimpawu- Ukusebenza njengesiqhenga, ukugxila kumthengi nokuba othembekileyo.
xh.duties: Qamba iizayo ngokwezicwangciso zomthengi nangaphakathi kwemida ezingamaqhama obugcisa obuqambiweyo. Qamba izinto ngeentsimbi nangezixhobo ngokwezicwangciso zomsebenzi nangokwezinga elithathwa njengelipheleleyo. Nikela inkqubo yokuqinisekisa umgangatho kwezinto ezenziweyo. Hlolisisa izixhobo nakwilengo ngenxa yeziphene zobugcisa. Lolisa izixhobo nelifasiliti ngokwemilinganiselo. Vavanya uloliso Iwexhobo nakwilengo kumacwangciso amaninzi. Phathela izixhobo ngenkqubo ngokocwangciso olumiselweyo. Nikela inkqubo yokuqinisekisa umgangatho kwezixhobo nelifasiliti ezifunyanwe zikhaladi ngesiseko. Lungelelanisa ngokubhala ngokwakho ngokweenkcukacha ezithile, uzihambelise nazo kuqinisekiso lokwazi nokuqinisekiswa kwengingqi. Zama ukuba usenokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obutsha, njengoko ecaleni kwamava okusebenza kwakho kubakho namakhono abucala.

zu.title: Isikhundla sokukhiqiza: Kagesi
zu.summary: Umnyango wezokuthuthukiswa kwezinsimbi ufuna umkhiqizi wesikhundla sokukhiqiza kagesi eTshwane ukuthi akhiqize izinhlobo zokwakha, ahlole izinto zakagesi anikeze isiqiniseko sokulingana, kudingeka ifomu lesitifiketi senkinga.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi esifanele senkinga. Okungenani amadayisi wezinsuku ezingaba ngu-0-2. Ilayisense yomshayeli. Izikhali: imithetho, izinqubomgomo nemithetho yesebe. Ulwazi ngemithetho, izinqubomgomo nendlela zomnyango. Izinhlelo ezibhekise kwegumbi. Ulwazi ngokuvumelana nomthetho. Izinhlelo ezenza umsebenzi ngesikhathi. Ulwazi nenkqubo yokuqamba kanye namakhono: ukubhala umbiko, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya, ukwenza izinqumo, ukusebenza ngokubambisana, ubuciko, ukuhlaziya, ukuzilawula, ukuxhumana, amakhonowegumbi, ukulungelela nokuhlela. Okuwumuntu- ukusebenza ngokubambisana, ukugxila kumthengi nokwethembeka.
zu.duties: Akhiqize izinhlobo zokwakha ngokwezinhlinzeko zalowo okufunwa kuye nangaphakathi kwezindlela zomsebenzi wakho. Akhiqize izinto ngezinto zokwakha nangemishini ngokwezinhlinzeko zalowo okufunwa kuye ngokuhambisana nemigomo. Anikeze isiqiniseko sokulingana kwezinto ezenziwe. Ahlole imishini kanye/noma izitesi ukuze abone iziphazamiso. Alungise imishini nezitesi ngokuhambisana nemigomo. Ahlole imishini kanye/noma izitesi ngokwezinhlinzeko. Akhulule imishini kanye/noma izitesi ngokweluhlu. Anikeze isiqiniseko sokulingana kwemishini kanye/noma izitesi. Abhale ahambise imibiko. Anikeze imibiko ohlelweni lwemisebenzi. Agcine uhlu lwemisebenzi. Aqondise futhi ahlinze abasebenzi. Azibuse ngemikhakha entsha nangendlela zokwenza imisebenzi ukuthi akhe azithuthukise.

xh.title: Umvelisi weMisebenzi yokuDala: uKagesi
xh.summary: Kufunwa uMvelisi wokuDala weKagesi kwiSebe lePhuhliso loPhuhliso eTshwane ukwenza iinkqubo zokwakha, ukuphonononga izixhobo kunye nokunika isiqinisekiso semveliso, kufuneka ifayida yeTesti yoKusebenza.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esifanelekileyo seTesti yoKusebenza. Okona nqanaba lokuqonelela kwamava eminyaka yi-0-2. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Amandla oKusebenza: umthetho weNkonzo kaWonke-wonke, iNgqungquthela nezinqanaba, uMthetho woKhuseleko lweMisebenzi. Ulwazi ngeengqungquthela zeSebe, iindlela zokuqhuba nemigaqo. Izicelo ezisebenzisa iikhompyutha ngezicelo ezinobuchule. Ulwazi ngokuvumelana nomthetho. Izicelo ezisebenzisa iikhompyutha. Ulwazi lwenkqubo yokvelisa namakhono: Ukubhala iingxelo zobuchule, ukuxazula iingxaki nokuqonda, ukwenza izigqibo, ukusebenza njengeqela, ukudala, ukwahlahlaza, ukuzilawula, unxibelelwano, amakhono ekhompyutha, ukucazulula nokuqamba. Iimpawu- Ukusebenza njengelungu leqela, ukugxila kumthengi nokubaThemba.
xh.duties: Yenza iinkqubo zokwakha ngokwesiphithiphithi somthengi ngaphakathi kwemida yamandla okuvelisa. Yeza izinto ngezinto nezixhobo ngokwesiphithiphithi somsebenzi ngokwemilinganiselo eqinisekisiweyo. Nikeza isiqinisekiso semveliso kwiinto ezenziwe. Phonononga izixhobo kwaye okanye iziseko zobuchule ukujonga iimpazamo zobuchule. Lungisa izixhobo neziseko ngokwemilinganiselo. Vavanya ukulungisa izixhobo kwaye okanye iziseko ngokuchasana nesiphithiphithi. Phatha izixhobo kwaye okanye iziseko ngokwejadulwele. Nikeza isiqinisekiso kwizixhobo kwaye okanye iziseko ezipathiweyo ezisezagcinweyo. Qamba kwaye unike iingxelo. Nikeza izinto ezingenisa kwindlela yokusebenza. Gcina kwaye ulondoloze irekhodi yesikhundla/irejista. Lilise kwaye ulungise abasebenzi. Landela iindlela ezitsha zobuchule nemigaqo ngenjongo yophuhliso ngokuthe nkqo komntu ngamnye.

Ulwazi ngokulandelana komthetho. Izinhlelo zesicikileli eziqinisekisiwe. Ulwazi nendlela yokukhiqiza kanye namakhono. Amakhono: Ukubhala umbiko obuchwepheshe, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, ukwenza izinqumo, ukusebenza njengeqembu, ukudala, ukuhlaziya, ukuzilawula, ukuxhumana, amakhono esicikileli, ukuhlela nokubamba izinto. Izinto ezibalulekile: Ukusebenza njengeqembu, ukugxila kumthengi nokuthembeka.
zu.duties: Kukhiqize izakhiwo ngokwezidingo zomthengi nangaphakathi kwezinkinga zekono lokukhiqiza. Kukhiqize izinto ngezinto zokwakha nemitshana ngokwezidingo zendlela yokusebenza nangokwezinga elivunyiwe. Kunike isiqiniseko sokulingana kwezinto ezikhiqiziwe. Kuhlolwe imitshana kanye/noma izikhungo ngeziphazamiso zobuchwepheshe. Kulungiswe imitshana nezikhungo ngokwezinga. Kuhlolwe ukulungiswa kwemitshana kanye/noma izikhungo ngokwezidingo. Kwenziwe isabhale kwemitshana kanye/noma izikhungo ngohlelo. Kunike isiqiniseko sokulingana kwemitshana ebiyisabhale naseyagcinwa kanye/noma izikhungo. Kuhlelwe futhi kunikwe izinhlangothi imibiko. Kunikwe okokufaka ohlelweni lokusebenza. Kugcinwe futhi kubhalwe irekhodi/irejista yomsebenzi. Kubhekwe futhi kuqondiswe abasebenzi. Kugcinwe kusekhona ngobuchwepheshe obusha nendlela zokwenza ukuze kube nokuthuthuka okuqhubekayo komuntu ngamunye.

xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esifanelekileyo senkcubeko yemisebenzi. Amava amancinci angu 0-2 eminyaka. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekileyo. Ukuzinza: Ulweso-mthetho lomsebenzi woLuntu, iMigaqo kunye noLaqwebo, loMthetho we-OHS. Ulwazi ngemigaqo, iindaba kunye nemithetho yesebe. Izicelo ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha ezinobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi ngokuthobela umthetho. Izicelo ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi nakhono lwenkqubo yokuphumba. Amakhono: Ukubhala iingxelo zobugcisa, ukuxazula nokuhlaziya iingxaki, ukwenza izigqibo, ukusebenza njengaqhakamsheliyo, ubuchwephesha bokuyila, ukwenza isigqibo, ukuqamba, ukuhlaziya, ukuqulunqa ubomi, unxibelelwano, amakhono ekhompyutheni, ukucwangcisa nokuhlela. Iimpawu: Ukusebenza njengaqhakamsheliyo, ukugxila kumthengi nokuba wothembekileyo.
xh.duties: Yila iimodeli ngokwesicwangciso somthengi nangaphakathi kwemida yamandla okuphumba. Yiza izinto ngesixhobo nemikhoyo ngokwesicwangciso somsebenzi nangemilinganiselo efanayo. Yiba nobulumko obuchanekileyo bezinto eziphunywe. Jonga isixhobo kunye nendawo xa sikhona ukutya kwasemva kobugcisa. Lungisa isixhobo kunye nendawo ngokwemilinganiselo. Vavanya ulungiso lwesixhobo nendawo ngokumelene nezigqibo. Khonza isixhobo nendawo ngokwexesha elicwangcisiweyo. Yiba nobulumko obuchanekileyo besixhobo nendawo ekhonziweyo nolungisiweyo. Qamba uze ungenise iingxelo. Nikela ngamagama eqhinga lokusebenza. Gcina uze ulondoloze irekhodi lesicwangciso/urekhodo. Qwalasela uze ulule abasebenzi. Landela iindlela ezintsha zobugcisa ngeenjongo zokuziphuhlisa ngokuqhubekayo.

Knowledge of Occupational Health and Safety Act. Skills: Interpersonal relations. Ability to utilise Public Works maintenance tools. Planning and organising. Staff supervision. Communication (written & verbal). Attributes: People centred. Professionalism. Collective responsibility. Transformation. Batho Pele Principles. Attention to detail. Honesty and integrity. Strong ethics.
jobs.duties: Request chemicals from stores as required. Test quality of water of softeners as well as the returning flows of condensate water. Fill chemicals tank with required chemicals as prescribed. Top up salt in brine tank. Check working conditions of chemical pumps. Test total dissolve solids (TDS) and blow-down according to prescripts. Monitor the stream pressure constantly Check correct temperature of hot well tanks. Adjust the stoker for efficient steam delivery. Report all defects immediately. Check the feed water pump-levels and hot well tanks for sufficient water supply to the boiler. Ensure that standby boilers and funnel is full of water and chemicals at all times. Control the flow of fuel. Ensure that the boiler environment is well maintained. Ensure proper usage of protective clothing. Ensure that the boiler environment is clean and safe. Ensure that the brine tank and water filter are cleaned as prescribed. Ensure the removal of ash from boilers, gritt arrester and smoke box. Log all recordings as per the assessment in the logbook. Perform supervisory functions. Receive and signoff on the delivery of coal. Provide shift reports. Maintenance of shift/overtime register. Perform related adhoc duties.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Sikelelwa Mboto at 076 521 4118

af.title: Keteloperateur
af.summary: Keteloperateur benodig by Weskoppies Facility Maintenance Hub in Tshwane, met Graad 10, 'n Nasionale Stoomsertifikaat en 1-3 jaar se ondervinding in ketelbedrywing.
af.requirements: Graad 10 en 'n gelykwaardige erkende Nasionale Stoomsertifikaat. 'n Minimum van 1-3 jaar se toepaslike praktiese ervaring opgedoen in ketelbedrywing. Bevoegdhede: Basiese kennis van norme en standaarde oor lae druk. Kennis van Onderhoudswerke se Norme en Standaarde. Kennis van onderhoudgereedskap. Kennis van die Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid. Vaardighede: Tussenmenslike verhoudinge. Vermoë om Openbare Werke se onderhoudgereedskap te gebruik. Beplanning en organisering. Personeeltoesig. Kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings). Eienskappe: Mensegerig. Professionaliteit. Kollektiewe verantwoordelikheid. Transformasie. Batho Pele-beginsels. Aandag aan besonderhede. Eerlikheid en integriteit. Sterk etiek.
af.duties: Versoek chemikalieë van die magasin soos benodig. Toets die kwaliteit van water van sagtmakers asook die terugvloei van kondensaatwater. Vul die chemikalieëtenk met die benodigde chemikalieë soos voorgeskryf. Vul sout aan in die pekeltenk. Kontroleer werktoestande van chemiese pompe. Toet totale opgeloste vastestowwe (TDS) en voer afvoer uit volgens voorskrifte. Monitor die stoomdruk voortdurend. Kontroleer die korrekte temperatuur van warmputtenks. Stel die stoker vir doeltreffende stoomlewering. Rapporteer alle defekte onmiddellik. Kontroleer die voerwaterpompe se vlakke en warmputtenks vir voldoende watervoorsiening aan die ketel. Verseker dat standby-ketels en skoorsteen te alle tye vol water en chemikalieë is. Beheer die vloei van brandstof. Verseker dat die ketelomgewing goed onderhou word. Verseker behoorlike gebruik van beskermende klere. Verseker dat die ketelomgewing skoon en veilig is. Verseker dat die pekeltenk en waterfilter skoongemaak word soos voorgeskryf. Verseker die verwydering van as uit ketels, gritopvanger en rookkas. Teken alle leeswaardes aan volgens die assessering in die logboek. Verrig toesigfunksies. Ontvang en teken af op die aflewering van steenkool. Verskaf skofverslae. Onderhoud van skof/oortydregister. Verrig verwante adhoc-pligte.

zu.title: Umlawuli Weshibilishi
zu.summary: Umlawuli Weshibilishi udingeka e Weskoppies Facility Maintenance Hub e Tshwane, kudingeka ibe khona ibanga le Grade 10, isitifikedi se-National Steam Certificate, kanye neminyaka eyi-1-3 yokuhamba phambili kokusebenza ngeshibilishi.
zu.requirements: Grade 10 nesitifikedi esihambisana naso esemthethweni se-National Steam Certificate. Okungenani ungamuju weminyaka engu-1-3 wokuhlomula ngokomzimba ohambelana nokusebenza ngeshibilishi. Ikhono: Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngemithetho nezindinganiso ngogcinelo oluphansi. Ulwazi ngemithetho nezindinganiso zokuGcina Imisebenzi. Ulwazi ngamathuluzi okulungisa. Ulwazi ngoMthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act. Amakhono: Izindinganiso zabantu. Ikhono lokusebenzisa amathuluzi okulungisa we-Public Works. Ukucubungula nokuhlela. Ukuqondisa abasebenzi. Ukuxhumana (okubhalwe nokukhulunwayo). Izimpawu: Ukugxila kubantu. Ubuchwepheshe. Ubume obuhlanganyele. Ukuguqulwa. Izimiso ze-Batho Pele. Ukunaka imininingwane. Ukuqotho nobungaziingxungubhalo. Izinga elikhulu lobuqotho.
zu.duties: Celwa amakhemikhali esitolo njengoba kudingeka. Hlola ikhwalithi yamanzi amakhemikhali okuthambisa kanye nokubuyela kwamanzi okucondense. Gcwalisa ithangi lamakhemikhali ngamakhemikhali adingekayo njengoba kumisiwe. Gcwalisa usawoti ethangini le-brine. Hlola izimo zokusebenza zamapampu amakhemikhali. Hlola okuzitholayo ngokuphelele (TDS) futhi uvumele uqedele njengendlela efunwa. Qapha ngokuzimisela ingcindezi yeshibilishi. Hlola ukuthi inqwaba yamathangi amasha inobujinja obufanele. Lungisa isitobhi ukuze kusetshenziswe ngokushesha kweshibilishi. Bika wonke amaphutha ngokushesha. Hlola izinga lamanzi apampini kanye namathangi amasha ukubona ukuthi kunamanzi afele ukudlulisela kushibilishi. Qinisekisa ukuthi amashibilishi abulalelo kanye nokuqhubekela phambili azele amanzi kanye namakhemikhali sonke isikhathi. Lawula ukuhamba kwamafutha. Qinisekisa ukuthi indawo yeshibilishi igcinwe kahle. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okufanele kwengubo yokuvikela. Qinisekisa ukuthi indawo yeshibilishi ihlanzekile futhi ikhuselekile. Qinisekisa ukuthi ithangi le-brine kanye nesihluzi samanzi sihlanzwa njengoba kumisiwe. Qinisekisa ukususwa kwamalahle kumashibilishi, kusibambile sokuphuka nokubhema kanye nesibhokisi sokubhema. Bhala wonke amarekhodi njengokuqinisekiswa encwadini yokubhaliswa. Yenza imisebenzi yokulawula. Yamukela futhi usayine ukulethwa kwamalahle. Hola imibiko yesikhathi. Ukulungiswa kwesikhathi noma ukusebenza ngaphezulu. Yenza eminye imisebenzi ebandakanyekayo.

xh.title: Umsebenzi woMatshini wokuQhuqha (Boiler Operator)
xh.summary: Kufuneka umsebenzi woMatshini wokuQhuqha (Boiler Operator) e Weskoppies Facility Maintenance Hub e Tshwane, kufuneka abe nakla Grade 10, National Steam Certificate, kunye namava eminyaka yoku-1-3 ekusebenzeni kumatshini wokuqhuqha.
xh.requirements: Grade 10 kunye ne National Steam Certificate eqeqeshiweyo efanayo. Ubuncinane bamava afanelekileyo angange 1-3 eminyaka obufumene ekusebenzeni ngezandla ekusebenziseni kwamatshini wokuqhuqha. Iikhompitensi: Ulwazi olusisiseko lwezindinganiso namagunya ngoxinzelelo olusezantsi. Ulwazi ngezindinganiso namagunya eMisebenzi yoKulungisa. Ulwazi ngezixhobo zokulungisa. Ulwazi ngeNtshontsho yoMhlaza kunye noKhuseleko (Occupational Health and Safety Act). Amakhono: Unxibelelwano lokunyanya. Isakhono sokusebenzisa izixhobo zokulungisa zeZentlalo (Public Works). Ukuqamba iqhinga nokuqamba. Ulawulo labasebenzi. Unxibelelwano (elibhalwayo noluthethwayo). Iimpawu: Ukujolisa kwabantu. Ubugcisa bokusebenza. Inxaxheba edibana nenxaxheba. Utshintsho. Iingcali zeBatho Pele (Batho Pele Principles). Ukuqwalasela iinkcukacha. Inyaniso nokuqiniseka. Iingcamango ezomeleleyo.
xh.duties: Celisa iikhemikhali kwisitolo njengoko kufuneka. Vavanya umgangatho wamanzi obugcisa bhetha kunye ne-flow ebuyela emva ezingamanzi. Gcwalisa itankhi yeekhemikhali ngeekhemikhali ezifunekayo njengoko kuchaziwe. Yongeza ushixe kwitankhi yobhedu. Khangela iimeko zokusebenza zeepampu zeekhemikhali. Vavanya amanzi aphilayo ayizi-solid (TDS) aze aqhushuke ngokumiselwa kwemigaqo. Qaphela uxinzelelo lomlambo ngokuqhubeka Khangela ubushushu obuchanekileyo beetankhi ezishushu. Lungisa isitokhela ukuze kuqhubeke ngokuchanekileyo ukunika isixhuqa. Mela zonke iimpazamo ngekokukhawuleza. Khangela amanqanaba eepampu zamaza kunye neetanki ezishushu ukuvakalisha amanzi alinganeyo kumatshini wokuqhuqha. Qinisekisa ukuba amatshini wokuqhuqha alindeleyo nepaipu zigcwele amazi ngeekhemikhali yonke imihla. Lawula ukutheleka kwamafutha. Qinisekisa ukuba indawo yomatshini wokuqhuqwa igcinwe kakuhle. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa okufanelekileyo kwezinxibo zokhuseleko. Qinisekisa ukuba indawo yomatshini wokuqhuqha ihlanzekile yaye ikhuselekile. Qinisekisa ukuba itankhi yobhedu nomsandi wehlabathi buhlanjwe njengoko kuchaziwe. Qinisekisa ukususwa kweFalabhacha kwamatshini wokuqhuqha, kwisibambi soyilo nokwibhokisi yethusi. Bhala zonke izalathiso njengoko kuqwalaselwa kwincwadi yokubhala. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo. Yamkela usayine ukulungiselelwa ukulethwa kwamalahle. Nikela ngenkcazelo yeshiphthi. Ukulungiselelwa kobhalisiweyo beshiphthi/ixesha elongeziweyo. Yenza eminye imisebenzi ehlotshanayo.

Direct and lead the implementation of the approved Departmental three-year risk-based audit plans. Manage and ensure that audits are conducted in accordance with GAS audit methodology, IIA Standards and best practice. Manage stakeholder engagement and reporting. Manage Resources; Maintenance of discipline. Management of performance and development of staff. Undertake Human Resource and other related administrative functions including recruitment process. Establish, implement, and maintain efficient and effective communication arrangements. • Develop and manage the operational plan of the unit and report on progress as required. Implement, and maintain processes to ensure proper control of work. Compile and submit all required administrative reports. Procurement and asset management. Plan and allocate work. Perform strategic and operational planning. Oversee the administrative support functions. Perform people management functions. Perform financial management functions. Manage the implementation of GAS Risk Management Mitigation Plan.

af.title: Direkteur: Risiko- en Nakomingsouditdienste
af.summary: Direkteurspos wat risiko- en nakomingsouditdienste vir Gauteng Provincial Treasury lei, wat 'n NQF level 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se bestuurlike interne ouditervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Driejaar-tertiale kwalifikasie (NQF level 7) in Interne Ooudit / Rekeningkunde of 'n vierjaar-B-Tech-graad met hoofvakke in Rekeningkunde en Oudit. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie en 'n Certified Internal Auditor/Chattered Accountant-akkreditering sal voordelig wees. 5 jaar ervaring op middel-/seniorbestuursvlak in interne oudit. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Public Service SMS Pre-Entry-sertifikaat voor aanstelling ingedien. Kennis van bestuursvermoë, Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations, DPSA Frameworks, PFMA en IIA Standards.
af.duties: Om risiko- en nakomingsoudit vir GPG-afdelings en handelsentiteite te lei en te bestuur. Bestuur en ontwikkel die opstel van die departement se driejaar-risikogebaseerde ouditplanne (minimum van 3 departemente). Rig en lei die implementering van die goedgekeurde departementele driejaar-risikogebaseerde ouditplanne. Bestuur en verseker dat ouditte volgens GAS-ouditmetodologie, IIA Standards en beste praktyk uitgevoer word. Bestuur belanghebbende-betrokkenheid en verslagdoening. Bestuur hulpbronne; Handhaaf van dissipline. Bestuur van prestasie en ontwikkeling van personeel. Onderneem menslike hulpbron- en ander verwante administratiewe funksies, insluitend die werwing proses. Vestig, implementeer en handhaaf doeltreffende en effektiewe kommunikasie-reëlings. • Ontwikkel en bestuur die operasionele plan van die eenheid en doen verslag oor vordering soos vereis. Implementeer en handhaaf prosesse om behoorlike beheer van werk te verseker. Stel alle vereiste administratiewe verslae op en dien dit in. Aankope en batebestuur. Plan en werk toeken. Voer strategiese en operasionele beplanning uit. Hou toesig oor die administratiewe ondersteuningsfunksies. Voer menslikehulpbronbestuursfunksies uit. Voer finansiële bestuursfunksies uit. Bestuur die implementering van die GAS Risk Management Mitigation Plan.

zu.title: Umcondo: Abasebenzi Bohlwayo Lobungozi Nokuqondiswa Kwemithetho
zu.summary: Isikhundla somcondo sokuholisa abasebenzi bohlwayo lobungozi nokuqondiswa kwemithetho kwe-Gauteng Provincial Treasury, sididinga iziqu ze-NQF level 7 nokuba namashumi amahlanu eminyaka yohlelo lokusebenza kobuququmbela kokuhlola kwangaphakathi.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesikhashana zeminyaka emithathu (NQF level 7) kokuHlola Kwangaphakathi / Izimali noma I-digri ye-B-Tech yeminyaka emine ezime ngqo kuZimali nasekuHlolweni. Iziqu zabafundi abathuthukile kanye ne-Certified Internal Auditor/Chartered Accountant kuzoba inhlekelele. 5 yeminyaka yamava ezingeni lomphathi woqobo/ophakeme ekuhloleni kwangaphakathi. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Isitifiketi sokungena ngaphambi kokuqashwa kwa-Public Service SMS. Ukwazi ngamandla okuphatha, uMthetho woMphatha Wezimali zikaZwelonke, Imlandelo weTreasury, Izakhiwo ze-DPSA, i-PFMA kanye namazinga e-IIA.
zu.duties: Ukuhola uphathe ukuhlola kobungozi nokuqondiswa kwemithetho kumayunithi weGPG kanye nokuHweba. Uphathwe kanye nokuthuthukisa ukulungiselelwa kwezinhlelo zokuHlola ezisekelwe kubungozi zeminyaka emithathu zomnyango (okungenani eminyaka engu-3). Qondisa uhole ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokuHlola ezamukelekile ezisekelwe kubungozi zeminyaka emithathu zomnyango. Phatha uqiniseke ukuthi ukuhlola kwenziwa ngendlela ye-GAS audit methodology, amazinga e-IIA kanye nokwenza okuhle. Phatha ukuxhumana nabaphathi bokuqashwa kanye nokubika. Phatha izinsiza; ukugcina inkuliso. Ukuphatha ukusebenza kahle kanye nokuthuthukisa abasebenzi. Yenza imisebenzi yezinsizakalo ezihlotshaniswe neHuman Resource kanye neminye imisebenzi yabasemgodini ehlanganisa inqubo yokuyalela. Misela, setshenzise, kanye nogcina izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenza kahle. • Thuthukisa uphathwe ihlelo lokusebenza lomyunithi ubike inqubekela phambili njengoba kudingwa. Setshenzisa, kanye nogcina izinqubo ukuqinisekisa ulawulo oluhle lwomsebenzi. Hlanganisa uhlole yonke imibiko yobasemgodini edingekayo. Ukuthenga kanye nokuphatha impahla. Hlela abeze imisebenzi. Yenza ukuhlela okubalulekile kanye nokuHlela kokusebenza. Qapha imisebenzi yokuNikela ngokwabasemgodini. Yenza imisebenzi yokuphatha abantu. Yenza imisebenzi yokuphatha izimali. Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwe-GAS Risk Management Mitigation Plan.

xh.title: Director: Risk and Compliance Audit Services
xh.summary: Isithuba sika-Director sikhokela iinkonzo zokuhlola iingozi nokuzithoba ze-Gauteng Provincial Treasury, sifuna i-NQF level 7 qualification kunye neminyaka emihlanu yamava okuba ngumlawuli kwi-internal audit.
xh.requirements: Isifikuldho setatu le tertiary (NQF level 7) kwi-Internal Auditing / Accounting okanye i-Four-Year B- Tech Degree nezihloko ku-Accounting and Auditing. Isifikuldho sokulandela i-post graduate kunye ne-Certified Internal Auditor/Chattered Accountant kuba yinzuzo. I-5 years yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi eliphezulu/ eliphezulu le manger kwi-Internal audit. I-driver’s license esebenzayo. Isatifikethi se-Public Service SMS Pre-Entry sifakelwa phambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Ulwazi ngokuba ngumniki we-Management Ability, i-Public Finance Management Act, i-Treasury Regulations, i-DPSA Frameworks, i-PFMA kunye ne-IIA Standards.
xh.duties: Ukuqamba kunye nokulawula ukuhlolwa kwezingozi kunye nokuzithoba kwamasebe e-GPG kunye noko kuqhuba kweentities ezithengisa. Ukulawula kunye nokuphucula ukulungiselelwa kweeplani zakuhlolwa kwezingozi kwiminyaka emithathu yasebe (ngokoze ngaphantsi kwee-Departments ezintathu). Ukululeka kunye nokuziba ukuqaliswa kweeplani ezivunyiweyo zakuhlolwa kwezingozi kwiminyaka emithathu zasebe. Ukulawula kunye nokwenza isiqinisekiso sokuba ukuhlolwa kwenziwa ngokwendlela ye-GAS audit methodology, i-IIA Standards, kunye nemigaqo egqithisayo. Ukulawula ukubambana nabathathi-nxaxheba kunye nokubika. Ukulawula izixhobo; ukugcina inqubo yolwemingqangatho. Ukulawula ukwenza nokuphucula abasebenzi. Ukwenza imiseben ye-Zabantu kunye namanye amasebe olu lawulo abangenelayo ebandakanya inkqubo yokubungenisa abasebenzi. Ukuseka, ukuqalisa, kunye nokugcina izixhobo zokunxibelelanana ezisebenze kakuhle kwaye zichane. • Ukuphucula kunye nokulawula iplani yokuqhuba yeqela kwaye ubike ngemigaqo efunekayo. Ukuqalisa, nokugcina iinkqubo ukuqinisekisa ulawulo oluchanileyo lwemisebenzi. Ukuqamba kunye nokubika ngenani lamabali e lawulo afunekayo. Ukuthenga nokulawula izinto. Ukrwelelisa kwaye uabelane ngomsebenzi. Ukwenza ukrweleliso lokuziba kunye nokuqhuba. Ukulawula imiseben ye- lawulo encedisayo. Ukwenza imisebenki yabantu. Ukwenza imisebenki ye zemali. Ukulawula ukuqaliswa kwe-GAS Risk Management Mitigation Plan.

jobs.title: Director: Transversal Risk Management
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum, (all-inclusive package), consists of 70% Basic salary and 30% flexible portion that may be structured in terms of the applicable rules.
jobs.summary: Director position in Gauteng Provincial Treasury responsible for managing transversal risk management across departments and municipalities, requiring NQF 7 qualification and 5 years senior management experience.
jobs.requirements: A three-year tertiary qualification (NQF Level 7) in Risk Management/ Auditing or Finance. 5 years’ experience in middle / senior management level in Risk Management. Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programme must be submitted prior to appointment. Valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: To manage, promote and enforce Provincial Risk Management Services in Departments and delegated Municipalities. Manage the development of Provincial Norms and Standards. Provide technical guidance and capacity building to Departments and Municipalities. Monitor, evaluate and report on Risk Management implementation in Departments and Municipalities. Manage and communicate Audit findings. Manage the development and review of a Provincial Risk Register. Management of the Directorate.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. B. Mtshizana at 060 387 4862
jobs.applications: Applications should be submitted online at: https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za
jobs.notes: The position is earmarked to address employment equity in terms of female and youth representation at Senior Management level. OTHER POSTS Applications should be submitted online and must be accompanied by a recently updated CV specifying all experience indicating the respective dates (MM/YY) as well as indicating three reference persons with the following information: name and contact number(s), email address and an indication of the capacity in which the reference is known to the candidate. Pre-entry SMS certificate is compulsory for SMS appointments. To access the SMS pre-entry certificate course and for further details, please click on the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/.           For more information regarding the course please visit the NSG website: www.thensg.gov.za Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents on or before the interview date following communication from HR. Suitable candidates will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks (criminal record, citizen, credit record checks, qualification, and employment verification). Confirmation of final appointment will be subject to a positive security clearance. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. The persons appointed to this position will be subjected to a security clearance. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise, and the other will be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Gauteng Provincial Treasury (GPT) reserves the right to utilise practical exercises / tests for non-SMS positions and during the recruitment process (candidates who are shortlisted will be informed accordingly) to determine the suitability of candidates for the post(s). GPT also reserves the right to cancel the filling / not to fill a vacancy that was advertised during any stage of the recruitment process. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Transversal Risk Management
af.summary: Direkteurspos in Gauteng Provincial Treasury verantwoordelik vir die bestuur van dwarsrygende risikobestuur oor departemente en munisipaliteite, wat 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie en 5 jaar se senior bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Driejaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (NQF Level 7) in Risk Management/ Auditing of Finance. 5 jaar se ervaring op middle / senior management vlak in Risk Management. Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programme moet voor aanbieding ingedien word. Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Om Proviniale Risikobestuur Dienste in Departemente en gedelegeerde Munisipaliteite te bestuur, te bevorder en af te dwing. Bestuur die ontwikkeling van Provinsiale Norme en Standaarde. Verskaf tegniese leiding en kapasiteitsbou aan Departemente en Munisipaliteite. Moniteer, evalueer en rapporteer oor die implementering van Risikobestuur in Departemente en Munisipaliteite. Bestuur en kommunikeer Ouditbevindings. Bestuur die ontwikkeling en hersiening van 'n Provinsiale Risikoregister. Bestuur van die Direktoraat.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ukuphathwa Kokuphela Kobungozi
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi ku Gauteng Provincial Treasury esibhekene nokuphathwa kokuphela kobungozi kulo wonke amanymango nemisasipala, sidinga izifundo ze-NQF 7 nokuhlongakhele iminyaka engu-5 kubaphathi abaphezulu.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezingathathi isikhathi esingaphansi konyaka othathu ezingeni eliphezulu (NQF Level 7) kwi-Risk Management/Auditing noma i-Finance. Ukuhlongakhele iminyaka engu-5 ezingeni lokuphatha eliphakathi/eliphezulu kwi-Risk Management. Isifundo sokungena ngaphambi kokwethulwa ku-Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programme kumele sinikezelwe ngaphambi kokwethulwa. Ilayisense yokushayela okuvunyelwe.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha, ukukhuthaza kanye nokuphoqa Izinsiza Zokuphathwa Kokuphela Kobungozi Esiyingini kumanymango nemisasipali okunikeziwe igunya. Ukuphatha ukuthuthukiswa kwezindinganiso nezenzo ezimiselwe esiyingini. Ukunikeza isiqondiso sobuchwepheshe kanye nokwakha amandla kumanymango nemisasipali. Ukubuka, ukuhlola kanye nokubika ngokuphathwa kokuphela kobungozi kumanymango nemisasipali. Ukuphatha kanye nokuxoxa ngemiphumela ye-Audit. Ukuphatha ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokubuyekeza Isibalo Sokuphela Kobungozi Esiyingini. Ukuphathwa kwebhodi yokuphatha.

xh.title: Umongameli: Ulawulo lweengozi ezihamba phambili
xh.summary: Isithuba somongameli kwi-Gauteng Provincial Treasury esibhekene nokulawula ulawulo lweengozi ezihamba phambili kumasebe nakumanxilume, sifuna izifundo ze-NQF 7 namava eminyaka eli-5 ekulawuleni abaphezulu.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezingamashumi amathathu ezinyanga zenyanga (i-NQF Level 7) kwi-Risk Management/ Auditing okanye i-Finance. Iminyaka eli-5 yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi / eliphezulu lolawulo kwi-Risk Management. I-Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programme kufuneka inikwe ngaphambi kokwenzelwa isithuba. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Ukulawula, ukukhuthaza nokuyalela iinkonzo zoLawulo lweengozi ezinga lePhondo kumasebe namanxilume aphiwe igunya. Ukulawula ukuphuhliswa kweziMigaqo neMilinganiselo yasePhondweni. Ukunika inkqubela malunga nobuchwepheshe nokwakha amandla kumasebe namanxilume. Ukujonga, ukuhlola nokubika ngokuqatywa kolawulo lweengozi kumasebe namanxilume. Ukulawula nokwazisa iziphumo zoKuhlola. Ukulawula ukuphuhliswa nokuphonononga i-Provincial Risk Register. Ukulawula iNdima yoMongameli.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Rekenkundige Ondersteuning
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur: Rekenkundige Ondersteuning by Provincial Treasury in Johannesburg, wat 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie in Finansiële Rekenkunde en 3-5 jaar juniorbestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Driejaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 7) in Finansiële Rekenkunde as hoofvak. 3-5 jaar junior bestuursvlak (ASD) ervaring in 'n rekenkundige omgewing.
af.duties: Om rekenkundige diensondersteuning te verskaf. Faciliteer en ondersteun departemente en entiteite met die implementering van rekenkundige beleide om aan minimum vereistes te voldoen. Bestuur die verskaffing van tegniese bystand ten opsigte van rekenkundige ondersteuning met betrekking tot beste praktyke. Faciliteer en koördineer opleiding aangaande rekenkundige standaarde en opstel van finansiële state. Bestuur die komponent.

zu.summary: Usomlungisi: Ukwesekwa Kwezobalomani e Provincial Treasury e Johannesburg, edinga izifundo ze-NQF 7 kwezezimali kanye neminyaka eyi-3-5 yamava ebungeni lobuholo obuncane.
zu.requirements: Izifundo eziphezulu ezithatha iminyaka emithathu (izinga le-NQF 7) kwezezimali njengenkalo eyinhloko. Imava eminyakeni engu-3-5 ebungeni lobuholo obuncane (ASD) emkhankathweni wezobalomali.
zu.duties: Ukunikeza ukwesekwa kwenkonzo yezobalomali. Ukukhuthaza futhi ukusekela iminyango nemitimba ngokuqaliswa kwezinqubomgomo zezobalomali ukuze kuhambisane nezidingo eziphansi kakhulu. Ukuphatha ukunikezwa kosizo lwobuchwepheshe ngokwesekwa kwezobalomali mayelana nezindlela ezihamba kahle kakhulu. Ukukhuthaza futhi ukuhlanganisa ukuqeqeshwa mayelana namazinga ezobalomali nokuhlelwa kwamafayela wezezimali. Ukuphatha ingxenye.

xh.title: Isekela Mongamzi: Inkxaso yeBuku
xh.summary: Isekela Mongamzi: Inkxaso yeBuku kwi-Provincial Treasury eJohannesburg, kufuneka kube khona izifundo ze-NQF 7 kwi-Financial Accounting kunye neminyaka engama-3-5 yamava enkulumbuso ejunior.
xh.requirements: Isifundo sesithathu seminyaka kwiyunivesithi (inqanaba le-NQF 7) kwi-Financial Accounting njengesifundo esibalulekileyo. Iimvela zeminyaka engama-3-5 kwinqanaba loLawulo ejunior (ASD) kwindawo yobukhulpiso.
xh.duties: Ukuze kubonezelwe inkxaso yesevisi yobukhulpiso. Ukwenza lula kwaye kuxhaswe amasebe kunye nabaqeshi ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo zokubhala iibhuku ukuze bahambelane neemfuno ezincinci. Ukulawula ukunikwa lwenkxaso yobuchwephesha ngokubhekisele kwinkxaso yobukhulpiso malunga namasiko amagqibeleyo. Ukwenza lula kwaye kuqhutywe uqeqesho malunga namagqibo wobukhulpiso nokulungelelaniswa kwezitatimende zemali. Ukulawula le component.

af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur: Strategiese Sourcing by Provincial Treasury in Johannesburg, wat verkryging en BBBEE-besteding vir Gauteng Provincial Government bestuur.

zu.duties: Ukuphatha izinsiza zokutholwa kwemithombo ephathekayo ngokuhlelo kahulumeni wesiFundazwe sase Gauteng. Qaphela ukwandiswa kokusebenzisa imali ye BBBEE ekuthengweni okunqanyuliwe kusuka ku-60% kuya ku-70%. Qaphela ukulandelwa kweNkathi yokusebenza ngokufeza ukusebenzisa imali yokubhalisa ngama- 98%. jobs.title: Deputy Director: Public Private Partnership (PPP)
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum, (all-inclusive package), consists of 70% Basic salary and 30% flexible portion that may be structured in terms of the applicable rules.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director needed at Gauteng Provincial Treasury to manage and monitor Public Private Partnership infrastructure projects in Johannesburg.
jobs.requirements: A three-year tertiary qualification (NQF Level 7) in Finance/ Commerce/ Economics/ Built Environment/ Law/ Public Management. 3 – 5 years’ experience at Junior Management level in PPP’s/ Infrastructure/ Law/Commerce/Project Management. Knowledge of the Constitutional, legal and institutional arrangements governing South Africa.
jobs.duties: To manage the implementation of Municipal and Provincial Public Private Partnerships (PPP) infrastructure projects. Monitor compliance with relevant regulations governing Public Private Partnership (PPP)'s. Provide technical support and advice for PPP Infrastructure projects. Analyse restructuring projects and feasibility studies for non-core functional services. Facilitate the implementation of PPP infrastructure projects. Ukubonelela nokulawula ulandelelwano lokubeka iliso kwiingxaki ezimalunga nolawulo lwezito ezikumasipala kunye nokunikela ngengcebiso, isikhokelo nokubonelela ngezenzo zokulungisa apho kufunekayo kuquka ukulawula izinto ezigcinwayo. af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Public Finance Management ACT (PFMA)
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur-pos in Johannesburg by die Provincial Treasury wat PFMA-nakoming moniteer en daaroor verslag doen, wat 'n NQF-vlak 7-kwalifikasie in Ouditering, Rekeningkunde, Nakoming of Risikobestuur en 3-5 jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Driejaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (NQF-vlak 7) in Ouditering/ Rekeningkunde/ Nakoming of Risikobestuur. 'n Nagraadse Diploma in Nakoming sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 3–5 jaar se ervaring in die Rekeningkunde-/ Risikobestuur-/ Nakomings- en/of Ouditeringsomgewing op 'n administratiewe funksionele vlak. Agetoonde vermoë om bestuursraamwerke toe te pas, wetgewing te interpreteer, en organisatoriese te ondersteun. Kennis van die PFMA, Tesourie Regulasies en tersaaklike wetgewing.
af.duties: Om nakoming van die bepalings van die PFMA en Tesourie Regulasies binne GPG-departemente te monitor, te evalueer en daaroor verslag te doen. Rigting gee vir die ontwikkeling van 'n nakomingsheelal en die kategorisering van wette daarbinnne vir die GPG-departemente. Bystand verleen met die hersiening en finalisering van Nakomingsrisikobestuurplanne (CRMP). Bystand verleen met die implementering van CRMP-aksieplanne wat gemonitor en opgespoor word. Bystand verleen met die opsporing en monitering van die implementering van Nakomingsrisikobestuur-aksieplanne en die AGSA-ouditaanbevelings vir GPG-departemente. PFMA-versoeke koördineer deur advies te verskaf aan die Hoof van Departement deur middel van 'n formele brief. Opleiding aan GPG-departemente verskaf soos versoek of soos deur die eenheid geïdentifiseer: Bestuur van die eenheid.

zu.title: Umđirektosi Osiza: I-Public Finance Management ACT (PFMA)
zu.summary: Isikhundla somđirektosi osiza eJohannesburg e Provincial Treasury sokugadia nokubika ngokuqondere emthethweni i-PFMA, sifuna iziqu ezinga le-NQF level 7 e-Auditing, Accounting, Compliance noma Risk Management, kanye neminyaka yemisebenzi eyi-3-5.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesikole samabanga athathu (NQF level 7) ku-Auditing/ Accounting/ Compliance noma Risk Management. I-Postgraduate Diploma ku-Physics izoba yinzuzo enkulu. Okuhlangenwe nakho okungeminyaka eyi-3–5 kumongo we-Accounting/ Risk Management/ Compliance, noma i-Auditing ezingeni lomsebenzi wokuphatha. Ikhono elibonakalayo lokusebenzisa izakhiwo zokubusa, ukuhlola umthetho, kanye nokweseka inhlangano. Ukuqonda i-PFMA, i-Treasury Regulations nemithetho ehlobene nayo.
zu.duties: Ukugadia, ukuhlola futhi ubike ngokuqondere nemithetho ye-PFMA ne-Treasury Regulations kumaphoyinti aGPG Departments. Ukunika inkundla yokuqonda ekwakhiweni kwendawo yokuziphendulela nasekuhlukaniseni izenzo ngaphakathi kwayo uma kuziwa kumaphoyinti aGPG departments. Ukusiza ekubukeni futhi kuphothulwe amaphulani boKulawula Iingozi Zokuziphendulela (CRMP). Ukusiza ekusebenziseni amaphulani okwenza i-CRMP agadiwe futhi alandelwe. Ukusiza ekulandeleni nasekugadieni ukusetshenziswa kwamaphulani boKwenza Ingozi Zokuziphendulela, nezincomo ze-AGSA Audit zamaphoyinti aGPG Departments. Ukulungiselela izicelo ze-PFMA ngokunika inxutsheliyo kumuntu ophethe i-Department ngesebe lesiqu. Ukunika uqeqesho lamaphoyinti aGPG Departments njengoko kwencelwe noma njengokuqonyiwe ukuphothula iphoyinti: Ukuphatha iphoyinti.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNkululekazigqibo: uMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente (PFMA)
xh.summary: Indima kaMncedisi weNkululekazigqibo kwiTreasury yephondo eJohannesburg egqamisa ngokuzinza ekusebenzeni inxaxheba ngebiko ngokuthobela umthetho wePFMA, ifuna isidanga esingunqanaba leNQF 7 kwizifundo ezinjengeVavvo, iNkqubo yeAkhowunti, ukuZinza okanye uLawulo loMngcipheko namava eminyaka engama3-5.
xh.requirements: Isifundo sezinyanga ezintathu esibangqa (inqanaba leNQF 7) kuVavvo oluchanekileyo / iNkqubo yeAkhowunti / ukuZinza okanye uLawulo loMngcipheko. ISetyenziswa ngemva kwediploma kokuZinza iya kuba lusuzu olwongeziweyo. Ukuba namava eminyaka engama3-5 kwimo yeAkhowunti / uLawulo loMngcipheko / ukuZinza, kwaye okanye ulawulo lokuvavva kwinqanaba lolawulo olusebenzayo. Ikhono eliveziweyo lokusebenzisa iinkqubo zalawulo, ukutolika umthetho, kwaye uncedise iNtshisho. Ukuqonda iPFMA, iziLungelelwaniso zeNqanaba lemali naba bethethwe ngokuchanekileyo umthetho.
xh.duties: Kuqwalaselwa, kuqatywa kwaye kubikwe ngokuqinisekisa ukuthobela izigqibo zoMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente (PFMA) nokuQaliswa kwezoLungelelwaniso zeNqanaba lemali ngaphakathi kweeSebe zeGPG. Kufuneka kubonelelwe isikhokelo ekwakheni indawo yokuzinza kunye nokwahlulahlula izenzo ngaphakathi kwayo kumasebe aGPG. Kuncediswa ekuphononongweni nasekupheliseni iNkqubo yoLawulo loMngcipheko wokuZinza (CRMP). Kuncediswa nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zenyozo zeCRMP ezilawulwa kwaye zilandelelwa. Kuncediswa ekulandeleleni nasekulawulen iinkqubo zokuSebenzisa iiNkqubo zoMngcipheko wokuZinza kunye neengcebiso zokuqatywa kweAGPA kumasebe aGPG. Kulungelelaniswa iicelo zePFMA ngokubonelela ngengcebiso kwiNtloko yeSebe ngeleta esemthethweni. Kubonelelwa isikhokelo kumasebe aGPG njengokoceliwe okanye njengoko kuchongiwe licandelo: uLawulo lothisi.

Om die koördinasie en effektiewe implementering van die MFMA en verwante beleide te fasiliteer en te ondersteun. Om die monitering, ondersteuning en verslagdoening oor die implementering van die MFMA en ondersteunende regulasies te fasiliteer. Bydrae tot en deelname aan belanghebbende-betrokkenheid om MFMA-nakoming te verbeter. Om die koördinasie en monitering van munisipale kapasiteitsbouprogramme te fasiliteer. zu.requirements: Iziqu zethatha iminyaka emithathu ezingeni eliphezulu (NQF level 7) kwi-Accounting/ Financial Management/ Public Finance/ Public Administration/ Economics/ Local Government Finance/ Auditing/ Commerce noma enkabeni ehlobene. 3-5 years’ experience ekulawuleni amasipala, ekulawulenwa kokuhambisana ne-MFMA, ekwakhiweni kwamandla, ekuhlangenweni ngokomxhasi, nakunkcenkceshini yeminikelo kanye/noma endaweni ehlobene.
zu.duties: Ukuqhubisa futhi uxhase ukuhleleka, ukulawula, ukubika kanye nenhlolo yokusetshenziswa kwe-Municipal Finance Management Act. Ukuqhubisa futhi uxhase ukuhleleka nokusetshenziswa okusebenza kahle kwe-MFMA kanye namapholisi ahlobene. Ukuqhubisa ukulawula, ukuxhasa nokubika ukusetshenziswa kwe-MFMA kanye nemithetho elandelwayo elexhasa. Ukufaka isandla nokuthatha inxaxheba ekuzihlanganiseni ngokomxhasi ukuze kuphuse ukuhambisana ne-MFMA. Ukuqhubisa ukuhleleka nokulawula amaphrogremu okwakha amandla amasipala. Ukuqhubisa ukuhleleka kokuphathwa kolwazi, ucwaningo, kanye nokwabelana ngendlela elungile yokwenza izinto.

xh.title: Umsekeli woMlawuli: ukuSetyenziswa kweMfma nokuZinza
xh.summary: Kufuneka uMsekeli woMlawuli e Provincial Treasury e Johannesburg ukuze ahle-hle isetyenziso, uluvo nokwakha amandla koMthetho woLawulo lweMali eMasipaleni, kwaye kufuneka anesidanga se-NQF 7 kunye namava eminyaka engama-3-5.

xh.duties: Ukuqhuba kwaye uxhase ukuhlehla, uluvo, ukuvela ngezigqibo kunye nenhlolwa kwesetyenziso koMthetho woLawulo lweMali eMasipaleni. Ukuqhuba kwaye uxhase ukuhlehla kunye nesetyenziso esisebenzayo se-MFMA kunye nemigaqo eqhotyoshelayo. Ukuqhuba uluvo, ukuxhasa nokubika ngasetyenziso se-MFMA kunye nemithetho evela isixhasa. Nikela kwaye ungene kumanxulumano nabanomdla ukuphucula ukuThobela i-MFMA. Ukuqhuba ukuHlehla noLuvo lweNkqubo zoKwakwa amandla aMasipala. Qhuba ukuHlehla koLawulo lolwazi, uphononongo, kunye nokwabelana ngokwenza okugqibeleleyo.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Finansiële Rekeningkunde
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur: Finansiële Rekeningkunde-pos by Provincial Treasury in Johannesburg wat 'n NQF level 7-kwalifikasie en 3-5 jaar toesigervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Driejaar-tertiêre kwalifikasie (NQF level 7) in Finansiële Rekeningkunde. 3-5 jaar se ervaring in Finansiële Rekeningkunde op toesigvlak. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van Openbare Diensregulasies, Wette, beleide en prosedures. Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) en Tesourie-regulasies.
af.duties: Bestuur die verskaffing van Finansiële Rekeningkundedienste. Inkomste en Kontantbestuur: bestuur die invordering en optekening van inkomste, kassierbestuur, verseker dat die kontant korrek toegeken word, monitering van die kontantboek, bestuur van klein kontant, bestuur van die departement se likiditeitsvereistes. Skuldbestuur; administrasie en skikking van inter-departementele debiteure en krediteure maandeliks, hou toesig oor die identifisering en akkurate optekening van skuld wat aan die departement verskuldig is. Uitgawebestuur: Verseiser tydige betaling van goedere en dienste, hou toesig oor die verifikasie van brondokumente; verskafferverrekening, magtig die betaling van oorpligings en subsidies wat op die rekeningkundige stelsel verwerk is. Verslagdoening; Verslagdoening: hou toesig oor die opstel van die Section 40 PFMA-verslag, tussentydse en jaarlikse finansiële state, skikking van wagrekenings, proefbalans-ontleding; verseker die veiligstelling van alle brondokumente. Skakel met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes oor finansiële bestuursaangeleenthede. Hou toesig oor werknemers om deeglike finansiële bestuursdienste te verseker, verseker dat alle ondergeskiktes opgelei en ontwikkel word om werk van die vereiste standaard doeltreffend en effektief te lewer. Bestuur prestasie, gedrag en dissipline van ondergeskiktes.

zu.title: Umabi weNqola: I-Anthology yamaholo eZimali
zu.summary: Indima kaMsizi woMqondisi: ukubhalisa kwezimali kuwo Umphathi Wezezimali OseNdinganeni e Johannesburg okudinga iziqu ezinga 7 le-NQF kanye namava eminyaka engu-3-5 yokuphatha.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesikhathi esiyisikhathi esithathu emva kwemfundo ephakeme (izinga 7 le-NQF) kokuBhalisa kweZimali. Ukwaziswa kweminyaka engu-3-5 kokuBhalisa kweZimali ngazinga lokuphatha. Ulwazi Nekhono: Ukuqonda koMthetho Wezinsizakolo Zikahulumenti, koMthetho, wezinqubo namapholisi. UMthetho WokuPhathwa KweMali Yomphakathi (i-PFMA) kanye noMthetho WokuQoqwa Kwemali.
zu.duties: Phatha ukunikezwa kwezinsizakalo zokuBhalisa kweZimali. Ukuphathwa kweNzuzo nokuPhehla kweMali: phatha ukuqoqa nokubhaliswa kwenzuzo, ukuphathwa kwabathengisi bemali, qinisekisa ukuthi imali yokuqoqwa ihlotshaniswa kahle, ukugadwa kwencwadi yemali yokuqoqwa, ukuphathwa kwemali encane, nokuphathwa kwezidingo zokuPhehla kwemali komnyango. Ukuphathwa kwezikweletu; ukulawula nokususa okufanele ukwamukelwayo nokuhlawulwayo okungaphakathi kumnyango njalo ngenyanga, lawula ukubona nokubhaliswa ngokunembile kwezikweletu ezibekwe kumnyango. Ukuphathwa kwezindleko: Qinisekisa ukukhokhwa kwesikhathi esifanele kwezimpahla nezinsizakalo, lawula ukuqinisekiswa kwamadokheda omthombo; ukuqondaniswa kwezinkonzo zimbonezelo, gunyaza ukukhokhwa kokudluliswa namarhasipho ahlehlwa esimeni sokubhalisa. Imbiko; Isekelo: lawula ukulungiselelwa kombiko weQoqo 40 wePFMA, izitatimende zezimali zesikhathi esiphakathi kanye nezonyaka, ukususa izikhungo ezibambezele, ukuhlaziya ukubhaliswa kwesilinganiso sokuzama; qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwawo wonke amadokheda omthombo. Xhumana nabanikazi bengxenye yangaphakathi nangaphandle ngendaba zokuphathwa kwezimali. Qapha abasebenzi ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi kunemisebenzi emihle yezinsizakalo zokuphathwa kwezimali, qinisekisa ukuthi bonke abaqaphiwe bafundiswa bakhuliswe ukuze bakwazi ukuletha umsebenzi othile ngokunembile nangempumelelo. Phatha ukusebenza, ukuziphatha nolunyuko kwabangaphansi.

xh.summary: Indima kaMncedisi weenekala: i-Financial Accounting kwi-Provincial Treasury eJohannesburg efunisa isigaba se-NQF level 7 kunye neminyaka engama-3-5 yamava okulawula.
xh.requirements: Iziqu zesikolo samabanga aphakamileyo ezithatha iminyaka emithathu (NQF level 7) kwi-Financial Accounting. Iiminyaka engama-3-5 yamava kwi-Financial Accounting kwinqanaba lokulawula. Ulwazi namakhono: Ukuqonda kwiZiko laBahluleli beeNkonzo zoLuntu, iiMthetho, iindululo neenkqubo. UMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoLuntu (PFMA) nelawulo leTreasury.
xh.duties: Lawula ukunikezwa kweenkonzo ze-Financial Accounting. Ukulawula iNgeniso nokuLawula iMali: lawula ukuqokelelwa nokubhalwa kwengeniso, ulawulo lwabagcini bemali, qinisekisa ukuba imali igcotywe ngokuchanekileyo, ukuphawula incwadi yemali, ulawulo lwemali encinane, ukulawula iimfuno zokuzinza kwesebe. Ukulawula intlnganiso; ukulawula nokuqhwesula iimali ezingenayo nziphumayo phakathi kweesebe nyanga yonke, qikelela ukuchonga nokubhalwa ngokuchanekileyo kwentlnganiso efunwa nguesebe. Ukuxoxisana nabantu abahlobene ngaphakathi nangaphandle mayelana nokuhlaziya ibhalansi yokuzivivinya (TB), ukuqapha izimali ezichithekile kanye nokubuka uluhlu lwe-AFS/IFS. af.title: Senior Administrasiebeampte Ouditeur: Prestasie-oudit
af.summary: Senior Administrasiebeampte in Prestasie-oudit by Gauteng Provincial Treasury in Johannesburg, wat 'n NQF level 6-kwalifikasie en 2-3 jaar ouditeringservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Driejaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (NQF level 6) in Ouditering/ Rekeningkunde/ Finansiële Bestuur. 2 – 3 jaar se ervaring in 'n Prestasie-oudit-omgewing, Bestuurderslisensie. zu.summary: Umphathi Ohlezi Wezomlawulo Kokuhlolwa Kokusebenza e Gauteng Provincial Treasury e Johannesburg, ofuna iziqu ze NQF level 6 nokuthi ube neminyaka eyi-2-3 yohlelo lokuhlola.

Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekwakheni uhlelo lokuhlola ngonyaka wonke ngokubonisana nabalingisi abathatha ingqikithi yengozi. Lakumba izinhlelo ezinemininingwana zokuhlolwa, okuhlanganisa inhloso, obala, indlela, nokwabiwa kwemithombo.usize ekutholeni izingozi ezibalulekile, izimpawu, izibindi ezingenabulungisi kanye nezindawo ezidinga ukuthuthuka ngaphambi kokuthi kuqale ukuhlola. af.summary: Administratiewe beampte benodig om sekuriteitsdienste te koördineer, CCTV-stelsels te monitor en toegangskontrole binne die Provincial Treasury in Johannesburg te bestuur.

Onderhoud en administrasie van toegangskontrolerstelsel; Implementeer en herstel kaartlesers en biometriese lesers, skep toegang vir nuwe werknemers en reik ID-kaarte uit (neem foto's), Skakel met IT-eenheid en HR (Nuwe aanstellings en bedankings), Verskaf toerusting-uitgawepasse (gekoppel aan toegangskaarte), Onderhou en werk die toegangs- en batesdatabasisse by, handhaaf stelselintegriteit, voorkom ongemagtigde toegang en minimaliseer aftyd. Voer en implementeer risiko- en bedreigingsassesserings uit; Identifiseer sekuriteitsverwante risiko's en bedreigings deur rondloop en inspeksies, Implementeer die bevindings van die bedreigings- en sekuriteitsassessering en oudits, Stel verslae oor sekuriteitskending op en dien by toesighouer in, help met ondersoeke na alle sekuriteitskending/insidente, Skakel met SAPS oor gesteelde GPT-bates en versoek beëdigde verklarings, Ondervra personeellede en verkry verklarings. Help met ondersoek na alle misdade en insidente in die departement; Koördineer die rapportering van verlore/beskadigde IT-toerusting op die Verlore/Beskadigde sjabloon, fasiliteer die aangemelde saakdossiers en skakel met SAPS oor gesteelde GPT-bates en versoek beëdigde verklarings, versamel bewyse (CCTV-beeldmateriaal, verklarings ens.) vir ondersoeke, Ondersoek en bevestig sake en verkry die verklaring van die getuie. Produseer ondersoekverslae met tersaaklike aanbevelings. Koördineer die implementering van personeelveiligheidsdienste. Fasiliteer die implementering van veiligheidsbewustheidsprogramme; Koördineer die verskaffing van MISS-opleiding gefasiliteer deur State Security Agency, Reik veiligheidsvorms uit en verskaf sifting vir beide personeel en diensverskaffers, Indien van veiligheidsvorms by State Security vir verwerking en die behoorlike bewaring daarvan, Liaser veiligheidsresultate in die databasis en kommunikeer die resultate met die 10, werknemers en tersaaklike belanghebbendes, implementeer die herstelmaatreëls waar nodig, help met deursoek (TSCM- Technical Surveillance Counter Measure). by die ligging waar sensitiewe inligting bespreek sal word, Beskerm die sensitiewe en geklassifiseerde inligting soos deur MISS verskaf.

zu.title: Onkosini Wokuphathwa Kwezindaba: Ukuvikeleka
zu.summary: Kudingeka onkosini wokuphathwa kwezindaba ozoqeqesha izinsiza zokuvikeleka, abheke izinhlelo ze-CCTV, aphathe futhi ukulawula ukungena ngaphakathi kwi-Provincial Treasury e-Johannesburg.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesikole samabanga aphakeme iminyaka emithathu (NQF level 6) ku-Public Management/ Administration. 1 - 2 unyaka wemithondo yokusebenza endaweni yezinsiza zokuvikela nziphephile. Okuyisisekelo okumayelana ne-OHS, amakhono okuphenya, amakhamera e-CCTV, ukudalwa kwamakhadi okungena/ukungena ngesibonakaliso somzimba. Ukwazi nge-Public Service Act kanye nemithetho. Ukukhonza abathathi-zixazululi. I-C MISS Document kanye nokwazi nge-Safety and Security Act.
zu.duties: Ukuqeqesha futhi ukuqale ukwenza izinsiza zokuvikeleka ngaphakathi kwamnyango. Ukuhlinzeka, ukubheka futhi ukwenza ukuphathwa kwezindaba zokuvikeleka okusebenza ngobuchwepheshe nokuphathwa kwe-CCTV ne-Digital video recorder (DVR); Ukubheka amakhamera e-CCTV, Ukukhipha okuqoshiwe kwe-CCTV ngenjongo yokuphenya, Ukubheka ngokuqhubekayo i-CCTV kanye nokuthola izibonakaliso ku-DVR. Ukugcina futhi kuphatwe inhlelo yokulawula ukungena; Ukuqalisa futhi uhlehle abafundi bamakhadi kanye nabafundi ngesibonakaliso somzimba, udale ukungena abasebenzi abasha umdlebe ubanike amakhadi e-ID (ukuthatha izithombe), uxhumane nomnyango we-IT ne-HR (Abasebenzi abasha kanye nalabo abaphuma emsebenzini), Unikele ukudlula kwezinsiza (okuhlobene namakhadi okungena), Ugcinile futhi uvuselele idathibheysi yokungena nezimpahla, ugcinile ukuhamba kwensiza, uvimele ukungena okungemukeleke futhi unciphise isikhathi esingasebenzi. Ukuqamba futhi uqalise ukulinganisa ubungozi nezinsongo; Ukuhlola izingozi kanye nezinsongo eziphathelene nokuvikeleka ngokuhamba ngezinyawo futhi uholo, Ukuqalisa okutholakele ekulinganisweni kwezinsongo nokuvikeleka kanye nokuhlolwa, Ukuqamba imibiko yokuqhunywa kwemithetho yokuvikeleka aye athumele kumqondisi, usize ekuphenyweni kwazo zonke izimo zokuqhunywa kwemithetho/zehlakalo ezinkimbini zokuvikeleka, axhumane ne-SAPS mayelana nezimpahla ze-GPT ezibukwe futhi acela izinkomba ezibhalwe ngaphansi komsolwa, abuze abasebenzi futhi athole izinkulumo. Ukusiza ekuphenyweni kwezono zonke izehloko kanye nezehlakalo emnyangweni; Ukuqeqesha ukubika kwezinsiza ze-IT ezehlulekile/ezonakele kwifomu le-Loss/Damaged, uhlinzeke amafayela ezehlakalo abikwe futhi axhumane ne-SAPS mayelana nezimpahla ze-GPT ezibukwe futhi acela izinkomba ezibhalwe ngaphansi komsolwa, aqoqe izibonakaliso (okuqoshiwe kwe-CCTV, izinkulumo, njll.) ngenjongo yokuphenya, aphenye futhi aqiniseke izehloko futhi athole inkulumo kufakazi. Ukukhiqiza imibiko ephenyiwe enemininluzo emayelana. Ukuqeqesha ukwenziwa kwezinsiza zokuqinisa abasebenzi. Ukuhlinzeka ukwenziwa kohlelo lokwazisa nge-vetting; Ukuqeqesha ukunikwa kwesikhathi sokukhunjulwa nge-MISS esekelwa i-State Security Agency, ukunikeza amafomu e-vetting kanye nokuhlolwa kokubili abasebenzi kanye nabahlinzeki bezinsiza, ukuthumela amafomu avetliwe kwi-State Security ukuzohlinzeka kanye nokugcinwa okuhle, ukufaka imiphumela ye-vetting kudathibheysi futhi axoxe ngemiphumela no-10, abasebenzi namalunga ahlobene, aqalise isenzo sokulungisa lapho kudingeka khona, usize ekuweni ukuhlola (I-TSCM-Technical Surveillance Counter Measure). endaweni lapho izinkomba ezizwilayo kuzobe zixoxwa khona, azivikele izinkomba ezizwilayo nezifihliwe njengoba kuqinisiswa i-MISS.

xh.title: Ofisi Wolawulo: Ukhuseleko
xh.summary: Kufuneka ofisi wolawulo ukulungisa iinkonzo zokhuseleko, ukujongisa iinkqubo ze-CCTV, noku lawula ulawulo lokungena ngaphakathi kwiprovinshi yeqhina kwiTreasury yephondo eJohannesburg.
xh.requirements: Isifundo seyunivesithi esithathu iminyaka (inqanaba 6 le-NQF) kwiLawulo Loriwole / Ulawulo. 1 - 2 unyaka bomgxama kwimeko yezenkonzo zokhuseleko. Ulwazi olusisiyelo nge-OHS, amakhono ephondo-phondo, iinkamera ze-CCTV, ukwenziwa kweekhadi zokungena / ukungena ngokobhalo lomzimba. Ulwazi ngoMthetho weeNkonzo zoLuntu nemigaqo. Iinkonzo zabathengi. uxwebhu lwe-MISS nolwazi ngoMthetho woKhuseleko noNtlamo.
xh.duties: Ukulungisa nokusebenzisa iinkonzo zokhuseleko ngaphakathi kwesebe. Ukukhuthaza, ukujongisa nokunika ulawulo lwenkokhelo yolawulo lobugcisa bobukhuseleko nokhuseleko lwe-CCTV kunye neDigital video recorder (DVR); Ukujongisa iinkamera ze-CCTV, Ukubuyisela i-CCTV footage ngenjongo yophondo-phondo, Ukuqhubekayo ukujongisa i-CCTV nokubuza iimbongo zobungqina kwi-DVR. Ukugcina noku lawula inkqubo yokungena ekulawuleni; Ukusebenzisa nokuyila ngokutsha abafundi bekhadi nabafundi ngokubhalisa ngobuqhwempu, ukweniza ukungena kumsebenzisi abasha nokunika iikhadi ze-ID (ukuthatha iithothombi), Ukuxhumana nenyanga ye-IT kunye ne-HR (Abaqeshwa abasha nokushiya umsebenzi), Ukunika iipasi ezimceliso zempahla (ukuzalanisa ngeekhadi zokungena), Ukugcina ukuhlaziya iidatabheysi zokungena nemithobo, ukuqhubekekisa umzila wenkqubo, ukuthintela ukungena okungagunyazisiweyo nokunciphisa ixesha loku ngase. Ukwenza nokusebenzisa iingqwalasela zeengozi kunye namagosa ezisiko; Ukuchaza iingozi namagosa ezisiko ngokuhamba ngeenyawo nangokuphonononga, Ukusebenzisa iingcamango ezivela kuingqwalasela zamagosa nokhuseleko nokuqwalasela, Ukulungelela iingxelo ngeenkozo zokhuseleko ezidliwayo nokuzinika e-andalashe, ukunceda kuphondo-phondo ngazo zonke iingcaphulo zokhuseleko / iziganeko, ukuxhumana ne-SAPS ngemithobo ye-GPT ngenxa yokutshathiwa nokuba kfuna iinkqubo zesibhengezo, ukucapukela abantu abasebenzayo nokuba nemi yaqatho. Ukunceda kuphondo-phondo ngazo zonke iintleko nangendlela ze sebe; Uku lungisa iinkcukacha ezahlukeneyo zokwaziswa ngemithobo ye-IT ephilisiweyo ekulahlekileyo / eonakeleyo kwitemplithi yokulahleka / uku onakala, ukukhuthaza iitikhithi ze khefu ezibikiweyo nokuxhumana ne SAPS ngemithobo ye GPT ezibiweyo noku ba kumcela iinkqubo zoku qamba, ukugcina i mbongo (i CCTV footage, iinkcazelo okunye) ngenjongo yophondo phondo, ukuphonda phonda kwaye siqinise i khefu kwaye ukufumana i nkcukacha kwi hlobo lokubakho. Ukubakha i ngxelo ebukiweyo ngaphandle nako nge njongo yokubakha i ngxelo ekhoyo. Ukulungelela ukusebenzisa iinkonzo zoku danga abasebenzi. Ukukhuthaza ukusebenzisa iinkqubo zokusika; Uku lungisa iinkonzo ze MISS ukudalwa nguState Security Agency, Uku nika iifomu zokusika nokudalwa kwelungelo elingcali kwabasebenzi nabanikezeli besebenza, Uku nika isiphithiphithi esidliweyo kwi State Security ukuze siqwalaselwe nokugcinwa, Uku faka iziphumo zokusika kwidatabhesi ukuze kuboniswe ke nama 10, abasebenzi nabanomdla, ukusebenzisa ukulungisa apho kuyimfuneko, uku nceda ukuqhwemesa (TSCM- Technical Surveillance Counter Measure). endaweni apho iinkcazelo ezimfihlakeleyo ziza kuxoxwa, Ukugcina iinkcazelo ezimfihlakeleyo nangokwe MISS.

Language skills and the ability to communicate well with people at different levels and from different backgrounds. Good telephone etiquette. Computer literacy. Knowledge of Public Service Act and regulations.
jobs.duties: To render secretariat support services to the Provincial Supply Chain Management. Provides a secretarial/receptionist support service to the DDG/Chief Director/Director(s): Renders administrative support services. Provides support to managers regarding meetings. Support the manager with the administration of the manager’s budget. Studies the relevant Public, Service and departmental prescripts/policies and other documents and ensure that the application thereof is understood properly.

af.summary: Verskaf sekretariële en administratiewe ondersteuning aan die Hoofdirekteur vir Supply Chain Management by die Provincial Treasury in Johannesburg.
af.requirements: Matric + Sekretariële Diploma of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. 3 – 5 jaar se ervaring in kantoorbestuur of soortgelyke rol. Taalvaardighede en die vermoë om goed met mense op verskillende vlakke en uit verskillende agtergronde te kommunikeer. Goeie telefoonetiket. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Kennis van Public Service Act en regulasies.
af.duties: Verleen sekretariële ondersteuningsdienste aan die Provinciale Supply Chain Management. Verskaf 'n sekretariële/ontvangersondersteuningsdiens aan die DDG/Hoofdirekteur/Direkteur(e). Verleen administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste. Verskaf ondersteuning aan bestuurders rakende vergaderings. Ondersteun die bestuurder met die administrasie van die bestuurder se begroting. Bestudeer die tersaaklike Openbare, Diens- en departementele voorskrifte/beleide en ander dokumente en verseker dat die toepassing daarvan behoorlik verstaan word.

zu.title: Umsizi WoMuntu Siqu Womqondisi Oyinhloko: I-SCM, Usekelo Labathengi
zu.summary: Nika usekelo oluyimfihlo nololuphathwa kakhulu komunye umqondisi ohlela phansi kokuqashwa kwezinsiza e-Provincial Treasury eJohannesburg.
zu.requirements: I-Matric + I-Diploma yokuyimfihlo noma isitifikati esilinganayo. 3 – 5 eminyakeni isipiliyoni ekuqashweni kwehhovisi noma esikhundleni esifanayo. Amakhono olimi nokukwazi ukuxhumana kahle nabantu abakumazinga ahlukene futhi abavela kwezendlalela ezahlukene. Indlela enhle yokuthinta beka etilifonini. Ukusebenzisana kakhulu ngekhompyutha. Ubonelela ngesikhundla sokusekela ekubeni umbhali/omamukela amakholi ku-DDG/Umngeni Oyinhloko/Umngeni: Unika amakhono okusekela ekuqashweni kwezinsiza. Unika abaphathi usekelo ngemihlangano. Usekela umphathi ekuphathweni kwesabelomali somphathi. Uyafunda imithetho ephathelene neMphakathi, Isevisi kanye nemithetho yomnyango/buhikhiwe kweminye imibhalo, aze abe wusizo ukuthi kusobala ukuthi kusetshenziswe njani.

Ulwazi ngoMthetho woMabonakude nemigqaliselo.

af.title: Boodskapper/bestuurder
af.summary: Boodskapper/bestuurder benodig by Gauteng Provincial Treasury in Johannesburg om bestuurs-, aflewings-, pendel- en algemene administratiewe funksies te verskaf.
af.requirements: Graad 12 of gelykwaardige toepaslike kwalifikasie. 1- 2 jaar se ervaring. Geldige bestuurderslisensie asook 'n Professionele Bestuurspermit (PDP). Basiese rekenaarvaardigheid, Kennis van die prosedures om die motorvoertuig te bedryf. Kennis van die voorskrifte vir die korrekte benutting van motorvoertuie. Kennis van die prosedures om te verseker dat die motorvoertuig behoorlik onderhou word, Kennis van die prosedures om boodskapperfunksies uit te voer, Gesonde interpersoonlike vaardighede.

zu.title: Umthumeli/umshayi wesithuthu
zu.summary: Kudingeka umthumeli/umshayi wesithuthu eGauteng Provincial Treasury eJohannesburg ukuze ahanise imisebenzi yokushayela, ukuletha izinto, ukushuttle nemisebenzi ejwayelekile yolawulo.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 noma isitifiketi esifanele esilinganayo. 1- 2 iminyaka yokusebenza. Ilayisense yokuqinisekile yokushayela kanye ne-Professional Driving Permit (PDP). Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngemishini, ulwazi ngemigudu yokuqhuba isithuthu. Ulwazi ngemiyalelo yesimiso sokusebenzisa kahle izithuthu. Ulwazi ngemigudu yokwenza isithuthu sigcinwe kahle, ulwazi ngemigudu yokwenza imisebenzi yomthumeli, amakhono ahle abantu.

Ulwazi lwenkqubookuqinisekisa ukuba imoto igcinwa ngokuchanekileyo, Ulwazi lwenkqubo yokuzezenza imisebenzi yomthumeli, Amandla obudlelwane bomntu nomntu.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 – R1 858 821 per annum, (all-inclusive package). The package includes a basic salary (70% of package), and a flexible portion of 30% that may be structured in terms of applicable rules. Which includes state’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund (13% of basic salary). The successful candidate will be required to enter into a performance agreement within three months after assumption of duty.
jobs.summary: Chief Financial Officer for the Department of Roads and Transport in Johannesburg, requiring a postgraduate finance qualification and five years of senior managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: A post graduate qualification (NQF level 7) Accounting / Financial Management / Management Accounting / Finance/Auditing. 5 years’ experience at a senior managerial level in financial / management / management accounting field. A valid driver’s license. Completion of the Nyukela Senior Management Pre-entry certificate endorsed by National School of Government must be submitted prior to appointment. Knowledge: PFMA and Treasury Regulations, Modified Cash Standard and Public Sector Accounting, Budgeting, Costing, and Financial Modelling, Audit and Compliance Management, Infrastructure Financial Management, Financial Systems (BAS, LOGIS, PERSAL, SCOA , GPDRT and GPG policies and procedures, Relevant public service prescripts, Service Level agreements, DORA, PPPFA, Preferential Procurement Regulations. Skills: Strategic management, Project management methodologies, Business Performance management, Change management, Stakeholder relations, Analytical thinking, Policy formulation, Financial management, Problem solving, Report writing.
jobs.duties: Oversee the strategic financial leadership, innovation and internal control systems. jobs.notes: Applicant must ensure that they complete all sections on the online Z83 and attached a detailed CV with at least three (3) contactable references. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, identity document and driver’s license on or before the day of the interview. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). The National Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. Preference may be given to appointable applicants from the underrepresented designated groups in terms of the Department’s equity plan. Persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply. Correspondence will be limited to successful candidates only. Short-listed candidates will be subjected to screening and security vetting to determine their suitability for employment, including but not limited to: Criminal records; Citizenship status; Credit worthiness; Previous employment (reference checks); and Qualification verification. Short-listed candidates will be expected to avail themselves at the Department’s convenience. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: In terms of the Directive on Compulsory Capacity Development, Mandatory Training Days & Minimum Entry Requirements for SMS that was introduced on 1 April 2015, a requirement for all applicants for SMS posts from 1 April 2020 is a successful completion of the Senior Management PreEntry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG) prior to appointment. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-preentryprogramme.              All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the interview and technical assessment for all SMS posts, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency-based assessments. Persons appointed will be subjected to a security clearance, the signing of performance agreement and employment contract. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment. If you have not been contacted within three 3 months after the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. By submitting the employment application form, you agree and consent in terms of Section 11(1) of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), 2013 (Act 4 of 2013), for your personal information which you provide to the DFFE to being processed by the department and its employees, agents, Cabinet committees, and subcontractors for recruitment purposes, in accordance with the POPIA of 2013. For general enquiries please conduct Human Resources on 010 345 1535. NB: If you do not receive any response within 3 months, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. No faxed, post or hand delivered, and late applications will be considered.

af.title: Onderdirekteur: Kommunikasie en Bemarking

Kennis van Regeringskommunikasiestelsels. Bemarking en Handelsmerk. Mediaverhoudinge en Publieke Verhoudinge. Digitale Kommunikasie en Sosiale Media. Belanghebbende en Publieke Betrokkenheid, Wetgewende en Regulerende Raamwerke, Strategiese Bestuur, Finansiële en Hulpbronbestuur, Navorsing en Kommunikasie-analise.
