Lui kommunikasieplanne in met diensleweringprioriteite, insluitend vlootoptimalisering, kostevermindering, en klinteentevredenheid. Koördineer geïntegreerde veldtogte om g-FleeT-dienste en innovasies te bevorder. Verskaf strategiese kommunikasiesteun, SMT, en die Kantoor van die MEC waar nodig. Hersien en werk strategieë op grond van prestasiedata en terugvoer van belanghebbendes by. Bestuur die ontwikkeling en implementering van handelsmerkbemarkerig in ooreenstemming met Korporatiewe Identiteitsstandaarde: Ontwikkel en handhaaf handelsmerkriglyne vir alle interne en eksterne kommunikasie. Hersien en keur bemarkingsmateriaal goed om nakoming van korporatiewe identiteitsstandaarde te verseker. Bevorder handelsmerk sigbaarheid oor regeringsplatforms en belanghebbende-omgewings. Fasiliteer belanghebbende-bewustheidsessies en uitreikprogramme. Monitor publieke persepsie en reputasiorisiko's en implementeer mitigasiestrategieë. Ontwiksel e-posbemarkings- en interne kommunikasieveldtogte. Bestuur gereelde bywerkings van digitale platforms met relevante en akkurate inligting. Gebruik digitale platforms om klinteensentriese dienste en innovasies te bevorder. Bevorder g-FleeT-dienste om benutting te dryf: bewustheid, en belanghebbende-waarde. Evalueer veldtogdoeltreffendheid en verfyn benaderings dienooreenkomstig. Analiseer veldtogprestasie en verskaf aanbevelings vir verbetering. Benchmark g-FleeT-prestasie teen bedryfs- en openbare sektor beste praktyke. zu.title: Onozinja NoMqondisi: Ixhumo nobuMakethe
zu.summary: Onozinja NoMqondisi: Ixhumo nobuMakethe e-Department of Roads and Transport e-Bedfordview, kudingeka iziqu ze-NQF 7 kanye neminyaka engu-3 kuya ku-5 yohlelo ezingeni lika-Assistant Director.
zu.requirements: Izinga le-NQF 7 kwi-Communications/Marketing. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Iminyaka engu-3 – 5 ezingeni lika-Assistant Director kwi-Communications / Marketing. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi mayelana nezinhlelo zokuxhumana kahulumeni. uMakethe kanye ne-Branding. Ubudlelwanoabezindaba noBudlelwano boRulumende. Ukuxhumana kwerhayisi kanye nabantu emiphakathini. Izinhlelo zomthetho nolawulo, ukuPhathwa okuhlelekile, ukuPhathwa kweMali nezinsiza. ucwaningo kanye nokuHlaziya ukuxhumana.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zomakethe nokuxhumana: Thuthukisa futhi usebenzise iNhlelo yeNgqungquthela yokuMakethe noXhumano ngonyaka ejwayeliswe nemigomo ehlelekile ye-g-FleeT kanye ne-APP. Hambanis izinhlelo zokuxhumana nezinhloko eziphathwa ukulethwa kwezinsiza, okuhlanganisa ukulungiswa kwezimoto, ukunciphisa izindleko, kanye nenjabulo yabathengi. Linganisa amaphulo ahlanganiswe ukuqashelwa kwezinsiza ze-g-FleeT kanye nemithelela. Nikeza ukusekela okuhlelekile ekuxhumaneni, i-SMT, kanye ne-Office of the MEC lapho kudingeka khona. Cabangisisa futhi uhlele izinhlelo ngokusekelwe emininingwaneni yokuqashiya kanye nempendulo yabathintekayo. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kokuqamba igama ngokuvumelana nemigomo ye-Corporate Identity: Thuthukisa futhi uqophe imigomo yokudumba igama lonke ukuxhumana langaphakathi nangaphandle. Cabangisisa futhi vumela izinto zomakethe ukuqinisekisa ukuvumelana nemigomo ye-corporate identity. Khuthaza ukubonakala kwegama kuzo zonke izinkundla kahulumeni nasezindaweni zabathintekayo. Qinisekisa ukubekwa kwendawo kwegama njengento ethembekile nethule imithelela yokuphatwa kwamafulethi. Yenza ukubuyekezwa kwesoqubo wegama njalo ukuze kuqiniseke ukuvumelana. Phatha ubudlelwano nabathintekayo kanye nobudlelwano boRulumende: Thuthukisa futhi usebenzise izinhlelo zokuqondiswa kwabathintekayo ezibhekezela kumimango yabathengi, izikhungo zasendaweni, kanye namanyuvesi. Phatha imisebenzi yobudlelwano boRulumende, okuhlanganisa ukuxhumana nezindaba, izitatimendeabezindaba, kanye nokuxhumana nabathintekayo. Liza imibuzo yabezindaba ngokuvumelana nemigomo yoxhumanomlonyakahulumeni. Liza izesikhathi sokwaziswa kwabathintekayo kanye namaphulo okukhululela emmango. Hlola imibono yomphakathi kanye nobungozi bemisindo futhi usebenzise izinhlelo zokunciphisa. Phatheka ukuthuthukiswa kokumakethe kwerhayisi kanye nokuphathwa kokuqukethwe: Thuthukisa futhi uphathe okokuqukethwe isiza se-intanethi se-g-FleeT kanye nezinkundla zama-dijithali. Sebenzisa izinhlelo zoxhumanongokusuka kulawolwazi ukuze khulise ukuxhumana nokuqashwa. Thuthukisa imiklamo yomakethe nge-imeyili kanye nokuqashiswa kokuxhumana langaphakathi. Phatha ukubuyekezwa njalo kwezinkundla zama-dijithali ngemininingwane eqondile neqinisekile. Sebenzisa izinkundla zama-dijithali ukuze ukhuthaze izinsiza eziqondiswe kumthengi kanye nemithelela. Khuthaza izinsiza ze-g-FleeT ukuze kusetshenziswe ngokwanele: ukuqashwa; kanye nenani elithintekayo. Hlela futhi usebenzise imiklamo yokumakethe ekhululekile ezinsizini zamafulethi kanye nemigomo entsha. Thuthukisa izinto zokumakethe (amaphukufulethi, izibonakudliwa, izibika, izinto zokuqashiswa). Sekele ukuthunjwa kwezinhlelo ezintsha kanye nezinsiza ngesikhathi samaphulo okuxhumana. Linganisa amaphulo angaphakathi ukuphucula ukuqashwa kwabasebenzi nokulinganiselwa. Hlola ukusebenza kolawulwazi bese uhlunga izindlela ngokuvumelana. Hlinzeka ngemicimbi ephumelelayo kanye nezinkundla zokuxhumana ezisekela ubudlelwano nabathintekayo kanye nokuqashwa kwesevisi: Hlela futhi uphathe imicimbi yeNkampani, okuhlanganisa ukuthunjwa, izikhungazabathintekayo, kanye noxholo. Linganisa ukubamba iqhaza kumakhosikazi kahulumeni nembono. Thuthukisa izinkulumo, izibonakudliwa, kanye nezazisezinkulu eziphathamandla. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa ngokusemthethweni kwazo zonke imicimbi ngokuvumelana nokudwebwa kwegama nemigomo ehlelekile. Hlola ukuphumelela komcimbi kanye nempendulo yabathintekayo. Yenza ucwaningo, hola ubuchule futhi ubeke inani ngemininingwane, ukuqonda nokulandelwa kokwenza: Yenza ucwaningo lothile nabathintekayo ukuthola izinto ezintsha namathuba. Hola izinkomba zokusebenza komakethe nokuXhumana (isb, injabulo yomthengi, izinga lokuxhumana). Qoqa izibiko zanyanga zonke, nyanga nganyanga, kanye nezinyanga zonke ngemisebenzi yokuxhumana. Hlaziya ukusebenza kolawulwazi futhi nikeza izincomo zokuthuthukisa. Fanisa ukusebenza kwe-g-FleeT nothile abakwimboni nasekwindlinakahulumeni. Phatha izinsiza: Phatha ukusebenza kwabasebenzi ngamaphulo e-Performance Management and Development System (PMDS). Lungiselela futhi phatha umtholampilo welunga ngokuvumelana nezinhloko zenhlangano nemfuneko ye-PFMA. Lungiselela futhi phatha umtholampilo welunga ngokuvumelana nezinhloko zenhlangano nemfuneko ye-PFMA. Hola ukuchithwa kwemali futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa okuphumelelayo, okulondolozayo, kanye nezinsiza ezisebenzayo. Phatha izinsiza zokuxhumana nakumakethe, izinsiza, kanye nemininingwane evulekile.

xh.title: iSekela Mongameli: IziNxulumano neNkqubo yokuThengisa
xh.summary: iSekela Mongameli: IziNxulumano neNkqubo yokuThengisa kwisebe leeNdlela nezeHuliso e Bedfordview, kufuneka abe nesatifikethi se NQF 7 kunye namava eminyaka 3 ukuya ku 5 kwinqanaba leSekela Mongameli.
xh.requirements: NQF Level 7 kwiZiNxulumano/Inkqubo yokuThengisa. ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni. Iminyaka engama 3 – 5 kwinqanaba leSekela Mongameli kwiZiNxulumano / Inkqubo yokuThengisa. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi ngeeNkqubo zoNxulumano zoRhulumente. Ukuthengisa nokumiswa kweBrandi, uNxulumano neeNkampu zeMidya, noNxulumano loLuntu. UNxulumano namaQela abaThengisi nabantu ngokubanzi, iinjongo zoMthetho nokuLawulwa, uLawulo loQhagalase, uLawulo lweMali neeSiseko zohlazo, kuPondayo nokusishweni koNxulumano.
xh.duties: Phatha uphuhliso lokusebenza kweenkqubo zokuthengisa nezinxulumano: Phuhlisa kwaye usebenzise iNkqubo yonyaka yokuthengisa noNxulumano egqamile kwiinjongo zoQhagalase zika g-FleeT nayo APP. Qwalasela iinkqaba zoxinulumano ngokumisela izinto eziphambili ekuhanulisweni kwesebe, kuquka ukusebenza kakuhle kweefleti, uKunciphisa iindleko, nokwaneliseka koluntu. Hlela iinkampu ezidibanyelweyo ukuqhashela iinkonzo ezintsha zika g-FleeT. Ziba inkxaso emi yoluleko yoxinulumano, kwi SMT, naseBhulweni le MEP xa kuyimfuneko. Phinda ubuyekeze iinkqubo ngokusekelwe kwimigaqo yokusebenza nempendulo yabaqeshi Phatha uphuhliso nokusebenza kweBrandi ngokwemigqango ye Corporate Identity: Phuhlisa kwaye uqinisekise imigaqo yobrandi kuzo zonke iindidi ezahlukileyo zoxinulumano. Buyekeza kwaye uvume izibonelelo zokuthengisa ukuqinisekisa ukuzithoba ngokwemigaqo ye corporate identity. Qhashela ubuso bebrandi kulo wonke amaqhingqo karhulumente nendalo yoxinulumano. Qinisekisa ukuba mihla le brandi njengesiseko esithembekileyo nesoquluba kwinto esiyilawulayo. Qhuba uPhondayo wemihla ngemihla ukujonga ukuzinza. Phatha uNxulumano namaQela neenkampu zoluntu: Phuhlisa kwaye usebenzise iinkqubo zoxinulumano namahlelo abaqeshisi oqondise kumasebe abathengi, kumaspalathi, nakwezinye iindidi. Lawula imisebenzi yokuzibonakalisa koluntu, kuquka uNxulumano neMidya, izindaba zamaphephandaba, noNxulumano namaQeshi. Yenza ikonferensi ngemibuzo yemidya ngokwemigaqo yoNxulumano karhulumente. Qalisa amashishini oNxulumano nabathengi, hlela namanyathelo okusiqa amagqabantshintshi. Qwalasa iimbonakaliso zoluntu neengozi ezinokubakho ekuhleliweni kombono, kwaye usebenzise amacebo okuzithintela okubi. Phucula ukuthengiswa ngokudijithali nokuLawula ngokuBhalwa: Phuhlisa kwaye ulawule okubhaliweyo kwi sayithi ye g-FleeT nakuqwembe lokudijithali: Sebenzisa amacebo oNxulumano ngokubanzi ukwandisa ukuthathyelwa koluntu nabathengisi. Phuhlisa iinkampu zoxinulumano ngemeyile nakwezangaphakathi. Lawula okubhaliweyo kwakho konke okutsha kuyo yonke iinkonzo ngolwazi oluchanekileyo. Sebenzisa amaqhingqo okudijithali ukuqhashela iinkonzo ezingabantu ngokubanzi nezoquluba. Qhashela iinkonzo zika g-FleeT ukwandisa isetyhi, nengqibelelo kwizinto eziphambili: Hlela kwaye usebenzise amacebo okuthengisa ohleliweyo ngeeNkonzo namacebo amatsha. Phuhlisa izibonelelo ezithengiswayo (abrosho, iinkcazelo, iiripoti, izinto ezidala umdla). Zoba inkxaso ekwaziseni iinkqubo ezintsha kwaye usebenzise ngokudityanisa kwe nkampu yokuthengisa. Hlela amacebo angaphakathi ukuqinisekisa ukuba basebenzi bayazi baze balandele amanyathelo. linganisa amandla enkampu, emva koko ulungise amanyathelo ngokufanelekileyo. Zisa iziganeko ezingagqibekanga kakuhle neenkqubo zoxinulumano ezigcinayo kwindalo eqhagamshela nabathengi kwaye idalwe ngokwaneliseka: Cwangcisa kwaye ulawule iziganeko ezahlukeneyo, kuquka amalungiselelo, amaqhingqo abathengi, iindonga zokuqonda. Hlela ukuthabatha inxaxheba koluntu ngenkqubo yorhulumente nethonya. Hlela amagama abakhulumi, iinkcazelo, iingxelo ezingagqibekanga ngokwemigaqo yabaphathi. Qinisekisa ukubakho koluntu nakuzo zonke iziganeko nangokwemigaqo yobrandi. Qwalasa imiphumela yesiganeko nempendulo yoluntu, Qhuba uphando, qwalase, kwaye ulungise iingxelo zokulinganisa imigaqo yokusebenza: Qhuba uphando malunga nokuphuhliswa kwehlabathi ngesiXhosa, ukuqonda uluntu ukuze ufumane okuqonda ngokuthi makube njani na. Qwalasa imilinganisela yamava nokubakho koluntu (umzekelo, ukwaneliseka koluntu, ukuthabatha inxaxheba kuluntu). Hlanganisela, qamba iingxelo zenyanga zesiqu, kunye neyomnyaka wamava, aze abe ngokulungileyo kwesiXhosa ngokuqonda ngokwemigaqo. Hlengahlengisa imiphumela yeenkampu, uze unike iingcebiso zokuyilungisa. Ngokomzekelo, ukuqinisekisa ukuba iiNkonzo zika g-FleeT zikuligqabhazi kwilizwe kunye neyurhulumente ngokubanzi. Lawula iziseko zohlazo: Lawula ukusebenza kbasebenzi ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo zeNkqubo yoLawulo loPhuhliso lokuSebenza (PMDS), Lungiselela kwaye ulawule ingxowa-mali yesebe ngokwemigaqo yomphakathi nakwezinye iindinganiso ze PFMA. Lungiselela kwaye ulawule ingxowa-mali yesebe ngokwemigaqo yomphakathi nakwezinye iindinganiso ze PFMA. Qwalasa iindleko kwaye uqinisekise ukugqitywa kwemisebenzi ngokuchanekileyo, ngokugqithisela kakhulu nengqondiso. Lawula izinto ezidityaniswa nezoxinulumano, ukuthengisa, nolwazi olubalulekileyo olusetyenziswa.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Loss Control and Vehicle Monitoring
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for loss control and vehicle monitoring at the Department of Roads and Transport in Bedfordview, requiring fleet management experience.
jobs.requirements: NQF Level 7 in Transport Management or Logistics, 3-5 years relevant experience in vehicle tracking industry and fleet management environment at supervisory/management (ASD) Level. A Valid driver’s License. Knowledge in Fleet Management Operations Loss Management Monitoring and Compliance Financial Management Investigations and Risk Management Data Analysis and Reporting Stakeholder Management.
jobs.duties: Manage vehicle tracking operations and risks: Develop and implement loss prevention and vehicle security strategy. Monitor fleet movement and identity risk anomalies and unauthorised vehicle usage. Investigate vehicle incidents. Establish and maintain procedures to minimize operational losses. Coordinate with law enforcement when required. Implement training programmes on tracker technology and customer service. Manage theft and recovery processes: Coordinate recovery efforts by external stakeholders e.g. law enforcements agencies and clients. Maintain accurate records of theft incidents recoveries and associated performance matrix. Prepare operational loss control and recovery performance reports. Manage customer support function and technical services delivery: Supervise technical support personnel and field technicians. Maintain strong technical knowledge of telematics and fleet technology. Manage and review technical service contracts and service provider performance. Manage customer escalations and resolve complex operational issues. Manage compliance with service level agreements and contractual obligations. Monitor technical support operations and drive continuous improvement in loss control and fleet visibility: Monitoring of fleet activities and critical alerts. Implement best practices for fleet visibility and operational efficiencies. Manage escalations relating to tracker devices communication failures and monitoring exceptions. Monitor customer support recovery success rates, monitoring efficiency and technical performance. Utilize advance Excel tools to analyse fleet performance to identify trends and management reports for executive decision making. Manage Resources: Manage employee performance. Manage employee personal development plans. Management and Development System (PMDS) processes. Prepare and manage the unit's budget in line with organisational priorities and PFMA requirements. Monitor expenditure and ensure effective, economical, and efficient utilisation of resources.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Verliesbeheer en Voertuigmonitering
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir verliesbeheer en voertuigmonitering by die Departement van Paaie en Vervoer in Bedfordview, wat vlootbestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: NQF-vlak 7 in Vervoerbestuur of Logistiek, 3-5 jaar se relevante ervaring in die voertuigopsporingsbedryf en vlootbestuursomgewing op toesig/bestuursvlak (ASD). 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van Vlootbestuursbedrywighede, Verliesbestuur, Monitering en Nakoming, Finansiële Bestuur, Ondersoeke en Risikobestuur, Data-ontleding en Verslagdoening, Belanghebbendebestuur.
af.duties: Bestuur voertuigopsporingsbedrywighede en risiko's: Ontwikkel en implementeer verliesvoorkoming- en voertuigveiligheidsstrategie. Monitor vlootbeweging en identifiseer risiko-afwykings en ongeoorloofde voertuiggebruik. Ondersoek voertuigvoorvalle. Stel prosedures in stand om operasionele verliesse te minimaliseer. Koördineer met wetstoepassing wanneer nodig. Implementeer opleidingsprogramme oor spoortegnologie en kliëntediens. Bestuur diefstal- en herstelprosesse: Koördineer herstelpogings deur eksterne belanghebbendes bv. wetstoepassingsagentskappe en kliënte. Hou akkurate rekords van diefstalvoorvalle, herstel en gepaardgaande prestasiematrikse. Berei operasionele verliesbeheer- en herstelprestasieverslae voor. Bestuur kliëntondersteuningsfunksie en tegniese dienslewering: Superwise tegniese ondersteuningspersoneel en veldtegnici. Handhaaf sterk tegniese kennis van telematiek en vloottegnologie. Bestuur en hersien tegniese dienskontrakte en diensverskafferprestasie. Bestuur kliënteskalasies en los komplekse operasionele probleme op. Bestuur nakoming van diensvlakooreenkomste en kontraktuele verpligtinge. Monitor tegniese ondersteuningsbedrywighede en dryf deurlopende verbetering in verliesbeheer en vlootsigbaarheid: Monitor vlootaktiwiteite en kritieke waarskuwings. Implementeer beste praktyke vir vlootsigbaarheid en operasionele doeltreffendheid. Bestuur eskalasies met betrekking tot spoortoestelkommunikasiefalings en monitoruitsonderings. Monitor kliëntondersteuning, herstelsukseskoerse, moniteringdoeltreffendheid en tegniese prestasie. Gebruik gevorderde Excel-instrumente om vlootprestasie te analiseer om tendense te identifiseer en bestuursverslae vir uitvoerende besluitneming voor te berei. Bestuur hulpbronne: Bestuur werknemerprestasie. Bestuur werknemer se persoonlike ontwikkelingsplanne. Bestuur prestasiebestuur- en ontwikkelingstelsel (PMDS)-prosesse. Berei die eenheid se begroting voor en bestuur dit in ooreenstemming met organisatoriese prioriteite en PFMA-vereistes. Monitor besteding en verseker doeltreffende, ekonomiese en doeltreffende benutting van hulpbronne.

zu.title: Onkamela Njengabantu: Ukulawula Ukulahlekelwa Nokubuka Izimoto
zu.summary: Isikhundla somOnkamela sokulawula ukulahlekelwa nokubuka izimoto eDepartment of Roads and Transport eBedfordview, sifuna owenziwe umsebenzi wokulawula inqwaba yezimoto.
zu.requirements: NQF Level 7 kuTransport Management noma iLogistics, 3-5 iminyaka yohlelo oluhambisana ngqo nemboni yokulandela izimoto nendawo yokulawula inqwaba kumazinga okuphatha/okulawula (ASD) Level. I-License evumelekile yomshayeli. Ulwazi ngokuSebenza kokuLawula iNqwaba yezimoto, ukuLawula ukuLahlekelwa, ukuBuka nokuhambisana Nemithetho, ukuLawula iMali, ukuPhenya nokuLawula iNgozi, ukuHlaziya iMininingwane nokubika, nokuLawula abahlobene nokuSebenzisana.
zu.duties: Phatha imisebenzi yokulandela izimoto kanye nengozi: sungula futhi usebenzise isu sokuvikela ukulahlekelwa nokuvikela izimoto. Buka ukunyakaza kwenqwaba bese uhloza izingozi ezingajwayelekile kanye nokusetshenziswa izimoto ngokungemthetho. Phenya izenzo ezehla kwezimoto. Sime futhi ulondoloze izindlela zokunciphisa ukulahlekelwa ezimisebenzeni. Hlanganyezela namaphoyisa lapho kudingeka khona. Sebenzisa izinhlela zokuqeqesha ngobuchwepheshe bokulandela izimoto kanye nencekomishi kumthengi. Phatha izinqubo zokweba kanye nokuthola okuwebiwe: hlanganyezela imizamo yokubuyiswa abahlobene ngaphandle isb. amaphoyisa kanye namakhasimonde. Gcina imibhalo eqinisekiswe kahle yezenzo zokweba okubuyisiwe kanye nokuqondiswa kokusebenza okuhlobene nalokho. Lungatha imibiko yokulawula ukulahlekelwa ezimisebenzeni kanye nokusebenza okuhlobene nokubuyiswa. Phatha umsebenzi wokusekela abathengi kanye nokuletha izinsizakalo zobuchwepheshe: Qapha abasebenzi abasekela ubuchwepheshe kanye nabaqeqeshi ababalulekile. Gcina ulwazi oluphezulu ngobuchwepheshe bokuthumela imininingwane nangenqwaba yezimoto. Phatha futhi ubuke izinkulumo zokusebenza zobuchwepheshe kanye nokuqondiswa kokusebenza abahlinzeki. Phatha izindaba zabathengi eziphakanyisiwe bese uxazula izinkinga ezinzima ezimisebenzeni. Hambisana nezinkulumo zemisebenzi kanye nezigwegwe zokusebenza. Buka imisebenzi yokuqeqesha ubuchwepheshe bese uqhuba ukuthuthuka okuqhubekayo ekulawuleni ukulahlekelwa kanye nokubonakala kwenqwaba: UkuBuka umsebenzi wenqwaba kanye nezaziso eziphakamisa. Sebenzisa izindlela ezingcono kakhulu zokubonakala kwenqwaba kanye nokusebenza kahle. Phatha izindaba eziphakanyisiwe mayelana nezinto zokulandela izimoto ukwehluleka ukuxhumana kanye nokungahambisani okubukwe. Buka izinga lokuphumelela kokusekela abathengi, ukusebenza kokubuka kanye nokuqondiswa kobuchwepheshe. Sebenzisa izinto ezithuthukisiwe zeExcel ukuhlaziya ukusebenza kwenqwaba ukuze uthole izinto ezihamba phambili kanye nemibiko yabaphathi ngezigqibo ezithathwa yiziqungamangalazi. Phatha izinsiza: Phatha ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Phatha izinhlela zentuthuko yabasebenzi. Imiqulu yokuPhatha nokuThuthukisa (PMDS). Lungatha futhi uphathe imali yesikhungo ngokuhambisana nezinhloso zenhlangano kanye nezidingo zePFMA. Buka ukusebenziswa kwemali bese uqinisekisa ukusebenza okunempilo, okonga kakhulu futhi okusebenza kahle kwezinsiza.

xh.title: Isekini Mlawuli: Lawulo Kokulahlekelwa Nokuhlola Izithuthi
xh.summary: Isekini Mlawuli wokulawula ukulahlekelwa nokuhlola izithuthi kwiSebe lezeNdlela nezeNthuthuko kumanzi eBedfordview, kufuneka nokuba namava ekulawulen iinkonzo kumazwe ethuthi.
xh.requirements: I-NQF Level 7 ekulawulen iinkonbo zethuthi okanye kumazwe ethuthi, 3-5 iminyaka yamava ngokusemthethweni kumazwe okulandelela izithuthi nokumweni kokulawula amazwe ethuthi kwinqanaba labaphathi/iinkcukacha (ASD). Ilayisensi yokushuka esemthethweni. Ulwazi kumazwe okuLawula Amazwe eZithuthi, ulawulo lokulahlekelwa, ukuhlola nokuzithoba, ulawulolwamali, uphando nokulawula ingozi, ukuhlalutywa kolwazi nokunikela ngemibuzo, kunye nokulawula abantu basebenzisana nabo.
xh.duties: Lawula izicwangciso zokuqhuba nokuhlola izithuthi neengozi: Phuhlisa futhi usebenzise isu lokuthintela ukulahlekelwa nokuqinisekisa ukhuseleko lwezithuthi. Hlola ukunyuka kwezithuthi, uchaze iingozi ezisemngciphekweni, nokusetyenziswa ngemigaqo engekho emthethweni kwesithuthi. Uphondo izehlo ezenzeka kuzo izithuthi. Seka futhi igcina iinkqubo zokunciphisa ukulahlekelwa ezinkqubweni zokuqhuba. Lungelanisa ngamaphoyisa iingcali xа sikhethwa. Seka iinkqubo zokuqeqesha kubuchwepheshe bokulandelela nakwinkonzo yabathengi. Lawula iinkqubo zokuruba nokuphinda uze ufumene okulahlekileyo: Lungelanisa amathuba okuphinda uze ufumene okulahlekileyo ngabantu basebenzisana nabo abangaphandle, njengamaphoyisa kunye namathenga. Gcina ukwaziswa okuchanekileyo ngokuwhokwa okulahlekileyo, ukuphinda ufumane okulahlekileyo, nangomlinganisela wemigangatho. Lungelelanisa iingxelo zokuqhuba ezinkqubweni zolawulo lokulahlekelwa nakumganga wokuphinda ufumane okulahlekileyo. Lawula inkonzo yokuxhasa abathengi nakuleyo yamakhono ezobuchwepheshe: Qondisa abantu abanobuchwephesha bexhaso labasebenzi besandla sabo. Gcina ulwazi olunamandla ngobuchwepheshe be-telematics nangezithuthi. Lawula futhi uhlolo iinkonzo ezifana nobuchwepheshe kubathengi bobuchwepheshe. Lawula izicwangciso zokunyusela abathengi futhi usombulule iingxaki ezingezantsi ezinkqubweni zokuqhuba. Lawula ukuzithoba kwiinkonzo ezemthethweni zeYure yeNkonzo nakuqinisekisa izigqibo ezisezantsi. Hlola iinkqubo zexhaso lezobuchwephesha futhi uzame ukuphucula ngokuqhubekayo ekulawuleni ukulahlekelwa nakukubonakala kwamathuba ezithuthi: Hlola iinkqubo ezithuthi kwaye uzame ukuqonda izaziso eziyimfuneko. Seka izinto ezilungileyo ekubonakaleni izithuthi nasezisebenzayo. Lawula izaziso ezihambelanayo nezixhobo zokulandelela, ukusilela kokunxibelelanа, nokuhlola iingenelo. Hlola ukuphumelela kokuxhasa abathengi, ukusebenza kahle kokuhlola, kunye nokusebenza ngobuchwepheshe. Sebenzisa izixhobo ze-Excel ezibucukuzihlaziyo ukuze uhlalutye ulawulo olwenzeka ezithuthi, uchaze amacandu aphucukileyo, uthumela iingxelo ezingcaleni ezingeni eliphezulu zokwenza izigqibo. Lawula izixhobo: Lawula imigaqo yokusebenza kwabasebenzi. Lawula iinkqubo zokuphucula abantu abangazimiselwa ngomntu. Iinkqubo zokuLawula nokuphucula iNkqubo (PMDS). Lungelelanisa futhi ulawule imali yesikhathi ngokuhambelana neenkqubo ezibalulekileyo zemfuno kunye ne-PFMA. Hlola ukuchithwa kwemali ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo, ngokugcina imali, nakwexabiso eliphantsi ezixhobeni.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Fleet Logistics
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Fleet Logistics position in Bedfordview requiring a National Diploma in Transportation, Logistics or Public Management and 3 to 5 years' fleet management experience.
jobs.requirements: A minimum three-year National Diploma (NQF Level 6) qualification in Transportation, Logistics, Public Management and Administrative degree, A valid B/EB driver’s License. Three (3) to Five (5) years functional experience in Fleet Management Services environment. Knowledge of managing Full Maintenance Lease (FML) contracts and must be proficient in MS Suite (Excel). Knowledge in Fleet Logistics Management Supply Chain and Logistics Operations, Fleet Maintenance Management, Legislative and Regulatory Compliance Financial Management Fleet Information Systems Risk and Operational Management Performance Monitoring and Reporting.

Monitor compliance with processes, procedures and internal controls of the Entity. Participate in the development, review and implementation of policies and standard operating procedure (SOP) to address identified gaps in the operation. Monitor the implementation of approved policies, procedures and recommend corrective measures where non- compliances is identified: Maintain appropriate records and evidence of policy compliance to support internal and external audits. Monitor the vehicle preparation process: Monitor the allocation process of vehicles in line with client needs (specification) and requirements Verify the roadworthiness of the vehicles prior to issuing the vehicle to client. Coordinate the end-to-end licensing and registration process. Liaison with internal / external stakeholders regarding vehicle fitments for new vehicles and monitor compliance with regulatory requirements (SOP and SLA). Compile monthly and quarterly reports on Fleet Leasing deliverables. Monitor utilisation of vehicles usage using different data sources to compile analysis on MS Excel. Provide input on the restructuring of contracts. Supervision of resources in the component and perform generic managerial function (Including people supervision): Provide operational guidance and support to the component. Monitor the utilisation of the financial and operational resources. Coordinate and monitor the implementation of the operational plans and work schedule activities related to Fleet Logistics functions. Promote a professional, accountable and performance driven working environment within the component. Maintain and update the operational risk register for fleet logistics activities.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Vlootlogistiek
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur: Vlootlogistiek-pos in Bedfordview wat 'n Nasionale Diploma in Vervoer, Logistiek of Openbare Bestuur benodig en 3 tot 5 jaar se vlootbestuurservaring.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum driedelige Nasionale Diploma (NQF-vlak 6) kwalifikasie in Vervoer, Logistiek, Openbare Bestuur en Administratiewe graad, 'n geldige B/EB-bestuurderslisensie. Drie (3) tot Vyf (5) jaar funksionele ervaring in 'n Vlootbestuursdienste-omgewing. Kennis van die bestuur van Full Maintenance Lease (FML)-kontrakte en moet vaardig wees in MS Suite (Excel). Kennis in Vlootlogistiekbestuur Voorsieningsketting en Logistiekbedrywighede, Vlootonderhoudsbestuur, Wetgewende en Regulerende Nakomende Finansiële Bestuur Vlootinligtingstelsels Risiko en Operasionele Bestuur Prestasie_monitering en Verslagdoening.
af.duties: Implementeer voorgeskrewe beleide: Hou by en bevorder toepaslike wetgewing, departementele voorskrifte, vervoerbeleide en die Gedragskode vir die Openbare Diens. Monitor nakoming van prosesse, prosedures en interne kontroles van die Entiteit. Neem deel aan die ontwikkeling, hersiening en implementering van beleide en standaardbedryfsprosedure (SOP) om geïdentifiseerde gapings in die werking aan te spreek. Monitor die implementering van goedgekeurde beleide, prosedures en beveel korrigerende maatreëls aan waar nie-nakoming geïdentifiseer word: Onderhou toepaslike rekords en bewyse van beleidsnakoming om interne en eksterne oudits te ondersteun. Monitor die voertuigvoorbereidingsproses: Monitor die toekenning van voertuie in ooreenstemming met kliëntbehoeftes (spesifikasie) en vereistes. Verifieer die padwaardigheid van voertuie voordat die voertuig aan kliënt uitgereik word. Koördineer die lisensie- en registrasieproses van begin tot einde. Skakeling met interne/eksterne belanghebbendes rakende voertuigtoepassings vir nuwe voertuie en monitor nakoming van regulatoriese vereistes (SOP en SLA). Koördineer versending en ontvangs van voertuie: Monitor die proses van voertuigversending aan kliënte. Verifieer die akkuraatheid van voertuiggebruiksdata wat op die Fleet Information System (FIS) vasgelê is. Monitor die teruggawe en vervanging van voertuie aan die einde van die termyn en fasiliteer die oorhandigingsproses aan Batebestuur. Onderhou akkurate rekords van voertuiginligting in die lêer. Monitor voertuigkontrakte en administrasie: Monitor kontrakbestuur in ooreenstemming met Full Maintenance Lease (FML)-ooreenkomste. Stel maandelikse en kwartaalverslae oor Vloothuur-lewerings op. Monitor die benutting van voertuiggebruik deur verskillende databronne te gebruik om analises op MS Excel op te stel. Verskaf insette oor die herstrukturering van kontrakte. Toesig oor hulpbronne in die komponent en verrig generiese bestuursfunksie (insluitend mense-toesig): Verskaf operasionele leiding en ondersteuning aan die komponent. Outeur en monitor personeelprestasie, werktoekenning, bywoning en verlof in ooreenstemming met die toepaslike beleide en prosedures. Monitor die benutting van die finansiële en operasionele hulpbronne. Koördineer en monitor die implementering van die operasionele planne en werkskedule-aktiwiteite wat verband hou met Vlootlogistiek-funksies. Bevorder 'n professionele, verantwoordelike en prestasiegedrewe werksomgewing binne die komponent. Onderhou en dateer die operasionele risikoregister vir vlootlogistiek-aktiwiteite op.

zu.title: Onxhumana woMphathi: uHlelo lwezimoto
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaOnxhumana woMphathi: uHlelo lwezimoto eBedfordview esidinga iDiploma yezwe eNqikweni lokuThuthuka eNqikeni lokuThuthuka (National Diploma) kokuHleleka kokuThutha, uHlelo lokuhamba kwempahla noma uMphathi wokuSebenza kahulumini kanye neminyaka emi-3 kuya kwengasiyiminyaka eyi-5 yokuhlela imoto.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma yezwe ubuncane beminyaka emithathu (NQF Level 6) kokuHleleka kokuThutha, uHlelo lokuhamba kwempahla, uMphathi wokuSebenza kahulumini noma i-degree yokuPhatha, i-License yokushayela ehlelekile i-B/EB. Ukutholakala kweminyaka emithathu (3) kuya kwengasiyiminyaka eyihlanu (5) yokusebenza ngokusebenza kahle emkhakheni we-Fleet Management Services. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwe-Full Maintenance Lease (FML) futhi kufanele ukuba uwuchwepheshe kwi-MS Suite (Excel). Ulwazi ngohlelo lokuhlela imoto oluncike kuhlangothi lokulethwa kwempahla kanye nokuhamba kwalo, ukuphathwa kokuLungiswa kwezimoto, ukuzithoba ngokomthetho nokuhambisana nomthetho kanye noMphathi wokuSebenza kahle emigqeni yezimali, inhlelo yolwazi mayelana nezimoto, ukubhekwa kwengozi kanye noMphathi wokuSebenza, ukubuka ngokomthelela nokubika.
zu.duties: Ukuqasha imithetho emitshelwayo: Ukuhambisana nokuqasha umthetho ohambisana nalowo osetshenziswayo, imithetho yomnyango, imithetho yezokuthutha kanye nesiKhwama soKuziphatha seSebenza kahulumini. Ukuhlola ukuhambisana kwenqubo, imiyalo nolawulo lwangaphakathi ku-Entity. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekwakheni, ukuphinda ubuke kanye nokusebenzisa imithetho nemiyalo yamagugu ukubhekana nokuqhamuka okutholakele emsebenzini. Ukubuka ukusebenziswa kwemithetho egunyaziwe, imiyalo nokuncoma izinyathelo zokulungisa lapho kutholwa ukungahambisani: Ukugcina iziqosho ezifanele kanye nobufakazi bokuhambisana nomthetho ukusekela ukuhlolwa kwangaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukubuka inqubo yokulungiselela imoto: Ukubuka inqubo yokwabiwa kwezimoto ngokuhambisana nezidingo ziklayenti (isibambi) kanye nezinye izidingo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imoto ilungele ukusetshenziswa endlwini ngaphambi kokuyinika iklayenti. Ukuhlanganisa inqubo yokuqala kuye kokuphela yokugunyaza futhi ubhalise imoto. Ukuxhumana nabahlanganyele bangaphakathi/nangaphandle mayelana nokulinganiselwa kwezimoto ezintsha futhi ubuke ukuzithoba ngemithetho edingwayo (i-SOP kanye ne-SLA). Ukuhlanganisa ukuthumela nokwamukela izimoto: Ukubuka inqubo yokuthumela imoto kubaklayenti. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi olushiwo ngomsebenzi wezimoto lufanele olushisiwe kwi-Fleet Information System (FIS). Ukubuka ukubuyiswa nokushintshwa kwezimoto ekupheleni kwesikhathi kanye nokubeka inqubo yokunika i-Asset Management isandla. Ukugcina iziqosho ezifanele zenhlolojwede yezimoto. Ukubuka amakhasimende ezimoto kanye nekhonthule: Ukubuka ukuphathwa kwekhonthule ngokuhambisana nomaKhonthule we-Full Maintenance Lease (FML). Ukuhlunga imibiko yenyanga ngamunyaka ngesigaba ngasinye emizamweni ye-Fleet Leasing. Ukubuka ukusetshenziswa kwezimoto ngokusebenzisa izinsuku ezihlukene zolwazi ukwenza isibukiso kwi-MS Excel. Ukuhlinzeka ngenkombandlela ngokuqashwa kabusha kwamakhonthule. Ukuqondisa izinsiza kwikhasimende kanye nokwenza imisebenzi yokuphatha ngokujwayelekile (okuhlanganisa ukuqondisa abantu): Ukunika inkombandlela ngokusebenza futhi usekele ikhasimende. Ukuqondisa kanye nokubuka ukusebenza kwabasebenzi, ukuhlukanisa imisebenzi, ukubakho nokuhamba ngemithetho kanye nezinqumo ngokuhambisana nemithelelo kanye nemiyalo edingwayo. Ukubuka ukusetshenziswa kwezimali nezinsiza zokusebenza. Ukuhlanganisa futhi ubuke ukusebenziswa kweplani yokusebenza futhi uhlele imikhakha yomsebenzi ehlobene nokuHlela kwezimoto. Ukuqasha indawo yokusebenza ebonakalisa ukukhululeka nokuzithoba ekutheni imisebenzi ihle kahle kuleyikhaya. Ukugcina futhi ubhaliswe kwabhalwe umbhalo weplani yesikhathi eside ngengozi ohlelweni lokuhlela imoto.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNqanaba: I-Fleet Logistics
xh.summary: Isithuba somncedisi weNqanaba: I-Fleet Logistics eBedfordview sifuna i-National Diploma kwiTransportation, iLogistics okanye iPublic Management kunye neminyaka 3 ukuya ku-5 yamava ekulawulweni kwezimoto.

Iminyaka elithathu (3) ukuya kwelihlanu (5) yamava abalulekileyo kwindawo yesebe le-Fleet Management Services. Ulwazi lokulawula amaqebomfanelo e-Full Maintenance Lease (FML) kwaye kufuneka abe nobuchule kwi-MS Suite (Excel). Ulwazi kwi-Fleet Logistics Management Supply Chain and Logistics Operations, Fleet Maintenance Management, Legislative and Regulatory Compliance Financial Management Fleet Information Systems Risk and Operational Management Performance Monitoring and Reporting.
xh.duties: Zonke iindlela ezichaziweyo zokusetyenziswa: Zilandele ziphakamise izinto ezisebenzayo zemithetho, izalathiso zesebe, iindlela zokuthutha kunye ne-Code of Conduct yesebe likarhulumhle. Qwalasela ukuvunywa kwemigaqo, iinkqubo kunye nokulawulwa kwangaphakathi kwe-Entity. Thatha inxaxheba ekwenzeni, ekuhlalweni kwakhona nasekuphotheni iindlela zokusetyenziswa kunye ne-standard operating procedure (SOP) ukuze ulungise izinto ezingekho zilungileyo kumsebenzi. Qwalasela ukusetyenziswa kwezindlela ezigunyaziweyo, iinkqubo kwaye uze uphezamise izikhuthazo ezilungisa apho kubonakala kungagunyaziswanga: Gcina irekhodi ezifanelekileyo kunye nobungqina bokulandela iindlela zokusetyenziswa ukuze uxhase ukuhlolwa ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Qwalasela inqubo yokuqulunqa izimoto: Qwalasela inqubo yokwahlwa izimoto ngokwemfuno yamaxhasi (izalathiso) nendawo efunwayo. Qinisekisa ukuba izimoto zikulungele ukuzingela ngaphambi kokuba zihanjiswe kumxhasi. Lawula inqubo egqithiselayo yokuqulunqa kunye nokubhalisa izimoto. Xhoxho nabantu bakulesi sebe / abangaphandle malunga nokuqeqesha izimoto ezintsha kwaye qwalasela ukuvunywa kwemigaqo esetyenziswayo (SOP kunye ne-SLA). Lawula ukuthumela nokuwamkela izimoto: Qwalasela inqubo yokuthumela izimoto kwabaxhasi. Qinisekisa ukuzinza kolwazi olubhalwe malunga nokusetyenziswa kwemoto kwi-Fleet Information System (FIS) Qwalasela ukubuyiswa nokutshintshwa kwezimoto ekupheleni kwethamsanqa kwaye ulawule inqubo yokunika i-Asset Management. Gcina irekhodi ezichanekileyo yolwazi lemoto efayileni. Qwalasela amaqebomfanelo ezimoto nolawulo: Qwalasela ulawulo lweqebomfanelo ngokwezi sivumelwano ze-Full Maintenance Lease (FML). Lungelelanisa iimbiko zenyanga nye kunye nezenyanga ezintathu malunga nezigqibo ze-Fleet Leasing. Qwalasela ukusetyenziswa kwezimoto kusetyenziswa iindidi ezahlukeneyo zolwazi ukuze kwenziwe isalathiso kwi-MS Excel. Nikezela ingqeqesho malunga nokubuyela ngokwakha kwakhona amaqebomfanelo. Ukulawula amadane kulesi sebenzi kwaye wenze imisebenzi yomlawuli jikelele (kuquka nokulawula abantu): Nikezela isixhobo nentsebenzelo kule ncwadi. Lawula ukuze qwalasele inkqubo yomsebenzi wabanzi, ukwahlwa komsebenzi, ukubakho nokurhoxa ngokomthetho osebenzayo. Qwalasela ukusetyenziswa kweempahla zemali nangokomsebenzi. Lawula ukuze qwalasele ukusetyenziswa kweendlela ezilungileyo zomsebenzi kwaye umsebenzi ochaziweyo oqhagamshelwe nemiSebenzi ye-Fleet Logistics. Phakamisa indalo ebanzi, ephantsi kweenkcukacha kwaye entsula umsebenzi kulesi sebenzi. Gcina kwaye uhlaziye irekhodi yokusingatha iingozi kumsebenzi wakho wokuthutha izimoto.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Customer Services Centre
jobs.summary: Assistant Director needed to manage customer service centre operations in Bedfordview, requiring a National Diploma in Public or Business Administration and 3-5 years supervisory experience.

Monitor service standards and compliance with organizational policies. Develop and implement customer service improvement initiatives. Supervision and Staff Management: Supervise and manage Customer Service Centre personnel. Allocate work, monitor performance, and provide guidance to staff. Facilitate staff training and development programmes. Conduct performance assessments and provide coaching where necessary. Customer Complaints and Queries Management Oversee the resolution of customer complaints, enquiries, and service requests. Investigate complex customer issues and recommend corrective actions. Ensure adherence to customer service turnaround times. Monitor trends in complaints and develop improvement interventions. Stakeholder Relations and Communication Liaise with internal and external stakeholders regarding customer service matters. Maintain effective communication channels with customers and service providers. Promote customer-centric service delivery practices. Monitoring, Evaluation and Reporting. Compile monthly, quarterly, and annual customer service reports. Analyse customer feedback and service performance data. Monitor service delivery standards, customer satisfaction levels, and key performance indicators (KPIs). Provide recommendations to management for continuous improvement. Policy and Compliance Management. Ensure compliance with applicable legislation, departmental policies, and service standards. Assist in developing and reviewing customer service policies, procedures, and service charters. Promote adherence to Batho Pele Principles and public service regulations. Resource and Risk Management. Manage resources allocated to the Customer Service Centre. Identify operational risks and implement mitigation measures. Ensure proper management of assets, records, and information within the unit.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Klantedienssentrum
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur benodig om klantedienssentrum-bedrywighede in Bedfordview te bestuur, wat 'n Nasionale Diploma in Publieke- of Besigheidsadministrasie en 3-5 jaar se toesigervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n minimum drie jaar Nasionale Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Publieke Administrasie / Besigheidsadministrasie-bestuur. 3-5 jaar se toesigervaring in 'n oproepsentrum / operasionele bestuursomgewing. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Kennis: Effektiewe kommunikasie-, skryf- en verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Kennis: Klantbestuur. Resultaat / kwaliteitbestuur. af.duties: Klantediensbestuur: Bestuur en koördineer klantedienssentrum-bedrywighede. Verseker dat kliënte doeltreffende, professionele en tydige dienste ontvang. Monitor diensstandaarde en nakoming van organisatoriese beleid. Ontwikkel en implementeer klantediensverbeteringsinisiatiewe. Toesig en personeelbestuur: Hou toesig oor en bestuur klantedienssentrum-personeel. Wi werk toe, monitor prestasie en verskaf leiding aan personeel. Fasiliteer personeelopleidings- en ontwikkelingsprogramme. Voer prestasie-assesserings uit en verskaf afrigting waar nodig. Kliëntekompleinte en navraebestuur. Hou toesig oor die oplossing van kliëntekompleinte, navrae en diensversoeke. Ondersoek ingewikkelde kliëntkwessies en beveel regstellende maatreëls aan. Verseker nakoming van klantediens-omkeertye. Monitor tendense in kompleinte en ontwikkel verbeteringsintervensies. Belanghebbende verhoudings en kommunikasie. Skakel met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes rakende klantedienssake. Onderhou effektiewe kommunikasiekanale met kliënte en diensverskaffers. Bevorder kliëngesentrede diensleweringpraktyke. Monitering, evaluerings en verslagdoening. Stel maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse klantediensverslae op. Analiseer klantterugvoer en diensprestasiedata. Monitor diensleweringstandaarde, kliënttevredenheidsvlakke en sleutelprestasie-aanwysers (KPIs). Verskaf aanbevelings aan bestuur vir deurlopende verbetering. Beleids- en nakomingsbestuur. Verseker nakoming van toepaslike wetgewing, departementele beleid en diensstandaarde. Bystand in die ontwikkeling en hersiening van klantediensbeleide, prosedures en dienshandveste. Bevorder nakoming van Batho Pele-beginsels en staatsdiensregulasies. Hulpbron- en risikobestuur. Bestuur hulpbronne wat aan die klantedienssentrum toegewys is. Identifiseer operasionele risiko's en implementeer versagtingsmaatreëls. Verseker behoorlike bestuur van bates, rekords en inligting binne die eenheid.

zu.title: Umlobi Oholiswayo: Isikhungo Sezinsiza Zeklayenti
zu.summary: Kudingeka Umlobi Oholiswayo ukuphatha imisebenzi yesikhungo sezinsiza zeklayenti e Bedfordview, kufunwa iDiploma Yezwe emqoka kwezokuqondiswa kwezempilo zabantu noma kwezoshishino kanye namaphuzu ayi-3-5 wobuhlakani bokuhlola kuleminyaka eyi-3-5.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma yezinga le-NQF Level 6 kwiminyaka emithathu ebanzi kwemfundo yasezikoleni ephathelene nezokusimba komphakathi / Ukuphathwa koshishino. Iminyaka eyi-3-5 yamava obuhlakani bokuhlola kwendawo yokuphatha ama-call Centre / okuHlelekile. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Ulwazi: Amakhono okuxhumana okusebenzayo, ukubhala nokubika. Ulwazi: Ukuphathwa kweklayenti. Ukuphathwa kwemiphumela / ikhwalithi. Izinto ezintsha / Ukuthuthuka okuqhubekayo. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuhlaziya. Ukuxoxisana. Ukuthatha izinqumo. Ukuxhumana. Ukuthatha isinyathelo. Ukuzwa ngokuhlukahluka kwebantfu.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zeklayenti: Phatha futhi uhlole imisebenzi yesikhungo sezinsiza zeklayenti. Qinisekisa ukuthi abaklayenti bathola izinsiza ezisebenzayo, ezinhle futhi esikhathini. Qapha amazinga ezinsiza nokuhambisana nemigomo yesigungi. Yakha futhi usebenzise izinhloso zokuthuthukisa izinsiza zeklayenti. Ukuphathwa kwabantu nokuqondiswa: Qondisa futhi uphathe abantu besikhungo sezinsiza zeklayenti. Hlukanisa umsebenzi, qapha ukusebenza, futhi unikeze imibono kubasebenzi. Siza ekufundeni nasekuthuthukisweni amabhengezi abasebenzi. Yenza ukuhlola ukusebenza futhi unikeze inceku lapho kudingeka khona. Ukuphathwa kwezibalwa zeklayeni nezikhungi Qapha ukuxazululwa kwezono zeklayenti, imibuzo, nezicelo sezinsiza. Phenya izinkinga ezinzima zeklayenti futhi uphakamise izinyathelo zokulungisa. Qinisekisa ukuthobela izikhathi zokuqeda imisebenzi yeklayenti. Qapha izindlela eziyisono futhi yakhe izinhloso zokuthuthukisa. Ukuxhumana nabahlanyeli nezindaba Xhumana nabahlanyeli bangaphakathi nangaphandle mayelana nezindaba zezinsiza zeklayenti. Gaga iziqondiso ezisebenzayo zokuxhumana nabaklayenti nabahlinzeka ngamasevisi. Khuthaza izindlela zokuletha izinsiza ezibheke kuleklayenti. Ukuqapha, ukuhlola nokubika. Hlela amabhikhi nyanga zonke, ngenyanga, futhi njalo minyaka yonke mayelana nezinsiza zeklayenti. Hlaziya imibono yeklayenti nedatha yokusebenza kwezinsiza. Qapha amazinga ezinsiza, inqondo yeklayenti, futhi izinkomba ezibalulekile zokusebenza. Nikeza izinikelo ezingumqondisi wemisebenzi ukuba ithuthuke. Imigomo nokuphathwa kokuhambisana. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nomthetho ophathekayo, imigomo yomnyango, kanye namazinga ezinsiza. Siza ekwakheni nasekuhlolisweni imigomo yezinsiza zeklayenti, izindlela, kanye namakhasi ezinsiza. Khuthaza ukuthobela imigomo ka-Batho Pele kanye nemigomo yezinsiza zomphakathi. Ukuphathwa kwemithombo nobungozi. Phatha imithombo enikezwe isikhungo sezinsiza zeklayenti. Hlola ubungozi ezimisweni futhi usebenzise izinyathelo zokunciphisa. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okufanele kwempahla, amarekhodi, futhi ulwazi lwesikhathi ngaphakathi kwegumba.

xh.title: Umcebisi weNdlela: Isebe leNkonzo zabakhwebi
xh.summary: Kufuneka kude kwenziwe umcebisi wendlela ukuze alawise imisebenzi yesikhululo seenkonzo zabakhwebi e Bedfordview, kwaye kulindeleke i-National Diploma kwi-Public okanye i-Business Administration kunye neminyaka emi-3-5 yamava okulawula.
xh.requirements: I-National Degree eyi-mnquba zeminyaka emithathu (i-NQF Level 6) kwi-Public Administration / Business Administration Management. Iimviwo zeminyaka emi-3-5 ekulawuleni ikomkhulu lemfow / i-Operations Management environment. I-Layisensi yokuQhatha. Ukusebenza ngekhompyutha. Ulwazi: Amakhono obuqhathaniswa ngokuchanekileyo nokuqaqambisa iingxelo. Ulwazi: Ukulawula abakhwebi. Ukulawula iziphumo / ikhwalithi. Iindlela ezintsha zokusetyenziswa / ukuphucula ngokuqhubekayo. Ukuxazulula iingxaki. Ukuhlola ngokwendlela. Ukuxoxisana. Ukwenza iigqibo. Unxibelelwano. Inceba. Ukuqonda ngokobunikela bendalo.
xh.duties: Ukulawula iNkonzo zabakhwebi: Ulawula kananjalo ulungelelanisa imisebenzi yase-Isebe leNkonzo zabakhwebi. Qinisekisa ukuba abakhwebi bafumana iinkonzo ezisebenzayo, ezichanekileyo, nangexesha elifanelekileyo. Hlola iimviwo zekhonzo nokuthobela iinkqubo ezisiwa phambili ngumbutho. Yila kwaye usebenzise iindlela zokuphucula izikhululo zeenkonzo zabakhwebi. Ukulawula kwaye uqondanse abantu base-Isebe leNkonzo zabakhwebi: Lawula abasebenzi base-Isebe leNkonzo zabakhwebi. Yaba umsebenzi, hlola ukusebenza, kwaye unike isikhokelo kubasebenzi. Khokela iinkqubo zokuqeqesha nokuphuhlisa abasebenzi. Yenza ukulinganiswa kokusebenza kwaye unike ufundi apho kufuneka khona. Ulawulo lwezinto eziphathwayo namava: Hlola ukuba kusetyenziswa njani iingxaki zabakhwebi, imibuzo, neesicelo seenkonzo. Phanda iingxaki ezinzima zabakhwebi kwaye uzeke izigqibo zokuqwalasela. Qinisekisa ukuzinza kwexesha elincinci lokubuyisela kwinkonzo yabakhwebi. Hlola iimeko ezihamba phambili kwiingozi eziphathwayo kwaye uphucule iindlela zokusonjulula. Unxibelelwano namab asebenza phandle: Thetha nabasembindini kunye nabanji bemisebenzi ngenkxaso yeenkonzo zabakhwebi. Gcina iindlela zokuchaka ubukhulu abakhwebi kwaye nooqaphiweze iinkonzo. Khankanya iindlela zokuhamba phambili ngenkxaso yeenkonzo ngokubaluleka kubakhwebi. Ukuhlola, ukulinganisa nokwenza iingxelo: Yenza iingxelo zenyanga, zeesiqendu, kwkunye nezo nyaka ngenkxaso yeenkonzo zabakhwebi. Hlola iimvakalelo zabakhwebi kwakunye nemigaqo yeminyuzi yeenkonzo. Hlola ukusebenza kwemigaqo yeenkonzo, iimeko ezihamba phambili, kwakunye namaphakathi okuqwalasela ukusebenza. Nikeza iingcebiso kulawulo ukuphucula ngokuqhubekayo. Iinkqubo namathumente olimi: Qinisekisa ukuhambelana ngesi scedule samashishini, namagama omtsetho wesabe, namagama omtsetho weenkonzo. Seda ekuyileni nakukuqwalaselweni kweenkqubo, namagama omtsetho weenkonzo zabakhwebi, namaxwebhu obunknono. Khankanya ukuhambelana kwezi ntsika zika-Batho Pele kwakunye namathumente omtsetho wesebe loarhente. Ulawulo lweempahla nengozi: Lawula imisebenzi ekelwe kwi-Isebe leNkonzo zabakhwebi. Mfuna amathuba amabi kwaye usebenzise iindlela zokuqwalasela. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa ngokuchanekileyo kweepahla, imibhalo, kwakunye nolwazi ngaphakathi kwesandule.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Oproepsentrum
af.summary: Bestuur oproepsentrum-bedrywighede, nakoming en dienslewering vir die Gauteng Department of Roads and Transport in Bedfordview.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum drie jaar Nasionale Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Openbare Administrasie/Besigheidsadministrasiebestuur. 3-5 jaar se toesighoudervaring in 'n oproepsentrum/operasionele bestuursomgewing. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Kennis: Effektiewe kommunikasie, skryf- en verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Kennis: Kliëntbestuur. Resultaat/kwaliteitsbestuur. Innovasie/Deurlopende verbetering. Probleemoplossing. Analities. Onderhandeling. Besluitneming. Kommunikasie. Inisiatief. Diversiteitsbewustheid.
af.duties: Bestuur die implementering van voorgeskrewe beleide: Hou by en bevorder wetgewende en departementele voorskrifte asook die gedragskode vir die staatsdiens. Monitor nakoming van oproepsentrum-prosesse, prosedures en interne kontroles van die entiteit, bevorder die toepassing van Batho Pele-beginsels en beste praktyke vir kliëntediens, ontwikkel en implementeer operasionele verbeteringsinisiatiewe in reaksie op geïdentifiseerde diensleweringsgapse en operasionele vereistes. Toesig hou oor en monitor daaglikse oproepsentrum-bedrywighede: Allokasie van operasionele hulpbronne om effektiewe oproepsentrum-dienslewering te ondersteun, monitor kliëntinteraksies en diensleweringsstandaarde binne die oproepsentrumomgewing, onderhou werksverhoudinge met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes. Koördineer oproepsentrum-verslagdoening en administratiewe funksies. Monitor kliëntnavraag-oplossing en kliëntondersteuningsdienste: Monitor die oplossing van kliëntnavrae en klagtes binne ooreengekome draaitye, verskaf leiding aan kliënte oor produkte, dienste en operasionele prosesse van die entiteit, hou eskaleerde navrae dop en koördineer korrektiewe maatreëls waar nodig, analiseer kliëntdienstendense en verskaf aanbevelings vir deurlopende verbetering. Koördineer voertuigtoekenning, instandhoudingsbesprekings en terugbesorgings: Koördineer die uitreik van korttermynverhurings aan kliënte, koördineer die ontvangs en uitreik van voertuie wat vir instandhouding en herstel bespreek is, fasiliteer die oorhandigingsproses aan batebestuur. Toesig hou oor hulpbronne: Verskaf operasionele leiding en ondersteuning aan die komponent, hou toesig oor en ondersteun personeel in die uitvoering van daaglikse aktiwiteite, monitor benutting van finansiële en operasionele hulpbronne binne die eenheid, stel begrotingsinvoere saam en verskaf aanbevelings oor operasionele hulpbronvereistes, fasiliteer personeelontwikkeling en bevorder deurlopende verbetering binne die komponent.

zu.title: Onozimele: Call Centre
zu.summary: Phatha imisebenzi, ukuziphatha kanye nokulethwa kwezinsiza kwe Call Centre kwabasebenzi kule Gauteng Department of Roads and Transport e Bedfordview.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma yezwe elinganashumi Eminyaka yezifundo (NQF Level 6) ku Public Administration/Business Administration Management. 3-5 unyaka wokuba ngumuntu onakekela abanye emhlabeni we call Centre/Operations Management. I-Driver's License esebenzayo. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi: Amakhono okuxhumana okusebenzayo, ukubhala nokubika. Ulwazi: Ukuphathwa kwabathengi. Ukuphathwa kwemiphumela/ikhwalithi. Into entsha/ukuthuthuka ngokungalokothi. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuhlola izinto. Ukuxoxisana. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuxhumana. Ukuthatha isinyathelo. Ukuqaphela ukubaluleka kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zabantu.
zu.duties: Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela ezibekiwe: Zilandele futhi usize kuqhubekiswe phambili izinto ezibekiwe ngokomthetho, zomnyango kanye nomkhondo wokuziphatha kazwelonke. Qapha ukuthi kuhambiswani kanjani na namaphrosessi, amaphrosedja kanye nokulawula okwangaphakathi kwe call centre, ube wusizo ekusetshenzisweni kwemigomo ka Batho Pele kanye nezinto ezinhle ekukhonzeni abathengi, khuthaza futhi usebenzise izinhloso zokuthuthuka eziku zokusebenza ngokumpendula ezibekiwe nasezidingweni zokusebenza ezenziwe. Nakekela futhi ulole imisebenzi yansuku zonke ye call centre: Yabel izinsiza zokusebenza ukuze usize ekulethweni kwezinsiza ekuhonzeni i call Centre, qapha ukuxhumana namakhasimede kanye nezinga lokukhonza emhlabeni we call Centre, gcina ubudlelwano nabantu abakule minyango nangaphandle kwayo. Hlanganisa ukubika kwe call Centre nemisebenzi yalawo mahhovisi. Qapha ukuxazululwa kwemibuzo yamakhasimende kanye nesevisi yokwesekela amakhasimede: Qapha ukuxazululwa kwemibuzo nezikhalazo zamakhasimede ngosuku oluhleliwe, nika abathengi isiqondiso ngemikhiqizo, isevisi kanye namaphrosessi okusebenza, landela imibuzo eyedwa kuye nephakanyiswe ibandakanywe futhi uhlanganise izenzo zokulungisa lapho kunesidingo, cwaninga ukuthi kutheni nje abathengi bakhonza ngale ndlela bese unikeza izeluleko zokuthi kuthuthuke njalo kule ndlela. Hlanganisa ukwabelwa kwezimoto, ukugcina izinkomba zokuphathwa nokubuyiselwa: Hlanganisa ukunikwa abathengi kwemoto okwesikhashana, hlanganisa ukutholwa nokunikezwa kwemoto ezimiswe ukuphathwa nokulungiswa, wenze iphroshesi yokudlulisa izinto ekuqaphelelweni kwempahla. Nakekela izinsiza: Nikeza abasebenzi isiqondiso kanye nokuwesekela, nakekela futhi weseka abasebenzi ekwenzeni imisebenzi yansuku zonke, qapha ukusetshenziswa kwezimali nezinsiza ezikuwo umnyango, qamba okufakwe ngaphakathi kwezezimali bese unikeza izeluleko ngezidingo zezinsiza, yenza abasebenzi bathuthuke bese ethuthukisa ngokungalokothi kuleso sakhiwo.

xh.title: Umncedisi woMlawuli: IZiko leNxibelelano
xh.summary: Lawula imisebenzi yenkqubo yokusebenza kweziko lenxibelelano, ukuzithobela kweenkqubo nokunikela inkonzo kwisebe leGauteng Department of Roads and Transport eBedfordview.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma (Nqanaba le-NQF 6) eliphela kwiminyaka emithathu kuPublic Administration/Business Administration Management. Amava eminyaka ye-3-5 ekulawuleni abasebenzi kwimeko yenkqubo yokusebenza kweziko lenxibelelano/kuLawulo lweNkqubo yokusebenza. Ilayisenesi elisebenzayo yokuQhuba. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi: Amandla okunxibelela ngokusebenzayo, kokubhala nakokwenza iingxelo. Ulwazi: uLawulo loMthengi. uLawulo lweSiphumo/umgangatho. IInovathi/Ukuqhubela phambili ngokuqhubeka. Ukuxazula iingxaki. Ukwenza isihluzo. uLawulwa ngokusebenzisana. uKwaya isiGqibo. uNxibelelano. Isithuba sokungena ngqo. uKuzipatha ngokubakho iintlobo ngeentlobo zabantu.
xh.duties: Lawula ukusebenzisa iinkqubo ezichaziweyo: Zithobe kwaye uncede iinkqubo zomthetho, izalathiso zesebe nendlela yokuziphatha kwinkonzo yomphakathi. Qaphela ukuzithobela kweekqubo zeziko lenxibelelano, iinkqubo nolawulo lwangaphakathi loo nto, undedele ukusebenzisa iMigaqo yeBatho Pele nendlela engcono yokunikelela inkonzo kumthengi, Yakhe uze usebenzise isikhokelo sokuphucula inkqubo yokusebenza ekuphenduleni iindleko ezingekho kwaye kufunekileyo ekunikeleni inkonzo nakuLawulweni lwenkqubo. Qwalasela uze ulawule imisebenzi yamhlanje yeziko lenxibelelano: Yabelu ngenkqubo yokusebenza ukuxhasa ukunikela inkonzo kweziko lenxibelelano, qaphela iintsebenziswano nomthengi nemiqathango yokunikela inkonzo kwingingili yeziko lenxibelelano, gcina ubudlelwane lokusebenza nabanye abantu abafakiweyo ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Hlela iingxelo zeziko lenxibelelano nemisebenzi yolawulo. Qaphela ukuxazulwa imibuzo yomthengi neenkonzo zokuxhasa umxhasi: Qaphela ukuxazulwa kwiimbuzo neengxaki zomthengi ngaphakathi kwexesha elivunyelweyo lokujika, nikezela inkombela kumaxhasi ngezixhobo zemisebenzi, iinkonzo neenkqubo zokusebenza kweyona nto, landela iimbuzo ezikhuliswe kumgangatho ophezulu uze uhlelange izenzo zokulungisa apho kufunekayo, Yenza isihluzo kumiselwane wenkonzo yomthengi uze unike iingcebiso zokuqhubela phambili ngokuqhubeka. Hlela ukwabelwa kwezithuthi, izicelo zolungiso nokubuyisa: Hlela ukunikwa kwezithuthi eziqeshwa isithuba esifutshane kumaxhasi, hlela ukamkelwa nokunikwa kwezithuthi ezilungiselelwe ulungiso nokubuyiselwa ngezicelo, khokela inkqubo yokunika ngasinye kuyo kulawulo lwempahla. Lawula izixhobo zemisebenzi: Nikeza inkombela yolawulo nokuxhasa ingxenye, Lawula uze uxhase abasebenzi ekuphumezenini imisebenzi yamhla, qaphela ukusetyenziswa kwemali ngezixhobo zolawulo ngaphakathi kuleyunithi, qamba iingcali zamaxesha oluqo kwaye unike iingcebiso ngeemfuno zezixhobo zolawulo, Khokela ukuphuculwa kwabasebenzi kwaye uncedise ukuqhubela phambili ngokuqhubeka ngaphakathi kwengxenye.

jobs.title: Assistant Director Panel Beating and Mechanical
jobs.summary: Assistant Director needed in Bedfordview to manage panel beating and vehicle body repair operations for the Gauteng Department of Roads and Transport.
jobs.requirements: A minimum three year National Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Transport Management, Fleet Management. 3-5 years' supervisory experience in vehicle repair, panel beating, fleet maintenance, or workshop management. Supervisory experience. Valid Driver’s License. Trade Test Certificate in Panel Beating will be an added advantage. Knowledge: Fleet management principles. Vehicle body repair and restoration techniques. Occupational Health and Safety Act. Insurance and accident claim procedures. Public sector regulatory framework (if applicable).
jobs.duties: Manage Panel Beating Operations: Direct panel beating and vehicle body repair operations. Coordinate the assessment and repair of accident-damaged vehicles, monitor repair turnaround times to minimise vehicle downtime, allocate work to panel beating staff and service providers, verify that repairs are completed according to manufacturer specifications and quality standards, Monitor workshop productivity and performance. Monitor Service Providers and Contractors: Evaluate the performance of panel beating contractors and suppliers, conduct inspections to verify quality and compliance with service level agreements, recommend corrective measures for underperforming contractors, facilitate contractor performance review meetings, Monitor contractor adherence to safety, environmental, and quality standards. Manage Vehicle Accident Repairs: Oversee the inspection and evaluation of damaged vehicles, approve repair quotations and repair methodologies, Coordinate interactions with insurance companies, assessors, and repair contractors, monitor repair progress and resolve repair-related challenges, verify that repaired vehicles are roadworthy before release, Maintain records of accident repair costs and trends. Manage Fleet Repair Costs and Budget: Monitor expenditure related to panel beating and accident repairs, Analyse repair costs and identify cost-saving opportunities, verify the accuracy of invoices and payment requests, prepare budget forecasts and expenditure reports, recommend strategies to optimise repair and maintenance costs. Monitor Fleet Compliance and Governance: Implement policies, procedures, and standards relating to panel beating operations, verify compliance with occupational health and safety requirements, monitor adherence to fleet management regulations and governance frameworks, facilitate internal and external audits, implement corrective actions arising from audit findings. Manage Human Resources and Performance: Supervise and develop panel beating personnel, conduct performance reviews and manage employee development plans, identify training and skills development needs, promote discipline, productivity, and teamwork within the section, Facilitate compliance with human resource policies and procedures.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur Karosserieherstel en Meganies
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur benodig in Bedfordview om karosserieherstel- en voertuigbakherstelbedrywighede vir die Gauteng Department of Roads and Transport te bestuur.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van 'n driejaar Nasionale Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Meganiese Ingenieurswese, Otomotiewe Ingenieurswese, Vervoerbestuur, of Vlootbestuur. 3-5 jaar se toesigervaring in voertuigherstel, karosserieherstel, vlootonderhoud, of werkswinkelbestuur. Toesigervaring. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. 'n Handelstoetssertifikaat in Karosserieherstel sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis: Vlootbestuursbeginsels. Voertuigbakherstel- en hersteltegnieke. Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid. Versekerings- en ongelukskadeprosedures. Regulerende raamwerk vir die openbare sektor (indien van toepassing).
af.duties: Bestuur Karosserieherstelbedrywighede: Bestuur karosserieherstel- en voertuigbakherstelbedrywighede. Koördineer die assessering en herstel van voertuie met ongelukskade, monitor herstelomlooptye om voertuig-onderbrekingstyd tot 'n minimum te beperk, werk aan karosserieherstelpersoneel en diensverskaffers toe, verifieer dat herstelwerk volgens vervaardigingspesifikasies en gehaltestandaarde voltooi is, monitor werkswinkelproduktiwiteit en prestasie. Monitor Diensverskaffers en Kontrakteurs: Evalueer die prestasie van karosserieherstelkontrakteurs en verskaffers, voer inspeksies uit om gehalte en nakoming van diensvlakooreenkomste te verifieer, beveel regstellende maatreëls aan vir onderpresterende kontrakteurs, fasiliteer kontrakteurprestasie-herbesprekingsvergaderings, monitor kontrakteurnakoming van veiligheids-, omgewings- en gehaltestandaarde. Bestuur Voertuigongelukskadeherstelwerk: Hou toesig oor die inspeksie en evaluering van beskadigde voertuie, keur herstelkwotasies en herstelmetodes goed, koördineer interaksies met versekeringsmaatskappye, assessors en herstelkontrakteurs, monitor herstelvoortgang en los herstelverwante uitdagings op, verifieer dat herstelde voertuie padwaardig is voordat dit vrygestel word, handhaaf rekords van ongelukskadeherstelkoste en -tendense. Bestuur Vlootherstelkoste en Begroting: Monitor uitgawes verbonde aan karosserieherstel en ongelukskadeherstelwerk, ontleed herstelkoste en identifiseer kostebesparingsgeleenthede, verifieer die akkuraatheid van fakture en betalingsversoeke, berei begrotingsvoorspellings en uitgaweveral state voor, beveel strategieë aan om herstel- en onderhoudskoste te optimaliseer. Monitor Vlootnakomigheid en Bestuur: Implementeer beleide, prosedures en standaarde rakende karosserieherstelbedrywighede, verifieer nakoming van beroepsgesondheids- en veiligheidsvereistes, monitor voldoening aan vlootbestuursregulasies en bestuursraamwerke, fasiliteer interne en eksterne oudits, implementeer regstellende maatreëls voortspruitend uit ouditbevindings. Bestuur Menslike Hulpbronne en Prestasie: Hou toesig oor en ontwikkel karosserieherstelpersoneel, voer prestasie-herbesprekings uit en bestuur werknemerontwikkelingsplanne, identifiseer opleidings- en vaardigheidsontwikkelingsbehoeftes, bevorder dissipline, produktiwiteit en spanwerk binne die afdeling, fasiliteer nakoming van menslike hulpbronbeleide en -prosedures.

zu.title: Assistant Director Panel Beating and Mechanical
zu.summary: Kudingeka i-Assistant Director e-Bedfordview ukuphatha imisebenzi yokulungisa amabhabhathizi nokulungisa izinqamuleli zemimoto ku-Gauteng Department of Roads and Transport.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma Yezwe eminyakeni emithathu ubuncane (NQF Level 6) ku-Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Transport Management, Fleet Management. Uhlolo lonyaka osungula abantu eminyakeni engu-3-5 ekulungeni izimoto, ekulungiseni amabhabhathizi, ekugcineni inqwaba kwezimoto, noma ekuphathweni kwendawo yokulungisa. Uhlolo lokugcina izimoto. Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela. Isitifiketi Sakho Lokuhlola ku-Panel Beating sibe yinzuza. Ulwazi: Imigomo yokuphathwa kwenqwaba kwezimoto. Izindlela zokulungisa noku buyisa izinqamuleli zemimoto. Umthetho Wezempilo Nokuphepha Emsebenzini. Inqubo yesiguransi nezicelo zokufuna imali lapho kwenzeke umlilo. Umthethosisekelo wokubusa ophathwa kuhulumeni (uma kunesidingo).
zu.duties: Phatha Imisebenzi Yokulungisa Amabhabhathizi: Qondisa imisebenzi yokulungisa amabhabhathizi nokulungisa izinqamuleli zezimoto. Hlela ukuhlola nokulungisa izimoto ezilimele ngesikhathi kwenzeke umlilo, qaphelisise izingathi zokuqedwa kokulungisa ukuze kuncishiswe isikhathi esize zingasebenzi izimoto, abelele umsebenzi kubasebenzi bokulungisa amabhabhathizi nabahlinzeki bemisebenzi, qinisekisa ukuthi ukulungisa kuqedwe ngokwezifiso zomkhiqizi nazinga eliphezulu, Qaphelisise ukusebenza kwendawo yokulungisa nokuqhuba kahle. Qaphelisise Abahlinzeki Namatheni: Hlolisisa ukusebenza kwamatheni nokulungisa amabhabhathizi nabahlinzeki, yenza ukuhlola ukuze kuqinisekiswe izinga nokuhozwa kwesivumelwano sezinga lenkonzo, phakamisa izindlela zokulungisa kwamatheni abasebenza kabi, sita imihlangano yokuhlola ukusebenza kwamatheni, Qaphelisise ukuhozwa kwamatheni ngokwezidingo zokuphepha, zokusingathwa kwendawo, nazinga eliphezulu. Phatha Ukulungisa Kwezimoto Ezenze Imlilo: Qapha ukuhlola nokubuka izimoto ezilimele, vuma izinani nezindlela zokulungisa, Hlela ukuxhumana namabhange wesiguransi, abahloli, namatheni bokulungisa, qaphelisise inqubo yokulungisa uxaze izinkinga ezihlobene nokulungisa, qinisekisa ukuthi izimoto ezilungisiwe zifanele ukuya esiqongweni ngaphambi kokukhululwa, Gcina irekhodi lezindleko zokulungisa lapho kwenzeke umlilo nokuqhathanisa. Phatha Izindleko Zokulungisa Inqwaba Kwezimoto Nesabelomali: Qaphelisise ukuchithwa kwemali ehlobene nokulungisa amabhabhathizi nalapho kwenzeke umlilo, Hlalisisa izindleko zokulungisa uphawule ithuba lokonga imali, qinisekise ukulunga kwezikweletu nezicelo zokukhokha, lukulungiselele iminikelo yesabelomali nemibiko yokuchitha, phakamisa izindlela zokusebenzisa kahle izindleko zokulungisa nokugcina. Qaphelisise Ukuhozwa Kwezimoto Nemigomo: Faka imigomo, inqubo, nazinga elihlobene nemisebenzi yokulungisa amabhabhathizi, qinisekisa ukuhozwa ngezidingo zezempilo nokuphepha emsebenzini, qaphelisise ukuhozwa ngomthetho wokuphathwa kwenqwaba kwezimoto nemiqondo yokubusa, sita ukuhlwa kwangaphakathi nangaphandle, faka izinyathelo zokulungisa eziphuma ekuhloleni. Phatha Abasebenzi Nokusebenza Kahle: Qapha aze aphuhlise abasebenzi bokulungisa amabhabhathizi, yenza ukuhlola ukusebenza uphathe izinkqubo zokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi, phawula izidingo zokuqeqesha nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono, khuthaza inqubo, ukusebenza kahle, nokusebenza ndawonye kuleyo nkalo, Sita ukuhozwa ngemigomo nangenqubo yabasebenzi.

Iinkqubo zokulunga iklaimu yomshikamlo nomonakalo. Inkqubo yomgaqo-siseko wolawulo lohulumeni wawowonke (ukuba kuyimfuno).
xh.duties: Phatha iMisebenzi yoKutya iphaneli: Qalisa imisebenzi yokutya iphaneli nokulungisa umzimba wezithuthu. Linganisa ukuvakwalweyo nokulungiswa kwezithuthu ezonakele ngenxa yeehingo, lilale ixesha elithathwayo kulungiso ukuze kuncitshelwe ixesha ezithuthu ezingasebenzi, zabelise umsebenzi kubasebenzi bokutya iphaneli nakubancedisi bokunika iinkonzo, qinisekisa ukuba ulungiso lugqityiwe ngokwemiqathango yomvelisi neemigangatho yekhwalithi, Lilale ukusebenza kwendawo yokusebenza nempumelelo. Lilale abaNikiwo beeNkonzo nabakhi: GXagula impumelelo yabakhi bath iphaneli kunye nabancedisi bokunika iinkonzo, yenze izilumkiso ukuyiqinisekisa ikhwalithi nokuhambelana nezenjongo zemigangatho yeenkonzo, icebise iindlela zokulungisa abenzi abangalunganga impumelelo, yenze iindibano ezimalunga nokuhlola impumelelo kwabakhi, Lilale ukuthobeka kwabakhi kupepeta kukhuseleko, ekusingqongweni, nakumigangatho yekhwalithi. Phatha uLungiso lweZithuthu eziHingwayo: Lilise ukuvakwalweyo nokulinganiswa kwezithuthu ezonakeleyo, vuma iingxengo zolungiso neendlela zolungiso, Lunganisa unxibelelwano naamashishini olu-akhicileko, abahloli, nabakhi bolungiso, lilale inkqubela yolungiso uxamle iinkinga ezingalungisanwa ulungiso, qinisekisa ukuba izithuthu ezilungisiwe zilungele umgama ngaphandle kokuzikhuphaza iitafile zexesha ekuqalweni, Gcina iirekhodi zeendleko zolungiso lweehingo kunye neendleko ezihambelana namaza. Phatha iiNdleko zoLungiso loQhiqho lweNqwelomshathi: Lilale iindleko ezimalunga nokutya iphaneli nokulungisa iihingo, Hlola iindleko zolungiso ukuze ufumane iindlela zokugcina indleko, qinisekisa ukuchanekiswa kweebhile kunye nezicelo ezimalunga nokuhlawulwa, lungise iimbaqi zemali eyindiliyo neengxelo zeindleko, icebise iindlelaokuyisengiso ezakunikezelwa yolungiso nokunqunjwa kwezithuthu. Lilale ukuhambelana koQhiqho lweNqwelomshathi noLawulo: Yenze iinkingada, iindlela, namazingatha aqulathe imisebenzi y yokutya iphaneli, qinisekisa ukuhambelana nemfuno yokhuseleko lokusebenza nempilo yomsebenzi, lilale ukuzithoba kolawulo lokulawulo iinkonzo zokuhamba namakhupu oqulathweyo, yenze ii-odi kwangaphakathi nakwasemva, yenze iintshukumo ezilungisa ezivela kumphumela we-odi. Phatha imiQamango yoBuntu neMveliso: Qondisa yakha abantu basebenza kwaneli yokutya iphaneli, yenze iimvavanyo zemveliso ulawule iindlela ezimalunga nokuqatshwa kwabasebenzi, chonga iimfuno zemfundo nokuqhubela phambili kwamakhono, khuthaza inkuliso, ukusebenza kakuhle, kunye nokusebenza njengesebenzi kwasekhouli, Yenze kuhambelane nemigaqo yobubantu neendlela ezikwimigaqo.

jobs.centre: Johannesburg (Head Office) REQUIRMENTS    :   An NQF level 6 National Diploma/NQF level 7 Bachelor’s Degree in behavioural/social science/ social work /psychology. Minimum of 2-3 years’ experience in the field of health and wellness and or gender, youth and disability management. Knowledge and Skills Relevant Legislation and Public Service Regulations, Understanding of expectations of customers, Knowledge of SLAs, Management information knowledge and Knowledge of GPG political and executive structures. Change management, Planning and organising, Strategy, Policy development, Project Management, People oriented, Financial Management, Knowledge of Acts governing Public Service, including Employment Equity, Public Service, Labour Relations, Basic Conditions of Service, Basic Human rights, Millennium development Goals, National Strategic Plan on Employee Health and Wellness, COIDA and OHSA.
jobs.summary: Senior Administrator Officer for Employee Health and Wellness at the Department of Roads and Transport in Johannesburg, requiring a diploma or degree in behavioural or social science with relevant experience.
jobs.duties: Raise employee awareness on healthy lifestyle matters through emails, newsletters and articles, Organize information sharing sessions and workshops on different lifestyle matters as guided by the health calendar, facilitate the activities of sports and recreation programme, distribute pamphlets and information brochure to employees on health and wellness, make all logistical arrangements e.g. Booking of boardrooms, catering and attendance registers and conduct awareness sessions on approved policies and programmes. Coordinate the provision of life skills coaching and mentorship programmes conducted by service providers or wellness specialists. Coordinate activities and provide secretariat services at wellness Committees eg. Wellness coordinator committee, peer educators committees, sports and recreation committees in the department. Provide administrative support on the services rendered by employee health and wellness contractors according to the agreed service standards. af.summary: Senior Administratiewe Beampte vir Werknemersgesondheid en -welstand by die Department of Roads and Transport in Johannesburg, wat 'n diploma of graad in gedrags- of sosiale wetenskappe met relevante ervaring vereis.
af.duties: Skep werknemerbewustheid oor gesonde leefstylaangeleenthede deur middel van e-posse, nuusbriewe en artikels; Reël inligtingsdelingsessies en werkswinkels oor verskillende leefstylaangeleenthede soos gelei deur die gesondheidskalender; fasiliteer die aktiwiteite van sport- en ontspanningsprogramme; versprei pamflette en inligtingsbrosjures aan werknemers oor gesondheid en welstand; tref alle logistieke reëlings bv. Bespreking van raadsale, etes en bywoningsregisters en voer bewustheidsessies oor goedgekeurde beleide en programme uit. Koördineer die voorsiening van lewensvaardigheidsogerigtings- en mentorskapsprogramme wat deur diensverskaffers of welstandspesialiste aangebied word. Koördineer aktiwiteite en verskaf sekretariaatsdienste by welstandkomitees bv. Welstandkoördineerderskomitee, portuurgewyse opvoederskomitees, sport- en ontspanningskomitees in die departement. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning oor die dienste wat deur werknemergesondheids- en -welstandkontrakteurs gelewer word volgens die ooreengekome dienstestandaarde. Hanteer administratiewe aangeleenthede wat verband hou met eise, fakture en betalings van die diensverskaffer. Neem op en hou lêers van alle fakture en kwitansies van bestellings en aankope wat deur die Eenheid gedoen is. Bestuur die logistieke reëlings van werkswinkels en die bespreking van plekke vir geleenthede. Bestuur vervoerreëlings en bespreking van akkommodasie vir die subdirektoraat. Hou rekords van vergaderings in die subdirektoraat. Verskaf insette in die ontwikkeling van EHW-beleide. Werk die konsepbeleid op en wysig dit volgens insette van belanghebbendes tydens konsultasies. Fasiliteer werkswinkels oor EHW en verduidelik beleide, riglyne en prosedures. Ousig oor administratiewe beamptes en internes. Verskaf mentorskap en opleiding.
