zu.title: Isikhulu Esiphezulu Sokuphathwa Kwezokqubitsho: Impilo Yabasebenzi Nokuphila Kahle
zu.summary: Isikhulu Esiphezulu Sokuphathwa Kwezokqubitsho seImpilo Yabasebenzi Nokuphila Kahle kuMnyango Wezokuhamba Nokuhanjiswa Kwezimpahla eJohannesburg, sifuna iziqu noma idiploma kwezenzululwazi zokuziphatha noma zomphakathi ezinhlobonhlobo okuhambisana namava ohlele.
zu.duties: Khulisa ukuqonda kwabasebenzi ngemibandela yendlela yokuphila empilweni ngokusebenzisa ama-imeyili, amatshicilelo amancane nemibhalo. Hlela izikhathi zokwabelana ngolwazi namagelela ngemikhakha ehlukene yokuphila njengokuqondiswa inkhalenda yezempilo, phefumulela imisebenzi yohlelo lwezemidlalo nezokuzjabulisa, abasebenzise amaphamfulethi namabhrosa ulwazi kubasebenzi ngezempilo nokuphila kahle, wenze wonke amalungiselelo ngokwendlela efana nokubhuka amagumbi okuhlanganela aphathwa kuyo, ukuphekwa nokudla kanye namafomu okubhalisa ubukhona, futhi uhlele izikhathi zokuqondisa ngemithetho nokuqondisa ohlelweni elamukelekile. Hlanganisa ukunikezwa kwezikhondo zezindlela zokuphila kanye nezinhlelo zokuqondisa nezokulekela ezinqunywe ngabahlinzeki besevisi noma ochwepheshe bezempilo nokuphila kahle. Hlanganisa imisebenzi futhi uhlinze ngesevisi yomabhalophethe Kumabhodhawezempilo Nokuphila Kahle njengakuKhomanisi Yezempilo Nokuphila Kahle, Khomanisi Yabafundisi Bahlanganyele, namakhomanisi ezemidlalo nezokuzjabulisa kumnyango. Hlinzeka ngenkxaso yokuphathwa kwezokqubitsho kusevisi ehiwe ngabakhiqizi bezempilo nokuphila kahle kwabasebenzi ngokuhambisana namazinga ebisevisi avunyiwe. Phatha izindaba zokuphathwa kwezokqubitsho ezihambisana nezimangalo, amafomu okukhokha kanye nezimali zokukhokha zabahlinzeki besevisi. Gcina amarekhodi futhi ugcinile wonke amafomu okukhokha kanye namasethifikethi oku-oda nokuthenga okwenziwe yilengo. Phatha amalungiselelo okuhlela amagelela nokubhuka izindawo zemikhakha yemicimbi. Phatha amalungiselelo okuhamba kanye nokubhuka izindawo zokuhlola kwesiqondiswa. Gcina amarekhodi emihlangano kwesiqondiswa. Nikela ngeminikelo ekwakhiweni kwemithetho ye-EHW. Buyekeza futhi ulungise umthetho ongakavunywa ngokuvumelana nezimalulelo abathintekayo ngesikhathi sokuxoxa. Phefumulela amagelela we-EHW ekucazululiswa imithetho, imiqondo nokuqondiswa. Qaphela abaphathi bezokqubitsho nabanakekelo. Hlinzeka nokuqondisa nokulekela. Hlinzeka ngenkxaso yokuphathwa ekuphathweni kwejikhaya lomsebenzi, ukwabiwa kwejikhaya kanye nezinto ongayikhetha. Hlanganisa amalungiselelo okuhleliswa ukuze kuqaliswe izinhlelo ze-EHW.

xh.title: Isebe Lomphathi Wongconathi: Impilo Yabasebenzi kwaye
xh.summary: Umphathi Wongconathi oPhakamileyo wezoLimo kwaye neNtlalontle yabaSebenzi kwiSebe lezeNdlela nokuHamba kwabantu eJohannesburg, lifuna idiploma okanye isidanga kwenzululwazi bokuziphatha okanye lentlalo kunye nolwazi olufanelekileyo.
xh.duties: Phakamisa isaziso sabasebenzi ngemiba yendlela ephilayo yempilo ngeimeyile, amanewsletters namanqaku. Cophela iinkqubo zokwabelana ngolwazi nangamajelo ngeemiba ezahlukeneyo zendlela ephilayo njengokuba kuchazwa ngokwekhalenda yempilo. Yenza iziseko kwiinkqubo zemidlalo yolwazi nemisebenzi yomzimba. Saza amapamphlet namabhrozere yolwazi kubasebenzi ngempilo nentlalontle. Yenza yonke iinkcukacha zolungiselelo umzekelo. Ukubhuka igumbi lebhodi, ukutya kwaye ufune iirejista zobukho uze uqhube iinkqubo zokuvakalisha kumapolisi namakhalenda avunyiweyo. Lawula ukubonelelwa kwinkqubo yokolunga ngobomi nokweluleka ngenkqubo eqhutywa ngabakho nabaqeqeshi bentlalontle. Lawula imisebenzi kwaye unike iinkonzo zesikolishi kwikomiti yentlalontle umzekelo. Ikomiti yolawulo yentlalontle, amakomiti abaqeqeshi bentsalgo, amakomiti emidlalo yolwazi nemisebenzi yomzimba kwisebe. Bonelela ngenkxaso yolawulo kwiinkonzo ezinikwa ngabaqeshi bempilo nentlalontle yabasebenzi ngokwesilinganiso seenkonzo esivunyelweyo. Phatha imiba yolawulo enxulumene neklaim, iinvoices nentlawulo yabanikezela inkonzo. Qamba kwaye gcina iifayile zonke iinvoices kwaye uqinisekise ukugcinwa kweenketho nokuthengwa okwenziwe ngumSebenzi. Lawula iinkcukacha zolungiselelo lwamajelo nobhuko lweendawo ngeziganeko. Lawula iinkcukacha zolawulo lokuhamba nendlela yokubhuka indawo yokuhlola kwisebe ngaphantsi komlawuli. Gcina iirekhodi zeendibano kwisebe ngaphantsi komlawuli. Nikela ngolwazi ekwakheni kwamapolisi EHW. Hlaziya kwaye ulungise idrafti yepolisi ngokwemiganekelo egqithiswayo ngabathengi ngexesha lembizo. Qhuba amajelo ngenkqubo EHW ngenkcazelo yamapolisi, imigaqo nolawulo. Qeqesha abasebenzi bolawulo kwaye qeqesha abafundi ngokwakho. Zise inkxaso yolawulo ekulawuleni inkqubo yeqokobhe leqokobhe, ukwaba kwamagumbi nemixelo encedisayo. Lawula iinkcukacha zolungiselelo lwenkqubo yokusebenza iinkqubo zolimo EHW.

jobs.title: Senior Admin Officer: Towing and Auctions
jobs.summary: Senior Admin Officer overseeing towing and auction services for the Gauteng Department of Roads and Transport in Bedfordview, requiring a National Diploma and 2-3 years relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: A minimum three year National Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Public Management or Public Administration or Business Management. 2-3 years relevant experience in towing and auctions at Salary Level 7. Knowledge of towing, auctions and vehicle assessments. Ability to implement and maintain simple, effective record keeping for towing and police clearances. Ability to liaise with towing merchants and RT46 contract administrators. Ability to coordinate relief vehicles based on the approved procedures and policy. Ability to coordinate enquiries from client departments, service providers and other stakeholders relating to withdrawn vehicles, towing and auctions. Valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Oversee Vehicle Life Cycle Programme (Repairs and Maintenance): Oversee the provision of towing and auction services to the entity, Liaise with client departments, service providers and other stakeholders on towing, auctions and vehicle assessments, Coordinate enquiries relating to withdrawn vehicles, towing and auctions, Implement and maintain simple, effective record-keeping systems for towing and police clearances, Liaise with towing merchants and RT46 contract administrators, Compile weekly, monthly and quarterly reports on towing, auctions and vehicle assessments, Coordinate the planning, development, implementation and monitoring of towing, auction and vehicle assessment activities. Coordinate Towing and Auction Administration: Compile and administer auction documentation. Obtain, verify and maintain TransUnion vehicle values for auction and disposal processes, Compile and maintain vehicle assessment reports and supporting documentation, monitor staff performance and maintain performance administration records within the unit, Document activities and compile weekly progress reports for review, Verify the execution of applicable maintenance procedures and administrative controls. Monitor Strategy and Development Initiatives: Review new business initiatives that affect towing, auctions and vehicle assessments, participate in approved projects and operational improvement initiatives within the area of responsibility, Assess the operational impact of new initiatives, projects and process changes, Communicate approved initiatives and process changes to relevant stakeholders, monitor implementation of approved changes and record their effect on service delivery. Supervise unit resources, including people management: Make budgetary recommendations and advise on spending, supervise resources to ensure effective services, implement sound management of human resources within the component, perform daily supervision of the section, Facilitate and encourage staff development to meet the changing demands of the job. Maintain Stakeholder Relationships and Monitor Continuous Improvement: Review operational processes and recommend continuous-improvement actions for towing, auctions and vehicle assessments., Maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to promote effective service delivery, Engage and negotiate with key stakeholders to facilitate compliance with towing and assessment requirements, Liaise and communicate with departments, customers, suppliers and other service providers, Coordinate an effective interface with other departmental staff, Monitor improvement actions against entity goals, service standards and customer requirements. Coordinate Relief Vehicle Administration Activities: Coordinate requests and allocation of relief vehicles to client departments in line with approved procedures, Verify vehicle availability, allocation approvals and supporting documentation before release, Record vehicle issue and return dates, mileage, fuel levels and vehicle condition in the relevant registers or systems, Monitor the duration of relief vehicle allocations and follow up on overdue returns, extensions and substitutions, Liaise with client departments and relevant internal units regarding relief vehicle availability, collection, return and replacement, Verify relief vehicles on issue and return and record any damages, defects or incidents for referral to the relevant unit. Compile weekly and monthly reports on relief vehicle allocations, utilisation, outstanding returns and exceptions.

af.title: Senior Administratiewe Beampte: Sleep en Veilings
af.summary: Senior Administratiewe Beampte wat oor sleep- en veilingdienste toesig hou vir die Gauteng Department of Roads and Transport in Bedfordview, wat 'n Nasionale Diploma en 2-3 jaar relevante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum driejarige Nasionale Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Openbare Bestuur of Openbare Administrasie of Besigheidsbestuur. 2-3 jaar relevante ervaring in sleep en veilings op Salary Level 7. Kennis van sleep, veilings en voertuigassesserings. Vermoë om eenvoudige, doeltreffende rekordhouding vir sleep en polisiële uitklarings te implementeer en te handhaaf. Vermoë om met sleephandelaars en RT46-kontrakadministrateurs te skakel. Vermoë om noodvoertuie te koördineer op grond van die goedgekeurde prosedures en beleid. Vermoë om navrae van kliëntdepartemente, diensverskaffers en ander belanghebbendes met betrekking tot onttrekte voertuie, sleep en veilies te koördineer. Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Oorsig oor Voertuiglewensiklusprogram (Herstelwerk en Onderhoud): Houd toesig oor die verskaffing van sleep- en veilingdienste aan die entiteit, Skakel met kliëntdepartemente, diensverskaffers en ander belanghebbendes oor sleep, veilings en voertuigassesserings, Koördineer navrae met betrekking tot onttrekte voertuie, sleep en veilings, Implementeer en handhaaf eenvoudige, doeltreffende rekordhoudingstelsels vir sleep en polisiële uitklarings, Skakel met sleephandelaars en RT46-kontrakadministrateurs, Stel weeklikse, maandelikse en kwartaalverslae oor sleep, veilings en voertuigassesserings op, Koördineer die beplanning, ontwikkeling, implementering en monitering van sleep-, veiling- en voertuigassesseringsaktiwiteite. Koördineer Sleep- en Veilingsadministrasie: Stel veilingdokumentasie op en administreer dit. Verkry, verifieer en handhaaf TransUnion-voertuigwaardes vir veiling- en besikikingsprosesse, Stel voertuigassesseringsverslae en ondersteunende dokumentasie op en handhaaf dit, moniteer personeelprestasie en handhaaf prestasie-administrasierekords binne die eenheid, Dokumenteer aktiwiteite en stel weeklikse vorderingsverslae vir hersiening op, Verifieer die uitvoering van toepaslike onderhoudsprosedures en administratiewe beheermaatreëls. Moniteer Strategie en Ontwikkelingsinisiatiewe: Hersien nuwe besigheidsinisiatiewe wat sleep, veilings en voertuigassesserings beïnvloed, neem deel aan goedgekeurde projekte en operasionele verbeteringsinisiatiewe binne die areas van verantwoordelikheid, Assesseer die operasionele impak van nuwe inisiatiewe, projekte en prosesveranderinge, Kommuniseer goedgekeurde inisiatiewe en prosesveranderinge aan relevante belanghebbendes, moniteer implementering van goedgekeurde veranderinge en rekord hul uitwerking op dienslewering. Hou toesig oor eenheidsbronne, insluitend personeelbestuur: Maak begrotingsaanbevelings en gee advies oor besteding, hou toesig oor bronne om doeltreffende dienste te verseker, implementeer deeglike bestuur van menslike hulpbronne binne die komponent, verrig daaglikse toesig oor die afdeling, Fasiliteer en moedig personeelontwikkeling aan om aan die veranderende eise van die werk te voldoen. Handhaaf Belanghebbendesverhoudinge en Moniteer Deurlopende Verbetering: Hersien operasionele prosesse en beveel deurlopende verbeteringsaksies vir sleep, veilings en voertuigassesserings aan., Handhaaf sterk verhoudinge met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes om doeltreffende dienslewering te bevorder, Betrek en onderhandel met sleutelbelanghebbendes om nakoming van sleep- en assesseringsvereistes te fasiliteer, Skakel en kommunikeer met departemente, kliënte, verskaffers en ander diensverskaffers, Koördineer 'n doeltreffende skakelvlak met ander departementele personeel, Moniteer verbeteringsaksies teen entiteitsdoelwitte, diensstandaarde en kliëntvereistes. Koördineer Noodvoertuigadministrasie-aktiwiteite: Koördineer versoeke en toekenning van noodvoertuie aan kliëntdepartemente in ooreenstemming met goedgekeurde prosedures, Verifieer voertuigbeskikbaarheid, toekenninggoedkeurings en ondersteunende dokumentasie voor vrylating, Rekord voertuiguitreiking- en terugbesorgdatums, kilometerstand, brandstofvlakke en voertuigtoestand in die relevante registers of stelsels, Moniteer die duur van noodvoertuigtoekenninge en volg oortydige terugbesorgings, verlengings en vervangings na, Skakel met kliëntdepartemente en relevante interne eenhede rakende noodvoertuigbeskikbaarheid, afhaal, terugbesorging en vervanging, Verifieer noodvoertuie by uitreiking en terugbesorging en rekord enige skade, gebreke of voorvalle vir verwysing na die relevante eenheid. Stel weeklikse en maandelikse verslae oor noodvoertuigtoekenninge, benutting, uitstaande terugbesorgings en uitsonderings op.

zu.title: Isikhundla Sobuhlakani Obuphezulu Sokuphatha: Ukubuyisela Izimoto Nokuthengiswa Kwempahla Phakathi Kwabantu
zu.summary: Isikhundla sobuhlakani obuphezulu sokuphatha esibheke ukubuyisela izimoto nokuthengiswa kwempahla phakathi kwabantu kuGauteng Department of Roads and Transport eBedfordview, esifuna i-National Diploma nephuzu lokunyuka kwemisebenzi elinganiselwe kwa-2-3.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF Level 6) ezothatha ubuncane eminyaka emithathu kwi-Public Management noma i-Public Administration noma i-Business Management. Iminyaka engu-2-3 yemva ekubuyiseleni izimoto nokuthengisini impahla phakathi kwabantu ku-Salary Level 7. Ulwazi ngokubuyisela izimoto, ukuthengiswa kwempahla phakathi kwabantu kanye nokuhlola izimoto. Isikhathi sokulondoloza amarekhodu amlula futhi asebenzayo ngokubuyisela izimoto nokutholakala kwezimoto zephoyisa. Ukuxhumana nabathengisi bokubuyisela izimoto nabaphathi bekhonthulakti be-RT46. Ukulungiselela izimoto zokubuyisela ngokusekelwe emigomweni nemithelela evunyiwe. Ukulungiselela imibuzo evela kwiminyango yabakhiqizi, kubakhiqizela izinsizakalo kwezinye iziphathimandla ngokuhlobene nezimoto eziyinkiwe, ukubuyisela izimoto nokuthengiswa kwempahla phakathi kwabantu. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Ukubheka Uhlelo Lwesikhathi Sephoyisa Lemiyo (Izilungiselelo Nokugcinwa Kweminyango): Ukubheka ukunikezwa kwezinsizakazo zokubuyisela izimoto nokuthengiswa kwempahla phakathi kwabantu, Ukuxhumana neminyango yabakhiqizi, abakhiqizela izinsizakazo kwezinye iziphathimandla ngokubuyisela izimoto, ukuthengiswa kwempahla nokuhlola imiyo, Ukulungiselela imibuzo eblahenekela izimoto eziyinkiwe, ukubuyisela izimoto nokuthengiswa kwempahla phakathi kwabantu, Ukusebenzisa nokugcina amasistimu amlula okulondoloza amarekhodu ngokubuyisela izimoto nokutholakala kwezimoto zephoyisa, Ukuxhumana nabathengisi bokubuyisela izimoto nabaphathi bekhonthulakti be-RT46, Ukwenza okubikwa ngezinsuku zamasonto, nyanga zanye kanye nenyanga ezintathu ngokubuyisela izimoto, ukuthengiswa kwempahla nokuhlola imiyo, Ukulungiselela ukucubungula, ukuthuthukisa, ukusebenzisa nokubheka imisebenzi yokubuyisela izimoto, ukuthengiswa kwempahla nokuhlola imiyo. Ukulungiselela Ukuphathwa Kokubuyisela Izimoto Nokuthengiswa Kwempahla Phakathi Kwabantu: Ukwenza nokuphatha amadokhumenti okuthengiswa impahla. Ukuthola, ukuqinisekisa nokugcina amanani ezimoto eTransUnion ukwenzela ukuthengiswa kanye namasudesi okulahla imiyo, Ukwenza nokugcina amabhuku okuhlola imiyo kanye namadokhumenti okusekela, Ukubheka imisebenzi yabasebenzi nokugcina amarekhodu okuphatha imisebenzi endaweni, Ukuqamba imisebenzi kanye nokwenza okubikwa ngezinsuku zamasonto mayelana nokuqhubekela phambili, Ukuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwemikhuba yokugcinwa kwezilungiselelo nokuqinisekiswa kokuphathwa kwezinto. Ukubheka Izindlela Zokuqala Nokuthuthukiswa Okusha: Ukubheka izinhloso ezintsha zomchakazo ezithinta ukubuyisela izimoto, ukuthengiswa kwempahla nokuhlola imiyo, ukubamba iqhaza emiklonyelweni evunyiwe nasemikhubeni yezobusebenza emhlabeni wakho konke, Ukuhlola umthelela wokuqala ezinhlelweni ezintsha, emiklonyelweni nasemishineni eshintshayo, Ukumayelana nezinhlelo ezintsha ezivunyiwe kanye nokushintsha kwemikhuba kunabahlotshanayo, ukubheka ukusetshenziswa kwezinto ezintsha ezivunyiwe kanye nokurekhoda umthelela wazo ekunikeleni ngezinsizakazo. Ukubheka izinsizakalo zendawo, okuhlanganisa ukuphathwa kwabantu: Ukwenza izincomo zamabhajethi kanye nokweluleka ngokuchitha imali, ukubheka izinsizakazo ukuze kuqinisekiswe izinsizakazo ezisebenzayo, ukusebenzisa ukuphathwa okuhle kwabesabasebenzi esigabeni, ukubheka ngemihla yonke isigaba, Ukulekela kanye nokuqasha ukuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi ukubhedeza imfuno eshintshayo yomsebenzi. Ukugcyna Izinhlobonhlobo Nabahlotshanayo Nokubheka Ukuthuthuka Okuqhubekayo: Ukubheka imikhuba yokusebenza kwaye ukwenze izincomo zokuthuthuka okuqhubekayo ngokubuyisela izimoto, ukuthengiswa kwempahla nokuhlola imiyo, Ukugcina ubuhlobo obuhle nabahlotshanayo baphakathi nangaphandle ukuthuthukisa inikezelo elilula lezinsizakazo, Ukuxhumana kwaye uhle bathi nabahlotshanayo abalulekile ukuze kusize ukulandelwa kwemigomo ngokubuyisela izimoto nokuqinisekisa imfuneko, Ukuxhumana nokuthumela imiyalezo kwiminyango, amakhasimidi, abahlinzela abanye kwaye oqashwa bona, Ukulungiselela isixhumanisi esisebenzayo nabesabasebenzi baleminyango, Ukubheka izenzo zokuthuthuka ngokulandelana kwamagcilgci womkhakha, izinkomba zomtholampilo namafunuwo yomthengisi. Ukulungiselela ukuphathwa kweziMoto Zokusiza Abantu: Ukulungiselela izicelo kanye nokwabiwa kwezimoto zokusiza kwiminyango yabakhiqizi ngokulandelana nemigomo evunyiwe, Ukuqinisekisa ukutholakala kwemoto, ukuvunyelwa kokwabelwa kwemoto kanye namadokhumenti okusekela ngaphambi kokukhishwa, Ukurekhoda amasuku okukhishwa nokubuyiselwa kwemoto, amakhilomitha, amazinga kagesi futhi uhlole imoto ezibalulekile noma kwisistimu, Ukubheka isikhathi esithathwe ukwabelwa kwezimoto zokusiza nokulandela izinto ezingabuyiswa ngosuku olwedlule, ukunwetshwa kanye nokushintshana, Ukuxhumana neminyango yabakhiqizi kwaye namanyunthu angaphakathi abalulekile ngokutholakala kwemoto yokusiza, ukuthunyelwa, ukubuyiselwa kwaye okushintshayo, Ukuqinisekisa izimoto zokusiza ekukhishweni nakubuyisweni kwaye urekhode noma yiziphi izinkinga, iziphazamisi noma izehlakalo ukuze zithunyelwe kwesinye isigaba. Ukwenza okubikwa ngezinsuku zamasonto ngenyanga zonye ngokwabelwa kwezimoto zokusiza, ukusetshenziswa, izinto ezingabuyiswa ngosuku olwedlule kwezinto ezingajwayelekile.

xh.title: Umphathi oMkhulu woMlawulo: UkuGqithisa nokuThengisa ngaphandle kobungeno neLungelo
xh.summary: Umphathi oMkhulu woMlawulo oqhelisa iinkonzo zokugqithisa nokuthengisa ngaphandle kobungeno neLungelo kwiSebe lezeMigaqo nokuHamba kweGauteng eBedfordview, ofuna iNcwadi yeDiploma yesiZwe kunye neminyaka eli-2-3 yamava ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: INcwadi yeDiploma yamashumi amathathu eminyaka ubuncinane (iNqanaba le-6 le-NQF) kuLawulo loLuntu okanye uLawulo boluSebenziso lokuLuntu okanye uLawulo loShishino. Iminyaka eli-2-3 yamava ahambelanayo ekugqithiseni nokuthengiseni ngaphandle kobungeno neLungelo kuMvuzo weNqanaba le-7. Ulwazi ngokugqithisa, ukuthengisa ngaphandle kobungeno neLungelo nokuhlola izithuthi. Amandla okusebenzisa kwaye zigcine iirekhodi ezilula, ezisebenzayo zokugqithisa nokucoca igcina polisa. Amandla axhumanisa nabathengisi bokugqithisa kunye nabalawuli besivumelwano se-RT46. Amandla okuhlela izithuthi zesondo ngokwezinqwelomiso ezivunyiweyo nenqubomgomo. Amandla okuhlela imibuzo evela kumasebe abathengi, ababoneleli beenkonzo nakwezinye iindidi zomnxhasi mayela ngezithuthi ezikhutshiweyo, ukugqithisa nokuthengisa ngaphandle kobungeno neLungelo. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Qhathamela iNkqubo yeSithuba soBomi beSithuthi (Izilungiso nokuGunyaziswa): Qhathamela ukubonelela iinkonzo zokugqithisa nokuthengisa ngaphandle kobungeno neLungelo kwinto, Xhumanisa namasebe abathengi, ababoneleli beenkonzo nakwezinye iindidi zomnxhasi ngokugqithisa, ukuthengisa ngaphandle kobungeno neLungelo nokuhlola izithuthi, Hlela imibuzo ehambelanayo nezithuthi ezikhutshiweyo, ukugqithisa nokuthengisa ngaphandle kobungeno neLungelo, Sebenzisa kwaye ugcine iinkqubo ezilula, ezisebenzayo zokugcina iirekhodi zokugqithisa nokucoca igcina polisa, Xhumanisa nabathengisi bokugqithisa kunye nabalawuli besivumelwano se-RT46, Qamba iingxelo ezivezimbini, ezinyanga nakwiikhota ngeenkokhelo zokugqithisa, ukuthengisa ngaphandle kobungeno neLungelo nokuhlola izithuthi, Hlela ukuqamba, ukuphuhlisa, ukusebenzisa kwaye ulinde iinkqubo zokugqithisa, ukuthengisa ngaphandle kobungeno neLungelo nokuhlola izithuthi. Hlela uLawulo lokugqithisa nokuThengisa ngaphandle kobungeno neLungelo: Qamba kwaye ulawule uxwebhu lokuthengisa ngaphandle kobungeno neLungelo. Thola, qinisekisa kwaye ugcize iinxibe zezithuthi zeTransUnion zenkqubo yokuthengisa ngaphandle kobungeno neLungelo nokuqhotyoshwa, Qamba kwaye ugcine iingxelo zokuhlola izithuthi nexwebhu elixhasayo, linda ukusebenza kwabasebenzi kwaye ugcine iirekhodi zolawulo lokusebenza ngaphakathi kweyunithi, Cacisa iinkqubo kwaye uqambe iingxelo ezivezimbini zent progressa ukuba kwiqaphelo, Qinisekisa ukuphumeza iinkqubo zokuGunyaziswa nolawulo lolawulo lokusebenza okufanelekileyo. Linda umGama noPhuhliso lwemiQulu esele ixhasiwe: Phengula imiqulu yoshishino emitsha echitha ukugqithisa, ukuthengisa ngaphandle kobungeno neLungelo nokuhlola izithuthi, thabatha inxaxheba kumaphulo aqvunyiweyo nemiQulu yokuPeleza nokusebenza ngaphakathi kommandla woxanduva lomntu, Hlola impembelelo yommandla yemiQulu emitsha, amaphulo kwaye utshintshe iinkqubo, Xhumana kuze nitsalele ngokubonelela iinkcukacha zemigibe evunyiweyo nakutshintshwe iinkqubo kubambe iqondo abalulekileyo, linda ukuphunyezwa kwezitshintsho ezivunyiweyo kwaye ubhale negalelo ekubonelelweni ngeenkonzo. Qhobosa amacebo eeyunithi, kuquka ulawulo abantu: Zenza izindulela zebhajeti kwaye unikezelwe ingcebiso ngokuchithwa kolawula amacebo ukuqinisekisa iinkonzo ezisebenzayo, sebenzisa ulawulo oluhle lwemisebenzi yabantu ngaphakathi kwengxenye, yenza ukulawula kwansuku zonke isexeshana, Yenzela kwaye khuthaza ukuphuhlisa kwabasebenzi ukuze bahambelane neemfuno ezitshintshayo zomsebenzi. Gcina uBudlelwane baboNaBantu abanomdla ukuze uLinde ukuPeleza kuQhaphelo okuQhubekayo: Phengula iinkqubo zommandla kwaye uzeke iinkqubo ezixhasa iMiba yokuPeleza kokugqithisa, ukuthengisa ngaphandle kobungeno neLungelo nokuhlola izithuthi., Gcina ubudlelwane obuqinileyo nabantu abanomdla bangaphakathi nangaphandle ukuze kuguqulelwe ukubonelelwa ngeenkonzo ezisebenzayo, Thabatha inxaxheba kwaye uxoxe nabantu abanomdla abalulekileyo ukuze kwenziwe ukulawuleka kokugqithisa nokuqinisekiswa kweemfuno zokuqhuba nokuhlola, Xhumanisa kwaye unxibelelane namasebe, abathengi, ababoneleli nakwezinye iinkonzo ezinikezela iinkonzo, Hlela ingqikitho ebalulekileyo namalungu oSebe abasebenza ngaphakathi kwesebe elinye, Linda iinkqubo zokulungiselela iMiba ngokumalinganiswe namaphupha eNtshi, iMilinganiselo yeNkonzo neemfuno zabathengi. Hlela iNkqubo yokuLawula iziThuthi zeVili ezinokuSetyenziswa esikhundleni: Hlela iimfuno kunye nokuqulunqa izithuthi ezahlukeneyo kwii-Departments zabo mthengi ngokwezinqwelomiso ezivunyiweyo, Qinisekisa isithuthi esikho, izaziso ngenqanaba esivunyiweyo nexwebhu elixhasayo ngaphambi kokunikwa iNkxaso, Bhala iintsuku ezinikiweyo nokubuyiswa kwesithuthi, iKilomitha, iMilinganiselo yamafutha nesiQithi sesithuthi kwiibhuku noma kwiinkqubo ezifanelekileyo, Linda isikhathi esabalelo lwesithuthi esinikwe ngokuthintela nokuqinisekisa ukubuyiswa okuphinde ukubhaliswa ngexesha, okwandiswa nokubuyiswa okungafaniyo, Xhumanisa namaDepartments abathengi neeyunithi ezikummandla mayela nokubakho kokubonelela izithuthi esikhundleni, ukubuyiswa, ukubuyiswa ngokutsha nokutshintshwa kwesithuthi esinikwa esikhundleni, Qinisekisa ukunikwa kwesithuthi esibuyiswa kwaye ubhale nayiphi na imonakalo, iziphene okanye iinkcaphepha ezikumaxhiba onke ukuba zithunyelwe kwiyunithi efanelekileyo. Qamba iingxelo ezivezimbili nenyanga ngeMiba yokubonelela izithuthi ezingeniswa esikhundleni, ukusetyenziswa, iingxelo ezibuyisiweyo ezingekho nemiBa eNgekhoyo.

jobs.reference_number: REFS/057127 Chief Directorate: Transport Support Services
jobs.title: Senior Admin Officer: Loss Control and Vehicle Monitoring
jobs.summary: Senior admin officer overseeing loss control and vehicle monitoring for the Gauteng Department of Roads and Transport in Bedfordview.
jobs.requirements: A minimum three year National Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Public Administration, Transport Management, Logistics Management, Business Administration, Fleet Administration. 3 to 5 years' experience in fleet administration, vehicle monitoring, transport operations, or fleet management at Salary Level 7. Experience working with vehicle tracking and telematics systems. Supervisory experience may be required. Valid Driver’s License. Knowledge: Fleet management principles and practices. Vehicle tracking and telematics systems. Road Traffic Regulations. Fleet policies and procedures. Data analysis and reporting. Contract and service provider management. Risk management principles.
jobs.duties: Maintain Fleet Vehicle Utilisation: Monitor fleet vehicles through vehicle tracking and telematics systems, Track vehicle movements, mileage, utilization, fuel consumption, and driver behaviour, identify irregularities such as unauthorized trips, excessive idling, speeding, and vehicle misuse, monitor optimal allocation and utilization of fleet vehicles, generate daily, weekly, and monthly vehicle monitoring reports. Monitor fleet compliance and governance requirements: oversee compliance with organizational fleet policies and procedures, monitor vehicle licenses, roadworthy certificates, permits, and insurance documentation, verify adherence to transport regulations and operational standards, Maintain accurate fleet records and audit-ready documentation. Reporting and Data Analysis: Analyze vehicle tracking data and identify trends, prepare management reports on fleet performance and utilization, Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) relating to fleet operations, provide recommendations to improve operational efficiency and reduce costs. Supervise Administrative and Operational Processes: Maintain driver profiles and records, Monitor driver compliance with fleet policies, Report incidents of vehicle misuse, speeding, and non-compliance, Support driver awareness and corrective action initiatives, Verify fuel transactions against vehicle usage data, Identify and report potential fuel abuse or fraud, assist in implementing fuel-saving initiatives. Support Stakeholder and Customer Services: Liaise with internal departments regarding vehicle usage and allocation, respond to vehicle monitoring queries and requests, provide fleet information to management and external stakeholders, Maintain effective relationships with service providers and fleet users. Supervise resources: Provide operational guidance and support to the component, Supervise and support staff in the execution of daily activities, monitor utilization of financial and operational resources within the unit, compile budgetary input and provide recommendations on operational resource requirements, facilitate staff development and promote continuous improvement within the component.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Khutso Motshekga Tel No: (010) 345 1538
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: online at https//jobs.gauteng.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applicant must ensure that they complete all sections on the online Z83 and attached a detailed CV with at least three (3) contactable references. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, identity document and driver’s license on or before the day of the interview. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). The National Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. Preference may be given to appointable applicants from the underrepresented designated groups in terms of the Department’s equity plan. Persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply. Correspondence will be limited to successful candidates only. Short-listed candidates will be subjected to screening and security vetting to determine their suitability for employment, including but not limited to: Criminal records; Citizenship status; Credit worthiness; Previous employment (reference checks); and Qualification verification. Short-listed candidates will be expected to avail themselves at the Department’s convenience. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: In terms of the Directive on Compulsory Capacity Development, Mandatory Training Days & Minimum Entry Requirements for SMS that was introduced on 1 April 2015, a requirement for all applicants for SMS posts from 1 April 2020 is a successful completion of the Senior Management PreEntry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG) prior to appointment. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-preentryprogramme.                 All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the interview and technical assessment for all SMS posts, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency-based assessments. Persons appointed will be subjected to a security clearance, the signing of performance agreement and employment contract. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment. If you have not been contacted within three 3 months after the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. By submitting the employment application form, you agree and consent in terms of Section 11(1) of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), 2013 (Act 4 of 2013), for your personal information which you provide to the DFFE to being processed by the department and its employees, agents, Cabinet committees, and subcontractors for recruitment purposes, in accordance with the POPIA of 2013. For general enquiries please conduct Human Resources on 010 345 1535. NB: If you do not receive any response within 3 months, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. No faxed, post or hand delivered, and late applications will be considered.

af.title: Senior Administratiewe Beampte: Verliesbeheer en Voertuigmonitering
af.summary: Senior administratiewe beampte wat toesig hou oor verliesbeheer en voertuigmonitering vir die Gauteng Department of Roads and Transport in Bedfordview.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum driejaar Nasionale Diploma (Vlak 6) in Publieke Administrasie, Vervoerbestuur, Logistieke Bestuur, Besigheidsadministrasie, of Vlootadministrasie. 3 tot 5 jaar ervaring in vlootadministrasie, voertuigmonitering, vervoerbedrywighede of vlootbestuur op Salarisvlak 7. Ervaring in die werk met voertuigopsporings- en telematikastelsels. Toesigervaring kan vereis word. Geldige bestuurderlisensie. Kennis: Beginsels en praktyke van vlootbestuur. Voertuigopsporing- en telematikastelsels. Padverkeerregulasies. Vlootbeleide en -prosedures. Data-analise en verslagdoening. Kontrak- en diensverskaffersbestuur. Risikobestuurbeginsels.
af.duties: Onderhou vlootvoertuigbenutting: Monitor vlootvoertuie deur middel van voertuigopsporing en telematikastelsels. Monitor voertuigbewegings, kilometerstand, benutting, brandstofverbruik en bestuursgedrag. Identifiseer onreëlmatighede soos ongemagtigde reise, oormatige ledige loop, spoedoortredings en wanbuik van voertuie. Monitor optimale toedeling en benutting van vlootvoertuie. Genereer daaglikse, weeklikse en maandelikse voertuigmoniteringsverslae. Monitor vlootkopsluit en goeie bestuursvereistes: verseem dat daar aan organisasie se vlootbeleid en prosedures voldoen word; monitor voertuiglisensies, padwaardigheidsbewyse, permitte en versekeringsdokumentasie; verifieer voldoening aan vervoerregulasies en operasionele standaarde; onderhou akkurate vlootrekords en oudit-klare dokumentasie. Verslagdoening en data-analise: Analiseer voertuigopsporingsdata en identifiseer tendense; berei bestuursverslae oor vlootprestasie en benutting voor; monitor sleutelprestasie-aanduiders (KPI's) met betrekking tot vlootbedrywighede; doen aanbevelings om operasionele doeltreffendheid te verbeter en koste te verminder. Oulseen administratiewe en operasionele prosesse: Onderhou bestuurderprofiele en -rekords. Monitor bestuurders se voldoening aan vlootbeleid. Rapporteer gevalle van voertuigmisbruik, spoedoortredings en nie-voldoening. Ondersteun bestuurdersbewustheid en korrektiewe optrede-inisiatiewe. Verifieer brandstoftransaksies teen voertuiggebruiksdata. Identifiseer en rapporteer potensiële brandstofmisbruik of bedrog; help met die implementering van brandstofbesparingsinisiatiewe. Ondersteun belanghebbende- en kliëntedienswerk: Skakel met interne departemente rakende voertuiggebruik en -toedeling. Reageer op voertuigmoniteringsnavrae en -versoeke. Verskaf vlootinligting aan bestuur en eksterne belanghebbendes. Onderhou effektiewe verhoudings met diensverskaffers en vlootgebruikers. Oorseen bates: Verskaf operasionele leiding en ondersteuning aan die komponent. Oorseen en ondersteun personeel met die uitvoering van daaglikse take. zu.duties: Gcina ukusetshenziswa kwamashobo ezimoto: Hlola amashobo ezimoto ngokusebenzisa amasistimu wokulandela izimoto nabuchwepheshe bokuthumela idatha; Landela ukunyakaza kwamashobo, ibanga eliwohliwe, ukusetshenziswa, ukusetshenziswa kaphethiloli, nokuziphatha komshayeli; qaphela okungalanga njengokuhamba okungavunyelwe, ukuma isikhathi eside kakhulu, ukugijima ngesivinini esikhulu, kanye nokusetshenziswa izimoto ngendlela engalungile; hlola ukwabiwa okulinganiselwe nokusetyenziswa kwamashobo ezimoto; ukukhiqiza amapheshana okuhlola izimoto nsuku zonke, masonto, nanyanga. Hlola ukulandelana kwemithetho yokulawula amashobo nezidingo zobuholi: qapha ukulandelana kwezinqubomgomo namasu okuqasha amashobo esikhungweni; hlola amalayisense ezimoto, izitifiketi zokuba zihambeka ngokumthetho wasegadi, izivumelwano, namaxwebhu okwesiguransi; qinisekisa ukulandelana kwezimiso zohambo namazinga okusebenza; Gcina irekhodi eliqinisekile lamashobo namaxwebhu alungele ukuhlolwa. Ukubika nokuHlaziywa kweDatha: Hlaziywa idatha yokulandela izimoto bese uphawula izinkomba ezibonakalayo; lungiselela amapheshana abaphathi ngokwenza kahle nokusetshenziswa kwamashobo; Hlola izinkomba eziyinhloko zokwenza kahle ezihlobene nezimisebenzi zamashobo; nikeza izeluleko ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kahle kanye nokunciphisa izindleko. Busa izinqubo zokuQashwa kanye nokusebenza: Gcina iprofayili namarekhodi abashayeli; Hlola ukulandelana kwabashayeli nezinqubomgomo zokuqasha amashobo; Bika izehlakalo zokusetshenziswa izimoto ngendlela engalungile, ukugijima ngesivinini esikhulu, nokungadeli imithetho; Sekela amasu okuqonda ukushayela nokwenza izinyathelo zokulungisa; Qinisekisa izinguqubo zokuthenga phethiloli ngokuqhathaniswa kwedatha yokusetshenziswa izimoto; Qaphela futhi ubike ukuphathwa kakhudlwana phethiloli noma ukwenza ngokungenisa amathalaku; siza ekusebenziseni amasu okonga phethiloli. Sekela abanakekelwa bamaphoyinti kanye nabakhokhelwa bayo: Xhumana namapheshele angaphakathi mayelana nokusetshenziswa nokuqashwa kwamashobo ezimoto; bheka imibuzo nezicelo ezihlobene nokuhlola izimoto bese uyaphendula; nikeza ulwazi ngamashobo kubaphathi namaphoyinti angaphandle; Gcina ubudlelwano obuhlakaniphile nabahlinzeki nabashayeli bamashobo ezimoto. Buka kanye nokusekela abantu: Nikeza ohlelweni isiqondiso sokusebenza kanye nousekelo; Buka kanye nokuqondisa abantu ekwenzeni imisebenzi yansuku zonke; hlola ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zokusebenza kanye nezimali ngaphakathi kohlelo; hlanganisa okufakwayo ebhajethi bese unikeza izeluleko ngemithombo yesabelo esidingekayo; khuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwabantu bese ukhuthaza ukuthuthuka okungapheli ohlelweni.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Wokulawula Iilahleko Nokuqaphela Izithuthi: Isikhulu Esingumlawuli Owegqithileyo
xh.summary: Isikhulu esingumlawuli owegqithileyo esibukeza ukulawula iilahleko nokuqaphela izithuthi kwisebe le-Gauteng Department of Roads and Transport eBedfordview.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma yeminyaka emithathu (NQF Level 6) kwi-Public Administration, Transport Management, Logistics Management, Business Administration, Fleet Administration. 3 to 5 years' experience ekulawulweni kwamagumba ezithuthi, ekuqapheleni izithuthi, kumasebe ezithuthi, okanye ekulawulweni kwamagumba ezithuthi kwi-Salary Level 7. Esiphiwo sokusebenza namajelo okulandelela izithuthi namajelo e-telematics. Kungenzeka kufunekwe esiphiwo sobuntu obakhe isikhokelo. I-Driver's License esemthethweni. Ulwazi: Iimvisiswano nezimbo zokulawula amagumba ezithuthi. Amajelo okulandelela izithuthi namajelo e-telematics. Imigaqo yoNtraffic yoMzila. Iinkqubo nemigaqo yamagumba ezithuthi. Ukuhlaziya i-data nokwenza iingxelo. Ukulawula kontrathi nabahanisi benkonzo. Iimvisiswano zokulawula ingozi.
xh.duties: Ukugcina Ukusetyenziswa kwamagumba ezithuthi: Qaphela amagumba ezithuthi ngamajelo okulandelela izithuthi namajelo e-telematics, Landelela iintshukumo zezithuthi, ibhanoyi, ukusetyenziswa, ukutsha kwezithuthi, nendlela abashumayeli behamba ngayo, chonga okungahoyiyo njengohambo olungenagunya, ukulinda isithuba eside kakhulu, ukugijima ngamdla, nokusetyenziswa kakubi kwezithuthi, qaphela ukwabiwa okulungileyo nokusetyenziswa kwamagumba ezithuthi, yenza iingxelo zokuqaphela izithuthi zemihla yonke, yanga, nenyanga. Qaphela ukuthobela imigaqo nemfuneko kolawulo lwamagumba ezithuthi: qaphela ukuthobela iinkqubo nemigaqo zolawulo lwamagumba ezithuthi, qaphela amaphepha-mvume ezithuthi, izatifikethi zokuqinisekisa ukusemthethweni ezithuthi, iipemit, namaxwebhu esixhobo sokhuseleko, qinisekisa ukuthobela imigaqo yokuthutha neemfuneko ezisezantsi, Gcina iirekhodi ezichanekileyo zamagumba ezithuthi namaxwebhu alungele ukuhlolwa. Ukwenza iingxelo nokuHlaziya i-Data: Hlaziya i-data yokulandelela izithuthi uze uchonge iintshukumo, lungiselela iingxelo zolawulo ngemveliso nokusetyenziswa kwamagumba ezithuthi, Qaphela izalathisi ezibalulekileyo zokuphumeza iziphumo (KPIs) ezidityaniswa nemisebenzi yamagumba ezithuthi, nike iingcebiso zokuphucula isipho sovakalelo sokusebenza uze unciphise iindleko. Lawula iinkqubo Zokulawula nokuSebenza: Gcina iiprofayile namarekhodi abashumayeli, Qaphela ukuthobela abashumayeli kwiinkqubo nemigaqo zamagumba ezithuthi, Yenza iingxelo ngezenzo zokusetyenziswa kakabi kwezithuthi, ukugijima ngamdla, nokungathobelwa, Xhasa amaqhinga okuqaphela abashumayeli nokuthatha izinyathelo zokulungisa, Qinisekisa iintengiso zefuel ngokuchasene ne-data yokusetyenziswa kwezithuthi, Chonga uze uxele iinkqubo zokusetyenziswa kakabi nefuel okanye ukukrekeza, ncede ekusekenzeni iinqobo ezilondoloza ifuel. Xhasa oomama bentsapho nabathengi: Thetha namasebe angaphakathi malungana nokusetyenziswa nokwabiwa kwezithuthi, phendula imibuzo nokuqaphela izithuthi, nike ulwazi ngeqela kubalawuli nakumaxwebhu abangenaphandle, Gcina ubudlelwane obusebenzayo nabahanisi benkonzo nabasebenzisi bamagumba ezithuthi. Lawula iimpahla: Nike isikhokelo sovakalelo nentsombo kul candelo, Lawula uze uxhase abasebenzi ekuphumezeni izenzo zemihla yonke, qaphela ukusetyenziswa kweempahla zezimali nentshebenzo kwicandelo, qamba izimvo ezifakwa kwisithubi ngenkcazelo uze unike iingcebiso ngeemfuno zeempahla zentshebenzo, xhasa ntlaluse inkqubela phambili yabasebenzi uze ukhuthaze ukuphucuka ngokuchasene nendlela kwicandelo.

jobs.title: Admin Officer: Accidents and Traffic Fines
jobs.summary: Admin officer needed in Bedfordview to manage fleet accidents and traffic fines, requiring a relevant diploma and 2-3 years' public service fleet experience.
jobs.requirements: A minimum three year National Diploma (NQF Level 6): Transport Management, Fleet Management, Public Management, Public Administration, 2-3 years’ experience in the fleet environment in the Public Service, Administration of Accidents, Administration of Traffic Fines, Report Writing and Computer Literacy. Knowledge: Strategic thinking, Customer management, Results/ quality management, Innovation/ continuous improvement, Problem solving, Analytical, Negotiation, Decision making, Communication, Initiative, Diversity awareness.
jobs.duties: Administer Fleet Accident Management: Receive and register all accident reports involving government fleet vehicles, Verify accident documentation for completeness and compliance, Capture accident information on fleet management systems, Liaise with drivers, departments, insurers, assessors, and service providers, Monitor progress of accident claims and repairs, Maintain accurate accident records and support documentation, Facilitate the recovery of accident-related costs where applicable, Compile accident statistics and reports. Administer Traffic Fines Management: Receive, verify, and record traffic fines issued to government vehicles, identify responsible drivers through vehicle allocation records, Forward traffic fines to responsible officials and departments, monitor payment and representation processes, maintain an updated traffic fine register, facilitate recovery of costs from liable officials where applicable, Escalate unpaid or disputed fines for further action. Monitor Compliance and Governance: Monitor compliance with fleet management policies and procedures, verify that accident reporting requirements are adhered to, ensure compliance with Road Traffic legislation, identify non-compliance trends and recommend corrective measures, maintain audit-ready records for accidents and fines, Support internal and external audit processes. Enhance Stakeholder Engagement and Customer Support: Provide guidance to drivers and client departments on accident and traffic fine procedures, liaise with law enforcement agencies, insurers, brokers, repairers, and legal representatives, respond to queries relating to accident claims and traffic fines, facilitate communication between stakeholders to resolve cases promptly. Reporting and Information Management: Compile monthly, quarterly, and annual management reports, Analyse accident and traffic fine trends, maintain databases and electronic filing systems, produce statistical reports for management decision-making, Prepare reports for executive and governance structures.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Khutso Motshekga Tel No: (010) 345 1538

jobs.title: Administrative Officer: Assets Management
jobs.summary: Administrative officer needed for asset management at Roads and Transport in Bedfordview.
jobs.requirements: A minimum three year National Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Accounting/ Financial management. 2-3 years’ experience in Finance. Client orientation and customer focus. People management and empowerment. Service delivery innovation Problem solving and analysis.
jobs.duties: Tag and label assets using barcodes or asset numbers. Maintain a record of vehicles received and reissued by asset management. Follow internal asset management procedures and controls and ensure compliance with PFMA and Treasury Regulations. Support internal and external audits by providing asset- related documentation. Conduct periodic physical verification of assets to confirm their existence and condition. Reconcile verified assets to the asset register and investigate all discrepancies. Coordinate and convene meetings with asset coordinators to address verification outcomes and enforce compliance. Perform ongoing follow-ups on unverified. missing, or discrepancies identified during. verification, and escalate unresolved matters where necessary. Process disposal of redundant, damaged, or lost assets in line with asset management processes. Assist with loss reports and ensure appropriate documentation is filed. Prepare monthly and quarterly asset management reports. Highlight discrepancies and assist with corrective action. File asset-related documents and records systematically. Respond to internal queries regarding asset status or information. Administer the key management system by recording the issuing and return of keys. Maintain and update asset movement records, including tracking of transfers, disposals, and reallocations. Capture new assets into the asset register in line with approved supporting documentation. Update asset movements (locations, disposals, transfers). Process disposals, transfers, and derecognition transactions accurately and in accordance with GRAP requirements. Perform regular reconciliations between the asset register, general ledger, and physical verification reports. Correct errors and update asset information such as location, custodian, condition, and useful lives.

af.title: Administratiewe Beampte: Batebestuur
af.summary: Administratiewe beampte benodig vir batebestuur by Roads and Transport in Bedfordview.
af.requirements: ‘n Minimum driejarige Nasionale Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Rekeningkunde/ Finansiële bestuur. 2-3 jaar ervaring in Finansies. Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Diensleweringsinnovassie. Probleemoplossing en analise.
af.duties: Merk en etiketteer bates met behulp van barcodes of bate-nommers. Hou ‘n rekord van voertuie wat deur batebestuur ontvang en weer uitgereik is. Volg interne batebestuursprosedures en -kontroles en verseker nakoming aan PFMA en Treasury Regulations. Ondersteun interne en eksterne oudits deur bate-verwante dokumentasie te verskaf. Voer periodieke fisiese verifikasie van bates uit om hul bestaan en toestand te bevestig. Versoen geverifieerde bates met die bate-register en ondersoek alle afwykings. Koördineer en belê vergaderings met bate-koördineerders om verifikasie-uitkomste aan te spreek en nakoming af te dwing. Doen deurlopende opvolgings op onverifieerde. vermiste, of afwykings wat tydens. verifikasie geïdentifiseer is, en eskaleer onopgeloste sake waar nodig. Verwerk die wegdoening van oortollige, beskadigde, of verlore bates in ooreenstemming met batebestuursprosesse. Bystand verleen met verliesverslae en verseker dat toepaslike dokumentasie ingedien word. Berei maandelikse en kwartaallikse batebestuursverslae voor. Lig afwykings uit en help met regstellende stappe. Dien bate-verwante dokumente en rekords sistematies in. Reageer op interne navrae rakende batestatus of inligting. Administreer die sleutelbestuurstelsel deur die uitreiking en terugbesorging van sleutels aan te teken. Onderhou en dateer batebewegingsrekords op, insluitend die naspoor van oordragte, wegdoenings, en hertoekennings. Voer nuwe bates in die bate-register in in ooreenstemming met goedgekeurde ondersteunende dokumentasie. Dateer batebewegings op (lokasies, wegdoenings, oordragte). Verwerk wegdoenings, oordragte, en derkennings transaksies akkuraat en in ooreenstemming met GRAP-vereistes. Voer gereelde versoenings uit tussen die bate-register, algemene grootboek, en fisiese verifikasieverslae. Korrigeer foute en dateer bate-inligting op soos lokasie, bewaarder, toestand, en nuttige lewens.

zu.title: Ofisa Oluphethe Izindaba Zokuphathekayo: Ukuphathwa Kwempahla
zu.summary: Kudingeka ofisa oluphethe izindaba zokuphathwa kwempahla ku Roads and Transport e Bedfordview.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma Yezwe Ngeminyaka emithathu (NQF Level 6) ku-Accounting/ Financial management. Uhalaza iminyaka engu-2-3 kwe-Finance. Ukugxila kumthengi nokunaka izidingo zakho. Ukuphathwa kwabantu nokuqinisekisa amandla. Intuthuko ekuletheni izinsiza Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya.
zu.duties: Faka amathagi namalebula empahleni kusetshenziswa amabhakhodi noma amanombolo empahla. Gcina irekhodi lezimoto ezitholwe futhi zihlotshaniswe kabusha ngokuphathwa kwempahla. Landela izinqubo nokulawulwa kwangaphakathi kokuphathwa kwempahla futhi qinisekisa ukuhambisana ne-PFMA kanye ne-Treasury Regulations. Sekela ukuhlola ngaphakathi nangaphandle ngokunikeza ukwaziswa okuhlotshaniswa nempahla. Yenza ukubuyekeza ngokomzimba kwempahla ngesikhathi esithile ukuqinisekisa ukuba khona kwayo nesimo sayo. Hambisanisa impahla ebuyeketiwe nesibuko sempahla futhi uphenye konke okungeyona eqondile. Hlela futhi ubize izinkhulumphakathi nabahleli bezimpahla ukubhekana nemiphumela yokubuyekeza futhi uqinisekise ukuhambisana. Yenza ukulandela njalo izinto ezingabuyekeziwe, ezishodayo, noma okungahambisani okutholakele ngesikhathi sokubuyekeza, futhi engeza izindaba ezingaxazululeki lapho kudingeka khona. Cululisla ukulahleka kwempahla engadingeki, eyonakele, noma elahlekile ngokuhambisana nezinqubo zokuphathwa kwempahla. Siza ngemibiko yokulahleka futhi qinisekisa ukuthi ukwaziswa okufanele kufakwe kufayela. Lungiselela imibiko yenyanga nenyanga yamakota yokuphathwa kwempahla. Bhekisa okungahambisani futhi siza nzenzo zokulungisa. Fakela kufayela ukwaziswa namarekhodi ahlotshaniswa nempahla ngendlela eshintshiwe. Phendula imibuzo yaphakathi mayelana nesimo noma ukwaziswa kwempahla. Phatha uhlelo lokuphathwa kwama-khiye ngokugcina irekhodi lokuphathwa nokubuyiswa kwama-khiye. Gcina futhi ulungise amarekhodi okunyakaza kwempahla, okuhlanganisa ukulandela ukudluliselwa, ukulahleka, kanye nokwenza kabusha ukwabelana. Faka impahla entsha esibukweni sempahla ngokuhambisana nokwaziswa okugunyaziwe. Hlaziya ukunyakaza kwempahla (izindawo, ukulahleka, ukudluliselwa). Cubungula ukulahleka, ukudluliselwa, kanye nezinkambu zokwesula ngokunembile ngokuhambisana nezidingo ze-GRAP. Yenza ukuhambisaniswa njalo phakathi kwesibuko sempahla, ijenerali leja, namarekhodi okubuyekeza ngokomzimba. Lungisa amaphutha futhi uhlaziye ukwaziswa kwempahla njengesimo sendawo, umgcini, isimo, kanye nobomi obusizo.

xh.title: Isikhulu Soqoqosho: Ulawulo Lwempahla
xh.summary: Kufuneka isikhulu soqoqosho sokulawula impahla kwi-Roads and Transport e-Bedfordview.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma eyiminyaka emithathu (NQF Level 6) kwi-Accounting/ Financial management. 2-3 years’ experience in Finance. Ukujongana nabaxhasi nokubeka abaxhasi phambili. Ulawulo labantu namandla abo. Intsingiselo yokuhlinzwa ngesevisi. Ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya.
xh.duties: Faka iitag kunye namaphawu empahla usebenzisa iibarcode okanye amanani empahla. Gcina irekhodi lezithuthi ezamkelwe nezibuyiswe ngokulawula impahla. Landela iinkqubo zangaphakathi zolawulo lwempahla lulawulo, kuqinisekise ukuzithoba kwi-PFMA naku-Treasury Regulations. Xhasa ukuhlolwa kwangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokubonelela amaxwebhu ahlobene nempahla. Yenza ukuqinisekisa ngokomzimba impahla ngamaxesha athile ukuqinisekisa ukuba ikho nemo yawo. Linganisa impahla ekuqinisekisiweyo kwirejista yempahla uphando zonke iingquzana. Lungelelanise ubudlelwane bemihlangano nabalawuli bempahla ukujongana neziphumo zokuqinisekisa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuzithoba. Yenza umlandu oqhubekayo kwinto engagqinisekiswanga. into elahlekileyo, okanye iingquzana ezifunyenwe ngexa. ekuqinisekiseni, uphakamise izinto ezingagqinisekiswa apho kufuneka kwenzeke. Yenza inkqubo yokuqwalasela iimpahla ezingafunekiyo, ezonakeleyo, okanye ezilahlekileyo ngokweemigaqo yolawulo lwempahla. Nceda ngemibiko yokulahleka uqinisekise ukuba amaxwebhu afanelekileyo aqhutywe. Lungiselela imibiko yempahla yenyanga nenyanga nethi karikhwatha. Qaqambisa iingquzana uncede ngendlela yokulungisa. Faka amaxwebhu ahlobene nempahla nerekhodi ngendlela echanekileyo. Phendula kwimibuzo yangaphakathi malunga neze empahla okanye ulwazi. Lawula inkqubo yokuqulunqa iiqhoshi ngokurekhoda ukunikwa nokubuyiswa kweziqhosha. Gcina uhlaziyo irekhodi yentshukumo yempahla, kuquka ukulandela ukudluliswa, ukugqithiswa, nokwabiwa kwempahla. Faka impahla entsha kwirejista yempahla ngokwamaxwebhu axhaswayo avunyiweyo. Hlaziya intshukumo yempahla (iindawo, ukugqithiswa, ukudluliswa). Yenza ngokuchanekileyo iinkqubo zokugqithiswa, ukudluliswa, kunye nakwii-transaction zokususa ukubonakala ngokweemfuno ze-GRAP. Yenza ukuqwalaselwa okuqhelekileyo phakathi kwerejista yempahla, i-general ledger, namaxwebhu akuqinisekisa ngokomzimba. Lungisa iimpazamo uhlaziye ulwazi lwempahla njengendawo, umgcinayo, imo, kunye nobomi obusetyenziswa.

jobs.summary: Desktop Technician providing hardware, software and peripheral support including incident resolution within SLA timelines at the Department of Roads and Transport in Bedfordview.

Ability to interact with people on different levels, Ability to be service orientated, Ability to undertake a risk analysis and undertake a risk analysis and undertake a risk mitigation strategy, Ability to identify and interpret the required information fields and documentation, Ability to manage project, Ability to prepare reports, submissions and presentations. Code 8/10 Driver’s License.

Perform routine maintenance, updates, and patch management. Respond to and resolve logged incidents and service requests within SLA timelines. Setup of new ICT equipment (desktops, laptops, printers, etc.). Support network connectivity at the desktop level (LAN/Wi-Fi troubleshooting). Maintain asset registers and ensure accurate tagging and tracking of ICT equipment. Participate in ICT infrastructure rollouts and upgrades. Deliver both in-person and remote technical assistance to staff across all departments, ensuring minimal disruption to operations. Promote responsible ICT usage by guiding users on security protocols, software best practices, and digital hygiene. Escalate complex or unresolved technical issues to second-tier support teams or designated ICT Practitioners for further investigation and resolution. Configure and update endpoint security tools to mitigate risks associated with cyber threats and system vulnerabilities. Track and report on user compliance with ICT security frameworks, flagging any deviations for immediate action. Participate in the setup and testing of backup and recovery solutions to minimise data loss and downtime. Maintain comprehensive records of service requests, troubleshooting steps, and outcomes. Create and maintain user guides and FAQs to improve self-service capabilities. Provide accurate and timely inputs for ICT performance metrics and departmental reports

af.title: Werkskermtegnikus
af.summary: Werkskermtegnikus wat hardeware-, sagteware- en randtoerustingondersteuning verskaf, insluitend voorvaloplossing binne SLA-tydraamwerke by die Department of Roads and Transport in Bedfordview.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum drie jaar Nasionale Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Inligtingstegnologie. 'n Minimum van 2 – 3 jaar se ervaring in ICT-ondersteuning. Besit van sertifisering in ITIL Foundation of CompTIA A+, N+, Security + sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Vermoë om met mense op verskillende vlakke te kommunikeer; Vermoë om diensgerig te wees; Vermoë om 'n risiko-anise te onderneem en 'n risikobeperkingsstrategie te onderneem; Vermoë om die vereiste inligtingsvelde en dokumentasie te identifiseer en te interpreter; Vermoë om projekte te bestuur; Vermoë om verslae, voorleggings en aanbiedings voor te berei. Kode 8/10 Bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning vir werkskermhardeware, sagteware en randtoerustingtoestelle. Installeer, konfigureer en los bedryfstelsels en standaardtoepassings op. Voer roetine-onderhoud, opdaterings en pleisterbestuur uit. Reageer op en los aangemelde voorvalle en diensversoeke binne SLA-tydraamwerke op. Opstelling van nuwe ICT-toerusting (werkskerms, skootrekenaars, drukkers, ens.). Ondersteun netwerkverbindendheid op werkskermvlak (LAN/Wi-Fi probleemoplossing). Onderhou bateRegisters en verseker akkurate etikettering en naspeuring van ICT-toerusting. Neem deel aan ICT-infrastruktuurrolle en opgraderings. Lewer beide persoonlike en afstandstegniese bystand aan personeel oor alle departemente, en verseker minimale ontwrigting van bedrywighede. Bevorder verantwoordelike ICT-gebruik deur gebruikers te lei oor sekuriteitsprotokolle, sagteware-bestuurspraktyke en digitale higiëne. Eskaleer ingewikkelde of onopgeloste tegniese probleme na tweedevlak-ondersteuningspanne of aangewese ICT-beoefenaars vir verdere ondersoek en oplossing. Konfigureer en werk eindpunt-sekuriteitsinstrumente op om risiko's wat met kub bedreigings en stelselkwesbaarheidsgeassosieer word, te beperk. Volg gebruikers se voldoening aan ICT-sekuriteitsraamwerke na en rapporteer daarop, en enige afwykings vir onmiddellike optrede uitlig. Neem deel aan die opstelling en toetsing van rugsteun- en hersteloplossings om dataverlies en onbedryfstyd te verminder. Onderhou omvattende rekords van diensversoeke, probleemoplossingstappe en uitkomste. Skep en onderhou gebruikersgidse en VRAE om selfbedieningsvermoëns te verbeter. Verskaf akkurate en tydige insette vir ICT-prestasiemetrieke en departementele verslae.

zu.summary: ITekhnishani ye-Desktop enikeza inkxaso yehadweya, isofthiwe kanye nezinto ezingaphandle okuhlanganisa nokuxazululwa kwezinkinga ngaphakathi kwesikhathi se-SLA e-Department of Roads and Transport e-Bedfordview.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-National Diploma zeminyaka emithathu (NQF Level 6) ku-Information Technology. Isiphephelo seminyaka engu-2 - 3 esiphephelwa enkxasweni ye-ICT. Ukuba nokuqinisekiswa nge-ITIL Foundation noma i-CompTIA A+, N+, Security + kuyoba inhlanhla. Ikono lokuxhumana nabantu kumazinga ahlukene, Ikono lokuba nolwazi lokwensiza, Ikono lokwenza ukuhlaziya ingozi kanye nokwenza ukuhlaziya ingozi kanye nokwenza isu lokunciphisa ingozi, Ikono lokubona futhi kuqondakale izinkambu zemininingwana eziyimfuneko nemitapo yamazwana, Ikono lokuphatha iphrojekthi, Ikono lokulungisa imibiko, izinkulumo eziyisibhalo namaphrezenteshini. zu.duties: Nika inkxaso yobuchwepheshe kwezokusebenza kwedesktop, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nezinto ezihambisanazo. Faka, lungisisa futhi uxazulule izinkinga kwezinhlelo zokusebenza kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezijwayelekile. Yenza ukugcinwa okujwayelekile, izibuyekezo, kanye nokuphatha ama-patches. Phendula futhi uxazulule izinkulumo ezingeniwe ngesikhathi seSLA. Hlela izinto zeqembu le-ICT entsha (desktops, laptops, abaphrinti, njll.). Nxhokolozela ukuxhumana kwe-netiwekhi emzinganweni wedesktop (uxazululo lwezinkinga ze-LAN/Wi-Fi). Gcina irejista yezimpahla futhi qinisekisa ukumakwa okunembile nokulandelwa kwezinto zeqembu le-ICT. Thatha inxaxheba ekwazisweni nasekweni izinhlelo ze-ICT nokwenza izibuyekezo. Nikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe ngokwamanzi kanye nakwe-inthanethi kubasebenzi kuyo yonke iminyango, kuqinisekiswe ukuphazamiseka okuncane emsebenzini. Khuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe le-ICT okunesibopho ngokuqondisa abasebenzisi ngemithetho yokuphepha, izindlela ezinhle zokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nokuhlanzeka kwedijithali. Dudulisa izinkinga zobuchwepheshe eziyinkimbinkimbi noma ezingaxazululeki kwamathimu enkxaso yesigaba sesibili noma kubasebenzi be-ICT abakhethiwe ukuze kube nokuphenya okwengeziwe nokuxazululwa. Lungisa futhi ubuyekeze izinto zokuphepha ze-endpoint ukunciphisa izingozi ezihlotshaniswa nosongo lwe-cyber namagebe ezinhlelo. Landela futhi wenze umbiko ngokuvumelana komsebenzisi namaphuzu okuphepha e-ICT, uphawule noma yikuphi ukungahambisani ukuze kwenzeke isenzo ngokushesha. Thatha inxaxheba ekwakhiweni nokuhloleni izixazululo zokulondoloza futhi ugcine ukuqinisekiswe ukunciphisa ukulahlekelwa imininingwane kanye nokungasebenzi. Gcina irekhodi eliphelele lezinkulumo zenkxaso, izinyathelo zokuxazulula izinkinga, kanye nabezimpumelo. Dala futhi ugcise izinhla zokuqondisa abasebenzisi kanye nama-FAQ ukuthuthukisa ikhono lokuzikholela. Nikeza imininingwane enembile ngesikhathi esifanele ezinkomba zentengo ye-ICT nakumabhiko weminyango

Hlaza, lungisa amandla okulinganisa, kwakunye nokusebenzisa isixhobo sakho ngokuphumeleyo. Yonke imisebenzi ebalulekileyo ibizwa ngokuba ngu-ICT infrastructure rollouts kwakunye ne-ICT infrastructure upgrades. Gcina iinkcukacha ngokutsho kobugcisa bezemiba ngeminyaka yokulungelelana nokuza. Zonke izixhobo ezinceda kumsebenzi wakho we-ICT infrastructure kufuneki zisusewe kwindalo yakho ngaphandle kokubandakanywa kwi-project endpoints. Gcina ukuba nalapho unako na amandla okusuka kummandla we-ICT infrastructure esithe wayesakuba nawo. Faka izigqibo ngokulandelana kwemisebenzi yakho, ngokubonwa kwakho ngendlela yakho yokubonisa iinkqubo zokulunga kwakunye nokuza kwamandla ezinye iinkqubo. Lungisa izixhobo ezisetyenziswa ngokutsho kobugcisa bezekstrata yakho kwindalo yakho kwaye ugqibe ukuba nalawo amandla okusebenzisa izixhobo zakho zokusebenzela phakathi kobugcisa bezemiba ngokutsho kobugcisa bezekstrata yakho.

jobs.title: Admin Officer: Security Services
jobs.summary: Admin Officer for Security Services at the Department of Roads and Transport in Bedfordview, requiring a National Diploma in Security Management, PSIRA Grade B and two to three years of relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: A minimum three year National Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Security Management / Security Risk Management. PSIRA Grade B. Minimum of 2-3 years’ experience in Security Management environment in the Public Service. Knowledge: Minimum Information Security Standard (MISS) policy document, Information Security, Knowledge and understanding of Security Management. People oriented. Driver’s License will be an added advantage.

Monitor parking of vehicles in the premises in consultation with Core Business Units, Compile and communicate Security Instructions to Security as directed by the Unit Manager, Monitor the Lost and Found Storage in consultation with Unit Manager, Communicate Security instructions to Security Supervisor as Directed by the Unit Manager, monitor compliance to the Security Access Control Procedures, Communicate and Facilitate Access to parking yards. Process Auction and Extra Security: Compile RLS01 and BOQ for planned auction, Facilitate all requirements of extra Security for the monitoring of Auctions, Participate in the Auction Planning and Postmortem meetings and present, Facilitate Security verification of auctioned vehicles and compile report, Compile Procedures and Processes for auction with the appointed security, Facilitate Auction Parade briefings, Facilitate auction vehicle dispatch, Monitor extra Security and ensure compliance with all requirements, Compile Security Auction Postmortem report and present findings. Process Security Breach Incidents: Receive Security Breach Incident Reports from Security Service Providers, g-FleeT Officials and Visitors. Open Security Breach Incident Files and Compile all required information, Update Security Breach Incident Register and Weekly/Monthly Reports, conduct preliminary investigations for all reported Security Breach Incident and escalate to Risk as directed by Manager, maintain all records of Security Breach Incident reported, Monitor Physical and Security Surveillance Helpdesk: Implement and Monitor Security Helpdesk as per Standard Operating Procedures. Monitor Service Providers providing maintenance and ensure that all requirements are met, Compile communications on security matters as directed by the Unit Manager, Exercise strict confidentiality in and around security surveillance matters, Monitor Security improvement projects. Comply with Risk processes and Mitigation: Comply to all relevant security Acts, Policies, Regulation and Standards, Monitor and enforce compliance to Security Policy, Plan, Processes and Procedures, Compile and submit weekly/monthly/quarterly security reports, maintain strict confidentiality on reported incidents Maintain the lost and found, keep record of incoming, stored and claimed (outgoing) lost and found items. Plan, Reporting, Administration: Conduct Secretariat Services for security meetings and maintain strict confidentiality on all security discussions and resolutions, maintain filing system for all security documentation (manual and electronic), Verify all submitted security invoices compile analysis, compile snag lists, completion letters, and submit for approval. Ziphendulele ngokugqamile ekuqhubeni kwezindaba zokubuka ukuvikela, Qapha imigomo yokuthuthuka kokuvikela. Qwalasela abanikezeli beenkonzo abayilayo ukunyanzelisa kuqiniseke ukuba zonke iimfuno zihlangatyeziwe, Hlenga iinkomfa ngemiba zokhuseleko njengoko kulawulwa nguMlawuli weNgcaciso, Zibambe ngokuqinisekileyo imfihlo kumaba ongaphakathi nakuninzi kuqwalaselo loKhuseleko, Qwalasela amaprojekthi okuphucula uKhuseleko. Zithobe kumathanga woMngcipheko nokuQhotsywa: Zithobe kumthetho wonke wohKusela, iNkqubo, iMigaqo nemiQathango, Qwalasela uze uQinisekise ukuzinikela kuNkqubo yohKuseleko, uCwangciso, iNkqubo nemiThetho, Hlenga uze uThumela iNgxelo yoKhuseleko yeVeki ngeNyanga/Q3 ngeNyanga, gcina ngokuqinisekileyo imfihlo kumabanga avela kwiNgxamiseko ezichaziweyo Gcina izinto ezekutyiweyo natholakele, gcina ulwazi lwezinto eziza, ezizigcinwayo neziye zithathwa. Cwangcisa, uChaze imiba, uLawulo: Nikezela iinkonzo zeBhodi eyimfihlo kwiiNkokheli zokhuseleko kwaye ugcine imfihlo ngokuqinisekileyo malunga nonikezelo lonke ngokhuseleko nengqiqo, gcina inkqubo yokugcina iifayile zamaxwebhu onke ohKuselo (ngetyalatye nangekhompyutha), Qinisekisa zonke iNkengiso zokhuseleko ezithunyelweyo kwaye uhlengengqalasorhwebo, uHlenge uluhlu lwezinto ezingasebenziyo, iileta zokuQedwa, kwaye uzithumele ukuvunywa. Abasebenzi: Lawula abasebenzi boKhuseleko ngaphakathi kweSigaba.

Relevant experience: A minimum of 1- 2 years’ post apprenticeship experience (Panel Beating), 1 year’s similar experience in public service environment and an advantage; and mechanical repairs background/ knowledge will be an added advantage.
jobs.duties: Manage all inspection tasks related to panel beating: physical inspection of vehicles; compile an assessment report for panel beating repairs; make recommendations on panel beating repairs to be done on the vehicle; keep records of all assessment reports, daily. Liaise with all relevant stakeholders: Answer telephonic enquiries from merchants and client departments on authorizations to be carried out; Make phone calls to affected stakeholders on a national basis in investigating specific cases of accident repairs/damages; Receive and send emails in respect of all communication regarding accident repairs; Give support to the Communications Unit with regards to their clients’ concerns on vehicles assessments. Ensure that panel beating services are priced market related: Do monthly benchmark studies of the costs of panel beating and towing in the private sector versus the government cost. Ensure that policies related to inspection of panel beating are adhered to: Keep records of policies and system and refer to them whenever decisions have to be taken in respect of assessments. Prepare weekly, monthly and annual reports concerning all inspection of panel beating and towing to the Assistant Director: Panel Beating and Mechanical: Keep files for all vehicles that have been assessed during the month so as to have a ready record for monthly reports; Files should include pictures taken of all the work assessed during the month.
