af.title: Assessor: Paneelklop
af.summary: Assessor in Bedfordview benodig om voertuie te ondersoek en paneelklop-herstelassesseringsverslae vir die Department of Roads and Transport op te stel.
af.requirements: Minimum vereiste: N2-sertifikaat in (Paneelklop), bestuurderslisensie kode 8. Vaktoets as 'n bykomende voordeel. Geen strafregister. Bevordrede kennis van Meganiese en paneelklopstelsels; Bedryfsprystendense; Verskillende kategorieë van klassifikasie van paneelkloppers; Motorvervaardigingsomgewing; Verskillende akkreditasiekriteria vir handelaars en kommunikasiepraktyke en goeie kennis van die openbare diensbestuursraamwerk. Relevante ervaring: 'n Minimum van 1-2 jaar se ervaring na leerlingskap (Paneelklop), 1 jaar se soortgelyke ervaring in 'n openbare diensomgewing is 'n voordeel; en 'n agtergrond/kennis van meganiese herstelwerk sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Bestuur alle inspeksietaake wat verband hou met paneelklop: fisiese ondersoek van voertuie; stel 'n assesseringsverslag vir paneelklop Herstelle op; doen aanbevelings oor paneelklop herstelle wat aan die voertuig gedoen moet word; hou daagliks rekord van alle assesseringsverslae. Skakel met alle relevante belanghebbendes: Beantwoord telefoonnavrae van handelaars en kliëntdepartemente oor magtigings wat uitgevoer moet word; Maak telefoonoproepe na geaffekteerde belanghebbendes op 'n nasionale basis by die ondersoek van spesifieke gevalle van ongeluksherstelwerk/skade; Ontvang en stuur e-posse met betrekking tot alle kommunikasie rakende ongeluksherstelwerk; Gee ondersteuning aan die Kommunikasie-eenheid met betrekking tot hul kliënte se bekommernisse oor voertuigassesserings. Verseker dat paneelklopdienste teen markverwante pryse prysgegee word: Doen maandelikse benchmark-studies van die koste van paneelklop en sleep in die private sektor teenoor die regeringskoste. Verseker dat beleide wat verband hou met die inspeksie van paneelklop nagekom word: Hou rekord van beleide en stelsels en verwys daarna wanneer besluite rakende assesserings geneem moet word. Berei weeklikse, maandelikse en jaarlikse verslae voor aangaande alle inspeksie van paneelklop en sleep vir die Assistent-direkteur: Paneelklop en Meganies: Hou lêers vir alle voertuie wat gedurende die maand geassesseer is om 'n gereed rekord vir maandelikse verslae te hê; Lêers moet foto's insluit van al die werk wat gedurende die maand geassesseer is. Voer enige ander taak uit soos deur die Assistent-direkteur: Paneelklop Meganies gedelegeer: Afhangende van die aard van die opdrag van die ASD: Paneelklop

zu.title: UMhloli: Ukulungisa Amaphuleti
zu.summary: Kudingeka umhloli eBedfordview ukuthi ahlole izimoto aze ahlele imibiko yokuqashwa kwamasitha emaphuleti kanye nokuqashwa kwesistimu yohlelo ngeqiniso, ngokwabezimo Ezeluvi, isiguquli sokuqala, ngokuqinisekiswa kokuthola imvume yokuba angangeni emaLega, ukuxhumana kanye nezinhlelo ezithize okulungiswa kwamaphuleti ezezimoto.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esikhulu: N2 Certificate in (Panel Beating), Driver’s license code 8. Ukuhlolwa kwamakhono njengento engeza inzuzo. Akukho rekhodi lezehla. Ukwazi kabanzi ngoMechanical kanye namasistimu okulungisa amapuleti Intrendi yentengo yendawo Izigaba ezahlukene zokuqamba kwabantu abaqamba amapuleti Izindawo zenziwa ngamathoyela zezimoto Izinkomba ezihlukene zokuqinisekisa abathengisi kanye nezindlela zokuxhumana kanye nokwazi okuhle ngohlelo lokuqashwa kuphathi wolonke. Isipiliya ezimele: A minimum of 1- 2 years’ post apprenticeship experience (Panel Beating), 1 year’s similar experience in public service environment and an advantage; and mechanical repairs background/ knowledge will be an added advantage.
zu.duties: Phatha wonke amasevisi okuhlola ahlobene nokulungisa amapuleti: ukuhlola izimoto ngokomzimba; hlela umbiko wokuhlolwa kokulungiswa kwamapuleti; nikeza izincomo mayelana nokulungiswa kwamapuleti okumele kwenziwe kuleso sithuthi; gcina irekhodi yawo wonke amabhiko okuhlola, nsuku zonke. Xhumana nabo bonke abahlomuli abahlobene: Phendula imibuzo yocingo evela kubathengisi nakumagatsha abathengi mayelana nezimvume ezimele kwenziwe; Yenza amakholi ocingo kubahlomuli abathintekayo kuzwelonke ekuphenyeni izimo ezithize zokulungiswa/ukulimala kwesehlelo lezimoto; Thola futhi uthumele imeyili mayelana nayo yonke inhulumendelo ngokulungiswa kwesehlelo lezimoto; Nikela inkxaso kwiYunithi Yezokuxhumana mayelana nezinkinga zabo ziklabhu ekubukeni izimoto. Qinisekisa ukuthi amasevisi okulungisa amapuleti ahamba kahle ngentengo emakethe: Yenza ucwaningo olunyakeni lonke lwamasonto onyanga wezindleko zokulungisa amapuleti kanye nomhILA ngenani ikholwa eliyingxenye yangasese kune leso sika hulumende. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhlonzwa izinqubomgomo ezihlobene nokuqashwa kwabahloli bokuqashwa kwezimoto: Gcina amaphoyisa kanye nemizila kanti futhi uxabise nawo noma kunini uma kuthathwa izinqumo ngesimo sezinqubo ezithinta ukusebenza okwenzelwe abantu bakhulu kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele. Hlela imibiko yamasonto onyanga kanye nenyanga nonyaka yonke ngokuqashwa kwabahloli bokuqashwa kwezimoto nokuhambahamba kwenqwaba yokuqashwa kuba ngumqashi oMgijima uBabanje: Gcina amafayela kuwo onke amathwasa abantu abagqokwe emuva ukuba abe nomsebenzi wokuqashwa okwenzelwe ukuba bathole imisebenzi eqeqeshiwe njengomphathi wokuqashwa, kanye nokubuye bakhombise ukuthi bakwazi ukusizwa ngokuqeqeshwa okutholakale kunoma yisiphi isikhathi esihleliwe; Okuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu okhokhelwa ukuba aqashe izimoto uzolalela futhi ahambe isikhathi eside ekubeni inqwaba yokuqashwa ehleli kahle, angayeki ukuba ayithole lelo vumba lokuxhumana emsebenzini ohleliwe ohleliwe wokusiza abantu abakufunayo ukuba bathole imali yokuqashwa okukhokhelwa ngokusemthethweni okubukeka kuyinto entsha ukuba umuntu angayikhokha ekhaya.

xh.title: Umhloli: Ulungiso lemoto
xh.summary: Kufuneka umhloli e Bedfordview ukuze ajonge iimoto aze alungelelanise iimbarave zokuqonda nokuqinisekisa ukulungiswa kweemoto kwesebe leZiendlu nezeenqwelomoya.
xh.requirements: Ifundo esezantsi: Isatifikethi seN2 kwi (Ulungiso lemoto), ilayisenesi yokushayela ikhowudi 8. Uvavvo lwebhaji njengento engeze ixabiso. Akukho ntlonyulo ebalulekileyo. Ulwazi olubanzi malunga neendlela zoncedo lwezoshishino nolwazi oluhlu kwaye oluzinzileyo lweendlela zokulungisa iimoto Ulwazi ngamaxabiso emisitho yonke imihla Iindidi ezahlukileyo zokuhluwa kolawulo lweemoto zokulungisa Indalo yokwenza iimoto Izinto ezahlukeneyo ezisisiseko sokugunyaziswa abathengisi kunye nendlela zokuqhathanisa ulwazi ngokulawula inkqubo yomphakathi. Uluhlu lweemfuno: Ubuncinane beminyaka engama- 1 ukuya kwa- 2 yokwenza izabelo ngeemoto, unyaka omnye oluhlu kwaye oluzinzileyo loluhlu olufana nolu kwindalo yokushicilela ulwazi, inguquko yobuchule ekulungiseni iimoto kuya kuba yingozi entsha.
xh.duties: Lawula onke amanyathelo okuqhatha ahlobene nokuqhatha iimoto ukuqinisekisa ngokobuhle babo bokwenza imoto ukuba ilungile ukuze yenziwe iirekhodi ekulungiseni iimoto ukuba zenziwe isigqibo ngokulungiswa kwemoto nokuba iyakulungiswa ngendlela efunekayo ukugcina zonke iingxelo ezinje ngale zibhalwa ngokwemithetho yemihla ngemihla. Thethathu nabathathi nxaxheba abaxulumana nokuqhatha: Phendula imibuzo ngokudibana nabathengi kunye namasebe eentsapho ngokumisela ukuba yintoni ekufuneka yenziwe yaye wenze umnxeba babathathi nxaxheba abachaphazelekayo kwilizwe lonke ukuphonononga izigxobo ezithile zokulungisa iimoto nentshabalalo; Yamkela uze wathumele iimeyile ngokwazo zonke iindlela zokulungisa iimoto ezibangelwa ukutshatyalaliswa; Nikeza inkxaso kwiNyulo loQhagamshelwano mayela neengxaki zabo mayela nokuqhatha iimoto ukuba zenziwe ngokuchanekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkonzo zokulungisa iimoto zixabisa ngokweemarike zoloncedo lwezoshishino: Yenza uphononongo lwanyanga zonke ukuthelekisa amaxabiso okulungisa iimoto ekukhaliphi iinkonzo ngokuchasene namaxabiso karhulumate. Qinisekisa ukuba izigqibo ezithile zokulungisa iimoto zilandelwa ngokomthetho: Gcina ulwazi olubanzi lwezinye iinkqubo zokulungisa iimoto uze wabuqinisekisa okanye wahlule ngokwakho ukuba ngawaphi amaNqaku ekufuneka athathwe ngokulawula iimva ezibaxhaphazele kakhulu ekusebenziseni iinkonzo zolawulo lwemoto ukuqhatha nezeNGXOLO ekuQondeni kweNdalo yoNyuso olungisiweyo lweMoto: Ziba zonke iindlela ezenziwayo ekujoweni iimoto ezikwizingozi ukuze kube khona ulwazi olulungeleleneyo olubalulekileyo mayela nokuqhatha iimoto yonke imihla; Ezi zifundo zilandela ngokulandelana kokulungiswa kwemoto ngokwemithetho yemihla yonke. Zenze nayo nayiphi na imisebenzi enye njengoko elelwe ngumlawuli wakhe oNjiniyela weMoto ezingelwayo: Oku kuxhomekeka kwindlela efuneka ngayo imisebenzi efunekayo ekulungiseni iimoto: Ngokwemisebenzi efunekayo evela kumlawuli weMoto

jobs.title: Inspector Panel Beating and Mechanical
jobs.summary: Inspect and assess accident-damaged vehicles, verify repair estimates, and ensure compliance with OEM and SABS standards for the Department of Roads and Transport in Bedfordview.
jobs.requirements: Minimum Requirement: NQF Level 4 Motor industry certificate and Trade Test as Motor mechanic, Panel Beater or Motor Body repair. Driver’s License. No criminal record. knowledge of Planning and organizing, Knowledge and understanding of Treasury and SCM framework, Relevant legislation and Public Service Regulations and communication practices and good knowledge of the public service management framework. Relevant experience: 1-2 years hand on panel beating/mechanical and inspection.
jobs.duties: Assessing and inspecting of vehicles: Inspect accident – damaged vehicles and assess panel, chassis and mechanical damage to scope repair work; Conduct pre-repair and post repair inspections to confirm all work meets OEM specifications and SABS standards; Verify repair estimates vs actual damage to prevent over quoting and fraud by panel beaters/mechanics. Control compliance and quality: Check panel beating quality for example panel alignment, filter thickness, paint match, overspray and panel gaps; Check Mechanical quality: Engine, brakes, suspension, steering, exhaust, electrical systems post repair; Ensure road worthiness compliance with NRTA and vehicle licensing requirements before signing off. Control cost and documentation: Compile inspection reports with photos, checklists and recommendations with SLA; Approve or reject invoices based on scope of work completed vs quoted; Maintain a vehicle repair register and track turnaround times, repeat faults and warranty claims. Liaise with workshop staff: Liaise with panel beaters, mechanics and service providers to rectify defective workmanship; Investigate breakdowns, repeated failures or customer complaints and submit findings; Advise on vehicle condition for condemnation, auction or continued use decisions.

af.title: Inspekteur Paneelkloppery en Meganies
af.summary: Inspekteer en beoordeel voertuie met ongelukskade, verifieer herstelramings, en verseker nakoming van OEM- en SABS-standaarde vir die Department of Roads and Transport in Bedfordview.
af.requirements: Minimum vereiste: NQF Level 4 Motor industry certificate en Trade Test as Motor mechanic, Panel Beater of Motor Body repair. Bestuurderslisensie. Geen strafblaadryvel. Kennis van beplanning en organisering, kennis en begrip van Treasury en SCM-raamwerk, tersaaklike wetgewing en Public Service Regulations en kommunikasiepraktyke en goeie kennis van die openbare diensbestuursraamwerk. Tersaaklike ervaring: 1-2 jaar praktiese panel beating/mechanical en inspeksie.
af.duties: Beoordeling en inspeksie van voertuie: Inspekteer voertuie met ongelukskade en beoordeel paneel-, chassis- en meganiese skade om herstelwerk te omlyne; Voer voor- en na-herstel-inspeksies uit om te bevestig dat alle werk aan OEM-spesifikasies en SABS-standaarde voldoen; Verifieer herstelramings teenoor werklike skade om oorhaaling en bedrog deur panel beaters/meghanici te voorkom. Beheer nakoming en gehalte: Kontroleer panel beating-kwaliteit byvoorbeeld paneelbelyning, filterdikte, verfpassing, oorspuit en paneelsplete; Kontroleer meganiese gehalte: Enjin, remme, vering, stuur, uitlaat, elektriese stelsels na herstel; Verseker padwaardigheidsnakoming met NRTA en voertuiglisensievereistes voor afteken. Beheer koste en dokumentasie: Stel inspeksieverslae op met foto's, kontrolelyste en aanbevelings met SLA; Keur fakture goed of verwerp dit op grond van voltooide werk vs kwotasie; Onderhou 'n voertuigherstelregister en monitor turnaround times, herhalende foute en waarborg-eise. Skakel met werkswinkelpersoneel: Skakel met panel beaters, meghanici en diensverskaffers om defektiewe werkmanship reg te stel; Ondersoek breekdowns, herhaalde faling of kliënteklagtes en dien bevindings in; Adviseer oor voertuigtoestand vir veroordeling, veiling of voortgesette gebruik besluite.

zu.title: Izidingo: Kufuneka abe nolwazi lokulungisa izimoto ezonakele. Kufuneka abe nolwazi lokuhlela nokulungisa izimoto ezonakele, ukulungisa izimoto ezilime njengesinyathelo esibalulekile sokusiza izimoto ezonakele ukuba zibuyele kubuphila obujwayelekile. Kufuneki abe nolwazi olukhulu mayelana nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izimoto ziyahamba kahle endaweni yemisebenzi, njengasekhaya, okungenzeka kube yindawo ekude namaphoyisa, kungenzeka kube khona izinkinga ezifanele ukuba zihlolwe ngaphambi kokuba kwenzeke okungalindelekile.
zu.summary: Kubalulekile ukuba wazi mayelana nomthetho mayelana namapolisi abalawuli weTreasury, kanye nemigomo yesizinda samazwe ngamazwe kanye nomthetho wokuphathwa kwezimoto zikahulumeni. Ukuqonda mayelana nokuhlela nokuhlolwa kwemisebenzi kubalulekile, ukudlula kwemisebenzi yezimoto ekugcineni kuncike ekuthuthukisweni kwekhwalithi. Isipiliyoni esingezansi seminyaka eyi-1-2 kokulungisa izimoto kubalulekile.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingavunyelwa: Isitifikedi se-NQF Level 4 semboni yezimoto kanye no-Vocational Test njengobalungisi bezimoto, noma abalaphi be-paneli noma abalungi bezimoto. Ilayisense yokuqhuba. Angabi nenkinga yokuba noma yisiphi isiko elibi. Ukuqonda okugxile ekwelaphi kwezimoto kubalulekile.
zu.duties: Ukuhlola nokubuyekeza izimoto: Hlola izimoto ezonakele ngenxa yezeho futhi ubuyekeze ukulimala kwe-paneli, i-chassis nezinye zangaphakathi ukuze uhlole umsebenzi wokulungisa; Yenza ukuhlolwa ngaphambi kokulungisa nangemva kokulungisa ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi wonke umsebenzi uhambisana nemithetho ye-OEM nezindinganiso ze-SABS; Qinisekisa izilinganiso zokulungisa uma kungenziwa isilinganiso sezimali uma kunenkinga yokubonakala kwalelo lima, ukuthi kubekwa izimali ezikhulu uma kungamelwe ukwenza kanjalo, ezibhekwe kubalaphi be-paneli noma izinsizakalo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuziphendulela kanye nekhwalithi: Hlola ikhwalithi yokulungiswa kwama-paneli okufana nokumiswa kwama-paneli, ubukhulu bokuqedwa kobuciko, ukufana kwemibala yamasonto, ukudlula kwemibala nabanakekelo; Hlola ikhwalithi yemishini yezimoto: Injini, izibhanki, okungenwa okungemidlalo, ukuqondiswa, izintsethi ezikhipha umoya, izinhlelo zikagesi ngemva kokulungiswa; Qalinise ukuthi izimoto ziyahambisa ngokusemthethweni ngokusho kwe-NRTA nezidingo zokubhalisa izimoto ngaphambi kokuqinisekisa ukuthi zihamba kahle. Ukulawula izimali nemitshingo yokuqinisekisa: Qamba imibiko yokuhlolwa izimoto kanye nezithombe, izinhlu zokuhlola, nezinkomba ezihambisana ne-SLA; Vuma noma wenqabe izikweletu ngokusekelwe emsebenzini oqedwe uma kunenkinga; Ukuhlola ukuthi imali etholwe iyini noma ukuthi yinkani yini ngokusho kwesexwayo, ukuthi kulelungiswa noma kungalungiswa. Gcina ugogo olubhalisa izimoto ezilungiswayo, ulandele ukuthi kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani ukulungisa, izinkinga eziphindaphindwayo, kanye nezinkambiso ezithunyelwa emkhankasini. jobs.centre: Westrand REQUIRMENTS    :   NQF Level 3, or equivalent with three (3) years’ experience in Road Work Maintenance experience. Knowledge and Skills: Ability and willingness to work under pressure. Good communication skills will be an added advantage. Ability to work long hours in a team.

jobs.summary: Road Worker Foreman sought in Gauteng to plan and monitor road maintenance team activities, requiring NQF Level 3 and three years' experience.
jobs.duties: Plan, allocate and monitor daily and weekly work activities of maintenance teams. Prepare weekly work schedules and ensure tasks are executed in accordance with approved work plans and duty sheets. Conduct routine road inspections to identify, assess and record road infrastructure defects. Monitor and report illegal activities and encroachments within the road reserve. Supervise the utilisation, inspection and safe operation of departmental vehicles, plant, equipment and tools, ensuring they are used solely for official purposes. Control and account for equipment, tools and materials issued to maintenance teams. Conduct site inspections to monitor work quality, productivity and compliance with departmental standards. Implement and enforce occupational health and safety requirements, investigate incidents and compile safety incident reports. Facilitate and oversee on-site training and development of maintenance personnel. Ensure compliance with applicable legislation, departmental policies, procedures and standards. Monitor contractors' performance and compliance with contractual obligations, legislation and departmental requirements. Manage the performance of employees through the Performance Management and Development System (PMDS). Compile and submit operational reports as required by management.

af.title: Padwerker Voorman
af.summary: Padwerker Voorman gesoek in Gauteng om padinstandhoudingspanaktiwiteite te beplan en te monitor, wat NQF Vlak 3 en drie jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.duties: Beplan, wys toe en monitor daaglikse en weeklikse werksaktiwiteite van instandhoudingspanne. Berei weeklikse werkskedules voor en verseker dat take uitgevoer word ooreenkomstig goedgekeurde werksplanne en diensstate. Voer roetine-padinspeksies uit om padinfrastruktuurdefekte te identifiseer, te assesseer en aan te teken. Monitor en rapporteer onwettige aktiwiteite en inbreuke binne die padreserwe. Toesig hou oor die gebruik, inspeksie en veilige bedryf van departementele voertuie, aanleg, toerusting en gereedskap, en verseker dat dit slegs vir amptelike doeleindes gebruik word. Beheer en reken vir toerusting, gereedskap en materiaal wat aan instandhoudingspanne uitgereik is. Voer terreininspeksies uit om werkgehalte, produktiwiteit en nakoming van departementele standaarde te monitor. Implementeer en handhaaf beroepsveiligheids- en gesondheidsvereistes, ondersoek voorvalle en stel veiligheidsvoorvalverslae op. Fasiliteer en hou toesig oor terreinopleiding en -ontwikkeling van instandhoudingspersoneel. Verseker nakoming van toepaslike wetgewing, departementele beleide, prosedures en standaarde. Monitor kontrakteurs se prestasie en nakoming van kontraktuele verpligtinge, wetgewing en departementele vereistes. Bestuur die prestasie van werknemers deur die Performance Management and Development System (PMDS). Stel operasionele verslae op en dien dit in soos deur bestuur vereis.

zu.title: iForeman Yomsebenzi Womgwabo
zu.summary: Sifuna iRoad Worker Foreman eGauteng ukuze ahlele futhi alawule imisebenzi yeqembu lokulungisa imigwabo, idinga iNQF Level 3 futhi namaphesenti eminyaka emithathu.
zu.duties: Hlela, abanikeze futhi ulawule imisebenzi yansuku zonke nanyanga zonke yamaqembu okulungisa. Lungiselela izikhathi zomsebenzi wanyanga zonke futhi qiniseka ukuthi imisebenzi yenziwa ngokusho kwezinhlelo zomsebenzi ezamukelekile namaphepha wemisebenzi. Yenza okuhlwayo okujwayelekile kwemigwabo ukuze ubone, uhlole futhi urekhode iziphazamisi zomgwabo. Qapha futhi ubike izenzo ezingekho emthethweni nokungena ngaphakathi kwindawo egodliwe yomgwabo. Lawula ukusetshenziswa, okuhlwayo nokuphephile kwezimoto, izitsha, izibuciko namathuluzi omnyango, qiniseka ukuthi asetshenziswa ngemigomo yomsebenzi kuphela. Lawula futhi uphendule ngamathuluzi, izibuciko nezinto ezinikwe amaqembu okulungisa. Yenza okuhlwayo kwendawo ukuze ulawule izinga lomsebenzi, umkhiqizo nokuhambisana nezindinganiso zomnyango. Yenza futhi ukuphoqelele izidingo zezempilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi, phenye izenzakalo futhi uhlole imibiko yezenzakalo zokuphepha. Siza futhi ulawule ukufundisa nokuqeqesha abasebenzi bokulungisa esizeni. Qiniseka ukuhambisana nomthetho ophathekayo, izinqubomgomo, izinqubo nezindinganiso zomnyango. Qapha ukusebenza nokuhambisana kwabakhiqizi nezibopho zesivumelwano, umthetho nezidingo zomnyango. Phatha ukusebenza kwabasebenzi ngeSistimu Yokuphatha Nokuthuthukisa Ukusebenza (PMDS). Hlela futhi uhambise imibiko yemisebenzi njengoba kudingwa abaphathi.

xh.title: Omane wabasebenzi bendlela
xh.summary: Kufunekwa omane wabasebenzi bendlela e Gauteng ukuyila kwaye alawule imisebenzi yeqela elilungisa iindlela, kufuneka inqanaba le NQF Level 3 nethimba leminyaka emithathu yamava.
xh.duties: Yila, yaba kwaye ulawule imisebenzi yamaxesha angapheliyo nanye ngeveki yamaqela alungisa iindlela. Lungiselela iinkqubo zomsebenzi wamaveki kwaye uqiniseke ukuba imisebenzi yenziwa ngokwemigaqo yokusebenza evunyiweyo namaphepha obuthume. Qhuba ukuhlolwa okuvamileyo kweindlela ukuze uzibe, uhlolisise kwaye urekhode iimpazamo zolwakhiwo lweindlela. Lawula kwaye uxela ngemisebenzi engezonyanze nokungena ngaphakathi kwendawo egcinwe yindlela. Lawula ukusetyenziswa, ukuhlolwa nokusebenza ngokhuseleko kwezithuthi, iiplanti, izixhobo namathulusi esebenze, kuqinisekise ukuba zisetyenziswa kuphela ngeenjongo zomsebenzi. Lawula kwaye ubale ngokweenkcukacha izixhobo, amathulusi nezinto ezinikiwe kumaqela alungisa iindlela. Qhuba ukuhlolwa kwindawo yokusebenza ukuze ulawule umgangatho womsebenzi, umveliso nokuzithoba ngokwemigaqo yesebe. Sebenzisa kwaye ugcine iimfuno zempilo nokhuseleko kwangaphakathi komsebenzi, phenisa iinkangeleko kwaye ulungelelanise iingxelo zeziganeko zokhuseleko. Qinisekisa kwaye ulawule uqeqesho nokuphuhlisa abasebenzi abalungisa iindlela kwindawo yokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukuzithoba ngokomthetho osebenzayo, iinkqubo, iindlela nemigaqo yesebe. Lawula ukusebenza komthengi nokuzithoba ngokweenkqubo zentengiso, umthetho nokuqonda kwisebe. Lawula ukusebenza kwabasebenzi ngokweNkqubo yoLawulo noPhuhliso loQeqesho (PMDS). Lungelanisa kwaye unikeze iingxelo ezibalelayo njengoko kufunwa ngurhulumente.

Ukusetshenziswa kwesithuthi sommesejini: qiniseka ukuthi isithuthi sisetshenziswa ngesiqusetjenziswa esihlosiwe; qiniseka ukuthi isithuthi sigciniwe sincwele.

jobs.title: Tradesman AID

jobs.title: Road Worker
jobs.centre: Tshwane (X5 Posts) (Johannesburg) (X5 Posts) REQUIRMENTS    :   NQF level 1 qualification or (Abet level 4 certificate or equivalent). No work experience is required. Knowledge and Skills: Ability and willingness to work under pressure. Good communication skills will be an added advantage. Ability to work in a team. Ability to read and write.
jobs.summary: Ten road worker positions in Tshwane requiring an NQF level 1 or ABET level 4 qualification, involving routine road construction and maintenance activities.
jobs.duties: Perform routine road construction and maintenance activities in accordance with approved work programmes and safety standards. Carry out pothole patching, crack sealing, surfacing and re-gravelling of roads. Construct, repair and maintain road earthworks, culverts, side drains, stormwater drainage systems, ditches, outlets and concrete channels. Clean and maintain road reserves, sidewalks, drainage structures, rest areas and other road infrastructure. Install, replace, repair and clean road traffic signs, road markings, delineators and other road furniture. Assist with the erection, repair and maintenance of road fencing, steel guardrails, gabions and pipe-laying works. Operate and maintain hand tools, small plant and specialised equipment in accordance with departmental procedures. Safeguard departmental tools, equipment and materials issued for official duties and report any losses or defects. Maintain a clean and safe work site and comply with occupational health and safety requirements. Assist with traffic accommodation and other road maintenance activities as directed by the supervisor. As work will be done throughout the province of Gauteng it must be noted that staff may be required to travel and sleep close to the various construction sites.

af.title: Padwerker
af.summary: Tien padwerkerposte in Tshwane wat 'n NQF-vlak 1- of ABET-vlak 4-kwalifikasie vereis, en roetine padkonstruksie- en instandhoudingsaktiwiteite behels.
af.duties: Voer roetine padkonstruksie- en instandhoudingsaktiwiteite uit in ooreenstemming met goedgekeurde werkprogramme en veiligheidsstandaarde. Voer pothole-patching, kraakseëling, oppervlakwerking en hergraveling van paaie uit. Konstrueer, herstel en onderhou pad-aardwerk, kulpvoering, sydreine, stormwaterdreineer stelsels, slote, uitlate en betonkanale. Skoon en onderhou padreserwe, sypaadjies, dreineerstrukture, rusareas en ander padinfrastruktuur. Installeer, vervang, herstel en skoon padverkeerstekens, padmerke, afbakeners en ander padmeubels. Bystand met die oprigting, herstel en instandhouding van padomheinings, staalreëlings, gabions en pyplegingswerk. Bedryf en onderhou handgereedskap, klein aanlegte en gespesialiseerde toerusting in ooreenstemming met departementele prosedures. Beskerm departementele gereedskap, toerusting en materiaal wat vir amptelike pligte uitgereik is en rapporteer enige verliese of gebreke. Handhaaf 'n skoon en veilige werkterreine en voldoen aan beroeps Gesondheids- en veiligheidsvereistes. Bystand met verkeergeriewe en ander padinstandhoudingsaktiwiteite soos deur die toesighouer aangedui. Aangesien werk regdeur die provinsie van Gauteng gedoen sal word, moet daar kennis geneem word dat personeel dalk benodig mag word om te reis en naby die verskeie konstruksieterreine te oornag.

xh.title: Umsebenzi weNdlela
xh.summary: Izithuba eleshumi zemisebenzi yendlela eTshwane ezifuna izifundo zeNQF level 1 okanye ABET level 4, ezibandakanya imisebenzi eqhelekileyo yokwakhiwa nokulondolozwa kweendlela.
xh.duties: Yenza imisebenzi eqhelekileyo yokwakhiwa nokulondolozwa kweendlela ngokomsebenzi ovunyiweyo namagunya ephepho. Yenza ukuvala amathambo, ukuvala iindonga, ukubakela iindawo nokubeka umhlaba kwakhona kwiindlela. Yakha, lungisa ulondoloze umhlaba weendlela, iindonga ezihamba ngaphantsi kweendlela, iindonga ezicala iindlela, iinkqubo zamanzu eputukeyo, iindonga, amadlebe namaphondo e-concrete. Cocola ulondoloze iindawo ezigqithiswe ziindlela, iindlela ezihamba abahamba ngeenyawo, iindakada zamaphondo, iindawo zokuphumla nezinye iindakada zokwakhiwa kweendlela. Faka, tshintsha, lungisa uze ucocole iimpawu zethrafikhi ezindleleni, iimpawu ezingabonakali ngokucacileyo, izahlulelo kunye nezinye izixhobo zasezindleleni. Phakamisa, lungisa ulondoloze ulwakhiwo lweendlela ezibakelwe iingcinga, izixhobo zokhusela i-steel, iindonga ezakhiwe ngamatye kunye nomsebenzi wokubeka amaphondo. Sebenzisa ulondoloze izixhobo zesandla, iityantshana kunye nezixhobo ezizodwa ngokwemigaqo yesabe. Hlala ukhusela izixhobo ezinikiwe ukuba zisetyenziswe kumsebenzi ofanelekileyo kokunye neemfuno zokusebenza kwangoko uze uxele naziphi na iintsengo okanye iziphaziso. Hlala ugcinela indawo ehlanzekileyo nephephileyo yokusebenza uze ulandele iimfuno zamagunya oyonwabo nephepho. Yenza umsebenzi wokumisela ithrafikhi kunye nezinye imisebenzi yolondolozo lweendlela njengoko kelwe ngumlawuli. Njengoko umsebenzi uza kwenziwa kulo lonke iphondo iGauteng, makugcinwe ngenxo ukuba abasebenzi banokufuneka bahambe baze bagqithe ekusingatheni iindawo ezahlukeneyo zokwakhiwa.

jobs.title: Cleaner GP 11/10/26
jobs.summary: Cleaner position at SAPS Pretoria ICTU requiring ABET Level 4 or Grade 9, offering R144 024 per annum at salary level 2.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must display competency in the core functions of the post. Be proficient in at least English and one other official language. Be a citizen of the Republic of South Africa of which documentary proof must be furnished on the day of the interview. Be in possession of ABET Level 4/ Grade 9/ Standard 7/ NQF Level 1 for which documentary proof can be produced when required. Knowledge Skills and Competencies Understanding of how to handle cleaning detergents. Occupational Health and Safety protocol. Basic literacy, numeracy and communication skills. Be able to read and write; Ability to interact with other officials in a professional manner. The ability to operate elementary machines and equipment; Willing to work extended hours when necessary.
jobs.duties: Maintaining of a high level of hygiene in and around the workplace with the cleaning of the SAPS premises assigned to, which may include either or both inner and outer parameters. Performing tasks of a routine nature, such as dusting. Polish furniture and floors. Vacuum carpets and mopping of tile floors. Remove refuse. Perform maintenance tasks in and around the assigned premises. Clean bathrooms and kitchens. Safekeeping and handling of a variety of Aids in the cleaning of the premises. Loading and unloading of goods. Garden maintenance services. Washing and cleaning of state vehicles, kitchenware and utensils.
jobs.enquiries: Lieutenant Colonel Scheepers Tel No: (011) 274-7301
jobs.applications: Due to the large volume of applications anticipated, it is preferrable for applications to be hand-delivered during office hours to Nr 7 Dolphin Street, Mayfair or scan application and CV together as one complete attachment and e-mail to ToerienLR@saps.gov.za.
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a Z83 Form (2021 version), obtainable from http://www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp, which must be accompanied with a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae. The post particulars and reference number of the post you are applying for, must be correctly specified on the application form. Please complete a separate application form for each post you wish to apply for. It is the responsibility of the applicants to submit applications timeously to the correct physical address as provided in the advertisement. Please note that applications submitted to an incorrect physical address will not be considered. Late applications will not be accepted or considered. Short-listed candidates will be required to produce originals of their Identity Document (ID), Senior Certificate and all educational qualifications obtained, service certificates from previous employers stating the occupation and motor vehicle driver’s license, before the interview. Qualifications and driver’s licences submitted will be subjected to verification with the relevant institutions. Applicants must have no previous criminal convictions or pending criminal/ departmental cases and shall allow their fingerprints to be taken and background enquiries to be made. Short-listed candidates may be subjected to a full security clearance process before or during any stage of employment. Short-listed candidates will be subjected to a vetting process which will include security screening, fingerprint screening, reference checking and verification of address, where necessary. All short-listed candidates, including the SMS, will be expected to undergo a personal interview and shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, (a) a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, as well as (b) an integrity assessment (ethical conduct). Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Short- listed candidates for appointments to certain identified posts will be vetted in terms of the Criminal Law (Sexual Offences and Related Matters) Amendment Act, 2007 (Act No 32 of 2007) and the Children’s Act, 2005 (Act No 38 of 2005). A candidate whose particulars appear in either the National Register for Sex Offenders or Part B of the Child Protection Register, will be disqualified from appointment. Candidates are expected to disclose if he/ she is a respondent in an interim or final protection order in terms of the Domestic Violence Act, 1998 (Act no 116 of 1998) or Protection from Harassment Act, 2011 (Act No 17 of 2011), and may be disqualified from appointment. The Criminal Law (Forensic Procedures) Amendment Act, Act 37 of 2013 requires that all new appointments in the South African Police Service as from 31 January 2015 provide a buccal (inside cheek) sample to determine their forensic DNA profile. The forensic DNA profile derived from the sample will be loaded to the Elimination Index of the National Forensic DNA Database. Appointments will be made in terms of the Public Service Act, 1994 (Act No 103 of 1994) as applicable to the post environment. Persons who retired from the Public Service by taking a severance package, early retirement or medical retirement, as well as persons with previous convictions, are excluded. The South African Police Service is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer and it is the intention to promote representivity in the Public Service through the filling of these posts. Persons whose transfer/ appointment will promote representivity will therefore receive preference. The South African Police Service is under no obligation to fill a post after the advertisement thereof. Correspondence will be conducted with successful candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Skoonmaker GP 11/10/26
af.summary: Skoonmakerpos by SAPS Pretoria ICTU wat ABET Level 4 of Grade 9 vereis, wat R144 024 per jaar teen salarisvlak 2 bied.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet bevoegdheid toon in die kernfunksies van die pos. Wees bedrywig in ten mineste Engels en een ander amptelike taal. Wees 'n burger van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika waarvan dokumentêre bewys op die dag van die onderhoud verskaf moet word. In besit wees van ABET Level 4/ Grade 9/ Standard 7/ NQF Level 1 waarvoor dokumentêre bewys voorgelê kan word wanneer daarvoor versoek word. Kennis, Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede Begrip van hoe om skoonmaakmiddels te hanteer. Beroepsgesondheids- en veiligheidsprotokol. Basiese geletterdheid, syferkundigheid en kommunikasievaardighede. Wees in staat om te lees en te skryf; Vermoë om op 'n professionele wyse met ander amptenare te skakel. Die vermoë om elementêre masjiene en toerusting te bedryf; Gewillig om ekstra ure te werk wanneer nodig.
af.duties: Handhaaf van 'n hoë vlak van higiëne in en om die werkplek met die skoonmaak van die SAPS persele waaraan toegewys is, wat óf die binne- óf die buiteparameters, óf albei, kan insluit. Uitvoer van take van 'n routine-aard, soos afstof. Wasmobbelmeubels en vloere. Stofsuig tapyte en draf teëlvloere. Verwyder afval. Uitvoer van instandhoudingstake in en om die toegewysde persele. Maak badkamers en kombuise skoon. Veilige bewaring en hantering van 'n verskeidenheid hulpmiddels by die skoonmaak van die persele. Laai en aflaai van goedere. Tuinonderhoudsdienste. Was en skoonmaak van staatsvoertuie, kombuisware en gereedskap.

zu.title: Ukunucoki GP 11/10/26
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokunucoki esikhundleni iSAPS Pretoria ICTU sidinga i-ABET Level 4 noma i-Grade 9, sinikeza i-R144 024 ngonyaka eholo elinga 2.
zu.requirements: Abafaki izicelo kumele babonise ukukwazi kumisebenzi eyisiseko yesikhundla. Babe nolwazi okungenani esiNgisini nolunye ulimi olusemthethweni. Babe ngabazinguzingu bangaRiphabhuliki yaseNingizimu Afrika okumele kube khona ubufakazi abubhalayo osukwini lokuxoxisana. Babe ne-ABET Level 4/ Grade 9/ Standard 7/ NQF Level 1 okungeza ubufakazi obubhalayo kutholwe uma kudingeka. Ulwazi Amakhono nokukwazi Ukuqonda indlela yokuphatha amakhemikheli okunucoka. I-Occupational Health and Safety protocol. Amasisekelo okufunda, okubala nokuxhumana. Bakwazi ukufunda nokubhala; Ikono lokuxhumana nabanye abasebenzi ngendlela ehloniphekile. Ikono lokusebenzisa imishini nezisetshenziswa eziyisisekelo; Bavolontiya ukusebenza amahora amude uma kunesidingo.
zu.duties: Ukugcina izinga eliphezulu lokucofa endaweni yokusebenza nasendaweni ezungezile ngokunucoka izakhiwo zeSAPS ezabeliwe, okungase faka izindinganiso ezingaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukwenza imisebenzi evamile, njengokusula uthuli. Ukupholisha imif nemipheme. Ukuvakha amakhava kanye nokuphuca phansi phansi lethayili. Ukususa izinkulumo. Ukwenza imisebenzi yokulungisa endaweni ezabeliwe nasendaweni ezungezile. Ukunucoka indawo yokugezela namakhishi. Ukugcina nokuphatha inhlobo ezahlukene zezisetshenziswa ekunucokeni izakhiwo. Ukulayisha nokulayisha okuphansi impahla. Inkonzomisebenzi yokugcina isive. Ukuhla nokunucoka izimoto zombuso, izinto zasekhishi nezisetshenziswa.

xh.title: Umcobi GP 11/10/26
xh.summary: Isithuba somcobi kwi-SAPS Pretoria ICTU sifuna i-ABET Level 4 okanye i-Grade 9, sinika umvuzo we-R144 024 ngonyaka kwinqanaba lomvuzo 2.
xh.requirements: Abafaki-msebenzi kufuneka abonise ukuzipatha kakuhle kumisebenzi eyeyona ntsebenzo yalesi sithuba. Kufuneka bakwazi ukubukoma ngesiNgesi nakwelinye ulwimi olusemthethweni ngenxa yelinye ulwimi. Kufuneka babe ngabemi bonke benkululeko yaseMzantsi Afrika, apho kufuneka kuhliswe ubungqina ngemibhalo ngosuku wemvuyo. Kufuneka babe nakho i-ABET Level 4/ Grade 9/ Standard 7/ NQF Level 1 ekwenzela ukuba ubungqina ngemibhalobungako ukubakhiwa xa kufuneka. Ulwazi Amandla Nokuzipatha Kuqonda indlela yokusebenzisa amachiza okucoca. I-Occupational Health and Safety protocol. Amandla abalayo abanzi, abanamanani nokuqhathanisa nabanye. Ukuba nakho ukufunda nokubhala; Amandla okuchasana nabanye abasebenzi ngendlela eqotho. Amandla okusebenzisa iimashini nempahla ezilula; Ukulungele ukusebenza iiyure ezinintsokothi xa kuyimfuneko.
xh.duties: Ukugcina inqanaba eliphezulu lococo kwaye ejikeleze indawo yokusebenza ngokucoca iindawo ze-SAPS ezabelwe kuzo, ezinokubanza okanye zibe ngeendawo zangaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukwenza imisebenzi ehamba njalo, njengokucoca umhlama. Ukucoca iimpahla nezitulo. Ukucoca iikaraphu nendlela yokuhlikihlela iifloho ezityhidiweyo. Ukususa inkunkuma. Ukwenza imisebenzi yokulungisa kwaye ejikeleze iindawo ezabelwe kuzo. Ukucoca iindlu zokuhlambuza nesiqholo. Ukugcina kwaye uphathise ubunjwabela bezixhobo ezahlukeneyo ekucoceni iindawo. Ukufaka nokukhipha impahla. Iinkonzo zokulondoloza isivuno. Ukuhlambuza nokucoca izithuthi zikarhulumente, impahla yekhitshi nezixhobo zekhitshi.

jobs.title: Environmental Officer Production Grade A-C
jobs.department: Department of Economic Development, Tourism and Environmental Affairs
jobs.salary_text: R357 597 – R395 352 per annum, (OSD) CENTRE             Ethekwini, Ilembe, Ugu, Amajuba, And Harry Gwala Districts
jobs.closing_date_text: 06 November 2026 (at 16h00). Applications received after the closing date and time will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Environmental Officer position supporting municipalities with environmental management, coastal zones and ecosystem projects across multiple KwaZulu-Natal districts.
jobs.requirements: The ideal candidate must have: An appropriate four-year Bachelor’s Degree in Environmental Management / Natural Sciences as recognised by SAQA; A minimum of one to two (1-2) years’ relevant experience in the Environmental Management field. A valid driver’s licence (code B).
jobs.duties: The incumbent will be required to: Provide environmental management support to municipalities and other organs of state/private entities; Support the management of Special Area management programmes and projects (including coastal zone management, threatened ecosystem, mountain catchment areas, wetlands, climate change adaptation and mitigation programmes and projects, etc.); Support the implementation of sustainable development planning initiatives and projects; Provide support in ensuring effective and efficient environmental information management system(s) within the district municipality; Perform all administrative and delegated work-related functions. Skills, Training, And Competencies: The successful candidate must have knowledge and understanding of the objects and provisions of the National Environmental Management Act, 1998, and associated legislation. Sound working knowledge of key environmental legislation, policies, and frameworks governing environmental management. Knowledge and understanding of the regulatory framework such as Sustainable Development Frameworks; Environmental Management Legislation framework; Development management legislative framework; Cooperative Governance Frameworks; Governance Planning, Evaluation and Reporting Frameworks, and Strategy Implementation Planning Frameworks. Knowledge and understanding of the Regulatory Framework for the Public Service, e.g., Public Service Act, PFMA, Treasury Regulations, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Skills Development Act, Service Delivery Frameworks (Batho Pele Principles). Skills: Ability to communicate at all levels with relevant stakeholders; Ability to evaluate and review documents; adaptive learning skills; ambidexterity in regular operations versus project initiatives execution; Technical Report writing, Policy Development and Analysis, Scientific Presentation; Research and Development, Mentoring, Administrative Management; Financial Management; Project Management; Computer Literacy, Report writing; change management, information management, spatial information management, organizational and event management, Analytical and Research skills; Presentation skills; Decision Making, People Management; Conflict Management; Good Interpersonal Relations; Problem Solving; Communication Skills (verbal and written). Values/ Attributes such as integrity, respect, honesty, discipline, teamwork, vision, transparency, commitment.
jobs.enquiries: MS N Walingo at 076 9385 441
jobs.applications: “Applicants are encouraged to apply for posts through the KZN online e- Recruitment system at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs or submit their Z83 and CV directly to the following email address: kznjobs@kznedtea.gov.za. Applicants may also visit any one of our Designated Online Application Centres (DOACS), where our friendly staff will assist you with applying online or receiving your hardcopy application. You can find the Designated Online Application Centres (DOACS) list at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs.” Please note that applicants should only use one of the following methods when applying for a post: Either through the online E-Recruitment System, Emailing the Z83 and CV directly to the relevant department, or submitting a hardcopy application as directed. Applications may alternatively be forwarded to the Department of Economic Development, Tourism and Environmental Affairs, Private Bag X9152, Pietermaritzburg, 3200, OR hand-delivered to the Ground Floor, 270 Jabu Ndlovu Street, Pietermaritzburg, 3201, in the vacancy box provided for the attention of Ms Nondumiso Buthelezi / Mr Sipho Zangwa.
jobs.notes: NB: all the appointments will be made in accordance with the employment equity targets of the department, which are African Male, Coloured Male, Indian male. people with disabilities who meet the requirements are encouraged to apply. successful candidates must note that they will have to serve in the districts where they are placed for a minimum of five (05) years before any transfers within the department can be considered. Directions To Candidates The Provincial Administration of KwaZulu-Natal is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer, and women and people with disabilities are encouraged to apply. The Department reserves the right not to make these appointments. All information submitted will be treated as confidential. The Department reserves the right to withhold the filling of the abovementioned posts at any time before an appointment. All applications must be submitted on the new Application for Employment form (Z83), which became effective from the 1st of January 2021, obtainable from any Public Service Department or can be downloaded at www.dpsa.gov.za-vacancies. The form must be completed in full, and the application form should be initiated, signed, and dated. All required information on the Z83 must be provided. Failure to complete or disclose all information will automatically disqualify the applicant. The completed and signed Z83 must be accompanied by an updated, detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV). Dates of starting and leaving employment must be given as DD/MM/YYYY. Shortlisted candidates must submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview, following communication from Human Resources. Should an applicant have a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applications submitted electronically will be taken as a final application and may not be amended or supplemented in any way after the closing date indicated in the advertisement. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Shortlisted candidates will be required to undergo a competency test/technical exercise. Candidates are discouraged from sending their applications through registered mail, as the Department will not take responsibility for the non-collection of those applications. The appointment is subject to a positive outcome obtained from the State Security Agency to the following checks (security clearance, qualification, citizenship, and previous employment verifications).          The Department will conduct reference checks with the HR of the current and or /previous employer(s) apart from the referees listed. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Before the appointment for SMS positions, the appointee will be required to produce a Pre-entry certificate for the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme, a public service-specific training program applicable to all applicants who aspire to join the SMS. The course is offered by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG as the Certificate for Entry, and full details can be found at: https://www.thensg.gov.za/trainingcourse/smspre-entryprogramme. Regrettably, due to excessive budget cuts, the Department cannot cover any travel and subsistence costs related to the recruitment process. OTHER POST

af.title: Omgewingsbeampte Produksie Vlak A-C
af.summary: Omgewingsbeampte-posisie wat munisipaliteite ondersteun met omgewingsbestuur, kussones en ekosisteemprojekte oor verskeie KwaZulu-Natal-distrikte.
af.requirements: Die ideale kandidaat moet oor die volgende beskik: 'n Toepaslike vierjaar Baccalaureus-graad in Omgewingsbestuur / Natuurwetenskappe soos deur SAQA erken; 'n Minimum van een tot twee (1-2) jaar se relevante ervaring in die Omgewingsbestuurveld; 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie (kode B).
af.duties: Die ampshouer sal verlang word om: Omgewingsbestuursteun aan munisipaliteite en ander staatsorgane/ private entiteite te verleen; Die bestuur van Spesiale Gebiedbestuursprogramme en -projekte te ondersteun (insluitend kussonebestuur, bedreigde ekosisteme, bergopvanggebiede, vleilande, klimaatsveranderingsaanpassing- en -beperkingsprogramme en -projekte, ens.); Die implementering van volhoubare ontwikkelingsbeplanningsinisiatiewe en -projekte te ondersteun; Steun te verleen om doeltreffende en doeltroue omgewingsinligtingbestuurstelsel(s) binne die distriksmunisipaliteit te verseker; Alle administratiewe en gedelegeerde werkverwante funksies uit te voer. Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede: Die suksesvolle kandidaat moet kennis en begrip hê van die oogmerke en bepalings van die Nasionale Omgewingsbestuurswet, 1998, en geassosieerde wetgewing; Deeglike werkskennis van sleutel-omgewingswetgewing, beleide en raamwerke wat omgewingsbestuur reël; Kennis en begrip van die regulerende raamwerk soos Volhoubare Ontwikkelingsraamwerke; Omgewingsbestuurswetgewingsraamwerk; Ontwikkelingsbestuurswetgewingsraamwerk; Samewerkende Bestuursraamwerke; Bestuursbeplanning, Evaluering en Verslagdoeningsraamwerke, en Strategie-implementeringsbeplanningsraamwerke; Kennis en begrip van die Regulerende Raamwerk vir die Openbare Diens, bv., Openbare Dienswet, PFMA, Tesourie-regulasies, Openbare Diensregulasies, Arbeidsverhoudingswet, Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid, Basiese Diensvoorwaardewet, Vaardigheidsontwikkelingswet, Diensleweringraamwerke (Batho Pele-beginsels); Vaardighede: Vermoë om op alle vlakke met relevante belanghebbendes te kommunikeer; Vermoë om dokumente te evalueer en te hersien; aanpassingsleervaardighede; ambidexterity in gereelde bedrywighede versus projekinisiatief-uitvoering; Tegniese verslagskrywing, Beleidsontwikkeling en -ontleding, Wetenskaplike aanbieding; Navorsing en Ontwikkeling, Mentorskap, Administratiewe Bestuur; Finansiële Bestuur; Projekbestuur; Rekenaarvaardigheid, Verslagskrywing; veranderingbestuur, inligtingbestuur, ruimtelike inligtingbestuur, organisatoriese en geleentheidbestuur, Analitiese en Navorsingsvaardighede; Aanbiedingsvaardighede; Besluitneming, Menslike Bestuur; Konflikbestuur; Goeie Interpersoonlike Verhoudinge; Probleemoplossing; Kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik); Waardes/ Attribute soos integriteit, respek, eerlikheid, dissipline, spanwerk, visie, deursigtigheid, toewyding.

zu.title: Onjiniyela Wemvelo Ukukhiqiza Izinga A-C
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaOnjiniyela Wemvelo esisekela oomasipala ngokuphathwa kwemvelo, izindawo zasolwandle namaphrojekthi wezimvelo kumawombe amaningi e-KwaZulu-Natal.
zu.requirements: Umsekeli ohlelekile kumele abe ne: I-degree yamashumi amane eminyaka ye-Bachelor ehambisana ne-Natural Sciences / ezokuphathwa kwemvelo njengoba kumatshunywe yi-SAQA; Okungenani amashumi amanye kuya kwamabili (1-2) eminyaka yolesiphephelo esihambisana nomkhakha wezokuphathwa kwemvelo. Ilayisensi yokuqasha ehlelekile (ikhowudi B).
zu.duties: Umntu oyikhonzile kuzofuneka: Anike inkxaso yokuphathwa kwemvelo kumamasipala nakwezinye izitho zombuso / izikhungo ezizimele; Axhase ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo zamaphrojekthi nezindawo ezikhethekile (okuqukethe ukuphathwa kwezindawo zasolwandle, izimvelo ezinsongekayo, izindawo zokuthola amanzi entaba, amadlebe, amaphrojekthi wezinhlelo zokuzinza nokulungisa ushintsho lwesimo sezulu, njll.); Axhase ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokuhlela ukukhiqiza okuzinza namaphrojekthi; Anike inkxaso ekuqinisekisweni kokusebenza ngempumelelo nangokunethezeka kwamasistimu okuphatha ulwazi olumayelana nemvelo ngaphakathi komasipala womlando; Azenze yonke imisebenzi yentengo yokubhaliswa nokwenziwa komsebenzi ohlotshaniswa naye. Amakhono, ukuqeqeshwa, nokuziqonda emsebenzini: Umsekeli ophumelelayo kumele abe nolwazi nokuthi aqonde izinhloso nobuqwebeqwebe be-National Environmental Management Act, 1998, kanye nomthetho ohambisana nawo. Ulwazi oluhle lokusebenza ngomthetho oyinhloko wemvelo, amapholisi, namakhandlela okuphatha imvelo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukwakheka komthetho njengokubakwamakhandlela eziThekwini Nsukuzonke; umthetho wokuphathwa kwemvelo; umthetho wokuphathwa kokuthuthukiswa; amakhandlela abumbisana kahle njengokubakwe-National Development Agency; amakhandlela okuhlela, ukuhlola nokubika okuqinisekisa ukuphathwa okuhlanganyenayo kanye namakhandlela okuhlela isu lenzuzo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukwakheka kwemithetho yomphakathi njengokubakweNdinganiso yonke yomphakathi njengokubakwe-White Paper on the Transformation of the Public Service Act, 1995; Public Finance Management Act, 1999; Public Service Act; Public Service Regulations, 1999; amanye amthetho njengokuba yi-State Information Technology Agency Act; Government Employees Pension Law; Employment Equity Act; Labour Relations Act; Basic Conditions of Employment Act; Skills Development Act; amagatsha njengalawo adinga ukwakheka nokuqondwa; Namakhono: Isikhathi sezinkomfa ezihambisana ezikoleni eziqoshwe kuleso sikhathi nangaphezulu kwendawo nokwazi ukusebenzisa imininingwane ekubhaleni izinkomba; Amakhono okubika, ukuqamba amaphuzu okuqinisekiswa, ukuhlanganisa ukuphatha nokucatshangelwa kokunye; Amakhono okwenziwa kwamaphrojekthi, ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi; Ulwazi lwekhompyutha; ukuhlakanipha, ukuqhathanisa nokuhlola, ukuphathwa komchazamkhando, ukuxhumana nokudlulisa ulwazi, ukuphathwa kokuqoqwa kwemibhalo, nokuphathwa kwebhizinisi nokuqoqwa; Isibonakaliso, okuningi okungenwa ngokusebenzisa izinyathelo ezinde kakhulu nokuqamba nokubika; ukwenza izinqumo, ukuphathwa kwabantu, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga; amakhono okuxhumana abantu, ukuphathwa kolwazi, ukuphathwa kolwazi nolwazi lwendawo; amakhono okuhlaziya nokuthola usizo, amakhono okuhlela, ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi yabasebenzi nokuxhumana kwabantu; isibindi, ukuzithiba, ukwesaba ukwenza okungalungile, ukwesaba ukukhohlwa, ukulalela, ukubekwa kwesikhundla, ukulalelwa nokuxhumana, ukumisela, ukulungisa, ukuziphatha okuhle, ukuziphatha okuhle, ukuxhumana okuhle, ukuziphatha okuhle nokuxhumana okuhle.

xh.title: Isebe Lemvelo Umphathiswa Kwindalo Inqanaba A-C
xh.summary: Isithuba somphathiswa wemvelo oxhasa ngisohlwayo ukulawula imvelo, iindawo zasolwandle namaprojekthi wesicoco kuwo wonke amaphondo amaninzi eKwaZulu-Natal.
xh.requirements: Umama obalulekileyo kufuneka abe nale: I-degree yeBachelor kwiminyaka emine kwilawulo lemvelo / iNzululwazi eNdalo njengokuba kuyamkelwa yiSAQA; Ubuncinane beminyaka elitha ukuya kwabini (1-2) yamava afanelekileyo kwilawulo lemvelo. Ilayisenisi yokushuka esemthethweni (ikhowudi B).
xh.duties: Umntu okhethiweyo uya kufuneka: Abonelele ngenkxaso yolawulo lemvelo kumasoohlwayo nakwezinye iintho karhulumente/iziqupha; Axhase ulawulo lweenkqubo namaprojekthi oLawulo lweendawo eZizodwa (kuquka ulawulo lweendawo zasolwandle, izicoco ezasengozini, iindawo zokubamba amanzi ezintabeni, amachibi, iinkqubo namaprojekthi zokuzivumelanisa nokunciphisa utshintsho lwemozulu, njl.); Axhase ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo namaprojekthi zokucotha ngokuhlala kunyuka; Bonelele ngenkxaso kuqinisekiso lweenkqubo ezisebenzayo ngeziphakamiso zolwazi lwemvelo kwisoohlwayo somasipala; Aphure imisebenzi yonke yolawulo nezinye ezimisiweyo ezinxulumene nomsebenzi. Amakhono, uQeqesho, kunye neNkomfa: Umama opumeleleyo kufuneka abe nolwazi lokuqonda iinjongo kunye neemimiselo yoMthetho woLawulo lwemvelo weSizwe ka1998, nalo mthetho onguxhaxha. Ulwazi olusebenzayo lwemithetho yemvelo, iinkqubo, namakhowudi aphaflowe kulawulo lwemvelo. Ulwazi nokuqonda okukhoyo kwendalo yolawulo njengokuMmiselo wokuCotha ngokuhlala; uMthetho ozaflowe woLawulo lwemvelo; uMthetho ozaflowe wolawulo lophuhliso; uMmiselo woLawulo ngokubambisana; uMmiselo woQeqesho, ukuHlola nokuChaza ngokwenza, kunye noMmiselo woQeqesho lokuGqiba iNdaba, nalawo mithetho yomGaqo-nkqubo. Ulwazi nokuqonda koMmiselo wolawulo kaQhankqo lweZizwe, umzekelo, uMthetho woQhankqo, iPFMA, iRegulation kaBulawa, iRegulation kaQhankqo, uMthetho weedoloji lwentlalo, uMthetho weMpilo koQeqesho, iRegulation eBuhlungu baseNyangweni, kunye namakhowudi okulawula ukuhanjiswa kwemisebenzi. Amakhono: Ukuthetha nakwizinqanaba zonke kunye nalo bani na ukuphila kwezentlalo; Ukwahlula nokubuyekeza amaxwebhu; amakhono okulola ukusula; ukuhanjiswa kolungelelwaniso ekusebenzeni njengesiqhelo kunye nokuhanjiswa kwamaphrojekthi; ukubhaliweenzichtwa ezitshay'ubuchwepheshe, oluPhuhliso lweNkqubo nokuHlola, iyunivesithi ngobukhaladi bemitsho; ucando kunye noQeqesho, oluLawulo ngokuziphatha; oluLawulo lwemali; oluLawulo lweProje; ukuFundisa ngekhompyutha, ukubhalo; ukuLawulwa kwesimo, ukugcina ulwazi, ukulawula iifowuni nolwazi, ngokuziphatha ngokumisela iindawo zeefowuni ezihamba ezweni, iinkqubo ezibizwa ngokwenza iimfuno ngokuziphatha, amakhono okuhlola imixholo yemiyalelo ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi oluqinileyo lweNkcubaka nokuBhalwa ngokusetyenziswa kwesixhobo esingundoqo sekompyutha; Iimpawu ngokuziphatha ngokuchaseneyo, ukuba mhle ngokuthetha ngokusukela ngokubonakalisa nasekuboniseni iindlela ezahlukeneyo, ezigqibeleleyo zeNdawo yeNkcubako; Ukucoca iNkqubo yeMisebenzi, ukuLawula uluntu olusebenzisa iinkqubo ezahlukileyo kuxhomekeke ekubeni abantu baye basetenziswa ngokulingana ngexesha elithile, iinkalo ezahlukeneyo zoluntu ekuphuhliseni iinkqubo; Ukubeka iNdawo nokuBhalwa ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi nokuqonda kwabantu, ukubaleka iimfuno ezidliwayo ngokusebenzisa izikolo ezibalulekileyo ezilawulwa yiNdalo yeMfundo; Iimpawu ezifana nobuqotho, intlonipho, inyaniso, isithinti, ukusebenza ngokubambisana, umgca othi xa ngowenkqubo kungayifuni nokuziphatha ngokubonakalisa ngokusukela nasekuziphatheni.

jobs.title: Head Clinical Department: (MEDICAL) Grade 1
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R2 704 842 per annum, (all-inclusive package), All-inclusive package consists of 70% basic salary and 30% flexible portion that may be structured in terms of the applicable rules, Plus Commuted Overtime which is subject to the needs of the department. Incumbents will have to sign the commuted overtime contract form annually.
jobs.summary: Head the Department of Anaesthetics and Critical Care at Grey's Hospital, requiring an MBChB, postgraduate qualification in Anaesthesiology, and seven years' specialist experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 / Senior Certificate MBChB or equivalent. A postgraduate qualification in Anaesthesiology, or a recognized equivalent qualification that allows for registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Anaesthesiology. current registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Anaesthesiology. Seven years’ experience as a Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA in Anaesthetics and critical care. NB! (Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit proof of all documents and certificate of service endorsed by Human Resources) NB: Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be requested from the shortlisted candidates only which must be submitted to on the day of the interview (ID copy, Driver’s license, educational qualifications, professional registration certificates, proof of current registrations etc. Additional Qualifications and Experience A valid drivers license. Management experience as a Head Clinical Unit in Anaesthetic and critical care. Knowledge, Skills and Experience: Comprehensive managerial and leadership skills to head the Department of Anaesthetics and Critical Care at Grey’s Hospital, manage its operational and strategic matters, and coordinate relevant services in Area 2. Sound specialist knowledge and experience in anaesthesiology, perioperative care, resuscitation, airway management, pain management and critical care. Knowledge of critical care service delivery, including ICU bed utilisation, patient prioritisation, referral pathways, patient flow and continuity of care. Competence in developing, implementing and monitoring departmental policies, protocols, guidelines and standard operating procedures. Thorough understanding of financial management, resource allocation and optimisation, budgeting and expenditure control. Sound knowledge of Human Resource Management, including EPMDS, staff development, career pathing, recruitment and retention, labour relations, disciplinary processes and grievance management. Proficiency with computers and the Microsoft Office suite, including Outlook, PowerPoint and Excel. Risk and incident management, clinical governance, patient safety and quality improvement. Problem-solving, decision-making, analytical thinking and conflict- management proficiency. Excellent verbal and written communication, report- writing, time-management skills and professional work ethic. Clinical leadership, teaching, training, mentorship and supervision skills. Ability to work under pressure and maintain effective working relationships. Knowledge, understanding and implementation of Batho Pele principles. Knowledge of medical ethics, medico-legal risk and relevant professional standards, including appropriate clinical documentation and incident investigation. Knowledge of relevant legislation, policies and regulations of the Department of Health/DPSA, including the National Health Act, PFMA, SCM regulations and other applicable prescripts. Computer literacy and proficiency in the Microsoft office suite.
jobs.duties: Head the Department of Anaesthetics and Critical Care at Grey’s Hospital and manage its operational and strategic matters, including coordination of relevant services within Area 2. Ensure the provision of safe, cost-effective and high- quality anaesthetic and critical care services, including appropriate clinical cover for elective and emergency procedures. Oversee preoperative assessment, intraoperative anaesthetic care, recovery and postoperative support, in collaboration with surgical and other relevant clinical departments. Provide operational oversight of critical care services within the department’s approved scope, including admission and discharge processes, bed utilisation, patient prioritisation and referral pathways. Formulate and execute annual operational plans and medium- to long-term departmental strategies aligned with the Department of Health’s priorities. Develop and implement strategies to meet APP and other performance targets, including theatre utilisation, cancellation rates, ICU bed occupancy, patient flow, clinical outcomes and waiting times, as applicable. Manage staff performance, EPMDS, recruitment and retention, labour relations, disciplinary processes, conflict management and grievance handling. Ensure appropriate staffing levels, skills and competencies of departmental personnel, including sessional practitioners where applicable. Promote teaching and training of registrars, medical officers, interns, nursing personnel and undergraduate students, including postgraduate supervision and academic programmes. Maintain liaison with the relevant departments and training institutions at the University of KwaZulu- Natal, CMSA, HPCSA and other academic partners, as applicable. Ensure clinical governance through regular morbidity and mortality meetings, clinical audits, utilisation reviews, incident reviews and quality improvement activities. Maintain and review the departmental risk register and implement measures to prevent and manage clinical, operational and medico-legal incidents. Design, implement and evaluate quality assurance and improvement programmes to reduce patient safety incidents and improve service efficiency. Participate in quality initiatives, including QA meetings, implementation of the Ideal Hospital Realization and Maintenance Framework, norms and standards, and OHSC- related activities. Manage budgets and resources prudently and ensure that essential anaesthetic and critical care equipment, medicines, medical gases and consumables are available, functional and appropriately maintained. Work with Finance, Supply Chain Management, Clinical Engineering and relevant hospital units to address equipment downtime, procurement delays and resource constraints. Chair and participate in relevant committees at Grey’s Hospital as required. Maintain accurate departmental records and statistics, including theatre activity, anaesthetic procedures, critical care utilisation and clinical outcomes. Work collaboratively within the Pietermaritzburg Metropolitan Hospitals Complex, with referring hospitals, DCSTs and EMS. Oversee and support outreach, in-reach and approved virtual support programmes in Area 2. Manage and address client complaints involving the department and ensure appropriate follow-up and corrective action. Provide specialist advice to clinicians on anaesthetic, perioperative and critical care management within the scope of the department. Undertake clinical duties, including commuted overtime, as required and in accordance with prescribed requirements. Serve as acting Senior Manager: Medical Services when required and formally delegated.
jobs.enquiries: Dr NMT Gumede Tel No: (033) 897 3317
jobs.applications: Applications to be forwarded to: The Human Resources Management Office, Greys Hospital Private Bag X9001, Pietermaritzburg, 3200 or Email Applications to khazimula.goba@kznhealth.gov.za or malinee.chandul@kznhealth.gov.za. FOR ATTENTION : Mrs M. Chandulal.
jobs.notes: Directions to Candidates: Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the new Z83 form and a detailed curriculum vitae only. Additionally: The new Application for Employment Form (Z83) is obtainable from any Government Department OR from the website – www.kznhealth.gov.za. Applicants must utilize the most recent Application for Employment Form (Form Z83) as issued by the Minister for DPSA (gazetted on 06 November 2020) in line with regulation of 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016 and failure to do so will result in disqualification. Applicants are required to complete and sign Z83,and also submit a detailed curriculum vitae (CV). All sections of the new Application for Employment Form (Z83) (except those sections that are not relevant to the applicant) must be completely, accurately and legibly filled in a manner that allows a selection committee to assess the quality of a candidate based on the information provided in the form. Applicants are required to reflect information even if the same information is provided on the detailed CV. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The Employment Equity Target for this post is: The Employment Equity Target For This Post Is: African Male, Coloured Male, African Female, Coloured Female.

af.title: Hoof Kliniese Departement: (MEDIES) Graad 1
af.summary: Hoof van die Departement Anestesie en Kritieke Sorg by Grey's Hospital, wat 'n MBChB, 'n nagraadse kwalifikasie in Anestesiologie en sewe jaar se spesialiservaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12 / Senior Certificate MBChB of ekwivalent. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie in Anestesiologie, of 'n erkende ekwivalente kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Anestesiologie toelaat. Huidige registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Anestesiologie. Sewe jaar se ervaring as 'n Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA in Anestesie en kritieke sorg. NB! (Slegs gekorte lyste kandidate sal vereis word om bewys van alle dokumente en 'n dienssertifikaat wat deur Menslike Hulpbronne endosseer is, voor te lê) NB: Geverifieerde afskrifte van kwalifikasies en ander relevante dokumente sal slegs van gekorte lysde kandidate versoek word, wat op die dag van die onderhoud ingedien moet word (ID-kopie, bestuurslisensie, opvoedkundige kwalifikasies, professionele registrasiesertifikate, bewys van huidige registrasies, ens. Bykomende Kwalifikasies en Ervaring 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bestuurservaring as 'n Hoof Kliniese Eenheid in Anestesie en kritieke sorg. Kennis, Vaardighede en Ervaring: Omvattende bestuurs- en leierskapsvaardighede om die Departement Anestesie en Kritieke Sorg by Grey's Hospital te lei, sy operasionele en strategiese aangeleenthede te bestuur en tersaaklike dienste in Area 2 te koördineer. Deeglike spesialiskennis en ervaring in anestesiologie, peri-operatiewe sorg, resussitasie, lugwegbestuur, pynbestuur en kritieke sorg. Kennis van kritieke sorg-dienslewering, insluitend ICU-bedbenutting, pasiëntprioritisering, verwysingsroetes, pasiëntvloei en kontinuïteit van sorg. Bevoegdheid in die ontwikkeling, implementering en monitering van departementele beleide, protokolle, riglyne en standaardbedryfsprosedures. Deeglike begrip van finansiële bestuur, hulpbrontoekenning en optimalisering, begroting en bestuursbeheer. Deeglike kennis van Menslike Hulpbronbestuur, insluitend EPMDS, personeelontwikkeling, loopbaanpadbeplanning, werwing en behoud, arbeidsverhoudinge, disiplinêre prosesse en griepbestuur. Bedrewe met rekenaars en die Microsoft Office-suite, insluitend Outlook, PowerPoint en Excel. Risiko- en voorvalbestuur, kliniese bestuur, pasiëntveiligheid en kwaliteitsverbetering. Probleemoplossing, besluitneming, analitiese denke en konflikbestuursbevoegdheid. Uitstekende mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasie, verslagdoening, tydbestuursvaardighede en professionele werketiek. Kliniese leierskap, onderrig, opleiding, mentorskap en toesigvaardighede. Vermoë om onder druk te werk en effektiewe werksverhoudinge te handhaaf. Kennis, begrip en implementering van Batho Pele-beginsels. Kennis van mediese etiek, medico-juridiese risiko en tersaaklike professionele standaarde, insluitend toepaslike kliniese dokumentasie en voorvalondersoek. Kennis van tersaaklike wetgewing, beleide en regulasies van die Departement van Gesondheid/DPSA, insluitend die Nasionale Gesondheidswet, PFMA, SCM-regulasies en ander toepaslike voorskrifte. Rekenaarvaardigheid en bedrewenheid in die Microsoft Office-suite.
af.duties: Hoof van die Departement Anestesie en Kritieke Sorg by Grey's Hospital en bestuur sy operasionele en strategiese aangeleenthede, insluitend koördinering van tersaaklike dienste binne Area 2. Verseker die levering van veilige, koste-effektiewe en hoë gehalte anestetiese en kritieke sorgdienste, insluitend toepaslike kliniese dekking vir elektiewe en noodprosedures. Hou toesig oor pre-operatiewe assessering, intra-operatiewe anestetiese sorg, herstel en post-operatiewe ondersteuning, in samewerking met chirurgiese en ander tersaaklike kliniese departemente. Verskaf operasionele toesig oor kritieke sorgdienste binne die departement se goedgekeurde omvang, insluitend toelatings- en ontslagprosesse, bedbenutting, pasiëntprioritisering en verwysingsroetes. Formuleer en voer jaarlikse operasionele planne en medium- tot langtermyn departementele strategieë uit wat met die prioriteite van die Departement van Gesondheid ooreenstem. Ontwikkel en implementeer strategieë om APP- en ander prestasietargets te bereik, insluitend teaterbenutting, kansellasiesyfers, ICU-bedbesetting, pasiëntvloei, kliniese uitkomste en wagtye, soos van toepassing. Bestuur personeelprestasie, EPMDS, werwing en behoud, arbeidsverhoudinge, disiplinêre prosesse, konflikbestuur en griephantering. Verseker toepaslike personeelvlakke, vaardighede en bevoegdhede van departementele personeel, insluitend sessie-beoefenaars waar van toepassing. Bevorder onderrig en opleiding van registrateurs, mediese beamptes, internes, verpleegpersoneel en voorgraadse studente, insluitend nagraadse toesig en akademiese programme. Onderhou skakeling met die tersaaklike departemente en opleidingsinstansies by die University of KwaZulu-Natal, CMSA, HPCSA en ander akademiese vennote, soos van toepassing. Verseker kliniese bestuur deur gereelde morbiditeits- en mortaliteitsvergaderings, kliniese oudits, gebruiksherbesienings, voorvalherbesienings en kwaliteitsverbeteringsaktiwiteite. Onderhou en hersien die departementele risikoregister en implementeer maatreëls om kliniese, operasionele en medico-juridiese voorvalle te voorkom en te bestuur. Ontwerp, implementeer en evalueer gehaltversekerings- en verbeteringsprogramme om pasiëntveiligheidsvoorvalle te verminder en diensdoeltreffendheid te verbeter. Neem deel aan gehalte-inisiatiewe, insluitend QA-vergaderings, implementering van die Ideal Hospital Realization and Maintenance Framework, norms and standards, en OHSC-verwante aktiwiteite. Bestuur begrotings en hulpbronne versigtig en verseker dat noodsaaklike anestetiese en kritieke sorg-toerusting, medisyne, mediese gasse en verbruiksgoedere beskikbaar, funksioneel en toepaslik onderhou is. Werk saam met Finansies, Supply Chain Management, Clinical Engineering en tersaaklike hospitaaleenhede om toerusting-onbedryfstyd, verkrygingsvertragings en hulpbronbeperkings aan te spreek. Voer sitting in en neem deel aan tersaaklike komitees by Grey's Hospital soos vereis. Onderhou akkurate departementele rekords en statistieke, insluitend teateraktiwiteit, anestetiese prosedures, kritieke sorg-benutting en kliniese uitkomste. Werk saam binne die Pietermaritzburg Metropolitan Hospitals Complex, met verwysende hospitale, DCSTs en EMS. Hou toesig oor en ondersteun inreik- en goedkeurde virtuele ondersteuningsprogramme in Area 2. Bestuur en hanteer kliënteklagtes wat die departement betref en verseker toepaslike opvolg en korrektiewe optrede. Verskaf spesialisadvies aan klinici oor anestetiese, peri-operatiewe en kritieke sorgbestuur binne die omvang van die departement. Onderneem kliniese pligte, insluitend geheelde oortyd, soos vereis en in ooreenstemming met voorgeskrewe vereistes. Diens as waarnemende Senior Bestuurder: Mediese Dienste wanneer vereis en formeel gedelegeer.

zu.title: Umphathi Womnyango Wezokwelapha: (EZOKWELAPHA) Isigaba 1
zu.summary: Ukuhola umnyango wezokwelapha nokunakekelwa okubalulekile esibhedlela i-Grey's Hospital, okudinga i-MBChB, iziqu zesikhundla esiphakeme kwezokwelapha ngesiKhungo sokugcina iziguli ezilalele, kanye namaphuzu ayisikhombisa emsebenzini wesikhulu.
zu.requirements: Isigaba 12 / Isitifikadi Somdlalo i-MBChB noma okulinganayo. Isiqu sokuhamba phambili ezokwelapha ngesiKhungo sokugcina iziguli ezilalele, noma isiqu esihlonishwe okulingana naso okuvumela ukubhalisa ne-HPCSA njengesikhulu sezokwelapha ezokwelapha ngesiKhungo sokugcina iziguli ezilalele. Ukubhalisa kwamanje ne-HPCSA njengesikhulu sezokwelapha ezokwelapha ngesiKhungo sokugcina iziguli ezilalele. Amaphuzu ayisikhombisa emsebenzini njengesikhulu sezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa ne-HPCSA ezokwelapha nokunakekelwa okubalulekile. NB! (Kuphela abathunywe kakhulu abazocelwa ukuthi bahunyiswe ngawo wonke amadokhumenti nesitifikadi sezenzo esiqinisekiswe ngabasebenzi) NB: Amakopi asemthethweni iziqu namanye amadokhumenti ahlobene azocelwa kubathunywe kuphela, okumele ahwetshelwe ngosuku lokuxoxisana (ikopi yesazisi, ilayisensi yomshayeli, iziqu zemfundo, izitifikadi zobhaliso lwemisebenzi, ubufakazi bobhaliso lwamanje, njll). Amaphuzu namava okwedlula Ilayisensi yomshayeli esebenzayo. Amava eBuphathi njengoMphathi WeYunithi Yokwelapha ezokwelapha nokunakekelwa okubalulekile. Ulwazi, Ikhono namava: Amakhono okubhalisa nokulawula komphakathi ukuyihola iNqobo Yezokwelapha nokunakekelwa okubalulekile esibhedlela i-Grey's Hospital, ilawule izindaba zokuphatha nezomgomo, futhi uhlele izinsiza ezihambisana kwindawo 2. Ulwazi olujulile olunesikhulu kanye namava kwezokwelapha kanye nokuqashwa kwezinsizakalo ezinhle, ukunakekelwa okukhulu kwezinsizakalo, ukuphulukiswa kwesikhathi, ukuphathwa kwesikhashana, ukulawula inhlupheko kanye nokunakekelwa okubalulekile. Ulwazi ngokulethwa kwensiza yezokunakekelwa okubalulekile, kufaka phakathi ukusetshenziswa kwamabhedu ase-ICU, ukubaluleka kweziguli, izindlela zokuqasha, ukugeleza kweziguli nokuhamba nokwaphinda kobuhlobo bokunakekela. Ukukhanya ekuthuthukiseni, ukusebenzisa futhi uqapethe imigomo yomnyango, imibhalo, izindlela nezinqubo ezisebenzayo. Ukuqonda okuphelele ngokuphathwa kwezimali, ukwabiwa kwezinsiza nokukhululeka, ukubhala ngemali nokulawula imali echithwayo. Ulwazi oluhle lokuphatha abantu, okuhlanganisa i-EPMDS, ukuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi, ukulandelwa kobugqila, ukuqasha nokugcina, ubudlelwano bemisebenzi, izinqubo zokuqamba izingxabano nokuphathwa kobuhlungu. Ukwazi kakhulu ngamakhompyutha nesisetshenziswa i-Microsoft Office Suite, okuhlanganisa i-Outlook, i-PowerPoint ne-Excel. Ukuphathwa kweingozi nezehloko, ukubusa ngokwelapha, ukuphepha kwesigula nokuthuthukiswa kobungako. Isixazululi sezinkinga, ukwenza izinqumo, ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya kanye nokuphathwa kwemingcele. Ukuxhumana ngomlomo nangokubhala okuhle, ukubhala umbiko, ukuphatha isikhathi namakhono omsebenzi wesikhundla. Ukukhulisa ukulawula ezokwelapha, ukufundisa, ukuqeqesha, ukweseka kanye nokubuka. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngomfutho ogcwele nokugcina ubudlelwano obuhle bomsebenzi. Ulwazi, ukuqonda nokusebenzisa imigomo ka-Batho Pele. Ulwazi ngokuziphatha ezokwelapha, ingozi yomthetho wezokwelapha namazinga abantu wesikhundla, okuhlanganisa umbhalo obhalwe kahle kanye nokuqamba izingxabano. Ulwazi ngomthetho ohlobene, imigomo kanye nomthetho womnyango wezempilo i-DPSA, okuhlanganisa i-National Health Act, i-PFMA, imithetho ye-SCM kanye namanye omthetho. Ulwazi ngekhompyutha nokuqonda kakhulu esetshenzisweni se-Microsoft Office.
zu.duties: Ukuhola iNqobo Yezokwelapha nokunakekelwa okubalulekile e-Grey's Hospital futhi ulawule izindaba zayo zokuphatha nezomgomo, kuhlanganisa nokuhlelwa kwezinsiza ezihambisanayo ndawonye 2. Uqinisekise ukulethwa kokunakekelwa okuphephile, okubiza kakhulu nokwedlula isilinganiso ezokwelapha, kanye nokunakekelwa okuhambisana nomthetho wezinto ezingajwayelekile nezimpilo. Qaphela ukubuywa kwesigula phambi kokusebenza, ukunakekelwa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi, ukubuyiswa nokwesekwa ngemva kwezinsizakalo, ukuhambisana nabantu bomnyango wezokwelapha. Nikeza inhluzo yokuphathwa kwezokunakekelwa okubalulekile phakathi kwesigaba esivunyiwe somnyango, kuhlanganisa inqubo yokungena nokuphuma, ukusetshenziswa kwamabhedu, ukubaluleka kweziguli kanye nezindlela zokuqasha. Yenza futhi uzenze izinkulumo-mgomo zonyaka nezomgomo wesikhathi esingaphezu kwanoma eside wezomnyango ehambisana nezinhloso zomnyango wezempilo. Thuthukisa futhi usebenzise izindlela ukufeza i-APP kanye namanye amaphuzu okwenza umsebenzi, kuhlanganisa ukusetshenziswa kwebhishi, izinga lokukhansela, ukuwohloka kwamabhedu e-ICU, ukugeleza kweziguli, iziphumo zokwelapha kanye nokulinda isikhathi, lapho kusebenzayo. Lawula ukusebenza kwabasebenzi, i-EPMDS, ukuqasha nokugcina abantu, ubudlelwano bemisebenzi, izinqubo ezixakile, ukuphathwa kwezinswamizi nomlando wamazwi. Uqinisekise amazinga okuhlala abasebenzi, amakhono namandla abantu bomnyango, kuhlanganise abantu abasebenza ngesikhathi. Khuthaza ukufundiswa kwayo yonke imindeni yezokwelapha, futhi qeqesha abafundi, iziguli kanye nabafundi abasha, kuhlanganise nokuqashwa kwesikhathi namaphuzu abafundi. Gcina ubuhlobo nomnyango othintene nezikole zokuqeqesha e-University of KwaZulu-Natal, i-CMSA, i-HPCSA namanye abahlanganyeli, lapho kusebenzayo. Uqinisekise ukubuswa kukahle ngokubanjwa kwezinkomfa zokugula nokufa, ukuhlolwa kwezokwelapha, ukuhlola ukusetshenziswa, ukuhlola izinhlekelwe kanye nokwenziwa kokuqamba. Gcina futhi uhlole irekhodi lomnyango mayelana nezingozi futhi usebenzise izinyathelo zokuvikela kanye nokuphathwa kwezehloko zokwelapha, ezingasebenza noma ngokomthetho. Dweba, sebenzisa futhi uhlole izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa nobungako ukukhululeka izehloko ezithinta iziguli ukuthuthukisa ukuphila kwemisebenzi. Thatha inxaxheba ekuthuthukiseni, okuhlanganisa kusuka kwinkomfa i-QA, ukusetshenziswa kwesakhiwo sokwakha nokugcina ibhedi elifanele namazinga, kanye namasevisi ohlelo lwe-OHSC. Lawula imali kanye nezinsiza ngokuhlakanipha futhi uqinisekise ukuthi izisetshenziswa ezibalulekile, izidakamizwa, amagesi wezokwelapha kanye nezinto ezidinga ukusetshenziswa zikhona, zisebenza futhi zihlolwe njengakuqondene.
