Sebenza nabantu bezimali, abaphathi beSisekelo Sezinsiza, njll. Hlala uxhumene neminyango ebalulekile emhlabeni i-Grey's Hospital njengoba kudingeka. Gcina amaphuzu bokubhala nemibhalo yezokwelapha, kuhlanganise amaphuzu ibhishi, ukwenza okubalulekile kokwelapha kanye nemiphumela yokwelapha. Sebenza ngobudlelwane phakathi kwe-Pietermaritzburg Metropolitan Hospitals Complex, nezibhedlela eziqashayo, i-DCSTs ne-EMS. Buka futhi usekele ukusakaza amaphuzu endaweni 2. Lawula futhi uxazulule izinkinga zamakhasimende ezithinta umnyango futhi uqinisekise ukulandelwa okufanele nokwenza isinyathelo. Nikeza izinkulumo-ezikhulu ngokwelapha, ukunakekelwa nokuqasha kwesikhathi ngesikhathi phakathi kwezokwelapha. Yenza imisebenzi yesikhathi, kuhlanganise nakuqashwa kwesikhathi esidingekile. Sebenza njengomphathi ongumphumela ongaphezulu wezokwelapha: ezinsizakalo lapho kudingwa futhi kwenziwa ngokomthetho.

xh.title: Umlawuli weSebe leMITHA: (YEMIYALEZO) inqanaba 1
xh.summary: UkuLawula iSebe le-Anaesthetics ne-Critical Care esibhedlele i-Grey's Hospital, kufuneka ube ne-MBChB, isidanga sesiqu sokugqithisa kwi-Anaesthesiology, kunye neminye elishumi elinesixhenxe yamava njengochophela.
xh.requirements: iNqanaba 12 / i-Certificate ephezulu MBChB okanye okulingana nayo. Isidanga sesiqu sokugqithisa kwi-Anaesthesiology, okanye isidanga esiqaphelelweyo esilingana neso esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha onguchophela kwi-Anaesthesiology. Ukubhalisa ngoku kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha onguchophela kwi-Anaesthesiology. Iminyaka elishumi elinesixhenze yamava njengoGqirha onguchophela emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kwi-Anaesthetics nokuqatha ukunyuka kwengqondo. NB! (Kuphela abagqithisiweyo kulu Luhlu abaya kucelwa ukuba bazinike iziqinisekiso zazo zonke iifom kunye nesatifikethi senkonzo esigqiniweyo nguBuntu nokuSebenza kwabantu) NB: iKopi ezinikezelwe nesityhatyiweyo zezidanga nezinye iifom ezinxulumeneyo ziza kucelwa kubagqithisiweyo kuphela abaza kuzinika ngosuku lokwencoko (ikopi ye-ID, ilayisensi yomqhubi, izidanga zemfundo, iisatifikethi zokubhalisa ngobuchophela, iziqinisekiso zokubhalisa ngoku njl. Izidanga ezongezelelweyo namaNava ilayisensi yomqhubi esebenzayo. Amava obulawulo njengoMlawuli weYunithi yoBuchophela kwi-Anaesthetic nokuqatha ukunyuka kwengqondo. Ulwazi, amakhono namaNava: amakhono obulawulo nobunkokeli obuzinzo bokulawula iSebe le-Anaesthetics ne-Critical Care esibhedlele i-Grey's Hospital, ulawula imicimbi yaso yomsebenzi nokuqamba iindlela, kwaye uqhube iinkonzo ezinxulumene koNdawo 2. Ulwazi nolwazi lweChophela olunzulu namava kwi-anaesthesiology, ukunyamekela ukwenza iindlela, ukuvusa kabusha, ukulawula indlela yomoya, ukulawula inxeba nokuqatha ukunyuka kwengqondo. Ulwazi ngokunikwa kweenkonzo zokuqatha ukunyuka kwengqondo, kuquka nokusebenzisa amabhedl a-ICU, ukuqwalasela umntu oqulunqwe, iindlela zokuthumela, ukuhamba komntu oqulunqwe nokuqhubekeka kweenkonzo. Ukuziphatha ekwakheni, ukusebenzisa nokuqwalasela iinkqubo zesebe, iimvume, iinkqubo zokwenza nemigaqo yomsebenzi. Ukuqonda ngokuzinzo kobulawulo bezimali, ukwabiwa kweenkcukacha kunye nokuphucula, ukwakha ingqikithi yemali nokuLawula ukutshatshala. Ulwazi oluzinzo ngoBulawulo bemiSebenzi yabaNtu, kuquka i-EPMDS, ukuphucula abasebenzi, ukumisela iNdlela yokuziphilisa, ukuthatha nabagqatswa, ukugcina abasebenzi, iindaba zokusebenza, iinkqubo zokujoyina nokulawula iingxaki. Ukuziphatha ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha neseMicrosoft Office, kuquka i-Outlook, i-PowerPoint ne-Excel. Ukulawula iingozi nemicimbi, ulawulo lweChophela, ukhuseleko lomntu oqulunqwe nokuphucula umgangatho. Amakhono okusombulula iingxaki, ukwenza izigqibo, ukuqamba ngokucokisekileyo nokulawula iingxaki. Uluntu kolwimi nolwanga olubhalwayo, ukubhala iingxelo, amakhono okuLawula ixesha nenkqubo yokusebenza eButshintsheyo. Amakhono obunkokeli bokuchophela, ukufundisa, ukuqeqesha, ukumncedi nokulawula. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngcinezinye kwaye ugcine iindibano zokusebenza ezisebenzayo. Ulwazi, ukuqonda nokusebenzisa iinkqubo ze-Batho Pele. Ulwazi ngamasiko oChophela, ingozi yomthetho weChophela nemiqathango yokuchophela ebdakamileyo, kuquka nokubhala iinkqubo zochophela ngokufanelekileyo nokuqwalasela iingozi. Ulwazi ngomthetho, iinkqubo nemiqathano yesebe lezeMpilo/DPSA, kuquka uMthetho wezeMpilo yoSiba, i-PFMA, imiqathano ye-SCM nemiqathano eminye esebenzayo. Ukuziphatha ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha neseMicrosoft office suite.
xh.duties: UkuLawula iSebe le-Anaesthetics ne-Critical Care esibhedlele i-Grey's Hospital ulawule imicimbi yaso yomsebenzi nokuqamba iindlela, kuquka nokuQhumba iinkonzo ezinxulumene koNdawo 2. Qinisekisa ukunikwa kweenkonzo zokhuseleko, ezithengiseka ngexabiso nazo zigqithiswe ngangaphezulu kwe-anaesthetic nokuqatha ukunyuka kwengqondo, kuquka nokugqithiswa ngokuchophela okufanelekileyo kweenkqubo ezikhethiweyo nezibungayo. Qwalasela ngaphambi kokwenza iindlela, ukunyamekela i-anaesthetic ngexesha lwenkqubo, ukuphila kabusha noncedo emva kokwenza iindlela, ngokusebenzisana namasebe oChophela nangaphezulu. Nikeza ulawulo lomsebenzi lweenkonzo zokuqatha ukunyuka kwengqondo ngaphakathi kwemigaqo esebe evunyiweyo, kuquka iinkqubo zokwamkelwa nokuphuma, ukusebenzisa amabhedl, ukuqwalasela umntu oqulunqwe nendlela zokuthumela. Misela uphumeze iinkqubo zomsebenzi zonyaka nokuqamba iindlela zesebe ezimfutshane ukuya kwezinde zehlelelane nemigqatho yesebe lezeMpilo. Yakha uphumeze iindlela zokufezisa i-APP nemigqatho eminye yemveliso, kuquka ukusebenzisa ithiyetha, amaxabiso wokuRhoxiswa, ukuzalwa kwamabhedl a-ICU, ukuhamba komntu, imveliso yochophela kwaye ilithe ngexesha, njengoko kufanelekile. Lawula imveliso yabasebenzi, i-EPMDS, ukuthatha nabagqatswa nokugcina abasebenzi, iindaba zokusebenza, iinkqubo zokujoyina, ukulawula iingxaki noncedo lokulawula iingxaki. Qinisekisa amanqanaba okusebenza, amakhono namakhono abasebenzi basebe, kuquka nabasebenzi ngokuhamba njengoko kufanelekile. Khuthaza ukufundisa nokuqeqesha kubagqibi-mfundo, oogqirha, abaqeqeshwa, abantu bokhathalelo nogqatshwa abafundi bezidanga ezongaphantsi, kuquka ukulawula kwesiqu yokugqithisa iinkqubo zemfundo. Gcina uqhagamshelwano namasebe kwaye uqeqeshe iindawo kwindawo i-University of KwaZulu-Natal, i-CMSA, i-HPCSA nabalawuli bemfundo abanye, njengoko kufanelekile. Qinisekisa ulawulo lweChophela ngokubamba iindibano ezihlala ngokomthetho nengxaki yokusweka, ukuqwalasela iChophela, ukuqwalasela ukusetyenziswa, ukuqwalasela iingozi nemisebenzi yokuphucula umgangatho. Gcina uqwalasele irekhodi yengozi yesebe uphumeze iinkqubo zokuthintela nokuLawula iingozi zochophela, zomsebenzi nongxaki yomthetho weChophela. Yila, phumeza uqwalasele iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa nokuphucula umgangatho ukunciphisa iingozi zokhuseleko lomntu oqulunqwe kwaye uphucule ukusebenza kweenkonzo. Thatha inxaxheba kumanyano okuphucula umgangatho, kuquka iindibano ze-QA, ukuphumeza i-Framework yokwakha nokugcina iSibhedlele esikhuselweyo, imigaqo namazinga, nemisebenzi enxulumene ne-OHSC. Lawula iingqikithi zemali nembonelelo ngokuzinzo qinisekisa ukuba zikhona, zisebenza kunye nokugcinwa ngokufanelekileyo ibhedl, iyeza, amagesi weyiza kunye nezinto ezisetyenziswa ezingagqithisiyo. Sebenzisana nezeMali, uLawulo lokuNikwa nokuThengiswa, iNjinieri yeChophela kunye neeyunithi zesibhedlele ezinxulumene ukusombulula ukungasebenzi ibhedl, ukulibaziseka kokuthenga nokuNxanela kweenkcukacha. Yiba nogqiba-mali kwaye uthathe inxaxheba kumabala anxulumene esibhedlele i-Grey's Hospital njengoko kufuneka. Gcina iirekhodi ezizinzo nenkqubo yebalwe yesebe, kuquka umsebenzi wethiyetha, iinkqubo zochophela, ukusetyenziswa kokuqatha ukunyuka kwengqondo nokuvela ngemveliso. Sebenzisana ngaphakathi kophuhliso lweSibhedlele i-Pietermaritzburg Metropolitan, nangeesibhedlele ezithumelayo, i-DCST ne-EMS. Qwalasela uxhase ukuqhwesela, ukungenisa iindlela nokuNcedo oluNginziwa oluvumiweyo kuNdawo 2. Lawula uzaxaze iingxaki zamaxhoba ezinxulumene nesebe qinisekisa ukulandela ngokufanelekileyo nokuThabatha iSigqibo. Nikeza ingcebiso yochophela kubachophela ngokuLawula i-anaesthetic, inkqubo yangaphambi nangemva kwaye i-Critical Care ngaphakathi kwemigaqo yesebe. Thatha imisebenzi yochophela, kuquka nokuba naxeshesi elihlaziwe, njengoko kufuneka ngokwemigaqo echaziweyo. Yiba nguLawuli oMdala oneNqanaba oSebenzayo: iNkonzo yeGqirha njengoko kufuneka kwaye unikwe igunya.

jobs.title: Head Clinical Unit (MEDICAL) Grade 1
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R2 168 145 per annum, (all-inclusive package), All-inclusive package consists of 70% basic salary and 30% flexible portion that may be structured in terms of the applicable rules, Plus Commuted Overtime which is subject to the needs of the department. Incumbents will have to sign the commuted overtime contract form annually.
jobs.summary: Head the adult multidisciplinary tertiary ICU at Grey's Hospital in Pietermaritzburg, managing critical care services and reporting to the Head of Department.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 / Senior Certificate MBChB or equivalent. A postgraduate qualification relevant to Adult Critical Care: eg (Anaesthesia, Surgery, Internal Medicine, Obstetrics and Gynaecology or Emergency Medicine), or a relevant qualification that allows for registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist. Current registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Critical Care or Certificate in trauma surgery. Five years’ experience as a Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA. NB (Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit proof of all documents and certificate of Service endorsed by Human Resources and may be subjected to competency test. Knowledge, Skills and Experience: Possess sound knowledge of human resource management, budgeting, the implementation and evaluation of quality assurance programmes, and information management. Possess knowledge of current health and Public Service legislation, regulations and policies, including medical ethics, epidemiology and statistics. Have good communication, leadership, decision-making and clinical skills Have sound up-to-date knowledge of clinical procedures, protocols and international standards of care within the discipline, including appropriate clinical use of current relevant technology. Be physically available to participate in the Pietermaritzburg Metropolitan Critical Care after-hours call system, which encompasses Grey’s Hospital, Harry Gwala Regional Hospital and Northdale Hospital. Be able to efficiently and appropriately assess and manage a broad spectrum of critically ill patients referred from the departments of Surgery, Orthopaedic Surgery, Surgical Specialities, Obstetrics & Gynaecology, and Internal Medicine. Have the ability to critically evaluate new technologies and decide on their cost- effective implementation Behavioural Attributes Required The applicant should possess: Stress tolerance, ability to work as an integral part of a team, self- confidence, and the ability to build and maintain good relationships with colleagues, nursing staff, allied medical staff and clinicians from other disciplines.
jobs.duties: Successful incumbent would be required to: Manage Grey’s Hospital’s adult multidisciplinary tertiary Intensive Care Unit (ICU) as a component of the overall Metropolitan Critical Care system within the Pietermaritzburg Department of Anaesthesia, Critical Care and Pain Management. Report to the Head of the Clinical Department of Anaesthesia and Critical Care at Grey’s Hospital and work jointly to ensure that Critical Care patient services are maintained efficiently and to an acceptable standard. Develop and refine Critical Care admission and discharge policies appropriate for Grey’s Hospital, in line with the overall Metropolitan Critical Care policies, to ensure the fair and ethical distribution of ICU resources. Actively participate in and support the progressive development of training programmes across the Metropolitan Critical Care system. These programmes should facilitate postgraduate Critical Care training for Medical Officers, Registrars specialising in other clinical disciplines, and Specialists undertaking Certification in Critical Care, while maximising the contribution of Grey’s ICU. Accept overall responsibility for the Critical Care management of critically ill patients admitted to the Critical Care Unit of Grey’s Hospital Lead the clinical Critical Care service of a tertiary hospital ICU that functions as part of the Metropolitan Critical Care service by: Personally providing Subspecialist-level consultant cover and clinical leadership for Grey’s Hospital Multidisciplinary ICU. Supervising and directing the clinical work of Specialists undertaking Certification in Critical Care Personally providing (on a rostered duty basis) after-hours Subspecialist consultant cover for the ICU at Grey’s Hospital as well as for other ICUs in the Metropolitan Critical Care system. Assessing pre- and post-admission high-risk patients in the wards, and providing clinical guidance to clinicians referring patients to the ICU at Grey’s Hospital. Liaising and working with the Critical Care services offered by the Department of Paediatrics at Grey’s Hospital on matters relevant to both adult and paediatric critical care. Participating in outreach programmes for the development of Critical Care services within the catchment area of Grey’s Hospital Participating in the teaching programmes co-ordinated by the Pietermaritzburg Department of Anaesthesia, Critical Care and Pain Management for vocational, postgraduate and nursing staff. Undertaking appropriate clinical research and supporting the research efforts of junior staff in the Pietermaritzburg Department of Anaesthesia, Critical Care and Pain Management. Provide effective and efficient management and supervision by: Ensuring effective utilisation and placement of medical staff, and giving guidance for the effective utilization and placement of nursing staff Maintaining discipline and ensuring that staff members act with integrity and professionalism within the law. Delegating duties to senior staff without lessening the incumbent’s own responsibility and accountability for actions taken on the incumbent’s behalf Liaising with hospital management regarding the ICU and High Care Unit’s infrastructure requirements, including funding, facilities, equipment, staffing and support. Maintaining self-development and staff development by CPD and CME activities and participation in postgraduate and other relevant academic/training programmes. Co-ordinating participation in Quality Improvement measures by staff. Ensure the proper and economical use of equipment, consumables and other resources.
jobs.enquiries: Prof. David Bishop Tel No: (033) 897 3412
jobs.applications: Applications to be forwarded to: The Human Resources Management Office, Greys Hospital Private Bag X9001, Pietermaritzburg, 3200 or Email Applications to khazimula.goba@kznhealth.gov.za or malinee.chandul@kznhealth.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : Mrs M. Chandulal
jobs.notes: Directions to Candidates: Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the new Z83 form and a detailed curriculum vitae only. Additionally: The new Application for Employment Form (Z83) is obtainable from any Government Department OR from the website – www.kznhealth.gov.za. Applicants must utilize the most recent Application for Employment Form (Form Z83) as issued by the Minister for DPSA (gazetted on 06 November 2020) in line with regulation of 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016 and failure to do so will result in disqualification. Applicants are required to complete and sign Z83,and also submit a detailed curriculum vitae (CV). All sections of the new Application for Employment Form (Z83) (except those sections that are not relevant to the applicant) must be completely, accurately and legibly filled in a manner that allows a selection committee to assess the quality of a candidate based on the information provided in the form. Applicants are required to reflect information even if the same information is provided on the detailed CV. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The Employment Equity Target for this post is: African Male, Coloured Male, African Female, Coloured Female.

af.title: Hoof Kliniese Eenheid (MEDIES) Graad 1
af.summary: Bestuur die volwasse multidissiplinêre tersiêre ICU by Grey's Hospital in Pietermaritzburg, bestuur kritiese sorgdienste en rapporteer aan die Hoof van Departement.
af.requirements: Graad 12 / Senior Sertifikaat MBChB of ekwivalent. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie relevant tot Volwasse Kritiese Sorg: bv (Anestesie, Chirurgie, Interne Geneeskunde, Verloskunde en Ginekologie of Noodgeneeskunde), of 'n relevante kwalifikasie wat toelaat vir registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis. Huidige registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Kritiese Sorg of Sertifikaat in traumachirurgie. Vyf jaar se ervaring as 'n Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA. NB (Slegs gekorte lys kandidate sal vereis word om bewys van alle dokumente en sertifikasie van Diens wat deur Menslike Hulpbronne onderskryf is, voor te lê en mag aan 'n bevoegdheidstoets onderwerp word. Kennis, Vaardighede en Ervaring: Besit deeglike kennis van menslike hulpbronbestuur, begroting, die implementering en evaluering van gehalteversekeringsprogramme, en inligtingsbestuur. Besit kennis van huidige gesondheids- en Staatsdienswetgewing, regulasies en beleide, insluitend mediese etiek, epidemiologie en statistiek. Het goeie kommunikasie-, leierskaps-, besluitnemings- en kliniese vaardighede Het deeglike opdatum-kennis van kliniese prosedures, protokolle en internasionale standaarde van sorg binne die dissipline, insluitend toepaslike kliniese gebruik van huidige relevante tegnologie. Wees fisies beskikbaar om deel te neem aan die Pietermaritzburg Metropolitaanse Kritiese Sorg buite-ure oproepstelsel, wat Grey's Hospital, Harry Gwala Regional Hospital en Northdale Hospital dek. Wees in staat om doeltreffend en toepaslik 'n breë spektrum van kritiek siek pasiënte wat verwys word vanuit die departemente van Chirurgie, Ortopediese Chirurgie, Chirurgiese Spesialiteite, Verloskunde & Ginekologie, en Interne Geneeskunde, te assesseer en te bestuur. Het die vermoë om nuwe tegnologieë krities te evalueer en te besluit oor hulle koste-effektiewe implementering Gedragskenmerke Vereis Die aansoeker behoort te beskik oor: Strestoleransie, vermoë om as 'n integrale deel van 'n span te werk, selfvertroue, en die vermoë om goeie verhoudings met kollegas, verpleegpersoneel, verwante mediese personeel en klinici uit ander dissiplines te bou en te handhaaf.
af.duties: Succesvolle ampsdraer sal vereis word om: Grey's Hospital se volwasse multidissiplinêre tersiêre Intensive Care Unit (ICU) te bestuur as 'n komponent van die algehele Metropolitaanse Kritiese Sorgstelsel binne die Pietermaritzburg Departement van Anestesie, Kritiese Sorg en Pynbestuur. Aan die Hoof van die Kliniese Departement van Anestesie en Kritiese Sorg by Grey's Hospital te rapporteer en gesamentlik te werk om te verseker dat Kritiese Sorg pasiëntdienste doeltreffend en tot 'n aanvaarbare standaard gehandhaaf word. Kritiese Sorg toelatings- en ontslagbeleid wat toepaslik is vir Grey's Hospital te ontwikkel en te verfyn, in ooreenstemming met die algehele Metropolitaanse Kritiese Sorg beleide, om die billike en etiese verspreiding van ICU hulpbronne te verseker. Aktief deel te neem aan en die progressiewe ontwikkeling van opleidingsprogramme oor die Metropolitaanse Kritiese Sorgstelsel te ondersteun. Hierdie programme behoort nagraadse Kritiese Sorg opleiding vir Mediese Offisiere, Registrateurs wat in ander kliniese dissipline spesialiseer, en Spesialiste wat Sertifisering in Kritiese Sorg onderneem, te fasiliteer, terwyl die bydrae van Grey's ICU gemaksimeer word. Algehele verantwoordelikheid vir die Kritiese Sorg bestuur van kritiek siek pasiënte wat tot die Kritiese Sorgeenheid van Grey's Hospital toegelaat word, te aanvaar Die kliniese Kritiese Sorgdiens van 'n tersiêre hospitaal ICU wat as deel van die Metropolitaanse Kritiese Sorgdiens funksioneer te lei deur: Persoonlik Subspesialist-vlak konsultantdekking en kliniese leierskap vir Grey's Hospital Multidissiplinêre ICU te verskaf. Die kliniese werk van Spesialiste wat Sertifisering in Kritiese Sorg onderneem, te toesien en te rig Persoonlik (op 'n roosterpligte basis) buite-ure Subspesialist konsultantdekking vir die ICU by Grey's Hospital sowel as vir ander ICU's in die Metropolitaanse Kritiese Sorgstelsel te verskaf. Pre- en post-toelating hoë-risiko pasiënte in die sale te assesseer, en kliniese leiding aan klinici wat pasiënte na die ICU by Grey's Hospital verwys, te verskaf. Skakeling en saamwerking met die Kritiese Sorgdienste wat deur die Departement van Pediatrie by Grey's Hospital aangebied word oor sake wat beide volwasse en pediatriese kritiese sorg raak. Deelname aan tuisbesoekprogramme vir die ontwikkeling van Kritiese Sorgdienste binne die opvangsgebied van Grey's Hospital Deelname aan die onderrigprogramme gekoördineer deur die Pietermaritzburg Departement van Anestesie, Kritiese Sorg en Pynbestuur vir vokasionele, nagraadse en verpleegpersoneel. Toepaslike kliniese navorsing te onderneem en die navorsingspogings van junior personeel in die Pietermaritzburg Departement van Anestesie, Kritiese Sorg en Pynbestuur te ondersteun. Doeltreffende en doeltreffende bestuur en toesig te verskaf deur: Effektiewe benutting en plasering van mediese personeel te verseker, en leiding te gee vir die effektiewe benutting en plasering van verpleegpersoneel Dissipline te handhaaf en te verseker dat personeellede met integriteit en professionaliteit binne die wet optree. Pligte aan senior personeel af te vaardig sonder om die ampsdraer se eie verantwoordelikheid en aanspreeklikheid vir optredes namens die ampsdraer geneem, te verminder Skakeling met hospitaalbestuur rakende die ICU en Hoë Sorgeenheid se infrastruktuurvereistes, insluitend befondsing, fasiliteite, toerusting, personeel en ondersteuning. Selfontwikkeling en personeelontwikkeling deur CPD en CME aktiwiteite en deelname aan nagraadse en ander relevante akademiese/opleidingsprogramme te handhaaf. Koördinering van deelname aan Kwaliteitsverbeteringsmaatreëls deur personeel. Verseker die behoorlike en ekonomiese gebruik van toerusting, verbruiksgoedere en ander hulpbronne.

zu.title: Umholi weYunithi Yezokwelapha (Yezonyanga) Izinga 1
zu.summary: Ukuhola i-ICU yabantu abadala emazinga aphakeme eningizimu wonke eGrey's Hospital ePietermaritzburg, ulawule izinkonzo zokunakekelwa okubalulekile futhi uthumele umbiko kuHoli weMnyango.
zu.requirements: Izinga 12 / Isitifiketi Samazinga Aphakeme MBChB noma okulinganayo. Isitifiketi sokufunda esiphakeme esihambisana nokunakekelwa okubalulekile kwabadala: njengana (Ukwenziswa okungalali, Izurgery, iNtshombo yangaphakathi, i-Obstetrics ne-Gynaecology noma iNtshombo yesikhathi esiphuthumayo), noma isitifiketi esihambisanayo esivumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha. Ukubhalisa kwamanje ku-HPCSA njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha ekunakekelweni okubalulekile noma isitifikati kuzo zolimo zesibhobo. Uhambo lweminyaka emihlanu lokusebenza njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA. OKUBALULEKILE (Kuphela abagqaji ababekwe ohlwini ababelekele ukuthumela ubufakazi bamadokhumenti wonke kanye nesitifiketi seNkonza esiqinisekiswe izinsizakalo zezabantu futhi kungabekwa esivivinyweni sobunkompete. Ulwazi, Amakhono noHlu lolunye olunolunye: Ukuba nolwazi olusemthethweni lokuphathwa kwezinsizakalo zezabantu, ukwakhegqelelwa imali, ukuphatha nokuhlola izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa izinga, kanye nokuphathwa kolwazi. Ukuba nolwazi ngemithetho, izimiso namapholisiamanje ezempilo kanye nazo zomphakathi wonke, okuhlanganisa isiko elihle lezokwelapha, i-epidemiology kanye nezibalo. Ukuba namakhono amahle okuxoxa, ukukhokhela, ukwenza izinqumo nokwelapha. Ukuba nolwazi olusemthethweni nolusha ngokwerherheliso lwezinkambu, izinhlaka namazinga okunakekelwa kazwelonke ngaphakathi kwesigaba, okuhlanganisa ukusetshenziswa ngokufanele kwezobuchwepheshe ezimanje ezihambisanayo ekwelapheni. Ukuba nokuzinikela ngokomzimba ukuthatha inxaxheba ohlelweni lokuqasha ngenkathi ngemva kwamas wePietermaritzburg Metropolitan Critical Care, oqukethe iGrey's Hospital, uHarry Gwala Regional Hospital kanye ne-Northdale Hospital. Ukuba nokuthi ukwazi ukuhlola ngokuphumelelayo nangokufanele ukubhekene nokuphatha ibanga elibanzi labagula ngokubalulekile abathunyelwe eminyangweni ye-Surgery, i-Orthopaedic Surgery, izindiza ezikhethekile zokuhlinzwa, i-Obstetrics & i-Gynaecology, kanye neNtshombo yangaphakathi. Ukuba namandla okuhlola ngokujulile izobuchwepheshe ezisha kanye nokunquma ngokuphatha ngemali okuhlelekile. Imininingwane yokuziphatha efunwayo. Umfunwa kufanele abe nayo: Ukubekezelela inkulumo, ukuthi akakwazi ukusebenza njengengxenye ebalulekile eqenjini, inkuthazo, nokwakha kanye nogcine ubuhlobo obuhle nabanye abasebenzi naye, abahluleki, izinsizakalo zonyango kanye nogwiri kwezinye izigaba.
zu.duties: Umntwana ophumeleleyo uzobe elekelelwa ukuba: Alawule i-Intensive Care Unit (ICU) yabantu abadala emazinga aphakeme yaba bantu bonke eGrey's Hospital njengengxenye yohlelo lwezokunakekelwa okubalulekile lwendawo lonke enkulu ngaphakathi koMnyango wePietermaritzburg we-Anaesthesia, Critical Care and Pain Management. Athumele umbiko kuHoli weMnyango we-Ahaesthesia and Critical Care eGrey's Hospital futhi asebenze ndawonye ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkonzo zokunakekelwa kokugula zibonakala zimi ngokusebenza kahle nasezingeni elivunyelwe. Athuthukise futhi acutulule izinhlaka zokwamukelwa nokukhishwa ekunakekelweni okubalulekile ezihambisana ne-Grey's Hospital, ngokuvumelana nezinhlelo zokunakekelwa okubalulekile zendawo lonke enkulu, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhlinzwa ngokubulungisa kanye nokuziphatha kwezinsiza ze-ICU. Athathe inxaxheba ngokuzimisela ekuthuthukiseni nasekusekeleni izinhlela zokuqeqeswa ezinga eliphezulu kuleyo ndawo enkulu yokunakekelwa okubalulekile. Lezi zinhlaka kufanele zenze kube lula ukuqeqesha okuphezulu ekunakekelweni okubalulekile kwabaFundayi bezoNya, abaQeqeshi abakhethe kwezinye izigaba zokwelapha, kanye nabaChwepheshe abathatha isitifiketi ekunakekelweni okubalulekile, kwesikhathi ekwandisa isandla se-ICU seGrey's. Athathe inxaxheba ejwayelekile ekunakekelweni okubalulekile kwabagula ngokubalulekile abamukelwe eyunithi yokunakekelwa okubalulekile eGrey's Hospital. Aholele inkonzo yezokwelapha ekunakekelweni okubalulekile ye-ICU yesibhedlela esiphakeme esisebenza njengengxenye yenkonzo yokunakekelwa okubalulekile ngaphandle ngesikhathi ngokuthumela: Ngokuzinikela ngokwakhe ukunakekelwa nokuholisa ekunakekelweni okubalulekile okusemazingeni aphakeme kweGrey's Hospital Multidisciplinary ICU. Ngokulawula nokuhola umsebenzi wezokwelapha wabaChwepheshe abathatha isitifiketi ekunakekelweni okubalulekile. Ukuzinikela ngokwakhe (ngohlelo lokusebenza) ukunakekelwa ngemuva kwamasiza ngemva kwamasheya esikhathi esiphezulu se-ICU eGrey's Hospital kanye nakwezinye i-ICU ohlelweni lwendawo enkulu lokunakekelwa okubalulekile. Akuhle abagula abangaphambi nangemva kokwamukelwa abasesiphethweni esiphezulu emigwaqweni, futhi anike isikhokelo sokwelapha kubachwepheshe abathumela abagula ku-ICU eGrey's Hospital. Axhumane futhi asebenze nezenkonzo zokunakekelwa okubalulekile eznikiwe nguMnyango we-Paediatrics eGrey's Hospital kwezindaba eziphathelene nokunakekelwa okubalulekile kokubantu abadala kanye nezingane. Athathe inxaxheba ohlelweni lokuqhubeleka phambili ngaphandle ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinkonzo zokunakekelwa okubalulekile ngaphakathi kwindawo ebuswa i-Grey's Hospital. Athathe inxaxheba ohlelweni lokuqeqesha oluhlanganiswe nguMnyango we-Pietermaritzburg we-Anaesthesia, Critical Care and Pain Management kubasebenzi bokuqasha, abaphakeme nabahluleki. Awenze ucwaningo oluhle lwezokwelapha futhi asekela umzamo wocwaningo wabasebenzi abasha oMnyangweni we-Pietermaritzburg we-Anaesthesia, Critical Care and Pain Management. Anikeze ulawulo lolusebenza ngokusebenza kahle futhi ngokulawula ngokuthi: Eqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa ngokusebenza kahle kanye nokubekwa kwabasebenzi bezokwelapha, futhi anike isikhokelo ngokusetyenziswa ngokusebenza kahle kanye nokubekwa kwabahluleki. Egcina isibopho futhi eqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi basebenza ngokuzithiba nangokubungcweti ngaphakathi komthetho. Edayimitha imisebenzi kubasebenzi abaphakeme ngaphandle kokwehlisa ibizo nomandla womphathi ekutheni izenzo ezenziwe ngesiquphe sakhe. Exhumana nabalawuli besibhedlela mayelana nezidingo zokwakhiwa ze-ICU ne-High Care Unit, okuhlanganisa imali, izimpahla, amadivayisi, abasebenzi nokusekela. Egcina ukuthuthuka kwakhe kanye nokuthuthuka kwabasebenzi ngemisebenzi ye-CPD ne-CME kanye nokuthatha inxaxheba ohlelweni lwesikhathi esiphezulu kanye nalolunye oluhambisanayo lolwazi/lokuqeqesha. Ehlanganisa ukuthathwa kwesinyathelo ngamunye ekuthuthukiseni izinga ngabasebenzi. Eqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa ngokufanele nangokugcina imali kwamadivayisi, izimpahla ezisetshenziswa ngokushesha kanye nezinye izinsiza.

xh.title: Umphathi weYunithi yeZiko loQhankqathazo (Eyonyango) Inqanaba 1
xh.summary: Ukuziphatha ngokubhalisa kwisebe i-ICU ethatha iindidi ezahlukeneyo kubantu abadala eGrey's Hospital ePietermaritzburg, ulawule iinkonzo ezikwingxwambeleko nokuxela kuNomlawuli weSebe.
xh.requirements: Izidanga 12 / Isatifikethi somNganga ombalwa iMBChB okanye esimelana naso. Isatifikethi sobudlelwane phakathi komzimba nempilo esibekela bucala kubantu abadala: njengokuthi (I-Anaesthesia, i-Surgery, i-Internal Medicine, i-Obstetrics and Gynaecology okanye i-Emergency Medicine), okanye isatifikethi esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengomchweli wezonzulwazi ezingcali kwezamayeza. Ukubhaliswa kwangoku kwi-HPCSA njengomchweli wezonzulwazi ezingcali kwe-Critical Care okanye isatifikethi se-trauma surgery. Iminyaka yamava emihlanu njengomchweli wezamayeza emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA. jobs.title: Medical Specialist – Internal Medicine
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 395 528 - R1 479 723 per annum, all-inclusive package Grade 2: R1 592 274 – R1 688 553 per annum, all-inclusive package Grade 3: R1 844 151 - R2 301 186 per annum, all-inclusive package (Consist of 70% basic salary and 30% flexible Portion that may be structured in terms of applicable rules). Other Benefits: (Medical Aid Optional) Plus 18% Inhospitable Area.
jobs.summary: Medical Specialist in Internal Medicine sought for Ladysmith Regional Hospital, requiring HPCSA registration and an MBChB degree.
jobs.requirements: MBChB degree or equivalent, plus an appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Specialist in Internal Medicine. Current registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Internal Medicine. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit proof of registration for (2026 (HPCSA). Recommendation: A valid driver’s license. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Internal Medicine. Grade 2: Minimum of 5 years’ appropriate experience after registration with HPCSA as a Medical Specialist (Internal medicine). Grade 3: Minimum of 10 years’ appropriate experience after registration with HPCSA as a Medical Specialist (Internal medicine). Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies: Good communication, leadership, interpersonal and decision making qualities. Sound knowledge of applicable health and Public service legislation policies, clinical guidelines, professional ethics, patient safety and clinical governance requirements. Ability to lead, supervise, mentor and teach Medical officers, Interns, students and members of the multidisciplinary team. Knowledge of current Health legislation and policies at Public Institutions. Ability to diagnose and manage common medical problems including emergencies.
jobs.duties: Provide clinical teaching, supervision and mentorship to medical officers, interns, nurses and other relevant staff. Develop, implement and review clinical policies, protocols and evidence-based quality improvement initiatives. Uphold professional, ethical, patient-safety and clinical standards in the Internal Medicine Department. Participate in clinical governance, mortality and morbidity reviews, clinical audits and risk management. Provide comprehensive inpatient, outpatient and emergency specialist Internal Medicine services. Perform administrative and clinical management duties as delegated by the Head of Clinical Unit. Lead and monitor quality improvement projects, remedial action plans and measurable service outcomes. Provide timely, effective regional-level specialist consultation, referral advice and multidisciplinary patient care. Contribute to undergraduate, postgraduate and in-service training, assessment and professional development. Establish and manage specialist Internal Medicine clinics according to service needs. Participate in commuted overtime and provide after-hours specialist supervision and emergency support. Carry out delegated responsibility and support the Head of Clinical Unit in service coordination. Participate in departmental and hospital management, operational planning and performance reviews. Participate in clinical research, regional outreach, referral coordination and professional academic activities. Ensure accurate clinical documentation, appropriate patient communication and ethical professional conduct. Support workforce development and the effective use of human, financial and clinical resources.
