af.title: Mediese Spesialis – Interne Geneeskunde
af.summary: Mediese Spesialis in Interne Geneeskunde gesoek vir Ladysmith Regional Hospital, wat HPCSA-registrasie en 'n MBChB-graad vereis.
af.requirements: MBChB-graad of ekwivalent, plus 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Interne Geneeskunde toelaat. Huidige registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Interne Geneeskunde. Slegs gekorte lys kandidate sal vereis word om bewys van registrasie vir 2026 (HPCSA) voor te lê. Aanbeveling: 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Interne Geneeskunde. Graad 2: Minimum van 5 jaar se toepaslike ervaring na registrasie by HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis (Interne geneeskunde). Graad 3: Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring na registrasie by HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis (Interne geneeskunde). Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede: Goeie kommunikasie, leierskap, interpersoonlike en besluitneming eienskappe. Deeglike kennis van toepaslike gesondheids- en Openbare diens wetgewing beleide, kliniese riglyne, professionele etiek, pasientveiligheid en kliniese bestuur vereistes. Vermoë om te lei, toesig te hou, te mentor en te onderrig Mediese beamptes, Interniste, studente en lede van die multidissiplinêre span. Kennis van huidige Gesondheid wetgewing en beleide by Openbare Instellings. Vermoë om algemene mediese probleme insluitend noodgevalle te diagnoseer en te bestuur.
af.duties: Verskaf kliniese onderrig, toesig en mentorskap aan mediese beamptes, interniste, verpleegsters en ander tersaaklike personeel. Ontwikkel, implementeer en hersien kliniese beleide, protokolle en getuienisgebaseerde gehalteverbeteringsinisiatiewe. Handhaaf professionele, etiese, pasientveiligheids- en kliniese standaarde in die Departement Interne Geneeskunde. Neem deel aan kliniese bestuur, sterfte- en morbiditeits hersienings, kliniese oudits en risikobestuur. Verskaf omvattende inpasiente, buitepasiente en noodspesialis Interne Geneeskunde dienste. Voer administratiewe en kliniese bestuurspligte uit soos deur die Hoof van Kliniese Eenheid gedelegeer. Lei en monitor gehalteverbeteringsprojekte, remediërende aksieplanne en meetbare diensuitkomste. Verskaf tydige, effektiewe spesialis konsultasie op streeksvlak, verwysingsadvies en multidissiplinêre pasientsorg. Dra by tot voorgraadse, nagraadse en indiensopleiding, assessering en professionele ontwikkeling. Stig en bestuur spesialis Interne Geneeskunde klinieke volgens diensbehoeftes. Neem deel aan pendeloortyd en verskaf buite-kantoorure spesialis toesig en noodondersteuning. Voer gedelegeerde verantwoordelikhede uit en ondersteun die Hoof van Kliniese Eenheid in dienskoördinering. Neem deel aan departementale en hospitaalbestuur, operasionele beplanning en prestasie hersienings. Neem deel aan kliniese navorsing, streeks uitreik, verwysingskoördinasie en professionele akademiese aktiwiteite. Verseker akkurate kliniese dokumentasie, toepaslike pasientkommunikasie en etiese professionele gedrag. Ondersteun werkforce ontwikkeling en die effektiewe gebruik van menslike, finansiële en kliniese hulpbronne.

zu.title: Izingcweli Ezezokwelapha – Ugogo (Internal Medicine)
zu.summary: Kufunwa Izingcweli Ezezokwelapha kugogo (Internal Medicine) e Ladysmith Regional Hospital, kudingeka ubhaliswe kwi-HPCSA futhi ube nesiqu se-MBChB.
zu.requirements: Isiqu se-MBChB noma okufanayo, kanye nesiqu esifanele esivumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengengcweli sezokwelapha kugogo (Internal Medicine). Ukubhalisa kwamanje ku-HPCSA njengengcweli sezokwelapha kugogo (Internal Medicine). Kuphela abagcotshiwe abafinyelelwe ohlwini abazodingiswa ukuthi bahunyuse inkomba yobhaliso loku (2026 (HPCSA). Incoma: Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingeka emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengengcweli sezokwelapha kugogo (Internal Medicine). Izinga 2: Okuncane eminyakeni engu-5 yesipiliyoni esifanele emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengengcweli sezokwelapha (Internal medicine). Izinga 3: Okuncane eminyakeni engu-10 yesipiliyoni esifanele emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengengcweli sezokwelapha (Internal medicine). Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqesha Namandla: Ukuxhumana okuhle, ukubusa, ubudlelwano bomuntu nobuntu, kanye namakhono okuthatha izinqumo. Ulwazi oluzinile ngemithetho namarhulumente wezempilo nezinkonzo zomphakathi, iziqondiso zezokwelapha, izimilo zomsebenzi, ukuphepha kwesiguli nezidingo zokuphathwa kwezokwelapha. Ikhono lokubusa, okuqondisa, ukumenga futhi kufundise abahlinzi, abafundi bezamani, abafundi nabalingane kumatimu ezingxenye ezahlukene. Ulwazi ngemithetho namarhulumente wamanje wezempilo kumathuluzi Womphakathi. Ikhono lokuhlonza futhi kuphatwe izinkinga zezokwelapha ezivamile kuhlanganise izimo eziphuthumayo.
zu.duties: Nikela ngokufundisa, okuqondisa nomyalezo wezokwelapha kubahlinzi, abafundi bezamani, abahlolzi besibhedlela kanye nabasebenzi abathintekayo. Bhaqa, phumeza futhi ubuyekeze imithetho yezokwelapha, imithetho yokusebenza, kanye nezinhloso zokuthuthukisa izinga ngokusekelwe kubufakazi. Gunyaza izimilo zobungcweli, izimilo zomuntu nobuntu, ukuphepha kwesiguli, kanye nezizinga zezokwelapha kumnyango we-Internal Medicine. Thatha inxaxheba ekuphathweni kwezokwelapha, ukubuyekeza ukufa nokugula, ukuhlola izokwelapha kanye nokuphathwa kwezingozi. Nikela ngamasevisi ezingcweli e-Internal Medicine aqophile ohambweni lwesiguli, olungaphandle kanye nezimo eziphuthumayo. Yenza imisebenzi yokuphathwa kwezokwelapha nezokuphatha njengoba kunikwe ngumkhulu weMnyango Wezokwelapha. Busa futhi ulawule izinhloso zokuthuthukisa izinga, izinhlelo zokuqeda izinkinga kanye nemiphumela yesevisi engakalengeki. Nikela ngeseluleko sezokwelapha esisesikhundleni sesifunda ngokushesha futhi ngokusebenza, incazelo yokweluleka ngokuqondiswa, kanye nenakekelo yesiguli kwelinye izinga lezikhungo. Faka isandla ekufundiseni abafundi ezingeni elingaphansi kwesiqu, abafundi ezingeni eliphezulu nesiqu, ekuqeqeshweni ngaphakathi, ekuqeqeshweni kanye nentuthuko yomsebenzi. Sungula futhi uphathe amaklinikhi ezingcweli we-Internal Medicine ngokwezidingo zesevisi. Thatha inxaxheba esikhathini esengeziwe esihamba naphandle kwehora futhi nikele ngokuqondisa kwesikhathi esiphuthumayo nesikhathi sange-ouru. Phenya umsebenzi onikwe futhi usekela umkhulu weMnyango Wezokwelapha ekuqondisweni kwesevisi. Thatha inxaxheba ekuphathweni komnyango nesesibhedlela, ekucwangcisweni kwezokuseshwa kanye nokubukeka kokuqashwa. Thatha inxaxheba ocwaningweni lwamaselula, olusukela esifundeni, ekuqondisweni kwezokuthumela, kanye nezinkomba zobugcisa bomsebenzi. Qinisekisa ukubhalwa okuyiqiniso kwezokwelapha, ukuxhumana okufanele nesiguli kanye nokuziphatha kwezimilo zobungcweli. Usekela intuthuko yamandla abasebenzi kanye nokusetshenziswa ngokusebenza kwamandla, izimali nezabelo zezokwelapha.

xh.title: Iziga zabaGqirha – iNgaphakathi kweNyongo
xh.summary: Kufunwa uNgqondankathazo wezICwanga waseLadysmith Regional Hospital, ofuna ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kunye nenqunba le-MBChB.
xh.requirements: Inqunba le-MBChB okanye elingalo, kunye nefaelifikheyshini efanelekileyo evumela ukubhalisa kwi-Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoGqirha oFundayo kwiNgaphakathi kweNyongo. Ukubhalisa okwangoku kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha oFundayo kwiNgaphakathi kweNyongo. Kukho abathunywa kokuba bahlulwe rhoqo baya kodingeka ukuba bazinike iziqiniseko zokubhalisa ngo-(2026 (HPCSA). Imfuno enkulu: Ilayisensi yokushaya. Amava: Isigaba 1: Akukho mva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha oFundayo kwiNgaphakathi kweNyongo. Isigaba 2: Ukungangwazi okuncinci kwi-5 yaminyaka yamafa afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha oFundayo (eNgaphakathi kweNyongo). Isigaba 3: Ukungangwazi okuncinci kwi-10 yaminyaka yamafa afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha oFundayo (eNgaphakathi kweNyongo). Isilumkiso, Amakhono, uQeqesho neLungiselelo: Iimpawu ezilungileyo zokuthetha, ukukhokela, ubomi phakathi kwabantu nokwenza izigqibo. Isilumkiso esinamanzi semigaqo nemiqathango yezempi lo yaseRiphabliki, izixhobo zokusesikweni, izazizi ngokusesikweni, ukhuseleko lwegulane nemiqathango yolawulo lokusesikweni. Ulungelelwaniso lokukhokela, okusemva kolawulo, okufundisa kwaye oqeqeshe abaFundi abaPheleleyo, abaFundi abakhawulezayo, abaFundi kwaye abalungu bqeqesha-bqeqesha. Isilumkiso semigaqo nemiqathango yezempilo yangoku kwiZiko leNtengiso. Ulungelelwaniso lokuqonda nokulawula iingxaki eziqhelekileyo zonyango eziquka iingxaki ezingezizo ezicatshulwayo.
xh.duties: Unikeze okufundiswa ngesikhathi, uqeqeshe okusemva kolawulo ogqitha kuFundi abaPheleleyo, abaFundi abakhawulezayo, abaFundi bonyango nakunabanye abasebenzi abafanelekileyo. Qamba, usebenzise uphehleza imigaqo nemiqathango yesikhundla, iiprothokholo neendlebe ezisesikweni ezinokusombulula izinga. Phakamisa izikweni, iindlela zisesikweni, ngokusesikweni, ngokhuseleko lwegulane nangaphezulu kwezigaba kwiSebe leNgaphakathi kweNyongo. Thabatha inxaxheba kulawulo lokusesikweni, ngokufa nokungaguli, ukuhlola kokusesikweni nolawulo lwengozi. Unikeze inkonzo esezikweni egqithisileyo yohambo, ngaphandle kweziko nongxamiseko lweziga zabaGqirha kwiNgaphakathi kweNyongo. Wenza imisebenzi yolawulo nolawulo lokusesikweni njengoko athunyelwe nguLawuli weCandu leNgaphakathi kweNyongo. Khokela uqikephela imigceni emizekelo yokwenza ngcono, izicwangciso zokusombulula ingxaki nezigubungelo ezibalulekileyo zenkonzo. Unikeze ixesha elifanelekileyo, elisebenzayo kumagumbi obuzo ngexesha, ingcebiso yokuba kuthunyelwe abanye nakwakhokelana nabanye abantu abanomsama wezigqibo. Yidwa kunye nokuqeqesha ngaphakathi ngenkxaso, ahlule kwaye uphuhlise kwakhona isikhundla. Suki kwaye ulawule iikliniki zeesiga zabaGqirha eNgaphakathi kweNyongo ngokweemfuno zenkonzo. Thabatha inxaxheba kwiiyure ezingaphezulu ezingakumbi kwiinkxaso ngaphandle kwabasebenzi kwiindawo zonyango kwakhona nentengiso yeenkokheli zesiga ngexesha elingaziwa. Yenza iimfuno ezithunyelwe kwaye uxhase uLawuli weCandu leNgaphakathi kweNyongo kwidibaniso lwenkonzo. Thabatha inxaxheba kolawulo lwesebe nolawulo lwesibhedlele, ukucwangcisa ngokusebenza nokuphinda uhlaziye isigqibo. Thabatha inxaxheba kophando lokusesikweni, iinjongo zasemaphandleni, uqukaniso lokuqokelela kwiindawo ezahlukileyo nemisebenzi yasesikweni ebalulekileyo. Qinisekisa ukubhaliswa okuchanekileyo kwamagama osaphila, ukunxibelelana okufanelekileyo negulane nendlela ebhekisa kakhulu ekubeni ngumntu ongowenu. Xhasa uqhube lweemfuno zabantu abalawulwayo nokusebenzisa ngokusebenza kakuhle abantu, imali nezixhobo zonyango.

jobs.title: Deputy Manager Nursing
jobs.salary_text: R1 069 215 - R1 219 323 per annum, all-inclusive package
jobs.summary: Deputy Manager Nursing position at Umphumulo Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal requiring a nursing degree, SANC registration and at least 9 years experience.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate plus Degree / Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery plus Certificate of Registration with the South African Nursing Council as a Professional Nurse and Midwife plus a minimum of 9 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC. At least 4 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognisable experience at management level. Current registration with SANC (2026 receipt). Computer literacy, a valid driver’s license and Diploma in Nursing Administration will be an added advantage as a recommendation. Knowledge of legislation and planning framework. Leadership, Management, planning, organization and co- ordination skills. Basic understanding of HR and Financial policies and practices. Basic understanding of the legislative framework governing the public service. Computer literacy to adequately manage information according to the requirements of the facility. Knowledge of hospital quality assurance and infection control practices. Decision making skills.
jobs.duties: Exercise overall control of Nursing Care, including information and implementation of Nursing Programmes and the execution and evaluation thereof. Manage the formulation and implementation of Strategic plan, Operational plan, Business plan, policies and procedures of nursing services. Demonstrate the facility’s commitment to quality care by ensuring compliance with Office of Health Standard Compliance (OHSC), Ideal Hospital (IHRM) and clinical governance structures and Infection Prevention and Control. Execute duties and function with proficiency, in support of aims and strategic objectives of the institution and the Department of Health. Ensure control of disciplinary matters, grievances and labour issues in the nursing sector. Timeously submit verbal and written reports to the CEO. Manage and utilize resources in accordance with relevant directives and legislation. Conduct clinical audits and co-ordinate, facilitate and implement quality improvement initiatives and Good Governance. Advocate and promote nursing ethos and professionalism. Ensure effective employee performance management. Identify training needs and implement intervention strategies. To assist the institution with audit preparedness and to implement and monitor audit findings. Facilitate clinical workshops to update nursing staff Ensure compliance with statistic collection and adherence to data management principles of KZN Department of Health.
jobs.enquiries: Dr. M. J. Zulu Tel No: (032) 4814101
jobs.applications: Please forward application quoting the reference number to The Human Resource Department, Umphumulo Hospital, Private Bag X9219, Maphumulo 4470 or hand delivered to Umphumulo Hospital, Human Resource Department, R74 Greytown Road, Maphumulo, 4470 or email to: raban.chirwa@kznhealth.gov.za / Zinhle.zulu@kznhealth.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : Ms ZP Zulu Tel No: (032) 481 4180
jobs.notes: Application must be submitted on the Application for Employment Form (Form Z.83), which is obtainable at any Government Department or from the website – www.kznhealth.gov.za must be accurately completed and signed. Reference Number must be indicated in the column provided on the form Z.83 together with a comprehensive CV only. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications, ID and other relevant documents with the application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of documents and proof of current and previous work experience (certificate of Service) endorsed and stamped by the Human Resource department on or before the day of the interview. Persons with disabilities should feel free to apply for the post. Shortlisted applicants in possession of a foreign qualification will have to submit an evaluation/verification certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) or other regulating bodies on the day of interview. Non- RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident/ Work Permit holders must submit a documentary proof if shortlisted. This Department is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer, whose aim is to promote representatively in all levels of all occupational categories in the Department. The appointment is subject to positive outcome obtained from the following checks: security clearance, credit records, qualification, citizenship and previous experience verifications. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Failure to comply with the aforementioned instructions will results to your application being disqualified. Applicants are respectfully informed that, if no notification of appointment is received within 3 months after the closing date, they must accept that their applications were unsuccessful. Please note that due to financial constraints, there will be no payment of S&T claims.

af.title: Adjunkbestuurder Verpleegkunde
af.summary: Adjunkbestuurder Verpleegkunde-pos by Umphumulo Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal wat 'n verpleegkunde-graad, SANC-registrasie en ten minste 9 jaar ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate plus Degree / Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery plus Certificate of Registration with the South African Nursing Council as a Professional Nurse and Midwife plus 'n minimum van 9 jaar gepaste/erkenningbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professional Nurse met die SANC. Ten minste 4 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet gepaste/erkenningbare ervaring op bestuursvlak wees. Huidige registrasie by SANC (2026 kwitansie). Rekenaargeletterdheid, 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie en 'n Diploma in Nursing Administration sal as 'n aanbeveling 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis van wetgewing en beplanningsraamwerk. Leierskap, bestuurs-, beplannings-, organisasie- en koördinasievaardighede. Basiese begrip van HR- en Finansiële beleide en praktyke. Basiese begrip van die wetgewingsraamwerk wat die openbare diens regeer. Rekenaargeletterdheid om inligting voldoende te bestuur volgens die vereistes van die fasiliteit. Kennis van gehalteversekering in hospitale en infeksiebeheerpraktyke. Besluitnemingvaardighede.
af.duties: Oefen algehele beheer oor Verpleegsorg uit, insluitend inligting en implementering van Verpleegkunde-programme en die uitvoering en evaluering daarvan. Bestuur die formulering en implementering van Strategiese plan, Operasionele plan, Besigheidsplan, beleide en prosedures van verpleegdienste. Toon die fasiliteit se verbintenis tot gehaltesorg deur te verseker dat daar voldoen word aan Office of Health Standard Compliance (OHSC), Ideal Hospital (IHRM) en kliniese bestuursstrukture en Infeksievoorkoming en -beheer. Voer pligte en funksies met vaardigheid uit ter ondersteuning van die doelwitte en strategiese oogmerke van die instelling en die Department of Health. Verseker beheer oor dissiplinêre aangeleenthede, griewe en arbeidsake in die verpleegsektor. Dien tydig mondelinge en skriftelike verslae by die CEO in. Bestuur en benut hulpbronne in ooreenstemming met toepaslike direktiewe en wetgewing. Voer kliniese oudits uit en koördineer, fasiliteer en implementeer gehalteverbeteringsinisiatiewe en Goeie Bestuur. Beywer jou vir en bevorder verpleeg-etos en professionaliteit. Verseker effektiewe werknemerprestasiebestuur. Identifiseer opleidingsbehoeftes en implementeer ingrypingstrategieë. Om die instelling te help met ouditgereedheid en om ouditbevindings te implementeer en te monitor. Fasiliteer kliniese werkswinkels om verpleegpersoneel op datum te hou. Verseker nakoming van statistiekversameling en voldoening aan databestuurbeginsels van KZN Department of Health.

zu.title: Deputy Manager Nursing
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaDeputy Manager Nursing esibhedlela i-Umphumulo Hospital e-KwaZulu-Natal esidinga idigri yokwelapha, ukubhalwa kwi-SANC kanye nokuba okungenani uneminyaka eyi-9 yokuhlangenwe nakho.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate kanye ne-Degree / Diploma kwi-General Nursing and Midwifery kanye ne-Certificate of Registration ne-South African Nursing Council njengoba i-Professional Nurse and Midwife kanye nokuba okungenani uneminyaka eyi-9 yokuhlangenwe nakho okuhlelekile/okuhlonishwayo ezokwelapha emva kokuqanjwa njenge-Professional Nurse ne-SANC. Okungenani kumele kube khona iminyaka eyi-4 yesikhathi esishiwo ngenhla okuhlelekile/okuhlonishwayo ezingeni lokuqashwa. Ukuqanjwa kwamanje ne-SANC (2026 receipt). Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha, ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile kanye ne-Diploma kwi-Nursing Administration kuzoba yinzuzo njengesiphakamiso. Ulwazi ngomthethosisekelo kanye nesakhiwo sophakamiso. Amakhono okuphatha, eNkantolo, ukuphatha, ukwakha kanye nokuhlanganisa. Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo kwezinqubomgomo ze-HR kanye nezezimali kanye nezindlela zokwenza. Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo kwesakhiwo somthethosisekelo esibusisa umphakathi wokwenza imisebenzi. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha ukulawula ulwazi ngokuhambisana nezidingo zesikhungo. Ulwazi lwezinhlelo zokuqinisekisa izinga lesibhedlela kanye nezindlela zokulawula ukutheleleka. Amakhono okwenza izinqumo.
zu.duties: Ziba ukulawula ngokuphelele ukunakekelwa kwezokwelapha, okuhlanganisa ukwazisa nokuphatha amahlelo wezokunakekela kanye nokuqashwa kanye nenhlolokusebenza yawo. Phatha ukwakheka nokusetshenziswa kweNdaba ebusuku, iNdebe yokusebenza, iNdebe yeshishini, izinqubomgomo kanye neziqondiso zokunakekelwa kwezokwelapha. Khombisa ukuzibophezela kwesikhungo ekunakekelweni kwemithombo yokuphila ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana ne-Office of Health Standard Compliance (OHSC), i-Ideal Hospital (IHRM) kanye nezakhiwo zombuso wezokwelapha kanye nokuvikela ukutheleleka nokulawula.enza imisebenzi kanye nemisebenzi ngokukhulu, ukwesekwa amaphupho kanye nenhloso ebalulekile zesikhungo kanye nenhlangano yezempilo. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa kwezindaba ezithintwe ukwenza izenzo ezingcolile, izikhulumi kanye nezinkinga zabasebenzi kwesigaba sezokwelapha. Thumela ngokushesha izimemo ezimaliswe nabezindaba eziyisibhalo kwi-CEO. Phatha futhi usebenzise imithombo ngokuhambisana nezinqubomgomo kanye nomthethosisekelo.enza ukuhlola okusekelwe ezokwelapha futhi uhlanganyele, ukweseka futhi usebenzise izinhloso zokuthuthukiswa kwemithombo yokuphila kanye noBuhle Bokulawula. Siza futhi ukhuthaze isithombe nokuzithoba kwezokwelapha. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kahle kokuqashwa komsebenzi. Phatha amaphupho amasha okuzwilwa imithombo yokuphila futhi usebenzise izinhlelo zokungenelela. Ukusiza isikhungo ngokulungele ukwahlwa kanye nokusebenzisa kanye nokubuka iziphetho zokuqashwa.enza izinkomba zokuqashwa kwamakhono ezokwelapha ukuvuselela abasebenzi bezokwelapha Qinisekisa ukulandelwa kokutholwa kwezibalo kanye nokuhambisana nezindlela zokuphatha idatha zenhlangano yezempilo i-KZN.

xh.title: I Sekela MphathiwoMongezi
xh.summary: Isithuba se Sekela MphathiwoMongezi kwisibhedlele i Umphumulo Hospital e KwaZulu-Natal esifuna inqununu ye mongezi, ukubhalisa kwi SANC kunye nobungakanisele phantse iminyaka eli-9.
xh.requirements: I Senior Certificate plus inqununu / iidiploma kwi Nursing jikelele nomnonoonyozo kwaye kwakhona ifayuni yokubhalisa njengomongezi we Njengomongezi oYilwayo kwi SANC. Ubungakanisele obungazange bungaphantsi kweminyaka eli-9 yamava afanelekileyo / aqatyiweyo kumongezi emva kwesivakalisi sokuba ngumongezi oYilwayo kwi SANC. Oko kuqala phantse iminyaka eli-4 kuloo ndawo inikezelwe apha ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo / aqatyiweyo kwinqanaba lokulawula. Ukubhalisa okuseleyo ukwakhona kwi SANC (2026 receipt). Ulwazi lokusebenzisa i khompyutha, ilayisenisi yokushuka eseyisimo kwaye nedioma kulawulo Iwe Zime ngcono ngakumbi njengesindululo. Ulwazi ngomthetho ngesakhiwo sokucinga. Ikhono lokukhokela, ukulawula, ukucwangcisa, ukuqamba, kunye nothint' unako. Ukuqonda okusesikweni ngokwemigaqo nemithetho ye HR kunye neemfuno ezimalini. Ukuqonda okusesikweni ngemigaqonqo elawula inkonzo kawo wonke wonke. Ulwazi ngokusebenza khompyutha ngokwaneleyo ukulawula inkcazelo ngokwemfuno zeziko. Ulwazi ngokuqinisekisa inyaniyo kwi nkqubo yamaza neenkqubo zokukhusela isibhedlele. Ikhono lokwenza iigqibo.
xh.duties: Lawula ngokubanzi iindlela zokunakekelwa komongezi, kuquka inkcazelo nokuqwashiswa kweenkqubo zokunakekelwa ukunye nokuphumeza nokuhlola konke oko. Lawula ukuselela nokuyalela isicwangciso esiPhambili, isicwangciso soSebenzo, iNkampani, iNkqubo kunye nemigaqonqo yeenkonzo zokunakekelwa kumongezi. Tyhila inyathelo le ziko lokuzinikela ngemigaqonqo emnandi ngokuqinisekisa ukuthobela kwemithelelo ye Office of Health Standard Compliance (OHSC), i Ideal Hospital (IHRM) kunye neempahla zomthetho wekl1inikh kunye nokuthintela nokulawula iintsholongwane. Phumeza imisebenzi ngokuchanekileyo, ngenkxaso yemigqiyo kunye nemiQango yo Bamba babo bobukhulu be Nkonzo. Qinisekisa ukulawula iindaba zolungelo, iingxaki zomsebenzi namathuba obomi kumongezi. Thumela iingxelo ezimbini zomlomo ngebholorho e Ziko. Lawula kwaye usebenzise inkcazelo ngokwemigaqonqo neenkqubo ezifanelekileyo. Qamba iindidi zokulinganisa kwaye ulungelelanise, wenze kwaye usebenzise iinkqubo zokuphucula iNtswa kunye noLawulo olululo. Xhasa kwaye usasaze iindlela zokunakekelwa ngokomoya kwaye ngokobuchwepheshe. Qinisekisa ukulawula ngokwaneleyo inkqubo yomsebenzi wogqisa. Phawula iindidi ezifuneka zokuzifundisa kwaye usebenzise iindlela zokuzibandakanya. Nceda iziko ngokulungelelana ukulinganisa nokuphumeza nokuhlola konke okufunyenwe kukulinganisa. Khokela iindibano ezincinci zokuqinisekisa ukulungeleliswa kolwazi komongezi. Qinisekisa ukuthathwa kolwazi ngokubalo ngokulandela iinkqubo zokulawula inkcazelo ye KZN Department of Health.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Monitoring and Evaluation
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (an all-inclusive salary package)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Monitoring and Evaluation at the KwaZulu-Natal Department of Health, requiring a degree in Public Health or Epidemiology and three to five years of relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: Matric Certificate (Grade 12). A Degree/Postgraduate diploma in Public Health / Epidemiology/ Biostatistics / Statistics. Three (3) to five (5) years experience in Monitoring and Evaluation in public health programmes at junior management level (Assistant Director). Approximately 3-5 years experience applying epidemiological and/or statistical concepts to public health related data analysis, preferably with HIV, ART, TB and MCWH data. Strong understanding of the public health system, with specific focus on health information, including data production, routine data in public health settings, cohort monitoring, and data quality improvement. Demonstrated experience in data mining, analysing cohort reports, webDHIS indicators in public health sector. Demonstrated experience with statistical analysis package such as STATA, SPSS. Demonstrated experience working with data visualisation tools. Experience working in or supporting, the public health sector. Computer literacy. Valid driver’s license. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: Strong knowledge of Strategic Health goals and guidelines legislative and policy framework such as NSP HIV, TB, STI 2023-28, KZN PSP HAST 2023-28; SDG Goals and 95-95-95 targets for HIV and TB. Knowledge of the DORA framework governing the Strategic Health Program. Sound knowledge of the Departmental MM & E Framework. Strong project and time management skills. Strong analytical skills including analysis of both quantitative and qualitative data. Computer proficiency in word processing, database, spreadsheet and graphics presentations. Excellent report writing. Interpersonal skills. Facilitation skills. Communication skills.
jobs.duties: Establish and Implement the Provincial Strategic Health monitoring and evaluation system. Develop tools for the ongoing review of programmes in the province. Ensure the use of approved indicators and targets. Measure progress and make recommendation for improvement. Ensure compliance with the requirements of the reporting systems for preparing HAST and MCWH program reports as per required formats i.e. DORA, APP, MTDP, MEC Budget Speech, SHP Dashboards, Treasury reports. Maintain and update SHP information repository. Coordinate the compilation of monthly, quarterly and annual report for HAST and MCWH programmes. Generate dashboard report for HAST and MCWH&N programmes. Conduct in-depth data analysis on ART quarterly cohort data and compile reports. Work closely with research institutions in HAST and MCWH&N programmes and share findings with Managers. Contribute to the Provincial Annual Performance Reviews including the review of Annual Programme budget and annual expenditure reports. Provide support and capacity building to M & E personnel within the Districts. Monitor implementation of the QIP project at all levels. Conduct meetings to discuss challenges and way forward. Give monthly feedback to Districts on their performance, data completeness, accuracy e.g. monthly submission TIET.NET dispatch files, overall SHP APP indicators. Ensure proper and accurate collection of performance data from the software of any implementing program. Work with Data Manager and Data Collection Manager to introduce and implement any newly developed health information system. Maintain and support any newly introduced system at facility level. Provide technical support to all levels using the system. Support the implementation of surveys related to Strategic Health Programs and reviews. Conduct mid-term and end of year reviews for all Districts’ programme performance. Plan and ensure implementation for HIV/ANC survey. Assist with preparation of ART TIER.NET PIT/EMR/SyNCH systems meetings. Support Program Managers in the revision of work plans and strategies. Strategize with provincial programme managers at both provincial and District level using updated information. Assist Programme Manager during preparation of business plans, target setting and crafting of indicators. Ensure the development and implementation of policies. Ensure the implementation of Provincial and Departmental frameworks. Ensure the implementation of policies according to agreed norms and standards. Monitor and evaluate compliance with implemented policies. Report on any discrepancies with regards to compliance to all relevant stakeholders. Review and amend policies as and when required based on input from stakeholders.
jobs.enquiries: Mr A Ngcobo Tel No: (033) 395 2210
jobs.applications: Interested applicants can visit the following website at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs for full posts details. “Applicants are encouraged to apply for posts through the online e-Recruitment system at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs or submit their Z83 and CV directly to the following email address HeadOffice.HRJobapplication@kznhealth.gov.za. Applicants may also visit any one of our Designated Online Application Centres (DOACS) where our friendly staff will assist you with applying online or receiving your hardcopy application. You can find the list of Designated Online Application Centres (DOACS) at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs All Applications should be forwarded to: The Chief Director: Human Resource Management Services KZN Department of Health Private Bag X9051 Pietermaritzburg 3200 or Hand delivered to: 330 Langalibalele Street Natalia Building, Registry, Minus 1:1 North Tower (Attention: Mr. A Memela)
jobs.notes: (This Department is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer, whose aim is to promote representivity in all levels of all occupational categories in the Department.) Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Application for Employment form (Z83) which must be originally signed, initialed and dated. Applications received on the incorrect Z83 will not be considered. All required information on the Z83 must be provided. Failure to complete or disclose all information will automatically disqualify the applicant. The Z83 should be accompanied by a comprehensive CV only (with detailed experience). Persons with disabilities should feel free to apply for the post. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (security clearance (vetting), criminal clearance, credit records, citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by SAQA. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have all foreign qualifications evaluated by SAQA and to provide proof of such evaluation (when shortlisted). Applicants: Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. If you apply for more than 1 post, submit separate applications for each post that you apply for. Should you not be contacted within 3 months of the closing date of the advertisement, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. NB: All shortlisted candidates will be required to submit proof of work experience endorsed and stamped by employer/s prior to the date of the interview.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Monitering en Evaluering
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir Monitering en Evaluering by die KwaZulu-Natal Department of Health, wat 'n graad in Publieke Gesondheid of Epidemiologie en drie tot vyf jaar van toepaslike ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Matrik Sertifikaat (Graad 12). 'n Graad/Nagraadse diploma in Publieke Gesondheid / Epidemiologie / Biostatistiek / Statistiek. Drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar ervaring in Monitering en Evaluering in publieke gesondheidsprogramme op junior bestuursvlak (Assistent Direkteur). Ongeveer 3-5 jaar ervaring in die toepassing van epidemiologiese en/of statistiese konsepte op publieke gesondheidsverwante data-ontleding, verkieslik met HIV, ART, TB en MCWH data. Sterk begrip van die publieke gesondheidstelsel, met spesifieke fokus op gesondheidsinligting, insluitend dataproduksie, roetine data in publieke gesondheidsomgewings, kohortmonitering, en datakwaliteitsverbetering. Bewese ervaring in datamynning, die ontleding van kohortverslae, webDHIS-aanwysers in die publieke gesondheidsektor. Bewese ervaring met statistiese ontledingspakket soos STATA, SPSS. Bewese ervaring met die werk met datavisualiseringsinstrumente. Ervaring met die werk in of ondersteuning van die publieke gesondheidsektor. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Sterk kennis van Strategiese Gesondheidsdoelwitte en riglyne wetgewende en beleidsraamwerk soos NSP HIV, TB, STI 2023-28, KZN PSP HAST 2023-28; SDG Goals en 95-95-95 teikens vir HIV en TB. Kennis van die DORA-raamwerk wat die Strategiese Gesondheidsprogram regeer. Degelike kennis van die Departementele MM & E Raamwerk. Sterk projek- en tydbestuurvaardighede. Sterke analitiese vaardighede insluitend ontleding van beide kwantitatiewe en kwalitatiewe data. Rekenaarbedrewe in woordverwerking, databasis, sigblad en grafiekvoorstellings. Uitstekende verslagskrywing. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Fasiliteringsvaardighede. Kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Stig en implementeer die provinsiale Strategiese Gesondheid monitering en evalueringstelsel. Ontwikkel instrumente vir die deurlopende hersiening van programme in die provinsie. Verseker die gebruik van goedgekeurde aanwysers en teikens. Meet vordering en maak aanbevelings vir verbetering. Verseker nakoming van die vereistes van die verslagdoeningstelsels vir die voorbereiding van HAST en MCWH programverslae volgens die vereiste formate, d.w.s. DORA, APP, MTDP, MEC Budget Speech, SHP Dashboards, Treasury verslae. Onderhou en dateer die SHP inligtingsbewaarplek op. Koördineer die samestelling van maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse verslae vir HAST en MCWH programme. Genereer dashboardverslae vir HAST en MCWH&N programme. Voer diepgaande data-anise op ART kwartaallikse kohortdata uit en stel verslae op. Werk nou saam met navorsingsinstellings in HAST en MCWH&N programme en deel bevindings met Bestuurders. Dra by tot Provinsiale Jaarlikse Prestasiehermientings, insluitend die hersiening van Jaarlikse Programme begroting en jaarlikse uitgaweverslae. Verskaf ondersteuning en kapasiteitsbou aan M & E personeel binne die Distrikte. Moniteer implementering van die QIP-projek op alle vlakke. Hou vergaderings om uitdagings en die weg vorentoe te bespreek. Verskaf maandelikse terugvoer aan Distrikte oor hul prestasie, datavolledigheid, akkuraatheid bv. maandelikse indiening van TIET.NET versendingslêers, algehele SHP APP aanwysers. Verseker behoorlike en akkurate versameling van prestasiedata van die sagteware van enige implementerende program. Werk met die Dataverwant en Data-insamelingsbestuurder om enige nuut ontwikkelde gesondheidsinligtingstelsel bekend te stel en te implementeer. Onderhou en ondersteun enige nuut ingevoerde stelsel op fasiliteitsvlak. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning op alle vlakke wat die stelsel gebruik. Ondersteun die implementering van opnames verwant aan Strategiese Gesondheidsprogramme en hersienings. Voer middeltermyn- en eindejaar-herzienings uit vir alle Distrikte se programprestasie. Beplan en verseker implementering vir HIV/ANC opname. Help met die voorbereiding van ART TIER.NET PIT/EMR/SyNCH stelselsvergaderings. Ondersteun Programbestuurders met die hersiening van werksplanne en strategieë. Strategiseer met provinsiale programbestuurders op beide provinsiale en Distrikvlak deur bygewerkte inligting te gebruik. Ondersteun Programbestuurder tydens voorbereiding van besigheidsplanne, teikenvastelling en formulering van aanwysers. Verseker die ontwikkeling en implementering van beleid. Verseker die implementering van Provinsiale en Departementele raamwerke. Verseker die implementering van beleid volgens ooreengekome norme en standaarde. Moniteer en evalueer nakoming van geimplementeerde beleid. Rapporteer enige afwykings ten opsigte van nakoming aan alle relevante belanghebbendes. Hersien en wysig beleid soos wanneer nodig op grond van insette van belanghebbendes.

zu.title: Onjiniyela Omncane: Okuvinjelwayo Nokuhlola
zu.summary: Onjiniyela Omncane woKuvinjelwayo Nokuhlola oKwaZulu-Natal Department of Health, ofuna idigri kuPublic Health noma i-Epidemiology kanye neminyaka emithathu kuya kwayisihlanu yemfundo efanelekile.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Matric (I-Graji 12). Idigri/Idiploma yesiqu siphezulu kwi-Public Health / i-Epidemiology/ i-Biostatistics / i-Statistics. Iminyaka eyithathu (3) kuya kwayisihlanu (5) yemfundo ekuvinjelweni nasekuholweni ohlelweni lwezempilo emphakathini ezingeni labaphathi abancane (i-Assistant Director). Malunga neminyaka eyi-3-5 yemfundo yokusebenzisa izimiso ze-epidemiological kanye/noma izibalo ekwenzeni isahluko senani lokubuka emaphakethini ezempilo, ngokuncinda ngendlela efanelekileyo ngedatha ye-HIV, ART, TB kanye ne-MCWH. Ukuqonda okuqinileyo kohlelo lwezempilo emphakathini, ngokugqamisa ukwaziswa kwezempilo, okuhlanganisa ukukhiqiza idatha, idatha evamile emakade wezempilo, ukuqanjwa kwamabanja, nokuthuthukiswa kwezinga lemithombo yedatha. Ukubonakala kuleminyaka yemfundo ekusebenzeni ukutsha imininingwane, ukuhlola amabhuku amabanja, izinkomba ze-webDHIS esikweni sezempilo emphakathini. Ukubonakala kwemfundo yokwenza isahluko ngemininingwane efana ne-STATA, SPSS. Ukubonakala kwemfundo yokusebenza nezinsiza zokubonisa idatha. Iminyaka yemfundo yokusebenza noma ukweseka isikupho sezempilo emphakathini. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa Namakhono Adingekayo: Ulwazi oluqinileyo ngezinhloso nezinqubo zezempilo ezibalulekile kanye nensimbi yomthetho nenhlelo yokuhlela efana ne-NSP HIV, TB, STI 2023-28, KZN PSP HAST 2023-28; Izinhloso ze-SDG kanye nezinhloso ze-95-95-95 ze-HIV ne-TB. Ulwazi ngohlelo lwe-DORA oluphethe uhlelo lwezempilo ezibalulekile. Ulwazi oluqinileyo ngohlelo lwe-MM & E lwaboMnyango. Amakhono amakhulu okuphatha amaphrojekthi nesikhathi. Amakhono amakhulu wokuhlola okuhlanganisa ukuhlola idatha yokubala kanye naleyo engabalo. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ekubhaleni amagama, ukugcina imininingwane, ukwakha amathebula kanye nemibukiso yezithombe. Ukubhala okuhle ngemibiko. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu. Amakhono okuquumba. Amakhono okuxhumana.
zu.duties: Sungula futhi usebenzise uhlelo lwesifunda lwezempilo ezibalulekileyo lokuvinjelwa nokuhlolwa. Yakha izinsiza zokuqhuba ukucatshangelwa okuqhubekayo kwezinhlelo esifundeni. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinkomba kanye nezinhloso ezamukelekile. Linganisa inqubo kanye nokubeka izinkomba ukuthuthukiswa. Qinisekisa ukuzinza kwemithetho edingekayo yohlelo lokuqamba imibiko yokulungiselela imibiko yohlelo lwe-HAST kanye ne-MCWH ngokulandelwa kwemifanekisela edingekayo i.e. DORA, APP, MTDP, MEC Budget Speech, SHP Dashboards, Treasury reports. Gcina futhi uvuse isiqu sokugcina ulwazi lwe-SHP. Hlelisisa ukuqoqa imibiko yenyanga ngemibili, kwesikhashana kanye kanxulumeyo ngezinhlelo ze-HAST kanye ne-MCWH. Yakha imibiko yamadashibhodi yohlelo lwe-HAST kanye ne-MCWH&N. Yenza isihlukanisi idatha esijulile sendatha yamabanja ye-ART kanxulumeyo futhi uqoqe imibiko. Sebenzisana kakhulu namasikhungo ocwaningo ohlelweni lwe-HAST kanye ne-MCWH&N futhi wabelane ngemiphumela namaManeja. Siza ekuphathweni kokuqamba imibiko kanxulumeyo esifundeni okuhlanganisa nokucatshangelwa kweNkiyacho yamaphrojekthi kanxulumeyo kanye nemibiko yemali ekhishwa kanxulumeyo. Nikeza isizo kanye nokuqeqesha ukwaziswa abantu bakuM & E ngaphakathi kwamaDistrikhi. Hlola ukusetshenziswa kwephrojekthi ye-QIP emazingeni onke. Biza izingqungquthla zokuxoxa ngobunzima kanye nendlela ephambili. Nikeza ngemibiko yenyanga ngemibili kuDistrikithi ngemisebenzi yamawunze, ukuphela kokubhalwa kwedatha, ukwedlulela, isb. ukulethwa kwamafayela e-TIET.NET kanxulumeyo, izinkinda zonke ze-SHP APP. Qinisekisa ukuqoqwa okufanele nokwedlulela kokuqoqa idatha yemisebenzi kusuka kusoftware yanoma yiliphi ihlelo. Sebenza ne-Data Manager ne-Data Collection Manager ukuze sekete futhi usebenzise noma yisiphi isikhathi sanimanzi sokwaziswa ngemithombo yezempilo. Gcina futhi weseka noma yisiphi isikhathi esithuliwe sakuwunza kwesikhathi kwamalungu esibhedlela. Nikeza isizo se-inothi emazingeni onke okusebenzisa uhlelo. Sela ukusetshenziswa kwezibalo ezihlobene nezinhlelo zezempilo ezibalulekile kanye nocwaningo. Yenza ukuqashelwa kwesikhathi phakathi konyaka kanye ekugcineni konyaka ngemisebenzi yazo onke amaDistrikhi. Cwangcisa futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa kocwaningo lwe-HIV/ANC. Siza ekulungiseleleni izingqungquthla zamasistemu e-ART TIER.NET PIT/EMR/SyNCH. Sela oManeja bephrojekthi ekuguqulweni kohlelo lokusebenza kanye nezinhlela. Hlela noManeja wephrojekthi yesifunda emazingeni obaba besebenza ngolwazi oluvandiwe. Siza oManeja bephrojekthi ekulungiseleleni amapulani zebhizinisi, ukubeka izinhloso kanye nokuqamba izinkinda. Qinisekisa ukwakhiwa nokusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zomthetho. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zesifunda kanye zalaboMnyango. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zomthetho ngokulandelwa kwemithetho kanye nokuqinisekiswa okuvunyelwene ngakuso. Hlola futhi uqashise ukuzinza kwezinhlelo zomthetho ezisetsenziswayo. Yenisa imibiko nganoma yiziphi izinto ezingahlangani ezingafani ngokuzinza kubo bonke abantu abahlobene. Buza futhi uguqule izinhlelo zomthetho njengoba kudingeka ngokungena kwezimiso kusukela kubantu bahlobene.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Ukuqwalasela nokuHlonipha
xh.summary: Isekela Mongameli wokuQwalasela nokuHlonipha kwisebe lezeMpilo yakwaZulu-Natali, lifuna idigrì yeMpilo kaLuntu okanye uQeqesho lwesifo esihlaselayo kwaye alifumene iminyaka emithathu ukuya kwehlanu yemisebenzi ehambelanayo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seMatric (Grade 12). Idigrì/Ipastgraduate diploma kwiMpilo kaLuntu / uQeqesho lwesifo esihlaselayo/ iBiostatistics / izibalo. Iminyaka emithathu (3) ukuya kwehlanu (5) yamava akuqwalasela nokuHlonipha kumathuba empilo koluntu kwinqanaba lolawulo olusezantsi (iAssistant Director). Malunga neminyaka e3-5 yamava ekusebenziseni iinkqubo zesifo esihlaselayo namba okanye iinkqubo ezibhekisa kumanani kwedatha ehambelana nempilo yoluntu, ngokukodwa ngedatha yeHIV, ART, TB neMCWH. Ukuqonda okuqinileyo inkqubo yempilo yoluntu, ngethamsanqa ngolwazi ngempilo, kuquka ukudala idatha, idatha etshintshayo kwiindawo ezinempilo yoluntu, ukuqwalasela iqela, nokuphucula ikhwalithi yedatha. Amanqanaba okubonisa amava ekutsha idatha, ukuhlalutya iiripoti zeqela, izalathisi ze-webDHIS kwicala lempilo yoluntu. Amanqanaba okubonisa amava nokuqwalasela idatha ngeempompo ezinjenge-STATA, SPSS. Amanqanaba okubonisa amava ekusebenziseni izixhobo zokubonisa idatha. Amava yokusebenza okanye ukuxhasa icala lempilo yoluntu. Ukwaziswa ngekhompyutha. Ilayisensi esemthethweni yokushayela. Ulwazi, Amandla, uQeqesho nokuZinikela okuFunekayo: Ulwazi oluqinileyo ngeenjongo zeStrategic Health kwaye nahemela ngokomthetho nangokwenkqubo yamaziko afana ne-NSP HIV, TB, STI 2023-28, KZN PSP HAST 2023-28; iinjongo ze-SDG nakuqwalasela i-95-95-95 ngeHIV neTB. Ulwazi ngenkqubo ye-DORA elawula iNkqubo yeStrategic Health. Ulwazi oluhle ngenkqubo ye-MM & E yesebe. Amandla amakhulu ekulawula iiprojekthi nexesha. Amandla amakhulu ukuhlalutya kuquka ukuhlalutya idatha enamanani nedatha engenanamanani. Ukuziphumeza ngekhompyutha ekubhaleni, kwisebe ledata, kwispredshithi nakubonakaliso kumapresentheshini. Ukubhala iiripoti ngenkqubo. Amandla bokusebenza nabantu. Amandla bokunceda. Amandla konxibelelwano.
xh.duties: Seka yaye uPhumeze inkqubo yeprovinsi yeStrategic Health yokuqwalasela nokuHlonipha. Yenza izixhobo zokuqwalasela rhoqo amathuba eprovinsi. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kwezalathisi neenjongo ezivunyiweyo. Qwalasela inkqubela yaye uzeke iingcebiso zokuphucula. Qinisekisa ukuthobela iimfuno zenkqubo yokuvela iiripoti zokulungiselela iiripoti zeprogram ye-HAST ne-MCWH njengakumagama afunekayo oko kukuthi i-DORA, APP, MTDP, iNkulumo yeBajeti ye-MEC, ama-Dashboard e-SHP, iiripoti zeTreasury. Gcina yaye uhlaziye isikhululo se-SHP. Linganisa ukudityaniswa kweeripotinyanga, ezihlobo nezonyaka zama-HAST namathuba e-MCWH. Yenza iiripoti ze-dashboard ze-HAST nezinkqubo ze-MCWH&N. Yenza ukuhlalutya okujulileyo kwedatha ye-ART yehlobo yenyanga ezintathu yaye ulungelelanise iiripoti. Sebenza kosetyenziswa eduze nezikolo zophando kumanathuba e-HAST nankqubo ye-MCWH&N yaye wabelane nengcamango namaManela. Nikeza inkxaso yaye yakha amandla abantu be-M & E kummandla. Qwalasela ukuphunywa kweeprojekthi ze-QIP kuzo zonke iinqanaba. Yanga iindibano ezithetha ngengozi nendlela ekuyo. Nikela ngenkcazelo yenyanga kummandla ngemfundo yabo, isigqibo sedatha, unyani oko kukuthi ungeniso lwenyanga lwamafayile e-TIET.NET dispatch, izalathisi ze-SHP APP. Qinisekisa ukuqokelelwa ngokuchanekileyo nangokufanelekileyo idatha yemfundo kwisoftware yanayo naipprogram ephilayo. Sebenzana noData Manager noData Collection Manager ukungenisa yaye uziphumeze naziphi na inkqubo entsha yolwazi ngempilo ekhiliziweyo. Gcina yaye uxhase naziphi na inkqubo entsha esezantsini kwisibhedlele. Nikeza inkxaso ngamava kuwo onke amanqanaba esebenzisa inkqubo. Xhasa ukusebenza kolwangoxwebhu oluhambelana neStrategic Health Programs neenkqubo. Qwalasela iinkqubo zaphakathi kunyaka nasekupheleni konyaka yonke imfundo yamathuba onke amawonga. Cwangcisa yaye uqinisekise ukuphunywa kolwango lwe-HIV/ANC. Nceda ukulungiselela iindibano ze-ART TIER.NET PIT/EMR/SyNCH systems. Xhasa abaManela beeprogram ekulungisekeni kwama-plani omsebenzi ngeendlela entsha. Cwangcisa namaManela beprogram bekwindawo yonke kwelinye iqondo kunye nalawo eseZantsi besebenzisa ulwazi olutsha. Nceda uMphathi weprogram xa kulungiselelwa ama-plani webhizinisi, ukuqamba iinjongo nokudala izalathisi. Qinisekisa ukwenziwa nokuphunywa kweekhalendle. Qinisekisa ukuphunywa kweenkqubo zaseZantsi nakwisebe. Qinisekisa ukuphunywa kweekhalendle ngokwemigaqo nemiqathango evunyiweyo. Qwalasela yaye uHloniphe ukuthobela iinkqubo eziphunyiweyo.nika ingxelo nangaluphi na usulelo ngokuthobela kuwo onke abathintekayo. Qwalasela yaye ulungise iinkqubo xa kufuneka ngokwengcamango kubathintekayo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Facilities Management
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum. The all-inclusive remuneration package consists of 70% basic salary and 30% flexible portion that may be structured in terms of the applicable rules.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Facilities Management at Ladysmith Regional Hospital, overseeing contracted services, support functions and compliance with service level agreements.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 / Matric or equivalent, An appropriate Degree / National Diploma in Administration / Management or equivalent. Plus at least 3 years’ appropriate junior managerial experience in Systems Management. Unendorsed Valid driver’s license. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies. Knowledge of and experience in General Administration, Patient Administration and Information Systems. Knowledge of relevant acts and regulations inclusive of Patient fees manual. Sound management, negotiation, inter-personal, decision making and problem solving skills. Working knowledge of the Basic Accounting Systems (BAS). Understanding of Information Technology and IT system. Good verbal and written communication skills. Computer literacy in MS Word and Excel. Ability to handle sensitive financial information in strictest confidence. Experience in budgeting financial planning and analysis.
jobs.duties: Monitor contracted hotel, facilities and support services to ensure adherence to service level agreement, quality standards, value for money and timely corrective action. Manage and coordinate support services, including Information Technology (e-Health), cleaning, telecommunications, registry and reprographics, maintenance, gardening, mortuary, housekeeping, security, laundry and transport. Ensure the implementation, functionary and monitoring of the e-Health electronic patient record management system, including accurate, secure and timely capture retrieval, reporting and protection of patient information. Ensure compliance with applicable legislation, policies, government regulations, the Ideal Hospital Framework and Office of Health Standards Compliance (OHSC) standards; coordinate assessments, quality improvement plans and corrective actions within the area of responsibility. Ensure effective management of human and financial resources within the directorate through workforce planning, staff supervision, performance management, budgeting, expenditure monitoring and cost containment in line with applicable prescripts Provide technical and operational advice to hospital management and ensure the reliability and maintenance of standby, emergency and critical facilities and infrastructure. Contribute as a member of the multidisciplinary management team to effective hospital governance, service delivery, integrated planning and performance reporting. Develop, maintain and implement effective disaster preparedness, business continuity and major incident management plans for facilities and support services. Assess service delivery alternatives, including outsourcing where appropriate, and recommend improvements to procurement, contract management, maintenance and operational efficiency. Ensure adherence to occupational health and safety requirements, infection prevention and control measures, and appropriate risk management across all facilities and support services. Manage staff training, capacity building and ongoing development in line with individual performance needs, departmental priorities and service delivery requirements.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Fasiliteitsbestuur
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir Fasiliteitsbestuur by Ladysmith Regional Hospital, met toesig oor kontraktiewe dienste, steunfunksies en nakoming van diensvlakooreenkomste.
af.requirements: Graad 12 / Matriek of gelykwaardig. 'n Toepaslike Graad / Nasionale Diploma in Administrasie / Bestuur of gelykwaardig. Plus minstens 3 jaar se toepaslike junior bestuurservaring in Stelselbestuur. Ongeëndorsede geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede. Kennis van en ervaring in Algemene Administrasie, Pasiëntadministrasie en Inligtingstelsels. Kennis van toepaslike wette en regulasies, insluitend die Patient fees manual. Deeglike bestuurs-, onderhandelings-, interpersoonlike, besluitnemings- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Werkende kennis van die Basic Accounting Systems (BAS). Begrip van Inligtingstegnologie en IT-stelsels. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid in MS Word en Excel. Vermoe om sensitiewe finansiële inligting in strengste vertrouelikheid te hanteer. Ervaring in begroting, finansiële beplanning en ontleding.
af.duties: Moniteer kontraktiewe hotel-, fasiliteits- en steundienste om te verseker dat daar voldoen word aan diensvlakooreenkomste, gehaltestandaarde, waarde vir geld en tydige korrektiewe optrede. Bestuur en koördineer steundienste, insluitend Inligtingstegnologie (e-Health), skoonmaak, telekommunikasie, registratuur en reproduksie, instandhouding, tuinmaak, lykhuis, huishouding, sekuriteit, wasgoed en vervoer. Verseker die implementering, funksionering en monitering van die e-Health elektroniese pasiëntrekordbestuurstelsel, insluitend akkurate, veilige en tydige vaslegging, onttrekking, verslagdoening en beskerming van pasiëntinligting. Verseker nakoming van toepaslike wetgewing, beleid, staatsregulasies, die Ideal Hospital Framework en Office of Health Standards Compliance (OHSC) standaarde; koördineer assesserings, gehalteverbeteringsplanne en korrektiewe maatreëls binne die area van verantwoordelikheid. Verseker effektiewe bestuur van menslike en finansiële hulpbronne binne die direktoraat deur die beplanning van die arbeidsmag, toezig op personeel, prestasiebestuur, begroting, bestedingmonitering en kostebeheer in ooreenstemming met toepaslike voorskrifte. Verskaf tegniese en operasionele advies aan hospitaalbestuur en verseker die betroubaarheid en instandhouding van stand-by-, nood- en kritieke fasiliteite en infrastruktuur. Dra as lid van die multidissiplinêre bestuurspan by tot effektiewe hospitaalbestuur, dienslewering, geïntegreerde beplanning en prestasieverslagdoening. Ontwikkel, onderhou en implementeer effektiewe ramptoerekendheids-, besigheidskontinuïteits- en groot voorvalbestuursplanne vir fasiliteite en steundienste. Beoordeel alternatiewe vir dienslewering, insluitend buitekontraktering waar toepaslik, en beveel verbeterings aan vir verkryging, kontrakbestuur, instandhouding en operasionele doeltreffendheid. Verseker nakoming van beroepsgesondheids- en veiligheidsvereistes, infeksievoorkoming en beheermaatreëls, en toepaslike risikobestuur oor alle fasiliteite en steundienste. Bestuur personeelopleiding, kapasiteitsbou en deurlopende ontwikkeling in ooreenstemming met individuele prestasiebehoeftes, departementele prioriteite en diensleweringsvereistes.

zu.title: UMqondisi ohambelayo: ukuPhatha izikhungo
zu.summary: UMqondisi ohambelayo wokuPhatha izikhungo e-Ladysmith Regional Hospital, obuka izinsizakusebenza ezinkontileka, imisebenzi yokusekela kanye nokuhambelana nezivumelwano zamazinga enkonzo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Grade 12 / Matric noma okulingana nazo, I-Degree / National Diploma elifanele eNqangweni lokuPhatha / ukuLawula noma okulingana nayo. Kanti futhi okungenani ngeminyaka engu-3 yamava okuphatha okulingana naye kuleveli encane ekuPhathweni kwezinhlelo. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile engavunyiwe nayo. Ulwazi, Amakhono, ukuQeqeshwa kanye nokuSebenzela. Ukuqonda kwaye ube namava eNqangweni lokuPhatha ngokuvamile, ekuPhathweni kwezinkomba zabaguli kanye neziNhlelo zokwaziswa. ULwazi ngemithetho kanye nezinqumo ezihlobene okuhlanganisa nesincwadi samanani abaguli. Amakhono okuphatha, okuxoxisana, okusebenza nabantu, okwenza izinqumo kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ulwazi lokusebenza nge-Basic Accounting Systems (BAS). Ukuqonda i-Information Technology kanye nenhlelo ye-IT. Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokuqukethwe emibhalweni. Ukubuka izinto ngekhompyutha kwi-MS Word ne-Excel. Ikhono lokuphatha imininingwane yemali ezwela kakhulu ngokuyigoma. Amava ekwenzeni ibhajudi, ukuhlela izimali nokuhlaziya.
zu.duties: Qapha izinsizakusebenza ze-hotel, izikhungo kanye nezinsiza zokusekela ezinkethiwe ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi zilandelwa isivumelwano samazinga enkonzo, izinga lomthetho, ukuthola inani lempahla kanye nesenzo esihle sokulungisa ngesikhathi. Phatha futhi uhlele izinsizakusebenza zokusekela, okuhlanganisa Information Technology (e-Health), ukucisha, ukuxhumana, irekhodi kanye nokuphindaphinda imibhalo, ukugcina izinto zisebenza, ukulondoloza izitshalo, isikhungo sabashonile, ukugcina indlu, ukuvikela, ukugeza izimpahla kanye nezokuthutha. Qinisekisa ukuphazamiseka, ukusebenza kanye nokubuka phambili kwenhlelelo yokuphathwa kwezinkomba zabaguli ezenziwa nge-e-Health electronic patient record management system, okuhlanganisa ukugcina, ukuthola ukubika kanye nokuvikela imininingwane yomguli ngokunembile, ngokuphepha futhi ngesikhathi esifanele. Qinisekisa ukulandelwa kwemithetho, izinqumo, imithetho kahulumeni ephathelene, i-Ideal Hospital Framework kanye namazinga e-Office of Health Standards Compliance (OHSC); hlela ukubuyekezwa, izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinga kanye nezinyathelo zokulungisa ngaphakathi kwesici esinibopho. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kwemithombo yabantu nenyazo emkhakheni wokuphatha ngokuhlela abasebenzi, ukubuka abantu abaphansi kwakho, ukuphatha ukusebenza, ukwenza ibhajudi, ukubuka ukuchithwa kwemali kanye nokugcina izindleko ngokulandelana kwemithetho ethile. Nikeza icebo lokusebenza nenkombandlela egxile enkonsathini kokuphatha isibhedlela futhi uqiniseke ukuthutha nokugcina izinsiza ezingajwayelekanga, eziphuthumayo kanye nezingqalasizinda ezibalulekile. Kon okuthi ubeyilungu leqembu eliphefumulelana ukuphatha emikhakheni eminingi kwenze ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kwezibhedlela, ukulethwa kwezinsiza, ukuhlelangqondaza nokubika ngemikhiqizo. Lakha, ulondoloze futhi usebenzise izinhlelo ezisebenzayo zokulungiselela izinguquko ezingalindelekile, ukuqhubeka kwebhizinisi kanye nokuphathwa kwezehlakalo ezinkulu kwezinsiza zokusekela nezikhungo. Hlola okunye ukukhetha ukuletha izinsiza, okuhlanganisa nokuthumela abanye abantu ukuba bazokwenza lapho kufanele khona, futhi uphathe izinkomba zokuthuthukisa ukuthenga, ukuphatha izinkontileka, ukulondoloza kanye nokusebenza kahle. Qinisekisa ukulandelwa kwezidingo zezempilo nokuphepha emsebenzini, ukuvikela ukutheleleka kanye nezinyathelo zokulawula, kanye nokuphathwa kwezingozi okufanele ezinsizeni zokusekela nasezikhungweni zonke. Phatha ukuqeqesha abantu, ukukhulisa amandla kanye nokuthuthukisa ngokuqhubekayo ngokulandelana nezidingo zomsebenzi womuntu ngamunye, izidingo zomnyango kanye nezidingo zokulethwa kwezinsiza.

xh.title: Isebe leNdlela yoLawulo: uLawulo lweziCwangciso
xh.summary: Isebe leNdlela yoLawulo kuLawulo lweziCwangciso e Ladysmith Regional Hospital, luhlola iinkonzo ezivunyelwe ngomthetho, imisebenzi yonke nayexhasa kunye nokuthobela iinkqubo zemvumelwano yenqanaba lenkonzo.
xh.requirements: I-Garde 12 / i-Matric okuyinto elingana nayo, i-Degree / i-National Diploma efanelekileyo kwi-Administration / i-Management okuyinto elingana nayo. Ngaphezu koko ubuncinane iiminyaka emi-3 yamava afanelekileyo e-engxamathelwe nobunkqonkqo lwe-Systems Management. i-driver’s license esemthethweni engazange ivunyelwe. Ulwazi, Amandla, uQeqesho namakhono. Ulwazi n.amava ku-General Administration, ku-Patient Administration nakwi-Information Systems. Ulwazi ngemithetho nemigaqo efanelekileyo kuquka i-Patient fees manual. Amandla okulawula, ukuxoxisana, amandla omntu ngamnye, ukwenza izigqibo nokuxazula iingxaki. Ulwazi lokusebenza lwe-Basic Accounting Systems (BAS). Ukuqonda i-Information Technology nenkqubo ye-IT. Amandi ahleli ekuthetheni nasekubhaleni. Ukuba nolwazi lokusebenza kwikhompyutha kwi-MS Word ne-Excel. Amandla okusingatha iinkcukacha ezibucali zemali ngokugqithiselweyo. Amava kokubhengisa uqeqesho lomanyano lwezimali noshicilelo.
xh.duties: Qaphela iinkonzo ezivunyelwe ngomthetho zehotele, izecwangciso nazonke ezixhasa ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela imvumelwano yenqanaba lenkonzo, iindidi zomgangatho, ixabiso lemali nokuthatha izigqibo zexeshayo ezilungisayo. Lawula uze wenzelanise iinkonzo ezixhasayo, kuquka i-Information Technology (e-Health), ukucoceka, iinkqubo zokunxibelelana, irejistri nokuqamba ngokutsha, ukulondoloza, ukulima, i-mortuary, ukugcina indlu, ukhuseleko, ukutswala iimpahla nokuhamba. Qinisekisa ukusebenza, abasebenzi nokuphawula kwenkqubo yoshicilelo lwebali yegula le-e-Health, kuquka ukubamba okuchanekileyo, okukhuselekileyo nangexeshayo, ukuhlolwa, okubikwayo nokukhuselwa kolwazi lwesigulane. Qinisekisa ukuthobela imithetho esebenzayo, iinkqubonqando, imigaqo kahulumeni, i-Ideal Hospital Framework neendidi ze-Office of Health Standards Compliance (OHSC); nenzelanise iindawo zokuqwalaselwa, iinkqubo zokuphucula umgangatho nokuthatha izigqibo zolungiso kwicala elibekiweyo lokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukulawula ngokusebenzayo abantu nezibonelelo zemali ngaphakathi kwesebe ngokucwangcisa umsebenzi, ukutyhila abasebenzi, ukulawula inkqubo, ukubhengisa, ukulandela ukutshatshala kumali nokugcina iindleko ngokweendatha ezifanelekileyo. Zenzelela iingcebiso ezobuchwepheshe ezisebenzayo kulawulo lwekhusi ukuze iqinisekise ukuzinza nokulondoloza ekubeni kusebenze, kwi-emergency nakwi-critical facilities nazo zonke iinfrastructures. Nikezela ngentsingiselo njengelinye athethi lephulo elinguzibo lweeminyaka emininzi ukulawula ngokusebenzayo ikhusi, ukunikwa kwenkonzo, ucwangciso oluhlanganiswe nokubika ngenkqubo. Zenza, ulondoloze uze usebenzise iinkqubo ezisebenzayo zolungelelwano lezohlwayo, ukuqhubeleka kwehwebi noku lawula iindwendwe ezinkulu zeecwangciso zokusekela iinkonzo. Qwalasela iindlela ezinokukhethwa ekunikweni kwenkonzo, kuquka nokuba ngaphandle apho kufanelekileyo, uze ucacele ngokuphuculwa kokuthenga, kulawulo lwemvumelwano, ekulondolozweni nasekusebenzeni ngokukhawuleza. Qinisekisa ukuthobela iimfuno zokhuseleko lwezempilo nokhuseleko emsebenzini, izithintela ukutwalwa kolwazi, nokuqhathwa kweengxaki kuzo zonke iifasilitisi nazo zonke iinkonzo ezixhasayo. Lawula uqeqesho lwabasebenzi, ukwakha amandla nokuphucula ngokuhlala kwenzeka ngokwemfuno yenkqubo yomntu ngamnye, iintloko ezibalulekileyo zesebe nemfuno yokunikwa kwenkonzo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Financial Management
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum, (all-inclusive package), consists of 70% Basic salary and 30% flexible portion that may be structured in Terms of the applicable rules.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Financial Management at Grey's Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, responsible for financial systems, internal controls and budget coordination.

Good planning, organising, analytical, problem-solving, decision-making and presentation skills. Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare financial reports and provide financial advice to management. Demonstrated leadership, supervisory, people management and performance management skills. Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, manage competing priorities and perform effectively under pressure. Computer literacy, including proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint, and experience in computerised financial management and reporting systems. Ability to engage effectively with management, staff, auditors, departmental officials and other relevant stakeholders.
jobs.duties: Coordinate and manage the implementation of sound financial management systems, procedures and internal controls to ensure compliance with applicable legislation, policies and financial management prescripts. Coordinate the preparation, motivation, consolidation and implementation of the institution’s MTEF budget in consultation with hospital management and relevant stakeholders. Monitor budget utilisation and expenditure against approved allocations, identify variances and recommend corrective measures to promote budget discipline and prevent unauthorised, irregular, fruitless and wasteful expenditure. Monitor institutional cash flow and expenditure commitments to support the timely settlement of obligations and prevent the accumulation of overdue payments. Prepare, analyse and consolidate accurate and timeous financial reports for submission to the Chief Executive Officer, hospital management and the relevant departmental structures. Provide financial management advice and support to the Chief Executive Officer and management on budget performance, expenditure trends, financial risks and resource allocation. Monitor the effective management and utilisation of the National Tertiary Services Grant (NTSG), ensuring alignment with approved allocations, applicable grant conditions and tertiary service delivery priorities. Coordinate the implementation of revenue enhancement measures, including revenue collection, reconciliation, monitoring and reporting, to improve institutional revenue management. Analyse financial data and management reports to identify trends, cost pressures, inefficiencies and opportunities for cost containment and improved resource utilisation. Monitor compliance with financial management policies, approved delegations, procurement procedures and relevant SCM prescripts, in collaboration with the responsible SCM officials. Maintain effective financial controls over expenditure, payments, commitments, revenue and other financial transactions to safeguard public funds. Coordinate the preparation of annual financial statements and other statutory financial reports, ensuring accuracy, completeness and compliance with applicable reporting requirements. Facilitate internal and external audit processes by ensuring the availability of supporting documentation, responding to audit queries and coordinating the implementation of agreed remedial actions. Monitor financial risks and internal control weaknesses and ensure that corrective measures are implemented within approved timeframes. Supervise, manage and develop staff within the assigned financial management component, including performance management, capacity building and the promotion of accountability. Review financial management processes and recommend improvements to strengthen efficiency, compliance, service delivery and the effective use of institutional resources. Promote the effective use of BAS and other approved financial management information systems to enhance financial monitoring, reporting and decision-making. Provide technical guidance to managers and cost centre holders on budget management, expenditure control, financial reporting and compliance with applicable financial procedures. Maintain effective working relationships with hospital management, departmental financial management structures, SCM officials, auditors and other stakeholders to support sound financial governance. Undertake any other duties delegated by the Chief Executive Officer or the relevant supervisor, consistent with the responsibilities of the post and applicable delegations.

af.requirements: Graad 12 / Senior Sertifikaat. 'n Toepaslike Baccalaureusgraad of Gevorderde Diploma (NQF Vlak 7) in Rekeningkunde, Koste- en Bestuursrekeningkunde, Finansiële Bestuur, Besigheidsadministrasie of 'n ekwivalente toepaslike kwalifikasie. 3-5 jaar middelbestuurervaring in Finansiële Bestuur. NB (Slegs gekorte lys kandidate sal vereis word om bewys van kwalifikasies en ander ondersteunende dokumente en 'n dienssertifikaat wat deur Menslike Hulpbronne goedgekeur is, voor te lê). Gekorte lys kandidate sal vereis word om 'n tegniese assessering te ondergaan om die kennis, vaardighede en bevoegdhede wat relevant is tot die vereistes van die pos te evaluleer. Kennis, Vaardighede en Ervaring: Die ampsdraer sal aan die Hoofuitvoerende Beampte rapporteer en sal verantwoordelik wees vir die bestuur en monitering van die instelling se finansiële bestuur- en SCM-funksies om goeie finansiële bestuursreël, effektiewe begrotingsbeheer, akkurate finansiële verslagdoening en nakoming van toepaslike wetgewing, en departementele beleide te verseker. Die ampsdraer sal die Hoofuitvoerende Beampte en hospitaalbestuur ondersteun in die bevordering van die effektiewe, doeltreffende, ekonomiese en deursigtige benutting van openbare hulpbronne om gehalte pasiëntsorg vol te hou. Kennis van toepaslike finansiële wetgewing, departementele beleide, direktiewe, praktyknotas, rekeningkundige prosedures en interne beheervereistes. Diepgaande kennis van begrotingsvoorbereiding, implementering, monitering en beheer, insluitend die Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) en Basic Accounting System (BAS). Kennis van bestuursbeheer, kontantvloei-beplanning, inkomstebestuur, finansiële rekeningkunde en finansiële verslagdoening. Kennis van openbare sektor Supply Chain Management-beleide, verkrygingsprosedures en toepaslike finansiële delegasies. Begrip van finansiële risikobestuur, interne oudit, ouditprosesse en die implementering van regstellende aksieplanne. Vermoë om finansiële inligting te analiseer en te interpreteer, bestedingsneigings en afwykings te identifiseer, en toepaslike regstellende maatreëls voor te stel. Vermoë om finansiële bestuursprosedures, stelsels en interne beheer te ontwikkel, te implementeer en te moniteer. Goede beplannings-, organiseer-, analitiese, probleemoplossings-, besluitnemings- en voorleggingsvaardighede. Effektiewe skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede, insluitend die vermoë om finansiële verslae voor te berei en finansiële advies aan bestuur te verskaf. Getoonde leierskaps-, toesighoudende, personeelbestuurs- en prestasiebestuursvaardighede. Vermoë om onafhanklik te werk, sperdatums na te kom, mededingende prioriteite te bestuur en effektief onder druk te presteer. Rekenaarvaardigheid, insluitend vaardigheid in Microsoft Excel, Word en PowerPoint, en ervaring in gerekenariseerde finansiële bestuur- en verslagdoeningstelsels. af.duties: Koördineer en bestuur die implementering van deeglike finansiële bestuurstelsels, prosedures en interne beheer om nakoming van toepaslike wetgewing, beleide en finansiële bestuursvoorskrifte te verseker. Koördineer die voorbereiding, motivering, konsolidasie en implementering van die instelling se MTEF-begroting in oorleg met hospitaalbestuur en toepaslike belanghebbendes. Moniteer begrotingsbenutting en besteding teenoor goedgekeurde toekenningar, identifiseer afwykings en beveel regstellende maatreëls aan om begrotingsdissipline te bevorder en ongemagtigde, onreëlmatige, nuttelose en dwase besteding te voorkom. Moniteer instellingskontantvloei en bestedingsverpligtinge om die tydige skikking van verpligtinge te ondersteur en die ophoping van agterstallige betalings te voorkom. Berei akkurate en tydige finansiële verslae voor, analiseer en konsolideer dit vir indiening aan die Hoofuitvoerende Beampte, hospitaalbestuur en die toepaslike departementele strukture. Verskaf finansiële bestuursadvies en ondersteuning aan die Hoofuitvoerende Beampte en bestuur oor begrotingsprestasie, bestedingsneigings, finansiële risiko's en hulpbrontoewysing. Moniteer die effektiewe bestuur en benutting van die National Tertiary Services Grant (NTSG), en verseker belyning met goedgekeurde toekenningar, toepaslike toekeningstoestande en tersiêre diensleweringprioriteite. Koördineer die implementering van inkomsteverbeteringsmaatreëls, insluitend inkomsteinning, reconciliëring, monitering en verslagdoening, om instellingsinkomstebestuur te verbeter. Analiseer finansiële data en bestuursverslae om neigings, kostedruk, oneffektiwiteite en geleenthede vir kostebedwing en verbeterde hulpbronbenutting te identifiseer. Moniteer nakoming van finansiële bestuursbeleide, goedgekeurde delegasies, verkrygingsprosedures en toepaslike SCM-voorskrifte, in samewerking met die verantwoordelike SCM-amptenare. Onderhou effektiewe finansiële beheer oor besteding, betalings, verpligtinge, inkomste en ander finansiële transaksies om openbare fondse te beskerm. Koördineer die voorbereiding van jaarlikse finansiële state en ander statutêre finansiële verslae, en verseker akkuraatheid, volledigheid en nakoming van toepaslike verslagdoeningsvereistes. Fasiliteer interne en eksterne ouditprosesse deur die beskikbaarheid van ondersteunende dokumentasie te verseker, op ouditnavrae te reageer en die implementering van ooreengekome regstellende maatreëls te koördineer. Moniteer finansiële risiko's en interne beheerswakpunte en verseker dat regstellende maatreëls binne goedgekeurde tydraamwerke geïmplementeer word. Onderrig, bestuur en ontwikkel personeel binne die toegewysde finansiële bestuurskomponent, insluitend prestasiebestuur, kapasiteitsbou en die bevordering van aanspreeklikheid. Hersien finansiële bestuursprosesse en beveel verbeterings aan om doeltreffendheid, nakoming, dienslewering en die effektiewe gebruik van instellingshulpbronne te versterk. Bevorder die effektiewe gebruik van BAS en ander goedgekeurde finansiële bestuursinligtingstelsels om finansiële monitering, verslagdoening en besluitneming te verbeter. Verskaf tegniese leiding aan bestuurders en kostesentrumhouers oor begrotingsbestuur, bestedingsbeheer, finansiële verslagdoening en nakoming van toepaslike finansiële prosedures. Onderhou effektiewe werksverhoudings met hospitaalbestuur, departementele finansiële bestuursstrukture, SCM-amptenare, ouditeure en ander belanghebbendes om goeie finansiële bestuursreël te ondersteun. Onderneem enige ander pligte wat deur die Hoofuitvoerende Beampte of die toepaslike toesighouer gedelegeer word, in ooreenstemming met die verantwoordelikhede van die pos en toepaslike delegasies.

zu.title: Onozimele: Ukuphathwa Kwezimali
zu.summary: Onozimele wokuPhathwa Kwezimali e-Grey's Hospital e-KwaZulu-Natal, onembelekile kwimithetho yezimali, izilawulo zangaphakathi kanye nokuqondanisa izabelo zemali.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 / Isitifiketi Samabanga Aphakeme. I-Degree yesidanga esiphakeme noma i-Advanced Diploma (NQF Level 7) ku-Accounting, i-Cost and Management Accounting, ukuphathwa kwezimali, u-Nzimasimboni Weshishino noma izifundo ezilinganayo ezifanele. Ukuze ube namandla okusebenza emabangeni aphezulu okuphatha imisebenzi ye-3-5 emnyangweni wezimali. OKUQAPHELWAYO (Kuphela abantu abezwe ngempumelelo kuzocelwa ukuba bahlawule izitifiketi zabo nezinye izitifiketi ezisekelayo nokuze kwenzeke okuhlolwayo okwemisebenzi okuhlolwa yi-NKomishani Yezinsiza Zabantu). Kuzodingeka abantu ababe seluhlwini lokuzwe ngempumelelo ukuba benze ukuhlolwa ngobuchwepheshe ukuze kubonakale ukuthi bayakwazi, benawe futhi banamandla okusebenza ngokwezidingo zesikhundla. Ulwazi, Amakhono Nomzamo Odingekayo: Lowo ozoqashwa uzobe ebika ku-Principal Officer futhi azobe nenkosi yokuphatha futhi aqaphe imisebenzi eyahlukene yesikhungo sokuphathwa kwezimali, kanye noMnyango Wezimali Ofanayo (SCM) ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa kwezimali okuhle, ukulawula amabhajethi, ukubika okuhlakaniphile kwezimali, nokuhambisana nomthetho ohambisanayo, kanye nenhlanganisela yangaphakathi. Lowo oqashiwe uzosekela i-Principal Officer futhi aqonde abaphathi besibhedlela ekutheni basebenzise izimali zikahulumumi ngokusebenza okuhle, ngokushesha, ngokwezimali okuncane, kanye nokusebenza okucacile ukugcina ukunakekelwa kwemikhuba esebenza kahle kwabeziguli. Othandekayo kufanele abonise ulwazi, amakhono namandla okwenza okulandelayo: Ulwazi oluhle kanye noqondisiso lomthetho we-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), izimiso zentengo, izixhumanisi zemali kanye nezinye izimiso ezihlukene zomnyango. Ulwazi ngomthetho ohambisanayo wezimali, izinqumo zomnyango, iziqondiso, izinkomba zemisebenzi, izinqumo zezimali kanye nezidingo zokuqondisa okungalawuleki. Ulwazi lokuqonda ukulungiselela amabhajethi, ukusebenzisa, ukuqapha kanye nokulawula okuhlanganisayo okufaka i-Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) kanye ne-Basic Accounting System (BAS). Ulwazi lokuphatha imali yokusebenza, ukuhlela imali eguqukayo, ukuphatha imali engenayo, ukubala kwezimali nokubika. Ulwazi lwe-Supply Chain Management policies, izinqumo zokuqasha nezinye izibopho zokuphathwa kwezimali ezingamthetho. Ukuqonda imithetho yokuphatha imali, ukuhola abaphathi-basebenzi, izinhlelo zokuqapha kanye nokusebenzisa izinqumo zokusiza ukulungisa. Amakhono okuhlaziya kanye nokubona izincazelo zezimali, ukubona ukuthi ithini imali kanye nezinye izincazelo, bese encoma izindlela zokusiza ukulungisa. Amakhono okwenza, ukusebenzisa, ukuqapha izinqumo zokuphathwa kwezimali, izinhlelo zokuqhuba kanye nezilawulo. Amakhono ahle ewonke okuhlela, ukuqonda, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuthatha izinqumo, nokwazi ukubhukuda. Amakhono okubhala nokukhuluma kahle ohlelo lwesiZulu, ahlanganisa nokwazi ukulungiselela imibiko yezimali kanye nokunika abaphathi izinkomba zemali. Amandla okubonisa, okuhola abasebenzi, ukuphatha abantu kanye nokuphatha imisebenzi kahle. Amandla okuzenza nokwenza ngokwakho, okuhlangabezana nemikhawulo, ukuphatha izinkinga eziqhakamishwayo, ukwenza imisebenzi ngokucindezela okukhulu. Ulwazi lokuqonda izinhlelo zekhompyutha, kanye nokusebenzisa i-Microsoft Excel, i-Word ne-PowerPoint kanye nolwazi lokwenza imisebenzi yezimali kanye nezinhlelo zokubika ngekhompyutha. Amandla okuxhumana kahle nabaphathi, abasebenzi, abaholi, izikhulu zomnyango nezinye izindlela ezithintekayo. Ulwazi Olungeziwe / Izifundo Ezidingekayo. Ilayisensi yokuqasha ehambisanayo ne-Code B (Code 8).
