zu.duties: Qondanisa kanye nokuphatha ukusebenziswa kwezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwezimali ezihle, izinqumo kanye nezilawulo zangaphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana nomthetho ohambisanayo, izinqumo kanye nezimiso zokuphathwa kwezimali. Qondanisa ukulungiselela, ukugqugquzela, ukuhlanganisa nokusebenzisa amabhajethi e-MTEF esikhungo ngokubonisana nabaphathi besibhedlela kanye nezinye izinhlangano ezithintekayo. Qapha ukusebenziswa kwamabhajethi kanye nezingxenye ezisebenziswa ezivunyiwe, ukuze ubone izinto ezingafani futhi ukuncoma izindlela zokulungisa ukuze kuthuthukiswe isikhundla sama-bhajethi nokuthi kungabekekhi ukusebenzisa ngaphandle kwesibopho, ngaphandle kwemithetho, ukusebenzisa ngaphandle kwenzuzo kanye nokulahlekelwa. Qapha ukugeleza kwemali yesikhungo kanye nezibopho zokusebenzisa imali ukuze kusekelwe ukukhokha okusheshayo kwezibopho nokuthi kunganaki imali ethunyiwe. Lungiselela, hlaziya futhi uhlanganise imibiko yezimali eqondile nangesikhathi efanele ukuyithumela ku-Principal Officer, abaphathi besibhedlela kanye nezinye izinhlelo zomnyango ezihambisanayo. Nikela izeluleko zokuphathwa kwezimali kanye nokusekela i-Principal Officer kanye nabaphathi ngokuthi kusebenza kanjani ama-bhajethi, izindlela zokusebenzisa imali, izingozi zemali kanye nokuqondanisa izimali. Qapha ukuphathwa kwe-National Tertiary Services Grant (NTSG), kuqinisekise ukuthi kuhambisana nezabelo ezivunyiwe, izinkomba ezihlobene namaranti kanye nezinhloso zokuqashwa kwemikhuba yamabanga aphakeme. Qondanisa ukusebenziswa kwezindlela zokugqugquzela ukwenza imali, okuhlanganisa ukuqoqwa kwemali, ukubuyisana, ukuqapha nokubika, ukuthuthukisa ukuphathwa kwemali yesikhungo. Hlaziya imininingwane yezimali nemibiko yokuphatha ukuze kubonakale izinhlobo zokusebenza, ukucindezeleka kwemali, ukungalungi kokusebenza, kanye namathuba okunciphisa izindleko kanye nokusebenzisa okuthuthukisiwe kwezimali. Qapha ukuhambisana nezinqumo zokuphathwa kwezimali, izibopho ezivunyiwe, izinqumo zokuqasha kanye nezinye izimiso ze-SCM, ngokubonisana nezikhulu ezibekiwe ze-SCM. Gcina izilawulo zezimali ezihle ngaphezulu kokusebenza, izibopho, imali engenayo, kanye nezinye izimali ngokulawula imali yakahulumeni. Qondanisa ukulungiselela imibiko yezimali yonyaka kanye nezinye imibiko yezimali ephathwa ngomthetho, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iyiqiniso, iphelele futhi ihambisana nezinkomba zokubika. Qedelela izinhlelo zokuqapha zangaphakathi kanye nezesangaphakathi ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi kuyatholakala imibhalo esekelayo, uphendule imibuzo yokuqapha kanye noxhumano lokuqondanisa ukwenza izindaba ezivunyiwe zokulungisa. Qapha izingozi zemali kanye nobuthakathaka bezilawulo zangaphakathi bese eqinisekisa ukuthi izindlela zokulungisa ziyenziwa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esivunyiwe. Qapha, phatha futhi uthuthukise abasebenzi ngaphakathi kwesigaba esinikeziwe sokuphathwa kwezimali, okuhlanganisa ukuphatha imisebenzi, ukwakha amandla kanye nokugqugquzela ukubekezeleleka. Hlaziya izinqumo zokuphathwa kwezimali futhi uncome ukuthuthukiswa okuzosiza ukuze kugcine ukusebenza okuhle, ukuhambisana, ukwenza imisebenzi nokusebenzisa izimali zesikhungo ngokusebenza okuhle. Gqugquzela ukusebenzisa i-BAS kanye nezinye izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwezimali ezivunyiwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuqapha, ukubika kanye nokuthatha izinqumo. Nikeza izeluleko ngamakhono abaphathi kanye nabaphathi bekhompyutha ngokuphathwa kwamabhajethi, ukulawula ukusebenzisa imali, ukubika ngezimali nokuhambisana nezinqumo zezimali. Gcina ubuhlobo obuhle bokusebenza nabaphathi besibhedlela, izinhlelo zomnyango zokuphathwa kwezimali, izikhulu ze-SCM, abaholi, kanye nezinye izinhlangano ukuze kusekelwe ukuphathwa kwezimali okuhle. Yenza namanye amanye imisebenzi enikiwe ngu-Principal Officer noma umqondisi ohambisanayo, ehambisana nezibopho zesikhundla nezinye izibopho ezihambisanayo.

xh.title: Isekeli likaMongameli: uQulo lweMali
xh.summary: Isekeli likaMongameli woQulo lweMali eGrey's Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, oqheliswe ngokulawula iinkqubo zemali, ulawulo langaphakathi nokuqhubekekisa nokubeka ngokulinganiselwa imali.
xh.requirements: Ireyithi 12 / Isatifikit'i Esenior. I-Degree yaze yafika kweziqu ezingcono okanye i-Advanced Diploma (NQF Level 7) kwi-Accounting, i-Cost and Management Accounting, uQulo lweMali, uQulo lweShishini okanye isiphakamiso esihambelana nako. 3-5 iminyaka yamava aphakathi kulawulo kuQulo lweMali. NB (Kuphela abaqeqeshi ababekiweyo kusayifuneka ukuba bazinike iibhankisi zokuqinisekisa iziqu neminye imibhalo exhasayo nokuqinisekisa iNkonzo evunyiwe ngabasebenzi boQulo lweBantu). Abaqeqeshi ababekiweyo kusayifuneka ukuba bagqibe uvavayo loqobo ukuvavanya ulwazi, amakhono namakhono ahambelana neemfuno zesithuba. Ulwazi, amakhono namava: Umntu oza kubakhona kuya kuxela kuMongameli oyiNtloko kwaye uya kuba nogqibezelo lokulawula nokuqapha imisebenzi yolawulo lwemali ne-SCM kwisikhululo ukuze kuqinisekelwe ulawulo lwemali olulungileyo, ulawulo lwevuli lemali elisebenzayo, iinkcukacha zemali ezichanekileyo nokuthobela koMthetho ofanelekileyo, neenkqubo zesebe. Umntu oza kubakhona uya kuxhasa uMongameli oyiNtloko nolawulo lwesibhedlele ekukhuthazeni ukusetyenziswa ngokusebenzayo, ngokuchanekileyo, ngokwengeniso nangokucacileyo kwemithombo yoluntu ukuze kugcinwe ukhatho oluhle lomguli. Umqeshi oqeqeshileyo kufuneka abonise ulwazi, amakhono namakhono alandelayo: Ulwazi olunyinyweni nokuqonda iMthetho woQulo lweMali kaWoLuntu (PFMA), iZimvo zoQyathelo, iNkqubo yoQyathelo neminye imiyalelo yolawulo lwemali kwicala likawonke-wonke. Ulwazi ngomthetho wezimali ofanelekileyo, iinkqubo zesebe, iimiyalelo, iinkcukacha zoqeqesho, iinkqubo zokubala izinto nemfuneko yolawulo langaphakathi. Ulwazi olunzulu lokulungiselela ivuli lemali, ukuqaliswa, ukuqapha nolawulo, kuquka iNkqubo yeMali eNtlanganisela yexesha eliphakathi (MTEF) neNkqubo yoQula iZinto (BAS). Ulwazi lolawulo loqashulo lemali, ucwangciso lwesantya semali, ulawulo lwengeniso, uqulo lwemali ngokubala nokuvelisa iinkcukacha zemali. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zoQulo lweziQhagamsheli kwicala likawonke-wonke, iinkqubo zokuqhumba nemiyalelo yemali esebenzayo. Ukuqonda ulawulo lengozi yemali, uqulo olungaphakathi, iinkqubo zovavayo nokuphunywa kweenkqubo zolungiso. Amakhono okwahlula nokuqonda iinkcukacha zemali, kuqaphwe iindlela zokuqashula nokwahluka, kunye nokucebisa iindlela ezifanelekileyo zolungiso. Amakhono okwakha, ukuqalisa nokuqapha iinkqubo zolawulo lwemali, iinkqubo nolawulo langaphakathi. Amakhono amabalawo, abumbeko, wokuqamba ngokobuchwepheshe, wokuxazulula iingxaki, okuthatha iigqibo obakha iinkcazelo. Amakhono othetha ngeshisho nangomlomo, okubandakanya ikhono lokulungiselela iinkcukacha zemali nokunika ingcebiso yemali kulawulo. Amakhono okukhokela, okulawula abantu nolawulo lomgangatho abonakalisiweyo. Ikhono lokusebenza yedwa, ukugqiba iinxesha ezimisiweyo, ukulawula iinto ezintlanu ezikrwada kwaye ukhangele ukusebenza ngokusetyenziswa ngaphantsi kwedabomfazwe. Ulwazi lwesikrini, okubandakanya ukukwazi ukusetyenziswa kweMicrosoft Excel, Word nam PowerPoint, namava kwiinkqubo ze-khompyutha zolawulo lwemali neenkcazelo. Ikhono lokuzonxibelelana ngokusebenzayo nalawulo, abasebenzi, abavavanyi, abasebenzi basebelemali nabanye abantu abahlobene. Iinkcukacha eziNgezelekileyo/Isiqu esifunekayo. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba ye-Code B (Code 8) esemthethweni. xh.duties: Qhubekekisa nokuqwalasela ukuphunywa kweenkqubo zolawulo lwemali ezilungileyo, iinkqubo nolawulo langaphakathi ukuze kuqinisekelwe ukuthobela koMthetho ofanelekileyo, iinkqubo nemiyalelo yolawulo lwemali. Qhubekekisa ukulungiselela, ukuxhasa, ukuqhina nokuphunywa kwe-MTEF yesikhululo ngengxoxo nolawulo lwesibhedlele nabanye abantu abahlobene. Qapha ukusetyenziswa kwemali nokugqithiswa kwemali ngokumiselwa kwemigca, kuqaphwe iindlela ezahlukileyo kuqatshulwe izinto ezilungiswayo zokuqhubela imisitha yemali nokuthintela ukugqithiswa kwemali okungenagunyaziweyo, okungachanekileyo, okungalunga nokuqhitha. Qapha isantya semali kwingeniso yemali yesikhululo nokuqinisekisa ukuzithabisa ukuze kuxhaswe ukuvalelwa kwexesha elifanelekileyo nokuqhitha amaxabiso ayizigqibo kwaye kuthintelwe ukuqokelelwa koshishino oqhuba ixesha elide. Lungiselela, hlalahlula ukuze uqhine iinkcukacha zemali ezichanekileyo nangexesha elifanelekileyo zokuze zithunyelwe kuMongameli oyiNtloko, kulawulo lwesibhedlele nakuqoqosho olunegunya kwesebe. Nikela ingcebiso ngenkxaso yolawulo lwemali kuMongameli oyiNtloko nalawulo ngokwenza ivuli lemali, iindlela zokuqashula, iingozi zemali nokunikwa kwemithombo. Qapha ulawulo olusebenzayo nokusetyenziswa kweNkwenkwebzeli yeZiko leNkonzo eziGqibeleleyo (NTSG), kuqinisekelise ukuhambelana nokunikwa okuvunyiweyo, iimeko zenkwenkwebzeli ezisebenzayo nokuqatshulwa izigqibo zentengiso. Qhubekekisa ukuphunywa kweendlela zokwandiswa kwengeniso, okubandakanya ukuqokelela ingeniso, ukuqothana, ukuqapha nokubika ngayo, ukuze konyuswe ulawulo lwengeniso yesikhululo. Hlalahlula iinkcukacha zemali neenkcazelo zolawulo ukuze kuqatshulwe iindlela, iingxaki zemali, ukungasebenzi kwezinto namathuba okulinganiselwa ixabiso nokusetyenziswa ngokusebenzayo kwemithombo. Qapha ukuthobela iinkqubo zolawulo lwemali, imiyalelo evunyiweyo, iinkqubo zokuqhumba nemiyalelo ye-SCM ofanelekileyo, ngokusebenzisana nabasebenzi abaqwalaselwa ngokuqwalasela i-SCM. Gcina ulawulo lwemali olusebenzayo ngaphezulu kokuqhithwa kwemali, ngeembekisi, ingenis kwemali engeyonganyelwa ngezinye iinkqubo zokubuyisana nemali ukuze kuvakalwe imithombo yoluntu. Qhubekekisa ukulungiselela iinkcukacha zemali zeminyaka yonke neminye iinkcukacha zemali zomthetho, kuqinisekelise ukuchanekileyo, ukuphelela nokuthobela iinkcukacha ezifanelekileyo zokubika. Yenza iinkqubo zovavayo ngaphakathi nangaphandle ukuze kuqinisekelwe ukuba khona kwemibhalo exhasayo, kuphendulwe iimbuzo zovavayo kuqhubekekiswe nokuphunywa kweenkqubo zolungiso ezivunyiweyo. Qapha iingozi zemali nongagqibekanga kolawulo langaphakathi uze uqinisekise ukuba iindlela ezilungisayo ziyaphunywa kwizixa ezivunyiweyo. Lawula, qwalasela uphuhlise abasebenzi ngaphakathi kwengxenye yolawulo lwemali enikiweyo, okubandakanya ulawulo lomgangatho, ukwakhiswa kwamakhono nokuqhubekekisa nokuqhubekeka kokuziphendulela. Phinda ubuke iinkqubo zolawulo lwemali uze ucelele ukuphuculwa ukuze kuqinisekelwe ukusebenza ngokusebenzayo, ukuthobela, ukulethwa kwentengiso nokusetyenziswa ngokusebenzayo kwemithobo yesikhululo. Khuthaza ukusetyenziswa ngokusebenzayo kwe-BAS neminye inkqubo yolawulo lwemali evunyiweyo ukonyuswa ukuqapha, ukubika nokuqumba iigqibo. Nikezela ingcebiso ngamakhono oqobo abaqambi bezixa nabanikabelo bemibutho yezixa ngolawulo lwemali, ukulawula ukugqithiswa kwemali, ukuvelisa iinkcukacha zemali nokuthobela iinkqubo zemali ezisebenzayo. Gcina ubudlelwane obusebenzayo nolawulo lwesibhedlele, ngeqoqosho lolawulo lwemali lesebe, abasebenzi be-SCM, abavavanyi nabanye abantu abahlobene ukuze kuxhaswe ulawulo lwemali olulungileyo. Yenza nanjani omnye umsebenzi onikiwe nguMongameli oyiNtloko okanye oqwalasela ofanelekileyo, ohambelana neemfuno zesithuba nemiyalelo esebenzayo.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager Nursing - Theatre
jobs.centre: Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital
jobs.city: Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital
jobs.salary_text: R785 568 – R898 215 per annum. Other Benefits: 13th Cheques, Medical Aid (Optional), Housing Allowance: Employee must meet prescribed requirements.
jobs.summary: Assistant Manager Nursing in Theatre at Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital, requiring SANC registration and a post-basic Operating Theatre qualification.
jobs.requirements: Matric / Grade 12, Basic R425 qualification with midwifery accredited by SANC (i.e. diploma/ degree in nursing) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council. Post Basic Nursing Qualification with a duration of 1 year accredited with the South African Nursing Council in Operating Theatre is compulsory. Registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse and proof of current registration. A minimum 10 years recognizable experience in General Nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with South African Nursing Council. At least 6 years of a period referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable experience in Operating Theatre after obtaining a 1- year Post Basic Qualification accredited with South African Nursing Council. 3 years of the period referred to the above must be appropriate/recognizable experience at Management Level. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competence Required: In-depth knowledge of nursing care processes Knowledge of nursing statutes and other relevant legal frameworks including the Nursing Act, National Health Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Patients’ Right Charter, Batho Pele Principles, Public Service Regulations, Disciplinary codes and Grievance Procedures. Sound knowledge of perioperative nursing care, operating theatre policies, infection prevention and control, clinical governance, quality assurance and patient safety standards. Ability to function well with a team. Leadership, organisational, decision-making and problem solving skills. Knowledge of surgical safety, aseptic techniques, sterilisation and prevention of surgical site infections. Financial, human resource and material resource management skills, Ability to coordinate, supervise and monitor nursing services within Theatre Complex.
jobs.duties: Ensure effective commutation and smooth running within the unit. Ensure overall management and necessary support for effective functioning of the unit. Develop policies and protocols for the unit. Coordination of optimal and holistic specialized nursing care provided within the set standards and professional/legal framework. Ensure effective management of quality nursing service. Ability and knowledge to carry out theatre nursing procedures. Ensure optimal utilization of Nursing Personnel in the unit. Manage PMDS of subordinates. Work as part of a multi-disciplinary team in the unit. Monitor checks and processes in the care of instruments in theatre. Develop SOP’S and Protocols for the unit. Mentoring of Operational Manager and Shift leaders in theatre. Supervision and control of all material resources and manage cost. Strict control of equipment and budget of department. Maintain clinical competence by ensuring that scientific principles of nursing are implemented. Participate in quality assurance, clinical audits, risk management and implementation of quality improvement initiatives. Participate in SCM and financial management processes as determined by PFMA. Maintain sound relations with all stakeholders and team within the department. Able to manage own work, time and that of junior colleagues. Demonstrate a basic understanding of HR and financial policies and practices. Manage staff performance, development, discipline, grievances and continuous professional development. Management of complaints. Ensure compliance with OHSC, Ideal Hospital Realisation Framework, infection prevention and control, clinical governance an patient safety standards. Ensure effective data management

af.title: Assistentbestuurder Verpleegkunde - Teater
af.summary: Assistentbestuurder Verpleegkunde in Teater by Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital, wat SANC-registrasie en 'n na-grondse Operasieteater-kwalifikasie vereis.
af.requirements: Matric / Graad 12, Basiese R425-kwalifikasie met vroedvroukunde geakkrediteer deur SANC (d.w.s. diploma/ graad in verpleegkunde) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council toelaat. 'n Na-grondse Verpleegkunde-kwalifikasie met 'n duur van 1 jaar geakkrediteer by die South African Nursing Council in Operasieteater is verpligtend. Registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige en bewys van huidige registrasie. 'n Minimum van 10 jaar herkenbare ervaring in Algemene Verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die South African Nursing Council. Ten minste 6 jaar van die bogenoemde tydperk moet toepaslike/herkenbare ervaring in Operasieteater wees na die verkryging van 'n 1-jaar Na-grondse Kwalifikasie geakkrediteer by die South African Nursing Council. 3 jaar van die bogenoemde tydperk moet toepaslike/herkenbare ervaring op Bestuursvlak wees. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdheid Vereis: Diepgaande kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse; Kennis van verpleegstatutes en ander relevante regsraamwerke insluitend die Nursing Act, National Health Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Patients' Right Charter, Batho Pele Principles, Public Service Regulations, Disiplinêre kodes en Grievance Procedures; Deeglike kennis van peri-operatiewe verpleegsorg, operasieteaterbeleid, infeksievoorkoming en -beheer, kliniese bestuur, gehalteversekering en pasiëntveiligheidsstandaarde; Vermoë om goed in 'n span te funksioneer; Leierskap, organisatoriese, besluitnemings- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede; Kennis van chirurgiese veiligheid, aspeptiese tegnieke, sterilisasie en voorkoming van chirurgiese terreininfeksies; Finansiële, menslike hulpbron- en materiaalhulpbronbestuursvaardighede; Vermoë om verpleegdienste binne die Teaterkompleks te koördineer, toesig te hou en te monitor.
af.duties: Verseker effektiewe kommunikasie en gladde werking binne die eenheid; Verseker algehele bestuur en nodige ondersteuning vir effektiewe funksionering van die eenheid; Ontwikkel beleide en protokolle vir die eenheid; Koördinering van optimale en holistiese gespesialiseerde verpleegsorg verskaf binne die gestelde standaarde en professionele/regsraamwerk; Verseker effektiewe bestuur van gehalte-verpleegdiens; Vermoë en kennis om teaterverpleegprosedures uit te voer; Verseker optimale benutting van Verpleegpersoneel in die eenheid; Bestuur PMDS van ondergeskiktes; Werk as deel van 'n multi-dissiplinêre span in die eenheid; Monitor kontroles en prosesse in die sorg van instrumente in die teater; Ontwikkel SOP'S en Protokolle vir die eenheid; Mentoring van Operasionele Bestuurder en Skif-leiers in die teater; Toesig en beheer oor alle materiaalhulpbronne en bestuur van koste; Streng beheer van toerusting en begroting van die departement; Handhaaf kliniese bevoegdheid deur te verseker dat wetenskaplike beginsels van verpleegkunde geïmplementeer word; Neem deel aan gehalteversekering, kliniese oudite, risikobestuur en implementering van gehalteverbeteringsinisiatiewe; Neem deel aan SCM en finansiële bestuursprosesse soos bepaal deur PFMA; Handhaaf goeie verhoudings met alle belanghebbendes en die span binne die departement; In staat om eie werk, tyd en dié van junior kollegas te bestuur; Demonstreer 'n basiese begrip van HR- en finansiële beleide en praktyke; Bestuur werknemersprestasie, -ontwikkeling, -dissipline, -griewe en deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling; Bestuur van klagtes; Verseker nakoming van OHSC, Ideal Hospital Realisation Framework, infeksievoorkoming en -beheer, kliniese bestuur en pasiëntveiligheidsstandaarde; Verseker effektiewe databestuur.

zu.title: Ongezayo Mphathi Wokuhlenga - I-Theatre
zu.summary: Ongezayo Mphathi Wokuhlenga ku-Theatre e-Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital, okudinga ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC nesifundo se-post-basic se-Operating Theatre.
zu.requirements: Matric / Grade 12, Basic R425 qualification with midwifery accredited by SANC (i.e. diploma/ degree in nursing) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council. Post Basic Nursing Qualification with a duration of 1 year accredited with the South African Nursing Council in Operating Theatre is compulsory. Registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse and proof of current registration. A minimum 10 years recognizable experience in General Nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with South African Nursing Council. At least 6 years of a period referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable experience in Operating Theatre after obtaining a 1- year Post Basic Qualification accredited with South African Nursing Council. 3 years of the period referred to the above must be appropriate/recognizable experience at Management Level. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competence Required: In-depth knowledge of nursing care processes Knowledge of nursing statutes and other relevant legal frameworks including the Nursing Act, National Health Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Patients' Right Charter, Batho Pele Principles, Public Service Regulations, Disciplinary codes and Grievance Procedures. Sound knowledge of perioperative nursing care, operating theatre policies, infection prevention and control, clinical governance, quality assurance and patient safety standards. Ability to function well with a team. Leadership, organisational, decision-making and problem solving skills. Knowledge of surgical safety, aseptic techniques, sterilisation and prevention of surgical site infections. Financial, human resource and material resource management skills, Ability to coordinate, supervise and monitor nursing services within Theatre Complex.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuthuthukisana kwezokuxhumana kanye nokuqhubekeka kahle ngaphakathi kwaleyunithi. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okubonakalayo kanye nokwesekwa okudingekayo ukuba leyunithi isebenze kahle. Hlela izinqubomgomo kanye namaphrotokholi aleyunithi. Ukulungiselela ukunakekelwa kwabesifazane okukhethekile okulinganiselayo nokuqondile okunikezwa ngaphakathi kwemigidingo ebesekelwe nangaphakathi kohlaka olusemthethweni/olobungcweti. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kwenkonzo yokunakekelwa kwesithembiso esikhulu. Ikhono nolwazi lokwenza izinqubo zokunakekelwa kwabesifazane kwi-theatre. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okulinganiselayo kwabasebenzi beNesayensi kahle isikhathi esithile. Phatha i-PMDS yabaphansi. Sebenza njengengxenye yetimu ebanzi emikhakheni eminingi kuleyunithi. Hlola ukugcwaliseka kwezinto nokuphathwa kwamathuluzi kukhotheatre. Hlela i-SOP'S namaphrotokholi aleyunithi. Ukulungisa abaphathi besebenzayo kanye nabahola ithuba ku-theatre. Ukulawula nokulawula yonke imithombo yezinto kanye nokulawula izindleko. Lawula ngokuqinile izisetshenziswa kanye nesabelo somnyango. Gcina ukufaneleka ngokwezokwelapha ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi izimiso zesayensi zokuhlengwa kusetshenziswa. Thatha inxaxheba ekulungiseni izinga, ukuhlola izinto ezingozayo, ukuphathwa kwezingozi kanye nokuphatha izinhlobo zokuthuthukisa izinga. Thatha inxaxheba kwi-SCM kanye nokuqondisa izinqubo kuka-PFMA. Gcina ubuhlobo obuhle nabantu abahlukene kanye nethimu ngaphakathi komnyango. Ukuba nakho ukuphatha umsebenzi wakho, isikhathi kanye nasabanye abasebenzi ngesikhathi esingaphantsi kwakho. Khombisa ukuqonda okuyisisekelo kwezinqubo kanye namapholisi we-HR kwezimali. Phatha ukusebenza kwabasebenzi, ukuthuthukiswa, inhlawulo, izinkinga kanye nentuthuko ephila phakathi kwesikhathi. Ukuphathwa kwezinkinga. Qinisekisa ukuthobela umthetho kwezinhlangano ezingaphansi kwe-OHSC, ohlelweni lwe-Ideal Hospital Realisation, ukuvikelwa kokuqhubekayo nolawula ukutheleleka, ukuqondiswa kwemisebenzi kanye namazinga okuphepha kwesifundo. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa kokuqondiswa kwemininingwane

xh.title: Umphathi oMncinci weCandelo lokuhlalwa kweGazi - iTiyetha
xh.summary: Umphathi oMncinci weCandelo lokuhlalwa kweGazi eTiyetha kwisibhedlele iDr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital, lifuna ukubhalisa kwiSANC nenqanaba lefundiswa elingentemi kwicandelo lokuhlalwa kwegazi elithi Theatre.
xh.requirements: IMatric / IGrade 12, ifundo yeR425 esisiseko enemalunga nababelethi evunyiwe yiSANC (okt. idiploma/ izidanga kwinzululwazi yokunyanga) evumela ukubhalisa kwiBhunga leZemizimu yaseMzantsi Afrika. Ifundo yeNesi yaseKumva lokuqala ngomgaqo wonyaka we1 evunyiwe yiBhunga leZemizimu yaseMzantsi Afrika kwicandelo lokuhlalwa kwegazi ithi Theatre ziyayiphela. Ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengeNesi yeNqanaba eliphezulu nomboniso wokubhalisa kwangoku. Iminyaka eli-10 evela kumava amkelwayo kwiNzulu-lwazi yoNyango jikelele emva kokubhalisa njengeNesi yeNqanaba eliphezulu kwiBhunga leZemizimu yaseMzantsi Afrika. Okungenani iminyaka eli-6 kwexesha elithi ngasentla kufuneka kube ngumava amkelwayo/ofanelekileyo kwicandelo lokuhlalwa kwegazi elithi Theatre emva kokuze kufunyanwe isidanga seNqanaba eliNgangamva kwelinye inyaka eli1 elifunwe kwiBhunga leZemizimu yaseMzantsi Afrika. Iminyaka eli-3 yexesha elithi ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngumava amkelwayo/ofanelekileyo kwelinye inqanaba leBaphathi. Ulwazi, Amandla, uQeqesho namakhono afunekayo: Ukuqonda ngokujulileyo iinkqubo zonkcuncoba lwezempilo; Ulwazi ngemithetho yezinési nemithetho ngqo ngokomthetho ehambelana nayo, kuquka uMthetho weZesi, uMthetho weZempilo yeSizwe, uMthetho woKhuseleko lweMisebenzi nokuKhuseleka, IBhile yamaLungelo aboGulayo, iMigaqo yeBatho Pele, iMigaqo yokuQhutywa kweenkonzo eziZizwe, iikhowudi zokuGxeka iindlela neNkqubo yeziNxaxheba; Ulwazi oluqinileyo ngokunyanga kwangaphambi, nangaphakathi kwesigqitho sokwenza izibetela, iinkqubo zomthetho-nkqubo zecandelo, ithiyori yokuThintela ukutheleleka nokuLawulwa kwaso, ulawulo lwezenzo ezibonelela ngokwemigaqo, isiqiniseko sokwemigaqo yekhwalithi nemicimbi yokugcina abagulayo kakhuselekile; Amandla okusebenza kakuhle qela; Amakhono okuba ngumongameli, yophando, wokuthatha izigqibo nokuxazula iingxaki; Ulwazi ngokhuseleko ekwenzeni iindawo zokuhlalwa, iindlela zokucoceka ngaphandle kwamagciwane, ukuhlanzwa nokuthintela ukutheleleka kwindawo esesigqithweni; Amakhono oLawulo lweMali, oLawulo lweMithetho yamalungu ombuso nemithetho yamathuba; Amandla okulungelelanisa, okuLawula nokujonga iinkonzo zonkcuncoba lwezempilo ngaphakathi kweNkundla ye Tiyetha.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ungeno-mthetho nokusebenza ngokuthula ngaphakathi kwesebe. Qinisekisa ulawulo jikelele ninoxaso olufunekayo ukwenzisebenza okusebenzayo kwesebe. Yila imigaqo-nkqubo neenkqubo zocwangco lwesebe. Ulungelelanisa okukhethwa ngokupheleleyo kwezibonelelo zokunyanga ezikhuselwe ngaphakathi kwemilinganiselo ezekiweyo nesiseko somthetho ngqo. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo lwezibonelelo zekhwalithi yokunyanga. Amandla nolwazi lokwenza iinkqubo zokunyanga kwisibethela. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kwesiBini seZemizimu kwindalo epheleleyo kwesebe. Lawula iPMDS abantu abangaphantsi kwakho. Sebenza njengenxalenye yeQela leentsapho ezininzi kwesebe. Yenza ulolwevuyo kwaye uluqonde iinkqubo ekunyenyngeniseni izixhobo kwisibethela. Yila iSOPs neNkqubo zocwangco kwesebe. Qeqesha abaphathi basebenzayo nabaphathi beshedi ngokutshintshwa kwamagatya kwesibethela. Ulawulo nolawulo lwemithetho yamathuba yonke kulawulo lweendleko. Ulawulo oluinileyo lezixhobo neyajezo yamathuba esebe. Gcina amandla obuchwepheshe bokunyanga ngokubhala iinkqubo zesayensi ngokusebenzisa imithetho yonkcuncoba yezempilo. Thatha inxaxheba kwisiqiniseko sokwemigaqo, ukuqwalasela iinkqubo zemigangatho yolawulo, uLawulo loMngcipheko nokusetyenziswa kolungiselelo lwezona nkqubo zilungileyo. Thatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zokuLawulwa kwemithetho yeMali nakulawulo lweMali ngokumiselwa uMthetho wePFMA. Gcina ubudlelwane obukhulu nabo bonke abanomdla nabanxaxhebe basebenzayo kwesebe. Makwazi ukulawula umsebenzi wakhe, ixesha nelale abasebenzi abancinane kuye. Bonisa ukuqonda okusemthethweni weenkonzo ngokubanzi nemigaqo yemali. Lawula inkqubo yabasebenzi, ukukhula kwabo, isithunywa-nxaxheba senkcitho, iingxaki zokuqaliwe nokukhula ngokunesondo ngonqamlezelo. Ulawulo lwezinto ezingamkelekanga. Qinisekisa ukuthobela umthetho kaOHSC, uLungelelwaniso lokuZinika iCandelo loPhumo olusemzantsi, ukuthintela nokulawula ukutheleleka, ulawulo lwezobugqirha kubugqirha ngokunyanga nokukhuseleka komntu ogulayo nangendlela efunwa kumacandelo ojinjwe ngokwemigaqo efanelekileyo. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo lweeseti zomthombo. Qinisekisa ulawulo lweseti yolwazi olubalulekileyo.

Manage and provide therapeutic environment for staff, patients and the public accessing health care services at Grey’s hospital Demonstrate effective communication to patients, families, multidisciplinary team members and other stake holders within the hospital Ensure that high quality nursing care is rendered to all clients accessing maternal and child health services at Grey’s Hospital, taking into consideration safety risks assessments and patient safety incidents prevention and reporting. jobs.notes: Directions to Candidates: Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the new Z83 form and a detailed curriculum vitae only. Phatha, uhlanganise bese ucubungula ukubonelela ngesiqeqesho kanye nocwaningo ngokusetshenziswa, ngobukhulu kwemihibahiba eholela ekuthuthukisweni kukakhunjulwana kwezokunakekela umama nezingane. Phatha futhi ufake isibindi, ubungcweti kanye nesiya sokusebenza phakathi kwabasebenzi. xh.duties: Nceda ukucwangcisa/uKuhlela nokuhlophisa iinjongo zeNqanaba le-Obstetrics neGynaecology. Lawula kwaye unikeze isixhobo esinomonde sabasebenzi, abaguli noluntu olutshaya iinkonzo zoKhathalelo eSibhedlele i-Grey’s Bonisa inxibelelwano elisebenzayo kubaguli, osapho, amalungu eqela elisebenza ngokwezifundo ngokwahlukileyo kwaye abanye abathathi nxaxheba ngaphakathi kwesibhedlele Qinisekisa ukuba kukhathalelo lweziguli olumgangatho ophezulu olunikwe bonke abathathi nxaxheba kwiinkonzo zoKhathalelo loMama neNwana eSibhedlele i-Grey’s Hospital, ukuqwalasela ukuhlolwa kweengozi ezinokubakho kwindalo yomntu kunye nokuthintela nokubika iingozi ezithinta ukhuseleko lwesiguli. Lawula ukusetyenziswa nokuQonda konke okusemva, uqwalasele iindlela zokulinganisa ixabiso. Lawula, co-ordinate ukuze uCwangcise ukunikwa kokuQeqesha ngokuchanileyo, uphondo kuNgeniso oluqheliswayo, ukugxila kwimigaqo ejoliswe ekuphuculweni koKhathalelo lukaMama neNwana. Gcina indawo yonke enomsela wobudlelwane ngamalungu eqela elisebenza ngokwezifundo ngokwahlukileyo. Nikeza inkxaso ngokuchanileyo kwiNkonzo zoKhathalelo lweSiguli njengokuncedisa imisebenzi yokwenza okunye iNkonzo yoLawulo lwasekhaya.

jobs.reference_number: GS 12/26 Component: Nursing Department- Paediatric Unit
jobs.title: Operational Manager Nursing (SPECIALTY)- Child Nursing
jobs.salary_text: R720 819 per annum. Plus 13th cheque, medical aid (optional), Homeowners allowance (employees must meet the prescribed requirements
jobs.summary: Operational Manager Nursing specialising in Child Nursing at Grey's Hospital, KwaZulu-Natal, requiring SANC registration and extensive paediatric nursing experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 Certificate Degree/Diploma in General Nursing that allows registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse. 1 Year Post–basic Nursing qualification Child Nursing Science. Current registration with the South African Nursing Council (2026 SANC receipt). A minimum of 9 years appropriate experience in Nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing of which 5 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable experience after obtaining the one year post basic qualification in Child Nursing Science. OR A minimum of fourteen (14) years appropriate/recognizable experience after registration as a Professional Nurse with the South African Nursing Council in General Nursing of which ten (10) years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable experience after obtaining the one year post basic qualification in Child Nursing Science. NB (Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit proof of all documents and certificate of Service endorsed by Human Resources) Knowledge, Skills, Training And Competencies Required: Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes, and other relevant legal frameworks such as: Nursing act, Occupational health and safety act, Patients’ rights charter, Bathe Pele principles, Public service regulations, Labor relations act, Disciplinary codes and procedures, Grievance procedure, Financial and budgetary knowledge pertaining to the relevant resources under management Insight into procedures and policies pertaining to nursing care. Leadership, organizational, decision making and problem-solving abilities within the limit of the public sector and institutional policy framework Interpersonal skills including public relations, negotiating, conflict handling and counselling skills. Computer skills in basic programs.
jobs.duties: Assist in planning/organizing and monitoring of objectives of the Paediatric Unit. Manage and provide a therapeutic environment for staff, patients and the public accessing health care services at Grey’s Hospital Demonstrate effective communication to patients, families, multidisciplinary team members and other stakeholders within the hospital Ensure that high-quality nursing care is rendered to all clients accessing Paediatric health services at Grey’s Hospital, taking into consideration safety risk assessments and patient safety incident prevention and reporting. Manage the utilisation and supervision of all resources, taking into consideration cost containment measures. Manage, coordinate and plan the provision of effective training and research, focusing on the programs aimed at the improvement of Child care nursing. Manage and instil discipline, professionalism and work ethics among employees. Develop strategies which will ensure compliance with quality care, infection prevention and control (IPC) programs, e.g. Ideal Hospital Realisation and Maintenance (IHRM) and Norms and Standards (N&S). Maintain a constructive working environment with the multi-disciplinary team members. Provide effective support to Nursing services, e.g. assist with relief duties to nursing management.
jobs.enquiries: Mr F.S. Matibela- Nursing Manager Tel No: (033) 897 3331
jobs.applications: Applications to be forwarded to: The Human Resources Management Office, Greys Hospital Private Bag X9001, Pietermaritzburg, 3200 or Email Applications to khazimula.goba@kznhealth.gov.za or malinee.chandul@kznhealth.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : Mrs M. Chandulal
jobs.notes: Directions to Candidates: Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the new Z83 form and a detailed curriculum vitae only. Additionally: The new Application for Employment Form (Z83) is obtainable from any Government Department OR from the website – www.kznhealth.gov.za. Applicants must utilize the most recent Application for Employment Form (Form Z83) as issued by the Minister for DPSA (gazetted on 06 November 2020) in line with regulation of 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016 and failure to do so will result in disqualification. Applicants are required to complete and sign Z83,and also submit a detailed curriculum vitae (CV). All sections of the new Application for Employment Form (Z83) (except those sections that are not relevant to the applicant) must be completely, accurately and legibly filled in a manner that allows a selection committee to assess the quality of a candidate based on the information provided in the form. Applicants are required to reflect information even if the same information is provided on the detailed CV. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The Employment Equity Target for this post is: African Male, Coloured Male, African Female, Coloured Female.

af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat Graad/Diploma in Algemene Verpleging wat registrasie by SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 1 Jaar Post-basiese Verplegingskwalifikasie Kinderverplegingswetenskap. Huidige registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegingsraad (2026 SANC-kwitsensie). 'n Minimum van 9 jaar toepaslike ervaring in Verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging waarvan 5 jaar van die bovermelde periode toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring moet wees na verkryging van die een jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie in Kinderverplegingswetenskap. OF 'n Minimum van veertien (14) jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegingsraad in Algemene Verpleging waarvan tien (10) jaar van die bovermelde periode toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring moet wees na verkryging van die een jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie in Kinderverplegingswetenskap. NB (Slegs kortlys-kandidate sal vereis word om bewys van alle dokumente en 'n dienssertifikaat deur Menslike Hulpbronne gepersonaliseer, voor te lê) Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding En Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures, verpleegstatute en ander relevante regsraamwerke soos: Verpleegwet, Beroepsgesondheid- en veiligheidswet, Pasienteregtehandves, Bathe Pele-beginsels, Staatsdiensregulasies, Arbeidsverhoudingswet, Dissiplinêre kodes en prosedures, Grievansieprosedure, Finansiële en begrotingskennis rakende die relevante hulpbronne onder bestuur Insig in prosedures en beleide rakende verpleegsorg. Leierskap, organisatoriese, besluitnemings- en probleemoplossingsvermoëns binne die perke van die openbare sektor en institutionele beleidsraamwerk Interpersoonlike vaardighede insluitend openbare betrekkinge, onderhandelings-, konflikhanterings- en beradingsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardighede in basiese programme.
af.duties: Bystand verleen met beplanning/organisering en monitering van doelwitte van die Pediatriese Eenheid. Bestuur en verskaf 'n terapeutiese omgewing vir personeel, pasiënte en die publiek wat toegang tot gesondheidsorgdienste by Grey's Hospital verkry Toon effektiewe kommunikasie aan pasiënte, families, multidissiplinêre spanlede en ander belanghebbendes binne die hospitaal Verseker dat hoë kwaliteit verpleegsorg aan alle kliënte wat toegang tot pediatriese gesondheidsdienste by Grey's Hospital verkry, verleen word, met inagneming van veiligheidsrisikobevalings en pasiëntveiligheidsinsidentvoorkoming en -verslagdoening. Bestuur die benutting en toesig van alle hulpbronne, met inagneming van kostebeheermaatreëls. Bestuur, koördineer en beplan die verskaffing van effektiewe opleiding en navorsing, met fokus op programme gemik op die verbetering van kinderverpleging. Bestuur en instil dissipline, professionaliteit en werketiek onder werknemers. Ontwikkel strategieë wat nakoming van gehalteversekerde sorg, infeksievoorkoming en -beheer (IVB)-programme, bv. Ideal Hospital Realisation and Maintenance (IHRM) en Norms and Standards (N&S), sal verseker. Handhaaf 'n konstruktiewe werkomgewing met die multidissiplinêre spanlede. Verskaf effektiewe ondersteuning aan Verpleegdienste, bv. bystand met verpligtingspligte van verpleegbestuur.

zu.title: Umlawuli Wokusebenza Wezokunakekelwa Esibhedlela (SPECIALTY) - UkuNakekelwa Kwezingane
zu.summary: Umlawuli we-Operational Manager Nursing ogxile kokuNakekelwa kwezingane eGrey's Hospital, eKwaZulu-Natal, ofuna ukuqoshwa kwi-SANC nokuba namava amakhulu ekunakelelweni kwezingane ezisesibhedlela.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12, idigri/diploma eNesibhedlela elivumela ukuqoshwa ne-SANC njengogadadi othile. Isikhathi esingu-1 Year sabafundi abaphakeme isikhathi sabafundi abaqotho (Post-basic) ngokusayensi yezesibhedlela bakhokhiswe khona eNingizimu Afrika kwi-2026 SANC. Ubudala obungu-9 emva kwesikhathi sokuba kuyo isitifikedi sobudala be-Professional Nurse kuzogcotshiwa eNingizimu Afrika njengoba kukhankaswe yi-SANC nangemvumelwano ngabesibhedlela njengoba kukhombisa izithombe ezingu-1 Post-basic. Usuku olu-1 lokuqala ngenkathi noma ngaphambi kwalo nalolu-1 lokuqala lapha eNingizimu Afrika njengoba kukhankaswe yi-Professional Nurse ngosuku lokuqala kwemvumelwano yabantu abasiza abesibhedlela emva kokuba kuyo isitifikedi esingephansi kwalo u-1 Post-basic. ENKOMBENZIMA (Kodwa abantu abalukhethiweyo kuphela bazochazwa ukuba kuzogcwala wonke amadokhumenti nesitifikedi sabo ngenhloko ye-Ngcwatshwa kwabesibhedlela emnyangweni). Ulwazi, amandla, ukugadunywa nokuqinisekiswa okuyisidingo: Ulwazi ngezinsiza ezingalungiswa nangendlela yezinsiza zokunakekelwa, ngezomthetho zezokwelapha, kwezinye izindlela ezithintekile njengokunjalo: Umthetho wokugadunywa, Umthetho wokuqinisekiswa kokuvikeleka kwabasebenzi kwezempilo, Isexwayiso samalungelo abagadi, Izimiso zikaBathe Pele, Isixwayiso sabantu abalwela izinsiza, Umthetho wezomnotho wabasebenzi, Amakhodi wokuvinjelwa kanye nezinsiza, Inqubo yokuphawula, Ulwazi lwezimali nezimali ezivumela ukusiza ezinsizini okuthintekile ngaphakathi kokuhlolwa. Ukuqondisisa ngezinsiza namasimu ezinsiza zokunakekelwa. Ukugada, ngokuhleleka, ukwamukela izinqumo kwaye ukwenza izinsuvi kunobuso inqubo yezinsiza ezingabazimi emphakathini nasekuqondiseni izu vinubhu kumamandla okuhlonza inqubo. Ulwazi lokuqondisana kabanzi phakathi kwezinsiza ezazikwonakala, nokubingelela, nokulwa nokuqonda, nokusiza kwabesabayo nangokunyanga abantu. Amandla okusebenzisa isistimu ekwenzeni izinto ngokusuka esikhathini ngenkathi kusebenza kwaye okubandakanya amandla amakhulu.
zu.duties: Siza ekubumbeni/okuqondiseni nasekuhloleni izinhloso zesigaba sokuNakekelwa kwezingane. Phatha futhi uhlinzeke ngendawo ethize yokwelapha abasebenzi, iziguli nemphakathi esifuna izinsiza zempilo eGrey's Hospital. Khombisa ukuxhumana okusebenzayo kuziguli, kumaphilisi, kubasebenzi bemisindvo yamakhandela amaningi nakwezinye iziphathimandla ngaphakathi esibhedlela. Qinisekisa ukuthi kunikezelwa ukunakekelwa kokuhamba phambili kwezokusiza ezokwelapha kubo bonke abatholi bezinsiza zokunakekelwa kwezingane eGrey's Hospital, ukubheka ukulinganisa ubungozi kanye nokuthintelwa nokubika kokwenza amaphutha okuphephwa kwesiguli. Phatha ukusetshenziswa nokuqondisa zonke izinsiza, ukubheka izinyathelo zokuzezelwa izindleko. Phatha, qondise futhi uhlele ukunikezwa kokugadunywa okusebenzayo kanye nokuphenya, ukugxila kumaphuzu abhekise ekuthuthukisweni kokunakekelwa kwezingane. Phatha futhi ufake isiqu sokuzenzela, ubungcweti namazinga okusebenza phakathi kwabasebenzi. Butha izuvinubhu ezizokuqinisekisa ukuthobela ukunakekelwa ngobuhle, ukuthintelwa nokuqondiswa kwezifo ezithathelwanayo (IPC), okwenyukela emaphuzu afana ne-Ideal Hospital Realisation and Maintenance (IHRM) kanye ne-Norms and Standards (N&S). Buyisa umoya kahle wokusebenza nomakhandela amakhulu abantu. Nikela ngokwesekela okusebenzayo ngezinsiza zokusiza bokunakekelwa, okwenyukela emaphuzu afana nokusiza imisebenzo yokubuyela emuva emaphathini okunakekelwa.

xh.title: Umphathi Wemisebenzi Yokhathalelo lwezigulane (Ebalulekileyo)- Ukukhathalela iNxweme
xh.summary: Umphathi Wemisebenzi Yokhathalelo lwezigulane ogxile ekukhathaleleni iNxweme eGrey's Hospital, KwaZulu-Natal, ofuna ukubhaliswa kwiSANC noluntu olunamava oluninzi ekukhathaleleni iinxweme.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12, Idegree/Idiploma ekukhathaleleni iigulane ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwiSANC njengogqithisa bokhathalelo lwezigulane. Unyaka oluli-1 wemfundo ephakamileyo yabantu abadlule esithunjini ekuphathweni kolwazi lokukhathalela iNxweme. Ukubhaliswa kwangoku kwiSouth African Nursing Council (isiqinisekiso se-2026 SANC). Amava anomgama weminyaka elingu-9 ekukhathaleleni iigulane emva kokubhaliswa njengogqithisa bokhathalelo lwezigulane kwiSANC ekukhathaleleni iigulane jikelele, apho kwalem minyaka emi-5 eidululweyo kufuneka kube ngamava afanelekileyo/avakalisekayo emva kokuqokelela ifom yesiqendu esithile senyaka ekuphathweni kolwazi lokukhathalela iNxweme. OKANYE Amava anomgama weminyaka elishumi elinane (14) afanelekileyo/avakalisekayo emva kokubhaliswa njengogqithisa bokhathalelo lwezigulane kwiSouth African Nursing Council ekukhathaleleni iigulane jikelele, apho kwalem minyaka elishumi (10) eidululweyo kufuneka kube ngamava afanelekileyo/avakalisekayo emva kokuqokelela ifom yesiqendu esithile senyaka ekuphathweni kolwazi lokukhathalela iNxweme. QAPHELA (Kuphela abathunyelwe kweluhlu lokugqibela baza kucelwa ukuba bazithobele zonke iimpawu zamaxwebha nesatifikethi seNkonzo esigqibiweyo nguMntu weZisebe zokuBakanya iZisebe) Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho namakhono aFunekayo: Ulwazi ngamanyathelo namacebo okukhathalela iigulane, izixhibho zamagosa ekhathalelo lwezigulane, nolunye ulwazio olusemthethweni oluthintela loo msebenzi njengaku: Nursing act, Occupational health and safety act, Patients' rights charter, Bathe Pele principles, Public service regulations, Labor relations act, Disciplinary codes and procedures, Grievance procedure, Ulwazi ngemali nezibonekelo ngovimba weemfuno ohilela iindidi ezithile ezingase zisetyenziswe ekulawulweni Umqondiso ngamanyathelo namacebo ahilela ukhathalelo lwezigulane. Amakhono okukhokela, okuqulunqa, okuthatha iigqibo nokusombulula iingxaki ngaphakathi komda wesakhiwo samacebo esiphithiphathi sabantu namacebo esisebe Amakhono okuhlobana nabantu kuquka izidlangalalaze zoluntu, ukuxoxisana, ukupatha iingxabano nakunika inkxaso ngeseliso. Amakhono ekhompyutha kwiprogram ezisisiseko.
xh.duties: Nceda ekulungeniseni/ukuqulunqa nasekuqwalaselweni kwezinto eziphantsi kwelizo leNxweme. Lawula unike imo eyakha isimo esinceda abasebenzi, iigulane noluntu olufikelela kwiinkonzo zempilo eGrey's Hospital. Bonisa inxibelelwano elisebenzayo kwiigulane, oolwabo, amalungu eqela elibonisana neminye imisebenzi kunye nabanye abantu abathintekayo ngaphakathi kwesibhedlele. Qinisekisa ukuba kukhathalelo lwezigulane olungumgama ophezulu lwenikelwa kubo bonke abafiki kwiinkonzo zokhathalelo lweNxweme eGrey's Hospital, ukuthatha ingqalelo ukulinganisa ubungozi kwaye uvimbele nokuveza iiganeko zokhuseleko lwegulane. Lawula ukusebenziswa nokugcina iliso kovimba wonke, ukuthatha ingqalelo izigqibo ezintsha zokugcina imali. Lawula, lungisa ulwazi nolwango lolwazi oqulunqwe ngokwemigaqo yamathuba, ulungelelwaniso lokulungelelisa ukuphucula amacebo abantu abaselayi ixesha elide kuqala kwinkqubo yokwenza iinkcukacha ngezinto ezintsha ezibalulekileyo zokulunga koluntu kwizigulana kwindalo yeproject yamathuba. Lawula unike inkxaso abasebenzi ngokusemthethweni, ngokungabikho mdla kakhulu kwiindlela ezahlukeneyo zokusebenzela izikole zobunklinikhi. Yila amacebo aya kuqinisekisa ukutshintshwa koluntu lokulingana nomngxengo, isiko lokubonelela oluqinisekisiweyo negunya elithembekileyo kwinkqubo yokuthathwa kwezigqibo ngokusesikweni. Asike athande ukusebenza ngokuvakalelwa kwemisebenzi kubantu abamhlophe ngamacebo abo abakhulu ebufundweni namava.

jobs.title: Operational Manager Nursing (SPECIALTY)- Critical Care
jobs.salary_text: R720 819 per annum. Plus 13th cheque, medical aid (optional), Homeowners allowance (employees must meet the prescribed requirements
jobs.summary: Operational Manager Nursing post in Critical Care at Grey's Hospital, KwaZulu-Natal, requiring a Professional Nurse with post-basic Critical Care qualification and at least 9 years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 Certificate Degree/Diploma in General Nursing that allows registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse. 1 Year Post–basic Nursing qualification in Adult/ Paediatric or Neonatal Critical Care Nursing. Current registration with the South African Nursing Council (2026 SANC receipt) A minimum of 9 years appropriate experience in Nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing of which 5 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable experience after obtaining the one year post basic qualification in Critical Care Nursing. OR A minimum of fourteen (14) years appropriate/recognizable experience after registration as a Professional Nurse with the South African Nursing Council in General Nursing of which ten (10) years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable experience after obtaining the one year post basic qualification in Critical Care Nursing. NB (Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit proof of all documents and certificate of Service endorsed by Human Resources). Knowledge, Skills, Training And Competencies Required: Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes, and other relevant legal frameworks such as: Nursing act, Occupational health and safety act, Patients’ rights charter, Bathe Pele principles, Public service regulations, Labor relations act, Disciplinary codes and procedures, Grievance procedure, Financial and budgetary knowledge pertaining to the relevant resources under management Insight into procedures and policies pertaining to nursing care Leadership, organizational, decision making and problem-solving abilities within the limit of the public sector and institutional policy framework Interpersonal skills including public relations, negotiating, conflict handling and counselling skills. Computer skills in basic programs.
jobs.duties: Assist in planning/organizing and monitoring of objectives of the Neonatal ICU and Nursery. Manage and provide a therapeutic environment for staff, patients and the public accessing health care services at Grey’s Hospital Demonstrate effective communication to patients, families, multidisciplinary team members and other stakeholders within the hospital Ensure that high-quality nursing care is rendered to all clients accessing neonatal health services at Grey’s Hospital, taking into consideration safety risk assessments and patient safety incident prevention and reporting. Manage the utilisation and supervision of all resources, taking into consideration cost containment measures. Manage, coordinate and plan the provision of effective training and research, focusing on the programs aimed at the improvement of neonatal care nursing. Manage and instil discipline, professionalism and work ethics among employees. Develop strategies which will ensure compliance with quality care, infection prevention and control (IPC) programs, e.g. Ideal Hospital Realisation and Maintenance (IHRM) and Norms and Standards (N&S). Maintain a constructive working environment with the multi-disciplinary team members. Provide effective support to Nursing services, e.g. assist with relief duties to nursing management.
jobs.enquiries: Mr F.S. Matibela- Nursing Manager Tel No: (033) 897 3331
jobs.applications: Applications to be forwarded to: The Human Resources Management Office, Greys Hospital Private Bag X9001, Pietermaritzburg, 3200 or Email Applications to khazimula.goba@kznhealth.gov.za or malinee.chandul@kznhealth.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : Mrs M. Chandulal
jobs.notes: Directions to Candidates: Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the new Z83 form and a detailed curriculum vitae only. Additionally: The new Application for Employment Form (Z83) is obtainable from any Government Department OR from the website – www.kznhealth.gov.za. Applicants must utilize the most recent Application for Employment Form (Form Z83) as issued by the Minister for DPSA (gazetted on 06 November 2020) in line with regulation of 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016 and failure to do so will result in disqualification. Applicants are required to complete and sign Z83,and also submit a detailed curriculum vitae (CV). All sections of the new Application for Employment Form (Z83) (except those sections that are not relevant to the applicant) must be completely, accurately and legibly filled in a manner that allows a selection committee to assess the quality of a candidate based on the information provided in the form. Applicants are required to reflect information even if the same information is provided on the detailed CV. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The Employment Equity Target for this post is: African Male, Coloured Male, African Female, Coloured Female.

af.title: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleging (SPESIALITEIT)- Kritiese Sorg
af.summary: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleging pos in Kritiese Sorg by Grey's Hospital, KwaZulu-Natal, wat 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige met 'n post-basiese Kritiese Sorg-kwalifikasie en ten minste 9 jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat Graad/Diploma in Algemene Verpleging wat registrasie by SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 1 Jaar Post-basiese verpleegkwalifikasie in Volwasse/ Pediatrese of Neonatale Kritiese Sorg Verpleging. Huidige registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad (2026 SANC kwitansie) 'n Minimum van 9 jaar gepaste ervaring in Verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging waarvan 5 jaar van die bogenoemde periode gepaste/erkende ervaring na verkryging van die een jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie in Kritiese Sorg Verpleging moet wees. OF 'n Minimum van veertien (14) jaar gepaste/erkende ervaring na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad in Algemene Verpleging waarvan tien (10) jaar van die bogenoemde periode gepaste/erkende ervaring na verkryging van die een jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie in Kritiese Sorg Verpleging moet wees. NB (Slegs gekortlysde kandidate sal vereis word om bewys van alle dokumente en 'n dienssertifikaat wat deur Menslike Hulpbronne onderskryf is, voor te lê). Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding En Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures, verpleegstatute, en ander tersaaklike regsraamwerke soos: Nursing act, Occupational health and safety act, Patients' rights charter, Bathe Pele principles, Public service regulations, Labor relations act, Disciplinary codes and procedures, Grievance procedure, Finansiële en begrotingskennis met betrekking tot die tersaaklike hulpbronne onder bestuur Insig in prosedures en beleide met betrekking tot verpleegsorg Leierskap, organisatoriese, besluitnemings- en probleemoplossingsvermoëns binne die perke van die openbare sektor en institusionele beleidsraamwerk Interpersoonlike vaardighede insluitend openbare betrekkinge, onderhandeling, konflikhantering en beradingvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardighede in basiese programme.
af.duties: Bystand verleen met die beplanning/organisering en monitering van die doelwitte van die Neonatale ICU en Kraamsaal. Bestuur en verskaf 'n terapeutiese omgewing vir personeel, pasiënte en die publiek wat gesondheidsorgdienste by Grey's Hospital verkry. Toon effektiewe kommunikasie teenoor pasiënte, families, multidissiplinêre spanlede en ander belanghebbendes binne die hospitaal. Verseker dat hoë-kwaliteit verpleegsorg aan alle kliënte wat neonatale gesondheidsdienste by Grey's Hospital verkry, gelewer word, met inagneming van veiligheidsrisikobeurdellings en pasiëntveiligheidsinsidentvoorkoming en -rapportering. Bestuur die benutting en toesig oor alle hulpbronne, met inagneming van kostebeheermaatreëls. Bestuur, koördineer en beplan die verskaffing van effektiewe opleiding en navorsing, met die fokus op programme wat gemik is op die verbetering van neonatale verpleegsorg. Bestuur en instil dissipline, professionaliteit en werk-etiek onder werknemers. Ontwikkel strategieë wat sal verseker dat daar voldoen word aan gehalte-sorg, infeksievoorkoming en -beheer (IPC) programme, bv. Ideal Hospital Realisation and Maintenance (IHRM) en Norms and Standards (N&S). Handhaaf 'n konstruktiwe werksomgewing met die multidissiplinêre spanlede. Verskaf effektiewe ondersteuning aan verpleegdienste, bv. bystand verleen met ontheffingspligte aan verpleegbestuur.

zu.title: Umlawuli Wezinsiza Wezokwelapha (ISIKHUNZI)- Critical Care
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaMphathi Wezimfanelo wezokwelapha ekwelapheni okubalulekile e-Grey's Hospital, eKwaZulu-Natal, sidinga Uguli Ogwile onesitifiketi se-Post-basic ekwelapheni okubalulekile kanye neminyaka engu-9 yokube ngumuntu oqashiwe ekwelapheni.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 idigri/iplani eBungeni lokhelo elivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengoguli ogwile. Unyaka oyi-1 wemfundo ehlukanisiwe ekuqhakeni kokukhululeka kwabantu abadala/abantwana noma abasakhulelwe ekwelapheni okugijiwe. Ukubhaliswa kwamanje ne-North African Nursing Council (2026 SANC receipt) okuncane iminyaka engu-9 yemvelo ekuqashweni ekuqashweni kwezokwelapha ngemuva kokubhaliswa njengoguli ogwile ne-SANC ekwelapheni okujwayelekile okuyiminyaka eyi-5 kuleyo minyaka okushiwo ngaphezulu kumele kube yimvelo/okuhlonishwa kwe-Interactive emva kokuthola isitifiketi sobu-1 sekhono ekuqhakeni kokukhululeka kokukhululeka kwabantu. OKUBALULEKILE (Kuphela abaqashiwe abafushane okuzofuneka ukuthi banikeze ukufakazela kwawo wonke amadokhumenti nesitifiketi seNkonzo esigunyaziwe abasebenzi). Ulwazi, amakhono, okugadangwa, kanye namakhono efunekayo: Ulwazi ngemigudu yokunakekela amagciwane nezinhlaka zamagciwane, namanye amagciwane asho okunye njengalela: Umthetho wezokwelapha, umthetho wezokwenzakala nokuqinisekiswa kwempilo, isitifiketi sezimvama zabaphulensi, imigidingo yeBathe Pele, imithetho yomphakathi, umthetho wezimfanelo, imigidingo yesigijimi kanye nemigudu yokubikisa imilando, imikhuba yokuxazulula izinkinga, ulwazi lwezimali kanye nebhajethi ngokubhekene nemithombo enkiwe ngaphansi kolawulo. Ukunaka ngemigudu kanye nezinqubomgomo ngokunakekelwa kwezokwelapha. Amakhono okuqukatha ukwakha amaphoyintsi, ukweluleka, ukukhulumisana nokukhokha ngokungabazeki kanye nokuqonda kwezinkinga phakathi kwemikhawulo yomphakathi kanye nokuqondisiswa kwenqubomgomo yomnyango. Amakhono okuxhumana kufaka phakathi izinto zomphakathi, ukuxoxisana ngohwevu, ukuphatha izimpixabo nokukhululeka, kanye namakhono okuxoxa imikhuba. Amakhono e-Computer ukusebenzisa amaphrokhari amakhulu ekhompyutha njengoba: iBhayibheli lenkulumo, umthetho wezomphakathi, imithetho yesikhathi esikude, imithetho yokuphendula nokufaka izinsizakusebenza, iKhompyutha yokuthola nokuqinisekisa izinkomba ekuphathwa kwezimali ngokubona imithombo, amakhono okulawula ukuhamba kwabantu, amakhono okusebenzisa amaphrokhari ekhompyutha ekuqaleni.
zu.duties: Msiza ekwelapha/hlela futhi uqaphele izinhloso ze-Neonatal ICU ne-Nursery. Phatha futhi unikeze isiqalelokunye sezuluso kubasebenzi, iziguli nalomphakathi ongangena emasevisini ezempilo e-Grey's Hospital. Khombisa ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo kuziguli, emindeni, kulabo abayingxenye yethimba elihlukahlukene kanye nabanye abahlobene phakathi kwesibhedlela. Qinisekisa ukuthi kunikezwa ukunakekelwa kwezokwelapha okwizinga eliphezulu kubo bonke abathola izinsiza ezokwelapha iziguli zezesimama e-Grey's Hospital, ucabange ngokuqathaniswa kwezingozi zokuphepha nokuvikela nokubika ngemikhuba engaphephile yeziguli. Phatha ukusetshenziswa kanye nokuhlola yonke imithombo, ucabange ngalezinye izindlela zokonga izindleko. Phatha, hlela futhi uhlele ukunikezwa kokugadangwa okuphumelelayo nokuqhuba ucwaningo, gigqila ezinhlelweni ezihlose ukuphucula ukunakekelwa kwezokwelapha kwezesimama. Phatha futhi ufunde isiyaluyalu, ukuba ngumuntu ongawakwesikhundla kanye nemikhuba emihle yomsebenzi kubasebenzi. Thutha izinqobo eziyaqinisekisa ukuthobela ekunakekelweni okwizinga eliphezulu, ekuvikeleni nasekulawuleni ukutheleleka (IPC), isb. i-Ideal Hospital Realisation and Maintenance (IHRM) kanye ne-Norms and Standards (N&S). Gcina indawo yokusebenza enomoya omuhle nalabo abayingxenye yethimba elihlukene. Nikela ukusekela okuphumelelayo emasevisini ezokwelapha, isb. ukusiza imisebenzi yesikhundla sabaphathi bezokwelapha.

xh.title: Umphathi Wemisebenzi Yokusingathwa kweZiguli (ISIKHUMO)- Ukunakekelwa Okubalulekileyo
xh.summary: Isithuba somphathi wemisebenzi yokusingathwa kweziguli kwiZiko lokunakekelwa okubalulekileyo eGrey's Hospital, eKwaZulu-Natal, sifuna umongikazi osemgangathweni onemviyo yemfundo engaphezu kwesisiseko sokunakekelwa okubalulekileyo kwaye enamava okungazingenwa ngaphantsi kweminyaka eli-9.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethdi seGraji ye-12 idigri/iploma kwiNursing eJikelele evumela ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengomongikazi osemgangathweni. Iminyaka el-1 yemfundo engaphezulu kwesisiseko seNursing kwiNursing yokuNakekela abadala abasemva kobudala/abatsha nabaNtshatsheli abasandla kwindawo ethile yokunakekelwa okubalulekileyo. Ukubhalisa kwangoku kunye neNkululeko yeZiguli zaseMzantsi Afrika (irasiyethi yeSANC ka-2026). Okungenani iminyaka eli-9 yamava afanelekileyo kwiNursing emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi osemgangathweni kunye neSANC kwiNursing eJikelele apho iminyaka esi-5 kwelo xesha elitshiwo ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo/avakalayo emva kokufumana isiqinisekiso seminyaka el-1 sokuqala seNursing kwindawo ethile yokunakekelwa okubalulekileyo. OKANYA Okungenazi iminyaka elishumi elinane (14) yamava afanelekileyo/avakalayo emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi osemgangathweni kunye neNkululeko yeZiguli zaseMzantsi Afrika kwiNursing eJikelele apho iminyaka elishumi (10) kweli xesha elitshiwo ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo/avakalayo emva kokufumana isiqinisekiso seminyaka el-1 sokuqala seNursing kwindawo ethile yokunakekelwa okubalulekileyo. QAPH (Kuphela abagqibiwe kuludwe abayakudingwa ukuba batyhale iziqinisekiso zamaxwebhu wonke nesatifikethdi seNkonzo esigqiniweyo nguBasebenzi boLuntu). Ulwazi, amakhono, uqeqesho namaphulo afunekayo: Ulwazi ngemigaqo nendlela zokunakekelwa kweziguli, izifanekiso zomthetho zeNursing, nolunye ulwesi olumalunga nomthetho njengalwa: uMthetho weNursing, uMthetho weMpilo yokuSebenza nokuKhuseleka, isatifikethdi samalungelo abagulayo, iimpelu zeBatho Pele, iimigaqo zesebe lokuSebenza, uMthetho wezeMibaniselwa koBuntu, iikhowudi nendlela zokuRhwebisa, iNqubo yokuPikisa, ulwazi malunga neemali nokuqwalasela imali ngokwemithombo ephathwa ngaphantsi kulawulo. Ukuqonda iindlela namaphulo amalunga nokunakekelwa kweziguli. Amakhono okukhokela, ekuqhelanisa, okuthatha izigqibo nokusombulula iingxaki ngaphakathi kwemida yesebe lommandla kunye nolawulo lolwangcaocele. Amakhono okuqhathanisa nabantu ahlanganisa ukubonakala koluntu, ukuxoxisana, ukupatha iingxabano nokweluleka. Amakhono ekhompyutha kumanqanaba aphuma kwesisiseko.
xh.duties: Nceda ukucwangcisa/ukuhlela nokuqwalasela iinjongo ze-Neonatal ICU neyeNursery. Lawula futhi uqeqeshe indawo yokwelapha abasebenzi, iziguli noluntu oluqhubela iinkonzo zempihlakalo eGrey's Hospital. Bonisa unxibelelwano olusebenzayo kuziguli, usapho, amalunga eqela elenza izigqibo ezahlukeneyo nabalulekileko abanye eckotsheni. Qinisekisa ukuba ukunakekelwa kolunye uhlobo lweziguli kwangangobugcisa kunikwa onke amaxhoba aququzelela iinkonzo zempihlakalo ezincanceni eGrey's Hospital, ungene amaxhoba, ukucingelwa ukupima iingozi nokuthintela nendlela yokuba ixhoba lingenwa ngakhona nokuyipha isiganeko, xa sika nokuqwalasela nokuqwalasela ezingozi zokhuseleko lwegula indlela yokubhala nokuqhutywa ngaphantsi. Lawula ukusetyenziswa nokuqhelanisa kolunye uhlobo lwemithombo, ungena ingcinga ngokusebenzisa iindlela zokulondoluzuza iindleko. Lawula, qhelanisa, caciswa, nokuqamba nokuqamba iNkonzo yolwazi nokuphanda iindlela, usebenzisa uluvo kwixesha elithile ngenjongo zokuphucula iNursing kwezempilo zabantwana. Lawula futhi ufake iziyalezo ngokukhathaleleka, zokwenza umsebenzi ngobuchule kwaye ufake isiseko somsebenzi kubasebenzi. Ukulungelelanisa iindlela eziya kuthi zinikwe iNkonzo ethile nangaphezulu kwezempilo, ukulungelelanisa ulondoluzo kwezifo eziyingozi nokulawula (iIPC) iinkqubo, njengakuyiyo iNkonzo yokubakelwa kwaye kugcinwe iHospital ekuyiyo iNgcamango (iIHRM) kunye nemigaqo eqheliswayo (iN&S). Gcina indawo yokusebenza ekaqheliswayo ngokwakha amakhondo anamava ngokuhamba kwexesha koluntu abancediswa bona bancedise nabasebenzi ekhaya. Nikela ngcediso ephumelelayo kumasebenzi eNursing, ngokomzekelo nceda nakuqeqeshwa komsebenzi wokuncedisa abaphathi beNursing.

zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12; Isiqu/iDiploma ekuQeqeshweni kabanjwa okuvumela ukubhaliswa ku-SANC njengesiGqili seNokhosi. NB (Kuphela abagqwayizi abakushiwe izinhlu abayobe bethunyelwa ubufakazi bamadokhumenti wonke kanye nesitifikedi seNkonzo esiqinisegiswe ngumnyango wezinsiza zabantu). Ukuqonda izinhlela nemigado elawula ukunakekelwa kabanjwa. Ubuhlakani bokuba ngumholi, ukuhlela, ukuthatha izinqumo nokuxazulula izinkinga ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo yomthetho wasekharidini nomphakathi kanye nomgomo wesikhungo. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu okuhlanganisa ubudlelwano bomphakathi, ukuxoxisana, ukuphatha izinkinga nokweluleka. Amakhono ekhompyutha ezinhlelweni eziyisisekelo.
zu.duties: Usize ekubekweni nhlelo/ukuhleleni nasekuqondisweni imigomo yeNqola yezokwelapha. Khombisa ukuxhumana okusebenzayo kubaguli, emindeni, kubalingana bemikhakha ehlukene nakubanye abahlanganyeli ngaphakathi kwesibhedlela. Qinisekisa ukunakekelwa kabanjwa okwizinga eliphezulu kunikezwa bonke abatholi bezinsiza ezesikhundla sokwelapha esibhedlela i-Grey's Hospital, ngokubheka ukulinganisela ubungozi bokuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabaguli nokuthwala izinkondolo zokuvikela ukuphepha kwabaguli nokubika. Phatha ukusetshenziswa nokugadlela konke izinsiza, ngokubheka izindlela zokulinganisa izindleko. Phatha, hlela futhi cwebezela ukunikwa kokusetshenziswa kwezolo kanye nocwaningo, ukugqamisa izinhlelo ezihlelelwe ukuphucula ukunakekelwa kabanjwa kokwelapha. Phatha futhi faka isiyalwa sezinkolo zomsebenzi, ubungcweti kanye nezinkolo zokusebenza phakathi kwabasebenzi. Hlela izindlela eziyokwenza ukuzwana nokuqinisekiswa kwenakekelwa elihle, nokuvikela nokulawula izifo ezelwayo (ama-IPC) izinhlelo, njengoku- Ideal Hospital Realisation and Maintenance (IHRM) nama-Norms and Standards (N&S). Gcina isikhungo sokusebenza esakha ngesandla nomqondo kubalingana bemikhakha ehlukene. Nikeza ukwesekwa okusebenzayo izinsiza zokuQeqeshwa kabanjwa, njengokusize ngemisebenzi yokukhulula abasebenzi bekuqeqeshwa kabanjwa babaphathi.

Qinisekisa ukuba kukho unxibelelwano olusebenzayo kubaguli, osapho, amalungu eqela elisebenza kumacandelo amaninzi nabanomdla kwiNdawo yokuhlasela engangeniyo kwisibhedlele. Qinisekisa ukuba kunikezelwa khathalelo yanamhlanje yamagosa abucala kubo bonke abathengi bexesha elizeleyo kwiinkonzo ezingalinganiswanga ezisebenzayo kwindawo yokuhambela ekufuneka igunyazwe kwisibhedlele. Lawula, ulawule kwaye ucwangcise iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo zokuzinza, ulungelelwaniso kunye nendlela yokubeka imigaqo yokuqinisekisa ukulungiselelwa kokuphucula iinkonzo ezifanelekileyo kubasebenzi nakuluntu.

Ukuqonda kumigaqo nemicimbi ethinta unyango lokuNesa. Amandla okuQamba, ekuHlelweni, ekuThatheni isiGqibo nokuSombulula iingxaki ngaphakathi kwemida wenkqubo yeenkozo zikarhulumente nakumaziko. Amakhono okuHlobo kunye nendibaniselwano nabantu, aquka ubudlelwano namaphakathi, ukuXoxisana, ukuphathwa kweengxabano nakunye nokuNika icebiso ngengxaki. Amakhono ekhompyutha kwinkqubo esisiseko.
xh.duties: Nceda kwiplani/uhlelo nakumkuqondiso iinjongo zeNyikithi yezeSifo iSengundo. Yonke le ndalo iphela iya kubakho igumbi elinokunyango kubasebenzi, iigulanya nalomaphakathi ukuya kufumana iinkonzo ezingagqibelelanga kwiGrey's Hospital. Bonisa unxibelelwano olusebenzayo kwiigulanya, osapho, amalungu eqela elinamaphandle nakwezinye iindalo endaweni yokunyanga kuGrey's Hospital. Qinisekisa ukunyanyalwa kolwelo olusemgangathweni ophezulu kubo bonke abafuni unyango olusebenzayo kwindalo eziSibo eSengundo kwiGrey's Hospital, njengoko sithathelwa ingqalelo ukuvavanywa komngcipheko ekhuseleko kwezigulana nokuthintela nokubhengeza iingozi ezingalulanga kwiSigulana. Lawula ukusetyenziswa nakumkuqondiso yonke iimithobo, njengoko sithathwa ingqalelo iindlela ezimangaliswe iindleko. Lawula, hlela unyango lweplani yokunika uqeqeshelo nokuphandela, njengoko kujolise kumagama aqeqesho nangaphezulu eSogxeni iSengundo. Lawula futhi ufake isithunzi sobuqeqeshi, ubugcisa bomsebenzi kubasebenzi. Phatha iindlela eziza kuqinisekisa ulwelo oluhle, ekuthinteleni nakulawulweni kwesifo sokutsha nokusuleleka (IPC), i.e. IHRM kwaye neN&S. Londoloza indalo enkampuni eqeqesweyo yokusebenza ngokubambisana namalungu eqela eliphelene namaphandle emikhosi. Nikeza inkxaso elusebenzayo kwinkonzo yokuNesa, i.e. nceda ngenkonzo yekhuselo kwintethizo yolawulo lweNesi.

jobs.title: Ultrasound Radiographer – Diagnostic Imaging Services
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R510 906 - R581 892 per annum Grade 2: R598 260 - R683 808 per annum Grade 3: R703 785 – R756 444 per annum Other Benefits: 13th Cheque, (Medical Aid Optional) Plus 12% Inhospitable Area.
jobs.summary: Ultrasound radiographer position at Ladysmith Regional Hospital providing diagnostic imaging services, requiring HPCSA registration as an independent practitioner.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 plus an appropriate qualification that allows for the required registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) in Ultrasound Radiography (2026). Certificate of Registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as an Ultrasound Radiographer (Independent Practitioner). Persons in possession of foreign qualification must attached an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Current registration confirmation / Annual practice with HPCSA as an Ultrasound Radiographer. Experience Grade 1: Nil experience after registration with HPCSA in respect of RSA qualified who have performed community services, and 1 year appropriate/recognizable experience in respect of foreign qualified not required to perform community service. Grade 2: Minimum of 10 years’ appropriate experience after registration with the HPCSA as an Ultrasound Radiographer. Grade 3: Minimum of 20 years’ appropriate experience after registration with the HPCSA as an Ultrasound Radiographer. Knowledge, Skills, Training And Competencies: Sound knowledge of obstetrics & gynaecology, general, cardiac and vascular ultrasound musculoskeletal ultrasound scanning techniques, protocols and procedures. Knowledge of radiographic procedures, equipment and accessories associated with relevant regulations. Sound knowledge of Radiation control regulations, safety measure and policies. Knowledge of occupational Health and Safety and other relevant Acts, policies and regulations, namely, infection control measures, etc. Knowledge of basic Quality assurance procedures in Diagnostic Radiography. Ability to communicate effectively and problem solving skills. Sound report writing and administrative skills. Computer literacy. Good interpersonal relations and ability to perform well within a team. Ability to work autonomously.
jobs.duties: Provide safe, timely and high-quality diagnostic ultrasound services in accordance with clinical indications, approved protocols and patient-centred care standards. Perform and accurately interpret ultrasound examinations within the scope of practice, and issue clear, complete and timely diagnostic reports. Promote patient dignity, privacy, informed consent, health education and continuity of care throughout the examination process. Perform ultrasound procedures competently, applying infection prevention and control, patient identification and clinical risk-management measures. Undertake patient reception, appointment coordination, registration and related clerical duties as required. Maintain accurate clinical records, examination registers, service statistics and routine operational reports. Support the effective day-to-day delivery of ultrasound services, including workload prioritisation, referral pathways and efficient use of available resources. Uphold Batho Pele principles, professional ethics and respectful communication with patients, families and multidisciplinary teams. Inspect, operate and care for ultrasound equipment safety, reports faults promptly and support equipment maintenance and service continuity. Provide guidance, supervision, mentorship and practical training to junior staff and students within the scope of professional practice. Participate in quality assurance, clinical audits, patient-safety initiatives and continuous quality-improvement activities. Comply with applicable professional standards, occupational health and safety requirements, the Ideal Hospital Framework and Office of Health Standards Compliance requirements.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. B. Mbana (Assistant Director: Radiography) Tel No: (036) 637 2111
jobs.applications: All applications should be emailed to LadysmithHospital.Job@kznhealth.gov.za / erick.ngxongo@kznhealth.gov.za or be posted to: The Human Resource Management, Ladysmith Regional Hospital, Private Bag X9928, Ladysmith, 3370 or Hand delivery to: The Human Resource Management Offices, Ladysmith Regional Hospital, Office No: 15, 36 Malcom Road, Ladysmith, 3370 FOR ATTENTION : Mr S.L.Dlozi.
