af.title: Ultrasoonradiograaf – Diagnostiese Beeldingsdienste
af.summary: Ultrasoonradiograafpos by Ladysmith Regional Hospital wat diagnostiese beeldingsdienste verskaf, wat HPCSA-registrasie as 'n onafhanklike praktisyn vereis.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 plus 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie wat die vereiste registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) in Ultrasoonradiografie (2026) moontlik maak. Sertifikaat van Registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Ultrasoonradiograaf (Onafhanklike Praktisyn). Persone met 'n buitelandse kwalifikasie moet 'n evalueringsertifikaat van die South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) heg. Huidige registrasiebevestiging / Jaarlike praktyk by HPCSA as 'n Ultrasoonradiograaf. Ervaring Graad 1: Geen ervaring na registrasie by HPCSA ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerdes wat gemeenskapsdiens gedoen het nie, en 1 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerdes wat nie vereis word om gemeenskapsdiens te verrig nie. Graad 2: Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Ultrasoonradiograaf. Graad 3: Minimum van 20 jaar se toepaslike ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Ultrasoonradiograaf. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding En Bevoegdheid: Deeglike kennis van verloskunde en ginekologie, algemene, hart- en vaskulêre ultraklank, muskuloskeletale ultraklank-skanderingstegnieke, protokolle en prosedures. Kennis van radiografiese prosedures, toerusting en bybehorende vereistes verbonde aan die tersaaklike regulasies. Deeglike kennis van Stralingsbeheerregulasies, veiligheidsmaatreëls en beleide. Kennis van Bedryfs-Gesondheid en Veiligheid en ander tersaaklike Wette, beleide en regulasies, naamlik infeksiebeheermaatreëls, ens. Kennis van basiese gehalteversekeringsprosedures in Diagnostiese Radiografie. Vermoë om doeltreffend te kommunikeer en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Deeglike verslagskryf- en administratiewe vaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge en vermoë om goed binne 'n span te funksioneer. Vermoë om outonoom te werk.
af.duties: Verskaf veilige, tydige en hoëgehalte diagnostiese ultrasoondienste in ooreenstemming met kliniese aanduidings, goedgekeurde protokolle en pasiëngesentrede sorgstandaarde. Voer ultrasoonondersoeke binne die bestek van praktyk behoorlik uit en tolk dit akkuraat, en reik duidelike, volledige en tydige diagnostiese verslae uit. Bevorder pasiëntwaardigheid, privaatheid, ingeligte toestemming, gesondheidsopvoeding en kontinuïteit van sorg deur die ondersoekproses. Voer ultrasoonprosedures bevoeg uit deur infeksievoorkoming en -beheer, pasiëntidentifikasie en kliniese risikobestuurmaatreëls toe te pas. Onderneem pasiëntontvangs, afspraakkoördinering, registrasie en verwante kantoorpligte soos vereis. Onderhou akkurate kliniese rekords, ondersoekregisters, diensstatistieke en roetinebedryfsverslae. Ondersteun die effektiewe daaglikse lewering van ultrasoondienste, insluitend werkladingprioritisering, verwysingsroetes en doeltreffende gebruik van beskikbare hulpbronne. Handhaaf Batho Pele-beginsels, professionele etiek en respekvolle kommunikasie met pasiënte, families en multidissiplinêre spanne. Inspekteer, bedryf en versorg ultrasoontoerusting veilig, rapporteer foute onmiddellik en ondersteun toerustingonderhoud en dienskontinuïteit. Verskaf leiding, toesig, mentorskap en praktiese opleiding aan junior personeel en studente binne die bestek van professionele praktyk. Neem deel aan gehalteversekering, kliniese oudite, pasiëntveiligheidsinisiatiewe en deurlopende gehalteverbeteringsaktiwiteite. Voldoen aan toepaslike professionele standaarde, vereistes vir bedryfsgesondheid en -veiligheid, die Ideal Hospital Framework en vereistes van die Office of Health Standards Compliance.

zu.title: Umreyidi we-Ultrasound – Amasevisi Okutholakala Isifo Ngokuhlola Izithombe
zu.summary: Isikhundla somreyidi we-Ultrasound esibhedlela i-Ladysmith Regional Hospital esinikeza amasevisi okutholakala isifo ngokuhlola izithombe, esidinga ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengomuntu osebenza ngokazimela.
zu.requirements: Itholakala i-Senior Certificate / i-Grade 12 kanye nesiqu esifanele esivumela ukubhaliswa okudingekayo ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) ku-Ultrasound Radiography (2026). Isitifiketi Sokubhaliswa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoMreyidi we-Ultrasound (Independent Practitioner). Abantu abanamasiqu avela emazwe angaphandle kumele basethe isitifiketi sokuhlola esivela ku-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Isiqinisekiso sobudale sokubhaliswa / umsebenzi wonyaka we-HPCSA njengoMreyidi we-Ultrasound. Okuhlolwa Isikhathi Esinamava i-Grade 1: Akukho mva emva kokuqashwa ku-HPCSA ngokwabo abathole isiqu e-RSA abenze imisebenzi yomphakathi, kanye neminyaka elingu-1 yamava afanele/ahlonishwayo ngokwabo bathole isiqu emazwe angaphange abadingeki ukwenze imisebenzi yomphakathi. i-Grade 2: Okuncane kakhulu iminyaka engu-10 yamava afanele emva kokuqashwa ku-HPCSA njengoMreyidi we-Ultrasound. i-Grade 3: Okuncane kakhulu iminyaka engu-20 yamava afanele emva kokuqashwa ku-HPCSA njengoMreyidi we-Ultrasound. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa Namandla Okwenza: Ukuqonda kahle izifo zokubeletha nabesifazane, i-ultrasound evamile, yenhliziyo naleyavesi yokuhamba kwegazi amasu okuskena i-ultrasound yamathambo namisipha, imithetho nendlela yokwenza. Ulwazi ngendlela zokwenza umsebenzi we-radiography, izisetshenziswa nezimpahla ezihlotshaniswe nemithetho ehlobene nawo. Ukuqonda kahle imithetho yokulawula ukusakazeka kwe-radiation, izinyathelo zokuphepha kanye namapholisi. Ulwazi nge-Occupational Health and Safety nakwezinye izigaba, amapholisi namithetho ahlobene nawo, okuyona, izinyathelo zokulawula ukutheleleka, njll. Ulwazi lwezisekelo eziyisiseko zokuqinisekiswa ikhwalithi kwi-Diagnostic Radiography. Ikono lokuxhumana kahle kanye namakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Ukubhala imibiko kahle namakhono okuphatha. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuhlobana kahle nabantu kanye nokukwazi ukusebenza kahle eqenjini. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngodwa.
zu.duties: Nikela amasevisi we-ultrasound okutholakala isifo ngokuhlola izithombe aphephile, ngesikhathi futhi anokukhiqiza okuphezulu ngokuya izinkomba zezokwelapha, imithetho evunyiwe nezindinganiso zokunakekelwa abagulayo. Yenza futhi uhlole ngokucophelela ukuhlolwa kwe-ultrasound ngaphakathi kwesibalo somsebenzi, uphumeze futhi unikeze imibiko echazwe ngokucacile, egqamile ngesikhathi esifanele. Khuthaza isithunzi sabagulayo, ukuzimela kwabo, ukuvuma ngokwaziswa, ukuqondisa ngempilo kanye nokwaphula ukunakekelwa kuwo wonke umugqa wokuqashwa. Yenza izinqubo ze-ultrasound ngokuziphendulela, usebenzisa ukuvikelwa nasekulawulweni kokutheleleka, ukuqashwa kabagulayo kanye nezinyathelo zokulawula ingozi yezokwelapha. Thatha ukwamukelwa kwabagulayo, ukuqondisa izikhathi zemihlangano, ukubhalisa kanye nemisebenzi ehlobene nokubhala njengoba kudingekwa. Gcina okubhalisiwe okuqondene nezokwelapha, imibhalo yokuqashwa, izibalo zomsebenzi kanye nemibiko evamile yokusebenza. Sekela ukulethwa kwansuku zonke okusebenzayo kwamasevisi we-ultrasound, okuhlanganisa ukubeka ngaphambani umthwalo wokusebenza, izindlela zokuqondisa kanye nokusebenzisisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Zigcine izimiso ze-Batho Pele, izimiso zokuziphatha zobungcweti kanye nokuxhumana ngokuhlonipha abagulayo, imindeni namakhasimba ahlukene. Hlola, usebenzise futhi unakekele ukuphepha kwezisetshenziswa ze-ultrasound, ubike iziphoso ngesikhathi futhi usekele ukugcinwa kwezisetshenziswa kanye nokwaphula umsebenzi. Nikeza okwakho isiqondiso, ukugada, ukulekela kanye nokuqeqesha okusebenzayo abasebenzi abasha nabafundi ngaphakathi kwesibalo somsebenzi wobungcweti. Thatha inxaxheba ekuqinisekisweni ikhwalithi, ukuhlola izinto zezokwelapha, izinhloso zokuphepha abagulayo kanye nokuqhubeka nokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi ngokukhanyayo. Landela izindinganiso zobungcweti ezifanele, izidingo ze-occupational health and safety, i-Ideal Hospital Framework kanye nezidingo ze-Office of Health Standards Compliance.

xh.title: Umzobi we-Ultrasound – Iinkonzo zoVavvo lokuQondisa
xh.summary: Isikhundla somzobi we-Ultrasound esibhedlele i-Ladysmith Regional Hospital esinika iinkonzo zovavvo lokuqondisa, sifuna ubhaliso kwi-HPCSA njengompraktishani ozimelayo.
xh.requirements: I-Senior Certificate / Isiganga 12 kunye nelayisensi efanelekileyo evumela ubhaliso olufunekayo kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) kwi-Ultrasound Radiography (2026). Isatifikethi sobhaliso kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomzobi we-Ultrasound (Independent Practitioner). Abantu abanelayisensi yamanye amazanga kufuneka bathathe isatifikethi sovavvo esivela kwi-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Isiqinisekiso sobhaliso sangoku / Unyaka wokuqhuba umsebenzi nge-HPCSA njengomzobi we-Ultrasound. Amanyakeni amva: Inqanaba 1: Akukho nomyeke ofunekayo emva kobhaliso kwi-HPCSA babantu ababhalise kwi-RSA abenze inkonzo yomphakathi, nethyaka elithathu 1 elifanelekileko / eliqondakalayo kubantu abavela kumazwe angaphandle abangazange bayedwelise ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi. Inqanaba 2: Amava wethyaka eli-10 ubuncinci emva kobhaliso kwi-HPCSA njengomzobi we-Ultrasound. Inqanaba 3: Amava wethyaka eli-20 ubuncinci emva kobhaliso kwi-HPCSA njengomzobi we-Ultrasound. Ulwazi, Amandla, Uqeqesho Nohlobo: Ulwazi oluzinileyo ngokuvelisa iindaba kwi-obstetrics & gynaecology, jikelele, intliziya nemithambo-lazo hlaziyo, indlela zokuskena ze-ultrasound yamathambo-nemisipha, iinkqubo namacebo. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zoradiography, izixhobo nezinto ezihambisanayo namaxwebhu. Ulwazi oluzinileyo ngemigaqo yokulawula imidl evu, iindlela zokhuseleko namapolicy. Ulwazi ngokuGCina uKhuseleko loGqatso kumanye umthetho, namapolicies namaxwebhu afanelekileyo, njengendlela zokuthintela ukutheleleka, njl. Ulwazi lwezakhiwo ezisisiseko zokuQinisekisa umgangatho kwi-Diagnostic Radiography. Amandla okunxibelelana kakuhle nendlela zokuxazulula iingxaki. Amandla aqinileyo okubhala iingxelo nolawulo. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Ubuhlobo obuhle nabathwva nembonakelso yokuqhuba kakuhle kqubu. Amandla okuzisebenzela.
xh.duties: Nika iinkonzo ze-ultrasound zovavvo ezizukileyo, ngexesha elifanelekileyo nemgangatho ophezulu ngokwemitsho yezempilo, iinkqubo ezamkelekileyo namazinga onkeleko weengcali abakhathalelekayo. Qhuba uphucule ngokuchanekileyo izivavvo zoltrasound ngaphakathi kwesithuba somsebenzi, uze unike iingxelo zovavvo ezicacileyo, ezizezinye, ngonxibelelwano oluqinisekise ukuthumela ixesha. Qhubeza isidima, okuhlawayo, isazikwangako, igqwi elidlayo eliyiyo kumakhula isikhundla onobonakalisa. Qhuba iinkqubo ze-ultrasound ngamandla, usebenzisa okuthintela ukutheleleka, uqinisekiso lwegama lenginginya kwezempilo iingxaki zolwazi. Thumela egqibelelo labenginginya, ulungiselelwe ii-apoyintmenentsi, abhalise ekunye namanye amathuba ohlelo njengoko kufunekayo. Gcina amarekhod ezempilo, ubhaliso lwesivavvo, izibalo zenkonzo nembalo yentsukela zentsuku zonke. Sekela ngokuchanekileyo ilwanzwa leenkambelo ze-ultrasound ngeminiyonke, kubandakanya ukubeka ngapambili umthwalo weenkonzo, iindlela zokudlulisela abenginginya nokusetyenziswa koluntu olukhoyo. Phakamisa amaplandu kaBatho Pele, izimvo zoluntu ekukhuselwa komthinjwva ekunokuba nobuhlobo babantu, osapho lweentsapho zokulungiselela imimiselo ngokubonisana. Linganisa, qhuba ugqibe ngokomgaqo-nkqubo nokhuseleko ngamalungu, qamba amaxwebhu ngexesha ngokukhawuleza uze usekele ekugodlageni koluntu kwaye uthuthelwe ngokukhawuleza kumadoda. Khokeza, ulawule unikezele ngokukhawuleza ukuze uqinisekise amanyathelo okuqeqesha abasebenzi ababasha n abafundi ngaphakathi kwesithuba solawulo. Thabatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yokuqinisekisa umgangatho, iingxelo ezihamba-nye ezisesidimeni, imigudu yokhuseleko lengamandla zenkonzo ezikhupha ngokuphila ngokubakho. Kowunxibe imilinganisela yakho, ngokumthetho wamanye amazwe. Qwalasela, qhuba uze unakekele ngokukhuseleka kwamathuba e-ultrasound, uxele ngamasimba ngokukhawuleza uze usekele ukugcinwa koluntu kwenkonzo ekuhambayo. Nikeza ingcebiso, ukulawula, ukukhokela nokufundisa ngokwenene abasebenzi abasezantsi nakwabafundi ngaphakathi kwesithuba soqeqesho lobuchule. Thatha inxaxheba kukuqinisekisa umgangatho, kwi-odi zokuhlelwa kwamakliniki, kwimigudu yokukhuseleka iingxelo kwezenkonzo ezingcono ngokusigqiba ngokusondezela kwindalo. Mncedise ngemigaqo yekhondo yobuphofu, iimfuneko zokuGCina uKhuseleko kweMisebenzi eNkundla, iNkqubo ye-Sihlalo esiwugqatyo eLungileyo kweKlinikh eQinileyo, neMfuneko yeSixhobo seZempilo.

jobs.salary_text: Grade 1 R495 423 – R581 931 per annum. Other Benefits: 13th Cheques, Medical Aid (Optional), Housing Allowance: Employee must meet prescribed requirements.
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse specialising in neonatal nursing sought for Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, requiring SANC registration and a post-basic neonatal qualification.
jobs.requirements: Matric / Grade 12, Basic R425 qualification i.e. diploma/degree in nursing or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council as Professional Nurse Plus Current registration with the South Africa Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse PLUS A post basic qualification in the Neonatal specialty / Paediatric / Critical care with a duration of at least 1 year, accredited with the SANC. Experience Required: Grade 1: A minimum of 4 years appropriate or recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing and Midwifery and after obtaining the one year Post Basic Qualification in the speciality. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competence Required: Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes, and other relevant legal frameworks such as: Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Patient Rights Charter, Batho Pele Principles. Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Disciplinary Code and Procedure, Grievance Procedure, etc. Financial and budgetary knowledge pertaining to the relevant resources under management. Insight into procedures and policies pertaining to nursing care. Leadership, organizational, decision- making and problem solving abilities within the limit of the public sector and institutional policy framework. Interpersonal skills including public relations, negotiating, conflict handling and counselling skills. Computer skills in basic programmes.
jobs.duties: Coordination of optimal, holistic specialized nursing care provided within set standards and professional/legal framework. Manage effectively the utilization and supervision of resources. Human Resources: Planning of the allocation/change list, day and night duty and inputs for leave. Financial- Resource: Monitor financial resources with emphasis on cost containment and the keeping of all records within the financial policies regarding tenders, procurement and the policy regarding revenue generation, i.e. UPFS. Order and monitor appropriate levels of consumable i.e. according to norms. Services - Monitor services, i.e. linen and cleaning in conjunction with housekeeping staff. Monitor telephone use and keep records. Coordination of the provision of effective training and research. Provision of effective support to Nursing Services Maintain professional growth/ethical standards and self-development.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Spesialiteit (NEONATALE Verpleging)
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige wat in neonatale verpleging spesialiseer, gesoek vir Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, wat SANC-registrasie en 'n post-basiese neonatale kwalifikasie vereis.
af.requirements: Matric / Grade 12, Basiese R425-kwalifikasie d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleging of等效kwalityn watwysing wat registrasie met die South African Nursing Council as Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak Plus Huidige registrasie met die South Africa Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige PLUS 'n Post-basiese kwalifikasie in die Neonatale spesialiteit / Pediatries / Kritiese sorg met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar, geakkrediteer by die SANC. Ervaring Vereis: Graad 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar gepaste of herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige met die SANC in Algemene Verpleging en Vroukeskei en na verkryging van die een jaar Post-Basiese Kwalifikasie in die spesialiteit. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdheid Vereis: Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures, verpleegstatutes en ander relevante regskader soos: Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Patient Rights Charter, Batho Pele Principles. Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Disziplinêre Kode en Prosedure, Grievance Procedure, ens. Finansiële en begrotingskennis met betrekking tot die relevante hulpbronne onder bestuur. Insig in prosedures en beleide met betrekking tot verpleegsorg. Leierskap-, organisatoriese-, besluitneming- en probleemoplossingsvermoëns binne die limiet van die openbare sektor en institusionele beleidsraamwerk. Interpersoonlike vaardighede insluitend publieke betrekkinge, onderhandeling, konflikhantering en beradingsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardighede in basiese programme.
af.duties: Koordineering van optimale, holistiese gespesialiseerde verpleegsors verskaf binne vasgestelde standaarde en professionele/regskader. Bestuur effektief die benutting en toesig van hulpbronne. Menslike Hulpbronne: Beplanning van die toedelings/veranderingslyse, dag- en nagdiens en bydraes vir verlof. Finansiële-Hulpbron: Monitor finansiële hulpbronne met klem op kostebeheer en die byhou van alle rekords binne die finansiële beleide rakende tenders, verkryging en die beleid rakende inkomstegenerering, d.w.s. UPFS. Bestel en monitor toepaslike vlakke van verbruiksgoedere d.w.s. volgens norme. Dienste - Monitor dienste, d.w.s. linne en skoonmaak in samewerking met huishoudelike personeel. Monitor telefoongebruik en hou rekords. Koordineering van die verskaffing van effektiewe opleiding en navorsing. Verskaffing van effektiewe ondersteuning aan Verpleegdienste. Handhaaf professionele groei/etiese standaarde en selfontwikkeling.

zu.title: Umcushiwe kahle weziguli ohlukaniswe ngamakhono ( Ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezingakazalwa)
zu.summary: Kufunwa umunyuzi ohlukaniswe ngamakhono ekunakekelwa kwezingane ezingakazalwa esibhedlela i-Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital e-KwaZulu-Natal, okudinga ukubhaliswa ku-SANC nesidiwo sokufundela amakhono okunakekelwa kwezingane ezingakazalwa.
zu.requirements: I-Matric / I-Grade 12, isidiwo esiyisisekelo se-R425 okungukuthi idiploma/idigri ekunyuzini noma isidiwo esilinganayo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council njengomunyuzi ohlukaniswe ngamakhono KANJESI Ukubhaliswa kwamanje kwi-South Africa Nursing Council (SANC) njengomunyuzi ohlukaniswe ngamakhono KANJESI Isidiwo sokufundela amakhono okunakekelwa kwezingane ezingakazalwa / abantwana / ukunakekelwa okuyinkinga, ngobudlebe obungenani unyaka oyedwa, esamkelwe yi-SANC. Isipiliphi esidingekayo: I-Grade 1: Ukubekezela okungenani eminyakeni engu-4 kokuhlakanipha noma okuqashelwayo ekunyuzini emva kokubhaliswa njengomunyuzi ohlukaniswe ngamakhono kwi-SANC ekunyuzini jikelele nasekubhekeleni lokubeletha, nangemva kokuthola isidiwo sonyaka oyedwa sokufundela amakhano ohlukanisiwe. Ulwazi, amakhono, ukuqeqeshwa nokuqashelwa okudingekayo: Ulwazi ngemikhuba nendlela yokunakekela amagula, izimiso zokunyuzi, futhi namanye emikhakha yomthetho ehlobene naleyo njengoba: i-Nursing Act, i-Health Act, i-Occupational Health and Safety Act, i-Patient Rights Charter, Izimiso zoMthetho woMphakathi. I-Public Service Regulations, i-Labour Relations Act, i-Disciplinary Code and Procedure, i-Grievance Procedure, njll. Ulwazi lwezimali nalebhalansi mayelana nezinsiza ezibhekelelwa. Ukuthola ukuqondisisa ngemikhuba kanye namapholisi ahlobene nokunakekela amagula. Amakhono okuhlola, ahlela, okuthatha izinqumo kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga ngaphakathi kwegcegu lomthetho wesikhungo sawonke wonke kanye nolwesikhungo. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu okuhlanganisa ubudlelwano nomphakathi, ukuxoxisana, ukuphatha izinkinga, kanye namakhono okweluleka. Amakhono okusebenzisa ikhompuyutha ezinhlelweni eziyisisekelo.
zu.duties: Ukuhlanganisa ukunakekelwa okungcono kakhulu, okuphelele kwamagula ahlinzekwa ngemva kwemithetho ehlanganiswe nangaphakathi kwesakhono somthetho. Uphathe kahle ukusetshenziswa nokuqondisa izinsiza. Abasebenzi: Ukuhlela ukwabiwa / uluhlu lwesikhathi, isikhathi sosuku nobusuku, kanye nokufaka iziphakamiso zeholide. Izimali - Izinsiza: Qapha izinsiza zezimali kugcizelele ekugcineni izindleko kanye nokugcina zonke iziqophiso ngaphakathi kwamapholisi ezezimali mayelana nezinkontileka, ukuthenga, kanye napholisi mayelana nokukhiqiza ingeniso, okungukuthi i-UPFS. Faka izinkomba futhi uqaphe amazinga afanele okusetshenziswa okwenziwa okutholakala, njengoba kumisiwe. Iminikelo - Qapha iminikelo, okungukuthi izingubo nokuhlanzwa, ngokubambisana nabasebenzi bokugcina isikhungo sihle. Qapha ukusetshenziswa kwefoni futhi ugcine iziqophiso. Ukuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngeqeqesho elisebenzayo kanye nocwaningo. Ukuhlinzeka ngokusekelwa okusebenzayo kuNkonzo Yokunyuzi. Ukugcina ukukhula kwesikhono / amazinga omthetho kanye nokuzithuthukisa.

xh.title: Umunathi weHlengikazi oQeqwe iNdlela ethile (UGUNYA lokuNika ukhathalelo kwiBhabhane eNtsha)
xh.summary: Kufuneki gqa iHlengikazi eQeqwe ngobuchule bokukhathalela iibhabhane ezingatshanga kwindawo yokulaliswa eziko lokhathalelo lwamazwe empiya iDr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, kwaye kufuneka abhalwe kwiSANC kwaye aneNdemeyer yokuqeqeswa kobugcisa ekukhathaleleni iibhabhane ezingatshanga.
xh.requirements: iMatric / uMlinganiselo wamaBango ali-12, isiqu esiyimfuno sika-R425 eso ngamagama athetha idiploma/idigri ekukhathaleleni abagula okanye esinye isiqu esinjalo esivumela ukubhalwa kwiBhunga lokuQeqesha laseMzantsi Afrika njengaseHlengikazi eQeqwe kanjalo nesibhalo sangoku kwiBhunga lokuQeqesha laseMzantsi Afrika (SANC) njengeHlengikazi eQeqwe KANJALO nesiqu sokuba ngumntu ogqithiweyo ekukhathaleleni amabhinqa abantwana abanganamzimba / ezingabantwana abasebethi / ekukhathaleleni abagula abasemngciphekweni ubude bexesha bengaphantsi kwamnyaka o-1 ubuncinane, esamkelwe yiSANC. Iimfuno zokuQonda ngokomzwangedwa: IBhasa 1: Ubuncinane beminyaka engu-4 yamava aqondileyo okanye abonwayo ekukhathaleleni abagula emva kokubhalwa njengeHlengikazi eQeqwe kwiSANC kwiQeqesho loManyano nokuNika ubele nasekuPhumeleleni isiqu sokugqitha kwakhona kwangemva kwexesha elonge inyaka elinye sika-R425 obuyimfuno ekubanzi ekubuchutheni. ULwazi, amakhono, uQeqesho namandla afunekayo: Ukwazi iinkqubo nezithethe zokukhathalela abagula, izigwebo ezichaza umthetho wehlonzi, nezinye iinkqubo zomthetho ezinjengeS: uMthetho weHlengikazi, uMthetho weMpilo, uMthetho weMpilo ekuSebenzeni nokuHlawula iingozi, isatifikethi samalungelo omguli, imigaqo yeBatho Pele. Iimigaqo yoMnyango weKhalende, uMthetho weQumrhu loBahlali, iNkqubo yoQeqesho nokuLungelelanisa, iNkqubo yokuziva iingxaki, njlknjl. ULwazi ngenkqubo yemali nemigangatho yemali ngokuthatha iindleko emithethweni ngovimba wolwazi ekuyimduliyo. Ukuqonda iinkqubo neenkqubomgqbo ezithinta ukukhathalela abagula. Amandla okukhokela, okuhlela, okwenza izigqibo nokusombulula iingxaki ngaphakathi kwemida wengingqi yoluntu nenguqu yeNkqubo yoBume beNtshiqelo. Amandla okuziphathisa nabantu aquka ubudlelwane boluntu, ukuqoqwa kweenkcazelo, ukuphatha iingxabano nokuqeqesha abantu bokudibana neengxaki zabo. Amakhono okusebenzisa ikhompyutha kweenkqubo eziyimfuno.
xh.duties: Ukulungelelanisa ukuhleleka koluntu, kukhathalelo ngokupheleleyo lweNdalo lweHlengikazi ekunikelwa ngaphakathi kweenkqubo ezingqinelanayo nakuBakho lweliNgesi nakuBakho loMthetho. Ukuqonda ubuchule kokusebenzisa nokuqondisa iindleko. uVimba wabantu: ukwakha uluhlu lokuNika iNkundla, imini nosuku kwaye ufake izicelo zokuNika iNkundla. iMali - iVimba: Qonda iindleko zemali ngokuziphatha ngokusindisa iindleko nokugcina zonke iirekhodi ngokweMigaqo yeNkqubo yokuNika iNkundla ngokweemfuno ezinje ngemiba yokukhethwa, iNkqubo yokuthenga kwaye nakuMthetho weNkqubo yokuzuzisa imali, oko ngamagama athetha iinkqubo eziyimfuno eziphantsi kwemithetho yokwenza imali engenayo. Yifaka kwaye ulawule ukulinganisa kwemigangatho yemiba yokutya ekulinganiswayo ngokomthetho. iinkonzo - Qonda iinkonzo, oko kukuthi ukwathuwa koluntu kwaye kucothiswe uluntu ngokuhamba phambili nemisebenzi yenkqubo yokuKhathalela abagula boluntu. Qonda ukusetyenziswa kolwazi waye ugqibe iintshukumo nokuQeqesha abantu bokukwazi ukwenza ulwazi nokuQonda iinkqubo ngokupheleleyo. Nikela ngokusebenzisa imisebenzi nokuQeqesha abantu iNkqubo yokukhathalela iHlengikazi ngokupheleleyo. Ukugcina ukukhula koluntu / iinkqubo zomthetho weNkqubo yokuziphatha nokuzithuthisa.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Specialty (OBSTETRICS and
jobs.salary_text: Grade1: R495 423 - R581 931 per annum Grade2: R607 350 - R752 913 per annum
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse specialising in obstetrics at Umphumulo Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, requiring SANC registration and at least four years of nursing experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1: A minimum of four (4) years appropriate / recognizable experience as a Professional Nurse with South African Council in general nursing. Grade 2: A minimum of fourteen (14) years appropriate / recognizable experience as a Professional Nurse with SANC in general Nursing of which at least ten (10) years must be appropriate / recognizable experience in maternity after obtaining the post basic qualification of Advanced Midwifery. Diploma / Degree in General Nursing and Midwifery. Registration with the S.A.N.C. as a Professional Nurse and midwife. A post basic nursing qualification in Advanced Midwifery, accredited with the South African Nursing Council. Current (2026) council receipt if shortlisted. Proof of current and previous experience endorsed by the HR department (if shortlisted). Understanding of nursing legislation and related legal and ethical nursing practices. Ability to perform clinical nursing practice in accordance with the scope of practice and nursing standards. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Decision making and problem-solving skills. Knowledge of Code of Conduct and Labour Relations and related policies. Ability to formulate patient related policies Basic understanding of HR and Financial policies and procedures. Basic computer literacy.
jobs.duties: Demonstrate effective communication with patients, supervisors, other health professionals and junior colleagues, including more complex report writing when required. Work effectively and amicably at a supervisory level, with persons of diverse intellectual, cultural, racial or religious differences. Display a concern for patients, promoting, advocating and facilitating proper treatment and care and ensuring that the section adheres to the principles of Batho Pele. Diagnose and manage obstetric emergencies in the absence of a Medical Officer ie. eclampsia, APH etc. Identify high risk clients during ante-partum and post-partum periods and manage or refer in accordance to hospital policy. Develop, implement and review obstetric policies and procedures. Develop quality improvement programs for obstetrics. Conduct Perinatal Mortality reviews or meetings. Implement EPMDS and identify staff training needs. Conduct in-service education for all obstetric staff. Participate in all obstetric programs ie. PPIP, PMTCT, BBI, BFI, and RHC – reproductive health. Practice participative management by assisting with relief duties of the supervisor. Maintain accurate and complete patient records. Ensure proper utilization of resources and exercise care over government property.
jobs.enquiries: Ms P Matlou Tel No: (032) 4814199
jobs.applications: Please forward application quoting the reference number to The Human Resource Department, Umphumulo Hospital, Private Bag X9219, Maphumulo 4470 or hand delivered to Umphumulo Hospital, R74 Greytown Road, Maphumulo, 4470. email to: raban.chirwa@kznhealth.gov.za / Zinhle.zulu@kznhealth.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : Ms ZP Zulu Tel No: (032) 481 4180
jobs.notes: Application must be submitted on the Application for Employment Form (Form Z.83), which is obtainable at any Government Department or from the website – www.kznhealth.gov.za must be accurately completed and signed. Reference Number must be indicated in the column provided on the form Z.83 together with a comprehensive CV only. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications, ID and other relevant documents with the application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of documents and proof of current and previous work experience (certificate of Service) endorsed and stamped by the Human Resource department on or before the day of the interview. Persons with disabilities should feel free to apply for the post. Shortlisted applicants in possession of a foreign qualification will have to submit an evaluation/verification certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) or other regulating bodies on the day of interview. Non- RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident/ Work Permit holders must submit a documentary proof if shortlisted. This Department is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer, whose aim is to promote representatively in all levels of all occupational categories in the Department. The appointment is subject to positive outcome obtained from the following checks: security clearance, credit records, qualification, citizenship and previous experience verifications. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process Failure to comply with the aforementioned instructions will results to your application being disqualified. Applicants are respectfully informed that, if no notification of appointment is received within 3 months after the closing date, they must accept that their applications were unsuccessful. Please note that due to financial constraints, there will be no payment of S&T claims.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Spesialiteit (OBSTETRIE en
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige wat spesialiseer in obstetrie by Umphumulo Hospitaal in KwaZulu-Natal, wat SANC-registrasie en ten minste vier jaar verpleegervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 1: 'n Minimum van vier (4) jaar gepaste / erkende ervaring as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die Suid-Afrikaanse Raad in algemene verpleging. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van veertien (14) jaar gepaste / erkende ervaring as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige met SANC in algemene Verpleging waarvan ten minste tien (10) jaar gepaste / erkende ervaring in verloskunde moet wees na die verkryging van die nagraadse kwalifikasie in Gevorderde Verloskunde. Diploma / Graad in Algemene Verpleging en Verloskunde. Registrasie by die S.A.N.C. as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige en vroedvrou. 'n Nagraadse verpleegkwalifikasie in Gevorderde Verloskunde, geakkrediteer by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad. Huidige (2026) raadskwitansie indien gelys. Bewys van huidige en vorige ervaring wat deur die HR-departement onderskryf is (indien gelys). Begrip van verpleegwetgewing en verwante wetlike en etiese verpleegpraktyke. Vermoë om kliniese verpleegpraktyk uit te voer in ooreenstemming met die omvang van praktyk en verpleegstandaarde. Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Besluitneming en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Kennis van Gedragskode en Arbeidsverhoudinge en verwante beleide. Vermoë om pasiëntverwante beleide te formuleer Basiese begrip van HR- en finansiële beleide en prosedures. Basiese rekenaarvaardigheid.
af.duties: Toon effektiewe kommunikasie met pasiënte, toesighouers, ander gesondheidsprofessionele en junior kollegas, insluitend meer komplekse verslagskrywing wanneer vereis. Werk effektief en vriendelik op toesighoudende vlak, met persone van uiteenlopende intellektuele, kulturele, rasse- of godsdienstige verskille. Toon besorgdheid vir pasiënte, bevorder, beywer en fasiliteer behoorlike behandeling en sorg en verseker dat die afdeling voldoen aan die beginsels van Batho Pele. Diagnoseer en bestuur verloskundige noodgevalle in die afwesigheid van 'n Mediese Beampte bv. eklampsie, APH ens. Identifiseer hoërisiko-kliënte gedurende die antepartum en postpartum periodes en bestuur of verwys in ooreenstemming met hospitaalbeleid. Ontwikkel, implementeer en hersien verloskundige beleide en prosedures. Ontwikkel gehalteverbeteringsprogramme vir obstetrie. Voer perinatale mortaliteits hersienings of vergaderings uit. Implementeer EPMDS en identifiseer personeelopleidingsbehoeftes. Voer in-diensopleiding vir alle verloskundige personeel uit. Neem deel aan alle verloskundige programme bv. PPIP, PMTCT, BBI, BFI, en RHC – voortplantingsgesondheid. Beoefen deelnemende bestuur deur te help met verpligtingspligte van die toesighouer. Onderhou akkurate en volledige pasiëntrekords. Verseker behoorlike benutting van hulpbronne en oefen sorg uit oor regerings eiendom.

zu.title: Uthisha wezokunakekela ogwethwe ngesikhundla (OBSTETRICS nakwezoku
zu.summary: Uthisha wezokunakekela ogwethwe ngesikhundla ogxile kwezokubeletha esibhedlela i-Umphumulo e-KwaZulu-Natal, ofuna ukubhaliswa ku-SANC futhi abe nobuhle bonye unyaka wokuhlala nangaphezulu ekuqashweni komsebenzi wezokunakekela.
zu.requirements: Izinga 1: Okungenani amashumi amane (4) unyaka wokuhlalela okufanelekile / okwaziwayo njengomthisha wezokunakekela ogwethwe ngesikhundla ohlotshaniswa ne-South African Council ekuqashweni komsebenzi wezokunakekela jikelele. Izinga 2: Okungenaka amashumi amane nane (14) unyaka wokuhlalela okufanelekile / okwaziwayo njengomthisha wezokunakekela ogwethwe ngesikhundla ohlotshaniswa ne-SANC ekuqashweni komsebenzi wezokunakekela jikelele, okokho okungenako amashumi (10) okumele kube ukuhlalela okufanelekile / okwaziwayo kwababelethi ngemuva kokuthola izifundo zangemva kwesikhundla sokubeletha okuthuthukisiwe. Isitifikedi / I-degree ekuqashweni komsebenzi wezokunakekela jikelele nakuqashweni komsebenzi wokubeletha. Ukubhaliswa ku-S.A.N.C. njengomthisha wezokunakekela ogwethwe ngesikhundla nathile ogwethwe ukubeletha. Isifundo sezokunakekela sangemva kwesikhundla sokubeletha okuthuthukisiwe, esethweswe isibambakushokiwe i-South African Nursing Council. Isitifikedi samanje (2026) senkolo uma ngabe uluhluwe. Isiqinisekiso sobuhle bokuhlala nangaphambili esiqinisekiswe umnyango we-HR (uma uluhluwe). Ukuqonda umthetho wezokunakekela kanye nemithetho ehlobene nokuqashwa komsebenzi wezokunakekela ngemithetho nasemigomeni. Ikono lokuqasha ukunakekelwa ngokwezokwelapha ngokuhambisana nendawo yokusebenza futhi ngokwemigomo yezokunakekela. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle nabantu kanye nokuhlobana kwabanye. Amakhono okuthatha izinqumo nokuxazula izinkinga. Ulwazi lwekhodi lokuziphatha kanye nezenzubantathu zomsebenzi namagunya ahlobene nayo. Ikono lokwakha amagunya ahlobene n iziguli. Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo nangemigomo nezenkambiso zomnyango we-HR noma zezezimali. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha ngokuyisisekelo.
zu.duties: Bonisa ukuxhumana okusebenzayo neziguli, oqashiwe, abanye ochwepheshe bezempilo futhi n othisha abangaphansi kwakho, okuhlanganisa ukubhala imibiko eyinkimbinkimbi uma kudingeka. Sebenza ngokusebenzayo futhi ngokuzwana ngezulu, esigabeni sokuqasha, kanye nabantu abehlukene ngezinga lobuchwepheshe, isiko, uhlanga noma inkolo. Bonisa ukukhathazeka ngeziguli, ukuthuthukisa, ukusekela futhi wenze lula ukwelapha nokunakekelwa okufanele, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ingxenye ihloniphe imigomo yokuqondisa i-Batho Pele. Qapha futhi uphathe izimo eziphuthumayo zokubeletha ekungekho kudokotela njenge-eclampsia, i-APH nokunye. Hlaba abathengi abasesandleni esibhedlela nangemuva kokubeletha baphathwe noma bathunyelwe ngokuhambisana nemigomo yesibhedlela. Buthuthukisa, uqashe futhi ubuyekeze amagunya kanye nesenzo sokubeletha. Buthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphucula ikhwalithi kwizokubeletha. Qasha izinkampani zokubuyelela noma iimithetho yokuhlolwa kwezokubeletha. Qashe i-EPMDS futhi uhlole izidingo zokuqeqesha abasebenzi. Yenza imfundo yokuhlolwa kule ndawo yezokubeletha bonke othisha. Thatha inxaxhele ezinhlelweni zokubeletha njenge-PPIP, PMTCT, BBI, BFI, futhi RHC – ukunakekelwa kwesibeletho. Zenza imizamo yokuphatha ngokubambana ngokwesekela kumsebenzi wekosulu wokuqashiwe. Gcina ukushicilelwa okuyiqiniso kanye nokuqediwe kokubhala iziguli. Qaphela ukusetshenziswa okuhle kwezinsizakalo futhi uhlole ngokunakekelwa ngokwemplilo eyisipho sikaHulumeni.

xh.title: Uongikazi oGwebu ekwimeko ye-OBSTETRICS noku
xh.summary: Uongikazi oGwebu ogqitha kwimeko yobuzali kwiSibhedlele saseUmphumulo eKwaZulu-Natal, kufuneka abhalwe kwiSANC abe nokunokhobela isiqingatha somsebenzi wokugcina ongaphela kwamnyaka wamane wonke.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba 1: Ukuba nobugqitha obungapheli kwamnyaka wamane (4) wokhobela olufanelekileyo / olusemthethweni njengoGqitha kwiBhunga leNtlalontle laseMzantsi Afrika kulonwadi lwezonyango. Inqanaba 2: Ukuba nobugqitha obungapheli kwamnyaka wamane aneshumi (14) wokhobela olufanelekileyo / oluseni njengoGqitha kwiBhunga leNtlalontle kwiNtlalontle lwezonyango, apho ongapheli kwamnyaka wamashumi (10) kufuneka abe ngumsebenzi ofanelekileyo / osemthethweni kwindlu yokuzalwa emva kokufumana isidanga sezonyango sendalo eqeqeshwe kwiBhunga leziBoneki. Isidanga kwiNqanaba lesiBini kumsebenzi wokuhlonza ekwibhalwe kwiBhunga leziBoneki laseMzantsi Afrika. Ubuchule bokubhala iingxelo ezibalulekileyo kwaye unamava wokusebenza nabantu abahlukene kwindalo, inkolo okunye iindalo. Ubuchule bokuxhasa iinkqubo zokulungisa iingxaki ezinxulumene nemiba yamagunyaziso. Ubuchule bokwenza izigqibo kunye nokusombulula iingxaki. Ulwazi lweNqumbo yokuZiphatha nemithelela yokuSebenza kwaye ulwazi lolawulo. Ulwazi ngokusetyenziswa kweekhompyutha. Ulwazi lokuqonda iinkqubo zemali neentsapho.
xh.duties: Bonisa ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo nabaguli, ootshitshi, oogqitha bemithi kunye namakhoboka amancinci, kuquka nobuchule bokubhala iingxelo ezinzima xa kufuneka. Sebenza ngokusebenziseka kwaye unobulumko kwinqanaba lolawulo, abantu abehlukene kwiingqondo, kwindalo, kumbala okunye inkolo. Bonisa inkathalo ngabaguli, ukukhuthaza, ukukhusela nokukhokela unyango olufanelekileyo nokuqinisekisa ukuba candelo lulandela iimiso kaBatho Pele. Yonga ulawula imiba enganto yobuzali ekungeni kokugqithwa kwexesha soGqitha wezonyango njengoko ukuxhentsha, ukubethwa amathambo kunye neento ezahlukeneyo. Qaphela abathengi abasengozini enkulu kwizithuba zangaphambi nokubetha indalo baze balawule okanye bakhuphe ngokulandela iNqumbo yesibhedlele. Zenze, zisebenzise kwaye uhlole iinkqubo zokulawula iinkqubo zokugcina ulwazi lwabaguli. Qeqesha abasebenzi kumsebenzi wokuhlonza kumaxesha onke. Hlanganyela kumanqwanqwa onke amanyathelo okungena emsebenzini okukhethiweyo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Supply Chain Management
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 – R573 897 per annum. Other Benefits: 13TH Cheque, (Medical Aid Optional) Plus Housing allowance.
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Supply Chain Management within the KwaZulu-Natal Department of Health, managing procurement, demand planning and SCM resources.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 / Matric or equivalent, An appropriate Degree / National Diploma in Supply Chain Management or equivalent plus at least 3 years’ appropriate supervisory experience in Supply Chain Management. Unendorsed Valid driver’s license. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies [Ne1.1]. Knowledge of Public Finance Management Act, Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act, Health SCM Delegations. Good communication, leadership, interpersonal and decision making qualities. Sound management, negotiation, inter-personal, decision making and solving problems. Knowledge of Treasury Regulations and Practice Notes. Good verbal and written communication skills. Knowledge of current Health Legislation and policies at Public Institutions. Ability to handle sensitive financial information in strictest confidence. Working knowledge of the Basic Accounting Systems (BAS)/ LOGIS and understand Promotion of Access of Information Act. Knowledge on Security Management Act. Computer literacy in MS Word and Excel.
jobs.duties: Manage demand planning, procurement of goods and services, quotations and bids in line with the Hospital Annual Operational Plan and approved procurement plan. Ensure efficient, economical and accountable management of SCM personnel, budgets and other allocated resources. Engage end users and stakeholders to identify procurement needs, service-delivery gaps and SCM compliance risks. Provide management with sound SCM advice, recommendation and corrective actions on procurement and contract matters. Communicate and implement applicable SCM circulars, policies amendments, Treasury instructions and practice notes. Ensure transparent, fair, competitive and cost-effective procurement and compliance with applicable legislation and delegations. Provide technical guidance to hospital management on acquisition, logistics, contract administration and supplier performance. Implement and monitor SCM procedure, internal controls, requisitions, purchase orders, good receipt and record keeping in preparation for Audits. Compile and analyse monthly SCM performance, procurement, contract, accrual and compliance reports, address exceptions promptly. Participate in multidisciplinary management structures to align SCM activities with clinical and operational priorities. Manage SCM operations and staff performance, including procurement turnaround times, LOGIS processes and asset controls. Ensure sound strategies to avoid Unauthorized, Irregular, Fruitless and Wasteful Expenditure and Reports thereof. Identify staff skills gaps, coordinate SCM training and promote continuous development and ethical conduct. Monitor compliance with the PFMA, Treasury Regulations, departmental SCM framework and supply chain prescripts, prevent and report irregular expenditure.
jobs.enquiries: Mrs. N. Mthembu (Deputy Director: Finance) Tel No: (036) 637 2111
jobs.applications: All applications should be emailed to LadysmithHospital.Job@kznhealth.gov.za / erick.ngxongo@kznhealth.gov.za or be posted to: The Human Resource Management, Ladysmith Regional Hospital, Private Bag X9928, Ladysmith, 3370 or Hand delivery to: The Human Resource Management Offices, Ladysmith Regional Hospital, Office No: 15, 36 Malcom Road, Ladysmith, 3370. FOR ATTENTION : Mr S.L.Dlozi
jobs.notes: This Department is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer, whose aim is to promote representivity in all levels of all occupational categories in the Department. Note: The contents of this Circular Minute must be brought to the notice of all eligible officers and employees on your establishment of all Institutions. Institutions must notify all candidates who qualify for post in this circular minute even if they are absent from their normal places of work to apply. Direction to Candidates: the following documents must be submitted: Application for Employment form (Z83) which is obtainable from any Government Department OR from the website - www.kznhealth.gov.za.The application form (Z83) must be accompanied by a detailed Curriculum Vitae only. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. The reference number must be indicated in the column provided on the form Z83 and on the back of the envelope, e.g. Ref 13/2018. NB: Failure to comply with the above instructions will disqualify applicants. Person with disabilities should feel free to apply for these posts. The appointment is subject to positive outcome obtained from the NIA the following checks (security clearance, credit records, qualification, citizenship and previous experience employment verification). Failure to comply will result in the application not being considered”. Due to the large number of applications, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged. However, correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Please note that due to financial constraint no S&T claims will be considered for payment to the candidates that are invited for an interview. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate's suitability based on the post's technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Toesienkettingbestuur
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur: Toesienkettingbestuur binne die KwaZulu-Natal Department of Health, wat verkryging, vraagbeplanning en SCM-bronne bestuur.
af.requirements: Graad 12 / Matrik of gelykwaardig, 'n Toepaslike graad / Nasionale diploma in Toesienkettingbestuur of gelykwaardig plus ten minste 3 jaar se toepaslike toesighoudende ervaring in Toesienkettingbestuur. Onbeëindigde geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis, vaardighede, opleiding en bevoegdhede [Ne1.1. Kennis van Public Finance Management Act, Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act, Health SCM Delegations. Goeie kommunikasie-, leierskaps-, interpersoonlike en besluitnemingskwaliteite. Deeglike bestuur, onderhandeling, interpersoonlike vaardighede, besluitneming en probleemoplossing. Kennis van Treasury Regulations and Practice Notes. Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Kennis van huidige Health Legislation en beleide by openbare instellings. Vermoë om sensitiewe finansiële inligting in die strengste vertrouelikheid te hanteer. Werkende kennis van Basic Accounting Systems (BAS)/ LOGIS en begrip van Promotion of Access of Information Act. Kennis van Security Management Act. Rekenaarvaardigheid in MS Word en Excel.
af.duties: Bestuur vraagbeplanning, verkryging van goedere en dienste, kwotasies en bieë in ooreenstemming met die Hospital Annual Operational Plan en goedgekeurde verkrygingsplan. Verseker doeltreffende, ekonomiese en verantwoordelike bestuur van SCM-personeel, begrotings en ander toegekende bronne. Betrek eindgebruikers en belanghebbendes om verkrygingsbehoeftes, diensleweringsgapings en SCM-nakomingsrisiko's te identifiseer. Verskaf bestuur met deeglike SCM-advies, aanbevelings en korrektiewe maatreëls oor verkrygings- en kontrakakele. Kommunikeer en implementeer toepaslike SCM-sirkuliere, beleidswysigings, Treasury-instruksies en praktisnotas. Verseker deursigtige, regverdige, mededingende en kostedoeltreffende verkryging en nakoming van toepaslike wetgewing en delegasies. Verskaf tegniese leiding aan hospitaalbestuur oor verkryging, logistiek, kontrakadministrasie en verskafferprestasie. Implementeer en monitor SCM-prosedures, interne kontroles, versoeke, aankoopbestellings, ontvangs van goedere en rekordhouding ter voorbereiding vir oudits. Stel op en ontleed maandelikse SCM-prestasie-, verkrygings-, kontrak-, toegeken- en nakomingsverslae, en hanteer uitsonderings onmiddellik. Neem deel aan multidissiplinêre bestuursstrukture om SCM-aktiwiteite met kliniese en operasionele prioriteite te bely. Bestuur SCM-bedrywighede en personeelprestasie, insluitend verkryging-omkeertye, LOGIS-prosesse en bateskontroles. Verseker deeglike strategieë om ongemagtigde, onreëlmatige, vrugtelose en vermorsende uitgawes en verslae daaroor te vermy. Identifiseer personeelsvaardigheidsgapings, koördineer SCM-opleiding en bevorder deurlopende ontwikkeling en etiese gedrag. Monitor nakoming van die PFMA, Treasury Regulations, departementele SCM-raamwerk en toesienkettingvoorskrifte, en voorkom en rapporteer onreëlmatige uitgawes.

zu.title: Umncedisi womqondisi: Ukuphathwa kweNtoxho
zu.summary: Umncedisi womqondisi: Ukuphathwa kweNtoxho kuKwaZulu-Natal Department of Health, uphatha ukuthenga, ukuletha izidingo kanye nezinsiza zokuphathwa kweNtoxho.
zu.requirements: Grade 12 / Matric noma okufana nayo, I-degree / National Diploma ehambelana ne-Supply Chain Management noma okufana nayo futhi okungenani ungamava eminyaka engu-3 okuhlola kwi-Supply Chain Management. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekwe engenamaphuzu. Ulwazi, Amakhono, ukuqeqeshwa namaKhono [Ne1.1]. Ulwazi nge-Public Finance Management Act, Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act, kanye ne-Health SCM Delegations. Amakhono okuxhumana abuhle, abokuba ngumholi, phakathi kwabantu kanye nokuqumba izinqumo. Ukuphathwa okuhle, ukuxoxisana, phakathi kwabantu, ukuqumba izinqumo kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ulwazi nge-Treasury Regulations kanye ne-Practice Notes. Amakhono abuhle okukhuluma nokubhala. Ulwazi nge-mthetho yezempilo njengamanje kanye nemigomo kuma-Public Institutions. Ikhono lokuphatha ulwazi lwezimali oluzwelayo ngokugcwele. Ulwazi lomsebenzi nge-Basic Accounting Systems (BAS)/ LOGIS kanye nokuqonda i-Promotion of Access of Information Act. Ulwazi nge-Security Management Act. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha kwi-MS Word kanye ne-Excel.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuletha izidingo, ukuthenga izimpahla kanye nesevisi, okushunqwaywayo kanye nama-bids ngokuhambisana ne-Hospital Annual Operational Plan kanye nendlela yokuthenga evunyiwe. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenza kahle, okuzenzele ngokwezimali noma okunakekelwa kwezemali kubasebenzi be-SCM, amabhujethi kanye nezinye izinsiza eznikiwe. Xhumana nabasebenzisi abaphela nabanomthelela ukuze ubone izidingo zokuthenga, amasomu okuletha isevisi kanye nengozi yokungahambisana ne-SCM. Nikeza abaphathi ngeluleko eluhlumba le-SCM, izinkomba kanye nezinye izenzo zokulungisa ngemicelo yokuqasha kanye nemibandela yamakontrathi. Xhumana futhi usebenzise imiyalezo ye-SCM, inguquko zemigomo, imiyalo ye-Treasury kanye nama-practice notes. Qinisekisa ukuthenga okusobala, okubulungile, okuncintisana ngako noma okungalibazisi kwezimali kanye nokuhambisana ngemithetho nemvume. Nikeza abaphathi besibhedlela ngokuqondisa okuhlumulwazi ngokutholwa, ukuletha kwezimpahla, ukuphathwa kwamakontrathi kanye nokuqhutywa kahle ngabahlinzeki. Sebenzisa futhi uhlole indlela yokusebenza ye-SCM, izintshingo zangaphakathi, izicelo, ama-purchase orders, ukutholwa kwempahla nokugcina izikhomeli ukuze kulungele i-Audits. Hlela futhi hlaziya ngamanyanga umbhalo wakho nge-SCM, ukuthenga, amakontrathi, ukubalwa kwemali ekade kanye nemibhalo yokuhambisana ngemithetho, uphendule noma yiziphi izenzo ezingajwayelekile ngokushesha. Thatha inxaxheba kuma-divisions amaningi okuphatha ukuze uhlehlise izenzo ze-SCM nokuqakulisana nezindima kwezempilo kanye nezokusebenza. Phatha izinsiza ezingokuphathwa kwe-SCM kanye nokwenza kahle kwabasebenzi, okuhlanganisa isikhathi sokuphendula kwezinsiza ezingokuthenga, izinqubo ze-LOGIS nokulawula impahla. Qinisekisa ngamasu ahle ukugwema okushukunyiswa, okungalungile, okungalidingi nasechitheke okudlula isidingo kanye nemibhalo yazo. Hlola amasomu kakhono abasebenzi, hlanganisa ukuqeqeshwa kwe-SCM futhi ukhuthaze ukuthuthukiswa ngokuphinda noma ngokuqhubeka kanye nokuziphatha ngokuzethemba. Hlola ukuthi kuhambisana yini ne-PFMA, izintshingo ze-Treasury, nendlela yokuqasha ye-SCM yomnyango kanye nemithetho yokuthengisa, ukuvimbela nokubika okungalungile ngokwezimali.

xh.title: iMongamzi oncedayo: uLawulo loQhagamshelwano lweziQinisekiso
xh.summary: iMongamzi oncedayo: uLawulo loQhagamshelwano lweziQinisekiso ngaphakathi kwiSebe lezeMpilo eKwaZulu-Natal, elalawula ukuthengwa kwezinto, ukuqeleliswa kwesicelo kwayo nesixhobo sokusebenza se-SCM.
xh.requirements: IGraji ye-12 / iMatrik okanye ezingqiqo, iDigri / iDiploma yeSizwe efanelekileyo kuLawulo loQhagamshelwano lweziQinisekiso okanye ezingqiqo ngaphezu kokuba nobugcisa obulinganiselwe kwiminyaka engama-3 bokuba nogcisa olulawulayo olinikezelwe kuLawulo loQhagamshelwano lweziQinisekiso. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba eza kwaye engagqintelwanga. ulwazi, amakhono, uqeqesho namandla okusebenza [Ne1.1]. Ulwazi ngeMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoLuntu, uMthetho weMigaqo yokuThandwa kolwazi, kwaye nomthetho wokusebenza kwezeMpilo. Ubuncinane bokuziphatha bokubonakalisa, ukulawula abantu, nokwenza izigqibo. Ukulawula okulungileyo, ukuxoxa ngokuncedisana, ukuqonda nabantu, ukuqamba izigqibo nokuxazulula iingxaki. Ulwazi lweMigaqo yoBucala kwaye ulwazi oluqinileyo ngokuthetha nokubhala. Ulwazi ngomthetho osebenzayo wezeMpilo nemigaqo kwiZiko loLuntu. Ukwazi ukuphatha ulwazi oluzenzekileyo ngemfihlo enkulu. Ulwazi olusebenzayo lweenkqubo zokuBala iimali (BAS)/ LOGIS kwaye uqonde ukuKhuthazwa kokufikelela kolwazi. Ulwazi ngeMithetho yoLawulo. Ulwazi lokusebenzela ngekhompyutha kwi-MS Word neExcel.
xh.duties: Lawula uqeleliswa kwesicelo, ukuthengwa kwempahla namacebo, okokuba kuthengiswe ngentlalo nangemigca nangengqondo esebenzisa iplaani yokusebenza yonyaka leSibhedlele neplaani yokuthenga evunyiweyo. Qinisekisa ukulawula okusebenzayo, kokugcina imali nokuba nexesha abantu be-SCM, imali ebonelelwayo nabezinye izixhobo abanikezelweyo. Thatha abasebenzisi nabanomdla ukuze uchaze iimfuno zokuthenga, izikhewu zokuzezelwa inkonzo namaxhala okuvumelana ne-SCM. Nikeza abalawuli ingcebiso ezigqibweni ngee-SCM, iingcebiso neminyuzo yokuqumba into nengxaki yokuthengisa nangemithetho yolwazi. Thetha kwaye usebenzise imigaqo yemigaqo ekhoyo, i-SCM, izimvo zomthetho, iingcebiso zeTreasury kunye noqeqesho. Qinisekisa ukuthengwa okuzenzekileyo, okulungileyo, okunciphisa imali kunye nokuvumelana nomthetho. Qinisekisa ukuthethwa ngokusemthethweni kweempahla ezithengwayo. Fakela inkqubo yokugcina iinkcukacha zobugcisa kubalawuleli besibhedlele. Yila kwaye ulawule iinkqubo zokuqala ukwenza iinkcukacha ngempahla, ukuyirekoda nokuyigcina ukuze kugqitywe izibalo. Hlola kwaye wenze ngokweqiniso iinkcukacha zokuqala, ukwenza ngokusisiseko iinkqubo zokuhamba kwexesha. Xhasa ukuqeqeshwa kolwazi nakwabasebenzi be-SCM kwaye ukhuthaze ukuziphatha okuhle. Qinisekisa ukuvumelana nomthetho weTreasury, imigaqo ye-SCM nabo bonke abathunyelwa ukuba balawule iindidi ezahlukeneyo zemali esebenziswa ngokuchanekileyo.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse General
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R337 359 – R397 392 per annum Grade 2: R411 978 – R485 289 per annum Grade 3: R495 423 – R635 088 per annum
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse General position at Umphumulo Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, requiring a nursing diploma or degree and SANC registration, with three graded salary levels.
jobs.requirements: Diploma / Degree in General Nursing and Midwifery. Matric certificate/ Grade 12/ Standard 10. Diploma / Degree in General nursing and Midwife. Registration with the S.A.N.C. as a General Nurse and midwife. Current registration with South African Nursing Council receipt (2026). Grade 1: No experience required. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years appropriate/ recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate/ recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes and other legal frameworks such as: Nursing Act, Health Act, Patient’s Rights Charter, Batho Pele Principles, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Disciplinary Code and procedure, Grievance Procedure, code of conduct etc. Good skills in Communication, report writing, facilitation, co-ordination, planning & organizing, decision making computer usage. Ability to formulate patient related policies. Basic understanding of HR and Financial policies and procedures.
jobs.duties: Demonstrate effective communication with patients, supervisors, other health professionals and junior colleagues, including more complex report writing when required. Work effectively and amicably with persons of diverse intellectual, cultural, racial or religious differences. Display a concern for patients, promoting, advocating and facilitating proper treatment and care and ensuring the adherence to the principles of Batho Pele. Practice participative management by assisting with relief duties of the supervisor. Maintain accurate and complete patient records. Utilise human, material and physical resources efficiently and effectively. Provide directions and supervision for the implementation of the nursing plan (clinical practice/quality patient care. Implement standards, practices, criteria and indicators for quality nursing (quality of practice). Practice nursing and health care in accordance with relevant laws and regulations to nursing and health care. Maintain a constructive working relationship with nursing and other stakeholders. Assist with relief duties of the supervisor and act as a shift leader on both day and night when necessary. Work as part of a multi-disciplinary team to ensure good nursing care that is cost Effective, equitable and efficient. Must be prepared to work shift as per allocation; includes night shift, weekends and Holidays. ENQUIRIE : Ms P Matlou Tel No: (032) 4814199
jobs.applications: Please forward application quoting the reference number to The Human Resource Department, Umphumulo Hospital, Private Bag X9219, Maphumulo 4470 or hand delivered to Umphumulo Hospital, R74 Greytown Road, Maphumulo, 4470. email to: raban.chirwa@kznhealth.gov.za / Zinhle.zulu@kznhealth.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : Ms ZP Zulu Tel No: (032) 481 4180
jobs.notes: Application must be submitted on the Application for Employment Form (Form Z.83), which is obtainable at any Government Department or from the website – www.kznhealth.gov.za must be accurately completed and signed. Reference Number must be indicated in the column provided on the form Z.83 together with a comprehensive CV only. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications, ID and other relevant documents with the application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of documents and proof of current and previous work experience (certificate of Service) endorsed and stamped by the Human Resource department on or before the day of the interview. Persons with disabilities should feel free to apply for the post. Shortlisted applicants in possession of a foreign qualification will have to submit an evaluation/verification certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) or other regulating bodies on the day of interview. Non- RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident/ Work Permit holders must submit a documentary proof if shortlisted. This Department is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer, whose aim is to promote representatively in all levels of all occupational categories in the Department. The appointment is subject to positive outcome obtained from the following checks: security clearance, credit records, qualification, citizenship and previous experience verifications. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Failure to comply with the aforementioned instructions will results to your application being disqualified. Applicants are respectfully informed that, if no notification of appointment is received within 3 months after the closing date, they must accept that their applications were unsuccessful. Please note that due to financial constraints, there will be no payment of S&T claims.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige (Algemeen)
af.summary: Professionele Verpleegkundige (Algemeen) pos by Umphumulo Hospitaal in KwaZulu-Natal, waarvoor 'n verpleegkundi-diploma of -graad en SANC-registrasie vereis word, met drie geklassifiseerde salarisvlakke.
af.requirements: Diploma / Graad in Algemene Verpleegkunde en Vroukeske. Matrieksertifikaat/ Graad 12/ Standaard 10. Diploma / Graad in Algemene verpleegkunde en Vroukeese. Registrasie by die S.A.N.C. as 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige en vroukeeskundige. Huidige registrasie met Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegstersraad kwitansie (2026). Graad 1: Geen ondervinding vereis. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/ erkende ondervinding in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike/ erkende ondervinding in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures, verpleegstatutes en ander regsraamwerke soos: Verpleegwet, Gesondheidswet, Pasiente se Regte-handves, Batho Pele-beginsels, Openbare Diensregulasies, Arbeidsverhoudingswet, Dissiplinêre kode en prosedure, Griewe-prosedure, gedragskode ens. Goeie vaardighede in Kommunikasie, verslagskrywing, fasilitering, koördinering, beplanning en organisering, besluitneming en rekenaargebruik. Vermoë om pasientverwante beleide te formuleer. Basiese begrip van HR- en Finansiële beleide en prosedures.
af.duties: Toon doeltreffende kommunikasie met pasiente, toesighouers, ander gesondheidsprofessioneles en junior kollegas, insluitend meer komplekse verslagskrywing wanneer vereis. Werk doeltreffend en vriendelik met persone van uiteenlopende intellektuele, kulturele, rasse- of godsdienstige verskille. Toon begaanheid met pasiente, bevorder, pleit en fasiliteer behoorlike behandeling en sorg en verseker die nakoming van die beginsels van Batho Pele. Beoefen deelnemende bestuur deur te help met aflospligte van die toesighouer. Onderhou akkurate en volledige pasientrekords. Benut menslike, materiaal- en fisiese hulpbronne doeltreffend en effektief. Verskaf rigting en toesig vir die implementering van die verpleegplan (kliniese praktyk/kwaliteit pasientsorg. Implementeer standaarde, praktyke, kriteria en aanwysers vir kwaliteitsverpleging (kwaliteit van praktyk). Beoefen verpleging en gesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met relevante wette en regulasies tot verpleging en gesondheidsorg. Onderhou 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met verpleging en ander belanghebbendes. Help met aflospligte van die toesighouer en tree as 'n skifitleider op beide dag en nag wanneer nodig. Werk as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span om goeie verpleegsorg te verseker wat koste-effektief, billik en doeltreffend is. Moet bereid wees om skif te werk soos toegeken; sluit nagskif, naweke en vakansiedae in. NAVRAE : Me P Matlou Tel No: (032) 4814199

Phatha ukunakekelwa kwezempilo ngokwesimo sezimo, izinhlelo ezinhle, iziKhalazo nemigomo Yokwenza. xh.title: Umongikazi woMsebenzi jikelele
xh.summary: Isithuba somongikazi womsebenzi jikelele eNmontana iUmphumulo Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, esifuna idiploma okanye isidanga sokonga kunye nokubhalisa kwiSANC, ngamakhulu amathathu amanqanaba omvuzo ahleliweyo.
xh.requirements: Idiploma / Isidanga kuNokunngqina jikelele nakuBokeki. Isatifikethi samatiket / Igreyidi 12 / Isitendard 10. Idiploma / Isidanga kumsebenzi jikelele ongabongikazi. Ukubhalisa kwiS.A.N.C. njengomongikazi jikelele nobongikazi bokubeleka. Isatifikethi samanje sokubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council ngesipathi (2026). Igreyidi 1: Akukho mfuneko yamava. Igreyidi 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-10 yamava afanelekileyo / aqathe kakhulu ekunongeni emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi ophumeleleyo kwiSANC kuNokongqina jikelele. Igreyidi 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-20 yamava afanelekileyo / aqathe kakhulu ekunongeni emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi ophumeleleyo kwiSANC kuNokongqina jikelele. Ulwazi ngeenqobo-zesixhobo zenokhatho kunye neenqubo, izikwelo zonokhatho nolunye ulawu olusemthethweni njengoku: uNokhatho, umThetho weMpilo, uMthetho-siseko wamaLungelo aboGulayo, iinjongo zeBatho Pele, iMatiket wabasebenzi baseLuntu, umThetho wezeMinyanya yoBasebenzi, iKhowudi yoLungelelwaniso nendeBe, iNqubo yokuCwengisa, iKhowudi yokuziphatha njl. Amapondo amahle kuNxibelelwano, ukubhala iingxelo, ukwenza, ukulawula, ukucwangcisa & ukuqamba, ukwenza izigqibo nokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono lokwenza iinqobo-zesixhobo ezinxulumene nogulayo. Ukuqonda okusisiqalo ngeenqobo-zesixhobo zeHR nezeeMali kunye neenqubo.
xh.duties: Bonisa ukunxibelelana kakuhle nogulayo, nabaphathi, nabalawuli bempiLo abanye kunye nabahlobo abasebenza ngaphantsi kwakho, kuquka nokubhala iingxelo ezinzima xa kufuneka. Sebenza ngokusebenza kakuhle ngokwesisa nabanabantu abahlukene ngecebo, ngesiko, ngenkokheli okanye ngenkolo. Bonisa ukukhathalela ogulayo, ukukhuthaza, ukuxhasa nokwenza kubekho unyango lokhatho olufanelekileyo nokuqinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kweenjongo zeBatho Pele. Zisebenza ngokulawulwa ngokubandakanywa ngokunceda kumsebenzi wokuncedisa womphathi. Gcina amagunya ogulayo achanekileyo aqediweyo. Sebenzisa izixhobo zabantu, ezabakho nangokwasemzimba ngokusebenza kakuhle nangempumelelo. Nikezela ngokuqhuba nokuqonda ngokusetyenziswa kwenqubo yokonga (umsebenzi wekliniti/khatho ogulayo yomgangatho ophezulu. Zisebenzisa iimilinganiselo, iindlela, iindlela zemigaqo nemiboniso yemilinganiselo yomsebenzi jikelele (umgangatho womsebenzi). Zisebenza ngokonga naye ukhatho loMpiLo ngokwelana nemithetho nemiQathango ngokuya ngokonga nokuKhathwa. Gcina ukusebenza ngokunyaniseka ubudlelwane bokonga ngezinye iinkampani. Nceda ngemisebenzi yokuncedisa komphathi uzale njengomphathi weshangi emini nasebusuku xa kufuneka. Sebenza njengesikhathi esininzi iqela abasebenza ubuntsha-ntathu ukuqinisekisa ukuba khona okhatho oluhle olungabizi mali kakhulu, olulinganayo olusebenza kakuhle. jobs.title: Forensic Pathology Officer Grade 1
jobs.salary_text: R225 777 per annum, (an all- inclusive salary package). Other Benefits Medical Aid Optional, Home Allowance – Employee must meet prescribed requirements and 13th Cheque
jobs.summary: Forensic Pathology Officer Grade 1 position providing administrative autopsy services at Amajuba Health District Office in KwaZulu-Natal.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12. A valid driver’s license minimum code 08. Recommendations Computer Literacy (MS Word, Excel, Power Point). Experience in mortuary services minimum of six (06) months. Knowledge, Skills, Behavioural Attributes and Competencies Required Knowledge of mortuary administrative processes and policies. Knowledge of Medico-Legal protocols and prescripts. Knowledge of criminal justice system. Knowledge of waste management policy. Knowledge of infection control protocols and OHS. Knowledge of cleaning materials and use of cleaning equipment.
jobs.duties: To provide an efficient and effective administrative autopsy service. Preparation of relevant documentation required during autopsy process. Identification of body to doctor. Taking verbatim notes as directed by the doctor. Fingerprinting of deceased for identification of deceased. Photographing (including downloading of images into relevant database) for identification and record keeping. Collection of exhibits and samples/specimens under direct supervision of medical practitioners. Documentation and appropriate safe keeping and handover to SAPS of all exhibits and specimens to maintain chain of evidence. Maintain chain of evidence register. Assist families with identification process. To provide effective transportation service in the collection and offloading of bodies from crime scene to mortuary. Collection and transportation of corpse between death scene and medico legal mortuary including loading and offloading of corpse. Ensure completion of all relevant documentation necessary in collection and transportation process. Admission of bodies into medico legal mortuary in accordance with prescripts. To maintain a technical autopsy service. Perform reconstruction of a corpse under direction/ instruction / supervision of the medical offer in charge of case/s. Movement of weighing corpse. Ensure washing, shrouding and labelling of bodies post examination and ensuring area of work is maintained in a clean and hygienic condition. Handle and safeguard properly of deceased and disposal of property to next of kin in the prescribed manner. To perform administrative duties including registry, fleet, assets and stock control activities. Typing of all postmortem and any other subsequent documentation generated because of the postmortem examination. Communication and making necessary arrangements with relevant role players in preparation for postmortem examination as per medical officer’s instructions. Maintain an effective and efficient filing system for all postmortem related documentation and ensure safe custody thereof. Develop and maintain a database of all information pertaining to the autopsy service and timely provision of monthly summary statistics to relevant stakeholders. Stock control including early warning arrangements. Reception and switchboard duties. Liaising with next of kin, undertakers, municipalities, hospitals, and SAPS to arrange burials, cremations and pauper burials of unclaimed bodies. Liaising with court, negotiating court attendance by medical officers and other medico mortuary staff.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. M.J. Mambi Tel No: (034) 312 2706
jobs.applications: All applications should be forwarded to: Mrs. T.N.B. Dube: KZN Department of Health, Amajuba Health District Office, Email: Lungile.Mbatha3@kznhealth.gov.za OR Hand delivered to 50 Harding Street Nedbank Building First Floor, Newcastle, 2940 FOR ATTENTION : Mrs. T.N.B. Dube
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Application for Employment form (Z83) This is obtainable from any Public Service Department or from the website www.kznhealth.gov.za.Application form (Z83) must be accompanied by detailed Curriculum Vitae. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other documents on application but must submit Z83 and a detailed Curriculum Vitae. Certified copies of qualifications, proof of registration and other relevant documents will be requested from the shortlisted candidates only which may be submitted to HR on or before the day of the interview. Originally signed letter from your current employer, confirming current and appropriate work experience related to the requirements and recommendation of the advert. The Reference Number must be indicated in the column (Part A) provided thereof on the Z83 form. NB: Failure to comply with the above instructions will disqualify applicants. People with disabilities should feel free to apply for the post. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (security clearance (vetting), criminal clearance, credit records, and citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants are respectfully informed that, if no notification of appointment is received within 3 months after the closing date, they must accept that their applications were unsuccessful. Please note due to financial constraints, there will be no payment for S&T claims. Indian Males are encouraged to apply and people with disability also should feel free to apply.

af.title: Forensic Pathology Officer Grade 1
af.summary: Forensic Pathology Officer Grade 1-posisie wat administratiewe outopsiedienste by Amajuba Health District Office in KwaZulu-Natal lewer.
af.requirements: Grade 12. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie minimum kode 08. Aanbevelings Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Word, Excel, Power Point). Ervaring in lykshuisdienste minimum van ses (06) maande. Kennis, Vaardighede, Gedragskenmerke en Bevoegdhede Vereis Kennis van administratiewe prosesse en beleide vir lykshuise. Kennis van medico-legale protokolle en voorskrifte. Kennis van die strafregstelsel. Kennis van afvalbestuursbeleid. Kennis van infeksiebeheerprotokolle en OHS. Kennis van skoonmaakmateriale en gebruik van skoonmaaktoerusting.
af.duties: Om 'n doeltreffende en effektiewe administratiewe outopsiediens te lewer. Voorbereiding van relevante dokumentasie wat tydens die outopsieproses vereis word. Identifikasie van liggaam aan dokter. Neem van verbatimnotas soos deur die dokter gerig. Vingerafdrukke van oorledene vir identifikasie van oorledene. Fotografeer (insluitend aflaai van beelde in relevante databasis) vir identifikasie en rekordhouding. Versameling van uitstallings en monsters/spesimene onder direkte toesig van mediese praktisyns. Dokumentasie en toepaslike veilige bewaring en oorhandiging aan SAPS van alle uitstallings en spesimene om ketting van getuienis te handhaaf. Handhaaf ketting van getuienisregister. Help families met identifikasieproses. Om effektiewe vervoerdienste te lewer by die versameling en aflaai van liggame van misdadytoneel na lykshuis. Versameling en vervoer van lyk tussen doods toneel en medico legale lykshuis insluitend laai en aflaai van lyk. Verseker voltooiing van alle relevante dokumentasie nodig in versamelings- en vervoerproses. Toelating van liggame in medico legale lykshuis ooreenkomstig voorskrifte. Om 'n tegniese outopsiediens te handhaaf. Uitvoer van rekonstruksie van 'n lyk onder rigting/instruksie/toesig van die mediese beampte in beheer van gevalle. Beweging van weeg van lyk. Verseker was, toedraai en etikettering van liggame na ondersoek en verseker dat werksarea in 'n skoon en higiëniese toestand gehandhaaf word. Hanteer en behoorlik beveilig van oorledene en besittinge aan naasbestaandes op die voorgeskrewe wyse. Om administratiewe pligte uit te voer insluitend register, vloot, bates en voorraadbeheeraktiwiteite. Tik van alle nadoodse en enige ander daaropvolgende dokumentasie gegenereer as gevolg van die nadoodse ondersoek. Kommunikasie en maak van nodige reëlings met relevante rolspelers in voorbereiding vir nadoodse ondersoek soos per mediese beampte se instruksies. Handhaaf 'n effektiewe en doeltreffende lêerstelsel vir alle nadoodse verwante dokumentasie en verseker veilige bewaring daarvan. Ontwikkel en handhaaf 'n databasis van alle inligting met betrekking tot die outopsiediens en tydige verskaffing van maandelikse opsommingstatistiek aan relevante belanghebbendes. Voorraadbeheer insluitend vroeë waarskuwingsreëlings. Onthalwing en skakelbordpligte. Skakel met naasbestaandes, lykbesorgers, munisipaliteite, hospitale en SAPS om begrafnisse, verasings en armbegrafnisse van onopgeëiste liggame te reël. Skakel met hof, onderhandel hofbywoning deur mediese beamptes en ander medico mortuum personeel.

zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba nguMphathi Wezokuhlinzwa Ngobuchwepheshe Bokufa Isibili esasibeka e-Service Administrative Administrative Autopsy Service Amajuba Health District Office eKwaZulu-Natal.

Okuhlangenwe nakho ezinsizeni zesikhungo sabakufa okuncane kwezinyanga eziyisithupha (06). Ulwazi, Amandla, Izimpawu Zokuziphatha Nemikhuba Edingekayo Ulwazi lwezinqubo zokulawula isikhungo sabakufa. Ulwazi lwemithethonqubo yokuhlinzwa ngomthetho nemiyalo. Ulwazi lesistimu yezigwegwebi. Ulwazi lwemithethonqubo yokulawula ukwenza izinto ezingcolisayo.
