zu.duties: Ukuleta insiza ehle kahle nesebenzayo yokulola i-autopsy ngokomqondo. Ulungiselela ukwabiwa kwemibhobho ebalulekile edingeka itholakale lapho kwenziwa inqubo yokulola i-autopsy. Ukubonakalisa umzimba kedokodo. Ukuthatha amanothi anegama ngelinye njengoba kuqondiswe yidokodo. Ukuthatha izigxivizo zeminwe zomuntu ofele ekumkhomba. Ukuhweba kwezithombe (okuhlanganisa nokulanda izithombe ukuzifaka kwesizinda sedatha ezifanele) ukukhomba umuntu ofile kanye nokugcina amarekhodi. Ukuthola izindikimba kanye nezampula/izibonelo ngaphansi kokuhlola okuqondile kwabaphathi bokuhlinzwa. Ukubhala ukwabelana okufanele kanye nokugcina ngokuhlanzekile nokuhanjiswa kwezindikimba kanye nezibonelo kuyo i-SAPS ekuze kugcinwe inqubo yokutholakala kwobufakazi. Ukugcina irejista yokuqondisa kwezindikimba. Ukusiza imindeni inqubo yokukhomba umuntu ofile. Ukunikeza insiza yokuhamba ehle kahle nesebenzayo ekutholeni nokukhishiwa emizimbeni esendaweni yegciwane kuya kwesikhungo sabakufa. Ukuthola kanye nokuhambisa isidumbu phakathi kwendawo yokuvinjelwa nokulahlekelwa kubantu abangenabo obunye ubulungisi balelo igciwane. Ukugcina ukubeke kwemibhalo engemuva yesiYili, uthando, imfanelo yokulondoloza, nokweluleka. Ukulunga imithethonqubo yokulawula umhlambi. Ukucatshangelwa kokubakwemithetho ebusa emigqweni. Ukucatshangelwa kokubakwemithetho ebusa ukubekwa komuntu ovela ngomthetho. Ukucatshangelwa kokubakwemithetho ebusa ukucatshangelwa kwemithetho ebusa ukucatshangelwa kokubakwemithetho ebusa ukubekwa kwezindawo ezihlanzelekile. Ukucatshangelwa kokubakwemithetho ebusa ukucatshangelwa kokubakwemithetho ebusa ukubekwa kwezindawo ezihlanzelekile. Ukuqinisekisa ukuhlelwa kwayo yonke imibhalo ebalulekile edingeka kuyo inqubo yokuthola kanye nokuhambisa. Ukufakwa kwemizimba kwesikhungo sokuhlinza ngomthetho mayelana nokulunga imithethonqubo. Ukugcina insiza yokulola i-autopsy ngobuchwepheshe. Ukwenza kabusha isakhiwo somzimba ofele ngaphansi kokuqondiswa / imiyalo / ukulawulwa komphathi wokuhlinza ongumphathi wamacala. Ukunyakaza ukulinganisa umzimba ofele. Ukugcina ukugeza, ukukhwabanisa, kanye nokubeka amalebula emizimbeni emumva kokuhlola nokugcina ukuthi indawo yokusebenza ihlale ihlanzekile futhi ihlanzekile. Ukuphatha kanye nokulondoloza umzimba ofele ngendlela efanele nokulahlekelwa kwezimpahla kubalandeli bakhe ngendlela ebalulekile. Ukwenza imisebenzi yokuqamba imibhalo ebalulekile kwezimpahla, kwezimoto, kwezimpahla zomnyango nokulawula izinto ezisetshenziswa. Ukuhweba imizimba phakathi kwendawo yokushona komuntu kwesikhungo sokuhlinzwa ngomthetho kuhlanganise ukufaka kanye nokukhipha umzimba. Ukugcina amarekhodi womsebenzi wokuhlinzwa ngomthetho kanye nezinye izinto ezidingekayo emsebenzini wokuhlinzwa ngomthetho. Ukuxhumana nokwenza izinhlelo ezidingekayo nabasebenzi ababalulekile ngokulungiselela ukuhlinzwa ngomthetho njengoba kuqondiswe ngumphathi wokuhlinza. Ukugcina uhlelo lokugcina amafayela olusebenza kahle kwayo yonke imibhalo ebalulekile yokuhlinzwa ngomthetho nokuqinisekisa ukuthi igcinwe kahle. Ukuthuthukisa kanye nogcina idatha yonke imininingwane ehlobene nesebenzi lokuhlinzwa ngomthetho nokuletha ngokushesha izibalo zeNyanga ezinkomba abathintekayo. Ukulawula izinhlelo zokulawula ukutholakala kwezimpahla. Ukwenza imisebenzi yokwamukela izivakashi kanye nokusebenza ngenhlangano. Ukuxhumana nezihlobo, abathengisi, amasipalithi, izibhedlela, kanye ne-SAPS ukulungiselela ukungcwaba, ukushiswa kanye nokungcwaba kwemizimba ezingaziwa. Ukuxhumana nekhothi, ukuxoxa ngokuza ekhothi ngabaphathi bokuhlinza kanye nabanye abasebenza kulezi zikhungo.

xh.title: Isikhokelo seNgcogo yokuHlolwa kweziLumkiso iNqanaba 1
xh.summary: Isithuba sesikhokelo seNgcoga yokuHlolwa kweziLumkiso iNqanaba 1 esinika iinkonzo zolawulo lokuHlolwa kwezidumbu kwioFisi leSebe leMephu yamoNye wamajonjuba eKwaZulu-Natal.
xh.requirements: iBakala 12. ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni ikhodi ephantsi 08. Iingcebiso yolwazi ngekhompyutha (MS Word, Excel, Power Point). Ulwazi lwamashishini obume obungazange alithwale, ixesha elingangenasi iinyanga ezintandathu (06). Ulwazi, amakhono, iimpawu zokuziphatha nokuLungelelanisa ezifunekayo: ulwazi ngemigaqo nemigangatho yamashishini olawulo. Ulwazi ngemigaqonkqubo yasezamashishini amavakalisi nemiqathango. Ulwazi lwemigaqo yamashishini amazwe ngobulungisa babaxhasi bobugcisa. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yolawulo lwezinto ezalahlwayo. af.title: Distrikse Uitvoerende Bestuurder

af.requirements: Kwalifikasies en Ervaring: 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/Grade 12/Matriek plus 'n voorgraadse kwalifikasie in enige gesondheidsveld op NQF-vlak 7 soos erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. 'n Terugkeerende nagraadse kwalifikasie in Public Health sal 'n sterk aanbeveling wees. 'n Minimum van vyf [5] jaar se ervaring op senior bestuursvlak. Personeelbestuur, probleemoplossing, goeie kommunikasie, leierskap, besluitneming, veranderingsbestuur, rekenaar en konflikbestuursvaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaf leierskap en strategiese doelwitte en oogmerke insluitend die bestuur van die distrik in die volgende areas: Primêre Gesondheidsorg. Hospitaaldienste. Finansiële bestuursdienste. Verseker doeltreffende en doelmatige dienslewering binne die distrik. Bestuur, monitor en evalueer die verskaffing van gesondheidsdienste binne die distrik. zu.title: Umphathi Mkhulu Wesifunda
zu.summary: Hola izinsizakalo zempilo Zesifunda Vhembe njengoMphathi Mkhulu, obuka phezu kwokunakekelwa okuyisisekelo, izibhedlela, izimali, izinsizakalo zenhlangano kanye nokuphathwa kolwazi.
zu.requirements: Iziqu Nohlelo: Isitifikedi samatikuletla seNqangi/Umngcinga we-12/uMatric kanye nethulu elingaphansi kweziqu kunoma yisiphi isikhathi sempilo esibekiwe njengenga le-NQF 7 njengokuqashelwa yi-South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Ithulu elihambisanayo leziqu lokusingatha emva kweziqu ku-Public Health lizoba ukunconywa okuqinile. Okungenani ihlelo leminyaka eyisihlanu [5] yohlelo ohlelweni lokuphatha oluphezulu. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha okuhlanganisa i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint; ukukwazi ukusebenzisa izinkundla zokuhlangana eziku-inthanethi. Ilayisense yokushayela elisebenzayo, ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi olujulile olunomsoco ngomthetho we-Public Service Act, 1994 njengokulungisiwe, i-Public Service Regulation 2016, njengokulungisiwe, i-Public Finance Management Act, 1999, i-Employment Equity Act, 1998, i-Skills Development Act, 1998, i-Occupational Health and Safety Act, 85 of 1993. Ukuphatha abantu, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuxhumana okuhle, ukuba ngumholi, ukwenza izinqumo, ukuphatha inguquko, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kanye namakhono okuphatha izinkinga.
zu.duties: Nikeza isiqondiso futhi uhlole imigomo namabalomgomo okuholela phambili okuhlanganisa nokuphatha isifunda kule minyakelo elandelayo: Ukunakekelwa Kwempilo Okuyisisekelo. Izinsizakalo zesibhedlela. Izinsizakalo zokuphathwa kwezimali. Izinsizakalo zenhlangano. Urhulumende wezinhlangano kanye nokuqamba. Ukuphathwa kolwazi nobuchwepheshe. Bumba, fakiise futhi ufeze imigomo & izinqubo ezihlobene nokusebenza kwesifunda. Qinisekisa ukulethwa kwensizakalo okusebenzayo nokunembile ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Phatha, hlola futhi uhlaziye ukunikezwa kwezinsizakalo zempilo ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Akha izixhumanisi nodibano nezindikimba eziyisiko kanye nalezo ezingeyona ezisemthethweni. Phatha futhi usebenzise izinsiza [abantu nezimali] ngokuhambisana nemiyalo nangomthetho ohlobene nawo. xh.summary: Qhuba iinkonzo zeempilo zesithili i-Vhembe District njengengena ekwindlu enkulu, ulawule unxibelelwano olungundoqo, iibhedlela, imali, iinkonzo zabakomkhulu nolawulo lolwazi.
xh.requirements: Izifundo nemicimbi: Isatifikethi seNaziso ezingundoqo/Grade 12/Matric kanye nesidanga se-undergraduate kuyo nayiphi na indawo yeempilo kwinqanaba le-NQF level 7 njengokuqatywa ngumaphu wokuqinisekisa izifundo eMzantsi Afrika [SAQA]. Isidanga se-postgraduate kwimimandla yezeempilo esiKawuli siza kuthatha ngendlela ekhuthazayo. Iqondo elingenakuphantsi kweminyaka elihlobo [5] yamava kwinqanaba eliphezulu lolawulo. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba eyasebenzayo, ngaphandle kweabantu abakhubekileyo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi olukhulu oluqhubekayo malunga ne-Public Service Act, 1994 njengoko igqityiweyo, i-Public Service Regulation 2016, njengoko igqityiweyo, i-Public Finance Management Act, 1999, i-Employment Equity Act, 1998, i-Skills Development Act, 1998, i-Occupational Health and Safety Act, 85 of 1993. Amakhono okulawula abantu, ukusombulula iingxaki, unxibelelwano oluhle, isikhokelo, ukwenza izigqibo, ulawulo lotshintsho, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuhambelana kolawulo lweengxwabo.
xh.duties: Nika isikhokelo nephakamisa iinjongo ezibalulekileyo neenjongo, kuquka nokulawula isithili kwezilandelayo: Unxibelelwano lwezeempilo ezingundoqo. Iinkonzo zezibhedlele. Phepha, sebenzisa uze uphumeze iinkqubo nemigaqo evela kumisebenzi yokuqhuba isithili. Qinisekisa ukuba kunika inkonzo ngokusebenzisekileyo nangokuchanekileyo ngaphakathi kwesithili. Lawula uze usebenzise izixhobo [abantu nemali] ngokwemigaqo nemiqathango elandelayo. A minimum of five [5] years’ experience at middle/senior management. Relevant experience in records management and / or statistical analysis. Computer literacy including MS Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint; Literacy in virtual meeting platforms. SMS Pre-Entry Programme [Nyukela]Certificate[https://www.thensg.gov.za/training- course/sms-pre-entry-programme/?utm_sourcechatgpt.com] upon appointment. A valid driver’s license except people with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: A good understanding of Records Management and National Archives. Knowledge of legislation and related regulations and policies in the public service as a whole relevant to the management of the directorate. Ability to manage multiple projects, excellent interpersonal & communication skills (written & verbal). Report writing and presentation skills. The incumbent must be assertive and self-driven, innovative, and creative, client focused, and solution-oriented Problem Solving, Good Communication, Facilitation, Analytical, Listening, Innovative, Report Writing, Conflict Resolution, Negotiation, Technical, Quantitative, Presentation and Co-ordination Skills. Be able to work under stressful situations as well as the ability to maintain high levels of professionalism. Personal Attributes: Honesty, Integrity, Flexibility. Responsiveness, Professionalism, Accuracy, Supportive, Team Player, Co- operative, Confidentiality, Pro-activeness.

Ensure proper provisioning and maintenance of General Records Services. Ensure proper provisioning and maintenance of Personnel Record Services in the Department. Formulate and manage the component’s budget against its strategic objectives. af.title: Direkteur: Rekordbestuur
af.summary: Direkteur van Rekordbestuur by die Limpopo Department of Health, verantwoordelik vir die leiding van rekordbestuurspraktyke en personeelrekorddienste.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies en Ervaring: 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat / Graad 12 / Matriek plus 'n voorgraadse kwalifikasie op NQF vlak 7 in Publieke Bestuur / Publieke Administrasie / Argiefstudies / Inligtingstudies/Inligtingswetenskap of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie soos erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. 'n Minimum van vyf [5] jaar se ervaring op middel-/seniorbestuursvlak. Relevante ervaring in rekordbestuur en / of statistiese ontleding. Rekenaargeletterdheid insluitend MS Outlook, Word, Excel en PowerPoint; Geletterdheid in virtuele vergaderingsplatforms. SMS Pre-Entry Programme [Nyukela]Certificate[https://www.thensg.gov.za/training- course/sms-pre-entry-programme/?utm_sourcechatgpt.com] by aanstelling. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie behalwe persone met gestremdhede. Kennis en Vaardighede: 'n Goeie begrip van Rekordbestuur en Nasionale Argiewe. Kennis van wetgewing en verwante regulasies en beleide in die staatsdiens as geheel relevant tot die bestuur van die direktoraat. Vermoë om veelvuldige projekte te bestuur, uitstekende interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondelings). Verslagskryf- en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Die ampsdraer moet besluitvaardig en selfgedrewe wees, innoverend en kreatief, kliëntgefokus en oplossingsgerig wees. Probleemoplossing, Goeie Kommunikasie, Fasilitasie, Analities, Luister, Innoverend, Verslagskryf, Konflikoplossing, Onderhandeling, Tegnies, Kwantitatief, Aanbieding en Koördineringsvaardighede. In staat wees om onder stresvolle omstandighede te werk asook die vermoë om hoë vlakke van professionaliteit te handhaaf. Persoonlike Eienskappe: Eerlikheid, Integriteit, Buigsaamheid. Reaksievermoë, Professionaliteit, Akkuraatheid, Ondersteunend, Spanspeler, Saamwerkend, Vertroulikheid, Proaktiwiteit.
af.duties: Verskaf leierskap en strategiese rigting in die afdeling. Verseker implementering en instandhouding van goeie Rekordbestuurspraktyke. jobs.notes: NB: Ensure that you read the conditions and requirements of the post before you apply. Failure to comply with the instructions below will result in your application being disqualified. By applying, it is understood that you agree to the conditions and requirements of the post. Applicants are hereby invited from suitably qualified candidates for vacant posts in the Department of Health. Applications should include a fully completed new Z83 form obtainable from any government institution or at www.dpsa.gov.za and must be accompanied by a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae [CV]. Completion of Z83 Application Form: Online applications must include the only Curriculum Vitae [CV] in PDF as attachment. Zipped ,IMG and JPEG documents will not be accepted. The new Z83 form must be fully completed and signed up by the applicant. The following must be considered in relation to the completion of Z83 by applicants: All the fields in Part A, Part C and Part D must be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full except the following: South African applicants need not provide passport numbers. If an applicant responded “No” to the question “Are you conducting business with the State or are you a Director of a Public or Private company conducting business with the State? Then it is acceptable for an applicant to indicate ‘not applicable’ or leave blank to the question. If yes (provide detail), “In the event that you are employed in the Public Service, will you immediately relinquish such business interest?”. Applicants may leave the following question blank if they are not in possession of such: “If your profession or occupation requires official registration, provide date and particulars of registration”. Noting there is limited space provided for Part E, F & G, applicants often indicate “refer to Curriculum Vitae (CV)” or “see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. It must be noted that a CV is an extension of the application for employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. The questions related to the conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered however applicants currently employed by the public service do not need to complete the section as it is intended for those seeking re-employment. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and to provide proof of such evaluation. Shortlisted candidates will be required to come for an interview, at which time, certified copies of all relevant qualifications, current registration with the relevant statutory body and copy of ID must be submitted. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One shall be a practical exercise and the other shall be integrity [ethical conduct] assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process . In terms of the Directive on the Implementation of Competency Based Assessments, Training & Development for Members of the Senior Management Services (SMS) in the Public Service, as amended. All Shortlisted candidates for the SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview .Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Assessment for core competencies outlined in the SMS handbook shall be conducted within one month of the appointment of the candidate. The Office shall communicate the logistics for the psychometric assessment to the candidate: Only recommended candidates for Senior Management Services (SMS) posts shall undergo psychometric assessment (Giotto, 15FQ+, and CPP assessment). Shortlisted candidates for the SMS posts will be required to submit SMS pre- entry certificate obtainable from National School of Government [https://thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entryprogramme/.]                  on appointment. The cost for Nyukela is at the applicant ‘s own expense. Successful candidates will be expected to enter into performance agreement and sign oath of secrecy. Suitable candidate will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks [criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification and employment verification] Please note by responding to the advertisement, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). Your information will be used soley for the purpose of this promotion and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent unless required by law. The successful candidate falling within the designated categories for disclosure of financial interests will be required to disclose his/her financial interests in accordance with the applicable prescripts within 30 days of assumption of duty. Only the designated categories will disclose their financial interest in line with Regulation 16 (c),17 (2) & 18 (3) of the Public Service Regulation, 2016 as amended The Department of Health is an equal opportunity Employment Equity and Affirmative Action Employer. Females are encouraged to apply for posts at senior management level in order to address the Employment Equity targets within the Department. People with disabilities are encouraged to apply and correspondence will be entered into with shortlisted candidates only. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only due to the large number of applications we envisage to receive; and if you have not heard from us within ninety (90) days of the closing date, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are hereby advised to, within 90 days, request reasons from the Department for any administrative action which has adversely affected them in terms of section 5(1)(2) of the Promotion of Administrative Justice Act 3 of 2000.Kindly note that NO payment of any kind is required when applying for posts advertised in this circular. The Department reserves the right not to fill any advertised posts. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

jobs.title: Director: Infrastructure Maintenance and Technical
jobs.summary: Lead infrastructure maintenance and technical support services for Limpopo health facilities, requiring an engineering degree and five years of senior managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: Qualifications and Competencies: A National Senior Certificate /Grade 12 /Matric plus an appropriate Degree in Civil/Structural or Mechanical / Electrical Engineering. At least six [6] years’ post qualification experience. Five [5] years’ experience at a middle/senior managerial level in infrastructure maintenance. Training programmes undertaken and successfully completed in Project Management or Health Facilities Management; or Maintenance Management Plus experience in health engineering and or health infrastructure maintenance or a similar complex environment will be an added advantage. Computer literacy with proficiency in MS Office Software. Valid driver’s license except for people with disabilities. The successful applicant must be prepared to travel extensively throughout the province and work longer hours. Main Role: The incumbent of this post will report to the Chief Director: Infrastructure Development and Technical Support Services and will be responsible for the provision of the effective and efficient management of the maintenance of the entire spectrum of Health Facilities, other infrastructure and the related technical support services that sustain an enabling environment for healthcare delivery in a cost-effective manner Knowledge, Skills, Training And Competencies Required: The ideal candidate must have: the ability to understand and apply the Provincial IDMS, guide and operate within all applicable legislation, policies, frameworks and instruction notes. The ability to understand the health services plan of the Department and specifically the requirements for maintenance, engineering and related support services and provide support to the chief directorate and health facilities. The ability to understand and apply international and national engineering, municipal waste management the occupational health and safety standards. The ability to understand and interpret specifications for engineering & technical services and application of the knowledge for procurement processes. The ability to plan and manage a diverse portfolio of projects and programmes. The ability to undertake a risk analysis and undertake a risk mitigation strategy. The ability to prepare reports, submissions and presentations the ability to motivate staff, develop competencies and promote a culture of excellence. The ability to meet strict project deadlines – preparation of documentation, report writing, chairing and minute taking of site meetings. Manage people. Manage finances.
jobs.duties: Plan, implement and manage the maintenance and technical support services component of all health facilities and infrastructure. Manage the provision of professional engineering services and provide support to the chief directorate and health facilities. Provide oversight management of maintenance and technical services provided at all health facilities. Manage the acquisition and deployment of maintenance resources Co-operate and work collaboratively with the directors, middle managers, professionals, technical and administrative support staff in the chief directorate in terms of infrastructure and maintenance planning and delivery, the health care services community at large in the provincial, district and facility maintenance teams. Manage healthcare infrastructure risk and quality improvement programmes. Manage compliance with the provisions of the occupational Health and Safety Act [OHS] related to equipment and effective municipal waste management. Set the visionary and strategic direction of the directorate, support and compliance to the health care service delivery imperative and legal prescripts. Manage the human, physical and financial resources of the directorate. The following must be considered in relation to the completion of Z83 by applicants: All the fields in Part A, Part C and Part D must be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full except the following: South African applicants need not provide passport numbers. If an applicant responded “No” to the question “Are you conducting business with the State or are you a Director of a Public or Private company conducting business with the State? Then it is acceptable for an applicant to indicate ‘not applicable’ or leave blank to the question. If yes (provide detail), “In the event that you are employed in the Public Service, will you immediately relinquish such business interest?”. Applicants may leave the following question blank if they are not in possession of such: “If your profession or occupation requires official registration, provide date and particulars of registration”. Noting there is limited space provided for Part E, F & G, applicants often indicate “refer to Curriculum Vitae (CV)” or “see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. It must be noted that a CV is an extension of the application for employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. The questions related to the conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered however applicants currently employed by the public service do not need to complete the section as it is intended for those seeking re-employment. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and to provide proof of such evaluation. Shortlisted candidates will be required to come for an interview, at which time, certified copies of all relevant qualifications, current registration with the relevant statutory body and copy of ID must be submitted. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One shall be a practical exercise and the other shall be integrity [ethical conduct] assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process . In terms of the Directive on the Implementation of Competency Based Assessments, Training & Development for Members of the Senior Management Services (SMS) in the Public Service, as amended. All Shortlisted candidates for the SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview .Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Assessment for core competencies outlined in the SMS handbook shall be conducted within one month of the appointment of the candidate. The Office shall communicate the logistics for the psychometric assessment to the candidate: Only recommended candidates for Senior Management Services (SMS) posts shall undergo psychometric assessment (Giotto, 15FQ+, and CPP assessment). Shortlisted candidates for the SMS posts will be required to submit SMS pre- entry certificate obtainable from National School of Government [https://thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entryprogramme/.]                  on appointment. The cost for Nyukela is at the applicant ‘s own expense. Successful candidates will be expected to enter into performance agreement and sign oath of secrecy. Suitable candidate will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks [criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification and employment verification] Please note by responding to the advertisement, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). Your information will be used soley for the purpose of this promotion and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent unless required by law. The successful candidate falling within the designated categories for disclosure of financial interests will be required to disclose his/her financial interests in accordance with the applicable prescripts within 30 days of assumption of duty. Only the designated categories will disclose their financial interest in line with Regulation 16 (c),17 (2) & 18 (3) of the Public Service Regulation, 2016 as amended The Department of Health is an equal opportunity Employment Equity and Affirmative Action Employer. Females are encouraged to apply for posts at senior management level in order to address the Employment Equity targets within the Department. People with disabilities are encouraged to apply and correspondence will be entered into with shortlisted candidates only. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only due to the large number of applications we envisage to receive; and if you have not heard from us within ninety (90) days of the closing date, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are hereby advised to, within 90 days, request reasons from the Department for any administrative action which has adversely affected them in terms of section 5(1)(2) of the Promotion of Administrative Justice Act 3 of 2000.Kindly note that NO payment of any kind is required when applying for posts advertised in this circular. The Department reserves the right not to fill any advertised posts. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Instandhouding van infrastruktuur en tegnies
af.summary: Voer die instandhouding van infrastruktuur en tegniese ondersteuningsdienste vir Limpopo gesondheidsfasiliteite, wat 'n ingenieursgraad en vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies en Bevoegdhede: 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat /Graad 12 /Matriek plus 'n toepaslike Graad in Siviele/Strukturele of Meganiese / Elektriese Ingenieurswese. Ten minste ses [6] jaar se ervarings na kwalifikasie. Vyf [5] jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/senior bestuursvlak in die instandhouding van infrastruktuur. Opleidingsprogramme wat in Projektbestuur of Gesondheidsfasiliteitsbestuur onderneem en suksesvol voltooi is; of Instandhoudingsbestuur Plus ervaring in gesondheidsingenieurswese en of instandhouding van gesondheidsinfrastruktuur of 'n soortgelyke komplekse omgewing sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Rekenaarvaardigheid met bevoegdheid in MS Office-sagteware. Geldige bestuurderslisensie behalwe vir persone met gestremdhede. Die suksesvolle aansoeker moet bereid wees om uitgebreid deur die provinsie te reis en langer ure te werk. Hoofrol: Die ampshouer van hierdie pos sal aan die Hoofdirekteur: Infrastruktuurontwikkeling en Tegniese Ondersteuningsdienste rapporteer en sal verantwoordelik wees vir die voorsiening van die effektiewe en doeltreffende bestuur van die instandhouding van die hele spektrum van Gesondheidsfasiliteite, ander infrastruktuur en die verwante tegniese ondersteuningsdienste wat 'n bemagtigende omgewing vir gesondheidsorglewering op 'n koste-effektiewe wyse in stand hou Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegthede Benodig: Die ideale kandidaat moet oor die volgende beskik: die vermoë om die Provinsiale IDMS te verstaan en toe te pas, te lei en binne alle toepaslike wetgewing, beleid, raamwerke en instruksienotas te opereer. Die vermoë om die gesondheidsdiensteplan van die Departement te verstaan en spesifiek die vereistes vir instandhouding, ingenieurswese en verwante ondersteuningsdienste en om ondersteuning aan die hoofdirektoraat en gesondheidsfasiliteite te verleen. Die vermoë om internasionale en nasionale ingenieurs-, munisipale afvalbestuur en die beroepsgesondheids- en veiligheidsstandaarde te verstaan en toe te pas. Die vermoë om spesifikasies vir ingenieurs- en tegniese dienste te verstaan en te interpreteer en die toepassing van die kennis vir verkrygingsprosesse. Die vermoë om 'n diverse portefeulje van projekte en programme te beplan en te bestuur. Die vermoë om 'n risiko-analise te onderneem en 'n risikobeperkingsstrategie te onderneem. Die vermoë om verslae, voorleggings en aanbiedings voor te berei die vermoë om personeel te motiveer, bevoegthede te ontwikkel en 'n kultuur van uitnemendheid te bevorder. Die vermoë om streng projekstermyns na te kom – voorbereiding van dokumentasie, verslagskryf, voorsitting en notule van terreinvergaderings. Bestuur mense. Bestuur finansies.
af.duties: Beplan, implementeer en bestuur die instandhoudings- en tegniese ondersteuningsdienste-komponent van alle gesondheidsfasiliteite en infrastruktuur. Bestuur die voorsiening van professionele ingenieursdienste en verskaf ondersteuning aan die hoofdirektoraat en gesondheidsfasiliteite. Verskaf toesigbestuur van instandhoudings- en tegniese dienste wat by alle gesondheidsfasiliteite verskaf word. Bestuur die verkryging en ontplooiing van instandhoudingshulpbronne Saamwerk en in samewerking werk met die direkteurs, middelbestuurders, professionele, tegniese en administratiewe ondersteuningspersoneel in die hoofdirektoraat ten opsigte van infrastruktuur- en instandhoudingsbeplanning en -lewering, die gesondheidsorgdienste-gemeenskap in die algemeen in die provinsiale, distriks- en fasiliteitsinstandhoudingsteams. Bestuur gesondheidsorg-infrastruktuurrisiko en gehalverbeteringsprogramme. Bestuur nakoming van die bepalings van die Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid [OHS] wat verband hou met toerusting en effektiewe munisipale afvalbestuur. Stel die visionêre en strategiese rigting van die direktoraat, ondersteuning en nakoming aan die gesondheidsorgdienslewering-imperatief en regsvoorskrifte. Bestuur die menslike, fisiese en finansiële hulpbronne van die direktoraat. NAVRAE: Algemene navrae oor die geadverteerde poste moet gerig word aan Me Hlokoa RE Tel No: (015) 293 6406, Me Mompei MM Tel No: (015) 293 6126 / Me Sebake RL Tel No: (015) 293 6426, Me Sebola MF Tel No: (015) 293 6002 en Me Mothiba JT Tel No: (015) 293 6329 gedurende kantoorure. ANDER POSTE

zu.title: Umqondisi: Ukulondolozwa Kolwelwesiwakho Nobuchwepheshe
zu.summary: Hola ukugcinwa kolwelwesiwakho kanye namasevisi obuchwepheshe okusekela izikhungo zempilo zaLimpopo, okudinga iziqu zobuchwepheshe kanye namahlanu eminyaka yokusebenza ezingeni eliphezulu lokuphatha.
zu.requirements: Izindingo nokukwazi: Umtsetfosikolo Wesikole Samabanga Aphakeme / Ibanga 12 / Isithifundamabanga kanye ne-Degree efanele kwi-Civil/Structural noma Mechanical / Electrical Engineering. Okungenani amashumi ayisithupha [6] eminyaka yokusebenza ngemva kokuthola izindingo. Amahlanu [5] eminyaka yokusebenza ezingeni eliphakathi/elphezulu lokuphatha ukugcinwa kwesakhiwo. Izinhlela zokuqeqesha ezithathiwe futhi zigcine ngempumelelo eProject Management noma Health Facilities Management; noma Maintenance Management kanye nokusebenza kwenzululwazi yezokunjiniyela kanye noma ukugcinwa kolwandle lokwakha izempilo noma endaweni evindezelwe okufana naleyo kuzobe kungenzeka kubungwe. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ngokusebenzisa i-MS Office Software. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile ngaphandle kwalabo abakhubazekile. Umuntu othunyelwe kumele azimisele ukuhamba uhambe kakhulu esifundeni sonke futhi asebenze isikhathi eside. Iqhaza eliyinhloko: Lowo othathayo kulesi sikhundla uzomela kwi- Chief Director: Infrastructure Development and Technical Support Services futhi uzobe egcina ulwazi ngokuphathwa kokuqinisekiswa kokugcinwa kolwandle lwemitholampilo, okwakhiwe kanye namanye amasevisi obuchwepheshe ahambisana nawo asiza ukuthi kushone isikhathi eside futhi kwemukelwe kalula emzimbeni wokukhiqiza amandla ezokwelapha. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa Nokuba Nekhono Okudingekayo: Umuntu ofanele kumele kube nokukwazi: ukuqonda nokusebenzisa iProvincial IDMS, ukuqondisa futhi asebenze ngaphakathi kwawo onke umthetho, izinqubomgomo, izakhiwo kanye nemiyalo. Ukukwazi ukuqonda uhlelo lomnyango lwamasevisi ezokwelapha ikakhulukazi izidingo zokulondolozwa, ulwazi olubuyela emva, namasevisi wokusekela ngokushesha kumgqondisi kanye nezakhiwo zezempilo. Ukukwazi ukuqonda nokusebenzisa izitathingendwazi zezokunjiniyela kazwelonke, ukuphathwa kokulahla izinto ezilahliwe kumasipala kanye ne-occupational health and safety. Ukukwazi ukuqonda nokuchaza izici ezitholakala kumasevisi obuchwepheshe baka & engineering kanye nokusebenzisa ukwazi ekwenzeni izidingo. Ukukwazi ukuhlela futhi aphathe izinhlelo nemibhalo ehlukene. Ukukwazi ukuqaphela futhi uhlele indlela yokunciphisa ingozi. Ukukwazi ukuhlanganisa imibhalo, izibhalo ezenziwayo futhi uhlele izinkomba ezibonisa ukuthi umuntu ukhuthele futhi usebenze ngokuzithoba. Ukukwazi ukugcwalisa izinkomba zesikhathi esihle okuhleliwe – ukuhlanganisa imibhalo, ukubhala imibiko, ukubusa kuthathe imininingwane kumihlangano yendawo. Uphathe abantu. Uphathe imali.
zu.duties: Hlela, phumeza izinhlelo uphathe ngokugcinwa kolwelwesiwakho kanye namasevisi wokwesekwa obuchwepheshe kuyo yonke izikhungo zezempilo nolwandle olwakhiwe. Phatha ukunikezwa kwamasevisi obunjiniyela obungochwepheshe futhi unikeze inkxaso eqondiswe kumqondisi ophakeme kanye nezikhungo zezempilo. Nikeza ngokuphathwa okubhekele kwaye okulawula ukugcinwa kanye namasevisi obuchwepheshe anikezwa kuyo yonke izikhungo zezempilo. Phatha ukutholwa nokubekwa kolwazi ngokugcinwa Sebenzisana ngokuhlangenwe nakho nabaholi, abaphathi baphakathi, ochwepheshe, abasekela abachwepheshe kanye nabasebenza kumqondisi ophakeme ngendlela yokuhlela ukwakhi nokulondolozwa kolwandle ngokuphathwa namandla okuhlinzeka, nendawo yamasevisi kuyo yonke imiphakathi isifunda, izigaba namathimu okulondolozwa. Phatha ingozi ekuphathweni kolwandle nasezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa izinga lezempilo. Phatha ukuvumelana nezimiso ze-Occupational Health and Safety Act [OHS] ngemishini nokuphathwa kwezimpahla ezilahliwe kwamasipala. Hlela indlela yokuqonda okujulile ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kanye noqondiso lomnyango wezokuhamba, sekela futhi ugunyaze ngokuhlinzeka ngamandla okusebenza ngokomthetho ohlela ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi yezempilo. Phatha abantu, izinto kanye nezimali zomnyango. OKUNYE OKUTHUNYELIWE

xh.title: Umongameli: Ukugcinwa Kolwakhiwo nokuSebenza ngamapolawu
xh.summary: Ukuba ngumphathi ekugcineni kolwakhiwo nesevisi yonkezo yeenkundla zempilo eLimpopo, kufuna isidanga sobuniniyane kunye neminye emihlanu yamava abaphathi abaphezulu.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zobungcaliswa: Isatifikethi seNazwima Esiphakamileyo /Grade 12 /Matric negunya ngeDangwe efanelekileyo kwi-Njulalwazi yokuYila/Ingcwangca okanye iNyumzinyuzi / isiLumbu. Ubuncinane leminyaka yamava emi-6 [6] emva kokufumana isidanga. Iimfono zeminyaka yamava emi-5 [5] kwinqanaba labaphathi abaphakathi/baphezulu ekugcineni kolwakhiwo. Iinkqubo zokuqeqesha ezithathiweyo kwaye zigqitywe ngempumelelo ekuLawulweni kweProjek okanye ekuLawulweni kweendawo zoMtholampilo; okanye ekuLawulweni kolwakhiyo nokugcinwa kwalo Nangaphezulu amava obuniniyane bemithi yempilo nokugcinwa kolwakhiwo yamathuba okanye indawo entsengentselezi efanayo kuya kuba lusazo olwongezelelweyo. Ukuba nobuchule ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha ngokuchanekileyo kwinkqubo ye-MS Office. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubekileyo. Umfaki isicelo opumeleleyo makabe lukhululekile ukuba nahamba-hamba kakhulu esifundazweni nakuba naxesha elide. Inxalenye ePhambili: Umntu ofaka esi sithuba uya kuxela kumongameli oMkhulu: ukuQanjwa kolwakhiwo nesebe lesiNiki ngeNkxaso eNcomekayo weeNkonzo yaye uya kuba naxanduva lokunikela ngolawulo olusebenzayo noluchanelekileyo ekugcineni ngokupheleleyo kwezi ndawo zoMtholampilo zonke, kolwakhiwo okunye nokuNxitywa kweNkxaso yoBugcisa ezihamba ngesixhobo esinceda ukwakhiwa kwendawo ekulungele ukuHlinzwa kweMithi yempilo ngendlela eGcinayo iMali Ulwazi, Amandla oQeqesho, eNkqubo yoQeqesho noBugcisa efunekayo: Umntu ofanelekileyo kufuneka akube nolo: ukuba nolawu lokuyiqonda nokusebenzisa iProvincial IDMS, ukuyalatha nokusebenza ngaphakathi kwawo onke amathetho, iinkqubo, iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo namagqabantshintshi. Amandla okuyiqonda icebo lenkqubo yamathuba asebesebenze ikwaye ngokukodwa iimfuno zokugcinwa, ubuniniyane nokuNxitywa kweNkxaso ezihlobene nazo kwaye unike inkxaso kwisebe elikhulu naseendaweni zoMtholampilo. Amandla okuyiqonda nokusebenzisa amagama obuniniyane, ukulawulwa kwefafa lamaspali, iinkqubo zokuQonda ukhuseleko lomsebenzi namazwe ngamanye. Amandla okuyiqonda nokutolika iinkcazelo zobuniniyane nesebe lenkonzo yobugcisa nokusebenzisa ulwazi kumanyathelo okuthenga. Amandla okucwangcisa nokulawula iinkqubo namaphrojekthi ahlukene. Amandla okwenza uphando olungcono olumnceda ekulawulweni kweengcinezelo. Amandla okulungisa iingxelo, iinkqubo nokubonisa amandla okukhuthaza abantu basebenzayo, ukuphucula ubuchule nokuthuthuzela isiko lokuba ngabantu abangcono. Amandla okuphumeza iimicimbi yamaphrojekthi ngexesha elichaziweyo – ulungiso lweefayili, iingxelo, ukubamba iintlanganisa ezindaweni zokusebenza kwaye athathe iingxelo zale ntlanganisa. Lawula abantu. Lawula imali.
xh.duties: Cwangcisa, phumeza ulawule ukugcinwa kolwakhiwo nesebe lenkonzo yenkxazo zolu bugcisa ezo ndaweni zomtholampilo zonke nakwolwakhiwo. Lawula ukunikelwa kweenkonzo zobuniniyane obuchanekileyo kwaye unike inkxazo kwisebe elikhulu kunye nazo ndawo zomtholampilo. Nikezela ngolawulo lwengaphandle ekugcineni kolwakhiwo nolwa bugcisa okunikelwa kuzo ndawo zomtholampilo zonke. Lawula ukufumaneka nokusetyenziswa kolwakhiwo lolwazi oQhutyelana osebenze ngokubambisana nabaphathi, abaphathi abaphakathi, oogqirha, abasebenzi baso bacisa boluncedisi bobugcisa kwisebe elikhulu ngokwemigaqo yolwakhiwo nokuqwalaselwa ekugcineni kwalo, ngokwabantu bemithi yempilo ngokubanzi, kwisiqithi kumaqondo amanqanaba esiphithiphithi nakwindawo yomsebenzi ekugcineni kolwakhiwo. Lawula iingcinezelo zomtholampilo zolwakhiwo nemigaqo yokuphucula iNgxangxashelegqa. Lawula ukuhambelana nokuthobela imigaqo enguMthetho woKhuseleko lokuSebenza nakoKunyuka kweempazamo ezinxulumene nezixhobo nokulawulwa okuchanekileyo kweefafa zikawonke wonke ummandla. Misela iNdlela eBonakalisa iNdlela nokuQondisa eQondisa iNdlela, inkxazo nokuhambelana nokuHlinzwa kweMithi yamathuba emthethweni nasezithethweni. Lawula iZixhobo ezithileyo eMthethweni ngokomsebenzi neNkqubo yamaphupha eNgcali yesebe. jobs.title: Head of Clinical Unit: Grade 1
jobs.centre: Tshilidzini Hospital (X1 Post) Mankweng Hospital (X1 Post) (General Surgery, Paediatrics and Child Health] This post is a joint appointment with the University of Limpopo, either as a senior lecturer or as an associate professor / professor if the requirements of the University of Limpopo are met.
jobs.salary_text: R2 168 145 per annum, plus Rural Allowance of 18% of basic salary PSCBC will apply. Commuted Overtime in accordance with the provincial policy and service delivery requirements
jobs.summary: Head of Clinical Unit Grade 1 at Tshilidzini and Mankweng Hospitals, jointly appointed with the University of Limpopo, responsible for clinical governance and comprehensive health service delivery.
jobs.requirements: Qualifications and Experience: A National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/Matric plus an appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa [HPCSA] as a Medical Practitioner Independent Practice or Public Service in the relevant medical specialty / sub- speciality. Current registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner Independent practice / public service in a relevant specialty Grade 1: A minimum of three [3] years as a Medical Specialist or Medical Sub-specialist. The following shall be added advantages: Supervision of Registrar/s for MMed dissertation Peer reviewed publications/s. PhD qualification or candidacy [Qualification and proof of registration to be submitted on date of interview]. A valid driver’s license except people with disabilities. Willingness to work in a flexi and/or shift system. Knowledge And Skills: Sound knowledge, skill and experience in the relevant discipline. Evidence of leadership, innovation and managerial ability. Evidence of ability to effectively train and teach at undergraduate and postgraduate level and experience in research and supervision Vision for the development of services in your discipline and appropriate knowledge of the health system. Personal Attributes: Integrity and professionalism. Attention to detail and accuracy. Accountability and reliability. Proactive and results oriented. Calm under pressure and adaptable to change. Committed to continuous learning and Batho Pele principles

Coordinate clinical responsibilities with and supervise specialists, registrars, medical officers, interns and other health care workers in your discipline. Lead academic activities in both undergraduate and postgraduate levels. Provide continuing medical education programmes for doctors in the relevant discipline. Assist with the strategic and operational planning of services in the catchment area of the hospital.

af.title: Hoof van Kliniese Eenheid: Graad 1
af.summary: Hoof van Kliniese Eenheid Graad 1 by Tshilidzini en Mankweng Hospitale, gesamentlik aangestel met die University of Limpopo, verantwoordelik vir kliniese bestuur en omvattende gesondheidsdienslewering.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies en Ervaring: 'n National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/Matric plus 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa [HPCSA] as 'n Mediese Practitioner Independent Practice of Public Service in die tersaaklike mediese spesialiteit / subspesialiteit moontlik maak. Huidige registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Medical Practitioner Independent practice / public service in 'n tersaaklike spesialiteit Graad 1: 'n Minimum van drie [3] jaar as 'n Medical Specialist of Medical Sub-specialist. Die volgende sal as voordele dien: Toesig oor Registrar/s vir MMed-verhandeling. Gepublieerde artikels in ewekniegebaseerde tydskrifte. PhD-kwalifikasie of kandidaatskap [Kwalifikasie en bewys van registrasie moet op die datum van die onderhoud voorgelê word]. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie behalwe persone met gestremdhede. Bereidwilligheid om in 'n buigbare en/of skofstelsel te werk. Kennis en Vaardighede: Deeglike kennis, vaardigheid en ervaring in die tersaaklike dissipline. Bewys van leierskap, innovasie en bestuursvermoë. Bewys van vermoë om doeltreffend op voorgraadse en nagraadse vlak op te lei en te onderrig, en ervaring in navorsing en toesig. Visie vir die ontwikkeling van dienste in jou dissipline en toepaslike kennis van die gesondheidsstelsel. Persoonlike eienskappe: Integriteit en professionaliteit. Aandag aan detail en akkuraatheid. Verantwoordelikheid en betroubaarheid. Proaktief en resultaatgerig. Kalm onder druk en aanpasbaar by verandering. Toegewyd aan deurlopende leer en Batho Pele-beginsels.
af.duties: Vir Kliniese Dissiplines: Beplan en lewer omvattende doeltreffende gesondheidsdiens vir pasiënte in die provinsie, toepaslik vir die dissipline en sorgvlak, insluitend uitreik- en ondersteuningsdienste na ander sorgvlakke in die opvangsgebied. Neem die leiding oor kliniese bestuur en gehalteverbetering in jou area van verantwoordelikheid, insluitend die ontwikkeling van tersaaklike riglyne en protokolle en die versekering van kliniese en sterftes-oudits. Koördineer kliniese verantwoordelikhede met en hou toesig oor spesialiste, registrars, mediese beamptes, internes en ander gesondheidsorgwerkers in jou dissipline. Neem die leiding oor akademiese aktiwiteite op beide voorgraadse en nagraadse vlakke. Verskaf programme vir voortgesette mediese opvoeding vir dokters in die tersaaklike dissipline. Bystand verleen met strategiese en operasionele beplanning van dienste in die opvangsgebied van die hospital.

xh.title: Intloko yeNqanaba leZamaklinikhala: Greidi 1
xh.summary: INtloko yokuLawula iNqanaba leZamaklinikhala iGreidi 1 kwiZibhedi zaseTshilidzini naseMankweng, ezakhelwa ngokwamaxhashe kunye neNyuvesi yaseLimpopo, nayo inoxanduva lokulawula ukusebenza ngokwamaklinikhala nokuhambisa ngokubanzi iinkonzo zeempilo.
xh.requirements: Izazisiweyo kunye nohambo lobomi: Isatifiketi esihle senukurhela esiNguni kwiNcwadana yeMfundo eNgezisa kwiKhaya / iGreidi 12 / Isatifiketi sokuqeda ibhasikili, ukhetho okulungelelane ngokusetyenziswa kwesisigqeba ngobuchwepheshe obungaqaliswa iNkundla yeeZiseko zokuQinisekisa iNqanaba leMfundo nakwiMveliso yeKamva leMfundo nakwiNkundla yeZamaklinikhala yaseMzantsi Afrika. Ngokubakho kwezinye iinkqubo ezinokwenzeka ukuba kukho iNdawo yokuqinisekisa isigqeba ngokusetyenziswa kwesisigqeba. Iindawo ezikwisigqeba ngokusetyenziswa kwesisigqeba ziqinisekisa ukuba kubekho iNkundla yokuQinisekisa iMfundo nokuqinisekisa ngokusetyenziswa kwesisigqeba ngokusesikweni ekufuneka kubekho. Ukuya kubakho izazisiweyo ezikwisigqeba ngokusetyenziswa kwesisigqeba, kubekho iNkundla yokuQinisekisa iMfundo ngokusetyenziswa kwesisigqeba kubakho. Isatifiketi ngokusetyenziswa kwesisigqeba ngokusetyenziswa kwesisigqeba singaqinisekiswa. Iindawo ezikwisigqeba ngokusetyenziswa kwesisigqeba ziqinisekisa ukuba kubekho iNkundla yokuQinisekisa iMfundo ngokusetyenziswa kwesisigqeba kubakho.
xh.duties: Kwiimajoro eziyiZamanyanzeliso: Cwangcisa kwaye uze unikezele ngolunye lukhawulezayo, ngokusebenza kakuhle inkonzo yezempilo kubakhusiwo kwiphondo, ngokufanelekileyo kweso sithili kwaye kwelo nqanaba lokunyamekela, kuquka nokubakho nokuxhasa iinkonzo kumanye amanqanaba okunyamekela kweloo ndawo ekungekhoyo. Qhuba ulawulo ngokwamaklinikhala ngokusesikweni nokuphucula umgangatho kummandla wakho owoyinxalenye yomsebenzi, kuquka nokulungelelanisa iindlela ezifanelekileyo neenkqubo, kuqinisekisa ukuba kubenako ukuhlolwa kwezokhlinikhala kwezokufa. Lawula iinzibezo ngokwamaklinikhala kunye nokulawula abaz emptiphekileyo, ababhali-magama, amakhomishinala abagqithisiweyo kwezonya, nezinye iindlu zokwamaklinikhala kummandla wakho. Qhuba imisebenzi yemfundo kwakunye nabanqwelwa bokuqala kunye nabagqithisiweyo kummandla wakho.

zu.title: Uhlelo Lwezempilo: Isikhundla Esiyinhloko: Izinga 1
zu.summary: Isikhundla Esiyinhloko Sezempilo Izinga 1 at Tshilidzini and Mankweng Hospitals, sinikwa njengesikhundla esihlangenwe nhlobo ne-University of Limpopo, sibhekele imithetho yokulawula izempo kanye nokulethwa kwezinsiza eziphelele zezempilo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu Nempilo Yokusebenza: Isitifikedi Seziqu Eziphakeme Zezwe/Izinga 12/Isi-Matric kanye nesiqu esifanele esivumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengesenzo sezokwelapha esizimele noma esikhundleni ssempilo kwikhalo/ikhasinda lenzima yokwelapha. Ukubhalisa njengamanje ku-HPCSA njengesenzo sezokwelapha esizimele/ezikhundleni sezempilo kwikhalo Izinga 1: Okungenani iminyaka ithathu [3] njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha noma ikhasinda wezokwelapha. Okulandelayo kuzobe yizinzuzo ezengeziwe: Ukugcina amaNqabanqaba be-MMd ethesis. Izishicilelo ezihlolwe ngabafundi. Isiqu se-PhD noma ukuba ngumyaleli. [Iziqu kanye nobufakazi bokubhalisa kuzofakwa ngosuku lokuqashwa]. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile. Ukuzithoba ekusebenzeni ngemithetho eguquguqukayo noma/yi-shift. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi olujulile, amakhono kanye nolwazi kwikhalo. Ubuciko obuboniswayo bokuziphatha, imvelakithi nobukhulu bokuhola. Ubuciko bokufundisa nokuhola abafundi ngamazinga aphansi naphakeme kanye nolwazi lokuphenya kanye nokuhola. Ubuke bokwakha izinsiza kwikhalo yakho kanye nolwazi olufanele ngezinhlelo zezempilo. Iminikelo Yomuntu: Ukuqotho nobungcwathi. Ukuqasha kuminingwane nokulunga. Ukuphendula kanye nokuthembeka. Ukuba nobunye ngaphambili nokubuka imiphumela. Ukwaziswa ngaphantsi koxanduva kokuzezelwa nokuzivumelanisa nezinto ezingaba khona. Ukuzinikela ekufundeni ngokungapheli kanye nemigqango kaBatho Pele
zu.duties: Amakhalo Okwelapha: Cwangcisa futhi unikeze insiza eziphelele eziphelele zezempilo kubaphula-balwe esifundazweni, ehambisana nekhalo neni esibhekele kuhlangene nokukhishwa kwezinsiza ezengeziwe kwamanye amazinga ezempilo esikhungweni. Hola imithetho yokulawula izempilo kanye nokuphucula izinga kwesikhundla sakho esibhekele, okuhlanganisa ukwakha imiqombo nezinhlelo kanye noqeqesho lokuhola izimpilo nokufa. Lunganisa izakhamuzi zezempilo kanye noKuhola Ochwepheshe, abayiNgqinamba, Ochwepheshe Bezempilo, Ochwepheshe abasha kanye nabanye abasebenzi bezokunakekelwa ezempilo kwikhalo lakho. Hola imisebenzi yemfundo kumazinga aphansi naphakeme. Hlela izinhlelo zemfundo ezingapheli yezokwelapha kubadokotela kwikhalo. Siza nokuqamba imithetho eguquguqukayo kanye nocwangciso lwezinsiza ezikhungweni ezisemthethweni.

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Manager: Medical Grade 1
jobs.salary_text: R1 713 534 per annum, (all-inclusive remuneration package], plus 22% of basic salary ISRDS Nodes Rural Allowance.
jobs.summary: Senior Clinical Manager position at Philadelphia Hospital in Limpopo requiring HPCSA registration and three years' experience as an independent medical practitioner.
jobs.requirements: Qualifications and Experience: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa [HPCSA] as Medical Practitioner. Current registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Medical Practitioner. A minimum of three [3] years appropriate experience as an Independent Medical Practitioner after registration with Health Professions Council of South Africa [HPCSA] as an Independent Medical Practitioner. Experience as head of clinical services will be an added advantage. All applicants must be South African citizens or permanent residents. Willingness to do after-hours work and be on call including shift work. A valid driver’s license except people with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of current Health and Public Services Legislation, Regulations and Policies. Sound clinical knowledge. Sound Medical Ethics with emphasis on budget control. Solid background of Epidemiology or demonstrative ability to use health information for planning. Sound knowledge of Human Resource Management and Quality Assurance Programmes
jobs.duties: Lead and manage the Medical and Health Care Services, ensuring the continuum of care in the Geographical service area of the hospital as well as appropriate referral. Ensure clinical governance, clinical guidelines and adherence to clinical protocols. Coordinate clinical responsibilities of Medical Practitioners and Allied Health personnel including the management and implementation of outreach and in-reach to the geographical service area. Ensure in-service training and supervision to all health care providers. Participate in the Quality Improvement Programme of the Department and the hospital and ensure that policies and procedures are followed. Allocate and manage resources, both human and financial. Monitor key performance indicators and plan quality improvement strategies to address the gaps.

af.title: Senior Kliniese Bestuurder: Medies Graad 1
af.summary: Senior Kliniese Bestuurder-posisie by Philadelphia Hospital in Limpopo wat HPCSA-registrasie en drie jaar se ervaring as 'n onafhanklike mediese praktisyn vereis.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies en Ervaring: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa [HPCSA] as Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Huidige registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Mediese Praktisyn. 'n Minimum van drie [3] jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Onafhanklike Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa [HPCSA] as 'n Onafhanklike Mediese Praktisyn. Ervaring as hoof van kliniese dienste sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Alle aansoekers moet Suid-Afrikaanse burgers of permanente inwoners wees. Bereidwilligheid om buite-ure werk te doen en oproepdiens te doen insluitend skofwerk. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie behalwe persone met gestremdhede. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van huidige Gesondheids- en Openbare Dienste-wetgewing, Regulasies en Beleide. Deeglike kliniese kennis. Deeglike Mediese Etiek met klem op begrotingsbeheer. Vaste agtergrond in Epidemiologie of demonstratiewe vermoë om gesondheidsinligting vir beplanning te gebruik. Deeglike kennis van Menslike Hulpbronbestuur en Kwaliteitsversekeringsprogramme.
af.duties: Lei en bestuur die Mediese en Gesondheidsorgdienste, en verseker die kontinuïteit van sorg in die geografiese diensarea van die hospitaal asook toepaslike verwysing. Verseker kliniese bestuur, kliniese riglyne en nakoming van kliniese protokolle. Koördineer kliniese verantwoordelikhede van Mediese Praktisyns en Geallieerde Gesondheidspersoneel insluitend die bestuur en implementering van uitreik en inreik na die geografiese diensarea. Verseker in-diensopleiding en toesig aan alle gesondheidsorgverskaffers. Neem deel aan die Kwaliteitsverbeteringsprogram van die departement en die hospitaal en verseker dat beleide en prosedures gevolg word. Allokateer en bestuur hulpbronne, beide menslik en finansiël. Monitor sleutelprestasie-aanwysers en beplan kwaliteitsverbeteringstrategieë om die gapings aan te spreek.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezemvelangcmda Ophakeme: Ezesayensi Yesifo izinga 1
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi wezemvelangcmda ophakeme esibhedlela i-Philadelphia esifundazweni i-Limpopo esidinga ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA namafomu eminyaka emithathu njengompraktisa wezokwelapha ozimele.
zu.requirements: Izindingo nemvelo: Iqeqeshe elifanele elivumela ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengompraktisa wezokwelapha. Ukubhaliswa kwamanje ku-HPCSA njengompraktisa wezokwelapha. Okungenani eminyaka emithathu [3] yemvelo efanele njengompraktisa wezokwelapha ozimele ngemva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengompraktisa wezokwelapha ozimele. Imvelo njengenhloko yezinkonzo zezemvelangcmda kuzoba yinzuzo engeziwe. Bonke abafaka izicelo kufanele babe ngabazali base-South Africa noma abahlali abahlala ihlala. Ukuzithoba ukwenza umsebenzi wesikhathi esingomphiloko nokuibiza kuhlanganise nomsebenzi weshifu. Ilayisense yokushayela elivumelekile ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemithetho, imithetho elandelayo nemigomo yezempilo kanye nezinkonzo zomphakathi yangokwamanje. Ulwazi olusogqweni lwezemvelangcmda. Izikolo zezokwelapha ezisogqweni ngokugcizelela ekuqotheni imali. Isizinda esiqinile se-Epidemiology noma ikhono elibonakalayo lokusebenzisa ulwazi olungezempilo ukuze kuhlelwe. Ulwazi olusogqweni lokuphathwa Kwabantu kanye namaprogramu eQinisekisa Ikhwalithi
zu.duties: Bhekisa uphathe Izinkonzo Ezesayensi Yesifo kanye Nezokunakekelwa Kwezempilo, uqinisekisa ukuqhubeka kokunakekelwa esikhundleni sesevisi yendawo yesibhedlela kanye nokuthumela kabanzi lapho kufanele khona. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa kwemvelangcmda, imihlahlandlela yezemvelangcmda nokulandelwa kwemithetho yezemvelangcmda. Hlanganisa izibopho zemvelangcmda zompraktisa wezokwelapha kanye nabasebenzi bezempilo abaxhubile kuhlanganise nokuphathwa nokusetshenziswa kwenqubo yokufinyelela kubantu besevisi yendawo. Qinisekisa ukuqeqeshwa nokuqaphelwa kubo bonke abanikezi besevisi yezempilo. Ngenxa kwenqubo yokuthuthukisa Ikhwalithi Kandaba yomnyango nesesibhedlela bese uqinisekisa ukuthi imigomo kanye nokuqhutshwa kwayo iyalandelwa. Hlukanisa uphathe izinsiza, zibantu kanye nezimali. Qapha izinkomba eziyisihluthulelo zentengo bese uhlela izindlela zokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi ukulungisa izikhala.

xh.title: UMlawuli ophezulu weZonyezakwiqondo: iNyanga inqanaba 1
xh.summary: Isithuba soMlawuli ophezulu wezonyezakwiqondo ePhiladelphia Hospital eLimpopo esifuna ukubhalisa kwiHPCSA kunye neminyaka emithathu yamava njengoGqithi weNyanga ozimeleyo.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno nemGqiba: Isidanga esifanelekileyo esikuvumela ukuba ubhalise kwiBhunga lwezoNyango eMhlabini iSebe iSouth Africa [HPCSA] njengoGqitha weNyanga. Ukubhalisa kwangoku kwiBhunga lezoNyango eMhlabini iSebe iSouth Africa (HPCSA) njengoGqithi weNyanga. Uqobo lweeNyanga ezintathu [3] zeminyaka yamava afanelekileyo njengoGqitha weNyanga ozimeleyo emva kokubhalisa kwakhe kwiBhunga lezoNyango eMhlabini iSebe iSouth Africa [HPCSA] njengoGqitha weNyanga ozimeleyo. Ilunga elizimeleyo lisesiCwangciso seNyango. Ubukho bemigaqo yomxholo weNyango kwakunye nokuqonda ngokupheleleyo kweziNyango. Amava njengentloko yezinkonzo zonyezakwiqondo kuya kuba lusizo. Zonke iindlela zokusebenzisa iNyango zidinga ukuba ngamakhamva asuka, iphantse kwesinawo, singawazedelwa abantu abadla ngokomelela ukuba basebenze emini nentsimbi kwaye, bapvand uluntu. Iimfuneko
xh.duties:
Busa uphathise iinkonzo zezonyezakwiqondo nemisebenzi yeMnikezelo wezoNylvoNyezo kulwandle lweeSebe loongqondo, kuqalise ngokusold Mornkqonko wezikwiozaxabo ekulawulweni yonke iNkonyo zoXilongo lonke elisesiCwangciso Sezizonoo ngexesha elicimileyo, ngenkxaso yeSenzo essibusa ngokubeka noalnini nabalahleko abo
abamenyelelweyo. Qinisekisa ulawulo lwezonyezakwiqondo, imigaqo yezonyezakwiqondo nokuthobela iinkqubo ezisemthethweni zezonyezakwiqondo. Lawula izibophezelo zezonyezakwiqondo zoBagqithi beGqitha kwiinyanga ezahlukeneyo neBasemagqweni aphiwo, kuqalise ngokuphathisa kwaye uphathe ukusasazwa nokwamkelwa kwenkonzo exubeneyo kolunye ukuze kungangeniswa iinkqubo kwindawo engeziwa ngokumiselweyo. Qinisekisa uqeqesho lwaqondo kwaye uqonde ukulawula onke amanxu
anamnikela iinkonzo ezonyezakwiqondo. Thatha inxaxheba kwiNkqubo yokuphucula izinga leSabe neZibedlela uze qinisekise ukuba kuthintelwa kwaye kusetyenziswe imigaqo ngeenkqubo ngokufanelekileyo. Sabela kwaye ulawule izixhobo, zombini ezonto ezikwiqondo nemicimbi yemali. Lilindele izalathiso eziphambili zokuphumeza iziphumo uze ucwangcise iindidiwe zokuphucula izinga ukulungisa izikrozo.

jobs.title: Clinical Manager: Medical: Grade 1 (SHIFTS)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 479 723 per annum, (all-inclusive remuneration package), plus 18% of basic salary PSCBC Rural Allowance or 22% ISRDS Nodes Rural Allowance
jobs.summary: Clinical manager needed at Groblersdal Hospital to lead medical and healthcare services, requiring HPCSA registration and three years' experience as an independent medical practitioner.
jobs.requirements: Qualifications and Experience: An appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa [HPCSA] as Medical Practitioner. Current registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa [HPCSA] as Medical Practitioner. A minimum of three [3] years appropriate experience as an Independent Medical Practitioner after registration with Health Professions Council of South Africa [HPCSA] as an Independent Medical Practitioner. Experience as head of clinical services will be an added advantage. All applicants must be South African citizens or permanent residents. Willingness to do after-hours work and be on call including shift work. Computer literacy including MS Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint; Literacy in virtual meeting platforms. Valid driver's license except for people with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of current Health and Public Services Legislation, Regulations and Policies. Sound clinical knowledge. Sound Medical Ethics with emphasis on budget control. Solid background of Epidemiology or demonstrative ability to use health information for planning. Sound knowledge of Human Resource Management and Quality Assurance Programmes
jobs.duties: Lead and manage the Medical and Health Care Services, ensuring the continuum of care in the Geographical service area of the hospital as well as appropriate referral. Ensure clinical governance, clinical guidelines and adherence to clinical protocols. Coordinate clinical responsibilities of Medical Practitioners and Allied Health personnel including the management and implementation of outreach and in-reach to the geographical service area. Ensure in-service training and supervision to all health care providers. Participate in the Quality Improvement Programme of the Department and the hospital and ensure that policies and procedures are followed. Allocate and manage resources, both human and financial. Monitor key performance indicators and plan quality improvement strategies to address the gaps.
jobs.enquiries: General enquiries about the advertised posts should be directed to Ms Hlokoa RE Tel No: (015) 293 6406, Ms Mompei MM Tel No: (015) 293 6126 / Ms Sebake RL Tel No: (015) 293 6426, Ms Sebola MF Tel No: (015) 293 6002 and Ms Mothiba JT Tel No: (015) 293 6329 during office hours.
jobs.applications: The circular of advertised vacant posts will be posted on the following websites: https://erecruitment.limpopo.gov.za/, www.ldoh.gov.za, www.dpsa.gov.za and Provincial Department social media. Applicants must apply on the following website: https://erecruitment.limpopo.gov.za/

af.title: Kliniese Bestuurder: Medies: Graad 1 (SKOFTE)
af.summary: Kliniese bestuurder benodig by Groblersdal Hospitaal om mediese en gesondheidsorgdienste te lei, wat HPCSA-registrasie en drie jaar se ervaring as 'n onafhanklike mediese praktisyn vereis.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies en Ervaring: 'n Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa [HPCSA] as mediese praktisyn toelaat. Huidige registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa [HPCSA] as mediese praktisyn. 'n Minimum van drie [3] jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n onafhanklike mediese praktisyn na registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa [HPCSA] as 'n onafhanklike mediese praktisyn. Ervaring as hoof van kliniese dienste sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Alle aansoekers moet Suid-Afrikaanse burgers of permanente inwoners wees. Bereidwilligheid om na-ure werk te doen en wagdiens te doen insluitend skofwerk. Rekenaarvaardigheid insluitend MS Outlook, Word, Excel en PowerPoint; Geletterdheid in virtuele vergaderingsplatforms. Geldige bestuurderslisensie behalwe vir persone met gestremdhede. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van huidige Gesondheids- en Openbare Dienste-wetgewing, Regulasies en Beleide. Deeglike kliniese kennis. Deeglike Mediese Etiek met klem op begrotingsbeheer. Vaste agtergrond in Epidemiologie of demonstratiewe vermoë om gesondheidsinligting vir beplanning te gebruik. Deeglike kennis van Menslike Hulpbronbestuur en Kwaliteitsversekeringsprogramme.
af.duties: Lei en bestuur die mediese en gesondheidsorgdienste en verseker die kontinuïteit van sorg in die geografiese diensgebied van die hospitaal asook toepaslike verwysings. Verseker kliniese bestuur, kliniese riglyne en nakoming van kliniese protokolle. Koördineer kliniese verantwoordelikhede van mediese praktisyne en bondgenootlike gesondheidspersoneel, insluitend die bestuur en implementering van uitreik en inreik tot die geografiese diensgebied. Verseker in-diensopleiding en toesig aan alle gesondheidsorgverskaffers. Neem deel aan die Kwaliteitsverbeteringsprogram van die Departement en die hospitaal en verseker dat beleide en prosedures gevolg word. Allokeer en bestuur hulpbronne, beide menslik en finansieel. Monitor sleutelprestasie-aanwysers en beplan kwaliteitsverbeteringstrategieë om die gapings aan te spreek.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezokwelapha: Ezokwelapha: Isigaba 1 (AMASHIFTHI)
zu.summary: Kudingeka umphathi wezokwelapha esibhedlela i-Groblersdal Hospital ukuba ahola izinsizakalo zezokwelapha nezempilo, kudingwa ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA nokuba neminyaka emithathu yokuhlola njengodokotela ozimele.
zu.requirements: Iziqu nokuhlola: Isiqu esifanele esivumela ukubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa [HPCSA] njengodokotela. Ukubhalisa kwamanje ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa [HPCSA] njengodokotela. Ukuze kube seminyakeni engu- [3] eqhubekayo yokuhlola njengodokotela ozimele ngemva kokubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa [HPCSA] njengodokotela ozimele. Ukuba nguqhishololwazi ohlela izinsizakalo ezokwelapha kuzoba yinjewane. Bonke abafaka izicelo kumele babe ngabazakwabo baseNingizimu Afrika noma abahlala njalo. Ukulungele ukusebenza emahoreni angemva kwesikhathi kanye nokuba thintana kuhlanganise nomsebenzi wamashifithi. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngakwikhompyutha kuhlanganise i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint; Ulwazi kumakhonferensi ezibukwa kwi-intanethi. Ilayisensi yokuqasha ehamba kahle ngaphandle kwabantu abasikhwesabathakathi. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemithetho, imithethonqondo kanye nemigomo ekhona yezempilo kanye nesezinsizakalo zikahulumeni. Ulwazi oluhle ngemithetho yezokwelapha. Izimilo zezokwelapha ezinhle ngqo nokugxila ekulawuleni imali. Ulwazi oluhle mayelana ne-Epidemiology noma ikhono lokusebenzisa ukwaziswa ngempilo ukwakheka. Ulwazi oluhle ngokuqashwa kwabantu kanye namaqaphelo ekuqinisekisweni ikhwalithi
zu.duties: Hola futhi uphathe izinsizakalo zezokwelapha nezempilo, uqinisekisa ukuthi ukunakekelwa kuhlakazekile endaweni yezinsizakalo yesibhedlela kanye nokuhamba kahle kokuthumela abagula. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezokwelapha, imihlahlandlela yezokwelapha kanye nokulandela imithetho yezokwelapha. Hlanganisa izinkinga zezokwelapha zodokotela nomsebenzi ohlangene nezempilo kuhlanganise ukuphathwa nokusebenzisa ukwenza ukuthutha kuleyo ndawo yezinsizakalo. Qinisekisa ukuqeqeshwa ngaphakathi nokuqashwa kubo bonke abanakekela impilo. Thatha inxaxheba kuhlelo lokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi loMnyango kanye nesibhedlela uqinisekise ukuthi imigomo kanye nemikhuba ilandelwa. Sabelaza futhi uphathe izinsiza, zangabantu nangempilo. Buka izinkomba ezinkulu zokusebenza uhlele izindlela ezithuthukisa ikhwalithi ukulungisa izikhala.

xh.title: uMlawuli wezoKliniki: wezoNyango: isiQophiso 1 (Iishifthi)
xh.summary: Kufuneka ibe ngumLawuli wezoKliniki eGroblersdal Hospital ukuze ahlope iinkonzo ezibonelela ngonyango lokwaLiswa kwezempilo, enezimfanelo zokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kunye neminyaka elishumi eyamava njengomNyangi oZimeleyo.
xh.requirements: Iziqu kunye noQeqesho: Isiqu esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalisa koBhungo loBuchule bokwaNyanga eMzantsi Afrika [HPCSA] njengomNyangi. Ugqibelo lokubhalisa koBhungo loBuchule bokwaNyanga eMzantsi Afrika [HPCSA] njengomNyangi. Okona ngxaki imfutshane kweminyaka elishumi [10] yamava afanelekileyo njengomNyangi oZimeleyo emva kokubhalisa koBhungo loBuchule bokwaNyanga eMzantsi Afrika [HPCSA] njengomNyangi oZimeleyo. Ulwabiwo lwamava njengentloko yeenkonzo zokunyanga kuya kuba lusikelelo. Onke amagama abantu mazingamaMzantsi Afrika mazingamaBhulu magingagqibele ukuba ngabemi abahlala khona. Ukulungelelanisa ukwenza umsebenzi wakho ngemini ngeyure yaye ulungele ukubizwa kuquka nakumashishini. Ulwazi lokusebenza i-computer kuquka ne-MS Outlook, i-Word, i-Excel, kunye ne-PowerPoint; Ulwazi ukusebenza iinkqubo zokudibana kwizikrini ezingekhoyo. Ibhagolo lokushukuma libhiyozelwe kodwa kungalitshwatywa abantu abakhubekileyo. Ulwazi nemigaqo: Ulwazi ngokuBhaliswa kwangoku kwezoBumpilo kunye nemigaqo yezeNhlonipho yoluntu. Ulwazi olubonakalayo lweenkonzo zokunyanga. Izimilo ezinzima ezoNyango lwezilo ekuqatshelweni kolawulo lwe bhajethi. Isimbali esinamava nge-Epidemiology okanye isakhono esibonakalayo sokusebenzisa iNkcukacha zakuNqulo ekuYilo. Ulwazi olubonakalayo ngolawulo lweNhlabathi yamathuba kwaye eQinisekisa iNkqubo eYilelweyo ukuze zikuphucule.
xh.duties: Busa kwaye ulawule Iinkonzo zokuNya kwezempilo nokuNxulumana, ukuqinisekisa ukubakho kokuNya okuqhagamshelwayo kwindawo yesebe le-geographical yesibhedlele nakwindawo efanayo yokuthumela abaguli kwamanye amaziko. Qinisekisa ulawulo lweenkonzo zokunyanga, iindlela zokuqonda ezingundoqo kunye nokuLandela imigaqo yeenkonzo zokunyanga. Qhagamshela iimviswano zokunyanga zoBhedeshala wezoKliniki kwaye lubuye lwaqhelanise nabasebenzi bezoNyango, kuquka nolawulo nokusebenzisa iinkonzo zokuhamba kwindawo efunyaniswa isibhedlele kunye nabantu bakhangele kuyo indawo leyo. Qinisekisa ukuqeqeshwa okusekho nakho emsebenzini kunye nokuQondisa onke amanqaku ezempilo aphiqelekileyo. Thatha inxaxheba kwiNkqubo yokuPhucula umngangatsho wesebe nesesibhedlele kwaye uqinisekise ukuba kusetyenziswa iinkqubo namagunya ngokufaneleyo. Cacisa kwaye ulawule izixhobo, ngokomntu nakulwabiwo lwemali. Qaphela izalathiso ezingundoqo zokuQonda ukwenza umsebenzi kwaye ucebe iindlela zokuPhucula umngangatsho zokulungisa izikroba.

jobs.salary_text: Grade A: R1 317 108 per annum, (all-inclusive remuneration package) Grade B: R1 593 765 per annum, (all-inclusive remuneration package) [The Department will determine the salary package based on years of experience post professional registration]
jobs.summary: Chief Engineer: Mechanical needed at the Limpopo Provincial Office in Polokwane to manage engineering designs and maintenance strategies for the Department of Health.
jobs.requirements: Qualifications and Experience: An appropriate Degree in Mechanical Engineering. Registered as a Professional Engineer with ECSA. Six [6] years’ experience. Experience in a health care environment or an environment of similar complex will be an added advantage. Computer literacy including MS Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint; Virtual meeting platforms literacy. The successful applicant must be prepared to travel extensively throughout the province and work longer hours. A valid driver’s license except for people with disabilities. Main Role: To perform and manage all aspects of varied innovative and complex engineering activities that result in progress in technology and engineering applications and provide strategic direction in the process. The ideal candidate must have: the ability to understand and apply the Provincial IDMS, guide and operate within all applicable legislation, policies, frameworks and instruction notes. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies: The incumbents of these posts will be responsible for performing and managing all aspects of varied innovative and complex engineering activities that result in progress in technology and engineering applications and provide strategic direction in the process. The ideal candidate must have: - Ability to apply the Provincial Infrastructure Delivery Management System [IDMS]. Ability to understand the health services plan of the Department and specifically the requirements for engineering services. Ability to undertake engineering design and analyze knowledge. Ability to understand and interpret specifications for engineering & technical services and application of knowledge for procurement processes. Ability to plan and manage a diverse portfolio of projects and programmes. Ability to apply Computer-aided engineering applications. Ability to undertake a risk analysis and undertake a risk mitigation strategy. Ability to prepare technical reports, submissions and presentations. Ability to understand how to prepare budgets, extract and interpret information from related information systems.
jobs.duties: Undertake engineering designs. Perform final review and approvals of audits on new engineering designs according to design principles or theory. Manage the execution of maintenance strategies through the provision of appropriate structures, systems and resources. Set engineering maintenance standards, specifications and service levels according to organizational objectives to ensure optimum operational availability. Monitor maintenance efficiencies according to organizational goals to direct or redirect engineering services for the attainment of organizational objectives. Provide effective engineering and project management services. Load project documents and update information on the data management system. Manage compliance with OHS and related legislation. Undertake research. Manage people and budgets.

af.summary: Hoofingenieur: Meganies benodig by die Limpopo Provinsiale Kantoor in Polokwane om ingenieursontwerpe en instandhoudingstrategieë vir die Department of Health te bestuur.

Ervaring in 'n gesondheidsorgomgewing of 'n omgewing van soortgelyke kompleksiteit sal 'n voordeel wees.
