zu.title: Injini Eyinhloko: Yezobunjiniyela Zezimoto: Izinkonzo Zobunjiniyela [grade a
zu.summary: Injini Eyinhloko: Yezobunjiniyela Zezimoto ifunwa eLimpopo Provincial Office ePolokwane ukuphatha izinjongo zokwakhiwa kwezobunjiniyela nezindlela zokugcina umnyango wezempilo.
zu.requirements: Izifundo Nemfundo: Isidiploma esifanele kwezobunjiniyela zazimoto. Ubhaliswe njenge-Injini Yezobungcweti ku-ECSA. Eminyakeni eyi-[6] yamava. Amava kwindawo yezokunakekelwa kwempilo noma endaweni efanayo nenkinga ezobumnandi kakhulu kuzoba yinikidi. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha okuhlanganisa i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint; Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ama-platforms wemihlangano ebonakalayo. Umuntu oqokiwe kumele abe ulungele ukuhamba kakhulu kwiphovinsi asebenze amahora amanengi. Ilayisense yokushayela esebenzayo ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile. Indima Eyinhloko: Ukwenza futhi uphate zonke izinkathi zemisebenzi yezobunjiniyela ehlukene eyisimiso futhi eyinkimbinkimbi ehole ephambanweni kumathebha futhi ezinhlelweni zobunjiniyela, futhi anikeze isiqondiso esimbozohlelo kuleNkinga. Isiqendu esifanele kumele sibe: ukwazi ukuqonda futhi sisebenzise i-Provincial IDMS, sihole futhi sisebenze ngaphakathi kwawo wonke umthetho, izinqubo, izinhlelo-ncumo nemiyalo osemthethweni. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqesha futhi nokwazi ukwenza imisebenzi: Abantu abakulezi zikhundla bazobekwe ngemfanelo yokwenza futhi baphathe zonke izinkathi zemisebenzi yezobunjiniyela ehlukene eyisimiso futhi eyinkimbinkimbi ehole ephambanweni kumathebha futhi ezinhlelweni zobunjiniyela futhi banikeze isiqondiso esimbozohlelo kuleNkinga. Isiqendu esifanele kumele sibe: - Ukuthanda ukusebenzisa i-Provincial Infrastructure Delivery Management System [IDMS]. Ukwazi ukuqonda iNqubo yezinkonzo zezempilo yoMnyango ikakhulukazi izidingo kumasevisi ezobunjiniyela. Ukuthanda ukuqamba izincomo ezobunjiniyela futhi ukuqamba ulwazi. Ukthanda ukuqonda futhi umtshule izincomiso kumasevisi ezobunjiniyela kanye namicu futhi wusebenzise ulwazi kumaphrokhessi okuthenga. Ukthanda ukuhlela futhi uphate iphothifoliyo ehlukene yamaphrojekthi kanye nezinhlelo. Ukthanda ukusebenzisa ezinye izinhlelo zekhompyutha zobunjiniyela. Ukthanda ukwenza ukuhlaziya kwezengozi futhi uhlele amaphuzu ekuyekeni izingozi. Ukthanda ukulungisa imibiko yobuchwepheshe, izinkulumo nemibukiso. Ukthanda ukuqonda ukulungisa izinjongo ezimalini, sikhuphe futhi sithule ulwazi kwizinhlelo ezihlobene nolwazi.
zu.duties: Ukuhlola izincomo zobunjiniyela. Ukwenzisisa futhi uvume ukuhlolwa kwezinto ezintsha kumadesayini zobunjiniyela ngokwezinye izinto noma inqubo yedeth. Ukuphatha ukuqhubwa kwezindlela zokugcina ngesiqinisekiso sezinhlelo ezifanele, amasistimu kanye nezinsizakusetshenziswa. Ukubeka izinga lokugcina izobunjiniyela, izincomiso kanye namasevisi ngokuhlelekile ngamagungqabuko empumelelo ukuqinisekisa ukutholakala okuphumelelayo. Ukuqapha ukuphumelela kokugcina ngokuhlelekile ngamagungqabuko ukuze ahole noma ahlwele amasevisi ezobunjiniyela ukufeza amagungqabuko ezinhlelo. Ukuhlinzeka ngezinkonzo ezinamandla zobunjiniyela futhi uphathamaphrojekthi. Ukufaka imibiko yeprojekthi futhi ulungise ulwazi kwisistimu yokuphatha idetha. Ukuphatha ukumuncwa kwemithetho ye-OHS kanye namanye amath. Ukuhlola ucwaningo. Ukuphatha abantu futhi izinjongo ezimalini.

xh.title: Injiniya Elikhulu: Onyazo: Iinkonzo Zonjiniyela [grade a
xh.summary: Kufuneka iNjiniya Elikhulu: Onyazo kwiLimpopo Provincial Office ePolokwane ukulawula iidisayini zonjiniyela kunye neendlela zolondolozo lweDepartment of Health.
xh.requirements: Izifundo kunye naloo Ngingqi: IDegree efanelekileyo kwiMechanical Engineering. Ubhaliswe njengeNjiniya Yobungcali kwi-ECSA. Cacile ukuba lubungakanani nguSix [6] iminyaka yamava. Amandla kwindawo yenkonzzo yempilo okanye kwindawo enzima njengale kuya kuba lusizo. Ukuba lisebenzisana nekhompyutha kuquka i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel nakwi-PowerPoint; Ulwazi malunga neplatifom zokudibana ngokugqithisileyo. Umfundi ophumeleleyo makabe elungele ukuhamba ihlabathi lonke eliphuma kule_phondo nakusebenza iiyure ezininzi. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekileyo. Indima Eyinhloko: Ukwenza nokulawula onke amacala emisebenzi yonjiniyela ehlukeneyo entsha nenzima evelisa inkqubela phambili kwiteknoloji nakwisetyenziswa senjiniyela kunye nokubonelela ngokuqonda ngokwezicwangciso kule ndlela. Umfakam wamkelekileyo makabe nakho: ulwazi lokuyiqonda nokuyisebenzisa i-Provincial IDMS, ukukhokela nokusebenza ngaphakathi kolawulo lonke, iinkqubo, iinkkango, iithiyori kunye nemiyalelo ephawulayo. Ulwazi, Amandla, Uqeqesho kunye Nokuziphatha: Ababambi bale zithuba baya kuba nawo uxanduva lokwenza nokulawula onke amacala emisebenzi yonjiniyela ehlukeneyo entsha nenzima evelisa inkqubela phambili kwiteknoloji nakwisetyenziswa senjiniyela kunye nokubonelela ngokuqonda ngokwezicwangciso kule ndlela. Umfakam wamkelekileyo makaba nakho: - Amandla okusebenzisa i-Provincial Infrastructure Delivery Management System [IDMS]. Amandla okuqonda iNkqubo yeenkonzo zempilo ye-Department ngokukodwa iimfuno zeenkonzo zonjiniyela. Amandla okwenza iidisayini zonjiniyela nokwahlula-hlula ulwazi. Amandla okuqonda nokutolika iinkcazelo zeenkonzo zonjiniyela ngenkqubo yonjiniyela nakwinkqubo yezobuchwepheshe nokusebenzisa ulwazi kwindlela yokuthenga. Amandla okucwangcisa nokulawula iiportifoliyo zamaphrojekthi ahlukeneyo. Amandla okusebenzisa izicelo zonjiniyela ezisebenzisa ekhompyutheni. Amandla okwenza uhlalutyo lweengozi nokwenza inkqubo yokunciphisa iingozi. Amandla okulungisa iingxelo zobuchwepheshe, okusetyenziswa nakwindibano. Amandla okuqonda indlela yokulungisa amabhajeti, ukutsala nokutolika ulwazi kwinkqubo yolwazi ehlotshaneni.
xh.duties: Ukuwenza iidisayini zonjiniyela. Ukuqamba ngokugqibeleyo nokuvuma iindaba zokuhlola iidisayini ezintsha zonjiniyela ngokwemiqathango okanye ngokwethiyori. Ukulawula ukuqedwa kweenkqubo zolondolozo ngokubonelela ngezakhiwo, iinkqubo namacebo afanelekileyo. Ukumisela iistenderd zolondolozo lwonjiniyela, iinkcazelo kunye namanqanaba enkonzo ngokweenjongo zoluntu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufumaneka okugqibelelyo kumsebenzi. Ukuqapha ukusebenza kolondolozo ngokweenjongo zoluntu ukuyisa okanye ukujikeleza iinkonzo zonjiniyela ngokufezekwa kweenjongo zoluntu. Ukubonelela ngeenkonzo zonjiniyela nakwinkqubo yolawulo lwamaphrojekthi. Ukufaka amaxwebhu amaphrojekthi nokuhlaziya ulwazi kwinkqubo yolawulo lwedata. Ukulawula ukuzithoba ngokwe-OHS nakumthetho ongengayo. Ukwenza uphononongo. Ukulawula abantu kunye namabhajeti.

jobs.title: Chief Engineer: Electrical: Engineering Services (GRADE a
jobs.salary_text: Grade A: R1 317 108 per annum, [all-inclusive remuneration package] Grade B: R1 593 765 per annum, [all-inclusive remuneration package] [The Department will determine the salary package based on years of experience post professional registration]
jobs.summary: Chief Electrical Engineer overseeing engineering designs and maintenance strategies at the Limpopo Department of Health Provincial Office.
jobs.requirements: Qualifications and Experience: A National Senior Certificate /Grade 12/Matric plus an appropriate Degree in Electrical Engineering. Registered as a Professional Engineer with ECSA. Six [6] years’ experience. Experience in a health care environment or an environment of similar complex will be an added advantage. Computer literacy including MS Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint; Virtual meeting platforms literacy. The successful applicants must be prepared to travel extensively throughout the province and work longer hours. A valid driver’s license except for people with disabilities. Main Role: To provide electrical engineering inputs and guidance which include all aspects of innovative and complex engineering applications for the development of infrastructure strategies, policies, systems, norms, standards and signing off on electrical installations. The ideal candidate must have: the ability to understand and apply the Provincial IDMS, guide and operate within all applicable legislation, policies, frameworks and instruction notes. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies: The incumbents of these posts will be responsible for performing and managing all aspects of varied innovative and complex engineering activities that result in progress in technology and engineering applications and provide strategic direction in the process. The ideal candidate must have: Ability to apply the Provincial Infrastructure Delivery Management System [IDMS]. Ability to understand the health services plan of the Department and specifically the requirements for engineering services. Ability to undertake engineering design and analyze knowledge. Ability to understand and interpret specifications for engineering & technical services and application of knowledge for procurement processes. Ability to plan and manage a diverse portfolio of projects and programmes. Ability to apply Computer-aided engineering applications. Ability to undertake a risk analysis and undertake a risk mitigation strategy. Ability to prepare technical reports, submissions and presentations. Ability to understand how to prepare budgets, extract and interpret information from related information systems.
jobs.duties: Undertake electrical engineering designs. Perform final review and manage the approval of audits on new electrical engineering designs according to design principles or theory. Manage the execution of maintenance strategies through the provision of appropriate structures, systems and resources. Set engineering maintenance standards, specifications and service levels according to organizational objectives to ensure optimum operational availability. Monitor maintenance efficiencies according to organizational goals to direct or redirect engineering services for the attainment of organizational objectives. Provide effective engineering and project management services. Manage compliance with OHS and related legislation. Load project documents and update information on the data management system. Undertake research. Manage people and budgets.
jobs.enquiries: General enquiries about the advertised posts should be directed to Ms Hlokoa RE Tel No: (015) 293 6406, Ms Mompei MM Tel No: (015) 293 6126 / Ms Sebake RL Tel No: (015) 293 6426, Ms Sebola MF Tel No: (015) 293 6002 and Ms Mothiba JT Tel No: (015) 293 6329 during office hours.

zu.title: Injiniela Ohamba: Kagesi: Amasevisi Ejiniya (GRADE a
zu.summary: Injiniela Ohamba Kagesi oqapha imiklamo yojyela nezinhlela zokugcina ehhovisi lephovinsi leLimpopo Department of Health.
zu.requirements: Iziqu Nempilo Yokusebenza: Isitifikedi Samabanga Aphakeme Kwezwe / Grade 12 / Isimatikuletsheni kanye nedigri efanelekileyo kujyela kagesi. Ubhaliswe njengenjiniela oqeqeshiweyo kwi-ECSA. Ukho isiphi iminyaka eyi-six [6] yempilo yokusebenza. Ulwazi kwindawo yezempilo noma endaweni enenkinga efanale ngenye kuzoba ngumvuzo ogezayo. Ukubhalisele ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha okuhlanganisa i-MS Outlook, i-Word, i-Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint; Ukubhalisele ekusebenziseni izinkundla zokuhlangana zedijithali. Oqeqeshiweyo okhethiweyo kumele abe sobala ukuzohlola ibanga elide kunawo wonke umzila wesifunda kanti futhi kumele akhone ukusebenza isikhathi eside. Ilayisense yokuqashisa esimweni esihamba kahle ngaphandle kwalabo abaphila bokukhubazeka. Indima Eyinhloko: Ukunikeza okokufaka kweenkomba kagesi nokuqondisa okuhlanganisa wonke amaphuzu wokusetyenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe ezingasela nezinomngcele ophakeme ekuthuthukisweni kwezindlela, izinqubomgomo, izinhlelo, izindinganiso, amaphuzu okulinganisa kanti futhi nokusayina kokwakheka kagesi. Oqeqeshiweyo ofaneleyo kumele abe: nakokeyo ukuqonda nokusebenzisa Provincial IDMS, okuqondise kanti futhi asebenze ngaphakathi kwawo wonke umthetho osebenzayo, izinqubomgomo, okhiye bokusebenza kanti futhi nemiyalo yokuqonda. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqesha Nemikhono Yomsebenzi: Abantu abazolesi isikhundla bazobe benoxandisa kanti futhi bayilawula yonke imisebenzi yojyela ehluhlukene enovelu kanti futhi enemiphumela yeqiniso ehlukene ekuthuthukisweni kobuchwepheshe nokusebenzisa ujyela kanti futhi banikeze isiqondiso esihle ekwenzeni umsebenzi. Oqeqeshiweyo ofaneleyo kumele abe: Nakokeyo yokusebenzisa Provincial Infrastructure Delivery Management System [IDMS]. Nakokeyo yokuqonda iNqubo Yezempilo Yomnyango kanti futhi ngokukhethekileyo izidingo zamasevisi yojyela. Nakokeyo yokuqamba imiklamo yojyela kanti futhi ahlakaniphe ukuxazulula ulwazi. Nakokeyo yokuqonda kanti futhi achaze izinhlelo zokwakha kanti futhi ukusebenzisa amakhono ukuxazulula izidingo zokuthenga. Nakokeyo yokuqamba kanti futhi ayilawule inhlelo ezihlukene zemigqaqo kanti futhi nezinhlelo. Nakokeyo yokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza zokujyela ngekhompyutha. Nakokeyo yokuqamba ukuxazulula ingozi kanti futhi ukwenza isu lokuxazulula ingozi. Nakokeyo yokulungiselela imibiko yobuchwepheshe, okokufaka kweenkomba kanti futhi okokubonisa. Nakokeyo yokuqonda ukuthi ungayilungisa kanjani izibhijethi, wakhiphe kanti futhi uchaze ulwazi olusuka kwezinye izinhlela zolwazi.
zu.duties: Ukwenza imiklamo yojyela kagesi. Ukwenza isibuyekevo esigqamile kanti futhi ulawule ukuvunywa kwezibuyekevo ezintsha zemiklamo yojyela kagesi ngokuhambisana namaphuzu omkhuba noma inqubo yomkhuba. Ukulawula ukwenziwa kwezinhlela zokugcina ngokunikezwa kwezakhiwo ezifanelekileyo, izinhlelo kanti futhi amakhono. Ukuhlela amaphuzu okugcina ujyela, izinhlelo kanti futhi amaphuzu okusebenza ngokohlelo lomnyango ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba sikhona ngokugcwele. Uqaphele ukusebenza okuhle kokugcina ngokuhleleka lomnyango ukuze axhome noma aqondise kabusha amasevisi yojyela ukuze kufinyelelwe amaphuzu omnyango. Ukunikeza amasevisi yojyela kanti futhi yokuqamba izinkomba eziqondileyo. Ukulawula ukuhambisana nomthetho we-OHS kanti futhi nomthetho ohlobene nowo. Ufake amaphepha ezinkomba kanti futhi uvuse izinkomba kwisimiso esimbalwa ngekhompyutha. Ukwenza ucwaningo. Ulawule abantu kanti futhi izibhijethi.

xh.title: Injini Ephambili: Yomzobo Wabakho: Iinkonzo Zomzobo (GRADE a
xh.summary: Injini Ephambili Yomzobo Wabakho elawula iindlela zomzobo nemigaqo yonkonzo kwiLungiselelo lezeMpilo loPhondo iLimpopo.
xh.requirements:
Izifundo Nemfundo: Isatifikethi SeNazionali Samabanga aPhezulu / Grade 12 / Matric plus Degree efanelekileyo kuMzobo Wabakho. Bhaliswe njengenjini Yobuchwepheshe kuECSA. Kwiminyaka esithandathu [6] yamava. Amaxa kwimojula yamayeza okunyanga okanye kwendawo enzima ngokufanayo kuya kuba lusizo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kuquka i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel nePowerPoint; Ulwazi lokusebenzisa iindlela zokubamba iindibano kwi-intanethi. Abaqeqeshi abaphumeleleyo kufuneka bekululunge ukuhamba gangesixhenxe kuwo wonke ummandulo kwaye basebenze iiyure ezinde. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubekileyo. INdimba Eyintloko: Ukubonelela ngencazelo yomzobo wabakho nokuqonda oko kuquka onke amacandawomzobo obuchwepheshe obutsha nobunzima ekuphuhliseni iindlela, iinkqubela, iinkqubo, imigaqo, amanqanaba nemigudu yolawulo lwezakhono zoluntu kunye nokuvuma izikhethwa ezimalini nobakho. Umzobi oqinisekileyo kufunekenokuba: nolawulo lokubonakalisa nokuqonda inkqubela yokulawulwa kwezakhono koluntu, nokuba nolwazi ngokumila okutsha kwezemigaqo yamagazethi kunye nemigaqo yonkonzo emfutshane. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Imfundo nokuNceda: Abanjini basezikhundleni kuya kuba nawo om basebenzise ukusebenza nokuqondisa onke amacandawomzobo obuchwepheshe obutsha nobunzima abakwazi ukusetyenziswa ekuphuhliseni iindlela zobuchwepheshe bese benika inkqubela ngokwemigaqo ekulawulweni. Umzobi oqinisekileyo kufunekenokuba: Alawule inkqubela yemigaqo yolawulo lwezakhono koluntu [IDMS]. Aqonde nezigqibo zemisebenzi yobuchwepheshe zoLungelelwaniselwano kwaye anyanzele iimfuno zobuchwepheshe ekutshintsheni iindlela. Abakwazi ukubumba imisebenzi ehamba phambili kuphuhliso koluntu kumacandawomzobo nobuChwepheshe bokuphuhlisa iindlela zobuchwepheshe ezingekazise. Aqonde iindlela zokusebenzisa imigaqo yolawulo lwezakhono ekuphuhlisweni kwazo.

Amaxa lokuziva ngakumbi nemisebenzi yonke yeNgqungquthela yonke kumacandawomzobo nobunzima bokulawula iinkqubo ezingcono zemisebenzi yokuhamba phambili. Iqonde iimfuno zokuba abasebenzi abavela kwakhona emacandawomzobo basebenze ngokufanelekileyo ekusebenziseni iinkqubela zoluntu. Ulwazi lokuqonda iindlela zokusebenza kwezemali, lokuvelisa nokuqonda iinkcukacha kwiinkqubela ezenza ngokwezimali masingaphakathi.
xh.duties: Ukuqhuba imisebenzi yomzobo wabakho. Ukwenza ovamile wokugqibela kwaye ulawule ukuvunywa kokuqwalasela kwemizobo entsha ngokomzobo wabakho ngokomzobo ngokomzobo nangokwesithiyori. Ukulawula ukuhamba kwezicwangciso zolungiso ngokubonelela ngezakhiwo, iinkqubo namacebo afanelekileyo. Ukumisela imilinganiselo, iindlela zolungiso nemigaqo yolawulo ngokomnqobo wezihloko ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba yonke imisebenzi ihamba ngokufanelekileyo. Okwangoku ukulinganisa ngokuchaneka kwemisebenzi yokulungisa ngokomnqobo wezihloko ukuze ulawule okanye ulawule iindlela zonkonzo zobuchwepheshe ukufezwa komnqobo. Ukubonelela ngeenkonzo ezilawulwayo zobuchwepheshe nokuqondisa imisebenzi yonke. Ukulawula ukusikeleleka kweemfuno nokulunga ngokomthetho, ngakumbi wokuLawula imisebenzi eBi-Inqanaba leNgqikithiyo. Ukufaka amaphepha omsebenzi nokulungisa iinkcukacha ngesixhobo sokulawula iinkcukacha ezimbali. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kokuphanda kwamacebo. Ukulawula abantu namaxesha omsebenzi.

jobs.title: Chief Quantity Surveyor: Engineering Services [grade A-B]
jobs.salary_text: Grade A: R1 143 468 per annum, (all-inclusive remuneration package) Grade B: R1 376 199 per annum, (all-inclusive remuneration package) (The Department will determine the salary package based on years of experience post professional registration)
jobs.summary: Chief Quantity Surveyor needed at the Limpopo Provincial Office to manage construction procurement strategy and infrastructure planning for the Department of Health.
jobs.requirements: Qualifications and Experience: A National Senior Certificate /Grade 12/Matric plus an appropriate Degree in Quantity Surveying. Registration as a Professional Quantity Surveyor with SACQSP. Six [6] years’ experience post qualification. Computer literacy including MS Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint; Virtual meeting platforms literacy. The successful applicant must be prepared to travel extensively throughout the province and work longer hours. A valid driver’s license except for people with disabilities. Main Role: To manage the delivery of the infrastructure-built environment programmes and projects in line with the Provincial Infrastructure Delivery Framework [IDMS]. The ideal candidate must have the ability to guide and operate within all applicable legislation, policies, frameworks and instruction notes. Knowledge, Skills, Training And Competencies: The incumbents of the post will be responsible for providing quantity surveying inputs and guidance for the development of infrastructure strategies, policies, systems, functional/technical norms and standards, plans for health in line with the Provincial Infrastructure Delivery Framework for the planning and construction of health projects. Ability to understand the health service delivery platform, indicators & service plan and how that links with infrastructure. Ability to undertake a risk analysis and undertake a risk mitigation strategy. Ability to interpret existing and develop new Functional and Technical Norms and Standards. Ability to identify the required information fields and documents for use by Health. Ability to prepare reports, submissions and presentations. Ability to meet strict project deadlines – preparation of documentation, report writing, chairing and minute taking of site meetings. Ability to understand how to prepare budgets, extract and interpret information from related information systems. Ability to understand how to apply the IDMS. Ability to understand how to identify the required information fields and documents for use by health.
jobs.duties: Prepare the construction procurement strategy and the Infrastructure Programme Management Plan. Contribute from a quantity surveying perspective project brief, costing models and operational narratives. Prepare quantity surveyor inputs for the User Asset Management Plan, the project list and Infrastructure Programme Management Plan. Prepare and/or manage the approval of packages/individual project briefs. Develop and maintain quantity survey planning and cost norms & standards. Participate in the procurement of professional service providers and contractors. Prepare policies, strategies, plans, procedures and criteria for all infrastructure projects from a quantity surveying perspective. Contribute to the review and acceptance of the Infrastructure Programme Implementation Plan. Monitor the implementation of Programmes/Projects. Load project documents and update information on the data management system. Manage the approval of project stage reports & designs. Manage the interface between the end-user/community structures and Implementing Agent[s]. Undertake research. Mentor and support a candidate quantity surveyor. Manage human, physical and financial resources.
jobs.enquiries: General enquiries about the advertised posts should be directed to Ms Hlokoa RE Tel No: (015) 293 6406, Ms Mompei MM Tel No: (015) 293 6126 / Ms Sebake RL Tel No: (015) 293 6426, Ms Sebola MF Tel No: (015) 293 6002 and Ms Mothiba JT Tel No: (015) 293 6329 during office hours.

af.title: Hoofkwantiteitsopmeter: Ingenieursdienste [grade A-B]
af.summary: Hoofkwantiteitsopmeter benodig by die Limpopo Provinciale Kantoor om konstruksie-aanbestedingsstrategie en infrastruktuurbeplanning vir die Department of Health te bestuur.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies en Ervaring: 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat /Graad 12/Matriek plus 'n toepaslike Graad in Kwantiteitsopmeting. Registrasie as 'n Professionele Kwantiteitsopmeter by SACQSP. Ses [6] jaar se ervaring na kwalifikasie. Rekenaargeletterdheid insluitend MS Outlook, Word, Excel en PowerPoint; Geletterdheid in virtuele vergaderplatvorms. Die suksesvolle aansoeker moet bereid wees om uitgebreid deur die provinsie te reis en langer ure te werk. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie behalwe vir persone met gestremdhede. Hoofrol: Om die lewering van die infrastruktuur-geboude omgewingsprogramme en -projekte te bestuur in ooreenstemming met die Provinsiale Infrastruktuurleweringraamwerk [IDMS]. Die ideale kandidaat moet die vermoë hê om te gid en te funksioneer binne alle toepaslike wetgewing, beleide, raamwerke en instruksienotas. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding En Bevoegdhede: Die ampshouers van die pos sal verantwoordelik wees vir die verskaffing van kwantiteitsopmetings-insette en -leiding vir die ontwikkeling van infrastruktuurstrategieë, beleide, stelsels, funksionele/tegniese norme en standaarde, planne vir gesondheid in ooreenstemming met die Provinsiale Infrastruktuurleweringraamwerk vir die beplanning en konstruksie van gesondheidsprojekte. Vermoë om die gesondheidsdiensleweringplatform, aanwysers en diensplan te verstaan en hoe dit met infrastruktuur skakel. Vermoë om 'n risiko-anise uit te voer en 'n risikobeperkingsstrategie uit te voer. Vermoë om bestaande funksionele en tegniese norme en standaarde te interpreteer en nuwes te ontwikkel. Vermoë om die vereiste inligtingsvelde en dokumente vir gebruik deur Gesondheid te identifiseer. Vermoë om verslae, voorleggings en aanbiedings voor te berei. Vermoë om streng projektestermynne na te kom – voorbereiding van dokumentasie, verslagskrywing, vooruitsit en notule neem van terreinvergaderings. Vermoë om te verstaan hoe om begrotings voor te berei, inligting uit verwante inligtingstelsels te onttrek en te interpreteer. Vermoë om te verstaan hoe om die IDMS toe te pas. Vermoë om te verstaan hoe om die vereiste inligtingsvelde en dokumente vir gebruik deur gesondheid te identifiseer.
af.duties: Berei die konstruksie-aanbestedingsstrategie en die Infrastruktuurprogrambestuursplan voor. Dra vanuit 'n kwantiteitsopmetingsperspektief by tot projekvoorstelle, kostemodelle en operasionele verslae. Berei kwantiteitsopmeter-insette voor vir die Gebruikersbatesbestuursplan, die projeklys en die Infrastruktuurprogrambestuursplan. Berei en/of bestuur die goedkeuring van pakkette/individuele projekvoorstelle. Ontwikkel en handhaaf kwantiteitsopmetingsbeplanning en kostenorme en -standaarde. Neem deel aan die aanbesteding van professionele diensverskaffers en kontrakteurs. Berei beleide, strategieë, planne, prosedures en kriteria vir alle infrastruktuurprojekte vanuit 'n kwantiteitsopmetingsperspektief voor. Dra by tot die hersiening en aanvaarding van die Infrastruktuurprogramimplementeringsplan. Monitor die implementering van programme/projekte. Laai projekdokumente en werk inligting op die databestuurstelsel op. Bestuur die goedkeuring van projekstadiumverslae en -ontwerpe. Bestuur die koppelvlak tussen die eindgebruiker/gemeenskapsstrukture en die Implementerende Agent[s]. Ondersoek doen. Mentorskap en ondersteuning van 'n kandidaat-kwantiteitsopmeter. Bestuur menslike, fisiese en finansiële hulpbronne.

zu.title: Inkantolo Ephambili Yokuqhathanisa Izinani: Amasevisi Onjiniyela [grade A-B]
zu.summary: Ifuna i-Inkantolo Ephambili Yokuqhathanisa Izinani Ehhovisi Likasifazwe i-Limpopo ukuphatha isu lokuthenga izinto zokwakha kanye nokuheha izindawo zokwakha zomnyango Wezempilo.
zu.requirements: Izifundo Nempilo Yomsebenzi: Isitifiketi Sezifundo Sezwe / Amagreyidi 12 / Isitifiketi Sokuphuma Emabangeni Aphakeme kanye nedigri efanele yokubala izinto eziswakeme emsebenzini wokwakha. Ukuqashiwe njengothisha wesigidi samapulani oswakeme emsebenzini wokwakha (Professional Quantity Surveyor) ngaphansi kwe-SACQSP. Okungenani eminyaka eyisithupha [6] yempilo yomsebenzi ngemva kwezifundo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha okuhlanganisa i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint; Ukwazi ukusebenzisa izinkundla zokuhlangana kwi-intanethi. Umuntu oyothunyelwa kumele abe kulungele ukuhamba kakhulu emhlabeni wonke futhi asebenze isikhathi eside. Ilayisensi yokuqasha ehlekileyo ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile. Indima Eyinhloko: Ukuphatha ukulethwa kwemihlungu yezindawo ezakhiwe kanye namaphulo ngokuhambisana neNkambiso Yekhaselwe Yokuheha Izindawo Zesifunda [IDMS]. Umuntu ofanelekileyo kumele abe nakhono okukhuba futhi asebenze ngaphakathi kwayo yonke imithetho, izinqubomgomo, izinhlelo kanye nemiyalo ephathelene. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa Kanye Nezakhono Zomsebenzi: Umuntu osezweni lesikhundla kumele abe nenxulumene nokubonelela ngemibono yokusiza kumsebenzi wokuqhathanisa izinani kanye nokukhombisa indlela ekuthuthukisweni kwezinhlelo zezindawo ezakhiwe, izinqubomgomo, izimiso, izinkambiso ezithinteka ngokusebenza noma ezobuchwepheshe, izilinganiso kanye namaphulo empilo ngokuhambisana neNkambiso Yekhaselwe Yokuheha Izindawo Zesifunda ngokuheha nokwakha amaphulo empilo. Ukuba nakhono ukuqonda inkundla yokuqasha amasevisi empilo, izinkomba kanye neplani yesevisi kanye nendlela ehumusha kwezindawo ezakhiwe. Ukuba nakhono ukwenza isilinganiso sezengozi nokwenza isu lokwehlisa izingozi. Ukuba nakhono ukuhumusha okukhona kanye nokuthuthukisa amaNomu kanye Namaphuzu Amasha Wezilinganiso Ezithinteka Ngokusebenza Noma Ezobuchwepheshe. Ukuba nakhono ukuhlukanisa imikhakha yemininingwane edingekayo kanye namadokhumenta okusebenzisa kuMnyango Wezempilo. Ukuba nakhono ukulungisa imibiko, izipho ngaphansi komyalo kanye nezinkombiso. Ukuba nakhono ukuhlangabezela emigceni ethi nkqo yesikhathi sephulo – ukulungiswa kwamadokhumenta, ukubhala imibiko, ukuba ngumengameli kanye nokubhala imizuzu yemihlangano yasendaweni. Ukuba nakhono ukuqonda ukulungisa amabhajethi, ukukhipha futhi uhumushe imininingwane kumasistimu emininingwanenye ahlobene. Ukuba nakhono ukuqonda ukusebenzisa i-IDMS. Ukuba nakhono ukuqonda ukuthi ukuhlukanisa kanjani imikhakha yemininingwane edingekayo kanye namadokhumenti okusebenzisa ezempilweni.
zu.duties: Lungisa isu lokuthenga izinto zokwakha kanye neNkqubo Yokuheha Izindawo. Wenze ngokubonisana ngombono womuntu oswakeme emsebenzini wokuqhathanisa izinto eziswakeme emsebenzini, izindlela ezibala imali kanye nemilando yemisebenzi. Lungisa imibono yomuntu oswakeme emsebenzini wokuqhathanisa izinani yeplani Yokuphatha izimpahla zabasebenzisi, uhlu lwamaphulo kanye neNkqubo Yokuphatha Iheha Izindawo. Lungisa futhi / noma uphele ukuvunyelwa kwezimpahla / imibono eqhathanisiwe yamaphulo aqangiweyo. Thuthukisa futhi ulondoloze izinkambiso zokuqhathanisa izinani kanye namapulani kanye namanomu kanye namaphuzu ezilinganiso. Thatha inxaxheba ekuthengeni abahlinzeki besevisi ezithile kanye nabaqashi. Lungisa izinqubomgomo, izu, amaphulo, izinqubo kanye nezinkambiso zayo yonke imisebenzi ezindaweni ezakhiwe ngokubonisana ngombono womuntu osuakeme emsebenzini. Siza ekubukweni kanye nokuqashweni kweNkqubo Yokuheha Izindawo. Bheka ukusetshenziswa kwamaphulo / imigwqo yomsebenzi. Faka amadokhumenti ephulo futhi uvuselele imininingwane kusistimu yokuheha idatha. Phatha ukuvunywa kwemibiko yesigaba sephulo kanye nemiklamo. Phatha ukuhlobana phakathi komsebenzisi / izakhiwo zomphakathi kanye Nommeli Osebenzayo. Yenza ucwaningo. Qeqesha kanye nokusekela ofakwa kwizifundo zabantu abasha ngeqhathanisa izinani. Phatha abantu, izinto ezithintekayo kanye nezimali.

xh.title: Usomlobi wezoMlinganiselo oyiNtloko: Iinkonzo zeNjiniya [inqaba A-B]
xh.summary: Kufuneka uSomlobi wezoMlinganiselo oyiNtloko kwiOfisi yaseLimpopo yePhondo ukulawula inkqubo yokuthenga izakhiwo nolungelelwaniso lwezohlalwe-ngcono kwiSebe lezeMpilo.
xh.requirements: Izifundo neNqanaba loMgangatho: Isatifikethi esiPhezulu seNazhonal / Grade 12 / Matric kunye neDegree efanelekileyo kwi Quantity Surveying. UkuBhalisa njengoSomlobi wezoMlinganiselo weNkqubo ngokuchanekileyo kwi SACQSP. Amarhamxa ali-6 [6] amava emva kokuFumana izifundo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kuquka i MS Outlook, Word, Excel kunye ne PowerPoint; Ulwazi lokusebenzisa iinkqubo zokuhlangana kwi-intanethi. Umfaki-mvuzo ophumelelayo kufuneka abe buthathaka-buvakalayo ukuhamba ihlabathi jikelele kwiphondo kwaye asebenze iiyure ezinde. Ilayisensi yokuQamba ehlayo ngaphandle kweemfuno zabantu abakhubazekileyo. Indima eNgcwalileyo: Ukulawula ukuhlinzwa kweenkqubo neziprojekthi zohlalwe-ngkona ezakhiwayo ngokwesiKokelo sokuHlinzwa kohlalwe-ngkona sePhondo [IDMS]. Umfundi ofanelekileyo kufuneka abe nako ukukhokela kwaye asebenze ngaphakathi kwazo zonke iimithetho, iinkqubomgobo, iinkqubo kunye namacebiso eweleyo. Ulwazi, Amandla, uQeqesho nakwiKhono: Umntu oza kuba kulesi sithuba uza kuba nawo mandla wokubonelela ngegalelo lokuloba imilinganiselo kunye nolwazi malunga nophuhliso lweenkqubo zohlalwe-ngcono, iinkqubomgobo, iinkqubo, iimigangatho eyi-mfihlo/eyobuchwepheshe, iiplani zempilo ngokwesiKokelo soHlinzwa lweZohlalwe-ngkona sePhondo ngenjongo yokucwangiswa nokwakhiwa kweziprojekthi zempilo. Amandla okuqonda inkqubo yokuHlinzwa iinkonzo zempilo, inkqubela nezicwangciso zezaNkonzo nendlela ezidityanisa nezohlalwe-ngkona. Amandla okwenza uhlalutyo lweengozi nokwenza inkqubo yokucutha iingozi. Amandla okutolika ezikhona nokupuhlisa iimigangatho yeMfihlo neyoBuchwepheshe entsha. Amandla okuchaza iinkalo zolwazi ezifunekayo namaxwebhu okusebenzisa iinkonzo zeMpilo. Amandla okulungisa iingxelo, izicelo kunye nokubonelela ngeminncediso. Amandla okuhlangabezana nemigaqo egqithisayo yeprojekthi – ukuLungiselela uBhalo, ukuBhala iingxelo, ukuzulisa nokubala amaminithi kwiiNkomfa zaseKhusini. Amandla okuqonda indlela yokulungisa amabhajeti, ukutsalwa uLwazi nokuLwahlula-hlula kwiinkqubo ezinxulumene ulwazi. Amandla okusebenzisa i IDMS. Amandla okuqonda indlela yokuchaza iinkalo zolwazi ezifunekayo namaxwebhu ekusebenziseni iinkonzo zempilo.
xh.duties: Lungiselela inkqubo yokuthenga izakhiwo nesiKokelo soLawulo lweNkqubo yoHlalwe-ngkona. Nikela nengqondo njengakoSomlobi wezoMlinganiselo malunga ne-projekthi, iinkqubo zexabiso kunye neenkcazelo zokuSebenza. Lungiselela amagalelo njengokoSomlobi wezoMlinganiselo wePlani yoLawulo lweSethi, uluhlu lweProjekthi nesiKokelo soLawulo lweNkqubo yoHlalwe-ngkona. Lungisa kwaye/okanye ulawule ukuvunywa kweenkxaso/inkcazelo zeprojekthi nganye. Puhlise kwaye ugcine iiplani zoBalo loMlinganiselo kunye neemigangatho yexabiso. Thatha inxaxheba kukuthengiswa kwezinkonzo zobugcisa nabathengisi. Lungisa iinkqubomgobo, iinkqubo, iiplani, iinkqubo noluhlu oluLungelelanisiweyo kuzo zonke iiprojekthi zohlalwe-ngkona ukusuka kwipengndo-mbono yeSomlobi wezoMlinganiselo. Nikela ekuchongiweni nasekuVunyweni kwePlani yoLawulo lokuZalisekisa iNkqubo yoHlalwe-ngkona. Qwalasela ukuZalisekiswa kweenkqubo/iiProjekthi. Fakaamaxwebhu eeprojekthi kwaye uhlaziye ulwazi kwiNkqubo yoLawulo lwamaxwebhu. Lawula ukuVunywa kweengxelo zoNqanaba lweProjekthi kunye nezimo. Lawula undLU ophakathi koMsebenzisi-maxesha/iimBumba zomphakathi kunye neMeli-misebenzi. Zama ucando lwemibuzo. Qeqesha kwaye uxhase uSomlobi wezoMlinganiselo oBande ubuncinane. Lawula iinkcukacha zobuNtu, ezoBunyulu kunye nezoMali.

jobs.title: Deputy Manager: Nursing Services (PN A-8) (SHIFTS)
jobs.centre: Donald Frazer Hospital (X1 Post) Musina Hospital (X1 Post) Seshego hospital (X1 Post)
jobs.salary_text: R1 069 215 per annum, (inclusive remuneration package), plus 8% of basic salary PSCBC Rural Allowance
jobs.summary: Deputy Manager of Nursing Services required at hospitals in Limpopo, providing clinical leadership and management of nursing care with at least nine years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Qualifications and Experience: A National Senior Certificate /Grade 12/Matric plus Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification as recognized by SAQA. Current registration with the South African Nursing Council [SANC] as a Professional Nurse. A minimum of nine [9] years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the South African Nursing Council in General Nursing. At least four [4] years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable experience at Management level. Willingness to do after-hours work and be on call including shift work. Computer literacy including MS Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint; Literacy in virtual meeting platforms. Valid driver’s license except for people with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of the application of the relevant statutes and policies governing the public service and nursing profession. Knowledge of Performance Management and Development System. Knowledge of strategic planning. Knowledge of PFMA and Treasury Regulations. Knowledge of the application of Batho Pele principles, Patients’ Rights Charter and quality assurance system. Knowledge of managing workplace discipline. Well-developed communication, presentation, negotiation and research skills. Knowledge of hospital performance indicators.
jobs.duties: Provide leadership, guidance, technical and management support to ensure the provision of optimal, holistic, specialized nursing care within set standards and a professional and legal framework. Ensure that prescribed policies and procedures are adhered to. Coordinate the provision of effective training and research to maintain professional growth, ethical standards and self- development. Continuously monitor and evaluate nursing service practices and clinical outcomes to ensure delivery of cost-effective quality health care. Effective resource (human, financial and physical) planning and management in accordance with relevant directives and legislation. Effective utilization of information technology and information systems to ensure accurate statistical data collection and capturing. Provide effective support to management and establish and maintain constructive working relationships with all other stakeholders. Participate in the analysis formulation and implementation of nursing guidelines, practices, standards and procedures.
jobs.enquiries: General enquiries about the advertised posts should be directed to Ms Hlokoa RE Tel No: 015 293 6406, Ms Mompei MM Tel No: 293 6126 / Ms Sebake RL Tel No: (015) 293 6426, Ms Sebola MF at 015 293 6002 and Ms Mothiba JT Tel No: (015) 293 6329 during office hours.

af.title: Adjunkbestuurder: Verpleegdienste (PN A-8) (SKOFTE)
af.summary: Adjunkbestuurder van Verpleegdienste word by hospitale in Limpopo benodig, wat klinieke leierskap en bestuur van verpleegsorg verskaf met ten minste nege jaar se ondervinding.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies en Ondervinding: 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat /Graad 12/Matriek plus Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. Huidige registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad [SANC] as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. 'n Minimum van nege [9] jaar toepaslike/herkenbare ondervinding in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ten minste vier [4] jaar van die bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/herkenbare ondervinding op Bestuursvlak wees. Bereidwilligheid om buite-kantoorure werk te doen en op oproep te wees, insluitend skofwerk. Rekenaarvaardigheid insluitend MS Outlook, Word, Excel en PowerPoint; Geletterdheid in virtuele vergaderingsplatforms. Geldige bestuurderslisensie behalwe vir persone met gestremdhede. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van die toepassing van die relevante statute en beleide wat die publieke diens en verpleegberoep regeer. Kennis van Prestasiebestuur- en -ontwikkelingstelsel. Kennis van strategiese beplanning. Kennis van PFMA en Tesourie-regulasies. Kennis van die toepassing van Batho Pele-beginsels, Pasiente se Regte-handves en gehalteversekeringsstelsel. Kennis van die bestuur van werksplekdissipline. Goed ontwikkelde kommunikasie-, voorlegging-, onderhandelings- en navorsingsvaardighede. Kennis van hospitaalprestasie-aanwysers.
af.duties: Verskaf leierskap, leiding, tegniese en bestuursondersteuning om die voorsiening van optimale, holistiese, gespesialiseerde verpleegsorg binne vasgestelde standaarde en 'n professionele en regtelike raamwerk te verseker. Verse dat voorgeskrewe beleide en prosedures nagekom word. Koördineer die voorsiening van doeltreffende opleiding en navorsing om professionele groei, etiese standaarde en selfontwikkeling te handhaaf. Monitor en evalueer voortdurend verpleegdienspraktyke en klinieke uitkomste om die levering van kostedoeltreffende gehalte-gesondheidsorg te verseker. Doeltreffende hulpbron (menslike, finansiële en fisiese) beplanning en bestuur in ooreenstemming met relevante riglyne en wetgewing. Doeltreffende benutting van inligtingstegnologie en inligtingstelsels om akkurate statistiese data-insameling en -vaslegging te verseker. Verskaf doeltreffende ondersteuning aan bestuur en vestig en handhaaf konstruktiewe werksverhoudings met alle ander belanghebbendes. Neem deel aan die analise, formulering en implementering van verpleegriglyne, -praktyke, -standaarde en -prosedures.

zu.title: Umphathi ohlangene: Izinsizakalo Zokunakekela (PN A-8) (AMASHIFI)
zu.summary: Kudingeka Umphathi ohlangene wezinsizakalo zokunakekela ezibhedlela eLimpopo, ohiqeka umholi wokwelashwa nokuphathwa kokunakekela esibhedlela ongemva kweminyaka engu-9 yokuhlanganyela imisebenzi.
zu.requirements: Izifundo Nempilo: I-National Senior Certificate /Grade 12/Matric kanye nesifundo esiyisisekelo se-R425 (okungukuthi idiploma/iziqu ekukenakelelweni) noma isifundo esilinganayo njengoba sivotwa yi-SAQA. Ubulungiswa okumanje ne-South African Nursing Council [SANC] njengogunyazi wezokunakekela esibhedlela. okungenani iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili [9] yohlu oluwanelisa oluqashwa emsebenzini wokunakekela esibhedlela ngemuva kokubhalisa njengogunyazi wezokunakekela esibhedlela ne-South African Nursing Council ekukenakelelweni okuvamile. okungenani iminyaka emine [4] yaleso sikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele ibe yohlu oluqashwa emsebenzini ezingeni lokuphatha. Ukuzithoba ekwenzeni umsebenzi ngemva kwezinsuku ezimalanga kanye nokuba seceleni kuhlanganise namashifi. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kuhlanganise i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel ne-PowerPoint; Ulwazi ngamaphulatifomu emihlangano eku-inthanethi. Ilayisensi yokushayela evunyiwe ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi ngokusetshenziswa kwezomthetho kanye namapholisi ahlobene ahlela imphakathi namkhulu wezokunakekela. Ulwazi ngohlelo lokuqeqesha nokuthuthukisa ukusebenza. Ulwazi ngokuqamba izinhlelo. Ulwazi nge-PFMA nezimiso ze-Treasury. Ulwazi ngokuqhekisana nemithetho ye-Batho Pele, isibonakaliso samalungelo abaguli kanye nehlelo lokunqinisa izinga. Ulwazi ngokuqondisa isiyalo esikhundleni somsebenzi. Amakhono okuxhumana, okubhukuda, ukuxoxisana kanye nokucwaninga ohlele kakhulu. Ulwazi ngezinkomba zokusebenza zesibhedlela.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngokuholwa, ukwesekwa, amakhono obuchwepheshe kanye nokwesekwa ukuphatha ukuze kuqiniseke ukunakekelwa okuhle, okuphelele, okuhlinzeka ngokwetiya emzinganweni ohleliwe nasemthethweni, ohlaka wemikhakha ehlobene nothisheli lomthetho. Qinise ukuthi imithetho namapholisi ahleliwe alandelwa. Hlela okuhlinzekwayo ukulungiselela nokucwaninga okuhle ukuze kugcinwe ukukhula komkhakha, imigomo yokuziphatha nokuzithuthukisa. Qapholisela futhi hlule izindlela ezisetshenziswa ekukenakelelweni emkhakheni wezokwelashwa ukuze kuqiniseke ukunikezwa kwezinsizakalo zezempilo ezinenzuzelo futhi zihle. Ukuhlelwa kwezinsizakalo nabantu (izimali nangokomzimba) nokuphathwa ngokuvumelana nemiyalelo nemithetho. Ukusetshenziswa okuhle kwezobuchwepheshe bokwazisa nezinhlelo zokwazisa ukunikeza idatha eqondile ekuqoqweni nasekushayweni kwezibalo. Nikela ngokwesekwa okuhle ekuphathweni futhi ukhize futhi ulondoloze ubudlelwano obuhle bokusebenza kuye bonke omunye abahlanganyeli. Thatha inxaxheba kokuqonda ukwakhiwa nokusetshenziswa kwemiyalo yokunakekela, izindlela zokusebenza, imithetho kanye nezinhlelo ezinyakazayo.

xh.title: Isekela Mphathi: Iinkonzo zeSesa (PN A-8) (IISHIFTHI)
xh.summary: Kufunekwa iSekela Mphathi weeNkonzo zeSesa kumazibigwe inkqubo ekwaLimpopo, ebonezela inkokhelo yobuqu kunye nokulawula inkonzo yesesa enomvuzo onguziyo ongaphantsi kweminyaka elishumi.
xh.requirements: Iziqinisekiso nobugqithi: Isatifikethi seQonga laseLizwe /I-Greyidi 12/Isatifikethi seMatric kanjalo neqinisekiso elisisiseko le-R425 (okt. idiploma/idigri kwinkonzo yesesa) okt. isiqinisekiso esilingana nesamkelwe yi-SAQA. Ukubhalisa ngoku kwiSouth African Nursing Council [SANC] njengogqithisa weNkonzo yeSesa. Ukunguziyo kokwaziswa okufanelekileyo/okubonakalayo kweminyaka elishumi [9] inkonzo yesesa emva kokuqwalaselwa njengogqithisa weNkonzo yeSesa kwiSouth African Nursing Council kwizigqibo ezingunguwo. Apho nthathu yeminyaka [4] yexesha elitshiwo ngasentla kufuneka kube kokwaziswa okufanelekileyo/okubonakalayo kwinqanaba loLawulo. Ukulungelelana ukwenza umsebenzi wemihla ngemihla emva kweyure zomsebenzi nokubakho kwiNkcitha kuquka nomsebenzi weshifthi. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kuquka i-MS Outlook, i-Word, i-Excel ne-PowerPoint; Ukwazi ukusebenzisa iinkqubo zemiqungqubo ethi ithethwe kwi-intanethi. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubekileyo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngokusetyenziswa kwezisalathiso neemimiselo ezibalulekileyo ezilawula inkonzo zoluntu nobugqithi beSesa. Ulwazi ngeNkqubo yoLawulo nokuPhuhliswa kwemisebenzi. Ulwazi ngeplani eqhubekayo. Ulwazi nge-PFMA neMimiselo yeLondolozo. Ulwazi ngokusetyenziswa kweempawu zeBatho Pele, isiQinisekiso seemGondo-bam ’ Lindelo, neNkqubo eQinisekisa umgangatho. Ulwazi ngokulawula inyameko kwendawo yokusebenza. Amakhono obuqu, abalulekileyo, ukuxoxwa negxelo eliqulunqiweyo.
xh.duties: Nika inkokhelo, ikamva lemntu, inkxaso yobuchwephesha nolawulo kuqinisekiswa ukubonelelwa kweNkonzo yeSesa elungele, yonke, egqithiswe ngomgangatho weziqendu nobuhlobo bomthetho obucwangcisiweyo. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kolawulo lwemimiselo neendlela ezamkelweyo. Lawula ukubonelelwa kwemfundo ekwazi ukuphuhlisa izigqibo zobugcisa ngendlela elungele ukuqinisekisa ukuphuhliswa kolwazi, iindalo ezifanelekileyo nokuziphucela. Qhubele phambili qwalasele qinisekise iinkqubo zenkonzo yesesa nemiphumela yalawulo urhulumente ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukubonelelwa kokhathalelo lwempilo lulinge ithamsanqa. Iplani yamathothi (abantu, imali, nezinto ezibonakalayo) ekwazi ukuphatha ngendlela elungele inkcitha kwizindlela ezingagqithanga phantsi komthetho. Ukusetyenziswa ngendlela elungeleyo kobuchwepheshe bomthwombo-bukhaya nobukhulu beNkcitha ukuqinisekiswa ukubamba iingxelo ngenkqubo yamathothi achanekileyo. Luncedo olusebenzayo kumthwombo-bukhaya oluqinisekisa ubudlelwane obuqhubekayo namanye onke amagqabantshi. Thatha inxaxheba kwengqiqo iqamba inyathelo elusetyenziswa iinkqubo, iinkqubo, imigangatho nendlela eziphatha iNkonzo yeSesa.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Financial Budgeting, Revenue and Debt
jobs.centre: Sekhukhune District Office (X1 Post) Mopani District Office (X1 Post)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Financial Budgeting, Revenue and Debt at Limpopo Department of Health district offices, requiring five years' financial management experience.

Inherent requirements of the job: Computer literacy including MS Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint; Literacy in virtual meeting platforms. A valid driver's license, except for people with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: An understanding of Public Sector Financial Administration and the prescription /provision of PFMA and Treasury Regulations. Good understanding of BAS, LOGIS and other financial systems. Ability to manage multiple projects, excellent interpersonal & communication skills [written & verbal] Report writing and presentation skills. The incumbent must be assertive and self-driven, Innovative, and creative, client focused, and solution oriented. Be able to work under stressful situations as well as the ability to maintain high levels of professionalism. Understanding of the government Standards Chart of Accounts. Applied Strategic Thinking. Budgeting and Financial Management. Project Management. Communication and Information Management. Continuous Improvement. Customer Focus and Responsiveness. Developing Others. Diversity Management. Managing Interpersonal Conflict and Resolving Problems Personal Attributes: Honesty. Integrity. Flexibility. Responsiveness. Professionalism. Accuracy. Supportive Team player. Co-operative. Confidentiality. Pro-activeness

xh.title: I-Deputy Director: Financial Management
xh.summary: I-Deputy Director: Financial Management e-Elim Hospital eLimpopo, ifuna idiploma okanye idigri kwi-Financial Management kunye neminyaka elishlanu yamava ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: Izifikhalathi kunye Noluhlu Lwamava: I-National Senior Certificate /Matric/ Grade 12 kwakunye ne-diploma yezizwe / i-bachelor's degree okanye isifikhalathi esilinganayo kwi-Financial Management/Accounting/Economics kwinqanaba le-NQF level 6 nangaphezulu njengoko kubalwa yi-South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA].Kufuneka kubekho amava angaphantsi kweenyanga ezintlanu [5] kwinkqubo ye-Financial Management kunye neenkqubo ezinxulumene nayo, apho kuthi kule minyaka kufuneka kubekho into engamashumi amathathu [3] emashumini emithathu, kwelona nqanaba elinganiselwa kwelilo nqanaba lokubanka ngokwemisebenzi njengakumlawuli ongumncedi.Kuba lilungu le-CA(SA)/IIA, okanye ukuvunywa kwindlu yokubhalisa njengo-CA(SA) okanye i-Institute of internal auditors (IIA) kuya kuba lusizo oluqhutshwa ngasentla .Iimfuno eziphakathi kwalo msebenzi: Ulwazi ngokupeyipa iikhompyutha ngamagama ahlukeneyo anjengokupeyipa i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel ne-PowerPoint; Ulwazi ngokupeyipa iinkqubo zokubamba iindibana ezikwi-intanethi. Iimfuno eziphakathi kwalo msebenzi: Ilayisenisi yokuqhwesha evisayo ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubekileyo. Ulwazi Nemisebenzi Yentsalo: Ukuqonda ngokulawula iimali karhulumente kunye neenkqubo ezibekiweyo kwaye nalawulo apho i-PFMA kunye nezigqibo zeTreasury zibekwe. Ukuqonda okukhulu iBAS, LOGIS kunye nezinye iinkqubo zohlolo lweemali. Ikhono lokulawula iiprojekthi ezininzi, amakhono amnandi ekunxibelelaneni nathi kunye nesithethi (esibhalwayo nesithethwayo). Ikhono lokubhala iingxelo nokubonisa. Lo mntu kufuneka abengumnini xesha ozimeleyo ngokwakhe, aze abengumntu ochukumisayo, anyuse inkqubo ngokungathintelwa, abe nogqalisa abaxhaswa rhoqo, aze achaze iingcamla. Makakwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi kweemeko ezinzima kwaye ulwazi lokulawula iqondo eliphezulu lomsebenzi kufuneka lugcinwe. Ukuqonda i-government Standards Chart of Accounts.
xh.duties: Lawula iinkqubo zokuqhutywa kweenkokhelo zesikhungo. Qinisekisa ukuba iinvoices zisetyenziswa ngaphakathi kwamatsiku angama-30 okuzifumana. Lawula ukuqokelelwa kweembuyekezo kunye nokuphinda kufunyanwe imali madinga. Lawula ukuqhuqhwa kweenkonzo. Lawula iinkonzo zolawulo lwemivuzo. Lawula uqwalaselo nobungqingqwa bejogra yemali. Lawula iinkqubo zempahla noluhlu lwezinto zesikhungo. Lawula iinkqubo zolawulo lwesikhephu esixhobileyo. Lawula iinkonzo zothutho. Qinisekisa inqanaba eliphezulu lokuvuzwa ngemigaqo-nkqubo eyasebenzayo. Zenza iingxelo zexesha nthi, nyanga nganye, kwikota nakwindalo ngonyaka ngokubhekisele kuzo zonke ezo nkqubo zinikwe ngasentla.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Human Resource Management and
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Human Resource Management at the Limpopo Department of Health, based at Sekhukhune District Office, requiring an NQF level 6 qualification and five years of relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: Qualifications and Experience: A National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/Matric plus NQF level 6 qualification in Human Resource Management/Development Public Management/ Administration or equivalent qualification at NQF level 6 as recognized by SAQA. A minimum of five [5] years relevant experience in Human Resource Management/Development of which three [3] should be at Junior Management/ Assistant Director level. Computer literacy including MS Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint; Literacy in virtual meeting platforms. A valid driver's license except for people with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Public Service Act, 1994.Public Service Regulations, 2016, Labour Relations Act 1995 Public Finance Management Act 1999.Basic Conditions of Employment Act 1998.Employment Equity Act 1997 Skills Development Act 1998 Occupational Health and Safety Act 1993.Performance Management Systems. HR Provisioning Administration. Public Service Administration. Human Resource Policies. Problem solving. Good Communication. Facilitation skills. Problem-solving skills. Leadership and analytical skills. Listening skills Innovative. Report writing skills. Conflict resolution. Negotiation. Technical skills. Quantitative Presentation Personal Attributes: Honesty. Integrity. Flexibility. Responsiveness. Professionalism. Accuracy. Supportive Team player. Co-operative. Confidentiality. Pro-activeness.
jobs.duties: Develop and ensure the implementation of policies, guidelines and procedures. Manage human resource practice and administration services. Manage human resource development and information management. Manage resources (physical and human)
jobs.enquiries: General enquiries about the advertised posts should be directed to Ms Hlokoa RE at Tel No: 015 293 6406, Ms Mompei MM at 015 293 6126 / Ms Sebake RL at 015 293 6426, Ms Sebola MF at 015 293 6002 and Ms Mothiba JT at 015 293 6329 during office hours.
jobs.applications: The circular of advertised vacant posts will be posted on the following websites: https://erecruitment.limpopo.gov.za/, www.ldoh.gov.za, www.dpsa.gov.za and Provincial Department social media. Applicants must apply on the following website: https://erecruitment.limpopo.gov.za/
jobs.notes: NB: Ensure that you read the conditions and requirements of the post before you apply. Failure to comply with the instructions below will result in your application being disqualified. By applying, it is understood that you agree to the conditions and requirements of the post. Applicants are hereby invited from suitably qualified candidates for vacant posts in the Department of Health. Applications should include a fully completed new Z83 form obtainable from any government institution or at www.dpsa.gov.za and must be accompanied by a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae [CV]. Completion of Z83 Application Form: Online applications must include the only Curriculum Vitae [CV] in PDF as attachment. Zipped ,IMG and JPEG documents will not be accepted. The new Z83 form must be fully completed and signed up by the applicant. The following must be considered in relation to the completion of Z83 by applicants: All the fields in Part A, Part C and Part D must be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full except the following: South African applicants need not provide passport numbers. If an applicant responded “No” to the question “Are you conducting business with the State or are you a Director of a Public or Private company conducting business with the State? Then it is acceptable for an applicant to indicate ‘not applicable’ or leave blank to the question. If yes (provide detail), “In the event that you are employed in the Public Service, will you immediately relinquish such business interest?”. Applicants may leave the following question blank if they are not in possession of such: “If your profession or occupation requires official registration, provide date and particulars of registration”. Noting there is limited space provided for Part E, F & G, applicants often indicate “refer to Curriculum Vitae (CV)” or “see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. It must be noted that a CV is an extension of the application for employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. The questions related to the conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered however applicants currently employed by the public service do not need to complete the section as it is intended for those seeking re-employment. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and to provide proof of such evaluation. Shortlisted candidates will be required to come for an interview, at which time, certified copies of all relevant qualifications, current registration with the relevant statutory body and copy of ID must be submitted. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One shall be a practical exercise and the other shall be integrity [ethical conduct] assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process . In terms of the Directive on the Implementation of Competency Based Assessments, Training & Development for Members of the Senior Management Services (SMS) in the Public Service, as amended. All Shortlisted candidates for the SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview .Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Assessment for core competencies outlined in the SMS handbook shall be conducted within one month of the appointment of the candidate. The Office shall communicate the logistics for the psychometric assessment to the candidate: Only recommended candidates for Senior Management Services (SMS) posts shall undergo psychometric assessment (Giotto, 15FQ+, and CPP assessment). Shortlisted candidates for the SMS posts will be required to submit SMS pre- entry certificate obtainable from National School of Government [https://thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entryprogramme/.]                  on appointment. The cost for Nyukela is at the applicant ‘s own expense. Successful candidates will be expected to enter into performance agreement and sign oath of secrecy. Suitable candidate will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks [criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification and employment verification] Please note by responding to the advertisement, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). Your information will be used soley for the purpose of this promotion and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent unless required by law. The successful candidate falling within the designated categories for disclosure of financial interests will be required to disclose his/her financial interests in accordance with the applicable prescripts within 30 days of assumption of duty. Only the designated categories will disclose their financial interest in line with Regulation 16 (c),17 (2) & 18 (3) of the Public Service Regulation, 2016 as amended The Department of Health is an equal opportunity Employment Equity and Affirmative Action Employer. Females are encouraged to apply for posts at senior management level in order to address the Employment Equity targets within the Department. People with disabilities are encouraged to apply and correspondence will be entered into with shortlisted candidates only. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only due to the large number of applications we envisage to receive; and if you have not heard from us within ninety (90) days of the closing date, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are hereby advised to, within 90 days, request reasons from the Department for any administrative action which has adversely affected them in terms of section 5(1)(2) of the Promotion of Administrative Justice Act 3 of 2000.Kindly note that NO payment of any kind is required when applying for posts advertised in this circular. The Department reserves the right not to fill any advertised posts. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Branch Coordinator: Office of the Chief
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Branch Coordinator in the Office of the Chief at the Limpopo Department of Health, responsible for coordinating reports, compliance and branch activities.
jobs.requirements: Qualifications and Experience: A National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/Matric plus NQF level 6 qualification in Office Management / Public Administration / Public Management or equivalent qualification as recognised by SAQA.A minimum of five [5] years’ experience of which three [3] years should be at junior management/ASD level within Administration / Office Management. Computer literacy including MS Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint; Virtual meeting platforms literacy. A valid driver's license except for people with disabilities Knowledge and Skills: Sound and in – depth knowledge of relevant prescripts, as well as understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service. Strategic alignment and leadership, Planning and Organizing, Programme and Project Coordination, Governance and Compliance, Financial Management, Change Management, People Management, Problem Solving and decision making, Communication and Stakeholder Management, Conflict resolution, Diversity Management, Report writing and presentation skills. Ability to work in a highly pressured environment. Personal Attributes: Integrity and professionalism. Attention to detail and accuracy. Accountability and reliability. Proactive and results orientated. Calm under pressure and adaptable to change. Respectful and diplomatic with stakeholders. Team player and supportive leader. Committed to continuous learning and Batho Pele principles
jobs.duties: Manage and Coordinate reports within the Office of Deputy Director- General. Coordinate the compilation and submission of branch compliance reports, budget and plans Coordinate compliance reporting and other related activities in the branch, etc. Ensure proper management of documents. Develop and maintain systems that will contribute towards improving efficiency in the office. Quality assure all submissions/memos prior to approval by the DDG. Establish, implement and maintain effective processes/procedures for information and documents flow to and from the office, etc. Management of queries and correspondence within the Office. Provide support to the office with regard to meetings and engagements. Manage Resources (Physical, Human and Finance)
