af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Takkokoördineerder: Kantoor van die Hoof
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur: Takkokoördineerder in die Kantoor van die Hoof by die Limpopo Department of Health, verantwoordelik vir die koördinering van verslae, nakoming en takaktiwiteite.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies en Ervaring: 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/Grade 12/Matriek plus 'n NQF-vlak 6-kwalifikasie in Kantoorbestuur / Openbare Administrasie / Openbare Bestuur of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van vyf [5] jaar se ervaring waarvan drie [3] jaar op juniorbestuurs-/ASD-vlak binne Administrasie / Kantoorbestuur moet wees. Rekenaargeletterdheid insluitend MS Outlook, Word, Excel en PowerPoint; Geletterdheid in virtuele vergaderingsplatforms. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie behalwe vir persone met gestremdhede. Kennis en Vaardighede: Deeglike en diepgaande kennis van toepaslike voorskrifte, sowel as 'n begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Strategiese belyning en leierskap, Beplanning en Organisering, Program- en Projekkoördinering, Bestuur en Nakoming, Finansiële Bestuur, Veranderingsbestuur, Menslikebestuur, Probleemoplossing en besluitneming, Kommunikasie en Belanghebbende-bestuur, Konflikoplossing, Diversiteitsbestuur, Verslagskrywing en voorleggingsvaardighede. Vermoë om in 'n hoëddruk-omgewing te werk. Persoonlike Eisenskappe: Integriteit en professionaliteit. Aandag aan detail en akkuraatheid. Verantwoordelikheid en betroubaarheid. Proaktief en resultaatsgedrewe. Kalm onder druk en aanpasbaar by verandering. Respekvol en diplomatieke met belanghebbendes. Spanspeler en ondersteunende leier. Toegewyd aan deurlopende leer en Batho Pele-beginsels.
af.duties: Bestuur en koördineer verslae binne die Kantoor van die Adjunkdirekteur-generaal. Koördineer die opstel en voorlegging van tak-nakomingsverslae, begroting en planne. Koördineer nakomingsverslagdoening en ander verwante aktiwiteite in die tak, ens. Verseker behoorlike bestuur van dokumente. Ontwikkel en onderhou stelsels wat sal bydra tot die verbetering van doeltreffendheid in die kantoor. Kwaliteitsverseker alle voorleggings/memos voor goedkeuring deur die ADG. Vestig, implementeer en onderhou doeltreffende prosesse/prosedures vir die vloei van inligting en dokumente na en van die kantoor, ens. Bestuur van navrae en korrespondensie binne die Kantoor. Verskaf ondersteuning aan die kantoor met betrekking tot vergaderings en betrokkenhede. Bestuur Hulpbronne (Fisies, Menslik en Finansies)

zu.title: Sekela-Jikelele: Umhleli Wegatsha: Indlu Yomkhulu
zu.summary: oSekela-Jikelele: Umhleli wegatsha kwiNkundla kaSikhulu ophethwe yi-Limpopo Department of Health, uphendula ngokuhlela imibiko, ubuzembe nemisebenzi yegatsha.
zu.requirements: Izifundo nemfundo: Isitifiketi somatikuletse semfundo ephilayo/Isigaba 12/Matric kanye nesitifiketi se-NQF level 6 kwi-Office Management / Public Administration / Public Management noma isitifiketi esilinganayo njengoba kunconywa yi-SAQA. Ukuze kube khona isipiliyoni esingaphansi kwe-nyanga ezintlanu, okunalinye emva kweminyaka emithathu, ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esingeminyaka emihlanu esibhaliswe emgqeni, kufanele abe nokuhlanganisa iminyaka emithathu ohlelweni lwabasebenzi abasha noma abangenangqondo ohlwini lwabasebenzi abasha, kumnyango ophethe izinsiza. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kuhlanganise i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel ne-PowerPoint; Ukusebenzisa amaphulatifomu emihlangano yamakhalakhwathi. Ilayisensi yokuqasha ehamba phambili ngaphandle kwabantu abasikhundlbileni. Ulwazi nezikhathi: Ulwazi olubalulekile nokujulile ngesibopho esibalulekile, kanye nokuqonda uhlelo lomthetho olawula Inkampani Yomphakathi. Ukungezwa kohlelo nobuholi, Ukucinga futhi uhlele, Ukuhlela uhlelo namaphulo, Ubuzembe nokuhambisana nemithetho, Ukuphatha imali, Ukuphatha inguquko, Ukuphatha abantu, Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo, Unxibelelwano nokuphatha izithangami, Ukuxazulula ukungahambelani, Ukuphatha izinhlobonhlobo, Ukubhala imibiko nezikhathi zokubonisa. Ukuba nokuthula ukusebenza eziveni eziphezu kwezidingo. Izakhiwo zobuntu: Ukuze kube khona ukuzimisela nokusebenza ngobuhlakani. Ukuqapha izinkomba nokulinganisa. Ukubekezele futhi othembekile. Ukuba nomoya wokuqala nokubheka imiphumela. Ukuhlala uzolile phantsi koxinzelelo futhi ulungele ukuguquguquka. Uhloniphe futhi ube nothe kuzithangami. Ukusebenza ngokuhlangeneyo nobungane. Ukuzimisela ukufunda kuqhubeka nemigiqgelo ye-Batho Pele
zu.duties: Qondisa futhi uhlele imibiko ngaphakathi kweNkundla kaSekela-Jikelele. Hlela ukuqoqwa nokuthunyelwa kwemibiko yobuzomela yegatsha, yesabelomali nezenkingqubo. Hlela ukubika ngobuzomela kanye namanye amasheshiso ahlobene egatshini, njll. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okufanele kwamafayela. Yakha futhi ulondoloze izimiso ezoze nemisuzulu kuthuthukiswa kwengaqo ezokhonzweni. Qinisekisa umgangatho wonke isibonelo/ikhophi yangaphambi kokuqinisekiswa yi-DDG. Suka, usebenze futhi ulondoloze inqubo ebusiseko yokwaziswa nokugeleza kwamafayela ukuya futhi evela ezokhonzweni, njll. Ukuphathwa kwemibuzo nokuxhumana ezokhonzweni. Nikeza ukwesekwa ezokhonzweni mayelana nezinkumiso nobudlelwano. Phatha izinsiza (Ezomzimba, Abantu nezimali).

xh.title: Ulawuli oNqamlezayo: Ulungelelanisi weCandelo: Iofisi yomlawuli oNqamlezayo
xh.summary: Ulawuli oNqamlezayo: Ulungelelanisi weCandelo kwiOfisi yomlawuli oNqamlezayo eLimpopo Department of Health, ungunaphakade ekulungelelaniseni iingxelo, ukuvumelana nemisebenzi yecandelo.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno nokulinganiselwa kokwazi: Isatifikethi seSizwe sabaMnyama/Grade 12/Matric angene iNQF level 6 kwilunga leNtengiso ngokuLawula iOfisi / uLawulo lukarhulumente / uLawulo lwarhulumente okanye isifundo esilinganayo njengoko sivunywa yiSAQA. Kufuneka abe nokugqithiswa kweminye elishumi elihlanu [5] kwemisebenzi apho kweminye mithathu [3] kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba lolawulo lweqhinga/ASD ngaphakathi kokuLawula iNtengiso / ukuLawula iOfisi. Ukwaziswa ukusetyenziswa kweekhompyutha kuquka iMS Outlook, Word, Excel nePowerPoint; Ukwazi ukusetyenziswa kweenkqubo zemihlaumboniso. Ileyisense yokuqhuba ngokusemthethweni ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubekileyo. Ulwazi nokhono: Ulwazi olukhulu oluqinisekileyo nolusondeleyo malunga nokubhalwa kwemigaqo ephilileyo, kunye nokuqonda ingqikithi yomthetho ophatha iNkonzo karhulumente. Ulungelelwaniso ngokwezitrategiya kunye nokuba nguqhankqalazo, uKuceba nokuLungelelanisa, uLungelelaniswa lweenkqubo kwaye nezimiso, uLawulo nokuVumelana, uLawulo lweMali, uLawulo lweZitshintshe, uLawulo lweSimo sabantu, ukuziqonda iinkinge nokuqhelwa kweenqguqo, ukuThetha nokuLawula abaMthunywa, ukuSombulula iingxabano, uLawulo lweNtsibano, ukubhala iingxelo nokuqamba iinkqubo ezibonwayo. Ulwazi lokuba nakho ukusebenza kwimeko egcwele ingcindezelo. Iimpawu ezenza umntu: Ukuzithembisa nokusebenza ngobumnini. Ukuqwalasela iinkcukacha nokuqinisekisa ukuchanekileyo. Ukuba nesibopho sokuphendula nokuthembeka. Ukuzigqatsa kwaye ugqibe ekuzuzweni kweziphumo. Ukhululekile ngaphantsi koxinzelelo kwaye uyakwazi ukuzinzisa ngaphezu kokuqhelaniswa notshintsho. Uyihlonela kwaye uthetha ngokukhuswileyo ngeenjongo eziphathwayo. Udlala njengesigqiza kwaye ungumlawuli olikhaya ngenkxaso. Uyazibophelela ekufundeni ngokukhululeka izihlandlo kunye nemigaqo yamagama abantu
xh.duties: Phatha ukuze ulungelelanise iingxelo ngaphakathi kwiOfisi yomlawuli oNqamlezayo. Lungelanisa ukuqulunqwa nokuhambiswa kweengxelo zovulomo lecandelo, wesabelo-mali neendlela. Lungelanisa ukuxela ngovulomo nanye imisebenzi ehlobene nayo kwicandelo, njl-njl. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okufanelekileyo kweenxaxhamba. Zenzele kwaye zigcinwe iinkqubo eziya kugalela isandphakathi ekuphuculeni ukusebenza ngokusebenzayo kule ofisi. Hlola ngomgangatho ongazenziswayo wonke izindululo/iimemo ngaphambi kokuqinisekiswa nguDDG. Misela, zisebenzise kwaye zigcine iinkqubo/indlela ezisebenzayo zokuhanjiswa kolwazi nweenxaxhamba ukuya kwaye kuphuma kule ofisi, njl-njl. Uphathwa lwemibuzo kunye nongxibo ngaphakathi kwiOfisi. Nikela inkxaso kule ofisi ngakumbi ngemihlaumbonwano kunye nemiboniso. Phatha izixhobo (Ezomzimba, Ezomntu kunye Neemali)

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Supply Chain Management
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Supply Chain Management at Pietersburg Hospital in Limpopo, requiring an NQF Level 6 qualification and five years of relevant SCM experience.
jobs.requirements: Qualifications and Experience: A National Senior Certificate /Grade 12/Matric plus NQF Level 6 in Supply Chain Management/ Financial/Logistics/Cost and Accounting Management or equivalent qualification at NQF level 6 as recognised by the South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. A minimum of five [5] years relevant experience in Demand and Acquisition Management of which three (3) must be at junior management or Assistant Director level. Computer literacy including MS Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint; Virtual meeting platforms literacy. A valid driver’s license except for people with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Hands-on approach on tenders, acquisition administration, asset management and contract management. Knowledge, understanding and application of Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA), Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment Act (BBBEE), Supply Chain Management (SCM) guide to Accounting Officers and Related Legislation. Good leadership and communication (verbal and written) skills, presentation skills, budgeting skills, computer literacy and knowledge of legal aspects in Supply Chain Management.
jobs.duties: Management of SCM bid committees; disposal committees; and contract negotiation committees. Management of commitments; Monitor compliance with Supply Chain Management Legislations, policies, procedures and related subscripts. Asset and Inventory Management as well as Contract administration. Prepare and submit monthly and quarterly reports in line with the reporting requirements. Management of staff. Management of audit action plan.
jobs.enquiries: General enquiries about the advertised posts should be directed to Ms Hlokoa RE Tel No: (015) 293 6406, Ms Mompei MM Tel No: (015) 293 6126 / Ms Sebake RL Tel No: (015) 293 6426, Ms Sebola MF Tel No: (015) 293 6002 and Ms Mothiba JT Tel No: 293 6329 during office hours.
jobs.applications: The circular of advertised vacant posts will be posted on the following websites: https://erecruitment.limpopo.gov.za/, www.ldoh.gov.za, www.dpsa.gov.za and Provincial Department social media. Applicants must apply on the following website: https://erecruitment.limpopo.gov.za/
jobs.notes: NB: Ensure that you read the conditions and requirements of the post before you apply. Failure to comply with the instructions below will result in your application being disqualified. By applying, it is understood that you agree to the conditions and requirements of the post. Applicants are hereby invited from suitably qualified candidates for vacant posts in the Department of Health. Applications should include a fully completed new Z83 form obtainable from any government institution or at www.dpsa.gov.za and must be accompanied by a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae [CV]. Completion of Z83 Application Form: Online applications must include the only Curriculum Vitae [CV] in PDF as attachment. Zipped ,IMG and JPEG documents will not be accepted. The new Z83 form must be fully completed and signed up by the applicant. The following must be considered in relation to the completion of Z83 by applicants: All the fields in Part A, Part C and Part D must be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full except the following: South African applicants need not provide passport numbers. If an applicant responded “No” to the question “Are you conducting business with the State or are you a Director of a Public or Private company conducting business with the State? Then it is acceptable for an applicant to indicate ‘not applicable’ or leave blank to the question. If yes (provide detail), “In the event that you are employed in the Public Service, will you immediately relinquish such business interest?”. Applicants may leave the following question blank if they are not in possession of such: “If your profession or occupation requires official registration, provide date and particulars of registration”. Noting there is limited space provided for Part E, F & G, applicants often indicate “refer to Curriculum Vitae (CV)” or “see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. It must be noted that a CV is an extension of the application for employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. The questions related to the conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered however applicants currently employed by the public service do not need to complete the section as it is intended for those seeking re-employment. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and to provide proof of such evaluation. Shortlisted candidates will be required to come for an interview, at which time, certified copies of all relevant qualifications, current registration with the relevant statutory body and copy of ID must be submitted. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One shall be a practical exercise and the other shall be integrity [ethical conduct] assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process . In terms of the Directive on the Implementation of Competency Based Assessments, Training & Development for Members of the Senior Management Services (SMS) in the Public Service, as amended. All Shortlisted candidates for the SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview .Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Assessment for core competencies outlined in the SMS handbook shall be conducted within one month of the appointment of the candidate. The Office shall communicate the logistics for the psychometric assessment to the candidate: Only recommended candidates for Senior Management Services (SMS) posts shall undergo psychometric assessment (Giotto, 15FQ+, and CPP assessment). Shortlisted candidates for the SMS posts will be required to submit SMS pre- entry certificate obtainable from National School of Government [https://thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entryprogramme/.]                  on appointment. The cost for Nyukela is at the applicant ‘s own expense. Successful candidates will be expected to enter into performance agreement and sign oath of secrecy. Suitable candidate will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks [criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification and employment verification] Please note by responding to the advertisement, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). Your information will be used soley for the purpose of this promotion and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent unless required by law. The successful candidate falling within the designated categories for disclosure of financial interests will be required to disclose his/her financial interests in accordance with the applicable prescripts within 30 days of assumption of duty. Only the designated categories will disclose their financial interest in line with Regulation 16 (c),17 (2) & 18 (3) of the Public Service Regulation, 2016 as amended The Department of Health is an equal opportunity Employment Equity and Affirmative Action Employer. Females are encouraged to apply for posts at senior management level in order to address the Employment Equity targets within the Department. People with disabilities are encouraged to apply and correspondence will be entered into with shortlisted candidates only. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only due to the large number of applications we envisage to receive; and if you have not heard from us within ninety (90) days of the closing date, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are hereby advised to, within 90 days, request reasons from the Department for any administrative action which has adversely affected them in terms of section 5(1)(2) of the Promotion of Administrative Justice Act 3 of 2000.Kindly note that NO payment of any kind is required when applying for posts advertised in this circular. The Department reserves the right not to fill any advertised posts. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Voorsieningskettingbestuur
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir Voorsieningskettingbestuur by Pietersburg Hospital in Limpopo, wat 'n NQF Level 6-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se relevante SCM-ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies en Ervaring: 'n National Senior Certificate /Grade 12/Matric plus NQF Level 6 in Supply Chain Management/ Financial/Logistics/Cost and Accounting Management of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF level 6 soos erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. 'n Minimum van vyf [5] jaar se relevante ervaring in Demand and Acquisition Management waarvan drie (3) op juniorbestuurs- of Assistant Director-vlak moet wees. Rekenaarvaardigheid insluitend MS Outlook, Word, Excel en PowerPoint; vaardigheid in virtuele vergaderingsplatforms. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie behalwe vir persone met gestremdhede. Kennis en Vaardighede: Praktiese benadering tot tenders, verkrygingsadministrasie, batebestuur en kontrakbestuur. Kennis, begrip en toepassing van Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA), Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment Act (BBBEE), Supply Chain Management (SCM) guide to Accounting Officers and Related Legislation. Goeie leierskaps- en kommunikasie (mondelinge en skriftelike) vaardighede, aanbiedingsvaardighede, begrotingsvaardighede, rekenaarvaardigheid en kennis van regsaspekte in Voorsieningskettingbestuur.
af.duties: Bestuur van SCM-biedkomitees; afvoerkomitees; en kontrakonderhandelingskomitees. Bestuur van verbintenis; Monitering van nakoming van Voorsieningskettingbestuurswetgewing, beleide, prosedures en verwante subskripte. Bate- en Voorraadbestuur asook Kontrakadministrasie. Voorbereiding en indiening van maandelikse en kwartaalverslae in ooreenstemming met die verslagdoeningsvereistes. Bestuur van personeel. Bestuur van ouditaksieplan.

zu.title: Umongameli Ongekho emthethweni: Ukuphathwa Kwendawo Yokuhlinzeka
zu.summary: Umongameli Ongekho emthethweni wokuPhathwa kwendawo yokuhlinzeka esibhedlela i-Pietersburg Hospital e-Limpopo, ofuna iziqu ze-NQF Level 6 nenhlelo yeminyaka emihlanu yokuqeqeshwa okuhlobene nokuphathwa kwe-SCM.
zu.requirements: Iziqu Nolwazi: Isitifiketi Samatikithi eSizwe / i-Grade 12 / i-Matric kahle nge-NQF Level 6 kokuPhathwa kwendawo yokuhlinzeka / Ezezimali / Ezezimali ezibhalwe ngokwezimali / Ezezimali nokuBhalwa noma iziqu ezifanayo ngqo kwelingu le-NQF 6 njengokuqashelwa yi-South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Ukuze kube khona okuncane eminyakeni emihlanu [5] ulwazi oluhlobene nokuphathwa kokuFunwa nokutholwa kanti eminyakeni emithathu (3) kumele kube ngazinga lokuphathwa okungaphansi noma ngazinga lomphathi osiza. Ukusebenzisa ikhomphyutha okuhlanganisa i-MS Outlook, i-Word, i-Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint; Ukwazi ukusebenzisa izinkundla zokuhlangana ezingokoqobo. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile. Ulwazi Namakhono: Indlela yokwenza ngokusebenza kwezinto ezifunwa, ukuphathwa kokutholwa, ukuphathwa kwempahla kanye nokuphathwa kwezinkontileka. Ulwazi, ukuqonda nokusebenzisa uMthetho wokuPhathwa kwezezimali Zomphakathi (PFMA), Imithetho yesikweletu, uMthetho wokuHlela Inqubomgomo Yokuqamba Okuthandwa (PPPFA), uMthetho wokuNikela Amandla Ezimboni Zomnotho Zonke (BBBEE), umhlahlandlela wokuPhathwa kwendawo Yokuhlinzeka (SCM) kubaphathi bezezimali kanye Nemithetho Ehlobene. Amandla okuba ngumholi futhi okuxhumana (okubhalwe nokuKhulunywa), amandla okubonisa, amandla okubhala amabhajethi, ukusebenzisa ikhomphyutha kanye nokuqonda izinto ezingokomthetho ekuphathweni kwendawo yokuhlinzeka.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa kwezinkomphi ze-SCM; izinkomphi zokulahla; kanye nezinkomphi zoxhumo lwezinkontileka. Ukuphathwa kwezibopho; Ukubheka ukuzwisisana kwemithetho yokuPhathwa kwendawo yokuhlinzeka, izinqubomgomo, izindlela kanye nezinhlu ezihlobene. Ukuphathwa kwempahla kanye nezinto ezigcinwa njengokuphathwa kwezinkontileka. Ukuhlonga kuthunyelwe imibiko yenyanga ngamunye nenyanga ngamunye eya ngokwezidingo zokubika. Ukuphathwa kwabasebenzi. Ukuphathwa kohlelo lwezenzo zokuqeqesha ukulandelwa kwemithetho yokubika.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Ulawulo Lwezinto Ezingeniswa Nakwezi eziphuma ngaphandle
xh.summary: Isekela Mongameli woLawulo Lwezinto Ezingeniswa Nakwezi eziphuma ngaphandle kwiBethesidala iPietersburg Hospital eLimpopo, kufuneka kubekho isifiksile seNQF Level 6 kunye neminyaka emihlanu yamava ahambelana neSCM.
xh.requirements: Izifundo kunye Namava: INational Senior Certificate /Grade 12/Matric ongezelelwe NQF Level 6 kwiSupply Chain Management/ Financial/Logistics/Cost and Accounting Management okanye isifiksile esilinganayo kwinqanaba leNQF level 6 njengokuqatshunywa yiSouth African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Amava amathathu anelisiyo eminyaka emihlanu [5] ahambelana noLawulo lwemfuno kunye nokufunyanwa kwezinto, apho kum kuthathu (3) kufuneka kube ngowolawulo ongazinzanga okanye kwinqanaba lomsekela Mlawuli. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kuquka iMS Outlook, Word, Excel kunye nePowerPoint; Ulwazi lokusebenzisa iinkqubo zemicimbo emibini. Ilayiseni yenqanawa egunyazisiwe ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile. Ulwazi nakhono: Indlela yokubamba ngokuthe ngqo umsebenzi kumatoliki, ulawulo lofakelo lwezinto, ulawulo lwempahla kunye nolawulo lweenkonzo. Ulwazi, ukuqonda nokusebenzisa iPublic Finance Management Act (PFMA), iTreasury Regulations, iPreferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA), iBroad-Based Black Economic Empowerment Act (BBBEE), isikhokelo seSupply Chain Management (SCM) sokuziya kuwo Accounting Officers kunye neMithetho ephatheleyo. Ulawulo oluhle nakhono lokunxibelelan (oluthethwayo nolubhaliwayo), nakhono lokubonisa ngokusentsonjethi, nakhono lokulawula imali, ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kunye nolwazi ngemigangatho yomthetho kuSupply Chain Management.
xh.duties: Ulawulo lweekomiti zemigqaliselo yeSCM; iikomiti zokuphunga izinto eziselhodini; nami iikomiti ziphathelele kuvavanyo lwezwi ngezwi lweenkonzo. Ulawulo lwezithembiso; Ukuphatha ukuhambelana neMithetho yeSupply Chain Management, iingqinqo, iinkqubo kunye nezinto ezidityaniswe ngapha kwazi. Ulawulo Lwempahla Nakwezinto ezingeniswa njengoko ulawula imisebenzi yeenkonzo. Ulungiselela kunye nokuthumela iingxelo nyanga zonke nethoba ngeyhengamazwi ngokuhambelana neemfuno zokuvelisa iingxelo. Ulawulo lwabasebenzi. Ulawulo lowenzo wenkqubo yokujonga iingxelo.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer: Engineering Services (GRADE A-C) (X1
jobs.salary_text: Grade A: R914 517 per annum, (all-inclusive remuneration package) Grade B: R1 030 296 per annum, (all-inclusive remuneration package) Grade C: R1 172 184 per annum, (all-inclusive remuneration package) (The Department will determine the salary package based on years of experience post professional registration)
jobs.summary: The Limpopo Department of Health seeks a Mechanical Engineer to undertake designs, audits and maintenance strategy at the Provincial Office in Polokwane.
jobs.requirements: Qualifications and Experience: A National Senior Certificate /Grade 12/Matric plus an appropriate Degree in Mechanical Engineering. Registered as a Professional Engineer with ECSA. Three [3] years’ experience post qualification. Computer literacy including MS Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint; Virtual meeting platforms literacy. A valid driver’s license except for people with disabilities. Main Role: To perform and manage all aspects of varied innovative and complex engineering activities that result in progress in technology and engineering applications. The ideal candidate must have the ability to work in line with the Provincial Infrastructure Delivery Framework [IDMS], guide and operate within all applicable legislation, policies, frameworks and instruction notes. The successful applicant must be prepared to travel extensively throughout the province and work longer hours. Knowledge, Skills, Training And Competencies: The incumbent will be responsible to provide all mechanical engineering inputs and guidance which include all aspects of innovative and complex engineering applications for the development of infrastructure strategies, policies, systems, projects functional / technical norms and standards aligned to the Provincial Infrastructure Delivery Management System [IDMS]. The ideal candidate must have ability to apply the Provincial Infrastructure Delivery Management System [IDMS]. Ability to understand the health service delivery platform, indicators & service plan and how that links with infrastructure. Ability to understand how acquisitions and disposals are managed in Government. Ability to undertake a risk analysis and undertake a risk mitigation strategy. Ability to understand Provincial and Departmental policies on leases and property management. Ability to understand the infrastructure information fields required for updating health infrastructure information management systems. Ability to meet strict project deadlines – preparation of documentation, report writing, chairing and minute taking of site meetings. Ability to understand how to prepare budgets, extract and interpret information from related information systems.
jobs.duties: Undertake engineering designs. Perform final review and approvals of audits on new engineering designs according to design principles or theory. Implement the maintenance strategy. Set engineering maintenance standards, specifications and service levels according to organizational objectives to ensure optimum operational availability. Monitor maintenance efficiencies according to organizational goals to direct or redirect engineering services for the attainment of organizational objectives. Provide effective engineering and project management services. Load project documents and update information on the data management system. Undertake research. Manage human, physical and financial resources.

af.title: Meganiese Ingenieur: Ingenieurswese Dienste (GRAAD A-C) (X1
af.summary: Die Limpopo Department of Health soek 'n Meganiese Ingenieur om ontwerpe, oudits en 'n instandhoudingsstrategie by die Provinciale Kantoor in Polokwane te behartig.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies en Ervaring: 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat /Graad 12/Matriek plus 'n toepaslike Graad in Meganiese Ingenieurswese. Geregistreer as 'n Professionele Ingenieur by ECSA. Drie [3] jaar se ervaring na kwalifikasie. Rekenaarvaardigheid insluitend MS Outlook, Word, Excel en PowerPoint; Geletterdheid in virtuele vergaderplatforms. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie behalwe vir persone met gestremdhede. Hoofrol: Om alle aspekte van uiteenlopende innoverende en komplekse ingenieursaktiwiteite uit te voer en te bestuur wat lei tot vordering in tegnologie en ingenieurstoepassings. Die ideale kandidaat moet die vermoë hê om in ooreenstemming met die Provincial Infrastructure Delivery Framework [IDMS] te werk, en om alle toepaslike wetgewing, beleide, raamwerke en instruksienotas te rig en daabinne te opereer. Die suksesvolle applikant moet voorbereid wees om uitgebreid dwarsoor die provinsie te reis en langer ure te werk. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding En Bevoegdhede: Die ampshouer sal verantwoordelik wees om alle meganiese ingenieursbydraes en leiding te verskaf, wat alle aspekte van innoverende en komplekse ingenieurstoepassings insluit vir die ontwikkeling van infrastruktuurstrategieë, beleide, stelsels, projekte se funksionele / tegniese norme en standaarde wat op die Provincial Infrastructure Delivery Management System [IDMS] afgestem is. Die ideale kandidaat moet die vermoë hê om die Provincial Infrastructure Delivery Management System [IDMS] toe te pas. Vermoë om die gesondheidsdiensleweringplatform, aanwysers & diensplan te verstaan en hoe dit met infrastruktuur skakel. Vermoë om te verstaan hoe verkrygings en besettings in Regering bestuur word. Vermoë om 'n risiko-ontleding te onderneem en 'n risikobeperkingsstrategie uit te voer. Vermoë om Provinciale en Departementele beleide oor huurkontrakte en eiendomsbestuur te verstaan. Vermoë om die infrastruktuurinligtingsvelde te verstaan wat nodig is vir die opdatering van gesondheidsinfrastruktuurinligtingsbestuurstelsels. Vermoë om streng projekteikenlyne te haal – voorbereiding van dokumentasie, skryf van verslae, bemaak en neem van notule van terreinvergaderings. Vermoë om te verstaan hoe om begrotings voor te berei, inligting uit verwante inligtingstelsels te onttrek en te vertolk.
af.duties: Onderneem ingenieursontwerpe. Voer finale hersiening en goedkeurings van oudits op nuwe ingenieursontwerpe uit volgens ontwerpbeginsels of -teorie. Implementeer die instandhoudingsstrategie. Stel ingenieursinstandhoudingstandaarde, spesifikasies en diensvlakke volgens organisatoriese doelwitte om optimale operationele beskikbaarheid te verseker. Monitor instandhoudingsdoeltreffendheid volgens organisatoriese doelwitte om ingenieursdienste te rig of te herlei vir die bereiking van organisatoriese doelwitte. Verskaf effektiewe ingenieurs- en projekbestuursdienste. Laai projekdokumente en werk inligting op die databestuurstelsel op. Onderneem navorsing. Bestuur menslike, fisiese en finansiële hulpbronne.

zu.title: Injiniya Yezobuchwepheshe: Izinsizakalo Zobunjiniyela (IZINGA A-C) (X1
zu.summary: I-Limpopo Department of Health ifuna u-Injiniya Yezobuchwepheshe ozoqamba izinhlelo, enze izivivinyo futhi asungule isu lokugcina izinto ezisebenza kwisikhungo sesifunda e-Polokwane.
zu.requirements: Izifundo kanye Nempilo yokusebenza: I-National Senior Certificate /Grade 12/Matric kanye ne-Degree efanele kwi-Mechanical Engineering. Mabarariwe njengo-Professional Engineer ku-ECSA. Unyaka abathathu [3] bokuqashwa emumva kwezifundo. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngemishini ekuhlanganisa i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint; Ulwazi lokusebenza kumapulatifomu emihlangano ebonakalayo. Ithikithi elivumelekile lokushayela ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile. Indima Eyinhloko: Ukwenza kanye nokuphatha yonke imicimbi yemisebenzi ehlukahlukene futhi ibucayi kobunjiniyela eholela entuthukweni yobuchwepheshe kanye nezicelo zobunjiniyela. Ophumelelayo kumele abe nakho ukusebenza ngokuhlomula kwi-Provincial Infrastructure Delivery Framework [IDMS], ahola kanye nokusebenza ngaphakathi kwawo wonke umthetho, izinqamuleli, izakhiwo kanye nemiyalo ehlotshanisiwe. Oqashiwe kumele alungele ukuhamba kakhulu esiyingweni sonke futhi asebenze amahora amude. Ulwazi, Amandla, Uqeqesho Kanye Nokusuka kwamakhono: Lo osebenzelayo uzobeka izidingo kanye nokuqondisa zonke izinto ezingeniswa ezobunjiniyela bezobuchwepheshe okuhlanganisa yonke imicimbi yezicelo ezintsha futhi eziyinkimbinkimbi zobunjiniyela ukuthuthukisa izuqoqo, izinqamuleli, izinhlelo, izinhloso ezisebenzayo / futhi kanye nemithetho ebuqotho ehambisana ne-Provincial Infrastructure Delivery Management System [IDMS]. Ophumelelayo kumele abe namandla okusebenzisa i-Provincial Infrastructure Delivery Management System [IDMS]. Ukukwazi ukuqonda ipulatifomu yokuletha izinsizakalo zempilo, izinkomba & isu lenkonzo nokuthi kuhlobane kanjani nomgwaqo. Ukukwazi ukuqonda ukuthi izinkokelo kanye nokulahla kwemali zinjiniyelwa kanjani kuHulumeni. Ukukwazi ukwenza isilinganiso sezengozi nokwenza isu lokunciphisa izingozi. Ukukwazi ukuqonda izinqamuleli zesiFunda kanye zaKanyumnyango ngokugcwala nentelalolo yempahla. Ukukwazi ukuqonda izinkambu zolwazi lomgwaqo efunwa ukuvuselela izinhlelo zolwazi lomgwaqo wezempilo. Ukukwazi ukhokelana nezikhathi ezibekiwe zemisebenzi – ukulungiselela ukuhlobana, ukubhala imibiko, ukwenza isihlalo kanye nokubhala iminothi emihlanganweni. Ukukwazi ukuqonda ukuthi ungakanisa kanjani imali, ukukhipha kanye nokuhumusha ulwazi olusuka kwizinhlelo zolwazi eziyihambisana.
zu.duties: Ukwenzela imilinganiselo yobunjiniyela. Ukuhlola ngokugcwele kanye ukuvumela izivivinyo ezenziwa emapulani ezintsha zokwenza zobunjiniyela ngokuya ngemithetho yokwakha. Ukusebenzisa isu lokugcina izinto zisendaweni. Ukumisa imithetho, izinqubo kanye nzinga lenkonzo yokwenza izinto zisendaweni ngokuhambisana nenjongo yenhlangano ukuze kufikezeleke ukutholakala okubalulekile kokuqhutshwa kwayo. Ukuqapha ukusebenza komgwaqo wokugcina izinto endaweni ngokuhambisana nezinjongo zenhlangano ukuqondisa noma ukuqondis kabusha izinsizakalo zobunjiniyela ukuze kufikelelwe ezinjongo zenhlangano. Ukuletha izinsizakalo ezisebenzayo zobunjiniyela nokuqondisa imisebenzi. Ukufaka amafayela omsebenzi kanye nokuvuselela ulwazi kwisimiso sokuphathwa kolwazi. Ukwenzela uphando. Ukuphatha abantu, izinto ezibonakalayo kanye nezimali.

xh.title: Injineli yezamasebe: Iinkonzo zoBunjineli (GRADE A-C) (X1
xh.summary: Isebe lezeempilo leLimpopo lifuna iNjineli yezamasebe ukuba yenze iimphango-zokwakha, ukuhlola nokulawula inkqubo yonkonzo kwiOfisi yePhondo ePolokwane.

Unyaka wamathathu [3] wolwazi emva kokuqatshwa kwezifundo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha olubandakanya i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel ne-PowerPoint; Ulwazi lokusebenzisa iinkqubo zothungelwano kwiindawo ezingabonwayo. Ilayisenisi yokushayela evakalayo ngaphandle kwe-soze babantu abakhubazekileyo. Indima ePhambili: Ukwenza nokulawula onke amacala emisebenzi eyahlukahlukene ehamba phambili yobunjineli edala inkqubela phambili kwiteknoloji nakuqeqeshwa kobunjineli. Umqeshwa oqhamlezayo kufuneka abe n’amandla okusebenza ngokwe-Sakheko sokuNikezela iNfrastructure sePhondo [IDMS], akhokele asebenze ngaphakathi kwawo onke amagazethi, iinkqubo, iisakheko nokuqwalaselwa kolawulo. Umqeshwa oqhamlezayo kufuneka abe nàmandla okusebenzisa iNkqubo yokuLawula ukuNikela iNfrastructure yasePhondo [IDMS]. Amandla okuqonda inkqubo yonikezelo lwezeempilo, izalathiso & isicwangciso senkonzo nendlela eqhagamshelana nayo nayo nempangano. Amandla okuqonda indlela ezingenwa kwaye zikhutshwe ngayo izinto kurhulumente. Amandla okwenza isalathiso sowohlobo nendlela yokususa ubungozi. Amandla okuqonda iinkqubo zePhondo nezeSebe malunga nokuqeshwa kolawulo bendalo. Amandla okuqonda iindawo zolwazi malunga nokwakhiwa ezifunekayo zokuhlaziya iinkqubo zolawulo lolwazi lwezeempilo. Amandla okuhlola ngokobunyeni iinkqubo zokusetyenziswa kwe-data base. Amandla okuhlola ngokobunyeni iinkqubo zemithetho nemiqathango. Amandla okukwazi ukusetyenziswa kwesixhobo esithile ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amandla okubonisa ulwazi kubuchwepheshe bokubhalisa kolawulo. Amandla okwenza isicwangciso soqeqesho nentlalo-elixabano. Amandla okusebenzisa ulwazi oluqulunqwe ngokweenkcukacha.
xh.duties: Ukwenzwa kwemibhalo yezamasebe. Ukuhlaziswa kokugqibela nokugunyaziswa kweviko ngokweenkcukacha ezintsha ngesiXhosa. Ukuyilwa kwesixhobo sangaphakathi. Kuye kusetyenziswe ekuphathweni komsebenzi weenkampani. Xa usenza umbhalo kwi-database kufuneka ufake iinkcukacha ngokobunyeni bezixhobo. Kubalulekile ukwenza isicwangciso ngexesha. Kuya kufuneka ukhokelwe ngokomthetho wezoLuntu. Kufuneka uhlole ngokubukhali ukuba ngaba akukho nto yakha ubunzima. Kubalulekile ukuba wazi ukuba yintoni na le ayikwaziyo. Kufuneka ufunde izikripthi ngenkqubo yokuphatha umntu. Kubalulekile ukuba wazi iinkqubo, amacebo okusebenza nezicwangciso. Xa usenza umbhalo ofanekiswayo, kufuneka uqinisekise ukuba lo mntu uya kwenza njani na. Kufuneka uqinisekise ukuba lena ngumbhalo ochanekileyo. Kufuneka wazi ukuba ngowuphi umntu onikezelwa ngokutsha kulo mthetho. Kubalulekile ukuba uqinisekise ukuba uyayiqonda ngokweenkcukacha indlela ekuyilwa ngayo le nkqubo.

af.duties: Verseker die beskikbaarheid van medisyne en voorrade (verskaf alternatiewe behandeling, verskaf deurlopende terugvoer oor medisynebeskikbaarheid aan gesondheidsorgprofessionele persone). xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukufumaneka kwezithi kunye nezinto ezifunekayo (nika amanye amakhitha wokunyanga, nikeza ingxelo eqhubekayo ngokufumaneka kwezithi kubasebenzi bemisebenzi yezempilo). Lawula iinkonzo ezithi zize ngokukhuthaza ukusetyenziswa kwezithi ngokufanelekileyo, ukunyanzeliswa kwezithi, ukulawulwa kokusebenzisa amachiza obhubhisa iintsholongwane ngokwemiqathango yabo yeKomiti yeZithi kunye Nonyango, ukulawula izinto nokubika kwinkqubo yokubika ngezinto. Lawula izinto kuzo zonke iinqanaba nokuphelisa ukulahlwa kwezithi. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa koluhlu lwezithi zesibhedlele kunye nokuhlaziya uluhlu lwamakhowudi naxa kusenziwa utshintsho kumikhombandlela eNgunye yoKunyanga.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager: Nursing (AREA) (PN – A7)
jobs.summary: Assistant Manager Nursing position at Pietersburg Hospital in Limpopo requiring a professional nursing qualification registered with SANC, offering R720819 per annum.
jobs.requirements: Qualification and Experience: A National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/Matric plus Basic R425 qualification i.e. diploma/degree in nursing or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council [SANC] as a Professional Nurse. Post basic qualification with duration of at least one [1] year accredited with the SANC. Current registration with the South African Nursing Council as a Professional Nurse. A minimum of ten [10] years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the South African Nursing Council [SANC] in General Nursing. At least six [6] years of the period referred to above must be appropriate / recognizable experience after obtaining the one [1]-year post- basic qualification in the relevant specialty. At least three [3] years of the period referred to above must be appropriate / recognizable experience at management level. Willingness to do after-hours work and be on call including shift work. Computer literacy including MS Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint; Literacy in virtual meeting platforms. Valid driver’s license except for people with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of the application of the relevant statutes and policies governing the public service and nursing profession. Knowledge of the Performance Management and Development System. Knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act [PFMA] and Treasury Regulations. Understanding the application of Batho – Pele principles, Patients’ Rights charter and quality assurance system. Well- developed communication, presentation, negotiation and research skills. Ability to interact with diverse stakeholders and health users and givers. Computer literacy and report writing skills. Facilitation and coordination skills. Problem solving, planning and organizing skills.
jobs.duties: Provide nursing services for in-patient care, outpatient care, chronic inpatient, outpatient services, occupational services, occupational, infection and quality assurance services. Implementation of the nursing plan [Clinical, Practices/quality of practice]. Practice nursing and health care in accordance with laws and regulations relevant to nursing and relevant care. Maintain a constructive working relationship with nursing & other stakeholders. Utilize human material and physical resources effectively and effectively. Promote care for ethics and professionalism.

af.title: Assistentbestuurder: Verpleegkunde (AREA) (PN – A7)
af.summary: Assistentbestuurder Verpleegkunde-pos by Pietersburg Hospital in Limpopo wat 'n professionele verpleegkwalifikasie geregistreer by SANC vereis, teen R720819 per jaar.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasie en Ervaring: 'n National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/Matric plus basiese R425-kwalifikasie d.w.s. 'n diploma/graad in verpleegkunde of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad [SANC] as Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. Post-basiese kwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste een [1] jaar geakkrediteer by die SANC. Huidige registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad as Professionele Verpleegkundige. 'n Minimum van tien [10] jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad [SANC] in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ten minste ses [6] jaar van bogenoemde tydperk moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring wees na verkryging van die een [1]-jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike spesialiteit. Ten minste drie [3] jaar van bogenoemde tydperk moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring op bestuursvlak wees. Bereidwilligheid om buite-ure werk te doen en oproepbaar te wees insluitend skofwerk. Rekenaarvaardigheid insluitend MS Outlook, Word, Excel en PowerPoint; Vaardigheid in virtuele vergaderplatforms. Geldige bestuurderslisensie behalwe vir persone met gestremdhede. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van die toepassing van die tersaaklike wetgewing en beleide wat die openbare diens en verpleegprofessie regeer. Kennis van die Prestasiebestuurs- en Ontwikkelingstelsel. Kennis van die Openbare Finansiesbestuurswet [PFMA] en Tesourievoorskrifte. Begrip van die toepassing van Batho-Pele-beginsels, die Handves vir Pasiente se Regte en die gehalteversekeringsstelsel. Goed ontwikkelde kommunikasie-, aanbiedings-, onderhandelings- en navorsingsvaardighede. Vermoë om met diverse belanghebbendes en gesondheidsgebruikers en -verskaffers te kommunikeer. Rekenaarvaardigheid en verslagskryfvaardighede. Fasiliterings- en koördineringsvaardighede. Probleemoplossing-, beplannings- en organisasievaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaf verpleegdienste vir in-pasiëntsorg, buite-pasiëntsorg, chroniese in-pasiënt- en buite-pasiëntdienste, beroepsdienste, beroeps-, infeksie- en gehalteversekeringsdienste. Implementering van die verpleegplan [Klinies, Praktyke/gehalte van praktyk]. Beoefen verpleegkunde en gesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met wette en regulasies tersaaklik tot verpleegkunde en tersaaklike sorg. Handhaaf 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met verpleegkunde en ander belanghebbendes. Benut menslike, materiële en fisiese bronne effektief en doeltreffend. Bevorg sorg vir etiek en professionaliteit.

zu.title: Umphathi Osiza: Ukunakekelwa Kweziguli (AREA) (PN – A7)
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi osiza ekunakekelweni kweziguli esibhedlela iPietersburg Hospital eLimpopo esidinga iziqu zokunakekela iziguli ezibhaliswe kwiSANC, sinikeza iR720819 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Iziqu Nokuhlomuleka: I-National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/Matric kanye nokuqedwa kwe-Basic R425 qualification okungukuthi idiploma/iziqu ezingenhla ekunakekelweni kweziguli noma iziqu ezingalinganayo ezivumela ukubhalisa kuSouth African Nursing Council [SANC] njengoNesi Ochwepheshe. Iqu elingenhla ngemva kokufunda okungenani unyaka [1] owodwa elamukiwe yiSANC. Ukubhaliswa okwamanje kuSouth African Nursing Council njengoNesi Ochwepheshe. Okungenani iminyaka eyishumi [10] yohlaka oluhambisana/olubonakalayo ekunakekelweni kweziguli ngemva kokubhalisa njengoNesi Ochwepheshe kuSouth African Nursing Council [SANC] ekunakekelweni kweziguli ngokujwayelekile. Okungenani iminyaka eyisithupha [6] kwesikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele kube yohlaka oluhambisana/olubonakalayo ngemva kokuthola iqu lonyaka [1] lomkhakha okuthile ngemva kokufunda. Okungenani iminyaka emithathu [3] kwesikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele kube yohlaka oluhambisana/olubonakalayo ezingeni lophathi. Ukuzethoba ukusebenza ngemva kwamahora nokuqashwa lapho kubiziwa kuhlanganise nokusebenza ngokushintshashintsha. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha kuhlanganise i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel kanye nePowerPoint; Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa izinkundla zokuhlangana ngokubonwayo. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile ngaphandle kwabantu abakhushafelekile. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi ngokusethwa kwemithetho nemiqathango ehlobene ebusa imisebenzi kahulumeni nobuchwepheshe bokunakekela iziguli. Ulwazi ngokuPerformance Management and Development System. Ulwazi ngoPublic Finance Management Act [PFMA] kanye neTreasury Regulations. Ukuqonda ukusetshenziswa kweenjongo zeBatho – Pele, isibhengezwe sezamalungelo abaguli kanye nesistimu yokuqinisekisa izinga lokunakekela. Amakhono okuxhumana, okubhala, okuxoxisana nokucwaninga ahleliwe. Ikhono lokuxhumana nabahlukene abasemikhakheni nabanakekeli nokunikeza ukunakekelwa. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha kanye namakhono okubhala umbiko. Amakhono okuholela nokuqondanisa. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, okuhlela futhi aqonde izinto.
zu.duties: Nikeza amasevisi okunakekela iziguli angaphakathi, okungaphandle, okungaphakathi okuhlala isikhathi eside, amasevisi angaphandle, amasevisi okusebenza, amasevisi okusingathwa, ukutheleleka kanye nokuqinisekisa izinga. Ukuphumeza ihlelo lokunakekelwa kweziguli [Ezokwelapha, Izindlela/Izinga lenkqubo]. Yenza ukunakekelwa kweziguli nempilo ngokuvumelana nemithetho nemiqathano eholele ekunakekelweni kweziguli nakunakekelwa okuhlobene. Gcina ubudlelwano obuhle bokusebenza phakathi kwabanakekeli kweziguli nabanye abahlanganyeli. Sebenzisa abantu, izinto ezishwasu kanye nemithombo yendawo ngokuphumelelayo. Khuthaza ukunakekelwa ngokomoya wenkolo nokuqotha.

xh.title: Umphathi Oncedayo: Ukonzo lwezempilo (AREA) (PN – A7)
xh.summary: Isithuba somPhathi oNcedayo koKonzo lwezempilo e Pietersburg Hospital e Limpopo esifuna isidfikifoliesheni sezoBuchule bokunyanga esibhalisiweyo kwi SANC, sinika R720819 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Iikwalificationshini nokuQondelela: I-National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/Matric plus Basic R425 qualification okt i-diploma/degree kwinzimo yokunyanga okt isifaniso esivumela ubhaliso kwi South African Nursing Council [SANC] njengoGqirha woKunyanga. I-post-basic qualification neqondo lesixa elingentlalutsha lonyaka [1] egunyaziswe kwi SANC. Ugqibelele ubhaliso kwi South African Nursing Council njengoGqirha woKunyanga. Ukuba kokona iminyaka elishumi [10] yamava afanelekileyo/aqaqambisayo kwinkonzo yokunyanga emva kokuBhalisa njengoGqirha woKunyanga kwi South African Nursing Council [SANC] eGeneral Nursing. Kufuneka kube nokona iminyaka esithandathu [6] yexesha elibalwe ngasentla yamava afanelekileyo/aqaqambisayo emva kokuFumana i-post-basic qualification yonyaka [1] kwisikhokelo ngokweso. Kufuneka kube nokona iminyaka emithathu [3] yexesha elibalwe ngasentla yamava afanelekileyo/aqaqambisayo kwinqanaba lokuLawula. UkuNomzimba kokwenza umsebenzi wemiyure ecaleni kweyiveki nokuba kwi-nxibelelwano yabiziweyo kuquka i-shift work. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa iikhompyutha kuquka i MS Outlook, i-Word, i-Excel ne PowerPoint; Ulwazi kumanqanaba okudibana ebesidibanayo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekileyo. Ulwazi nakhono: Ulwazi ngokusetyenziswa kweemithetho nemigaqo elawula inkonzo yomphakathi nobugqirha bokunyanga. Ulwazi ngokwenza iPerformance Management and Development System. Ulwazi ngoMthetho wePublic Finance Management Act [PFMA] nemiQathango yeTreasury Regulations. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa iimigaqo iBatho-Pele, iPatients’ Rights charter, neNkqubo yokuQinisekisa umgangatho. Ulwazi oluzinze ngokwexesha lokusebenzisana, okubonwayo, lokuxoxa nokwenza uphando. Ukuba nokuzipatha ngokudibana neentango ezahlukeneyo, abasebenzisi benkonzo yezempilo nanikezeli. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa iikhompyutha nakhono lokubhalwa. Ulwazi lokuQhuba nokulungelelanisa. Ulwazi ngokuziba, ulwazi ngokusombulula iingxaki nokuCwangcisa.
xh.duties: Zeka iinkonzo zokunyanga ngokwengcali kwinkonzo yabaguli abalala phantsi kwaphakade, abangalali phantsi kwaphakade, abalala ixesha elide, abangalali ixesha elide iinkonzo, ukunyangwa kwemisebenzi, iinkonzo zokusingqongileyo, iinkonzo zokusingqongileyo, iinkonzo zokuQinisekisa umgangatho. Ukusebenzisa icebo lokunyanga [Clinical Practices/quality of practice]. Yenza ukunyanga nokunakekela ezempilo ngokuHambelana nemithetho neengqinelwano ezifana nokuNyanzeliswa kwenkonzo yemiyalelo yokunyanga nokunakekela. Ukugcina idlelane ngokusetyenziswa ngokusetyenziswa ngokusebenzisana nezinye izigqiza zokunyanga. Yonke iinkonzo ezintsha & ezinye iindleko ngokusebenzisa. Sebenzisa iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo zomzimba, yonke imibutho namathuba afanelekileyo kwaye ngokusebenzisa. Khuthaza ukuziphatha ngocwangco-lwazi nokuba ngumntu ongcali.

jobs.summary: Operational Manager Nursing posts across Limpopo clinics requiring a nursing diploma and SANC registration, paying R720,819 per annum plus rural allowance.
jobs.requirements: Qualifications and Experience: A National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/Matric plus a minimum of Basic R425 qualification i.e. diploma/degree in nursing or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council as a professional nurse. A post-basic nursing qualification, with duration of at least 1 year, accredited with SANC in one of the specialities relevant to PHC. A minimum of nine [9] years’ appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as professional nurse with the SANC in general nursing. At least five [5] years of the period referred to above must be appropriate /recognisable experience after obtaining the one [1] year post basic qualification in the relevant specialty. Willingness to work shifts, day-night duty, weekends and public holidays and to work extra hours on short notice. Computer literacy including MS Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint; Virtual meeting platforms literacy. Valid driver’s license except for people with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of primary health care package of services and management of diseases. Good written and verbal communication and good interpersonal relations. Experience in linking patient information and project management activities. Ability to work independently. Sound understanding of PMDS. Knowledge and insight of legislation and policies, relevant to current nursing practice within the public sector. Good organizational, interpersonal, leadership, decision-making and conflict resolution skills. Basic computer skills (MS word/power point/excel). Basic understanding of HR and financial policies and practices. Personal Attributes. Integrity and professionalism. Attention to detail and accuracy. Accountability and reliability. Proactive and results orientated. Calm under pressure and adaptable to change. Team player. Committed to continuous learning and Batho Pele principles.

Participate in management and utilize physical, financial and Human Resources to fulfil operational and developmental functions in accordance with legislation and policies. Manage stock and equipment in accordance with legislation and policies. Participate in health promotion and illness prevention initiatives and contribute to their evaluation. Maintain and promote ethical standards and core values of the department.

af.title: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleegkunde (PHC) (PN-B3) (SKOFTE) (X128
af.summary: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleegkunde-poste by Limpopo-klinieke wat 'n verpleegkunde-diploma en SANC-registrasie vereis, met 'n salaris van R720,819 per jaar plus landelike toelaag.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies en Ervaring: 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/Grade 12/Matriek plus 'n minimum van Basiese R425-kwalifikasie d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde of 'n ekwivalente kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad as professionele verpleegkundige moontlik maak. 'n Post-basiese verpleegkwalifikasie, met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar, by SANC geakkrediteer in een van die spesialiteite wat vir PHC relevant is. 'n Minimum van nege [9] jaar se toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as professionele verpleegkundige by die SANC in algemene verpleegkunde. Ten minste vyf [5] jaar van bogenoemde tydperk moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring wees na verkryging van die een [1] jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie in die relevante spesialiteit. Bereidwilligheid om skofte te werk, dag-en-nagdiens, naweke en openbare vakansiedae, asook om addisionele ure met kort kennisgewing te werk. Rekenaargeletterdheid insluitend MS Outlook, Word, Excel en PowerPoint; Geletterdheid in virtuele vergaderingsplatforms. Geldige bestuurderslisensie behalwe vir persone met gestremdhede. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van primere gesondheidsorg-pakket van dienste en bestuur van siektes. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie en goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Ervaring in die koppeling van pasiëntinligting en projekbestuuraktiwiteite. Vermoë om onafhanklik te werk. Deeglike begrip van PMDS. Kennis en insig van wetgewing en beleide, relevant tot huidige verpleegpraktyk binne die openbare sektor. Goeie organisatoriese, interpersoonlike, leierskaps-, besluitnemings- en konflikoplossingsvaardighede. Basiese rekenaarvaardighede (MS Word/PowerPoint/Excel). Basiese begrip van HR- en finansiële beleide en praktyke. Persoonlike eienskappe. Integriteit en professionaliteit. Aandag aan besonderhede en akkuraatheid. Verantwoordelikheid en betroubaarheid. Proaktief en resultaatgerig. Kalm onder druk en aanpasbaar by verandering. Spanspeler. Toegewy aan deurlopende leer en Batho Pele-beginsels.
af.duties: Doeltreffende en effektiewe koördinering van vereiste verpleegsorg, wat voldoen aan die standaarde wat deur die diens en professionele raamwerk gestel is. Neem deel aan bestuur en benut fisiese, finansiële en Menslike Hulpbronne om operasionele en ontwikkelingsfunksies ooreenkomstig wetgewing en beleide te vervul. Bestuur voorraad en toerusting ooreenkomstig wetgewing en beleide. Neem deel aan gesondheidsbevordering en siektevoorkoming-aktiwiteite en dra by tot hul evaluering. Handhaaf en bevorder etiese standaarde en kernwaardes van die departement.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezokusebenza Wokuhlengwa (PHC) (PN-B3) (AMASHIFI) (X128
zu.summary: Izikhundla zomphathi wezokusebenza wokuhlengwa emaklinikhini ase-Limpopo afuna idiploma yokuhlengwa nokubhalisele kwi-SANC, ekhokha i-R720,819 ngonyaka kanye nensiza yasemaphandleni.
zu.requirements: Izifundo nemiyalezo: I-National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/Matric kanye nesidingo esingaphansi kwamakhulu atholakale ngokulinganisela okuncane se-Matric/Grade 12 idiploma/degree in nursing noma okulingana nokuvumela ukubhalisa South African Nursing Council njengogqoki wezokuhlengwa. I-post-basic nursing qualification, ihlolwe njalo ukuthi ithinte iminyaka engu-1, ehlotshaniswa i-SANC ukwazi ukuthi kubalulekile e-PHC. Iminyaka engu-9 ngokulinganisela kokutholakala komkhakha ofanelekile/okuhlonzekwayo kokuhlengwa ngemuva kokubhalisa njengogqoki wesokuhlengwa South African Nursing Council ngokujwayelekile. Okungenani iminyaka eyisihlanu [5] kwalowo mkhakha kumele ibe ngokufanelekile/okuhlonzekwayo ngemuva kokuthola le minyaka eyisihlanu [5] kuleyo minyaka eyisihlanu ebalulekile. Kuthanda ukusebenza ngamashifi, amabili alolo busuku nemini, ngokuphela nangamaholide. Iminyaka eyisikhombisa [7] ekutheni isikhathi esimbalwa sifanele/okuhlonzekwayo emsebenzini okhokhelwa ngemali efanayo nendawo edingwa ukuba kubhaliswe ku-South African Nursing Council ngokujwayelekile; okungenani iminyaka eyisihlanu [5] kuleyo minyaka eyisikhombisa kumele kube ngokulingana nendlela ehlonza iminyaka eyisihlanu ethi ibe yinto efanayo. Ukuthanda ukusebenza amashifi, ilungiselelo lamabhulumende angaphandle kolwesi olusetshenziswa kanye nesikhashana nangokushesha. Ulwazi lokusebenzela ikhaya eliseduze nakude kanye nokuba yisidingo esihle ekubambisweni nalabo abakhokhelwa imali. Computer literacy including MS Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint; Virtual meeting platforms literacy. I-Learner's License/Driver's license (ngaphandle kwabantu abaphila nokuqinisekisa ukuba bangakwazi ukuqhuba. Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of primary health care package of services and management of diseases. Good written and verbal communication and good interpersonal relations. Experience in linking patient information and project management activities. Ability to work independently. Sound understanding of PMDS. Knowledge and insight of legislation and policies, relevant to current nursing practice within the public sector. Good organizational, interpersonal, leadership, decision-making and conflict resolution skills. Basic computer skills (MS word/power point/excel). Basic understanding of HR and financial policies and practices. Personal Attributes. Integrity and professionalism. Attention to detail and accuracy. Accountability and reliability. Proactive and results orientated. Calm under pressure and adaptable to change. Team player. Committed to continuous learning and Batho Pele principles.
zu.duties: Ukuhlanganisa ngokusebenza kahle nangokusebenza ngempumelelo ukunakekelwa okudingekayo kokuhlengwa, okuhambisana namazinga abekwe yinkonzo nangomgodla wemisebenzi. Ukubamba iqhaza ekuphatweni nokusebenzisa izinsiza eziphathekayo, ezimali nabantu ngokugcwalisa imisebenzi yezokusebenza nokuqhubela phambili ngokuvumelana nomthetho nemigomo. Ukuphatha izimpahla nezinsiza ngokuvumelana nomthetho nemigomo. Ukubamba iqhaza ekukhuthazeni impilo nasekuvikeleni ukugula futhi ungenele ekuhloleni lokho. Ukugcina futhi ukukhuthaza amazinga okuziphatha kanye namagugu abe umnyango.

xh.title: Umphathi Wemisebenzi Yokhathseleko Kwezempilo (PHC) (PN-B3) (IISHIFTHI) (X128
xh.summary: Izithuba zobaphathi bemisebenzi yakhathseleko kwezempilo kumaziko eLimpopo afuna idiploma yokhathseleko kwezempilo neregistry ye-SANC, ethumela umvuzo we-R720,819 ngonyaka nokongeza indlela yemiddi yasehlane.
xh.requirements: Izifundo nemPhilo: Isatifikethi SeSenior Sendlwini/Nqanaba 12/Isatifikethi sokuphela kwesikolo samabanga aphakamileyo kanjalo nangaphezulu kwesiqinisekiso esisisiseko seR425 oko kukuthi idiploma/idigri ekhathseleko lwempilo okanye isiqinisekiso esifanayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council njengogqithi ekhathseleko lwempilo. Isiqinisekiso sokugqithisa ekhathseleko lwempilo, esithatha inyanga enye ngaphezulu, esivunyelwe yi-SANC kwenye yemisebenzi ehambelana ne-PHC. Unyaka wethoba [9] osuke uqinisekisiweyo wokuba namava ekhathseleko lwempilo emva kokubhalisa njengogqithi we-SANC kwindalo yemphilo. Kwenzeke kube nenyanga ezintlanu [5] ekuthethwa ngasentla kwexesha elithatha isiqinisekiso esifanelekileyo/esisazisiweyo emva kokufumana isiqinisekiso se-[1] yenyaka yokugqithisa esihlobene ne-PHC. Ilungelelaniso lokusebenza iishifithi, umsebenzi wemini nobusuku, iintsuku zeevekendi namaholide abahlali nokusebenza iiyure ezongezelelweyo ngokukhawuleza. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha oluquka i-MS Outlook, i-Word, i-Excel ne-PowerPoint; Ulwazi olupheleleyo lweenkqubo zokudibana ezingabonakaliyo. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esebenzayo ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubekileyo. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi lweqela lesebenziseko lezonyango lwephfanelo nokulawula iimfono. Isixhobo sokubhala nokuthetha esilungileyo nendibaniselwano elungileyo phakathi kwabantu. Namava ekuxhumaniseni inkcazelo yomntu ofayo nemiqqobo yokulawula. Ulwazi lokuzinikela ngokusebenza. Ukuqonda okuzinzileyo kwe-PMDS. Ulwazi nemibono yomthetho nemigaqo, ehambelana nonyango lwezempilo lwangoku kwingingini yorhulumente. Amakhondo abalulekileyo okuqamba, ukuzinikela ngokwentsini, ukulawula, ukuthatha izigqibo nokulungisa iingxaki. Amakhondo abalulekileyo okusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word/PowerPoint/Excel). Ukuqonda okubalulekileyo kweenkqubo zemigaqo ye-HR nezemali. Iimpawu zomntu. Intembeko nokuziphatha ngokobungcali. Ukuqwalasela iinkcukacha nokuchaneka. Ukuqabela nokuthembeka. Ukuziphatha ngokuzifaka nokujolisa kumziphumo. Ukuzinza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo nokuzinza kuguquko. Ukusebenza njengomdlali weqela. Ukuqinisekiswa ekufundeni kuqhubekayo nakumagunya amabini aBatho Pele.
xh.duties: Ukuqhubelela phambili ngokusebenza kwekhratya lwezonyango olufunekayo, oluhambelana namagunya abekiweyo ngesebe nolwesakhulo sabaphathi. Ukuzibandakanya ekulawuleni nokusebenzisa izixhobo, imali namaziko abantu ukuze kuqaliswe imisebenzi yokuqhubelela phambili ngokumthetho nemigaqo. Ukulawula izinto nezixhobo ngokumthetho nemigaqo. Ukuzibandakanya ekuphakamiseni impilo nakunciphisa iimfono ungene nje ngegalelo ekuqwalaselweni kwawo. Ukugcina nokuphakamisa amagunya obugcisa namanxhinxebo abalulekileyo esebe.

jobs.title: Control Engineering Technician-mechanical
jobs.centre: Provincial Office (Polokwane) IREQUIREMENTS   :   Qualifications and Experience: A National Senior Certificate /Grade 12/Matric plus NQF level 6 in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent relevant qualification. Registration with ECSA as a Professional Engineering Technician Mechanical. Six [6] years’ post qualification technical experience. Training programme undertaken and successfully completed in Project Management will serve as an added advantage. Computer literacy including MS Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint; Virtual meeting platforms literacy. The successful applicant must be prepared to travel extensively throughout the province and work longer hours. A valid driver’s license except for people with disabilities. Main Role: To render technical services and support in terms of management of service providers responsible for the maintenance of lifts, laundry machines, refrigeration and boilers and manage information on the use of utilities. The ideal candidate must have the ability to work in line with the Provincial Infrastructure Delivery Framework [IDMS], guide and operate within all applicable legislation, policies, frameworks and instruction notes. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies: The incumbent of this post will be responsible to provide all electrical/mechanical engineering inputs and guidance which include all aspects of innovative and complex engineering applications for the development of infrastructure strategies, policies, systems, projects functional / technical norms and standards aligned to the Provincial Infrastructure Delivery Management System [IDMS]. The ideal candidate must have the ability to apply the Provincial Infrastructure Delivery Management System [IDMS]. •Ability to understand the Health service delivery platform, indicators & service plan and how that links with infrastructure. Ability to understand how acquisitions and disposals are managed in Government. Ability to undertake a risk analysis and undertake a risk mitigation strategy. Ability to understand the infrastructure information fields required for updating health infrastructure information management systems. Ability to meet strict project deadlines – preparation of documentation, report writing, chairing and minute taking of site meetings. Ability to understand how to prepare budgets, extract and interpret information from related information systems.
jobs.summary: The Department of Health in Limpopo seeks a Control Engineering Technician to manage mechanical infrastructure, service providers and utilities maintenance at the Provincial Office in Polokwane.
jobs.duties: Develop/determine and maintain technical and functional norms and standards for mechanical/electrical installations and systems. Assist with the investigation proposals for innovative service delivery mechanisms and undertake feasibility studies. Compile mechanical/electrical briefing documentation and specifications. Provide inputs to the determination of the Construction Procurement Strategy and the Infrastructure Programme Management Plan. Validate quality of performance of service providers in terms of norms, standards and maintenance contracts. Compile reports with recommendations related to non-performance in terms of maintenance mechanical / electrical installations and systems. Investigate mechanical / electrical engineering installations and equipment to validate compliance with the Occupational Health and Safety Act and the Engineering Regulations issued in terms of the Act. Load project documents and update information on the data management system. Implement [construction], training and commissioning of mechanical/electrical engineering installations. Undertake research. Manage human, physical and financial resources. ENQUIRES : General enquiries about the advertised posts should be directed to Ms Hlokoa RE Tel No: (015) 293 6406, Ms Mompei MM Tel No: (015) 293 6126 / Ms Sebake RL Tel No: (015) 293 6426, Ms Sebola MF Tel No: (015) 293 6002 and Ms Mothiba JT Tel No: (015) 293 6329 during office hours.

af.title: Beheeringenieurwerkingstegnikus-meganies
af.summary: Die Department of Health in Limpopo soek 'n Beheeringenieurwerkingstegnikus om meganiese infrastruktuur, diensverskaffers en nutsbiedienonderhoud by die Provinsiale Kantoor in Polokwane te bestuur.
af.duties: Ontwikkel/bepaal en handhaaf tegniese en funksionele norme en standaarde vir meganiese/elektriese installasies en stelsels. Help met ondersoekvoorstelle vir innoverende diensleweringmeganismes en onderneem uitvoerbaarheidstudies. Stel meganiese/elektriese briefdokumentasie en spesifikasies op. Verskaf insette tot die bepaling van die Konstruksie-aanbestedingsstrategie en die Infrastruktuurprogrambestuursplan. Valideer die kwaliteit van prestasie van diensverskaffers in terme van norme, standaarde en onderhoudskontrakte. Stel verslae op met aanbevelings rakende nie-prestasie in terme van onderhoud aan meganiese/elektriese installasies en stelsels. Ondersoek meganiese/elektriese ingenieursinstallasies en toerusting om nakoming van die Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid en die Ingenieursregulasies wat ingevolge die Wet uitgereik is, te valideer. Laai projekdokumente en werk inligting op die databestuurstelsel op. Implementeer [konstruksie], opleiding en inbedryfstelling van meganiese/elektriese ingenieursinstallasies. Ondersoek instel. Bestuur menslike, fisiese en finansiële hulpbronne. NAVRAE : Algemene navrae oor die geadverteerde poste moet gerig word aan Me. Hlokoa RE Tel No: (015) 293 6406, Me. Mompei MM Tel No: (015) 293 6126 / Me. Sebake RL Tel No: (015) 293 6426, Me. Sebola MF Tel No: (015) 293 6002 en Me. Mothiba JT Tel No: (015) 293 6329 gedurende kantoorure.

zu.title: Itheknishani yobunjiniyole bokulawula-isinyezelo
zu.summary: UMnyango Wezempilo oLimpopo ufuna Itheknishani yobunjiniyole bokulawula ukuphatha isakhiwo sezinyezelo, abanikezeli besevisi nokugcinwa kwezinsiza eNdiweni loBuzwe ePolokwane.
zu.duties: Bumba/qamba futhi ugcine izindinganiso nezimiso ezobuchwepheshe nezokusebenza kokuqashelwa nokuhlelwa kwezinyezelo/zabangqangi kanye namasistimu. Siza ekuphenyeni izinkambo zokuhlinzeka ngezenzo ezintsha futhi wenze izifundo zokubuka ukuzwana. Hlanganisa ukwatalwa kwemibhalo nezibuyekezo zezinyezelo/zabangqangi. Nikeza izimiso ekubumbeni umkhankaso wokuthenga izakhiwo nephulani yokuphathwa kwenkqubo yezakhiwo. Qinisekisa ukubaluleka kokusebenza kwabanikezeli besevisi ngokwemilinganisyo, izindinganiso nakumakontradi wokugcina. Hlanganisa imibhalo yezincomo ehlotshaniswa nokungasebenzi ngokokugcina kokuqashelwa/hlelwa kwezinyezelo/zabangqangi kanye namasistimu. af.summary: Spesialiteitsposte vir professionele verpleegkundiges by verskeie Limpopo-hospitale wat SANC-registrasie en 'n post basiese kwalifikasie in 'n spesialiteitsverpleegkunde-gebied vereis.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies en Ervaring: 'n National Senior /Grade 12/ Matric plus Basiese R425-kwalifikasie [d.w.s. diploma/graad] in verpleegkunde of 'n ekwivalente kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council as Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Post basiese verpleegkundige kwalifikasie in een van bogenoemde spesialiteitsverpleegkunde-gebiede met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar, geakkrediteer by die SANC in een van die spesialiteite waarna verwys is. Huidige registrasie by die South African Nursing Council [SANC] as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring vir Graad 1: 'n Minimum van vier [4] jaar toepaslike /herkenbare verpleegkundige ervaring na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die South African Nursing Council [SANC] in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ervaring vir Graad 2: 'n Minimum van veertien [14] jaar toepaslike / herkenbare verpleegkundige ervaring na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde en ten minste tien [10] jaar van bogenoemde tydperk moet toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring wees na verkryging van die een [1] jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie in Spesialiteit. Moet in staat wees om skofte te werk [insluitend nagskof en openbare vakansiedae]. Bereidwilligheid om ekstra ure op kort kennisgewing te werk. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures, verpleegstatutes en ander relevante regsraamwerke soos: Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Patients' right charter, Batho Pele-beginsels, openbare diensregulasies, 2016, Labour Relations Act, 1995, dissiplinêre kode en prosedure, klagteprosedure ens. Goeie kommunikasie, verslagskrywing, fasilitering, skakeling, netwerking en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Inligtingsbestuur. Kennis van bestuur, beplanning en organisering. Persoonlike Eienskappe: Integriteit en professionaliteit. Aandag aan besonderhede en akkuraatheid. Verantwoordingspligtigheid en betroubaarheid. Proaktief en resultaatgerig. Kalm onder druk en aanpasbaar by verandering. Respekvol en diplomatiek met belanghebbendes. Spanspeler. Toegewyd aan deurlopende leer en Batho Pele-beginsels
af.duties: Verskaf rigting en toesig vir die implementering van die verpleegplan [kliniese praktyk/kwaliteitspasientsorg]. Implementeer standaarde, praktyke, kriteria en aanwysers vir kwaliteitsverpleging [kwaliteit van praktyk]. Beoefen verpleging en gesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met die wette en regulasies relevant tot verpleging en gesondheidsorg. Onderhou 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met verpleging en ander belanghebbendes. Benut menslike, materiële en fisiese hulpbronne doeltreffend en effektief.

zu.title: Umhlengikazi Ohwebile (IZIFUNDO EZIKHULUME KAKHULU) (EZIHLUKENE) Izinga 1 - 2 (PN - B1])
zu.summary: Izikhundla somhlengikazi ohwebile ezitshenzelwa ezahlukene ezibhedlela zase Limpopo ezidinga ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC nesiqu sendlela yokufunda esingemuva kwesisekelo endaweni yokufunda ekhetheke kuyo ukunakekelwa kwempilo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu nokuhlangenwe nakho: Isiqu se-National Senior /Grade 12/ Matric kalengele nesesiqu se-R425 esisishogweni [okungukuthi idiploma/idigri] ekunakekelweni noma isiqu esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council njengomhlengikazi ohwebile. Isiqu sokufunda okungemuva kwesisekelo ekunakekelweni kwenye yalezo ndawo ezikhetheke kakhulu ekunakekelweni ngaphezulu nangesikhathi esingaphezu konyaka unyaka owodwa, esamukelekile e-SANC kunoma yisiphi esinye sezifundo ezingaphezulu ezishiwo. Ukubhaliswa okwamanje ne-South African Nursing Council [SANC] njengomhlengikazi ohwebile. Uholo lwezinga 1: Okungenani eminyaka emine [4] yohlelo oluhambisanayo /olungaqondakala kalulo lomsebenzi wokunakekela emva kokubhaliswa njengomhlengikazi ohwebile ne-South African Nursing Council [SANC] ekunakekelweni jikelele. Uholo lwezinga 2: Okungenani eminyaka eyishumi nane [14] yohlelo oluhambisanayo / olungaqondakala kalulo lomsebenzi wokunakekela emva kokubhaliswa njengomhlengikazi ohwebile ne-SANC ekunakekelweni jikelele futhi okungenani eminyaka eyishumi [10] kwesikhathi esishiwo ngaphezulu kumele kuhle futhi kuqondakale kalulo lohlu oluqhubekayo emva kokuthola isiqu sendlela yokufunda eyinyanga eyikhulu nengugogo ekunakekelweni okukhetheke kulo. Kumele ukwazi ukusebenza ngokushintshashintshwa izikhathi [okuhlanganisa ukusebenza ebusuku nasemaholidi omphakathi]. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza amahora angaphezulu ngesikhathi esifushane. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemikhakha yokunakekela nokuhamba kwemisebenzi yemithetho yokunakekela nokunye okuhlobene nemithetho efana ne: i-Nursing Act, i-Health Act, i-Occupational Health and Safety Act, i-Patients' right charter, imigomo ye-Batho Pele, izimiso zomphakathi wonke, 2016, i-Labour Relations Act, 1995, ikhodi nesimo sokuphatheka, isimo sokukhalaza njll. Ukuxhumana okuhle, ukubhala okuhle imibiko, ukwesekwa, ukuxhumana, ukwakha izinhlobonhlobo zokuxhumana namakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuphathwa kwolwazi. Ulwazi lokuphatha, ukuhlela nokuhlanganisa. Izimpawu zobuntu: Ukuzelelwa ngokuziphatha nokuba ngochwepheshe. Ukuqaphela imininingwane nokuqinisekisa ukuqonda. Ukubeka incazulo nokuthembeka. Ukuba mqapheli wezidingo nokugcina ukubambelela ekufeni izifiso. Ukuhlala uzolile naphansi kwenkcindezelo nokuzwela izinguquko. Ukuba nomzwelo nokuziphatha kabi ngomuzi nabanye abahlanganyeli. Ukusebenza ngokuhlanganyela. Ukuzinika ngeqeto ekufundeni okuphila ikhaya nokubamba izimiso ze-Batho Pele
zu.duties: Nika umqondo futhi ulawule ukuphathwa kwehlelo lokunakekela [isebenzo sokwelapha / ukunakekelwa okuhle kwesiguli]. Qamba izimiso, izindlela zokwenza, izinkomba nemigomo yokunakekelwa okuhle [izinga lwenkalo yomsebenzi]. Yenza ukunakekelwa nokunakekela impilo ngokulandela imithetho nemithetho ehlobene nokunakekelwa nokunakekela impilo. Gcina ubudlelwano obuhle bokusebenza nabahlengikazi nabanye abahlanganyeli. Sebenzisa izinsizakalo zabantu, izinto ezibekiwe namaphasi kahle okusebenzisa izinsiza.

xh.title: Igcisa lokhathalelo lwabantu (SPECIALTY) (VARIOUS) Inqanaba 1 - 2 (PN - B1])
xh.summary: Izithuba zobugcisa bokhathalelo lwabantu kumajelo ahlukeneyo kumaziko okhathalelo lwabantu eLimpopo afuna ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC nelifikholethi yasemva kwesiseko kwelona jelo lokhathalelo lwabantu lilodwa.
xh.requirements: Izifundo nemava: Inqanaba eliphezulu leSizwe / Inqanaba 12 / Isatifikathi yesikolo samabanga aphakamileyo kwaye kusetyenziswa isicwangciso seR425 esisisiseko [okt. idiploma/idigri] ekhathalelweni lwabantu okanye isifundo esingolutsho esivumela ukubhaliswa kuBhungo lokhathalelo lwabantu laseMzantsi Afrika njengogcisa lokhathalelo lwabantu. Ifikholethi yasemva kwesiseko ekhathalelweni lwabantu kwelinye kweelo jelo lokhathalelo lwabantu elidweliswe ngasentla, esithatha ubude bonyaka omnye ubuncinane, egunyaziswe yi-SANC kwelinye kweelo jelo elitshiwo ngasentla. Ukubhaliswa kwangoku kuBhungo lokhathalelo lwabantu laseMzantsi Afrika [SANC] njengogcisa lokhathalelo lwabantu. Imava yaseNqanabeni 1: Ubuncinane beminyaka emine [4] yemava efanelekileyo / ebonakalisekileyo ekhathalelweni lwabantu emva kokubhalisa njengogcisa lokhathalelo lwabantu kuBhungo lokhathalelo lwabantu laseMzantsi Afrika [SANC] ekhathalelweni lwabantu ngokubanzi. Imava yaseNqanabeni 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka elishumi eline [14] yemava efanelekileyo / ebonakalisekileyo ekhathalelweni lwabantu emva kokubhalisa njengogcisa lokhathalelo lwabantu kwi-SANC ekhathalelweni lwabantu ngokubanzi kwaye ubuncinane kweminyaka elishumi [10] kwexesha elitshiwo ngasentla kufuneka kube yimava efanelekileyo / ebonakalisekileyo emva kokufumana ifikholethi yasemva kwesiseko yonyaka omnye [1] kwijelo elithile. Kufuneka ukwazi ukusebenza ngokutshintsha iishaphi [kuquka umsebenzi wasebusuku namaholide ezizwe]. Ukulungele ukusebenza iiyure ezongezelelweyo ngesantya esisheshayo. Ulwazi ngamakhono: Ulwazi malunga neenkcubeko neenkqubo zokhathalelo lwabantu, izigaba zomthetho zokhathalelo lwabantu nazamanye amagunya omthetho arelevanti anjengala: uMthetho weKhathalelo lwAbantu, uMthetho wezeMpilo, uMthetho weKhathalelo loKhuseleko loMsebenzi, isatifikathi yamalungelo abaguli, iinkqubo zeBatho Pele, iimigaqo yesebe lolawulo loqoqosho, 2016, uMthetho wezeQumrhu loMsebenzi, 1995, ikhowudi yohlangothi lwengxaki nenkqubo, inkqubo yezikhalazo, njl. Amakhono oluthetho oluhle, ukuBhala iingxelo, ukuQhuba, ukuQhagamshelana, ukuNxulumanisa noKusombulula iingxaki. uLawulo lolwazi. Ulwazi loLawulo, uCwangcisa oluHle kwaye ulungisele. Iimpawu zobuntu: Uqotho nobungcali. uMzondelelo kwimbotyi nokuChaneka. uNxandarho noThemba. uQhaga nokuJolisa kumziphumo. uZolilexeshana ngaphantsi koxinzelelo kwaye uzimisele ngokutshintsha. uHlonipha kwaye uthethelele nabathathi-nxaxheba. uDlala ngokwqoqiweyo. Uzinikele ekufundeni ngokungapheliyo nasekuKhuseleni iinkqubo zeBatho Pele
xh.duties: Nika isalathiso nolawulo ekusebeniseni isicwangciso sokhathalelo lwabantu [izilolonga ezenzwayo / ukhathalelo lwemigqangi olungangcaliyo]. Sebenzisa iindidi, iinkqubo, iingongoma neenkqubo zokulinganisela isiseko ekhathalelweni lwemigqangi olungangcaliyo [isiseko sezenzo]. Zenza isixhobo sokhathalelo lwabantu nolunye uKhathalelo lwempilo ngokuvumelana namathetha ngamathetha lawo ohlonitshwa lula ekhathalelweni lwabantu nasekhathalelweni lwempilo. Gcina uludidi lokusebenza ngokwakha kwaye uhambisane nabakhathaleli bantu bonke abanye. Sebenzisa amathambo, izixhobo nezinto ezingaphakathi ngokuchaneka nokusebenza ngokufanelekileyo.
