jobs.notes: NB: Ensure that you read the conditions and requirements of the post before you apply. Failure to comply with the instructions below will result in your application being disqualified. By applying, it is understood that you agree to the conditions and requirements of the post. Applicants are hereby invited from suitably qualified candidates for vacant posts in the Department of Health. Applications should include a fully completed new Z83 form obtainable from any government institution or at www.dpsa.gov.za and must be accompanied by a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae [CV]. Completion of Z83 Application Form: Online applications must include the only Curriculum Vitae [CV] in PDF as attachment. Zipped ,IMG and JPEG documents will not be accepted. The new Z83 form must be fully completed and signed up by the applicant. The following must be considered in relation to the completion of Z83 by applicants: All the fields in Part A, Part C and Part D must be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full except the following: South African applicants need not provide passport numbers. If an applicant responded “No” to the question “Are you conducting business with the State or are you a Director of a Public or Private company conducting business with the State? Then it is acceptable for an applicant to indicate ‘not applicable’ or leave blank to the question. If yes (provide detail), “In the event that you are employed in the Public Service, will you immediately relinquish such business interest?”. Applicants may leave the following question blank if they are not in possession of such: “If your profession or occupation requires official registration, provide date and particulars of registration”. Noting there is limited space provided for Part E, F & G, applicants often indicate “refer to Curriculum Vitae (CV)” or “see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. It must be noted that a CV is an extension of the application for employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. The questions related to the conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered however applicants currently employed by the public service do not need to complete the section as it is intended for those seeking re-employment. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and to provide proof of such evaluation. Shortlisted candidates will be required to come for an interview, at which time, certified copies of all relevant qualifications, current registration with the relevant statutory body and copy of ID must be submitted. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One shall be a practical exercise and the other shall be integrity [ethical conduct] assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process . In terms of the Directive on the Implementation of Competency Based Assessments, Training & Development for Members of the Senior Management Services (SMS) in the Public Service, as amended. All Shortlisted candidates for the SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview .Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Assessment for core competencies outlined in the SMS handbook shall be conducted within one month of the appointment of the candidate. The Office shall communicate the logistics for the psychometric assessment to the candidate: Only recommended candidates for Senior Management Services (SMS) posts shall undergo psychometric assessment (Giotto, 15FQ+, and CPP assessment). Shortlisted candidates for the SMS posts will be required to submit SMS pre- entry certificate obtainable from National School of Government [https://thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entryprogramme/.]                  on appointment. Only the designated categories will disclose their financial interest in line with Regulation 16 (c),17 (2) & 18 (3) of the Public Service Regulation, 2016 as amended The Department of Health is an equal opportunity Employment Equity and Affirmative Action Employer. zu.title: Umndenankathula: Amasiko Abasebenzi kanye
zu.summary: Umndenankathula wamasebe asebenzi e-Limpopo Department of Health, uphatha izikhethwa, ukushiya umsebenzi, izintelezi zabasebenzi nokuphathwa kwe-HR kumagatsha amathathu esibhedlela.
zu.requirements: Izifundo nemihlando: Isitifikedi samabanga aphezulu senational/Matric plus NQF level 6 qualification in Human Resource Management /Public Admin/ Administration noma isifundo esilinganayo NQF Level 6 njengokuqashelwe yi-SAQA. Okungenani eminyaka yamathathu [3] imihlando enele kulelo izinga lokulawula kwamasiko abasebenzi noma ukuphathwa. Kumele kubekwe isiqinisekiso somqondo se-PERSAL futhi ukwazi ukusebenzisa izinhlelo ze-HR kahulumanti kubalulekile. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha okuhlanganisa i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint, nokwazi ukusebenzisa izinkundla zemicimbi yokuhlangana ngokuchofoza. Ilayisense evumelekile lokushayela ngaphandle kwalabo abanesimo sabantu. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngawo mthetho we-Public Service Act, 1994, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Labour Relations Act, nemiyalo ye-HR edingekile. Ukuqonda izinqubo zokubumba abantu, ukukhetha, ukumiswa, ukupheliswa, ukudluliselwa kanye nokwesekwa emmangweni kahulumanti. Ulwazi ngokusuka kwesimiso se-PERSAL nokuphathwa kwemininingwane ye-HR. Intuthuko ehubekayo yeziqu kumthetho we-HR. Ulwazi ngemikomelo yabasebenzi, indlu, okunikezwayo, ukushiya umsebenzi kanye nokuqondiswa kwe-overtime. Ulwazi ngemiyalo yezikhalazo, isoso, nezintelezi zabasebenzi. Ukuqonda izidingo zokuhlolwa nokuhambisana nezinqobo e-HR. Ukwazi okukhulu ngokuhlela abantu, ukulondoloza amarekhodi, nemiyalo yokubika.
zu.duties: Phetha ilusu elihambisana nemigomo esebenzayo. Lawula izikhethwa, ukupheliswa, ukudluliselwa kanye nokwesekwa. Lawula ukushiya umsebenzi kanye namakhomelo abasebenzi [Isinikelo, overtime, Indlu]. Nikeza inkuxeko yokuqondisa abasebenzi kanye nokuhambisana nezinqobo. Lawula izintelezi zabasebenzi. Lawula izinsiza [Ezomzimba neZabantu].

xh.title: Umsekeli weNgcamani: Amalungiselelo abaBasebenzi kunye
xh.summary: Umsekeli weNgcamani weMalungiselelo abaBasebenzi kwiSebe lezeMpilo iLimpopo, uphatha ukuqeshwa, iivenkile zomhlala, iindaba zobudlelwane basebenzi kunye nolawulo lwe-HR kumaziko amathathu esibhedlele.
xh.requirements: Iziqu kunye noQeqesho: I-Certificate yeziGqibo ezeNqanaba eliPhezulu leSizwe/Isiqingatha sika-12/ iMatric kunye nelayithensi-{} yomgangatho we-6 kwi-NQF kwiLawulo lweLungiselelo labaBasebenzi /uLawulo lweSizwe/ uLawulo okwelayithensi-{} ekweloNqanaba le-6 le-NQF njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Okona kncinci kwiminyaka elithatu [3] yamava ohleli kumanqanaba okuqonda amalungiselelo okwenza umsebenzi. Isitifikathi se-PERSAL培训/certificate may also be available for those interested. Ilatatwa isitifikati sokuzilolonga kwi-PERSAL /isitifikati kufuneka sibe nazo kunye nolwazi lwamakhulu we-HR karhulumente kubalulekile. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kuquka i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel kunye ne-PowerPoint, Ulwazi kumaplatfomu othungelwano ezingempela. Ilayisensi yokuqeshisa egunyazisiwe ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubekileyo. Ulwazi kunye neNtsebenzo: Ulwazi ngoMthetho weSebenza kaWiso-mthetho we-1994, uMthetho weSiseko seZiseko zokuQeshwa, uMthetho weeNdaba zoBudlelwane baBasebenzi, nezinye izikhululo ze-HR. Ukuqonda iindlela zokuqesha, ukhetho, ukuqeshwa, ukupheliswa, ukudlulisela nokubekwa komsebenzi kwicandelo likarhulumente. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yenkqubo ye-PERSAL nolawulo lwedata ye-HR. Intshukumbiso etshintshayo ekuphuhliseni ngamathambo ambalwa ngesiXhosa. Ulwazi ngamaxhathso abaBasebenzi, izindlu, iimalini ezongezelekileyo, iivenkile zomhlala kunye namacebo okulawula ihoure ezenza ngaphezu kwexesha. Ulwazi ngeendlela zokuphikisana, isohlwayo, neendaba zobudlelwane basebenzi. Ukuqonda iimfuno zokuphendula kwi-audit nokuthobela kwi-HR. Ukuqonda ukucwangcisa i-HR, ukulawula iirekhodi, kunye nemigaqo yokubika.
xh.duties: Ukuze kusebenze isicwangciso sehhasho ngokwamanqanaba amakhulu. Qokelela iindlela ezixubeneyo kunye neendlela ezingavunyelwanga ekubekeni abantu abatsha kwindalo ekucotywa kuyo imisebenzi. Lawula iivenkile zabasebenzi kunye namaxhaso abasebenzi [iimalini ezongezelekileyo, ihoure ezenza ngaphezu kwexesha, izindlu]. Nikezela ngokuxhasa koLawulo lweLungiselelo labaBasebenzi nokuthobela. Lawula iindaba zobudlelwane babasebenzi. Lawula izixhobo [eziZoBukhali nabaBasebenzi].

Ukuqeda ngempumelelo i-Immediate Life Support (ILS) ekuvumela ukuba ubhalise kwi-HPCSA njengomncedisi weAmbhulensi (AEA). I-Three [3] years’ experience ukuba ubhalise kwi-HPCSA njenge-ILS. Amakopi weziQendu nokubhalisa kwangoku kwi-HPCSA kufuneka afakelwe. Ukuzimisela ukwenza umsebenzi wemiyalelo yemiva nokuvela kumnxeba kuquka nomsebenzi weshifti. Ulwazi lokusebenzela ikhompyutha kuquka i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel ne-PowerPoint; Ulwazi kumthform wokudibana kwangaxeshanye. Ilayisensi yokuqesha esemthethweni [C1/ Code 10] ne-Professional Driving Permit for Passengers. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi lwemigaqo ye-ILS. Ukuqonda i-EMS nendlela yokusebenza. Amakhono obuhlalo nokuhamba nabantu abaqinisekisiweyo. Amakhono amahle okuthetha nokubhala. Ulwazi lo-Mthetho woLawulo lweMali ka-Pandic.
xh.duties: Ukulawula izithuthi, izixhobo nabasebenzi be-EMS kwinqanaba lesiteshi. Ukunyanga abagula ngokwemigaqo ehambisana nayo. Ukugcina iindlela ezilungileyo zokunyanga ngokwemilinganisyo yekhwalithi. Ukuhambisa nemigaqo egqithisiweyo yemisebenzi. IMIBUZO: Imibuzo jikelele ngeesithuba ezityhaliweyo kufuneka ithunyelwe kuMs Hlokoa RE Tel No: (015) 293 6406, uMs Mompei MM Tel No: (015) 293 6126 / uMs Sebake RL Tel No: (015) 293 6426, uMs Sebola MF Tel No: (015) 293 6002 noMs Mothiba JT Tel No: (015) 293 6329 ngexesha lamahora wemisebenzi.

jobs.title: Diagnostic Radiographer: Grade 1-2 (SHIFT)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R413 121 per annum Grade 2: R482 499 per annum plus 12% of basic salary PSCBC rural allowance. CENTRE             George Masebe Hospital (X1 Post) Sekororo Hospital (X1 Post) Donald Frazer Hospital (X1 Post)
jobs.summary: Diagnostic radiographers needed at Limpopo hospitals to operate imaging equipment, ensure patient safety and maintain departmental standards on shift.
jobs.requirements: Qualifications and Experience: A National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/Matric an appropriate qualification that allows a registration with the HPCSA as a Diagnostic Radiographer. Current registration with HPCSA as a Diagnostic Radiographer. Experience for Grade 1: Less than ten [10] years’ appropriate/recognisable experience after registration with the Health Professions Council [HPCSA] as Diagnostic Radiographer. Experience for Grade 2: Minimum of ten [10] years appropriate/recognisable experience after registration with the Health Professions Council [HPCSA] as Diagnostic Radiographer. Willingness and ability to work shifts / flexi hours [including night duty, weekends and public holidays]. Willingness to work extra hours on short notice. Knowledge And Skills: Thorough knowledge of Diagnostic Radiography techniques and protocols. Ability to work independently and in a team. Comprehensive knowledge of radiation protection, quality assurance and equipment safety. An understanding of public service procedures. Report writing skills. Good interpersonal relations. Computer literacy. Knowledge of Patient Archiving and Communication Systems and Radiology Information Systems in Regional and tertiary hospitals. An independent thinker and worker. Ability to work under pressure.
jobs.duties: Responsible for the smooth running of the department and professional services to patients. General care of patients and safety of patients. Produce images of high standards.
jobs.enquiries: General enquiries about the advertised posts should be directed to Ms Hlokoa RE Tel No: (015) 293 6406, Ms Mompei MM Tel No: (015) 293 6126 / Ms Sebake RL Tel No: (015) 293 6426, Ms Sebola MF Tel No: (015) 293 6002 and Ms Mothiba JT Tel No: (015) 293 6329 during office hours.
jobs.applications: The circular of advertised vacant posts will be posted on the following websites: https://erecruitment.limpopo.gov.za/, www.ldoh.gov.za, www.dpsa.gov.za and Provincial Department social media. Applicants must apply on the following website: https://erecruitment.limpopo.gov.za/
jobs.notes: NB: Ensure that you read the conditions and requirements of the post before you apply. Failure to comply with the instructions below will result in your application being disqualified. By applying, it is understood that you agree to the conditions and requirements of the post. Applicants are hereby invited from suitably qualified candidates for vacant posts in the Department of Health. Applications should include a fully completed new Z83 form obtainable from any government institution or at www.dpsa.gov.za and must be accompanied by a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae [CV]. Completion of Z83 Application Form: Online applications must include the only Curriculum Vitae [CV] in PDF as attachment. Zipped ,IMG and JPEG documents will not be accepted. The new Z83 form must be fully completed and signed up by the applicant. The following must be considered in relation to the completion of Z83 by applicants: All the fields in Part A, Part C and Part D must be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full except the following: South African applicants need not provide passport numbers. If an applicant responded “No” to the question “Are you conducting business with the State or are you a Director of a Public or Private company conducting business with the State? Then it is acceptable for an applicant to indicate ‘not applicable’ or leave blank to the question. If yes (provide detail), “In the event that you are employed in the Public Service, will you immediately relinquish such business interest?”. Applicants may leave the following question blank if they are not in possession of such: “If your profession or occupation requires official registration, provide date and particulars of registration”. Noting there is limited space provided for Part E, F & G, applicants often indicate “refer to Curriculum Vitae (CV)” or “see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. It must be noted that a CV is an extension of the application for employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. The questions related to the conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered however applicants currently employed by the public service do not need to complete the section as it is intended for those seeking re-employment. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and to provide proof of such evaluation. Shortlisted candidates will be required to come for an interview, at which time, certified copies of all relevant qualifications, current registration with the relevant statutory body and copy of ID must be submitted. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One shall be a practical exercise and the other shall be integrity [ethical conduct] assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process . In terms of the Directive on the Implementation of Competency Based Assessments, Training & Development for Members of the Senior Management Services (SMS) in the Public Service, as amended. All Shortlisted candidates for the SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview .Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Assessment for core competencies outlined in the SMS handbook shall be conducted within one month of the appointment of the candidate. The Office shall communicate the logistics for the psychometric assessment to the candidate: Only recommended candidates for Senior Management Services (SMS) posts shall undergo psychometric assessment (Giotto, 15FQ+, and CPP assessment). Shortlisted candidates for the SMS posts will be required to submit SMS pre- entry certificate obtainable from National School of Government [https://thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entryprogramme/.]                  on appointment. The cost for Nyukela is at the applicant ‘s own expense. Successful candidates will be expected to enter into performance agreement and sign oath of secrecy. Suitable candidate will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks [criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification and employment verification] Please note by responding to the advertisement, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). Your information will be used soley for the purpose of this promotion and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent unless required by law. The successful candidate falling within the designated categories for disclosure of financial interests will be required to disclose his/her financial interests in accordance with the applicable prescripts within 30 days of assumption of duty. Only the designated categories will disclose their financial interest in line with Regulation 16 (c),17 (2) & 18 (3) of the Public Service Regulation, 2016 as amended The Department of Health is an equal opportunity Employment Equity and Affirmative Action Employer. Females are encouraged to apply for posts at senior management level in order to address the Employment Equity targets within the Department. People with disabilities are encouraged to apply and correspondence will be entered into with shortlisted candidates only. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only due to the large number of applications we envisage to receive; and if you have not heard from us within ninety (90) days of the closing date, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are hereby advised to, within 90 days, request reasons from the Department for any administrative action which has adversely affected them in terms of section 5(1)(2) of the Promotion of Administrative Justice Act 3 of 2000.Kindly note that NO payment of any kind is required when applying for posts advertised in this circular. The Department reserves the right not to fill any advertised posts. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Diagnostiese Radiograaf: Graad 1-2 (SKOF)
af.summary: Diagnostiese radiograwe word by Limpopo-hospitale benodig om beeldtoerusting te bedryf, pasiëntveiligheid te verseker en departementele standaarde tydens skof te handhaaf.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies en Ervaring: 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/Grade 12/Matriek 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Diagnostiese Radiograaf toelaat. Huidige registrasie by HPCSA as 'n Diagnostiese Radiograaf. Ervaring vir Graad 1: Minder as tien [10] jaar se toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring na registrasie by die Health Professions Council [HPCSA] as Diagnostiese Radiograaf. Ervaring vir Graad 2: Minimum van tien [10] jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring na registrasie by die Health Professions Council [HPCSA] as Diagnostiese Radiograaf. Bereidwilligheid en vermoë om skofte / buigbare ure te werk [insluitend nagdiens, naweke en openbare vakansiedae]. Bereidwilligheid om ekstra ure op kort kennisgewing te werk. Kennis en Vaardighede: Deeglike kennis van Diagnostiese Radiografie-tegnieke en -protokolle. Vermoë om onafhanklik en in 'n span te werk. Omvattende kennis van stralingsbeskerming, gehalteversekering en toerustingveiligheid. 'n Begrip van staatsdiensprosedures. Verslagskryfvaardighede. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Kennis van Patient Archiving and Communication Systems en Radiology Information Systems in streeks- en tersiêre hospitale. 'n Onafhanklike denker en werker. Vermoë om onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Verantwoordelik vir die gladde verloop van die departement en professionele dienste aan pasiënte. Algemene sorg van pasiënte en veiligheid van pasiënte. Produseer beelde van hoë standaarde.

zu.title: Odokotela we-X-ray Eziyisibonakalise: Izinga 1-2 (ISHUFTI)
zu.summary: Badinga odokotela be-x-ray eziyisibonakalise ezibhalwe ngamabhethela ase-Limpopo ukusebenzisa izisetshenziswa zokuthwebula izithombe, ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabantu abagulayo kanye nokugcina amazinga womnyango ngeshafthi.
zu.requirements: Izifundo Nemfundo: I-National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/Matric noma isifundo esifanele esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengedokotela we-X-ray eziyisibonakalise. Ukubhalisa kwamanje kwi-HPCSA njengedokotela we-X-ray eziyisibonakalise. Isipiliyoni se-Grade 1: Ngaphansi kweminyaka eyishumi [10] yesipiliyoni esifanele/esihlonishwayo emva kokubhalisa kwi-Health Professions Council [HPCSA] njengedokotela we-X-ray eziyisibonakalise. Isipiliyoni se-Grade 2: Okungenani iminyaka eyishumi [10] yesipiliyoni esifanele/esihlonishwayo emva kokubhalisa kwi-Health Professions Council [HPCSA] njengedokotela we-X-ray eziyisibonakalise. Ukuzethemba kanye namandla okusebenza ngamashafthi / amahora aguquguqukayo [ahlanganisa ibusuku, amasonto nezikhathi zeholide]. Ukuzethemba ukusebenza amahora engeziwe ngokushesha. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi olujulile ngezindlela namaphrothokholi zedokotela we-X-ray eziyisibonakalise. Ukukwazi ukusebenza wedwa nakwisiqh team. Ulwazi olubanzi ngesivikelo sekhebula eliblzayo noma esilwelwe, ukuqinisekiswa kwekhwalithi nephepha kwezisetshenziswa. Ukuqonda izinqubo zomsebenzi kahulumeni. Amandla okubhala umbiko. Ubuhlobo obuhle nabantu. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngemishtemu yoku gcina izithombe abantu kanye namaphfuntini okuxhumana kumabhethela emikhakha kanye namabhethela abalinganiswa. Umuntu oqonde ngamande nobusebenza bodwa. Amandla okusebenza ngendabdaba.
zu.duties: Ubheke emisebenzini yokuhamba kahle komnyango kanye nensekelo yobuhlakela kwabah病患者. Ukunakekelwa okuvamile kwabahlinzeki nophepha ababhanthwe. Ukukhiqiza izithombe zobuhle obuhle.

xh.title: Isikhululi sezifundo esingeniso: Inqanaba 1-2 (SHIFT)
xh.summary: Kufuneka kubekho abasikhululi bezifundo ezingeniso kumazibuttle eLimpopo ukuba basebenzise izixhobo zokuthatha imifanekiso, baqiniseke ukhuseleko lwabagulayo kwaye bagcemale amazinga asebha ngelixa bethatha ishithi.
xh.requirements: Izifundo namava: Isatifikethi seZiko leSizwe/Grade 12/Matric, isifundo esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesikhululi sezifundo ezingeniso. Ukubhalisa kwangoku kwi-HPCSA njengesikhululi sezifundo ezingeniso. Amava elinqanaba 1: Ngaphantsi kweenyanga ezilishumi [10] zamava afanelekileyo/avakalisekayo emva kokubhalisa kwiBhunga leMisebenzi yeZempilo [HPCSA] njengesikhululi sezifundo ezingeniso. Amava elinqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beeNyanga ezilishumi [10] zamava afanelekileyo/avakalisekayo emva kokubhalisa kwiBhunga leMisebenzi yeZempilo [HPCSA] njengesikhululi sezifundo ezingeniso. Ukuzimisela nethuba lokusebenza iishithi / amagosa aguquguqukayo [kuquka nomsebenzi wabusuku, iiveki zokuphumla namhlanga ngamhlanga]. Ukuzimisela ukusebenza amagosa amaninzi ngemva yesithuba esimfutshane. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi oluchaziweyo ngamathodisi namaprotocol okubamba imifanekiso yokuxilongo. Ithuba lokusebenza eyedwa nakwisigqeba. Ulwazi olubanzi ngokhuseleko lwenyukliya, uqinisekiso lomgangatho nokhuseleko lwezixhobo. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zikonzo leziguqu. Amakhono okubala ingxelo. Imiganano elungileyo phakathi kwabantu. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngeendlela zokugcina iirekhodi zabagulayo kunye neendlela zokunxibelelwana kumazibuttle obume kunye nabantsondenkathathi. Umntu ocinga nasebenza eyedwa. Ithuba lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo.
xh.duties: Umntu oqwalaselwe kwindalo echanekileyo yesebe nkonzo yobugcisa kubagulayo. Unyango lwezonke lwabagulayo nokhuseleko lwabagulayo. Ukudala imifanekiso emazinga aphezulu.

jobs.summary: Optometrist position at Jane Furse Hospital in Limpopo requiring HPCSA registration, with two grade levels offering salaries from R413,121 to R482,499 per annum plus rural allowance.

Current registration with Health Professions Council of South Africa as Optometrist. Experience for Grade 1: None after registration with HPCSA as Optometrist. Experience for Grade 2: Minimum ten [10] years after registration with HPCSA as Optometrist. Computer literacy including MS Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint; Literacy in virtual meeting platforms. A thorough understanding of relevant legislation and policies related to the clinical support and rehabilitation professions. An understanding of public service financial procedures. Give expert advice of a specialist nature in the interpretation before action can be taken which includes the collection and analysis of patient data. Make recommendations with regard to policies/strategies for Optometry. Liaise with stakeholders on Optometry services, including NGOs and universities. Support and coordinate optometry services and professional development. Ensure the provision of optical and non-optical services to the institution.

af.title: Optometrist: Graad 1-2
af.summary: Optometrist-pos by Jane Furse Hospital in Limpopo wat HPCSA-registrasie vereis, met twee graadvlakke wat salarisse van R413,121 tot R482,499 per jaar plus landelike toelaag bied.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies en Ervaring: 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat /Grade 12/Matriek plus 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa [HPCSA] as Optometrist moontlik maak. Huidige registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as Optometrist. Ervaring vir Graad 1: Geen na registrasie by HPCSA as Optometrist nie. Ervaring vir Graad 2: Minimum tien [10] jaar na registrasie by HPCSA as Optometrist. Rekenaargeletterdheid insluitend MS Outlook, Word, Excel en PowerPoint; Geletterdheid in virtuele vergaderingsplatforms. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie behalwe vir persone met gestremdhede. Kennis en Vaardighede: Deskundige kennis in die funksionele veld van Optometrie. 'n Deeglike begrip van relevante wetgewing en beleide wat verband hou met die kliniese ondersteunings- en rehabilitasieprofessies. 'n Begrip van staatsdiens finansiële prosedures. Verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Goeie kommunikasie-, interpersoonlike verhoudings- en beplanningsvaardighede. 'n Vragende houding. 'n Onafhanklike denker en werker. Vermoë om onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Beveel en monitor begrotingsvlak aan. Opgradering en instandhouding van toerusting. Gee deskundige advies van 'n spesialisgeaardheid by die interpretasie voordat optrede geneem kan word wat die versameling en ontleding van pasiëntdata insluit. Oplossing van komplekse professionele en bestuursprobleme en beleidsake waardeur 'n verskeidenheid inligting ontleed word deur 'n wye reeks alternatiewe tot die mees geskikte oplossings/uitkomste te evalueer. Doen aanbevelings ten opsigte van beleide/strategieë vir Optometrie. Skakel met belanghebbendes oor Optometrie-dienste, insluitend NGO's en universiteite. Ondersteun en koördineer optometrie-dienste en professionele ontwikkeling. Verseker die voorsiening van optiese en nie-optiese dienste aan die instelling.

zu.title: I-Optometrist: I-Grade 1-2
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba ngu-Optometrist e-Jane Furse Hospital e-Limpopo esidinga ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA, ngamazinga amabili ohlola ngeholo eliqala ku-R413,121 kuya ku-R482,499 ngonyaka ohlanganise nenikelo yasemaphandleni.
zu.requirements: Izifundo nemfundo: I-National Senior Certificate /Grade 12/Matric ohlangene nesifundo esifanele esivumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengo-Optometrist. Ukuze ubhaliswe njengamanje ku-HPCSA njengo-Optometrist. Okufanele kube khona uma uzinga lokuqala: Akukho okufuneka emva kokuqinisekiswa ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengo-Optometrist. Okufanele kube khona uma uzinga lesibili: Okuncane iminyaka eyishumi ngemva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengo-Optometrist. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, kuhlanganise i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint; Ukusebenzisa izinkundla zokuhlangana eziku-inthanethi. Ilayisensi yokushayela eyavunyelwe ngaphandle kwabantu abaphila nokhubazekile. Ulwazi nobuhlule: Ulwazi olukhulu emkhakheni wokuOptometry. Ukuqonda kakuhle ngemithetho namanqubomgomo ahambisana nokusekelwa ngokwelapha nemisebenzi yokululama. Ukuqonda mayelana nemigudu yezimali yesevisi yomphakathi. Amakhono ebhala umbiko. Amakhono okuxhumana okuhle, ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu kanye nokuhlela. Isimo sokubuza imibuzo. Umuntu ocinga ngokwakhe futhi asebenze ngokwakhe. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo.
zu.duties: Ncoma futhi ulawule izinga lebhangete. Ukuthuthukiswa nokugcinwa kwemishini. Nikeza izeluleko ezithile zobuchwepheshe ekutolikweni ngaphambi kokuthi kuthathwe isinyathelo okuhlanganisa ukuqoqa nokuhlaziya idatha yeguli. Paxa izinkinga eziyinkimbinkimbi zobuchwepheshe nezobuphathi kanye nemibuzo yenqubomgomo lapho kuhlaziywa khona ulwazi oluhlukahlukene ngokuqonda osikhundleni osihlukahlukene ongathola izixazululo/iziphumelo ezinhle kakhulu. Yenza izincomo mayelana namanqubomgomo/amasu okuOptometry. Xhumana nalabo abehilelekile ezinsizakalweni zokuOptometry, okuhlanganisa i-NGOs namanyuvesi. Sekela futhi ulawule izinsizakalo zokuOptometry nentuthuko yobuchwepheshe. Qinisekisa ukubonezela izinsizakalo ezibonwayo nangezibonwayo esikhungweni.

xh.title: I-Optometrist: Inqanaba 1-2
xh.summary: Isithuba se-Optometrist kwi-Jane Furse Hospital eLimpopo esifuna ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA, namanqanaba amabini anika umvuzo oqala ngo-R413,121 ukuya ko-R482,499 ngonyaka ongaphezwa kweminyaka eyinkulungwane nemvuzo wasezweni.
xh.requirements: Izifundo nemiphefumlo: Isatifikedi seZwe iNqanaba eliPhakamileyo /Grade 12/Matric ongaphezwa kwesifundo esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njenge-Optometrist. Ukubhalisa okwangoku kwi-HPCSA njenge-Optometrist. Imiphefumlo yokuqala inqanaba 1: Akukho emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njenge-Optometrist. Imiphefumlo yokuqala inqanaba 2: Inani elingaphantsi kweshumi [10] leminyaka emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njenge-Optometrist. Ulwazi ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha olubandakanya i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel ne-PowerPoint; Ulwazi ngokusebenza iinkqubo zokudibana nge-intanethi. Ilayisensi yokushuka esebenzayo ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubekileyo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi olubanzi kwinkalo yokusebenza nge-Optometry. Ukuqonda okupheleleyo kwezomthetho neenkqubo ezinxulumene nokuxhaswa ngamathandabuzo nokuphinda kunyuselwe koomsebenzi. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zezimali zenkonzo yoluntu. Amakhono okubhala iingxelo. Amakhono obuncwethe bokuthetha nabantu, ukumelana nabantu nokucwangcisa. Imo yokubuza imibuzo. Umntu ocinga nokusebenza ngodwa. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcinezelo.
xh.duties: Icekisa ilungelelanise inqanaba lesibhgethi. Ukuphucula ukugcina izixhobo. Nikela ingcebiso entsundu yobuchwephetshe ekutolikweni ngaphambi kokuthatha isigqibo, equka kuqoqosho lolwazi lwesigulane. Sombulula iingxaki zobuchwephetshe nokulawula ezingaqondakaliyo kunye neendaba zenkqubo ezinxulumene neenkqubo ezahlukeneyo zolwazi ezihlaziweyo kwindlela ezahlukeneyo eziya kwisiphumo/impendulo. Nikela ngeengcebiso ngendlela zokulawula iinkqubo/iindlela zokuqhuba i-Optometry. Qhagamshelana namalungu ebandla kwiinkonzo ze-Optometry, kuquka i-NGOs kunye neeyunivesithi. Xhasa ilungelelanise iinkonzo ze-Optometry ukuphucula ulwazi lobuchwephetshe. Qinisekisa ukwabiwa kweenkonzo ezibonakalayo ezingabonakaliyo kule ndlu.

jobs.title: Occupational Therapist: Grade 1 –2
jobs.centre: WF Knobel Hospital (X1 Post) Botlokwa Hospital (X1 Post) Tshilidzini Hospital (X1 Post)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R413 121 per annum Grade 2: R482 499 per annum plus 12% of basic salary PSCBC Rural Allowance.
jobs.summary: Occupational Therapist Grade 1 to 2 positions at three Limpopo hospitals, requiring HPCSA registration, with a rural allowance.
jobs.requirements: Qualifications and Experience: A National Senior Certificate/Grade 12 /Matric plus an appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa [HPCSA] as Occupational Therapist. Current registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa [HPCSA] as Occupational Therapist. Experience for Grade 1: None after registration with the Health Professions Council [HPCSA] as an Occupational Therapist. Experience for Grade 2: Minimum of ten [10] years appropriate/recognisable experience after registration with the Health Professions Council [HPCSA] as Occupational Therapist. Computer literacy including MS Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint; Literacy in virtual meeting platforms. A valid driver's license except for people with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Candidate should have a sound knowledge of general Occupational Therapy principles. Candidates should have a sound knowledge and application of clinical theory, practice and ethics relating to the delivery of Occupational Therapy services. Adhere to provincial, hospital and departmental policies, procedures and regulations. Knowledge of public service legislation, PFMA, policies and procedure. Candidate must have good verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work independently and in a multidisciplinary context. Demonstrate effective interpersonal skills, strategic planning, organizational skills, leadership qualities and supervisory skills. Ability to work under pressure.
jobs.duties: Render Occupational Therapy services that comply with standards and Norms in the hospital and community setting. Candidate will be expected to render Occupational Therapy service in adherence to the scope of practice and health protocols. Render effective patient centered Occupational Therapy services in the hospital, community and outreach services to schools, ECD centres, special schools and old age homes. Compilation of daily and monthly statistics and reports using available departmental tools. Participate in Continuous professional development. Carry out delegated duties by supervisor or manager. Participate in student training and supervision. Participate in Quality Assurance Audits. Exercise care with all consumables and equipment. Manage allocated Resources. Participate in promoting and marketing Occupational Therapy.
jobs.enquiries: General enquiries about the advertised posts should be directed to Ms Hlokoa RE Tel No: (015) 293 6406, Ms Mompei MM Tel No: (015) 293 6126 / Ms Sebake RL Tel No: (015) 293 6426, Ms Sebola MF Tel No: (015) 293 6002 and Ms Mothiba JT Tel No: (015) 293 6329 during office hours.
jobs.applications: The circular of advertised vacant posts will be posted on the following websites: https://erecruitment.limpopo.gov.za/, www.ldoh.gov.za, www.dpsa.gov.za and Provincial Department social media. Applicants must apply on the following website: https://erecruitment.limpopo.gov.za/
jobs.notes: NB: Ensure that you read the conditions and requirements of the post before you apply. Failure to comply with the instructions below will result in your application being disqualified. By applying, it is understood that you agree to the conditions and requirements of the post. Applicants are hereby invited from suitably qualified candidates for vacant posts in the Department of Health. Applications should include a fully completed new Z83 form obtainable from any government institution or at www.dpsa.gov.za and must be accompanied by a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae [CV]. Completion of Z83 Application Form: Online applications must include the only Curriculum Vitae [CV] in PDF as attachment. Zipped ,IMG and JPEG documents will not be accepted. The new Z83 form must be fully completed and signed up by the applicant. The following must be considered in relation to the completion of Z83 by applicants: All the fields in Part A, Part C and Part D must be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full except the following: South African applicants need not provide passport numbers. If an applicant responded “No” to the question “Are you conducting business with the State or are you a Director of a Public or Private company conducting business with the State? If yes (provide detail), “In the event that you are employed in the Public Service, will you immediately relinquish such business interest?”. Applicants may leave the following question blank if they are not in possession of such: “If your profession or occupation requires official registration, provide date and particulars of registration”. Noting there is limited space provided for Part E, F & G, applicants often indicate “refer to Curriculum Vitae (CV)” or “see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. It must be noted that a CV is an extension of the application for employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. The questions related to the conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered however applicants currently employed by the public service do not need to complete the section as it is intended for those seeking re-employment. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and to provide proof of such evaluation. Shortlisted candidates will be required to come for an interview, at which time, certified copies of all relevant qualifications, current registration with the relevant statutory body and copy of ID must be submitted. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One shall be a practical exercise and the other shall be integrity [ethical conduct] assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process . In terms of the Directive on the Implementation of Competency Based Assessments, Training & Development for Members of the Senior Management Services (SMS) in the Public Service, as amended. All Shortlisted candidates for the SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview .Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Assessment for core competencies outlined in the SMS handbook shall be conducted within one month of the appointment of the candidate. The Office shall communicate the logistics for the psychometric assessment to the candidate: Only recommended candidates for Senior Management Services (SMS) posts shall undergo psychometric assessment (Giotto, 15FQ+, and CPP assessment). Shortlisted candidates for the SMS posts will be required to submit SMS pre- entry certificate obtainable from National School of Government [https://thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entryprogramme/.]                  on appointment. Only the designated categories will disclose their financial interest in line with Regulation 16 (c),17 (2) & 18 (3) of the Public Service Regulation, 2016 as amended The Department of Health is an equal opportunity Employment Equity and Affirmative Action Employer. af.title: Arbeidsterapeut: Graad 1 –2
af.summary: Arbeidsterapeut Graad 1 tot 2 poste by drie Limpopo-hospitale, wat HPCSA-registrasie vereis, met 'n landlike toelaag.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies en Ervaring: 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/Grade 12 /Matric plus 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa [HPCSA] as Arbeidsterapeut moontlik maak. Huidige registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa [HPCSA] as Arbeidsterapeut. Ervaring vir Vlak 1: Geen na registrasie by die Health Professions Council [HPCSA] as 'n Arbeidsterapeut nie. Ervaring vir Vlak 2: Minimum van tien [10] jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring na registrasie by die Health Professions Council [HPCSA] as Arbeidsterapeut. Rekenaarvaardigheid insluitend MS Outlook, Word, Excel en PowerPoint; Vaardigheid in virtuele vergaderingsplatforms. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie behalwe vir persone met gestremdhede. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kandidaat behoort oor 'n deeglike kennis van algemene Arbeidsterapie-beginsels te beskik. Kandidate behoort oor 'n deeglike kennis en toepassing van kliniese teorie, praktyk en etiek rakende die lewering van Arbeidsterapie-diensste te beskik. Hou by provinsiale, hospital- en departementele beleide, prosedures en regulasies. Kennis van openbare diens-wetgewing, PFMA, beleide en prosedures. Kandidaat moet oor goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede beskik. Vermoë om onafhanklik en in 'n multidissiplinêre konteks te werk. Toon effektiewe interpersoonlike vaardighede, strategiese beplanning, organisatoriese vaardighede, leierskapskwaliteite en toesighoudende vaardighede. Vermoë om onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Lewer Arbeidsterapie-diensste wat voldoen aan standaarde en Norme in die hospital en gemeenskapsopset. Kandidaat sal verwag word om Arbeidsterapie-diens te lewer in ooreenstemming met die omvang van praktyk en gesondheidsprotokolle. Lewer effektiewe pasiëntgesentreerde Arbeidsterapie-diensste in die hospital, gemeenskap en uitreikdiensste aan skole, ECD-sentra, spesiale skole en oudertydhuise. Samestelling van daaglikse en maandelikse statistieke en verslae met behulp van beskikbare departementele gereedskap. Neem deel aan deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling. Voer gedelegeerde pligte deur toesighouer of bestuurder uit. Neem deel aan studente-opleiding en toesig. Neem deel aan Kwaliteitsversekeringsoudits. Oefen sorg uit met alle verbruiksgoedere en toerusting. Bestee toegekende hulpbronne. Neem deel aan die bevordering en bemarking van Arbeidsterapie.

jobs.title: Physiotherapist: Grade 1-2
jobs.centre: Lebowakgomo Hospital (X1 Post) Seshego Hospital (X1 Post) St. Ritas Hospital (X1 Post)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R413 121 per annum Grade 2: R482 499 per annum plus 12% of basic salary PSCBC Rural Allowance
jobs.summary: Physiotherapist Grade 1-2 positions at three Limpopo hospitals requiring HPCSA registration, offering rural allowance.
jobs.requirements: Qualifications and Experience: A National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/Matric plus an appropriate qualification that allows a registration with the HPCSA as Physiotherapist. Current registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa [HPCSA] as Physiotherapist. Experience for Grade 1: None after registration with the Health Professions Council [HPCSA] as Physiotherapist. Experience for Grade 2: Minimum of ten [10] years appropriate/recognisable experience after registration with the Health Professions Council [HPCSA] as Physiotherapist. Inherent requirement of the job: Manage and coordinate physiotherapy services in critical care units and wards. Willingness to work night shifts, weekends and public holidays. Inherent requirements of the job: Computer literacy including MS Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint; Literacy in virtual meeting platforms. Knowledge And Skills: Thorough knowledge of physiotherapy. Ability to work independently. Ability to work under pressure and in an intensive care environment. Ability to work in an infectious area and practice infection control to protect patients, other health workers and oneself from infection. An understanding of public service procedures. Report writing skills. Good interpersonal relations.
jobs.duties: Responsible for professional services to patients. General care of patients and safety of patients.
jobs.enquiries: General enquiries about the advertised posts should be directed to Ms Hlokoa RE Tel No: (015) 293 6406, Ms Mompei MM Tel No: (015) 293 6126 / Ms Sebake RL Tel No: (015) 293 6426, Ms Sebola MF Tel No: (015) 293 6002 and Ms Mothiba JT Tel No: (015) 293 6329 during office hours.

af.title: Fisioterapeut: Graad 1-2
af.summary: Fisioterapeut Graad 1-2 posisies by drie Limpopo hospitale wat HPCSA-registrasie vereis, met 'n landelike toelaag.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies en Ervaring: 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/Grade 12/Matriek plus 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie met die HPCSA as Fisioterapeut moontlik maak. Huidige registrasie met die Health Professions Council of South Africa [HPCSA] as Fisioterapeut. Ervaring vir Graad 1: Geen na registrasie met die Health Professions Council [HPCSA] as Fisioterapeut. Ervaring vir Graad 2: Minimum van tien [10] jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring na registrasie met die Health Professions Council [HPCSA] as Fisioterapeut. Inherente vereiste van die pos: Bestuur en koördineer van fisioterapiedienste in kritieke sorgeenhede en saale. Bereidwilligheid om nagskofte, naweke en openbare vakansiedae te werk. Inherente vereistes van die pos: Rekenaarvaardigheid insluitend MS Outlook, Word, Excel en PowerPoint; Geletterdheid in virtuele vergaderingsplatforms. Kennis en Vaardighede: Deeglike kennis van fisioterapie. Vermoë om onafhanklik te werk. Vermoë om onder druk en in 'n intensiewe sorgomgewing te werk. Vermoë om in 'n aansteeklike area te werk en infeksiebeheer toe te pas om pasiënte, ander gesondheidswerkers en oneself teen infeksie te beskerm. 'n Begrip van openbare diensprosedures. Verslagskryfvaardighede. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings.
af.duties: Verantwoordelik vir professionele dienste aan pasiënte. Algemene sorg van pasiënte en veiligheid van pasiënte.

zu.title: Umunyenti wezokwelapha ngokunyakaza: Izinga 1-2
zu.summary: Izikhundla zomunyenti wezokwelapha ngokunyakaza Izinga 1-2 emitholamphila emithathu yaseLimpopo ezidinga ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA, futhi inikeza isabelo sendawo yasemaphandleni.
zu.requirements: Iziqu nokuqeqeshwa: Isitifikedi Seziqu Eziphakeme Zesifunda/Izinga 12/Imatriki kahle ngesiqu esifanele esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengomunyenti wezokwelapha ngokunyakaza. Ukubhaliswa kwamanje kwi-HPCSA njengomunyenti wezokwelapha ngokunyakaza. Ukuqeqeshwa koqobo nolwazi nge-Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekayo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengomunyenti wezokwelapha ngokunyakaza. Ukuqeqeshwa koqobo nolwazi nge-Izinga 2: Uqobo lolwazi olungu-10 [10] eminyakeni ngemva kokubhaliwa emtholampilo njengomunyenti wezokwelapha ngokunyakaza. Izidingo eziphathelene nomsebenzi: Lawula futhi uhleze imisebenzi yezokwelapha ngokunyakaza emayunithi ezokunakekelwa ezinkethembi nasezalini. Ukuthanda ukusebenza ngababili bayo ekugcineni, njalo ngezinsuku zokuphumula. Izidingo eziphathelene nomsebenzi: Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha okuhlanganisa i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel ne-PowerPoint; Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa izinkundla zoxhumo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi olujulile ngezokwelapha ngokunyakaza. Ukukwazi ukusebenza kwakho. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngaphezu kwesidingo kanti nakwindawo ezokunakekelwa ezinkethembi. Ukukwazi ukusebenza endaweni ezithulelwana futhi ukwenza izindlela zokuvikela isifo ukuze uvikele abaguli, abasebenzi bezempilo nabanye. Ukuqonda izindlela zokusebenza kwesevisi yomphakathi. Amakhono okubhala okubikezelwayo. Ubuhlobo obuhle nabantu.
zu.duties: Ubhekele ukunakekela ngokuchwepheshe abaguli. Ukunakekelwa okuvamile kwabaguli nokuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabaguli.

xh.title: Umsebenzi wePhysiotherapy: Inqanaba 1-2
xh.summary: Izithuba zomsebenzi wePhysiotherapy Inqanaba 1-2 kumaspitala amathathu eLimpopo afuna ukubhaliswa kwiHPCSA, enikezela ngesembozo zasemaphandleni.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo nolwazi: Isatifikethi seSizwe sePhezulu/Inqanaba 12/iMatric kwaye nafomathi efanelekileyo evumela ukubhaliswa kwiHPCSA njengoPhysiotherapist. Ukubhaliswa okwangoku kwiBhunga leMisebenzi yezeMpilo eMzantsi Afrika [HPCSA] njengoPhysiotherapist. Ulwazi lweInqababa 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka elishumi [10] yolwazi olufanelekileyo/olusayinisekayo emva kokubhaliswa kwiBhunga leMisebenzi yezeMpilo [HPCSA] njengoPhysiotherapist. Iimfuno zangaphakathi zesithuba: Ulwazi lokusebenza ngemeyile kubandakanya iMS Outlook, Word, Excel nePowerPoint; Ulwazi kumaplatifom zoxumba lweentlanganiso ezikwi-intanethi. Ikhono lokusebenza kwindawo ethathu iimveliso ezikhoyo kwaye uzilolule ukuqinisekisa ukuthintela abantu, oonyeziweyo beempilo nokuzigcina ukungahoywa isifo. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zophatho koluntu. zu.title: Umdwebi Wezithombe: Izinsizakusebenza Zokuxhumana
zu.summary: Kufunwa Umdwebi Wezithombe osebenzela KwaLimpopo Umnyango Wezempilo ePolokwane ukuba adweba izinto zokuxhumana futhi anikeze ukwesekwa kwabaphathi.
zu.requirements: Izifundo neminyuzo: Isitifiketi Se-National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/Matric kanye nesidanga se-NQF level 6 ekudwebeni kwezithombe, Eokuxhumana Okubonakalayo, noma okulinganayo ezingeni le-NQF Level 6 njengoba kuhlonzwa yi-South African Qualification Authority. Uminyuzo eminyaka yoku-2 wamava ohambisana nokudweba kwezithombe. Ukugqama ekusebenziseni i-Adobe Creative Suite noma eminye imikhiqizo ekudwebeni yobungcweti ebonisa amava ohambisayo kuzodingeka kuhlelo lokuxoxiswana. Ukugqama ekusebenziseni ikhompuyutha kwi-Ms Outlook, Work, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint; kanye namasimu okuhlangana kwabanikelayo. Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile Ulwazi namakhono: Izimiso nezindlela zokudweba izithombe, ukuxhumana okubonakalayo nokuphatha uphawu lobuchwepheshe: Isoftware ekudwebeni yobungcweti okuhlanganisa i-Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop) namanye amasimu alinganayo. Inqubo yokukhiqiza izintambo kuhlanganise okungeni phambi kokushicilelwa, ukuphela kokushicilelwa nokukhiqiza ngokuhlelo okukhulu. Ukukhiqiza okuwukanikhasi nge-Intanethi, kwabanikelayo bokusonjulula, nakumasu okuvela nge-imeyili. Izinga le-GCIS Visual Identity Standards nemihlahlandlela yokuxhumana kahulumeni. Amazinga okufinyeleleka ekudwebeni ukuxhumana okubonakalayo. Izimiso ezisisekelo zokuqamba izinhlelo futhi kuhlelwe ukukhiqiza. Inqubo yophatho lwesonto samabhxelo esebenza ekuthengeni izinsizakusebenza zokushicilela nokudweba. Umthetho ohambisana nezinsizakhalomphakaba okuhlanganisa uMthetho Womphakaba, 1994, Izinhlelo Zomthetho Womphakaba, 2016 noMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyeleleka Kolwazi. Ukugqama okuphezulu ekusebenziseni isoftware ekudwebeni izithombe yobungcweti. Ukudweba ukubhekiswe phansi nokuhlela isigaba. Ukuphatha ukubonakala okubonakalayo nokuhambisana nephawu lobuchwepheshe. Ukuphatha ukukhiqiza kokushicilelwa nokungakanikhasi. Ukucubungula amaphulo nokuphatha izinsuku eziyisikhathi. Ukuqaphela imininingwaneokuqinisekiswa ikhwalithi. Ukubhaliwe nokuxhumana ngomlomo. Ukuhlangana nabahumelelebe nokuba namakhono okuxhumana nomuntu. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokucabanga ngokudweba. Ulwazi nokuphatha imirekhodi Izimpawu zabantu: Ukuziphatha ngobungcweti nokuziphatha kahle. Ukumakaneka nokuyiqaphela imininingwane. Ukucabanga ngokudweba nokuba yinto entsha. Ikono lokusebenza ngabanye nangaphakathi kwethimba. Ukuguquguquka nokuzenzela ngesikhathi esinengcindezi. Indlela yokusebenza ngokubambisana ngokwethimba. Ukuzibophezela ekufundeni nasekokuthuthuka
zu.duties: Ukudweba zonke izinto ezishicilelwayo nezokuxhumana: Ukwenza ucwaningo lwabezindaba futhi ugcine ukuya phambili nokudweba nezinhlelo zesoftware. Ukweluleka abaphathi ngezindlela ezisebenzayo zokudweba izinto zokuxhumana. Ukunika inkonzo yokwesekwa abaphathi

xh.summary: Kufuneka angummlili wokuLinganisa iinovisi eziBonakalayo kwiSebe lezeMpilo loMphondo waLimpopo ePolokwane ukuyila izinto zoxibelelwano kunye nokunika inkxaso yolawulo.

Ukuziqonda kakuhle kwi-Adobe Creative Suite okanye naliphi na isoftware yobugcisa ekufaneka ukubonisa amava afanelekileyo kuya kufuneka kudliwano-ndlebe. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwi-Ms Outlook, Word, Excel, ne-PowerPoint; nakuwo onke amaqonga eendibano ezikwi-intanethi..Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba egqithisiweyo ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubekileyo Ulwazi nobuchule: Iimvisiswano nendlela zokulinganisa iinovisi ezibonakalayo, uNxibelelwano ngokuBonakalayo kunye nokulawula uphawu lwentslowano: Isoftware yobugcisa yezomsebenzi kubandakanya i-Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop) nokuqonga okulingana nayo. Iinkqubo zokuvelisa ezishicilelwayo kubandakanya i-pre-press, ukugqiba ukushicilela kunye nokuvelisa ngefomathi enkulu. Ukuvelisa okuqukiweyo kwi-web, entlakasasa nakwiinkqubo zoxibelelwano nge-imeyile. Izinga leGCIS lemmo wokuBonakalayo ngokuBonakalayo nemiQathango yokuxibelelana karhulumente. Izinga lokufikeleleka ekulinganisweni kweenovisi ezibonakalayo. Iimvisiswano eziyisisiseko zolawulo lwamaphulo nokuqwalasela ukwenziwa kwemisebenzi. Iinkqubo zolawulo lweenkonzo zokuqokelelwa kwabakhi kunye neenkonzo zokulinganisa nokushicilela. Umthetho ofanelekileyo wesebe lomanyano karhulumente kuquka uMthetho woManyano kaRhulumente ka-1994, iMigaqo yoManyano kaRhulumente ka-2016 noMthetho wokuPhuthaza uFikelelo kwIinkcukacha. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi olujulile nolulungele mayelana nemithetho, izindlela kanye nokuqonda uhlelo lomthetho oluphethe Imisebenzi Yomphakathi. Ukugada Imisebenzi Yokuphatha Nokwabela Umsebenzi. Ukusebenza Kahle Ngokobuchwepheshe. Ukuvumelana Nomthetho Nokuqonda Ukuphathwa Komphakathi. Ukucubungula Nokuhlela. Ukugcina Ukulunga Nokuthembeka Kwekhwalithi. Ukucophelela Ngemali Nokunamba Kumanani. Ukuphatha Abantu Nokugcina Isiyalezwe. Amakhono Okuxhumana Nokuhlobana Nabantu. Ukuxazulula Izinkinga. Ukuphatha Ulwazi Namaphathi. Izici Zomuntu: Ikono lokuxhumana namabhisi, ababusi abaphezulu, abasemthethweni kanye nomphakathi ngendlela eprofessional. Ikono lokusebenza ngabanye nangaphakathi kwethimba. Ubuhle bokuhlobana nabantu. Ikono lokusebenza nabantu abanzima nokuxazulula izinkinga. Inzwelo yomthwalo kanye nokuzithoba. Ukungabuki ngamehlo. Ukuzithiba. Ukuba Nolwazi Ngokukhonzwa Komphakathi. Ukuzigcina. Inzwelo enkulu yokuthembeka. Ukuvikelwa kokungakhululeki kwamaphathi.
zu.duties: Nikela nesevisi yokusekela ekuphathweni kwezinto. Misela futhi ulondoloze uhlelo olusebenzayo lokulawula imibhalo. Hlela, qaphela futhi uphathe imisebenzi yokuphathwa kwezinto ehlobene nemisebenzi yezemisebenzi yabantu. Hlela uphathe imisebenzi ehlobene nochungechunge lwezinsiza yonqenqema.

xh.title: Iofisa yolawulo: Iofisi likaMongameli oNgunya: iNqubo
xh.summary: Iofisa yolawulo elinceda uMongameli oNgunya: iNqubo kwiOfisi yoPhondo iLimpopo, elilawula unxibelelwano, imisebenzi engqondweni yabasebenzi noshishino lokuhambisa impahla.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zobungcalu nemipilo yomsebenzi: Isatifikethi senqanaba eliphezulu lesizwe/Umphakamo 12/Isidanga somatikhetshi ngenqanaba lesi-6 le-NQF kwizifundo ze-Secretarial /Office Management/Management Assistant okanye isidanga esilingana nalenqanaba lesi-6 le-NQF njengoko kvunywe yi-South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Minyaka emi-2 [2] yamava kulawulo leofisi. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kuquka i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel ne-PowerPoint; Ulwazi kumaplatifomu oonxibelelwano abakwi-Intanethi. Ukuzimisela ukusebenza iiresi ezongezelelweyo ngexesha elifutshane. Ilayisensi yokuqhayisa egunya ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekileyo. Ulwazi nobuchule: Ulwazi olubanzi nolunjalo ngemithetho, iinkqubo nakuqonda kwisiseko somthetho esilawula inkonzo kaRhulumade. Ukuqonda ukulawula imisebenzi nokwaba umsebenzi. Ubuchule obusebenzayo ngenkqubo. Ukuhambelana nolawulo. Uplani nokuhlela. Ukuqinisekisa izinga kwaye ulawule. Uchanekilelo kumali namanani. Ukulawula abantu nobuyalo. Unxibelelwano nolwazi lokusebenza nabantu. Ukuxazulula iingxaki. Ulwazi nolawulo lwerikhowudi iimpawu zobuntu: Ikhono lokunxibelelana nakuwo onke amaziko, abaphathi abaphezulu, abasebenzi bomphakathi ngokusemthethweni nangobubele. Ukwenzelwa abantu. Ukuqonda ngokuzimela. Indyikitya enkulu yokuzithembeka Ukhusela imfihlo kwamaxwebhu.
xh.duties: Kha uncedo lolawulo. Misela zigqibe kwaye uzigcine inkqubo yokulawula iingxelo kunye nexesha. Qhoboshelo, ulawule kwaye ulawule imisebenzi yabasebenzi kwindawo yolawulo. Qhoboshela kwaye ulawule uchaini wokusetyenziswa koluhlu nemisebenzi ehlobene nayo kwicandelo.

jobs.title: State Accountant (EXPENDITURE and Accounts)
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 per annum (Level 07) CENTRE             Witpoort Hospital
jobs.summary: State Accountant at Witpoort Hospital in Limpopo handling salary and expenditure management, requiring Grade 12 plus NQF level 6 and two years' finance experience.
jobs.requirements: Qualifications and Experience: A National Senior Certificate /Grade 12/Matric plus NQF level 6 qualification at NQF level 6 as recognised by the South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. A minimum of two [2] years’ experience in salary and expenditure management / various disciplines related to financial management. Computer literacy including MS Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint; Literacy in virtual meeting platforms. A valid driver's license except for people with disabilities Knowledge and Skills: An understanding of public sector financial administration and the prescription / provision of PFMA and Treasury Regulations. Good Understanding of BAS, Finest and other financial systems. Well-developed communication skills / interpersonal relations. Thorough understanding of public sector revenue collection processes.
jobs.duties: Ensure compliance with payment of suppliers within 30 days. Perform monthly reconciliation of invoice registers. Manage creditors related accruals and payables. Manage salary related accruals and payables. Ensure that all claims are processed within prescribed timelines. Responsible for Salary Administration services. Prepare documents for audit readiness purposes. Perform monthly creditors reconciliation. Enforce compliance to the acts, regulations, procedures and other directives. Attend to Internal and external auditors. Compile relevant reports.
jobs.enquiries: General enquiries about the advertised posts should be directed to Ms Hlokoa RE Tel No: (015) 293 6406, Ms Mompei MM Tel No: (015) 293 6126 / Ms Sebake RL Tel No: (015) 293 6426, Ms Sebola MF Tel No: (015) 293 6002 and Ms Mothiba JT Tel No: (015) 293 6329 during office hours.

af.title: Staatrekenmeester (BESTEDING en Rekenings)
af.summary: Staatrekenmeester by Witpoort Hospital in Limpopo wat salaris- en bestuursbestuur behartig, met 'n vereiste van Graad 12 plus NQF level 6 en twee jaar se finansiële ervaring.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies en Ervaring: 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat /Grade 12/Matriek plus 'n NQF level 6 kwalifikasie op NQF level 6 soos erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. 'n Minimum van twee [2] jaar se ervaring in salaris- en bestuursbestuur / verskeie dissiplines verwant aan finansiële bestuur. Rekenaargeletterdheid insluitend MS Outlook, Word, Excel en PowerPoint; Geletterdheid in virtuele vergaderingsplatforms. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie behalwe vir persone met gestremdhede Kennis en Vaardighede: 'n Begrip van openbare-sektor finansiële administrasie en die voorskrifte / bepalings van PFMA en Treasury Regulations. Goeie begrip van BAS, Finest en ander finansiële stelsels. Goed ontwikkelde kommunikasievaardighede / interpersoonlike verhoudings. Deeglike begrip van openbare-sektor inkomste-insameling prosesse.
af.duties: Verseker nakoming van betaling aan verskaffers binne 30 dae. Voer maandelikse rekonsiliasie van faktuurregisters uit. Bestuur skuldeisersverwante toekoms en betaalbaarhede. Bestuur salarisverwante toekoms en betaalbaarhede. Verseker dat alle eise binne voorgeskrewe tydlyne verwerk word. Verantwoordelik vir Salarisadministrasiedienste. Berei dokumente voor vir ouditgereedheid. Voer maandelikse skuldeisersrekonsiliasie uit. Handhaaf nakoming van die wette, regulasies, prosedures en ander richtlyne. Spreek interne en eksterne ouditeure. Stel tersaaklike verslae op.

zu.title: Isikhundla sikaFakhiwe esikhungweni sikaHulumeni (Izimali ezikhishiwayo neza-Akhawunti)
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaFakhiwe esikhungweni sikaHulumeni esibhedlela i-Witpoort Hospital e-Limpopo, okuphatwa kuso ukulawula kweholo nezimali ezikhishiwayo, kudingeka ibe khona ibanga le-Grade 12 kanye nezinga le-NQF level 6 kanye neminyaka emibili yokuhlangabezana komsebenzi wezimali.
zu.requirements: Izifundo kanye nokuhlangabezana: Isitifiketi Samabanga Aphakeme Sezwe / ibanga le-Grade 12 / i-Matric kanye nesifundo sezinga le-NQF level 6 njengoba kuhlonzwa yi-South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Ukwaziswa okuncane kweminyaka emibili [2] yeminyaka yokuhlangabezana ekulawulweni kweholo nezimali ezikhishiwayo / izigaba ezahlukene ezihlotshaniswa nokulawulwa kwezimali. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha okuhlanganisa i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint; Ulwazi lokusebenzisa amapulatifomu emihlangano yamavidiyo. Ilayisense yokushayela elisebenzayo ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile. Ulwazi kanye namakhono: Ukuqonda ukuphatwa kwezimali kwesikhungo sikaHulumeni kanye nemiyalo / izinhlaka ye-PFMA kanye nezoKuyalela ze-Treasury Regulations. Ukuqonda kahle i-BAS, i-Finest kanye nezinye izimiso zezimali. Amakhono okuxhumana ahlotshaniswe kahle / izimo zokuxhumana nabantu. Ukuqonda okujulile izinqubo zokuqoqa imali esikhungweni sikaHulumeni.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nokukhokha abakhiqizayo ngaphakathi kwezinsuku ezingama-30. Yenza ukuqondanisa kwanyanga zonke kubhaliswe izikweletu. Lawula izikweletu ezihlotshaniswa nezinto ezibekwe ibhajajili nezokukhokhwa. Lawula izikweletu ezihlotshaniswa neholo nezinto ezibekwe ibhajajili nezokukhokhwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izimangalela ziqashelwa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esishiwo. Uxhomeke ekunikezweni amasevisi okulawula iholo. Lungela amadokhonda okulungele ukwenziwa okuhlolwayo. Yenza ukuqondaniswa kwanyanga zonke kwabakhiqizayo. Phoqa ukuthi kuhlonelwe umthetho, izimiso, izinqubo kanye nezinye iziyalezo. Phendula abahlolwayo bangothile nababangaphandle. Hlela imibiko edingekayo.

xh.title: IsiNgqongoshe sehlelo kabhaso (I-RHEXABHO nee-Akhawunti)
xh.summary: IsiNgqongoshe sehlelo kabhaso esibhedlele i-Witpoort Hospital e-Limpopo esinonakele ngokulawula umvuzo nentlawulo, kufuneka ibe nesifundo seNqanaba le-12 kunye ne-NQF level 6 kunye neminyaka emi-2 yamava kwezimali.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zamagqabo namava: Isatifikethi i-National Senior Certificate / Grade 12 / Matric kwakunye nelifikeshini le-NQF level 6 kwinqanaba le-NQF level 6 njengoko kubonwa yi-South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Amava abuncinane eminyaka yamathandathu [2] kulawulo lwemivuzo nentlawulo / izinto ezahlukeneyo ezinxulumene nokulawulwa kwezimali. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kuquka i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel ne-PowerPoint; Ulwazi kwiinkqubo zokudibana ezikwi-intanethi. Ilayisenesi evakalayo yokushayela ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubekileyo. Ulwazi nobuchule: Ukuqonda ukulawulwa kwezimali kwicala likarhulumente kunye namagunya / izigqibo ze-PFMA kunye neMithetho yeTreasury. Ukuqonda kakuhle i-BAS, i-Finest kunye nezinye iinkqubo zezimali. Amabhalo agqithisweyo wobuchule / ubudlelwane nabantu. Ukuqonda ngokucace gcalesela iinkqubo zokuqokelela imali ekarhulumente.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukuthobela ekuhlawulenii ababoneleli ngaphakathi kweentsuku ezingama-30. Yenza uqwalaselo nyanga zonke kwiirejista zamagazati e-akhawunti. Lawula izibonelelo ezinxulumene nabanikazi nentlawulo. Lawula izibonelelo ezinxulumene nomvuzo nentlawulo. Qinisekisa ukuba yonke iklam iproseswa ngexesha elifunekayo. Uprada weenkonzo zoLawulo lomVuzo. Lungisa amaxwebhu ngenjongo yokulungelelwa uqwalaselo. Yenza uqwalaselo nyanga zonke kubanikazi babhaso. Phantisa ukuthobela ngokwemithetho, iimigaqo, iinkqubo nezinye iinkqubo. Phendula kubagqatswa bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Hlaba iingxelo ezifanelekileyo.

jobs.title: Chief Registry Clerk
jobs.summary: Chief Registry Clerk at Siloam Hospital in Limpopo, requiring a Grade 12 plus NQF level 6 qualification in Records Management and three years of registry experience.

A minimum of three [3] years’ relevant experience in a Registry and/ Records management environment. A valid driver's license except for people with disabilities Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge, understanding and application of registry duties, including procedures and directives for the effective and safe management, storage and archiving of administrative and patient records. Knowledge, understanding and application of various filing and cataloguing systems. Knowledge, understanding and application of relevant legislations applicable to records management. Planning and organizing skills. Postal system.

Registry services, including filing, postage of mail, management of incoming and outgoing internal and external correspondence. Maintain control registers. Ensure proper control to access to records storage rooms. Ensure confidentiality of information. Implement effective and efficient disposal program for Records Management. Preparation of records required for audit purposes. Ensure records storage rooms are well maintained in line with required standards. Supervision of subordinates.

af.summary: Hoofregisterklerk by Siloam Hospital in Limpopo, vereis 'n Graad 12 plus 'n NQF vlak 6-kwalifikasie in Rekordbestuur en drie jaar se registerervaring.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasie en Ervaring: 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/Graad 12/Matriek plus 'n voorgraadse kwalifikasie op NQF vlak 6 in Argief-/Rekordbestuur-/biblioteek- en inligtingwetenskap-kwalifikasie soos erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. 'n Minimum van drie [3] jaar se relevante ervaring in 'n Register- en/of Rekordbestuursomgewing. Inheemse vereistes van die werk: Rekenaargeletterdheid insluitend MS Outlook, Word, Excel en PowerPoint; Geletterdheid in virtuele vergaderplatforms. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie behalwe vir persone met gestremdhede Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis, begrip en toepassing van registerpligte, insluitend prosedures en richtlyne vir die doeltreffende en veilige bestuur, berging en argivering van administratiewe en pasiëntrekords. Kennis, begrip en toepassing van verskeie indiening- en katalogiseringsstelsels. Kennis, begrip en toepassing van tersaaklike wetgewing van toepassing op rekordbestuur. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Posstelsel.
af.duties: Bestuur van rekords (indiening, onttrekking, berging, veilige bewaring en toegang). Registerdienste, insluitend indiening, pos van posstukke, bestuur van inkomende en uitgaande interne en eksterne korrespondensie. Handhaaf beheerregisters. zu.title: I-Nkulu Yabathungi Beziqu
zu.summary: Indlula edala eyisiphethu esikhulu i-Siloam Hospital eLimpopo, kudingeka isithupha esisha sokuphothula iminyaka yeshumi nesishiyagalombili kanye nethiphu elifana nesikhundla lesithupha se-NQF ekusebenzeni kweziqu nokuphathwa kwamaphathwa, kanti futhi kudingwa iminyaka emithathu yokusebenza ngephathwa.
zu.requirements: Izidingo kanye Nesipiliyoni: I-National Senior Certificate/Grade 12 / Matric kanye nethiphu elingenisele e-NQF level 6 kwi-Archives/ Records Management/ library and information science eliqashelwe yi-South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Ukuze ube nokuhlolwa okuncane kakhulu kweminyaka emithathu [3] yesipiliyoni esihambisana nendawo yokuqashwa kweziqu kanye/noma ekuphathweni kwamaphathwa. Izidingo ezingezona eziguquguquki zomsebenzi: Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha okuhlanganisa i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint; Ulwazi lokusebenzisa izinkundla zokuhlangana ezingabonakali. I-licence yokushayela evumelekile ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile Ulwazi kanye Nezindidi: Ulwazi, ukuqonda nokusebenzisa imisebenzi yephathwa, okuhlanganisa izindlela kanye neziluleko zokuqinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo nokuphephile, ukugcina kanye nokulondoloza amaphathwa omphathwa kanye namaphathwa esiguli. Ulwazi, ukuqonda nokusebenzisa izinhlelo ezahlukahlukene zokulondoloza kanye nezinhlelo zokuqhathanisa. Ulwazi, ukuqonda nokusebenzisa izigaba ezahambisana nomthetho ezibhekisela ekuphathweni kwamaphathwa. Izindidi zokuqamba izinhlelo kanye nokuhlela. Isimiso seposi.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa kwamaphathwa (ukulondoloza, ukukhipha, ukugcina, ukugcina ngokuphepha kanye nokungena). Izinsiza zephathwa, okuhlanganisa ukulondoloza, ukuthumela imali ngeposi, ukuphathwa kwezincwadi ezingena kanye nezincwadi eziphuma ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukugcina izibuko zokulawula. Ukuqinisekisa ukulawula okufanele ekungeni emagumbi okugcina amaphathwa. Ukuqinisekisa ukuziphimisela kolwazi. Ukuphatha isimiso sokulahlekelana ngamaphathwa esebenzayo nokuqinisekisiwe ekuphathweni kwamaphathwa. Ukulungiselela amaphathwa adingekayo ngenxa yokuhlola. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amagumbi okugcina amaphathwa agcinwe kahle njengoba kudingwa izindinganiso. Ukuphathwa kwabahlolwa.

xh.title: INkulu Yomlindi Weefayili
xh.summary: INkulu Yomlindi Weefayili e Siloam Hospital e Limpopo, ifuna i-Grade 12 negunya le-NQF level 6 kwabaphathi Beerekhodi nethotho yeminyaka elithathu yamava kulawulo lokulonda iifayili.
xh.requirements: Izifundo namava: Isatifikethi sezizwe se-National Senior Certificate/Grade 12 / Matric negunya lesiqu elingaphantsi kwesidanga se-NQF level 6 kwi-Akhayiviesi/ Records Management/ library and information science njengokuqatshiwa yi-South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Isiqingatha seminyaka elithathu [3] yamava ahambelanayo kwindawo yoLawulo lwe-Akhayiviesi nakwindawo yoLawulo lweerekhodi. Iimfuno ezingeyo lolmsebenzi: Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kubandakanya i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel PowerPoint; Ulwazi lokusebenzisa iinkqubo zokuthetha ngokubonana. Ilayisensi yomqeshi egunyazisiweyo ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekileyo. Ulwazi ngezakhono: Ulwazi, ukuqonda nokusebenzisa imisebenzi yolawulo lweefayili, kubandakanya iinkqubo neelayisensi zokulawula ngokusebenzayo nangokhuseleko, ukugcina nokuqamba iirekhodi zolawulo nezomguli. Ulwazi, ukuqonda nokusebenzisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuqamba iirekhodi nezokwenza ikhathalogu. Ulwazi, ukuqonda nokusebenzisa amagazethi ahambelanayo nawo alawulo lweerekhodi. Isakhono sokuceba nokuhlela. Inkqubo yeposi.
xh.duties: Ukulawula iirekhodi (ukuqamba, ukuzitsha, ukuzigcina, ukuzigcina ngokhuseleko nokufikelela). Iinkonzo zolawulo lweefayili, kubandakanya ukuqamba iifayili, ukuthumela iposi, ukulawula ungeno lwemibhalo yangaphakathi nangaphandle ezingenayo neziphuma. Ukugcina amarejista olawulo. Ukuqinisekisa ukulawula ngokufanelekileyo ukufikelela kwizinto ezigcina iirekhodi. Ukuqinisekisa imfihleko yolwazi. Ukuze kusebenze ngokusebenzayo nangexeshane inkqubo yokutshatyalalisa kulawulo lweerekhodi. Ukuqulunqa iirekhodi efuneka ngenjongo zokuhlolwa. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba iindawo ezigcina iirekhodi zigcinwa ngokulungileyo ngokwemigqalo efunekayo. Ukulawula abasebenzi abangaphantsi.

Current registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. Grade 2: a minimum of ten [10] years appropriate / recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC as General Nurse. South African Citizen or permanent resident. Willingness to do after hours work and be on call including shift work. Calm under pressure and adaptable to change. Team player. Committed to continuous learning and Batho Pele principles.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige [met Vroedkunde] [PN -A2]: Graad 1 – 2
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundiges met vroedkunde word benodig by verskeie Limpopo hospitale, wat SANC-registrasie en 'n R425-verpleegkwalifikasie vereis.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies en Ervaring: 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat /Graad 12/Matriek plus Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (Diploma of Graad in verpleegkunde) of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council as Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. Huidige registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Graad 1: geen toepaslike / erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde nie. Graad 2: 'n minimum van tien [10] jaar toepaslike / erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC as Algemene Verpleegkundige. Suid-Afrikaanse burger of permanente inwoner. Bereidwilligheid om buite-ure werk te doen en oproepbaar te wees insluitend skofwerk. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse, prosedures en regsraamwerke. Goeie kliniese vaardighede. Vermoë om onder druk te werk en streng infeksiebeheer-beginsels toe te pas. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Persoonlike Eienskappe: Integriteit en professionaliteit. Aandag aan detail en akkuraatheid. Verantwoordelikheid en betroubaarheid. Proaktief en resultaatgerig. Kalm onder druk en aanpasbaar by verandering. Spanspeler. Toegewyd aan deurlopende leer en Batho Pele-beginsels.
af.duties: Beoefen verpleegkunde en gesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met die wette en regulasies wat relevant is tot verpleegkunde en gesondheidsorg. Onderhou 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met alle lede van die span. Benut menslike, materiële en fisiese hulpbronne doeltreffend en effektief.

IGrade 1: Akukho okuhlonga okufanele / okubonakalayo kweminye yezokunursing emva kokubhaliswa kwamanje njengenensi yobuchwepheshe kwi-SANC. Ukusebenza ngokuqinisekile emaphakandwo nokusebenza kwangamathambo. Isandla sokuhlolwa nokusebenza. Izindingo eziyisikhuthazo: Ukuqiniseka kokusebenza; Isandla sokusebenza. Ukuqiniseka ngokusebenza. Ukukhululeka nokusebenza. Ukuzimisela nokusebenza. Ukusebenza ngokuzethemba nokuziphendulela. Isibindi nokusebenza. Ulwazi lolimi nolwesiko. Ulwazi lwezomthetho.
zu.duties: Benze umsebenzi wezokunursing nempilo ngokuvumelana nomthetho nemithetho ehlobene nezokunursing nempilo. Bahlale begcine ubudlelwano obuhle bokusebenza bonke amalungu eqembu. Basebenzise izinsiza zabantu, izinto, nendalo ngendlela esebenzayo futhi ngokuphumelelayo.

xh.summary: Kufunekwa abaPhathi beBoya bokuNika iNdemanga kumathunga amaninzi eLimpopo, kusafuneka bubhaliso kwi-SANC nefomali yeesifundo se-R425.

Ulwazi nolugcwaliseko: Ulwazi ngeendlela zenkathazo zokukhathalelwa iimeko, iindlela nemiGaqo esemthethweni. Iindlela ezilungileyo zokwenza izigulo. Isiphithiphithi sokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo lokusebenza nokufaka iinkqubo ezinzima zokuqonda nokulawula ukutshintshwa koophasiwe. Amakhono oluthetha olonge. Iimpawu zobuNtu: Inyanisekile kunesi nakhona uBuzilahle. Ukukhathaleleka kolunye kwaye ukwenza umsebenzi ngokuchanekileyo. Ukuziphendulela nokuthembeka. Ukuzithathela izigqibo nokuzinika imveliso. Ukwazi ukuzibamba nangaphantsi koxinzelelo lokusebenza nokuzijika ngokutshintsha iimeko. Umsebenzi weSiqu. Ukuqinisekisa ukukhula ngokulandelelana koluntu nobuBatho Pele.
xh.duties: Ukuqhuba imisebenzi yokukhathalela imeko yomntu nemisebenzi yezempilo ngokwelungelelanisa nemigaqo yomthetho nokuhambisana nemisebenzi yokunyanga nokunakekela imeko yomntu. Ukugcina uluhlu lokusebenza olwakhiweyo nobudlelwane obuhle kubo bonke abaluhluli. Ukusetyenziswa ngokusebenziseka ngokupheleleyo nangokuchanekileyo kwemisebenzi yomntu, yemitshini nobunke benkalo

jobs.summary: The Limpopo Department of Health is recruiting 46 Pharmacist Assistants (Post Basic) across multiple districts, requiring SAPC registration and Grade 12 plus an appropriate qualification.
jobs.requirements: Qualifications and Experience: A National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/Matric plus an appropriate qualification that allows registration with South African Pharmacy Council as Pharmacist Assistant [Post Basic]. Current registration with the South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) as a Pharmacist Assistant Post Basic. Ability to travel to all facilities within the cluster. Willingness to do after-hours work and be on call including shift work. Computer literacy including MS Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint, Literacy in virtual meeting platforms. Valid driver’s license except for people with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Pharmacy Act and Regulations, Medicines and Related Substances Control Act. Good Communication Skills. Support to public health initiatives. Safe preparation and dispensing support. Stock control and supply support. Operational and workflow support. Professional and ethical conduct. Continuous learning and workplace training Personal Attributes: Integrity and professionalism. Attention to detail and accuracy. Accountability and reliability. Calm under pressure and adaptable to change. Team player. Committed to continuous learning and Batho Pele principles.
jobs.duties: Order items as authorized by the Nursing Manager. Confirm and follow up all orders with DEPOT. Provide weekly reports on stock availability. Receive stock from depot/hospitals. Receive stock from depot/hospitals, by checking physical stock vs invoices, Capture stock on the stock cards, Address all queries with the depot e.g. price queries. Issuing stock to cubicles and patients. Receive and issue stock using picking lists. Check if stock is picked correctly. Complete and maintain documentation. Record and report excessive stock and deviations to the Depot. Assist in maintaining a pharmaceutical stock control system that complies with good pharmacy practice and legal requirement. Manage stock to avoid expired stock, Maintain relevant documentation e.g. credit notes, Ensure product safety, Perform stocktaking twice a year, Facilitate returned goods. Coordinate pay-point helpdesk services. Monitor service level agreement with third party contractors. Identify new pay points. Re-organize and realign in terms of laid down norms and standards. Ensure the establishment of pay point committees. Participate in the control and distribution of stock to facilities with particular reference to the dispatching of such products to facilities within the legal requirements and according to good distribution practices. Management of cold chain. Pack stock after picking. Dispatch stock to cubicles. Process documents for stock returned from cubicles.
