af.title: Aptekerassistent (POST Basies): Graad 1 -3 (SKOFTE) (X46
af.summary: Die Limpopo Department of Health werf 46 Aptekerassistente (Post Basies) oor verskeie distrikte, wat SAPC-registrasie en Graad 12 plus 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie vereis.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies en Ervaring: 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/Graad 12/Matriek plus 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie met die South African Pharmacy Council as Aptekerassistent [Post Basies] moontlik maak. Huidige registrasie met die South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) as 'n Aptekerassistent Post Basies. Vermoë om na alle fasiliteite binne die cluster te reis. Bereidwilligheid om na-ure werk te doen en op roep te wees insluitend skofwerk. Rekenaarvaardigheid insluitend MS Outlook, Word, Excel en PowerPoint, Geletterdheid in virtuele vergaderplattelatte. Geldige bestuurslisensie behalwe vir persone met gestremdhede. Kennis en Vaardighede: Pharmacy Act en Regulasies, Medicines and Related Substances Control Act. Goeie Kommunikasievaardighede. Ondersteuning aan openbare gesondheidsinisiatiewe. Veilige voorbereiding en afleweringsondersteuning. Voorraadbeheer en verskaffingsondersteuning. Operasionele en werkvloei-ondersteuning. Professionele en etiese gedrag. Deurlopende leer en werkplekopleiding Persoonlike Eienskappe: Integriteit en professionaliteit. Aandag aan detail en akkuraatheid. Verantwoordelikheid en betroubaarheid. Kalm onder druk en aanpasbaar by verandering. Spanspeler. Toegewyd aan deurlopende leer en Batho Pele-beginsels.
af.duties: Bestel items soos gemagtig deur die Nursing Manager. Bevestig en volg alle bestellings met DEPOT op. Verskaf weeklikse verslae oor voorraadbeskikbaarheid. Ontvang voorraad van depot/hospitale. Ontvang voorraad van depot/hospitale deur fisiese voorraad teenoor fakture te kontroleer, Vang voorraad op die voorraadkaarte op, Hanteer alle navrae met die depot bv. prysnavrae. Uitreik van voorraad aan kubikels en pasiënte. Ontvang en reik voorraad uit met behulp van pluklyste. Kontroleer of voorraad korrek gepluk is. Voltooi en onderhou dokumentasie. Reken en rapporteer oormaat voorraad en afwykings aan die Depot. Bystand met die handhawing van 'n farmaseutiese voorraadbeheerstelsel wat aan goeie apteekpraktyk en wetlike vereistes voldoen. Bestuur voorraad om vervalle voorraad te voorkom, Onderhou toepaslike dokumentasie bv. kredietnotas, Verseker produkveiligheid, Voer twee keer per jaar voorraadopname uit, Fasiliteer teruggeneemde goedere. Koördineer betaalpunt-hulptelefondienste. Monitor diensvlakooreenkoms met derdeparty-kontrakteurs. Identifiseer nuwe betaalpunte. Herorganiseer en herlyn volgens vasgestelde norme en standaarde. Verseker die vestiging van betaalpuntkomitees. Neem deel aan die beheer en verspreiding van voorraad aan fasiliteite met spesifieke verwysing na die versending van sulke produkte aan fasiliteite binne die wetlike vereistes en volgens goeie verspreidingspraktyke. Bestuur van die koue ketting. Pak voorraad na pluk in. Stuur voorraad na kubikels. Prosesseer dokumente vir voorraad wat vanuit kubikels teruggestuur is.

zu.title: Umsekeli Wogqira Wezamuchi: Izinga 1 -3 (Ishifthi) (X46
zu.summary: I-Limpopo Department of Health ithumba abasebenzi abangu-46 abangabasekeli Bogqira Bezamuchi (Post Basic) kumakhaya ahlukene, kudingeka ubhalise ku-SAPC futhi ube ne-Grade 12 kanye nesifundo esifanele.
zu.requirements: Izindingo namava: I-National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/Matric kanye nesifundo esifanele esivumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Pharmacy Council njengoMsekeli Wogqira Wezamuchi [Post Basic]. Ubhaliso lwamanje ku-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) njengoMsekeli Wogqira Wezamuchi Post Basic. Ikhono lokuhamba kuzo zonke izikhungo ngaphakathi kweqembu. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngemva kemahora nokutholakala ngocingo kuhlanganise nokusebenza ngamashifthi. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kuhlanganise i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel ne-PowerPoint, Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa izinkundla zokuhlangana ezibonakalayo. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile. Ulwazi nekhono: I-Pharmacy Act kanye nemithetho yayo, i-Medicines and Related Substances Control Act. Amakhono okuxhumana ahle. Ukusekela izinhlelo zempilo yomphakathi. Ukuqinisekiswa okuphephile kanye nousekelo lokunikeza imithi. Ukuqinisekiswa kwemibhalo kanye nousekelo lokuhlinzeka. Usekelo lokusebenza nokuqondisa izindlela. Ukuziphatha ngobungcweti nangokungakhohlisi. Ukufunda okuqhubekayo kanye nokugqugquzelwa esikhundleni sokusebenza Izibalulo zomuntu: Ukuzethemba nobungcweti. Kuqwalaselwe imininingwane nokunembile. Ubunembeza nokuqotho. Ukuqina ngaphansi kwegcinzeffu nokuguquguquka ngokushintsha. Ukusebenza njengomuntu oqonda omunye omunye. Ukuqaphela ukufunda okuqhubekayo kanye nemigomo ka-Batho Pele.
zu.duties: Oda izinto njengoba kuvunyiwe nguNhloli Wezokunakekela. Qinisekisa futhi ulandele wonke ama-oda ku-DEPOT. Nikeza ngemibiko yansonto zonke ngokutholakala kwemibhalo. Yamukela imibhalo evela ediphothi/ezibhedlela. Yamukela imibhalo evela ediphothi/ezibhedlela, ngokuqinisekisa imibhalo yokwenyama ngokumelene namafomu, Bhalisa imibhalo ekhadini lemibhalo, Soxazula yonke imibuzo nediphothi isb. imibuzo yentengo. Nikeza imibhalo kumagumbi nasezigulweni. Yamukela futhi unike imibhalo usebenzisa izinhlu zokukhetha. Qaphela ukuthi imibhalo ikhethwe ngendlela efanele. Qedelela futhi ulondoloze imibhalo. Bhalisa futhi umbike imibhalo enenani elikhulu nokungahambisana nomthetho ku-Depot. Siza ekuhlondolozeni indlela yokulawula imibhalo yezamuchi ephilisana nemikhonzo ehle yokugqira kanye nezidingo zomthetho. Phatha imibhalo ukuze uvimele imibhalo esiphephelwe isikhathi, Londoloza imibhalo ehlobene isb. amanothi esikweletu, Qinisekisa ukuphepha kwemikhiqizo, Yenza ukubala kwemibhalo kabili ngonyaka, Kubusise ngemikhiqizo ebuyisiwe. Hlanganisa izinkonzo zedeski lenani lokukhokha. Qaphela isivumelwano sezinga lenkonzo nabathengisi bobabili. Thola amaphoyinti okukhokha amasha. Hlela kabusha futhi ulungise ngokomthetho obekiwe futhi ngamazinga. Qinisekisa ukusungulwa kwekomidi yamaphoyinti okukhokha. Thatha inxaxheba ekulawuleni nokuhanjiswa kwemibhalo ezikhungweni nokuqinisekisa ukuhanjiswa kwalemikhiqizo ezikhungweni ngokwezidingo zomthetho nangokomkhonzo ohle wokuhambisa. Ukuphatha ibhanga elibandayo. Faka imibhalo ngemva kokukhethwa. Hambisa imibhalo kumagumbi. Cubungula imibhalo yemibhalo ebuyiswa emagumbini.

xh.title: Umncededi wezeempilo (POST Basic): Greydi 1 -3 (IISHIFTHI) (X46
xh.summary: I-Limpopo Department of Health iyakhalisa aba ncinci aba-46 bezeempilo (Post Basic) kumaphondo ahlukeneyo, kufuneka abhaliswe kwi-SAPC kwaye aneGreymdi 12 kunye nesifundo esifanelekileyo.
xh.requirements: Izifundo nemisebenzi: Isatifikethi Sezwe ePhakamileyo/Greydi 12/Umatriki kunye nesifundo esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiSouth African Pharmacy Council njengomncededi wezeempilo [Post Basic]. Ukubhaliswa ngoku kwiSouth African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) njengomncededi wezeempilo Post Basic. Ukuba nakho ukuhamba kuzo zonke iindawo ezikwilqoqo. Ukulungele ukwenza umsebenzi wemiyezo engaphandle kweyure zomsebenzi kwaye ube kwi-coll ngokubandakanya umsebenzi weshifthi. Ukuba nakho ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ngokubandakanya i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel nePowerPoint. Ukuba nakho ukusebenzisa iinkqubo zokudibana ngekhompyutha. Ilayisenesi yokushayela esebenzayo ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubekileyo. Ulwazi namakhono: Umthetho wezeempilo neMila. Umthetho woLawulo lweMithi nokuNgqinelana nako. Amakhono abalulekileyo enkcumama. Inkxaso kwiinkqubo zezeempilo zoluntu. Inkxaso ekulungiselelweni okhuselekileyo nokunikweni kwemithi. Inkxaso ekulawulweni kwemithi nokunikelweni kwayo. Inkxaso ekuqhubeni kwenkqubo nomsebenzi. Ukuziphatha ngobuchwephesha nokungathembeki. Ukufunda kuqhubekayo nokoluleko kwindawo yomsebenzi Iimpawu zobuntu: Intembeko nobuchwephesha. Ukunaka iinkcukacha nokuchaneka. Ixabiso nokuthembeka. Uxolo ngaphantsi koxinzelelo nokuqhelana nokutshintsha. Ukudlala njengelungu leqela. Uzinikezele ekufundeni kuqhubekayo nakwiinkqubo zeBatho Pele.
xh.duties: Faka iiodolo zemithi njengemvume yenkolikho njengengcebiso yamagosa obucalo. Qinisekisa kulandele zonke iiodolo eziye zifakelwa kwi-DEPOT. Zela iingxelo ngeveki ngamnye malunga nokubakho kwemithi. Yemikela imithi evela kwindawo yokugcina imithi/iibhedle. Yemikela imithi evela kwindawo yokugcina imithi/iibhedle, ngokutshintsha imithi ebonakalayo nemali efakelwayo. Bhala imithi kwiikhadi zemithi. Phendula konke ukubuzwa kwindawo yokugcina imithi njengakwimibuzo yexabiso. Yabelana ngemithi kwiikhomitye nagabafundi. Yemikela kwaye yabelana ngemithi usebenzisa uluhlu lokukhetha. Qinisekisa ukuba imithi ikhethwe ngokuchanekileyo. Qedela kwaye ulondoloze amaxwebhu. Bhala kwaye uxele malunga nemithi e ngaphezulu kakhulu nokutshintsha kwindawo yokugcina imithi. Nceda ekulondolozeni inkqubo yolawulo lwemithi yezeempilo ehambelana namalungu obuchwephesha bezeempilo nemigangatho yomthetho. Lawula imithi ukugwema ukuba iphelelwa lixesha. Londoloza amaxwebhu afanelekileyo njengepapasha zemali. Qinisekisa ukhuseleko lemithi. Wenze ukubala kwemithi kabini ngonyaka. Yenza kube lula ukubuyiswa kwemithi. Lawula iinkonzo zedeski kwiziko lokuhlawula. Qonda isivumelwano sezinga senkonzo namakontrakti bangesithathu. Phawula iindawo zokuhlawula ezintsha. Lungisa kwaye ulungiselele ngokomthetho ngokwezidingo nemigangatho. Qinisekisa ukusekwa kwekomiti yendawo yokuhlawula. Thatha inxaxheba ekulawuleni nokuğcinweni kwemithi kwiindawo ezahlukeneyo ngakumbi ukuthunyelwa kwalemithi kwiindawo ngokumthetho ngokwezenzo ezilungileyo zokuthunyelwa. Lawula umthetho wobanda. Beka imithi emva kokuyikhetha. Thumela imithi kwiikhomitye. Qhuba amaxwebhu okubuyiswa imithi kwiikhomitye.

Ukubuka ukuthi umuntu uyakwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha okuhlanganisa i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint, Ukwazi ukusebenzisa izinkundla zohlelo lwezinto ezingabonwa zokuqoqwa kwabantu. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo ngaphandle kwalabo abanesikhindi sabantu. Ulwazi Nobuhlakani: Ulwazi lokuhlaziya izinto ngezobuchwepheshe, amakhono okubhala imibiko yezobuchwepheshe. Izinhlelo zokusebenzisa ikhompyutha ngezobuchwepheshe, ukuxhumana okuhle kanye namakhono okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. (Word, Excel, Outlook). Ulwazi ngokuhambisana nomthetho, Ukukhiqiza, ulwazi namakhono wenqubo, Ukuba nakho ukufunda nokutolika izikowane zokukhiqiza nezakha. Ulwazi nakuhlangenwe nakho ngokuhambisana kumthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act endaweni yokusebenza kubaluleke kakhulu. Ukwenza kabi yimali kanye nezimali ekugcinweni kwazo. Ukuxhumana Okuhle, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, ukuthatha izinqumo, ukuhlela nokuhlela izinto. Ukukhulekela futhi nikakhono abanye. Ukusebenza njengeqembu kanye namakhono okuhlaziya izinto. Ukuziphathela. Ukugxila kumthengi nokuphendula ngokushesha.
zu.duties: Gcina ulungise izinkinga ezihlobene ngesidakwa ugesi/ ukuqoqa / izintuluzi. Hlola ulungiselele izinkalo zokusebenza kanye noma / izinsiza mayelana nezidingo ezithile. Nika insiza izinsiza futhi noma / izinsiza. Phatha ulondoloze irekhodi lemsebenzi / ukubhalisa izingxenye ezilondolozwe futhi ezilungisiwe. Phatha futhi qaphise abantu abangemthetho wokuphatha izimali nabantu.

xh.title: Umzobi Onqanaba a – C (IISHIFTI)
xh.summary: Isebe lezeMpilo loMntlaRhine likhanka abazobi abaningi kumaziko amakhula ezempilo ukwenzisa ulungiso lamanzi, kumbane namashishini, ngemivuzo eqwalaselwa ngamava.
xh.requirements: Izifundo nemoMava: Isatifikethi esifanelekileyo sokuvavanya ishishini. Inqanaba A: 0 - 16 yamava afanelekileyo kwel candelo emva kokuze kufunyanwe amava afanelekileyo ashishini. Inqanaba B: 18 – 32 yamava afanelekileyo kwel candelo emva kokuze kufunyanwe amava afanelekileyo ashishini. Inqanaba C: 33 yamava nangaphezulu afanelekileyo kwel candelo emva kokuze kufunyanwe amava afanelekileyo ashishini. Ukuzimisela ukwenza imisebenzi yokulindila emva kweyure zomsebenzi, ngeenekhaya, ngeeholide zikawonke-wonke nangaphezulu kweyure okanye xa kuseneko. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kuquka i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel nePowerPoint. Ulwazi kwiinkqubo zokudibana kwangaphandle. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubekileyo. Ulwazi nobuchule: Ulwazi lokwahlula-hlula ngobuchwephenshe, amaqhinga okubhala iingxelo zobuchwephenshe. Izicelo zobuchwephenshe ezixhaswa yikhompyutha, abalulekileyo bokunxibelelana nolwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. (Word, Excel, Outlook). Ulwazi ngokuthobela umthetho, Ulwazi lobuchule bokwenza nolwazi hlokusebenza. Ukwazi ukufunda nokutolika izahluzo zokwenza nezakhiwo. Ulwazi namava malunga nokuthobela umthetho woMsebenzi woKhuseleko noMpilo kwindawo yokusebenza luyimfuneko. Ubungqondo beQoqa neCandelo leMali. Ukunxibelelana kakuhle, ukuxazula iingxaki nokuwahlula-hlula, ukwenza iigqibo, ukuqamba nokuhlela amakhono. Ukwakhisa nokuqeqesha. Ukusebenza ngenqe nokuwahlula-hlula. Ukuqulunqa iqu. Ukujolisa kumthengi nokuphendula.
xh.duties: Ukulungisa ukuqhekeka kobuchwephenshe nxulumene nombane/ ukudibanisa/ ulungiso lamanzi. Ukuvavanya ulungiso lokuqhekeka kwemizobo kunye/noma izinto ezilungise kumimo efunwayo. Ukukhonza imizobo kunye/noma izinto ezenziwayo. Ukugcina kunye nokulawula irekhodi yomsebenzi/ irekhodi yoqhekeko olungisiweyo. Ukulawula noQeqesho looMathathuba abantu.

jobs.title: Accounting Clerk-revenue Management
jobs.centre: Dr CN Phatudi Hospital (X1 Post) Thabamoopo Hospital (X1 Post)
jobs.summary: The Department of Health in Limpopo seeks two accounting clerks for revenue management at Dr CN Phatudi and Thabamoopo hospitals, requiring an NQF level 6 finance or accounting qualification.
jobs.requirements: Qualification and Experience: A National Senior Certificate /Grade 12/ Matric plus NQF level 6 qualification in Financial Management/Accounting/Cost Management Accounting or equivalent qualification at NQF level 6 as recognized by the South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Computer literacy including MS Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint; Literacy in virtual meeting platforms. Valid driver’s license except for people with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Basic understanding of Public Sector Financial Administration and the prescription / provision of PFMA and Treasury Regulations. Basic understanding of BAS and PERSAL. Communication skills and good interpersonal relations. Ability to accept responsibility and to work independently.
jobs.duties: Receive and record debts creation forms submitted, Capture revenue and debt transactions in the financial system. Creation of debts on BAS system and implement PERSAL deductions. Open and maintain debt files. Issue reminder letters and/or make telephonic follow-ups on outstanding debts. Compile files to be handed over to debt collectors and reconcile payments received, Clearing of Revenue and debt related suspense accounts through passing of relevant journals, Perform daily revenue and debt reconciliation. Safeguard state resources/books and registers. Handle and update all accounting records in line with applicable procedures. Filing, record keeping and any other records related activities. Perform cashier duties. Provide any other administrative functions as directed from time to time.
jobs.enquiries: General enquiries about the advertised posts should be directed to Ms Hlokoa RE Tel No: (015) 293 6406, Ms Mompei MM Tel No: (015) 293 6126 / Ms Sebake RL Tel No: (015) 293 6426, Ms Sebola MF Tel No: (015) 293 6002 and Ms Mothiba JT Tel No: (015) 293 6329 during office hours.

af.title: Rekenkundige Klerk-Inkomstebestuur
af.summary: Die Department of Health in Limpopo soek twee rekenkundige klerke vir inkomstebestuur by Dr CN Phatudi en Thabamoopo-hospitale, wat 'n NQF level 6-finansies of rekenkunde-kwalifikasie vereis.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasie en Ervaring: 'n National Senior Certificate /Grade 12/ Matric plus NQF level 6-kwalifikasie in Financial Management/Accounting/Cost Management Accounting of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF level 6 soos erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Rekenaarvaardigheid insluitend MS Outlook, Word, Excel en PowerPoint; Vaardigheid in virtuele vergaderingsplatforms. Geldige bestuurderslisensie behalwe vir persone met gestremdhede. Kennis en Vaardighede: Basiese begrip van Openbare Sektor Finansiële Administrasie en die voorskrifte/bepalings van PFMA en Treasury Regulations. Basiese begrip van BAS en PERSAL. Kommunikasievaardighede en goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings. Vermoë om verantwoordelikheid te aanvaar en onafhanklik te werk.
af.duties: Ontvang en rekord skuldskeppingsvorms wat ingedien word. Vang inkomste- en skuldtransaksies in die finansiële stelsel. Skepping van skulde op BAS-stelsel en implementeer PERSAL-aftrekkings. Maak skuldlêers oop en onderhou dit. Stuur herinneringsbriewe en/of doen telefoniese opvolg uitstaande skulde. Stel lêers saam wat oorhandig moet word aan skuldinvorderaars en versoen betalings ontvang. Skrapping van inkomste- en skuldverwante hangrekeninge deur die passing van toepaslike joernale. Voer daaglikse inkomste- en skuldversoenings uit. Beskerm staatsbronne/boeke en registers. Hanteer en dateer alle rekenkundige rekords op in ooreenstemming met toepaslike prosedures. Lêwerk, rekordhou en enige ander rekordverwante aktiwiteite. Voer kasierpligte uit. Verskaf enige ander administratiewe funksies soos van tyd tot tyd opgedra.

zu.title: Accounting Clerk-revenue Management
zu.summary: I-Department of Health e-Limpopo ifuna abakhi bezibalo ababili bokuphathwa kwemali etholwayo ezibhedlela i-Dr CN Phatudi kanye ne-Thabamoopo, kudingwa ithuba le-NQF level 6 kwezimali noma izibalo.
zu.requirements: Izindingo Nempilo yomsebenzi: Isitifikedi seNazionale Esiphakeme /I-Garde 12/ I-Matric kanye nethuba le-NQF level 6 kuFinancial Management/Accounting/Cost Management Accounting noma isitifikedi esilingana esingeni le-NQF level 6 njengoba samukelwa yi-South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kuhlanganise i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint; Ukwazi ukusebenzisa izinkundla zokuhlangana ezibonakalayo. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile ngaphandle kwabantu abasikhohlake. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo kokuqashwa kwezimali kwesifunda sikahulumeni kanye nemiyalo / izinkinga ze-PFMA kanye nezimiso zeTreasury. Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo nge-BAS kanye ne-PERSAL. Amakhono okuxhumana nobuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Ikhono lokwamukela imithwalo yemfanelo nokusebenza kodwa.
zu.duties: Wamukele futhi ubhale amafomu okwakhiwa izikweletu ohunyushiwe, Bhala imali etholwayo nezinkokhelo zezikweletu ohlelweni lwezimali. Ukwakhiwa kwezikweletu ohlelweni lwe-BAS nokusebenzisa ukukhishwa kwemali ohlelweni lwe-PERSAL. Vula futhi ulondoloze amafayela wezikweletu. Khishza amagwembe esikhumbuzo nokwenza ulandelelo ngefoni ngezikweletu ezingakhokhiwe. Lungiselela amafayela okuhambiswa kubasizi izikweletu futhi uqondanise imali etholwe, Ukusula izikhwama zethimba lemali etholwayo nezinkokhelo zezikweletu ngokudlulisa amajenali afanele, Yenza ukuqondaniswa kwansuku zonke kwemali etholwayo nezikweletu. Sicela izinsiza/izincwadi kanye namarekhodi zombuso. Phatha futhi uvuselele yonke imirekhodo yezibalo ngokulandelana kwemigaqo esebenzayo. Ukufaka efayeleni, ukugcina irekhodi naneminye imisebenzi ehlobene namarekhodi. Yenza imisebenzi yesikhundla somsizi wemali. Nikeza naneminye imisebenzi yezokweluleka njengoba kuhlelwa ngesikhathi esithile.

xh.title: Iclerki eBhalisini-Umlawulo wenkunkuma
xh.summary: Isebe lezeempilo eLimpopo lifuna oclerki ababini bebhalisi kumlawulo wenkunkuma kumaspithala iDr CN Phatudi neThabamoopo, befuna isifundo seNQF level 6 kwezemali okanye ebhalisini.
xh.requirements: Iifundo nokuQonda: Isatifikethi samabanga aphezulu saseNingizimu Afrika /Grade 12/ Matric kanjalo nesifundo seNQF level 6 kokuLawula izeMali /iBhalisi/uLawulwa kweNxwelo maBhalisi okanye isifundo esilinganayo kwinqanaba leNQF level 6 njengokuqatyiweyo yiSouth African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha olubandakanya iMS Outlook, Word, Excel nePowerPoint; Ulwazi kumaplatifomu emihlangano yelektronikhi. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubekileyo. ULwazi neNdempondo: Ukuqonda okusemva kokulawula imali kahulumbe nemigaqo yePFMA nemigaqo yeTreasury. Ukuqonda okusemva kweBAS nePERSAL. Amakhono okunxibelelana nogqitho oluhle nabantu. Ukuba nakho ukwamkela uxanduva lokusebenza wedwa.
xh.duties: Wamkele ubhale iifomu zokuvelisa amatyala ezithunyelweyo, Ubhale inkunkuma nemisebenzi yetyala kwinkqubo yezemali. Ukuvelisa amatyala kwindlela yeBAS system ungenise nokuqhelanisa iPERSAL. Uvule igqibe ulwazi lwamatyala. Uthumele iiletteri zokukhumbuza okanye ukwenza amajeloamatyala angazalisekiyo. Uqokelele iifayile eziza kuniwe kubatyali betyala uqhelanise nemali ethunyelweyo, Ukucoca inkunkuma namatyala ahlobene ne akhawundi ngenkqubo yokudlula ejameni, Wenze uqhelaniselo lwemihla ngemihla lenkunkuma natyala. Ugcinze iirhisoso zolawulo/ iibhuku kunye nezibhalo. Uphathe uhlaziye zonke iirekhodi zebhalisi ngokwemigaqo esebenzayo. Uluhlu, ulondolozo kolwazi nanakunye imisebenzi ehlobene nolwazi. Wenze imisebenzi yomlawuli wekhawunta. Unikeze nananye imisebenzi yolawulo njengokuba kuyalelwa nangaxesha nyanye.

af.title: Personeelbeampte

af.requirements: Kwalifikasie en Ervaring: 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/Grade 12/Matriek plus NQF-vlak 6 soos erken in HRM/Openbare Bestuur/Openbare Administrasie of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie soos erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Rekenaarvaardigheid, insluitend MS Outlook, Word, Excel en PowerPoint; Virtuele vergaderplatforms. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie behalwe vir persone met gestremdhede. Kennis en Vaardighede: Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede.
af.duties: Implementeer menslike hulpbronadministrasiepraktyke. Ukuqashwa kokusebenza kahle kwemisebenzi. Ukuphela kwenkonzo (khombisa izinyathelo). Phendula imibuzo engaphansi kolawulo lwemithombo yabantu. Hlanganisa izibalo. jobs.title: Administration Clerk: Patient
jobs.centre: Nkhensani Hospital (X1 Post) Witpoort Hospital (X1 Post) George Masebe Hospital (X1 Post) Groblersdal Hospital (X1 Post) Grace Mugodeni Health Centre (X1 Post) Louis Trichardt Hospital (X1 Post) Seshego Hospital (X1 Post) Pietersburg Hospital (X1 Post)
jobs.summary: Administration clerks needed at eight Limpopo hospitals and health centres to capture patient information and handle admissions and discharges.
jobs.requirements: Qualifications and Experience: A National Senior Certificate/Grade 12 /Matric plus NQF level 6 in Financial Management / Accounting / Cost Management Accounting or equivalent qualification at NQF level 6 as recognized by the South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Inherent requirements of job: Must be prepared to work shifts (including night duty, weekends and public holidays). Computer literacy including MS Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint; Literacy in virtual meeting platforms. Willingness to work extra hours on short notice. A valid driver's license except for people with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Administrative duties. Knowledge of record keeping and archive procedures/patient billing. Ability to accept accountability and responsibility and to work independently and unsupervised.
jobs.duties: Capturing patients’ information on PHIS/DHIS and maintain any other required health information in the relevant information system in accordance with the policies of the department. Ensure that ICD10 codes are captured for each diagnosis against each patient. Admission and discharge of patients. Maintain patient appointments and schedule them accordingly. Ensuring that all admitted patients are correctly and timeously discharged in the system as per discharge registers/patient file. Perform inter-wards and inter-hospitals patient transfers. Manage the movement of patient file in the area of responsibility. Billing of services rendered [procedures, pharmaceutical, laboratory tests, blood services etc.] to patients in the allocated area of responsibility in line with ICD-10 coding and UPFS. Process preparation of patient invoices. Ensuring that the number of patients admitted in the system reconciles with all hospital patient admission & discharge registers. [Reconcile patients ’statistics]. Follow- up and trace accounts outstanding according to policies and procedures. Ward Administration and provide ward statistics. Typing of Reports. Filing and record keeping and any other records related activities. Provide any other related administrative functions as required from time to time.

af.title: Administratiewe Klerk: Pasient
af.summary: Administratiewe klerke benodig by agt Limpopo hospitale en gesondheidsentrums om pasientinligting vas te lê en opnames en ontslae te hanteer.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies en Ervaring: 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/Graad 12/Matriek plus NQF-vlak 6 in Finansiële Bestuur/Rekeningkunde/Kostebestuursrekeningkunde of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 6 soos erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Moet bereid wees om skofte te werk (insluitend nagskof, naweke en openbare vakansiedae). Rekenaarvaardigheid insluitend MS Outlook, Word, Excel en PowerPoint; Vaardigheid in virtuele vergaderplatforms. Bereidwilligheid om kort kennisgewing ekstra ure te werk. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie, behalwe vir persone met gestremdhede. Kennis en Vaardighede: Administratiewe pligte. Kennis van rekordhouding en argiefprosedures/pasientfakturering. Vermoë om verantwoordelikheid en aanspreeklikheid te aanvaar en onafhanklik en sonder toesig te werk.
af.duties: Vaslegging van pasiente se inligting op PHIS/DHIS en onderhou enige ander vereiste gesondheidsinligting in die tersaaklike inligtingstelsel in ooreenstemming met die beleide van die departement. Verseker dat ICD10-kodes vir elke diagnose teenoor elke pasient vasgelê word. Opname en ontslag van pasiente. Onderhou pasientafsprake en skeduleer dienooreenkomstig. Verseker dat alle opgeneemde pasiente korrek en betyds in die stelsel ontslaan word volgens ontslagregisters/pasientlêer. Voer pasientoordragte tussen sale en tussen hospitale uit. Bestuur die beweging van pasientlêers in die area van verantwoordelikheid. Fakturering van dienste gelewer [prosedures, farmaseuties, laboratoriumtoetse, bloeddienste ens.] aan pasiente in die toegekende area van verantwoordelikheid in ooreenstemming met ICD-10-kodering en UPFS. Proses die voorbereiding van pasientfakture. Verseker dat die aantal pasiente wat in die stelsel opgeneem is, met alle hospitaalpasientopname- en ontslagregisters versoen. [Versoen pasiente se statistieke]. Opvolg en naspoor van uitstaande rekenings volgens beleide en prosedures. Saaladministrasie en verskaf saalstatistieke. Tik van verslae. Liasseer en rekordhouding en enige ander rekordverwante aktiwiteite. Verskaf enige ander verwante administratiewe funksies soos van tyd tot tyd vereis.

zu.title: Umlobi wokuphathwa kwezomphakathi: Isiguli
zu.summary: Kudingeka abalobi bokuqashwa ema-Limpopo esibhedlela kanye namasikhungo esezempilo ayisishiyagalombili ukuze kubhalwe ulwazi lwesiguli futhi kuphathe ukungena nokuphuma kwabaguli.
zu.requirements: Izifundo nezinqubo: Isitifikedi Sezifundo eziphakeme Kazwelonke/Isigaba se-12/Imatrix kahle nge-NQF level 6 ekuPhathweni kwezimali / ezezimali / ekuPhathweni kwezimali ezibiza noma isitifikedi esilinganayo esiku-NQF level 6 njengokuqashwa yi-South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Izidingo ezibangelwe umsebenzi: Kumele kube khona ukulungela ukusebenza ngokushintshashintsha kwamashifti (okuhlanganisa ukusebenza ebusuku, ngezinsuku zokuphila kanye namaholide omphakathi). Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha okuhlanganisa i-MS Outlook, i-Word, i-Excel ne-PowerPoint; Ukwazi ukusebenzisa izinkundla zokuhlangana ezibonwayo. Ukulungela ukusebenza amahora amaningi ngasese ngokuqashwa okusheshayo. Ilayisense evumelekile lokushayela ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile. Ulwazi namakhono: Imisebenzi yokuphathwa kwezindaba. Ulwazi lokugcina izinkumbulo kanye nezinqubo zokuqoqa ulwazi/ifayela lemali efanele isiguli. Ikhono lokwamukela inxaxheba nokwethembeka nokusebenza ngodwa ngaphandle kokuboniswa.
zu.duties: Ukubhalwa kolwazi lwabaguli kwi-PHIS/DHIS kanye nokugcina ngaphezulu nanoma yiluphi ulwazi lwezempilo oludingekayo ohlelweni lolwazi oluhambisana namapholisi omnyango. Qinisekisa ukuthi amakhodi e-ICD10 abhalwa ngamunye ngamunye ngosulegulwe ngasoguli. Ukungena nokuphuma kwabaguli. Gcina izinkhundla zokuhlangana neziguli bese uzihlela ngokufanele. Ukulungela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abaguli abangeni bakhishwa kahle ngesikhathi ohlelweni njengoba kushiwo kuma-discharge registers/ifayela lesiguli. Yenza ukudluliselwa kwabaguli phakathi kwezindlu zesibhedlela kanye namanye amasibhedlela. Phatha ukunyakaza kwebheja lesiguli endaweni yokusebenza. Ukubheja izinkonzo ezinikezwe [izinqubo, izidakamizwa, izivivinyo zethelwe, izinkonzo zegazi njll.] kubaguli endaweni yokusebenza ehlotshanisiwe ekwenziweni kwamakhodi e-ICD-10 kanye ne-UPFS. Hlela inqubo yokuqinisekisa ukuthi inani labaguli abangenile ohlelweni luhambisana namabhukhu wokungena nokuphuma kwesibhedlela wonke wonke. [Hambanisaulwazi ngabaguli]. Landela futhi uthole ama-akhawunti angeke ahlawulewa njengoba kushiwo ngamapholisi kanye nezinqubo. Ukuphathwa kwendlu yesibhedlela kanye nokunika izibalo zendlu yesibhedlela. Ukuthayipha amabhukhu wokubika. Ukugcina izinkumbulo futhi kunoma yiziphi ezinye izinkundla eziqhathaniswa nokuqoqwa kwezinkumbulo. Nikela nanoma yisiphi isibonakaliso esihlobene nokuphathwa kwezindaba njengoba kudingeka ngezikathi ezithile.

xh.title: Ikhlerk: Yolawulo: Isiguli
xh.summary: Kufuneka abalawuli bolawulo kumazibiko asibhozo eLimpobo nakwiziko ezempilo ukugcina ulwazi lwesiguli nokusebenza ngokuqatshulwa nokukhutshwa kweempazamo.
xh.requirements: Izifundo nokuQonda: Isatifikethi seNqanaba leZiko leSizwe/Grade 12 /Matric plus NQF level 6 kwiLawulo leeMali /uBuhlengwa /uLawulo lweNxibo-mali noma izifundo ezilinganayo kwinqanaba leNQF level 6 njengoko evunywa yiSouth African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Iimfuno zangaphakathi zomsebenzi: Kufuneka abe kulungile ukusebenza ngokutshintsha (kuquka umsebenzi wasebusuku, iiveki zokuphumla namhla zolwa). Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kuquka iMS Outlook, iWord, iExcel nePowerPoint; Ukufunda nokubhala kumaphlatfomu emiboniso yentlanganiso kwi-intanethi. Ukuzithanda ukusebenza iiyure ezongezelelweyo ngesaziso esifutshane. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekileyo. Ulwazi nobuchule: Imisebenzi yolawulo. Ulwazi lokugcina irekhodi nendlela zokulondoloza iifayile /amabilling esiguli. Ukuba nakho ukuzithathela izigqibo nokuziphendulela nokuqonda ukusebenza yedwa ngaphandle kolawulo.
xh.duties: Ukugcina ulwazi lweziguli kwiPHIS/DHIS nokugcina nanoma iluphi na ulwazi olunye lweempilo olufunekayo kwinkqubo yolwazi efanelekileyo ngokomthetho wepolicies yesebe. Qinisekisa ukuba iikhowudi zeICD10 zigcinwa kuyo nayiphi na iyo ngokuchazwe ngabaphandi ngabanye phantsi kwesiguli ngasinye. Ukwenza isicelo ngokungena nokuphuma kweziguli. Gcina uluhlu lwamaxesha okubonakaliswa kweziguli zilandele. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iiguli ezamkelwe ziphume ngokuchanekileyo nangexesha elichanekileyo kwinkqubo ngokweziqhingqi zokuphuma /ifayile yesiguli. Yenza udludlu lwangaphakathi phakathi kwamagumbi nesibhedlele nakwezinye iisibhedle. Lawula uluntu lweefayile ezibhedle kwelinye elisebenza. Lawula iinkonzo ezibizwayo [izicwangciso, izitya, izivivinyo zethutyana, iinkonzo zegazi, n.] kwabaguli kwelinye elisebenza ngokumiselwa kwekhowudi ye-ICD-10 nengaqnelanayo. Lungiselela ukubonelelwa kwesiguli izaziso-mali. Qinisekisa ukuba inani lemiguli engeniswe kwinkqabo idibana nayiphi na ibali elidibana kwisibhedlele. [Qinisekisa izibalo zokubakho kwesiguli]. Landela uphando lwezibalo ezibhedle ngokuhambelana neze miqathango nemithetho yoluntu. Lawulo oluphathekayo kwaye unike izibalo kwigumbi elisebenzayo. Ukuthayipha iingxelo. Ukugcina iifayile ezisebenzayo nakunye na imisebenzi egqithiselwa kwindlela yasekhaya. Unike naniphi na esinye isakhiwo se律 sikaRhulumente njengoko kufuneka ngexesha.

jobs.title: Accounting Clerk [salary Administration]
jobs.salary_text: R237 453 per annum (Level 05) CENTRE             Provincial Office (Polokwane)
jobs.summary: The Department of Health in Limpopo seeks an accounting clerk for salary administration at the Provincial Office in Polokwane.
jobs.requirements: Qualifications and Experience: A National Senior Certificate /Grade 12/Matric at NQF level 6 qualification in Financial Management/Accounting/Cost Management Accounting/Economics at NQF level 6 as recognized by the South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Computer literacy including MS Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint; Literacy in virtual meeting platforms. A valid driver's license except for people with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Basic understanding of Public Sector Financial Administration and the prescription / provision of PFMA and Treasury Regulations. Basic understanding of BAS and PERSAL. Communication skills and interpersonal relations. Ability to accept responsibility and to work independently.

Reconcile and verify all claims received before payments. Capture BAS and PERSAL payments. Ensure that all claims are processed within prescribed timelines. Reconcile payroll on monthly basis. Prepare salary related accruals and payables. Ensure readiness of documents for audit purposes. Perform filing of all documents in the section.

af.title: Rekenaarklerk [salarisadministrasie]
af.summary: Die Departement van Gesondheid in Limpopo soek 'n rekenaarklerk vir salarisadministrasie by die Provinciale Kantoor in Polokwane.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies en Ervaring: 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat /Graad 12/Matriek op NQF-vlak 6-kwalifikasie in Finansiële Bestuur/Rekeningkunde/Kostebestuursrekeningkunde/Ekonomie op NQF-vlak 6 soos erken deur die Suid-Afrikaanse Kwalifikasies-owerheid [SAQA]. Rekenaarvaardigheid insluitend MS Outlook, Word, Excel en PowerPoint; Geletterdheid in virtuele vergaderingsplatforms. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie behalwe vir persone met gestremdhede. Kennis en Vaardighede: Basiese begrip van Publieke Sektor Finansiële Administrasie en die voorskrifte / bepalings van die PFMA en Tesourie-regulasies. Basiese begrip van BAS en PERSAL. Kommunikasievaardighede en interpersoonlike verhoudings. Vermoë om verantwoordelikheid te aanvaar en onafhanklik te werk.
af.duties: Skrap alle salarisverwante uitstaandrekenings. Skrap alle PERSAL-uitsonderings op 'n daaglikse basis. Ontvang en teken alle eise in die eiseregister in. zu.title: Umlobi wezabelo [imapulazi neholo]
zu.summary: I-Department of Health e-Limpopo ifuna umlobi wezabelo wokuphathwa kweholo e-Provincial Office e-Polokwane.
zu.requirements: Izifundo nokuhlolakale: I-National Senior Certificate /Grade 12/Matric ezingeni le-NQF level 6 kumfundweni we-Financial Management/Accounting/Cost Management Accounting/Economics ezingeni le-NQF level 6 njengoba kunikwa amandla yi-South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha okuhlanganisa i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint; Ulwazi mayelana namapulatifomu emihlangano ye-inthanethi. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile. Ulwazi nobuchule: Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo kokuphathwa kwezimali kwesekthe kahulumeni kanye nemiyalo/nemithetho ye-PFMA kanye ne-Treasury Regulations. Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo mayelana ne-BAS kanye ne-PERSAL. Amakhono okuxhumana nobuhlobo phakathi kwabantu. Ikhono lokuthatha inxaxheba nokusebenza ngokuzimele.
zu.duties: Cacisa wonke ama-akhawunti we-suspense ahlobene neholo. Cacisa wonke amaphutha e-PERSAL nsuku zonke. Thola futhi urekhode wonke amafomu wemibhalo ohwini kwemibhalo yamafomu. Hambisanisa futhi qinisekisa wonke amafomu etholwe ngaphambi kokukhokha. Faka ngekhompuyutha izinkokhelo ze-BAS kanye ne-PERSAL. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amafomu aqashwa ngaphakathi kwezinsuku ezimisiwe. Hambisanisa uhlu lweholo nyanga zonke. Lungisa izimali eziphathelene neholo ezibhekiswe phambili kanye nalezo okufanele zikhokhwe. Qinisekisa ukulungele ukutholakala kwemibhalo ngenjongo yokuhlola. Yenza ifayela leziqu zizonke endaweni nendaweni.

xh.title: Umntwini ohlala iisetti ezimali [ilawulo lomvuzo]
xh.summary: Isebe lezeMpilo eLimpopo lifuna umntwini ohlala iisetti ezimali ukulawula umvuzo kwi-Office yePhondo ePolokwane.
xh.requirements: Izifundo nokuQonda: Isatifikethi seNqanaba leSizwe /Grade 12/Matric kwinqanaba le-NQF 6 kwisifundo seLawulo lweMali /uKubala iMali/uKubala iMali yeXabiso/izoQoqosho kwinqanaba le-NQF 6 njengokuqatshwa yiSouth African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Ukuba nawolwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha kuquka i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel ne-PowerPoint; Ulwazi kumathform eentlanganiso ezenziwa ngokwendalo. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubekileyo. Ulwazi naye Namava: Ukuqonda okusesiseko ngokuLawulwa kweMali yoNyaka woWoLuntu kunye nemithetho /iimveliso ze-PFMA kunye nezeMvisiwo zeTreasury. Ukuqonda okusesiseko nge-BAS ne-PERSAL. Amandla okunxibelelana nabantu nokuxhumanisa. Amandla okwamkela ixanduva nasebenza ngodwa.
xh.duties: Kucocwe onke ama-accounts ohlobo lomvuzo alibazisekayo. Kucocwe zonke iingxaki ze-PERSAL nsuku zonke. Kwamkelwe kubhalwe zonke iingcala kwirejista yeengcala. Kuqinisiswe kuqaliswe zonke iingcala ezifunyenwe ngaphambi kokuKhawulelwa. Kungeniswe iintlawulo ze-BAS ne-PERSAL. Kuqinisekiswe ukuba zonke iingcala zisetyenziswa ngexesha elichaziweyo. Kuqinisiswe umvuzo nyanga zonke. Kulungiselelwe onke amaxabiso ahlobene nomvuzo nokuhlawulelwayo. Kuqinisekiswe ukulungelelana kwamaxwebhu ngenjongo yokujongwa ngababalengi. Kwenziwe ukuhlohla kwamaxwebhu kweso saxa.

jobs.title: Provisioning Admin Clerk: Supply Chain Management (X5
jobs.centre: Mopani District Office (X1 Post) Matlala Hospital (X1 Post) Dilokong Hospital (X1 Post) Siloam Hospital (X1 Post) Ellisras Hospital (X1 Post)
jobs.summary: Provisioning admin clerks are sought across five Limpopo health facilities to provide supply chain management clerical and logistical support services, including supplier registration and quotation processing.

Computer literacy including MS Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint; Literacy in virtual meeting platforms. A valid driver's license except for people with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Basic knowledge of supply chain duties and practices as well as the ability to capture data. Operate computer and collecting statistics. Basic knowledge and understanding of the legislative frameworks governing the public service. Basic knowledge of working procedures in terms of the working environment.

Capture specifications on the electronic purchasing system. Place orders, Issue and receive bid documents. Provide secretarial or logistical support during the bid consideration and contract conclusion process. Asset and Inventory Management (verification, stock count, barcoding, stock issue, spot checks, disposals)

af.title: Voorsieningsadministratiefklerk: Verskaffingskettingbestuur (X5
af.summary: Voorsieningsadministratiefklerke word vir vyf Limpopo-gesondheidsfasiliteite gesoek om administratiewe en logistieke ondersteuningsdienste vir verskaffingskettingbestuur te verskaf, insluitend verskafferregistrasie en kwotasieverwerking.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies en Ervaring: 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/Grade 12/Matriek plus 'n N6-kwalifikasie in Verskaffingskettingbestuur/Logistiek/Inkoopsbestuur/Ekonomie/Finansiële Bestuur of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 6 soos erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Rekenaarvaardigheid insluitend MS Outlook, Word, Excel en PowerPoint; Geletterdheid in virtuele vergaderingsplatforms. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie behalwe vir persone met gestremdhede. Kennis en Vaardighede: Basiese kennis van verskaffingskettingpligte en -praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê. Werks met 'n rekenaar en die insamel van statistiek. Basiese kennis en begrip van die wetlike raamwerke wat die openbare diens regeer. Basiese kennis van werksprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing.
af.duties: Verskaf administratiewe en logistieke ondersteuningsdienste vir verskaffingskettingbestuur. Registreer verskaffers op die LOGIS-stelsel. Vra kwotasies aan en ontvang dit. Lui spesifikasies op die elektroniese inkoopstelsel vas. Plaas bestellings, uit en ontvang bieddokumente. Verskaf sekretariële of logistieke ondersteuning tydens die bodoorwegings- en kontrakafsluitingsproses. Bate- en voorraadbestuur (verifikasie, voorraadtelling, stokkeredigering, voorraaduitreiking, steekproewe, besittings)

zu.title: Clerk we-Admin we-Abakhiwe: Ukuphathwa Kwesikweletu (X5
zu.summary: Kfunwa abaclerk be-admin ekubakhiweni emaklinikhini amahlanu e-Limpopo ukuba banikeze izinsizakusebenza zokuphathwa kwesikweletu nokuweseka izimpatho zokulandelana kwenani, okuhlanganisa ukubhaliswa kwabahlinzeki nokucutshungulwa kwamagama okuzayo.
zu.requirements: Izindinganiso nokuhlolwa: I-National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/Matric kanye nesiqu sika-N6 ekuphathweni kwesikweletu/abalawuli/baphathi bokuthenga/ukuphathwa kwezimali noma isiqu esilinganayo ezingeni le-NQF level 6 njengoba setshunqiwe yi-South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha oluhlanganisa i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint; Ulwazi ekusebenziseni izinkundla zokuhlangana ngamazwi ngesikhathi sanamanje. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi olulingene ngemisebenzi nokuqashelwa ekuphathweni kwesikweletu kanye nako ukusebenzisa idatha. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokulonda izibalo. Ulwazi olulingene nokuqonda imithetho ezokubusa imphakathi. Ulwazi olulingene ngemigudu yokusebenza ngokwendawo yokusebenza.
zu.duties: Nikela izinsizakusebenza zokuphathwa kwesikweletu nokuweseka izimpatho. Bhalisa abahlinzeki kwisistimu i-LOGIS. Cela wamukele amagama okuzayo. Faka izinkomba kwesistimu yokuthenga ngamakhompyutha. Faka izinimba zokuthenga yakha, wamukele amadokhumendi wokubamba izinhlamvu zokuthenga. Nikeza abasizayo ngokubhaliswa noma ngezinsizakusebenza ngesikhathi senqubo yokucatshangelwa kwamagama okuthenga kanye nokuqedwa kwezivumelwano. Ukuphathwa kwempahla nesibali ngokuyilonda ngokwemithetho, ukubala izimpahla, ukufaka amabhakodi, ukukhiqiza izimpahla ukuyabhalisa, ukusesa ngokungalindelekile kanye nokulahleka kokuhamba phambili.

xh.title: Iliseki Lolulo Lwezabasebenzi: Lulawulo Lwezixhobo Zokuhamba Nokusetyenziswa (X5
xh.summary: Kufunwa abaliseki bolulo lwezabasebenzi kumaziko amaholo amahlanu eLimpopo ukubonelela iinkonzo zolulo nolwandlalo lwezixhobo zokuhamba nokusetyenziswa, kuquka ukubhalisa kwezixhobo zokuhamba nokusetyenziswa kwaye kuphuhliswe iingxelo zemigca ethengisa ngexabiso.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno: Izatifikethi Nempilo: Isatifikethi Seve Nqanaba Liphezulu/Klasi 12/Imatriki ngenye yamagqabantshintshi eN6 kwiLulawulo Lwezixhobo Zokuhamba Nokusetyenziswa/Imigaqo yokuthengisa/Ukuphatha Ukuthengisa/Ilizoqoqo/UPhatho Lweemali okanye isigqibo esilinganayo kwinqanaba le-NQF level 6 njengoko kugunyaziswe yiSouth African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Ukuzazi ukusebenza ngakompyutha njengoko kubandakanya i-MS Outlook, Word, Excel, ne-PowerPoint; Ulwazi ngokuqhuba iindibano ngeplathfom ezingabonwayo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekileyo. Ulwazi Nemakhono: Ulwazi olusisiqalo ngemisebenzi yolulawulo lwezixhobo zokuhamba nokusetyenziswa nakho ukwazi ukungena idatha. Ukusebenza ngakompyutha nokuqokelela izibalo. Ulwazi olusisiqalo nokulonda ukuqonda kweemithetho ebalawula inkonzo zikawonke-wonke. Ulwazi olusisiqalo ngemigaqo yomsebenzi ngokwemeko yendawo yokusebenza.
xh.duties: Kubonelelwe iinkonzo zolulo nolwandlalo kwiLulawulo Lwezixhobo Zokuhamba Nokusetyenziswa. Kwaye kubhaliswe abathengisi kwinkqubo ye-LOGIS. Kucelwe kwaye kwamkelwe imigca ethengisa ngexabiso. Kungeniswe iinkcazelo kwinkqubo yokupeyinta ngokombane. Kubekwe iiodolo, zikhutshwe kwaye zamkelwe amaxwebhu okuthengisa. Kubonelelwe inkonzo yoluseki okanye lwendlela yokuziphatha ngelixa kuqwalaselwa ukuthengiswa nokugqitywa kwezivumelwano. UPhatho Lweempahla Nakwiliso Yezinto (ukuqinisekisa, ukuqhathanisa izinto, ukubeka ikhowudi, ukuphuma kwezinto, ukuhlola ngelixa, ukulahlwa)

jobs.title: Emergency Care Officer: Grade 3 (SHIFTS)
jobs.centre: Donald Frazer EMS (X1 Post) Giyani EMS (X1 Post) WF Knobel EMS (X1 Post) Tzaneen EMS (X1 Post) Sekororo Hospital (X1 Post)
jobs.summary: Emergency Care Officers are needed across multiple Limpopo EMS bases to provide patient treatment, transport and planned transfers, requiring an ILS qualification and HPCSA registration.

Council of South Africa [HPCSA] as an Ambulance Emergency Assistant (AEA). Current registration with the HPCSA as a Basic Ambulance Assistant or an Ambulance Emergency Assistant (AEA). Inherent requirements of the job: Willingness to do after-hours work and be on call including shift work. Valid driver’s license (C1/ Code 10) with Professional Driving Permit for Passengers. Knowledge And Skills: Understanding Emergency Medical Services and its line of business. Good communication and presentation skills. Understanding of Planned Patient Transport service. Knowledge of clinical practice at ILS level.

Change and replenish surgical sundries and medicals gases and ensured items are disposed of timeously and are exchanged for fresh stock. Assist in maintaining a clean and tidy base and vehicles. Maintain best clinical practices in accordance with quality standards. Perform shift work in accordance with Emergency medical services policy. Participate in in-service training and refresher courses.

af.title: Noodsrampsaaksienningbeampte: Graad 3 (SKOFTE)
af.summary: Noodsaaksienningbeamptes word benodig by verskeie Limpopo EMS-basisse om pasiëntbehandeling, vervoer en beplande oorpligting te verskaf, wat 'n ILS-kwalifikasie en HPCSA-registrasie vereis.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies en Ervaring: 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/Grade 12/Matriek en suksesvol voltooi van 'n toepaslike Intermediate Life Support-kursus (ILS) [Heg kopie aan] wat registrasie by die Health Professions. Council of South Africa [HPCSA] as 'n Ambulance Emergency Assistant (AEA) moontlik maak. Huidige registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Basic Ambulance Assistant of 'n Ambulance Emergency Assistant (AEA). Inherente vereistes van die werk: Bereidwilligheid om buite-ure werk te doen en oproepklaar te wees insluitend skofwerk. Geldige bestuurderslisensie (C1/ Code 10) met Professional Driving Permit for Passengers. Kennis en Vaardighede: Begrip van Emergency Medical Services en sy bedryfslyn. Goeie kommunikasie en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Begrip van Planned Patient Transport-diens. Kennis van kliniese praktyk op ILS-vlak.
af.duties: Behandel en vervoer primêre pasiënte na 'n Gesondheidsfasiliteit vanaf die toneel en tussen Gesondheidsfasiliteite in ooreenstemming met toepaslike protokolle. Voer Planned Patient Transfers (PPT) uit. Verander en vul chirurgiese benodigdhede en mediese gasse aan en verseker dat items betyds weggedoen word en omgeruil word vir vars voorraad. Help om 'n skoon en netjiese basis en voertuie in stand te hou. Handhaaf die beste kliniese praktyke in ooreenstemming met gehaltstandaarde. Doen skofwerk in ooreenstemming met Emergency medical services-beleid. Neem deel in diensopleiding en herhalingskursusse.

zu.title: Inkosi Eziphuthumayo Yezesimo Esiphuthumayo: Izinga 3 (ISHIFTHI)
zu.summary: Izikhulu Zesimo Esiphuthumayo zidingeka kumabhasi amaningi e-Limpopo EMS ukunikeza ukwelashwa kwesiguli, ukuhambisa kanye nokudlulisela okuhleliwe, okudinga izifundo ze-ILS kanye nokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA.
zu.requirements: Izifundo nezinkalo: Isitifikedi Sezwe Esiphezulu/Izinga 12/Isitifikedi sikamatriki futhi uqede ngempumelelo ikhosi efanelekileyo Yeziqu Eziphakathi Zokusekela Impilo (ILS) [Hambisa ikhophi] evumela ukubhaliswa kuKhanseli Yezempilo Esebenzayo YaseNingizimu Afrika [HPCSA] njengomndlankathi Wezimo Eziphuthumayo Wezimpilo (AEA). Ukubhaliswa okwamanje kwi-HPCSA njengomshayeli Ohlangothi Ophansi Wezimpilo noma Umndlankathi Wezimo Eziphuthumayo Wezempilo (AEA). Izidingo ezibangelwe umsebenzi: Ukuze uvume ukusebenza emahoreni ngemva kwezinsuku zokuqasha nokuthi utholwe lapho kuthiwa kuyo kuhlanganise nenhleleleko yokushintsha amashifithi. Ilayisense elivumelekileyo lokushayela (C1/ Ikhodi 10) elinomvumo Oqeqeshiweyo Wokushayela Ohambisa Iziguli. Ulwazi Nobuchule: Ukuqonda Isevisi Yezokwelashwa Eziphuthumayo kanye nomkhakha wayo wemisebenzi. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana kanye nokubukeka. Ukuqonda Isevisi Yokuhambisa Iziguli Ehleliwe. Ulwazi lwemisebenzi yezesempilo ezingeni le-ILS.
zu.duties: Welasha futhi uhamabe izigulu zokuqaya etholakalayo kufasitela lezempilo esuka kwindawo yesenzakalo nakufasitela kuhlanganise nendawo yangaphakathi lezempilo ngokuhambisana namaphrothokholi ahambisanayo. Yenza Ukudlulisela Iziguli Okuhleliwe (PPT). Lushintshuse futhi udalaze izinto zokuhlonga ezinkomo zokuhlonga kanye namagesi ezempilo kanti futhi qinisekisa ukuthi izinto ziyaphephwa ngesikhathi esifanele futhi ziyashintshwa ngokushintsha nakwesisetshenzwa esisha. Siza ekugcineni isisekelo esicocekileyo futhi esicocekileyo kanye nezemoto. Landa izinkambiso ezinhle zezesempilo ngokuhambisana namazinga okugucula. Yenza imisebenzi yeshifithi ngokuhambisana nenhleleleko yesevisi yezokwelashwa eziphuthumayo. Thatha inxaxheba ekubhaleni ngomsebenzi kanye namakhosi okuqeqesha.

xh.title: Nothuleli Wezolonwabo lwezingozi: Inqanaba 3 (ISHIFI)
xh.summary: Kufunekwa abaNothuleli Bezolonwabo lwezingozi kwiziseko ezahlukeneyo ze-EMS kwi-Limpopo ukunika unyango kubaphathiwe, ukuthutha ngakunye nokudlulisa okucwangcisiweyo, kudinga isifundo se-ILS nangabhaliso kwi-HPCSA.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno nemava: Isatifikethi se-Senior Certificate/Grade 12/Matric kwaye uphothule ngempumelelo ikhosi yokuFaneleyo ye-Intermediate Life Support Course (ILS) [Faka ikopi] evumela ukubhalisa kwi-Health Professions. Council of South Africa [HPCSA] njengoba yi-Ambulance Emergency Assistant (AEA). Ukubhalisa ngokwangoku kwi-HPCSA njengoba yi-Basic Ambulance Assistant okanye i-Ambulance Emergency Assistant (AEA). Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ukulungelelaniswa nokwenza umsebenzi wemihla ngemihla emva kweyure kwaye ube kufowuni kuquka nomsebenzi weshifti. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni (C1/ Code 10) ene-Professional Driving Permit for Passengers. Ulwazi namakhono: Ukuqonda i-Emergency Medical Services nendlela yayo yokusebenza. Amakhono amabaleni okuchazwa nokubonakalisa. Ukuqonda inkonzo yokuPlanned Patient Transport. Ulwazi lwendlela yokwenza unyango ezingeni le-ILS.
xh.duties: Nyanga kwaye uthathe abaphathiwe abasemva kwezifo bayise kwiziko lezempiIelo esuka kwindawo yenkokelo kwaye phakathi kwezi ziko ezeMpiIelo ngokwemigaqo ekubalulekileyo. Yenza iPlanned Patient Transfers (PPT). Tshintsha uze ugcwalise izixhobo zokuhlinzekwa kwezokuhomba nangesiGazi lezonyango kwaye qiniseka ukuba izinto zityalwa ngexesha elifanelekileyo zize zityityiswe ngempahla entsha. Nceda ekuhoyeni izehlile kwaye ihlale ihlanjululwe indawo yokuqinisekisa nenyumba ezikwisiseko. Gcina izinto ezilungele ekuqhubeni izenzo ngokwemilinganiselo yemigaqo yekhwalithi. Yenza umsebenzi weshifti ngokwemigaqo yesebe le-Emergency medical services. Thatha inxaxheba kokuqeqeshwa ngaphakathi nakuqeqesho lokuvuselela.

jobs.centre: WF Knobel Hospital (X1 Post) Letaba Hospital (X1 Post) Sekororo Hospital (X1 Post) Lebowakgomo Hospital (X1 Post) Warmbaths Hospital (X1 Post)
jobs.summary: Dental Assistant Grade 1 positions at five Limpopo hospitals requiring Grade 12, a Dental Assisting qualification and current HPCSA registration, offering R225,777 per annum.

Knowledge of regulatory and safety standards [such as CDC and OSHA guidelines], proper personal protective equipment (PPE) use, and Cross – contamination prevention. Understanding patient medical histories, medications, billing codes, and insurance claims processing. Chairside assisting sterilization and instrument management. Diagnostic imaging. Patient data and Records maintenance, Computer literacy, Communication and Patient education, Empathy and Compassion, Organization, Time management, Attention to detail, Teamwork and Adaptability.
jobs.duties: Render Assistance during procedures. Patient comfort care, Sterilise equipment. Render administrative tasks (Front office). af.summary: Tandheelkundige Assistent Graad 1-posisies by vyf Limpopo-hospitale wat Graad 12, 'n Tandheelkundige Assistent-kwalifikasie en huidige HPCSA-registrasie vereis, bied R225,777 per annum.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies en Bevoegdhede: 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/Graad 12/Matriek Sertifikaat plus 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie met die HPCSA as 'n Tandheelkundige Assistent moontlik maak. Voltooiing van 'n geakkrediteerde Hoër Sertifikaat in Tandheelkundige Bystand (NQF Vlak 5). Huidige registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Tandheelkundige Assistent. Kennis en Vaardighede: Begrip van tandnommeringstelsels, mondstrukture en tandheelkundige terminologie vir duidelike kommunikasie met die kliniese spanne. Kennis van regulatoriese en veiligheidsstandaarde [soos CDC- en OSHA-riglyne], behoorlike gebruik van persoonlike beskermingsuitrusting (PPE), en kruisbesmettingvoorkoming. Begrip van pasiënt mediese geskiedenisse, medikasie, faktureeringskodes en versekeringsklasterverwerking. Bystand langs die stoel, sterilisasie en instrumentbestuur. Diagnostiese beelding. zu.title: Umrese Wamazinyo Isigaba 1
zu.summary: Izikhundla zabarese bamazinyo Isigaba 1 emitholampilo emihlanu yakwa-Limpopo esidinga Isigaba 12, iziqu zokuba Ngumrese Wamazinyo nokubhaliswa okusemthethweni ku-HPCSA, inikeza i-R225,777 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Iziqu Namakhono: Isitifikedi Seziqu Eziphezulu Kwezwe/Isigaba 12/Isitifikedi se-Matric kanye nesiqu esifanele esivumela ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengomrese wamazinyo. Ukufeza i-Higher Certificate evunyiwe ekubeni Ngumrese Wamazinyo (NQF Level 5). Ukubhaliswa okwamanje ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomrese wamazinyo. Ukwazi Nokusebenzisa Amakhono: Ukuqonda izinhlelo zokunumbrha amazinyo, izakhiwo zomlomo, namagama okhetho ukuxhumana ngokusobala namateyimu ezokwelapha. Ulwazi lwezimingonqo namazinga okuphepha [njengezokuqondwa kwe-CDC ne-OSHA], ukusetshenziswa kwebhodo yokuvikela umzimbo (PPE), nokuthintela ukungcoliswa kwezinye iziguli. Ukuqonda umlando wezempilo weziguli, imishanguzo, amakhowudi okulethela, nokuqhuba izimangalo zomshwalense. Ukusiza esihlalweni, ukusiza ukucashiswa kwamathuluzi nolawulwa kwamathuluzi. Ukuthwebula izithombe zokuhlolwa. Ukugcina ilwazi leziguli namarekhodi, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuxhumana nokufundisa iziguli, ukuzwelana Nobubele, ukuhleleka, ukuphatha isikhathi, ukuqaphela imininingwane, ukusebenza ndawonye nokuzezelana.
zu.duties: Nika lusizo ngesikhathi kwenziwa izinqubo. Ukunakekelwa kokuzela okuphumule kusiguli, Kuqoqe izisetshenziswa. Yimisebenzi yolawulo (ihhovisi elingaphambili). IMIBUZO: Imibuzo jikelele mayelana nezikhundla ezimashunyweni kufanele ithunyelwe kuMs Hlokoa RE Tel No: (015) 293 6406, uMs Mompei MM Tel No: (015) 293 6126 / uMs Sebake RL Tel No: (015) 293 6426, uMs Sebola MF Tel No: (015) 293 6002 kanye noMs Mothiba JT Tel No: (015) 293 6329 ngesikhathi samasevisi.

xh.title: Umncediweezinyo inqanaba 1
xh.summary: Izithuba zomncediweezinyo inqanaba 1 kumazibuthe amahala eLimpopo afuna iGrade 12, isidanga sokuba ngumncediweezo nokuqinisekiswa okwangoku kwi-HPCSA, sinika umvuzo we-R225,777 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Izidanga nezakhono: Isatifikethi seNational Senior Certificate/ iGrade 12/ isatifikethi seMatric kanye nesidanga esifaneleyo esivumela ukuqinisekiswa kwi-HPCSA njengomncediweezo. Ukuqwalaselwa kweHigher Certificate evisiweyo kumncediwezinyo (iNQF Level 5). Ukuqinisekiswa okwangoku kwi-Houth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomncediweezo. Ulwazi nezakhono: Ukuqonda iinkqubo zokubala amazinyo, iinkqubo zomlomo, nemitsho yezonyo ukuze kuqondakale ukunxibelelwana neqela elisebenzayo ekliniki. Ulwazi ngemigangatho yokuziphatha noku khuseleka [njengoko kumacandelo eCDC neOSHA], ukusetyenziswa kolwazi lokuqinisekisa umzimba (PPE), noku thintela ukusasazwa kwezifo. jobs.title: Driver /messenger
jobs.centre: Helen Franz Hospital (X1 Post) Mokopane Hospital (X1 Post) St Ritas Hospital (X1 Post) Grace Mugodeni CHC (X1 Post) Dr Machupe Mphahlele (X1 Post) Sekororo Hospital (X1 Post) George Masebe Hospital (X1 Post) IREQUIREMENTS   :   Qualifications and Competencies: A National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/Matric or equivalent qualification at NQF level 4 as recognised by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Seven (7) – Twelve [12] months driving experience. Advanced driving skills will be an added advantage. Driver’s License (C1) and Professional Driver Permit (PDP). Shortlisted candidates will also be subjected to a driving test. Knowledge And Skills: Communication, Teamwork, Job Focused learning, Basic literacy and Integrity. Knowledge of Batho Pele Principles. Excellent knowledge of routes and respect for of South African driving law. Personal Attributes: Integrity and professionalism. Attention to detail and accuracy. Accountability and reliability. Proactive and results oriented. Calm under pressure and adaptable to change. Team player. Committed to continuous learning and Batho Pele principles.
jobs.summary: The Department of Health in Limpopo seeks drivers and messengers with Grade 12, a C1 licence and PDP to provide transport and delivery services across seven hospitals and clinics.
jobs.duties: Provide safe and punctual driving services to the department. Regular checking and follow up of the driver plans. Collect, deliver, pack and secure goods and services for the department. Transport officials and patients to different destinations. Deliver correspondence to government authorities / organisations and assist in processing various vehicle permits. Vehicle maintenance: daily check of oil, water, brake fluid, cleaning of vehicle, battery and tyres properly and keep the official vehicles in clean condition, both inside and outside. Ensure that the vehicle has an adequate fuel level at all times. Ensure vehicles are serviced on time and schedule vehicle servicing time with Logistics Officer. Ensure sound running of the vehicles assigned, report and arrange minor repairs where necessary. Keep track of timely car license renewals.
jobs.enquiries: General enquiries about the advertised posts should be directed to Ms Hlokoa RE Tel No: (015) 293 6406, Ms Mompei MM Tel No: (015) 293 6126 / Ms Sebake RL Tel No: (015) 293 6426, Ms Sebola MF Tel No: (015) 293 6002 and Ms Mothiba JT Tel No: (015) 293 6329 during office hours.

af.title: Bestuurder/boodskapper
af.summary: Die Department of Health in Limpopo soek bestuurders en boodskappers met Graad 12, 'n C1-lisensie en PDP om vervoer- en afleweringsdienste by sewe hospitale en klinieke te verskaf.
af.duties: Verskaf veilige en tydige bestuursdienste aan die departement. Gereelde nagaan en opvolg van die bestuursplanne. Versamel, lewer, pak en beveilig goedere en dienste vir die departement. Vervoer amptenare en pasiënte na verskeie bestemmings. Lewer korrespondensie aan regeringsowerhede/organisasies en help met die verwerking van verskeie voertuigpermitte. Voertuigonderhoud: daaglikse nagaan van olie, water, remvloeistof, skoonmaak van voertuig, battery en bande deeglik en hou die amptelike voertuie in skoon toestand, beide binne en buite. Verseker dat die voertuig te alle tye 'n voldoende brandstofvlak het. Verseker dat voertuie betyds gedien word en skeduleer voertuigdienstye met die Logistieke beampte. Verseker die behoorlike funksionering van die toegewysde voertuie, rapporteer en reël klein herstelwerk waar nodig. Hou tredes met die tydige hernuwing van voertuiglisensies.

zu.title: Umshayeli / umthumeli
zu.summary: I-Department of Health e-Limpopo ifuna abashayeli nabathumeli abane-Grade 12, ilayisense le-C1 ne-PDP ukuthi bahlinze ngezinsizakalo zokuthutha nokuletha ezibhedlela nakemitari eyisikhombisa.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokushayela eziphephile nasezikhathini ezifanele umnyango. Ukuhlola njalo futhi kulandele izinhlela zomshayeli. Qoqa, thwala, faka futhi uvikele izimpahla nezinsizakalo zomnyango. Thutha abasebenzi kanye nabezigula kwezinhlobonhlobo zezindawo. Thumela izincwadi ezinhlanganweni zahulumeni / ezinhlanganweni futhi usize ekucubunguleni izimpahla zezimoto ezahlukene. Ukugcinwa kwemoto: ukuhlola nsuku zonke amafutha, amanzi, umthombo wokumisa, ukucwayiza imoto, ibhathiri namatayi ngendlela efanele futhi zigcotine izimoto zikahulumeni zicoke, ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Qinisekisa ukuthi imoto inamafutha ayanele njalo sonke isikhathi. Qinisekisa ukuthi izimoto zikhonwa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi futhi hlela isikhathi sokukhonwa kwemoto ne-Logistics Officer. Qinisekisa ukugijima okuhle kwezimoto ezinikiwe, bika futhi uhlele ukulungiswa okuncane lapho kudingeka khona. Gcina ulwazi lokuqala kabushwa amalayisensi wemoto esikhathini.

xh.title: Umshayeli /ithumbe
xh.summary: Isebe lezeMpilo eLimpopo lifuna abashayeli nabaThumbe abaneQadi le-12, ilayisenisi ye-C1 nePDP ukubonelela iinkonzo zothutho nokuhanjiswa kwezinto kumazwe angama-7 esibhedlele nakwiikliniki.
xh.duties: Bonezela iinkonzo zokushayela ezikhuselekileyo nasezigabeni ezifanelekileyo kwisebe. Ukuhlola ngokuqhubeko noku landelela iindwendwe zomshayeli. Qokelela, hambisa, packa uze ugcine izinto neenkonzo kwisebe. Thutha abasebenzi negulane kumawonke ahlukeneyo. Hambisa iincwadana kubalawuli baseburhulumente / iimbumba/ngeziko ezahlukeneyo, uthsese ekuqhubisweni kweepermits ezahlukileyo zesithuthi. Ukugcina isithuthi: ukuhlola nsuku zonke amafutha, amanzi, i-brake fluid, ukucocha isithuthi, ibhatri netayara ngokuchanekileyo, uze ugcinise isithuthi esisesidlangalaleni sicoceke, ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Qinisekisa ukuba isithuthi sinamafutha awanele ngalo lonke ixesha. Qinisekisa ukuba izithuthi ziyasebukezelwa ngexesha elichanekileyo uze ulungise ixesha lokusebukezela kwesithuthi noMlawuli we-Logistics. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa okuchanekileyo kwezithuthi ezinikiweyo, ixela uze ulungise izinto ezincinci xa kuyimfuneko. Qinisekisa ukuvuselelwa kwamalayisenisi ezithuthi ngexesha elichanekileyo.

af.title: Telekommunikasie-operateur (SKOFTE)
af.summary: Twee telekommunikasie-operateur skofposisies by George Masebe en Siloam Hospitale in Limpopo, wat Graad 12 en rekenaarvaardigheid vereis.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/Graad 12/Matrik of NQF vlak 4 soos erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. 'n Oproepsentrum-kwalifikasie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Bereidwilligheid om buite-ure werk te doen en oproepbaar te wees, insluitend skofwerk. Rekenaarvaardigheid insluitend MS Outlook, Word, Excel en PowerPoint, vaardigheid in virtuele vergaderingsplatforms. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis of begrip van Batho Pele-beginsels. Telefoonetiket. af.duties: Ontvang en rig telefoonoproepe. Maak oproepe en hou rekords. Neem boodskappe neer en stuur dit deur. Rapporteer foutiewe lyne vir herstelwerk.

zu.title: Telecom Operator (SHIFTS)
zu.summary: Amaphuzu amabili we-telecom operator shift e-George Masebe nasemapitala i-Siloam e-Limpopo, adinga i-Grade 12 nokusebenzisana nekhompyutha.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samabanga aphezulu esiNingizimu Afrika/Grade 12/Matric noma i-NQF level 4 njengokuqashelwa yi-South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. af.summary: Verpleegassistentposte by drie Limpopo hospitale wat SANC-registrasie en Graad 12 met toepaslike kwalifikasie vereis, en skofwerk in pasiëntesorg behels.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies en Ervaring: 'n National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/Matric plus 'n kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as Verpleegassistent moontlik maak. Huidige registrasie by die SANC as Verpleegassistent. Graad 1: geen na registrasie as 'n Verpleegassistent by die SANC nie. Graad 2: 'n minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/erkenningwaardige ervaring as Verpleegassistent na registrasie by die SANC. Graad 3: 'n minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike ervaring na registrasie as Verpleegassistent met toepaslike/erkenningwaardige ervaring in verpleging na registrasie by die SANC. Bereidwilligheid om buite-kantoorure werk te doen en oproepbaar te wees, insluitend skofwerk. Kennis en Vaardighede: Basiese kennis van wette wat die beroep regeer. Basiese verpleegvaardighede. Kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Professionaliteit en etiese praktyk. Spanwerk en samewerking. Waarneming en verslagdoening. Gesondheidsopvoedingsondersteuning. Deurlopende leer.

zu.title: umsizi wezokwelapha: izinga 1 - 3 (ISHIFTHI)
zu.summary: Izikhundla zabasizi bezokwelapha kulezi zibhedlela ezintathu ze-Limpopo ezidinga ukubhaliswa ku-SANC kanye ne-Grade 12 noma iziqu ezihambisanayo, okubandakanya ukusebenza ngamashiftha ekunakekelweni kwabaguli.
zu.requirements: Iziqu nokuhlangenwe nakho: Isitifikedi se-National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/ Matric kanye nesiqu esivumela ukubhaliswa ku-SANC njengomsizi wezokwelapha. Ukubhaliswa njengamanje ku-SANC njengomsizi wezokwelapha. Izinga 1: akukho okudingekayo ngemva kokubhaliswa njengomsizi wezokwelapha ku-SANC. Izinga 2: okungenani iminyaka engu-10 yokuhlangenwe nakho okuhambelanayo / okutholakalayo njengomsizi wezokwelapha ngemva kokubhaliswa ku-SANC. Izinga 3: okungenani iminyaka engu-20 yokuhlangenwe nakho okuhambelanayo ngemva kokubhaliswa njengomsizi wezokwelapha okuhambelanayo / okutholakalayo kwabezokwelapha ngemva kokubhaliswa ku-SANC. Ukuzithoba ukwenza umsebenzi wemahora engavamile nokuba thintana nabantu kubandakanya ukusebenza ngamashiftha. Ulwazi nobuchwepheshe: Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngemithetho ebusa inqubo. Ubuchwepheshe obuyisisekelo bezokwelapha. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu nokwazi ukusebenza nabantu. Ukuziphatha ngobungcweti nokuziphatha ngokulunga. Ukusebenza njengqembu nokubambisana. Ukwazi ukugqamisa nokubika. Ukusekela kolwazi ngezempilo. Ukufunda ngokuqhubekayo.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha inqubo yokunakekela ngaphakathi kwesibopho sokusebenza somsizi wezokwelapha. Ukusiza abagulu ngomsebenzi wansuku zonke (ukunakekelwa okuzijwayelekile). Ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kwezokwelapha okuyisisekelo. Ukugcina ukukhula ngobungcweti / izinga zokuziphatha nokuzithuthukisa. xh.requirements: Izifundo nokuQeqesho: Isatifikethi seQela lesiNazo Lesizwe/iGreyidi 12/iMatric kunye noqeqesho oluvumela ukuqatshelwa kwiSANC njengomncedisi wezempilo. Ukuqatshelwa okwangoku kwiSANC njengomncedisi wezempilo. Inqanaba 1: akukho nto emva kokuqatshelwa njengomncedisi wezempilo kwiSANC. Inqanaba 2: ubuncinane leminyaka 10 yamava afanelekileyo / aqatshelwayo kumsebenzi womncedisi wezempilo emva kokuqatshelwa kwiSANC. Inqanaba 3: ubuncinane leminyaka 20 yamava afanelekileyo emva kokuqatshelwa njengomncedisi wezempilo amava afanelekileyo / aqatshelwayo kwezempilo emva kokuqatshelwa njengoko kwiSANC. Ukuza ngomzimba kwenza umsebenzi wemihla ngeyure yokugqiba nokubikwa kuqala kubandakanya nomsebenzi weshifti. Ulwazi nobugcisa: Ulwazi olusiselwini lomthetho olawula inqobo yomsebenzi. Amapupsa obugcisa obusiselwini bezempilo. Unxibelelwano nobugcisa bokwenza unxibelelwano nabantu. Ubungcali nokuziphatha ngokwesithethe. Ukusebenza njengesebe kunye nentsebenziswano. Ukuqwalasela nokubika. Inkxaso yemfundo yezempilo. Ukufunda ngokuqhubeka.
xh.duties: Zenzisa inakekelo yezempilo ngaphakathi kwesithuba senkqubo yomsebenzi yomncedisi wezempilo. Nceda abagulayo nemicimbi yemihla yonke iphila (onakekelo lomzimba). Nikela ngenakekelo elisisiseko lezempilo yoclinal. Londa ukukhula kobungcali / amanqanaba okuziphatha ngokwesithethe nokuziphuhlisa. jobs.centre: Hayani Hospital (X1 Post) Thabazimbi Hospital (X1 Post) Jane Furse Hospital (X1 Post) Lebowakgomo Hospital (X2 Posts) ElimHospital (X1 Post) Malamulele Hospital (X1 Post) Mankweng Hospital (X1 Post) Maphutha Malatji Hospital (X1 Post) Nkhensani Hospital (X2 Posts) Musina Hospital (X1 Post) WF Knobel Hospital (X1 Post)
jobs.summary: Ward attendants needed at multiple Limpopo hospitals to provide cleaning services, supervise subordinates and maintain infection control within wards.
jobs.requirements: Qualifications and Competencies: A National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/Matric or ABET/AET at NQF level 4 as recognised by the South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Exposure in hospital environment and patient care will be an added advantage. Ability to lift persons of varying weights, ability to move and lift heavy equipment and supplies. Ability to work with heavy duty laundry/cleaning equipment. Willing to work with human excreta, fluids including blood. Willing to work with and ability to lift corpses of varying weights. Ability to operate machinery. Ability to be on your feet for a period of up to 12 hours per day. Must be able to work shifts (including night duty, weekends and public holidays). Willingness to work extra hours on short notice. Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of Batho Pele Principles, Occupational Health and Safety Act, 1993. Waste Management. Use of cleaning equipment. Good Communication and customer care skills. Teamwork. Job focused learning. Basic literacy. Integrity.
jobs.duties: Render cleaning services. Ensure safekeeping of cleaning equipment. Supervise subordinates. Perform household activities within the ward. Render sluice functions [human excreta fluids including blood]. Maintain infection, prevention and control.

af.title: Saalbode
af.summary: Saalbodes benodig by verskeie Limpopo-hospitale om skoonmaakdienste te lewer, ondergeskoftes te toesien en infeksiebeheer binne sale te handhaaf.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies en Bevoegdhede: 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/Grade 12/Matrik of ABET/AET op NQF-vlak 4 soos erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Blootstelling in 'n hospitaalomgewing en pasiëntesorg sal 'n voordeel wees. Vermoë om persone van verskillende gewigte op te lig, vermoë om swaar toerusting en voorrade teskuif en op te lig. Vermoë om met swaardienswas-/skoonmaaktoerusting te werk. Gewillig om met menslike ekskrement, vloeistowwe insluitend bloed te werk. Gewillig om met en vermoë om lyke van verskillende gewigte op te lig. Vermoë om masjinerie te bedryf. Vermoë om vir 'n tydperk van tot 12 uur per dag op jou voete te wees. Moet in staat wees om skofte te werk (insluitend nagskof, naweke en openbare vakansiedae). Gewilligheid om ekstra ure op kort kennisgewing te werk. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van Batho Pele-beginsels, Occupational Health and Safety Act, 1993. Afvalbestuur. Gebruik van skoonmaaktoerusting. Goeie kommunikasie- en kliëntesorgvaardighede. Spanwerk. Werkgefokusde leer. Basiese geletterdheid. Integriteit.
af.duties: Lewer skoonmaakdienste. Verseker veilige bewaring van skoonmaaktoerusting. Toesien oor ondergeskoftes. Voer huishoudelike aktiwiteite binne die saal uit. Lewer spoelfunksies [menslike ekskrement, vloeistowwe insluitend bloed]. Handhaaf infeksievoorkoming en -beheer.

zu.title: Umgcini Weziguli
zu.summary: Abagcini beziguli badingwa emitholampilo eminingi yakwa Limpopo ukunikeza izinsiza zokucwasha, ukulawula abangaphansi kanye nokugcina ukulawulwa kokutheleleka phakathi kweziguli.
zu.requirements: Izifundo namakhono: Isitifiketi Sabazali seNingizimu Afrika/Umthamo 12/iMatrik noma i-ABET/AET kwizinga le-NQF 4 njengoba kunakekelwa yi-South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Ukuvezwa emkhakheni wesibhedlela nasekunakekelweni kwezigulu kuzoba yinzuzo. Ikono lokuphakamisa abantu abanesisindo esihlukahlukene, ikono lokuhambisa nokuphakamisa izisetshenziswa ezisindayo kanye nezimpahla. Ikono lokusebenza ngesisetshenziswa esisindayo sokugeza/ngokucwasha. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza nokuphatha amakhosi omuntu, uketshezi kuhlanganise igazi. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza naye ukuba nenkos yokuphakamisa amadoda abafa abanesisindo esihlukahlukene. Ikono lokusebenzisa izinsiza. Ikono lokuma emilenzeni isikhathi eside esifika emahoreni angu-12 ngosuku. Kumele ukwazi ukusebenza ngokuphindwe kwezikhathi (kuhlanganise isabelo sobusuku, amasonto ongazuva lomsebenzi). Ukuzithoba ukusebenza amahora engeziwe ngosuku oluncane lokwazisa. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi lwezingumo zikaBatho Pele, i-Occupational Health and Safety Act, 1993. Ukuphathwa kokuhlakaza. Ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zokucwasha. Ukuxhumana okuhle namakhono okukhathalela abathengi. Ukusebenza njengeqembu. Ukufunda okugxile emsebenzeni. Ukubhala nokufunda okulula. Ukuzithiba.
zu.duties: Nikeza izinsiza zokucwasha. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kokuphepha kwezinsiza zokucwasha. Lawula abangaphansi. Yenza imisebenzi yasekhaya phakathi kwesiguli. Nikeza imisebenzi yokuhlanzela [amakhosi omuntu oketshezi kuhlanganise igazi]. Gcina ukulawulwa kokutheleleka, ukuvikela nokulawula.

xh.title: Umgcini weWadi
xh.summary: Kuyafuneka abagcini bewadi kwiizibhedlele ezininzi zaseLimpopo ukunika iinkonzo zokucofa, ukulawula abangaphansi kwabo nokugcina ulawulo lotyhefayo ngaphakathi kwamawadi.
xh.requirements: Izifundo nokuzipatha: I-Certificate yomZwe yabaMva/Banga le-12/iMatric okanye i-ABET/AET kwinqanaba le-NQF 4 njengokuqatshwa yiSouth African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Ulwazi kwindawo yesibhedlele nokuqonda abagula kuya kuba lusizo. Ikhono lokuphakamisa abantu abanobunzima obuhlukeneyo, ikhono lokushukuma nokuphakamisa izixhobo nezinto ezinzima. Ikhono lokusebenza ngezixhobo zokucofa/okuhlamba ezinzima. Ukuze ukulunge ukusebenza nobundebe bomntu, amanzi anegazi eliqulethe. Ukuze ukulunge ukusebenza naye nokuba nakhono ukuphakamisa amathambo abantu abanobunzima obuhlukeneyo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngemishini. Ikhono lokuqhuba ixesha elide elide unyaka de kube ngangoyi 12 iiyure ngosuku. Kufuneka ukwazi ukusebenza kumashifthi (kuqukiyela umsebenzi wabusuku, iiveki zamaxe pha nentsuku zikahulumende). jobs.title: Handyman
jobs.centre: Siloam Hospital [X1 Post] Mopani District Office [X1 Post]
jobs.summary: The Department of Health seeks two handymen at Siloam Hospital and Mopani District Office to maintain buildings, carry out repairs and assist with emergency breakdowns.
jobs.requirements: Qualifications and Competencies: A National Senior Certificate /Grade 12/Matric ABET / AET at NQF level 4 qualification as recognised by the South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Appropriate verifiable competencies in carpentry and joinery, repairs and installations. Inherent requirements of the job: Ability to use industrial woodwork machinery and electrical power tools etc. Willingness to perform shifts hours, weekend, public holidays and standby duties. Must be physically able to perform duties required. Knowledge And Skills: Conversant with the requirements of the General Machinery Regulations and the Occupational Health and Safety Acts.
jobs.duties: Undertake the maintenance of buildings. Carry out minor repairs and maintenance to hospital building. Assist with repairs and emergency breakdowns (including after-hours repairs). Maintain and repair equipment, repair of plant equipment, furniture, fixtures and mechanical fittings.
jobs.enquiries: General enquiries about the advertised posts should be directed to Ms Hlokoa RE Tel No: (015) 293 6406, Ms Mompei MM at 015 293 6126 / Ms Sebake RL Tel No: (015) 293 6426, Ms Sebola MF Tel No: (015) 293 6002 and Ms Mothiba JT Tel No: (015) 293 6329 during office hours.
