af.title: Handwerkman
af.summary: Die Department of Health soek twee handwerkmans by Siloam Hospital en Mopani District Office om geboue te onderhou, herstelwerk uit te voer en met noodgevalle te help.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies en Bevoegdhede: 'n National Senior Certificate /Grade 12/Matric ABET / 'n AET-kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 4 soos deur die South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA] erken word. Toepaslike verifieerbare bevoegdhede in skrynwerk en tintelmakery, herstelwerk en installasies. Inherente vereistes van die pos: Vermoë om industriële houtwerkmasjinerie en elektriese kraggereedskap ens. te gebruik. Bereidwilligheid om skofure, naweke, openbare vakansiedae en standby-pligte te verrig. Moet fisies in staat wees om vereiste pligte te verrig. Kennis en Vaardighede: Vertroud met die vereistes van die General Machinery Regulations en die Occupational Health and Safety Acts.
af.duties: Onderneem die onderhoud van geboue. Voer klein herstelwerk en onderhoud aan hospitaalgeboue uit. Bystand met herstelwerk en noodgevalle (insluitend na-uurse herstelwerk). Onderhou en herstel toerusting, herstel van aanlegtoerusting, meubels, fiksture en meganiese passing.

zu.title: Umuntu ozenzela imisebenzi yezandla
zu.summary: Umnyango we-Health ufuna abasebenzi ababili abenza imisebenzi yezandla e-Siloam Hospital nase-Mopani District Office ukuze bagcine izakhiwo, benze izilungiso futhi basize ezimeni eziphuthumayo zokuwohloka.
zu.requirements: Izifundo namanethuba: Isitifikedi se-National Senior Certificate /Grade 12/Matric ABET / AET ngesizinga se-NQF level 4 njengoba kuqashelwe yi-South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Amanethuba abonakalayo afanele ebunjini bezinkuni nasekuhlanganisweni kwazo, ekulungiseni nasekufakeni izinto. Izidingo ezingokwemvelo komsebenzi: Ikono lokusebenzisa imishini yensimbi yezinkuni kanye namathuluzi amabhanyabhanya kagesi njll. Ukuzithoba ekwenzeni amahoursi okushintshana, ngezasonto, ngezikhathi zeholide zomphakathi nasekubeni yilungo elilungele ukubizwa. Kumele ukube ngokomzimba ukwazi ukwenza imisebenzi edingekayo. Ulwazi nanamakhono: Ukwazi izidingo ze-General Machinery Regulations kanye ne-Occupational Health and Safety Acts.
zu.duties: Bamba iqhaza ekugcineni izakhiwo. Yenza izilungiso ezincane nokugcinwa kwezakhiwo zesibhedlela. Siza ekulungiseni nasezimeni eziphuthumayo zokuwohloka (kuhlanganise ukulungiswa ngemva kohoursi). Gcina futhi ulungise izisetshenziswa, ukulungiswa kwemishini yentshiza, ifenitsha, izinto eziyisihluthulelo kanye nezinhlanganisela zomshini.

xh.title: Umenzi wemisebenzi yezandla
xh.summary: Isebe lezeempilo lifuna ababenzi bemisebenzi yezandla ababini esibhedlele iSiloam nakwiOfisi yesiQondo saseMopani ukugcina izakhiwo, ukwenza izilungiso nokunceda ngokuphuluka kwezinto ngokutsha kwayo.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno: Isatifikethi seQonga laseMzantsi Afrika / Indidi le-12 / I-Matric ABET / I-AET kwinqanaba le-NQF 4 njengokuqatshwa yi-South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Ukuzinza okufanelekileyo okungaqinisekiswa kokwenza izinto zokutyela nokuqhotywa, izilungiso nokuseka izinto. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi kwomsebenzi: Ukuba nelo lokusebenzisa iimachine zokubaza ngezandla namathulusi amandla kagesi njl. Ukuzithanda ukwenza imisebenzi yeshifu, ngaphezu kwemini, ngeentsuku zokuphumla kolonke ukube kumi kwaye ukulungele ukwenza imisebenzi yokulindela. Kufuneki ukwazi ngokomzimba ukwenza imisebenzi efunekayo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ukuqonda iimfuno ze-General Machinery Regulations ne-Occupational Health and Safety Acts.
xh.duties: Ukugcina izakhiwo. Ukwenza izilungiso ezincinci nogcino kuzakhiwo zesibhedlele. Ukunceda ngokulungisa nokuphuluka kwemiba ngokutsha kwayo (kuquka izilungiso ngemva kweeyure zomsebenzi). Ukugcina nokulungisa izixhobo, ukulungisa izixhobo zokusebenzela, iifanitsha, izinto eziyiyo neefitingi ezisebenza ngamandla.

jobs.title: Food Service AID
jobs.centre: Letaba Hospital (X1 Post) Pietersburg Hospital (X1 Post) St Ritas Hospital (X1 Post) Maphutha Malatji Hospital (X1 Post)
jobs.summary: Food Service Aid positions at four Limpopo hospitals requiring Grade 12 plus a Hospitality Management certificate, with duties including food preparation, hygiene maintenance and kitchen cleaning.
jobs.requirements: Qualification and Competencies: A National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/Matric plus Certificate/National Vocational certificate in Hospitality Management from TVET or equivalent. Appropriate competencies in a Food service unit. Ability to lift and move heavy equipment and supplies. Ability to be on your feet for a period of 12 hours per day. Ability to work shifts during the day, weekends and public holidays. Knowledge And Skills: Ability to prepare meals according to standardised recipes and menus, as well as safely and correctly handle industrial equipment. Basic knowledge of the food service hygiene and safety principles. Handle conflict management. Knowledge of supplies, equipment, and/or services ordering and inventory control. Ability to follow routine verbal and written instructions. Ability to read and write. Ability to understand and follow safety procedures. Ability to safely use cleaning equipment and supplies. Ability to lead and train students. Ability to lift and manipulate heavy objects. Knowledge of food service lines set-up and temperature requirements. Skill in cooking and preparing a variety of foods.
jobs.duties: Perform all tasks emanating from the preparation and serving of food. Maintain safety and hygiene standards. Assist in the receiving and safe storage of food and other products. Assist with the informal in-service training of new employees. Clean and purify the kitchen, canteen and equipment. Deliver and Collect food warmers & trolleys from the wards according to the number of patients. Promote and maintain safety in the kitchen. Comply with Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point [HACCP] on food handling and preparations to ensure food safety. Ensure that daily activities are in-line with the Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point [HACCP]. Pre-preparation and cooking of food for normal diet as per standardized recipes. Pre-preparation and cooking of food for therapeutic diet as per standardized recipes. Portion and serve (plating or bulk serving) and pack meal delivery carts according to the wards diet lists. Push meal delivery carts to wards to deliver food as per ward list. Collect meal delivery carts from the wards after serving each meal. Place servings in blender to make foods for soft or liquid diets. Assist in packing food into storerooms. Packaging and labelling of therapeutic diets as per ward diet list. Place items such as eating utensils and condiments on trays. Apportion and place food servings on plates and trays according to the diet list. Examine filled tray for completeness and places on cart, dumbwaiter, or conveyor belt. Wash dishes and cleans work area, tables, cabinets, and ovens. Collects and place garbage and trash in designated containers. Emptying of waste bins at all times. Clean, wash and maintain work areas including floors, facilities, pots, pans, service ware, utensils and equipment as appropriate to the area of operation. Performs miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned. Handling of Dishwasher and cleaning of equipment and utensils before and after use. Supply clean cutlery and crockery during mealtimes. Report any faults, breakages and illness in the Food Service Unit (FSU). Cleaning of the FSU and food trolleys according to the cleaning schedule and after every meal preparation and serving.
jobs.enquiries: General enquiries about the advertised posts should be directed to Ms Hlokoa RE Tel No: (015) 293 6406, Ms Mompei MM Tel No: (015) 293 6126 / Ms Sebake RL Tel No: (015) 293 6426, Ms Sebola MF Tel No: (015) 293 6002 and Ms Mothiba JT Tel No: (015) 293 6329 during office hours.

af.title: Kosdienshulp
af.summary: Kosdienshulp-poste by vier Limpopo-hospitale wat Graad 12 plus 'n Sertifikaat in Gastehuisbestuur vereis, met pligte wat voedselbereiding, die handhawing van higiëne en skoonmaak van die kombuis insluit.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasie en Bevoegdhede: 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/Graad 12/Matriek plus Sertifikaat/Nasionale Beroepssertifikaat in Gastehuisbestuur van TVET of gelykwaardig. Toepaslike bevoegdhede in 'n kosdienseenheid. Vermoë om swaar toerusting en voorrade op te tel en te beweeg. Vermoë om vir 'n tydperk van 12 uur per dag op jou voete te wees. Vermoë om skofte te werk gedurende die dag, naweke en openbare vakansiedae. Kennis en Vaardighede: Vermoë om maaltye volgens gestandaardiseerde resepte en spyskaarte voor te berei, asook om industriële toerusting veilig en korrek te hanteer. Basiese kennis van die kosdienshigiëne en veiligheidsbeginsels. Hanter konflikbestuur. Kennis van bestelling van voorrade, toerusting en/of dienste en voorraadbeheer. Vermoë om roetine mondelinge en skriftelike instruksies te volg. Vermoë om te lees en te skryf. Vermoë om veiligheidsprosedures te verstaan en te volg. Vermoë om skoonmaaktoerusting en voorrade veilig te gebruik. Vermoë om studente te lei en op te lei. Vermoë om swaar voorwerpe op te tel en te hanteer. Kennis van kosdienslyne-opstelling en temperatuurvereistes. Vaardigheid in die kook en voorbereiding van 'n verskeidenheid voedsel.
af.duties: Voer alle take uit wat voortvloei uit die voorbereiding en opdien van voedsel. Handhaaf veiligheids- en higiënestandaarde. Bystand verleen by die ontvangs en veilige berging van voedsel en ander produkte. Bystand verleen met die informele in-diensopleiding van nuwe werknemers. Maak die kombuis, kafeteria en toerusting skoon en suiwer. Lewer en haal koswarmligte en trollies vanaf die sale af volgens die aantal pasiënte. Bevorder en handhaaf veiligheid in die kombuis. Voldoen aan Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point [HACCP] by voedselhantering en -voorbereiding om voedselveiligheid te verseker. Verseker dat daaglikse aktiwiteite in ooreenstemming is met die Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point [HACCP]. Voorafvoorbereiding en kook van voedsel vir 'n normale dieet volgens gestandaardiseerde resepte. Voorafvoorbereiding en kook van voedsel vir 'n terapeutiese dieet volgens gestandaardiseerde resepte. Portioneer en bedien (bordjies of grootmaatbediening) en pak maaltydafleweringswaentjies volgens die saal se dieetlyste. Stoot maaltydafleweringswaentjies na sale om kos volgens saallys af te lewer. Haal maaltydafleweringswaentjies na die sale terug na die bediening van elke maaltyd. Plaas porsies in 'n blender om voedsel vir sagte of vloeibare diete voor te berei. Bystand verleen by die inpak van voedsel in stoorkamers. Verpakking en etikettering van terapeutiese diete volgens saaldieetlys. Plaas items soos eetgereedskap en geurmiddels op skinkborde. Verdeel en plaas voedselporsies op borde en skinkborde volgens die dieetlys. Ondersoek die voltooide skinkbord vir volledigheid en plaas dit op 'n waentjie, gondelbak of vervoerband. Was skottelgoed en maak die werkarea, tafels, kaste en oonde skoon. Haal en plaas vullis en rommel in aangewysde houers. Ledig asblikke te alle tye. Maak, was en handhaaf werkareas insluitend vloere, fasiliteite, potte, panne, serveergoed, eetgereedskap en toerusting soos toepaslik vir die area van werking. Voer diverse taakverwante pligte uit soos toegewys. Hantering van skottelgoedwasser en skoonmaak van toerusting en eetgereedskap voor en na gebruik. Voorsien skoon eetgereedskap en breekgoed tydens maaltye. Rapporteer enige foute, breekgoed en siekte in die Kosdienseenheid (FSU). Skoonmaak van die FSU en kostrollies volgens die skoonmaakrooster en na elke maaltydvoorbereiding en -bediening.

zu.title: Food Service AID
zu.summary: Izikhundla zika Food Service Aid kwizibhedlela ezine Limpopo ezidinga Grade 12 kanye nesitifikedi se-Hospitality Management, imisebenzi kuhlanganisa ukulungiselela ukudla, ukugcinwa kokuhlanzeka kanye nokuhlanza enkishini.
zu.requirements: Izifundo kanye namakhono afanele: Isitifikedi se-Senior Certificate se-National / Grade 12 / Matric kahlanganye ne-Certificate / isitifikedi se-National Vocational se-Hospitality Management esivela kwi-TVET noma esilinganayo. Ukwazi okufanele enkhiyini yesevisi yokudla. Ukuthwala futhi ususe amathuluzi amakhulu nezimpahla ezisindayo. Ukuthwala ukumiswa izinsuku eziyisikhombisa amahora ayisishiyagalombili ngosuku. Ukuthwala ukuba ngabasebenzi abaqasha ngesikhathi, phakathi nemini, ekupheleni kosuku kanye namaholide. Ulwazi kanye namakhono: Isikhono sokulungiselela izidlo ngaphakathi kwandlela yokupheka kuhlelwe izitayela kanye nemiyalo, kanye nokugcina ngokuphepha futhi ngokufanele amathuluzi woqobo. Ulwazi olusisekelo lwezimilo zokuqasha isimo sokuhlanzeka kokudla kanye nesimo esiphephile. Ukuhambisana kwezinkinga kule imicimbi. Ulwazi lokuthumela izimpahla, amathuluzi, kanye noma ngemisebenzi ukuze ihlelelwe kwezinto okuqashwa kwaye kubhalwe. Isikhono sokulalela imiyalo yokukhuluma nokuqamba okuphila nokubhalwayo. Isikhono sokufunda nokubhala. Isikhono sokuqonda futhi ulandele imiyalo yokuphepha. Isikhono sokusebenzisa ngokuphepha impahla yokuhlanza kanye nezinto ezidinga ukuhlanza. Isikhono sokukhokhela futhi uqeqeshe abafundi. Isikhono sokuphakamisa bese ukwenza ngezitha ezinkulu ezindayo. Ulwazi lokuqasha izinsiza ze-Food Service kanye namazinga okushisa. Isikhono sokupheka kanye nokuqeqesha ukudla ngendlela ezihlukene.
zu.duties: Yenza yonke imisebenzi evela kulokho okulungiselela futhi kukhonze ukudla. Gatula amazinga okuphepha kanye nesimo sokuhlanzeka. Siza ekwamukeleni nasekugcineni ngokuphephile ukudla kanye neminye imikhiqizo. Siza nokolunye ukuqeqeshwa okungekuqeqeshweni olusemthethweni kwabasebenzi abasha. Hlanza futhi usule inkishi, isikhungo sokudla kanye nempahla. Thwala futhi usule izimoto ezigcina ukudla kushisile namathrola ezindaweni zokwelashwa ngokwenani labaguli. Khuthaza futhi ugatule ukuphepha enkishini. Hambisana ne-Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point [HACCP] ekuphathweni nasekulungiseleleni ukudla ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kokudla. Qinisekisa ukuthi imisebenzi yansuku zonke ihambisana ne-Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point [HACCP]. Lokhu okulungiselelwa ngaphambili kanye nokupheka ukudla kwesidlo esijwayelekile njengoba kucacisiwe ezindlekweni ezisemthethweni. Lokhu okulungiselelwa ngaphambili kanye nokupheka ukudla kwesidlo sokwelashwa njengoba kucacisiwe ezindlekweni ezisemthethweni. Hlukanisa futhi ukhonze (ukubeka kwendlalelo noma ukukhonza okuningi) bese uhlela izimoto ezithwala ukudla njengengxenye yohlu lwesidlo sezindawo zokwelashwa. Susa izimoto ezithwala ukudla uye ezindaweni zokwelashwa ukuze uzoyehlela ukudla njengohlu lwendlalelo. Sule izimoto ezithwala ukudla ezindaweni zokwelashwa emva kokukhonza isidlo ngasinye. Beka iziphakelo kwibhhulenda ukwenza ukudla okuthambile noma okumanzi. Siza ekufakeni ukudla endlini yokugcina. Kufakwa kwemibhalo kanye nokubeka amalebula kwamasidlo okwelashwa njengohlu lwesidlo sendawo yokwelashwa. Beka izinto ezinjengempahla yokudla kanye nezinto zikafudunda kwizitrayi. Hlukanisa futhi beke iziphakelo zokudla kwizitrayi njengohlu lwesidlo. Hlola izitrayi ezigcwaliswe ukuze ubone ukuthi zigcwele yini bese uzibeka kwisithwali, kwisikhuluma-mathuluzi, noma esitalazini. Geza izitsha bese uhlanza indawo yokusebenza, amatafule, amakhabethe, kanye nezivule-oveni. Qoqa futhi ufake okuthile okungathandiwe kanye namaphakheji kwiziqukathi ezibekiwe. Ukuphetha okuthile okungenamtshato izibeki ezingcolile ngaso sonke isikhathi. Hlanza, geza futhi ugcinise izindawo zokusebenza kuhlanganise namaphulasi, izindawo, izinkomishi, izibhanxa, izitsha zokukhonza, izinto zokusebenza kanye nempahla njengoba kufanele endaweni yokusebenza. Yenza eminye imisebenzi ehlobene nomsebenzi njengoba uyabeliwe. Uphatha idishiwasha kanye nokuhlanza impahla kanye nezinto zokusebenza ngaphambi nangemva kokuze kusetshenziswa. Nikeza ngesandla esihlanziwe kanye namathilosi ngesikhathi sesidlo. Bika noma yimaphi amaphutha, ukuphuka nokugula enkhiyini yesevisi yokudla (FSU). Ukuhlanza kwe-FSU kanye namathrola okudla ngokushesha ohlelweni lokuqashwa ngemva kwakho konke ukulungiselela nokukhonza ukudla.

xh.title: Umncedi weNkonzo yeKutya
xh.summary: Izithuba zomncedi wenkonzo yekutya kumazibini amane eLimpopo afuna iGreydi 12 kananjalo nesatifikedi seSonkezo soLawulo loMamkela wabakhwelweyo, nomsebenzi oquka ulungiselwa lokutya, ukugcinwa kwezohlwayo nokucocwa kwesibini sokutya.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno namakhono: Isatifikedi seSizwe seSebe phakamileyo/iGreydi 12/Isatifikedi yokugqibela kwesikole kananjalo nesatifikedi/isatifikedi seVocational yaseZwe kwizoLawulo zoMamkela wabakhwelweyo kwiTVET okanye eselinganayo namakhonyo afanelekileyo kwicandelo lenkonzo yekutya. Ikhono lokuphakamisa nokuhambisa izixhobo ezinzima nenz伻bambelo. Ikhono lokumila iiyure ezili12 ngosuku. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokutshintshwa kweeshafthi emini, ngeekhwayiti nakumihla yomthendeleko yomntwonke. Ulwazi namakhono: Ikhono lokulungiselela ukutya ngokwemiqathango namamenyu ezisentloko, nokuphatha ngokhuselekileyo nangendlela elungileyo izixhobo zeshishini. Ulwazi olusisiseko ngeendleba zohlelo lokugcinwa kokuhlaneka nokhuseleko ekutyaneni. Ukuphatha ulawulo looxabano. Ulwazi ngokuoda iziphako, izixhobo, kunye/nokwenzeko kweenkonzo nolawulo lwesibonelelo. Ikhono lokulandela imiyalelo eqhathanisiweyo yoluntu nalebhalweyo. Ikhono lokufunda nokubhala. Ikhono lokuqonda nokulandela iinkqubo zokhuseleko. Ikhono lokusebenzisa ngokukhuselekileyo izixhobo zokucoca kunye nenzimbambelo. Ikhono lokukhokela nokufundisa abafundi. Ikhono lokuphakamisa nokwenza ngamazinkqubo izinto ezinzima. Ulwazi ngokuseta iinkqubo zemigca yekutya neemfuno zobushushu. Ikhono lokupheka nokulungiselela iintlobo ngeentlobo zokutya.
xh.duties: Zonke iinkqubo zomsebenzi ovela kulungiselwe lokutya nokukhothoza ekutyaneni. Zigcinwe ziimfuno zokhuseleko nantle. Ukuncedisa ekwamkeni nokugcineni ngokukhuselekileyo ukutya nanye iimveliso. Ukuncedisa ngokuhlobo lomsebenzi wosuku kubasebenzi abatsha. Kucocwe kuye kuhlanjwe isibini sokutya, icani kunye nezixhobo. Kuhanjiswe kwaze kubuye kuthathwe izixhobo ezigcino ukutya shushu kunye namathrolhi kwiwardi ngokwemivo yomntu ogulayo. Kukhuthazwe kugcinwe ukhuseleko kwisibini sokutya. Kuhambelane nokuchaziweyo kwesisongelo sokutya kwimeko eyingozi (HACCP) kwiphatho nokulungiselwa lokutya ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukhuseleko lokutya. Kuqinisekiswe ukuba imisebenzi yemihla ngemihla ihambelana neHazard Analysis Critical Control Point (HACCP). Ukulungiselela ngaphambili nokupheka ukutya kwesidlo esiqhelekileyo ngokwemiqathango ezisemgangathweni. Ukulungiselela ngaphambili nokupheka ukutya kwesidlo seNzululwazi ngokwemiqathango ezisemgangathweni. Ukuyahlula inxalenye ukutya kwaye kuzinikwe (ngokubeka kwiiiplate okanye ukukhonza ngokusetyenziswa kolwabiwo) bese kupakishwa amathroli okuhambisa ukutya ngokwemivo yokutya kwiwardi. Kuqhweteswe amathroli okuhambisa ukutya kwiwardi ukuyisa ukutya njengoko kubonisiwe kwivo yewardi. Kuthathwe amathroli okuhambisa ukutya kwiwardi emva kokukhonza isidlo ngasinye. Kubekwe izidlo kwi-blender ukwenza ukutya kwamaswidi okanye amanzi. Kuncediswa ekupakisheni ukutya kwindlu zogcino. Kupakishwe kulungqishwe iisidlo zeNzululwazi ngokwemivo yezidlo kwardi. Kubekwe izinto ezinjengesixhobo sokutya nezihombiso zokutya kwitreyi. Kuhlulwe kubekwe inxalenye yesidlo kwiiplate nakwitreyi ngokwemivo yesidlo. Kujongwe ukuba itreyi egcweleyo ihambelana nezinto zonke bese kubekwa kwithrolhi, kwidumbwaita okanye kwibhante yokuqhatha. Kuhlanjwe izitya kwaye kococwe indawo yokusebenza, iitafile, iikhabhathi, kunye neziko. Kuthathwa kubekwa inkunkuma ezithintelweyo kwiithangi ezizodwa. Kuzalazwa iibhokisi zeempazamo nanini na. Kucocwa, kuhanjwa kugcinwa iindawo zokusebenza kuquka amagumbi, iziseko, iipotsi, iipani, izitya zekhonzo, izixhobo zokutya nezinye izixhobo njengoko kufuneka kwindawo yokusebenza. Kwenziwa omnye umsebenzi ongabanjwayo njengoko umiselwe. Ukuphatha umshini wokuhlamba izitya nokucoca izixhobo nezitya phambi nangemva kokuzisebenzisa. Kubonelelwa ngendlela esixhobo esicocekileyo namatshizi ekutyeni ngesikhathi sokuhanjiswa kokutya. Kuxelwe naluphi na usulelo, ukuqhawuka kwezinto nokugula kwindawo yekonzo yekutya (FSU). Kucocwa i-FSU namathrolhi okutya ngokwejadula lokucoca nasemva kwesidlo ngasinye nokulungiselelwa nokukhonza.

jobs.title: General Worker/labourer
jobs.centre: Sekhukhune District Office (X1 Post) Mopani District Office (X1 Post) Vhembe District Office (X1 Post) Capricorn District (X1 Post) Groblersdal Hospital (X1 Post) Bungeni Health Centre (X1 Post) Dilokong Hospital (X1 Post) Seloane Clinic (X1 Post) Mahwelereng Clinic (X1 Post) Lebowakgomo Hospital (X2 Post) Mokopane Hospital (X3 Posts) Mashashane EMS (X1 Post) Siloam Hospital (X1 Post) Klipspruit Clinic (X1 Post) Philadelphia Hospital (X1 Post) Danville Clinic (X1 Post) Donald Frazer Hospital (X1 Post) Jane Furse Hospital (X1 Post) Letaba Hospital (X1 Post) Hayani Hospital (X1 Post) Elim Hospital (X1 Post)
jobs.summary: The Department of Health in Limpopo seeks general workers and labourers for various hospitals, clinics and district offices across the province at salary level 2.
jobs.requirements: Qualification and Competencies: A National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/Matric or ABET/AET at NQF level 4 as recognised by the South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Exposure to the hospital environment and patient care will be an added advantage. Ability to lift and move heavy equipment and supplies. Ability to work with heavy duty Laundry/cleaning equipment. Willing to work with human excreta, fluids including blood. Willingness to work with and ability to lift corpses of varying weights. Ability to operate machinery (lawnmowers and weed eaters). Ability to be on your feet for a period of up to 12 hours per day. Must be able to work shifts (including night duty, weekends, and public holidays). Willingness to work extra hours at short notice. Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of Batho Pele Principles, and occupational Health and Safety Act, 1993 [OHS]. Good communication and customer care skills. Waste Management.
jobs.duties: Perform any of the following duties and/or any other general duties as allocated and directed from time to time per operational needs of the facility: General: Load and offload. Assist Artisans and Tradesmen Aids. Keep tools safe and clean. Maintain the grounds of the facility. Porter: Transport patients using stretcher or wheelchair to / from wards or departments or any other area of the health facility. Carry patients. Take corpses to the mortuary. Clean / wash stretchers and wheelchairs. Minor maintenance of stretchers and wheelchairs. Laundry Aid: Accurate recording of all incoming and outgoing linen on a daily basis to hospital, clinics and EMS services. Correct handling, receiving and dispatch of soiled and clean linen to the wards and clinics according to internal protocol and infection control measures. Cleaning of laundry and laundry equipment on daily basis. Follow and adhere to Health and Safety Regulations. Cleaner: Perform cleaning services in offices, passages, ablution facilities etc. Emptying dustbins & picking up waste. Perform any other cleaning duties. Keep and maintain cleaning equipment and materials safe.
jobs.enquiries: General enquiries about the advertised posts should be directed to Ms Hlokoa RE Tel No: (015) 293 6406, Ms Mompei MM Tel No: (015) 293 6126 / Ms Sebake RL Tel No: (015) 293 6426, Ms Sebola MF Tel No: (015) 293 6002 and Ms Mothiba JT Tel No: (015) 293 6329 during office hours.
jobs.applications: The circular of advertised vacant posts will be posted on the following websites: https://erecruitment.limpopo.gov.za/, www.ldoh.gov.za, www.dpsa.gov.za and Provincial Department social media. Applicants must apply on the following website: https://erecruitment.limpopo.gov.za/

af.title: Algemene Werker/arbeider
af.summary: Die Department of Health in Limpopo soek algemene werkers en arbeiders vir verskeie hospitale, klinieke en distrikkantore regoor die provinsie op salarisvlak 2.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasie en Bevoegdhede: 'n National Senior Certificate/Grade 12/Matric of ABET/AET op NQF-vlak 4 soos erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Blootstelling aan die hospitaalomgewing en pasiëntsorg sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Vermoë om swaar toerusting en voorrade op te tel en te beweeg. Vermoë om met swaardiens was-/skoonmaaktoerusting te werk. Bereidwilligheid om met menslike ekskrement, vloeistowwe insluitend bloed te werk. Bereidwilligheid om met en vermoë om lyke van verskillende gewigte op te tel. Vermoë om masjinerie te bedryf (grasmaaiers en onkruidverwyderaars). Vermoë om tot 12 uur per dag op jou voete te staan. Moet in staat wees om skofte te werk (insluitend nagskof, naweke en openbare vakansiedae). Bereidwilligheid om by kort kennisgewing ekstra ure te werk. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van Batho Pele-beginsels, en die Occupational Health and Safety Act, 1993 [OHS]. Goeie kommunikasie- en klienversorgingsvaardighede. Afvalbestuur.
af.duties: Voer enige van die volgende pligte en/of enige ander algemene pligte uit soos van tyd tot tyd toegeken en gelys volgens operasionele behoeftes van die fasiliteit: Algemeen: Laai en aflaai. Bied hulp aan ambagsmanne en ambagsmanne-assistente. Hou gereedskap veilig en skoon. Onderhou die gronde van die fasiliteit. Draer: Vervoer pasiënte met draagbaar of rolstoel na/van sale of departemente of enige ander area van die gesondheidsfasiliteit. Dra pasiënte. Neem lyke na die lykhuis. Maak/was draagbare en rolstoele. Geringe onderhoud van draagbare en rolstoele. Washuishulp: Akkurate rekordhouding van alle inkomende en uitgaande linne op 'n daaglikse basis aan hospitale, klinieke en EMS-dienste. Korrekte hantering, ontvangs en versending van vuile en skoon linne na die sale en klinieke volgens interne protokol en infeksiebeheermaatreëls. Skoonmaak van die washuise en wasmasjinerie op 'n daaglikse basis. Volg en hou aan aan Gesondheids- en Veiligheidsregulasies. Skoonmaker: Voer skoonmaakdienste uit in kantore, gange, ablusie-fasiliteite ens. Stofblikke leegmaak en afval optel. Voer enige ander skoonmaakpligte uit. Hou en onderhou skoonmaaktoerusting en materiaal veilig.

zu.title: Umsebenzi ovamile/umsebenzi wokuhlinza
zu.summary: IGumbi Lezempilo eLimpopo lifuna abasebenzi abajwayelekile nabahlinzayo kwezinhlekebalimi ezahlukahlukene, amakliniki noma amohlaka ohulumeni bonke esifundazweni izinga leholo 2.
zu.requirements: Izifundo nezikhono: Isitifikadi samatikuletela sibe yisibonelo seNqubelangcono esingathathwa njengengxenye yesitatimende samaMatlandela Iqiniso. Ukuqonda ukusebenza kwesikhungo sezokwelapha nokunakekelwa kweziguli kuzoba yingxenye yesibonelo sokwaziswa komsebenzi. Ukuba nendlela yokuphatha imishini yabasebenzi begodu nokukwazi ukusebenzisa imishini ebingaselikhaya enesibopho. Ukuthanda ukusebenza imisebenzi ekhomba ukuthumela imiphakathi noma imihambo yabantu begodu nokwaziswa kwabantu. Ukuthanda ukusebenza nokwaziswa kokusebenza imisebenzi ehlukileko begodu nokwaziswa kokusebenza. Ukuba nendlela yokusebenza imisebenzi ehlukileko yokusebenza ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwegumbi. Ukuba namandla wokusebenza isikhathi eside ukuya emahoreni 12 ngemini. Kufanele ukube nokwaziswa kokusebenza amasheduli (kuhlanganise ukusebenza ebusuku, amaweekendi, namaholide). Ukuthanda ukusebenza amahora amaningi ngesikhathi esifushane. Ulwazi nemakhono: Ulwazi lwezimiso zeBatho Pele, nomthetho Wezokuphepha komsebenzi nezokuphila, 1993 [OHS]. Ukuxhumana okuhle namakhono okukhuluma noma ukweluleka abathengi. Ukuphatha imfuyo.
zu.duties: Kwenze noma yimuphi umsebenzi olandelayo kanye nanoma yimiphi eminye imisebenzi evamile njengoba odlule bese ethunjwa isikhathi ngesikhathi ngokuhamba kwezidingo zomsebenzi wesikhungo: Imisebenzi evamile: Latha futhi ukhlaze. Siza abangenisa imisebenzi yamasu kanye nabasizi. Gcina izinto zokusebenza zingabeki. Hlola izindawo zesikhungo. Ukuthutha: Thutha iziguli usebenzisa ukhathode noma isihlalo kuya/kusuka emagumbini ohlelo noma kwenye yonke indawo yesikhungo sezokwelapha. Phatha iziguli. Thatha izidumbu siye enkabzendlini. Hlamba ukhathode kanye nama-awulehodi. Ukulungisa okuncane kwekhathode nawawulehodi. Usizo lweziwula: Ukubala ngokunembile yonke imibhede eqa kanye nokuhambe nsuku zonke esibhedlela, amakliniki, kanye nezinkonzo ze-EMS. Ukuphathwa okuhle, ukwamukela kanye nokuthumela imibhede emibi nehlanzekile emagumbini nasemaklinikini ngokuhambisana namasu angaphakathi nezinyathelo zokulawula ukutheleleka. Ukuhlanzwa kweziwula kanye nemishini yezingubo nsuku zonke. Landela futhi uzinikeze emthethweni Wezokuphepha nezokuphila. Ukuhlanza: Yenza imisebenzi yokuqoqezwa emagunyeni, emihandeni, emagumbini okugeza njll. Ukweqa iziqu nezinto ezingathandeki. Yenza noma yimuphi umsebenzi wokuqoqezwa. Gcina futhi ulondoloze imishini kanye nezinto zokuqoqezwa ingabeki.

xh.title: Umsebenzi jikelele/umsebenzi wenkqubo
xh.summary: Isebe lezeMpilo eLimpopo lifuna abasebenzi jikelele nabasebenzi benkqubo kumaziko amaninzi, iikliniki ngeentsapho zeofisi kuyo yonke iphondo kwinqanaba lemvuzo 2.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno namakhono: Isatifikethi seSizwe seNamaphunga/IBanga 12/Imatikhisti okanye i-ABET/i-AET kwinqanaba 4 le-NQF njengokuqatshelwa yiSouth African Qualifications Authority [SAQA]. Ukuvezwa kokusingathiwa kwamakhusito kunye nonyango lwegazi kuya kuba ngelentlengo. Ikhalo lokuphakamisa nokuhambisa izixhobo ezinzima kunye neempahla. Ikhalo lokusebenza ngezixhobo ezinzima zokuhlamba impahla/ukucoca. Ilungelelaniso ukusebenza nokubeka izinto ezingcolisayo zomzimba, namanzi aqukiweyo negazi. Ulawulo lwegazi elingahoyanga.
xh.duties: Yenza nayiphi na kule misebenzi ilandelayo kwaye/noma omnye umsebenzi jikelele njengoko udayimwe kwaye ulungelelaniswe ngokwesidingo semisebenzi yelungelo: Into jikelele: Faka khupha impahla. Amakhona aqondo ukuceba, ukulungelelanisa, izabhalulo nokusombulula iingxaki. Amakhona anamandla okunxibelelana nabantu. Ukuzinikela kumxhasi nokupha impendulo ngokukhawuleza. Manage the implementation of child justice, residential care, rehabilitation and developmental programmes for children in conflict with the law. Ensure compliance with statutory requirements relating to the admission, placement, care, detention, transfer and release of children. Oversee the provision of social work, psychosocial support, educational, therapeutic and reintegration services. Ensure the safety, security, protection and well-being of children and staff. Manage human, financial and physical resources, including staff supervision, performance management and capacity development. Coordinate intersectoral collaboration with relevant government departments and stakeholders to promote the effective administration of child justice, family reunification and social reintegration. Monitor service delivery, maintain accurate records, compile statutory and management reports, and ensure compliance with governance, risk management, occupational health and safety and quality assurance requirements.

af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Baccalaureusgraad in Maatskaplike Werk. Registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Raad vir Sosiale Diensberoepen as Maatskaplike Werker. 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as Maatskaplike Werker by SACSSP, insluitend vyf jaar toesig/ middelbestuurservaring. Geldige bestuurslisensie vir 'n motorvoertuig. Bevoegdhede: Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Verslagskryfvaardighede. Fasiliteringsvaardighede. Koördinasievaardighede. Skakelingsvaardighede. Netwerkwerk. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Leierskapsvaardighede. Analitiese vaardighede. Diplomatiekheid. Veranderings- en kennisbestuur. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Personeelsbestuur. Finansiële bestuur. Probleemoplossing, beplanning en organisering. Tydbestuur. Spanspeler. Strategiese beplanning. Beleidsanalise en -ontwikkeling.
af.duties: Bestuur en gee leiding vir die lewering van gevorderde en gespesialiseerde maatskaplikewerkdienste binne gedefinieerde areas van verantwoordelikheid, rakende die sorg, ondersteuning, beskerming, ontwikkeling en bemagtiging van kwesbare individue, gesinne, groepe en gemeenskappe deur middel van relevante programme en in samewerking met belanghebbendes. Gee strategiese en professionele rigting oor komplekse sosiale toestande en aangeleenthede wat kan lei tot, of voortspruit uit, sosiale onstabiliteit, en verseker toepaslike, geïntegreerde en responsiewe ingrypings. Bestuur, hou toesig en gee professionele leiding aan maatskaplikewerkpersoneel, en bevorder etiese praktyk, professionele verantwoordbaarheid, deurlopende ontwikkeling en die lewering van gehalte-maatskaplikewerkdienste ooreenkomstig toepaslike wetgewing, beleide, professionele standaarde en departementele prioriteite. Neem die leiding met die ontwikkeling, beplanning, implementering, monitering en evaluering van maatskaplikewerkprogramme en -ingrypings, en verseker belyning met departementele strategiese doelwitte en die doeltreffende, ekonomiese en effektiewe benutting van finansiële, menslike en ander hulpbronne. Bestuur die prestasie en ontwikkeling van menslike hulpbronne binne die area van verantwoordelikheid en verseker effektiewe werksmagbeplanning en -ontplooiing om diensleweringprioriteite te ondersteun. Moniteer diensgehalte, professionele nakoming, programme-prestasie en uitkomste, en instelle korrektiewe maatreëls waar nodig. Bou en onderhou strategiese vennootskappe met relevante regeringsdepartemente, nie-regeringsorganisasies, professionele liggame, gemeenskapsstrukture en ander belanghebbendes om geïntegreerde maatskaplike welsynsdienslewering te versterk. Bly op hoogte van ontwikkelinge in die velde van maatskaplike werk, maatskaplike welsyn, beleid en bestuur, en verseker dat relevante navorsing, wetgewing, beleidsontwikkelinge en beste praktyk dienslewering inlig. Verskaf gesaghebbende professionele en bestuursadvies aan senior bestuur oor maatskaplikewerkpraktyk, programme-prestasie, diensstandaarde, professionele bestuur en ontluikende maatskaplike welsynsuitdagings, en verseker die effektiewe uitvoering van administratiewe, finansiële, verslagdoenings-, moniterings-, risikobestuurs- en nakomingsfunksies binne die area van verantwoordelikheid.

zu.title: Umphathi Womsebenzi Wokweluleka: Zwelintlanga Fatman Mgcawu
zu.summary: Phatha futhi uhola ukulethwa kwezinsiza zobuchwepheshe bomsebenzi wokweluleka ezintweni ezingozivungama ngaphandle komnyango wesifunda i-Upington, okudinga iziqu zobuchwepheshe bomsebenzi wokweluleka kanye namawula ayi-10 ubudala.
zu.requirements: Isiqu esifanelekile se-Bachelor's Degree ku-Social Work. Ukuqashelwa ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions njengomsebenzi wokweluleka. Okuncane kakhulu eminyakeni engu-10 yohluvo olufanelekile/oluhlonishwayo ekuwelulekeni emva kokuqashelwa njengomsebenzi wokweluleka ku-SACSSP okuhlanganisa eminyakeni eyisikhombisa yohluvo lobuhlakani/buphathi phakathi nendawo. Ilayisensi yomshayeli wesimoto esemthethweni. Ikhono: Ikhono lokuxhumana kahle. Ikhono lokubhala imibiko. Ikhono lokuqukatha. Ikhono lokuhlanganisa. Ikhono lokuxhumanisa. Ukuxhumana. Ikhono lobuntu. Ikhono lokubusa. Ikhono lokuhlola. Ubumnandi. Ukuphatha shintsho nolwazi. Ikhono lokucwaba futhi uhlele. Ukuphatha abantu. Ukuphatha izimali. Ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukucwaba nokuhlela. Ukuphatha isikhathi. Ukudlala njengelungu leqembu. Ukuhlela ngokuhlosiwe. Ukuhlola nokuthuthukisa amapholisi.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi unikeze isiqondiso ekuletheni izinsiza zobuchwepheshe eziphakeme nangokhethe ngemikhakha ethize ekuhlelelwe ukunakekelwa, ukusekela, ukuvikela, ukuthuthukisa nokunika amandla abantu, emindeni, amaqembu namakhaya abantu abangcolile ngezinhlelo ezifanele nangokubambisana nabalume. Nikeza isiqondiso ngokohlelo nangobuchwepheshe ezimeni ezinzima zomphakathi nasezindabeni ezingase zibangele, noma ezivela, ezingazinzini komphakathi, futhi uqiniseke izithakazelo ezifanele, ezihlanganisiwe futhi ezisabela kahle. Phatha, qapha futhi nikeza isiqondiso sobuchwepheshe abasebenzi bokuweluleka, ukukhuthaza ukuziphatha ngokomthetho, ukuphendula ngobuchwepheshe, ukuthuthuka okuqhubekayo nokuletha izinsiza zobuchwepheshe zobungcwele ngokomthetho osebenzayo, amapholisi, izinga lobuchwepheshe okuhloselwe umnyango. Hola ukuthuthukiswa, ukuhlela, ukusebenzisa, ukuqapha kanye nokuqondisa izinhlelo zokuweluleka futhi ungenele, uqiniseke ukuvumelana nezinhloso ezihleliwe komnyango kanye nokusetshenziswa ngempumelelo, ngokugwema nangokusebenza kwezimali, abantu kanye nezinsiza ezinye. Phatha ukusebenza kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwemithombo yabantu emkhakheni onakekelwayo futhi uqiniseke ukuhlela futhi ukubeka abasebenzi ukuze useke izinhloso zokuletha izinsiza. Qapha izinga lenzuzo, ukuvumelana ngobuchwepheshe, ukusebenza kwezinhlelo kanye nemiphumela, bese ufake izinyathelo zokulungisa lapho kudingeka khona. Yakha futhi ulondoloze ubudlelwano obuhle namaphoyisa omnyango, izinhlangano ezingengowahulumeni, izikhulu zobuchwepheshe, izakhiwo zomphakathi nabanye abalume ukugcizelela ukuhlanganiswa kokuletha izinsiza zokweluleka ezenziwe. Hlala ulwazi ngokuthuthuka ekuwelulekeni, enkusizeni yomphakathi, kumapholisi nasenkundleni yokuphatha, futhi uqiniseke ukuthi ucwaningo, umthetho, ukuthuthuka kwamapholisi kanye nokuqhuba ngokuhlosiwe kusekela ukuletha izinsiza. Nikeza konile ngobuchwepheshe kanye nelesiyo yophathi izeluleko kubaphathi abaphezulu ngokuqhuba umsebenzi wokweluleka, ukusebenza kwezinhlelo, izinga lenzuzo, ukuphatha ngobuchwepheshe kanye nezingozivungama ezibhaxa ezinkundleni yokuletha izinsiza, futhi uqiniseke ukusetshenziswa ngempumelelo kwezinkonzo zokuphatha, izimali, ukubika, ukuqapha, ukuphatha ubungozi kanye nokuvumelana emkhakheni onakekelwayo.

xh.title: Umphathi Womsebenzi Wokwenzela Uluntu: Zwelintlanga Fatman Mgcawu
xh.summary: Lawula uhola nokubonelela ngeenkonzo ezizodwa zomsebenzi wokwenzela uluntu kumntu nomphakathi abasengozini kwindawo yokusebenza yesithili sase Upington, kwaye kufuneka ube nomfungo kumsebenzi wokwenzela uluntu kunye neminyaka elishumi yamava.
xh.requirements: Iqondo elilungileyo le-Bachelor's Degree kumsebenzi wokwenzela uluntu. Ukubhalisa ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions njengomsebenzi wokwenzela uluntu. Ubuncinane beminyaka elishu (10) yamava alungileyo/awaziwayo kumsebenzi wokwenzela uluntu emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wokwenzela uluntu ku-SACSSP, kuquka iminyaka emihlanu yamava okulawuleni abanye/okulawula elingana laphakathi. Ilayisenesi elisebenzayo yokuqhuba imoto. Ikhono lokusebenza: Ikhono elihle lokucinga. Ikhono lokubhala iingxelo. Ikhono lokulungelelisa. Ikhono lokuhambelanisa. Ikhono lokunxibelelana. Ukwakhiwa kweenxibelelwano. Ikhono elihle lokuhamba nabantu. Ikhono lokulawula. Ikhono lokuhlola. Unyamezelo. Ukulawula utshintsho nolwazi. Ikhono lokuceba nokuqamba. Ukulawula abantu. Ukulawula iimali. Ukusombulula iingxaki, ukuceba nokuqamba. Ukulawula ixesha. Ukusebenza njengelungu leqela. Ukuceba iindlela ezikumgangatho ophezulu. Uhlalutyo nokuphuhliswa kweenqobo.
xh.duties: Lawula uze unikeze inkokheli ekuboneleleni ngeenkonzo ezibandakadayo n ezizodwa zomsebenzi wokwenzela uluntu kwimimandla echaziweyo yomsebenzi, ezidityaniswe nokukhathalela, ukuxhasa, ukukhusela, ukuphuhlisa nokuwabusisa abantu abasengozini, usapho, amaqela namaphakathi ngenkqubo ezifanelekileyo nangokusebenzisana nabathintekayo. Nikeza isalathiso esikumgangatho ophezulu nangobuchwepheshe kwiimeko nezinto ezintsonko zentlalontle ezingayisela, okanye ezingavela kuzo, ukungazinzi kwentlalontle, uze uqiniseke ukungenelela okulungileyo, okudityanisiweyo nokusabela kakuhle. Lawula, ulawule uze unikeze inkokheli yobuchwepheshe kwabasebenzi bomsebenzi wokwenzela uluntu, ukhuthaza ukuziphatha ngokweenkqubo, ukuzibophelela ngobuchwepheshe, ukuphuhlisa ngokuqhubekayo nokubonelela ngeenkonzo zomsebenzi wokwenzela uluntu zamgangatho apho kubhekenwe kumthetho osebenzayo, iinkqubo, imigangatho yobuchwepheshe neenkqubela ezibalulekileyo zesebe. Yiba inkokheli ekuphuhlisweni, ukucebeni, ukusebenziseni, ukuqhuba nokuhlola iinkqubo zomsebenzi wokwenzela uluntu noku ngenelelo, uqinisekisa ukuzalathelana neenjongo ezikumgangatho ophezulu zesebe nokusetyenziswa ngokusebenza, kokugqithisela kwindalo, nangokwenza kakuhle kweenkxaso zemali, zabantu nasezinye. Lawula ukusebenza nokuphuhliswa kweenkxabo zabantu kulawulo lwakho uze uqiniseke ukuceba ngokusebenza abasebenzi balungileyo nokubasesandleni ukuze uxhase iinkqubela ezibalulekileyo zokubonelela ngenkonzo. Qokelela ulwazi ngomgangatho wesebe, ukuhambelana ngobuchwepheshe, ukusebenza kwenkqubo nemitsho, uze ufake izindlela zokulungisa apho kufunekayo. Akha uze ulondoloze ubudlelwane obukumgangatho ophezulu namasebe ahlukeneyo karhulumente, iintsebenzo ezingekho kurhulumente, amaqela obuchwepheshe, iimbango zomphakathi nakunye abathintekayo ukuze uqinise inkqubo yeenkonzo ezidityanisiweyo zokwenzela uluntu. Hlala uyazi ngenkqubela kummandla womsebenzi wokwenzela uluntu, ukwenzela uluntu, iinkqubo nokulawula, uze uqiniseke ukuba uphando olufanelekileyo, umthetho, ukuphuhliswa kweenkqubo nendlela elungileyo yokusebenza kuqaqe ubonelelo ngenkonzo. Nikeza ingcebiso egqithisileyo ngobuchwepheshe nokulawula kulawulo oluphezulu malunga nokusebenza komsebenzi wokwenzela uluntu, ukusebenza kwenkqubo, imigangatho yesebe, ukulawula ngobuchwepheshe nemo ezibangelwa zinkqubo zokwenzela uluntu, uze uqiniseke ukuphumeza ngokusebenza kakuhle imisebenzi yolawulo, yemali, yengxelo, yokulawula ingozi nokuzelelwa kolawulo kulawulo lwakho.

jobs.title: Manager: Community Development: Zwelintlanga Fatman
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1-2: R1 009 512 - R1 414 593 per annum, (Salary will be in accordance with OSD Determination)
jobs.closing_date_text: 12 November 2026. It is the sole responsibility of an applicant to ensure that their application reaches the Department on or before the closing date. The Department accepts no responsibility for server delays, connectivity problems or other technical difficulties resulting in late submission. Late applications will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Manage community development interventions at the District Office in Upington, requiring a relevant degree and ten years of experience.
jobs.requirements: An Applicants must possess an appropriate NQF Level 7 Bachelor’s Degree in Community Development / Development Studies / Social Science. Valid motor vehicle driver’s licence. A Minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognisable experience in Community Development after obtaining the required qualification, this must including five years supervisory/middle management experience. Competencies: Good Communication skills. Report writing skills. Facilitation skills. Co-ordination skills. Liaison skills. Networking. Interpersonal skills. Leadership skills. Analytical skills. Diplomacy. Change and knowledge management. Planning and organization skills. People Management. Financial Management. Problem Solving, Planning & organizing. Time Management. Team player. Strategic Planning. Policy analysis and development.
jobs.duties: Manage the identification, facilitation and implementation of integrated development interventions in partnership with the community and other relevant stakeholders through efficient, effective and economical utilization of resources by the unit/sub-directorate. Monitor, interpret and review legislation and policies to determine whether legislation and policies are still relevant and comply with current requirements. Develop proposals to amend/maintain the relevant acts and policies, and develop new policies where required. Manage community development unit/sub directorate to ensure that an efficient and effective community development service is delivered through the proper utilization of human, financial and physical resources. Keep up to date with new developments in the community development and management fields to enhance service delivery. Plan and ensure that research on community development is undertaken. Undertake/facilitate complex community development research.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. Godfrey F Mjezu at 064 880 3202
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application only via https://form.jotform.com/ncdsdev/ncdsd--online-vacancy- application
jobs.notes: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. Kindly note that technical support is only available from Monday to Friday from 8:00 to 16:00. Should you experience any difficulties with your online application you may contact the helpline on 076 424 7850. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (in PDF format) via the link supplied. The new Z83 form can be downloaded at www.dpsa.gov.za-vacancies or obtainable from any Public Service Department. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, ID and driver’s licence before or on the day of the interview. In addition, Social Service Professionals will be required to submit proof or registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) and certificate of service for recognition of previous experience before or on the day of the interview. Failure to comply with these pre-conditions will disqualify applications from being processed. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Correspondence will be limited to short- listed candidates only. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise, and the other will be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to test relevant technical elements of the job, the logistics of which will be communicated by the Department. Selected candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record check, citizenship verification, qualification/study verification and previous employment verification). Successful candidates will also be subjected to security clearance processes. Successful candidates will be appointed on a probation period of twelve (12) months. Misrepresentation in the application documents will result in automatic disqualification and disciplinary action in the event the candidate has already been appointed. The Department reserves the right not to make appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). Furthermore, if you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All interviews will be conducted at the Provincial Office stationed in Kimberley. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Bestuurder: Gemeenskapsontwikkeling: Zwelintlanga Fatman
af.summary: Bestuur gemeenskapsontwikkelingsintervensies by die Distrikkantoor in Upington, wat 'n toepaslike graad en tien jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n toepaslike NQF Vlak 7 Baccalaureusgraad in Gemeenskapsontwikkeling / Ontwikkelingstudies / Sosiale Wetenskappe hê. Geldige bestuurderslisensie vir 'n motorvoertuig. 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/herkenbare ervaring in Gemeenskapsontwikkeling na verkryging van die vereiste kwalifikasie, dit moet vyf jaar toesig/middelbestuurservaring insluit. Bevoegdhede: Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Fasiliteringsvaardighede. Koördineringsvaardighede. Skakelvaardighede. Netwerk bou. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Leierskapsvaardighede. Analitiese vaardighede. Diplomasie. Veranderings- en kennissbestuur. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Mensebestuur. Finansiële bestuur. Probleemoplossing, beplanning en organisering. Tydbestuur. Spanspeler. Strategiese beplanning. Beleidsanalise en -ontwikkeling.
af.duties: Bestuur die identifisering, fasilitering en implementering van geïntegreerde ontwikkelingsintervensies in samenwerking met die gemeenskap en ander relevante belanghebbendes deur doeltreffende, effektiewe en ekonomiese benutting van hulpbronne deur die eenheid/sub-direktoraat. Monitor, interpreteer en hersien wetgewing en beleid om te bepaal of wetgewing en beleid nog relevant is en aan huidige vereistes voldoen. Ontwikkel voorstelle om die relevante wette en beleide te wysig/te handhaaf, en ontwikkel nuwe beleid waar nodig. Bestuur die gemeenskapsontwikkelingseenheid/sub-direktoraat om te verseker dat 'n doeltreffende en effektiewe gemeenskapsontwikkelingsdiens gelewer word deur die behoorlike benutting van menslike, finansiële en fisiese hulpbronne. Hou treding met nuwe ontwikkelings in die gemeenskapsontwikkelings- en bestuursvelde om dienslewering te verbeter. Beplan en verseker dat navorsing oor gemeenskapsontwikkeling onderneem word. Onderneem/fasiliteer komplekse gemeenskapsontwikkelingsnavorsing.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwabantu: Zwelintlanga Fatman
zu.summary: Phatha ukuthuthukiswa kwabantu kwezinyathelo ezingene kwezikhungo e Upington, kudingeka ibanga elifanele neminyaka yohlu lwenkingu eyishumi.
zu.requirements: Abafakiswa kufanele babe ne-NQF Level 7 Bachelor's Degree efanele kwi-Community Development / Development Studies / Social Science. Amalayisense okushayela ihhashi elivunyiwe. Okungenani iminyaka engu-10 yohlu lwenkingu olufanele/oluhlonishwayo e-Community Development ngemva kokuthola isifundo esidingekayo, lokhu kufaka phakathi iminyaka eyinhlanu yohlu lwenkingu lokubeka abantu/bolawulo phakathi. Izakhiwo: Amakhono okuxhumana kahle. Amakhono okubika. Amakhono okukhwesabiseza. Amakhono okuhlanganisa. Amakhono oxhumo. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu. Amakhono okubusa. Amakhono okuhlaziya. Isikhundla. Ukuphathwa koshintsho nolwazi. Amakhono ekuhlela nokuqamba. Ukubusa abantu. Ukubala imali. Ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlela nokuhlela. Ukubala isikhathi. Ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwaqo. Ukubala okujulile. Ukuhlaziya ngezinqubomgomo nokuthuthukiswa.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuqashwa, ukukhwesabiseza nokusetshenziswa kwezinyathelo zokuthuthukiswa ezihlangene ngokuxhumana nomphakathi nabalayebe abafanele ngokusebenzisa ngokuqhubekayo, ngokusebenza kahle nangokusindisa okuyimithombo eqenjini/ohlelweni. Qaphela, chaza futhi ubuke kabusha umthetho nezinqubomgomo ukuze uzule ukuthi umthetho nezinqubomgomo zisasebenza futhi zihambisana nezidingo zanamuhla. Lenga iziphakamiso zokuwashintsha/zokuzigcina imithetho nezinqubomgomo ezifanele, futhi lenga izinqubomgomo ezisha lapho kudingeka khona. Phatha iqembu/ohlelomthetho lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi inkonzo yokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ihamba kahle nangempumelelo ngokusetyenziswa ngokufanele kwemithombo yabantu, yemali neyezinto. Gcina unolwazi ngokusungula okusha emkhakazini wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi nokuqamba ukukhulisa ukuletha inkonzo. Hlela futhi uqiniseke ukuthi uphenyo ngokuthuthukiswa komphakathi kwenziwa. Yenza/khwesabiseze uphenyo oludanisayo ngokuthuthukiswa komphakathi.

xh.title: Umphathi: Ukuzimisela Koluntu: Zwelintlanga Fatman
xh.summary: Lawula ukuzimisela koluntu kwindawo yoMmandla eUpington, okufuna idigri efanelekileyo namashumi amnye eminyaka yamava.
xh.requirements: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe nedigri yeBachelors kwiNqanaba le-NQF Level 7 kwi-Community Development / Development Studies / Social Science. Ilayisensi evakalayo yokuqhuba imoto. Inani elingaphantsi kweminyaka eli-10 yamava afanelekileyo/avakalayo kwi-Community Development emva koku fumana isifundo esifunekayo, oku kufuneka kuqulathe iminyaka emihlanu yamava okulawula/baphakathi bakwindima. Ikhono lokunxibelelana kakuhle. Ikhono lokubhala iingxelo. Ikhono lokulawula inkqubo. Ikhono lokuhlela. Ikhono lokunxibelelana. Ikhono lokwakha iintonjana. Ikhono lokunxibelelana nabantu. Ikhono lokuba ngumholi. Ikhono lokuhlola. Ubu diplomat. Ukulawula utshintsho nolwazi. Ikhono lokucebisa nokuqamba. Ukulawula abantu. Ukulawula imali. Ukusombulula iingxaki, ukucebisa nokuqamba. Ukulawula ixesha. Ukudlala njengelungu leqela. Ukuceba ngokwangakanalo. Ukuhlola nokuqamba iinkqubo.
xh.duties: Lawula ukuqhawula, ukwenza kubekho lula nokuqamba ukuzimisela koluntu ekudityanisiweyo ngokusebenzisana nomphakathi nabananye baphandle abane mphatho ngokusebenzisa iindlela ezilungele ngokwamaxebu, ngokwemigaqo nangokwexabiso kuqoqosho zemithobo yamandla ngumgunyathi/esebe. Qokelela, hlalutya kwaye uqambe iilayisensi namagazetha ngokwenza uhlolo lwesixokelelwano sazo. Qamba iindlela zokulungisa/uphawule iindlela ezingasebenziyo, nelentsika yokuqamba ezinye iindlela zokusebenza. Lawula iqela lenkonzo yokuzimisela koluntu ngokuchanekileyo ukuba kwenzeke ukuba abantu basebenzise ngokuchanekileyo amathuba abanawo ngokwemali nemithi yokusebenza. Gcina ulwazi olutsha ngokuzimisela koluntu kwaye uphucule inkonzo ekuyiqhayo lokuqonda ngokommandla. Cwangcisa kwaye uqinisekise ukuba kwenziwa uphando mayela noluntu. Phepha/qokelela uphando ngokuzimisela koluntu olubandakanya iingxaki ezinzima.

jobs.title: Manager: Community Development: Frances Baard District
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1-2: R1 009 512 - R1 414 593 per annum, (Salary will be in accordance with OSD Determination)

jobs.summary: Manage community development interventions and integrated development programmes at the Frances Baard District Office in Kimberley, requiring an NQF Level 7 degree and 10 years experience.

Manage community development unit/sub directorate to ensure that an efficient and effective community development service is delivered through the proper utilization of human, financial and physical resources. Keep up to date with new developments in the community development and management fields to enhance service delivery. Plan and ensure that research on community development is undertaken. Undertake/facilitate complex community development research.

af.title: Bestuurder: Gemeenskapsontwikkeling: Frances Baard District
af.summary: Bestuur gemeenskapsontwikkelingsintervensies en geïntegreerde ontwikkelingsprogramme by die Frances Baard District Office in Kimberley, wat 'n NQF Level 7-graad en 10 jaar ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n toepaslike NQF Level 7 Bachelorsgraad in Gemeenskapsontwikkeling / Ontwikkelingsstudies / Sosiale Wetenskappe hê. Geldige bestuurderslisensie vir 'n motorvoertuig. 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/erkenning van ervaring in Gemeenskapsontwikkeling na die verwerwing van die vereiste kwalifikasie, dit moet vyf jaar toesigtelike/middelbestuurservaring insluit. Bevoegdhede: Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Verslagskryfvaardighede. Fasiliteringsvaardighede. Koördineringsvaardighede. Skakelvaardighede. Netwerking. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Leierskapsvaardighede. Analitiese vaardighede. Diplomasie. Verandering- en kennisbestuur. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Mensebestuur. Finansiële bestuur. Probleemoplossing, beplanning en organisering. Tydbestuur. Spanspeler. Strategiese beplanning. Beleidsontleding en -ontwikkeling.
af.duties: Bestuur die identifisering, fasilitering en implementering van geïntegreerde ontwikkelingsintervensies in samewerking met die gemeenskap en ander relevante belanghebbendes deur doeltreffende, effektiewe en ekonomiese benutting van hulpbronne deur die eenheid/sub-direktoraat. Monitor, interpreteer en hersien wetgewing en beleid om te bepaal of wetgewing en beleid steeds relevant is en aan huidige vereistes voldoen. Ontwikkel voorstelle om die tersaaklike wette en beleid te wysig/te handhaaf, en ontwikkel nuwe beleid waar nodig. Bestuur die gemeenskapsontwikkelingseenheid/sub-direktoraat om te verseker dat 'n doeltreffende en effektiewe gemeenskapsontwikkelingsdiens gelewer word deur die behoorlike benutting van menslike, finansiële en fisiese hulpbronne. Bly op hoogte van nuwe ontwikkelings in die gemeenskapsontwikkelings- en bestuursvelde om dienslewering te verbeter. Beplan en verseker dat navorsing oor gemeenskapsontwikkeling onderneem word. Onderneem/fasiliteer komplekse gemeenskapsontwikkelingsnavorsing.

xh.title: Umphathi: Intshukumo yoluntu: Frances Baard District
xh.summary: Lawula iindlela zokuziphilisa ekubeni uluntu lunye kunye nokuqhubela phambili koluntu kwi-Frances Baard District Office e-Kimberley, kufuneka i-NQF Level 7 degree kunye neminyaka el-10 yamava.
xh.requirements: Izicelo kufuneka zibe nayo i-NQF Level 7 Bachelor's Degree esemthethweni kuzo zonke iindidi zobugcisa obungafanelekanga kwelinye ilizwe. iimpawu zokubamba ngaphantsi kweMithetho yokuLawula iindlela ezahlukeneyo. amava afanelekileyo amsaka nokuqinisekiswa kwesaziso ngokubanzi ukufumana ubuntshila kwiindidi ezingekho kwilizwe, iindleko ezifanelekileyo (Global) ezahlukeneyo. Iimpawu ezifanelekileyo zokubamba iindaba, ukuziphatha (General), ukuba yindoda nokuqwalasela inkqubo. Iimpawu zokuba ziyinyani, ubugcisa obuhle bokuziphatha (Communications) nokunxulumana nabantu (Liaison). Iinkqubo ezilawulwa ngokusebenzisa amagama amakhulu anjengokuba ngokuchanekileyo (Networking). Iimpawu zokuziphatha (Communication), zokudala umba (Facilitation), zokuhambelana (Co-ordination) nezo nxibelelwano (Interpersonal). Iimpawu zokuziphatha (Communication) ezibalulekileyo zokulawula iinkqubo (Leadership). Iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo zobugcisa (Analytical) ezilungele ukuzenzela iinkqubo (Diplomacy). Ukutshintsha ulwazi (Change and knowledge management). Ukucwangcisa nokuhlanganisa (Planning and organization). Ukulawula abantu (People Management). Ukulawula imali (Financial Management). Ukusombulula iingxaki (Problem Solving), ukucwangcisa nokuhlanganisa (Planning & organizing). Ukulawula ixesha (Time Management). Ukubamba iqela (Team player). Ukucwangcisa ngesicwangciso (Strategic Planning). Uhlalutyo nokuphuhliswa kwegama lenkqubo (Policy analysis and development).
xh.duties: Lawula unqajaniso, lenze kwaye uphumeze iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuziphilisa kunye nokuba nhlobo ngamnye kuluntu nakubanye abathintekayo ngokusebenzisa izixhobo ngesandla esifaneleyo, ngokusebenza kakuhle nangokuchanabusayo kwicala elingaphantsi kweso/le sebe. Qwalasela, tlaluthe ulungise imithetho yosetyenziso lwawonke-wonke nemigaqo ngokuqinisekisa ukuba iyahambelana nemifuno yangoku. Ludwe iimvozo zokulungisa/okanye ukugcina imithetho yosetyenziso nemigaqo ngokwemfuneko, ukwaze udwe imigqa evela kubomi basekuhlaleni. Lawula icandelo lokuziphilisa komntu wonke kwakunye nesigaba sangaphantsi ukuqinisekisa ukuba kukho inkonzo echanabusayo ngokusebenzisa abantu, imali nezixhobo ngokuchanekileyo. Qhubelezela iimfuno zokuziphilisa ezingekoyo ukuze kukhuliswe isabelo-nkonzo. Cwangcisa ukuqinisekisa ukuba lwenziwa uphando malunga nentswalo-ntle yamahlathi nangakumbi ngakumbi. Yenza ukuqhuba uphando olubucayile malunga nentswalo-ntle yamahlathi nangakumbi.

zu.requirements: Isitifikedi samatinyanga / Isifundo se-Grade 12 kanye nokuqoqwa kokufundela okufanelekile kolunye ucingo lweyunivesithi emsebenzisini wezenhlalakahle (isb. I-Bachelor of Social Work) noma isifundo esilinganayo njengoba kuqashelwe yi-SAQA esivumela ukubhalisa ngobuchwepheshe ne-SACSSP. Ukubhalisa kwamanje ne-South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP). Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela imoto (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile). Isipiliyoni: Ubuncwane beminyaka eyi-8 yokuqashelwa okufanelekile emsebenzisini wezenhlalakahale ngemuva kokuqashelwa njengomsebenzisi wezenhlalakahle ne-SACSSP. Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela imoto. Ikhono: Ikhono elihle lokuxhumana. Ikhono lokubhala imibiko. Ikhono lokuhola ingqungquthela. Ikhono lokuhlela. Ikhono lokuxhumana nezinye izinhlangano. Ukuxhumanisa. Ikhono lokusebenzisana nabantu. Ikhono lebotswana. Ikhono lokuhlaziya. Ikhono lezomthetho. Ukuphatha ulwazi noshintsho. Ikhono lokuhlela nokuqamba. Ukuphatha abantu. Ukuphatha imali. Ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlela nokuhlela. Ukuphatha isikhathi. Ukusebenza njengelunga qembu. ukuhlela okuhlose ukwakha isiqondiso. ukuhlaziya nokuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo.
zu.duties: Thuthukisa, sebenzisa futhi ugcine izinqubomgomo ezomsebenzisini wezenhlalakahle: hlola, chaza futhi ubuyeke omthetho, izinqubomgomo kanye namaphrosedha ukunquma ukuthi omthetho, izinqubomgono kanye namaphrosedha kusafanelekile futhi ahambele nezidingo zamanje; Thuthukisa izindaba zokulungisa/ukugcina omthetho, izinqubomgomo kanye namaphrosedha abalulekile futhi uthuthukise izinqubomgomo/amaphrosedha amasha lapho kudingeka khona, okubandakanya ukubala imali ehowa izinqubomgomo; Thuthukisa izinhlelo zokusebenzisa izinqubomgono eziphathelene nalokho. Gcina ulwazi olusha ekuthuthukisweni kwemisebenzi yezohlenalakahle, funda amathurnal okubhala ngobuchwepheshe kanye namaphephandaba ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuqashelwa olusha ekuthuthukisweni; Hlola futhi ucninde isikhungo somthetho nezenqubomgomo yezinsiza ezenhlalonhlalo ngokuqhubekayo; Xhumana/uzo emihlanganweni namanye amanye amaphiko, izinhlangano ezingakahulumeni kanye nezinhlangano ezibalulekile ukuze uqasele izinto ezintsha ekuthuthukisweni kuleyo minyakazo; Zibandakanye ezimeni zokuthuthukiswa kobuchwepheshe ngokuqhubekayo njengoba kumiselwe; ucwaningo nokuthuthukisa, wenze imisebenzi yabahlinzeki edingekayo ekuhlelweni.

xh.title: Umphathi Wezinqongo Zomsebenzi Wokwenzela Ubuntu: Inqanaba 1-2
xh.summary: Isebe loPhuhliso loLuntu lifuna abaphathi batshanu bezinqongo zomsebenzi wokwenzela ubuntu ukuba baphuhle, basebenzise kwaye bagcine izinqongo zomsebenzi wokwenzela ubuntu kwiOfisi yasePhondo eKimberley.
xh.requirements: Isatifikedi samabanga aphezulu / Isidanga 12 kwangaphambili ngesidanga sokufunda esingaphakathi kwendalo esifanelekileyo sokwenzela ubuntu (umz. iBachelor of Social Work) okanye isidanga esilinganayo njengoko sivunywe yiSAQA esivumela ukubhaliswa ngokuchanekileyo kwiSACSSP. Ukubhalisa ngoku kwiSouth African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP). Ilayisenzi esebenzayo yomqhubi wesixhobo sakho (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubekileyo). Imisebenzi eyayivenwe: Iminyaka engu-8 ubuncinane yamava afanelekileyo kumsebenzi wokwenzela ubuntu emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wokwenzela ubuntu kwiSACSSP. Ilayisenzi esebenzayo yomqhubi wesixhobo sakho. Ikhono: Ikhono elilodwa lokunxibelelana. Ikhono lokubhala iingxelo. Ikhano lokukhuthaza. Ikhano lokuhlanganisa. Ikhono lokuxhumanisa. Ukudibanisa namanye. Ikhano lokuhlangana nabantu. Ikhano lokukhokela. Ikhano lokuhlola. Isigqibo. Ukulawula inguquko nolwazi. Ikhano lokuqamba nokuhlela. Ukulawula abantu. Ukulawula imali. Ukusombulula iingxaki, ukuqamba nokuhlela. Ukulawula ixesha. Umdlali weliqela. Ukuqamba ngokwezikhundla. Ukuhlola nokuqamba izinqongo.
xh.duties: Qamba, yenza kwaye ugcine izinqongo zomsebenzi wokwenzela ubuntu; qwalasela, chaza kwaye uhlole uluntu, izinqongo neenkqubo ukugqiba ukuba ngaba uluntu, izinqongo neenkqubo zisalatha njani kwaye ziyahambelana neemfuno zangoku; Qamba iingxiso zokulungisa/okugcina umthetho, izinqongo neenkqobo ezilungeleyo kwaye uqambe izinqongo/eenkqobo ezintsha xa kufuneka, kuquka nokuqhathanisa ixabiso lezinqongo; Qamba iinkqubo zokusebenzisa izinqongo ezilungeleyo. Zigcine ngokwazi ngeenguquko ezintsha kwindalo yomsebenzi wokwenzela ubuntu, funda amaphepha ezindaba ezoqobo nokushicilelweyo ukuqinisekisa ukuba kuqatshelwe iinguquko ezintsha; Qwalasela kwaye ufunde inkqubo yomthetho nokuqonda kwamasebenzi obuntu kuqhubeko; Xhumanisa/zithathe iindibano namanye amasebe, iindalo ezingekoyo kurhulumente nabanomdla abalungileyo ukwazi ngeenguquko ezintsha kwizinto ezilungeleyo; Zibandakanye kwiinkqubo zokuqhubeka phambili ngokuchanekileyo njengoko kuchaziwe; Uphononongo nophuhliso, Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo efunekayo kwicandelo.

jobs.summary: Social Work Supervisor positions across Northern Cape districts requiring a Bachelor's degree in Social Work, SACSSP registration, 8 years' experience and a driver's licence.
jobs.requirements: Appropriate Bachelor’s Degree in Social Work. Current Registration with the South African Council for Social Services Professions (SACSSP) as a Social Worker. A minimum of 8 years appropriate experience in Social Work. Valid motor vehicle driver’s licence. Knowledge and Skills: Computer Skills. Interpersonal Skills. Communication Skills. Report Writing Skills. Management and Evaluation Skills. Knowledge of supervision model within the sector. Knowledge of relevant programmes in Social Work. In-depth knowledge of social work service delivery model. People management and empowerment.
jobs.duties: Render comprehensive social work services aimed at the care, support, protection, empowerment and development of vulnerable individuals, groups, families and communities through the implementation of relevant social work and social welfare programmes. Identify, assess and respond to social conditions and circumstances that may result in, or stem from, social instability and social dysfunction in any form, and facilitate appropriate interventions, referrals and linkages with relevant services and stakeholders. Provide professional supervision, guidance, advice and support to social workers, social auxiliary workers and volunteers to promote effective, ethical, and accountable and quality social work service delivery in accordance with applicable legislation, policies, professional standards, departmental directives and best practice. Keep abreast of developments, emerging trends, legislation, policies, research and best practices in the social work and social welfare fields, and facilitate the application of relevant developments to improve service delivery. Oversee and coordinate the administrative and operational functions required within the unit, including planning, record management, reporting, monitoring, quality assurance and compliance, and undertake higher-level administrative functions as required. Ensure the effective coordination of social work interventions and resources within the unit, promote integrated and multidisciplinary service delivery, and contribute to the achievement of departmental priorities and social development outcomes.

af.title: Maatskaplike Werktoesighouer: Graad 1-2
af.summary: Posisies vir Maatskaplike Werktoesighouers oor Northern Cape-distrikte wat 'n Baccalaureusgraad in Maatskaplike Werk, SACSSP-registrasie, 8 jaar ervaring en 'n bestuurslisensie vereis.
af.requirements: Toepaslike Baccalaureusgraad in Maatskaplike Werk. Huidige registrasie by die South African Council for Social Services Professions (SACSSP) as 'n Maatskaplike Werker. 'n Minimum van 8 jaar toepaslike ervaring in Maatskaplike Werk. Geldige bestuurslisensie vir 'n motorvoertuig. Kennis en Vaardighede: Rekenaarvaardighede. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Kommunikasievaardighede. Vaardighede in verslagskrywing. Bestuurs- en evaluasievaardighede. Kennis van die toesigmodel binne die sektor. Kennis van tersaaklike programme in Maatskaplike Werk. Diepgaande kennis van die maatskaplike werkdiensleweringmodel. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging.
af.duties: Lewer omvattende maatskaplike werkdienste gemik op die sorg, ondersteuning, beskerming, bemagtiging en ontwikkeling van kwesbare individue, groepe, gesinne en gemeenskappe deur die implementering van tersaaklike maatskaplike werk- en maatskaplike welsynsprogramme. Identifiseer, beoordeel en reageer op sosiale toestande en omstandighede wat kan lei tot, of voortvloei uit, sosiale onstabiliteit en sosiale disfunksie in enige vorm, en fasiliteer gepaste ingrypings, verwysings en skakeling met tersaaklike dienste en belanghebbendes. Verskaf professionele toesig, leiding, advies en ondersteuning aan maatskaplike werkers, maatskaplike hulpwerkers en vrywilligers om doeltreffende, etiese, verantwoordbare en gehalte maatskaplike werkdienslewering te bevorder in ooreenstemming met toepaslike wetgewing, beleid, professionele standaarde, departementele riglyne en beste praktyk. Hou tred met ontwikkelinge, opkomende tendense, wetgewing, beleid, navorsing en beste praktyke in die maatskaplike werk- en maatskaplike welsynsveld, en fasiliteer die toepassing van tersaaklike ontwikkelinge om dienslewering te verbeter. Oorsien en koördineer die administratiewe en operatiewe funksies wat binne die eenheid benodig word, insluitend beplanning, rekordbestuur, verslagdoening, monitering, gehalteversekering en nakoming, en onderneem hoër-vlak administratiewe funksies soos benodig. Verseker die doeltreffende koördinering van maatskaplike werk-ingrypings en hulpbronne binne die eenheid, bevorder geïntegreerde en multidissiplinêre dienslewering, en dra by tot die bereiking van departementele prioriteite en maatskaplike ontwikkelingsuitkomste.

zu.title: Umphathi Womsebenzi Wokweluleka Nekusiza: Izinga 1-2
zu.summary: Izikhundla zobumphathi bomsebenzi wokweluleka nekusiza kuzifundazwe ezingezini zika Northern Cape ezidinga iziqu ze-Bachelor's degree kumsebenzi wokweluleka nekusiza, ukubhalisa ku-SACSSP, iminyaka engu-8 yomhlalapholisile nelayisensi yokushayela.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelor's Degree ezifanelekile kumsebenzi wokweluleka nekusiza. Ukubhalisa njengamanje kwi-South African Council for Social Services Professions (SACSSP) njengenkokheli yomsebenzi wokweluleka nekusiza. Okungenani iminyaka engu-8 yomhlalapholisile ofanelekile kumsebenzi wokweluleka nekusiza. Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela imoto. Ulwazi Namakhono: Amakhono okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okuxhumanisa nabantu. Amakhono okuxhumana. Amakhono okubhala imibiko. Amakhono okuphatha nokuhlola. Ulwazi lwemodeli yokweluleka kweli ngabelelo. Ulwazi lweminhlahla ehlobene nomsebenzi wokweluleka nekusiza. Ulwazi olujulile lwemodeli yokuletha izinsizakalo zomsebenzi wokweluleka nekusiza. Ukuphatha nokunikeza amandla abantu.
zu.duties: Letha izinsizakalo ezibandakanya zonke izindawo zomsebenzi wokweluleka nekusiza ezibhekise ekunakekeleni, ukusekela, ekuvikeleni, ukunikezeni amandla nakuntuthukweni kwabantu, amaqembu, imindeni nasezigabeni kusetshenziswa iminhlahla ehlobene nomsebenzi wokweluleka nekusiza kanye nowokwengamela kakhuluma. Hlola, khombisa futhi uphendule izimo ezenza zomphakathi ezingabanga, noma ezikhona ngenxa yokungaziniki isithunzi nokungasebenzi kahle komphakathi nganoma yisiphi isimo, futhi wenze ukubekezela okufanelekile, ukuthumela kwezinye izindawo nokuxhumanisa izinsizakalo nabaphathi abahlobene nalokho. Nikeza ukweluleka ngomsebenzi, ukuhola, ukweluleka kanye nokusekela abasebenzi bokuweluleka nekusiza, abasizi kanye nabathandi ukukhuthaza ukuletha izinsizakalo zomsebenzi wokuweluleka nekusiza ezisebenza kahle, ezihlonipha imithetho, ezibhekana neziphetho kakhulu kanye neyisimo esihle ngokuhambisana nomthetho osekwenziwayo, izinqubomgomo, izindinganiso zobungcalu, imiyalo yomnyango kanye nezindlela ezinhle kakhulu zokuqhuba umsebenzi. Gcina ulwazi mayelana nokuthuthuka okwenzakalayo, izinto ezithuthuka ngaso sonke isikhathi, umthetho, izinqubomgomo, ucwaningo kanye nezindlela ezinhle kakhulu kumsebenzi wokuweluleka nekusiza nakowokwengamela kakhuluma, futhi wenze ukuba kusetshenziswe lokho kutadisha ukuthuthukisa ukuletha izinsizakalo. Bheka futhi uhlele imisebenzi yentlongando kanye neyokusebenza edingekayo eyunithi, okuhlanganisa ukulethula, ukulawula okubhaliwe, ukubika, ukulawula, ukuqinisekisa isimo esihle kanye nokuhambisana nomthetho, futhi wenze imisebenzi eyisibhaxu ezinga eliphezulu njengoba kudingeka. Qinisekisa ukuhleleka okusebenza kahle kokubekezela komsebenzi wokuweluleka nekusiza kanye nezinsiza eziseyunithi, khuthaza ukuletha izinsizakalo ezibuyekeziwe kakhulu nezisebenzisana namakhasimende abahlukene, futhi wenezele ekufezeni izidingo eziyinhloko zomnyango kanye nokuvela kwemiphumela yokuthuthukiswa komphakathi.

xh.title: UmLawuli woMsebenzi woKunceda abaNTU: Inqanaba 1-2
xh.summary: Izithuba zoKhangelo lomSebenzi woKunceda abaNTU kwiiNgingqi zamasebe eNyakatho Kapa ezifuna iDegree yeBachelor kumsebenzi wokunceda abantu, ubhaliso kwi-SACSSP, iminyaka engu-8 yamava nelayisenisi yomqhubi.
xh.requirements: Idegree elungeleleneyo yeBachelor kumsebenzi wokunceda abantu. Ubhaliso lokhulo nangoku kuSouth African Council for Social Services Professions (SACSSP) njengomsebenzi wokunceda abantu. Ukwaziswa okungengaphantsi kweminyaka engu-8 yamava afanelekileyo kumsebenzi wokunceda abantu. Ilayisenisi elisebenzayo yomqhubi wesithuthi. Ulwazi nakhono: Amakhono ekhompyutha. Amakhono okusebenzana nabantu. Amakhono okunxibelelan. Amakhono okubhala iingxelo. Amakhono olawulo nokuqwalasela. Ulwazi ngemodeli yolawulo ngaphakathi kwesebe. Ulwazi lweenkqubo ezifanelekileyo kumsebenzi wokunceda abantu. Ulwazi olujulileyo lwemodeli yoletho lweenkonzo zomsebenzi wokunceda abantu. Ulawulo lwabantu nokubanika amandla.
xh.duties: Nikeza iinkonzo ezibanzi zomsebenzi wokunceda abantu ngezinja ezijolise ekuqwalaselweni, inkxaso, ikhuselo, ukunika amandla nentlutho yabantu abaswela khuseleko, amaqela, usapho namaphakathi ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo zomsebenzi wokunceda abantu nenzalo lwabantu. Phawula, hlola uze uphendule iimeko zentlalo neemeko ezinokubangela, okanye ezivela kwindida yentlalo nasekungabeni kobunyulu ngaluphi na uhlobo, kwaye ulawule ungnatho olufanelekileyo, oqondiswo kunye nokudibanisa ngeenkonzo ezifanelekileyo nabanomdla. Nikeza ulawulo, isiwangomsebenzi, icebiso nenkxaso kwabasebenzi abanceda abantu, abancedisi bomsebenzi wokunceda abantu nabathanda ukuncedisa ukukhuthaza ukusebenza ngokufanelekileyo, ukuzithembisa, ukubanjwa uxanduva nokuvelisa iinkonzo zomsebenzi wokunceda abantu zemigangatho ephezulu ngokwesiseko semigaqo ekuwohloswayo, iinkqubo, iimigangatho yomsebenzi, imiyalelo yesebe nendlela elungileyo yokusebenza. Hlala uwazi iintshukumo, iindlela ezibonakalayo, imigaqo, iinkqubo, uphando nendlela elungileyo yokusebenza kwiminyhadala yomsebenzi wokunceda abantu nenzalo lwabantu, kwaye ulawule ukusetyenziswa kweentshukumo ezifanelekileyo ukuphucula ukulethwa kweenkonzo. Lawula kwaye uhlele imisebenzi yolawulo nokuqhuba efuneka kwisebe, kuquka uqwalaselo lolwangqesho, ulawulo lweekhadi, ukuvelisa iingxelo, ukuqwalasela, uqinisekiso lomgangatho nokuze kwenzeke imigaqo, kwaye wenze imisebenzi yolawulo yomgangatho ophezulu njengoko kufuneka. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo lwenkqubo yomsebenzi wokunceda abantu namathuba kwisebe, khuthaza ukulethwa kweenkonzo ezidityanisiweyo n ezinemimandla emininzi, kwaye uncede ekufezweni kwezinto ezibalulekileyo zesebe nemiphumelo yentlutho yentlalo.

jobs.summary: Supervise integrated community development interventions in the John Taolo Gaetsewe District, requiring a relevant degree and seven years of experience.
jobs.requirements: Qualifications: Bachelor’s Degree (NQF Level 7) in Community Development / Development Studies / Social Science. A valid driver’s license. A minimum of 7 years recognizable experience in Community Development after obtaining the required qualification. Valid driver’s license. Community Development knowledge, skills, attitudes and values to engage in the social development of communities. Knowledge and understanding of human behaviour and social systems and legislation to assist with interventions at points where people interact with their environments in order to promote self-empowerment. The ability and competence to coordinate community development structures and ability to manage projects. The ability to influence individuals and group to participate in their own self-empowerment ventures. Understanding of social dynamics. Presentation, Problem solving skills, Computer skills, Written and verbal communication skills, Research and report writing skills, financial management and Supervisory skills.
jobs.duties: To supervise the identification, facilitation and implementation of integrated community development interventions in partnership with the community and other relevant stakeholders and to assist employees engaged in this function by resolving problems. Supervise and support community development practitioners to ensure that there is communication and co-ordination with all relevant role players, internal and external (e.g., in departments/provinces, NGO, local community structures and faith-based organizations) and stakeholders to facilitate intersectoral collaboration, integrated planning and establishment of partnerships to ensure sustainability of development activities within the community. Supervise and guide community development practitioners to enhance their performance on community development and to perform administrative support on community development and related activities. Keep up to date with new developments in the community development field to enhance service delivery. Supervise and advise community development practitioners to ensure an efficient and effective service. Supervise, mentor, coach and advise community development practitioners to ensure an efficient and effective service. Manage the sub-unit. Monitoring and evaluation of non-profit organisations. Provide administrative, educational and supportive functions.

af.requirements: Kwalifikasies: Baccalaureusgraad (NQF Vlak 7) in Gemeenskapsontwikkeling / Ontwikkelingsstudies / Sosiale Wetenskappe. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. 'n Minimum van 7 jaar se herkenbare ervaring in Gemeenskapsontwikkeling na die verwerwing van die vereiste kwalifikasie. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bestuur en adviseer gemeenskapsontwikkelingspraktisyns om 'n doeltreffende en effektiewe diens te verseker.
