zu.title: Umphathi Wokuthuthukiswa Kwendawo
zu.summary: Qapha izindlela ezihlangene zokuthuthukiswa kwendawo ezisingathweni kule John Taolo Gaetsewe District, kudinga idigri ethize namava eminyaka eyisikhombisa.
zu.requirements: Izifundo: I-Bachelor's Degree (NQF Level 7) ku-Community Development / Development Studies / Social Science. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ubuncwane beminyaka engu-7 yamava abonwayo kokuCommunity Development ngemva kokuthola izidingo ezidingekayo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi, amakhono, izinkalo namagugu okuthuthukiswa kwendawo ukuze kuthathwe inxaxheba ekuthuthukisweni kwentlalo yendawo. Ulwazi nekuqonda ukuziphatha kwabantu, amasistema entlalo nomthetho ukuze kwazi ukusiza ezindaweni lapho abantu benzula khona nemvelo yabo ngenhloso yokugqugquzela ukuzithuthukisa. Ikono nesikhundla sokuhlanganisa izakhiwo zokuthuthukiswa kwendawo nenkosi yokuphatha amaphrojekthi. Ikono lokuqinisekisa abantu namaqembu ukuba bathathe inxaxheba ekuzithuthukiseni. Ukuqonda okuqhubekayo entlalo. Amakhono okubhukuda, okuxazulula izinkinga, okusebenzisa ikhompyutha, okubhala nokukhuluma, okucwaninga nokubhala imibiko, okuphatha imali namakhono okuqapha abanye.
zu.duties: Ukuqapha ukubona, ukwenza nokusebenzisa izindlela ezihlangene zokuthuthukiswa kwendawo ngokubambisana nendawo kanye nabanye abaholi, nokusiza abasebenzi ababambe iqhaza kulesi sikhundla ngokuxazulula izinkinga. Qapha futhi usiseke abasebenzi bokuthuthukiswa kwendawo ukuze kuqhubeke ukuxhumana nokuhlanganisa wonke abadlali abathintekayo, ngaphakathi nangaphandle (isb., kumnyango/izifundazwe, i-NGO, izakhiwo zendawo kanye namaqembu okholo) namalungu ukuze kwazi ukuxhumana phakathi kwemikhakha, ukuhlela okuhlangene nokuqamba izinhlobo ezinhle ukuthi ke nemithelela yezento yokuthuthukisa ihlale ikhona endaweni. Qapha futhi uhola abasebenzi bokuthuthuthukiswa kwendawo ukuthuthukisa amakhono abo ngendlela yokuthuthukiswa kwendawo nokwenza imisebenzi yeqhaza ngendlela yokuthuthukiswa kwendawo nezinye izinto ezihlobene nayo. Gcina ukuba ne-ulwazi olusha ngendlela yokuthuthukiswa kwendawo ukwenza ukuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi ibe yinto engcono. Qapha futhi unikele izeluleko kubasebenzi bokuthuthuthukiswa kwendawo ukuze imisebenzi ihamba kahle nangempumelelo. Qapha, ufunde, uhole futhi unike izeluleko kubasebenzi bokuthuthuthukiswa kwendawo ukuze kuqhubeke ukuba nesevisi esebenza kahle nangempumelelo. Phatha inxenye encane. Ukubuka nokuqinisekisa izinhlangano ezingazelelwa inzuzo. Nikela ngosekelo lweqhaza, okufundisayo nokusekela.

xh.title: Mphathi Wophuhliso Loluntu
xh.summary: Qondisa ukungenelela okudidiywe kophuhliso loluntu kwisiqhingi sika John Taolo Gaetsewe, kufuneka ncediswe ndima kwaye kube neminyaka yamava eyisixhenxe.
xh.requirements: Iziqinisekiso: I-Degree ye-Bachelor (Inqanaba le-NQF 7) kwi-Community Development / Development Studies / Social Science. Ilayisense yomqeshi esemthethweni. Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-7 yamava abalulekileyo kwi-Community Development emva kokufumana iziqinisekiso ezifunekayo. Ilayisense yomqeshi esemthethweni. Ulwazi, amakhono, imigaqo kunye namaxabiso wophuhliso loluntu onokuthi athathe inxaxheba kophuhliso lwentlalo koluntu. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuziphatha kwabantu kunye nezinxulumanii zentlalo nomthetho onceda ekungeneleleni kumapha abantu aphilelana khona nemizekelo yabo ukuze bakhusule ukuzincedisa ngokwabo. Isakhono nolwazi lokuhlanganisa iinkqubo zophuhliso loluntu nokuqonda ukulawula iiprojekthi. Isakhono sokuguqula abantu namaqela ukuba bathathe inxaxheba kumashishino abo okuzincedisa ngokwabo. Ukuqonda iingqinamba zentlalo. Amakhono okubonisa, ukusombulula iingxaki, amakhono ekhompyutha, amakhono okubhala okubhaliweyo nokuThetha, amakhono ophando nokuBhala iingxelo, ulawulo lweemali namakhono okuQondisa.
xh.duties: Ukuqondisa ukuchonga, ukwenza lula nokuphumeza ukungenelela okudidiywe kophuhliso loluntu ngokusebenzisana noluntu nabalindelayo abanengxaxheba kunye nokunceda abasebenzi abathatha inxaxheba kwlesi siseko ngokusombulula iingxaki. Ukuqondisa nokuxhasa abaphathi bophuhliso loluntu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba kukho ingxoxo nokuhambelana nababo bonke abanengxaxheba, ngaphakathi nangaphandle (umz., kumasebe/iiprovinsi, i-NGO, iinkqubo zaluntu zendawo neendawo zenkolo) kunye nabanengxaxheba ukwenza lula ukusebenzisana phakathi kwamasebe, uplani e incorporated nokusekwa kwezibambiselo ukuze kuqinisekiswa ukusasityibiliki phambili kwamashishino oluntu. Ukuqondisa nokukhokela abaphathi bophuhliso loluntu ukuphucula imvela yabo kophuhliso loluntu nokwenza iziko lolawulo ngocwangco lophuhliso loluntu namashishino ahlobeneyo. Gcina ulwazi olutsha ngophuhliso loluntu ukuze uphucule iinkonzo. Ukuqondisa kunye nokucebisa abaphathi bophuhliso loluntu ukuze kuqinisekiswe inkonzo esebenzayo nasebenzayo. Ukuqondisa, ukukhokela, ukukulisa nokuyalela abaphathi bophuhliso loluntu ukuze kuqinisekiswe inkonzo esebenzayo nasebenzayo. Ukulawula ibango elingananzelwa. Ukuqwalasela nokuhlonipha iindawo ezingeniso ngeniso. Ukubonelela ngolawulo, imfundo nokuxhasa imisebenzi.

zu.title: Umphathi Wentshuxeko Yomphakathi

Gcina ulwazi olusha ngokuqhubeka kwezinto ezintsha emkhakheni wentshuxeko yomphakathi ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukulethwa kwenkonzo. Qapha futhi unikeze izeluleko abaphathi bentshuxeko yomphakathi ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi inkonzo iyasebenza ngokufanele. Qapha, yiba yithisha, qeqesha futhi unikeze izeluleko abaphathi bentshuxeko yomphakathi ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi inkonzo iyasebenza ngokufanele. Phatha i-sub-unit. Lawula umcele abaphathi bophuhliso lomphakathi ukupucuka inkqubo yabo kophuhliso lomphakathi kwaye enze inkxaso yolawulo kophuhliso lomphakathi kumisebenzi ehambelanayo. Zigcine usuku nanamhlanje ngeenkqubo ezintsha kwiphuhliso lomphakathi ukupucuka inkonzo. Lawula uncede abaphathi bophuhliso lomphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba inkonzo iyasebenza ngokulungileyo nangokufanelekileyo. Lawula, yiba ngumzala, yiba ngumququzeleli uncede abaphathi bophuhliso lomphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba inkonzo iyasebenza ngokulungileyo nangokufanelekileyo. Lawula izinto ezincinci. af.title: Gemeenskapsontwikkelingsopsigter
af.summary: Stuur geïntegreerde gemeenskapsontwikkelingsintervensies in die Pixley ka Seme Distrik toe, wat 'n bachelorsgraad en sewe jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies: Bachelorsgraad (NQF Vlak 7) in Gemeenskapsontwikkeling / Ontwikkelingsstudies / Sosiale Wetenskappe. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. 'n Minimum van 7 jaar herkenbare ervaring in Gemeenskapsontwikkeling na verkryging van die vereiste kwalifikasie. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Gemeenskapsontwikkelingskennis, vaardighede, gesindhede en waardes om betrokke te raak by die sosiale ontwikkeling van gemeenskappe. Kennis en begrip van menslike gedrag en sosiale stelsels en wetgewing om bystand te verleen by intervensies by punte waar mense met hul omgewings omgaan ten einde selfbemagtiging te bevorder. Die vermoë en bevoegdheid om gemeenskapsontwikkelingsstrukture te koördineer en die vermoë om projekte te bestuur. Die vermoë om individue en groepe te beïnvloed om deel te neem aan hul eie selfbemagtigingsondernemings. Begrip van sosiale dinamika. Voorlegging, probleemoplossingsvaardighede, rekenaarvaardighede, skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede, navorsings- en verslagdoeningsvaardighede, finansiële bestuur en toesighoudende vaardighede.
af.duties: Om die identifisering, fasilitering en implementering van geïntegreerde gemeenskapsontwikkelingsintervensies in samewerking met die gemeenskap en ander tersaaklike belanghebbendes toe te lig, en om werknemers wat by hierdie funksie betrokke is, by te staan deur probleme op te los. Rig en begelei gemeenskapsontwikkelingspraktisyns om hul prestasie rakende gemeenskapsontwikkeling te verbeter en om administratiewe ondersteuning te verleen vir gemeenskapsontwikkeling en verwante aktiwiteite. Bly op hoogte van nuwe ontwikkelings in die gemeenskapsontwikkelingsveld om dienslewering te verbeter. Rig en adviseer gemeenskapsontwikkelingspraktisyns om 'n doeltreffende en effektiewe diens te verseker. zu.title: Umlawuli Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi
zu.summary: Qapha izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ezihlangene esifundeni i-Pixley ka Seme, edinga idiploma le-bachelor neminyaka eyisikhombisa yokuhlanganyela ekusebenzeni.
zu.requirements: Iziqu: I-Degree ye-Bachelor (NQF Level 7) ku-Community Development / Development Studies / Social Science. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Uboniso lweminyaka eyingu-7 nangaphezulu wokuqashwa ku-Community Development ngemva kokuthola isidingo esitholakalayo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi, amakhono, imikhuba namanxulumo e-Community Development ukubamba iqhaza eku thuthukisweni komphakathi. Ulwazi nokuqonda indlela abantu abahamba ngayo nezinhlelo zomphakathi kanye nomthetho ukusiza ekwenzeni izindlela ezithile lapho abantu bexhumana namaphi abahlala kona ukuthuthukisa ukuzibusela. Ikhono nokuqonda ukuhlelwa kohlelo lolu hlelo lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi nokuqonda ukuphatha amaphrojekthi. Ikhono lokuthinta abantu abadingayo namanqembu ukuba bathathe inxaxheba ekuzibuseleni. Ukuqonda ukwenza kwamandla emphakathi. Amakhono okwethula, okuxazulula izinkinga, akhompyutha, okubhala nokukhuluma, okucwaninga nokubhala ngemibiko, okuphatha imali namakhono okuqapha abantu.
zu.duties: Ukuqapha ukuqashwa, ukweluleka nokuphatha izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ehlangene ngokubambisana nomphakathi nabanye abahlanganyeli abafanele, futhi usize abasebenzi ababambe iqhaza kule nkathi ngokuxazulula izinkinga. Qapha futhi useke abenza isisekelo sokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi kukhona ukuxhumana nokuhlelwa kahle nakho konke okuhlobene nalokhu, ngaphakathi nangaphandle (isb., kuminyango/izifundazwe, i-NGO, izakhiwo zomphakathi zasendaweni kanye nezinhlangano ezingesona ezikahulumeni) nabanikabelo ukuze kukhuthazwe ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlangahlengeni, ukuhlela kahle ngokuhlangene nokwakhiwa kwezibopho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba mathathu kwezinkalo zokuthuthukisa ngaphakathi komphakathi. Qapha futhi uhole abasebenzi bomphakathi ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kwabo ekuthuthukisweni komphakathi futhi benze ukwesekwa ngokokuphatha ekuthuthukisweni komphakathi nasezinye izenzo ezihlobene. Gcina uthwase ngentuthuko entsha enkundleni yokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuletha izinsiza. Qapha futhi unikeze abasebenzi bokuthuthukiswa komphakathi izeluleko ukuze kuqiniseke ukuletha izinsiza ezisebenzayo futhi ezinhle. Qapha, yiba ngumeluleki, uqeqeshe futhi unikeze abasebenzi bokuthuthukiswa komphakathi izeluleko ukuze kuqiniseke ukuletha izinsiza ezisebenzayo futhi ezinhle. Phatha isigaba esincane. Ukuqapha nokuhlola izinhlangano ezingenzi inzuzo. Nikeza imisebenzi yokuphatha, yemfundo nesokusekela.

xh.title: Umphathi weNtuthuko yoLuntu
xh.summary: Ukulawula izithinteli zophuhliso lolwazi oluhlangeneyo lwentsapho kwingingqi yakwaPixley ka Seme, efuna idegree ye-bachelor kunye neminyaka esixhenxe yamava.
xh.requirements: Izifundo: Idegree yeBachelor (NQF Level 7) kwiCommunity Development / Development Studies / Social Science. Ilayisenisi yokuqeshisa evumelekileyo. Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-7 yamava aqathayo kwiCommunity Development emva koku fumana izifundo ezingafunwayo. Ilayisenisi yokuqeshisa evumelekileyo. Ulwazi, amakhono, imigaqo namaxabiso eCommunity Development ukuba ubambe iqhaza kuphuhliso lwentsapho. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuziphatha kwabantu namagebe angathinteli namagunya ukunceda ngeenthinteli kumda apho abantu bathintela namajelo ukuthuthuzela ukuzibonelela. Isakhono kunye namandla okulawula amaqheleza ophuhliso lwentsapho nesakhono sokulawula iiprojekthi. Isakhono sokukhuthaza abantu namaqela ukuba baphathe iqhaza kwezenzo zabo zokuzibonelela. Ukuqonda imithethonqamiso yentsapho. Amakhono okubonisa, ukusombulula iingxaki, amakhono ekhompyutha, amakhono okubhala nokuThetha, amakhono ophando nobhalo lwemibiko, ulawulo lwemali kunye namakhono okulawula.
xh.duties: Ukuqonda nokulawula ukuqondwa, ukwenziwa kolula nokusetyenziswa kwezithinteli zophuhliso lolwazi oluhlangeneyo lwentsapho ngokusebenzisana nentsapho nakunabanye abathinteli abafanelekileyo kwaye uncede abasebenzi ababambe iqhaza kule nkqubo ngokusombulula iingxaki. Lawula kwaye uxhase abaphathi bophuhliso lwentsapho ukuqinisekisa ukuba kukho uncumo ngokusebenzisana nabo bonke abadlali abafanelekileyo, ngaphakathi nangaphandle (umzekelo, kumasebe/iiphondo, i-NGO, iinkqubo zentsapho yendawo kunye neendawo ezisekelwe kukholo) nabalatheli ukwenza lula ukusebenzisana phakathi kwamasebe, ucwangciso oluhlangeneyo nokusekwa kweziqhelo ukuqinisekisa ukuzinza kwezenzo zophuhliso ngaphakathi kwentsapho. Lawula kwaye uqonde abaphathi bophuhliso lwentsapho ukuze bathuthuzele iziphumezo zabo ekuphuhliseni intsapho kwaye benze inkxaso yolawulo ekuphuhliseni intsapho nakwezinye izenzo ezinxulumene nayo. Gcina ulwazi olutsha ngophuhliso lwentsapho ukuze kulungiswe ukusetyenziswa kweenkonzo. Lawula kwaye uxabe abaphathi bophuhliso lwentsapho ukuqinisekisa inkonzo ekhawulezayo nesebenzayo. Lawula, qonda, qeqesha kwaye uxabe abaphathi bophuhliso lwentsapho ukuqinisekisa inkonzo ekhawulezayo nesebenzayo. Lawula icandelo elingezantsi. Ukulandelela nokuhlola iindawo ezingezizo ngenjongo yenzuzo.

zu.title: UQaphali Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi
zu.summary: Kufuneka uQaphali Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi e-Upington ukuze aphathe izinyathelo zokuhlanganisiwe zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, okudinga i-degree ye-bachelor futhi minyaka yedlule emsebenzini.
zu.requirements: Izidingo: I-Degree ye-Bachelor (NQF Level 7) kokuqashwa komphakathi / izifundo zokuthuthukisa / isayensi yomphakathi. Ilebula yokuqasha efanele. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-7 yohlelo lokusebenza oluqashwayo kokuqashwa komphakathi emva kokuthola izindingo ezidingekayo. Ilebula yokuqasha efanele. Ulwazi lwokuqashwa komphakathi, amakhono, izinkomba namagugu ukuze ukwazi ukusebenzisana ekuthuthukiseni komphakathi. Ulwazi nomqondo wokuziphatha komuntu kanye namaphuzu omphakathi kanye nomthetho ukuze kusize ezinyathelweni lapho abantu bahlangana nokuhlala khona ukuze kukhuthazwe ukuzibuse ngokuzimela. Ikhono nomndeni wokuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa komphakathi nasekuphatheni imiklamo. Ikhono lokushukumisa abantu amaqembu ukuba bahlanganyele ezinhlelweni zokuzibusela. Ukuqonda ngokuhluka kwentukutho yomphakathi. Amakhono okukhombisa, ukuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono ekhompyutha, amakhono okubhala nokukhuluma, ukuphenya nokubhala ngemibiko, ukuphatha izimali namakhono okuqaphela abantu.
zu.duties: Ukuqaphela ukuhlonza, ukwenza lula nokuphatha izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa intshonalanga komphakathi ngokuhlanganisa umphakathi namanye abahlanganyeli abafanelekile, futhi ukusiza abasebenzi ababhekene nale ntungo ngokuxazulula izinkinga. Qaphela futhi usekele abasebenzi bomphakathi ukuthuthukisa ukuze kuqiniseke ukuxhumana nokuhlanganisa kwabo bonke abadlala indima, bangekhaya nangaphandle (isb., emimangweni/izifundazweni, i-NGO, izinhlelo zomphakathi zendawo kanye namahlelo agqoka inkolo) kanye namaphuzu ukuze kwenzeke ukusebenzisana phakathi kwemimango ehlukene, ukuhlela ngokuhlanganisiwe nokusungula ubudlelwano ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthuthuka kwezinkambu emphakathini. Qaphela futhi ohole abasebenzi bomphakathi ukuthuthukisa ukuze bakwazi ukusebenza kahle kokuqashwa komphakathi futhi bakwazi ukusebenza ngokwesilinganiso nangemisebenzi ehlobene nayo. Gcina ukuthi uyazi ngemikhambi yemisha ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi ukuze kuphuculwe ukulethwa kwezinsiza. Qaphela futhi uwelule abasebenzi bomphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe insiza ehle futhi esebenzayo. Qaphela, fundisa, hlakanipha futhi welule abasebenzi bomphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe insiza ehle futhi esebenzayo. Phatha inqenye elingaphansi kwalo. Ukuqapha futhi ukuhlola inhlangano ezingekho ngenzuzo. Ukunikeza imisebenzi yokuphatha, yokufundisa kanye nokusekela ezinye izinkambu.

xh.requirements: Izifundo eziqinisekisiweyo: I-Bachelor's Degree (NQF Level 7) kwiPhuhliso loBuntu / IZifundo zoPhuhliso / INzululwazi yeZentlalo. Ilayisense yokuqeshisa esemthethweni. Ubuncinane beminyaka elingu-7 yamava aqukiweyo kuPhuhliso loBuntu emva kokuqokelela izifundo ezifunekayo. Ilayisense yokuqeshisa esemthethweni. Ulwazi, amakhono, iimvakalelo namaxabiso oluPhuhliso loBuntu lokwenza uxhaxho ekuphuhliseni koluntu ngokwentlalo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuziphatha komntu kunye namakhusela entlalo ukuze kuncedwe ekungenisweni kumathuba apho abantu babelana nendalo yabo ukuze kukhuthazwe ukuzinceda. Ikhono nokuqonda ukulawula iindonga zokuphuhlisa uluntu nendlela yokuphatha iiprojekthi. Ikhono lokucupha abantu namagroupha ukuba bathathe inxaxheba kumaphulo abo okuzinceda. Ukuqonda iziganeko ezithintela izentlalo. Amakhono okubonisa, amakhono okuxazulula iingxaki, amakhono ekhompyutha, amakhono bhalo nokunxibelelwana ngomlomo, amakhono opando nokubhala iingxelo, ukulawula iimali namakhono okulawula abantu.
xh.duties: Ukulawula ukuqatshwa, ukuncedisa nokusebenzisa ukungenelela kokuphuhlisa koluntu okuhlangeneyo ngokubambisana noluntu namalungu amnye abathintekayo nokuwanceda abasebenzi ababandakanyekayo kule nkqubo ngokuxazulula iingxaki. Ukulawula nokuxhasa abaphuhlisi boluntu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba kunxibelelwano nokuqhelanisa nabo bonke abadlali abathintekayo, ngaphakathi nakwingaphandle (umzekelo, kumasebe/iiprovinsi, i-NGO, iindonga zoluntu zakwaloo ndawo namashishini athe ngqo kwenkolo) nabalaphu abathintekayo ukuze kuncediswe ukusebenzisana phakathi kweendawo ezahlukeneyo, uqweqwe lokucwangcisa nokusekwa koluntu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusaselwa koluntu kumashishini ukuphuhlisa ngaphakathi koluntu. Ukulawula nokukhokela abaphuhlisi boluntu ukuze kuphuculwe ukusebenza kwabo ekuphuhliseni koluntu nokwenza inkqubo yolawulo lokuncedisa ekuphuhliseni koluntu nakumashishini ahambelana nawo. Ukuhlala uphezile ngokuphuhlisa okutsha kumashishini ukuphuhlisa uluntu ukuphucula inkonzo ehanjiswayo. Ukulawula kunye nokweluleka abaphuhlisi boluntu ukuze kuqinisekiswe inkonzo echanekileyo nesebenzayo. Ukulawula, ukukhuthaza, ukufundisa nokweluleka abaphuhlisi boluntu ukuze kuqinisekiswe inkonzo echanekileyo nesebenzayo. Ukulawula iqela elingaphantsi. af.title: Gemeenskapsontwikkelings toesighouer
af.summary: Beneem toesig oor geïntegreerde gemeenskapsontwikkelingsintervensies in samewerking met belanghebbendes in Postmasburg, wat 'n graad en sewe jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies: Baccalaureusgraad (NQF Level 7) in Gemeenskapsontwikkeling / Ontwikkelingstudies / Sosiale Wetenskappe. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. 'n Minimum van 7 jaar herkenbare ervaring in Gemeenskapsontwikkeling na verkryging van die vereiste kwalifikasie. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Gemeenskapsontwikkelingskennis, vaardighede, houdings en waardes om betrokke te raak by die sosiale ontwikkeling van gemeenskappe. Kennis en begrip van menslike gedrag en sosiale stelsels en wetgewing om te help met intervensies by punte waar mense met hul omgewings interaksie het om selfbemagtiging te bevorder. Die vermoë en bevoegdheid om gemeenskapsontwikkelingsstruktures te koördineer en die vermoë om projekte te bestuur. Die vermoë om individue en groepe te beïnvloed om aan hul eie selfbemagtigingsondernemings deel te neem. Begrip van sosiale dinamika. Voorlegging, Probleemoplossingsvaardighede, Rekenaarvaardighede, Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede, Navorsings- en verslagskryfvaardighede, finansiële bestuur en Toesighoudende vaardighede.
af.duties: Om toesig te hou oor die identifisering, fasilitering en implementering van geïntegreerde gemeenskapsontwikkelingsintervensies in samewerking met die gemeenskap en ander relevante belanghebbendes en om werknemers wat by hierdie funksie betrokke is te help deur probleme op te los. Toesig hou en gemeenskapsontwikkelingspraktisyne ondersteun om te verseker dat daar kommunikasie en koördinasie met alle relevante rolspelers is, intern en uitwendig (bv. in departemente/provinsies, NGO, plaaslike gemeenskapsstrukture en geloofsgesinde organisasies) en belanghebbendes om intersektoriële samewerking, geïntegreerde beplanning en die vestiging van vennootskappe te fasiliteer om volhoubare ontwikkelingsaktiwiteite binne die gemeenskap te verseker. Toesig hou en gemeenskapsontwikkelingspraktisyne lei om hul prestasie op gemeenskapsontwikkeling te verbeter en om administratiewe ondersteuning te verleen oor gemeenskapsontwikkeling en verwante aktiwiteite. Op hoogte bly van nuwe ontwikkelings in die veld van gemeenskapsontwikkeling om dienslewering te verbeter. Toesig hou en gemeenskapsontwikkelingspraktisyne adviseer om 'n doeltreffende en effektiewe diens te verseker. Toesig hou, mentor, afrig en gemeenskapsontwikkelingspraktisyne adviseer om 'n doeltreffende en effektiewe diens te verseker. Bestuur die sub-eenheid. Monitering en evaluering van niewinsorganisasies. Verskaf administratiewe, opvoedkundige en ondersteunende funksies.

zu.title: Umlawuli Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi
zu.summary: Ukuqapha izintshukumo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi ngokubambisena nabahlanganyeli ePostmasburg, kudingeka isiqu kanye neminyaka eyisikhombisa yolesithende sehlombe.
zu.requirements: Izidingo: Isiqu se-Bachelor’s Degree (NQF Level 7) ekuThuthukisweni Komphakathi / Izifundo Zokuthuthukisa / Isayensi Yomphakathi. Ilayisensi yokuqasha esemthethweni. Ukwaziswa okungu-7 iminyaka ekuthuthukiseni komphakathi ngemva kokuthola izidingo ezidingekayo. Ilayisensi yokuqasha esemthethweni. Ulwazi, amakhono, izinkalo kanye namagugu okuthuthukiswa komphakathi ukubamba iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni komphakathi. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda ukuziphatha kwabantu kanye namasistimu womphakathi nomthetho ukusiza ngezintshukumo kumaphuzu lapho abantu bexhumana khona namaphakathi abo ukuze kukhuthazwe ukuzikhukululela. Isikhathi kanye namandla okuhlelela izakhiwo zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi kanye namandla okuphatha amaphulo. Isikhathi sokukhuthaza iziphakamiso kanye nokuqasha ukuba basheshe ekuthuthukisweni okuzenzakalayo. Ukuqonda izinguquko zomphakathi. Amakhono okuhlanganisa ukubeka phambili, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono ekhompyutha, amakhono okubhala nokuqamba, amakhono okucwaninga, ukubhala amarekhodi, ukulawula izimali namakhono okuqapha.
zu.duties: Ukuqapha ukuqashwa, ukweluleka nokuphatha izintshukumo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi ezihlangene ngokubambisana nomphakathi kanye nabanye abahlobene ngokusiza abahlanganyeli ekulethweni kwezinkinga. Ukuqapha futhi useke abasebenzi bomphakathi ekuthuthukisweni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona ukuxhumana nokuhlela ndawonye bonke abadlali indima abahlobene, ngaphakathi nangaphandle (isb., Kuzikhungo/tifundza, i-NGO, izakhiwo zomphakathi zendawo kanye nezinhlangano eziqonde enkolo) kanye nabahlanganyeli ukwenza ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlangano ezahlukene, ukuhlela okuhlangene kanye nokusungula ubudlelwano ukuqinisekisa ukuba khona okuqhubekayo kwezimisebenzi zokuthuthuka endaweni. Ukuqapha futhi uhola abasebenzi bomphakathi ekuthuthukisweni ukuze bakhiqize ngaphezulu ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi futhi benze ukusekelwa kwezokomlawulo ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi nasemisebenzini ephathelene nayo. Ukugcina ijubane nokuqonda okusha ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi ukukhulisa ukulethwa kwezinsiza. Ukuqapha futhi welule abasebenzi bomphakathi ukuqinisekisa insiza ephumelelayo nesebenzayo. Ukuqapha, ukuba umgqugquzeli, ukubunga futhi welule abasebenzi bomphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulandelwa kwezinsiza ezipumelelayo noma ezisebenzayo. Ukulawula ibungo elingaphansi kwaleli. Ukulawula nokuqinisekisa ukuhamba kwezinhlangano ezingenzelele inzuzo. Ukunikeza ukusekelwa kolawulo, izemfundo kanye nemisebenzi ekusekeleni.

xh.title: Mphathi Wophuhliso Loluntu
xh.summary: Ulawule ukungenelela kokuphuhliswa koluntu okudityanisiweyo ngokusebenzisana nabathathi-nxaxheba kwi Postmasburg, kufuneka unemvela kunye neminyaka elishumi elinethandathu yamava.
xh.requirements: Izifundo: I Degree ye Bachelor (NQF Level 7) kwi Community Development / Development Studies / Social Science. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ubuncinane beminyaka elingu-7 yamava aqondeleyo kwi Community Development emva kokuqeqeshwa okufunekayo. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi, amakhono, imigaqo kunye namaxabiso e Community Development ukuba wenze kumphuhliso wentlalo yoluntu. Ulwazi nokuqonda indlela eziphatha ngayo abantu kunye nezithinteli zentlalo nomthetho ukuncedisa ekungenisweni koluvo kumapha aphothulwa kakhulu ukhululeka kwabakho. Ikhono nokuqonda ukulawula iimpawu zophuhliso loluntu kunye nokuqonda ukulawula amaphrojekthi. Ikhono lokuguqula aba bantu namanqanqamshwa ukuba bathathe inxaxheba kwishishini labo lokuziphuhlisa. Ukuqonda iimpembelelo zentlala. Ikhono lokubonelela nokuqonda nokuqamba izisombululo ezingundweba nokuqonda nokuqonda imithetho ekunceda ukuba kuthintwe emapha abantu bathintana nomo wabo ukuze bathole amandla okuziqhayisa. Amandla nokuqonda ekusingeni koluntu nakwindalo ngokubanzi.
xh.duties: Ukulawula ukuqaphela, ukulawula nokusetyenziswa kwexesha elithile nokulawulwa koluntu ngokusebenzisana noluntu kunye nabanye bathathi-nxaxheba abalulekileyo ngokusebenzisana noluntu nabanye abathathi-nxaxheba abahamba phambili. Ulawule, uze uncede abasebenzi abaphatha kulo msebenzi ngokusombulula iingxaki. Ulawule uze uncede abaphathi bophuhliso loluntu ukuqinisekisa ukuba kukho ngenxa yoluntu nazo zonke iindawo ezibalulekileyo ngaphakathi nakunaphandle (umzekelo, kumasebe/iimbumbraluka, NGO, iindawo zoluntu lwengingqi kunye nokuqonda amakholwa) ukulawula ngenye indlela kubakho olunye usetyenziso ngokusesikweni. Ulawule uze ubakhokelele abaphathi bophuhliso loluntu ukuba baphucule ngokusebenza kwabo ekuphuhliseni koluntu nokwenza inkxaso yolawulo ekuphuhliseni koluntu nasezinye izinto ezinxulumene nokuqonda amathuba amakhulu nokuqinisekisa uluntu. Makagcinwe ngoncedo nolwazi olutsha windlela yophuhliso loluntu ukuze alikhuthaze uluntu olunjalo. Ulawule uze uncede abaphathi bophuhliso loluntu ukuze kubekho ukusebenza okukhawulezileyo nokuqinisekileyo. Ulawule, uze uncede ukubakhokela abaphathi bophuhliso loluntu. Lawula iqumrhu elingaphantsi. Ukukhokelela nokulawula i nzimbali ezimali ngenkqubo ngokusesikweni. Zibonelele ngolawulo, ngolwazi ngolunye usetyenziso nakunxaxheba ngokusesikweni.

af.summary: SAPS soek datatypiste oor vier North West-distrikte om inligting op polisiestelsels en databasisse vas te lê, te verifieer en te onderhou, wat 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en taalvaardigheid vereis.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet bevoegdheid in die kernfunksies van die pos toon. Wees bedrywig in ten minste Engels en een ander amptelike taal. Wees 'n burger van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika waarvan dokumentêre bewys op die dag van die onderhoud voorsien moet word. Besit 'n Graad 12/ Senior Sertifikaat/ NCV Vlak 4 of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (NQF Vlak 4 soos deur SAQA erken). Relevante opleiding of kursusse op die gebied van die pos sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis, Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Algemene rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Office, MS Power Point, MS Outlook). Sterk beplannings-, organisasie-, administratiewe en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Sterk interpersoonlike vaardighede. Kliëntfokus en reaksievermoë. Wees gewillig om onder te werk.

Verskaf algemene administratiewe en datavasleggingsondersteuning aan die komponent. Verseker vertroulikheid en sekuriteit van SAPS-inligting en -rekords. Voldoen aan toepaslike SAPS-beleide, prosedures, instruksies en voorgeskrewe tydraamwerke. Voer enige ander verwante pligte soos deur die toesighouer aangewys uit. Bevorder polisieprofessionaliteit en lewer professionele Polisiedienste.

Gcina inqanaba eliphezulu loluqeqeswo ulandela iNkqubo yokuziphatha yeSouth African Police Service. Phucula ubungcalisa bolice nikeze iinkonzo zePolice ezibungcalisileyo.

jobs.summary: Head of Clinical Unit for General Surgery at Tygerberg Hospital, requiring HPCSA registration as a Medical Specialist and minimum 3 years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Specialist in General Surgery or Plastic Surgery. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in General Surgery or Plastic Surgery. Experience: A minimum of 3 years’ appropriate experience after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in General Surgery or Plastic Surgery. Inherent requirement of the job: It will be expected of the Head: Clinical Unit to work commuted overtime, limited to 12 hours, if operational requirements so demand. Participation in the after-hours consultant call system is required. The incumbent must be able to function independently in a high-volume specialist burns service and provide leadership across normal and after-hours service delivery. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Advanced clinical and operative competence in General Surgery or Plastics Surgery, including the management of complex and critically ill burns patients. Proven clinical leadership and managerial capability in a specialist surgical service, with the ability to lead a multidisciplinary Burns Unit and supervise senior and junior medical staff. Knowledge and experience in clinical governance, morbidity and mortality review, audit, quality improvement, protocol development and monitoring of standards of care. Ability to manage service access, patient flow, referral pathways, human resources and scarce clinical resources in a high-volume tertiary service. Experience in undergraduate and postgraduate teaching and supervision, with the ability to contribute to specialist surgical training and academic programme development. Appropriate research experience, including supervision of research, data analysis, presentation and publication. Computer literacy and database competence are required. Excellent interpersonal, communication, relationship-building and teamwork skills. Insight into local healthcare delivery, diversity, transformation and equity.
jobs.duties: Provide and oversee safe, effective and efficient specialist burns care, including operative, peri-operative, critical care and after-hours service delivery. Provide overall clinical governance and clinical leadership of the Burns Unit, including development, implementation and monitoring of protocols, morbidity and mortality review, clinical audit, patient safety and quality-improvement activities. Provide strategic and operational management of the Burns Unit, including service planning, access and referral management, patient flow, resource stewardship, cost-centre oversight and responsible use of blood products, laboratory services, medicines, consumables and theatre resources. Lead, supervise and develop medical staff and trainees in the Burns Unit, including performance management, roster oversight, professional conduct, mentorship and multidisciplinary teamwork. Liaise with hospital management, General Surgery, Anaesthesia, Critical Care, Nursing, Rehabilitation services and referring clinicians to strengthen coordinated burns care and referral pathways across the Tygerberg drainage area. Provide undergraduate and postgraduate teaching, bedside training, tutorials and specialist supervision, and contribute to relevant examinations and academic programme activities. Lead and supervise research, audit, data collection and service-evaluation activities in Burns Surgery, with active participation in relevant institutional and provincial governance structures where required.
jobs.enquiries: Prof G Oosthuizen, email: george-oost@sun.ac.za
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. af.title: Hoof Kliniese Eenheid (MEDIES) Graad 1 (ALGEMENE Chirurgie)
af.summary: Hoof van Kliniese Eenheid vir Algemene Chirurgie by Tygerberg Hospital, wat HPCSA-registrasie as 'n Mediese Spesialis en minimum 3 jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Algemene Chirurgie of Plastiese Chirurgie moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Algemene Chirurgie of Plastiese Chirurgie. Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 3 jaar se toepaslike ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Algemene Chirurgie of Plastiese Chirurgie. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Dit sal van die Hoof: Kliniese Eenheid verwag word om siekrooster-oortyd te werk, beperk tot 12 uur, indien operasionele vereistes dit vereis. Deelname aan die buite-ure konsultant oproepstelsel word vereis. Die ampshouer moet in staat wees om onafhanklik in 'n hoëvolume spesialis brandwonde-diens te funksioneer en leierskap te bied oor normale en buite-ure dienslewering. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Gevorderde kliniese en operatiewe bevoegdheid in Algemene Chirurgie of Plastiese Chirurgie, insluitend die bestuur van komplekse en kritiek sieke brandwonde-pasiënte. Bewese kliniese leierskap en bestuursvermoë in 'n spesialis chirurgiese diens, met die vermoë om 'n multidissiplinêre Brandwonde-eenheid te lei en senior en junior mediese personeel te superviseer. Kennis en ervaring in kliniese bestuur, morbiditeits- en mortaliteitsondersoek, oudit, gehalteverbetering, protokolontwikkeling en monitering van sorgstandaarde. Vermoë om dienstoegang, pasiëntvloei, verwysingsroetes, menslike hulpbronne en skaars kliniese hulpbronne in 'n hoëvolume tersiêre diens te bestuur. Ervaring in voor- en nagraadse onderrig en supervisie, met die vermoë om by te dra tot spesialis chirurgiese opleiding en akademiese programontwikkeling. Toepaslike navorsingservaring, insluitend supervisie van navorsing, data-analise, aanbieding en publikasie. Rekenaarvaardigheid en databasisbevoegdheid word vereis. Uitstekende interpersoonlike, kommunikasie-, verhoudingsbou- en spanwerkvaardighede. Insig in plaaslike gesondheidsorglewering, diversiteit, transformasie en billikheid.
af.duties: Verskaf en hou toesig oor veilige, effektiewe en doeltreffende spesialis brandwondesorg, insluitend operatiewe, peri-operatiewe, kritieke sorg en buite-ure dienslewering. Verskaf algehele kliniese bestuur en kliniese leierskap van die Brandwonde-eenheid, insluitend ontwikkeling, implementering en monitering van protokolle, morbiditeits- en mortaliteitsondersoek, kliniese oudit, pasiëntveiligheid en gehalteverbeteringsaktiwiteite. Verskaf strategiese en operasionele bestuur van die Brandwonde-eenheid, insluitend diensbeplanning, toegangs- en verwysingsbestuur, pasiëntvloei, hulpbronbestuur, kostesentrum-toesig en verantwoordelike gebruik van bloedprodukte, laboratoriumdienste, medisyne, verbruiksgoedere en teaterhulpbronne. Lei, superviseer en ontwikkel mediese personeel en opgeleides in die Brandwonde-eenheid, insluitend prestasiebestuur, rooster-toesig, professionele gedrag, mentorskap en multidissiplinêre spanwerk. Skakel met hospitaalbestuur, Algemene Chirurgie, Verdowing, Kritieke Sorg, Verpleegkunde, Rehabilitasiedienste en verwysende klinici om gekoördineerde brandwondesorg en verwysingsroete oor die Tygerberg dreineringsgebied te versterk. Verskaf voor- en nagraadse onderrig, bedkant-opleiding, tutoriale en spesialistiese supervisie, en dra by tot toepaslike eksamens en akademiese programaktiwiteite. Lei en superviseer navorsing, oudit, dataversameling en diensevaluasie-aktiwiteite in Brandwonde-chirurgie, met aktiewe deelname aan toepaslike institutionele en provinsiale bestuursstrukture waar vereis.

zu.title: Umphathi Wenqulo Yezokwelapha (EZOKWELAPHA) Isigaba 1 (Ukuhlinza Ngokuvamile)
zu.summary: Umphathi Wenqulo Yezokwelapha wokuHlinza Ngokuvamile eTygerberg Hospital, ofuna ukubhaliswa kuHPCSA njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha nokuba nobuningo obuncane beminyaka engu-3.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezingaphansi kwesilinganiso: Isiqu esifanele esivumela ukubhaliswa kwabaphathi beHPCSA njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha kokuHlinza Ngokuvamile noma ukulungisa izinkomo zomzimba. Ukubhaliswa komkhandlu wezesiqu: Ukubhaliswa kwiHPCSA njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha kokuHlinza Ngokuvamile noma ukulungisa izinkomo zomzimba. Isipiliyoni: Ubuningo be-3 weminyaka isipiliyoni esifanele ngemva kokubhaliswa kwiHPCSA njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha kokuHlinza Ngokuvamile noma ukulungisa izinkomo zomzimba. Isidingo esingokwabelane somsebenzi: Kuzofuneka ukuba Umphathi: Inqulo Yezokwelapha asebenze isikhathi esingeziwe esibalwe ngokwesivumelwano, sinqunyiwe esikhathini esingange-12 amahora, uma izidingo zokusebenza zifuna kanjalo. Ukubamba iqhaza kulesimu sokubiza ochwepheshe benzele abantu ngemva kwezikhathi zokuvamile zokusebenza kudingeka. Lowo othathwe isikhundla kumele ukwazi ukusebenza eyedwa enkonzweni ebanzi yokuchwepheshe bokwelapha kashiso bese ethola isikhundla sokuhola inkonzo ekunikwa nangemva kwezikhathi zokusebenza. Amakhono (ulwazi/izikhonso): Amakhono aphakeme okwelapha nokuhlinza kokuHlinza Ngokuvamile noma ukulungisa izinkomo zomzimba, okuhlanganisa nokuphathwa kwabaguliswa abasha ukufa ngokusha futhi begula kakhulu. Isikhonso esibonakalayo sokuhola iklodhi yochwepheshe kanye nesikhundla sokuphatha inkonzo yokuhlinza, bese ekwazi ukuhola ibhunu elikhulu labantu abaningi balale imfundo yokusha futhi alawule abasebenzi bazogwala nezogqoqwa kanye namagidi aphakeme kanye namagidi asezansi ezokwelapha. Ulwazi kanye nesipiliyoni ekuphathweni kokulawula izindaba zezokwelapha, ukubuyekezwa kokugula nokufa, ukuhlola, ukwenza izinto ngcono, ukuthuthukiswa kwemithetho yokusebenza kanye nokuqapha amazinga okunakekelwa. Isikhonso sokuphatha ukufinyelela enkonzweni, ukuhamba kwesiguli, izindlela ezisetshenziswa ukuthumela abantu kubachwepheshe, abantu abasiza kumnyango kanye nezinsiza ezincane zezokwelapha enkonzweni ebanzi ezinga elikhulu. Isipiliyoni sokufundisa abantu abangangenwe yilolu hlobo kanye nokuqasha abafundi beminyaka yonkhe, bese ekwazi ukusiza ekugadeni abafundi bokuhlinza kanye nokuthuthukiswa kohlaka lokufunda iziqu. Isipiliyoni esifanele sokwenza ucwaningo, okuhlanganisa nokugada ucwaningo, ukuhlaziya imininingwane, ukwethulwa kanye nokushicilelwa. Ukubhala nokuqonda kumakhompyutha kanye namakhono okusebenza namakholomu wemininingwana adingeka. Amakhono aphakeme okuxhumana nabantu, ukukhuluma, ukwakha ubuhlobo kanye nokusebenza ngokuthi ubuhlakani bakho ubukhulu. Ukuqonda ngezenzalo zezempilo zendawo, izinhlobonhlobo zamasiko, ushintsho olubhekiswe ekingeni nokulingana.
zu.duties: Nika futhi ulawule ukunakekelwa okuphephile, okusebenzayo futhi okunomthelela kwashiso abaguliswa njengechwepheshe, okuhlanganisa nokuhlinza, okungaphambi kokuhlinzwa, ukwelapha abaguliswa abagula kakhulu nokunikwa inkonzo ngemva kwezikhathi zokusebenza. Nikezela ngokuphatha kahle izindaba zezokwelapha nokuhola iklodhi yokusha, okuhlanganisa nokuthuthukiswa, ukusetshenziswa nokuphathwa kwemithetho yokusebenza, ukubuyekezwa kokugula nokufa, ukuhlola izindaba zezokwelapha, ukuphepha isiguli kanye nokusebenza ukwenza izinto ngcono. Nikezela ngokuphatha ngohlakani nangokusebenza iBhunu Lokusha, okuhlanganisa nokuqamba nendlela yokusebenza, ukuphatha ukufinyelela nokuthunyelwa kwesiguli, ukuhamba kwesiguli, ukusetshenziswa kokuqondiswa kwabantu, ukubheka izindleko ezenzelwa izigaba, nokuphatha kusizo okuzi-arterial blood, izinsiza zezahlulelo ezikliniki, imithi, izinto ezisetshenziswa kanye nezinsiza zokuhlinza. Hola, qasha futhi uthuthukise abasebenzi bazogwala nezogqoqwa eBhunu Lokusha, okuhlanganisa nokuphatha imisebenzi, ukuqapha uhlelo lokuqesha, ukuziphatha ngokomthetho weziqu, ukunika abantu izeluleko kanye nokusebenza ngokuthi ubuhlakani bakho. Xhumana nabaphathi basemapitala, ukuhlinzwa ngokuvamile, anesthetists, ukwelapha abaguliswa abagula kakhulu, abahlengikazi, izinkonzo zokulungisa nokuphinde ukwelaphe abantu kanye nabaqashi ukugcina abantu abasha nokuqeqesha abantu abanamakhono okuhlinza. Hola futhi ulawule abafundi abafuna ukwenza ucwaningo, ukuhlola imininingwane, ukuthola imininingwane nokuhlola inkonzo ekuhlinzweni abashisa abaguliswa, bese ekwazi ukubamba iqhaza ngokugcizelela. Nikezela izinkonzo zokufundisa abantu abangangenwa yilolu hlobo kanye nokufundisa ngemva kwalezo ziqu, ukufundisa ngasese, ukunika izeluleko nokugada abantu abangafuni ukwenza ucwaningo ngokwedlule, bese ekwazi ukusiza ekuhlolweni okuhlobene nokuthuthukiswa kohlaka lokufunda.

xh.title: Umphathi weYunithi yeZozo (EZESIBINZO) Inqanaba 1 (I-EZIQU Ukwelusa)
xh.summary: Umphathi weYunithi yeZozo zobuGqatsha kwiTygerberg Hospital, efunayo ukubhaliswa kwiHPCSA njengoGqirha ongunyazi kunye nolwazi lweminyaka engu-3 ubuncinane.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezifunekayo ubuncinane: Isifundo esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoGqirha ongunyazi kukuWelusa ngokubanzi okanye Ukuvelisa iNyama. Ukubhaliswa kubungcali: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha ongunyazi kukuWelusa ngokubanzi okanye Ukuvelisa iNyama. Ulwazi: Ulwazi olufanelekileyo lweminyaka engu-3 ubuncinane emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha ongunyazi kukuWelusa ngokubanzi okanye Ukuvelisa iNyama. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Kuya kulindelelwe kwiNtloko: iYunithi yeZozo ukusebenza isixa esixokiweyo sexesha elongeziweyo, esimiselwe kumawaka ali-12, ukuba iimfuno zokusebenza zifuna njalo. Kufuneka kube khona inkathazo kwindlela yokubiza oogqirha abanolwazi ngemini ngemihla yamaxa enguye - ophantsi. Umntu othathwe kule sithuba kufuneksi akwazi ukusebenza eyedwa kwinkonzo ebugcwele yabaguli balahlekelwe yimililo nokubonelela ngobukhosi kunkonzo yamaxa ajikelezi kwaye nangamaxa enguye. Ikhono (ulwazi/obukhosi): Ulwazi nobugqirha obuphezulu bokusebenza kukuWelusa ngokubanzi okanye Ukuvelisa iNyama, kuquka ukupathwa kwabaguli abanengxaki abagula kakhulu balahlekelwe yimililo. Ubufundi bekhono lokuba ngumlawuli kunye nobukhosi kwinkonzo yokwelusa, ngenkatho yokukwazi ukukhokela iYunithi ebanzi yolwazi nokulola oogqirwa abaphezulu nabalowayo. Ulwazi nolwazi ekulawulweni kolwazi lokugqirha, ukuphonononga ukufa nokufa, ukuhlolwa, ukuphucula umgangatho, ukwenza iinkqubo nokujonga amanqanaba eNkonzo. Ikhono lokulawula ukufikelela kwenkonzo, ukuhamba kwengxaki yomntu, iindlela zokuqhubela ngokuxelela, iinkcukacha zabantu kunye nezithako zokugqirha ezingekho Zigqithiweyo kwinkonzo ebugcwele yamaza amakhulu. Ulwazi ekufundiseni abafundi abangangenanga nabanegqityiweyo kunye nokuqwalasela, ngenkatho yokunikela ekuzeni kokugqirha ukuwelusa nokuphuhliswa kweenkqubo ezikwisayensi. Ulwazi olufanelekileyo lokuphanda, olubandakanya ukuqwalasela iints zenokuphandaisa, ukuhlalutya iingqokelela zolwazi, iSazizo nokuPapasha. Ukubakho kolwazi kwiikhompyutha kunye nobugqirha kwiziphuzi zolwazi kufunekile. Ikhono elibalaseleyo labantu, lokunxibelelwana, sokwakha iintsebenziswano nesiqhengqw ngokusebenza ngokubumbene. Ukuqonda mayela nonikezelo lwezempi lo, izinto ezahlukeneyo, isuguqo kunye nobulinganiso.
xh.duties: Kubonelele kunye nokulawula ngokuchanekileyo, ngempumelelo nangokusebenza kakuhle ukunakekelwa kwabaguli balahlekelwe yimililo, kuquk ukusebenza, ixesha elingekho kwiPhondo ekuya kusebenza kwamaxa enguye. Kubonelele ngokulawula nangokubonelela iNkqubo ngokubanzi kwaye nabugqirha kwiYunithi yabaGuli balahlekelwe yimililo, kuquk ukuphuhliswa, ukusebenzisa nokulawula iinkqubo, ukuphonononga ukufa nokusweleka emhlabeni, ukuhlolwa kogqirho, ukhuseleko lomntu nakwizinto zokuphucula umgangatho. Kubonelele ngokulawula ngokubanzi kwaye nangokusebenza kwiYunithi yabaGuli balahlekelwe yimililo, kuquk ukuhlelwa kwenkonzo, ukufikelela nokuqondisa ukulawula iindlela ezikwiNdlela yokuQhubela ngokuxela, ukuhamba komntu, ukulawula izixhobo, ukuqwalasela iindleko, ukusebenzisa ngokufanelekileyo imveliso yegazi, iinkonzo zommandla, amayeza, iinkcukacha, nezinto zoMzila wezinja. Khokela, yolula kwaye uphuhlise ugqirho nabafundi kwikholeji yabaGuli balahlekelwe yimililo, kuquk ukulawula inkqubo yokwenza imisebenzi, ukulawula iNkqubo yokubala abantu basebenza ngayo, ukuziphatha ngobugqirha, ukukhokela nokuSebenza ngokubambisana nebala elikhulu. Qhagamshela nolawulo lweZibhedlela, UkuWelusa ngokubanzi, Ukwala iNtlungu, ukunakekelwa Okukrakra, ukuQeqeshwa kweZibhedlela, iinkonzo zoku Buya emva kokubethwa kabuhlungu kunye nogqirho abakuxela ngomntu ongenayo ukuQhubela amaNkcukacha ukuze kuqinisekwe ukunakekelwa kolahlekelwe yimililo, nokuQhagamshela kumaphakamiso apha inkcukacha apha kwiTygerberg drainage area. Kubonelele ngokufundisa abafundi abangangenanga nabafundi abanegqityiweyo, ukufundisa ecaleni kwembhede, iinkalo zokufundisa nokuqwalasela iNtshukumo yokugqityiweyo kwangaphambili kwexesha, kwaye unikeze ekuzeni kwamava okugqitha kwisayensi nakwizinto ezikwinkqubo elungisa. Yolula kwaye ulalele iinkqubo zokuphandaisa, ukuHlolwa, ukuQokelela iNkcukacha nokuSebenzisa amaNkcukacha eNkonzo kwiNkqubo yokulahlekelwa yimililo, ngokuthatha inxaxheba kubalawuli bokuQamba iNkqubo basebenza ngokubambisana kwiphondo xa kufuneka.

Sterk mensbestuursvaardighede, analitiese denke, probleemoplossing, besluitneming en vermoë om in 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk. Finansiële en hulpbronbestuur. Ervaring in Bestuur of Leierskap.
af.duties: Bestuur algehele prestasie van 'n 24/7 Radiologie-diens by die Streeksaal, binne 'n ekosisteem-benadering. Ondersteuning aan Radiologie-dienste vir Rural East-ekosisteem in samewerking met Groote Schuur-hospitaal soos benodig. Verskaf leierskap en verseker dat toepaslike kliniese bestuurstelsels in plek is vir die Garden Route- en Central Karoo-distrik (Rural East-ekosisteem). Korporatiewe bestuur van die Radiologie-funksionele besigheidsEenheid wat finansiële en menslike hulpbronbestuur insluit. -Samewerking en skakeling met ander Departemente binne die hospitaal en oor die Rural East-ekosisteem heen. Funksioneer binne die Uitvoerende Bestuurspan en pas kennis van openbare gesondheidsadministrasie en -bestuur toe. Neem deel aan navorsing. Superviseer en lei junior en senior personeel, asook onderrig van voor- en nagraadse studente as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span.

zu.title: Uhlelo lwekhanda lemitholampilo izinga 1 (RADIOLOGY)
zu.summary: Buka phansi insiza ye-Radiology yamahora angu-24/7 e-George Regional Hospital, okudinga ukubhaliswa kwe-HPCSA njengesikhanga sezokwelapha kwi-Radiology kanye nokuhlangenwe nakho okungu-3 iminyaka.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo okuncane kuzo: Izifundo ezifanele ezivumela ukubhaliswa e-HPCSA njengesikhanga sezokwelapha kwi-Radiology. Ukubhaliswa komkhakha: Ukubhaliswa e-HPCSA njengesikhanga sezokwelapha kwi-Radiology. Okuhlangenwe nakho: Ukuze kube njalo, kuhlezi kufuneka kube ngaphezulu kwe-3 iminyaka yokuhlangenwe nakho njengesikhanga sezokwelapha emva kokubhaliswa e-HPCSA njengesikhanga sezokwelapha kwi-Radiology. Isidingo esibalulekile sokuqasha: Ilaysensi yokushayela efanele i-Code B. Kuzo zodingwa ukuba uHlelo: Ikhanda lemitholampilo usebenze amahora okusebenza ngaphandle kwesikhathi esijwayelekile, okuncishiselwe emahorini angu-12, uma kunesidingo sokusebenza. Ukuba nakwesiphephulu sokusebenza amahora anguqukayo njengesidingo somthwalo wemitholampilo. Izakhono (ulwazi/izikhongozeli): Kufuneka abe nokulandelana okuqinile kolwazi lomtholampilo nolawulo lwemitholampilo, okubandakanya ukuhlangenwe nakho ekolunjini kanye nokufundisa emazingeni abafundi abangakafiki ne-abayikho, kanye namapheshele kwamapheshele awo wonke amakhosi. Izakhono ezinqamile sokupatha abantu, ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukwenza izinqumo nokuba nalo ikhono lokusebenza eqenjini elinamapheshele amaninge.
zu.duties: Lawula ukusebenza okuphelele kwensiza ye-Radiology yamahora angu-24/7 esibhedlela se-Regional Hospital, ngendlela yokusebenza njenge-ecosystem. Nikela ngokusekela insiza ye-Radiology kwi-Rural East Ecosystem ngokubambisana ne-Groote Schuur Hospital uma kunesidingo. Nikela ngokubusa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba kukho izimiso ezifanele zolawulo lwemitholampilo kwi-Garden Route and Central Karoo District (Rural East Ecosystem). Ulawulo lwebhizinisi le-Radiology Functional Business Unit okubandakanya ukulawula imali nezinsiza zabantu. -Ukusebenzisana nokuxhumana namanye amapheshele angaphakathi kwesibhedlela nakuyo yonke i-Rural East Ecosystem. Sebenza ngaphakathi kweqembu le-Executive Management Team futhi usebenzise ulwazi lolawulo lolawulo loluntu nemiphakathi. Zibandakanye ekuphenyeni. Bukela futhi uqeqeshe abasebenzi abasha nabadala, kanye nokufundisa abafundi abangakafiki ne-abayikho njengengxenye yeqembu elinamapheshele amaninge.

xh.title: Umphathi weNqanaba le-1 lesebe leNgelanisayo lokuSebenza (RADIOLOGY)
xh.summary: Qhatha inkonzo ye-24/7 ye-Radiology esibedlele iGeorge Regional, efuno ubhaliso kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha oPhezayo kwi-Radiology kunye nocwangciso olungangangxekiyo kwiimyanga ze-3.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezingangangxekiyo: Iqualifications ezifanelekileyo ezivumela ubhaliso kwiHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoGqirha oPhezayo kwiRadiology. Ubhaliso kunye nekhophu lemigqo: Ubhaliso kwiHPCSA njengoGqirha oPhezayo kwiRadiology. Isiphaluka: Ubuncinane beentsuku ezimbini zomsebenzi ongagqibekanga njengoGqirha oPhezayo emva kokubhalisa kwiHPCSA njengoGqirha oPhezayo kwiRadiology. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ilayisenisi ye-Code B esebenzayo. Kuya kufunwa kuba kusebenze iingozi ezingapheliyo ezida ngalo lonke ixesha, ezilinganisela kumawaka ali-12, ukuba iimfuno zokusebenza zifuna njalo. Kuya kufuneka ukuba akwazi ukusebenza iiyure eziguqukayo njengoko kudingwa isithwixwixi sesixhobo. Iikhompetensi (ulwazi/amakhono): Kufuneka abe nerekhodi elqabileyo lempilo yakhe ebonakalisa ulwazi lokusebenza neenkqubo zokulawula imicimbi yemfundo, kuquka namava wokufundisa nokufunda kunqanaba lobudiki nobugqirha nakuzo onke amacandelo. Ikhono elinzulu lokulawula abantu, ukucinga ngokwahlulelana, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukwenza izigqibo kunye nakhono lokusebenza kwindlu equlunqwe ngamagatya amaninzi. Ulawulo lweMali kwaye nokuLawulwa kweZibonelelo. Isiphaluka sokulawula okanye uLawulo.
xh.duties: Lawula inkqubo yonke yemisebenzi ye-24/7 kwinkonzo yeRadiology esibedlele iGeorge Regional, ngendlela ekujoliswe kuyo iinkqubo ezidityaniswe kunye. Nika inkxaso kwiinkonzo zeRadiology kummandla oQhelekileyo weGqitha iGqirha sibedlele naseGroote Schuur Hospital xa kusetyenziswa. Nika uLawulo kuqinisekise inkqubo ezifanelekileyo zokulawula imicimbi yemfundo kuGarden Route nakuCentral Karoo District (ummandla oQhelekileyo waseGqirha). Ulawulo lenkqubo yeRadiology egunyazisiweyo equka ukulawula imali kwaye nokuLawulwa kwabasebenzi. -Ukuhlangenwe ngenye indlela nokuvakashelwa kwamanye amasebe angaphakathi kwesibedlele nakummandla oQhelekileyo waseGqirha. Sebenza ngaphakathi kweqela leLawulo eliPhezulu kwaye usebenzise ulwazi lolawulo kwaye nokulawula inkonzo yabantu bonke. Thatha inxaxheba kophando. Qeqesha kwaye ulungise abasebenzi abasha nabakhulu, nafundisa abafundi abangangqamanga nangabaphumeleyo njengenxalenye yeqela elungiselelwe amagatya amaninzi.

jobs.title: Medical Specialist Grade 1 to 3 (PLASTIC Surgery)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 395 528 per annum Grade 2: R1 592 274 per annum Grade 3: R1 844 151 per annum (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.)
jobs.summary: Medical Specialist in Plastic Surgery sought for Groote Schuur Hospital, Western Cape, offering salaries from R1,395,528 to R1,844,151 per annum across three grades.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualifications: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Medical Specialist in Plastic Surgery. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Plastic Surgery. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Plastic Surgery. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years appropriate experience as Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA (or a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of a foreign qualified employee) as Medical Specialist in Plastic Surgery. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years appropriate experience as Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA (or a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of a foreign qualified employee) as Medical Specialist in Plastic Surgery. Inherent requirements of the job: Commuted overtime is compulsory. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Ability to work in a team. Ability to communicate effectively (verbal and written). Ability to initiate research, strong academic record in terms of teaching and research supported by publications and presentations. Commitment to attaining advanced surgical skills especially in Microsurgery. Computer literacy, the ability to develop and work with databases. Skills and experience in undergraduate and postgraduate teaching and training.
jobs.duties: Ensuring, as part of a team, continuous improvements in the quality, efficiency and outcome of plastic surgery patients. Help manage the out-patient service for Plastic Surgery. Train under/post-graduate students, including elective students, and other allied health personnel. Assist with leadership and oversight of the day-day running of the Division of Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery. Assist with cross-cover for the plastic service at Red Cross War Memorial Children’s Hospital. Actively participate in all the academic activities of the division including performing and overseeing research. Assess, investigate and manage patients referred to the Plastic Surgery service from the Western Cape and beyond.
jobs.enquiries: Prof S Adams Tel No: (021) 406-6415 or email: saleigh.adams@uct.ac.za
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Groote Schuur Hospital has adopted the department’s ecosystem framing of its training platform. Accordingly, all medical specialist appointments may be called upon to work across this platform and may include rotations at Metro West and Rural East hospitals. This includes Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital, New Somerset Hospital, Mitchells Plein District Hospital, Victoria Hospital and George Provincial Hospital. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). Please ensure that you attach an updated CV. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the advert for the POST 37/287: Deputy Director: Manager Hospital Development (5/8th Post) Directorate: Facilities and Infrastructure Management, Centre: Tygerberg Hospital, Redevelopment Office, Salary R582 684 (5/8th) per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual’s personal needs) advertised in the Public Service Vacancy 37 dated 16 October 2026, has been amended as follows: Deputy Director: Manager Hospital Development (5/8th Post) (3 Year-Contract) OTHER POSTS

af.title: Mediese Spesialis Graad 1 tot 3 (PLASTIESE Chirurgie)
af.summary: Mediese Spesialis in Plastiese Chirurgie gesoek vir Groote Schuur Hospital, Western Cape, met salarisse vanaf R1,395,528 tot R1,844,151 per annum oor drie grade.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasies: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie met die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Mediese Spesialis in Plastiese Chirurgie moontlik maak. Registrasie met 'n professionele raad: Registrasie met die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Plastiese Chirurgie. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen nadat registrasie met die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Plastiese Chirurgie verkry is nie. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie met die HPCSA (of 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van 'n buitelands gekwalifiseerde werknemer) as Mediese Spesialis in Plastiese Chirurgie. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie met die HPCSA (of 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van 'n buitelands gekwalifiseerde werknemer) as Mediese Spesialis in Plastiese Chirurgie. Inherente vereistes van die pos: Gekombineerde oortyd is verpligtend. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om in 'n span te werk. Vermoë om doeltreffend te kommunikeer (mondeling en skriftelik). Vermoë om navorsing te inisieer, sterk akademiese rekord ten opsigte van onderrig en navorsing ondersteun deur publikasies en voorleggings. Toewyding aan die verwerwing van gevorderde chirurgiese vaardighede veral in Mikrochirurgie. Rekenaarvaardigheid, die vermoë om databasisse te ontwikkel en daarmee te werk. Vaardighede en ervaring in voor- en nagraadse onderrig en opleiding.
af.duties: Verseker, as deel van 'n span, deurlopende verbeterings in die gehalte, doeltreffendheid en uitkoms van plastiese chirurgie-pasiënte. Help bestuur die buitepasiëntdiens vir Plastiese Chirurgie. Leer voor-/nagraadse studente, insluitend keusestudente, en ander verwante gesondheidspersoneel op. Bystand verleen met leierskap en toesig oor die daaglikse bestuur van die Afdeling Plastiese en Rekonstruktiewe Chirurgie. Bystand verleen met kruisdekking vir die plastiese diens by Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital. Neem aktief deel aan alle akademiese aktiwiteite van die afdeling insluitend die uitvoer en toesig hou oor navorsing. Evalueer, ondersoek en bestuur pasiënte wat na die Plastiese Chirurgie-diens verwys word vanuit die Western Cape en daar buite.

zu.title: Uchwepheshe Wezokwelapha Izinga 1 kuye ku-3 (I-Podiatric Surgery)
zu.summary: Kufunwa uchwepheshe wezokwelapha kwi-Podiatric Surgery wesibhedlela i-Groote Schuur Hospital, e-Western Cape, ehlinzeka ngamaholo asuka ku-R1,395,528 kuya ku-R1,844,151 ngonyaka kuzo zonke izinga ezintathu.
zu.requirements: Izindingo zemfundo ezingowonke: Isifikadhwe esifanele esimvumela ukuba abhalise ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha kwi-Podiatric Surgery. Ukwengamathiselwa kubhalwe kunhlangano yamagugu: Ukubhalwa ku-HPCSA njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha kwi-Podiatric Surgery. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekileko emva kokubhalwa i-HPCSA njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha kwi-Podiatric Surgery. Izinga 2: Okungenani ihlandla leminyaka eli-5 isipiliyoni esifanele somchwepheshe wezokwelapha emva kokubhalwa i-HPCSA (noma kunhlangano yamagugu evezwe njengamahle kwabasebenzi abafundile kumanye amazwe) njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha kwi-Podiatric Surgery. Izinga 3: Okungenani ihlandla leminyaka eli-10 isipiliyoni esifanele somchwepheshe wezokwelapha emva kokubhalwa i-HPCSA (noma kunhlangano yamagugu evezwe njengamahle kwabasebenzi abafundile kumanye amazwe) njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha kwi-Podiatric Surgery. Izidingo ezingokwakho emsebenzini: Ukusebenza ngenkathi efaniselweko kuyadingeka. Ikhono (ulwazi/izikrini): Ukuthanda ukusebenza ngokuphathe abantu abanengi. Ukukwazi ukuthetha kahle ngokukhuluma nakubhalayo. Ukuthanda nokuba mello wokwenza isifundo, ukugcina isifundo esihle nendlela yokufunda nokwenza isifundo esisekelwa ngokubhala nokudalula izinto. Ukuzinikela ekufundiseni amasunduwo wokusebenza ngokwamanobumba aphambili kwikhambo le-I-Microsurgery. Ukusebenzisana namakhomphyutha, ukukwazi ukuthuthukisa nokusebenza ngemithololho yolwazi. Ulwazi nesipiliyoni ekufundiseni nokuqeqesha abafundi abangenayo nabangaphandle.
zu.duties: Ukuqinisekisa ukuba ngamunye wabantu abanengi, ukuthuthuka okungaphezulu kokuhamba kwezempilo, ukugcina isikhathi okuhle, nokuvela komphumela ongconothiweko emagulwini abangenayo e-Podiatric Surgery. Ukusiza ekuphathe imisebenzi egulwini abangenayo ngaphandle kwesibhedlela i-Podiatric Surgery. Ukufundisa abafundi abangenayo abangenangaphezulu, okuhlanganisa abafundi abazikhethelayo, nabanye abantu abasebenza ngemithololho yezokwelapha. Ukusiza ekuthomeni nokubuka ukuphatha kwemini ngemini kokuphatheka kwe-Podiatric Surgery kanye nokuphendula i-surgery. Ukusiza ukusombulula ukusiza kwamanye amasibhedlela iplastiki e-Red Cross War Memorial Children’s Hospital. Ukubambe iqhaza kakhulu kumasebenzi onke okufundwayo, okuhlanganisa nokwenza nokubuka isifundo sokuphatha iplastiki. Ukufunda, ukuphenya nokuphatha amagulu athunyelwe kwindlela ye-Podiatric Surgery ukusuka kwi-Western Cape nangaphandle.

xh.title: Uchwepheshe Wezempilo Inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3 (Unyango lwe-PLASTIC)
xh.summary: Kufunwa uchwepheshe wezempilo kunyango lwe-Plastic Surgery eGroote Schuur Hospital, eWestern Cape, kunye nomvuzo oqala kwireyithi R1,395,528 ukuya kwireyithi R1,844,151 ngonyaka kuzo zonke iinqanaba ezintathu.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezincinane zemfundo: Isifundo esifanelekilo esivumela ukubhalisa kwiHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengo chwepheshe wezempilo kunyango lwe-Plastic Surgery. Ukubhalisa kwibhunga lobuchwepheshe: Ukubhalisa kwiHPCSA njengo chwepheshe wezempilo kunyango lwe-Plastic Surgery. Isipho sokusebenza: Inqanaba 1: Akukho mfuno emva kokubhalisa kwiHPCSA njengo chwepheshe wezempilo kunyango lwe-Plastic Surgery. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-5 yesipho sokusebenza esifanelekileyo njengo chwepheshe wezempilo emva kokubhalisa kwiHPCSA (okanye ebhungeni labagqatswa bezempilo basemazwe ngamazwe eliqatywayo malunga nomsebenzisi ofundwe emazwe ngamazwe) njengo chwepheshe wezempilo kunyango lwe-Plastic Surgery. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-10 yesipho sokusebenza esifanelekileyo njengo chwepheshe wezempilo emva kokubhalisa kwiHPCSA (okanye ebhungeni labagqatswa bezempilo basemazwe ngamazwe eliqatywayo malunga nomsebenzisi ofundwe emazwe ngamazwe) njengo chwepheshe wezempilo kunyango lwe-Plastic Surgery. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Unyulu lokusebenza ixesha elide egqithiswayo yiyo kuyimfuno. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ikono lokusebenza eqeleni. Ikono ukuxoxa ngokusebenzayo (ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo). Ikono ukuqalisa uphando, irekhodi eqinileyo yamabakala kwimfundiso nophando exhaswa zizinto ezishiyiweyo neziboniso. Inkathalo yokufumana amakhono anobuchwepheshe obuphakamileyo ekwenzeni iintshilo ikakhulu kwiMicrosurgery. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha, ikono yokuphucula nangokusebenza nedayitha. Amakhono nesipho sokufundisa nokuqeqesha abafundi abangakafundi kwaye abafunde kwakhona.
xh.duties: Ukuqinisekisa, njengengxenye yeqela, ukuphucuka okuqhubekayo kwikhwalithi, ukusebenza kakuhle nemvelaphi yeempatient zenyango lwe-plastic surgery. Ukunceda ukulawula inkonzo yabaguli bango-phandle benyango lwe-Plastic Surgery. Ukuqeqesha abafundi abangakafundi nabalawulo, kuquka abafundi abakhethwayo, nabanye basebenzi bezempilo. Ukunceda nengurume negalelo ekusebenzeni kwansuku zonke kohlulo lwenyango lwe-Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery. Ukunceda ngokugqithisa inkonazo kwantshilo zenyango lwe-plastic eRed Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital. Ukubamba inxaxheba ngokusebenzayo kuzo zonke iinkqubo zamabakala zohlulo kuquka nokwenza nokuqwalasela uphando. Ukuqwalasela, ukuphanda nangokulawula abaguli abathunyelwa kwinkonzo yenyango lwe-Plastic Surgery ukusuka eWestern Cape nakunye.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Comprehensive Services
jobs.salary_text: R1 101 468 per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual’s personal needs).
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Comprehensive Services at the West Coast District Office in Malmesbury, requiring an NQF 7 health qualification and HPCSA, SANC or SAPC registration.

Experience: Appropriate experience in District Health Services and Health Service Management as well as experience in management of priority health services and health programs. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid (Code B/EB/C1) driver’s license and willingness to travel. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge of the District Health System and strategic plan of the Department of Health and wellness (Healthcare 2030/2050). Optimal and efficient Project Management and Financial Management skills. Good knowledge of Health-related regulations, policies, Acts in respect of Statutory Bodies, Health facility Boards, District health councils. Good communication, interpersonal, leadership and conflict management skills. Computer literacy (Ms. Word, PowerPoint and Excel) and facilitation skills.
jobs.duties: Overall leadership and management the Integrated Comprehensive Health Services in the West Coast District health services within the Rural West Eco- system. Provide leadership and management related to quality patient- centred-care of integrated service delivery on the HCBS, PHC platform and district hospitals. Lead and support information management, information systems, including monitoring and evaluation of all health services by setting specific targets, monitor indicators and health outcomes in the district. Provide leadership and management of resource allocation, health services budgets, people management and assets in the component. Interface management and effective communication with all internal and external stakeholders on all platforms. Lead and support skills development and capacity building of clinical nurse training and the NPO sector.
jobs.enquiries: Mr W. Caesar Tel No: (022) 814-0301
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).

One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Omvattende Dienste
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur: Omvattende Dienste by die Weskus Distrikkantoor in Malmesbury, wat 'n NQF 7 gesondheidskwalifikasie en HPCSA-, SANC- of SAPC-registrasie vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: 'n Toepaslike gesondheidsverwante kwalifikasie (NQF 7) wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) of South African Nursing Council (SANC) of South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) moontlik maak. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in Distrik Gesondheidsdienste en Gesondheidsdiensbestuur asook ervaring in die bestuur van prioriteitsgesondheidsdienste en gesondheidsprogramme. Inherente vereistes van die pos: Geldige (Kode B/EB/C1) bestuurslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis van die Distrik Gesondheidsstelsel en strategiese plan van die Department of Health and wellness (Healthcare 2030/2050). Optimale en doeltreffende Projekbestuur en Finansiële Bestuur vaardighede. Goeie kennis van Gesondheidsverwante regulasies, beleide, Wette ten opsigte van Statutêre Liggame, Gesondheidsfasiliteitsrade, Distrik gesondheidsrade. Goeie kommunikasie, interpersoonlike, leierskaps- en konflikbestuursvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid (Ms. Word, PowerPoint en Excel) en fasilitasievaardighede.
af.duties: Algehele leierskap en bestuur van die Geïntegreerde Omvattende Gesondheidsdienste in die Weskus Distrik gesondheidsdienste binne die Landelike Wes Ekostelsel. Verskaf leierskap en bestuur verwant aan gehalte pasiëntgesentreerde sorg van geïntegreerde dienslewering op die HCBS-, PHC-platform en distrikshospitale. Lei en ondersteun inligtingbestuur, inligtingstelsels, insluitend monitering en evaluering van alle gesondheidsdienste deur spesifieke teikens te stel, aanwysers en gesondheidsuitkomste in die distrik te monitor. Verskaf leierskap en bestuur van hulpbrontoewysing, gesondheidsdienstebegrotings, mensebestuur en bates in die komponent. Skakelbestuur en doeltreffende kommunikasie met alle interne en eksterne belanghebbendes op alle platforms. Lei en ondersteun vaardigheidsontwikkeling en kapasiteitsbou van kliniese verpleegsteropleiding en die NPO-sektor.

zu.title: ONgqongqoshe: Isevisi Ebanzi
zu.summary: ONgqongqoshe: Isevisi Ebanzi eKantolo LoMmandla West Coast eMalmesbury, kudingeka iziqu zempilo ze-NQF 7 nokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA, SANC noma i-SAPC.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zemfundo ezingaphansi kwesidingo: Iziqu ezifanele ezihlotshaniswe nezempilo (NQF 7) ezivumela ukubhaliswa kuHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) noma South African Nursing Council (SANC) noma South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC). Isiphephelo: Isiphephelo esifanele kwi-District Health Services kanye noMphathi Wezinsizakalo Ezempilo kanye nokuba nesiphephelo ekuphathweni kwezinsizakalo ezibalulekile zempilo kanye namaphrograms empilo. Izidingo ezitholakale emsebenzini: Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B/EB/C1) evumelekile nokuthanda ukuhamba. Amandla (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi nge-District Health System kanye nenqubomgomo ye-Department of Health and wellness (Healthcare 2030/2050). Amakhono aphumelelayo nokusebenza kahle koMphathi Wezinhlelo nokuphathwa Kwezimali. Ulwazi oluhle ngezinqubo, izinqubomgomo, kanye nama-Act ahlobene namabhunga ezomthetho, amabhunga ezindawo zempilo, kanye namakhansela empilo esifundazwa. Amakhono ohlakaniphile okuxhumana, obantu, abaholi kanye nokuphathwa kwezinxibelelwano. Ukubhalisele ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha (Ms. Word, PowerPoint kanye ne-Excel) kanye namakhono okubamba izifundo.
zu.duties: Ukubusa ngokuphelele nokuphatha Isevisi Yezempilo Ebanzi Ehlangene kwi-West Coast District health services ngaphakathi kwe-Rural West Eco- system. Nikeza isibusiso kanye nokuphathwa okuhlobene nokunakekelwa kweziguli okugxile kugunjiniwe kokulethwa kwezinsizakalo eziyisinye ku-HCBS, kwisimiso se-PHC kanye nakumahospithala esifundazwa. Hola kanye nokusekela ukuphathwa kolwazi, izimiso ezolwazi, okuhlanganisa nokuqapha kanye nokuhlolwa kwayo yonke imisebenzi yezempilo ngokumisa izinhloso ezithile, ukuqapha izinkomba kanye nemiphumela yezempilo esifundazweni. Nikeza isibusiso kanye nokuphathwa kokwabiwa kwemithombo, amabhajethi ezinsizakalo zempilo, ukuphathwa kwabantu kanye nezimpahla kuleyoqoqo. Ukuphathwa koxhumano kanye nokuxhumana ngokusebenza kahle nabo bonke abaningi bengaphakathi nangaphandle kuzo zonke izinkundla. Hola kanye nokusekela ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kanye nokwakhiwa kwamandla ekuqeqeshweni kabanuhlalutheka kweziguli kanye nendima ye-NPO.

Imfundo: Ifundo elungileyo kwiinkonzo zeZempilo zoMmandla nokuLawulwa kweZinkonzo zeZempilo kanjalo noluhlu lolwazi ekulawuleni iinkonzo ezibalulekileyo nezentsozo ezintsonthotho zezempilo. Iimfuno ezisemzimbeni zomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B/EB/C1) esebenzayo nethemba lokuhamba. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi ngeNkqubo yeZempilo yoMmandla nendlela esekwe kuyo iSebe leZempilo nemfuyo (Healthcare 2030/2050). Amanyathelo amabini ngokuphuculwayo nokusebenza kakuhle okuLawulwa kweMisebenzi nokulawula iMali. Ulwazi olululu ngemigaqo ezimalana nezempilo, iinkqubo, iMithetho malunga neeBhunga eziLungiselelwa ngumthetho, iBhunga leziBhunga zokuQashwa izigulana, iBhunga loMmandla. Amakhono amabini okuncokolisa, okuziphatha kubantu, abakhokeli nokulawula iingxabano. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Ms. Word, PowerPoint and Excel) namakhono okukhuthaza.

Khokela inkokheli nokulawula ukuphathwa kolwazi, iinkqubo zolwazi, kuquka nokubeka umlinganiselo wokubeka iinjongo ezithile, ukulandelela iinkomba nemiphumela yezempilo kulawulo lwemisebenzi ebalulekileyo. Nikeza inkokheli nokulawula ukwabiwa kwamathuba, amaxa einkonzo ezintsonthotho, ukuphathwa kwabantu nempahla kwindima. Lawula nokuthetha ngokusebenzayo nabathile abangaphakathi nangaphandle ngakuzo zonke iinkqubo. Khokela nokukhuthaza ukuphuhliswa kwamakhono nokwakha amandla emfundo yokukhokela abantu abakliniki nakwindima ye-NPO.

jobs.title: Registrar (MEDICAL) (MEDICINE: Internal)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 041 402 per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual’s personal needs).
jobs.summary: Registrar in Internal Medicine at Groote Schuur Hospital, requiring HPCSA registration as a Medical Practitioner.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Practitioner. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner (Independent Practice). Inherent requirements of the job: Commuted overtime is compulsory. Each Registrar will be appointed in a specific training complex but could be required to work across the platform on request. Emergency and after hour call cover. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Appropriate and sufficient clinical experience since obtaining the degree of MBChB and after completion of internal medicine rotations. Effective leadership & interpersonal skills. FCP (SA) Part 1. Knowledge, expertise and experience with regards to providing medical services in assessment, diagnosis and treatment of inpatients and outpatients. Post community service experience in Internal Medicine on an equivalent clinical platform. Previous research experience and publication.
jobs.duties: Clinical Service Provision. Effective Clinical Administration in patient records and patient reports. Participate in the Teaching Programme. Research and Professional Development (incl. completion of MMED).
jobs.enquiries: Dr D Maughan Tel No: (021) 406-6422 or deborah.maughan@uct.ac.za
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). Consideration will be given to existing employees who are already on higher salary packages to retain their existing salary position, as personal. As such they are entitled to receive pay progression. Appointment as a Registrar will be for a maximum contract period of 4 years. Employees in service who opt to continue with their pension benefits as Registrar, will be required to resign after completion of their registrarship should they not be successful for advertised Specialist positions. Should registration with the HEI as a student be discontinued for any reason the appointment of Registrar also discontinues. Applicants must indicate whether they have bursary obligations. Groote Schuur Hospital has adopted the department’s ecosystem framing of its training platform. Accordingly, all registrar appointments may be called upon to work across this platform and may include rotations at Metro West and Rural East hospitals. This includes Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital, New Somerset Hospital, Mitchells Plein District Hospital, Victoria Hospital and George Provincial Hospital. The Department of Health is guided by the principles of Employment Equity. Candidates with disability are encouraged to apply and an indication in this regard will be appreciated. Specific Registrar posts within the Department will be identified as part of the Affirmative Action programme to create a representative Specialist cadre in line with applicable procedures. Preference will be given to SA citizens/permanent residents with a valid identity document. Registrars will be required to register as post-graduates with University of the Western Cape according to the yearbook and guidelines. Please ensure that you attach an updated CV. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the advert for the POST 37/287: Deputy Director: Manager Hospital Development (5/8th Post) Directorate: Facilities and Infrastructure Management, Centre: Tygerberg Hospital, Redevelopment Office, Salary R582 684 (5/8th) per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual’s personal needs) advertised in the Public Service Vacancy 37 dated 16 October 2026, has been amended as follows: Deputy Director: Manager Hospital Development (5/8th Post) (3 Year-Contract) OTHER POSTS
