xh.title: Umenzi wesalathiso (EZESIQELO LOMZIMBA) (EZESIQELO LOMZIMBA: Langaphakathi)
xh.summary: Umenzi wesalathiso kwiSiqelo Lomzimba Langaphakathi eGroote Schuur Hospital, efuno ukubhalisa kwiHPCSA njengogqirha.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezingaphantsi kwesiqinisekiso: Isiqinisekiso esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalisa kwiHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengogqirha. Ukubhalisa kwiBhungo lobugqirha: Ukubhalisa kwiHPCSA njengogqirha (Ukuqamba okuzimeleyo). Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Iyakutshatyalaliswa ngokuchithwa kwexesha elongezelelweyo kumsebenzi. Qho umenzi wesalathiso uya kushicilelwa kwiplatform ethile yokuqeqesha kodwa angafunwa ukuba asebenze kwindawo nayo ngecela. Ukugubungela iimeko ezibuthathaka nexesha langaphandle. Ikhono (ulwazi/amaxesha okusebenza): Ulwazi olufanelekileyo nolwaneleyo lweklinikhi ukususela ekufumaneni idigri yeMBChB emva kokugqitywa kokuqhuba okusesiqelini somzimba langaphakathi. Ikhono elisebenzayo lekhosenethi & lobuntu bokusebenza nabantu. IFCP (SA) Indawo 1. Ulwazi, amakhono amandla nolwazi lokunika iinkonzo zesiqelo ekuhloleni, ekubekeni isifo nokuqhatha abagula abalali kwisibhedlele nangaphandle. Ulwazi lokusebenza emva kwenkonzo yomphakathi esiSigelini somzimba langaphakathi kwiplatform efanayo yeklinikhi. Ulwazi lwangaphambili lokuphand noshicilelo.
xh.duties: Ukunika inkonzo yeklinikhi. Ulawulo olusebenzayo lweklinikhi kwirekhodi yomgula nangemibiko yomgula. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiNkqubo yokuFunda. Uphononongo nokuZuzisa ngobuchophokazi (kuquka nokugqitywa kweMMED).

jobs.title: Registrar (MEDICAL): Public Health Medicine
jobs.salary_text: R1 041 402 per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual’s personal needs.)
jobs.summary: Registrar in Public Health Medicine at the Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness Head Office, requiring HPCSA registration and a valid driver's licence.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Practitioner. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner (independent practice). Inherent requirement of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s licence. Registration for the MMED in Public Health Medicine at the University of Cape Town. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Computer literacy, and the ability to learn new technical skills. The candidate must have a strong understanding of public health, health systems and health policy. Preference will be given to candidates with a relevant post graduate public health qualification. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Good interpersonal and time- management skills. The successful candidate is expected to be technically competent and to align to the values of the Department of Health and Wellness.
jobs.duties: Public Health medical service provision in the public sector health services in different rotations and locations. Teaching and training/supervision of under and postgraduates and running training for WCG service personnel. Operational research and presentation and publication in peer-reviewed scientific fora. Management, administration and leadership – using public health expertise to assist administration, management and allocation of personnel, resources and facilities, and to monitor and evaluate programmes and projects. Participate in formal training in public health disciplinary components.
jobs.enquiries: Ms Lesley Shand Tel No: (021) 483 2639 or email: lesley.shand@westerncape.gov.za
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates may be subjected to a competency test. No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. As directed by the Department of Public Service and Administration, applicants must note that further checks will be conducted once they are shortlisted and that their appointment is subject to positive outcomes on these checks, which include security clearance, qualification verification, criminal records and previous employment. Appointment as Registrar will be for a maximum contract period of 4 years. It may become necessary to second/transfer staff to another hospital/institution during their period of training, in which case affected staff will be consulted prior to any decision being implemented. Registrars will function across health facilities, as per an agreed programme. Registrars will be required to register as post- graduates with the applicable University in the Western Cape according to the requirements for the discipline in the yearbook and guidelines. Should registration with the HEI as a student be discontinued for any reason the appointment as a Registrar also discontinues. Consideration will be given to existing employees who are already on higher salary packages to retain their existing salary position, as personnel. As such they are entitled to receive pay progression. Employees in service who opt to continue with their pension benefits as Registrar, will be required to resign after completion of their registrarship should they not be successful for advertised Specialist positions. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for a change in registration status). Specific Registrar posts within the Department will be identified as part of the Affirmative Action programme to create a representative Specialist cadre in line with applicable procedures. Note: 1 post will require to be placed in George for 2 years. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the advert for the POST 37/287: Deputy Director: Manager Hospital Development (5/8th Post) Directorate: Facilities and Infrastructure Management, Centre: Tygerberg Hospital, Redevelopment Office, Salary R582 684 (5/8th) per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual’s personal needs) advertised in the Public Service Vacancy 37 dated 16 October 2026, has been amended as follows: Deputy Director: Manager Hospital Development (5/8th Post) (3 Year-Contract) OTHER POSTS

af.title: Registrar (MEDIES): Public Health Medicine
af.summary: Registrar in Public Health Medicine by die Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness Hoofkantoor, wat HPCSA-registrasie en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n mediese praktisyn toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n mediese praktisyn (onafhanklike praktyk). Inheemse vereiste van die werk: Geldige (Code B/EB) bestuurslisensie. Registrasie vir die MMED in Public Health Medicine by die University of Cape Town. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Rekenaargeletterdheid, en die vermoë om nuwe tegniese vaardighede aan te leer. Die kandidaat moet 'n sterk begrip van openbare gesondheid, gesondheidstelsels en gesondheidsbeleid hê. Voorkeur sal gegee word aan kandidate met 'n tersaaklike nagraadse openbare gesondheidskwalifikasie. Uitstekende mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Goeie interpersoonlike en tydsbestuursvaardighede. Die suksesvolle kandidaat word verwag om tegnies bevoeg te wees en by die waardes van die Department of Health and Wellness aan te sluit.
af.duties: Lewering van openbare gesondheidsmediese dienste in die openbare sektor se gesondheidsdienste in verskillende rotasies en plekke. Onderrig en opleiding/toesig van voor- en nagraadse studente en aanbieding van opleiding vir WCG-dienspersoneel. Operasionele navorsing en voorlegging en publikasie in portuurgekeurde wetenskaplike fora. Bestuur, administrasie en leierskap – gebruik van openbare gesondheidskundigheid om administrasie, bestuur en toewysing van personeel, hulpbronne en fasiliteite te ondersteun, en om programme en projekte te monitor en te evalueer. Deelneem aan formele opleiding in openbare gesondheidsdissiplinêre komponente.

zu.title: Umabhalane (WOKWELAPHA): IMITHOLMPILO YOMPHAKATHI
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba ngumabhalane emitholmpilo yomphakathi esikhungweni esikhulu se-Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness, kudinga ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kanye ne-layisensi yokushayela esebenzayo.
zu.requirements: Isidingo samathambo sekharikhulamu: Isiqu esifanele esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengodokotela ohlinzayo. Ukubhalisa kubhalwe ngenhlangano yolwazi: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengodokotela ohlinzayo (ngokuzimela ekusebenzeni). Isidingo salolu msebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B/EB) esebenzayo. Ukubhalisa kwi-MMAD yemitholmpilo yomphakathi e-University of Cape Town. Izindlela (ulwazi/amasu): Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kanye nethuba lokufunda amasu amasha obuchwepheshhe. Kudingeka umuntu akuqonde ngokujulile ngemitholmpilo yomphakathi, izimiso zezempilo kanye nemigomo yezempilo. Kuzothunyelwa ngaphezulu abantu abanesiqu esifanele sokuthutha emitholmpilo yomphakathi emva kwesiqu. Amandla okukhuluma nokubhala kahle. Amandla okuhlobana nabantu kanye nokuphatha isikhathi. Umuntu okhethiwe kulindeleke ukuba nokwazi okobuchwepheshhe nokuhambisana nemitjhili yabasebenzi bemitholmpilo.
zu.duties: Ukunikeza izinkonzo zokwelapha ezinkabeni ezivezwe emphakathi ezinkonzeni zezempilo komphakathi kuzinhlaka ezahlukene nendawo. Ukufundisa nokugadula abafundi abaphakathi nabanoma ngaphakathi kwesikhathi sabo sokufunda nokubumba abasebenzi be-WCG. Ucwaningo lokusebenza, ukubumba ukudalulwa kanye nokushicilelwa kumaza ababili abashiwo iziqu. Ukuphatha, ukulawula inhlelo nokuba ngumholi – ukusebenzisa ukwazi kwemitholmpilo yomphakathi ukusiza ukulawula, ukuphatha nokwaba imithwalo yabasebenzi, izinsiza kanye namaphuzu, kanye nokubuka futhi uhlole izinhlelo namagepha. Ukubamba iqhaza ekufundiseni ngokwemitholmpilo yomphakathi.

xh.title: Um_Phathi (WEZEMPILO): IzoLimo ngaweMPilo kuLuntu
xh.summary: Um_Phathi kwiZoLimo ngaweMPilo kuLuntu kwiWestern Cape Department of Health and Wellness Head Office, lifuna ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA nelayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.requirements: Isigaba sokufunda esincinane: Isiqu esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengogqirha wezempilo. Ukubhalisa koluntu olusebenzayo: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha wezempilo (inkqubo yokuzilolonga ezigqithiselayo). Icawa yokwenza le nsiba: Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni (i-Code B/EB). Ukubhalisa kwi-MMED kwiZoLimo ngaweMPilo kuLuntu kwi-University of Cape Town. Ulwazi (olwazi/izikholwa): Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, nokuThembu ngeziqu evela kwi-MED kwi-University of Cape Town. Isakhulu (isazindingqondo/izakhono): Ulwazi lweekhompyutha, nendlela yokusebenzela izikholo ezinitsha zobugcisa. Umngeni wezopolitiko makakwazi ngokuzingca ngemizobo nokuqonda inkqubo yezempilo yako. Isikhethwa masinikwe abantu abanesiqu sokuziphucula ngemizobo yezempilo. Ikhomityhudeyithi ezingca kubalulekile ngokuthetha kubakho nokuqamba izimvo. Ulwazi oluseziko ngokudibana noqeqesho. Umntu ophumeleleyo makabe nomkhwa wolwazi kwezobugcisa aze alinge nemizabo yeNyango yoNyilo lwaMaphakade (Code B/EB). Ukubhalisa kwi-MMED kwiZoLimo ngaweMPilo kwi-University of Cape Town. Ulwazi/Izakhono: Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, nokuba nokuzuza izakhono ezintsha zobugcisa bosiko. Umnyatheli kufuneka abe nokuqonda okuqinileyo kwempilo yoluntu, iinkqubo zempilo namagunya empilo. Isikhundla siza kunikwa abathathi nxaxheba abanesiqu sokugqibela kwizifundo zempilo yoluntu. Izakhono ezilungileyo zokuthetha nokubhala. Izakhono ezilungileyo zokusebenza nabantu nokulawula ixesha. Umntu ophumeleleyo kulindelekile ukuba azisebenzele ngobugcisa azelalishe nemibono ye-Nyango yoNyilo lwaMaphakade.
xh.duties: Iinkonzo zonyango ezikwikhaya lezempilo, ezisebenza kumphakathi ngemiba yokujika okokuba kwindawo ezahlukeneyo. Ukuqeqesha nokulawula abafundi abangaphantsi kwexesha elifutshane nelingagqityiweyo kwaye ngaphezu koko abo bafaka isicelo sokuqeqeshwa kubasebenzi be-WCG. Upando-lwazi nolukhoyoIulo nokuvelisa kwindawo ethengisa ngokubhaliweyo apho kunye nemibuzo yabantu ekunxibelelanisayo, kunye noqeqesha abasebenzi be-WCG. Uphando-nzame nokubonisa ngapandle kwamagama kwizibini ezinje ngokuba ngabambeleli abanemveliso ekuvunyweni kwexesha elifanelekileyo kumntu ngamnye. Ulawulo, ukulawula nokuqonda - ukusebenzisa ulwazi ngemiba yoluntu ngokukunceda ukuba ulawule, ulawule ulwabiwo labantu, imithombo nakwindawo ekuyo ngokubanzi, kwaye ulawule kwaye ahlule inkqubo namaphulo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yokuqeqeshwa kumalunga naweMpilo yoLuntu.

jobs.summary: Medical Officer Grades 1 to 3 sought for the Trauma Centre at Groote Schuur Hospital, requiring HPCSA registration as a Medical Practitioner.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Practitioner. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration as Medical Practitioner with the HPCSA in respect of SA qualified employees. 1-year relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognized foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years’ appropriate experience as Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 6 years’ relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required n South Africa. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate experience as a Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 11 years’ relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognized foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Inherent requirements of the job: Advanced Trauma Life support (ATLS) certified. Commuted overtime is compulsory. Participate in the after-hours call system. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Airway skills and ability to resuscitate the severely injured patient. Ability to conduct research. Ability to work as part of a trauma team. Knowledge, expertise and experience with regards to providing medical care of high care trauma patients. Basic surgical skills, ultrasound course, PALS,BLS and ACLS. Appropriate and sufficient clinical experience since obtaining the degree of MBChB and after completion of internal rotations. Completion of Community Service and prior trauma experience.
jobs.duties: Leadership. Teaching. Innovation and Research. Clinical Governance. Clinical Service: Patient care and assisting in theatre.

af.title: Mediese Beampte Vlak 1 tot 3 (TRAUMA-sentrum)
af.summary: Mediese beamptes Vlakke 1 tot 3 word gesoek vir die Trauma-sentrum by Groote Schuur Hospitaal, wat HPCSA-registrasie as 'n Mediese Praktisyn vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn. Ervaring: Vlak 1: Geen na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by die HPCSA met betrekking tot SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers nie. 1-jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Gesondheidsprofessionele Raad met betrekking tot buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers, vir wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Vlak 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn met betrekking tot SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 6 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Gesondheidsprofessionele Raad met betrekking tot buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers, vir wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Vlak 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn met betrekking tot SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 11 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Gesondheidsprofessionele Raad met betrekking tot buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers, vir wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Advanced Trauma Life Support (ATLS)-sertifisering. Pendel-oortyd is verpligtend. Neem deel aan die buite-ure oproepstelsel. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Lugwegvaardighede en vermoë om die ernstig beseerde pasiënt te reviveer. Vermoë om navorsing te doen. Vermoë om as deel van 'n traumaspan te werk. Kennis, kundigheid en ervaring met betrekking tot die verskaffing van mediese sorg aan hoësorg-trumapasiënte. Basiese chirurgiese vaardighede, ultraklankkursus, PALS, BLS en ACLS. Toepaslike en voldoende kliniese ervaring sedert die verwerwing van die MBChB-graad en na voltooiing van interne rotasies. Voltooiing van Gemeenskapsdiens en voorafgaande trauma-ervaring.
af.duties: Leierskap. Onderrig. Innovasie en Navorsing. Kliniese Bestuur. Kliniese Diens: Pasientsorg en bystand in die teater.

zu.title: Ihlangwezi Wezokwelapha Elinga 1 kuya ku-3 (Isikhungo se-TRAUMA)
zu.summary: Bafunwa abahlangwezi bezokwelapha abalinga 1 kuya ku-3 bedlule esikhungweni se-Trauma esibhedlela i-Groote Schuur, kufuneka kube khona ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomenziwezokwelapha.
zu.requirements: Ithuba lemfundo elinganiselwe: Isibonakaliso esifanele esivumela ukubhalisa ku-High Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomenziwezokwelapha. Ukubhalisa kumkhandlu wemisebenzi yamakhono: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomenziwezokwelapha. Isipiliyoni: Ilinga 1: Akukho okudingekile emva kokuqinisekiswa njengomenziwezokwelapha kwi-HPCSA mayelana nabasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe eNingizimu Afrika. Isipiliyoni esifanele seminyaka engu-1 emva kokuqinisekiswa njengomenziwezokwelapha kumkhandlu wamakhono wezempilo ovunyiwe wamazwe ngaphandle mayelana nabasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe kwezwe ngaphandle, okungalindelekile ukuthi benze inkonzo yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Ilinga 2: Isipiliyoni esifanele okuncane isikhathi esingeminyaka engu-5 njengomenziwezokwelapha emva kokuqinisekiswa kwi-HPCSA njengomenziwezokwelapha mayelana nabasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe eNingizimu Afrika. Isipiliyoni esifanele okuncane isikhathi esingeminyaka engu-6 emva kokuqinisekiswa njengomenziwezokwelapha kumkhandlu wamakhono wezempilo ovunyiwe wamazwe ngaphandle mayelana nabasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe kwezwe ngaphandle, okungalindelekile ukuthi benze inkonzo yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Ilinga 3: Isipiliyoni esifanele okuncane isikhathi esingeminyaka engu-10 njengomenziwezokwelapha emva kokuqinisekiswa kwi-HPCSA njengomenziwezokwelapha mayelana nabasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe eNingizimu Afrika. Isipiliyoni esifanele okuncane isikhathi esingeminyaka engu-11 emva kokuqinisekiswa njengomenziwezokwelapha kumkhandlu wamakhono wezempilo ovunyiwe wamazwe ngaphandle mayelana nabasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe kwezwe ngaphandle, okungalindelekile ukuthi benze inkonzo yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Izidingo ezibangelwe umsebenzi: Ukugqamisa nokuqinisekiswa kwe-Advanced Trauma Life support (ATLS). Ukusebenza ngemahora okwedlule okuyisibopho. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yokubiza ngemva nemahora. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Amakhono ekuphefumula kanye nokuhlakanipha ekuphiliseni isiguli esilimele kakhulu. Ikhono lokwenza ucwaningo. Ikhono lokusebenza njengengxenye yeqembu le-trauma. Ulwazi, amakhono nesipiliyoni mayelana nokunikezwa kwezokwelapha kumagulane we-trauma abasengozini enkulu. Amakhono wobugqilikazi abasisiseko, ikhosi le-ultrasound, PALS,BLS kanye ne-ACLS. Isipiliyoni sezokwelapha esifanele nesanele kusukela ekutholeni idigri ye-MBChB nangemva kokuqedwa kokujikelela ngaphakathi. Ukuqedwa kwenkonzo yomphakathi nesipiliyoni sangaphambili se-trauma.
zu.duties: Ukukhokhela. Ukufundisa. Ukuba yinto entsha nokucwaninga. ukuqondiswa kwezokwelapha. Inkonzo yezokwelapha: Ukunakekelwa kwegulane kanye noku_siza esidlaveleni.

xh.title: Isigqirha esiNqanaba 1 ukuya kwi-3 (IZiko le-TRAUMA)
xh.summary: Kufunwa abagqirha abangezinga 1 kuye kwa-3 ukuya kwiziko le-Trauma kwisibhedlele iGroote Schuur Hospital, kufuneka ubhalise kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha wezonyango.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sefundelo esingaphantsi: Isifikelelo esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Health Professions Council (HPCSA) njengogqirha wezonyango. Ukubhalisa kwikhowuncelo yomsebenzi: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha wezonyango. Isipilo sabo: Inqanaba 1: Akukho nanye emva kokubhalisa njengogqirha wezonyango kwi-HPCSA mayela namaphethuwo aqeqeshiweyo e-South Africa sebenzayo. Unyaka wam-1 wamava ahambelana nokuqeqesha emva kokubhalisa njengogqirha wezonyango kukhowuncelo yamanye amazwe ezezonyango ekuqatshelwa kuyo, kwabaphethuwo bangaphandle, abangadingi ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufuneka e-South Africa. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinci beminyaka elingu-5 yamava afanelekileyo njengogqirha wezonyango emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha wezonyango, ukuya kubaphethuwo base-South Africa sebenzayo. Ubuncinci beminyaka elingu-6 yamava ahambelana nokubhalisa njengogqirha wezonyango kwikhowuncelo yamanye amazwe ezezonyango ekuqatshelwa kuyo, kwabaphethuwo bangaphandle, abangadingi ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufuneka e-South Africa. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinci beminyaka elingu-10 yamava afanelekileyo njengogqirha wezonyango emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha wezonyango, kwabaphethuwo base-South Africa sebenzayo. Ubuncinci beminyaka elingu-11 yamava ahambelana nokubhalisa njengogqirha wezonyango kwikhowuncelo yamanye amazwe ezezonyango ekuqatshelwa kuyo, kwabaphethuwo bangaphandle, abangadingi ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufuneka e-South Africa. zu.title: Umlobi wezokwelapha (MEDICAL) (DERMATOLOGY)
zu.summary: Umlobi wezokwelapha osekhundeni le-dermatology esibhedlela i-Tygerberg ethola ukunakekelwa okuphephaliswe ngumqeqeshi obhalene, okuhlanganisa ukunakekelwa kwabagula bengaphandle nangaphakathi, okudinga ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA namalayisense wokushayela osebenzayo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zemfundo ezingezansi okudingekayo: Iziqu ezifanele ezivumela ukubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomqeqeshi wezokwelapha. Ukubhalisa ebhodini lemphumelelo: Ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomqeqeshi wezokwelapha (kwesipesheli ezimele). Isidingo esingokoqobo somsebenzi: Ilayisense wokushayela we-Code B/EB osebenzayo. Ukusebenza ihora elongeziwe kunesinye kanye nokumbovwa kanye nokusinda emahoreni adlule njengoba kuqunyiwe futhi kuqokwe uhlelo lomsebenzi lomnyango. Ukubamba iqhaza kuleminyuzi yokunakekelwa kwabagula bengaphange kwesikhungo se-dermatology, esebenza nsuku zihlanu ngeviki, igumbi elihloliwe le-dermatology kanye nesinxaxheko sabagula bengaphakathi esibhedlela i-Tygerberg. Ukuzithoba ukuhamba kuzikhungo zokufinyelela kanye nokusebenza kuyo yonke indawo eqeqeshiwe eqokiwe lapho kudingeka. Ikhono (ulwazi/izikhono): Ulwazi lokuhlolwa kwezempilo olufanele, isahlulelo kanye nokuhlolwa okulandela i-MBChB; ukuthumela imiyalezo ngempumelelo kanye nezikhono zokuxhumana nabantu; ikhono lokusebenza eqenjini elihlangene emikhakheni ehlukene, lokuphatha isikhathi kanye nokusebenza engxushunxushini; ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha; nokuzinikela ekunakekelweni okuziobizayo, okugxile egulini kanye neqeqesho lesipesheli. Okuhlolwa kwezokwelapha kwe-dermatology okuhlobene, iziqu noma idiploma eyiziqu ezedlule exhutshwe ku-Dermatology kanye nakho okushicilelwe noma okuhlolwa kolwazi.
zu.duties: (izindawo eziphumelelisayo/okukhiqizwayo): Kunikeza ukunakekelwa okuphephile kwe-dermatology ngaphansi kolawulo lwesipesheli emakiliniki zansuku zonke eziyisikhombisa, egumbini le-dermatology elihloliwe kanye nesinxaxheko sabagula bengaphakathi kweminye imisebenzi yesibhedlela. Wenza izinkinga ze-dermatology ezifanele ngenani leqeqesho futhi ugcwalise ihora elongeziwe kunesinye kanye nemisebenzi yamahoreni adlule njengoba kuqunyiwe. Ugcina irekhodi yokuhlolwa kwezempilo eliqiniso, ukuthumela kanye namadokhumenti okukhishwa, futhi uqedele imisebenzi yolawulo yesibhedlela kanye neyunivesi ethunyiwe. Uthattha inxaxheba ekufundiseni abafundi abangaphansi kanye nabo baphothule iziqu futhi ulawule abasebenzi abasha kanye nabafundi njengoba kufanele. Uhlaya uhlelo lokufunda nemithelelo, ugcine iphothifoliyo kanye nelogbukhi edingekayo, futhi uqedele izidingo zeqeqesho lesipesheli eziqunyiwe. Uthattha inxaxheba kulwazi lokuphenya i-dermatology kanye nokuhlolwa kwezokwelapha futhi uqedele ingxenye yolwazi lokuphenya i-MMed eyiqunyiwe.

xh.title: Umcebisi wezamazulu wezempilo (I-DERMATOLOGY)
xh.summary: Umcebisi wezamazulu wezempilo kwi-Dermatology esibhedlele i-Tygerberg onikezela ngonakekelo lwabaguli abangehlanga nabalaliswayo ngaphantsi kolawulo lwabachandisi, efuna ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA nelayisensi evakalileyo yokushayela.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingunaphakade: Isigaba esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomcela-mzimba. Ukubhaliswa kwikomkhulu labo bachofi: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengomcela-mzimba (i-Independent Practice). Isifundo esibalulekileyo somsebenzi: Ilayisensi evakalileyo ye-Code B/EB yokushayela. Iyure ezize ezibekelwe umsebenzi wongaphandle kwamayehe nolonakekelo lwangemva kwamayehe njengoko kumisiwe kwaye kwabelwe ngumgaqo wemisebenzi wesebe. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwinkonzo yabaguli abangehlanga kwi-Dermatology, ebasebenza iintsuku zihlanu ngeveki, ewardi ecacileyo ye-Dermatology nakwindibano yabalaliswayo esibhedlele i-Tygerberg Hospital. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba kwiindawo zolonakekelo olusasazekileyo nokuwusebenza ngaphezu kwendawo yokuqeqeshwa egunyazisiwe xa kufuneka. Amandla (ulwazi/amehlo): Ulwazi, isigqibo namava ematshini olulingana ngokulandelwa kwe-MBChB; isakhono sokunxibelelana nokwazi ukusebenzela nabantu; isakhono sokusebenza kwinqanaba elinamagcisa ahlukeneyo, ulawulo lwexesha nokusebenza ngqondo phantsi koxinzelelo; ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha; nokuqinisekisa ukuziphatha ngokwezimiso, ukunakekelo olubhekisa kumguli nokuqeqeshwa njengochwepheshe. Ulwazi lokunakekelwa kwe-Dermatology, idiploma okanye isidanga se-postgraduate equkiweyo kwi-Dermatology nolwazi loluntu lwezibhalo zovavayo.
xh.duties: (iindawo eziphelayo/iziphumo): Nikezela ngonakekelo olukhuselekileyo lwe-Dermatology ngaphantsi kolawulo lwabachandisi kumagumbi abaguli abangehlanga ngemihla yeyiveki, ewardi ecacileyo ye-Dermatology nakwindibano yabalaliswayo kwezinye iinkonzo zesibhedlele. Yenza iinkqubo ezifanelekileko ze-Dermatology ngokwesisiseko sokuqeqeshwa kwaye ugcwalise iiyure ezize kwaye nemisebenzi yemiyalelo yemihla yamayehe nangemva kwamayehe. Hlala ukugcina iirekhodi ezichanekileyo zempi ngezempilo, imibhalo yokudluliselwa nokuphuma kwabaguli, nokuqeda imisebenzi yolawulo kwisibhedlele nakwiziko lezazivo. Thatha inxaxheba kokuqeqeshwa kwabafundi abangangeniswanga nabo bongeziwe kwaye ulawule abasebenzi abancinane nafundi njengoko kufanelekile. Khubeka kwindlela yorhwebo nemilinganiselo, zigcine zifana isiqendu esifunekayo ne-logbook, uze uqede iimfuno ezibekiweyo zokuqeqeshwa njengochwepheshe. Thatha inxaxheba kuphando lwe-Dermatology nokuqinisekiswa kwenkonzo yokunakekelwa kwaye uqede icandelo lovavayo lwe-MMed elibekiweyo.

jobs.title: Registrar (EMERGENCY Medicine)
jobs.salary_text: R1 041 402 per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs)
jobs.summary: Registrar in Emergency Medicine required to provide emergency patient care, clinical governance and supervision of junior colleagues within Western Cape Emergency Medical Services.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Practitioner. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner (Independent Practice). Inherent requirement of the job: Valid driver’s licence. Completion of FCEM [SA] part 1. Willingness to travel. Willingness to work commuted overtime. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Appropriate clinical Knowledge in Emergency Medicine after registration as a medical practitioner. Clinical Emergency Care knowledge and skills appropriate to a competent independent emergency doctor in South African practice. Academic development of self and others. Administrative and medicolegal knowledge and skills related to South African Emergency Care practice. Professional conduct with all stakeholders. Evidence of administrative and medicolegal functions. A minimum of 24 months of work experience in an Emergency Centre under supervision of an Emergency Medicine Specialist, preferably within the past three years. Demonstratable experience in research and Level 1 ultrasound accreditation.
jobs.duties: Effective and efficient care of emergency care of emergency patients. To provide emergency related services to patients in designated service areas. Clinical and corporate governance duties as pertain to services provided at placement. To provide supervision and in-service training to junior colleagues and other staff. Contribute to the teaching and training of Health Science students.
jobs.enquiries: Ms Kim Fullard Tel No: (021) 815-8821 or email: Kim.Fullard@westerncape.gov.za
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). Consideration will be given to existing employees who are already on higher salary packages to retain their existing salary position, as personal. As such they are entitled to receive pay progression. -Appointment as Registrar will be for a maximum contract period of 4 years. Employees in service who opt to continue with their pension benefits as Registrar, will be required to resign after completion of their registrarship should they not be successful for advertised Specialist positions. Applicants must indicate whether they have bursary obligations. The Department of Health is guided by principles of Employment Equity. Candidates with disability are encouraged to apply and an indication in this regard will be appreciated, Specific registrar posts within the Department will be identified as part of the Affirmative Action programme to create representative Specialist cadre in line with applicable procedures. -Preference will be given to SA citizens/permanent residents with a valid identity document. Registrars will be required to register as post graduate students with University of Cape Town according to the yearbook guidelines and fulfil academic teaching, training and research activities. Although posts are held at the institutions stated above, registrars will be expected to rotate through various institutions in the Groote Schuur and Tygerberg training complexes. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the advert for the POST 37/287: Deputy Director: Manager Hospital Development (5/8th Post) Directorate: Facilities and Infrastructure Management, Centre: Tygerberg Hospital, Redevelopment Office, Salary R582 684 (5/8th) per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual’s personal needs) advertised in the Public Service Vacancy 37 dated 16 October 2026, has been amended as follows: Deputy Director: Manager Hospital Development (5/8th Post) (3 Year-Contract) OTHER POSTS

af.title: Registrateur (EMERGENCY Medicine)
af.summary: Registrateur in Emergency Medicine word benodig om noodpasiëntesorg, kliniese bestuur en toesig oor junior kollegas binne Western Cape Emergency Medical Services te verskaf.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n mediese praktisyn toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n mediese praktisyn (Independent Practice). Inherente vereiste van die pos: Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Voltooiing van FCEM [SA] deel 1. Bereidwilligheid om te reis. Bereidwilligheid om te werk oorbetaalde ure. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Toepaslike kliniese kennis in Emergency Medicine na registrasie as 'n mediese praktisyn. Kliniese nood sorgkennis en vaardighede toepaslik by 'n bekwame onafhanklike nooddokter in Suid-Afrikaanse praktyk. Akademiese ontwikkeling van self en ander. Administratiewe en mediesregtelike kennis en vaardighede verwant aan Suid-Afrikaanse Emergency Care-praktyk. Professionele gedrag teenoor alle belanghebbendes. Bewys van administratiewe en mediesregtelike funksies. 'n Minimum van 24 maande werkervaring in 'n Emergency Centre onder toesig van 'n Emergency Medicine Specialist, by voorkeur binne die afgelope drie jaar. Aantoonbare ervaring in navorsing en Level 1 ultraklankakkreditasie.
af.duties: Doeltreffende en doeltreffiende versorging van noodversorging van noodpasiënte. Om noodverwante dienste aan pasiënte in aangewese diensareas te verskaf. Kliniese en korporatiewe bestuurspligte soos dit betrekking het op dienste by plasings. Om toesig en in-diensopleiding aan junior kollegas en ander personeel te verskaf. Bydrae tot die onderrig en opleiding van Health Science-studente.

zu.title: Isikhundla sikaRejistra (EMERGENCY Medicine)
zu.summary: Kudingeka isikhundla sikaRejistra ezinsizeni zezempilo eziphuthumayo ukwenzela ukunakekela iziguli eziphuthumayo, ukulawula izinsiza zezempilo nokuphatha oboke bakhulu ngenhla ngaphakathi kweWestern Cape Emergency Medical Services.
zu.requirements: Imininingwane yemfundo esebenzayo: Ithuba elimelayo lokwemukelwa okuvumela ukubhaliswa kuHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomdayisi Wezokwelapha. Ukubhaliswa kolungu olungamandla: Ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengesiheleli Sosobuchwepheshe (HPCSA) njengesiheleli Sokwelapha (Okuzimele). Isidingo sasemsebenzini: Ilayisense yokushayela okusebenzayo. Ukuphumelela iFCEM [SA] inqamu 1. Ukuthanda ukuhamba. Ukuthanda ukusebenza amahora angaphezulu kwemisebenzi eqashiwe. Amakhono (ulwazi/iziqu): Ulwazi lokwelapha olufanele ngemila ezinsizeni zezempilo ngemva kokubhaliswa njengomuntu oyisosi.
zu.duties: Ukunakekelwa okusebenzayo nokuqhuthekwa kweziguli eziphuthumayo. Ukunikeza izinsiza eziphathelene nezimo eziphuthumayo kubantu bakhona ezindaweni ezimiwe zokusebenza. Imisebenzi yokubusa ngemigomo yezokwelapha nokuphathwa kwenhlangano ngokuthintana nemisebenzi etholakala lapho kubekwe khona. Ukunikeza ukulawula nokwegcisha abasebenzi ngesikhathi sokusebenza kubalingiswa abancane kanye nabanye abasebenzi. Ukufaka isandla ekufundiseni nokuqeqesheni abafundi bezSayensi Yezempilo.

xh.title: Umgbali wezifundo (iNKCUMBO YokuGula okungalindanga)
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe mugbali wezifundo kwizifundo zokugula okungalindanga ukunika amaxhosa okugula okungalindanga, ulawulo lweklinikhi nokulawula abasebenzi abancinci kwiinkonzo zeMedical zeZenxweme eWestern Cape.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezingowona ezingakanani: Isifundo esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalisa kwiHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomnyezi wezempilo. Ukubhalisa kwikhande lobugcisa: Ukubhalisa kwiHPCSA njengomnyezi wezempilo (Ukwenzela ngokuzimela). Imfuno ebeliler ngaphakathi kwalo msebenzi: Ilayiseni yokushayela ngokusemthethweni. Ukuqwalaselwa kweFCEM [SA] icandelo 1. Ukulungele ukuhamba. Ukulungele ukusebenza amawaka angaphezu kwesithuba sexesha. Ikhono (ulwazi/izakhono): Ulwazi olufanelekileyo lweklinikhi kwezifundo zokugula okungalindanga emva kokubhalisa njengomnyezi wezempilo. Ulwazi nezakhono zokunyanga okungalindanga olufanelekile kunyazi wezokugula okungalindanga ozenelayo eMzantsi Afrika. Uphuhliso lwemfundo lwakho nabalanye. Ulwazi nezakhono zolawulo nezomthetho ezibutelwe kwiinkonzo zokunyanga okungalindanga eMzantsi Afrika. Ukuziphatha ngobugcisa kunye nabo bonke abathintelwe kakhulu. Iziphumo zolawulo nezomthetho. Iqela leenyanga ezingama-24 zomsebenzi kwiSentsha yokugula okungalindanga ngaphantsi kolawulo lomganga wezifundo zokugula okungalindanga, ngokukhethwayo kwiminyaka edlulileyo ithathu. Ulwazi lokuqinisekiswa lokuphonononga nokuqinisekiswa kolwazi lokuphonononga ngomnxeba oqhuba izandi ezingaphezulu kwindidi 1.
xh.duties: Ukuhoyisa nokusebenza ngokusebenzela okusemthethweni ukunyanga okungalindanga abagulayo. Ukunika iinkonzo ezinxulumene nokugula okungalindanga abagulayo kwimimandla ebalulekileyo yesebe. Imisebenzi yeklinikhi nolawulo lwentsebenzo njengoko ijongene nesebe elinikiweyo. Ukunika ulawulo nemfundo kubasebenzi abancinci nabanye. Ukugalela ekufundiseni nakuqeqesheni abafundi baseZenzululwazi zeZempilo.

jobs.title: Registrar (MEDICAL) (GENERAL Surgery)
jobs.salary_text: R1 041 402 per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.)
jobs.summary: Registrar in General Surgery at Tygerberg Hospital, providing surgical care and training under HPCSA registration with a valid driver's licence.

Commuted overtime is compulsory. Emergency and after hour call cover. Each Registrar will be appointed in a specific training complex but could be required to work across the platform on request. On- site after-hours duties relating to care of newly arriving acute patients as well as inpatients. Involvement in research/audits relating to surgery, trauma, and burn care.
jobs.enquiries: Ms M Brand, e-mail: mbran@sun.ac.za

af.title: Registrateur (MEDIES) (ALGEMENE Chirurgie)
af.summary: Registrateur in Algemene Chirurgie by Tygerberg Hospital, wat chirurgiese sorg en opleiding verskaf onder HPCSA-registrasie met 'n geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council (HPCSA) as Mediese Praktisyn moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn (Independent Practice). Inherent requirement of the job: A valid (code B/EB) driver's licence. Commuted overtime is compulsory. Emergency and after hour call cover. Each Registrar will be appointed in a specific training complex but could be required to work across the platform on request. Kompetensies (kennis/vaardighede): FCS part 1 as well clinical experience in Surgery and/or Trauma. A current certificate of ATLS and Basic Surgical Skills course completed. FCS part 2 and experience in research/publications. Evidence of effective leadership and interpersonal skills are essential.
af.duties: Verskaffing van veilige chirurgiese sorg aan pasiënte. Peri-operatiewe sorg van chirurgiese pasiënte. Deelname aan intensiewesorgbestuur. Leer die kuns en wetenskap van algemene chirurgie, trauma- en brandwondsorg. Bywoon van tutoriale en assist met die opleiding van internes, mediese studente, verpleegpersoneel en paramedici. Terreinpligte na buitekanture wat verband hou met die sorg van pas aankomende akute pasiënte sowel as hospitaalpasiënte. Betrokkenheid by navorsing/ouditte met betrekking tot chirurgie, trauma en brandwondsorg.

zu.title: UmBhalisi (WOKWELAPHA) (I-GENERAL Surgery)
zu.summary: Isikhundla somBhalisi ku-General Surgery esibhedlela i-Tygerberg Hospital, ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kokwelapha ngokuhlinza nokugcinwa kokufundela ngokushaywa kwegama ku-HPCSA nelayisensi evumelekileyo yokushayela.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezingezansi: Izifundo ezifanelekileyo ezivumela ukushaywa kwegama kwi-Health Professions Council (HPCSA) njengokudokotela. Ukushaywa kwegama kwikomkhulu lemisebenzi: Ukushaywa kwegama ku-HPCSA njengokudokotela (Independent Practice). Isidingo esangaphakathi somsebenzi: Ilayisensi evumelekileyo (code B/EB) yokushayela. Ukusebenza ngalezo vesha okulinganisiwe kuyinyamezela. Ukumbovula kokusingathiwa kanye nokugquma emva kwamahora. UmBhalisi ngamunye uyonikwa isikhundla kwiziko eligcwele ukufundela kodwa angadingwa ukusebenza kuwo wonke amaphathform ngosicelo. Ikhono (ulwazi/izakhono): I-FCS part 1 kanye namava okusebenza e-Surgery kwayo/cacile i-Trauma. Isatifikathi samanje se-ATLS negatshathi lokugqiba lokulinganiselwa kwamakhono okuhlinza i-Basic Surgical Skills. I-FCS part 2 kanye namava ocwaningweni/okushicilelwayo. IUPUPTHO lokubonisa ukulawula okufanelekileyo nokuqhathanisa nabantu kuyimfuneko ebalulekileyo.
zu.duties: Ukunikezwa kokunakekelwa okukhuselekileyo ngokuhlinza kwabagula. Ukunakekelwa kwabagula abalinyazwe kushukela ekubhoklweni. Ukubamba iqhaza ekulawuleni i-Intensive Care. Ukufunda ubucukubhede nobugcisa be-general surgery, i-trauma, kunye nokunakekelwa okusha nje. Ukuza nazo kumayitha yokufundela kwaye uncede ekugqibeleni nasekufundiseni oongqongqoshe, abafundi bonyaka bokugqiba, izisebenzi zokunakekelwa kanye namaparamediki. Iinkxaso-msebenzi ezikuwo onke amahora asemva kwesikhathi ezikwithuba leziko eziphathelene nokunakekelwa kwabagula abafika kabusha ababhityileyo kwaye noma ababhekwa esibhedlele. Ukuzibandakanya ocwaningeni/okusweni okuphathelene ne-surgery, i-trauma, kunye nokunakekelwa okusha nje.

xh.title: I-Registrar (MEDICAL) (GENERAL Surgery)

xh.requirements: Isifundo esisezantsi sabafundi: Isifundo esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha. Ukubhalisa kwikomishani yamagqirha: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha (Ukuzilolonga ngokuzimeleyo). Isidingo sobuqu sobomi bomsebenzi: Ilayisense yokushayela (ikhowudi B/EB) esebenzayo. Ukusebenza ngemizuzu engaphezu kwesixa esixelelwe kuya kumfuno kwaye kukhoyo. Ukumela i-emergency nokusetyenziswa kweeyure ezingaphezu kwesakhiwo. Umnye Registrar uya kumiselwa kwelixa elithile lemfundo kodwa angafunwa ukusebenza phezu kwendawo ngemfuno. Isazima-nzulu (ulwazi/amakhono): I-FCS inxalenye 1 njengokunye nemfundo ngokuhlinza nakwi-Trauma. Ifunda i-ATLS ngesifundo esikumgangatho ongundoqo se-Surgical Skills esiqediweyo. I-FCS inxalenye 2 nemfundo ngolwazi-phononongo/ukushicilela. Iziphumo zamandla okukhokela ngokusebenzisekayo namakhondo okuhamba nobumthwana zimfuneko.
xh.duties: Ukunikeza inkokhelo yokuhlinza ekhuselekileyo kumaguli. Inkokhelo kwelixa eliqhubekayo lokuhlinza kumaguli. Uthatha inxaxheba ekulawuleni i-Intensive Care. Ukufunda ubugcisa nenzululwazi yokuhlinza ngokubanzi, iintsholongwane, nokunakekela amatshatshazi. Ukuze ubakhobokhe iikhosi ezifundiswayo kwaye uncede nokolula ukufundiswa kobugqirha abangenamsebenzi, abafundi bekudwelwa phantsi, abantu basekhiliniki, nabadluli bemotor vehicle. Imisebenzi yasekhaya ekuhloveni exhubekileyo malunga nenkokhelo kubantu abafika iintlanganiso ezingalindelekanga, nengabahlali evela ezingcaphepheni. Uthatha inxaxheba kophononongo-lwazi/iingxelo zokwahlulela malunga nokuhlinza, iintsholongwane, nokunakekela amatshatshazi.

jobs.summary: Medical Officer Grade 1 to 3 in Surgery and Orthopaedics at Khayelitsha District Hospital, requiring HPCSA registration as a Medical Practitioner.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Practitioner. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Medical Practitioner. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration as a Medical Practitioner with the HPCSA in respect of SA qualified employees. 1-year relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognized foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years’ appropriate experience as a Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 6 years’ relevant experience after registration as a Medical Practitioner with a recognized foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. -Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate experience as a Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 11 years’ relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognized foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s license; willingness and ability to travel. Full commuted overtime (average 16 hours per week) is mandatory for the permanent/fulltime post. Ensure CPD compliance. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Ability to render a high quality general surgical service. Strong ethical principles with leadership, conflict resolution, organisational & counselling skills. Willingness and ability to teach at undergraduate and post graduate level. Digital systems competency. Enrolment to write General Surgery: FCS Part 1.
jobs.duties: Clinical service delivery in general surgery, including management of surgical patients in the emergency center, wards and outpatient department. Pre- operative, intra-operative and post operative care of surgical patients with surgical skills appropriate for the level of experience. Management of inpatient and outpatient referrals as well as after hour management of surgical patients. Clinical governance in the form of resource stewardship, accurate medical record keeping, morbidity & mortality reviews and case audits. Teaching & training activities at undergraduate and postgraduate level with participation in the departmental and hospital academic programs. Actively Involvement in research. Systems input and participation within the Metro East Ecosystem. Contribution to improvement of internal systems within the general surgery service – both within the hospital and the Metro East ecosystem. Participation in the wider functions of the general surgical service within the hospital, both clinical and administrative, where reasonable and feasible.

af.title: Mediese Beampte Graad 1 tot 3 (CHIRURGIE en Ortopedie)
af.summary: Mediese Beampte Graad 1 tot 3 in Chirurgie en Ortopedie by Khayelitsha Distrikshospitaal, wat HPCSA-registrasie as 'n Mediese Praktisyn vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie met die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Registrasie met 'n professionele raad: Registrasie met die Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Mediese Praktisyn. Ervaring: Grade 1: Geen na registrasie as 'n Mediese Praktisyn met die HPCSA ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 1-jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn met 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers, van wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Grade 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie met die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 6 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie as 'n Mediese Praktisyn met 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers, van wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. -Grade 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie met die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 11 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn met 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers, van wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Geldige (Code B/EB) bestuurslisensie; bereidwilligheid en vermoë om te reis. Volle pendeloortyd (gemiddeld 16 uur per week) is verpligtend vir die permanente/voltydse pos. Verseker CPD-nakoming. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om 'n hoë gehalte algemene chirurgiese diens te lewer. Sterk etiese beginsels met leierskap, konflikoplossing, organisatoriese en beradingsvaardighede. Bereidwilligheid en vermoë om op voorgraadse en nagraadse vlak te onderrig. Digitale stelselsbevoegdheid. Inskrywing om General Surgery: FCS Part 1 te skryf.
af.duties: Kliniese dienslewering in algemene chirurgie, insluitend bestuur van chirurgiese pasiënte in die noodsentrum, sale en buitepasiëntafdeling. Pre-operatiewe, intra-operatiewe en post-operatiewe sorg van chirurgiese pasiënte met chirurgiese vaardighede toepaslik vir die vlak van ervaring. Bestuur van in-pasiënt en buitepasiënt-verwysings asook na-uur bestuur van chirurgiese pasiënte. Kliniese bestuur in die vorm van hulpbronbestuur, akkurate mediese rekordhouding, morbiditeits- en mortaliteits hersienings en gevaloudits. Onderrig en opleidingsaktiwiteite op voorgraadse en nagraadse vlak met deelname aan die departementele en hospitaal akademiese programme. Aktiewe betrokkenheid by navorsing. Stelselbydrae en deelname binne die Metro East Ekosisteem. Bydrae tot verbetering van interne stelsels binne die algemene chirurgiese diens – beide binne die hospitaal en die Metro East ekosisteem. Deelname aan die wyer funksies van die algemene chirurgiese diens binne die hospitaal, beide klinies en administratief, waar redelik en haalbaar.

zu.title: Izinga 1 kuye ku-3 leDokotela eZochoshayo (Ukuchoshwa nokwelashwa amathambo)
zu.summary: Izinga 1 kuye ku-3 leDokotela eZochoshayo kwiKhayelitsha District Hospital, kudingwa ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengodokotela owayolayo.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo evunyiweyo: Izigaba ezifanele ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengodokotela owayolayo. Ukubhalisa kubungazwe bemikhakha yemisebenzi: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengodokotela owayolayo. Ukuhlola: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekayo emva kokuqokwa njengodokotela owayolayo kwi-HPCSA mayelana nemisebenzi yabantu abathuthukiswe eNingizimu Afrika. Unyaka oyedwa wemfundiso efanayo emva kokuqokwa njengodokotela owayolayo kubungazwe bemikhakha yangaphandle bemisebenzi yezempilo mayelana nemisebenzi yabantu abathuthukiswe ngaphandle, okungadingeki ukuba benze isisebenzi somphakathi njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 2: Okungenani eminyakeni engu-5 yemfundiso efanayo njengodokotela owayolayo emva kokuqokwa kwi-HPCSA njengodokotela owayolayo mayelana nemisebenzi yabantu abathuthukiswe eNingizimu Afrika. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-6 yemfundiso efanayo emva kokuqokwa njengodokotela owayolayo kubungazwe bemikhakha yangaphandle bemisebenzi yezempilo mayelana nemisebenzi yabantu abathuthukiswe ngaphandle, okungadingeki ukuba benze isisebenzi somphakathi njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. -Izinga 3: Okungenani eminyakeni engu-10 yemfundiso efanayo njengodokotela owayolayo emva kokuqokwa kwi-HPCSA njengodokotela owayolayo mayelana nemisebenzi yabantu abathuthukiswe eNingizimu Afrika. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-11 yemfundiso efanayo emva kokuqokwa njengodokotela owayolayo kubungazwe bemikhakha yangaphandle bemisebenzi yezempilo mayelana nemisebenzi yabantu abathuthukiswe ngaphandle, okungadingeki ukuba benze isisebenzi somphakathi njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Isidingo sasemsebenzini: Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B/EB) esemthethweni; ukuzithoba nokukwazi ukuhamba. I-overtime ephelele (okungenani amahora angu-16 ngesonto) iyadingeka kwisevisi yonke yesikhundla esigcinwayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi uzikholezile ngemithetho ye-CPD. Izakhono: Ukukwazi ukunikeza isevisi yochoshayo ezingeni eliphezulu. Izinkambiso zokuziphatha ezinamandla nezinkambiso zokuqamba izinkinga, ezinhle zokuphathwa nokuhlakanipha nokweluleka. Ukuzithoba nokukwazi ukufundisa izinga elingaphansi kwelomthwesizwe nelingaphezulu kwalo. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zekhompyutha. Ukubhalisa ukuze kubhale i-General Surgery: FCS Part 1.
zu.duties: Ukunikeza isevisi yezokwelapha kochoshayo, okuhlanganisa nokuphathwa kweziguli zochoshayo esikhungweni sezimo eziphuthumayo, emagumbini nasenkembeni leziguli ezingahlali esibhedlela. Ukunakekelwa kweziguli zochoshayo ngaphambi kokusebenza, ngesikhathi kokusebenza nangemva kokusebenza ngezakhono zochoshayo ezifanele izinga lomlando wemisebenzi. Ukuphathwa kweziguli ezinikelwe esibhedlela nangezingezi ezingangena ngaphandle kanye nokuphathwa kweziguli zochoshayo emahoreni angavamile. Ukuqondiswa kwezobuchwepheshe ngendlela yokuqasha amatholimba, ukugcinwa okunembile kumarekhodi ezokwelapha, ukuhlola ukukhubazeka nokufa kanye nokuhlola icala. Imisebenzi yokufundisa nokuqeqesha izinga elingaphansi kwelomthwesizwe nelingaphezulu kwalo ngokubamba iqhaza ohlelweni lokufunda lobuchwepheshe nolwesibhedlela. Ukubamba iqhaza ngokuzitshalisela ocwaningweni. Okokufaka izindlele zohlelo nokubamba iqhaza ngaphakathi kwemvelo ye-Metro East. Ukufaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni izindlele zangaphakathi zohlelo ngaphakathi kwisevisi yochoshayo – kokubili ngaphakathi kwesibhedlela nangemvelweni ye-Metro East. Ukubamba iqhaza emisebenzini engaphezu kokuqondile yesevisi yochoshayo ngaphakathi kwesibhedlela, kokubili yezokwelapha nangomlondolo, lapho kunesidingo futhi kungenzekwa.

Ukubhaliswa koluntu lwabangcali: Ukubhaliswa kwi-Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengogqirha wezokwelapha. Unyaka we-1 wamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhaliswa njengogqirha wezokwelapha kwi-foreign Health Professional Council ekuqatywa kuyo malunga nabasebenzi abagqithiswe kwamanye amazwe, abangafuneki ukuze benze iNkonzo yokuQonda njengoko kufunwa kwi-South Africa. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-5 yamava afanelekileyo njengogqirha wezokwelapha emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha wezokwelapha malunga nabasebenzi abagqithiswe kwi-SA. Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-6 yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhaliswa njengogqirha wezokwelapha kwi-foreign Health Professional Council ekuqatywa kuyo malunga nabasebenzi abagqithiswe kwamanye amazwe, abangafuneki ukuze benze iNkonzo yokuQonda njengoko kufunwa kwi-South Africa. -Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-10 yamava afanelekileyo njengogqirha wezokwelapha emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha wezokwelapha malunga nabasebenzi abagqithiswe kwi-SA. Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-11 yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhaliswa njengogqirha wezokwelapha kwi-foreign Health Professional Council ekuqatywa kuyo malunga nabasebenzi abagqithiswe kwamanye amazwe, abangafuneki ukuze benze iNkonzo yokuQonda njengoko kufunwa kwi-South Africa. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ilayiseni (Code B/EB) esebenzayo; ukulungelelana nokuqonda ukuhamba. I-overtime ebanzi ngokupheleleyo (okulinganelayo iiyure ezingama-16 ngeveki) iyafuneka kwisithuba esisisigxina/esipheleleyo. Qinisekisa ukuzithobela i-CPD. Amandla (ulwimilo/izakhono): Amandla okunika inkonzo ekumgangatho ophezulu we-surgery jikelele. Iimvisiswano ezomeleleyo zokuziphatha ezinengqondo yokulawula, ukusombulula iingxabano, ukulungelelanisa & izakhono zokuqondisa. Ukulungelelana nokuqonda ukufundisa kwinqanaba lokufunda ngaphantsi nangaphezulu kweyaze. Amandla ekusebenziseni iinkqubo zamakhompyutha. Ukubhaliswa ukubhala i-General Surgery: FCS Part 1.
xh.duties: Ukunikezwa kwenkonzo yezonyango kwi-surgery jikelele, kuquka nokulawula abaguli be-surgery kwindawo yezithuba ze-emergency, amawadi nesebe labaguli ababuyayo. Ukukhathalela abaguli be-surgery phambi kwenkonzo, ngexesha lenkonzo nangemva kwenkonzo ngezakhono ze-surgery ezifanelekileyo kwinqanaba lamava. Ukulawula abaguli abanjelwe ngaphakathi nababuyayo, kunye nokulawula abaguli be-surgery emva kweyure ezisebenzayo. Ulawulo lwezonyango ngendlela yolawulo kwamathuba, ukugcina iirekhodi zonyango ezichanekileyo, ukuhlola ukungalungi nokufa nokuhlolwa kweedatha. Iindwendwe zokufundisa & ukulungiselela kwinqanaba lokufunda ngaphantsi nangaphezulu ngokuthatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yonyando lasebe le-nesibhedlele. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ngokuzimisela kuphando. Ingeniso yeenkqubo kunye nokuthatha inxaxheba ngaphakathi kwinkqubo yase-Metro East Ecosystem. Inxaxheba ekuphuculweni kweenkqubo zangaphakathi ngaphakathi kwenkonzo ye-surgery jikelele – kokubhe ukuba ngaphakathi kwesibhedlele nase-Metro East ecosystem. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kumasebe amaninzi enkonzo ye-surgery jikelele ngaphakathi kwesibhedlele, kokubhe ezonyango nengowolawulo, apho kuyaneliseka kwaye kuyenziwe.

zu.title: Operational Manager Nursing (SPECIALTY: Psychiatry) (NEW
zu.summary: Isikhundla sika-Operational Manager Nursing ebuchosheni e-Stikland Hospital, Western Cape, sifuna ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC nesidanga sokuhamba phambili kwezokwelapha ngengqondo, sinikeza iholo le-R720819 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Isidanga esincane semfundo: Isidanga se-Basic R425 (okt. idiploma/idegrei yokunyolovela) noma isidanga esilinganayo (R683 plus R880) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengo-Professional Nurse. Isidanga sokunyolovela esingenasiqalo esinofundo ongakhathwayo ongaphansi kwawo unyaka o-1 oqinisekisiwe yi-SANC ebuchosheni obuhamba phambili (Advanced Psychiatric Nursing Science) (R212). Noma I-Degrei yeminyaka eyi-4 yokunyolovela (R174) noma isidanga esilinganayo (R171 plus R1497) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengo-Professional Nurse. Idiploma eyisiqu ekuphelelwe isikhathi (R635) eqinisekisiwe yi-SANC kwezokwelapha ngengqondo ezempilo. Ukubhaliswa kolwazi olungcwathisayo: Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengo-Professional Nurse. Okuhlangenwe nakho: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-9 yokuhlangenwe nakho okuhambisana/okwaziwayo kokunyolovela ngemva kokubhaliswa njengo-Professional Nurse kwi-SANC ekunyoloveni jikelele. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-5 yexesha elishiwo ngenhla kufanele kube yiloluhlobo/olwaziwayo lokuhlangenwe nakho ngqo ebunyakeni obudaliwe (Psychiatry) ngemva kokuqeda isidanga sokunyolovela esingasiqalo soyaka o-1 noma idiploma eyisiqu ebunyakeni obudaliwe. Isidingo esingaphakathi somsebenzi: Ukuzithoba ukusebenza izinguqulo, ngemva kwamasikhathi, ngezikhathi zeholide zomphakathi, emini noma ebusuku, kanye nemisebenzi yokulalela. Ilayisensi yokushayela. Amakhono (ulwazi/iziqu): Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Ms Word, Excel kanye ne-Power Point).
zu.duties: Nikeza ukulawula, ukubuka, ukucubungula, ukweqisa kanye nokulawula ukunikeza inakekelo elithuthukiswe eliholwa ngoguli egumbini labaguli bengqondo. Misa uhlelo lokwenza izinto ngcono ngokusebenza kahle nangempumelelo. Misa uhlelo lokulawula izibonelelo (abantu, inqobo yempilo yezobuchwepheshe, izimali ngenxa nezikhungo) ngokusebenza kahle nangempumelelo. Ukulawula ngokupheleleyo ingxenye yabanyoloveli okuhlanganisa abafundi, umclerki wegumbi labaguli, kanye nokwesekwa ekhaya. Misa amasu obuchwepheshe obusebenza kahle nangempumelelo egumbini labaguli bengqondo abakhulu. Lawula ukulawula isifo sokutheleleka, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa nokuqeqesha abanyoloveli kanye nabahlobene nabo. Nikeza inkxaso kwindlu ka-Deputy Manager Nursing.

xh.title: Umphathi Wemisebenzi WoKunyanga (ISIKOLO: IPsychiatry) (ENTSHA
xh.summary: Isithuba somPhathi Wemisebenzi WoKunyanga kwipsikhiyatri eStikland Hospital, Western Cape, esifuna ukubhalisa kwiSANC nengena ngesidanga sokunyanga esiphezulu kwipsikhiyatri, sikhawuleza ngeR720819 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esincinane semfundo: Isidanga esisisiseko seR425 (okt idiploma/idigri ekuNyangenyo) okt isidanga esilinganayo (R683 kwaneR880) esivumela ukubhalisa kuSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengesiGqibo soKunyanga. Isidanga sokunyanga ngemva kwesidanga esisisiseko esithatha ixesha elinganayo nonyaka unyaka oyi-1 esamkelwe yiSANC kwiAdvanced Psychiatric Nursing Science (R212). OKT Idigri eYiBhola kwiNursing eminyaka engama-4 (R174) okt isidanga esilinganayo (R171 kwaneR1497) esivumela ukubhalisa kuSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengesiGqibo soKunyanga. Idiploma yesidanga ngemva kwe-degree (R635) esamkelwe yiSANC kwiMental Health Nursing. Ukubhalisa koluntu olungoyilo: Ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengesiGqibo soKunyanga. Uqeqesho: Iminyaka engama-9 ubuncinane yamava afanelekileyo/awaziwayo ekuNyangenyo emva kokubhalisa njengesiGqibo soKunyanga kwiSANC kwiGeneral Nursing. Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-5 kulowo maxesha ochaziweyo ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo/awaziwayo kwelona candelo lithile (iPsychiatry) emva kokufumana isidanga esisesidanga ngemva kwesisisiseko esithatha unyaka oyi-1 okt idiploma yesidanga ngemva kwe-degree kwelona candelo lithunyelwe kulo. Isidingo sangaphakathi somsebenzi: Ukuzimisela ukusebenza ngokutshintsha ishithi, emva kweyure zomsebenzi, ngeentsuku zihlala zikholiswe, emini okt ebusuku nakuwo omawumba wokulindela. Ilayisensi yokushayela. Ikhono (ulwazi/amashebe): Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (iMs Word, iExcel nePower Point).
xh.duties: Nikezela ngokuba ngumntu okhokelayo, okuhlomlayo, ocwangcisa, ohola alo ndlela ulawulo lokunikezela ngokukhululeka ukunyanga iNgumntu ogulisayo ogxile kwindawo yokunyanga abagulelo kumsonto wepsikhiyatri. Sebenzisa inkqubo eyongezelelweyo nokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo yokuphucula izinga. Sebenzisa iNkqubo elawula ngokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo izixhobo eziyimfuneko (abantu, iiteknoloji ezempilo, ezoqobo zimali nezakhiwo) ezilungelelanisiweyo. ULawulo jikelele lolwahlulo lokunyanga, kuquka oobo bafundi, oobo basemagumbini abayi-clerk nabahlinzeki bokubuyisela endaweni. Sebenzisa ulwazi lokusebenza ngokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo kwigumbi lokunyanga elikhethwe ngokukhethekileyo kwipsikhiyatri. Lawula ulawulo lokuthintela iinfeksiyo, iinkqubo zophuhliso nokuqeqesha kubasebenzi bokuNyanga nabanxulumene nabo. Nikezela ngenkxaso kwi-ofisi yoMphathankulu woKunyanga.

Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis van Maternal-Child-Women's Health, HIV/AIDS/STI/TB, Chroniese Siekte. Kennis van bestuur en Community Orientated Primary Care (COPC). Vermoë om onafhanklik en in 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk. Rekenaarvaardig in MS Office (Excel, Word en Power point) en MS Outlook.
af.duties: Koördinering en implementering van die Lewensloop-benadering in die substreek, m.b.t. HAST/FBS en Gemeenskapsgebaseerde Dienste en die daarstelling van dienskoppelinge en diensintegrasie. Verskaf toezig en ondersteuning aan gesondheidsfasiliteite i.s.m. die implementering van programspesifieke gehalteversekeringsbeleid, 95/95/95-protokolle, norme en standaarde. Betrokkenheid by vaardigheidsontwikkeling en opleiding om geïntegreerde gesondheidsdienste te ondersteun, bv. NIMART. Versterk en koördineer interne en eksterne skakelbestuur met belanghebbendes, insl. NPO's, eksterne vennote, ens. om implementering van die COPC-beginsels te verbeter. Monitering en evaluering van diensdoelwitte en teikens, insluitend die versameling, validering en interpretasie van statistiese data. Effektiewe implementering van toepaslike projekte om die geïntegreerde primêre gesondheidsorgdiens in die substreek te verbeter.

zu.title: Isikhundla sokuHlanganisa imiNqungqulu yezempilo (COMPREHENSIVE Health)
zu.summary: Isidingo se-Clinical Programme Coordinator esikhundleni se-Northern/Tygerberg Sub-Structure Office, ukuba ahlele imisebenzi ye-HAST kanye nemisebenzi yempilo ekekelwe emphakathini, kanti kudingeka ukuba nomfundaze we-Clinical kanye nokubhalisa e-Council.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esingaphansi semfundo: Isidinqa se-R425 esisisekelo (okungukuthi idhigloma/idigri ekufundeni) noma isidinqa esilinganayo (i-R683 kanye ne-R254) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-North/North African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoguliwe. Noma idigri yokufunda kweminyaka emi-4 ekufundeni (i-R174) noma isidinqa esilinganayo (i-R683 kanye ne-R1497) noma i-R171 kanye ne-R1497) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoguliwe. (Le minqubo isebenza kuphela kumakhulu abakhulu, okuyimfuneko yalabo, ukuba sihlale sigodola kwi-Council).
zu.duties: Ukuhlanganiswa nokuphatha indlela yesikhathi sempilo esikhumulweni, ngokubaluleka kumisebenzi ye-HAST/FBS nemisebenzi ekekelwe emphakathini kanye nokumisa izixhumanisi zemisebenzi nokuhlanganisa imisebenzi. Ukunikeza ulawulo nokwesekela izindawo zempilo ngokwaleyo kokuphatha imithethonqondo yomkhwa omuhle eqondiswe ohlelweni, 95/95/95 imitheshonqondo, izindinganiso, nemigomo. Ukuhlanganyela ekuthuthukiseni amakhono nasekufundeni ukusekela ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi yempilo ehleliwe, njengokuthi NIMART. Ukugqugquzela futhi ukuhlanganisa ukuphathwa kwezinhlebo zangaphakathi nangaphandle nabahlanganyeli, kuquula ama-NPO, abalinganeyo bangaphandle njll., ukuze kuphuculwe ukuphatha imigomo ye-COPC. Ukuqapha nokuhlaziya izinhloso nemigomo yomsebenzi okuhlanganisa ukuyiqoqa, ukuqinisekisa, nokutolula idatha ezibalweni. Ukuphatha ngempumelelo imigidingo ethize ukuphucula umsebenzi wempilo oyinhloko ohleliwe esikhumulweni.

xh.title: UmLungelelanisi weNkqubo yokuQwalasela iMiba yoGqitho lweMiba yoNyango (iNkqubo yeMiba yoNyango yeNyango luNyango lwaMaternal/Child Health)
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umLungelelanisi wenkqubo yezempilo kwiNdiro yeNorthern/Tygerberg Substructure ukuze alungelelanise iHAST neenkonzo ezisekelwa kumaphandle, kwaye kufuneka ane kwalifayeshini yokongkolwa abhaliswe kwiSANC.

Okt idigri yeminyaka emi-4 kukongkolwa (iR174) okt ikwalifayeshini elingana nayo (iR683+ iR1497) okt iR171+ iR1497) evumela ukubhaliswa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogqithintsha. (Le nkqubo isebenza kuphela kwiisithuba zabalulekileyo zabalulekileyo kwindawo apho kukhona isiphithiphithi sabo bonke abantu abafuna ukubhaliswa kwiSANC). Ukubhaliswa kwiBhunga lamagqabi: Ukubhaliswa kwiSANC njengogqithintsha. IExperience: Iminyaka engu-7 exeperiensini efanelekileyo/eqwalaselwayo kukongkolwa emva kokubhaliswa njengogqithintsha kwiSANC kukongkolwa jikelele. Iimfuno zangaphakathi zobasebenzi: Ilayiseni yomqhubi (ikhowudi B/EB). Kufuneka uhamba ukuze unike inkxaso ngaphakathi kwendawo yelizwei yeChief Directorate: Metro Health Services. Iimpawu (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi ngezempilo zabezala, abasetyhini, nabantwana, iHIV/AIDS/STI/TB, ulwazi ngeziyobolwa ezihlalisayo, ulwazi lolawulo, neCommunity Orientated Primary Care (COPC). Ukuba nakho ukusebenza eyedwa nakwinqanaba leqela leentsapho ezahlukeneyo. Ukuba nolwazi lokusebenza ngeminye leems MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, neMS Outlook.
xh.duties: Ukulungelelanisa nokuphumeza indlela yokuphila ngamabakhusela (Life course approach) kwingingqi, ngesiseko seHAST/FBS neNkonzo eZenzelelayo kwindawo yokuhlala kunye nokumisa iziphatho zoluntu phakathi kweenkonzo nokudityaniswa kweenkonzo. Ukunika ikhobondo lenkxaso kwiifasilithi ezinkqonkqo zempilo ngokuphumeza iinkqubo ezithile zemigaqo yokuqinisekisa umgangatho, i95/95/95, iinkqubo, namazinga afunekayo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kuphuhliso lwamakhono nokuqeqesha ukuxhasa ukubonelelwa kweenkonzo ezidityanisiweyo zempilo, umzekelo, iNIMART. Ukuzisa amandla nokulungelelanisa ukulawulwa koluntu olungaphakathi nangaphandle nabaphathwa njengabantu abalulekileyo, kuquka iNPOs, ababambisana nabo bangaphandle, njl. ukuphucula ukuphumeza amagama oMbasebenzi beCOPC. Ukugcina iliso nokuqwalasela iinjongo namaphuzu eenkonzo kuquka ukuthatha, ukuqinisekisa, nokutolika idatha yezibalo. Ukuphumeza ngempumelelo iiprojekthi ezifanelekileyo ukuphucula inkonzo yempilo ekuqaleni edityanisiweyo kwingingqi.

jobs.title: Clinical Programme Co-ordinator: Grade 1 (NURSING
jobs.summary: Clinical programme co-ordinator needed at Mowbray Maternity Hospital to oversee nurse education, training and clinical teaching, requiring a nursing diploma or degree with SANC registration.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R254) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. OR A 4-year bachelor’s degree in nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. (This dispensation is only applicable for posts of Clinical Programme Coordinator where it is an inherent requirement of the post, incumbent to maintain registration with the SANC). Registration with a professional council: Current registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse. Experience: A minimum of 7 years’ appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in general nursing. Inherent requirements of the job: Willingness to assist accredited Higher Education Institutions with external practical examination of students as required. Willingness to work overtime and provide hospital relief when required. Valid (Code B/EB) drivers’ licence. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Experience in Nursing Education and Training in a Perinatal clinical setting with specialised perinatal health care knowledge. Effective leadership, supervisory, planning, coordination, organising, facilitation, mentoring, problem solving, decision- making, as well as conflict resolution skills. Ability to interact, network and liaise with diverse stakeholders and health care users and providers. Extensive knowledge of nursing care practice and procedures, nursing statutes and ethical standards, and other relevant legal frameworks such as: Nursing Act, SANC Education and Training Regulations and Qualifications Framework, Skills Development Act, Department of Health Training and Development Policies and Procedures, All Health-Related and Public Services Regulations and Guidelines, Labour Relations Act, Disciplinary Code and Procedure, Grievance Procedure.
jobs.duties: Responsible for the overall coordination of clinical teaching and learning, the facilitation and oversight in the development of operational plans to give strategic direction to nurse education and training in the hospital and provide support to hospital management. Provide professional and technical support for the provision of quality patient care through proper management of formal and informal training interventions. Participate in the maintenance of norms and standards of nursing practice to promote the health status of health care users by establishing, maintaining inter-professional and multi-disciplinary teamwork that promotes effective and efficient health care. Participate in the development and implementation of the hospital quality assurance programmes, guidelines, protocols, norms and standards in line with the QA requirements. Utilize information technology (IT) and other management information systems to manage information for the enhancement of training and development. Effective management and utilization of resources (human, financial and physical) in accordance with relevant directives and legislation.
jobs.enquiries: Ms M Holland Tel No: (021) 659-5550
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates could be subjected to practical test. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process.
