af.title: Kliniese Programkoördineerder: Graad 1 (VERPLEEGKUNDE)
af.summary: 'n Kliniese programkoördineerder word by Mowbray Maternity Hospital benodig om toesig te hou oor verpleegonderrig, -opleiding en kliniese onderrig, waarvoor 'n verpleegdiploma of -graad met SANC-registrasie vereis word.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R254) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. OF 'n 4-jarige baccalaureusgraad in verpleegkunde (R174) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R1497 of R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. (Hierdie dispensasie is slegs van toepassing op poste van Kliniese Programkoördineerder waar dit 'n inherente vereiste van die pos is dat die ampsdraer registrasie by die SANC moet handhaaf.) Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Huidige registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 7 jaar se gepaste/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in algemene verpleging. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Bereidwilligheid om geakkrediteerde hoër onderwysinstellings met eksterne praktiese eksaminering van studente by te staan soos vereis. Bereidwilligheid om oortyd te werk en hospitaalverligting te bied wanneer vereis. Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Ervaring in Verpleegonderrig en -opleiding in 'n perinatale kliniese omgewing met gespesialiseerde perinatale gesondheidsorgkennis. Effektiewe leierskap-, toesighoudende-, beplannings-, koördinerings-, organisasie-, fasiliterings-, mentorings-, probleemoplossings- en besluitnemingsvaardighede, asook konflikoplossingsvaardighede. Vermoë om met diverse belanghebbendes en gesondheidsorgebruikers en -verskaffers te skakel, te netwerk en te liaise. Uitgebreide kennis van verpleegsorgpraktyk en prosedures, verpleegstatutes en etiese standaarde, en ander tersaaklike regsraamwerke soos: Nursing Act, SANC Education and Training Regulations and Qualifications Framework, Skills Development Act, Department of Health Training and Development Policies and Procedures, All Health-Related and Public Services Regulations and Guidelines, Labour Relations Act, Disiplinêre Kode en Prosedure, Grievance Procedure.
af.duties: Verantwoordelik vir die algehele koördinering van kliniese onderrig en leer, en die fasilitering en toesig oor die ontwikkeling van operationele planne om strategiese rigting te gee aan verpleegonderrig en -opleiding in die hospitaal en om ondersteuning aan hospitaalbestuur te bied. Bied professionele en tegniese ondersteuning vir die voorsiening van gehalte pasiëntsorg deur behoorlike bestuur van formele en informele opleidingsintervensies. Neem deel aan die instandhouding van norme en standaarde van verpleegsorgpraktyk om die gesondheidsstatus van gesondheidsorggebruikers te bevorder deur die vestiging en instandhouding van interprofessionele en multidissiplinêre spanwerk wat doeltreffende en effektiewe gesondheidsorg bevorder. Neem deel aan die ontwikkeling en implementering van die hospitaal se gehalteversekeringsprogramme, riglyne, protokolle, norme en standaarde in ooreenstemming met die QA-vereistes. Gebruik inligtingstegnologie (IT) en ander bestuursinligtingstelsels om inligting te bestuur vir die verbetering van opleiding en ontwikkeling. Effektiewe bestuur en benutting van hulpbronne (menslike, finansiële en fisiese) in ooreenstemming met tersaaklike riglyne en wetgewing.

zu.title: Umphathi weNkqubo yokuHlinza: Isidanga 1 (NURSING
zu.summary: Kufunekwa umphathi weHlelo lokusebenza olusesikweni kumanyuzi we-Pangwe ukuba aqaphele imfundo yokuhlinza, ukuqeqesha nokufundisa okusemtholampilo, kwaye kufuneka ane-diploma okanye idigri yokuhlinza ekubhalise kwi-SANC.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi: Isidanga sokugqiba ukuqeqeshwa okuyisisekelo (R425) (okungukuthi idiploma/idigri ebunjiniyela) noma esinye isidanga esilinganayo (R683 kahle R254) esikuvumela ukuba ubhalise kuSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoguliwe ohlinzayo. Noma idigri yeminyaka emine (R174) noma isidanga esilinganayo (R683 ngaphezulu kwe-R1497 noma i-R171 ngaphezulu kwe-R1497) esikuvumela ukuba ubhalise kuSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoguliwe ohlinzayo. (Lokhu kusebenza kuphela kumasevisi oHlelo lokuhlela okusemtholampilo lapho kuyisidingo esiyisisekelo sikaMnyango, ukuba aguze ngokubhaliswa kwi-SANC). Ukubhaliswa kubulungu bemanyuzi we-HPCSA: Ukubhaliswa kwangoku njengoguliwe ohlinzayo. Ukuze uhlole: Iminyaka eyi-7 ngokugqamile kokuhlinza emva kokubhaliswa kwakho njengoguliwe ohlinzayo. Izidingo eziyisisekelo somsebenzi: Ukuthanda ukusebenza phantsi nokuze usinke ixesha elide, nokwenza imisebenzi engaphezu kwesikhathi esiqunyiwe naxa kufuneka. Ilungelo elisezantsi (i-Code B/EB). Ulwazi lokusebenza: Ulwazi lokuhamba ngokugqibeleleyo, ukulawula, ukuzinza, ukuhlela, ukuqonda, ukwenza izigqibo, ukulawula abasebenzi, nokuqonda ukwenza iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo.
zu.duties: Uxhume kokuqondisa ngokuphelele ukufundisa nokufunda okusemtholampilo, ukwesekwa kanye nokuqapha ekuthuthukisweni kohlelo lokusebenza ukuze kunikezwe isiqondiso esinguqo ezindaweni zokuqonda zokuhlinzeka ngemfundo kanye nokuqeqesha kwabahlinzoki esibhedlela kanye nokusekelwa kubaholi bethu. Ukunika inkxaso ngobuchwepheshe kanye nokusebenza okunzulu ukuze kutholakale ukunakekelwa okuhle kwagula ngokuphatha kahle izikhathi zokuqeqesha ezisemthethweni noma ezingowolwazi. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekugcineni nasezingen eliphakeme kwezinsiza eziphuma kumthetho wesizwe ukuze kuthuthuke izimo eziphilayo nabasebenzisi bezempilo ngokusungula kanye nokuqhuba ngomsebenzi wabantu abanobuchule bezinkalo eziningi okukhuthaza ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okusebenza kahle kakhulu. Ukungenelela ekuthuthukisweni nasenkqubo yezivumelwano zekhwalithi zesibhedlela kanye nemigomo yalo kanye namagunya ezinkalo ezahlukene ngokuhambisana nalenkelo yezidingo ze-HR kanye nomthetho wezindlu kanye nemithetho ekhona. Ukusebenzisa imishini yethuluzi lokwaziswa kwemibhalo okusebenza ngokuba nokwaziswa okuzenzakalelayo (IS) ukuze kutholakale ulwazi ngesikhathi esifanelekileyo ngokuhambisana nemithetho yesiNdhlu.

xh.title: Umlawuli wenkqubo wezongamzo: Inqanaba 1 (NURSING
xh.summary: Kufuneka kubekho umlawuli wenkqubo wezongamzo kwiMowbray Maternity Hospital ukulawula imfundo, ukuqeqeshwa nokufundisa kwabongikazi ngokusesigangathe, ifuna idiploma okt idigri kubongikazi enesatifikethi se-SANC.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezingowona: Isigaba seBasic R425 (okt. idiploma/idigri yokuqeqesha) okt isifanekelo esimandla (R683 ngaphezulu kwe-R254) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogqirha wezongamzo. OKT Idigri yeminyaka emi-4 yokongamzo (R174) okt isifanekelo esimandla (R683 ngaphezulu kwe-R1497 okt R171 ngaphezulu kwe-R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogqirha wezongamzo. (Le nkqubo iyasebenza kuphela kuzithuba zeClinical Programme Coordinator apho kuvela ukuba kuyimfuno ngokwemvelo yesithuba, ukuba lowo uthatha isithuba agcine ukubhaliswa kwiSANC). Ukubhaliswa kolawulo ngamabala: Ukubhaliswa okwangoku kwiSANC njengogqirha wezongamzo. Isiphaluka: Iminyaka elungileyo engu-7 nengaziwayo ekongamzeni emva kokubhaliswa njengogqirha wezongamzo kwiSANC kwizongamzo ezingalinye. Iimfuno ezingokwemvelo womsebenzi: Ukuzithanda ukunikela inkxaso kumaziko emfundo ephakamileyo akhankanyiweyo kunye nokuvavanya okusesiveni abafundi njengoko kufuneka. Ukuzithanda ukusebenza ixesha elingaphezu kwesiqhelo nokuthatha isikhundla kubaluleke kakhulu. Ilayisenisi ekhethwa ngokomthetho (Code B/EB). Amakhono (ulwazi/izakhono): Isiphaluka ekufundiseni nokuqeqesha kubongikazi kwimeko yokuqondisa nokuqeqesha ngokwemvelo kwindalo yokuqondisa. Amaphuphu okukhokela abasebenzi, okuqonda, ukuqwalasela amaplan osebenzo, ukulawula, ukuqhelanisa, ukubakela ngamandla, ukufundisa, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukwenza isigqibo, nokusingatha iingxaki. Ukuzincedisa kwakhona, ukubakela kwaye unxibelelane nobahlali bezinto ezahlukeneyo. Ulwazi olubanzi ngamagama amaninzi okubala imisebenzi yokongamzo nemimiselo, kwakunye nemigaqo yamagunya.
xh.duties: Uxanduva lokulawula ngokubhekisele kokuqondisa nokuqeqesha ngokwesigangathe, nokuqhuba nokuqonda kumaplan osebenzo ukunika isalathiso ngakwesicwangciso kwimfundo nokuqeqeswa kwabongikazi esibhedlele nokunikela inkxaso kulawulo lesibhedlele. Nikela inkxaso yobuchwepheshe nengamandla ekunikeleni ngamabalu alungileyo omthwalo wengqsiza ngokulawula ngokuchanekileyo iindlela zokuqeqesha ezizezinhlobo nangaloo nqanaba. Thatha inxaxheba ekugadeni iimigaqo namazinga okwenza umsebenzi wokongeza ukuze konyuswe imeko yempilo yabasebenzisi besebe lendalo ngokuseka, kugcinwe ukusebenza ngokubambisana nabochwephesha abangenamtshato nakwindalo yokwenza umsebenzo eqhuba unyango lwezempilo olusebenzayo noluchanekileyo. Thatha inxaxheba ekwakhiweni nokuqwalaselwa kweenkqubo ziqinisekisa umgangatho kwisibhedlele, iindlela zokuqonda, iimigaqo, iimigaqo namazinga ngokwamfuno weQA. Sebenzisa iinkqubo zolwazi lwesixhobo (IT) nolunye ulwazi lolawulo lweenkqubo ukulawula ulwazi ukuphucula ukuqeqeshwa nokuqaliswa kwamakhono. Ulawulo olusebenzayo nokusebenzisa izibonelelo (abantu, ezo matyala nemizimba) ngokwemigaqo nokuqatshulwa okuhambelanayo.

af.title: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleging Graad 1 (ALGEMEEN: Kinders
af.summary: Operasionele bestuurder-verpleegpos by Vredenburg Hospitaal wat 'n basiese verpleegkwalifikasie en SANC-registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/grade in verpleging) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R254) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. OF 'n 4-jarige Bachelorgaad in Verpleging (R174) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R1497 of R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 7 jaar toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring in Verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Inherente vereistes van die werk: 'n Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Vermoë om te reis om byeenkomste, uitreik- of operasionele aktiwiteite by te woon. Bereidwilligheid om oortyd te werk, buite-ure en naweek wagdienspligte te doen wat dagdiens, nagdiens en openbare vakansiedae kan insluit. Bereidwilligheid om die Assistent Bestuurder Verpleging en Operasionele Bestuurder te ontlast wanneer nodig. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om onafhanklik en as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span te funksioneer/besluite te neem. Goeie kommunikasie, interpersoonlike verhoudinge, uitsonderlike leierskap- en konflikoplossingsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook en Internet). Kennis en begrip van die Distrik Gesondheidsisteem/en die implementering daarvan asook ervaring in kantooradministrasie, menslike hulpbronbestuur, finansiële bestuur, toevoerketting en prosessering van verkrygingsprosesse op Operasionele vlak.
af.duties: Verskaffing van Leierskap en Bestuur deur toesig, koördinering en afbakening om gehalte-sorg te verskaf deur professionele en etiese standaarde en wetgewing in die aangewese eenheid toe te pas. Kliniese bestuur van die aangewese eenheid. Verskaffing van doeltreffende ondersteuning aan verpleegdienste. Doeltreffende bestuur van die benutting en toesig oor hulpbronne, mensebestuur, werknemerverhoudinge en monitering en evaluering van gehalte. Toereikende finansiële beplanning en ondersteuning, begroting en beheer van die eenheid. Professionele en etiese gedrag. Toesig oor navorsing, opleiding en opvoeding in die eenheid.

zu.title: Umphathi Wemisebenzi Yokuhlengwa Ukhulu 1 (JIKELELE: Abezingane)
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi wemisebenzi yokuhlengwa esibhedlela i-Vredenburg esidinga izifundo ezenza isisekelo sokuhlengwa nokubhaliswa kwa-SANC njengogongqosi.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezingaphansi kancane: Isifundo se-Basic R425 (okt. idiploma/ijazi kuhlengwa) noma isifundo esilingana (R683 plus R254) esivumela ukubhaliswa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogongqosi. NOMA Ijazi le-Bachelor Degree lemihla yeminyaka eyi-4 ekuhlengweni (R174) noma isifundo esilingana (R683 plus R1497 noma R171 plus R1497) esivumela ukubhaliswa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengugongqosi. Ukubhaliswa kubungebengi: Ukubhaliswa kwa-SANC njengogongqosi. Isipiliyoni: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-7 yohlelo oluhambisana noma olusobala ekuhlengweni ngemuva kokubhaliswa njengugongqosi kwa-SANC ekuhlengweni okujwayelekile. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ilayisense elivumelekile (Code B/EB) lokushayela. Ukukwazi ukuhamba ukuze ubambe iqhaza emihlanganweni, ekwenzeni imisebenzi kuyabakhona, noma emisebenzini yansuku zonke. Ukuzithoba ekubeni usebenze ngaphezu kwamahora okujwayelekile, ukuqashelwa ngemva kwamahora nangamaphelamvila okuhlanganisa usuku, ubusuku nangamaholide aphathe kakhulu. Ukuzithoba ukumela omphathi osekelayo wezokuhlengwa nomphathi wemisebenzi noma kudingeka. Izindoni (ulwazi/izikhali): Ukukwazi ukusebenza/ukuthatha izinqumo ngayodwa futhi njengengxenye yeqembu elinabongqondo abahlukene. Ukuhlanzeka kahle ukuxhumana, ubudlelwano nabantu, ubuholi oluhlukile namakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook ne-Internet). Ulwazi nokuqonda i-District Health System/nomthelela wayo empilweni kanye nesipiliyoni ekuphathweni kohlelo lwabasebenzi, ekuphathweni kwemali, ekuthengisweni nasekuqasheleni nasezinhlelweni zokuthenga ezingeni lokusebenza.
zu.duties: Nikela ngobuholi nangokuphatha ngokuqondisa, ukuhlanganisa nokwabelana imisebenzi ukuze kuphathwe kahle ngokusebenzisa izindingo zobungqosi nemithetho kwelungelo elabelwe. Ukuphathwa kwezokuhlengwa kwelungelo elabelwe. Nikela ngokusekelana okusebenzayo ezinkonzweni zokuhlengwa. Phatha ngokusebenzayo ukusetshenziswa nokuqondisa okwemali, ukuphathwa kwabantu, ubudlelwano nabasebenzi nokuqashelwa nokuhlola izinga. Ukuphathwa kwemali ngokulungiselela nokusekela, ukubhaletha nokuqinisekiswa kwelungelo. Ukuziphatha ngobungqosi nangokuzithoba. Ukuphathwa kokwelolwazi, ukuqashelwa kokuqondisa kanye nefundo kwelungelo.

xh.title: Umphathi weMisebenzi yokhathalelo lwamagula ongango 1 (JIKELIYO: Abantwana)
xh.summary: Isithuba somphathi wokhathalelo lwamagula eVredenburg Hospital esifuna izifundo ezingowamabasisi kwaye kubekho ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengoguli nesiGuli soPhulo.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esiphakamileyo esingowasembanjini: Isifundo esiyisisiseko i-R425 (oko kukuthi idiploma/idigri yokhathalelo lwamagula) okanye isifundo esilinganayo (i-R683 kwaye kune-R254) esivumela ukubhalisa kuBunge lwaseMzantsi Afrika lwokuKhathalela iNtanga yeMagula (i-SANC) njengesiGuli soPhulo. OKANYE Idigri yeBachelors yeminyaka e-4 eKhathalelweni lweMagula (i-R174) okanye isifundo esilinganayo (i-R683 kwaye kune-R1497 okanye i-R171 kwaye kune-R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa kuBunge lwaseMzantsi Afrika lwokuKhathalela iNtanga yeMagula (i-SANC) njengesiGuli soPhulo. Ukubhalisa kubunge lobuphofu: Ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengesiGuli soPhulo. Uphando: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-7 yamava afanelekileyo / awazwayo eKhathalelweni lweMagula emva kokubhalisa njengesiGuli soPhulo kwi-SANC ekuKhathaleleni iNtanga eJikelwise. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ilayisenisi ethi (iKhowudi B/EB) yokushayela. Amandla okuhamba ukuze kuwoonlwambo, iinkonzo ezikumaphandle, okanye imisebenzi yokuqhutywa. Ulungelelwaniso lokusebenza ngaphezu kwexesha, nasekuqwalaselweni kwamagumbi nakumasebe phakathi kwamanyathelo okuhlala kude njengemini ecutshwana ebusuku, kwiiholide zikawonke-wonke. Ulungelelwaniso lokunceda oMncedi oNgowamabasisi noMphathi weMisebenzi xa kudingeka. Iimfuneko (ulwazi/amakhono): Amandla okusebenza/nokwenza izigqibo kodwa nengamandla ukwakha iqela labantu abavela kumacandelo amaninana. Ukwaziswa komlomo okuhle, ukubambisana kwabantu, ukukhokela okumangalisayo nokuYeza ngamandla eembambano. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngokuQamba (i-MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook neQonga lemithi yolwazi). Ulwazi nokuqonda leeNkqubo zeZempilo zoMmandla/kwaye nokuzisebenzisa kwempilo, nakulwazi lokulawula ofisi, ukulawula abantu, ukulawula imali, nokwenziwa kwezinto nokuThenga kweenkonzo ngenqanaba loMsebenzi.
xh.duties: Inikezelo loKukhokela nokuLawula ngokuqwalasela, ulawulo lokubumba, ulawulo lokwabelwa abanye ukunikeza ukhathalelo olulungileyo ngokusebenzisa izigqibo zobugcisa nezomagunyaziso nakumthetho kwicandelo elahluliweyo. Ulawulo lolungelelwaniso ngamagumbi kwicandelo elahluliweyo. Ukunikwa kolawulo ngesakhono kumasebe okhathalelo. UkuLawula kakuhle ukusetyenziswa nokuqwalasela kweempahlo, ulawulo lwabantu, iziganeko zabasebenzi nokulinganisa nokuqwalasela kolungelo. Uhlengahlengiso olulungele ulawulo lwemali, ulungiselelo lwesithuba, nokuLawulwa kwecandelo. Ukuziphatha ngokobugcisa nangokomagunyaziso. Ukuqwalasela uphando, ukuqeqesha nokuFunda kwicandelo.

jobs.title: Chief Artisan Grade a
jobs.summary: Chief Artisan needed at George Regional Hospital to oversee maintenance programmes, repairs and risk mitigation for buildings, plant and equipment.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate recognised Trade Test Certificate / trade qualification in Electrical or Mechanical Artisanship. Experience: Ten (10) years’ appropriate post-qualification experience as an Artisan/Artisan Foreman. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s licence and willingness to travel when required. Willingness to perform authorised overtime, standby duties, unplanned call-outs and emergency maintenance to maintain critical hospital services. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Appropriate supervisory/managerial experience in a multidisciplinary workshop (Electrical, HVAC and Mechanical), including experience in procurement of goods and services and contracted maintenance. Proven technical and supervisory ability in electrical, mechanical and general building maintenance, including hospital engineering systems. Knowledge of the Occupational Health and Safety Act, machinery regulations, statutory compliance and safe maintenance practices. Ability to plan preventive maintenance, prioritise breakdowns, assess infrastructure risks and maintain continuity of critical services. Knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act, applicable Treasury and supply chain management prescripts, procurement and delegated authority. Ability to prepare technical specifications, evaluate work completed, manage workshop stock and safeguard state assets. Financial management, budgeting, expenditure monitoring and basic cost-analysis skills. Strong leadership, staff supervision, planning, decision-making and change-management skills. Effective communication, customer service, stakeholder engagement and teamwork. Good technical report-writing, record-keeping and problem-solving skills. Computer literacy in MS Word, Excel, Outlook and relevant electronic maintenance/work-order systems.
jobs.duties: Develop and implement annual preventive maintenance programmes, prioritised work plans and maintenance risk mitigation measures for hospital buildings, plant and equipment. Coordinate preventive, reactive and emergency repairs to electrical, mechanical and building services; safeguard continuity of clinical-critical systems. Allocate, supervise and quality-assure workshop work orders, contractor maintenance, statutory inspections and completion records. Manage maintenance budgets, commitments, procurement specifications, contractor performance, workshop stock, tools and asset controls in accordance with prescripts. -Supervise and develop workshop staff; manage work allocation, performance, attendance, leave, training, standby arrangements and authorised overtime. Implement occupational health and safety requirements; identify, document and escalate infrastructure, fire protection and technical compliance risks. Maintain accurate service and inspection records and submit reports on maintenance performance, expenditure, unresolved faults and corrective actions. -Sound project management, technical analysis, troubleshooting, contractor management and quality-assurance skills.
jobs.enquiries: Mr R Cajada Tel No: (044) 802-4358 or e-mail: Ricardo.Cajada@westerncape.gov.za
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates may be subjected to a practical and/or competency test. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. af.title: Hoofvakman Graad a
af.summary: Hoofvakman benodig by George Streekshospitaal om toesig te hou oor instandhoudingsprogramme, herstelwerk en risikobeperking vir geboue, aanleg en toerusting.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike erkende vaktoetssertifikaat/vakkwalifikasie in Elektriese of Meganiese Vakmanskap. Ervaring: Tien (10) jaar se toepaslike post-kwalifikasie-ervaring as 'n Vakman/Vakman-opsigter. Ingebedde vereiste van die werk: Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te reis wanneer vereis. Bereidwilligheid om gemagtigde oortyd, wagdienste, onbeplande oproepe en noodinstandhouding uit te voer om kritieke hospitaaldienste te handhaaf. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Toepaslike toesig/ bestuurservaring in 'n multidissiplinêre werkswinkel (Elektries, HVAC en Meganies), insluitend ervaring in verkryging van goedere en dienste en kontraktueel-instandhouding. Bewese tegniese en toesigvermoë in elektriese, meganiese en algemene gebouinstandhouding, insluitend hospitaalingenieurswese stelsels. Kennis van die Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid, masjinerievoorskrifte, statutêre nakoming en veilige instandhoudingspraktyke. Vermoë om voorkomende instandhouding te beplan, afbreek te prioritiseer, infrastruktuurreisiko's te asseser en kontinuïteit van kritieke dienste te handhaaf. Kennis van die Wet op Openbare Finansiële Bestuur, toepaslike Tesourie- en verskaffingskettingbestuur voorskrifte, verkryging en gedelegeerde gesag. Vermoë om tegniese spesifikasies voor te berei, voltooide werk te evalueer, werkswinkelvoorraad te bestuur en staatsbates te beskerm. Finansiële bestuur, begroting, uitgawemonitering en basiese koste-anise-vaardighede. Sterk leierskap, personeeltosig, beplanning, besluitneming en veranderingbestuur-vaardighede. Effektiewe kommunikasie, kliëntediens, belanghebbendes-betrokking en spanwerk. Goeie tegniese verslagdoening, rekordhouding en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid in MS Word, Excel, Outlook en toepaslike elektroniese instandhoudings-/werkordesistelsels.
af.duties: Ontwikkel en implementeer jaarlikse voorkomende instandhoudingsprogramme, geprioriteerde werkplanne en instandhoudingsrisiko-beperkingsmaatreëls vir hospitaalgeboue, aanleg en toerusting. Koördineer voorkomende, reaktiewe en noodherstelwerk aan elektriese, meganiese en geboudienste; verseker die kontinuïteit van klinies-kritieke stelsels. Ken werkswinkel-werkordes, kontrakteur-instandhouding, statutère inspeksies en voltooiingsrekords toe, hou toezig daarop en verseker die kwaliteit daarvan. Bestuur instandhoudingsbegrotings, verbintenis, verkrygingspesifikasies, kontrakteurprestasie, werkswinkelvoorraad, gereedskap en bateskontroles ooreenkomstig voorskrifte. -Hou toezig oor en ontwikkel werkswinkelpersoneel; bestuur werktoewysing, prestasie, bywoning, verlof, opleiding, wagdienste en gemagtigde oortyd. Implementeer beroepsgesondheids- en veiligheidsvereistes; identifiseer, dokumenteer en escaleer infrastruktuur-, brandbeskermings- en tegniese nakomingsrisiko's. Onderhou akkurate diens- en inspeksierekords en dien verslae in oor instandhoudingsprestasie, uitgawes, onopgeloste foute en korrigerende maatreëls. -Klankprojekbestuur, tegniese analise, probleemoplossing, kontrakteurbestuur en gehalteversekeringsvaardighede.

zu.title: Onenhloko Wezisebenzi Ngesandla Izinga A
zu.summary: Kudingeka Onenhloko Wezisebenzi Ngesandla esibhedlela i-George Regional Hospital ukuze aphele izinhlela zokugcina izinto zisezweni, izilungiso kanye nokunciphisa ingozi kwezakhiwo, izinto kanye nemicimbi.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo eliphansi kakhulu: Isitifiketi sezisebenzi ngesandla esivunyiwe / isiqu sezisebenzi ngesandla ku-Electrical noma i-Mechanical Artisanship. Isiphephelo: Iminyaka yishumi (10) yesisephephelo esifanele emva kokuthola isiqu njengesisebenzi ngesandla / Nkululekeli wezisebenzi ngesandla. Isidingo esifuyekile somsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B/EB) esikhongoze kanye nesifiso sokuhamba ngesikhathi esidingekayo. Isifiso sokwenza amahora amaningi avunyelwe, imisebenzi yokuqaphela, amacala akhwehlelekile kanye nezilungiso ezingajwayelekile ukuze kugcinwe imisebenzi ebalulekile yesibhedlela. Izakhiwo (ulwazi/amasu): Isiphephelo esifanele sobuNhlobo/baphathi kumsebenzi wabantu abahlukene (Electrical, i-HVAC kanye ne-Mechanical), okuhlanganisa isiphephelo ekuthengeni izimpahla kanye nezinsiza kanye nokugcinwa kwento ngokwesivumelwano. Ikhono obubonakalayo lobuchwepheshe kanye nobuNhlobo ekugcineni kwezinto zobugesi, zezinsiza kanye nazo zonke izakhiwo, okuhlanganisa izinhlela zobuchwepheshe zesibhedlela. Ulwazi mayelana noMthetho wezempilo kanye nokuphepha komsebenzi, imithetho yamashishino, ukuziphendulela ngokomthetho kanye nezindlela eziphephile zokugcina izinto zisezweni. Ikhono lokuhlela ukugcinwa okuvimbela ingozi, ukuqamba izinto ephukile, ukuhlola ingozi yezakhiwo kanye nokugcina ukuqhubeka kwemisebenzi ebalulekile. Ulwazi mayelana noMthetho weMali Kahulumeni, imiyalo ye-Treasury kanye nokuphathwa kwesonto sezempahla, ukuthenga kanye negunya elinikiwe. Ikhono lokulungisa izinkomba zobuchwepheshe, ukuhlola umsebenzi ongiwe, ukuphatha izinto zokugcina emsebenzini kanye nokuvikela izimpahla zombuso. Ukuphathwa kwemali, ukweluleka ibhajidi, ukuqaphela okuchithwayo kanye namasu abalayo. Amasu abalulekile obuholi, ukuqaphela abasebenzi, ukuhlela, ukwenza izinqumo kanye nokushintsha ukuphathwa. Ukuxhumana okusebenzayo, isevisi yabathengi, ukuhlangana nabahlanganyeli kanye nokusebenza ndawonye. Amasu abalulekile okubhala imibhalo yobuchwepheshe, ukugcina izinkomba kanye nokuxazula izinkinga. Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha ku-MS Word, i-Excel, i-Outlook kanye namasistimu abalulekile ezenza ngqo okugcina/ukulungisa izinto.
zu.duties: Hlula futhi usebenzise izinhlela zonyaka zokugcina okuvimbela ingozi, izinhlela zomsebenzi ezihlelwe kanye nezinyathela zokunciphisa ingozi yemisebenzi yezakhiwo, izinto kanye nemicimbi yesibhedlela. Hlanganisa ukulungisa okuvimbela ingozi, okuphendula kanye nezokuphuthuma kwamashishino obugesi, zezinsiza kanye nezezakhiwo; gcina ukuqhubeka kwamasistimu abalulekile ezokwelapha. Aba, qaphela futhi qinisekisela isikhathi somsebenzi wezinto zokugcina, ukulungiswa ngokwesivumelwano, ukuhlola ngokomthetho kanye namarekhodi okuphothulwe. Phatha amabhajidi okugcina, izithembu, izinkomba zokuthenga, ukusebenza kwabathengisi, izinto zokugcina emsebenzini, amathuluzi kanye nokulawula izimpahla ngokuhambisana nemiyalo. -Qaphela futhi cula abasebenzi bokuqapha; phatha ukwaba umsebenzi, ukusebenza, ukubakhona, ukukhishiwa, ukuzijwayeza, izinhlela zokuqaphela kanye namahora amaningi avunyelwe. Sebenzisa izidingo zezempilo kanye nokuphepha emsebenzini; qamba, bhala futhi khulisa ingozi yezakhiwo, ukuvikela imililo kanye nokuziphendulela kobuchwepheshe. Gcina amarekhodi okusebenza kanye nokuhlola njalo abalulekile futhi thumela imibhalo ngokusebenza kokugcina, okuchithwayo, iziphakeme ezingaxazululwa kanye nezinyathela zokulungisa. -Amasu abalulekile okuphatha iphrojekthi, ukuhlola ubuchwepheshe, ukuxazula izinkinga, ukuphatha abathengisi kanye nokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi.

xh.title: ISikhulu seNzima lesiNqanaba a
xh.summary: Kufuneka ISikhulu seNzima eGeorge Regional Hospital ukuba lulawule iinkqubo zolondolozo, izicoliso nokunciphisa ingozi kwezakhiwo, iiplanti nempahla.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingangeniswanga esincinci: Isatifikethi esivunyelweyo esifanelekileyo seTrade Test / isifundo sezandla kwiElectrical okanye iMechanical Artisanship. Isiphalo: Iminyaka elishumi (10) yamava afanelekileyo emva kokuthweswa izidanga njengenziwa/Foreman yenzima. Imfuno engaphakathi kweshishini: Ilayisense yokushayela (Code B/EB) esebenzayo nentando yokuhamba xa kufuneka. Intando yokusebenza isikhathi esongeziweyo esivunyelweyo, imisebenzi yokuqwalasela, iinkqubela ezingahloselwanga nokulungiswa kwesisiningi ngokubakiseleyo ukuze zigcinwe iinkonzo ezibalulekileyo zesibhedlele. Iikhompetensi (ulwazi/amakhono): Isiphalo esifanelekileyo sokulawula/nokuba ngum lawuli kwisixhobo sentsebenzo esinabaphi abayimivo (Electrical, HVAC neMechanical), kuquka namava ekuthengeni iimpahla nenkonzoo nokulondolozwa ngokwemithetho yoxhaso. Ikhono elibonwayo leloncedo nolawulo kwizicoliso ezinhlobo ezahlukeneyo zombane, zezinzwa kakhulu nangokunjalo ezakhiwayo, kubandakanya iinkqubo zokunjiniyela zesibhedlele. Ulwazi ngeOccupational Health and Safety Act, iimigaqo zemishini, ukuzithoba ngokomthetho nendlela ekhuselekileyo yokulondoloza. Ikhono lokucwangcisa ukulondolozwa okuthintelayo, ukuqwalasela izixhongo ezaphukileyo, ukulinganisa iingozi zolwakhiwo nagcino lweenkonzo ezibalulekileyo. Ulwazi ngePublic Finance Management Act, imigaqo yeTreasury nolawulo lwendlela yokuthenga, ukuthenga namagunya anikiweyo. Ikhono lokulungisa iinkcazelo ngokobuchwepheshe, ukulinganisa umsebenzi ogqityiweyo, ukulawula izinto zesixhobo sentsebenzo nokhusela impahla karhulumente. Ikhono lokulawula imali, ukwenza amaxabiso, ukuqwalasela ukuchithwa kwemali nokuhlalutya ixabiso ngokwemigaqo. Amakhono amandla okukhokela, ukulawula abasebenzi, ukucwangcisa, ukuthabatha iigqibo noshintsho-olawulo. Ikhono lokunxibelelana ngokusebenzayo, inkonzo yabathengi, ukuzibandakanya nabanomdla nokusebenza njengesigqithi. Amakhono amabalweyo okubhala iingxelo ngokobuchwepheshe, ukugcina amarekhodi nokusombulula iingxaki. Ukuzoba ngekhompyutha kwiMS Word, Excel, Outlook nakuwo nawaphina naamachubungu awoncedo ngokubhalwe ngesixhobo sokulondolozwa/okulinganisa.
xh.duties: Yakha uze usebenzise iinkqubo zonnyiko zokulondolozwa okuthintelayo, iiplani zomsebenzi oqwalaselweyo nendlela zokunciphisa iingozi kolondolozo kwezakhiwo, iiplanti nempahla zesibhedlele. Lawula izicoliso ngokulondolozwa, ngokuchasana nangokubakiseleyo kumsebenzi wamandla, wezinzwa nakwakhiwo; qinisekisa ukuqhubeka kweeknxubo ezingagcinwa. Abela, lawula ukuqinisekiswa ngomgangatho umsebenzi wesixhobo sentsebenzo, ukulondolozwa ngumthengisi, ukuqwalaselwa ngokomthetho namarekhodi okugqitywa. Lawula amaxabiso, izithembiso, iinkcazelo zokuthenga, isiphelo somsebenzi womthengisi, izinto zesixhobo, izixhobo nolawulo lwempahla ngokomthetho. -Lawula ze uphephe abasebenzi besixhobo; yenza ulawulo lomsebenzi ohanjiswawo, isiphelo, ubungathyi, ikhowuti, imfundo, iplani yokumela naxesho elongeziweyo elivunyelwe. Sebenzisa iimfuno zenkululeko yempilo yokhuseleko; qaphela, bhala uze wenze ulwazi olunyuka lweengozi, kokhuselo lomlilo ngenkqubo ngokobuchwepheshe. Gcina amarekhodu anomgama wamasevisi nokuqwalaselwa uze uze unike iingxelo ngenkqubo yolondolozo, ukuchithwa, iziphene ezingazityiswanga nendlela zokulunga. -Amakhono omlawulo weshishini olubuhle, ukuhlalutya ngokobuchwepheshe, ukuqwalasela iingxaki, ukulawula abathengi ukhuseleko komgangatho.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 2 (SPECIALTY: Mental Health)
jobs.centre: Support and Outreach Oudtshoorn PHC, Oudtshoorn Sub-district
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 per annum
jobs.summary: Professional nurse (Grade 1 to 2) specialising in mental health needed to provide acute and chronic mental health care at primary health care facilities in Oudtshoorn.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R880) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post-basic nursing qualification with a duration of at least 1 year accredited with the SANC in Advanced Psychiatric Nursing Science (R212). OR A 4-year bachelor’s degree in nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R171 plus R1497 and R683 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post graduate diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Mental Health Nursing. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: A minimum of 4 years’ appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Grade 2: A minimum of 14 years’ appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 10 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognisable experience after obtaining the 1-year post-basic qualification or post-graduate diploma in the relevant specialty. Inherent requirement of the job: A valid driver’s licence. Willingness to work overtime when needed. The incumbent is expected to consult with patients at different facilities in the Sub-Districts. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good psychosocial- and health assessment skills. Knowledge of Mental Health Legislation and Psychopharmacology. Good problem-solving, communication, interpersonal, planning and organisational skills. Knowledge in the use of clinical equipment and control of budget levels. Experience in data management and accurate record keeping of the relevant mental health services.
jobs.duties: Actively participate as a specialist nurse in the provision of acute and chronic mental health care to clients of all age groups at Primary Health Care facilities in the Oudtshoorn Sub District. Make bio-psychosocial health assessments that are culturally sensitive. Design and implement treatment plans and critically evaluate outcomes. Engage in case management activities such as organising, accessing, negotiating, coordinating and integrating services. Promote and maintain mental health and manage the effects of mental illness through education, counselling and psycho-social rehabilitation. Participate in the training and clinical supervision of other health care providers.
jobs.enquiries: Ms NC Jackson Tel No: (044) 203 - 7205
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to candidates who apply for the first time for registration in the post basic qualification or post graduate diploma in the relevant specialty. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the advert for the POST 37/287: Deputy Director: Manager Hospital Development (5/8th Post) Directorate: Facilities and Infrastructure Management, Centre: Tygerberg Hospital, Redevelopment Office, Salary R582 684 (5/8th) per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual’s personal needs) advertised in the Public Service Vacancy 37 dated 16 October 2026, has been amended as follows: Deputy Director: Manager Hospital Development (5/8th Post) (3 Year-Contract) OTHER POSTS

af.title: Professionle Verpleegkundige Graad 1 tot 2 (SPESIALITEIT: Geestesgesondheid)
af.summary: Professionle verpleegkundige (Graad 1 tot 2) wat spesialiseer in geestesgesondheid benodig om akute en chroniese geestesgesondheidsorg by primêre gesondheidsorgfasiliteite in Oudtshoorn te bied.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R880) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionle Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Post-basiese verpleegkwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar wat by die SANC geakkrediteer is in Advanced Psychiatric Nursing Science (R212). OF 'n 4-jarige bachelorsgraad in verpleegkunde (R174) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R171 plus R1497 en R683 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionle Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Nagraadse diploma (R635) wat by die SANC in Mental Health Nursing geakkrediteer is. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as Professionle Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: Graad 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar se toepaslike/erkende ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionle Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar se toepaslike/erkende ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionle Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ten minste 10 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkende ervaring wees na die behaling van die 1-jarige post-basiese kwalifikasie of nagraadse diploma in die tersaaklike spesialiteit. Inherente vereiste van die werk: 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om oortyd te werk wanneer nodig. Die ampsdraer word verwag om pasiënte by verskillende fasiliteite in die Sub-distrikte te raadpleeg. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goeie psigososiale- en gesondheidsassesseringsvaardighede. Kennis van Geestesgesondheidswetgewing en Psigofarmakologie. Goeie probleemoplossings-, kommunikasie-, interpersoonlike-, beplannings- en organisatoriese vaardighede. Kennis van die gebruik van kliniese toerusting en beheer van begrotingsvlakke. Ervaring in databestuur en akkurate rekordhouding van die tersaaklike geestesgesondheidsdienste.
af.duties: Neem aktief deel as 'n spialisverpleegkundige in die verskaffing van akute en chroniese geestesgesondheidsorg aan kliënte van alle ouderdomsgroepe by Primêre Gesondheidsorgfasiliteite in die Oudtshoorn Sub-distrik. Maak bio-psigososiale gesondheidsassesserings wat kultureel sensitiief is. Ontwerp en implementeer behandelingsplanne en evalueer uitkomste krities. Raak betrokke by gevalbestuursaktiwiteite soos die organiseer, toegang verkry, onderhandel, koördineer en integreer van dienste. Bevorder en handhaaf geestesgesondheid en bestuur die gevolge van geestesiekte deur opvoeding, voorligting en psigososiale rehabilitasie. Neem deel aan die opleiding en kliniese toesig van ander gesondheidsorgverskaffers.

zu.title: Umsebenzi we-TB wezokunakekela kubantu abagula nengqondo isikhundla esingu-1 kuya esingu-2
zu.summary: Uthunyiwe lomunyu we-TB ukuya emazingeni oku-1 kuya kwangu-2 oholelwe ukuba anakekele abagulayo abangenele ngengqondo emitholampilo ekunakekelwa kwezempilo esiyisiseko eKZN.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zemfundo ezingaphansi kwesidingo esincane: Isiqu esiyisiseko se-R425 (okuwukuthi idiploma/iziqu ezitholwa esikhungweni se-university ekunakekelwa kwezifo) noma isiqu esilinganayo (i-R683 kanye ne-R880) esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomenziwe wezokunakekela. Isiqu sezokunakekela i-TB ngemuva kokuqeda isiqu esiyisiseko esithatha isikhathi esingafika unyaka okuyisincane, esagunyaziwe yi-SANC kwi-Advanced Psychiatric Nursing Science (i-R212). Noma Iziqu ze-bachelors zeminyaka emi-4 ekunakekelwa kwezifo (i-R174) noma isiqu esilinganayo (i-R171 kanye ne-R1497 kanye ne-R683 kanye ne-R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomenziwe wezokunakekela. Idiploma etholwe ngemuva kweziqu (i-R635) evunyiwe yi-SANC kwi-Mental Health Nursing. Ukubhalisa emkhakheni wezomthetho wezokuqashwa: Ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengomenziwe wezokunakekela. Isipiliyangi: Izinga 1: Isipiliyangi esihambisanayo/esityiwayo esingafika unyaka emi-4 ekunakekelwa kwezifo ngemuva kokubhalisa njengomenziwe wezokunakekela kwi-SANC kwi-General Nursing. Izinga 2: Isipiliyangi esihambisanayo/esityiwayo esingafika eminyaka engu-14 ekunakekelwa kwezifo ngemuva kokubhalisa njengomenziwe wezokunakekela kwi-SANC kwi-General Nursing. Okungenani iminyaka engu-10 yaleso sikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele ibe yisipiliyangi esihambisanayo/esityiwayo ngemuva kokuthola isiqu seminyaka engu-1 ngemuva kweziqu eziyisiseko noma idiploma yamva nje kwesiqu esithinta inkinga ethize. Isidingo ngokwemvelo somsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela evunyelwe. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngaphezu kwesikhathi uma kudingeka. Lomuntu othathiwe uma ethathwa kulindelekile ukuba ayoxoxa nabagulayo ezikhungweni ezahlukene kwi-Sub-Districts. Izindlela zokwenza umsebenzi (ulwazi/izikhombandlela): Ubuchule obuhle bokuhlola impilo yengqondo nenyanga. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Mental Health Legislation kanye ne-Psychopharmacology. Ubuchule obuhle bokuxazulula izinkinga, okwokuxhumana namanye abantu, okwokuqhathanisa nokuhlela. Ulwazi ukusetshenziswa kwemishini yokunakekela kanye nokulawula izinga lwebhajethi.
zu.duties: Yiba ngumhwebi onguchwepheshe othatha inxaxhebe ngokusebenzayo ekunikezeni ukunakekelwa kwezempilo yengqondo okwedlule okunesikhathi esifushane nasesikhathi eside kubathintekayo bonke beminyaka emikhakheni yokunakekelwa kwezempilo yasele ngaphansi kwe-Oudtshoorn Sub District. Yenza ukuhlola impilo yebhayolojinya, yengqondo nenyanga ngendlela ethobela izinkomba zamasiko. Hlela futhi usebenzise izinhlela zokwelashwa bese uhlonza ngokucophelela imiphumela. Zibandakanye kumisebenzi yokuphathwa kwezimo njengokuhlela, ukufinyelela, ukuxoxisana, ukuqambanisana nokuhlanganisa izinsiza. Khuthaza futhi ulondoloze izempilo yengqondo futhi uphathe imiphumela yegula lengqondo ngefundo, ukweluleka nokuqashelwa kabusha kwengqondo nenyanga. Thatha inxaxheba ekuletheni futhi ekubukheni ngamehlo okuhola abanakezeli bezempilo abanye.

xh.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 2 (IINDABA: Impilo yengqondo)
xh.summary: Kufuneka umongikazi osebenzayo (Grade 1 to 2) ogqithiswe kwikhathalelo lwengqondo ukunika inyango ebugxekayo nasekusaphi kwezempilo kwiziko ezingundoqo zeempilo kwi-Oudtshoorn.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso esingaphantsi semfundo: Isiqrwewu seBASIC R425 (oko kukuthi idiploma/idigri kwinkonzo yokongikazi) okanye isiqrwevu esilinganayo (R683 kwakunye ne-R880) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoMongikazi oSebenzayo. Isiqrwewu sokongikazi sangemva kwesiseko esinomgangatho wonyaka ongungaphantsi kwawo-1 esamkelwe yi-SANC kwi-Advanced Psychiatric Nursing Science (R212). OKANYE Idigri yezidanga zine yokongikazi (R174) okanye esiqrwevu esilinganayo (R171 kwakunye no-R1497 nayo R683 kwakunye no-R1497) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoMongikazi oSebenzayo. Idiploma yesidanga sangaphezulu (R635) esamkelwe yi-SANC kwikhathalelo lwempilo yengqondo. Ukubhaliswa koluntu lwabachwepheshe: Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengoMongikazi oSebenzayo. Iimbonelelo: Grade 1: Isipilingo seminyaka engu-4 ubuncinane semisebenzi efanelekileyo/eqaqiswayo kwinkonzo yokongikazi emva kokubhaliswa njengoMongikazi oSebenzayo kwi-SANC kwinkonzo yoGqatsa. Grade 2: Isipilingo seminyaka engu-14 ubuncinane semisebenzi efanelekileyo/eqaqiswayo kwinkonzo yokongikazi emva kokubhaliswa njengoMongikazi oSebenzayo kwi-SANC kwinkonzo yoGqatsa. Kufuneka kube yiminyaka engu-10 ubuncinane yelo xesha elidweliswe ngasentla isipilingo semisebenzi efanelekileyo/eqaqiswayo emva kokufumana esiqrwevu sangemva kwesiseko senyaka elinye okanye idiploma yesidanga sangaphezulu kummandla obalulekileyo. Imlinganiselo eseqelwe kumsebenzi: Ilayisenisi yokushayela esevedini. Ukulungelelana ukusebenza ngaphezulu kwexesha xa kuyimfuneko. Kulindeleke kumntu oze kule nhlangano ukuba echache nabaguli kwindawo ezahlukeneyo kumaphondo angaphantsi. Ikhono (ulwazi/obuchwephesha): Iakhono ezilungileyo zokulinganisa imeko yengqondo nempilo. Ulwazi ngeMithetho yeMpiqondolo kunye ne-Psychopharmacology. Iakhono ezilungileyo zokusombulula iingxaki, nokunxibelelana, phakathi kwabantu, zokuyila nokulungelelanisa. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa izixhobo zonyango nokulawula amanqanaba emali echithiwayo. Iimbonelelo ekulawulweni lwedata nasekugcineni irekhodi elicacileyo leenkonzo ezingqondana nekhathalelo lwengqondo.
xh.duties: Thatha inxaxheba ngokuzimisela njengomongikazi wezobuchwepheshe ekunikezeleni ngenyango yokhathalelo lwengqondo ebugxekayo nasekusapheni kubaxhasi bonke imiqgubo yeminyaka kwindawo zezempilo ezingundoqo kwi-Oudtshoorn Sub District. Yenza iimpimo zezeempilo eziyibio-psychosocial ezingabandakanyiyo ngenkcubeko. Yila uphumelelise iicebo lokunyanga uze ulinganise ngokuchanekileyo iimphumo. Zibandakanye kumisebenzi yokulawula amacala efana nokuyila, ukufikelela, ukuthengisa, ukulungelelanisa nokudibanisa iinkonzo. Khuthaza zigcine impilo yengqondo ulawule iimpembelelo zesifo sengqondo ngenkqubo yemfundo, ingcebiso nengqalelo ezingqongweni. Thatha inxaxheba ekufundiseni nasekuqwalaselweni ngokwendalo abanye banikeli bekhathalelo lwempilo.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Ondersteuningsdiens (INFRASTRUCTURE and
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur vir Ondersteuningsdiens wat infrastruktuurbeplanning, kapitale verbeteringsprojekte en ondersteuningsdienste by die Western Cape College of Nursing, Stikland Campus bestuur.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: 'n Toepaslike Nasionale Diploma (NQF Level 6 of gelykwaardig) in Public Management of Project Management. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in infrastruktuur- en ondersteuningsdienste. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Geldige (Code B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis van toepaslike wetgewing, regulasies en beleide, soos OHSC-standaarde. Kennis van faciliteits- en infrastruktuurbestuur, instandhouding, kontrakte en best-practices vir ondersteuningsdienste. Strategiese denke, beleidsontwikkeling en operasionele beplanning. Leierskap, toesig, spanbou en konflikoplossingsvaardighede. Belanghebbendebestuur, onderhandeling en verhoudingsbou-bevoegdhede. Uitstekende mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasie, insluitend verslagskrywing en tegniese dokumentasie. Rekenaargeletterdheid (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams). Projektbestuurvaardighede, insluitend beplanning, organisering en koördinering van dienslewering.
af.duties: Lei en koördineer die ontwikkeling en implementering van infrastruktuurmeesterbeplanning en lewensiklusbeplanning. Bestuur kapitale verbeteringsprojekte vir geboue en fisiese infrastruktuur oor alle werf. Bestuur ondersteuningsdienste soos werkswinkel, vervoer, reprodugrafie, en rekordbestuursondersteuning/argiewe, en huishouding. Bestuur dienskontrakte (sekuriteit, skoonmaak, instandhouding, toegangsbeheer, biometriese stelsels, CCTV, brandstelsels, grasonderhoud, plaagbeheer ens.). Verseker doeltreffende sekuriteit/toegangsbeheer vir alle personeel en studente se veelvuldige kampusse. Hou toesig oor begroting en finansiële bestuur vir ondersteuningsdienste. Lei mensebestuur binne ondersteuningsdienste.

zu.title: Osiza ongumqondisi: Inkonzo Yokusekela (i-INFRASTRUCTURE kanye
zu.summary: Osiza ongumqondisi wezinkonzo Zokusekela ophatha ukuhlela kwezokwakhiwa, imisebenzi yokuthuthukisa okuyisihluthulelo kanye nezinkonzo zokusekela e-Western Cape College of Nursing, Stikland Campus.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezingaphansi komthetho: I-Diploma yezwe elifanele (i-NQF Level 6 noma okulinganayo) ku-Public Management noma i-Project Management. Isipiliyongo: Isipiliyongo esifanele kwezokwakhiwa nasezinkonzweni zokusekela. Isidingo esibekelwe leminyuzo: Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B/EB) evumelekile. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi ngemithetho, imithethonqubo kanye namapholisi ahlobene, njengezindinganiso ze-OHSC. Ukwazi ukuphatha iziteshi kanye nezokwakhiwa, ukulungiswa, amakontrakthi, nezinkonzo zokusekela ezilungile. Ukucabanga ngokubeka iqondo, ukuthuthukisa amapholisi, kanye nokuhlela ukusebenza. Amakhono okuhola, okuqapha, ukwakha iqembu, kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ikhono lokuphatha abahlanganyeli, ukuxoxisana, nokwakha ubudlelwano. Ukukhuluma nokubhala kahle ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe, okuhlanganisa ukubhala imibiko kanye nemibhalo yobuchwepheshe. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-Microsoft Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint, i-Outlook, i-Teams). Amakhono okuphatha imisebenzi, okuhlanganisa ukuhlela, ukuhlela izinto kanye nokuhlanganisa ukulethwa kwenkonzo.
zu.duties: Hola futhi uhlanganyele ekuthuthukiseni nasekusebenziseni uhlelo lokubeka ngendlela kwezokwakhiwa nokuhlela imishini yonke lesikhathi. Phatha imisebenzi yokuthuthukisa okuyisihluthulelo kwezakhiwo nempahla ezakhiwe kuzo zonke iziteshi. Phatha izinkonzo zokusekela njengesitolo sezimbi, izokuthutha, ukuphindaphinda imibhalu, ukusekelwa kokuphathwa kwemibhalo/iziqoshwa, kanye nokugcina izindlu eziphathwa kahle. Phatha amakontrakthi enkonzweni (izokuphepha, ukuhlanza, ukulungiswa, Lawula Ukungena. Izinhlelo ze-Biometric, i-CCTV, izinhlelo zomlilo, ukulondoloba indawo, ukulawula izinsecti njl.) Qinisekisa ukuphepha okusebenzayo/Lawula Ukungena kubo bonke abasebenzi nabafundi abakumanyeni amakhasi amaningi. Qapha ukwenza izibalo kanye nokuphatha izimali kuzinkonzo zokusekela. Hola ukuphathwa kwabantu ngaphakathi kwezinkonzo zokusekela.

xh.title: Umncedisi woMlawuli: Isebe loNxibelelaniso lweNkonzo (INFRASTRUCTURE and
xh.summary: Umncedisi woMlawuli wesebe loNxibelelaniso lwenkonzo ophatha uqeqesho lolwakhiwo, amaprojekthi okuphucula inkunzi kunye nezinto zoxhaso kwi-Western Cape College of Nursing, Stikland Campus.
xh.requirements: Iziqu zemfundo ezisezantsi: i-National Diploma efanelekileyo (NQF Level 6 okanye elinganayo) kwi-Public Management okanye i-Project Management. Isiphaluka: Isiphaluka esifanelekileyo kwi-Infrastructure nasezixhobisi zoxhaso. Iimfuno eziphathwayo zomsebenzi: Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba (Code B/EB) esebenzayo. Amandla (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi ngemithetho, iimila kunye namapolicy ahambelanayo, njengamazinga e-OHSC. Injingo kwintsapho yolwakhiwo nokulawula izixhobo, ulondolozo, iikontrathi, kunye nezona nzise zezixhobisi zoxhaso. Ukucinga ngokobunyani, uphuhliso lwepolicy, necandelo lokuhlela. Amandla okukhokela, okulawula, ukwakha iqela, kunye nokuzeba ngengxaki. Amandla okulawula abathathi-nnxaxheba, ukucingelana, nokwakha ubudlelwane. Unxibelelwano olubalaseleyo lwasentlweni nolubhalwayo, kuquka nokubhala iiripoti namaxwebhu obuchwephesha. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams). Amandla okulawula amaprojekthi, kuquka ukucwangcisa, ukuqamba kwaye ulungiselele ukunikwa kwenkonzo.
xh.duties: Khokela kwaye ulungiselele uphuhliso kunye nokusebenzisa iplani enkulu yolwakhiwo neyexesha elide lokuphila. Lawula amaprojekthi okuphucula inkunzi yezakhiwo nolwakhiwo olubonakalayo kuzo onke iindawo. Lawula izixhobizi zoxhaso ezifana newokshophu, ukuhamba, i-Reprographic, inkxaso yolawulo amarekhodi/izinto zokugcina, kunye nokucoza indlu. Lawula iikontrathi zenkonzo (ukhuseleko, ukucoza, ulondolozo, Lawulo loNgeno. Iinkqubo ze-Biometric, i-CCTV, iinkqubo zomlilo, ukugcina umhlaba, ukulawula izinsekedi njl.). Qinisekisa uLawulo loKhuselo/loNgeno olusebenzayo kuwo onke amalungu kunye nabafundi kumanyathelo amaninzi. Qondisa ukulinganisa nephatho yemali yezixhobizi zoxhaso. Khokela ukuqonda abantu kule nxalenye yezixhobizi zoxhaso.

jobs.title: Clinical Technologist Grade 1 to 3: Nephrology
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R413 121 per annum Grade 2: R482 499 per annum Grade 3: R564 822 per annum
jobs.summary: Clinical Technologist in Nephrology sought for Groote Schuur Hospital, Observatory, to perform renal therapies, water quality checks and infection control duties.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows for registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Clinical Technologist in Nephrology. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as Clinical Technologist in Nephrology. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA in Clinical Technology in respect of RSA qualified employees. One-year relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Clinical Technology in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Grade 2: Minimum of 10 years’ relevant experience after registration with HPCSA in Clinical Technology in respect of SA qualified employees. Minimum of 11 years’ relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Clinical Technology in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Grade 3: Minimum of 20 years’ relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Clinical Technology in respect of RSA qualified employees. Minimum of 21 years’ relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Clinical Technology in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform community service as required in South Africa. Inherent requirements of the job: Delivering an after-hours renal replacement therapy service is compulsory. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good communication skills (verbal and written). Good interpersonal skills. Ability to work under pressure and to manoeuvre heavy dialysis equipment. Ability to work as a team as well as independently. Willingness to participate in training of Clinical Technology students.
jobs.duties: Participate in on-going quality control and infection control. Perform other non- renal related therapies such as plasma exchange. Perform Body Composition Monitoring (BCM) on CKD patients. Perform daily RO water checks; do monthly water sampling for bacterial count and perform tests for the endotoxin levels. Perform continuous renal replacement therapies in the ICUs, i.e. CVVHD, CVVHDF & SLED. Perform renal replacement therapies i.e haemodialysis in chronic and acute settings. Willingness to work overtime as needed. Perform administrative duties related to clinical technology, including maintaining patient records, treatment documentation, laboratory results and equipment records. Assist the supervisor and manager with the training of Clinical Technology students and provide support to Student Clinical Technologists with their research projects.
jobs.enquiries: Mr D Mweli Tel No: (021) 404 3366 or email: daniel.mweli@westerncape.gov.za
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status)”. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the advert for the POST 37/287: Deputy Director: Manager Hospital Development (5/8th Post) Directorate: Facilities and Infrastructure Management, Centre: Tygerberg Hospital, Redevelopment Office, Salary R582 684 (5/8th) per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual’s personal needs) advertised in the Public Service Vacancy 37 dated 16 October 2026, has been amended as follows: Deputy Director: Manager Hospital Development (5/8th Post) (3 Year-Contract) OTHER POSTS

af.title: Kliniese Tegnoloog Graad 1 tot 3: Nefrologie
af.summary: Kliniese Tegnoloog in Nefrologie gesoek vir Groote Schuur Hospital, Observatory, om nierterapieë, watergehalte-kontroles en infeksiebeheerpligte uit te voer.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Kliniese Tegnoloog in Nefrologie moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as Kliniese Tegnoloog in Nefrologie. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie by die HPCSA in Kliniese Tegnologie ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Een jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in Kliniese Tegnologie ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers van wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig nie, soos in South Africa vereis. Graad 2: Minimum van 10 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by HPCSA in Kliniese Tegnologie ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Minimum van 11 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in Kliniese Tegnologie ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers van wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig nie, soos in South Africa vereis. Graad 3: Minimum van 20 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in Kliniese Tegnologie ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Minimum van 21 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in Kliniese Tegnologie ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers van wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in South Africa vereis nie. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Die lewer van 'n na-ure niervervangingsterapiediens is verpligtend. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik). Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede. Vermoë om onder druk te werk en swaar dialise-toerusting te maneuvreer. Vermoë om as 'n span te werk asook onafhanklik. Bereidwilligheid om deel te neem aan die opleiding van Kliniese Tegnologie-studente.
af.duties: Neem deel aan deurlopende gehaltebeheer en infeksiebeheer. Verrig ander ni-nierverwante terapieë soos plasmainruiling. Verrig Body Composition Monitoring (BCM) op CKD-pasiënte. Verrig daaglikse RO-waterkontroles; doen maandelikse watermonstename vir bakteriële telling en verrig toetse vir endotoksienvlakke. Verrig deurlopende niervervangingsterapieë in die ICUs, d.w.s. CVVHD, CVVHDF & SLED. Verrig niervervangingsterapieë d.w.s. hemodialise in chroniese en akutte omgewings. Bereidwilligheid om oortyd te werk soos benodig. Verrig administratiewe pligte verwant aan kliniese tegnologie, insluitend die instandhouding van pasiëntrekords, behandelingsdokumentasie, laboratoriumresultate en toerustingrekords. Help die toesighouer en bestuurder met die opleiding van Kliniese Tegnologie-studente en verskaf ondersteuning aan Student Kliniese Tegnoloë met hul navorsingsprojekte.

zu.title: Umlobi Wezobuchwepheshe Bekliniki Ezingeni 1 kuya ku-3: I-Nephrology
zu.summary: Kufunwa umlobi wezobuchwepheshe bekliniki kwi-Nephrology esibhedlela i-Groote Schuur Hospital, e-Observatory, ukuze enze izidlakalo zezinso, ukuhlola ibhalansi lamanzi nalolunye ulwazi oluhlobene nezenzo zokubulala amagciwane.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esingokoqobo samanje: Ithuba elifanele elivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomlobi wezobuchwepheshe bekliniki kwi-Nephrology. Ukubhalisa kubhalwe labathi: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomlobi wezobuchwepheshe bekliniki kwi-Nephrology. Isipiliyoni: I-Grade 1: Asikho isidingo seminyaka yamva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kubasebenzi abangasebenza ngokomthetho we-RSA. Kufuneka abe nonyaka omnye wesipiliyoni esihambisanayo kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kubasebenzi abangaphandle, abangadingi ukwenza inkonzo yoluntu, njengoko kucetyiswa eNingizimu Afrika. I-Grade 2: Iminyaka eyi-10 ngenani elingaphansi kwesipiliyoni esihambisanayo kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kubasebenzi abangasebenza ngokomthetho we-SA. Iminyaka eyi-11 ngenani elingaphansi kwesipiliyoni esihambisanayo kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kubasebenzi abangaphandle, abangadingi ukwenza inkonzo yoluntu, njengoko kucetyiswa eNingizimu Afrika. I-Grade 3: Iminyaka engu-20 ngenani elingaphansi kwesipiliyoni esihambisanayo kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kubasebenzi abangasebenza ngokumthetho we-RSA. Iminyaka engu-21 ngenani elingaphansi kwesipiliyoni esihambisanayo kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kubasebenzi abangaphandle, abangadingi ukwenza inkonzo yoluntu njengoko kucetyiswa eNingizimu Afrika. Izidingo ezingokoqobo zomsebenzi: Kuyadingeka ukuba kubekho ukulethwa kwesidlakalo sokushintsha inso ngemva kwamahora. Ikhono (ulwazi/izikrili): Amakhono amahle okuxoxa (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Amakhono amahle okusebenza nabantu. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegazi kanye nokukwazi ukushukumisa amadivayisi esidlakalo esinzima. Ikhono lokusebenza njengeqhaza kanye nokusebenza ngabanye. Ukuzithoba ekuthatheni inxaxheba eqeqeshweni abafundi bezobuchwepheshe bekliniki.
zu.duties: Thatha inxaxheba ekulawuleni igazi kanye nokulwa nentsholongwane.enza Izinye izidlakalo ezingahlobene nezinso njengokushintsha iplasma. Yenza ukulandwa kolwazi lomzimba (BCM) kubaguleli abanesifo sezinso esingaphelisi. Yenza okuhlolwayo kwamanzi nsuku zonke; yenza yonke inyanga ukuthatha amasampula amanzi ukubala amagciwane futhi uholole amanani e-endotoxin. Yenza izidlakalo zokuqhubeka nokushintsha izinso kuma-ICU, okungukuthi i-CVVHD, i-CVVHDF ne-SLED. Yenza izidlakalo zokushintsha izinso, i-haemodialysis ezimweni zesikhathi eside nakumasoga. Ukuzethemba ekwenzeni imisebenzi engaphezu kwamahora njengoba kudingeka. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo ehlobene nobuchwepheshe bekliniki, okuhlanganisa ukugcina amafayela abaguleli, amaphepha okwelapha, iziphethu zolololwazi kunye namarekhodi ezinsimbi. Siza ongqongqoshe nomphathi eqeqeshweni labafundi bezobuchwepheshe bekliniki futhi unike inkxaso kwabafundi abafunda ukuba ngabalobi bezobuchwepheshe bekliniki emibhalweni yabo yokuseseka isipiliyoni.

xh.title: Umngenisi wotekhnoloji yamagqabi esigaba 1 ukuya koku-3: I-Nephrology
xh.summary: Kufunekiwe umngenisi wotekhnoloji yamagqabi kwi-Nephrology eGroote Schuur Hospital, Observatory, ukuze enze iindidi zokwelapha iziphalu, iikholi zomgangatho wamanza nemithefundo yokulawula ukuthelekisa.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sokuqala semfundo: Isifikelelo esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomngenisi wotekhnoloji yamagqabi kwi-Nephrology. Ukubhalisa kwikhowudi yomsebenzi: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomngenisi wotekhnoloji yamagqabi kwi-Nephrology. Isipili: Isigaba 1: Akukho mfuneko emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kumatshini wamagqabi, malunga namaphakathi awayesakuzelwa ngabasebenzi base-RSA. Unyaka omnye wamava ahambelana nokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kumatshini wamagqabi, malunga nabasebenzi basesinye sezwe abayekelwe ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufunekayo eMzantsi Afrika. Isigaba 2: Ubuncinane leminyaka elishumi yamava ahambelana nokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kumatshini wamagqabi, malunga namaphakathi awayesakuzelwa ngabasebenzi base-South Africa. Ubuncinane leminyaka elishumi elinanye yamava ahambelana nokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kumatshini wamagqabi, malunga nabasebenzi basesinye sezwe abayekelwe ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufunekayo eMzantsi Afrika. Isigaba 3: Ubuncinane leminyaka elingamashumi amabini yamava ahambelana nokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kumatshini wamagqabi, malunga namaphakathi awayesakuzelwa ngabasebenzi base-RSA. Ubuncinane leminyaka elingamashumi amabini ananye yamava ahambelana nokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kumatshini wamagqabi, malunga nabasebenzi basesinye sezwe abayekelwe ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufunekayo eMzantsi Afrika. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi kumsebenzi: Ukuze kubhetele ukuba inkonzo yokulungisa amathumba emva kweyure emva kwamanyathelo, wethulwe. Ikhono (ulwazi/izakhono): Ikhono lokuzithetha nokubhala elilungele. Ikhono elilungelelho lokusebenzisana nabanye. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi kokgxekiweyo nokuyiseka iakhiso zokuhambisa ukudluliswa kwamathumba. Ikhono lokusebenza njengomnye wethim kwaye nangaphandle kwethim. Ukulungele ukuze uncedise ekolweni abafundi botekhnoloji yamagqabi.
xh.duties: Thatha inxaxheba kumatshini olawulo kokuhamba kolwazi kwiinkcukacha zokuhamba kwesiselo. Yenza iindidi zokwelapha ezingezizo ezindwendweni zeziphalu ezinjengokutshintsha amathumba. Yenza ukuqwalasela lomzimba (BCM) kwiziguli ezinesimo esibi esinamathumba. Yenza iikholi zemihla yonke zika-RO; yaza ngenyanga yenza iikholi zokulinganisa ubalo lwamagciwane kwaye uqwalasele iindlela ezisezantsi ze-endotoxin. Yaza ngokulandelanayo ukuqwalasela kokuhamba kwesiselo kwii-ICUs, oko kukuthi i-CVVHD, i-CVVHDF ne-SLED. Yaza iindidi zokulungisa amathumba, oko kukuthi i-haemodialysis kwisimo esihlala sileyo nangesiya esibiyo. Ukulungele ukusebenza ngeyure ezongezelelweko njengoko kufunekayo. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo ehlobene notekhnoloji yamagqabi, kuquka ukugcina amafayile eziguli, amaxwebhu okwelapha, iimpumlo zekhemikhali naxwebhu oqaqweni. Nceda umphathi nesikhululi ekolweni labafundi botekhnoloji yamagqabi kwaye unike inkxaso kwabo bafundi abangangenisi kotekhnoloji yamagqabi ngeendaba zemisebenzi yophando.

jobs.title: Senior Administrative Officer: Supply Chain Management
jobs.summary: Senior administrative officer managing supply chain and warehouse operations for the Western Cape Health Warehouse.
jobs.requirements: Minimal educational qualification: An appropriate National Diploma (NQF 6) or equivalent in Supply Chain Management. Experience: Appropriate experience in Supply Chain and Warehouse Management, including demand planning, inventory optimization, supplier coordination, and maintaining efficient storage and distribution systems. Appropriate experience in managing & handling stock in a store/warehouse environment. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s licence. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Ability to collate, verify data, work accurately and methodically. Good interpersonal and organisational skills. Computer skills (MS Word, Excel and Outlook). Knowledge and practical experience in LOGIS or Basic Accounting System (BAS). Knowledge of administrative and/or support duties in a store/warehouse.
jobs.duties: Acquisitions Management - Handling and contract management as per notices in order to procure medical consumables (contract and non-contract). Ensure Compliance with the AO system and delegation when acquiring goods and services. Ensure strict adherence to and continuously maintain up-to-date knowledge of applicable departmental policies, prescripts, and procedures. Managing procurement end-to-end in terms sampling request, evaluation submission, presenting to QC, following the relevant procurement processes. Execute responsibilities within the Electronic Procurement System (ePS), ensuring adherence to procurement prescripts and compliance requirements. Prepare bidding templates and supporting documentation for presentation to the Quotation Committee. Compile and report on stock on hand and dues-out, supporting effective inventory control and planning. Contract management, Forecasting, Demand, Reporting & Policy development for warehouse. ESL, Logis ICN Compliance & BMI. Maintain regular communication with suppliers and internal stakeholders, ensuring timely follow-up on outstanding orders. Assist with interim and annual financial reporting, including financial year-end processes. Performed ad-hoc administrative and operational support tasks as required. Initiate and formulate new proposals for optimal efficiency and effectiveness regarding service. Human Resource Management - Attendance register control, leave planning and control, labour relations, training & development identification and performance agreements and review.
