af.title: Senior Administratiewe Beampte: Voorsieningskettingbestuur
af.summary: Senior administratiewe beampte wat voorsieningsketting- en pakhuisbedrywighede vir die Western Cape Health Warehouse bestuur.
af.requirements: Minimale opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: 'n Toepaslike Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) of gelykwaardig in Voorsieningskettingbestuur. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in Voorsieningsketting- en Pakhuisbestuur, insluitend vraagbeplanning, voorraadoptimalisering, verskafferkoördinasie, en die handhawing van doeltreffende berging- en verspreidingstelsels. Toepaslike ervaring in die bestuur en hantering van voorraad in 'n winkel-/pakhuisomgewing. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om data te versamel en te verifieer, akkuraat en metodies te werk. Goeie interpersoonlike en organisatoriese vaardighede. Rekenaarvaardighede (MS Word, Excel en Outlook). Kennis en praktiese ervaring in LOGIS of Basic Accounting System (BAS). Kennis van administratiewe en/of ondersteuningspligte in 'n winkel-/pakhuis.
af.duties: Verkrygingsbestuur - Hantering en kontrakbestuur soos per kennissgewings ten einde mediese verbruiksgoedere (kontrak en nie-kontrak) te verkry. Verseker nakoming van die AO-stelsel en delegasie by die verkryging van goedere en dienste. Versester streng nakoming van en handhaaf voortdurend opgedateerde kennis van toepaslike departementele beleide, voorskrifte en prosedures. Bestuur van verkryging van begin tot einde ten opsigte van monsterversoek, evalueringsvoorlegging, voorlegging aan KV, en die volg van die relevante verkrygingsprosesse. Voer verantwoordelikhede uit binne die Electronic Procurement System (ePS) en verseker nakoming van verkrygingsvoorskrifte en nalewingvereistes. Berei bodsjablone en ondersteunende dokumentasie voor vir voorlegging aan die Aanhalingskomitee. Stel verslae op oor voorraad op hand en uitstaande versendings ter ondersteuning van doeltreffende voorraadbeheer en -beplanning. Kontrakbestuur, voorspelling, vraag, verslagdoening en beleidontwikkeling vir pakhuis. ESL, Logis ICN Compliance & BMI. Handhaaf gereelde kommunikasie met verskaffers en interne belanghebbendes en verseker tydige opvolg van uitstaande bestellings. Bystand met tussentydse en jaarlikse finansiële verslagdoening, insluitend prosesse aan die einde van die finansiële jaar. Voer ad hoc administratiewe en operasionele ondersteuningstake soos vereis uit. Begin en formuleer nuwe voorstelle vir optimale doeltreffendheid en effektiewiteit ten opsigte van diens. Menslike hulpbronbestuur - Bywoningsregisterbeheer, verlofbeplanning en -beheer, arbeidsverhoudinge, opleiding en ontwikkelingidentifisering, asook prestasieooreenkomste en hersiening.

zu.title: Onoziphatha Abaphezulu Bokuqashwa Bobuchwepheshe: Ukuphathwa KokuHlinzeka Ngokulandelana
zu.summary: Onoziphatha abaphezulu bokuqashwa bobuchwepheshe abaphatha izinqubo zokuhlinzeka kanye nezinkomba zediliki yezempilo yase-Western Cape.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo okuncane: Isitifiketi se-Diploma Kazwelonke esifanelekanayo (NQF 6) noma esalinganayo kwi-Supply Chain Management. Isiphaluka: Isiphaluka esifanele e-Supply Chain nase-Warehouse Management, okuhlanganisa ukuhlelwa kwezidingo, ukukhishwa kwezimpahla ngokusebenza, ukuhlelwa kwezibopho zezinkontileka nabahlinzeki, nokugcina izimiso zokulondolozwa nokuhambahambayo. Isiphaluka esifanele ekuphatheni nokuphatheni kwezimpahla ngokuhamba kwesikhathi enkabeni noma edilikini. Iphutha ezingavunyelwa: Ilayiseni yokuqasha evumelekile (Code B/EB). Amakhono (ulwazi/amandla): Isikhono sokuqamba, ukuqinisekisa idatha, ukusebenza ngokunembile ngokwesikhathi. Amakhono amahle abantu kanye nokuhlela kwabantu. Amakhono ekhompyutha (MS Word, Excel and Outlook). Ulwazi nesesiphaluka sokusebenza kwi-LOGIS noma i-Basic Accounting System (BAS). Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yomnyango kanye/noma ukusekela imisebenzi enkabeni noma edilikini.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa kokuthenga - Ukuphatha izinkontileka njengoba kushonile ukuze kutholwe izimpahla zokwelapha (ezinkontileka nangezingezona ezinkontileka). Qinisekisa ukulandelwa kwesistimu yamagunya e-AO nokwabelwa izibopho uma kutholwa impahla namasevisi. Qinisekisa ukulandela ngokuqinile nokugcina ulwazi olwamuva ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngeminyango yemithetho, izinkomba, kanye nendlela ezikhiqizwa umnyango. Ukuphatha ukuthenga okuyinkimbinkimbi kusukela ekuceshweni, okuhlanganisa nokucela okwesampula, ukuhlolwa kokuhanjiswa kolwazi, ukwethula kwi-QC, ukulandela izinqubo ezithintekayo zokuthenga. FEZISA izibopho ngaphakathi kwesistimu yokuthenga ngekhompyutha (ePS), qinisekisa ukulandelwa kwemithetho yokuthenga nezidingo zokuqinisekisa. Hlela amasampula okubiza imibhalo engesikhundla kanye nemitshingo yokusekela ukuze inikezwe iKomidi Lezintengo. Qamba futhi unikeze umbiko ngempahla etholakalayo naleyo ebulalele, okusekela ukulawula impahla ngokushesha kanye nokuqamba amasu. Uphathwa kwenkontileka, ukubikezela, isidingo, ukumbika kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwemithetho yesikhulo. I-ESL, ukuqinisekiswa kwe-Logis ICN ne-BMI. Gcina ukuxhumana njalo nabahlinzeki kanye nabahlanganyeli baphakathi, ukuqinisekisa ukulandela ngokushesha izinkumbulo ezingezansi ezibekelwe ukutholakala kokutholwayo. Siza ngemibiko yezimali yabakini nenyanga zonke, okuhlanganisa izinqubo zokuphela kwonyaka wezimali. Yenza imisebenzi ngesikhathi ethize ebusolobuhle kanye nokuwesekela ukusebenza njengoba kudingwa. Sungula futhi udalwe iziphakamiso ezintsha ukufeza ukusebenza okuphumelelayo ngokwesikhundla ngokuphelele. Uphathwa kweNbali Yabasebenzi - Ukulawula irejista lokuhamba, ukuhlela nokulawula ukukhishwa kwabasebenzi, ubudlelwano bokuqasha, ukuqashwa kobuqeqeshi nokutholwa kokuthuthukiswa kanye nezinkontileka zokusebenza kanye nokubuyekezwa.

xh.title: Ofisi Elungiselelweyo Ewezomphatho: U lawulo lwesikwama sehlabathi
xh.summary: Ofisi elungiselelweyo ezomphatho elawulayo isikwama sehlabathi nemisebenzi yendlu yokugcina iifowuni zempilo eWestern Cape Health Warehouse.
xh.requirements: Iziqu zemfundo ezincinci: I-National Diploma (NQF 6) efanelekileyo okanye esilinganayo kwi-Supply Chain Management. Isiphiwo: Isiphiwo esifanelekileyo ku-lawulo lwesikwama sehlabathi nendlu yokugcina, kuquka ucwangciso lwemfuno, ukwandiswa kwezinto ezikwindla, uqhagamshelwano nokuhambelana nabanikezeli, nokugcina iinkqubo zokugcina nokuhambisa izinto ngokusebenzayo. Isiphiwo esifanelekileyo sokulawula nokuphatha izinto ezikwindla kwimeko yethengisi/indlu yokugcina. Imfuno engaphakathi yomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqhuba (Code B/EB) esemthethweni. Iimfuno (ulwazi/amakhono): Amandla okuqokelela, kuqinisekisa idatha, ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo nangendlela ecwangcisiweyo. Amandla amahle okuhambelana nabantu nokuquumba izinto. Amandla ekhompyutha (MS Word, Excel ne-Outlook). Ulwazi nesiphiwo esisebenzayo kwi-LOGIS okanye i-Basic Accounting System (BAS). Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yolawulo nokunxibelelanayo ethengisini/endlwini yokugcina.
xh.duties: Ulawulo lokufumana izinto - Ukuphatha nokulawula iinkontrana njengoko kubekiwe kwisaziso ukuze kuthengwe izinto zokwelapha ezisetyenziswa zidibana (iinkontrana nangaphandle kwekontrana). Qinisekisa ukuthobela iinkqubo i-AO kwaye anikwe igunya xa efumana izinto neenkonzo. Qinisekisa ukuthobela ngokweenkqubo kwaye uhlale usazi iinkqubo zamasebe, izimiso nemigaqo ephilayo. Ukulawula ukuthengwa kwezinto ukusuka ekuqaleni ukuya ekupheleni ukuya kwicelo lokusampula, ukuqweshwa kolwazi olutyhilweyo, ukuzibonakalisa kwi-QC, ulandelele iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo zokuthenga. Zenza imisebenzi ngaphakathi kwenkqubo i-Electronic Procurement System (ePS), uqinisekisa ukuthobela imigaqo yokuthenga neemfuno zokuthobela. Lungiselela iitempleyiti zokuqinisekisa nokuxhasa amaxwebhu okuzibonakalisa kwi-Quotation Committee. Qamba kwaye uchaze ngokuzi izinto ezikwindla ngezo zingenayo, uxhasa ukulawula kwizinto ezikwindla nokucwangcisa. Ulawulo lweenkontrana, ukuchaza imigaqo, ukuchaza imfuno, iintsingiselo nokuphuhisa iinkquboendlwini yokugcina. I-ESL, i-Logis ICN Compliance ne-BMI. Uqhagamshele rhoqo nababoneleli nabalawuli bangaphakathi, uqinisekisa ukulandelela ngexesha izinto ezingaxhomekekanga. Nceda ngeentsingiselo zonyaka nezinye zezezimali, kuquka iinkqubo zonyaka wemali ophelileyo. Yenza imisebenzi evela ngexesha yolawulo nokuquumba njengoko kufunekayo. Qalisa kwaye udidiye iindaba ezintsha ngokusebenza kakuhle ngokwemigaqo ngenxa yeenkonzo. Ulawulo lwezemidlalo yabantu - Ukulawula irejista yokubakho, ucwangciso lolusuku nolawulo, uqhagamshelo lwabasebenzi, ukuqonda iimfuno zolungelelwaniso nokuphuhiswa kwamakhono namaxesha ovavanyo nemigqaliswano yomsebenzi.

jobs.title: Senior Administrative Officer: Finance (REVENUE/FEES,
jobs.summary: Senior administrative officer needed at Khayelitsha District Hospital to manage revenue collection, hospital fees, patient administration and medical records.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: An appropriate National Diploma (NQF 6) or equivalent. Experience: Appropriate experience in Revenue (Hospital Fees and Patient Administration) and Medical Records. Appropriate supervisory experience in the Revenue (Hospital Fees and Patient Administration) and Medical Records field. Appropriate experience of Patient Admissions and Wards, including the Clinicom System. Inherent requirements of the job: Willingness to travel and work after hours when required. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Workable knowledge, Chapter 9 of Department of Health financial and revenue management policies generally with a focus on the management of patient fees and revenue collection in public health facilities. Knowledge and experience of the Clinicom system. Good interpersonal and communication skills and Good numerical skills. Computer literacy. Ability to accept accountability, responsibility, work independently. Computer literacy in Microsoft Office (MS Word, Excel, Outlook, Access). Workable knowledge of AR System, Clinicom, BAS and JAC as well as knowledge of UPFS, Chapter 18, PFMA, handling of state money, patient valuables (Chapter 6) and patient records management and all circulars, instructions and policies related to the above. Good supervisory, interpersonal, leadership and communication skills and a strong sense of responsibility.
jobs.duties: Manage and provide support to areas in respect of Revenue Generation. Ensure all Revenue monthly Targets are received monthly from Medical Aids, other 3rd parties and self-funded patients to reach year-end target. Manage and provide support to areas regarding Revenue Collection. Ensure crediting of all payments are done on the BAS System as well as Billing system. Monitor balancing between the BAS. Staff are managed appropriately in terms of HR policies. Ensuring all Reporting functions are timeously met. Manage Patient Administration Services and Medical Records with the aim of improving data quality and patient information and records according to Finance instructions, circulars, and policies. Manage the Fees Department and ensure implementation and compliance with relevant Finance Instructions, Revenue notices, SOP’s and PFMA as well as conducting and attending meetings and forums. Effective management of Revenue debt and budget control. Ensure completion and submission of monthly reports and provide feedback to management. Ensure effective Human Resources Management, which includes the management of disciplinary procedures as well as supervision and evaluation of personnel under your control. Assess patients in accordance with Hospital Memorandum 18 and UPFS manual.
jobs.enquiries: Mr N Sitonga Tel No: (021) 360-4734
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the advert for the POST 37/287: Deputy Director: Manager Hospital Development (5/8th Post) Directorate: Facilities and Infrastructure Management, Centre: Tygerberg Hospital, Redevelopment Office, Salary R582 684 (5/8th) per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual’s personal needs) advertised in the Public Service Vacancy 37 dated 16 October 2026, has been amended as follows: Deputy Director: Manager Hospital Development (5/8th Post) (3 Year-Contract) OTHER POSTS

af.title: Senior Administratiewe Beampte: Finansies (Inkomste/ fooie,
af.summary: Senior administratiewe beampte benodig by Khayelitsha Distrikshospitaal om inkomsteinning, hospitaalfooie, pasiëntadministrasie en mediese rekords te bestuur.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: 'n Toepaslike Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) of gelykwaardig. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in Inkomste (Hospitaalfooie en Pasiëntadministrasie) en Mediese Rekords. Toepaslike toesigervaring in die Inkomste (Hospitaalfooie en Pasiëntadministrasie) en Mediese Rekords veld. Toepaslike ervaring in Pasiënttoelatings en Sale, insluitend die Clinicom Stelsel. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Bereidwilligheid om te reis en buite kantoorure te werk wanneer vereis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Werkbare kennis, Hoofstuk 9 van die Departement van Gesondheid se finansiële en inkomste-bestuursbeleid in die algemeen met 'n fokus op die bestuur van pasiëntfooie en inkomsteinning in openbare gesondheidsfasiliteite. Kennis en ervaring van die Clinicom-stelsel. Goëie interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede en goeie numeriese vaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Vermoë om aanspreeklikheid en verantwoordelikheid te aanvaar en onafhanklik te werk. Rekenaargeletterdheid in Microsoft Office (MS Word, Excel, Outlook, Access). Werkbare kennis van AR-stelsel, Clinicom, BAS en JAC asook kennis van UPFS, Hoofstuk 18, PFMA, hantering van staatsgeld, pasiëntwaardevolle items (Hoofstuk 6) en pasiëntrekordbestuur en alle sirkulêres, instruksies en beleide wat verband hou met bogenoemde. Goëie toesig-, interpersoonlike, leierskaps- en kommunikasievaardighede en 'n sterk sin vir verantwoordelikheid.
af.duties: Bestuur en verskaf ondersteuning aan areas met betrekking tot Inkomstegenerasie. Verseker alle Inkomste maandelikse teikens word maandeliks van Mediese Hulp, ander 3de partye en self-gefondsierde pasiënte ontvang om jaareindeteiken te bereik. Bestuur en verskaf ondersteuning aan areas met betrekking tot Inkomsteinning. Verseker kreditering van alle betalings gedoen word op die BAS-stelsel asook die faktureerstelsel. Monitor balansering tussen die BAS. Personeel word toepaslik bestuur volgens HR-beleid. Verseker dat alle verslagdoeningsfunksies tydig nagekom word. Bestuur Pasiëntadministrasiedienste en Mediese Rekords met die doel om datakwaliteit en pasiëntinligting en -rekords te verbeter volgens Finansiële instruksies, sirkulêrs en beleide. Bestuur die Fooie-afdeling en verseker implementering en nakoming van toepaslike Finansiële Instruksies, Inkomste kennissies, SOP's en PFMA asook die voer en bywoon van vergaderings en forums. Effektiewe bestuur van Inkomsteskuld en begrotingsbeheer. Verseken voltooiing en indiening van maandelikse verslae en verskaf terugvoer aan bestuur. Verseker effektiewe Menslike Hulpbronbestuur, wat die bestuur van dissiplinêre prosedures asook toesig en evaluering van personeel onder u beheer insluit. Assesseer pasiënte in ooreenstemming met Hospitaal Memorandum 18 en UPFS-handleiding.

zu.title: Isikhulu Esiphezulu Solawulo: Izezimali (IMALI ENGENAYO/IZIMALI,
zu.summary: Kudingeka isikhulu esiphezulu solawulo e-Khayelitsha District Hospital ukuphatha ukuqoqwa kwemali engenayo, izimali zesibhedlela, ulawulo labagula kanye namarekhodi ezokwelapha.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi kakhulu: Isitifiketi sezohwebo sesizwe esifanele (NQF 6) noma okulingana naso. Isiphephelo: Isiphephelo esifanele eMali Engenayao (Izimali zaseSibhedlela nolawulo labagula) kanye Nemarekhodi Ezokwelapha. Isiphephelo sokuhlola esifanele kwindawo yemali engenayo (Izimali zaseSibhedlela nolawulo labagula) nemarekhodi ezokwelapha. Isiphephelo esifanele sokwamukela abagula nasemawadeni, okuhlanganisa isistimu ye-Clinicom. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ukuvolontiela ukuhamba futhi usebenze ngemva kwezihora lapho kudingeka khona. Ikhono (ulwazi/izikhono): Ulwazi olusebenzayo, Isahluko 9 sezinqubomgomo zeMnyango Wezempilo ezezimali nokuphathwa kwemali engenayo ngokuvamile kugxile ekuphathweni kwezimali zabagula kanye nokuqoqa imali engenayo emasikhosini ezempilo esidlangaleni. Ulwazi nesiphephelo sesistimu ye-Clinicom. Izikhono ezinhle zokuba ngiphakathi kwabantu nokuxhumana kanye nezikhono ezinhle zokubala. Ukusebenzisana nekhompyutha. Ikhono lokwamukela ubunjiniyela, ukubhekwa, ukusebenza ngokuzimele. Ukusebenzisana nekhompyutha kwi-Microsoft Office (MS Word, Excel, Outlook, Access). Ulwazi olusebenzayo Lwesistimu ye-AR, Clinicom, BAS ne-JAC kanye nolwazi lwe-UPFS, Isahluko 18, PFMA, ukuphathwa kwemali kahulumeni, izinto eziyigugu zabagula (Isahluko 6) kanye nokuphathwa kwamarekhodi abagula kanye nazo zonke izindikimba, imiyalo nezinqubomgomo eziphathelene nalokhu okungenhla. Izikhono ezinhle zokuhlola, ukuba ngiphakathi kwabantu, ukuba ngumholi nokuxhumana kanye nokuziphathelene okuqinile.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi unikele inkxaso kumapheshana ngokuphathelene nokukhiqiza imali engenayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi nganhamva ngamunye imigomo yonke yemali engenayo itholwa njalo ngenyanga kusuka Kwezamabholidi Okugongqela, kwezinye izikhulu ezingu-3 kanye nabagula okuzikhokelayo ukuze kufinyelelwe emgqeni wokugcina kweminyaka. Phatha futhi unikele inkxaso kumapheshana mayelana nokutholwa kwemali engenayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukufakwa kwemali etholwayo kwenziwa kwisistimu ye-BAS kanye nesisistimu yokubhileda. Qaphela ukulinganisela phakathi kwe-BAS. Abasebenzi baphathwa ngendlela efanele ngokusho kwezinqubomgomo ze-HR. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amagugu okubika ahlongozwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Phatha Izinkonzo Zolawulo Labagula kanye Namarekhodi Ezokwelapha nenhloso yokuthuthukisa izinga lemiondoya namapheshana agula neminonondalo ngokusho kwezimiyalo zezezimali, izindikimba kanye nezinqubomgomo. Phatha umnyango wezimali mali futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa kanye nokuthobela imiyalo ehlobene Nezezimali, izaziso zemali engenayo, i-SOP kanye ne-PFMA kanye nokubamba nokuhamba emihlanganweni nasemafomini. Uphathe ngempumelelo imali engenayo ebhalwe njengesikweletu kanye nokulawula umthethosikelela webhajethi. Qinisekisa ukugcwaliswa nokuhlongozwa kwemibiko yamanyanga kwaye unikeze impendulo kubaphathi. Qinisekisa ulawulo oluphumelelayo Lwezinsiza Zabantu, okuhlanganisa ukuphatha izinqubo zesisinyathelo kanye nokuhlola nokuhlulela abantu abaphansi kwakho. Hlola abagula ngokuvumelana Nemorandamu yaseSibhedlela 18 nengosiyele i-UPFS.

xh.title: Isikhulu esiPhakamileyo soLawulo: izeMali (INZUZO/IMALI,
xh.summary: Kufuneka aphathe inxaxheba kwindawo enkulu yeintloko yokumela iNjinji yeshumi elinesihlanu eRhawutini ephila ngokulawula inzuzo, imali yesiBhedlele, ukuphatha iigaziaba, iingxelo zomsebenzi, iindlela zeempazamo zamagosa, iingcinga zamakhadi ezamakhaladi, iingcamango ezivela kwiindawo ezahlukeneyo kwiindawo ezininzi ekudingekayo, iingxelo zeempazamko zomsebenzi wakho, ngokusebenzisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo neendlela ezahlukeneyo kwiindawo zokusebenza ezenza ukuba ukwazi ukusebenza ngokukhawuleza, ngokucace gca, ukuba ngcono nokugqithela kakhulu ngokufunda nokubhala ngokusesi ngokusesi ngokusesi ngokusesi ngokusesi ngokusesi ngokusesi.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi: i-National Diploma (NQF 6) efanelekileyo okanye ezingangayo. Isipiliwe: Isipiliwe esifanelekileyo kwinguquko (iMali yesiBhedlele noLawulo lweGaziaba) neziXhobo zeGaziaba. Isipiliwe esifanelekileyo sokulawula kwinguquko (iMali yesiBhedlele noLawulo lweGaziaba) nasezicatshulwa zeGaziaba. Isipiliwe esifanelekileyo sokwamkela abaGulayo naseZigqibele, kubandakanya isixokelelwano seClinicom. Iimfuno zangaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ulwazi lokuhamba nokusebenza emva kweyure xa kufuneka. Iimpawu zokusebenza (ulwazi/akhazimbo): Ulwazi olusebenzayo, isiSigqeba 9 samagazethu we-isebe lezezeMalI namagazethu olawulo lwengeniso ngokubanzi ngekigcino ekulawulweni kwamabizo abaGulayo nokwamkelwa kwengeniso kwiindawo zempli yezezeMpilo. Ulwazi nesipiliwe kusixokelelwano seClinicom. Akhazimbo ezilungileyo zomanyano nobuqhetseba phakathi kwamathandabuzi, nobunikela ngenani eliselula. Ukuzinikela ngokubhala ngokusingathwe ngokwenyuka, ukubala ngokumaza imivo, nemitathayo ngokusesi ngokusesi ngokusesi ngokusesi ngokusesi.
xh.duties: Qondisa kwaye unikeze inkxaso kummandla ongemva kokuVeliswa kweNgeniso. Qinisekisa ukuba onke amanqaku nyanga zonke eNgeniso afunyanwa nyanga nganye kwi-Medical Aids, amanye amaqela esithathu nabaqfalisi bazimali ukuze kufikelelwe kwinqaku lokuphela konyaka. Qondisa kwaye unikeze inkxaso kummandla malunga nokuQokelelwa kweNgeniso. Qinisekisa ukuba ukwenzwa kwe-credit kwe zimali zonke kwenziwa kwiBAS System nakwisixokelelwano se-Billing. Lilise ukulinganisela phakathi kwe-BAS. Abasebenzi baphathwa ngendlela efanelekileyo ngokwelawulo le-HR policies. Kuqinisekiswa ukuba onke amasebenzi okubika afezwa ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Qondisa iinkonzo zoLawulo lweGaziaba kwabaqfalisi kunye neziXhobo zeGaziaba nolwazi lwabaqfalisi noludidi oluphuculweyo lwegaziaba ngokwezikhokelo, iinyanga, namagazethu ezezimali. Qondisa iSebe leMali yezibonelelo kwaye uqinisekise ukusebenza kwaye ukuthobela izikhokelo ezingathathi th的组织phambili ezezimali, izaziso ezingathathi ndawo zomceli mali, i-SOP’s kunye ne-PFMA, kunye nokubamba kwaye uzithobele iimbevano kunye namabhodi. Qondisa ngokusebenzayo leNgeniso yetyala kolweso lwezimali ukulawula umthetho. Qinisekisa ukwenziwa ngokuphumelelayo komsebenzi wokuLawulwa kwezixhobo ezingamathambo, oko kubandakanya ukulawula iinkqubo zolawulo lwamaxesha akude ukuba kungabi namaxesha amakhulu kwaye akungenwa ngenkathalo. Linganisa ngokuchanekileyo abagulayo ngokweMemorandam 18 yesibhedlele nengxoxo ephants ngesiB iningaakunye ne-UPFS manual.

jobs.summary: Social worker wanted at George Regional Hospital to provide clinical social work services to patients, families and caregivers across the Rural East Ecosystem.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the South African Council for Social Services Professions (SACSSP) as Social Worker. Registration with a professional council: Registration with SACSSP as a Social Worker. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate experience in Social Work after registration as Social Worker with SACSSP. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years’ appropriate experience in Social Work after registration as Social Worker with SACSSP. Grade 4: A minimum of 30 years’ appropriate experience in Social Work after registration as Social Worker with SACSSP. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s license. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Computer literacy in MS Windows, Word, Excel, Outlook and proficiency with electronic health information systems. Ability to conduct comprehensive psychosocial assessments and develop, implement, and monitor intervention plans. Ability to manage vulnerable patient groups to access appropriate social support systems. Ability to manage crisis situations, prioritize tasks, and ensure timely interventions. Good verbal and written communication skills to facilitate communication between multidisciplinary team members. Knowledge of statutory processes.
jobs.duties: Provide geographic knowledgeable social work services to inpatients, outpatients, and their families or caregivers across the Rural East Ecosystem. Render a clinical Social Work service independently and within multi- disciplinary team setting. Facilitate access to community resources and support services. Facilitate referrals to department of social development, non- governmental organizations, community-based organizations, and other relevant government services. Ensure compliance with relevant legislation, policies, and ethical standards governing social work practice. Maintain an appropriate administrative system and effective management of physical resources related to renal dialysis services, Pauper burials applications, old age home applications and all other relevant referrals made to the community. Form 22 completion for abscondments and neglect of children. Identify areas for quality improvement and implement initiatives to enhance patient care and outcomes.
jobs.enquiries: Ms S van Wyngaard Tel No: (044) 802-4472
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates may be subjected to a practical. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted with their job application/on appointment. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). -It should be noted that advertised posts are linked to the Institution/ Facility that forms part of the Ecosystem Service platform. Upon appointment, incumbents will be expected to render clinical services across institutions in the Ecosystem, as needed to sustain health service delivery. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the advert for the POST 37/287: Deputy Director: Manager Hospital Development (5/8th Post) Directorate: Facilities and Infrastructure Management, Centre: Tygerberg Hospital, Redevelopment Office, Salary R582 684 (5/8th) per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual’s personal needs) advertised in the Public Service Vacancy 37 dated 16 October 2026, has been amended as follows: Deputy Director: Manager Hospital Development (5/8th Post) (3 Year-Contract) OTHER POSTS

af.title: Maatskaplike Werker Graad 1 tot 4
af.summary: Maatskaplike werker gesoek by George Regional Hospital om kliniese maatskaplikewerksdienste aan pasiënte, gesinne en versorgers regdeur die Rural East-ekosisteem te bied.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die South African Council for Social Services Professions (SACSSP) as Maatskaplike Werker moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by SACSSP as 'n Maatskaplike Werker. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as Maatskaplike Werker by SACSSP. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar se toepaslike ervaring in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as Maatskaplike Werker by SACSSP. Graad 4: 'n Minimum van 30 jaar se toepaslike ervaring in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as Maatskaplike Werker by SACSSP. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Rekenaarvaardigheid in MS Windows, Word, Excel, Outlook en vaardigheid met elektroniese gesondheidsinligtingstelsels. Vermoë om omvattende psigososiale assesserings uit te voer en ingrypingsplanne te ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor. Vermoë om kwesbare pasiëntgroepe te bestuur om toegang tot toepaslike maatskaplike ondersteuningstelsels te verkry. Vermoë om krisissituasies te bestuur, take te prioritiseer en tydige ingrypings te verseker. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede om kommunikasie tussen multidissiplinêre spanlede te fasiliteer. Kennis van statutêre prosesse.
af.duties: Bied geografies ingeligte maatskaplikewerksdienste aan in-pasiënte, buite-pasiënte en hul gesinne of versorgers regdeur die Rural East-ekosisteem. Lewer onafhanklik 'n kliniese Maatskaplike Werk-diens binne 'n multidissiplinêre spanopset. Fasiliteer toegang tot gemeenskapsbronne en ondersteuningsdienste. Fasiliteer verwysings na die departement van sosiale ontwikkeling, nie-regeringsorganisasies, gemeenskapsgebaseerde organisasies en ander tersaaklike regeringsdienste. Verseker nakoming van tersaaklike wetgewing, beleide en etiese standaarde wat maatskaplikewerkpraktyk regeer. Handhaaf 'n toepaslike administratiewe stelsel en effektiewe bestuur van fisiese bronde verbandhoudend met niere-dialiseerdienste, Aarmoedebegrafnis-aansoeke, ouetehuis-aansoeke en alle ander tersaaklike verwysings na die gemeenskap. Voltooiing van Vorm 22 vir wegblywers en verwaarlosing van kinders. Identifiseer areas vir gehalteverbetering en implementeer inisiatiewe om pasiëntsorg en uitkomste te verbeter.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Wezenhlalo Isigaba 1 kuya ku-4
zu.summary: Kudingeka umsebenzi wezenhlalo e-George Regional Hospital ukunikeza izinsiza zomsebenzi wezenhlalo wetemhlengwa kubafundi, emindenini nakwalabo abanakekela abantu emphakathini wonke kuso isimiso se-Rural East Ecosystem.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zemfundo ezingaphansi kwazo konke: Iziqu ezifanele ezivumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Council for Social Services Professions (SACSSP) njengomsebenzi Wezenhlalo. Ukubhalisa kwiqembu lemsebenzi ohlotsheni lwemfundo: Ukubhalisa ku-SACSSP njengoMsebenzi Wezenhlalo. Isipiliyoni: Isigaba 1: Akukho okudingekayo ngemva kokubhalisa. Isigaba 2: Okungenani eminyakeni engu-10 yesipiliyoni esifanele somsebenzi Wezenhlalo ngemva kokubhalisa njengoMsebenzi Wezenhlalo ku-SACSSP. Isigaba 3: Okungenani eminyakeni engu-20 yesipiliyoni esifanele somsebenzi Wezenhlalo ngemva kokubhalisa njengoMsebenzi Wezenhlalo ku-SACSSP. Isigaba 4: Okungenani eminyakeni engu-30 yesipiliyoni esifanele somsebenzi Wezenhlalo ngemva kokubhalisa njengoMsebenzi Wezenhlalo ku-SACSSP. Isidingo sokwemukela umsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B/EB) evumelekile. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha kwi-MS Windows, Word, Excel, Outlook nokuhlakanipha ekusebenziseni izimiso zolwazi lwempilo ezisekweni lekhompyutha. Ikhono lokwenza ukuhlola okuphelele kobudondolo kanye nekwenza, ukuphatha, futhi kulawule izinhlelo zokungenelela. Ikhono lokuphatha amaqembu abaguli abasengozini ukuthi afinyelele ezimisweni ezifanele zokusekela emphakathini. Ikhono lokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo, lize libeke izinhloso eziyinhlophayoriti, futhi liqinise ukungenelela ngesikhathi esifanele. Amakhono amahle okuxoxa nokubhala ukuthuthukisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu eqembu elihlukahlukene ngezikhathi. Ulwazi ngemikhakha yomthetho.
zu.duties: Nikeza izinsiza zomsebenzi wezenhlalo ezingezwa ulwazi ngemikhakha kubafundi abangaphakathi, abangaphandle, nabo bayingane noma abanakekela emphakathini wonke kuso isimiso se-Rural East Ecosystem. Nikeza insiza yomsebenzi Wezenhlalo wetemhlengwa ngokuzimele kanye ngaphakathi kweqembu elihlukene emikhakahlukeni. Yenza kube lula ukufinyelela emithonjeni yomphakathi kanye nezinsiza zokusekela. Yenza kube lula ukuthumela kumnyango wezenhlalo, izinhlangano ezingezwa ngaphansi kukahulumende, izinhlangano ezisekelwe umphakathi, kanye nananyunye ezinye izinsiza kahulumente ezibalulekile. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhlonishwa umthetho othinteka, izinqubo, kanye namagugu okuziphatha ohlakeni lomsebenzi wezenhlalo. Gcina isimiso esifanele sokuphatha kwaye ulawule ngokusebenza imithombo ephisikayo ehlotshaniswa nokuqashwa kwenza inkonya, izicelo zokungcwabelwa kwabampofu, izicelo zasekhaya labadala, kanye nakho konke okunye okuthunyelwe emphakathini. Ukuqedwa kwakhoFomu 22 mayelana nokushiywa kwesibhedlela kanye nokunganakwa kwabantwana abancane. Hlola izindawo ezingathuthukiswa izinga bese usize kakhulu ukuthuthukisa ukunakekelwa kwabaguli nokuqashwa kwemisebenzi.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Wentsalo Inqanaba 1 ukuya kwi-4
xh.summary: Kufunwa umsebenzi wentlalo eGeorge Regional Hospital ukunika iinkonzo zobuntlalo ezibodlwa kubaguli, Omaphaya kunye nababanjwa ngabo kulo lonke iRural East Ecosystem.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezinciniseleyo: Isifanelekiso esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Council for Social Services Professions (SACSSP) njengomsebenzi wentlalo. Ukubhalisa koluntu olunesipili: Ukubhalisa kwiSACSSP njengomsebenzi wentlalo. Isipili: Inqanaba 1: Akukho nto emva kokubhalisa. Inqanaba 2: Okungaphantsi kweenyanga ezili-10 ezifanelekileyo zesipili kumsebenzi wentlalo emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wentlalo kwiSACSSP. Inqanaba 3: Okungaphantsi kweenyanga ezili-20 ezifanelekileyo zesipili kumsebenzi wentlalo emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wentlalo kwiSACSSP. Inqanaba 4: Okungaphantsi kweenyanga ezili-30 ezifanelekileyo zesipili kumsebenzi wentlalo emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wentlalo kwiSACSSP. Iimfuno ezinqamlezileyo zomsebenzi: Ilayisenisi yokushayela (Code B/EB) esemthethweni. Amandla okwenza umsebenzi (ulwazi/izakhono): Ulwazi lokusebenza ngakompyutha kwi-MS Windows, Word, Excel, Outlook nesikolo kwiinkqubo zolwazi lwempilo ezikwikhompyutha. Amandla okwenza ukulinganisa okupheleleyo kwezobuntlalo nokuyila, ukusebenzisa, nokulawula iindlela zengenelelo. Amandla okuphatha amaqela abaguli abasengozini ukuba bafikelele kwiinkqubo zoxhaso zentsalo ezifanelekileyo. Amandla okuphatha iimeko ezingxamisekileyo, ukubeka izinto ngokwakhemba, nokwenza ukuba iingenelo zenziwe ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Isakhono esilulo sokuthetha nokuvelisa esibhalwe phantsi ukwenza lula ukuthethana phakathi kwamalungu eqela elahlukeneyo lwemisebenzi. Ulwazi lweenkqubo ezisemthethweni.
xh.duties: Nika iinkonzo zabasebenzi bentsalo ezingummandla abagulayo abalaliswayo, abangalaliswayo, namaphaya abo okanye ababanjwa ngabo kulo lonke i-Rural East Ecosystem. Zenza inkonzo yeClinical Social Work uzimele nangaphakathi kwindawo eseza iqela elahlukeneyo lwemisebenzi. Yenza lula ukufikelela kwimithombo yoluntu kunye neenkonzo zoxhaso. Yenza lula ukudluliselwa kwisebe lezentshukumo yoluntu, iintshaba ezahlukeneyo, iintshaba ezisekelwe kuluntu, nakwezinye iinkonzo zahulumeni ezifanelekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuthobela imithethonkqubo, iindlela zokwenza, neemigangatho yokuziphatha ebalawula inkqubo yomsebenzi wobuntlalo. Gcina inkqubo efanelekileyo yolawulo kwaye ulawule ngokusebenza kakuhle imithobo ebonakalayo edibana neenkonzo zokuhlanjwa kwezintso, izicelo zokungcatshwa kwabafileyo, izicelo zasekhaya labadala, nazo zonke ezinye izicelo ezidluliselwa kuluntu. Ukuqediswa kweFomu 22 ukubaleka kwabaguli nokungalaleli abantwana. Phawula iindawo ezifuna ukuphuculwa kwaye usebenzise iinkqubo ukuphucula ukhathalo lwabaguli nemiqobo.

Experience: Appropriate experience in the repair and maintenance of medical and related hospital equipment. Good verbal and written communication skills. Computer literacy. Ability to resolve technical problems with accuracy. Knowledge of and ability to use of various tools (hand and power), including dedicated test equipment to carry out functions.
jobs.duties: Carry out maintenance and repairs of electronic hospital equipment. Perform acceptance and safety testing on equipment. Calibrate medical equipment. General administration duties as required by Clinical Engineering, write reports, specifications and keep records of departmental activities. Inter-act with hospital staff and private sector employees with regards to services and repairs. Handle general, everyday departmental queries.

af.title: Industrietegnikus Algemene Ingenieurswese Produksie
af.summary: Industrietegnikus benodig by Groote Schuur-hospitaal vir die instandhouding, herstel en kalibrering van elektroniese mediese toerusting; vereis 'n Nasionale Diploma in Elektriese, Elektroniese of Kliniese Ingenieurswese.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Nasionale Diploma in Elektriese, Elektroniese of Kliniese Ingenieurswese (T-, N- of S-stroom) of registrasie as 'n Ingenieurstegnikus ingevolge die Engineering Professions of South Africa Act, (Act 46 of 2000). Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in die herstel en instandhouding van mediese en verwante hospitaaltoerusting. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Vermoë om met handgereedskap en elektroniese toetstoerusting te werk. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis van mediese toerusting. Vermoë om foutopsporing en herstel van elektroniese hospitaaltoerusting tot op komponentvlak uit te voer. Kennis van gesondheids- en veiligheidsvereistes binne 'n tegniese omgewing. Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Vermoë om tegniese probleme akkuraat op te los. Kennis van en vermoë om verskeie gereedskap (hand- en kraggereedskap) te gebruik, insluitend toegewyde toetstoerusting om take uit te voer.
af.duties: Onderhoud en herstel van elektroniese hospitaaltoerusting uitvoer. Aanvaarding- en veiligheidstoetse op toerusting uitvoer. Mediese toerusting kalibreer. Algemene administratiewe pligte soos vereis deur Kliniese Ingenieurswese, verslae en spesifikasies skryf en rekords van departementele aktiwiteite hou. Met hospitaalpersoneel en privaatsektorwerknemers ten opsigte van dienste en herstelwerk skakel. Algemene, daaglikse departementele navrae hanteer.

zu.title: Industrial Technician General Engineering Production
zu.summary: Kudingeka i-industrial technician e-Groote Schuur Hospital ukugcina, ukulungisa nokulinganisa izinto zezokwelapha eze-elekthronikhi, kudingeka i-National Diploma kwi-Electrical, Electronics noma i-Clinical Engineering.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezingavunyelwe ukuba ngaphansi kwaleli zinga: i-National Diploma in Electrical, Electronics or Clinical Engineering (T, N or S Stream) noma ukubhaliswa njengo-Engineering Technician ngokwe-Engineering Professions of South Africa Act, (Act 46 of 2000). Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanele ekulungiseni nasekugcineni izinto zezokwelapha nezihlobene nalezo ezisetshenziswa esibhedlela. Izidingo ezele kulo msebenzi: Ikono elokusebenza ngezinsimbi zesandla nezinto zokuhlola eze-elekthronikhi. Amakhono (ulwazi/izikhono): Ulwazi ngezinto zezokwelapha. Ikono lokuthola izinkinga nokulungisa izinto zezibhedlela eze-elekthronikhi kuze kufike kwizinga le-component. Ulwazi ngemithetho yezenhlalo nokuphephile endaweni yobuchwepheshe. Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhala. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikono lokuxazulula izinkinga zobuchwepheshe ngokuningiliziwe. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukusebenzisa izinsimbi ezahlukene (zesandla namandla), kubandakanya izinto zokuhlola ezizimele ukuze kwenziwe imisebenzi.
zu.duties: Ukwenza ukugcinwa nokulungiswa kwezinto zezibhedlela eze-elekthronikhi. Ukwenza ukuhlolwa kokwamukela nokuqiniseka kwezinto. Ukulinganisa izinto zezokwelapha. Imisebenzi evamile yolawulo njengoba kudingwa i-Clinical Engineering, ukubhala imibiko, izinhloso nokugcina irekhodi yemisebenzi yomnyango. Ukuxhumana nabasebenzi basibhedlela nabasebenzi bomkhakha wangasese ngokuphathelene namasevisi nokulungiswa. Ukuphatha imibuzo yansuku zonke evamile yomnyango.

jobs.summary: Industrial technician needed at Tygerberg Hospital to maintain, repair and install anaesthetics and related medical equipment.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: National Diploma (T- N- or S- Stream) or a B-tech degree (or equivalent) in Mechanical / Mechatronics / Electronic / Electrical or Clinical Engineering. Experience: Appropriate practical experience in the repair and maintenance of equipment in a Clinical Engineering or other Engineering environment and be willing to be trained in-house on ongoing basis. Inherent requirement of the job: Candidate must have the ability to be trained or have experience to operate mechanical machinery i.e. lathe, milling machine, etc. as well as doing minor electronic/electrical repairs by making use of test equipment, i.e. a multi-meter. Active interest in Medical Equipment, like ventilators and anaesthetic machines and repair and servicing thereof. Willing and able to perform physically challenging work. Willing to perform any other task required by you, requested by Clinical Engineering management. Candidate must be willing to assist other technicians in different workshops within Clinical Engineering, if required from time to time. Valid Driver’s license Code B. Willing to work over-time if required. Willing to do stand-by duties and callouts if required. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Computer literacy (including excel and word). Proven ability in fault- finding and repair of equipment, including, but not limited to, anaesthetic machines, ventilators, suction units, blenders and other equipment maintained by Clinical Engineering Anaesthetic workshop. Good written and verbal communication. Candidates must have experience to manage, plan and organise maintenance schedules on equipment. Knowledge of the Occupational health and safety act 1993 and its relevant regulations. Understanding of what Clinical Engineering entails. -Basic knowledge of anaesthetic and respiratory life support equipment.
jobs.duties: Carry out maintenance, preventative maintenance, repairs and installation of related medical equipment. (Could be after hours or weekends). Liaise with clients and colleagues with regards to information and work progress. Ensure continuity of service by assisting other sections within CED, prioritising of work and agree to allocation of work due to operational requirements as determined by Clinical Engineering management. Write reports and assist with the drafting of specifications. Keep up to date records of equipment and activities including acceptance testing, marking and tracking. Ensure compliance with Occupational Health and Safety Act. Candidate must adhere to all legal requirements, protocols and procedures.

Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. af.title: Industriële Tegnikus Produksie (ANESTESIE /
af.summary: Industriële tegnikus by Tygerberg Hospital benodig om anestetiese en verwante mediese toerusting te onderhou, herstel en installeer.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Nasionale Diploma (T-, N- of S-Stroom) of 'n B-tech graad (of gelykwaardig) in Meganiese / Megatronika / Elektroniese / Elektriese of Kliniese Ingenieurswese. Ervaring: Toepaslike praktiese ervaring in die herstel en onderhoud van toerusting in 'n Kliniese Ingenieurswese- of ander Ingenieurswese-omgewing en bereid wees om op 'n deurlopende basis in-huis opgelei te word. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Kandidaat moet die vermoë hê om opgelei te word of ervaring hê om meganiese masjinerie te bedryf, d.w.s. draaibank, freesmasjien, ens., asook om klein elektroniese/elektriese herstelwerk te doen deur gebruik te maak van toetstoerusting, d.w.s. 'n multimeter. Aktiewe belangstelling in Mediese Toerusting, soos ventilators en anestetiese masjiene en die herstel en instandhouding daarvan. Bereid en in staat wees om fisies veeleisende werk te verrig. Bereid om enige ander taak te verrig wat deur Kliniese Ingenieurswese-bestuur van u verlang word. Kandidaat moet bereid wees om van tyd tot tyd ander tegnici in verskillende werkswinkels binne Kliniese Ingenieurswese te help, indien nodig. Geldige bestuurderslisensie Kode B. Bereid om oortyd te werk indien nodig. Bereid om wagbeurtpligte en oproepe te doen indien nodig. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Rekenaargeletterdheid (insluitend excel en word). Bewese vermoë in foutopsporing en herstel van toerusting, insluitend, maar nie beperk tot, anestetiese masjiene, ventilators, suig-eenhede, blenders en ander toerusting wat deur die Kliniese Ingenieurswese Anestetiese werkswinkel onderhou word. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie. Kandidate moet ervaring hê om instandhoudingskedules op toerusting te bestuur, te beplan en te organiseer. Kennis van die Beroepsgesondheids- en veiligheidswet 1993 en sy relevante regulasies. Begrip van wat Kliniese Ingenieurswese behels. -Basiese kennis van anestetiese en respiratoriese lewensondersteunende toerusting.
af.duties: Onderhoud, voorkomende onderhoud, herstelwerk en installasie van verwante mediese toerusting uitvoer. (Kan na ure of naweke wees). Liaise met kliënte en kollegas ten opsigte van inligting en werkvoortgang. Verseker kontinuïteit van diens deur ander afdelings binne CED te help, prioritisering van werk en instemming tot toewysing van werk weens operasionele vereistes soos bepaal deur Kliniese Ingenieurswese-bestuur. Verslae skryf en help met die opstel van spesifikasies. Op datum rekords hou van toerusting en aktiwiteite, insluitend aanvaardingstoetsing, merking en naspeuring. Verseker nakoming van die Beroepsgesondheids- en Veiligheidswet. Kandidaat moet aan alle wetlike vereistes, protokolle en prosedures voldoen.

zu.title: Indlela yokusebenza yobuchwepheshe bemvelo (ANAESTHETICS /
zu.summary: Kudingeka umuntu wobuchwepheshe bemvelo e Tygerberg Hospital ukugcina, ukulungisa nokufaka izibuko ezihlobene nokwelapha ngenaliti kanye nezinye izikhali zokwelapha.
zu.requirements: Izifundo eziyingqayizivele eziyisidingo: National Diploma (T- N- or S- Stream) noma i-B-tech degree (noma okulingana nayo) ku-Mechanical / Mechatronics / Electronic / Electrical noma i-Clinical Engineering. Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanele sokulungisa nokugcina izibuko endaweni yobunjineli bokwelapha noma enye indawo yobunjineli kanye nokuba waziwe ukuthola uqeqesho ngaphakathi ngokuhlala njalo. Isidingo esingaphakathi kwomsebenzi: Kumele umuntu akwazi ukuqeqeshwa noma abe nesipiliyoni sokuphatha izinsimbi zomshini ezinjengelathi, izibuko zokushayela, njll. kanye nokwenza Izilungiso ezincane zikagesi/uqingo ngokusebenzisa izibuko zokuhlola, njengesibuko sokulinganisa ngokubanzi. Ukukhanga ngomzwela kwezikhali zokwelapha, njengezikhali zokuphefumula nokwelapha ngenaliti nokuzilungisa nokuzigcina. Ubulunge futhi ukwazi ukwenza umsebenzi onzima ngokomzimba. Ubulunge ukwenza noma yimuphi umsebenzi omunye odingekayo kuwe, oceliwe ngabaphathi be-Clinical Engineering. Kumele umuntu abe waziwa ukusiza abanye abobuchwepheshe emagumbini ahlukene ngaphakathi kwe-Clinical Engineering, uma kunesidingo ngezinye izikhathi. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile i-Code B. Ubulunge ukusebenza ngemva kwezinsuku uma kudingeka. Ubulunge ukwenza imisebenzi yokuma ngemuva futhi ukwenza ukubizwa uma kudingeka. Amandla (ulwazi/ikhono): Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (kuhlanganise i-excel ne-word). Ikhono eliveziwe ekutholeni iziphazamisi nokulungisa izibuko, kuhlanganise, kodwa lingaqinelisiwa, izikhali zokwelapha ngenaliti, izikhali zokuphefumula, amayunithi okususa, ama-blender namanye amayunithi agcinwa yi-Clinical Engineering Anaesthetic workshop. Ukuxhumana okuhle ngokubhala nangokukhuluma. Kumele abantu abafaka izicelo babe nesipiliyoni sokuphatha, ukuhlela nokuqamba izinhlelo zokugcina izibuko. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Occupational health and safety act 1993 nemithesho yakho ehlobene. Ukuqonda ukuthi i-Clinical Engineering ithini. -Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngamaphoyinti okwelapha ngenaliti nokuphefumula.
zu.duties: Ukwenza ukugcwaliswa, ukugcina ukuthintela izinkinga, ukulungisa nokufaka izibuko zokwelapha ezihlobene nalokhu. (Kungaba ngemuva kwamahora noma nangamasonto). Xhumana nabathengi nabadlangile ngokwaziswa nentuthuko yomsebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuqhubeka kokwenziswa ngokusiza izingxenye ezinye ngaphakathi kwa-CED, ukuqamba kabusha umsebenzi nokuvumelana nokwabiwa komsebenzi ngenxa yezidingo zokusebenza njengokuqunywe ngabaphathi be-Clinical Engineering. Bhala imibiko futhi usize ekubhaleni izinkomba. Gcina amarekhodi ajwayelekile wezibuko nemisebenzi ehlanganisa ukuhlola ukwamukelwa, ukumaka nokulandelana. Qinisekisa ukuthikamezela ngomthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act. Kumele umuntu alandele yonke imithetho, amaphrotokholo nemicimbe enisidingo.

xh.title: Indlela yokuSebenza yoBuchwephesha bokuVelisa iinjongo (I-ANAESTHETICS /
xh.summary: Kufuneka indlela yamagcisa ochwephesha kwisiBhedlele saseTygerberg ukugcina, kulungise kwaye kufakelwe ipeleti zokubetha iinjongo nezinye izixhobo ezinxulumene nezonyango.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezingaphantsi: i-National Diploma (T- N- or S- Stream) okanye i-B-tech degree (okanye efanayo) kwi-Mechanical / Mechatronics / Electronic / Electrical okanye i-Clinical Engineering. Isiphiro: Isiphiro esifanelekileyo ngokwamava ekulungiseni nasekugcineni izixhobo kwindawo ye-Clinical Engineering okanye kolunye ukusingqongile kwe-Engineering kwaye ube ngowolulekayo ukuba ulunywelwelwe ngaphakathi ngokuqhubekayo. Imafundo afunwayo emsebenzini: Umthwali-magama kufuneka akwazi ukulunywa okanye abe nesisiphiro sokusebenzisa izixhobo zomatshini ezinjengesilathi, i-milling machine, njl. Kanjalo nokwenza izilungiso ezincinci ze-electronic/electrical ngokusebenzisa izixhobo zovavabo, njenge-multi-meter. Ukuba nomdla kwezixhobo zonyango, njengee-ventilators ngeendawo zamaza amabele nokuzilungisa nokuzonkeleza. Ukolulekile kwaye unako ukwenza umsebenzi onzima ngaphezu komzimba. Ukolulekile ukwenza naliphi na elinye igcala elifunwa kuwe, elicelwa ngurhulumente we-Clinical Engineering. Umthwali-magama kufuneka abe ngowolulekayo ukuncedisaamagcisa ochwephesha kwizithili ezahlukileyo ngaphakathi kwe-Clinical Engineering, xa kufuneka ngamaxesha athile. ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo i-Code B. Ukolulekile ukusebenza ngaphezu kwexesha xa kufuneka. Ukolulekile ukwenza imisebenzi yokumila nokuqashelwa xa kufuneka. Iimpawu (ulwazi/izakhono): Ulwazi lwekhompyutha (kuquka i-excel nelayisi). Isakhono esibonakalisiweyo ekufumaneni isiphene nasekulungiseni izixhobo, kuquka, kodwa lingagqitywa kuko, iindawo zamaza amabele, ii-ventilators, ii-suction units, ii-blender nezinye izixhobo ezigcinwa yi-Clinical Engineering Anaesthetic workshop. Ilulwimi elilungileyo elibhalwayo nelothethwayo. Abathwali-magama kufuneka babe nesisiphiro sokulawula, ukuqamba iindaba nokuhlela iindululo zokugcina izixhobo. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Occupational health and safety act 1993 nangemimiselo yawo. Ukuqonda ngokubaluleka kwe-Clinical Engineering. -Ulwazi olusemva ngamapeleti okusinda nokuphefumla.
xh.duties: Ukuqhutywa kokugcina, ukugcina ngenjongo yokuthintela, ukulungisa nokufakela izixhobo ezinxulumene nezonyango. (Kunokwenzeka emva kweeyure okanye ngeekwezinduvo). Ukuqhathanisa nabojaxabayo nabo basebenza ngqo ngenkcazelo nangonyuko lomsebenzi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuqhutywa kolwazi ngokuncedisa amanye amacandelo ngaphakathi kwe-CED, ukubeka phambili umsebenzi nokuvuma ukwabiwa komsebenzi ngenxa yeemfuno zokuqhutywa njengoko kugqitywa ngurhulumente we-Clinical Engineering. Ukubala iingxelo nokuncedisa ekubhalweni iinkcazelo. Ukuze zigcinwe iirekhedi ezizamkelwayo ngenkcazelo ngemisebenzi kuquka ukuvavanya nokuvuma, ukumaka nokuvela. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela umthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act. Umthwali-magama kufuneka athobele onke izinto ezifunwa ngumthetho, iiprotocol nendlela zokwenza izinto.

OF 'n 4-jarige bachelorsgraad in verpleging (R174) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R1497 of R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Profesionele Verpleegster moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as Profesionele Verpleegster. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare verplegingservaring na registrasie by die SANC as Profesionele Verpleegster in Algemene Verpleging. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie by die SANC as Profesionele Verpleegster in Algemene Verpleging. Inherente vereistes van die pos: Geldige (kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om mobiele eenheid te bestuur wanneer vereis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis en insig van relevante wetgewing en beleid verwant aan verpleging binne die openbare sektor en basiese rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Word, Excel en Outlook) om te kan kommunikeer, pasiëntinligting vas te lê, resultate te kontroleer, data vas te lê en verwysings op die verskillende elektroniese stelsels te doen en op te spoor. Vermoë om gehalte pasiëntsorg deur die implementering van protokolle, riglyne en standaarde te bevorder.
af.duties: Behandeling van pasiënte op Primêre Gesondheidsorg vlak met betrekking tot Kuratiewe Dienste, d.w.s. Meldbare Siektes, Geestesgesondheid en Chroniese Siektes. Gee rigting en toesig vir die implementering van gehalte omvattende verplegingsorg binne die PHC konteks. Handhaaf etiese praktyk binne regs- en regulasieraamwerke. Handhaaf 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met alle relevante belanghebbendes van die PHC span. Benut menslike, materiële en fisiese hulpbronne doeltreffend en effektief. Neem deel aan opleidingsprogramme en navorsingsaktiwiteite. Handhaaf werksplekdissipline van ondergeskiktes.

zu.title: Unesi Othwebulekile Izinga 1 kuye ku-3 (General Nursing: PHC)

Noma idigri yeminyaka emine yobudlule (R174) noma isifundo esilinganayo (R683 okanye R1497 noma R171 okanye R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengenesi Othwebulekile. Ukubhalisa eqhilipha emthethweni: Ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengenesi Othwebulekile. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho Izinga 2: Isipiliyoni esingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-10 ngemva kokubhalisa kwi-SANC njengenesi Othwebulekile ku-General Nursing. Izinga 3: Isipiliyoni esingaphansi kweminyaka engu-20 ngemva kokubhalisa kwi-SANC njengenesi Othwebulekile ku-General Nursing. Izidingo zomsebenzi ngokwemvelo: Ilayisensi yokushayela (ikhandi B/EB) esebenzayo. Ukuza ngesithembiso sokushayela imoto yesikhungo ngenkoma kudingeka. Ukuzazi kahle (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi nokuqonda ngemithetho neminqango ngokwezempilo ngaphakathi komnyango kahulumeni nokwazi kahle ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha (MS Word, Excel kanye ne-Outlook) ukuze ukwazi ukuxhumana, ukubhalisa izinkomba zomuntu, ukuthola imiphumela, ukuthumela imininingwane kanye nokwenza ukulandwa kweminikelo ezinhlebhini zikagesi ezahlukene. Ukuzakhondo ekukhweni izinga lezempilo emphakathini ngokusetshenziswa kumthetho, imiqondo nezindingo.
zu.duties: Ukwelapha iziguli ezingeni le-PHC ngokumayelana nemisebenzi yokwelapha, okungukuthi. Izifo ezenzelwa umyalezo, Izenzelo ngekhanda okanye ngengqondo nezifo ezingapheli. Ukunika imiqondo nokugcina ngokuphathwa kwezempilo ekugcineni izinga le-PHC. Ukugcina imisebenzi ngezikhumulo ngaphakathi komthetho. Ukugcina ubudlelwano obuhle kwezomsebenzi kwaye uzenze ngokusebenzisana nabanomdlandla kwiqembu le-PHC. Ukusebenzisa abantu, izinto zomsebenzi nendalo yomsebenzi ngeendlela ezifanele. Ukungenisa izinhlelo zokuqeqesha nokwenza ucwaningo. Ukugcina isithibekelo kubasebenzi abangaphansi kwakhe.

Ukubonelela ngolawulo lolungelelwano lokusebenza ngokunyanga ngokubanzi ngokuchanekileyo ngaphakathi kweNqobo ye-PHC. Ukugcina ukusebenza ngokwenyaniso ngaphakathi kwemithetho nemigaqo. Ukugcina idibaniso elilungileyo lokusebenza nabo bonke abantu ababalulekileyo beqela le-PHC. Ukusebenzisa izixhobo ezithileyo, iimpahla nezinto ezingokomzimba ngokusebenza kakuhle nangokugqitha. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zokuqeqesha nokusingathwa kophando. Ukugcina ulawulo lwendalo yabaphansi ababekwayo.

jobs.title: Occupational Therapist Grade 1 to 3 (NEUROLOGY,
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R309 840 per annum Grade 2: R361 875 per annum Grade 3: R423 618 per annum
jobs.summary: Occupational Therapist Grade 1 to 3 sought at Tygerberg Hospital to provide assessment and occupation-based treatment in neurology.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows for registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Occupational Therapist. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as Occupational Therapist. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA as Occupational Therapist in respect of RSA qualified employees. 1-year relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as Occupational Therapist in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as Occupational Therapist in respect of RSA qualified employees. A Minimum of 11 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as Occupational Therapist in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as Occupational Therapist in respect of RSA qualified employees. A minimum of 21 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as Occupational Therapist in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Experience in Neurology, Neurosurgery and Adult Psychiatry Occupational therapy. Intermediate and advance seating experience. Splinting experience. Experience in student training/supervision. Sound knowledge of relevant national, provincial legislation and various physical conditions. Good interpersonal, organizational, and planning abilities. Able to work well within a team. Good communication skills (written and verbal).
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be required to deliver an effective and efficient occupational therapy service in the above-mentioned clinical areas that may include (but is not limited to) the following: Conducting comprehensive assessments and occupation-based treatment. Performing basic, intermediate and advanced seating assessments for wheelchair users. Fabrication and prescription of various upper and lower limb splints. Measurement and fabrication of pressure garments. Executing appropriate discharge plans in accordance with departmental procedures. Independent case management through attendance of ward- rounds and multi-disciplinary meetings (where applicable). Contribute to management of physical resources in Occupational Therapy Department. Provision of OT student training.
jobs.enquiries: Ms S Ngemntu Tel No: (021) 938-5062
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration as Occupational Therapist with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. af.title: Ergoterapeut Graad 1 tot 3 (NEUROLOGIE,

Die uitvoer van basiese, intermediêre en gevorderde sitplek-assesserings vir rolstoelgebruikers. Vervaardiging en voorskrif van verskeie boonste en onderste lid-spalke. Meting en vervaardiging van drukkledingstukke. Die uitvoer van toepaslike ontslagplanne in ooreenstemming met departementele prosedures. Onafhanklike gevalbestuur deur bywoning van saalrondtes en multidissiplinêre vergaderings (waar van toepassing). Bydrae tot bestuur van fisiese hulpbronne in die Ergoterapie-departement. Verskaffing van OT-studente-opleiding.

zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi kakhulu: Iziqu ezifanelekile ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoTherapist Womsebenzi. Ukubhalisa kwi-bhodi yomuntu osebenza ngobuchwepheshe: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoTherapist Womsebenzi. Isiphoqhwa: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekayo emva kokuqashwa kwi-HPCSA njengoTherapist Womsebenzi kubasebenzi abathole iziqu eRSA. Unyaka oyedwa wokuhlangenwe nakho okuhambisana nendima emva kokuqashwa kwi-HPCSA njengoTherapist Womsebenzi kubasebenzi abathole izakuvalo, okungadingeki ukuba benze umsebenzi wentambama, njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 2: Ucingo lokuqala lwe-10 unyaka ukuhlangenwe nakho emva kokuqashwa kwi-HPCSA njengoTherapist Womsebenzi kubasebenzi abathole izakuvalo eRSA. Izinga 3: Ucingo lokuqala lwe-20 unyaka wokuhlangenwe nakho emva kokuqashwa kwi-HPCSA njengoTherapist Womsebenzi kubasebenzi abathole izakuvalo eRSA. Amakhono (ulwazi/izikhali): Isiphoqhwa kwi-Neurology, i-Neurosurgery kanye ne-Psychiology yabadala komsebenzi wokwelapha. Isiphoqhwa sokuhlola amakhiye ezinga eliphakathi nelifana. Isiphoqhwa sokwenza ama-splint. Isiphoqhwa sokufundisa/bhekisa abafundi. Ukuqonda kahle ngemithetho yesizwe nesiswati kanye nezimo zomzimba ezahlukene. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana,oku hlela, kanye nokuqamba izinhlelo. Ukwazi ukusebenza kahle naphakathi kwenqaba. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana (okuqamba nokuqamba).
zu.duties: Umuntu ohlolwe ukube umenzi wokugqiba uzodingeka ukuletha insiza yomsebenzi wokwelapha evela emandla kwezindawo ezivezwe ngaphezulu ezifaka phakathi (kodwa ezingagqidi) okulandelayo: Ukwenza ukuhlola okujulile kanye nokwelapha okusekelwe emsebenzini. Ukwenza ukuhlola amakhiye abathanda izihlalo ezinga eliphansi, eliphakathi nelifana kubasebenzisi bezihlalo ezinganawo. Ukwenza nokubeka phambili ngokufaka izandla ngezansi kwezinye izandla ezingenawo izandla ezingezansi. Ukulinganisa nokwenza izingubo zokuqinisa. Ukuphumeza izinhlelo zokuqedisa ngokulandelwa kwemithetho yeminyango. Ukuphatha izicala ngokuzimela ngokubakhona kwamasentimimenti kanye nemihlangano yezingxenye eziningi (lapho kufanele khona). Ukusekela ukuphatwa kwemithombo yomsebenzi eNyuvesi yomsebenzi weTherapy Womsebenzi. Ukunikezwa kokufundisa abafundi be-OT.

Ukunikela ngokulawulwa kwezinto ezizimo ngokwabantu kwisebe lokoTherapist weMisebenzi yeNkqubo. Ukunika isifundo sabafundi se-OT.

jobs.summary: Pharmacist Assistant (Post Basic) Grade 1 to 3 position at Caledon Hospital in the Theewaterskloof Sub-district, Western Cape.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) as a Pharmacist’s Assistant (Post Basic) Institutional or Pharmacist’s Assistant (Post Basic). Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SAPC as Pharmacist’s Assistant (Post-Basic) or Pharmacist’s Assistant (Post- Basic) (Institutional). zu.title: Usiza-isokhulu (POST Basic) Grade 1 to 3
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba ngusiza-isokhulu (Post Basic) Grade 1 to 3 esibhedlela iCaledon Hospital endaweni yaseTheewaterskloof Sub-district, Western Cape.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esingaphansi kwaleso esidingekile: Udidi lwemfundumlandu oluvumela ukubhaliswa kulandwa kwesifunda sezokwelapha iSouth African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) njengosiza-isokhulu (Isilingo Esisekelo) Esikhungweni noma njengosiza-isokhulu (Isilingo Esisekelo). Isibhalo kulandwa kwesifunda: Ukubhaliswa ku-SAPC njengosiza-isokhulu (Isilingo Esisekelo) noma njengosiza-isokhulu (Isilingo Esisekelo) (Esikhungweni). Isipitho: Isigaba 1: Akukho okumele kwenzeke emva kubhaliswa ku-SAPC njengosiza-isokhulu (Isilingo Esisekelo). Isigaba 2: Okungenani iminyaka engu-5 yokuba uhambisana nemithwalo yamaphili noma ufunde ukuba ngusiza-isokhulu (Isilingo Esisekelo) kwa-SAPC. Isigaba 3: Okungenani iminyaka engu-13 yokuba uyaphila futhi ufake amandla emisebenzi engahle ilingane nokuba ngusiza-isokhulu (Isilingo Esisekelo) kwa-SAPC. Izidingo ezingenakuphikiswa ekusebenzeni: Ukuba nelayisensi yokushayela okugunyaziwe. Ukuzwela ukuba ungasebenze isikhathi esinde uma kunesidingo. Izinkomba (ulwazi/iziqu): Inkinga yokusebenza kodwa kufanele usebenze nobuntu obuveza umsebenzi ohlukene owodwa ngawodwa, noma ubuhle bokuba ungumuntu osetha amateyasha amaningi ukuze ukhule futhi ubenomthelela ekunakekelweni kwesiguli nemindeni yayo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhaphetha ethuthukisa ulwazi (MS Office: Word, Excel, PowerPoint kanye ne-Outlook) kanye nokubonisa ukuzisola nokwazi ukusebenzisa inkundla yokwelapha eyisikhuthazo (JAC/WellSky) ukuze alungiselele imikhiqizo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa imikhiqizo yezokwelapha okukhona emthethweni, umthetho nokuqashwa komthetho wokuvela komuntu oqashwe ngemigqa yesikhungo ukuthi uyisebenzise kanjani emsebenzini wakhe. Ukwazi ukuhlunga imikhiqizo ehlobene nezokwelapha nangamathuluzi abo emithethweni yesikhungo, okuhlanganisa ukuhlela nokugcina ukutholakala kwemikhiqizo phakathi komzila onqamule izinhlelo eziyisikhuni ezisemthethweni zokusebenza kahle nokuba nezigaba ezilungile, ukuze kusebenze kahle nangokunembile imithetho yokugcina imikhiqizo. Ukwazi imithetho yezokwelapha, ukuze akwazi ukuqapha nokuhlela imikhiqizo yokwelapha phakathi kwesikhungo njengoba kumthetho wezokwelapha (Medicines Act 101 of 1965), umthetho wezokwelapha (Pharmacy Act 53 of 1974) kanye nomthetho wezimali kahulumuki (Public Finance Management Act). Ukuba nomphumela wobuholi obuhle, bokuxhumana nokukwazi ukuqinisekisa amandla okuphendula izinkinga ezenzeka kwezinye izinduna ezikuleli. Ukuba nomthelela ekucubunguleni, ekuphatheni kwesikhathi, ekubambe umthetho, ekuxazululeni izinkinga, ekwakheni izinto ezintsha, ekusebenzeni ngokunembile ngaphansi kwezinkinga nokuba noma ngabe usebenza ngomoya wokuba ngumuntu ongathathi ihubi nokuthula.
zu.duties: Msiza ekulawulen nasekunikeni ngempumelelo imikhiqizo yamakhemikhali. Msiza ekwenzeni ngokunembile, ukushintshwa noma ukukhiqizwa kwezidakamizo ezingcolile noma izindikimba ezihleliwe. Msiza ekulawuleni nasekukhandweni kahle kwesitokhwe sezokwelapha emikhakheni ohlinzeka ngayo ukuze kwethwelwe kabusha isitokhwe. Sekela futhi usize umphathi wesikhungo sezokwelapha ekubhaleni ulwazi, ekuqwalasisen imininingwane, ekuqoqweni izibalo, ekunikeni ulwazi nasemiholweni yansuku zonke yomnyango wezokwelapha, okuhambisana nokuphendula imibuzo mayelana nezindaba ezokwelapha. Uyibhekelele ukulungiselelwa kwemibhalo yezidakamizo aze afube ekunikezweni kwemithi okuzosetshenziswa ngumuntu oyiguli ngaphansi kokugadwa sisokhulu njengoba kuchaziwe kumthetho wezokwelapha. Athathe kulesi sikhundla phakathi kwendawo ehlukene.

xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezingowona bambeni: Isifanelekiso esivumela ukubhaliswa kwibhunga leFama leSouth African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) njengoMncedisi weFama (Post Basic) Institutional okany ngoMncedisi weFama (Post Basic). Ukulungele ukusebenza ngaphezu kwexesha xa kuyimfuneko. Amandla (ulwazi/ikhono): Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimeleyo, nangaphakathi kwiqela elinabasebenzi bemimiselo eyahlukeneyo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa okuhle kwaguli. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Office: Word, Excel, PowerPoint neOutlook) kunye nokubonisa amava ekusebenziseni inkqubo yokunikela iyeza iJAC/WellSky. Ulwazi ngokuqhuba ngokulungileyo kweFama kunye nokuziphatha kwefama yesebe kunye namanyathelo ayo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yokulawula ukunikwa kwamayeza, kuquka ukulawula iqela elibandayo. Ulwazi olufanelekileyo ngamagunya empilo ezingawodwa walunion kunye nasephondo, uMtsetfo weZiyobisi 101 ka-1965, uMtsetfo weFama 53 ka-1974 kunye noMtsetfo woLawulo lweMali yoLuntu. Uqwalasela isiguli unesakhono esihle somanyano nobunyani, kuquka nakhono lokunxibelelana nabanye oogqirha abanakekela impilo. Ikhono lokucwangcisa, ulawulo lwexesha olusebenzayo, ukwenzela iziqinisekiso, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukuyilwa intsha ukuba yinto, ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo ngaphantsi koxinzelelo nokugcina uphawu oluphakamileyo lobugcisa. Ikhono lokwenzela iziqinisekiso kwimisebenzi enikiweyo kuquka namabuzo ahambelana namayeza. Ulwazi ngereferensi yokunika amayeza isifo esahlala ixesha elide, esinxulumene nesebe lezeMpilo eWestern Cape.
xh.duties: Nceda ekulawuleni ngokusebenzayo kunye nokunikwa iimveliso zamayeza. Nceda ekuyileni ngokuchanekileyo, ekulungeniseni okanye ekwenzeni eyamayeza engaphelelanga okanye isixobo esijolise ngomthetho. Nceda ekulawuleni ngokusebenzayo kunye nokusatyalweni amayeza kumacandelo angaphakathi kwesikhululo ukuzalisekiswa kwamayeza. Xhasa uncede umphathi weFama ngokubamba iidata, ukugcina iirekhodi, ukuqokelela izibalo, ukunika inkcazelo kunye nokuqhuba yonke imihla yesebe lefama, kuquka nokusombulula amabuzo amayeza. Nyamezela ukulungiselelwa kwemithi yokugqibela uncede ekunikweni amayeza kusetyenziswa ngumntu ngamnye osiguli ngaphantsi kolawulo oluthe ngqo lomnyathi wefama njengoko kubekiweyo kuMtsetfo weFama. Ndibale emisebenzini kwinginginya engaphakathi.

xh.title: Umncedi Wezamayeza (POST Basic) Inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3
xh.summary: Isithuba somncedi wezamayeza post-basic kwiziko elingapheli lase-Stellenbosch, ukunceda ekunikwenzweni konikezelo lwezinzulu ezimali nezamayeza kunye nolawulo lokunikwa kwamayeza kwiiqonga ezahlukeneyo zesixa sokusuka kwinqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezincitshisiweyo: Njengoko kufunwa isikhululo sokuzilolonga kunye ne-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) kunye nelayisensi yomncedi wezamayeza (Post Basic) evumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SAPC njengomncedi wezamyeza (Post-Basic) (Ezikolweni) okanye umncedi wezamayeza (Post-Basic). Ukubhaliswa kolungiselelo lweengcali: Ukubhaliswa kwangoku kwi-SAPC njengomncedi wezamayeza (Post-Basic) okanye umncedi wezamayeza (Post-Basic) (Ezikolweni). Imfundo/ngqondo: Inqanaba 1: Akukho ntseba yokubhaliswa kwi-SAPC njengomncedi wezamayeza (Post-Basic). Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane leminyaka engama-5 yamava alungileyo njengomncedi wezamayeza emva kokubhaliswa njengomncedi wezamayeza (Post-Basic) kwi-SAPC. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane leminyaka elingama-13 yamava alungileyo njengomncedi wezamayeza emva kokubhaliswa njengomncedi wezamayeza (Post-Basic) kwi-SAPC. Iimfuno zangaphakathi zenkonzo: Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B/EB) esemthethweni. Ukuzimisela ukwenza imisebenzi yasemva kwamahora rhoqo. Amandla (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Office: Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook). Amandla okusebenza ngokuchanekileyo ngaphantsi kwengcinezelo nolawulo lolwazi oluphezulu lobungcali. Amandla okusebenza kwiqela elinabochwepheshe abahlukeneyo anamakhono amanitshisi okubonana nabantu nokunxibelelana. Ulwazi olufanelekileyo malunga namagazethu ezeMPilo ezeLwizwe nasePhondo, iMedicines Act 101 of 1965, iPharmacy Act 53 of 1974 kunye ne-Public Finance Management Act. Ulwazi olufanelekileyo lokusingatha kwezamayeza nolawulo lwebala. Ukucinga ngokuhlalutyo okutsha nayo nendlela yokunceda ekusingatheni, ulawuleni, nasekugcineni inkqubo.
xh.duties: Inceda ekunikezeleni ngezinzulu ngokwemithetho nakubungela bemisebenzi. Inceda ekulawuleni amayeza (ukwamkela, ukugcina, ukulawula nokusasaya amayeza) kuquka nokulawula unxibelelwano lokugcina amayeza abanda kuzo zonke iindawo zokugcina amayeza. Inceda ekunikezeni iinkcukacha ezimalunga nempilo, inikezelo malunga nokusetyenziswa nendlela yokugcina amayeza. Inceda ekulawuleni ukuphela kwendlela yokusetyenziswa kweempahla. Ukuzinikela kumagazethu nokuqinisekiswa kwemithetho kunye neengqondiso ze-Good Pharmacy Practice. Inceda oogqirha bezamayeza ngeenkqubo ze-Chronic Dispensing Unit (CDU).

jobs.title: Administration Clerk: Support (MEDICO Legal Services)
jobs.summary: Administration clerk needed at Groote Schuur Hospital in Observatory to provide administrative support, reception services, and manage records for medico-legal services.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Grade 12 (Senior Certificate or equivalent qualification). Experience: Appropriate experience in a Medico Legal environment. Appropriate office administration experience. Appropriate experience in client care. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good planning; organisational; interpersonal and communication skills. Ability to meet deadlines. Knowledge of Clinicom. Ability to compile stats and draft reports. Knowledge of Electronic Content Management (ECM). Knowledge of the POPI and PAIA Act. Undergo development courses. Computer literacy in (MS Word, Excel and Outlook).
jobs.duties: Deliver an effective and efficient administrative support and reception service. Office management and liaise with external and internal clients. Create, register, update and manage databases and electronic management of records. Request and transfer patient folders via Clinicom. Process client/patient requests and prepare documents for completion by clinical staff in terms if RAF /WCA /SAPS and Insurance. Ensure timeous submission of statistical data, as well as collate and compile monthly report and statistical data. Provide assistance to Supervisor and HOD.
jobs.enquiries: Mr K Stevens Tel No: (021) 404 3238
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the advert for the POST 37/287: Deputy Director: Manager Hospital Development (5/8th Post) Directorate: Facilities and Infrastructure Management, Centre: Tygerberg Hospital, Redevelopment Office, Salary R582 684 (5/8th) per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual’s personal needs) advertised in the Public Service Vacancy 37 dated 16 October 2026, has been amended as follows: Deputy Director: Manager Hospital Development (5/8th Post) (3 Year-Contract) OTHER POSTS

af.title: Administrasieklerk: Ondersteuning (Medico-regsdienste)
af.summary: Administrasieklerk benodig by Groote Schuur Hospitaal in Observatory om administratiewe ondersteuning te bied, ontvangsdienste te verrig en rekords vir medico-regsdienste te bestuur.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Graad 12 (Senior Sertifikaat of equivalente kwalifikasie). Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in 'n Medico-regsomgewing. Toepaslike kantooradministrasie-ervaring. Toepaslike ervaring in kliëntesorg. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goed beplanning; organisatoriese; interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om sperdatums na te kom. Kennis van Clinicom. Vermoë om statistiek op te stel en verslae op te stel. Kennis van Electronic Content Management (ECM). Kennis van die POPI en PAIA-wet. Ondergaan ontwikkelingskursusse. Rekenaarvaardigheid in (MS Word, Excel en Outlook).
af.duties: Lewer 'n doeltreffende en effektiewe administratiewe ondersteunings- en ontvangsdien. Kantoorbestuur en skakel met eksterne en interne kliënte. Skep, registreer, werk en bestuur databasisse en elektroniese bestuur van rekords. Versoek en dra pasiëntlêers oor via Clinicom. Verwerk kliënt/pasiëntversoeke en berei dokumente voor vir voltooiing deur kliniese personeel ter sprake van RAF /WCA /SAPS en Versekering. Verseker tydige indiening van statistiese data, asook versamel en stel maandelikse verslag en statistiese data op. Verskaf bystand aan toesighouer en HOD.

zu.title: Clerk Wezobulungisi: Ukusekelwa (Izinsizakalo ze-MEDICO Legal)
zu.summary: Kudingeka ikhulu lezobulungisi esibhedlela i-Groote Schuur Hospital e-Observatory ukuze kutholwe ukusekelwa ngokobulungisi, izinsizakalo zokwamukela abantu, kanye nokuphatha amarekhodi ezinsizakalo ze-medico-legal.

Isipiliyoni esifanele sobulungisi be-ofisi. Isipiliyoni esifanele ekunakekelweni kwabathengi. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukubeka uhlelo okuhle; ukubumbene; amakhono obudlelwane nabantu nokuxhumana. Ikhono lokuhlangabeza izikhathi ezimisiwe. Ulwazi nge-Clinicom. Ikhono lokuhlanganisa izibalo nokubhala imibiko. Ulwazi ngokuLawulwa kokuQukathwa kwe-Elekthronikhi (ECM). Ulwazi ngemithetho ye-POPI ne-PAIA. Ukugcotshwa kwamakholo ezenzuzo. Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha ku-(MS Word, Excel ne-Outlook).
zu.duties: Nika ukusekelwa okusebenzayo nakusebenza kahle ngokobulungisi kanye nensizakalo yokuwamukela abantu. Uphathelela lofisi ube nexesha nabathengi bangaphandle nangaphakathi. Yakha, bhala, buyekeza uphathamse lezinto zencazelo yedatha kanye nokuhlanganisa nokuqamba inyanga yonke imibiko nedatha yesibalo. Nikeza usizo kuMqondisi nakuHOD.

xh.title: Clerk yolawulo: Inkxaso (Iinkonzo ze-MEDICO Legal)
xh.summary: Kufuneka i-clerk yolawulo kwi-Groote Schuur Hospital e-Observatory ukunika inkxaso yolawulo, iinkonzo zokwamkela, nokulawula irekhodi yezenkonzo ze-medico-legal.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingangangeli: I-Grade 12 (Isatifikethala esiphezulu okanye isifundo esilinganayo). Isipilo: Isipilo esifanelekileyo kwimodeli ye-Medico Legal. Isipilo esifanelekileko kolawulo lwe-ofisi. Isipilo esifanelekileko kukunakekelwa kwabathengi. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukuqamba okuhle; ukulungiselela; amakhono ongathathihanayo nokuqhathanisa. Isakhono sokugqiba umsebenzi ngexesha. Ulwazi lwe-Clinicom. Isakhono sokudidiyela iistats nokubhala iireports. Ulwazi lwe-Electronic Content Management (ECM). Ulwazi lwe-POPI ne-PAIA Act. Ukungena kwiklasi zophuhliso. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha kwi-(MS Word, Excel ne-Outlook).
xh.duties: Nika inkxabo yolawulo nereception ezisebenzayo nangcono. Ulawulo lwe-ofisi nokuqhagamshelana nabathengi bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Yila, bhalisa, hlaziya ulawulo lwedatabase nokulawula irekhodi ngekhompyutha. Cela kwaye udlulele iifoldi zabaguli nge-Clinicom. Sebenzisa iimfuno zabathengi/abaguli kwaye ulungise amaxwebhu ukuba agqitywe ngabasebenzi boluhlazo mayela ne-RAF /WCA /SAPS ne-Insurance. Qinisekisa ukuba idatha yestatistikuthi ithunyelwe ngexesha, kwaye qokelela udidiyela ireport yenyanga nidatha yestatistikuthi. Nike inkxaso kuSupervisor ne-HOD.
