zu.requirements: Izidingo ezincane zemfundo: I-Senior Certificate (noma efanayo) ine-Mathematics noma i-Accounting njengenhloko edlulile kanye/noma i-Senior Certificate (noma efanayo) nobungcweli/emisebenzi egxile kumagunya Okwenza ngendlela ehle (KPA) esikhundleni. Ukulungiselela amaqembu emigidingo yeminikelo eqenjini lomigidingo yeminikelo. Ukucubungula kanye nokushesha ngemibhalo yokuthenga. Ukucela imiginingo yezimpahla kanye namasevisi nge-EPS okungukuthi, ukuthengwa ngaphandle, amakhontrakti amancane, imibhalo exhunyiwe kanye nokuthenga ngamakhontrakti ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukubaluleka kokubonelelwa kwesitoki.

Bystand verleen met navorsing, verslagskrywing, samestelling en opdatering van statistieke verbonde aan die komponent se aktiwiteite. Lewer 'n wye verskeidenheid take wat begrotingsbeheer, hantering van klein kontantgeld, reis- en bestee-toelaes asook bystand met voorbereiding van spesiale projekte/bedrywighede insluit. Stel tentoonstellingsuitrusting op en breek dit af met betrekking tot verwante gebeurtenisse/projekte/programme/aktiwiteite van die komponent. Kantooradministrasie insluitend die beantwoording van telefone, algemene tik, rekordhouding, verspreiding en opsporing van dokumente. Hanterer die verkryging van al die komponent se vereistes. Stel notules van vergaderings op en versprei dit vir konsultasie met verskeie belanghebbendes (intern en ekstern).

zu.title: Iklerki kolawulo: Impilo, Ukuhlukahluka kanye NokuKhubazekayo
zu.summary: Iklerki kolawulo esinika inkxaso yezokuhlelela kumihlangano namakilasi oqeqesho eNdayishi ye Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness Head Office.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esingaphansi kwesidingo: Senior Certificate (noma okulinganayo). Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanele. Isidingo esingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ikono lokuhamba lonke isifundazwe. Amakhono (ulwazi/izikhombisi): Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Email). Ikono lokuxhumana ngempumelelo. Amakhono okuhlela futhi ahlele, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga ngendlela entsha. Amakhono abantu, amakhono ezibalo kanye namakhono okuhlaziya.
zu.duties: Nikeza inkxaso yezokuhlelela futhi wenze izinhlelo ezifanele njengokuqasha izindawo, ukuhlela ukuthutha kwe GG, ukupheka, amadokhumenti kanye nezinye izinto ezidingekayo emihlanganweni namakilasi oqeqeshweni njengoba kudingiwe. Siza ocwaningweni, ukubhala imibiko, ukuqoqa futhi ubuyekeze izibalo ezihlobene nemisebenzi yenhlangothi. Yenza umsebenzi ohlukahlukene ohlanganisa ukulawula izimali, ukuphatha imali encane, izifiso zokuhamba nokuhlala kanye nosizo ekulungeniseni izinhlelo/izenzakalo ezikhethekile. Misela futhi ukuqoqa izinto zokubonisa ezihlobene nezinhlelo/izenzakalo/izinhlelo zomsebenzi/imisebenzi yenhlangothi. Lawulo lezibhalo okuhlanganisa, ukuphendwa kwezocingo, ukuthayipha ngokujwayelekile, ukugcina amarekhodi, ukusatshaliswa kanye nokulandelwa kwamadokhumenti. Phatha ukuthenga konke okudingwayo kwenhlangothi. Bhala amaminithi emihlangano uwahambisele kuqondiswa kubantu abahlukahlukene abanomthelela (ngaphakathi nangaphandle).

xh.title: Clerk woLulawulo: Impilo, Uwahlukano nobukhwalImpofu
xh.summary: Clerk wolulawulo onika inkxaso yezophononongo lwezindlu kumatyala nabasebenzi bhenga kwiNqanaba leSebe leMpilo nokuPhila eNtshona Koloni.
xh.requirements: Igcadiso lemfuno yemfundo: Iqinisekiso lesidanga (okanye elilinganayo). Isiphaluka: Isiphaluka esifanelekileyo. Imfuno engaphakathi kwesithuba: Ukukwazi ukuhamba kuwo onke amagatya esiphaluka. Ikhono (ulwazi/isezincwadi): Ukuba nelwazi lweekhompyutha (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, nge-imeyile). Ukukwazi ukuqhuba isaz azisisebenzayo. Ikhono lokucwangcisa nokuhlela, ikhono lokuzibophelela kwimizamkeli entsha. Ikhono lokuqhathaniswa neenani nakuxwebhu lunye nalolu hlalutyo lwemigaqo.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yezophononongo kwaye udenze izicwangciso ezifanelekileyo ezinjengokulungela izindlu zokutyela, ulawule ithrekitha ze-GG, ukulungela ukutya, uxwebhu neminye imizekelo kumatyala nasekunyeni abasebenzi bhenga njengoko kufuneka. Nceda ngophando, okubhaliweyo kwiingxelo, ulungelelwaniso nokuhlaziya iisitathistikhisi ezidityaniswe nemisebenzi yegunya. Yenza iimisebenzi emininzi equka ulawulo lwemali, ukuphatha imali encinci, iinkqubo ezimala ukubakho komntu kunye nezifuneko zoku kwangisa kwelinye ixesha nasekwenziweni kweenkqubo ezibalulekileyo. Misela kwaye ukuhlakulele izixhobo zokubonisa ezinxulumene noko kubakho kwamanyathelo/amatyala/inkqubo/imisebenzi yegunya. Ulawulo lwezinhloko zolawulo lwesithuba okuquka ukuphendula iingxoxo ezinomntu wonke, ukubhala iingxoxo ngokubanzi, ukugcina izixa, ukusasaza nokulandelela iingxoxo ezinomntu wonke. Lawula ukulungiselela konke okufunwa yigunya. Bhala iingxoxo zemiyalezo yexesha elithile kwaye zenzele abantu abangenayo kule minikelo eyahlukene kwelinye iqela ecaleni kwelinye iinkqubo ngaphakathi kwakho nangaphandle kwakhe.

jobs.summary: Boiler operator needed at Groote Schuur Hospital to monitor industrial boilers, perform routine maintenance, and ensure compliance with occupational health and safety standards.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Grade 10 Certificate and an equivalent recognised valid National Steam Certificate. Experience: Appropriate experience working on large industrial boilers. Inherent requirements of the job: Must have an accredited qualification in the operation of coal fired steam boilers. Required to do standby duties, and work nightshift and overtime. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Ability to plan ahead (pro-active), work independently as well as in a team and it would be required for the officer to learn & comply with in-house systems & procedures. Strict adherence to the Occupational Health and Safety Act. Be able to work under-pressure and be willing to work shifts when required.
jobs.duties: Assist Artisan-Foreman with routine maintenance and repairs. Ensure adherence and compliance with Occupational Health standards and the Occupational Health and Safety Act. Ensure correct usage and flow of chemicals. Monitor boiler pressure in accordance with demand. Monitor the water/fuel level of the boiler. Perform administration functions.

zu.title: Umlawuli Weboyela (Indlu Yeboiler)
zu.summary: Kudingeka umlawuli weboyela esibhedlela iGroote Schuur Hospital ukuze abheke aboyela bembonakalo, enze izinsiza ezijwayelekile, futhi aqinisekise ukulandela izindinganiso zezempilo nokuphepha kwemisebenzi.
zu.requirements: Izindingo zemfundo ezingowezinye: Isitifikedi seGrade 10 nesitifiketi seNational Steam esamukelekayo nesasekhaya. Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyono esifanele sokusebenza kuboyela abakhulu bembonakalo. Izidingo ezingokwemvelo komsebenzi: Kumele abe nelayisensi emukelwa emsebenzini wokuphatha aboyela besithuthu abasebenza ngamalahle. Kudingeka akenze imisebenzi yokulalela, futhi asebenze ebusuku nasikhathi esengeziwe. Ikhono (ulwazi/izindlebe): Ikhono lokucabanga phambili (okusebenzayo), ukusebenza eyedwa kanye nangaphakathi kwethimba futhi kuzodingeka ukuthi umphathi afunde & alandele izinhlelo & izinqumo zendlini. Ukulandela ngokuqinileko umthetho weOccupational Health and Safety Act. Ukwazi ukusebenza ngokucindezeliwe futhi avume ukusebenza ngokujwayelekile lapho kudingeka.
zu.duties: Siza iArtisan-Foreman ngezinsiza ezijwayelekile nalokulungiswa. Qinisekisa ukulandela nokuhambisana nemigomo yezempilo kanye nomthetho weOccupational Health and Safety Act. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okufanele nokugeleza kwamakhemikhali. Bheka umfutho weboyela ngokuhlomula isidingo. Bheka izinga lamanzi/itshejielwa leboiler. Zenza imisebenzi yokuphatheka.

xh.title: Boiler Operator (BOILER House)
xh.summary: Kufuneka i-boiler operator eGroote Schuur Hospital ukulawula iiboiler zorhwebo, ukuhlala kuhlala unxibelelwano nokwenza imisebenzi, kwaye uqinisekise ukuthobela imigangatho yempilo yomsebenzi nokuKhuseleko.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi: Isatifikethi seGrade 10 kunye nesiQinisekiso seQondo seSteam samaZwe esamkelwayo nesiqinisekisiweyo. Isipilo: Isipilo esifanelekileyo sokusebenza kwiiboiler ezinkulu zorhwebo. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Kufuneka kubekho ngaphezu koko isifundo esiqinisekisiweyo ekusebenzeni kwiiboiler zomsi wamalahle. Kufunekile ukwenza imisebenzi yokulindela, ukusebenza ibusuku nakugqitha isikhathi. Ikhono (ulwazi/amazimahla): Ulwazi lokucwangisa ngaphambili, ukusebenza nosodwa nakwindyalo, kwaye kuya kufuneka kumgcinamafa aze afunde kwaye athobele iinkqubo nezendlela zangaphakathi. Ukuthobela ngokuqinileyo uMthetho weSempilo koMsebenzi nokuKhuseleko. Makakwazi ukusebenza ngoxindwa kwaye azimisele ukusebenza iishifti xa kufuneka.
xh.duties: Nceda uArtisan-Foreman ngokuhlala ngonxibelelwano nokulungisa. Qinisekisa ukuthobela nokuziphatha ngokwemigangatho yeSempilo koMsebenzi nokuMthetho weSempilo koMsebenzi nokuKhuseleko. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa okuchanekileyo nokuhamba kweekhemikhali. Qaphela umfutho weboiler ngokwesantlu esifunekayo. Qaphela izinga lamanzi/amafutha eboiler. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo.

af.title: Ambagsman-assistent (ELEKTRIES)
af.summary: Ambagsman-assistent (Elektries) by Groote Schuur Hospital wat ondersteuning bied met onderhoud, herstelwerk en installasies van aanleg, toerusting en geboue.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Graad 10 of gelykwaardig. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in algemene elektriese werk. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Bereidwilligheid om oortydpligte te verrig wanneer vereis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Basiese kennis van elektriese/meganiese ingenieurswese. Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Nakoeming van die Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid 1993 en sy toepaslike regulasies.
af.duties: Bystand aan ambagsmanne met onderhoud, herstelwerk en installasieprojekte van aanleg, toerusting en geboue van die hospitaal. Onderhou aanlegkamers, aanleg, toerusting en werkarea in 'n skoon en veilige toestand. Voltooi en retourneer herstelaanvrae en hou verder rekord van alle herstelwerk. Bystand met bestelling en beheer van die werkswinkel, materiaal en gereedskap. Oplei en ontwikkel personeel. Skoonmaak van areas waar werk gedoen is.

zu.title: Umsizi womculi (AMANDLA KAGESI)
zu.summary: Umsizi womculi (amandla kagesi) e-Groote Schuur Hospital ukusekela ukugcinwa, ukulungiswa nokufakwa kwezinhlelo zamandla kagesi, izinto zokusebenza nezakhiwo.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi kakhulu: IGrade 10 noma okulingana nayo. Isiphalazwe: Isiphalazwe esifanele emsebenzini jikelele wamandla kagesi. Isidingo esingokoqobo somsebenzi: Ukuzithoba ukwenza umsebenzi wehora edlule lapho kudingwa khona. Ukukhanya (ulwazi/izikhali): Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo. Ulwazi olusukelo ngobunjiniyela bamandla kagesi/njiniyela wamashini. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu kanye nokuxhumana komuntu nomuntu. Ukuziphatha ngomthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act 1993 nangemithetho ehlobene nawo.
zu.duties: Siza abadlali ngokugcina, ukulungisa kanye nezinhlelo zokufaka izinto zokusebenza, amathuluzi nezakhiwo zesibhedlela. Gcina amagumbi okusebenza, izinto zokusebenza nomkhakha wokusebenza ngesimo esihlanzekile nesiphephile. Qedela futhi ubuyisele izicelo zokulungisa futhi ugcine irekhodi yonke imilolongo. Sisa ekufuneni nokulawula isikhululo sokusebenza, izinto nezinsimbi. Hlola futhi uthuthukise abasebenzi. Hlanza izindawo lapho kwenziwe khona umsebenzi.

xh.title: Umncedi wenkosi yezandla (ELECTRICAL)
xh.summary: Umncedi wenkosi yezandla (Electrical) eGroote Schuur Hospital exhasa ukunyanga, ukulungisa nokuMisa izixhobo, iimpahla ngezakhiwo.
xh.requirements: Isigaba semfundo esingugqibelio: Grade 10 okanye esing ongelelo. Iimava: Iimava ezifanelekileyo kumsebenzi jikelele wezombane. Imfuno engaphakathi yomsebenzi: Ukuzithanda ukusebenza iiyure ezingaphezulu xa kufuneka. Iakhono (ulwazi/amabom): Ikkelo lokusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcindezelo. Ulwazi olusiseko lophando lwombane/njongo. Iakhono elungileyo lokunxibelelana nabantu. Ukuziphendamela koMthetho woPhondo lwezaNtle noKhuseleko ka-1993 nemigaqo yawo ahambelanayo.
xh.duties: Nceda iinkosi zezandla ekunyangeni, ukulungiseni nakuMiseni iiprojekthi zezi xhobo, iimpahla nezakhiwo zesibhedlele. Gcina iigumbi zezi xhobo, izixhobo, iimpahla nendawo yokusebenza zicocekile kwaye zikhuselekile. Gqiba ubuyisela iifomu zokuCelwa ukulungiswa uze ugcinire irekhodi yonke imilungiso. Nceda ekuyaleleni nokolawulweni kwentshimbi yokusebenzela, iimpahla nezixhobo. Qeqesha usaphuhlisa abasebenzi. Cosa iindawo apho kwenziwe khona umsebenzi.

Supervisory skills and optimal utilisation of sub-ordinates. Ability to perform routine structured tasks. Ability to adhere to safety standards.

Responsible for effective communication, overall control and organising of housekeeping tasks in a Health Facility. Effective utilization of resources (physical and financial). af.title: Huishoudingstoziender
af.summary: Hou tosig oor huishoudingspersoneel by Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital in Rondebosch, handhaaf skoonmaakstandaarde en bestuur maaltydvoorsiening vir pasiënte.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: General Education and Training Certificate (GETC)/Grade 9 (Std7). Ervaring: Toepaslike skoonmaker-/huishoudingsdienservaring. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Verplig om skofte, naweke, openbare vakansiedae en in ander departemente te werk. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om doeltreffend te kommunikeer. Toesighoudende vaardighede en optimale benutting van ondergeskiktes. Vermoë om roetine-gestruktureerde take uit te voer. Vermoë om by veiligheidsstandaarde te hou.
af.duties: Handhaaf 'n hoë standaard van skoonmaak en higiëne binne die hospitaal. Toesig en prestasiebestuur van die huishoudingspan. Verantwoordelik vir die voorsiening en opdiening van maaltye en drankies aan pasiënte en ouers. Verantwoordelik vir effektiewe kommunikasie, algehele beheer en organisering van huishoudingstake in 'n gesondheidsfasiliteit. Effektiewe benutting van hulpbronne (fisies en finansiële). Hanteer en verwyder huishoudelike en mediese afval. Beheer en reik linnevoorraad uit soos vereis. Toepassing van die dissiplinêre prosedures en konflikoplossing. Bystaan met die uitvoer van ad hoc-take binne die hospitaal.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezokuhlanzwa
zu.summary: Qaphela abasebenzi bezokuhlanzwa e Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital e Rondebosch, ugcine amazinga okuhlanzwa uphinde ulawule ukunikezwa kwesidlo sabesiguli.
zu.requirements: Isidingo sokuqala emfundweni: General Education and Training Certificate (GETC)/Grade 9 (Std7). Isiphefumulo: Okuhlobene nokuhlanzwa/nokwenza izinsizakalo. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Kuyadingeka ukusebenza amashifti, amasonto, amaholide omphakathi nasemap handle. Izindawo (ulwazi/izikhali): Ukuba nendlela yokuxhumana. Izikhali zokuqapha nokuphathwa kwabangaphansi kahle. Indlela yokwenza imisebenzi eqenjisiwe. Indlela yokuziphatha ngokuvikelekile.
zu.duties: Gcina izinga eliphakeme lokuhlanzwa nokuhlane e Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital. Qapha ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi yeqembu. Iyaqashelwa ekunikezeni nasekuletheni izidlo iziphuzo kubesiguli nasezibhelule. Iyaqashelwa ukuxhumana okuhle, ukulawula okujulile nokuhlela imisebenzi yokuhlanzwa. Ukusebenzisa okuhle okwemithombo. Uphatha futsi ukhwamenta insiza yomphakathi. Lawula futsi unike insiza yemigqaqulo njengoba kudingekwa. Sebenzisa izinqumo zokuqeqesha indlu yezindlu.

xh.title: Mlawuli Wokugcina Izindlu Ezingcono
xh.summary: Lawula abasebenzi bokugcina izindlu ezingcono eRed Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital eRondebosch, zigcina amanqanaba okococekileyo nolawulo lokunikezwa kwesidlo kubaguli.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingakananiyo: General Education and Training Certificate (GETC)/Grade 9 (Std7). Isipili: Esiphiwo ngokuhamba isipili somsebenzi wokucoca/ukugcina izindlu. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi womsebenzi: Kuyanyanzelekile ukusebenza iishewula, iintsuku zempuma, amaholide eilonke nakwamanye amasebe. Ukuzipatha (ulwazi/izakhono): Amandla okunxibelela ngokusebenzayo. Amandla okulawula nentunyamo elifanelekileyo labo abangaphantsi. Amandla okwenza imisebenzi eqhelekileyo eyisakhiwo. Amandla okulandela amanqanaba okhuseleko.
xh.duties: Gcina amanqanaba aphezulu okococekileyo nokhathalelo lwezifo ezithathelanayo ngaphakathi kwesibhedlele. Ulawulo lomsebenzi nobuntlola yomgangatho wesebe lokugcinwa kwezindlu ezingcono. Ukwakha ukuba ngumntu oqhetshelwe kukunikezwa nokukhonza iidiliya kunye neziselo kubaguli nabanini. Ukwakha ukuba ngumntu oqhetshelwe ekunxibelelanweni ngokusebenzayo, ulawulo jikelele nokuhlela imisebenzi yokugcina izindlu ezingcono kwisikhululo seenkzo. Ukusetyenziswa ngokusebenzayo kwezibonelelo (ezibonakalayo nezemali). Ukuqhuba nokususa inkunkuma yasekhaya nezonyango. Ulawula nokuphatha izinto zendlu ezidityaniswayo njengoko kufuneka. Ukusebenzisa iinkqubo zolawulo lokuziphatha kunye noyilo lwe ngxoxo Uncede ekwenzen imisebenzi evela isiqu kwesibhedlele.

jobs.title: Operator (REPROGRAPHICS)
jobs.summary: Provide reprographics and printing services at Groote Schuur Hospital, managing print requests, office organisation and monthly statistical reporting.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: General Education and Training Certificate (GETC)/Grade 9 (Std. 7). Experience: Appropriate Printing experience. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good planning, organisational, client care, interpersonal and communication skills. Ability to meet deadlines, Compiling and reporting on statistics. Computer literacy in (MS Word, Excel and Outlook). Undergo development courses.
jobs.duties: Deliver an effective and efficient Printing service for the entire Hospital. Effectively finish off all printing requests. Effective office organisation and liaise with external and internal clients. Ensure timeous submission of statistical data, as well as collate and compile a monthly report. Perform relieve duties when necessary. To relieve the Photocopy Centre and deliver urgent printing requests to remote Departments as well as assisting the Medico-Legal department with urgent copies. Provide assistance to Supervisor and HOD.
jobs.enquiries: Mr K Stevens Tel No: (021) 404-3238
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the advert for the POST 37/287: Deputy Director: Manager Hospital Development (5/8th Post) Directorate: Facilities and Infrastructure Management, Centre: Tygerberg Hospital, Redevelopment Office, Salary R582 684 (5/8th) per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual’s personal needs) advertised in the Public Service Vacancy 37 dated 16 October 2026, has been amended as follows: Deputy Director: Manager Hospital Development (5/8th Post) (3 Year-Contract) OTHER POSTS

af.title: Operator (REPROGRAFIEK)
af.summary: Verskaf reprodrukkuns- en drukdienste by Groote Schuur Hospital, bestuur drukversoeke, kantoororganisasie en maandelikse statistiese verslagdoening.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: General Education and Training Certificate (GETC)/Grade 9 (Std. 7). Ervaring: Toepaslike drukervaring. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goeie beplanning, organisatoriese, kliëntesorg, interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om sperdatums na te kom, opstel en rapporteer oor statistieke. Rekenaarvaardigheid in (MS Word, Excel en Outlook). Ondergaan ontwikkelingskursusse.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n effektiewe en doeltreffende drukdiens vir die hele Hospitaal. Voltooi alle drukversoeke effektief. Effektiewe kantoororganisasie en skakel met eksterne en interne kliënte. Verseker tydige voorlegging van statistiese data, asook versamel en stel 'n maandelikse verslag op. Verrig aflosspligte wanneer nodig. Om die Fotokopieersentrum af te los en dringende drukversoeke aan afgeleë Departemente te lewer, asook om die Medico-Legal-departement by te staan met dringende kopieë. Verskaf bystand aan Supervisor en HOD.

zu.title: Operator (REPROGRAPHICS)
zu.summary: Ukunikeza izinsiza zokuphrinta kanye nezinsiza zokushintsha amaphepha eGroote Schuur Hospital, ukuphatha izicelo zokuphrinta, ukuhlela ihhovisi nokubika ngokwesibalo nyanga zonke.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephiwa phansi: General Education and Training Certificate (GETC)/Grade 9 (Std. 7). Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanele sokuphrinta. Amandla (ulwazi/amaskilli): Amaxhubezi angcono, ahleliwe, anakekelwa abathengi, obuntu obuhle namaskhili okuxoxa. Ikono lokuhlangabezana namadeshi, ukuhlela nokubika ngokwesibalo. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha (MS Word, Excel and Outlook). Ukuba nakolunye uhlelo lokuthuthuka.
zu.duties: Ukuletha insiza yokuphrinta ezayo nesebenzayo kuyo yonke iHospital. Ukuqedela ngokusebenzayo yonke imibiko yokuphrinta. Ukuhlelwa kwendlu yokusebenza ngokusebenzayo nokuxoxa nabathengi bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi ulwazi lwesibalo luthunyelwa ngesikhathi, kanye nokuhlanganisa nokuhlela umbiko wanyanga zonke. Ukwenza imisebenzi yokusiza lapho kudingeka khona. Ukusiza iPhotocopy Centre futhi ulethe imibiko yokuphrinta ephuthumayo kuminyango ekude kanye nokusiza iMedico-Legal department ngamakopi aphuthumayo. Ukunika usizo kusiKhomishane kanye neHOD.

xh.title: Umlawuli (REPROGRAPHICS)
xh.summary: Nika iinkonzo zokuprinta nezoreprografiki eGroote Schuur Hospital, ulawule izicelo zokuprinta, ukuhlela kwiofisi nokuxela ngokubalo kwinyanga.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi: General Education and Training Certificate (GETC)/Grade 9 (Std. 7). Isiphiwo: Isiphiwo esifanelekileyo sokuprinta. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukuceba okulungileyo, ukuhlela, ukunakelela abathengi, ukuziphatha nabantu nokunxibelelana. Ikhono lokuzaliseza iimvela zemihla, ukuqamba nokuxela ngokubalo. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word, Excel and Outlook). Ukwenza iindonga zophuhliso.
xh.duties: Nika inkonzo yokuprinta esebenzayo nengasebenziyo yonke iHospital. Qedela ngokusebenzayo zonke izicelo zokuprinta. Ukuhlela kwiofisi okusebenzayo nokunxibelelana nabathengi bangaphakathi nabangaphandle. Qinisekisa ukungenisa ngexesha idatha yokubalo, kunye nokuhlanganisa nokudibanisa ingxelo yenyanga. Yenza imisebenzi yokumisela xa kufuneka. Ukumisela iPhotocopy Centre kwaye ufake izicelo zokuprinta eziphuthumayo kumasebe akude kunye nokuncedisa isebe leMedico-Legal ngeekhophi eziphuthumayo. Nika inkxaso kumLawuli nakwiHOD.

jobs.title: Medical Officer: Grade 1 to 3 (SURGERY) (20
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R501 per hour Grade 2: R572 per hour Grade 3: R662 per hour
jobs.summary: Medical Officers Grade 1 to 3 in surgery sought for Khayelitsha District Hospital, requiring HPCSA registration as a Medical Practitioner.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Practitioner. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Medical Practitioner. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration as a Medical Practitioner with the HPCSA in respect of SA qualified employees. 1-year relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognized foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years’ appropriate experience as a Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 6 years’ relevant experience after registration as a Medical Practitioner with a recognized foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. -Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate experience as a Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 11 years’ relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognized foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s license; willingness and ability to travel. Full commuted overtime (average 16 hours per week) is mandatory for the permanent/fulltime post. Ensure CPD compliance. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Ability to render a high quality general surgical service. Strong ethical principles with leadership, conflict resolution, organisational & counselling skills. Willingness and ability to teach at undergraduate and post graduate level. Digital systems competency. Enrolment to write General Surgery: FCS Part 1.
jobs.duties: Clinical service delivery in general surgery, including management of surgical patients in the emergency center, wards and outpatient department. Pre- operative, intra-operative and post operative care of surgical patients with surgical skills appropriate for the level of experience. Management of inpatient and outpatient referrals as well as after hour management of surgical patients. Clinical governance in the form of resource stewardship, accurate medical record keeping, morbidity & mortality reviews and case audits. Teaching & training activities at undergraduate and postgraduate level with participation in the departmental and hospital academic programs. -Actively Involvement in research. Systems input and participation within the Metro East Ecosystem. Contribution to improvement of internal systems within the general surgery service – both within the hospital and the Metro East ecosystem. Participation in the wider functions of the general surgical service within the hospital, both clinical and administrative, where reasonable and feasible.
jobs.enquiries: Dr A Goliath Tel No: (021) 360-4200; Dr S Gilbert Tel No: (021) 360-4200
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for a change in registration status). Candidates will be subjected to a practical assessment. It should be noted that advertised posts are linked to the Institution/ Facility that forms part of the Ecosystem Service platform. Upon appointment, incumbents will be expected to render clinical services across institutions in the Ecosystem, as needed to sustain health service delivery." It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the advert for the POST 37/287: Deputy Director: Manager Hospital Development (5/8th Post) Directorate: Facilities and Infrastructure Management, Centre: Tygerberg Hospital, Redevelopment Office, Salary R582 684 (5/8th) per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual’s personal needs) advertised in the Public Service Vacancy 37 dated 16 October 2026, has been amended as follows: Deputy Director: Manager Hospital Development (5/8th Post) (3 Year-Contract) OTHER POSTS

af.title: Mediese Offisier: Grade 1 tot 3 (CHIRURGIE) (20
af.summary: Mediese Offisiere Grade 1 tot 3 in chirurgie gesoek vir Khayelitsha District Hospital, wat HPCSA-registrasie as 'n Mediese Praktisyn vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie met die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie met die Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Mediese Praktisyn. Ervaring: Grade 1: Geen na registrasie as 'n Mediese Praktisyn by die HPCSA ten opsigte van Suid-Afrikaans gekwalifiseerde werknemers nie. 1 jaar se tersaaklike ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers vir wie dit nie vereis is om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis te verrig nie. Grade 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie met die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn ten opsigte van Suid-Afrikaans gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 6 jaar se tersaaklike ervaring na registrasie as 'n Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers vir wie dit nie vereis is om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis te verrig nie. -Grade 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie met die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn ten opsigte van Suid-Afrikaans gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 11 jaar se tersaaklike ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers vir wie dit nie vereis is om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis te verrig nie. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Geldige (Code B/EB) bestuurderslisensie; bereidwilligheid en vermoë om te reis. Volledige berekende oortyd (gemiddeld 16 ure per week) is verpligtend vir die permanente/tydvolle pos. Verseker CPD-nakoming. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om 'n hoë kwaliteit algemene chirurgiese diens te lewer. Sterk etiese beginsels met leierskap, konflikoplossing, organisatoriese en beradingsvaardighede. Bereidwilligheid en vermoë om op voor- en nagraadse vlak te onderrig. Digitale stelselsbevoegdheid. Inskrywing om General Surgery: FCS Part 1 te skryf.
af.duties: Kliniese dienslewering in algemene chirurgie, insluitend die bestuur van chirurgiese pasiënte in die noodsentrum, saale en buitepasientafdeling. Pre-operatiewe, intra-operatiewe en post-operatiewe sorg van chirurgiese pasiënte met chirurgiese vaardighede toepaslik vir die vlak van ervaring. Bestuur van in-pasient- en buitepasientverwysings asook na-ure bestuur van chirurgiese pasiënte. Kliniese bestuur in die vorm van hulpbronbewaring, akkurate mediese rekordhouding, morbiditeit- en mortaliteitsondersoeke en gevaloudits. Onderrig- en opleidingsaktiwiteite op voor- en nagraadse vlak met deelname aan die departementele en hospitale akademiese programme. Aktiewe betrokkenheid by navorsing. Stelseltoevoer en deelname binne die Metro East-ekosisteem. Bydrae tot verbetering van interne stelsels binne die algemene chirurgiese diens – beide binne die hospital en die Metro East-ekosisteem. Deelname aan die wyer funksies van die algemene chirurgiese diens binne die hospital, beide klinies en administratief, waar dit redelik en uitvoerbaar is.

zu.title: Umguli: Izinga 1 kuya ku-3 (UQHOLO) (20
zu.summary: Kudingwe Abarhuli bezinga 1 kuya ku-3 bolunyando eKhayelitsha District Hospital, kudingwa ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengoGuli.
zu.requirements: Isidingo sokugcina semfundo: Ithifikheti elifanele elivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengoGuli. Ukubhaliswa kubhaliso lwemisebenzi: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengoGuli. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho esidingwe ngemuva kokubhaliswa njengoGuli ku-HPCSA mayelana nabasebenzi abathweswe izifundo eNingizimu Afrika. Unyaka owodwa wesipiliyoni esifanele ngemuva kokubhaliswa njengoGuli kubhaliso lwamahlebezi lwelinye iganga lamazwe olusetshenzwayweni, kubasebenzi abathweswe izifundo kwamanye amazwe, abangadingeki ukuba benze isevisi Yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 2: Ucingo lweminyaka engu-5 yesipiliyoni esifanele njengoGuli ngemuva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengoGuli mayelana nabasebenzi abathweswe izifundo eNingizimu Afrika. Ucingo lweminyaka engu-6 yesipiliyoni esifanele ngemuva kokubhaliswa njengoGuli kubhaliso lwamahlebezi lwelinye iganga lamazwe olusetshenzwayweni, kubasebenzi abathweswe izifundo kwamanye amazwe, abangadingeki ukuba benze isevisi Yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. -Izinga 3: Ucingo lweminyaka engu-10 yesipiliyoni esifanele njengoGuli ngemuva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengoGuli mayelana nabasebenzi abathweswe izifundo eNingizimu Afrika. Ucingo lweminyaka engu-11 yesipiliyoni esifanele ngemuva kokubhaliswa njengoGuli kubhaliso lwamahlebezi lwelinye iganga lamazwe olusetshenzwayweni, kubasebenzi abathweswe izifundo kwamanye amazwe, abangadingeki ukuba benze isevisi Yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Isidingo sakho ngokwalo msebenzi: Ilayisensi evumelekile (Code B/EB) yokushayela; ukuzethemba nokuwukwazi ukuhamba. I-overtime epheleleko (okulinganiselwa emahoreni angu-16 ngesonto) iyadingeka kule sikhundla esihlala njalo. Qinisekisa ukuthi uyahambelana ne-CPD. Ukuzwana kwamakhono (ulwazi/izakhono): Ukukwazi ukunikeza isevisi yobunyephi eqinisekisiwe. Izimiso zokuziphatha ezomehlwe nokuba nolunye uhlelo lokuphatha, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlela nokweluleka. Ukuzethemba nokuwukwazi ukufundisa emazingeni abafundi abasha nabafundi abaphothulile. Isakhono sezinhlelo zedijithali. Ukubhaliswa ukugxuma ukuhola kumvuzo wezangqa: i-FCS Part 1.
zu.duties: Ukulethwa kwevula inkonzo yamagciwane eguqweni, okuhlanganisa nokuphathwa kwamalungu eNingizimu Afrika. Ukweluleka, ukulungisa nokuphatha amaphuzu kanye nabalingani bamalungu amanye. Ukuphathwa kwamalungu abantu kanye nabalingani bamalungu amanye, kanye nokuphathwa kwamalungu eNingizimu Afrika ngosuku olungalungile. Ukuphathwa kwesikhathi Esiguqwa njengomhloli wokuqinisekisa; ulondolozo lwemali, ukubhalisa amafayela okuqinisekisa kanye nokubuyekeza ukulimala nokushona nokwenza isilinganiso sezinkulumo. Ukuhlela nokufundisa abafundi emazingeni abasha kanye nalabo abathole imfundo ephilayo, kanye nokubamba iqhaza kwemibhalo eguqulayo. Ukuxhamuka ohlelweni lokuqinisekisa nokufunda ukwenza ucwaningo. Ukubandakanyeka ezinhlelweni eziguqulayo kanye nezinhlelo zomphakathi eKhayelitsha District Hospital. Ukubandakanyeka kwezinhlelo eziguqulayo namaphuzu ohlelo lwamalungu eNingizimu Afrika – kokubili esibhedlela nakwisistimu eKhayelitsha District Hospital.

xh.title: Dokhota wezempilo: Grade 1 ukuya ku-3 (SURGERY) (20
xh.summary: Abaphathi bezempilo Grade 1 ukuya kwi-3 kwezenzo zokuhlola bafunwa kwi Khayelitsha District Hospital, kwaye kufuneka abhaliswe kwi HPCSA njengompraktishini wezempilo.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezingowona qaphelo: Ifundo elifanelekileyo elivumela ukubhalisa kwi Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengompraktishini wezempilo. Ukubhalisa kunabhedu bokugqithisa: Ukubhalisa kwi Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengompraktishini wezempilo. Isipili: Grade 1: Akukho nanye emva kokubhalisa njengompraktishini wezempilo kwi HPCSA malunga nabasebenzi bagqithiselwe e-South Africa. I-1-year yesipili esifanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengompraktishini wezempilo kunabhedu wamazwe ngaphandle wezempilo ebonwayo malunga nabasebenzi bagqithiselwe kwamanye amazwe, abangafuneki ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufuneka e South Africa. Grade 2: Ubuncinane besipili seminyaka elingu-5 ekubeni ngumpraktishini wezempilo emva kokubhalisa kwi HPCSA njengompraktishini wezempilo malunga nabasebenzi bagqithiselwe e-South Africa. Ubuncinane besipili seminyaka elingu-6 emva kokubhalisa njengompraktishini wezempilo kunabhedu wamazwe ngaphandle wezempilo ebonwayo malunga nabasebenzi bagqithiselwe kwamanye amazwe, abangafuneki ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufuneka e South Africa. -Grade 3: Ubuncinane besipili seminyaka elingu-10 ekubeni ngumpraktishini wezempilo emva kokubhalisa kwi HPCSA njengompraktishini wezempilo malunga nabasebenzi bagqithiselwe e-South Africa. Ubuncinane besipili seminyaka elingu-11 emva kokubhalisa njengompraktishini wezempilo kunabhedu wamazwe ngaphandle wezempilo ebonwayo malunga nabasebenzi bagqithiselwe kwamanye amazwe, abangafuneki ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufuneka e South Africa. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqhuba (Code B/EB) esemthethweni; ulungelelwaniso nanako ukuhamba. I-overtime epheleleyo (ngaphezulu kwe-16 hours ngeveki) iyafuneka kwisithuba esingapheliyo/esize ngokupheleleyo. Qinisekisa ukuzaliseka kwe CPD. Iikhono (ulwazi/akhono): Amandla okunika inkonzo yokuhlola ngokubathi high quality. Iimigaqo yobugcisa eqinileyo enobuqhawe, ukusombulula iingxabano, ukulungelelanisa &akhono zokucebisa. Ulungelelwaniso nanako ukufundisa kwinqanaba lokufunda nangasemva kwalo. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zamakhompyutha. Ukubhalisa ukubhala i General Surgery: FCS Part 1.
xh.duties: Ukunikezwa konyango lweklinikhi kwizenzo zokuhlola ngokubanzi, kuquka nokulawula abaguli bezokuhlola kwiziko lokubakho iimeko ezibuthathaka, amagumbi okulala nesebe labantu abangabuye baye kwesibini. Ukunikezelwa konyango ngaphambi kokwenza ukuhlolwa, ngexesha lokwenza ukuhlolwa nakwenza ukuhlolwa emva kwalo kwabaguli bezokuhlola ngekhono lokuhlola elihambelana ninqanaba lobuchule. Ukulawula oku rhwelwa kwaye kugcinwe abaguli bangaphakathi nabangaphandle, nakulawulwa kwabaguli bezokuhlola ngemiyalezo yemigibe yexesha. Ukuqonda konyango kwelinani labantu ngokwemigaqo yokulawula iinkcubeli, ukugcina irekhodi yolwazi ngokuchanekileyo, nokuphonononga iimeko zokugula nokufa nokuhlola iimeko. Imisebenzi yokufundisa nokulungiselela kwinqanaba lokufunda esekuyoyo nakumaziko aphakamileyo ngokuthatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yemisebenzi yesebe nespitali. -Ukuthatha inxaxheba ngokuzimisela kwindima yokuphonononga. Ingxelo yenkqubo nokuthatha inxaxheba ngaphakathi kwe ndawo ye Metro East Ecosystem. Inxaxheba ekuphuculeni iinkqubo zangaphakathi kwinkonzo yezokuhlola ngokubanzi – kokubili ngaphakathi kwespitali nasekuhlaleni kwe Metro East ecosystem. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kumsebenzi ongabanzi wezokuhlola ngokubanzi ngaphakathi kwespitali, kokubini iklinikhi nolawulo, apho kufanelekileyo nakwenzekayo.

jobs.title: Administrative Clerk
jobs.summary: Administrative Clerk position at SAPS Cape Town requiring Grade 12 and computer literacy to manage correspondence, logistics, fleet, and filing systems.
jobs.requirements: Be in possession of Grade 12 / Senior Certificate / NCV Level 4 or equivalent qualification (NQF level 4 as recognized by SAQA). Relevant courses in the field of the post will serve as an added advantage. General computer literacy skills (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Office, MS PowerPoint and Outlook). Demonstrate competency in acting Independently, Professionally, Accountable and with Credibility. Good verbal and written communication skills. Sound planning, organizing, administrative and problem-solving skills. Strong interpersonal skills. Customer focus and responsiveness. Be willing to work under pressure.
jobs.duties: Administer incoming and outgoing correspondence. Administer logistics, vehicle fleet, leave records, weekly, monthly and quarterly returns. Provide administrative support relating to inspection on buildings, premises, and properties. Maintain, database/filing system/registers Protect integrity of unauthorised access of files/records registers and filing system.
jobs.enquiries: Customs House Building, Lower Heerengracht Street, Cape Town: HRC Mzomba Tel No: (021) 409 6584
jobs.applications: Complete application forms must be hand-delivered to: South African Police Service, Customs House Building, Lower Heerengracht Street, Cape Town, 8000, posted to Private Bag X9004, Cape Town, 8000 or emailed: Recruitment94@saps.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a Z83 Form (2021 version), obtainable from http://www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp, which must be accompanied with a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae. The post particulars and reference number of the post you are applying for, must be correctly specified on the application form. Please complete a separate application form for each post you wish to apply for. It is the responsibility of the applicants to submit applications timeously to the correct physical address as provided in the advertisement. Please note that applications submitted to an incorrect physical address will not be considered. Late applications will not be accepted or considered. Short-listed candidates will be required to produce originals of their Identity Document (ID), Senior Certificate and all educational qualifications obtained, service certificates from previous employers stating the occupation and motor vehicle driver’s license, before the interview. Qualifications and driver’s licences submitted will be subjected to verification with the relevant institutions. Applicants must have no previous criminal convictions or pending criminal/ departmental cases and shall allow their fingerprints to be taken and background enquiries to be made. Short-listed candidates may be subjected to a full security clearance process before or during any stage of employment. Short-listed candidates will be subjected to a vetting process which will include security screening, fingerprint screening, reference checking and verification of address, where necessary. All short-listed candidates, including the SMS shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, (a) a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, as well as (b) an integrity assessment (ethical conduct). Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Short-listed candidates for appointments to certain identified posts will be vetted in terms of the Criminal Law (Sexual Offences and Related Matters) Amendment Act, 2007 (Act No 32 of 2007) and the Children’s Act, 2005 (Act No 38 of 2005). A candidate whose particulars appear in either the National Register for Sex Offenders or Part B of the Child Protection Register, will be disqualified from appointment. Candidates are expected to disclose if he/ she is a respondent in an interim or final protection order in terms of the Domestic Violence Act, 1998 (Act no 116 of 1998) or Protection from Harassment Act, 2011 (Act No 17 of 2011), and may be disqualified from appointment. The Criminal Law (Forensic Procedures) Amendment Act, Act 37 of 2013 requires that all new appointments in the South African Police Service as from 31 January 2015 provide a buccal (inside cheek) sample to determine their forensic DNA profile. The forensic DNA profile derived from the sample will be loaded to the Elimination Index of the National Forensic DNA Database. Appointments will be made in terms of the Public Service Act, 1994 (Act No 103 of 1994) as applicable to the post environment. Persons who retired from the Public Service by taking a severance package, early retirement or medical retirement, as well as persons with previous convictions, are excluded. The South African Police Service is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer and it is the intention to promote representivity in the Public Service through the filling of these posts. Persons whose transfer/ appointment will promote representivity will therefore receive preference. The South African Police Service is under no obligation to fill a post after the advertisement thereof. Correspondence will be conducted with successful candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Administratiewe Klerk
af.summary: Administratiewe Klerk-posisie by SAPS Cape Town wat Graad 12 en rekenaarvaardigheid vereis om korrespondensie, logistiek, voertuigvloot en lêerstelsels te bestuur.
af.requirements: Beskik oor Graad 12 / Senior Sertifikaat / NCV Level 4 of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (NQF level 4 soos erken deur SAQA). Relevante kursusse in die veld van die pos sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Algemene rekenaarvaardigheidsvaardighede (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Office, MS PowerPoint en Outlook). Toon bevoegdheid om Onafhanklik, Professioneel, Verantwoordelik en met Geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Klank beplanning, organisatoriese, administratiewe en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Sterk interpersoonlike vaardighede. Kliëntfokus en reaksievermoë. Wees bereid om onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Administreer inkomende en uitgaande korrespondensie. Administreer logistiek, voertuigvloot, verlofrekords, weeklikse, maandelikse en kwartaallikse opgawes. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning met betrekking tot inspeksie van geboue, persele en eiendomme. Onderhou databasis/lêerstelsel/registers. Beskerm die integriteit van lêers/rekords, registers en lêerstelsel teen ongeoorloofde toegang.

zu.title: Administrative Clerk
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba ngumlawuli ohlezi e-SAPS Cape Town esidinga ibanga le-Grade 12 kanye nolwazi lwekhompyutha ukuphatha imibhalo, izimpahla, izimoto, kanye nezinhlelo zokuqoqa amafayela.
zu.requirements: Obek Grades 12 / Senior Certificate / NCV Level 4 noma izifundo ezilinganayo (NQF level 4 njengoba kwamukelwa yi-SAQA). Izifundo ezihlobene nendawo yesikhundla zizoba yinzuzo. Ulwazi olubanzi lwekhompyutha (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Office, MS PowerPoint kanye ne-Outlook). Khombisa ikhono lokusebenza izimele, ngobungcweti, ngobuwezwayo kanye nokwethembeka. Amakhono okukhuluma nokubhala kahle. Amakhono okuhle okuhlela, ukuqamba izinhlelo, lolawulo nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono amakhulu okusebenza nabantu. Ukuqinisekisa iklayenti nokuphendula. Ukube ukulungele ukusebenza ngokucindezelwa.
zu.duties: Lawula okufakwayo nokuphumayo okuyimibhalo. Lawula izimpahla, izimoto, amarekhodi okuhlala ekhaya, kanye nokubika okwenzelwa nsuku zonke, njenyanga zonke kanye nekwikhwtha. Nikeza inkxaso yolawulo ehlobene nokuhlola izakhiwo, izindawo, nezimpahla. Gcina uhlelo lwesisekelo data/uhlelo lokuqoqa amafayela/kusile namarekhodi. Vikela ukuphathwa kuhle kwamafayela/kusile nokungena okungagunyaziwe kwamarekhodi kanye nesesikhundla sokubhalisa amafayela.

xh.title: Umsekeli Wokulawulo
xh.summary: Isithuba somsekeli wolawulo kwi-SAPS Cape Town esifuna i-Grade 12 nolwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha ukulawula unxibelelwano, izinto ezihamba nendlela, inkqubo yezimoto, kunye nenkqubo yokugcina iifayile.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka ube ne-Grade 12 / Senior Certificate / NCV Level 4 okanye isifanekiso esilinganayo (NQF level 4 njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA). Iinkqubo ezimalini kwinkalo yesithuba ziya kuba ngumonde olongezelelekile. Amakhono ajikelezile ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Office, MS PowerPoint and Outlook). Khombisa ikhono lokuziphatha ngokuzimele, ngobungcali, ngokubenyamezela nangobugqatya. Amakhono amabalincinci okuthetha nokuBhala. Amakhono aqinisekileyo ukuqamba iindaba, ukuhlela, ulawulo nokuxazulula iingxaki. Amakhono amaninzi okuziphathisa ngabanye. Ukugxila kumthengi nempendulo. Makube lukhululekile ukusebenza ngcangcazelo.
xh.duties: Lawula unxibelelwano olungena noluphuma. Lawula izinto ezihamba nendlela, inkqubo yezimoto, amarekhodi ekhathazo lemfuyo, ngee-returns zanveki, zenyanga nezesiganxezu. Nikeza inkxaso yolawulo ngokuphathelele ukuphonononga izakhiwo, iindawo, kunye namapropati. Phatha, idatabase/inkqubo yokugcina iifayile/irejista. Sithintela ukufikelela okungenasimiso kwifayile/irekhodi yamarejista nenkqubo yokugcina iifayile.
